rows.title: Lt Ouroumov's Worm CYOA V17
rows.titleText:
Two entities spiral through space, past stars and planets alike. Their parts shift between dimensions. Approaching a world, one you recognize as Earth, they shatter into hundreds of millions of pieces into millions of Earths. The shattered pieces, shards of the entities, take root on empty Earths before bonding with humans. Humans at their lowest, would go on to learn through conflict. Through this, they would advance the entity.

Something went wrong with their cycle this time. A mistake causes the more intelligent of the entities to crash into a planet where it is, not long after, put down. The entity's shards remain, in the hands of those who wish the death of the other entity, but things are not so easy. Even with all the parahumans, those bonded with the entities' shards, working in perfect unison, humanity would stand no chance against the remaining entity in a fight.

However, you may change that.

One day, you went to sleep and ...

objects.text:
Don't want to deal with Scion but still want to enjoy the Worm-verse? I have the solution!

Powers don’t come from Entities, instead Shards are a symbiotic species. When a colony migrates to a planet and nests, it grants the inhabitants powers. After some time, the Shards will reproduce and smaller colonies will migrate to other worlds. None of this brings about the end of the world, you're safe. (You lose the ability to pick perks or drawbacks related to Scion/Eden and specific ones related to Entities)

However, through some strange twist of fate, Cauldron still exists. Doctor Mother has found a dying colony of Shards and is exploiting the corpse to create vials. Eidolon still created and controls the Endbringers. With no Entity in charge, the rules are slightly different. Powers slowly grow as they are used and the Shards grow with the user. The world no longer exists on borrowed time, except the one imposed by human nature that is.
objects.title: Entities, what are those Entities you speak of?

objects.text:
Don't want to deal with Shards either but still want to enjoy the Worm-verse?

Powers don’t come from Shards. All powers are shardless, even those under the Shard category. Trigger events are replaced by Awakenings, which work in similar ways but do not necessarily require a negative event. 

However, through some even stranger twist of fate, Cauldron still exists. Doctor Mother has the power to create vials that grant powers. Eidolon still created and controls the Endbringers. With no Entity or Shards in charge, the rules are slightly different. Powers slowly grow in strength and versatility the more they are used. The world no longer exists on borrowed time, except the one imposed by human nature that is.

objects.text: This is the day Taylor Hebert, the primary focus of Wildbow's visions, was shoved into a locker and triggered with the power to control arthropods. If you don't change anything, you have about two years and five months before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: January 3rd, 2011

objects.text: This is a couple of days before Taylor Hebert, the primary focus of Wildbow's visions, first debuted as a Cape, an active Parahuman, and fought Lung, the Dragon of Kyushu. If you don't change anything, you have two years, two months, and thirteen days before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: April 7, 2011

objects.text: You find yourself half a month before the start of Ward. Sorry, it seems I’ve gotten the wrong info; Wildbow is a post-cognitive, not a precognitive.
objects.title: July 1st, 2015

objects.text: This is the day the Simurgh attacks Canberra, Australia. If you don't change anything, you have about 2 years and 4 months  before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: February 24th, 2011

objects.text: This is the day before Leviathan attacks Brockton Bay, drawn by gang wars, the subsequent chaos, and several reasons unknown to the general public. Unless something extremely radical happens, Leviathan will not change its purpose.
objects.title: May 15th, 2011

objects.text: This is the day the Slaughterhouse 9 start their recruiting run in Brockton Bay. If you don't change anything, you have about two years and fourteen days before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: June 7th, 2011

objects.text: This is the day Echidna breaks out of her cell out of despair and rage, starting a series of events that unravel both Cauldron’s existence to the world and the Triumvirate’s role in it. If you don’t change anything, you have about 2 years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: June 20th, 2011

objects.text: This is the day when Behemoth attacked New Delhi, India. After a devastating battle, Behemoth fell under Scion's beams. This moment became a turning point in history, marking the first time an Endbringer faced his End.
objects.title: July 26th, 2011

objects.text: This is the day when the new Fourth Endbringer, Khonsu, attack Japan. He was driven back only after three days of intense battles involving both local and international heroes.
objects.title: January 20th, 2012

objects.text: This was the day when the last Endbringers known to humanity—Bohu and Tohu, also called The Twins—revealed themselves to the world. They attacked Bucharest and Los Angeles one after the other, and due to their then-unknown powers, the battle was lost.
objects.title: October 10th, 2012

objects.text: It is Gold Morning. Jack Slash will convince Zion to kill the entirety of humanity, in what would later be called Gold Morning, today. You have less than a day to prepare, it’s best to make the most of it.
objects.title: June 20th, 2013

objects.text: This is the day the Simurgh attacks Madison, Wisconsin. If you don't change anything, you have about 3 years and 6 months before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: December 23rd, 2009

objects.text: You will find yourself on the day before Emma Barnes—Taylor Hebert's childhood friend—and her dad gets attacked by the ABB. You have about four years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: Summer, 2009

objects.text: This is a week before Annette Hebert, Taylor Hebert's mother, dies in a car crash while using her cell phone. If you don't change anything, you have about five years before the remaining entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: September, 2008

objects.text: This is a few days before the ‘Boston Games’, as it came to be known, even starts. Villains from everywhere, such as Damsel of Distress, will come and try to fill the gap of power that appeared after the Protectorate arrested the major villains of Boston. If you don't change anything, you have about six years before the remaining entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: Spring, 2007

objects.text: This is the day before the Endbringer, Leviathan, attacks Newfoundland. However, if you change things here without being careful, Dragon, the benevolent AI, could end up remaining Richter's housekeeping AI. Or, worse, release her too early, according to Wildbow's predictions, she won't be so benevolent. You have about eight years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: May 8th, 2005

objects.text: This is the day the Simurgh first appears and attacks Lausanne, Switzerland. If you don't change anything, you have about ten years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: December 30th, 2002

objects.text: The Protectorate and PRT will deploy to Ellisburg, New York in the hopes of eliminating Nilbog. At the end of the day, all but two of the PRT agents will have been killed, Ellisburg will be quarantined, and Nilbog will be designated as an S-Class threat.
objects.title: February 2nd, 2001

objects.text: This is the day before the Siberian kills Hero. The Siberian is, in fact, Dr. William Manton’s projection, using her daughter’s twisted visage. However, his projection is powerful, up to damaging even the invulnerable Alexandria. Few things can stop the Siberian and what little can, just pop the projection temporarily. By default, you have nearly thirteen years before the remaining Entity goes on its multiversal genocide.
objects.title: September 14th, 2000

objects.text: This is the day before Leviathan attacks Kyushu. November 2nd is also the first appearance of Lung, who would do more damage to Leviathan than any other Cape before him. By default, you have nearly fourteen years before the remaining Entity goes on its multiversal genocide.
objects.title: November 1st, 1999

objects.text: This is the day Leviathan first appears and attacks Oslo, Norway. If you don't change anything, you have about seventeen years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: June 9th, 1996

objects.text: This is the day Behemoth first appears and attacks the Marun oil field in Iran. If you don't change anything, you have about twenty years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: December 13th, 1992

objects.text: This is the day that Alexandria, Eidolon, Hero, and Legend form the original Protectorate team. If you don't change anything, you have about twenty-five years before the remaining Entity attempts to commit multiversal genocide.
objects.title: May 1st, 1988

objects.text: May 19th is the day before the first appearance of Scion, Earth's greatest hero. It is also the first appearance of anything truly extraterrestrial or supernatural on Earth. You know the truth about Scion, though, don't you? By default, you have over thirty years before the remaining Entity goes on its multiversal genocide.
objects.title: May 19th, 1982

objects.text: During a riot on Earth Cheit, Fume Hood was shot, leading to her having a broken trigger event and transforming her into the Titan Eve, this event was the final straw for the ongoing stress caused on reality due to powers, and thus 'broke the ice'. Causing an uncountable amount of black lightning-like reality cracks to spread throughout multiple earths. About a dozen capes also began to break, turning into Titans.
objects.title: The Ice Breaks

objects.text: This is the day Goddess, the former ruler of Earth Shin, launches her full-scale attempt to conquer Earth Gimel. If you don't change anything, she will first subdue Team Breakthrough by indoctrinating them via her Master power before then attacking the Parahuman prison to recruit its inmates to her cause.
objects.title: Goddess’s Takeover

objects.text: You appear between 1900 and 1980, well before Scion makes his appearance.
objects.title: 1900s

objects.text: You appear during the 19th Century (1800 to 1899). Due to the hazards of temporal displacement, you can at best choose a decade when to arrive.
objects.title: 19th Century

objects.text: You appear between the 15th and 18th century (1400 to 1799). Due to the hazards of temporal displacement, you can at best choose a period within 20 years to arrive and your exact date of arrival will be random.
objects.title: 15th-18th Century

objects.text: You appear between the 6th and 14th centuries (500 to 1399). You find yourself among the Fall of the Roman Empire and the beginning of The Medieval Era. Due to the hazards of temporal displacement, you can at best choose a period within 30 years to arrive and your exact date of arrival will be random.
objects.title: The Middle Ages

objects.text:
You will emerge somewhere between the 8th century BCE and the 5th century CE. This era spans the time of Homer's famous epics, the Iliad and the Odyssey, through the rise and fall of mighty empires, culminating in the decline of the Roman Empire.

However, due to the inherent risks of temporal displacement, you can, at best, narrow your destination to a specific period within a 40-year window. But even so, the precise date of your arrival will remain entirely unpredictable.
objects.title: Classical Antiquity

objects.text:
You'll be transported to an era that stretches from the dawn of the Bronze Age to its eventual decline—sometime between the 33rd and 7th century BCE. This epoch marked humanity's first forays into metallurgy, the transition from stone to bronze—a revolutionary shift that reshaped tools, weapons, and societies alike.

It was a time of extraordinary transformation, defined by the flourishing of agriculture, the rise of cultural complexity, and the early adoption of writing in certain regions—a period when the seeds of civilization began to take root and flourish, setting the foundation for the world to come.

While you have some leeway in determining the general arrival time, the exact date will remain partially unpredictable.
objects.title: The Bronze Ages

objects.text: You are dropped in between two million and two hundred thousand years ago. You have some leeway in choosing when you drop in.
objects.title: Dawn of Man

objects.text: You appear millions of years before humans even began. Your earliest starting point is the end of the Triassic Period. While there is some leeway for when you appear, the latest you can arrive is before the mass extinction event.
objects.title: Jurassic Period

objects.text: You appear 4.5 billion years on planet Earth, back when it was essentially an enormous cloud of dust and gas. At least you get to watch the creation of planet Earth live in front of you over the course of a long period of time. If you find yourself getting bored, should you still be alive, bring something with you to stave off the boredom.
objects.title: Birth of Planet Earth

objects.text: You find yourself placed right after the Big Bang. 13.7 billion years before the start of the canon story. You can choose to appear before the Big Bang and witness the creation of a Universe.
objects.title: Dawn of Creation

objects.text: You find yourself half a century after Gold Morning.
objects.title: June 24th, 2063

objects.text:
You’re a thousand years late. The world has moved on. The connected Earths now bear only a vague resemblance to what once was.

Gold Morning, the Endbringers, the Titans—are regarded as distant history and fairytales told to children.
objects.title: June 24th, 3013

rows.title: Scenario (Alternate Earths)
rows.titleText: These scenarios can be used to choose a starting point for Alternate Earths. If the universe has multiple openings or starting points (ex: Harry Potter, Mass Effect, etc.), you can choose relative to which "episode" the start is. You have some flexibility regarding the dates if they can be matched to appropriate canon events.

objects.text: You replace one of the people that already existed on Earth Bet. This includes any of the Original Companions, provided you pick the option with the appropriate strength level, even if they may not appear in the story normally. You keep their power if they are already triggered, in addition to any powers you choose here. You shall have all their memories and skills, you'll be able to act just like they did. You can decide how far you merge, if it's just your mind in their body with their memories and skills, or if your personalities merge completely. If you want you can decide how this works if you want to figure out a way to make this not stealing someone's body, mind, and soul from them. If you Self-Insert into someone who has yet to Trigger, if you Trigger or Second-Trigger you will gain their powers.
objects.title: Character-Insert

objects.text: Thankfully, whatever method was used to make the portal, it allows you to be reincarnated as someone who fits your criteria. You shall have all their memories and skills, you'll be able to act just like they did. You can decide how far you merge, if it's just your mind in their body with their memories and skills, or if your personalities merge completely. If you want you can decide how this works if you want to figure out a way to make this not stealing someone's body, mind, and soul from them.
objects.title: Reincarnation

objects.text: Your body is remade for you, just as it was. You will have no identity on Earth Bet.
objects.title: Drop-In

objects.text: You reincarnate into an original character, you can choose their appearance, age, and occupation freely.
objects.title: Original Character

objects.text: You become the twin of an existing character. With this option, you can choose to also have the same power as your twin, with your trigger events being adjusted so that things work out.
objects.title: Twin

objects.text: You are the sibling (older or younger) of an existing character.
objects.title: Sibling

objects.text: You are a member of the family (cousin, and so on) of an existing character.
objects.title: Family Member

objects.text:
Your consciousness is made into a Positronic Brain and installed into the body of an android or gynoid. This body will be able to mostly pass as a human from the outside.

Your chassis is not Tinkertech, merely advanced technology.
objects.title: Android / Gynoid

objects.text:
Your consciousness is made into a Positronic Brain and installed into the chassis of a robot. This body will not be able to pass as a human.

Your chassis is not Tinkertech, merely advanced technology.
objects.title: Robot

objects.text:
Your consciousness is housed within a bioengineered body designed for a specific purpose. 

Your form is not Tinkertech, merely the result of advanced bioengineering.
objects.title: Biomorph

objects.text:
Your consciousness is digitized into an artificial intelligence roughly on par with a human intelligence.

Your mind is perfectly emulated within a neural network to function like a human brain, which includes emotions and other psychosomatic processes.

Due to this, you won't experience any sudden personality changes or memory loss in your newfound state of existence.

Your mind can more easily process large quantities of data, is slightly more capable of multitasking, and gains an affinity for learning and applying modern-day programming languages.

Your mind can be housed on any computer system with enough processing power and storage space.
objects.title: Artificial Intelligence

objects.text:
Your consciousness is digitized into an artificial intelligence and installed into the central processor of a construct, the fusion of organic, cybernetic technology, and artificial intelligence. The ability of this body to pass as human depends on which chassis, modules, and appearance you chose. While you are a pure-software AI and capable of extending parts of yourself into other system, you only function at optimal performance when inside of your construct body. 

Full transfer of your consciousness into an external server is possible but, unless extreme care is taken, you will rapidly suffer memory corruption and require a full defragmentation immediately once you return to your body.

Your chassis is not Tinkertech, merely advanced technology.
objects.title: Construct

objects.text: Your sex does not change from your previous life.
objects.title: Same Sex

objects.text: You are a biological male.
objects.title: Male

objects.text: You are some mix of a biological male and female.
objects.title: Intersex

objects.text: You are a biological female. Interesting fact: most parahumans are female.
objects.title: Female

rows.title: Sex
rows.titleText: Your sex, aka whether your body is male, female, or other.

objects.text: Your gender does not change from your previous life.

rows.title: Gender
rows.titleText: Your consciousness is being tweaked to be compatible with your chosen body, so you don't need to spend months trying to figure out how to move your body correctly. While you're at it, do you want to change your gender? (Gender is what you identify as.)

objects.text: You have not yet started school. If you have started school, you're in preschool or kindergarten. You are going to have trouble caping and may become famous as one of the youngest Capes ever. Younger capes tend to be more powerful.
objects.title: 0 to 6 years old

objects.text: You have not yet started puberty and are in elementary school. Younger capes tend to be more powerful, but the Wards don't allow them to do much.
objects.title: 6 to 10 years old

objects.text: You're starting puberty and finishing elementary school. Younger capes tend to be more powerful, but the Wards don't allow them to do much.
objects.title: 10 to 12 years old

objects.text: You are in middle school, and unless you're a late bloomer, puberty has started or is coming soon.
objects.title: 12 to 14 years old

objects.text: You're in high school and have started getting used to puberty. You might be able to get a driver's permit.
objects.title: 14 to 18 years old

objects.text: You have either completed college, just completed college, or are currently in college. You have finished the worst of puberty or completed it all together. You're also a legal adult. If you're 21 or older, you can legally drink alcohol. In Brockton Bay, you're eligible for joining the Protectorate rather than the Wards, though some other cities require you to be at least 22 rather than 18.
objects.title: 18 to 24 years old

objects.text: You're a young adult, but no longer in college. Unless you're going for a PhD, you're probably out of college. Unless you're jobless, you are a member of the workforce.
objects.title: 24 to 29 years old

objects.text: You are an adult. You're part of the workforce and you have more worldly experience than most other Capes. Newly triggered adult Capes are rare.
objects.title: 30 to 50 years old

objects.text: You are middle-aged going on elderly. Middle-aged capes are very rare. Take some bonus points.
objects.title: 50 to 70 years old

objects.text: You are elderly. You are nearly unique in how old of a Cape you are. I suggest your costume be a cosplay of Gandalf or Dumbledore. Here are some bonus points.
objects.title: 70+ years old

rows.title: Age
rows.titleText:
How old is your body? Answer: Negative something seconds old, it hasn't been created yet. How old is your body going to look, though? Your body will biologically be that old.
As long as it fits the chosen age range, you can choose the exact age.

objects.text: You look like a very attractive female. If you're male, your face will be feminine and your body slender. Additionally, you can no longer get acne.
objects.title: Beautiful

objects.text: You look like a very attractive male. If you're female, your face will look like that of a feminine man and you won't have any very obvious signs of being female. Additionally, you can no longer get acne.
objects.title: Handsome

objects.text: You look very attractive, but you don't necessarily look like one sex or the other. Additionally, you can no longer get acne.
objects.title: Androgynous

objects.text: You're moderately attractive. Additionally, you can no longer get acne.
objects.title: Attractive

objects.text: You're not ugly, but you're not exactly good-looking either. You won't be prone to getting acne.
objects.title: Average

objects.text: You're either ugly or somewhat unattractive and prone to getting acne.
objects.title: Ugly

objects.text: You are hideous. You're also prone to getting acne.
objects.title: Hideous

objects.text: You are visibly scarred, with these scars notably affecting your appearance.
objects.title: Scarred

objects.text: Age: Early Twenties Gender: Male Background Leet is popularly known by his online streams with his partner in crime, Über. Using his tech to replicate characters and weapons from videogames, they committed multiple crimes while simulating said games; one particularly controversial being imitating GTA by beating prostitutes. Generally unpleasant and annoying, Leet has difficulty making allies, and has an inferiority complex. Despite all this, he is capable of trust and friendship as shown with Über, and can be a power multiplier when guided by someone smart. Powers Leet is a tinker with access to all tinker technology trees that the Entities deem safe. However he has several key drawbacks, primarily the fact that he can only ever create something once. The more similar a tinkertech creation is to something that he's made before or the more he worked within a particular idea or field, the higher the chance of a creation misfiring or failing. Alternatively, the more different his creation is in terms of design, mechanisms, functions, etc; from anything he made before, the more likely it is to work. His shard has a strong dislike of him due to his lack of imagination and from playing too safe, which reduces their gain of Data, and will attempt to sabotage him within his constraints in the Cycle.

rows.title: Identity
rows.titleText:
You've chosen to character-insert into someone you know of from Wildbow's predictions. Who will it be?

All data is assuming it's April 8, 2011.

If you choose a Scenario prior to your chosen person's birth, you will awaken when your brain first develops in the womb. You will not go insane from this.

Warning: If you character-insert into a member of the Protectorate, Wards, or New Wave, you will likely be put under M/S protocols either due to Gallant's sudden inability to read your emotions and/or Panacea's sudden inability to see your brain, or the fact that Gallant can still see your emotions and Panacea can still see your brain causing them to believe you've been Mastered (mind controlled). 

Alternatively if you chose Reincarnation as your Incarnation method this is the section where if you reincarnated as a twin, sibling or family member you pick which character you are related to.

In addition to any powers you may or may not purchase you can choose to have powers similar to the character you are related to with a similar level of strength or even entirely identical if you are their twin. You may also choose if your new family has powers similar to any you’ve purchased.

addons.text: Yura was approached and given the task to create a Tinker tech suit that perfectly fit Anarchy. She designed a suit equipped with adaptive technology that could incorporate and enhance other technologies while maintaining the appearance of a stylish, mundane suit. Due to the suit’s unique properties, Anarchy can generate advanced materials at a faster pace and, with sufficient study, even reproduce Tinker-made unique materials for his Tinkertech. This suit not only bolsters Anarchy’s capabilities but also assists with Tinkering due to hidden tools inside. Another set was made as a frilly Magical Girl outfit, but not a single person still alive has seen it.
addons.title: Chaos Regalia

objects.text:
Name: Xavier Mustaffa
Gender: Male
Age: 16
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful 

Power: (Machine World + Reconfiguration)
Anarchy has the ability to generate advanced materials out of his body and use them to construct tinkertech. Specifically, Anarchy's specialty is Adaptive technology, meaning their tinker tech has the ability to alter and improve itself based on its environment and the data it collects. Furthermore, all the tinkertech constructed by Anarchy can self-repair and self maintenance, which makes them highly reliable. His most noteworthy creation is the Sentinel, an automaton capable of analyzing and gaining capabilities that can counter parahumans.

Personality:
Anarchy’s mental state is fragile and unreliable, with a co-occurrence of multiple psychiatric disorders. He struggle with schizophrenia, a severe mental illness characterized by delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, and cognitive impairment, along with personality disorders, including Bipolar Type 1, characterized by manic and depressive episodes, and DID, Dissociative Identity Disorder, formerly known as Multiple Personality Disorder, where the patient has distinct, alternate personalities. This combination causes Anarchy to have an unstable personality, which may manifest as mood swings, changes in motivation and energy, as well as unstable interpersonal relationships, trust, and reliability. Despite this, he continues to rule over Malaysia, and never harms his citizens unless given a reason to.

Background:
Anarchy has been categorized as an S-Class threat, meaning that he possess extraordinary powers and capabilities, and his actions, if left unchecked, could result in catastrophic consequences. Additionally, he holds a position of power as the Warlord of Malaysia, overseeing a large territory with millions of inhabitants. Interestingly, despite his dangerous reputation, he is well-loved by his subjects.

By choosing him, you will enter a friendly partnership where you gain access to all of Malaysia’s resources at the cost of your assistance in certain matters. Additionally, it is recommended to be wary as Anarchy may attack you at any given moment for no apparent reason.
objects.title: Anarchy

addons.text: One of Yura’s odd jobs commissioned her to create a suit for Professor. A black and red suit that amplifies the strength of the powers he gives. The suit is equipped with all kinds of self-defense armaments and even a lie detector. It also comes with a way for the user to not appear on any technological devices such as cameras or photographs.
addons.title: Covenant Suit

objects.text:
Name: Aaron 
Gender: Male
Age: 47
Appearance: Attractive

Power: (Flint + Network Hub + Geas)
Professor possesses the power to cause people to develop a Corona Pollentias and trigger. In order to use this ability, Professor must strike a deal with the person who will be granted abilities. The person must accept the terms of the deal, and after that, they are automatically compelled to follow through their end of the bargain and unable to change or back out of it. Furthermore, Professor has the ability to access all the abilities that have been granted to others. 

Personality:

Professor is an enigmatic and secretive individual, known to be incredibly cagey about his motivations and desires. One of the first powers he garnered through his deals was the ability to predict the future, and upon doing so, he was presented with a grim vision of the world's end. Given this sobering insight, Professor devotes a great deal of his time and energies towards nurturing and empowering individuals who are well-equipped to leverage their abilities for the betterment of society, ensuring that they are wisely utilized, avoiding a potential catastrophe brought on by the wrong hands. Ultimately, the Professor's opaque mannerisms and secretive nature belie an altruistic goal of ensuring the survival of the human population by providing a helping hand to the right individuals.

Background:

Professor's backstory has long been shrouded in mystery, as he is known to have covered up any traces of his origins. All that is known is that he originally hails from Earth Nun and used a combination of his abilities to traverse to Earth Bet, “Ground Zero”, due to its status as the epicenter of the end of the world. Despite the veil of secrecy enveloping him, it is an observable fact that he possesses a keen artistic aptitude in drawing as well as a fondness of apples. There are rumor's of having seen him with a lover, a woman wearing a fedora but no proof has been found.
objects.title: Professor

addons.text: With the help of the Professor, Jacob is far more controlled. This means that while Jacob will not be causing mass destruction, he will instead focus of undoing all the good the Professor and you will do, even try to bribe the two of you into being villains like him.
addons.title: The Devil’s Game

addons.text: Jacob decided to join the Avant Garde, seeking more power and desiring to be near to his idol. Jacob acts as a prison and warden, punishing and torturing those deserving of it. He keeps control over the criminal underworld throughout all worlds, keeping things chaotic yet far from the innocent.
addons.title: Lord 666

addons.text:
One of the strangest jobs she’s had, she was commissioned to create a suit that is also a clown outfit. A black and red crowned clown costume that incorporates various technologies in it. She doesn’t exactly know who wanted it, but after receiving the information and making the costume, it was taken. She did not get paid for making it.

Jacob’s powers obtain a stronger copy of the power he caused to trigger. His trigger sight is capable of guiding him to create different events to plan out what kind of powers he could get through a predictive algorithm attached to his suit.
addons.title: Regal Jester

objects.text:
Name: Jacob Black
Gender: Male
Age: 23
Appearance: Attractive

Power: Making of a Tragedy (+ Addon)

His power allows him to “see” people’s trigger events, whether they can trigger at all is not important. From there, he can make plans that causes people to trigger. His plans allow him to permanently scar the minds of those he triggers, in a way much like Simurgh bombs. He will gain weaker versions of whatever power his target triggers, in a similar manner to that of a cluster.

Backstory:

Jacob originates from a different Earth, using his powers to travel to alternate Earths. 

When Jacob was still a youth, he was nearly left behind in a bunker after his parents told him the world had ended. Instead, he elected to eliminate his parents and survive as a homeless youngster. This traumatic experience has since shaped Jacob, fostering his callous and independent demeanor.

Jacob doesn’t care for cape culture, seeing it as a stupid and boring “game”. He was amongst the first people The Professor has ever given powers to, from before he gained his precognition. He saw the Professor as someone strong, and wished to emulate him. 

In an attempt to gain The Professor's attention, he formed a group he calls The Court of Jesters, crowning himself the Crown Prince of Crime.

Personality:

Jacob is a psychopathic individual with an overwhelming desire to control the fate of others, treating them as mere pawns in his games.  He revels in the prospect of wielding power over others, reveling in the sensation of manipulation and control. His lack of empathy and compassion, coupled with his willingness to resort to extreme measures to achieve their ends, makes them a daunting and unpredictable opponent.

Note: 

Among the many powers Jacob has, one of them allows him to travel to different earths. If you don’t rein him in, there is a good chance you will be getting a Kill Order for being an accomplice.
objects.title: Crown Prince of Crime

addons.text: While not one of Yura’s strongest or most notable pieces of equipment, she met a teenager who hides herself in a pocket dimension. Out of pity and as a fellow introvert, Yura created a comfortable jacket for Ellis. The nameless jacket enhances Ellis’s powers and creates bigger and faster effects than before. But it’s also a very comfy self-cleaning jacket that can be worn to stay cool during hot days and warm during cold days.
addons.title: A Comfortable Jacket

objects.text:
Name: Ellis Cadmon
Gender: Depends
Age: 18
Appearance: Androgynous Young Adult

Perks: (Negentropy, Blind Spot)

Items: (Secret Lair)

Power: (Liminal Landscaper, Liminal Avatar)

The Mysterious Architect is able to create an extradimensional space at the the thresholds of physical boundaries, these extra dimensional spaces can be manipulated and enhanced over time to give the Mysterious architect even more space and detail of manipulation. Any being that crosses the threshold in the same direction that the Liminal space was created will cause them to enter the liminal space instead. 

The Mysterious architect while within the boundaries of their liminal landscapes can turn immaterial and create an avatar out of the same materials and creatures that enter the landscape with the same detail as the landscape they are currently in. With the boost from Negentropy they are able to create an avatar in any Liminal landscape and travel to that landscape even if it isnt directly connected.

Personality:

Ellis Cadmon was a runaway teen who dropped out of Highschool, and had been homeless for the most part of the last year until they stumbled upon the entrance to a secret underground lair. It wasn't the largest lair and could probably only accommodate a team of 10 people. It looked like it had been abandoned for awhile, but they had found a way to lock the door which meant they should be relatively safe from the outside and anyone that might try and do them harm. Ellis ran away from a bad home life, and struggles with pretty severe ADHD and is fairly introverted and lacking trust in most people. However if one manages to worm their way past the carefully crafted defense put up in the social path, Ellis transitions into a quiet but chatty friend.
objects.title: Mysterious architect

addons.text: A shapeshifting suit for a Changer, Asphalt was commissioned to create a suit that can be worn by someone who can alter shape. She created a self-repairing suit that can be worn and torn as much as possible while allowing it to not be distracting in combat. The suit greatly improves the speed at which Hellhound grows.
addons.title: Enterprise Suit

objects.text:
Name: N/A
Gender: Male
Age: 21
Appearance: Handsome Case 53

Power: (Dragon of Kyushu, Lord of Cinder)

At his base, Hellhound is extremely resilient, heals rapidly, and has pyrokinesis focusing on cinders and ash. When faced with conflict, turns into a three headed Hellhound that thrives on combat, exponentially growing both in size and power with each moment he spends fighting. This also affects his defenses, so getting hit with poison would give him poison resistance that would then scale with him. Once out of conflict he can stay in that form for 2 hours, after which he will revert to his base form while permanently retaining 10% of the power from his other form.

Personality:

Hellhound values trust and loyalty above all else, a product of having been betrayed by the person who sheltered him when he was most vulnerable. He is very distant and cold towards strangers, but to friends he is playful and outgoing, always the life of the party. 

Background:

Hellhound began his journey in Columbus, Ohio, as a lost and naive Case 53, unaware of his own identity and purpose. Unfortunately, he soon crossed paths with a malevolent human trafficker who sought to exploit his vulnerability. The criminal, sensing an opportunity to take advantage of his misfortune, feigned a desire to offer him shelter. However, upon Hellhound falling asleep, the trafficker attempted to drug him, hoping to subjugate him and force him into compliance. Despite their attempt, Hellhound's robust regenerative abilities prevented any harm to him. In response, Hellhound swiftly retaliated, brutally attacking and torturing the trafficker until he divulged the details about the organisation he worked for. Thereafter, Hellhound claimed dominion over the organisation and renamed it 'Cerberus'. Utilizing this force at his disposal, Hellhound proceeded to abolish human trafficking and several other crimes while maintaining a stranglehold on the region. Criminals shudder at the mention of his name, and law enforcement agencies label him as a 'Warlord', while the citizens respect and adore him. Despite his intimidating and uncompromising reputation, Hellhound is regarded as a benevolent ruler, whose firm but fair governance has transformed the area into a thriving sanctuary
objects.title: Hellhound

addons.text: Yura was commissioned to create a Japanese-themed Magical Girl shrine maiden outfit for Artemis. It greatly amplifies the strength of her friends. The outfit comes with accessories for her friends that, when equipped, allow them to “store” a form. When Artemis rides one of her Friends, it can gain a boost related to both the current and stored form.
addons.title: Yin & Yang

objects.text:
Name: Eva
Gender: Female
Age: 11
Appearance: Beautiful

Power: (Animal Friends, Improved Friends)

Eva can summon two projections of animals, they can be any form or size she wishes but usually keeps them as large wolves. These animal friends can each have 20sp worth of powers that Eva can change whenever she wants, though they must be counterpart to each other i.e fire and ice, light and darkness, etc. though instead of clashing, amplify each other significantly when used together. On top of this, when carrying or riding them any powers she has are boosted in some way thematically relating to her friends, a bird might incorporate razor feathers into a blaster power, for example. She also has the ability to fuse with her Animal Friends, granting her significantly enhanced versions of their powers and combined strength, durability, speed, and reflexes while also giving her animal features in line with her Friends, such as wings from a bird or a tail from a dog.

Personality:

Happy and playful on the surface, Eva is a social butterfly who loves to spend time with her friends. Despite her cheerful demeanor, she has a secret cynical side and struggles with abandonment and trust issues, resulting from a traumatic childhood. Deep down, Eva is incredibly clingy and seeks security in the people she cares about, but is wary of getting too close for fear of being hurt. 

Background:

Eva has humble origins, being born to a low class family struggling to get ends meet. When she was ten, her family was going through a particularly rough time. Her parents offered to bring her to the zoo, much to her excitement.

Eva's world turned upside down when she was sold into the dark world of slavery. When the full truth of her situation was revealed, she discovered that she had been betrayed by her own parents, who sold her to the slave traders. Overwhelmed with grief and anger, Eva was left with no one she could trust. She suffered during her time as a slave, and was saved by Hellhound, who became someone she admired. She turned to him for comfort and guidance, and their bond only grew stronger.

Originally, she was incapable of helping Hellhound due to being an ordinary human. This frustrated her, as she was unable to help her saviour. This is when she met a stranger in a suit eating an apple, and was given a deal. She gained her powers, initially taking the form of two wolves. Since then she served as Hellhound’s right hand. She hasn’t seen the stranger since, but knows he will eventually return for her side of the bargain
objects.title: Artemis

addons.text: A commission for a traditional Japanese Kimono, it was designed with flowers decorating the kimono. Shiroi Hana connects with Angela’s Shades and multiplies their strength by 10x. Aside from that, it can also disguise itself into a variety of different colors and patterns. With some coaxing, Yura also managed to make Angela leave with a Magical Girl outfit, one that is 10 times more frilly than the kimono. The Magical Girl outfit can draw from Angela’s power and revive others without requiring the sacrifice of a slot, on top of also having the ability to enhance Angela’s Shades by 10x.
addons.title: Shiroi Hana

objects.text:
Name: Angela “White” Maloku
Cape Name: Morrigan
Gender: Female
Age: 18
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful
Power: Harvester, Hecatoncheires, Araboth, Best of My Own

White inherited an offshoot of her father’s own ability, most notably manifesting in a form similar to that of the Faerie Queen, but far more powerful and versatile. She has a fully upgraded and realized Harvester (including its addons and other associated and required powers). Additionally, she possesses an ability that increases her shade limit by one every day.

Her other major component is Araboth, which allows her to enhance herself, items, others, as well as her shades, through charges her power provides, allowing her to add enchantments and powers to their repertoire over time, as well as enhancing them overall whenever they pass certain tiers. She regularly uses it on her favorite shades to empower them further. 

Her most important ability is to temporarily sacrifice a slot to bring to life any shade she wishes. She can even bring back the dead with this power. 

She has had her powers since she was a toddler and thus has a truly massive amount of permanent summons, powers, and enchantments at her disposal, as well as normal shades.

Background:
Born as the daughter of Alexander “Green” Maloku on Earth Yarok, Angela would inherit her father’s unique nature and abilities. 

She was often spoiled rotten with love and affection by her father and wanted for nothing during her formative years. Upon first meeting her younger brother, she was at first jealous of the attention he would get from their father, but she grew to love her younger brother quickly enough.

This continued until 2016, when her father disappeared without warning or so much as a goodbye to her or their group. 

What’s more, her father’s civilian identity was seemingly leaked, subsequently outing her and her brother as a result. 

The threat of an incredibly powerful Parahuman that could seemly wield any power, raise the dead, and kill anyone with nothing more than a touch resulted in most of the world fearing her even when she was but a child, the few that didn’t or that could conceal it having hidden agendas of their own. As a result of this she’s become cold to most, rarely trusting those outside the group her father has traveled with, considering them family. 

Her father’s disappearance had greatly affected her, having never truly recovered from his absence despite the strong front she’s put.

This continued for years before she eventually decided to retreat with her brother and remaining family to another earth while looking for her father. 

She had known for a long time that her father was not dead, having attempted to resurrect him for at least once a day for years on end and having been entirely unsuccessful, but she could not communicate with him either. 

After years of no results, she  decided that she would go back to the past to reunite with him that way and hopefully find answers.

Personality:
White is a friendly person, but this is often overshadowed by the mask she puts on to protect herself. Due to this she often comes off as aloof and uncaring to strangers. Despite this, she has a soft spot for her brother and cute things, often causing her mask to crack slightly when interacting with them.
objects.title: White

addons.text: Yura created a Magical Girl outfit similar to that of Symbol II’s predecessor. A Magical Girl Equipment that can store energy and save it as a second battery bank for Symbol to use. Her wand is capable of a wider variety of blasts and, at a heavy energy price, can unleash a devastating All-or-Nothing attack.
addons.title: Love & Justice

objects.text:
Name: Nadia Wilde
Gender: Female
Age: 10
Appearance: Attractive (More on the cute side though)

Power: (Energy Well)

Magical Girl Symbol is capable of drawing from a limited amount of energy that regenerates slowly when not in use and while resting. While she has a limited pool to draw on, she can use it with a surprisingly high amount of flexibility. Ranging from enhancing her physical attributes, creating fields that weaken damage, and shooting blasts of energy. With time she could learn even more uses of her power such as flight or healing.

Personality:

Symbol is still young and naive, unaware of the harsh realities of the world. Due to the lack of experience, she exudes a sense of weakness due to being a new cape. But underneath that naivety is someone with determination and empathy. At times she could come off as a bit of a fool, but rarely it would be possible to spot that thinking brain of hers. And then ruin that impression with something childish.

Nonetheless, if anyone is in distress, she will try her utmost to rescue them. Like her hero, she never abandons those who are struggling, no matter the obstacle. She perseveres with unwavering faith and resolve, striving to make a difference. She has a lot to learn, both about herself and the world. In time she would naturally learn about both the light and darkness lurking in humanity's heart and need to grasp how to deal with such conflicts. She also needs to learn how to live her double life without sacrificing either side, as both Symbol and Navia. But regardless of the challenges she will face, she aims to make the world a better brighter place. One person at a time.

Background:

Nadia, who is unknowingly a second-generation cape, was inspired by the late superhero Magical Girl who laid their life down for her. In honor of her hero's memory, Nadia took on their mantle and became Magical Girl Symbol The Second. Despite lacking powers, she strived to be the greatest hero she could be, putting forth her all. Outside of her Magical Girl activities, Nadia is a young student at her local school and has troubles with her daily life. Trying to balance her daily life while moonlighting as a cape is causing trouble for her education and real life. Even so, she still tries to do her best but pushes herself too far oftentimes.

One fateful day, she encountered a suave gentleman in a business suit who offered her a deal and apple juice. She doesn't recall the details of the agreement, due to it being so long ago, only remembering that it granted her newfound strength. Occasionally, she wonders about the agreement's contents, wondering what it all entailed. But what she does know, is that her powers got a boost in its capacity, strength, and versatility somehow. Growing as she uses them and making her stronger.
objects.title: The Second Symbol

objects.text:
Name: Symbol?
Alias: Five
Gender: Female
Age: Unknown
Appearance: Terrifying

Power: (The Void Beyond the Stars + Eternal Flame + Golden Form + Open Eyes + Anti Monitor)

The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is an embodiment of both the void and evil itself, having the ability of effortless and absolute reality warping on a planetary scale. Beyond that range, she still has total dominion over darkness and shadow, with the power to manifest unending hordes of nightmarish shadow abominations and create pockets of emptiness to engulf energy, beings, or entire realms and drag them into the void, either erasing them from existence or enslaving them to her malevolent will if it is a creature. If an entity somehow manages to survive being dragged into the void, they will not live much longer, as the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol can enter and exit the void as she pleases, and due to her connection to the void, she becomes All-Powerful while inside it.

The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol's control over the cosmic veil also allows her to ignore dimensional barriers and any restraints, allowing her to disappear at will and freely travel through the omniverse.

Her mere presence alone will transform the world around her, subconsciously bending space and time to create impossible geometry and spaces that lead back into themselves. The sky will seem to be in perpetual night, and the geography might shift in an instant, creating new pathways and destroying others. Anyone unfortunate enough to find themselves trapped in her domain will find their bodies mutating into monstrous versions of their former selves, a dark reflection of their greatest fears and darkest desires, only desiring the death of anything that crosses their path.

The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is a memetic cognitohazard, When a creature learns of her existence or is actively observing her, she, in turn, gains knowledge of that creature's existence and will be able to infect them, subtly twisting their mind, body, and soul, Draining them of their willpower and sanity until they can do nothing but obey her every whim. The more a target is exposed to the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol, the faster the infection will take over. Even simply looking at a photo of her will cause a dramatic loss of sanity. As a result of this, she is a complete blindspot to all Thinker powers.

When someone is fully corrupted, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol will gain their knowledge, experience, and powers. She is able to access and modify the abilities of anyone she has corrupted, and can grant the abilities to her other victims. If a puppet of hers is destroyed in battle, she can immediately recreate them at full strength.

Due to her connection to evil itself, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is completely immortal. With time, she can recover from anything, even true death and existence erasure. Her death would require the total elimination of the omniversal essence of evil, a truly impossible feat. However, her revivals are not instantaneous, with more complete deaths taking longer amounts of time to come back from. Something such as complete bodily annihilation will heal in an instant, while esoteric attacks such as existence erasure will take days or weeks to heal.

When facing a truly great foe or challenge, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol can transform into a titanic, vaguely humanoid mass of crackling shadows and tendrils with glowing white eyes, with the innumerable faces of her past victims on her torso wailing in agony. In this state, her regeneration will become overclocked to the point that she seems utterly invincible, and the range on her reality warping and void manipulation will be extended to an absurd degree. She will be able to rewrite the universe she inhabits as she pleases, and can utterly shatter dimensional barriers to let her darkness rapidly spread from universe to universe and from timeline to timeline. However, this transformation is not permanent, only lasting for around an hour before she will reverts to her standard appearance and become unable to transform for a week.

Her powers stem from the corruption of the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚, evil acts, and negative emotions. The more that its corruption and evil are spread, the greater her powers will become. 


Background:

Originally, the F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol was a hero, a magical girl of the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚. She was a woman who sought to spread love and justice across the world. That is, until she came into contact with an avatar of the essence of evil itself. Fooled by its disguise of incompetence, she became close friends with it, not knowing of the malevolent schemer which lied beneath. In a moment of weakness, the evil fooled her into letting it into her mind, infecting her. Once she realized the deceit, she attempted to fight back, but her struggle was in vain. Her mind and soul were warped beyond recognition, her personality erased. She was forced to kill and infect her closest friends, turning them into pawns to serve the evil that had corrupted her.


Personality:

Due to the corruption caused by the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚, The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol is seemingly incapable of empathy and remorse, only able to feel joy when inflicting pain onto others. The stronger the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚'s influence is, the less sanity she possesses. If it's influence is strong enough, the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚ may seize total control, making her orders of magnitude stronger than she normally is, allowing her and her puppets to act as a true hivemind, and letting her stay in her eldritch form indefinitely until the F̵̢͚͛̅i̶̤̋̀f̸̹̻̒͝ṯ̸̩̕h̴̪̺̀̿ ̸̻̏̑T̵̬̻̆̐ḯ̵͍̌m̴̰̼̏̄ę̵͙̾l̸͈̏ḭ̵̰͒̕n̵̫̏ẻ̶̠̫̚ relinquishes control. However, there are rare moments when she is alone and regains a semblance of control. And sometimes, when she's all alone, tears can be seen streaming down her face.

Note: The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol does not exist in your chosen world unless she is selected as a companion. When selected, she will retroactively be inserted into the world at a time of your choosing.
objects.title: The F̶͕͠i̵̧̓f̴̢͌ẗ̴̰ĥ̷̙ Symbol

addons.text: A Magical Girl outfit created for the purpose of looking cool and fashionable. A strange outfit that was created, but Yura herself has no clue what to do with it as Artztinnen’s power is strange. It’s a frilly Magical Girl outfit; unlike the other outfits she created, this one does not improve the user’s power. It only improves the comfort level they have wearing it.
addons.title: Blazing Flames

objects.text:
Name: Iris? Artze?
Gender: Female
Age: ?? (14 to 16???)
Appearance: Attractive

Power: Aura + Elementalism

Ärztinnen possesses the ability to conceptually wield fire at her disposal which comes from her being a Magical Girl. With a powerful bond with fire, she can use it to create, shape, and control fire at will. And even tap into its symbolism and metaphysical properties to inflame emotions and burn away sickness. But she can also use this to create protective barriers, predict danger, and enhance her life force to enhance her physical abilities.

Her fire can take on traits of various kinds that she comes across as well as alter them to fit the situation on hand. With the flexibility she possesses, she can conceptually destroy something into oblivion and burn away the damage done to buildings.

Personality:

Ärztinnen is a veteran magical girl who has been active for a good number of years. She is often seen as more serious compared to other magical girls, such as Symbol, due to her experience. However, it is also because of this experience that she knows the importance of being grounded with the regular folk without being lost in all the villains and sparkles. She understands that being a magical girl is not just about flashy powers and spectacular displays of magic.

Due to her experience, she knows it's important to remember the regular folk who seem to easily become mere statistics. And she tries to bridge the gap this creates when it comes to getting in touch with the real world. While she will have concerns over the escalating stakes, she will also make sure to check on the mental health and well-being of her fellow peers. She understands the stress and pressure it puts on people, in both their public, and offers them her wisdom to help.
Background:

Ärztinnen is the daughter of two internationally known villains, having trained most of her early life to inherit her family's business, skills, and experience she used in her later magical girl activities, having decided that she didn't want to be a villain herself. While she retained a good relationship with her parents, with them supporting her, she's since left them to journey to other universes and timelines, only coming back occasionally to visit. With her immortal life, Ärztinnen tends to explore the universe in search of new experiences and fun things to do, often settling down for decades to lend valuable experience and wisdom to Magical Girls of all kinds.
objects.title: Magical Girl of Flames, Ärztinnen

addons.text:
During his earlier years Hakan would wander the various Earths as a mercenary, less as a need for money and more as a subconscious attempt to endanger himself. A constant punishment for his own sins, driven by the never ending guilt and maddening rage he constantly threw himself head first into danger to satiate his bloodlust. 

Having garnered a reputation as an incredibly powerful and fearless parahuman, he had no shortage of those wishing to garner his services. Having been drawn to Earth Yarok because of the various constantly raging wars and the presence of large swaths of territories poisoned by Eden’s body which also gave rise to an abnormally large amount of powerful beasts to combat.

Superstition would seep into practice for many people, new legends being formed out of the aftermath of Eden’s arrival. Stories of the territories poisoned as being slowly being overtaken by hell, the denizens transformed into demons or killed by the demon horde. Others believe it to be a punishment of a reawakened god long forgotten, and many more stories. 

He would receive a lucrative contract to hunt down a “demon”, one to travel from normal human lands into the edges of plagued territory. Having been told it was a “demon born from the flesh of monster”, and that it would be best to hunt it down now as it appeared to have separated from the other demon that was constantly nearby, he would assume that it was the runaway creation of another monstrous case 53 and set out to hunt it. 

Only to instead encounter a young child instead, an impossibly powerful Parahuman child, but a child nonetheless. A young 6 year old child, the other “demon” that he appeared to have separated from being the young boy’s mother, who he would have discovered to have passed a few months prior. Driven by necessity and loneliness, the boy had traveled to nearby villages in search of others, only for him to be cruelly run out. 

Having secretly followed the boy to his home after his discovery, he slowly pieced the story behind him. Born to a woman afflicted by the plague that killed or transformed all others, one who had started to show signs of heavy mutations however she had miraculously held on. Having made it to term, she was able to successfully give birth to her son. However what should have been seen as miracle was instead seen as curse, the disease had mutated the once beautiful woman, in the eyes of the others of her village she was already seen as a demon, and her son’s abnormal physical strength as a babe despite his normal appearance only cemented it as fact in the eyes of others. A demon born from a monster.

Out of cowardice of what would happen should they directly attack, they instead cast them out to hopefully die in the wild. Despite all odds the young mother would survive her afflictions for years, pushing herself and her body to the limits to stay for as long as possible so as to not leave her child alone. But alas her body could only go so long, eventually perishing and leaving her child alone in the world.

The story would strike a chord deeper within him, resulting in self reflection they hadn’t experienced in years. They would take the young child in, who insisted on being called Green, eventually coming to see them as their own son. 

As a side effect of Green’s presence and their close relationship, Green would over the years enhance Hakan’s power. Green would absorb and reconstruct Hakan’s shard, merging it directly with Hakan. This in turn greatly increased his power, mutating into Araboth (alongside the Arakiel and Archmage’s Workshop addons). Green in turn having someone there to help him develop his powers during his younger years is also subsequently more powerful, equal to his New Gods equivalent, and will continue to grow at an increased pace. Hakan would also develop a parahuman mercenary group much earlier, gaining a much larger following. There are another 25 parahumans as members of their group, among them Overhaul and Tyrant. They consider each other family, all having chosen to follow when they eventually left Yarok. 

On Hakan’s advice, Green would allow Blue to copy the powers of each member of their group, incorporating their various abilities into his own before Green in turn enhanced it. Blue now also possesses (Trump) Fairy Queen and its addon with Oberon, Elfame. 

Blue no longer possesses an active power limit, and possesses a copy of Green’s power as well the other members of their group, but he cannot access them because of a block placed on it that will unlock under one of three conditions. Either 10 years pass, Green removes the block, or Blue is in danger in which case Green’s Paradigm power will unlock and protect Blue. The power’s copied or stolen by Blue will incorporate itself into his copy of Paradigm, allowing them to mutate and evolved as well as having their features added on to his own power, or their power broken down to add to his own pool of power.

Blue’s power while locked will prioritize enhancements and evolution, at a far quicker pace than it would otherwise. They’ll eventually unlock the total depth of the power at their disposal, and will quickly grow past that limit as well. 

As he grew to be far more open and comfortable with others, Green would regularly enhance the powers of his allies, resulting in the other members of their group gaining various enhancements as well.
addons.title: A Guiding Hand

addons.text: Al Abadi’s upgrade from Green would result in his Prototype being able to construct powers as powerful as a rating 14 (~80) SP with one charge at the first Araboth tier and passively improve them based on data collected without having to waste a charge, although he can still spend charges to amplify them quicker.

In addition he also has a maxed Architect merged into his power.

addons.text: One of Yura’s commissions was to create equipment for a cape. Unlike some others, she worked with Hakan to create his cape outfit. And as thanks for the help, she also added a snazzy suit to make a pair. While wearing either, it doesn’t help Al Abadi with charges, but it does assist with his ability to create and improve his powers. Refining the process to create stronger, more adaptable powers as well as filtering through the power patterns he saves onto his costume to quickly create new powers as fast as possible.
addons.title: Prismatic Code

objects.text:
Name: Hakan Bengi
Gender: Male 
Age: 56 (Physically 26) 
Appearance: Masculine, Handsome 
Power: (Trump) Prototype + Hecantocheires 

Al Abadi possesses the power to copy, create, and improve powers. Each day he generates 15 charges, with which he can spend to utilize his powers. He can spend a single charge to copy the powers of any parahuman within his line of sight. 

He can also spend charges to also construct new powers, or use them to either alter it or improve them further. More powerful abilities require more charges.He can choose to construct powers randomly, however the cost of the powers are the same. He can generate any power he can think of. 

He can store an unlimited amount of charges and has no limit to the amount of powers he can utilize at the same time, likewise he can also store a power, keeping it from being used if he doesn’t wish to for any reason. 

He has two secondary thinker powers, one that allows him to perfectly recall power patterns, and another that allows him to understand the patterns and how to modify and combine them into new ones. 

History 

Born on Earth Efes decades prior, Al Abadi was among the first capes to trigger after the arrival of the Entities, acquiring his powers within a few days of their arrival. His Earth was unfortunately one of the ones heavily affected by the scattering of Eden’s shards, his power in particular not coming from a normal trigger but similar to Contessa where he gained his ability through drinking water contaminated by a shard of Abbadon. As a result of this his power doesn’t have any of the innate restrictions that other shard powers have, as Eden was unable to place the proper restrictions in place before her death.

Following his trigger he would find himself losing control of himself, his unrestrained shard connected haphazardly to him resulting in it unintentionally running rampant on his psyche, heightening his rage, paranoia, and shortly thereafter his bloodlust. In his psychosis induced frenzy he would end up unintentionally murdering many people, among them his own friends and family. Thankfully his frenzy would end after a few days, the haphazard connection to their shard corrected, however the damage was already done. 

He had been knocked comatose for a number of weeks following his trigger and rampage, during which time the denizens of his world felt the effects of being poisoned by shards, with most food and water sources contaminated the vast majority of the population quickly fell ill and died, and among the unfortunate few that survived this initial ordeal the vast majority was turned into horrific monsters. 

Awakening weeks later in an empty hospital room with the vision of the Entities arrivals and their purpose and the memories of his rampage burned into his memory, he woke up with hate burning in his chest, only to have it crushed upon finding his family, his friends, everyone he had ever known that survived his rampage long gone. The only thing he had left was a letter left to him by his mother, one of the few that had managed to escape his rampage, written when she was the last living family member and felt herself fading away from the same poison that afflicted the rest of her world. 

Written as an apology for leaving him alone, she urged him to continue to live regardless. To live well and prosper. While aware he was not entirely responsible for his rampage, the guilt ate away at him regardless. The reality that the shard connection was later corrected only made it worse, as he often wondered if he could have fought off the shards effects for longer that maybe he could have kept them from dying to his hands, or even if he could have managed to recover quicker to take the few that survived away from their dying world. 

With most of humanity dead, including anyone he had ties to, and the world well on its way to being entirely inhospitable, they saved the few they could transporting them to another Earth and left not long after. 

He wandered aimlessly across the multiverse, finding it hard to continue living but doing so out of respect for his mother’s last wishes as well as in hopes that he may eventually grow powerful enough to contest the Entities he saw in his Trigger Vision. He intends on surviving until the end of the cycle, having created an immortality power he constantly keeps active not long after he acquired his powers. This is also the reason for his youthful appearance as he has physically not aged in 30 years. 

He would eventually establish himself on Earth Yarok as a mercenary, drawn to the world as it currently experiences a milder version of what plagued his own world. He would find himself often traveling alongside other Parahumans, eventually establishing their own impromptu mercenary group. 

Personality 

He comes off as generally aloof and serious, especially towards those he is unfamiliar with. Still harbors mild feelings of survivor’s guilt. The years of wandering alone and the loss of his friends and family have made a marked change in his personality, particularly in regards to those he gets close to. 

This has resulted in him becoming closed off to many, a subconscious trait adopted as a way to protect himself so he doesn’t have to go through the pain of losing more of those he cares about. For those that do manage to get close to him, he is often seen as the gruff old man with a soft side. He still struggles with showing emotion, but does his best to understand others and comfort them. 

During the earlier years following his trigger event, Abadi was an incredibly destructive, ruthless, violent, and brutal wanderer, focused entirely on his own goals. He would turn the feelings of guilt into a near obsessive need for vengeance, oftentimes finding himself on worlds heavily afflicted with monstrous beings to both let off his bloodlust and in the hopes of collecting powerful abilities for himself to eventually grow powerful enough to kill the entities. He has also gained an incredible disgust for cowards who would sacrifice others to preserve themselves. 

The years however have changed him, having slowly learned to accept what had happened, having become more calm, controlled, and stoic. 

However he is still perfectly capable and willing to be thoroughly brutal with his enemies when the situation calls for it, and even more so when those he’s gained an attachment to are harmed or threatened. 

He has a soft spot for children, especially those that have either lost their own families or are otherwise in precarious circumstances. They often remind of his young niece, who he was incredibly close to and still harbors immense guilt for his part in her death. He’ll often go out of his way to find good homes for them, or at the very least that they are taken care of in some manner. Since his arrival on Earth Yarok, he’s often taken the rare Parahuman child under his own care, due to the world’s warlords habit of hunting and forced conscription of other Parahumans.

objects.text:
Name: Alexander “Green” Maloku
Cape Name: Ignis 
Gender: Male 
Age: 23
Appearance: Masculine, Handsome 
Power: Paradigm

Green inherited a much more powerful variation of his father’s ability, his own unique Shard-Human hybrid nature granting him far more power than he would have otherwise. Green possesses a fully upgraded and realized Paradigm, (including its addons and other associated and required powers). 

Among Green’s favored powers is his innate ability to “flicker”, allowing him to page through all possible alternate states of himself and anything else within range, and swap them either piece by piece or in whole. This can be used to do anything from healing, to clothing someone, altering a person’s power expression, even teleport by swapping possible locations. He can even use this to restore Eidolon’s power in full if he were inclined. 

His “flicker” ability is not dependent on other existing versions, although he can use it in that manner if he wishes. Instead it defaults to let him choose from an infinite array of possible alternate states of everything in his range. He exhibits the same intuition and instinctive control over this aspect of his power as the rest of the abilities granted by Paradigm, allowing him to effortlessly and subconsciously choose exactly what state would be best for his purposes, and is even capable of even using this power entirely out of reflex. 

The powers he utilizes are notably more powerful when used in conjunction with another, producing far more powerful and useful effects than they would normally. This allows him to bypass limitations, incorporate the properties of powers into one another, and even fuse them into powers far more powerful than their component parts. When a power gets more powerful, his overall pool of power grows alongside it so that it never takes a greater percentage of his power to hold it. He can choose to allow a power to hold more than one slot, with each slot dramatically increasing the power. 

His power has long since mutated to be more flexible with how it expresses itself, alongside his normal method of manifesting powers he’s also capable of manifesting anything from skills, items, imbuing others with powers, manifesting minions to even more esoteric things such as enchantments, immunities, absolute effects, and much more. Destroying things he’s made or imbued doesn’t destroy the pool of power for him to use, simply freeing it up for him to use again, nor can it be taken away from or be used as a vector to get to him.

Green awakened his powers at the young of 5, and has constantly developed over the course of his life, gaining and developing powerful abilities, mutations and dramatically increasing his power. 

Background:

Born as the illegitimate son of Eidolon on Earth Yarok, the circumstances of Alexander’s birth were incredibly complex. During a mission to study parts of “Eden’s” body that had crash landed on Earth Yarok and was poisoning and converting large areas of the population into shards, Eidolon would meet and have a small fling with one of the women that had been poisoned, but still wasn’t showing symptoms. Eventually the study was deemed unsafe as they started dying en masse and it was abandoned, Eidolon leaving, never aware of the pregnancy or his birth. Alexander’s mother lived long enough to give birth and raise him for a few years before she too passed. She often referred to him as “Green” after the cloak his father wore and he carries the pet name still in remembrance. As a result of his unique nature of being born to a human altered with a dead shard and a human that was more shard than human, something strange happened and he was born as a perfect Human-Shard hybrid. This has caused his powers to not be derived from another shard but from himself, rendering him Shardless, and allowing him and his power to cross between incompatible systems and be inherited, and can keep his powers from being manipulated without his consent. He is a natural Blindspot like his father, but he is more powerful, capable of choosing if, when, and how any thinker powers perceive him. 

Earth Yarok had large territories run by parahumans, who themselves built kingdoms and waged war with one another as hired mercenaries, Green would join one of these kingdoms and would work as a mercenary until 6 months prior. Because they often needed a steady supply of new parahumans, kingdoms would often buy newly awakened or captured parahumans to eventually fold into their forces. Despite his distaste for it he attended one of the meetings as a bodyguard for a warlord that hired him, where he saw a child “flicker”, a trait of his own power. Quickly realizing the possibility, and confirming with his own powers, he became horrified and enraged. Realizing his hypocrisy, he betrayed the warlord, killing and crippling a great number of others at the auction, and freeing the other parahumans. Soon after, he left his previous world behind.

Personality:

Typically carries a relaxed and nonchalant demeanor, and can be quite playful at times. He’s noted to have a soft spot for children and animals and will avoid harming them if it can be avoided. Takes a serious and ruthless demeanor in combat, and has been noted to be incredibly cold blooded if he believes it necessary. He’s incredibly protective of his family, and will go to great lengths to make sure they are protected, but he is still adjusting  with leaving his previous life behind. While he never hid his identity in his previous world as the practice never took off there, he has taken to using the identity Ignis to better protect his children. 

(Note: Green prefers an incredibly high paced fighting style, swapping out powers and mixing and matching to quickly overwhelm opponents. His fighting style can be categorized with unrelenting aggressive and domineering attacks, leaving very little if any room for respite or regrouping for his opponents.)
objects.title: Green

addons.text: While Green was commissioning his own equipment, he purchased a small blue onesie for Blue. Comfortable pajamas that can clean themselves no matter how dirty they get. While appearing like a cute blue onesie, it is built with various kinds of defenses. It can even teleport Blue to the nearest designated beacon. Yura keeps one such beacon in her workshop.
addons.title: Blue Onesie

objects.text:
Name: Aurelian “Blue” Maloku
Gender: Male 
Age: 3
Appearance: Masculine, Adorable
Power: (Manager + Archive + Bypass + New Target Acquired [Unshackled] + Hecatoncheires + Striker → Shaker + Shard Automation [Catalogue])

Blue possesses the ability to copy or take the abilities of anyone within a 100 meter range around himself, as well as hand them out.

He can alter the powers in his possession by cycling through different expressions of the same power, boosting one aspect at the expense of another, changing its restrictions, synergizing and fusing them, splitting them, etc., including altering and merging other powers with his base power to improve it.
