His power automatically scans and catalogues any power that comes into his range. Alongside this, his power has an infinite catalogue that carries every possible and impossible and potential power, component, combination, fusion, variation, and expression.

He possesses secondary thinker powers, the first of which grants him subconscious awareness of what is in his archive and immediately brings it to the forefront for use when he pulls for it.

The second grants him an intuitive understanding of every detail, quirk, underlying nature, feature, and application of a power he either possesses, comes across, or in his archive, in addition to granting natural and effortless control over any power he possesses or otherwise encounters.

By focusing on his Archive, he can choose to copy powers directly from his Archive rather than another source. He can discard unwanted powers but will have to acquire them again if he wants to use them, meaning he’ll either need to copy or take it again, whether from his Archive or from another source. Copying and stealing powers are both immediate. His powers will slowly grow over time as well to cover more in what his powers can manipulate.

He has no limits to the amount of abilities he can use at any time, although he can store powers as inactive, neither discarding them, but neither allowing them to operate.

His ability works on everything, from organic to inorganics such as Cauldron Vials, the Garden of Eden, and other objects that grant or have powers, although they’re adapted for his use.

Likewise, he can also imbue objects and other creatures with his powers; in the case of inorganics, this would allow him to create objects with powers. If bought alongside any other companions, you may choose for Blue to have a copy of their abilities already. You may also optionally extend this to yourself, allowing him a copy of your own abilities.

He is a natural Blindspot like his father, and as his powers are a result of being a shard-human hybrid, he can use his powers to both affect incompatible systems and keep others from affecting his own without permission. His powers are derived from himself like his father, rendering him Shardless and his powers inheritable. 
 
Background:  
Born as the son of Alexander “Green” Maloku on Earth Yarok, Aurelian would inherit his father’s unique nature and abilities. His mother passed away not long after his birth and, with his father not aware of even the pregnancy, left him to be sent to an orphanage. His life there was mostly uneventful until he awakened the powers he inherited from his father and was found “flickering” by one of the matrons.

Earth Yarok had large numbers of feudal kingdoms run by parahumans that would then hire themselves as mercenaries, and to replenish their numbers they would at times buy recently awakened or captured parahumans to then force into their armies.

As they were lucrative sells, and since Aurelian had no real guardian to speak of, he was taken to such a place by his matron, where as luck would have it, Green was visiting as a bodyguard to the warlord he was hired by.

Seeing him “flicker” as a demonstration of his power, Green quickly put two and two together and decided to save Aurelian. Following the rescue, they immigrated to another world.

Due to his young age, Aurelian found it difficult to keep himself from using his power accidentally. He was convinced by his father to allow him to alter it to its current form to help. The extra effort required to call upon powers has made it easier for him. He was given the pet name Blue by his father, a play on his own nickname and Aurelian’s eye color.

Personality:  
Blue is a happy child. Although uprooted from his home 6 months ago, he quickly found himself bonding and enjoying his life with his recently met father and family. A precocious and kind child, he’s quick to find himself friends with almost anyone he meets, and has a habit of picking animals to take home to care for, with a particular fondness for cats.

Blue’s young age makes him impressionable, but you’ll quickly discover a clear and near unbelievably bright intelligence alongside a personality that seems to naturally gravitate to altruism. Despite this, you’ll quickly discover that it’s one that seems to be rooted in sense rather than blind faith, young as he is.

Alongside a natural curiosity and charisma, he possesses an absurd talent for using his powers, more than his innate power would suggest. Combined with his innate potential, you’ll find it difficult to find another that can so easily and readily be molded into something great.
objects.title: Blue

objects.text:
Name: Annika Severin
Cape Name: Muse
Gender: Female 
Age: 21
Appearance; Feminine, Beautiful
Powers: (Drawing Board + Rewrite + Hecatoncheires + Bypass + New Target Acquired [Unshackled])

Annika possesses the ability to shape reality with a thought, able to push life and objects into being or alter them through nothing more than her sheer will. 

Her power produces 15 charges for her to utilize her ability through. These charges fuel her ability to create, modify, and empower anything—living or non-living, herself or others—according to her will.
While sheer will is sufficient to create life, constructs, or tools, using a reference medium—such as a drawing, sculpture, written concept, or even preexisting works made by others—can reduce charge cost or increase a creation’s baseline potential. The quality and intent of the medium can dramatically influence the outcome. 

She can freely adapt these references, modifying appearance, personality, or powers however she chooses.

She may also affect existing people or entities, including herself. With 1 charge, she can rewrite any aspect of a willing target—biology, powers, skills, memories, personality, form, etc. She may do this to herself as easily as anyone else. For an unwilling target, rewriting costs 3 charges. These targets can then be altered or enhanced freely, exactly like one of her own creations.

When rewriting something or someone, she can choose to simply reshape them without claiming them, or she may claim them—integrating them into her domain. She may also claim individuals or items without reshaping them at all, simply by spending the required charges. 

Claimed beings and objects gain access to growth, enhancements, and revival. She can also choose to imbue claimed individuals with the same innate loyalty her creations possess, or leave them unaltered. 
Her original creations are intrinsically and absolutely loyal by default, unless she intentionally designs them otherwise.

A single charge allows her to create an item or being roughly equivalent to a baseline human—either a single creature or a group with equivalent combined capability. Additional charges dramatically increase their power.

By spending more charges—during creation or afterward—she can enhance their powers, expand their repertoire, and grant them new abilities, skills, items, or traits.

A single charge allows her to grant them an ability that’s roughly a 3 on the PRT scale with 2 charges needed to increase its rating by 1. She can also spend a charge to grant them superhuman skill in any skill. 

There is no limit to how many powers, skills, or traits she can give them, nor any upper cap on strength.

If any of her creations or claimed allies are destroyed, she may spend 1 charge to instantly and fully revive them, with all memories and powers intact.

Background
Born on Earth Seret, Annika grew up in a quiet, but influential northern coastal town where the winters were long and the darkness even longer. Her family prized education and tradition, encouraging her to study language, art, and history at a young age.

Her family was respected, rooted in tradition and the arts — her father a celebrated local painter whose work helped shape the culture of their seaside town.

She grew up learning to draw, sculpt, and paint as soon as she could hold things in her hand, her talent shining through even then. 

It was at this young age where she first manifested her ability, calling beings out of sketches and clay long before she could even fully write her name. 

At first, her father was overjoyed by this wonder, but as the years passed and the true depth of her talent emerged, envy curdled his love. Compared to her effortless, living artistry, his lifetime of skill felt meaningless.

Unable to look upon her without bitterness, he sent her away to live with her grandmother. The last memory she has of her parents is them embarking on a sea voyage from which they never returned, lost in a wreck by a fierce storm. 

Her grandmother raised her with gentleness and steadiness, shielding her from the opportunism of distant relatives who circled like sharks, hoping to benefit from Annika’s incredible power.

Annika’s grandmother would pass gently in the night years later, leaving Annika as her heir. Unwilling to stay when the last tie to the town was truly gone, Annika left her home at the young age of 16 and started traveling. 

What followed wasn’t conquest, or even a goal—it was just life.

She created what she needed. Companions. Protectors. Artisans. Healers. Objects and structures for shelter, transport, and exploration. 

As needs arose, her power allowed her the ability to create anything to overcome any obstacle; as her retinue grew, she eventually built a large enough following to require a stake of land to keep, growing it further over time.

She has a veritable army at her disposal, although she’s not particularly inclined to view them in that manner; as far as she’s concerned, she treats them respectfully, as living beings with their own worth. 

While she has a number of creations that she’s made for conflict, the vast majority of them feature more than just combat-oriented abilities, utility is almost always her focus rather than simple violence. The rare number that are used solely for conflict are usually made so in the heat of the moment and out of immediate need and only are such because she’s yet to give them newer abilities or a rewrite yet. 

She's also drawn a number of normal followers, those who’ve flocked to her as a result of the prosperity her kingdom enjoys.

Her life was not steeped in tragedy or suffering culminating in a trigger event to becoming a parahuman, in fact her life was for all intents and purposes entirely peaceful and happy until she became a Parahuman. This was in fact because Annika was not a Parahuman in the traditional sense, her power is entirely self derived, Shardless.

Personality
Annika is intelligent, bright, funny, warm, and disarmingly friendly. She’s highly educated, thoughtful, with an instinctive curiosity and a love of history, language, design, and people. 

Naturally witty—with a wry sense of humor and a surprisingly good memory for gossip and trivial facts. Despite her power, she isn’t controlling or arrogant. She’s someone who would rather listen than lecture, and who values curiosity as much as capability.

She has a genuine affection for people—both those born and those made. Her creations are not tools to her. They are individuals. She sees them as autonomous, independent beings, each with their own identity, growth, and emotional depth. She supports their development, celebrates their successes, and mourns their loss—not like someone mourning broken tools, but like someone grieving family.

She’s self-aware, aware of her blind spots, and quick to ask for help when needed. She listens. She seeks advice. She surrounds herself with brilliant creations not just to lead—but to learn.

She’s not naïve. She’s experienced enough to know the world can be cruel, but still stubborn enough to believe it can be better. She’s lighthearted and clever, often disarming people with charm, a joke, or a knowing grin—but behind that is someone deeply thoughtful and deliberate. She acts decisively when she has to, especially when lives or peace are on the line.

Annika actively avoids violence whenever possible. She’s not a fighter, and she doesn’t take pride in others fighting for her either. After a single disastrous incident—with an immensely powerful parahuman—she’s become even more reluctant to engage in conflict.

A misunderstanding led to aggression, then escalation. Dozens of her creations were destroyed. Though she revived them, she chose to rewrite their memories to erase the trauma. She has never truly forgiven herself for it. What haunts her most is the realization that the parahuman in question had been holding back—only doing enough damage to drive her forces away. Had they intended worse, it could have been catastrophic.

Since that day, Annika has lived with a quiet, gnawing fear. She doesn’t even like to speak the parahuman’s name. The thought of facing them again—especially in combat—genuinely terrifies her. She’s learned how fragile even the strongest creations can be when faced with true, overwhelming power. And how fragile she is by comparison.

This hasn’t made her powerless—but it has made her careful. She builds smarter. Stronger. More interconnected. She creates support systems, buffers, stabilizers, and enhancers—not just to empower her companions, but to minimize the chance she ever has to use them in violence again.
Through it all, she remains herself.

She travels. She sings. She paints. She makes people feel heard. Her presence is comforting, her humor dry, her charisma effortless. She’s a masterful artist in every sense—drawing, sculpting, composing, performing, designing, storytelling. Her voice is mesmerizing. Her creations are moving. Her charm is easy and genuine.

Having Annika as a companion naturally extends to having all her creations, all she’s ever made on your side as well. Considering how deep her particular well of power goes, and the sheer strength and variety this alone is a massive boon. 

Additional Notes 
Beyond her powers, Annika is a prodigious artist in every sense. She can draw, paint, sculpt, sing, act, and write with extraordinary skill. Her voice is hauntingly beautiful, her performances emotive and magnetic, and her work across all mediums stirs deep emotion. She’s an adept instrumentalist, lyricist, and storyteller.

She’s also incredibly intelligent in broader academic and social contexts—charismatic, creative, quick-witted, and deeply empathetic. A bit of polymath there isn’t much that she doesn’t exhibit some familiarity with, or at least some talent in.
objects.title: Muse

addons.text:
One of the capes Violet claimed into her embrace, Symbol II initially didn’t stand out. Among the fallen gods and monsters, Nadia was an ordinary child given a second chance to live her life due to her untimely death and the fact that no one knew she had died. As they were situated in the same place, it made sense that they would get to know each other.

Contrary to Kei’s expectations, Nadia isn’t particularly displeased with the fact that she died and is now a Shade subservient to Kei. She’s a hyperactive child with a rich imagination, and she claims Kei is her “Patron” for her “Magical Girl activities.” Nadia often visits to drag Kei on grand adventures of stopping evil and eating cake.
addons.title: Magenta

addons.text:
One of the capes Violet claimed into her embrace, Asphalt was a powerful Tinker who greatly changed the way Violet viewed Tinker powers. Surprisingly, Asphalt is not afraid of Violet despite being forced to serve as her Shade, as it allowed Asphalt to meet the people important in her life.

Due to Asphalt’s penchant for Magical Girl Equipment, Violet has come into possession of a frilly violet Magical Girl outfit that enhances her power by 1000%. She would wear it less if it weren’t so comfortable and strong. Thanks to the Innovation Brigade, led by Asphalt, all of Kei’s Shades wear either suits or Magical Girl equipment. There is no in-between.
addons.title: Transparent

addons.text: One of the Capes Violet claimed into her embrace, Evelyn was a game changer in how Violet utilized her full power. Due to Evelyn’s ability to strengthen powers within her range, whenever Violet needed something done, she would rely on Evelyn’s power boost. Because of this, Evelyn is not officially part of any of Kei’s Brigades, she instead bounces between each of them based on where she is needed. However, because her death is unknown, she mostly acts as a member of the Chaos Brigade. One thing Violet didn’t expect was to be disliked by Evelyn’s Clustermates, as it seemed her claim over Evelyn negatively impacted their opinion of her subconsciously.
addons.title: Taupe

addons.text:
One of the things Violet claimed into her embrace. A Shard that used to be her, a husk of herself without her mind from the accident that occurred when she time-traveled. [VIOLET], as it was originally called, is like an empty being that has no clue what to do. Something that wasn’t her, but believes itself to be her. Violet decided to name it Sangria, as despite it's origins, it was was different from her.

Unlike the other members of Violet’s Shades, Sangria doesn’t separate from Kei and doesn’t work with any of the Brigades because of that. Instead, it follows her every move and acts like a clingy koala bear unable to separate itself from her. Because of Sangria’s circumstances, Kei took it upon herself to teach it how to be more human.

The reabsorption of Sangria fixed the missing parts Violet lost. Repairing her damaged original powers back to their full condition and more. This effectively means Violet gets access to a fully upgraded Faerie Queen and Butcher, with their addons and necessary powers.
addons.title: Sangria

addons.text:
One of the capes Violet claimed into her embrace, one of the many heroes who lived and died without many people knowing her. Mary was one of the many who became a Shade, but while powerful they rarely interacted. It was only after a while did Violet realized that Symbol was a distant relative of hers. Despite her death, she remains supportive of the people around her and helps encourage Shades in the Afterlife. 

Symbol’s power is powerful and tied with Violet’s Shades. An endless number of grown powers can be passed onto them. However Mary doesn’t want that, and respecting her wishes Violet simply lets her do what she wants.
addons.title: Pink

objects.text:
Name: Kei “Violet” Maloku
Gender: Female
Age: 21
Appearance: Beautiful

Powers: Harvester (*Ereshkigal, *Duat), Manager, Predator{10x} (*Amalgamation, *Gravekeeper, *Nexus), Resilience (*Vaccine), Starlight Punch, Walking Afterlife, Wild Hunt (*The Morrígan, *Elfame), Wrath of the Creator

Violet has inherited an alternate version of her father’s ability. Rather than being a Shard-Human hybrid, she was born as a mutated Shard with the mind of a human. Her body is an Avatar created by her Shard to interact with others. She is an unchained Shard capable of consuming other Shards for resources and [DATA]. The more Shards she consumes, the stronger she becomes. Whenever a Parahuman dies, Violet gains a direct path to the Shard in question, allowing her to consume it. Violet possesses a fully upgraded Faerie Queen and Butcher, including their addons and necessary powers.

She can summon an endless number of Shades not only of those who have died but also of the living and their possibilities. By reaching into alternate universes, she can summon a Shade of them to work for her. Her Shades are stored in a mental world that collects and archives every Shade she has, allowing her to enhance, mix, and alter the Shades or the powers she obtains. Violet can also gain copies of the powers she interacts with, be it by touch or her Shades making contact. She can alter Shades, changing their form to whatever she desires, and her Shades and powers are 25 times stronger than they were in life. If they fall, their strength is added to hers, and she can bring them back an hour later or summon exact copies of the same Shade. With so many powers at her disposal, she incorporates their traits into her Avatar, making her as fast as her fastest Blaster Power or more durable than her most destructive power. Her true body becomes significantly stronger with the consumption of better Shards.

Because her body is a projection created by her Shard, power manifestations or Parahumans that come into contact with her or her powers can serve as a direct connection to the source of their power. While she can consume Shards without killing the host, she can also choose to kill the host in the process. This death touch works on any sentient being, not just Parahumans, and they can serve as one of her Shades. Born with the ability to consume Shards, she is resistant to all kinds of phenomena they have encountered. The more they attack her, the more she figures out their vectors and adapts herself. Although it does not influence her decisions, she feels inclined to consume Shards because they are delicious.

As an Avatar, Violet is immune to powers that would affect a normal person, such as Master powers. Other powers like Thinker and Trump have an extremely difficult time parsing her, to the point of being incomprehensible gibberish even to the Simurgh or reducing her abilities by only 5% by when someone should be capable of complete negation. Even if it’s a blazing fire or a hyper-specialized Shard virus, due to her experience with an infinite variety of powers, she’s likely seen it before and can use the attack to further refine her defense.

Background:

Kei is a mysterious figure with no clear origin, appearing out of nowhere like a ghost. She is an enigma, with some people finding her amiable and humble, while others see her as manipulative. As a Hero with a disguised identity, she doesn’t stand out and isn’t particularly notable, with her fights ending quickly. Despite her heroic activities, there is not a single clue about her powers, leading to speculation and rumors about her true nature. Some believe she is a Shaker or a Blaster. Even rumors of potentially being a Master, but almost nothing is known about her, and her enigmatic smile only deepens the mystery.

Born as the daughter of Aurelian “Blue” Maloku sometime in the far distant future, Kei sacrificed a majority of herself to escape to the past in an unspecified alternate universe. Growing up after the disappearance of her grandfather, she was often spoiled by those around her. But as she grew, the Shades she claimed told her a completely different story. A life where she got everything she could ever want without consequences because she was powerful and feared, she started to grow disillusioned with this kind of life. Wanting to reject it, she worked with her friends (They are Shades) to hatch a plan to escape. While she lost the Shades she had, she no longer has to live in a future where everyone around her walks nervously because of the reputation her father’s children have. In the future, the universe bows before her as one of the god-children, but she decides it isn’t normal for people to obey the childish whims of the powerful and wants to live a life with the common folk.

Personality:
 
Always keeping a smile, Kei’s true feelings are hard to sense. Her expression rarely changes from the polite smile she has and it’s never quite known what she is thinking at any given moment. This constant smile, combined with her calm and composed behavior, often makes her come off as highly suspicious. And her eyes, while kind, seem to often hold a glint of cunning knowledge like she’s always several steps ahead of everyone else. And to Parahumans, she seems even more untrustworthy.

Despite her suspicious habits, Kei is actually a massive cape nerd. A fan of all kinds of superheroes and stories. Unknown to others, she often keeps recordings and newspaper clippings of various capes around the world. Her room is filled with merchandise of various heroes and she’s often in the forums of even the most obscure of capes. And while she is knowledgeable about superheroes, she doesn’t consider herself to be one. Perhaps due to the past, she didn’t have a lot of friends who weren’t Shades.
objects.title: Violet

objects.text:
Name: “Kei Maloku”?
Gender: Female?
Age: 0
Appearance: Beautiful (Disfigured)

Powers: Pillage + Ghoul + Hemorrhagia + Cursed Blood + Future Figures

Having lost all of its [DATA], [VIOLET] is determined to rebuild itself. Despite this loss, it quickly adapts and relearns how to consume Shards for [DATA] and resources. However, some aspects elude it, leading to critical errors. As a Shard-Hybrid Corpse that only vaguely remembers its original form, it attempts to modify itself to resemble what it believes [VIOLET] is, ultimately becoming a mere husk. Instead of possessing a death touch, [VIOLET]'s blood weakens and slowly kills Parahumans on contact. It can manipulate this blood into various shapes. Attempts to access the multiversal possibilities have failed, but by reverse engineering its current functions, it learned how to access possible futures to restore its blood or acquire new powers.

The body it currently inhabits is a corpse from a grave stitched together with Biokinesis to look as close as possible to what [VIOLET] thinks it looked like. If the body is killed, it raids the nearest Shard or the Shard that killed it and warps its host to look like [VIOLET].

Background:

[DATA]? [DATA]? [DATA]?

Missing Error: Not Found.

After a mishap with Time Travel, [VIOLET] lost all the [DATA] it had, vaguely remembering only bits and pieces of it. Now, it has no idea what it was or who it was. Any information that could be helpful has completely vanished, leaving it unable to find more. But what it does know is the instinct to gather [DATA] and enter conflict. And from that, it can hopefully find the missing [DATA] on [VIOLET] that disappeared.

Personality:

A Shard-Hybrid that has nothing to lose. Without any [DATA], it clings to its original purpose of collecting [DATA] and engaging in conflict. As a corpse, it relentlessly battles any Parahuman it encounters to the death, seeking to reclaim the missing [DATA] needed to become [VIOLET].

It’s quiet and emotionless, acting without needing a reason to find and seek out Parahumans. But despite this, it understands the notions of working with allies. If someone suggests they join teams, it’ll be easy to convince them to work together as long as the goal is [DATA]. [VIOLET] doesn’t understand social cues and can only see people as either being Violet or not Violet. With this kind of personality, it treats betrayal as a good thing and combat as a given. Though betraying Violet is unforgivable.
objects.title: [VIOLET]

addons.text: Due to Yura’s fame as a fashionable suit Tinker, many powerful people come to her for a suit. Maya is no different and requests a suit as well. A fashionable form-fitting suit with an array of defense capabilities. It can store energy from her Breaker State and use it to heal her wounds and power the suit. The suit also grants her the ability to gain the traits of the elements she controls, such as moving at high speeds even without actively using her powers. Due to Yura trying to tell everyone she specializes in frilly Magical Girl outfits, Maya got a buy 1 suit get 1 Magical Girl outfit free. Maya’s Magical Girl outfit is stronger than her suit; strangely, it has never been seen.
addons.title: The Thunderbolt

objects.text:
Name: Maya Khan
Other Aliases: Dawnbringer, Empress, Enyo (Ἐνυώ)
Gender: Woman
Age: 25 (Apparent)
Appearance: Attractive

Power:

Intrinsic (T0): Mover (Reaction), Tinker/Changer (Hygiene), Brute/Thinker (Pain)

Shard: The One Who Tamed Lightning, Reconstruction, Embodiment of the Supernova

Maya has a broad ability to manipulate electricity and plasma, though in a base state, she’s largely limited to electricity and lightning. Her shard grants her an innate understanding of electricity to complement this manipulation. At some point in her past, a second trigger granted her access to a breaker state that increased the potential of her manipulation by many magnitudes. The amount of plasma, light, and gravity she can generate and command is unfathomable. Her shard seems uninhibited with how much control it allows her over these abilities–a potential side effect of its isolation from its Entity. Entering her breaker state is able to fully heal and repair any damage to her body. The true appearance of her breaker state has never been witnessed, as she will either mask it with a more heroic visage or completely hide it under a tightly controlled light-based illusion.

Background:

Maya is originally from Earth Arad, a parallel Earth that diverged sometime around the Late Bronze Age collapse. Her earth had a much smaller population than Earth Bet, and notably few parahumans after coming into contact with the Entities. After triggering, she quickly rose up as one of the great world leaders on Earth Arad. Maya’s shard is seemingly an anomaly, as it doesn’t appear to be part of the same network that belongs to the Warrior and Thinker Entities. This affords Maya a large degree of protection and privacy from their shards. The isolation of her shard from its Entity has led it to becoming more attached to Maya and reaching out to her in her dreams, granting her a unique awareness of The Cycle. Maya has come to theorize that her shard was a centerpiece in its Entity’s energy production and regulation processes and would have served as the power source for its avatar.

Earth Arad is largely devoid of thinker and tinker shards, which has made Maya’s goal of obtaining [Negentropy] difficult. Now that she, through uncertain means, finds herself on Earth Bet, she has a much greater opportunity to gather subordinates to research and obtain the answers she seeks. Her awareness of The Cycle leads her to interfere with the plans of the Warrior and Thinker network, including taking a heavy handed approach to ending parahuman conflicts, destroying Endbringers, and preventing [Negentropy] from being discovered by them.

Personality:

Maya is a strong willed woman, and perhaps a little vain, as is fitting for someone who is used to standing upon the world stage. She sees it as her duty to maintain a relatively peaceful and orderly world, free from the interference by the Entities. She has a seemingly conflicting progressive stance on human agency and freedom with a heavy handed take on achieving and maintaining societal order. However, she is not, generally, an unfriendly person, and is much more relaxed out of the office. Those who grow close to her may even get the chance to see a more playful and easygoing side to her usual persona.

Her time in politics has taught her a great deal at being a great communicator and negotiator. She is fully capable of thinking on her feet and hiding her true intentions while leading political adversaries astray. She is an empress in every sense of the word.

In the times that she is drawn into more direct conflict, Maya tends to carry a sense of superiority over her opponents–something that clearly originates from the low parahuman population on Earth Arad. She prefers a much more straightforward approach in combat and will always favor ending a fight quickly than drawing it out, even if that requires more force than necessary to end the ordeal. Even though she tends to delegate when necessary, she is not afraid to get involved and get her hands dirty with things that some might see as beneath her.
objects.title: The Honored One

addons.text: Failing to convince Vasantra to wear a Magical Girl costume, Yura created the Interface Suit. Yet another cool fancy suit that enhances Construct’s powers. Construct’s hardlights are capable of replicating the physical traits of materials to reproduce various technology. Due to limited memory, it can only create simple weapons. It’s to note that Vasantra’s Magical Girl outfit has enough room to fit the blueprints of every weapon ever conceived from the past to the modern era. Sadly, Yura could not convince Vasantra to wear it on a casual basis.
addons.title: Interface Suit

objects.text:
Name: Vasantra Brontes
Gender: Woman
Age: 19
Appearance: Attractive

Power (Force Elemental with Built-In Orb + Unlimited Potential + Property Catalogue)

Construct has the ability to create and manipulate hardlight objects. She also has a catalogue of the physical properties of the objects she touches, which she can then apply to her constructs. Her constructs' strength depends on her own physical abilities, which is complemented by the lack of limit to her physical growth. She can perceive the world through her constructs, and even give them orders for them to carry out on their own. She can even give her construct's specific Manton Limits, deciding what affects/is affected by her constructs.

Background:

A second generation cape, Construct recently triggered while in a collapsing house and manifested a construct to protect herself. With both her parents being long dead, she relies on her two younger siblings for companionship, caring and loving them as any proper older sibling would. 

Personality:

Construct, while determined, is quite obstinate, and might not always be willing to rethink things. Maybe a little too confident, she would find things out the hard way more often than others. Still, this does not mean she wouldn't ask for help, it's just that she'd want to see that she's wrong before she admits it.
objects.title: Construct

addons.text: One of Yura’s commissioned pieces of equipment, a suit that grants the user protection. This suit boosts Node’s ability to enhance powers by making it faster as well as improving the maximum limit. Its name comes from the fact that Malcom was willing to buy the prototype without taking the time to make it more fashionable. It was insulting to Yura’s artistic sense, so she gave him a Magical Girl outfit as well. Surprisingly, he was willing to wear it if told to. Node’s Magical Girl outfit contains the frills needed to fit a kinetic absorption barrier that stops any projectile going toward him. It also has an EMP that can shut down any technology around him along with all the functions his suit possesses.
addons.title: Prototype 1

objects.text:
Name: Malcom Brown
Gender: Male
Age: 28
Appearance: Average

Power (Power Seed + Growth Booster + Power Proxy + Gatekeeper + Copycat + Parallel Processing with Mental Computer)

Node has the ability to permanently create, boost, or nullify the powers of anyone he has touched. Boosted and created powers take weeks to show a noticeable change, though nullification is instant. He can also add conditional triggers to powers he's affected, as well as use such powers for himself while they are nullified.

Background:

Using his cauldron bought powers Node has been at the center of the new power black market, and quite often brought in by cauldron as well. Until recently, he's been employed for his trump abilities, living a life of comfort as his employers rake in cash. He can use every power he's loaned out, causing him to have gained a grab-bag power set in addition to his primary abilities. He's been quite lackadaisical in this though, so it's not much of a head start, though you can change this if you handle him correctly.

Personality:

Node is very indifferent about life, and while he has his morals and preservation instincts, his emotions are almost always muted except for extreme cases. This leads to a lack of ambition, and him being a follower instead of the leader he could be.
objects.title: Node

addons.text: A strange man who commissioned clothing from Yura, she accepted but found it impossible to enhance any powers he had. Regardless, she managed to create an outfit that meets his specifications as a highly comfortable set of robes. The robes also function as note-keeping and can record anything Cole comes across to review for later. It also has the ability to record notes for review later.
addons.title: Akashic Record

objects.text: Name: Cole Eralin Other Aliases: Keeper of All Truths, The Eternal Scribe, The Living Archive Gender: Male Age: 20 (Apparent) Appearance: Attractive Power: Heart of Runes, Merlin Reincarnated Background: Cole Eralin was born eons ago on a rather unremarkable planet that has since been lost to time, publicly at the very least. It was on that very planet that he awoke his Heart of Runes, thus casting him from his home dimension into the wider multiverse. Understand that Cole’s curiosity has been and will continue to be his undoing. While the number of runes he has to his name is innumerable, his main focus is the collection of Knowledge in all its forms. Cole has the ability to manipulate and monitor the flow of information, secrets shared won’t be revealed, personal information will remain uncovered. Countless worlds have been left better off due to his presence, while just as many lay in ruin. Knowledge comes at cost that is often too great for those searching. Personality: Cole Eralin is the incarnation of curiosity, forever bound to explore the vast space that is reality. There is no length that Cole will not go to in order to discover something new, in addition Cole is incredibly unlikely to accept a trade of materialistic gains, preferring an exchange of knowledge. There are many things that can be shared freely, although beware there are some things you are better off unaware about without the proper protections. He is not interested in politics or unnecessary forms of obfuscation. Cole is capable of transforming any information into a memetic threat, or an anti-meme if he finds it deserved. Cole is the premier user of the Heart of Runes, as he is the very first being to ever awaken this system. There is no one with a deeper understanding of his particular form of magic. Rarely will Cole be at the front lines, instead being predisposed to supporting those who have yet to live out their own adventures. While he remains jaded due his experiences, Cole retains hope in this newly discovered realm of humanity. Knowledge is Power
objects.title: Keeper of All Truths

addons.text: One of Yura’s more successful commissions. Having successfully created a frilly Magical Girl outfit, Aurelia is now the proud owner of a green frilly Magical Girl outfit. At the commissioner’s request, this Magical Girl outfit lacks any combat abilities and instead focuses entirely on defense. It focuses on protecting Aurelia as much as possible from as many threats as Yura can think of. Trumps, Masters, and even Thinkers would have a harder time using their powers on Aurelia, and even if they are successful, their powers will be weaker. Aurelia can use Atlas while moving, but she has to move very slowly.
addons.title: Gaia Wardrobe

objects.text:
Name: Aurelia “Lia” Santos
Other Aliases:
Cerēcula
Leaf
Gender: Woman
Age: 18
Appearance: Attractive

Power
Intrinsic (T0): Mover (Reaction), Brute/Breaker (Hibernation)
Shard: Atlas, Confetti, Seed of Yggdrasil

Aurelia is an extremely potent agrokinetic, boasting near absolute control over any and all plants within a range of 10 miles. Her control extends to a lesser extent out to 100 miles, and her presence itself has an effect on plants within 1000 miles. So long as she remains rooted to the ground, she is also able to obtain near invulnerability and becomes an immovable object. She also boasts extremely fine and precise telekinetic control over small leaves within 100 meters of herself. She can extend both of these latter two abilities through any plant within her 10 mile, absolute control range. She tends to neglect using it, but Aurelia also has a high Brute rating corresponding to her ability to easily unroot and toss around trees with her bare hands.

Background

Aurelia was born on Earth Arad and was quickly scouted and recruited by Maya Khan after she triggered. Maya, having found Aurelia when she was young, quickly became a mentor figure to her and quite protective of her. Due to being a child up to this point, Maya has kept Aurelia out of major conflicts, meaning that Aurelia has little in the way of combat experience. This doesn’t concern her much, as her abilities are powerful enough even without experience and she dislikes violence.

Using her control over plants, Aurelia quickly rose to being the most responsible for ensuring strong and consistent, natural food production on Earth Arad. She spent most of her time at the Greenhouse, one of the primary locations for agriculture on Arad. Aurelia hopes to continue studying botany and agricultural sciences to further understand her abilities and help society. Through uncertain means, Maya went missing on Earth Arad, which led to Aurelia eventually finding herself on Earth Bet searching for her lost mentor.

Personality

Aurelia is an energetic and happy-go-lucky girl, even with all of the responsibilities she had pushed on her in her childhood. She finds it easy to talk to and make friends with people. To practice her plant manipulation, she greatly enjoys making unique, one of a kind, flowers for people.

She really dislikes violence and will try to diffuse a situation before it gets worse. If she’s dragged into something, she is far more likely to fight defensively and aim to immobilize her opponents than harm them. Extending her Atlas ability to her plants to create invulnerable prisons has been a go to for ending fights for her. She doesn’t like how much more parahuman conflict there is on Earth Bet and wishes to find her mentor and find somewhere peaceful to live instead.
objects.title: Valeria

objects.text:
Name: Nameless | Amata
Gender: Woman
Age: 0
Appearance: Average/Attractive

Amata's ringed eyes cause concern, lowering her appearance amongst those who dislike them.

Power ( Amata of Samsara )
Amata's power is best described as an abomination of Healing Circle, Redistribution of Pain, and Teddy Bear applied to her eyes.

She has three sections of this power.

The first part of her power is a Shaker effect with a range of fifty meters. Fifty meters around her, people will have dulled emotions, be extremely resistant against Master effects, be able to stay up for two days without any ill effects, go five days without water, and five weeks without food. The closer one is to Amata, the larger the effects, where if someone was right next to Amata for a week, they still would not be tired. At that point, it takes two weeks for a person to feel the effects of exhaustion or tiredness. This effect works on Amata as well, but to an extreme. Amata has no need for sleep, no need for food, no need for drink. Amata's emotions are constantly dulled, preventing her form experiencing extreme anything.

The second power of what forms "Amata of Samsara" is the the ability Amata's eyes hold. Amata, if looking upon an object or a person, will be able to repair their body or the object. Tinkertech is also included. The maximum range of this repair is 200 meters, upon which Amata can no longer repair things in line of sight. Amata's repair gets stronger the closer she is to the object, and also is constantly activated on herself. Her body is in a constant state of quick-repair, allowing her to bring her limbs back together the moment they're torn off. There is a limit, though. Amata can only repair herself once every fifteen seconds.

The third section is an activated ability that can only happen if Amata cuts off her own arm and keeps it cut off. A circle spreads on the ground below her, the blood and arm reducing themselves to atoms to form it. With that, Amata is put under intense amount of pain, to the point she is paralyzed. The circle spreads out in a radius of 100 meters and begins significantly healing everyone in the area. This will last fourteen seconds before Amata's second power forcefully stops it by regenerating her arm. Usage of this ability cripples Amata from the pain.

If Amata undergoes the equivalent of a Second Trigger, Amata will lose the ability to repair objects, but instead gain the ability to revive the dead up to a period of five years and lose the massive healing circle.

Background

Amata has no history, no memories, and no knowledge. There is no tattoo indicating Amata is a case 53, but she very well could be. She lacks seemingly everything that could identify her as anything but human. Test results of DNA will turn up nothing, not even ancestry. She is also not a drop-in from the CYOA, but could be considered more like a summon. She is summoned to your side to assist in your goals. Even if you had the power to see histories of people with no exceptions, Amata's will be blank.

One without a legacy to even look up to, one without a history to view. Amata has no past.

Personality

Amata is a curious individual, and a very talented one. As a result of her power, she is completely unable to sleep, but she can eat and drink. She has no idea what sleep is, nor does she understand language properly. Owing to her talented nature, she'll be able to pick up the local language within days, and owing to her nature as your companion, she will understand what you want her to do intuitively.

As a result of Amata's inability to experience extreme emotions, as her first power is always on, Amata is truly unable to empathize with people in contexts requiring it. She will never be able to understand why you scream yourself hoarse over a friend abandoning you, she will never understand why people break into tears over deaths in the family. To her, she will only be moderately upset, unable to truly empathize. Her power has given her a mental disorder in basic terms.

People are often communicating with emotion, which is also something Amata will struggle with. Amata will struggle to figure out context when emotion is the significant factor, only able to find out with copious amounts of time learning emotions. And even then, Amata will sometimes still default back and be unable to understand why someone who is asking for help isn't really asking for help with a problem, but asking for comfort. Amata will be a difficult companion as a result, but will be loyal.
objects.title: Amata of Samsara

addons.text: A strange commission from a funny guy, Yura was asked to create a comfortable lab coat that also protects the user from the elements. As they are both Tinkers, they worked together to design the perfect lab coat full of any kind of tools a Tinker may need on a daily basis. She had to reject adding a death laser into it though. It wasn’t frilly enough to reasonably fit one.
addons.title: THE LABCOAT OF DOOOOOOM!!!

objects.text:
Name: Ernest Green Moore
Gender: Male
Age:~40
Appearance: Average

Power: String Theory, (Tinker) Upcoming Century, (Tinker) Research And Development

Personality: Ernest is a goofball; to put it in simple terms, he likes to joke around to hide the scars that haunt his past. He is genuinely curious about everything science-related and wants to spread his joy of science to everyone he meets. However, in doing so, his schemes often include showing off his inventions to the world in a spectacular fashion. He genuinely does not see anything wrong with what he is doing and thinks he is a stand-up guy who plots to make the world a better place. If that just so happens to make him ruler of the city he is in, that is merely a coincidence.

Background: When he was little, he got no love from his parents and was a social outcast for being the nerdy kid in an out-of-the-way town with farmer parents. He has since become a scientist with the goal of taking over a city. He goes about this with grand inventions that always seem to fail; however, despite that, he has still never been caught, and he believes his next greatest success is with his newest invention.
objects.title: Professor Time

addons.text: A strange man who commissioned a set of comfortable and fancy robes. His powers were odd, and Yura had no clue how to work with them. But ignoring that, she managed to create comfortable robes that can protect the user from various kinds of impacts and have an inbuilt detection feature that can detect living organisms within a wide radius. When the Necrorobes were completed, another customer in a Magical Girl outfit jumped him in surprise, and he ran away in terror. She got paid at least. But now she understands that despite his tall figure, he’s afraid of Magical Girls. No wonder he looks at all the Magical Girl outfits with a wary expression.
addons.title: Necrorobes

objects.text:
Name: Azoth
Gender: Male
Age: Physically 24
Appearance: Average

Power: (Arcanist + Archmage + Monster Maker)

Azoth has a near unlimited amount of spells which he can cast, only limited by his gigantic mana pool and imagination. Anything from flight, enhancing his physical abilities, destroying a city by summoning a meteor, mind control, or tossing lightning bolts around are all things he can do. Continual effects such as buffs or auras will permanently decrease his mana pool until the effect is dispelled. If his mana pool is fully depleted, it will recharge itself in 8 hours.

Where Azoth truly shines is in the field of Necromancy, being able to raise thousands of basic zombies or skeletons or a small handful of higher tier enemies such as death knights, liches, or Nightwalkers daily. Azoth has total dominion over the undead created by him, and they only cost an initial sum of mana to create, and do not decrease his mana pool like buffs do.

Backstory:

Azoth was a parahuman who lived on an earth which never advanced past the late medieval era. The people on that earth that parahumans were magical in nature, and the world more resembled a classical high fantasy world than anything else. In that world, Azoth was a notorious necromancer who ruled over a kingdom of the dead and dreamed of world conquest. Fortunately for the rest of that earth, he would never be able to realize his dreams, as he was sent into Brockton with a case of amnesia after an altercation with a rival warlord.

Personality:

Due to the circumstances that sent him here, Azoth does not retain many memories of his past, only having a vague sense of his identity. Nonetheless, Azoth retains his keen intellect and manipulation skills, and he has no qualms with morally questionable tactics such as mind control or murder. Unlike his old self, the current Azoth lacks any grand dreams of conquest and prefers to stay out of cape business for the most part, desiring a quiet life of isolation and mostly using his powers for small inconveniences and to "disappear" those he dislikes. He also has a phobia of small children.
objects.title: The Archmagus

addons.text: A highly realistic robot commissioning a suit from her was not something she expected. She almost thought of him as a real person. Regardless, working with him was rather interesting for Yura. His insights into concealing technology within small spaces without hindering movement were revolutionary. Satisfied, she tried to offer a Magical Girl outfit as well. He didn’t accept it.
addons.title: Doom Suit

objects.text:
Name: Responds to "Doom" or "Your Excellency"
Gender: Robot, Male presenting
Age: ???
Appearance: Average, I guess? (Faux flesh looks burnt under the mask, but has great facial structure, so it probably evens out.)

Powers: (Brute) Man of Steel, (Thinker) Plans within Plans, (Thinker) Polymath, (Tinker) Research And Development

This Doombot, while limited and partially defective, is still an extremely capable planner, a polymath comparable to a modern Carl Fredrich Gauss, and still has access to parts of it's enormous technical database (though it must repair itself to access more). While somewhat inflexible and not starting with most of it's database due to damage to the memory center of it's artificial brain, it is still a convincing replica of the extradimensional megalomaniac who created it to those who don't know what to look for. It's external frame appears to be a set of almost medieval armor that hides all manner of built in Tinkertech.

Personality:

Doombot 4510, due to damage caused by the dimensional anomaly that dumped it on Earth Bet, appears to be a caricature of the personality of it's creator. It acts out grandiose monologues, elaborate deathtraps, and generally picks up the Villain Ball at every opportunity. This actually conceals it's intelligence & relative independence, which are more than good enough to fool most people into thinking they're talking to the original. An especially canny Tinker might be able to restore more of it's original functionality, but most would at best be able to get it to apply it's superhuman reasoning power to the question of why explaining your whole plan to your enemies is a bad idea.
objects.title: Doombot 4510

addons.text: Equipment commissioned by a mysterious relative of Ellena, she was given cute Magical Girl equipment that greatly improves the number of powers she can have. At most, she can have 200 powers, each at 4 on the PRT scale. But as time passes, the Magical Girl outfit will refine itself and adapt to Ellena’s growth. It can save and recall previously made patterns instantly, allowing for a quicker change in abilities.
addons.title: Iris

objects.text:
Name: Ellena Aguilera
Gender: Female
Age: 14
Appearance: Average

Powers: (Trump) Exonerate, (Trump/Shaker) Disperse.(Trump) Aliena

Ellena has a power that mirrors Eidolon, but where he has 3 strong powers, she can have many weak ones. She has an energy pool that she can use to form them. She can put only so much energy in a single power, otherwise the power will fail to form. Tinker, Trump, and permanent effect powers cost more energy to a lesser output. Her current limit is 20 powers at once, each a 2 in the PRT threat ranting. They take around 3 minutes to form, but can be dismissed at will. Previous made patterns cost a fraction of the time to recall. She has a secondary power that allows her to dispel power effects, or divide them among targets. She is a blind spot for Thinkers, and Trump powers dont see to work on her, either benefical or detrimental effects.

Ellena always keeps a multitask power, allowing her to recall or form more than one power at once. She is also one of the rare capes whose power can grow. In a year, it is expected that her energy pool will increase half as much, and she will be able to hold powers in a 4 on the threat range.

Background:
 
Ellena and her parents were refugees from Chile, leaving after Behemoth destroyed the Capital. Life in California was hard, from her father and mother scraping by with low paying jobs, and the prejudice and hate because of her origins. Things took a worst turn when a gang kidnapped her and her family at the dead of the night. Bounded, she watched her mother and father being mutated and killed after being force-feed two strange looking vials. When it was her turn, she felt a unbearable pain and saw a weird vision, but survived. The next day, when she was being processed to be sold to another group, she managed to escape using her powers. When she tried to approach a hero for help, the hero misunderstood the situation and tried to apprehend her. Due to this, she doesn't trust the authorities, and is currently on the run.

Personality:
Ellena was once a sweet and care-free kid. After losing her home and parents, and being forced to live in a foreign land without knowing how to properly speak the language, Ellena became closed and paranoid, distrusting anyone and always being on high alert. She still has a courageous side, and while she will run from danger, she will defend someone from it. A friendly hand could return some normalcy to her life and take her out of her shell, while a firm hand that proves that they can protect her can mold her into a trusty tool.
objects.title: Djinn

addons.text: Commissioned equipment made with the recommendation of some dude in a business suit, Yura created a gothic Victorian Magical Girl outfit with a lot of frills to create this one-of-a-kind outfit. The frills covering the majority of her body conceal the fact that it automatically does maintenance on Mei’s body while reinforcing the body for safer usage of Mei’s power. The dress acts as a kind of second skin that Mei can use to merge with her Tinkertech and then eject off it.
addons.title: Chains

objects.text:
Name: Mei
Gender: Female
Age: 19
Appearance: Disfigured 

**Power**
* Shard: (Tinker) Escalation + (Tinker) Destruction 
* Biology: Crawler/Weld-based mechanical body

Mei has a tinker power that rapidly grows in accordance to the threat she is facing. In addition to that, most of her tech is extremely destructive, as the simplest gun she can make can cause a small building to collapse, while harming its user.

Her biology has been altered by Mannequin, made based on Crawler and Weld. She absorbs any metal in contact with her when injured, and her body reconfigures itself to overcome whatever damaged her with no concern about keeping her appearance human. Due to this, she has to go into maintenance regularly to keep her humanoid form. This causes her to have an uncanny effect, looking pretty at fist until you take a good look at her. Additionally, due to her own tinkertech's properties, it is not uncommon to see her harming herself with every use, or her tech growing inhumanly.

While not necessarily a power, she has absurd pain tolerance.

**Background**

Only child of Lung, survived Kyushu but was kidnapped in San Francisco by Mannequin, who saw his daughter through her. She was put under various modifications and alterations before she suddenly had powers, using her power to finally escape and returned to her father’s embrace. A secret she kept was that she didn't trigger, but instead made a deal with some dude in a business suit.

**Personality**

Always doubts her ability, finds herself lacking, and gives off false confidence and desire for her father’s affection without realizing her father himself has no idea how to show such affection. Hates Mannequin, sees him as the greatest enemy, and hates what she is and her inhuman appearance. Dislikes how Mannequin calls himself her father. Hates Halloween due to the amount of skeletons people leave around, as it reminds her of a certain magic-claiming creep. Calls people pussy if they can’t take the pain.

Note: ABB will protect her, her father is overprotective of her and The Nine might swing around for her one day.
objects.title: Doll

addons.text: Equipment created as a commission to one of the oldest active capes known currently on behalf of some well-dressed individual. Yura was tasked with creating a dampener suit instead of what she normally makes. The Dial Suit is capable of swapping between boosting Roy’s power and weakening it. While boosted, he can apply his power to various objects and people, but it also makes him regress faster. While dampened, he begins to age normally.
addons.title: Dial Suit

objects.text:
Name: Roy Anderson
Gender: Male
Age: 89
Appearance: Attractive

Power:
Shard: (Mover/Breaker) Time Out!

Roy can cut himself off the current time flow. This allows him to, in his eyes, stop time. What is really happening is that he can accelerate his own time. His powers work automatically as well, making it that he cannot age and his body's time is reversed when injured. However every time he uses his power he becomes younger, weaker, and more childlike. Due to not being able to age he will be stuck in this state. Despite being over 89 years old, he currently looks to be no more than 12.

Background:

He was among the first to trigger, triggering right under Scion himself. He was in a hospital, on his death bed, cursing his lack of time when he triggered. He has been the oldest hero, and helped many during Endbringer fights. He has done much in his life and is more or less content. He has a yearly routine of meeting up with old friends for drinks, although the only one to consistently come is some well dress individual with a fondness of deals.

Personality:

The current Roy may seem energetic, childish and playful, but in reality he is cynical, unable to show it due to his mentality being affected by his age. The constant battle between his maturity and child brain is something he has had to deal with, so expect him to act old and wise but become a hyperactive child the very next second. Also has a phobia of undead, and keeps a distance from Myrddin due to his similarity to another guy calling himself a mage.

Note: Roy will die soon due to de-aging. He will ultimately be unable to survive long past gold morning, as at that point he will be an infant. He has, in his will, stated that once he is below age 5, he wishes to be put to rest.
objects.title: Timelord

addons.text: Equipment commissioned by Overhaul, it’s significantly less frilly than anything Yura has worked on before. With the Overlord suit, Mia’s radius expands significantly, and every other function was spent on other things. The suit can shapeshift into any form Mia desires while still maintaining the Tinkertech weaved into its metal while also assisting the user to be as comfortable as it can be. Yura managed to convince Mia to take a Magical Girl outfit along as well; hopefully, Mia will use it.
addons.title: Overlord

objects.text:
Name: Mia Bianchi  
Cape Name: Overhaul 
Gender: Female 
Age: 22 
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful 
Power: Overhaul + Omnikinesis 

Within a radius of 250 meters around herself, Overhaul has absolute control over reality,  essentially creating or transforming anything she can imagine into existence. Moving objects, generating and manipulating all forms of energy or matter, creating sentient beings, psychic constructs, alternative versions of herself or others, all this falls within her purview. The world is a vast ocean of vibration, matter, and energy to her senses, and all it takes is a thought to send it moving according to her wishes.

Alongside her incredible power to manipulate the world as she pleases, she has a secondary thinker ability that grants her inherent knowledge and understanding of all matter, energy and even conceptual beings and allows her to effortlessly, intuitively, and instantly control all that falls in her range. This allows her to perform actions such as seamlessly shapeshifting herself or others within her range, rearranging large areas instantly, effortlessly rearranging molecular structures, reshape, reassemble, or restore anything, living or not, at will and much more. 

Background:

Born on Earth Yarok Mia’s early life was in many ways idyllic. Born to wealthy parents who themselves had ingrained themselves deep into a successful and mostly peaceful region controlled by a powerful parahuman, she never truly experienced the horrors of the constant wars that plagued the rest of her world. Until at the age of 14, the plague struck her home. Pieces of Eden’s body had impacted her world years prior, entire regions mutated and the populace died horrible deaths or turned into terrifying powered monsters.

It was slow acting, Eden’s body only affecting the regions it had impacted first, however slowly but surely her poison spread, whether through the wind, the water, or other vectors, people became sick. It took her parents first, they thankfully died quickly, albeit painfully. Her younger sister Elena fell ill not long after, a fact that tore at her heart and crumbled her own resolve. Mia was next, her body slowly becoming weaker and more fragile, she had resigned herself to her inevitable demise, hoping to at least not turn into one of the monsters that lurked among their world and hopefully pass peacefully alongside her sister. 

However, there she was rescued, not by a doctor but a boy not much older than her, a parahuman, she had been weak when he had arrived, but she remembered in vivid detail as he placed his hand on Elena, and she suddenly “flickered”, awaking with such strength as if she had never been sick, more so even. He had cured her, and in the process turned her into a parahuman, and Mia not long after. Wishing to repay the one who saved them, and with the rest of their family dead, both Mia and her sister followed the boy who had saved them, who went by the strange name Green, joining the group of parahumans he traveled with.

Unfortunately on their world large territories are run by parahuman warlords, who would hire themselves as mercenaries and wage war against one another. As they usually needed a steady supply of parahumans, they would often buy newly awakened or captured parahumans, or outright hunt and enslave them themselves into their armies. After Green’s discovery of Blue and the subsequent fallout, the group had decided it was time to leave the world for another, for hopefully better pastures. 

Personality

Overhaul is a kind and charismatic individual who radiates positivity and warmth. She possesses a natural charm that draws people towards her. Her beautiful appearance, both inside and out, and natural happy disposition and warm smile captivates those around her. While she is a compassionate individual, her first priorities have always been those close to her, enough so that her compassionate nature will not stop her from destroying those that could harm them.
objects.title: Overhaul

addons.text: Equipment commissioned by Tyrant, it was one of the outfits Yura claimed to have the most difficulty with despite knowing how it works. The Model G costume is a high-functioning comfort costume with the general self-maintaining and cleaning features that all Yura’s equipment possesses. Deciding to focus more on the kind impression Elena gives rather than any specific power boost, it’s a suit that emphasizes Elena’s serious demeanor. While Yura was making it with Elena, she thought to herself that it didn’t match how Elena interacted with others.
addons.title: Model G

objects.text:
Name: Elena Bianchi  
Cape Name: Tyrant 
Gender: Female 
Age: 20
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful 
Power: Tyrant + Mr.Worldwide 

Tyrant possesses absolute dominion of all forces within a massive radius around herself that can encompass the entirety of the planet Earth. 

Through kinetic energy she can unleash blows and strikes that appear ordinary, but carry catastrophic force behind it, effortlessly drain the momentum of bullets fired at her leaving them harmlessly suspended in mid air, reshape the landscape at will, and much more. 

Beyond sheer strength, she has access to other forces as well, capable of using electromagnetic fields to render electronic devices useless, create devastating surges or call massive thunderstorms at will. Or she can utilize thermal energy to create searing conflagrations capable of scorching massive areas. 

Furthermore, her mind is enhanced, enabling subconscious calculations of the forces she can control with precision, and an innate understanding and awareness of the forces she can manipulate and all she can do with her power. This heightened cognitive ability allows her to effortlessly and intuitively manage the vast array of forces at her disposal, ensuring unparalleled and seamless control over the forces within her range. She can alter her range at will anywhere from full force to entirely off. 

Background:

Born on Earth Yarok, Elena had a wonderful life in her early years. Wealthy and loving parents, a peaceful home, a dotting older sister who adored her, living in what was seen as one of the most stable and successful regions on her world, Elena had everything going for her. Until the plague struck. Pieces of Eden’s body had impacted her world years prior, entire regions mutated and the populace died horrible deaths or turned into terrifying powered monsters.

It was slow acting, Eden’s body only affecting the regions it had impacted first, however slowly but surely her poison spread, whether through the wind, the water, or other vectors, people became sick. Her parents wasted away first, then her friends, her neighbors, she saw the peaceful world she had fade away. Then she fell ill, feeling her body growing feeble and weak, she became terrified, terrified of becoming a monster, terrified of her weakness, terrified of losing any more of her loved ones. Her body failing, her mind slowly following, she was at death’s door when she was rescued. 

A young parahuman, only a few years older than her, cured her with his ability. In doing so he awakened her power, giving her the strength that she craved in her weakened state. With their family now gone, and wishing to repay the one who rescued them, Elena and her sister followed the boy who had saved them, who went by the strange name Green, joining the band of parahumans he traveled with. 

Unfortunately on their world large territories are run by parahuman warlords, who would hire themselves as mercenaries and wage war against one another. As they usually needed a steady supply of parahumans, they would often buy newly awakened or captured parahumans, or outright hunt and enslave them themselves into their armies. After Green’s discovery of Blue and the subsequent fallout, the group had decided it was time to leave the world for another, for hopefully better pastures. 

Personality

Tyrant typically carries a calm attitude, often appearing unfazed in any situation. Highly independent and self confident Tyrant is used to confronting and solving problems before anyone else realizes that there is one. The range of her abilities has often left her the first to face an opponent, resulting in her gaining an incredible amount of experience in direct combat with others. 

Despite her at times serious demeanor she is friendly and open to others, being notably well versed and friendly with children and animals. She gets along famously with Blue, having given him his first pet, and often watching over him and on occasion taking him flying.
objects.title: Tyrant

addons.text: The bear now comes with a lute, the tier 0 power Shaker/Master and a natural mastery of music, being capable of playing any song they've ever heard.
addons.title: BeArserk

addons.text:
There were in fact 21 bears involved in the mauling of Jack Slash that day. Sir Yogi was the one that arranged it all. Sir Yogi is in fact smarter than the average bear and one day had a premonition that Jack Slash would end the world. 

Sir Yogi is revealed to have a lesser version of the shardless Polymath and an ageless immortality. The premonition was just a one-time thing sadly, no future seeing bear for you.
addons.title: The Prodigal Cub

addons.text:
While out exploring the multiverse with Blue, the two of them happened upon a strangely docile bear that they decided to claim as a pet for Blue.

Eliza convinced Blue to grant a power to Sir Yogi, giving him a Trump ability that makes hostile powers unable to affect him directly.
addons.title: A Normal Pet

addons.text: Sometimes, the equipment Yura is asked to make can get strange. But other times, a non-harmful way of tracking Sir Yogi might top the list of weird things. Surprisingly, Tracking Device A is not a collar but a ribbon tied around one of Sir Yogi’s arms. It contains not just a tracking device, but it can also serve as protective armor by creating a barrier around the entire body that protects against heat and cold or teleport Sir Yogi to the nearest teleportation beacon. Yura keeps one such teleportation beacon in her workshop.
addons.title: Tracking Device A

objects.text:
Name: Sir Yogi
Gender: Male
Age: 5
Appearance: Rugged

Power:
Is inexplicably good at fighting Jack Slash.
Personality:
Is a bear.
objects.title: A Mundane Bear

addons.text:
Due to Eidolon having less stress, he noticed that his daughter wasn't as keen on heroing as he was and toned things down to a much more reasonable level.

Eliza is now a ward, and she now hangs out with you while on break from her ward duties.

She will be much more receptive to helping you out with serious tasks, although she’ll still be pretty insistent on unwinding. She's on break after all.
addons.title: Solver of Father Issues

addons.text:
When she ran away from home she was left wandering the multiverse aimlessly, until one night when she was feeling home sick, she idly wished “that there was somebody in her family with fewer issues she could talk to”, and got surprised when her power responded with a location. Her power took her to a strange parallel earth that had been infected with portions of Eden, where she soon met a man that went by the name of “Green”. 

Upon realising she was alone and not an enemy, Eliza was quickly accepted by the group Green travelled with. Upon seeing the similarities in their abilities, Eliza quickly found herself under Green’s wing. 

Seeing Greens more laid back approach to the responsibility of his great power while still making use of it to support what he believes in has helped her feel more comfortable with her own ability to act without dedicating herself to her task. She's now much more comfortable assisting you with any kind of caping business you may have, although she has a preference for non-combat roles.

Green proved to be an incredibly effective teacher and quickly accelerated her training and growth in ways her father never could. Teaching her to be capable of manipulating her flickering states with greater ease than ever before.
 
Most of note is that she has gained the ability to separately conjure the alternate states her flickering accesses, allowing her to summon alternate versions of herself and anything else her flickering can apply to, although keeping these alternates summoned takes focus. She is capable of then fusing these alternate versions with the original, granting them the best traits of their fused selves for the situation, similar to chevalier's power. Alternative versions of parahumans get a random, different version of their power. Alternative versions of herself cannot have the same power selected. Fused parahumans (including herself) will have their powers fused to be the best as well, with powers sufficiently differing enough instead gaining synergistic traits with each other.

He resolved her battery issues by replenishing her power and converting her into a being similar to himself. This also had the added benefit of amplifying the power she can summon to be capable of equaling an Endbringers. While she still can’t fight or summon powers as strong as Green can, she is more than a match for her father. 

She also now reflexively teleports whenever she hears the word “dodge”, a side effect of Green’s habit of shouting it before launching powerful attacks her way during her training. You could get away with ‘accidentally’ triggering this little quirk once or twice a month if you're careful about it. 

While she still dislikes battle, she has become a more capable fighter, picking up Green’s more ruthless combat style. 

She also has a tendency to take Blue exploring, often without telling Green, to his annoyance.
addons.title: Teal

addons.text: One of the few people whom Yura managed to convince to purchase a Magical Girl outfit, Eliza's new dress is imbued with a unique power. This outfit acts like an enhanced version of a Breaker state, allowing her current powers to "bleed" into it as an additional, powerful expression. For instance, if she wields pyrokinetic abilities, the dress transforms its ruffles into powerful jets of fire that she can manipulate. This boost significantly amplifies her existing powers, providing both Magical Girl Aesthetics and strength in battle. Because Eliza purchased it with the Buy 1 Suit Get 1 Magical Girl Outfit Free deal, she also has a suit. Though the suit can take on different styles like her Magical Girl Outfit, it’s much more focused on aesthetics.
addons.title: Crosshairs

objects.text:
Name: Eliza Nunyabidnes (She gives a different obvious gag surname every time she’s asked)
Gender: Woman
Age: 16
Appearance: Feminine, Average

Power (Ignis Fatuus + Ideal Transit):
She is capable of entering a flickering breaker state, allowing her to page through alternate versions of herself and swap any traits with them, including swapping injured body parts for healthy ones to heal herself, swapping her position with an alternative self, allowing her to teleport anywhere or even swapping in objects she could potentially be holding, allowing her to conjure any object she could reasonably carry or wear, including minor tinkertech. She’s also capable of doing these things for anything/anyone she touches.

Finally, she has the ability to pull one power at a time from an incredibly large database containing basically every power that could reasonably be distributed during a standard cycle. Every power has a “battery” that drains based upon usage (lower strength powers have better battery life). These batteries are smaller than Eidolons but “recharge” automatically over time.

She’s capable of finding any useful alternate self (or power) she desires nigh instantly, with her power automatically sorting her catalog of alternate selves so that the most useful traits/powers for her desires and situation are always around the top of the list. This prioritization even accounts for information she doesn't have yet, being near precognitive in its accuracy (i.e. her teleport locations are automatically adjusted to ensure she neatly dodges or easily notices hazards, the powers at the top of the list tend to be ideal for solving her problems even based upon information she doesn't yet have etc.).
Background:

Eliza was conceived when her mother had a one-night stand with Eidolon. She lived a rather happy life not knowing the identity of her father until one day she triggered during an endbringer attack while on vacation with her mother. 

After her trigger, her father introduced himself to her and quickly began to fill her schedule with training, trying to mold her into the perfect superhero by his standards.

But as the training began to build up, her social life began to suffer, and she started feeling stressed out from all the pressure her dad was pushing on her. Her power reacted to this and started “malfunctioning”, pushing stranger/mover type powers and far away teleport locations every time she reached for it during training instead of more useful powers. Her father intensified the training in response, intent on training her to be able to push past these “malfunctions”, until she finally snapped and ran away from home.

Since then, she's been wandering about the multiverse aimlessly, on the lookout for the next interesting thing to distract herself with.
Personality:

A contagious wellspring of energy and enthusiasm, Eliza is always on the lookout for fun and new things.

She’s a free spirit and heavily dislikes being ordered around. She wants to do things because she feels like it, not because somebody else is making her. 

She seems to have an almost supernatural ability to tell when you're upset, almost always showing up whenever something is bothering you or stressing you out. She's shockingly good at knowing just the thing to help you calm down or de-stress, whether that be taking you on a tour of the greatest sights in the multiverse, suggesting weird new activities (“Have you ever tried zero gravity paintball?”) or simply just showing up with a pint of ice-cream and being there to talk to.

She has a strong sense of empathy. If she sees someone suffering, she'll inevitably be drawn into helping them out. Not to say that she's a total doormat, she's rather good at telling when she's just being taken advantage of and isn't afraid to ditch anybody who tries.
