She dislikes actual fighting (“It's just not as fun if everybody else isn't having fun with you”) and tries to avoid it whenever possible, although she can be convinced to spar with you so long as it's kept rather casual.

Despite her attempts to suppress it, she does secretly have a competitive streak and if you beat her at something, you can probably expect her to eventually challenge you again, although she’ll probably try to dress the activity up as something new.

While you could hypothetically convince her to actually address her issues with her father and responsibility, she has her father's stubbornness and the rebellious spirit of a teenager, so good luck with that.
objects.title: Wisp

addons.text:
While Wisp's resistance to their Thinker power threw Murphes off at first, the two of them wound up quickly developing a wonderful, if strange, friendship.

While Wisp was rather helpful at teaching Murphes about morality, she was also very effective at teaching the concept of pranks to the creature, which they took to wholeheartedly. 

This inevitably kicked off a prank war between the two, which, with the use of their powers, has escalated to a rather comical extreme.

The constant practice against a blind spot has led Murphes to become incredibly effective at predicting and planning around opponents even when they're immune to Thinker powers.
addons.title: Immaterial

addons.text:
As animals living in a human world, it can be tough for them. Thus the two of them have banded together.

The two creatures have learned an almost supernatural ability to understand each other at a glance, allowing them to coordinate incredibly well.

Murphes has learned from Sir Yogi, gaining an increased ability to push through the pain and how to move in a strange pattern that makes them shockingly effective at dodging Blasters, even without the usage of their Thinker power.

Sir Yogi has learned from Murphes how to be disconcertingly good at stealth, enough that one might believe the bear to have some kind of Stranger power. He is incredibly good at jump-scaring people with these skills, having a habit of popping up in the most unexpected and unusual places.
addons.title: Big And Small

addons.text: A cat costume for an autonomous Master Projection, compared to the bear, this one is actually less surprising. Commissioned by the same person who wanted Tracking Device A, Catsuit Noir is a stylish suit that can be worn by a cat. Due to having even less surface area to work with compared to a normal suit, it has some simpler functions. The suit can create a realistic replica of the area around them in a 250-meter radius to spy from any angle Murphes desires, even from far away. This can reproduce sounds, look behind walls, and analyze the temperature of water at a distance. It’s attached to Murphes’ power, and because of that, it comes along with him wherever he goes, and can summon it similar to how Yura’s Magical Girl equipment can be. It also amplifies Murphes’ invisibility, making him completely undetectable.
addons.title: Catsuit Noir

objects.text: Name: Murphes Gender: N/A Age: 6 months Appearance: Sleek Powers: Murphes is a fully autonomous Master projection, in the form of a black housecat of an indeterminate breed. Unlike a housecat, Murphes' has raccoon-like paws that allow them to deftly manipulate objects, no need to sleep; drink or eat, and a lyrebird-like voice box, allowing them to mimic sounds. Murphes can target a person within line of sight to mark them, at which point they can then stay within 100 metres of them, as when they're not within range of their target or Master, they will become weak and sickly. When they die, they will resurrect in a safe space nearby their Master, who is currently in a hospital being watched by the PRT. Murphes has a Stranger power, allowing them to choose to become invisible to direct observation, only being detectable through the edge of one's senses (in the corner of the eye; at the edge of your hearing; etc.) or secondary methods (mirrors, echoes, cameras, etc.) Paired with that, they have a precognitive Thinker power that grants them enhanced planning abilities and precognitive "polling" to assist them in engineering scenarios to cause maximum harm in any way possible to their current target, building upon the consequences of each plan to escalate further: building rube goldberg traps; sabotaging their relationships; triggering their trauma; etc. This power is most efficient when Murphes has a minute of time and some resources to plan and prepare, but it can, in a pinch, work as an on the fly combat Thinker power. Personality: Murphes is soft-spoken and intelligent. However, they lack any kind of social grace without the assistance of their Thinker power, speaking rather bluntly and honestly. ㅤ They have a strange innocence about some things. Due to a combination of their inhuman mindset and the fact that most of their information comes from either the shard or their Thinker powers black-boxed assistance, they have huge blindspots in their knowledge base that leaves them with strange assumptions about the way things work. Murphes' mind functions more like a cats than a humans, including lacking innate empathy for humans. That doesn't mean they can't come to care about other people, it just means it's harder for them to fully understand other people or the impact their actions have on them. Murphes has recently discovered that they rather enjoy wordplay and poetry, finding the strange tics of the various human languages, and the many ways they can be formed a fascinating experience. While they are much calmer without the feedback cycle from their Masters influence, they do still get antsy and will feel the need to occasionally cause trouble for somebody due to the influence of their shard. Background: Murphes is the minion of a former villain, having been used to harass, sabotage and occasionally assassinate business opponents for their Master, the CEO of a moderately large business. One day, their Master got involved in an unfortunate car accident and fell into a coma, leaving Murphes without any further instructions on what to do. While Murphes wandered about the city attempting to find a way to come to grips with their unexpected independence, they were caught by the PRT, who had discovered the connection between Murphes and their Master. Murphes managed to escape and decided to leave town in order to expand their search and save their Master, both from the PRT and their health condition. However, as they spent more time away from their Master, they began to realize how little they truly knew, especially about the humans their life revolves around, and started to question the nature of themselves and their place in the world. ㅤ On their travels, they came across you and, for whatever reason, felt that you could help them answer the various questions and doubts they've recently come to have.
objects.title: Murphes

addons.text: A complicated commission with a strict set of requirements, Yura spent a great deal of time designing various outfits before Anastasia decided to simply buy them all. A greater deal of time was spent on creating the most beautiful clothing to match her appearance. It is a set of 7 clothing connected to a network that shares information on Anastasia’s adaptations and adapts itself to best create the most beautiful form it can do. The Aphrodite Series of clothing also greatly improves her control and speed of her adaptations while keeping it within her perception of beauty. This is done by making the Shard treat the dress as skin and grow adaptations onto it, causing most adaptations to happen on the outfit itself rather than Anastasia’s body. It is one of the few dresses Yura has created, as most of her commissions involve making a suit.
addons.title: Aphrodite Series

objects.text:
Name: Anastasia Aelius 
Gender: Female
Age: 25
Appearance: Beautiful 

Power: Bag of Holding, Rebirth, Terraforming, Beauty, Accelerated Evolution, Self-Biokinesis

As a cluster cape she enjoys the benefit of having four distinct powers, one primary power and three secondary powers.

Her primary power manifests as a powerful multifaceted changer ability. It passively has her body undergo tens of thousands of years of evolution a second based on the stresses her body is currently under. 
There are two safeguards embedded into this passive ability: one ensures her power never devolves her body below her base state, and the other ensures that her physical form is constantly evolving to fit her aesthetic preferences for her own body whenever her life isn’t in danger.
Besides those passive abilities this power has an active mode in which she has total control over her internal biology and appearance down to cellular level. In either mode she maintains complete awareness of her biology down to the genes of individual cells.

As for her secondary powers one is the ability to project a portal to a pocket dimension with seemingly infinite space in it for storage. She can also have the portal shoot something out at up to 60 miles per hour.

Another of her secondary powers accumulates charges and whenever she should happen to die, one of this power's charges is used, bringing her back to life a month later at random safe spot. She started with one charge, gaining one charge per month she goes without dying, with this power having a maximum capacity of 5 charges.

Her final secondary power is a potent and versatile tinker power specializing in survival in inhospitable environments with dual approaches to that specialty. One approach focuses on surviving and navigating hostile environments in various ways, the other focuses on changing the environment to suit her needs.

Personality:

Naturally introverted and reserved she can come off as cold and standoffish to people she isn’t familiar with. 

Because of her experiences she has an intense hatred for discrimination, villains, criminal organizations, and especially Gesellschaft.

She greatly enjoys reading fantasy and sci fi stories as well as playing rpg video games along with some shooters.

She is very attached to her newfound beauty, perhaps unhealthily so, being very unwilling to spend even a moment in a form that doesn’t meet her beauty standards after two decades hating her appearance.

Unlike most parahumans her powers have done a great deal to help her overcome her trauma and mentally recover even if she doubts she’ll ever fully get over her experiences. 

Background:

Born to a moderately wealthy family in Greece in her early life Anastasia grew up plagued by several genetic illnesses that negatively affected her health and physical development. Even though she was showered with affection from her parents and never had to deal with any serious bullying or negative treatment from her peers she grew to despise her body from both the constant pain she felt from it and its appearance seeing herself as extremely ugly.

Then in her early twenties she was kidnapped by Gesellschaft who had obtained her medical records and noticed she had the potential to trigger. She and three other victims would be drafted into an experiment to create a stable four person cluster that would serve Gesellschaft. Through the planning efforts of Gesellschaft thinkers they were subjected to personalized tortures that would see them each trigger within a minute of each other forming a four person cluster.

Incredibly traumatized Anastasia would create a powerful tinker based organic explosive material in her body with her first use of self-biokinesis that she then detonated, as she was unwilling to remain captive by Gesellschaft. Luckily for her, one of her secondary powers automatically revived her in a safe location a month later far from any Gesellschaft members.

In that safety her power got to work giving Anastasia a body she could only dream of before her trigger which helped her calm down. 

After taking a moment to gather her bearings she immediately made her way back home. After proving her identity and reconnecting, the family has since decided to move to America to put as much distance between them and Gesellschaft as possible. 

After settling into her new home in America with her family she has taken to being an independent hero named Typhon both as a way to keep her family and new town safe, but also as a way to practice her powers in a chaotic environment and get experience fighting. Anastasia has also literally reinvented herself making her body look completely different with a normal human appearance when in her civilian identity pretending to just be a friend of her family only taking on her true form when in private.

As she would grow more familiar with her powers she would experiment with her tinker power and self-biokinesis to enhance her body in various ways while maintaining her beauty with her most commonly applied attributes having her look mostly human with some draconic traits.
objects.title: Typhon

addons.text: A commission outside of her usual expertise, Yura was asked to create power armor but without needing a pilot. Working together with Verdant, she created a fully robotic combat body that can incorporate the powers she possesses. The Omega Body is capable of regeneration as long as a piece of it is intact and can connect to other combat bodies for simultaneous control. As a freebie, Yura attached various outfits for the Omega Body, including a frilly Magical Girl outfit.
addons.title: Omega Body

objects.text:
Verdant
Cost: 48 CP

Name: Samantha Hebert
Gender: Female
Age: 32
Appearance: Beautiful 

Powers: Redundancy, Solarpunk, Deadpool, Rotom, Pocket Dimension

As a cluster cape she enjoys the benefit of having four distinct powers, one primary power and three secondary powers. 

Her primary power is a potent and versatile Tinker ability specializing in all things Solarpunk, a movement that focuses and envisions a potential sustainable future where both nature and technology are one. Through innovative design principles and meticulous engineering, her tinkertech is fault-tolerant and can withstand extensive damage or component loss, demonstrating remarkable durability, adaptability, and reliability. This comes paired with two minor abilities, one to convert plant material into usable components for tinkering that are resistant to chlorokinetics and the other is enhanced memory concerning green technology and positive social engineering. 

Her first secondary power provides her high level regeneration, so long as even a single cell survives she will eventually regenerate. Through shard side synergy and communication this power doesn’t reject genetic modifications she makes to her body, unless they are actively harming her, same with cybernetics so long as she remains partially organic and those cybernetics can accurately communicate and work with her organic biology, however any such cybernetics won’t be repaired by this power if damaged.

Her second secondary power lets her possess non-living objects, and control electronics through this. Her physical health is altered to match the condition of the objects she possesses. She still has all five senses while possessing an object. If she has cybernetics they come with her when she possesses an object, though she doesn’t have access to her cybernetics functionality when she does, same for clothing.

Her final secondary power lets her teleport into a pocket dimension at will. It is only about as large as a warehouse, has no windows, and is furnished with all the basic necessities for living. No one can detect this dimension or forcibly enter it without her direct consent.

Personality:

She is a very private and introverted person, struggling to connect to others after the trauma she has undergone.
Though when she’s in her heroine identity she hides her pain behind a smile.

She enjoys reading fantasy and sci fi books, along with relaxing and napping in private secluded areas.

Background:

A few decades ago, after her mother divorced her father, Samantha moved from North America to England for her mother's work. Although she was relieved to distance herself from her abusive father, she deeply regretted leaving her older brother behind.

Samantha led a relatively normal life. She attended school, made friends, graduated, attended college for a few years, and eventually secured a job at a factory. Despite her mother's persistent nudging to find a husband and start a family, Samantha never found herself attracted to any man. This caused her to question herself and wonder if she was somehow flawed. 

While her life was far from perfect, she was content. That was until her mother fell ill due to a chemical spill. Although her mother didn't die immediately, Samantha took it upon herself to cover her mother's medical bills and ensure she was well cared for. Despite Samantha's best efforts, the treatments only delayed the inevitable. Over the following three years she had to watch her once vibrant mother deteriorate into a mere shadow of her former self before passing. Her mother's death in front of Samantha's eyes pushed her over the edge and triggered her.

Unfortunately for Samantha, things are about to get much worse for her, as after her trigger she was near immediately kidnapped by villain organization Gesellschaft.

As she would soon discover her newfound tormentors had learned through a random search with their thinkers that she had the potential to trigger, and was building toward a tinker trigger. So they secretly began to monitor her, predicting when and where her trigger would occur through their thinkers' efforts. All the while they planned on what to do with her after her trigger, ultimately it was decided she would be drafted into one of Gesellschaft's cluster trigger experiments into making a four person cluster. 

When she finally triggered they ensured her clustermates were secretly nearby, and through extremely precise timing and thinker planning were pushed over the edge to trigger at nearly the same time as her to form a cluster.

What followed her kidnapping would be two months of unspeakable horror as Gesellschaft sought to break her to their will, until finally she managed to escape by scattering her cells across half the world using a modified irrigation system. A significant chunk of her grey matter in particular was sent to America, the country chosen for her escape as besides allowing her to reconnect with her brother, America was also far from Gesellschaft influence. 

When she finally regenerated she would go underground doing her best to hide her identity as she tried to rebuild her life, she would find her pocket dimension invaluable in this as it provides all the basic necessities for life and had enough space for a tinker workshop.

Eventually she would end her seclusion after one of her scavenging runs for tinkering supplies ended in disaster, she was attacked by a villain seeking to pressgang the tinker into working for them when out of nowhere a heroine came from above to fight the villain giving her a chance to escape. 

The experience would shake her from her rut and inspire her to become the heroine Verdant. Seeking to fight villains and give people hope.

For combat she prefers to use her breaker power to possess fully robotic combat bodies she builds. While combat capabilities and durability is important to her, she also strives to make any robotic body she creates and possesses to resemble a human in power armor with their face exposed to best inspire hope and positivity in people.

By the time she meets you she has also started trying to locate her brother Danny, seeking to reconnect.
objects.title: Verdant

addons.text: A commission requesting the strongest equipment Yura can create, disregarding appearance. Yura creates the Aegis Magical Girl outfit, complete with enough frills to touch the ground. A groundbreaking piece of armor that can take in the properties of Amelia’s blood to apply various effects onto the ‘saves’ she creates. The frilly Aegis outfit is also capable of storing up to 70 saves at once and allows her to move around while summoning a save as long as she stays within a general area. Sadly, due to Amelia’s ability to shift equipment into another space, it’s unlikely the news will ever report on Shield Maiden wearing a frilly magical girl outfit.
addons.title: Aegis

objects.text:
Name: Amelia 
Gender: Female
Age: 25
Appearance: Wild but Beautiful 

Powers: Snapshots, Metamorphosis, Bloody Tinker, Weatherman, Ghost Equipment 

As a cluster cape she enjoys the benefit of having four distinct powers, one primary power and three secondary powers. 

Her primary power allows her to create ‘saves’ of the areas and people around her. The longer she stands still while taking the save, the wider the range becomes. Her power can store up to 7 saves at once.  She can summon these saves at anytime, allowing her to swap her current surroundings with any previously captured moment in an instance. The saves act normally, and will not know that they are not the real deal, although they can deduce it with time. The duration of her summoned saves depends on its size and her experience. The bigger the summoned saves, the harder it is to maintain. Once the save is dismissed, the area returns back to how it was before she deployed her save.  

Her first secondary power allows her to create a cocoon around her body. If she stays in the cocoon for less than an hour, all it will do is slowly heal her injuries and cure her of any disease. But if she stays within longer than an hour, her appearance will start to be altered. The cocoon will first optimize the body's natural systems, and then it will start to  slowly transform her body to better reflect and utilize her other powers.

Another of her secondary powers is a tinker specialization with two very different approaches to technology. The first allows her to alter the composition and properties of blood, allowing it to perform a variety of anomalous actions. This can include enhancing physical capabilities, increasing healing power, or even granting limited powers. She can also create tinkertech made out of blood to create or enhance objects.
The second approach allows for the creation of long-term, wide area, indiscriminate effects. Starting at effects covering a block and growing in range from there.  Examples of things she could build are: a static generator that emits intense apathy upon everybody in a multi-block radius; a thick fog that forces immense downward gravitational pull upon every airborne object inside; she could even create direct weather events, forcing a city to endure a constant barrage of powerful lightning strikes from a permanent thunderstorm or survive an eternal sub-zero blizzard.

Her last secondary power allows her to make any equipment she is wearing shift to another space but still keep its benefits and functions. For example, she can wear power armor and be strong, but look like she is wearing normal clothes. The invisible equipment will still protect she from damage and need to be repaired if she takes too much damage. Acting like having a hidden layer of gear over her outfit.

Personality:

Full of rage that she struggles to control. But has a soft spot for those who have suffered.

Struggling to learn how to enjoy life. The sight of masculine features makes her remember her captors in Gesellschaft for various reasons but she doesn’t take out that instinctive revulsion on the innocent as she knows that would make her no better than her captors.

Hates being weak or in a position of weakness.

Background:

Her past is a mystery to her, with her first clear memories having her awakened in a Gesellschaft facility with amnesia. She would have no time to process this state of affairs as she would near immediately be subject to various environmental tortures. From being thrown into the middle of the ocean, left on top of a cold mountain, to being left stranded in the middle of desert. Day after day her torturers would have teleported across the world to various environments only barely given enough food and medical attention not to die between her torture sessions.

While this state of affairs continued she would learn a few things about herself and her circumstances. First she definitely hates Gesellschaft, second is that she likes the name Amelia and has decided that that is her name now, third is that the reason she was being tortured was because she, and three other victims had been drafted into an experiment to create a stable four person cluster that would serve Gesellschaft. 

Through the planning efforts of Gesellschaft thinkers they were subjected to personalized tortures that would see them each trigger within a minute of each other forming a four person cluster.

After her trigger she immediately started plotting on how to use her new abilities to escape and gain revenge. Eventually concocting a blood based retrovirus that she would expose everyone in the base that contained her to using a modified fog machine. This retrovirus would give the members of Gesellschaft amnesia while also altering the structure of their egos, and personalities in ways that would spark prejudistic rage in them if they could remember their past beliefs. The only ones she spared were herself, and the sole remaining member of her cluster she knew to live.

Now with her freedom acquired she travels the world making it her life’s work to mock and destroy the principles of Gesellschaft by being a true heroine while dressed up as a Viking:

Through a combination of her cocoon power and blood tinkertech she has also begun modifying her body, to get rid of weaknesses, and strengthen herself while still possessing a beautiful but imposing heroic figure.
objects.title: Shield Maiden

addons.text:
The CBR was among the few incidents (and the most recent) handled by Avant Garde on Earth Bet, managing to successfully subdue and with Green’s intervention somewhat “fix” her power. Unveiling a young 9-year-old girl, who he would take in to raise as his own.

She now lives as a relatively normal young girl named Lucy under the care of Green, albeit incredibly powerful. She insists on being called Red, an affectation she adopted upon learning he called Blue as a pet name after his own. Will react with incredible and relentless violence to any perceived threat to her saviors and adopted family.

She now possesses Nascent Eldritch, and its upgrade Epithet Bound to Yaldabaoth alongside Multi Faced, Effectively winning the war against the entity remaining before it has begun. However do be wary, as she may in turn become an even greater threat than the entity. This will only happen in the event of the sudden loss of her new adoptive family, or your direct intervention. The loss of the first family she has ever truly had may end up… disastrously.
addons.title: The Scarlet Queen

objects.text:
Name: L̵̵̷u̸̷̵c̶̷̶y̵̸̸  Lost, "The Heart"
Gender: F̶͙͝ẽ̶̝m̴͛ Unknown
Age:  9̵̭̀ ̸̪͘Y̵͎̽e̴̙͒a̶̛̯r̵͆s 3.5 months?
Appearance: Ä̸́̑v̸̓͌e̵͆͆r̷̙̎a̵̮̅g̸͆̚e̸̓ Nightmarish

Power (Shard Yaldabaoth) and Description: An unending tide of screaming horrors, numbering into the millions strong, it performs utterly horrifying assaults whenever it "activates" obliterating and rendering more and more of the country uninhabitable, The CBR seems capable of eternal growth, As a result, the CBR is soon to be classified as an S-Class threat. If one can enter through the unholy landscape, horrifying wildlife, and timeline paradoxes and survive, they may encounter the "heart" of the CBR an utterly nightmarish beating heart covered in a mass of eyes, it is likely the destruction of the "heart" will destroy the CBR, or at least halt its growth. -Canadian Military Report

Personality: If one were to encounter "The Heart" one would find a highly introverted individual, only amplified by their new horrific form, alongside various forms of Dysphoria, and a large amount of physiological issues, stemming primarily from their new and old appearance, and suffering a borderline paranoid siege mentality, borne from a lack of communication due to an ironclad language barrier, countless failures convince the humans to stop attacking have begun to eat away at their idealism, which is slowly fading away, as a result "The Heart" Is becoming increasingly desperate to form some sort of relationship with the humans before they perish, or worse, wander off...

Background:  A forgotten child, inside a long dead city, the master of the hivemind, and its slave, whoever the "CBR" once was is lost to time, but if one were to ask "The Heart" they would receive a series of contradicting stories, which of these stories, if any, are true is left open to question, but no matter how hard one tries to point out these contradictions, "The Heart" will somehow not notice.
objects.title: Crimson Blight Region

addons.title: The Rise of the Human Singularity

addons.text: A commission involving collaboration with the vigilante Pulsar, was a lot more mundane than any other commission Yura has received before. The order mostly consisted of comfortable civilian clothing with protective features like kinetic absorption. The rest of it was simply rare or hard-to-create materials that Yura had the capability of making. Most of these materials were artificial Tinkermade metals or designs for various weapons or alloys.
addons.title: Delivery

objects.text:
Name: Annabelle Simons
Gender: Female
Age: 17
Appearance: Average (Ariadne) / Beautiful (Pulsar)

Power: Doll General, (Tinker) Clarketech

Ariadne is an incredibly powerful Tinker, her shard due to various mishaps lacking many of its limitations. She has access to some of the most advanced technologies Entities encountered during their cycles. She can create Tinkertech which accesses other dimensions, nanotechnology, neural links and many other technologies which to most people would outright seem like magic.

But beyond all of those, her greatest specialization is in a technology that partly inspired the mechanics behind the Entities' avatars. She can build and control many remote bodies for herself, being able to use between 5 and 20 at once depending on how powerful she makes them. The most powerful of said bodies is Pulsar, which she often makes people believe is her real body; Pulsar is made of an alloy tougher than titanium, and is currently equipped with flight of up to Mach 10, a small array of matter-disintegrating lasers, processing power rivaling a supercomputer and nanites able to rebuild its body from scratch in about an hour.

However, Ariadne's shard is currently at critical levels of energy. Due to that, it is saving as much of it as possible, which makes her tinkering much slower and a lot less efficient. Additionally, this increases the energy requirements of her tinkertech; she mitigates this in part through tinkering incredibly efficient sources of energy, but even with this, Pulsar can only remain active for 8 hours at most before needing to recharge, with the rest of her tinkertech faring a bit better. However, was she close in some manner to a source of negentropy for a while, her uninhibited shard could quickly learn the [ANSWER] as well and circumvent those issues. 

Backstory:

Annabelle first triggered at 7, a few months after her beloved dad, which already wasn't often present, completely disappeared. Her and her mother were still relatively well-off from the money he had been giving them, but it waned over the years, especially as Annabelle's health started to decline. Eventually, she decided to use the powers she had discovered herself to become the notorious hacker Ariadne in order to get money for herself and her mother.

When her tinkertech and hacking brought Earth Bet to her attention a few years ago, she was able to become fairly certain of what had become of her father, and quash most of her hopes to find him alive somewhere. He had apparently been a great hero there, killed by a then-unknown villain... It is in his honor that she started to build a new persona for herself, the powerful heroine Pulsar.

Personality:

Despite her shard being from the Thinker Entity, the extremely young age at which she triggered still led it to affect it her personality. It is fairly hard for her to relate to others, which in addition to her poor health leads to her mostly remaining at home (at least bodily). However, acting through her dolls helps her to at the very least be less awkward. Thus, as Pulsar, she can still seem a bit odd, but overall personable.

She has some problems with authority, stemming from her family's money problems, thus acts mostly as a vigilante as Pulsar. However, her desire to follow in her father's footsteps is deep and real, and she wishes to prevent other heroes from dying as he did if she can.

Even without her powers, Annabelle remains very smart; while her tinkertech helps, most of the hacking she does still comes from her own skill, and while she understands that the blackbox means others cannot truly understand her tinkertech, she has fairly little patience with people having difficulties to grasp other concepts.
objects.title: Ariadne / Pulsar

objects.text:
Name: Saigo Tenki (Always gives fake names every time he’s asked) Cape Name: Farcical Other Aliases: Pierrot, Fallen Prince, “that rotten piece of s@#$” Gender: Male Age: 25~(?) Appearance: Masculine, Handsome (with a touch of androgyny) Powers:
  • Intrinsic (T0): Thinker (Understanding) (+ Swift Insight), Thinker (Clarity), Thinker/Stranger, Parallel Processing (+ Mental Computer)
  • Shard: Fractal of Entropic Decay (+ All Add-ons, except the [ALTERNATIVE]) + Mr. Worldwide, [Query][Response] (+ All Add-ons), Alt. Cleave and Lacerate (+ Add-ons), Atropos Wannabe
Due to the extraordinary circumstances Saigo suffered and his Shard’s (or cluster of Shards he isn’t sure of which, they aren’t the most forthcoming) mysterious nature, Saigo’s powers are best encapsulated in the concept of “̡̱̭͕̗͎́̂̽̓̍͠t̷͍̥̃̓͐͋̊͆͟h̵͇̦̻̭̖́͋͐̌̕e̵̷̖̩̝̰͚̮̿͐͘ ̵̛̫͇̎̐E̲̋̽̿͏͙̌n͉̟͚̆̆̒͝d̸̜͛̂̾̕ ̨̜̝̼̳͑͒́͗̚͘ô̡̥̮̱͚̙͎͆͑̈f̙̓̐̓͢͝ ̰̝͎͍͉͋̄̋͘À̡̯͎͇̺̖̮́̀ͅl͕̞̪̋͞͝ͅl̨͉̥̬͙͛̊̃͝ ̠͙̣̟́͑̚T̴̸̢͕̖̙̼̍͌͒͟͢h̻̹̘͎̹͓̀͆͒̈́̕͢ỉ̶̝̤͉̤̹̒n̴̢̥̻̘͊̏̉̈́͛̚ǵ̨͔̱̇͢͢͝s̲͍͓̜͐̓͋̌̅”̱̝̫̹̒̑͑͆̽̿ͅ, that is, the control of Entropy and that entails. The most common application he does can be divided into three aspects which are Containment, Diffusion, and Exhaustion. One to control or decelerate Entropy, one to diffuse and absorb energy within a system, and another to accelerate Entropy. Holds similarities with Stilling in terms of parallel and contrast, but also its usage. The range can vary from 3 three blocks at its weakest to planet-wide depending on the Shard's [Energy]. Over time, Saigo developed and gained through his exploits and [Huntings] other capabilities, communicating and manipulating Shards and their Hosts, abusing Broadcast functions, amassing a myriad of power expressions and applications to implement for his Power by consuming other Parahumans (or their Shard, where’s the fun of a job half-done~?), thinking the best ways to E͍͇͔n͔̝d̡͖ anything displeasing him, among other quirks to his abilities. One of his innate talents was his intelligence, one could argue it was Parahuman on its own, and he put it to good use to get by, especially during his time at the Garden, weaving and composing anyone to spare himself the brunt of the Imperium’s experiments. He was always gifted intellectually, the Compound just accentuated it. Currently, after he snatched and snacked on Parahumans on one of his “trips”, he obtained some expressions that allowed him to fully control anything in his vicinity, it was oddly fitting for it to appear as a devastating tempest, so it's the fact his molding of reality seems to be degrading reality at the seams (nothing Containment can fix, though). Moreover, that fact it weakens dimensional thresholds to better go on “trips”, is left unsaid. Something to ponder, however, is his Shard’s inherent capabilities: The Shard itself seems unrestricted from the common restrictions and programming the Entities usually apply to Shards disseminated in a cycle, but also from where it comes from… being an Abaddon Shard with an agenda also counts as an oddity. Background: Being from an “illegitimate” family branch of the Imperial Family on Earth Yarok, Saigo Tenki was a person largely defined by his situation. His being a casualty of the Imperial Family’s attempts to raise their bloodline and consolidate power through both the experimentation of Eden’s parts residing in the Higashis and the artificial breeding of family branching to achieve Parahuman hegemony within their Empire aside from their trade. All of their efforts were situated in a secret garden to monitor the branch families and their children. At first, he was a bright young kid, with a quiet disposition but not against to have his fun either way. That’s not to say he was cunning, his brains got him far in what was his life as far as he gathered, with strides in education and being well-liked by his brothers and sisters. All that came to an end the moment he started his induction to the Silver Flesh Compound’s research. Their studies with the Silver Flesh along with the experiments with Parahumans and their protuberant masses in their brain (coming from some Thinker and Tinker support, mind you) yielded some findings on controllable power expressions; they knew the risks of dealing with the Flesh, so with a mysterious benefactor helping them to advance their research including creating potential parahumans through a mysterious section of the Silver Flesh with a… frankly obsidian coloration, they wasted no time on trials. Whatever happened at his trial's turn and came into contact with him started to veer his personality, not at an alarming rate, people took notice, just enough to be kind of noticeable for those who knew the kid. From then on, anyone in the Garden felt odd when the kid was around, he looked withdrawn, and more attentive to the abuse behind closed doors, there were times he just chuckled to himself for no observable reason… he’s different, and the moment he became part of the trials to the Silver Flesh was the beginning. Saigo, nevertheless, knew better now. He doesn’t know what his Shard(s) see in him, yet what they tell him about the Cycle, the Purpose, how all his existence came to be through helping him by magnifying his already sharp intellect, all of this showcasing the greatest set-up and punchline he’d ever found; he was one for jokes, but this took the cake! At first, Saigo was concerned (even something broke inside him), but [Apex] settled his worries just by showing him what it/they set out to do, being his Father’s Teeth and Claws. Nevermind [Apex] doesn’t go along with the Fool and the Broken’s plans, both in and out of the Network, giving a safety net. From then on, he was on a mission, a pursuit of misery and wonder, everything he did with the utmost delight, both gloom and calamity was for one goal: T̖̯̼̑͞͏̴̪͖h̡̞̰̯̱͈̋́̍͞͠ͅi͉͙̓̽̕͘n̴̹̑͆͆͘ͅͅķ̝̑̔̈̌̈͡i̧̖̭͆̔̒̆̚̕͜n̨̞͖̫͔̗̩̏̍͗̎ͅg̗̣̳̹̘̀͊̔̔͜ ̫̦͇̼̀̋́̚o̗̫̟͐̑͒͟͠f̨̩͈̻̆̀̎ͅ ̵͂̓͂̂͆ͅt͇̫͔̯̊͐̿̆̀͡͝h̼͎̤̉̾̿̏é̫̓̓̽̾͑͒ͅ ̷͙̮͉̜̳̒͗̎͝ͅÉ̵̜̦̏́̆̂̇n̫̙͑̽͏͓͑̆̇d̴̛͍̤̱̊̂̄̅͟. Personality: Both affable and devious alike, Saigo revels in his ability to comprehend and shatter all that he finds wanting, which are most things. After his near-destruction and escape from the Garden he lived all his life until his 16th birthday, he carries himself with a sardonic or jokingly snarky demeanor. His emotional state depends on whatever he does is important to his pursuits, he can be manic and euphoric in cases where he feels it’s crucial in his mind, and other times bored and snappy where it’s not. A man sometimes defined by his vivid and dramatically comedic character is delighted in front of an “audience”. All the atrocities and disasters he acts on a whim (so he says) all always with a smile and a compliment. There are times he seems depressed or sorrowful, but quickly shakes it off as a joke . His fighting style can be described as nothing else but unpredictable and oftentimes ravingly mad. He acts the blubbering fool, and the next, he catches you unawares with a surprise attack while rocking up and down riding up nervous breakdown. They are places where he's brutal and exactingly vicious, exercising liberal use of psychological warfare. The method to his madness is that while his unpredictability and potential lunacy may be genuine, he uses it to his advantage, balancing contrasting qualities of sagacity and derangement. Underneath all this, he’s a broken man who can't gain what he wants the most: A happy life. To be truly happy. Every hand life has dealt to him practically robbed him of such fate, and the moment he realized this inevitability shattered him; the loss of his innocence, hope, and who he once was is the basis of the man he is today. Saigo knows this, his partnerfriend knows this, and he can’t deny it for all he wants, so his pursuit is an effort to cope with this reality. It’s all he has, really.
objects.title: Farcical

addons.text: A commission to create a suit for Bin Woo-Jin, due to his unique nature as a decaying body, kept it together through a mysterious theater mask. While the suit is a normal suit by Yura’s standards, it was made with particular care to its self-cleaning properties due to Bin’s Calling causing the suit to be grimy and rotten. The mask, despite being a fully solid object, completely changes its expression when people blink, changing itself to each individual viewer. Strangely, after the commission was completed, Yura was puzzled about how he complimented the lack of “line” between Shadow and Self.
addons.title: Phantom Opera

objects.text:
Name: Bin Woo-Jin Cape Name: Façade, Jeongmyeon Gender: Male Age: In his 40s, his power keeps him “young” in his 20s. Appearance: Attractive, yet an off-putting air oozes out of him. Powers:
  • (Brute) Zombie (+ The Living Dead), (Brute) Deadpool, Clearing the World to One Nothing Left to Hide (+ All Add-ons, with Individuation replacing Imago Dei), Alt. Optimum, Mod. Eternal Star (with all powers within its slots).
Owing to the special circumstances of his Trigger, Bin is, by all biological (and tellingly obvious) means, dead. A Walking Corpse, in the beginning stages of his Post-mortem Interval, giving him a delayed and aching tinge in his movements and bearings. The natural process of putrefaction closes in ever slowly if not for a Regen Brute power he regularly slots to stave this off. This results in his appearance being close to when he was in life, albeit with a gnawing sense of wrongness coming off for those unlucky to have a brush with him. Doom and gloom aside, it offers quite a large amount of endurance and resilience, with slower regenerative capabilities, and a near-parahuman physical and mental conditioning amidst his near-putrid complexion—something to thank his… benefactor. The consequential powers aside from his haphazard mutation to keep him alive, are an Optimizer assisting with refining his powers further while also counseling him on better courses of actions or alternate contingencies to better find long-term success when actively sinking himself on his Call; another power, coming from traces of a Shard meant to link with him if not for his benefactor integrating it into itself was his ability to See and Force the Truth in the purest sense in people’s hearts, he can exert a 5-block wide field where those Truths lay bare, people finding it incapable of lying or saying anything as a lie within it, changing the meaning of truth and lies, ruthlessly and unforgivingly hammering people’s psyche with both Truths unveiling personal wounds and peripheral Truths whether being their family or friends, transfixed in horror for being forcibly into a state of fullness with no peace, and sometimes (if he’s feels festive or spiteful) takes pleasure on tearing them down until there’s nothing left in their eyes. This, is his Calling. All of these powers are, not to mention, permanently slotted within the main power that is the benefactor, or as it likes to be called, [Façade]: [Façade] itself is the cannibalized remains of a Thinker Shard gobbled up by a cast-off Loner Shard, an [Broadcast]/[Administrator] equivalent bud cluster turned into a full-fledged Shard, transferred as a contingent plan if [The Eye] hasn’t latched on adequate [Host]. [Façade]’s system works the remaining slots as “facets”, fading echoes of Bin’s psyche taking shape into powers both needed and desired by him, ranging from Brute to enhance his already remarkable “physique” to Breaker letting loose on the area; Trump powers might arise suspicion among the Network. With his scarce tools and cadaverous vulnerability, he sticks with what worked for him till the end: coolheadedness and meticulousness shrouding cruelty untold. This goes from combat, ambushes, and all-around his Calling. Some who survived his Calling confessed a sense of hopelessness and inevitability of how unflinching he carried himself, the stench of death enveloping the absence of mercy he showed on what he’d done. To him, it was good. Skills: Economics, Political Science, Tactics, Strategy, Business, Harmful, Diplomat, Aggression, Criminal Underworld. Background: Bin was a person defined by his love for family, namely his sister, the only good in his life; the one pushing him further for a glimpse of a good life. His parents were absent, in the effect of ‘not with them anymore, with a consolation prize’. The inherited assets, money, and investments with their untimely death allowed them to live their lives in luxury and comfort, past their parents’ absence… past their scars. His folks weren’t good people, every now and then they got this notion in their heads of this unattainable pursuit of perfection and supremacy he and her sister staunchly needed to follow, at the cost of sleep, friends, and the trivialities other rabble have to “chase” to compensate. Funny story, the moment he listened Bin saw it as it always was: a lot of hogwash. Still, his parents were also under the tenet all immigrants live by to achieve the ephemeral American Dream: overbearing authority, so he had no say. It’s fucked they were lucky enough to survive the accident and left all the better for it, looking back, he felt relieved, but that’s trauma for you. His life’s only respite was his sister’s company; sure, he was older, usually older brothers were the teasing and tussling types for sisters, but not you. She took care of you, and you, her. Where they didn’t have to hide under a mask of entitlement or condescension, where they’d laid their heart bare, True for themselves, where he felt he was doing something right for once. From that day out, all his ambitions and dreams were to repay her. That is until it happened. Jiah was struggling, she wasn’t for big parties yet her popularity and peer pressure won in the end. What transpired was beyond him at the time (all over nothing, just for that 𝕗𝕦𝕔𝕜𝕖𝕣 Novak not dealing with rejection like an adult): rumors about promiscuity, his relationship with her sister (you sick f*cks), bullying, ostracization, shunning borne out petty revenge. At first, she managed; a person can’t hold on to their resolve without eroding amidst this barrage, she struggled, suffered, till she couldn’t. Till she cracked. All that Bin found was a letter and a news report. The car hasn’t started soon enough. He gazed over her, he ran, too late. He felt numb. Some part of him lay there lifeless, henceforth, the thought left was Vengeance. All these thoughts and happenstance blurred and blended together: His failed Cauldron Vial. The Boogeyman’s smile. His plan. His preparations. His success. Setting the stage. The Calling. Their wails. Their begging and supplication. His “life’s” fulfillment. And then, nothing. A false life then and there, all for forcing the world to atone for sins against him, a catharsis that came as it went, left with nothing. An Empty Man… he might as well finish the job, that’s when [Façade] latched on him, made him [See]. All the more reason, I guess, he resigned. Two hours later, he leaves, truly a Dead Man. Personality: Jaded but steadfast, he is a complex individual. Described as bitter and vengeful to those unlucky to raise his ire, yet outwardly jovial and deviously good mood. A terrifying man in his intellect and known for aggressive expansions, hostile takeover, and astute administration. All this second to his raison d'etre: Revenge… all gone once he won. His true personality comes out in his tirades most victims name as the Calling, where he reveals his lack of anything except the Call itself: A man past his demise, made to walk the Earth. A dull and wooden thing whose sole purpose is to lift the Veil of Lies that cost the only Light of his Life, stopping at nothing to spread the Truth further, no matter the cost.
objects.title: Jeongmyeon

objects.text: Name: Timothy “Timmy” Joneson Cape Name: Foul Play / Dirge Gender: Male/Nonbinary Age: 28 Appearance: Average, leaning on gender-neutral. Powers: The Parahuman Anathema + Add-ons (Minus-i, Old World Order, Summa Blasphemia) [40-100 [DATA] packages from different parahumans across Dirge’s career, able to construct power expressions from any rating; has an Anti-Stranger and Anti-Thinker aspect covering up his tracks.] At first, when Timothy noticed that the powers of other capes weren’t working properly around him, just after the last encounter had left him with too much baggage to unload, he thought nothing of it. After reading on forums about a thing called a “Trigger Event” out of a whim, he couldn’t connect the dots fast enough. It felt like a consolation prize, taking the shape of a monkey’s paw. This probably explained why the modified termites puppeteering him had died out, or so he thought. It was nothing to write home about. He pondered the limits of his nullification (2-meter radius, oval-shaped, terrifically responsive to all parahuman powers and effects). It began as a little voice in the back of his mind urging him, against better judgment, to indulge his curiosity, which grew into a restlessness he couldn’t shake off. Caving in, under several midnight strolls of vaguely following his gut (indeterminate sense that locates and identifies parahumans perfect for reconnaissance) and several trainwreckscape fights in his name, he understood what he could be capable of; to give any cape a taste of their medicine, rebound their bullshit in a sick joke or simply pull their magic tricks into pageantry was more than he should’ve ask for a consolation prize, now understanding why capes put themselves so much into the danger (besides being not all there up there). It was all fun and games until he lost his only tether to a normal life, his Pa, Ma, his Big Sis, all because he bit more than he could chew, enemies hurting on the only way they could: the Heart. That’s when he Second Triggered, and Dirge was born. Background: Born on Earth Bet-Delta, Los Angeles, California, Timothy Johnson was of the opinion that he was a sane man in a mad world, with all these capes running amok. Deep down, he resented how they could do whatever they wanted, while he never admitted to himself until it was too late; remembering all the gangs and the budding Protectorate’s pissing contests while leaving the common man to clean up the mess afterwards, he seethed inwardly how the world didn’t give its due, getting through day-to-day in his life till college. That is, till a battle with Alexandria, Minion Master, and a Bio-Tinker, who unwittingly deployed a swarm of termites and left him to fend for himself among other passerbys, almost escaping their crosshairs. He sometimes thinks to himself that if the Tinker felt he hadn’t suffered enough, he surmises in retrospect, unleashed their termites, taking control of his body while slowly eating at his entrails. And not to sound ungrateful to Alexandria, but reasoned a day without having the worst day of your life wouldn’t be nice for starters, yet beggars can’t be choosers. A moment of weakness unsurprisingly flashed across the headspace, a torrent of the bottled rage and poison he felt as always, yet couldn’t indulge; unless another door opens in another job’s shape, the bile in his throat wasn’t worth it. All the black tar he usually keeps a lid on by detaching himself from the situation to survive or sheer sarcasm poured out of him, losing control of the torrent of bitterness or loathing at the world he bears surviving–not living, surviving–flooding out his mind’s cracks. All that congealed into the worst moment of his life. The last moment he remembers is stars, the whirlwind, and shapes foggily ringing a bell. All gets blurry afterward; he didn’t realize he’d been freed from being mastered until his knuckles were bloodied and he had the poor bastard responsible for all of this battered and with few teeth left. The moments after were quick: a time of experimenting—a null-field where every power didn’t work, with a few “patrols” experimenting with their power’s limits and fights he stumbledfound and won by the skin of his teeth—Tim grew a head, a feeling of invincibility, on the cape landscape, feeling untouchable on their paltry tricks once he come to understand their expressions. They became a joke hero playing around the villain scene, ragebaiting villains left and right. The Villainous organizations in Los Angeles were the petty sort, so they came to an agreement. Targeting their family in a series of terroristic schemes, Tim paid his debt in blood. While being personally targeted by the main echelons, he Second Triggered and snapped. Those who knew them noticed a change in behavior for the worse, focusing on capes, becoming a nationwide threat. Personality: Quiet and reserved, the tragedies they suffered had buried the person he was. With an extroverted manner that borders in theatric and spiteful bent, he tests Parahumans in their character, with a mysterious qualifier beneath, acts as another Equalizer on Earth-Bet-Delta. He’s responsible for removing a larger Parahuman population in their decades of experience.
objects.title: Foul Play / Dirge

addons.text: When Yura was traveling out to gain inspiration, she met a Simurgh-like being hiding inside a library. At first, she was a little afraid, but after trusting the Tinkertech she wore and communicating with Michael, she found him to be a kind person, even if he can be a bit childish. Due to feeling bad for him, Yura created Cloudy Skies for him. It’s a floating halo that stays above him and generates a Stranger effect, making it hard for Michael to be detected. It has a secondary effect of reducing the strain Michael’s powers have on his eyes.
addons.title: Cloudy Skies

objects.text:
Name: Michael
Gender: Non-Binary
Age: ???
Appearance: Monstrous
Powers: Michael is a case 53 who is a massive ball of flesh covered in dozens of eyes, surrounded by a total of six pairs of wings. Each pair of wings has a wingspan of 10 meters. Each feather of these wings is adorned with an eye, each one possessing the ability to function similarly to human eyes, allowing them to see through them regardless of the feather’s distance from their main body. Not only that, but they can use telekinesis to control these feathers with incredible precision within a 1-kilometer radius of their location. Their wings are stronger than steel yet completely weightless. This enhanced durability also extends to the eyes on the feathers. 

Beyond that, Michael has a Trump power that gives them an ability for each eye they have. These powers are always sight-based, such as clairvoyance, petrification gaze, etc. However, they must always have a power active in each of their eyes, resulting in them accidentally using their powers on others. Having the same power active in multiple eyes increases its strength exponentially, at the cost of mental distortion, leaving many problems such as the inability to tell time, read faces, recognize faces, etc.

Personality: Michael is curious, rather childish and kind. However, they have a rather inhuman mindset, having trouble comprehending certain concepts. They genuinely wish to help others, but the way they do so can be morally incorrect, such as feeding the poor with the corpses of criminals, or mind controlling criminals to make them upstanding members of society. 

They have a hobby in reading and writing, particularly enjoying poetry. 
Background: Michael was discovered injured in a destroyed building, with the building itself having been transformed by Michael's powers into a bizarre, otherworldly mess. Despite suffering grave bodily injury, Michael managed to escape the building and was caught on camera in the process. Due to Michael's actions, appearance, and striking resemblance to the entity known as the Simurgh, they were quickly labelled as a villain - an undeserved title that Michael would do anything to shake off.

Michael's reputation as a villain continued to grow, as they were later seen launching brutal attacks against other supervillains and subsequently attempting to "rehabilitate" criminals. With their unorthodox methods and lack of concern for the consequences, Michael's actions earned them further scorn and fear, cementing their position as a scourge within the criminal underworld. Yet, what they truly sought was not chaos and disorder, but justice and retribution - a desire that many did not understand, and one that ultimately served as the driving force behind their destructive and disruptive behaviour.
objects.title: Lucifer

addons.text: A commission from a man with blonde hair and glasses, Yura had to create a suit to match the coldly professional businessman Salvatore. While not frilly, The Suit is capable of helping Salvatore grant more wishes per person every month. Later, after some events, Salvatore offered her wishes, but he couldn’t accomplish what she wanted.
addons.title: Bellbringer

objects.text:
Name: Salvatore "Sal" Carloni
Gender: Male
Age: 36
Appearance: Masculine, Attractive

Power: (Master) Geas + (Master) Mascot + (Thinker/Stranger) Taboo + Don't Speak Her Name! + (Stranger/Thinker) Discount Genie + Prayers received, Wishes granted. + Monkey Paw + Genie from Wish.com

Sal possesses the ability to fulfill wishes, for himself and others, within certain constraints. The wishes he can grant are limited to 3 wishes per person per month (including himself) and they must be theoretically possible for him to have completed within a year. If these conditions are met, reality will alter to fulfil the wish according to either the desires of the individual or Sal himself. Sal can also enforce binding contract agreements between others and himself for each wish he grants. If all parties agree to the contract, they will be bound to fulfil the terms due to a Master effect.

Sal also possesses a strong secondary Thinker power: a multiversal awareness of whenever someone is referring to him, be it by his name, title etc. This awareness extends to the location of the individual as well as the context in which his name was used. He can use this connection to temporarily express a projection of himself in a 20-metre radius around the person who used his name, permitting him to offer and use his wish-granting abilities.

Skills: Connection, Presentation, Polyglot

Background: 

Salvatore "Sal" Carloni was born on Earth Taw, an earth technologically equal to the early 1900s and going through a slow industrial revolution driven by electricity and renewable energy instead of fossil fuels. Sal triggered at a young age when he had a major altercation with his parents as a teenager, resulting in him becoming disowned and homeless. He entered into a life of crime, using his power to work his way up until he was the head of his own powerful, widespread organisation.

Sal was contacted by Cauldron as a young adult, becoming aware of the multiverse. Striking a deal, Sal would offer wishes to individuals on behalf of Cauldron for 'favours' when they did not desire power vials. In exchange, he would gain access to other Earths and remain an independent contractor. Through this, word has spread through hundreds of Earths of the "Goodfellow" who can grant wishes for a price if you speak his name.

Sal's true power comes from the sheer number of 'favours', connections and influence he has built up over almost two decades across the multiverse, dramatically expanding what he is theoretically capable of doing within a year and so the potency of his wishes. He can sometimes be spotted having a drink with a man with blonde hair and glasses, and a woman wearing a suit and a fedora.

Personality: 

To most, Sal gives the impression of a coldly professional businessman, particularly when engaging in deals for wishes. Typically apathetic and indifferent, Sal's decades of granting wishes in return for 'favours' across the multiverse have caused him to develop a level of callousness, particularly concerning his work with Cauldron although he's sociable to some of their members.

He remains independent and elusive to most, maintaining his privacy to the vast number of people he has met over the years, but for a few select individuals to whom he considers close friends. He typically respects the spirit of any agreement he enters into and expects others to do the same. He has a knack for dry sardonic humour.
objects.title: Mr. Goodfellow

addons.text: A commission for clothing that appears casual but has some fancy tricks stored in its pocket. Heart of Cards is an outfit that can change its appearance freely while having a pocket dimension allowing the storage of various equipment if needed. Though Yura was not even sure if Luthor was a Parahuman in the end, she did manage to create neat, comfortable, and casual clothing for her client. She also managed to incorporate a somewhat generic feature that boosts any Parahuman powers Luthor may have.
addons.title: Heart of Cards

objects.text: Aye, siwmae! How can we help each other? Name: Luther Penndraigg Gender: Nonbinary Age: 17 Appearence: Attractive Power: Perfect Host & Alloy Fusion Luther exists in a highly specific quantum superposition. While this is almost useless as he is constantly under observation from himself. It makes him the Perfect Host for a number of outside entities due to the subtle changes in him as a physical and metaphysical entity. While this does nothing on its own, it allows anything that needs a partner or ‘Host’ to operate to view him as an ideal candidate, and use Luther with greater efficiency. The ability to close off this favourable connection ensures more sentient beings ‘deal’ rather than take. Background: Luther Penndraigg was a relatively normal child before he fell directly into a live piece of Tinkertech designed by his father to create ‘infinite’ energy by syphoning it from other possible realities. After being hospitalised for a number of years as a result, he found the tools and artefacts of his, now very deceased, father’s lab aren’t as volatile as one would expect from tinkertech abandoned for almost a decade. Personality: Luther is a smarmy git. Slow, observational and careful he often believes himself to hold most cards in any room unless it’s significantly weighted against him. That said, when stressed this quickly becomes a tendency to violence and a scramble to hold leverage once again. The transactional relationship with his father and a number of years in the foster system has led to a feeling of safety being correlated to said leverage.
objects.title: Luther Penndraigg

objects.text: What am I, Chopped liver? Cape Name: Taliesin Gender: Male Age: 23 Appearance: Ugly (case 53) Power: (Master/Trump) Scepter of Power (+ Remembrance + Archive of Expressions + Royal Scepter) + (Trump/Shaker) Don't mess with a white mage (+Celestial Intervention) Backstory: Maegwynn Lascarii is a Welsh Case-53 that by all accounts does not remember most of his life. Appearing on the outskirts of a village in North-Wales, Maegwynn quickly attracted the attention of UK-based cape team ‘The King’s Men’. Reaping the benefits of an unusual body plan and a magic-seeming set of powers, Mae was fashioned into a Druid-esc figure in the King’s Men’s lineup. After the group was opened to private investors during Austerity, he has a moderately successful merchandise line. Personality: Maegwynn is a willful but deeply insecure person who struggles to balance a genuine desire to live a completely mundane and normal life with a deep seeded need for validation and the everyday struggles of existing as an ‘unappealing’ ‘Monster Cape’. Mae does not like the term ‘Case 53’ and would honestly rather be called a slur.
objects.title: Maegwynn Lascarii

objects.text: “Worse things happen at sea, you know,” Name: Mita Ocondria Cape Name: Twrch Trwyth Gender: Male Age: 19 Appearance: Ugly (case 53) Power: (Changer/Trump) Pokemon, (Master/Trump) Pokémon Go, Pokémon: Let's Go! Backstory: Mita Ocondria found themselves dropped unceremoniously into the centre of Belfast ten years ago. Understandably based on their appearance, they were quickly ‘acquired’ by the King’s Men during its brief period of ownership by the British Government. After it went private during Austerity, Mita lost much of the enthusiasm towards the group after he and… select co-workers began being sidelined into a ‘B-Team’ after ‘Persistent Market Research’ showed they had low marketability. Personality: Bouncy and loud, Mita can often be found socialising with whoever and whatever crosses his path. He shares a london flat with three housemates (although he is allegedly a bad roommate) and earns enough to make a habit of seeing Crusaders football matches live when able (much to the chagrin of Matty matthews, one of the aforementioned roommates).
objects.title: Mita Ocondria

objects.text: “Symbols live forever” Name: Flint Adeboye Cape Name: Splitscreen (IV) Gender: Male Age: 26 Appearance: Average Power: (Master/Tinker) The Spark of Life + (Shaker/Striker) Mechanicus Aura + (Striker) Machine Spirit + Spirit of All Things + (Trump/Tinker) Enhancer Backstory: Splitscreen is a legacy monaker, first belonging to a german Tinker during the first emergence. After his death, another tinker took his cape name and armour, believing he was worth more as a symbol than a martyr. Splitscreen II (Formerly Cortechs), being an informational tinker developed a device to amalgamate the memories and ‘experience’ of each Splitscreen mantle, one all later splitscreens have used/maintained to ensure it can be used later. Splitscreen III (Formerly Nightrider), being a more combat focused Tinker updated the armour to its current standard. Following her own death, the title has passed to the Birmingham-based Overclock. Overclock was a mechanic-turned-Support member of the King’s Men, possessing both the ability to create transforming machines and a Tinkertech-maintenance and enhancement aura to ensure their continued function. He actively took the mantle of Splitscreen following the active refusal of Nightrider’s ‘preferred’ candidate (A Brute named Blockade). Naturally, the identity of ‘Splitscreen’ is a closely guarded secret, though it is widely acknowledged within the cape scene there must have been at least two. This, however is due to the fact in late 2010, a disgruntled PRT employee leaked the digital reproduction of Split Screen IV as of the most recent backup, leading to multiple black market ‘copies’ of varying quality, make and use. Toybox’s policy of selling these copies at a premium is one of the many reasons they garner large-scale attention from the King’s Men when cells are discovered. Splitscreen is largely deployed ‘alone’ with an entourage of robots created by Overclock’s power. Most commonly accompanied by at the very least two, though commonly up to five, this does tend to make Splitscreen a force multiplier of sorts. This is largely unremarked upon, it’s assumed Splitscreen merely constructed these robots during ‘post-endbringer leave’, after all his ‘specialty’ isn’t publicly known. Armoured in Nightrider’s (adjusted) armour and armed with both Faux-tinker tech he makes an imposing figure. Personality: Splitscreen VI is conflicted. Much of their time is given to deciphering which parts of their memories and history is ‘Overclock’ and what belongs to ‘Splitscreen’. It’s a legacy that’s swallowed his entire life, mind and soul, crawled into his skin and looks out of his eyes to tell him what to do. As with most SPlitscreens, he’s on the lookout for a ‘successor’ should the worst come to pass, despite Blockade’s active insistence on letting the mantle die as a ‘Cancerous growth’.
objects.title: Splitscreen (IV)

objects.text: “I’m smokin’ that shit that makes the primordial stillbirth regain it’s consciousness!,” Name: Dadriel ae Tamoth! Cape Name: N/A Gender: Be Not Afraid Age: Questionable Appearance: Average (Case 53) Power: Magitek Nouliths + Nexus Arcanum + Familiar (One Object) x 2 + Reincarnated as a [REDACTED] but my [REDACTED] is [REDACTED] and the prom is tomorrow! Backstory: Dadriel is a small creature that nonetheless has been alive for several centuries. Part of a species of consummate scavengers, they ride the trail of Entities for easy meals, scavenging the remains, and potentially finding separate hosts to parisitise. This relationship is similar to that of pilot fish. Unfortunately, Dadriel got caught in the jetstream and arrived far too early, crashing to earth. Luckily there are many valid hosts, and their species do seem notably gullible. Currently it’s under Cauldron observation, but is allowed to roam free on the Scottish highlands due to the fact it’s really not any form of major issue. Personality: Dadriel believes it’s far more impressive than it is. To hear it say, it’s a being of incredible primordial might and power capable of feeling civilisations with a fitting host. This is patently untrue. It claims to have taken part in intergalactic wars for the fate of galaxies. This is also untrue. Very few of its words should be taken as true, in fact. It enjoys annoying people and praise and it will make this fact whoever's problem feels correct at the time. It’s current host is one Jaheda Salik who is in the unfortunate position of modulating it’s outbursts and impulsivity Given she still has to sleep when it does not, this is quite difficult.
objects.title: Dadriel, the Parasite

addons.text:
Welcome to the King's-Men, the UK’s (formally) government sponsored cape team with branches around the country. These divisions are usually situated directly on top of cities with broad jurisdiction within them. 

The general training for a King’s Man consists of general combat and arrest training similar to metropolitan police supplemented with a period acting as ‘Squire’ to an established member (usually all completed within the Central Office in London) before full graduation to the team and assignment to a location. Young and Junior members meanwhile are required to stay on as a ‘Squire’ until Sixteen or Twenty depending on various circumstances and factors.

Unfortunately, as of the 2010 Cameron-Clegg coalition, and the Austerity measures introduced therein, the King’s Men have started to take corporate and wealthy singular sponsors out of necessity, leading to a wider ‘commercialisation’ of the team, much to the chagrin of many. 

It is generally unusual for King’s Men to keep their public and private identities separate, but not unheard of, especially for those in more public positions or with a background in American Heroics.
addons.title: The King's Men

objects.text: ”The more the merrier,” Name: Guitulth Ddraigg Gwyn Cape Name: Ddraigg Gwyn Gender: Male Age: Unknown Appearance: (Case 53) Power: (Trump/Master) Butcher + Pillage + (Changer) Bio-Assimilation Backstory: The beast that would become known as Gitulth awoke in London shortly after the Simurgh’s 2008 attack. Unfortunately for everyone involved, the United Kingdom’s reluctance to quarantine the city lead to multiple unopposed ‘simurgh-bombs’. Guitulth, being assumed to be unaffected due to his non-existence on Earth-Bet during the attack, was quickly bundled into a Kings-Men taskforce to ‘deal’ with these individuals. This Is when his main power made itself known, actively and disgustingly growing organs, pieces and on one occasion even a full head for each parahuman killed. In the following years, his easy draconic marketability and field experience made him a shoe-in for leadership in the South-West Kingsmen during it’s separation from the welsh-branch. Currently Gitulth is housed in Bristol, having three children, Oen, Pynkh and Grekkle. Personality: Imperious and relatively introspective for a dragon the size of a Subaru Outback, Guitulth has repeatedly ‘made lemons’ out of the situation handed to him. That said, as with much of the South-West Kings men, he’s not nearly as enchanted with the organisation under austerity, and the Cameron Government’s insistence the organisation seek ‘investment’. Not the least of his issues is that he actually has to read over and approve his team’s merchandising rights. It certainly forms an opinion to see your organisation saving money on merchandise manufacturing costs by claiming you don’t count as human.
objects.title: Guitulth Ddraigg Gwyn

objects.text: "Nothing Stays," Name: Marcus(?) Gender: Nonbinary Age: Questionable Appearance: Ugly (case 53) Power (Self-Rewrite + Self-Inserting for Days + New Game + (Master/Trump) Drawing Board + Rewrite) Marcus has a near-unlimited control over his own physical form and capabilities as well as their own history. Specifically they tend to prefer non-obtrusive changes to history just to streamline their life and existence, especially considering any new form they find themselves in. A true Retroactive Shapeshifter. Backstory: Marcus Mask was a child when Scion appeared. This is a lie. Marcus Mask was trapped beneath the radioactive rubble in New York. This is a lie. Marcus Mask was a founding member of the Protectorate. This is a lie. Marcus Mask is a nascent endbringer. This is a lie. Marcus Mask is the Entities attempt to preserve causality. This is a lie. Marcus Mask is a refugee from another universe. This is a lie. Marcus Mask has been drifting to and from a thousand bodies over a thousand lifetimes for a thousand reasons. Unlimited Power Bores Absolutely. Recently, Marcus has been experimenting with global edits and insertions. Personality: Marcus Mask is mercurial to a fault. Easily bored and flighty he whips from lie to lie and shape to shape to find some core to hold on to for a time. If he ever actually gained a reason or a cause, he’d be a force to be reckoned with, but as it is, he’s nothing but a wanderer only bound by fleeting interest.
objects.title: Marcus Mask

objects.text: Beginning trial 53... Name: Wren House Gender: Male Age: 51 Appearance: Average Power: (Tinker) Oh the Humanity, (Tinker) Bloody Tinker Backstory: Dr Wren House spent most of his life in and out of hospitals and research clinics at the behest of his father. When he was old enough, he specialised in biochemistry at his university, and completed a separate MD. He’d had Lymphocytic Leukemia since he was a boy, and spent much of his career as a researcher specialising in the disease, and much of his career as a doctor specialising in its treatment. When an interesting startup calling itself ‘Haemat’ reached out to him while searching for researchers, the money was too good to meaningfully ignore. Unfortunately, as he was working his condition continued to worsen, not helped from the remote location in the Welsh countryside and the long hours he kept. That was until one day, Wren made a breakthrough, every analysis confirmed it, and he was assured of his own success, submitting it in its totality to his superiors, not realising what he had actually accomplished. Haemat management took one look at the documentation, and the secondary testing, and sent it up the chain. Unfortunately, TinkerTech isn’t well known for being mass producible, reliable, stable, or profitable given the numerous legal statutes designed to protect consumers from “Tinkertech” remedy scams. Thankfully, under the table, it would be incredibly profitable in higher quantities. Thus, after making brief contact directly with Dr House, the board unanimously set aside a black budget and a blanket permission, selling the facility into a shell-company. And Doctor Wren House was left alone in the summer of 1992 in the welsh wilderness with several million pounds and no oversight, as long as he produces his remedy quota. And so he began to unravel. He made clones of himself by the dozen, making tweaks, adding new technologies and tests into each batch to see if they’d fare any better. He tested the boundaries of his specialty and the clones abilities besides. The more notable clones tended to leave what was rapidly turning into a compound. Wren 3, Wren 21, Wrens 55 & 58, but there were ever more being born each year, each more experimental and infused than the last. Losing a few wasn’t of consequence. If losing the children was ever of consequence he’d probably have removed the Leukemia from a few. Personality: Wren House is a cult leader. He’s spent the last twenty years alone but for the odd corporate visitor and a series of clones, his primary concern is his ‘work’ and the fact that after several decades of trying his own supply, his Leukemia has progressed from the mundane to truly esoteric. The clones are always a means to an end, but he knows better than to give them an alternative. They were born in the compound and they exist by his graces, they’re well by his graces. For the few with some true tinkertech integrated into them the only reason they can still function is because he deigns to spend his time with them, they’re favoured, they’re his favourites. And children should never disappoint their father. Outside of his ‘family’, he’s quiet. Any form of social grace he had has long since left him sometime in the last two decades. Brusc, and to the point, quick to anger and slot to forget. There’s an implication that he really does hate what his life has become, but if it’s going to be fixed then he has to be the one to fix it. It must be within his control, utterly and completely, and anything beyond that control must remain outside of his walled garden.
objects.title: Wren House

objects.text: Sometimes the only way out is as a carcass,” Name: ‘Alpha Iota’ (Wren House 46) Gender: ??? Age: 19 Appearance: Average Power: (Tinker/Master) Machine World, C53: Robotkin, Secondary Powers Alpha Iota fundamentally can extrude technology they understand from themselves, including the very helpful secondary ability to understand most tinkertech once they can take it apart, even if it stops working the near instant it’s fully extruded. Unfortunately they have also actively abandoned their body and become completely digital and reliant on a series of ‘temporary’ units that are technically owned by the King's Men as an organisation rather than themself. Backstory: Wren House Senior is a cloning tinker. This is widely considered a bad thing for everyone involved. Needless to say the compound in rural Wales where he keeps the cavalcade of Wren-Juniors only kept within means of control by Tinkertech ‘gifts’ and near death (and not so near death) experiences, sees its fair share of crisis points. As all the Wrens contain Corona Pollentias, they all have the capacity to trigger, even if few have to date.
