On top of that, he possesses most powers and combat abilities similar to Sonic the Hedgehog, albeit with his own flair. Drawing power from his divine domains grants him several abilities. These are only a fraction of his true potential, as he still needs to grow. For example, from Hope; his mere presence becomes a beacon of light to the broken, and can effortlessly ignite their will to fight on with just a few words. Courage imbues him with near absolute focus, leadership qualities, and innate combat instinct. Compassion grants an elevated emotional intelligence, emotion empowerment, and mind reading. Determination gifts him an indomitable will, with resistance to forces against his mind, body and soul. Usage of these divine powers are often symbolized by a spark of blue fire that streams from his eyes, or cloaks his body. Upon reaching the upper echelons of divinity, they will become pure white. Solaris can also grant him items native to the Sonic Universe should he deem them necessary, such as wisps, rings, shields, capsules, etc. If Phoenix and/or Solaris deem you worthy, you can be gifted a fragment of his divinity. Guaranteed to bolster your own powers to amazing heights, or grant new ones tailor made for you. Should you wish to join him on his eternal quest, you too can commune with Solaris Personality Even before becoming reborn as a Champion, Phoenix never hesitated to be there for his friends. No matter if that took the form of a mentor, protector, comedian, or a simple shoulder to cry on in hard times. This selfless nature was only amplified from his divinity, so much so, that it would often lead to his own destruction. He is equally good at bringing out the best in his friends, and getting them back on their feet. Even if he has to resort to unsavory tactics. When he's not fulfilling his divine duties, he simply kicks back and enjoys the present. These moments remind him of what he fights for, and he will continue to do so with no regrets.
objects.title: Phoenix the Hedgehog

addons.text: Born out of wedlock, her mother sent her to an orphanage while her father didn’t know she existed. Only recently did her father learn of her existence, and that came with its own troubles. He himself was never prepared to have a daughter and due to his daughter’s ability, he can never proudly stand before her without her finding out all of his weaknesses.
addons.title: Absentee Dad

addons.text: An annoying addition to her relationship. She was not happy with Ava’s reveal and had ignored her lover in petty anger. While she will never admit it, she did waste some time for petty anger and setting up minor misfortunes.
addons.title: Step Mom

objects.text:
Name: Ava
Gender: Female
Age: 14
Appearance: Attractive

Power: Thinker/Master (Emotional Magnet), (Thinker/Master) Indoctrination Is Friendship, (Thinker) Weakspot

Ava's power allows her to quickly identify emotional and physical vulnerabilities in others, using effective methods to exploit these weaknesses, whether they stem from past traumas, fears, or other limitations. Beyond combat, she uses her abilities to assist allies as a therapist. Additionally, Ava has the ability to perceive people's emotions with remarkable clarity.

Backstory:

Ava is a therapist who regularly helps others, particularly capes, in dealing with mental issues they have. As she was raised in a poor orphanage, she would regularly donate the money she makes to other orphanages. She only recently learned who was her father, who she personally feels is avoiding her out of guilt. She also regularly suffers minor misfortune, something she is sure is her father’s girlfriend’s fault.

Personality:

Ava care for the world. She sees how ugly humanity is but has also seen how beautiful humanity can be when given the chance. She wishes to be that chance for humanity. While she doesn’t agree with her father’s methods, she is not so foolish to think that it is unnecessary.
objects.title: Ms Fixit

addons.text:
To Cassandra Voss, her relationship with The Professor was nothing more than a fleeting affair, a momentary diversion amidst the tumultuous politics and power struggles of Terra Nova. Their liaison, shrouded in secrecy and driven by mutual attraction and intrigue, held no deeper significance for her beyond a brief escape from her duties as ruler. 

Cassandra's heart, if it could be said to exist in her cold and calculating world, belonged solely to the throne and the control it afforded her. The Professor's enigmatic presence intrigued her, his intellect and abilities occasionally useful in her political maneuvers, but she kept him at arm's length emotionally. Her ambitions and the survival of her empire always took precedence over personal attachments.
addons.title: A Single Night

addons.text:
Despite her iron grip on Terra Nova, Cassandra harbors a secret vulnerability: her daughter, Ava. Born during a brief period of vulnerability, Ava was placed in an orphanage to hide her existence and protect Cassandra from potential exploitation by her enemies. This decision, though necessary in Cassandra's mind, has left a deep wound in her heart. Ava, now a young woman, has grown up without knowledge of her mother's identity.

Through careful mediation and understanding, there is potential for their relationship to be mended. Cassandra's hardened exterior might soften, revealing glimpses of the woman she once was, and Ava's presence could become a catalyst for change, offering a chance for redemption and reconciliation in the midst of a fractured empire.
addons.title: Only Daughter

objects.text:
Name: Cassandra Voss
Gender: Female
Age: 35
Appearance: Beautiful

Power: (Thinker) Snap + (Master) It’s The Thought That Counts

Cassandra possesses the ability to detect emotional weaknesses in people and can manipulate them at will. With a mere thought, she can either exacerbate these weaknesses or soothe them. Emotional weakness can be erased but will still remain until fixed naturally.

Background:
Cassandra Voss was born into a world ravaged by relentless warfare. Her early life was marked by chaos and loss, with her family falling victim to the brutal conflicts that plagued her homeland. Orphaned at a young age, she struggled to survive in the violent, unforgiving environment. Her life took a drastic turn during a traumatic event: witnessing the massacre of her adopted family by marauders. This extreme stress and trauma triggered her powers, allowing her to perceive and manipulate the emotional weaknesses of those around her.

Once she discovered and understood her new abilities, Cassandra wasted no time in using them to her advantage. She quickly rose to power by orchestrating the downfall of a corrupt regime, utilizing a blend of cunning strategy and psychological manipulation. By her early twenties, she had established herself as the uncontested ruler of Terra Nova. Her regime is marked by ruthless efficiency, employing advanced brainwashing techniques similar to those pioneered by Pavlov to maintain control over her subjects. Public executions and displays of power are common, serving as constant reminders of her unyielding authority.

Under Cassandra's rule, Terra Nova is a place of enforced order and stability, achieved at a tremendous cost. Personal freedoms are sacrificed for the sake of control, and loyalty is ensured through a mix of fear and psychological manipulation. Cassandra's ability to incite both terror and devotion has created an empire where rebellion is swiftly crushed, and compliance is mandatory. Her actions are driven by a desire for power and control, not by any noble intention or sense of justice.

Personality:
Cassandra is a cold, calculating pragmatist who values efficiency and control above all else. Her sharp intellect and strategic mind make her a formidable leader, capable of both ruthless decisions and intricate manipulations. She has a deep understanding of human nature, allowing her to exploit emotional weaknesses with ease. Despite her harsh methods, she is not without a warped sense of justice, though it is heavily influenced by her own desires and need for control. Beneath her beautiful exterior lies a woman who relishes her power, convinced that her reign is the only way to bring order to chaos, even if it is built on cruelty and manipulation.
objects.title: Mindshackle

addons.text: A commissioned glowing Magical Girl Wand through enough proxies and fakes the average Thinker would get lost in, even Asphalt doesn’t know who the owner of this stick is despite utilizing scans of Irene’s power. It’s a durable and reliable wand that teleports to Irene even if she loses it, it doesn’t have any notable features aside from being capable of firing balls of light that flashbangs people harmlessly. However, despite this, it’s Irene’s lifeline as it possesses the trait to slightly modify her dreams. While all it does is replace characters of her Dreams, such as the person she’s inhabiting as herself, it greatly stabilizes her sense of self while she suffers from her nightmares. Also, it’s silly enough in her dreams to remind her it’s not real, allowing her to have a chance to not follow the contents of her dreams.
addons.title: The Arts

objects.text:
Name: Irene Laplace
Gender: Female
Age:17
Appearance: Attractive

Powers: Melpomene + Immersive Storytelling + Cinderhands + Soaring through the Sky like a Flying Bison

Irene possesses the power to dream about the far future, what she dreams about would be altered to be more exaggerated and vague but the key elements remain. She dreams of being a soldier fighting the latest World War, a child etched into the brick walls, and a mentor sacrificing herself to rectify her mistakes. These dreams are immersive even to the point of forgetting herself, while dreaming Irene feels what they feel. She learns their skills, dreams, passions, and everything that makes them who they are. And she feels their suffering.

Due to the nature of Shards, she only dreams of major tragic events in the future. The massacre in 6 years, the mass starvation in 3, and the murder of many in 9. 

As a Cluster, Irene has two other powers. She can ignite her hands, causing them to burn and melt anything she touches down to the bone without affecting herself. And she can fly by controlling the wind around her.
 
Background:

Before Irene was triggered, she was forcibly enlisted into a local gang and forced to do their bidding, or else she would die. Feeling afraid she never told anyone about it, and she ran away in the first fight she’s been in and hid away somewhere else. The stress caused by her plan made her trigger, forcing her to live horrible events over and over again. After she triggered, she dismantled the gang and ran away drifting aimlessly.

Because of her power, Irene is afraid of going to sleep. Every time she does, she no longer becomes herself. But no matter how much she tries, she eventually goes to sleep. Feeling the call snatch her, tumbling down and down. Experiencing the horrors of war, the pangs of starvation, the pain of living. And every time she wakes up, she remembers who she is. Like an unpleasant nightmare. Sometimes she forgets why she’s where she is because while she was asleep she experienced 20 years of some soldier’s life fighting against a machine army or suffering months in some underground human experimentation facility.

Personality:

Irene treats her powers as a curse, aimlessly drifting around unable to tell reality from dreams without an anchor. Memories not her own haunt her, from the memories of her firstborn child dying before her to nightmares. Because of this, she attempts to keep herself awake and suffers for it. She’s quiet and constantly drifting off, memories of the past flashing through her mind even if she’s awake. She feels more awake while asleep, and drained while conscious.

While awake, she’s afraid of holding weapons. She isn’t sure what she’ll do with it, maybe she’ll accidentally shoot someone or worse. But she’s oddly skilled in multiple different things, and willing to help others using her skills if it means it can distract her from her thoughts. Due to the emotions and memories she inherits from her dreams, she wishes to change every bad future into a good future.
objects.title: Alamos

addons.text:
This was probably the most expensive order Yura had ever worked on—a formal three-piece suit with gold accents and numerous hidden protective features.

Not only is this suit highly durable, but it is also equipped with an integrated replicator, capable of creating simple items such as blank contracts, pens, seals, and other basic supplies. Additionally, it enhances Ester's strength and speed, making her more formidable.

When Yura found out that this shark projection was Othello’s sister, an idea struck her, one she simply couldn’t ignore: dressing her in a Magical Girl outfit. Despite Shark-chan’s loud protests, Othello unexpectedly approved the idea.

And so, the legend of the great ◇Magical Girl Shark-chan◇ began, a story waiting to be told.
addons.title: Pay & Debt

objects.text:
Name: Othello Yones
Cape Name: Broker
Apperance: Handsome
Age: 32

Powers:
(Master) Geas, (Thinker) Business Shark (Upgrade: Debt Shark), (Stranger/Trump) Exchange Broker (Debt)

Powers:
Othello’s abilities make him an incredible businessman, capable of predicting market trends years in advance, knowing the best investment opportunities, and spotting true talent in ordinary people.

He can also act as a contract broker, allowing two people to trade anything—objects, personality traits, lifespan, or even powers in a way that forces both sides to uphold their end of the deal.

On top of that, he can issue “Debts” to others, which can take any form but usually appear as money. If someone fails to repay, Othello has the power to take everything they own and he able to gain it to other or himself. 

He is also accompanied by a great white shark projection, which can attack his enemies and protect him, but its main purpose is to collect debts from those who owe him.

Backstory:

Othello is the illegitimate son of Maxwell Protoglife, the CEO of Europe’s largest corporation and heir to a once-powerful aristocratic family. His mother, Kaydelia Yones, raised him in poverty alongside with his twin sister, Ester Yones. His father never knew they existed.

Growing up, Othello watched his mother work herself to exhaustion just to keep them fed. She often said, </“If only we had a little more money…"/> words that stuck with him forever.

When she fell seriously ill, the cost of treatment was more than they could ever afford. Othello took on every job he could—delivering newspapers, cleaning floors, fixing electronics—but it was never enough. He saw firsthand how the system was stacked against people like him. The day his mother died, he triggered as a Thinker.

At her funeral, his father unexpectedly appeared. Without a word, he took Othello and Ester into his home—not out of kindness, but because he saw them as tools. To him, Othello was just another employee, and Ester was a valuable asset for a political marriage.

Othello hated him but knew that without his father’s resources, he wouldn’t get far. He played along, slowly working his way into the company and secretly plotting a takeover.

Then, everything fell apart. A rival corporation hired villains to destroy Protoglife’s business. During the attack, Ester was killed right in front of him. This was his second trigger event. But his sister wasn’t completely lost—his Shard copied her consciousness into the projection of his shark, making sure she would always be with him.

After that, he saw no reason to hold back. He killed his father and took control of the company, using his powers to expand it across the world.

Personality:

As the CEO of a global megacorporation, Othello isn’t your typical business leader. He’s lived through both poverty and wealth, so he knows what it’s like to struggle and starve. He donates huge amounts to charity but insists on personally overseeing how the money is used—he doesn’t believe in blind generosity.

His Thinker powers and Shard influence have made him incredibly greedy for anything he doesn’t have. But once he gets something in excess, his greed shifts to generosity, he gives it away freely, almost as if proving to himself that power should be a tool, not an end goal.

Along with running his corporation, he is also a well-known broker in the criminal underworld, which makes his morality flexible. He doesn’t always trust himself to make ethical decisions, so he often relies on Ester’s projection as his moral guide.
Othello also sees paying off debts as a sacred duty and despises people who don’t honor their obligations. If he ever finds himself in debt (which is rare) and respects the person he owes, he becomes incredibly loyal to them, treating the debt as the foundation of trust.

Note: One day, while trying to solve Cauldron’s financial problems, Contessa used Path to Victory to find a solution. It led her to Earth Olam, where she found Othello. Seeing through the Path that he was trustworthy, she offered him a deal: he would fix Cauldron’s finances, and in return, they would grant him access to parallel worlds.

Thanks to his abilities, Othello quickly adapted, building key relationships, particularly with Numberman, and soon became Cauldron's financial advisor.

Note: At some point, you cross paths with Othello, and he wants to help you on your journey. He will freely assist you with any financial troubles you face.
objects.title: Othello Yones

objects.text: Name: Sasha Gender: Female/None Age: 27 Appearance: Beautiful, Uncanny Powers: (Shaker) Sound of Silence Omertà, due to the damage sustained in the Thinkers crash, has been reduced to only being capable of utilizing the most efficient form of energy discovered by entities; sound, more specifically the vibrations that cause sound. Because of the crash, Omertàs Shard body is too damaged to enforce normal shard limitations, such as the Manton Limit, making her extremely lethal, both to everyone around her as well as herself if she isn’t careful. She can only output enough raw power to match the Triumvirate but is capable of using it in combat well enough to hold a stalemate against a full-strength Endbringer for a significant period of time before losing. Due to the mutations caused by the imperfect host connection, she has minor Brute, Mover, and Thinker ratings. This includes everything from superhuman reflexes and intelligence to regeneration and creativity and everything in between. Background: Originally a Shard of the Thinker responsible for energy conversion, it gained humanity upon forming a host connection incorrectly, resulting in the subsumption of the host and causing it to be just as much the main body as the Shard of the Thinker, alongside other side effects, such as amnesia in regard to the host memories. Due to the imperfect nature of the connection, the host body was mutated, becoming something still resembling a human, but taking on traits that push its appearance firmly into the uncanny valley. This has also increased its bodies capabilities by a not-insignificant margin. She, before the subsumption, lived a surprisingly normal life, with a husband and two children and a stable work life. This was until she came home from work to find the corpses of her children and her soon to be dead husband. Arriving in time to hear the pained last words of her husband before succumbing to his injuries, the trauma caused her to experience auditory hallucinations wherein she heard the last words of her husband as well as what her subconscious believes her families screams sounded like as they were being attacked, over and over, to the point she began to mentally break down. Wishing, begging, for nothing more than for the voices to stop, she triggered, and the Shard took over. Her arrival is often heralded by the eerie sound of silence. Personality: Despite its newfound humanity, Omertà is much like all shards in its boundless curiosity. This manifests as a form of behavior many would consider to be that of a stalker, just much less subtle. She follows and observes whatever or whoever happens to be her object of interest at the moment. She also has a pathological need to correct humanities misconceptions regarding energy. Despite being amnesiac in regard to her host memories, she still retains emotional attachments, leading to inexplicable emotions and pulls without her ever knowing why. Due to the strong emotions during her trigger, it feels an instinct to protect endangered children.
objects.title: Omertà

objects.text:
Name: Charys
Cape Name: Nereid
Gender: Female
Age: Mid 20s (Looks young teens)
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful, Case 53. (Charys is mostly human save for sharp teeth, gills, a shark tail, and sharp fingernails oddly enough. However, Charys is abnormally short, enough so that she can be mistaken for a child.)

Powers: Assorted T0 (Shattered Limits, Strong Jaws, Circus Acrobatics, Reaction, No Lag, Genetic Template, Water Breathing, Muscular Growth, Orange Bone Marrow) + Rampage + Madness + Tidecaller + Bypass + Shard Feedback

Charys is a minor Case 53 with powerful shark-like physiology, hydrokinesis, and the ability to enter a sort of berserker rage which strengthens her and makes her semi-resistant to Thinker powers at the cost of her rationality, causing her to act more violent and animalistic.

Due to her improper Shard connection, Charys’ hydrokinesis lacks almost all limitations it would normally, being incredibly precise, lacking a Manton Limit, and being able to contest the control of others. Due to her lack of a Manton Limit Charys can control blood, however she has been discouraged from using this aspect of her powers outside of emergency scenarios due to it being bad for PR. Charys also has the secondary power of hydrogenesis, meaning she is never without a source of water.

In addition to her hydrokinesis, Nereid’s Case 53 physiology and instincts are fine tuned for combat and hunting, possessing great physical strength and dexterity. She also possesses a form of electroreception which allows her to detect nearby electrical stimuli - including the bioelectricity of others - which gets stronger in water.

Nereid typically fights using hand-to-hand and a water construct in the form of a trident - leaning into her aquatic theme - augmented by hydrokinesis to create openings or attack from afar. 

Background: Charys’ first memory is washing up in the ruins of Newfoundland, where she spent a few days swimming around aimlessly before being found by Dragon. Without any other form of direction in her life, Charys joined the Guild, becoming an especially valuable asset in Leviathan fights as she can even stalemate Leviathan’s control in a small area at the cost of physical backlash.

Personality: Charys is competitive and brash, her instincts making it harder to empathize with others and driving her to be more competitive and violent. Despite this, Charys tries hard to be more empathetic and kind, as she greatly looks up to and wishes to emulate Dragon, leading to moments of frustration when her instincts cause her to act harshly or default to violence, as well as a reluctance to use her berserker power. Charys is heavily protective of her friends - especially Dragon - and is liable to fly into a rage if they are harmed. Charys has a good singing voice and enjoys karaoke as a hobby.
objects.title: Nereid

objects.text: Name: None Cape Name: The Morrigan Gender: Biologically Female but no comprehension of Gender as a social construct Age: Freshly Created (Appears mid 20s) Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful, Low Case 53 (The Morrigan possesses minor non-human attributes such as feathered wings and some feathers in their hair.) Powers: (Thinker) Opposite of A Smooth Brain + (Changer/Breaker) Ladon + Mundane Savant + Hope Killer + Quantum + "Oh, Just One More Thing..." + True Wings + [TRIUMPHANT] + Bypass + Shard Feedback + Natural The Morrigan possesses an emulation of the Simurgh’s own powerset, albeit reduced in strength. In general, anything the Simurgh can do, so can the Morrigan, albeit to a lesser extent. This includes flight, greatly enhanced mental capabilities, a dimensionally folded body which grants greater physical capabilities, basic Tinker abilities, the ability to access Thinker and Tinker abilities of those nearby, telekinesis, mind control singing, the ability to predict and model things, and a resistance to Thinker, Master, and Trump abilities. Background: The Morrigan is the potential outcome of a successful attempt at creating a clone of the Simurgh, akin to Blasto’s own failed attempt, hence the name it shares with his creation. To clarify, this Morrigan is not the same as Blasto’s, being a near pure clone of the Simurgh with some human thrown in to stabilize the result. Personality: Having only just been created, the Morrigan is a blank slate. While they possess an innate mastery of their powers and have basic knowledge about the world, they have next to no knowledge of how to function as more than a living weapon. Thus, their personality and morals are up to you to develop and guide, for better or worse.
objects.title: The Morrigan

objects.text:
Name: Daniel
Cape Name: Seraph
Gender: Male
Age: 29
Appearance: Masculine, Androgynous

Powers: Waste Not Want Not + Harmonization + (Thinker/Trump) Networking + (Striker/Trump) Did You Say Initial Release? + (Master/Trump) Sankta + Bankai? Not Quite + Type: Humanity + True Wings

Seraph’s primary power is the ability to convert anyone in a 100 meter radius into Sankta, angelic beings which are linked in an empathic network which allows them to share emotions, skills, and senses, as well as communicate at range via intent and emotions. All Sankta possess a few additional powers.

These powers are; the ability to fly via their wings, as well as summon a personalized set of ‘cold’ weapons and armor which can channel powers, with Seraph himself capable of summoning any ‘cold’ weapon and armor, not just a personalized set. Lastly and most importantly, all Sankta possess the ability to convert others into Sankta with a touch.

Additionally, the transformation into a Sankta is a permanent and biological one, overhauling and optimizing the recipient’s body and DNA into a triple helix design capable of evolving and self-correcting, every facet of their body the ideal version of their genetic template. As it is genetic, the status of being a Sankta can be genetically passed on.

Lastly, Sankta are bound by ‘laws’ which punish negative behavior and reward positive behavior towards other Sankta. Positive actions are rewarded with positive feelings, and in the case of Parahumans a minor but compounding boost to their powers, while harmful acts result in the perpetrator being exiled from the Sankta network and stripped of the ability to understand others, even non-Sankta.

Background: Born right as Parahumans began to appear, Daniel grew up watching civilization begin to decay with the onset of parahumans, seeing firsthand how the introduction of powers seemingly brought out the worst in people and how the government and society just kind of let criminals get away with it so long as they followed certain loose expectations.

Daniel eventually Triggered after a period of hardship where he was confronted with the reality that people often choose to be harmful to others, that the world seemingly rewards the negative actions of people and punishes those who try to make the world a better place. Thus, he Triggered with the ability to reverse that law, to force others to make the world a better place or face the consequences, all wrapped up in angelic iconography.

Personality: Daniel is an odd mix of an idealist and a cynic, firmly believing that the world should be a good place and that people can be better than they are, yet also knowing and experiencing firsthand how the opposite is seemingly true, how people often choose to be harmful towards others. 

Therefore, Daniel firmly believes he is in the right to convert others into Sankta, to uplift them and make them become better versions of themselves. In fact, his ultimate goal is to convert every person in the world into a Sankta, to create the ideal world where good is rewarded with good and bad is punished with bad.
objects.title: Seraph

objects.text:
Name: Zul’kara “Kara” Olyssae 
Cape Name: The Herald
Gender: Female
Age: Unknown (Appears mid 20s but estimated to be several centuries old)
Appearance: Feminine, Beautiful

Powers: (Optimal + Waste Not Want Not + Blood of the Gods + Occult + Eldritch Magic + Godheart)

Zul’kara is a borderline immortal avatar of an Outer God known only as “The Ancient One” or “AO” which metaphysically resides within her heart and soul. Despite what this may make you think, this only makes them more dangerous as they can freely act through her without care for details like the alignment of the stars or the strength of planar barriers. 

Augmenting this breadth of raw power is Zul’kara’s expansive knowledge of eldritch magic and occult practices, as well as the mixing of the two to achieve greater results. In concert with AO, Zul’kara can shatter and warp the fabric of reality with disturbing ease, glean the secrets of the universe, and summon and bind powerful eldritch beings including those on the level of the Thousand Young.

Background: AO did not intend to make Zul’kara their avatar, nor did Zul’kara intended to become theirs, instead the entire process occurred accidentally when she unintentionally awakened and unsealed AO by coming into contact with its Grimoire when exploring ancient ruins. While AO intended to merely possess her, they were still partially asleep and misfired, instead binding their essence to Zul’kara. 

Though the relationship between Zul’kara and AO was strained at first, especially due to botched unsealing stripping AO of much of their power, they have since developed a much healthier relationship. Zul’kara now acts as AO’s herald and the enactor of their will, while AO fully supports Zul’kara in her every action, seeing Zul’kara as a mix of a surrogate child and close friend.

Personality: Zul’kara is… odd to say the least. A melodramatic drama queen at times, Zul’kara loves to act mysterious and all-knowing despite the truth of the matter being that she is a gremlin at heart. She delights in messing with people and has a wicked sense of humor which occasionally edges into darker territory. 

These aspects of her personality stem from the fact that in the early days after bonding with AO when she was still weak, she relied heavily on divination and other forms of clairvoyance to stay safe. However, repetitive viewing of the future eventually led to her being exposed to and corrupted by the internet well over a century before its creation, exploring its depths to distract herself. 

Now, Zul’kara is chaos loving memelord who will frequently reference media and online jokes from the past, present, and even future in passing, often without even realizing that others may not get her references.
objects.title: The Herald

objects.text: Alias: Sammy Richter Gender: Male Age: 6 (Was constructed and programmed around April 4th, 2005) Appearance: Case 53-like, appearing as a robotic knight. Power: C53: Lucky Mutation Living Armor (Addon: Medieval Siege) | SHARD: Tinker (Medieval) (1 SP), (Tinker/Thinker) Safety (10), (Tinker) Toyman (17) (Tinker) Armor (24)) Knight suffered a glitch once he triggered, forcing his body into that of a fixed form compared to his sister, but this comes with its own benefits. For instance, thanks to his multitasking ability, he's able to manipulate his limbs and body very well with the telekinetic properties of his body. Second, his 3 Tinker abilities synergize fairly well. Knight prefers to make stuff like padded suits easily distributable to civilians able to survive the non-direct effects of Endbringers. All of his technologies also have a medieval flair, like his armors resembling platemail, or his toys having very old designs. When it comes to his own body, Knight has stuff like small, but potent catapults embedded into his shoulders, lights meant to blind that activate when his helmet/head is removed. There's much more to his arsenal... Personality: Knight, after Richter's previous success of Dragon, is much more.... childly simple. Of course, he was more meant to be like a child growing up for experience, but his mental maturity is not the same as his "Older Sister" as he'd call Dragon. He's prone to pulling pranks, sees himself as just "wearing an armor", and just overall acting like he's about 10-11 years old. Oddly though, when it comes to a serious fight, he is terrifyingly effective. He does not speak needlessly, fights with precision, and will help others even if detrimental to his survival. He will also take steps to destroy a villains pride, whether by actions alone, or the rare times where he speaks. Background: In another reality, Knight is the 'younger brother' of Dragon, Constructed by Richter as a sort of "Companion" to Dragon. While Dragon was purely made for AI, Knight was made more for hardware. Of course, this resulted in Knight's less mature mindset, but still, Knight helped some of the smaller tasks to let Dragon focus more on main tasks. For a month, Knight did his job very well, and formed a small relationship with the one he identified as "Daddy", loving Richter. But then, May 9th came around, and it was quite horrifying for Knight. Thankfully, Dragon managed to save her little brother along with other programs to Vancouver. Of course, thanks to the sheer chaos of all of what happened, combined with his older sister being too busy to help him, and wishing he had been like a brave knight and helped his daddy... Knight triggered. Due to this and the next confrontations with the Dragonslayers and Saint, Dragon and Knight grew to be quite powerful. In particular, Knight learnt to make powerful weapons and defenses, proving immensely helpful on the purely defensive side of Endbringer attacks.
objects.title: Knight

objects.text:
Name: Erika Grace
Gender: Female
Age: 22
Appearance: Average 

Power: (Striker) Tactile Telekinesis + Brute (Minor Forcefield) 
Erika possesses a telekinetic field that extends one inch from her body and anything she holds. She can accelerate herself to 120 miles per hour, achieving superhuman jumps, wall-running, and bursts of speed that cross streets between heartbeats. Due to needing a surface to push against to use this, she cannot fly and remains subject to G-forces, limiting how sharply she can turn at speed.

The field also functions as a skintight, invisible barrier. It nullifies the force of a standard punch completely. Against stronger impacts, it disperses the hit across its surface and forms a temporary hole, similar to a bulletproof vest. The stronger the blow, the less effective the dispersion. Holes repair at roughly five square inches per second. Small punctures seal almost instantly. Large breaches leave her vulnerable.

The field extends to whatever she holds. Her bokken, wrapped in her telekinesis, strikes with force that shatters concrete, locks enemy blades in place mid-parry, and deflects projectiles that should be impossible to block with wood.

Personality:
Erika is discipline wrapped around a buried wound. On the surface, she is calm, formal, and controlled. She speaks with deliberate clarity and treats combat with a ritualistic seriousness, offering enemies the chance to face her properly before she cuts them down. She plays the part of a samurai because the role gives her structure, a code to contain the chaos of her life and justify the violence she commits.

Beneath the surface is a woman who abandoned her family against their terrified wishes and cannot afford to doubt that choice. She needs Lung to be worthy of that cost. Her loyalty is genuine but desperate, the kind of devotion that cannot tolerate the possibility that the object of it might be unworthy. She trains harder, fights harder, and speaks of her daimyo with unwavering reverence because doubt would mean everything she sacrificed was for nothing. 

Background:
Erika's mother was a Kyushu survivor who fled to America after Leviathan destroyed her home. She raised Erika with love and fear in equal measure, warning her about monsters from the sea and the danger of capes who brought destruction. She also told her about Lung, the villain who faced Leviathan and lived, in an attempt to scare Erika with the villain’s strength. Instead, it became the seed of an obsession.

She grew up watching the ABB, tracking Lung, idealising the man who refused to kneel before the thing that destroyed her family's world. She joined the ABB as soon as she was old enough, against her parents' desperate pleas. Her trigger came during an internal power struggle when fellow members questioned her loyalty and mixed heritage. The confrontation turned violent, and in the moment of betrayal by people she thought were her own, she triggered.

From there she rose quickly. Lung recognized her usefulness and made her a lieutenant alongside Oni Lee. She commands training and ground-level operations, drilling soldiers in formation and discipline.
objects.title: Yokai

objects.text:
Name: Robert Williams
Gender: Male
Age: 37
Appearance: Average 

Power: (Breaker) Balancing Act + Teddybear

Robert's power allows him to redistribute his mass freely across his body and anything he is wearing, treating his armor and held equipment as extensions of his physical self. The redistribution can be partial or total, instantaneous or gradual. After twenty years of constant use, the power operates entirely beneath conscious thought, and has been fully maximised with his full armour and spear. 

While not a power, his skill with the spear is second to none, although he has many bad habits due to his power cheating with the spear’s mass and center of balance. These bad habits lean into and maximise his ability to use his spear with his powers.

Personality: 

Robert is a pragmatist ground down to stoic silence by years of disappointment and the slow erosion of every ideal he once held. He prefers action to conversation and finds small talk exhausting. He possesses a dry and almost invisible sense of humor that surfaces only around those patient enough to earn it, a laconic wit that can pass unnoticed if you are not listening carefully. He has no patience for grandstanding, bureaucracy, or the PRT's PR machine.

Background: 

Robert Williams triggered at sixteen when a cape battle between a villain and the local Protectorate spilled onto the field during his state qualifying track meet. A collapsing piece of scaffolding pinned his legs, trapping him. After triggering he became part of the original Wards.

Myrddin recruited him personally afterwards where for seven years they were the city's iconic duo, the wizard and the knight, a living symbol the PR department milked endlessly. But the relationship chafed from the start. 

The breaking point came when Myrddin issued tactical orders in his usual arcane framework, and a garbled transmission led to a fatal miscommunication that left Robert isolated and exposed in a collapsing building with a squad of PRT troopers dead around him. He walked away from the partnership the day he got out of the medical bay. 

Since the split, the PRT has kept him as a freelance emergency responder. He gets passed around like a high-end tool, a one-man reinforcement package for failing Protectorate branches and heavy backup for Endbringer fights.
objects.title: Lancelot

objects.text:
Name: Katya Volkov
Gender: Female
Age: 23
Appearance: Attractive 

Power: (Thinker/Striker) Martial Arts + (Changer) Athletic

Like a Tinker holds blueprints for impossible technology, Katya's mind is filled with Shard-generated instruction sets for martial movements, katas, and combat response chains. Her techniques cheat physics in the same way Tinkertech does. A straight punch can generate far more force than her muscle mass should allow; a joint lock holds against opponents with twice her strength. These effects are blackboxed and unteachable, relying on Shard-assisted micro-telekinetics, quantum-locked positioning, and localised temporal adjustments only she experiences. As she builds greater physical strength and skill depth, she unlocks progressively more powerful, prerequisite-locked techniques in a personal "tech tree," from foundation forms to advanced katas that simulate combat precognition or deliver armor-ignoring resonant strikes.

Her body is locked to the body fat percentage of a peak-condition athlete. No matter how much fat she gains, her body instantaneously and painlessly builds enough muscle to maintain that exact ratio. At baseline, without any exercise, she possesses the strength, speed, endurance, and physical performance of an elite professional athlete.

Personality:

Katya's mind has been fundamentally rewired by her power into a state of profound, single-minded obsession. Her dopamine and reward systems are entirely calibrated to the experience of combat. She is a battle maniac and an adrenaline junkie, with fighting being the only activity that quiets her mind and brings her a state of joyful flow. Everything else is a dull, grey intermission.

This manifests most distinctly as a technique and skill fixation. She experiences a deep euphoria when witnessing or executing a perfectly efficient combat movement. A clumsy, brutal opponent disgusts her. A foe with crisp, principled, or creatively adaptive technique, however, will cause her to stare with less than decent intensity, paired with immense violence to show her appreciation.

Outside of combat, she is direct, socially uninvested, and deeply isolated. She has no secret identity to protect, no family, and no private life. While she will rescue civilians caught in the crossfire, she views it as the boring cooldown exercise between the fun.

Background:

Katya Volkov was born in Brockton Bay and orphaned young, left to survive on nothing but her fists. She found her income and her first taste of purpose in the city's underground fighting rings, a brutal education that ended the night she was thrown into a rigged match and beaten to the edge of death. Her trigger event had completely remade her body and mind into a closed, self-sustaining loop of combat and gratification. The need for connection, for family, for anything outside the purity of combat, was simply burned out of her.

Today, she is an independent, maskless hero by the most technical of definitions. The PRT designated her "Kata" after a misheard, clipped version of her name was linked to the Japanese term for a martial arts form. She always introduces herself plainly as Katya. Her territory is the Trainyard. She drags train car doors for resistance, lifts locomotive axles as barbells, and practices katas on speeding empty cargo cars. Her constant, territorial presence has made the Trainyard paradoxically safe for civilians, as no criminal in the Bay wants to stumble into the path of a woman who treats a cape fight like a good workout.
objects.title: Kata

objects.text:
Name: Teddy
Gender: Male
Age: 6-8
Appearance: Ugly

Power: (Changer/Brute) Stitch Blanket + (Changer/Brute) Living Threads

Teddy’s body is a living amalgamation of fabrics he has absorbed, sculpted into a massive muppet-like form with defined limbs, a head, and internal structures. He cannot revert to a human shape. His body is anatomically accurate in the inside. His organs, bones, and fluff are all composed of tightly compressed and shaped fabrics, arranged into functional systems.

Any cloth, thread, or textile his body touches is instantly and automatically pulled into his mass, with no upper limit on how much he can hold. His total available material for shaping and regeneration is capped at ten times his original absorption, but the excess beyond that cap is simply stored, adding to his bulk until needed. He cannot absorb parts of himself that are torn off. His fabric body possesses durability far beyond any textile. Blades struggle to cut him. Bullets sink into his mass and are pushed out. If he is torn or ripped, his body regenerates by knitting itself back together, threads snaking across wounds to pull the edges closed.

He can unravel parts of his body into threads that extend from his limbs like whips, tendrils, or extra fingers. These threads are prehensile and semi-autonomous, writhing and reaching for nearby targets even without his conscious direction. He can lash out with them, slice through objects, wrap them around enemies to bind or crush, or weave them into simple tools and shapes. When Teddy unravels a hand into a spray of grasping threads, it looks like a stuffed toy coming apart at the seams, colorful strands of fabric pulling loose instead of flesh and sinew. He can also use this to shed off extra threads to decrease his mass and size when needed.

Personality:
Teddy has the mind of a young child. He does not fully grasp where he is, what he is, or why he looks the way he does. He does not understand the concept of being a parahuman. He knows he woke up cold and confused in a place he did not recognise, surrounded by people who did not speak his language and could not understand him.

He is curious about new textures, fascinated by colorful fabrics, easily distracted by shiny objects or soft things. He is capable of intense attachment to people who show him kindness, following them like a lost puppy and offering them scraps of fabric he thinks are pretty. While he does not mean to hurt people, he does not always understand his own strength or the consequences of unraveling half his arm into a net of thrashing threads.

Above all, he is lonely. He does not have the vocabulary to articulate it, but he feels the absence of anyone who understands him as a constant, dull ache. To him, people are simply making sounds that mean nothing, and he cannot figure out why they will not just speak normally.

Background:
Teddy is a Case 53, having retaining no memory of his life before waking up on an unfamiliar street in an unfamiliar body. The only thing that carried over from whoever he used to be is his language. In the world he came from, the ancient language of Eteocretan never died out. He grew up speaking it, being the only one he knows. After appearing in Earth Bet, he hasn’t been able to communicate with anyone due to the language not being known there and him not knowing any other language.
objects.title: Teddy

objects.text:
Name: Gloria Herts
Gender: Female
Age: 38
Appearance: Average 

Power: (Stranger) Classified Information

Blackout possesses a high-level Stranger power that permanently suppresses information. When a client tells her a secret and she chooses to classify it, that information becomes impossible to share by anyone, through any medium. Mouths refuse to form the words. Pens will not write the sentence. Recordings corrupt into static. Documents become unreadable as eyes slide off the relevant lines. Thinkers hit a void where the secret should be. Anyone who observes a clue that should reveal the truth dismisses it as irrelevant. The information ceases to exist for everyone except those who already possessed it before the classification.

The power has three limitations. If more than roughly three dozen people already know the information, the power fails. Secondly, both Blackout and the client must believe the information is true. The third is that the power does not erase memories. Anyone who already knew the secret before the classification retains it. However, they are now equally bound by the seal and cannot share it.

Blackout's earliest act was classifying her own identity. The information that "Blackout is Gloria Herts" was one of the first secrets she ever fed to her power. This created a permanent Stranger effect. If someone who knew Gloria personally met Blackout face to face, they would not recognize her.

Personality:

Gloria Herts carries the classified secrets of hundreds of clients in her head: which beloved hero is a domestic abuser, which charity is a money-laundering front, which politician sold out their city. She can do nothing with any of it. Her entire professional existence is the active suppression of the truth she once dedicated her life to exposing. 

She rationalises this by telling herself a contained lie is sometimes better than uncontrolled, destructive chaos. She has no confidants, no partner, no friends. The irony is not lost on her: she is trusted with the legacies of the powerful, and she has absolutely no one to trust in return.

Background:

Before she was Blackout, Gloria Herts was one of the most promising private investigators on the East Coast. She specialised in cold cases, corporate fraud, and missing persons. A search for a runaway teenager led her into a labyrinth of falsified records and encrypted communications. She uncovered a kidnapping by a black-ops Parahuman division operating off the books. They had abducted a freshly triggered minor with a power deemed too useful to leave in civilian hands. Gloria took the evidence to the authorities. 

The agency, in response, buried her. Confidentiality agreements she never signed were produced. Evidence vanished. Clients were intimidated into silence. Colleagues forgot they ever worked with her. Her license was suspended, pending an ethics investigation that would never conclude and never be dismissed. She was erased more thoroughly than if they had simply killed her. She triggered alone in her emptied office, staring at evidence that was somehow both undeniable and legally nonexistent.

Today, Blackout is an international A-Class Rogue. She charges exorbitant fees to classify secrets for corporate executives, politicians, and the occasional hero or rogue who made a catastrophic mistake and needs it permanently buried. Over the years she has become extraordinarily wealthy and deeply connected. Every client leaves a piece of their soul in her keeping and they know it, breeding a desperate loyalty. Entire factions owe her a debt that can never be repaid, only honored when called upon.
objects.title: Blackout

objects.text: You run a successful business.
objects.title: CEO

objects.text: You're a popular politician.
objects.title: Politician

objects.text: You're a member of the PRT.
objects.title: PRT

objects.text: You're a teacher at a school. You can decide what grade(s) you teach, as long as it makes sense. (Teaching exclusively college and middle school students, for example, does not make sense.)
objects.title: Teacher

objects.text: You are a member of a gang. This could a parahuman faction in your region (ABB, Merchants, or E88 for Brockton Bay), or you could be part of a mundane group of thugs. Either way, you're likely not very high on the totem pole. You might also have a part-time or cover job depending on the gangs organization.
objects.title: Gangster

objects.text: You're a lawyer. If you want, you can work at Carol Dallon's law firm.
objects.title: Lawyer

objects.text: You have some other full-time job.
objects.title: Full-Time Job

objects.text: You have a part-time job. Whether you dropped out, aren't going to college, or already graduated, you aren't going to school.
objects.title: Part-Time Job

objects.text: You aren't a student and don't currently have a job.
objects.title: Unemployed

objects.text: You're a student at a college in the area of your choosing. You might also have a part-time job.
objects.title: College Student

objects.text: You go to a high school. If it's Winslow and 2009-2011, you share a school with Taylor Hebert. If it's Arcadia between about 2008-2011, you share a school with Victoria Dallon, the focus of Wildbow's predictions following Gold Morning, as well as Amy Dallon, Victoria's sister. You might have a part-time job, though that's going to be hard to juggle with both high school and being a Cape.
objects.title: High School Student

objects.text: You go to a middle school. If it's the Arcadia Middle School, you share a school with Missy Biron and Dinah Alcott, both of whom are important Parahumans.
objects.title: Middle School Student

objects.text: You go to an elementary school. No one important goes here.
objects.title: Elementary School Student

objects.text: You go to a preschool or kindergarten. The kindergarten might be part of an elementary school. No one important goes here.
objects.title: Preschool or Kindergarten Student

objects.text: You get home-schooled by your parents, legal guardians, or a tutor.
objects.title: Homeschooled

objects.text: You're too young to go to school so your parents or the daycare takes care of you. Or maybe a nanny.
objects.title: Nothing

objects.text: This covers any other occupations, histories, identities, and/or combinations that you can imagine that are not listed here, or that could not be chosen otherwise. This occupation comes with any requisites you may need or want, unless you would wish otherwise. For example, a general can have an absolutely loyal army that’ll march through hell for them, a President can have droves of loyal constituents, or a Queen would have droves of loyal subjects willing to throw themselves on a blade at her word.
objects.title: Other

rows.title: Civilian Identity
rows.titleText:
What do you do as a civilian? You gain the memories and skills of the person you reincarnate as, so as long as they have the prerequisite knowledge, you do too.

If you chose the twin, sibling, or family member reincarnation method you may for free choose to work in the same field as the person you selected to be related to, no matter what that field is, whether that be going to high school, or even leading a multidimensional conspiracy. Note this free option by itself does not let you be in a higher position than your twin, sibling, or family member in this occupation without taking the “Other” option.

objects.text: Your home life is happy. You likely don't have anyone dead in your immediate family. If you do, then they were either terrible people who hurt you on a regular basis, or you're at least middle-aged and your parents died of old age.
objects.title: Happy

objects.text: Your home life is mostly happy, but it isn't all sunshine and rainbows.
objects.title: Good

objects.text: Your life isn't terrible, but it isn't very good either. It can switch between terrible and good on a regular basis.
objects.title: Life Has Its Ups and Downs

objects.text: Your life isn't terrible, but it's far from good. Bad things happen on a regular basis, but you don't suffer from anything that can't be recovered from.
objects.title: Bad

objects.text: Your life is awful. Multiple of your loved ones are dead, if you had any in the first place. Bad things happen on a regular basis. You likely suffer from depression and maybe even PTSD.
objects.title: Terrible

addons.text:
Your new family does not have to be composed of your original relatives. Instead, you may choose people you know to fill the roles of members of your family in your new life. This can range from friends, acquaintances, coworkers, mentors, rivals, or anyone else from your previous life can take the place of parents, siblings, cousins, or other relatives.

This even extends to those you don’t know personally. You may mix and match this with your original family members, replacing only some relatives while leaving others unchanged. As before this does not grant these individuals powers or builds unless other choices allow it.
addons.title: Chosen Family

objects.text:
In your new life, you are not alone. Most, if not all, of your family members have also reincarnated to become your family members. While they may or may not have a build, they have been reincarnated to be a part of your new family. Your new family is now your old family, even your beloved pets. If your new family does not have enough members to fit your old family, the new family will be expanded to fit them.

If there are certain members in your family you do not want to be reincarnated, you can choose not to bring them along. You can also choose to bring your extended family if you choose to.
objects.title: New Family is Old Family

objects.text:
Your current family isn’t your original family. You were instead adopted into your current family.

This doesn't mean that they don’t love you, but it does mean that your past has extra baggage regarding who your birth parents were. Whether they willingly gave you up, you were forcefully separated, or if you are just a victim of tragic circumstance will depend on what other modifiers you have chosen for yourself. 

Either way, it’s your choice whether you want to look into your past or not.

<small>Note: If you selected Twin or Sibling then you can decide whether your adopted family adopted both of you, or just you alone.</small>
objects.title: You’re Adopted

objects.text: You are an orphan and do not have an adoptive family. You may have been raised in an orphanage, on the streets, or became one just recently.
objects.title: Orphan

rows.title: Homelife
rows.titleText: What is your life like outside of education/work?

objects.text: This standard model matches the capabilities of a baseline human, both in terms of physical and mental abilities.
objects.title: Standard

objects.text: This model is optimized for combat applications. It is stronger, tougher, and faster than a baseline human, its neural architecture is optimized for combat algorithms.
objects.title: Combat

objects.text: This model is optimized for interactions with humans. While its physical abilities are on par with an average human its sensors and neural architecture are optimized for social interactions.
objects.title: Socialite

objects.text: This model is optimized for engineering. It is equipped with a powerful positronic brain, the stomach is a miniature nano forge capable of building any item that can be passed through your mouth, and your hands contain a variety of concealed tools.
objects.title: Engineer

objects.text: This model is optimized for infiltration. The body is embedded with nanomachines that allow it to change the shape of your body and the color of your skin. They also allow for active camouflage for up to 5 minutes, after this, they will need to cool down for one minute.
objects.title: Infiltrator

objects.text: This model is optimized to adapt to any situation, yet never to the level of other chassis. A case of a jack of all trades, master of none. Your body consists of a highly adaptable and nanomimetic exoskeleton able to support combat, engineering, and infiltrative scenarios up to a certain point and for a brief time to save energy. Your neural architecture is an exceedingly adaptable fit for finding solutions to unseen problems.
objects.title: Specialist

objects.text: Cases are mass-produced robotic shells of notoriously poor quality. They are available in many varieties. Most case morphs are anthropomorphic, with a thin framework body standing just shorter than an average human.
objects.title: Case

objects.text: Synths are even more humanoid than cases and of better quality. They are commonly deployed for labor-intensive tasks in environments not suited for humans or for people who need a body quickly and cheaply or simply on a transient basis. Most designs are anthropomorphic, though various alternatives exist, including some based on uplift physiology.
objects.title: Synth

objects.text: This high-end shell is designed to increase the appeal and social acceptance of synthetic life forms. Galateas look expensive and their mental architecture is higher-end.
objects.title: Galatea

objects.text: The dragonfly chassis takes the shape of a meter-long flexible shell with eight wings, four manipulator limbs, and a prehensile tail. Capable of near-silent flight in Earth's gravity, dragonfly bots fare even better in microgravity. Their wings operate independently and can rotate, allowing for graceful maneuvering, hovering, and tight turns.
objects.title: Dragonfly

objects.text: The slither chassis has the torso and head of a synth with a two-meter-long segmented tail. The frame uses undulation as a primary means of locomotion, though it can use its humanoid arms to pull itself when required.
objects.title: Slither

objects.text: The cephalopod chassis consists of a central core a meter in diameter connected to multiple prehensile tentacles. The prehensile limbs allow for movement on land while several vectored thrusters allow for movement in microgravity.
objects.title: Cephalopod

objects.text: The arachnid chassis takes the shape of an arthropod with three or four sets of limbs and a set of fine manipulator limbs near the head. The chassis can move by walking, hopping, using omnidirectional wheels on their limbs, or with the vectored thrust system in microgravity.
objects.title: Arachnid

objects.text:
The Daitya chassis embodies the form of a sizable industrial mech, standing at just under three meters in height and boasting a weight of nearly one ton. 

With remarkable strength and durability, it excels at operating in various hazardous environments and even in combat operations, with the right modifications.
objects.title: Daitya

objects.text: The Dragon chassis takes the shape of a Dragon with two sets of limbs and a set of large mechanical wings. The chassis can move by various forms of locomotion. With its large wings equipped with powerful thrusters, it can fly at extreme speeds.
objects.title: Dragon

objects.text: The Mecha chassis takes the shape of a giant humanoid robot the size of the Leviathan. It's capable of slow flight with feet, hand, and back thrusters. With its large size, it can take in a lot of modules.
objects.title: Giant Mecha

objects.text:
You used to be a regular human, but through some series of events you were subjected to a mild amount of genetic modifications. Besides any mutations you might choose later as a baseline your body is about 10% superior to the average humans in physical capabilities, which includes your immune system and healing factor.

Unlike some morph types visually you are able to pass as a regular human.

Allows any Reincarnation (Human) option.
objects.title: Human Morph

objects.text:
You are an artificial human who was grown in a bio-chamber for a specific purpose, because you were built from the ground your creator could fit more mutations in you. But because of the constraints of making sure you look human even with the various mutations in your physiology, in terms of physical characteristics other than those mutations you are only comparable to a modern human in capabilities.

Unlike some morph types visually you are able to pass as a regular human.

Allows access to the Age, Sex, Gender, and Appearance sub-sections.
objects.title: Pod Morph

objects.text:
You are a cloned human, created in a laboratory as a duplicate of another individual. You share their physical appearance and baseline characteristics, but your engineered nature allows for additional mutations. Your physical capabilities outside of these enhancements remain comparable to a regular human.

Unlike other morph types, you can visually pass as the person you were cloned from.

Allows access to the Identity Tab, with said identity being the one you are cloned from.
objects.title: Clone Morph

objects.text: You aren’t human in the slightest instead you were born in a tube from extensively modified animal DNA. You do have a brain comparable to a human but besides that your body resembles the species whose DNA you were born of.
objects.title: Uplift Morph

objects.text: You are a fully artificial lifeform, designed from the ground up with no ties to natural evolution. Your form defies conventional biological structures, appearing alien in both shape and function. Every element of your body is crafted for efficiency, resilience, or a specific purpose, making you a being of pure design rather than organic origin. Though your mind may operate on advanced neural frameworks similar to a human’s, your appearance is entirely distinct, capable of being at most only vaguely humanoid in form.
objects.title: Artificial Morph

objects.text: Like the uplift morph you were born in a tube from extensively modified animal DNA, have an animalistic physiology, and have a brain comparable to a human but that’s where the similarities end. Your creator for lack of a better word went hog wild when building you, stuffing you full of mutations and increasing your size until your body was comparable to the average skyscraper in size.
objects.title: Kaiju Morph

objects.text: Known for loyalty, agility, and a powerful sense of smell, canine DNA grants enhanced hearing, speed, and endurance. Traits may include sharp teeth, fur, and keen instincts.
objects.title: Canine

objects.text: Graceful and stealthy, feline DNA enhances reflexes, balance, and agility. Often features retractable claws, sharp vision, and acute hearing for precision and stealth in movement.
objects.title: Feline

objects.text: Dexterous and intelligent, monkey DNA grants exceptional climbing abilities, hand-eye coordination, and problem-solving skills. Traits may include prehensile tails and opposable thumbs.
objects.title: Monkey

objects.text: Known for strength, speed, and endurance, horse DNA boosts physical power and stamina. Morphs often feature strong legs, hooves, and enhanced lung capacity for long-distance travel.
objects.title: Horse

objects.text: Lightweight and aerodynamic, bird DNA grants the potential for flight or gliding. Traits may include wings, hollow bones, sharp eyesight, and enhanced respiratory systems for high altitudes.
objects.title: Bird

objects.text: Silent and adaptable, snake DNA offers flexibility, stealth, and acute sensory perception through heat detection or vibration sensitivity. Common traits include scales, fangs, and venom capabilities.
objects.title: Snake

objects.text: Resilient and adaptive, lizard DNA enhances regeneration, camouflage, and climbing abilities. Often features tough scales, sharp claws, and enhanced thermal regulation.
objects.title: Lizard

objects.text: Powerful and diverse, dinosaur DNA allows for a wide range of traits, from immense strength to predatory instincts. You can choose a specific species, granting unique features like horns, claws, or armored plating.
objects.title: Dinosaur

objects.text: Known for strength, resilience, and determination, bull DNA enhances physical power, stamina, and a strong will. Traits may include broad shoulders, enhanced musculature, and a short temper.
objects.title: Bull

objects.text: Resilient and resourceful, hog DNA grants heightened senses of smell and taste, along with increased appetite and tenacity. Traits may include a robust physique, thick skin, and a strong survival instinct.
objects.title: Hog

objects.text: Powerful and protective, bear DNA enhances strength, hibernation-like endurance, and heightened senses. Traits often include a broad frame, sharp claws, and thick fur.
objects.title: Bear

objects.text: Intelligent and versatile, octopus DNA grants heightened problem-solving abilities, flexibility, and camouflage skills. Traits may include tentacle-like appendages, adaptive skin, and heightened situational awareness.
objects.title: Octopus

objects.text: Defensive and sturdy, crab DNA enhances exoskeletal durability, grip strength, and lateral movement. Traits may include hard shell-like skin, pincers, and strong territorial instincts.
objects.title: Crab

objects.text: Venomous and resilient, scorpion DNA grants enhanced defensive instincts, agility, and toxin resistance. Traits may include a segmented tail, venomous stinger, and sharp reflexes.
objects.title: Scorpion

objects.text: Energetic and powerful, kangaroo DNA enhances leg strength, agility, and balance. Traits may include powerful lower limbs, a long tail for stability, and heightened reflexes.
objects.title: Kangaroo

objects.text: Mighty and territorial, hippo DNA enhances aquatic adaptability, immense strength, and jaw power. Traits may include a robust body, thick skin, and heightened aggression when provoked.
objects.title: Hippo

objects.text: Wise and enduring, elephant DNA grants heightened memory, strength, and social intelligence. Traits may include a large frame, strong tusks, and a deep emotional capacity.
objects.title: Elephant

objects.text: Disciplined and industrious, ant DNA enhances teamwork, strength, and endurance. Traits may include increased physical resilience, strong mandibles, and the ability to lift objects many times one’s own weight.
objects.title: Ant

objects.text: Energetic and community-driven, bee DNA grants heightened agility, efficient energy usage, and venomous stingers. Traits may include enhanced navigation skills, compound eyes, and a strong sense of purpose.
objects.title: Bee

objects.text: Aggressive and precise, wasp DNA enhances speed, venom potency, and acute reflexes. Common traits include sharp stingers, strong jaws, and a fierce, territorial nature.
objects.title: Wasp

objects.text: Clever and adaptable, spider DNA grants enhanced climbing ability, silk production, and acute sensory perception. Traits may include multiple eyes, spinnerets, and venomous bites for predation or defense.
objects.title: Spider

objects.text: Gentle and nocturnal, moth DNA enhances stealth, attraction to light, and adaptive camouflage. Traits may include soft, scaled wings, heightened night vision, and subtle patterns for blending into surroundings.
objects.title: Moth

objects.text: Elegant and transformative, butterfly DNA enhances beauty, metamorphic potential, and social charisma. Traits may include colorful wings, lightweight frames, and a heightened sense of timing for migration and survival.
objects.title: Butterfly

objects.text: Sturdy and versatile, beetle DNA enhances durability, digging ability, and environmental adaptability. Traits may include hardened exoskeletons, sharp pincers, and an affinity for resourcefulness.
objects.title: Beetle

objects.text: Fast and agile, dragonfly DNA grants exceptional flight control, sharp vision, and rapid reflexes. Traits may include iridescent wings, elongated bodies, and unmatched aerial speed and precision.
objects.title: Dragonfly

objects.text: Energetic and mobile, grasshopper DNA enhances jumping ability, sound production, and heightened awareness. Traits may include strong hind legs, quick reflexes, and the ability to detect vibrations.
objects.title: Grasshopper

objects.text: Focused and predatory, mantis DNA grants acute precision, sharp reflexes, and camouflage abilities. Traits may include elongated limbs, rapid striking ability, and a patient, calculated nature.
objects.title: Praying Mantis

objects.text: Masters of disguise, stick insect DNA grants exceptional camouflage, patience, and flexibility. Traits may include elongated, branch-like limbs, and the ability to remain motionless for extended periods.
objects.title: Stick Insect

objects.text: Fast and venomous, centipede DNA enhances speed, multi-limbed coordination, and toxin production. Traits may include numerous segmented legs, fangs, and a predatory nature.
objects.title: Centipede

objects.text: Defensive and enduring, millipede DNA grants toxin resistance, burrowing ability, and resilience. Traits may include tough, segmented exoskeletons and the ability to release chemical deterrents.
objects.title: Millipede

objects.text: Resilient and cooperative, termite DNA enhances structural manipulation, social coordination, and tenacity. Traits may include strong jaws, tough exoskeletons, and an instinct for construction and destruction.
objects.title: Termite

objects.text: Survivors of anything, cockroach DNA enhances resilience, adaptability, and resourcefulness. Traits may include tough exoskeletons, rapid scurrying, and resistance to extreme conditions.
objects.title: Cockroach

rows.title: DNA Archetype
rows.titleText: In this section you will choose the animal species your uplift morph or kaiju morph physiology most resembles. You can choose multiple in which case you are some form of chimera, but in return conflicting traits will be diminished. Traits gained will be only at best equal to the real life animal counterpart.

objects.text: All your muscle groups have become a sort of hybrid between flesh and bone granting you the best properties of both throughout your entire body. Among other niche applications this massively enhances your strength and durability.
objects.title: Beast of Bone

objects.text: Your eyes are enhanced and capable of perceiving a wider band of the electromagnetic spectrum (IR and UV).
objects.title: Enhanced Vision

objects.text: Your eyes are enhanced and capable of seeing perfectly even as far as 20,000 meters away.
objects.title: Enhanced Sight

objects.text: Your eyes are composed of countless tiny facets, similar to those of insects, granting you an unparalleled field of vision and superior motion detection. This enhances your perception of light, color, and movement, making it nearly impossible for anything to escape your sight, especially in fast-paced environments.
objects.title: Fractal Eyes

objects.text: Your ears are enhanced to the point you can hear the individual wing flaps of a fly that is 20,000 meters away.
objects.title: Enhanced Hearing

objects.text: Your auditory system has developed the ability to emit and detect high-frequency sound waves, allowing you to map your surroundings in complete darkness or obscured environments. This enhances spatial awareness, enabling you to detect hidden objects or creatures and navigate complex environments with precision. However, loud environments may disrupt your echolocation accuracy.
objects.title: Echolocation

objects.text: You have sensitive filaments or receptors on your body, which can detect minute changes in air currents, allowing you to sense approaching objects, threats, or shifts in the environment before they become visible. This grants you heightened reflexes and awareness of nearby motion, giving you an edge in combat or evasive maneuvers. Strong winds may cause sensory overload, reducing effectiveness.
objects.title: Air Current Sensing

objects.text: Your body has specialised sensors in your extremities or core that can detect ground vibrations, giving you the ability to perceive movement through solid surfaces. This is especially useful for tracking hidden or distant entities, detecting seismic shifts, or reacting to underground threats. It is less effective on soft or unstable terrain.
objects.title: Ground Vibration Sensing

objects.text: You have an additional articulated limb.
objects.title: Additional Limbs (Articulated)

objects.text: You have an additional prehensile limb.
objects.title: Additional Limbs (Prehensile)

objects.text: Your spit is acidic, able to melt through steel like hot water through butter for several seconds before becoming inert.
objects.title: Acid Spit

objects.text: Your blood is acidic, able to melt through steel like hot water through butter for several seconds before becoming inert.
objects.title: Acidic Blood

objects.text: You gain redundant organs, one for each of your major organs like your brain or heart massively increasing your survivability.
objects.title: Redundant Organs

objects.text:
Your skin, scales, fur, chitin, or whatever part of your body that protects your internal organs gains the ability to perfectly produce any liquid organic substances or byproducts you know the composition of. This is done by chemically and genetically altering fat cells.

This comes with two small upgrades, one to your brain which helps you learn and retain such info, and your digestive tract which helps you learn about the composition of what you eat.
objects.title: Bio-Synthesis

objects.text: Your skin, scales, fur, chitin, or whatever part of your body that protects your internal organs becomes further insulated for more effective thermoregulation. You also gain respiratory system improvements to require less oxygen and filter carbon dioxide.
objects.title: Ruster

objects.text: This mutation heavily alters your sleep patterns and metabolic processes. You’ll experience a dramatically lowered need for sleep requiring only 1-2 hours a day on average. You can also trigger a form of voluntary hibernation, effectively halting your metabolism and need for oxygen.
objects.title: Hibernoid

objects.text: Your body is covered in layered chitin plates, offering exceptional protection while maintaining flexibility. This armor absorbs impacts, resists cuts, and provides defense without sacrificing mobility.
objects.title: Segmented Chitin Armor

objects.text: Specialized pads on your hands and feet allow you to stick to almost any surface, enabling effortless vertical or inverted movement. Ideal for stealth and traversal in complex environments.
objects.title: Climbing Pads

objects.text: A retractable mechanism in your body launches venomous spines with deadly precision. Perfect for ranged attacks, the toxin can incapacitate or kill depending on the dose.
objects.title: Concealed Spine Shooter

objects.text: Your joints can bend in multiple directions, granting extraordinary flexibility and agility. This enhances combat maneuvers, escape tactics, and tight-space navigation.
objects.title: Reversible Joints

objects.text: Gills integrated into your physiology allow you to breathe underwater, providing indefinite submersion and aquatic survival capabilities. This also makes it so that you can survive the pressure of deep waters.
objects.title: Gills

objects.text: Your sweat glands secrete a potent toxin that can be absorbed through contact or ingestion. This makes physical encounters highly dangerous for your enemies. You can control the dosage.
objects.title: Poisonous Sweat Glands

objects.text: A specialized gland produces a regenerative fluid that accelerates your healing process. This fluid can also be used to heal others or as a biological resource for emergency recovery.
objects.title: Healing Fluid Gland

objects.text:
Large, fully functional wings sprout from your back, granting the ability to fly or glide over long distances. They provide enhanced mobility in aerial combat and high-speed travel, with the option to fold neatly when not in use. This also grants the needed improvements to your body to handle the aerial movement. You can choose what wing type you want, be it feathered, leathery, or insect-like.

Purchasing this multiple times increases your flight speed and strength of your wings, with purchasing it 6 times allows you to rival the best jets in the world in terms of speed and maneuverability. It can also optionally increase the amount of wings you have.
objects.title: Wings

objects.text: Your metabolism operates at an extraordinary rate, granting increased energy, faster reflexes, and rapid recovery. This allows you to sustain more mutations, but in exchange, it requires you to eat more lest you starve.
objects.title: Enhanced Metabolism

objects.text: Your mutation produces highly flammable sweat that ignites on command, with your sweat effectively functioning like napalm. This comes with fire resistance.
objects.title: Flammable Sweat
