objects.text: Your cognitive functions are massively enhanced, granting superior intelligence, memory, and problem-solving abilities. You process information at incredible speeds, making you a master strategist or inventor. This also improves reaction time and complex multitasking.
objects.title: Big Brain

objects.text: You can produce and lay eggs that hatch into genetically controlled offspring—lesser clones tailored to your needs. These offspring can vary in form and function, from simple biological drones to specialized organisms designed for tasks such as combat, labor, or reconnaissance. You have a degree of control over their traits, allowing you to create distinct roles, much like a queen controls her hive, however it is still limited by your genetic traits, so if you have no wings then creating offspring with wings is impossible.
objects.title: Egg Production

objects.text: Sharp, durable claws can extend and retract from your fingertips at will, giving you a powerful melee weapon and climbing tool. These claws can tear through tough materials and are easily concealed when not in use, making them perfect for both stealth and combat situations.
objects.title: Retractable Claws

objects.text: Your lungs and blood have been optimized for oxygen absorption and transport, granting you extraordinary stamina and resilience in low-oxygen environments. This improves endurance, enhances high-altitude performance, and allows you to sustain energy in your body for longer.
objects.title: Enhanced Respiratory System

objects.text: Your body produces melanin that adapts to radiation exposure, darkening to protect you from harmful radiation levels. This offers enhanced resistance to environmental hazards like solar flares, radiation zones, and extreme UV exposure, while also storing energy from absorbed radiation for future use.
objects.title: Radiation-Responsive Melanin

objects.text: Your musculature has been augmented with a hydraulic system, granting you immense physical strength and durability. You can unleash high-powered bursts of strength or speed, similar to the explosive strikes of a mantis shrimp. The system operates through pressurized fluid, providing precision and efficiency while conserving energy.
objects.title: Hydraulic-Powered Body

objects.text: Your body is capable of generating and expelling a high-pressure stream of water from your mouth. This stream is powerful enough to cut through metal, stone, or any material softer than reinforced steel.
objects.title: High-Pressure Water Breath

objects.text: You have an internal bioelectric system capable of storing and discharging electrical energy. After accumulating a charge from prolonged metabolic activity, you can release a powerful electrical burst, stunning or incapacitating nearby foes. The charging process requires time, and frequent use may strain your energy reserves.
objects.title: Bioelectric Discharge

objects.text: Your adrenal glands have been modified to produce a potent cocktail of chemicals far beyond ordinary adrenaline, functioning more like a built-in combat drug system. This mixture heightens strength, speed, reflexes, and pain tolerance to superhuman levels for a short duration, turning you into a near-unstoppable force in high-stress situations. While incredibly effective in battle, overuse can lead to severe physical strain, chemical imbalances, or long-term damage to your body.
objects.title: Adrenaline Surge

objects.text: Your body has the potential to grow and evolve to a far more significant degree than ordinary creatures. While this doesn’t allow for evolutions overnight, it does make it that if you suffer the same issue for long enough, your body will begin to develop ways to survive against it, taking months to years instead of centuries.
objects.title: Growth Potential

objects.text: Your body has doubled in size, providing a greater surface area and mass to house additional mutations. This increases strength, durability, and physical resilience, allowing you to bear more weight, deliver more powerful attacks, and endure harsher environments. However, you require more energy to sustain yourself daily.
objects.title: Larger Body

objects.text: Your skin has developed chlorophyll-like cells capable of converting sunlight into energy, reducing the need for external sustenance. This enhances your stamina, granting moderate energy regeneration during daylight.
objects.title: Photosynthesis Skin

objects.text: Your body is riddled with flaws and recessive traits, resembling natural evolutionary paths rather than optimised design.
objects.title: Inefficient Biology

objects.text:
Your genetic code is inherently unstable, making your body prone to unpredictable malfunctions. This instability can manifest in various ways, such as rapid aging, sudden organ failure, temporary loss of biological functions, or the development of genetic illnesses. While the effects are temporary, they can strike without warning, leaving you vulnerable in critical moments. 

Purchasing this once will result in relatively nonlethal issues, such as temporary weakness or random pains. Each additional purchase either introduces new symptoms or increases the severity of existing ones.
objects.title: Genetic Instability

rows.title: Mutations
rows.titleText: This is a section where you choose Mutations which are various biological attributes and capabilities. If a Trait you have contradicts a Mutation you take, the Mutation trumps said trait.

objects.text: The exterior of your chassis is covered with a nanomaterial capable of changing color.
objects.title: Chameleon Skin

objects.text: An engineering nano-hive is embedded in your chassis allowing you to manufacture objects less than 30dm<sup>3</sup> in size.
objects.title: Engineer Swarm Hive

objects.text: A repair nano-hive is embedded in your chassis allowing you to repair yourself and other machines.
objects.title: Repair Swarm Hive

objects.text:
Flowing throughout your body is a network of nanites with one purpose. These nanites will alter the mechanical components of your body to adapt to and remain in sync with any new upgrades and changes your body might experience.

As an example, say you integrate a gun with a lot of recoil into your hand without changing anything else about your body, this module would make those changes for you. Making the rest your arm better at compensating for recoil and maybe some changes to your legs so you can brace against the ground better.

These changes even extend to compensating for biological changes a Construct might experience. Like say a Construct’s biological components changed species from human to a centaur due to a mutagen they were exposed to, their mechanical components would shift and alter themselves to remain compatible with their new physiology.

The adaptations these nanites can make to your mechanical components are based on your own engineering knowledge, or if you have no engineering knowledge capable of modifying your body effectively the modifications the nanites make will be based on the same technology that made your body. 

The speed in which these nanites can make changes to your body is impressive equalizent to thousands of man hours a second all focused on altering your mechanical components. 

However these nanites are only capable of making the simple functional changes to your body, not highly complex changes, and can’t make mass out of nothing. So if you’re a Tinker and have access to resources the changes you can make to yourself will almost certainly outperform these nanites even if it takes longer.

These nanites do not make constant alterations to your body, as soon as they arrive at a “good enough” solution to your body’s current needs that is what they’ll stick to until your body is modified further.

These alterations will be focused on your internals, making little to no changes to your outward appearance.
objects.title: Reactive Modification Swarm

objects.text: One or more of your limbs have access to a multitool that unfolds from a small pod.
objects.title: Multitool

objects.text:
Your technological knowledge now goes slightly beyond the ability to maintain yourself. You know how every component of your body works, how to make replacements for those components, along with technology that further supports your existence such as a basic automatic repair bay, and the tools needed to create that repair bay and the components of your body. 

This module works as an excellent starting point for building up your own tech base such that, with enough resources and time you might be able to make a decent impression of a Tinker.

If you have the technological know how the repair bays you can build also serve as an excellent tool for modifying your body; removing modules, replacing modules, modifying modules, even adding new ones.
objects.title: Self Sufficient

objects.text:
Your design is modular, essentially any and all non critical systems like limbs, outer armor, and optics were built to make removal and replacement simple and easy. 

Get an optic damaged and need to have it replaced before your next combat encounter? A simple fifteen second job so long as you know what you’re doing and have a replacement prepared. 

This has uses beyond simplicity in repair as it also allows you to easily and rapidly modify your body for different situations by just replacing parts of your body with parts already built with that situation in mind.
objects.title: Modular

objects.text: One or more of your limbs have digits that split in a fractal giving you the ability to manipulate things on a nanoscopic scale.
objects.title: Fractal Digits

objects.text: A non-lethal weapon is mounted to your chassis (remote taser, microwave emitter, etc.), either embedded inside one of your limbs or mounted to your body with a pod.
objects.title: Non-lethal Weapon Mount

objects.text: A lethal weapon is mounted to your chassis, either embedded inside one of your limbs or mounted to your body with a pod.
objects.title: Lethal Weapon Mount

objects.text: Your outer armor is reinforced with a hardened carbon alloy that makes it resistant to most low and medium-caliber weapons.
objects.title: Reinforced Armor

objects.text:
Your main body contains an interface that human sized life can enter and pilot you through. If your main body is a building sized mecha this might be an actual pilot seat, if you’re too small to contain a pilot seat maybe you can fold around a pilot like a suit of Iron Man armor.

While you don’t necessarily have to follow the commands of whoever is plugged into this interface, working together with them in “synch” will increase your capabilities by freeing up mental processes you can devote to other tasks.
objects.title: Pilot Seat

objects.text: Your chassis is equipped with a secondary cortex, giving it enhanced computational power and storage.
objects.title: Secondary Cortex

objects.text: Your chassis is equipped with a secondary reactor providing additional power and allows it to support more modules.
objects.title: Secondary Reactor

objects.text: Your chassis uses special folding technology that allows more efficient use of space.
objects.title: Folding System

objects.text:
You are not mere basic metal and circuitry instead a living metal that has its own DNA forms the very foundation of your mechanical body. 

This gives you a few benefits, notably every piece of this living metal can passively heal and maintain itself with access to adequate energy and supplies just like organic tissue.

The way this living metal communicates with itself across your body also increases the amount of functionality that your body can have. Essentially your body has no need for cables and other such methods to transmit instructions to the various modules and components of your body. This is because living metal in addition to its other capabilities can be used as a medium to transmit information and instruments to other pieces of living metal and technology if it is physically connected to either, all while being used to form the frame, armor, or even the entirety of your body.

It is also possible to adapt certain gene mods and genetic enhancements to work on your living metal DNA.

Any modifications and upgrades that are made to your body out of ordinary inorganic materials and aren’t rejected as harmful to you will slowly be converted into this living metal.
objects.title: Techno-Organic

objects.text: Your chassis is equipped with an advanced communications module allowing you to listen, intercept, and modify signals. This also installs a universal port to connect to systems physically.
objects.title: Advanced Communications Module

objects.text: You possess an advanced scanning system capable of obtaining a large array of information about your environment. It allows you to listen in to conversations from far away, scan through clothes and even bodies to detect all manners of devices or weapons, etc.
objects.title: Advanced Scanner

objects.text: Your optics are enhanced and capable of perceiving a wider band of the electromagnetic spectrum (IR and UV).
objects.title: Enhanced Vision

objects.text: Your optics are enhanced and capable of perceiving matter on a nanoscopic scale.
objects.title: Nanoscopic Vision

objects.text: You have an additional articulated limb.
objects.title: Additional Limbs (Articulated)

objects.text: You have an additional prehensile limb.
objects.title: Additional Limbs (Prehensile)

objects.text:
Your physiology includes some method of flight whether that be wings on your back, or thrusters on your limbs; you are free to choose within reason. Each purchase improves the effectiveness of this flight method. 

At 1 purchase your flight is comparable to a jet pack. At 5 purchases you might be able to single-handedly fly to Mercury from Earth in only a few days even without Tinker Construction or Esoteric Construction.
objects.title: Flight System

objects.text: Your consciousness is now hosted within a Quantum Brain, guaranteeing immunity to memory corruption or personality loss resulting from hardware changes.
objects.title: Quantum Brain

objects.text: A humanoid torso is attached to your main body.
objects.title: Humanoid Torso

objects.text: Your main body is twice as large.
objects.title: Large Chassis

objects.text:
Your mind is spread across multiple bodies, each with a back up Positronic Brain in case the original body dies. While you are able to pilot all these bodies at once, it doesn’t come with any multitasking abilities.

Every purchase gives you 1 additional body.
objects.title: Swarm Body

objects.text: Whoever designed and built you spent more time improving the efficiency of the technology that composes your body, reducing the size of individual components without affecting their capabilities allowing more modules to be added to your body overall.
objects.title: Efficient Design

objects.text: Whoever designed and built you spent more time improving the effectiveness of the technology that composes your body, improving the capabilities of all other modules you might’ve purchased except for Efficient Design by 10% per purchase.
objects.title: Effective Design

rows.title: Robot Modules
rows.titleText: Those modules integrate into your chassis and provide additional features.

objects.text: This module improves your EWAR capabilities, allowing you to infiltrate many computer systems with ease. Tinker-hardened networks will still give you a difficult time.
objects.title: Electronic Warfare

objects.text: This module allows you to have multiple parallel instances of your consciousness within a single process.
objects.title: Threads

objects.text: This module allows you to have instances of yourself. Those instances are complete copies of yourself at the time of the fork. It is possible to seamlessly merge forks as well as to combine them into a single instance.
objects.title: Fork

objects.text: You have no Shard. You may not take any powers and some Perks will be restricted to you.
objects.title: No Powers

objects.text:
Your powers come from a Shard, a symbiotic piece of a great crystalline worm ‘entity’ searching for the solution to Entropy.

Below, you will be able to select what Entity your Shard came from, their specific benefits and limitations, and the rank of your Shard within the Entity.
objects.title: Shard

objects.text: You become an Entity. This opens the Entity Section. By default, you are a newborn Entity, possessing only the most basic and fundamental systems an Entity requires to exist. You are vast, you are powerful, and you are at the very beginning of what you could become. Any Shard Power you take from the Shard Powers section will become a cluster of Shards dedicated to creating variants of that power, ranging from lesser versions to greater expressions depending on your Technology and Prototype clusters. Tier 3 powers will give the most variants and shards.
objects.title: Entity

objects.text:
Your powers do not come from a Shard but from an artifact in your possession. You can only select powers from the Objects of Power category. Some Perks and Drawbacks may be restricted.

You have at least a basic and instinctive understanding of your artifacts nature and how to use its abilities, if not necessarily all the different ways they can be used creatively.

Note that all artifacts inherently have compatibility with powers of any kind. Artifacts are also inherently negentropic and whiteboxed.
objects.title: Artifact

objects.text:
Your powers do not come from a Shard but from another source like your genetics, soul, and the like. You can only select powers from the Shardless category. Some Perks and Drawbacks may be restricted.

You have at least a basic and instinctive understanding of your powers nature and how to use them, if not necessarily all the different ways they can be used creatively.  

Note that all Shardless powers inherently have compatibility with powers of any kind. Shardless powers are also inherently negentropic and whiteboxed. 

You can choose whether all your powers are distinct or facets of a greater whole, in either case, they will be able to affect each other and/or synergize together unless explicitly stated. Over time, the synergies can change or reinforce depending on how your powers grow.
objects.title: Shardless

objects.text: Your powers do not come from a Shard, but rather a Patron that empowers you in return for fulfilling their desires or commands. You can select powers from both the Shard and Shardless section. Some Perks and Drawbacks may be restricted. Patrons are divided into Cosmic and Symbiotic Patrons. Cosmic Patrons are powerful higher entities that grant power in exchange for doing their bidding, following their tenets and acting as their agents, having a degree of influence over your actions. Symbiotic Patrons are weaker entities that work in concert with you in a mutually beneficial relationship. You have at least a basic understanding of your powers' nature and how to use them, if not necessarily all the different ways they can be used creatively. Below, you will be able to select what Patron has given you your powers, their specific benefits, tenets, and limitations, and whether it is Symbiotic or Cosmic in nature. Note that all Patron powers inherently have compatibility with powers of any kind. Patron powers are also inherently negentropic and whiteboxed. You can choose whether all your powers are distinct or facets of a greater whole, in either case, they will be able to affect each other and/or synergize together unless explicitly stated. Over time, the synergies can change or reinforce depending on how your powers grow.
objects.title: Patron

rows.title: Powers Origin
rows.titleText: Powers are granted either through connecting to shards of the entities or by a supernatural source. Depending on the type you select, different powers will be available to you.

objects.text: The Artifact(s) in your possession holds power(s) akin to those granted by a Shard. This opens the Shard Power section.
objects.title: Essence of Shard

objects.text: The Artifact(s) in your possession holds power(s) very different to those granted by a Shard. This opens the Shardless Power section.
objects.title: Essence of Shardless

objects.text: "Stand proud, for you are strong. Stand proud, for you are indomitable. Stand proud for you are right." What is a greater power than humanity's unrelenting will? That is what the Taurus presides over. It is a being that appears in different forms depending on the follower, mostly based on their greatest desires. It could be a motherly figure, urging its child to keep moving forward. It could be a literal giant bull, demanding the strength of its beneficiary. Or it could even be an unseen urge, firing you up and making you want to go go GO! It seems to be most attracted to folks in a tight spot or at their lowest. Could it be that's the reason it seeked you out? However it manifests, only its benefactee(s) could sense it, to the point that they almost seem to be drawn to one another, be it in partnership or in battle. To an outsider's perspective however, one could almost see a crown of horns manifesting on those it had attached to, only to disappear as they blink. The mark of the horned beast on which lands are razed for its desires. Despite its rather dogmatic followers, it could be surprising to some to hear that the Bull is a rather Neutral force. It does not care how selfish or selfless your desires are. It only asks for you to commit to it. To give all you can to fulfilling what it is you chose to stand for. And it will not tolerate you faltering. You have chosen your ideals, you cannot back down. Compromise is for the weak, and you are not weak. What the Taurus provides its followers is simple, the ability to defy Death itself. No, it is not instant regeneration, but you are able to hold onto life long enough to potentially get healed. You are basically too angry to die. At least, unless you are unable to stay determined enough to keep on going. The Bull shall let you go and pass away once you find yourself truly satisfied. Otherwise, Taurus gives its stalwart soldiers higher endurance, their skins literally hardening to keep themselves from getting major damage. Better yet, these boons proove even more effective when you're in a pinch, giving you the comeback you need to turn the tides of conflict into your favor. You are one of the bullwarks this patron is known for. Heck, a lot of its followers take on a berserker approach in combat, combining their anger with their blessings to just never back down. There is great cost to finding your will waver however. You will weaken, not just in terms of losing your benefits, but also, physically. You will suddenly be awash with fatigue, lowering your vitality the moment you begin to question your ideals. At worse, you could even get sick, with the very worse cases causing an unfortunate follower to waste away into dust. Death finally claiming them. So, little one, are you willing enough to fight for what you believe in? Or are you just gonna give up? The choice is always yours.
objects.title: ♉ Taurus - The Bullwark of Beliefs

objects.text:
Gemini, the Twins biting each other's tails are a singular duo in a grand cosmic war game facing each other-themselves. Being the same being as much as they are separate, Pollux and Castor each divide the universe into set binaries in order to use them to beat the other in a grand game from which they are at once eternal loser and victor.

The twins look to their empowered as enablers in this war, capable of using them to ‘strike’ against their other. Making small changes and great ripples in order to affect the other’s strategies and options. These range from Pollox demanding the annihilation of a local faction to deny the resources to its twin, or Castor needing a road to be built along exact co-ordinates to facilitate a later move. 

However, with each needing to use the same tools in their subordinates, they will often give demands at the same time to the same one. Both Pollux and Castor are rather transparent that when ignored or subverted they are likely to respond by actively reducing abilities, creating coincidences, and making minor changes in causality that grow as their demands are ignored. 

Meanwhile they both offer the inverse, as well as a measure of protection from the other, to varying degrees. Thus the role of their servants is primarily in balancing their demands or becoming too crucial to one for the other to be allowed to affect them too harshly.
objects.title: ♊ Gemini - Twins Chasing Each Others Tails

objects.text: "Your people shall spread like dandelions to the wind." Cancer is a disease, a multiversal mutation that spreads across several worlds, propagating until it potentially fully takes over. And you are its first host in its universal conquest. The Cancer appears as an alien crystalline avatar, showing itself in dreams or visions to followers and potential hosts. Its physical form is a purple gem inside a meteor that had landed in your chosen world long before you entered. It should be around your starting location should you wish to look for it. Though maybe you should leave it alone. Let it do its thing, which is offering power to folks like you. This patron only wants one thing, which is to keep spreading. To gain more hosts by any means necessary. To do so, it needs you and others to place it in contact to anybody who could potentially accept its deal. As such, its followers tend to be desperate folks with something lacking in their lives which Cancer promises to provide. Whether it be an amputee given a crystal arm or somebody who feels alone given a crystal companion, etc. This is how this creature keeps multiplying, by preying into the desires of many. What this patron gives is the ability to create the crystals it is made out of. Not only could this potentially help in combat through crystal generation, it also gives you regeneration capabilities, with your wounded areas hardening into crystals that would later fall off once you're fully regenerated. You are its precious host after all. It needs you healthy. Plus, you can potentially sell these crystals as amethysts for a pretty penny. This Patron's gifts are with you forevermore, even if someone were to try to destroy its initial source. Why though? It's not like it turns you into a crystal monster or anything. Soon there should be walking crystal folk all around. What's not to love? Of course, you have to keep helping it spread. Throughout your lifespan, you simply have to spread its shards discreetly, in case some folks may want to stop you (again, why though?). Failure or refusal to do so will cause your body to slowly shut down, petrifying you, and then little by little, turning you into a mere unfeeling crystal. A living rock. A fate worse than death. This patron does not take kindly to insubordination. It will spread, and it will keep spreading, whether you like it or not.
objects.title: ♋ Cancer - The Eternal Expansion

objects.text: “A king must burn brighter than all others, for the crown belongs only to those who roar their truth. To live as anything less than what you are is treason against your very soul.” Leo, the Lion, does not hide what he is, nor does he permit others to do so. He demands that those who follow him cast aside self-delusion and live as sovereign expressions of their own calling. For Leo, no tragedy is greater than a soul dimming itself in chains of falsehood. Kingship, to Leo, is not dominion over others but mastery of the self. It is living without apology, laughing without restraint, raging without disguise, and pursuing the full excellence and terribleness of your nature. The heart’s truth is the only crown worth wearing; to deny it, to clothe yourself in masks and half-measures, is the basest cowardice. Where other patrons whisper laws, Leo roars a challenge: be your truest, most extreme self. If you are a healer, heal without timidity or restraint. If you are a fighter, strike like it is the last dawn you will see.If you are a scientist, pursue discovery as if you will personally set foot on new worlds. None of this is moralizing; it is a call to abandon petty social hedges, cowardly half-truths, and false modesties. Dance publicly. Savor loudly. To follow Leo is to live as if the world were a stage and every act an act of kingship. Toward this end, Leo demands no single creed, for he recognizes that truth differs for each heart. Instead, he demands integrity of self regardless of what others think or demand, and this must also extend to your powers. A rationalist must not profane their science with spells and charms. A dreamer must not bind their wonder into circuits and gears. A guardian must not wield power to wound, but to protect and uplift. The Lion judges each by their own inner law and their loyalty to it. To follow Leo is to burn with the fullness of your being, so that others may see you and be inspired to burn as well. Leo rewards the faithful with the fire of kingship. Their strength, charisma, and vitality blaze brighter the more earnestly they embody themselves. Their voice compels attention, their laughter carries courage, and their wrath shakes the resolve of enemies. Powers also grow in harmony with a followers true calling: a scientist’s insight leaps into genius, a dreamer’s visions crystallize from air, a healer’s touch soothes beyond mortal means. They stride through the world like kings, embodying themselves so fully that others cannot help but follow. But those who betray their truth are scourged by the Lion’s roar. Magic collapses in the hands of the rationalist. The dreamer’s machines rust into failure. The healer who wounds finds their own flesh struck with reflected pain. These punishments are not curses but mirrors, the falsehood consuming itself. The longer the mask is worn, the harsher the reflection, until the pretender is stripped bare. Leo’s influence is ever-present, a constant pressure at the edge of thought. He does not whisper, nor tempt. His chosen feel the roar in their marrow, a pressure that demands alignment. To live in truth is to feel exultant, alive, invincible. To live in falsehood is to feel hunted, each breath trembling under the weight of hypocrisy. There is no middle ground: one either roars with the Lion, or is drowned beneath his voice.
objects.title: ♌ Leo – The Lion Who Roars True

objects.text: "I am that which lies between Art and Artifice, I am the space between the stars and the void between thought. Cogito Ergo Non Sum; I Think, Therefore I Am Not," All things have their time and their place in an eternal set of infinite binaries. It is the duty of Libra, The Cosmic Scale to ensure one does not overtake the other. It’s an observer with its hands in all places. To Libra all things are rightly and uniquely bound to an opposite force whether knowingly or not. It has claimed to be older than all, choosing hands across worlds and universes so far apart there’s no word for the distance, and that it knows what should and must be. Its hands are in all great things, tweaking and correcting for the ‘correct’ outcome, shaping the void in order for something to fill the position it has created, altering the fly to change the hurricane. It is as it is and has no room for the creature comforts of compassion or spite. Maybe it never has. It selects its hands for their use. Their binary taken and empowered, to correct as its fingers where the sheer weight of Libra would crush the tapestry its weaving. The pair act together or not at all, two hands to touch two fingers to pinch. Such is its want. Libra’s command is simple, to follow its’ direction no matter how esoteric, to be loyal hands that act to fulfil what is/has/should be. Its reasoning is rarely explained, assumed to be incomprehensible, or at least inscrutable. It does not care what the hand thinks, what it says, how it twitches and fidgets as long as its task is done. These tasks come in many forms, hollow sentences spoken from hands’ own mouths, dream-visions while awake, impossible coincidences in print errors communicating in a 1987 copy of Crime and Punishment, and stranger besides. These tasks come inconsistently, sometimes going months between messages and sometimes coming multiple times a week. They also range drastically in how demanding they are, some being simple as moving a specific leaf, others involving widescale terraforming and intense effort. However, these tasks will never be beyond your capabilities, and more dramatic tasks may even call multiple hands into proximity to carry them out. Libra’s reward for its hands is simple and twofold, firstly noninterference. It allows them to do as they will until they are needed and simply enjoy the power they've been given. Secondly, freedom from their binary. While their corollary may well be another hand (and perhaps even nearby), they are not bound to them so strictly, both a philosophical kind of freedom from their pairs and an assurance they wont end up endangering Libra's path through accident or consequence. Should its hands fail to perform their tasks however, it is far from forgiving. It begins somewhat subtle, misfortune and ‘urging’ in order to push its hand to the correct track once again, but if a hand should remain disobedient, unruly, and convulsive, then it is time for the Binary to reammerge. In extremis, Libra will send the other hand that was formerly bound with its troublesome partner to either correct their behaviour, or in extremis, ‘excise’ the hand entirely.
objects.title: ♎ Libra - Architect of What Is Not

objects.text:
Scorpio, the Secret Keeper, is a relatively young being, a cosmic child born on the still-warm corpse of a dead star. In the silence of that birth, it opened its many eyes and beheld the universe in all its vastness. Overwhelmed by beauty and mystery, it felt one emotion above all others: curiosity. In that moment, it decided what it would become. A collector, hoarder of that most precious resource: information.

The Secret Keeper appears as a colossal scorpion, its exoskeleton having a blue, iridescent colouring, usually seen half-submerged in a pool of abyssal water. The pool is not liquid, but memory made visible, within its depths flicker fragmented scenes, blurred voices, and untold truths reflected as dreams. Its shell glistens with the sheen of knowing, shifting in color as new secrets are absorbed and old ones protected.

Scorpio wants one thing, always and endlessly: secrets. It demands from its followers every intimate detail, their past, their fears, their mistakes, their truest selves. Then it pushes further, insisting they gather secrets from the world around them. Political whispers, concealed crimes, buried traumas, hidden names, all are treasures to the Keeper. It has been called a busybody, a gossip, and a snoop. Only the first and last accusation is accurate. Scorpio never shares what it learns. To it, information is only valuable if no one else has it. 
 
Scorpio demands two things of its followers. First, they must vanish into anonymity. Their identity must be hidden: name, face, past, even their emotional core. All must be shrouded. The less others know, the stronger Scorpio’s hold. The Keeper alone must know them truly, their secret self is part of its collection. Second, they must gather secrets. The fewer who know a thing, the more value it holds. There is no formal system, but Scorpio keeps a yearly quota. If too little is offered, it becomes… irritable.

And when Scorpio is displeased, it targets what it values most: information. Failing followers find pieces of themselves vanishing, temporarily but painfully. Skills vanish. Names fade. Memories blur. The greater the shortfall, the greater the damage. It never erases permanently, Scorpio would never destroy secrets it already owns but it withholds them. The pain of being cut off from yourself, even briefly, is a lesson not soon forgotten. And yet it grants its followers profound gifts.

Those bonded to the Keeper gain a terrifying knack for cold reading, the ability to infer deep truths from scraps of information. A glance, a hesitation, a word choice, all become data. Their minds race silently, filling in gaps with impossible precision. Given the smallest input, they can often predict outcomes before they unfold. They also gain the ability to split their focus in impossible ways. Unlike ordinary multitasking, which divides attention, Scorpio’s gift duplicates it. A single follower may fully track multiple conversations, movements, or pieces of data at once, as if their mind lives in layers, each perfectly attentive, each perfectly calm. 

But the strongest gift Scorpio bestows is the power to shroud information itself. A follower may, for a time, suppress the very concept of their presence by erasing information of themselves from others. Those affected cannot perceive them, comprehend their existence, or consciously act in response to them.
objects.title: ♏ Scorpio – The Secret Keeper

objects.text: "The desire for more. The wish for things to be better. The dreams of those unbroken by the world. The endless whimsy of those who refuse to grow up. The ultimate expression of hopelessly hopeful delusions that consume the mind." All beings dream. Even the darkest heart hides a flicker of wonder, a fragile hope that things might yet be brighter. The Bleeding Star nurtures this spark as it gallops endlessly across the cosmos, scattering its golden blood into waiting souls, awakening slumbering flames of longing, wonderment, and possibility. It often blesses those buried in the depths of despair, gifting them HOPE—its strange and eldritch concept of it at least. The broken find themselves stitched together with dreamlight, reshaped by visions of new horizons. Yet the gift is fickle: what mends one heart may shatter another, drowning them in delusions and dreamscapes from which they may never return. As the beacon of HOPE, the Bleeding Star becomes your compass—your North Star—revealing the underlying chaos and madness of reality whilst guiding you through it with inspiration, creativity, and imagination. It allows you to glimpse patterns within disorder, to make sense of things even when you do not fully understand them. Its light infuses your limbs with strength enough to keep moving, burning brightest when despair weighs heaviest. And others, witnessing your defiance, find their own hope rekindled—for even the faintest ember can set the world aflame. The Bleeding Star's command is simple: never stagnate. Dream, desire, explore, and create. Kindle the dormant sparks of hope in others, nurture their dreams, and lift them when they fall—all while indulging in revelry. Gallop ever onward in pursuit of the impossible, chasing wonder without end. But if you falter—if despair is allowed to fester—the Bleeding Star will "correct" you, twisting your mind toward madness in its relentless effort to preserve whimsy. However, just as easily, unchecked indulgence may blaze into delusion, drowning you in another kind of madness. In such moments, the mind becomes a prism of fantasy, every thought refracting into impossible visions, every desire spiraling further from the world of stone and soil. To be blessed by the Bleeding Star is to forever walk the boundary between dream and delirium, between wonder and ruin. And as one of its chosen, you will also find yourself utterly averse to enduring tasks you once found mundane or tedious, ever drawn toward new desires, ever compelled to wander in pursuit of dreams forevermore
objects.title: ♐ Sagittarius - Bleeding Star of Hope

objects.text:
Capricorn, the Pitying Observer, is a presence that stands outside the tides of history. It claims to have watched the birth and extinction of civilizations across uncounted worlds and eons, always noting the same trajectory: hierarchy ossifies into oppression, power decays into corruption, and those desperate to preserve life inevitably wield death as their instrument. To Capricorn, no culture is unique, no destiny divergent. There is only the recursion of failure, spiraling endlessly. From this conclusion, it regards all living beings with cold pity, convinced they are doomed to repeat flaws they cannot shed.

Rarely does the Observer intrude upon the mortal plane. When it manifests, it does so as a singular, all-encompassing eye, its pupil composed of endless fractal pupils nested within each other. More often, it is encountered indirectly: as a fleeting whisper, a vision half-seen, or an impression at the edge of perception. Capricorn prides itself on distance, never deigning to act directly, shaping events instead through the hands of others. Its detachment is framed as dignity, though in truth it is rooted in disdain. Its pity is not compassionate but arrogant. It only ever acknowledges its own positives, ignoring its own flaws while doing the opposite to all other things.

Capricorn’s command is to watch, not to act. Its chosen are instructed to witness, record, and comprehend without becoming entangled in the struggles of mortals more than necessity demands. If interference cannot be avoided, it must be carried out subtly, with the lightest of touches, leaving no visible hand upon the weave of fate. To serve the Observer is not to avert the inevitable, but to bear witness to its unfolding.

The Observer also urges its followers to mirror its worldview: to perceive corruption as inevitable, to understand that every structure will decay, and to accept that the cycle cannot be broken. This perspective is framed not as despair but as clarity: freedom from the burden of false hopes and illusions.
 
The voice of Capricorn comes in subtle forms: impressions that sharpen into intuition, whispers in the mind that dissolve on recollection, or moments where the senses bloom into impossible clarity. These experiences carry with them an intoxicating sense of detachment, as though standing above the world, untouchable by its noise.

Through these visions, Capricorn nudges its chosen toward obedience. A whisper may urge hesitation at the perfect moment, allowing an enemy to reveal their own corruption. Sudden clarity might draw attention to the hidden flaw in a leader’s words, seeding doubt where once there was loyalty. An inexplicable certainty may guide a follower to observe rather than intervene, so that they record failure instead of preventing it. Each gift feels like insight freely gained, but in truth, it is the Observer’s hand shaping perception, ensuring its servants act, or refrain from acting, in ways that preserve its doctrine of witness and inevitability.

Those bonded to Capricorn gain perception beyond natural bounds. Eyes trace details invisible to others, ears catch whispers carried across vast distances, and minds dissect information with precision bordering on the inhuman. Memory hardens into permanence, patterns reveal themselves effortlessly, and insight strikes like lightning without conscious effort.

These gifts extend to any powers tied to perception or cognition, heightening them to their utmost potential. Lies, illusions, and hidden dangers become transparent, while even the faintest ripple in the environment can be discerned. The more one observes, records, and reflects, the stronger these abilities become.

Capricorn also grants endurance across time itself. Followers age with extraordinary slowness, their vitality preserved so they may witness the long cycles of rise and collapse as the Observer does. This longevity is paired with a stillness of being, a resistance to physical change, manipulation, and decay. Time itself struggles to erode what Capricorn preserves.

Capricorn does not punish defiance with overt wrath. Instead, it sinks its weight into the mind of the transgressor. Those who abandon its tenets and act boldly find themselves burdened by an ever-growing sense of futility. Joy becomes muted, ambition erodes, and every effort feels meaningless. The harder they resist, the heavier this nihilism becomes, until the follower abandons their cause not from external command, but from the conviction that nothing matters.

This influence is not permanent. Should the follower return to the Observer’s path , such as withdrawing from interference and resuming their role as witness, the weight slowly recedes, restoring the quiet detachment that Capricorn demands.
objects.title: ♑ Capricorn – The Pitying Observer

objects.text:
At some unknowable moment in space, a black hole died. In its death throes, it erupted into a supernova that birthed a Beast. The Ever-Striking Ram tore forward, gouging furrows in the stillness of the explosion that birthed it, with horns that glowed gold in the formless dark.

Aries was a Beast of Motion itself, made flesh in the form of a colossal golden-scaled dragon, ever wreathed in flame, crowned by the massive curling horns of a ram. Where its hooves strike, inertia breaks. Wherever it passes, the flow of entropy unravels, made new again. It is a wanderer that inspires and burns, pushing the world to keep up.

It seeks no worship and its desire is simple: forward motion. The more a follower begins, and the more earnestly they push toward new frontiers, in mind, form, or deed, the more Aries entwines with them. Not all beginnings are sacred, but all beginnings invite it. To be a vessel for Aries is to carry dozens of sparks inside you, each tied to a specific endeavor, each glowing brighter the further you walk from the known.

The Ever-Striking Ram grants its followers the Spark of Initiation, a living, internal spark that flares each time something new is genuinely undertaken. It can be anything, a new hobby, a new lesson, a new skill or even a variation of a skill already learned. The follower feels a surge of energy, clarity, drive, and talent, guided by instinct and adrenaline. This extends to any power you have, especially so when used in new ways.
 
Each separate endeavor earns its own spark, a distinct thread of divine favor. The more you begin, and the more you push what you begin into uncharted space, the stronger the presence of Aries becomes. These sparks, however, are not permanent. After the initial surge, they begin to fade, and returning you back to your base capabilities. But they can burn brightly again, reset to their original strength, when you innovate: using the same skill in a new way, creating or learning a new variation, or improving it at its foundation.

The sparks interact with one another. A project begun in solitude may feed a decision in battle. An idea nurtured in musing may grant instinct in negotiation. The Ram sees no boundary between disciplines, only between movement and stillness.

The Ever-Striking Ram also blesses any skill or power you have, making it have no true bottleneck. It can grow in endless amounts of ways, you only need to find them. Any weakness or limitations they once had can be fixed, as long as you put in the effort. However, the bigger the weakness and limitations they have, the harder it is to overcome them.

The Ever-Striking Ram grows symbiotically with the follower. It responds to initiative, but thrives on progression. Starting is not enough, each flame must be stoked by pushing boundaries. Stagnation causes the patron’s voice to fade, like a signal lost in fog. Renewal comes only with further reach.

Aries grows in three dimensions:

Flamecount – the number of distinct sparks the follower carries (i.e., meaningful new undertakings).

Depth of Pursuit – how far each spark is pushed into unknown terrain.

Fervor – how fully the follower commits, regardless of success.

As each of these dimensions grows, so too does the boon of The Ever-Striking Ram: each spark lasting longer, burning brighter, and interacting more powerfully between each other.
objects.title: ♈️ Aries - The Ever-Striking Ram

objects.text:
In an unknown forest, in an unknown time, a presence stirred. A small spirit was born, and with its birth it gained a yearning for a partner. It was a being that sought to be bound to one soul alone. This was the Maiden — a fae spirit woven from devotion itself.

The Maiden does push her will upon many. She appears quietly, as one being’s mirror and keeper, manifesting as the idealized partner her chosen perceives. Only the bonded one may see her fully, though her influence weaves unseen around them. She exists not as a goddess of conquest, but as a personal covenant: eternal companionship, sharpened by exchange.

Her pact is simple. The Maiden asks for gifts: not trinkets or tokens, but things that hum with power, history, or invention. A relic, a legendary weapon, a piece of masterful craft, an advanced machine, even a book of rare truths — to her, all are sustenance. Each gift becomes a seed of transformation, a lens through which her boon flows. The nature of the offering shapes the nature of her enhancement. A relic of war may sharpen the follower’s reflexes and strength; a tome of rare knowledge may refine their insight and broaden their memory; a crafted device may grant intuition with tools and machines; an heirloom of lineage may cloak them in authority or presence. What is given becomes transmuted, mirrored through the Maiden’s devotion, until its essence entwines with her chosen.
 
The strength of the boon grows with the significance of the offering. Minor treasures stir only gentle echoes: a clearer mind, a steadier hand, a flicker of intuition. Greater relics blaze like beacons within the bond, infusing the follower with profound capability and causing the Maiden’s form to become more vivid, more tangible, more present. In time, with relics of true weight, she can walk beside her chosen like a partner in flesh, even able to become visible to others.

Her gifts do not fade, for her faithfulness does not falter. Every relic offered, no matter how small or great, becomes a permanent thread in the tapestry of her follower’s power. The bond only grows richer, deeper, more intricate with time.

Virgo thrives not only on the act of giving but on the intimacy of presence. The more her chosen calls upon her, speaks with her, and leans upon her counsel, the stronger the thread becomes. Her devotion deepens with each hour of shared solitude, each moment of reliance, each act of trust. When gift and intimacy converge, she does not merely grant enhancements but begins to weave her follower’s abilities together, boosting synergies or creating new ones.
objects.title: ♍️ Virgo – The Ever-Faithful Maiden

objects.text:
Aquarius, the Endless Current, seeps into you and blends with your body and mind until you and the water move as one. It speaks in soft ripples — a pull in your blood, a rush in your breath, a whisper of waves in half-remembered dreams.

Aquarius was not planned, not destined — just a ripple born from the chaos of forming stars, a wandering accident of creation. Too small to shape galaxies, too fragile to exist without a host, it survived by slipping into living vessels, stitching itself into breath and blood.

Aquarius is tied to the rhythm of your heart. What begins as a shimmer in your veins becomes a current that moves with all your moves and change with you. To carry the Current is to join in this endless motion. Stillness is its enemy; it pushes you onward, always toward change and renewal. Old walls need to break, heavy chains must dissolve, and what was stagnant is swept away to make space for something new.

Its waters make you more than mortal. Wounds close as if rinsed clean, poisons wash out of your blood, and fatigue drifts away like mist under sunlight. Your movements carry the strength of tides — hard to resist, impossible to hold down. Blades slide aside as though caught in unseen streams, while your own strikes land with momentum greater than your body alone. In time, you may bend rivers, call rains, calm storms, or even shape the elements as if the cosmos itself flows through your hands.
 
The bond deepens as you move and grow. At first, Aquarius is no more than a glimmer in your blood, a quiet dream of oceans under alien skies. But with each change, each broken barrier, its voice grows stronger. You and the Current become one — a living tide born of water and starlight, carrying both destruction and renewal wherever you move.
objects.title: ♒ Aquarius – The Endless Current

objects.text:
Fractal colonies are composed of thousands or even millions of minor cosmic entities working together as one organism. Individually, each member of the colony is weak and often hyper-specialized, but their ability to synchronize makes the powers they can manifest while working in concert greater than the sum of their parts. These colonies exist in the space between dimensions, where they can blend with the weak exotic energies that ebb and flow in the void to hide from predators. When two colonies meet in the void, they will often exchange members and information to alleviate their weaknesses and as well as spread new discoveries. As a result, colonies are generally well-rounded in terms of powers.

When a host bonds with a colony, the resultant powers are often multi-faceted and their mutation potential is greatly heightened. Your powers start out slightly stronger and more versatile than described. However, the main advantage of symbiosis with a fractal colony is that your powers grow horizontally, allowing them to manifest new and varied functions or abilities, alleviate weaknesses, improve efficiency, and more over time.

You are also able to offload cognitive tasks to the colony – such as processing sensory inputs or automate the use of certain powers to, for example, create an automated defense – and benefit from its distributed nature to increase your analytical intelligence and memory. In general fractal colonies are beings of logic and instinct, blank slates devoid of personality and character. However, as you spend time bonded with the colony, it will slowly develop into its own person, taking traits that mirror or complement your own, adapting to become the perfect partner.

While the colony exists in the dimensional void, it is also able to shift into other layers of reality when needed and some of its members are able to project a material form in the same layer you occupy. Their size and appearance vary greatly, from undulating strands the size of a worm to polyhedral shapes the size of a volleyball. All of the projections are able to float and move around, their speed is limited to around 10 km/h. However, these projections are fragile and can be shattered with relatively little force. The total mass that can be projected is roughly equivalent to the average adult human.

Your bonded colony naturally grows over time as it collects small amounts of exotic energies around you. naturally more abundant than in the dimensional void, using the bond as a conduit. Some areas are more rich in certain types of energies, the best sources are other parahumans – which release exotic energies as they use their powers – and dimensional nexuses – points where multiple layers of reality intersect with each-other. The latter are the perfect location to create a nursery, a place where your colony can nest and hatch new members in relative safety, which allows your colony to rapidly grow in strength until the nexus destabilizes. However, nexuses are incredibly rare and sought after by all matters of dimensional entities, so you might have to fight for control of one and defend it while your colony nests.
objects.title: ♓ Pisces - The Fractal Colony

objects.text:
Your power comes from the Warrior Entity.
- Your power pushes you toward conflict and can alter your personality.
+ You instinctively understand how to use your powers.
+ Your power will back you up in a pinch or when you're actively using your power for conflict. 
+ Your power has enough juice to last at least a century of active use.

You can choose whether all your powers are distinct or facets of a greater whole, in either case, they will be able to affect each other and/or synergize together unless explicitly stated. As your Shard is restricted (unless it is Deviant) the synergies are fixed at the time of Trigger.
objects.title: Shard of the Warrior Entity

objects.text:
Your power comes from the Wanderer Entity.
+ Your power doesn't alter your personality or push you towards conflict.
+ You instinctively understand how to use your powers.
+ Your power starts slightly stronger than described and can grow in strength and potency over time if you push your limits.
+ Your power will back you up in a situation where you are incapacitated and are unable to continue fighting. 
+ Your power has enough juice to last at least a few centuries of continuous use.

You can choose whether all your powers are distinct or facets of a greater whole, in either case, they will be able to affect each other and/or synergize together unless explicitly stated. As your Shard is abnormal the synergies can be reinforced when your power grows.
objects.title: Shard of the Wanderer

objects.text:
Your power comes from the Thinker Entity.
+ Your power is dead and can't directly change your personality.
- You have to learn how to use your powers.
- If you use your powers too much, you could use up all its juice within a couple of decades.
+ Your powers may be slightly stronger than described.

You can choose whether all your powers are distinct or facets of a greater whole, in either case, they will be able to affect each other and/or synergize together unless explicitly stated. As your Shard is dead the synergies are imperfect and fixed at the time of Trigger.
objects.title: Shard of the Thinker Entity

rows.title: Shard Type
rows.titleText: Whichever entity granted your Shard confers different benefits and limitations, as well as opening different perks and drawbacks below.

objects.text:
This Shard is not considered to be important to the entity.
You can choose Tier 1 powers.
objects.title: Normal

objects.text:
This Shard is considered important to the Entity, so it will not be discarded lightly. The entity would be hindered by the loss of this Shard.
You can choose Tier 1 and 2 powers.
objects.title: Vital

objects.text:
The Entity, not having this Shard, is severely hindered. This Shard is significantly stronger than most others, only equaled by the other Queen shards.
You can choose Tier 1, 2, and 3 powers.
objects.title: Noble

rows.title: Shard Ranking
rows.titleText: How powerful is your Shard? This affects the maximum strength of powers you can receive.

objects.text: You can pick powers from the Tier 1 section.
objects.title: Essence of a Shard (Normal)

objects.text: You can pick powers from the Tier 1 and Tier 2 sections.
objects.title: Essence of a Shard (Vital)

objects.text: You can pick powers from the Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 sections.
objects.title: Essence of a Shard (Noble)

rows.title: Shard Essences
rows.titleText: Since these powers are not tied to a Shard, they can be grown through use and creative exploration. They also count as Negentropic and White-Box.

objects.text: Instead of entering the world of Worm as a Host, you'll become a Shard instead. Your Host is determined by your choices in the Character section and the Perks and Drawbacks apply to them instead (except for the ones that affect their Shard or the World). If you become the shard of an existing parahuman you take over their existing shard instead of becoming a new one. Your hosts can reach your nesting dimension through portals and teleportation with your permission.
objects.title: Shard

addons.text:
Instead of starting off with an increase to the rate at which your power improves, your power only gives half of the improvements a normal shard would give. Only by fighting for a year will your Shard turn this rate back to normal, multiple for it to become a slight improvement. Though if you antagonize it and stop fighting, it might just shift it back. Your shard will only be satisfied by you fighting frequently. You can shorten the timespan by increasing the amount of fights per day.

You also get negative intuition scaling with your improvement rate, the lower it is, the more it will try to get you killed. These hunches will feel like gut feelings that you should really follow, at base it would be things like jumping in front of a blast or a bullet, saying something that escalates a fight or instinctively dodging an attack in the wrong direction, things that will hopefully get you killed. At the normal rate it will simply be things that get you injured, only at the slightly improved rate will it leave you alone.
addons.title: Violent Relationship

objects.text: Your Shard, for some reason, doesn't like you. It will give you very little leeway with your powers and might even try to actively get you killed. You can improve this relationship by being a good Host but it will take time.
objects.title: Hostile

objects.text: Your Shard is indifferent towards you. It will give you a bit of leeway with your powers but won't actively help you. Whether your relationship improves or degrades is up to you.
objects.title: Neutral

addons.text:
Your Shard’s affection for you reaches the intense, single-minded devotion seen in examples like [FRAGILE ONE]’s bond with Victoria, [QUEEN ADMINISTRATION]’s devotion to Taylor, or [BROADCAST]’s fixation on Jack. It will — at its own volition — bend, reinterpret, or temporarily break its normal rules if doing so serves to protect you, preserve you, or help you thrive. That can look like ignoring internal restrictions, pushing past self-preservation protocols, or reshaping how it allocates its effects and protections in the moment.

The entity loving you is not necessarily comprehensible as a continent-scale, multidimensional lattice of crystalline intelligence. It cares in ways that are alien as well as genuine. Your Shard’s priorities may diverge from human norms: it may make choices based on its own modes of “love” that confuse or endanger you, and its attempts to secure your future can attract attention from other shards, entities, or systems who notice an unusually altered shard signature.
addons.title: [HOST]:[BEST HOST]

objects.text: Your Shard really likes you. It will give you leeway with your powers and will happily help you out when in a tight spot. Your powers will develop in helpful ways over time.
objects.title: Friendly

objects.text: It somehow went unnoticed by the Entities that your Shard had the ability they sought for eons: it defies entropy. Somehow your power allows you to defy entropy and uses this to supply itself. You will never run out of energy. This is more or less useless unless you're either immortal or think you can convince the Entity to leave behind all his/her/their other Shards, including Sting, and therefore not kill all humans in exchange for your Shard. A Shard without this Perk may still have the ability to defy entropy, but you need to find it yourself because the Shard doesn't already know.
objects.title: Negentropy

objects.text: Your Shard somehow found and connected to a vast supply of energy, enough to power your abilities regardless of how powerful they are, for billions of billions of years of continuous use before even seeing a drop in effectiveness. It is useless to you unless you are immortal, but if you are, who knows? You may be able to find the secret to Negentropy in the vast time you and your shard now have.
objects.title: Power Supply

objects.text:
Your Shard possesses [DATA] about esoteric forms of reality manipulations, scientific advancements, mental and physical undertakings, and all-around foreign to generally supernatural foundational abilities. Grants you access to the Shardless Powers section, with these powers tied to your Shard, however.

Your Shard powers can now affect non-Shard abilities, however any abilities copied, granted or stolen will be still tied to your Shard.
objects.title: Esoteric Knowledge

addons.text:
Your shard adopts a stealth paradigm drawn from the most ruthless corners of cosmic survival. Its presence vanishes into multiversal shadows, masking every signature and reflexively generating false echoes to lure any prying detection into dead ends. Interdimensional scanners, shard-based analysis, and even the probing tendrils of entities like Scion or Eden strike only static—the illusion of a false shard laid on an otherwise empty earth.

This module layers over your Pocket Shard’s infinite-range connection and your Closed Communications’ silence protocols, forging an almost absolute concealment. No shard can trace your power’s origin or pattern, no network can triangulate it's position, and no hive-mind link can pull your shard into its web.
addons.title: Dark Forest Protocols

addons.text:
Your Shard isn’t just in a pocket dimension—it’s anchored directly in your personal core, making the connection even more personal and nearly untouchable.

As is your very self that is housing it, your Shard now adapts fully to the state of your true self. Even if you lose your body, mind and soul, or become something stranger, the connection persists without interruption—unless your actual existential core is destroyed (in which case, you have bigger problems than losing your powers).

This setup makes outside detection or interference much harder: as long as your core self remains, your Shard’s presence and power source are cloaked from even those seeking dimensional or metaphysical signatures.

The Shard, curious as always, enjoys exploring its new “home”—collecting [DATA] with unprecedented proximity.
addons.title: Soul Mate? By Chance?

objects.text: Normally a Parahuman's Shard settles itself on an alternate uninhabited Earth preventing them from using their power after reaching a certain distance from Earth, but not you. Your Shard instead resides within a pocket dimension connected directly to your Corona Pollentia. Due to this fact, there is no range limit for your power. You could be on the other half of the multiverse and several billion light-years away and your Shard wouldn't even lag, nonetheless stop working. Now the only way to lose your powers is the permanent destruction of your Corona Pollentia.
objects.title: Pocket Shard

objects.text: You are the first successful Cauldron Cape and are a shoo-in for becoming a high ranking member of the multidimensional conspiracy.
objects.title: The Prototype

objects.text: Your Shard can converse with you. This will give you headaches unless your companion can learn to moderate their voice.
objects.title: A Voice in my head

objects.text: Your Shard can bring you into a dreamscape while you sleep, the appearance will correspond to the Shard and the powers it has. In there, you can converse and interact with your companion.
objects.title: Superliminal Space

objects.text: Your Shard can express itself through a minion Master power you have, a projection, or even a cloud of bugs. You lose access to the minions while the Shard is controlling it.
objects.title: Autonomous Projection

objects.text: Your powers awakening was too much for you to handle, making it necessary for them to evolve beyond their initial manifestation to ensure your survival. This drastically increases their breadth, depth and your control over your powers, but no longer allows you to second trigger.
objects.title: Double Trigger

objects.text:
Your shard appears to have suffered some damage, however, this damage is overwhelmingly in your favor as the Trigger limit you can potentially undergo has been removed.

While that may not seem like an advantage on its own, the threshold for your Triggers has also been lowered to something nearing a Second-Gen cape but still requires a significant amount of stress, e.g., a very difficult cape fight that's not going your way. These Triggers continually loosen restrictions, set loose the amount of power your Shard provides as well as add new facets to your power. However, continual and consecutive Triggers will lead to a drain on your Shard's power, killing your Shard from exhaustion.
objects.title: Two and a Half Triggers

objects.text:
Good news, your Tinker-tech is not black-boxed. Your technology is free of Shard interference, no longer degrades artificially, can be mass-produced, and the scientific principles behind your tech can be studied and reproduced by scientists. 

Bad news, your Tinker tech is not black-boxed. A lot of people will want to know you.

Your Power grants you basic knowledge of the principles and formulas necessary to understand and build the many blueprints in its library. However, this is on the level of an engineer or mechanic, not a scientist. If you want to write a thesis or textbook about the mechanics underlying your technology, you will need to study and reverse engineer your own technology.
objects.title: White-Box Tech

objects.text:
You and your Shard share a link stronger than any other. Your Shard has embedded an emergency protocol within you. Should your shard be damaged, reformatted, or destroyed it will be able to restore itself through a backup stored within yourself. The speed at which your Shard can do this is dependent on its energy supply.

If your Shard is devoid of energy you will be able to restore energy by exposing yourself to energy sources as a kind of absorption. So long as your connection to your Shard continue to exist your Shard can recover from anything.
objects.title: Emergency Repair Protocol

objects.text:
Your Shard is less restricted than usual, this doesn't lift all restrictions as the result would be ... explosive but it gives your Shard more leeway to express your powers.

In practice, this could do several things. It removes your Manton Limit and allows you powers to apply to more things. For example, Skitter can control all invertebrates, Vista is less limited by living creatures, or telefrag people by teleporting into the spot they currently occupy. This can also loosen other restrictions such as the restrictions all Tinkers have on space travel and other Technologies the entities consider high-risk. As time passes on, you find your Shard getting better at controlling itself allowing for more limits to be removed. Eventually removing things such as the inability to affect Endbringers. This also allows your shard to modify inter-power synergies over time.
objects.title: Uninhibited

objects.text:
Your Shard has broken from one of the Cycle’s core limitations: controlled growth. Rather than maintaining a defined ceiling, your abilities are capable of continuous improvement, scaling in strength, scope, and precision over time or under stress. This growth is not without cost, as your Shard compensates by dramatically increasing energy consumption, with higher levels of output demanding increasingly greater amounts of power. At lower levels, this remains manageable, but pushing your abilities too far can result in burning through your shard's typical power reserves and leaving you powerless.

On the plus side, you can now consciously cap your growth in one or more of your powers at a certain level.

Negentropy and, to a lesser extent, Power Supply negate this drawback.
objects.title: Unrestricted Growth

addons.text:
Your Patron no longer teaches you through raw information alone. Instead, it constructs the single most effective possible path for your growth.

Training methods, experiences, combat encounters, experiments, and even failures are subtly arranged to maximize comprehension and long-term development while minimizing wasted effort and harmful stagnation. Concepts that would normally require decades of study can become intuitive through carefully guided progression.

This guidance adapts continuously to you. If a method becomes inefficient, it changes. If you struggle with a concept, the Patron reframes it through approaches you naturally understand. If your powers possess hidden depth or unconventional potential, the Patron steers you toward discovering it organically rather than simply handing you answers.

Under its guidance, even highly esoteric or abstract powers become practical, intuitive, and deeply mastered.
addons.title: Great Teacher

objects.text: You are capable of learning how your power works (and only your power unless you possess some kind of power copying). By learning how your power works you are permanently capable of using them even if you're disconnected from your Shard. This would be as if you possessed Shardless. Even after mastering your power, your Shard continues to help you by revealing new and creative ways to improve and use your power that you normally wouldn’t think of, and by boosting your power when you confront enemies, giving you a combat advantage.
objects.title: Patron

addons.text: You and your Shard preserve one another; if one’s destroyed, a system is in place to bring back the other, or, to be exact, a comprehensively restorative system is established should both of you be destroyed. Every cell of your body (or if they remain in the event of your death) has the means to bring your Shard back, once resurrected it will use its own [Energy] reserve to rebuild your body back from whatever state it was in. Now, the only way you’d stay dead is by obliterating every atom of your body and Shard at once.
addons.title: [PRESERVATION]

objects.text:
Whether your Shard absolutely adores you, or maybe it's out of sadistic enjoyment, it believes that you produce premier [DATA], wanting to keep you as its Host at all costs. If you are killed and there's still at least a good portion of your body intact, your Shard will try to use anything at its disposal—your powers—to resuscitate you. 

If your body were completely obliterated, your Shard would somehow store your core self, using whatever sways it has on the Network to connect to another Host and recreate you from scratch, bringing you back. If all else fails, it’ll use the new host to overwrite their very being with your being. Even if it were a new Cycle, your Shard will do all it takes to keep you alive.
objects.title: Host Preservation Failsafe

objects.text: Your shard's communication module has been uniquely modified, allowing it to sever or ignore connections from other shards. Shards like [Broadcast], which are designed to coordinate and influence other shards, will no longer have power over your shard. Your powers are not detectable or analyzable by other shards. This means that other parahumans cannot sense your abilities or predict your actions through shard-based interactions. Entities, such as Scion or Eden, have reduced control over your shard.
objects.title: Closed Communications

addons.text: In addition your shard enhances your combat intuition, though this only becomes somewhat noticeable after a few months of regular fighting, like getting a hunch on an enemy weak point, or a shiver right before an attack. It will be unreliable at first, but with time and combat become like a pseudo-Thinker power.
addons.title: A Subtle Nudge

objects.text:
Your Shard has gifted you with a subconscious repository of knowledge based on similar power expressions from previous [Cycles] and [Hosts]. By drawing on these experiences, you can learn to handle your powers better, with an increased rate of progression at which your powers grow. 

To consciously access the repository requires dedicated practice and study, and applying that knowledge requires additional effort beyond that. However, your powers give you a helping hand, guiding you to the information most likely to improve your understanding or the places and situations most likely to facilitate effective practice.

This is practically a cheat sheet and skill book rolled into one, leading you to fully master your powers with less trial-and-error, less exhaustive research, and fewer creative walls to impede you.
objects.title: Compendium

objects.text: Your shard is in sync with you. This sounds like it's nothing out of the ordinary, on the contrary, it means that as a host, you influence your Shard as much as your Shard influences you. Your emotions have the greatest effect if you are feeling happy or determined, this gets your Shard to temporarily remove restrictions and allocate more power to you, in turn, feelings of fear and depression can impose new restrictions as well as decrease the overall power that you can use.
objects.title: Synchronicity

objects.text: Your Shard will make your power grow in the direction you desire, if you want your blasts to be stronger, or your flight faster it will focus on improving them, though this will take a couple of fights to become a noticeable difference. Should you want new power aspects, it will attempt to increase your powers in that way, like adding homing to your blasts or a trail to your flight. If you want entirely new powers, like becoming undetectable, your flight will start becoming silent or more difficult to notice, but it would likely take months for this new ‘power’ to develop enough to impact a fight, much longer to become useful or distinct enough to be called its own power. Abilities that are entirely different from the power set you possess are also impossible to gain this way. If you want to copy the power of other Parahumans for example, you might become capable of adjusting your blasts into different modes, mirroring the powers of some of the people you’ve fought, but copying their power entirely wouldn’t work.
objects.title: Guided Growth

objects.text: Your Shard is very focused on gathering combat data and thus rewards you a lot more for getting into parahuman combat than usual, at base this slightly increases the rate at which your power improves after fights. The more often you fight, the more your Shard will improve your power, this rate increases if you fight regularly. Someone with a normal Shard would need multiple months of combat to get the same improvements as you’d get within a month once you start fighting regularly, and as you keep fighting this rate will only increase. Your Shard also counts sparring as a fight as long as it mimics active combat, though live combat, especially with multiple opponents is still more rewarding. Repeatedly fighting the same opponents and fighting opponents severely weaker than you will give diminishing returns.
objects.title: Combat-Oriented

addons.text: You and your Shard operate in a form of harmony that is unseen in with any other [HOST] and Shard. The two of you work together in a way that allows the two of you to manipulate and change the way and amount of power output you use. Additionally, this partnership allows for finer control over how your Titan form manifests and functions, even being able to change its form through your reciprocal cooperation, changing its size and appearance to even that of a human, or even allowing for you to initiate the transformation in stages.
addons.title: Symbiosis

addons.text: You and your Shard's hostility have caused a fundamental disconnect between yourselves, allowing for both of you to fight for control over the way and amount of power you use. Additionally, this hostility has caused a chaotic occurrence in your Titan form’s manifestation, causing it to become like a volatile bomb going off wherever you transform with your powers as the fallout. Even the form of your Titan appears to be wrong and will cause other parahumans to be filled with a sense of dread and fear at its appearance.
addons.title: Competition
