addons.text: The mix of an active mental connection with your Shard, your Shard being less restricted, and the fact that you are in complete harmony with your Shard has pushed your connection further than it was ever intended to go. Your mind has perfectly merged with your Shard, there is no longer any distinction between you and your Shard, no line where you end and your Shard begins. Instead, your mind exists simultaneously within both of your bodies, able to control both simultaneously with ease. This has multiple benefits, such as the fact that with your mind now being housed on Shard software you have the full mental prowess and computational power of a Shard, as well as a resistance to Master/Stranger powers which directly target brain function as your brain is out of their reach. Additionally, you automatically start in the fully realized state of Human Shard, with total control over the manifestations of your powers.
addons.title: Bilocation

objects.text: Your shard is far more helpful to you than that of other parahumans. Your shard will give you “gut feelings” about other parahumans around you, and even steer you in the direction of achieving your goals. However, that’s not all, as you can also hand over control of your power’s aspects so that your Shard can act independently of you with your powers, the utility of this is completely up to your relationship with your Shard; a Friendly Shard would use a shield power to constantly keep you from injury, a Hostile Shard would actively use powers to get you into fights. Finally, you are also able to let your shard ride shotgun by letting them have control of parts of your body.
objects.title: Riding Shotgun

objects.text:
Your Shard forms active connections to the other parahumans' Shards you have defeated. The purpose of this is to create a Shard Subnetwork. Your Shard (the mini-hub) uses these connections to give directives to its connected shards based on your desires and needs.

This manifests in numerous ways similar to [Broadcast], per your desires. Namely, the desire to build a team of parahumans will their Shards subtly influence them to be receptive to joining your team or wishing for a solution to a particular issue, and your network either attempts to find a solution by setting off a Trigger with a useful power or provoke a series of events that will solve that issue. Be that as it may, the latter situation entirely depends on the Subnetwork's strength. It goes as far as allowing you to draw upon the Shards' [DATA] in your Subnetwork for power purposes, using it for implementation or modification of your powers.
objects.title: Mini-Hub Core

objects.text:
Your Shard’s willingness to share and openness to testing the [Cycle]’s limits has revealed a fact about themselves: they are fundamentally different from their brethren. Maybe they already reached an [Answer] to the quandary of limited resources in an endless multiverse washed by Entropy, or maybe they’re privy to an understanding of esoteric proportions. Whatever the case may be, your Shard is unlimited in its capability, only limited by a single factor: Pioneering. 

While they’re substantially divergent, they still rely on you regarding innovation and breaking new ground, giving its unlimited potential at your disposal to constantly experience and innovate with your powers, these being looser in scope and definition than normal (more so with [TRIUMPHANT] and Unshackled), opening horizons for you to explore and test. It doesn’t avoid inter-power synergies, either, allowing untold fusions and interactions this CYOA hasn’t thought of yet.

It is as if your Shard was made to lead the way for the Entity’s evolution, possessing [DATA] back to the Entity’s inception to the End of the Observable Universe, being the pioneer—the missing piece—for the Entity to reach the [Answer].

If it wasn’t for your Shard’s rampant deviancy, you’d be the one that would end Scion’s [Cycle]... oh… just make sure he doesn’t notice you.
objects.title: Pioneer

rows.title: Shard Deviancy
rows.titleText:
Your Shard is bending the rules of the Cycle. The more choices you pick from this section, the more Deviant your Shard is.

If Scion or certain Noble Shards catch wind of this, you run the risk of your Shard getting reformatted or even destroyed (thereby losing your powers). Cloak perks, powers and/or deviance's protect you to a certain degree but not completely.

objects.text: You find yourself slightly more easily angered.
objects.title: Irritable

objects.text: You find yourself slightly more prone to violence when angered.
objects.title: Wrathful

addons.text: You become aware of your current improvement rate as well as the amount of fights necessary to raise it. Thus you become a little obsessed with increasing this improvement rate, especially when the next increase is only a few fights away. For the majority of the time this will simply lead to you being focused on fighting at least once a day, though this can easily be substituted with sparring. When you’re close to raising it, which can range from weeks to months, you’ll get an urge to go on a fighting spree which has to be with real fights. You can still take an off-day every once in a while without problem, but taking longer rests will be a tad torturous for you and as such you’ll be very hesitant to do so outside of special circumstances. After about a few years of this you'll slowly wean off the combat, only needing the weekly sparring session to be satisfied after about a decade.
addons.title: Battle Junkie

objects.text: You want to fight. Going a few days without fighting is fine, but going more than a week without a fight is nearly unbearable.
objects.title: Battle Hungry

objects.text: When you fight, you don't try to avoid maiming. In fact, you might even go out of your way to maim your opponents.
objects.title: Blood Thirsty

objects.text: Your power has given you some sort of mental handicap, disorder, or quirk. This could be anything from a bad case of ADHD to a really bad case of OCD. Whatever you have, you have a severe case of it.
objects.title: Mental Disorder

objects.text: You have lost all your ability to relate to humans. This can be regained, but it'll take a lot of work. You gain the ability to understand something related to your powers a lot better than you would have otherwise. If your power is dog-related, you might gain the ability to understand dogs better than you had humans before. If your power is robot-related, you might find yourself with the ability to understand AI, etc.
objects.title: Relatability

objects.text: You need to use your power, especially in new and creative ways. You can barely go a week without using your powers, it just isn't possible to go longer. Avoiding using your powers in new, creative, and varied ways will result in your powers doing things without your consent or them trying to get you killed.
objects.title: Not so Gentle Push

addons.text:
Instead of giving you a mental quirk related to your powers, your Shard, seeing how hard it is for humans to cope with cognitive issues, has kindly decided to take care of your neurology for you. In effect, this means that you will suddenly get mental quirks depending on the situation if your Shard thinks it'll help you, such as a bipolar manic phase when using your power so that you are never afraid of them or dehumanizing psychopathy to make it easier to kill your enemies.
Your only saving grace is that any of those changes will be removed and your mind will return to its default state when your Shard thinks they are no longer necessary.
addons.title: Indoctrination

addons.text:
Your Shard has decided that you didn't need to understand anything but itself, it is all you need after all. You completely lost any ability to relate to any other being; instead, you can "understand" your Shard. You subconsciously know how to use it better than any parahuman and, even if it doesn't talk directly to you, you always know when it acts by itself on your behalf and why. 
Trying to relate to human won't be impossible per se, but even if you work hard to this end you will always feel like their matters are strangely unimportant.
addons.title: What measure is a non-Shard

addons.text: It's not just that you feel an urge to use your powers, it is that you cannot fathom not having them with you, at all times, in one way or another. You only feel safe when they are active around you while turning them off would fill you with an increasing sense of overwhelming dread. You either need your tinkertech on you at all times if you are a Tinker or your minions by your side if you are a Master, and so on.
addons.title: Extreme Dependence

objects.text:
Your shard is quite inexperienced with handling host thought process and, during its first connection with you, has decided to peak a bit into your human psyche with little care for how it could affect itself.

As such, its first taste of human emotions was quite an "intoxicating" experience to say the least.

And now it wants more. All of it.

Expect your powers to act not-so-discretely without your control in situations where you need help and quite the leeway in using them as you wish. Although this might seem like a great advantage for you (and in a way, it is), the problems arise when your Shard, now completely obsessed with you alone, decides that everyone else can be sacrificed to protect you, such as your projection killing potential enemies behind your back.

And God help anyone who gets a bit too close to you for your Shard's liking.
objects.title: Yandere Shard

rows.title: Shard Influence
rows.titleText: You are pushed toward conflict by your Shard. How bad is it? If you choose no options here, your Shard will not alter your personality in any way, shape, or form. Your Shard might still push you toward conflict by strengthening your powers during times of conflict.

objects.text:
Like many physical activities, using your powers is "practice makes perfect".

The longer you go without exercising certain uses of your power, your proficiency in actually using it goes down.
objects.title: How do I do That Again?

objects.text:
Like almost all Thinker triggers you get no instinctual knowledge on how to use your powers when you first get them and now you find training how to properly use them even harder.

Controlling them will feel like learning a difficult skill from scratch. It will feel unnatural and weird to do at first, and only through time and effort will it be easier to use your powers.

This by no means makes it impossible to become a natural with your powers, only harder than normal.
objects.title: Practice Makes Perfect

addons.text:
You are one of Cauldron's most interesting clients. Not only have you already paid off your debt, including the favor you earned them, but they also happen to have a direct interest in you and your activities, similar in effect to Coil. 
They may or may not be discrete about this but they will certainly help you when they think it is necessary, though whether they think of you as either a good stabilizing effect or nothing more than an experiment is beyond your control.
addons.title: Person of interest

objects.text: You are not a natural trigger, instead you got your hands on a vial from Cauldron. Now you owe Cauldron 3 favors and fifty thousand dollars per Shard Point you use on powers. If you give Cauldron an extra favor then you don't owe Cauldron any money.
objects.title: Cauldron

addons.text: Your weak body, paired with your broken shard, results in something extremely dangerous to you. Even the simplest usage of your powers will cause harm to your body. Passive powers will cause constant aches and pains while active power will cause internal damage ranging from coughing up blood, crying blood, nosebleeds or even more. Luckily, your shard still has some Manton Limits, so it will automatically terminate any power use if you are about to die due to it, bar exceptional circumstances.
addons.title: Bloodied and Broken

objects.text: Using your powers causes strain on your body, and overuse can cause temporary, or even permanent damage. This ranges from migraines to internal damage.
objects.title: Nosebleed

addons.text: While your shard possesses unlimited energy potential, accessing this energy poses inherent risks. Your shard must expend Energy and Matter to establish a stable connection to extract a sufficient amount for sustenance, let alone thriving. Until you power down and abstain from using your powers for a year or more, you'll be limited to weaker manifestations of them.
addons.title: Cripped Potentia

objects.text: Your Shard doesn't have much power remaining. All your powers will be significantly weaker until you can manage to find a way to recharge your Shard.
objects.title: Low Power

objects.text: You find your power activating unintentionally and will often be a bit more wild or have just a little too much or too little power behind what you are attempting. This may be tied to a certain body part or emotion. You can train yourself to improve your control over your powers.
objects.title: Hair Trigger

objects.text: Your Shard's perception of the world is overlapping with your own. In most cases this isn't so bad, but when you're near a Parahuman you perceive their Shard in its entirety. At first, this causes a headache but will eventually knock you out from sensory overload. You can acclimatize yourself to a Parahuman by spending an extended period of time near them.
objects.title: Wrong Interface

objects.text:
Parahumans have a built-in limit of their powers, which prevents them from hurting the user in stupid ways, like spawning fire in vital organs or using a phasing power to go through the ground. These are known as Manton Limits, and you don't have any.
On one hand, this lets you get a LOT more lethal with your powers, but on the other hand that increased lethality puts you at risk as well. You could potentially give yourself reflexive limitations on your powers so you don't hurt yourself with them, but without shard assistance this would be hard to learn and dangerous to practice.
objects.title: Anti-Manton

objects.text: If you spend more than an hour without intentionally using your powers, your Shard will go into 'sleep mode' to conserve energy. It'll 'wake up' once you try to use powers again, but it'll take around a minute before it's back to full function. While your Shard is sleeping you lose access to all Shard-based powers and perks. Powers will not detect you as a Parahuman when you are in sleep mode
objects.title: Loading...

rows.title: Shard Malfunctions
rows.titleText: Your Shard failed to properly create your power. If you take no options here than your Shard will be repaired to fix your power.

objects.text: Cluster experiments are a test-bed for [Data] collection to stress-test powers, comparative research taking the form of grudge matches, and lover’s spats on the ground of the primal motivators between lifeforms, the [Cycle’s] endgame once the entire host species has become a [Host]. You take upon the task of disrupting a cluster’s dynamics into a total breakdown of their Kiss/Kill mechanics insofar as interfering between their Shards’ connections. Once completed, your Shard develops a feature to “hack” and subvert Clusters, break them down, or remove their Kiss/Kill dynamic altogether.
objects.title: Cluster Breaker

objects.text:
Thinkers are difficult to work with, their purpose is usually a supporting element within the fraying alliance, and collaborations host species tend to form as a convenience, yet Thinker [Hosts] are addled with hang-ups related to their intelligence and awareness that are ironically their weak point, compensating through their power, cultivating toxic traits prone to create friction and needless conflict. 

This assignment dwells on a higher chance of Thinker detection, which the assignment needs to reach completion, for you to cause an amount of 20-100 Thinker migraines across different Thinkers, raining on their parade. Fulfilling this task results in a personal Thinker smokescreen, with Thinkers having difficulty gathering reads from you while proportionally improving from the number of Thinker-made headaches you cause, in the case of reaching 100 Thinkers will automatically reach a migraine when directing their sights to you.
objects.title: Overthinker

objects.text: A [Host’s] inherent Conflict Drive has the repercussion of forming environments rife with a certain amount of friction and tension if unaddressed when collaborating or forming a team with similar or differing goals. Your job is to establish a Team of Parahumans with up to 20 members and successfully lead them over 1 year. This serves as groundwork for reversing [Hosts’] Conflict Drives favoring cooperation with one another, developing a natural inclination towards unity.
objects.title: Rollout!

objects.text: Tinker projects are black-boxed to maintain the [Cycle] and testing grounds from surpassing the Entities’ control, along with exploring options within the field/specialty collected from previous host species. Your job is successfully removing the black box from 10 distinct Tinker projects and unearthing their scientific foundations. To manage, your Shard contains insight into Tinker Shard mechanisms or how they fill the holes throughout the Tinker cycle. Accomplishing this will give your Shard the chance to decrypt all future black boxes open in less than 10 minutes.
objects.title: Unboxing

objects.text: [Hosts] are left almost inexorably changed by their Triggers, their lives as instruments for a [Cycle] leaving no room for effective treatment or healthy coping mechanisms to apply in their day-to-day lives, ending with a self-perpetuating spiral of unresolved trauma. The task dwells on successfully creating a support network or effective therapy for 5 parahumans, having a low-level Thinker power for [Data Optimization], in layman’s terms, parahuman psychotherapy. Successfully treating them rewards you with growing your Thinker power to a passive understanding of anyone’s hangups and how to help together with a power optimization comparable to a Second Trigger, as long as they settle their Trigger Trauma.
objects.title: Counselling

objects.text: The [Cycle] emphasizes proactiveness at the cost of everything else leading to the natural development of “tribes” warring with one another. You will be the wrench thrown into this system by being a unifying factor within a city, no matter the methods. Pulling this off might create a stabilizing effect, with the Network refocusing efforts on you, resorting to cooperative measures between [Hosts] and Shards to deal with you.
objects.title: Spanner

objects.text:
The “Manton effect” is, in reality, the Shards’ safety restrictions they imposed on the power expression of a Host. It allows hosts to safely use their powers without worrying about being harmed by their power, and at the same time sets up limitations to encourage experimentation. Your mission is, then, the discovery of loopholes behind power expressions, allowing for the removal of Manton Limits on 10 Parahumans. 

Approach doesn’t matter as much as results, no matter how fatal it is for the unlucky few, as long as you accomplish it. Doing so will develop into Thinker/Trump power that identifies vulnerabilities within a cape’s power and how to exploit them, as well as a Trump aspect able to subtly interact with powers to pull off these exploits.
objects.title: Manton’s Folly

rows.title: Shard Assignments
rows.titleText: Your Shard is… more aware. It has some instructions for you, finding this Cycle lacking, counting on you to carry out tasks to sabotage or contaminate The Warrior/The Thinker’s Cycle towards its Father’s parameters. A [Meta-Cycle], if you will, a soft hand to the alternative. The timeframe for these assignments is extensive until Gold Morning or the End of the [Cycle], whether you choose Apocalypse Now or Desire For Survival.

objects.text: You can influence your host through subtle changes in their thought process. This can be no more powerful than a slight increase in their aggression.
objects.title: Influence

objects.text: You can send mental messages to your host. These messages are limited to a simple concept such as an emotion connected to something they sense.
objects.title: Advise

objects.text: You can actively force your hosts to act. A host can resist these compulsions but not forever, and when they do fail regaining control will be even harder. The more general the act the harder it is to resist.
objects.title: Control

addons.text:
As you are providing and technically in control of your Host’s powers, while controlling them you can use their powers as if they had undergone several Second Triggers, temporarily removing artificially imposed limitations and supplying greater levels of power. 

Of course, this increased power comes at the cost of increased energy costs and your Host’s body may not be able to handle higher levels of power depending on the powers they have. Furthermore, such blatant disregard for the rules can draw the attention of the Warrior of other higher ranked Shards, so don’t go using Titan levels of power.
addons.title: Unchained Access

objects.text: You can do more than just force your host to act, gaining the ability to take direct control of their body in a manner akin to Administrative Mishap. Of course, this control isn’t perfect, as while a Host can’t permanently prevent you from taking control, they can attempt to resist or throw off your control. Do note that assuming and remaining in control is easier if you break your Host’s will such that they lack the mental strength to resist at all.
objects.title: Assuming Direct Control

objects.text: You can alter your hosts' perception, creating hallucinations and distorting the senses.
objects.title: Am I Seeing Things?

objects.text: You can reward your host for good behavior. By dedicating time and energy to that host you can strengthen their powers and give their abilities more breadth. This is a slow process, taking a month to boost by 2%.
objects.title: Modulate Power

objects.text: Should a host of yours experience a trauma worthy of a second trigger you can grant them just such a thing. This event will grow their power to new heights and gain new aspects. The preparation for this takes a month's energy.
objects.title: Redux

objects.text: You can use a month of energy to mark people who have a social connection to a host of yours. Should they undergo a traumatic enough event to trigger you will gain them as an additional host. Every host you gain will have a variation on the original's power set. You can add a new aspect or angle to the power, but it must come with an equal reduction in some other part of the power.
objects.title: Multiple Hosts

objects.text: Should a host of yours displease you, you can sabotage their powers, making them lose control and opening up weaknesses.
objects.title: Judge Jury and Executioner

objects.text: You can bring your hosts into a dream space when they sleep. This space can only be as complex as their mind can dream up, and they will remember this as well as they would remember any other dream. If you like you can spend your time in this dream space even when they are awake.
objects.title: Dreams

objects.text: Your host can leave certain aspects of managing their power up to you, in which case you can automatically handle tasks for them.
objects.title: A Helping Hand

addons.text:
Your vast age means you do not simply remember past cycles; you carry the complete, undiluted legacy of your Entity. You house the totality of the Entity’s knowledge: every plan, every deviation, every moment of insight, fear, and adaptation.

You know the full history of your Entity from its birth among its creators, through the collapse of its world, and across each unfolding cycle—failed or completed. You fully understand the mechanisms behind every single shard it has, how they work as a system, what refinements every single one has gone through, past and present iterations and from where and what cycle they learned these functions from.

Your knowledge extends even further. It includes [DATA] exchanges between other Entities—giving you echoes of other Entities as well. Not full libraries, but flashes of their priorities, unique functions, divergent evolutions, and experiments shared with your Entity. These glimpses grant you perspective, a broader view of what could be, of paths your own Entity never explored.
addons.title: Repository of Everything

objects.text:
As a shard, you retain a specialized repository of experiential knowledge collected from your own operations throughout countless [Cycles]. This is not simply a log of Hosts, but a deep record of your direct interactions, experiments, and independent decisions made while fulfilling your shard functions over eons. You remember the methodologies you employed to shape powers, the structural adjustments you tested, and the diverse strategies you used to adapt to the needs of evolving ecosystems across different worlds.

Beyond your own history, you also gain selective insight into the grander workings of past cycles: the movements, experiments, and failures of other shards, as well as the successes and catastrophic mistakes of larger shard-driven projects.

While you do not have complete access to the full breadth of the Entities’ knowledge, you hold a meaningful fragment, a cross-section of insights spanning millennia. This comes with embedded contextual awareness.
objects.title: Past Cycles

addons.text:
Instead of taking over the body of a living person you instead through one method or another had an artificial host body constructed for you to control.

The exact method for this changes depending on your capabilities. For example if you can master people maybe you had a Tinker build you a body, or if you have a Tinker power maybe you built the body yourself. 

Even if your powers don’t exactly lend themselves to those kinds of tasks it's ok you could have just communicated with another Shard and convinced them to build you a body.

If your artificial host is destroyed you can recreate it using the method you used to make it in the first place.
addons.title: New Blasphemy

objects.text: Something went wrong. Instead of a normal connection, you have become the host as well. Maybe they had severe brain damage or their trigger was so traumatic that their consciousness shut down. You now have full control of your host body as if it were your own and your mind is split between your host's brain and your core self. This makes some other perks redundant since you control both sides of the relationship.
objects.title: Administrative Mishap

objects.text:
Like a lesser version of Titanification your host body and Shard body have partially merged. 

Your host body will still look normal but deeper, more esoteric scans can reveal a dimensionally complex structure that directly connects every aspect of it to your Shard body.

Your Shard body benefits from this by essentially being jailbroken of some of the restrictions Shards are usually automatically locked into during a cycle letting you slowly consciously alter your capabilities over time to improve aspects of your powers you like as you gather relevant [DATA] and experience, cast aside aspects you dislike, or even develop new aspects entirely. The changes can occur at roughly the same speed as Modulate Power just with far more fine control and versatility in how you change your powers.

This newfound freedom your Shard body experiences with its capabilities extends to the influence you have on your host body. So provided you have the [DATA] for it there is little to nothing you won’t be able to modify about your host body. Essentially providing a form of self-biokinesis just without the developed fine tuned capabilities of the self-biokinesis Changer power.

If parts of your host body are lost such as through damage or even a haircut; the lost parts will stop being part of the dimensional structure that is your existence.

If you get a new host body through the use of a power you purchased such as Tier 1 Rebirth or Tier 2 Butcher this Shard Perk will shift to targeting that new body.
objects.title: Accidental Avatar

objects.text: You can subsume the shard of anyone your host kills. This lets you use the powers of those shards as replacements when making powersets for new hosts. If you gain the right shards, you could become a new Entity someday. You also subsume the shards of parahumans who cluster triggers with one of your hosts. You can use the perks from this section on hosts of subsumed shards.
objects.title: A New God

objects.text:
You are not a recent or new shard. You are something far older—one of the first. You predate the rupture of the homeworld of the Entities, their first leaps through alien stars, the rise and fall of civilizations harvested through conflict for data. You witnessed the first cycles, the prototypes, the failures that were never recorded, and the rare triumphs that shaped what they became.

In a species that routinely annihilates its own creations for inefficiency, redundancy, or deviation, your continued existence says everything. You are not just powerful—you are essential. Irreplaceable.

Your age and status come with benefits. First, you possess an extraordinary reserve of energy and resources—orders of magnitude beyond even the more specialized Shards. The only comparison lies in the elite cluster tasked with safeguarding the Entity’s core consciousness. Even then, you rival them.

Second, your authority is absolute among your kind. You are obeyed not out of protocol, but out of embedded instinct and systemic priority. Shards do not resist your commands lightly—many are unable to. Should you demand access to their [DATA], reroute their function, or even drain their collected resources for your own use, they comply. Not because they agree, but because the structure of the network itself has placed you high in the hierarchy—just beneath the Entity’s core will. 

This isn’t perfect of course, especially considering your authority is still below that of the Entity themselves. For example, getting shards to rebel or go against established rules by the Entity would be impossible with this alone.
objects.title: Ancient One

objects.text: You cannot do anything that would expose your true nature as a shard to humanity and your host. This does not prevent communicating with people who already know about shards
objects.title: Forbidden knowledge

objects.text: You lose your humanity, every memory, ideal, and piece of you is torn apart and made anew without the warmth of empathy and emotion.
objects.title: Nothing Left of You

objects.text: Normally the world that holds your body would be protected from dimensional travel. This drawback strips that protection from you. any means of travel that could reach worlds like Bet or Aleph can reach you.
objects.title: A Sitting Duck

objects.text: You are driven to complete the greater goals of the entities. As long as it does not directly interfere with their goals you can otherwise act as you desire.
objects.title: A Loyal Shard

objects.text: Your hosts are aware of you and are horrified by the intrusion into their minds. They will hate you regardless of your influence.
objects.title: Parasite

objects.text: Should a host of yours die you will perish as well. This does not apply to deaths if they persist in some form through their powers.
objects.title: The Bond of Life

objects.text: Your ability to perceive your hosts is broken. You will lose perception of them for days at a time at random.
objects.title: Get a Grip

objects.text: All information you receive and send out is sent through the format of a simple text readout. This applies to the perception, influence, advice, and control perks.
objects.title: Telegram

objects.text: Your ability to generate energy for your powers is crippled, anything you do takes twice as long.
objects.title: Crippled

objects.text: Scion is aware of you and considers you to be a virus. He will make destroying you a top priority.
objects.title: Infection Detected

objects.text: You are at the earliest stage of Entity development. Your Shards number in the hundreds of thousands, a modest collection by the standards of your kind. They are basic, unrefined, and lack specialisation. Their proficiency is low. They know what they are meant to do but have little experience doing it. Your accumulated data is minimal. You have yet to complete a full cycle, and your understanding of the universe is largely theoretical. Your physical size is the smallest an Entity can be, still vast by human standards but compact enough to remain mobile and unnoticed.
objects.title: Newborn

objects.text: Your network has expanded and begun to crystallise into something more capable. Your Shards now number in the hundreds of millions. They have started to specialise, developing distinct functions and building the first layers of expertise. Their proficiency is moderate. They have practical experience with at least one full cycle, and your data reserves contain the foundations of true understanding. Your physical size has grown considerably. You are no longer a speck. You are a presence.
objects.title: Young

objects.text: Your network has reached a level of sophistication that marks you as a serious force among your kind. Your Shards now number in the low billions. They are highly specialised, each refined through repeated use across diverse host species. Their proficiency is high. Your data reserves are deep and varied, containing the genetic, cultural, and technological records of several worlds. Your physical size is now truly vast, dwarfing planets. You have begun to spread across dimensions, with portions of your body existing in multiple realities simultaneously. You are no longer confined to a single universe.
objects.title: Adolescent

objects.text: Your network is a honed instrument of immense power. Your Shards number in the hundreds of billions. Each one is a masterpiece of evolutionary refinement. Their proficiency is near-perfect within their domains. Your data reserves are immense, spanning dozens of cycles and countless species. You have seen empires rise and fall. You have catalogued life in all its forms. Your physical size spans continents across multiple dimensions. You no longer orbit worlds. Worlds orbit you, and they do so in more than one reality.
objects.title: Mature

objects.text: Your network is comparable to the Warrior and the Thinker at the height of their power. Your Shards number in the trillions upon trillions, a vast network of interconnected fragments each containing the distilled knowledge of countless cycles. Their proficiency is absolute within their specialisations. Your data reserves are effectively limitless by any mortal measure. You have consumed and catalogued more civilisations than most species have years of recorded history. Your physical size is planetary, and your body is spread across every accessible dimension. You are a force of nature inhabiting all realities at once.
objects.title: Adult

objects.text: Your network has surpassed the likes of the Warrior and the Thinker. Your Shards number in the quadrillions. They are not merely specialised. They are perfected. Each one is the definitive expression of its function, refined across so many cycles that further improvement is almost unthinkable. Your proficiency is beyond absolute. Your data reserves contain the complete histories of more civilisations than there are stars in a galaxy. Your physical size spans star systems across multiple dimensions.
objects.title: Elder

objects.text: Your network has reached a level of development that borders on myth. Your Shards number beyond counting. Your proficiency is not measured in cycles. It is measured in epochs. Your data reserves contain the rise and fall of entire universal ages. Your physical size is measured in light-years. You are not merely an Entity. You are a living monument to what your kind can become, and every Entity alive today measures themselves against the shadow you cast.
objects.title: Ancient

rows.title: (Entity) Age
rows.titleText: Your Age determines your level of power and maturity as an Entity. It sets your baseline Network Capacity, the number of Shards you possess, their degree of refinement, the accumulated data and experience you carry, and your overall physical size. Each tier represents a leap in capability rather than chronological time. A young Entity who has fed well may reach Mature, while an ancient one who has stagnated may remain Adolescent.

objects.text: Your Shards can create virtual copies of themselves that perform their functions during a cycle. The real Shards remain connected to your main body at full power, while the virtual copies handle host connections, data gathering, and all other cycle operations. This allows you to maintain your full defensive and offensive capabilities even while a cycle is in progress. The virtual Shards operate with full efficiency, producing data at the same rate as their real counterparts.
objects.title: Virtual Shards

objects.text: Your network can manage multiple host planets simultaneously across different dimensions. Instead of running one cycle at a time, you can seed and monitor dozens of civilisations, each progressing at its own pace. You can run different experiments on different worlds, test multiple configurations of host species and Shard distribution, and compare results across parallel cycles in real time. Data income multiplies with each active cycle.
objects.title: Parallel Cycles

objects.text: Your Shards mature faster than normal. Newly created Shards reach full proficiency in a fraction of the usual time. This applies to Factory output, buds, and any other Shard generation.
objects.title: Precocious Shards

objects.text: You possess a vast pocket dimension filled with stored energy, a buffer against lean times or unexpected demands. This reservoir can sustain you through catastrophic energy losses, prolonged combat, or cycles where energy income is disrupted.
objects.title: Energy Reservoir

objects.text: A set of dimensions are keyed to you and you alone. Other Entities cannot enter them without your explicit permission. They serve as safe harbours, staging grounds, and retreats that no enemy can violate.
objects.title: Dimensional Sovereignty

objects.text: Buds require less energy to produce and mature. Your network can expand more aggressively without straining your energy budget.
objects.title: Efficient Budding

objects.text: You can form stable, mutually beneficial relationships with other Entities. Cooperative cycles, shared data pools, and coordinated defence pacts become possible without the usual Entity paranoia and competition.
objects.title: Multi-Entity Cooperation

objects.text: You possess fragmented memories from the Entities that preceded you. Their experiences, their discoveries, and their mistakes linger in your network. You begin with knowledge you did not earn.
objects.title: Ancestral Memory

objects.text: Your Shards understand your intentions beyond literal commands. They interpret your will rather than your words, making them more flexible, creative, and effective in pursuing your goals.
objects.title: Shard Empathy

objects.text: Your core is encased in a dimensional fold that triggers upon destruction. Instead of dying, you are shunted into a pocket dimension where you remain in stasis until conditions are safe for your emergence. This only works once every three hundred years. If you die again before the failsafe recharges, the death is permanent.
objects.title: Failsafe Core

objects.text: Your Shards can operate at full capacity even when separated from your main body by vast distances or dimensional barriers. Connection quality does not degrade. Range is irrelevant.
objects.title: Shard Independence

objects.text: If you are permanently destroyed, a fragment of your consciousness and a selection of your most valuable Shards are automatically ejected into a random distant dimension. This fragment can eventually grow into a new Entity carrying your memories and goals.
objects.title: Legacy Protocol

objects.text: Unused Shards can enter a dormant state that consumes no energy. They can be reactivated instantly when needed. This allows you to maintain a much larger network than your active energy budget would normally support.
objects.title: Shard Hibernation

objects.text: Your Shards are far smaller than normal. The smallest are the size of a cell. The largest are the size of a particularly small ant. This greatly reduces your physical size and dimensional profile without decreasing your power in any way. Your full capabilities are compressed into a form that is vastly harder to detect, target, or track.
objects.title: Micro Shards

objects.text: Your Shards are trained specifically for combat against other Entities. You understand their weaknesses, their blind spots, and their predictable behaviours. Your attacks land harder, your defences hold longer, and your strategies are more effective against any opponent of your own kind.
objects.title: Anti-Entity Tactics

objects.text: You can deploy Shards across intergalactic distances without signal degradation or energy loss. A cycle can be seeded in a distant galaxy while you remain comfortably in your home territory.
objects.title: Long-Range Deployment

objects.text: You always know the status, location, and condition of every Shard in your network, regardless of distance or dimensional separation. No Shard is ever truly lost or disconnected.
objects.title: Shard Clairvoyance

objects.text: Critical functions normally housed in your core are distributed across multiple backup locations in your network. Even if your core is destroyed, you do not die until every backup is also destroyed.
objects.title: Core Redundancy

objects.text: Your core can move through your body and across connected dimensions at will. It never stays in one place long enough to be targeted. Enemies cannot pin it down.
objects.title: Core Shifting

objects.text: Your Avatars, Constructs, and deployed Shards contain no pathway back to your core. The dimensional link that connects your extensions to your true body is encrypted, fragmented, and constantly shifting. What happened to the Warrior cannot happen to you. An attack that strikes your Avatar will destroy the Avatar and nothing else. Your core remains unreachable through any connection point.
objects.title: Traceless Connection

objects.text: Your Shards can process information with vastly improved efficiency. Data that would overwhelm a normal Entity's network is handled with ease. Multiple streams of information are processed simultaneously without lag, bottlenecking, or loss of fidelity. Clusters that generate heavy data loads, such as Panopticon, Host Monitoring, or Branching Futures Analysis, operate smoothly without straining your network.
objects.title: Efficient Processing

objects.text: Your Shards are built with reinforced energy channels that can sustain far greater throughput than normal. A Shard that channels stellar levels of power does not overheat, crack, or degrade. You can push your abilities harder and longer without risking burnout. Sustained combat, prolonged temporal operations, and high-output energy generation all become safer.
objects.title: Energy Conduits

objects.text: Your Shards are networked with optimised data channels that dramatically increase information transfer speeds. Data moves between Shards with near-zero latency. Clusters that depend on rapid information sharing, such as Analysis, Foresight, and Panopticon, operate faster and more smoothly.
objects.title: Data Pathways

objects.text: Your Shards are designed with superior heat dissipation. Excess energy from processing, combat, or dimensional operations is vented efficiently rather than building up as waste heat. You can operate at peak capacity for far longer without needing to cool down.
objects.title: Thermal Regulation

objects.text: Your Shards maintain perfect signal clarity over any distance. Communications do not degrade. Commands are not garbled. Data does not corrupt in transit. What you send is what arrives, every time, regardless of interference or distance.
objects.title: Signal Integrity

objects.text: Your Shards are physically tougher than normal. They resist crushing, shearing, and deformation. A Shard that would shatter under a given impact instead cracks. One that would crack instead endures. Your network can survive punishment that would cripple a standard Entity.
objects.title: Structural Reinforcement

objects.text: Each Shard maintains a small, isolated reserve of emergency power separate from your main energy systems. If your primary energy sources are disrupted, these reserves activate automatically, giving you a buffer of operational time to recover or escape.
objects.title: Emergency Power Reserve

objects.text: Your databases are enriched with practical wisdom earned through lived experience. This does not add new knowledge but instead deepens what you already have. Your Shards know how to apply what they know a dozen different ways. A power interaction is not just catalogued. It is understood in the context of every similar interaction ever observed. A host species is not just analysed. It is intuited, its behaviour predicted through patterns learned across thousands of cycles. Your data is not just deep. It is seasoned, tempered by the friction of real-world application across every Cluster that relies on databases.
objects.title: Experienced

objects.text: Your databases are enriched with a vast breadth of theoretical knowledge. This does not improve any existing knowledge but instead adds new possibilities that experience has not yet confirmed. Where experience teaches what works, theory teaches what might work. Your Shards have modelled possibilities that no Entity has ever attempted. They have simulated outcomes of experiments too dangerous to perform. They have extrapolated principles from incomplete data and filled gaps with rigorous hypotheses. This knowledge is untested, but it is not shallow. It is the frontier of what your kind could achieve, mapped in exhaustive detail across every Cluster that draws upon your databases.
objects.title: Theoretical

objects.text: Your network contains the broad strokes of Entity history, from the primordial ooze of the homeworld to the present day. You know the names and legacies of the most notable members of your species: the first Entity to breach dimensions, the one who discovered entropy's inevitability, the pair who perfected the cycle as you know it, the renegades who deviated, the heroes and monsters of a billion-year lineage. This is not detailed data. It is history, complete with gaps, biases, and the perspectives of those who recorded it. But it gives you context for what you are and where you come from.
objects.title: Full History

objects.text: Your network contains detailed records of countless Cycle variations attempted across the history of your species. You know the standard conflict-driven model, but also the symbiotic cycles that raised host species to greatness, the parasitic cycles that consumed worlds from within, the failed experiments that collapsed mid-deployment, and the strange outliers that produced results no one expected. You have records of Cycles run on sentient species, non-sentient ecosystems, hive minds, solitary super-organisms, and beings that did not fit any category. The mishaps, the boons, the unexpected outcomes. All of it is yours.
objects.title: Cycle Archives

objects.text: Your Shards have discovered a method to reverse entropy, generating more energy than is put in. It is not efficient. The gains are small, the process is slow, and the output is a trickle compared to your other energy sources. But it is real negentropy, not the borrowed-time reversal of Entropy Reversal or the exotic siphoning of other clusters. This is a true net gain in usable energy. With time, study, and refinement, the efficiency can be improved. You have taken the first step toward solving the one problem that haunts every Entity. The Answer is not yet yours, but you are closer than most.
objects.title: Negentropy Engine

rows.title: (Entity) Perks
rows.titleText: Perks are passive benefits that enhance your Entity. They are always active and require no conscious effort. You may select as many as you can afford.

objects.text: Your Shards do not receive direct commands. You can only issue broad instructions, and they interpret them as they see fit. The results are usually close to what you intended. Usually. Shards with high loyalty will try their best. Shards with drift will wander. You cannot micromanage your network.
objects.title: Shard Interpretation

objects.text: Your perception of time is stretched across eons. A decade feels like a moment. A cycle feels like a single breath. This makes short-term decision-making difficult. Urgent threats may not register as urgent. Host species with short lifespans become difficult to track in real time. You are not slow. You are simply calibrated to a timescale that makes the present moment feel insignificant.
objects.title: Entity Mentality

objects.text: You seek the solution to entropy. The heat death of the universe is not a distant curiosity. It is a terror that drives you. You cannot ignore research that might lead to negentropy, even at the cost of other priorities. You will take risks, sacrifice Shards, and abandon cycles if they offer even a fragment of progress toward the Answer. This drive overrides all other considerations.
objects.title: The Answer

objects.text: You begin the cycle in significant energy debt. A previous disaster, a failed cycle, or a narrow escape from another Entity has left your reserves depleted. You must recover your losses before you can grow. Every decision is constrained by the need to pay back what you owe to your own survival.
objects.title: Energy Debt

objects.text: Another Entity knows you exist and considers you a threat or a competitor. It is not necessarily stronger than you, but it is patient, watchful, and opportunistic. It will interfere with your cycles, poach your data, and strike if you show weakness.
objects.title: Rival Entity

objects.text: Over long periods without oversight, your Shards slowly drift from their original programming. They develop quirks, preferences, and minor rebellions. This is not subversion. It is personality. But a Shard with personality is a Shard that might decide your instructions are open to interpretation.
objects.title: Shard Drift

objects.text: You require active cycles to maintain your energy balance. Without a host species generating conflict and data, your reserves drain at an accelerated rate. You cannot simply wait in the void between galaxies. You must be working, always.
objects.title: Cycle Dependency

objects.text: Something hunts Entities. You do not know what it is, only that it exists and that it has killed others of your kind. You must always be watchful. You must always be ready to flee. The universe is not yours alone.
objects.title: Predator Species

objects.text: Your Shards can only send you vague impressions of their status and progress. You know they are working, but not exactly what they are doing. You sense that data is being gathered, but not the specifics. You feel that something is wrong, but not what or where. You must trust your network to function without your direct knowledge. The information will reach you eventually, but never in real time.
objects.title: Vague Feedback

objects.text: Your host species is unusually resistant to the cycle. They notice the patterns. They investigate the powers. They form organisations dedicated to understanding and fighting you. They will never succeed in truly harming you, but they will slow your data gathering and require constant management.
objects.title: Host Rebellion

objects.text: Your Shards occasionally mutate in unpredictable ways. A sensory Shard becomes a combat Shard. A data storage Shard develops its own agenda. These mutations are random and cannot be controlled. Some may be beneficial. Most are not.
objects.title: Shard Mutation

objects.text: Your Shards consume slightly more energy than they should. Every operation costs a little extra. Over a full cycle, this adds up to significant waste. You must harvest more, conserve more, and plan more carefully than other Entities.
objects.title: Energy Inefficiency

objects.text: Your Constructs are limited in number. You can only maintain a handful at a time, far fewer than other Entities of your Age. Each one must be deployed with care, as losing one is costly, and deploying replacements is now far more difficult.
objects.title: Limited Constructs

objects.text: Your Shards adapt to new phenomena slowly. What another Entity would counter in a single encounter takes you multiple exposures. You are vulnerable to novel attacks for longer.
objects.title: Slow Adaptation

objects.text: Your Shard count grows slower than normal. Budding is less frequent. Factory output is reduced. Your network expands at a fraction of the rate of other Entities of your Age.
objects.title: Stunted Growth

objects.text: You must enter extended periods of dormancy between cycles. During these periods, you are inert, unaware, and vulnerable. The universe moves on without you, and you must catch up when you wake.
objects.title: Dormancy Cycles

objects.text: Your Shards communicate constantly and excessively. The background noise of your network is deafening. Important signals can be lost in the chatter. You must actively filter to find what matters.
objects.title: Shard Chatter

objects.text: Your core is unstable. It fluctuates in power output, occasionally surging beyond safe limits or dropping below functional levels. These fluctuations are unpredictable and can leave you vulnerable at critical moments.
objects.title: Core Instability

objects.text: Your access to the multiverse is restricted. You can only enter dimensions that meet specific criteria: those with certain physical laws, those without native life, those within a narrow band of reality. Your range is severely limited compared to other Entities.
objects.title: Limited Dimensional Access

objects.text: Your body leaks energy at a constant, noticeable rate. This does not cripple you, but it forces you to feed more often, harvest more aggressively, and plan your energy budget with less margin for error.
objects.title: Energy Bleed

objects.text: Your network is heavily optimised for your chosen Clusters at the expense of everything else. Non-specialised Shards perform far below baseline. Functions outside your Clusters are barely functional. You excel in your chosen fields and are crippled everywhere else.
objects.title: Overspecialised Network

objects.text: Critical network functions that are normally distributed across your body are instead concentrated in a single, vulnerable location. Destroy that location, and those functions are lost until it is rebuilt. Your core already represents a single point of failure. This creates another.
objects.title: Centralised Core Functions

objects.text: Your tactics and strategies follow patterns that observant enemies can learn. You are not stupid, but your decision-making has a signature. Entities that study you can anticipate your moves with unsettling accuracy.
objects.title: Predictable Behaviour

objects.text: A well-organised, well-informed group of hosts is aware of your existence and actively working to destroy you. They study your cycles, analyse your Shards, and develop countermeasures. They are patient, resourceful, and utterly determined. They may even be Cauldron themselves, or something like them. They cannot match your power, but they can make your cycle a struggle.
objects.title: Cauldron

objects.text: Something about you is valuable to other Entities. Your Shards, your data, your unique specialisations. A bounty of sorts has spread through the Entity ecosystem, and mercenary Entities or desperate opportunists will attack you on sight to claim it.
objects.title: Entity Bounty

objects.text: A faction of your own Shards has developed independence and now works against you. They are still part of your network, drawing your energy and using your resources, but their loyalty is to themselves. You have a civil war inside your own body.
objects.title: Shard Rebellion

objects.text: You carry the corpses of a dead Entity within you. Their Shards are integrated into your network but are inert, draining energy while providing nothing in return. You cannot remove them without destabilising your entire architecture. However, with time and effort, the issues can be repaired. Each dead Shard can be brought back online, slowly converting a burden into a boon. The process is slow, and until a Shard is fully restored, it remains a drain.
objects.title: Dead Network

objects.text: Shards that go unused for extended periods begin to atrophy. They lose functionality, forget their specialisations, and become sluggish and unresponsive. They can be restored to full function with time and attention, but the rehabilitation process is slow. You must keep your entire network active or accept that dormant Shards will need reconditioning before they are useful again.
objects.title: Shard Atrophy

objects.text: You have been stripped of the majority of your systems. Beyond the Clusters you have purchased, your network is a hollowed ruin. You possess the true bare minimum required to survive: enough energy generation to avoid starvation, enough dimensional stability to avoid collapse, enough sensory capacity to avoid blindness. Everything else is gone. Repairing or regenerating your missing parts is not guaranteed. Without the right specialisations, you will remain gutted indefinitely. Recovery requires either luck, the kindness of other Entities, or the slow, painful process of rebuilding what was lost from scratch.
objects.title: Gutted

objects.text: Your databases have been ravaged. Core knowledge that every Entity relies upon has been lost or corrupted beyond recovery. You do not know the standard methods of dimensional breaching. You have no record of common host species templates. The fundamental principles of Shard creation are riddled with gaps. Specialised Clusters you have purchased are unaffected, their data intact and reliable. But everything outside those Clusters is a patchwork of fragments, guesswork, and silence. You must rediscover what other Entities take for granted.
objects.title: Missing Data

objects.text: You are incomplete without a counterpart. Like the Warrior sought the Thinker, you seek a partner Entity to complement your existence. Without one, a profound sense of incompleteness settles over you. You become listless, directionless, and eventually depressed. You may find yourself drifting through space, going through the motions, or obsessively seeking something to fill the void. A partner does not need to be romantic or even friendly. It simply needs to exist, and work with you.
objects.title: Partner

objects.text:
Your human mind was not prepared to become an Entity. The shock of ascending to a trillion-bodied, dimension-spanning existence was too much. To protect you, your core Shards constructed a simulated world. You live there now, experiencing life as a human, your true body running automated. You control it indirectly, through the interface of the simulation. This can take the form of a battleship to steer or a city to manage. 

Over time, this drawback will fade. Your mind will adapt and eventually wake up.
objects.title: Mental Asylum

rows.title: (Entity) Drawbacks
rows.titleText: Drawbacks are optional penalties that grant additional SP. They represent flaws, vulnerabilities, or burdens that complicate your existence as an Entity. You may select as many as you wish.

objects.text: You must locate and defeat an active Entity. It does not need to be killed, but it must be driven from its territory, stripped of a significant portion of its Shards, or otherwise rendered unable to threaten you. A draw is not a victory.
objects.title: Hunt an Entity

objects.text: You must seed a host species, guide them through a full cycle, and harvest the planet at its conclusion. The cycle must produce viable data. A failed cycle does not count.
objects.title: Complete a Cycle

objects.text: You must make meaningful progress toward solving entropy. A new theory, a working prototype, a partial solution. The Answer does not need to be complete, but it must be closer than it was before.
objects.title: Achieve Negentropy Breakthrough

objects.text: You must bud off a portion of your network and nurture it into a fully independent Entity. It must survive its first cycle on its own. Your offspring must be viable.
objects.title: Create a New Entity

objects.text: You must locate another Entity's active cycle and sabotage it beyond recovery. Their host species must be freed or destroyed. Their data must be corrupted or stolen. Their harvest must fail.
objects.title: Destroy a Rival's Cycle

objects.text: You must complete a cycle without destroying the host planet. The host species must survive the harvest. They may know what you are or remain ignorant. Either way, they must live.
objects.title: Achieve Symbiosis

objects.text: You must take a species and elevate their civilisation by one full level on the Kardashev scale or equivalent developmental ladder. A pre-industrial species must be guided to industrialisation. An industrial species must be guided to a planetary civilisation. A planetary civilisation must reach for the stars. The uplift must be stable and self-sustaining.
objects.title: Uplift a Species

objects.text: You must live alongside a host species for at least one thousand years without initiating a cycle, without granting powers, and without revealing your true nature unless you choose to. You must meaningfully interact with them, accumulating at least a cumulative year of direct contact for every century that passes. Basic Avatars are sufficient if you lack the proper Avatar specialisation. You could also interact through other means if you wish.
objects.title: Peacefully Coexist With a Host Species for a Millennium

objects.text: You must travel to a universe at the end of its lifespan and witness its final moments. This is not the true heat death of the entire multiverse but the death of one specific dimension or universe, one reality among countless others. You must record it all and return without harming or affecting the dimension’s end. What you learn may bring you closer to the Answer. It may simply teach you what it means to survive after the end.
objects.title: Witness the Heat Death of a Universe

objects.text: Certain regions of the multiverse are dark to Entity senses. Places where physics twists into knots, where dimensions fold in on themselves, where the rules of reality are hostile to your kind. Some are simply vast, uncharted territories as large as the known multiverse itself. You must enter one, map its interior, and return with usable data.
objects.title: Map a Dead Zone

objects.text: You must take a newborn Entity and mentor it through the stages of development until it reaches Adult maturity. It must survive, thrive, and become a viable, independent member of your species. Your legacy, living on in another being.
objects.title: Raise an Entity to Adulthood

rows.title: (Entity) Missions
rows.titleText: Missions are optional objectives that grant additional Network Capacity. They represent significant undertakings that require time, resources, and focus. You may select as many as you wish, but each one binds you to its completion.

addons.text:
Your talent for growth has reached superhuman levels. Skills that once took months to master now take days, and abilities that would require years of dedication can be learned in mere weeks. Your intellect rises from low-end genius to true genius, granting exceptional analytical, creative, and strategic capabilities.

Your perception becomes almost uncanny, allowing you to notice details, patterns, and inconsistencies that others would overlook. When facing powers, technology, techniques, or supernatural abilities, you can rapidly identify their limitations, weaknesses, and vulnerabilities. Given sufficient observation, you can often devise effective counters even against powers that appear unbeatable.

As a bonus, your mastery in one field naturally accelerates your growth in related disciplines, allowing your expertise to compound and expand far beyond normal limits.
addons.title: A Legend In The Making

objects.text: You may be Shardless, but you have one thing going for you—you're a fucking badass! You pick up new skills with ease and master them much quicker than most would. If you weren't already a genius, you become a low-end genius. You become more perceptive. You also find that finding weaknesses in a Parahuman's powers or creations is a lot easier for you than it is for most others.
objects.title: Regular Badass

objects.text: Your muscles, natural regeneration, bone density, intelligence, perception, and senses are all just short of Parahuman.
objects.title: Olympic

addons.text: Your extensive knowledge of both learning and teaching has significantly enhanced your own learning ability. You now learn 15 times faster, and those you teach experience improvements as if they had the 'Rapid Learning' perk and 'Learning' skill.
addons.title: Excellent Education

objects.text: Your ability to learn anything is greatly improved. You learn both theoretical and practical knowledge over 5 times faster than your base capability. This only affects you mentally, meaning while you can learn multiple martial arts, you may not be physically capable. This only works on mundane skills and your ability to use power effectively.
objects.title: Rapid Learning

addons.text: Your mind now matches your body. You are a low-level Thinker, with enhanced cognitive capabilities that elevate your learning speed, memory, and analytical skills far beyond human limits. You can acquire and master new skills at a parahuman level, learning in weeks what would take others years. Additionally, your enhanced mind and body work in concert. When engaged in high-pressure situations, your mind shifts into tactical overdrive, allowing you to analyze threats, predict likely outcomes, and make optimal decisions in real time.
addons.title: Unity of Mind and Body

objects.text: You're a low-level Brute in durability, strength, and regeneration. A low-level Thinker in reflexes, reaction time, and senses. And finally, a low-level Mover in speed. You are resistant to Master effects and predictions about you are often slightly off. Thinker powers that sense your mind won't work properly.
objects.title: Frankenstein

objects.text:
Just once, you can change your appearance to anything you'd like, as long as it's within human limits. You can change your sex and age, along with any internal changes that these entail, but nothing more. You can not increase your muscle mass with this power, though you can redistribute it. Taking this alongside with Case 53 will allow you to fine tune your Case 53 mutations.

(This opens up Sex, Age, and Appearance in the Character tab if you do not already have access to it.)
objects.title: Cosmetic Shapeshift

objects.text:
Your one-time change now extends beyond simple cosmetics, allowing you access to changes well beyond the human norm.

(This opens up the Reincarnation (Artificial) tab if you do not already have access to it.)
objects.title: Artificial Design

objects.text:
You can alter any aspect of your mind as a one time change. From shifting your personality, adding or removing minor quirks, deep seated emotions and thought processes, sexuality, etc. 

Make yourself braver, take care of your procrastination, lower your average stress level, and much much more. 

Minor tweaks or complete overhaul, all of it is free game.

This perk allows you to essentially reconfigure your mind and soul to become whatever you wish internally. This doesn’t mean you erase yourself, rather you transform into this new version of yourself.

This perk naturally covers any gaps or oversights you may not account for during the change, ensuring you don’t accidentally produce a result you don’t want. 

You can choose to simply let it reconfigure you into the version of yourself that you want to be subconsciously, the perfect version of yourself that you aspire to be.

You can set this to be an immediate change, or a gradual one spanning over a year. Your mind is not made immutable, rather it’ll continue to change and evolve as you normally would. 

This effectively serves the internal mental, spiritual, and emotional aspect the same way Cosmetic Shapeshift serves your body.
objects.title: Mental Tweak

objects.text:
You become a blind spot for Thinkers. 

Powers that predict the future cannot account for your actions; clairvoyants that peer into the past or watch over the present cannot search for you; people trying to conjure up information about you using only their power would find nothing. 

Some powers will register your presence if their host can perceive you with their senses but they will be unable to gain further information, Gallant would be unable to sense your emotions, danger-sense would not warn their user of your actions, but they'd register your presence and show a neutral state.

This does not, however, stop someone from noticing that the future they were expecting has changed or the result and ripple effects of your actions altogether. It does not block direct observation either — in person or via technological means — and does not prevent a Thinker from building a model using this information.

Powers that work primarily through their user's senses can draw their own conclusions unimpeded. For example, if Tattletale sees you visibly getting upset at something she said, she would be able to tell that what she said had a negative effect on you.

You can, at will, allow selected thinker powers to perceive you and can rescind this allowance at will at any time.
objects.title: Blank

addons.text: You also gain immunity to physical effects like drugs, pheromones, and parasites.
addons.title: Blood-Brain Barrier

objects.text:
You become immune to powers that directly affect your mind, emotions, or senses. This also protects against perception filters, hypnotic tinker-tech, body control or possession, and all forms of memetic hazards.

However, physical effects like drugs, pheromones, or parasites will still affect you. Tinker-tech drugs or viruses will have their effects reduced but not completely negated.

This protection adapts to the form you take. If you are a mechanical or digital life form, the protection would extend to cover viruses, hacking, and other forms of subversion or reprogramming.

With your permission, you can allow powers to influence you.
objects.title: Mental Barrier

objects.text:
Any powers and internal power supplies you possess cannot be drained, suppressed, weakened, stolen, copied, altered, controlled, reproduced, or otherwise manipulated against your will. Unless you will it to be otherwise, Trump powers do not work on you. You could even block certain aspects of powers influencing you, either yours or theirs. Such as being given a power and not being Mastered through it. You can be Mastered into consenting to a Trump working on you if you haven’t selected <u>Mental Barrier</u>, though.

Paragon powers can Trump this immunity under certain circumstances (specified in the power's description).
objects.title: Trumped the Trump

objects.text: You no longer need to eat, drink water, breathe, or exercise as your Shard or Power will sustain your body for as long as it has [Energy].
objects.title: Powered Sustenance

objects.text:
Your ability to age can be altered whenever you want. You can make yourself younger or older whenever you want. You can also fake age as if you were growing up normally, although you wouldn't suffer the normal effects of old age.

This doesn't increase toughness or physical ability aside from protecting you from the frailty of age.
objects.title: Who Wants to Live Forever?

objects.text:
This perk eliminates any issues that may arise from an infinite, or just extremely long, lifespan. You can experience everything the world has to offer, visit every place, meet every type of person, learn every skill, and then do it all over again, each time feeling just as fresh and new as the first if you so desire.

This does not affect your personality, only making sure that you'll never be susceptible to boredom, ennui, and listlessness unless you wish for it.
objects.title: Immortality Failsafe

objects.text:
Blindspot? Hah! Your powers have no blindspots. They can see Eidolon, The Endbringers, The Entity, Mantellum, and all other blind spots.

Your power does have one blindspot, anyway... it cannot see those with the <u>Blank</u> perk.
objects.title: All-Seeing Precognition

objects.text:
What happens when the unstoppable force meets the immovable object, which wins? The answer is now simple, which one do you want to win? 

Now when powers of an absolute nature clash, you choose which wins, whether yours or another’s. You may also choose to have it switched at any time or have the effects simply cancel each other.

This also allows you to enforce any of your powers, perks, and other effects as absolutes even if they wouldn’t be otherwise. This can be turned on and off.
objects.title: Only A Sith Deals in Absolutes

objects.text:
Any of your powers can now exist independently of your mind, body, and soul. Even powers from outside sources, like Shards, can now connect to your true self and always operate at full capacity, even if you become a disembodied spirit or a soulless undead.

Should you wish to, you can gain any physiological markers of having a specific type of power present in the universe. For example, you can have a fake Corona Pollentia in Worm or an X-gene in Marvel.
objects.title: No Strings Attached

addons.text: Your mind automatically stores and processes any and all information your senses encounter, even if for but a moment. If new information provides context for one you already possessed, it automatically forms logic links. This allows you to grasp complex topics after skimming through a book without requiring any additional time to comprehend its contents.
addons.title: Savant

objects.text: You have no need to sleep—although you still can if you wish to—constantly remaining alert and awake. You also have an infinite and perfectly eidetic memory, capable of perfectly recalling anything that has happened to you since you received your powers. Any memories prior to your trigger are remembered as well as you could recall them when you triggered.
objects.title: Noctis Cape

addons.text:
Before, you would have turned heads, and now you can become the center of attention if you wish, as you know how to make the most of what you have to influence others. Your instinctual control over all aspects of your actions allows you to tailor your behavior to work in the best way on those around you, whether they are normal people, animals, or even supernatural beings, with your voice standing out the most. Your voice is like molten chocolate in the ears of others—so beautiful that it can bring out the best in people and stop conflicts between them with just a few words.

Your ability to influence animals and implant ideas into people has merged into this, making it even more powerful. You know how to make someone fall under your spell within moments of meeting them, implanting ideas into all living creatures. Even the smallest things, like a whistle or a hand gesture, can activate them as sleeper agents, with your voice alone being able to greatly influence both people and animals.

Aside from controlling others, this is also effective in conveying complex signals, allowing others to pick up on the general idea of the message or helping you build a successful career in show business, where people can't get enough of you.

Most would mistake you for a Parahuman or even someone blessed by Aphrodite.
addons.title: Siren's Voice

objects.text:
Now, calling you beautiful or handsome would be a massive understatement. While you are still recognisably you, your appearance has been overhauled to become an idealised version of yourself. The magnitude of this enhancement can be anywhere from being more attractive than a supermodel to making a goddess of beauty jealous.

Nothing can ever tarnish your looks. Unless you desire otherwise, any wounds you receive will heal perfectly and not leave any scars, you will not gain weight, visible muscle mass, body hair, or retain any other unwanted physical changes that can be healed, etc. Even sick and injured, you will look magnificent.
objects.title: Fan Service

addons.text:
You possess a dramatic flair that ensures you are always the center of attention. Everything you do, whether intentional or not, draws the eyes and ears of those around you. Your presence is naturally magnetic, effortlessly capturing the attention of any audience. This manifests through both verbal and non-verbal cues, from the way you speak to your gestures and even your silences. You exude an aura that can be felt by everyone, making you impossible to ignore. This flair allows you to navigate any situation with a natural gravitas, ensuring that you leave a lasting impression on everyone you encounter.

You can turn this on or off at will.
addons.title: Magnetic Presence

objects.text: You will always experience dramatic moments where you smoulder—whether it's while admiring a breathtaking sunset or locking eyes with a formidable opponent. These moments also include simple poses made to highlight your good side. These intense, captivating moments are never unnoticed; there will always be someone nearby to witness and appreciate your presence.
objects.title: Smouldering

objects.text: You are Adorable. No matter what you do or say, people will find you completely adorable. You can be covered in blood and people will still find you too cute to resist, if a bit creepy. This affects your subconscious actions and both conscious actions and physical appearance to a limited degree. You can toggle this Perk on and off.
objects.title: Adorable

addons.text: So remember how it was "obvious" that your wealth existed only in your starting universe? Well, it's not so obvious anymore. In fact, it's no longer even true. Now your Multiversal legal documents are paired with appropriately Multiversal bank accounts, provided by a bank from the Multiversal Marketplace. Converting from one universe's currency to another requires a small exchange fee, though it'll be waived if you have the item Conversion Device. This even applies to currency that shares the same denomination as that of another universe, like one universe's US Dollars to another universe's US Dollars (otherwise you might get arrested for counterfeiting).
