Points of exchange are diegetically integrated into whatever world you're in; in modern or technologically advanced worlds it might be done through their official website, in a somewhat retro world you might have to go to a local bank to arrange a transfer from out-of-state or use telephone banking, in a post-apocalyptic world there might be representatives attached to trade caravans and their depots, and in a fantasy world you might have to go to a large city to find a moneychanger, but it will always be as convenient (or inconvenient) as can be reasonably expected from the setting.
addons.title: Offshore Bank Accounts

objects.text:
You have Batman's real superpower: Money. This comes in the form of numerous bank accounts, investments, and assets worth millions, several properties worldwide, and a few safehouses. These assets are only on your world of arrival.

The money refreshes as you spend it, either from interest or dividends, but you only have 5 million dollars in liquid assets. If you need to withdraw any more than that, you'll need to talk to your private banker.
objects.title: Wealthy

objects.text:
You have a legal identity in the place of your arrival. You can choose to customize this legal identity within reason, ranging from a student of a certain school to a dockworker to a lawyer.

This is mostly useless if you choose Reincarnate or Character-Insert, though a homeless person or a sufficiently young orphan might not have one.
objects.title: Legal Identity

objects.text: If you possess any means to travel across the multiverse, the first time you enter a new world, you may choose to have an established identity there. This identity includes the necessary paper trail and can be customised within reason, ranging from a student at a certain school to a dockworker to a lawyer.
objects.title: Multiversal Citizenship

objects.text: Not only do you have a legal form of identification, you have actual history in this world. Expect to be approached by people who knew you before your drop in.
objects.title: History

objects.text:
People with the same goals, principles, or personality are more likely to mesh well together. Even if they were your enemies yesterday, you find it easier to befriend and work with them. Yesterday's enemies can be today's friends, against a common foe the both of you somehow work wonderfully together.

It's easier for people to set aside their differences and work together. You'll be more likely to work well together on a team. This even makes actions like Tinkering together easier.
objects.title: Peaceful Vibes

objects.text:
You are exactly the kind of person powerful groups want on their side.

Your abilities, potential, temperament, connections, or usefulness make you stand out as a valuable prospect to nearly any organization that becomes aware of you. 

Governments, hero teams, villain groups, corporations, secret societies, independent factions, and similar powers will all be more inclined to investigate you, approach you, and offer you a place with them.

This does not make them irrational, careless, or blindly trusting, but it does mean they will view you as someone worth recruiting rather than someone to ignore, discard, or casually oppose. 

Offers made to you are better than they would be for someone else in your position, with groups more willing to negotiate, provide incentives, overlook minor or major issues, or offer unusual arrangements in order to secure your cooperation.

To put it bluntly, they’ll often pull out all of the stops to get you to join. 

Even extremely secretive, selective, or exclusive groups are affected by this. 

If Cauldron exists and is capable of contacting you, they will become aware of you and extend some form of recruitment offer within six months of your arrival at most. The exact offer depends on your power, usefulness, behavior, and the time period you arrive in.

You may delay any such offer, even indefinitely, until you are willing and able to properly consider it. You may also decline without retaliation, provided you do not actively make yourself their enemy.

Groups will still try to remain on good terms afterward, seeing you as a valuable possible ally, asset, or future recruit. Even after a refusal, they may continue to curry favor, offer assistance, provide opportunities, or leave the door open for later cooperation.
objects.title: Prime Recruit

objects.text:
Your will is absolute, boundless, and unbreakable. Maybe it’s your ideals, an all-consuming ambition, or maybe it's just a rock-solid certainty in how you see the world. You are patient beyond belief, even capable of spending countless hours doing mind-numbing tasks. Your willpower is endless and no matter how difficult the situation, even if you're torn in half, locked in a time loop of endless agony for thousands of years, or subjected to a fate worse than death, you'll be able to shrug it off. You will never be left drifting without a sense of purpose, and though you might change your goals and refine your ideals you always have the motivation to fuel turning them into a reality.

This will greatly bolster your sense of self in the face of adversity, and you’ll be able to plant your feet when everyone else is giving up. Of course, you still have emotions and you can still be hurt emotionally, but you'll always be able to maintain your composure and keep your emotions from ruling your decision-making. Take care that you don't become so tunnel-visioned that you fail to see others as actual people with agency.
objects.title: Invictus

objects.text:
You won't lose your sanity or rationality under any circumstances unless you're being controlled by a power. And even if you somehow did, no matter the circumstances, you will never lose your humanity and empathy. Your team, family, or friends will always be there to bring you back from the abyss. Your personal issues are much easier to work through and even without help you'll be able to get through them in time. This might take a while if it's bad, but you'll make it out eventually.

This also makes you highly resistant to mental health problems and emotional manipulation, though not completely immune. You’re also really good at helping others through their issues, and it’ll stick more often than not as long as you can get through to them.
objects.title: Well-Adjusted

addons.text: You have developed a mindset and perspective on life that only naturally immortal or incredibly long-lived species possess. While you don't lose the capability to act swiftly, you can also let millennia pass by without so much as noticing it, floating through life as if on autopilot. You naturally consider time on more vast timescales than any mortal human could dream of, allowing you to create plans that may take thousands of years to come to fruition.
addons.title: Eternal Mind

objects.text: Your patience is inexhaustible.  You could sit without moving for days with no problem, or easily spend countless hours on a single, mind-numbing task.
objects.title: Patience of a Saint

objects.text:
Isn't it embarrassing to be afraid of something that poses no threat to you whatsoever? Now, as long as something cannot harm you or the threat is negligible, you will not feel any fear towards it.

Even if you were deathly afraid of heights, should you obtain the power of flight, the fear will vanish, and should you have suffered from an extreme case of arachnophobia, you can crawl through the tunnel filled with spiders, with maybe a healthy amount of caution should there possibly be a poisonous breed, neither will any jumpscare so much as make you flinch.
objects.title: Intrepid

objects.text:
Your character’s history has been altered slightly.

Perhaps you are Taylor Herbert, the son of Danny Herbert, the Great Hero Eidolon. Maybe you grew up in a different city; maybe you have more family members; maybe you had your powers for far longer; maybe you had your powers even before going through the CYOA, etc.

With all methods of Incarnation, this allows you to alter the Meta (Target)’s history prior to the CYOA. If bought as a Character Insert or Reincarnation, this also allows you to apply it to the character your Meta (Target) is inserting into.

(Note: While you can’t make any large changes directly to the setting or storyline with just this, any changes that would make sense with your other choices are fair game. If you character insert as Victoria Dallon, but alter your history to have always had an Endbringer controlling power you bought here then the world's history will be altered accordingly.)
objects.title: Altered History

objects.text:
You gain a reputation easily, a spark of appearance that makes you shine. Your accomplishments are often embellished by others or people just credit things happening to you. Anything you do will be amazing and astounding. Even in losing, you seem to lose gracefully and in winning you seem like an unsurmountable giant. The impression you give can change depending on how you want, you could be cool or cute, handsome or beautiful. The way you move, talk, and fight will always be astonishing, even if you didn't intend to. 

This makes it easier to bluff your way out of a situation and gives you leverage in getting what you want. This can be toggled on and off.
objects.title: Reputable

addons.text:
Your intimidating reputation has carved out a small slice of happiness for you. Those who would be your enemies will do almost anything to stop you from coming out of retirement; You will be bribed, placated or given favours at the mere whisper of you returning to the world you once abandoned. Your direct family will also be safe from  any reprisal. Only when you pick up the sword again will your old foes try to defeat you. 

Do enjoy your retirement whilst it lasts.
addons.title: The One Who Left It All Behind

objects.text: You’ve already built up an incredibly intimidating reputation for yourself, having spent years tearing apart enemies that everyone thought were unbeatable. Those that manage to get away are usually crippled and doing whatever they can to avoid a second encounter. Most will not dare to go against you without it being absolutely necessary and armed to the teeth, and even then they’ll triple-check to make sure. They’ll still feel like they’re about to get their teeth kicked in.
objects.title: A Pencil. A Fucking Pencil!

addons.text:
You are more than a Natural Leader, for you are a once-in-a-generational leader of men who will one day be known the world over, with your name spoken of in intrigue, admiration, and fear. With the Charismatic and all the skills needed, you are someone capable of bringing change to the world, and people can feel that as recruitment becomes even easier, with even those who possess powers being more willing to follow you, or at least hear you out first (whether that stems from genuine interest, curiosity, or amusement depends on the people in question).

You can more quickly rise through the ranks of power and authority in whatever organization you join, or even come to find yourself leading your own faction. You are able to lead the greatest of nations, leaving an impressive footprint behind, or turn around a struggling nation going through multiple crises at once.

You are destined to be one of the Greats; now the question is, how will the people know you?
addons.title: World Leader

objects.text: People tend to look to you for guidance and leadership. You have an easy time recruiting people, and for some reason, they tend to be pretty loyal. People with powers might take a bit more convincing, mostly because they know their value.
objects.title: Natural Leader

objects.text: No matter what happens, you will keep your identity hidden even by using one minor cosmetic change. For example, putting on glasses or styling your hair differently.
objects.title: Cover Story

objects.text: As a Hero, isn’t it just a pain in the ass when you get fired from your job because you had to leave in the middle of work to go save the city? That’s no longer a problem for you. Whenever a situation comes up that needs your attention, be it a bank getting robbed or your drug operation getting busted, you can leave what you’re doing to go handle it and still have a job to come back to. In essence, this means you don’t have to worry about your social life suffering because of your hero or villain life.
objects.title: Double Life

objects.text: You're not unlucky. You won't get killed by accident, only by something someone did intentionally. Someone has to go out of their way to kill you if they want you dead. This power doesn't protect you from Endbringers (or any other truly overpowered or world-ending threats).
objects.title: 'Plot' Armor

objects.text: As someone with experience with either alcohol or hard drugs, your body has adapted to their effects, allowing you to maintain some level of control in your actions even when drunk or drugged. You still experience the physical and emotional symptoms of intoxication and drugs, but you are able to better control your impulses and stay focused on the tasks at hand. This doesn't completely negate the effects of alcohol or drugs, but it can help you stay somewhat regulated.
objects.title: Controlled Intoxication

objects.text: Wildbow's Shard, like any other Warrior Shard, was geared for conflict, and so what would really happen is a bit more spaced out. In other words, you have an extra two years, two months, and 13 days until Gold Morning, and the events of Ward also took twice as long and started two years, two months, and 13 days later.
objects.title: Conflicted Predictions

addons.text: Your magical girl transformation conceals your identity from those who observe you. It prevents your true identity from being revealed regardless of attempts to bypass it. The actions you take, how you speak, how you act, and even DNA analysis cannot reveal who you are unless you tell them. You can even transform in front of someone and they still won't recognize you.
addons.title: Cognition Inhibitor

addons.text:
Your transformation into a Magical Girl, along with any other transformation abilities you have, whether they’re rooted in technology, the supernatural, magic, or otherwise is protected. You cannot be interrupted during your transformation nor can your transformation be prevented. Attacks against you will fail in a manner that provides sufficient time not only to transform comfortably but also to perform an entire dance mid-transformation or engage in any other action that enhances the flair of your transformation. This will protect from Endbringers and other overpowered or world-ending threats. But this protection only lasts until you transform, normal 'Plot' Armor will protect you once you've transformed.

Additionally, you are given the time to transform during time-critical events and somehow not waste a single second. No matter how important it is, your transformation somehow doesn't waste time even if everyone watched you do a tiny dance when a bomb needs to be defused.
addons.title: Transformation Montage

objects.text: You are a magical girl; you have a transformation sequence to turn into your Magical Girl form. This provides no benefit and is purely for show. The transformation can be instant if you wish it.
objects.title: Magical Girl

addons.text: Fan Service now extends to all of your powers, at least those that manifest visually.
addons.title: Visual Effects

objects.text:
Your powers take on a certain theme. Teleportation now melds with the shadows if you have a dark theme, and Tinker abilities can decorate swords without negatively impacting performance. This doesn't weaken or strengthen any of your powers, but it does make it more thematically accurate to whatever you choose.

You can choose to follow or switch your theme whenever you wish. And rebranding yourself comes to you easier.
objects.title: Thematic

objects.text:
You gain a theme song or even multiple theme songs that can either come from an unknown source or your mind. You can even have a song for every emotion you're currently feeling. It can be any song or even an unknown song that fits the current situation. You're not limited by the number of songs you can possess and can even add more songs later on.

The songs you play can be selectively heard by whomever you choose. You can choose to switch your theme song whenever you wish. You can also choose to disable this if you no longer want to.
objects.title: Theme Song

objects.text:
You can control how much your actions affect the future of the world. Even if you arrived a few thousand years before the events depicted in some medium, no matter how much you affect the past, the same characters that you are familiar with will still be born, and the same plot will still happen.

This does not work if you deliberately act to prevent certain events, but otherwise, fate can be extremely flexible, bending over backwards to ensure that history plays out the same way you remember it. Some histories and character backstories may change, depending on the magnitude of your interference, but never become completely unrecognisable.
objects.title: Just as Planned

objects.text:
The inside of your body is protected against influences that attempt to target it. For example, a telekinetic cannot crush your heart inside of your chest.

You also gain some measure of resistance to esoteric attacks like instant death or erasure. This is not complete immunity and will still hurt you, severely, but you will at least have a chance to survive.
objects.title: Manton Protected

addons.text: Your resistance to supernatural attempts to influence has gained a new dimension, allowing you to resist time travel-based alterations. Now, if someone changes the past in such a way that your body is altered, you can reject the change. For example, if the new timeline resulted in you losing an eye, you can choose to reject that change and regain your binocular vision. Like before, bring the change back if needed. This has a limit, though; the more powerful the being / force that created this new timeline is, the less you can resist the changes. If the person who did it is weaker or as strong as you, you can reject the physical changes just fine. If they are more than double but less than an order of magnitude stronger than you, you can reject crippling changes like a missing limb or a slave seal tattoo, but cosmetic changes like a new haircut or mundane tattoos can’t be rejected. If they are more than a hundred times stronger than you, then lethal changes can be rejected, but crippling changes like loss of limbs can’t be. If they are more than a thousand times stronger than you, just accept your fate. If you have Golden Perks as well, you can reject any retroactive changes to your body, no matter how much stronger the source is compared to you. Note: This only works with time travel or other retroactive reality shifts. If someone just uses their power to change your hair color or something without altering the past (and Manton Protected didn’t already stop it), you can’t use this to reverse it.
addons.title: Ripple Effect Proof Body

objects.text:
Your mind and memories are protected from any and all alteration that would arise from the changes to reality, history, and timelines. Whenever history changes, you will keep both your original memories and the new ones that resulted from new history. This extends to all changes brought about by time and reality manipulation, including time loops and timeline resets.

You can choose to let the memories of the current or previous timelines lie as purely encyclopedic knowledge or influence you as if you truly lived through them, as well as change your decision at will.

This, however, does not protect you from directly having your memories rewritten through something like telepathy.
objects.title: Ripple Effect Proof Memory

objects.text:
You have a way home, but only once.

After you reach the natural end of the story, such as defeating Scion, resolving the central crisis of the setting, or achieving an equivalent victory condition in an Alternate Earth, this perk activates. If the setting has no clear final victory condition, it becomes available after 25 years.

Once available, you may use this perk to return to your original world. You keep all powers, perks, skills, memories, and changes gained during your journey. You may also bring any companions, followers, bound items, personal equipment, objects of power, or possessions that are able and willing to come with you.

With 2 purchases, instead of arriving home after the same amount of time has passed, you may return to the exact moment you left, the next morning, or another narratively appropriate point shortly after your departure.

You may also choose to restore your age and/or body to what they would have been had you never left, while still keeping everything you gained. This is optional. You can return unchanged, partially restored, or fully restored as you prefer.

This return is one-time only.
objects.title: Return Ticket

objects.text:
Any teleportation or similar power you possess now allows you to travel to other universes. You can travel to any universe you have previously been to, including your home universe, as well as target universes based on any knowledge you possess, such as memories you had prior to gaining powers, awareness of a setting through some form of media, etc.

If you have no such ability, you can still travel to other worlds by accessing the medium in which it is depicted. For example, a Harry Potter book for the Harry Potter universe, a Skyrim game for Skyrim, etc.
objects.title: Homecoming

objects.text:
If you possess any means to travel across the multiverse, you can choose to re-enter any universe you have previously been to at the exact same time you left it, no matter how much time has passed. This includes your original world.

If you have any powers that allow you to interact with other universes without actually moving to them, they will count as if you were there when used.
objects.title: Resume

objects.text: Now, you can return to any universe you have previously been to even before you left. Unless you possess other means of time-travel, you can only go as far back as the moment you were born, and after arriving in the universe, you will take the place of your younger self, assuming its appearance and, at the same time, retaining all your powers and memories.
objects.title: Rewind

addons.title: Self-Deceiving Powers
addons.text:
You can now selectively hide any Power you’re supressing from your other Powers. Any ability that triggers in response to the danger you’re in, such as (Trump) Queen of Escalation or Soul Resonance, will now calculate the danger you’re in by how much strength you’re currently not suppressing as opposed to how much you actually have.

Realistically there is little that could threaten a Legendary Super Saiyan (Dragon Ball Series) in A Song of Ice and Fire, but now (Thinker) Danger Sense still responds as if you were a regular human.

The selective nature of your concealment does mean you can have Forged In The Trials of Combat trigger as if you were a regular human, but have the improvements it grants apply to the entirety of your power instead of to merely what you’re currently using.

objects.text:
Every single aspect of your powers, strength, and perks can be selectively toggled and dialed to the point they can be turned completely off. You can also select people and individuals who are not affected by your perks and powers, making it seem as if they're capable of withstanding reality-breaking attacks. You can scale your reality-ending destruction to be tuned down to cause mild concussions, granting you the ability to not overkill everything in existence. As long as you wish it, it’s almost impossible to kill someone if you don't want to.

This does not work on drawbacks or on perks that rely on items like Wealthy.
objects.title: Holding Back

addons.text:
You now have control over how others interpret the nature of any and all of your powers and abilities. For example, you can disguise any of your powers so that they appear to belong to a completely different power system, such as masking your magic powers as psionics and vice versa. This is so powerful that even if the nature of powers may be revealed through something like a blood test, everyone will still come to the conclusion that your powers are exactly what you present as.

While not granting you any direct buffs, as the nature of your powers doesn't truly change, if something in the world is conditioned upon you having the right nature of power, you can appear as if you satisfy any such requirement.
addons.title: Red Herring

objects.text:
You can now selectively conceal your true capabilities. When doing so, no device or ability will be able to detect your hidden powers.

You can either conceal any or all of your powers and skills completely, appearing as if you never possessed them in the first place, hide only some aspects of those, or, alternatively, just limit the detectable level of strength, appearing weaker than you truly are.
objects.title: Hidden Strength

objects.text:
You are now immune to the negative side effects of power sources from outside yourself, whether it be combat drugs, enchantments, items, divine blessings, curses, and anything that empowers you or that you wield in some manner.

This means that if a drug could enhance your strength tenfold but reduced your life by half, you could take it as you please with no worry for the cost as it doesn’t impact you.

Likewise, if an item granted you the power to see the future at the cost of inevitable madness, feel free to use it as you please as your mind remains as sharp and crystal clear decades after, as before you even touched the item.

Made a pact with a demon for the ability to manipulate light, the cost being your soul, weakness to holy objects, and an inability to use your powers or even walk on holy ground? Walk into a church, pray, utilize your light to create an interesting spectacle for the parishioners, and fret not for your soul is still your own.

This also comes with complete immunity to addiction.

The perk doesn’t expand upon the power, nor does it add new abilities; it merely removes the complications that may arise from the power.

This allows you to benefit from all the positives of outside power sources, with any negative mechanics and complications wiped away or shifted to be non-detrimental, such as a demonic force’s natural weakness and aversion to holy objects. However, it would not add new aspects; it removes negative effects and factors, but doesn’t create new beneficial ones.
objects.title: Accentuate the Positive

objects.text:
You are now immune to the negative side effects of your self-derived powers.

For example, magic that may have used your emotions and/or stamina to fuel its power now has a separate pool to draw upon so as to not leech off you.

Likewise, any aspect of your abilities that negatively affects your mental state, your body, your soul, or any other aspect of yourself is wiped away or shifted to a non-detriment.

Are you a Kryptonian weak to Green Kryptonite? Now chuck that useless rock as if it was some common quartz rock. Let those grunts think they have a chance because they’ve got their magic bullet only to laugh in their face as that bullet does nothing.

Your magic leaves you barely able to stand, fog your mind, or scar your soul? Not anymore. Fire as many spells as you wish—your health, body, mind, and soul remains unfazed. Your magic instead drains from a separate pool that replenishes over time.

Your bloodline grants you the power to enter a form that gives phenomenal cosmic power in exchange for giving up your humanity? Feel free to shift back and forth as you wish. Enjoy the benefits of remaining who you were with all the pleasure of having all that power.

The perk doesn’t expand upon the power, nor does it add new abilities; it merely removes the complications that may arise from the power.

This allows you to benefit from all the positives of your powers. Any drawbacks, powers, biological traits, or magic systems that may have held any negative complication or mechanics have been wiped away or shifted to be non-detrimental. However, it would not add new aspects; it removes negative effects and factors but doesn’t create new beneficial ones.

It would remove a Kryptonian's natural weakness to Green Kryptonite, but not their dependence on sunlight, nor would it grant new abilities for perceived limitations.
objects.title: Eliminate the Negative

objects.text:
Alongside eliminating any drawbacks your powers come with, you can turn them into strengths.

Whenever you encounter an effect that would naturally weaken or debilitate you as a result of the powers you possess, you are instead enhanced by the same margin.

For example, as a Kryptonian, Green Kryptonite would amplify your power, pushing you as far away in strength from your normal form as you are to humans.

This applies automatically; however, you can choose for it to not take effect if you wish, for any reason.
objects.title: Platinum Kryptonite

objects.text:
In some universes, certain champions of justice travel through the atmosphere at superluminal speeds without igniting everything for miles and lift buildings, even though they should crumble due to structural integrity. Now, so can you.

Not only do you have any required secondary powers that your primary powers might require to be used without horrifying or destructive implications, but, provided you have the powers for it, you can lift buildings without them falling apart and move at speeds in the multiple digits without destroying everything if you don't want to.

You now have complete control over the amount of collateral damage your attacks can output such that a planet-busting punch will only affect your enemy, not the planet itself. It all just works.
objects.title: Comic Book Physics

addons.text:
Some people might think you're the child of a Shounen Hero and a Magical Girl, given how easily you can form and maintain so many friendships at once. These bonds are genuine and deep, and they begin to have a positive impact on those you connect with.

As a result, they become better at communicating their feelings and intentions to others. Having someone with whom they can speak frankly allows them to grow in ways they might not have been able to if they were alone. Gaining the encouragement to take risks or stand up for themselves are just a few examples of how you and your friendships uplift each other, making each of you better than before.

This improvement can also be seen in rivals. At first, it may seem like you and they are only getting better at defeating each other and others, but as time goes on, both you and they find other aspects of your lives improving thanks to having someone to compete against. Even something as simple and complex as ideals is refined through this conflict between you.

For you, friendship almost seems like a power in itself. Though, no giant friendship lasers included—you'll have to look elsewhere for that.
addons.title: Joys of Friendship, Passion of Rivalry

objects.text: You find it easier to make friends, and the friends you do make are in it for the long run.
objects.title: Friendly

objects.text:
You find it easier to explain how your powers work and people will have an easier time accepting it in a way that works for them. There can't be some misunderstanding on what you can or can't do unless you purposely make yourself vague.

To the greater world, your out-of-context powers will be forcefully shoved into some random explanation. Maybe your magical totems are some kind of Tinker restriction or psychic powers are some kind of PR move. If you choose to, even doctors doing in-depth medical scans would treat the strange growth in your brain as normal.
objects.title: Explained

addons.text: You may choose whether your chosen significant other suffers from Yandere Syndrome. If you do, they will receive both the increased muscle density and behavioral changes. You may choose how badly it affects them: from sweet and a little possessive and overprotective, to utterly psychotic and willing to commit murder-suicide at the drop of a hat, or everywhere in between.
addons.title: Love Sick

objects.text:
Through a stroke of fate, you either have or will soon find your soulmate. Maybe you’ve yet to meet them, or maybe—if you are a reincarnation—you already have prior history together; every single detail is completely up to you. You can leave this entirely to chance, or you may optionally choose now whom this may be, anyone of your choice. Either way, when you next cross paths, you’ll both immediately and unmistakably know that you’re meant for each other.

They are matched to your ideal in every way, and you are the same for them. Whether it’s a romantic interest, a friendship, or anything else—you're perfect for each other. You get along easily and flawlessly, your bond is unbreakable, you're both willing to go to hell and back for one another and support each other to be the best versions of yourselves, and every bit of love is reciprocated. All you need is each other, and even if that’s all you had, it would still be the happiest time of your life.

If you genuinely want this level of relationship or to develop one with someone in the future, you’ll find that things will very quickly and organically progress to this level.

You can optionally extend this perk to affect any and all companions you purchase.
objects.title: A Significant Other

objects.text:
With all those troubles that come with a super life, you can never have enough "me time". This Perk helps you by letting all your troubles take a "day off". An eldritch monster is trying to devour reality, and you are the only one who can stop it? Relax, it won't happen until you have your "free day".

A super tinker is planning to take over the world? Relax, that won't happen when you are playing your games, having a date, or even on the beach. This perk takes action from time to time while you are relaxing or too stressed.
objects.title: Peaceful Life

objects.text:
You have chosen to make your world rather mundane. Here, conflicts are less about world ending, or even city ending, threats. Instead, a lot of the issues are low stakes, like maybe the Endbringers are instead asshole neighbors, or the One Piece is just an old collectible that your uncle, Roger, lost a long while ago, etc. This modifier affects most of the named cast in the setting of your choosing, changing their stories to be a little less deadly (though Death could still come in mundane scenarios).

Note that this does not remove the superpowered, scifi, or fantasy elements of your world. Big things could still very much be happening in the background, it's just that, the scale of what the point of view focused on is lowered considerably for the cast. You could also potentially still be able to find some stuff to spice up the experience, but nothing too grand scale. 

Good for folks who want a more relaxing experience.
objects.title: A Slice in Life

objects.text: Your body will be completely self-cleaning. The moment you close your eyes, and wish to be clean, any filth, dirt, and grime built up on your body and or your clothing will magically disappear, this also includes your dental hygiene. Not only that, but you'll also carry a wonderful scent, perfectly tailored to the liking of yourself and those around you, such that everyone smells you a little different, but loves it all the same. You'll both smell, feel, and be heavenly fresh forevermore.
objects.title: World Clean

objects.text:
You can choose the art style & visuals of whatever universe you're in on the fly. This doesn't functionally change anything, and you're the only one who notices, but sometimes the universe badly needs a redesign.

You can mix and match styles and even set conditions, like if, for example, you wanted everything in the Wormverse to look as gloomy as normal, but in-costume capes looked like four-color comic heroes. That said, this isn't a Thinker power, and you can't use it to "cheat." For example, you can't pull the old video game trick of having plot-important items that look significantly more detailed than regular ones.
objects.title: Art Style

objects.text:
You are not just you, but a combination of yourself and another. Pick someone else that could fit into one of the Meta (Target) options, and both such Meta options are combined into one person.

You can choose how this is manifests, from being a perfect merger of the two, mind, body, soul and more, to some strange amalgamation or hybrid. Maybe one’s mind is in another’s body, or maybe a melding of their personalities and/or souls, balancing out opposing traits and further reinforcing similar ones. Or perhaps it’s simply one person in their own body with memories of another life as well, or maybe they were simply a past life that they can now vividly remember.

They can even be two versions of the same person, ones who had walked on wildly different paths and underwent vastly different experiences.

If you’ve bought any companions, you may choose to have any of them as additional members of this merge if you wish. Or you can choose to consider them the sole meta (Target) if that is what you wish.
objects.title: Merge

objects.text: You can change how some aspects of a power, object of power, or perk of yours work. This doesn't make it more powerful but can change some of its mechanics.
objects.title: Power Tweak

objects.text:
You can change how any aspects of any of your powers, objects of powers, or perks work. This doesn't make it more powerful but can change some of its mechanics.

You can use this to alter the mechanics of some of your powers or OoPs, a single one of them, fuse all of them or allow them to be expressed through one power or object, or any combination of alterations you can think of. This doesn’t allow you to make yourself more powerful on its own.
objects.title: Power Tweak (All)

addons.text:
Your powers, objects of powers, and perks aren’t just fixed in at one point in time; instead, they’ll alter and shift to continuously match you perfectly.

This also allows you to manually make adjustments at will, freely shifting it to suit your needs. If you prefer, you can always allow it to default back to shifting into an optimal state for you once more.
addons.title: Personal Touch

objects.text: Your powers, OoPs, and perks are all adjusted to fit you perfectly. The little nuances and the subtle details that you may have otherwise overlooked or miscalculated are no longer an issue, instead all the little nuances and details are smoothed out entirely on their own to become the best possible fit for you.
objects.title: Tailor Made

objects.text:
Once you have defeated Zion or any equivalent enemy in threat (not necessarily power) to whatever universe you're in any self-targeted drawbacks you have chosen will be removed. (Examples: Monologue, Trouble Magnet, etc.) This specifically targets the side effects, limitations, and other adverse consequences associated with the selected drawbacks.

It is important to note that certain drawbacks may require the achievement of specific goals for their complete removal. In such cases, the associated drawbacks will persist until the designated objective has been successfully accomplished. (Examples: CUI Summer Camp, Endbringer Target, etc.)

This perk will also activate after 25 years even if you don't defeat Zion or an equivalent enemy.

(This perk does not apply to drawbacks that involve environmental changes or the acclimation drawback).
objects.title: Countdown

objects.text: The strength of your drawbacks have been weakened, now they aren’t as absolute. For example, Fairy Goddess will make it that while Glaistig Uaine will not have ever entered Birdcage, and may have an inclination for “collecting” your power, she will not actively hunt you down. Instead, her interest in you will be more passive, akin to a curiosity rather than an obsession.
objects.title: Protection Against Evil

addons.text: Due to your temporary protection, your 'acquirement' of abilities throughout your journey will occur after they've been taken from you once. Perhaps a stray experiment or esoteric accident has affected you, or an abstract curse, or maybe your equipment has merely been seized by your enemies. Either way you can expect a long walk back to a power you've already tasted.
addons.title: Before the Fall

objects.text:
With your first purchase, you gain protection from external threats that could harm you or your powers. This includes Paragon users who can erase powers, and time travelers who can alter your past. Schemes against you will be delayed until your Brief Protection ends. This includes drawbacks such as Slaughterhouse Eight, Fairy Goddess, or Worst Day Ever but not those that affect you directly like Case 53, Acclimation, or Corona Pollentia.

Brief Protection lasts for one day per purchase. The time is based on your own perception, so it doesn’t change if you travel in time. This protection also extends to your friends and family.
objects.title: Brief Protection

addons.text: Due to your temporary protection, your 'acquirement' of abilities throughout your journey will occur after they've been taken from you once. Perhaps a stray experiment or esoteric accident has affected you, or an abstract curse, or maybe your equipment has merely been seized by your enemies. Either way you can expect a long walk back to a power you've already tasted.
addons.title: Before the Fall

objects.text:
With your first purchase, you gain protection from external threats that could harm you or your powers. This includes Paragon users who can erase powers, and time travelers who can alter your past. Schemes against you will be delayed until your Momentary Protection ends. This includes drawbacks such as Slaughterhouse Eight or Fairy Goddess but not those that affect you directly like Case 53, Acclimation, or Corona Pollentia.

Momentary Protection lasts for one month per purchase. The time is based on your own perception, so it doesn’t change if you travel in time. This protection also extends to your friends and family.
objects.title: Momentary Protection

objects.text: The universe conspires in your favor, no matter what you seek to achieve or overcome. Good luck follows you at every turn, increasing the likelihood of success and decreasing the likelihood of failure in all your endeavors, no matter how challenging they may be. Luck smiles upon you always. This might not help you win the lottery, or find your soulmate but it can be felt in almost every aspect of your life.
objects.title: Serendipitous Luck

objects.text: You possess an innate ability to perceive and anticipate danger or hidden information.
objects.title: Sixth Sense

objects.text: You have attained inner peace and balance, allowing you to remain calm and centered in any situation.
objects.title: Inner Harmony

objects.text: You radiate charisma and magnetic charm, effortlessly drawing others towards you and influencing them positively.
objects.title: Charismatic Aura

objects.text:
Your powers, perks, and skills can be passed down to your descendants, and to adopted children who have been in your care for at least 5 years, or not in any combination of your choice.

Taking this with reincarnation will allow you to retroactively add any of your powers, perks, and skills to any family members or loved ones in your new life in any combination of your choice. You can choose for their versions to be weaker than your own, or with certain weaknesses, or to manifest different expressions of power. 

You can apply this to any ancestors you may have as if you inherited it from them instead of the other way around.
objects.title: Inheritable

objects.text:
Your powers aren't just passed down through your family - they become a legacy. Your descendants inherit not just your abilities, but also your charisma, intelligence, and even your sense of purpose. They feel a deep sense of connection to you and your past and will carry on your legacy even after you're gone. 

Each generation’s inherent power is much greater than the previous, capable of inheriting a far more powerful version of their predecessor’s abilities. They will suffer no difficulty because of the increase in potency. You can also control whether they inherit a different expression of your abilities and what differences they possesses, as well as scale back anything they would inherit if you wish.

But this isn't just a one-way street - as your family grows, so too does your power. Your abilities grow stronger with each new generation, and you can feel their presence like a comforting blanket, even in the afterlife.
objects.title: Heir to the Throne

objects.text:
No matter what powers you take, no matter what changes you undergo, you will remain human.

Whether this means you are Mentally Human, Biologically Human, Spiritually Human, Fundamentally Human, or all of the above is up to you, but regardless of your choice, you will never lose the benefits, abilities, or physical might of any alternative race you picked.
objects.title: Humanity

objects.text: Those you care about, such as your friends, family, and loved ones, are protected by fate. Similar to 'Plot' Armor, they're protected from negative or unfortunate circumstances, even when it comes to the supernatural. People are less likely to target them, and your enemies will prefer to use other methods of getting to you.
objects.title: Worriless

objects.text: Beings that are two or more magnitudes of power above you won't notice you unless you are explicitly brought to their attention. Even if they were to somehow learn of you, the information would seem to be of little importance, causing their mind to unconsciously prioritize other subjects over you. This also protects against any passive effects they have that would affect you or protect against this perk.
objects.title: Beneath Notice

objects.text: While in any universe, you will gain access to a comprehensive repository of knowledge pertaining to that world. This knowledge encompasses all relevant media, lore, and information, granting you an in-depth understanding of the intricacies and details of the world you are about to explore. This includes not only the official canon but also the insights and notes of the author(s) and/or creator(s), ensuring that you are well-equipped to navigate the world you are entering.
objects.title: World Knowledge

objects.text:
Shortly after arriving in your chosen verse, someone with a skill/power you want decides to take you as an apprentice. Whatever skill or power (and their upgrades) you choose, they are a master at it and would do everything they can to mentor you through your journey towards the same mastery and beyond.

You can only choose one skill or power, however, you can choose the entirety of a power, upgrades, and add-ons included.
objects.title: Teacher

objects.text:
Bad News: your <u>Worst Day</u>? Even worse, you’ve suffered "terminal body failure" once the Day’s done with you. Your body was mangled beyond recognition, your brain and mind only survived by pure chance.

Good News, to be fair?  Seems your body’s remains were salvaged, your mind digitized and you were transformed into a <u>Construct</u>. You can now choose a <u>Chassis</u> and <u>Modules</u> in the <u> Character</u> Section.
objects.title: Million Dollar (Wo)Man

objects.text: Your robot/android/biomorph/construct body is now tinker-tech instead of normal tech. You can maintain yourself even if you aren't a tinker yourself but only a tinker can modify or improve your body. If you possess relevant tinker powers, your body incorporate tech from their library. Otherwise, you are simply "generic" tinker-tech.
objects.title: Tinker Construction

objects.text: Your robot/android/biomorph/construct body now incorporates esoteric components such as magitech or other advanced technologies available in the Shardless section. If you possess relevant powers, your body incorporates technology from their library. Otherwise, you are simply "generic" advanced tech.
objects.title: Esoteric Construction

objects.text: Your Perks have evolved, making them an order of magnitude stronger. For example, if before, a Perk protected your mind from most of the attacks, it would now protect it from everything. Should a Perk not be able to go a tier higher, it would develop beneficial side effects that expand the scope of what it can do.
objects.title: Golden Perks

addons.text:
Now, instead of being unbothered by everything because you are unable to comprehend it, you are unbothered by everything because even though you get everything, you just simply don't get what about it bothers others.

Sure, Cthulhu looks all scary, and its appearance is definitely a bit unique, and quite a bit impossible; however, you really don't get why that can be mind-shattering.
addons.title: I Get It Now... But Not Really...?

objects.text: Gaze your eyes, tune your ears. Witness the snap of sanity, the scream of existence unraveling. Feel it, hear it, understand... absolutely nothing. They say that looking upon an eldritch horror can make you mentally snap, and the void staring back will have you cease all brain functions... Well, you can safely say that's a load of crap. When you looked at Cthulhu, you just saw a bipedal squid, and when you looked into the void, you didn't see anything.
objects.title: I Don't Get It

objects.text:
Unlike native inhabitants of any world you travel to, you are unbound by any of its inherent concepts, rules, or restrictions.

Abilities or phenomena that would impose upon you the setting's concept of death, for example, will fail to affect you at all; and should you possess any powers that would otherwise come with inherent downsides due to interaction with the world's metaphysics, they will be free of those drawbacks.

Benefits and positive effects, if you wish, still apply as normal and can even be carried to other worlds.

You can also bestow the same benefits upon anyone or anything else, from objects and living beings to powers and power systems, allowing them to retain full functionality even in settings with completely different metaphysics.
objects.title: Foreigner

objects.text: Only once, whatever physical, psychological or genetic issue you possess is now gone. No more depression, chronic diseases, missing teeth or limbs, etc. It can even fix predisposition to diseases that you aren't aware of. You can also choose not to fix some things if you want (Picard chose to be bald, so why shouldn't you?). This fix, however, takes effect BEFORE drawbacks, so anything caused by them wouldn't be solved by this.
objects.title: Clean Bill Of Health

objects.text:
Whether you are reborn as a clone, uploaded into a machine, pieced together by hands not your own, or even revived through a ritual better left unexamined, you will remain undeniably yourself. Your soul is never lost or severed in the process, always carrying with it your memories, personality, and all of your powers. What others might call a “copy” is no mere imitation—it is you in truth, seamless and unbroken, the same being in whatever form you inhabit.

This ensures that any rebirth, reconstruction, or transference is a continuation rather than a replacement. There is no paradox, no dilution, no splintering of identity unless you wish it so. Even when others attempt to bring you back with imperfect methods, whether crude science or questionable sorcery, what they create will resonate with your essence and become a true vessel, ready to be filled wholly by you. In short, however many times you fall, however many ways you are brought back, you will always remain yourself.
objects.title: Continuity Of Existence

objects.text:
In many stories, there are certain objects and beings that only the Chosen may wield. Swords and amulets that answer only to a bloodline, hammers and grimoires only for those considered worthy, or sometimes just because they require certain traits from their new user.

With this, now all such requirements are dust before the wind. You can lift the Hammer of Thor while not being worthy, pull the Sword from the Stone without being the Once and Future King, bear the Witchblade while being a man, and summon the Egyptian Gods as if you were the Pharaoh Atem himself.
objects.title: Wielder of Them All

addons.text:
Beyond only locking away sensitive information, you can lock your history away, determining a false one to take its place. 

This history can be simple or complex, but it cannot actually change past events or create things which did not exist. When scrutinised this history is validated by examinations of you, whether those be telepathic or more esoteric.

For instance, if you claimed to be an alien soldier in DC, Telepathic scans and the Lasso of Truth would both validate your story, but the world you allegedly came from would not be created from nothing.
addons.title: Alibi

objects.text:
You can now lock certain information within your mind, ensuring that it cannot be extracted under any circumstances. It can be specific information, like meta-knowledge of the setting, or even an abstract idea.

Whatever you lock will stay safely hidden inside your mind until you, in the right state of mind, decide to unlock it. This not only protects from any power that would try to extract it but also prevents you from accidentally revealing locked information yourself.

Lastly, you can even lock information from even yourself, although you will still have an idea that something has been locked away and why and will be able to unlock it again should you need to.
objects.title: Infolock

objects.text:
Not only is your ‘Alibi’ undetectable within your own mind, but it is fully reinforced by the world around you. This would not construct entire people or largescale locations from nothing, but it might create ‘pieces’ that corroborate your story. 

For instance, if you claimed to be an interdimensional refugee, pieces of ‘your ship’ might be found near where you landed. If you claimed you’re a clone created by a shadowy conspiracy then an actual conspiracy may well have their cloning setup revealed with some conveniently corrupted records.

If you change your story these ‘pieces’ will be recontextualised to fit (ie, the aforementioned cloning lab may be revealed to be an attempt to clone you rather than your source) but will not disappear.
objects.title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die

addons.title: We Who Make Our Own Legacy
addons.text:
In addition to gaining knowledge of the canon cultures of your powers, You can now choose to make any changes you desire to the information you recieve, up to designing entirely new cultural and societal traditions surrounding your powers, rather than being influenced by the canonical societal contexts they come from. You may decide what kinds of academic culture surround a magical practice, which theological beliefs informed holy rituals, or what kind of enemy a mech was built to fight. 

You are also given a unified cultural base for a hypothetical civilization that incorporates all of your powers, perks, items and skills that fits your tastes and purposes, which you can teach to any society you lead, create or gain from the CYOA

This doesn’t give or create an entire civilization in your world, but it does also allows you to greatly tailor other addons unlocked by Those Who Came Before.

objects.text:
You get a full grasp of the history and culture of the civilization your power comes from.

It doesn't give you any specific details or advantages, just a broad understanding of who they were.
objects.title: Those Who Came Before

objects.text:
You gain an array of minor secondary powers, similar to those featured in grab-bag capes but without the Cluster dynamics. These minor powers purposely manifest themselves to complement, synergise and enhance the primary power picked. For example, a Mover power could get secondary powers enhancing their agility, coordination, and stamina. A grab-bag cape typically has 2 to 4 secondary powers with their primary power. You can determine the expression of each secondary power although they must work to support the primary power.

The total combined strength of these secondary powers can be worth up to a maximum of 20% of the SP cost of the primary power they're linked with. If you’ve combined multiple powers into one, you use their total SP cost. Otherwise, if treating powers separately, use their individual SP costs to acquire secondary powers for each.
objects.title: Secondary Powers

addons.text: You have complete conscious control and awareness over any unconscious parts of your powers as well, such as Shamrock's micro-telekinesis or what adaptations you'd get with Crawler. This doesn't boost the strength of a power, and if a power is truly random, you'll have no control over it. If a power cannot be turned off, this wouldn't allow you to do so; instead, it allows you precise control over its effects. We have Holding Back for that.
addons.title: The Little Things

objects.text:
You have an uncanny and natural aptitude for your abilities, as if the usage and talent was ingrained into your instincts. 

You possess absolute and perfect control and understanding over all your powers, granting instinctive mastery and knowledge over your powers, able to control your power in its every manifestation as effortlessly as breathing, from its most explosive and powerful manifestation to its most subtle nuances.
objects.title: Natural

objects.text: You gain a year's worth of practical experience with your powers, and as such the power growth and fighting experience you’d normally gain in that timespan. Each time you select this after the first doubles the amount of years you gain.
objects.title: Practical Experience

objects.text:
Your powers get stronger the closer you are to the moment you acquired them—be it mindset, situation, physical condition, and etc.

Each selection allows you to further strength the boost. Since Shard powers powers already have a Sechen Range then the first selection acts as a if it was a second selection, essentially extending your maximum number of selections by 1.
objects.title: Sechen Ranges

addons.title: Customised Personality
addons.text: All your creations now come with a personality tailor-made to your preferences. This may be either a fully fledged personality right out of the box, or they may develop it over time.

objects.text:
Every being you create, be it through powers, technology, or any other way, will be absolutely and unbreakingly loyal to you unless purposefully created otherwise. This loyalty is so absolute that not even mind control, hacking, or similar powers could turn your creations against you.

While this does not prevent those beings from developing their own personalities, nor does it guarantee that those personalities will be to your liking, you can be sure that your will and wishes will always be at the top of their list of priorities.
objects.title: Loyalty Insurance

objects.text:
The Endbringers are not impossibly powerful anymore. Their power level is limited to what they have shown during their fights. They certainly have tricks in reserve but they will not have an eleventh-hour power-up if you start to beat them.

Their cores are still protected by impossibly dense and layered matter, but destroying one will not crack the planet in half. The Endbringer will simply die.
objects.title: Fair Kaiju Fights

objects.text: No matter what, other Endbringers won't awaken or activate from another Endbringer’s death. With this, you will only have to worry about the Simurgh, Leviathan, and Behemoth. Killing one is easier said than done, though.
objects.title: Extras Not Included

objects.text: All Endbringer cores are destroyed upon your arrival in this Universe at the cost of some of your Shard's capacity for powers.
objects.title: End of the Kaiju

objects.text: Scion's core Shards are destroyed upon your arrival in this universe at the cost of your Shard's capacity for powers. Scion's corpse will come to the attention of someone who can stop it from resurrecting (the network is stabilized and Titans will not happen).
objects.title: Overcharge Strike

objects.text:
The core Shards of all Entities across the Multiverse are destroyed upon your arrival in this Universe. Their corpses will in way or another either get destroyed or stabilized, removing any worry of consequences from their death. 

This effect explicitly excludes The Warrior or other Entities currently in play within the story’s primary settings. This exclusions also covers any Entity introduced or included via Drawbacks, Setting modifiers, and other possible scenarios and changes. All other Entities across the Multiverse are affected identically to Ubercharge Strike. 
⁨⁨
objects.title: Supercharge Strike

objects.text: The core Shards of all Entities across the Multiverse are destroyed upon your arrival in this Universe. Concerned parties will come to the attention of the corpses and either destroy or stabilize them.
objects.title: Ubercharge Strike

objects.text:
Scion is not impossibly powerful anymore. 

Even without the exact circumstances of the Golden Morning, it's possible to kill Scion by being sufficiently powerful, he will still put up one hell of a fight and the death toll will be enormous but he isn't impossibly powerful.
objects.title: Not as Powerful

objects.text:
All the Entities are not as impossibly powerful anymore.

They will still give most Type 3 civilizations a run for their money, but a concerted effort and exotic weapon technology can make an Entity cut their losses. Killing one will still require extremely precise tactics and very specific weapons (or the right powers).

If you are yourself an Entity, you are still affected by this perk but to a lesser degree than your siblings.
objects.title: Not as Powerful (Global)

rows.title: Perks
rows.titleText: Perks are beneficial side effects.

objects.text: Your appearance(s) becomes non-human, whether this new look is based on your selected powers or not is up to you. The Appearance section in the Character section becomes available if it wasn't already. The choice you make in this section steers the appearance of your new form and determines how aesthetically pleasing it will be. It does not mean you will necessarily look more human but how monstrous or close to the uncanny valley your form gets. Average would place you in the same category as Newter, obviously non-human but not overly uncanny, while The Handsome and Beautiful choices means your form will be considered pleasing to look at, it could be that you look human but your skin is covered in mesmerizing patterns or that you are a lumbering six-legged beast with sleek curves and elegant horns. On the other hand, Ugly and Hideous would place you on the opposite side of the spectrum, where your features have elements that trigger primal reactions of fear or disgust in humans, such as the appearance of rotting flesh or proportions that are disturbing.
objects.title: Case 53

objects.text: Some part of you appears minorly inhuman. From eyes that are mishapen or rainbow hued to skin that is far too pale, some part of you makes your identity as a parahuman obvious. You can choose to have multiple features, though they will all be cosmetic and cannot deviate from a standard human body plan. Something like Canary's feathers would be acceptable.
objects.title: Colorful Eyes

addons.text: Your Case 53 transformation is still monstrous, but now can be... somewhat humanoid. Your appearance is 50% human at best. Maybe you have a centaurish-lower or upper torso with a mostly human other half. Maybe you have way more limbs than normal. Or maybe you just have a general humanoid form, but lack actual human features. You will never be able to completely lose whatever inhuman traits you have, but likewise, you will never become less human than these changes make you.
addons.title: A Bit Inhuman

objects.text:
Your Case 53 mutations have massively diverged from the human norm. Your body structure, whatever it may be, is now distinctly non-humanoid. 

No mundane disguise can pass you off for a normal human, and no one will mistake you as such.
objects.title: Utterly Inhuman

objects.text:
You are a product of the organization, Cauldron. As a Case 53, you exhibit both their signature tattoo and the typical side effect of amnesia, being unable to recall any memories from your life before receiving powers.

While this means you are removed from your debt/favors, it also means Cauldron knows your powers.
objects.title: Case 53 Tattoo

objects.text: Your body is aged down to somewhere between 6 and 12 years old. You will age normally but cannot use powers to age yourself up. Your physical abilities are reduced to match your age. Adults will not take you seriously and your independence will be severely limited.
objects.title: Pint Sized

objects.text: You do not visibly age. Not to be confused with the inability to age, you will still grow old, suffer the issues of age and die. However, appearance-wise you will always look like a child. Powers and perks cannot permanently negate this, however temporary powers ups can allow you to look like an adult while under its effects. Once the conditions for Countdown has been achieved, you will be able to age normally.
objects.title: Childlike

objects.text:
The strength of your powers are reduced in every area but technical knowledge to what would generally be expected of someone your age. With The Force (Star Wars) you would be roughly equivalent to a Jedi youngling or padawan, with Witchcraft and Wizardry (Harry Potter) you would be roughly equal to a 2nd or 3rd year student.

You can grow your powers through typical methods such as training and physically maturing.

<small>Note: this scales with any powers taken, such that if your build gives you massive reserves, you would still have massive reserves, but only compared to other children. Similarly, if you are a dragon, then you would have the physical and magical stats of a dragon child, rather than a human.</small>
objects.title: Growing Pains

objects.text:
You are now mentally affected by your age. This means that you are more prone to acting like someone your age usually would.

If you are a preteen, expect to be much more impatient, immature and willing to do stupid things because it sounds cool to you. If you are a teenager, puberty will hit you exactly as hard as it did the first with all the new feelings and changes.

No matter the case, you also have the general impulse to ignore adult advice and dislike supervision because you believe you know better.

If you are instead 70+, you tend to act like a stereotypical cranky old person. You are set in your ways no matter how out of place they might be, you complain about the youth and random topics at inconvenient times and exaggerate about how things were better in your day.

As an older person, you also struggle to accept advice from anyone you think is younger than you and take anyone not listening to you to be disrespectful and lacking manners.

In serious situations, you are able to suppress these feelings and act with your original rationality and maturity; however, afterwards, you will inevitably do something that reminds everyone around you how old you actually are no matter how mature or dependable you seem at times.
objects.title: Act Your Age

objects.text:
Instead of taking everything in stride, you feel a great dissonance with every change made by your choices in this CYOA and find it incredibly hard to acclimate.

If you chose to inhabit a new body then you would experience body dysmorphia, constantly wondering who that is in the mirror or thinking you're taller/shorter than you are.

If you've changed worlds, then you find yourself totally lost on this world's history and cultures and constantly missing your old world.

If you've gained new powers then they don't come naturally to you. With you finding their use/feel to be jarring and constantly forgetting that you possess such abilities.
objects.title: Dissonance

objects.text:
Whether it's a concerned citizen, a responsible adult, or even a school principal, someone has alerted child services that you, a child, have endangered yourself and used your abilities recklessly in their opinion.

Now, child services is hot on your trail, aiming to place you in an orphanage. If they succeed, you'll be barred from using your powers until you turn 18, and all your current objects of power will be confiscated.

But it doesn't end there.

Child services will conduct a thorough investigation, involving interviews with you, your family, and potentially other witnesses. Legal proceedings might ensue, leading to court hearings and custody decisions.

Depending on the outcome, you may receive support services such as counseling or educational programs on responsible power use.

Note: Some objects of power may empower your body in ways that are undetectable and cannot realistically be confiscated. If these are used in public and noticed by child services, it may lead to a detailed discussion regarding their misuse, with parental involvement and potential educational interventions.
objects.title: Won't Somebody Please Think of the Children!?

objects.text:
Regardless if you're immune to Master/Stranger powers or not, you have a Geas on you. A Geas is a compulsion you must obey, being commonly irresistible to break. 

You are aware of your Geas and are not affected mentally by it, but if you try to resist the Geas you won't be able to. It may make your body move on its own if you try to disobey. If your chosen Geas were to ‘be a good person’,  you would find yourself forced to do things you felt a good person would do. The more specific the Geas, the more debilitating, impossible, and painful it is to resist.

If the Geas is extremely general, such as to be a ‘good person’, you could get away with being an asshole or even petty theft with only some heartburn, but if it was something on the line of ‘not stealing’, then if you tried to steal you'd find yourself paralyzed and feeling as if hundreds of red-hot needles were before forced into every nerve on your body.
objects.title: Conscious Geas

objects.text:
Regardless if you're immune to Master/Stranger powers or not, you have a Geas on you. A Geas is a compulsion you must obey, being commonly irresistible to break. 

You are unaware of your Geas, and their effects are entirely mental. If your chosen Geas was to ‘be a good person’,  you would find yourself genuinely trying to be a good person. And this is NOT caused by your Shard if you have one. 

To be clear, you forget you chose this Perk even if you remember all your other choices. The more general the Geas is, the less it affects your personality: if your Geas were to ‘be good’, you'd find yourself a significantly better person, or at least trying to be a significantly better person, yet you might still occasionally do something you know isn't good because of selfishness, revenge, or some other reason and not be relatively reluctant, meanwhile, if your geas was more specific like to ’not steal’, you'd obsessively hate the idea of stealing and likely couldn't do it even if it would stop the Entity from ending all worlds.
objects.title: Unconscious Geas

objects.text:
You can choose a task that you are compelled to complete during your time in this world. This works via a Master-like effect which raises the priority you place on that task just high enough to ensure that you seriously pursue it, but not so high that it overrides your personality or deeper convictions. So long as you make steady progress towards the goal, and don't delay artificially or take major steps backwards, this compulsion may have no noticeable impact on your personality or behavior at all.

The task can be either primarily passive (e.g. joining and maintaining membership in a particular organization), or active (like defeating a particular opponent). However, it must either place a non-trivial demand on your time or pose a meaningful challenge, taking into account your powers and abilities. Passive tasks fade after about two years of successful compliance, with the exact timeline depending on how great of a burden it places on you during its active period.
objects.title: Minor Compulsion

objects.text: You find that you have a knack for pissing off people who have viewpoints that oppose yours. Something about you causes people who have incompatible perspectives to have an unnatural dislike of you. This can easily cause arguments when you encounter them, create friction under collaborative circumstances, and when trying to interact with those with opposing viewpoints it will devolve into a pissing contest.
objects.title: Enmity

objects.text: Oops, it seems while you were waiting to insert whatever was in charge of your body pissed off a lot of people. Your reputation as a Villian(ess) has already spread far and wide. Even if the world you go to doesn't follow the typical hero and villain paradigm most people will already think you are a horrible person and you will have to work hard to change their opinion on you.
objects.title: Oh No, I've Been Reincarnated as the Villain(ess)!

objects.text: Your outsider nature can be felt, and you get all the wrong kinds of attention. Expect to be treated poorly.
objects.title: "Odd"

objects.text: You can't explain your powers to others. If you try to, no information is conveyed in the attempt, even if the explanation was a lie (speech sounds silent, writing doesn't appear on the page, etc). Others can come to their own conclusions on how your powers work just fine, although attempts to confirm or deny their theories fail as well.
objects.title: In One Ear...

objects.text: You seem to be a walking talking failure of basic operational security. Even if you consciously try, you tend to slip some information about yourself. And whenever you do slip, it somehow reaches the ears of those who might actually use that information. It's safe to say your enemies might know where you live, work, relax, and even the name of your pet poodle.
objects.title: Murphy

addons.text:
Congratulations, your body is not below average when compared to the general population but is instead enhanced to the point where some might confuse you for a Parahuman. Unfortunately for you, this comes with many different side effects. 

Much like those with Hyperesthesia, Osteopetrosis, and Myostatin-related muscle hypertrophy; your body is overwhelmed by how above average it is in certain areas. Your increased muscle mass will cramp and hurt your joints. Your bone density will make it harder to swim and make it easier to break and fracture. Your increased sensitivity means you get overstimulated more easily.

Your body is overall more prone to disease due to nutrients being taken by your muscles and bones. You are stronger than others sure, but without careful regulation of your health, you will easily become wracked with sickness and pain.
addons.title: Overtaxed Body

objects.text: Your physical traits are below average when compared to the general population. It takes you twice as long to build strength as it does for others, and your immune system is weak, causing you to fall ill frequently.
objects.title: Weak Body

objects.text: Good news, you get a free suit of tinker-tech armor. Bad news, your body — particularly your immune system — is so weak that it requires the life-support systems of the suit to keep you alive. The armor is fully sealed, with an integrated air recycling system, but it is not completely self-sufficient. You still need food and water to survive — which need to be sterilized before being consumed or you risk getting sick — and evacuate bodily waste. The battery built into the armor lasts 48 hours under regular use, considerably less under heavy strain, but can be stretched to 120 hours in low-power mode. The armor includes ports to ingest semi-solid food, empty the waste tanks, and recharge the batteries. The armor includes a self-repair system that can handle regular maintenance and minor damage to non-critical system with your help but any amount of serious damage will overwhelm its capabilities. At this point, you will need the assistance of a tinker. If you have a tinker power with a specialty that includes power armor, you can handle repairs and even upgrade the suit. The tinker-tech suit is primarily geared towards survival and so does not increase your strength beyond that of an average person or include any weapons. However, the external armor is resilient enough to protect from blades and small caliber bullets. Outside of the armor or a similarly clean environment, you can only survive a few days before your body fails from the rapid progress of diseases. However, the medical system of the armor can help you recover as long you are placed back inside the armor within that time frame. This condition is tied to your body can't be removed by your powers or healed through any external means except for an ego transfer to an entirely new body. (If you have the Tinkertech Armor, you can merge it with your life support suit and have it benefit from your tinker-tech specializations out of the box. Other items like Tinkertech Gadget, Tinkertech Power Modification, Artificial Intelligence, and so on can be integrated into the armor if you desire.)
objects.title: Permanent Life Support

objects.text: Good news: your life-support suit now responds as naturally and instinctively as your original body. Bad news: that’s because it is your body. Your original flesh is completely gone, leaving only your brain and a small portion of your nervous system inside a reinforced, shock-absorbing case within the frame's torso. Your biological senses are gone, replaced by synthetic ones: optical cameras for sight, audio sensors for hearing, and pressure sensors that provide an approximation of touch. The frame is moderately superhuman - strong enough to pry open reinforced doors and durable enough to shrug off small-arms fire - but it is fundamentally a life-support rig, not a war machine. It fares poorly in sustained combat. The life support system is capable of processing ordinary food and water into clean nutrient slurry, but lacking a tongue or stomach, eating is simply dumping organic mass into an intake hopper. In addition to the standard 48-hour battery, the frame features an internal generator. It is too weak to meaningfully recharge the system while under load, but given enough downtime it can slowly replenish your reserves. If the main battery runs dry, the generator can still produce enough power to keep you alive (and moving, albeit very slowly) in the low-power mode. Unfortunately, the internal repair protocols are only capable of handling minor damage and surface-level repairs. Any serious structural trauma can leave you trapped, blind, and helpless inside an unresponsive metal husk. It would be a very good idea to make friends with a tinker, even if you are one yourself. (If you have the Tinkertech Armor, you can merge it with your frame and have it benefit from your tinker-tech specializations out of the box.
