Everybody in the cluster gets a minor nerf to all of their powers, their strength being redirected to give one random person in the cluster a moderate power boost. This power boost can be stolen by anybody in the cluster by focusing while staying within a moderate radius of the current holder for long enough (the further away they are, the longer they'll need, increasing logarithmically with distance). The current holder has no indication that the boost is being stolen until it's gone.

If the current holder of the boost dies, the boost will transfer to a random person in the cluster. If there is only one surviving member of the cluster, then this mechanic will stop, with the boost and nerfs from this mechanic vanishing.

If a person has held the power boost for too long, they will get a stalemate penalty that slowly increases in strength over time. The penalty will increase the range at which the clustermates can steal the boost (if it gets large enough to cover the planet, this range will begin to extend interdimensionally as well). As well as the range increase, the base time required to steal the boost will slowly begin to decrease as the penalty gets stronger as well.

The penalty accrued from holding the boost will weaken back to nothing over time if the person no longer holds said boost.
objects.title: King of The Hill

objects.text:
Everybody in the cluster gets a minor buff to their powers due to the strength of one random person in the cluster being redirected, giving that one member a moderate power nerf. The holder of this nerf can give it to any clustermate by focusing while staying within a moderate range of them for long enough (the further away they are, the longer they'll need, increasing logarithmically with distance). The target has no indication that the nerf is being transferred to them until it's done.

If the current holder of the nerf dies, the nerf will transfer to a random person in the cluster. If there is only one surviving member of the cluster, then this mechanic will stop, with the nerf and boosts from this mechanic vanishing.

If a person has held the power nerf for too long, they will get a stalemate boon that slowly increases in strength over time. The boon will increase the range at which they can give away the nerf (if it gets large enough to cover the planet, this range will begin to extend interdimensionally as well). As well as the range increase, the base time required to transfer the nerf will slowly begin to decrease as the penalty gets stronger as well.

The transfer range boon accrued from holding the nerf will weaken back to nothing over time if the person no longer holds said nerf.
objects.title: Hot Potato

rows.title: Cluster Choice
rows.titleText:
Your powers will be evenly distributed between each person in your “cluster” (referred to as “clustermates”).

You may select a portion of the powers you have to be your primary powers. The primary powers will get a minor/moderate nerf, based on the number of clustermates you have. The rest of your powers will have their strength heavily reduced and will henceforth be referred to as your secondary powers. You must leave at least one secondary power available per clustermate you have, as these secondary powers represent their primary powers.

Your clustermates will get power sets inspired by all of your powers, including primary powers inspired by your secondary powers, with every secondary power being represented as a primary power held by one of your cluster mates. These powersets will always be of roughly equal strength to yours.

Your clustermates will all in all have a build of roughly the same strength as yours, including this drawback & the appropriate suboptions selected.

If a member of your cluster dies, the secondary powers of everyone in the cluster will become a bit stronger to compensate. However, even if every single one of your clustermates were to die, your powers would still not be boosted back to the level they would be without this drawback.

objects.text: You are immortal. Every time you die, you respawn near your body. However, each time you resurrect, you lose your a part of your being. It may be a power of yours, or a memory, maybe even an emotion or a sense. Don't die too many times, you would end up becoming a hollow shell.
objects.title: Curse of Undeath

objects.text: You suffer from a curse that alters the results of your actions in unexpected ways. No matter what you do, you will always end up with something different but somewhat similar to what you intended. For example, if you attempt to write a novel, it will magically transform into a graphic novel instead. If you prepare a cake, you will find yourself with a batch of cream puffs. If you perform a song, you will involuntarily break into a choreographed dance. These are mild effects that don't impact serious events and change something into a similar thing.
objects.title: Curse of Strange

addons.text: Not even the self-inflicted torment of the Curse of Pain is immune to the Curse of Masochism, and in fact the two Curses even synergize with each other: Not only does the former make it easy to get addicted to the latter’s warped sense of pain, it also makes it similarly easy to get addicted to inflicting it on others as a direct consequence. Try not to go overboard.
addons.title: Curse of Sadomasochism

objects.text: With this curse, your sense of pain is completely warped, causing your body to find it unnaturally soothing and enjoyable—and at more extreme levels, borderline pleasurable. This also overrides any Perks, powers, or other abilities (such as an Alien/Eldritch physiology) that would normally negate or help you deal with pain, reducing their effectiveness to a quarter at most and capping the pain reduction at 50%.
objects.title: Curse of Masochism

objects.text: Every dish you attempt to make ends up causing the worst food poisoning imaginable. A simple egg boiled by you could infect the water supply with salmonella and make everyone who drinks it sick. A cake baked by you for a party could start a fire that spreads to the whole neighborhood. A sandwich made by you with just two slices of bread may create something that looks like it came straight from HP Lovecraft, with tentacles and eyes oozing out of the crust. No matter how much you practice or improve your cooking skills, you can never produce anything edible or safe. But you may learn to control the appearance of your dishes.
objects.title: Curse of Unpalatable

objects.text:
You suffer from what is acutely known as Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder or ‘ADHD’ but in a rather severe form. You are not able to go more than five minutes without either swapping thought processes to a new topic or changing your current activity. This essentially impedes and slows down progress for anything that requires great concentration over long periods of time. Such as, but not limited to, meditation, tinkering, studying, etc. 

This curse has three exemptions, it will not be active during combat, when you are sleeping, and during intimate relations.

This curse stacked with ‘Curse of Worldly Distractions’ lessens your concentration time by half.
objects.title: Curse of Distractions

objects.text:
You suffer from what is essentially ‘worldly’ ADHD. Meaning instead of your body producing the effect that disallows concentration for more than five minutes, random events in real life will occur that either physically or mentally prevent you from focusing on your current train of thought or activity.

This curse has three exemptions, it will not be active during combat, when you are sleeping, and during intimate relations.

This curse stacked with ‘Curse of Distractions’ lessens your concentration time by half.
objects.title: Curse of Worldly Distractions

objects.text: Every harm you do will cause you to suffer the same pain. The feeling of a knife against someone makes you feel like you were stabbed. The sound of a gunshot in your ear makes you feel the bleeding. The burning of someone you burned makes you burn with agony. Every act of violence you commit will be reflected back to you in equal measure. Although you won't physically be harmed from this curse.
objects.title: Curse of Pain

addons.text:
Beyond making Tainted Hallucinations influenced by those Negative memories (resulting in things like your perception making a friend appear untrustworthy due to the collective memories of millions) now Curse of Negativity and your hallucinations join to make you experience those memories within your dreams as if they were your actual reality. Your mindscape is clay and Shifting World is its sculptor.

Graveyard of Memories ensures Negative memories aren't the only thing you will experience within your dreams, you could in one day experience a completely boring day of someone doing nothing and in another experience someone's euphoria at finally completing their goal.

If you have Fragments Made Reality you will sometimes enter your mindscape instead of dreaming, upon which you can physically interact with the minds in your head.
addons.title: Shifting World

addons.text: Reminder's version of Thematic, Theme Song and Magical Girl are now affected by those Negative memories, Graveyard of Memories adds Neutral and Positive memories to it. If you have Theme Song the sounds it makes actually makes someone feel a emotion/sentiment its trying to invoke, be it anxiety, fear, or happiness if you have Sunshine Upon You or Graveyard of Memories, depends on whether its basing the sound on a memory of yours or a memory from Curse of Negativity. Wonderland or Cure Curse would allow you to use this to help manage the minds within your mindscape from Fragments Made Reality.
addons.title: Thousand Reminders

addons.text: Positive and Neutral memories join the looping within your mind, lessening the frequency upon which Negative memories play. In compensation every 6 days you lose access to the Positive and Neutral memories and the Negative memories will be things that distress you, and if you have any friends, family and etc then their Negative memories will appear with more frequency.
addons.title: Graveyard of Memories

addons.text:
Instead of your memories gaining voice through Voices of a Memory, you will instead house within your mindscape the minds of everything that died in the universes you are residing in, sensed in, or passed through. Those minds have access to your memories, thoughts, and senses; whether they will try to help you, ignore you, try to mess with you, or anything else depends on their personality. Those minds can't be erased; nothing from mindwipes to existence erasure can permanently get rid of them. 

This can work as a well of knowledge, if only it didn't make going to sleep, concentrating, or thinking difficult due to constantly hearing well over a thousand voices simultaneously.

As time goes on, you will start to be able to handle hearing so many voices simultaneously; however, this will take at minimum 6 months.
addons.title: Fragments Made Reality

objects.text:
The negative memories of all living and dead beings from the universe you reside and universes you have sensed or passed through now play in a loop within your mind. You can't permanently get rid of them and your thoughts, emotions and senses will influence which ones appear.

If a timeloop were to occur, you would still have all the negative memories of the previous loops and identical memories would fuse, the emotions and sentiments they invoke would thus increase in strength.
objects.title: Curse of Negativity

addons.text:
Through the mastery of your malediction, the genius of your madness, and the fusion between your cursed body and insane mind; you have obtained the means to have true power over yourself.

First, Inland Empire allows you to control the differing manifestations of your madness. When you so desire, you may manifest your madness into reality, using your body as a conduit. With Obsession, you could summon chains to bind your opponents, blend into a crowd with Faceless, and even use Dense to outright ignore attacks, making it so they basically never happened. None of these manifestations are set in stone, being a fluid as your mind. Just as you could bind opponents with Obsession, you could also enhance your senses to track them down wherever they go. Not only that, but you can combine the manifestations of your insanity as well. Human Killing Ghost and Superiority Complex could manifest a weapon perfectly suited to enhance your strengths and exploit your enemies’ weaknesses. 

Second, Embrace Curse gives you the ability to combine your curses with your insanity, allowing you to use their power in combination too devastating results. Curse of Destruction could combine with Berserk State to destroy all in your path, while Curse of Strange and Altered Mind might end up warping reality around you. The mixture of your curse with your mind also means you could manifest curse by themselves, your odd overview of the world seeing them as one and the same. You might use the Curse of Distractions to trick people at opportune times, Curse of Unknown to erase knowledge of your presence, or just use Curse of Unpalatable to make someone want to vomit in the middle of their special attack.

Finally, your powers are also affected by your manifestations. Minions could receive duplicates though Another Mind, Black Hole Brain could cause powers like Injury Empowered to trigger from your memories alone, and the Curse of Technology could give your Tinkertech a rather violent security system should unauthorized people use it.

None of this happens immediately, you must first master the Curse of Manifestation itself. Through this, you will gain the ability to train your mind and body together to achieve these awesome powers. Nothing comes free in this world, but don’t worry, your insight will help guide you how best to train.
addons.title: I Think, Therefore I Am

objects.text: Your body and mind are fused and equal; unfortunately, you get the bad part of it. When you take physical damage, your mind also takes damage, and vice versa. Mental disorders and illnesses have physical manifestations on your body, such as scars, unhealed wounds, or semi-physical abstract manifestations, such as a collar or shackles, as a sign of submission or defeat. More serious disorders, such as memory loss, will manifest as a permanent change in the appearance of your face until you bring back lost memories or create new ones that define you, or when you are in extreme despair and cannot get out of it, you will crack and break like a mirror.
objects.title: Curse of Manifestation

addons.text: Your anxiety further embitters your paranoia, creating a complex where you feel persecuted or victimized, the pervasive feeling that someone or something is out to get you, stokes within you desperation and cowardice, with your plans leaning on a vitriolic and personal angle.
addons.title: Kobeni Complex

objects.text: Your paranoia is great enough to make Batman take notes from you. You needlessly make hundreds of plans of simulated scenarios which may never come true. You have contingency plans against both your enemies and allies and even a hypothetical enemy you may face in future. To you, today's friends may as well be tomorrow's enemies. You will have a hard time making friends and trusting others.
objects.title: Curse of Paranoia

objects.text: You are plagued by a curse that limits your abilities in some way. Whenever you do something, you will face some kind of obstacle or handicap. Whenever you undertake something, you will encounter some form of difficulty or disadvantage. For instance, if you engage in combat, you might suddenly become paralyzed in your right arm. If you play chess, you might be forbidden from moving your knights. You always encounter some kind of restriction that makes your current task harder.
objects.title: Curse of Crippling

objects.text: You are under the influence of a curse that deprives you of knowledge and understanding. You always come across information that is incomplete or missing, and you tend to lose your memory of crucial details at the most inconvenient times. You are constantly unaware and confused about what is happening around you.
objects.title: Curse of Unknown

objects.text: Wherever you go, you leave a trail of death and decay in your wake. The plants around you age at an accelerated pace, with their lifespan shortening by a factor of eight within a 30km diameter. Furthermore, fruits and vegetables within a 7km radius of you will rot at an increased rate, making them unfit for consumption in mere hours.
objects.title: Curse of Black Thumb

objects.text: Wherever you go, you leave a trail of destruction and chaos in your wake. Your mere presence is a blight to the natural world, and all creatures and vegetation are drawn to cause you malice and harm. Animals will go out of their way to maul and attack you, while plants will reach out to grasp and strangle you, with vines twisting and wrapping around you like the tentacles of an octopus, determined to drag you into their grasp. This curse makes the very earth itself your enemy, with those that belong to nature acting upon an uncontrollable desire to exact carnage upon you.
objects.title: Curse of Nature

objects.text: Your presence causes a cascade of technological breakdowns, resulting in devices malfunctioning and ultimately failing when you interact with them. However, tinkertech remains resilient to this disruption, although in exchange you have little to no talent when using or even comprehending someone else’s usage of the devices. As a result, even though you can technically utilize tinkertech, the process is riddled with frustrations and challenges, making it a near impossible thing.
objects.title: Curse of Technology

objects.text: You are cursed with a touch that turns everything to stone. No matter what you touch, living or non-living, it becomes a lifeless rock. You cannot control this power, nor can you reverse it. Even the slightest contact can transform gold into granite, or treasures into rubble. You are doomed to be alone and surrounded by stone.
objects.title: Curse of Stone

objects.text: Every activity you try to enjoy ends up triggering the most unbearable headaches imaginable. A simple movie watched by you could cause a throbbing pain that makes you nauseous and dizzy. A book read by you for pleasure could induce a blinding migraine that prevents you from seeing anything else. The more interesting something is, the worse you suffer from it.
objects.title: Curse of Boredom

objects.text: "If you kill a killer, the number of killers in the world remains the same." Each time you kill more than once a day, the person closest to you will slowly lose themselves to an overwhelming dark desire. The mind twists, contorts, and warps, with the sudden and uncontrollable urge to wipe you from the face of the Earth. They turn into murderous and tortured individuals, seeking only to inflict pain and suffering upon those around them, directing their special hatred towards you. The corruption spreads with each life you take, and another close to you becomes a deranged and malevolent creature. They become unrecognizable, a twisted shell of their former selves, hell-bent on causing as much misery as possible.
objects.title: Curse of Killers

objects.text: You possess a shapeshifting power but you can't control it. You can’t control how you look or who you are. Every day, your gender, appearance, and age will change randomly and drastically. You can try to use other shapeshifting powers to alter your appearance, but your new form will take on traits from your base form. However, any perks that affect your beauty or agelessness will still apply to any form you take. If you are handsome in one form, you will be beautiful in another.
objects.title: Curse of Appearance

addons.text: The intensity of your social anxiety intensifies through the roof, with exploits and shenanigans all for avoiding any social event or (potential!) awkward conversations, and in the moment all your avoidance comes in vain you don’t freeze as much you flip out of sheer anxious mania, with a franticness that… weirdly… endears some people!?
addons.title: Bocchi Complex

objects.text: You struggle with interpersonal relationships and often shies away from first encounters. You struggle with social events, and tend to make things awkward by either slipping up or overdoing it. Many will find you weird, and most will stay away from you. When stressed, you try to hide from any social situations, trying to hide in trash cans, cardboard boxes, or other objects. If you fail to do this, you would freeze up and be incapable of thinking straight.
objects.title: Curse of Social Anxiety

objects.text: You are stuck in a time loop that happens at random and ends at random. When you loop, its not really a loop and more like entering alternate timelines as there will be small differences between loops even without you doing anything, making it impossible to leverage knowledge gained from previous loops.
objects.title: Curse of Timeless

addons.text: All of your lovers, on top of being yanderes, will also be late bloomer, or normal bloomer depending on their age, sufferers of Yandere Syndrome. Otherwise normal people with average strength will have their muscle density rapidly increase to them now suddenly be as strong as a top tier all-around athlete, and God help you if you actually date an athlete or body builder.
addons.title: Really? Them too?

addons.text:
Any potential love interest you have—or will have—is now akin to your soulmate. Just like your soulmate, they share perfectly aligned ideals with you. Just like your soulmate, you are flawlessly compatible, getting along effortlessly with each other. Just like your soulmate, you and them find fulfillment simply by being in each other’s presence.

...However, as with all things in life, nothing is perfect. You will encounter many such people in your life—each one just as much a perfect match for you like your soulmate. Choosing to dedicate yourself to one may potentially hurt the others. Yet, even in their pain, they are likely to turn the blame inward or toward external circumstances rather than fault you, as they, too, are perfect for you. If you fail to manage these relationships carefully, those who share a deep connection with you may ultimately choose to leave, in more ways than one—whether out of resignation, defeat, or unwillingness.
addons.title: Curse of Significant Others

objects.text: All the lovers you have/will have will turn into Yandere. They will try to keep your affections to themselves, even going as far to killing any potential competition they think they will face. If you try to break off the relationship, they may as well kill you to preserve you in their memories. They will always be influential and powerful enough to do so. Do be careful, sometimes a Yandere lover is much more dangerous than a superpowered nemesis.
objects.title: Curse of Yandere Lover

objects.text:
You have been cursed with an aura that transforms anyone who comes too close into a fanatic—fanatical about you, of course. What’s more, anyone who gets close to you becomes an even bigger fanatic than those who are merely affected by your aura. This obsession is so extreme that it makes characters like Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti (Re:Zero) and Yuno Gasai (Future Diary) seem tame by comparison.

These fanatics will do anything to gain your attention, often resorting to violence and even sacrifices. Initially, this fanaticism may appear as simple adoration, but it knows no bounds and can escalate infinitely. Furthermore, the longer someone remains within your aura, the more intense their obsession becomes, amplifying their fervor to unprecedented levels.
objects.title: Curse Of The Zealot

objects.text:
You bear a curse. Anyone who spends time around you—strangers, allies, even enemies—begins to develop a permanent irrational, overwhelming compulsion to protect you. 
It begins small: a wince when you’re scratched, a pang of guilt if you're bruised. But this protectiveness quickly spirals into mania. If you're injured repeatedly, regardless of severity, those affected may try to confine you "for your own good," treating your safety as something sacred—even if it means smothering your freedom or agency entirely.

The curse strikes deeper and faster in those who already care for you. Friends, lovers, and allies fall hardest, becoming emotionally unstable at the thought of you suffering. If you save someone’s life, they are immediately and irreversibly bound by the full weight of the curse—unable to tolerate even the thought of you in harm's way. Worse still, even the cruelest or most sadistic beings are not immune.

 Upon harming you, they begin to feel a creeping, inescapable guilt that grows over time, weakening their resolve until they can no longer bring themselves to raise a hand against you.
But the greatest cost is isolation. 

Those affected by the curse only trust others similarly bound, forming a tangled web of paranoia and overprotection. Your relationships are reduced to guardianship, your independence eroded by well-meaning jailers. You become a fragile idol on a high pedestal—untouchable, watched constantly, and never truly free.

Note: you may optionally make this drawback effect any Companions, or OoP's that give sapient or near sapient beings you take, at any level of intensity you choose
objects.title: Curse of The Mother Hen

objects.text: You cannot win without incurring some sort of small or partial loss simultaneously: Set up a hundred smaller plans, and you’re guaranteed to fail at anywhere from 1/5 to 1/3 of them depending on how important they are to you and your goals; A bigger, singular plan will always have some sort of ‘price’ to it, no matter what steps you take - for example, defeating a rival ending with you sustaining some sort of temporarily-crippling injury or a noticeable hit to your reputation, or a major battle against an opposing faction ending with a noticeable chunk of your resources or troops being depleted.
objects.title: Curse of Pyrrhus

objects.text:
No matter what you do or where you go, you can no longer stay in the same place forever - at least, not without consequences: Whether it be due to local troubles cropping up to harass you or your very presence causing a growing cascade of issues to plague the area, residing in any area for more than a few days at a time will cause complications to appear in your current place of living.

These troubles start off relatively uncommon and minor, but ramp up in both frequency and intensity rapidly, escalating into seriously inconveniencing/debilitating within weeks, life-threatening for mundane people in months, and starting to verge into environment/infrastructure-threatening hazards at a year or more. Not even places of residence that you fully own or have made are safe from this curse, though it does not count any 'dwellings' that can travel with you - such as mobile homes or ships of any kinds - avoiding the curse as long as you stay on the move.
objects.title: Curse of the Nomad

objects.text:
Every time you either wrong a person or fail someone, a voice will appear in your head. It will randomly, but consistently, condemn you for your action. If you failed to help a woman find her missing husband for example, that woman’s voice will haunt you, condemning your inadequacy and failure. If you harm someone, that person’s voice will constantly condemn you, making you out to be the villain even if you had a legitimate cause. These voices will build in number, until they are a chorus of constant criticism, yet you will always be able to understand each individual voice no matter what.

Even if you didn’t voluntarily choose to help someone, this can be seen as failing them. Even if you didn’t know that you did something, like accidentally having casualties after a fight, their voices will appear and condemn your ignorance. These voices will become stronger the more tired and mentally exhausted you become. Whenever you sleep, their forms will also appear in your dreams.
objects.title: Curse of Condemnation

objects.text: No matter what actions you take, they will always have some sort of destructive side or after-effect: Trying to heal a simple cut may cause it to scar noticeably and/or develop chronic pain; Trying to save a city from a villain may lead to fighting which destroys at least a few buildings and/or some key piece of infrastructure. While this isn’t unbearable - you can still do more good than harm - this will ensure that your work is never truly done and that there will always be a drain on your time and resources.
objects.title: Curse of Collateral

objects.text: You made a deal with Death to become immortal, however she tricked you. The first time you die, you will be resurrected in a half-dead state. Your body will be atrophied and all your physical abilities will weaken massively. Your magic will also become closely aligned with Death, thereby making any life magic difficult to cast. Living beings will also instinctively distrust you. You will have hard time making friends. Beware of gods/spirits of death for they will consider you an abomination and may try to kill you. However no matter how many times you die, you will always resurrect in this half-dead state. Do remember, if you heal yourself from this state, Death will take hold of your soul and you will permanently die. And just like the man who was tricked by Death, you will also only remember about the immortality part and forget the drawback. Only after your first death, will you remember everything.
objects.title: Curse of Half-Death

objects.text:
You now exist simultaneously in two separate timelines. You will have the mental capacity and multitasking ability to control your self in each timeline. The world around you may seem nearly identical in both but each timeline will have small, uncanny differences that makes meta knowledge from one timeline useless in another. These small differences will build up to create two completely different futures.

Anything negative that happens to you in one timeline, such as injury, exhaustion, illness, or even death, manifests instantly in the other. However, positive events, like healing or rest, do not transfer.
objects.title: Curse of Split Time

objects.text:
You are cursed in such a way that your thoughts can be heard by others. Everything that passes through your mind can be perceived as spoken words, audible to those around you. Who exactly hears your thoughts depends on the world you've entered — it could be a random citizen or an entire group of individuals crucial to that world’s fate.

You forget that you ever chose this curse. Moreover, the curse skillfully conceals its existence: it subtly alters events so that the truth stays outside your awareness. Every time you get close to discovering it, “coincidental” disruptions occur — phone calls, accidents, sudden meaningless conversations, or even a strange sense of forgetfulness. People who might try to warn you suddenly lose the ability to speak about it, or they forget what they were going to say. Their lips move, but no sound comes out. This even applies to written text: sometimes it may appear briefly — only to vanish when you blink. This effect isn’t absolute — the most determined allies might try to hint at it through actions, glances, written notes, or bizarre, seemingly disconnected phrases.

If you do manage to uncover the curse, the concealment effect will break. The curse can also selectively distort or censor information - supposedly at random.
objects.title: Curse of Mind Reading

objects.text: For every blessing that comes your way, a barrage of misfortune follows, a relentless tide of adversity that eclipses any flicker of good fortune. Discover a penny, and soon you'll find yourself drowning in debt. Receive aid in thwarting a mugger, only to return home to the charred remains of your house. The scales of fortune are forever tipped against you, leaving you to navigate a world where every step forward seems to invite a dozen steps back.
objects.title: Curse of Exchange

objects.text:
Forever shall you walk the path of solitude, your steps echoing in the void, devoid of companionship or comfort. No longer shall the warmth of an embrace or the solace of a home be within your reach. Condemned to wander eternally, you drift like a lost soul through the boundless expanse of existence, longing for respite but finding only fleeting moments of peace amidst the relentless currents of perpetual unrest. 

The echoes of your footsteps reverberate through emptiness, a reminder of your eternal isolation. No companions await you, no sanctuary offers refuge from the relentless march of time. Forever adrift, you search for a place to call home, yet find only fleeting glimpses of solace amid the ceaseless turmoil of your existence. Each passing moment weighs heavy on your weary soul, as you yearn for connection and belonging, knowing that such comforts will forever elude your grasp.
objects.title: Curse of Loneliness

objects.text: Every item you try to handle ends up shattering into the most dangerous fragments imaginable. A simple vase picked up by you could explode into shards that fly across the room and injure anyone nearby. A laptop used by you for work could spark a short circuit that fries all the electronics in the building. The more precious something is, the worse you destroy it.
objects.title: Curse of Glass

objects.text: Your body has undergone changes, and you now exhibit a variety of debilitating symptoms such as a constant dry cough, labored breathing, and persistent headaches. These symptoms are always present and are exacerbated when you use your powers. Additionally, you may experience nausea, dizziness, and chest pains. Overuse of your abilities can leave you temporarily bedridden and could result in severe injury or death. Your new condition is serious, and you must exercise caution when utilizing your abilities. It is crucial to be aware of your limits and seek medical attention if symptoms persist or worsen.
objects.title: Curse of Sickness

objects.text: Any living being you fall in love with dies. The only way to get over this curse is to become apathetic towards life. You are destined to live a lonely life with this.
objects.title: Curse of Contradiction

objects.text: You are required to spend 50% of the day sleeping in order to recharge your powers. Going a few days without sleeping would weaken your powers, and finally a weak of not sleeping will stop your powers from working.
objects.title: Curse of Sloth

objects.text: Every food you try to eat ends up triggering the most unbearable hunger imaginable. A simple snack consumed by you could cause a gnawing pain that makes you faint and weak. A meal eaten by you for satisfaction could induce a ravenous appetite that prevents you from feeling anything else. The more delicious something is, the worse you starve from it.
objects.title: Curse of Gluttony

addons.text:
Aren’t you forgetting something? No. You now remember everything, and that is the problem.

Every 24 hours, you will remember 23 hours and 55 minutes of what happened in absolute, maddening detail. You can choose 5 minutes per day that you will be allowed to forget everything about. The rest will be permanently added to your mind.

While remembering everything in absolute detail might sound nice at first, due to how the curse interacted with your black hole of a brain, you no longer perceive time like normal people.

To you, yesterday, last year, and the unthinkable present are happening simultaneously. Every stubbed toe or injury, every sore muscle, every negative feeling, every unpleasant odor or thought is being experienced at once, while every second new memories and experiences are being added to the maddening collection of your life.
addons.title: Forgot to Remember to Forget

objects.text: You are cursed with irreversible memory loss. Every 24 hours, you will forget 23 hours and 55 minutes of what happened. You can choose what 5 minutes per day you will remember exactly. The rest will be erased from your mind.
objects.title: Curse of Memory

objects.text: You cannot win without losing half the time. If you set up plan with 100 sub plans, you are confirmed to fail at 50% of them. A standalone plan always has a 50% chance of failure/victory, no matter what steps you take. You will never get a complete victory. You may kill scion only to find out he was keeping a worse enemy at bay!!
objects.title: Curse Of Failure

objects.text:
The whims of Fate work in mysterious ways, but yours work in the most gauche and contrived ways possible. Your life’s events occur and proceed in the weirdest or frankly stupidest manner, almost like a bad movie or book, and usually doesn’t work in your favor in the long-term, as people start noticing these sequences of events and happenstance take place around you or transpire with you at the center, and slowly distance their involvement or outright don’t want to work with you, as they too suffer from your honestly from idiotic flukes. 

Normally, you’d be moderately bothered by pivotal events occurring in sloppy or bland execution, done lazily, or happening disastrously, in the worst cases.

This, essentially, turns your life into a badly told story, with all its clichés and contrivances.
objects.title: Curse of Whimsy

objects.text: No matter what action you take, you will always cause the maximum destruction possible. Trying to heal a simple cut may mutate the dormant cancer the patient had, thereby turning him into a horrific abomination. Trying to save a city from a villain may lead to fight which not only destroy the city but also the neighboring cities. Do be careful how you use your power, for your curse may destroy this world even before Scion does.
objects.title: Curse of Destruction

objects.text: Every time you deceive others about who you are, you will lose sight of your true self. You will become a stranger to yourself, living in a world of lies. Every time you pretend to be in a different situation, you will forget where you came from. Your lies will not only make you forget about what the lie was but also may cause you to forget something random within your mind. With enough lies, you will lose touch with your roots, your values, and your goals. Every time you exaggerate your abilities, you will forget what you can really do.
objects.title: Curse of Lying

addons.text: The drawback of the two contradicting curses are lifted, but in exchange you got a new curse. No matter what you try to say, it will come out as a riddle. The riddle is Thinker proof, so the only way to understand it is to use your natural intelligence. Additionally, if no one answers you riddles at least once a week, you will begin to forget what the answer of the riddle is.
addons.title: Curse Of Riddles

objects.text: Every time you reveal the truth, you will be unable to change yourself. Your personality, and sense of self grows more rigid and unbending. You will be mentally, physically and spiritually incapable of change and growth. With each truth said, you grow more immutable. While you are far more mentally resistant, you are also more fragile in some ways. If someone were to argue against everything you believe in and emerge victorious, not only would your perspective on life collapse, but everything that you are would be shattered as well.
objects.title: Curse of Truth

objects.text:
You are afflicted by a curse that slowly turns your body into a form of living stone when you use your powers. The curse starts in the extremities, manifesting as small pebbles that grow inside muscle and fat tissues, painful but bearable. As time goes on, more and more tissue will be replaced by the curse, whole tissue and bones will slowly calcify, becoming stiffer and more painful.

The further the curse progresses, the harder it becomes to heal from injuries. While the living stone that is eating your body is more resistant to blades, it is also more vulnerable to impacts; what would have been a bruise can shatter your skin or even an entire limb.

It can take years for the curse to progress far enough to reach the torso, where it starts to become a threat to your life. When your spine starts turning to stone, your body will become even more sluggish. When the curse changes the intestines and stomach, you will need to find other ways to sustain yourself. And when it reaches the lungs and heart, your life nears its end.

There are ways to mitigate this curse, slow its progress, even cure it and reverse the effects, but this is by no means an easy feat. No matter how powerful or intelligent you are, it will take at least three years of persistent study to find mitigations, and six to find a lead for the cure. Will you make it in time?
objects.title: Curse of Medusa

objects.text: When something goes wrong in your vicinity people are more likely to blame you for whatever it was and think you caused it intentionally. This will only happen for mundane incidents unless someone nearby suspects that you have powers.
objects.title: Curse of Blame
Multi-Pronged Curse
objects.text:
You’re afflicted by a strange Curse that takes the form of momentary but severe bouts of all of the Curses found in this CYOA.

The Curse will react to your current situation by immediately hindering you and appropriately shifting to a momentary Curse: being focused on a task will plague you with Curse of Boredom, Distractions, or Worldly Distractions depending on your state of mind; hoping to finish an essay due for tomorrow will afflict you with Curse of Strange and inexplicably transform your essay into an academic paper; when you’re finding a headway in mastering your powers you’ll shortly suffer from a short but hard-hitting case of Curse of Crippling.

Living Curse will add a malicious factor to the mix as your Curse will creatively mix multiple Curses at once, worsening your experience. On the flip side, Cure Curse lowers the severity of your ever-shifting Curse, enough to grow accustomed to and manage it in your day-to-day life, with Embrace Curse helping you completely soothe your Curse, turning this into an ever-changing Blessing suited for every situation you find yourself in.

addons.text: The power of your living curse has dropped significantly, and its ability to take over your body has been lost completely. Though it remains a threat, its once overwhelming presence has diminished. If ignored, the curse will gradually grow stronger. However, with consistent effort, you can now maintain or even weaken it. Moreover, an unexpected possibility has emerged: you can attempt to reason with your curse. Engaging deeply with it might allow you to find common ground or harness some of its power, though this will be extremely difficult as the curse initially despises you.
addons.title: Suppressed Curse

addons.text:
Your efforts to embrace your misfortune have caused your ability to reason with your curse to be greatly enhanced. You can find common ground with it much easier and your acceptance of it makes it no longer despise you completely, though you still seem annoying, at least at first. 

Additionally, a miraculous change has occurred. By working together with the curse, it is possible to invert its effects, allowing it to become a true blessing. You will be able to willingly give it more power and control to help you in both combat and everyday life. It’s corruptive effects on the mind becoming a more soothing presence, a friend that is always by your side.

None of this will happen overnight and it will take great efforts on both sides to even get to this point. But no matter what, you still have to the chance to truly change your fate.
addons.title: Living Blessing

objects.text:
Your curse is a living, intelligent being dedicated to harming you. It has a consciousness of its own and will actively seek ways to bring you misfortune and suffering. This malevolent entity is not static; it will grow, adapt, and transform itself in response to any attempts you make to cheat or outsmart it. Each time you try to evade its grasp, it learns and evolves, becoming more cunning and insidious in its methods.

As time passes, your curse will also grow stronger, albeit extremely slowly. This incremental increase in power means that the longer the curse persists, the more difficult it becomes to manage and the more destructive its influence.

The curse will slowly corrupt your mind. In its most severe stage, it is possible to be completely consumed by your curse. This means that the curse takes over your body, using it as a host, and your very essence becomes twisted to serve its purpose. In this state, your sole goal becomes to spread the curse to others, perpetuating the cycle of suffering and despair. At this point, the curse will have suffused itself into your very existence, allowing it to spread itself to others through you and your abilities. The curse, now fully in control, will use your abilities and knowledge to extend its reach, seeking new victims to ensnare in its malevolent grip.
objects.title: Living Curse

objects.text: Your curse has been greatly weakened and can be gradually healed over time and with effort. Although it will affect you indefinitely, as you grow stronger and gain healing, its severity will decrease. Still, it may randomly resurface, and its effects are likely to last indefinitely. It will never be entirely erased, but it may become manageable with persistence.
objects.title: Cure Curse

objects.text:
Since you can’t get rid of your curse, you’ve decided to embrace it and let it become part of you. In the process of doing this, you’ve leveraged your curse into becoming a blessing. Paranoia makes you more aware of your surroundings, a black thumb helps you kill weeds, and even contradiction can be made to kill your loved one’s cancer and diseases. 

This is not an automatic process. It may take years to learn how to use your curses this way and even longer to master them. Once mastered however, your life will be enriched to the point you wouldn’t have it any other way.
objects.title: Embrace Curse

rows.title: Curses Choice
rows.titleText: Choose your affliction, brave one.

objects.text: You can't show your emotions properly. Anything you act on, you tend to do in the opposite way. Your happiness displays as anger and anger displays as happiness. You can't even cry properly.
objects.title: Tsundere

objects.text: You can't display emotions at all. Any attempts to do so come off flat and emotionless. Even your voice is the same monotonous words no matter what you try.
objects.title: Robot

objects.text: You have become detached from your Humanity. You regard other living beings as different and separate from yourself. You may feel superior, protective, indifferent, or even hostile to them. You may treat humans as if they were pets or toys. This makes you have difficulty seeing eye to eye with them.
objects.title: Inhumanity

objects.text:
Whether it was your trigger event or just who you are, You know the weakness that your body possesses and it disgusts you. You seek to augment it in any way you can, from mundane steroids to experimental tinker-tech cybernetics or bioware. 

Despite how much you may augment your body you will begin to find it lacking in time.
objects.title: Transhumanist

objects.text: You don't have a brain-to-mouth filter. You say whatever's on your mind right when you think it. This means you might be less considerate about others' feelings when you speak, but you're also more likely to say things that are more honest and less filtered. Just be careful that you don't accidentally hurt someone's feelings with what you choose to say.
objects.title: Brain to Mouth Filter

objects.text: Whatever pops into your mind, you find yourself doing it without hesitation. You struggle to resist your impulses and your unwanted thoughts take over your actions.
objects.title: Head Empty, No Thoughts

objects.text: You can't read other people's faces. What they are feeling, the emotions they carry, and the words they say. You can't pick up on the emotional nuances they may have.
objects.title: Dense

objects.text: You can't identify people, they all look exactly the same to you. Be it how they look or speak. You can't even identify your own face.
objects.title: Faceless

addons.text: You are now a sufferer of Yandere Syndrome, while personality and behavior wise you remain about the same, your muscles are now much denser, if you were of average strength you are now as strong as a top tier all-around athlete. This synchronizes well with Brute powers and powers that better your physique.
addons.title: Yan-Doki-Doki

objects.text: You are fixated on something to an unhealthy degree. It could be collecting stuffed animals, playing games, or anything else that catches your interest. The more you act on your obsession, the better you feel.
objects.title: Obsession

objects.text: Your Insanity manifests itself as a form of a communication disorder. You can't help but speak in a chosen way. It can range from a ye olden knight or a crazy Magical Girl. It doesn't affect your actions, but how you speak.
objects.title: Voron Method

objects.text:
Your power(s) are sentient beings that can talk to you. They have their own personalities that reflect the nature of the power itself. For example, a fire power would be more impulsive, while a water power would be calmer. 

While they cannot stop you from using them, your relationship with them affects how strong or weak they are. If you get along well with them, they will double your power. If you clash with them, they will half your power. If the power in question involves some kind of summoning, it will have the ability to control it independently from you. Your sentient powers are only voices in your head, they cannot take over your body or mind.

Personified Power (One Power) is independent of Hallucination and does not get stronger from it.
objects.title: Personified Powers (One Power)

objects.text:
Your powers are sentient beings that can talk to you. They each have their own personalities that reflect the nature of the powers themselves. For example, a fire power would be more impulsive, while a water power would be calmer.

While they cannot stop you from using them, your relationship with them affects how strong or weak they are. If you get along well with them, they will double your power. If you clash with them, they will half your power. If the power in question involves some kind of summoning, it will have the ability to control it independently from you. Your sentient powers are only voices in your head, they cannot take over your body or mind.

Personified Powers (All Powers) is independent of Hallucination and does not get stronger from it.
objects.title: Personified Powers (All Powers)

objects.text: The thought of killing other people makes you smile. You can't help but relish in the act of murder and death. The more people you kill the happier you become. You've become obsessed with murder and death.
objects.title: Human Killing Ghost

objects.text:
You're addicted to eating other people. To you, the meat of other humans will taste heavenly, better than any dish on earth. Anything else tastes utterly flavorless in comparison. Moreover, those killed at the height of fear will produce the best flavor.

Should you be a race other than human, this will extend to that race as well.
objects.title: Anthropophagy

objects.text:
You don't just experience <u>Hallucinations</u>—but also exhibit the full spectrum of schizophrenia's symptoms from: delusions, disorganized or catatonic behavior, fragmented thoughts and speech, along with negative symptoms such as diminished emotional expression or avolition.

The severity of these symptoms is tied directly to the strength of your Hallucinations, ranging from relatively mild and somewhat manageable (if you're careful) to full-on spiraling as you lose touch with both reality and yourself.
objects.title: Schizophrenia

addons.text: If your fleeting delirium wasn’t enough, your passenger(s) will suffer your bouts of insanity. Another Self supports your plight by sharing the pain and softening the blow of your episodes. Another Ego makes this a “hot potato”, able to shunt Crashout Season to the passenger(s) much to their chagrin, yet able to toss it back at you, just as intense. Another Person is a coin toss between the former two, hanging on the Character’s willingness to cooperate.
addons.title: Folie à Deux

addons.text: Your frequent but momentary bouts of insanity take on symptoms similar to psychotic breaks, turning your everyday life into a walking hell where you’re detached from both reality and a sense of self: Obsession plunges you into a conspiratorial deluge of unhealthy fixations, both big and small, building up to some grand scheme of mania; Human Killing Ghost inevitably turns into a rampant killer that’ll leave the Slaughterhouse 9 blushing under a haze of bloodlust; Altered Mind will further rewire your mind to be completely dissociated from reality, and so forth.
addons.title: The Infernal Engine

objects.text:
You suffer spontaneous, short-lived but severe episodes of random psychological disorders found in DSM-5-TR and/or Insanity Choices found in this CYOA, except for Choices resembling dissociative or psychotic disorders. 

You can, at least, expect your symptoms to vaguely fit your situation: getting praised for an achievement might spiral into Superiority Complex until something appears to simply plummet your hyper-inflated ego; a nagging feeling of age in your joints and spine may bring out a Transhumanist diatribe about the weakness of the flesh, and the almost irresistible urge to change to “the certainty of steel” you’ll forget tomorrow once this ache is gone from your mind; a new interest might be immediately your new Obsession until you’re onto better things; or you fall into a Berserk State if someone pushes too much of your buttons, etc.

Wonderland doesn’t lower the severity of this form of madness as much as it keeps you grounded amidst your episodes, retaining enough common sense not to worsen your everyday life. Inland Empire, though, works the same with your temporary forms of insanity, adding depth, weight, and instinctive mastery over them to the point of living a relatively “normal” life.
objects.title: Crashout Season

objects.text: Sometimes, completely randomly, you enter a berserk state of rage and attack everyone around you. This also happens whenever you're reminded of certain bad memories or embarrassments in the past. In this state, you can't tell friends from foes.
objects.title: Berserk State

objects.text: You have a power that absorbs the minds of whomever you kill. Because of that, they live inside your head and can talk to you. Most likely you will go insane from the many voices if you continue killing lots of people. The minds of those you kill are only voices in your head, they do not have any power over you.
objects.title: Anathema

addons.text: You are the best, none can convince you otherwise. In fact, people should be grateful to be in your very presence, worshipping the ground you walk on. Your Narcissism is on another level, reaching to the point of delusion. You are unable to see beyond your own needs, desires, and abilities, believing yourself to be superior to everyone around you. Your ego is so inflated that you are completely unaware of your own limitations and faults. Instead, you see yourself as a perfect, godlike figure, who deserves constant admiration, worship and attention. Any attempt to challenge your self-perception is met with denial, anger, or even violence, as you cannot tolerate any criticism or pushback against your deluded sense of superiority. Your level of vanity and hubris is beyond what most people can even imagine, and it will likely lead to you to ruin.
addons.title: God Complex

objects.text: You are plagued with the constant need to prove your strength and dominance. Refusing to back down from a challenge or tolerate being compared to others, you engage in a constant cycle of one-upmanship to demonstrate your worthiness. Showing weakness is not an option, and any sign of vulnerability or humility can be perceived as weakness. You must always be the biggest, the strongest, the smartest, the best. This endless cycle of escalation has consumed your mind, leaving you unable to see beyond the need to prove yourself. Even amongst friends and family, you must continue to show that you are better than them, you cannot show weakness by openning up to them about any problems you face. Even showing anything other than confidence can be considered weakness.
objects.title: Superiority Complex

addons.text:
Your negative memories colors your hallucinations, making them all negative and pushing you from reality even more. The sky is red, water is black, plants look dead, people say things that pushes all your trauma buttons and much more.

Those hallucinations aren't static and are subject to constant subtle changes and from time to time a major change happens.

Having Wonderland allows you to know they are not real. Having Sunshine Upon You makes all your memories color your hallucinations, blending happiness and unhappiness in everything you experience.
addons.title: Tainted Hallucinations

addons.text:
If you have Thematic, it gains the capacity to make each power have not only its own theme but multiple of them instead of a single one shared between them, but you no longer have control over what theme your powers have, instead it's influenced by your negative memories. The memory of the day you were trapped inside a burning building makes your forcefield gain a theme of "Drywall" resulting in it no longer being transparent and a theme of "Burning" resulting in heat and smoke being emitted from it. Those themes aren't static and are prone to change.

If you have Theme Song, it gains the capacity to play any sound and those who can hear it can have their own sounds separate from the ones everyone else is hearing, but you can no longer turn it off, it shares sounds with others on its own and its influenced by your negative memories, doing its best to remind you of things you wish you didn't remember and making sure that any new trauma will be enhanced with music, ambiance and sfx, while at the same hyping up your enemies and giving them the best time of their lives.

If you have Magical Girl, your transformation gains the capacity to change your appearance using illusions and can use your powers to make parts of those illusions real, but it's tainted by your bad memories. Maybe it makes you look like the Evil version of yourself that you battled years ago, maybe your skin looks rotten, maybe you have Self-Biokinesis and now look like one of your parents. The appearance of your transformation isn't static and may change over time.

Sunshine Upon You shifts all negativity to neutrality by making Thematic, Theme Song and Magical Girl be affected by all of your memories instead of only the negative ones. Wonderland gives you back control over them, so you can turn off Theme Song and control what themes your powers will have.
addons.title: Reminder

addons.text: Instead of only your negative memories, now your positive and neutral memories are affected by Black Hole Brain as well. Laughing reminds you of the day you were dancing in the rain, sitting in your chair reminds you of the day you were in your bed staring at celling in boredom and etc.
addons.title: Sunshine Upon You

addons.text: Fractured Psyche now affects your memories too, but only significant ones. Not all happy memories gain voice, only the happiest ones.
addons.title: Voices of a Memory

addons.text:
Your dread and trauma are nigh-inescapable every bitter and hurtful memory spills over your conscious, being an exercise in futility to ignore or escape your anguish. Never the constant presence of dread compounds with Black Hole Brain, turning its mechanics into an ever-constant montage of your life’s tragedy.

Having Wonderland allows you to understand that is the mind fighting itself. Having Sunshine Upon You makes the experience more agreeable, with both your greatest failures and successes being at the forefront of your mind. Having Tainted Hallucinations ramps up the hallucinations' rendering, that is, their depth or how deep they cut.
addons.title: Downward Spiral

objects.text:
Now trauma goes in and never dissappears. Every negative memory, every torment, everything you wish you didn't remember constantly plays on loop on your mind.

All of your senses and thoughts guides your looped memories to specific ones, the taste of a spoon reminds you of the day you tasted your own blood due to almost dying, touching paper reminds you of your bad grades, thinking about buying a pizza reminds you of the day you didn't have money for anything and etc.

Once you acquire a negative memory you can never get rid of it, if your mind was completely erased the negative memories and the memories that give context to them would be back.
objects.title: Black Hole Brain

objects.text:
Your mentality has been heavily altered, fundamentally changing the way you think and process information to the point where it can be described as alien. The cognitive pathways you take to arrive at conclusions are vastly different from those of others, leading to perspectives and behaviors that seem strange or incomprehensible. For example, where a typical person might quickly recognize a pattern or a straightforward solution, your mind might delve into an elaborate array of possibilities, generating connections that others would never consider.

In problem-solving scenarios, your approach might be so unconventional that it appears nonsensical to others. This can result in solutions that are either brilliantly unorthodox or disastrously impractical, causing frustration and confusion among colleagues who cannot follow your thought process. You might experience the world in a way that others find bizarre. For example, you could perceive time non-linearly, making it hard for you to adhere to schedules or deadlines. An event that seems imminent to others might feel distant to you, and vice versa, causing constant disorientation and frustration in time-sensitive situations.

Additionally, your altered cognitive processes can cause difficulties in learning new tasks or adapting to new environments. While others might quickly grasp a new concept or adjust to a new setting, your brain's unique wiring could lead you to focus on irrelevant details, making the learning process slow and arduous.
objects.title: Altered Mind

addons.text:
Possessing either Mild Hallucination, Hallucination, or Major Hallucination will make the other minds within you gain control. They will be able to use your powers for the duration they are in control. Additionally, this other consciousness is usually fine with not being in control. 

If you possess Mild Hallucination, they are just a voice in your head that you can control when to swap. If you possess Hallucination you and them can sometimes swap between each other, you have to fight for control. If you possess Major Hallucination you are the voice in their mind and they control when to swap.
addons.title: Hallucination

objects.text: You possess a second mind within your head that carries the same values and goals as you. They will comment or speak in your head but otherwise will not be able to do anything except to advise you. They are usually agreeable to whatever your goal is. But usually how this is achieved can differ from how you want it to.
objects.title: Another Self

addons.text:
Possessing either Mild Hallucination, Hallucination, or Major Hallucination will make the other minds within you gain control. They will be able to use your powers for the duration they are in control.

If you possess Mild Hallucination, they are just a voice in your head that you can control when to swap. If you possess Hallucination you and them can sometimes swap between each other, you have to fight for control. If you possess Major Hallucination you are the voice in their mind and they control when to swap.
addons.title: Hallucination

objects.text: You possess a second mind within your head that carries different values and goals from you. They will comment or speak in your head but otherwise will not be able to do anything except to distract you. They may not agree to whatever you want to do and differ from you in major ways.
objects.title: Another Ego

addons.text:
Possessing either Mild Hallucination, Hallucination, or Major Hallucination will make the other minds within you gain control. They will be able to use your powers for the duration they are in control.

If you possess Mild Hallucination, they are just a voice in your head that you can control when to swap. If you possess Hallucination you and them can sometimes swap between each other, you have to fight for control. If you possess Major Hallucination you are the voice in their mind and they control when to swap.
addons.title: Hallucination

objects.text: The second mind within your head is the Character Insert of your choosing. They will comment or speak in your head but otherwise will not be able to do anything except to distract or advise you.
objects.title: Another Person

objects.text:
With each purchase, the amount of extra psyches each Another drawback you've taken increases by one. For Another Self and Ego, the added personalities would behave as you'd expect, leading to a rise in arguments and fights for control, but for Another Person, the extra will have a small level of personality drift to them to separate themselves from the 'original', anywhere between the levels of the other two drawbacks.

In addition, each instance also mildly increases the drift between personalities: For Another Self and Person, this is more subtle, marginally increasing the gap per-purchase and only becoming significant between personalities at amounts higher than five, while for Another Ego this is more pronounced, requiring only half as many at most for internal complications to start appearing.
objects.title: Yet Another

objects.text: As time goes on, whatever insanity drawback you were afflicted with will only become more difficult to manage. Regardless of how much effort you put into mastering it, it will inevitably grow more challenging to keep at bay, and the effects will become more severe with each passing day.
objects.title: Deteriorating Mind

objects.text: You experience mild auditory and visual hallucinations from time to time. You hear things that are not there or see things that are not real. But this does not bother you much in most situations. You may occasionally act on something that was never said, which may cause you some embarrassment. Your powers are slightly stronger than described.
objects.title: Mild Hallucination

objects.text: You hallucinate and cannot differentiate your imagination from reality. You have moments of clarity. Your powers get stronger the lower your clarity is at any point in time. At your worst, your powers are twice as powerful. At your best, your powers are slightly stronger than described.
objects.title: Hallucination

objects.text: You are forever stuck in a massive hallucination dream state. Everyone in your mind usually says something else and they look absolutely differently. You can't tell your imagination from reality and no one could understand you. Your powers are now forever twice as powerful.
objects.title: Major Hallucination

addons.text: Your Fracture Psyche has settled on a system after a good look at themselves, reaching a realization of being part of a greater whole, they’d be finally receptive to the structure. With thoughts presenting themselves for an overall picture of their notions and foundations after fully reflecting on them, capable of being internalized and integrated; emotions and impulses are open to being processed and making peace with them, as with every fragment. This strengthens them since they reach their culmination in your psyche, finding their place, and why they are who they are. You are “whole” now. A faded reflection of who you once were.
addons.title: Faded Psyche

addons.text:
Your skills can potentially grow to the point of being Thinker powers.

Your internalized thoughts now may affect how your powers function.

Your Personified Powers are no longer independent of Hallucination and can become stronger from it.
addons.title: Internalized Power

objects.text: Your consciousness and mental monologue are splintered: every skill, belief and desire now has a voice of its own. You will experience internal dialogue with various aspects of your own personality, each representing different thoughts, emotions, and impulses. These internal voices often clash, leading to inner turmoil and conflicting motivations.
objects.title: Fractured Psyche

objects.text:
You have learned to master your insanity to a certain degree. You still experience them, but you can usually distinguish between what is real and what is not. You also have authority over your own abilities, even when you are just a voice in someone’s head. You can decide whether they can access your powers or not.

This prevents you from being distracted in situations that require focus and concentration, such as combat. You can even ignore your hallucinations when they are not helpful. You can also lead a relatively normal life to a certain degree, although others might think you are a bit of a daydreamer. However, you do not have complete control over your insanity. It can still flare up at random times, causing you to lose touch with reality.

(Taking Wonderland allows you to possess Well-Adjusted together with the Hallucination Insanity Options.)
objects.title: Wonderland

addons.text:
The Winds of Fate has smiled upon you, and you feel it wash over you, comprehending the inherent transience in it. You see its nature, and can sense it in your life.

Fate manifests itself as gut feeling or little intuitions, a nudge in one’s hands drawn to anything relevant to your fate. It works as a radar with fortuitous or ill-fated events that occur around you; when present, you’ll be at the right place at the right moment with the right tools or skills to solve or ruin, depending on your fate. You won't know where it might lead or end up in, yet you trust in Fate to not lead you astray.

At times, Fate leaves signs for momentous occasions, pushing your involvement, all for a greater Plan at hand. This turns you on a Cosmic Instrument: a person that changes the world’s Fate to the desires of the Cosmos.
addons.title: Cosmic Instrument

objects.text:
Your insanity has passed the threshold of ordinary lunacy and reached the state that only shamans or some geniuses share: that of genius and madness going hand-in-hand, reaching greater heights on both.

Your hold on your insanity both deepens and changes, as you master it through a lens of revelation, understanding, and acceptance to a greater degree. In a sense, your forms of insanity are worsened, though upon closer scrutiny, they ironically work to your advantage, sway, and well-being.

For example, Obsession is channeled in an exhaustive yet somewhat healthy manner; Dense doesn’t emotionally impair as much; and Human Killing Ghost will be inevitably self-examined and self-reflected to be deepened, accepted, and then mellowed. This process extends to your abilities: you gain control over how your powers are enhanced from your distortion, fully submerging in it without losing your sense of self or self-determination.

You hold an odd overview of the world, both insightful and absurd, a strange blend of magical and critical thinking. Some don’t fathom when it starts and ends, yet they begrudgingly value your perspective as unconventionally compelling at times.

This insight allows you to glimpse beyond the surface, using both your subconscious and conscious mind (dreams, thoughts, and unchained voices), along with psychic automatism or surrealism (hunches and unleashed gut feelings), to understand the world around you: people, motives, and situations, all with glaring clarity. It gives you a deeper sensitivity to the world, turning you a wise and intuitive individual. This also grants you a talent for the supernatural, as "out-of-the-box" thinking comes easily.

With Hallucinations, imagination and reality reach an accord—to see the world of what it truly is while never losing sight of objective actuality in the background—animating the inanimate, feeling the "spirits" of cities, and "hearing" conversations from afar about crucial events and topics, all balanced by staggering self-awareness so as not to lose yourself.

This is heightened by Child of Fate and/or Serendipitous Luck; it becomes quite obvious how to get a feel of fate’s strands and passively make any situation surreal and absurd.

Hallucinations no longer heighten the strength of your powers in proportion to your delirious grip on reality. Instead, they shift into your potential and talent, giving you the aptitude to obtain that strength (with Major Hallucination giving you the potential to double the strength of your powers).

With Well-Adjusted and/or Inner Harmony, you carry yourself in a normal yet strangely distinct bedside manner, having a somewhat eccentric personality colored by your realization, albeit with a pleasantly put-together conduct and mentality.

This enlightenment helps you enjoy a normal life amidst your condition(s); despite what others think of you as a bit of a daydreamer and somewhat strange, in time they’ll be thankful for your unconventional outlook. Contrastingly, accepting and understanding your insanity won’t get rid of it; why would you want to? It’s a part of you—best to come to grips with it. Some days are harder than others, sure, but you’ll never go off of the deep end or abandon your relative composure.

(Taking Inland Empire allows you to possess Well-Adjusted together with Fractured Psyche.)
objects.title: Inland Empire

objects.text:
You and the other person who shares your mind are unaware of each other’s existence. You switch places randomly, with the time between switches ranging from a few hours to half a day, taking turns being conscious and unconscious. Whenever the person currently in control goes unconscious, another person gains control. If you have more than one person in your head, the amount of time you stay in control is equally divided. This causes a lot of confusion as you have no memory of what the other person did or why. If you have Noctis, your time in control is doubled.

However, if you suffer from hallucinations, your time to yourself is limited by how severe they are. If you possess Mild Hallucination, you have 2/3rd of your original time to yourself. If you possess Hallucinations you have half of your original time to yourself. If you possess Major hallucination you have 1/3rd of your original time to yourself. Once your time is up, you switch places with the other person in your mind.  

(Anathema and Personified Powers are not viable for Day and Night.)
objects.title: Day and Night

objects.text:
The minds within you can no longer fight for control. Instead each mind (including yourself) can only stay in control for 30 minutes, upon which the mind that used up their time loses control over the body and their powers. In order to reset their timer they must give the control over the body to another mind.

If there's three or more minds (You and 2 or more minds) within your body then each mind must have control at least 3 times per day

Mid Hallucination decreases the time to 25 minutes, Hallucination to 15 minutes and Major Hallucination to 5 minutes.
objects.title: Golden Mind

objects.text:
Plagued by an unconscious hangup, you possess a certain mental complex or multiple that'll act as a "knot" of unresolved feelings and beliefs within yourself, warping your behaviour in puzzling, hard-to-quantify ways.

What these complex(es) might be can be left to chance, or you can pick how they'll develop—though once formed, like most of its kind, it'll be notoriously hard to be rid of.
objects.title: Psychological Complex

rows.title: Insanity Choice
rows.titleText: Choose how your Insanity shows itself.

objects.text: You will have an eventful day, meet lots of interesting people, and maybe make an enemy or two. You are guaranteed to survive this day.
objects.title: Eventful Day

objects.text:
You will have a pretty bad day. If something could go wrong it will. You'll crash through the roof of a Merchant rave party with every cape in attendance, stumble upon an Empire rally or dog fighting ring, or something of that order. You'll most likely have to fight your way out or pack a good pair of running shoes.

(If you picked Corona Pollentia you have a high chance to Trigger on that day).
objects.title: Bad Day

objects.text:
You will have the (wait for it) Worst Day Ever. It will be ten times worse than the bad day and you'll really have to use all your wits to survive the day.

(If you picked Corona Pollentia you are certain to Trigger on that day, provided you survive it).
objects.title: Worst Day

objects.text: The Slaughterhouse Nine have conveniently decided to visit your place of arrival and will interrupt whatever they were doing at the time. (If you picked Corona Pollentia you are certain to Trigger on that day, provided you survive it and remain sane).
objects.title: Tea Party with the Nine

objects.text:
You will have to contend with a single Endbringer right as you arrive, which one is random. You might have an hour or so of grace since the Endbringer will need some time to get to your location. Use your preparation time wisely.

If the Endbringers do not exist in the world you are in, an attack will happen within a week of your arrival instead.

(If you picked Corona Pollentia, don't. You will die a horrible, horrible death).
objects.title: Worthy Opponent

objects.text:
You will have to contend with all three Endbringers at once right as you arrive. You might have an hour or so of grace since the Endbringers will need some time to get to your location. Use your preparation time wisely.

If the Endbringers do not exist in the world you are in, several attacks will happen in quick succession starting a week after your arrival instead.

(If you picked Corona Pollentia, don't. You will die a horrible, horrible death).
objects.title: Ultimate Showdown of Ultimate Destiny

objects.text: Scion/Eden/the local Entity has been alerted of your presence and will view you as a threat equal to or higher than a full-grown Entity. You have two and a half hours to prepare for their arrival as they prepare for combat. If Entities do not exist in the world you are in, the attack will happen within a month of your arrival instead. (If you do not possess the power to stand up to an Entity, pray to your god for mercy, for your opponent has none).
objects.title: The ultra-true ultimate showdown of maximum ultimate destiny

objects.title: Mid-Tier
