objects.text: 35% of these newly Awakened individuals will have potential for their setting's powers at about the lowest "normal" level for empowered people, 50% will have low-mid-level potential, 14% will have mid-level potential, 0.5% will have mid-high-level potential, 0.4% will have high-level potential, and 0.1% will have potential equal to some of the strongest users for their setting.
objects.title: High-Tier

objects.text: 95% of these recipients will have a random Object of Power roughly equal to 7 SP in strength, and 5% will have an object equal to 15 SP.
objects.title: Low-Tier

objects.text: 85% of these recipients will have a random Object of Power roughly equal to 7 SP in strength, 10% will have an object equal to 15 SP, 4.5% will have an object equal to 20 SP, and 0.5% will have an object equal to 25 SP.
objects.title: Mid-Tier

objects.text: 35% of these recipients will have a random Object of Power roughly equal to 7 SP in strength, 50% will have an object equal to 15 SP, 14% will have an object equal to 20 SP, 0.5% will have an object equal to 25 SP, 0.4% will have an object equal to 30 SP, and 0.1% will have an object equal to 35 SP.
objects.title: High-Tier

objects.text: 10% chance of a broken Trigger producing a Titan
objects.title: Titans: Common

objects.text: 1% chance of a broken Trigger producing a Titan
objects.title: Titans: Normal

objects.text: 0.1% chance of a broken Trigger producing a Titan
objects.title: Titans: Rare

objects.text: 95% of these recipients will have a Power roughly equal to 7 SP in strength, and 5% will have a Power equal to 15 SP.
objects.title: Low-Tier

objects.text: 85% of these recipients will have a Power roughly equal to 7 SP in strength, 10% will have a Power equal to 15 SP, 4.5% will have a Power equal to 20 SP, and 0.5% will have a Power equal to 25 SP.
objects.title: Mid-Tier

objects.text: 35% of these recipients will have a Power roughly equal to 7 SP in strength, 50% will have a Power equal to 15 SP, 14% will have a Power equal to 20 SP, 0.5% will have a Power equal to 25 SP, 0.4% will have a Power equal to 30 SP, and 0.1% will have a Power equal to 35 SP.
objects.title: High-Tier

rows.title: Tier 0 / Lesser Powers
rows.titleText: These are lesser powers, one won't even be enough to make you a street-level cape on its own, though if you're clever and skilled enough, it might give you enough of an edge for you to succeed. If you have 'Shard' origin, you may choose for them to be connected to your shard.

objects.text: It takes a third of the time it would otherwise for you to react to stimuli. The average human can react in 0.2 seconds, with the fastest being 0.15 seconds. If you had average human reflexes, your reaction time is now 1/15 of a second or 0.067 seconds.
objects.title: Mover (Reaction)

objects.text: You're able to exert up to a maximum of 5 newtons of force total on objects within 50 meters of you. The force has to be spread between any objects you're using this power on.
objects.title: Shaker (Minor Telekinesis)

objects.text:
You may copy any stimulus you perceive and have it reappear at a later time. Any trigger is allowed, but it may only act on your own knowledge and senses. 

This for example could be you copy the sound of a rooster and have it play every 24 hours or whenever you feel hurt.
objects.title: Shaker (Alarm)

addons.text: Your precise motor control means that you can make more complex objects with your hands, this is mirrored in your ability to replicate objects with Handmade.
addons.title: Precision Craft

objects.text: You may replicate objects by touching them. This will cause physical strain proportional to mass, and you may at most replicate one 10cm radius region per use. Replications may only be as complex and detailed as a handmade object. You may only replicate mundane things, meaning no Tinkertech or objects of supernatural origin.
objects.title: Striker (Handmade)

addons.text: Your curtain may now be selectively tangible, allowing it to interact with the world. While they can handle a casual punch, be warned that this now allows them to be moved and interacted with like a normal object.
addons.title: Tangibility

addons.text: You can now move and shape your curtain. This could let you bend your curtain to surround an object, or even form it into a mask that moves with you.
addons.title: Shaping

addons.text: Your curtains can now affect all of the senses, allowing for full fledged illusions. This could, for example, allow you to make a picture of a cookie that smells like one too.
addons.title: Senses

objects.text: You are able to summon an intangible curtain that may selectively reflect both light and sound.
objects.title: Shaker/Stranger (Privacy)

addons.text:
Your refined Pink musculature now has a perfect anchor in your Black bones. Previously, despite your enhanced muscles, you couldn't fully unleash their power without risking fractures. That limitation is gone. Your skeletal structure is now strong enough to withstand the full force of your muscles, allowing you to exert your full strength without fear of injury.

With this, the natural mental block that once restricted your muscle output has been lifted, granting you the ability to contract and pull with maximum force. Your new flexible yet dense muscle fibers also enhance your durability—your flesh is nearly as impervious as your bones, capable of deflecting weapons and even stopping low-caliber bullets just by flexing.

Despite this overwhelming strength, you have complete control over your muscle output, allowing you to regulate how much force you exert at any given moment.
addons.title: Shattered Limits

objects.text: You can access all your strength at any time, allowing you to perform feats that normally could only be done when on an adrenaline high. This can cause damage to your muscles and bones. You are guaranteed to heal correctly given enough time.
objects.title: Brute (Hysterical Strength)

objects.text:
Your muscles have transcended their natural limits, seamlessly fusing the power of White Fast-Twitch fibers with the endurance of Red Slow-Twitch fibers to form a new, superior hybrid variant—Pink Muscle. This mutation grants you explosive strength, relentless stamina, and peak efficiency across all physical feats.

Refined and densely packed, your musculature maximizes power without excess bulk, ensuring that every fiber is optimized for force and resilience. Yet, despite this immense strength, your dexterity and precision remain untouched, allowing for seamless, controlled movement. Remember, force is mass times acceleration—strength isn't just lifting power but an all-encompassing boost across every parameter.
objects.title: Brute (Pink Muscles)

addons.text:
Through a combination of an enhanced and reinforced skeletal structure, thousands of micro-joints, and simultaneous control over vibration and temperature, you are able to reproduce and amplify a phenomenon analogous to cavitation, characteristic of the pistol shrimp, generating extreme instabilities in the air pressure in front of your fingers that violently collapse upon the release of accumulated energy.

As you prepare the technique, you channel muscular tension along one or both arms while the thousands of joints in your skeleton store mechanical energy, vibrating at extreme frequencies and raising the temperature of your fingers to the point where the skin briefly becomes incandescent; this energy is concentrated and stabilized in the air in front of your fingertips, forming a highly unstable region of fluctuating pressure, and when you snap your fingers, the entire stored charge is released instantaneously, producing a detonation that expands forward as a searing shockwave.

Your extraordinarily rigid skeleton absorbs the recoil generated by the explosion without difficulty, allowing you to repeat the technique without risk of bone fractures; however, the heat and friction produced with each use cause accelerated wear on the skin, tendons, and muscles of your fingers, requiring brief recovery periods for your regenerative.
addons.title: One Move and You're Gonna Get… the Shrimp

objects.text:
Your bones have become unnaturally dense and refined, granting them incredible durability—capable of withstanding tremendous pressure and even deflecting blades. Though your flesh may still suffer damage, your skeletal integrity far surpasses that of an ordinary human, forcing opponents to risk shattering their own bones upon impact with yours.

As a result of the heightened rigidity in your skeleton and joints, your muscles can now exert far greater strength than they would normally, without fear of fractures or breakage. If you wish, your bones may even take on a black color.
objects.title: Brute (Black Bone)

addons.title: Snake
addons.text:
You have become very snake-like, able to crawl along the ground like a snake through body vibrations and move around like a serpent, making full use of your ability to bend and spring forward in sudden movements.

Your tail enhances these features even further, as it is now able to break the sound barrier several times over, with the ability to strike at incredible speeds while minimizing damage to yourself.

objects.text: Your entire skeleton is made of thousands of joints, allowing your body to become "elastic" enough that you can strike opponents at supersonic speeds, similar to how a whip breaks the sound barrier with each swing. This doesn’t increase your durability, meaning each full powered hit seriously harms your body. You gain a minor regeneration factor in relation to your bones, making the chance of incorrect healing for your bones impossible.
objects.title: Brute (Countless Joints)

addons.text: Your trachea had gained a very efficient filter, allowing you to breathe no matter the density of the smog, as long as the air contains oxygen and nitrogen.
addons.title: Breathing Filter

objects.text: Your lung capacity has been increased fourfold. In addition to that; when you breathe, you take in over 80% of oxygen content in the air. This enhanced oxygenation energizes and strengthens your body, while rendering you immune to the debilitating effects of oxygen poisoning. This power not only offers you increased strength and vitality, but also allows you to adapt to any environment and perform at your peak under extreme conditions, such as in high altitudes or low-oxygen environments.
objects.title: Brute (Lung)

addons.text:
You have come to resemble a night creature whose origin can be traced to a dragon and has become known as guardians and wicked warnings: a Gargoyle.

Your eyes have adjusted to being able to move about in low light without issue, like a cat's own, which, combined with the synergy of your legs, tail, and wings, has turned you into the ideal form of a hunting predator, able to strike terror into the hearts of even the bravest, as your very movements seem otherworldly, able to strike from most anywhere, pursue for long distances, ensnare your prey with your arms, wings, or tail, and slip away just as quickly.

You can change your skin to have the toughness of stone without any of the downsides; this stone skin is waterproof and is very resistant to erosion and damage, requiring modern power tools to breach it. Along with this increased durability, you can fuse your fingers and toes together to create larger digits to use your nails like large claws or even swords.

Your stone skin can be changed to better blend in with your surroundings, taking on the composition and texture to help you hide in plain sight, where only the most keen-eyed observation would be able to spot you at all—thinking you're only a statue until you move.

This transformation can be turned on and off.
addons.title: Stone Guardian

objects.text: You can stay absolutely still for extended periods of time. During this, you can go for long periods without breathing, eating, or sleeping.
objects.title: Brute (Stiff)

objects.text: You can change the temperature of your body from -50°C to 100°C  with no negative effects on yourself.
objects.title: Breaker (Icy Hot)

objects.text: You can vibrate any part of your body at up to supersonic speeds. This does not protect against anything beyond air resistance and friction with your own body.
objects.title: Breaker (Vibration)

addons.text: You can not only inject ideas into your victims; you can also give them unquestioning commands and partially change their consciousness. With the help of your mesmerising voice and hypnotically attractive eyes, you can capture the attention of any person and put them in a semi-unconscious state in which your victim will carry out all your orders. In this state, your victim is extremely receptive to your influence, and after leaving this state, your victim will not remember anything that they did under hypnosis. It doesn't work on people with strong wills.
addons.title: True Hypnotist

objects.text: You just know how to implant ideas. Whether it's the mesmerizing and dimensional timbre of your voice, or it's your hypnotic gestures; when communicating with you for some time, people can easily fall into a trance and become pliable to your influence.
objects.title: Master (Hypnotist)

addons.text:
You’re a prodigy in the tinkering process. Your ability to design and visualize is far smoother, your innate talent immediately accounting for any flaws or holes that you may have otherwise overlooked. Ideas come far more readily and easily, and you’ve gained an innate understanding and talent that allows you to creatively apply and develop your knowledge base, particularly in the practice of invention of new technologies.

Your tinker cycle can also be shortened, allowing you to choose to create minor white-boxed tinker tools to rapidly speed up the process.
addons.title: True Tinker

addons.text: This ability has evolved from schematics to understanding everything. Your mind now subconsciously fixes false or otherwise incomplete ideas based on your knowledge. Not only will this also incorporate new knowledge into past ideas, knowledge, or thoughts, making it more complete, but it will also bring up past knowledge or ideas if the situation demands for it. This can range from schematics all the way to theories on people or even the fundamental forces of the universe.
addons.title: Internalized Knowledge

objects.text: When you're coming up with blueprints, your mental gaps will be filled by your unconscious mind as long as you have the prerequisite knowledge to come to the conclusion yourself given enough time. It also makes it easier to learn to engineer or program.
objects.title: Tinker (Handyman)

objects.text: You have an intuitive understanding of angles and trajectories, granting you nearly perfect aim. You can line up your shots nearly instantly, even for complex trajectories where the projectile bounces. You are still capable of missing if your aim is thrown off.
objects.title: Blaster (Deadshot)

addons.text: You can now have one additional trail of thought reserved for subconscious calculations. When you activate it and present it with a goal, it will try to come up with a solution, using all the knowledge you possess in the most efficient way at an accelerated pace. These subconscious calculations will be as efficient as if you studied and devoted all of your time to figuring out a solution to the presented problem yourself under the constant influence of Bullet Time.
addons.title: Automated Deduction

addons.text:
You gain an additional train of thought dedicated to all things related to games, from the creation of all forms of games to solving/winning all forms of games, whether through playing by the spirit of the rules or by using loopholes and exploits to come out on top.

This is most apparent with things such as puzzles and riddles, as you become the master of such games, with you being able to apply those game talents in new and unexpected ways in other areas of life, such as using your puzzle-solving ability to create an escape out of most situations, like an escape room game with the strangest items and combinations, or using your expanded knowledge from trivia to give you the edge in unraveling a rival’s plans.
addons.title: Riddler's Arcade

objects.text: You can give your full focus to several things at the same time without difficulty. The amount of things you are able to focus on varies depending on how mentally taxing each task is, so you might be able to hold only 2 or 3 conversations at once but you could do a dozen minor tasks simultaneously. You are still limited by your physical capability to do multiple things at once; you only have so many hands after all.
objects.title: Thinker (Multitask)

objects.text: You figure things out twice as fast if you say your thought process out loud.
objects.title: Thinker (Rubber Ducky)

addons.text:
Are you having difficulties at the moment? Had enough of people ordering you what to do at all times? Are you being treated as a complete deadbeat and people make you feel unvalued? Well, worry no more for we have a solution for you!

We welcome you with Vault-tec Assisted Targeting System! A visually dynamic auto targeting system made with top-grade "technology" that allows YOU to shoot with pin-point accuracy with almost no effort on your part! All you do is make a conscious choice on what you want hit, and your hands move like smooth butter to shoot its target with speed and accuracy that is sure to dazzle all the ladies. With VATS, you're one trigger away from solving all your problems!

You will also get a 15% discount on your next purchase, and a brand new electronic waterproof toothbrush that's rechargeable with solar energy for free!

<sub>We are not responsible for property damage, unintentional manslaughter, spontaneous dismemberment, or any questionable decisions made during the operation of VATS.</sub>
addons.title: V.A.T.S.

objects.text: You can process information at an unprecedented rate. When this power is active, the world seems to slow down to a crawl, making bullets seem to move no faster than a jogger. Even the most complex of information seems to flow into your mind with ease, enabling you to make quick decisions and solve problems. While your body retains its regular movement, you can easily make use of this enhanced mental speed to plan ahead, strategize, or simply take a moment to collect your thoughts. You can toggle this effect on and off. Overuse leads to headaches.
objects.title: Thinker (Bullet Time)

objects.text: This power allows you to instantly sense the validity of answers to any questions you ask. Whether the response comes from your own investigation, another person's response, or even your own intuition, you can use your gut instinct to determine if the answer you received is either correct, incorrect, or even partially correct—nothing more. This works best when you have more information on the subject.
objects.title: Thinker (Gut Instinct)

objects.text: Your insight into past actions has been enhanced, allowing you to identify mistakes and understand what went wrong with exceptional clarity. When reflecting on a past decision or event, you can pinpoint flaws or missteps with a heightened sense of awareness. With this knowledge, your mind automatically adjusts your future actions to avoid repeating the same mistakes, improving your decision-making over time. However, while this ability sharpens your hindsight, it doesn’t guarantee flawless future outcomes; it simply provides you with the tools to learn and adapt more effectively from your past experiences.
objects.title: Thinker (Hindsight)

objects.text: You can permanently change the texture and color of any surface you touch, such as turning a smooth flaxen floor to annoyingly rugged and navy. You may undo this at will.
objects.title: Striker (Finger Painting)

objects.text: You can exert a precise force on any surface you are directly touching. This force may be exerted in any way you desire, whether it's a poke, slash, or even manipulating a tool. The maximum force that can be exerted is based on your own strength, and it gets more precise the slower you are. A quick punch would only have the precision of a poke, but touching for a minute would allow for atomic precision.
objects.title: Striker (Precise Strike)

objects.text: Your hands can change any ingredient used for creation, such as chemistry or smithing, into its most optimal state for said task or desire in design. This optimal state can be varied based on task.
objects.title: Striker (Optimal)

objects.text: You may exchange the temperature of anything you touch with the temperature of your own body. This could allow you to cool down a coffee by heating up your finger, or vice versa. Exchanging heat will cause physical strain proportional to the speed of exchange.
objects.title: Striker (Heat Exchange)

addons.text:
Now there is a venom gland under each of your finger- and toe-nails, as well as specialized muscles around it to funnel the venom while the corresponding nail is shaped into a claw.

Additionally you can now turn your hair into detachable quills much like a porcupine's, only your quills can be laced with venom as well. You can also grow and release envenomed fine barbed hairs all over your body, much like those of a tarantula, irritating the eyes and lungs of anyone they make contact with.

You may design a new type of venom specifically for your claws and quills. This allows you to generate a different type of venom you are capable of producing with each venom gland, giving you more options.
addons.title: Claws and Quills

objects.text: You can control the length and strength of your hair and nails. You could become Rapunzel with hairs as durable as piano wires in minutes, and could grow your nails into claws as hard as steel.
objects.title: Changer (Hair/Nails)

addons.text:
Your body has become something akin to a living tension coil—flexible, explosive, and brimming with kinetic potential. Capable of contorting yourself into extreme positions and shapes to store energy like a loaded spring—the longer you maintain this tension, the greater the stored energy, right before releasing it in a sudden burst of speed, power, or movement.

A twisted torso becomes a whirling kick, a coiled limb lashes out with whip-like speed, and a compressed crouch can launch you skyward or ricochet you off walls like a human pinball. With enough experience and control, you can even chain these bursts into a seamless web of relentless, rapid, and fluid motions.

However, this comes with an inherent risk. Release too much at once, and you might lose control. Mistime a move, and the tension could turn on you instead, pulling joints, straining muscles, or even fracturing bones.
addons.title: Spring

objects.text: You have inhuman flexibility, able to contort your body into a space the size of your head.
objects.title: Changer (Contortionist)

addons.text: You now have an extra way to store items. When swapping sex, you can store clothing and accessories you’re wearing up to 2kgs, letting you have an entire outfit on standby to either already be wearing when you swap or to switch with your current one without swapping sex.
addons.title: Stored Outfit

objects.text: You can transform your sex and appearance into what you would have looked like had you been born the opposite sex, as well as switch back to your original sex and appearance at will.
objects.title: Changer (Ritsuka)

objects.text: You know when Parahumans are nearby and have a one word generalization of their powers.
objects.title: Thinker (A Word)

objects.text: People will initially come to the conclusion you're weak and that they could defeat you easily. You can turn this off so people can come to their own natural conclusions.
objects.title: Stranger (Weakling)

addons.text:
When you enter your hibernating state, your body shuts down all non-essential functions, drastically reducing your need for food, water, and oxygen. You can survive for months on nothing, and your body prioritises survival, conserving energy and only using it when absolutely necessary. The longer you remain in this state, the more your body adapts, developing resistance to toxins, extreme temperatures, and environmental hazards.

While hibernating, your subconscious remains hyper-aware, passively absorbing details from your surroundings—conversations, movements, and even subtle shifts in body language. Upon waking, you instinctively recall everything that occurred as if you had been fully conscious. Your mind also processes complex problems in your sleep, often allowing you to wake with intuitive solutions, enhanced perception, and a clearer understanding of unresolved challenges.
addons.title: Like a Log

addons.text:
With the ability to reroute your brain, and the ability to multitask, you are now able to split a portion of your mind off that is dedicated to sleeping, allowing the rest of your brain to function as fully rested 100% of the time. 

This counts for powers that require sleep or similar alternatives to take effect.
addons.title: Split Mind

objects.text: You can enter into a state of hibernation at will. While hibernating, your subconscious mind will keep watch for danger and wake you when you want it to, allowing your conscious mind to rest in an enhanced sleep. Hibernation is four times more effective than sleeping, allowing a full night's rest in just two hours.
objects.title: Brute/Breaker (Power Nap)

addons.text:
You can now create perfect instructions, with all the gaps in the algorithms being perfectly filled by your subconscious. Instructions are so complete that you can program your body to interact as if it were piloted by a fully conscious being, or even make it behave completely identical to yourself.

Of course, your thought programs would never be truly conscious, and as such, the displayed personality would not change with time, even if it executed its assigned task for years or decades.
addons.title: Thought Programming

objects.text: You can set yourself under a Master effect to perform any task on autopilot, if you make a mental script for it beforehand. You can set any amount of protocols for any possible task. Quality of performance depends on the thoroughness of your script.
objects.title: Thinker/Master (Autopilot)

objects.text: You are able to sense and perceive the predominant emotion that a sentient being is currently undergoing within your field of view. Furthermore, you can subtly influence and guide this emotional state towards a different direction, from anger to fear, hate to happiness, etc.
objects.title: Thinker/Master (Emotional Magnet)

addons.text:
You can now construct subconscious programs that would utilise your powers in a specific way in response to certain stimuli, either external or internal.

For example, you can set your powers to attack anyone around you if you ever fall unconscious. Or, if you have a teleportation power and some sort of clairvoyance, make your teleportation power activate when someone in your range of detection calls your name and destination, serving as a teleportation hub without even being consciously aware of it all the time.
addons.title: Automated Power Management

addons.text:
You can sleep and dream once again, and it brings far more benefits than it did before.

You can now fall asleep instantly at will and wake up at any moment. When you are asleep, your subconscious brain will parse and organise all the knowledge you received during the day, even if something was in your field of vision only for a second, a barely perceptible sound you ignored, etc. All this will be analysed and integrated with the rest of your knowledge, as if you personally devoted enough time to analyse the information down to the last minute details. If you skimmed through the pages of a book, after a light nap, it will be as if you read and comprehended perfectly every last bit of information presented.

As your brain now constantly optimises its information storage, its indexing function has also been enhanced. When presented with a problem, your brain will instantly provide all the relevant information, even without you consciously trying to recall something.
addons.title: Brain Formatting

addons.text: Your mind's natural organization has evolved through mastery over your mind, intuitive blueprinting, and hyper-linguistic ability. Your brain now continuously adapts and integrates any language you learn, optimizing its structure for efficiency. This can result in encrypted thoughts, and through being efficient, increased memory storage, and increased thinking speed.
addons.title: Cognitive Language

objects.text: You've been granted increased control over your mind, allowing you to rewire it as you wish. Applications of this include memory organization, mental searches, emotional regulation, and even management of your subconscious. This does not noticeably improve your thinking speed or ability to multitask.
objects.title: Thinker/Master (Organized Mind)

addons.text: Your supernatural control over your vocal cords allows you to mimic any voice you've ever heard perfectly. You also have perfect pitch.
addons.title: Vocals

objects.text: You could be a world-class orator, vocalist, or ventriloquist, with the ability to alter and project your voice to the limits of human ability, and slightly beyond.
objects.title: Shaker/Master (Speaker)

addons.text:
Your abilities as a social chameleon have evolved, acquiring new qualities; you can not only blend in, but now you can take someone's place, not just by seeming the part, but by being that person as well.

You can effortlessly adopt new identities, whether newly created or stolen, and move about without issues, to such an extent that it would be nearly impossible to sniff you out in a group without concentrated Thinker effort.

Stealing identities takes longer than creating new ones, but that's purely due to getting the details right; knocking out guards to steal their uniforms in under five seconds, creating the necessary documents to prove who you are, and profiling a target to understand how to copy them — you can do all this and more, becoming someone people fear, the one who can take everything from them.
addons.title: Imposter

objects.text: You have a perfect instinct for navigating social circles and situations. Able to effortlessly blend into any situation, you are a true social chameleon.
objects.title: Thinker/Stranger (Fitting In)

objects.text: You are a Tinker 1 specializing in makeup, hygiene and grooming, hair styling, and general cosmetic products.
objects.title: Tinker/Changer (Cosmetic Artist)

objects.text: You specialize in making fakes. This includes creating fake weapons, bodies, and other objects. Your imitation items are convincing to most, but thinkers and tinkertech users can detect their true nature. Your creations, no matter how perfect, will still be fake. If you make a fake gun, it won't fire, and a fake shield won't be able to protect you.
objects.title: Tinker/Stranger (Faker)

objects.text: Your sense of pain is replaced by a light, undistracting fizzy sensation, allowing you to operate at full capacity regardless of injuries. A different sensation like an itch will occur if what you're doing will exacerbate an existing injury.
objects.title: Brute/Thinker (Painkiller)

objects.text: At will, you can cause your spit and sweat to become caustic. It will cause mildly painful, short-term reactions to anyone else it touches.
objects.title: Blaster/Striker (Caustic Fluids)

addons.text:
Your grip extends to the world around you, allowing you to make yourself nigh impossible to move relative to a static point.

This also lets you climb walls and hang on ceilings.
addons.title: Grounded

objects.text: You have an unwavering grip that prevents anything you hold in your hand from being knocked down, taken away, or unintentionally released, unless you consciously choose to let it go.
objects.title: Striker/Brute (Unwavering Grip)

addons.text: Due to your new sense of time, reaction speed, and spring-like coils, your base speed has tripled from what it once was. However, these new speeds truly shine through when you are shrunk down into your “fun size” form, as your top speed, along with related things like reaction time, grows to a much higher degree. If you were an ordinary human, this would allow you to keep up with supercars on the road; however, while you can run at these speeds, the risks and injuries increase, as well as the strain on your stamina.
addons.title: Unidentified Blur

objects.text: You can shrink down into a "fun-sized" version of yourself, greatly increasing your speed and mobility and proportionately decreasing your weight and strength.
objects.title: Changer/Mover (Chibi)

objects.text: You can grow and increase your muscle mass significantly, enough to roughly triple your base strength.
objects.title: Changer/Brute (Meathead)

objects.text:
You can boost your strength, speed and reaction time by 5 times, with the boost lasting only a split second, costing stamina and a 1 second cooldown after the surge ends. A normal person with no physical training can handle using this no more than 10 times in noncombat situations. 

An example of its ideal use is activating it right before a hit lands, boosting the power of the hit’s speed and strength. Another example is activating it right before you are going to be hit, using the surge in speed and reaction time to both perceive the attack better and dodge at the very last second. In both cases, using it for decisive actions are best.
objects.title: Brute/Mover (Surge)

objects.text: Your movements and any clothing you wear are unnaturally quiet. Most people probably wouldn't be able to hear you at all unless you were in a full sprint or wearing something obnoxiously loud like plate armor.
objects.title: Stranger/Mover (Stealth Mode)

addons.text: Your expertise allows you to imbue your creations with emotional resonance, allowing them to influence the emotions and perceptions of those who see or wear them. This allows the wearer of your creations to convey confidence, calmness, or inspiration as needed. Additionally, your designs can subtly affect the wearer's emotions, allowing them to embody the persona their attire represents. For example, a warrior's armor might instill courage and determination, a diplomat's suit could enhance charisma and eloquence, and an artist's outfit might boost creativity and imagination. This emotional alignment helps the wearer act the part they dress for.
addons.title: PR’s Dream

objects.text: You specialize in creating various kinds of outfits, equipment, drawings, and so on that can strike the hearts of people. This grants you parahuman levels of fashion and design and can be used to make a lasting first impression. This Tinker Specialty works well with other Tinker Powers.
objects.title: Tinker/Thinker (Public Relations)

objects.text: Your movements flow easily and gracefully. This enables you to effortlessly dodge attacks, stay balanced in any situation, and pull off extremely difficult maneuvers.
objects.title: Thinker/Mover (Graceful)

objects.text: The moment your blood leaves your body, it becomes completely useless for everything besides being an absolutely mundane human blood not connected to you. This also makes it useless for things like gene tests, cloning, and any blood-related powers besides your own.
objects.title: Stranger (Strange Blood)

objects.text: You possess the ability to heal flawlessly. Injuries like dislocated joints will reset themselves, and issues such as myopia-related vision loss will also mend. This power doesn't affect the speed of healing; instead, it ensures that any healing your body undergoes is precise. For instance, if it typically takes weeks for a wound to close, this healing process will occur flawlessly over those weeks. No more poorly healed broken bones causing future problems.
objects.title: Brute (Genetic Template)

addons.text: Your mind processes information at an accelerated pace, effortlessly grasping complex concepts in minutes. Heightened neuroplasticity for instinctual understanding, a reliable gut instinct for truth assessment, and an organized mind that orchestrates thoughts, memories, and emotions combine to create a formidable force. The result is unparalleled cognitive prowess, facilitating seamless navigation through thought, perception, and decision-making.
addons.title: Swift Insight

objects.text: Your brain has reached new heights, allowing you to intuitively understand and comprehend everything much faster. What used to take you weeks now takes you hours, or even minutes. Your neuroplasticity is through the roof.
objects.title: Thinker (Understanding)

addons.text:
You no longer just survive underwater; you thrive, as you can swim throughout the ocean at double your top running speed with no hindrance to your movement. Whatever toxins you encounter while underwater can no longer affect you, with most being unable to enter your body and those that do being quickly filtered out, like microplastics, hazardous chemicals, or oil.

Water pressure is no longer a danger, but rather an annoyance for the most part, as higher pressures can slow you down. Only extreme pressures—over 4,000 meters—present a real danger to you without additional protection. This also means you're immune to the bends, as your body can easily adjust to the changes in pressure, allowing you to leap out of the ocean with your full momentum behind you.

In addition to all of this, you gain a nictitating membrane for your eyes—effectively a third eyelid to go with your upper and lower eyelids—allowing you to blink and moisten the eye without losing sight. Unlike the others, this eyelid is horizontal instead of vertical. Your eyes become much more adept at adjusting to different levels of light, allowing you to see underwater as long as even a little light can reach those depths. As a consequence, this makes you immune to sudden changes in light, so flashes cannot negatively affect you.

Finally, due to your knowledge of the ocean, you have a basic grasp of creating a habitat for yourself underwater. While it may not be identical to one on the surface, you can, with time, research, location, and resources, build an underwater home or even a city.​
addons.title: Aquatic Lifestyle

objects.text:
Your lungs now possess the ability to filter water entering them in ways that let you breathe water as if it were air, both fresh and salt water. Breathing water automatically takes care of the liquid requirements of a healthy diet. 

Polluted/contaminated water is still dangerous to you. You can also handle water pressure fifty percent better than the average human. You also no longer have a gag reflex for liquids.
objects.title: Brute (Water Breathing)

objects.text: With a touch, you have the ability to transform any type of liquid into any type of beverage you desire.
objects.title: Striker (John 2:1-11)

addons.text: Your mind constantly organizes all the knowledge you receive through all of your senses, without the need for downtime and rest. For example—the moment you see a page in a book, it is imprinted into your memory with instant and perfect understanding of every bit of information. Your mind will also automatically extrapolate any missing information based on your knowledge, as well as correct false data.
addons.title: Comprehension

objects.text: Your mind has been sharpened, improving your focus, creativity, and memory. With your newfound clarity, your mind effortlessly flows from one thought to the next, completely unhindered by unwanted distractions. While this does not improve your intelligence or comprehension abilities, this greatly improves your creativity, granting countless ideas ready to be acted upon. This also enhances your memory, making it impossible to lose your train of thought, or forget any potential ideas.
objects.title: Thinker (Clarity)

objects.text: You can get the most out of everything you engage with, avoiding unnecessary waste. Your body can more efficiently extract the most nutrients from food, keeping you full and hydrated for longer periods of time. This applies to your sleep as well, making it so you have to sleep less for the same benefits as a full night of rest. Other examples include crafting and getting the most out of your ability to manage time and space as resources.
objects.title: Thinker/Brute (Waste Not Want Not)

addons.text:
Your now paradoxical heart (not needing one, but having it still) has been repurposed into something else; no longer the engine of your body, it has become a supercharger to enhance your capabilities.

Your blood flow is sped up and optimized to increase your physical abilities by about 5% at a baseline, though this can rise in demanding situations as it draws from your reserves of energy and nutrients to speed up regeneration and enhance your abilities. However, doing so depletes more of your reserves, so there is a limit to how long this boost can last.

Additionally, you gain greater control over your heartbeat, allowing you to slow it down or speed it up without consequence; furthermore, the effects of the "King Engine" are no longer limited to your heart, but spread throughout your body, giving you full control over the volume of your heartbeat and significantly raising its upper limit. In theory, you could even use this as a means of communication through Morse code.

Damage or powers focused on your heart are still no threat to you; instead, they will only take away the boosts from "Super Heart Charge" until your heart regenerates from the damage done, even if it was completely removed. However, full regeneration after removal would take several weeks at a minimum to complete.
addons.title: Super Heart Charge

objects.text:
Your heartbeat can become really loud. Loud enough for everyone around you to hear it clearly at 130 decibels, which is the equivalent of a hammer pounding a nail. The stronger your muscles are, the louder your heart will be.

This doesn't give any other real benefits besides the loud heartbeat. The heartbeat won't impede or damage your hearing. You can turn it on or off whenever you want, but it may sometimes turn itself on on its own if your emotions are intense enough, like fear or anger.
objects.title: Stranger (King Engine)

addons.text: When Tinkering you can selectively treat anything you touch as if it had the properties of iron or steel, with these properties selectively staying present in the final result. This allows you to do things such as forge futuristic alloys into plate armor using medieval methods, or even create swords of ice with the durability of steel. With time you can can work light itself into armor and arm yourself and others with blades forged from fire and lightning.
addons.title: Exotic Forgemaster

addons.text:
Through your connection to your ancestors, you now not only have access to medieval blueprints but also all skills and knowledge from medieval times. You can seamlessly engage in swordplay with the expertise of a knight, practice herbal medicine as understood in that era, and navigate court politics with the cunning of a noble diplomat. 

However, the knowledge and techniques you possess are rooted in the understanding of medieval times, meaning areas such as medicine or science may be outdated, rudimentary, or even incorrect by modern standards.
addons.title: Blast of the Past

addons.text:
You can imbue into your medieval creations one of the following effects: a minor heat effect (can cause a burst of heat capable of causing first degree burns), a minor ice effect (a burst of cold that can numb muscles and cause a stinging pain), a minor electrical effect (a jolt that can make someone crumple to the floor), a force dispersion effect, or a minor enhancement to shock absorption. The effects can be made with certain triggers, such as contact, command, or motion. With time you'll be able to make new effects based on other T0/Lesser powers you have, modify the effects you've already made, and even give your creations multiple effects at once.

While under sunlight, your medieval creations will repair themselves and become permanently stronger. As an example, an iron sword, after a full day of absorbing sunlight, could gain the durability and edge retention of steel. Self-repairing will allow for an object to be returned to peak condition within 12 hours of sunlight. In general, imbued effects will take twice as long to increase in power as the other qualities of your creations. Increases in power will have diminishing returns, so don't expect to make Mjolnir by soaking a hammer in the sun for a week.
addons.title: Temu Objects of Power

objects.text: You are knowledgeable in the techniques used to create medieval technology, such as iron blades, catapults, forts and more. You have a strong understanding of the materials, tools, and techniques used in forging and are skilled in the creation of medieval technologies using these methods.
objects.title: Tinker (Medieval)

objects.text: You shoot and create sticky threads coming from your wrists made of an organic material similar to a spider web. The amount of webs you produce depends on your stamina and/or the body’s internal fat stores. Use this for barriers, a defensive perimeter, and bindings or traps.
objects.title: Blaster (Thwip!)

objects.text: You can manipulate the texture, color, density, sensitivity, and health of your skin. You could for example harden your skin alongside changing its texture to appear rocky on the surface so it could offer a slight protection, or change the hues of your skin as a makeshift camouflage. By consequence, you have a borderline parahuman sense of touch.
objects.title: Changer/Brute (Skin)

addons.text: You can copy the eyes and ocular characteristics of animals you’ve encountered and studied the eyes of, be it to experience having compound eyes like those of insects. For night, heat or monocular vision, or to see more colors like tetrachromats do, as long as you manage to encounter animals who have these kinds of visions.
addons.title: Animalistic Ocular Variance

objects.text: You can change the color and shape of your eyes and make them a little shine. This doesn't offer any benefits, but you can copy other people's retinas to fool eye scanners.
objects.title: Changer (Colorful Eyes)

addons.text:
Thanks to your 'luck', any of your semi-plausible stupid ideas are now guaranteed to work out at least as competently as a well-thought-out plan or idea. What's more, the smarter your opponent or opponents are, the more potent your 'luck' is, further increasing the chance of your plans succeeding. If your opponent was someone like Accord, the chances of your stupid ideas being successful might be almost 100%.

You are also a complete blindspot to all prediction-based thinker abilities short of those that are 'All-or-Nothing' like Contessa.
addons.title: I Can't Believe That Worked

addons.text:
Your mind operates with an unshakable simplicity, cutting through the fog of manipulation and deception. Abstract concepts, illusions, metaphors, and indirect mind games fall flat against you because you lack the capacity—or perhaps the burden—to interpret anything beyond its most literal meaning. When someone attempts to ensnare you in an elaborate illusion or manipulate your thoughts through subtle persuasion, their efforts crumble like a house of cards. Indirect psychological tactics—false visions, layered meanings, or intricate suggestions—fail entirely, as you cannot be swayed by anything you do not perceive exactly as it is.

Direct mind control will still take hold, as it bypasses interpretation entirely, but any attempt to confuse or mislead you through indirect means is doomed to fail. A false reality conjured to distract or disorient you becomes meaningless; you perceive it as no more than what it appears on the surface. Enemies who rely on tricks of the mind find their efforts reduced to nothing.
addons.title: Weaponized Smoothbrain
Slapstick!
addons.text:
Instead of merely prepared stupidity, your confusing body language combined with your ability to reflect and redirect kinetic energy has allowed you to replicate, to some extent, a slapstick character.

You become harder for Thinkers to predict, and even when they get a clear answer, they tend to be somewhat dumbfounded by what they find, with it not being uncommon for them to wonder how you managed to survive this long. The random actions you add to your movements enhance your use of Tai Chi, the use of which becomes nearly automatic so long as it fits the theme of slapstick, appearing more like random luck than actual skill.

objects.text: When planning or deciding on an idea, you can now think of a possible and semi-plausible really stupid idea. If you decide to go through with this idea, then the idea is immune to most prediction-based thinker abilities and has a higher chance to work depending on how smart your opponent is.
objects.title: Thinker/Trump (Dare to be Stupid)

addons.text:
Your body now operates at peak efficiency, maximizing every biological function. Every muscle, bone, and organ works at 99% optimization, ensuring no energy or nutrients are wasted. You can break down and absorb even the toughest organic matter, fully recycling everything you consume. As a result, your stamina is nearly limitless, though exerting yourself too much can still wear you down.

Your sleep cycles have also adapted. You can use unihemispheric slow-wave sleep (USW), allowing part of your brain to rest while the other stays active, eliminating the need for full sleep. While you no longer require sleep to function, you may still feel a mental desire for it. When you do sleep, your REM cycles are far more effective, fully restoring your body and mind in a fraction of the time.

In practical terms, you only need one hour of sleep per week, though even that is more for mental relief than an actual necessity.
addons.title: Refined Biology

objects.text:
Every autonomic part of your body—such as your liver, lungs, and lymphatic nodes—has been streamlined and optimized for peak efficiency. These systems can now handle and counteract challenges such as detoxifying your body at an accelerated rate and managing toxins, heavy metals, and other harmful substances that would overwhelm a normal body. Additionally, minor imperfections like wisdom teeth, certain bones like the fabella, and inverted eye cones have been corrected.

This optimization means that minor injuries and illnesses heal faster, you fend off infections and diseases more effectively, require less sleep without sacrificing restfulness and your lymphatic system is heightened, minimizing downtime and maintaining your peak physical condition.
objects.title: Brute/Breaker (Efficient Autonomic Systems)

addons.text: Thanks to your ability to interface with electronic devices and understand code, you can now use Book Osmosis to download information from digital devices you're in contact with.
addons.title: Download

addons.text: You have gained a reverse form of Book Osmosis, printing information from your mind directly onto surfaces and into books.
addons.title: Finger Printing

objects.text: By touching a book, you can absorb its contents and gain all the knowledge within. You will have perfect understanding of the knowledge. However, if you try to absorb all the information too quickly, you may suffer from headaches, and you will have trouble remembering the material. You can also use this power while asleep, passively gaining knowledge of books you are touching as you rest. However, in this case, much of the information will be stored in your subconscious, making it harder to access directly. Instead, it may come to you in the form of instincts, dreams, or sudden insights. This does not protect you from hazardous information.
objects.title: Striker/Thinker (Book Osmosis)

objects.text: No matter what outfit you choose, you'll experience complete comfort, regardless of the circumstances. You can wear high heels and hike for hours without any pain or discomfort, or don a heavy cloak under the hot sun without feeling overheated or burdened. Whether you're dressed for elegance or practicality, your attire will never hinder you, allowing you to move freely and effortlessly in any environment. This doesn’t fully affect armour, only affecting decorative parts of said armour.
objects.title: Breaker/Striker (Clothes)

addons.text:
Your jaws are enhanced to complement your teeth, significantly increasing both its range of motion and its bite strength. 

With this, you could even fit and crush multiple bricks in your mouth if you wanted.
addons.title: Strong Jaws

objects.text: Your teeth become incredibly strong, like titanium, and are sharp like razors. You can also change their shape, color, and slight structure—defaulting to a shark-like appearance. Your oral cavity and tongue gain equal strength, ensuring you don’t accidentally cut your tongue and if you try chew on concrete or metal, swallowing such materials is not advisable.
objects.title: Brute/Changer (Sharp Teeth)

addons.text: You are now the master of every known language—you are now capable of easily making a new language with a mere thought. Alongside this ability, you have also gained the ability to naturally address each entity in its natural tongue simultaneously, both verbally and through writing. You could theoretically talk to the whole world at once, with each person hearing their natural language. Somehow, this also allows deaf people to naturally understand you even if they can't hear you and can't see you using sign language.
addons.title: Babel²

objects.text: You are a natural hyper-linguist, and a subsection of your brain is built for storing and processing what you know about languages, including both their meaning and grammar. This applies to all forms of language, including but not limited to verbal, written, and even body language, given enough time. The process is faster the more languages you know and the more similar the new language is to ones you already know. This won't allow for you to immediately understand someone's language but will significantly speed up the process.
objects.title: Thinker (Cypher)

addons.text: You can implant eyes into your detached hands which will likewise continue functioning as before, granting you another viewpoint. The time necessary to regrow your eyes and hands is halved.
addons.title: Tenome

addons.text: Your hands are no longer limited to crawling along surfaces, and may now move through the air with ease. They do not have much force behind their movements, so don’t expect them to be able to pick up anything heavier than a wrench.
addons.title: Flying Hand

addons.text: You can now teleport your hands about, both those that have already been detached and your still-attached hands; however, while you don't need line of sight on the hands themselves, you still need to have line of sight on where you want them to appear. Given that this only affects your hands, the charge time on distance (10 cm for every second) has been reduced to 1/8th of what it was, essentially turning that 10 cm into 80 cm for the same amount of charge time, so long as it's only focused on your hands.
addons.title: Hand Toss

objects.text: You may now detach your hands at will, and they function as if still attached. Your body may regrow new hands over time, but it can take up to a few weeks to fully regenerate.
objects.title: Brute/Master (Creeping Hand)

addons.text: Your knowledge of the law has expanded to include all the laws of the governing body of any area you happen to be, whether it's a country or an entire star system. You also know all the loopholes or traps present within those laws.
addons.title: Lawyer from Hell

addons.text: Your ability to complete paperwork has been upgraded to include all kinds of legalese, and every bit of paperwork you now do is fool-proof within the legal system you work in. No lawyer or devil can find any loophole in any documents you've helped create.
addons.title: Legalese

objects.text: You have gained the ability to defeat the greatest threat to any being in a position of power: paperwork. No matter how much needs to be done, you can complete it in no more than 30 minutes and be done as if you dedicated yourself completely to the task with all of your knowledge and abilities.
objects.title: Thinker/Shaker (Bane of Paperwork)

objects.text: You are a savant when it comes to insults. Whether it be based upon a person's appearance or character, your insults are astonishingly accurate, always hitting where it hurts—emotionally, that is. This power does not cause direct physical damage. Do note that you have no direct control over how a person will respond to your insult—where one person would collapse and sob with a potent insult, another would go into a blind rage. Not all insults are equal, though; you can't expect a weak or cut and paste insult to have much effect, but it would have a minuscule improvement.
objects.title: Thinker/Master (What, You Egg?)

addons.text: Your eyes count as yourself and can thus each employ 3rd person vision though their range is halved, you can hear through them due to this perspective not using your ears to hear. Your detached eyes can also rotate seamlessly without moving. This doesn’t allow you to focus on each of them simultaneously, you can only perceive through one perspective at a time. Though you’re always aware of how much noise, visual and auditory, each eye perceives. You have to switch your current perspective if you want to see or hear through them.
addons.title: Multiple POVs

objects.text: You have 20/20 vision, your eyes can regenerate any damage done to them and they’ll have graft tolerance as transplants. You can also painlessly detach your eyes, which will remain functional even without a body to sustain them, your eyes will regrow within a week.
objects.title: Thinker/Brute (Flawless Ocular Donor)

addons.text:
Your body has undergone a radical transformation, turning your bloodstream into a corrosive medium that you can weaponize. You can eject caustic blood from your body, to inflict damage on your surroundings or enemies, shooting up to dozens of meters away with pin point accuracy.

Your heartbeat serves as a key component of your abilities, generating powerful sound waves that resonate through your body. These vibrations enhance blood flow, increasing your endurance, oxygen distribution, and the range at which you can project your caustic blood. The louder and faster your heart beats, the more oxygen and adrenaline you can pump into your muscles, granting you temporary bursts of superhuman strength and speed. An interesting secondary aspect is that the faster your heart beats, the faster you can replenish blood.

You have precise control over your corrosive fluids, allowing you to selectively concentrate their acidic properties in specific parts of your body. This specialisation increases potency in the targeted areas but reduces the acidity elsewhere, providing flexibility in both offense and defense.

Lastly, the acidic properties of your blood leave no trace beyond the damage caused, making your attacks impossible to track or analyse.
addons.title: Favourite of Landsteiner

objects.text: You possess the ability to guide the flow of blood throughout your body. This would allow you to do things like modify your heart rate, scab quickly, redistribute your body temperature, or even force harmful toxins out of your bloodstream.
objects.title: Brute (Blood Guidance)

addons.text:
Your sense to anticipate danger can now lock in on the events your 'Gitchy Feelin’’ warns you about, however it won’t outright inform you of what they are. So long as the event itself isn't the kind to suddenly happen without any warnings, (i.e. a drive-by shooting or an endbringer attack), you can use your sixth sense to help infer what the event could be. The closer you are to the event occurring, the ‘heavier’ your danger sense will feel to you. 

This will continue until you are within 1 hour of the event occurring. If the event happens within the first hour after receiving the warning, it will feel heaviest within 10 minutes of it occurring instead.
addons.title: Closing The Gap

addons.text:
Once you get an uneasy sensation that something bad is coming, you start experiencing small, fleeting moments of déjà vu. These moments are vague and scattered, like half-remembered dreams, but they grow stronger the closer you get to whatever Gitchy Feelin’ was warning you about. When you’re just minutes away, the déjà vu becomes overwhelming, locking you into an eerie certainty that you’ve already lived this moment before.

The feeling of déjà vu won’t tell you why it matters or what’s about to happen, but you’ll be sure that this moment is part of it. Your instincts will sharpen, making it easier to tell if something feels right or wrong, but the déjà vu doesn’t come with answers—just the eerie sense that you’ve lived this before, and that what you do next counts.

If you manage to change course, making choices that take you away from the danger, the déjà vu weakens, becoming less intense and less frequent. This doesn’t mean you’ve avoided the event entirely, just that you’ve nudged yourself off the direct path toward it. But if the déjà vu keeps building, you’ll know you’re still headed straight for whatever’s coming.
addons.title: Half Remembered Echoes

objects.text:
You have a minor, but ‘far-out’ danger sense, in the form of a series of sensations that make your head swim and your legs tremble, leaving you uncomfortable for a short time. This will never occur during active combat or whenever it is otherwise detrimental for you to experience it. This sense is never wrong, per se, but you can easily under/overestimate what they’re warning you about.

These feelings will be an omen for bad things to come within the next 6 hours of you experiencing these feelings. However, the seriousness of these events does not affect the ‘potency’ of the sensations, so whether the feeling is warning you about an upcoming endbringer attack or having a really heated argument with a close friend remains unclear. When the event occurs, you will know that it’s what the feelings were warning you about.
objects.title: Thinker (Gitchy Feelin')

objects.text:
Your ability to solve problems has been increased tenfold. You can process information, evaluate options, and come up with solutions way faster than normal. What would take others minutes or hours, you can do in a few seconds. You can analyze a problem and mentally run through dozens of possible solutions, narrowing it down almost immediately to what you think is most likely to work.

You’ll be able to come up with solutions on the fly and adjust your approach as new information comes in.
objects.title: Thinker (Problem Solving)

addons.text:
In addition to safely detaching any body part or organ, you can now attach others in their place no matter how biologically incompatible or alien they are. Newly attached organs will integrate without any issues, possibly even providing you with various boons if the body part in question was taken from someone possessing superhuman capabilities, with your flesh seamlessly connecting all the new additions the moment they touch your body. The only real limitation is that you can have only one brain.

Even if you had changed every single part of your body, at any time you may initialise the slow process of normalising your body, with your DNA overwriting and reverting any foreign body parts, restoring the body you had before any changes were made. The time required for a full reversal may vary depending on the amount of changes you have done to yourself but will never be more than a week.
addons.title: Godrick the Grafted Jr.

addons.text:
You are no longer at the mercy of random mutations. When you transplant an organ or a body part onto yourself, the constantly adapting nature of your DNA will assimilate all the positive traits of the transplanted body part and gradually spread them over to the rest of your body. These new traits will perfectly integrate with your biology, never hindering you or causing unwanted changes.

This allows you to, potentially, achieve any mutation with the right template. Additionally, you can now reverse any changes that were caused to your biology, whether as a result of your own evolution or outside meddling.
addons.title: Guided Evolution

addons.text: Any organ transplant or blood transfusion you provide now grants the same temporary but high-speed healing factor you benefit from, though the recipient must pay the cost with their own body and energy. In a pinch, you can douse external wounds in your blood, or feed someone your blood to heal internal wounds; these methods are less effective than actual transfusions and transplants. If you possess the Brute/Breaker (Efficient Autonomic Systems) power, your blood also supercharges their immune system, allowing them to fight off diseases and infections their system could not handle on its own.
addons.title: Regenerative Transfusion

objects.text:
Your genetic makeup becomes somewhat malleable, able to temporarily adapt to foreign bodies entering your system or adapt your biological material to foreign bodies.

You can transplant organs, transfuse blood, and so on without fear of rejection even if the donor is an alien, a mutant, or anybody else. This works both ways, so you act both as a universal recipient and a universal donor. This even allows you to have children with races that are normally biologically incompatible with you, with the resulting offspring becoming true hybrids, gaining all the benefits and lessening the drawbacks of the parent's respective species.
objects.title: Brute (Biocompatibility)

addons.text:
With the ability to organize your mind, you are now able to manipulate the knowledge you store in a crystal more precisely. This allows you to store multiple memories in a crystal, more precisely tune how knowledge is presented, or even combine previous skills to form a more versatile version adapted to a desired purpose. 

You are still limited to an hour of your knowledge, so any experiences will stay just as weak as before, just more customizable. This also allows you to retain experiences that have been condensed due to the nature of Organized Mind.
addons.title: Managed Knowledge

addons.text: With the powers of mental hibernation and acceleration combined, you may now condense larger crystals while napping. There is no limit on storage size of such crystals, and they condense at a rate of one hour of information every second.
addons.title: Improved Condensation

addons.text: With improved clarity of thought and a natural grasp of communication, you can greatly increase the quality of your knowledge. No matter a persons past experiences, they will perfectly understand your knowledge, and with greater quality. This also naturally allows for higher concentration of information at up to ten times the previous amount.
addons.title: Crystal Clear

addons.text: With the power to absorb external information, you may now choose to channel it directly into a crystal at normal speeds. This information may come from anywhere, whether it be media or a living being, as long as you have consent or ownership of the knowledge.
addons.title: Download

addons.text: Instead of using a condensed crystal on a living being, you can instead choose to turn it into an illusion describing the experience in real time. Once used an an illusion, the crystal may not be used for another purpose.
addons.title: Display

addons.text: You can now join two crystals together by touching them, allowing them to combine in knowledge. The closer the two crystals are in knowledge, the higher quality the fusion will be. If a crystal being fused previously came from a fusion, it gains a 20% penalty to its maximum contributed knowledge.
addons.title: Fuse

addons.text: You can use Über to gain mastery over a specific skill or technique and then crystallize it using Thinker (Knowledge Condensation). The skill you master with Über is not bound by the one-hour time limit, just limited by what ever skill you can conjure up with Über. This means you can condense highly refined or advanced techniques into a crystal, regardless of the time it would ordinarily take to learn or practice them. This is however unlikely as Über does not give complete skills, only specific technique (such as how to throw a punch).
addons.title: Skill Crystals

addons.text: Your ability to easily make mental blueprints allows you to insert a how to guide to make weak piece of tinkertech. This is extremely limited and cannot be used for more than one piece of tech. An engine part could be added but not the full engine. It is only as strong as 1 SP but complexity could be upgraded to 2 SP depending on other addons.
addons.title: Schematics

addons.text:
Consent and ownership are no longer a hurdle for you, as you can force out information from the media or a living person and condense it into a crystal.

This may make the process a bit longer with living people, as they can fight against it in a battle of wills; but the stronger your will and the more skills you have, this becomes a small hurdle in the process.
addons.title: Forceful Extraction

objects.text:
Your mind can condense crystals that contain your experiences, such as a single memory, knowledge, or skill. It may at most contain an hour of information, and it is wiped from your mind. This process will take a second for every minute of information stored.

Keep in mind that any knowledge or skills gained will be fairly weak, as anything decent would typically take longer than an hour to learn.
objects.title: Thinker (Knowledge Condensation)

addons.text: You are no longer restricted to your own species, allowing you to copy from any mundane organism you touch.
addons.title: Biocompatibility

addons.text: You may now choose to regenerate your body at rapid rates, at the cost of increased bodily strain and calorie consumption.
addons.title: Growth Override

objects.text:
You may now choose to guide the growth of your body to copy anything you touch, at the cost of increased demand on your body. You can choose to copy any mundane features you want, such as hair color, facial structure, height, immunities, etc, though the larger the modification, the greater the calorie consumption.

This will not be any faster than normal, meaning it may often take many months, or even years to fully enact a change, though depending on what you are trying to change, you might be able to accelerate the process through mundane methods such as exercise or hair growth formulas. Also, this may only copy from those that are the same species as you.
objects.title: Changer (Guided Growth)

objects.text: While stationary, sunlight invigorates you in both body and mind. The invigoration of the body provides sustenance, a quickened metabolism, decreased fatigue, enhanced cellular regeneration, and improved physical capabilities. The invigoration of the mind provides improved clarity, perception, rationale, and willpower.
objects.title: Brute/Thinker (Solar)

addons.text: You can manage the changes made to powers, store information on what changes you've made and what the resulting power was, in addition to seeing what changes you've yet to make could result in. As an example, you could see what would happen by changing Tinker (Medieval) to a Thinker power without having to test it.
addons.title: Hypothetical Changes

addons.text:
You can track your accumulated souls, the lifeforce of those you've slain, how the Fire Keeper has converted them into power for you, visualized as levels and stats, and what the cost of souls currently is to get another level up. The higher your level is, the more souls it takes to level up again. The stats are as follows:
Vitality - your raw life force and your body's integrity
Attunement - your mental clarity and memory
Endurance - your physical stamina
Strength - your brute strength
Dexterity - your combat finesse, agility, and precision
Intelligence - your mental processing speed
Faith - your conviction and devotion
addons.title: Soul Level

objects.text: You can summon a mental HUD that only displays all your powers and their upgrades. If your powers can create new powers, the HUD allows you to manage this process directly. You can only watch, not interact.
objects.title: Thinker/Trump (HUD)

addons.text:
Your mind has evolved into a perfect analytical engine, capable of seeing not just details and patterns, but their long-term implications. Every problem, situation, or system you observe is broken down into its fundamental components within moments, allowing you to understand how every piece interacts and how small changes will ripple outward. You don’t just notice details—you instantly comprehend their significance, spotting weaknesses, opportunities, and the most efficient path forward with almost supernatural clarity.

This extends to people, social dynamics, combat, and large-scale strategy. Given time to analyze, you can predict how someone will act, identify the exact pressure points to exploit, and orchestrate long-term plans with ruthless efficiency. Whether in a fight, a negotiation, or on a battlefield, you are always several moves ahead, adapting faster than your opponents can react.

Your ability to optimize your thought processes in real time makes your decision-making flawless, constantly refining how you analyze, recall, and apply knowledge. Given enough data, you can devise counterstrategies on the fly, predicting and adapting to any scenario before it fully unfolds. You are a walking grandmaster of strategy, capable of countering and outmaneuvering even the most unpredictable situations.
addons.title: Watchmaker

objects.text: You are perceptive, extremely so. You can notice the smallest details near instantly, and have no trouble recalling those details. That’s about as far as this goes—actually making use of those details, be it for deductions or anything else, is up to you, as this power only helps you notice details.
objects.title: Thinker (Attention to Detail)

addons.text:
In your mind, there is a mental notebook. This notebook records everything you learn about the people you interact with. It keeps track of the clothes they like to wear, their favorite things, their dislikes, and how they respond to different actions. The notebook grows over time, adding more details as you observe and interact with them. This notebook is very detailed. It notices even small changes in their feelings, such as a slight drop in affection caused by something you said or did. Every reaction, no matter how small, is recorded and stored for future reference.

If you choose, you enter a state called “Ideal Route” mode. This mode uses the information in the notebook to guide your behavior, helping you match the preferences of the person you are focusing on. It ensures that your actions and words align with what they like, making you appear as their “ideal type.” This mode adjusts your behavior to avoid mistakes and create a perfect connection with the person based on their preferences.
addons.title: Ideal Route

objects.text: You have the power all Dating Sims need! An affection meter. You can see the amount of affection, or just general positivity, a person has for you. You can choose what format you prefer, from gauges to numbers or even an aura around your target. This only allows you to see positive emotions a person has in relation to yourself, and how your actions increase or decrease said positive emotions.
objects.title: Thinker (Affection Meter)

objects.text: Whenever you’re being visually recorded or come into the focus of a camera, you’ll gain awareness of its perspective. In addition to gaining the viewpoint you’re being observed from, you can also perceive how the shot will turn out—whether it will be a bad photo (red), a good photo (yellow), or a perfect photo (green). This allows you to adjust yourself to always let your best self be photographed and recorded.
objects.title: Thinker (The Perfect Shot)

objects.text: Just like you’d see the back of the characters you control in video games, you can now examine yourself from a third-person perspective centered around yourself. This perspective can zoom out up to 5m. It can go through thin walls if you press yourself to them, but cannot go through thick walls or the ground. This perspective will always be focused on you and as such, will always look into your direction. Your normal sight will remain unaffected and you can control both separately without much difficulty—this vision remains unaffected even if your normal senses are impaired and you can hear through it. This power can serve as a vector for any other sensory powers you possess.
objects.title: Thinker (Third Person POV)

objects.text: You’re capable of mentally viewing information about yourself, but this only includes your body. This can range from seeing your lifting strength and maximum speed to the amount of cells in your body or what your blood is like, much more accurately and detailed than what a blood test could show. You can view some very specific information if you manage to find the right sub-menu, like what your kidney processes, or the details of your brain parts. This only shows your current data.
objects.title: Thinker (Physical Profile)

objects.text:
You may choose to perceive the olfactory, tactile, and gustatory timeline of any entity you are touching. You may look up to at most an hour into the past/future, and will take at most a minute to do so. 

This would for example allow you sense if an object has been in any easily distinguishable environments such as a sewer or landfill.
objects.title: Thinker (Indirect Oracle)

objects.text: Your body has natural folds that function as multi-use pockets. This allows you to hide a variety of small items on your person with easy stowage and retrieval.
objects.title: Tinker/Stranger (Skinbelt)

objects.text:
With a single physical touch, you can diagnose yourself or others, identifying any and every ailment, wounds, or even toxins affecting the body. This ability allows you to pinpoint the exact location of the affliction, understand its nature, determine how long it has been present, and predict potential side effects or complications, etc. You can even use this on the recently deceased, to understand the full cause of their death.

While this power provides comprehensive information about the condition, it does not reveal a cure or solution—only the full scope of the issue.
objects.title: Striker/Thinker (Diagnostic)

addons.text: The addition of sounds to your cosmetic effects make them hit even harder than before. The rumble of your walk as you're cloaked in aura making you look even more cool and/or terrifying, or the distinct charge of your signature attack making its payoff even more satisfying. Even your mundane actions will carry more weight than you realize.
addons.title: I am the Storm

objects.text: The world itself acknowledges your supreme power. You generate a variety of minor effects: The earth around you shakes with your mere presence. The wind trembles with your every footstep. The sky roars with thunder at your anger. These effects are somewhat random and cannot be used for combat, but they will always look extremely cool.
