You aren't limited to the three mentioned effects, and can generate anything from glowing eyes to changing the color of the sky, as long as it is cosmetic. You cannot turn this power off, though you can scale it down.
objects.title: Shaker (Badass Aura)

objects.text:
Your ability to manage and apply your existing knowledge more effectively has been boosted. Rather than just learning new skills, your mind finds ways to optimize how you use what you already know, leading to faster growth and greater efficiency in all areas of life. It allows you to structure and reorganize your thoughts, ideas, and experiences into more effective systems.

 You are able to intuitively recognize patterns and improve mental processes that were previously disjointed or underutilized. Whether it's reorganizing knowledge for better retention, finding new connections between concepts, or creating streamlined approaches to problems, your mind constantly refines itself. This power doesn't just make you smarter, it helps you maximize your mental potential by finding the best ways to organize and apply what you already know, accelerating your development and making you more capable over time.
objects.title: Thinker (Papert's Principle)

objects.text: You can instantly determine the exact measurements of any object you look at. All measurements are automatically transmitted to your mind in the metric system of your choice.
objects.title: Thinker (Eye Measurement)

addons.text: At will, for ninety minutes a day, you can "Lock In". When Locked In, the boost from Flow State is expanded to include your powers and more abstract and physical capabilities, such as learning speed and strength. Additionally, all of your attributes that have been boosted by Flow State and Locked In are improved by 20%. You can spread out the activation period, like Locking In for ten minutes and using the rest later, with no limit to how much you can spread it over the day. Note: Locking In still doesn't improve any of your abilities beyond your own maximum capabilities beyond the 20% boost, so you won't be able to lift the most a human can lift in optimal conditions; you will be able to lift as much as you can in your current state within optimal conditions.
addons.title: Locked In

objects.text: You are always in the flow state, a zone of focus and clarity where your mind and body operate in extreme conjunction. Whether you’re solving problems, competing, or performing in a celebration, you’re always functioning at the peak of your natural abilities. Distractions fade away, hesitation disappears, and every action will feel exact, precise. You won’t surpass your physical or mental limits, but you’ll always perform at 100% of what you’re truly capable of, and no less. In any situation, you’re at your best. However, this does NOT make you better at your given talents; you’re simply doing your best, so you will have to train to become the best.
objects.title: Thinker (Flow State)

addons.text:
You're not limited to just your hands; your entire body can be used as a focus and, by extension, your own shadow. Furthermore, you can be far more creative than simply animating your entire shadow—you can split parts of it apart, and those pieces can form new shapes of their own.

Your only limit is that your shadow stays bound to wherever it is.
addons.title: Autonomous Shadow

addons.text:
Any and all shadows within your vicinity are now your stage to control. They slither and jump through surfaces with serpentine grace, horrifying glares, or anything else you can think of. 

The only thing stopping you from becoming a true campfire story is the lack of auditory cues and other miscellaneous additions, which will come from your other powers.
addons.title: Shadow Show

objects.text:
Ever tried doing a shadow puppet? You know, using your hands to shape the shadows on a wall to form different shapes? Well, you've got supernatural talent in that trick now! 

You don't even need to move your hands—just think of whatever you want and the shadows will form it with ease. You still need to use your hands as a focus, of course.
objects.title: Shaker (Shadow Puppet)

objects.text: You are surrounded by a thin, skintight, invisible forcefield, forming a protective barrier. While it offers some defense, the field is delicate. It can absorb and completely nullify the force of a standard punch. When subjected to impacts stronger than a punch, the field will only partially disperse the impact across the hit area while creating a temporary hole. This means you still take damage, but it is spread out, much like the effect of a bulletproof vest. The stronger the force of the hit, the less effective this dispersion becomes. The holes repair themselves rapidly, healing at a rate of approximately five square inches per second.
objects.title: Brute (Minor Forcefield)

addons.text:
You can grow feathers on your wings at will, regardless of if you chose to have feathers initially, shedding them on command if you want it to. While the feathers are on your wings, you can increase their hardness to that of rock without impacting their utility as feathers. 

Additionally, you can control any feathers you have shed so long as they are within 50m of your current location. In doing so, you have full control over their trajectory, and can move them at roughly 10mph (~16 km/h).
addons.title: Exotic Wings

addons.text: Your wings can at will coat and uncoat themselves in a thin sheen of waxy oil, massively reducing their water-drag while, if they're feathered, also preventing them from getting waterlogged. Thanks to this you can use your wings as flippers to propel you through the water much like a penguin, allowing you to swim at speeds of up to 25mph while staying startlingly agile, seemingly turning on a dime without losing speed underwater. If you have any powers that increase your physical strength, they will apply here, allowing you to reach even greater speeds.
addons.title: Flippers

addons.text:
You can produce poisonous scales through your wings, regardless of their appearance, and spread the scales through wingflaps, both in an area and in more targeted gusts, affecting anyone that breathes them in. Inhalation is admittedly a slower vector of poisoning than injection, taking significantly longer to achieve the same results, however in turn it is far subtler, with the victim quite possibly not noticing anything is wrong until it is far too late.

Though when spreading your scales do keep in mind that they are carried by air-currents and can hence be dispersed by wind or washed away by rain or sea-spray. You can fully control when you produce scales, though the process will take a few minutes and once they are produced, you cannot retract them.

You may design a new type of venom specifically for your scales.
addons.title: Scales

objects.text: You now have wings on your back that are proportional to your body size. You may choose the appearance of the wings but only once before insertion. You can’t fly with them, but you can glide. The wings are made of thin but powerful muscle and bone, and can fold up into your body. The wings heal at a similar rate and efficacy to any other limb, so if they’re cut off they cannot regrow naturally with just this power. They can’t fold up if heavily injured and if they are inside your body when injured they will be forced out.
objects.title: Changer/Mover (Wings)

addons.text:
Due to the combination of powers that feed into and empower one another, you gain the strength and advantages of cats and their larger feline cousins, proportional to your size. Beyond the strength and grace of cats, you also gain a degree of night vision, the ability to hear things below what humans are able to hear, and the ability to nap just about anywhere.

Your nails also gain a minor chemical to them that you can turn on and off; nothing too powerful, but if you cut someone, they are more prone to getting an infection that requires over-the-counter medicine and bed rest. This can vary between individuals, and those with any healing factor or a decently strong immune system can shrug it off.

Note: The scratch bit at the end is in reference to how, when a cat scratches you, you will need to treat it in case it gets infected or something worse.
addons.title: Cat Scratch Fever

addons.text: Your limited form of teleportation has gained a new aspect, allowing you to change your orientation in space instantly; this is mainly to help make Cat's Landing more efficient, but you could use it to spin in place, turn around instantly, or use it to make sharp turns. This power affects you and whatever you are holding that you can lift; it does not affect physics outside of your momentum being carried over for a few moments after use.
addons.title: XYZ Rotate

objects.text: You always land on your feet. Even if someone knocks you off balance or pushes you, you will always land on your feet. Even if you are upside down and only an inch off the ground, you will flip over and land on your feet. This does not prevent you from breaking your legs on the landing. If you are launched at a wall, you can choose to temporarily count the wall as your landing spot, making you hit the wall feet first.
objects.title: Thinker/Mover (Cat’s Landing)

addons.text:
You have an unparalleled mastery over physical movement. Your understanding of body mechanics, coordination, and technique is near-instantaneous, allowing you to absorb and master any physical skill—from martial arts to sports, parkour, or even precision-based tasks like surgery or marksmanship—in record time. If you see it, you can learn it. If you practice it, you perfect it. In other words, you can copy physical motions extremely well.

Your muscular adaptation now works in harmony with your accelerated learning, ensuring that your body physically adapts as quickly as your mind. Movements that would normally take years of training to refine become second nature in days, even hours. When learning a new skill, your muscles optimise themselves for the act, ensuring that every action you take is backed by a body perfectly tuned for this new skill.

Additionally, your muscle memory is enhanced, allowing you to recall and execute learned movements flawlessly, even under extreme stress. You don’t just remember how to perform a technique—you internalise it, making it feel as natural as breathing.
addons.title: Muscle Head’s Skill

addons.text:
Your body is capable of movements that border on the superhuman, combining strength, speed, coordination, and control without compromising any of them. Your muscles adapt specifically for dynamic motion, allowing you to move with exceptional fluidity even during intense physical activity.

You can chain actions together with almost unnatural precision, turning jumps, dodges, impacts, recoveries, and attacks into continuous motion. Momentum becomes easy to control and redirect, letting you recover balance instantly, maintain speed through difficult terrain, and easily perform complex maneuvers that would normally require years of training or place extreme strain on the body.

Additionally, your timing and spatial awareness are enhanced to an extraordinary degree. You instinctively position yourself in advantageous ways, allowing you to narrowly avoid attacks, land safely from dangerous falls, navigate unstable environments, and exploit openings in motion almost automatically.

Even at full speed or under extreme pressure, your movements remain controlled, precise, and deliberate, giving the impression of effortless mastery rather than raw exertion.
addons.title: Cinematic Motion

objects.text: Your muscles grow stronger and more durable at an accelerated rate, becoming denser without increasing in size. As you exert yourself, your muscles adapt, improving stamina and energy, allowing you to perform demanding tasks for longer periods without fatigue. This power makes you more resilient to physical strain, increasing both your strength and endurance over time. This comes with higher maintenance, requiring more nutrition to maintain.
objects.title: Brute (Muscular Growth)

objects.text:
Your body no longer needs to sweat or produce waste. As such, processes that would've needed either of those are handled by your power. For example, your temperature is constantly adjusted to what it would've been had your body still produced sweat.

This also extends to any organism in your body, which means no eye crust and your teeth won't decay.
objects.title: Breaker (Wasteless)

addons.text: You can move things around inside your body. This could allow you to regurgitate things or even absorb/eject them through your skin.
addons.title: Internal Manipulation

addons.text:
You are able to store your body parts within one another, such as storing a spare leg in your torso, though it may take time to absorb or extrude.

This also grants the capability to grow spare limbs even if you currently have all limbs attached, allowing you to always have total bodily access without sacrificing on potential number.
addons.title: Organ Storage

addons.text: You may treat your projections as part of your own body, allowing you to move your limbs through your projections onto the other side. This does require you to keep the core organ on the other side, so unless you have multiple torsos you are not able to fully travel via projection.
addons.title: Organ Transportation

objects.text:
You can selectively cause anything foreign inside your body to become intangible. This could allow you to put an apple in your mouth and store it for later consumption, or swallow a sword for a magic trick. Objects maintain position relative to your center of mass while intangible. 

You also gain a basic spatial sense of what is currently inside your body.
objects.title: Stranger (Internal Intangibility)

objects.text:
Your bone marrow has radically changed, becoming densely packed with essential materials, serving as both a reservoir for energy and a powerhouse for cellular regeneration. Able to store vast amounts of nutrients and fat for times of need, even allowing for rapid bursts of strength and stamina in a pinch. Additionally, your red and white blood cell production has been greatly reinforced, bolstering your immune system to the point where most infections struggle to take hold before being eradicated—this, however, doesn't make you immune to illness.

This shift has also triggered a surge in stem cell production, subtly enhancing your body's natural healing and granting a mild but noticeable boost to regeneration. Altogether, these enhancements make you significantly more resilient, durable, and long-lived—though at the cost of increased body mass, making you noticeably heavier than before.
objects.title: Brute (Orange Bone Marrow)

objects.text:
With the power of an endless stomach, you can eat without limits. No matter how much you consume—whether it’s a whole buffet or mountains of snacks—you’ll always feel satisfied and never uncomfortably full. Your digestive system has been altered to store excess nutrients and calories indefinitely, completely digested and ready for use when needed. You won't get fat and will only feel hungry when your reserves start running low.

Note: This power only applies to food you can already eat, not things outside your capability to consume.
objects.title: Brute/Stranger (Stomach Storage)

addons.text: Now the workload of having a number of voices, each of them saying something different, isn’t so impossible anymore. With this, you can delegate a thought process to one of your voices, making the task of having your voices say different things almost as easy as breathing. All of your voices with delegated lines of thought count towards ‘Thinker (Rubber Ducky)’ when speaking their respective thought processes out loud. While it works as normal when your voices are figuring out different things, focusing more than one of them on the same subject will link them together, and increasing the overall multiplier of how fast those lines of thought figure things out (i.e. One voice by itself is x2 as usual, 2 voices focusing on the same thing is x4, three is x6, 4 is x8, 5 is x10, 6 is x12, so on and so forth). Any voices involved must speak out loud in order to contribute towards the multiplier.
addons.title: Layers Upon Layers of Processing Power

objects.text:
Your vocal cords have mutated, allowing you to speak in more than one voice simultaneously without expending any more breath than you usually do. These voices can be the same or be completely different to one another, provided that you theoretically have the range to make it so. At the beginning, holding any more than 2-3 voices speaking the same sentences is your soft limit, anything more than that risking damage or soreness in your throat.

Eventually, you will be able to use more voices simultaneously with time and practice and even have them speak different things.
objects.title: Stranger (Voices Are Like Onions)

objects.text:
When you’re faced with a situation where you don’t know what to say, you can activate this power, which will give you six possible responses to choose from. Time slows to one-tenth of its normal speed while you make your decision, giving you plenty of time to think without the pressure of the moment.

Each of these 6 responses will be distinct. Two of them are neutral—they won’t bring you any significant benefits, but they also won’t cause any harm. Another two will lead to positive outcomes, offering different types of rewards depending on the situation. The last two will result in negative consequences, which could vary from minor setbacks to more serious costs.

You won’t be able to tell which response falls into which category. The options appear equally valid on the surface, leaving you to rely on your judgment, instincts, or context clues to decide. Additionally, some options won’t stay available forever. If you take too long to choose, certain responses will disappear, limiting your choices and increasing the risk.

The effects of your chosen response depend on the situation. It could change how someone sees you, influence decisions, open or close opportunities, or trigger unexpected events. 

Once you select an option, your body will automatically say or do it without hesitation, even if you’re unsure or would have otherwise chosen differently.

You can use this power as many times as you want. There’s no cooldown or cost beyond the inherent risk of making the wrong choice, which can lead to unintended consequences depending on the situation.
objects.title: Thinker (Dialogue)

objects.text: Your organs have become hardier and more durable. The soft flesh inside you has now become harder to tear, instead stretching and deforming in response to trauma before returning to its shape. Even when they are damaged, they are quicker to heal and less prone to disease. Their higher limits means that they can be pushed much further than normal, increasing things like your alcohol tolerance. You are consequently more resistant to the forces of inertia, able to go to speeds not humanly possible due to normal organs turning to soup.
objects.title: Brute (Spongey Organs)

objects.text:
You can permanently change the taste and smell of any object you touch, such as making salt taste like pepper or making old shoes smell like freshly baked cookies. This does not affect nutritional value, so make sure you don't trick your body into eating too much of what it shouldn't.

You aren't able to make any stimuli that you haven't personally experienced before.
objects.title: Striker (Finger Food)

objects.text: You have the ability to change the color of your hair at will. This includes natural shades, vibrant neon colors, or even patterns like gradients and stripes. The transformation is instant and can be undone just as quickly. This power only affects the color of your hair and cannot alter its texture, length, or other properties. It is purely cosmetic and perfect for adding a personal flair to your look.
objects.title: Changer (Chroma Hair)

addons.text: The strength at which you can vomit is now much higher, thanks to your muscles. You can now vomit up to a distance of 20 feet. Up close, you could knock over a man with a vomit slimeball, splashing it all over them like a thick slush.
addons.title: Projectile, Projectile Vomit

addons.text: You can now manipulate your vomit telekinetically, moving it as if you were holding it and shaping it with your hands. This allows you to manipulate other objects from a distance by, for example, turning the viscosity up to the max, or force it into others’ mouths to make them retch and distract them.
addons.title: Emetokinetics

addons.text:
Instead of producing no waste, your body instead converts any and all waste products into more digestive acids, safely stored within your endless stomach. This allows you to vomit frequently and in further quantities, letting you to throw up rapid-fire streams of bile or a continuous torrent like a hose.

You can now also ‘charge up’ vomit in your stomach like you were filling a water balloon, before unleashing it out from the depths of your digestive system and out of your mouth. The effect would be something like a fire hydrant bursting open, spreading outwards in a deluge of your own sick.

Lastly, for a much less disgusting function of this power, you can harmlessly swallow any object that would fit down your gullet and retrieve it whenever you want to, such as keys or other small debris. In the case of the latter, you can charge your vomit with much less useful objects, allowing you to spit them out like they were fired from a slingshot. You can do this with only one for greater accuracy, or many to act like a shotgun.
addons.title: Upchuck

objects.text:
You can vomit at a distance of 5 feet at will, the muscles necessary to accomplish this action temporarily strengthening themselves for the duration of this ability. Additionally, while doing this, your stomach, esophagus, and mouth become more durable, to allow for anything that you vomit to be vomited out safely. Note that this doesn’t aid you in eating, say, glass - only successfully vomiting it out.

You can also modify the viscosity of your digestive acids, and other such liquids within your stomach like mucus or water, to allow for the modification of the contents of your vomit. If you want to send a vomit slimeball at someone, you very much so can.
objects.title: Blaster (Projectile Vomit)

objects.text:
You can create static pairs of miniature portals that permanently link between each other. Each end originates at the tips of two different chosen fingers. 

These portals are 2 cm in radius and cannot move or change destination once created. You may dismiss them at will.
objects.title: Striker (Bite-Sized Portals)

addons.text:
Thanks to your constant temporal precision and your ability to perform actions at the exact right moment, you now possess an enhanced sense of orientation that goes beyond simply knowing your coordinates.

You are now able to anticipate the exact time it will take you to reach your destination, based on your speed, terrain, obstacles, and the type of movement you are performing, as well as accurately foresee the ideal moments to rest or adjust your route, optimizing your travel time.

In addition to that, you are also capable of perceiving your immediate surroundings, including the direction and distance to previously known points of interest, such as a target, a safe haven, or even an emergency exit.

This allows you to navigate with precision in unknown or complicated areas, never losing track of your location, even under adverse conditions (such as underground, in total darkness, or in a place with no external reference points).

If you are engaged in a specific activity (such as escaping danger, finding a target, or navigating through dangerous terrain), your perception of the environment will automatically adjust to the optimal distances and safest routes. However, this ability does not grant you the ability to "see" these points of interest; you can only "sense" them based on your perception of time and space.
addons.title: Travel Plan

objects.text: You always know your exact coordinates in the Global Position System or whatever similar system exists in your current world.
objects.title: Thinker (GPS)

addons.text:
Due to the synergistic adaptation of your sponge-like tissues and coiled sinew system, your entire body acts as a living shock absorber, redirecting impacts instead of enduring them. When struck, your body instinctively deforms and stretches, reducing resistance while offloading a significant portion of the incoming kinetic energy into your reinforced tendons and ligaments.

This process allows you to "catch" force with your body, channeling it through your sinew coils where it's absorbed, stored, and harmlessly dissipated or redirected through movement. The more elastic and relaxed your body, the greater the energy transfer and mitigation.

However, as your body accumulates damage, this kinetic transference becomes less effective—your sinews strain, and the force begins to hit harder.
addons.title: Kinetic Sink

objects.text:
Your tendons and ligaments have transformed into something resembling steel coiled springs, anchoring more efficiently to bone and muscle whilst balancing elasticity with rigidity—allowing them to absorb, store, and release kinetic energy with every movement, significantly improving agility, flexibility, and overall physical performance while sharply reducing the risk of strains, sprains, or tears.

This mutation shines during acts of running and jumping, where your sinews store impact forces and release them in bursts, letting you move faster, leap higher, and travel farther with less effort. However, their immense recoil strength means that, under extreme stress, they're more likely to pull on bones hard enough to cause fractures before snapping themselves.

Additionally, they'll also soften landings and reduce fall damage, but this won't prevent injury from excessive heights. Fortunately, they can regenerate quickly, minimizing wear from repeated or intense exertion.
objects.title: Brute/Mover (Sinew Coils)

objects.text: You can summon fingers out of any mirrors that you can see. This as a result allows for mirrors to be a conduit for your powers.
objects.title: Shaker/Trump (Mirror Mirror)

addons.text: Due to already possessing an extensive comprehension of Mathematics, your capabilities as a Human Calculator have grown significantly, enabling you to process data at 4MB per second, operating at 50–100 MHz, which allows you to make greater use of your Mathematical knowledge, making even short work of formulas when you need the answer to solve them.
addons.title: Calculations Complete

objects.text:
Your brain now has specifically developed areas designed for calculations that are naturally adept at arithmetic, allowing you to have a computer-like ability to calculate stuff. You also gain a natural ability to remember mathematical formulas.

Without any training, you can mentally calculate things using roughly 2MB worth of "memory" per second, operating at the normal 25-40 MHz, about 4 times more memory, and 10 MHz faster than the average scientific calculator. Unlike most computers, this ability only allows you to calculate in base ten instead of binary. With training, your body will slowly adapt to utilizing this instinctively, based on your knowledge.
objects.title: Thinker (Human Calculator)

objects.text:
You are able to swiftly put on and remove various items, whether it be makeup, clothing, or even equipment. This allows you to change your appearance or gear in an instant. Whether you’re preparing for an event, gearing up for a mission, or disguising yourself on the fly, your speed and efficiency in changing make you incredibly versatile. Likewise, when the moment calls for it, you can just as quickly shed any attire or gear, making transitions effortless and fluid.

However, while you can remove anything immediately, you must have it within arm’s reach before you can rapidly put it on.
objects.title: Stranger (Changing Room)

objects.text: You can create simple projections in your hands, limited to 15 cubic centimeters in volume and fitting within a 15 cm cube at creation. The projections must be based on your general understanding, cannot have supernatural or contradictory properties, and cannot be more complex than a hand crank or gearbox. If significantly damaged, they dissipate and must be reformed. Examples include a blade, rubber band, egg beater, wire, or stylus.
objects.title: Striker (Budget Projection)

objects.text: Have you ever noticed the difference between something that isn’t really fitted for you and something that is? It’s quite an experience to have something so customized just for you. Now, though, you’ll experience this all the time. As you pick up armor and weapons, try out new clothing, or just sit in a chair, reality will subtly readjust the items to suit you perfectly, changing the fit, balance, weight, and any other similar features to match your needs as if it had been custom-designed for you alone. This only works while you have ‘possession’ of the item in question; as soon as you stop touching it, these changes will revert, as if nothing had ever happened.
objects.title: Striker (Custom Fit)

objects.text:
You have the ability to teleport anywhere within your line of sight, but it requires charging - at a rate of 1 second for every 10 centimeters of distance. This may be selectively applied to anything that is within a 10 centimeter range of yourself.

You can also choose to teleport in arbitrarily small increments to create a fluid, continuous motion.
objects.title: Mover (Lazy Bum)

objects.text:
Human sensory systems naturally introduce slight delays in perception, meaning that everything you see, hear, and feel is slightly behind reality. Now, however, your brain can receive and process sensory input instantaneously.

Motion blur is nonexistent, with fast-moving objects appearing with perfect clarity. Your perception of time is flawlessly accurate, with no inconsistencies between sight, sound, and touch. Hand-eye coordination and balance feel effortlessly precise, as every movement is perfectly synchronized with what you perceive. Your reaction time remains limited by your body, but hesitation caused by misinterpreted timing is a thing of the past.

The world unfolds before you in perfect real-time. No lag, no delay—just pure, uninterrupted perception.
objects.title: Thinker (No Lag)

objects.text: You may choose to change the size of your hands, at the cost of scaling the rest of your body in the opposite direction. You may at most scale your hands by a factor of two, and your body must maintain the volume throughout any changes.
objects.title: Changer (Resized Hands)

addons.text:
This power is now always active when you're engaged in combat, regardless of whether it's flashy or not. You also process them at a subconscious level, meaning you no longer need to actively think about them. On top of that, the information you gain from each snapshot now covers every detail you could possibly ask for.

If you can throw your opponent into the sky, you'll know their exact trajectory and coordinates, allowing you to easily make follow up combos. Or if you're on the other side of the milky way and your opponent is on earth, you'll fly to their exact location when you crash back to the planet like a meteor.

You can filter the rate you receive this information or turn it off completely at anytime.
addons.title: Eye Catcher

addons.text: What do audiences love most about watching two or more superpowered individuals beat the crap out of each other? The Cool Factor! Which you now have in spades, as not only does your every move in combat look cool, but you know how to act to maximize it to the extreme. Careful not to get drunk off your own aura, but I can't blame you if you do. You get to see how awesome you look for crying out loud! The cosmetic effects you generate allow your snapshots to be more colorful and expressive, like manifesting onomatopoeia, arrows, or leaving beacons of light from your last attack that conveniently highlight exactly where your opponent is, or add some extra oomph to truly sell, or exaggerate just how powerful you are. You always have an intuitive sense of balance between knowing the coolest possible stunt you could do, when to do it, how to execute it, and maximizing both practicality with spectacle.
addons.title: Spectacle

addons.text:
Just like pressing the shutter button on a camera; instead of just one snapshot, you can choose to receive multiple at once that showcases the performed feat from many different angles and distances. These are all photographically memorized instantly, and can be discarded just as easily.

Your increased perception and multitasking also allows you to rewind and fast forward through the snapshots in rapid succession and as a separate minor thought process. This works for both the current ones you're sorting through and the previous ones you've made, making virtually no detail about the battlefield escape you.
addons.title: Burst Shot

objects.text: Superpowered individuals fighting in media is always entertaining to watch due to the omnipresence of the viewers. The actual characters don't experience that due to being limited by their own field of vision. You are the exception to this. Now whenever you fire your big blue laser, send your opponent hurling through terrain, fly at incredible speeds around the world, etc. A snapshot showcasing the scale of your attack, property damage, distance covered, size of the crater you made, etc is automatically and instantly beamed into your brain. This also works if you're a victim to the same treatment. You will always know where you and your opponent(s) stand within each snapshot. This only activates AFTER an action has occurred that warrants it.
objects.title: Thinker (Longshot)

objects.text: While normal humans have three photo-color receptors and some have four, you now possess sixteen of them—the same as a mantis shrimp. You can perceive a vast portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, including ultraviolet, infrared, polarized light, and even segments of microwaves and X-rays. Despite this overwhelming input, your brain effortlessly interprets and filters the visual data. You can toggle up to ten of these photoreceptors off at will, allowing you to return to human-normal-ish vision but with enhanced sensitivity to violet, red, and cyan hues.
objects.title: Thinker/Brute (Colorful Gaze)

objects.text: People just can't really recognize you. Whether they’ve known you all your life or if they just met you a minute ago; when you activate this power, people are unable to recognize you. That being said, there are ways for people to figure out that it's you… Mainly you telling them, in great detail, that you're the guy with a face they can't match. That doesn't mean that people can't recognize you when you use this power, just that they view the you using the power and the you not using it as two different people. (This also works on computers).
objects.title: Stranger (Mask Of A Face)

addons.text: You’ll now occasionally move in ways that will make your opponents underestimate you, lowering your eyes to give the impression that you’re giving up, flinching to seem like you’re scared, or movements that make your opponents think you’re leaving an opening. These will be convincing as the specifics will slightly adjust for each opponent to look realistic.
addons.title: Sheep in Wolf's Clothing

addons.text: You’re now much more capable of ricocheting your projectiles, good enough that you could hit enemies from their blindspots, or calculate how to hit them even if they dodged. This makes projectiles you throw much harder to predict as they’ll ricochet seemingly randomly, yet will still manage to land where they were aimed at.
addons.title: Ricochet

objects.text:
You can introduce a level of randomness into your body, confusing and spoofing Thinkers and people trying to get a sense of what you’re feeling, thinking or going to do. This alters your micro-expressions and mildly shifts your movement centimeters at a time, making physically predicting you much more difficult. This doesn't protect you from precogs or strong enough Thinkers, but it mildly changes your actions, so a precog would see you moving slightly differently in each future, even if they didn’t change anything that would affect you. 

You’d still be doing the same thing, you’d just be going a tad bit differently about it, like using different muscles to form a smile, walking a tad more to the left, saying synonyms of a word or rarely even attacking with a different limb.
objects.title: Stranger (Confusing Body Language)

objects.text: You will regenerate 0.5% of your health per second for a minute. You have three charges of this ability. You can either spread them out, or stack them all on top of each other. Each charge is refreshed after every 24 hours have passed since time of usage.
objects.title: Brute (Histskin)

objects.text: You possess extraordinary fine motor control, allowing you to perform intricate tasks with effortless precision. Whether threading a needle, assembling complex machinery, or writing in microscopic script, your movements are exact and fluid. Delicate activities like handling fragile objects, cooking with finesse, or walking on a tight rope come easily to you.
objects.title: Thinker (Fine Manipulation)

objects.text:
You can select a single goal of yours, and until its completed you can't die of old age. If you complete the goal and have long since passed your original lifespan, you will die of old age. Additionally, you can choose whether your body still appears to age or not, and if it does at which speed.

The goal must be something you genuinely want to accomplish.
objects.title: Breaker (Just Long Enough To See This Through)

addons.text:
Now, you can copy not just how someone moves—but the force behind it. Strength, speed, even raw kinetic output can be mimicked if you observe it directly. The catch? Your body still has to pay for what it borrows.

The greater the gap between your own physicality and the one you’re copying, the nastier the backlash. Additionally if you copy something but miss details, the consequences worsen. Exceeding your natural limits by too much in a short span can rupture tendons, tear muscle, or even cause limbs to literally explode. 

Fortunately, you get a kind of built-in danger sense—when you watch someone move, you immediately feel how much it would mess you up to copy it.
addons.title: Crash Out

addons.text:
You can now perceive and internalize even the subtlest nuances of what you’re observing—micro-movements, muscle twitches, vocal inflections, patterns most people would never consciously register. These details don’t just catch your eye anymore; they imprint clearly into your memory, ready to be drawn on when copying.

The result? When you copy, you’re doing so with near-total fidelity, replicating actions with uncanny precision—again, within the limits of your physical ability. You still can’t lift a car just because you saw someone else do it, but if it’s something you could do, your version is as close to the original as humanly (or inhumanly) possible.

This also doesn’t eliminate the limitations of your natural memory entirely—you can still forget things over time—but it does significantly mitigate them. What you observe with intent tends to stick much more clearly and for much longer, especially when it’s something you’re actively trying to replicate.
addons.title: Mirror

objects.text:
You have a knack for “copying” actions, but it’s not as overpowered as it might sound. 

You can only mimic what you actually notice, so if you miss the finer details, they’re simply not there when you yourself do the action. Plus, your memory still works the same way it always has—you won’t magically retain copied movements forever without practice. You can copy off memory to use the copied action but if you start to forget details, then your copy will start to degrade until nonexistence. And most importantly, just because you can copy something doesn’t mean you can actually do it. If it’s beyond your physical limits or natural abilities, tough luck. This also doesn’t give you the knowledge of the person you copy, so even if you can copy a punch from a skilled fighter, this wouldn’t give you the experience or knowledge on when to use it or to alter/innovate it.

That said, this is still incredibly useful in the right hands. For example, by watching someone skilled at a task, you can fast-track your learning process, shaving hours off the time it takes to develop muscle memory.
objects.title: Thinker (Copy)

objects.text:
You are able to focus inwards, entering a meditative state where you filter out your senses and unrelated thoughts, highlighting and focusing on specific ideas and thoughts. In this state you can unpack complex ideas, solve problems, or trace patterns of thought with near-superhuman precision. Mental interference—such as fear, doubt, or confusion—melts away, granting you unwavering concentration and emotional stillness. This also helps deal with mental exhaustion and lessens headaches, even Thinker headaches. 

This works best when you enter it in a calm or relaxed state. Sitting in a lotus position also helps.
objects.title: Thinker (Meditation)

objects.text:
Congratulations. You’ve just defeated one of the greatest nuisances known to mankind. Bugs. 

Your body is now always surrounded by an invisible forcefield that instantly kills any small insect that gets within a 10 cm radius. This process is instantaneous, silent and leaves no trace behind.

Additionally, this field muffles the sounds of nearby insects, making it easier to ignore those that are smart enough to keep their distance.

You can also choose to selectively spare individual bugs or species from getting zapped, like butterflies and bees for example.
objects.title: Shaker (Bug Zapper)

addons.text:
You can now store your own sound effects within a mental playlist and play them at any time. This playlist can be visualized within your mind, be projected outward as a screen, or something else entirely. 

The scale, pitch, tone, frequency and other aspects of these sounds are completely togglable to you. You can also mix these sounds in a variety of ways to create unique results.
addons.title: Sound Designer

addons.text:
Your Badass™ Effects package has been upgraded to full control with the addition of guaranteed intimidation via your Master effect.

Your control expresses itself in the form of Onomatopoeia; specifically that of comic books & manga.

They do not physically appear, but you can create any associated effect as a projection, which will be much stronger than any generic projection you could normally make.

For example:
Thinking of the onomatopoeia "Snikt" will cause a set of six sharp, high-quality metal claws to form, instead of a simple pair of steel needles.

Thinking "Fwoosh" would send people back a foot, and thinking "Fwooooosh" would cause them to tumble backwards repeatedly.
addons.title: Solid Script from Wish™

objects.text:
Your actions now become punctuated by audio cues: The snap of your fingers produces a satisfying crack, the thuds of your footsteps command a terrifying presence, the boom of your fist smashing concrete conveys your might. You're not limited to just these, as you can generate a variety of sound effects based on the intent behind your actions. 

You can toggle this on and off, filter the rate it happens, adjust the volume, and choose whether only you or others can hear them.
objects.title: Shaker (SFX)

addons.text: You can now use your ooze as a blaster power, allowing you to eject it from your body at high speeds and move it telekinetically with your mind. While stuck objects will still weight it down, any attracted water is not factored in, allowing you to attract large amounts of water with little force required.
addons.title: Ooze Manipulation

addons.text: Your ability to heat up surfaces allows you to turn your ooze into a more permanent glue. This causes it to lose its attractive properties towards water, but at the advantage of letting you perfectly fuse surfaces together.
addons.title: Thermal Catalyst

objects.text:
You can selectively secrete a sticky, transparent substance that attracts water to unnatural levels. When stuck to an object it is very difficult to remove, and the strength of the pull of water increases with volume. 

At very low temperatures (around -30°C) it temporarily shrinks into a powdery substance with less adhesion.
objects.title: Striker (Hydro Ooze)

objects.text: By writing down each step as you solve a problem—whether it’s calculations, decisions, or reasoning—you will be able to solve said problem three times faster.
objects.title: Thinker (Show Your Work)

objects.text:
Your body has mutated to metabolize ionizing radiation as a source of energy. While not perfectly efficient, this ability allows you to survive and even thrive near hazardous radiation levels. Your cells are far more resistant than a normal human's, enabling you to stand near something like the Elephant's Foot for a few hours with only some minor radiation sickness your body can quickly purge.

However, extreme rapid exposure—like to the Demon Core—can still overload your system, temporarily shutting down your ability and causing acute radiation poisoning, though you'd still survive where others wouldn't.

A steady, high radiation source puts your body into a temporary overdrive, pushing you to peak human physicality. But stay in that state too long, and you'll crash from the strain. Moderate levels, on the other hand, boost your stamina, reduce your need for food or sleep, and make you healthier overall.

Yet, this heightened metabolism will also make your body emit noticeable heat, enough that anyone touching you might be alarmed by how hot your skin feels.
objects.title: Brute/Breaker (Radiation Eater)

objects.text:
You can spatially compress any object, but at a very slow and tiring rate. For every minute you squeeze an object between your hands, its volume permanently shrinks by 20%. 

This can not work on living beings, and uses more and more stamina the longer you shrink something.
objects.title: Striker (Squeeze)

addons.text: Your games are organized to pack as much as possible into small packages: playing cards perfectly scaled for the most beautiful artwork and clear-to-read writing; models and pieces neatly organized to both minimize possible damage and loss, while positioned to take as little space as possible and fitting what seems to be double the limit of any game cartridge and disk, all while pushing their systems to work 50% better than their limit through clever coding tricks.
addons.title: More Fun for Less

addons.text: You don't merely make games; you elevate them. Those you make have such a level of detail and care that it would take years of dedicated effort to replicate—easy to play and understand, but capable of possessing layers upon layers of mastery. Even at their worst, they never feel half-hearted or unfinished, as your games become the pinnacle others follow: a guiding star to light the way to a future.
addons.title: Better Games

addons.text:
The point of a game is, first and foremost, to do something. Sometimes, it’s solving puzzles; sometimes, it’s killing monsters; or maybe, it’s fetching an item—regardless, these activities also need to be fun, something you have a real talent for.

You can easily make tasks in your games enjoyable to just about any player, and can also easily come up with dozens or more ideas to keep players occupied and playing your game for that much longer.

The stories that you tell, the characters that you design, the worlds that you create. They are all detailed, exquisitely so and many would be hard pressed to consider them incomplete. They have a depth to them that makes them almost lifelike in their design, as if the characters could actually exist or that the worlds themselves were once real.

Beyond making you one of the best storytellers to have ever been born on Earth, as well as one of the greatest character designers, world builders and many other related things, you will also have the ability to flesh out just about any idea. What this means is that anything that you design, whether it be the ornate details of a sword or the winding paths of a maze, will be incredibly intricate and well thought out.
addons.title: The Quest Giver

addons.text:
As a designer, you are one of the best of your craft; you know just how to design your games to be well-balanced, intuitive, easily explained, and have depth to their mechanics.

You could easily design a game that suits many playstyles without favoring any specific one. Intuitive enough for a baby to use, and could add aspects to your game for the real hardcore players to search for and master.
addons.title: Designer

addons.text: When developing your games, you can choose to gear them towards a certain type of clientele, whether they are enjoyers of specific genres or a broad demographic of people. You gain an up-to-date, instinctual ability to know what they want and why. This massively improves reception among these people without affecting the rest of the market too much. With this insight, you can increase the amount of work you can do in a day by roughly 50%, with a similar boost to quality.
addons.title: Niche Product

addons.text: Your skills with games have expanded beyond creation into something more vile and cutthroat: marketing. Now, as you make games, you'll know instantly how to make them noticeable and draw people in, capturing the imagination and admiration of the public while navigating public opinion and the media to easily make your games popular, regardless of the medium. All of this comes to you effortlessly, as even games that become failures earn you a nice profit and some fans. With a little bit of luck and hard work, you can build an empire that rivals the Pokémon Media Franchise at its peak.
addons.title: Cultural Craze

addons.text: Your games can not only be fun, but also educational, with your players never realizing they're learning. Literacy, mathematics, critical thinking, short- and long-term planning, situational awareness, history, wilderness survival, occult defenses, economic theories, game theory, visualization, mind games, social skills, learning something about themselves, and so much more—all become part of your games. These games transform into more than treasured memories for many; they become the building blocks for brighter futures.
addons.title: Educational

addons.text:
Games are meant to be played to have fun, but that's not their limit. Due to your knowledge of helping others and your medical expertise, you can prove this.

Now, you can easily design your games to help people in various ways—whether it's helping them work through issues by venting in safe and constructive manners, processing their emotions and traumas, or even reaching out to others. While these elements can be the centerpiece of a game, they can also be easily added to other projects.

And it's not just mentally or emotionally. You intuitively know how to make your games more accessible to others, such as by including Braille on your cards or designing controllers for a wide range of abilities and setups. It may not seem like much at first, but it will make a world of difference for some people. Sadly, there is only so much you can do for game journalists.
addons.title: Play together

addons.text:
You are something nigh unheard of—an anomaly in an industry where image is worth more than gold. You are someone others can trust their IP (Intellectual Properties) with. Due to this, you have a much easier time using the IP, from something as minor as using it for a theme for a game, to much grander things, such as an expansive and detailed game that uses the characters and lore of the IP in new and unheard-of ways, or even creating crossovers of multiple IPs.

With every successful product, the easier for you to find it to acquire the rights to use new IPs, with restrictions being loosened with every success. And if you have the Reputation Perk, it wouldn't be long before people are just handing their IP to you—or even begging, in some instances, for you to use them.
addons.title: Trust me with IP

addons.text:
You know how to make games, but even if it's the greatest ever conceived, production and distribution can bring it all to a complete halt—until now. You intuitively grasp what will be needed to mass-produce and distribute your games on every level of the supply chain, along with knowing who would be worth partnering with and who can be trusted to act as middlemen. Should no infrastructure exist for your needed supply lines, you know where and how they can be built, along with having fallbacks to minimize the risk and damage of a supply-line collapse.

You can effectively weigh the cost and resources of each step of the supply chain and consider factors that may go over the heads of others—such as seeing the value in a more local partner, who you can hold great soft power over, when compared to an overseas mass producer. You use all you have to get the best results, leveraging everything you can to turn setbacks around, such as pressuring one partner for better deals after they revealed company secrets or using policy changes as an excuse to get out of contracts that were more detrimental than beneficial.

When all is said and done, you know how to make games and how to get them to people, making a profit where others would have lost money.
addons.title: Pipelines & Middlemen

addons.text: The 'curse' of game adaptations is, like many others, a self-fulfilling prophecy due to the hubris, ignorance, apathy, and sometimes outright hostility of those who believe they know better or simply wish to exploit the recognition of something for a quick profit. However, you are above such things, as you actually know what you're doing—your ability to make games has melded with your skills as a film director and producer, allowing you to make faithful adaptations of all sorts of games that are faithful to the games themselves, at least in spirit, making them something worthy of praise, with you being able to push back against studio oversight when their 'clever' ideas would sink the project. It's not just a one-way street, as you can use your filmmaking ability to enhance your games, creating high-stakes moments and expertly crafted storytelling, creating branching narratives that make worlds feel alive or giving players enough material to forge their own. And if you're adapting a game from another property, you can expertly stay faithful to the source material, such as letting the physically strong character use their wits to get out of trouble instead of brute force, focusing on the charm and appeal of the source material, instead of creating another generic product with a new skin layered on top. As a consequence of your ability to create games quickly, with cinematic appeal and fidelity to the source material, you can expect to be known as the go-to person for tie-ins and adaptations, especially with the Trust me with IP add-on.
addons.title: What Curse?

addons.text: The process of creation is rarely straightforward, and more than likely, mistakes will be made, but unlike most, you can catch these little mistakes while you're in the midst of creation. And even beyond that, you can look at your previous works and that of others and gain a far greater understanding to make improvements, gaining an in-depth understanding of these failures with the how, what, and why an idea was bad or good with poor execution.
addons.title: Learning from the Past

addons.text:
When you make your games, you can implement elements that can draw people in and influence them in various ways, though nothing overt or noticeable at first. Perhaps your cookie-themed game has elements that draw people in to obsess over details like design elements or characters, maybe there's additional content elsewhere they have to get for the full experience, perhaps it brought them to tears, and maybe half the fun in your game is the reaction of the players, so you make things to bring out those reactions/interactions, forging new friendships or even the design just staying with people.

But the impact of these games is not just for the moment; they can linger in the back of people's minds. Seeing elements of your work in other games, maybe they doodle a piece of your work, like scenery, characters, and art style, or perhaps even creating fanworks based on your creations, while to others, your games are the clearest memory they have with loved ones they can no longer play with.

For good or ill, your games can influence people, staying with them for years to come to join and shape the public zeitgeist (spirit of the age).
addons.title: Who is playing who?

addons.text:
To the shock of many, the games you design can take on cues and lessons from various faiths and beliefs, not only being faithful to the spirit and word of said faiths but also being able to teach and not preach about them, to give a greater understanding. As a consequence, playing your games counts as a form of worship—depending on the central faith / beings connected to said game (for example, if people played a video game with the Goddess of Hearth and Home, Hestia, as the protagonist, that would count as worship towards Hestia), but giving faith in this way would not impede or go against any pre-existing covenants / vows.

Due to this and other factors, your games gain an edge to them regarding the supernatural, granting a degree of protection of warding off hostile entities, and even trapping them for a time by making them play your games to even the playing field a bit. While not absolute, it will give people an edge to survive most encounters with the supernatural and fight off things like possession or malevolent forces that have latched onto people, or even draw in malevolent forces to target those who play it—if you dare.

You can imbue your games with any magic or spiritual powers you have, so that, in theory, you could make your own Jumanji, given time and research.
addons.title: Ghost & Spirit Game Night

addons.text:
You are supernaturally good at making modifications for games. You can work with any game’s code, no matter how obtuse or hardcoded its files are. You can change an action-rpg into a rythm strategy game, add every single pokemon as mobs, or patch a modlist of over 2000 to work without conflicts or crashes.

You can also make incredibly easy-to-use modding tools for your own games, allowing even amateur modders to similarly easily add their own epic campaigns and questlines, change the artstyle from retro-pixel to stylized cinematic 3D or make a total conversion that turns a game from a dark low fantasy world to an apocalyptic nanopunk xianxia setting.

Your mods can only be added to multiplayer servers by the server owner.
addons.title: Modder

addons.text: Now your powers can work through any games you make. You are able to connect your powers to variables you state in the code and choose from what point of the screen they will work and what they will automatically do after activation. Powers supposed to be used only on you for the needs of your games consider the player as you.

objects.text:
You are a Tinker 1 with a specialization in developing games of all kinds. Card games, video games, board games, you name it, you can probably make it. While your technology isn't useful in combat, you can create household masterpieces that can make an impact on people indirectly if you put your mind to it. Furthermore, the speed at which you can develop these games is practically the only thing that could be considered as 'parahuman’, able to make enough progress in a day that a full and experienced team of developers would take a month to match it.

Finally, your products aren't tinkertech outright, more so technology that would be a decade or so ahead of their time.
objects.title: Tinker (Game Dev)

addons.text:
Your body is not merely healed—it is whole. With this power, your form exists in perfect internal harmony, not just as you are now, but as you always should have been. Every strand of muscle, every fiber of tissue, every cell in your body sings in accord with your core self. This is no mutation, no enhancement, no external perfection—it is simply you, aligned completely with your ideal genetic expression.

From the moment you choose, your body reshapes itself according to the best it could have become, guided by ideal growth conditions, perfect health, and unbroken rhythms from the very start of life. It does not grant power, height, or features you never had in your blood—but it does ensure every feature you could have had is brought to full bloom. Your body becomes the ideal execution of your natural template.

Every inch of your skin, the structure of your bones, the slope of your shoulders, the sharpness of your jawline, the strength and tone of your muscles—all of it becomes a living symphony. You are not superhuman, but you are the absolute best version of a human that you were ever meant to be.

This harmony is not static. Each morning, your body re-aligns itself to maintain its internal rhythm.

You are not flashy. You do not glow. But you are always right. The way you move. The way you sit. The way you breathe. You are not what others dreamed you could be. You are what you were always meant to become.
addons.title: Symphonic Flesh

objects.text: Your body is your sanctuary, and with this subtle but life-changing power, it finally feels like it. Every morning, you wake up feeling truly rested—no grogginess, no lingering fatigue. Your skin is always clear and comfortable, free from breakouts or irritation. Your body’s internal cycles and hormonal rhythms are perfectly balanced. You experience no mood swings, cramps, or other unpleasant side effects. If you have a menstrual cycle, it is silent and painless; your body quietly recycles what it needs, leaving you unbothered. If you don’t, you still benefit from stable hormones and smooth regulation, free from the usual annoyances. Reproductive health is optimized for comfort, with your reproductive system remaining healthy and trouble-free. For those who can become pregnant, the process is gentle and manageable, with minimal discomfort and a swift recovery. The symptoms of aging—aches, stiffness, forgetfulness—are softened. You still age, but the transition into old age is easier and more comfortable, with dignity and ease. You’re not immune to disease or injury, nor are you superhuman. Your body simply works with you, not against you, making daily life that much more pleasant. You don’t glow or sparkle, but every day you wake up with a body that feels like it’s on your side. The little annoyances—fatigue, cramps, breakouts, aches—fade into the background, letting you focus on living, not just enduring.
objects.title: Brute (Harmonization)

objects.text:
You need no equipment beyond your own body weight to train yourself. No matter how strong you become, no matter how inexhaustible your endurance, you can get a good workout with nothing but a calisthenics routine that would be suitable for a normal human. 

A routine that is moderate for a normal person will keep you in shape if you have no other powers to do so; a routine that would be intense for the average athlete will see you making impressive gains even when you can normally bench press mountains.

When this power is active, the actions you take for the purpose of exercise will both strain and tire you like they would a baseline human, even if your other powers would normally prevent this. 

This effect will cease the moment you stop exercising.
objects.title: Brute (Calisthenics)

objects.text:
You can redirect and reflect kinetic energy, but only by moving with the force rather than resisting it. By shifting the energy's path away from you—much like the principles of Tai Chi—you can deflect attacks and momentum-based impacts. This ability applies to both your body and weapons, allowing for fluid parries and deflections.

However, its effectiveness depends on the force's power and mass—a punch or thrown object is easy to redirect, but something as heavy as a speeding car would simply overwhelm you. Your reaction speed is another crucial limitation; if an attack is too fast or catches you off guard, you won't be able to respond, making this ability ineffective against bullets or similar high-speed projectiles.
objects.title: Brute/Striker (Tai Chi)

addons.text:
Your wings have been genetically spliced with your extra arms. Your ‘arms’ are now grotesque wing-limbs, twisted by biological necessity. These wings’ muscles are corded and strengthened to the point of being veiny, blurring the line between the two body parts. 

The hands at the end of these limbs are instead replaced by talon-like formations that consist of a fan of hyperflexible digits. The excess flaps of skin ending in what look like scales of keratin on these wings that appear to be feathers, are in fact fingers complete with fingernails that require no trimming, originating from thinned hands that flare out from the base of the wings, hidden beneath other fingers. 

While these are more fragile and feeble, they are nonetheless numerous in quantity and possess the same dexterity and tactile sensitivity that your dominant hand does, allowing you to do something like pick a hundred locks at once or play on a dozen phones at the same time, given the ability to multitask effectively. The support musculature on your back designed to help brace your arms has been significantly enhanced as well, now acting as ‘wrists’ made to support the hundred-handed appendages. Additionally, these wings can still retract, and your clothing and armor still adapts to them.
addons.title: Grasping Pinions

objects.text: You are capable of growing and retracting two extra arms from and into the small of your back. This pair of arms possesses every characteristic of your regular arms, except for a few key differences. For one, they are a third longer to account for reach, and possess an extra elbow each to allow for greater flexibility. Additionally, certain muscles along your back also grow when these arms are manifested to allow for the same stability and strength as if they were on your shoulders. Any clothes or armor you are wearing while this occurs will adapt to the new arms, sleeves or greaves being created ad-nihilo as they grow from your back. When you retract your arms, these conveniences are similarly retracted.
objects.title: Changer/Striker (Arms)

objects.text:
Whenever you drink tea that you made yourself, your body and mind are dragged back to a normalized version of yourself.

If you are too hot, you are cooled down, if you are overexcited you will be calmed, but if you are tired you will regain energy.

The more your current condition differs from what your "normal" is, the more tea you need to fully normalize yourself.

This ability also works on both malignant and beneficial power effects of many kinds, so long as they directly affect your body or mind.

Drinking tea diminishes powers granted by others, many kinds of Master effects, as well as Striker effects such as teleportation marks or granted invulnerability.

Drinking tea does nothing against environmental effects, and does not heal you or revert your form in any way.
objects.title: Thinker/Breaker (Tea lady)

objects.text: One or multiple things about you are guaranteed to leave a lasting impression on the people you meet. From your accent, mannerisms, opinions, your voice, comedic style, etc. One person can remember your quirks like an amusing hiccup in mundane life, another like a new song that gets stuck in their head, unconsciously adopting your habits, or other influences. You can't control the specifics of what people will remember you for, and won't be aware of them unless you can read minds, but each impression you make is guaranteed to paint you in a neutral light at worst or a positive one at best. You can control the intensity of your impressions based on intent and skew them towards a specific perception.
objects.title: Thinker/Master (Rent Free)

objects.text: You are a Tinker 1 specializing in magic tricks of all kinds, such as vanishing cards, swallowable swords, rabbit-producing hats, etc. This does not grant you more skill when performing these tricks.
objects.title: Tinker (It's Magic!)

objects.text: You gain an ultra-acute sense of taste, capable of detecting the tiniest imperfections in any dish with only a single taste. For example, you'd be capable of recognizing and differentiating different types of salt by country and knowing exactly how long a specific portion of a dish or a particular ingredient was overcooked. If you tried, you could also learn to gain information from tasting inedible things.
objects.title: Thinker (God’s Tongue)

objects.text: By cracking your knuckles, your neck or any other part of your body, you can intimidate those that hear the crack. This can range from earning you some respect, to inducing intense fear depending on the situation. You can intensify the effect through slow repetition, pointed threats or through typical intimidation tactics. You can limit who is affected, whether a whole crowd or just a single person, though the effect becomes diluted the more targets it affects.
objects.title: Master (Intimidating Crepitation)

addons.title: Factorial Heart
addons.text:
Your circulatory system now combines both adaptations. You possess a normal, fully functional heart in your chest, while the specialized contractions from Heartless remain active throughout your blood vessels. Your body therefore has two independent means of circulating blood: your actual heart and the distributed pumping system created by Heartless.

The two systems work together under normal conditions, improving circulation and providing the combined benefits of Dual Hearts and Heartless. If your physical heart is destroyed or incapacitated, the distributed system can continue circulating your blood, effectively allowing you to survive without it. Likewise, damage to the distributed system does not leave you completely without circulation as long as your heart remains functional.

Furthermore, whenever another power or ability derives a benefit from having a heart, the benefit is calculated using your effective number of hearts factorially. You begin with two, giving a 2! multiplier to such effects. If you somehow acquire another functional heart, your effective count becomes three and the multiplier becomes 3!, with further hearts increasing it accordingly.

This applies to powers that use the heart as a source of energy, enhance its output, depend on its beating, strengthen the effects of having multiple hearts, or otherwise directly benefit from your cardiovascular system. It does not arbitrarily multiply unrelated abilities merely because they happen to affect your body.

You can therefore have more than one heart without accumulating the normal vulnerabilities associated with them. Your physical heart is still a genuine organ, but your body retains the heart-independent circulation that makes Heartless so difficult to kill.

objects.text:
Your circulatory system has changed to function without the need of a heart. Specialized muscular contractions along your veins and arteries keep your blood in constant motion, effectively replacing the heart’s pumping action. Cuts seal themselves almost instantly, and blood vessels clamp shut to prevent bleeding, drastically increasing survivability against punctures, cuts, or ruptures.

While you can still suffer from severe trauma or blood loss if enough tissue is destroyed at once, ordinary injuries that would normally cause fatal bleeding are now mere inconveniences. Your body naturally maintains stable blood pressure and flow, even under extreme exertion or damage.

You are immune to up to 20gs of force and any heart-related powers, be they benign or not, such as being killed by a heart attack from the Death Note, as you lack the organ.
objects.title: Brute (Heartless)

addons.text: Your electromagnetic power has evolved quite a bit due to other powers in play; first amongst these changes, your ability to generate additional electrical energy through your muscles and skin. This allows you to shock people with the maximum power produced, depending on the surface area, with your open palms being akin to a defibrillator, whereas the tips of your fingers would be akin to a stun gun. This can, in turn, be used on yourself to stimulate your muscles for extra power and restart your heart should the need arise. You can produce a magnetic field from your skin, which will also drain your energy. Holding a bunch of spoons on your face won't use too much, but something needed to damage vulnerable items, like hardware, would require more energy, and you cannot use this to hold your own weight for long without additional energy reserves. The boosts from Surge can be increased further by drawing upon your biological energy, raising it to 60 as the hard limit, which could leave you bedridden at best or outright dead, with the lower levels having less severe but present backlash from use.
addons.title: Tingles and Tricks

objects.text:
You possess the ability to generate weak variable electromagnetic fields that allow you to wirelessly charge or power electronic devices. This process draws directly from your own biological energy—primarily in the form of calories, but potentially from other energy sources such as magical energy, if you possess them. 

Distance to the object may decrease charging efficiency drastically; similarly, direct physical contact increases it. Additionally, you are limited in the number of devices you can charge/power at the same time without a multi-tasking power because each device will need their own field due to different charging/power requirements.
objects.title: Striker/Shaker (Wireless Charger)

objects.text:
A thin, near-invisible film covers your eye holes from the inside. It stops foreign substances/materials from touching your eyes and slowly eradicates them. You can allow things to pass through it.

The film absorbs any tears that touch it to lubricate your eyes and excessive light—from all parts of the light spectrum—to fuel the eradication of the substances/materials. As a side effect, your eyes are protected from light and you will be unable to cry unless you allow your tears to go through the film.
objects.title: Brute (Eye Protection)

objects.text:
Luminous bands bloom beneath your skin along natural lines of muscle and bone. You can turn them on or off at will, choose any color (including gradients), and modulate brightness as high as you want—from a faint night-light glow to retina-searing glare—though extreme output rapidly burns calories and causes fatigue. The light is cool (no heat), non-laser, and carries no concussive force.

You can hold steady, pulse, ripple, or strobe in any pattern, sync to your heartbeat or steps, and decide whether the glow shines through thin clothing or stays skin-only. This works perfectly underwater: brightness isn’t dampened by immersion. Strobes cut through murk for signaling (e.g., simple Morse), and you can tighten the glow to your skin to reduce backscatter or bloom it outward to fill space. Pressure and temperature don’t affect the glow, but strong output still costs calories; note that vivid patterns may attract curious sea life.
objects.title: Changer/Blaster (Bioluminescent Stripes)

objects.text: You have a sixth sense that informs you of your general location's upcoming weather for the next few days.
objects.title: Thinker (Forecast)

objects.text:
Any weapon or object you hold in your hands can become invisible due to the air concealing it. This does not apply to organic beings. You can't see the object yourself.

When you make the object visible again, the wind surges violently in all directions.
objects.title: Shaker (Invisible Air)

addons.text:
Now, even other semi or completely biological parts of your body are under constant monitoring, always present as a vague sense at the back of your mind until you focus on them.

When you do, you can instantly pinpoint the exact number and location of micro-fractures in your bones, compare red and white blood cell counts, or perceive how many skin cells die and are replaced each minute.

This awareness isn’t limited to fully biological structures—if you possess Magecraft Circuits, Chakra Pathways, or even an unusual brain region handling Psionics, they too develop new neurons connected to a node in your brain, which itself maintains a cluster of neurons dedicated to monitoring itself.
addons.title: Even Fridges are Smart

objects.text:
Each organ now possesses neuron-like networks that continuously monitor vital data such as blood pressure, sugar and salt balance, oxygen saturation, toxin levels, and other irregularities. These pre-programmed neural circuits expand the organ’s natural capacity by integrating new “senses”, allowing it to detect subtle imbalances or threats (such as dehydration, minor infections, or nutrient deficiencies) before they become serious.

The organs do not make you stronger or faster, but they vastly improve your body’s internal awareness and regulation. With practice, you can consciously access this data as though receiving silent status updates from within.
objects.title: Brute/Thinker (Smart Organs)

objects.text:
Your auditory system has been drastically enhanced, making it significantly more sensitive and robust than before. While the average human can perceive sounds in the range of 20 Hz to 20 kHz, your hearing now spans from 10 Hz to 200 kHz—putting you on a similar level to bats and vastly expanding your auditory range.

In addition, thanks to the increased resilience of your auditory system, loud or high-frequency sounds no longer cause pain or disorientation. Your eardrums are highly resistant to damage and, even if injured, recover far more rapidly than normal.

Your brain is fully equipped to process the increased sensory input without strain. Unwanted sounds can be effortlessly filtered out and ignored, allowing you to focus only on what matters.
objects.title: Thinker (Bat Ears)

objects.text: Whenever you yawn you can choose to selectively make everyone else around you feel somewhat tired. You also can now yawn on command.
objects.title: Master/Shaker (Infectious Yawns)

addons.text:
Your Dimensional Awareness has further refined your Mind's Eye, deepening its perception of reality.

The first benefit is a notable increase in both the range and precision of your Dimensional Awareness. These enhancements continue to grow as you further train and develop your Mind's Eye.

But there's more. Where you were once only able to sense the presence and nature of dimensional irregularities, you can now discern their origin. Whether caused by advanced technology, arcane magic, or divine intervention, your Mind's Eye can identify the source behind distortions in the dimensional fabric—so long as they fall within its expanded range.
addons.title: Dimensional Sight

addons.text:
