Your Dimensional Awareness and innate talent for Navigation have fused into a rare and extraordinary ability.

You are now a master of traversing extra-dimensional and higher-dimensional spaces. Regardless of their nature or the method of travel—be it technology, magic, or sheer will—you instinctively discern the safest and most efficient path to your destination. If you had no clear goal upon entry, you'll instead be drawn to the closest safe location.

Whether navigating the Warp of Warhammer 40k, the Slipspace of Halo, or even the twisted Dream Realms of mad Elder Gods, one thing is certain: you will never be lost.
addons.title: Dimensional Navigation

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to attune yourself to the dimensional fabric of reality, granting you a form of Dimensional Awareness that some physicists would kill for.

With this heightened perception, you can detect dimensional irregularities in your immediate vicinity. This includes things like time bubbles, spatial distortions, portals, unstable space-time, dimensional barriers, and even warped or altered reality.

Note that this awareness does not provide protection against these phenomena, nor does it offer a means to counteract or manipulate them. It simply allows you to sense their presence and understand their nature.

Additionally, while you can technically detect the micro-portals formed within the corona pollentia of Parahumans, these portals are so minuscule in scale and impact on the dimensional fabric that you would need to be within 5 meters of a Parahuman to perceive them—unless they are actively using their powers. In which case, you can detect them from 20 meters away.
objects.title: Thinker (Dimensional Awareness)

objects.text:
Your feet have gotten new additions, developing sensory structures that grant the tactile abilities of an elephant's foot. With them, you can detect minute low-frequency seismic vibrations through the ground with your bare feet, effectively allowing you to "hear" distant movements and actions across a wide area, much like an elephant within its natural range.

Yours, however, are far more sensitive than an elephant's by area to compensate for the smaller surface of a human foot, but this also means injuries to your feet will feel significantly more painful. As an adage, your brain has been tweaked to interpret and process this new sensory input without confusion.
objects.title: Thinker (Pacinian Corpuscles)

objects.text: You can manifest or dismiss a fully prehensile tail at will. When grown, the tail is built for strength, balance, and dexterity, enhancing agility for improved movement and stability in combat. It functions as a third limb—able to grip objects, strike with force, and aid mobility (climbing, vaulting, acrobatics). Its durability matches your body, capable of withstanding impacts and delivering powerful blows. You can de-grow the tail instantly when not needed, restoring your normal silhouette.
objects.title: Changer/Brute (Tail)

addons.text: The enhanced strength of your digitigrade toes synergizes with your enhanced flexibility and remarkable body coordination, allowing you to effectively use your feet as a second pair of hands. The classical tricks of shooting a bow or pouring yourself a drink with your feet are child's play to you, as would detailed works like painting, mechanical repairs, or operating a computer. Simply said, if you can do it with your hands, you can now do it equally well with your feet.
addons.title: Leg Hands

objects.text:
Your legs restructure into powerful, digitigrade limbs, resembling those of a large predator. This transformation enhances speed, agility, and jumping ability while reinforcing your bones and muscles for increased durability. Your balance improves drastically, making you more stable even in uneven terrain or while moving at high speeds.

Your foot structure reduces strain on joints and allows for greater force transfer, letting you run faster and kick harder. While your feet become tougher, they remain flexible enough for precise movement. You can toggle between digitigrade and plantigrade stances at will.
objects.title: Brute/Changer (Digitigrade Legs)

objects.text:
You may selectively make materials permanently more flexible by repeatedly stressing them in a related manner using your hands. This does not reduce its strength or other related properties, though tougher materials may require more force and time to work.

This could, for example, allow you to slowly increase your arm's range of motion through guided movements, or make a wooden stick much more elastic without breaking it by stretching it in small increments.
objects.title: Striker (Learned Flexibility)

objects.text: You may freely change what you smell and taste like. This changes how others perceive your smell and taste, but doesn’t affect their fundamental composition. You can choose whether you're affected by this as well or whether this only affects the perception of others.
objects.title: Stranger (Smell & Flavor)

addons.text: Due to being a universal donor and receiver, your extradimensional pocket has evolved a bit; you possess three time-locked pocket dimensions equal to your body volume, and just as you can move excess liquids from other people into a pocket where they will be converted into your fluids, you can transfer excess fluids into other people, effectively performing a blood transfusion just about anywhere.
addons.title: Blood Van

objects.text: Your body gains access to a time-locked pocket dimension with a volume equivalent to your body’s volume. Your body will automatically shunt excess bodily fluids, such as water, blood, and cerebrospinal fluid, into the pocket dimension when you have enough of them, and will bring them into your body from the pocket dimension when you are lacking them. You may restrict the flow of liquid in either direction as you please.
objects.title: Breaker/Brute (Extradimensional Blood Bags)

objects.text:
You are able to mentally interact with electronic devices. For example, you could move a cursor with your mind or mentally type in the search bar, with all the benefits of this occurring at the speed of thought. However, you can deliberately choose to interact more slowly. You are naturally skilled at this type of mental interaction.

Note that you are limited by what the device itself can handle. You might be able to mentally type a million words per minute, but your computer might not be able to keep up.

This ability has a range limit of 10 meters. The device must be at least within your peripheral vision.
objects.title: Master (Mental Bluetooth)

objects.text: You are a Tinker 1 specializing in self-help books. You could make a fitness book that can calculate the optimal routine for a person, or a self-esteem book that works as good as what any therapist could do. This also makes it easier to learn how to write well.
objects.title: Tinker (Self-Help)

addons.text:
You can now alter the type of particulate matter you can generate within your pockets by adding a small sample of it to any pocket you have. However, said new type of particulate is restricted to said pocket.

So your left pocket may now carry finely ground pepper as an option, but only that pocket in that specific set of clothes.

You also now only need to have a hand in your pocket, allowing the chosen particulate matter to form rapidly in the other, at a rate equivalent to the maximum volume your hand every 5 seconds on command.

This, in concert, lets you produce and material you have added to said pocket in any ratio, and allows you to slightly alter their texture, colour, irritability, and how adhesive they are.
addons.title: Craft Store Crash

addons.text:
You can now alter the flavour of the particulate matter within your pockets on command by changing their colour & texture. You can afflict any flavour you know of, as long as you subconsciously associate the colour and/or texture with the flavour, even if you've never personally experienced it.

For example, if the colour of green reminds you of a swamp or sewage, prepare for the smell & taste of methane & plant mulch or refuse to linger.

Or if you decide to give talcum powder a coarse grit that reminds you of chalk, that's what it will taste like.
addons.title: Taste the Rainbow

addons.text:
You repertoire of particulates has expanded to liquids in the most unusual way - you can now conjure any liquid (i.e. liquid at room temperature with no human intervention) you know the properties & composition of in a highly concentrated powder form, enough that dumpjng a handful in the average claw-foot bathtub will turn the entire volume of water into anywhere from 15-50% concentration, inversely porportional to molecular complexity.

You've also mildly violated the laws of thermodynamics, as by default, any particulate you now use is at room temperature, meaning you can even conjure powdered lava that would turn into molten liquid upon contact with water.

Finally, you can remotely exchange your temperature with any particulates you throw, allowing you to circumvent the hydrophilic properties from breaking down at cold temperatures.
addons.title: Bath Bombs

addons.text:
Your powers have evolved with disturbing synergy.

Your wrist pockets are now also time-locked pocket dimensions, and you can now store anything smaller than the opening inside indefinitely.

More importantly, you now have the ability to create new pockets in your body, via cutting a line into your skin.

This process does not harm you, nor does it hurt, so long as it is done by your hand.

These pockets have similar pocket-dimensional spaces to your wrists & the one connected to your entire body.

Their maximum capacity is equal to 1/10th the volume of your body.

Inside each of these pockets, you can store any form of matter you have consumed, purifying & refining them instead of digesting them,  in either liquid or particulate form.

You can now expel any liquids or particulates you've stored, including biological fluids in the main pocket dimension, from any pocket you have in your body at roughly the same velocity as the average thrown baseball.

These substances cannot mix inside your pocket dimensions.
addons.title: Pocket Sandstorm

objects.text:
By reaching into any form of fabric pocket sewn directly on your clothes and making a fist/grasping motion, you can conjure either sand, talcum baby powder, or neon pink glitter at a minute cost of your stamina.

The thrown matter is slightly more irritating than its mundane counterpart & will adhere somewhat unnaturally to any surface, requiring a minimum of an hour's thorough scrubbing to remove, slightly more if directly on skin or in hair.
objects.title: Striker/Blaster (Pocket Sand)

objects.text:
With a bit of sweat and a lot of effort, you can bend anything—pipes, bars, doors—just like a certain shiny cartoon robot. It’s exhausting work, but you’ll twist and warp stuff you’d normally never budge.

And yes, you can bend living things…but they’ll fight you every inch of the way, and the results will be more “horrifying pretzel” than “fun party trick.”
objects.title: Striker (Bender)

objects.text:
You gain a vague sense of timing in activities you are either aware of or actively engaging in. 

With this, you'll never burn food as you get a sense of when to just take it off the stove, you always take out metal from a forge at the right time, or know right when to dodge when in a fight.

Things you're not actively aware of, like an ambush or anything that happens outside your awareness or knowledge, will not trigger it.

However, this does not give you the reaction speed or physical abilities necessary to complete certain actions. Just because you know just when to move when someone shoots doesn't mean you'll be able to move fast enough to do so.
objects.title: Thinker (Right on Time)

addons.text: In addition to being able to completely negate pain, you can change the sensations you will feel depending on the type and severity of the injury. In other words, you can reconfigure the settings of your pain receptors.
addons.title: Pain Configuration

addons.text: You can now configure your senses to give you a sound effect of your choosing when you'd normally feel them. Additionally, you are no longer limited to only feeling your senses at 100% or 0%; you can configure how much you want to feel whichever sense you want between 0% to 200%.
addons.title: Sensory Sound Effects

objects.text: You can disable your body's senses. This includes touch, taste, hearing, but also feelings such as sleepiness, hunger, thirst, and so on. The only exception to this is pain, which you cannot negate.
objects.title: Thinker (Sensory Deprivation)

objects.text: You always know where the four cardinal directions, the four ordinal directions, and the eight secondary intercardinal directions are in relation to you.
objects.title: Thinker (Compass)

objects.text: You can store items within a set of pocket dimensions tied to each of your hands. You may only store one item for each hand, and they must be a single object that you can both hold and lift with one hand. A container and its contents count as a single object.
objects.title: Striker/Stranger (Wristpocket)

objects.text: Your memory becomes infinite and perfectly eidetic. From the moment you gain this power onward, you can recall any experience—down to sensations, words, and tiny details, as if it were happening again in front of you. All memories from before you gained this power are “cleaned up” and restored to perfect clarity, including things you had completely forgotten, losing any blur, distortion, or emotional fog.
objects.title: Thinker (Total Recall)

objects.text:
You can manifest a thin forcefield “mask” that only covers your nose and mouth. Its sole function is to ensure you can breathe safely in any environment—underwater, in smoke, in toxic air, in vacuum/space, or on alien worlds with incompatible atmospheres.

The mask can be invisible or any solid color you choose, and you can toggle it on/off at will. It provides no other protection (no armor, pressure shielding, temperature resistance, or filtration beyond making breathing possible).
objects.title: Breaker (Breath Mask)

objects.text:
You can safely ingest and digest anything you can physically swallow, regardless of material.

From the moment an item enters your mouth, it cannot harm you anywhere along your digestive tract. This covers damage from sharpness, abrasion, punctures, caustic or reactive substances, extreme heat/cold on contact, toxins, and pathogens.

You must actually eat the item. Size is limited to whatever you can swallow. Digestion still takes time, and tougher or denser materials take longer. It only provides nutrition if the material contains usable energy/nutrients, otherwise it digests harmlessly.
objects.title: Brute/Breaker (Iron Stomach)

objects.text: You're capable of understanding, maintaining and changing Tinkertech coding, however you're incapable of creating your own. This gives you enough know-how to also be a middling Programmer.
objects.title: Tinker/Thinker (Saint)

objects.text:
Your respiratory system has undergone a remarkable transformation. 

Where it once relied solely on oxygen, it can now extract sustenance from a wide range of gases to keep your body functioning.

Nitrogen, carbon dioxide, methane, and even noble gases such as helium can now be metabolized to sustain you. As a result, environments containing 0% oxygen pose no inherent danger, provided at least one other gas is present in sufficient quantity.

Despite this versatility, oxygen remains the most efficient fuel for your body. In low-oxygen environments, a substitute gas must constitute at least 35% of the breathable atmosphere to prevent symptoms comparable to oxygen deprivation from occurring.
objects.title: Brute (Iron Lung)

addons.text:
The senses of smell and taste are intrinsically connected, which has led to your godly sense of taste supercharging your already phenomenal sense of smell. You can now smell better than even an elephant, the animal with the best sense of smell on the planet. When locking onto a scent, a shark seeking blood would look like a human with a bad cold compared to you. The amount of information you can extract from scent becomes unnerving, allowing you to reconstruct the last days and maybe even entire weeks of a person's life just from their scent while they stand in front of you.

With training and concentration, you can break a scent down to the atoms composing its molecules to understand the chemical makeup of any new material you encounter, letting you know exactly how a meal will taste the moment you smell it. You still need to figure out what each scent means through practice, but the process will go much faster for you.
addons.title: God's Nose

objects.text:
Your sense of smell sharpens, becoming equal, if not superior, to that of animals like canines or bears. This allows you to effortlessly distinguish between different people and track them over miles, as well as letting you read information about their health and emotional states simply from their scent. Beyond this, it can help you find food, assist in orienting yourself, and notice potential dangers as long as they're not downwind from you.

Your mind will be able to process this new tide of information without becoming overwhelmed, capable of perfectly keeping track of and analyzing every individual scent, though it will take time and practice to understand what each scent means. You are protected from being overwhelmed by vile stenches; however, you can still identify them as unpleasant.
objects.title: Thinker (Bloodhound)

addons.text:
You can now directly treat memories and memetic systems as notes, as well as place them on your mental corkboards, duplicate them across notes, and play them from an outside perspective. You can also create shelves for specific memory, note, and corkboard combinations to be stored for later and recalled at any time. 

As an additional benefit, this allows you to create archives—backups—of any memories you have.
addons.title: Mental Library

addons.text:
You can utilize Book Osmosis to transcribe absorbed information to your Mental Corkboards. Because information is being directly transcribed to to your corkboards, the strain on your brain is lower, this allows for a greatly increased information absorption rate.

In exchange your actual understanding of the information will be nonexistent, this can be corrected by going through your corkboards to absorb the information later. If you absorb too many books this way without clearing your corkboards, it can lead to them becoming extremely cluttered.
addons.title: Transcribe

addons.text:
Your mental library has perfectly synergized with your ability to transcribe books to your Mental Corkboards. You can easily copy entire books to your library, with it never becoming disorganized or cluttered. 

Your understanding of directly transcribed information will still be nonexistent, at least until you take some time to truly absorb it in from you library. But you'll be able to find whatever mental tome you're looking for with ease, allowing for effortless access to the information when needed.
addons.title: Bibliomania

objects.text:
You now have the ability to write, organise, and store notes mentally, as well as create hallucinatory displays of your notes for you to observe and shift around at will. 

These displays only appear for you, unless you have a telepathic power to share them.
objects.title: Thinker (Mental Corkboards)

addons.text:
Your perfect healing and stem cell production have melded with your slowed aging, allowing you to achieve true agelessness. 

You no longer age past your prime and will never die of old age or develop age-related complications. Though you might want to pick up some form of enhanced memory, or you are going to forget things.
addons.title: Biological Immortality

objects.text:
Your body no longer visibly ages, nor does your body or your brain decay beyond your physical prime. 

This does not endow true agelessness; it only ensures that you do not visibly age or suffer the frailty of old age, allowing you to live up to 150 years. 

This means you would still look like you were in your 20s when you die of old age in your 150s.
objects.title: Brute/Thinker (Agelessness)

objects.text:
Whenever you are in a universe which has a beginning, i.e. one which does not 'exist infinitely', then you will have access to a continual subconscious awareness of the exact amount of time, in Planck time units, since the beginning of that universe, providing access to a continual sense of the exact amount of time passing between any two moments, and what 'universal time' it currently is.  As long as you have knowledge of a local timekeeping system, and a point of reference to sync it up with the Universal Clock, this awareness can be configured to present itself to you in that local system.

This ability synergizes heavily with any ability permitting time travel, allowing for identification of exact moments of departure and arrival.
objects.title: Thinker (Universal Clock)

addons.text: Your horn(s), and by extension your skull, has become significantly more durable than before, being x1.5 greater than the rest of your bones, and can alter their shape and size but will return to the normal design of what you originally picked. Your horn(s) can act as a focus for some abilities to increase their strength and control by 20%; if damaged, the boost gain is lost until the horn(s) are healed.
addons.title: Black Horn

addons.text:
You gain the ability to summon additional layered keratin going from the base of your neck and following along your spine and down your tail into the tip, where it encases the end of the tail, allowing it to act as a bludgeoning weapon, providing additional protection and healing to your spine without sacrificing dexterity.

If you have the Black Horn addon, then the boost to strength and control increases to 50%, along with control over your back and tail armour, growing spikes along your back, and limited shapeshifting of your tail armour to make it near anything from a thagomizer (spiked tail) to a working hand of sorts.
addons.title: Thagomizer

addons.text:
Due to your various powers, you have come to resemble a trouble-making creature, such as an Imp or a Gremlin.

You have become a natural at sabotage and stealth, using your small stature to slip by unnoticed, with your ability to come up with blueprints being used to help sneak around and plan what to do to damage a piece of equipment, such as removing the nails of a floorboard to ensure a guard gets stuck or gutting the engine of a car. Your ability to use your horns and nails has evolved, as you are better able to use your nails as impromptu tools—not quite comparable to the real thing but good in a pinch—with you being just as creative with your horns, like using them as a base for an antenna setup.
addons.title: Miscellaneous Imp

addons.text: The luminous bands beneath your skin can now help regulate and direct the increase in energy you receive from absorbing radiation, with your wings themselves being able to store vast amounts of radiation without it affecting the rest of your body right away, effectively storing it like fat; by directing the energy into your horn(s), you are able to fire off beams of radiation equal to the levels in your body as a means to discharge them safely or use them as a weapon.
addons.title: Kiddie Kaiju

objects.text:
You can manifest or dismiss Horn(s) on your head, the style, placement, and number of which you can decide now. But regardless of appearance, they are the same, possessing a core of living bone that's connected to your skull with a sheath of layered keratin (a protein found in hair and nails) that strengthens and reinforces the horn(s).

Horns grow with maturity, so while bumps in the beginning, they will begin to grow outward around puberty, no matter what, your horn(s) will be proportional to your body and will not hinder your movements. If damaged or even completely removed, they will completely recover within a few hours, and you even have the ability to painlessly break off your horns to use them as materials and tools, with this healing extending to the rest of your skull that has been altered to better protect your brain and inner bones from impacts to the head or your horn(s).
objects.title: Changer/Brute (Horn)

addons.text:
Much like poison dart frogs, you're able to selectively secrete an extremely poisonous mucous at will. In addition to letting you coat yourself to punish any biting-attacks and coating a weapon with your secretion, the poison in this mucous can be adjusted to cause irritation of the skin on contact, or even seep through the skin to poison anyone making contact with it.

You can combine your secreted poison with the water-attracting ooze you can already generate in order to make it more dangerous for anyone trying to remove it, though of course the more water is bonded to the ooze, the more diluted your poison becomes. This however can be used to force the enemy to choose between being dealing with a more concentrated poison seeping into their body or being forced to fight while weighed down by the fully waterlogged ooze.

You may design a new type of venom specifically for your mucous, and can freely choose which of your venoms will be excreted in your poison mucous at any given time.
addons.title: Poison Mucous
Endless Myriad Venoms
addons.text:
Your venom is now no longer restricted to a single type. Thanks to Poisoner’s ability to produce new toxins at will you can now freely customize the properties of the venom you produce in each individual gland at will, with the only restriction being that you must empty a venom gland of its old content before you can begin producing a new venom. 

In return however the production speed for your venoms is now no longer tied to how exotic or potent it is, the production-process for new venom now only takes seconds as opposed to the hours if not days it used to take before. This only applies to the venoms you produce internally in your glands, not toxins produced externally through Poisoner alone.

objects.text: Your body now has developed venom glands. This allows you to produce a custom type of venom with a wide variety of possible effects, ranging from neurotoxins, paralytics, anesthetics, hallucinogens, blinding agents, necrosis induction, or any other trait of your choice, so long as they can be found in nature. This is a one-time-choice, meaning that whatever venom you design at purchase will be the only type of venom you can produce. You are immune to your own venom and resistant to similar ones. You generate your venom through regular biological processes, meaning it takes a few days to fully fill a venom gland. By itself this power does not come with a delivery method, so unless you've chosen Sharp Teeth to grow venomous fangs or Tail to grow a stinger you will, much like a komodo dragon, be limited to emptying your venom glands into your oral cavity when clenching your jaws and then either transfer it via a bite, if your teeth break skin, or spitting it into someone's eyes.
objects.title: Brute (Venom)

addons.text:
Through drawing nourishment from the Earth and Sun, you can, in theory, hibernate indefinitely, as what you use up is replenished; the invigoration of Solar is greatly increased, allowing you to better heal any damage you may have and increase the abilities of your subconscious.

While you hibernate, it’s possible for you to blend in with your environment, with plant matter forming around you to add an extra layer of protection, however fragile it may be. Should you be in contact with a flora system, such as the roots of trees, your awareness can be expanded through them; however, the information will be less detailed, with only broad information.

Should you have SolarHouse of the Cell, you can do more than blend into the environment for protection and rest; you are able to support the nature around you, as the excess power you gain can be spread out to increase your own protections and enrich your area. Given enough time, you could bring life to a barren area, or at least in theory.
addons.title: Discount Dryad

objects.text: You are able to absorb nutrients from the ground through your skin by burying a foot, a fist, or a sufficient area of your body (such as lying on your naked back) for nourishment, only taking in what you need and what’s safe.
objects.title: Brute (Fake Flora)

addons.title: Calisthenic Integration
addons.text:
Your body no longer requires a dedicated exercise routine to benefit from physical activity. Any deliberate physical action can serve as training, provided you perform it with the intent of improving yourself.

Walking, climbing, swimming, fighting, dancing, working, carrying objects, practicing a sport, or even repeatedly performing an otherwise mundane movement can all provide meaningful physical training. Your body determines what physical adaptations can be extracted from the activity and treats the effort as an appropriate exercise.

The benefits still scale according to the difficulty, duration, and consistency of the activity. A casual walk will not provide the same stimulus as intense exercise, but even simple activities remain useful rather than becoming completely irrelevant as your physical abilities increase.

Combined with Calisthenics, this means you never need to worry about finding an exercise capable of challenging you.

objects.text:
Your muscles don’t develop in just one dimension. Training for strength, endurance, flexibility, or size enhances all aspects of your physical ability simultaneously. Running can build powerful muscles, lifting weights can increase flexibility, and any form of exercise contributes to balanced growth throughout your entire body.

Instead of developing isolated muscle groups, your body distributes the benefits of training evenly, creating exceptional strength, endurance, agility, flexibility, and resilience across every muscle. Because your muscles adapt perfectly to any challenge, every workout improves multiple physical qualities at once, allowing you to progress far beyond normal human limits.
objects.title: Brute (Muscle Equilibrium)

addons.text:
Your false memories now possess a similar level of security as those set by Infolock. Once formed, they appear completely authentic and genuine in every regard.

Whether interacting with telepaths, memory-walkers and clairvoyants or undergoing truth serums, lie detectors and other methods, your memories will be seen as real. Any attempt to reveal discrepancies will fail as no accessible inconsistency exists to uncover.

An observer may question the plausibility of a recollection, but not its authenticity as a memory. At most, they may conclude that you misremembered events, were under an illusion or subject to some other form of deception, but they won’t identify the memory itself as being artificial or fabricated.

You retain full control over these memories. For instance, your true memories could be hidden away entirely, preventing any extraction, while a layer of false memories is presented in their place for others to perceive and engage with as if utterly real.
addons.title: Mnemonic Masquerade

objects.text:
You can construct any number of fake memories that appear entirely identical to genuine ones, both to yourself and to any external observer that examines your mind.

These fabricated memories can be as long, detailed and internally consistent as you wish, ranging from brief moments to potentially entire lifetimes of false experiences. You retain an innate awareness of which memories are real and which aren't, unless you consciously choose otherwise.

However, these memories are limited by your own knowledge and imagination. They cannot grant you new skills, information or understanding you do not already possess. For instance, you could recall talking in a language fluently, but a native speaker would instantly recognize it as just similar sounding nonsense.

You may alter or erase false memories at will and can even allow them to overwrite your actual memories, causing you to fully believe in their authenticity. You can restore your original memories at any time, either immediately or at a predetermined future date.
objects.title: Thinker (Fake Memories)

objects.text:
Whatever you chant, intelligible or not, subtly compels those who hear it to chant it with you. This compulsion is carried through the chants of others, though its effect diminishes the further from you it gets.

The strength of this compulsion scales with the number of heard repetitions, the volume it is chanted at and the number of people whose chants are being heard.
objects.title: Master (Chorus)

objects.text:
Once daily, you can add, remove, or change one letter in the name of another T0 you have, changing its effects. You can vaguely influence the way that the power manifests, but it will broadly need to adhere to the same power category and will be of a roughly equivalent level of power. This effect can only be applied to one power at a time, with the changed power being returned to normal after another is changed.

An example of how this could be used would be changing Thinker (Forecast) to Thinker (Lorecast), changing the power from vaguely letting you tell the upcoming weather to gaining faint insights into the history of an item while looking at it. Alternatively, you can use this on the power category's name to recontextualize the name, resulting in a new, roughly equivalent power. An example of this would be changing Tinker (It's Magic!) to Thinker (It's Magic!), changing the power to make you skilled at common magic tricks and general sleight of hand.
objects.title: Trump (One Letter)

objects.text:
You can cry on command and control the extent of it, whether it’s a single big solitary tear, a small steady stream that doesn’t block your vision, or water streams flying outwards from your eyes like waterfalls as they do in cartoons, though this would dehydrate you quite rapidly without other powers that replenish your water reserves or grant access to a supply of it.

You can also control the saline content of your tears, whether it’s completely deprived of salt or filled with as much salt as a drop of water can contain, though this likewise makes use of your body's salt reserves.

Your tear ducts and eyes are incapable of getting sore or irritated from crying, though you can, at will, make them appear as such, allowing you to make your tear ducts and eyes appear reddened and inflamed.

Alongside this, you find it intuitive to utilize your tears for emotional manipulation, such as learning what tones of vocal accompaniment and body language are necessary to properly convey your desired projection of sadness.
objects.title: Master (Crybaby)

objects.text:
You can induce a stranger effect that—from other's perspective—makes it look like you're locked in one specific pose, yet by physics breaking logic, you still move and complete an action as normal.

You can use this to walk down the stairs even though you're just standing still with your hands in your pockets, or connect your punch even though it looks like you stopped halfway through.

You have full control over how long this effect lasts.
objects.title: Mover/Stranger (One Frame Man)

addons.text:
Your ability to touch the hearts of others has grown stronger as you no longer just give those you cheer for encouragement; you are able to help them push aside doubts and worries to help them. And the more you cheer, the more people who are neutral will begin joining you in your cheers, turning those you support into the heroes of the game.

With your instinct regarding what works best when cheering for someone mixing with your Tinker specialty in making first impressions, the drawings, performances, chants, and other means of showing your support become more effective as they gather more fans for the one you support. With enough people, it won't just allow those you cheer on to perform at their best, but can also demoralize the ones they're up against, without a bad word uttered against them.
addons.title: Hype (Wo)Man

addons.text: Whenever you cheer someone on, you can have background music begin playing, similar to Theme Song, with your cheering giving the music more impact with each sound and movement. The music played matches the current situation of those you are cheering on and gives them additional boosts for the situation, such as increased foresight and problem-solving when things look bad or increased creativity and bravery when on the verge of a turnabout.
addons.title: Accompanying Band

addons.text:
The boost your cheering gives is no longer a minor thing, a pep in their step towards the finish line; now, with your cheering, it can enhance the abilities of others as if they had Thinker (Flow State) and Brute/Mover (Surge), washing away hesitation and performing at their peak with brief moments of going beyond their limits. However, you will need to cheer to maintain this boost at regular intervals, and it ends once the game / match / event is over.

With enough cheering, it is possible for those you cheer on to age more gracefully, not stopping the aging process but making its effects less severe so those you support can play on for longer.
addons.title: The People Sing for Victory!
Cheerleader
addons.text: The effectiveness of your cheers now grows stronger with each additional person who joins in, with two levels of engagement: either joining you in cheering as a major performer, doing routines with a lot of activity, so long as they are capable of it; or doing small actions with a large crowd, such as cheering, saying words brought up by Dialogue, and holding up items if they were prepared beforehand.

objects.text:
You are a Thinker that specializes in cheering someone on; knowing the best form, method, and timing to make your encouragement and support of others known and giving them a boost in whatever they are doing.

This comes with an instinct for what items and materials would help cheer someone on in any situation; while a full-on cheer squad would fit a major sporting event, it would be distracting for an intense one-on-one card game.
objects.title: Thinker/Trump (Cheerer)

objects.text:
You may capture a single second of your own movement and replay it either through manual activation or by setting simple conditions that need to be fulfilled, like someone looking at it or coming into close proximity of it, only once it has played out will you be able to use this power again.

This replay of yours will be an illusion that will dissolve naturally once affected by the material world, or once it’s done replaying your movements. It will mirror any actions done during this period of time, including the use of powers and technology, though these replays will be purely visual.
objects.title: Stranger (Phantasm)

objects.text: You can fire a loud, harmless burst of confetti from your hands at will.
objects.title: Blaster (Party Popper)
Thinker (Schemer)
objects.text: You possess an intuitive knack for devising secretive plans. Concealing your actions, anticipating potential pitfalls, and maneuvering through complicated schemes come naturally to you. You are also more perceptive toward attempts to manipulate you or plot against you. This power does not make your plans flawless or prevent you from being deceived.

objects.title: Thinker/Breaker (Emergency Button)
objects.text: You possess the ability to hit a metaphorical 'button' and force yourself to die instantly, regardless of any attempts by external means of keeping you alive.

objects.title: Brute (Dual Hearts)
objects.text: Your circulatory system has changed, gaining and properly supporting a functional second heart. As the two hearts beat, your body sees a quite a few benefits; the overall stress of your circulatory system is reduced, your stamina lasts longer and recovers faster, you can handle far higher g-forces with little issue, you heal faster, your body is better able handle reaching larger sizes or more intensive traits, and though quite painful you can survive if one heart becomes incapacitated.

objects.title: Mover (Sea Legs)
objects.text: You are able to walk on liquids as if they were solid, but you are not protected from the effects of those liquids so don't expect to be walking on lava without burning.

objects.title: Stranger/Thinker (Allspeak)
objects.text:
You can now always understand what is being spoken by others and be understood by others whenever you speak. This functions as a perception filter that translates the meanings of words with perfect context on the end of the speaker and listener. 

Those with enhanced mental or sensory abilities can pick out the underlying language if they focus hard enough, but otherwise this process is largely seamless and undetectable.

objects.title: Changer/Mover (All Fours)
objects.text: You can move on all fours as easily and naturally as you can walk upright. While doing so, your posture, joints, balance, and coordination subtly adapt to support quadrupedal walking, running, and maneuvering without discomfort or strain.

objects.title: Changer/Brute (Tentabones)
objects.text: *Quiet, weird licking noises.* "Huh. Hey Jerry! Wanna see my teeth wriggle?" No longer a simple unliving structure your body built to support itself, your skeleton is now made of stiff and hard tentacle-like tubes and sheets. These are more durable and more flexible than normal bones, with the added ability to regenerate at the same speed as your skin. They can be controlled to a minor degree; flexing and moving independently of your normal muscles—even squeezing or swelling to extend and contract them—but such motions are both slow and easily able to hurt or permanently damage your ligaments and muscles. With careful practice you can use this to subtly change your facial structure, natural gait, proportions, and posture. Not by a great amount—perhaps just a few inches in lengths in the limbs here and there without damaging yourself. Just be careful not to do something like pinch your brainstem on accident. On the flipside, if any of your bones become exposed outside your flesh they become easier to control, quicker, more flexible and more dexterous—up to and matching that of your normal fingers. Note: This does not make your skeleton one cohesive unit. All your bones are still separate, and you still have joints. This just replaces the material.

objects.title: Thinker (Dark Vision)
objects.text:
You now have a perfect dark vision. No matter how devoid of light an area is, be it in a completely isolated room or at the bottom of the ocean, you can see as clearly as if it were in the broad daylight.

You do not suffer any adverse effects from sudden changes in brightness for so long as your dark vision is active, as it maintains a balanced lighting even should a flashbang blow up in your face.

You can activate and deactivate this vision at will.

objects.title: Striker (Signs)
objects.text:
This power works much like Miss Militia's, you generate a brownish blob of energy that can take the shape of signs you can hold in one hand. While there is nothing stopping you from hitting people with your sign, it would probably be more effectively used as a hand fan.
Like a certain Coyote you can only make a few different messages in a short period of time, and they cannot be longer than 10 words.

objects.title: Stranger/Master (Sneezy)
objects.text:
Any one person trying to aim any form of ranged attack at you will get the strongest, most eye watering need to sneeze they have ever experienced in their life.
Beings that do not sneeze are immune to this automatic defence, and in the event of multiple attackers it selects at random.

objects.title: Striker/Master (The Cuddle Emperor's Greater Soft Embrace)
objects.text:
Your physical affection possesses an exceptional ability to comfort, soothe, and emotionally heal others. Any affectionate contact you give, whether a gentle headpat, hug, embrace, or cuddle, naturally feels exceptionally warm, pleasant, and reassuring, creating a profound sense of safety and comfort in those you touch.

This effect works on both the body and mind, easing stress, calming agitation, dispelling negative emotions and mental influences, and helping stabilize those suffering from emotional or psychological distress. The comfort provided by your affection is genuinely therapeutic, allowing even deeply troubled or emotionally damaged individuals to gradually recover their composure and find peace.

Your affection also naturally encourages feelings of trust, attachment, and emotional openness, making it easier for people to accept comfort from you and lower their emotional defenses. Even someone normally cold, hostile, or incapable of expressing their feelings can find themselves unable to resist the overwhelming sense of warmth and reassurance your touch provides.

The power is not tied to any specific gesture; it is the affection itself that carries the effect. As a result, the more naturally affectionate the interaction, the more completely the target can relax and benefit from your comforting presence.

You can slide around on your feet as if you were wearing skates by controlling the friction between you and the ground. This only allows you to move at speeds you would be capable of reaching in skates, averaging about 20km an hour.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) Skater

objects.text: For the purposes of self-propelled movement, you can treat yourself as if you had only 1/8 of your total mass, when advantageous. This allows you to jump higher, accelerate and change direction quicker, and run across more fragile surfaces, all without the disadvantages that would usually come from such a low weight, such as increased susceptibility to wind resistance or decreased force of impact.
objects.title: (Mover) Featherweight

objects.text: You can run at an additional 35 mph than you could without powers, without breaking a sweat, and 60 mph when pushing yourself at best. Your legs have a small Breaker effect that allows you to run without the risk of taking damage. You can exercise to increase your total speed, but your speed with your powers on will always be an additional 35 and 60 mph once you make an effort. It appears that high-quality shoes are now on your list of needs.
objects.title: (Mover) Fast as a Hedgehog

objects.text: You can jump 50 meters, and as long as you land on your feet, you won't get hurt, as your feet are completely invulnerable to damage and act as shock absorbers. You can use this power to jump horizontally, but be careful to land on your feet. And word of advice, kickboxing matches well with this, so you might as well learn it!
objects.title: (Mover) Flying like a Chicken

objects.text: You can move any object or person you touch a distance of up to 50 feet in any direction in a straight line. While moving, these objects are largely damage-resistant. Small, hand-held objects move at roughly 75 mph, while objects the size of a car move at half that speed.
objects.title: (Mover) Rail

objects.text: You can adhere to any non-horizontal surface within your sight; this allows you to stand on walls.
objects.title: (Mover) Wallcrawler

objects.text:
You can instantly appear anywhere you can visualize yourself, and succeed in, moving to within the next 10 seconds. This power takes into account your abilities and setting, though not the actions of others around you.

This power strongly synergizes with other Mover powers.
objects.title: (Mover) Skip Step

objects.text: You can fly! Your acceleration is kinda slow, 3 m/s^2, but your maximum speed is 120 miles per hour! If you're moving fast when you first start to fly, you'll keep your velocity, but unless you start by jumping off a motorcycle or have other Mover powers, that's only going to start you off at a couple of miles per hour.
objects.title: (Mover) Soaring through the Sky like a Flying Bison

objects.text: You can walk, run, and stand in the air. You can also walk back down to the ground if you want. You can use this to stop yourself in mid-air or skid at any speed, just prepare for an impact.
objects.title: (Mover) Stairway to Heaven

addons.text:
Your enhanced reaction speeds to stimuli have now compounded together for an incredible effect. Your reaction time has increased to a total of 100 times faster than your original baseline, enabling you to perform remarkable physical and mental feats where response time is crucial.

To help you coordinate and fully maximize your inhumanly fast reflexes, your mental processing speed has also been boosted, allowing your mind to operate up to a total of 10 times faster than before.
addons.title: Lightning Fast Reflexes

objects.text: Your reaction time is 25x faster than it would be otherwise. If your reaction time was average, your reaction time to visual stimuli would be 0.01 seconds. You can also think and process information 3 times as quickly.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Star-Nosed Mole

objects.text: You possess a limitless amount of physical and mental stamina, applying to all natural forms of exertion—including any effort enhanced by powers—so long as that exertion remains fundamentally tied to your own body or mind. If you have a power that lets you run faster, punch harder, or think more clearly, and it still depends on your muscles or mental focus, you can sustain it indefinitely. Fatigue, exhaustion, and burnout are no longer part of your existence. You can run, lift, concentrate, or push yourself at full intensity forever, without your will faltering or your performance fading. This doesn’t enhance your raw strength, speed, or intelligence; it simply means you’ll never tire, no matter the duration or effort involved. However, for powers that use stamina as a discrete resource and don’t rely directly on your body or mind, you aren’t treated as having infinite reserves. Instead, your stamina pool is multiplied by ten and regenerates at one hundred times the normal rate. If this pool is ever fully depleted, you suffer no lasting fatigue—only the temporary inability to power that specific ability until it replenishes.
objects.title: (Mover) Stamina

objects.text: You have absolute awareness of any and all matter within 5 meters of yourself, and can teleport to anywhere within 4 meters of yourself. Your cool down is half a second. All living beings in the spot you're teleporting to will be teleported just outside where you chose to teleport.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Blink and you Miss it.

objects.text: You can summon anyone you've ever seen to any location within 10 feet of you as long as there is enough open space. The person you are attempting to summon is aware that you are attempting to summon them and can refuse if they so wish. This works on people you have seen an accurate image of. This does not work across dimensions.
objects.title: (Mover) Summoning

objects.text: At will, you can target any object in your line of sight and 'lock' yourself to it. While 'locked', you always maintain the same relative position to it that you had when you first activated this ability. You can 'unlock' yourself at any time, disabling this effect. You are immune to friction while this power is active. Breaking the line of sight does not disable the 'locking' effect.
objects.title: (Mover) What He's Having

objects.text: You move faster when running away from a target. Your speed increases based on the speed you are being chased. If there is no one chasing you, your speed returns to normal. Your speed will always be the speed you can move at, plus the speed people are chasing you at. This means you can always outrun whoever chases you unless they can teleport.
objects.title: (Mover) Run Away!

objects.text: You automatically evade the first attack directed at you, regardless of its nature or magnitude. Whether the attack is a minor strike or one capable of devastating an entire area, your power will instantly relocate you just outside the range of danger. This extends to evading surprise or stealth attacks. This effect applies only to the initial attack, meaning any subsequent strikes will proceed as normal and can potentially hit you. This resets once combat ends.
objects.title: (Mover) Initial Dodge

addons.text:
You aren’t actually Batman, but you emulate his legendary skill in stealth and infiltration. You have an uncanny knack for slipping into places where you shouldn’t be, leaving no trace behind. Your movements are so fluid and deliberate that even the most advanced security systems struggle to keep up. Guards overlook you as if you’re part of the shadows, and even when spotted, your quick thinking and agility allow you to evade pursuit with ease.

You can bypass complex security systems, patrols, and even evade high-tech measures like motion sensors or laser grids. While you can’t outright vanish into thin air, your presence becomes so subtle that you might as well have. In moments of extreme focus, you may even exploit minor distractions or environmental factors to become functionally invisible for brief periods.
addons.title: Batman

objects.text: You possess a mastery of entry and escape, making you a true expert in navigating barriers. Whether it’s a high-security compound or a locked vault, you instinctively analyze the structure, spotting weak points and assessing the level of difficulty with startling precision. This grants you an intuitive sense of how “escapable” or “break-inable” any location is, as well as the best actions and plans to maximize your chances of success. While it can't overcome the truly impossible, your skill ensures that, given enough time and resources, most barriers will fall before your expertise.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Infiltrator

addons.text:
Dirt is tough to swim through, but you don't have to anymore. Instead, you can act like it's just air, allowing you to walk, run, or just stand in it without a lick of resistance. The ground is displaced when you enter it, but returns to its original position quickly.

This isn't limited to just dirt; this is applied to stone, metal, and just about anything that isn't organic.
addons.title: Highway to Hell

objects.text:
You can move through sand, earth, and gravel like a fish through water.

You can dig through solid stone or stone-like materials at significantly reduced speeds.

You will not need to breathe while underground and will possess an innate sense of direction.
objects.title: (Mover) Ground Diver

addons.text:
Your body is a perpetual motion system, cycling kinetic energy through every movement with explosive efficiency. Each sprint, jump, or strike coils energy into your sinews and spring-like form, allowing you to store and release force in a continuous feedback loop. Instead of slowing down, every impact fuels the next, letting you ricochet off surfaces, twist mid-air, and accelerate with every rebound. You move like a living pinball, seamlessly chaining momentum into greater speed and power, making you nearly impossible to predict or catch.

This kinetic buildup doesn’t just enhance movement—it turns every action into a weapon. Landings create shockwaves, strikes detonate with stored force, and even a simple step can rupture the ground beneath you. If an opponent blocks or absorbs a hit, the energy doesn’t dissipate—it transfers, ready to explode on the next impact. Whether evading, attacking, or traversing terrain, your motion never goes to waste. The longer you move, the stronger you become, and as long as there’s something to push off, you can keep building momentum indefinitely.
addons.title: Kinetic Ricochet

objects.text: You can use your elastic energy, changing your body to be more spring-like, to bounce and rebound for greater momentum. You can compress a body part or your entire body, being stretchable and compressible enough to store a greater amount of elastic energy than the best compression springs. What’s more, you can shore up elastic force to continuously gain greater momentum and impact inertia with every continual rebound that stacks speed and force the more you bounce around.
objects.title: (Mover/Changer) Springs

objects.text: You can convert and store heat energy and later release it as kinetic energy from anywhere on your body. The release of kinetic energy won't hurt you... directly. If you release the force of a bomb from your hand, your hand will be fine, but if you hit a wall, you will be hurt by that.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Hotwheels

objects.text: You can utilize a sword, be it of Western or Eastern origin, to achieve flight while positioned on top of it. The maximum speed is determined by your body's abilities or capped at Mach 2.
objects.title: (Mover) Flying Sword

objects.text: You possess the power to warp the space between you and your destination to close the distance with a single step. The distance you can travel in a single step is determined by the length of your maximum sprinting distance; this ability allows you to swiftly transport yourself, avoiding the time otherwise required to travel by foot or any other means.
objects.title: (Mover) Warp Step

objects.text: You can create a paint-like substance from your hands that you can throw to cover an area. You can enter any paint mark created by your power and emerge from any other paint mark you have created. Any paint mark you create will degrade to the point of uselessness over several days, and using them will cause them to degrade significantly faster.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Inc Incorporated

objects.text: You can switch the location of any two people as long as the difference in mass is no larger than 50% of the larger of the two.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Position Control

objects.text: You can create a permanent pair of portals that bridges the gap between two points in space. The more accurate your knowledge of a location is, the quicker it is to make portals that connect to it, with locations you can directly perceive being instant. Your portals may be in any form you desire, but each may have up to a maximum surface area of 10m^2. There is a slight gap in the bridge between the portals that may cause a slight delay due to the need for them to perfectly sync with each other. Your portals must be created in empty space, though anything can go through them, and it is a two-way connection. You may have only one pair of portals active at a time, but you may destroy them at will.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Portal

objects.text: You can alter gravity's influence on your body to fly and launch yourself at high speeds. Anyone you touch can also have their gravity altered, although this stops once you stop touching them. You are immune to the fall damage you receive when colliding with something at high speeds.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Gravitational Shift

objects.text: Your speed escalates exponentially the longer you maintain your top velocity, allowing you to move faster with each passing second. To match your body’s incredible pace, your mind accelerates as well, ensuring perfect synchronization between thought and movement. However, this speed comes at a cost: your stamina depletes at the same rate your speed increases. The faster you go, the quicker you exhaust yourself.
objects.title: (Mover) Accelerate

objects.text:
You find your bodily movement and awareness heightened to a superhuman degree. Your proprioception and sense of every avenue of mobility result in a parahuman talent that allows you to move and traverse any environment, using it to your advantage. You intuitively adapt to obstacles with fluidity and continuity of movement, seamlessly transitioning from one type of movement to another, performing athletic feats at near-ludicrous speeds and reflexes. To maintain this, you gain a parahuman level of athleticism.

Your talent extends to any tool that facilitates movement, as you instinctively relate your movements to these tools. This includes conventional means of transportation (land, marine, and aerial vehicles, to name a few) as well as unusual rails, ropes, and anything else that assists your mobility.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Kinesiologist

objects.text:
You can make your body disappear a portion at a time, each reappearing somewhere else of your choosing within a 15-meter radius. The portions of your body can either float independent of anything else, or move as if they were still a part of you, such as an arm twirling 360 degrees in place before acting like it has proper leverage on a punch or grapple. Your sensory organs can also be shifted around using this power. Using both of your eyes, you could daisy chain them somewhere useful before teleporting one eye back to your body while using the other one to spy.

The speed at which your body’s portions can move depends on how fast you yourself could move, either floating or fixed to your ‘body’. You also gain a heightened sense of proprioception or body position and movement to help move each portion of your body independently.
objects.title: (Mover) Cheshire

addons.text: You gain a new aspect to your ability: a red line extends from yourself, automatically attaching to anyone you can see (or keep focus on, even if they move out of sight). The darker the line, the greater the danger they’re in; as it nears black, their risk of death increases. This only works on others, not yourself.
addons.title: Direction

objects.text:
As long as you have it in your line of sight - or are aware of it as a static element (like a building) - you can visualize an intangible tether perceptible only to you. This tether can connect any two objects, allowing you to mentally pull or push them in either direction, or even both at once. For example, you might push a gun out of a criminal’s hand to prevent them from grabbing it, yank yourself toward a building like a swinging rope, or pull two cars together to collide.

The mass, existing counter-acting momentum, and resistance of the objects you affect determine how much mental will you must exert, with the intended force acting as a multiplying factor. You could affect only one side of the tether so that it pushes away or pulls toward the other direction of the tether, though alternatively, you may affect both directions so that both objects pull together or push away like magnetic poles. You may instantly switch which two objects your tether connects to, and any object will retain the momentum of your exertion. If the tethered object exits your line of sight, you can continue using the tether as long as you don’t switch it.

You start with the capability to levitate a human body ten feet in the air by keeping them pushed away from the ground or restrain someone on the ceiling against gravity with manageable effort, enough that it would take a day of constant use before exhaustion sets in. More intense uses increase the strain, though you can train yourself to handle greater feats. Notably, moving your own body toward something requires no mental strain - only pulling something toward yourself does. Anything you carry by your own strength is also strain-free. This power physically adapts your body to prevent injury from these movements and grants a natural talent for maneuvering yourself like the iconic Spider-Man, so you won’t accidentally kill yourself using it.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Tether

objects.text:
You can teleport to anyone you can see, appearing within five meters of them and positioning yourself between them and the nearest enemy.

When you teleport, your durability increases based on three factors: how strong and close the nearest enemy is, how weak the person you teleported to is, and if the enemy is in the middle of an attack. This boost is strongest when the threat is highest, allowing you to shield the person teleported to effectively.

The durability boost fades if you move more than five meters away from the person you teleported to.
objects.title: (Mover/Brute) Castling

objects.text: Anywhere you've ever touched, or a part of your body larger than a cubic millimeter has touched, there will be a marker that you can teleport to. This does not allow you to travel to other universes, nor to other planets. You will not be able to teleport to it if there is no location within 2 meters of the marker that has enough open space for you.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Flying Raijin

objects.text: You have the ability to move faster the longer you are in motion. Your speed and thought speed effectively double every minute you move at your top speed. This is counted in real-time and not the time you perceive while under the effects of this power. You are protected and can choose to protect your surroundings from the effects of your increased speed.
objects.title: (Mover) Gear Shift

objects.text:
You have wings for every power in your possession, including ones that are gifted by others or temporary, but you can only use the wings of one power at a time. You don't need to have your wings out 24/7, as you can hide them. The maximum wingspan is slightly bigger than the size you would need if those wings needed to flap to give you flight. The base appearance of those wings can be that of any being that exists in your world, be it in reality or in fiction, but the biggest influence on their appearance is the powers they come from. Wings that come from a power that allows you to use multiple powers will have their appearance affected by the currently active powers.

Those wings help a power by offering utility or boosting its potency if it is unable to do the former. An example would be if you had the capacity to control fire but no ability to make it. You could have a pair of wings that are made of fire that can overlap, with the amount of fire increasing at a reasonable pace, allowing you to have a wing-shaped stockpile of flames to use. Another example would be a tinker power. Using Bonesaw as an example, your pair's wings could be made of metal and would have inside them surgical tools and long, thin robot arms to manipulate those tools, helping with self-surgery.

Depending on the Tinker's power, it may come with very basic tinkertech in its specialty, like tiny, plain drones from Remote Control. Tactile Telekinesis could give you a pair of invisible and intangible wings that apply your Tactile Telekinesis to whatever is touching it or inside it. Fairy Queen could give you a pair of wings for every shade, giving you the capacity to shoot needles made of black energy from them that kill any Parahumans and steal their powers, and aid or boost the power of the shades, depending on what they have.

The wings give you the capacity to fly 100mph at base, increasing depending on the power they come from and decreasing the less of your wings you have connected to you. If you were to detach the entirety of your wings from you to use for a power, like ferrokinesis, you would only regrow the wings if 5 minutes passed, upon which the iron can no longer be returned to its position, or if they were destroyed, upon which the destroyed material would be regenerated.
objects.title: (Mover/Trump) Winged One

objects.text: You can teleport anywhere in your line of sight, leaving behind a clone of yourself holding all of your powers besides Seeing Double when you teleport. These clones are under your control, an extension of yourself, as if they are part of a short-lived hive mind. These clones will crumble into dust after 30 seconds if they aren’t killed beforehand. Unlike a devilish bomber, you do not suffer mental degradation from this power.
objects.title: (Mover/Master) Seeing Double

addons.text:
You are Paper, your wings are Paper, and both Papers possess quite significant, synergistic abilities.

The force multiplier from your paper body now also applies to your wings, while your wings’ steel-strength durability and weightlessness weaves into your body. You go from mid-level Brute and Mover to someone who could give Alexandria a real tough time. Additionally, you can now turn into a Paper Airplane, a second level of Breaker state that your default paper Breaker state can access.

In this form, you integrate your body with your wings, folding into a paper airplane the size of a small car. Your frame can cut through the sky with near-unmatched durability and speed. Your movements are fluid and effortless, and you can easily adjust your trajectory and speed. You have no drag in this form, air resistance becoming a thing of the past as you accelerate faster and faster, moving so quickly that the human eye literally cannot track you. Your body also turns into a weapon thanks to the sharpness of the edges of your Paperform, letting you cut and pierce right through most things thanks to your durability.
addons.title: Paperform

addons.text:
Your feathers have taken on a different form, integrating themselves into your wings. Your paper wings now consist of a couple of hundred sheets of paper, each of them the ‘feathers’ that you once had to summon. These sheets are fully under your telekinetic control, letting them shift, scatter and reform at a thought, turning from mere flight enablers to a fluid, shapeshifting armament. Your wings are no longer bound to being on your back. Now, they can dissolve into a whorl of paper planes, solidify into sharp edges, or become entire structures - all in the blink of an eye.

Your ability to bind and unbind them from each other has also been enhanced. At a moment’s notice, you can crumple multitudes of them into hyper-dense constructs ranging from spears to barriers. The more of them there are in a single crumple, the more inertia the construct will possess.

You can imbue sheets of your paper into becoming sleek, autonomous entities that act according to your orders - nimble minions that can act independently outside of your range and follow pre-set instructions. Individually, they’re fast, evasive, and deadly. In unison, they could cut down a street of gangbangers in seconds. If a sheet is ever damaged, it doesn’t fall, either - it folds and creases itself, adapting like it were a particularly resilient cell. They can mend by absorbing nearby paper or by crumpling themselves with other sheets. When not needed, they return to form your paper wings once more.
addons.title: Manifolded Fleet

objects.text:
Your body can generate a pair of lightweight, incredibly durable wings that look like they were made from paper, with all the creases and folds that would require their form. These wings allow you to glide through the air and maneuver with incredible precision; you might not be able to fly immediately, but by god will it take a herculean effort to catch you on the ground before you get going.

Your wings aren’t rigid in form,  though as durable as steel, they share many of the same qualities of paper, such as the weight and flexibility. With simple little shifts in structure, you could optimize them for speed by flicking them into sharp ‘dart’ wings, maneuverability by spreading them wide into ‘branches’, or controlled descent by simply making them wider and more concave. They also absorb impacts incredibly well, taking force and distributing it across themselves.

Lastly, your weight shifts whenever you’re airborne. You weigh the same as normal when your feet are on the ground, but when both feet are off, you become as weightless as your wings, making you exceptionally difficult to ground until both feet touch a surface, at which point your weight returns. Naturally, killer dropkicks. With a strong enough leap, you could ride air currents indefinitely, carrying you across cities if you’re high enough. Your wings can also be used as both barrier and bladed implements when combat is required, needing you to simply change their forms to do so.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) On Paper Wings

objects.text:
Every second spent at your top speed will increase your top speed by 10 KPH, with every second below your top speed reducing it by the same amount until reaching your base running speed.

Initially you appear to have none of the usual protections against such a speed, but this only lasts until the moment you're about to receive an injury caused by your speed. Every time your speed would put you in some sort of danger, you develop a temporary power designed to nullify that danger. 

This could manifest as phasing through walls you didn't notice, strengthening your legs as you begin to exert more force than they can handle, or even weakening blows against yourself if you ran into an attack. 

This does functionally guarantee that you're able to maintain your top speed indefinitely with enough willpower, as you would gain a power to prevent yourself from being injured by overexertion.

These powers are solely designed to protect you from your own speed and tend to have less obvious offensive uses. On top of this, they aren't guaranteed to protect you from things unrelated to your speed. If you run into a Brute's punch headfirst, the power you get may defend you from the entire blow, but it's only required to defend you from the force you're exerting against the fist through your speed, not the force the punch would have if you were standing still.

You lose these temporary powers when you dip below the speed you got them at.
objects.title: (Mover/Trump) Can't Stop

objects.text: You can teleport to anywhere you can see. If you're a Noctis Cape, you can teleport to anywhere you've seen since getting your powers. You can teleport to other universes with this. You cannot use this power to co-inhabit the same space as another being; you will either teleport inside the being or right outside of it.
objects.title: (Mover) Blink!

objects.text:
You can intuitively "connect" with inorganic and organic beings of your choice, allowing you to exchange their current acceleration and velocity at your behest. For instance, you can go abnormally fast by linking yourself to a moving car or plane at the expense of making them immobile. You could abuse this to slow people down by linking them to objects in their rest state. Your mind and body gain the necessary physiology to react and adapt to the changing speeds. However, the longer you attempt to maintain it, the more likely you will suffer from mental and physical damage.

Note: Trying to attach yourself to photons in an attempt to move at light speed would only go horribly wrong, as your body would be rendered nearly massless, leaving your mind in a vegetative state.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) Speed Connect

addons.text:
Your ability has evolved twofold. First, alongside entering any virtual world, you can now enter any written world. The more famous the story, the more lifelike everything in there will be. A story only known by one person may not even be accessible to you, while something well-known across the world will be no different from the real world to you. To enter these worlds, you simply need to touch a book the story is written on, and you can exit from any version of this written work as long as it’s on the same planet as the one you entered.

Secondly, you can now bring things out of these worlds, including living people. The limitations of (Trump/Striker) Fictiportation still apply; the more powerful the item or person is, the more energy it drains from you. The more popular and widely known the item or person is, the easier it is to bring it out to the real world. You can bring out items or people that are depicted as being more powerful than PRT Rating 5, but they will be weakened to match your limit. They're capable of regaining their strength as your power grows.
addons.title: Book Worm

objects.text:
You gain the ability to enter virtual worlds. The way this works is simple: by touching a screen that has an active video playing on it, you can enter a simulated version of said video. From an outside perspective, you will look like you have entered the screen and can be seen interacting with the video from the screen itself. Inside the simulated world, you can interact with the people and environment as if they were all real, allowing you to alter the "plot" of the video. Certain events, such as timeskips, will not happen in the simulated world. 

You will be able to see a floating, nearly invisible screen inside the simulated world, one that only you can see. This screen will show the outside world. You can leave the simulated world by touching this screen. After you leave, the simulated world will slowly return to how it should be.

This is a localized event, so if you were to enter a streamed video, only your device would be affected and no one else. However, you can sense the other devices connected to that stream and are able to transfer yourself to them. Be warned: if your current device were to be deactivated and lose all signal, you would be trapped in the virtual world. This can be used offensively by trapping your enemies inside the virtual world.

You are unable to bring anything and/or anyone from the virtual world into the real world unless you have Homecoming, although they will still be restricted to a degree based on your Shard's ranking and energy.
objects.title: (Mover) Sadako

addons.text: You can now glide on gaseous surfaces as well as solids and liquids, granting you what is effectively flight - though this still excludes areas where there aren’t any surfaces to begin with, such as vacuums like the void of space, as well as primarily plasma-based surfaces.
addons.title: Skycrawler

addons.text: By increasing the size of limbs you’re using for Glide n’ Slide, you can not only increase the amount of speed they give proportionate to how much they are multiplied, but also increase your maximum speed by the increase in output on affected limbs.
addons.title: Upscaled

addons.text: You can now grab hold of and glide on more esoteric “surfaces”, such as plasma states of matter like flames and electricity, as well as, more importantly, power expressions; provided you can survive it, you could do things like ride on Blaster attacks or fly through field/aura-based Shaker effects, among other things.
addons.title: Ride the Lightning

objects.text:
You can glide on any solid or liquid surface your limbs are touching. Your maximum speed is 15mph for each limb you have on a surface, to an upper limit (without Negentropy) of about Mach 1.5 if you have an absurd amount of limbs, such as through a Changer power or biotinkering. Your gliding cannot handle sharp turns well at higher speeds, requiring you to either travel on curved surfaces or stop and reorient for anything sharper than turning corners when going at highway speeds or greater.

This power comes with a pair of secondary Brute abilities; one to help protect you from environmental factors, such as dust, smoke, debris and insects in the form of a weak full-body barrier whose durability scales with your current speed, and another in the form of increased resilience specifically in regards to high G-forces and sudden stops or turns.
objects.title: (Mover/Brute) Glide n’ Slide

objects.text:
You can accelerate your own flow of time, making it flow 100 times faster than the current flow of time around you, allowing you to move and act at 100 times the speed to an outside observer.
