However, this is not the same as super speed. It doesn't allow you to perform feats like punching at 100 times the force of a normal punch thanks to the speed increase, running up walls using inertia, or building momentum for extraordinary jumps.
objects.title: (Mover) Clock Up

objects.text:
You have the power of super speed! Although your powers are different from the norm, as your powers work off a form of kinetic energy absorption, which grants you your speed. When you run, your ability to absorb kinetic energy expands in scope and becomes stronger. Your average speed without absorption leaves you running at 200 mph, as well as your absorption being in a diameter of five meters and draining a tenth of the surrounding kinetic energy.

However, using absorbed kinetic energy will allow for an exponential increase in speed until the limit on both range and absorption rate is reached—this limit being one mile and all of the surrounding kinetic energy. At optimal kinetic absorption, the world around you will appear at a standstill. The absorption field around you will hold for 5 minutes once you stop moving at super speed and will quickly begin to peter out to zero thereafter.

Additionally, your ability to interact with the physical world is not hindered like Velocity; moreover, it is enhanced with the kinetic energy that you absorb! This allows you, when in your field or when moving at super speed, to have an approximation of super strength by way of transferring energy into what you touch to either move or damage it.

You have an array of secondary Thinker abilities that grant you the superhuman sensory input, perception, comprehension, as well as the enhanced spatial and situational awareness needed to use this ability to its fullest.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Kid Velocity

objects.text:
You have total control over your own momentum. You can stop or slow down on a dime, instantly change direction, convert a straight sprint into a rapid spin or vice versa, all with no unwanted loss of speed. You could even concentrate the entire momentum of your body in your fist (just be careful not to tear your arm off). 

That primarily limitation is that gaining speed still requires a source of propulsion. You can, however, redirect any force that acts on your body in a sustained way, such as harnessing gravity to imitate flight or pushing back against a shove with the same force that was exerted against you, though this doesn't let you move through solid objects and is potentially limited by your reaction time.

This comes with a perfect sense of balance and spatial orientation, as well as immunity to motion sickness. You also instantly acclimate to any G-force in a fraction of a second, though sudden impacts can still injure you.
objects.title: (Mover/Brute) Lurching Intruder

objects.text: You can move anywhere from average running speed to Mach 5. You have a Breaker rating stopping you from taking damage from running around, but the effect will break if you run into or attack something. If you're going too fast when you do this, you might instantly die.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Quicker than Thunder

objects.text: You emit a bodily energy field that pierces and slashes anything while moving at incredible speeds. Your speed is shy of breaking Mach 2, with your maneuverability and perception being evenly enhanced. You normally produce air rips and vorpal shockwaves while you move, with every appendage equal to cutting weapons, and so on.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Raze

objects.text:
Within a 100m radius, you can branch out your movement and/or actions by splitting one’s possible movement within your area, and taking one maneuver as the “real” move before and once it’s canceled. The magic happens when choosing to cancel or select another branch of movement, that is, turning a branch to a “real” one and vice versa, i.e., effectively overwriting a sprint to a clothesline as if it always was the plan, or immediately selecting your retreat branch as the “real” branch. 

This puts a strain on your body, however, as you can’t consecutively and indefinitely “branch out” and need to be on a stable “real” branch after 30s, only doing dozens to a couple of branches depending on your endurance. Doing consecutive “branches” under the time limit doesn’t hurt, luckily enough, only limited by what’s possibly available as a movement and action, nearing a hundred possibilities. 

These branches are still tangible and can act on an action or deed, their results and outcomes remaining regardless of collapsing the branch; this also implies you inherit your branches’ experiences or gains once you collapse them, while also receiving their injuries or fatigues, what have you, albeit balanced by your “real” state’s health or state of mind, if you're in good health, it’s halved by half i.e. doing a full routine on a “branch” while you rest on the “real” one, merging your "branch" you receive the branch’s gains, receiving half the strain and fatigue.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Move Cancel

objects.text:
You can manipulate space or time around you, but you must choose which one to control at any given moment. When you control space, you gain an aura that glows red, and when you control time, it glows blue. However, your range is limited to just a few inches from your skin.

While controlling space, you can manipulate objects and even redirect them in your small range. You can prevent attacks from ever reaching you by warping space itself or even teleporting short distances. When you teleport, you can instantly move to any location you can see within range, even if it's behind you or in a different direction. You can even alter the distance you travel in a single step, making each movement more efficient and extending it for a greater distance.

When controlling time, you can accelerate yourself or decelerate anyone or anything within range. For example, you can move faster than the eye can follow, or slow down the actions of opponents or projectiles. Time manipulation works in a way that you can affect anyone or anything within range for a short duration, even if they manage to escape your immediate reach. However, once your influence fades, their movements return to normal speed.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Asynchronous Spacetime

objects.text: You can teleport anywhere on the planet where no one is looking, as long as no one is looking at you. If someone is looking at you through Thinker powers, like Clairvoyant, your power still works, as they aren’t looking at you directly. You are aware of everywhere on the planet that no one is looking at. You can't teleport into contact with another living being either. If you try, you'll find yourself a couple of nanometers away.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) I am the Shadow

objects.text: You can move fast enough to be just shy of breaking the sound barrier, with a jumping ability proportional to your speed. Your agility, coordination, reaction speed, stamina, and durability are all boosted to make this survivable and allow you to move with the proportional grace of an Olympic athlete. This power is also supported by perfect traction, giving you the ability to make impossible turns and move on any surface, from the frictionless to the vertical, or even the inverted.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) Veloci…Raptor?

objects.text:
Once cloaked in darkness, you may transform into an intangible, fluid-like substance, merging seamlessly within the shadows. Within this form, you swim and dive through the darkness as effortlessly as a shark navigates the open ocean. Movement within this shadowy domain is an alien experience—less like swimming and more akin to floating weightlessly through the void.

This shadowy expanse—a pocket dimension sustained by your shard—exists as an otherworldly reflection of reality, directly tied to the shadows it originates from. The size and depth of this shadow sea mirror the dimensions of the casting shadow: the larger and darker the umbra, the more expansive and profound the realm becomes.

Skimming the surface of this stygian sea allows you to observe and eavesdrop on the physical world through the shadow's origin. Beneath this surface, however, the sea reveals its true mysteries—hidden fissures and caverns leading to other shadows across reality, connected to distant pockets of darkness. While submerged, you remain utterly undetectable, eluding powers designed to pierce through concealment.

Yet, this shadowy sanctuary is not without its limits. Your presence within any single shade is finite, forcing you to constantly move in shallower shadows or risk ejection if you linger too long. While deeper, darker shadows grant extended respite without disruption.

As you descend into the shadowy abyss, you'll find your perception of reality warping as the fabric of reality begins to twist and distort. Near the surface, the effects are subtle, with only minor disruptions to time and space. But the deeper you venture, the more profound the distortion becomes. Distant locations may take less or more time than reason would logically dictate.

This dissonance creates a surreal, dreamlike journey through the shadow's unfathomable depths, where the boundaries of reality blur and yield to your passage.
objects.title: (Mover/Stranger) Shadow Diver

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to create a hundred diamond-shaped “feathers” per minute, manifesting up to a maximum of five hundred at once. You have complete telekinetic control over these feathers and infinite multitasking while doing so.

You can also bind and unbind the feathers to each other to exponentially strengthen them, or to yourself to grant you flight. Individually, each feather's speed, strength, and durability are slightly less than those of an average human, which increases to a durability capable of taking punches from Alexandria and a speed and strength comparable to a bullet train when all of them are bound together.
objects.title: (Mover/Master) Let The Feathers Fly

objects.text:
You can fly at a speed just short of the sound barrier. You can instantly accelerate from a standing start to any speed up to your limit.

This power comes with a Breaker field that prevents you from being affected by environmental factors, such as dust, smoke, insects, debris, and cold. Your field affects your body and extends to 10 centimeters, keeping temperatures comfortable inside and unwanted debris out. Your field also filters the air to give you breathable air in low-oxygen environments, preventing airborne diseases and aerosol compounds from affecting you.

You also have a minor Brute power in the form of increased resilience, specifically regarding high G-forces and sudden stops or turns. You also don't get motion sickness.

You have a secondary Thinker ability to perceive and navigate your surroundings at high speeds, detect obstacles, and predict your enemies' movements.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) I Believe I Can Fly

objects.text: You can open portals to anywhere your friends are, no matter the distance, no matter the universe. This is the only power that will allow you to return to your home universe completely unassisted. Family you're close to are also considered friends by this power. Your portals have to be within 5 meters of the person you wish to teleport to, and can't be opened inside of them (unless they have any holes in their body big enough for you to enter; in which case, you can open your portals inside of those.)
objects.title: (Mover) Raven

objects.text:
You are capable of teleporting yourself and/or anything you’re touching to the same place in another known dimension.

You cannot teleport into an occupied location. You instinctively know if attempting a teleport will take you to a place that is guaranteed to kill you (dangerous/no atmosphere, heavy radiation, into lava, etc.), although you do not know what the danger is.

You can preview any position you can teleport to with this power, so long as it is in a known dimension.

A dimension becomes known if you either have been there or viewed it directly through some form of Thinker power.

You can also blindly teleport to an unknown dimension that is “adjacent” to the current dimension you are in.

For the purposes of blind teleporting, there are two adjacent dimensions to every dimension for this power, forming a chain that contains every dimension in the multiverse not locked off by the entities (so blind jumping will never land you in Shardspace).

After blind teleporting, you will be unable to teleport using this power for a minute.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Dimensional Shunter

objects.text:
You can create fragile and near-invisible strings within your immediate surroundings at a rate of one string per second, which alert you when they’re broken. These will merge into stronger and thicker strings if they come into contact with each other once broken by someone. 10 strings would become as strong and persistent as spider silk when broken by a hand, while 100 strings would merge to become as strong as steel, though they’d become clearly visible in such quantities.

Your body cannot interact with these strings except to summon or dismiss them, meaning you could walk through hundreds of them without any of them breaking or moving.

They’ll remain for a day once created, then decay into nothing.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Spider's Web

objects.text: Anyone within 300 meters of you will glow any color you want. They can even be seen through walls or if they're invisible. All parts of this power are toggleable, and you can lower your range however you want. You can decide if others can see the glow, or if you only want specific people to see it.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Target Acquired

addons.text: When releasing the air concealing your weapon, the wind surge will propel any debris orbiting it forwards at high speeds.
addons.title: Debris Burst

objects.text: Your power collects broken material and amalgamates it around the object you’re holding. It’s fairly indiscriminate as it flies toward you, but you can slightly manipulate the path these objects take. The objects that gather around your held object will also not feel heavier for you.
objects.title: (Shaker) Ruckus

objects.text: You can project a portal to a pocket dimension with seemingly infinite space in it. You will always know what's in the pocket universe, and you will always be able to retrieve what you want from it. The opening of the portal will increase in size when you try to insert something larger than the hole itself. The pocket dimension can hold all the water in the world, but it would take many lifetimes. You can telepathically order the portal to shoot something out at 60 miles per hour or less.
objects.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Bag of Holding

objects.text: Within a moderate area around you, you can produce sound and light to create audiovisual and olfactory illusions. These illusions cannot be loud or bright enough to damage an average person's sight or hearing, but aside from that, there is no limit to the complexity of the illusions you can make.
objects.title: (Shaker) Room Temperature Mirage

objects.text:
You have absolute control of all sound within 100 feet of yourself, or about 30 meters. You cannot create sound using this power, including pure amplification, but you can absorb it for later use. 

This means you can redistribute energy, but you cannot add more through this ability alone. You can absorb enough sound to equal the energy in a large thermonuclear warhead, but since you can only absorb energy from sound, you'd need millennia to absorb that much without the help of a Tinker.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Orchestra

objects.text:
In a 1-kilometer radius around you nobody can fly.

This affects not only parahumans but also mundane forms of flight like helicopters, planes, and drones, this even affects tinker-tech based flight.

This does not affect you.

You can turn this off at will.

This power can't affect Endbringers or Scion.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) You Can’t Touch The Sky

objects.text: You can turn any mirrors within LOS into portals, allowing traversal between them. Additionally, your portals are less constrained by normal physics, allowing you to do things like shrink those who enter them, or even have people come out days later while having felt like only a few seconds to them. When a portal exits your vision, it shatters.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Dimensional Mirrors

objects.text: You exude an Aura of repair and stability, capable of restoring mundane objects to their full abilities and maintaining Tinker-tech in a stable state. The effect is strongest when the objects are in proximity to you, and it reaches its full strength when touching the skin. The rate of repair depends on complexity and volume; the more complex or large the object, the longer it takes to repair. Although this ability cannot repair Tinker-tech, it ensures that non-destructive components of Tinker-tech do not require maintenance.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Mechanicus Aura

objects.text: You can project an inviolable barrier that is, at most, 3 meters in radius. You need to take down the barrier if you want to move out of the radius of the barrier. There doesn't need to be a delay between taking down a barrier and putting another up, so if you have perfect timing you can technically move at your maximum speed with the forcefield up.
objects.title: (Shaker) Forcefield

objects.text:
You are able to share your emotions with those in your immediate vicinity, causing them to experience the same feelings as you do. By radiating your emotions, you can impart happiness, sadness, anger, or any emotion you are experiencing to those around you. As long as you are confident, you can share that confidence with others. As long as you feel motivated, you can make others feel motivated. If you feel bone crushing despair, you can cause others to suffer the same fate.

You also have a heightened awareness and control over your own emotions. While you can’t make yourself suddenly mad with rage, you can still be angry at will, same with any other emotions. You can, at will, fall into any specific emotion you currently feel, making it spiral and grow rapidly.

Few powers are able to resist this, as even Alexandria would be affected.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Shared Emotions

objects.text: You can project an aura that causes anyone within 100 feet to feel awe and admiration of you. If they have a reason to feel afraid of you, they will instead be intimidated.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Influencer

objects.text:
You can conjure a chill that permeates the environment. Although the ambient temperature remains unchanged, any living being within its reach will instinctively feel a creeping cold, as if the warmth is being drawn from their very bones.

This chill is not merely a psychological effect; it reaches deeper, subtly influencing the body’s natural functions. Blood begins to flow more sluggishly, as if responding to a sudden drop in temperature. Muscles start to tighten and cramp, making movement more laborious and leaving those affected feeling unnaturally fatigued.
objects.title: (Shaker) Unbearable Chill

objects.text:
You have the unique ability to generate a thick and dense fog in your surroundings. The radius of the mist gradually expands as you remain inside it, growing up to a 300-meter radius. Your presence within the mist is virtually undetectable, with only the strongest sensory abilities capable of piercing through it. You possess the remarkable ability to see perfectly through the fog, and you are even granted a strong increase in speed while inside.

One of the unusual effects of the fog is that it emits a strange aura of obliviousness where people are unable to notice it until they are deeply engulfed. Those trapped inside the mist suffer from a lack of direction and gradual stamina drain. The strength of these effects increases as the night progresses and peaks at midnight, creating a surreal and disorienting environment.
objects.title: (Shaker/Stranger) The Mist of London Night

objects.text: You possess the ability to create thin but durable steel-like wires from your skin which can be telekinetically controlled, although the more you control at once, the worse your fine control, though a multitasking power would negate this drawback. With experience, this thread can even be formed into rudimentary constructs such as walls or blades.
objects.title: (Shaker) Razorwire

objects.text:
You can inscribe a mark onto an object or surface, anchoring a protective field around it. At its base strength, the mark projects a 10-meter radius zone of influence, though the radius can be expanded with greater time, focus, and effort during its creation.

Within this zone, nothing, whether living, dead, or otherwise, can enter if it carries hostile, malicious, or harmful intent toward anyone inside. The field works on both physical and psychological levels. It does not repel with violence or alarms; instead, it simply unravels the desire to approach. Intruders find themselves hesitating, turning back, or losing track of why they wanted to get close in the first place. In some, the thought of entering the space may provoke unease, confusion, or sudden distraction. For others, it’s like the place doesn’t even exist—an unnoticed gap in perception.

If a being with insidious intent is already inside the ward when it’s activated, their harmful thoughts are dulled, pushed to the background of their mind, as if their aggression is muffled beneath a heavy weight. Rage becomes apathy, malice becomes confusion.

The mark is immobile once placed, and its strength depends on how carefully it was made.
objects.title: (Shaker) Warding

objects.text:
The more people genuinely believe you are new, untrained, or unfamiliar with a particular topic, skill, or field, the more power you draw from the phenomenon of “beginner’s luck.”

Your advantage manifests in subtle, layered ways. Mishaps that should trip you up instead slip past you. Opportunities that should statistically pass you by instead seem to land effortlessly in your lap. People cut you slack without realizing it. They instinctively excuse your failures, assume your missteps are harmless, and lower their guard around you. Systems and processes that should punish you instead soften, their consequences dulling when aimed your way. Training phases accelerate unnaturally for you, your learning curve steepening as your body and mind adapt with unusual speed. Tools, equipment, and situations that should resist or fail instead work smoothly in your hands, as if chance itself has quietly chosen your side.

This power hinges entirely on perception. People’s belief in your inexperience actively fuels this power. If those around you think you don’t know what you’re doing—even if you’re faking—you gain the full benefit. The less competent they perceive you to be, the more heavily the odds tilt in your favor. You can be an expert in secret, but as long as those around you still see you as a rookie, the effect remains in full force. The moment your cover is blown—when people genuinely believe you’re experienced—you lose the beginner’s edge, and the strange force that once protected you vanishes.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Level 1 Crook

objects.text:
By rubbing two nonliving surfaces together, you can cause them to gradually exchange physical properties in a guided manner. For example, if you rub a magnet with a shard of glass, you could cause the glass to temporarily become magnetic, but at the cost of the magnet itself becoming less so for the same duration.

Properties are exchanged in a manner similar to heat, so that if there is a cold object (surface lacking property) and a hot object (surface with property) they will eventually equalize (both having 50% of property) given enough time, with the rate of exchange proportional to the contact area.

The effect generally lasts about five additional seconds for every one second of rubbing, but if a property is continuously maintained then it may become permanent over long periods of time.
objects.title: (Shaker) Rub A Dub Dub

objects.text: You can imbue an All-or-Nothing effect into 1000 feet of your surroundings rendering it completely impossible to alter or affect. It's immune to everything you do to it barring Sting or Stilling. This doesn't affect anything small enough to be handheld, while things like cars still work, you can’t move or damage it if it isn’t consistent for a car.
objects.title: (Shaker) Collateral

objects.text: You are able to create a field with a radius of 50 meters that causes all lifeforms within it to quickly lose aggressive tendencies or hostile intentions, at the same giving a slight compulsion that makes people outside go away from your field.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Peace Zone

objects.text: Whenever you make an attack with your body, you can make a mirror image of you repeating the same move. This afterimage is half as strong as you, and dissipates after a second.
objects.title: (Shaker) Afterimage

objects.text:
You gain the ability to, with a snap of your fingers, induce an overwhelming sensation in everyone within a block radius as if they have consumed the world's spiciest chili. 

This sensation persists for five minutes, and any attempts to alleviate it inadvertently escalate the discomfort to unbearable levels, potentially extending its effects up to 24 hours.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Spicy Snap

addons.text:
In combination with your ability to amplify gravity, your gravity wells have mutated and gained a more offensive twist.

When creating your gravity wells, you may optionally choose to amplify their gravitational pull, turning them into black holes, although unless you will it, they cannot grow by consuming matter. When creating a black hole, you can choose its size, although your Shard (if you have one) has instituted a soft cap of a few meters in radius. You retain the ability to selectively make yourself or others immune to the gravitational pull of your black holes.
addons.title: Schwarzschild

objects.text: Within 250 feet around you, you can create points where Gravity centers. Launching anything or anyone nearby towards that point. You can choose to make yourself or certain targets in your range immune to the effects of your Gravity Wells.
objects.title: (Shaker) Gravity Well

addons.text: Your Force Constructs all have a built-in scrying orb, allowing for them to perceive the world around them just as you do. At any time, you may focus on a particular Force Construct, perceiving the world around it as if you yourself are there with all of your senses.
addons.title: Built-In Orb

objects.text: You can create malleable Force Constructs that you can manipulate at will. You may move, reshape, and destroy them whenever you desire, but creating them requires up to a minute of focus. You can have any amount of them present at one time, but the maximum surface area a single Force Construct can have is 10m^2 and their density is that of water. If you choose to create a Force Construct smaller than the maximum, it takes proportionally less time to create. Any impact stronger than a bullet shot from a pistol will shatter it, and the maximum force it can exert is based on your own strength. You gain a tactile sensation of what your Force Constructs touch, but have no other innate senses. While not invisible, they are very faint and hard to see, being highly transparent and lacking specific color.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Force Construct

objects.text: You can slowly manipulate electromagnetic fields, allowing you to warp the surroundings in anomalous ways. This would allow you to levitate objects, induce electric currents, or even create illusions. There is a somatic component to this power, requiring that you gradually bend and layer electromagnetic fields with your bare hands. This grants advanced knowledge of electromagnetism, as well as a basic electromagnetic sense with which you may perceive the world. Due to your manipulation's slow and somatic nature, this power is not feasible for fast-paced combat.
objects.title: (Shaker) Electromagnetic Warping

objects.text:
Within 100m², you can cage any living thing, putting them in place in unseen bear-trap constructs enveloping them like a <s>springlock</s> iron maiden suit. It’s especially constricting around their vulnerable areas, with the victims particularly aware of the plight, feeling as if spikes and toothpicks are almost piercing their skin. This immobilizes them at that last minute before they weren’t close to you.

Testing their luck by trying to move will crush and impale them, and once one is set off, the rest will follow… in a slow and steady pace. Quite a horrible way to die.
objects.title: (Shaker) Beartrap

objects.text: You are able to create a field with a radius of 100 feet where any living organisms you choose are attacked by small physical projections every 10 seconds. You are able to control the rough shape of the projections, choosing whether they are blunt or sharp, for example. The projections are able to hit with enough force to easily break bones. The projections disappear after impact. You can dismiss this field at will.
objects.title: (Shaker) Area of Attack

objects.text: You can create floating opaque spheres in the surrounding area. Anything that touches a sphere causes it to explode with the force of a grenade. You can fill a 30-foot radius in 10 seconds, packed at a distance of 4 per sq. yard.
objects.title: (Shaker) Minefield

addons.text: Your powers of personal storage and item generation have interacted in a rather useful manner. When Loot Drop activates, the spawned loot will instantly be collected within your personal storage space. This allows for rapid collection of items as they are created, preventing the necessary hassle of manually gathering the earned loot.
addons.title: Auto-Loot

objects.text:
When you take down an opponent, they drop loot based on their strength. Beating regular people usually gives you basic items like money, tools, or jewelry, depending on their status. Stronger or more skilled individuals might drop better things, like advanced weapons or rare materials. Parahumans drop the best loot, often related to their powers, such as unique gear that can boost your own abilities. If you choose to kill instead of just incapacitating them, the loot increases in quality or quantity by a single magnitude.

Repeatedly targeting the same individual within a short timeframe results in diminishing returns, as the quantity/quality of the loot decreases.
objects.title: (Shaker) Loot Drop

addons.text: Time stopping is awesome! But now you have an extra little ability you can use instead of time stop: You can skip time for 5 seconds. Within this skipped time, everyone will still take their predetermined actions, but they won't remember what happened in the skipped time once it's over. Same limitations as before, can only be done every 60 seconds.
addons.title: Kingu Kurimuzon!

objects.text:
You can stop time, halt the forward motion towards the end of all things, for exactly 5 seconds, and you  can do it again after 60 seconds. Within these 5 seconds, you can move, stab, shoot, jump, even interact with a phone normally!

 Anything that is in contact with you will join your stopped time for as long they stay in contact. Yes, including people and uninvited guests. If you throw something, it will move a few meters, but it will still carry it's forward motion for when time resumes once more.

Now you can achieve the greatest feat of them all: putting people back down the stairs.
objects.title: (Shaker) Spell Card: Za Warudo!

objects.text: You emit a field that enhances someone’s pain receptors ranging in an area of 50m²: a paper cut feels as if they’ve been slashed by a sword, a mere touch causes discomfort, and any movement provokes a stab of pain of false alarms to their body, resulting on sensory overload or burning out the nervous system or parts of the brain if done constantly (Regent, anyone?). Similarly, your pain is magnified with the highlight of automatically transferring any amped-up painful sensation to anyone in your area mitigating any remaining pang or ache; the more crowded the field, the less pain you feel on account of uniformly diffusing across the crowd.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Agony Exhibition

objects.text:
You can generate a gas that induces uncontrollable, involuntary laughter in anyone who inhales it. This is a deep, violent, full-body laughter that hijacks the mind and refuses to let go. Once inhaled, the gas immediately interferes with the subject’s brain chemistry, flooding it with an overwhelming surge of dopamine, serotonin, and other euphoric compounds. The effect is instantaneous and self-perpetuating: as soon as the subject finds anything remotely funny—even a passing thought—their laugher continues and grows. And under the influence of the gas, everything becomes funny.

It doesn’t matter how grim or neutral a situation is; to the affected, it’s all hilarious. Their sense of judgment is chemically compromised, bent and warped until even the act of laughing itself feeds the cycle. They laugh until they can’t breathe, through cracked ribs, spasms and tremors, their lungs fighting for air even as their faces split into rictus grins. The longer they remain in the gas, the worse it gets. Cognitive function deteriorates rapidly, pain is reinterpreted as humor, and panic is dismissed as absurdity. Some claw at their own throats trying to breathe, still laughing. Others collapse, eyes wide with manic glee, locked in terminal hysterics.

Exposure can lead to suffocation, internal damage, ruptured vessels, and in extreme cases, death from sheer neurological and respiratory exhaustion. Even a brief exposure—a single breath or passing whiff—is enough to seed the effect deep into the body. Once inside, it lingers for days, embedded in the bloodstream and brain chemistry. During that time, the individual must do everything in their power not to laugh, even once. A single giggle, a single slip into humor, even an accidental smirk at the wrong moment can reignite the effect, spiraling them back into lethal hysterics.
objects.title: (Shaker) Why So Serious?

addons.text: Wither now extends through any sand under your active control to a degree, each grain carrying your accelerated decay into whatever it contacts. However, this increased effectiveness only applies to geological materials or objects originating from geological materials; grinding dirt, stone, concrete, iron, steel and more down into fine particulate at rates that scale exponentially with the volume present. A handful reduces rock in minutes, a bucketful chews through iron, and a roomful sweeps steadily outward through most geological material like a beige - and eventually, partially iron - tide. Every material eroded becomes more sand, increasing the amount of sand under your control, amplifying the effect of the erosion, creating more sand to contact more material to erode, so on and so forth until you cannot fit more sand in your radius and are forced to simply shove it out.
addons.title: Desertification

objects.text:
You control all sand within a 25-meter radius as a single, cohesive mass, directing it with broad commands like waves, walls, or engulfing clouds rather than micromanaging individual grains. A vague tactile sense extends through any sand you're actively controlling, letting you feel shapes, movements, and textures pressed against it, though this feedback remains blurry and impressionistic rather than precise. 

Your power scales exponentially with volume; a handful of sand is sluggish and difficult to move with any force, but a bucketful becomes responsive, a roomful becomes an extension of your will, and at maximum saturation you can compress drifting grains into dense, temporary sandstone hard enough to crush steel or support collapsing structures.
objects.title: (Shaker) Sandstorm

objects.text:
You can exude an aura that heals others in a 10-meter radius around yourself.

Within this area of effect, vitality is refreshed, pain is relieved, open wounds visibly close, and infections are eliminated. Bones will even set properly given enough time in your aura. The more serious the injury, the more difficult it is, and longer it takes to heal.

You can, with enough focus, exempt individuals from this effect.
objects.title: (Shaker) Healing Circle

objects.text:
Your body can, at will, exude chemicals that can expand up to 30 meters before degrading and have various effects upon entering the body. 

At first, it will soothe and nullify all aggressive feelings and place the affected in a state of relaxation akin to light sleep, resisting it is possible although it is deceptively capable of affecting even high-tier brutes. In addition, it will start giving an increasing healing factor and immune system, and can even heal psychological damages with time.

Most importantly, after some time depending on the resilience of the affected, it will make them more and more susceptible to whatever you say, akin to a hypnotic state. After the effects have completely cleared the affected will think that these thoughts are their own, and even thinkers can be affected with enough time.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Aromatherapy

objects.text: You can cause any non-static phenomena, including your other powers, to instantly and rapidly flare in both size, power, and intensity. This includes causing a lighter to flare into a flamethrower that can melt steel and breathing with enough force to break bones. You can flare any amount of phenomena at once but any more than 10 and the effect is weakened enough as to be functionally useless. Flares last up to a maximum of ten seconds, after which the phenomena reverts to it’s original intensity. This does not apply to any byproducts caused by the flare such as fire spreading.
objects.title: (Shaker) Flare

objects.text: You can cause people to hallucinate by manipulating their five senses. You can make them feel as if they are burning alive, being torn to pieces, or being impaled over the course of days while only seconds have actually passed. While extremely versatile these illusions use your own experiences and feelings to make them, thus an illusion of being impaled would not feel as real, painful, or terrifying if you did not experience something similar yourself. Be careful not to go insane in an attempt to master your power.
objects.title: (Shaker) Illusion Master

objects.text: You prevent anyone who can perceive you to be unable to directly aim at you. Even sharpshooters and firing squads a few meters away from you can neither pinpoint nor adjust their sights to accurately shoot you, their arms wavering or you are fortuitously out of focus. This includes powers or weapons.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Stormtrooper Aim

objects.text:
You have the power to control the speed of anything within a 15-meter radius. The power’s potency is proportional to how close it is to you e.g. an object’s speed 1 ft away from you can be adjusted by any percentage between 10% to 1000%, and an object 9 ft away is a mere 90% to 200%. Unfortunately, you can’t go below 0.001% and above 1,000,000%, and being Manton Limited you cannot apply this to yourself.

(Note: This is not precisely at a foot. For example, a meter can slow a target down to 3.2% of its speed.)
objects.title: (Shaker) Speed Zone

objects.text:
You have the ability to manipulate the very concept of spontaneity, allowing you to bypass the usual constraints of time and process when creating. As long as you have the necessary materials at your disposal, you can conjure whatever you desire instantly. However, you cannot create conventional objects in this way. Instead, what you create is a spontaneous manifestation, an immediate, raw effect.

For example, with the right components on hand, you could instantly cause a targeted explosion, trigger a powerful healing effect, or summon a projection in a blink of an eye. There’s no delay, no assembly required—your creations simply appear the moment your will and materials align.

However, the complexity of the desired effect determines the quality of materials you’ll need. Simpler creations, like a basic explosion or a minor healing burst, may require only common or low-grade components. But for more intricate manifestations, such as a highly targeted healing or a long-lasting summoned projection, the materials must be rare, high-quality, and specifically suited to the effect. The greater the complexity and potency of what you're trying to produce, the more precise and valuable the resources must be to fuel that creation.

(If you have tinker powers, then you cannot use this power to instantly create tinkertech.)
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Spontaneous

objects.text: You are a medium-range biokinetic. You are able to telekinetically move the bodies of any organism in their range, including yourself.
objects.title: (Shaker) Bio-telekinesis

addons.text: Any limb you sprout will be considered a duplicate, enhancing the strength and capabilities of the original limb as well as any other duplicate you sprout.
addons.title: To Be Many

objects.text: You are able to replicate and sprout pieces of your body from the surface of any object or living thing. You can manipulate said body parts remotely, as if they were extensions of your own original limbs. Note that you will feel any injury or strain these body parts feel, as well as that each replicated appendage is no different from that of your actual corresponding limbs, meaning they reflect your own physical strength. The body parts are also bound to the surface they sprout from and cannot move from their spot. You also need to be able to see the object or what it looks like for them to effectively sprout your limbs on them.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Multi-limbs

objects.text:
You gain the ability to, with a snap of your fingers, alter everything around you temporarily within a block radius. You also have a stage you can call with a snap of your finger based on a certain power. You have 9 SP to spend on a fixed stage. You can only use these powers in the stage you set and they will be enhanced. For example, a Striker power can be applied to anyone within your stage and if the power is based on blood the area around you will be full of blood. You cannot take Tinker, Thinker, or Master powers with this power.

However, other Parahumans inside your stage with similar powers to your current stage also gain a similar buff. But if their power is the opposite, they instead become weaker. The stage follows you as you move.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Stage Change

objects.text:
You emit transparent, colorless, and odorless gas from your body capable of subverting any microorganism and bringing it into your control, likewise stretching this internally to any lounging microbiota in your body through your immune system acting more much as a container/reprogrammer just as a defender. 

Within it, you control and spread any subverted bacteria, archaea, viruses, and fungi through your invisible fog, infecting anybody with a vague awareness of their biology that is merely focused on infectivity, severity, and lethality. 

These factors will increase (or decrease) depending your emphasis: transmission vectors, symptomatic diagnosis, and abilities ranging from medical or environmental tolerance to rapid adaptation against genome sequencing, etc. Every infected is linked to your power, yet the more it transmits the less control you hold over the outbreak.
objects.title: (Shaker/Changer) Outbreak

objects.text:
No matter what you do, your actions are always non-lethal. You could shoot someone in the head, throw them out of an airplane, break their neck, or even detonate an explosion around them, yet somehow, they will survive—injured, perhaps, but never fatally. Whether through your powers, external forces, or sheer physics, death simply does not follow in your wake.

Even if logic dictates otherwise, your attacks, traps, and environmental hazards will never result in a fatality. Wounds will be severe enough to incapacitate but never critical. Falling debris will always land just off-center, explosions will throw rather than tear apart, and even point-blank headshots will result in unconsciousness rather than death. Any scenario where you would otherwise be responsible for someone’s demise is subtly altered, ensuring that no one perishes by your hand.

You can disable the effect at will to finish them.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Heroes Don't Kill

addons.text:
Building on your ability to dissipate effects, you can now continually disperse them beyond your usual radius, spreading them out until they are effectively reduced to nothingness. Previously overwhelming forces become doable as they are diffused across an unbounded volume.

Furthermore, you can adjust the distribution of dissipated effects within your range. Rather than diffusing them uniformly, you can channel them into specific people, objects or areas, including yourself. For example, a healing power could be spread out to aid your entire group while the kinetic energy of an enemy’s punch could be divided across multiple foes.
addons.title: Redistribution

objects.text:
You can dissipate any energy, effect or phenomenon within a 20-metre radius of yourself by evenly distributing it throughout that entire volume.

This significantly reduces the local intensity of incoming effects, allowing you to experience only a tiny fraction of the original. For example, the kinetic energy of a punch would be dispersed across all the matter within your range, diffusing it down to miniscule levels and leaving you unharmed.

A blaster power might have its projectiles’ momentum spread out the instant it enters your radius, greatly diminishing its speed and force. Similarly, the thermal energy of a normal flamethrower would be reduced to the point of barely warming you up and a taser would be made virtually harmless.

This power activates automatically in response to any harmful force that enters your radius, but you can also trigger it manually for other phenomena. You have fine control, allowing you to selectively choose which effects to dissipate and which to leave untouched with a thought.

However, if the incoming effect is powerful enough or requires only tiny amounts, you can still be harmed. A huge explosion may retain enough energy after dissipation to cause serious injury while an extremely potent nerve gas might still poison you.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) Dissipate

objects.text:
This power allows you to place a single marker located wherever you're standing, with the marker glowing and visible to anyone. You may remove and reapply the marker at any time, but the effect will reset itself and must be done all over again. Starting at a radius of 10 meters around the marker, the area will slowly expand at a rate of 5 meters per hour up to a maximum of 1 kilometer, and cannot be seen by others. You are always aware of the size of the area down to the centimeter. The closer the area gets to its maximum, the brighter the marker becomes.

Based on how close you are to the marker (using the closest multiple of 5) compared to the current size of your area's radius, your strength and durability will be multiplied. The larger the area, the better the enhancement can be. For example, having a 20-meter radius and being within 5 meters of your marker will increase your strength and durability fourfold. Having a 100-meter radius and being within 5 meters of the marker will multiply it by 20 instead. Having the full kilometer and being 100 meters away from the marker would multiply it by 10, and so on.

Leaving the area entirely will not affect the marker; you simply won't be affected by this power until you re-enter the area.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) No Place Like Home

objects.text:
Just as in those schlocky action films or sappy romantic comedies, it appears that everyone around you holds a tone of melodrama or embellishment to anything they do or act, behaving as if they were actors in a film, with higher dramatics, editing shots, and special effects to accompany it. 

For example, getting closer to a gang-related skirmish about to blow off transforms it into a standoff with the tension, violence, and bombast of Tarantino films, or getting closer to a dinner date turns it into a Richard Curtis’ heartfelt declaration of love. The scene before you always leaves you out of shot, only a spectator, always able to be outside others’ sights while your show goes on. 

Being tempted to be the star of the show, however, will have several benefits: many advantages such as increased combat ability in action scenes, social acumen or wit in humor or dramatic scene, to acrobatic talent or parkour skills on a chase will show themselves whenever you need it, while the scene around you will lean to your advantage at every opportunity. For example, cops will be sluggish or clumsy when they reasonably shouldn't be under a chase scene. Once out of active sight or involvement, then you’ll turn into another face in the crowd.

You can switch this on whenever you like, wherever you are, becoming part of the scene, and depending on the number of people or the distance between people, you can turn an apartment floor of 200m² into 5 city blocks, being around 400m².
objects.title: (Shaker/Stranger) Cinema Flair

objects.text: Within 10 meters of yourself, your enemies will be automatically "hit" by you. You aren't attacking yourself, your attacks are simply landing already without having to do a thing. If you have nothing in your hands, your enemy will be constantly punched where you would punch, at the rate you can currently punch. If you have a knife though, then you automatically stab them instead. Beyond the damage itself, no evidence of the attack are left behind, so no bullets will be lodged in someone, or a casing on the ground.
objects.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Kill Aura

objects.text:
You can summon and control very powerful tentacles from the ground around you. You can summon tentacles within 20 meters of yourself, and control them within 300 meters. If they remain out of your control for too long, they will begin to starve.

By default, the tentacles look like those of an octopus, but you can change that as long as it's biologically feasible.

If you do it in the water, you can summon and control a Kraken, but only one at a time. The Kraken can sustain itself with food if not in your range, and acts similar to an octopus.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Tentacles

objects.text: You have a Shaker ability with a city-wide effect, capable of causing a sudden and severe loss of comprehension among those in its range. Those affected find themselves unable to make sense of the things around them, whether it be the language spoken by others, the written words on a page, or even body language. This power covers every aspect of communication, and it affects everyone in proximity, except for those you choose.
objects.title: (Shaker) Babel

objects.text: You can read and apply effects based on the intent of others within a 250-foot area around you. Hostile intent against you or someone in your range can feel incapable of violence. Meanwhile, people with the intent of sabotage can find themselves failing with simple instructions.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Judgment

objects.text: You can fill an area with knockout gas, quickly or slowly sedating people who inhale it within your 10 ft radius, which you entirely fill within seconds. Moreover, there are no risks of permanent damage or death from inhaling the gas.
objects.title: (Shaker) Hotbox

objects.text: You possess the ability to create fields of instability, where reality becomes unpredictable within limited areas. You can generate up to five active fields at a time, with each field having a maximum width of 10 meters and not extending beyond 100 meters from you. Within these defined spaces, the environment, objects, and individuals may undergo unforeseen transformations and fluctuations due to the inherent instability of reality.
objects.title: (Shaker) Bedlam

objects.text:
At will, you may dramatically accelerate the decline of all personal resources—without any additional benefits—in a 50-meter radius. Personal resources, in this case, means things like the internal energy and fat stores of living beings.

This causes everyone except the user to rapidly burn through their available resources, collapsing due to dehydration or lack of energy. In the case of prahumans who utilize internal energies of some kind, this also accelerates the decline of those energies as well.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Starvation

objects.text:
By motioning to a wall, you can generate red doorways onto it. The rooms coming from these doors do not apply to the actual geometry of the building, being individual pocket dimensions.

These rooms are stocked as a typical room within the building the door would be made. If produced inside a house, for instance, it might create a second living room or another seemingly lived-in bedroom. In an office, however, it might produce a breakroom or set of cubicles. These rooms are empty but for the inanimate objects you’d be likely to find in them. Similarly, the rooms match the state of the building, with ruined buildings also producing ruined appearing rooms.

Red Rooms can be created off the walls of other Red Rooms, and if done enough, they can connect to other rooms or even entirely different buildings in reality (though the distance between two buildings would be much larger than if the rooms took up real space).

While these rooms come with doors, they are not exclusive to your use, and can be entered by anyone like any other doorway. Additionally, they cannot be removed and are, by all accounts, now permanent fixtures of the location they are made.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Red Room

objects.text:
You can induce sudden, intense but temporary physiological afflictions in others within your range.

The effect functions through line of sight and does not require physical contact. You are not introducing pathogens, toxins, or foreign energies; you are forcing the target’s own biology to express specific responses on command.

These conditions must be biologically plausible responses the human body is capable of producing on its own, but which you can now forcibly trigger at will. 

Examples include: severe vertigo, nausea, gastrointestinal distress, violent coughing fits, blinding migraines, muscle tremors, weakness, shortness of breath, fever spikes, chills, loss of coordination, sudden fatigue, sensory distortion, or any other internally generated symptom the body can feel or produce. 

You choose the exact affliction or combination of afflictions at will, may apply multiple simultaneously, and may precisely control their severity from mild discomfort to fully incapacitating. Effects manifest rapidly and may last anywhere from a few seconds to several hours depending on your intent. 

By default, the power does not inherently create permanent damage, though extended or extreme use can lead to natural secondary consequences such as dehydration, exhaustion, or strain and even death.

Your power possesses a striker component as well that allows your to prime targets on touch, able to set afflictions to affect the target at a later date based on conditional requirements, such as when entering a fight, or after a set time period, or even more horrifically cause it to persist permanently until you alleviate the effect yourself. 

It also allows you to create a few more unique effects, such as causing the body to desync, reflexes delayed, muscles misfiring out of sequence, and other effects that body could do, but doesn’t. 

While afflictions you give others will fade after the time you set for it, unless you make it permanent through your striker component, they’ll wane as slow or fast as the target’s own body will allow. But by touching them you can remove all the symptoms immediately.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Accute Affliction

objects.text: You can cause anyone in a 50-meter radius to instantly go to sleep. This can affect anyone or thing that possesses the ability to sleep. However, you cannot affect Noctis Capes, as they don't need to sleep.
objects.title: (Shaker) Fainting Spell

objects.text: You can summon a deep crimson flame. This flame can burn anything regardless of how flammable the object is. It cannot be put out with mundane materials, taking a long time to naturally be put out through time and the flame also spreads rapidly, to the point you don’t actually have control over its spread beyond putting it out with a thought. Anytime you use this power expect everything in that general area to be burned down. You are immune to your own flames, and your flames are not any hotter than an average flame.
objects.title: (Shaker) Frenzied Flame

objects.text: You can freeze space-time, creating calcified space-time. These frozen areas are completely immovable and indestructible, except when exposed to an All or Nothing effect. Any object or person caught within the calcified space-time becomes entirely frozen in time. If only part of something is caught inside, it will be severed from the portion left outside, as though cleanly cut. To create them, you create an invisible energy that you mould, only you can see this energy. Once you finished moulding it and it is enveloping whatever you wanted to freeze, you can activate it, turning the energy into calcified space-time. Larger areas require more time to create. For example, freezing an area large enough to encompass a human body may take a few seconds, while freezing something significantly larger could take several minutes. This power can disrupt other powers that interact with Space and/or Time. You can dismiss calcified space-time you make at will.
objects.title: (Shaker) Frozen Space

objects.text: You can alter gravity within 100 feet or 30 meters of yourself. You can change the gravity anywhere from 10% to 500%.
objects.title: (Shaker) Gravity

objects.text: This power allows you to generate, manipulate, and control cold temperatures, with the ability to freeze objects, people, and even the air itself. With the power to shoot out icy blasts that can freeze anything in their path, this power has the potential to cause great devastation in a short amount of time. Not only can you create obstacles by forming ice structures, but you can also utilize your power to increase your mobility by creating ice paths or walls to climb and jump off of. Furthermore, this power grants you the ability to freeze any projectile coming their way, turning them into solid chunks of ice and rendering them harmless. This power gives you resistance to cold temperatures, at the cost of lowering your body temperature. As such, you should be wary of high temperatures.
objects.title: (Shaker/Breaker) Icy Kiss

addons.text: Your pikes are now composed of silver like reinforced steel, vastly increasing their durability and lethality. Additionally, these pikes can now manifest from any object within your effective range. However, they remain Manton-Limited, preventing them from emerging directly inside the bodies of living beings. Their psychological impact has also grown, now actively weakening those in their presence.
addons.title: Vlad

addons.text:
Upon entering your maddened state, you unlock an additional power that further enhances your combat capabilities. You gain the ability to generate stakes from within your own body, which can be utilized in multiple ways to increase your lethality and versatility in battle. These stakes can be used offensively to stab and impale your enemies at close range. You can also manipulate these stakes to transform your body, akin to Hookwolf, creating various weaponized forms such as spiked armor, or other configurations that suit your fighting style and the situation at hand. You can launch these stakes at high speeds with remarkable accuracy, allowing you to strike targets from a distance and engage opponents who are out of reach.

In addition to their offensive uses, these stakes provide a unique defensive capability. Should you suffer a wound, you can generate stakes to fill and close the wound temporarily. While this does not heal the injury, it effectively stabilizes the wound, preventing further bleeding and allowing you to continue fighting without being hindered by your injuries. However, note that using stakes to fill your wounds is not a viable long-term solution. The stakes will exacerbate the injury over time, cutting you from the inside and potentially causing more severe damage if left untreated.
addons.title: Count Dracula

objects.text:
Within a radius of one kilometer, you can create pikes that emerge from the ground, thrusting upwards to impale enemies. The mere sight of the pikes exerts a psychological impact, inducing intense anxiety or fear in opponents and destabilizing their mental state. The closer and less spikes you create at once, the faster they are formed. 

These manifested pikes persist as tangible obstacles, obstructing movement and reducing the likelihood of evasion as time goes on.
objects.title: (Shaker) Impaler

objects.text:
Your stomach - the organ, that is - has become massively empowered and reinforced. Its walls become tougher than diamond, while its acid becomes capable of digesting nearly anything. Nothing that the acid digests can negatively affect you as a result, or at least anything you personally would perceive as negative. Additionally, should you lose any digestive acids, your stomach’s glands will work on overdrive to immediately replace what was lost.

You have the ability to overlay your surroundings with the space inside of your stomach, proportionately enlarged to be able to encompass an area of 30 feet around you. This will cause your stomach to begin to digest anything within the space overlaid, excluding yourself.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) Stomach In, Stomach Out

objects.text:
You have the ability to make any human or animal lose their hearing, as long as you know their face and current location, with no limit to distance. 

You can also choose how they become deaf, selecting any cause that could realistically result in hearing loss—such as an injury or a sudden loud sound. If the cause isn’t feasible, the person simply becomes deaf instantly. 

You may also set a timer that determines when the hearing loss occurs, based on the cause you selected.

(This ability affects only humans and animals.)
objects.title: (Shaker) Deaf Note

objects.text:
You can invert any non-living object or contiguous material within a 50-meter radius of yourself, turning it inside out while preserving its exact external shape, total volume, and material composition. 

What was the interior surface becomes the new exterior surface, and vice versa, meaning every internal layer, component, or void flips position with the outermost layer. For example, inverting a car pulls the engine block, wiring, and upholstery to the outside while the paint and body panels end up inside, leaving the same silhouette but with all structural integrity destroyed. Inverting a concrete wall brings internal rebar and hollow spaces to the outer face while the smooth finished surface compresses inward, causing immediate cracking and collapse. Inverting a safe exposes its contents and locking mechanism on the outside while the hardened steel shell becomes an interior crushing cage.

This cannot invert living beings, including humans, animals, or plants, due to the Manton limit. It also cannot change an object’s overall shape, separate materials into different locations, or teleport anything; the inversion happens in place, and objects must be entirely within the 50-meter radius to be affected.
objects.title: (Shaker) Inverted Structure

objects.text: You can make bubbles of slowed, hastened, or frozen time. Frozen time grows at a rate of 1m³ every two minutes. Hastened time at a rate of 1m³ per 15 seconds. Slowed time grows at a rate of 1m³ per 10 seconds. By default, slowed time is 10% slower than the speed of time, hastened time is 1000% faster than the speed of time, and frozen time is 0% the speed of time, completely static. As slowed time grows slower, or hastened time grows faster, it takes longer and longer to grow. A bubble can be no larger than a cubic kilometer, and you cannot have more than 100 active bubbles. You can pop a bubble at any time. All-or-Nothing powers like The Siberian, Clockblocker, and Flechette/Foil can pop all bubbles, though the Siberian will pop when doing so.
objects.title: (Shaker) Temporal Tempo

objects.text:
You possess two bodies: your real body and a simulated body, both of which you can control simultaneously.

Your simulated body exists within a gritty, dystopian simulation world filled with scraps and trash, all low quality material. In this world, you have a tinker power that grants you access to a vast array of tinker specialties, albeit at a lower level. You can make the basics from any tech tree but no further than that.

Anything you build in the simulated world—once it becomes operational—can be projected into the real world. These projections are tangible and fully functional, seamlessly integrating into reality as if they were built there. However, the connection between the simulated and real worlds is more than just a projection; it's a two-way link. Any damage inflicted on the projection in the real world directly affects its counterpart in the simulated world. Conversely, any modifications or repair in the simulated world will immediately reflect on the projection in reality.

The bigger and more complex the projection, the more strain you have to keep it summoned.
objects.title: (Shaker/Tinker) Scrapyard

objects.text: Everyone within a 10-meter radius has their connection to their shard temporarily weakened, requiring them to slow down in their power usage. Every affected parahuman can only use their powers once every ten seconds, with continuous powers instead being limited to being used half the time, at most every other 10 seconds. You can selectively choose who is affected.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Power Slowdown

objects.text: You can amplify the qualities of your surroundings. You can increase height, strength, size, mass, color, darkness, durability, and so on. You can only increase one property per target. Amplification takes a while to wind up, and it increases for as long as you are amplifying something. You have no way to ‘pause’ when amplifying a quality; it’s either constantly growing or making it go back to normal.
objects.title: (Shaker) Amped Up

objects.text: Every day you can summon a random item. These items can be anything from a blade of grass to a portable black hole, but no matter what, these items will be useful to you. You have 3 slots for items. If an item isn’t in a slot, then it will disappear a day after it is either spawned or removed from a slot. You have a higher chance of gaining mundane items, and higher tier items have a possibility that you may not be able to control them.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Loot Box

objects.text:
You can make something end quickly by accelerating it. You can do this on what you can see, on yourself and what you are touching, or on your powers. What is affected by your power will age faster at the same rate you accelerated it.

Accelerate an arriving plane and it will quickly go from flying to landing, accelerate the cooldown of a power and it will decrease until it is skipped entirely, accelerate the decay of something and it might just break if it was close to happening, accelerate healing and it will quickly finish.

You can accelerate something as fast as want to but the more you surpass 10x the original speed the more of a headache you build up, go fast enough and you might die of brain damage. Negentropy removes this limit.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Time Magic!

objects.text: You have telekinesis. When you're lifting less than 10 pounds or 4.5 kg in total, you have fine control equal to that of Parian. Otherwise, your fine control is decent but requires a lot of concentration that really can't be given during a battle. Your maximum carrying capacity is 15 tons. Your telekinesis can't move anything faster than you can go without the Quicker than Thunder power or teleportation. Your telekinesis accelerates to maximum velocity in five seconds, no matter how much the thing you're carrying weighs.
objects.title: (Shaker) Telekinesis

objects.text: You can manipulate water at a moderate scale. You can telekinetically control any water in your line of sight, compressing it and launching it at speeds of up to 150 mph. Furthermore, your hydrokinesis extends to a 5-meter radius around you, allowing you to detect and manipulate any water molecules. However, your fine control is far worse without a line of sight, and you can only control the general direction and shape of the water.
objects.title: (Shaker) Wavecrasher

addons.text: Instead of dirt, those within a city block that wish you harm will now feel as if they continuously get Carolina Reaper sprayed into their eyes and mouth, an effect comparable to constantly getting pepper-sprayed without being able to close your eyes or hold your breath, only dialed up to eleven. This power can neither cause lasting physical damage nor kill anyone affected, though with sufficient exposure your enemy may wish otherwise.
addons.title: Geneva Wants A Word

objects.text:
You possess the ability to implant within a city block the sensation of having dirt put on the subject's eye. Allowing for the distraction of those who wish to harm the user, the sensation does not care about durability bypassing normal defenses, giving the same rough and coarse sensation no matter how durable a target is. 

The longer the sensation persists, the worse it gets for those under the effects of this power.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Dirt in Your Eye

objects.text:
You possess absolute control and awareness over any vibrations that come into contact with you, extending even to their more esoteric forms. As a consequence of this power, your mind has undergone a mental metamorphosis, transforming your brain into a supercomputer capable of processing an overwhelming influx of sensory data. This adaptation safeguards your mental faculties, enabling you to handle the intense demands of your abilities without compromising your sanity.

Despite the breadth of your control, the immense focus and precision required to use this power are mentally exhausting, limiting much of its practical application. Making the true scope of your ability effectively constrained, as you must meticulously calculate, monitor, and direct each aspect of the vibrations you manipulate, making even minor adjustments a taxing endeavor.

Although you cannot generate vibrations directly, you can alter and amplify existing ones, gradually building them up to cataclysmic proportions. With time and precision, you could produce forces capable of reducing cities to rubble or reshaping entire landscapes. However, such large-scale feats are extremely taxing, requiring total concentration and prolonged immobility. The mental and physical toll often leaves you incapacitated afterward, and any lapse in focus risks triggering unintended, catastrophic effects. 

That’s why mastery comes into play: the more accustomed you are to processing every stream of vibrational information, the more proficient you become in terms of control and precision, the less taxing it becomes for your mind and body, slowly but surely obtaining your power’s full scope. Best viewed as a learning curve, it’ll take long and hard steps for you to attain this.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Maestro

objects.text: You have an aura of total apathy and despair. It causes people to simply stop what they were doing and stare into space, remembering the worse parts of themselves and how meaningless their actions are. The effects lasts for as long as the victims are in your range, which is about 50 meters in radius.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Depression

objects.text: You can reshape the environment within 100 feet or 30 meters. You can't make anything float while doing this, but as long as they're not levitating, you have pretty much total control of the non-animal environment. You can cause what's basically an earthquake except on a much smaller scale, you can move plants, you can have a plant's vines wrap around your target. You can even make it so you have the higher ground.
objects.title: (Shaker) Environment Shaping

objects.text: You can slowly turn everything in a maximum range of 10 km into a dark ink-like substance. The smaller your range, the faster everything around you turns, while at the maximum range it would take an entire day. You can animate and control this ink-like substance that corrodes and turns anything it touches into more of itself. You can animate corpses, rubble, and so on. Though if it's a Parahuman, you cannot use their powers even if you control their corpses. Your Ink can control its state, from being harder than steel to more fluid than water.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Black Goo

objects.text: Centered on you, you can replace the terrain with lava at an exponential rate, starting at 10 square meters/second with a maximum radius of around 10 kilometers. It acts like normal lava, with the exception that it doesn't affect inorganic material standing on it and the heat doesn't extend further than ~10 cm from the surface. This pool goes down extradimensionally about 10 meters. You are immune to the heat, and instead grows stronger when surrounded and submerged in lava.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) The Floor is Lava

objects.text:
Just like your poor attempts at removing that embarrassing part of a photo, like a photobomb or a fake ass friend, you hold the full power of the Lasso Tool! 

<sub>(Warning: Shard-imposed restrictions apply)</sub>

Mostly, you can instantly draw an invisible boundary around any object or its surroundings, isolating it from the immediate environment, either remotely or by touch. This manifests as a faint, luminous dashed line around your hands, leaving a nearly invisible energy thread trailing from your fingertips when active. After tracing an outline with their hands (almost like drawing digitally) and closing it, a shimmering border snaps into existence around the object, not unlike the digital tool’s marching ants. 

This keeps the object from interacting with the laws of physics or being influenced by the area around it, as well as telekinetically controlling or resizing it, e.g., selecting a random car on a crowded street, lifting it straight up out of traffic, and dropping it down in a parking spot without disturbing the people, air, or debris immediately next to it. Due to the power’s isolation from physical reality, it’ll defy environmental physics like air resistance, friction, and what have you. “Copypasting” the isolated object isn’t out of the question; by snapping your fingers, another 1:1 copy of the object materializes.

This power is limited by the object’s complexity the object’s complexity and the need for precise tracing or selection, however, as the complex an object can potentially be, the more concentration and stamina are needed, together with an imperfect or sloppily made trace, i.e., selecting half a building, will “sever” the object—spatially and temporally, cleanly at that, either leaving behind perfect cuts or what’s left of the unselected object.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Lasso Man!

objects.text: With this power, you can summon swirling vortexes of energy within a range of up to 100 meters. These vortexes have the ability to disrupt and destabilize nearby powers, drain energy and unleash destructive blasts. The unleashed energy vortexes can cause havoc and widespread devastation as they move through their surroundings.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Energy Vortex

objects.text: You can control the weather within 1000 miles of your location. Your precision on a small scale is not nearly as precise as that of an Airbender, but you can do powerful airblasts. You can form tornadoes or hurricanes on a whim. You could easily destroy society by yourself if you're not careful.
objects.title: (Shaker) Storm

objects.text:
You are able to heighten the emotional response of those around you to extreme levels. Even the smallest triggers can provoke overwhelming feelings, turning minor annoyances into uncontrollable fury or slight amusement into uncontrollable laughter. This also removes the natural limits on how deeply emotions can be felt. For example, a person’s anger could grow boundlessly, while their joy could become so intense it becomes almost otherworldly.

These heightened emotions also manifest physically. A person consumed by anger might grow dangerously hot, their body reddening and swelling until they violently explode. Those overcome with happiness might find themselves floating uncontrollably, as if weightless. Fear could cause someone to tremble until they collapse or dissolve into mist, while jealousy might create a corrosive effect that damages their surroundings.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Emotional High

objects.text:
Each day, you gain 1 charge of this power, accumulating up to a maximum of 7 stored charges. By expending a single charge, you can force a near miracle—a highly unlikely but technically possible event—to occur with absolute certainty. This turns low-probability outcomes into guarantees. For example, a jammed door might swing open at your touch, a hidden object might just happen to be exactly where you look first, or a dying flashlight might sputter back to life just long enough to get you out of danger. These are outcomes that could happen under normal physics and logic, but likely wouldn’t—until now.

If you spend two charges, you can bend reality further—making the impossible merely possible. A gun might misfire despite flawless maintenance, or a collapsed bridge might momentarily support your weight. These feats remain unlikely, unless you seal the miracle by spending a third charge—guaranteeing that the impossible outcome is not only possible, but guaranteed to happen. For example, you could fall off a 12 story building and survive, or have an atom just randomly split perfectly to cause a nuclear explosion.

There are limitations: the effect radius is confined to you and your immediate surroundings—roughly within a few meters—and you are restricted by the Manton Limit.
objects.title: (Shaker/Breaker) Miracles

addons.text: Bedlam adds an element of volatility, there’s select fields of instability where reality breaks down and worsens the disaster’s havoc, causing irreparable damage to some areas, especially owing to fluctuations and deformations from it alongside the ensuing disaster dictating what flavor of unpredictability some poor sod may find. The selection method usually finds places with the most tension or conflict the most preferable.
addons.title: CF

objects.text: Your power deals with disasters, both freakish, man-made, and natural alike, within an area of 200m² you emulate and bring forth any disaster or catastrophe that can occur within nature and/or civilization.
