At first, you start with low-risk disasters like Cat 1 hurricanes, 3.0 earthquakes, or possible man-made disasters if factors are present, which ramps up to high-risk or near-cataclysmic disasters, such as earthquakes, floods, thunderstorms, tornadoes, heatwaves, snowstorms, landslides, sinkholes, eruptions, droughts, firestorms, nuclear explosions, fallout, epidemics, etc. the more conflict or devastation you spread while also extending your range to 500m². You have a light control of what type of disaster you can summon depending on the meteorological and territorial features within your area, with the chance of drawing forth multiple types of disasters.
objects.title: (Shaker) Hazardous Disaster

objects.text:
You are capable of transforming inorganic material into different physical states of matter at will. You can transmute matter within a 100 metre radius of yourself, with the maximum amount of material you can manipulate at once being up to 10 metric tons. The phases of matter you can transmute to and from are limited to the classical states of solid, liquid or gas.

While the material you've transmuted is in a different state of matter compared to its original form, you're capable of telekinetically controlling it within your range. For example, you could convert air into a solid and manoeuvre it like a shield around you or turn the ground into liquid before solidifying it again to entrap your enemies.

When transformed, the material retains its normal chemical properties although you can freely adjust fluid dynamics like viscosity. Any changes to the physical state of an object or material can be permanent but you can also revert matter back into its original form at any point.
objects.title: (Shaker) Matter State Master

objects.text: You can set a rule for reality that affects an area within 200 feet of you. There can only be one rule at a time. These rules must be simple, cannot affect people's minds or powers, and cannot directly cause harm to someone.
objects.title: (Shaker) Edict

objects.text:
You gain pyrokinesis focused around cinders and ash and the ability to summon cinders and ash, along with near immunity to heat and fire. The cinders and ash you can summon can melt steel within moments of contact, and alongside this, you have the ability to transform your body into a living mass of superheated ash and cinders. In this state, you cannot be hurt except by the destruction of the burning core, which is normally located inside your head, but with training and experience, you can learn to move it around your body to protect it from damage.

You can also create constructs that are strong as steel out of your ash and cinders, and you can heal yourself from anything using ash and cinders that you did not create so long as your brain remains fully intact.
objects.title: (Shaker/Breaker) Lord of Cinder

addons.text: Your parasites have synthesised, allowing the clones emerging from your cocoons to retain powers of the original, though at a reduced potency, as long as the cocoon itself survives.
addons.title: Eat My Wings

objects.text:
You are able to release small, writhing parasites that burrow into other people’s bodies. This has a small range limit, only able to infect people in your immediate surroundings. Once inside, these parasites grow quickly, forcing their host’s body to change. A fleshy, grotesque mask forms over the person’s face, draining their energy and making them weak and helpless. The longer you stay around a person, the more parasites you can infect them with and the faster they change. As the parasites spread, the host’s body starts to turn inside out—flesh warps, organs pulse visibly, and they become unrecognizable. Eventually, they’re wrapped in a gross, cocoon-like shell made of their own twisted flesh. 

From this cocoon, a constant flow of mutated clones of the original host emerge, each twisted and deformed in bizarre ways. These clones retain no powers or skills the host had, only their horrifying appearance and basic functionality. The clones are mostly feral and animalistic, although loyal to you.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Parasitic Army

addons.text: You have now gained better control over the illusion, allowing you to show both the worst day of your life and the best day, as well as anything in between. You can manipulate the illusion to project moments of extreme joy, hope, and fulfillment from your past, albeit exaggerated to a surreal degree. This duality enables you to create a complex, shifting landscape of memories, alternating between your highest highs and lowest lows, to manipulate the emotions and perceptions of those trapped within. You can oscillate between tormenting your enemies and lulling them into a false sense of security with glimpses of your happiest memories, making the eventual return to horror even more disorienting and psychologically damaging.
addons.title: All of Me

objects.text:
You can cause people in your surrounding to enter a hellish illusion, forcing them to relive a nightmarish version of your lowest point in life. This power projects your own deepest trauma into their minds, making them experience your suffering as if it were their own. They feel every ounce of your pain, fear, and despair, magnified by the illusion to an almost unbearable degree.

In this illusion, they are subjected to the same horrifying events and emotional turmoil that you endured, but with added horrors that make the experience even more excruciating. The illusion distorts their perception of time, dragging out moments of intense agony to feel like they last for hours. They see and feel the world as you did during your lowest point, trapped in a cycle of relentless torment.

You yourself will be stuck inside this illusion, the trauma boosting your power and giving you a degree of control over this illusion.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Worst Day Ever

addons.text:
The end of the world never stopped. Your ability to manifest disasters has combined with your ability to put the world into a post-apocalyptic state, transforming it into an active, ongoing process that goes past the end of humanity. The environment constantly evolves through layered scenarios - a forward trajectory of collapse where the environment gets worse and worse until it is beyond uninhabitable. The zone reacts in real time and your range constantly expands with each successive “domino”; seismic faults giving way under weakened structures, famine causing ambient life to grow more hostile, infrastructure rapidly deteriorating under rapidly-occurring entropy. The power draws from the repertoire of disasters you possess to justify why the world keeps getting actively worse around you.

Any attempt to “fix” - that is, neutralize or cleanse - the environment is treated as an error by the logic of the power, and is therefore met with further disaster and rejection. Meanwhile, the Stranger effect is enhanced passively, as anybody outside of the zone while it is active now treats it as not just ‘lost', but instead permanently unsalvageable, akin to Chernobyl.
addons.title: Doomsday, Ceaseless

addons.text:
In your wake is the logical endpoint of every single ending, biting at your heels. Malum advances the twisted logic and range through which Doomsday Went functions into a cascade of timelines, where every apocalyptic scenario that could be is not only realized, but given room to metamorphosize, every manifestation of the doomsday clock striking twelve rubbing shoulders. The disasters don’t just play out anymore - they interfere and interact with each other, competing and compounding and creating unnatural, hybrid catastrophes. A nuclear wasteland suffering from ecological collapse under skies darkened by ever-burning megafires and extreme hydroactivity, for example - and that’s just with the ones you’d find on Earth. This is a culmination of worlds that have died over and over, staggering forwards in a parody of what could have been.

People outside of your zone no longer see it as lost or uninhabitable. Rather, it is now simply unthinkable, scrubbed away from geological and mental relevance completely. Satellite images will blur, maps will refuse to acknowledge its existence and terrain, and memories will warp to exclude it as if it were never there. Any attempt to document or explain what is happening within only creates confusion and contradiction. Lastly, any attempt at even erasing or stopping what is within will only feed into the stewpot, as the attempts themselves are immediately marked as disasters also, and will suffer the other apocalypses moving in to further the strife.
addons.title: As We Know It

objects.text:
You are capable of exerting a wide-area Shaker effect that constantly centers itself on you as you move, which continuously overwrites the local environment into a post-apocalyptic state, instantiating physical and ecological situations and conditions as if the end of the world has passed. This doesn’t make the end of the world happen - the world has moved on, and its consequences are all that remain. Note that “the end of the world” as dictated here is more “the end of human life.”

Upon activation, the power selects a specific scenario in which to apply to everything within the area, ranging from the rise of the undead to a solar flare so strong it brushed against the earth, before applying these effects on the zone encompassing the user. In the aftermath of a nuclear war scenario, for example, the air would become saturated with radiation, electronics and other such electricity-dependent systems would fail, buildings would suddenly acquire collapse profiles matching damage from shockwaves, and all water becomes contaminated. Any physical changes brought about that intersect people, such as rubble and debris, result in any person being harmlessly teleported to a safe place beside these destroyed objects. 

All of this will occur as if the apocalypse had already happened within this area, exempting people within who will be affected by its consequences. The world’s moved on, therefore everything within the bounds of the zone will behave accordingly - animals mutating or behaving in hostile situations if any non-human organic life were to remain in the scenario chosen as if generations had passed, with social responses being suppressed due to authorities and populations believing the area to have been ‘lost’, the effect breaking when presented with direct proof of evidence. Attempts to terraform, purify, or normalize your environment - even by parahumans - are also suppressed unless of sufficient strength.
objects.title: (Shaker/Stranger) Doomsday Went

objects.text:
You can instantly create any material you know the atomic composition of in any quantity and structure you can imagine that would fit in a radius of 10 meters from your body. You can create multiple materials at once.

This comes paired with minor Thinker capabilities improving your ability to learn the atomic composition of materials, and the ability to better visualize structures in general.

This power does have one major limitation though, namely that you can’t create matter in a space already occupied by a solid structure. Especially if that solid structure is a living being, that said you can use this power to create life should you have the necessary knowledge.

Synergizes well with Tinker powers.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Infinite Treasury

objects.text:
You possess absolute dominion over fungal matter within a ten-meter radius, capable of detecting even singular individual spores floating through the air and transforming them into networks of mycelium and fruiting vessels. This awareness extends to all fungal species simultaneously which grants you a constant stream of biological data centered around fungi and fungi-adjacent organisms.

In order to make proper use of this awareness, your brain has been restructured into something akin to a distributed processing system, granting you a greatly increased and refined sense of attention. This allows you to multitask much more effectively in regards to the manipulation of mycelium, allowing you to track hundreds of colonies, manage their growth, and sift through the sensory aspects of your domain in such a manner that even if your power were copied, the lack of the necessary processing would render it all but useless. Given time, you can transform entire city blocks into sprawls of fungal matter, weaving through roads and buildings and floating in thick clouds through the air.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Mycorrizha

objects.text:
You can control several elements as well as you could if you had the bender powers, but you can only control one at a time. Additionally, they're split into additional elements.

The elements are Air, Water, Ice, Earth, Metal, Plants, Fire, and Electricity.

The switch between elements takes 5 minutes of rest.
objects.title: (Shaker) Traveler

addons.text: Your ability to Tinker with crystals synergizes with Alexandrite’s creation and control of crystals, qualitatively enhancing it. Now, you can use Alexandrite to instantly recreate any crystal you’ve previously Tinkered up. While not too useful for recreating tinkertech which is only partially crystal, crystal-only creations like the hypothetical elemental crystals described in Crystals! can be created en-masse so long as you’ve created at least one iteration of it normally.
addons.title: Crystal Sorcery

addons.text:
Your ability to manipulate crystalline material has merged with your ability to generate and manipulate Shardmatter. You no longer need to touch an object to make use of your Density or Material Expansion abilities; instead, affecting any crystalline or organic material within your fields of influence, the shorter of which is increased to 25 meters.

You are no longer required to separate parts of your body in order to turn them into Shardflesh, as the synergy between your two powers alters your Breaker state to be entirely composed of the stuff. You gain all the benefits from this that your creations would, namely, high Brute and Mover ratings. As your neural pathways have changed as well, you gain an appropriately high Thinker rating. Finally, your Shaker manipulation grants you the ability to fly.

With access to enough Endbringer flesh, you can both consume it for healing and shape it within yourself, granting you a different Breaker state that is a far smaller version of that Endbringer. This "Conflict Sentinel" form has access to weakened versions of that Endbringer's powers; diminished as these powers are, they are still quite potent when compared to garden-variety parahumans, being roughly equivalent to the strongest T2 powers or the weakest T3 powers. You only need to consume enough of their material once in order to transform, permanently increasing your repertoire of forms. Any Conflict Sentinels you create are added to your repertoire as well.
addons.title: Mellite

objects.text: You can create and control all forms of crystals, though your defaults are alexandrite and diamond. Creating other types of crystals takes some concentration on your part. You are able to create all crystals within 12 meters of yourself and control all of your created crystals within a hundred-meter range of yourself. You are able to transform your body into a crystal that can heal by absorbing crystals. The crystals that make up your breaker state are significantly more durable than normal.
objects.title: (Shaker/Breaker) Alexandrite

objects.text: You possess complete terrakinesis within a hundred-metre range of yourself. You also possess the ability to increase the density and durability of all stones that you are controlling, though this is significantly improved if you are directly touching the stone in question. You are also able to transform all non-living things into stone. Your strength and durability are increased 10-fold.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) Gaia

objects.text: Things tend to go in your favor. Endbringers won't attack the city you're in, you'll almost always win when you gamble, and you won't get hit by a stray shot. This only effects matters of luck. If someone is trying to kill you, it won't make the roof fall on them unless it was already falling apart. Flechette won't manage to shoot the Endbringer core when it's about to kill you unless she was already aiming near the core. The Slaughterhouse 9 is unlikely to target you unless you're either a perfect target for them or you took the Slaughterhouse 8 drawback.
objects.title: (Shaker) Deus Ex Machina

objects.text:
You can induce heart attacks in anyone you know the face and location of, with an unlimited range. You could determine anyone’s cause of death aside from heart attacks, from car accidents to any event where it is realistically possible for one to die, if it isn’t the person dies from a heart attack. You can set a timer when a person dies, which is contingent to the determined cause of death.

(This only works on humans and animals).
objects.title: (Shaker) Kira

addons.text: Instead of a simple effect within reason, you place a single rule that your bounded field enforces. The potency of said bounded field’s rule depends on its simplicity; the more complex a rule, the more diffused or weakened it is enforced.
addons.title: Territorial Field

objects.text:
You can create boundary lines made of dimensional energy around a physical area, creating a space between “outside”  and “inside”, isolating the bounded space from the “outside” world. You can, consequently, set one effect on the “inside” or the boundary line itself. This is commonly used for defensive and covert purposes, yet it can also be used for battle, such as producing 7 tightly bonded bounded fields with a barrier effect.

These effects range from obfuscating the bounded area from trespassers, adding a subliminal suggestion or coercion of apprehension, fear, or obliviousness to dissuade someone from intruding upon the area, or simply creating an invisible barrier to physically stop people from entering. You can impose almost any effect within your bounded area if it isn’t a massive change to the area or doesn’t require vast or excessive resources; aside from spatial, dimensional, and All-or-Nothing attacks or powers, nothing can remove or destroy a bounded field.

Once constructed, you can’t move your bounded fields once set.
objects.title: (Shaker/Stranger) Bounded Fields

objects.text:
You can manipulate the fabric of spacetime, allowing you to make non-euclidean regions that defy conventional physics. This would allow you to make things bigger on the inside, an endlessly looping stairway, or even a time dilation room. There is a somatic component to this power, requiring that you stretch and pull at the very fabric of spacetime with your bare hands. You may not reverse time, and you cannot cross dimensions either. 

The better your knowledge of a region, the higher the quality of the manipulations you do, making it almost impossible to accurately port to a place you've never been to before. Due to your manipulation's somatic nature, complex or long-range manipulations require much more time to enact, possibly increasing by several magnitudes.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Dimensional Warping

objects.text: You possess the ability to create, control, and shape all forms of electricity and lightning. Along with great knowledge and understanding of electricity and lightning, you possess the ability to enhance your body with the power of lightning and even transform yourself into living lightning.
objects.title: (Shaker/Breaker) The One Who Tamed Lightning

objects.text:
You can project a glowing aura (you decide the color) from your body that can cover the radius of a city block. You can manipulate the wavelengths of anything that enters this aura except yourself. This can have various effects from piercing and canceling parahuman effects, raising and lowering heat to various extremes, disintegration, manipulating kinetic energies, energies in general, telekinesis, and much more. 

A piece of the power of Stilling is in your grasp, the sole drawback you unfortunately possess comes in the form of dilution: the more you disperse it, the more it loses in radiance, along with taking more time for its effects to materialize e.g. at the power’s full deployment over your entire radius, it simply illuminates the area with its effectiveness reduced to the point where it takes a second to raise or lower the area’s temperature by a degree. Conversely, the more compact an area the more effective, as you can deftly alter the temperature by thousands of degrees a second, your aura shining like the sun.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Still Aura

objects.text:
With a touch, you can lock the spatial position of an object relative to another object you have recently touched. You may choose a surface or curve of allowed relative positions, such as a sphere of constant distance or a straight line that prevents orthogonal movement. 

This effect is inherently symmetric and forces are shared between the two bodies as if joined by an unbreakable physical link. You may choose whether the constraint is tied to the orientation of either or both bodies. 

Applications include: linking an opponent to a speeding vehicle to carry them along at high speeds, "levitating" an object by constraining its vertical position relative to the floor, or steering a projectile in mid-air by constraining it to a radial line oriented with the weapon. The effect ends on its own after about an hour, or if you dismiss it, but is otherwise inviolable.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Holonomic Constraint

addons.text: You can now populate your Dungeon with Pokémon, gaining much greater control of what Pokémon are created and how many are created in the process. Your ability to create Pokémon for your Dungeon is powered by a finite energy pool that regenerates slowly over time, taking a full day to completely replenish normally, although engaging in conflict or having your Dungeon defeat other people greatly speeds up the process. Pokémon created in your Dungeon are innately loyal and protective of the Dungeon Core and are inclined to listen to and obey you, but will not always do everything you say or perfectly follow orders. You can also use this energy to create natural Pokémon objects like evolution stones and berry bushes, although the more potent the object, the more resources are needed to make it. If you have Pokémon: Let's Go! then you can even create Mythical and Legendary Pokémon, although the energy cost will be immense and they'll likely be prideful enough to disregard orders without proper compensation or other means of incentivizing them to follow instructions.
addons.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon

addons.text:
In combination with your ability to cultivate growth in others, you have become a Grindstone, a place where steel sharpens steel. All who exist within your domain - both your own monsters and those who delve your depths - experience directed and exponentially greater growth.

This growth aligns with how they exercise themselves in your domain; those who use their powers experience their powers growing in strength and versatility, those who exercise their body experience their strength swell to superhuman levels, and those who exercise their mind experience their cognitive prowess expand to surpass the brightest natural genius.

While it is technically possible to achieve growth through mere exercise, the greatest and fastest gains are achieved through combat.
addons.title: Grindstone

addons.text: Your control of your Dungeon has caused an unexpected synergy with your Dimensional Warping. When in the form of a Dungeon Core, you no longer have to rely on somatic components for manipulations within the bounds of your Dungeon, as your innate control counts in their place. Furthermore, due to it being your creation and your connection to it, you have flawless knowledge of its confines, vastly increasing the quality of your alterations. These two aspects combined allow you to transform even the insides of even a small Dungeon into a “bigger on the inside” sprawling complex of spatial expansion and temporal warping, functionally becoming a pocket dimension anchored to the Dungeon’s entrance in reality. If you were to possess Multiversal Warping, then you could truly turn your Dungeon into another dimension altogether, with the ultimate expression being turning your Dungeon into a multiversal crossroads of sorts, existing outside of conventional dimensions and connection to multiple universes at once, a true Demiplane.
addons.title: Pseudo-Demiplane

addons.text: The Demesnes-Keeper’s near-absolute control over reality has combined with your Dungeon to grant you astronomical levels of control of its interior. For starters, you no longer need to be in the Core to manage a Dungeon; in fact, the interior of your Dungeon always counts as being within the range of Demesnes-Keeper. Additionally, your perception and control are always at their highest fidelity and precision within the confines of your Dungeon, regardless of its size, providing absolute awareness and dominion of everything that happens within it. Lastly, as Demesnes-Keeper can create matter and energy, your expansion is no longer bound by resource limitations and through your ability to create alternate versions of yourself inherited from Reality Sculptor, you can even form multiple Cores to create and manage multiple Dungeons at once.
addons.title: The Grand Dungeon

objects.text: You can transform into a Dungeon Core that has control over a Dungeon. A Dungeon starts as just a room with a core in it, but with resources, it can expand. The Dungeon can use resources to make monsters. The Dungeon Core can turn back into a human, but the Dungeon will be left behind. You can only manage the Dungeon while you are in the Core. If the Dungeon Core is destroyed when you're in it, you're dead; otherwise, you just need to start from zero.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Dungeon Core

addons.text: Your pool of energy can be replenished by absorbing matter into your core. Furthermore, you can designate an area around your core to be "owned" by you, which boosts your abilities, including all of your creations when within land you "own". You can increase this land at the cost of energy.
addons.title: Final Dungeon

addons.text: You can now enhance your structures and units at the cost of energy. This new capability allows you to upgrade their functionalities, boosting their performance and granting them more specialized and unique abilities. Whether it's increasing the firing range of your turrets, reinforcing your walls with better materials, or giving your troops advanced combat skills, the possibilities for enhancement are vast. However, the more mobile the entity you wish to improve, the more energy it requires. Therefore, enhancing stationary defenses like turrets is significantly easier and more energy-efficient compared to upgrading mobile units such as troops.
addons.title: Impenetrable Tower

addons.text: You can combine constructs to create more advanced and powerful units or structures. This ability allows you to merge different constructs, blending their features and capabilities to form a superior entity. For example, you can fuse two turrets to create a hybrid with enhanced firing power and range, or combine different types of troops to produce a versatile unit that excels in multiple combat scenarios. The process of combining constructs costs energy, depending on the strength of each construct; however, the result will have a lower energy drain than everything used in its creation combined.
addons.title: Swipe and Fuse

objects.text:
You gain the ability to create and control defensive structures and units. Upon activation, you can summon a variety of turrets, barriers, and automated minions within a limited radius around them. These constructs are semi-autonomous, following simple commands such as "attack," "defend," or "patrol," and are powered by a finite energy pool that regenerates slowly over time, which takes a full day to fully replenish.

You can create three primary types of constructs: turrets, barriers, and minions. Turrets come in various forms, such as projectile launchers, energy blasters, and area-of-effect emitters, each with a specific range and damage profile. Barriers can be solid walls, energy shields, or spiked barricades, providing cover and controlling enemy movement. Minions are small, mobile units that can engage in melee combat, scout areas, or perform repair tasks on other constructs.

The structures and units have modest durability and firepower, making them effective for delaying and repelling small-scale threats rather than overpowering stronger opponents. You must strategically place and manage your creations, as each construct drains from your energy pool, and excessive use can leave them vulnerable. The stronger the construct, the more energy it drains from you. The stronger the construct, the more energy it consumes. Additionally, the longer a construct remains undamaged, the less energy it will drain. This resets once it's damaged.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Tower Defence

objects.text:
You have access to a pocket dimension. Inside this pocket dimension is a perfect copy of every single piece of mundane technology that has ever existed in the history of Earth. As long as it’s as advanced as an LED Lightbulb, and less advanced than pseudo-Tinkertech, then a copy of it exists in the pocket dimension. 

The dimension contains one copy for every distinct instance of a given piece of tech that exists in the real world. If a thousand functionally identical AK-47s were manufactured, you'd have a thousand copies, each representing a specific serial number, one for every rifle that ever left the factory. However, if a specific item undergoes significant modification during its lifetime, like an AK-47 that was later customized with a new stock and scope, the dimension treats it as a new distinct version. You'd have one copy preserved in its original factory condition, and another copy preserved at that modified configuration's peak.

You can summon anything in the dimension into the real world at will, with it appearing within a 10 meter radius. There is no limit to how many items you can summon at once, and each one has its own distinct summoning time. The bigger the thing you summon, the longer it takes, with a AK-47 taking a few seconds while a Panzerkampfwagen VIII Maus would take a full half an hour. The amount of time needed to summon scales exponentially with no limit. You cannot move while an item is being summoned without cancelling the summon.

When you unsummon the object, they return into the pocket dimension where they are repaired to their prime, taking a maximum of 48 hours to do so, no matter how damaged they are. Summoned objects always appear on a stable surface within your radius, oriented as they would normally rest. You cannot summon them mid-air or inside other objects or people.
objects.title: (Shaker) Vault of the Modern Era

addons.text: When you are struck down, with no possibility of revival, your combat abilities skyrocket for your one final blow, enough to practically guarantee that your target will either be destroyed, or at least gravely wounded. If you have (Brute/Trump) No Pain, No Gain then the force behind the attack will be so strong that it can even break through to an endbringer core. If you instead have (Thinker/Trump) Skill Issue then you will receive a Path to Victory like effect, being guided into the strike that will do the most possible damage. This guidance is not limited by any blind spots. If you have both powers, then the force behind your blow is perfectly distributed and targeted in such a way that your foe isn’t just killed, but completely destroyed, with not even a cell of them left intact.
addons.title: Finishing Blow

objects.text: Once you have taken a lethal blow, a blow you cannot survive, you will find an excess of strength that will allow you to do one single attack. This attack will land upon its target; it cannot be dodged, blocked, or nulled. This attack will be greater than your strongest possible attack. If you have other powers, then it may use said powers for the final attack; for example, a Blaster power could be enhanced and used. Your body will move automatically to attack the moment this power activates.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Spartans Die Standing

objects.text: You regenerate when you touch someone else's blood. One quart of someone else's blood would be enough to fully regrow a cut-off arm if it was the only damage done to you. The healing is spread throughout your entire body. You are not an actual vampire and this ability cannot be given to others by biting them.
objects.title: (Brute) Vampire

objects.text: When you hurt someone in some way, be it through punching, stabbing, or shooting, you will be healed for the equivalent to the damage you caused. If you were to dismember someone, that would count as completely destroying their arm, allowing you to regenerate the equivalent of an entire arm. Killing a person would completely restore you into peak condition.
objects.title: (Brute) Lifesteal

objects.text:
Your regeneration speed scales with the severity of your injury. A wound that would kill you within minutes, such as a crushed ribcage or a severed femoral artery, regenerates pounds of flesh in those same minutes. A deep gash that would bleed out over an hour closes in roughly that hour. Anything on the level of a scraped knee or smaller receives no speed boost at all and heals at the normal human rate.

As the wound shrinks past certain thresholds, your regeneration slows proportionally. The last inch of a deep laceration closes no faster than a mundane cut, and the final millimeter crawls. This means you could survive almost anything, but will likely end up having a scar. A properly set bone or stitched wound heals straighter than one left to your power alone, because the final slow phase is indistinguishable from normal healing and can still go wrong if not cared for.

Your regenerated flesh does not appear from nowhere. Each regeneration puts you into a caloric and nutritional debt equal to the mass restored plus interest. After regrowing a limb, you will need to consume tens of thousands of extra calories over the following days or risk fainting, muscle wasting, or the debt compounding into further biological strain.
objects.title: (Brute) Scarred Healing

objects.text: Any damage done to you will be spread evenly among any living being larger than a large rat within 10 meters of you. A bullet to the head will probably still kill you, even if there are 10 other people within range of you. It will also just kill all of them.
objects.title: (Brute) No, I am Spartacus

objects.text: You absorb all the damage done to every ally within 10 meters of you before they can even notice it, causing them no damage or pain. You may selectively choose what damage to take. This does not provide any other standard brute perks, so take with caution.
objects.title: (Brute) No, I am Leonidas

objects.text: After taking damage, you cannot take damage from another attack of the same type until a second has passed.
objects.title: (Brute) Immunity Frames

objects.text:
You are a regenerator now, with some minor drawbacks: your regenerations are focused on keeping you alive, so they aren't capable of creating new biomatter. Instead, they must relocate unneeded biomatter to heal you, taking it from where you need it most. For instance, if your body needs to grow a new heart, it might take the flesh from your leg to make it happen. 

If you are not in life-threatening situations, then your regenerations will focus on patching you up. The good news is that you have also gained a secondary power concerning eating. You now digest 100% of everything you consume – all the nutrients are absorbed and used to form new biomatter, meaning you have no waste. You can even eat things like stones, although they contain few nutrients. As long as you can swallow it, you can eat it. This also removes any problems like food poisoning.
objects.title: (Brute) Biological Redistribution

objects.text:
You can sense an energy evenly distributed across your body. The energy itself doesn’t do anything, until you choose to focus it in parts of your body. For example, by taking the energy in your arms and placing it in your legs, your arms will become sluggish and heavy, while your legs become stronger and faster. This enhancement and weakening affects any powers acting on that part of your body, such as other brute powers. You can instantly focus any part of your body with this energy, it being limited only by how fast you can act.

If you were to permanently lose a limb, the amount of energy in your body doesn’t decrease, instead it is distributed to the remaining parts of your body, strengthening it.
objects.title: (Brute) Focused Strength

objects.text:
Your raw strength and durability become intrinsically linked, ensuring that no matter how powerful you become, your body will always be able to withstand the force you unleash. This means that if you can throw a punch strong enough to shatter steel, you can also endure an equivalent impact without breaking. Likewise, if your resilience grows, your strength rises to match, ensuring you can hit as hard as you can endure.

However, this does not inherently increase either your strength or toughness—it simply maintains a perfect balance between the two.
objects.title: (Brute) Greatest Defence is Offence

objects.text: You are now capable of, for all intents and purposes, living through and recovering from anything, so long as two conditions are met. Firstly, your head, and secondly, your brain must be intact. As long as those two parts of you are intact, your body will be able to heal and make itself whole. This, however, is not a quick process, as your body heals at the same rate as it would for a normal injury.
objects.title: (Brute) Just Won't Die

addons.text:
Previously, your ability to become immune to whatever hurt you was limited to the specific cells that regenerated after injury.

Now, thanks to the newfound sentience of your cells, these adaptations can be communicated and shared throughout your body. Any immunity you gain is no longer localised but instead systemic.

For example, the invulnerability gained from a bullet wound to your arm would spread, causing the rest of your entire body to become equally resistant to the same type and magnitude of damage.
addons.title: Immune System

objects.text:
If any part of your body is wounded and then heals, the regenerated tissue will become permanently immune to the same type and intensity of damage that caused it.

This immunity is strictly localised; only the area that was harmed and heals gains this invulnerability. For example, if you're shot in the arm, the injured region will become inviolable to kinetic impacts of that force or weaker. The rest of your body, however, will remain just as vulnerable as before.

The same area can stack immunity to multiple forms of damage as it adapts to whatever it regenerates from, whether it’s blunt trauma, acid, electricity, radiation or even exotic parahuman effects. This protection is capable of adapting to almost anything short of All-or-Nothing attacks like Sting. 

Similarly, you can improve the threshold of existing immunities by healing from more powerful iterations of the same damage. Skin scarred by a candle burn may only protect against mild heat at first, but if the same area later recovers from a blowtorch, its resistance will strengthen to match.

This doesn’t alter the appearance of your body in any way, nor does it improve the speed or extent to which you can normally heal.
objects.title: (Brute) Exposure Therapy

objects.text:
Your attacks have far greater effect on non-Manton limited targets. You could punch straight through a concrete wall or shatter a steel beam with ease. However, your punch is no stronger against a living person, striking them with only the ordinary force of your natural swing. This also offers you no protection from the impact itself. That means punching through a wall, even if the wall breaks, still hurts your hand exactly as much as if the wall had remained intact.

This also applies to thrown objects. If you throw an object, that thrown object will also tear through non-living matter far more effectively. The same rule applies to any other power you may have.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Knucklehead

objects.text: You have a moderately above peak-human body in every way, excluding looks. Your looks are increased by one level though, and if they're already at the top level, then you look parahumanly attractive. You can also turn any circular object with a diameter less than a meter into a nearly-inviolable shock absorbing shield as long as you have touched it within the last 15 seconds. The appearance of the object doesn't actually change, and this power can only be used on one object at a time. The object must be metallic in nature.
objects.title: (Brute/Striker) Captain America

objects.text: Your mass is directly proportional to your acceleration. As your acceleration increases, your mass also increases, leading to a higher density. This increase in density enhances your strength and durability. This dramatically increases the force of your attacks. The boost in your strength will mean that you always will be able to move your newly added mass with no difference from your base mass.
objects.title: (Brute) Mass = Acceleration

objects.text: Any damage you take will be spread out evenly across your body, causing you to lose all natural weak spots. This can cause you to die suddenly all at once though, so be careful.
objects.title: (Brute) Distributed Damage

objects.text: You are fully immune to various gases, radiation, and other indirect hostile effects. You do not need to breathe and any food you consume will be safe for consumption regardless of what it was. However, once your skin is breached, until it is closed or healed, radiation or other airborne viruses can get inside you.
objects.title: (Brute) Airtight

objects.text: At any time, you can lock the position of your feet on the ground. As long as that ground is there, you cannot be moved until you unlock the position of your feet. When like this, you are completely invulnerable, are stronger than even Glory Girl, and have enhanced reflexes. Your wounds do not get worse while you're in this state.
objects.title: (Brute) Atlas

objects.text: You are stronger than steel. That's about it. Your flesh is like steel, your blood is like molten steel, and your bone is like reinforced steel. They're still flesh, blood, and bone, but they're as strong and durable as the steel itself, liquid steel, and reinforced steel, respectively. You regenerate more quickly than normal.
objects.title: (Brute) Man of Steel

objects.text:
You possess minor superhuman strength—enough to hit harder than a peak human and perform feats of physicality just beyond normal limits, but not to the degree of shattering concrete or tossing vehicles with ease. Your real power manifests in the moment of impact: whenever any part of your body strikes a surface—be it a punch, kick, headbutt, elbow, knee, or even a full-body slam—you generate a shockwave that pulses through the object you’ve hit.

This shockwave isn’t overwhelmingly strong on its own. A single strike might create a small internal tremor, a rattle, or some surface-level stress. The strength of the pulse weakens the farther it travels from the point of contact, dispersing energy the deeper it spreads. However, each successive hit sends another pulse through the target, and those pulses build on one another. The more you hit the same object, the more the internal vibrations amplify, stacking with growing intensity.

The effect escalates exponentially. What starts as harmless vibrations can evolve into cracking walls, ruptured supports, and sudden collapses, as the internal structure becomes overloaded by the layered force. Even tough materials and reinforced armor can’t withstand the cumulative resonance forever. This works best when you can land multiple hits in quick succession, maintaining the buildup before it has time to fade.
objects.title: (Brute/Striker) Hammer

objects.text: You have tactile telekinesis that allows you to lift anything. This doesn't enhance your punch speed or durability at all. If you pick up something large, you don't need to worry about structural integrity, your power will keep it intact.
objects.title: (Brute) Do you even lift?

objects.text: The longer you fight, the more physical power, speed, and durability you acquire. It tops at around 50 times max human potential and takes around 5 minutes of combat to get there.
objects.title: (Brute) Pump It

addons.text: The hate flows, but you don't react. While your emotions don’t have an impact while your rational mind is detached, they are still very well there, meaning you can gain the full boost of Rampage with no loss of self-control.
addons.title: Self-Control

addons.text:
Your mind is filled with madness and anger, but instead of a fiery rage, you find nothing but ice-cold hatred. Your powers, strength, and instincts get a major increase, and Thinkers will have trouble even simulating or intuiting you. Not only that but your mind has been enhanced as well, giving you a semblance of control.

You are still capable of thought, but most wouldn’t call it rational. You are a near-emotionless machine dedicated to one goal and one goal only. When you enter this state, you gain an undying hatred towards something. This can be decided beforehand, but it is possible to trigger this involuntarily. This hate will guide you to do your maximum efforts to achieve your goals. From helping plan the perfect murder to finally outdoing your neighbor’s Christmas decorations, all of it will be fueled with cold hate. Revenge is a dish best served cold after all.
addons.title: Cold-Blooded Hate

objects.text: When you are angry, your strength, speed, and durability are multiplied proportionally to your anger. Look at it this way: assuming you're an ordinary man, if you're somewhat angry for somebody embarrassing you at school or work, you could find yourself punching brick walls down, and taking similar blows; if you're pissed off, like someone hurting a loved one, you could find yourself punching a hole through a 5-inch steel wall; if you are angry enough to the point that you lose all restraint, you could bring down a 2-story house with just a single blow. On command, you can make yourself easier to anger.
objects.title: (Brute) Rampage

objects.text: You can absorb blood through your skin to temporarily increase your physical attributes proportional to the quantity and quality of blood absorbed. Half a pint of blood is enough for definitively superhuman strength. This is capped at making you as strong as an Endbringer.
objects.title: (Brute) Blood Bath

objects.text: You have the power to heal by touching the earth. When you make direct contact with the ground, you can absorb it to hasten your body's regeneration process. This ability allows you to recover from wounds, injuries, and fatigue at an accelerated rate. Minor wounds and cuts heal within seconds, moderate injuries such as deep gashes or fractures can take a few minutes, and severe injuries, like major organ damage or extensive burns, may require an hour of continuous contact, that is if you can survive for that long.
objects.title: (Brute) Antaeus

addons.text:
Your body has become a perfect vessel for harmonic warfare. Fabric, armor, and even sealed environmental suits no longer inhibit your absorption; the moment sound enters your vicinity, it’s yours to harvest. Whether it echoes off metal, seeps through stone, or hums through atmospheric pressure, you take it in unimpeded.

This refined control allows you to pour extra energy into your field, and when your field is sufficiently charged, it can emit carefully tuned frequencies across its surface, targeting the structural integrity of anything it touches. These resonant pulses can fracture concrete, split steel, or unravel synthetic fibers, depending on how much energy you've stored and how long you maintain contact. The stronger and denser the target, the more power you must dedicate, and living matter is more resistant to this effect—though not immune. With enough buildup, even reinforced armor or advanced materials begin to crumble against you.

Your high-frequency hum also now spreads through all space under your sonic control. Every corner of your domain becomes laced with this subtle, weaponized vibration. Even without seeing you, anyone within your soundscape begins to feel the effects: confusion, nausea, aching muscles, and a growing sense of pressure that builds with every passing moment.
addons.title: Resochor

addons.text: Your skin now acts much the same as your mouth. You are capable of shutting your own skin’s pores with your mouth, and in doing so, also shutting off any access to your power for as long as both your mouth and skin are closed. However, any sonic energy already within your body begins to echo throughout it ad infinitum, getting harder and harder to hold in. From here, you have two choices. Opening your pores after this process powers up your passive defenses for as long as your pores were shut. You are essentially untouchable: any force no matter how strong, even absolute ones, sloughs off energy rapidly until they simply do not carry any more than a rock at standstill. Fire sputters out, the ground below your feet can’t be affected, even a punch from Alexandria if she were to reach you would feel like the world’s softest pillow. Your hum is similarly enhanced, capable of affecting even the most immaterial beings so long as they can think and feel, and could kill those without the strength to resist it if they got too close. However, releasing this hum increases the rate at which your energy drains thricefold. Opening your mouth and making the smallest noise instead releases all of that pent up energy out. If the previous option were a shield, then this would be the spear. You are free to shape the force released from your mouth at will, but it must always stay somewhat conical or cylindrical. The narrower it is, the more range and power it’ll have, and vice versa. Clearing out a street with this would knock everybody in range to the other end and absolutely pulverize them, the street, and almost demolish the building behind them. Take a narrow shot the size of a coin at roughly where Leviathan’s core is and he’d care enough to beeline straight for you.
addons.title: Blastchoir

objects.text:
Your body is a living absorber of sound and motion. Every pore naturally draws in ambient vibrations—footsteps, machinery, voices, even distant impacts—and stores that energy in a dense biological matrix beneath your skin. This stored energy passively powers a constant vibrational field that surrounds your body. This field weakens physical force before it reaches you, scattering the energy of blades, bludgeons, and projectiles so they strike with reduced impact. It doesn’t make you invincible, but it makes every hit softer, slower, and less effective. The more energy you’ve absorbed from your surroundings, the stronger this passive defense becomes.

Additionally, you can have your pores emit an ultra-high-frequency hum. The hum is beyond the range of human hearing. The longer someone remains near you, the more their body and mind begin to suffer—disorientation, nausea, migraines, muscle weakness, and sensory fatigue begin to take hold. This hum is powered by the energy you absorb, growing stronger the more noise and motion you take in. In chaotic environments or dense battles, this makes you a walking zone of invisible, crushing pressure that wears down everything around you.

Because you absorb sound directly through your skin, you also hear through it—able to perceive vibrations and soundscapes across your body. However, this skin-hearing and your absorption alike are dulled when covered, with fabric or armor muffling both your senses and the energy you can draw in.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Echohide

objects.text:
You have a reservoir of energy that can be directed to temporarily enhance or manipulate your bodily systems. Whether it’s your muscular strength, your natural healing factor, your immune response, or even the speed and clarity of your neural processes, you can selectively supercharge these functions to surpass normal human limits.

When activated, the affected areas of your body emit a faint, hazy glow—an aura that subtly outlines the system or part being enhanced. This effect is instinctively regulated by your Shard, which prevents you from exceeding the structural or biological limits of your body and causing catastrophic failure. For instance, enhancing the muscles in your arm could allow you to punch hard enough to shatter a brick wall—but not beyond that unless you also reinforce supporting systems like your skeletal structure or connective tissue.

You have enough energy to maintain complete, full-body enhancement for up to 10 minutes. However, this is the upper limit of output and drain. Enhancing fewer systems drastically reduces energy consumption, allowing for significantly longer use. The more systems you empower at once, the faster your reserves deplete, with drain increasing exponentially.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Battle Aura

objects.text:
You have a personal shield that produces torrents of water in reaction to breaches. This shield is capable of blocking bullets and even hits from Brutes, with the resulting water torrent being proportional in size and strength, though as your shield has a limited amount of water contained within it will get weaker and smaller the more damage it takes. 

You can also travel by means of a personal tidal wave which likewise has a separate water pool it pulls from and can modulate both speed and size of it, provided your water supply allows it.

These supply pools replenish to full over the span of a few minutes if they go empty, though you can replenish them manually by being near natural water sources as your power gets both stronger and less limited with access to external supplies of water.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Hydrofoil

objects.text: Any impact that lands on you will be absorbed and increase your strength. It will still harm you as much as the level of impact can. The increase in strength is equal to the power of the impact and lasts as long as you've been hit within the last five minutes.
objects.title: (Brute) Yang it!

addons.text: Good News and Bad News. Good news, as long as you have energy, you are functionally immortal. To be exact, you can treat your internal energy reserves that sustains you as lifespan and vice versa. So you can store, in practice, endless amounts of energy and use it to boost any aspect of yourself and powers. This also gives you more advanced methods of energy gathering, giving you extremely high resistance to any energy based attacks, from lasers to radiation. Bad news, if you ever run out of energy, like a real Shard, you will probably die. After all, if your energy is your lifespan then running out means dying. Luckily, you also come inbuilt with Shard protocols so the chances of that happening without you actively overriding it is low.
addons.title: Energy Problems

objects.text: You steal the remaining natural lifespan of anything you kill, increasing your own lifespan. This can work on non-human races however when killing anything functionally immortal or with extremely long lifespans the effects are weakened, only giving you a maximum of 999 years with diminishing results. You can boost any part of your body, be it your strength or your regeneration, at the cost of your lifespan. If you have others powers you can boost that too. You have an instinctive knowledge on how long your lifespan is.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Life Taker

objects.text: You gain durability, speed, and strength proportional to the time spent out of combat. This reduces the longer you remain in combat but increases if you are outside conflict i.e. for the first 10 seconds, you are as strong as an Endbringer, but after an hour you are no stronger than an average human.
objects.title: (Brute) Cast Off!

objects.text: You have a protective aura that negates a single fatal attack regardless of what it was. This can only be used once per 30 seconds, and after usage, you will be immune to any and all forms of attacks, effects, and so on for 10 seconds.
objects.title: (Brute) Fatal Shield

objects.text:
You absorb pure water through your skin's pores. Any non-H2O content is automatically filtered out and remains on your skin's surface. For every one liter of pure water you absorb, you convert that water directly into one pound of living human flesh. 

This flesh can repair any wound, replace lost tissue, regenerate organs, or regrow entire limbs, provided you absorb enough water to cover the required poundage. The transformation is automatic and localised; you do not need to consciously direct it, though you can accelerate healing in a specific area by concentrating water contact there. 

Absorption speed is not fixed but instead depends on environmental contact. Full immersion in fresh water allows rapid intake, while mist or humidity provides negligible healing. You cannot convert your own body's water into flesh, nor can you create excess tissue beyond restoring your baseline human form. 

If you absorb water with no wounds to heal, the water passes through your system without conversion.
objects.title: (Brute) Sponge

addons.text: While you are physically slow when being observed, it is when you are unseen that your true power shines through. When unobserved, even just for a moment, you can freely instantaneously accelerate to move at speeds of up to 30 metres a second. Your reflexes, reactions and thought speed are all increased to match your velocity. You will suffer no issues from friction or physical strain at these speeds and can also instantly decelerate, ignoring momentum.
addons.title: Don’t Blink

objects.text: When you are seen, you gain a durability equivalent to that of the Siberian, at the cost of being physically slowed. It would feel as if you were moving in deep water.
objects.title: (Brute) Skulking Angels

objects.text: Your natural regeneration is enhanced when you are asleep, allowing you to recover from physical injuries and mental fatigue much faster than normal. After sleeping for 8 hours, you will be at your peak, both physically and mentally.
objects.title: (Brute) Restful Night

objects.text: You have access to a web of energy that usually lies dormant under your skin, vastly increasing your durability and strength. You can extend this web to nearby objects, sacrificing portions of your durability until you withdraw it again. While objects are coated by the web, they exhibit the same durability and enhanced strength as your body does and can be controlled telekinetically by you. Your durability will not go below your baseline, and the higher your base durability, the more energy you have access to.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Defensive Position

objects.text:
Your body instinctively reconfigures itself in the moment, engaging every available muscle in perfect coordination whenever you perform a physical action. Whether you’re throwing a punch, scaling a wall, or even just walking, your entire musculature activates as a single, unified system. Like a seasoned fighter who punches with their hips, shoulders, and core without thinking, your body does this automatically, all the time, for every action. 

Not only does it draw on every muscle, it also instinctively brings your full weight to bear. Every motion becomes a whole-body act, leveraging not just your strength but the total mass of everything you’re carrying—including your own bodyweight and any gear—channelled seamlessly into each action.

In addition, your musculature adapts on the fly to match the physical demands of your actions. Sprinting? Your muscles immediately behave like those of a trained sprinter—fast-twitch dominant, explosive, light. Shifting to a lift? Your muscle fibres reorient to resemble those of a powerlifter—denser, slower, built for brute strength. 

These changes don’t add or remove mass; they instantaneously alter the nature of your existing muscles to best serve the current motion.

Layered over this is a constant, internal nudge—an intuitive mental sensation that adapts with your intent. When learning a new physical skill, it corrects errors, reinforcing better technique and speeding up your learning curve drastically. When performing a familiar task, it shifts to refine: helping you minimise wasted movement, optimise timing, and extract maximum force from every action with the least effort.
objects.title: (Brute/Thinker) Neuromorphic Reflex

addons.text: When your heart is destroyed, you become insanely strong, but that strength dissapears when it's healed. Not anymore, not while your still in the fight. When you obtain your boosts from your injuries, it won't dissapear outright if they are healed, instead sticking with you throughout the the whole fight.
addons.title: Pain not Wasted

objects.text: The more injured you are, the more powerful you become. You become stronger, faster, more durable, and react faster. This applies to your powers as well. You also possess a mild Brute power that keeps you standing even after your bones are broken. If you are on your last-minute stand, you could find yourself contesting an Endbringer in physical might with just an ordinary person's strength.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) No Pain, No Gain

objects.text:
You embody the power of repetition, growing stronger, tougher, or more skilled through deliberate and continuous effort. The growth starts small, almost imperceptible, but escalates with each consecutive action. The more you repeat without interruption, the greater the benefits, peaking before diminishing as your body demands rest.

For example, if you throw a punch, the first few repetitions might feel no different, but over time your strikes will grow faster, stronger, and more precise. By the hundredth punch, your power will have increased dramatically. This improvement, however, applies only to the specific action you are repeating. A stronger straight punch won’t make your uppercuts more powerful or improve your ability to block.

This growth only works when you are consciously and deliberately performing an action. Automatic or passive acts, like breathing normally or blinking, don’t trigger your ability. Interruptions also break the cycle, forcing you to start over from the beginning.
objects.title: (Brute/Thinker) Rinse and Repeat

objects.text:
Your strength, durability, and overall physical power increase in direct proportion to the number of people who admire and feel loyal to you. This connection doesn’t need to be personal; widespread admiration from strangers, fans, or followers can empower you just as well as the devotion of close allies.

When people express their admiration openly in your presence—through cheering, chanting, declarations of loyalty, or even acts of service or protection—the effect surges, providing a temporary boost in power. The surge lasts as long as the visible or vocal support continues.

The effect favors quantity over quality. While one person’s complete devotion may be powerful, even overwhelming, two people with half that intensity will strengthen you more. A room full of people with modest admiration will outmatch a single die-hard follower. True power comes from building a wide base of support—being loved, admired, or idolized by the many rather than the few. The effect is strongest when admiration takes the form of cult-like devotion or parasocial obsession. 

If you possess other powers, this admiration-fueled strength enhances them as well.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Fame

objects.text: If you are aware of an attack, it will not harm you. You can only be hurt by sneak attacks. If you're hit by an attack that's too quick for your mind to comprehend that it's there, you are not considered aware of it by your power.
objects.title: (Brute) Pridwen

objects.text: You possess a special form of durability that can ignore blunt attacks. Your body has a unique effect that influences how certain physics interacts with it. Attacks weaker than your defense will be completely negated even if physics says you should be launched. This also allows you to grab impossibly large objects without them breaking apart.
objects.title: (Brute) Solidarity

objects.text: You are strong and durable to an appreciably superhuman degree. Strong enough to lift 2500 kg with the same ease a normal man might lift 40. Durable enough to shrug off the fire from anti-material rifles, explosions on the scale of infantry manned rockets, and even the efforts of industrial cutting tools. This power also includes enhanced leverage and a false increase in mass when resisting blows.
objects.title: (Brute) Bee Proof

addons.text:
If you have a corona, it has become spread out across your body with redundancies. If you don't have a corona, then your consciousness is spread out across you in the same way. Even if you are reduced to a pile of meat, as long as there's a clump of stuff left over, you will survive. But that's not the true power of this mutation. 

Firstly, your severed parts no longer lose connection when they're gone. Instead, when you lose any part of your body, be it a limb, organ, blood or even skin cells, it begins to regenerate and grow at a slow but steady pace, eventually creating a copy of the body you had when it was lost. In order to create a full copy the lost piece needs at least 30% of your mass, which it can gain by fusing with nearby pieces. It takes weeks for these copies to fully grow, with diminishing returns with higher levels of regeneration. You control these other bodies like you control your own limbs and can move your core consciousness between them at will. Clone bodies you are not currently housed in will rot at an accelerated pace, scaling with regeneration, to deteriorate and becomes useless in a minimum of twenty-eight days.
addons.title: The Living Dead

objects.text: You possess extraordinary resilience, enabling you to endure severe injuries and remain alive even if your body is severely damaged, as long as your Corona Pollentia remains undamaged. Should any other part of the brain endure damage, you may experience a loss of bodily functions. Your regenerative capability is limited, requiring weeks to heal major wounds or lost limbs. You will also lose the need for sleep, food, and water. Your body will resemble a well-preserved corpse, as you will have no heartbeat, no need to breathe, and a low body temperature.
objects.title: (Brute) Zombie

objects.text: You are able to convert kinetic energy into mass, growing in size as objects strike them. You are immune to issues like the square-cube law and surface area problems; physics within your body is warped to behave like it would at normal sizes. The larger you are, the more force you can absorb completely.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Goliath

addons.text:
Your ability to control your skin has allowed you to weaponize your unbreakable skin. By manipulating your skin’s texture and density, you can alter your skin into makeshift weapons still possessing your All or Nothing effect. Examples include turning your hand into claws, your feet into hammers, and creating “spikes” along your back.

Your added control over your All or Nothing effect has given you the ability to selectively enhance certain parts of your skin to the detriment of others.

The enhanced health of your skin has also become enhanced health for you in general, giving a minor boost to your healing factor both in and out of seawater.
addons.title: Kishin

addons.text: The smell of desire~ Your skin now passively disrupts all powers attempting to affect you, whether they fall under Thinker, Master, Stranger, or any other classification. Before any ability can take effect, it must first pass a 60% skill check. If the attempt fails, the user must wait five minutes before trying again. Additionally, as a side effect, your All or Nothing effect has been notably enhanced in a manner of speaking, ensuring that even if another All or Nothing ability has enough power to bypass your defenses, it must still pass a second 60% skill check before taking effect.
addons.title: 60% of The Time, It Works Every Time

objects.text: You are UNBREAKABLE!!!, or at least your skin is, for the most part. Your skin now has a slight All or Nothing effect to it. This prevents it from being torn apart by other All or Nothing powers without significant force behind it to pierce through your protection, with your only other notable weakness being that it is only just skin deep, meaning you will still have to deal with pain, blunt force trauma, heat, radiation, etc. Things that can affect your gooey interior are fair game. In combination with this, you have been given a substantial all-around boost in all your other physical aspects, from looks, healing, strength, etc. Providing superhuman amplifications, though not enough to take down a whole squad of professional soldiers on your own. When coming into contact with seawater, you gain an accelerated healing factor.
objects.title: (Brute) Caeneus

addons.text:
It seems your blood is much more deadly now; its superheated and poisonous nature has combined to create a mixture that'll melt organic and inorganic material no matter the form your blood takes, searing and devouring anything that touches your blood. Not even Brute powers may counteract these effects.

You are immune to all of these effects yourself.
addons.title: Noxic Blight

objects.text:
You can ignite your blood internally to enhance your physical abilities, turning you into a steam engine that vents out gouts of super-heated steam from your body whenever this power is active. Alternatively, you can build up internal pressure and unleash a jet of super-heated blood and steam from your hands, capable of slagging steel within seconds of contact. With enough practice, this ability can extend to any part of your body, not just your hands.

To sustain this power, you regenerate blood at an astounding rate—roughly ten times your body weight in blood per day—ensuring a near-constant supply for you to use. This ability also comes with an accelerated healing factor and enhanced durability to withstand the intense strain of internal combustion.
objects.title: (Brute/Blaster) Boiling Blood

addons.text: Your brain and heart have both become sources of your regeneration. As long as one of these two organs remains whole, you will be able to regenerate your entire body.
addons.title: Two Point Regeneration

addons.text:
Due to no longer having a Heart for your regeneration to originate from, your ‘point’ of regeneration is now your entire vascular system.

As long as even the tiniest bit of your postcapillary venules remain, you will eventually be able to regenerate the rest of your body.
addons.title: Discount Deadpool

objects.text: Your regeneration is simple. So long as your heart is whole and able to beat, you can regenerate 25% of your body mass in one minute. But to reiterate, this is only the case so long as your heart is able to function. You can even regenerate your brain. Beyond your heart, there are no requirements, as you can regenerate without requiring sustenance.
objects.title: (Brute) High-Speed Regeneration

objects.text:
It seems you have been gifted the power of a woolen shield! Albeit in a very unusual way. From clusters of pores on your body, you secrete a slime that, for aesthetic purposes, you can choose the color of, turns into sheep wool! If you were to stand in traffic with your body fully covered, you could survive multiple vehicles colliding into you, and not damage the vehicles outside of them damaging each other.

The Wool also conducts and dissipates dangerous materials. If someone were to pour acid on your wool, it would just neutralize the acid and be like dumping a drink on it. Electricity would warm you up like a toasty blanket over you. However, a sufficiently sharp blade or powerful enough esoteric attacks can penetrate the wool. You also need to concentrate to speed up the growth process, even if you don't need to do the same to shed any excess wool.
objects.title: (Brute/Changer) Baa Baa

objects.text: You possess a repulsive field around yourself radiating from your skin capable of deflecting and stopping objects or projectiles, being free to use this power to move or push people or things as you like. You can manipulate the field’s strength and precision how you please, where you turn it down in some parts of the body while working on others. You modulate its strength and thickness with the operating logic of the further out the power extends, the weaker the outward pressure exerts, exponentially increasing the closer it is to you.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Relentless Pressure

objects.text: You can only take so much damage at a time, regardless of how much damage you should be taking. The severity of damage is also reduced to a set amount. A single attack will gouge out a teaspoon of your flesh at most. Beams are not considered a single attack.
objects.title: (Brute) Ablation

objects.text: You can create and manipulate an unlimited number of small shields, each about 1 cm in length and 0.5 cm thick. You have unlimited multitasking and can move them around, but your range is only 1 inch from your body. Each shield will break at the force of an ordinary punch. The shields act as a repulsive force, allowing you to use them to push people away from you. The shield’s repulsive force and durability grow stronger when used alongside multiple other shields. These shields are transparent on one side, allowing you to see through, while others will see a blank surface.
objects.title: (Brute/Master) Implacable

addons.text: While you still weren’t bitten by a radioactive spider, your Shard coincidentally recreated abilities from our favorite webhead, with a facsimile of Spider-Sense and creating organic webs from your wrists aside from his physical abilities. Your physical abilities are deepened on maneuverability’s side: your reflexes are 40x better than a normal human possesses (in conjunction with Danger Sense you’re almost capable of evading any attack), and your agility and dexterity give you better and wider acrobatic and aerobatic talent, your “Spider-Sense" can have a few other quirks, too, such as using your Danger Sense as a Radar to suss out the danger around you or which direction it comes from.
addons.title: Itsy-Bitsy Spider

objects.text: While you weren't bitten by a radioactive spider, you have super strength, the power to stick to walls, and enhanced balance and coordination. You have the proportional strength of a spider and can lift over 12 tons. Your hands and feet can stick to anything, regardless of if you're wearing gloves or shoes. You can pull them off with little effort, but it is nearly impossible for anyone else to do so.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Spider-Man

objects.text:
You are now able to build up kinetic energy in your body through repetitive motions. This kinetic energy will give a red glow that brightens as more kinetic energy is stored. The kinetic energy can also be stored for later use. When you use this kinetic energy, you can choose to strengthen your body, increase your speed, or make yourself stronger, but it all depends on how much energy you’ve built up. There is, however, a limit on the amount of energy that you can output, as you cannot output more energy than would come out of a ballistic missile.

You can also, if you have other powers, use your stored-up energy to boost them proportional to how much energy you have stored.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Fa Jin

addons.text:
You now passively gain strength from all those who have fallen under your influence as part of your “gang.” This draw is constant, requiring no conscious effort on your part, and it doesn’t weaken those you pull from.

The efficiency of this passive gain still hinges on loyalty. The more deeply influenced a person is, the larger the share of their strength you receive. Someone just beginning to feel the subtle push of your social gravity contributes only the barest trace of power, while those fully immersed in your gang’s identity—those whose loyalty has been completely shaped by you—provide a much more significant share. The cap sits at thirty percent of a person’s strength, a maximum that can only be reached when their loyalty to you is absolute.

Importantly, this passive gathering of power is entirely separate from your direct draining. You can still actively strip strength from specific followers to supercharge yourself even further.
addons.title: And That’s How Mafia Works

objects.text:
You are able to drain the physical strength of those who are loyal to you, directly pulling their power into your own body. This process is not perfectly efficient—there is always some energy loss, but how much is lost depends entirely on the depth of their loyalty to you. When loyalty is weak or shallow, the drain is severely wasteful.

If you were to pull five units of strength from someone like this, four might be lost in the process, leaving you with only one. However, as their loyalty deepens, the losses diminish. From followers who truly respect and commit to you, you can draw their strength with minimal waste, siphoning it cleanly into your own body.

At the pinnacle of devotion, where their loyalty is complete and unquestioning, the process reverses entirely. When you drain five units of their strength, not only is nothing lost—you gain extra. Their loyalty actively amplifies what you receive, allowing you to draw five and walk away with six or more. Their belief in you feeds you more than their bodies ever could.

The process weakens your followers as you drain them, stripping away their strength directly. Their muscles become sluggish, their physical capabilities dulled until they recover naturally over time. How quickly a follower recovers depends on both their physical health and the strength of their loyalty—the healthier and more loyal they are, the faster their strength returns.

The boost in strength you receive is temporary, lasting for half the time it takes for the follower you drained to fully recover. The stronger and more devoted your followers, the longer you can sustain the borrowed power, but no strength taken ever lasts forever.
objects.title: (Brute) Level 100 Mafia Boss

objects.text:
You have access to two distinct Brute states, each determining how physical attacks affect you.

In the first, you are completely immune to any attack that covers more than one square inch of your body upon impact. This renders you invincible to blunt force strikes, shockwaves and heavy punches but still vulnerable to piercing and slashing attacks such as bullets or blades.
