In the second state, the rule is reversed. You become immune to all attacks covering less than one square inch of surface area. As such, arrows and other penetrating attacks cannot harm you though larger area impacts can. You can shift between these two states at will.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Achilles' Body

objects.text:
Your body is no longer a fixed baseline, but a self-refining system that improves through use. Physical effort, strain, and repetition reshape your biology, allowing you to rapidly approach and surpass peak condition while still looking like your default appearance, such as Human-like. Days of exertion produce results comparable to months, and your limits continue to rise.

At baseline, your body is superhuman. You possess strength sufficient to lift several tons, speed and coordination beyond Olympic levels, and durability capable of withstanding heavy impacts, small arms fire, and extreme physical strain. Your endurance allows sustained output with minimal fatigue.

This improvement is entirely physical. Your muscles, bones, nerves, and organs optimize toward efficiency and resilience. Your oxygen usage sustains prolonged exertion, your joints endure extreme stress, and your internals remain stable under harsh conditions.

Your physiology eliminates inefficiencies. Gains stabilize once achieved, maintaining peak condition without degradation. Strain, injury, and environmental stress become adaptations, reinforcing your body against repeated exposure.

Your nervous system operates with precision, synchronizing perception and motion. You instinctively correct errors mid-action, align force and timing with high accuracy, and react with fluid, controlled movement. This grants advanced balance, timing, and spatial awareness that can border on predictive motion.

Your adaptations grow while remaining biologically grounded. Your strength, resilience, and efficiency can increase far beyond your starting point, developing specialized optimizations based on what you endure.

Finally, you possess awareness of your physical state. You recognize inefficiencies and strain as they occur, and your body corrects them over time, ensuring continuous refinement toward a more efficient form.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Enhanced Physique

addons.text:
Your biological armor has developed qualities reminiscent of a certain iconic symbiote from a distant alternate universe.

It makes use of excess hyper-compressed biomass to create limbs or additional biological weapons for its own use. This makes your biological armor lighter, granting greater agility and speed in combat and survival capabilities. However, this significantly reduces your defense; it is still reversible simply by retracting the new parts back into your armor to restore its incredible durability and weight. In this way, you can rapidly alternate between forms focused on lightning-fast attacks and a form centered on high-power strikes.

Additionally, you can detach portions of your compressed biomass and give them pre-programmed orders—whether simple or complex—to perform any task autonomously using the abilities you have granted through your Tinker specialty. Their appearance and regenerative capabilities are limited by the amount of biomass you provide. Through these symbiotes, your process of gathering nutrients and biomass becomes highly efficient, yielding greater gains in a short period of time. Your biological armor receives the same benefits.

The natural advantages granted by the biological armor are now applicable in your base form, and you can even perform partial transformations with precise control.
addons.title: False Klyntar

addons.text:
Your armor has acquired new combat and survival capabilities.

Your form resembles a muscular ape, exuding a fierce and savage image. But you know that it secretly hides a highly efficient and resilient predator.

Both your wool and the biological armor fuse completely to create a layered defense that utilizes the hypercompression of biomatter. As you delve deeper, each layer becomes more resistant than the one before. The final layer, separating your true body from the armor, provides a defense that only a high-level Brute like Alexandria or Lung at max level can break.

If you possess an extra reserve of biomass, you can regenerate your new, enhanced armor.  But the more layers are damaged, the longer it takes to regenerate.

Your weapons receive the same level of protection, but they become the opposite of defensive when you attack. If you were fire-resistant, your weapons absorb the heat and transform it into a hot blade. If you were resistant to electric shocks, your weapons take on a form capable of mimicking a railgun or a powerful, lethal taser.

Any type of physical or kinetic damage is reduced to a point where you appear invulnerable. This doesn't make you immobile; you can still be pushed or dragged if someone manages to overcome your body weight.
addons.title: Ozaru

objects.text:
You have the disturbing ability to form weaponry and armor out of your biological matter. Your armor and weaponry start off comparable to steel in durability but are much lighter as they grow in strength alongside your body. When activated, this power makes it seem like a blackish-red mass is poring out of your skin and hardening into your weapons and armor. This comes with multiple perks, including the weapons and armor that can retract into your body; they can "heal"; you can use the biological matter to heal yourself; and lastly, they can be affected by any power that strengthens your body. When they retract inside their body, they enter a hyper-compressed state, ensuring that they do not hinder you or are visible in any way, but you are still affected by their weight. 

A downside is that, due to them being made of your biological matter when they repair themselves and are created, they use your nutrients and flesh. With time, you may implant your biological armory into others, with them starting out as being affected by your body's abilities, but over time they will lose that trait as they get repaired through their new host.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Biological Armory

objects.text:
Your strength, durability, and abilities, as well as those of your allies, grow as the size of your group increases, though the effects are relatively modest in smaller numbers. With fewer than ten allies, the enhancement is barely noticeable, offering only minor boosts. The power becomes significant when the group grows to the hundreds, peaking in potency at around 500 individuals. At this point, each member’s abilities are amplified to nearly 20 times their original strength. Beyond this, the effects taper off, with diminishing returns, making additional members provide increasingly smaller contributions to the overall boost.

This amplifies both physical capabilities and powers, scaling dynamically with the group’s composition. A fighter becomes faster and stronger, a healer more efficient, and powers gain increased range and intensity. 

The boost relies on both proximity and cohesion among group members, as each individual under its influence acts as a relay, extending the range of the effect. This creates a network where the amplification can spread across greater distances, provided the members remain within range of one another. However, the power offers no inherent coordination or unifying influence, leaving the group’s effectiveness entirely dependent on their ability to work together. If members become disorganized, scattered, or fail to align their efforts, the amplification weakens substantially, diminishing its overall potency and causing individuals to revert closer to their original strength.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Power in Numbers

objects.text:
When chasing or stalking someone or some goal, you slowly but surely grow impervious to any obstacle that might come between you and your mark. At first, going through a fence or door can injure not as severely as usual when barging in, with only bruises or hematomas as proof. 

Then, gradually at the 2-hour mark, these start to be less and less severe, even slowly recovering at a faster pace, growing stronger and stronger as your body grows paradoxically in density and swiftness, it doesn't speed you up, but it does make you light on your feet, jumping from 1 to 4 stories and acrobatically evading anything between you and the mark. Enough time with your cat and mouse chase, or at the 8-hour mark, you've become a Brute of the likes of Gavel or Alexandria, as long as you keep chasing.
 
Finally catching or missing your mark or goal, you'll gradually lose your strength until you're left relatively powerless.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Unyielding Pursuit

objects.text: You can shoot weak beams of energy from your hands, but your real power is to charge your fists with your strongest Blaster powers and unleash them at point-blank range without hurting yourself. Your body and clothing gain the properties of your Blaster powers. You are as durable and fast as your best Blaster powers, even taking their traits. If you can control your long-range attacks from a distance, you can fly. If one of your Blaster powers is All-or-Nothing, you are also immune to anything that is not All-or-Nothing. This power also extends to your clothing. Even your reaction speed is enhanced based on your fastest attacks.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Starlight Punch

addons.text:
The soft limit that used to hold you back is gone. You no longer need to rest or avoid strenuous activity to generate energy at peak speed. Before, your generation slowed down the more you moved and fought. Now? You generate energy at that same ideal rate all the time, whether you are sleeping, sprinting, or in the middle of a brawl.

On top of that, the stronger and tougher your baseline body is, the faster your energy builds up. With time, the amount of energy you will generate will also increase the more energy you have stockpiled. Just having a lot of it stored up gives you a passive boost across the board. The more you have saved, the better this boost becomes. This effect is only about one percent of what you would get if you actually burned through that energy all at once, but it is passive and has no cost making it far more reliable.
addons.title: Growing Stockpile

objects.text:
You naturally generate and store a unique form of energy over time. When you are resting or not engaging in physically strenuous activities, your energy generation rate increases. This stored energy can be used to strengthen your physical capabilities or amplify any other powers you possess. The energy reserves have no strict limit, allowing you to accumulate energy endlessly. However, as your stockpile grows larger, the rate at which you generate energy decreases, creating a soft limit on how much energy you can accumulate at any given moment. 

At the peak of this soft limit, unleashing all of your stored energy grants you immense power, placing you just below the level of an Endbringer for a few minutes before your reserves are entirely depleted. Reaching this soft limit takes a minimum of one week under optimal conditions.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Stockpile

objects.text: You have a charge that has a maximum capacity of fifteen minutes. It regenerates at a rate of 1 minute of use per minute of disuse, and does not regenerate when in use. Using this charge makes you totally invulnerable to all attacks, except for other offensive All or Nothings which it mutually annihilates with, though this disables your invulnerability for a few seconds.
objects.title: (Brute) Invulnerable

objects.text:
You're the bargain bin version of Alexandria. Now to put that into actual terms of what your power can do. I’ll start with your not-invulnerability.

Your body now experiences damage at a much slower rate than normal; this means that if you were to be hit by a truck, your body wouldn’t show damage till hours later. However, all it'll do is break down the moment, for example, if something as strong as Leviathan were to hit you, it will kill you in one minute as opposed to one second. However, it is worth noting that with lower-level injuries, your body's natural ability to heal can heal injuries as they occur, i.e., if you were shot, your body would heal you at the same rate you receive the damage, making it as though you were never shot.

You also possess super strength, enough to lift nearly a hundred tons. Now, while that sounds like a lot, it isn't. Additionally, you have a rather unique ability to decrease the effects of gravity on your body whenever you jump, which, paired with your superstrength, can allow you to leap tall buildings in a single bound.

Finally, your brain has also been made extremely efficient, allowing you to process and interpret information rapidly, making you a genius.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Library Junior

addons.text: Now, as you heal from whatever injury was granting your enhancement, you find that you retain some of the added strength or combat skill ontop of that gained from (Brute/Trump) Zenkai Boost. The proportion of the boost that is based on how long it takes to heal. Less than a day would keep around 1% of the boost, while a year you see you keeping over 90%.
addons.title: Comeback Kid

objects.text:
You can now grow stronger after recovering from an injury. This boost not only enhances your physical abilities but also amplifies the strength of all your other powers.

Minor injuries, such as small cuts or bruises, provide only a slight increase in power—typically just a few percentage points. More serious injuries, like broken bones or nonlethal traumatic wounds, can significantly boost your power by 50% to 75%. However, critical injuries, such as gunshot wounds, severe blood loss, or the loss of a limb, offer the most dramatic increase, multiplying your power by 3 to 5 times.

You also possess a moderate healing factor that ensures you recover to perfect health over time, helping you survive these injuries.

This healing factor allows broken bones to heal within a couple of weeks and missing limbs to regrow in a month or two. However, be warned: fatal injuries, such as decapitation or being stabbed through the heart, will still kill you. So, don’t fight recklessly your healing factor is not on the same level as Wolverine or Deadpool, at least not yet.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Zenkai Boost

objects.text:
You can now enter a super-empowered state known as Overdrive Mode. In this state, both your physical abilities and any other powers you possess are pushed into overdrive, amplifying them far beyond their normal limits in exchange for significant strain on your body.

Your ability to use this power is directly tied to your physical health and fitness. The healthier and more athletic you are, the more strain your body can withstand while maintaining the state.

For example, an average adult in good health could sustain a 10× increase in power for about one minute and would likely experience only exhaustion afterward. An Olympic-level athlete, however, could maintain the same 10× increase for approximately three to four minutes.

The greater the power multiplier, the heavier the toll it takes on your stamina and body. Lower multipliers can be sustained for longer periods, while higher multipliers can only be maintained briefly.

For instance, instead of a 10× increase for one minute, you could choose a 2× increase for five minutes—or do the opposite and push for a 100× increase for only a second or two.

Unless you possess additional powers or superhuman physiology to offset the strain, it is strongly recommended that this ability be used sparingly and within safe limits. Overuse places immense stress on the body and may lead to severe injury or even death.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Overdrive Mode

objects.text:
You can manifest floating rings of light around parts of your body or weapons you are holding. These rings are a mere visual representation of your power and have no direct effect on the environment. However, whatever it is they are wrapped around will have its power doubled for each ring. The exact form this amplification takes depends on the intended purpose of what is being amped. Wrapping a ring around your fist will make it punch harder but give no benefit to your legs. A sword will cut sharper and deeper while a gun would fire bullets with greater force and speed. These rings can also be used in conjunction with other powers to similarly enhance them, such as making flames burn even hotter if you shot fire from your hands.

Multiple rings can be manifested at a time and each individual one can be moved around you instantly at will, but using these rings incurs mental fatigue, which grows more severe with each ring used at once. Furthermore, maintaining these rings for prolonged periods of time rather than using them in quick bursts can prove excessively draining.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Mang

objects.text:
You are ostensibly one of the strongest Brutes to live, able to exert All-or-Nothing levels of force on par with the Siberian, with one caveat: you have no way to generate any form of artificial leverage with this power.

If you were to try and push against a steel wall, the concrete beneath your feet may fail and cause you to slide back instead. No force is capable of stopping you from moving your body, but it remains completely up to you to figure out how to get leverage. It's recommended to learn grappling, as using yourself as leverage is a great way to get the most from your strength.

This grants you a form of durability that negates damage in your direction of motion, mostly to stop you from breaking your bones or tearing apart your body as you press against things much more durable than yourself.
objects.title: (Brute) Stronk

addons.text:
You can now have multiple Phylacteries at once, and can now leave them away from you without losing their effects. However, doing so will make you feel hollow and irritated. 

All of your Phylacteries also gain a sliver of you within them, something like a projection made in your image to protect the Phylactery.
addons.title: Hocruxes

objects.text:
You can mark an object and turn it into a Phylactery. To do so, you have to place the object inside a special circle you power helps you make. The time it takes for the object to turn into a Phylactery depends on the size and complexity of the object, for example a simple doll will only take a few minutes whereas a piece of tinkertech can take over a few weeks and an entire city could take well over a year.

You can only have one Phylactery at a time. When a Phylactery is being made, you will be weakened, constantly sick, irritable and sometimes pained. You cannot be far from the object when making a Phylactery, even after it is made you cannot be too far from it, as if you are you lose its effects.

When you have a Phylactery, your body undergoes a change. First, you gain an All or Nothing defence that makes it that any damage below a certain threshold is completely nullified. Even if the damage exceeds this threshold, it is instead weakened to 10% of their original damage. Your body’s durability itself also increases, making tank shells necessary to leave a scratch you. Last but not least, you regenerate at an absurd rate, you can regain entire limbs in a matter of minutes.

If your Phylactery is destroyed, you will be temporarily weakened and lose its effects. It also hurts like crazy.
objects.title: (Brute) Phylactery

objects.text: You are a regenerator, with a twist. Your regeneration works via massively enhanced metabolic processes, creating a large amount of heat when used. You can control the speed of this healing, anywhere from a mild fever for above human healing to an explosion of flame for near instant regeneration. You are extremely resistant to the heat and force made from your regeneration, but a big enough burn will cause enough injuries to initiate a secondary one. This does not increase your need for sustenance, and is 'true' regeneration.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Pyrexia

objects.text:
Your have the ability to coat your arms in a “armored skin” that grants your arms enhanced durability equal to that of steel rather than skin. Additionally whenever your arms are in this state you gain additional strength allows you to lift up to ten tons however with no additional ability to manage leverage. Finally your left and right arms serve different purposes.

Your left arm is meant for attacking, as it has the ability to distribute kinetic energy and damage throughout whatever it comes into contact with as if you had punched every square inch of whatever you hit. However there is a limit to the amount of area that it can cover, stopping at around the overall area equivalent to an eighteen wheeler.

Your right arm is meant for defense, as attacks and impacts are mitigated when you use this arm to block as they are absorbed into your arm and cause you no harm, truly representing the survivability of a brute. However there is a limit to how much punishment your right arm can handle, stopping around the level of high power explosions and the like.
objects.title: (Brute/Changer) Two Good Arms

objects.text: You have the combined strength, speed, and durability of everyone within ten meters of you. Good against Brutes, not so much against Blasters.
objects.title: (Brute) Mine, Mine, Mine!

objects.text:
You have Glory Girl or Antares’ durability and strength. Any impact stronger than a bullet shot from a pistol will pop your shield, but it can take any impact without taking damage. When the shield is down, you no longer have enhanced durability, but you still have your super-strength. Your shield will regenerate after one or two seconds, longer if it was a sustained impact. Your enhanced strength is enough to allow you to lift 30 tons. Due to the nature of your enhanced strength, you'll still get tired from keeping your hand raised too long since it doesn't help counter gravity.

Additionally, this protects you from non-physical attacks, including poisons, sickness, Trumps, Masters, Strangers, reality warpers, precogs, and any power that directly affects others.

You lose all these immunities when your barrier is down.
objects.title: (Brute) Telekinetic Barrier

objects.text: As long as even a cell of you survives, you can regenerate from it. A cut will heal almost immediately. A severed head will take a while, and will regrow from the head. You can not use this power to create clones. If your Corona Pollenta and Corona Gemma are near-simultaneously hit by a power that heavily deals in and/or relies on portals and dimensional shenanigans, you will die.
objects.title: (Brute) Deadpool

objects.text:
You can manifest a single snake-like construct from your back. Its thickness can be anywhere between a normal finger and a head, but it can only be extended up to 10 meters. Your construct can use any mundane poison/venom through its fangs and blood. You and your construct are immune to any mundane poison/venom.

If you suffer a fatal head injure while your construct is out, you will keep living and be quickly healed, and you will also be able to manifest a additional construct while the maximum length of your constructs is increased by 50 centimeters.

The previous effect also applies to your constructs, though with them any fatal injury works.

Your constructs are as durable as a snake of their size would be and their senses are connected to you, meaning that while you can for example see through them—thus allowing you to see heat through them—you also feel their pain.
objects.title: (Brute/Master) Hydra

objects.text:
The purpose of numbers in a fight is to overwhelm, to wear you down through sheer persistence. Even if the individuals are weak, their strength lies in their numbers. But for you, that concept is meaningless. Numbers no longer matter. Whether you’re facing ten or a hundred, your power renders them indistinguishable.

For example, if an opponent is too weak to match you in a one-on-one fight, no amount of them together can overpower you—their strength doesn’t stack. On the other hand, if an opponent is your equal and capable of facing you one-on-one, adding more of them won’t improve their chances. The difficulty remains the same, and your odds of victory are unaffected, regardless of how many you face.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Numbers? I Don't Know How To Count

objects.text: You can gradually amplify your muscle fibers, eventually reaching a point where they can't be contained by your skin. You gradually gain mass and height while doing this, and after 5 minutes of changing, you will be at your maximum of 50 feet high. You will look like a giant made of muscle and have strength comparable to Alexandria. Any injuries caused by your transformation, such as your skin tearing open, are repaired as you transform back.
objects.title: (Brute/Changer) Yeah, I Lift

objects.text:
You are decently superhuman—you can tear through brick walls like wet paper mache, have reflexes comparable to a cat, receive only mild bruising from the most powerful conventional firearms, and can punch and kick at Mach speeds.

However, the real meat of this power is the ability to mentally direct the kinetic energy your body produces with every action while preventing it from dispersing in every direction, focusing that energy along paths you desire. This lets you do things like punch the air and have it be a viable and controllable ranged attack.

This manipulation of kinetic energy scales with how much kinetic energy you can produce as it will still dissipate over time and distance no matter how tightly you compress and direct it.
objects.title: (Brute/Blaster) Mantis Shrimp

objects.text: You will always be as strong as necessary to exert as much force as the strongest blow that you've ever been hit with. This increases both durability and strength.
objects.title: (Brute) Rocky

objects.text: You are a premier Brute on a level short of only Alexandria herself. Capable of throwing around main battle tanks like an E-girl might throw her cat and shrugging off anything short of a tactical nuke. You are immovable by outside forces, but be careful as you will take the full force of any blow, though lesser assailants will find themselves breaking upon your body.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) The Duke

addons.title: Star Platinum: Za Warudo
addons.text: Your ability to stop time is now a lot more flexible, even having a much shorter cooldown. You may stop time for any amount of time up to 5 seconds, with the cooldown being much lower depending on the condition you're in. The minimum cooldown is equal to the amount of time you stopped time for, with injuries and fatigue increasing this cooldown. The highest your cooldown can be is 60 seconds, with that only being possible if you were to stop time for 5 seconds while being heavily injured and exhausted.

objects.text:
Your body's strength, speed, precision, and even eyesight have been elevated to truly bizarre levels.

Your strength is at such a level that you can throw around cars, break diamonds the size of boulders with a barrage of your fists, all with a durability to match. This physical might even extends to your internal organs, allowing you to do something like sucking with such force that you can inhale all the mist blanketing an entire village into your lungs, something that could be a great boon against certain Breaker states.

Your speed and precision is potent enough that you can deflect barrages of projectiles with your fists, perform delicate surgery with ease, intercept bullets, and even catch a bullet shot point-blank at you.

Your eyesight and mental acuity is such that you can make out meaningful details from long distances, perfectly follow the shuffling of a deck of cards, and in tandem with your speed and precision draw a photo-realistic image of something you see in mere seconds.

Most bizarrely, your shard has given you minor shapeshifting as an extension of the precision you hold over your body. This shapeshifting mostly allows you incredible flexibility, balance, and minor control over the shape of your physique. By truly pushing it you could do something such as temporarily extend the length of a finger or two by a few feet.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Bizarre Physique

objects.text: When fighting with those you truly care about, you and they will grow stronger until together you are as strong as your opponents' combined power. This does not take into account skill or their ability to work together unless that skill/ability is Parahuman in nature (Like Contessa, Victor, or Teacher).
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Stronger Together

objects.text:
You can generate a force-field exoskeleton armor around your body, suspending you safely within the torso. The armor is a semi-translucent color of your choice—that you can see through without issue—and can be reshaped to fit your personal style, ranging in height from 4 to 8 meters.

The armor mimics your movements with enhanced strength—powerful enough to throw tanks or lift locomotives. It can protect the user from all forms of damage as long as it remains intact, only breaking against certain exotic all-or-nothing effects or high-powered and/or sustained levels of force. You are able to almost instantly restore the armor upon destruction or damage, provided you are still conscious.
objects.title: (Brute/Striker) Armor

addons.text:
First off, your two forms of All-or-Nothing protection haven't merged. Instead, they now stack on top of each other, meaning you would need to be hit with two seperate All-or-Nothing attacks within less than a second to hope to damage you.

Secondly, while in sea water you are capable of healing even in your invioable state. This makes you perhaps one of the hardest capes to kill on Earth Bet.
addons.title: Unbreakable²

addons.text:
You can cause your body to become completely inflexible. Alexandria herself couldn't move a hair on your head in this state, though she could still pick you up and throw you around.

You can do this to your body as a whole or just to individual parts, such as effecting only your hand to make your strikes hit harder, similar to brass knuckles.
addons.title: Statue

objects.text:
You are indestructible. You don't require sustenance, sleep, or air, and are immune to effects that would directly affect your body, such as Panacea's biokinesis, as well as things such as disease or poison. As a side effect of this, you do not age.

You aren't any less flexible, and are no harder to throw around. If you encounter another All-or-Nothing effect, this power will take around a second to recover, during which time you will be vulnerable.

If something harms you in this vulnerable state, the wound will remain as-is and will cease to bleed, worsen, or cause pain. This means that unless something kills you within the few moments of vulnerability, you will be no worse for wear, beyond having an unhealing wound.
objects.title: (Brute) Unbreakable

objects.text:
You can shift your brain out of reality. While in this state anything that would normally affect your brain, won’t. Whether it’s emotion-affecting powers or a sword through your head, as your brain plainly isn’t there. 
The rest of your body will function as usual, yet any negative signals your body would send to your brain will not arrive when in this state, whether pain or negative emotions.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Brainless Behavior

objects.text:
No matter what kind of injury you obtain or damage you sustain, your skin will remain as beautiful and perfect as always, even if you’re cleaved in two, get struck by a thousand slashes or get immolated, your skin won’t look any different. What’s underneath on the other hand… that cleave will still cut you into two, your skin will simply keep those two halves together, those thousand slashes might not be visible, but you’ll be shedding those thousands of blood drops internally nonetheless, and as for those 3rd degree burns, well you won’t have to worry about your beauty being marred, but you’ll still be suffering from it all the same.

This as such doesn’t truly protect you from any damage, it simply makes all attacks that would pierce your skin, skip past it. Even in the process of you being hurt there will be no visual confirmation of your injuries, except if your enemy can see inside of you or you spit out blood and the like.
objects.title: (Breaker/Stranger) Untouchable Skin

objects.text: You are highly resistant to all forms of poison, heat, electricity, and acid. You are totally immune to all forms of sickness and radiation. You are only moderately resistant to poisons that nullify your powers. You would die if you were on the surface of the sun for more than a couple of minutes. A lightning bolt would still mildly sting. A Tinkertech acid might still cause harm, if it's corrosive enough.
objects.title: (Breaker) Immune Response

objects.text: You can shift into a semi-gaseous state. While in this state, you can pass through walls as long as some part of you other than your feet go first. You can technically phase through the floor, but as long as your feet touch the floor first, you won't phase through it. You remain vulnerable to fire and electricity, and are especially vulnerable to strong winds. Strong winds won't kill you, but you can't exactly resist them. You are immune to bullets and lasers while in this state; they'll pass straight through you.
objects.title: (Breaker) Phase

objects.text:
Each of your pores is now equivelant to the sum total of all your orifices. Anything one of your orifices could intake or exude is now something your pores are capable of. What this means is that you can see, smell, hear, breath and even speak through the surface of your skin. This power is also applied through your hair despite them not having pores in typical sense.

This power comes with a Thinker aspects that helps you manage the senses that come with it. Any power that works through one of your orifices or their senses may now be applied via your pores and theirs.
objects.title: (Breaker/Thinker) Porous

objects.text: You are a rubber person. Or, really, just really elastic and not conductive. Blunt forces do no damage to you and you're resistant to heat. You could get crushed by Behemoth or punched by Alexandria and not get damaged. You do not have Haki, 2nd gear, 3rd gear, or any other gear that Luffy has in the anime.
objects.title: (Breaker) Gomu Gomu no Mi

objects.text: You can redistribute your mass any way you want across your body. This can help with a few situations; for example, put most of your mass at a point of impact to increase the strike's potency, put a lot of mass into your feet to greatly increase your balance, or climb surfaces more easily by distributing your mass across your fingers, your feet and your upper body. Any part of your body made heavier than normal through this also receive a proportional increase in durability, so that Newton's third law doesn't lead to your limbs exploding from a punch with increased mass.
objects.title: (Breaker) Balancing Act

objects.text: You are able to transform into a featureless grey blob. To enter this form, you must first choose your destination or direction. Once your target is locked, you transform and are propelled toward it at bullet-like speed, relinquishing all control over your trajectory, pace, or ability to maneuver mid-flight. In this form, your body becomes a pliable, resilient mass, impervious to most physical damage but vulnerable to being forcibly stopped by obstacles. Your transformation will end either upon reaching your intended destination or if your momentum is prematurely halted. If you are stopped prematurely, you will be disoriented.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Bullet

objects.text:
You can transform into a physically altered state where your body takes on grotesquely extended proportions. Your arms are abnormally long—dangling well past your hips, with a reach that lets you strike or grab several meters away without stepping forward. Your legs are equally exaggerated, granting you towering height—easily adding 2 meters to your stature—and allowing for massive, lurching strides that cover ground with unnatural speed. Your torso is elongated and flexible, giving your entire silhouette a strange, almost marionette-like verticality. Despite the warped look, your body remains solid and stable.

This transformation comes with a noticeable increase in strength. Your longer limbs give you powerful leverage, letting you strike with force that exceeds what your build would otherwise suggest. Punches and kicks carry crushing momentum due to the length of your wind-up, and your reach gives you a dominating presence in close quarters. Your flexibility increases alongside your length, allowing you to twist and maneuver in ways most would find unnatural—ducking under blows without bending your knees, rotating your torso farther than it should go, or reaching around cover with ease.

In this form, your body also processes damage in an unconventional way. Blows don’t distribute properly across your form; instead, the force of impact is compressed into smaller, localized zones without amplifying the damage itself. A hit that would normally knock someone back or spread shock through bone and muscle instead lands in a confined patch, leaving surrounding areas unaffected. This doesn’t make you immune to pain or injury, but it makes cumulative trauma less effective. A flurry of hits won’t wear you down the same way they would someone else, and area attacks lose efficiency, failing to affect your body as a whole.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Odd Proportions

objects.text: Your body explodes in a blast of light, streams of lightning, and fragments of crystallized energy. These fly off in a blast covering a distance of 30 feet. You reform from the blast where you originally were after a few seconds.
objects.title: (Breaker) Lightshow

objects.text: You can transform into crystal shards. Each shard contains a copy of your mind, which can control its shard telekinetically and is connected to the others through telepathic communication. There is no limit on the number of shards you can create, as long as your total volume remains the same and no single shard is smaller than a fingernail. However, as more shards are created, the more deviations in each copy of your mind. Additionally, the further away each shard is from the other, the harder it is to maintain telepathic communication. The optimal amount of shards (to get minimal mental deviations) is no more than 15, with the optimal range between each shard (for peak mental communication) being no higher than 10 meters away from each other. Upon reforming, all the minds fuse back into one. Fusing with minds that have deviated from the original may result in those deviations being retained.
objects.title: (Breaker/Master) Thousand Faces

objects.text: You can selectively ignore anything you put your mind to. Although only one thing at a time, this can range from guns making you fully immune to all gunfire to the ground, which lets you phase right through it. Ignoring the ground will cause you to shoot out from wherever you entered from at high speeds.
objects.title: (Breaker) Flicker

objects.text: You can, at will, instantly enter and exit a breaker state that inverts your colours. While in this state, all damage you take and deal is inverted, with light attacks dealing heavy damage and powerful attacks dealing next to no damage.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Inverse

addons.title: Super Protected
addons.text: The essence of a suit of armor is to protect the wearer. Now you can protect yourself from so much more. Your Ablative Armor now gains the ability to adapt to non-physical damage forms, such as fire or cold. If your armor is damaged and recovers without breaking, it will begin to adapt. This is not "true resistance" in the sense of preventing damage from occurring. Instead, it is a focused form of regeneration, tailored to counter the specific forms of damage it has encountered more efficiently. For example, an acid could burn through a fourth of the armor. But if tried again, it would make less progress as the armor already knows how to deal with such damage and begins healing even as it is damaged. However, a more potent acid would still overwhelm the regeneration and deal damage as normal. Additionally, the armor now serves as a form of all-purpose environmental protection. While the armor is active, you no longer need to breathe, your need for sustenance is greatly reduced, and you have a level of immunity to things like pressure, ambient radiation, temperature, and G-forces. This resistance is adaptive, similar to your defenses, and will grow through exposure to higher levels of it. Congratulations, you've now effectively received a super-spacesuit.

objects.text:
Your body is protected by an ablative energy barrier that absorbs damage like a health pool. As long as this barrier remains intact, incoming attacks deal no real harm. However, once depleted, any further damage directly affects you. This protective pool regenerates over time, but the mechanics of its recovery and growth depend on how it is used.

Fully depleting and allowing it to fully recover increases the maximum capacity of your HP pool, making it more resilient over time. Conversely, taking partial damage and letting it regenerate gradually increases the recovery speed, decreasing the time it takes to refill. The regeneration has a soft cap, preventing more than instant full recovery.

The durability of your armor scales proportionally to your strength/durability vs incoming damage. For reference, a 9mm bullet depletes 1 HP for an average human, and you begin with a base 10 HP, meaning you could withstand a full magazine of small-arms fire before the barrier collapses if you had no other powers.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Ablative Armor

addons.text:
Due to your Breaker state, you and your ghostly copies are able to phase and overlap with one another to a deeper degree. As such, when multiple duplicates occupy the same physical space as you or with each other, your properties can merge for a cumulative effect. 

For instance, if two duplicates overlapped with you, your physical attributes, such as durability, strength or momentum, would be effectively tripled. This enhancement also extends to any equipment carried, including armour and weapons.
addons.title: Ghostly Host

objects.text:
You can freely enter a Breaker state that grants you an extremely favourable Manton Effect, allowing you to effortlessly phase through all non-living matter while simultaneously interacting with living matter as normal.

Walls, armour and bullets become meaningless as you can simply pass through them without resistance. The effects of your Breaker state also extend to anything you wear or hold. Your clothing remains just as protective while melee weapons in your grasp will ignore any shields entirely, letting you strike your enemies directly.

While in this Breaker state, you also gain the ability to fly, though your maximum speed is limited to being as fast as your ordinary movements.
objects.title: (Breaker/Striker) Manton’s Ghost

objects.text:
Upon entering your Breaker state, your skin begins to flake and peel like shedding scales, revealing grotesque representations of your inner wounds—physical, mental, or other. These distortions are shaped not by the objective state of your body, but by your perception of harm. A minor psychological trauma might manifest as a massive, jagged blemish, while a life-threatening injury that you’ve mentally dismissed could appear nearly invisible.

Peeling these flakes away allows you to remove or diminish the issue they represent. In some cases, this can sever afflictions like trauma, master effects, or psychosomatic impairments. Lost limbs or organs appear as black, obsidian-like constructs, their connections to your real body ragged and spiked. By slowly shedding the surrounding flakes, you can regenerate what was lost, though it takes effort and time.
objects.title: (Breaker) Flaked Skin

objects.text:
You're unaffected by any attacks that wouldn't kill you within a minute. What this means is that, for example, if you were shot in such a way that wouldn't lead to you dying or bleeding out within 60 seconds, the bullet would instead bounce off you, as you become invulnerable and immovable to it.

But the reverse is also true: if you're hit by an attack that would kill you in a minute or less, you die from that attack immediately.

The check of whether or not you survive an attack doesn't take into account outside interference that could happen after you receive the attack, whether it be a friendly parahuman healing you or additional attacks on you making your condition worse.
objects.title: (Breaker) All or Nothing Defense

objects.text: This power comes with two effects. The lesser of the two is that it renders you largely immune to damage from environmental kinetic impacts-being thrown through walls, slammed into the ground, or falling from orbit won't even bruise you. Second and more importantly, the more injured you are, the easier it is for attacks and impacts to send you flying. A few scratches? You might be a little easier to push around. Open wounds? Somebody punching you will knock you out of the way of their follow-up attacks. Lacerated and nearly dead? People will find it difficult to land the finishing blow on you because every time they start to hit you, you'll ricochet away into the distance before they can cut deep enough to hit your organs.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) SETTLE IT IN

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate your speed in ways that defy logic. You can instantaneously reach your max speed or reach a full stop instantly. If you are capable of moving fast enough to break the sound barrier, you will not produce a sonic boom. Additionally, you can run into a person/object at max speed without turning them or yourself into a paste, allowing you to punch someone at max speed and not have your fist rip through them.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Speed Force

objects.text: You can "thin" your existence, diminishing your presence to the point where the rules of reality barely apply to you. In this state, you can defy gravity, pass through walls, or slip unnoticed through the world around you. However, if you thin yourself too much, there's a risk of fading completely out of existence.
objects.title: (Breaker/Stranger) Thin Existence

objects.text:
Your body functions like that of a video game character, with an internal health bar that tracks your vitality. No matter how much damage you take, your body remains visually intact, showing no wounds, bruises, or scars. Instead, all injuries are reflected purely by a reduction in your health bar. Even if an attack would normally break a bone or leave a deep wound, your physical form remains unchanged—until your health reaches zero.

Additionally, status effects appear as debuff icons beside your health bar rather than manifesting as gruesome injuries. Bleeding would appears as a persistent health drain, rather than actual open wounds. Broken bones limit movement or impose penalties to actions but leave no visible fractures. Poison, burns, and other effects function as ongoing damage-over-time or stat reductions, displayed as game-like icons instead of physical symptoms.

However, you are not invincible. If your health bar reaches zero, you’ll fall just like anyone else—whether you look hurt or not.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Gamer Body

objects.text:
You can shift your body into a humanoid mass of electromagnetic fields. While in this state, you are intangible in the conventional sense—bullets pass through you, physical attacks do nothing, and you are unaffected by most environmental hazards. However, your ability to interact with the world is entirely limited to electromagnetism.

You can manipulate electromagnetic forces to exert influence: magnetizing metal objects, generating electric currents, emitting radio signals, or interfering with electronics. You can move by pushing or pulling yourself along conductive surfaces, repelling off magnetic fields, or riding currents through power lines. Traditional touch, speech, and manipulation of non-conductive materials are out of your reach.

Your senses also shift to match this form. You no longer see with your eyes, but instead perceive the world through electromagnetic awareness—sensing electric fields, magnetic lines, radio waves, and the charged movements of electronic devices and currents. Living beings appear to you as networks of neural and bioelectric activity.
objects.title: (Breaker) Pulseform

objects.text:
You can grow a subdermal layer of any material you have touched, the layer forming underneath your skin. After growing this layer, you can tear away your existing skin to bring this material to the surface. Notably, you can also strategically tear different sections of your skin to give access to different layers. Regardless of the material’s usual strength it is always easy (if not clean) to remove.

24 Hours after creating the first layer, you can grow another subdermal layer of another material (including regular skin), up to a maximum of seven layers of different materials. For all intents and purposes you gain the effects of each of the layers, though only the layer on top though others can be torn off and exposed to the world, which would be necessary for most effects reliant on being in open air (ie not durability) like reflectiveness, specific chemical reactions or aesthetic purposes.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) “Strip His Skins and Show His Scars,”

objects.text: You can transform your body into a metallic physiology and alter your shape and composition to a degree. In this form, you are stronger and more durable than most. Your malleable physiology allows you to survive what would be fatal injuries to a baseline human. In this form, you can assimilate any metal you touch. This can be used to repair your form. If you fully transform, you gain a highly-favorable Manton Effect: powers that only affect organic beings tend to not affect you, and powers that only affect inorganic material also tend to not affect you.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Weld

objects.text: You can shrink yourself to the size of 1 cubic centimeter. You retain your human strength while in this form. You can grow back to normal with a thought.
objects.title: (Breaker) Ant Man

objects.text: You can shift into a Breaker state that has an alternate power set. You have a total of 10 SP to spend on powers for this form. It can't have Breaker or Changer powers. You do not have your original powers while in this form.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Other Side of the Coin

objects.text: You have the ability to perform multiple actions simultaneously on a quantum level. You are limited to 10 actions at the same time and all of them must be locked in the same single point of space you are standing in.
objects.title: (Breaker) Superposition

objects.text: You can enter a state where your temperature is absolute zero. Heat around you will be drawn inward, tugging on the matter as it passes. This effect grows stronger the longer you stay still.
objects.title: (Breaker) Solstice

objects.text: Your power has altered your biology, making your skin and muscles more flexible and able to move in ways that are beyond the norm. Your joints are multidirectional or omnidirectional, which allows for a greater range of movements. Your spine has become more flexible as well, allowing you to fold and twist your body in any direction along it. Your bones have also been altered, making them more rubbery and able to be stretched or flattened. Your internal organs also have the ability to function even when stretched or flattened, and your skin cannot be torn. Whenever you crack a joint, you not only do not feel the pain, the joint adjusts and heals to become more able to move in that direction.
objects.title: (Breaker/Stranger) Ragdoll

objects.text:
You can transform your body into a solid, unmoving statue. In this state, you gain an All-or-Nothing Defense, with attacks failing to harm you unless they are also All-or-Nothings.

When you enter this statue form, you impose a strange spatial lockdown on the world around you. The very moment you transform, you create a boundary that locks space itself, anchored to a fixed 10-meter radius around you. Anyone caught within this radius at the moment of transformation finds themselves utterly trapped, unable to cross the threshold no matter how far they try to run. The more they attempt to leave, the more distance they must cross—the 10 meters becomes an endless expanse they can never escape. No matter how far they walk, sprint, or teleport, the edge remains forever out of reach.

Likewise, anyone outside the radius when you transformed is completely unable to enter. The space folds against them, making the boundary impossibly distant, unreachable no matter how hard they try to close the distance. The area around you becomes a pocket of isolation, separating those inside from the outside world with an impenetrable, infinite barrier.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Warden

objects.text:
You can transform your body into that of a human-sized maggot. In this form, you are physically frail, your body vulnerable to even mild harm, and your pace sluggish and crawling. However, you are able to sense corpses in your vicinity. Once you find one, you can invade it, forcing your way inside through any available orifice, no matter how small or sealed.

Upon entering a corpse, you seize control of it completely, puppeteering it from within. You overclock its body beyond the limits it once knew, driving its physical performance to between 110% and 120% of what it could achieve at its absolute peak. However, “100%” in this case does not refer to the body’s normal output, but to the extreme, short-lived burst of hysterical strength that living humans can manifest in moments of life-or-death desperation. The fresher the corpse, the stronger the overclock. Newly dead bodies granting the full 20% enhancement, while more decayed ones remain yield less.

Although you gain none of the host’s memories, you can instinctively access their physical skills and reflexes through the lingering traces of muscle memory. You can fight, move, and act as they once did. You also retain any power they had in life, although without the instinctive connection and understanding they have, and tinker powers outright not work. 

During possession, your true maggot body remains completely unharmed, hidden and invulnerable within the host. This protection lasts only so long as the host remains viable; once more than half of the corpse is destroyed, you are forcibly expelled, reverting to your vulnerable form.

Once possessed, the corpse decays naturally, as if it had been properly buried, its flesh slowly succumbing to the quiet, inevitable pull of rot and time.
objects.title: (Breaker/Master) Maggot

objects.text:
You can enter a breaker state in which any external effect produced (items consumed, shots fired, powers used, etc) will be stored in a ‘queue’of five effects. From this queue, the next time you perform an action that would be added to the queue, you perform all actions inside the queue as well. Actions endemic to you, like punching or running would not enter the queue. 

For instance, if you had a Blaster power, firing it once at a target would fill one slot in the queue, then drinking a Tinkertech serum would fill another one. While drinking the serum it would fire another shot, and firing afterwould would both fire another shot of the blaster power and reproduce the effects of the serum. This would continue until either they are ‘pushed out’ of the queue or you deactivate the breaker state, which empties the queue.

Effects are added to the queue in the order they occur. Assuming multiple events happened in the exact same instant, your shard creates a random order.
objects.title: (Breaker) Echo Chamber

objects.text: You can enter and exit a mirror world through mirrors or reflective surfaces, identical to the real world in every way except it is devoid of living beings. The mirror world reflects the state of the real world, so cars will still move and such, and any action you perform in the mirror world will occur in the real one as well. You can't directly harm or observe any living beings, including the Endbringers and Entities.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Mirror World

objects.text: You can send yourself back in time by up to 5 minutes, replacing your past self but with all your future self's injuries and possessions, but you won't be able to use the ability again until you're back to when you time traveled from.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Puella Magi Homura Magika

objects.text: In Worm, the term “flying brick” was replaced by “Alexandria Package”. You, however, take the original term literally. You are able to turn into a flying brick, able to move up to 100km/h, and carrying the Kinect energy of a brick at that speed. You also have enough resistance equal to hit something at that speed and not break.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) The Flying Brick

objects.text: You can possess objects. Possessing an undamaged object will heal you, and possessing a heavily damaged object will heavily injure you. Unless the object is electronic in nature, you can do nothing while possessing an object. You still have all five senses when possessing an object. If the object is electronic you can control the object. You cannot control a living being with this power.
objects.title: (Breaker) Rotom

objects.text: You can enter a Breaker state in which your body is compressed and flattened in one direction, down to roughly the thickness of cardboard. In this state, you retain all the strength and durability of your normal form, concentrated down into your new volume without increasing your weight: Naturally, this increases your physical power, toughness and speed up to a mildly superhuman level, and pairs especially well with any other powers that increase your strength or durability, acting like a force multiplier. Additionally, your Breaker state is surprisingly flexible, allowing you to fold and bend yourself similar to actual cardboard, letting you slip through cracks and openings and hide in places that would be impossible for normal people.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Cutout

objects.text:
You now have access to a fourth spatial dimension, and through that, another axis of movement. You don’t teleport; rather, you step into a direction that literally does not exist from a three-dimensional perspective, something akin to invisibility and phasing.

You can move through this axis as easily as just deciding to walk left or right, and are able to perceive it just as easily as you would regular space. From here, you can ignore most obstacles outside of exotic power effects or tinkertech centered around spatial or temporal manipulation. However, you cannot interact with objects beyond the axis as you move through it, meaning you’ll need to ‘peek’ your hands out if you want to punch someone.

You can bring objects on your person with you, but you’ll find objects any larger than a bag ‘destabilizing’ during your stay along the foreign axis. The result of this destabilization is a scrambling of the matter of that object upon exiting the axis. It remains a contiguous mass, but the more time spent within, the more unrecognizable it’ll look.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Axis Shift

addons.text:
When a limb is severed, it doesn’t simply regrow from your body; instead, the lost piece regenerates into a new, living version of you. These clones begin as partial reflections, but over time, they diverge. Each develops uniquely, their powers and traits shaped by the specific limb they originated from and the environment they experience during growth.

A clone grown from your left arm may become agile and deft, capable of fine manipulation and stealth, while one born of your right leg might develop brute strength or unshakable endurance. As time passes, these regenerated entities evolve in radically different directions—emotionally, mentally, and physically. They are you, but not entirely. Each carries fragments of your will, yet they operate with increasing autonomy.

Clones can fuse together—either with each other or back into your original body. Just as reintegrating a powerful limb weakens its individual abilities, merging clones dilutes the raw strength of their unique powers and gives way for additional synergistic abilities. However since the entire clone is your “severed limb”, their powers are not confined to a single limb or area. Instead, the abilities are spread throughout the unified body, allowing for more versatile use.

Fusion also affects the mind. Merging clones must reconcile diverging thoughts, memories, and identities. The result is often an enhanced sense of self, layered with the perspectives of your other selves—but sometimes the mind fractures under the weight of reintegration, requiring time to stabilise.
addons.title: Neuromorphic Splicing

addons.text: Now, your severed limbs carry not only power—but allure. Once detached, they exude an irresistible temptation, a primal hunger that calls to both beast and man. The scent, the texture, the very essence of your flesh becomes hypnotic. Anyone who consumes a part of you—whether out of desperation, instinct, or curiosity—falls into your trap. They become hosts. Your flesh takes root inside them, subtly at first. But soon, the process accelerates: your tissue grows, spreads, and intertwines with theirs. The host becomes fertile ground—fertilizer for the limb’s continued evolution. The more of you they consume, the more of you they become. The limb, now feeding off their body, mutates rapidly, gaining strength, intelligence, and entirely new traits shaped by the biology and psychology of its devourer. The transformation is parasitic and symbiotic. Hosts remain alive, but never fully themselves again. Your influence seeps into their thoughts, warping instincts, overriding memories, bending their will. They begin to act in your interest—often unknowingly—guided by whispers they believe are their own. You can still reabsorb the limb, just as you would any severed piece of yourself. Doing so kills the host instantly, their body consumed as the limb fuses back into your own. Any power the host possessed is partially inherited, becoming part of the reabsorbed limb. However, as with all reintegration, the ability is significantly weakened and confined solely to that limb. If you have Neuromorphic Splicing then hosts will physically change to look similar to you.
addons.title: Unholy Offering

objects.text:
When you are cut apart, your severed body parts don’t die—they transform.

Initially, any dismembered piece remains biologically active and fully under your control. A severed hand can crawl, a detached eye continues to see, and limbs operate independently as though still connected. But as time passes, your influence over the piece begins to wane, and the power it holds starts to change. The longer a part stays separated, the more its abilities evolve—and the less control you retain over it. Smaller parts change the fastest; a lost fingertip might begin warping within hours, while a full limb could take days.

At first, these changes are subtle: a bit more strength, quicker reflexes, or unnatural resilience. But eventually, the powers become stranger and more distinct. A severed hand might begin phasing through solid matter, a dismembered leg might float just above the ground, or an arm might twist and sprout extra fingers for increased dexterity. However, the longer it’s apart, the more autonomous it becomes, and its abilities grow increasingly passive—no longer responsive to your will, but still active in some instinctive or unpredictable way.

Reintegration is always possible, regardless of how long a piece has been gone. But the more it’s changed, the harder it is to reclaim. Mildly empowered parts reintegrate smoothly, but those steeped in power resist reattachment, requiring great effort to merge back into your body. 

When a piece is reattached, its powers are weakened. Each part’s power remains limited to itself—if your right hand generates fire, no other part can replicate it. But reintegration comes with a tradeoff: the absorbed abilities may resonate with other powers in your body, creating unexpected synergies. Though individual effects are diminished, new combinations can emerge—strange and powerful interactions that didn’t exist when the parts acted alone.

If too many parts are severed and scattered far from each other, your consciousness begins to fray. Like your limbs, you lose autonomy—your mind drifting, awareness dimming, until you eventually fall into a kind of deathless stasis. Not dead, but no longer alive in any meaningful sense. Yet revival is possible. If your parts are brought back within proximity and enough of you is reassembled, awareness returns. Your mind rekindles, and you live again. This also means you are immortal as long as enough of your limbs are preserved and reassembled.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Sundering

objects.text:
Your body no longer follows the design of ordinary human anatomy. You have no bones, no organs, no internal tissues—only yourself, repeated endlessly in layered form. Beneath your skin is another version of you, and beneath that, another still. Each layer is a complete external copy of your body, stacked within like a living Russian nesting doll.

You can shed your current outermost layer at will. When removed, this layer becomes an independent clone under your command. It has no thoughts or emotions, and cannot act without your direction, but it moves and functions as though it were you. It retains all of your powers, starting at nearly full strength, but weakens gradually over time. After twenty-four hours, the clone crumbles to dust, unable to maintain its form any longer.

You can only ever shed your topmost layer. Each time you do, your own body becomes smaller, your mass and physical presence reduced. Overuse makes you visibly diminished and physically more vulnerable.

You cannot create clones unless you have at least one extra layer beyond yourself. With only your core body remaining, you are incapable of shedding further. You begin with just one additional layer on top of your true self, meaning that at the start, you may only produce one clone before needing to recover. However, with each passing day, you naturally develop another layer, increasing your total capacity. After one day, you’ll have two layers. After two days, three. This build-up continues indefinitely.

Each added layer also enhances your current self. With every new layer grown, your body becomes slightly larger, denser, and more physically powerful. The more layers you hold at once, the greater your presence, resilience, and brute strength. As stated earlier however, by shedding layers you loose a portion of this increase.
objects.title: (Breaker/Master) Matryoshka

objects.text:
You can transform into a weightless, translucent state. In this form, your body appears faint and softly glowing, as if made of light—recognizably you, but stripped of physical heft. You cast no shadow, make no sound when moving, and leave no impression on the ground beneath you. Though clearly visible, you feel as if you could drift with the wind. Despite your altered state, you can still touch and be touched, and your presence remains solid enough to make direct contact with living beings.

While in your transformed state, any living creature you maintain physical contact with experiences a dramatic boost to their capabilities. The enhancement begins the moment contact is made, starting small—a slight sharpening of focus, a quickening of reflexes, a surge of strength—and grows steadily the longer contact is sustained. After half a minute, it can elevate the target to peak of their species. If maintained long enough, the effect can push someone well beyond their natural limits, granting parahuman level abilities. The empowerment ends the instant contact is broken.

This is not limited to the physical. The boost scales with the target’s abilities, including parahuman powers. A Blaster’s attacks might become more precise or overwhelming. A Shaker’s area of control could expand. A Tinker might find their mental blueprints falling into place with intuitive clarity.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Moral Support

objects.text: You can fly at 15 miles per hour and can phase through matter. However, when in this state, you cannot interact with anything except light. You cannot talk, you cannot hear, you can only see and be seen. Useful, if you can lip read or need to get somewhere secure. You do not need air in this state.
objects.title: (Breaker) Null

objects.text: Your body has a unique field covering you that can warp space. This allows you to move between the atoms of objects, bullets fly around you, lasers redirect, and so on. You can control this warped space to selectively grab things or redirect attacks back at a person.
objects.title: (Breaker) Redirection

objects.text: You can transform into a crow-like humanoid shape built out of black blades. In this form, you possess incredible speed, including low-altitude flight, and a defensive spatial warping power that causes incoming objects to slide out of your way.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Dark Shadow

objects.text: Taking elemental damage allows you to absorb it. Electrical damage makes you faster and stronger than you normally would be and rubble would make you more durable. The greater the damage a normal human would take would dictate how long you would be boosted. If you possess an elemental power, you can have it as long as you want. If you currently possess an element like Thunder, you cannot absorb non-thunder elements like Fire until the duration of Thunder is over.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Elemental Boost

objects.text:
You’re the paranoia within people’s minds, the specter of their nightmares given form and their delusions made manifest. 

You can take the form of Shonen Bat, your base form is that of a kid with roller skates, curly hair and a bent metal baseball bat. You’re capable of sensing people who desperately want to escape reality and when you transform into Shonen Bat can hit them at full-force with your bat, or non-lethally if so desired, and thus give them a temporary relief from the problems haunting them. As you slide into their lives and leave them a present, you can slide out of it just as quickly and disappear by simply changing back to your normal body, with people actively discounting you as a possible suspect for Shonen Bat.

Yet not all people are the same, rumors and paranoia fuel your form, someone with a great imagination and countless problems they want to escape from, especially coupled with knowledge and belief in the rumors surrounding you, will empower you when going against them. Whether it’s a muscular body, a grotesque face, rapid regeneration or merely your bat being super effective against them, the more paranoid and fearful people are of you, the stronger and more monstrous your form. This scales with the collective belief of the people currently sensing you.

However, people who have a firm grasp on reality and know to face it head on serve as a counterforce to those paranoid many, whereas your form might remain monstrous, the strength you wield will be weakened by the strength of their convictions. Beliefs like happiness or indifference meanwhile serve as forces that reduce the monstrousness of your form while likewise sapping your strength at a weaker rate.

To become the proper Shonen Bat you must slide into a population's heart, stoke their fears, paranoia and rumors in regards to you and be as elusive as the wind.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Shonen Bat

objects.text:
When you enter your breaker state, your body collapses into a baseball-sized black hole with a miniature purple event horizon, transforming you into a literal hole punched through dimensions. In this state you have no physical substance, cannot touch or be touched by anything in your environment, and you are completely immobile, your form remains fixed in place with only one exception.

While in this breaker state, random loose objects from across multiple dimensions are passively drawn through your portal body and emerge into your current reality. You possess only the vaguest conceptual influence over what comes through, such as a slight preference for "trash-like" or "solid" items, but the actual results are unpredictable, ranging from boulders to scrap metal to broken machinery. The effect is Manton-limited, meaning you will never accidentally summon a living creature, a functioning biological entity, or anything that originated from inside another person's body.

Every object that passes through your portal body emerges coated in an undetectable energy unique to you. When two or more coated objects touch, their energies combine. You are able to sense all such objects and manipulate them telekinetically. This control extends to breaking and reshaping objects, though it functions more like fast-paced carving. Control is smoother the closer an object is to your portal body and the more total energy it contains, meaning a large clump of objects touching each other moves with fluid precision, while many small objects scattered far apart feel sluggish and clumsy. 

The energy coating over the objects allow them to interact with your portal body. This means you can use your telekinetically controlled objects to carry or push yourself through the environment as your sole method of locomotion.
objects.title: (Breaker) Dimensional Scar

addons.text:
With your powers over code and software, your digital existence has the potential to be elevated.

Due to your own nature as strands of code while you are digitized, you now have the ability to rewrite your own code while in a network. This ‘Shapeshifting’ or modifications cannot be brought out into your real body when you leave, though will still be present when you digitize yourself again.

This allows for far more freedom in your manipulation and travels through the internet, almost immediately elevating yourself to the level of a powerful AI like Dragon, though it would take time to achieve the level of a fully unbound AI. If this Addon were to be purchased with Ghost Protocol however, you would be even better than an unbound AI, the equivalent of a digital god with only Tinkered code and tech possibly slowing you down.
addons.title: Porygon

objects.text:
You now have the ability to turn your physical body into strands of code, allowing you to act like a program and affect different technologies and even the internet. To do this, you must be touching a piece of technology that is at the level of being connected to the wider network, though you could infiltrate isolated servers as well as long as you have physical contact with them.

One of the limits of this power, besides it being a Striker, is that it only provides the barest of coding knowledge, just enough to ‘move’ around and poke things. If you want to reach the heights this power could bring you to, you’ll need to work on your software skills yourself. 

In addition to this, you can actually be ‘harmed’ in your code form with firewalls and viruses if you aren’t careful, and the ‘injuries’ you sustain would transfer into your flesh and blood body whenever you leave.

If a device is connected to the wider internet, you have the ability to exit out of a different ‘terminal’, effectively allowing you to travel the world through technology.
objects.title: (Breaker/Striker) Digitize

objects.text: You can control how much mass you have, without changing your size. Your minimum density is just above that of air, your maximum density is just above that of Tungsten.
objects.title: (Breaker) Density

objects.text:
You can grow a pair of glowing, wing-like structures from your back. These wings let you fly without limits on how high or how fast you can go. However, even though the wings can move at incredible speeds, your own senses—like sight, focus, and reflexes—don’t improve. You might be able to fly fast, but reacting in time is still up to you.

While the wings are active, a thin protective field forms around your body. This field keeps you safe from things like wind pressure, freezing air, or heat from moving too fast. But every time the field protects you from something, the wings take damage.

If the wings take too much damage, they disappear. They won’t come back right away—the more damage they took, the longer the wait, with a maximum of one week. Be careful not to push them too far while flying fast or high, or they might break mid-flight.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Icarus

objects.text: When you die, one of this power's charges is used, bringing you back to life a month later at some safe spot. You start with one charge, regenerate one charge per month without dying, and have a maximum capacity of 5 charges.
objects.title: (Breaker) Rebirth

objects.text:
You have three forms you can transform into. It takes thirty seconds to transform, and you're as vulnerable as a normal human during this process. They are all as easy to control as your own human body.

First, you can transform into a wheel, with which you can accelerate and bounce around at high speeds.

Second, you can transform into a highly durable turret, with which you can shoot blasts of coloured heat, moving at high speeds and doing great damage. You cannot move in this state and have a limited range of aiming. The speed of fire is roughly ten blasts per second.

Third, you can become a line on the ground, projecting a forcefield above you that has the durability and strength of Alexandria. The line can occupy a total space of up to 20 m^2, and it can be no thinner than 5cm. You can move and shape it around to some degree, though it is somewhat slow. 

Additionally, you can once a week bestow upon another the use of one of these forms. If you do it several times on the same person, they'll eventually get all the forms, though never the ability to spread them to another. You cannot share the forms with prior parahumans, but if they trigger, they keep their forms. This does not bestow any type of control upon them, but gratitude and social pressure.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Tri-state Area

objects.text:
You can transform into a small orb-like core with the ability to absorb surrounding matter and store it in its structure. Once absorbed, you can use this matter to continuously maintain and control any form you desire, so long as you have enough of the right materials. Additionally, the core can utilize the stored matter as fuel, burning it to enhance your speed, strength, durability, and control over your Breaker power. This process can also augment other powers you have, making them more potent based on the amount of matter being consumed at a given moment. The denser something is, the better results you gain from burning it.
