(This power synergizes with your Tinker abilities to create and manipulate Tinker Tech to use while in your orb form. For Brute and Striker powers, the forms you make are considered part of you.)
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Armored Core Ignite

objects.text: You can transform into a monstrous and yet beautiful form that vaguely resembles all the parts of animals in the bird family-- beaks, feathers, wings and talons. Everyone who can see you in this state has their adrenaline secretion and fight-or-flight responses artificially suppressed, making them feel extremely calm. They are prevented from raising their heart rate above a certain level, meaning that they can’t even run. Finally, noise in a certain range of you is partially muted-- it can’t go above a certain volume.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Ibis

objects.text: You can transform into a Wendigo that feeds on human blood. Your monster form is sickly skinny while still being massive, with razor-sharp claws and a strong sense of smell and hearing, allowing you to track prey with ease. Your strength and speed increase with each feeding as you gain strength from the blood of your victims. You can also manifest mutations by consuming Parahumans, such as having a slightly higher resistance to heat by devouring a Pyrokinetic, increasing the volume of your roar by devouring a Sonokinetic, or even growing in size by devouring a Size Manipulator. Nothing enough to be a power, but still enough to be noticed.
objects.title: (Breaker) Wendigo

addons.text: No longer do you have to draw your ink creatures, now you can directly create them from your ink. While this does allow you to quickly create high quality ink creatures, due to not being drawn they do not benefit from the ability to inherit the properties of what they were drawn on. Any ink creatures can automatically be given your ability to spread and merge with ink at no cost.
addons.title: Inklings

addons.text: Using ink constructs you can make 1:1 copies of just about anything, which in conjunction with Idol Theory can work just as well as the original. This is even capable of replicating some Tinkertech and power infused objects like Dauntless’ gear. Furthermore, by shapeshifting into a perfect copy of someone, you are capable of using Idol Theory to copy their capabilities at full strength. This perfectly copies their current capabilities, so if you copy the Faerie Queen you also have access to all the Shades she had when you copied her. If you have Inklings you can make your ink creations be perfect copies as well. Keep in mind that your Shard is still sourcing this, so summoning swarms of copies of powerful Parahumans can quickly drain your Shard’s reserves.
addons.title: Mirror Image

addons.text: Your ink and the ink-like substance of Black Goo are now one and same, allowing you to selectively express the properties of either through your controlled ink, with the main draw being Black Goo’s ability to convert existing matter into more of your ink. Should you possess Inklings then corpses reanimated by your ink retain their powers.
addons.title: Tainted World

addons.text: Your ability to become and control ink has meshed incredibly well with your ability to Tinker with ink. You may freely shift any ink you control into any variety of ink you have previously created. Your fine control over your ink allows you to rapidly create incredibly detailed and complex seals simply by making the ink you control take the shape of whatever symbols are required. Lastly, you are able to bypass the need for paper at the cost of quality, directly painting Seals onto objects or even forming your own body into a living Seal.
addons.title: Living Seal

objects.text:
You can transform your body into special ink. While transformed you can freely control the shape and state of your ink, from a solid copy of someone else to a living puddle which slithers across the ground. You can even selectively change parts of your body, such as turning your arm into a whirling mass of tendrils harder than steel. You can also transform existing ink into more of your ink through contact with it.

When fully transformed you can choose to leave a trail of your ink wherever you touch, which you can submerge yourself in. While submerged your speed is greatly accelerated and your movements are undetectable, allowing you to quickly reposition yourself and catch your enemies by surprise. You can also assimilate your ink outside of your body to repair any damage you take or grow larger. Finally, you possess the ability to telekinetically control any of your ink, possessing incredibly fine control.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Inkheart

objects.text:
You can feel within your body a dormant reservoir. Whenever you engage in activities that relax you, entertain you, or bring you a sense of personal well-being, this reservoir begins to fill with energy. The more authentically beneficial the experience is to you, the more energy is generated.

This energy can be used to create and shape a second form—an alternate body that you can switch into. At its base, this form is a perfect replica of your current self. However, by expending energy, you can customize it. You can alter its structure, appearance, and function, granting it unique features and abilities. These abilities must be biologically based, but you are not limited to human biology. Your Shard gives you access to a vast archive of alien and esoteric lifeforms, allowing you to incorporate exotic biological traits—ranging from levitating muscle sacs to organs that excrete gold. If you ever wish, you can reset the form, but you will not regain the energy used to create it.

Transformation into this form requires a one-time energy cost, but there is no ongoing drain to maintain it. Once activated, the new form remains stable for as long as you choose. However, the form’s biology influences your mind. If the avatar’s brain structure or sensory systems differ significantly from a human’s, your thoughts, instincts, and emotional responses may begin to shift accordingly. With stranger forms, this influence may become more alien, altering your perspective and behavior while you’re transformed. You also cannot create the energy for your reservoir while in this form, nor can you alter it. You can transform back to your original appearance at will. 

If you have any power besides this one, it will be available to you in either forms.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Custom Avatar

objects.text: You embody some element, whether that is Air, Water, Fire, Earth, Energy, Void, Ice, Electricity, Metal, Iron, Gold, Oxygen, Carbon, Uranium, or whatever, you embody it. Your personality shifts toward that element (Fire would be hotheaded, ice would be cold, Air would be flighty, Uranium would be unstable, etc.) You have total control of that element within 30 meters of yourself, fine control within 50 meters, and rough control within 100 meters. You have weaknesses based on your element. (Water is weak to Electricity, Fire is weak to Earth, Water, and Void, Air is weak to Void, etc.) An Endbringer with control over your element trumps your control. A Time elemental cannot time travel.
objects.title: (Breaker) Elemental

addons.text: Your limit in how much you can detach and split your body and how far you go through it is loosened to a worrying extent. Full Body Detachment allows you to split into variable lengths and proportions: vertical or diagonal detachments, split into centimeter-wide pieces or parts, etc. Flawless Ocular Donor gives regrowth abilities to any split you lost, a certain awareness of any piece or parts, roughly perceiving everything around you through them, and even using other body parts to accelerate your regrowth.
addons.title: Lizard Tail Splitter

objects.text:
You can divide your body into many pieces, telekinetically controlling them at a whim and using them as if they were connected as always. Your segments are held together by localized macro-level quantum teleportation allowing you greater maneuverability and range while maintaining cohesion, being “linked” still, separating yourself up to 30 different parts. You can slowly regenerate any detached body parts in case losing a segment or as self-defense, taking its time to heal.

That said, there are limits to this: your segments’ range limit in terms of how far it is to your body is 130m², ceasing function altogether once reaching that limit, losing your body’s connection, and weak points such as your heart and brain (especially your Corona Pollentia) persist even when split and spread around, lethal weak points if targeted.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Monsoon

addons.text:
Your breaker form has absorbed Elevation, gaining its characteristics. You start off with 6 pairs of wings + 1 wing for every other power you have. The feathers on all your wings will have eyes, and you will be able to telekinetically control these feathers within a 7-kilometer range, as well as see through these eyes regardless of distance. 

You can choose to designate any wing you have to enhance one of your powers, and you can have multiple wings focus on the same power for a far greater boost. The appearance of the wings will shift based on the power they enhance; by boosting a fire-based power, the wings may become wings of flames, the eyes on the feathers glowing like magma. 

The eyes on your feathers will also gain a minor sight-based power if the wing they are on is enhanced; for example, on a pair of wings of flames, the eyes can turn anything in their line of sight more flamable or perhaps increase its temperature.

Finally, you will find that your breaker form and your base from will slowly merge. This starts with your human form gaining more eyes or feathers with an eye on them, slowly growing from places such as their hair, while your breaker form will find its giant eyeball becoming more humanoid. Once the two forms have become one and the same, your powers would have grown multiple folds, with your wings increasing in numbers greatly, at least tripling.
addons.title: Mandate of Heaven

addons.text:
Your feathers gain the special properties of "On Crystal Wings", turning them into powerful weapons and tools. Individually, their durability is comparable to that of Osmium, coupled with their razor-sharp edges, makes them lethal instruments capable of slicing through steel effortlessly. Moreover, the weightlessness of these feathers allows you to wield them with unparalleled agility and precision. Your telekinetic control over each feather has improved, allowing you precision equal to that of a machine.

You can now also summon up to 1000 feathers every week, each adorned with an eye, granting you a remarkable sense of awareness and control over your surroundings. These eyes are also boosted, allowing you to see with crystal clarity, unhindered by distance. Additionally, when your feathers are gathered within your wings and/or bind together, they are able to withstand blows Endbringers and fly at speeds surpassing Mach 20. Furthermore, in that state the sharpness of your feathers allows you to effortlessly cut through any non esoteric material that stands in your way.
addons.title: Seraphim

addons.text:
Your feathers individual speeds tops out at Mach 1. When your feathers are gathered within your wings and/or bind together, they are able to achieve top speeds of Mach 30. This also grants you a remarkable level of control and coordination, with an unparalleled mastery over aerodynamics and fluid dynamics.

The additional eyes on your feathers have also been boosted, offering a form of pseudo-precognition, your awareness becomes heightened to the point of predictive foresight. By processing and analyzing visual stimuli, you're able to calculate and anticipate events with remarkable accuracy, granting you a strategic advantage in navigating through complex and dynamic environments. However, this ability is limited, as it requires visual input. This also comes with a form of auto defense, as your feathers will block and/or shoot down any attack you predict.
addons.title: Ophanim

addons.text:
Your feathers have become even more powerful. Not only do they get strengthened, but you also gain the ability to quickly replace any feather that has been destroyed. This rapid regeneration can be leveraged to allow you to shoot up to 6000 feathers per minute. This will exhaust your stamina should you abuse it too much.

You can also increase the size of your feathers to up to 84 inches in length to use as close combat weapons for yourself or others should you choose. When using a feather in close combat like this, you can use your telekinesis to make the feather vibrate at rapid speeds to increase your cutting power. You can even do this to an entire wing, transforming it into a massive sword with the power to cut through titanium like a hot knife through butter. Sustained vibration will also exhaust your stamina, so be careful.
addons.title: Cherub’s Sword

objects.text:
You are able to transform into a massive eyeball surrounded by a total of six pairs of floating wings. Each feather of these wings are adorned with an eye, each one possessing the ability to function similarly to human eyes, allowing you to see through them regardless of the feather’s distance from your main body. Not only that, but you can use your telekinesis to control these feathers with incredible precision within a 1 kilometer radius of your location.

Your wings are stronger than steel, yet completely weightless. This enhanced durability is also extends to the eyes on the feathers.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Be Not Afraid

addons.text: You now possess the physics of a Bethesda game character, allowing you to perform ridiculous feats such as launching people into the sky at Mach speeds, making your horse fly, item duping, terrain clipping, sequence breaks, and a whole host of other ridiculous feats.
addons.title: Bethesda

addons.text: Your Move Cancel is subsumed into Bugged Out, incorporating better uses and advancements on “flaws” in movement and collision detection. You can exploit the collision detection of a bus or any other object by running into it and launching it, infusing a “flaw” in collision detection onto other objects or weapons, phasing your attacks into the other side, infinite jumping by a “false” ground (which is also exploitable), the vaunted BLJ, lag exploits, or any movement exploits to date and thought of.
addons.title: Collision Glitch

addons.text: You can apply a “flaw” to how you give and take damage. Every attack you do can tank two hits or offensive without being staggered or losing your stance until your poise breaks afterward, and your movement has a passive Super Armor where any damage you endure is reduced between 5%-20% without any pushback or breaking stride, with the chance of invincibility frames in case of recovering from unconsciousness.
addons.title: Hyper Armor

addons.text: Your “flaws” are now out of your control, unbidden from yourself aside from an “on-and-off” switch. This results in unintended consequences like people being caught on a “fault” on the ground, finding themselves falling from the first floor of their apartment, and simply anything from your proximity irremediably twisted and broken beyond belief.
addons.title: Game-breaking Glitch

objects.text: You can see “flaws” in the world. Through these flaws, you can break reality in beneficial ways. Glitching through walls, cloning objects, and teleportation, all of this is possible as long as you can find the right spots and learn the right methods. You instinctively know how to use each flaw you find, although it may take some time to master.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Bugged Out

objects.text:
You control your bodily vibrations to move at incredible speeds, resulting in appearing as an unrecognizable blur to others. This operates by channeling a portion of the kinetic energy from atomic motion in your body’s molecules in various directions.

Your obfuscation then works from the resulting vibrations and speeds you’re traversing, others being incapable of seeing anything but a haze and a garbled voice when you speak. It goes further if you accelerate and maintain a higher speed and vibrational resonance to the point of one fails to follow or see your movements, a form of invisibility through sheer velocity. 

How this power also works essentially guarantees the environment won’t affect you as you repel any influence through your vibrating self, working both ways: you traverse without complications of air resistance or other physical forces, as well as leaving any sign of sound, or physical traces of your movements or presence, the quicker you are.

Your speed is understandably enough to back up your concealing effects, with only Mach 4-5 maximum.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Blur

objects.text: You can transform into a shattered figure composed of monomolecular crystal shards. In this form you can glide forward at highway speeds, though in order to change directions you must briefly shift forms. While transformed, you are highly durable and will reflect most non-exotic energies, but you can be temporarily scattered by sufficient force.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Fractal

objects.text:
Whenever you enter a Breaker state, you fully, and painlessly, heal. This also removes the effects of Masters and Strangers. You can enter a glowing Breaker state where you emit blinding amounts of light, which you can target.

Things you target with your light for over 30 seconds will begin to be repaired, including humans.

Your reaction time is 5x faster.
objects.title: (Breaker) Reconstruction

objects.text: You are capable of 'programming' your own actions and then forcing your body to follow through with those actions. When this occurs your body enters an All-or-Nothing state, allowing you to tear through even the toughest materials and ignore conventional physics to complete your task. This includes things such as preventing you from needing to breathe and sleep, or allowing you to walk on air to complete your program. The downside, however, is that you cannot cancel a program once it has begun, and the only way for it to end is to either finish or encounter another All-or-Nothing effect. You have a secondary Thinker power that assists you in making programs, though do note that they cannot be made reactionary.
objects.title: (Breaker/Brute) Python

objects.text: You can instantaneously alter the friction between yourself, anything you're touching, or anything within 5 centimeters of something you're touching. You can increase or decrease the coefficients of static and kinetic friction to anything between 0.001 and 0.999, though the coefficient of static friction has to be more than the coefficient of kinetic friction.
objects.title: (Breaker) Friction

addons.title: Sentient Wave Pattern
addons.text:
The safety limits imposed on your body by your abilities have been completely loosened.

You can alter your wavelengths to manipulate your physical properties and shape, exist as an incorporeal entity or even teleport short distances through quantum entanglement.

Your capacity for movement has vastly improved, allowing feats such as reaching superluminal speeds by using the speed of light and bending space through gravitational waves to mimic an Alcubierre drive, or accessing adjacent realities via dimensional breach by tuning to the correct frequency.

Your consciousness will continue to exist uninterrupted, capable of perceiving all information being affected by Stilling and unaffected by the alterations you subject yourself to, unless willed otherwise. Your power will increase your mental capacity to compensate for the required multitasking and processing speed necessary to accommodate any changes.

objects.text:
Your shard is related to Stilling and possesses most if not all the same capabilities, in your case though, that involves a much more limited range.

You may manipulate the wavelengths that compose your body in ways your power has deemed safe for you. For example, you could increase your durability to certain types of damage, increase your strength massively, and fly at high speeds. You may also manipulate the wavelengths of things in a short radius of your body in a more unrestricted manner like a disintegration touch, pierce power effects, or generate kinetic force in a manner that stacks with your strength, just to name a few examples.

You are technically always in a Breaker state for the purposes of powers that detect that or rely on it.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Still Body

addons.title: Accelerated Mastery
addons.text:
With your new instant understanding of the inner workings of the powers around you, you are able to create and apply new ways to operate your unique energy. 

You could take a look at Legend and instantly figure out a variety of laser type attacks, or you could look at Alexandra and understand a more efficient and powerful way to increase your defensive capabilities.

You are still limited by your original energy pool size, though maybe taking a look at other Parahumans like Armsmaster could give you ideas on how to improve your efficiency with the energy.

objects.text: Within you lies a well of raw energy that is somewhat limited in size, but it regenerates after use and rest. While the strength of the energy is low for now, it is extremely versatile. You can use it to strengthen your own physical attributes, so you can hit harder or move faster, even generate a field to lower the damage of incoming forces or to fall slowly to the ground; maybe even fly one day, fire off blasts able to destroy buses (but only a few at a time). Maybe you'll even learn how to turn it into a tangible solid to create constructs or even to heal people one day. Hell, even a bastardized form of telekinesis is possible, but you'll have to train for it.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Energy Well

objects.text: If a consensual contract is agreed upon, without coercion or Master effects involved, though bribery is fine, all parties must follow through. All parties must be aware of the power. This power works on you even if you're immune to Master powers, and won't work if another power is immune to it. You must be one of the involved parties, even if the contract just labels you as a witness or arbitrator. Be careful to look for loopholes. This power fails if the contract becomes impossible to fulfill.
objects.title: (Master) Geas

objects.text: You can create and crudely control a clone of yourself anywhere within your perception, you can still control it if it goes outside of it, but if more than half of its body intersects with something solid then it will dissolve into smoke until resummoned as it can't pass through walls. It cannot interact with anything, and doesn’t affect the environment, with the parts that try temporarily dissolving. This also happens when it's hit by something after which it reforms once the object has passed through it, though more than half of its body being hit will dispel it, with its whole body turning into smoke which will persist for a while. It doesn’t give any sensory feedback and its face is in the uncanny valley.
objects.title: (Master) Illusionary Clone

addons.text:
You can now squeeze together 1 pound of any non-living material to make Critters out of.

Critters will gain enhanced abilities depending on what material they are made out of: stone enhances a Critter's weight and strength, glass gives them sharp cutting edges, while gold makes a Critter much smarter.

Critters also last longer depending on what material they are made of, with stone lasting days before collapsing, and metals lasting weeks.
The tougher and more valuable the material, the longer the Critter can last.
addons.title: Crush Critters

addons.text:
You can now choose to make flying Critters with 4 long leaf-like wings in place of legs.

These Critters can carry half as much as their normal counterparts can but can fly at human running speeds, albeit with difficulty turning without slowing down.

Flying Critters can also work together to carry heavier items, as long as they have enough places to grip.
addons.title: Leaf Critters

addons.text:
Your Critters now have mouths with incredibly sharp teeth in them, capable of biting through even hard materials like plastic or bone.

Your Critters can use their mouths to eat sugar or sugar-containing things like fruit, honey, or candy to extend the time they keep existing, with a gram of sugar roughly equaling an extra hour of existence.

You can verbally order them what things and in what situations they are allowed to bite and eat. If not ordered otherwise, Critters will seek out and eat sugar to extend their lifespans on their own.
addons.title: Om Nom

objects.text:
By squeezing together a pound of soft plant matter, such as leaves, grass, or moss, you can create a thumb-sized Critter.

Critters have a round body with four stubby legs, a round head with eyes, and two graspers attached to the head like antennas.

They are loyal to you and capable of following verbal orders, although they aren't smart enough to reliably make decisions or distinguish people from each other.

Critters can stick to walls and ceilings using their legs and carry objects up to a pound in weight using their graspers. Critters can work together to carry heavier objects or bridge gaps by linking together if directed to.

Critters collapse into loose plant matter an hour after being created and are about twice as durable as the materials that make them up.
objects.title: (Master) Peat Critters

objects.text: You have the ability to create a projection that shares all five senses and you can speak through it. Its form can be anything you imagine, however, you can't swap form unless you release the projection first. It is not physically strong or powerful in any way, it is closer to a walking plush animal.
objects.title: (Master) Mascot

objects.text: When you activate this power, your micro expressions shift, triggering an instinctual feeling in others that something isn't quite right. It will cause others who interact with you to feel that something is off, slowly growing fearful from the "eerie" feeling they get from you. This effect grows to the point they will get fearful at the mere thought of you, although it weakens as they spend less time with you.
objects.title: (Master) Uncanny Valley

objects.text: Every participant in discussions you participate in will understand the rationality and viewpoint of all the other sides. Information gained from this power cannot harm you in any way, and you may toggle this ability at will.
objects.title: (Master) State the Obvious

objects.text:
You possess the ability to telekinetically control small objects you throw/flick. The faster the object moves, the finer your control over it becomes. While you cannot generate additional thrust to keep the object flying indefinitely, you maintain a localized field of influence around it. This field allows you to manipulate its trajectory or object around it during flight, but at the cost of speed, as the field applies a drag-like effect.

This trade-off means that quick, precise manipulations—such as pulling a grenade pin or redirecting a light object—can be performed with minimal loss of momentum. However, attempting to exert sustained control over heavier or faster-moving objects, like dragging a bullet mid-flight, significantly reduces the thrown objects speed. The control within this field is incredibly precise, allowing you to exert opposing forces along the object's trajectory.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Ahead of the Curve

objects.text: You can create 5 phantom copies of yourself, which will follow your mental orders. They look exactly like you but they can't affect the world around them. Phantoms will disappear 5 minutes after being created.
objects.title: (Master) Mirror Image

objects.text: Everyone will believe and do the opposite of what you say. This effect is permanent, and you cannot deactivate it. Additionally, your words and actions are often interpreted as sarcasm, making true communication with others difficult or impossible.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Opposite

objects.text: You can create invisible specters that travel a designated route. While they don't share senses with you, you are a vague sense of the things happening around them. While there are no limits on how many you can make, they only move as fast as a normal walking speed.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Patrol

objects.text: You can force anyone to say anything. There is no limit to what you can make them say or what words they can speak. You can even make them speak languages they don’t know.
objects.title: (Master) Recite

objects.text:
You have a subtle, passive emotional manipulation power that causes those around you to experience a gentle, persistent sense of admiration and a desire to please them, like the fluttery feeling of puppy love. 

This effect radiates naturally from the user, subtly shifting the perceptions and priorities of anyone in their vicinity to align with the user’s needs and desires. The influence is soft and difficult to detect, causing people to rationalize their feelings as genuine and rarely suspecting outside manipulation. 

While it cannot force anyone to act against their core values, it makes others more forgiving, eager to help, and inclined to see the user in a positive light. 

The effect is always active, offering the user natural social advantages and loyalty from those they encounter, though it can sometimes lead to awkward or potentially dangerous infatuations or complicate genuine relationships.
objects.title: (Master) Papillon

objects.text:
You can compel a person to have doubts or be insecure about certain ideas or mentalities.

If the ideas/beliefs are within their belief system, their effectiveness grows, e.g., a person who believes in a social Darwinist mentality, finds the faults of this belief more easily over time, growing more insecure or self-conscious of holding said ideas until progressively resenting it altogether to the point of either self-hatred or self-rejection. 

Another use could be implanting doubt about an idea outside a person’s belief system to distance or sour a person toward said idea, i.e., inserting a doubt about the very idea of sports, resulting in avoiding or hating sports.
objects.title: (Master) Seed of Doubt

objects.text: You have extremely fine telekinetic control over all scraps of paper smaller than a square inch within 100 meters. I suggest you get a paper shredder. You also have an unlimited capacity to multitask.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Confetti

addons.text:
The maximum force you can exert on animated objects has risen to equal that of (Shaker/Blaster) Action at a Distance, allowing you to manipulate massive objects, up to the size of entire buildings, through your verbal commands. Furthermore, as long as the objects can hear your voice and you are aware of the objects you wish to control, you can remotely command them, for example, using a phone or speaker.

The movements of the animated objects have also become significantly more accurate and precise, mirroring the innate exactness of your force projection. Whether you’re guiding a needle through a keyhole or coordinating the synchronised movement of multiple objects, your orders are executed flawlessly.
addons.title: Grand Puppetry

objects.text: You can give verbal commands to objects, telekinetically animating them like puppets. It may be as complex of a command as you like, but commands will fade after an hour. The maximum force exerted is based on your own strength, and the accuracy and precision of their movements depends on your skill with using the objects. While they can follow orders, they do not have the intelligence and creativity required to make decisions. You can tell an object information required for future orders, but the information will be forgotten an hour after it was given.
objects.title: (Master) Animate Objects

objects.text: You have knowledge on how to cause fear. You can know anyone’s fear with just a glance and the perfect way to make them feel fear. You can manipulate those who are afraid, making them unknowingly act as you wish. You can, with relative ease, traumatize people, permanently scarring them. Doing so allows you to place a permanent order in their subconscious. This works best when used on a single person at once, but can still be used on a crowd.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Fear

addons.text:
You can now effectively buy your way into favorable relationships, able to substitute money and valuables in place of bonding.

Despite the method used, the relationship isn’t contingent on valuables still flowing in, so bribing that politician to be your friend will actually make them your friend, and something that can and will persist even when you no longer send them money.
addons.title: Shiny

objects.text: You have a passive master effect that affects everybody you interact with, increasing their willingness to give you gifts and valuables. This effect is massively increased on targets who find you attractive.
objects.title: (Master) Gold Digger

objects.text: You are able to seize control of any entity already under a Master effect or any projection. For example, you could take over one of the Fairy Queen's Shades, gain control of Skitter's swarm of bugs, or even turn a Simurgh Bomb to work in your favor. Additionally, this ability includes a sub-power that enables you to detect who or what is currently under a Master effect. You will retain control permanently, and you will be able to dismiss the master effect if you wish. For stuff like Simurgh Bombs or Skitter’s bugs it’s pretty direct but for stuff like Siberian or Fairy Queen’s Shades, you will be able to resummon them at a later date if you wish.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Piracy

addons.text: Thanks to your ability to control plants, you no longer need to physically touch a plant to begin its transformation—as long as it’s under your control then you can start its transformation. The time required to craft your creations is also dramatically reduced. What once demanded minutes or hours now takes only a fraction of that—one-tenth, to be exact. If you possess Shaper of Flora, you can freely grow new traits onto your creations during or after the transformation process, integrating features like toxin-producing thorns, fruit-bearing branches, or vines laced with irritants or hallucinogens.
addons.title: Bloom

addons.text:
Your plant-like physiology has given rise to a new application for your ability to manipulate and animate plants. You can now use your Dryad body as a template to alter and animate plant life into becoming a perfect copy of your own body complete with a connection to your Shard by copying what passes for your Corona as well.

What makes this truly powerful however, is the fact that your unlimited multitasking and complete mental awareness of plants has evolved into distributing your consciousness across all animated plant life. Your mind now resides in all plant constructs you have animated, of which your original body also counts, and you can only die if all of them are destroyed. This means that even if your original Dryad body is destroyed you can still survive and create a new one.
addons.title: Floral Avatars

objects.text:
With a touch, you can animate and control plant life. The time required depends on the size of the plant being transformed: smaller creations can be animated in minutes, while larger or more complex constructs may take hours.

Once animated, your creations are entirely loyal to you. They act independently within their abilities, following your will with unwavering obedience. These plant-based constructs possess internal systems you create from the ground up—hydraulic muscles, circulatory fluids, pressure-resistant vessels, and nerve-like conduits. Their internal complexity and level of intelligence scale with their size; a small vine-creature may carry out simple tasks, while a massive, tree-like sentinel may understand and react to complex orders with tactical awareness.

The physical power of each minion is also influenced by the condition of the plant before transformation. A well-nourished, healthy specimen results in stronger, more resilient constructs. Wilted or damaged plants produce weaker bodies, unable to support the full range of physical feats your designs might allow.

Once animated, your constructs live for as long as their bodies can be sustained. They do not require your constant control to function, but their continued existence depends on maintenance—sunlight, nutrients, water, or artificial means if adapted accordingly. As long as they are alive, they retain their function and loyalty.
objects.title: (Master) Green Thumb

objects.text:
When people sleep near you—whether in the next room or under the same stars—you can feel their presence in the dreamscape. With a thought, you may step into their dreams, slipping from your own body into theirs as easily as crossing a doorway.

Once inside, you aren’t just a guest. You are a director, a painter, a god in miniature. You can bend the dream to your will—altering places, faces, events, even the flow of time. Minutes outside might become hours inside, or the reverse. Emotions become your brush, memories your canvas. You can turn a nightmare to peace, or shape a gentle dream into a silent message.

While in their dreams, your real body sleeps. You remain linked to it, able to return with a thought or when it is in danger. When the dreamer wakes, they may remember everything—or nothing. Dreams are slippery things, and even your most vivid creations may fade into half-remembered emotion or strange deja vu. But seeds can still be planted. Ideas, comfort, fear, even subtle changes in perspective can remain without conscious recall. Additionally when they do wake, you are kicked out and back into your body, waking up in the process.
objects.title: (Master) Sleep Walker

objects.text:
Every time you covertly investigate a situation related to a person, or you simply find them suspicious of something, they’ll unreasonably feel compelled to do or act in ways that incriminate themselves in small to obvious ways. You have no overt control over the Master effect concerning who or when, only that the Mastered will always be the culprit or an accomplice, manifesting in poorly pretending their innocence, buckling under pressure, or desperately making plans to clear their name that are often on the incompetent side of the barn. 

Among the crowd, they’ll be hard to discover, but rest assured: their incompetence will be revealing.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Incrimination

addons.text: Your control over rodents have increased, to the point you are able to have absolute control of them, down to their involuntary movements. You can even out right "possess" them, perceiving and feeling what they see and feel.
addons.title: Rattus Rex Magnus

objects.text: You have total control of the minds of any and all rodents within about 3 city blocks. You also have an unlimited capacity to multitask.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Rodent King

objects.text: You can incite feelings of unrestrained abandon in those around you, lowering inhibitions and inducing low-level euphoria. This effect gradually increases to outright drunkenness, with no negative consequences felt the next day. You can even further amplify this aura by imbuing it with bloodlust, leading those affected to become wildly aggressive and violent.
objects.title: (Master) Bacchus

addons.text: Now, whenever someone eats your flesh and gets addicted to it, they are also poisoned. The only cure for the symptoms of the poison? Your flesh. Rehabilitation is now near impossible, as if they do not have your flesh or blood regularly they will die.
addons.title: Cursed Drugs

addons.text:
If your flesh and blood is eaten without permission, the person who eats it will suffer temporarily but will still benefit from the healing and/or boost from eating your flesh. However, this boost has become a curse. The healing they gained is flawed, the boost they gain is broken, a temporary boost that gives various long term issues. For instance, a wound that heals might seem fine at first, but it could reopen later, festering with infection. A temporary boost in strength or speed might be followed by debilitating weakness or pain, leaving them worse off than before. If they have devoured your flesh and blood for an extended period of time, then the issues will likely result in their death.

On the other hand, if given permission not only will they get an addiction to your flesh, they will also grow stronger from it. Any power they have slowly becomes more versatile as their restrictions loosen, normal humans slowly evolve as their bodies become more efficient. However, the addiction will still grow, in fact it will be worse as those who eat your flesh can feel themselves growing and they will desire to grow more.
addons.title: Medicine or Poison? The Difference Is The Dosage…

objects.text:
Your body has undergone a disturbing transformation. Every part of you—your blood, flesh, and organs—has the potential to become irresistibly delicious, more flavorful than anything anyone has ever tasted. With each bite, the taste would only grow more exquisite, an endless escalation of delight. You even exude an aroma reminiscent of the perfect meal, enticing those around you.

However, this allure only manifests if you willingly consent to give your flesh. If you do not, your body becomes the opposite—vile and repulsive, with a taste and scent so foul it drives away even the most desperate. Those who attempt to consume you without permission are met with this revolting experience, even suffering sickness from this.

For those who taste your blood with your consent, an addiction takes hold immediately. They become slaves to their desire, unable to resist the compulsion to obey your every command in hopes of savouring you again. Over time, their identity erodes, leaving them little more than puppets, unable to willingly break free from your control.

If someone under your thrall is forcibly separated from you, they suffer intense withdrawal symptoms, both physical and mental. Only those who survive this torment for long enough can break free from your influence.

This doesn’t give any additional regeneration so be wary.
objects.title: (Master) Inverse Cannibalism

objects.text: You can “step” out of your body, creating an invisible and intangible specter that you will inhabit, while your body falls unconscious. As the specter, you can float and have selective intangibility, although you will not be able to affect the world in a direct manner. For example, if you climb on the back of someone in your specter form, the target will feel heavier, more tired and strained. If you whisper into the ear of someone, they will be influenced by your words, although it is limited to short term influence. If your body is harmed or awakened, your specter form will dissolve and you will reawaken in your body.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Ghostfreak

objects.text: You can reverse how anyone within your line of sight perceives direction. They will see up as down, left as right, and forwards as backward. This effect wears off as soon as they are out of your line of sight.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Reversed Controls

objects.text: You can make anyone within clear sight match your moves precisely. They will follow the exact movements you do and even copy the words you say. Although you can't make them do anything that you yourself cannot do. If both you and they possess a blaster power, you may use their blaster power.
objects.title: (Master) Puppeteer

objects.text: You can completely control a person's actions and powers while you are touching them, but they are free as soon as you let go.
objects.title: (Master) Play Along

objects.text: You can cause other people around you to monologue for long periods of time without them realizing it. This can cause them to reveal all forms of information they otherwise wouldn't normally say.
objects.title: (Master) Monologue

objects.text: With this power, you can command anyone with just a glance. The longer the target is exposed to your serious glare, the more overwhelming the sensation of compliance becomes. They will feel an irresistible urge to do whatever you want, against their own free will, as if possessed.
objects.title: (Master) Heavy Gaze

objects.text: You are able to conjure three powerful, muscular horses that can sprint at a speed of Mach 3, making them an elite and speedy means of transportation. These horses also have (Mover) Stairway to Heaven, allowing them to run in the air. If the horses remain in close proximity to each other, they can combine their abilities to form a chariot-like construct, enabling a rider to travel at superhuman speeds without experiencing any negative effects, such as inertia or nausea. This chariot also grants the rider a minor cognitive boost, allowing their mind to process information at a heightened rate, thus eliminating any perception of time dilation.
objects.title: (Master/Mover) Rodeo

objects.text:
You can create multiple glowing, translucent copies of yourself, each one appearing side by side in a chain that connects back to you. Creating these clones cost stamina. These clones can’t stray far from one another, requiring close proximity and coordination, but this makes for a highly synchronized team. You and your clones are adept at working together, making it easy to execute complex strategies and formations. Each clone do not have any of your powers. 

When you take damage, the damage is randomly trqanfered to one of your clones. The clones are also relativly more fragile than you, shattering when they take too much damage.
objects.title: (Master/Brute) Ghost Copies

objects.text: When this power is activated this forces whoever you ask a question to answer truthfully. This works off the spirit of the question, your power automatically communicating your intentions even when you would fail. This can be directed as you wish, only affecting those you wish to effect and no one else.
objects.title: (Master) Confession

addons.text:
A Demon of the Heart’s awakening and every person’s Shadow, are mere facets of the same idea: a person's worst True Self. A person’s Heart Demon and Dark Passenger consolidate into a more invasive entity, an Imago Diaboli—a version of themselves with their worst impulses and flaws, that feeds off of the entirety of the target’s worst aspects.

It’ll haunt the target at every moment, warping their sense of reality to cave into their urges and worst selves unwittingly, isolating them from anyone capable of bringing them to their senses. Its method overwhelms the target, catastrophizing the entity as apparently insurmountable, giving the entity more power and influence the more the target crumbles over the enormity of their materialized faults, with the entity briefly taking control in a black-out episode to act on their vices or urges, sinking the target’s mental health. Once the target’s at an all-time low, who they once were will “give up”, and the entity shall take their place in return.

Just like both powers, the only way to overcome this is by confronting and accepting this crystallized image, rejecting the entity’s prospect and accepting it as part of oneself, denying the entity of what it feeds on.
addons.title: Inner Temptation

addons.text:
The monster manifested from a person’s sins takes on Dark Passenger’s traits. First, it removes your touch-based limitation; as long as you put a name to the target’s face, you can implant and form the monster. They are comparably ruthless, especially to their “maker”—never turning down an opportunity to goad or mock them for their “weakness”, having a more overt influence of their “maker” the closer they are, becoming more irritable, quick to anger, or sensitive to their negative traits or emotions. Made of the sins and the target’s darker mental facets and actions that pushed them to act them out, the monster is two times more powerful than normal, already cunning enough to outwit the target, with the finality of “breaking” the target’s will, leaving a husk of their former selves without fully taking over their body, a puppet in all but name for the monster to hide.

Confronting their darker impulses and the sins hounding them will weaken the manifestation’s power and strength, fully dispelling once the target has attained a fulfilling closure with the sins they hold.
addons.title: Outer Struggle

objects.text:
Through touch, you can implant (or rouse out) a dark passenger, a person’s Shadow or darker side brought to life within their mind. This manifests as voices, urges, and thoughts they usually put off as intrusive that gains push inside their psyche, increasingly becoming sociopathic to homicidal as more time passes, their mind deteriorating the more they fight against this side of themselves. If a person caves in, the passenger overtakes the person’s psyche, essentially overwriting their mind in a literal bent of Shadow Possession.

There’s a way out, though; the target can either resolve to confront this side of themselves or even integrate it from within, “killing” the dark passenger and leaving the target with a stronger psyche or mental strength than before.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Dark Passenger

addons.text:
Your body is a stage, your voice an instrument, and together they shape the masses. You now possess an innate mastery of dance, moving with effortless grace no matter the style, and your power naturally helps you improvise songs that perfectly complement your motions. 

Singing makes people eager to listen and follow, while dancing reinforces deep, involuntary obedience. They are able to piggyback off each other, with the song being able to be transferred fully through electronics via the ripples, and the strength of the ripples able to match the strength of your song.

Additionally when you sing and dance together, those who follow your commands begin to grow stronger. Their physical and mental capabilities subtly enhance the more they obey—reacting faster, thinking sharper, and even enduring more. This makes your enthralled followers not just loyal, but increasingly formidable. The effect is temporary but can become permanent with prolonged influence.
addons.title: Siren’s Call

objects.text:
Whenever you dance you can emit ripples in the air that causes anyone hit by them to enter a trance and obey anything you say. If your dance was the most atrocious thing ever the ripples would barely travel away from you and those caught by them would not obey any order that they absolutely would not want to—plus it wouldn't last long—, as such the better your moves the farther those ripples travel, the more orders can bypass unwillingness and the more the trance will last.

This works through electronics, with said electronics acting as vectors for the ripples—so if the ripples extended 5 meters from you a TV would send ripples up to 5 meters. If you were the best dancer in the world not only would your range be that of an entire city but by that point your suggestions would become permanently absolute.
objects.title: (Master) Hypnodancer

addons.text:
Now, when you steal everything from somebody with your “The Face Stealer” power, your victim will become a new Blank Doll under your power, allowing you to have several non-finalized dolls at once. Your dolls also benefit from the suspended state property, making them practically immortal with the Faceless upgrade pushing this even further, allowing them to go beyond human limits.

If you have the Face Giver upgrade, the additional forms on your dolls can be used for swapping as well, but the power will always interact with the form they were using for defeating their opponents. This also allows you to harvest a doll in its now complete form(s) for your face collection instead of finalizing a complete doll.
addons.title: Doll Factory

addons.text:
Now your dolls become linked to every living being they swapped their original physical parts with. The doll has control over what is transmitted through the link, so it could be nothing, limited to sensation or even physical effects, in which case it's halved between the doll and the original being, so sharing a bleeding injury will cause both the doll and the original to bleed out at the same halved rate. The doll always has higher priority, so by sharing its sense of sight, the original owner will see everything from the doll’s perspective, but becomes blind by their own.

As the effect is tied to the doll parts swapped over to the victims, it will cease to function if said part is removed.
addons.title: Living Voodoo Doll

addons.text:
Your base power synergized with your specialization in modularity, enabling you to disassemble your Blank Doll into parts and tinker with those parts separately. This also allows you to build extra replacement parts and store any detached part without degradation. This also pushes your specialty into Bio-Tinkering as any swapped parts will still qualify for you to detach and tinker with. Your finalized dolls will lose this modularity, but they will also need no maintenance on anything you tinkered with on their body before that.

With only this add-on, you are still limited to having one functioning Blank Doll even if you manage to assemble more complete bodies from spare parts.
addons.title: Modular Chassis

objects.text:
You gain the ability to summon a blank mannequin-like projection which has a physical and mental capability on par with a completely average human but no true sentience. This doll will have complete loyalty and devotion towards you accomplishing your orders to its best. Whenever your doll defeats somebody, you will get a mental choice between 3 random traits their opponent has. These can include things like body parts, physical stats, mental capabilities, skills, and even powers. Your selected choice will be swapped between your doll and its defeated opponent. This is a complete swap, so it's possible to be a downgrade for the doll, like swapping its average strength with somebody who is below average, and any physical swap will also come with connected biological systems, but also with their drawbacks, like swapping their mouth would come with a complete digestive system and a need for sustenance and breathing. The doll parts will provide a permanent minor power for their new owners to guarantee their function within the average human range, so even if they lose something like their eyes, they will still retain their capability to see.

Having your doll kill an opponent will grant you a single swap of your choice with its victim instead, and defeating the same opponent multiple times will grant an increased chance to pull traits they value more.

The doll starts with no powers for itself, but it has a single empty slot which it can swap. In case you have the ability to grant powers to your doll, it will manifest as extra slots taken up by the power(s), making it possible to give it multiple powers. Your doll is always a valid target for any power designed to empower/enhance other beings, even in its non-living state.

When your doll becomes fully biological, no longer having any of its original physical blank parts, you gain access to a mental trigger to finalize your doll, making it a permanent living being still under your master effect with its own developing sentience, but no longer capable of swapping traits. Finalized dolls no longer count as your original projection, allowing you to summon a new fresh Blank Doll as well.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Blank Doll

objects.text:
You can create fully-formed adult humans at the cost of stamina. Creating more than one in a day risks feeling like you ran a marathon. The resulting Workers are complete individuals with moderate fitness and age-appropriate skills, but you control only the broadest categories of their purpose. You cannot specify their exact appearance, personality, or background. They emerge with mundane documentation and belongings, immediately integrated into the world by a potent Stranger effect that rewrites peripheral memories. To all observers, a Worker has always existed as an unremarkable member of society.

While intrinsically loyal to your well-being, Workers possess full autonomy of mind and will. They argue, dissent, and refuse orders they deem foolish or harmful to you, serving as a council rather than a slave army. However, they possess zero instinct for self-preservation. A Worker will calmly and logically walk into certain death if it is the most efficient way to advance your safety or goals, viewing their own existence as entirely expendable.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Workers

objects.text:
Compel a living creature within your line of sight to dance. Target begins to perform a comical dance: shuffling, tapping its feet and capering with burning passion. A dancing creature cannot move away from its original position and will have a hard time focusing on something else.

Effect requires a concentration from you and can be ended prematurely by individuals with especially strong will.
objects.title: (Master) Irresistible Dance

objects.text: You can cause a target to have a "gut" feeling about a particular subject, You can influence what this gut feeling will be, but you can't completely control it.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Instinct

objects.text: You can regurgitate the nutrients in your body, keeping the bare minimum to keep your body functional, and from that regurgitation you produce rats, which you can control with precision, seeing and sensing through their eyes. The rats created are smarter and tougher, able to defeat a teen with their strength and wit alone. However, the more rats you directly control, the smaller your shared sight becomes, making it more difficult to see through each rat individually, ultimately only being able to see what multiple of your rats see. Your rats can grow by eating, increasing in strength and intelligence up to being as big and strong as a bulldog and as smart as a monkey. If your rats devour a human, they will be able to grow further, becoming as big as a grown pig while gaining a bipedal appearance, gaining the dexterity equivalent to a monkey. Once they reach this state, you lose control over them but they remain loyal to you.
objects.title: (Master) Ratatouille

objects.text: You have the ability to taunt any enemies in a 100 meter radius, pulling their attention towards you while making them ignore any attacks from others, up to a certain point. This also gives you a slight brute rating.
objects.title: (Master/Brute) Come at Me Bro!

addons.text: You can choose to fuse the Heart Demon you made with the monster created based on the sins of the target. In this form, the Heart Demon can grow stronger the more sins the target has done. Simply getting over whatever issue the Heart Demon feeds from is not enough, for it now embodies every sin they have done. The only way to survive is to repent for every sin they've done, and for every second they don't, the Heart Demon will force them to suffer just as they made others suffer. If they don't fully repent fast enough or the Heart Demon becomes strong enough, they will die.
addons.title: Heart of Sin

objects.text: With a touch, you can awaken a Heart Demon in someone. This Heart Demon will take the form of some issue that the target is facing. At the start, it'll be very weak—only appearing in dreams to torment its target. But the longer the issue festers, the stronger the Heart Demon becomes. Given enough time or if the target spirals from the given issue, the Heart Demon can activately manipulate the target's senses and even temporarily control them when they feel negative emotions. The stronger the Heart Demon, the more strain it causes on the target's heart, literally. If it gets strong enough, the target will die from a heart attack. The only way to defeat the Heart Demon is through accepting and moving past whatever issue the Heart Demon is feeding on. For example, if it is feeding on trauma from a specific incident, the only way to defeat it is to move past your trauma.
objects.title: (Master) Heart Demon

objects.text: You can duplicate everybody that you can currently see and yourself. Duplicates spawn directly behind the original, facing in the opposite direction. Everybody duplicated by your power controls both their original body and the cloned body; however, because you can’t give secondary multitasking power to anybody they clone, the overall effect is highly disorienting rather than empowering. Duplicates are ‘fragile'—if they’re knocked unconscious, even for just a moment, they vanish.
objects.title: (Master) Ditto

objects.text: You can influence a target to do something they would not as long as they see you do it first. This can range from making normal civilians decide to become pretend capes to capes deciding to speak things differently.
objects.title: (Master) Join The Madness

objects.text: From your shadow, you can create crow projections. These projections can go as far as 20 kilometers away from you and are no faster or stronger than an average crow. If they die, their bodies will break apart into shadows. You can see through these projections, and while you have a general level of control over them, they are mostly independent, only staying within your range, moving to locations you dictate and swarming targets of your choice. Your crows have a passive aura around them that heightens fear, anxiety, dread and despair. The more crows there are in an area, the stronger their collective aura becomes. You can only summon 10 crows a day but can keep them summoned indefinitely, allowing you to slowly build up the amount of crows under your control.
objects.title: (Master) Scarecrow

objects.text: Whenever you save someone's life, they are compelled to be completely loyal to you, though they still maintain their original morals and rationality. This loyalty diminishes every time they do you good, and once they have done the equivalent of saving your life in deeds the loyalty breaks, though you can refresh their loyalty at any time by saving their life again.
objects.title: (Master) Karma Repayment

objects.text: You gain the ability to sense and project anger and rage from those within a few blocks of you. The emotional reaction is dependent on the person affected but is also subtle and slow enough that unless they are already aware of you and your power would seem natural. You also gain an increase in general durability and strength proportional to the anger of those around you.
objects.title: (Master/Brute) Anger Issues

objects.text: When you defeat someone, you can inspire them to follow you. As long as you are strong enough to defeat them they will remain loyal to you. You can make them genuinely loyal to you during this time.
objects.title: (Master) In Your Shadow

objects.text:
You are able to incubate living beings within your own body. These incubations can occur anywhere on your body—your abdomen, shoulders, back, legs, or even more unorthodox places like your skull. The process begins subtly, with a small, almost imperceptible bulge forming beneath the skin. Over the course of seven days, the growth becomes more pronounced, swelling outward until it resembles a heavily pregnant belly.

During this gestation period, you will feel an ever-growing hunger. The larger the bulge, the more ravenous you become, as your body diverts an increasing portion of its resources to nourish what’s growing within. Once the week is complete, the bulge ruptures painlessly and bloodlessly, and the creature is birthed fully alive. Your body heals from the rupture near-instantly, leaving no trace of trauma.

Each creature birthed is tailored by your intent and will, guided and rendered viable by your shard, allowing you to create biologically plausible beings in nearly any shape or function—predators, scouts, weapons, guardians, or even intelligent companions. At birth, these entities are in an infantile or juvenile stage and will continue to grow and develop over time, with the full maturation process taking anywhere from one week to a full month depending on their designed strength, complexity, and purpose.

You may carry multiple incubations simultaneously, however, the more you carry, the more visible, vulnerable, and demanding the process becomes. Damage dealt directly to the gestating bulges can disrupt the process—if an unborn creature is fatally harmed or killed during gestation, you will feel intense pain, as well as need to restart the incubation from the beginning.
objects.title: (Master/Changer) Incubator

objects.text:
You emanate a passive, ambient influence that gradually reshapes the social landscape around you, drawing individuals together into a cohesive and loyal group—your gang. This is not overt mind control, but a slow, insidious molding of social alignment and group dynamics. People who share even loosely similar views, goals, or outlooks are the first to be affected, requiring less internal friction to be pulled into your orbit. As your power takes hold, these individuals start aligning their perspective with yours. With enough time—typically a full day of consistent proximity or shared space—they begin to shift, behaviorally and socially, to mirror your unspoken leadership.

As more time passes, the effect deepens. Their independent charisma, social status, and presence are subtly drained—not in a way that leaves them empty, but in a way that funnels that weight and force into you. They speak less, listen more, and begin to defer to you in ways they may not even recognize. In turn, you become exponentially more commanding and persuasive. Your social gravity intensifies with each person pulled into your sphere, allowing you to sway others with a glance, end arguments with a word, and unify disparate groups into a singular identity: yours.

Each new addition reinforces the illusion of legitimacy and cohesion, making the group appear from the outside as something elite, respected, enviable. People not yet under your influence instinctively perceive the unity, the confidence, the shared language of status—and they want in. Outsiders look upon your group with fascination and longing, compelled by the idea that your orbit is where the power, belonging, and momentum are.

The formation of loyalty is slower for those with opposing worldviews or deep resistance but the effect is patient and relentless. Once someone is drawn in, they defend you with the fervor of someone protecting their identity.
objects.title: (Master) Gang Leader

objects.text:
You can induce specific thought to a target within your line of sight, which becomes more prominent the longer you keep your influence. At first, it will be fleeting and brief, but with each passing moment it will occupy their mind more and more, until they become unable to think about anything else. 

Their mind will enter an endless cycle with this thought alone. Even if attacked, they will still be completely occupied by this single obsession, not reacting to the assault. 

It takes around a minute until they become entirely obsessed and you need to maintain a relatively strong concentration on this task, you can be interrupted by sufficiently strong stimuli. The effect fades away gradually within 30 seconds after your influence has ended.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Fleeting Obsession

objects.text: With repeated exposure, you can make people think of others in certain ways. This power only activates when you, the person you're affecting, and the person you want to change what they think about are in the presence of eachother.
objects.title: (Master) Red Strings

objects.text: You have the ability to force everyone around you, including yourself, into a turn-based state. When activated, each individual is assigned a turn in a random order, during which they can perform one deliberate action. An action is defined as any intentional act that requires effort, such as attacking, activating a power, moving, using an item, or activating a device. Subconscious actions and passive powers like breathing, blinking or regeneration do not count as actions and occur freely. For example, if a someone chooses to attack, that attack is their action for the turn, and they cannot move or use another ability until their next turn. Similarly, casting a spell, moving to a new location, using an item, or activating a device each constitutes a single action per turn. You can keep this state up for no longer than 10 minutes.
objects.title: (Master) Turn Based RPG

objects.text: With just a touch and a word, you can make anyone forget everything and anything related to that word as well as the word itself. This can range from names to objects, or even general knowledge. They will totally forget everything about it, even the definition of it.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Forget It

objects.text: You can create intangible sand-like constructs that cause those who come into contact with them to fall asleep. You are able to manipulate the dreams and nightmares of your targets, allowing you to induce pleasant or horrifying dreams. You can control the dreamscape itself, crafting any situation or environment you desire, and the individuals experiencing these dreams will feel as though they are actually there. You can also access the unconscious minds of their targets, giving them insight into their deepest desires, fears, and memories.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Sandman

objects.text: You can create a projection of an animal. This does not have to be a real animal, the only limitation is that it has to be smaller than an elephant. You cannot change what kind of animal your projection is. It can be anything from a flying walrus to a dragon the size of an ant.
objects.title: (Master) Spirit Animal

objects.text: You can give yourself or others an increasing amount of dread the more an action is performed repeatedly. The longer they repeat the action, the more they will dislike it. This can be subtle in as many as 4000 repeats needed to hate it or as few as 10 repeats needed.
objects.title: (Master) Lifestyle Changer

objects.text: You can create watery monsters out of nearby sources of water. Once created, the watery monster can use hydrokinesis of its own to attack others and reinforce itself, following your mental directives. If the monster is frozen or sufficiently dissipated, the watery monsters will be considered dead. The more water there is, the bigger and stronger the watery monsters can be.
objects.title: (Master) Naiad

objects.text:
You can sense and consume emotions, drawing them from others as if they were a tangible energy source. It is easier and more effective for you to sense and eat emotions directed at you. When you feed on emotions, they nourish and empower you, granting a temporary surge of strength and vitality. Draining people of their emotions leave them lethargic and apathetic. This state is temporary but draining all of their emotions multiple times extends the duration of this state until it becomes permanent. 

Note that indulging in too many emotions at once carries risks. Overconsumption leads to a volatile reaction within you, resulting in a your vomiting, releasing pure, liquid emotion. This liquid, a concentrated essence of whatever feeling you consumed, is potent and potentially dangerous. If another person were to ingest this emotional substance, they would experience an overwhelming burst of that specific emotion, magnified to an extreme. 

For example, if you had gorged on hatred, drinking this liquid would fill the person with an uncontrollable surge of hatred, likely consuming their thoughts and behavior.
objects.title: (Master/Brute) Emotivore

addons.text:
You are no longer limited to just inducing pain and may set more exotic punishments such as burns, electric shocks, increased sensitivity, or total sensory deprivation. 

The only real limitation to what punishments you can dole out are that Shard effects beyond the level of T1 are unavailable to you unless you possess a power which operates on similar principles, in which case your Shard had the relevant [DATA] to enact those effects.
addons.title: Unusual Punishment

objects.text:
By touching someone you can place a brand on them which can induce either pain or pleasure in accordance with rules you set when placing the brand. This allows you to condition those you mark, inducing pain when they act against you and pleasure when they obey. The rules you set can be as elaborate and precise as you desire.

This also has combat applications as you can tag someone in a fight and immediately make it so even thinking about trying to harm you causes excruciating pain as if every nerve was set on fire.

You can have as many brands as you desire active at a time, but a brand will wear off after a week unless reapplied. You may dictate what levels of pain or pleasure are induced, ranging from a subtle warmth to feeling as if every nerve was bathed in salt and then set on fire.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Pavlov

addons.text:
Your shard has decided to stop treating the prevention of your harm as a single moment, and now considers it to be an ongoing process. Rather than protecting against harm in the moment, it now simulates a continuous, recursive effect within those that plan, carry out, or directly assist in a chain of events that would lead to your harm.


Within this effect, their perception is continuously rewritten and retried in small, second-long loops, forcing them to do things differently every time until the shard singles out a loop where the result is your continued safety. However, the more these individuals loop, the more their newly acquired Thinker headaches begin to act up. From here, there are two paths: They successfully learn - unconsciously or otherwise - to change any behavior that might put you at risk, or they get an aneurysm or worse.
addons.title: Act On Intent

objects.text: Whenever somebody harms, kills, or otherwise acts against you physically with malevolent intent, they are shunted back in time to a few seconds before their action, as if their previous actions were nothing more than a memory. Functionally, this is your shard feeding their mind precognitive visions by simulating their actions and continuing this cycle until they choose to take action in a way that does not lead to your harm by their hand. To other people as well as yourself, nobody seems to be capable of bringing you harm. You are not aware of anything that happens within these visions - and due to the precognition taking place in others’ brains rather than yours, your aggressors receive Thinker headaches that continue to scale with how many times they attempt to harm or kill you.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Majority Report

objects.text:
By looking at someone you are able to gradually alter and refine certain areas of the brain relating to social ability and memory. This ability first focuses on altering the brain towards at least the functionality of the average human, and plateaus at a level that lets targets function as mid-level social thinkers with photographic memory, though this would take hours.

The biggest drawback and strength of this power is that empathy, guilt, and overall emotional capacity fall under this purview of social ability. This power can give hardened war criminals a working conscience in short time. If you were to actually maximize someone's brain with your power their ability to empathize would likely lead them to dedicate their life to making other people happy, with their memory letting them never forget any wrong they've committed.

That being said, there is a point at which the suffering and guilt one person can experience plateaus as their capacity to work through their emotions in a healthy manner outweighs their ever-increasing empathy.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Heartmaker

objects.text:
If any reflective surface shows at least ten percent of your body within a person's field of view, the effect triggers. This could be your full silhouette in a mirror, your head and shoulders in a window, or just your legs in a puddle. The moment their eyes register that image, their attention locks onto it completely. They cannot look away, they cannot focus on anything else, and all other thoughts are forcibly shut down.

While trapped in this state, the victim's mind is reduced to a single looping process. They experience a total cognitive arrest where every thought is an involuntary expression of worship toward the image they see. Their internal monologue becomes a ceaseless stream of adoration, marveling at the perceived perfection, beauty, and grandeur of the reflection. No fear, planning, or situational awareness can break through. Physically, they stand or sit frozen, eyes fixed, utterly defenseless. The experience feels transcendent while it lasts, a moment of pure blissful devotion with no room for anything else.

The effect breaks instantly the moment your reflection leaves their sight, whether because you moved, the surface was obscured, or someone pulled them away. However, the memory of the mental experience does not fade like a normal recollection. It sits in their mind as a flawless, glowing memory of the most euphoric and sublime moment they have ever felt. This remembered bliss can foster a desperate longing to experience it again, making them vulnerable to voluntary re-exposure.
objects.title: (Master) Narcissus

objects.text:
You can cause individuals to owe you one-time ‘favors’, which you may later call in to directly influence and manipulate them.

You acquire these favors by placing someone in your debt, regardless of its nature, through your actions (or inaction). To form a favor, a sense of moral obligation must be recognised by the person on some level, even if only subconsciously.

Individuals may owe you multiple favors at once and these can range from helping cover up a mistake to rescuing them from death’s door. The weight a favor carries is directly proportional to the cost, risk and impact of the act that formed it. This influence manifests as an imperceptible master/stranger effect, biasing them to your aid.

Your actions must be meaningfully notable to generate a favor; minor assistance and kindness such as holding open a door or offering brief help is insufficient. Comparatively, grievous personal sacrifice on your part or directly saving their life may form a favor powerful enough to compel near-absolute cooperation.

When calling in a favor, the request must be comprehensible and finite. If a request reaches beyond a person's capabilities and/or the favor's influence, the favor's effectiveness is reduced or may fail entirely. A favor cannot be used to directly acquire more favors from the same person but indirect methods are feasible.

You retain full awareness of all favors owed to you, including who owes them, what caused each one and the degree of influence they can exert. You may spend favors whenever you are communicating with the person in question at anytime.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Owe You One

objects.text:
