You may designate any one person you can see or sufficiently identify, including through representations such as photographs, recordings, or similar media, as your subject.

That person becomes absolutely loyal to you for as long as they remain selected.

This loyalty does not overwrite their personality, memories, preferences, emotions, intelligence, or mannerisms. They remain entirely themselves, except that their loyalty to you is genuine, complete, and unquestionable. 

They will act according to both the spirit of your intentions rather than deliberately misinterpreting orders, exploiting technicalities, withholding relevant information, or otherwise attempting to circumvent what you actually want.

Their loyalty does not require constant commands. They can think independently, take initiative, disagree with you when they genuinely believe you are mistaken, and otherwise behave according to their normal personality, but always from the position of sincerely wanting your interests and intentions upheld.

The effect is psychological rather than simple bodily control. While Suzerain is responsible for imposing the loyalty, a subject’s experiences while under its influence remain real. Relationships, affection, trust, habits, beliefs, and other changes that naturally develop during that period may persist afterward.

You may have only one active subject at a time. Selecting someone else immediately releases the previous subject from Suzerain, removing only the loyalty directly maintained by the power. Any loyalty or other feelings they have naturally developed remain their own.
objects.title: (Master) Suzerain

addons.title: Technopathic Swarm
addons.text: Each of your Bugs becomes a transmitter for your Technopathy, allowing precise control of electronics beyond your normal Technopathy range though individual Bugs. You may also use the electricity of electronics within your Technopathy range to create Bugs.

objects.text: “Looks like your Shard got a little confused about computer bugs.” You can absorb small amounts of electrical energy, using it to create Bugs. These Bugs are clumps of living electricity, and a close look would reveal they are similar in shape to hornets. You have a control capacity of one hundred Bugs, with a maximum range of five hundred feet. You're able to tap into their senses, which are slightly better than a normal hornet's senses. Though their true potential lies in their electrokinetic abilities, including a five-foot electrical sense around each one. A single one can create a weak taser like shock, while all of them together could unleash a lightning bolt. Though this would cause them to overload, destroying them. Additionally, they can cause malfunctions in electronics they're touching. Larger numbers of them can allow actual technopathic control. However, that would require practice.
objects.title: (Master) Bugs

addons.text:
Now your brand can interact with any addictions you set up, rewarding them for indulging and triggering punishments as they try to resist. But most importantly, any brand linked to an addiction will have its duration refreshed the moment they feed their addictions to a certain threshold. With this threshold being lower, less common is the target of addiction. The duration reset would need a rapid consumption of a jug of water to trigger, but a single shot of alcohol would suffice. Your brand will also have some elements in its design representing its linked addictions.

The base duration of your mark is also increased to a month.
addons.title: Perpetual Reinforcement

addons.text:
As your target(s) affected by Anti-Addictol experience withdrawal effects, they slowly develop a power perfect for seeking out their next hit. The maximum strength of these powers is still limited to 5sp or less, but it will stay up until they satisfy their cravings.

The power they gain will always have you as their blind spot, so they can never develop a counter for Anti-Addictol itself or anything designed directly against you.
addons.title: Craving Power

objects.text: You gain the ability to manipulate addictions to a limited degree, you can remove addictions or modify pre-existing addiction your target has to anything else. The modified addiction will keep the addictiveness of the original source, so if you made your target react to your voice or simple water like they would react to narcotics, then every time they hear you or drink water, they will feel the same rush as if they have taken the substance. This can have a compounding effect by combining all of their addictions into a single one.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Anti-Addictol

objects.text: You can control any electronic within 200 meters of yourself and become a genius when it comes to coding. You can hack into electronics farther than 200 meters from you as long as you're using an electronic within 200 meters of you to do it.
objects.title: (Master) Technopathy

addons.text:
Your powers, both centred around controlling plants, have merged, giving you a perfect resulting combination. This new level of control allows you to not only telekinetically control any plants within your range but also manipulate and alter them as you please, without needing to interact with the plants directly. You can cause the grass beneath your enemy's feet to turn deadly poisonous, boost the size and strength of vines to help restrain them or remotely shape entire orchards to your liking.

Your awareness and control over plants have expanded to a total radius of 3 kilometres. You still cannot make plants fly unless the plant has been modified to possess that capability.
addons.title: Shaper of Flora

objects.text: You have telekinetic control over all plants within 500 feet. You can do things like use vines to trap people or crush them with a tree. You cannot make plants fly. You also have an unlimited capacity to multitask to control plants.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Poison Ivy

objects.text: You can produce white, physically androgynous humanoids from your body, which physically copy any equipment that you are wearing upon creation. They are made out of a clay-like substance about as durable as bone and feel no pain. These creatures will only follow your commands unless stated otherwise. Additionally, by focusing on a skill, these creations become masters of said skill at "birth" (ex: gun use, martial arts, painting, chess, etc.) and can be used as support. The limits are that they are only limited to one per skill; as such, it’s impossible to create two creations with gun-wielding skills.
objects.title: (Master) Clay Servants

objects.text: You can release small nearly invisible strands of harmless string from your fingertips that can control up to 10 objects or people in a distance of 1000 meters. The string would go through any material, but esoteric effects would fail. You can apply the effects of your Striker powers through them. Anyone using powers can cut through your strings.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Strings

objects.text: You can create fragile clones of yourself. Their durability it low and their copies of your powers weaken the more clones you have. At one clone, its power will be half as strong as yours, at 100 they'll be just under a hundredth as strong as you. When one of your clones is popped, you'll receive their memories. You can create a maximum of 100 clones. Your clones do not have this power.
objects.title: (Master) Kage no Bunshin

objects.text: You can make one person at a time fall deeply in love with you. They can realize they're being Mastered, and their reaction to this depends on their personality, the situation, and their past interactions with you.
objects.title: (Master) Love at First Sight

objects.text: Whenever you truly save someone, whether their life or from a horrid fate, you will gain their perfect and unbreakable loyalty. They will swear their lives to you, and will do everything in the power to help you. This also works on enemies you choose to spare. Your aware of when this can activate and can choose for it to activate or not, as well as who it applies to or not.
objects.title: (Master) Hero Worship

addons.text:
Your paradoxical power has evolved thanks to the new timelines it has now access of. You still can't use those abilities yourself due to their reverse-causal usage but now your future self sends a clone for each future experienced with Schrodinger with a time limit of 1 minute, they will still appear close to you and you have now a vague sense of their position.

Each of them has its own timer and the time limit can be modulated so that some clones may disappear earlier than others although they all have to be gone for new ones to appear again, you can however forcefully remove any of them via a bit of concentration.
addons.title: Continuum

objects.text:
You possess the ability to send a clone of yourself into your past for up to 20 seconds, the clone will appear close to you and will instantly disappear after the 20 seconds have passed and you cannot use your power as long as the clone is still here (if it dies, it will stay here until the timer has expired).

The particularity of this power means that, from your perspective, you will never actually use your power, as the clone's arrival inevitably undoes the reason for its existence.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Paradox

addons.text: The more people worship you, the stronger all your abilities (besides this one) become, fueled by their belief. This also enhances your physical prowess and mental acuity. However, this power is not all powerful. The loss of faith or dwindling followers can weaken you, although it will never go below your base power.
addons.title: Faithful

objects.text: You possess the ability to alter people's perception of you, making them see and worship you as a divine, god-like figure. Under the influence of this power, they exhibit unwavering reverence and awe, treating your words and actions as sacred. This effect is temporary and fades after a certain period of distance. Even when the influence dissipates, those who were affected will not notice anything strange from their altered behavior or the adoration they felt.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Divine

addons.title: Super Mutant Mob
addons.text: Those you've made grow will mutate at twice the speed they normally would, this doesn't effect the stability of the mutation. Allowing for either rapid uncontrolled mutations, or faster controlled mutations. If you fully mutate someone under these conditions, they will retain the Breaker state as a permanent effect.

objects.text:
You can induce rapid and extreme mutations in biological creatures, changing their form in seconds. These mutations always enhance the target’s physical attributes, increasing its size, strength, and natural abilities—teeth grow longer, muscles thicken, hides toughen, and reflexes sharpen. However, such rapid evolution comes at a cost.

The more you push a creature’s mutation, the more its intelligence deteriorates. Higher reasoning gives way to instinct, and as the mutations progress, the creature becomes increasingly mindless. However, the dumber it becomes, the more fiercely loyal it is to you, following your commands without hesitation. If mutated too far, its brain devolves to the point of complete dysfunction, rendering it incapable of survival and resulting in death.

Additionally, repeated or extreme mutations increase the likelihood of sterility. A creature that undergoes mild or controlled mutations may still reproduce, but those subjected to excessive changes are more likely to become completely sterile.

For a more stable approach, you can slow the mutation process, allowing for controlled adaptations with fewer drawbacks. This method preserves more of the creature’s intelligence and biological integrity; however, in turn, this means they will have less inherent loyalty towards you. All changes are permanent.
objects.title: (Master) Mutant Mob

objects.text:
This power alters the thought processes of anyone that sees you, making them gradually become protective of you and unwilling to hurt you. The more time someone spends under the influence of the power, the more fanatical they become, doing everything in their power to do things you ask of them and to make you happy. You cannot tone down or deactivate this effect.

Long term exposure to this power causes those were exposed to become fanatical and violent, warping the way they see reality and their memories to make them seek to “protect” you from even the most minor threats, most of the time with lethal force, additionally due to the victims of this power becoming obsessed with protecting you, most under the influence of this power will hide their actions from you.

The effects of the passive power fade over time without exposure, lasting longer the more intensely people were affected, the exposed often feel confused and guilty for their actions while affected heavily. On top of that, those affected by this power are subconsciously aware of your opinions on things and adjust their behavior accordingly, such as pulling their punches against someone you care about.

Taking the perk Holding Back allows you to tune and turn off this power, or make it affect specific targets.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Fanatic Loyalty

addons.text: Your pool increases slowly, the rate increasing by staying in darker places. This allows you to create more shadow minions. All your shadow minions also gain the ability to both stay within your shadow and travel in a 2 dimensional form.
addons.title: Shadow Lands

objects.text: You can detach your shadow, allowing it to move around freely and act as it wishes. It can freely travel through or stay within other shadows, however its movements will be limited when in the light. You can also manifest your shadow, giving it an actual 3 dimensional form instead of its original 2 dimensional form. The shadow can morph itself, however limited only to what types of shadows you can make via shadow puppets. Your shadow will be stronger the bigger it naturally would be, and the more shadows there are in the area. When detached you will have no shadow.
objects.title: (Master) Detached Shadow

addons.text: You can make it so that when the spectral doppelgänger is defeated, its memories and experiences during the combat are transferred to the original target. This sudden influx of information causes a sharp, intense headache akin to a thinker headache, overwhelming the target with the full brunt of the doppelgänger's experiences. This added effect not only leaves the target physically exhausted but also mentally strained. You can make more than one spectral doppelgänger for each target, and doing so weakens the spectral doppelgänger. 2 clones make them 50% as strong as the original, 3 will be 33%, etc. This doesn't weaken the headache from the memory transferred. You can make a maximum of 100 clones, each having 1% of the target's strength. You will not suffer any headaches if you use this on yourself.
addons.title: Spectral Remembrance

objects.text: You possess the ability to create a unique form of spectral doppelgänger by touching someone. This requires skin to skin contact. This invisible copy can only be seen by you and the original target, perfectly mirroring the target's skills and powers. This doesn't mean they are intangible; they just cannot be perceived by others. The doppelgänger's primary directive is to engage in combat with its original counterpart, fueled by an instinctual desire to fight and defeat them. They will not obey any command from you other than to fight their original. While the copy cannot directly harm the original, the pain from their attacks is significantly amplified, being two to three times greater than normal. The doppelgänger cannot be more than 1 kilometre away from their original. The spectral doppelgänger will only go away after being killed, being more than 1 kilometre away from their original, or being dismissed by you. You can use this power on yourself.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Shadow Boxing

objects.text:
You can bring your drawings to life as ink creatures, each imbued with traits and powers based on your artistry and the medium you use. The better and more detailed your drawing, the stronger, more stable, and lifelike the creature becomes. A hastily sketched doodle might result in a fragile, unstable creation, while a meticulously crafted masterpiece could yield a creature with impressive strength, intelligence, and resilience. Depending on their quality, they can have a maximum of 7 SP worth of powers.

However, your creations inherit properties from the surface they were drawn on. If you sketch on a delicate medium like paper, the creature will be vulnerable to water, fire, or tearing attacks. Conversely, a drawing etched on something durable, like stone, results in a creature far tougher to destroy. This trait is distinct from the creature’s overall durability, which is tied to the quality of the drawing itself.

You can unsummon the ink creatures at will, returning them to their original drawing, which will be altered based on the state of the ink creature when they were unsummoned.
objects.title: (Master) Scribble

objects.text:
You are a living lexicon, able to rapidly acquire understanding of any linguistic system from the vocabulary of languages to how they work to all the various regional dialects and accents. Your power analyzes all forms of communication you encounter - spoken, written, signed - ensuring swift comprehension. However, this is only the secondary function of your Thinker classification.

The core of your power allows you to read a person's internal 'linguistic map', able to trace associations in any direction you wish linguistically, from the technical associations of red with roses or the personal associations of 'red > shirt > dad > wore'. This can even work in real-time on their current chain of thought, such that if someone is speaking, for example, you could predict their next words before they even fully form them mentally.

Crucially, this linguistic map isn't just readable - it's modifiable. You can swap or overwrite connections. For instance, you could switch someone's understanding of 'red' and 'blue' though that would be more surface level as they simply swap the two names of the colors around. More complex changes - like altering their view of a loved one or enemy - require tampering with numerous associations and may take time to perfect. This doesn’t alter memories or emotions directly but reshapes how those experiences are interpreted, such as pulling together all of someone's knowledge about you remaining the same but creating such a strong connection to 'BAD IDEA' that they recoil at the very thought of you.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Skein

objects.text: Whenever you engage in combat of any kind with another parahuman, a charge begins to form inside of you. This charge takes anywhere from 10 minutes of combat to half an hour to build to completion, luckily for you these minutes don't need to happen all at once. Once this charge builds to completion you are able to spawn a half sized and half powered caricature of said parahuman. These caricatures last anywhere from 15 to 30 minutes depending on the strength of their progenitor. Additionally you are able to bank charges of multiple as well as the same parahumans.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Chibi Champion

objects.text:
This power adds a multiplier to any action you do that would increase your reputation with someone.
You can choose the multiplier, as long as it is no more than ten, but the more powerful it is, the less subtle it is.
objects.title: (Master) Positive Multiplier

objects.text:
You can emit a gas around your body. When inhaled, this gas breaks down specific neurological connections in the brain, leading to a complete collapse of the individual's established worldview. While their memories remain intact, their beliefs and interpretations of the world are entirely reset.

For example, if a doctor were exposed to the gas, they would still retain memories of their medical practice and skills, but might now believe in absurd notions, such as a banana being capable of curing a stab wound, similar to what a naive child might believe.

Immediately after exposure to the gas, individuals become highly susceptible to influence by the first narrative presented to them. For instance, a deeply religious person might become an atheist or adopt Mickey Mouse as their new deity. Similarly, a prejudiced individual could transform into an exceptionally open-minded person, and vice versa.

Upon receiving a replacement narrative, they unquestioningly accept everything presented to them. Alternatively, if left to their own devices, they may embrace any fanciful notions their mind might come up with.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Logosthesia

objects.text: You can temporarily siphon 25% of the mental capabilities of everyone within 25 meters of you. The combined intelligence, processing ability, multitasking, etc that you siphon lasts for 25 minutes after they leave your range, though your victims regain their full faculties immediately.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Brain Drain

objects.text:
You can summon little green men that stand 0.75 meters tall and possess an innate understanding of mudane technology. They can easily design cutting-edge technology that is fully replicable.

These little green men can operate on your behalf, either working individually or collaborating together to tackle large tasks, creating a versatile and effective workforce that can produce results efficiently and with high precision. 

While they are initially proficient in a wide range of technologies, they will gradually gain specialized areas of expertise as they become more experienced, allowing them to create pseudo-tinkertech. However, they will be inferior compared to tinkers with the same specialty, only beating them in their understanding of their technology.
objects.title: (Master/Tinker) Kerbal

objects.text: You can turn anybody you touch into a metre-tall imp with red skin, a tail, and horns for an hour. The imps will resemble their original appearance and retain all of their powers. They must obey every command of their master. The duration can be extended by touching the target again, but the more time somebody spends as an imp, the more they can twist the commands of their master or even resist them eventually.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Imp Master

objects.text:
You can spawn shadowy gremlins that lock on to the first target that they see. Each gremlin is about the size of a big chihuahua and can rush forward at Olympic speeds. A gremlin will relentlessly chase down its target until either the gremlin or the target is destroyed. When the gremlin reaches its target, it will hold down the target. You can switch the locations of any two gremlins at any time. If either Gremlin is holding onto its target, they will bring their target with them. You can make the gremlins change target.

Gremlins are very fragile; it takes just one ordinary-strength punch to dissipate a gremlin. Gremlins will intentionally move to avoid attacks; though they’re fast when they’re charging someone, they’re not very agile. They can be hard to aim at, as they are smoky and somewhat transparent.
objects.title: (Master/Mover) Gremlins

objects.text: You can create alternate copies of yourself that glow a random color, the color dictates your personality but their opinions and goals will match you. Red may be angrier than you but will still work and assist you. While you may not share memories or senses with them, they remember and inherit the knowledge of their predecessors. They have all the same powers and knowledge you have. You can dismiss them whenever you want.
objects.title: (Master) Mirror Mirror

objects.text:
You can command people to do something and they will follow it exactly as said. Those under your control will have a vacant stare and exhibit no emotions.

Depending on how you worded your sentences, they can forget what they did, do a command at certain triggers, or have it last an desired amount of time.
objects.title: (Master) Command

objects.text: You can completely dominate someone by touching them. This allows you to modify their mind, whether it be their memories, relationships, desires, personality, or even morals, though over the course of a month any modifications will slowly unravel, starting with morals and ending with memories.
objects.title: (Master) Dominate

objects.text:
Imagine being able to make it so that anyone was your best friend, trusted confidant, or loyal servant. Well, you can now, you can affect anybody by modifying their social and emotional relationship about yourself, temporarily or permanently to whatever you wish.

This can either be a change in how they act, or up to them suddenly having appropriate memories clear as day that makes them believe that it was always this way. You’re not limited to just the relationships between the target and yourself. You can make a man hate his best friend with murderous rage, leave his beloved wife the same way he’d walk away from a stranger on the street, or loyally and fervently dedicate himself to a cause he didn’t even know existed yesterday. 

This power can affect any number of people as long as you can directly perceive them, and you can roughly sense a person’s currently existing relationships when you pay attention.
objects.title: (Master) Relationship Modification

objects.text: This power consists of two parts: one is Thinker-related, allowing you to become a competent CEO/Boss of a company/business with expertise in all skills and learning of the craft. The other part enhances the abilities of your employees, similar to the Bastard Son (sans the detrimental effects), in their respective fields. Secretaries, programmers, researchers, and more become parahumanly adept in their trades. The effect is subtle and fades when they are not in their work areas. Field employers use their work base as their designated work area.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) The Boss

objects.text: You possess a passive and long-lasting master effect that implants something akin to a Conflict Drive in everyone around you. This effect interacts oddly with Parahumans, causing their Conflict Drive to worsen and their powers to gain an increasing trigger-happy power boost.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Haze of Conflict

objects.text:
To your vicinity, people’s uncomfortable truths about themselves are in plain sight within their mind’s eye, incapable of avoiding them, almost as if someone forces them to confront their biases and self-deception. You gain an insight into their unconscious truths and use it to your advantage or theirs if you’re more benevolent. 

When asked about something, they’ll tell you with the utmost truth as they lose their capacity to lie to themselves and others around you.

This can be therapeutic for some as it is crushing for others.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Truth Serum

objects.text:
You gain the ability to massively empower the effects of any interactions you have with others or others have with each other. 

A minor gift could be made to bring even the most entitled and unappreciative person to tears as if it was the most thoughtful thing they could have ever received, becoming a cherished memory.

The slightest smug expression could send even the most taciturn into a frothing rage, driving them to violence at the slightest provocation. 

You can control the intensity of these interactions and are able to control who can see and perceive the effects of the interaction, allowing you to send someone into a wild berserker rage with a massive crowd watching and believing they suddenly lost their mind, or have a crowd oohing and awwing when you give someone their dropped pen back. 

This effect extends through other media, allowing even recordings to generate the same effect.
objects.title: (Master) It’s The Thought That Counts

addons.text:
In addition to your base two bodies, any clones produced by Hive Mind also fall under Bilocation's selective sharing of beneficial changes, allowing for a much greater force multiplier for any improvements shared.

Do note however that past a high enough amount of clones, any shared benefits will begin to tax your shard more intensely, even moreso for power-granted enhancements; if you aren't careful or don't have Negentropy, a Warrior Shard could be depleted within just decades like a Thinker Shard.
addons.title: Polylocation

addons.text: Your alternate power Breaker state has become entwined with your additional body, whenever you want to use those powers with your real body you will swap power sets with your additional body.
addons.title: Bilocated Coin

addons.text: Each selection of Another Side of the Coin grants you another additional body for Bilocation, each one having access to a different one of your alternate power Breaker states.
addons.title: Multilocated Coin

objects.text:
You now project a second body to control, with a supplementary Breaker ability to selectively share changes and improvements.

With a thought, you can summon your other body next to your "original" and simultaneously control both at once, aided by a minor tertiary Thinker enhancement to give you just enough multitasking and mental processing to use both with full focus. When first summoned, your second body will be identical to your first, even down to possessions held and worn- aside from anything granted/projected by powers- and shares all other powers you have.

The selective sharing aspect of this power allows you to only carry over positive changes between both bodies without any harm/impairment or negative side-effects; have one body work out and only they get the fatigue and soreness, while both get the benefits of exercise, have one sleep or eat and both get the rest or nutrients, and so on. This even extends to the effects of both your and others' powers, though stacking on too many shared enhancements can severely impact your or others' Shard's energy reserves in the long-term, unless you have Negentropy.

If your original self dies, the other automatically becomes the "real" one while the attacked vanishes like a Master projection, reappearing 24 hours later with similar rules as above. If a hostile Trump weakens this power, less and less benefits will be shared between both forms, and full nullification will result in one of your bodies being forcibly desummoned until you escape the effect.
objects.title: (Master/Breaker) Bilocation

objects.text:
This power grants you a single biological minion that you can remotely control by thought. You gain biokinetic control over that minion’s biology, capable of rapidly reshaping it into anything you can imagine within seconds, so long as it’s biologically possible and its body has the mass for it.

Your minion will come into existence possessing the biological form of a normal Earth animal that you desire, though size will be scaled off its mass. Speaking of which, your minion will possess a starting biological mass equal to your body, though it can gather more through consuming and processing various other compounds such as dirt, sunlight, or flesh.

If your minion is destroyed or dies, it will respawn near you within a second, though its biological mass and form will be reset to its initial state.

You are always aware of your minion’s physical condition, distance from you, and can share in its senses. You are also granted a minor boost to multitasking so you can manage your minion and your own body at the same time.

Besides your minion, this power also grants you a minor biological Tinker tech base. This is so you start with various ideas and knowledge on ways to manipulate your minion's biology. Examples include turning your minion into functional mythological creatures such as a centaur or wyvern with abilities comparable to a PRT rating of 6. Synergy with other biological Tinker powers will obviously expand these capabilities.
objects.title: (Master/Tinker) Piggot’s Terror

objects.text:
Every day, you receive a Charge. You may hold up to 20 Charges at any given time. With these Charges, you can breathe life into scale models and animate them. Minis, action figures, 1:700 battleships, and similar kinds of figures are able to be affected by this power. These models will be able to talk, move, act, and function like who/what they're based off of when applicable. Models of beings that are more powerful than a Triumvirate member will have their abilities scaled down to match that level at the figure's theoretical peak.

As more Charges are given to a model, the model becomes a little bit more powerful, often receiving weak powers based on what/who they were based off of after the first couple Charges. This is not the only benefit, as the model will also grow in size by a fair bit, figures smoothing out, gradually losing their toy-esque appearance and appearing more like the real deal instead of a poseable action figure.

When a model has been given a certain amount of Charges, they will no longer be able to receive any more, as they have reached the peak of their ability. The size, quality, and appearance of a figure can determine the limit for a figure's peak ability. For example, an unpainted and damaged Warhammer mini may not even be able to be animated at all, let alone stand up to a regular person. On the other hand, a wonderfully painted high-quality 1:8 scale model of Sailor Moon could end up taking more than 20 Charges, ending up as large as her original counterpart. 

As a rule of thumb, models that could eventually match the level of a below-average Parahuman or weaker take ≤ 5 Charges, a model comparable to the average Parahuman would take ~10, above average would be ~15, and models that have the potential to reach Triumvirate-tier would take ≥ 20 Charges.
objects.title: (Master) Kitbash

addons.text: Your psionic powers have mutated your larva with psionic potential. Now, as each larva unfolds, they bestow a fresh copy of (Thinker/Master) Sonder to their host, with them having to train and grow it themself. You feed off the host’s telepathic growth, leeching two to five percent of their growth, enhancing your own telepathic prowess in the process. If you have the Psychokinesis addon, your larvae are also innately imbued with it.
addons.title: Psy-Worms

addons.text:
Your ability to give others lesser variations of your powers has altered the composition of your larvae, with them developing properties similar to Corona Pollentia and the Corona Gemma of parahumans.

This allows you to imbue the larvae with a seed of your powers. These powers begin at around a third as strong as yours at most, but they grow with use and time, potentially reaching their original strength.

Reclaiming their full strength takes six months at a minimum, and stronger powers can take multiple years to reach full power.

Additionally, your control over your larvae allows you to extend your reach into their hosts' brains, enabling you to exert some influence on their thoughts and emotions. While your overall control is weak and minor enough not to be easily noticeable, you can shift emotional responses and implant thoughts that aren't theirs.

However, if you do it frequently enough or deviate too far from your host's overall personality, someone can notice it. This effectively allows you to form a [Conflict Drive] of your own.
addons.title: Pseudo-Corona Pollentia

addons.text: The worms can now be formed directly from the nutrients that are stored with Stomach Storage, rather than with your own flesh. The worms grow out of your skin, with matter materializing from Stomach Storage to form worm-flesh as needed.
addons.title: Painless Birth

objects.text:
You can create honey bee-sized larval worms from your own flesh and blood, consuming a bee-sized volume of mass from your body. You possess a direct neural connection to these larval worms, allowing you to control them. You have infinite multitasking for controlling your larvae.

These larvae can burrow into the brains of sentient life through the nose before integrating themselves and unfolding into a neural web that intertwines across the host’s entire brain.

As your larvae unfold, they begin tapping into the host’s senses, beginning with touch and ending with sight, allowing you to use them as a highly effective information-gathering network. This does not overwhelm or impair you, regardless of how much sensory information you receive.

Gradually, as your larva intertwines with more and more of the host’s brain, it gains a greater reach into the host's thought process, eventually being able to read and decipher the host’s thoughts and memories in real time.

Your larva can act as the source of mental or immaterial powers. If you are a Tinker, you could send an unwitting host into a tinker fugue or, if you possess precognitive powers, give your hosts visions of the future.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Brain Worms

objects.text:
You don’t bleed anymore. When you’re hurt, spiders spill out of your wounds instead of blood. Depending on the size of the wound, there could be a dozen to hundreds of spiders that pour out. These spiders move as one with your intent: defending you, attacking enemies, clotting wounds with silk, or even disappearing into cracks and dark corners.

The pain from your injuries will fade as more spiders are released. As you sustain more damage, the quantity and aggression of the spiders increase. The spiders remain for only a short time; they begin to break down into ash after thirty minutes and disappear within an hour.
objects.title: (Master/Breaker) Blood Spill

objects.text:
You can create and control fire within a short distance of yourself, with a person-sized fireball being on the upper end of what you can do. You can also enhance others, mending their scrapes, and giving their power an offensive boost. Using your enhancement power on others grants you influence over them, allowing you to manipulate their emotions. 

This influence increases the more often you use it on them, allowing you to control them long term by 'branding' them with your fire. The 'branding' process needs you to be in physical contact with them for several minutes as you brand both their physical body and their emotional landscape into one that puts you fully in control over them.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Lionheart

objects.text: Your power subtly makes people do things that will lead to your victory: shooters in your range will twitch and miss, people you are speaking to will trust you implicitly (or disbelieve you if you employed reverse psychology), and people you are fighting will slip up, leaving themselves open. This power scales with your ability to recognise and seize advantages—the more victory conditions you know how to capitalise on, the more ways your power can help you. This doesn't guarantee you a win; it only makes it possible if you can seize the opportunity.
objects.title: (Master) Victory's Path

objects.text: When you fall asleep, a large group (20) of shadowy figures, dressed all in black and riding black horses, decked out with black harnesses, and wielding broom-shaped whips, are summoned. The group splits into smaller groups to patrol and protect you. They are able to detect hostility directed at you and go unnoticed when inactive. Each guard has a strong brute rating and their horses have a strong mover rating. Together, their Brute/Mover rating can reach 6, but when acting alone it’s only 1-2. The group grows weaker the further they are from you while sleeping, with a maximum range of 2 kilometers from your resting place. The group will disappear after you awaken.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Sleeping Guard

addons.text:
Your shadow’s detachment evolves into full self-sufficiency, transforming it into a parallel entity that mirrors your intent. Once detached, it gains autonomous agency and the capacity to wield Starving Shade independently, using itself as a medium.

It can swallow matter or beings by pulling their own shadows into its surface, creating a recursive drag effect. Anything devoured through this method is delivered into the same private dimension your Starving Shade maintains, where the Doppel can freely move and act. This allows it to “hunt” across the pocket dimension and reality, submerging into and emerging from surfaces or other contiguous shadows like an aquatic predator.

The Doppel’s consistency assumes a soft, viscous form that can appear humanoid, amorphous, or animalistic, depending on lighting and your mental image. Its size and strength scale with your natural shadow’s dimensions, but its tangibility now fluctuates with your focus. You can feed it portions of your own stamina to grant it independent persistence for extended durations, during which it acts with semi-autonomous judgment aligned with your subconscious goals.

When reattached, it carries over what it has absorbed into you - memories, sensations, or raw absorbed material compressed into symbolic "shadows" within your pocket dimension. Over time, this feedback loop allows you to refine and repurpose what it consumes, folding experiences and materials into your own reservoir.
The Doppel functions as an externalized manifestation of your own will and hunger. In dimly lit or shadow-dense environments, it behaves almost as a perfect reflection that acts before you do, striking from impossible angles and returning to you through overlapping silhouettes.
addons.title: Hunting Shade

addons.text:
You no longer require a darkened environment to be able to travel through shadows. Instead, you can slip directly into your shadow, transforming it into a versatile portal. Your shadow can now collapse into a small, mobile dot of darkness, capable of slinking across surfaces and merging seamlessly with other shadows to travel undetected. This allows you to traverse shadowed environments much faster, your movement speed scaling inversely with ambient light. In a pitch-black city with the stars visible in the sky, you can cross from one end to the other in mere seconds, while a brightly lit area slows your passage significantly, making alternative travel methods more practical.

The pocket dimension within your shadow evolves to reflect the external world with increasing clarity based on the darkness of your surroundings, perfectly mirroring reality in total darkness, but growing vague and abstract in brighter places. You can remain within this dimension indefinitely and exit through any shadow your dot has merged with, sliding along with your shadow as if the ground or the sides of a building were frictionless.
addons.title: Swimming Shade

objects.text:
Your shadow transforms into a semi-tangible projection, gaining a subtle three-dimensional quality akin to a layer of fabric. You can freely alter its texture at will, ranging from soft velvet to rough grit, or even a smooth, imperceptible surface.

The true potential emerges when you imbue it with the properties of water or any other liquid. Your shadow develops the simulated "surface tension" of this liquid, allowing it to engulf and pull anything or anyone that presses into it downward, placing them into a personal pocket dimension. This realm appears dark, and being inside it mimics the sensation of immersion in water, but it lacks any actual substance or mass. By default, it subtly draws in ambient elements like air, radio waves, and sound from its surroundings, but you can choose to disable this function.

Additionally, you gain precise control over your shadow's movements and positioning - your shadow need not be humanoid, in fact, and you could swallow a pretty big bike with good positioning. However, its newfound nature renders it immune to any manipulation by light, maintaining a fixed surface area equivalent to your silhouette cast by a direct backlight on a flat wall. In all other respects, it behaves like a natural shadow, but it can’t refract into multiple shadows if you’re currently being illuminated by many light sources or extend beyond its inherent limits. You can choose to make your shadow move onto your own body, over clothes and skin, rendering you immune to most forms of harm that could sink into the shadow (e.g. bullets and stabs get sucked, but being hit with a car will still damage you as normal), but it is important to note that it will only ever cover you partially due to its limited surface area.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Starving Shade

objects.text:
By touching a corpse, you can cause its flesh to blacken and decay in seconds, sloughing off the bone as it liquefies, turning every ounce of rotted tissue into a swarm of insects. The resulting creatures are hybridized abominations; their bodies are elongated like centipedes but segmented and armored with a glossy beetle-like exoskeleton. Their heads resemble a cross between a fly’s compound eyes and a spider’s mandibles. Each has four wings patterned like those of a butterfly, scaled and iridescent, yet capable of rapid, sustained flight. Their size is comparable to that of large spiders, and they release pheromones that cause fear. Despite the mismatch, all their parts work perfectly, even though they shouldn’t be able to in nature.

How fresh the corpse is changes how strong and strange the insects are. If the body is old, the insects are weak, dull-colored, and slow. If the body is fresh, they come out bigger, brighter, faster, and stronger, with more exaggerated features such as sharper mandibles, thicker armor, and more intricate wing patterns. Their physical capabilities and vitality scale directly with the quality and recency of the flesh they originate from.

While you are incapable of directly controlling them, you can speak to them telepathically and they will obey your orders. Every one of them recognizes you as their progenitor and treats you akin to their god. Each insect has a simple, animal-like mind, about as smart as a clever dog. The more powerful an individual insect is, the more intelligent it becomes. When several gather, they can pool their intelligence, temporarily merging their awareness to heighten their collective intelligence and coordination. They have no range limit.

You can use them as vectors so you don’t have to touch a corpse yourself. This indirect process is slower than touching the corpse, but it gets faster if you send more insects at once.
objects.title: (Master) Fly Strike

objects.text: You gain control of three small creatures that each have two powers that each cost at most 5 SP. They're also very durable, strong, and fast. If one of them dies they'll be replaced by a new, similar creature with different powers of about the same strength. You will not be able to choose the new creatures' powers, they'll be entirely random.
objects.title: (Master) Friendbringers

objects.text: You can cause anyone who sees you or your power manifestations to suffer memetic hazards, inducing mental damage to anyone who perceives you with any of their senses. While this power is active, individuals who observe you will begin to suffer psychological and physical damage, ranging from nausea to headaches. The severity of these symptoms escalates with prolonged exposure, leading to complete madness and causing them to attack everyone around them after a few minutes. This effect extends to any medium that depicts you while the power is active, such as photographs or drawings. You are also a complete blindspot to all Thinker powers short of those that are like Contessa.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Open Eyes

objects.text: You now possess the power to create flawless duplicates of yourself—the act of which is instantaneous, appearing anywhere within a 2-meter radius of your choosing. The only limitation is that the chosen space must be able to contain them. You may produce up to ten duplicates per day, refreshing precisely 24 hours after your last use of the ability. Should you wish, you can also absorb any copy within that same 2-meter radius, immediately occupying their position. This act rejuvenates you, restoring 5% of your physical and mental condition, and with enough clones, can even pull you back from the brink of death. Each duplicate retains all of your memories, skills, abilities, and physical state at the moment of their creation, lasting only 24 hours before dissolving in a scatter of light—or sooner, should either they or you be killed (in which case, they'll all disappear). Able to act independently, make decisions—and even create duplicates of their own, albeit with the same restrictions as you. Rest assured, despite their self-awareness, they have your best interests in mind and are unwaveringly loyal. Moreover, a mental link connects all of "you," granting a limited form of telepathy. Through it, you can convey emotions and intentions, though not fully formed thoughts, across this network. Note: Because of the shared constraint, if a clone dies, all clones created by that clone dissolve as well. Absorbing a clone, however, does not count as them "dying."
objects.title: (Master) Child of Flemming

addons.text: Biological Redistribution has been integrated into Mitosis. Firstly, your regeneration can now draw from your biomass storage before needing to draw from your physical body. Second, and more importantly, your powers no longer see any difference between organic and inorganic matter. Any form of matter you consume, both organic and inorganic, can be used for the purposes of regeneration and replication. Of course, this doesn’t help with actually getting things in your stomach, so you’ll still need to figure out some way to do that yourself.
addons.title: Total Omnivore

objects.text:
You have gained the power of self-replication. Whenever you consume organic matter, a portion of that matter is reserved to fill a sort of ‘container’ and once that container has filled with an amount of biomass equivalent to your own, you may ‘split,’ dividing yourself into two identical copies of yourself.

This is a perfect continuation of existence, with the copies retaining all of your memories, skills, abilities, and physical state at the moment of their creation, with no degradation or loss of physical or mental functions. This means that each copy can, in turn, split as well, forming an exponentially growing swarm.
objects.title: (Master/Breaker) Mitosis

objects.text: You can animate statues of creatures, humans, or animals. Their abilities are based on the creature the statue was based on. No matter what their durability is that of the material they're formed from. A wooden statue of a Phoenix will still be weak to fire due to the material it's made of. Strength also increases with the size of the statue and how detailed it looks. A metal statue of a dragon the size of Lady Liberty could go toe to toe with any of the Endbringers.
objects.title: (Master) Golem

objects.text:
You can summon a projection that has powers of its own; you can choose the appearance as long as it's roughly humanoid. You can control your stand as if it was a second body and see through its senses. It has no hard range limit but you will start to feel latency as it gets further than 20km away from your body, or if the stand is in another dimension. 

Your stand has a total of 20 SP to spend on powers but can't have access to minion-type Master powers and Trump powers are more restricted in their functions (ex: copied powers are not permanent, can't give powers to yourself, etc.) or unavailable (ex: Network Hub); they are also restricted to Tier 1 or equivalent powers.
objects.title: (Master) Stand

objects.text:
You can summon a projection with up to 10 SP worth of abilities specifically tailored to the situation that triggered the call: a guardian in battle, a healer in crisis, a guide in confusion, etc. Its form, nature, and powers are entirely determined by the circumstances and your subconscious need at the moment of summoning. You have no direct control over it, and its behavior is governed by an internal logic that may not align with your expectations, though it will never act in direct opposition to your well-being and the reason you summoned it.

The projection remains active for a maximum of one minute before dissipating into nothingness, though it may vanish sooner if its purpose is fulfilled. Each summoning takes a toll—your physical and mental stamina are both significantly drained, and attempting to summon multiple projections at once or in rapid succession causes the strain to scale exponentially, potentially leading to collapse, unconsciousness, or worse.
objects.title: (Master) Calling Help

objects.text:
You can create one perfect clone of yourself each day. All your clones are part of a Hive Mind under your control, meaning you all share your consciousnesses with each other, with you being in charge of it all. Your Hive Mind shares all your powers at 100% capacity EXCEPT Hive Mind itself.
Should the original you die, a random clone will become the original.
objects.title: (Master) Hive Mind

addons.text:
Enhancer can now affect objects inside your Staff and even the Staff itself. Their quality improves passively, using a power makes the object it comes from to improve quicker.

Together with this it also allows any other of your powers that affect objects to affect your Staff and the objects within it.
addons.title: Golden Scepter

objects.text:
You can summon a Projection that manifests as a grey wood Staff with a yellow crystal orb on its tip. You can use all your senses through this Staff like how it can use yours. The Staff can fly at a speed of 60mph. The Staff is sapient with its mind, being connected to yours, allowing it to read your intentions and commands to follow your will, though it can act independently. The Staff is highly durable, being able to take a punch from Alexandria before breaking, though you can resummon it later.

By touching something, the Staff can absorb it. The bigger an object than you is, the longer it'll take for it to absorb. If attached to something else, both their sizes will be taken into account; too large of an object won't be absorbed. Non-sapient living beings can't be absorbed, while sapient beings can only be absorbed once given consent. It has 6 Weak slots and 1 Strong slot to store absorbed objects, which you can freely swap between a Weak and Strong slot.

Absorbed objects enter stasis, remaining frozen in time for as long as they're in storage.

The Staff gains weak powers based on the objects inside it. The Strong slot amplifies the power gained greatly by the object. The power expression is random, but you can freely randomize it again. Some powers may need you to be touching the Staff to use. What the object is does not influence the strength of the power, only its expression.

The following are examples of power expressions. By absorbing a spear, the Staff can change its crystal orb into a spear-like shape capable of cutting anything that isn't metal, like a hot knife through butter, on a Weak slot, while the Strong slot would give it the additional capacity to control its length. Absorbing a rock would grant the Staff the capacity to reshape the stone on a Weak slot, whereas a Strong slot would allow for additional capacity to create stones. The stone created by the Staff shall stay locked in whatever place it was made in, even air, though it will rapidly decay if not attached to anything.

Absorbing a Cauldron Vial/Corona Pollentia will create a temporary connection to whatever Shard they're connected to. Endowing the Staff with a random power like any other object. If you're lucky, the power expression could be what their host has.

The Staff is hyperaware of its surroundings and has a perfect memory, allowing you to access and effectively use any knowledge it acquires. The Staff has an awareness of what's inside it, allowing it to, for example, know the contents of a book stored within it or the components of the ink used. It can communicate with you by whispering to your mind.

Touching the Staff grants you the ability to fly, greatly enhancing your thinking speed, and with your consent, it can pilot your body. The Staff will try to protect you from harm, though it won't do so if you consider said harm beneficial. It could protect you by piloting your body to evade an attack or use one of its powers.

The Staff changes based on what is occupying the Strong slot and its power expression. The level of influence the Weak slots have depends on the compatibility of what's inside. A chunk of iron on the Strong slot would make the Staff turn into metal, while a lighter on a Weak slot would make it glow red-hot.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Scepter of Power

objects.text: You have absolute control of the bodies and powers of every carbon based lifeform within 10 meters of yourself, as well as an unlimited ability to multitask. This power extends through portals. You will retain your sanity. You can turn this power off at will, or let people within your range keep control of themselves while you control others. Certain people are immune to this power, such as Alexandria and Imp.
objects.title: (Master) Khepri

objects.text: You can fabricate and augment monsters via charges. Utilizing one charge allows you to design a creature with assorted characteristics and capacities, with a most of 10 charges required for the most capable and intricate creations, which can even rival the strongest parahumans. You will receive one charge per day and can store a maximum of 20 charges. Instead of constructing a fresh creature, one can also employ a charge to upgrade an existing one, with diminishing returns.
objects.title: (Master) Monster Maker

objects.text: You possess a master power enabling the creation of shadow minions of any desired shape or size —be it bipeds, quadrupeds, or formless entities resembling slimes— while always retaining the color and form of shadows. You have a pool of power that governs the "birth" and sustenance of these creatures, offering a choice between prioritizing quantity or enhancing their individual quality. You can have up to 15 regular minions, create a super one capable to withstand an normal battle Endbringer most powerful attack, or any combination in between. While your minions cannot wield Trump powers, the only limitation on the number of powers they can possess is determined by your power pool.
objects.title: (Master) Shadow Servant

addons.text: Your robots no longer require you to maintain them when integrating a Tinker specialty, and can maintain themselves or each other.
addons.title: Ratcheting

addons.text: Your robots no longer need to obey conservation of mass. A stereo player could transform into a robot the size of a small building, or a human-sized machine into a pistol.
addons.title: Walkman in Disguise.

addons.text:
Your understanding of technology that fundamentally interfaces with your power allows you to manifest Cybertronian technology much like your robot creation. However, the more esoteric and powerful the technology you manifest the more material you’ll need to compensate. 

Ie. an otherwise mundane blaster might take slightly more than the requisite material to physically build, but an Ancient and Powerful Relic of the Ancients might take an entire scrapyard to partially complete.
addons.title: Death of a Reference

objects.text:
You have a pool of energy inside you that you can discharge into inanimate objects in order to convert them into robots capable of transforming between their forms. The larger an object is, the more energy it will consume, and the pool will take a week to refill if drained completely. Additionally, these machines obey conservation of mass as far as their size and complexity is concerned. 

The largest object you could theoretically convert in one go would be a sixteen-wheeler truck. However there is no limit to the number of robots you can create as long as you have the energy. These robots appear to have personalities and internal lives, but these are all simulated by your Shard (unless you’re Shardless or possess Esoteric Knowledge) .

Additionally, you can integrate any Tinker specialties you may have into your robots, but they will need to be maintained like any other piece of Tinkertech.
objects.title: (Master/Tinker) The Spark of Life

objects.text:
You are able to disgorge a variety of creatures from your mouth. These creatures begin small enough to be (uncomfortably) regurgitated, but quickly grow in size to their fully intended height.

Each of these creatures can have a defined purpose when expelled, from ‘mount’ to ‘combatant’ to ‘defender’ to even ‘advisor’ for which they will gain minor (up to maximum 3sp) powers to facilitate their role.

While you have no limit on the number of creatures you can disgorge, you are limited to them being only five times your mass when generating them combined, allowing for either a small horde, specialised squads, or a single massive juggernaut minion.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Disgorge

objects.text:
You're a Tinker with a specialty in reusing the Tinkertech of others, however whereas a normal Tinker would have their power to rely on to turn normal items and materials into Tinkertech and repairing theirs through them, you're exclusively limited to using the Tinkertech of others to do so, without the Tinkertech of others you're as such useless. 

This also means that you’ll have to cannibalize more Tinkertech to maintain and repair your creations. You will get inspired by the Tinkertech you cannibalize, granting you various designs from their specialty that you can turn their Tinkertech into, but in exchange you do not have a specialty of your own.
objects.title: (Tinker) Cannibal

objects.text: You're not a real Tinker; instead, you know how to make anything that can be made in a mundane manner.
objects.title: (Tinker) Jack of All Trades

objects.text:
You excel at creating advanced throwing weapons; a few examples of which include throwing knives that drill into struck targets, homing throwing spears, and even exploding ninja stars.

This specialty includes advanced aerodynamic engineering knowledge to better allow you to create accurate projectiles.
objects.title: (Tinker) Thrown

objects.text:
You are a Tinker who specializes in bells—ranging from the internal swinging mechanisms of Western designs to the external striking beams of Eastern temple bells.

Some of your designs are based on bells from previous Cycles, using materials and resonances not found—or even possible—on Earth.

Your creations can scale from handheld sticks covered in jingling bells to massive bells the size of very small buildings.

The bells you make can cause exotic effects by altering frequencies, producing phenomena that go far beyond simple sound.
objects.title: (Tinker) Bell

objects.text: You can create things that detect, find, or analyze other things. This covers a wide number of areas, such as programs searching and analyzing data flow to identify anomalies, and significant events broadcasted and posted across the internet or database, imaging and sensing Tinkertech equipment ready to locate, recollect information, and store it for later examination, and to create a workbench capable of detecting any type of imperfection, detail, oddities within existent Tinkertech, streamlining and refining your projects. It pairs exceedingly well with (Tinker) Sharing and (Tinker) Communication.
objects.title: (Tinker) Detection and Analysis

objects.text: You can create incredibly intuitive tinkertech that allows it easier to work with other Tinkers. Your tinkertech can merge well with other Tinkers in a collaboration. Even other people have an easier time using your tinkertech.
objects.title: (Tinker) Sharing

objects.text: You are a Tinker specialized on all potato related things, be them farming, eating, industrial process and more. You can make plastic from potato Starch, poison from green ones, or bake, fry, mash, stuff, dry, just salt it and more. Solve world hunger by potato farming on industrial scale.
objects.title: (Tinker) Brotato

objects.text: You’re a Tinker capable of creating joke items, these can range from mundane stuff you could buy at toy stores, to seemingly magical products which can confuse and confound others. Examples include dungbombs, lotion to grow a fake mustache, shoes with suction cups and even weather in a bottle.
objects.title: (Tinker) Wizard Wheezers

objects.text: You can create things that can transfer large amounts of data from one place to another extremely quickly or even instantaneously.
objects.title: (Tinker) Communication

addons.text:
You don't fix broken Tinkertech - you resurrect it.

You bypass traditional repairs with quick, intuitive triage—jury-rigging functions back into existence using whatever’s at hand in a blur of heat-stained fingertips and gutter-found wiring. Burned-out circuits, cracked casings, half-melted lenses - each is a breadcrumb leading you back to the original design. You read warped copper traces like shorthand, guess tolerances by the smell of the smoke, and then dive straight in, grafting scraps together with the speed of a street medic setting bones.

Because you treat every ruined device as a half-assembled kit, the usual hunt for replacements all but vanishes. Broken power cells become shielding, shattered optics form jury-rigged waveguides, and one machine’s “useless” housings shim into the next. In minutes you can coax a wreck to boot, and in an hour’s time you have something field-ready. The finished product hums a little rougher and never quite hits peak output, but it keeps running long after more delicate work would seize.
addons.title: Miracle Worker

objects.text: You can repair, maintain, and use any Tinkertech you find. You can also combine Tinkertech into something that combines the functions of the two inventions. Any Tinkertech you repair or maintain will, in the future, last longer.
objects.title: (Tinker) Repair

objects.text:
You excel at creating advanced technology that both repairs and maintains itself. For example, a sword that self-sharpens, getting rid of nicks acquired in combat, or power armor that repairs cracks in its frame.

This comes with a minor generalized Tinkertech tree slightly beyond the innate knowledge most tinkers have on technology that's not related to their specialty.
objects.title: (Tinker) Self-Repair

addons.text: Combined with your designed clothing, your poses can convey emotions through photos, albeit muted. The effect is much more pronounced through video, allowing you to manipulate the feelings of your audience and subtly even their thoughts. You can use this to make unwanted paparazzi feel startled, confused and ashamed, yet to the naked eye, the effect can be so vibrant as to be combat applicable, allowing you to manipulate enemy reactions and guide their actions. A subtle arm raise for a burst of surprise and a bullet missing its mark, as an example. Although, you have to be aware of your target to manipulate them this way, and against a few combatants outside of fights, you’ll likely be incapable of keeping everyone off-foot enough to not shoot you.
addons.title: Mesmerizing Poses

addons.text:
This Addon allows you to apply Armsmaster’s efficiency and miniaturization specialty far more freely in the creation of Tinkertech that looks like clothing and accessories.

What this means is that you can make clothes and accessories that look mundane but have various Tinkertech functions and capabilities.

So a Sunday dress you make might easily be capable of protecting a wearer from .50 caliber, including any skin it doesn’t directly cover, while also giving said wearer a minor Brute and Mover rating of 2 or 3 in strength and speed.

A bracelet you make might have the functions of a phone, while being able to shoot lasers that can punch through a foot of steel, and have an anti-gravity generator able to give you a basic form of telekinesis that can move a ton anywhere within a few dozen feet of you.

You aren’t limited to just making items that look like normal clothing, though. This addon retains the capabilities to make essentially any kind of clothing and accessories. So feel free to make spandex suits that look like something a traditional superhero might wear, or outfits straight out of anime and manga; it's great for making high-quality cosplay.
addons.title: Fashion And Function

objects.text: You gain a deep understanding of fashion, clothing, and design, as well as the emotions and ideas that can be expressed through them. You are able to design and create clothing and other garments that reflect and amplify their emotions and personality, and to read and understand the intentions and emotions behind the clothing and uniforms worn by others.
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) Garment

objects.text:
With this power, you receive a Tinker specialty revolving around friction. Essentially, you can create materials and technologies that are virtually frictionless, experience extreme friction, or have selective friction.

This has a number of properties—for example, you could build boots with selective friction soles that, combined with internal gyroscopes, could provide a form of enhanced speed when virtually frictionless, or the ability to walk on walls and ceilings with friction.

Virtually frictionless materials in technology also means that so long as you design things properly, mechanical components will experience reduced wear and increased performance over longer periods.
objects.title: (Tinker) of Friction

objects.text:
You specialize in the construction of technology that is capable of remotely manipulating other forms of matter, much like a form of telekinesis.

Basic forms of this technology are only capable of manipulating matter in very basic manners, such as holding an apple in the air ten feet away with all the finesse of an average human, and remotely exerting 1 ton of force anywhere within that radius.

Also when you're starting out, power sources you can make for your kinesis technology when restricted to the spatial and weight requirements of personal equipment like gloves or a handgun, are only capable of exerting force for a minute or two before needing to be recharged or replaced.

Synergy with other Tinker powers will allow you to construct more powerful and specialized forms of kinesis technology. For example, a Tinker power specialized in genetics allowing you to create biokinesis technology, or an Energy focused Tinker power letting you construct dynakinesis technology.
objects.title: (Tinker) Kinesis

addons.text:
Your are a master at crafting smart home and home security systems that can keep track of everything happening inside a residence, maximizing the inhabitants' comfort by analyzing daily routines and for example the coffee-machine starting to brew the moment the owner wakes up or the clothes-hamper driving the dirty laundry to the washing machine and subsequently the drier by itself.

At the same time your systems also track any threats entering your property and react in defense, from locking down doors and windows over setting up Home Alone-esque trap-setups before finally, if authorized, escalating to more destructive and ultimately possibly lethal defenses that will nonetheless cause minimal damage to the home itself.

Your system will also attempt to identify known or unknown threats based on indicators like clothing and behavior to ensure it doesn't zap the mailman or a new gardener. A man's home is his castle, and any home you've outfitted is a castle sinfully comfortable and nigh-impregnable.
addons.title: The Safety of Home

objects.text:
Your specialisation lies in household goods, furnishings and everyday consumer appliances; the essentials of daily life that are often overlooked.

You can create highly advanced domestic items, ranging from kettles, fridges and ovens to household furniture such as beds, chairs, cabinets and much more. This naturally also covers common consumer electronics: televisions, lighting, smart-home interfaces, entertainment devices and other staples of modern life.

You could produce a coffee maker that prepares the perfect brew, a wardrobe that automatically irons, folds and sorts your clothing, a climate-control system that ensures an ideal ambience in every room or home maintenance units that clean and repair before you notice it.

Note that your machines are fairly basic compared to what (Tinker) Electronics or (Tinker) Robots could make, prioritising convenience over complexity, but these do pair well together. With this speciality, you can transform anywhere into the perfect home, producing pure domestic bliss.
objects.title: (Tinker) Domestic Life

addons.text: You are now able to attach your surveillance-tech to specialized drones to render them mobile, allowing things like your ant-sized and -shaped microphone to crawl around to find better hiding spots, or transparent camera-drones. The increased amount of data now traveling through your robots also taught you how to improve the programming of your robots, allowing them to carry out more complex tasks, especially ones that require coordination between multiple units.
addons.title: Mobile Surveillance

objects.text:
You can create devices and programs designed to gather information on specific targets. This ranges from software that can reconstruct every action taken on a specific computer going back to the time it was built, cameras that can pick out and track every person in a crowd at the highest resolution and see objects hidden on or even inside their person, directional microphones that can catch and separate every single voice in a crowded train-station or translate minuscule vibrations of a windowpane into all noise produced in the room, from music to conversation, etc.

This also includes the ability to disguise your creations to make them less likely to be noticed, whether that is by making the microphone the size of a small ant, or disguising your array of vibration-sensors that keeps track of every person in a football-stadium as bin holders with actual bins attached. However your aptitude is inferior to that of (Tinker) Camouflage, and an experienced observer knowing roughly where to look will discover your technology given a bit of time.

Your technology is exceptional at what it does, but it is stationary and has no direct offensive or defensive capabilities in and of itself, though it synergizes very well with other Tinker-Powers.
objects.title: (Tinker) Surveillance

addons.text: Your potions can now have permanent effects. While each individual potion can only enact small, incremental changes, these can accumulate over time to produce significant, lasting transformations. All changes are ensured by your power to be safe and beneficial. These permanent upgrades strengthen your base form, making it more powerful and enhancing the effects of future potions you take.
addons.title: Juicer

objects.text: You can make potions/chemicals that have a number of weak effects. They can be poisonous, heal small wounds, increase natural regeneration by 100%, act as steroids without the downsides, cause emotions that can be suppressed if the person who drinks the potion has sufficient willpower, or increase senses by a significant margin. You can also make any mundane chemical with ease. Your potions can do a number of other things, but they're all fairly weak.
objects.title: (Tinker/Master) Love Potion

addons.text:
You can cannibalize mundane and Tinker technology alike, salvaging working components from anything you get your hands on, mixing and matching functioning parts as needed.

The chain and motor from a broken electric bicycle, the remains of a forcefield generator, come together as a chainsword with hardlight teeth. A busted up leaf blower, a malfunctioning frost gauntlet, remade into a pneumatic icicle gun.
addons.title: Salvage^2

objects.text: You specialize in working with subpar materials and tools, allowing you to make quick-and-easy weapons and other equipment from junkyard scraps and assorted household items. This synergizes with basically every other Tinker specialization, ameliorating a lack of proper funding or dedicated workshop. Pairs especially well with (Tinker) Repair and (Tinker) Reproduction.
objects.title: (Tinker) Salvage

addons.text:
Most Tinkers would simply throw away and replace, or repair their broken Tinkertech, but not you.

You can take a piece of broken Tinkertech, and rip into individual components, while identifying what works and what's broken at a glance. Working components get reused, while broken are given new life as completely new ones, with the end result being a new piece of Tinkertech with a different purpose.

The remains of a freeze ray becomes a tiny super computer, its cooling system reused, freezing a strange mixture of powdered focusing lenses and battery acid into a crystalline matrix. Broken hydraulic power armor turned into a jetpack, fuel made from hydraulic fluid reacted with pieces from a damaged power core, canisters and hydraulic pumps re-utilized to handle it.
addons.title: Scrap Worker

objects.text:
You can create advanced technology from the discarded remnants of society. What others see as trash, you see as the raw materials for innovation. From broken appliances, rusted metal, shattered glass, and forgotten scraps, you can craft advanced tinkertech from.

The more unwanted and neglected the materials, the more potent the technology you can create. A crumpled soda can becomes the casing for a powerful energy core, while a pile of twisted wires can be reassembled into a neural interface that surpasses cutting-edge designs. Your ability’s main focus lies in this inversion of value—the deeper the rejection and abandonment of the materials, the more powerful and advanced your creations become. This doesn’t necessarily mean the material has to be low quality, just that it has been “thrown away”. This specialty allows you to boost any other tinker power you have as long as you use trash to build.

You can sense just how unwanted an item is, when you encounter a discarded object, you instinctively know how much it’s been overlooked, forgotten, or discarded, and this perception fuels your creativity. Rummaging through trash and sifting through the most disgusting refuse poses no problem for you; in fact, you see it as a treasure hunt. Where others see filth and decay, you see potential and untapped energy, and you’re unfazed by the dirt and grime. The more unwanted an object, the more your excitement grows.
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) One Man’s Trash Is Another Man’s Treasure

objects.text: You are a focal tinker. That means you focus on a single item, refining and rebuilding said item with multiple or a singular powerful function(s). This means that you do extremely well with a single weapon or outfit that you focus on and improve, however, it also means that you will be extra vulnerable to having your gear taken or destroyed. This doesn't mean it's impossible to make multiple objects, just that they will be nowhere near the quality of whichever item you focus on the most.
objects.title: (Tinker) Attunement

objects.text:
You specialize in material reinforcement, employing methods such as specialized coatings, dipping, doping, or additive integration to fundamentally alter the properties of any base material.
