You are always the first to strike, no matter the situation. Even if an opponent tries to attack you first, your attack will land before theirs. Your body reacts automatically, and reality subtly bends to ensure your attack connects first.

This works at any range. Whether someone fires at you from another city or charges you at superhuman speed, your strike will always reach them before their attack hits you.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) First Strike

objects.text:
You can repel and attract your own blood, being able to expel all of your blood and reabsorb it. You can survive 10 minutes without blood. You can make your blood either be unable to stick to anything or super sticky, one helps with recovering it and the other helps with indirectly attracting/repelling things that aren't your blood.

When attracting your blood you can decide to make it dodge any obstacle. Whatever blood yours touch is converted and becomes your own. You can at any time revive your blood cells, meaning your dry blood can be recycled.

Your blood is a complete anti-thesis to harmful microorganisms and anything unclean, so you are never going to become sick from using it for something and then absorbing it back.
objects.title: (Blaster) Bloodlet

addons.text: Your rings can be enhanced with your esoteric effects, allowing them to have far stronger and stranger abilities than was previously possible.
addons.title: Neptunian

objects.text:
You can create rings ranging from a centimetre to two meters in diameter and launch them at great speed. While naturally only moderately sharp, when they pass the vicinity of anything they gain its properties. You do not have to launch these rings, though they naturally orbit you at moderate speed until launched.

While stone or concrete would make the rings more durable, ice or steel could lead to a much sharper cutting edge. Fire meanwhile could superheat the entire ring.

 In addition, esoteric and novel materials and phenomena are also capable of affecting the rings. A Shaker effect that warps space for instance might let the ring bend and contort out of a circular shape, while a multitude of effects could come from breaker states.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) Saturnian

objects.text: You can turn someone into a literal lightning rod to be stroked by lightning, no matter how sunny your day is. This power’s cooldown lasts 3 minutes after use. The summoned lightning is as strong as any lightning, enough to rend and burn flesh.
objects.title: (Blaster) Lightningrod

objects.text:
You can double the velocity of any projectile in motion every 10 meters of distance traveled. Blaster powers qualify as projectiles. The effect stops when the projectile hits something and has diminishing returns.

Note: This does not protect the projectile from vaporizing from its own velocity.
objects.title: (Blaster) Acceleration

objects.text:
You can slowly form and grow small roughly spherical crystals out of starlight at night. You’d usually be able to form roughly 15-20 pebble sized crystals per night (if you did nothing else, like sleeping).

These crystals, when broken, violently “explode”, directly applying varying amounts of heat and outward force to anything nearby based on how close it was to the crystal and how large the crystal itself was, with crystals the size of a pebble equalling a strong grenade. The absolute nature of this explosion means it ignores the protective capabilities of any armour.

You have telekinetic control over these crystals and can break them at will. You also have a vague understanding of the location of these crystals relative to yourself.
objects.title: (Blaster) Stellar Fragments

objects.text:
Every one of your actions—whether a punch, a shot, or even a whisper—now carries a potent enhancement from your power. This boost is attuned to any piece of information you possess about your target. Whether you know their name, their personality, their fears, or even a single detail about their past, each bit of knowledge enhances the potency of your actions.

This power isn’t limited to dealing damage; it affects any interaction you have with your target. If you aim to heal them, even a fragment of familiarity—like knowing their favorite color or hometown—will amplify the effect, allowing you to restore them with greater intensity and speed. If you choose to harm or torment, even the smallest fact, like a nickname or a habit, will magnify their suffering, bringing their deepest vulnerabilities to the surface.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Personalised Attack

objects.text:
You can manifest a hovering platform around yourself. This platform can absorb and control any kind of weapon within itself. The only limitations it has are that it cannot exceed three times the total volume of your body and that it only accepts weapons. For instance, if you try to absorb the weapon systems of a tank, only the cannons will be absorbed. Additionally, any ammunition fired will be generated by your power. All absorbed weapons are automatically repaired by the Weapons Platform. In regards to Tinker Tech, it will instead be maintained unless it is your own.

If you possess Tinker Powers, you are capable of working on the Weapons Platform as if it were Tinker Tech.
objects.title: (Blaster/Tinker) Weapons Platform

objects.text:
You can transform any object into a projectile, weaponizing even the most mundane items in your surroundings. The effectiveness of each projectile—its strength, range, and power—is determined by the material from which it is created.

When you activate this ability, the object reshapes into the form of an arrow, ready to be launched. At a baseline, every projectile possesses the speed and force of a bullet from a gun. The true power of this ability lies in the unique properties that each material brings to the table.

For instance, a stone projectile might have limited range and low penetration power, but its significant mass ensures it delivers a strong impact force on contact. On the other hand, projectiles made from something like poisonous leaves can inflict a poison effect on any target they strike. Metallic objects might offer high penetration and range, while fragile items like glass could shatter on impact, creating dangerous shrapnel.
objects.title: (Blaster) All Things Are Projectiles

objects.text:
Your mouth works like a perfect echo chamber. When you keep it shut, any sound you make—like a hum, growl, or scream—gets trapped inside and starts echoing over and over. With each echo, the sound grows louder and more powerful, but it also changes. It becomes slower, thicker, and heavier—not just louder. The longer you hold it in, the more intense and altered it becomes.

When you finally open your mouth, the stored sound bursts out as a heavy, crashing wave. Instead of moving fast like a regular noise, it hits like a wrecking ball—slow but full of force. It can knock people down, break through walls, or shake the ground. But the heavier and stronger the sound is, the quicker it fades, which means it won’t go very far. Shorter echoes travel farther but hit lighter, while longer ones strike harder but stay close.
objects.title: (Blaster) Banshee

objects.text:
You can now call down a sealed canister from above, crashing into a chosen location with a loud impact and a plume of dust. Each canister contains a nearly-random single item of immediate use, ranging from the mundane to the extraordinary. The selection is unpredictable but always relevant to the user’s circumstances, as though a “system” behind the drops anticipates what is most useful to the user at that moment and provides it.

Possible contents for these canisters include any common FPS item such as medical kits, bullet-proof armor, weapons of varying technological level, consumable boosts (temporary shields, cloaking devices, or heightened strength), and compact equipment such as drones or motorcycles. Any items possible must fit within a human-sized container, and once expended or destroyed, will vanish into particles of light.
objects.title: (Blaster/Tinker) Supply Drop

objects.text:
By using clay figures, paintings, or just someone's photos, you can affect the one it is resembling by interacting with it.

The severity of injuries or effects you can inflict depends on the nature and accuracy of the items used.
objects.title: (Blaster) Voodoo

objects.text: You can fire reasonably destructive but small scale fast moving blasts of colorful light. These blasts can be selectively Manton Limited to either only affect matter, types of matter, or people.
objects.title: (Blaster) Selective Targeting

objects.text: You can create and fling chains from your arms. Just before launching a chain, you can choose a substance that the chain will home in on and stick to — it will pass harmlessly through all other substances. If you don’t pick any substance, it will just stick to the first thing it hits. You can retract any chain you have out, pulling it (and anything it’s attached to) towards yourself. If the object or person that the chain is attached to is strong enough to counter the pulling power of the chain, you will instead be dragged to the thing that the chain’s stuck to.
objects.title: (Blaster) Chained

objects.text: Every attack you make causes at least a teaspoon worth of damage regardless of what you did. This can even break the effects of All-or-Nothings like Siberian and applies to any form of attack you deal with.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) Paper Cuts

objects.text:
When you throw a coin into the air, it can reflect a ranged attack towards an enemy of your choice, or the nearest one if you can't make your mind up.

This can work on most ranged attacks. If someone shoots a coin you flipped into the air, the bullet is gonna ricochet back towards the shooter. If someone fires a laser at it, then the laser will ricochet. If a constant beam is attacking the coin, it will still be able to ricochet it for as long as it is in the way, but it will need another coin to be able to send it back to the attacker, otherwise, it will just ricochet the beam into the sky.

This power also comes with a Thinker ability to calculate the best position and area to throw a coin for any attack.

You can also hit the coin, sending it into the area you were punching with 500% of the kinetic energy you hit it with. This allows the coin to bounce once before it loses its power. It will bounce off any surface for as long as it has powers.

If you have multiple coins in the air, the attack that hits one of the coins will ricochet toward the other coin, making the attack 25% stronger for every coin it hits.

The coin can be in the air forever, as long as it is airborne, not touching the ground, and not affected by a supernatural force.
objects.title: (Blaster/Thinker) Fistful of Dollars

objects.text:
You possess the ability to sing with a voice so profoundly wrong, so deeply discordant with natural sound, that it becomes a weapon in itself. When you begin to sing, the effect is immediate and unmistakable: those who hear it experience a violent physical reaction as their bodies reject the sound on a primal, involuntary level. Blood seeps—or bursts—from their ears, nostrils, eyes, and mouths, vessels rupturing under the strain of frequencies that were never meant to exist. What hurts them is the structure of the sound, the impossibly broken harmonics and jagged tonal violence that infects everything it touches.

Your voice bypasses all normal limitations of hearing. Deafness provides no immunity; even those born without the ability to hear are affected as the unnatural sound forces itself directly into their nervous systems. Damage caused by your voice doesn’t grant resistance either. If someone’s eardrums are already destroyed, it doesn’t matter—your song reaches past ruined tissue, striking nerves, blood vessels, and pain centers with unwavering precision. Silence, earplugs, noise-canceling systems, or even power-based sound filters are useless.

As you continue singing, the damage escalates. Minor exposure might cause disorientation, dizziness, or headaches paired with light bleeding. But sustained listening leads to internal hemorrhaging, collapsing balance, and seizures. Some collapse entirely, curled up and screaming not because of what they’re hearing, but because of what it’s doing to them. And through it all, the voice remains—a cracked, haunting, almost absurd parody of song, dragging its listeners toward a crescendo of agony.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Voice of the Devil

addons.text:
You can now mentally materialise Trick Cards around you at will, appearing from thin air.

These cards are just as tangible and effective as those made from physical playing cards. With this, you are guaranteed to never run out of possible cards to play.
addons.title: Spare Deck of Cards

objects.text:
You can transform any playing cards you touch into ‘Trick Cards’, each imbued with a weak, single-use Striker effect of your choice. 

You may have up to several dozen Trick Cards concurrently; these can levitate around you and be launched at a target with a thought. They fly with expertly thrown force and may autonomously maneuver in mid-air, altering their path to track foes or evade barriers.

Upon hitting a target or sticking themselves onto a surface, the cards release their assigned Striker effect. Each effect is limited in strength and versatility to no more than a Tier 0 power at most and may only persist for up to 10 seconds before fading.

For example, you could feasibly produce cards that act as a flashbang, induce brief paralysis, suppress someone's pain, pierce metal, freeze an object’s surface, discharge an electric shock upon impact and much, much more. You also gain peak human skill in throwing cards and card tricks.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Card Trickster

objects.text:
You may summon up to a dozen invisible, intangible snipers by designating targets in your vicinity. At your mental command, these ghostly marksmen will open fire upon them. You can show their aim via their sights' laser dots.

So long as their vantage point can fit a sniper rifle, is not under direct observation and has a viable trajectory to hit the target, these projections may manifest anywhere in a two-mile radius. They don't actually tangibly exist and involve no physical shooter, muzzle flash or casings besides their bullets. 

Each sniper wields a McMillan TAC-50 rifle and has inhuman precision, capable of near perfect accuracy at extreme range. You may assign multiple targets simultaneously, coordinate volleys, direct their fire in real time, reposition them instantly to new locations or just leave them on overwatch indefinitely.
objects.title: (Blaster/Stranger) Sniper's Nest

objects.text: You can fire beams of light out of any light source in your line of vision or within 50ft. The laser’s strength is relative to light’s strength, e.g., a typical lightbulb will fire blasts with enough potency to stun people or fatally injuries under constant fire, and so on. Due to the power’s limits, it doesn’t work with celestial bodies.
objects.title: (Blaster) Lighthouse

objects.text: Your eyes are able to fire powerful laser beams that are able to cut through buildings, and possess incredible flexibility, allowing it to effortlessly bend and curve to precisely strike its intended target. No obstacle can escape the seeker-like precision of these lasers.
objects.title: (Blaster) Dollar Store Omega Beam

objects.text: Any projectile or long-range attack you make gains additional phantom copies. This effectively multiplies your output and can include Blaster powers. However, the more copies you make, the more inaccurate you are.
objects.title: (Blaster) Bullet Hell

objects.text: Any attacks you deal are imbued with an energy that causes wounds to heal slowly and incorrectly. You can toggle this power on and off.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) Hemorrhage

objects.text:
You can create fireballs in a wide variety of types and sizes. You can generate them in sizes anywhere from a baseball to a meter in diameter, create them out of either burning gas, oil, or plant matter, and can control how they move, such as having them fly in a straight line, obey gravity, follow a set path, or even chase after specific targets. You can also set how they interact with others, such as having them disperse on impact, bounce off of people and/or the environment, explode and spread their contents over an area, or stick to whatever they contact.

There is no hard upper limit to the number of fireballs you can have generated at a time, but you can only generate about one maximum-sized fireball a second, or however many other, smaller fireballs that make up the total size.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Just Fireball

objects.text: You temporarily swap the level of mastery and experience between two skills of anyone you can see. This can last up to a few days, but if there is a huge difference between two skills, the duration will be shortened. Swapping the target’s swordsmanship skill to polearms could last a week, but swapping it to cooking might last only a few hours. Any new expertise gained in a skill is also swapped back when the duration ends.
objects.title: (Blaster/Master) Skill Reallocation

objects.text: You have the ability to shoot out an elemental attack from your mouth in either a cone of a 30 ft diameter or a 50 ft long beam. The element of this attack can be changed from a simple air attack to something as drastic as a laser beam.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Breath Attack

objects.text: You have been given the ability to use fire that burns at around 2000° Celsius. You can manipulate this fire into various shapes and temperatures. However, the main feature/possible drawback is the form of expulsion. You are limited to shooting the fire from orifices in your body. Your ears, nose, mouth, and so on. If all of them are blocked, you can build up the heat and power until any one is unblocked, at its strongest being able to output a fire as hot as 4,000° Celsius to those on the receiving end. You also receive a Brute aspect that, while making you highly resistant to other heat/fire-based blaster powers and immune to your own fire, also gives you lesser resistance against cold-related threats.
objects.title: (Blaster/Brute) Infernal Orifices

objects.text: You can shoot kinetically charged lasers from your hand that fires a beam that continuously gets stronger and stronger. The longer it is used the greater the power it shows. Initially, it fires a beam no more dangerous than a regular punch. But after an hour of usage, it can launch an Endbringer back.
objects.title: (Blaster) Charging Beam

objects.text: You can charge up energy welling in your hands and launch them. Your charge will form a ball of energy in your hand that glows. The longer you charge them the more destructive they are. An instant usage of this power is less dangerous than a gun, meanwhile, a day of charging can severely damage an Endbringer.
objects.title: (Blaster) Charged Beam

objects.text: You can create powerful beams of energy from wherever on your body. These beams of energy possess knockback and can kill you if you fire one that is too powerful. Though you may use these to fly as well if you disregard collateral damage. You can even be able to severely injure an Endbringer with this, but after doing so you might be sent flying.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Cannoneer

objects.text: You can absorb and store sunlight to turn into blasts or lasers at a later time. Your maximum capacity is a blast as powerful as twenty thermonuclear missiles, but you'd likely need help to achieve that power within your lifetime. If you were teleported to the sun while having this power and Immune Response, you might gain the power to do this within the three minutes you survived being there.
objects.title: (Blaster) Solar

objects.text: You have an icy blue shield that arrests the movement of anything that enters it. You can ‘spend’ your shield by firing it out as a laser that destroys nonliving matter in a wide beam in one direction, originating from you. Living creatures struck by the beam are left paralyzed by intense cold. It takes about half a minute to recharge this shield after using the blast function.
objects.title: (Blaster/Brute) Icy Protection

objects.text:
You can create and control projectiles made of baleful bluish-black energy that shred through their targets. These projectiles do damage upon impact and create an explosion of energy afterward, dealing a second round of damage. This allows you to attack through defenses like Glory Girl's barrier. The projectiles can move at any speed from 0 to 450 miles per hour, though you cannot change this after they are created. 

You can control the size, shape, direction, and power of the projectiles. The strongest of your projectiles is able to one-shot Crawler and has the explosion range of a city block. Alternatively, you can concentrate this force into numerous thin needle-sized projectiles to pierce through Endbringers, until around the 50% layer mark. 

Uniquely, these projectiles can be manifested anywhere in a 100 meter radius around you, including behind and above, rather than just within line of sight. This allows you to do things such as rain spears of destruction from the sky or manifest countless projectiles behind your back. You are immune to your projectiles and explosions.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Roadless Camelot

objects.text:
You're the bargain bin version of Legend.

You have the ability passively absorb anything in contact with you that isn't one of the three states of matter. Each absorbed thing has its own metaphorical container that stores them for later use. Anything bigger than a small explosion will overwhelm your absorption resulting in you still taking damage from what you couldn't absorb. From electromagnetic waves to inertial reversal fields what you can absorb is quite diverse.

Besides your inability to be hurt up to a certain point, you can use up what you absorbed to shoot beams made up of it. E.g light makes regular lasers, cold creates a invisible beam that freezes things, kinetic energy is like a punch in the form of a laser and etc. Additionally you have a secondary flight ability that allows you to move at bullet train level speeds.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Folktale

addons.text: Your platforms can be turned into Skidmark energy fields, greatly increasing the kinetic energy they apply to anything in the direction of the field but lowering your control over the precise application of the energy greatly, only being able to move things left and right and making slow turns, however you can still do things like sticking to the platforms upside down, just be careful not to pass out from motion sickness from the speed.
addons.title: Boost Pad

objects.text:
You can shoot trailing lines of energy of any color of your choice from anywhere on your body which create floating platforms made of the same energy.

These platforms can either be left behind by the initial ray which can travel up to 50 feet away or begin from it at any point during flight extending up 100 feet long and 10 feet wide in any shape, orientation and direction which you can alter at any time including extending them as long as they lose length in another direction.

These platforms are completely flat and blunt on the sides and stop when impacting something they can't break through.

You can control the direction and movement of anything on these pathways to an extent, such as speeding up, slowing, or trapping to and stopping them from moving effectively making your platforms extremely sticky, or use the same effect to stick to them upside down or climb them like a spider you can also use this to slide on your own platforms at high speeds while extending them as you move.

When the initial ray impacts an object or living creature you can choose between two effects being applied to them.

-The first effect is that they get wrapped in a tube of your energy while the energy stays fully under your control, including moving it anywhere you want and controlling the movement of anything inside, allowing you to shoot people like a cannonball. Additionally the energy constantly applies a kinetic pressure onto the thing trapped inside making it very difficult to move as the force applied increases the more force they exert.

-The second effect is simply having the ray unravel into a wall and slamming the target with multiplied kinetic force applying more force than it should, this is mostly concussive in effect with a large amount of knock-back but repeated impacts can be harmful or cause incapacitation or even be fatal as bruises and internal wounds build up.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Spectral Platforms

objects.text:
You can now bypass the mechanics of firing a projectile or beam entirely, directly causing the effects of your blaster power to manifest on any target within your line of sight. Instead of shooting or launching an attack, the target immediately experiences the impact of your power as though they were hit at point-blank range.

For instance, if your blaster power involves a laser beam, the beam itself does not need to travel or even exist. You simply are required to have the target in your line of sight, and they will feel the full force of the laser’s effect as if they were struck at point blank. This makes the attack unavoidable, as there is no physical projectile to dodge or block.
objects.title: (Blaster) Aimbot

objects.text:
The snow is quite strong with you. Your control over the moisture in the air has manifested in the form of Cryokinesis. Your snow can reach a temperature of -100 degrees Celsius, well past the point of ice. 

You are initially limited to small blizzard beams that could plant most people and lower-tier brutes on their ass along with blunt Ice balls. But, with enough learning time, you could figure out how to make Blizzards and snow effects rivaling the worst in history and Ice constructs the likes of which have never been seen.

But another very helpful benefit is that of its resistances. You cannot be affected by any cold-based diseases or effects, no matter how intense they are, the tiniest bit short of All-Or-Nothing effects. You also are able to reduce the effects of fire based-blasters by your mere presence.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Snow Shots

objects.text: You can create floating moving balls of light that you can see with. They can fire beams of concentrated energy at whatever you see. Their maximum range is 5 kilometers from you and will stay within that range, you can use your other blaster powers through them. These balls of light also take the properties of your various Blaster powers, such as if you could shoot nuclear blasts you can make them explode.
objects.title: (Blaster/Master) Sentry

objects.text: The more people that follow you, the stronger this power is. With no followers, this power does nothing, with one follower, it's as strong as a bullet. To calculate the power of the blast, multiply the amount of followers you have by the power of a bullet. Assume the bullet is from some sort of handgun. For a person with no reservations for either manipulation or stowing fanaticism, this could be exceptionally powerful, maybe enough to solo an Endbringer, provided you survive the attempt. Your blast is reminiscent of Star Wars Blasters, though accurate, with sounds and all.
objects.title: (Blaster) Worship

objects.text: You can launch concentrated beams of colorful energy that get more powerful based on the total power of you and your allies combined. The better you work together and know them, the more accurate and control you have over this.
objects.title: (Blaster) Friendship Beam!

objects.text:
You can shoot a devastating shockwave of air pressure from the palm of your hands. You can control the shockwave, being able to weaken and shape it, you could spread it into a wide attack capable of destroying multiple buildings or concentrate into a baseball-sized beam.

Releasing shockwaves, especially at high intensities or repeatedly, strains your muscles, causing aches that worsen with overuse. Your physical strength directly influences the power of your shockwaves—greater strength not only allows you to generate more force but also improves your resistance to the physical strain, letting you push the limits of your ability without as much fatigue.
objects.title: (Blaster) Air Cannon

objects.text: You can extend beams of destruction that can extend up to 15ft from your palms. These beams disintegrate anything they touch except for your body.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) Beamsaber

objects.text: Any projectile you fire, no matter the mass or size, will end up exploding on impact and hitting at least Mach 4 (the fastest sniper rifle shoots around Mach 6). Keep in mind to adjust your aim, a catapult will not hit the same place other catapults would, what with the projectile going multiple times over the speed of sound.
objects.title: (Blaster) Broken Phantasm

objects.text: You can fire beams of energy that can burn through materials. You possess a limited storage of energy that can strengthen your Blaster powers. This energy recharges over time, speeding up when you are in combat. You can fire much stronger beams of energy the more energy you consume per blast. You have a greater capacity the more Blaster powers you possess, but even without other powers a full energy blast can severely damage an Endbringer.
objects.title: (Blaster) The Classic

objects.text: You possess the ability to fire grey lasers that can slow anything it hits, this also makes them monochrome in color. You can combine all your Blaster powers into one. And have the flexibility to selectively choose which Blaster powers currently are being combined. The more Blaster powers you incorporate, the more colors Monochrome gains. Things like Legends lasers count as individual blaster powers for the purposes of this power.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Monochrome

objects.text:
You have three varieties of blasts you can fire:

The moment you fire a power you'll be able to set the specifics, assuming any need to be set. For example, if you fired the Gravity Shaker power, you'd be able to choose what gravity it applied over its area of effect once it hit.

While the following descriptions mention Tier 1 powers, it's really saying any power that could be classified as Tier 1.

The first variety fires a random Tier 1 level Blaster or Shaker power at the target.

The second fires a random Tier 1 level Striker power at the target.

The third gives the target a random Tier 1 Thinker or Master power. This lasts for 3 minutes.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Metronome

addons.title: Bloody Missiles
addons.text:
Your Rocket Fists now incorporate the pressurized blood and steam of Boiling Blood, transforming your launched limbs into missiles. Rather than simply flying straight toward their target, they can make limited course corrections after launch by venting superheated blood and steam from their remaining tissue.

The gunpowder-like explosion of Rocket Fists combines with your boiling blood, producing a violent mixture of burning steam, scalding vapor, and caustic blood mist on impact. You can adjust the mixture toward greater explosive force, wider area coverage, or thicker noxious clouds depending on your intent.

Even if you miss your original target the missile leaves a trail of caustic blood in its path, allowing you to lay down traps to limit your target's movement.

addons.title: Promethean Rocket
addons.text:
Promethium Vitae's Ignited Heart transforms your Rocket Fists into miniature ICBMs. Your limbs can be propelled by controlled ignition and burning blood, allowing them to continue accelerating after launch and perform far more aggressive course corrections than before.

The immense energy density of Promethium Vitae dramatically increases their acceleration and destructive power, while your exhaust vents allow launched limbs to brake, turn, spiral, or pursue targets before impact. You retain control through the surviving connection to your body, letting you guide them along complex trajectories rather than sending them in a straight line.

Your supercharged blood changes the payload, combining with the Rocket Fists' explosive ignition to produce a blast comparable to that of a Nuke, followed by a lingering cloud of superheated, highly toxic blood vapor. The resulting contamination can render the impact area dangerous long after the initial explosion, while the missile itself leaves a trail of burning blood and superheated exhaust in its wake.

At its peak, every launched limb becomes a self-guided, regenerating projectile, powered by your living ignition system and capable of devastating an area even after the initial impact.

objects.text:
You can literally ignite your limbs like gunpowder and launch them toward any target, turning your arms and legs into living rockets. The larger the portion of your body you launch, the greater its payload and velocity.

Launching only a fist produces an explosion roughly comparable to a hand grenade, while accelerating to transonic speeds. Launching a forearm up to the elbow produces a blast comparable to a small anti-vehicle warhead, while reaching supersonic speeds. Launching your entire arm up to the shoulder produces a massive high-explosive detonation comparable to a large naval artillery shell, while the limb itself accelerates to hypersonic speeds.

You can also suppress the explosive payload entirely, allowing the launched limb to function as an extraordinarily powerful high-speed punch or kick. The same principle applies to your legs, allowing you to fire your feet, lower legs, or entire leg as progressively larger projectiles.

After being launched, the limb rapidly regenerates from the remaining cinders. A hand or forearm returns within seconds, while regenerating an entire arm or leg can take up to a minute. This regeneration also activates when you are injured, though it works considerably more slowly than when replacing a launched limb. However, your regenerative abilities cannot save you if your brain or heart is completely destroyed.
objects.title: (Blaster/Changer) Rocket Fists

addons.text:
Your invisible mouths inherit Mouthful’s functions, able to freely shift your mouths’ shape and size to a higher level than normal, creating constructs from them to defend yourself and predatory purposes. This adds several adaptations, such as sharing oxygen intake with your mouths and surviving in oxygen-free or toxic environments as long as a mouth can breathe clean oxygen. It also extends to metabolic intake, gaining both nourishment and improvements provided enough calories.

Likewise, the mouths you form across your body receive Chomp’s hunger and consumptive ability, triplicating the rate of mouths you can create.
addons.title: Ravenous

objects.text:
You send off invisible mouths capable of biting, digesting, and consuming anything living, non-living, to any person or obstacle your way, such as oncoming blasts, except the Endbringers, Alexandria, or any All-or-Nothing attacks or defenses, ranging to half a kilometer radius. This power uses your Shards’ omnivorous nature, weaponizing it through the manifestation on your maws. These maws sink their teeth in and perforate some of the most durable or dense metal alloys or materials and are free to digest them into raw resources for either enhancement or range extension. Though it works best with line-of-sight and something to target no matter when it functions around or behind you, is both automatic and indiscriminate with no discernible target.

The mouths' size is only comparable from a grizzly bear to the biggest known mammal, with its rate of consumption only triple your usual metabolism.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Chomp!

objects.text: You can shoot out slow black beams that, when in contact with a person, cause you to swap places with your target, killing them in the process, and morph into an exact body double of them. You will also gain all of your target's gear after transformation, leaving your own gear behind.
objects.title: (Blaster/Changer) Identity Theft

objects.text:
You are a pyrokinetic, being capable of conjuring and manipulating your own brand of special purple flames. These flames, in addition to burning normal materials, also burn parahuman powers. 

Upon coming into contact with a supernatural effect, it will set it aflame and burn it away no matter the durability. These flames are even capable of consuming invisible/immaterial effects like Shaker auras, all or nothing effects and things that are currently under the effects of a power (empowered by a Striker ability, telekinetically controlled, under a Master effect, etc.) no matter the objects' original flammability for as long as they remain under an effect. 

These flames don't burn tinkertech any better than they would any other normal machinery, since they’re not power effects.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Burnout

objects.text: Your power allows you to shoot an All-or-Nothing blast from your hands up to a range of a mile, traveling at roughly the speed of a bullet. This blast affects the first thing it touches and absolutely destroys it by your Shard simulating the object and causing damage to it based on projected defenses of said object down to the last molecule, the closest approximation to what happens would be the object being hit with an exact antimatter duplicate in the area it was struck.
objects.title: (Blaster) A Damned Mile!

objects.text: You can release elemental blasts with the power of a nuclear missile, without any of the radiation. Well, unless your chosen element was radioactive.
objects.title: (Blaster) Mythical

addons.text:
You can now transform your body directly into the very droplet you summon, becoming a small, compact and immensely dense form.

You must select a destination or direction to initiate this transformation but you retain full control over your trajectory and movement once in motion, letting you adjust your course on the fly to avoid obstacles at supersonic speed. 

Alternatively, if you choose, you can simply plough through any obstacles in your way. With the droplet’s unmatched durability and velocity, you are nigh-impervious to being stopped and can punch through barriers without dropping your Breaker state.
addons.title: Endshot

objects.text:
You can summon a single ‘droplet’ in your hand; a small, metallic-like mass roughly the size and shape of a standard toy marble.

You have complete telekinetic control over this droplet, being able to move it at supersonic speeds reaching up to Mach 5. This object ignores momentum or friction, being able to accelerate instantaneously, stop dead or immediately turn in any direction.

The droplet has a density and durability comparable to the innermost layers of an Endbringer, making it an almost unstoppable projectile. It could punch through tanks like tinfoil or pierce dozens of foes in moments with pinpoint accuracy. You could also use it for less destructive purposes, such as assisted flight via tethering yourself to it.

To facilitate your control, you have a dedicated secondary thought process that effortlessly manages the droplet's movements, regardless of its velocity. This Thinker component also offers direct sensory perception through the droplet, providing awareness of its surroundings.
objects.title: (Blaster/Thinker) Droplet

addons.text: You can now gain modifiers for your protective aura as well, from reducing the cooldown to adding special effects when triggered such as reflecting attacks, self-healing you, or unleashing AOE attacks. To better use any special effect modifiers you may get, you gain the ability to trigger your protective aura on command.
addons.title: Block Modifiers

addons.text: You can now gain modifiers for your body as well, from increasing your health pool or movement speed to adding health regeneration or passive damage reduction.
addons.title: Body Modifiers

addons.text: In addition to whatever power you would get from Glass Cannon, you also get to choose a modifier as if 24 hours had passed.
addons.title: Proper Rogue-lite

addons.text: You can now gain modifiers for your summoned minion as well, from increasing its perceptive range or movement speed to adding special effects such as increasing summon count, healing select allies, or transforming into more powerful combat forms. At base, it gains the ability to fire weak Blaster-esque bolts of energy roughly equivalent to a strong punch in force. If you also possess Body Modifiers, it also obtains a personal health bar and a swathe of new modifiers are unlocked for your Buddy.
addons.title: Battle Buddy

addons.text:
Upon defeating an enemy and generating loot, there is a chance to spawn Modded Loot. These items are special, capable of being equipped and providing numerous modifiers to the wielder. These modifiers are more potent than to the permanent modifiers available to the user, with fewer negative modifiers.

Normal thugs and similar enemies have an extremely low chance of spawning Modded Loot, at 0.01% chance. Stronger enemies, such as equipped soldiers, have a 0.1% chance, and parahuman-class opponents have a 1-10% chance, depending on their strength relative to yourself.

Modded Loot will occassionally spawn with special effects, being especially likely to appear on drops from parahumans. These effects tend to be utilitarian or protective in nature, such as providing flight, immunity to fatigue, or detecting hostiles at range. The strongest items may manifest the rare active ability, though typically with some limitations.
addons.title: Modded Loot

addons.text:
You now gain a special ability, a powerful state known as Boost Form. This ability can be activated for up to thirty minutes, before needing to recharge over the course of twenty-four hours. While active, damage will slowly begin to accumulate, with regeneration effects mitigated in regards to this damage so long as the Boost Form is active.

When triggered, your body becomes wreathed in wild energy and your modifiers are drastically strengthened. All active modifiers have their numerical values doubled, and the special modifiers gained from parahuman sources may gain additional effects.

Additionally, a new type of modifier may appear when defeating a parahuman. These "Boost Modifiers" apply only to your Boost Form, granting special and powerful abilities exclusive to the form. Each parahuman can only provide one Boost Modifier, and unless specifically stated otherwise, each Boost Modifier is mutually exclusive to all others.
addons.title: Boost Form

objects.text:
You can fire small spherical ‘bullets’ of energy from your hands, which travel at around 60 mph and are subject to gravity. These pellets can hit with enough force to crack concrete, although you can scale back the power if you so desire. However, this is just their base form.

Once every 24 hours you are presented with a choice of one of five options, random modifiers for your bullets that can be mentally equipped or de-equipped instantly at will. You can also gain modifiers by defeating parahumans, being presented with a choice of one of three modifiers.

Modifiers can range from simple things like increasing the power or speed of the bullets to more exotic effects like changing the type of projectile or bestowing the bullet with unique properties like life steal or the ability to grow in power by bouncing off of surfaces. Modifiers can sometimes include “negative” effects as well as a form of balancing, such as a modifier which massively increases damage also making your bullets slower. 

When you get modifiers from defeating parahumans the options available are always related in some way to the power the parahuman had, such as pyrokinetic providing options related to heat or fire. Additionally, you can get more than one of the same modifiers and their effects stack and interact in both positive or negative ways, so experimentation to find proper synergies is highly advised.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Rogue-lite Shooter

objects.text: You can fire a single, lethal-homing projectile shaped like a sword. It originates above and slightly behind your head. The more people you want to kill, the larger, sharper, and faster the sword becomes. The sword cannot cut through your own flesh and only dissipates when all its targets are dead. The strength of the sword is limited to be only able to damage an Endbringer substantially without killing it.
objects.title: (Blaster) Damocles

objects.text: Your power is in some way related to Stilling, although more limited in scope as merely frequence-manipulating blasts you can let out. Having said that, these blasts inherit Stilling’s versatility, changing the wavelengths of your blasts can alter their direction mid-air, sapping the motion of whatever it hits, turning it into a concussive blast, and complete disintegration of a target, among others. Your blasts also possess the ability to be tuned against the use of other powers, making it so that they can punch through shields with little effort, scar Brutes with ease, or even disrupt a power’s effects on someone once you hit them.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Still Blast

objects.text: You can shoot from your fingers lasers that travel at a speed of 370 meters per second. You can set how far your lasers can travel, up to the maximum distance of 50 meters. Their thickness is the same as your fingers. You can alter the trajectory of your lasers, but you need to determine their path before firing them. When your lasers hit something organic they pierce through ignoring all defenses, when they hit something inorganic they explode on contact—this explosion has a random detrimental effect on inorganic things, metal rusts, eletronics are disrupted as if hit by a EMP, etc. You can swap the effects of Organic and Inorganic, but it only takes effect after a minute.
objects.title: (Blaster) Laser Bullets

addons.text: Each of your railgun markers can now be used as markers for (Mover/Striker) Flying Raijin and vice versa. This also allows you to extend your ability to keep track of your markers to massively enhance the use of your teleportation. Allowing you to teleport, blast, or both simultaneously anything you can target.
addons.title: Flying Railgun

objects.text:
You can designate markers anywhere within your line of sight, anchoring them to either fixed points in space or to objects or people as points your power can interact with. 

At will, you may launch yourself, anything you touch, and/or anything that bears one of your markers to any one of your other markers at horrific speeds. 

The trajectory is always a straight line from the point of launch to the marker, however you are not limited to simply one jump, instead your power allows you to create routes through all of your established markers, allowing you to change total trajectories and even looping through them.  

This lets you set out routes that can be followed until changed as well, allowing you to potentially create a barrier where you set an object to constantly loop between two or more markers until you change it otherwise.

The speed at which you may launch such projectiles caps at Mach 8 from the launch to the first marker, however every subsequent marker it hits will it allow its speed to double, allowing you to drastically increase the speed and power it travels at by routing through multiple markers.

You can freely choose to set the speed at which something is launched, whether at the cap or to be lower, and can control whether hitting another marker will increase its speed or not.

During transit and till they stop, whatever is launched is coated in a breaker effect that renders them immune to the harmful side effects of traveling at such speeds and whatever they may collide with, instead the force expelling outwards. This will result in obliterating most of what it comes in contact with, or pushing whatever it can’t out of the way. 

You may also coat the targeted marker in the same breaker effect; rendering them safe from collisions from a launched object. 

You can choose to waive this breaker effect away, leaving what is launched at the mercy of the speed, kinetic force, and energy it will hit and be hit with. 

Railgun acts as a near all-or-nothing as far as its trajectory is concerned, unless it encounters another all or nothing in which case it will simply immediately deactivate and blunt all forces on the user, leaving them unharmed from their travel but suddenly stopped. 

Your power also comes with a secondary aspect to support all this that provides constant, intuitive awareness of every active marker and their positions relative to one another and to you. 

This also includes an awareness of what each marker actually is, such as knowing what marker is what location, person, or object. This is also wonderful for keeping track of things and their distances and positions relative to each other, 

This awareness manifests as a mental map that updates in real time, allowing you to plan routes, anticipate movement, and execute complex chains of launches with near-perfect precision. Markers are permanent and persist without input although you may also dismiss them at will if the need ever arises. You may have as many markers as you wish.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Railgun

objects.text:
Shooting guns, swinging a sword, driving a car, anything you have done, has some measure of skill to it. What this power allows you to do, is to use a skill at the best you ever used it. If you could cut through steel at some point, you can replicate that feat again. If you could knock someone out with a punch to the gut, be assured you can do it again with no issues on your part.

You don’t need to have personally performed the feat; as long as you’ve experienced it directly—whether through possession or other means—you can imitate it, provided it’s an improvement over your previous abilities.
objects.title: (Thinker) New Personal Record

objects.text: Time only moves when you move. In other words, if you stand completely still, time won't move at all. Looking around with your eyes and such things do not count as moving. If you move slowly, time will move slowly as well. You also gain an incredible advantage though, beyond the extra time, and that's the fact time moving again has slight delay. This means you can dodge bullets! You just need to have stopped moving before it's already piercing your head.
objects.title: (Thinker/Mover) SUPER HOT

objects.text: You can see using comic book X-ray, infrared, and ultraviolet vision.
objects.title: (Thinker) X-Ray and Vav

addons.text:
All five senses are enhanced well beyond what a man normally can sense, but what about that little voice in your head, the one that tells you something isn't quite right? Sometimes, in a rush, you ignore that voice, or perhaps it just isn't loud enough to get its point across.

Well, now your sixth sense is loud and clear. Hidden dangers are something you will always know; attacks you can't see coming are something you'll know is coming while having an idea of how to counter them, if you can. Your intuition to sense if someone is intentionally misleading you or omitting information is guaranteed.

While you can't use your sixth sense to solve a puzzle on its own, it works alongside what your other senses pick up, alongside your own knowledge. If you could theoretically figure out the code to a lock by thinking on it for some time, like a riddle, your sixth sense will help guide you to figuring out the code.
addons.title: To Sense Beyond

objects.text: Your five senses are supernatural, allowing you to count all the leaves on a tree from a mile away. Find someone by their scent if they are within a mile of you. Being able to pinpoint the location of a needle by the sound it made when dropped on the floor in a busy mall. Feel the subtle changes in temperature and air density of someone or something going through the air. Taste the rich flavors of food down to the most exquisite detail, allowing you to truly appreciate the taste of the food people make. This also means that you can detect with ease if something is harmful to you.
objects.title: (Thinker) Primal Perception

objects.text: You can intuit connections between events, people, things. For example, you can learn that Alexandria is somehow connected to Case 53s, however it doesn’t give an explanation on how they are connected. As long as you are knowledgable on both subjects your power automatically tells you they are connected in someway. Your power is always on, unless if you have the Holding Back perk.
objects.title: (Thinker) Conspiracy Nut

objects.text: This power grants you access to the collective memories of all your ancestors, giving you a gigantic repository of knowledge and experience that you can access at will. Keep in mind, however, that absorbing memories comes with the chance of acquiring the traumas contained within them, and that absorbing too many memories might change your personality and how you view the world.
objects.title: (Thinker) Goa'uld

addons.text:
Where Full Picture gave you complete detail through one sense, and Synesthesia allowed you to translate between them, this merges both into something greater: a web of senses working together.

You might “see” the flow of time by binding vision to temporal sense, relive future moments as if they had already happened, or “hear” the exact color of a rose sealed in glass while blindfolded. You could “taste” the intent behind words, “smell” the outline of magnetic fields, or “touch” the structure of gravity itself. Even abstract forces — probability, causality, fate, higher dimensions — may be read as if they were colors, tones, or textures, depending on how you align your perceptions.

Unlike before, there is no risk of overload. Each sense can distribute its burden across the others, creating a balanced perception that grows clearer the more senses you combine. With practice, you can design entire frameworks of sensory interplay, granting you awareness that stretches from the smallest particle to the broadest cosmic law, all in seamless harmony.
addons.title: Esoteric Senses

objects.text: You can make yourself, or any animal, experience any one of the senses through another comic-book style, being able to smell shapes or seeing the number ‘7’ taste citrus fruit. The intensity and duration of the experience can be decided by: from having just one sense and keeping the experience forever, to tasting shapes and it works for a second. The senses are not limited to the 7 common senses, being able to affect supernatural and Parahuman senses.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) Synesthesia

objects.text: You gain a Thinker ability to discern what would be the optimal bribe to convince a person or group to do a particular task for you. And a minor Master ability to get said target to at least listen to your convincing attempts to take the bribe in question as well as not second-guess themselves if they do go along with it.
objects.title: (Thinker/Master) Bribery Makes Everything Easier

addons.text:
Your Shard (Again, if you have one) has come up with the idea to communicate with other Shards that are Important or Relevant to your World (In case of Earth Bet, this would be Conflict Engines, Triumvirate-Tier Shards, and Shards of Parahumans that you find 'important'). Exchanging Data from these Shards has given them a more clear idea of upcoming events involving them. Not only has Data gathering for these people never been easier, but using this new Data, your Shard has found it within reason to give you an "Intuition" on these important events.

What this means is that rather than the chosen day being random, it will instead be a day that has an important event, or is the most important of those 2 weeks. How this is decided is influenced by what kind of Shard you have. If you have a Warrior Shard, it will be the day with the most Conflict or the day with the most promising amount of Data to be gained. If you have a Thinker Shard, this will be subjective, but you will be unable to figure it out immediately, so training your understanding of the "Intuition" is required. If you have a Wanderer Shard (or are Shardless), it will give you the day that is most important going by your beliefs and opinions.

(Note: Don't go into a Simurgh Battle expecting the Simulation to be the same, she'll likely plan around it, knowing that your Shard has information on her actions.)
addons.title: Prometheus Beta

objects.text:
Once a day, when you sleep, you can choose to receive a dream that simulates/predicts a random day within the next two weeks. This dream will always be not 100% accurate, as there will be minor or major discrepancies in your dream compared to the actual day it simulates. You can mitigate this by collecting Data, thereby receiving more accurate predictions on how people would act. 

You gather Data subconsciously (with a lot of help from your Shard, if you have one) by going outside, talking to people, and learning how they act with certain stimuli or scenarios. Finding information about people via other means (Biographies, Interviews, Personal Files/Information, Psychological Evaluations, etc.) will also be considered as gathering Data.

Your Shard can also exchange Data with other shards about their host's behavior, making actions done by Parahumans more accurate. Your memories are also taken into account, so the more that you remember, the more Data that can be used to make the dream more accurate. 

As the chosen day is random, important events do not take priority, and as such, they may be skipped entirely.
objects.title: (Thinker) Prometheus Alpha

addons.text: You have gained the ability to combine or infuse your potions with your food, enhancing not only the effect of the potion but also how much nutrition your food provides. Alongside this ability, all your potions are also nutritional, even if they won't fully provide the same benefits or nutrition as a real meal while overall tasting better.
addons.title: Chef's Kiss

objects.text:
With the ability to create incredibly tasty food from even the most basic ingredients, your culinary mastery transcends ordinary boundaries. Not only can you transform simple fare into mouthwatering delights, but you also gain a heightened sixth sense to perceive the unique sense of taste possessed by those around you. This uncanny ability allows you to tailor your creations to suit individual palates, ensuring that every dish brings unparalleled satisfaction to anyone who partakes.

But your culinary prowess extends even further. By infusing mundane food with a tantalizing taste enhancements from your touch, you have the power to make any dish irresistibly delicious, surpassing the addictive allure of even the most potent substances. The flavors you create are so enchanting and captivating that they leave a lasting impression, forever etching your culinary creations into the memories of those fortunate enough to experience them. With each bite, you transport others into a world of culinary ecstasy, where food becomes an extraordinary sensory journey.
objects.title: (Thinker/Master) Chef Supreme

objects.text:
You are able to manipulate your personal perception of reality through precise innate control of your senses. You can conjure up incredibly realistic fantasy worlds and blur the lines between what is real and what’s not via these mental hallucinations in a manner akin to lucid dreaming.

You can completely block out any sense of pain if you are injured, create imaginary friends or have the air smell constantly fresh. This power applies to all of your senses, including any parahuman ones. This will even trump other powers manipulating your senses although you have to be aware of them and their effects on you to do this.
objects.title: (Thinker) Overactive Imagination

addons.text:
Your thousand voices are not just varied in personality and perspective—they are specialists, each dedicated to solving a specific issue, mostly everyday challenges. One might be an expert at conflict resolution, another at financial management, another at social navigation, and so on. They form a complex, adaptive support system, anticipating common problems before they arise and offering preemptive solutions.

However, when you face a challenge beyond their expertise, a new set of about three to five voices are born, each dedicated to solving that singular problem but with different focuses. For example, if you’re caught in a high-stakes negotiation and your current voices fall short, five new ones emerge—one focusing on persuasion, another on body language analysis, another on logical argumentation, one on emotional manipulation, and the last on exit strategies. If you face the same issue too many times and get too many redundant voices, they will merge into a single voice who is better than all of them collectively.

These new voices integrate with the existing council, enriching the collective intelligence. They adapt rapidly, learning from each other and from you. Over time, if a similar issue recurs, these voices merge into a singular, multi-faceted expert, ensuring that no problem is ever faced unprepared again.
addons.title: Polyphonic Strategist

objects.text:
Every time you get incapacitated, or your situation leaves you debilitated, you get a new voice in your head—someone who's an expert at dealing with whatever took you down.

If you drown, the voice of an expert diver will start talking to you, giving tips like, “Stay calm and conserve your air.” If you’re taken down in the wild, you’ll hear a survivalist’s voice guiding you on how to endure, what not to do, and what to do. Get your ass beat in a fistfight? You’ll get the voice of a brawler who knows how to handle punches, saying stuff like, “Roll with the hit, keep your guard up.” Get caught in a gunfight? A marksman will pop up, advising on better positioning and how to spot cover.

But it’s not just physical incapacitation. If you find yourself imprisoned, you’ll get the voice of an escape artist, suggesting ways to break out. If you’re struggling with being poor, you will get the voice of the impoverished, telling you how to survive and make do. Get blinded? You’ll get the voice of an echolocator, guiding you with strategies for navigating without sight.

You can switch to these voices whenever you want—let them take over to guide you in tricky situations, or switch back to your own mind. If you keep getting taken out by similar things (like getting beat up a lot or always drowning), those voices will merge into a single expert that’s the best at handling all aspects of that situation.

Basically, these voices help you survive and avoid getting incapacitated again. They get better the more you deal with whatever keeps putting you down. Plus, they can use your mental abilities.
objects.title: (Thinker) Voices of Failure

objects.text:
Congratulations! You've gained a sixth sense! You now possess electroreception, much like many species of sharks.

This new ability allows you to detect weak electrical fields, enabling you to track living beings and objects over a distance of roughly 100 meters. To support this, your skin is embedded with highly specialized electric receptors. Unlike in sharks, however, these receptors remain invisible—unless you choose to reveal them.

Typically, electroreception is limited outside of saltwater because air is a poor conductor of electricity. But your receptors are extraordinarily sensitive, allowing you to use this sense just as effectively in the air as underwater.

Your brain has also been enhanced to seamlessly process this new stream of sensory input without any strain. And for convenience, you can switch your receptors on or off at will.
objects.title: (Thinker) Electroreception

objects.text:
You become the living embodiment of the term "Business Shark," gaining numerous minor thinker-powers perfectly suited for the world of business. These powers allow you to predict market trends and future shifts with incredible accuracy, making you an unmatched negotiator, even when dealing with the most conservative businessmen and politicians.

You possess a keen sense for identifying individuals with high potential and know exactly how to develop their talents and unlock their abilities. You can manage cash flow in a way that satisfies employees and shareholders while providing them with the minimum they find acceptable. Your skills enable you to direct the growth and investments of your company to not only keep it afloat but also ensure continuous prosperity.

You have a natural intuition for drawing people into debt, turning them into willing workers under your influence. You are capable of building a global business empire from virtually nothing, though achieving this might take several decades. In the world of business, you are a shark among fish.
objects.title: (Thinker) Business Shark

addons.text: All animals are irresistibly drawn to you, treating you with devotion and loyalty. Whether it’s a playful squirrel, a majestic eagle, or a gentle deer, they all love you and instinctively come to your aid, often before you even realize you need help. Birds serenade you with sweet melodies, woodland creatures clear your path, and even the fiercest beasts become your protectors.
addons.title: Aura of a Disney Princess

addons.text: Now your singing can be understood by all, from the birds to the dogs to any person, thus allowing it to affect all. You can Master anyone who understands you through singing. This also gives you the talent to make and sing songs on the spot. The effects of your Mastering has also become more subtle, giving you better control over it.
addons.title: Voice of a Disney Princess

objects.text:
You have the ability to communicate with and understand animals. From mammals to birds, reptiles to amphibians, you can easily connect with any animal you encounter, albeit some require more effort than others. With some animals, such as insects, their alien mindset and manner of communication make it challenging to fully comprehend, but talking to a hive rather than a single bug can make it easier. 

(Do note that humans count as animals, thus allowing you to bypass language barriers.)
objects.title: (Thinker) Dr Dolittle

objects.text: You will automatically know six objects you will need in the next 24 hours, or at a specific occasion or event within this timeframe. This power can only be used once every 24 hours. It will focus on things considered more important, such as gear for an upcoming fight, over 20 bucks for your lunch.
objects.title: (Thinker) Checklist

objects.text: You have total awareness within 30 meters of yourself. Your awareness only extends to anything that's been within 30 meters of yourself for over a hundredth of a second.
objects.title: (Thinker) Byakugan

addons.text: When you grab, use or just wear an object, you get hundreds of years of experience every second for that particular object. However, you will lose all the experience gained from the object upon losing contact.
addons.title: Greenhorn Master

objects.text: You are as skilled in the use of any tool or machine you've touched within the last five minutes as a professional, though not quite as much as a master.
objects.title: (Thinker) Skilled

objects.text:
When you read or hear a story, you can experience it, though it's all in your mind. You are able to picture and feel the events as if they were happening to you. For example, if someone describes a hike through a dense forest, you can feel the crunch of leaves underfoot, hear the rustling of wildlife, and see the sunlight filtering through the trees as if you were there.

This experience can give you insights into the storyteller's experiences and emotions, even possible allowing you to learn skills from these stories. However, this power of immersion cannot be activated if the story lacks sufficient information or is too vague. If crucial details are concealed, such as names being replaced, the experience may be altered, but you will instantly sense that something is off. Additionally, it comes with a subtle sense that helps you judge whether a story is true. This sense isn’t based of what the storyteller thinks is true, but what is actually true. Authentic stories evoke rich, vivid, and dynamic images and feelings, while fake stories often feel dull, flat, lifeless, and artificial. This difference can help you tell if a story is genuine or not.
objects.title: (Thinker) Immersive Storytelling

addons.text:
Your mind is now permanently emulated on your Shard, similar to that of Noctis Capes or Case 53s. Like the Noctis Capes, you possess perfect memory, bordering on self-prescience. You no longer need sleep but can still enjoy it recreationally, and you are unaffected by mental fatigue or loss of consciousness.

Since your mind exists within the Shard, Master/Stranger powers that typically target the physical brain no longer affect you, Stranger powers that manipulate brain functions directly, like Nice Guy’s ability, can't influence you, however, Master powers that control the body, such as Jean-Paul/Alec’s nervous system control can still influence you.
addons.title: Shard Mind

objects.text: You can detach your rational mind from your body and think clearly in this state. While it can protect against Master effects, it can't negate suggestions you would still follow even in this state. Additionally, you enter a state of being a High-Functional Sociopath during this period.
objects.title: (Thinker) Clean Mind

addons.text:
In the Dream Room your operations room will simply be a part of the room that you intuitively know how to find. 

You can with great effort awaken yourself from the dream room early at the cost of a serious thinker headache. 

You can choose to let any of your clustermates assist you in managing your operations, giving them a weaker version of your intuitive understanding of the room, the ability to communicate with people you have tagged as well and adding another five blocks to the range of this power per assisting person.
addons.title: Support Crew

objects.text:
You find it easy to fall asleep at will even with chaotic surroundings and can wake up from sleep with a minute of focus.

Whenever you sleep, your consciousness will be transported to a simulated military operations room.

If you have a master power you can maintain its effects while sleeping if you can't already. While awake, you can tag willing individuals (anybody under the effects of one of your master powers will automatically count as tagged for this power). You will have the ability to communicate with any tagged being inside the range of your ops room when you're inside, allowing you to coordinate them.

The room will give you real-time information on the environment in a five-block radius communicated by the various elements of the room that you can understand in a strange, intuitive dream logic kind of way. From the room you can find out the layout of the area, any environmental effects (such as traps or shaker effects, even if they're hidden or otherwise undetectable), the locations of every living being in the area, what they are and what they currently have equipped (what they're wearing and what they're holding).

You cannot directly recognize people with the information from the room alone (you can tell the difference between tagged and not tagged people) and will have to pick up who they are from context clues (what they're wearing, where they are, etc.). However, each person tracked is identifiably distinct, so you will never lose track of which person is which, no matter how complex their movements. (i.e. if Trickster swapped two people, you’d be able to instantly tell that they’ve switched, even if you didn’t know who they were)
objects.title: (Thinker) Consciousness Commander

addons.text: Not only are you able to sense chemical composition and structural layout, but you gain the understanding of how anything you analyze works, allowing you to replicate it. This does not apply to tinker-tech or supernatural effects.
addons.title: Analyze

addons.text:
Your ability to see as far as you want applies to your skin-vision, granting LOS across the entire universe.

Shard blindspots still apply.
addons.title: Universal Vision

addons.text: Your dimensional awareness has further enhanced all of your senses. Your nose could gain an improved capability for dimensional detection; your touch could give greater detail on a specific dimensional phenomenon; your mouth could be able to taste the curvature of spacetime; perhaps your eyes and ears could even perceive other dimensions in a very small radius.
addons.title: Dimensional Senses

objects.text:
Each of your senses becomes enhanced. Your nose can sense electromagnetic fields; your mouth can understand chemical composition; your touch can examine structural layout; your ears can use echolocation; and you may see from any pore of your skin.

You additionally become immune to information overload, and may selectively disable any part of your senses.
objects.title: (Thinker) Enhanced Senses

addons.text:
The synergy between unlimited physical training and mental growth through bodily development has unlocked a new frontier—your mind itself has become a muscle, one that can be trained without limit. With no theoretical ceiling to your cognitive development, your brain now operates beyond conventional human limitations, continuously refining itself with every challenge.

As a result, your thinking power can reach inhuman levels. You could process an arbitrary number of interconnected or completely separate thoughts simultaneously. Complex problem-solving will become second nature—where others would struggle for hours, you effortlessly juggle partial differential equations and multi-dimensional geometry, all in the background of your mind. Every intellectual endeavor becomes a form of training, sharpening your cognitive abilities like an ever-improving muscle.

And if you ever feel a headache? That just means your stupid is leaving, and the smart is settling in.
addons.title: Mega-Mind
Calisthenic Mind
addons.text:
The principle behind Brute (Muscle Equilibrium) now extends through Strong Man to your mind. Any physical training that improves your body simultaneously develops your mental faculties, with the resulting improvement distributed throughout your entire mind rather than being limited to any particular cognitive ability.

Training any physical quality therefore develops your entire range of mental faculties simultaneously. A simple jumping cord training montage can improve your strength, endurance, coordination, balance, and other physical qualities while likewise enhancing your willpower, reasoning, memory, concentration, creativity, adaptability, and every other aspect of your mind. The specific exercise only determines how effectively you train your body; once the improvement occurs, its benefits are distributed throughout your physical and mental faculties alike.

This principle also applies to deliberate mental training. Improving any particular cognitive ability causes the resulting development to spread throughout the rest of your mind, allowing relatively simple forms of practice to produce broad intellectual growth. Combined with Brute (Calisthenics), even basic exercises can become extraordinarily effective; repeatedly practicing elementary arithmetic, for example, can eventually develop the overall mental capacity required to handle vastly more advanced mathematics without directly studying those higher-level concepts.

You must still train for improvement to occur, and the rate of development depends on the quality, intensity, and consistency of that training. You simply no longer need to separately train each part of your body or mind to develop it.

objects.text:
Your body is now a great tool for your mind, creating a effect where physical training directly enhances cognitive abilities. Every aspect of your mental fitness—problem-solving, memory, creativity, and focus—grows in proportion to your physical development. As your body becomes faster, stronger, and more enduring, so too does your mind sharpen and evolve.

Training for speed heightens your mental processing and recall, allowing you to analyze and retrieve complex information at unprecedented speeds. Developing raw strength fortifies your willpower and your ability to tackle mental challenges with brute force, breaking down problems with a forceful, direct approach. As you improve physical agility through stretching and movement exercises, you also cultivate mental flexibility. Building physical endurance grants you extraordinary mental stamina, ensuring clarity and focus under pressure for extended periods.
objects.title: (Thinker) Strong Man

addons.text:
At the start of your dream, you can now choose the situation. You can choose your background in what world and what situation. You can try to replicate dreams you had in the past but details will be off and different.

If you die in your dream, you can choose to start again at the beginning like usual or experience a new dream.

This doesn’t allow you to extend or shorten the total amount of time you spend dreaming.
addons.title: My Dream

objects.text: You will have a lucid dream every time you sleep. You don’t get to control the dream itself, but you’re fully aware that it’s a dream, and you can make choices within it. The dreams are completely random—one night, you might find yourself as a janitor, scrubbing floors in a massive, empty building, and the next, you’re a soldier in the chaos of war, facing death and destruction. You could even end up in a dream where you are an animal, be it a prey animal being chased or a predator in an hunt. When this ability first kicks in, your dream only lasts five minutes. But with every dream after that, the time doubles—5 minutes turns into 10, then 20, then 40, and so on. The dreams grow longer and longer, becoming more vivid and immersive with each passing night. Even death will not end the dream, all that will do is restart the dream. If you have the Holding Back perk you can end a dream ahead of time. This doesn’t extend how long you sleep, only how long the dream feels for you. Any skills you learn or experience in these dreams stay with you when you wake up. Whether it’s mastering a specific technique, understanding a complex system, or even just developing a sharper mind, your time in the dream world makes you smarter, more experienced and capable in reality.
objects.title: (Thinker) Dreams of Another Life

addons.text: During your interlude dreams, you may choose to witness alternate versions of past events, exploring how different decisions could have shaped the outcome. These variations are based on real possibilities—actions you realistically could have taken, informed by what you knew at the time. When viewing these alternate outcomes, you also experience the thoughts and emotions of those involved.
addons.title: Different Endings

objects.text: Every time you go to sleep at the end of the day, you can, at will, experience interlude dreams. They will depict the events of the day from the point of view of several other characters, complete with the narration of their inner thoughts and feelings.
