The events shown in these interludes will be, in one way or another, related to your actions during the day. You may, at any time, switch to another character POV or interrupt interludes entirely and either wake up or fall asleep as normal. Any interlude lasts at most an hour of real time, no matter how much time passes inside the dream. Should you go without sleep for several days, you may experience Interlude Ark, where every character POV may last for as long as you have been awake, still taking at most an hour to fully view it.
objects.title: (Thinker) Interlude

addons.text: Your gut instincts are now directly assisted by your power, ensuring that your intuition is almost always correct. You subconsciously gravitate towards the correct answer to your questions and suspicions almost immediately, steering you clear away from failure without need of conscious thought. If going right instead of left would lead you into a trap, you get goosebumps and shivers and a large dose of hesitation. If an opportunity presents itself that seems a bit too good to be true, your mind helps you disengage before you can overcommit.
addons.title: Jump to Conclusion

addons.text:
Your ability to come up with absurd, absolutely off-the-wall plans has been integrated into your power. Moment by moment, you see and process not just the most stupid thing to do, but also the most improbable - to everyone including yourself. From the process to the result of the action, barely anyone would be able to predict it. However, these actions will continually allow your power to increase in strength, and act as little limit breakers for your restrictions, giving you more leeway to actually plan ahead with your power’s assistance.

Additionally, your lack of understanding threats beyond your comprehension and your mind’s simplicity extends into your ability to process useful information, stripping away most complexities in favor of allowing you to plan with your power in play. The aforementioned effects allow you to have significantly more control over the result of your presence in an engagement and actively participate in strategizing.
addons.title: Haphazard Planning

addons.text:
Your subconscious control and replication of luck have synergized into the perfect stagehand for your actions. While you can’t plan much into the future by yourself, your power does the job for you, drawing on your desires for an expected outcome and putting that luck to work. While long-term planning still hinders you, your power assists in this endeavor by automatically helping to lay the groundwork for future success. Your power can now ensure you’re in the right place at the right time.

This manifests as a series of minor lucky breaks that happen one after another, as a domino effect that gradually gains momentum. If you decide to start walking like a drunk all of a sudden, you will have dodged a bullet. Take a wrong turn for the hell of it, and you’re close to the perfect ambush position for a mugging happening in the alley right beside you. Every action you take now possesses an invisible safety net under it, ensuring that no matter what you do, you’ll always have a little bit of something to fall back on.
addons.title: Prosperity in Motion

addons.text:
Your power begins to reach into the future—not by revealing it, but by guiding you toward it. You now receive subtle nudges and urges that compel you to take certain actions, often without explanation or apparent purpose. These impulses may seem irrational, wasteful, or even counterproductive in the moment, but every one of them is a deliberate stroke in a masterpiece of strategy still unfolding. You may not know why you feel compelled to turn left instead of right, speak up in a meeting, or buy a specific item on a whim—but eventually, often much later, the reason becomes stunningly clear.

The longer term the plan is, the more random it is and less you understand. While short-term nudges often have a visible chain of cause and effect—take a detour, talk to this person, pick up that item—longer-term plans begin to feel like chaos wearing a disguise. This randomness isn’t true disorder, but a reflection of the power operating on a level of complexity far beyond your conscious comprehension. 

While your power is self-correcting in the short run, long-term plans are less flexible once set in motion. A single divergence, even accidental, can cause cascading failures—though, paradoxically, your power might have accounted for that too, and nudged you toward making the mistake. The deeper you lean into the randomness, the more you must accept that understanding why is a luxury you no longer have. Your only certainty is this: if you trust the path, the plan will unfold.
addons.title: All According To Plan?

objects.text: Your instincts and intuition passively operate at a superhuman level, giving you a subconscious understanding of the best courses of action available in any given moment of time. Whether in a scrum, a regular conversation, or for more recreational purposes like storytelling, you react like you already knew what you were going to do, like beginner’s luck taken to the next, next level. Your gut feelings prove accurate, and your hesitation just vanishes in the face of anything you know you can handle. However, you’re pushed away from long-term planning by the power itself, making detailed strategies feel slow. You can execute them just fine, but you’ll find your instincts and intuition more and more dull by the moment. The more information you can act on, the less effective your power becomes. Conversely, it ensures that you’re at your very best when you’re at your wit’s end: blind, deaf, and acting with absolutely no plan whatsoever.
objects.title: (Thinker) This Is The Greatest Plan…!

objects.text:
Whenever you take physical damage from an attack, you instantly gain comprehensive theoretical knowledge of that attack. You learn its biomechanics, force vectors, energy transfer, timing, and mechanical execution. For example, if someone breaks your nose with a straight punch, you immediately understand how they generated that force. You know their foot placement, hip rotation, arm angle, and impact distribution. You can then apply that knowledge to your own punches. Turning that theory into practical muscle memory happens hundreds of times faster than natural learning. What would take weeks of practice condenses into minutes or hours, with more severe injuries providing deeper and more detailed information.

This understanding remains purely theoretical and does not grant you any inherent ability to replicate exotic or parahuman effects unless you already possess the necessary means. For example, if a pyrokinetic burns you, you’ll learn everything about the fire's behavior, its heat gradient, and how the parahuman controlled it. You still cannot breathe or throw fire without a compatible power or technology. The same applies to being rammed by a car. You learn the vehicle's speed, mass, impact angle, and crumple dynamics, but your body cannot generate that force. You gain only the knowledge, not the physical capability to reproduce the attack.
objects.title: (Thinker) Feel It In My Bones

objects.text:
You can now tag people to then create distinct mental groups, linking each other in a shared information network. You may have as many groups at a time as you wish. 

Anyone added to a group becomes continuously aware of the condition and location of every other member within the same group, with each person’s position updating in real time through an intuitive mental map that tracks movement, area, and activity. 

The map also shows the actual area itself, rather than simple feeling of relative distance. This will allow members to actually tell where people went, such as a restaurant or home or office, rather than a feeling of simple distance. 

This awareness is not limited to just the present moment either, members are able to pull up a history of activity and location through a continuously recorded history that begins from the moment they were added to the group and persists for as long as they remain connected.

Beyond simply tracking the power also enables communication between members of the same group, allowing them to discuss through a form of telepathy. This communication is seamless and immediate, making coordination effortless even across large distances. 

Individual members can hide their information from other members, and are not obligated to communicate with others if they do not wish, essentially able to block, mute, or simply not “pick up” their communications, however they cannot hide from you and you can force that channel open, and can likewise remove someone’s ability to hide from others and reinstate it at will.
objects.title: (Thinker) Life 360

objects.text:
You gain enhanced timing. You can effectively time and manage group activities with exceptional efficiency. With this ability, you can calculate the precise amount of time required for a given task and organize team members accordingly. 

Your enhanced timing ability requires you to have an understanding of every factor involved in the task at hand. Whether it's the environment, fitness, Parahuman powers, or any other relevant detail, you have a heightened sense of intuition that helps you precisely determine the optimal course of action for each situation. 

You have the normal Shard blindspots.
objects.title: (Thinker) Perfect Timing

objects.text: You get more skilled in combat the more injured you are and possess a mild Brute power that keeps you standing even after grave physical stress or injury, like broken bones or deep abdominal gashes. While it doesn't heal you, it can keep you in a fight if you aren't dead yet. If you're on your last-minute stand, you can even defeat the likes of Contessa.
objects.title: (Thinker/Brute) Skill Issue

addons.text:
Now, your voices have their own voices, each splintered into fragments of consciousness. Where once there were a thousand distinct personalities, now there are countless more, each representing a specific skill, belief, or desire. Every thought, every nuance of emotion, every fleeting doubt or hope is now personified—a chaotic chorus that never quiets.

This fragmentation brings with it an overwhelming complexity. The once-cohesive voices that offered you guidance are now scattered, each pulling in a different direction. A single decision, once supported by a unified inner team, now invites endless debates from every fragment. Every action is scrutinized from a dozen angles, every belief challenged by its own counterpoint.

As if this weren’t enough, new voices have emerged, bringing with them ways of thinking entirely foreign to you. Some think like animals—instinctual, driven by primal urges and survival. Others have alien logic, detached from human emotion or conventional reason. These new personalities offer extremely different perspectives that most cannot understand.
addons.title: Fractured but Whole

addons.text:
Each of your voices embodies a specific role, mastering it to the point of attaining peak human abilities. Whether it’s the strategist who calculates every possible outcome or the therapist who intuitively understands the mentality of others, each personality is a specialist in its domain.

The voices come equipped with all the knowledge required for their roles, instantly accessible and always up-to-date. The healer knows every medical procedure, the linguist speaks every language fluently, and the warrior possesses unmatched combat skills. They aren’t just knowledgeable—they are the embodiment of expertise. They act with the confidence of someone who has spent a multiple lifetimes honing their craft.

This seamless integration means that whatever task lies ahead, you have within you the perfect expert to tackle it. The roles complement each other, each personality providing a piece of the puzzle, working together to achieve your goals. When they align, it’s as if you have an entire team of specialists within you, each one operating at their absolute best.
addons.title: Thousand Masteries

addons.text:
A few of your voices, no more than 15, gains a power seed deep within them. The type of power that emerges from these seeds is entirely random and the time it takes for the seeds to mature and the upper limit of the seed’s strength is still the same. Each voice can only ever have 1 seed, and you cannot reclaim the seed they have.

After their seeds mature, they spark the creation of another seed, birthing a new voice within your mind. This new voice carries its own unique perspective, and power. The cycle is continuous, with each maturing seed setting off a chain reaction of growth and evolution.

However, these voices can only wield their powers when “given the driver’s seat,” meaning they must take control to use their abilities fully. While you remain the ultimate authority, choosing when and if to relinquish control, the voices can only act when you allow them to step forward. Powers that enhance their mental abilities, like increased perception or strategic insight, can be accessed while they remain in the background, but anything beyond that requires them to take the lead.

At any moment, you can regain control, seamlessly transitioning from one voice to another or reclaiming the reins yourself. This ensures that while each voice may possess unique powers, you remain the one guiding the ship, deciding when to let these powers shine and when to pull them back. With time and practice, it is possible to have more than one voice in control at once, merging them temporarily.
addons.title: Legion

addons.text: The personalities are no longer just voices, but actual souls residing alongside yours. Thousand versions of yourself whose sole purpose in life is helping you. Because of this you are resistant to attempts at messing with your soul due to those souls being in the way. Not only that but any powers of yours that need a soul to work or a mind will also apply to all of them while simultaneously counting you all as one and separate beings, which allows you to for example have access to a thousand semblances on top of your own. Additionally, your souls—including your very own—also have access to weaker versions of any of your non-soul/mind powers, allowing them to for example protect you against intruders by straight up fighting the intruder.
addons.title: A Thousand Genuine Souls

objects.text:
Inside you, there resides a thousand voices, each representing a distinct personality with its own outlook on life. These voices know everything you know, share every memory, and possess the same knowledge, yet they interpret it in their own unique ways. Some are cautious, some daring; some are analytical, others creative. They argue, they suggest, they critique, but ultimately, they all work together toward a common goal—yours.

You are the conductor of this symphony, the one who holds the reins. No matter how many perspectives they offer, how many strategies they propose, your will is the guiding force. When you decide on a course of action, every voice aligns behind you, channeling their unique strengths and insights to make your decision a success. They bring different skills to the table, drawing from their unique understanding, but they never overshadow your desires. Instead, they enhance them, offering solutions you might never have considered alone. Any attempt to master you will likely fail, as if one mind is mastered, another takes its place. Thinker powers have a difficulty reading you, as reading a thousand people at once is far from easy.

You are a collective consciousness—a thousand minds working as one. Every challenge becomes an opportunity for collaboration, every obstacle a problem to be solved from countless angles. And while the voices may sometimes clash, creating a cacophony of thoughts and opinions, in the end, they are all united in a singular purpose: helping you become the best version of yourself, achieving what you set out to do, and ensuring that your path is always illuminated by the wisdom of many. 

If at any point the voices are too much, you can silence them at will.
objects.title: (Thinker) A Thousand Souls

objects.text: You can create a floating, intangible orb that you can use to gather information from afar. You can move the orb telekinetically, and may perceive things from the orb's location with all your senses as if you were there. It cannot go through living things, and intense heat dispels it. While not invisible, the orb is very faint and hard to see, being highly transparent and lacking specific color.
objects.title: (Thinker) Scrying Orb

objects.text: You can give your full focus to several things at the same time and increase your mental capabilities by cloning your brain. You can do this once per day, and it will always appears within a jar. Although non-sentient and non-sapient, frequent use will make it likely for your emotions to seep into it, resulting in the formation of an alternate personality within your mind and network of brains. Fortunately, if it happens, they will never be malicious, as they will consider you a parental figure.
objects.title: (Thinker) Multibrain

addons.text: You can choose to bring those you've invited into the Cinema into your other simulated dream spaces.
addons.title: Guest Appearances

objects.text:
You find it easy to fall asleep at will.

Whenever you sleep, your consciousness will be transported to a simulated movie cinema. If you fall asleep while maintaining contact with anybody else, you can pull them into this simulated space with you, knocking them out as well. Nothing that happens in the cinema will persist once they wake up from the dream, due to it being a mental space, the exception being a portion of the Thinker headaches or other costs incurred via the use of powers in the cinema. There is a door in the cinema that will wake up anybody that walks through it so long as their unconsciousness isn't being maintained by external forces (such as the effects of other powers or drawbacks).

In this cinema, anybody can choose to replay, pause, rewind, etc. any of their memories on the screen at perfect quality (viewing the screen intently will allow people to experience the non-audiovisual senses of those memories). These memories will be in pristine shape with no degradation from forgetting or alterations, being backed by postcognition to ensure they're always accurate (So you’d be able to view Imp while she had her power active in the memories, for example).

Anybody inside the cinema can apply their Thinker powers to the memory, allowing anybody focusing on the screen to be able to postcognitively get information from them as if the power were being used at the time of the memory, from the point of view of the memory (including the use of touch-based thinker powers on things the rememberer was touching at the time). Only the Thinker aspects will work for this, however, i.e. Victor draining a person's skills from a memory would not drain the person's skills in real life.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Dream Cinephile

objects.text:
When you sense someone or something, you instinctively know how many identities they have or had and can choose to know those with more detail.

You know their names, date of creation accompanied with every use and their reason, motives of their existence, equipment and capabilities—things like clothing, tools and weapons, powers and skills, physical stats, etc; you even get what or who those identities are connected to and their relationship—things like whether they are enemies or friends, or perhaps family, maybe all three, etc. Although, you would need to sense those connections to know their identities.
objects.title: (Thinker) Breaking the Mask

objects.text:
You possess memories of the future, recalled as naturally and vividly as you remember your past. These future memories blend seamlessly into your existing recollections, making it nearly impossible to tell what has already happened and what is still to come. You may suddenly “remember” a conversation or an event—only to realize later that it hasn’t occurred yet, or perhaps never will.

You remember the near future with relative sharpness, while events further ahead become vague or completely lost. Just like how childhood memories blur over time, your visions of the distant future grow unstable the further they are from the present. Adding to the confusion, acting on a future event can shift the timeline, subtly or drastically, without your awareness. Each future memory you act on can cause other memories of the futures to shift or disappear and you won’t know what changed as they will have changed seamlessly in your mind.
objects.title: (Thinker) Deja Vecu

objects.text:
You are exceptionally creative in how you use powers, yours and others'.

You instinctively spot unusual applications, clever combinations, and overlooked tricks. Small details stand out to you. Secondary effects suggest new possibilities.

Moreover, you have an intuitive sense of how to utilize abilities in the moment, able to think on the fly. This also extends to how to potentially spot weaknesses or bypass opponents' abilities.

For example, utilizing a swarm of bugs to suffocate an immortal and immutable brute by ramming bugs down their throat.

After seeing a power in action, grasping the basic concepts of it, or extrapolating it from simple inference, you quickly grasp ways it could be pushed further, used differently, or turned against its owner.

This also extends to making you excel at teaching others how to use their abilities.

You don’t increase the raw strength of any ability. You simply think of things other people don’t.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Munchkin

addons.title: True Reflection
addons.text:
Your Flaked Skin is no longer simply a manifestation of your condition, but the raw material from which your Inner Self is maintained and rebuilt. Every flake contains a fragment of the underlying concept it represents—flesh, memory, instinct, emotion, immunity, power expression, or something stranger. Within your Inner Self these fragments can be collected, refined, broken down, or recombined before being reintroduced into your body.

This allows damage to become a resource instead of merely something to remove. A peeled trauma can reinforce mental resilience, excess bone can strengthen your skeleton elsewhere, scar tissue can be refined into healthy flesh, while redundant or unwanted traits can be dismantled into generic "building material" for future repairs or modifications. Nothing your shard removes is necessarily wasted.

Likewise, your Inner Self gains an internal economy. The shadow workers collect discarded flakes, sort them into stockpiles, recycle useful components, and manufacture replacement parts while you focus on larger projects. Missing organs, damaged structures, or even entirely new biological systems can first be assembled from these reclaimed materials before being installed into their proper place.

objects.text:
Your shard grants conscious access to the abstract representation it uses to monitor and maintain your body and mind. Rather than entering it, you simultaneously perceive both realities at all times, your awareness naturally divided between the physical world and your shard's maintenance space without distraction or loss of focus. This inner world takes a symbolic form shaped by your psyche and powers—a factory, laboratory, temple, fortress, sewer system, or any similarly fitting environment.

Within it, every aspect of your being is represented by mechanisms, structures, and strange shadow-like workers. These entities are manifestations of your shard's autonomous maintenance processes, continuously repairing damage, regulating biology, organizing memories, and maintaining your Corona Pollentia. They are neither intelligent nor alive, merely specialized processes given symbolic form.

By directly repairing, reorganizing, or modifying these representations, the corresponding changes gradually manifest in reality. Likewise, injuries, diseases, mental trauma, power-related abnormalities, and other conditions appear within this landscape at their source, allowing them to be diagnosed and corrected before they worsen. The extent of your changes remains limited only by what your shard could ordinarily accomplish.
objects.title: (Thinker/Breaker) Inner Self

objects.text:
By activating this ability with the intent to figure out something specific, you will be put in a gray box for one minute with controllable hyper focus on trying to figure out what you want to figure out. After one minute passes, any information you figured out will be sent back to the start of when you entered the box. This can theoretically be done an infinite number of times, but each time will give a small Thinker headache that stacks with each iteration.

Just to clarify, it is NOT your consciousness being sent back, just the information you figured out/obtained in the box. This ability can be cancelled at any time, and when you do, you will be back to the instance you activated the ability.
objects.title: (Thinker) Think Tank

objects.text: You can correctly answer any question that is yes/no, true/false, or a/b and more than 100 people know the correct answer to it on the planet. You also know if the answer leans heavily in one direction or the other.
objects.title: (Thinker) One or the Other

objects.text: You can absorb your opponent's muscle memory, causing them to lose the ability to perform most actions unconsciously. This includes the need to think about even the most basic functions, like breathing, blinking, and swallowing. The absorption also confer the necessary physical ability to utilize the muscle memory effectively as well as allow you to temporarily gain the targets strength.
objects.title: (Thinker/Brute) Stolen Muscles

objects.text: You gain the ability to simulate a person's brain. Simply by being in your line of sight, you can read their surface thoughts and memories by tapping into their mental activity, gaining an understanding of how they think and processing their thoughts in real-time. The longer you maintain visual contact with the target, the deeper you can delve into their thoughts, eventually gaining access to their most recent and significant memories. You can also insert your own thoughts into a person’s surface thoughts, allowing you to communicate.
objects.title: (Thinker) Mental Probe

addons.title: Kilo-Brain
addons.text:
Your brain is no longer limited to the size normally permitted by your skull and human biology. Instead, its mass scales with the amount of muscle in your body, with every kilogram of muscle you possess supporting an equivalent amount of additional brain mass.

This additional brain tissue remains fully functional and integrates with your existing nervous system, increasing your neural capacity as your body develops. Losing muscle causes the corresponding excess brain tissue to shrink as well, though your brain will never be reduced below its normal biological size.

The effect does not create unlimited brain mass. It cannot push your brain beyond what your biology can safely support, and additional mass provides no benefit once you reach the maximum practical biological limit. Likewise, having insufficient muscle simply means you gain no additional brain tissue rather than losing your normal brain.

addons.title: Kilo-Mass-Brain
addons.text: Your brain is no longer subject to its biological limits. Whether through unrestricted processing or its existence beyond your physical body, the restriction on how large your brain can become is removed. You can continue converting mass into brain indefinitely, allowing it to become a black body, grow to planetary proportions, or potentially both if you possess both requirements.

objects.text:
Your brain is structured in a far more complex, optimized, and efficient manner than that of the average human.

Your neuron density is five times higher than the human average, and your brain features more folds and wrinkles, increasing its surface area. This allows for more neurological connections to fit within your skull. Additionally, your brain forms connections at an accelerated rate and possesses a highly efficient glymphatic system.

As a result, every aspect of your cognitive functioning is enhanced, including but not limited to: exceptional abstract thinking, a photographic memory, extraordinary problem-solving skills, accelerated learning, unparalleled creativity, extended mental stamina, and a heightened processing speed.

In essence, you are a genius. You possess an intellect that far surpasses even the brightest minds in history such as Sir Isaac Newton and Albert Einstein—an intellectual powerhouse with a staggering IQ of 300.
objects.title: (Thinker) Opposite of A Smooth Brain

objects.text: You have a downward vision from the skies, anything above the clouds can't be seen though. Your eyes are accurate enough to track individual people and sharp enough to even read their lips.
objects.title: (Thinker) Eagle Vision

objects.text: Each day, you receive 3 visions of events that will happen within 24 hours. These events are random but significant. If something particularly important will happen, like an Endbringer attack, you will receive a vision from that event. You receive your first vision upon waking, your second an hour later, and the third an hour after that.
objects.title: (Thinker) All Part of the Plan

objects.text: This allows you to assume the skills of a single character or role at a time, attaining their peak human abilities. By immersing yourself in the role, you gain their expertise and excel in various fields.
objects.title: (Thinker) Roleplay

objects.text: You are extremely good at learning and memorizing patterns. This allows you to quickly analyze an opponent’s attack sequences and movements, enabling you to predict their next actions based on observed behaviors. By identifying small changes in their strategy, you can make precise adjustments to counter their attacks or exploit weaknesses. Your accuracy is only limited by the information available, but once enough data is gathered, you can anticipate even subtle shifts. For example, after observing an opponent’s attack style for a short time, you can recognize their preferred moves—whether it’s a tendency to strike low after a feint or to rely on quick jabs between heavy hits, and from there you can “herd” them to your desired position.
objects.title: (Thinker) Pattern Recognition

addons.text:
The Dream Room of your cluster will draw upon the power of your Super Dream, turning it into a full-on world and granting it the same properties as your standalone dreams.

The Dream Realm's enforced “safety” can now be disabled between any two consenting clustermates (and can be re-enabled at will), allowing them to harm or otherwise affect each other freely, useful for sparring or testing purposes.

If the Super Dream is (one of) your primary power(s), the Dream Realm will focus on and bend towards your needs over everyone else: the realm and its soulless automaton inhabitants providing minimal assistance to the rest of your clustermates, even potentially refusing to help or actively hindering those that you dislike (it won't ever directly harm them, but it’ll startle them, annoy them, etc.). This favoritism of the realm does not extend to features added to the Dream Realm via your clustermates' powers (such as from their variants of your Super Dream power) or from other cluster mechanics that affect the dream (such as the tokens from Playing Favourites).

The Dream Realm is still a mental space, and thus nothing that happens in the Dream Realm to its inhabitants (injury, master effects, empowerment, etc.) will affect their real bodies or otherwise persist once everybody wakes up except for skill building and muscle memory (unless the power is explicitly stated to do so otherwise).
addons.title: Dream Realm

objects.text: Whenever you sleep, your consciousness is transported to a simulated reality designed by your power to provide various methods to experiment and train your power to its fullest extent in a safe environment. Powers with limited resources do not consume them in this world. There is no sapient life in this world, just soulless automata for you to practice on. This world and your body in it are entirely mental/simulated, only useful to build skill and muscle memory. Time spent in Super Dream counts as proper sleep for the purposes of body maintenance. It is not just powers this helps train; if you, for example, wish to develop your skills as a mechanic, it will provide opportunities for you to develop the skill as long as you put the work in—do this enough times for multiple different disciplines and people might think you have a Tinker power or multiple Thinker powers even if this is your only power.
objects.title: (Thinker) Super Dream

objects.text: You can think of a set of traits and/or skills you want in somebody, and your power will give you a mental compass to the closest target fitting your criteria.
objects.title: (Thinker) Looking for More

addons.text: Your power will automatically filter out dangerous sensory inputs, rendering you immune to threats such as flashbangs and cognitohazards.
addons.title: Ignorance Is Bliss

addons.text: You now have the ability to synchronize precise data with your observation target. You can determine the exact number of windows, cracks, weak points in a structure, as well as the exact layouts of ventilation, sewage, and other systems directly related to the object. Any of your knowledge or abilities also add to this information. For example, if you know the exact time and route of a security patrol, you can approximate their location.
addons.title: Augmented Picture

objects.text:
All your senses work in an “absolute” fashion: if you perceive something, no matter how occluded or how minute a part of it, you will be able to perceive it in its entirety with that sense as if you were right next to it. This is a full 3D extension of the sense along its topology, including internal topology if the object is not airtight. This doesn't give you knowledge of things resting on or inside the object, just the object itself. This has no range limit, allowing you to view even heavenly bodies light-years away in full, real time detail.

For example, if you saw only a person's foot, you’d be able to view that person in their entirety; if you heard a muffled conversation, you’d be able to hear the words loud and clear; if you touched a bottle, you could feel the entire surface of the bottle, including its inner walls; etc.

As well as this, you can also do the opposite, filtering specific objects out of your senses if you desire, leaving only a vague “blob” in its place that you know is filtered. So you could filter out a specific person's voice to ignore them; or, with quick reflexes, filter out a flashbang grenade to avoid being affected by it; etc.

This power does innately help you process your senses to prevent you from getting sensory overload, but that protection breaks down if this power is pointed against particularly large (building sized) or complex (Escher-like/fractal) objects, giving Thinker headaches without training and focus.
objects.title: (Thinker) Full Picture

addons.text: Now, if you manage to capture an object in any of your senses, you can push to allow you to sense that thing with all your senses along the entire object, even airtight cavities. Overusing this feature can give you Thinker headaches.
addons.title: Full Profile

objects.text:
You can get information on anything (living or non-living) by viewing replicas of it. The more accurate a replica is, the greater amount of detail you can get about the object it represents.

View a crude drawing of a building, and you can get the knowledge that the building it represents still exists and the rough cardinal direction it’s in; view a map of an area and you can get a top-down view of the area the map represents and where it exists relative to you; view a to-scale doll of a person (or one made using parts from the person) and you can not only get an accurate third person view of the target and can pinpoint their current location exactly, but you can also get extra insight into them like how they think or their emotional weaknesses, depending on what qualities the doll gets most accurate.
objects.title: (Thinker) Sympathetic Sight

addons.text:
Able to time your actions perfectly, you no longer need to actively perform to music, but rather perform actions and you will naturally conform to the BPM.

While this seems at first to only be a Quality of life upgrade, what counts as ‘performing actions’ actually means ‘interacting with the world’ essentially allowing you to complete actions in a veritable blitz. 

A footstep may be a beat, but a leap would not be for there’s nothing affected until you land, every punch an impact with no visible windup, every held beat a choice
addons.title: HUSTLE!

objects.text:
Whenever music is played in your hearing, you can become three times more effective in any task as long as it is performed to the beat of that music. 

For instance, blasting an 80s jam from your speakers and getting into a scrap, timing your attacks to the beat would produce three times the result you’re looking for, be that damage, time disoriented from a stunning strike etcetera.

This also affects non-combat activities, with tinkering, training, calculating and more all growing more efficient and effective when performed to the beat.
objects.title: (Thinker/Mover) Dead as Disco

objects.text:
You become incredibly good at things you really don't want to do at that moment. The more you hate doing a specific task right now, the better and more skilled you become at it. The second you start feeling okay about doing it, or you don't mind anymore, your amazing skill starts to disappear until you're back to baseline skill at it.

Its caps at the skill level of the greatest human practitioner in history, enhanced by approximately twenty percent.
objects.title: (Thinker) Unwilling Prodigy

addons.text:
Your ability to create knowledge crystals has allowed you to store information you gain within, and to fire them at great speeds, acting as a kind of ‘ranged’ version of your upload. However, these are crystalline shards and can cause major damage independent of the information uploaded if fired carelessly.

Additionally, as they will receive the upload from the crystal fired into them, it can be a quite literal psychological warfare.
addons.title: Trauma Gun

addons.text:
The information you spread can never be removed or forgotten from someone’s mind. It will always be there, ready to spring forth and for associations to be made to it to ensure it never leaves. 

While this does ensure they’ll always be subject to (Trump) The Imaginary Trump, it also means any traumatic memories, skills, or manifest information you give to them will remain a complete and constant presence unless you deign to remove it.
addons.title: TBR: The Brain Router

objects.text:
You can download and upload information to and from people’s brains by touching them. While this allows you to copy and reproduce skills, ideas, and memories, you are unable to delete or remove anything that is taken from there. 
Any skill that you download from the target is largely the same, though there may be edge-cases where you’re unequipped due to not having developed the skill naturally.

If you have a method of retaining large amounts of information this can become quite lethal if you uploaded too much to one person.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) Data Transfer

objects.text: Ah you think darkness is your ally? You merely adopted the dark. I was born in it, molded by it. I didn't see the light until I was already a man, by then it was nothing to me but blinding! The darker your surroundings, the more your baseline physical and mental capacities amplify. In dim light you grow noticeably stronger, more coordinated, and sharper of instinct. As the area darkens further, your existing strength, speed, durability, and cognitive speed continue scaling upward. However, you do not create any capabilities you didn’t originally have. You cannot suddenly speak a language you never learned or play an instrument you never practiced, but any physical or mental task you could already perform becomes executed with escalating superhuman proficiency. In total darkness you reach your peak: your body operates at the highest physical records in human history, while your mind matches history's greatest strategic and analytical intellects, processing battlefield information and predicting enemy actions with the applied genius of a Napoleon and Sun Tzu in real time, along with the genius and creativity of humanity’s greatest scientists and artists. Any skills you have will reach the peak of what they can be used at, seamlessly flowing and building on other skills you have. You see just as clearly in darkness as you do under a noon sun, with no loss of detail, color, or clarity. But because your capabilities grows the darker your surroundings become, your vision actually gets better in the dark, exceeding your own daylight acuity until total darkness grants you a level of visual sharpness and perception that outclasses anything you could experience in the light.
objects.title: (Thinker/Brute) Dark Knight
(Thinker) Compiler
objects.text:
You perceive your own mind as a biological computer system. You see every thought, emotion, memory, and subconscious routine as a visible process, allowing you to identify inefficiencies, emotional loops, and wasted cognitive resources in real time.

You can dynamically shunt your finite mental resources between faculties. This is a zero-sum act. To enhance one capability to superhuman levels, you must temporarily suppress others. You can, for instance, silence your inner monologue and suppress pain to become a hyper-lethal combat engine, or shut down your sense of self to become a perfect social manipulator. The suppressed functions return when the shunt ends. You can also sacrifice a part of your mind to compile an automated Module. The resources sacrificed are reprogrammed to run the new function your mind didn’t originally do. You can revert this via mental logs.

You can bundle these Modules to create a Thinker Cluster, a hyper-specialized problem-solving program. It essentially allows you to create Thinker powers, each having a thinker rating from 1 to 7. Ratings above 7 are impossible. The human mind simply lacks the resources. Attempting it fails catastrophically, causing violent mental backlash and incapacitation. All Thinker Clusters are strictly limited to processing, analysing, and drawing inferences from information already gathered by your own senses. They cannot generate new information from nothing. A Cluster cannot grant precognition, clairvoyance, telepathy, or any form of extrasensory perception. It is a post-processing engine only, working on data you have already perceived.

Your only path to growth is refinement. You can make your mind more structured, efficient and effective while retaining its original architecture to free up resources, allowing for more Modules. Still, the ceiling of a single human consciousness remains absolute.

You can communicate with the deceased, summoning intangible and transparent versions of their corpses. The spirits are unable to move more than one meter away from their earthly remains, leaving them confined to the immediate vicinity. However, their ability to communicate is limited, and their cooperation may not be guaranteed. Moreover, require at least their head to initiate the summoning, as without it the ghost will be unable to think.
objects.title: (Thinker) Ghostmates

objects.text: When your eyes are shut, or blinding in some way, you can predict the movement of objects in a large area around yourself. Spending longer with your eyes shut allows you to look further into the future.
objects.title: (Thinker) Sightless Predictions

objects.text: You are a Combat Thinker, specializing in the role of a one-(wo)man army, excelling in both one-on-one and one-against-many combat scenarios. Your ability to anticipate actions before they occur enables you to perform mind-boggling feats of finesse and skill. Among those who rely on conventional methods, you are considered the pinnacle of combat prowess including tactics, strategy and skills, making even individuals like Uber and Victor appear somewhat gimmicky in comparison. Additionally, you attain a nominal level of fitness (if you don't already possess it or a superior level) and an understanding of how to best train and maintain your body health.
objects.title: (Thinker) Precognitive Combat

objects.text:
When it comes to any mundane scientific or mechanical skill, or understanding of theoretical knowledge, you are unmatched. Your comprehension and expertise are always equal to, if not greater than, that of any other human on the planet.

This ability grants you the equivalent skill level of the foremost expert in any given scientific or mechanical discipline, as well as an equivalent understanding of any scientific or mechanical theorem, approaching the level of omnicompetence.

Furthermore, your expertise is not dependent on the existence of others. If the leading expert in a particular field or the person with the deepest understanding of a theorem were to pass away, you would retain your unparalleled skill and knowledge.
objects.title: (Thinker) Renaissance Man

objects.text:
This power turns you into a combat savant. When in battle, your mind makes multiple connections a second, taking into account your opponents' positions, your own weapons, their weapons, their likely future actions according to their body movements, and which course of action is likely to end in their defeat. While this accelerates your own perception while in combat, enough to keep up with your deductions and allows you to predict your enemies' actions to a point, these are all things you'd be capable of doing mundanely; this power simply makes this prediction faster and more intuitive.

However, whereas mundane folk would hit a plateau in skill at some point, you don't.

Every fight will allow you to make more connections; while this increase in skill is most noticeable at the start, where it might only take you a few fights to go from a complete novice with a weapon to an expert, you'll learn more complex, inventive, and efficient ways to use them as you fight and keep fighting. Some of that expertise would also carry over to other weapons, like using bladed weapons, allowing you to learn a sword faster. Yet this isn't limited to weapons; you'll get better at using your own body, powers, environment, and even other people, whether it's your allies or enemies. As you keep fighting with or against the same ones, you'll rapidly become more proficient in working together with them or putting them down quickly. And just like with weapons, you'll be able to carry some, if not most, tricks you learn against one opponent to another.

This would turn you into a decent combatant when you're new to this power, into someone as skilled as John Wick with a few dozen fights and would make people wonder whether you've got a power that makes you know the steps necessary to end any fight, once you've survived north of a hundred. While this assists you in combat, you’ll have to learn diplomacy on your own if you wish to end fights non-violently, though.

Less violent types of combat, like games, also benefit from this power somewhat, but this mostly serves to help you take notice of the behaviors and tells of your opponents; how useful this will prove depends entirely on what kind of game it is.
objects.title: (Thinker) Combat Savant

objects.text:
The ability to adapt your skills from one field to another is among the most valuable talents a person can have, a talent you have in spades it seems.

What this power offers is threefold. First and perhaps the most immediately apparent, is that all your skills will grow to match the greatest among your repertoire. Moreover, any improvements to your skill in any skill will also improve your skills in every other field. This applies to every skill you try your hand at.

If you had been a world-renowned chef you could pick up a gun and land a bullseye on a standard target as easy as it would be to dice some onions, even if you had never picked up a gun before.

An expert video gamer who’s never bothered to run would find himself capable of scaling up a building like he’d been practicing parkour his entire life.

The second effect is more passive, your mind immediately learns to adapt existing skills to improve one another across any field.

As the third effect, you’ve gained the power to shift your body’s physical form to reflect different skill sets. The physical body can only adapt to the level of the skill set you are utilizing. You can freely shift back to your normal form at will, you’ll retain your level of skill however your performance may suffer as your body is not at the optimal level to perform alongside your skill.
objects.title: (Thinker/Brute) Transferable Skills

objects.text:
You have a healing hand… a therapeutic touch, you could say. 

You understand people’s traumas, hang-ups, and generally their mental state (intuitively and academically) while being capable of remediating or advising them with therapeutic strategies, knowing how to help people open up, and guiding them to deal with their problems. 

If that isn’t enough, a touch (or a slap, that works, too!) implements this process altogether: healthy coping mechanisms, a new perspective on themselves, a possibility of self-awareness and self-reflection, only years of appointments can do to a person all in one helping hand. 

It doesn’t change the contents or essence of a person, but rather changes a person’s outlook or perspective on their life, putting them on a path of healing and giving them the tools for a better road.
objects.title: (Thinker/Master) TLC

objects.text: Provided you either know what something or someone looks like or can get an accurate description or name, you can immediately pinpoint where it is and can figure out the quickest and/or easiest way to get there.
objects.title: (Thinker) Tracker

objects.text: You can see five visions that start the moment you begin the vision to five minutes later, each with a different choice you choose before starting the vision, and can choose which route you wish to take. You cannot use this power in the visions, and you have to choose one of the routes. You can end a vision early. If you encounter a blindspot you'll snap out of your visions and you'll be where you started.
objects.title: (Thinker) Schrödinger

addons.text: When individuals are connected through the network hub, the effects of the skill/sense share do not degrade with distance like they normally would. In addition, this also grants a limited abilty to telepathically speak to one another.
addons.title: Networked Networking

addons.text: Individuals within the network continue to build upon their skills and experience, their own skills and experience interacting and fusing with the skills and experience of the network, forming something new. With the constant growth and exchange of skills and knowledge in your network, you have the potential to continually improve your abilities and find new ways to apply them. Over time, you may develop ways to work around power limitations or discover new applications for your powers, expanding your repertoire and increasing your effectiveness in combat or other tasks. This growth does not increase the raw strength or power of your abilities, but rather improving the user's ability to use them skillfully and effectively.
addons.title: Interconnected Networking

addons.text: The network has mutated in an interesting way, individuals within it have become even more closely connected. The network's mutated state has allowed for the sharing of memories, thoughts, and experiences among all connected minds, creating a collective consciousness that enables everyone to act as one cohesive unit. This new level of coordination has made it possible to learn skills and abilities at an unprecedented rate, and it has also increased the efficiency of communication and teamwork within the network. The more members or clones that join the network, the greater the potential for rapid learning and skill acquisition, as the collective knowledge and expertise of the network becomes available to all.
addons.title: Hive Network

addons.text:
You can sew your own limbs onto other people. These limbs are fully controllable by the recipient and gives them access to your network of skills. Depending on how "fresh" the limb is, the skills will be sharper and more well-honed and the limb stronger and more responsive. As it rots, the limb grows weaker and sluggish and their connection to the network will weaken. You can't make someone worse at something they were skilled in this way. Repeated use will cause the recipient to slowly accumulate the common skills that the limbs have. 

Additionally, they will gain the ability to make other people into secondary nodes for their own personal network. All the skills in the personal network can be accessed by you, but the secondary nodes are unable to access the main network. This personal network will start weakening as the limb rots.
addons.title: Living Dead Men

objects.text:
With a single touch, you can connect people to your network, allowing them to draw power and knowledge from the collective. Each individual becomes a node in the network, pooling their skills and senses to form a powerful force. Senses include but not limited to: spatial awareness, power granted senses, ordinary 5 senses, and more. Those in the network also gain a minor multitasking ability so that they can make use of the additional senses with no problems.

There is a limitation, the effectiveness of the connection gradually weakens as the individual moves further away from other members of the network. As a result, it becomes harder for individuals to access the shared skills and senses, and vice versa.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Networking

addons.text: Now it doesn’t matter how long the target has been dead, you can gain the skills regardless.
addons.title: Inheritance

addons.text: You gain more than just the skills of the deceased, instead you gain all of their memories. Be warned that if done multiple times without a break, your personality can be overwritten unless you have a very strong will and sense of self.
addons.title: Embodiment

addons.text: You not only gain all the skills of the deceased but also their memories as well, taking them upon yourself. You can now mantle the identity of the deceased, becoming them in the truest sense yet never losing yourself in the act, maintaining the core of your identity.
addons.title: Mantling

objects.text:
You can permanently gain the skills of the recently deceased near you. As long as they died no longer than a day ago, you can absorb all the skills they possessed in life. You will also gain snippets of memories related to those skills.

Note that you will gain all of the deceased’s skills at once; for ordinary people, this will prove a nonissue, but for certain capes, such as Victor, you may find yourself having a thinker headache after gaining all his skills.
objects.title: (Thinker) Flatline

objects.text: Anyone within a 50 feet radius will be known. This can range from armed intruders to Strangers, within your range, you can spot them and know the exact details of what they have on them. You can also attach your power to an object or building and sense whenever someone tries to get inside even if you're not there.
objects.title: (Thinker) Landlord

objects.text: You can gain a third-person view of anyone you know the appearance of. You must know at least what their face looks like without any kind of mask but you can spy on them regardless of where they are. You can choose to spy on yourself to grant yourself limited clairvoyance of your surroundings.
objects.title: (Thinker) Dreamer

objects.text: You can read the history of any object the is personally/emotionally valuable to someone.
objects.title: (Thinker) Retroactive Empath

objects.text:
With a single touch, you can steal the memories of others, taking it for yourself. Those that you steal from will lose these memories forever. Your mind has been reinforced, able to distinguish which memories are yours and which are not, though you can be temporarily overwhelmed if you take on too many at once.

A minor aspect of this power is that you'll be able to get a minor affinity for skills from the memories of people you steal from; nothing exceedingly major, just some minor instincts from the memories you plunder.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) Mind Plunderer

addons.text:
You can see more than just emotional and mental weak points, you can see physical weak points as well. With but a glance you know just where to strike to cause maximum physical damage to your target, seeing all the imperfections and flaws which can be leveraged to destroy all that you desire. 

Furthermore, you are no longer restricted to seeing the weak points of living beings, your gaze can unveil the flaws of inanimate objects as well, such a revealing just where to strike to bring a building collapsing down.
addons.title: Flaws of Creation

objects.text: With a single glance you can tell all of a person's mental and emotional weak points. This doesn't help you leverage them.
objects.title: (Thinker) Snap

objects.text: You know when you're being directly observed and can counter-observe the target. If they are listening in on you, you can listen in on them. If they are using a power, you can counter-observe them as well.
objects.title: (Thinker) Anti-Monitor

objects.text: You can parry any form of attack, or attempt to do so, with whatever is on hand. Responding to attacks either precognitively or reflexively should they ignore precognition. However, it does not actually speed you up to successfully block. Your body will react in a way that causes the least amount of harm to you.
objects.title: (Thinker) Parry

objects.text: You can cause any projectile/thrown object/Blaster power to ricochet unrealistically off surfaces to hit targets. You can make bullets ricochet off 10 different surfaces before accurately hitting the weak spot of something.
objects.title: (Thinker/Blaster) Ricochet

objects.text:
You can see a second layer of reality. This reality is a mirror of the true reality but distorted by emotions and past actions. You can see actions that have happened in an area, to a limited degree, see the mental state of a person in physical form, and hear the true feelings and thoughts of people around you unfiltered. 

When looking at an office worker, you may see a distorted version of them, where they are skinny and half dead, overworked. When looking at a murder scene you may see puddles of blood that aren’t there. When someone is talking, you do not hear what they say, but what they feel and think is unfiltered. Your eyes are open and you see the world for what it truly is. You and anyone else who has this power is immune to the distortion in the second reality, thus appearing as yourselves. 

You can toggle this on and off.
objects.title: (Thinker) Twisted World

objects.text:
You can 'pause' time and enter your own mindscape dimension, where you have god-like control, able to alter, modify, and create as you wish. Your thoughts, feelings, senses, and more are stored as books in your mind to an inhuman degree after minimal exposure. Inside your simulated mind, you can still view the outside world, but it will appear 'paused.'

Additionally, you can simulate different scenarios, practice skills, and interact with the stored books of thoughts and memories, allowing for cross-referencing information and solving complex problems. You can process information and think at incredible speeds, analyzing and coming to conclusions at an unprecedented rate. Your perfect memory enables you to read entire pages of text with just a glance and learn at an incredible pace. With some training, you'll even be able to cold read people on the same level as Alexandria.

You cannot modify your intelligence or thought process inside or using the mindscape. The dimension resets after each use, ensuring a fresh start every time.
objects.title: (Thinker) Mental Faculty

addons.text:
The presence of skilled individuals accelerates your own growth far beyond what direct learning or theft alone would permit.

Whenever someone within your vicinity possesses notable proficiency in a skill, discipline, or field of expertise, your ability to improve in related areas gains a passive multiplier proportional to the breadth, depth, and uniqueness of their mastery. Greater experts provide stronger acceleration, while groups with overlapping but distinct competencies can compound this effect.

This does not require active theft. Merely existing near capable individuals causes your training efficiency to increase, as your mind unconsciously compares, extrapolates, and optimizes against nearby standards of performance. Their presence continues to improve your growth rate beyond the copied baseline.
addons.title: On the Shoulders of Giants

objects.text:
You are able to master any skill or field of endeavor at an unparalleled pace and continue growing beyond conventional limits. Within days of study or practice, you can achieve the proficiency of professionals, and within a week, ascend to the ranks of experts. Though your growth slows as you approach mastery, your superhuman learning ability ensures continuous and noticeable improvement with sustained effort. For perspective, your training efficiency is such that hours of focused practice equate to months of typical learning.

This only affects your skills, not inherent attributes like strength or energy reserves. However, your potential for skill acquisition and refinement is virtually limitless, as you possess perfect technical retention and flawless execution. Once learned, your skills never degrade, and you always perform at your peak.

Moreover, your capabilities allow you to push skills to superhuman levels. You can achieve feats such as mastering echolocation to navigate blindfolded or manipulating your organs to avoid critical injuries during combat. While this supernatural skill offers incredible potential, it still operates within the realm of possibilities, so learning to fly would be impossible.

Lastly, you gain an acute awareness of errors during any task, recognizing mistakes as they occur and ensuring they are never repeated.
objects.title: (Thinker) Enhanced Mastery

objects.text:
You are able to observe the future with perfect certainty. By focusing your thoughts on a specific moment and event, you can project your awareness forward in time to witness it as a disembodied, invisible presence. You view the event from above, unable to interact or influence what you see.

What you witness in these visions is guaranteed to occur. The people and actions within the event will unfold exactly as seen. However, your perspective is limited: you do not receive context before the event begins, nor do you witness what happens afterward.

Despite the certainty of the event itself, factors surrounding it remain fluid. The cause of the event, its consequences, and the reasons behind each action are all changeable. You can’t alter the event you’ve seen directly, but the surrounding narrative is malleable. By acting on what you’ve learned or preparing for the exact moment, you can shift the world around the moment you observed, changing what leads to it or what comes after.

Once you observe a specific moment in time, you are temporarily locked out of viewing other moments in that area or timeframe. Until the vision has fully played out in real time, you are blind to anything nearby in both space and chronology. Attempting to see other points close to the one you’ve already seen will result in a blank void. Beyond that limitation, you may explore the timeline freely, skipping to other places and distant futures as your focus and curiosity allow.
objects.title: (Thinker) Canon Event

addons.text: Through iterative practice and refinement, much like a Tinker iterating on their technology, you can gradually internalise the techniques from Martial Adept into your Martial Arts kinetic blueprints, causing your Shard to treat them as natural movements rather than external channeled abilities, with the process requiring you to execute the technique repeatedly while your Shard observes and rewrites your muscle memory over weeks or months. Once internalised, you can perform that technique using only your Martial Arts power, meaning it no longer draws from your Martial Adept energy reserve and can be executed as fluidly as any other combat move your Shard has installed. Self-enhancement techniques can be internalise with moderate effort over months, but techniques that project energy externally such as blasts, barriers, constructs, or elemental effects are significantly harder, akin to a Tinker building outside their specialty, requiring years of dedicated practice or a breakthrough moment like a fugue state to convert, and even then the internalised version may suffer reduced range, area, or power compared to the fueled original.
addons.title: Martial Master

objects.text:
Like a Tinker carries blueprints for impossible devices in their head, you carry kinetic blueprints. These are complete instructions for combat movement, katas, and response chains that your Shard generates and installs directly into your muscle memory. Visually speaking, you look like you jumped straight out of a kung-fu movie.

The martial arts you perform may have passing resemblance to real world styles but they are original creations generated by your Shard. Your Shard draws from human fighting history as raw inspiration, then warps it through alien logic to produce movements that are slightly more effective than they should be, much like Tinkertech cheats physics. A straight punch might generate far more force than your muscle mass should allow while a joint lock might hold despite your opponent being twice as strong. 

Like Tinkertech, these effects are blackboxed. Others cannot learn these techniques because the move relies on countless Shard assisted cheats that cannot be replicated by normal human instruction. Much like a tech tree, as you build a stronger physique and greater skill depth, you unlock progressively more advanced techniques that require prerequisite skills to use, each new technique stronger than the last.

You also have your own tinker fugue, usually triggered by extreme stress. Your conscious mind steps back and your Shard puts you in a state of extreme focus and inspiration. This lets your instincts take over, moving with far greater power and skill than you normally output. You ignore pain and fatigue completely while your Shard invents entirely new katas on the fly, using sequences you have never seen before. In this state you automatically target anything you even subconsciously consider dangerous. The fugue typically lasts thirty seconds, although it can be lengthened if a fight hasn’t ended, after which you wake up, without memory of the fugue.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) Martial Arts

objects.text:
You have a tremendous intuition for social dynamics that grows sharper, deeper, and more reliable as the scale of the systems involved grow larger. This is highly-effective for large organizations, spectacular for media ecosystems, and nearly precognitive when applied to entire cultures or economies. You could flawlessly predict all the results of an upcoming election from a pile of recent magazines, outpredict Number Man at the stock market, or engineer shifts in public consciousness powerful enough to spark nation-wide riots. Organizations that earn your ire might find their internal culture splintering into factions at the same time that public interest in their activities inexplicably wanes, all while fighting off seemingly unshakable PR disasters.

You aren't truly precognitive and your manipulations are far from absolute. For one, you require reliable information to work with, though passive cultural osmosis can do a lot of the groundwork when it comes to the big picture. If you want to truly understand a particular organization expect to spend some time digging through old memos or listening in on interpersonal chatter, and even then you can still be thrown off course by major disruptions, like natural disasters, sudden public revelations, or miraculous scientific breakthroughs.

Like Accord, you're also limited by the willingness of others to follow your instructions. Although the power of a few well-placed phone calls should never be underestimated, you're most effective when you already have organizations at your command or networks of contacts to act through, since the sort of influence you can exert as an individual isn't your power's forte.

This power includes an acute but limited intuition for the behavior of individuals, primarily focused on how they fit into and respond to the cultures around them.
objects.title: (Thinker/Master) Zeitgeist

objects.text:
By touching someone you can permanently use any of their senses, including Parahuman senses.
This works on animals, humans, Parahumans, Endbringers, and Entities.
objects.title: (Thinker) My Eyes are Your Eyes

addons.text: It seems like your danger sense isn't limited to danger anymore, but to everything. You could sense an object you will need in the future, sense the fake doppelganger between 2 individuals who look the same, sense what buttons to press to gain access to a computer, sense someone following you, and more.
addons.title: General Sense

objects.text: You gain a vague sense that can instinctively inform you of various dangers and threats. You can instinctively sense all kinds of things such as poisonous gas, Shaker effects, traps, lies, and even hidden things. The greater the danger the more foreboding it is. The closer it is to the present, the more accurate it is.
objects.title: (Thinker) Danger Sense

objects.text: You possess unparalleled precision in your actions. Every movement you execute goes precisely where it is intended, with the ideal amount of force required for the task. You possess an innate understanding and control of your bodily functions and operations, including every autonomic function, like your organs (heart, liver, and intestine), individual muscle fibres, hormonal production and regulation, and mental and neural processes, with absolute precision.
objects.title: (Thinker) Discombobulate

objects.text:
You can create filters to see the world through. In practice what this does is it allows you to assign visual filters, which are expressed as colors that can manifest in any multitude of ways. The filters can be for anything you can imagine and can be altered at any time.

Filter for “danger” and assign it with the color red, and you’ll soon start to notice a clearly visible, only to you, sign on anything that could be a danger to you.

Smoky trails into rooms that foreshadow danger, a stock's ticker is soft red before you buy it, a random person on the street is flashing in bright red warning you of a killer in plain clothes, etc.

Likewise, you can also assign things such as “success” to the color green, numbers highlighted in green as you fill out a lottery ticket, a smoky trail leading somewhere, and the correct wire to defuse a bomb highlighting a bright and unmistakable neon green.

The more vivid the colors, the closer to your assigned filter it matches. Despite however many filters you assign or however you choose to manifest it, it’ll never actually deter your normal vision, still being fully aware of what your normal visual input would show. You can assign as many filters as you want, as broad or specific as you want, and can reassign colors and how that manifests at will.
objects.title: (Thinker) Filter

objects.text:
You constantly see 10 seconds into the future. You also possess a secondary multi-tasking thinker ability that allows your perception to seamlessly process both your normal vision and your future sight at the same time, ensuring this duality doesn’t interfere with the natural flow of your body’s movements or actions.

You can turn this vision off at will, but it'll turn back on if you're going to get seriously injured within the next ten seconds.
objects.title: (Thinker) Glimpse

addons.text:
The deep understanding you have of your allies is complemented and amplified by your sensory network. Each of you can effortlessly correlate all the data it provides, building a flawless mental model of how the different sensory streams relate and contextualizing each through the powerful insights provided by Ninshú. The result: perfect synchronicity, as every movement, reflex, and observation is broadcast across the network faster than any individual can even process their own intentions.

You move as one, with instant comprehension of your allies' every involuntary twitch. You can even intuit the observations or decisions they'll make from the sensory data you share, outpacing them to their own conclusions. This creates a feedback loop, where your thoughts and actions are felt by your allies with more clarity and decisiveness than you can muster on your own, while this comprehension is mirrored back to you nearly instantly. 

From an external perspective, your unit moves with March- or Number-Man-like coordination, albeit with less individual efficiency.

This full effect requires that none of you censor any data from the network; even the smallest omissions can cause rapid fall offs in effectiveness. On the other hand, if you can manage to subsume your enemies in your network without leaking your own insights back to them, you can turn the effect around, countering their actions with seemingly precognitive decisiveness.
addons.title: Together as One

objects.text:
You can link to anything and anyone within a 100-meter radius. Everyone you link with also gains a link to one another, even if you were to add more later on.

Everyone linked to one another develops a deep and incredible understanding of each other, allowing them to understand and share feelings, insights, intentions, and experiences without a word.

This connection will persist even after they leave your range, and will allow you to communicate with one another even from afar without any difficulties. You’ll each be immediately notified when and if someone in your connection is in danger.

The effects are greatly magnified when in physical contact, allowing you to view and understand another’s entire life with a single brief touch.

This can also be manipulated to be one way by any member, allowing a method of simply transferring information if a member wishes, such as teaching another member a language they know, allowing them to not share other information with another if they choose not to.

As you are the center for this, you can choose to exclude some or to excise them from your group at will. Others cannot prevent you from viewing any information at will, and you can pass this ability to bypass information denial to other members.
objects.title: (Thinker) Ninshú

objects.text:
You have a Thinker power that gives you an instinctive ability to act charismatically, navigate social situations, and understand the feelings of others. This is enhanced by a subtle Master power that acts without your conscious control to influence those you interact with. In everyday situations, this leads to small nudges to smooth social interactions in your favor, over time making those you become close to devoted to you. During higher-stakes interactions, it can trade some subtlety for a stronger effect.

You also have an instinctive knowledge of the positioning of people in your vicinity.
objects.title: (Thinker/Master) Indoctrination Is Friendship

objects.text: You can tell prophecies in the form of poems that can tell the future. These futures can be changed. If it’s somebody who hasn’t heard the prophecy tries to change it, it will happen regardless of their interference. This power's only blindspot is your home universe, but when talking about the Entity or Endbringers, it will be murkier than usual.
objects.title: (Thinker) Oracle of Delphi

objects.text:
Upon entering combat, you create a temporal “lock,” anchoring your consciousness to that moment. If you die, time rewinds to the instant the lock was formed, allowing you to attempt the fight again with full awareness of past failures. This reset occurs endlessly, granting infinite retries. However, the trauma of each death accumulates, with pain, fear, and mental exhaustion compounding over time. There is no reprieve between loops; the moment you die, you are immediately thrust back into battle, with no opportunity for rest or recovery for your mind.

The lock remains active until you either emerge victorious or successfully disengage from combat. If you are caught in a surprise attack, you can still be killed outright. However, if you survive the initial attack, the lock will form at that exact moment—meaning every reset will return you to the instant you first endured the ambush.
objects.title: (Thinker) I’ve Come to Bargain

addons.text: Landing an attack on a physical weak spot will now be a guaranteed crit. You have a 77% chance to do double damage, 10% for triple, 8% to quadruple, and 5% to do 10x damage.
addons.title: Critical Weakspot!

addons.text: You know where they bleed the most, now. Your counter-defensive and counter-offensive Thinker powers fuel your awareness, once more: you grasp your opponent's weak points, deficiencies on their footing, fighting style, the environment's weak links, and how to leverage it in 1.5 seconds without any loss in traction.
addons.title: Heart Playstyle

objects.text: You know the weakness of anyone or anything you see. You don't necessarily know how to leverage that weakness, though. For example, when looking at Alexandria you'll see that she's vulnerable to drowning, but won't know how to actually drown her.
objects.title: (Thinker) Weakspot

objects.text: If you were to take an object from another person without their explicit permission, you can not only utilize said object masterfully, but you can also increase the effectiveness of the object. The more the owner of the object wants it back, the better the effectiveness gets.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) Theft

addons.text: The possible movements, courses of action, and interplays are open to your mind's eye. You will now possess an intuitive awareness of your movement and its consequences when 'paused', now knowing which road's a dead end or a chance for the taking under the 1.5-second window. Your "branching" and "collapsing" maneuverability is more fluid and coordinated than before, instantly understanding the most effective path while overwhelming an opponent with consecutively "canceling" motion after motion without any loss of momentum.
addons.title: Brain Playstyle

objects.text:
At any time, you can ‘pause’ time from your perspective, rendering both yourself and others unable to move.
