From this position, you can choose to undertake one simple physical action taking no more than one and a half seconds, such as throwing a punch, jumping, running a predetermined distance, or using another power. Following this decision, you are locked into performing the action to its completion, at which point time will freeze again and you can take another action as before. If you are interrupted while taking the action, time will only ‘pause’ again when you would have ‘paused’ before had the action completed as intended

You can return to normal time at any point.
objects.title: (Thinker) Your Only Move

objects.text: You can perceive how things are “broken” and then know how to repair or fix them. This applies to anything “broken”, from non-functioning appliances, inactive tinkertech, damaged psyches, or societal problems. As with any problem or "broken" thing, it takes time and dedication for you to find a solution, with the problem's scale and reach proportional to the time you take to solve and "fix" it.
objects.title: (Thinker) Mr(s). Fixit

addons.text: "Give me a minute, I'm good. If I've got an hour, I'm great. You give me six months? I'm unbeatable." You have the strategic and sometimes unorthodox ability and resourcefulness of John "Hannibal" Smith, leader of the A-Team. You can adapt to any situation and free yourself from dangers by using what is available to you. Just like Hannibal, you nearly always have an equally crazy and brilliant plan that gets the goals of the mission done.
addons.title: I Love it When a Plan Comes Together

objects.text: You are amazing at making plans. However, the longer term and more complicated the plan you want to make, the longer it takes to make the plan. If your plan is going to take a whole century to complete, or is very complicated, it might take years for you to complete your plan. A somewhat complex plan that lasts a week will only take a couple of hours. This power does not make you OCD.
objects.title: (Thinker) Plans within Plans

objects.text: You are capable of viewing the past with perfect clarity, with the typical Shard blindspots. This can be directed at a specific person that has been in your line of sight or a location that you have been at, within the past day. Time can be slowed down, paused, or sped up during this viewing.
objects.title: (Thinker) Past Sight

addons.text: You may also use any of your abilities anywhere within your sphere of influence, acting as if you are there at any point within your sphere.
addons.title: Sphere of Influence

objects.text:
You can create invisible tags anywhere within either your line of sight or by touch.

Within a 50-meter radius of your tags, you have a form of omniscience—able to garner any kind of information within that sphere, whether you wish to receive it as a form of sight, sound, or simple clairvoyance.

You can access the full stream of information without any kind of information overload.

Moreover, you can teleport anywhere you wish within that sphere, able to manifest yourself at will there. You can garner information from outside the sphere, but only by way of using your senses to pick up anything that they would have by the edge of the sphere.

Tags can be placed on locations, rendering them unmoving, or to objects or people, allowing you to create potentially moving spheres of influence. You can have as many tags as you want.
objects.title: (Thinker/Mover) Sphere of Insight
(Thinker/Trump) Smartest Person In The Room
objects.text:
Whenever a Thinker enters within a range of roughly 100 meters from you, you will gain access to their power. This not only feeds you the information their power is currently sending them, but also grants you a copy of it to use on your own. You have an increased ability to multitask and manage information as to not get overwhelmed.

Your power also does this to a lesser extent for mundane knowledge, as when you encounter a situation it will feed you knowledge from the people within range to help you solve it. Both Thinker powers and this knowledge are slowly lost over the minutes following their source leaving your range.

Friendly reminder: Contessa is a blindspot to Thinkers. This power is no exception.

You’re great at simulating things. A quick glance at your surroundings gets you a flawless simulation of the next 10 seconds, as well as a flawless simulation of the past 10 seconds. The further into the future/past you look, the less accurate the simulations get. The more information you have about your surroundings and other variables, the more accurately you can simulate the future or past.
objects.title: (Thinker) Laplace Demon

objects.text: You can retrieve your memories from the future until the next point you either die or run into a blindspot.
objects.title: (Thinker) Respawn

objects.text:
You have the incredible power of Path To Victory! But only for getting object A to point B. You can choose a subject/group of subjects (it must be an actual physical thing, you can't run a “Path to bring good fortune to me” or anything similarly abstract) and a position to take it to, at which then your power will give you a step-by-step precognitive guide towards getting the target to its location in the most efficient way possible, with the power guiding your body to perfectly perform the actions required.

When setting your paths, the target location must be a real thing and not too vague (no “path to bringing my opponents to death” or “path to a place/person that will help me succeed”), although it can be moving, and you don't need to know where exactly it is i.e “Path to get on to that train” or “Path to the nearest grocery store” are both valid paths.

Your path automatically defaults to ensuring the safety of the object being transported as much as is physically possible while still moving it. However, you can toggle this protection off for a more efficient path.

You are also capable of dictating specific routings for your path such as “Path to getting there stealthily” or “Path to the most dramatic entrance”.

Keep in mind that even with these restrictions, you can still pull off some less obvious paths like “Path to getting this bullet into their head” or “Path to getting this villain to prison” (the path doesn't ensure that the villain will necessarily stay in said prison, just that they’ll get there).
objects.title: (Thinker/Mover) Pathfinder

objects.text: That which holds an image of an Angel, Becomes itself an Angel Any image of yourself—whether it's a drawing, photograph, statue, reflection, or any other representation—is connected to you. You have the ability to perceive through these images and even transform them into physical manifestations of yourself. The closer the image resembles you in detail and accuracy, the less effort it requires to convert it into a fully functional clone. For example, a life-sized statue of yourself can easily be animated into what is essentially a perfect replica, with minimal strain and limitation. On the other hand, a simple printed photograph of you would be more challenging to transform into a clone, requiring greater effort and potentially resulting in a less stable copy. These clones all have your powers, acting as extensions of your will. If your original body were to be destroyed, your consciousness would automatically transfer to one of your existing images, allowing you to survive as long as any depiction of you remains. Through these clones, you can continue to interact with the world, effectively making you immortal as long as there are images of you in existence.
objects.title: (Thinker/Master) Self Image

addons.text: (Thinker) Time-Loop has fused with (Thinker/Trump) Glass Cannon, making it so that instead of "precognitive simulations", you are genuinely going back in time. This removes your thinker headaches allowing you to die and reset as many times as you wish. Do note however that the less time in between your deaths and the lower the variance in your death the weaker the abilities gained becomes, so try not to die too many times in one go.
addons.title: Looping Hourglass

objects.text:
Having the power of “coming back” from death, and getting stronger from your untimely end seems like a worthwhile power, aside from the necessity of “dying” time and time again for it to work. Unfortunately, this isn’t a simple “get stronger quick” scheme rolled into a power. 

Let me explain: As opposed to truly dying and then returning to the point of time before your death, you experience precognitive simulations of the future timelines à la Coil. These keep going until your “death”, which you then go back to a place in time where your safety point is. Hell, you could use this aspect as information gathering from several timelines you only shut down with your… willingness, in sensible terms, with each try experiencing growing thinker headaches until you can’t anymore. 

A second facet of this is every time you “die” in a conflict or obstacle to overcome, you gain offensive abilities addressing said circumstances to deal with them next. Hell, you can gain power expressions from parahuman powers that got the better of you with a solely offensive spin. A downside of diminishing returns each time you “die” from the same parahuman power, starting strong yet weaker from the original, only to trickle down to a crawl in strength gain.

This goes back to the power’s title and concept: it turns you into a Glass Cannon (an RPG archetype centered on offense without defense to compensate; hits hard, dies easily) for the power’s function, which means you’ll never get any defensive abilities or power expressions from your “deaths”. 

Another limitation of this is the limited frequency of your “deaths” until you growingly suffer Thinker headaches. 

Note: Offensive abilities range from physical enhancements sans durability, and skills geared to inflict more damage, such as weapon handling or unarmed hand-to-hand combat.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Glass Cannon
(Thinker/Trump) Nikke
objects.text:
Your Shard deals with Shard communication similarly to Jack Slash, providing a keen awareness and insight against capes that’s expressed by scheming and devising plans unable to be outmaneuvered or beaten by other parahumans.

Working by granting a supernatural instinct when it comes to Parahuman conflict and being deeply aware of the Parahuman condition through a psychological and sociological lens, including an intuitive awareness of what drives capes, enough to intuit hints of their Trigger Event, and more. For example, fashioning several layers from an overarching scheme made of short-term ploys by second-rate proxies that would spiral into a sweeping city gang clean-up; your planning capability when it comes to your brethren is almost unparalleled, working best under high stakes.

When put on the spot, you’ll promptly dodge attacks from the most powerful of Strangers, Thinkers guessing what you want them to see, while your power subtly nudges parahuman powers, e.g., redirecting or weakening any or some Blaster or Shaker attacks away before impact. It’ll almost be unnoticeable to some, while in other cases it’ll be blatantly obvious in grueling conflicts where your opponent has no choice but to put two and two together.

In these cases, your Shard will actively start to pilot your body to accomplish these feats, doing so to thwart any Thinker probing, such as Tattletale or Armsmaster’s lie detector, from any suspicion.

It’s not all sunshine and rainbows, though; while your powers allow you to be the victor against any Parahuman and leave with no scratch, there’ll be cases where it’ll simply ensure survival. Contessa, Jack Slash, Eidolon, Endbringers, Scion—none of them would kill you if your sole goal is surviving to tell the tale. Battered, broken, almost at death’s door, but alive.

Of course, any normal person with a gun and a grudge, a twist of fate, and so on are still capable of killing you pretty well, so best be careful.

addons.title: Checkmate
addons.text: Strategizing around Parahumans never felt so easy. Your charisma and parahuman talent for navigating social situations make interactions with capes smooth, giving you the charm to dance around them, know the right words to say, and create an air of invincibility.

objects.text: When you touch someone, you can mark them. But touching that mark again, you can apply several effects on them ranging from: paralyzing them for 15 minutes, putting them to sleep, or dulling their senses. The power’s effects are amplified if the second touch is a punch or kick. This power works through thin gloves. The mark fades after 12 hours.
objects.title: (Striker) Knockout

addons.text: While the maximum duration limit remains the same, you no longer have to set a predetermined duration of how long the object will remain phased out of reality. You can now instead choose to set a trigger that will cause the object to appear prematurely, just like in Shaker (Alarm).
addons.title: Trigger

objects.text: You may temporarily teleport any object into the future by holding it for a duration. The object is not moved spatially, but will temporarily disappear for a duration equal to how long you held it for. Until it reappears, time will not pass from the perspective of the object. You may not teleport living beings.
objects.title: (Striker) Futureport

addons.text: The marks you leave can transmit your pain touch to a lesser extent. Upon striking a mark a second time you can cause somebody to be wreathed in full body agony for 15 minutes.
addons.title: Persistant Ache

addons.text: You can choose to cause total numbness instead of pain, or any variation in-between. This also allows you to do things such as make it so only pain can be felt in an area. This numbness doesn't inhibit motor control.
addons.title: Numbing

objects.text: You can cause people extreme pain with your touch. You can choose which 'kind' of pain, such as burning, itching, aching, ect. This pain fades over the course of a few minutes after contact, and if contact is held for more than a second it can reach the maximum local saturation of pain that can be felt in an area, and begin to radiate beyond the point of contact.
objects.title: (Striker) Gympie-Gympie

addons.text: You can vibrate the energy of the blade itself at extreme speeds, adding a cutting edge that greatly enhances its power. By vibrating the blade at supersonic frequencies, you drastically increase its ability to slice through materials, making it capable of piercing esoteric materials that would ordinarily be resistant to physical attacks. The vibrating edge creates a faint hum in the air, alerting those with keen senses, but remaining invisible to the eye.
addons.title: Vibroblade

objects.text: By extending your hand flat, an invisible blade of force materializes around it. This blade is imperceptible, giving the illusion that your hand itself slices through objects effortlessly. While the blade can easily cut through most ordinary materials—such as wood, fabric, flesh, and even thin metals—its effectiveness is limited by the natural durability of your hand. If your hand cannot withstand the material or force of impact, the blade will fail, potentially injuring you in the process.
objects.title: (Striker) Blade Hands

objects.text:
You can now land critical hits, doing massive damage! The damage varies depending on your luck: 20% chance to do double damage, 3% chance to triple, 1.5% chance to quadruple, and 0.5% to do 10x damage. If you haven't landed a critical hit after 10 attacks, the next one will be guaranteed to crit. This "pity critical," if you will, will only deal double damage though.

All forms of attack qualify for critical hits.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Critical Hit!

objects.text:
You are able to selectively swap the regions of space between your hands. Your power does not affect anything outside of a 10 cm sphere touching the center of your palms. 

It does not work within living beings, but can affect regions of space that are in contact with them—for example, you could swap a chunk of concrete that your hand is resting on with the space around another’s hand, encasing their hand in concrete. However, you cannot swap the region of space inside their hand, or directly affect any part of their body.
objects.title: (Striker) Swapped Palms

objects.text:
You can deliver kicks with explosive, disproportionate force—far beyond what your physical strength alone should allow. Even casual kicks you land feel like they hit with the force of a sledgehammer. Your most powerful kicks, in ideal conditions, are capable of launching enemies or objects with the momentum and force of a speeding car.

In addition, you also have a subtle control over the trajectory of anything you kick. Whether it’s a person, a projectile, or a loose object, you can influence its direction slightly mid-flight, allowing for surprisingly accurate shots. This effect isn’t precise enough for full guidance, but it’s more than enough to curve a kick just right to catch someone off-guard or redirect a launched object toward a secondary target.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Striker

objects.text: You can form hardlight constructs with just a thought within a meter of yourself, limited to a total of 10m³ of hardlight. Hardlight has the strength of steel, provided you leave it as normal. The greatest advantage of hardlight is that it can imitate other matter, allowing you to create anything. Presuming you know the chemical makeup of the matter you want to imitate, alongside the blueprints of the thing you want to make. Even comes with a complimentary perfect memory to store all your knowledge. Your constructs have no range limit, but it will still count to your hardlight limit until you dispel it.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Hardlight

objects.text: Every attack you make leaves an invisible imprint that repeats the attack after a set delay chosen by you. You cannot change the delay once it is already set.
objects.title: (Striker) Divergent Fist

objects.text: You can clean anything within a five-meter bubble of you and whatever you're directly touching, immediately removing any dust, dirt/mud, oil/grease, non-water fluids, and anything else commonly considered 'filth' from the area of effect. This also extends to some things not typically thought of as filth, such as scorch marks or tarnish on metals, or tire marks on asphalt and concrete. You may choose if removed filth is absorbed by your power or simply displaced to elsewhere.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Cleanse

objects.text: Whenever you touch someone, you can make them forget everything that happened within the last 24 hours.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Forget-me-yes

objects.text:
You can mark up to five people by touching them. This gives them a Stranger aura of 15 feet that they cannot turn off until they touch someone else with the place you touched them, upon which the mark will be placed on the new person instead, and so on and so forth. That is to say, there can only be (at most) 5 people with a mark at any given time. You can take away these marks whenever you wish.

The Stranger aura makes people subconsciously inch away from the target and harbor moderately negative feelings towards the target, which get worse the longer they stay inside the aura. Staying out of the aura will have these effects dissipate over an hour. People who have a mark will be immune to the effects of other people who have the mark.

This can be applied to yourself if a person with a mark touches you. If this happens, you can turn it off, disable the effect, or get rid of it the regular way. You will always know who has a mark at any given time, and how long they've had it.
objects.title: (Striker/Stranger) The Cheese Touch

addons.text: Your limitation on only manifesting “cold” weapons has been lifted, allowing you to manifest modern weapons while retaining the ability to channel your powers through them. However you are still unable to manifest tinkertech weapons unless you have some other way of loosening that limitation. If you possess Bankai? Not Quite then you can manifest more modern forms of armor as well, such as riot gear or specialized infiltration suits.
addons.title: Modern Channeling

objects.text:
You have the power to manifest weapons like Miss Militia, but yours is distinctly different—you are limited to only “cold” weapons, such as swords and spears, with the most advanced being an arbalest. However this is not where your power ends as you are able to “channel” your other powers through the weapons that you create. 

This can have a variety of effects depending on the power; blaster powers can be channeled through a sword to turn a beam into an arcing slash attack, master powers can become “poison” on the tip of an arrow affecting whoever is struck, stranger powers conceal and permeate through weapons making their effects undetectable coming from you, etc.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Did You Say Initial Release?

objects.text:
You can move fast—but only when you’re attacking. Your punches, kicks, and any kind of strike happen at lightning speed, letting you land dozens of hits in just a few seconds. Your limbs become a blur when you’re on the offensive, making it hard for enemies to react or block once you’re within reach. This speed only applies to attacks, making you a serious threat in close combat where every moment counts.

Outside of attacking, you’re stuck at normal human speed. You can’t run faster, dodge quicker, or move around any faster than an average person. This means if someone keeps their distance or tries to outmaneuver you, you can’t rely on your power to catch them or get away. 

Additionally, just because your attacks are fast doesn’t mean they hit hard. Each blow carries only as much force as your normal strength allows—no more than what you’d do at regular speed. A hundred fast punches still hurt like a hundred normal ones, not like being hit by a truck.
objects.title: (Striker/Mover) DPS

objects.text: You are capable of healing people so long as they remain in contact with you. This healing is perfect, albiet slow, regeneration, with you needing to remain in contact with somebody for an hour to regrow a hand. It is fast enough to prevent somebody from bleeding out due to moderate wounds.
objects.title: (Striker) Healing Touch

objects.text: You can restore damaged inanimate objects back to their newest forms. The larger and more complicated an object the longer it takes. Repairing a normal sword can take minutes but Tinker Tech can take hours.
objects.title: (Striker) Renewal

objects.text: You can change the size of any inorganic object you touch, and changes are permanent. The size you can change an object to ranges from the size of an ant to the size of a car, and you cannot affect objects that are already outside this range. Mass is not changed, and you may undo this change at will.
objects.title: (Striker) Change Size

objects.text: You can make a permanent hole through any surface by touching it. It may be of any shape, but the maximum width is 3 meters, and the maximum length is 10 meters. This cannot erase living matter or power-generated matter/energy, such as force fields. You may undo this change at any time, but anything still inside it will meld with resulting matter, so be careful. You can only have one hole active at once, though you can reactivate previous holes without needing to touch their origin again.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Hole

objects.text: You can make it so anything or anyone that touches you over a certain velocity will suddenly lose all their velocity when they touch you. This is automatic.
objects.title: (Striker) Stop!

addons.text: The power of the Crit, in the palm of my hand... You have the ability to stockpile your critical hits just the same as your damage with each strike. When a critical strike would be triggered, the critical is not applied immediately and is instead banked. Upon reaching the 100th strike, or otherwise ending the combo, your critical hits all trigger at once. The critical multipliers are multiplicative with the same level of critical and additive with all others. For example, landing three ×2 Criticals would result in a ×8 Critical, however landing a ×2, ×3, and ×10 result in a ×15, not a ×60. The total Critical Hit multiplier is applied after the combo multiplier from 100th Strike.
addons.title: Nuclear Critical!

objects.text:
All of your attacks only deal 1/100 of the damage they normally would. All of the power that is not dealt is stocked up, and it caps out at 100. When you reach the 100th strike, all of the stockpiled damage is merged, and multiplied by 100 for the final blow. The process then repeats itself after the 100th. You can delay this for as long as you like, but you can only have one 100th strike.

You aren't strictly required to use this power at the 100th blow, you can use this power as low as 2 blows. Remember though, you can't hold it back. If you have 6 blows already stocked up, you can't only use 2. Do note though that the multiplier is weaker the fewer blows it has to work with. If you have 6 blows, it will only be a multiplier of 6 times.
objects.title: (Striker) 100th Strike

objects.text: Any object you touch can be imbued with Charges. The amount of Charges they possess is dictated by the quality of the object. Amplified objects will take an entire day to recover all of their charges. A basic gun can possess a single charge, while a Tinker device can possess even more. A single charge doubles the quality and damage of the object and spending another charge will double it again. A single charge lasts 10 seconds but doubles every additional charge spent.
objects.title: (Striker/Tinker) Amplify Charges

objects.text:
Your touch can cause anything colloquially known as “metal,” including materials generated by other parahuman powers, to violently tear itself apart and wrap around your body as a full suit of armor. Both the process and the resulting armour does not harm you or limit your movement.

Once formed, the armor rapidly rusts, covering it in jagged, sharp edges. As the rust spreads, the armor becomes weaker and less protective. In exchange, its edges become sharper. Wounds caused by these sharp, rusty edges also become more prone to severe infection.

Your metal armor counts as your touch for this power. Touching another metal object with your armor lets you absorb and add it to your suit, increasing your suit’s mass and strength without sacrificing mobility. As new metal is integrated, the weaker, rusted material is pushed to the outer surface, sharpening its deadly edges, while fresher, stronger metal layers beneath reinforce your protection.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) Rusted Juggernaut

objects.text: By touching metal, you can turn it into Vibranium, a nearly invulnerable material that also acts as a near-perfect shock absorber. The better quality the material, the stronger and better at absorbing the energy the Vibranium is. You convert metal to Vibranium at a rate of 1 cubic centimeter a minute. If you go a week without touching a Vibranium construct, it will revert to its previous metal at the same rate.
objects.title: (Striker) Vibranium

objects.text: You possess the ability to convert any object or material you come into contact with into pure gold, merely through the touch of your hand. With just one touch, you can instantly turn anything into a shining golden specimen, whether it be metal, wood, stone, or any other material. This power is highly versatile and can be leveraged in numerous situations, from combat to economic prosperity. However, it also comes with a considerable drawback: any item transformed into gold cannot be reverted back to its original state and is forever lost to the owner. This power can affect other living beings, albeit at a slower rate.
objects.title: (Striker) Midas Touch

objects.text: You can manipulate the mass of any inorganic object you touch, and changes are permanent. The mass of the object you change must be at most two orders of magnitude different from it's original mass.
objects.title: (Striker) Mass Manipulation

objects.text: You have the ability to touch an object and induce a rotational force with your point of contact being the pivot. It starts at a manageable level, but with each rotation, the object accelerates more and more. This momentum is built up over time, allowing you to launch high-speed objects in a desired direction at any moment. The friction at the point of contact is reduced, allowing the object to spin with minimal resistance. The force and speed of the launch are directly proportional to the speed and force with which you spin the object. You may not spin objects with a volume greater than 10 cubic meters.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) The Spin

objects.text:
You can create crystal growths with a touch, which you can then dismantle to create catastrophic artillery-level siege weapons and any ammunition they might need. You can do this fast enough to construct an artillery weapon within minutes and have enough power-given know-how to build and utilize your constructions, though these are still fundamentally mundane weapons instead of true Tinkertech. The crystals you create become malleable under your touch, allowing you to form them into the various parts required for your artillery and when touching a place with both hands can create crystals fast enough to be useful in combat.

While your crystals are as durable as the material they're made of once created, they crumble over the course of an hour and tend to collapse or weaken much faster when not being actively used, whether in combat, as a weapon or as material for your artillery. Your weapons won’t work unless you’re the one using them, or at least the one pressing the ‘trigger’ as your crystals keep their normal rigor when not in contact with you. 

Additionally your crystals change colors and type from day to day, affected by various factors from your mood, your shards disposition towards you, up to the purpose you’re using them for, making your crystals range from being made of Fluorite, Quartz, Jade or any other crystal and very rarely out of Talc or Diamond. Your interactions with your crystals are unaffected by which material they’re made of⁩⁩, making construction just as fast independent of the material they’re currently made of.
objects.title: (Striker/Tinker) Facet

objects.text: Any object or person you touch can selectively phase through anything you want. You cannot apply this to yourself and you can make something phase through multiple things if needed. Even if you cannot properly identify what that something is, you can phase through it so long as you have seen it or can imagine it.
objects.title: (Striker) Phase Touch

objects.text: You can touch any type of bladed weapon and turn its edge sharp enough to cut through almost anything. It couldn't effectively cut through an Endbringer's flesh, but it could cut through steel with only moderate effort. The durability of the weapon is also increased to be able to cut through incredibly hard materials without taking damage or losing its edge.
objects.title: (Striker) Edge

objects.text:
Your whole body is a living battery. You will naturally generate electricity over time, which will take a week to fully charge. You can, however, absorb electricity through direct contact with a charged material. You can then release this stored energy at will through any part of your body, delivering electric shock to anything that touches you.

You can store enough to completely burn someone to crips instantly or just the right amount to stun for a few seconds. You can't control the path that your current will take and although you can send your energy through clothes with the right settings, it would burn holes into them to make way for the current.

Furthermore, you are immune to electric attacks as long as you have enough storage to absorb them completely, but once your storage is full, you will take damage, though you are heavily resistant.
objects.title: (Striker) Human Capacitor

objects.text: You can cause old wounds to reopen or bones to re-break, regardless of how long ago the original injury was.
objects.title: (Striker) History’s Pain

objects.text:
You have the power to bless a machine with a spirit, guiding it in your chosen direction. The disposition of these creations is not tethered to their form; whether a tank aiding its pilots, a toaster thirsting for blood, or a printer dutifully obeying commands, the original purpose of the object has minimal sway over its essence, for good or ill.

Examples of usage can focus on the maximization of their function, such as enhancing a gun's accuracy to precisely hit the wielder's desired target, prolonging a sword's sharpness, or just making a Machine gain a trait not commonly seen on them, like a hyper-aggressive toaster that will burn all bread put on them because they want Humanity to suffer, it can too enable more autonomous functionalities in modern devices like planes, cars, or smartphones. These will have options to be more "Autonomous", such as AI-like help, self-driving if the device can move for itself in the hardware front, or more.

(Additionally, all machine spirits gain imperceptible durability through metaphysical means and minor self-repair abilities tailored for preservation and maintenance purposes.).

Their emotional level has a broad spectrum, from highly emotional to extremely logical, with intelligence ranging from that of a child to that of an adult human, and the more powerful and precise you make, the more time you need to awaken their spirit. All of them can and will grow with stimuli, gaining new traits based on their experience and intensity.

As their creator, All Blessed Machines hold you in high regard. However, their affections can shift, and they may develop favorites beyond you.
objects.title: (Striker) Machine Spirit

objects.text:
Twin Impact allows the user to, at the site of any initial impact, create a second impact remotely and at their discretion. The second impact will be at least 5 times stronger than the initial one. It can also be used on objects or on people.

The second impact can be triggered at any moment, regardless of how much time has passed or how far away the user is. There is no limit to how many times this ability can be used; however, each activation must be applied to a different impact location for it to take effect.
objects.title: (Striker) Twin Impact

addons.text:
Your ability to convert objects into fleshy versions of themselves has expanded; you are now capable of fusing and integrating your creations into your own body, turning yourself into the weapon instead of just creating them. These bio-organic objects take on the appearance of bone, keratin, or muscle and have a durability similar to steel but are far lighter and more adaptable. With time and focus you can mutate integrated weapons and armor with far more precision and expertise than before, changing them to grant traits like secreting acid, having extra sensory organs, or even shooting projectiles. Once integrated, these objects are a part of you repairing when damaged and using your body's nutrients to do so. Overuse and excessive regeneration will lead to you being weakened and malnourished until you eat enough to return back to normal. 

Converted tinkertech can be integrated in the same way; it retains most of its functions while gaining regenerative abilities and thus no longer needs maintenance. Using assimilated tinkertech is highly costly, though, causing you to become exhausted quickly. When your grafts are not in use, they can be stored internally in a hyper-compressed state concealed beneath your skin but still adding to your overall weight. With time you can implant your grafts onto other creatures; these grafts hold some similarity and connection to you, but over time that link vanishes as the graft adapts to the host's biology.
addons.title: My Arms Are My Arms

objects.text:
You have the ability to cause objects that you touch to be transformed into biological versions of themselves, which you can then slowly mutate and alter the properties of. The more you alter and change an object, the longer you must spend working on it to do so. With enough time spent on an object, you can be able to grant it various biological functions, ranging from skeletal reinforcement to creating digestive acids to even creating basic and rudimentary nervous systems. 

You can take a sword and convert it to a sword-shaped mass of flesh and then turn the sharp edge of the blade into a row of jagged teeth that regrow when knocked out or broken. You can take a bomb and make it into a living organism filled with volatile and explosive gas and then have it grow legs, creating a network of nerve impulses that allow the living bomb to scurry around mindlessly. With enough time and focus, you can even heal injuries on yourself and others by converting an object into flesh and then grafting it into the wound, though this is extremely difficult and time-consuming. You could even turn tinkertech into a fleshy version of itself that you could modify; converted tinkertech no longer needs maintenance. You also gain a Panacea like understanding of the biological creatures you touch.

Your only major limits are time, because alterations to objects take time to perform, and size. The bigger an object is, the harder it is to change it, and the longer it takes to do so. At a certain point an object will be too large for your power to work on, and this is also the case for objects which are secured into place in their environment. A parking meter that is cemented into the sidewalk would be something that you can not use your power on, but if that same parking meter were to be ripped from the sidewalk by something else, you could then grab it and begin to use your power on it. Most vehicles are too large for you to use your power on.
objects.title: (Striker) Meat Touch

objects.text:
By touching an object that fits into 2ft³ of space, you can consume it in order to gain a commensurate amount of improvement to yourself to the quality of what was consumed.

This improvement is somewhat random, ranging from physical strength, to mental improvement, to additions to power supplies.

Objects you consume provide greater benefits the more significant the object. A pile of dirt may not provide much growth, but a piece of Tinkertech would provide far larger gains.
objects.title: (Striker/Breaker) The Void

objects.text:
You have a mental database of all Cold Weapons made throughout history, it updates whenever a new one is made. Through touch you can use this database to convert a cold weapon into a different cold weapon. The database also contains all skills related to using those weapons, allowing you to perfectly wield them.

You can split bigger weapons into smaller ones, and can remerge them as long as they are touching each other. You can't split weapons made through splitting. You can still use your weapon conversion on them.

You are aware of all cold weapons within 100 meters of you. You also know their exact distance, direction, composition, design and state.

Your database — and thus your weapon conversion  — are limited to mundane cold weapons.
objects.title: (Striker/Thinker) Cold Weaponry

objects.text:
You possess a minor telekinetic field concentrated around your hands, fingers, and palms. Extending only a few centimeters from your skin, it acts as an incredibly precise multitool, allowing you to manipulate matter directly with your hands without physically touching it.

You can assemble and disassemble objects, tighten or remove screws, drill, weld, cut, reshape materials, and separate components with great precision. With sufficient focus, you can even manipulate materials on a molecular level, separating compounds or rearranging their structure. At the extreme end, you can manipulate individual atoms, though doing so is extraordinarily difficult and potentially hazardous.

The more precise the manipulation, the slower it becomes. Simple mechanical work can be performed almost instantly, allowing you to dismantle or reassemble complex machinery within moments. Molecular manipulation requires considerably more concentration, while atomic-scale work may take hours of uninterrupted focus.

Your range is deliberately limited, but within that range your hands become a remarkably versatile tool capable of performing delicate engineering, manufacturing, repair, and materials processing without conventional equipment.
objects.title: (Striker) Micromanipulators

objects.text:
Every day you get a ‘budget’ of 2000kg of mass you can use to duplicate anything, but only ‘one’ of something.

By focusing on an item in front of you, you can cause another one to appear beside it, ranging from objects to even people. The duplicate will be exactly like the original in every way, with tinkertech being no exception, though it would still be as ‘used’ as the original and would still be subject to the maintenance limits of tinkertech.

While you can only duplicate something once, the new duplicate counts as a new entity that you can duplicate again.
objects.title: (Striker/Breaker) (In)Finite

objects.text: You can fuse two things together temporarily that possess all the properties and powers of the two things combined. You can even fuse two already fused things, there are no limits to what can be fused. Still, they also increase in size when fusing them, making them unwieldy if you fuse too much.
objects.title: (Striker/Tinker) Fuse

objects.text:
You may touch a device and literally black box it, causing it to become encased by a dark veil. This causes the device to be immune to thinker/tinker abilities to understand what's within, as well as abstractifying it's function with regard to physics. This abstractification can remove unintended side effects such as friction or disrepair, as well as improve the reliability of any intended effects.

The durability of the veil is proportional to the durability of the device, and all effects reset to normal if the veil is pierced.
objects.title: (Striker) Abstraction

objects.text: When touching an object with one hand, you can generate a mirror image of it with your other hand. These copies are identical to the originals, except for the fact that they are black, like obsidian or onyx. The object weighs effectively nothing to you, but it behaves as if it has the same mass as the original towards anybody else touching it.
objects.title: (Striker) Echo

objects.text:
Your nerves have undergone a transformation, becoming something far beyond their original organic form. Now, they resemble neon-glowing metal wires that pulse with a vibrant, ethereal light beneath your skin. These luminescent tendrils trace intricate patterns across your body, visible through your skin like a living network of circuitry, their glow intensifying with your emotions or when you focus on a task.

When you touch an object, you can extend these glowing nerves into it, merging with its structure in a way that allows you to control it as if it were an extension of your own body. You can manipulate the object with incredible precision, making it move or function according to your will. Whether it's a complex piece of machinery or a simple tool, your nerves grant you an unparalleled level of control, as if the object is now an integral part of your nervous system.

However, your exposed nerves are highly sensitive. A sudden shock, an intense sensation, or an unexpected feedback loop from the object you're controlling can send waves of pain through your body, overwhelming your senses. The more you extend your nerves, the more exposed and vulnerable you become.
objects.title: (Striker/Changer) External Nerves

objects.text: You can augment your physical movements with fiery versions of those motions that emanate out in the direction of the motion. Maintaining focus can let you extend the range of the fiery copies. These fiery copies also have their own set of mass and force and can easily spread, even on non-flammable material.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Fiery Moves

objects.text: You can create near-invisible claws and teeth at your nails and in your mouth, respectively. The claws and teeth can slide between atoms and sever molecular bonds. In addition to that, your physique is slightly enhanced. Your jaw is greatly enhanced, making it possible for you to crush reinforced steel with your biting force.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) Cutthroat

objects.text: You can secrete a slime-like substance that, when applied, gives you or others a temporary boost in strength. You can control how much you secrete and how potent it is.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Gooey Steroids

objects.text:
You have the unique ability to alter the fundamental nature of Shaker and Striker powers through a simple touch. By doing so, you can make Shaker powers behave like Striker powers and vice versa, this include you. The strength of the powers adjusts according to the change in range, either amplifying or diminishing their effects depending on the transformation.

Vista gains a personal field where distances are stretched to near infinity, making her nearly untouchable as attacks can't reach her or have a power like (Shaker) Liminal Landscaper and with Clockblocker it would now allow him to stop multiple targets within his line of sight or a range around him like Hatchet Face, although the duration of the effect is reduced due to the expanded range. This change holds for 24 hours or you dispel the effect by touching them again.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Shake, Shake, Shake

objects.text:
You can scan and tweak the body of others. This requires direct skin-to-skin contact with your target, with your awareness and control scaling directly to both the surface area of contact and the duration it is maintained. A single fingertip for a second gives you a faint glimpse of their immediate biological state, while a full palm for a minute lets you map entire systems, and sustained full-body contact turns their internal biology into an open book you can read and rewrite at will.

This control only allows you to alter existing biological functions, forcing them to operate in ways they were never meant to, such as flooding the brain with dopamine to engineer devotion, alter their hormonal balance, toggle their heart rate from slow to fast instantly, or inhibiting neural pathways to alter the senses. On the other hand you wouldn’t be able to create new structures, heal wounds, reshape flesh, or alter genetics, only alter what is already present. Each tweak feeds you new data on cause and effect, deepening your understanding of their specific body and as you understand their body better, you can continue to tweak it in unique and novel ways.

The instant skin contact breaks, your supernatural understanding and tweaking ability reset entirely to baseline. However, your memory retains the knowledge of what you discovered, allowing you to relearn their body and reinstate control far more efficiently with every subsequent encounter.
objects.title: (Striker) Discombobulating Puppeteer

objects.text:
With a touch, you can give people up to 8 copies of your Perks or Drawbacks, as long as they make sense to be something that can be given. For example, Endbringer Target could be given, but Overcharge Strike or Second Wave Parahumans could not be given.

You can take away these perks/drawbacks at will. If you die, they keep the perks/drawbacks forever, unless another Parahuman can remove them. 

Giving someone Mental Barrier will remove any Master Effects on them, even if they were a one-time effect that isn't actively maintained.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Perk

objects.text: You can grab and hold onto anything. You can grab lasers and throw them back, explosions and redirect them, and you can even grab entire buildings if you are strong enough. You gain 15x faster reaction speed and anything you catch cannot harm you or escape your grip unless you want it to. This can negate teleportation as well.
objects.title: (Striker) Grippy Grip

addons.text:
Your connection to your thorns has evolved. Your thorns blood consumption now simultaneously fuels their growth and your blood-fueled abilities, with both benefiting as if they had each consumed the full amount. Additionally, through physical contact with your thorns, you can siphon the blood they’ve consumed, weakening them and slowing their spread while also channeling that blood into your own blood-fueled abilities. Lastly, through this evolved connection, you gain greater control over the direction your thorns spread and what consuming blood primarily enhances: durability, growth, or both.

If you have the Blood Bag upgrade, you may also use the blood stored in your pocket dimension to feed your thorns. This process uses the same rate of consumption as if the thorns were draining a live target.
addons.title: Blood Link

objects.text:
You can generate dense, bloodthirsty thorns from any surface you touch. When you place your hand on an object—be it a wall, the ground, or even a person—thorns erupt from that point, spreading quickly and aggressively. They snake outward, wrapping around surfaces and driving themselves deep into materials, whether organic or inorganic, unaffected by the Manton Limit.

These thorns have an insatiable need for blood, which fuels their growth and sustains their strength. In the absence of a blood source, they begin to wither and weaken almost instantly, losing their durability and ability to spread. However, once they encounter a living creature, they instinctively latch on, draining blood to continue thriving and expanding.
objects.title: (Striker) Thorns

objects.text: You can turn yourself and others into canine forms. The forms can vary wildly, but as long as at its base it is a canine, then you can transform yourselves or others into it. When transformed, you and your targets will gain subconscious canine-based behavior (such as baring of teeth and direct eye contact when threatening others or feeling threatened).
objects.title: (Striker/Changer) Wolf Time

addons.text: You can now actually turn objects you touch into cake rather than just change the way they interact with you. The rate of transformation increases the longer you maintain contact, with a maximum capacity of transforming up to ten times your volume at once. You have the ability to freely choose the flavor of the cake, allowing for a wide variety of tastes. Whether it's a rich chocolate cake, a delicate vanilla sponge, or an exotic fruit blend, as long as you have tasted it before.
addons.title: It’s All Cake

objects.text:
You can treat anything you touch as cake. This means you can eat solid concrete, cut apart steel, or smash buildings. This doesn’t affect the properties of the material itself, just the way it interacts with you. As such, you can use this to smush “cake” into people, but not people into “cake”. This is Manton Limited from working on living creatures. This power can only affect the first few layers of an Endbringer before being rendered null.

You can activate/deactivate this power at will.
objects.title: (Striker) Real or Cake

objects.text:
You gain the ability to control the shape and state of any blood you are in direct contact with, forming various constructs from thorny vines to crystallized blood blades or even functional wings. Furthermore, any blood you control counts as you for the purposes of Striker powers. 

However, the property of counting as you for the purposes of Striker powers is only present in the blood in direct contact with your body. If your constructs cease to be in contact with your body, they will fall apart. On the flip side, this does allow you to control someone else’s blood if it is in contact with blood you already control.

Lastly, you are limited by how much blood you possess, and this power doesn’t grant any form of regeneration so you may very well bleed yourself dry if you aren’t careful.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Viral Blood

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to “equip” gear that you are carrying. When an item is equipped, it grants an additional bonus distinct from its natural function. For example, wearing plate armor already provides physical protection, but equipping it might enhance your overall endurance, grant additional resistance to blunt force trauma, or even extend its defensive benefits to areas not covered by the armor itself. Similarly, a sword will still cut as normal when wielded, but equipping it could increase your strength, improve your cutting precision, or even enhance your ability to parry attacks.

The quality and nature of the gear influence the bonuses granted. A high-quality shield might not only improve your ability to block attacks but also provide resistance to knockback or stagger effects. A poorly made or damaged weapon, on the other hand, might only grant a minor boost or come with drawbacks, such as a rusted sword offering slight strength enhancement but increasing the risk of it breaking mid-fight.

Other gear may offer protection against specific conditions—equipping a treated cloak might grant resistance to heat, while a reinforced helmet could help you resist concussive forces or mental attacks.

However, you cannot over-equip yourself. Even if you can physically wear multiple pieces of gear at once, you can only equip items that do not interfere with each other. For instance, you may be able to wear both a suit of heavy plate armor and a cloak, but you would have to choose which one to equip—the armor for increased resilience or the cloak for enhanced mobility or elemental resistance. However, as long as they don’t take the same “slot”, then you are free to equip as many things as you can wear.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Equip Bonuses

objects.text:
Anything you touch starts to decay, rot, and/or age at an increased rate. A minute of this on an object would be equivalent to a century, on something dead it would be equivalent to a decade, and on a living being a minute would be equal to a year.
You can do this in reverse. You can choose if memories are affected.
objects.title: (Striker) Wither

objects.text: By staying in one position for an extended amount of time, your next attack will become physically stronger. You do not gain more durability while holding still though.  You effectively double in strength every 10 seconds.
objects.title: (Striker) Hold Strike

objects.text: Your attacks leave invisible marks in the air that allows you to repeat the action you did to make them exactly where you made them. You can trigger this whenever you want and lasts for a week.
objects.title: (Striker) Delay Strike

objects.text: For every physical strike you do that misses, your next attack that does hit a target will deal damage based on the cumulative damage of everything you did. It resets whenever you successfully hit a target.
objects.title: (Striker) Stockpile

objects.text:
You have an instinctive knowledge of pseudospiritual energy that flows through peoples' bodies. You can instinctively tell how this energy flows through their bodies.

By imbuing your hands with this pseudospiritual energy you can apply certain effects to your opponents through the pseudospiritual energy flow's pressure points. This includes deactivating their powers, putting them into an unconscious state, putting them in a suggestive state, making them intoxicated, making them completely lose all concept of time, etc.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Chi Blocking

objects.text: You can melt inorganic and organic matter into slush and solidify them. This takes longer on organic beings than it does with inorganic, you can also selectively melt and solidify things you touch. If you are good enough, you can melt two living creatures together in a way where they still function.
objects.title: (Striker) Melty

objects.text: If you touch someone, you can swap bodies with them. All powers aside from this one swap. If you touch two people, you can swap them instead.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Body-Swap

objects.text: You have telekinetic control over yourself and everything within one inch of yourself. Your control is very fine. You can make yourself go up to 120 mph with this.
objects.title: (Striker) Tactile Telekinesis

addons.text: Permanent Effect removed your limited number of ongoing halving with it becoming a permanent part of reality while also allowing you to stack the effect halving anything again, again, again…
addons.title: Recursive Dividing

objects.text: You can "halve" anything with a touch. The bigger the physical object, the longer it takes (it scales progressively). Objects always get halved at exactly 50% of their mass. You have some control over how and where objects get halved. You can halve anything weighing a couple of kilograms instantly. You can also halve imaginary "concepts" or forces that affect objects and people, such as "This object's drag is only half" or "This person only uses half of their stamina when moving." They can have 2–5 ongoing halvings at a time. The more specific and limited the halving, the easier it is to maintain.
objects.title: (Striker) Divide

objects.text: You can manipulate the buoyancy of anything you touch. This can include yourself. This could allow one to float, sink, or fly in any fluid medium, such as water or air. You can make cars float in the air or jump far distances with a leap. You can maintain control over any object you are affected by, even if you are no longer touching them, and can release control whenever.
objects.title: (Striker/Mover) Buoyancy

addons.text: Your ability to magically transform your equipment has synchronized with your skill at making magical-themed gear. Equipment you temporarily enhance will also have minor tinkertech additions that follow the original theme of the equipment. In addition, you may use your Mark to store information on the manifested tinkertech, allowing you to reliably manifest it again or build it separately. The Mark can also be used as a conduit to enhance equipment from a distance.
addons.title: Suit Up!

objects.text: You can temporarily enhance your equipment for greater enhancement. They will have greater flexibility, strength, durability, and speed. If they do not possess any special qualities, they will gain one. The temporary enhancement will alter the appearance of your equipment on the theme of how they were original. If it possessed frills it will be more frilly while if it were more mechanical it would grow even more machine-like.
objects.title: (Striker/Tinker) Dress Up!

objects.text:
By touching an object that fits within 2ft³ of space, you can convert it into a single indestructible Locust under your direction.

Locusts created from more significant objects such as tinkertech or complex items are highly likely to be created with additional minor powers of their own equivalent to 1sp. 

These Locusts follow your direction, but are fundamentally rather simple, only really responding to rudimentary commands.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) The Abyss

objects.text: You can pull a hammer out of hammerspace and hit someone hard enough to send them flying. No matter what this won't seriously harm them, though it may incapacitate them for a time. The hammer is a perfect shield, unbreakable and inviolable. The only person who can put any force onto it is you. Your reflexes are enhanced to peak human. Flechette's power would be redirected by this.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) Stop! Hammer Time

objects.text: You can absorb and store the personalities and powers of others. The absorbed memories and powers can be imprinted into a new body, creating a separate existence. The process does not overwrite the new host's original powers and experiences. The power absorption is temporary if the target is in good health but can become permanent if they are weakened.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Backup

objects.text:
Through physical touch, you can inject memories or experiences (either your own or someone else's), so the target lives out those memories perfectly. This can be utilized so that every physical and emotional sensation will feel real to them. Enough contact may incapacitate the target, or cause them to be in a coma, even death.

To increase effectiveness, you gain a fraction of memories from the people you previously touched.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Memory Injector

objects.text: You can automatically create explosions at any hostile force that touches your body without harming you. You can set how dangerous something needs to be in order to trigger this effect. The explosion is as strong as a grenade. You can also create explosions from wherever you want on your body without something triggering it.
objects.title: (Striker) Explosive Armor

objects.text: Your melee attacks get stronger in a geometric progression the longer you attack the same target without stopping. You have to continue hitting your opponent with pauses no longer than 5 seconds between the strikes or your combo will be broken.
objects.title: (Striker) Combo

objects.text: You can alter any object you touch to momentarily act like broken safety glass that is easily shattered. You could walk through a reinforced metal door or person like they aren't even there. This also works on forcefield effects but doesn't function on Endbringers past the surface layers. The property wears off a few seconds after contact with you.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Fragmentation

objects.text: You can selectively rewind the state of anything you touch, including yourself, to a previous state. You can do things such as rewinding your physical state to heal injuries or repair objects, rewinding someone’s mind to erase select portions of their memories, or even rewind someone’s entire state to resurrect them. You can selectively choose what aspects to rewind such as only physical, to restore someone to a younger and healthy body without erasing their memories, or perhaps just healing someone’s injuries they have gotten from training without removing any benefits from said training.
objects.title: (Striker) Rewind

objects.text: Given the cases where someone intends to do you harm and succeeds in touching you, or you want to inflict as much pain on someone else in turn, you automatically turn their body against them, flipping their bodily defenses and systems—enough internal damage to reach organ failure—to cause unbearable pain until they pass away from shock. This goes especially for parahumans, also turning their power against both lifting their Manton Limit and passively causing their power to wreak havoc inside their bodies.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Retribution

addons.text:
Haze of Conflict further worsens this power’s effects: acting both as an agitating factor on the power’s infectious rate and considerably deteriorating the vector’s disorders to maniacal and near-psychotic lengths, Parahumans under this power become hotbeds, their power expression on their rampage acting as an extension of the contagion.

This also causes an odd behavioral pattern in the “infected”: They are drawn to gatherings or large groups of people, where they violently explode in a paroxysm of rage or hysteria. This conflict engenders enough violent contact with one another and sufficient emotional instability to jumpstart an outbreak.
addons.title: Mob Mentality

objects.text:
Every time you touch or graze any person close to your personal space, you induce (or aggravate) a disorder based on the person’s psychological profile, tendencies, and potential neuroses, a nervous personality may lead to developing an anxiety disorder, and a bad-tempered person may worsen to a form of Intermittent explosive disorder (IED), to name a few. A Thinker aspect helps with ascertaining the vector’s probable disorder, with the rate of a person’s succumbing to this illness depending on their mental resilience and prior “demons”. The power behaves infectiously, with all under its effects acting as a vector contaminating the populace further through touch, accelerating the infection rate the more people are infected. 

Parahumans with a condition or disorder due to their power are just as susceptible as any person, with the power’s caveat of oddly interacting with their trauma and resulting tendencies, quickly falling victim to this and promptly losing themselves.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Disorder

objects.text:
With a mere touch, you can strip an entity of its face, leaving behind a smooth, featureless void where it once was. The victim is neither truly dead nor alive, existing in a suspended state where they require no sustenance, oxygen, or sleep. Any wounds they had at the moment of theft are rendered inert—never worsening, but never healing either. They effectively become unchanging, unable to die. While they remain functionally immortal in this state, they are utterly deprived of their senses of sight, smell, and taste, and are left incapable of speech.

Once stolen, a face becomes yours to wear, and with it, you inherit the natural and supernatural traits associated with it. A dog’s face grants an unparalleled sense of smell, a cat’s bestows superior night vision, and the face of a parahuman with clairvoyance or emotion-sensing allows you to use those abilities as if they were your own. You can seamlessly switch between faces at will, but only one may be worn at a time. The transition is instantaneous, letting you adapt to different situations with frightening speed. If you somehow have more than one face, you can wear multiple faces.

Your collection of faces is permanent unless you choose to return them, at which point the victim regains their senses and consciousness as if no time had passed.
objects.title: (Striker/Changer) The Face Stealer

addons.text:
Due to the extreme synergy between these two powers, both have been given additional effects.

You are capable of targeting anything within the range of your Tuning Field with Tuning Fork without touching them, and anything which Tuning Field has already adapted to will have the timer halved.

Your secondary field has also gained the ability to mimic the properties of your Striker effect, allowing you to have a form of passive offense on top of both your active effect and defensive field, so long as you are actively targeting something.

Finally, you have much more control over how your Striker effect manifests, allowing you to use it in non-lethal ways. This can be things such as general power disruption against parahumans, or specific effects like slowing the time of what you hit when facing Velocity.
addons.title: Tuning Spork

objects.text: Upon making contact with something, a looping timer will begin: its length depending on how difficult the target would be to harm. A normal person would only take a few seconds, while a Titan may take a dozen or so minutes. Upon completion of a loop of the timer, your strikes will become better augmented to harm your target. Against Velocity, they may allow you to strike a place he was a few seconds ago to harm him, while against Panacea, it may give your strikes a Blaster rating or produce a shield around them. This only augments the effects of your strikes, meaning it won't do things such as boost your speed. Each additional loop increases how effective your strikes are, and against targets more susceptible to harm, they may even become lethal after only a few loops. These effects cannot be passive in nature, and choosing a new target will reset any past augmentations and start a new timer catered for them. You don't need to switch targets when attacking a new one, but adaptations meant for some may not help you against others. They also plateau after a while, since there's only a certain amount of damage your strikes can deal before they just become instantly lethal. You can 'target' just about anything, from a stone to an Endbringer, though certain targets may have unique interactions with your power. An example would be Eidolon switching powers or Endbringers' unique internal structure, though even then, you'd still eventually be able to kill them as well. If you target Scion, you could manage to destroy his body, and even eventually manage to find a way to circumvent the Stilling, but the actual Hub is beyond you due to shard restrictions. It would also take a ridiculously long time.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Tuning Fork

objects.text: Your body isn't 1000°... it's 10000°F, a little over the temperature of the sun's surface. Your temperature won't interact with the air unless you want it to, and can be turned off or confined to certain limbs at any time you will it so. You cannot be hurt by any heat less than 20000 degrees Fahrenheit.
objects.title: (Striker) 1000 Degree Knife

objects.text: You can replicate matter through physical contact. You may replicate multiple things at once, but you cannot replicate over 200 kilograms of material at a time. Clones share access with the original's Shard.
objects.title: (Striker) Replicate

objects.text: Whenever you touch a object, being, or surface, its physical properties get added to your Property Catalogue. You may later choose to apply one of these properties to another object, being, or surface by touching it. These physical properties may be either something basic like texture, color, density, or durability; or a more advanced property like conductivity, reactivity, or even uniform chemical makeup.
objects.title: (Striker) Property Catalogue

objects.text: You can revert any living being to its youngest form, such as a baby, a seed, an egg, and so on. The target will retain the memories, growth, personality, and powers that it had before the transformation, even if they are not typical for its new age. This power only works on living beings who reached the prime of their life or past that.
objects.title: (Striker) Ouroboros

objects.text: With a touch you can change the direction of anything that touches you. It remains at the speed it was going prior to you touching it, only its direction has changed.
objects.title: (Striker) Vector Alteration

objects.text: You can make anything you touch to have the durability, resistances, and even esoteric defenses reduced by an arbitrary amount. This can range from making the human body's acid resistance to be lower than stomach acid to making Endbringer cores incapable of negating powers.
objects.title: (Striker) Resistance Down

objects.text: You can choose to make anything you touch implode inwards on contact and destroy itself. This only works on physical objects or people, you can also delay this for a maximum of a day. You can also choose to remove your timed Implosions.
objects.title: (Striker) Implosion

objects.text: If you touch someone and you want them dead, they're dead. This only works on humans.
objects.title: (Striker) Death Touch

objects.text: You possess the power to manipulate a web of energy, allowing you to use it to send objects or individuals into the future. By utilizing this energy, you can cause the objects or individuals to temporarily cease to exist and reappear at a later time. However, if an object is in their relative location after they reappear, they will end up fusing, causing damage to both objects. If you were to use all of your energy at once, you can send someone a year into the future. Doing so will require over a month to recover all you energy.
objects.title: (Striker) Time Strike

objects.text: You can absorb damage done to living beings (including yourself) or objects, healing or repairing them, and store that damage in a battery of sorts. You can then give that damage, or a fraction of that damage, to someone or something else with a touch. This cannot bring back the dead, though it can repair their bodies.
objects.title: (Striker) Redistribution of Pain

addons.text: During stopped time your body is further enhanced by a order of magnituded and you can have as many instances as you want. When time resumes the bonus enhancement is undone and the extra instances created during stopped time disappear after the cooldown for your time stop ends.
addons.title: Sakuya's Lesser Cousin

objects.text:
You have a mental Playlist that is filled by touching a non-living object that isn't bigger than you. Said Playlist is numbered 1 to 5—with 1 being the newest item—and as such can only hold 5 items. Adding a item to the Playlist pushes the previous item one number below, doing so while the Playlist is full means the oldest item is discarded to make space for the new newest. You have a couple ways of managing your Playlist: you can discard an item, you can manually drag around a single item at a time, you can directly swap two items positions, and you can randomly shuffle everything.

By selecting a number from the Playlist you gain absolute awareness of the object within it—for example what a specific knife can cut, its material composition, who made it, what was it used for since its creation, etc. Though the true purpose of the selection is your capacity to them recreate the selected item either into your hand, with said hand repositioned in whatever way you want—like say recreating a Gun with your finger already on the trigger, or recreating multiple knifes between your fingers. You can freely overwrite whatever is already in your hand with a selected item.

Since the items within a Playlist are a 1:1 copy of the original object at the time of registry, they also contain any properties acquired by being affected or made by a power, though while for example the cable from Hookline would keep its All-or-Nothing durability due to it being a property of the chain itself you would not have telekinetic control over it.

Each item in the Playlist can have a maximum of 20 instances at a time. The oldest instance of an item disappears to make way for its newest instance if its limit is surpassed. if an item is no longer in the Playlist all of its instances disappear, they also disappear 1 hour after their creation.

Together with a scary capacity to accurately hit any of your projectiles, your entire body is enhanced to the human limit to take advantage of your Playlist.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Object Playlist

objects.text:
Your Striker ability allows you to interact with abstract or non-physical effects as if they were solid, tangible phenomena. To you, every hostile intent, psychic attack, emotional manipulation, or conceptual influence can be met on physical terms. You can literally grab and strike the intangible, treating mental or metaphysical assaults as if they were solid things. When someone tries to dominate your mind, you catch the command midair and snap it in half. When despair or fear creep in, you can crush them underfoot like any other threat. If someone forces you into an illusion, you punch it till it crumbles. You can even crush or choke parahuman senses that reach too close or back at all.

Your Thinker aspect translates these conceptual effects into perceivable structures — patterns, motions, or distortions you can read and react to. You can see manipulation before it takes hold, feel the weight of a power before it lands, and hear deceit as if it were a note out of tune. You’re not immune to such effects — you simply fight them head-on, nullifying their influence through direct, physical confrontation. Even psychological trauma or precognitive inevitabilities can be confronted and dismantled by force of will made real.

This, however, doesn't give you the knowledge/sense of how to fight or the strength/might needed to perform those feats; still, removing Taylor's control of something/someone is as easy as snapping a thread, while beating Zion's depression would be an effort in futility.
objects.title: (Striker/Thinker) Fight Me With Your Fists

objects.text: Your attacks, be it from weapons, your fists, and so on leave undetectable remains only you can see and feel. You can choose to instantly teleport to one of these invisible remains whenever you choose or cause them to explode in an All-or-Nothing spatial rupture that destroys anything within a 3-meter range of it. You are immune to the effects of your Spatial Slashes and they last up to a week, after which they will fizzle and fade.
objects.title: (Striker/Mover) Spatial Rupture

objects.text: You can make an object stronger, more durable, and better at its purpose than it was before. However, you need to be careful when doing this, doing it improperly can result in damage to the object. You can use this on yourself, though it could kill you if you do it badly.
objects.title: (Striker) Reinforcement

objects.text: You can steal luck with a touch. The effect fades over time - a person whose luck was stolen will gradually get back to baseline normal. It might be possible to temporarily gain the luck equivalent to (Shaker) It Gets Worse, but it will only last for a few minutes and you need to drain at least 100 people within the time frame of 10 seconds.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Jinx

objects.text:
With a touch, you can freeze any object or person in time for a maximum of 15 minutes. At any time you can unfreeze any frozen object, but after 5 minutes it will get more and more likely to unfreeze all on its own. After ten minutes you can no longer force the object to unfreeze. With a touch, you can unfreeze objects frozen by Clockblocker.

You can break Gray Boy bubbles, as well as other localized temporal effects caused by Bakuda and other temporal manipulators.
objects.title: (Striker) Clockstopper

objects.text:
You can generate and decrease mundane energy through touch, such as generating large spikes of heat able to melt concrete or stopping bullets against your skin. You don't have a traditional self-protecting Manton limit, rather a percent of your output is instead inverted as a way to protect yourself from harm, which can be ignored if you wish to push yourself further at the cost of your safety.

You aren't limited against using multiple energy types at once, nor against directly affecting living things. This power gets noticeably stronger with prolonged use of a single output, with the cost being that it takes an increasingly longer amount of time to turn off. Your maximum strength would be roughly equal to Lung's heat output in his fight against Leviathan, though your lack of any dynakinesis and the massive ‘cool off’ time would likely cause enough collateral to get you slapped with a kill order.
objects.title: (Striker) Dynamo

objects.text:
By manipulating time and matter, you can return things to their original states and heal deep injuries. Even if the patient is barely alive, you can save them and restore their bodies to their optimum state. 

However, to do this, you must understand the perfect condition of the body you are restoring, so, to achieve this, your power makes you go through all the experiences of the target, meaning you will experience their lifetime of pain in just a few seconds. With time, you can expand your usage of this power. 

As a side effect of experiencing your patient’s memories, if you can somehow think through the pain, you can gain access to their skills. With enough mastery you can also modify the process, allowing you to alter the bodies of your targets at will instead of simply restoring them.
objects.title: (Striker/Thinker) "Healer"

objects.text:
You can trigger Black Flash at will with any strike you make.
