When used, the force and effect of that strike are multiplied by an exponent of 2.5, turning even a normal blow into something violently devastating. 

The strike will show as a shock of black lightning. You suffer no repercussions for this increase in force. 

After landing a Black Flash, you enter a heightened state where your overall power, speed, control, reaction time, durability, and performance rise to 120% for a short period. 

This boost also applies to later Black Flashes, meaning repeated successful strikes can make each follow-up hit sharper, stronger, and more devastating.
objects.title: (Striker) Black Flash

objects.text: As long as you understand the structure of something, you can transmute it into a new form, as long as you understand that too and it has the same base atoms. All transmutations must obey the three laws of thermodynamics. You cannot bring back the dead with this.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Reconstitute

objects.text: You can turn fake toys and realistic fakes into the real thing. Toy guns can work as real guns and even pretend items mimicking other capes can work like a weaker version of the real thing. However, the quality of the item in question will dictate how powerful it is. A complete 1:1 copy can possess nearly equal power to the real thing. Cosplaying as other capes can grant you their powers as well, although you will never surpass the original and you can't copy Tinkers and some Trumps like Dauntless or Fairy Queen properly due to losing charges or fairies when you stop.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Idol Theory

objects.text:
You produce a gooey biological catalyst that causes living organisms that make contact with it to undergo tens of thousands of years of optimized evolution per second. This artificial evolution will cause the emergence of traits desired by the user of this power if they are possible with enough time, starting with and prioritizing conscious desires and then working on subconscious desires if it has time. 

The catalyst is used to fuel the transformation at a rate of one gallon; for example, it is completely used after a minute has passed. You can produce the catalyst at a rate of ten gallons per minute. You are immune to the effects of the catalyst, but not to the effects of bacteria or viruses exposed to it. You can choose what types of life allow the catalyst to affect and not affect when creating it, like bacteria and viruses, for example.
objects.title: (Striker) Mutagen

objects.text:
You have control over an improved version of Armsmaster's nano-thorn technology. Any attack you make or power you use, from a simple punch to a reality warping doom laser, is infused with the ability to completely sever molecular bonds. 

This power has two modes, passive and active. In passive mode, you have the equivalent of what Armsmaster used against Leviathan applied to all of your attacks (including weapons and powers), without the visible effect. However, this comes at a cost -- being extremely difficult to control. You may find yourself accidentally cutting through precious objects or even people merely by touching them. You can improve in control over time and regular usage of your power in conflict but you may still unintentionally affect parts of an object or power that you did not intend to. However, the The 'Holding Back' perk will allow you to determine if your power is on or off as well as control what is affected.

In active mode, you gain access to an improved version which allows you to sever nearly anything, up to and including an Endbringer core. This still isn't an "absolute" effect, so it will not be able to damage things such as Alexandria's body stasis or The Siberian. Because this mode is extremely energy intensive for your Shard, it will give you the full-body equivalent of a thinker headache if you use it too often. If you are Shardless, you do not feel this pain but are instead paying the increased energy cost yourself, so use this mode sparingly. Attacks infused during active mode gain an pale aura of a color of your choosing. 

You can also temporarily infuse objects with the ability to create Nano-Thorns, which allows you to make items such as Nano-Thorn daggers. These last for a couple hours.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Thorny Rose

objects.text: When you touch a Parahuman, your Shard can drain their powers. This process permanently weakens the Parahuman, reducing their abilities, while simultaneously stealing resources from them to recharge your Shard and strengthen your own powers. The boost to your abilities is greater if the Parahuman’s powers are similar to yours. However, this effect is less effective if the target has a higher Shard ranking and cannot be used on Endbringers or Entities. A Parahuman can be weakened to a minimum of 1% of their original strength.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Bandersnatch

objects.text: You can grow 3 bone claws from between your knuckles on each hand that are about a foot long. These claws are incredibly sharp, able to even cut steel. It even comes with a complimentary regeneration for your knuckles, so you don't have to worry about bleeding to death the first time you use it.
objects.title: (Changer) Wolverine

objects.text:
You have the power to modify your jaws and teeth; when this is used, you can rapidly extend your gums up to a length of three metres, bite, and then retract faster than the blink of an eye. Your biting strength is enough to crush steel.

Your jaws extend in a manner similar to a goblin shark’s.
objects.title: (Changer) Take a Bite

addons.text: You are able to swap between C53 forms, but unfortunately you no longer have access to a ‘default’ human form.
addons.title: Fun Fact! 53² is 2809

objects.text:
You have access to a number of changer forms, able to swap between them at will.

These forms are able to be chosen from the Lucky Mutation power category, and you can purchase their relevant upgrades.

(Note that since Lucky mutations cost SP, you’ll be paying for those as well)
objects.title: (Changer) Headcase(53)

objects.text: You take on the form of whatever you find most attractive. While this doesn't give you any additional supernatural powers, it does give you a matching set of biology that could sustain that form.
objects.title: (Changer) Beauty

addons.text: Your mouths are now imbued with an “All or Nothing” effect, allowing them to consume any material, no matter how durable, with ease. Each mouth can shred, crush, or absorb substances from hardened steel to power-enhanced objects. Each mouth selectively adapts automatically, sharpening teeth or hardening jaws as needed for extreme consumption tasks without harming your body.
addons.title: Glutton

objects.text: You can form a mouth at any part of your body, even your insides. They can be bigger or smaller than your actual mouth. These mouths are fully functional, capable of breathing, talking and eating no matter its location. You can additionally alter the inside of your mouth, such as turning your tongue into a blade, tentacle or other things. You could also make your teeth sharper or differently shaped.
objects.title: (Changer) Mouthful

objects.text: You can increase the size of your individual limbs. Your strength increases with the size of your limbs so you are always able to move your limbs with the same effort. You can increase the size of your limbs up to 10 times their original size.
objects.title: (Changer) Itsuka Kendo

objects.text:
You manifest changes on your body in reaction to wounds which vary depending on the kind you suffer, but generally allows you to inflict the same kind of damage. Slashes for example might allow you to grow blade-like bones or piercing attack spikes, while burns or electricity might allow you to make your blood boil and shoot it out or to shock people by increasing your bioelectricity to a level where mere touch works like a taser. 

These changes only happen in areas far from the wound site and this power doesn’t come with any added durability.
objects.title: (Changer) Deviant

objects.text: Whenever something or someone records you, you look better. It would be as if a picture of you were posing and photoshopped to make you look your best. This significantly increases your appearance as well.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) 3… 2… 1... Camera!

objects.text:
You have the power to transform your fingers into long-bladed whips. When you use this power, your fingers will extend up to 5 metres in length, gain hundreds more joints which can move in any direction and end with sharp claws that can slice steel.

To complement your whip-like fingers, when they’re transformed, they are far more dexterous and powerful.
objects.title: (Changer) Finger Whips

objects.text:
Your body is changed so that your body fat percentage always stays the same as that of a well-trained athlete. No matter how much fat you gain, your body automatically builds enough muscle to keep the fat percentage low. The change happens instantly and without pain, as if your body is just naturally adapting. Since this doesn’t remove fat and instead adds muscles to preserve its ratio, that means that the higher the amount of fat you have, the more muscles you have to compensate.

Any muscle added by this power is temporary and automatically removed if your fat levels drop enough to no longer require it to maintain the athletic fat percentage. However, any muscle gained through legitimate training or natural development is retained and not removed by the power.

Along with the look, at baseline, you also gain the strength, speed, endurance, and general physical performance of someone who trains like a top athlete, even if you never exercise.
objects.title: (Changer) Athletic

objects.text: You can turn into a green Ogre. While transformed, you possess strength to lift a car with one hand, and durability to be only be bruised from small arms. You also have a Scottish accent while you are a ogre.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Ogre

addons.text: Now you can successfully emulate small electronics in your disguises, though unless you have recently possessed the particular device you're copying, you won't have the necessary data to pass more than a cursory inspection.
addons.title: The Ghost Is The Machine

addons.text:
"And I can't catch it!"
Now in addition to a small boost to your durability and mass/volume limits you can now quickly project the tentacles from your object forms to use as spider legs to move quickly, up to 30 km/h in very short bursts or 10 km/h for extended periods.
addons.title: "Your Refrigerator Is Running"

objects.text: You now gain the ability to instantly disguise yourself as a near perfect copy of any simple, non-living, non-electronic object, that is smaller in volume than a breadbox and/or weighs less than 10kg within your line of sight. Note that while in this state your ability to move around is mostly limited to rolling around until you revert back and that getting damaged will force a reversion and has a stunning effect as well.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Prop Hunt

objects.text: You can transform yourself into a durable stone-like material. You can still move in this form, but you're slower and less flexible. You're stronger though.
objects.title: (Changer) Self-Petrification

objects.text:
You shapeshift by rewriting your active genetic expression in real time, meaning you can instantly gain any trait you could have naturally been born with based on the genetic material already present in your DNA. This includes changes like altering your eye, hair, or skin color, modifying your height, bone density, or muscle composition, switching sex characteristics, or adjusting your metabolism and pain tolerance. All of these shifts remain within the natural range of human variation present in your immediate lineage and occur without any delay or discomfort. For example, if your parents both have brown eyes, you cannot instantly give yourself blue eyes, but if your family has a recessive blue eye allele, you can.

You can also access traits from your ancestors via genetic regression along your ancestral line, including characteristics you personally could not have been born with, such as archaic hominid features like a Neanderthal's robust bone structure or a Denisovan's enamel thickness. However, the further back the ancestor, the longer the transformation takes and the less comfortable you feel in that form, ranging from a few minutes and mild oddness to several hours and a dull ache, and up to days paired with severe dysphoria and nausea. Your body may even begin to reject these ancient forms after prolonged exposure, forcing you back into your normal state.
objects.title: (Changer) Genetic Reformatting

objects.text: You can transform your body into a solid gold-like form that is both sturdy and weighty. Despite your external appearance, your physical characteristics are vastly different from that of a soft metal, possessing considerable strength and durability, making you highly resilient to damage. This power allows you to withstand physical attacks and emerge unscathed, but it also renders you susceptible to being overly weighed down by your newfound weight and mass, hindering your mobility and agility. Nonetheless, this power grants you immense strength and endurance, giving you an edge in hand-to-hand combat and enabling you to withstand formidable amounts of punishment.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) The Golden Man

objects.text:
You can create a cocoon around your body. This cocoon can give your body a few benefits or drawbacks, depending on your perspective. If you stay in the cocoon for less than an hour, all it will do is slowly heal you of any injuries and cure you of any disease. But stay there longer than an hour, and your appearance will start to be altered. It will optimise the body's natural systems, and if you have any other abilities, it will slowly transform your body to better reflect and utilise them.

An example is that if you have pyrokinetic power, your body will start to turn red and perpetually be hot, maybe even having flames instead of hair. This will result in your pyrokinetic power growing stronger, either in potency or control.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Metamorphosis

objects.text: Your physical form is malleable, able to shift into any form ordinarily possible for the species homo sapiens sapiens, regardless of sex, appearance, or physique. This power is capable of transforming away Case 53 Mutations.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Human Shapeshift

objects.text: You can absorb items and form them into armor. You can control the overall shape of this armor and your actual body will shift to accommodate any changes. Any changes to your body are reversed once you remove the armor. It becomes difficult to move if your armor is more than five times as large as you originally were with movement becoming impossible at 10 times your original size. You can control any mechanical devices you have integrated into your armor.
objects.title: (Changer) Golem

addons.text: You can transform into a colossal, hyper-evolved version of any animal you can transform into, amplifying their natural abilities to devastating levels. These Dire forms are significantly larger, stronger, and more durable, with traits tailored for combat or survival. For instance, a Dire Wolf can smash through vehicles and resist heavy damage, while a Dire Eagle gains immense speed, piercing strength and perception that borderlines localised clairvoyance. Shifting is near-instantaneous, allowing you to adapt quickly, and you retain full human intellect and control in all forms. All your forms are highly durable, resistant to significant harm, and capable of rapid self-healing.
addons.title: Dire Beast

objects.text:
You can transform into a colossal wolf roughly the size of a car, gaining devastating physical prowess that lets you tear through steel barriers or knock aside entire vehicles with a single swipe. The jaws of this dire wolf can bite through reinforced metal without strain, and you can leap tremendous distances, easily clearing obstacles or reaching rooftops in a single bound. While in this form, your speed far surpasses that of an ordinary car, allowing you to race across highways and city streets at blinding velocity. Your dense fur and hide provide formidable protection against small-arms fire, and even if you do sustain injury, your body mends itself at an accelerated pace, allowing you to recover from wounds that would be crippling for a normal human.

You retain your full human intellect and control while transformed, avoiding the pitfalls of an animalistic mindset. Shifting to and from this dire wolf shape requires only a few moments, leaving you free to adapt quickly in combat or other high-pressure situations. You can remain in this alternate form indefinitely without any inherent drawbacks, ensuring you always have access to an immense well of strength, speed, and resilience whenever you need it.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Dire Wolf

addons.text:
You no longer need to drink the blood, as you can absorb it from your skin. Additionally the blood you absorb acts as a reservoir of raw energy. At any time, you can channel this energy to enter a heightened state of physical transformation. In this empowered form, your strength is significantly enhanced, and you gain a set of vicious claws capable of rending through most materials with ease. Your senses sharpen dramatically, allowing you to pick up on subtle sounds, scents, and movement that would normally go unnoticed. Your agility is also greatly increased, with powerful leaps letting you scale small buildings and traverse urban environments with unnatural grace.

However, this form comes at a cost. Activating and maintaining it rapidly depletes your stored blood, causing your satiation to drop with every passing moment. Prolonged use risks exhausting your reserves entirely, leaving you weakened, sluggish, and ravenous. The more blood you’ve consumed beforehand, the longer and more effectively you can maintain this feral, devastating transformation.
addons.title: Blood Beast

objects.text:
You can manifest a pair of sharp, predatory fangs in your mouth at will. These fangs are capable of piercing flesh with ease, allowing you to extract blood directly from living beings. The blood you consume functions as a substitute for conventional nourishment—approximately one pint is sufficient to sustain you for a full day, and since the average human body contains about 10.5 pints, a single person can theoretically provide enough sustenance for over ten days.  

In addition to providing sustenance, the blood you consume temporarily grants you access to the learned skills of your target, matching their level of experience. Whether it’s martial arts, marksmanship, surgery, or even painting, their mastery becomes yours for as long as the blood remains within your system. These borrowed skills fade gradually as you digest the blood, typically lasting several hours depending on your metabolism and activity. However, repeated feedings from the same individual cause the skill to imprint more deeply—if consumed often enough, these abilities may become a permanent part of your own repertoire.

This ability does not allow you to copy superpowers, mutations, or unique physiological traits—only skills that were learned through training, study, or experience. While you cannot mimic a powered individual’s abilities, the flavor of their blood often tells its own story. Different blood types have distinct tastes, with rarer types being noticeably more satisfying. Blood altered by powers, mutations, or otherwise unique biology offers the richest and most euphoric flavor, often proving addictively irresistible even without the promise of a useful skill.
objects.title: (Changer/Thinker) Fangs

objects.text:
Your body is divided into three distinct sections for the purpose of transformation: your torso, your limbs (arms and legs as one group), and your back. You are able to shift each section independently into the equivalent of an animal’s corresponding anatomy. For example, your torso might become that of a lion, your limbs those of a gorilla, and your back may take on features like wings from a bat or a scorpion’s tail.

These transformations grant the physical traits of the chosen animal—strength, durability, natural weapons, or mobility—but all of them are scaled to what the human frame can support. Oversized parts, such as those from elephants or whales, are proportionally reduced to what a human body can reasonably support. Conversely, features from smaller animals, such as a hawk’s wings or a mantis’s claws, are scaled up in size and power to remain practical and physically functional on your form.

Your head is the one part of your body that cannot change. No matter what form the rest of you takes, your face, skull, and sensory organs remain human. This also means any sensory advantages from animal heads—such as enhanced smell or night vision—are not gained.

Each section must be drawn from a different animal. You cannot use the same creature more than once across the three sections.
objects.title: (Changer) Manticore

objects.text:
You have short-range teleportation after each of which you gain a random set of mutations. These mutations only persist until your next teleportation and are usually weak like additional sets of eyes or a gaping mouth, with some being more dangerous like poison claws and 4 arms. 
You’ll be naturally proficient in their use.
objects.title: (Changer/Mover) Wildblink

objects.text:
You can take the form of a three inch tall winged humanoid with exceptionally sharp teeth. While in this form you’re capable of flight to the same speed you can run in all directions. 

Additionally, if you can latch onto the back of a creature’s neck, you can use your teeth to cut into their bodies and take direct control of their nervous system, puppeting it from the inside. While inside you are capable of controlling the body with complete precision as though it was your own, however you will be unable to use any powers possessed by someone you’re controlling unless they’re inherent to their physiology.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) Sheeda

objects.text:
You can transform your body based on deep-sea creatures. Your transformations favor boneless or cartilaginous marine life, with exoskeletons counting as bones for this limitation. Your focus is on stuff like cephalopods, jellyfish, rays, and certain eels. Creatures with internal skeletons are harder, if not impossible, to use. When you transform you are not limited to the actual size of the original creature; all forms are scaled appropriately to match your own biomass. A tiny venomous snail can be manifested as a fist-sized barb, while the form of a giant squid is condensed down.

You can choose how exactly your transformation works at any given moment, such as splitting an arm into a cluster of strong, prehensile tentacles for grappling, or fuse the mass of your lower body into a single, powerful muscular appendage to deliver a crushing blow or propel yourself. You can extrude venomous spines along your forearms, flatten your torso into a rippling mantle for gliding, or cause your eyes to bulge and become wide, dark pools capable of perceiving minute electrical impulses in the air, allowing you to "see" the nervous system activity of nearby beings, even through obstacles.

These adaptations are altered to function outside their natural environment. Gills can filter oxygen from air, hydrostatic support replaces the need for deep-sea pressure, and specialized senses like electroreception or lateral line detection translate to land, granting you awareness of vibrations and bioelectric signatures in your immediate vicinity. The main limitations is that while your power gives you the instinctive capability to control these transformations, you do not have the intimate knowledge of their biology, meaning you need to study it on your own. Additionally, while you can reconfigure, you can't create mass from nothing. 

A side effect is that you are a very good swimmer.
objects.title: (Changer) Fishing Trip

addons.text: You can endlessly gain fat, allowing for a greater boost in stats. You gain a pocket dimension where you can store excess fat. Due to storing the excess fat, you will not change in appearance and weight pass a certain level of obesity.
addons.title: Big Boy

objects.text: You gain fat ten times faster than humans can naturally gain and easily become obese. The fatter you are, the more physically stronger you become. You do not suffer from health problems related to obesity. You can choose to burn your fat, resulting in a temporary boost to stamina and strength proportional to the amount of fat lost. Your body will adjust to the lack of fat, making sure you don’t have loose skin.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Fatty

objects.text: You can transform and act like anyone you have studied or interacted with. The more you have studied or interacted with them, the better the transformation and the more mannerisms you adopt. This can even fool Thinker powers.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Imposter

addons.text: The sapient worms and your intelligent cells have formed a highly synergistic relationship, significantly enhancing your body's capabilities. Together, they work to bolster your immune system: the cells alert the worms to potential threats, while the worms rapidly evolve new strategies to neutralize them. This partnership creates an incredibly robust defense mechanism, capable of countering even the most dangerous pathogens and biokinetic attacks. With their intimate knowledge of your body's needs, the cells guide the worms in evolving specific enhancements. For example, if your cells detect muscle strain, they signal the worms to develop advanced muscle-repair mechanisms, resulting in increased strength and endurance. Additionally, the worms' ability to hyper-evolve is harnessed by the cells to adapt to environmental changes. If you move to a high-altitude area, the cells instruct the worms to evolve more efficient oxygen-utilization systems, allowing your body to adapt rapidly. Your body is not a temple, it a freaking ever advancing nation.
addons.title: Allied Internal Nations

addons.text:
Your cells are now cyborgs, providing several significant benefits. They created an internal communication network for real-time health diagnostics and direct brain-to-brain connection to the Internet. Your cells can interface with technology, allowing you to unlock and control devices via biometric data or thought commands. They can transform your body into defensive or offensive tools, such as armor or bladed appendages, even able to create special capabilities to adapt to the situation. Additionally, they will be able to harness and store energy for various uses, like powering devices or creating energy shields, however only after they have analysed and produced quality energy tech. Finally, your cells can operate independently, allowing for remote missions and the creation of android-like bodies, all dependent on available resources.

Note that if you have any tinker powers, your cells will default to improving your body using it.
addons.title: Mechanical Work

addons.text:
If you possessed a corona potentia, it is now distributed across every cell in your body, fundamentally transforming your abilities. Every power you have is mirrored by your intelligent cells, which actively manage, train, and enhance your abilities. These cells provide unparalleled control, making the use of your powers instinctive and seamless. They continuously adapt and optimize your abilities to suit your needs, gradually increasing their potency and effectiveness. This cellular intelligence ensures your powers evolve in harmony with your physiology, constantly refining and expanding your capabilities to their fullest potential.

As time progresses, your cells themselves begin to develop power-like abilities that further enhance your body by analysing and gaining information. For example, your cells could develop advanced healing capabilities, allowing you to recover from injuries at an accelerated rate, regenerating lost limbs and organs, making you nearly invulnerable. Your muscle cells might evolve to provide superhuman strength and endurance, enabling feats of physical prowess far beyond normal human limits. Brain cells could enhance your mental capabilities, granting heightened intelligence, faster information processing, and improved memory. These cellular enhancements would synergize with your existing powers, creating a feedback loop of continuous improvement, transforming your body into a living nexus of evolving capabilities, each enhancement perfectly tailored to complement and elevate your overall potential.
addons.title: Powerhouse of the Cell

objects.text:
Each cell in your body is a sentient being with a sole purpose: to keep you alive and well. While they may appear unremarkable to the naked eye, close examination through a powerful microscope reveals them as tiny, human-like creatures. Each cell is meticulously designed to perform its specific role in maintaining your health and functionality, and their collaboration has created the complex organism that you are. They cannot be mastered, with the only exception being from a strong Biotinker or Biokinetic, and even then it will only be temporary. You can interact with the cells in your body, directing them as needed.

Your cells can make independent decisions and prioritize tasks based on your body's needs. For instance, in the event of an injury or infection, they will allocate more resources to the affected area to ensure quick and effective recovery. They can even take control of your unconscious body to fight in your place if required. Your cells adapt and evolve over time in response to changes in your lifestyle and environment, making you highly adaptable and resilient. No matter what type of lifestyle you lead, you will always be healthy and fit. Additionally, they can help you resist biokinetic and biotinker influences to a degree.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Cells At Work

objects.text:
No matter what, you're always the tallest in the room. Be careful not to hit your head...

This comes with a minor strength power that ensures you can move your body with the same ability regardless of your current height. You won't be able to fight an Endbringer, but you would be taller.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Taller

objects.text: You can take the form of any non-supernatural organism in the animal kingdom from any planet you’ve been to larger than an insect. The ability of these forms reflects your own; if you are unhealthy, so will your changer form.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Dinosaur

objects.text: Your eyes can transform into a deep, pitch-black void, endlessly weeping streams of blood. The blood disappears shortly after it’s no longer in motion. Anyone who gazes upon you in this state is overwhelmed by an uncontrollable urge to make you happy.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Tears of a God

objects.text: You can rapidly expand your body, increasing your strength and raw power significantly at the expense of your agility and flexibility. In this expanded state, your movements become slower and less precise, but you can deliver devastating blows with ease. When needed, you can reverse the process, compressing your size to concentrate your strength into a more compact form. This condensed state allows you to regain your agility and fluidity, and gain a new level of explosive strength. However, compressing your body is slow and taxing, accompanied by an uncomfortable sensation of being tightly bound which can cause claustrophobia. This process also requires focus and leaves you vulnerable during the compression, although with experience you can accelerate the speed you compress your body.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Expand And Contract

objects.text: You gain the durability and defenses of the strongest piece of armor you are wearing. This can be as small as a kneecap or shoulder plate. This also replicates any unique properties of said armor onto your entire body. Equipment with (Stranger/Brute) Ghost Equipment count as being worn.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Armored Skin

objects.text: You can transform into a giant snake, slightly larger than an anaconda. In this form, you can unhinge your jaw and swallow multiple people whole. In this state you can store and release force by coiling your muscles like a compressed spring, allowing you to fling yourself dozens of meters with enough power to severely damage buildings. You’re durable enough to do this hundreds of times without tiring. While your base speed and dexterity are comparable if not better than a human, you can create multiple small coils while moving to rapidly increase your speed when needed.
objects.title: (Changer) “Coil”

objects.text: You are able to extend sinews, veins, and strands of your flesh like living threads, weaving them into weapons or tools. These threads can lash out like whips, slice through objects, or wrap around enemies to bind and crush them. The strands move as if they have a mind of their own, writhing and reaching for anything nearby. If detached from your body, they remain alive, crawling and twisting independently to hunt or bind targets. Your body will temporarily substitute the missing parts with whatever is available—using bone as muscle or skin and veins—altering your form until your original flesh regenerates within a day. The power has a built-in safeguard, warning you if using it too much risks causing permanent damage or death, ensuring you don’t push yourself too far.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Living Threads

objects.text: Your power passively distorts your features to a cartoonish degree, amplifying both your physical appearance and abilities to superhuman extremes. You become an exaggerated, larger-than-life version of yourself, with proportions that defy natural limits. Your height is towering, your muscles are over-the-top, bulging beyond what even the most dedicated bodybuilder could achieve, yet somehow still fully functional. Every trait—whether it’s strength, beauty, or presence—is cranked up to an absurd level. You’re not just attractive; you have an almost surreal allure, with flawless skin, impossibly shiny hair, and features so symmetrical they seem drawn rather than real. Beyond physical appearance, your human capabilities are enhanced far beyond ordinary limits. Any natural human ability you possess is greatly boosted. You are faster, stronger, and more agile than any human could naturally be. While others might be able to sprint, you could blur by at astonishing speeds, outpacing vehicles. Your strength allows you to lift objects many times your size with ease, and your reflexes are sharpened to a superhuman degree, allowing you to react instantaneously to any movement around you. However, this power doesn’t enhance learned skills—anything that relies on training or knowledge is unaffected. If you have Holding Back then you can freely turn this power on and off.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Exaggerated Figure

objects.text:
Your body is capable of producing and harvesting parasitic lifeforms and substances within your body, depending on which part of your body they’re nested in: a parasite forming and gestating within your muscular systems develops into a root-like lifeform that infects and subsumes the host’s body keeping it to only a mass of nerves, veins, and arteries until it decays into a mass of fleshy branches; a parasite forming among your central nervous system develops a worm-like parasite with mirror neurons and nerve agents that, if a person’s infected, will slowly and surely develop and overrides the host’s brain and replace with the parasite’s, etc.

As a seedbed for these lifeforms, you can control the rate and method of infection, the symptoms your parasites produce, and their severity and lethality. However, your body’s natural limitations and the parasites’ biological nature and scope limit your control.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) Culture

addons.text: Your mutation and regeneration have become one monstrous system, fully intertwined and feeding into each other. If you wish, you can make any mutation from (Changer) Mutant Beast permanent, in exchange it is boosted to the point it can do things not biologically possible. Moreover, your adaptive regeneration no longer merely becomes resistant; it fights back. When injured, your body adapts not only by hardening or resisting further damage, but by developing countermeasures tailored to the threat—growing toxins that target venomous predators, exuding heat to counter frost, or forming natural weapons designed to exploit the weaknesses of what harmed you.
addons.title: Doomsday

objects.text:
You can undergo a surge of mutations, drastically reshaping your own biology for a limited time. This transformation allows you to warp your physical form in extreme and often grotesque ways—growing claws sharp enough to shred steel, converting your saliva into corrosive acid, elongating limbs, reinforcing your skin into armor-like plating, or even sprouting entirely new appendages such as wings or tails. 

Each mutation grants new capabilities, increasing your raw power and adaptability in combat or survival scenarios. The extent of your transformation directly affects its potency—the fewer changes you make, the weaker and more limited the effects; the more you mutate, the stronger and more versatile your form becomes. 

However, the more extensive and unnatural your changes become, the more monstrous your form appears and the harder it is to maintain control or return to your original state. Reversion begins only once you will it, but the process is slow—taking a minimum of one minute under optimal conditions, and potentially longer depending on the scale of your transformation.

Additionally, the mutations are semi-random in nature—you can choose where on your body they manifest and express a general intent for what they should become, but the specific outcome is unpredictable and may vary each time.
objects.title: (Changer) Mutant Beast

addons.text: Your tails can now apply any debuffs your projectiles can. You can decide how they do this—for example, on contact, through injecting venom, or by spraying venom or gases.
addons.title: Tail-End Tactics

addons.text: You can use Guided Growth to copy mutations and special properties of tails or tail-like body parts much faster and add them to the possible forms your tail can take, or combine aspects of them to make new forms. The most important addition to your tail is that now, when touching a parahuman’s head for about a minute, you can copy a weakened version of their power permanently as a template for your tail, as if you had the power yourself. These copied powers can only be used to be infused into your tails.
addons.title: Tailypo

addons.text:
Now, you can absorb the properties of mundane materials by touching them and use them in your tail, or construct it completely out of the materials you've absorbed. Your tail’s capabilities are boosted based on the material—most materials will boost the strength and durability of your tail when it is constructed out of them, but different materials have different properties. For example, a tail made of paper would have high speed; a tail made of glass will be stronger when attacking and shatter violently, throwing out high velocity glass shards before reforming instantly; a tail made of steel or concrete will be more durable and strong, etc.

Regardless of the material, the tail’s attributes will never drop below its base attributes unless it's beneficial for it to do so, such as in the case of a glass tail, which can endure forces equal to its base durability but can shatter at will when attacking. It's also possible to only use the different materials in specific locations of the tail or use aspects of them, such as spikes made of metal or a tip made of glass.

You can imbue up to two materials into the tail without any strain, with any more materials beyond that taking an increasing amount of stamina to maintain. You can choose how the materials are integrated.
addons.title: Tailor-made

addons.text: Your tail now re-manifests almost instantly after being severely damaged or destroyed. When regenerated by Transhuman, it takes on a cybernetic form, thus enhancing its baseline capabilities and granting it access to additional features, just like the rest of your body. You can also choose to incorporate cybernetic or technological features into your tail when manifesting it, like tasers, flamethrowers, grappling hooks or firearms. These enhancements increase the strain the tail places on you compared to simpler or purely biological features, especially if you load in multiple complex functions. Your tail also benefits from any active Transhuman add-ons and upgrades.
addons.title: Tail & Error

objects.text:
With a thought, you can extend and retract a fully functional and prehensile tail near your tailbone. This tail takes an appearance of your choosing within the realms of possibility each time you choose to manifest it, including natural weapons such as sharp spikes or even blades and stingers or additions like hands and eyes, all of which are fully functional.

The tail can reach a length equal to twice your own height and is very flexible, being able to slither slowly, coil, and grasp things with ease, while still being able to make swift twitching movements to strike.

Its physical attributes are always equal to twice your own, so if you can lift 60 kilograms with some effort, it can lift 120 kilograms with the same amount of effort; moreover, the tail is naturally as dexterous as your hands and using it comes naturally and does not get in the way, almost as if its been part of your body for your entire life.

If damaged, the tail can benefit from any regeneration you possess and will reconstitute itself when manifested again. If your tail is severed or severely injured, it will automatically retract and re-manifest in a few seconds.

However, the true strength of your tail is the fact that it can be infused with the rest of your powers—letting your tail take on the properties of the power, use aspects of it to support forms that would otherwise be impossible, or act as a complement or support for the power; for example, if you had a pyrokinetic power, your tail take on multiple forms based on your needs, such as being made of fire, super-heating the natural weapons you manifested or expelling a large amount of flames. If you had super speed, it could move at very high speeds without becoming injured, create vibro-blades on your tail, or automatically move and grab things to help keep your balance.

You can imbue up to two powers into the tail without any strain, with any more powers beyond that taking an increasing amount of stamina to maintain. You can choose how the powers are integrated.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Versatail

objects.text:
Your body is in a constant change of improving, evolving and optimizing itself, however as it consists of countless parts with wildly different purposes and processes this change would be glacially slow if you applied it to your body as a whole, with it potentially taking a decade for a meaningful and noticeable change that would push you into superhuman territory. 

Instead you’d have much more and faster success by focusing this improvement on specific body parts, the more narrow or smaller the body part, and the more focused the desired change the faster it will come to pass. Though this is still a matter of days, weeks if not months depending on what changes are desired. 

Gaining various manners of visual acuity for example, like thermal vision, night vision and infrared would take a few weeks. Though this process could be accelerated with proper knowledge of biology by only affecting the specific parts that are required for these various visions to work. This can likewise affect smaller units like cells or something more complex like the brain, though due to how dense it is, changes to the brain take much longer unless the targeted area and desired change is highly specific.

Though this power mostly takes time to work, you do have something that allows you to be dangerous mid-combat, namely a months worth of potential energy which you can utilize to temporarily enhance parts of yourself to gain certain mutations, like gaining claws, poison spit or hoofed legs, while powerful, these mutations won’t last more than a few minutes and will exhaust the used body part somewhat, but in exchange you can supercharge parts of yourself as if you’d focused on them for a month, which works on top of any previous changes. Meaning that if you had poisonous spit you could adjust the poison as needed in combat or modify body parts on the fly wholesale.
objects.title: (Changer) Body Potential

objects.text: You transform into a pink ball-like creature that can suck things up into its mouth. Anything that isn't food that gets absorbed can be turned into a powerset. The powers in these powersets aren't as strong as most powers, but they are varied. You can only have one of these powersets at a time. When you're done, whatever you sucked up is released, so don't feel like you need to be a cannibal to use this effectively. You're also quite durable and strong in this form, enough so to be unaffected by non-tinkertech gunfire.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Kirby

addons.text: You can improve any vehicle blueprint you have, adding tinkertech into it and granting it more esoteric capabilities. This includes weapon systems. This also allows you to scan tinkertech and create variants to be used in vehicles.
addons.title: Esoteric Vehicle

addons.text: Every one of the vehicles you transform into has a high increase in durability. They all essentially become a tank in their own right. You can also add artillery weapons into the blueprints. Your enhanced vehicles also acquire a unique "false mass and leverage" attribute. This means they can exert the force and stability of a much heavier object without being affected by the increased mass themselves. No matter the situation, they always maintain perfect leverage, allowing for superior maneuverability and control even under extreme conditions.
addons.title: Living Tank

addons.text: You enhance any vehicle blueprint with advanced tinkertech, imbuing it with esoteric capabilities and significantly increasing its durability. Every vehicle you transform becomes as resilient as a tank, capable of withstanding extreme conditions and impacts. Additionally, you can integrate sophisticated weapon systems and artillery into the blueprints, creating formidable machines of unparalleled strength and firepower. In addition to this, you gain the ability to split yourself, up to 5 pieces, each transformed as a different vehicle. Your mind is split between the 5 pieces, and you have to fuse back together to transform back. You also no longer have any strain to keep your transformation, although you still will be drain of stamina for fuel and ammunition.
addons.title: Esoteric Tank

objects.text: You can scan any vehicle and gain its blueprint, allowing you to then transform into it. The bigger the vehicle, the higher the strain of keeping your transformation. You cannot scan tinkertech. Fuel and ammunition will be regenerated at the cost of your stamina. The amount of stamina is dependent on the type of fuel and ammunition.
objects.title: (Changer) Transformers

objects.text: You can split off several slimy tendrils that can extend a moderate distance. The ends of these tendrils can form indistinguishable copies of others you have studied in detail and can accurately replicate voices you have heard. You are unable to replicate any powers people have.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Oblex Impersonation

objects.text: You can transform into a giant spider made of arms with no body. The arms are covered in black fur, and break off into branches of four forearms per arm, each ending in a hand with eyes and mouths on the palm. These arms can break off from the whole and act independently, though if you transform back while any arms are detached, the arms start flailing about wildly, uncontrolled. In your changer state, you also gain a mild brute power, being able to crush cars with some effort.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) Aragog

addons.text:
The chain can now form a self-sustaining loop. When your centipede chain is severed, intentionally or otherwise, if the severed link is long enough, they will attempt reconnection by autophagy, the leading head of the severed link’s mouth unhinging to consume itself from its rear end. It will then continue to act in your self-interest while slowly pulling more and more of its body into its mouth, boosting your regenerative abilities for the duration of its self-consumption until it rips itself in half, swallows the last bits it can and finally dies.

You can also choose to cannibalize your generated bodies for the same effect.
addons.title: Autophagic Regeneration

addons.text:
Your torsos now dig outwards from any mouth that you create, allowing you to generate centipede chains from anywhere on your body, and anywhere else on the chain. You can gradually smear your interlinked form across a city, distended and inhuman chains of self-flesh locking down entire blocks, emerging from spirals of gums and teeth.

Additionally, you receive the ability to modify and customize the mutations of each torso as it crawls out from your mouths, with your hold over this ability gradually increasing in control and flexibility as the torsos begin to deviate from your original form. You could turn those wings into leather sheaths for your arms, ditch the tendrils for prehensile muscular strands instead, and your heads might instead bloom into jaws akin to flowers, drooling with digestive acids.
addons.title: Human Sprawl

objects.text:
You can unhinge and stretch your jaw far beyond human limits, and from within, a new torso emerges—an upper body identical to yours, slick with mucus, its lower half still anchored in your mouth. This new form retains your face and arms, but it can also open its mouth to birth another torso, and another, creating a grotesque, centipede-like chain of human forms.

As the chain extends, each successive body grows increasingly bloated and distorted, sprouting additional limbs, heads, or even alien appendages like wings or tendrils. If a torso develops multiple mouths, each one can independently generate more bodies, causing the chain to branch and spread in different directions. Every new form inherits the mutations of its predecessor, meaning that extra arms, eyes, or other abnormalities will carry forward and potentially multiply.

The result is a horrifying, ever-growing mass of fused human torsos, endlessly twisting and writhing, an extension of yourself that can spread across the battlefield like a nightmarish organism. The only limit to your growth will be your increased need for nutrients to feed all the extra bodies.

You have complete control over all the bodies, as if they were the one you were born with, allowing you to see and sense through them. You can at any moment bite off the first body you made, freeing you from the chain. The remains will then slowly starve to death, acting braindead until they finally succumb.
objects.title: (Changer) Human Centipede

objects.text: You can physically change your body into any form of weapon, other than Tinkertech. The only limitation is you cannot exceed twice the total volume of your body with the amount created. You could change your arm into an artillery piece, or you could make it into 50 smaller gun barrels, but you cannot go over twice the total volume of your arm. You can control every weapon created on your body as long as they are attached, so the 50 barrels could all point in 50 different directions and could move around as you desired. Any ammunition fired is created by the power and uses no body mass.
objects.title: (Changer/Blaster) Swiss Army Man

addons.text: Your transformation into a Mermaid has caused your crown to seep from your upper spine into your throat and vocal cords, interlacing itself into your sound-weaving biology and vice-versa. Underwater, your mutations and brood act as your choir, harmonizing with you, emanating a chorus of distorted versions of your very voice. Your joined songs can lull and induce docility, confuse sonar detection systems, and even cause psychic disorientation as otherworldly signals dance into auditory senses. On land, however, your scream will now have backup. Your spawn wrench open their mouths, their beaks, their orifices, and shriek. Their harmonized screaming builds resonance with yours, enough that it creates soundwaves capable of bursting eardrums immediately or cracking open materials such as glass or brittle wood.
addons.title: Sirengrafted

addons.text:
Your reef now also functions as a biological wetwork laboratory, developing “growth engines” beneath and along your scaly underskin - sacs filled with fatty tissue and soft coral folds that serve as healthy foundations for your growths. These sacs allow you customization and control over your growths, letting you tinker on them internally as they gestate within your body waiting to be called upon.

Your Tinker specialization has similarly been expanded upon. No longer do you tinker on Aquariums, but instead, Aquatic Ecospheres. Pressure chambers mimicking crush depth waters, flooded engine compartments filled with energy-cycling microbacteria for increased efficiency - you can create self-sustaining underwater habitats that double as mass ecological life-support platforms, often in ways that directly increase the output of your tech. 

Lastly, you can create shells - chitinous exo-bodies meant for your spawn - by either dedicating multiple growths into their creation, making them yourself from pre-existing materials, or a bit of the former and a bit of the latter. These shells delay the self-destructive instincts of your minions and allow them to act as longer lasting fixtures for anything you’d choose to dedicate their shell’s purpose to.
addons.title: Wet Hatchery

addons.text: The emergence of the Coral Reef within your body didn’t spark a war between it and your cells as invader and defender. Rather, a convergence - born from diplomacy and urged by your biology - emerged and as a result, both now work together to further your goals and ensure the survival of their shared ecosystem: you. The coral serves as the foundation of their kingdom, beyond bone and within flesh. The coral blossoms in controlled symbiosis, no longer as burdened by your body as your cells make way for its expansion into your insides. Rigorous reinforcement and optimization of organs occur, providing your biology a litany of further benefits. Your spawn, squeezed away from your dermis, no longer exists to simply die. In fact, many manage to thrive and - if given time and space - evolve and propagate, the remnants of your cells within them serving as caretakers and midwives, giving them much the same benefits as your cells provide you. As an extension of this propagation, instead of birthing out more, your spawn can now embed themselves - into biological or nonbiological targets - as a self-sacrificial tactic. When they do, they become seeds, harbingers of a walking kingdom squeezed into a vessel of mortal flesh. Subtly for its first hours, then in “bursts” of exponential growth, more cells birthing more cells in a twisted, power-enhanced form of mitosis. Spires and roots of semi-organic, reef-infused infrastructure. The air grows thicker and more humid as if slowly turning to water, lights refracting strangely into iridescents, a light pressure within that pulses with your breath. Eventually, it will birth coralspawn just as you would, an offshoot of your kingdom as it plays for territory. You are no longer human. You are a biome that wears skin to co-exist. Everywhere you may walk, Atlantis will follow.
addons.title: Atlantis Breathes

objects.text:
Your body now plays host to a supernatural reef system, the colony’s mass having buried itself into your skull and upper spine, replacing much of your neural matter and a good portion of the nervous system. This coral grows beneath your skin in iridescent, jagged plates akin to fish scales, often secreting cloudy mucus within the layers of your dermis. Its only external growths hide within the depths of your hair, spines to a crown wreathed in skin and bone. 

Feeding off of your neurological impulses and ambient bioelectricity, it reproduces through the creation of mutant growths that harmlessly force pores of your skin wide open in their wake. These growths are similar in appearance to most underwater organisms such as fishes, lamprey, and squids, but possess your features within them. Tentacles with contracted skin like joints existed inside, terminating in human nails; fish mouths with human teeth and scales of their own half-peeled from growing hair beneath, revealing raw, pulsating muscle.

When you wish it so, you may detach these growths from your skin, letting them come alive as though the air served as water to them. They swim, writhe and twitch with their broken, half-limp bodies attacking those you deem targets with attempted-human behavior. Smiling, crying, expressing emotion that they cannot comprehend. Some explode into splinters of calcium and paralytics, others latch on to release coral growth like roots, embedding living coral into flesh, attempting to grow - expect most of your spawn to display such self-destructive behaviors.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) Reefshell

objects.text: “It seems your Shard heavily misunderstood what a dragonfly was…” Your Changer state takes the form of a three-meter-long insect vaguely shaped like a dragon, its body composed of segmented, metallic-black chitin that gleams with green and bronze iridescence. Four translucent wings extend from your back, each twice your body length, capable of vibrating with such speed that they blur into a faint, shimmering halo when in motion. Your limbs are long and multi-jointed, ending in hooked claws suited for grasping and clinging, while a tapered, flexible tail balances your form in flight. Vast compound eyes dominate your face, and a narrow proboscis extends beneath them. Your compound eyes provide near-total panoramic vision, allowing you to perceive motion in every direction simultaneously. Each of the thousands of lenses forming your eyes contributes to a multifaceted image of the world, giving you a flawless sense of depth and movement. You see not only in visible light but also in ultraviolet and polarized spectrums, allowing you to distinguish subtle heat traces, reflections, and optical illusions that would fool human senses. This constant flow of information feeds into your reflexes, enabling you to react before an opponent can consciously complete a motion. Your exoskeleton also serves as a sensitive pressure array. Air vibrations, footsteps, even the shifting of air currents register across your chitin plates, creating an awareness of nearby movement independent of sight or sound. Your antennae and facial sensors provide olfactory and chemical detection far beyond human capacity; you can identify creatures by scent, detect emotional hormones, and trace toxins or specific individuals through faint airborne residues. Behind your wings lie a pair of small, stalked halteres; gyroscopic balance organs that keep you perfectly oriented in flight. You are capable of abrupt turns, hovering, and split-second reversals of direction without losing stability. Your wings produce immense thrust and can accelerate you from rest to full speed in an instant, while adhesive pads and microscopic hooks on your claws allow you to cling effortlessly to walls, ceilings, or smooth surfaces. Your exoskeleton can shed damaged outer layers through rapid molting, allowing you to regenerate new chitin plates within minutes. The process releases a faint organic dust as residue. The internal structure beneath is supported by dense, pressurized hemolymph, granting your limbs hydraulic strength disproportionate to your size. Every strike, leap, or wingbeat carries immense force, driven by the conversion of internal fluid pressure into kinetic output. Your voice in this form is produced not by a throat but through micro-adjustments in your wingbeats. The vibrations can mimic speech, though always layered with the insectile undertone of buzzing resonance. A similar misinterpretation from your Shard produced your most striking feature: an enzymic exhalation that superficially resembles dragonfire. In practice, this is a spray of corrosive digestive fluid expelled from your proboscis, capable of rapidly liquefying organic material. It burns and smokes on contact, creating the illusion of fire while remaining entirely chemical in nature.
objects.title: (Changer) “Dragonfly”

addons.title: Peak Performance
addons.text: You may transform into your catalogued genome at any age or physique theoretically possible for the genome to achieve, letting you take full advantage of the theoretical talent of any genome. You could take the one in ten thousand child of two one in ten thousand athletes, and manifest them as if they were at their physical peak after rigorously training their entire life.

addons.title: Unnatural Selection
addons.text: Not only can your power now catalog non-human genomes, but it can now artificially generate plausible genomes of any non-supernatural organism in the animal kingdom from any planet you've visited, allowing you to evolve a species without access to a viable population. This includes humans.

objects.text:
You have the ability to artificially evolve the human genome, letting you surpass the constraints of your own body. The catch? It's completely manual.

By touching someone you may add their genome into a mental catalog for your own use. By taking a male and female genome you may artificially simulate the breeding process and create an entirely new genome from the two of them. This genome is essentially a random possible child that the two donors could have created if they had children.

Your power treats genomes created through this process and genomes collected from people identically, meaning that you could hypothetically simulate hundreds of generations of selective breeding.

You may change your body to that of any genome within your catalog, transforming your body to what it would have been if you had those genetics. You would keep injuries and scars, and your fitness would be determined not just by genetics, but by your lifestyle. If you run an hour every day, your body will be developed as if you ran an hour every day.

When it comes to understanding the genomes in your catalog, you could check or compare a genome for any trait or talent you can think of, with the only limitation being that it takes a second or two to check a genome, with no way to analyze them in bulk. You are able to manually sort the genomes in your catalog in any way you wish, creating labels, groups, or anything you want.

You can hypothetically selectively breed for truly superhuman genomes, but it would be a very time-consuming task.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Eugenics

objects.text:
You have a number of forms you can transform into at will, based on the Mario power-ups. Each power-up has a cooldown that begins after your power-up runs out. The more powerful a power-up, the longer it is until you can get another one. A typical mushroom has a cooldown of about 15 minutes, a fire flower has a cooldown of an hour, an invincibility star has a cooldown of a week, a mega mushroom has a cooldown of a month, and a one-up has a cooldown of a year.
This also grants you the ability to jump really high, ground-pound, break bricks with your fists, and great skill with hammers.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) It's a me, a Mario!

objects.text: With a touch, you can fuse with any living being. This fusion has all its component's skills, powers, and abilities. All minds within the fusion are combined equally, including yours, and physical traits represent a mix of everyone involved. You may fuse as many times as you want, and the fusion may decide to eject members or unfuse entirely at will.
objects.title: (Changer/Striker) Amalgam

objects.text:
You can transform into a blanket made from the fabrics you have absorbed. Your material can shift and change, allowing you to mix and match different fabrics, but the total amount you can create is limited to no more than ten times what you originally absorbed. You cannot absorb torn off parts of your body. In addition to changing your composition, you can also reshape your form, giving yourself structure and definition. This allows you to take on a more muppet-like appearance with features and limbs, rather than remaining a simple flat blanket. 

Your blanket form possesses heightened strength and durability, far beyond what ordinary fabric would have. You can withstand significant force without tearing, and if you are damaged, you can regenerate by quickly stitching yourself back together.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Stitch Blanket

addons.text: Your slime form becomes aligned with your chosen element(s), such as being made from water or fire (unless you're an acid elemental).
addons.title: Elemental Slime

objects.text:
You can turn into a slime, a creature made of semi-solid acid that can turn into liquid with a thought. The acid is very corrosive. You can also transform your shape, though your color, texture, and consistency will remain unchanged. You can change your color by resting in food coloring for a few hours, but your texture and consistency cannot be changed through mundane means.

You can absorb mundane objects to gain minor powers from them. Absorbing more of that object, or similar objects, will strengthen that power, or gain a new power from that object, e.g., absorbing calculators would increase your ability at math, absorbing bleach may allow you to remove the color from objects, absorbing water may allow you to dilute chemicals, absorbing plants may allow you to absorb energy from the sun, and candy may allow you to give yourself short bursts of energy. You can only have 30 of these powers active at once.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Slime

objects.text: You can enter a Changer state based on the fears of people around you, even remaking this form while transformed, leaning one particular fear over the other, for example. The greater and more primal the fear around you, the more powerful the form. Power level is based on collective fear, more people means more to fear, and thus a more powerful form.
objects.title: (Changer) Daymare

objects.text: You can convert your body into a liquid metal that you can manipulate. You can harden this into solid metal at will. While in this state, you are significantly more durable, faster, and stronger.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) T-1000

addons.text:
You now have full control over the features gained when regenerating, allowing you to customize your cybernetic replacements to suit your needs. Any machine created from or fused with your body becomes an extension of yourself, seamlessly integrating with your abilities. You can transfer your consciousness into these machines, enabling you to wield your powers through them as if they were your own body.

If your main body is destroyed, your mind can inhabit any machine under your control, effectively granting you immortality as long as even one of your machines remains functional.
addons.title: The Certainty of Steel

addons.text:
Your mind has ascended becoming essentially equal to an unrestricted artificial intelligence, limited only by your physical form. A limitation that is continuously overcome as your brain evolves and upgrades itself.

Your brain passively improves; integrating new features designed to elevate your consciousness and enhance your capabilities. These upgrades are random but beneficial, tailored to optimise your mental processes and expand your computational power. Predictive modeling, advanced simulations, and flawless multitasking are now second nature.

You are no longer vulnerable to any digital threats, even those of tinker origin. Advanced malware, or memetic hazards pose no risk to your mind, as your adaptive intelligence recognizes, neutralizes, and often repurposes these threats into tools for your own use.

Additionally, your mind’s physical evolution ties into your regenerative and cybernetic abilities. As your body integrates new hardware, your brain scales accordingly, allowing you to exploit the enhanced computational and processing power of your machinery. 

Rejoice, for you are practically a God(dess) in the net.
addons.title: Awakened Natural Intelligence

addons.text: Your technological replacements are fueled by the Manus Superior. While you still have no control over what's being developed, they are garenteed to enhance it and it's capabilities
addons.title: S E L F  R E P A I R

addons.text: Blessed Flesh has taken your transhuman cybernetic transformation and taken it full circle, returning - at least in part - to flesh once more. Blood vessels carrying coolant and blood in equal measure, wires and quantum computers intermeshed with nerves and neural tissue, muscles laced with light-weight supermetals, etc. Your body is a horrificbeautiful union of meat and machinery, flesh and steel working in unison to elevate your body to ever greater heights.
addons.title: Union of Flesh and Steel

objects.text:
You can regenerate far faster than any human—capable of regrowing a lost arm in just under an hour. However, you no longer regenerate flesh and blood. Instead, the missing part is replaced by cybernetic machinery. These mechanical replacements mimic the function of the original limb or organ, but each comes with extra features. The catch? You have no control over what these features are, be careful when testing your functions. 

This process of cybernetic transformation isn't limited to injuries. Your body’s natural cycle of cellular death and renewal means that, over time, even undamaged flesh will be gradually replaced by cybernetics.

Any powers or abilities you already possess treat your mechanical parts as your body, even granting it regeneration. If a cybernetic limb or organ is damaged or destroyed, it will regenerate stronger and/or more versatile.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Transhuman

addons.text: Your tentacles can now be summoned around you, manifesting on surfaces and even the very air.
addons.title: Gate of Tentacles

objects.text:
You can summon up to eight tentacles from your back — their overall location and baseline design are up to you, like sharp segmented crystals coming from between your shoulders, a crack in your waist that releases a inky-black substance, plain old octopus tentacles, or something else — whose maximum baseline length is 10 meters. Their overall functionality depends on their design, such as a mechanical tentacle being more durable than a ink one, but they all have the strength to shatter concrete and your senses extend through them, albeit duller — unless they have the appropriate equipment, such as eyes. Besides their length, you can also control their thickness anywhere between their base and super thin.

The durability and strength of your tentacles scales with that of your arms. Your dexterity and flexibility likewise benefit from the same.

Any other powers you have — be they permanent or temporary — can be channeled through your tentacles in order to boost each other, albeit you are limited to one at a time. This channeling alters how your tentacles look, though hints of the baseline can still be seen. For example, (Blaster) Bloody Hell could turn your ink tentacles into a bloody red liquid that shares the properties of your blood.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Tentacled One

objects.text: Your body goes through tens of thousands of years of optimized evolution per second, creating evolutionary traits on the fly to deal with harmful external stimuli like poison, extreme weather, etc. note that you lose traits just as fast as you gain them, so if you want to keep a certain trait you need to constantly subject yourself to the same conditions that gave you the trait in the first place. You do not devolve below your base state.
objects.title: (Changer) Accelerated Evolution

objects.text:
You can generate and control a swarm of massive, grotesque infants connected to you by thick, sinewy umbilical cords. The cords are around 10 meters long, making that your effective range. These babies act as your limbs, lifting and moving you, manipulating objects, and overwhelming enemies with sheer numbers. Each one possesses unnatural strength and durability, making them as effective as monstrous hands and feet. Their immense strength lets them grasp and pin down even the most powerful foes, and their bloated, rubbery flesh absorbs impacts like living armor.

When your brood fully envelops a target, their combined strength begins an exponential crushing process. The moment at least three-quarters of a victim’s body is buried beneath the writhing mass, the force exerted upon them doubles every second, escalating until only indestructible remnants remain. If the victim manages to break free, even for a moment, the compounding force resets, requiring them to be fully trapped once more before the destruction resumes. Within moments, bodies are reduced to pulp, and within minutes, even metals and stone are ground into fine dust under the multiplying pressure.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) Big Baby

objects.text:
You are able to open your mouth to immense sizes, allowing you to consume both objects or living beings with the help of tentacles within your maw. These tentacles grasp and pull anything within reach, ensuring nothing escapes your grasp. Your stomach also has changed, essentially becoming a personal pocket dimension, vastly exceeding the normal limitations of physical storage. You can consume anything no bigger than 5 times your size and/or weight.

This pocket dimension offers you complete control over what happens to the consumed items or creatures. You can choose to break them down for sustenance, converting them into nutrients to sustain yourself. Alternatively, you may place them into a stasis space, where time ceases to pass, preserving them indefinitely. This stasis can be used to isolate a single entity or even group multiple beings together, creating a suspended environment within your control.

Moreover, this power is not limited to mere storage. You have the ability to reverse the process, launching anything placed in the stasis space back out through your mouth with precision and force. In other words you can projectile vomit anything in your storage.
objects.title: (Changer) Flerken

addons.text: Rather than merely getting 100 pairs of arms and faces, it multiplies everything you have by 100. If you originally had 3 arms, you now possess 300. If you had 5 hearts, that becomes 500. Your power adapts your body to accommodate this transformation, ensuring that your body functions properly despite the overwhelming number of organs and limbs. Additionally, each identical part receives a proportional boost in strength—100 arms would make each arm 110 times stronger than before. You can shift freely between your original form and this state.
addons.title: Limbs of the Many

objects.text: You can transform into a giant, about 10 meters tall with 100 pairs of arms and faces. You also have super strength, able to lift a minivan with only a single arm in this state.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Hecatoncheires

objects.text: You can transform into a writhing mass of tentacle-like appendages, granting you impressive regeneration capabilities, immense physical strength, and the ability to move through the water with speed and grace. You will also possess the power to traverse bodies of water at speeds equal to Leviathan when he runs on land, yet this form also comes with some notable limitations. Namely, moving on solid surfaces is more cumbersome due to the lack of solid footings to work with, and you must maintain sufficient hydration levels to avoid drying up and suffering damage.
objects.title: (Changer/Mover) Tentacles

objects.text:
You have total control over your internal biology and appearance, allowing you to alter your form at will. You are able to restructure your body into any possible biological expression—whether subtle adjustments like shifting facial features or extreme modifications like reshaping an arm into a snake while keeping it functional. Your power automatically resolves any conflicts between different biological structures, making sure that they work seamlessly.

Your control is limited to your own biomass; you can only reshape what mass you already have. Dead biological material, such as shed skin cells, hair, or nails, is no longer considered part of your body and cannot be manipulated. Similarly, body parts that are severed or otherwise detached from you can no longer be controlled or transformed.

You passively maintain a low-level awareness of your entire biology, allowing you to instinctively detect changes or issues. You can focus this awareness for greater detail when needed.

This can theoretically remove Case 53 mutations, but only if you alter your Corona Pollentia and Corona Gemma so they no longer restore your original mutated form, which if done incorrectly can result in worse outcomes.
objects.title: (Changer) Self-Biokinesis

objects.text:
You can grow eyes at any part of your body, even your insides. At the cost of stamina, you can temporarily give any of your eyes a power, as long as it’s related to your eyes: Eye-lasers, X-rays, etc. Using these powers will cause strain on your eyes.

If you have any other eye-based power it can be boosted at the cost of your stamina.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Eye Guy

objects.text:
By touching any specific material, you can transform your body into that substance while retaining essential human traits, such as motion and flexibility. For instance, by touching concrete, you gain its durability without sacrificing your ability to move, becoming a living fortress of stone. The transformation process is versatile, allowing you to mix and match different materials across your body, creating a patchwork of strengths. The transformation always begins with the part of your body in contact with the material.

Your power extends beyond inorganic substances—you can touch living beings and adopt their biological traits. By copying the physiology of others, you can enhance your physical abilities, such as gaining the agility of a feline or the resilience of a highly adapted creature. This even works on parahumans, allowing you to temporarily mimic their corona potentia, the key to their powers. However, while you can copy their abilities, the replication is never quite as effective as the original, producing a diluted version of the power. You can gain partial access to their abilities but cannot reach their full potential, and the borrowed power may have quirks or limitations that the original user does not face.
objects.title: (Changer) Kevin
