objects.text: You can transform into several ecosystems. You have full control and minutia of the types ranging from jungles, forests, tundras, deserts, and rainforests, to freshwater and marine ecosystems if a natural water source is nearby—easily changing between them when transformed—as well as their flora and (non-sentient) fauna, with a keen insight of all species and their life cycles, being an expansive control of said flora and (non-sentient) fauna at a macro and micro level to all animals within the ecosystem's food chain. You can choose the ecosystem’s layout when you turn into it, only adding and adjusting things on a macro scale when transformed. This ecosystem, though, is limited by an area of a mile radius.
objects.title: (Changer/Breaker) Biosphere

objects.text: You have the power to transform into a bird so large that its size is closer to a house instead of any normal bird. This form is very fast with flight in the hundreds of miles per hour; its size also comes with great strength, enough to pick up an entire lorry between your talons while being durable enough to require concentrated high-calibre fire to pierce your skin. Your natural weapons are also quite strong: talons capable of penetrating steel and a beak that even mid-level brutes would be wary of.
objects.title: (Changer/Breaker) Roc

objects.text:
Your power allows you to grow layers of Endbringer flesh over your body, shaped into a manipulable, armor-like shell. The more layers you grow, the progressively denser and stronger your inner layers become until you reach a point equivalent to an Endbringer. However, this is a gradual ramping effect that takes time to achieve.

This comes with no additional strength and the end-armor treats your body as its core; meaning that if you summon it while injured, or become injured when it's active, the armor will have gaps exposing your actual body.
objects.title: (Changer/Breaker) Endarmor

objects.text:
The insides of your body changed to slowly resemble a facsimile of Endbringer flesh, slowly folding dimensionally and layering itself to consolidate into a fleshy yet solid core at the center of your body. Your power steadily generates layers using natural resources such as fat stores, caloric intakes, and surrounding kinetic energy you act upon or affect you, empowering the dimensional folding and layering process. Each layer confers a degree of strength and dense durability while never sacrificing your original weight, with every layer giving x2.5 increase in your physical abilities, alongside a growing ability to circumvent the grasp physics has over you the more layers you possess as your layers do more than letting you ignore your ‘true’ weight and density. 

Though you can’t have more than 30 layers, those layers are never as durable as an Endbringer, with the punches of a Brute 5-7 or as formidable as a Shaker 5-8 capable of dealing with your unnatural physiology.
objects.title: (Changer/Breaker) Ladon

objects.text:
You can transform into a bipedal Anklyosaurus that can breathe fire. You're moderately more durable and powerful than an actual historical Anklyosaurus, and you can regenerate at a moderate pace. You can also jump 30 meters into the air (~100 feet), break stones with ease, and order legions of summonable minions of varying abilities to do your bidding. They are loyal to you, but they hold their own wills, so they won't blindly obey all your orders.

Your insides are also filled with loyal, intelligent minions. If you swallow someone whole, they'll be transported into your gut, where they can help or hinder you in various ways, though your internal minions will fight against anyone that tries to harm you.

Some of the effects that can be activated from your inside include growing to be multiple times larger than Behemoth (and making you the strongest Brute recorded by a significant margin), overclocking any of your abilities (including non-super ones), controlling your body (in a very jittery manner), altering your digestion, putting you to sleep, waking you up, and resuscitating you.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) Bowser

objects.text: You can transform into mythical creatures. Your maximum size is that of New York City... incidentally, you'd need to be that size and a Dragon if you wanted to kill an Endbringer, though you'd likely destroy the city and everything nearby as well. Your growth rate is 1 inch per second.
objects.title: (Changer) Lung? Hah! I'm the real dragon here.

objects.text:
Your cells automatically replicate any bodily alteration, trait, and characteristic that is regarded as stronger, healthier, or simply superior to your previous bodily or genetic state and to the user in general without straying from your baseline bodily shape and appearance, being invisible to the naked eye, preferring inconspicuous changes or changes masquerading as normal. You can mimic Changer or Brute powers by replicating their traits and integrating them into yourself.

At first, you can only permanently copy little and/or beneficial traits from other people, your ability stopping you from copying Brute and/or Changer powers or ignoring them entirely. This occurs as a Manton Limit of the ability, it senses you aren’t well-built or possess a good fitness base to sustain and utilize those traits on their own, meaning you have to build a base of bodily characteristics that aid you.

Once you finish nurturing physiological traits capable of handling powers, your power senses it’s sufficient, lifting its Manton Limit, and being capable of replicating beneficial parts of Brute and/or Changer powers.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Chimeric Integration

objects.text:
You can transform into any non-legendary or mythical Pokémon. The descriptions of Pokémon found in Pokédex entries are ignored. Metagross isn't as smart as a supercomputer, Alakazam doesn't have an IQ over 9000, and your mother can be alive while you're a Cubone.

Your transformations are not limited to four moves; this limitation is only for competitive fights. Pokémon will usually have around a dozen moves. When your Shard runs out of juice, you're stuck in whatever form you're in at the time.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Pokémon

objects.text: You can freely shapeshift your body by copying the body parts and/or tissue of any organism within a very short radius. Elements copied can be scaled up and down at the your leisure. If you copy a parahuman's brain, it is possible to gain access to their power. Note that you can only copy living tissue.
objects.title: (Changer) Synthesis

objects.text: You have been granted the ability to transform into a black tar-like, monstrous version of animals with bone-like armor. These animals are not only stronger, faster, and more durable but, depending on the type, may have a special ability. These forms are suited for death and to bring about negative emotions, of which you can detect and even feed upon for a minor temporary strength boost while in your Grimm form.
objects.title: (Changer) Grimm

addons.text: Whenever you Challenge someone you can turn your Knockoff copy into the power you’d gain if you beat them, you can turn it back to the one you initially chose whenever you want. Though you’d have to Challenge them again to regain it. If you manage to defeat them and gain the power you copied, you can overlap them additively, likewise with each upgrade.
addons.title: Free Trial!

objects.text: Are you a fan of a parahumans power but haven’t got the budget to spare? Choose any canon cape, you get a T0 version of their whole power. How about Eidolon? Enjoy your three barely noticeable or useful powers. Alexandria? A small overall boost, increasing durability, strength, jumps and enhancing your mind, as well as slightly slower aging. Legend? Faster acceleration and far leaping with bright and harmless Rainbow Lasers! How exactly these weaker versions manifest is up to you, like flight becoming slow falling, a higher jump, gliding or levitation, but they have to encapsulate the major strokes of the cape you’re copying them from and also be appropriately weakened.
objects.title: (Trump) Knockoff

addons.text: You can now tell exactly what each effect is doing and can even use it to track the relative location of the source of the effect: the Parahumans themselves.
addons.title: Parahuman Bloodhound

addons.text:
Your senses are keenly attuned to parahuman or supernatural phenomena more than before e.g. being sensitive to parahuman powers in greater detail, seeing the alteration of a brain’s synapses under a Master effect bit by bit, watching the process of how Shaker or Striker powers function or how constrained they are in real-time on the environment or other people, feeling out traces left from previous uses, identifying the power responsible in question to a probable parahuman once they’re within your field of awareness, and handily tracking or neutralize them if you can as soon as you fully made a profile running deep to what their Shard is by parsing their power expression.

As a consequence, your senses possess a greater amount of depth and variety focused on esoteric or parahuman phenomena, with synesthetic senses for better visualization i.e. your vision and touch can perceive a Brute’s muscle filaments and understand their method of reinforcement or regenerative abilities, or seeing and feeling the Simurgh’s “scream” and its effects on people by a sensory interplay of touch, sight, and hearing.
addons.title: Parahuman Tuning Fork

objects.text:
You can see the supernatural: you can visually identify areas/objects/people being affected by parahuman powers (Glory Girl’s awe/fear aura, telekinetically controlled objects, a person with a passive Brute power, power generated material like Kaiser’s blades, areas under Thinker observation, etc.) as a “buzzing glow” around the affected area/object.

You can't distinguish what the powers are doing, just that they exist and the boundaries of them. You can, however, recognize and identify each unique effect to the point that you can tell the difference between two different overlapping or identical-looking effects, i.e., if there were two overlapping Shaker auras, you’d be able to tell where one ends and the other begins, as well as recognize one of those Shaker auras from having seen it elsewhere earlier.

This sight can't identify normal tinkertech or its effects, as they are not by default under the effect of any parahuman powers.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Third Eye

objects.text:
You are able to create small tetrahedral anchors that may be used as an origin for the powers of anyone who can see them. They may also be affected by powers themselves, ignoring Manton limits when doing so.

For example Purity could fire from an anchor, or Panacea could reshape an anchor.

You may selectively choose how the anchors themselves are affected by powers and physics, as well as who may use them.
objects.title: (Trump) Anchor

addons.text: Your T0 power from Knockoff is also affected by Rainbow's boost effect.
addons.title: Eighth Color

addons.text: One Letter treats Rainbow's T0s as a separate pool of T0s, allowing you to alter one of Rainbow's T0 and one normal T0 at the same time. Altering a Rainbow T0 will have its [Time] carry over to the altered power.
addons.title: Chroma Shift

objects.text: You can swap between seven different T0 powers chosen when you get this power. As you use each T0 power, they individually accumulate [Time], you can expend an equal amount of [Time] from each power to temporarily use all seven of them simultaneously at 700% strength. If you use each T0 power for one hour, you will be able to enter the boosted state for one hour.
objects.title: (Trump) Rainbow

objects.text: You can see what powers someone has, as well as if they're actively using it.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Power Sight

objects.text: Whenever a power is directly used on you, it fails, and cannot be used again on you for 5 minutes. A power only works on you when it failed the previous time, resulting in powers failing every other time. This doesn't work on Thinker and Stranger powers. You can allow a power to be used on you if you consent.
objects.title: (Trump) Error, Try Again

addons.text: When you gain your enhancement from Madness, your rage is also ignited, reaching what it was at its peak. Your rage now also makes your other powers stronger in the same way it enhances your physical abilities.  Your instincts for combat are heightened even further, and thinker powers in general struggle to get a full grasp on you.
addons.title: Madman's Rampage

objects.text: At the cost of your logical thinking/planing, you gain a major boost to your physical capabilities and powers. Additionally, you gain a boost to your instincts, capable of “feeling” the most suitable development for oneself during combat. You become immune to short term procognition and analysis based thinker powers.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Madness

objects.text: You can swap the powers of any two Parahumans for an hour. No matter what complicated web of power swapping you do, eventually everyone will have their original power back. You can choose whether they instinctively know how to use their new powers. Your range is 1 kilometer.
objects.title: (Trump) Powerswap

objects.text: You can choose anyone in your line of sight and tag them. If the tagged person has a power applied to them or uses their power, a similar thing happens to you. If they get buffed, you get buffed and if they teleport you teleport too. This includes mental simulations, time travel, and various kinds of enhancements given by powers. You don't have control over their power, you can only make it so that effects apply to them are applied to you. If they teleport, you can choose to appear within 50 meters of where they are.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Hijack Council

objects.text: “Fill thy hollow fist with the Will to Protect; this power is called Conviction.” Your strength is drawn from your beliefs, your emotions fueling both your body and any powers you wield. When acting in a way that aligns with your ideals—whether noble or selfish—you receive a significant boost, pushing past normal human limits. A hero fighting for others, a warrior chasing revenge, or even someone driven by sheer pride can all tap into this power. So long as you hold to your convictions with absolute certainty, they will strengthen you. This enhancement isn’t just a vague feeling—it translates into faster strikes, greater endurance, and an almost unshakable resilience as long as your resolve holds firm. Beyond that, you can directly channel your emotions into your attacks, weaponising your determination, anger, or even sorrow to enhance your power. A punch thrown in fury might hit with the force of a sledgehammer, while a desperate last stand could grant you the endurance to keep fighting long past exhaustion. If you possess other abilities, this emotional drive amplifies them as well, making your flames burn hotter, your barriers more unyielding, or your speed nearly untouchable. However, this strength is not without its limits. If your faith in your ideals wavers or your emotions are clouded by doubt, the boost weakens. Blind rage or reckless passion may grant power, but without direction, it can be wild and inefficient. To wield this ability effectively, you must understand yourself—what you stand for, what drives you—and be willing to commit to it fully. The greater your conviction, the greater your strength.
objects.title: (Trump) Conviction

addons.text:
When you are attacking your Marked target, you are now guaranteed to crit on hit. You have 85% chance to only do double damage, 8% for triple damage, 6% to quadruple, and 1% to do ten times damage. 

If your target has 2 Marks, then you have 70% chance to do double damage, 15% chance to do triple damage, 10% chance to do quadruple damage, and 5% chance to do ten times damage. If your target has 3 Marks, then you have a 65% chance to do double damage, 20% to do triple damage, 15% to do quadruple damage, and 10% to do ten times damage.
addons.title: Hunter's Strike

objects.text:
You have the ability to apply a Mark to anyone within your line of sight. You can only have one Mark applied, which can last for at most 8 hours. If you succeed in killing your Marked target, the Mark can be applied to someone else immediately, but if you fail, it has a "cooldown" of 4 hours until you can apply it again.

This Mark has multiple effects designed around enhancing your ability to hunt and kill your target. To better hunt a target who may run, you have the ability to sense the general direction and distance of your target. To better hunt a target who may hide, you have enhanced senses when searching for your target and are more resistant to Stranger effects that benefit your target. Lastly, to better kill a target who is strong, any attack you make against your target is 25% more effective.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Hunters Mark

objects.text: You can swap the expression of powers to any Parahuman for an hour. They will possess the same Shard but have an alternate version of what they could be. Shaker power can be turned into a Striker power.
objects.title: (Trump) Scramble

addons.text: Now you can train up all of your Tier 0 powers up to 3 SP with Training Montage, and grant the trained-up versions via Endow.
addons.title: Tier 0.5

addons.text: Endow allows you to grow Tier 0 offshoots with Power Seed; these start growing from practically nothing and take a week to develop, fully maturing at the 1 SP power level. But an offshoot can grow simultaneously with a normal Power Seed, and successfully growing offshoots on somebody will increase the 5-power limit of Endow on them. Any Tier 0 power taken back will always operate at 100% power while also being added to the list of possible endowed powers.
addons.title: Offshoot

addons.text: Each Tier 0 Power you generate through David’s Trash Can is added to the catalog of Tier 0 Powers you can endow onto others through your touch. This also increases the number of Tier 0 powers you can endow to 10. If you have Synergy then you can create addons between compatible Tier 0 Powers, both those you grant and those you use yourself, while your addons are greater than the sum of its parts they cannot exceed their value in SP, so an addon using 5 Tier 0 Powers can only be as strong as a 5 SP Tier 1 power.
addons.title: Infinite Zero’s

addons.text: You are capable of granting others your altered T0s. If you give out a T0 you do not already possess, you can only make one change to it when doing so. You are free to give out any previously altered T0 made using One Letter.
addons.title: Altered Gifts

addons.text:
When giving people T0s through Endow, you can also give them the same [Time] mechanic as Rainbow. This limits them to using only one of the T0s you've given them at a time, but they can expend [Time] from all of the T0s to enter their own boosted state.

The percentage boost they receive depends on how many T0s you've given them. If they only have two, their T0s will go up to 200% strength. If you have Prismatic Boost, their T0s will be temporarily enhanced to higher SP levels instead, two T0s would become 2 SP powers while boosted.
addons.title: Gifts With Rain-bows

objects.text:
With a touch, you are capable of granting up to 5 Tier 0 powers to an individual. These powers may be revoked at will. However, should you die, they will retain them. You may apply this to any number of people.

Any addons that they meet the requirements for will also be granted. Though you may restrict them if you want to.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Endow

objects.text:
You have a much, much weaker expression of Eidolon’s own Trump Power; this turns you into a facsimile of one of the most famous Trumps Earth Bet has ever seen, albeit a depressingly weak one.

You have a mental catalog containing all of the Tier 0 powers found in this CYOA, and from this catalog, you can manifest up to 10 Tier 0 powers at a time. It takes a minute to load a lesser power from this catalog; you can manifest multiple powers at once.

You can also create new Tier 0 powers not found in this CYOA and add them to your mental catalog. Each power takes 5 minutes to create, and you can only make one at a time. 

You do trigger any addons between the CYOA’s Tier 0 powers, but you cannot make new addons between Tier 0 powers.
objects.title: (Trump) David’s Trash Can

objects.text: You are able to improve the capabilities, such as physical ability, skills, or powers, of others by simply ordering them. The more specific the order as well the more closely they follow the order, the greater the boost. There's no master effect in play, so others will still need to follow through on their own volition. This doesn't work through the devices; orders need to be given face-to-face.
objects.title: (Trump) Commander

objects.text: You can select one person to be your Master. While this doesn't force you to follow their commands, you get stronger when you do so. This must come directly from them and recordings don't work. You can swap whoever is your Master whenever you want.
objects.title: (Trump) Loyal Companion

addons.text: Something has changed about your crystals, the inclusion of Magik Adept metamorphosing them into something more. The crystals you create through your power are now physically manifested Formulas, including the crystals created from the powers of others. This means that while the crystals themselves remain one-use, you can study them to learn their principles for your own use, potentially even recreating the crystallized power as a cantrip, although the process of studying and converting a crystal into a formula is hard and complex. You can also crystallize any cantrips you have prepared, allowing them to be shared with others or Tinkered with. Taking Crystal Tinker with this grants you an intuitive sense - bordering on a Thinker/Tinker power - for deciphering the principles of crystallized powers and altering them for your own use.
addons.title: Crystal Formulae

objects.text: You have the ability to crystalize powers, turning them into handheld consumables that anyone can use. A crystal can hold either a single use of an instant power, or 1 minute of a continuous power. These crystals may be used by tinkers in their creations, and they can also be affected by some trump powers, particularly ones that boost, modify, or nullify powers. It takes a minute to crystalize these powers, and you may crystalize the powers of other people if you are both touching them and have their consent. These crystals have a composition similar to quartz.
objects.title: (Trump) Power Crystallization

objects.text:
Powers used against you will only deal half the damage they should normally do. Power-based flamethrowers will do less damage than normal flamethrowers. Resistance Increase also protects you from various forms of instant death, reality warping, and all forms of strange and esoteric effects. While it doesn't fully negate it, it makes it so it has less effect on you. To the point, you would survive a power that would normally kill you in an instant but only barely.

This can apply to Stranger, Trump, and Master powers as well. Although this power is less effective against All-or-Nothings.
objects.title: (Trump) Resistance Increase

objects.text: You possess two distinct operational states, each enhancing a different domain of your being: one of intellect, the other of brute force. You must always be in either one or the other. Jekyll mode is a transformation of the mind. Upon entering this state, you acquire a Thinker rating, and with it, the shackles of mental fatigue are utterly removed. Sleep deprivation, information overload, burnout—none of these apply to you anymore. Every facet of cognition—logic, empathy, memory, creativity—is elevated to the brink of parahuman ability, each function reinforcing the others in a seamless, ever-efficient mental engine. However, in this mode your brain never stops. You’re always analyzing, always thinking, from running background calculations, deconstructing conversations in real-time, or making subconscious connections between seemingly unrelated data, your mind refuses to idle. This perpetual mental overclocking risks pulling you inward, the world can start to feel distant as your focus narrows, or worse—your thoughts spiral endlessly, looping in increasingly complex patterns you can’t quite shut down. Hyde mode, by contrast, shifts all emphasis to the body. Here, you gain a Brute rating. Physical exhaustion ceases to exist as a concept; stamina becomes effectively limitless. Every biological function related to movement, strength, speed, and durability is elevated to the edge of parahuman capability. Muscles coil with explosive power, bones and sinew harden, reflexes sharpen to an almost predatory level. The downside, however, is that your emotional regulation, empathy, strategic patience are cast aside. Your brain deliberately minimizes functions that don’t directly support immediate combat. You become driven by simple directives: fight, overpower, survive. Finesse and technique are deprioritized in favor of overwhelming power and instinctual aggression. Note that this isn’t a case of dual personalities. You don’t become someone else. Rather, each mode reshapes your priorities and mental frameworks to better suit the context—intellectual or physical. If you possess Holding Back, you are granted a third option: to return to your baseline self, operating outside either mode. Otherwise, you must always exist as either the brilliant mind of Jekyll or the unstoppable force of Hyde.
objects.title: (Trump) Jekyll and Hyde

addons.text: If a power you copied using Temu Copier has secondary powers then your copy will not need to occupy any slots for you to use those secondary powers.
addons.title: Fraction of a Fraction

objects.text:
You can copy permanently on touch, but you only gain the secondary powers of your targets. Secondary in this context means anything that isn’t part of the main powerset and wouldn’t by itself be categorized as a power, however, this doesn’t include things that are dependent on the power itself like power senses. Examples would be Brandish’s resistance to blinding lights, Glory Girls throws having more speed and force than they should, as well as not getting dizzy from high speed maneuvers and Aegis capability to deal with pain. 

Capes whose powerset have several secondary powers to copy have more rules. With Circus as an example, it would be possible to copy all of their powers except for their pyrokinesis and storage space as they’re only enhancing something that you already possess, but you’d get much weaker versions at peak human level instead of superhuman and you could only copy them one at a time with a week long cooldown after each acquisition.

Parahumans that don’t have copyable secondary powers still grant benefits by improving the next secondary power you copy, giving it slightly more oomph. If you copy enough similar powers they can develop into a proper parahuman power, like spatial sense allowing you to perceive your surroundings even with your eyes closed.
objects.title: (Trump) Secondary

objects.text: You can temporarily double the strength of your body’s capabilities and your powers, you can also transfer this boost to another person. As a downside every exertion of stamina is twice as exhausting. How long the boosts last is tied to your stamina. When the boost is transferred to someone else you are still the one who pays the stamina cost for their actions while boosted.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Twice Critical

addons.text: You can expend [Time] from an individual T0 Rainbow power to temporarily give someone the boosted version of it.
addons.title: Chromatic Boon

objects.text: At the cost of losing it yourself, you can give others any powers you have to another. If you can create/copy/steal powers, then you can give these powers to others. Temporary powers can also be given, but only last until their duration is up, after which the power will go away. You can also choose to split a power, dividing it equally between yourself and your target(s).
objects.title: (Trump) Bestowal

objects.text: You can copy a 50% weaker version of any Parahuman's powerset if they're within 150 meters of you. You keep this powerset for an hour after they leave your range.
objects.title: (Trump) Fae Court

objects.text:
You can redirect the effects and expressions of other powers away from their intended targets and onto yourself or something directly connected to you.

Whenever a power attempts to affect another valid target, you may forcibly alter its destination. Attacks, enhancements, sensory effects, movement powers, spatial distortions, status effects, summons, bindings, transmissions, or other manifestations can be rerouted so that they instead affect you, an object you possess, an area you occupy, or another target meaningfully associated with you.

This does not negate the power or weaken its effect. The expression occurs normally, only with its destination forcibly rewritten.

The redirection must remain broadly compatible with the original effect. A power targeting minds cannot be redirected into a wall unless that wall possesses a valid mental component, while a spatial effect aimed at a city block may instead be centered on your immediate surroundings.

Power effects redirected toward you are treated as willingly accepted for the purpose of hostile resistance, defensive rejection, or automatic countermeasures. This does not guarantee safety, merely successful transfer.

You cannot directly force powers to target completely unrelated destinations. The effect must always resolve onto you or something sufficiently tied to you through possession, proximity, ownership, influence, or direct association.
objects.title: (Trump) Get Here To Me!

addons.text: When pushed to your limit, when you have exhausted all your tricks, when you have no strength in your limbs anymore, when faced with something far beyond you, you will feel an unexpected trickle of power. You can never falter or fall down. You will always have just a bit more strength and be able to push on just a bit more. Your powers will grow slowly; the worse the situation you are in, the greater they grow. While its growth in raw power is minimal, its growth in versatility is tremendous. Most of its growth will be aimed at assisting you in your current situation, prioritizing now without much consideration for the future.
addons.title: Plus Ultra

addons.text:
No longer do you only gain strength by standing by death’s doors; as you take the final step and are embraced by death, you will receive a boon.
 
Your body, once you have perished, will continue to stand, its powers strengthened to their peak. Much like any Master power you have, your body will act to avenge your death, becoming a ferocious beast puppeteering your remains. It will carry out any plan you may have before your death, but know that no matter what it does, it is not you. It is, at best, a shadow of what once was. If you had a regeneration-based power, you will be able to be revived after a while.
addons.title: Push Beyond

objects.text: When you're under extreme stress, exhaustion, or overwork, your powers magnify in strength, effectiveness, and overall control. It responds to your state of mind, gaining a considerable boost when you're not in the most ideal conditions. This boost grows if you have recently been or currently in the middle of combat.
objects.title: (Trump) Desperation

objects.text: You can turn off anyone's power with a touch. However, you can only do this with one person at a time. Useful if you need to make sure someone arrives at the Birdcage though. There is no time limit on this power. If you die this power is deactivated.
objects.title: (Trump) Nope!

addons.text: You can now reallocate more specialised stats, including but not limited to charisma, creativity, wisdom, sense and perception.
addons.title: Focused Stats

objects.text: You can take one of five stats and reallocate them. This can be, Strength, Speed, Durability, Intelligence, and Dexterity. By decreasing Strength you can increase your Speed and Dexterity or increase Intellect by reducing Durability. You cannot go over the total amount of stats you possess, however, temporary buffs and other powers do add to the total value. If you possess a Gamer System, you may reallocate any of the stats you have there.
objects.title: (Trump/Changer) Reallocate

objects.text: The longer you use your powers, the more they ramp up. This could mean being physically stronger, firing projectiles faster, or even having a farther range. It ramps by 1.01 times its current power every second, to a max of 5 minutes for about 20 times it original power. If you stop using your powers for longer than 5 seconds then the ramp resets. This does not apply to passive powers.
objects.title: (Trump) Ramp

objects.text: You can gradually enhance an item that you use or have on your person over time, improving the quality of its functions and granting it powers. These enhancements become more effective as the quality of the base item increases, and the rate of improvement speeds up when in active combat. You may divide your power between more than one item, at the expense of enhancement speed.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Enhancer

addons.text: Those you complete the challenges of, get a boost to their power similar to what you’ve gained from them, so completing their first challenge would be equal to them gaining a T0 of their own power, with challenges at 5 or beyond diminishing weaknesses or loosening restrictions.
addons.title: Shared Benefits

objects.text: You can permanently boost the powers of any Parahuman based on a certain amount of charges you use. You gain a charge every 24 hours which can be imbued into any Parahuman. Every time you boost a Parahuman, the strength they gain gets weaker the more you do it. Boosts will completely stop once they reach 200% power. This can be used to recharge Eidolon. To fully boost someone to 200% power requires 6 months.
objects.title: (Trump) Boosted

objects.text: By being in active combat, your abilities become stronger. The greater your involvement—whether by leading or facing strong opponents—the more your powers are boosted. This boost is dependent on what you are doing in combat, if you are directly fighting then you would get more raw power or subpowers to boost your main one. If you are leading or commanding others then the boosts will be more focused on versatility and support effects. This boost is removed once you leave combat. The boost can, at best, triple your power’s capabilities or strength, with this requiring you to be at the centre of the conflict.
objects.title: (Trump) Active Combat

objects.text:
With a single touch, you can grant someone a temporary superpower by forcing them to briefly experience an alternative version of their life where they underwent a trigger event. For one minute, they gain the power they would have developed in that alternate timeline and can use it as if it were their own.

This effect doesn’t depend on whether the person could actually trigger in the real world—if they can’t, the timeline you draw from adjusts reality just enough to create one where they could.

You don’t choose the power, and neither does the person receiving it. The only guarantee is that, for one minute, they become who they could have been—had things gone differently.

Each time you use your power on the same person, the result changes. You don’t pull from the same timeline twice. The trigger event you connect them to may be slightly different, wildly altered, or even completely unrelated to the previous one. As a result, the power they receive can shift in small ways—or change entirely—depending on which version of their alternate timeline you reach into.

If the person already has powers, the temporary one is added on top of their original set. These additions are usually synergistic, as both abilities come from the same shard.
objects.title: (Trump) Spark

objects.text: When you touch a Parahuman, you receive a full-strength copy of their power for an hour.
objects.title: (Trump) Copycat

addons.text:
Your two Trump powers have synergized, allowing you to reallocate usage times for parahuman powers with multiple purviews.

Meaning that if you want, you can take the timer from Alexandria's Thinker power and Flight and give it to her Stasis-based Brute power, extending its timer from 5 to 15 minutes of use.
addons.title: Switch Up Dial-Up

addons.text: Copy and Copycat merge, instead of a 5 minutes timer or a 1 hour countdown you have a 5 hours timer.
addons.title: Copy^2

objects.text:
By touching a Parahuman you have a vague idea of what their powers does and can copy it, upon copy you gain a more in-depth knowledge of the power. 

Although you have no limits to how many powers you can copy, unless you maintain constant contact with the original user your copies will cease to exist after using up their 5 Minutes timer. This timer only goes down when you turn on a power and immediately stops when the power is turned off, so if you used alexandria's durability for 3 seconds and turned it off you would have 4 minutes and 57 seconds left.

When a Parahuman has what could be considered multiple different powers—like Glory Girl's Aura, Forcefield and Flight—they are simultaneously considered one and different powers, so you could for example activate solely the Flight without fear of running out the timer of the Forcefield.
objects.title: (Trump) Copy

objects.text: You can gain energy from Parahumans in a 100-foot radius to recharge your stamina, based on the power classification they are you gain various powers. If they are Mover, you are faster. If they are Blasters, you can exchange stamina to shoot beams of energy. You can also choose to store this energy for later use. Any powers you have can utilize this battery to augment itself.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Drain Battery

objects.text: It is possible to amplify your powers by pushing it past their limits, making them more potent and effective. However, doing so comes with significant consequences. As you continue to push your powers to greater heights, you will experience increased physical strain and pain. This could result in permanent damage to your body, making it more difficult to maintain and control your abilities. The increase in power is temporary, and it is recommended to not regularly use this power as the strain can kill you.
objects.title: (Trump) Limit Break

objects.text:
Your blood is now pitch-black and serves as a universal panacea for nearly every ailment. It purifies the body of viruses, purges toxins, cures cancer, reverses aging, restores lost limbs, and even physically cures Case 53s. However, these properties are only applicable after your blood leaves your body and is ingested. You can control the texture, taste, and density of your blood, with diluted versions have weaker healing effects. Regardless of the exact taste, your blood feels refreshing to drink, like an energy drink after a workout. You have an absurd regeneration rate for blood, allowing for you to be drained near endlessly.

Your flesh is also similarly "empowered." Consuming your flesh grants a qualitative improvement in every physical aspect, restoring individuals to the prime of their youth and permanently halting aging. Repeated consumption can grant a weak healing factor and turn the person into a low-level brute, though this caps out after a while. You don't have an inherent regeneration factor for your flesh.

You can consume both your blood and flesh to get the effects. 

Good luck!
objects.title: (Trump) "Panacea"

objects.text: By explaining your current action, you get much stronger. Your powers will express themselves in a more controllable and powerful manner. The longer the chant more accurately defines it, the greater it expresses itself.
objects.title: (Trump) Warcry

objects.text: If you are aware of an incoming Parahuman attack, you can redirect it back at the sender of the power. If they're actively manipulating whatever you're countering, they lose control over that attack while you send it back at them.
objects.title: (Trump) Redirection

objects.text: You can disconnect your head from your neck with a thought. When doing so, any power you have will be boosted, the strength of the boost increasing the longer you have your head disconnected. You will eventually need to reconnect your head as your body cannot sustain itself forever without it, since eating without a mouth isn't exactly possible.
objects.title: (Trump/Changer) No Head?

objects.text:
If someone acquires information about you, no matter how small it is, they will become a Trump -2. This means any opposing force effectively gains a +2 rating against them. Bumping into a table would cause them to collide with a Brute 2 Table, someone throwing a pebble at them would gain Blaster 2, someone trying to investigate them would become a Thinker 2, etc.

You know the names of those being affected and what information they possess, and you can selectively exempt others from your power.
objects.title: (Trump) The Imaginary Trump

objects.text: You can make anyone you touch ignore negative Trump powers like Hatchet Face or even Endbringers. This allows Parahumans to use their powers even if they are currently being negated.
objects.title: (Trump) Access Granted

objects.text: You now have the ability to steal powers, however you go about it in a very unique way. Your power allows you to steal the copied, stolen, created, or gifted powers of others within an area of 5 meters of yourself and use them as your own. Your stolen powers function in the same way as they would for their original user meaning that if you stole a shade from Glaistig Uaine you would then summon that shade instead of gaining that shades powers.
objects.title: (Trump) Reservoir Jack

objects.text: You can relocate any power you know of, changing its point of origin to another location, object, or being. This requires 1 minute of focus on the power you wish to relocate, and you may choose to keep focusing to prevent the wielder from reverting the change. You may revert this change at any time. If you are trying to relocate someone else's power, you must be able to see them.
objects.title: (Trump) Relocate

objects.text: You can create infinitely thin planes that can be imbued with your powers. These planes are both invisible and intangible, and when something passes through them they are affected by the imbued powers. It takes a second to manipulate a plane, but they last forever. Such manipulation includes the ability to move, reshape, create, destroy, and modify the imbuement. You may have an unlimited number of planes active at once, but each plane may only have an area of up to 10m^2. To imbue these planes with powers from other people, you must both be touching them and have willing consent. You are informed of whenever something passes through the plane, and what it was.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Imbuement Plane

objects.text: You can remove and break parahuman effects of any nature within 50 feet. It can range from wide-area effects, Master effects, Tinkertech, and banish projections. The affected target will then be temporarily immune from the parahuman power responsible for up to an hour.
objects.title: (Trump) Exonerate

objects.text: You can disperse effects like Shakers, Strikers, and other continuous effects into nothing or into the people around you. Dividing the effect on the people around you divides the total strength of the effect. An invulnerable object might make 5 people extremely durable. Once the affected object leaves your range, it returns to normal regardless of how dispersed it was.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Disperse

objects.text: You may give either yourself or someone else an enhanced growth rate for one of their powers. The boosted power grows at a rate of 1 SP/week, up to a max of twice the original SP cost. It will grow based on the owner's actions and experiences, and will try to suit their needs similar to Dynamist Jr. Using the power on someone else requires both physical touch and consent. Each person can only have one growth booster at a time, and they may not have a power boosted if it has already been boosted to the limit. You may grant boosters to an unlimited amount of people, and can remove boosters at will.
objects.title: (Trump) Growth Booster

objects.text: You can invert the effects of any power you see and lasts until it leaves your vision. This does not work based on perception, so inverting the effects of a punch will not heal you, instead turning it from a blunt attack into a slashing or piercing attack. Powers that work specifically by damaging parts of your body via unknown means will instead heal you. All or Nothing powers will instead be nullified and not do anything.
objects.title: (Trump) Inversion

addons.title: Stacked Deck
addons.text: Each power gained through Reservoir Jack counts for the purpose of Empowerment Conduit, meaning that you can potentially gain as many powers from a Type Two Trump at a time, as they’re capable of granting to others. And that each power gained this way improves all obtained powers to the extent that the latest gained power was improved.

objects.text:
You are a prime conduit for Type Two Trumps, namely those that can grant/partner/bond powers to others, as well as capes who can typically only grant powers to animals. When you become the focus of such capes, their power will be much more effective on you, this can manifest in various ways, whether in temporary powers lasting longer, powers carrying more potency, the Trump having more control over what kind of powers you’re granted or being an acceptable target for capes whose powers can typically only affect specific animals.

The effects of these empowerment will increase steadily with repeated exposure, improving in potency after each bestowal, though this won’t override any inbuilt power limitations and maxes out at double of the norm in each parameter. A cape whose granted powers typically last up to 5 minutes won’t have their powers last beyond 10 for you, no matter how often they empower you, things like power, range and control will likewise be capable of improving until they hit that limit.

This only partially protects you from the drawbacks that some of these empowerments come with, mainly by preventing you from being injured, permanently mentally or physically unbalanced or killed by your granted powers via enforcing the Manton-limit. Though this would not prevent any Mastering done by power granters.

To find these Type Two Trumps you’ve also got a Thinker sense for them, having a very general sense for their location in a city-wide radius and becoming more and more aware of their exact position and state the more often you’re empowered by them.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Empowerment Conduit

objects.text:
You are able to enter a nightmare realm whenever you sleep. In this place, you can’t truly die, but every time you do, it still feels real—pain and all. Time flows differently here: while only a day passes in the real world, an entire year slips by in the nightmare realm. In other words, the time in the nightmare realm is 365 times longer than the real world. 

Every day you spend the nightmare realm builds up a charge, and after a full year in the nightmare realm’s time, you can use the accumulated charge to step into someone else’s dreams. The target doesn’t need to be near your body, as long as you know their name or place of residence you can enter their dreams. You can even place certain requirements, such as “has heroic inclination” and enter a random dream that meets the requirements.

Inside their dream, you can grant the dreamer a power based on their dream. The more accumulated charge you have, the more powerful the ability, with a year worth of charge allowing you to make 3 SP powers, reaching up to a maximum of 15 SP with 5 years worth of charge (which in reality would be 5 days of constant sleep). You cannot use this to grant yourself powers—this ability only works for others.

Those you bless with powers will occasionally catch glimpses of the nightmare realm through your eyes when they sleep. They might even experience some of your memories from your time trapped in that world, whether they want to or not.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Endless Dream

objects.text:
Your body now processes all consumables as if they were items in a game, granting temporary bonus effects beyond their usual properties. A well-prepared meal might grant a boost to endurance or slow health regeneration, an energy drink could enhance speed or increase stamina regeneration, and potent drugs could heighten reflexes, increase strength, or sharpen mental focus.

However, these benefits are strictly temporary, lasting only as long as the inherent potency of the consumed item allows. The better the quality of the food or substance, the stronger and longer-lasting the effect. A gourmet dish made from high-quality ingredients might provide significant recovery and stat bonuses, while hastily prepared or low-quality food may only offer minor boosts.

This also does not negate the natural consequences of consumption. While a high-energy snack might give a burst of stamina, overeating can still cause discomfort, and toxins or harmful substances will still affect your body. Drugs will still damage internal organs, alcohol will still impair judgment, and excessive stimulant use can still lead to crashes or addiction. Your body may benefit from these temporary enhancements, but you are not immune to their long-term consequences.

This ability is passive and activates on all things you eat.
objects.title: (Trump) Consumables

objects.text: You can enchant weapons with non-Tinker powers as long as you're within 100 meters of the person with the power you're using for the entire duration of when you're making the weapon. If they leave the area you can continue with it later without losing progress. You can choose whether the weapon grants the wielder use of the power, or has a variant of the power itself.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Enchantment

objects.text: When you activate this power, you get a power designed to solve a problem of your choice. The power is only of the same strength as a 5 SP or less power, but it's specifically designed to help with the problem you present to it. The power stays for up to one day and you cannot use (Trump) Just the Thing again until the old power is gone. You can drop a power at any time.
objects.title: (Trump) Just the Thing

addons.text:
When you bestow a power to another, it is automatically marked. The person who gained you power can also pass on the power similar to how they can pass on your mark. Each time the power is passed on, its strength increases. This effect applies even if the recipient did not receive the power directly from you but through someone else who passed it onward. The strength of the power will drop by a magnitude if given to someone who already had it before, with it not dropping more than its base strength. Its strength returns when given to someone new.

Additionally, you can create a mental echo of each previous bearer of the power, tied to the current holder of the power. These echoes act as guides for the current wielder, sharing their insights and experiences. While all echoes provide guidance, your own mental echo has the most influence, with you even able to communicate with your mental echo without the other echoes knowing.
addons.title: Legacy Bearer

objects.text:
You have a special mark that gives a minor boost to your powers. You can give the mark to someone else, the mark growing stronger when you do so. The person with the mark can then give it to someone else boosting the mark further. With every person, the mark grows. If given back to someone who has had the mark before, the mark will permanently be weakened by a degree. 

You, the original holder, will be aware of whoever has the mark, the strength of the mark, and have a degree of control over the person who has the mark.
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Torch Bearer

objects.text: A counter exists in your mind, tracking the number of people you’ve killed. Every kill increases the counter by 1. For each increment of the counter, all your physical, mental, and other abilities increase by 1%. If the counter shows 2, your abilities are enhanced by 2%. If it reaches 10, you gain a 10% boost, and so on, with no upper limit to what you can achieve. Your power thrives on the destruction you sow, making every kill an investment in your own growth.
objects.title: (Trump) Bodycount

objects.text: When you touch a person, you can give their power a single-use trigger that decides when and how their power will go off. The owner of the power is unable to use their power until the trigger activates. This trigger can be anything, such as a simple timer, a speech-activated phrase, or even a complicated computer program, though any information it acts on will be based on what the owner of the power can perceive. There is no limit on how long a trigger can last until it activates, nor a limit on how many people can have a trigger at once, though a single person can only have one trigger at a time. Durational effects can last up to an hour, and cannot change what they are doing once activated, but are unable to be dismissed by the owner of the power.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Gatekeeper

objects.text: You possess the ability to temporarily drain resources from your future self, drawing on strength, vitality, or even intelligence from a point in your timeline yet to come. For instance, if you are injured, you can tap into your future vitality to heal instantly, recovering from wounds as if they had never occurred. However, this power is balanced by a cost: at an unpredictable moment in the future, the vitality you borrowed will be withdrawn, causing you to experience a temporary loss of life force, leading to sudden fatigue or injury. The same principle applies to other attributes—if you drain strength, you may gain a temporary boost now, but you will face a period of temporary weakness later on. This ability isn’t limited to physical traits; you can also siphon knowledge, skills, or even mental sharpness from your future self, giving you a temporary edge in the present. However, this leaves your future self vulnerable to a temporary decline in those same areas. If you have other powers, you can even drain those temporarily from your future self, amplifying your current abilities at the expense of a weaker or less capable version of yourself down the line. Every drain is temporary, meaning the boost you gain now will eventually give way to a temporary drain in the future, ensuring that balance is maintained across time. If you possess the perk Holding Back, you can designate a specific time for when the drain will occur, allowing you to prepare for its effects. You could even choose to spread it out over multiple instances.
objects.title: (Trump) Future Figures

addons.text:
Your secondary field around your body has merged with the forcefields provided by Destruction Barbie, allowing you to have multi-layered defenses against Parahuman effects. All 5 of your forcefields are constantly being updated with feedback from the information you gain with Tuning Field to become immune to surrounding parahuman effects. Furthermore, the fields surrounding you also alter themselves to become offensively better against surrounding Parahuman defenses. This means you can punch through esoteric effects such as Legend's Breaker state, walk through warped space or altered time, and beat up Gray Boy.

Furthermore, you gain extensive information regarding anything interacting with your forcefields, allowing you to tune to them at ridiculously high speeds. For example, an effect that you encounter for the first time which manages to pierce through your first forcefield would immediately be registered and become almost half as effective by the time it reaches the 2nd forcefield. The time to tune is still higher for more complex abilities.
addons.title: Multi-Tuned Fields

addons.text:
You can use the information gained from Tuning Field together with Tattletale and information from your Shard to predict the exact Shard behind enemy Parahumans, along with their rank and role in the cycle. You can then utilize this information to understand the deeper dimensional mechanics that exact Shard uses, along with its preferences in power expression.

This allows you to attune to alternate power expressions of a shard by experiencing just one effect. For example, you might become far more resistant to shard buds, clustermates, and Echidna clones of a Parahuman despite only encountering the original.

If you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless, you can better understand the source of esoteric effects. For example, you can differentiate a wizard who manipulates their energy from someone who uses an external entity to channel their abilities at a glance. You still have all the abilities mentioned above in addition to this.
addons.title: Insider Trading

objects.text:
You have a 100-meter field around you in which you can sense a variety of particle movements, wavelengths, and chemical reactions. Your power automatically filters out the useless information and focuses primarily on enemy movements and parahuman-generated effects. The closer an effect is to you, the greater detail you can perceive it in.

If you perceive an effect for enough time, you can begin to reverse-engineer its composition. You have a secondary Thinker power which allows you to understand how to find flaws inside these compositions, and you can alter a secondary field around your body to the exact makeup to counter any effects.

This means that the longer an effect is used on/near you, the less effective it is against you until you become immune to it completely. More complex abilities take longer to adapt to, up to several hours for the most complex. Absolute abilities, such as Sting, cannot be adapted to.

These effects don't have to be parahuman in nature. For example, you could tune in to be immune to a normal flamethrower.

Your resistance works on the core mechanics of the powers themselves, so if you encounter a power that works on similar principles to one you are already immune to, you will likely have resistance to the ability.

Furthermore, your understanding of the inner workings of parahuman abilities makes you an expert on their exact usage and function. You can find new and creative applications of almost any power you encounter, as well as identify niche weaknesses that the user wouldn't ever normally encounter. For example, you might find out the true use of Parian's power within a couple of minutes of being around her while she uses the ability.

If you have any other powers/abilities, you can alter them to work more effectively against specific parahuman effects that you have tuned to without reducing their power.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Tuning Field

objects.text:
You can give yourself quests, which function as self-imposed challenges. Completing these quests grants you rewards, usually in the form of growth, skill improvement, or improvements of any abilities you have. The difficulty of the quest determines the quality of the reward—trivial tasks provide little to no benefit, while significant challenges yield meaningful enhancements. You can have up to five active quests at a time, each with its own objective and potential reward.

While you can create repeatable quests, the rewards scale accordingly. Repeating simple actions, like taking steps, will offer minimal to no benefit, but sustained effort toward meaningful goals—such as practicing a skill for a set amount of time—will grant better rewards. The nature of the rewards aligns with the quest completed.

You can abandon or replace quests at any time.
objects.title: (Trump) Quest

objects.text:
You manifest a shuffling deck of cards. From this deck, you may draw a single card at random. The suit and value of the card determine the nature and magnitude of its effect. Numbered cards range from 2 (the weakest) to 10, followed by face cards—Jack, Queen, and King—each stronger than the last. At the pinnacle of power is the Ace, representing the highest possible effect. Each suit corresponds to a unique type of effect.

Heart cards heal. A low draw, such as the 2 of Hearts, will seal cuts, mend bruises, or soothe minor injuries. But at the pinnacle of its power, the Ace of Hearts can reverse death—provided the target has been dead for less than a minute—restoring them not just to life, but to their absolute physical and mental prime.

Club cards manifest physical matter. A 2 of Clubs might generate a mundane object—like a pen, a rope, or a metal cup—nothing more complex or large than a common spoon. But the Ace of Clubs can conjure items such as a nanothorn.

Diamond cards serve as defense. A 2 of Diamonds might toughen the skin, rendering it leathery and resistant to cuts and minor trauma. An Ace of Diamonds offers a single moment of absolute invulnerability—a defense capable of withstanding even a stilling blast.

Spade cards embody offense. A 2 of Spades delivers a blow equal in force to a standard human punch. An Ace of Spades can shoot an attack on par with a full-force blow from Alexandria herself.

In addition to the 52 standard cards, the deck includes two Jokers. When drawn, a Joker can mimic the effect of any card in the deck—any suit of choice at a random value. 

Drawing a card does not activate it. Instead, the card is added to your hand—your personal collection of drawn cards, visible only to you. You may continue drawing until your hand contains five cards, at which point it becomes full. Once your hand is full, you may activate the cards in any order you choose. Effects are instant and last for only a short while. Only after all five cards have been played or discarded can you begin drawing again.

Additionally, the combination of cards in your hand—your “hand strength”—can enhance the effects of individual cards. A weak card like the 3 of Spades may hit harder if it’s part of a flush or a straight. A 7 of Hearts may heal like a 10 if it completes a full house. The better the hand you hold, the stronger each card within it becomes.
objects.title: (Trump) Deck of Cards

objects.text:
You mark someone by touching them. However, an unwilling target can break free of it later through sheer willpower, which takes exceptional mental strength and resolve. You can also voluntarily remove a mark anytime you choose.

Once marked, every person generates their own separate well of energy that represents their total capabilities: their strength, speed, intelligence, skills, stamina, everything they are. You can freely drain energy from any marked person's well and grant it to another, weakening the source and strengthening the recipient by the exact amount taken. The transfer is proportional: if you drain half of someone's total ability and give it to someone else, the recipient gains that full half on top of their own baseline. You can stack from multiple sources, so draining half from two different people and giving both halves to one target makes that target a composite of their original self plus the two halves.

If a marked person dies, their well doesn't vanish, it becomes permanently available to you with no living owner attached. You can drain it completely with no downside since there's no one left to weaken.
objects.title: (Trump) Human Resources

objects.text: You can alter the strength of any Parahuman's powers if they come within 50 meters of you. This effect lasts fifteen minutes after they leave your range. You can weaken their power to 50% its usual strength, or enhance it to 250%. This cannot be used on yourself.
objects.title: (Trump) Fluctuation

objects.text: You can apply the effects of Telekinetic Barrier to anyone. This makes them far stronger and more durable than normal and can protect someone from non-physical attacks, including poisons, sickness, Trumps, Masters, Strangers, reality rewriters, precogs, and any power that directly affects others. Your protection lasts an entire day before disappearing.  However, anything stronger than a gunshot will break the protection.
objects.title: (Trump) Protective Barrier

objects.text: You can permanently make someone your proxy by touching them, allowing you to treat them as the point of origin for any of your powers. A proxy being your point of origin allows you to channel any of your powers through them, treating them as you for the purposes of location, as well as allowing you to be aware of both them and what they perceive. There is no limit to how many proxies you can have, and this power may be used recursively, allowing you to make someone that a proxy touches a proxy as well. By touching another person you can choose to allow them access to one of your proxies, for purposes of both channeling and perceiving.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Power Proxy

objects.text: Whenever a power is used directly on you, you gain a single charge for that power. These charges may be used as a single-use copy of the original power. For powers that run continuously, the time you spend being affected by the power determines how long the charge gained will last. You may use one charge to give another charge a +50% boost, and this may be used repeatedly to a 10x boost to a power, in any direction of growth that you desire. You can gain a maximum of 3 charges of the same power per hour, but different powers have separate counters. There are no limits on how many charges you can have.
objects.title: (Trump) Power Absorption

objects.text: After a power is directly used on you, you will become immune to it. This doesn't work on Thinker and Stranger powers. You can allow a power to be used on you if you consent.
objects.title: (Trump) Immunity

addons.text: Your one-word descriptions can now go up to three-words, with you being able to swap at will between one, two, and three.
addons.title: Wordy

objects.text: You can detect nearby Parahumans and receive a one-word generalization of their powers in a language you know — as an example: Statue, Flight, and Smart for Alexandria. Within 5 meters you can also edit their powers through altering the description of it — although you are limited to three edits per Parahuman, and the result must be a valid word. The edit may do one of the following: add (Any -> Many), remove (Flight -> Light), substitute (Statue -> Status), or swap characters. You may also revert your edits. The overall strength of the power is not altered.
objects.title: (Trump) Wordsmith

objects.text:
You gain the power to cultivate. 

This can be applied to plants, as well as animals and people. You can cultivate specific traits and abilities in others or even yourself, encouraging and directing development in any biological system. While you don't have full control, your ability makes a significant impact, especially when your target is younger, thus more flexible to change. However, the rate of growth lowers over time and as the target ages. Cultivation isn't immediate, usually requiring weeks to months to develop a specific trait. The more specific the trait, the faster you can develop it. 

Few examples of your capabilities are cultivating traits such as Confidence, Leadership, and Willpower, or boosting your target's biological attributes like Strength, Speed and Endurance to greatly surpass human limits. You can also use this power on yourself.
objects.title: (Trump) Cultivation

objects.text: If anyone attempts to activate a power while you can see them, it will result in the power being disabled for a random period of time (3–33 minutes), but the target will be convinced that it’s working fine. You can toggle this effect.
objects.title: (Trump/Stranger) Power Confusion

addons.text: This power has fused with Genesis, the energy from Genesis now also being used to create powers when you are asleep. Every time you fall asleep, you now enter a dreamscape as a formless entity. Every hour you gain 1 SP worth of energy that you can use to make a power. You can use this energy to create, alter or improve powers you have. You can also choose to use this energy to empower your projection from Genesis. Furthermore, you don't need to be asleep to create powers anymore, although doing so when you are awake will cost twice the amount of energy compared to when making, altering or improving powers when asleep.
addons.title: Sleeper

objects.text: You get powers at a rate of 1 SP an hour as long as you’re asleep. These powers are reset every time you go back to sleep restarting the cycle from the beginning. You think of a general concept/desire for a power before you sleep and get something that at least somewhat fits that when you wake. The strength limit on powers you can get is equivalent to a maximum of 10 sp per power. You can create multiple powers at once though that divides the SP generation between them with powers you desired most being prioritized. You can not create more than 10 powers during a sleep cycle. You can fall asleep on demand and don’t wake up before you want unless you are in active danger. You cannot make Trump powers that permanently empower yourself with other powers or alter Sleep Empowered’s rules.
objects.title: (Trump) Sleep Empowered

objects.text: Gives you a power for every injury you receive. These powers last as long as you have those injuries and for up to ten minutes after being healed. Power strength is determined by severity of injury which goes up to about 10 SP worth for a severed limb, while what power manifests is determined by type of injury in order to someway counteract the negatives of that injury and the situation you received it in. This power comes paired with a healing factor that while in combat only heals enough to keep you alive from anything that doesn’t kill you immediately but outside of danger rapidly heals your injuries completely.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Injury Empowered

objects.text: You gain powers from scars. The strength of the power gained from a scar is dependent on its size and the danger of the situation in which you received it; a tiny scar gained from a cat scratch would give you a power even weaker than a T0, whereas a massive scar gained from surviving an endbringer fight might grant you a power as strong as 15 sp. This also makes your body more predisposed towards scarring.
objects.title: (Trump) Permanent Reminder

objects.text:
You can now empower the remains of living creatures into "trophies", that, when worn, modify at least one of your other powers based upon the abilities, identity and general danger of whatever your trophy came from.

So long as the trophy is a major part of a worn item (i.e. a wolf tooth necklace or a bull leather jacket), it will boost your other powers thematically; parts from a wolf might twist your powers to be better at coordination with others or, failing that, to be more aggressive; a bull's may boost the maximum amount of force you can take with your Brute powers, or give you a greater resistance to the backlash/cost of your other powers; a trophy made from a capes body may flavour your powers with elements of theirs, granting new capabilities or simply boosting where they overlap. If worse comes to worst and you simply have nothing that can thematically relate to the trophy, then it will grant you a decent standalone passive power based on the source instead (that can then be modified by your other trophies).

The size and integrity of the trophy has a logarithmic impact on the amount that it will boost you: a single hair as a trophy would pale in comparison to a leather garment, and a freshly skinned bodysuit would provide incredible benefits to your other powers. Wearing multiple trophies from the same or similar sources counts as a single trophy of their combined sizes.
objects.title: (Trump) Trophy Hunter

objects.text:
You can now choose to temporarily weaken one or more of your other powers to redistribute its strength out to any number of different powers, being able to choose roughly how much strength to take and give to/from each ability of yours. 

The amount that one power boosts another is based upon the overall relative strength of the powers: Gifting 100% of a T0 power's strength to a paragon power would result in a nigh unnoticeable increase; while gifting even 1% of a paragon power to a T0 would result in an incredible boost.

The boost works based upon the power's concept, focusing on improving based upon emphasising its themes and strengths. If a pyrokinetic power is focused on the high intensity of its fire, most of the boost will go towards increasing that intensity further; if a Master power is focused on its range and control of many minions, then this power would focus on improving that range and, if it's control is already absolute, potentially even introducing thematically related ways to allow you to capture/create more minions; etc.
objects.title: (Trump) Hyperfocused

objects.text:
You can draw from the powers of Parahumans around you. This happens because within a 30-meter radius, you slowly draw [Energy] and copy [Data] from their Shards. Now, Shards are rather stingy with these so the higher yours is ranked the more and quicker you gain.

Through this ability, you can summon powers from these Shards, the strength, quality, and duration of which are all based on those you've drawn from. In the instant you choose to use your stored [Energy] and [Data], your power simulates a Trigger giving you a power for however long you have stored [Energy]. Stronger powers use up [Energy] quickly while weaker powers can last quite some time.

This manifestation, nevertheless, is not without limits; you can only keep up to three powers at a time. Even though discarding a power can allow you to save up [Energy] and [Data], the next time you draw from that stored [Energy] you'll manifest a new power altogether.

(If you have a Normal Shard, Shards will only send largely junk [Data] at a rate that would take 1 hour to retrieve the equivalent of 1 SP and enough [Energy] for 1 minute of a weak power. If you have a Vital Shard, Shards will only send partial junk [Data] at a rate that would take 20 minutes to retrieve the equivalent of 1 SP and enough [Energy] for 3 minutes of a weak power. If you have a Noble Shard, then Shards will never send junk [Data] at a rate that would take 5 minutes to retrieve the equivalent of 1 SP and enough [Energy] for 5 minutes of a weak power.)
objects.title: (Trump) Daimon

addons.text:
There are no longer any restrictions on what you can manifest. Instead of being confined by predefined powersets, you are free to design them entirely from the ground up, customizing their functions, interactions and overall expression in any way you choose.

This offers vast control over how each powerset operates, including their overall synergy. You might combine three powersets for a specific goal or generalize them for broader utility, all so long as the final result stays coherent and under the 4 SP limit. Likewise, you are now also able to manifest multiple, duplicate powersets.
addons.title: Tohu Unbound

objects.text:
You can manifest up to three replica powersets, each one being derived from any parahuman to have existed, whether past or present.

Your simulated powersets are capped at being up to 4 SP in overall potency. Your copied versions will either be weaker than, or on par with, their real life counterparts, but cannot exceed the original. You could combine Legend, Purity and Raymancer to emit searing blasts or blend Imp, Mantellum and Blindside into an elusive Stranger effect.

For example, you might select Eidolon and gain a lesser version of his ability to manifest multiple semi-random powers. Each of these powers would be proportionally weak, however, no more than 1-2 SP in strength. Alternatively, choose Shadow Stalker and you could mimic her full powerset with no handicap.

You cannot select yourself and are limited to one powerset per parahuman at a time, preventing duplicates. It is possible to partially circumvent this by using parahumans such as Glaistig Uaine and the like. It takes a minute to select and 'lock-in' a powerset before it's usable, but you can dismiss and switch out at will.

When mentally searching for a parahuman to mimic, you instinctively sense compatible powersets aligned with your intent. This intuition also provides a baseline understanding of each powerset’s capabilities, mechanisms and limits, but offers you no extra skill, experience or mastery.
objects.title: (Trump) Third-Rate Tohu

addons.title: Storm Troopers
addons.text:
Your two Trump effects have interacted in an interesting way; not only do the granted Brute powers stack, but the power boost enhances and alters the electric aura.

Reduced damage is now converted into additional electrical energy instead of simply being negated. This can either temporarily enhance the electric aura, or be discharged in one big burst.

addons.title: Berserker's Haze
addons.text:
You can cause a sort of berserker rage in people you've made grow. Those in a berserker rage will grow to three times their normal height instead of twice. They will attack anything that isn't you or another person you've made grow.

Their strength is further enhanced, and their durability becomes nearly twenty-five times in relation to their increased size, with any damage they would take being reduced to one third. Any other powers they do have will be boosted by 100%, but their control will be negatively impacted.

objects.text:
You can temporarily grow other people up to twice their normal height. This is an effect similar to Fenja and Menja's Breaker states.

Granting enhanced strength and increasing their durability by nearly ten times in relation to their increased size, with any damage they would take through their new physique being cut in half. Furthermore, this will temporarily boost any powers they do have by fifty percent.

Physical contact is required to grant the effect, with a duration of half an hour for each application, though you can end it earlier if you desire.
objects.title: (Trump) Bigger IS Better!

addons.title: Backup Trump Card
addons.text: In addition to triggering at will, you may now initiate a second trigger for any power granted to you by Trump Card at will. This can only be done once per power, but is guaranteed to help address whatever problem caused you to second trigger, from your blaster power not being able to affect someone who is intangible, to you just not liking what you triggered with and hoping for something more to your liking, though the greater the need the better the improvement from the second trigger. In addition, this increases the chances of multiple Trump Card powers synergizing with each other and can increase any existing synergies as well.

objects.text:
You can, at will, force yourself to trigger with a power based on your current circumstances, after which this power will be spent.
