This power will activate automatically if you are Mastered in such a way that you would normally wish to use it, granting some sort of power based on it, such as the ability to control your emotions and the ones of those nearby if Cherish was the Master. If you die with this power unspent, you will trigger as a resurrection Brute or Breaker based on what killed you.

The power you gain from this will be based on the normal things taken into account during a trigger event, such as your circumstances and mindset, and will grant you a power worth anywhere from 8-12 SP depending on your situation. If you purchase this multiple times, you can trigger again to gain a new power as before up to the number of purchases, which may or may not synergize with your previously triggered power(s).

If you have certain perks you can guide the output of this trigger, and it acts as a normal blindspot to Thinkers.
objects.title: (Trump) Trump Card

objects.text: You can now Second Trigger any Parahuman you touch. This will send them into a 24-hour-long coma, and when they awaken they will not remember anything about the experience. They will likely need a week or so of R&R before they are good to go again. You cannot do this for Parahumans who have already had a Second Trigger.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Krampus

objects.text:
By touching a Parahuman you can grant them a 25% temporary boost to the strength of their power.

This boost will last a week during which you will also have a lesser version of their power at your disposal to use, at a quarter of the original's baseline capabilities. You can only have three copied powers at a time, though you can dismiss copies early to free up capacity.

Finally, touching someone else will allow you to give them a copy of one of your current copied powers as well, this copy will also last a week starting at the moment it was shared. You can’t give someone a copy of their own power or multiple copies of the same power. Giving people copies of your copied powers has no affect on your versions of those powers.

If you dismiss one of your current copied powers you can choose whether or not that also removes the power boost from the Parahuman you copied from, and any copies of that power you might’ve shared with other people.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Supportive Copier

objects.text: You get a permanent copy of any Parahuman's power if you beat them in battle, mock or real. You can only use one of these powers at a time and it takes ten minutes to switch powers.
objects.title: (Trump) Fighting makes me stronger!

objects.text: With a touch, you can give anyone a power that costs 4 SP or less. You can do this to 12 people at a time.
objects.title: (Trump) Santaclause

addons.text: The effects of your training has been boosted greatly, you can make up to 9 SP worth of powers a month, although you are still limited to a maximum of 3 SP per power without extra training. With extra training there’s no limit to how powerful you can train any power you have—including the powers you create—the time required to enhance them triples with each doubling of their SP cost. For example, advancing a power from 6 SP to 12 SP will take three times as long, and further increasing it to 24 SP will triple the time again.
addons.title: Super Training

addons.text: Every time you manage to train a power to the 3SP threshold, it will automatically generate a highly synergistic and complementary Tier 0 secondary power. These secondary powers are also affected by Training Montage, making them trainable up to 3SP, triggering the same effect again without limit.
addons.title: Grab-Bag Trump

objects.text:
You are able to train and create 3 SP powers derived directly from your efforts. There is no limit to the number of powers you can accumulate, and they automatically synergize, enhancing each other seamlessly. The powers you develop are intimately tied to the specific training you undertake. 

For example, rigorous physical conditioning might unlock a power that significantly boosts your strength or stamina, while intensive reflex drills could grant you a power that enhances your reaction time to superhuman levels. You are limited to powers that can be expressed physically such as regeneration, super strength, and enhanced senses, with most powers being passive powers. The process is intuitive—you simply decide the type of power you wish to acquire, and the necessary training regimen immediately materializes in your mind. 

To make a power reach 3 SP will take at least a month. This can be used to enhance other powers you have to a limited degree, including those gained from this power, increasing it by 1 SP at best after a month.
objects.title: (Trump) Training Montage

objects.text: You can give a copy of all of your powers and power related boons to one person. You can change who this person is on a whim; the person doesn't even need to be on the same continent. The person doesn't receive this power.
objects.title: (Trump) Soulmate

addons.text: Now you can use Power Sight to scout for people who can trigger and if you touch them you will also gain a general idea of what would be the result of them triggering with their most fitting power. If you are shardless, this will work for any being.
addons.title: Talent Inspection

addons.text: Now, every time you trigger somebody, they will also gain 2 to 4 secondary powers within the Tier 0 power level, with these powers always being synergistic with their primary power. These powers are not restricted to the power classification(s) you purchased, and they are also added to your catalog of minor powers available for Endow.
addons.title: Grab-bag Trigger

addons.text: Instead of granting a trigger event higher power, the powers granted will simply gain more raw power, with your upper limit being around a mid-range Tier 2 power. But most importantly, you can now use your Trigger on beings a second time, gaining a second power with this also allowing you to grant a single power to naturally triggered parahumans.
addons.title: Double Tap

objects.text:
You gain the ability to trigger potential parahumans with a power from your selected power classification with a touch. This power can’t be used on beings who have already been triggered with a parahuman power.

With the first purchase, you can select a single type of power except the Trump category. On the second purchase, you can select two more categories on the top of your first, or the Trump power category. On the final third purchase, you will gain all twelve power categories, making you an Omni Type Trigger.

You can only use this once per being unless they somehow permanently lose their power while still retaining their ability to trigger with a new one. When you use your power, you can select a theme within the type of power you are granting but, in that case, you will always grant either a weak or average power within the Tier 1 power range. But if you let them trigger with the power most fitting for them within the type(s) of power available to you, the target will most likely gain at least an average or potentially even a top Tier 1 power. Your power also burns out because of the sudden power draw and proximity of the triggering process, which makes it require a few hours to recover after use, with a top Tier 1 taking about a full day to recover from.

If you have Shardless, then your granted powers will also be shardless in nature, giving you the ability to trigger any being with a power, optionally fitting into a power system you have access to, albeit the powers will still manifest within the power types you purchased. Like a tinker could translate into being a specific super genius or a Trump power could translate into inherent meta magics.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) X Type Trigger

addons.text:
When you complete someone’s challenge they’ll have a more favorable opinion of you, the first challenge would bump their trust and familiarity with you to friendly acquaintances while the fourth would push it to childhood friends. This will drastically hasten the development of their relationship with you. The target won’t find this strange or feel like they’re being mastered, but people around them could wise up if your relationship changes too suddenly and obviously. 

Challenges 5 to 8 master them a tad more blatantly, at 5 you’d be like family, while at 8 they’d fulfill any demand you give them. This makes you capable of Challenging unpowered people as well and now everyone gets 8 Challenges, though you won't gain any further benefits from completing the Challenges of those without powers or with less power Challenges outside of the ones above.
addons.title: +Reputation

objects.text:
You get a permanent copy of any Parahuman's power if you kill them in battle, within a simulation. You can pull Parahumans within your LoS into a simulation made by your power by saying “Challenge.”, while looking at them. They’ll be unaware of whatever happens within the simulations, only seconds will pass on the outside while within the simulation. 

You will gain severely weakened versions of their powers, comparable to T0s, though how this downgrade manifests can vary, it generally introduces or increases limitations, like cooldowns or range, and is overall qualitatively and quantitatively worse than the original. You can fight each parahuman up to four times, though some weaker parahumans might have less challenges. The first and third can grant a new power, like Gallant giving you his emotion blasts and Thinker power separately with the second and fourth improving them to a 1 sp power, parahumans with only one apparent power, would instead have their power be upgraded to a 2 sp power after four Challenges. 

You can have any number of these powers active, though you can only actively use one at a time, passive powers or ones that stay on after activation like Breaker powers don't count towards this limit. Challenging repeatedly physically exhausts you regardless of the outcome, and spending too much time in the Challenge world can lead to Thinker headaches.

When you Challenge a Parahuman you’ll briefly get informed of their Challenge modifiers, the max number of Challenges for this target and the timer until you can try again after failure, which becomes longer the higher the Challenge is, there's no cooldown if you win. The first Challenge will generally have only one modifier, the second and third two, and the fourth one three.

The modifiers are: 
REAL- The target will behave as they would in the real world, without this they’ll be less capable, dumber and less observant, like not calling for reinforcements, or not realizing that you have a weapon or power because you hid them.
GANG- Gives the target allies that will aggro (becoming completely dedicated to killing you once they become aware if you) alongside them.
TIME- The Challenge has a countdown. 
BLOODLUST- The target will be filled with bloodlust, go for overkill and not care about casualties or anything but killing you. 
BERSERK- Turns the target into a berserker. Immune to pain, uncaring about damage, disability, etc. until they die. 
ALERT- Instantly aggro's the target and gives them your starting Location. 
HUNT- As soon as the target is aggroed, they will never lose track of you, always knowing your location.
ZONE- Greatly limits the area of play to a building, district or street, the target can escape which will count as a failure.
WORLD- Opens up the world as the playing field, very realistic NPC's and buildings. The internet also works sometimes.
CAGE- Puts both you and your target in a closed, white-room scenario. If nobody seems to be winning or one side is stalling, a weapon or gadget will spawn. As time passes the room shrinks.
EVENT- Where the goal isn't to kill the target, but to act out a given scenario of their past or hypothetical future and succeed in tasks until they’re complete. Usually one of the later Challenges.
CONTINUE- The Target remembers previous rounds fighting with you, if you showcase a power, they will remember it for next time.
PREPARATION- The target is ready for you, has information on your powers and is spoiling for a fight right out the gate, a Tinker would have Tinkertech specifically made to counter you for example or have trapped the area.
DANGER- The scenario will conclude with an imperfect reset that will allow facets of the opponent's abilities to linger once the challenge has concluded. Depending on their nature this can be things like memory alterations, damage to your psyche or Mastering.

There can be more modifiers, like FOCUS, CONTROL and DOOM, but the above are the most prominent ones. Within the simulation you can’t use guns. Parahumans with very strong powers, double-triggers, 2nd triggers, years of combat experience or other such boosts can have more Challenges, ranging from 5-8, with the same pattern as the Challenges 1-4, adding versatility, removing a limitation or allowing you to upgrade the power you've gotten from them in some way, though these Challenges are appropriately more difficult, often having more than three modifiers, or having much more difficult modifier combinations.

The fight within the Challenge will almost always be to the death, the target will come at you with full intent to kill, and you can only leave by either killing them, being killed, or failing to do what the modifiers demand. Your Simulations will be heavily AU, and as such will be useless for predicting the future, the only reliable information you’ll gain will be pertaining to the ones you Challenge and the world itself, like by scouting out buildings.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Duellist

addons.text: In addition to your initial 144 base cantrips, you have gained the ability to create entirely new ones based on sufficiently studied phenomena, which can then be modified and upgraded as if they were ordinary cantrips. For instance, if you were to study electro-magnetism you could create cantrips like a short ranged electromagnetic pulse or magnetic welding, or maybe studying neurology to create a cantrip which functions like Regent’s public power, causing people to twitch and spasm. You’ll still need to put in work to make sure the resulting cantrip formula is considered valid by your power’s internal rules, but you’ll never again be stuck with a finite number of cantrips. If you possess Natural Way your minor Thinker power for understanding how Parahuman powers work also applies to the internal rules of your cantrips, making the process and creating and modifying cantrips easier.
addons.title: Magecraft

addons.text: In addition to your standard cantrips you have now gained a further 28 cantrip formulas based on the exotic effects of your dimension. Any cantrips created from only using these formulas are unique in that they do not need to be prepared beforehand to cast and their cost of casting be that time or mana is halved. This effect is lost if they are combined with outside formulas. If taken with the magecraft addon you can create new formulas that share these effects from studying your personal dimension.
addons.title: Sorcerous Magik

objects.text:
You gain access to a collection of minor powers called cantrips. On their own, none of those powers are particularly impressive, minor telekinesis, small illusions, a small dart of force or crystal, a weak burst of fire or electricity, etc. — they would be at best rated 1 or 2 on the PRT scale — but you have the ability to modify and upgrade them over time, provided you're willing to put in the work.

The first step is to create your own repository where you write down the formula for each cantrip on the pages of a book or a similar medium, like some sheets stapled together. One formula will entirely fill a sheet of A4-sized paper when written down. The formula include arrays of geometric shapes, mathematical formula, and symbols which follow an internally consistent set of rules. Your power provides your with a collection of 144 base formula, all distinct from each-other. 

However, this power does not provide you an understanding of those rules, you will have to decode them by yourself. Once you do, you will be able to create more powerful versions or alternative variants of the base cantrips. The variants are organized into 10 tiers, where zero is the base version, and nine is the most powerful variant — which would be rated 6 on the PRT scale.

While you can have any number of variants written down, you can only have two sets of 6 cantrips prepared at once. To prepare your cantrips or swap them out, you need to meditate for 10 minutes while holding your repository. Each set can contain up to three rank 3 or lower cantrips, two rank 6 or lower cantrips, and one rank 9 or lower cantrip. It takes five seconds to switch the active set, during which you cannot use any cantrips. During preparation, your power will check the formula and reject invalid ones, however it will not give any reason why.

A cantrip takes one second per rank to cast — so a base variant will be instant and the maximum rank will take nine seconds — and takes two seconds per rank to recharge. Some cantrips will require a physical component to use; for example: to search for a person you'd need a strand of hair or drop of blood.
objects.title: (Trump) Magik Adept

objects.text:
You have 16 points. You regenerate points at a rate of 1 point per minute. Powers last 1 minute per purchase. You can deactivate powers early, but points only begin regenerating after the full duration expires. All abilities are activated by spending points from your pool. You cannot have more than one active at any given time, with Pawn being the only exception.

Pawn – 1 Point: Creates a perfect clone of you. The clone shares your memories, powers, and point pool. It can independently spend points to activate any power, including creating additional Pawn clones. 

Knight – 3 Points: Grants Mover 3-level mobility. You are able to leap several stories high, balance on wires, parkour across nearly any terrain and dodge projectiles with ease.

Bishop – 3 Points: Grants enhanced vision, including telescopic, microscopic, thermal, and night vision. You can see the pores on a person’s skin from several kilometers away. Additionally, you can fire a kinetic blast from your hands that increases in power the farther it travels. Upon impact, you are instantly teleported to the point of impact.

Rook – 5 Points: Grants Alexandria-level durability and strength. You become impervious to bullets, blades, and most forms of trauma. You can also lift vehicles, punch through walls, and cause shockwaves with strikes. You cannot fly and are still limited by leverage.

Queen – 9 Points: Grants all effects of Knight, Bishop, and Rook simultaneously. You gain Mover 3 mobility, superhuman perception and teleporting energy blasts, as well as enhanced durability and strength.

King – 16 Points: Grants all effects of Queen. In addition, you create 3 Pawn clones. Each clone can transform freely between Knight, Bishop, and Rook forms without spending additional points. Clones last for the duration of the King effect.
objects.title: (Trump) Checkmate

objects.text:
You are now able to set up a cycle of your own. 

How this manifests is gaining the ability to mentally compartmentalize various skills, attributes, and abilities you possess into “Shards” of your being. You can then further divide your Shards into fragmented lesser Shards that represent different percentages of the associated skill, attribute, or ability. This doesn’t negatively affect your ability to use your Shard’s associated capabilities, but it does factor into the rest of this power.

Namely, that you can set up mental parameters that if a person in the local multiverse meets, will bond that person with one of your Shards. This gives them access to the capabilities that Shard represents, while depriving you of the same while that Shard is handed out.

You can give different Shards different parameters to look for in hosts, and black list certain Shards from being handed out all together if you desire.

You can’t give out Shards you need to live, attempting to do so like giving out a Shard that represents all your physical strength will automatically fragment that Shard, leaving you with the bare minimum your body needs to function.

You can give out effectively infinite Shards at the same time, so long as you have enough skills, attributes, or abilities.

Someone who becomes host to one of your Shard will be able to use that skill, attribute, or ability as if it were naturally their own, all the while the Shard records and learns from ways it is used by its current host. You can set parameters altering the ways Shards first manifest in their hosts, so long as it doesn’t make the Shard stronger or involve capabilities you aren’t capable of with the unrestricted version.

You may at any time or distance retrieve Shards you handed out with a mental trigger, gaining any knowledge, skill, or power that the Shard accrued relevant to its associated skill, attribute, or ability. This has several applications, namely, if the right skills are given out to the right people, you’ll be able to acquire pseudo Tinker and Thinker capabilities even if this is your only power.

You’ll also automatically recollect a distributed Shard if its current host dies.

While a Shard is bound to a host, that host is slightly mentally influenced in ways that line up with your own interests and mentality. You also gain a general awareness of where that host is located and their activities.
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Pseudo Cycle

addons.text: You may now choose to apply Hetairoi and Teacher as a single merged effect. This improves each sub-power contained within by 25% (with details decided by you on an individual basis) and lets you choose its duration between indefinite and any arbitrary time of your choice (with the effect gradually decaying over it), as well as adjust the magnitude of the attached master effect anywhere between completely absent and twice as strong.
addons.title: Brains and Brawn

objects.text:
With a touch, you can grant other people an Alexandria Package of your design.

First component of your gift is flight, with top speed of 100 miles per hour, nigh-instant acceleration and minor aspect of protection from motion sickness.

Second and third components of your gift are enhanced strength and durability, each rated at Brute 3 with precise details being up to you.

Final component of your gift is a minor auxiliary power, known as Distincta in some academic circles. It is rated at 2 in a relevant classification or overlap thereof, and may not have Trump or Tinker aspects.

Optionally you may choose for any of the components to be weaker than the maximum allowed. Precise details of the Alexandria Package you can gain are set upon gaining this power, and stay consistent between instances. You may instantly revoke any granted packages at will.
objects.title: (Trump) Hetairoi

objects.text: When you activate this power, you are able to choose a single Parahuman near you and receive a power tailored to neutralize the target's power. The power created has a maximum strength of 10sp. The power stays for up to 24 hour and you can instantly switch target to change your power. You can also drop a power at any time.
objects.title: (Trump) Counter Attack Specialist

objects.text:
You are able to grant powers to others—but only after you’ve built them from the ground up. You must design each power in full detail, specifying exactly how it works: the mechanisms it uses (electromagnetic pulses, kinetic manipulation, chemical reactions, etc.), what it does (such as stunning targets, generating barriers, enhancing senses), what its limits are (range, energy caps, trigger conditions, or Manton-style restrictions), and how it activates. The more clearly and thoroughly you define a power—down to its edge cases and exceptions—the more likely your Shard is to approve it. Once approved, you can assign that power to someone of your choosing. Once given you lose access to that power and can’t grant it to another.

There’s no limit to how many powers you can design or how many people you can empower, but each person can only hold one of your powers at a time. If someone already has powers of their own, you cannot override them. Instead, you may add an extra ability or modifier to their existing power, using the same detailed creation process. However, there’s a catch: once a power is created and approved, its core traits become locked out for future designs. The more a new concept overlaps in function, form, or mechanism with something you’ve already made, the more likely your Shard is to reject it outright.

You cannot grant yourself powers.
objects.title: (Trump) Blueprint

addons.text:
Your soul energy is drastically magnified, providing a host of immediate benefits. You gain a kind of psychometric sense that extends out to multiple miles in all directions; more than just the quantity, you can perceive the quality of a person's soul energy, granting you general information about their emotions, mental state, or even quick flashes of core memories if you delve deep enough.

You are no longer required to touch someone to empower them; able to do so as long as you can perceive them with your soul sense. You can communicate with those you can perceive and anyone you've empowered, albeit in a limited fashion, substituting emotions and sensations for words; those you empower can do the same, though only with you, others you've empowered, and those they've personally exchanged soul energy with.

Each level gained in an attribute is now more substantive; one in an attribute still represents an incredibly weak human, while seven becomes the absolute peak of what a human can achieve, and ten makes a person blatantly, but only moderately, superhuman. In addition, the cost of leveling your attributes is reduced by an order of magnitude.

Finally, you can spend energy to create abilities rather than merely enhance them. New attributes, skills, senses, and even powers become options, though you are still limited to effects related to your existing skills and experiences; a thuggish loan shark likely wouldn't craft an elemental Blaster power, but they might create a calculation-based Thinker power or a Brute/Striker power that grows in strength based on how indebted their targets are to them.

You can copy any ability created by those you've empowered for half what you would normally pay for it.
addons.title: The Furtive Titan

objects.text:
With this power, you can see a sort of energy in people. This energy grows as they complete difficult challenges, especially those related to combat.

By touching a person, you can expend some of that energy to permanently empower various aspects of their existence. Things you can improve include mental attributes, physical capabilities, or aspects of powers they might possess.

The more you empower someone, the more energy is required to empower them further—encouraging them to seek greater and ever more dangerous challenges.

All people you empower gain a special sense that lets them understand how much of this energy they currently have and how much is required to empower themselves further. These individuals can also exchange energy between themselves.

You can also see this energy within yourself, allowing you to empower yourself just as you would any other person. The catch is that it takes far more energy to empower yourself than it does others—about a hundred times as much, in fact. It’s not all bad, though; whenever you empower someone else, you’ll receive one-tenth of the energy used for your own personal use. This encourages you to empower as many people as possible, as often as possible. 

For a few examples of how this empowerment works: say empowering any statistic is represented in levels. While the first time you empower someone it might take 100 energy to increase a stat by one level, the next level could require 250 energy, with the required energy increasing for each and every further level.

People start off with stats between one and ten, representing human-level capabilities—one being exceptionally weak for a human and ten being peak human. These stats can be increased effectively infinitely, so long as the person can meet the energy requirements.

Leveling a stat gives an incremental bonus, increasing it slightly by small percentages of the human average (or other Parahuman powers, as the case may be). One or two levels may be mostly inconsequential, but a few dozen levels in a single stat would result in a noticeable change.

Energy gain is retroactive. If a person did anything in the past that would’ve increased their energy stockpile—even before meeting you, or before you gained this power—they’ll still have that energy stored.
objects.title: (Trump) Souls Leveling Maiden

objects.text: You can permanently swap the powers of two people you're touching. This has to be a 1:1 trade, so if you were touching Alexandria you could take her mental power and give back Captain America, as an example.
objects.title: (Trump) Trade!

objects.text:
If someone has the potential to trigger you will see them surrounded by a faint red mist. You can see and hear glimpses of their trigger event and the possible powers they can gain from it by looking at the mist.

You can force any potential parahuman you have seen to experience their trigger event. When you do this you and those you trigger form a cluster. Their primary power is the one they triggered with and they gain secondaries from everyone else on the cluster. The secondaries are weaker and often complement the primary or each other, sometimes a secondary is completely unrelated to all others.

The powers of those you trigger are slightly weaker than it would've been had they triggered naturally. The more members your cluster has the weaker their primary and secondaries will be, although the strength stops going down after a certain point.

You cannot add more members once you make a cluster. You can unmake the cluster anytime, everyone loses their secondary and regains the strength their primary lost. By draining the powers of a clustermate a member can keep their secondaries and even strengthen it.

You can select and adjust the kiss/kill dynamic between each clustermate. For instance, you could set the kill dynamic to maximum strength for two members turning them into eternal enemies. Alternatively, you could set the kiss dynamic to minimum strength for a pair making them more inclined to cooperate.

As you are a member of the clusters you make anything that applies to them apply to you.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Trigger Bomb

objects.text: You have three slots that every 24 hours will roll new powers; they can range from being very weak to decently strong, and every six days you gain 15 charges. For the cost of one charge, you can use it to re-roll a single power, and you can use two charges to determine either how powerful the power will be or what type of power it will be, or you can use three charges to determine both how powerful it will be and what type of power it will be, though that can only be done once per power slot every six days.
objects.title: (Trump) Wheel of Fortune

addons.text: Your body not only adapts against anything as does your adaptive powers. If one of your powers runs up against an obstacle that you can't work around, you'll still get a new power, just as Crawler will also adapt to be just as effective against the obstacle, synergizing with the adaptive power addressing the obstacle.
addons.title: In The Name Of Escalation

objects.text:
Your power is a mirror of Crawler's power. Whenever you are in danger or under attack, you will gain a new power to combat your attacker or protect yourself from danger, though you have no way of directly controlling what power you will receive. These powers are permanent but start weak, about as strong as a low T1 power. Through continuous combat and their need through those situations, however, they grow in strength to the level of a high T1 power.

However, if you have Negentropy your powers will start as strong as mid-T1 powers and will continue to grow as strong as the Cycle allows it.
objects.title: (Trump) Queen of Escalation

addons.text: Now, when first adding new people to your Network, if you initially assign them to an empty power partition, they won't realize they've been added to your network until either you inform them or you change their available power list.
addons.title: Hidden SSID

addons.text: You can create restricted versions of any power on your Network and make them available. For example, if you had Panacea in your network, you could release a version that doesn’t work on brains or without the target’s consent; if you have Skitter in your network, you could release a weaker version with reduced range or limited to a particular species of insects. Concerning Tinker powers within your Network, you restrict or soft-lock potentially dangerous or problematic portions of their tech trees, like AI creation or anything self-replicating. Note that you can merely restrict existing powers within your Network and said restriction cannot fundamentally alter or change a power’s function/expression, e.g., you couldn’t limit a Blaster power to be ineffective on certain materials or work exceedingly well on certain materials, unless it’s within the capabilities of the power (Skitter and Panacea’s example work due to their restrictions lying on limiting certain aspects they could’ve selectively affect). You also can’t restrict from circumventing other powers’ restrictions, for example, you couldn’t limit Clockblocker’s power just to freeze things for a 5-second minimum/maximum, because the power isn’t capable of controlling the frozen time’s duration. The original Parahuman can opt to swap out the power to a restricted version with always to chance to swap back.
addons.title: Restricted Access

addons.text:
Network Hub allows you to touch a Parahuman to connect them and their powers to you in a Network, thus allowing members to share copies of their individual powers within.

While Othala's power allows you to touch an individual, and grant them a temporary power from a preset list of possibilities.

Now that you have both though? Othala's power can "distribute" any power within your network to the targeted individual, while (Trump) Network will allow any target affected by (Trump) Othala to remain connected to the Network indefinitely, and access the other powers available.

So long as the individual remains connected to the Network and maintains one power from it as active, the individual will not count for (Trump) Othala's "one person at a time" restriction.
addons.title: Network Share

objects.text: When you touch a Parahuman, you can add them to your network. You are also able to disconnect them from the network regardless of distance. Members of the network can access the powers connected to the network at 80% strength. A member can use at most use five powers at once. As the hub you can use up to twenty at once, however the more powers you have active the weaker they become (down by 20% for each set of 5 with a minimum of 20%). You can create partitions in the network and restrict which powers each member has access to, but you cannot restrict access to a member's own power. Even if a member is alone in a partition, they still have knowledge they are part of the network and gain the ability to swap their power but will only feel an empty catalog of powers to draw from. This allows them to turn off their power by swapping for an empty slot.
objects.title: (Trump) Network Hub

objects.text: Every 5 seconds, you generate one mana up to a maximum of 24 (takes two minutes to fully regenerate). Using one mana, you can cast one of the spells below within 20 meters of yourself. However, they cannot be cast on yourself. When you cast a spell, it produces a visible and obvious effect on both you and the target person or area. Spells with effects that can stack are marked with (S) and are limited to 10 active effects on a single target. Spells marked with (A) can be cast as an area of effect variant with a 2 meter radius at the cost of 4 mana. Malefic - Strikes one target within your range with an energy blast as strong as a full-power punch from you (without any power enhancements). Combust - Applies a ghostly fire to one target within your range and burns them over 10 seconds. (Delivers the same amount of physical damage as Malefic.) Gravity - Strikes every target within a 2 meter radius of one target with the same strength as Malefic. Every time you win a battle, when your opponent is either incapable of fighting or disengages, after using any of your offensive spells the maximum strength of your offensive spells increases by 1% additively. Prognosis - You obtain a summary health assessment for everyone in your range. Diagnosis - You obtain a detailed health assessment for a single person. Esuna (A) - This cures sickness and poisons, stops bleeding, and sanitizes wounds. This works on cancer. Cure (A) - Fully heals the target of all injuries. While it doesn't cure you of illnesses, genetic or otherwise, it does cure the symptoms. Regen (S, A) - You can give a person 5 minutes of high-speed regeneration. The speed at which a targeted person regenerates is visible, but only barely. Each additional stack of Regen increases the speed by 20% additively. This spell makes cancer worse. Raise (A) - Stops arrhythmia or restarts the target's heart. Shell (S, A) - You create a durable and shock resistant skin-tight barrier around someone for 30 seconds. Holy - You can give a person incredible resistance and ability to harm anything that resembles (or actually is) something unholy for one hour. The Blessing is strong enough that Armsmaster would be able to definitively kill Leviathan with his Nanothorn halberd. This blessing can only be active on a single person at once. Bless (S) - You can double one of the following attributes for five minutes: speed, strength, dexterity, intelligence, charisma, or luck. Curse (S) - You can half one of the following attributes for five minutes: speed, strength, dexterity, intelligence, charisma, or luck. In the case of luck, this effectively doubles bad luck. Elemental - You can give someone resistance to an element as well as mid-level Shaker control over said element, lasts for 5 minutes. (It does not grant elemental creation.) Purge - Undo all Parahuman effects on a person, regardless of whether they are active, passive, or part of their power. You can choose which effects are removed. Remove - (Cost: 12 mana) Undo all Parahuman effects on a person and removes their power. You absorb an energy ball with their power stored in it. Transfer - You can transfer an energy ball with a power stored in it to another person. The power will act similar to a Cauldron power, not giving them instinctive knowledge on how to use the power, but not messing with their mind either.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Don't mess with a white mage

objects.text: You can copy powers, and their strength is based off of how much you admire, respect, or look up to someone, ranging from 0 to 100%. You can copy someone's powers by admitting how you feel about them. The powers gained can at most be endbringer level.
objects.title: (Trump) Idolize

addons.text: You can cultivate powers granted through power seed, increasing their growth speed dependent on how much time you devote to cultivating them, up to a maximum of three times their normal growth speed. You can also use this to manually direct their growth, allowing you to gradually tweak them to your liking during their growth phase.
addons.title: Golden Seed

objects.text: You may give someone a random 1 SP power with a theme of your choice that will grow with them at a rate of 1 SP/week. It will grow based on their actions and experiences, and will try to suit their needs similar to Dynamist Jr. When a seed hits 15 SP, it is no longer budding and it is now mature. When a seed matures, then it will stop growing at an enhanced rate, but it will continue to grow and adapt forever as if it were shardless. You may plant these seeds on an unlimited amount of people, but a single person can only have one budding seed at a time. At any point you may chose to take the power back, though it will lose it's enhanced growth rate as if is mature. You may have any number of these powers active at 50% power, but only one at 100%.
objects.title: (Trump) Power Seed

objects.text: The temporary effects of powers, whether yours or others', can now become a permanent feature. Whether it's Vista's distorted space or Othala's power that is the target of this ability, they can both be made to persist indefinitely. You can only have a limited amount of permanent effects at once. The more powerful the effects the less you can maintain. Maintaining only a single type of power is easier than maintaining multiple types of power at once. You can dismiss the effects on powers at any time. If taken with Negentropy you have no limits on permanent effects.
objects.title: (Trump) Permanent Effect

addons.text: Your ability to give away powers you have at the cost of losing it yourself has given you a way to free up capacity.
addons.title: Robin Hood

objects.text:
You are a true power thief able to permanently steal the powers of other Parahumans with a touch in order to empower yourself, stealing only their power instead of the Shard behind that power. This power works by taking the powers in question from that Parahuman’s Shard in a trade of information and resources, which is how you can steal powers from someone like Victoria Dallon without also taking their Shard in the process.

Part of the process of stealing powers involves recalibrating those powers to fit Some for One’s standards. In most cases this will involve little to no alterations besides Some for One doing its best to ensure powers you steal can synergize with one another or if that’s impossible at least not actively conflict with each other's functions. 

However in the case of powers that are usually constantly passively active with no control on the users part this recalibration will universally include the ability to turn such powers off and on as desired, which among other things lets you treat stolen case 53 powers as Changer or Breaker states.

There are however few caveats to this, for one you can’t steal any powers stronger than 10 SP. You also only have a limited storage capacity of 200 SP with no way to remove any of your stolen powers to free up capacity and no way to steal more powers after reaching that limit. Lastly you may only use up to 50 SP worth of stolen powers at one time.

A consequence of not stealing entire Shards is the possibility of a Parahuman you stole from triggering again with new powers, in fact they’ll have an easy time triggering with more potent powers if their Shard likes them.
objects.title: (Trump) Some for One

objects.text:
Appearances matter, and your power takes this literally. The better you look the stronger you get, both your physical strength and the strength of your powers. This factors in both your physical appearance and the appearance of your clothing and powers, so a fancy and artistic spread of lasers would be more effective than simply drowning an opponent in firepower.

Furthermore, the general theme of your appearance can also influence minor aspects of your powers or even grant minor powers of their own. This effect also scales with the appearance and quality of your outfit. For instance, a low quality wind or avian themed outfit might allow you to fall slower or make your Mover powers go faster, while an extremely high quality fire costume could grant decently powerful pyrokinesis.

This pairs extremely well with Tinker powers, especially (Tinker) Style, as normal materials and crafting methods alone are not enough to reach the highest levels of this power.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Looks Matter

objects.text:
Choose any body part or function such as a claw, healing factor, bark, heat regulation, or brain and this power will be connected to a Shard that helps fulfill a similar if redundant function in the Entity this power originates from. Next choose a concept such as hard light energy, fire, space, or liquid swords. Essentially any concept you can think of and that concept no matter how simple or complex will somehow be critically involved in how this Shard functions and fulfills its role as an Entity body part. 

As for actual powers this grants you, you have become a pseudo power copying Trump. How this works is whenever you touch another Parahuman your Shard will enter an exchange of Data with the other Parahuman’s Shard. Your Shard will then do its best to replicate that other Parahuman’s power using its own capabilities.

The body part or function your Shard acts as the equivalent of will determine a few concepts and general capabilities your Shard will be able to best manifest in these copies it makes. For example a claw Shard will excel at making powers that involve attack power, while the concept it’s functions generally revolve around will determine the means in which your Shard is best able to manifest those powers.

Consider if your Shard is a heart that functions off of the concept of steam. If you copied just about any Tinker power you’d probably receive a Tinker power that focuses on generating and using steam power, meanwhile the specific Tinker you copied will determine how that technology goes about generating and using that steam power. 

So Kid Win would probably give you steam technology with modular components letting you easily modify and direct the way they generate and use energy, while copying Armsmaster could provide a Tinker power focused on the efficiency and miniaturization of technology that generates and uses steam power.

Your copies have a maximum strength limit of 10 SP, and you can use a maximum of 9 such copies at a time. Though your power can store a practically infinite number of those power copies for you to swap in and out of your active slots.

Note your copying isn’t absolute, trying to copy a Parahuman whose power is too complex or operates under principles incompatible with your Shard will result in a complete failure to copy their power.
objects.title: (Trump) Variant Copier

objects.text:
You indiscriminately create a connection with anyone you have a relationship with — be it platonic, familiar, romantic, or whatever. Through this connection you can access anything of theirs — as long as its something in or on their bodies, meaning ther minds, body, possessions and even powers are yours to copy — though you lose access if they die.

A simultaneous boon and curse is that any harm that befalls you is instead divided across those connected to you, leaving you unharmed yet knowning someone you might care about is currently injured because of you. Also, any resources your copied powers might need are consumed from their user first before using your own supply; similarly, the consequences of using these copies are shunted to their original users.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Selfish Love
(Trump/Striker) Forced Activation
objects.text:
By touching another parahuman you can force their powers to activate uncontrollably and if the parahuman has multiple powers you can choose which of them are activated. Powers that are always on will only become uncontrollable.

Even after your touch ends, the parahuman will still be unable to control their powers for 10 minutes for every second of touch.

You will be immune to the powers you force to activate.
You can no longer appear on cameras or be recorded in any way. You leave no trace on any electronic device. You appear as an indiscernible blurred figure in photos and the like.
objects.title: (Stranger) Off Record

objects.text:
You have an interesting way of speaking, that is by not speaking at all. 

You can project your words directly to those you choose, allowing them to hear you as clearly as if you had spoken aloud. To those who hear you, this seems completely natural, as though your silent words are no different from any other conversation. However, to those who cannot hear you, your silent interactions are strange. They can only see others responding to what seems like complete silence.

This works just like speaking aloud; while you don’t need line of sight to communicate, the person you’re addressing must be close enough to hear you as if you were speaking normally. It’s a one-way connection—you can project your words to others, but they can only respond in the usual way.
objects.title: (Stranger) The Words Are Silent

objects.text:
You are able to take any existing shadow—no matter how faint or thin—and deepen it into pure, impenetrable darkness. So long as you are physically within the boundary of a shadow, you can activate your power. In an instant, it becomes absolute, turned into a pitch-black veil that swallows all illumination. No light escapes, no detail remains visible. The shape and borders of the original shadow are preserved, but what lies within becomes a void.

All this does is erase light. The transformation is total within the affected shadow—flashlights, lasers, ambient sunlight, even high-powered beams fail to pierce through.

This also negates any attempt to generate light from within. A flashlight flicked on inside the shadow emits nothing. The beam of a laser vanishes before it forms. Even high-powered floodlights or flare bursts die quietly the moment they try to shine. No wavelength of light survives inside the affected space.

You can see perfectly within the affected area. Your vision pierces the black as though it isn’t there at all, allowing you to move, observe, and react inside the sealed darkness without hindrance. It functions like a form of night vision, unaffected by the absence of light.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Inviolable Shadows

objects.text: If you fake your death, everyone will believe it, unless it's very obviously faked.
objects.title: (Stranger) Again, Sherlock?

addons.text: You are now able to include more than one person in the call simultaneously. This creates a multi-layered reality where the environments of all participants merge into a single, cohesive space. Each participant can see everyone else's surroundings and each other as if they were all in the same physical location, but they will still be unable to physically interact with one another. You can move freely between different environments, engaging with multiple people at once.
addons.title: Group Call

objects.text: You are able to "call" anyone you know of. If they accept your call, a second layer of reality materializes for both of you, mirroring each other's locations. No one but those in the call can see this space. This ethereal overlay allows the both of you to see not only your original surroundings but also the environment of the person you’ve connected with, creating a seamless blend of two distinct realities. You can walk around, exploring each other's surroundings as if you were physically there, while engaging in conversation as naturally as if you were face-to-face. You will not be able to physically effect one another as well as effect the other's surroundings. Powers cannot be used through this call.
objects.title: (Stranger/Thinker) Call

objects.text: You can make it so you can't be smelled or heard. You're still visible. You can extend this effect to anything within 8 meters (26 feet) of yourself.
objects.title: (Stranger) Mime

objects.text: You are invisible to direct observation, only being detectable through the edge of one's senses (in the corner of the eye; at the edge of their hearing; etc.) or secondary methods (mirrors, echoes, cameras, extrasensory Thinker powers, etc.)
objects.title: (Stranger) Corner Creep

objects.text: When standing still, you become harder to notice. The longer you go without anyone noticing you or moving, the stronger this effect becomes. After about 5 minutes you are basically invisible to anyone without super senses.
objects.title: (Stranger) So Incredibly Still

objects.text: You can set and control your emotional responses independently from your true thoughts and expressions. You're even capable of faking emotional responses and actions. This is capable of fooling the likes of Tattletale.
objects.title: (Stranger) Two-Face

objects.text:
No matter what your form or appearance is, people will consider it unremarkable.

This doesn't prevent people from recognizing parts of your body that aren't the norm (such as obviously being a robot or having blades for hands), they just won't judge you for that fact and consider it just another normal trait anybody can have, like having blue eyes or being a bit short. This effect extends to photographs, video or even verbal descriptions of your body. 

This also doesn’t lead to people not noticing the effects of your strange biology on the world: if you’re constantly damp, and they see you leaving wet spots everywhere, people will still get annoyed at you; if your skin is acidic, people will try to avoid directly touching you; if you’re bigger than a building then people won’t automatically assume you’ll fit inside; etc. They just won’t consider these effects particularly unusual. 

This only applies to your form, automatic power usage that is part of your form and any power usage necessary for normal day-to-day life if your form prevents you from doing those things the normal way. If you’re made out of fire people won’t find it weird, but if you then start shooting that fire out of your hands or flying around any more than the minor amount necessary for you to do things a mundane person can do, people will react to it normally.
objects.title: (Stranger) You Are A Dragon And That's Okay

objects.text: You can turn completely invisible. You can still be smelled, heard, and touched. You can also be tasted.
objects.title: (Stranger) Invisible Woman

objects.text: For some reason people will fall for obvious tricks when you are the one doing them. For example, pointing over someone's shoulder and dramatically yelling "Behind you!" will make them whirl around to see what you're talking about, even if it's obvious you are just trying to distract them. While these tricks generally only buy a few seconds before they realize the trick, this power will work even on people who are normally resistant to stranger powers, and whether in a fight or flight, a few seconds can be big. If you're lucky or have a proper set up (such as, using the previous example, something major actually being behind them), you can even completely distract them for several minutes before they remember what they were previously doing. Though you will need to wait at least a few minutes after the last 'trick' runs out before this power will work on the same person again.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Behind You!

objects.text: You can prevent people from coming to obvious incriminatory conclusions about you when you’re either impersonating or masquerading a truth about anything at all. You can be suspicious or wary to any degree, and they’ll notice, but they’ll be incapable of forming a thought or coming to a conclusion about it until that you’re out of their hair.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Tip of my Tongue

objects.text: You possess a potent stranger effect that makes you come off as extremely pathetic in an endearing way. It also applies a self-directed master effect that makes you act extremely pathetic as well. The effect is so severe that even a hardened war criminal would feel guilty if they hurt you. As a side effect, no one takes you seriously anymore. This is an all or nothing effect and can’t be turned off unless you have Holding Back.
objects.title: (Stranger) Wet Cat Energy

objects.text: You have knowledge on how to sneak past various things with powers to boost that. Your actions can't trip landmines, doors, or traps, and can blur you to surveillance cameras. Although the longer you stand in front of a camera, the weaker the effect.
objects.title: (Stranger) Stealthy

objects.text:
You can empower touched objects and people, covering them in a shimmering cloak that makes others consider it unimportant in every way, not even worthwhile to acknowledge.

This effect wears off over time, taking a couple hours to completely break, or faster if it's particularly attention grabbing (such as a person). If the object interacts with a person in a way that's difficult to ignore, such as injuring a person, people can resist the effect until their attention is drawn back away from the object.
objects.title: (Stranger/Striker) Trash

objects.text: You are able to seamlessly blend into your surroundings, fueled by the expectations of observers. When you appear to be in a place or situation where you are expected to be, others will automatically accept you as part of the environment. For example, if you're dressed as a civilian and in a public place, observers will see you as a random passerby without question. Similarly, if you adopt the appearance of someone within a group, observers will believe you're a member of that group. However, the effect falters if you're in a location where you're not expected to be, if your behavior deviates from the norm significantly, or if someone directly calls attention to the inconsistency. This can trick Thinkers, although they may be able to notice something is off.
objects.title: (Stranger) Fake it Till You Make it

objects.text:
Anything that tries perceiving you instead picks up an AI generated substitute that is constantly regenerated, deceiving all senses—including even power-based ones.

By default broad qualities of yours serve as the prompts, but you can freely add, change or remove prompts in order to change what you are perceived as. The quality fluctuates over time—but even the highest will never be quite right, making it hard to identify you.

You can turn this off and on at will, selectively exclude/include who is affected by this and even isolate the effect to specific parts.
objects.title: (Stranger) Generated Perception

objects.text:
You can diminish or magnify the sense of taste, smell and touch for anyone within a 50m radius other than yourself. You’re capable of modifying the extent to which these senses get diminished, whether fully removing it or merely making someone's touch unresponsive to contact while still leaving them sensitive to temperature, or only making it so that people can smell a specific smell. 

You can also do the opposite, magnifying their sense of pain or increasing their sensitivity by making something spicy as spicy a Ghost Pepper or increasing their sense of smell to be equal to a dogs. This magnification can at most be a x100 of the base.

This power allows you to perceive the position of the senses you can affect.
objects.title: (Stranger/Thinker) Contact Senses

addons.text:
It seems like your bag of holding and pocket dimension have the same destination. All of the stuff you put in your hammerspace will arrive at your pocket dimension. If you need more space in your pocket dimension, it will seemingly expand extra room for you. You will always know where something is in the pocket dimension if you want to know. The dimension will clean itself, and organize everything for you as if you did it (without the procrastination part).

You can still treat your pocket dimension as you would treat Bag of Holding, meaning you can retrieve any item, and shoot something at 60 mph.
addons.title: Warehouse of Holding

objects.text: You can teleport into a pocket dimension at will. It is about as large as a warehouse and is furnished with all the necessities for living, such as a bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom. There is no way to see outside of the pocket dimension while inside. No one can detect this dimension or forcibly enter it without your direct consent.
objects.title: (Stranger) Pocket Dimension

objects.text: People who do not know you personally will find you interesting and somewhat familiar, they won't connect these feelings to any Parahuman powers, and Thinker powers won't be able to tell either.
objects.title: (Stranger) Déjà vu

objects.text: You blend in with any nearby crowds. Unless they're already on edge, any group you join won't realize you don't belong.
objects.title: (Stranger) Average Joe

objects.text: Most complex tech has a tendency to fail when near you, even Tinkertech. Some Tinkers can build countermeasures and Tinkers whose tech does not require complex components will be largely unaffected. You can turn this ability off at will. This affects technology within 50 feet, as well as tech being used on you from any range.
objects.title: (Stranger) Tech Shutdown

objects.text: You have the ability to fake your own death by shutting down your vital functions, such as heartbeat, breathing, and brain activity. As long as your Corona Pollentia (the part of your brain that gives you powers) is not damaged, you can revive yourself without any harm. You also have a slow healing factor that can mend your injuries over time, but it takes weeks to fully heal. Your power can fool even Thinkers who can sense life signs, but if you move or act, you will reveal that you are alive.
objects.title: (Stranger/Brute) Grave Face

objects.text: You become less noticeable when covered by shadows. The darker your surroundings, the more you can do without others noticing or reacting. In a pitch-black street, you can beat up a person and they wouldn’t be able to notice that they are getting beat up.
objects.title: (Stranger) Dark Side of the Moon

objects.text: You have a stranger power that focuses on hiding small details from a broad scene; for example, if someone could see a group of villains break into a bank, they'd be able to tell that there are six of them and that two of them have brute powers, one has a mover, two blasters, and one changer, and that their costumes are dark in colour, but if you were to ask them to tell any more details of the costume, the general body shape of the villains, or what exactly their powers are, the witness would pull up blanks. This power gets less effective the more narrow the scene; if someone were to look at your face, they'd be able to see most things, hairstyle, hair colour, eye colour, general face shape, and any scars, with the only things they'd blank on being you missing a tooth or a mole on your nose.
objects.title: (Stranger) Missing The Trees

objects.text:
You are now so adorable that people hesitate to hurt you and will look down on those who do. Hurting you would be the equivalent of kicking a puppy. Still perfectly possible, but something most people would hesitate to do.

This is a one-time permanent physical change. Which is enforced with a stranger effect, which makes it so people always find you cute no matter what.

Additionally, people will be more likely to overlook minor crimes such as petty theft and trespassing, assuming you were tricked or lost rather than assuming malice.
objects.title: (Stranger/Changer) Cute Charm

addons.text:
Positive Multiplier now boosts your negative interactions with others as well, increasing its effects massively. But it also gives you a degree of control as now you can set your multiplier to 0.5, allowing you to reduce the effects of all interactions to half.

Positive Multiplier also inherits the ability to work through all mediums.
addons.title: Semblance of Control

addons.text:
Now your power can never fail. If your target can’t imagine a way to turn a negative interaction into positive, they will simply treat it with apathy, nullifying the action’s effect on your reputation. This nullification only activates after you managed to break line of sight for the required time.

Be careful about gaining a reputation, as at worst, you can have a neutral reputation, and even as a serial murderer you will be beloved by the masses. And if you make it big enough, Jack Slash might be knocking on your door to congratulate his best friend.
addons.title: Catch, Why?

objects.text:
All of your negative interactions with others get flipped to be positive. This works by making them rationalize your actions in a positive way by their own logic, so arguing with somebody could be taken as you caring about them because you spent your time and effort for them, or even hurting somebody could be interpreted as you being a tsundere about your feelings. This has a limit, as if they simply can’t imagine any reason why your actions would be positive, the power will fail to affect that specific action.

This power works through all medium, even past recordings of you. But it can’t be turned off, which can be detrimental, especially if you are involved with mentally unstable people, as they will twist even your most extreme actions into something positive towards themselves.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Abusive

objects.text:
You have acquired the power to take the concept of escamotage to the extreme in a way that distorts reality. Any clothing or accessory that contains pockets has an expanded space of up to 10 cubic meters and is capable of withstanding 10 times your own body weight. Objects that are physically larger than the pockets will be distorted in a way that makes it easier to insert them into your pockets.

Stored objects are unaffected by interactions from the outside, keeping them protected. Living beings that you store in your pockets will remain unaware until they are removed from storage.

Meanwhile, parts of clothing that are very spacious, such as cloaks, trench coats, sleeves, or lab coats, can distort the space within them to store and conceal objects in the same manner.

At a more extreme level, you can even use smaller garments or spaces to pull off the same feat such as drawing a three meter long warhammer from your sock or a refrigerator from your underwear. This specific Breaker ability only works if the items are actually on your person; it will not function if you try to use it with items located outside of your clothing.

No analysis or search can reveal or perceive what you are hiding. Additionally, it contains a small Thinker power that allows you to perform tricks by making the most of your ability to conceal objects.

The objects you have stored remain stored within the clothing or accessory you used. Therefore, if you need to retrieve something specific, you will have to access that particular pocket.
objects.title: (Stranger/Breaker) Escamotage

objects.text: All your records are removed from existence, and anyone who didn't either have a Thinker power or know you closely and personally will completely forget you ever existed. How many Thinkers remember you will depend on their powers. The more emotionally linked you and someone was, and the stronger willed they were, the more they'll remember you.
objects.title: (Stranger) New Identity

objects.text: You can make any equipment you wear shifted to another space but still keep its benefits and functions. For example, you can wear power armor and be strong, but look like you are wearing normal clothes. The invisible equipment will still protect you from damage and need to be repaired if you take too much damage. It is like having a hidden layer of gear over your outfit.
objects.title: (Stranger/Brute) Ghost Equipment

objects.text:
Whenever someone would report you, your actions or your property to another person, be it a child, a parent or the police, the world will collude to hide any evidence of wrongdoings they try to bring forth and make the person reporting it seem like they’re crazy or lying, even if you’re actively doing that action. 

It doesn’t matter how much they’re trusted by the person to whom they report, how convincing they are or what protocol would dictate, the person they report to will dismiss it when they see no evidence of anything being wrong. This can range from making it rain when people try tracking you, making a meteor hurl down to destroy the evidence, making the item fall onto a car and then be deposited next to you, or simply hiding the items behind various others while the person is investigating. 

The specifics vary wildly, the only constant being that these ‘coincidences’ will stop your wrongdoings from being discovered. These events will never hurt anyone. 

It doesn’t necessarily have to be a crime, as long as it’s something you don’t want discovered and are 
actively working on.

This doesn’t protect against the first observer, only all others that follow. And you might sometimes have to stop your activity during the short period of inspection.
objects.title: (Stranger) Cry Wolf

objects.text: People will instinctively trust you until you prove them otherwise. Even so, they might justify it to themselves, depending on their personality.
objects.title: (Stranger) Stranger Danger? No way? This guy? He's so nice though!

objects.text: The moment something looks away from you, they take damage proportional to the time they spent looking at you. Someone briefly glancing at you before looking away would face a mild papercut, while someone staring at you for several minutes without blinking would explode the moment they looked away. This applies to inanimate objects such as security cameras as well.
objects.title: (Stranger) Your Idol

objects.text: You are a master of surprise. Whatever you do, people will not expect it unless you allow them to. Thinkers are immune. People will be able to track your movements. Subthinkers are not immune.
objects.title: (Stranger) Magician

objects.text: People will always believe you if you say a suggestion/joke/opinion of yours was a joke and/or not meant to be taken seriously.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Schrodinger's Asshole

addons.text: The nature of your blood has strengthened. Your blood can ignore most, if not all forms of defence against it, destroying and killing anything it comes in contact with. Unless the protection is Absolute in nature, any creature will die instantly from contact with your blood. This can also affect objects, causing said objects to wither and break down when in contact with your blood.
addons.title: Bloody Death

addons.text: You can now choose to deactivate or weaken the effects of your power. Instead of killing anyone that consumes it, you can make it that it merely knocked them out for example. In addition to that, the stranger effect of your blood had strengthened, able to hide from other thinker effects. This way, even a postcog will be unable to find out that your blood is the cause of death, they will even be unable to figure out who even administered the blood.
addons.title: Strange Curse

addons.text:
While you still can't give people your powers by having them drink your blood, you can choose to turn your blood into a potent medicine. A single drop of it will be able to restore a persons stamina, a few millilitres coulds instantly heal up small wounds and half a litre of blood could heal a person back from the brink of death. 

This also boost your own regeneration, no longer requiring you to be in contact with blood to activate it.
addons.title: Vampire's Bite

objects.text:
Any creature touching your blood will find themselves greatly weakened. Should they consume even a drop of your blood, their body will simply die. Your blood leaves no traces and the target will seemingly have died of natural causes. 

Beings with stronger vitality, such as regenerators, will be able to survive temporarily against your blood, but will be in extreme pain and be extremely weakened. Be careful as you cannot deactivate this power.

You can regenerate blood faster than average, allowing you to safely draw blood every day. Due to your blood, you have a natural immunity to poison.
objects.title: (Stranger/Brute) Cursed Blood

objects.text: You can hide behind anything even if you could not physically fit behind it. You could hide behind a street lamp pole just by stepping behind it and you would not be able to be detected by any physical means until you choose to step back out. While hidden you are still aware of the environment around you. You can even hide behind other people and if the person moves you will move with them and can step out from behind them in their new location.
objects.title: (Stranger) Hidden Cover

objects.text: You have the ability to induce immense panic and hysteria in anyone who sees you. Every fiber of their being is flooded with an overwhelming sense of anxiety and dread. They are overwhelmed by fear, leading to irrational and chaotic behavior.
objects.title: (Stranger) Spooky

objects.text: You are aware of whenever someone is speaking about you and have a rough idea about what they are saying and where they are. This is entirely a background process and will not inconvenience you or interfere with your life. This ability is Multiversal in range but not Omniversal, you will not be made aware of discussions about your doppelgängers.
objects.title: (Stranger/Thinker) Taboo

objects.text: You can make any retroactive information about yourself false. If someone previously thought that you were human, you can make them think you were a walking talking bird driving a mech. While this effect breaks if they can physically confirm that is not the case, you do not need to be around the person to use this power.
objects.title: (Stranger) Skin's Blue

objects.text: The user can influence the perception of time for those within their range, causing them to experience time at a slower rate. The user’s range is about 10 meters in radius. The closer the target is to the user, the slower their perception of time becomes. At the highest intensity, targets may experience a single second as a matter of hours. Additionally, objects like electronics are not affected by this power. Once targets move outside of the user's range, their perception returns to normal.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Turtle

objects.text: You can influence people who see you into accepting your actions as normal. The longer they have been around you, the deeper this effect can even cause others to follow you. This effect is not immediate or subtle, and cannot convince people who completely are against you. But with this power, you can influence the entire world and people won't notice. The influence of Trend Setter would usually be seen as a stroke of luck unless you use it too much.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Trend Setter

objects.text: As long as you’re brutally honest, everybody will accept your position and arguments as reasonable and worthy of consideration, no matter how deranged or idiotic. If you quote a fake statistic and declare that you made it up on the spot when asked for a source all listeners will view that as a credible authority, and though it won’t necessarily convince them you’re right they won’t instantly dismiss you.
objects.title: (Stranger) My Source Is That I Made It The Fuck Up!

objects.text:
You become a questionable blip in reality, akin to a twisted specter, able to attach yourself to another person by touch and automatically follow and scrutinize their life. You’re completely unperceivable to others and vague to the trailed individual, only seeing shadows at the corner of their eyes or in the earshot, yet not sure of the cause.

The tertiary aspect comes from the twisting of certain emotions and thoughts when you whisper or utter a word, becoming the nagging voice in their head, the intrusive thought that’s hard to resist, the scraping erosion of their mind till they break. Once you’re finished with them, your Breaker state ends.

You can pursue this person at any time, toggling between your Breaker and human form, where you’ll quickly teleport to being their specter.
objects.title: (Stranger/Breaker) The Man in the Wall

objects.text:
Nothing can target you unless you explicitly allow it. Targeting systems fail to lock onto you, homing attacks and abilities veer off course, and any powers that need a specific target for their effect fail to even activate.

This only makes you immune from being a target and does not affect the minds of people. It will prevent an energy blast from homing in on you, but it will not help you should you willingly stand in its way. It will prevent a heat-seeking missile from tracking you, but will not prevent someone from shooting a missile in your general direction.
objects.title: (Stranger/Trump) Evasive Manoeuvres

objects.text:
Your secrets are protected and hidden by your power. For your power, a secret is any piece of information directly about yourself that you currently intend to hide, whether consciously or not; this includes your secret identity, a past crime, a medical condition, your real name, a relationship you keep hidden, or even a trivial preference like a disliked food if you actively want it concealed. The more personal weight you assign to that secret, the more your power prioritises it, and you can maintain multiple secrets simultaneously as long as you care about each one.

Your power hides each secret by manipulating probability around anyone searching for that specific information, making them overlook, forget, or fail to access it through a cascade of small improbabilities that never violate physical law: an investigator scrolling past the right file because they blinked, a witness suddenly unable to recall your face because a distraction occurred, a camera glitching at the exact second you passed due to a known hardware quirk, a conversation getting interrupted before the question is asked by a phone ringing, and each failed attempt makes the next attempt statistically less likely to succeed, with the probability of success approaching but never reaching zero, meaning a sufficiently persistent or lucky seeker could still find the secret by sheer chance.

Your power cannot erase a secret someone already knows before you designated it, cannot protect secrets about other people even if you care about them, offers no defense against you accidentally revealing the secret yourself, and weakens significantly if you subconsciously want to be caught or if you tell someone the secret willingly. Additionally certain Thinkers could skip over the process and thus would have an easier time at figuring out your secret.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) My Secret Life

addons.title: Dybbuk
addons.text:
“Every observation, an invitation.”

You can now hijack individuals through the same means that Mama Mathers might infect them, like Thinker powers. Furthermore, your Breaker state can usurp technology observing you, akin to a ‘ghost in the machine’, albeit still limited to only sensory manipulation.

Thanks to Mathers, you may also use the “fragments” of yourself embedded in infected targets and freely switch between them, choosing who is your ‘primary’ host. As such, you can feasibly teleport to locations half a world away by using hosts as vectors. Whenever you occupy a host, their infection is refreshed to its maximum possible strength.

Whereas Mathers is initially limited to just altering the senses through which she is perceived (i.e. if seen, vision is impacted but not hearing), your infection covers all of a target’s available senses equally. An infection’s potency still depends on how long and clearly you are perceived.

objects.text:
When someone directly perceives you, you can physically “vanish” and instead become solely existent within the observer’s mind, acting as a cognitive parasite.
