While in this parasitic state, you completely hijack their senses. You freely piggyback on their sight, hearing and more, letting you perceive everything they might. At the same time, you can also distort their sensory input, altering what they see, touch, taste etc. 

For example, you could create false phantoms of yourself to mislead your host, make them feel overwhelming pain or even whisper to them via their hearing. This power does not provide any further awareness or control over other aspects of your host’s mind.

At any time, you may re-appear by manifesting at a nearby location where your host perceives you to be. So if you cause them to see you standing across the road, you may materialise there in truth. If whomever you are hijacking dies, you will forcibly emerge.

You are fully aware of everyone currently observing you, including how their senses are registering you, although you can only hijack one host at a time. This power also only encompasses direct observation and does not extend to indirect methods such as electronic spying or remote Thinker powers.
objects.title: (Stranger/Breaker) Sensory Squatter

objects.text: You can transform yourself into a half-transparent ghost that can enter the bodies of people and control them from the inside. You have access to their powers while inside of them as well as your own. You do not have to always control them and can instead just hide inside a person undetectable by any other forms of detection. You cannot possess objects or corpses, only living organisms relatively as small as you or larger. Although you can cram yourself into humans regardless of your size compared to theirs.
objects.title: (Stranger/Breaker) Hitchhike

objects.text:
If anyone tells you something, no one else can learn that information. The limitation on this is that the information cannot already be common knowledge; if more than about three-dozen people already know a piece of information, this power won't work on it. It also only applies to information that both parties believe to be true.

If someone tries to share this information, they'll be unable to. If someone tries to read the information, their eyes will just slide past it. If someone observes something that should clue them in, they'll dismiss it.
objects.title: (Stranger) Classified Information

objects.text: Whenever you hear somebody verbally wish for something, you can turn their wish into a reality, but only if you have the skills and abilities to theoretically accomplish it within one month. If you do have the ability to fulfill the wish, reality will shift to accommodate the outcome of your theoretically success. You are limited to using this ability three times per person, and you cannot use it for your own wishes.
objects.title: (Stranger/Thinker) Discount Genie

objects.text:
As long as you can escape any pursuers or combatants, you’ll never face the negative consequences of any actions you take.

Kill a man in broad daylight, as long as you escape the police and/or any other pursuers and stay out of sight for long enough, you’ve effectively gotten away with it.

They’ll never pursue a case against you regardless of how much evidence they collect, they’ll never harass you, or be used against you in any way.

Likewise you can do the same with any other kind of consequences, his brother won’t swear vengeance, you won’t face any issues with the public opinion of you, no gang members will try to take revenge, they won’t hold it against you as part of any negotiations, etc. 

This doesn’t prevent people from realizing you did it of course, but merely lets you escape any consequences as long as you get away, both legal and otherwise.

This does allow you to still benefit from any positives that may come out of the actions, allowing you to somehow paradoxically be able to garner positive results, such as praise for saving a family from a house fire, while simultaneously avoiding negative repercussions from the same action, such as having set fire to the house yourself. 

This follows for any action you commit, as long as you can escape and break the line of sight with anyone who is both aware of the action you’ve taken and is actively pursuing or engaging and is antagonistic because of it. 

For this power to take effect you must have broke line-of-sight with any pursuers and must remain out of sight for 30 minutes. Thinker powers do not count for line-of-sight. 

This power can be toggled to effect certain actions and not others, left on passively for everything, or simply turned off.
objects.title: (Stranger) Catch Me If You Can

objects.text: People won't notice you unless you attack them. You could go the the bathroom on their food, and while they wouldn't eat the food, they wouldn't acknowledge your existence. They will know something is up though, since there was poop in their food.
objects.title: (Stranger) Unnoticeable

objects.text: Everyone will feel their attention pulled to you. It isn't absolute, but most people wouldn't notice if someone else was being mugged right next to them while this power is active. People who either can not pay attention to a single thing for their life or who are very good at paying attention to one thing in exclusion to all others will have resistance to this power.
objects.title: (Stranger) Center of Attention

objects.text:
You become a Harem Protagonist, gaining a "magnetic aura" towards those who could plausibly hold mutual romantic interest with you, subtly causing chance encounters and progressively influencing emotions in your favor with each one, particularly in the case of parahumans. This even goes as far as to Trump powers, causing Thinker powers to conclude this power's influence is the result of coincidence and preventing parahumans affected by this power from unintentionally harming you with their powers. 

Be warned that this does not come with an "off" switch and parahumans by nature are unstable.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Harem Protagonist

addons.text:
Instead of only justifying or explaining your actions to the point of indifference, individuals affected by your power will now continually rationalise your actions to that of reverence and worship, no matter how ridiculous or horrific the act.

Spit in someone’s eye? A blessing bestowed from the almighty. Stab a family member in the heart? A feat to be worshipped and clear proof of divinity. These rationalisations are so ingrained and seemingly logical that it is extremely challenging to convince an affected individual otherwise.
addons.title: You ARE the Messiah!

objects.text:
You possess the uncanny power to ensure that no matter what you do, you will always be forgiven for your actions by the individuals affected. Whenever you do something that would cause offence, resentment or hostility in any form, the people impacted will automatically, completely forgive you for whatever you did.

For example, you could verbally harass or even directly harm someone and they would absolve you. This doesn’t alter or erase an individual’s memories, it only ensures that they will not form a grudge or hold whatever you’ve done against you. This power will cause those affected to subconsciously justify or rationalise your actions, convincing themselves that your behaviour wasn’t that bad or that there was a good reason for it, but only to the point of indifference.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Absolution

objects.text:
You emit a 300-meter-wide Master effect known as a “SEP field”. SEP, as in “somebody else’s problem”, essentially imposes the mind’s capacity to opt out of anything if it is considered as somebody else’s mess or matter, or the people’s natural capacity not to see anything they don't want to, aren't expecting, or can't explain.

Anything you do won’t be questioned, as they automatically think someone will take care of it, will feel it’s too weird to deal with, and so on. This can be focused on one or several objects or a group of people, too, shrouding them in an “presence” of SEP; your actions are completely nothing to write home about to others’ eyes.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) SEP

objects.text: You can, at will, activate a Boring aura which makes it so that everyone feels incredibly bored, restless, and fatigued.
objects.title: (Stranger) Boring

objects.text: You have the uncanny ability to blend in and infiltrate any group, no matter how ridiculous it would be otherwise for you to be in that group. People will instinctively trust whatever background you give them, and you will be treated befittingly. It would take hard evidence or a show of incompetence to convince others that you are an Imposter and not the actual identity that you have given them, but you also have quite the ability to shift fault and blame your failure on others rather than yourself, to the point of making others doubt that the imposter is the one you are trying to frame.
objects.title: (Stranger) Imposter Sus

objects.text: If you believe what you're saying is the truth, everyone will believe you, unless they have proof you're wrong shoved in their face. If you said the sky was purple, while believing it, looking at the blue sky would snap them out of the effect.
objects.title: (Stranger) Truth

objects.text: People will believe any lie you make. However, the more absurd the lie, the quicker this effect fades. If they see incontrovertible proof you were lying, the effect will snap.
objects.title: (Stranger) Bluff

objects.text:
You are capable of producing an invisible, intangible “fog” over a large area. This fog is capable of hijacking the senses of everything inside, living or artificial (like cameras and microphones), giving you the ability to access and override them at will to make them experience whatever illusions you desire, effectively turning the area into a holodeck. You are also capable of creating illusions of the same calibre that can be visible even to people outside the fog, although you will not get to access their senses or be capable of specialising the illusions to specific people like you would if they were inside.

You can range from giving everyone in the fog the same illusion to giving each individual person a different personalised experience, with their expectations and knowledge filling in the gaps for any details about the illusions you don't personally assign (how it breaks, what it looks like on the back, etc.).

Those inside the fog will instinctively act in such a way to maintain the illusions they’re observing (i.e. if they lean against an illusory wall they will unconsciously lean in such a way that they are still balanced and thus won't fall through it), if they push past these instincts and/or make mistakes the illusions automatically adjust to maintain realism and explain away any inconsistencies caused by the illusion in whatever way the subject thinks would make the most sense (i.e. if they tripped and fell through an illusory wall then the illusory wall will have “broken”).

Your power is even capable of hijacking and tricking exotic senses like thinker powers, although they take more focus to understand and manipulate.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Sensorium

objects.text:
You have the ability to make those who see you become unable to perceive anything but you. Not only that, but it causes them to hyperfocus on you. Essentially, their senses won’t register anything that isn’t you—with the exception of themselves—and their thoughts and actions are solely focused on you. This means that if you used your power on a team, all members would not only lose sight of each other, but also forget they were fighting you together because they are too preoccupied with wanting to punch your face to remember they aren’t alone.

While this power allows you to essentially blind your opponents to the world around them—enabling things like setting up traps without detection—it has the side effect of making those affected by it highly perceptive of you, not even walls working as visual covers. This could lead to issues, such as them remembering your face very clearly, even decades later.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Eyes On Me

objects.text:
You have a power similar to Coil, the power to simulate two timelines where you take mutually exclusive actions. However, unlike Coil, your timelines only last 5 minutes, and you must choose which timeline happens when you activate the power. The main benefit from this power is that you may create a realistic, tactile illusion paired with a strong Stranger effect that makes everyone believe you chose the other timeline.

This allows you to, say, make your opponent think you charged right at them and engaged them in melee combat, even feeling 'your' blows, when in reality you snuck up behind them and stabbed them in the back, never even noticing their gaping wound. When 5 minutes pass, the illusion fades away, simulated injuries vanish and real injuries that were previously hidden appear, as everyone realizes that they were tricked.

If they know about the power ahead of time, they can try to act on how they think your real actions are, but the Stranger effect is hard to resist, constantly forcing people to consider that your simulated actions are real. Certain Parahumans like Alexandria or Weld who don't think with normal brains are completely immune to the Stranger portion, but the illusion still completely hides your presence and real actions even from power derived senses.

Your illusion has a selectable range between 10 and 1000 meters. You may selectively exclude people from the effect, allowing them to see the real timeline with the illusion appearing as a mostly translucent hologram to them just as it does for you.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Simulated Delusion

rows.title: Power Copy
rows.titleText: You're copying the power of a parahuman. Powers like Eidolon's or Glaistig Uaine's won't be here.

addons.text: As a Titan, all your power limiters are gone, including those of your human body, your teleporting now has no range limit. Your Shard’s threat calculation has scaled up into a complete danger sense which you can use to assess the biggest threat and immediately teleport to it. You absorb the light in the area as you teleport, enveloping yourself in a shadow wherever you appear.
addons.title: Titan Skadi

objects.text: You have the ability to teleport to the nearest biggest "threat" in your vicinity, only towards this threat. This ability can be applied in battle by "lining up a shot" and teleporting towards the most dangerous target on the field, hitting any collateral targets on your way towards said target. Your shard has an evaluation mechanism that fixes what the greatest threat to yourself is, which means if your actions put yourself in danger you could be cut off from your power in the middle of a fight. You can’t teleport other people with you.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Axehead

objects.text: You can fly fast and leave trails of luminous slivers of light that fall to the ground in your wake. Upon touching something solid they balloon out to make soft force fields that will then encase those that they come into contact with. These force fields can be broken out of without too much trouble, even with multiple fields layered over one another, but they impede movement.
objects.title: (Mover) Dovetail

objects.text: You’re a pseudo-teleporter, by picking a target through line of sight you gain awareness of them and can advantageously position yourself to catch them off guard, staying at the same starting position yet warping space to get to that advantageous position as if you had already been there. You can cover great distances but don’t disappear while positioning yourself until you arrive.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Foxtrot

objects.text: You can teleport to areas you’ve set up in advance.
objects.title: (Mover) Getaway

addons.text: As a Titan you’re capable of teleporting things and people hundreds of kilometers away through cloud gateways. Whenever something makes its way through these, they are followed by an explosive materialization proportional to the size of what was teleported, which flattens the surroundings and kills people purely due to its power. This ranges from entry point to exit point, leaving behind a trail of devastation.
addons.title: Titan Pouffe

objects.text: You’re a 'cloud mover', with the ability of mass transportation, able to create solid clouds to transport objects.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Pouffe

objects.text: You have the ability to create a cubic space of virtually any size which serves as six interlinked portals. Passage through one side of the portal can transport you to the far side. You have altered perceptions of space and movement, allowing you easier interpretation during combat.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Scroll

objects.text: You can dilate time, making the world appear frozen to you with a cooldown of 1-2 minutes after use. This effect extends a quarter inch from your body, allowing some breathing, however, while your power is active, your ability to physically interact with the world is severely limited. Air is experienced as dense as water, thus limiting the amount of time you can stay in this state through your air supply, and heat is insufferable without protection, which can lead to injuries. Carried weight makes it harder to move and thus using your power for extended periods will leave you exhausted or even wounded.
objects.title: (Mover) Secondhand

addons.title: Tele-Glitch
addons.text: You can use your groups of five or more Bugs as markers for your teleportation. This consumes the Bugs you teleport to, with their electricity amplifying the electromagnetic disruption of your teleport.

objects.text: You’re capable of short range teleportation and disruption of electromagnetics.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Virago

objects.text: You can charge up energy, expending it to trade each second of time spent charging for several seconds worth of invulnerability, super strength, super speed and electromagnetic repulsion/attraction.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) Battery

objects.text: You have the ability to alter and extend your clothing. Using your power, you could form the sleeves of your costume into large wings and fly by riding air currents, alter your wings to attack from above by extending them or use them as barriers to block enemy fire.
objects.title: (Mover) Flapper

objects.text: By swiping bladed weapons mid-air, deep, long furrows appear in the area they were aimed at. You also have a personal Mover ability that allows you to "flicker" between the ends of the furrows created by your power.
objects.title: (Mover) Longscratch

objects.text: You’re a Mover/Shaker who is capable of creating portals. The portals you create look like forcefields. When people enter the portals, they turn into a fractal energy bolt and move quickly to a different location.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Tailgate

objects.text:
You can swap the positions of two targets of similar mass that are both within your field of view, including yourself. 

Your ability to swap targets is impacted by the difference in their masses. To compensate for any discrepancy in mass, surrounding air must be drawn in, which increases the time needed. Consequently, substantial mass disparities significantly slow this power down and reduce your effective range.

You have a secondary Thinker ability that lets you sense the mass and weight of your targets, helping you determine how easily they can be switched.
objects.title: (Mover) Trickster

objects.text: You’re a bio-speedster, capable of moving superhumanly fast, due to your unique biology. You’re unnaturally thin like a broomstick with thin skin stretched tight across your face and eyes bulging out of your skull.
objects.title: (Mover) Whippersnap

objects.text: You can generate clouds of smoke-like darkness which you are able to teleport yourself and others through, with a range of multiple city blocks.
objects.title: (Mover) Abhorror (Teleporter)

objects.text: You have a teleportation power to mark objects and people via touch and teleport to them whenever you want, as well as several minor powers that enhance your agility, coordination, and stamina.
objects.title: (Mover) Mouse Protector

addons.text: As a Titan, your abilities are hugely upgraded. You become capable of dropping into the ground as if it were liquid, producing a liquid ripple that shakes buildings and streets, doing a large amount of damage to everything around yourself. While in the ground you can also move through it rapidly.
addons.title: The Flowing Titan

objects.text: You have a mover power that is a type of controlled spatial distortion, this spatial warping is accomplished by drawing out circles with your equipment and then stepping on the affected space to propel yourself forward. Like surfing on it while allowing you to move at an unbelievable speed.
objects.title: (Mover) Shortcut

objects.text: You have flight that gradually accelerates in speed but has limited turning ability and can create gaseous filter 'bombs' that thrust all gas, oxygen included, out of an area, until you cancel the effect, prompting a crashing return of the gas.
objects.title: (Mover) Albatros

objects.text: You can fly and create a blue-green forcefield around yourself. You can increase the brightness of your forcefield over a few seconds, making it swell and ultimately detonate causing a large explosion with no harm to yourself, leaving the forcefield out of commission for a while.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Grandiose

objects.text: You’re a Mover who can teleport towards another person by casting out a shimmer of light, with your arrival teleporting them in turn. You’re also a Thinker who can communicate with people via 'telepathy' limited through concepts. The language interpretation is done by the recipient's brain, meaning it’s not restricted to the individual's language and you’re able to 'read' people. This part of your power can be used for long-distance communication.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Relay

addons.title: Relativity
addons.text: Through the integration of Mass = Acceleration, one of Velocity’s major weaknesses has been averted. Rather than your mass decreasing as you accelerate, it instead increases in line with the effects of Mass = Acceleration, allowing you to instead become vastly stronger and more durable as you accelerate. If you possess the upgrade Celerity then you can selectively toggle whether accelerating increases or decreases your mass, allowing you to either increase in strength or phase through things. This switching occurs instantaneously, meaning that you can do things like phase through someone before immediately switching to increased mass in order to hit them from behind.

objects.text: You have the ability to move in superspeed, though your ability to affect the world lessens the faster you go due to your mass lessening.
objects.title: (Mover) Velocity

objects.text: You have the ability to launch yourself at high speed, bounce off surfaces, and create explosions of fire on contact. You can bounce without creating explosions, or create explosions without bouncing. You can't bounce on water. Even without exploding, your kicks are sufficient to toss a person across a room hard enough to incapacitate them and to shift metal. In addition you have a slowed aging rate.
objects.title: (Mover) Bambina

objects.text: You have flight with build-up of speed over time, can transfer built-up speed to others with a touch, sacrificing speed for high-impact blows. Have increased agility, can make deafening shrieks, and recover very quickly from smaller wounds, but not from larger wounds.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Foulcock

objects.text: You can fly as well as create and throw "ice fractals" that you can control the path of and which expand explosively on impact. You can predetermine the size and shape of these glaciers, to such ends as forming ice armor or walls.
objects.title: (Mover/Blaster) Rime

objects.text: You have enhanced leaps and bounds with set rules on leaping/bounding toward or to predetermined markers. By placing a marker on the moon you could teleport to and from it.
objects.title: (Mover) Kirin White

objects.text: You possess four abilities. A Mover power that allows you to treat any direction as 'down', letting you jump, walk, and 'fall' any way you choose, A minor Tinker power for Gauntlets that cover your arms, the ability to inflict negative emotions on those touched with gauntlets you create, and finally a Striker ability that allows you to easily blast through inorganic material.
objects.title: (Mover/Tinker) Snag

objects.text: You possess acute short-range clairvoyance, short-burst superspeed, see people’s biology while ignoring the issues of light, darkness or intervening objects, and have 'phantom hands' that can reach into people's bodies to do horrible internal damage to organs and/or nerves.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Watch

objects.text: You can access a variety of pocket dimensions to banish people, create blasts of wind, collect matter and shoot it as a bullet, fly, and clean up radiation. You can also glimpse how powers work.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Myrddin

objects.text: You can teleport up to 50 feet by swinging a weapon. While teleporting, innumerable versions of yourself occupy the space in the area between your departure and arrival point, each moving for a fraction of a second. The distance you teleport is determined by the arc of your swing. You also have a slight brute rating.
objects.title: (Mover/Striker) Black Kaze

objects.text: You are capable of teleporting to any location you have ever been to. You can also teleport to unknown locations based on their distance relative to you or specific spatial coordinates. Furthermore, you can teleport anyone within a 10 meter radius with you. Your teleportation is accompanied by a noise similar to a muffled thunderclap. The longer 'strides' you make, the louder the sound is.
objects.title: (Mover) Strider

objects.text: You can telekinetically control objects you trace a rune onto.
objects.title: (Shaker) Rune

objects.text: You have the ability to unfold materials in a fractal like manner. For example turning a metal fan into a large wall to act as a barrier.
objects.title: (Shaker) Crested

objects.text: You have control over subsonic noises. You can both sense and generate higher-pitched pulses of subsonic noise to act as a form of radar. This echolocation aids you in combat, allowing you to fight even with your eyes closed. You can also maintain a pulse of subsonic noises to disorient and induce vertigo in living creatures.
objects.title: (Shaker) Cricket

objects.text: You can displace things into and out of a dimension filled with water.
objects.title: (Shaker) Fathom

objects.text: You can reduce the flow of time for a single target, slowing them in an ongoing effect and can swap the target at a moment's notice.
objects.title: (Shaker) Final Hour

addons.text:
You can create entire living beings out of pure energy, shaping them into human or nonhuman forms. These beings have no independent will or consciousness but are fully capable of following your commands. 

Although they lack minds of their own, they can perform complex tasks, acting as extensions of your will. The less biologically stable they are, and the more you summon at once, the higher the strain there will be to keep them summoned.
addons.title: Emperor of Cups

objects.text: You have the ability to create limbs out of energy, using them for mobility or grafting them onto wound stumps as prosthetics.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) King of Cups

objects.text: You have enhanced strength and agility that are further augmented with point-blank aerokinesis.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) Califa de Perro

objects.text: You can create a hazy field around yourself and others, that copies whatever happens inside that field to another area. You’re also capable of flight.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Chronicler

objects.text: You can create pocket dimensions, and you can place these 'caches' in fixed locations. You can store both inanimate objects and people. Caches placed within roughly 25 feet of each other can form a 'network' where objects or individuals, albeit the latter with a delay, can be taken from. Your abilities only operate ideally when you have total focus without worrying about your safety or other distractions.
objects.title: (Shaker) Cozen

objects.text: You have proximity-based Psychometry, you can draw knowledge from objects and people in your vicinity. It’s always on, but somewhat focusable and suppressible.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Dredge

objects.text: You can target an individual with this power via line of sight and temporarily teleport them away. From the affected individual's perspective, they are transported to a shadowy landscape for an indefinite period of time. The affected individual may experience anxiety as a side-effect of this power.
objects.title: (Shaker) End of Days

objects.text: You have a Shaker ability that allows you to create shockwaves by clapping your hands. These shockwaves collect items as they move away from you, and you can redirect all of these into a different direction with high speed though your own movement.
objects.title: (Shaker) Gong

addons.text:
Your smoke-like darkness is weightless and expands exponentially, clinging to everything it touches. Once it clings to someone or something, it drains all forms of energy—heat, sound, light—leaving only a cold, suffocating void. All powers within your darkness are completely nullified.

As their powers are suppressed, you gain full access to them. You can wield these abilities with the same skill and control as their original owners.
addons.title: Grue²

objects.text: You can generate clouds of smoke-like darkness that erase all light and mute sounds. This smoke also interferes with microwaves, radio frequencies, radiation, and certain Breaker powers. Also, your vision is unaffected by your own darkness.
objects.title: (Shaker) Grue

objects.text: You gain an aerokinetic ability to create blades of wind. You can form whirlwinds and slice people with air compressed into razor-like ribbons.
objects.title: (Shaker) Kazikli Bey

objects.text: You can create force fields in geometric shapes, remaining aware of them to an almost clairvoyant level. You can individually choose what can pass through them and can walk through your own force fields easily. Sufficiently powerful hits can shatter your fields and they generally appear in the shape of pyramids, diamonds, cubes, spheres, and cylinders. You can turn some of these shapes into sharp points by manipulating how these shapes are expressed. The range within which you can create force fields is about twenty feet.
objects.title: (Shaker) Licit

objects.text: You’re a healer who emits an aura that regenerates those in the area, causing wounds to close quickly and mend. Your power feels like being by the fireside, just close enough to feel as though that 'heat' had a physical form, just close enough to be bearable, instead of feeling hot however, the sensation is almost like a chill. The sensation is directional, making everyone aware of exactly where you are. Your power has a wide range, able to reach across an entire street, and grants some resistance to the wounding effects of other powers while under your power. Your power can be repressed.
objects.title: (Shaker) Lizardtail II

objects.text: You have an always-on Shaker ability that transforms the surfaces of objects fifteen feet around you, in a perfect circle, into an oil slick. This oil produces bubbles and is Manton-limited, but can affect clothes. Once you leave the surfaces revert to their normal state. You can ignite your oil and aren’t damaged by the fire produced this way.
objects.title: (Shaker) Naphtha

objects.text: You have fine telekinetic control over materials that weigh less than a half-pound. You can infuse porous materials with your power to control larger objects. Human flesh is the best material for your power, giving you more control and strengthening the material.
objects.title: (Shaker) Parian

objects.text: You are capable of instantly rewinding yourself or an object (living or nonliving) within line of sight back to where and how it was a few seconds ago. Any object or person transferred this way, including yourself, has their memory erased of the transfer and the time in between.
objects.title: (Shaker) Perdition

objects.text: You have enhanced strength, as well as a shaker power that allows you to create spears of light that can impale people and extend up to the horizon.
objects.title: (Shaker/Brute) Prong (Mercenary)

objects.text: You gain flight, the ability to project hard light blasts, and create force fields around yourself. However your flight is relatively slow and your blasts, although with a wide range, are somewhat weak. In exchange, your shields are very strong and you can freely manipulate them as well as keep them suspended in midair without grounding.
objects.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Shielder

objects.text: You have the ability to create spheres of light around living things, which move to follow them. Anything inside the sphere of light becomes soft and malleable, and any alterations to them while inside are permanent. The bubbles are semi-solid, but allow small creatures to move through them when they push. When one surrounds a target's head, they’ll have difficulty breathing and have their vision distorted, but these go back to normal when the effect ends. The spheres are only large enough to contain someone's head at their largest, and fade after a short time.
objects.title: (Shaker) Softball

objects.text: You can create 'chainsaw' rotations of telekinetic activity around your hands. Invisible wheels, oval in shape, can be used to attack, propel yourself forward, and scale surfaces. Your physical durability is augmented by your powers.
objects.title: (Shaker) Tomcat

objects.text: You have gaseous kinesthesia, pink spores of dust accumulate over time in your vicinity. These serve as a vector for your power letting you exert greater strength, leverage and maneuverability over objects and people over time. It can also be used to jump start a truck that should have been scrapped a decade ago. Though this can take up to five minutes.
objects.title: (Shaker) Velvet

objects.text: You can rapidly create spectral duplicates of people and objects within your vicinity, yourself included. These spectral copies are less like duplicates and more like forcefields, being bits of force molded in a particular shape. The copies are weak and less than solid on their own but become more and more solid when they overlap. They shatter when broken.
objects.title: (Shaker) Vince Crowley

objects.text: You create beachball-sized black spheres which you can control. You can use it to illuminate the dark and draw people towards them. Their pull increases steadily, from a gale up to allowing you to drag people into it, securing them tight against the sphere's surface and allowing you to transport them that way.
objects.title: (Shaker) Anomaly

objects.text: You can control a metal ball that you can move around at supersonic velocities. You’re also capable of flight.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Balk

objects.text: You’re capable of creating a variety of force fields and deflector fields. You have a clairvoyant awareness of your fields, including what affects them.
objects.title: (Shaker) Bastion

objects.text: You’re a Shaker capable of utilizing vibrations, primarily your voice but also others, to deliver deleterious and unpleasant hallucinations to individuals in the area, this bypasses artificial/real deafness. You cannot render allies immune to your power.
objects.title: (Shaker) Cadence

objects.text: You have a pocket dimension which you can use to store things and which has the ability to suck air into it strongly enough to create a vacuum, dragging flying capes towards it. You can also light an entire person on fire just by touching them.
objects.title: (Shaker/Striker) Carnie

objects.text: You can mark a location. If you die in said location, you fill the area with violent twisted flesh, as well as cross and angel iconography. You gain swiftly increasing awareness and control over the mutated flesh and angels before being born from the mass, after which point it all dies.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Crosswise

objects.text: You can create telekinetically controlled 'orbs' of light that look like flowers or firecrackers. You can plant these orbs with a touch on surfaces, allowing them to grow over time for larger and more varied effects when you detonate them or an opponent accidentally touches them. Your power needs your hands free to use.
objects.title: (Shaker) Fleur

objects.text:
Your darkness is thicker, heavier, and comes out slower, but grows exponentially. It also weakens or temporarily removes some powers.
Additionally, you can copy the powers of Parahumans inside your darkness, though they'll be weaker and you generally don't gain the thinker benefits the copied power has.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Grue (Second Trigger)

objects.text: You’re a gravity manipulator who can create multiple conflicting gravity fields within an area. Able to manipulate overlapping gravity environments to throw people around. You can also perceive gravity wells. Effects produced by you break if you lose concentration. You can apply your power to yourself while moving to make it near-silent, though straining your attention significantly.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Moonsong

objects.text: You manifest an aura of repulsiveness so strong that the relief of having it lifted can be addictive. You could capitalize on this by making yourself and your territory as disgusting as possible. This makes it easier for your power to amplify feelings of disgust to full repulsion and reinforce your reputation as a crazy person. Your power's secondary effects help you cope psychologically and you have resistance to emotional manipulation by other capes.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Pearl

objects.text: You have the power to break non-living material into leaf-like fragments, control those fragments, and reconstitute them into the objects or parts of the object at a different location. You’re able to use your power to break down a car in three to four seconds. The flakes you create are light and fragile enough that they take a while to do much damage, often failing to harm even an insect, although they are sharp enough that a storm of petals can cut through spider silk. One notable offensive use for your power is that you can reconstitute heavy objects in mid-air above your opponents.
objects.title: (Shaker) Rosary

objects.text: You’re able to hide yourself and other people in two-dimensional space. Upon emerging from a surface, they will peel away and emerge unscathed. People in these two-dimensional spaces can still be injured if the surface they reside on becomes damaged.
objects.title: (Shaker) Scape (2D)

objects.text: You have the ability to twist the world around you, using it to weaken the world around you such as walls and building supports. Your power works in a wide area but at a slow speed. your power is unhindered by the presence of living beings. You can also sense the world through your power, able to stretch buildings even with your eyes obstructed.
objects.title: (Shaker) Scape (Weakener)

objects.text: You can create strips of purple repelling energy on surfaces you can see. These strips are one directional, meaning they either accelerate or repel mass depending on which side it entered from.
objects.title: (Shaker) Skidmark

objects.text: Listening to you causes a latent cascade of mental and sonic energy to build. Once released it stuns and deafens people at will based on how much a given subject has heard you talk. After being unleashed the power 'resets' and must be built up again.
objects.title: (Shaker) Speaker of the House

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate chains with telekinesis. You can also use them to move quickly around the battlefield and even roll long distances as a huge ball.
objects.title: (Shaker) Trial

objects.text: Your power is sound manipulation, of which you can control its force, area of effect, and unleash it in bursts. You also sport a mild healing factor, healing quicker than average with minimal scarring. Your sound blasts are capable of punching through concrete.
objects.title: (Shaker) Triumph

objects.text: You are capable of telekinesis, but only in a counterclockwise rotation around yourself. You can use it to create what is effectively a point-blank telekinetic cyclone around yourself, picking up dust, papers, cigarette butts and fragments of rock.
objects.title: (Shaker) Whirlygig

objects.text: You’re an aerokinetic who can compress the air around you into shearing blades of wind that grow as they travel out, these blades are able to 'boomerang' back to you. These blades have enough shearing force to cut through a modern-day cart. You’re able to manipulate the wind around you so bugs and projectiles have a harder time trying to cover you. You’re also capable of using large gusts of wind to push objects away from you.
objects.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Eligos

objects.text: You have the ability to create human and nonhuman body parts made of energy, that are able to cover an area ranging from one horizon to the other.
objects.title: (Shaker) King of Cups (Second Trigger)

objects.text: You’re able to raise surfaces, use them to move around and sculpt them into rough images, able to create rough statues.
objects.title: (Shaker) Scape (Sculpter)

objects.text: You gain a form of aerokinesis. You can condense air into hard ‘claws’ that you can launch as projectiles, create explosive blasts of condensed air, use air currents to deflect projectiles and achieve limited flight by essentially floating in place. You can also draw in sounds and smells towards yourself, effectively enhancing your senses.
objects.title: (Shaker) Stormtiger

objects.text: You generate a paint-like substance from your body, primarily your hands, and in large quantities if you need to. This 'paint' has a variety of applications and can be controlled after it is deposited. These applications included hardening, which can be used to seal up a door. It can be used to trap opponents, if an enemy is strong enough to shatter it, it can harden and be broken and harden again. You seem to leave paint on things you touch even if you don't want to, but your ability to control the substance makes cleaning it up easy.
objects.title: (Shaker) Tempera

objects.text: You have the ability to fill empty spaces with hundreds of small, razor-sharp force fields, with collective, cumulative resistance, meaning the more there are, the stronger their force fields become.
objects.title: (Shaker) Vex

objects.text: You generate a gas with each sound you make linked to the vocal stress you put on it. This gas can be converted into a variety of effects, including but not limited to concussive force, heat and cold, as well as others. You can also use your ability to clear out anything obscuring your mouth and throat. You are resistant to effects generated by your own powers, but repeated use causes your throat to get sore.
objects.title: (Shaker) Barker

objects.text: You are a versatile pyrokinetic and can teleport freely between flames. You find it harder to stop using your power the more you use it and become increasingly psychopathic in the presence of fire. You are immune to fire.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Burnscar

objects.text: You can produce a cone-shaped spray of liquid forcefield capable of covering roughly eight hundred square feet in seconds. It is initially fragile, breaking if the target is already moving at a walking pace, before setting to a consistency akin to sheet metal, capable of being bent or broken with exerted force at the edges. Further spray can layer the field for additional strength. You can manage the breadth and intensity of your spray by way of energy projected tools that your power provides at the palm of your hands which can be used as weapons. Using these tools, you can keep the clay in a semiliquid state and mold it into simple, medieval constructions, alter its properties to facilitate these constructions, or alter their fundamental properties, such as making the substance conductive to electricity or not.
objects.title: (Shaker/Tinker) Clay

objects.text: You’re able to create a pale blue forcefield bubble that can flare an intense orange white filling it with intense heat, incinerating everything inside. Your power is restricted to spherical shapes like domes and bubbles. The incineration effect is optional and you can simply use them to contain objects and people.
objects.title: (Shaker) Crucible

objects.text: You’re capable of materializing ferrous metal objects in midair in the shape of spears, blades, and weights. These form at higher or lower altitudes, with their flight controlled using minor ferrokinesis which you can use to aim them, sometimes sacrificing accuracy for penetrating power. You have the ability to 'charge' your power, manifesting a larger number of ferrous objects.
objects.title: (Shaker) Iron Rain

objects.text: You can create metal objects that extend from a solid surface around you. The metal can be iron or steel.
objects.title: (Shaker) Kaiser

objects.text: You have blood control that can cause a lot of damage, you can also function as a healer of sorts by drawing blood out of people, cleaning it, then putting it back in. You can create enormous blood clots the size of fists to cover people's wounds.
objects.title: (Shaker) Sanguine

addons.text:
The scope and potency of what Shamrock can do has been considerably amplified. Your unconscious clairvoyance and precognition abilities now encompass an entire city with your precognition able to see up to 24 hours into the future. Your micro-telekinesis has similarly benefited from this new range, with Shamrock working subconsciously to continuously cause slight changes to your future benefit.

Your 'luck' has magnified exponentially as Shamrock and Deus Ex Machina play off each other to create powerful, cascading chain reactions on a grand scale. A series of seemingly unrelated malfunctions across the city could occur to prevent enemy reinforcements or a building might collapse on an opponent due to structural weaknesses having 'spontaneously' transpired hours earlier.
addons.title: Luck of the Irish

objects.text:
You possess a subtle combination of micro-telekinesis combined with an unconscious small-scale clairvoyance/precognition-based Thinker ability. You can cause slight changes around you which lead to greater effects, manipulating events in your favour and so giving the appearance of extraordinary luck.

For example, you could shoot with perfect accuracy, casually dodge attacks, influence dice rolls or easily find lost objects. Your powers also cause you to be a Thinker blindspot to most.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Shamrock

objects.text: You’re a type of telekinetic with the power to maintain spatial relationships, like being able to connect yourself and others with Movers that might be limited to personal teleportation. Your power requires you to have a strong reference with what you’re working with. Preferably through touch for a strong connection but, failing that, eyesight can be used albeit not as effectively.
objects.title: (Shaker) Sifara

objects.text: You can create gravity spheres that drag all things touching them into the sphere's center. You can also weaponize these spheres by giving them a shredding or cutting exterior or using the interior to crush things. The pull and a timed dismissal of the sphere can ‘toss’ persons and objects.
objects.title: (Shaker) Snaptrap

objects.text: You’re capable of forming a miniature black hole that looks like a blob of darkness, that vacuums things into it and can consume and devour them. You can expand it, albeit slowly.
objects.title: (Shaker) Snuff

objects.text:
You can broadly manipulate metal around yourself with strong crude movements (e.g., pushing, pulling, crushing) for both offensive and defensive purposes. Your metallokinesis allows you to wear metal armor without being encumbered and lets you hinder opponents that use metal weapons or armor against you. You use your metallokinesis to distort your armor into a variety of useful shapes, such as a blade to cut through restrictive material, and a completely form-fitting suit that protects your armor from being entered by small minions and attacks. 

On top of reshaping metal, you can also slowly refine it to enhance your strength and durability and repair damaged armor. Your metallokinesis focuses on strength instead of agility/accuracy and thus lacks fine control, has short range, and is slow.
objects.title: (Shaker) Adamant

objects.text:
You are capable of generating an inertia-manipulating field around you that has a controlled series of effects. One permutation dampens inertia, protecting and slowing things in the area, another accelerates them to prompt faster, less controlled movement. You can affect yourself independently of this general effect, with some benefits of a dampening effect to protect you alongside the benefits of an acceleration to give you speed. 
You can be selective in its application. You have an aura effect that manipulates inertia in a radius around yourself, with a positive bias for yourself. Your field disrupts energy and machinery, which tends to fail or work intermittently within your field. Its use visibly distorts light around it.
objects.title: (Shaker) Auroch

objects.text: You have some degree of enhanced strength and can manipulate earth with a very high degree of control. Able to create a pillar of asphalt without damaging the ground on top. Your ability also gives you a Thinker awareness of earth, a constant sense of the ground around you.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Gully

objects.text: You can affect kinetic forces in a wide radius around you, though the strength of your manipulation tapers off with distance and is strongest in close proximity, giving you a Brute rating. For example, you can slow down, disrupt, or deflect hostile forces via controlled, unconscious alteration of air friction/resistance. Hostile enemies may have trouble breathing. In addition, your actions have increased results for energy involved, a punt sending someone flying through a brick wall. However, sufficiently powerful kinetic attacks such as a melee charge from Leviathan can still take you out of the fight.
objects.title: (Shaker) Krieg

objects.text: You can teleport sections of landscape and only landscape, such as hills or even power effects. Your power is unpredictable, sometimes teleporting things out as well as in, but you can use multiple teleports to shore up gaps. You have limited accuracy and control.
objects.title: (Shaker) Shuffle

objects.text: You have featureless gray planes in the area between your pelvis, your right foot, an area of your stomach, around an eye, and your left arm. You’re capable of manifesting these missing parts of your body from various dimensions, resulting in more powerful attacks. Able to obliterate concrete and steel with a single attack by leveraging possible versions of yourself and drawing them together into one coordinated strike.
objects.title: (Shaker) Subject 3016

objects.text: You can grow artificial organic structures from 'seeds' you create. These seeds will swell into pillars, stairs, houses etc. growing exponentially given enough time in your sphere of influence. The organic wood-like substance will eventually harden into a stone-like substance of varying colors of your supposed choosing after you have terminated the growth.
objects.title: (Shaker) Agnes Court

objects.text: You can banish people into extradimensional spaces or remove them from one. Within any area you can perceive, you can generate dark lines forming complex geometric angles. When you activate your ability, the lines will solidify, contract, and turn into a glossy black. Anything contained within this area is banished into a newly created extradimensional space. Similarly, you can rescue others from created secondary/alternate dimensions. This process has the reverse appearance of banishing, the lines will expand and fade. You can use these powers on yourself to escape into a secondary dimension and teleport back to your former location. If your power fails, there is some backlash like a nosebleed or coughing blood.
objects.title: (Shaker) Cache

objects.text: You and your twin share the same body, only one can be on the surface while the other is locked away in a lightless, motionless prison, with only a window that looks out through your twin’s eyes and listens through your twin’s ears. If two have different looks, then swapping identities also changes your appearance. You can swap identities with your twin rapid fire if you have to. The swapping has mixed results as an anti-master measure, but it affects physical forces, granting some maneuverability. You’re a matter creator able to generate and shape glowing energy that you then transform into their respective element. These start out as motes that then have lines link up between them which then become their respective element. One makes rock, the other makes water. You two are able to create enough material for things like a fort. And can shape the material around single objects and people. One can spray people with water and then switch to the other to turn the water into rock and encase the subject. This switch can only happen if the shapes are "alive" with more energy to back it up. If you two let it die a switch can not happen. Water evaporates and the stone easily crumbles. You two possess different moderately enhanced physical abilities. One has a bit of resistance to temperature extremes, meaning they can withstand greater cold and greater heat than most people can. The other also has an enhanced way of breathing, being able to continue speaking while being choked out. The properties of the matter you two create are related to you and your twin's relationship to each other. For example instead of water creating ice or suffocating gas, with the other forming metal instead of rock.
objects.title: (Shaker) Capricorn

objects.text: You can duplicate non living objects by manifesting a bubble of scintillating energy. By charging up and releasing a ‘wave’ effect, about as tall and as big around as a house, people hit by the effect can fly within the area of this slow-rolling wave. You can also give cover to people within your bubble and anything that crosses the bubble can be duplicated whenever it crosses your field, as long as it travels outward.
objects.title: (Shaker) Empusa

objects.text: You have a Shaker ability, letting you spawn countless copies of objects that you push into the ground. These require your presence and attention to exist. These objects lurch and spear out of the ground. You can replicate almost anything in an area, with the replications independent of the template after replication.
objects.title: (Shaker) Gibbet

objects.text: You can create crystalline forcefields that have a noticeable violet-blue tint strong enough to cut into Endbringer flesh. You can move these forcefields at up to 40 km/h, though only in straight lines. If an opponent is within 50 feet of you, you can create a forcefield to bisect them. You have a limit to how many forcefields you can active at once, up to a dozen at a time when being offensive. Your forcefields do not conduct temperature. You have extremely fine control over your forcefields.
objects.title: (Shaker) Narwhal

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate silicon through high-frequency sounds, giving you essentially perfect control over all glass, sand, and other siliceous compounds.
objects.title: (Shaker) Shatterbird

addons.text: As a Titan you gain a massive increase in range, in addition, you can now convert inorganic matter inside your range into ash, which you can telekinetically control and shape. The buildings, as well as other structures in your way dissolve into ash dunes. These are reconstructed once you leave the area, however, ash that’s already been used up will not be reconstructed, leading to buildings sometimes becoming brittle or collapsing entirely. The sheer amount of particulates in the air dampens sounds into near silence in your vicinity.
addons.title: The Ashen Titan

objects.text: You create and scatter large amounts of “ash” all over the area through waves, blasts, or puffing out your body after taking a hit or striking during combat. This particulate matter bleeds into the surrounding area’s structures effectively reinforcing it. Having no control over the ash yet more as an extension of yourself as a Breaker state, you absorb and coat yourself with the “ash” for either reformation (automatically kicks in when in mortal danger) or teleportation purposes, consuming a portion of your surrounding “ash”. Once active, you find yourself unable to leave the “ashen” area unless using up all the accumulated or surrounding “ash” or simply ignite yourself and your “ashen” place on fire, with heat at 1100℃, consuming it at a steady rate. When you exit your Breaker state all nearby flames are deftly extinguished afterward.
objects.title: (Shaker/Breaker) Cinereal

objects.text: You’re a powerful but limited aerokinetic and telekinetic. To truly use your aerokinetic powers at their optimal you need to let a charge build up. How fast this charge builds is a differential that can vary from a few hours to several days. With a charge you can draw in the air from an entire city and stagger endbringers, without it your aerokinesis is restricted and much harder to work with. You can use your telekinesis to fly and it’s strong enough for you to carry materials with.
objects.title: (Shaker) Exalt

addons.text: As a Titan, you can produce razor wire within a quarter mile of yourself, which scales up over time and is not Manton-limited. You also become extremely agile.
addons.title: Titan Arachne

objects.text: You produce a mass of thin black wires within thirty feet around yourself, that cuts everything in its way. You’re immune to their sharpness. You can control them, but they tend to lash out at threatening sensory cues. Your power permanently leaves you in a heightened psychological state, as such you don’t get mentally tired.
objects.title: (Shaker) Hunter

objects.text: You have the ability to warp and twist matter within your field of view, corkscrewing it until it is nothing but radioactive dust. This however is Manton limited as you are unable to warp the matter of living beings
objects.title: (Shaker) Scape (Corkscrew)

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate sound within roughly a mile's radius. You can use it to amplify your voice, alter it to match others, throw it to speak directly into people's ears, or cancel out sounds you don't want to hear. Your abilities also allow you to hear sounds in any given area. It is almost impossible to cancel you out as you can transmit sound, and by extension words, through multiple mediums. This includes bone, thus earplugs or earmuffs are ineffective. You can modulate the sound to the point that people will hear what you’re saying as if it’s the voice within your head. You can overload everyone in your range with a deafening jarring scream.
objects.title: (Shaker/Stranger) Screamer

objects.text:
You can create a miniature sun, hundreds or thousands of degrees in temperature, that you can manipulate at will. It takes a few seconds to form a sun. The sun forms in your hands.
Temperature within five feet of yourself is normalized, and while it won't put out fires, it will stop fires from hurting anyone.
objects.title: (Shaker) Sundancer

objects.text: You create a labyrinth through non-euclidean space, however you’re restricted to simple unmovable surfaces. When using your power any building is twisted and inverted into a confusing, physics-breaking, space warping maze. Your power activates in pulses, with each wave warping the area further. You can use this ability to twist large areas, including several buildings, into a maze the size of a skyscraper. You’re also able to manipulate the effect on a smaller scale within your radius to let you move through it.
objects.title: (Shaker) Cretan

objects.text: You can create conical blasts of warped space that will destroy anything inside. You don't have full control over your power and your blasts have enough recoil to launch you backwards.
objects.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Damsel of Distress

objects.text: You’re a shaker, who can create heavy industrial equipment out of the ground. You’re capable of manifesting things like mechanical claws, molten hot metal, giant pincers, an enormous crane mount with a wrecking ball, and giant buzz saws. Your ability has a limitation in which three 'splashes' occur before you can summon anything significantly large.
objects.title: (Shaker) MYOSHA

objects.text:
Your power is implemented through a shaker aspect that manifests in patches near you that slowly grow and change. They eventually fill in an entire area, but you must remain stationary for this to happen. If you’re in an area with enough technology or machines, your power will prioritize affecting them, transforming the machinery into a 'node' that will serve to propagate the effect of your power. The effect propagates particularly well along any wiring or cables. After you leave the area, the affected machines convert back into their original configurations. 

Examples of this ability include the creation of gigantic interlinked computer systems complete with monitors and interfaces, turrets (automation inconsistent), and teleportation devices that only operate within your area of effect. Further portable housings of tinker devices are created that let you use your technology outside of your area of effect. You have no conscious control over your power, but your power tends to give you things that assist in solving problems in your surroundings. Objects affected by your power only ever worked for you.
objects.title: (Shaker/Tinker) Ogun

addons.text: With Redirection providing fine control, Spatial Rupture or Damsel of Distress providing non-Manton Limited All-or-Nothing offensive capabilities, and Vista providing sheer range, you have effectively jailbroken your spatial manipulation. This allows you to achieve just about any spatial effect with enough time and effort, from compressing entire oceans into the space of a bucket, to portals and teleportation, to creating regions of warped and fractured space which destroy matter and energy. As a passive effect, you generate a field of warped space around yourself which automatically redirects and/or destroys any matter and energy you explicitly do not allow to interact with you. If you possess the addon Space-Time, then your ability to interfere with the time aspect of space-time is similarly jailbroken, with Multiversal Warping further extending your authority to all forms of dimensional phenomena, allowing you to reshape the surrounding space-time continuum at will.
addons.title: [Expanse]

addons.text: Vista subsumes Dimensional Warping, integrating its diverse capabilities into itself while retaining its original ease of use, forming something greater than its individual parts. In simpler terms, everything you could do with Dimensional Warping, you can now do with Vista—this greatly loosens your Manton Limit, all while retaining Vista’s range and ease of use. This effectively removes Dimensional Warping’s reliance on somatic gestures and skips the time it would normally take to manipulate space-time. Your mental map of terrain gains much greater fidelity and is capable of sensing spatial and temporal phenomena. If you possess Multiversal Warping, then Vista gains interdimensional reach and your mental map gains the ability to sense dimensional phenomena as well, allowing you to identify parahumans through the presence of their Corona Pollentia.
addons.title: Space-Time

objects.text:
You can warp space on a continental scale. However, the presence of living beings interferes with your ability, with the process of using this power being described as “smudging everything around like wet clay.” You also possess a sort of mental map of the surrounding terrain.

This power is incredibly versatile and works best when anchored to solid matter, effectively stretching, compressing, or bending it. This allows for applications such as shrinking objects or manipulating terrain to form “treadmills” to keep people away from you, although non-anchored effects are possible, such as regions of space which redirect projectiles.
objects.title: (Shaker) Vista

objects.text: You can create a dampening effect that causes bullets to lose their inertia, heat to seep out of areas, energy attacks to lose their fizzle, and humans to lose their will. You can concentrate your power in a smaller area, halting all motion. Even at its widest and least intense, it reduced ambient temperatures to the point that moisture freezes in the air, creating a telltale mist. People under its effect experienced a mental torpor, feeling their thoughts slow to a crawl. They will stand still as if they died from the cold.
objects.title: (Shaker) Winter

objects.text: You have the ability to create bubbles of accelerated time that can last as long as their inhabitants have oxygen, as well as enhanced strength and durability. You can stagger your bubble manifestation to give yourself superspeed, allowing you to rapidly move in the bubble before returning to real time. To outside observers, the bubbles you create with your power are irregular areas of violent color and space distortion, obscuring the view inside, and out. Further anyone enclosed within is cut off from the outside world as most abilities can not breach the barrier your powers create, this allows you to provide areas for planning sessions,  and to provide emergency first aid. As well as enclose yourself with targets to dispatch them within seconds of real time, while minutes to hours pass inside.
objects.title: (Shaker) Dispatch

objects.text:
To use your power, you need to focus and hum a lullaby without being interrupted. This causes a localized area of space to “blur” into another world. This pocket dimension appears as a hazy indoor setting complete with beds, walls, carpeted floors and stairs superimposed onto the existing environment. During the appearance of the pocket dimension, a music box-like chiming begins, gradually intensifying in tempo and complexity and being joined by the sound of your humming from additional sources. Wherever this reality is overlaying something it keeps other powers from working properly. The chorus of humming comes from distinct sources, located in the baby-carriages among other locations. You can "wake" them, causing wet noises and movement to come from the same locations. 

Once you and any accompanying you have left the affected area, the humming and chiming fade and the doors and windows begin to close. Your power lingers for a bit after you leave. If an area has been saturated with your ability enough, surfaces start producing fleshy growths inside them, that can be broken out of. Once disturbed, the growths will instinctively attack anyone nearby. The growths have a degree of permanence and can be hidden in containers as traps. They will remain even after you have left the area. You have some sense through these distant minions, and are able to control them while in vicinity.
objects.title: (Shaker) Nursery

objects.text: You have the ability to reverse the age of people and objects at the cost of them losing their memories of the time that has been reversed. You can also use your ability to speed up objects and as such speed up construction without disastrous side effects. You’re capable of bringing an entire building down.
objects.title: (Shaker) Semiramis

objects.text: You have the power to alter the direction but not the magnitude of gravitational pull on or by yourself, other people, and objects within your range. You apply your powers most offensively by hurling people or objects up and then reversing your power to let them fall. This environmental change allows you to do things like walk along the sides of buildings. You’re not strictly limited to shifting gravity ninety or even a hundred eighty degrees but every degree in between.You can only manifest one gravitational change at a time. This power lets you weaponize loose objects, being able to reverse gravity, sending them up into the air and then changing gravity to send it towards your targets. You can also use it to move large amounts of objects around. Securing you to the ground as well as other objects negates much of your offensive ability. Your power has an upper limit, when objects reach the threshold of your effect the object will be effectively weightless in the liminality of the effect and regular gravity.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Topsy

objects.text: You have a large-scale Shaker and Master ability that allows you to sense everybody in a fairly large range around yourself and create force fields copying the shape of any living things, including plants and microbes within your vicinity. They appear beside whatever they copy and you can move them all by will. Plants can’t follow your command, but everything else does, they’re strong albeit slowly.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Jed Tylor

objects.text: You can superimpose objects and locations from pocket worlds onto the surrounding area. The longer you have been in an area, the greater your range. Your power is affected by your mental state, the less lucid you are, the stronger your power.
objects.title: (Shaker) Labyrinth

objects.text: You have the ability to create and alter building layouts, by creating architecture with your power. You can use this ability to slide walls around, create walls where there weren't any, create trapdoors, etc.
objects.title: (Shaker) Scaffold

objects.text: You can send out terrain altering pulses that shape it to your design. Within your scope is raising new buildings, restructuring existing ones, including the direct control of the features of the building, or razing structures entirely. This allows you to maintain and clean buildings. Though you’re too slow to use in a fast moving battle situation. You can create an entire palace and cancel out seismic events in your area of influence.
objects.title: (Shaker) Tōng Líng Tǎ

objects.text:
You are capable of creating static loops in time, during which any alterations made to their being are undone. Everything affected takes on a monochrome appearance. Only you can enter or leave created loops. During the loops, the only changes that would persist would be those inflicted by you (such as cuts or burns) and the victims' thoughts. Pain inflicted on those trapped within the loops is experienced repeatedly. You may adjust the duration of the loop, expanding it so the trapped individuals can speak full words, or shortening it to quickly repeat the initial burst of pain from a wound. You are unable to close these loops.

The loops could persist for a long period, often exceeding the natural lifespan of living creatures.

The loops could cover an area roughly equivalent to a square that was five feet wide and eight feet tall. The power works at the speed of the your thoughts, able to stop Sting enhanced darts in midair.

The power rendered you effectively immortal, constantly restoring your body to the state it was in when you first received your abilities. This prevented you from aging or even becoming soiled. Your memories remained regardless of your form. Any time you are injured or weakened, your power will take you back as far as was necessary to reverse the damage.
objects.title: (Shaker) Grey Boy

objects.text: You can redistribute pain and wounds across your entire body rather than the point of hurt/wounding.
objects.title: (Brute) Nemean

objects.text: You have a force field that can block any blow no matter how powerful, but any powerful impact will bring it down for about two seconds, longer if it's a sustained hit. You can fly at almost 80 miles per hour. You have super strength, strong enough to allow you to lift about 14 tons. You have an emotional aura that makes it so those around you are either in awe or fear of you.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Glory Girl

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate metal in direct contact with your skin, as well as for a few seconds after you stop touching it.
objects.title: (Brute) Cuff

objects.text: You can adapt to damage and can fly. Your adaptation allows you to act as if your body was at peak capacity no matter how much damage has been done to you. You do not feel pain.
objects.title: (Brute) Aegis

objects.text:
You have a force field that can block any blow no matter how powerful, but any powerful impact will bring it down for about two seconds, longer if it's a sustained hit. You can fly at almost 80 miles per hour. You have super strength, strong enough to allow you to lift about 14 tons. You have an emotional aura that makes it so those around you are feeling an emotion you chose.
Your force field is larger than your body. It is malleable to whatever shape you desire such as forming telekinetic hands, but it cannot be larger than 10x your size.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Antares

objects.text: Your body becomes a doll-like figure, with a large stream of mixed appendages and trailing ghostly material, a curtain of cords, ribbons, and strings behind you. You are a body-snatcher that can take over recently deceased corpses and maintain them in a lifelike state, can attach retractable tools to your limbs and have uncanny strength and zombie-like durability while in a body.
objects.title: (Brute) Bijou

objects.text: You’re a brute that becomes the Red Knight, manifesting a weapon and armor that replenishes itself by absorbing smoke and burned material. You can intensify any part of your body to make your armor glow with veins of intense heat, where you wade you’ll only bring destruction and fire, due to your size and the heat you emanate. You can't communicate or do much more than stampede through the area, generating the smoke and burned material that replenishes your body. If you stop moving your equipment no longer replenishes and you self-immolate, becoming incapable of manifesting the Red Knight for weeks until you have gathered enough energy to manifest it once more.
objects.title: (Brute) Burned Man

objects.text: Consuming the blood of others enhances your strength, speed, and durability. The more blood you consume, the stronger you get. This also increases how much you weigh, making you quite heavy.
objects.title: (Brute) Crimson

objects.text: Your power grants you the ability to gain durability at the cost of mobility. The slower you move, the tougher you become, additionally when you use your power you generate a kinetic dampening field around yourself with a similar effect.
objects.title: (Brute) Chubster

objects.text: Your body can untangle into prehensile flat serrated tendrils capable of cutting with great force. These tendrils are formed from the outer layer of your body, making you completely hollow internally, able to store objects internally despite having no outward changes to your mass than if you were an average human.
objects.title: (Brute) Sveta (Orchard)

objects.text: You possess enhanced size, strength, speed, and agility, can make a deafening roar, transfer harm from some impacts to nearby people, and have pain resistance as well as faster healing.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Oxfair

objects.text: You have enhanced strength and a protective ability that allows you to reflect damage, whether physical or powerbased, back onto your attacker. You either need to see the person attacking you or there needs to be some correlation between the person and the damage done.
objects.title: (Brute) Gwerrus

objects.text: You can create extremely dense stone armor, as well as a shield and have enough enhanced strength to wear them daily. They are semi-permanent and you can manifest more at will.
objects.title: (Brute) Stonewall

objects.text: You have super speed in your head and legs and super strength in your chest and arms. Your power causes you to perceive the world around you in perpetual slow motion, leaving you unable to communicate normally.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Chuckles

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate electromagnetism at point-blank range. This includes a personal shield that augments your strength and durability, in addition to more esoteric uses of electromagnetism such as attracting metal objects or discharging your shield to augment your hits.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Manpower

objects.text: You’re a Brute, capable of taking immense damage. When you become damaged, a new version of yourself will rip out of your damaged body. This new version is larger and stronger than your normal form. You have potential to grow strong enough to take on or parry a direct attack from a Titan.
objects.title: (Brute) The Flower of the Hecatomb

objects.text: You have super strength and reflexes that scale up depending on the number of opponents you face, with diminishing returns, as well as a two-to-three-foot teleport and a minor increase in durability.
objects.title: (Brute) Vantage

objects.text: You have a breaker state that allows you to grow to be up to six times your normal height, this breaker state also grants you super strength as well as increasing your durability nearly a hundred times in relation to your current size, the damage you take is divided in proportion to your size meaning that at your maximum of six times your size, you only take one-sixth of the damage.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Fenja/Menja

objects.text: You start as a low level brute but grow stronger and slowly transform into a dragon the longer you fights. You have pyrokinesis and enhanced senses that grow stronger the more you grow.
objects.title: (Brute) Lung

objects.text: Your power makes it so you can only take so much damage at a time, and reduces the severity of any damage to a set amount. Shooting you with a hail of bullets would be little different from shooting you with one or two bullets, and any given bullet would only gouge out a teaspoon's worth of flesh. Offensively, you have the ability to lift objects three to four times your own weight, and to imbue melee weapons with both your durability and with vast impact. You can also transfer your defensive power from your weapon to your target, making the target near-invulnerable as it flies through the air. The target will then be pulverized when it hits something else.
objects.title: (Brute) Gavel

objects.text: You have a very powerful headbutt, capable of knocking very strong Brutes over. You can only do this a limited number of times to powerful enemies before needing rest. You have an All-or-Nothing grade of invulnerability, albeit limited to your head and torso. This also extends to master-effects, making you immune to the Simurgh's scream.
objects.title: (Brute/Striker) Torso

addons.text: You have the enhanced abilities of both Prancer and Moose as a Titan. With extreme speed and agility, capable of leaping a mile and a half in a single bound.
