You’re also extremely durable and capable of tanking multiple attacks from both capes and other Titans. The accumulated damage would still impact your mobility for a while, though you slowly regenerate. You can infuse inanimate objects caught in your shockwaves with Breaker effects. Doing so causes the debris to float, which you can then use for cover or as projectiles.
addons.title: Titan Oberon

objects.text: You’re a Brute with decently strong durability and strength, your body movements can emanate shockwaves and you have precise control over how they spread. You can use this as a form of reactive defense by using your body as a spring in the face of a strike.
objects.title: (Brute/Shaker) Moose

objects.text: You’re an Alexandria package cape with considerable super strength, enough to punch through a building, are ostensibly invincible, and capable of flight. However, your abilities come with the unfortunate side effect of being radioactive. The harder you fight, the more radioactivity you build around yourself, although you’re immune to its effects.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Tritium

objects.text: You have permanent adaptive regeneration. As long as you survive, any injury will heal at incredible speeds. This healed tissue often gains non-human attributes/augmentations and is altered, if possible, to be more resistant to the source of damage.
objects.title: (Brute) Crawler

objects.text: You have a breaker form that distorts you, allowing for greater agility, reflexes and ultimately the capability to dodge bullets, but it’s easily broken with even a glancing blow, taking time to reassert itself, rendering you relatively vulnerable in the interim.
objects.title: (Breaker) Prancer

objects.text: You can enter a ghostly breaker form to build and maintain the mechanized suit that holds and sustains your decaying corpse and brain. You can set the suit to autopilot while in your breaker form to leave it and interact with the battlefield.
objects.title: (Breaker) Cradlegrave

objects.text: You have the ability to shrink to around two inches tall. While in this form you’re capable of flight and can produce a small, foot-long spray of high-pressured blood, that is quite potent, casually penetrating metal. You can use this laser at your full size, but it is weaker.
objects.title: (Breaker/Mover) Bloodplay

objects.text: You can displace and teleport parts of your anatomy around a given area. You have to see them to retrieve them back. Your body-parts retain full functionality and sensation. You’re capable of teleporting your eyes and ears in order to spy on people and gain intel. However, this leaves the rest of your body deaf and blind, and lacking in balance.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Disjoint

objects.text: You have the ability to turn into a giant ball, with the armor you wear becoming the exterior, for example turning into a giant ball of spikes when wearing spiky plate armor. In this form you can accelerate faster than should be possible.
objects.title: (Breaker) Cleat

objects.text: You can enter a shadow-like breaker state in which you are lightweight and capable of phasing through matter. Electricity will harm you in this state.
objects.title: (Breaker) Shadow Stalker

objects.text: You have a Breaker form that is indestructible while still and have increased awareness. In this form, you don’t need to eat. You can vary the speed you switch into your breaker state and can move by sliding yourself across the ground, both inside and outside your breaker state.
objects.title: (Breaker) Caryatid

objects.text: You disappear on death, only to emerge from a nearby location, bigger, tougher, and stronger, but less intelligent.
objects.title: (Breaker) Koschei

objects.text: Your body is a space-warping effect. Space-warping lingers throughout your general area, leaving a trail of breaking/snapping/fracturing space-warp behind you. You can also channel this effect into things you touch and maintain the ability to further warp yourself as an attack.
objects.title: (Breaker/Striker) Wendigo

objects.text: You are capable of flight and can turn yourself and your gear into a living projectile. Changing into a Breaker form, that allows you to go faster than the speed of sound, but unable to change course.
objects.title: (Breaker) Young Buck

objects.text: You have a power that resets you to your base form every five seconds. You also have a minor thinker power related to mechanics.
objects.title: (Breaker) Alabaster

objects.text: You can toggle between two Breaker states: One granting exceedingly maneuverable flight abilities, the other turning you into an immobile artillery platform. In your mover state, you can effectively turn on a dime, moving at roughly eighty kilometers an hour. You can fly through solid concrete or meet bullets head-on without being harmed. As a Blaster, you are fixed in place but can project vast numbers of missile-projections. You can level a ten-story building in eight seconds, taking one floor at a time.
objects.title: (Breaker) Grumman

objects.text: You can turn into a cloud of condensation, drawing all available, airborne or liquid moisture to yourself and reshaping yourself as you wills it. The maximum range you can control your water is in line of sight, further water moves slower. Your control is best with visible and clean water.
objects.title: (Breaker/Shaker) Sploosh

objects.text: You can turn into living fog that erodes living matter while it is inside. You can shift as much or as little of your body as you wish into a gaseous entity. You can also control your solidity.
objects.title: (Breaker) Fog

objects.text: You’re a breaker whose form is permanently active. Any object you interact with is imbued with energy, reverting back to its prior condition and location after a set duration of about half a minute. This serves to severely disorient people you use lethal force on. As a hypothetical example of how your power works, you could start beheading people and they would 'reset' to their previous undamaged state, fully cognizant about what occurred. As a secondary benefit of your power you have no need to eat, sleep, or excrete. It is very hard for anyone or any ability to harm you, as you will simply reset back to your prior condition.
objects.title: (Breaker) Gasconade

objects.text: You can adopt another two-dimensional-looking form, in which you can envelop others and exert external force to control their actions and assume limited control of their powers.
objects.title: (Breaker/Master) Hidden Hand

objects.text: You can change into a form of acid and can shoot acid at people.
objects.title: (Breaker) Acidbath

objects.text: You can enter a breaker state where you can reshape your body like a liquid. In this state, you’re capable of merging with objects to spatially distort them and alter their shape. This includes things like lengthening chains while also thinning them out, or reconstructing buildings from debris. This warping ability means that your body becomes intertwined with a material. While merged, you take on the durability of the object. When merged with an object, your senses are limited to feeling changes in the object: vibrations, temperature etc. You’re able to feel the temperature of the surfaces you’re interacting with. Your power is limited to a short range around his body.
objects.title: (Breaker) Annex

objects.text: You’re a Breaker who’s able to vibrate and self-explode, showering those nearby with gore- more than should be contained in a human body. This explosion has enough force behind it to crack nearby windows. You then gain control over anyone covered in the body’s material. You can control everyone under your influence simultaneously. Controlled subjects do not speak with their original voice but instead a combination of your and your subject's voices. You can reform your body by separating it from the last unreleased victim. This can be partially prevented by restraining them. If your minions die, you can survive, but suffer some personality damage. Your victims have a barely existing, dream-like recollection of periods under your control.
objects.title: (Breaker) Kingdom Come

objects.text: You gain the ability to sap energy from everything around you to form a hard light projection of your own body. This projection can be large and roughly the same density as your own, or it can be normal-sized and dense enough to have its own gravity well. Your power briefly cripples the minds, bodies, and powers of anyone nearby.
objects.title: (Breaker) Lustrum

objects.text: You can metamorphose yourself into a solid fixture that grants you nervous system control over humans and animals in the area, as well as limited control of electronics. In this state, you cannot move or be moved and are nigh invulnerable.
objects.title: (Breaker/Master) Prince Prosperous

objects.text: You’re a Breaker/Changer/Stranger with the ability to turn into a localized telekinetic whirlwind, a ghost for all intents and purposes. Your form picks up debris and other untethered objects and puts them in orbit around a central point within the storm. You have enough control of this to transport multiple wounded without actually hurting them, you can do this by moving them to the furthest part of your range where affected objects rotate the slowest. You have an upper limit of 12 minutes for the amount of time you can spend in your Breaker state, but with time and regular combat you can exceed it.
objects.title: (Breaker/Changer) Wanton

addons.text:
Your extensive power over that of the unseen has similarly manifested itself in your monstrous Breaker form, making it even more formidable than before. 

The overall strength, durability and speed of this form have been improved to place you on par with some of the strongest parahumans around. Additionally, you have gained an extraordinary level of regeneration in this state, able to heal entire limbs in the blink of an eye... as long as no one is watching.

Your amorphous ink-blot-like body has also become even more versatile, allowing you to freely alter your size and shape to an extreme degree. You can shrink to the proportions of a snake to slip through hidden crevices or increase your size to be larger than a tank to deliver devastating blows.
addons.title: What Goes Bump in the…

objects.text: You transform into a monster whenever no one is looking at you. While in this form you are incredibly strong, fast, and nearly invincible. Any damage you have taken is healed when you transform.
objects.title: (Breaker) Night

objects.text: You are capable of transforming into an unnaturally pale-skinned Breaker form that visibly distorts and blends into nearby surfaces. In this Breaker form, you don't need to eat or sleep, and you automatically infect surfaces within a radius of 4.6 meters of yourself, temporarily transmuting them into a material similar in appearance to your Breaker form. When you die while in your Breaker form, your body will shatter into black shards and reform out of an infected surface of your choice. You can only transform back by re-absorbing all currently infected surfaces. After transforming back, you will be hit with a drawback with intensity relative to the time you spent in the Breaker state.
objects.title: (Breaker) Night Hag

objects.text: You are a Breaker, capable of transforming into a rough purple form with silvery, smokey hair. While you are in your Breaker form, you have the ability to: Fly with incredible control, being able to stop on a dime; conjure a foot long black energy blade from each hand, capable of easily slicing through steel; emit a short ranged aura that inflicts intense agitation, enough to incapacitate an average person; and have a Tinker power that allows you to construct studs that, while in your Breaker form, absorb energy to emit hands made out of electricity. However, in this form you are also physically weakened, are unable to talk and are stuck in an unusual mental state, similar to being on a stimulant, including a "crash" when transforming out of the form.
objects.title: (Breaker) Colt

objects.text: You have a breaker ability that cloaks you in metallic ribbons, allowing you to shapeshift into any form you choose. When transformed into forms with wings you can fly. You’re capable of inflating your forms to Endbringer size and crush buildings in passing. Your breaker power multiplies your efforts over time, giving repeated actions more effect and power. Your power also lets you hit harder every time you strike at something, even counting the beats of wings against air, but it still takes time.
objects.title: (Breaker) Lord of Loss

objects.text: You can see through the eyes of anyone you touch simultaneously and for several hours after your touch, and can temporarily blind or hamper their senses as well.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Guillaume Vasil

objects.text: You can make one person freeze as long as you stay completely still. This is especially effective on people with momentum, as they won’t be able to change course.
objects.title: (Master) Juliette Vasil

objects.text: Your power causes your opponents and yourself to pass out and fall into a trance in a flash of light, victims are conscious but helpless under your power. This trance can be broken if something suitably jarring happens to those caught within it though it also carries the risk of waking you up as well. You can selectively affect people.
objects.title: (Master) Thirteenth Hour

objects.text: You can create patches of warped space, roughly two-by-two feet across, these slightly 'bulge' out distorting and discoloring space. When approached by anyone who isn’t you, the bulges pop, revealing a duplicate. Duplicates perish after several minutes, but can re-form into protrusions repeating the process.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Blister

objects.text: You can control birds by mentally setting rally points where birds get pulled towards. You can mentally push or pull to control where the birds move towards, when you’re not controlling them you can see through your birds eyes. This can be used to make influenced birds move in a wave, told to attack targets on their way and similar actions. You cannot control individual birds during flight or out of sight, but you could for example make an individual pigeon hop from one knee to the other, then back again. You can control full flights of birds.
objects.title: (Master) Chicken Little

objects.text: You have the ability to control a large amount of rats in a radius, able to command them and get some crude sensory feedback from them.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker)  Chitter

addons.text: Your power is no longer restricted by the amount of hair you currently have—you can generate and control an endless supply at will. This applies to all your hair, including body hair, which you can now lengthen and strengthen just like the hair on your head. Every strand, no matter where it grows, becomes a potential weapon, tool, or shield.
addons.title: Wookie

objects.text: You can animate and control your hair, but are restricted to how much hair you have at a given time. This hair can be shaped into a variety of forms including different forms of shields for protection or multiple limbs for mobility. And you can use tools and weapons to improve your versatility.
objects.title: (Master) Coiffure

objects.text: You have the ability to control birds with 'programmed' paths via gestures and phrases, although they need to be trained beforehand to learn these. You can apply fire resistance and pyrokinesis to them, turning each into a 'Phoenix'. Larger birds are even more resistant to fire and explosions when granted this power.
objects.title: (Master) Felix Swoop

objects.text: Through touch you can impel individuals to move a set distance and attack anything that comes within their range.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Minakhm

objects.text: You’re a master, who summons centipede-like creatures from the sides of your body. These centipedes are half a foot wide, two inches tall, and have serrated razor sharp legs. They have mouths that can spew acid, and bodies that channel this acid in certain directions. The fluids are luminescent in the light and black in the dark.
objects.title: (Master) Mukade

objects.text: You have the ability to induce high levels of fear in other people.
objects.title: (Master) Nicholas Vasil

objects.text: You can induce intense rage in others, however, you also inflict it upon yourself. This tends to cause 'duels' between you and your victims. In addition, you’re faster and stronger than normal, capable of winning against an adult in unarmed combat. This increased strength is also given to those that your power affects. You possess a resistance to emotion-affecting powers.
objects.title: (Master/Brute) Roman Vasil

objects.text: You can empower dogs by giving them symbiotic biological armor that vastly increases their size - on the order of three thousand or more pounds - grants enhanced strength, durability, agility, and an asymmetrical covering of bony plates, spikes, exposed muscles, calcified flesh, and prehensile tails. The armor only lasts a certain amount of time, however. It starts weakening after about ten minutes on average, and is usually completely defunct by fifteen minutes. You have trouble trying to socialize with humans, your power having hardwired you to better understand canines. You do not automatically control the dogs that you empower.
objects.title: (Master) Bitch

objects.text: You have a permanent master-aura, that forces anybody perceiving you into intense pleasurable synesthesia and a somewhat infatuated state. It partially affects technology, and can be transferred through cameras in weakened form. You also have a unique vision that reveals things in the darkness but limits your ability to see things in light.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Engel

objects.text: You’re a self-duplicator who can create one to three instances of yourself, who each acts independently of the others. They have slightly different personalities and physical differences that can provide other benefits based on the separation. A minor drawback is an imperfect memory, accurate in the broad strokes but you can mess up with some details. You and your clones have some degree of shared awareness. When separated the Furcate instances need to decide who 'stays' and who 'goes', as they draw down on their reserves for remaining separated and not choosing a possible Furcate to 'substantiate'.
objects.title: (Master) Furcate

objects.text:
You can create ghostly duplicates of yourself and your possessions, which pass through inorganic objects, but not organic ones.
These ghostly clones cannot use your other powers.
objects.title: (Master) Crusader

objects.text: You have a certain amount of ‘juice’ that refills over time. You’re able to induce intense and sensory-complete hallucinations of whatever the target loves most. The intensity and length of these hallucinations depend on how much accumulated ‘juice’ you use on them, with a full dose starting a hallucination that can last 5 straight days. These hallucinations are so intense, that the person afflicted will usually end up hating whatever it is they used to love. If you don’t use up the juice you have saved up, it will start to unconsciously affect the people around you.
objects.title: (Master) Decadent

objects.text: You can manipulate emotions, specializing in incapacitating and stunning people. You can also read emotions, en masse and at a significant range, this ability is refined to the point it can act as a lie detector. You have a problem reading other emotion manipulators.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Effervescent

objects.text: You are capable of long range self duplication, that operate independently with no personality degradation.
objects.title: (Master) Entourage

addons.text: Each of your clones from Prism can use a separate Rainbow T0. This allows you to store [Time] with up to three different Rainbow T0s, or the same one at an increased rate. Activating Rainbow's boost will apply it to all your Prism clones simultaneously.
addons.title: Dispersive Prism

objects.text: You’re a Master who can split into three temporary clones. As long as just one survives, you’ll live. You can reabsorb your clones in a flash of light to enhance yourself, allowing you to deal "crushing" blows to your opponents. This enhanced your strength, speed and durability. However, it only lasts for a few seconds. Your clones retain the same equipment, you can choose to have them materialize without it however, allowing you to escape restraints. It’s possible for you to accidentally bring things along that you weren't aware of and you have to consciously choose to exclude objects from being copied.
objects.title: (Master) Prism

objects.text: You can form connections with anybody within your range, these connections need to be anchored on pieces of anatomy your power can immediately recognize. While connected to people, you can feel everything they feel and they can feel everything you do, this allows unfettered communication, coordination, and synchronization. When connected to multiple people, everybody can sense each other, in what is labeled a network. In addition, these people can sense the locations of one another within the network. The range of this network works over large distances. This can be used in combat, by forcing your opponent to feel any of the pain they are inflicting on you, or that you’re inflicting upon yourself. It also greatly enhances your coordination in hand-to-hand fight, but only when tools aren’t involved.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Syndicate

objects.text: You can create and control three animated force fields in the rough shape of bears that look like ghostly images.
objects.title: (Master) Ursa Aurora

objects.text: You have the ability to take over the bodies of others, with their powers still intact. You can’t take over corpses.
objects.title: (Master) Pretender

objects.text: You can generate an aversion field affecting all individuals within roughly 500 feet/1.66 city blocks. Individuals who are close to you when your power activates experience a higher-intensity effect and harm themselves as they attempt to leave the area.
objects.title: (Master) Princess Scarecrow

objects.text: You have an emotion affecting chant, increased size, an ability to heal very recent damage of those listening to the chant or by touching them, and by concentrating can perform giant leaps
objects.title: (Master/Brute) Ramfair

objects.text: You have total control of all arthropods within 3 to 5 blocks as well as infinite multitasking.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Skitter

objects.text: You have the ability to imbue animals with human traits, at the expense of stealing them from human subjects. These changes are permanent and can be both mental and physical. You do not require touch to make these changes. The mutated creatures have some measure of sapience and sophonce, thus they can be used to relay information, and carry out a multitude of other tasks. How much they change is based on the animal used and the amount you have worked on them.
objects.title: (Master) Bamet

objects.text: You’re a self-replicating Master whose clones can self-replicate, but you are psychologically limited from exploiting this to its limit.
objects.title: (Master) Kudzu

objects.text: You have a Master ability that allows you to create homunculus copies, caricatures, or mockeries, of parahumans, including yourself. These are twisted caricatures, versions of capes that represent everything the target hates about themselves. These clones also gain the abilities of the original cape, but in no way near as potent or reliable, you can have several active at a time. You have a Thinker power that gives you knowledge about what the target hates about themselves, which you can command your clones to share and make them talk about ‘themselves’. The homunculi don't exist for very long.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Mockument

objects.text: You can apply your power on a nearby individual you’re aware of, with a brief period between each selection. While under the effect of your power, the individual is attacked with an overwhelming wave of emotion, typically admiration for you. This feeling feels pure and is very strong, this wave of emotion does not have long-lasting effects. It is possible to resist for a time, but you could convince some people to kill themselves. While an individual is under the effect of your power, you also gain protections against that target, becoming immune to anything and everything that individual does. You also gain clairvoyance through their eyes and can psychometrically observe their history/memories. However, this psychometry is inaccurate at the start, though it can ramp up with time. You can only affect one person at a time. You must point at or lock eyes with a nearby individual to apply your power to them. You can fire your power while blinded, but you still have to face potential targets and point in their direction.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Monokeros

objects.text: You can control other peoples' nervous systems. At first all you can do is make them twitch, but if you're around someone long enough you can control their entire body. The farther away and more people you control the harder it is. You can use their powers.
objects.title: (Master) Regent

addons.text:
Your copies now possess an instinctive superhuman cooperation, allowing them to coordinate with each other without getting in each others' way as they carry out your will like a swarm of ants. They also no longer degrade with time, though in return they are far more fragile, melting into rapidly evaporating gray sludge if they receive a strong blow, like a normal adult woman's strike with a rolling pin or a teenager's swing with a golf club. Each clone can in turn spawn more clones of their own, rapidly turning into a near-unstoppable wave of bodies able to simply overrun any conventional force. Clones still have access to your powers, barring any ability that increases physical durability beyond withstanding the forces generated by their own strength.

If a clone gets into contact with another person's blood, they can absorb it and create a clone of them loyal to you. These clones are also connected to the pseudo-hivemind, but beyond that have none of your powers. In return they do however have any power their original have, again barring any that would increase physical defense. These clones do not inherit any memories of their original, but they do get their body-language and way of movement.

These fragile mass-produced clones are not added to your Hive Mind, nor can they serve as new Original bodies if your old one is destroyed.
addons.title: Sad Man's Parade

objects.text: You have a master ability that allows you to produce a large amount of duplicates of yourself in a very short amount of time, roughly 15 clones every three seconds. The clones rapidly degrade after their creation, ending up brain dead after a few seconds and reduced to pulp within 15 minutes.
objects.title: (Master) Spree

objects.text:
You are an exceptionally skilled singer, but your singing also affects those who hear it. Anyone who hears you sing becomes susceptible to suggestions. However, you do not have an innate ability to tell when someone is under the influence of this effect, which may inadvertently cause words meant for normal conversation to turn into power-enforced commands.

Anyone may give suggestions, with a broad range of applications. Suggestions can induce physical reactions, such as nodding, or compel involuntary actions. Commands like “calm down” can even soothe an affected subject in dangerous situations.

The effect is weakened when transmitted through technology.
objects.title: (Master) Canary

objects.text: You have a small increase in durability and strength. You also generate an aura that makes emotions and actions more slippery for those around you, escalating as the number of people in your vicinity grows. Every person is an antennae, transmitting their feelings in part to the others. Situations escalate and make people stupid, especially in larger groups. A friendly challenge becomes an outright brawl, a bit of fear into mindless stampeding fear, suppressing rational thought. Until you’re killed due to this, yet you don’t stay down, the higher emotions run, the more intense they are, the faster and harder you come back, with a small yet permanent increase in durability and strength and a stronger temporary increase right after your resurrection. Your wounds also regenerate once you’ve crudely patched them up. However, if you die with no witnesses, then you’ll simply stay dead as there are no high-running emotions to fuel your resurrection.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Grim Survivor

objects.text:
By touching objects you can create "loose, telekinetically animated servants" out of available mechanical material that are restricted to your immediate presence. Like a garage door or several large vehicles, which you’re able to drive purely by telekinesis. Offensively you can reconfigure your targets into other shapes that can then move on their own, like humanoid minions but other shapes are possible if joints are physically present. Your creations need your continuous influence to remain animated. 

You aren’t limited in the number of creations you can make or how far away they can move from you, only by how far you can see and sense them. Your only true constraint is the time you have to create an object as your power adapts objects into servitors for you regardless of material, though prefabricated materials generally work best. Animating and converting structures like a bridge, building, a concrete block or any other single-piece construction lengthens the time to the point of in-feasibility with the materials coming apart. Your creations are incapable of flying.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Mockshow

objects.text: You have the ability to drain the strength and energy out of people, fatiguing them extremely quickly and leaving them feeling as weak as a baby, even momentarily interrupting active power usage.
objects.title: (Master) Noontide

objects.text: You compel others within your range to reverse allegiances, acting out with extreme prejudice against things they valued most, to the best of their abilities. The more they love it, the more they’ll want to destroy or ruin it.
objects.title: (Master) Saltykov

objects.text: You have the ability to both know the complex emotions of those in a very large range around yourself, and control emotions within a smaller radius.
objects.title: (Master) Cherish

objects.text: You have telekinetic control over a hundred-foot-long cable with a hook on the end. Only you can control or influence it and the cable is completely indestructible.
objects.title: (Master) Hookline

objects.text: Your primary ability is an emotional manipulation power that expresses itself through a roar, you don’t have much control over it. When unleashed it can be particularly devastating, wrecking people's emotions and driving them into a frenzy, to the point they can turn on allies, making you very effective against groups. Solid objects can block your scream. Your power includes a form of extrasensory perception, allowing you to sense others emotions. You’re highly mobile, able to run on walls with little effort. You have a tinker power with a specialty in claws for your hands and feet that enhance your power. Your claws are also enhanced by your power, becoming exceedingly sharp.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Love Lost

objects.text: You have a Master ability that allows you to create a veritable tide of low-grade minions. You can produce thousands at a time, and they can range from the size of a quarter to the size of a bear. Though a lot are too small, too weak, missing essential parts, or too dumb to be useful. You can also fly and use this to pour your minions on targets.
objects.title: (Master) Teem

objects.text: You have the ability to implant severe, permanent compulsions on others through physical contact that activate whenever certain conditions are met by the victim. You can choose both the conditions and the compulsions you inflict. This can go as far as to force your victims to engage in self-harm or starve themselves, with no apparent way to break the effect.
objects.title: (Master/Striker) Florence Vasil

objects.text:
You can create about 9-10 fully autonomous larval parasites a day. These parasites are purely instinct-based, unable to learn, and generally prioritize attacking vulnerable humans or uninfected human corpses in order to turn them into a hive and grow, although they will abandon stealth to attack other targets in the case that you or they are threatened. In their larval state, they are roughly the size of lemons, appearing similar to a trilobite with a barbed shell hard enough to resist conventional ammunition & weapons, sharp claws and a long stinger tail. In this state, they tend to find hiding places to lie in wait to ambush and burrow into their victims' orifices, waiting until they're still for a while before paralyzing them so that they can call their siblings using pheromones and collectively devour the victim from the inside out.
 
As they feed upon more victims, they will grow bigger and bolder, finally capping out at human size, at which point they will develop several dangerous natural weapons, such as a shotgun spray of pellets containing a powerful acid.
objects.title: (Master) Breed

objects.text: You’re capable of shifting your appearance into another person. Additionally you’re capable of splitting apart into multiple clones in a "oozing process" that starts with a polyp that grows separates from you and then takes on more defined features, you can vary the time it takes for this to happen or reverse it entirely. These clones in turn have their own shape shifting ability, but while you can make them physically stronger than a target of equivalent mass, you can’t replicate any powers they might have. Once killed or dismissed, the clones wither and collapse into bloody messes respectively. The clones are largely autonomous, but tend to either work towards whatever objective they were made for, or listen to the original. There is no range limit, but your clones wither within the day.
objects.title: (Master/Changer) Satyrical

objects.text: You have a master/trump power that grants thinker/tinker powers to people you choose, however the stronger the power the greater decrease in faculties in the subject, making them unable to express any information/skills from their abilities. You can also modify existing powers to a limited degree, by using a sort of hypnotic state to unlock it, similar to a second trigger.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Teacher

objects.text: You can produce autonomous, shape-shifting minions. For example a large featherless bird that is around ten times your mass, has significant superstrength, is able to track people, and who is relatively docile and predictable. Minions can be the size of houses. Your minions feed on your emotions and are affected by them physically.
objects.title: (Master) Egg

objects.text:
When you are perceived by something the offending sense is infected with a "fragment" of you—this affects even power-based senses and technology—, with said fragment immediately manifesting. The fragment will stay awake until you stop being perceived and will be temporarily awakened once again every time the owner of the infected sense perceives your name or yourself. 

Through this fragment you can perceive through the infected sense, meaning you could for example see using a CCTV camera; affect and alter what the sense can perceive, which could be used to, for example, cause an emotional sense to detect calm from you when you are absolutely panicking—the fragment can manifest itself through the infected sense if the infection is sufficiently strong, be it your voice if it was hearing, appearance if sight, touch if touch and etc.

The potency of an infection (e.g., the strength of the effect, degree of control over that sense, infection duration) depends on how long and clearly the sense perceived you. For example, people who only fleetingly register you in some way are still affected if only nominally, though this can still be enough to play tricks and distract people. With more exposure, you can cause powerful and disabling hallucinations. The strength of the infection also affects how easily the fragment reawakens, enough exposure to thinking or referring to you in an abstract sense is sufficient for the fragment to wake up.

You can feel your connection with all of your fragments and since each fragment is an instance of you, you basically have no problems handling all under your power regardless of the quantity. You can allow the infected to piggyback off your fragments to communicate with each other.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Mama Mathers

addons.text:
Every time you fall asleep, you now enter a dreamscape as a formless entity. You can use the energy you stored to design a body, granting it various capabilities and powers. The stronger the form, the greater the initial energy cost as well as the passive energy drain.

Furthermore, now even when you are asleep without having a projection up, you can generate and store energy. The energy also doesn’t reset when you awaken.
addons.title: Hypno

addons.text:
In the dream room, there is a pond that you intuitively know how to find. By immersing yourself in this pond, you will be capable of conjuring your form as you usually do when you fall asleep.

You can choose to allow your clustermates to immerse themselves as well, letting them add their own energy to your creation, strengthening it by allowing you to make more complex/unstable forms with less cost and giving them partial control over the form. When you are piloting your projection with your clustermates, you will all have an instinctive abstract form of communication with each other, allowing you all to co-ordinate and control the form together better than you could have alone.

A clustermate can only start contributing to the form while it's being made.
addons.title: Chimeric Pooling
Make My Monster Grow!
addons.text: When asleep, you can channel your Breaker state through your Master construct. While the effects remain the same, they are more effective on your construct. This is because it is already beyond the abilities of a baseline human.

objects.text: Upon arising from sleep, you will find yourself depleted of energy. You must remain awake for a period of time to recharge your power. To use this power, you must sleep, whereupon you can generate a new body and control it while your physical form remains in a state of slumber. Your forms can have various appearances and abilities. Note that the more biologically stable the form is, the less your ability's energy will be drained. You need to visualize the desired form before initiating the creation process. You have a maximum of 2 minutes to manifest the form of your choosing. The transition between forms requires time.
objects.title: (Master) Genesis

objects.text: You can induce suggestibility in people by looking at them. You can then implant triggers or orders, including erasing the memory of the suggestion.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) Valefor

objects.text: You have the ability to control your shadow, which has a sentience of its own. This shadow is capable of protecting you from harm, as well as acting on your behalf in various ways. The shadow's appearance, form, and abilities are all subject to change based on its absorption of other life forms. At the start, it is only big enough to fit in the palm of your hand. With enough absorption, the shadow will grow and gain significant power and influence, becoming a powerful force capable of challenging even the Endbringers. There is no known upper limit on the amount of strength the shadow can gain.
objects.title: (Master) Moord Nag

objects.text:
You can create minions by recycling pre-existing living material. You can customize these minions with feelings and powers of their own, allowing for a vast array of shapes and forms. Your monsters can breed and give birth to more monsters.

To create a monster, you enclose a target in one of your generated sacs. The target can try to fight free, but once enclosed, their biological material is passed through your body into another sac, where it's transformed into a slurry. This mixture of living matter can be used to create new monsters.
objects.title: (Master) Nilbog

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate any emotion, of anyone within line of sight. The psychological effects of your emotional manipulation are strong enough to make your thralls willing to die for you and can be long-term or even permanent, continuing even after your death. You’re unable to affect capes that experience significantly dulled emotions.
objects.title: (Master) Heartbreaker

objects.text: You are a tinker who specializes in glassworking and glassworking tools; for example, you could construct devices that can turn inorganic matter into glass.
objects.title: (Tinker) Bauble

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with the specialty of putting people into stasis.
objects.title: (Tinker) Ex Nihilo

objects.text: You are a biotinker specialized in creating lifeforms.
objects.title: (Tinker) Blasto

objects.text: You are a Tinker specializing in neurology, including brain scans and draining or recording thoughts up to removing, modifying, and implanting memories/brain regions in the form of skills or talents.
objects.title: (Tinker) Cranial

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with an emphasis on drones and remote tanks with crystal cores.
objects.title: (Tinker) Erik Granholme

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with a specialty that evolves sea creatures in some capacity. You’re capable of creating a large humanoid mech, containing an eel-like creature within.
objects.title: (Tinker) Fishtank

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with a specialty in simulations, examples include making simulations to practice in and a fractal palace that confuses intruders with a kaleidoscope effect.
objects.title: (Tinker) Jiǎ

objects.text: You’re a tinker that can make anything, but whose creations work worse the more similar they are to previous creations, your tinkertech also tends to be very crude and hodgepodge with an excess of openings and gaps that burn hot near the power source. Which are highly explosive and violently detonate upon being dropped from high up.
objects.title: (Tinker) Pwn

objects.text: You’re a tinker with a specialty in flame manipulation, special effects, and guns.
objects.title: (Tinker) Pyrotechnical

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with a specialty in attaching things to one another. Like attaching bombs to steel girders.
objects.title: (Tinker) Riveting

objects.text: You’re a tinker, emphasizing very heavy mechanical wings and a bodysuit that lets you wear the wings without your legs folding backward beneath you. The wings are strong enough to pry open a bank vault door but are not dexterous enough to make easy attacks in melee. In exchange for weakening their strength, you could load them with missiles or other payloads.
objects.title: (Tinker) R.O.K.

objects.text: You’re a Tinker specializing in propulsion, mainly jetpacks, and missiles.
objects.title: (Tinker) Stinger

objects.text: You’re a tinker who builds drones that build things in turn, particularly buildings.
objects.title: (Tinker) Big Rig

objects.text: You are a Tinker that produces large batches of chemicals that provide various supportive effects upon being drunk. Examples include increased strength, flexibility, resistance to toxins, resistance to the elements, resistance to harm, reflexes, or focus, restoration of damaged tissues and prompt rapid cellular growth. The batches have a rather serious use requirement, needing the drinker to orally imbibe large quantities, at minimum liters, of the drafts in order to receive the desired effect. You can also, after sufficient study, produce a draft that can nullify a specific person's power temporarily if they were to drink it.
objects.title: (Tinker) Cask

objects.text: You are a Tinker who specializes in cryogenics and stasis. This can be made into preservation efforts and utilized to create gadgets and weapons that freeze anyone you point it into.
objects.title: (Tinker) Glace

objects.text: You are a tinker with access to all tinker technology trees that the Entities deem safe. However you have several key drawbacks, primarily the fact that you can only ever create something once. The more similar a tinkertech creation is to something that you've made before or the more you've worked within a particular idea or field, the higher the chance of a creation misfiring or failing. Alternatively, the more different your creation is in terms of design, mechanisms, functions, etc. from anything you've made before, the more likely it is to work.
objects.title: (Tinker) Leet

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with a specialty in time-related Tinkertech that assists time-related powers. You also have the power to reverse the flow of time and make things move in reverse, Manton limited to inanimate objects. You could make bombs and boomerangs that behave unusually when under the effects of your power, and by studying parahumans with time-related powers you can make equipment that assists them in using their powers.
objects.title: (Tinker) Last Minute

objects.text: You’re a music tinker whose sounds mutate the people through said music.
objects.title: (Tinker) Rattenfänger

objects.text: You’re a "crude" specialty resource tinker, who can work with scrap and develop something that works surprisingly well from what should be inferior components. You’re able to shift into a blob-like body which you can change into working, if slow-moving, pseudopods and which can generate energy that you can use to power your tinker devices. Your gear is fairly limited and you’re nearly incapable of making anything 'fancy', but you can build it fast, build it durable, and you can build it from parts as common as a rusted old car. You can make power armor with enhanced strength and durability. You can drive your suit without needing to use proper limbs when in your blob body.
objects.title: (Tinker) Trainwreck

objects.text: You specialize in large-scale defense systems including ones that employ force fields.
objects.title: (Tinker) Uppercrust

objects.text: You’re a Tinker who is capable of transferring your consciousness into a hardy life form that occupies animals, replacing their brains and gradually transforming them into twisted bipeds with tentacles threaded in and out of their bodies. Effectiveness varies depending on where you are in the cycle.
objects.title: (Tinker) Wormcoil

addons.text:
Your Tinker abilities have merged into an incredibly broad Tinker power centered around the concept, 'improvement of functionality'.

This Tinker specialisation enables you to incorporate every aspect of this concept into your Tinkertech all at once; from enhancing its efficiency to improving its modularity and versatility, miniaturizing it or also increasing its redundancy and durability. You can maximise the functionality of your Tinkertech beyond anything that even Armsmaster and Dragon combined could create. From weapons to software to biotechnology, you can improve it all.

This Tinker specialty drastically empowers and pairs well with almost any other Tinker specialization.
addons.title: Kaizen

objects.text: You are a Tinker whose specialization is miniaturization and efficiency.
objects.title: (Tinker) Armsmaster

addons.text: Your modular Tinker power has merged with Redundancy, making you a specialist in minimalist technology. Now, your expertise revolves around creating devices that achieve more with less, each component oftentimes doing the work of three.
addons.title: Minimalist Technology

addons.text:
Instead of a hard distinction between your modular components and add-ons for other Tinkertech, you see both as fundamentally the same. As a result, any device you create or modify benefits from recursive enhancement - every single component amplifies the function of every single other component in the system.

For example, a stealth suit with noise dampeners and a thermal cloak doesn’t just mask heat and sound separately - the dampeners subtly redirect heat signatures, and the thermal cloak absorbs residual vibrations, making the entire system far more effective than the sum of its parts.

The enhancements scale exponentially at first, but hit diminishing returns once the system reaches a certain complexity threshold, preventing an infinite feedback loop.
addons.title: Synergistic Systems

objects.text:
You are a Tinker specializing in modularity.

Rather than building discrete inventions, you create modular components that can be combined, reconfigured, and repurposed into a wide variety of devices. A power source used in a weapon today might become part of a mobility system tomorrow; sensors, emitters, and control modules can be swapped between projects with minimal effort.

From these building blocks, you create anything from small, single-purpose gadgets slapped together from a few spare parts, to larger, more complex systems that can reconfigure themselves on the fly - parts shifting and sliding like a Rubik’s Cube. This makes you a true Jack-of-All-Trades: highly resourceful and adaptable, but your creations rarely match the raw power or efficiency of more focused Tinkers.
objects.title: (Tinker) Kid Win

objects.text: Your Tinker specialty lies in hydrotech that self-improves with use, with regular curation and attention required.
objects.title: (Tinker) Breathless

addons.text:
Your affinity for surveillance tech is much more than the sum of its parts, with an emphasis on scope and flexibility. Your camera specialty expands to include microphones, seismographs, and sensors of all sorts, each with comparable versatility to Lookout's already-broad focus. With the same ease at which you could previously create a single-function scanner, you can now produce truly totalizing information-gathering devices, able to tabulate and process dozens of distinct forms of conventional and esoteric data at once, at no cost to the fidelity of each individual data-stream. 

You are particularly adept at building and deploying networks of devices to monitor large areas, such as fleets of spy-drones that monitor the conversations of an entire city, though processing large amounts of collected data may still be a bottleneck without other auxiliary specialties, such as (Tinker) Software. 

Your counter-surveillance abilities are similarly boosted, able to thwart surveillance networks nearly as total as those you could produce yourself.
addons.title: Panopticon

objects.text: You're a dual-field Tinker that specializes in surveillance and counter-surveillance, such as cameras and immobile terminals.
objects.title: (Tinker) Lookout

objects.text: You’re a dust Tinker, able to create equipment like a scanning device or a gun with three shots that can reduce things to dust and carve a three-foot wide tunnel.
objects.title: (Tinker) Particulate

addons.text: Your Tinker specialization goes beyond simply creating vehicles; you craft extraordinary machines of unparalleled speed and maneuverability. Whether it’s a motorcycle that can break the sound barrier or a fighter jet capable of interplanetary travel, if a problem can be solved with speed and has a cockpit/pilot, you can likely engineer a solution for it such as installing a N.O.X. system on a bicycle.
addons.title: Speed Racer

addons.text:
Your vehicles are not just modes of transportation; they are self-sustaining habitats capable of withstanding the harshest environments and threats. From mobile cities that traverse the world’s most dangerous terrains to spacecraft that can journey across galaxies. You have the ability to create cities on wheels, ships that can venture into space, or even drills that can reach the Earth's core, these vehicles are even capable of withstanding atomic warheads, all designed to provide everything needed for daily life.

If the Speed Racer addon is active, your vehicles could be designed to participate in races that span entire solar systems or galaxies. These vehicles would be equipped to handle any planetary environment, from the frozen plains of an ice world to the molten lava seas of a volcanic planet, all while maintaining the speed and maneuverability needed for high-stakes competition.
addons.title: Red Line

objects.text: You have a tinker power focused on creating vehicles.
objects.title: (Tinker) Squealer

objects.text: You’re a tinker who specializes in large mechanized suits, which are powered via steam. These suits are strong and heavy, can vent steam at people, and can camouflage into these steam clouds.
objects.title: (Tinker) Steamwheel

objects.text: You're a Tinker with a specialization in architecture and seismic technology. You also gain Thinker abilities when it comes to sensing and intuiting architecture and geology.
objects.title: (Tinker) Tecton

objects.text: You are a Tinker specializing in creating simple pocket dimensions. Those dimensions are difficult to locate without knowing their entry point, requiring a transporter device afterward.
objects.title: (Tinker) Dodge

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with a focus on heavy artillery. Able to create missiles and guns large enough to fit on a tank, a back-mounted rocket that you could use to move around and tinkertech that would allow you to easily reload your weaponry. You also have super strength, without any additional durability.
objects.title: (Tinker) Gundeck

objects.text: You’re a Tinker whose technology creates blasts of anomalous radiation that can turn individuals into mutants that are docile towards you, but driven by their cannibalistic hunger and then leashed by their reluctance to be irradiated further.
objects.title: (Tinker) Jamestowner

objects.text: You are a tinker who specializes in self-contained systems, designed to sustain life while sheltering it from external forces, including water, weather, space … and bugs.
objects.title: (Tinker) Sphere/Mannequin

objects.text: You’re a tinker that specializes in medicine and drugs. Your drugs are primarily temporary in effect, requiring regular doses to have long-lasting effects. Examples include drugs that transform those who consume them essentially into zombies that obey your orders. Truth serums, medicine capable of reversing your transformations. A liquid that transforms your body into being twice as tall, with flexible limbs and super strength. Nanomachines that cause victims to produce large amounts of a thick gray liquid from their orifices until they burst. These nanomachines cause mutations to the bodies of the victims, with eyes and mouths appearing in the piles of the liquid as it dries.
objects.title: (Tinker) Bitter Pill

objects.text: You’re a Tinker with a macro specialization. The bigger it is, the better it works.  Materials and time are your only limitations.
objects.title: (Tinker) Chopshop

addons.text: You can transform your potions from (Trump/Tinker) Alchemist into injections, increasing their potency without increasing their rate of toxicity buildup. You are also able to convert a potion from an injection to be aerosolised. Additionally, you can imbue your potions with specific emotions, amplifying their effects but causing the associated emotion to intensify in the user. For example, a potion infused with anger will not only heighten strength but also trigger a surge of rage. Your emotional forms are no longer limited by a fixed number of transformations per day. You may now shift between forms as many times as necessary. However, pushing beyond your natural limits will cause you to build up toxicity.
addons.title: Street Seller

objects.text:
You’re a Tinker with a specialty in injections that cause you to transform into a range of emotional forms and can also build a Tinker scanner for powers. Each form is tied to your emotional state with strengths and weaknesses inherent in each of them, which combine with secondary modifiers that add altered characteristics, like Mad Anxiety, Strained Peace and Brooding Anger. You can combine traits from different forms into a hybrid form with hybridized abilities. 

If you don’t use your whole range of emotional forms, such as trying to stay in one too long, it will negatively impact your psychology and train of thought. These changes can be euphoric in how they affect your mood, like a narcotic. Your exposure to your own monstrous forms gives you resistances to horrific mind affecting powers. You can have two to three transformations a day. With each form, you rotate through a small but permanent change that occurs with your body, an addition in one area that causes a subtraction in another, like being a little taller, a little stronger, but also a little more sluggish.
objects.title: (Tinker/Changer) Cryptid

objects.text: You’re a tinker, who specializes in the creation of physics-breaking nanofluids. You can also construct an agility frame that despite its fragility, provides you with great mobility. Examples include a fluid vat with a syringe that contains your fluids, which you can switch out as you please. Pink Fluid with numerous non-Newtonian properties which you can use as a beacon, a kind of specialized traction surface and trampoline. Neon Yellow Fluid that becomes paint-like when applied to something, can latch onto something, and move onto it even while dislodged or deny telekinesis hold on the object. Red Compression Fluid used to fit objects into places that they should not physically be able to fit into and a Pill Popper, a massive, hundred pound launcher, inspired by another power, which can deliver your fluids with remotely detonated football-sized projectiles.
objects.title: (Tinker) Withdrawal

objects.text: Your primary power is a tinker power with a specialty in making limbs, you can imbue your tinkertech attacks to let them hit with an explosive force beyond what they should be hitting with. You have an intuitive ability to stay balanced, even while standing with your tinkertech hands. You also have a secondary power that allows you to sense emotional weaknesses in people, letting you know exactly how far you can push things with them before they will break.
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) Cradle

objects.text: You are a tinker focused on mass production.
objects.title: (Tinker) Masamune

objects.text: You are a Tinker whose specialization is explosives. You are able to create bombs with an incredibly wide variety of effects, not all of them lethal. You don't have complete control over what you build and sometimes don't even know what the end result will be.
objects.title: (Tinker) Bakuda

objects.text: You are a Tinker specializing in drugs that temporarily turn subjects into monsters while storing their original form. The drugs trigger a transformation that draws in extra mass, with even water being a possible source. While the transformation can hold off injuries, it does not actually heal the subject. The subject returns to their injured state when the transformation stops. There is no guarantee of complete recovery from experimental forms. Your formulas are geared toward turning people into weapons, with hormones kicking into overdrive and priming their fight or flight instincts.
objects.title: (Tinker) Lab Rat

objects.text: You are a powerful biotinker specializing in medical sciences.
objects.title: (Tinker) Bonesaw

objects.text:
You are a tinker with almost no limitations regarding what you can build. However, all of your creations work on a countdown from the moment construction begins, requiring careful time management and sufficient resources in order to achieve the best results. When time or resources are insufficient, your creations will backfire like Leet. 

You tinker noticeably faster than other tinkers and can create specialized drones to do construction for you.
objects.title: (Tinker) String Theory

objects.text: You’re a blaster who can create dark clouds in a loose line and shoot a beam of darkness through the middle of them.
objects.title: (Blaster) Ala

objects.text: You can fire weightless and ricocheting black stars that become spikes which impale targets they draw near to.
objects.title: (Blaster) Cassiterite

objects.text: You have the ability to produce six harpoons from your torso. These harpoons can be used both as an attack, as well as a way to pull yourself along, as a minor Mover ability.
objects.title: (Blaster) Grapnel

objects.text: You can create slow-moving projectiles (around half the speed of a thrown basketball) that you can detonate concussively at will. You also have a secondary ability that allows you to see in the dark.
objects.title: (Blaster) Lightstar

objects.text: You can turn any projectile into an obscenely high-ranged projectile with perceptions to match.
objects.title: (Blaster) Rifle

objects.text: You’re a blaster, who can only shoot a single shot at a time of softball sized stones. These stones fly in straight lines at high velocities, and are very good at shattering things that are inorganic, notably armor.
objects.title: (Blaster) Slingstone

objects.text: You have the ability to blast bullets of smoke and hot air that can choke people.
objects.title: (Blaster) Smokey Bandit

objects.text: You can fire explosive darts of light.
objects.title: (Blaster) Starlet

objects.text: You have the ability to shoot blasts that sting the whole body of those hit and gradually yet permanently alter people's pain responses, causing them to like pain. Your blasts are near-instantaneous and hard to dodge, leaving curling afterimages in their wake.
objects.title: (Blaster/Master) Aroa Vasil

objects.text: You’re a blaster that shoots darts with thin lines attached. Once darts connect, even if they don’t harm the target, you can fling the target up to 20 feet in a direction and fling yourself at the same time. You will always land securely on your feet.
objects.title: (Blaster) Corax

objects.text: You’re able to concoct a number of chemicals within your stomach and project them through your skin. You can make fire retardant foam, adhesives, lubricants, and strong acids. Your unusual biology also makes you noticeably more durable than normal humans.
objects.title: (Blaster) Gregor the Snail

objects.text: You’re capable of creating globes of light that grow as they fly, then stop in mid-air at planned areas. The orbs have a space-warping effect, some causing accelerating motions in the general area, redirecting movement in their vicinity and enhancing the output of certain forms of energy as well. The area that the orbs affect are based on their size and they don’t distinguish between allies and enemies, their effects increase over time.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Jacklight

objects.text: You’re a sound Blaster able to deafen people and destroy audio equipment. The sound you produce typically moves faster than it normally should.
objects.title: (Blaster) ReSound

objects.text: You’re a Blaster, who can produce a homing fireball that sucks in other projectiles, concentrating them in one area.
objects.title: (Blaster) Signal Fire

objects.text: You’re a blaster that strikes anyone within a large area of effect that penetrates both cover and armor, with permanent brain damage and memory loss in exchange for granting you a temporary boost to your mental power. Your victims' eyes glow.
objects.title: (Blaster/Thinker) Codex

objects.text: You have the ability to create globs of superheated glass. These globs splash upon impact. You can also float in a heat bubble, but your flight is slow to build up in speed, with turns throwing your accuracy and reaction time. You steam while you fly, with your orbs growing faster the faster you go.
objects.title: (Blaster) Etna

objects.text: You can form weapons from a semi-sentient blue-black blur of energy. These weapons have unlimited ammo and can only be mundane in origin. You also have perfect memory and don't need to sleep.
objects.title: (Blaster) Miss Militia

objects.text: You’re a Blaster/Shaker, with the ability to fire powerful "bullets" from your hand connected with strings of near-invisible razor wire. Your bullets resembled a conch shell. You could embed a series of bullets in the walls of an area, rendering it impassable.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Mokosh

objects.text: You produce branches from your back. When you hurl these branches, they explode into a dozen spikes and impale everything around them. They can work as effective barricades and can also bloom with poisonous flowers, eventually releasing gas or pollen if enemies enter their proximity. These proximity effects cease when you leave the range.
objects.title: (Blaster) Backwoods

objects.text: You have the ability to create a large number of bouncing orbs of light that can explode with controlled varying levels of strength ranging from non-lethal concussive blasts to severely lethal explosions. You're also immune to the blasts and the effects of your own orbs, including the light they produce.
objects.title: (Blaster) Flashbang

objects.text: You create buds that unfold into complex crystalline shapes based on a timer or upon impact with a target. These buds aren’t longer than a foot and have a large tool box of potential uses, with abilities like bonding to surfaces, setting touched things on fire, canceling out chemical reactions, and messing with Tinker devices. You also have an enhanced awareness and processing ability regarding fine detail, essentially a pericog, being able to track things like a swarm of insects.
objects.title: (Blaster/Thinker) Floret

objects.text: You have the ability to spew geysers of a napalm-like liquid chemical from your mouth that ignites on contact with objects, creating intense flame that can melt concrete, stone, and steel beams. You aren’t Manton-protected against heat, since the liquid you spits is inert until it makes contact with someone/something.
objects.title: (Blaster) Spitfire

addons.text: As a Titan, your blaster power is vastly amplified. You also gain a tinker aspect and can dismantle parts of tinkertech to make use of them as raw materials for your inventions. This tinkertech can further enhance your blaster abilities.
addons.title: Titan Auger

objects.text: You have a Blaster ability that manifests as a beam of light. With this beam of light, you can bring things in from other dimensions. This ability follows a set rotation. One beam replaces anything it hits with sparks. The following beam replaces anything it hits with flowers and pollen. After a time, these flowers and pollen will revert back into whatever they replaced. The next beam is one of radioactive desolation. You can travel interdimensionally, by focusing your beam on yourself, appearing in a radiation blighted city for as long as you can hold your breath, unless you want to breathe in radioactive dust.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Auger

objects.text: You can cast out large, baseball-sized bullets that move with enough force to break bones, one from each hand per two or three seconds. These bullets, on striking a surface, produce a cloud of sulfurous gas. The gas has a smell comparable to rotten eggs or skunk, and produces an immediate, albeit mild burning sensation, particularly around the mucus glands.
objects.title: (Blaster) Fume

objects.text: You can channel your power through a lance but for it to work something needs to be struck with your lance’s end. The effects range from concussive blasts, elemental attacks, suction and disintegration, etc. A Mover ability giving you a short burst of speed to close in on the target is included, to assist in effectiveness.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) Jouster

objects.text: You can spawn random items into your hands. You can’t choose the items that appear, but they are usually suitable as weapons. Examples include a machete, a gallon tank of fuel, a textbook, a manhole cover, a large bottle of alcohol, a lawn dart, a burning plank, utensils, a vase, toys, a stick of dynamite, a metal stein, a pipe with a shower head attached,  something that created a cloud of gas, and a handful of foot-long centipedes. You also have a minor brute rating that can be used to throw these items at high velocities.
objects.title: (Blaster/Brute) Kitchen Sink

objects.text: You have the ability to fly, create energy blasts from your hands, and create force fields. You can gather energy in your hands, which you can "spend" to shoot sprays of laser blasts. Your blasts are strong enough to get through bone plates in one shot. When people are hit by them they react as if they were punched. Even fired individually, several successive blasts are enough to beat a person to a pulp. Your shields are broad enough to protect other people, described as a "wall of light", transparent. You can use your force fields as a first-aid measure, shaping them to cover a wound, though they are rooted in place unless you make them a bubble around yourself. You can create a small forcefield to help you lift someone. You’re resistant to blinding lights and additionally can see in the dark.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Lady Photon

objects.text: Your attacks bend space to create perfect accuracy, never missing a target within range.
objects.title: (Blaster) Quarrel

objects.text: Your ability is two-fold. First you can noisily blast out shadowy lines, where these strands land, on any surface, silhouettes made of shadow appear. The connective lines count as living tissue for some powers under the Manton Effect. As long as clones are created, and there can be as many as twelve, you’re able to swap places with the clones. Further, these clones can act independently of you, following your directions and general intent. The clones and lines can be affected by powers such as force fields, Tinker guns, and blaster powers but not by tasers. When hit strongly enough to damage them, the shadowy energy tends to dissipate.
objects.title: (Blaster/Master) Seir

objects.text: You create large scale, powerful energy blasts. However, they can only move 15 mph and must be created 4+ ft away.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Tunguska

objects.text: You generate a five-foot-wide, sharp-edged gold hoop that you can move at will, and which can generate force fields and lasers. You can use this to fly. Your lasers are continuous beams of golden light, and you can generate multiple beams at a time. Your force fields are immobile and generated around the ring, in order to protect yourself you’d have to recall it to your side and remain in one place. You can double the hoop’s size.
objects.title: (Blaster) Halo

objects.text: You have flight, energy beams, and force fields, but with weaker shields in exchange for more powerful beams and flight. You can fire crimson concussive blasts that are judged strong enough to affect Leviathan and break his grip. With continuous fire, you can clear rubble. You can fire them from your hands, or shoot a fan of beams from your fingertips. You have enough fine control to burn a design into clothing. You can create crimson force fields, but they are relatively weak and capable of being broken when you kick off against them. You could make a spherical forcefield around yourself and a partner, a square forcefield to support yourself and a partner in midair, or a small forcefield to keep your lasers from going too far. Your flight is fast and mostly limited by your motion sickness.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Laserdream

objects.text: You can create portals to otherworldly ocean depths, resulting in massive geysers, alternatively you can reverse the flow to suck in waterborne items/enemies, you can close the portal to leave everything in the other reality. You cannot close your portals while objects or people are in between them.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Ligeia

objects.text: You can fire blades that create lines on hit surfaces and if that surface is struck it splits along the line. You have a Tinker specialization in frail prosthetic arms. You have an enhanced sense of balance that lets you stop in place at any speed or turn on a dime. You can spread mild guilt and doubt over an area.
objects.title: (Blaster/Tinker) Precipice

objects.text: You can generate bursts of sparks from your skin, emanating out in a cone. On contact with a surface, these sparks imbue it with an antigravity effect and ricochet off surfaces already imbued with the effect forcefully enough to push objects. The range is rather short, at about eight feet. You could use this on very heavy armor, where the effect would cushion you while making the suit surprisingly light. Vents in the gauntlets would allow you to deliver focused blasts at a range of about ten feet. The armor's low weight, thanks to your power, would allow you to move surprisingly quickly if needed. Individuals struck by your power may be flung by the combination of antigravity and forceful ricochet. In confined quarters, the sparks may fill the area, disrupting foes or teammates.
objects.title: (Blaster) Snubnose

objects.text: You can launch barbed tethers in long-distance shotgun sprays. Each connected tether poisons your target's blood and taints their body parts, slowing the healing of said parts. While this occurs, you rapidly regenerate yourself and restore your own condition. On perishing, you launch out hundreds of tethers for potential hundreds of feet to drink and attempt to revive yourself.
objects.title: (Blaster) Heartsoul

objects.text: You can convert and magnify almost any light in your close vicinity into a concussive Laser cannon. The brighter the light source is, the more energy you can shape and direct. While your power can easily be lethal, you can moderate the output to less-than-lethal levels. You can choose to either adjust the output and intensity of one light source at a time, or you can amplify every available light source at once, to devastating effect.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Lightslinger

objects.text: You can summon large red spheres composed of 'abstract energy' filaments from far behind you that can then be directed towards a targeted area. Where the energy impacts, a major, yet discriminatory, rearrangement ensues. Targets can be pulled to their feet or knocked down, they may end up facing another way, be placed behind cover, and innumerable changes are possible at the impact site. You and any allies can be easily excepted from this rule. On a smaller scale, you can shoot small blasts of the energy to push targets back. Your energy balls are roughly the size of a trailer home and are summoned through various hand gestures, accompanied by a black flare when they appear. Starting as orbs the energy deforms as it moves through the air. Non-targeted individuals just feel a wash of warm air as the effect touches them.
objects.title: (Blaster) Mayday

objects.text: You can tear any piece of your midsection off and use them as destructive projectiles. Your 'ammo' is dependent on the amount you can tear from your stomach and how quickly you can tear the tissue away. Anything in your lower torso is fair game, bones, skins, organs, everything. Regeneration rates and effects are dependent on the tissue type, they don’t follow the law of conversion of mass, as their detonations are far more explosive than they should be. You also have slightly enhanced strength from your elbows down, making tearing your own flesh easy. Tearing organs off isn’t enough to prime them for detonation, you need to activate them and then throw the individual organ. You can remove several organs to make a pile for later use, though they self-detonate after some time. You can use your consistently concave midsection to store items without them showing. Your thrown body parts have various effects: Your blood and fat burn like cooking oil, your gallbladder makes a quiet detonation leaving behind a puddle of caustic acid. Your kidney makes noxious napalm-like stink sludge, alternatively they make huge fragmentation bombs if they are filled with kidney stones. Your muscles cause a large clean detonation, your rib is explosive in a shaped detonation going in two opposite directions, your spinal sheath causes a concussive detonation, your stomach makes acid and your skin explodes.
objects.title: (Blaster/Brute) Sidepiece

objects.text: You’re a blaster with a three-beat attack that emanates from your eyes. The first beat is a massive stream of liquid that resembles molten gold or magma, that travels fast enough to deliver serious damage by itself. This column is about five feet around. The second beat lets the matter ignite into white flames, with temperatures high enough to instantly turn surroundings into glass. The final stage transforms the flames into ultra-bright sparks that can blind for up to 2 minutes.
objects.title: (Blaster) Solarstare

objects.text: You can create orbs that look like a cabbage made of stone or an origami onion. These projections have a disintegration effect that can eat its way through thick bone and stone and other materials. It can also be used to provide a limited clairvoyant effect on a target, leaving them unharmed working as a type of body search.
objects.title: (Blaster/Thinker) Spruce

objects.text: You can throw chunks of crystal that pass seamlessly through walls and the ground, then explode out in a small detonation of gas, debris and crystalline fragments. The crystals home in on their targets, for example, a crystal thrown into the ground would re-emerge beneath the target. You can see through solid objects as if they were made of glass or transparent crystal, with edges and corners catching the light. Unmoving objects look white-edged, while moving objects like people look blurred and diffracted, their white-edged present selves surrounded by red images of their past and blue images of their future. Humans are also surrounded by distortions in the light that represent their focus and emotions, with dramatic changes in focus resembling fractures in the crystal. You can see other colors beyond the red past and the blue future, like green.
objects.title: (Blaster/Thinker) Crystalclear

addons.text: As Titan Eve your physical range and durability have drastically increased, due to your new and giant non-human physiology. You can produce gas that fills the area in a radius around yourself. You can control this gas to a greater extent, solidifying it at will into various shapes that you can, in turn, manipulate, solidifying it into weapons like by launching spikes of hardened gas at opponents. When those solidified projectiles collide they have a corrosive shrapnel effect, producing heavy, but localized damage. You can alter the properties of the gas you produce, leading to various effects, like a bubblegum pink gas that erodes holes into whatever it contacts, with pink and green maggots with sharp pincers forming from it. These creatures can be as big as humans, while the holes formed by this gas are extradimensional, not significantly compromising the structural integrity of whatever they form in.
addons.title: Titan Eve

objects.text:
