You can create fragile spheres of poison that explode on contact with hard surfaces, creating weak concussive blasts strong enough to knock a person over and a splash or cloud of poison. The spheres are solid and about the size of a billiard ball. Their color depends on the potency of their payload, ranging from yellow to yellow-green and further into black. The strength and properties of your gas can be varied, usually being stronger if concentrated into liquids, where it can affect people on skin-contact. 

Your poison can range from making people nauseous and slightly feeble up to the point of melting organic objects on contact. You can recall already expelled gas by forming new projectiles. You can also dissolve already-formed spheres, however it takes some time. You have control over your spheres, able to launch them in straight lines at record-level pitcher speed, course-correct them mid-flight, or make them orbit your hand in an ellipse. You can manifest multiple spheres at a time and send them all at once. Your gas does not obstruct you in any way.
objects.title: (Blaster) Fume Hood

objects.text: You can create and throw needles that disintegrate material on contact, producing high-velocity shrapnel. They are not Manton Limited and can rip through flesh. You can "charge up" a needle, increasing its size up to that of a railroad spike.
objects.title: (Blaster) Paris

objects.text: You can fly, have the ability to manipulate and capture diverse forms of energy with equipment and then use that energy to launch orbs at your enemies. The more energy you collect, the greater the charge you have for your orbs, which are roughly a foot across and deep each, and can follow complex flight patterns that you can set along with specific detonations. You can also reprogram these orbs after they have been launched, and can decide whether they damage allied targets or not. This allows you to survive lightning blasts from Behemoth, though you’d still be blown back far enough to be severely injured.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Revel

objects.text:
You can create sonic orbs by pointing and shooting or with throwing motions that conclusively detonate when they connect. These are "soft" explosions which impart kinetic energy without heat or damaging shockwaves, and they affect both humans and inanimate objects. The more you use them the stronger your blasts become. Once you have tagged a series of targets, you can unleash a "finale" of coordinated secondary detonations that launch all previous targets in a cascading chain reaction of collisions and further detonations. 

With the help of making onomatopoeia, you can shape and regulate the initial strength of your blasts. E.g. The proper imitation of a gunshot can put a hole into the gunsteel even at down-low of the overall charge. It also extends to your regular speech, which starts triggering power-effects when your power is restless. It takes time to build up a new “finale” after using it, but the finale becomes less precise as the number of targets and the setup time increases if you delay it. Some skill is involved in controlling the finale. You have some innate durability.
objects.title: (Blaster) Finale

objects.text: You can control hundreds of blades. You can use this swarm of blades to lacerate people, though your blades don’t have much penetration power, or pin them down, and can also form these blades into different shapes, including a shield or a spike by interlocking them. You can use these blades for flight.
objects.title: (Blaster) Lionwing

objects.text:
With an internal supply of energy formed from sunlight, you have the ability to create kinetically charged light, to move through the air at high speeds while generating powerful blasts.

You can also create beams strong enough to level buildings, create smaller beams, or fire multiple beams at once. it takes a moment to charge up beams, energy visibly welling up in your hands.
objects.title: (Blaster/Breaker) Purity

objects.text: You can create innumerable energy blasts and beams, condensing and refining them to devastating effect using a lens that you can project and control. You don't need a straight shot to hit your targets.
objects.title: (Blaster) Raymancer

objects.text: You have the ability to violently draw in moisture from your environment, allowing you to stun or kill your targets. This ability ignores force fields and armor. This limited hydrokinesis, which is conversely not Manton-limited, is effectively targeted dehydration. You can use your power in a long tight cone-shaped "blast" or in a tight field around you. The moisture you extract remains floating around you.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Sere

objects.text:
Your power constantly generates beach ball-sized spheres of energy in your immediate vicinity that manifest as flashes of white light. Your shard finds a parallel Earth with roughly corresponding architecture and swaps more permanent elements of this architecture in as needed, while shunting any remaining matter caught in these blasts out to that parallel Earth. Thus, your spherical explosions appear to delete matter but typically leave the ground and buildings intact because they are effectively portal cuts that also swap select elements in to avoid tearing up your own footing, as such your power never blasts the ground out from under your feet. 

Your spheres of energy are All-or-Nothing, their shunting/swapping of matter cannot be blocked by any non-perfect defense. Including the Endbringers. You can push your power into overdrive to generate explosions more frequently. As your power is heavily interdimensional, your power is always on, you also have limited control over your power as the placement of your explosions is somewhat random. As such to avoid any friendly fire, you must keep your distance from allies. You also can’t really control where your blasts hit with any degree of accuracy as you only have some ability to dictate their general direction and frequency (i.e., spam a general area). Your power has a relatively short range of no more than around 20 feet.
objects.title: (Blaster) Scrub

objects.text: You’re a Thinker who can focus on things and form a clone of your mind that has slowed perceptions. This allows you to pick over every detail of the thing you’re focusing on, for an amount of time that you control. You’re capable of doing this for months of your own perceived time.
objects.title: (Thinker) Big Picture

objects.text: You can rate situations using colors. Purple and black would be various degrees of negative, with yellow being less severe.
objects.title: (Thinker) Appraiser

objects.text: You can provide numerical threat ratings for situations, with higher numbers being worse in severity. 9 and 8 for highly dangerous situations with 3 for a less dangerous one.
objects.title: (Thinker) Eleventh Hour

objects.text: You ‘eat’ babies, drawing them into your center and building around them. With antennae-like branches, that reach out to connect to others, and turn emotional connections physical. Through these tentative connections, you can read information. You’re able to tell when people are lying.
objects.title: (Thinker/Changer) Blackforest

objects.text: You can see the likelihood of someone committing violence to others around them, as well as the recency and particular flavor of violence.
objects.title: (Thinker) Danger Zone

objects.text: You can see emotions and can shoot emotion blasts. The stronger the emotion you're blasting, the more force comes with it.
objects.title: (Thinker/Blaster) Gallant

objects.text: You can grant any information you know to others via touch. The transfer will be accompanied by a pink flash and the targets will intuitively know the content you’ve transferred to them and understand them better than mere words could convey.
objects.title: (Thinker) Mapright

objects.text: You can create a 'couple of things' that you instinctively know the location of, enabling you to tag people and track them.
objects.title: (Thinker) Nero

objects.text: You have a Thinker ability that allows you to physically see the lies that people tell themselves. You can turn this off by concentrating.
objects.title: (Thinker) Sean Gilpatrick

objects.text: You’re a Thinker who can see contraband and other hazards.
objects.title: (Thinker) Squint

objects.text: You can master any technique as long as you concentrate. You can only have 1 technique at a time, and you do not have an understanding of the broader skill.
objects.title: (Thinker) Über

objects.text: You have a Thinker ability that can invasively evaluate the medical condition of a person.
objects.title: (Thinker) Venarum

objects.text: You have a combat-oriented thinker ability, with a specialty in knives and bladed weapons. Your power lets you know the most effective place to put knives.
objects.title: (Thinker) Operator Red

objects.text: You can see small detached objects both animate and inanimate regardless of the obstacles between you and them. You cannot sense internal objects. You have knowledge on how to train and command rats to retrieve the objects you’ve found, and can teach them to open doors for you. You can maintain an awareness of them while they’re out of reach and are somewhat able to get an understanding of what your rats are thinking as they ‘talk’ to you.
objects.title: (Thinker) Ratcatcher

objects.text: You have an innate knowledge of how to cut through mental defenses, and force people into giving you accurate information by effectively torturing them. You can also sense people based on their emotions.
objects.title: (Thinker) Samuel Vasil

objects.text: You’re able to throw knives with exceptional prowess, able to hit flying targets with kitchen knives unweighted for throwing. As well as hit targets with a thrown knife even while being blinded and attacked.
objects.title: (Thinker) Unter

objects.text: You’re a thinker who gets a clairvoyant awareness of a pre-designated area on an x-y-z plane. Anyone within this area is assessed by your power. The things assessed are traits like fitness, martial arts prowess, run speed and other similar stats. The smaller an area that you maintain awareness of, the more accurate information you get. You become completely incapacitated while your power is in use.
objects.title: (Thinker) Braindead

objects.text: You’re a thinker whose precognition functions best when everyone around you is at their worst, FUBAR, in the midst of chaos and heightened emotions. You also have an enhanced memory.
objects.title: (Thinker) Spur

objects.text: You have the ability to 'merge' with people, capturing that person. While merged with people, you can use that person as a power source, and a modifier to your own knowledge base and personality.
objects.title: (Thinker) Vessel

objects.text: You can use precognition to follow two timelines where you make different choices.
objects.title: (Thinker) Coil

objects.text: Your power helps you deduce things, often times without sufficient evidence. However, without enough evidence you can get really incorrect answers. You will get headaches if you use this power too much.
objects.title: (Thinker) Tattletale

objects.text: You have a minor forcefield, sonic laser powers, and a social Thinker power, that makes you aware of the threat level of individuals associated with your target, not including that person, in terms of color. You can also learn languages unnaturally quickly, your comprehension advancing from broken to flawless after three exchanges with native speakers.
objects.title: (Thinker/Blaster) Arbiter

objects.text: You’re a clairvoyant thinker with a specialized understanding of anything above you. You have what is described as 'top-down clairvoyant awareness'. Because of this, you’re extra efficient with a gun. While using a gun, you move it normally from left to right, but almost instantaneously up and down. This means that, if you aim, you’re guaranteed to get a hit if the gun is at the right point horizontally, as you will automatically be able to make any headshots. You also have enhanced hearing.
objects.title: (Thinker) Birdbrain

objects.text: You’re a pericog/limited clairvoyant who can "read" a large amount of information from a person. However, this power gives diminishing returns as a subject becomes more and more familiar. This allows you to predict the strikes of unknown targets and counter them, using their predicted movement to your advantage. You’re unimpeded by obstacles like walls, allowing you to see through them like where they’re going.
objects.title: (Thinker) Figurehead

objects.text: You have a deadly accuracy power that allows you to hit a baseball into angles that will inevitably hit somebody's weak point, like their temple or heart. This tends towards the lethal side. You also have the ability to make things ricochet on contact with a surface, with the post-ricochet being even stronger.
objects.title: (Thinker/Blaster) Homer

objects.text: You have an ability that grants you complex analysis of observed objects and individuals, including observation of past, present, future, physical composition, and weak points.
objects.title: (Thinker) Pinpoint

addons.text: As a Titan, your power increases dramatically in strength and potency. Affecting everybody within a certain radius of yourself, effectively giving them brain damage. You can apply your power through objects, including air. You gain an increase in power or confidence for every person that you drain. You’re incapable of stealing/draining power-related skills.
addons.title: The Nemean Titan

objects.text: You are a skill thief, with the ability to absorb the practical expertise of anyone you spend time in the presence of. The skills you can absorb can be increased by things such as eye contact or physical contact, with each connection made increasing the breadth and depth of what you are able to steal, whether a specific skill or a target's general skill set. Unless you completely steal a target's skill, they will regain the skill over time.
objects.title: (Thinker/Stranger) Victor

objects.text: You’re a thinker who can take a block of time to survey an area and gain precise clairvoyance and detailed information on that area, down to dust particles, history, who has been there, people's routines in there, and some inklings about events that may come to pass in that area. While inside the designated area, which is enough to cover a large building or a house and the two neighboring properties, you become deft, quick, hyperalert, and benefit especially from chaos - scattered papers, destruction, fire, flooding, and the like. You’ll be able to just roll with every bit of environmental fuckery and turn it on your enemies. However, once you’re focused on an area, you become blind outside of it, and this takes hours to pass.
objects.title: (Thinker) Junco

objects.text:
You’re a Thinker whose intelligence increases in relation to the size and scope of the problems presented to you, therefore the more complex the problem you’re given, the faster you can devise a solution for it. This applies to a wide range of applications. From your perspective, your Shard feeds you estimates and information with whatever task you set your mind to. 

An example would be solving world hunger using only a telephone and the internet in less than six and a half hours, then typing it out in a further nine into a concise 150-page document outlining how to implement it. However, your plans are often too complicated to turn into practice. Your plans have more direct utility. When you personally direct your subordinates they tend to win their fights. Further, you can 'accordinate' plans to take out certain individuals, while your tactical ability in direct encounters is less usable. You’re able to create elaborate physical and social traps. 

Other Thinker powers can interfere with your abilities and your plans have blind spots if other Thinkers were to step in. Your power affects your behavior. Specifically, it makes you hyper-aware of disorder and things that are "out of place", so much so that even minor details can drive you to homicidal rage. Though you do recognize this in yourself and can actively try to contain the urges your power gives where it would be inconvenient to act upon. You also have a minor sub-talent for creating non-tinkertech objects with multiple interlocking parts and a sense of aesthetic harmony.
objects.title: (Thinker) Accord

objects.text: You have a danger sense and enhanced perceptions, which you can give to others, at the cost of losing it yourself for the duration you grant it. You can only empower one person at a time in line of sight, but you can rapidly switch who has your power. People using your power are better able to evade attacks, dodging blows they shouldn't be able to see coming. You and anyone under your empowerment has glowing yellow eyes.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Ahrima

objects.text: You receive memories from people who have consumed a part of your body, including blood, and flesh. You receive these memories when they go to sleep at the same time as you. The memories you receive are vague, not complete memories, but enough to piece broad strokes together, allowing you to get an instinctive feel of who the person is, and how they act. The effects of your powers are permanent.
objects.title: (Thinker) Jonathan Miller

objects.text: You’re a 'shotgun precog', viewing a number of relatively inaccurate visions. You view a spread of futures in a matter of moments with the number of events and the length of the viewing periods depending on the time since your last 'shotgun', your emotional state, and your degree of rest. The number of futures viewed varies from two to six and the duration varies from seconds to hours, respectively. The ability hits a ceiling at the point where you’re incapacitated for longer than the visions last. Capabilities and priorities you observe are reasonably accurate, but events can diverge wildly. You get your best returns when you’ve been in direct combat. Your power might be observing possible worlds and then extrapolating one possible future of that possible world. However your power sometimes seems to actively work against you and your allies attempts to figure it out, especially if you’ve avoided combat.
objects.title: (Thinker) Roulette

objects.text: You’re a Thinker who can see incoming attacks through a form of pseudo-clairvoyance in battlefields, capable of managing nigh-instantaneous counter attacks even when surprised. Another benefit to your abilities is having beyond expert-level tactical sensibilities with talent in regards to the actions of large groups of combatants.
objects.title: (Thinker) Shén Yù

objects.text: You’re a Changer whose form is sensitive due to your secondary Thinker function. When you’re lied to, you can sense these lies due to the reaction you can interpret from your guts, each reaction influences your changer form. Making it more and more combat capable with grotesque mutations, like large claws, hidden sets of teeth and thick braided skin. Your Thinker power is distinctly focused on the meaning behind a statement rather than concrete wording. It can be 'beaten' by exclusionary detailing; a white lie or lying by omission. You’re still able to gain information from a lie and give out factual information from it.
objects.title: (Thinker/Changer) Crock o’Shit

objects.text:
You possess three types of enhanced senses and can only use one at a time.

Zoomed sight with simultaneous viewing and processing of multiple scenes in FOV.
Sight through inorganic material which can be used to locate people through walls.
Organic sight that allows you to see the inner workings of an individual’s body in detail.

Your primary offensive power is an explosive touch linked to perception—this ability is linked to the quality and quantity of your focus on a target, ranging from delivering blows at five or so times the usual strength to obliterating large vehicles. The variance in effectiveness sometimes drastically changes from one moment to the next.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) Horizon

objects.text: You are a "brainwashing" Thinker.
objects.title: (Thinker) One

objects.text:
Your primary power is an enhanced sense of timing that requires you to have an understanding of every factor involved in the task at hand. Whether it's the environment, fitness, parahuman powers, or any other relevant detail, you have a heightened sense of intuition that helps you precisely determine the optimal course of action for each situation. This makes you unreadable to other Thinkers. 

Your second power allows you to infuse nonliving objects with the ability to ignore select laws of physics, and those infused objects exist simultaneously in all dimensions including their own allowing even a stick to cut through the hardest materials. 

Your third power allows you to create timed explosions through basically drawing a fuse. The length of the fuse affects how long it takes for it to explode. The fuse looks like rippling water and has hues of blue, purple, and black with those hues only disappearing 1-2 seconds after contact between you and the fuse ceases. A flare, purple and blue with black in the center starts where the fuse originates and the explosion occurs when it reaches where the fuse ends. The explosion disrupts breaker effects and you have an enhanced sense of accuracy.
objects.title: (Thinker/Striker) March

objects.text: You can predict the future as percentages. Doing so too much will give you headaches.
objects.title: (Thinker) Kid Cassandra

objects.text: You can "distort" and extend whatever you’re touching at a fast speed, helping you move or strike enemies from afar.
objects.title: (Striker) Leister

objects.text: You have the ability to temporarily turn the people you touch into audio-visual copies of yourself. These copies can infest others they touch, passing on the remaining duration instead of renewing the duration. This does not override the subject's identity in any way, it is effectively a solid light disguise.
objects.title: (Striker) Mirrormask

objects.text: You have a Striker/Master power that allows you to create a copy of yourself so long as you’re making contact with an enemy.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Prong

objects.text: You can create fire from nothing that is capable of burning through bone. Your hands and arms are burned black up to your elbows, resembling a log gone cold in a fireplace.
objects.title: (Striker) Cinderhands

objects.text: You can create a bestial image over your upper body that can attack the things around you. The projection has considerable strength and regenerative abilities.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Captain Claw

objects.text: With a touch you can adjust the gravity upon any non-living material, or any non-living material it's connected to, the bigger the change, the faster it wears off.
objects.title: (Striker) Cascade

objects.text: You can freeze something in time with a touch. It stays frozen for 30 seconds to 10 minutes. You can freeze something with only a fraction of a second of contact.
objects.title: (Striker) Clockblocker

objects.text: You can transfer the properties of one object to another on touch. Like making swords and axes out of a diamond.
objects.title: (Striker) Diamondtooth

objects.text: You can embed your limbs into a surface to project a larger version of your limbs some distance away on a similar surface.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Golem

addons.text: Every time you hold an object, it is stored within a mental catalog, allowing you to summon a perfect obsidian-black replica at will. These copies retain all the properties and mass of the original objects, but they are weightless to you, allowing you to handle even the heaviest items with ease. To anyone else, the replicas behave as if they have their full mass and function, giving you a powerful advantage. When no longer needed, the items dissolve back into your mental inventory, ready to be summoned again. You can only put into the catalog stuff that you can hold and carry, so air cannot be placed in the catalog.
addons.title: Echo Chamber

objects.text: By touching an object with one hand you can produce a copy of it with your other hand. These copies are identical to the originals, except for the fact that they are black like obsidian, or onyx. You can make the copied objects disappear at will. You are capable of turning the air itself into an object, for example, to create a statue.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Little Midas

addons.text: As a Titan, you have the same abilities but significantly scaled up and with a changer-flare. You can use space warping through your praying mantis-like limbs and are powerful enough to deflect beams from Legend, and easily smear an Alexandria Package cape into a paste. You no longer have a range limit. You can use space-warping effects to move in unintuitive ways, using your lances as fixed rotation points.
addons.title: The Impaler Titan

objects.text: You have an ability that works through your weapons, which varies based on whether you swing it, thrust it, or keep it still. For example keeping it still makes it unfurl transforming into a shield and spiraling it creates suction.
objects.title: (Striker) Mystic Magic Impaler

objects.text: Your power allows you to dig through potential realities to find alternate versions of the person you are working on and apply that person's condition to your target. This removes the person's injuries, essentially making it as though they had not suffered them at all. You use your body as a bridge for this process. You can also use this to apply harmful effects to your targets.
objects.title: (Striker/Thinker) Scapegoat

objects.text: You look like a half-mummy and half-bird. Desiccated with feather-like straps, and have wings that drape out from your arms, as well as a single blade in place of your middle toe, and another at your heel, as well as a very distinct speech impediment. While flying you have an unusual kind of movement that enables you to slide through the air, for example upward and at a diagonal and thus move unnaturally in the air. Your movements also have an afterimage. This afterimage is capable of doing just as much damage as the attack that precedes it.
objects.title: (Striker/Mover) Vulturehawk

objects.text: You can control the kinetic energy of yourself and things you touch. You can absorb kinetic energy into a battery of sorts and redistribute that energy later.
objects.title: (Striker) Assault

objects.text: You possess enhanced reflexes, agility, and perception of time. You can imbue parts of your body with extra striking power and invulnerability, both to powers and general harm.
objects.title: (Striker) Grace

objects.text: You have the ability of limited blood control and some personal biokinesis, which allows you to create hard physical cutting weapons out of your blood, and shields out of your scabs.
objects.title: (Striker) Hemorrhagia

objects.text: You secrete a hallucinogenic fluid from your skin at all times. You are noticeably tougher, stronger, and faster than a normal human.
objects.title: (Striker/Mover) Newter

objects.text: After touching an object, you can move the object a set distance of exactly forty-three feet along any horizontal plane. While moving, these objects are largely resistant to damage, though some affected materials do get damaged after heavy collisions. Small, hand-held objects move at roughly seventy-five miles an hour, while objects the size of a car move half that speed. You can apply this effect to yourself.
objects.title: (Striker) Rail

objects.text: You have the ability to create simple weapons and shields out of hard light that can be used to slice through steel or defend against powerful attacks. You can also roll yourself into a ball with a layered, spherical forcefield around you that can fly away whenever it is hit, you exercise some control over the direction. While in the ball you track your surroundings with another kind of awareness. You have some resistance to blinding lights.
objects.title: (Striker/Breaker) Brandish

objects.text: You have the power to combine the properties of several items into one - selectively taking their attributes into his primary weapons, you need stamina and concentration to use this power. These different attributes appear as shapes and lines in an abstract representation of the object's properties. You can see glimmers and images that represent the powers of others.
objects.title: (Striker/Thinker) Chevalier

addons.text: When entering your Titan state, all items you’ve invested charges into, temporarily gain several years worth of charges, drastically improving them. A spear that could extend by a meter, could now extend for miles. A helmet that expands awareness could now show everything in every dimension within your radius. While in this form you can also simultaneously exist in every dimension you want to affect.
addons.title: The Kronos Titan

objects.text: You can put charges into items to give them powers. This slowly makes them more powerful. Active combat speeds up the collection of charges.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Dauntless

objects.text: You have the ability to separate molecular bonds in any non-living material to make holes or cuts by touching it.
objects.title: (Striker) Faultline

objects.text: You have the ability to flay individuals of their skin with a touch. Once skin has been absorbed, you gain a permanent increase in your own strength and durability. You can run at great speeds by virtue of this natural strength. You can also alter the pigments of your skin to create patterns. Your power is always active, making you instinctively reach towards people when threatened, to strengthen yourself against possible attacks. Your power doesn’t affect animals, or make you reflexively reach for them.
objects.title: (Striker) Vellum

objects.text: Upon making contact with a person, you can inflict 'distilled defeat' upon them, usually taking that person out of the battle. Each person you affect appears to cause one of your fingernails to glow. The severity of your power is affected by how powerful you appear in your target's eyes. The more confident you appear to your target, the longer and stronger your power hits. If their opinion of you is taken down, the effect dissipates on all that were affected, and you suffer the backslash yourself. You possess a secondary Thinker power that allows you to sense the bodies of people in close vicinity to you. This sense also applies to those you use your power on and assists your aim with your primary power.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Chastity Vasil

objects.text: You can move things to where they were ten seconds ago, move things to where they're slated to be ten seconds in the future, or pause things for up to ten seconds, releasing at a whim.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Epoch

addons.text: As a Titan, your needles' effectiveness has increased dramatically. You’re capable of fully mutating someone with only momentary contact, and your victims are incapable of reverting. You can create monsters that are over 12 stories and taller, towering even over other Titans. The needles that you create can manifest from the ground itself.
addons.title: The Ophion Titan

objects.text: You have a bio-manipulation ability that allows you to change the bodies of people into grotesque forms. Examples include changing a boy into having the head and limbs of a dog, changing three women to look exactly alike, and aging a woman 40 years. You can create needles from your body that you can use to splice the traits of other beings into a person.
objects.title: (Striker) Mr. Bough

objects.text: Your movement is augmented with shockwaves that allow 'Kinetic extension', and any collision you produce releases blasts strong enough to knockdown people at significant distance. You can use this ability to augment your movement speed, as you’re able to lunge and maintain that lunging speed.
objects.title: (Striker) Thud

objects.text: You can imbue any inorganic object you touch, from ball bearings to automobiles, with kinetic energy, causing it to go flying faster than the speed of sound.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Ballistic

objects.text: You can ignite oxygenated liquids and sense inorganic liquid, you’re immune to heat damage. You’re not limited by the Manton effect and can ignite bodily fluids.
objects.title: (Striker) Flashpoint

objects.text: You acquire a brute package that boosts both your strength and durability. In addition, any harm you endure can be transferred to any person you've touched within 24 hours. They bear the full impact of the damage, or a portion proportionate to the number of individuals in the chain of harm. The power's definition of "harm" is somewhat ambiguous, offering potential loopholes, possibly enabling you to evade situations akin to Grey Boy's time loop.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) King

objects.text: You produce duplicates across the area spaced out in rows and columns of 5 feet. Simultaneously awareness and movement of all duplicates.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Warrior Princess Kaguya

objects.text: You have telekinetically assisted strength. Your strength and durability increase with the size of your audience and the reaction you get from them. Your secondary power feeds the same reactions that fuel your strength to leave your targets stunned, reacting slower, or making them take longer to pick themselves off the ground. This effect is able to cause more permanent brain damage.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Blowout

objects.text: You possess biokinetic durability, size, and a touch that turns individuals inside out.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) Prolapse

objects.text: You can imbue weapons, objects, and ammunition with the ability to inflict gradually worsening wounds that smoke and sting. All wounds you inflict will bleed, fester and permanently scar if not tended to, with scratches having the potential to worsen into evisceration. You have a clairvoyant awareness of those you wound. You also have enhanced strength, reflexes, and agility.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) Ravager

objects.text: You can infuse nonliving objects with the ability to ignore select laws of physics, including the ability to go through anything. You also have an intuitive understanding of angles and trajectories as well as an enhanced sense of timing.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Flechette/Foil

objects.text: You can enhance bats with different blaster-effects that are activated by swinging them, your power can be applied to several objects. One is an elaborate ornate bat which appears to be encased in glass or ice, with a localized galaxy in the center. The other bat is made of wood that glows at its core, and is wreathed in golden horns that rotate around it. Swinging your golden bat produces a large golden slash that is powerful enough to carve up a powerful brute and you can double this bat in size. Your galaxy bat is stronger, but also "messier". You can deliver strong, repeated swings even one-handed and while exhausted, due to your power making your bats lighter.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Switch Hitter

objects.text: You have a striker ability that allows you to push people into a pocket dimension of your own making. In this pocket dimension, you effectively become god. Each person put into your pocket dimension is allocated a 12 foot by 12 foot room, that you have absolute power over, with the exception that you cannot expand it.
objects.title: (Striker) Happyland

objects.text: Anything you hit will explode, while an attacker also suffers a retaliatory explosion should you be hit. You have resistance to damage from other powers, one that becomes better the further the distance from your target as well as basic strength and durability increases, letting you survive things like falling from great heights. Indirect force can still affect you though. Combined, these powers would allow you to take lightning strikes from Behemoth and fight hand-to-hand with Scion. You also have some resistance to mind-affecting powers. Your power is under conscious control, you can suppress it.
objects.title: (Striker/Brute) Hoyden

objects.text: You have touch-range biokinesis. You can only use this on others, not yourself. You have an instinctual understanding of most biology, but even so, you cannot always understand biological-based Parahuman powers, such as the biological armor of Bitch's dogs.
objects.title: (Striker) Panacea

objects.text: Your power allows you to edit brains through touch. You can brainwash individuals, erase memories, and implant knowledge of languages you know into individuals. You’re able to remove powers as you can choose to edit the brain of an affected individual so that a spoken key word or phrase will permanently take away their connection to their powers, i.e., the individual loses their powers for good. You can also set a spoken key word or phrase that temporarily removes that individual's powers. Though this can be taxing if overused.
objects.title: (Striker) The Slug

objects.text: Your face and body shift according to your basic perception of attractiveness, which slightly changes every time you see a new face to the point that even your friends will have some trouble recognizing you. Additionally, you can now become skilled, mentally and physically, at anything you focus on for an extended period of time. Throughout your changes, you will seem to keep certain basic physical features, such as your original hair color.
objects.title: (Changer) Oliver

objects.text: You can generate a porcelain shell around yourself.
objects.title: (Changer) Teacup

objects.text: You can create scythe blades out of your hands.
objects.title: (Changer) Genoscythe

objects.text: You can unfold into an immobile shelled form with multiple external brains, shelled lenses for perception and pincer limbs for basic manipulation.
objects.title: (Changer) Seashell

objects.text: You’re a garbage processor, or trash changer. By gathering detritus and sewage into your body you can configure it into different forms. You gather this trash by consuming or 'chugging' it, turning it into any solid, gas, or liquid that you may require, in far greater quantities than what you consumed.
objects.title: (Changer) Chugalug

objects.text: You can turn yourself into a mess of ribbons, when inactive you possess a humanoid form with vertical horizontal lines across your body. You can absorb an individual, with some of their memories and appearance being absorbed into yourself costing some of your own. This effect can be repeated, but holding on to anyone too long ‘digests’ them. This can lead to the obfuscation of your personality as more memories and experiences are added to your own, shifting you. You can hold people in suspension without absorbing them.
objects.title: (Changer/Stranger) Matryoshka

objects.text: You can scar people for life, in order to temporarily restore your own beauty. At your peak, you can dance through combat, all grace and poise. At your valleys, when you’ve gone more than a week without a victim, you manifest attack mutations. Raw strength, claws, and teeth in hidden places.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Sightly

objects.text: You can absorb vibrations, utilizing the energy to induce physical changes including new features, armor, and weaponry. Your powers give you a form of progressive neural degradation that can be delayed with your powers.
objects.title: (Changer) Mog

objects.text: You’re a Changer, who can form an expanded amorphous or vaguely humanoid body out of loose debris. Your body can divide, stretch, fork out and reconfigure itself into a mass of tendrils (not dissimilar from a mass of veins and arteries) that attach themselves to loose matter, such as dirt, compost, junk, sand or mud. Your body then brings this loose matter together around your body, allowing you to craft yourself a harder and bigger body. You can also redistribute it across your body, so that if your arms are loaded with debris you can move some of it to cover your torso or head instead.
objects.title: (Changer) Mush

objects.text: You can manipulate bone. You can grow and shrink your own bones but not other peoples’ bones. You cannot control bones inside of people unless you can see them.
objects.title: (Changer/Shaker) Marquis

objects.text:
You have rusty nails for teeth and you can extend any part of your body into a dangerous implement. Your arms and legs, torso, fingers, and toes, or any other body part can be stretched to fine, barely visible points, while at the same time being durable, maintaining rigidity and joint mobility. You can even weaponize your tongue or expand your face to something more like a crocodile so that you can bite people. 

This interferes with your ability to speak until you turn back. It also gives you a certain amount of strength and speed, though this only applies in your Changer form, making it possible to cover a good distance with your stride. You can also use your power to enter through tight spaces. Although durable, your stretched parts can be damaged, and transfer damage once returned to normal.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Nailbiter

objects.text: You have the ability to change into a quadrupedal creature for a limited time. While in this form, you have a power-nullifying ranged attack.
objects.title: (Changer) Animos

addons.text: You can now manipulate your skin much more finely, capable of controlling it as if it were water rather than flesh. Additionally, the power itself becomes more refined. You no longer need to staple or stitch skin, instead flaying others with but a touch. Your regeneration also spreads to all the skin you make part of yourself, preventing the decay that would normally come.
addons.title: Crawling In My...

addons.text: Your dominion over skin has evolved. Your fine control becomes even finer, akin to a certain bug master’s. This is less so scaling multitasking however, and more beyond superhuman proprioception when it comes to your skin. Your skin’s All-or-Nothing nature now also applies to any skin you make part of yourself, and will reinforce it so long as it’s part of you. Any skin you choose to shed will become normal skin once more, albeit left with any alterations you’ve made (e.g., making furniture out of hardened skin). Your skin now also cannot be forcefully shorn away from your body; you can never be flayed.
addons.title: Nemean

objects.text: You have the ability to manipulate your own skin and regenerate. You can extend this ability by flaying people and stitching or stapling their skin to your own. Your regeneration connects the tissues and extends your power’s breadth and reach, but it doesn't prevent all rejection or decay, forcing you to replenish it from time to time to keep the boost. You can use this to climb buildings, break your fall, smother, and bludgeon your foes.
objects.title: (Changer) ​​Skinslip

objects.text: You have the ability to grow to enormous heights alongside an aura that alters gravity.
objects.title: (Changer/Shaker) Campanile

objects.text: You’re a self mutating changer with a focus on tracking. For example, you can fly with the help of wings and strange inflatable tumor-like growths. Make a slit appear down your face, resembling a bat's nose, aiding you in finding people with its associated super-smell. You also have enhanced hearing and superhuman vomiting abilities, able to vomit much more and much harder than any human being can. You can also shoot a loogie with the speed of a bullet and are a regenerator, capable of healing a bullet wound within seconds.
objects.title: (Changer) Barfbat

objects.text:
You have short-range telekinesis and biokinesis, your abilities are mutually reinforcing. Further in the face of a Power canceling Trump that affects one aspect of your power the other half would generally need a separate counter. Your telekinesis is a personal force field with some crude control, having a multiplicative effect on your physical strength. While also having a noticeable defensive aspect, strong enough to survive a hit from an Endbringer. 

Your physical strength is bolstered by your biokinesis, as you can make yourself into a physical Adonis, patch up your own wounds and harden tissues, accumulate calcium into stone-like plates under your skin and you can use your biokinesis to swell or shrink your features. You can return to your natural state reflexively, which drastically reduces muscle mass towards the original baseline. With practice you could reflexively dampen the damage from burns by creating heat resistant chemicals, neutralize the toxins by isolating it in the body, or increase the insulation and conductivity qualities of your flesh before electricity damage takes hold.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Browbeat

objects.text: You can swell into a flesh bubble with fast recovery/personal mutations if not ‘popped’ in time. Have some strength & size increases, but are slower while grown. You have the ability to ‘roll’ with incoming impacts, as if turning into a boulder, and can make a guttural noise to "turn off" others’ brains momentarily, interrupting their thoughts.
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Foulpig

objects.text: You have the ability to change into a form made out of metal blades.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Hookwolf

objects.text: You can temporarily add range to abilities, turning strikers into blasters. This can also affect Masters, extending their range.
objects.title: (Trump) Gunnery Anne

objects.text: You can temporarily alter other parahuman abilities, granting or removing power, range, effectiveness, and duration, with minor costs on other fronts.
objects.title: (Trump) Deva Yaga

objects.text: You can willingly decrease your own physical and mental attributes in order to increase those of people you focus on. This can also be used to double their recovery time and natural healing, as well as mental recuperation and equilibrium. It impacts your own recovery, but if you aren’t tired, the effect on you is negligible.
objects.title: (Trump) Tribute

objects.text: You are able to use globular clusters of darkness that you control in mid-air through a small link of shadow between your hand and the sphere. These globular clusters of darkness stick to targets like gum and allow you to absorb the captured target's powers.
objects.title: (Trump) Abhorror (Glob)

objects.text: You’re a Trump that can create and manipulate lines of light that connect you to the capes in the area, as well as extract a translucent blob from that diagram. Bullets shot into the blob gain the effects of the powers that the diagram connected.
objects.title: (Trump) Queen of Swords

objects.text: You can copy the general nature of powers with an output, and produces your own output in form of powerful hyper-gravity.
objects.title: (Trump) Upperhand

objects.text: You have the ability to grant "unreliable" defenses that remove power aspects of those you’re ‘protecting’, capable of countering Behemoths 'death aura’, as well as many other powers, some to the point of negating all attacks like a blasters projectiles or the whole power, but some remain unaffected like a strangers power. Your power is ranged, and only requires you to concentrate on the person you’re ‘protecting’, you can’t protect more than one individual. The targets of your power glow and feel an "energy" or "ripple" coursing through them. Your defenses don't protect against being pushed or thrown around allowing those with enhanced physical abilities to still effectively fight against 'protected' opponents. Essentially while you’re able to grant 'single-target power immunity' to others you can’t 'protect' against the laws of physics.
objects.title: (Trump) Usher

objects.text: You can copy the general nature of powers, while only mimicking aspects of said powers relating to movement and manoeuvrability, essentially copying it into a Mover-type version of the power.
objects.title: (Trump/Mover) Spright

objects.text:
By collecting pieces of animals, including humans, you gain enhancements in the form of beneficial mutations. By keeping these body parts close to you, anyone around you within fifty feet, or roughly fifteen meters, that fall within your aura are granted the same mutations at half strength. There is a transition period before the mutations take effect, which takes some getting used to. 

Examples include: Cat's eyes that grant night vision, lizard tail that grants regeneration. Human which has a doubling effect, with specific professions giving skill boosts, like a neurosurgeon’s fingers granting quicker fingers and better hand-eye coordination. While muscles give greater strength with the increase dependent on the source. Your trophies function even when dried or rotting.
objects.title: (Trump) Trophy Wife

objects.text: You can grant inhuman levels of skill with obscure objects that your subjects can use in innumerable ways as tools and weapons. However, this has a detrimental effect on the subjects' mental integrity and independence, leaving them highly suggestible.
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Bastard Son

objects.text: You have a Trump power that allows you to assume different forms based on the shard of your opponent. Each confers differing benefits based on the shard. You have a single base form.
objects.title: (Trump/Changer) Blue Bomber

objects.text:
You have a Trump power that lets you grant one out of a preset list of powers to one person at a time. 

Among the known powers that can be granted are Pyrokinesis, Invincibility, Regeneration, Flight, Super-Speed, and Super-Strength.

Each power lasts only a short duration, ranging from 30 seconds to 2 minutes. The powers that bend reality more tend to "burn out" faster in terms of duration.
objects.title: (Trump) Othala

objects.text:
You can summon four totems or "diagrams", each with a specific function. They can either be used to suppress a specific parahuman ability or to create one of four effects. You can summon them all at once but when you use one, the other three disappear. While the trump effect is suppressing another parahumans power you can’t use them for effects, the suppression effect itself is temporary, but can for example suppress master effects, flight and completely negate blaster powers. You can redraw the diagrams at will but if you have used them before they will be semi transparent, slowly fading back in until they are, back to full strength. 

You are ineffective against Case 53s. Your totems each have a different effect, one is a Javelin that can shoot blaster darts that emit a dark orange light by all caught in it. A Petard that can make circular creations with a concussive effect. A Saber that creates crescent shaped energy that can be wielded like a sword and a Trundle with a Wheel-Star creation that can move you and others a moderate distance to a predetermined location.
objects.title: (Trump) Amaymon

objects.text: You have the ability to magnify the powers of parahumans in close proximity.
objects.title: (Trump) Two

objects.text:
You set out a zone and attune it to particular functions, altering specific properties of physical phenomena or laws within a relatively small area. These functions are multifaceted in scope and reach, from messing with gravitational or temporal phenomena to dabbling in either sabotaging or neutralizing parahuman abilities by “finding the right attunement” of the cape’s connection to their powers. 
Your power gives everything in your area of effect a washed-out yellow tint, everybody in the zone only sees yellow.
objects.title: (Trump) Citrine

objects.text: You have a Trump/Shaker power which is capable of trapping people in an arena that you create, in which their powers cease to work, this extends to tinkertech too. The arena's border also partially blocks out air and light. This bubble, while highly resistant, is not completely impenetrable and can be popped through powers from outside.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Contender

objects.text: You can grant a combination of invincibility, enhanced strength, and an electric charge to other individuals with a touch. You can apply this to entire squads, making them effectively invincible and giving them strength powerful enough to qualify the recipient as a Brute, while also making them capable of electrocuting someone to death with a touch. This granted invincibility also stacks with the durability of capes that are already Brutes, but alone it is far from strong enough to survive hits from true heavy hitters.
objects.title: (Trump) Galvanate

objects.text: You have a field that nullifies other powers, as well as a brute power.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Hatchetface

objects.text: Your power works by boosting one aspect of someone's power in exchange for dropping proficiency in another, such as more power at a loss of control, or more control at a loss of range, which you’re able to choose. This has the unfortunate side effect of driving your targets homicidally insane after prolonged periods of use and they are noticeably off-kilter to those who know them. You can also change your personality into your target's 'ideal wo/man' which makes manipulating them easier. You can also see a person's abilities in high detail and what they’ve done with it. Reliable application of your power requires physical contact.
objects.title: (Trump) Ingenue

objects.text: You can share powers among a group. This power is not shared.
objects.title: (Trump) Null

objects.text: You’re a pyrokinetic with the ability to manifest purple flames from your hands. You can manually increase the intensity of the fires you create, and extinguish them at will. However, you can only extinguish fires that you can see. Your flames ignite nearby active powers, spreading across them like normal fire across oil. For example, this effect applies to Breaker forms, Shaker effects, and even Master effects. Your flames also ignore power-based invulnerability. Although the purple fires don’t chase after Thinker powers, they can blind them or be painful to perceive.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) The Pharmacist

objects.text:
You can make other people in your vicinity develop Corona Pollentias and trigger. This effect persists even through severed parts of yourself as long as you're not dead, and you may choose to selectively affect others.

(Note: If you've picked Shardless and Essence of Shard, you can even use this on yourself, since you technically aren't connected to a real shard.)
objects.title: (Trump) Flint

objects.text: You have an array of powers including superhuman reflexes, balance and coordination, enhanced aim and spatial sense, a pocket dimension you can use to deposit items in and limited pyrokinesis.
objects.title: (Stranger) Circus

objects.text: You can generate 'hard light' shells around objects and individuals, then mobilize them for a duration before they expire. These images can be made to follow a set path, turn corners, and move in whatever manner you see fit. The images break after five to ten seconds or when subjected to an impact or obstacle that would block their continued movement. You can also create images in vast quantities in order to obscure vision.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Feint

objects.text: You can manifest a fog that is capable of distracting and stupefying.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Foggy Idea

objects.text: You have a power that involves inflicting bad luck on both specific targets and in a general area. Attempts to hit you will instead hit teammates, and people will stumble and injure themselves.  You need to be able to perceive your targets in order to affect them. You have stances that help focus how you spread your power, along with keeping them in view. You affect your targets via the environment and can thus be blocked the same way. You affect a large area of effect with a lack of fine control.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Error

objects.text: You can create and control illusions, you can move and alter these images. However, when these illusions are disrupted they turn into harmless smoke. Walking through these illusions is enough to break them. Your illusions are permanent, able to function even if you are knocked out or sleeping.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Nix

objects.text: You can mold yourself into someone’s perfect person, physically and behaviorally. Your secondary power grants you enough knowledge to act the part once you’ve set a target, like how to make them fall for you, as well as what to say to hurt them.
objects.title: (Stranger/Thinker) Jewel of Boston

objects.text: You possess a 'mirror self' that travels in another world, and only has limited interactions with reality. It has to move around to gather intelligence, its passage does not disturb anything in the normal world as someone who is invisible or even intangible might. However it can not walk through walls or similar as it occupies its own mirror world that reflects wherever you are. You can shunt yourself into the mirror world, bringing your other self in from that world at the same time — producing an effect that could be mistaken for teleportation. You can control the nature of the interactions between your 'mirror self' and the world, allowing it to attack while remaining otherwise invisible and intangible, making shallow cuts and similar to targets. This ability requires concentration. The sensory input you receive from your mirror self is resistant to stranger powers.
objects.title: (Stranger) Othello

objects.text: When dying, you produce a duplicate who will enter the battlefield at a run from the edge, from 50+ feet away, and while being unobserved. The original body persists only so long as it is observed.
objects.title: (Stranger/Brute) The Man in the Corners

addons.text: You can prevent any act that will make an individual aware of your precise location, appearance, or activities. This effect extends to people, Thinker powers, cameras, and any known form of observation. More than just blanking out awareness, this ability inherently prevents anyone from even attempting to look at you. The only way to know about your location is to keep track of the radius of this anti-observational effect. Additionally, you can cause invasive horrific hallucinations, causing immediate, overwhelming, and potentially permanent psychological damage. This is a projected effect and can’t penetrate sufficient cover.
addons.title: The Stranger Titan

objects.text: You have a stranger power preventing anyone's eyes from pointing in your direction, unless an obstacle is blocking you, or their eyes are closed. Others are prevented from physically touching you, and you cannot be pointed at by fingers, weapons, cameras, or Master minions. This power is always active, and cannot be turned off without a perk allowing it to be.
objects.title: (Stranger) Blindside

objects.text: You have a stranger power that makes it impossible for anyone to willingly impede you.
objects.title: (Stranger) August Prince

objects.text:
You are incredibly hard to notice when your power is active—to the point where people forget you were even there in the first place. However, this ability comes with its limitations and downsides. Your power defaults to being on, and you must focus to keep it off. Conversely, you have enough fine control to erase only the last few moments of a conversation, allowing you to repeat it until you find the right line to use.

This power operates based on a more standard interpretation of memory, meaning inhuman memory structures remain unaffected, and the sensory aspects of some powers can work around it. Additionally, it does not affect people viewing you through cameras or video footage. While your presence is difficult to perceive, it is still possible for others to register your scent, even if they struggle to link it to you. People may also recognize your presence in more abstract ways, such as correctly identifying that a Stranger is present, even if they cannot directly perceive or remember your existence.
objects.title: (Stranger) Imp

objects.text: You have an area-of-effect power which creates increasingly protective layers that block perception powers into or out of your radius by blinding shards. This even affects subconscious ones such as Lung's transformation, and human senses. This effect is so intensive that it blocks even the strongest of Thinker powers, although it does not work across dimensional boundaries or video. Your power nullifies sensory aspects of powers within 15 feet of you and conventional senses within 5 feet. However, you can expand your range by figuring out how your power works.
objects.title: (Stranger/Trump) Mantellum

objects.text: You can encase people within semi-real illusions of monsters that are under your control. While encased in this monster form, the victim is completely unconscious for the duration. The physical form of these monsters can range widely; from large wall-crawling spiders to nightmarish tentacle creatures to lizard-like beasts with razor-sharp claws and teeth. However, these illusions are as fragile as glass and the victim will return to normal once the illusion is broken.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Psychosoma

objects.text: You can turn into an undetectable form that spews an odorless gas, causing headaches, tinnitus, watery eyes and eventually blindness, memory loss, and coma. While in this form, you can be revealed by attacks, which cause you to explode into thick green smoke.
objects.title: (Stranger) Miasma

addons.text: You have greater control of the poison you produce and the types of poison you can produce has expanded. Additionally, your poison gas has taken on the attributes of Grue’s darkness, erasing light and muting sound to name the most obvious effects, although your senses remain unhampered. You have control over the consistency of your poison gas, able to make it thick and choking fog which blinds, or even turn it liquid, although you still retain full control over the movement of said poison. This pairs well with your new ability to choose what poison you create, as any poison you have previously Tinkered up can now be produced in either liquid or gaseous form, in addition to any form of mundane poison or venom. Lastly, the speed at which you create poison is vastly increased, as is the speed at which the poison spreads, allowing you to rapidly flood entire city blocks with a thick fog of poison.
addons.title: Viper

objects.text: You can release poisonous gas that you can form into a solid shape, cover with an illusion and move at will. At best the gas will knock a person out; at worst it can cause permanent brain damage and organ failure.
objects.title: (Stranger/Shaker) Nyx

objects.text: You have the power to hear everything within a certain range of yourself regardless of volume and intervening obstacles or noises. You can also manipulate particular sounds, from absolute silence up to twice as loud, and have the ability to teleport to anywhere within earshot of a given sound by using the echoes to gradually phase out over the course of about two seconds.
objects.title: (Stranger/Mover) Leonid

objects.text: While this power is active, everyone will think that you're a nice guy. A friendly acquaintance. Even if you stab them in the guts, they wouldn't hold it against you.
objects.title: (Stranger) Nice Guy

addons.text: Your powers are scaled up, allowing you to toss whole buildings at once and drastically increasing your range.
addons.title: The Liminal Titan

objects.text: You have entered into a permanent breaker state in which your physical form has dissipated and is now composed entirely of air making you invisible. Your body's individual strength has been reduced to be akin to a barely perceptible breeze of wind, and your presence now extends over a wide area, reaching up to many miles in radius. When focusing on a specific area, you can create temporary physical self-duplicates of your body out of the air and are able to manifest enormous quantities of these duplicates at a time as well as control them. Each body is similar to a slight breeze but by combining these duplicates together into a single action, you can generate powerful physical forces, capable of lifting heavy objects and throwing individuals with ease. You are effectively omnipresent within the space that you cover, though limited to human senses.
objects.title: (Stranger) The Custodian

objects.text:
Good news, you still look human from the waist up. Bad news, you're attached to a very large spider body. Hopefully you're not arachnophobic.

You can climb walls and ceilings with your spider legs. You can also produce silk with your spinnerets and weave it, the silk is much more resistant than regular spider's silk. You gain a minor Tinker 0 power to easily weave clothes and various constructs from your silk.
objects.title: Arachne

objects.text:
All in all, you are rather unaltered… besides your limbs. Instead of human arms you have bird wings, and instead of human legs you have talons. This form does have its advantages. You gain the ability to move your talons with the same precision as normal human can move their hands, and using your wings you are able to fly as fast as an eagle.

You gain a minor T0 Mover power that boost your reaction time and spatial awareness.
objects.title: Harpy

objects.text:
Your upper body is unchanged, but your lower body is replaced with a long, serpentine form. It possesses enhanced strength, is extremely flexible, and it is fairly silent when moving.

You also gain a minor T0 Thinker power, granting you the ability feel the vibrations and movements of objects, creatures, and people around you through the ground, allowing you to "see" without using your physical eyes. You can even distinguish between the different types of stone, earth, and metal you touch.
objects.title: Lamia

addons.text: Your plant-based biology has made your own body a valid target for Shaper of Flora’s plant alteration, this allows you to directly alter the shape and properties of your body to the same extent you could tinker with plants. From increasing your body's strength and durability, growing wings made of leaves to fly, turning your saliva toxic, or even making it heal, to regenerating by absorbing plant matter, or creating complex pheromones to influence the minds of other living beings. This also allows you a great degree of shapeshifting, the only limit being that your biology remains similar to that of a plant. While this can't undo your case 53 nature, you can tinker with your body to the point that it would require inspecting your internal organs to notice you aren't human.
addons.title: Nymph

objects.text:
Thankfully, you still have a fully human frame, however you are now closer to plants than to animals. Your skin is bark, botanical epidermis or a mix of both, and you have leaves and flowers rather than hair, growing on your scalp and perhaps in other spots. Your flowers may produce fruits.

You are tougher than before, and you can photosynthesize through your epidermis and leaves, taking care of a part of any of your energy needs. Additionally, your body constantly if slowly regenerates all over, allowing lost limbs to be regained, or even your heart, which is no longer vital; however, the more it is damaged, the more sluggish you will be. Finally, you also have a Thinker 0 power allowing you to understand the needs of plants, including your own.
objects.title: Dryad

objects.text:
Choose something related to the four classical elements, such as fire, water, earth or air, even lightning, metal, or magma. You are now made of that element, forming a vague humanoid body. 

You gain some control over your element, and can even absorb it to heal to a small extent. You gain a sixth sense as to where more of your element is in relation to you.
objects.title: Elemental

objects.text:
You are big… really big. 

Your size is somewhere between double to quadruple your base size. This gives a boost to your physical abilities, matching your increased size.
objects.title: Giant

objects.text:
You gain the body of a lion and wings of an eagle, with only your head remaining the way it was before. Your strength, speed and dexterity is triple to that of an ordinary lion. Your wings allow you to fly.

You gain a T0 thinker power, focused on understanding and solving puzzles. You also gain a T0 brute power that protects you from environmental damage, so stuff such as rain or snow won’t be able to affect you as much.
objects.title: Sphinx

objects.text: Your new appearance is now that of a fantasy elf. This means being generally more beautiful than a human, having unnatural hair color, long pointed ears, a naturally lithe body, a talent for archery, and having an easier time navigating in natural environments. Your vision is also better than a human's, and you can see a bit more in dark environments. Instead of a higher lifespan, you are guaranteed not to catch any illnesses and to have a perfectly healthy body.
objects.title: Elf

objects.text: Your transformed appearance is that of a Tiefling. You now possess distinctive features, such as demonic traits like horns protruding from your head, a tail, and perhaps even otherworldly skin tones. As a Tiefling, you possess a minor pyrokinesis ability. Your eyes may gleam with an otherworldly glow, and your resilience might be heightened.
objects.title: Tiefling

objects.text:
Your whole body is now made of a transparent gelatinous substance that you can harden at will to match the toughness of human skin. This body grants you a great amount of resistance to physical damage, as you are capable of simply pulling your body back together when cut or crushed. 

You can slowly reshape your body into any shape you desire, although you still need to respect conservation of mass when doing so.

The interior of your body is acidic, dissolving anything put inside. Anything dissolved in your body counts as you eating it. Due to your unusual biology, you cannot catch diseases or otherwise get sick because of anything you have eaten.
objects.title: Slime

objects.text:
It appears that your new body resembles that of a fantasy dwarf.
Despite being 4-5 feet tall on average, you still weigh around 160 pounds; this is because your body is much denser than human, making you moderately tougher and stronger than an average human as a consequence. You're also remarkably tolerant to toxins, extreme temperatures, and sudden pressure changes. 
Your vision also surpasses that of a human, enabling you to see well in low-light conditions. 
Additionally, you have extraordinarily nimble fingers, providing you with unparalleled precision when tinkering or handling small and delicate objects.
As a final touch, you may choose to sport a magnificent beard if you lacked one before.
objects.title: Dwarf

objects.text:
You somewhat resemble humans, as you are at minimum two meters tall with green skin, a muscular physique and large tusks.

You have an instinctive sense of combat, helping you fight better and adapt on the fly.
objects.title: Orc

objects.text:
You are supernaturally beautiful and have an addition of wings capable of going 30 mph with perfect manoeuvrability.

From ethereal glowing butterfly-like wings, to the fleshy wings of a bat, you have complete control over their design. Their maximum possible length spans the base of your feet to a head above your full height. The minimum being the length of your forearms.

They have the durability of bone and benefit from any brute powers you possess. If destroyed, they will regenerate completely in a day. 

Your wings are not the actual cause of your flight, they simply provide an animation. Any flight powers you possess can optionally choose to apply this animation. This also means that should your wings be destroyed, you are still capable of flight.

You are granted a one time opportunity to change your eye colour, hair colour and height. The minimum possible height being 15cm, the maximum being 200cm. Your height has an inversely proportional effect on your flight speed, i.e. the smaller you are, the faster you are. The maximum being 300 mph. Your voice can be projected to speak at normal human levels regardless of your size.

Additional minor effects include emitting a glow around your body, with greater emphasis on your wings, eyes and hair, giving the appearance of being affected by a light breeze, adding a chorus of additional voices to your own and the ability to increase the intensity of these minor effects to a moderate degree.
objects.title: Fairy

objects.text:
You find yourself morphing into a catgirl or catboy, depending on your gender. Cat ears, a tail, and retractable claws become part of your new anatomy, with your body and organs seamlessly adjusting to this feline transformation.

Your flexibility and dexterity now mirror that of cats, while your senses align with theirs, granting you heightened perception. Moreover, you discover the ability to shift into a cat form at will.

As an unexpected perk, a subtle aura surrounds you, rendering people nonhostile. In your cat form, this aura intensifies, making others not only friendly but also sparking an irresistible desire to treat you like a regular cat, complete with pets and affectionate gestures.

However, the transformation is not without its challenges. Periodically, you may succumb to the temptation of laziness, seeking out a cozy sunny spot for leisure. Additionally, your playful side surfaces more prominently when you inhabit your cat form.
objects.title: Felid

objects.text:
Guess you got the short end of the stick, pal. 

You’ve become a goblin, a scurrying and cunning race of creatures. Traits common are small stature, big pointy ears, and greenish skin. Wait, no, you’re more than that! At least on paper. A hobgoblin is set apart from common goblins due to being the next step of goblins. That also means you’re just below average in stature, stronger, smarter, and more menacing than common goblins.

Your physical and mental abilities are enhanced and geared to misdirection, scheming, traps, commerce, and ordnance.
objects.title: Hobgoblin

objects.text:
You’ve become a koblod, a high social and cunning race of creatures. Typically, between 2 and 3 feet tall, and weighing between 25 to 35 pounds, with scaled skin, sinewy and digitigrade legs, long and clawed fingers, and a rat like tail. The more good looking your appearance, the more you lean towards "cute". Whereas the more ugly your appearance, the more animalistic you look.

You find working in groups comes naturally, darkvision (which lets you see in low light up to 60 feet away in shades of gray) and you have an aptitude for finding and planning traps/ambushes.
objects.title: Kobold

objects.text:
You're still made of flesh and blood, but your power has caused your body to take on a more sharpened appearance, with your body being either jagged and rough like a low polygon model or completely pixelated.

All damage you take is equally distributed across your entire body, meaning you no longer have any weak points.

As well as this, you have a perfect memory for every action you’ve ever taken and the capacity to re-perform said actions at one-to-one accuracy (throwing the same perfect punch over and over again, saying the exact same phrase with identical emphasis, charging one of your blaster powers to the exact same timing and shooting it, etc.).

Your power will give you small concessions towards allowing you to mimic your previous actions despite a lack of space or physical obstructions, i.e. jumping with full force despite one of your feet hanging off an edge; the ability to phase through partial obstructions to swing a sword despite not otherwise having the space to do so; etc.
objects.title: Avatar

objects.text:
Your body is made of porcelain, hollow, with a single golden heart at its center, suspended by golden wires that travel around every part of your body. The wires function as nerves, allowing you to feel and control your porcelain limbs with incredible precision. You have perfect control over your movements, with perfect precision with every part of your body. No matter what wound you suffer, you will not die as long as your heart isn't damaged. 

You possess a minor tinker power which allows you to repair your own body, although it will leave visible cracks where the damage was. With time, the cracks naturally disappear. Your body has extremely flexible joints; however, it is rigid at any other part.
objects.title: Doll

objects.text: Your new appearance is now that of an angel. This means you have anywhere from one pair to six pairs of white wings capable of slow flight, a very beautiful appearance, no matter your gender, and a golden halo above your head. You also emit a calming fragrance, making it easier to calm down violent situations, talk with people, and more.
objects.title: Angel

objects.text:
The good news is that you’re still human in shape and looks. The bad news? You’re dead. From your pallid skin, lack of body heat, and stiff movements, it’s impossible to hide that there’s something wrong with you. Disguises are a temporary measure, only misleading or delaying others about your “condition.” Even worse, the Manton Limit registers you as “inanimate”, but still organic. Overtime, you’ll begin to rot and smell like a real rotting corpse.

Being dead does come with some perks, however. Sleeping, breathing, and eating are all optional, poison fails to find a grip, pain is entirely removed, and while you are immune to the effects, disease will still fester inside your putrid flesh, and you've all but lost your sense of taste. One of your bigger problems is that you no longer have natural healing. Regeneration or healing effects from outside sources will work, but anything that relies on cellular division will be severely weakened. Luckily, you're quite good at sewing now; enough to be able to reattach body parts with a single hand and a little time. You even soak up the residual skills of the past owner of that part, relevant to what that limb was used for. Finally, you can move your body parts around as if they were still attached to you if severed by attuning to them over time. After a week or so, that part will become a normal severed limb.
objects.title: Ghoul

objects.text:
Good news!, you still Human...ish. Bad news, you are now a human-sized cockroach with a humanoid body, possessing cerci and antennae.

Standing at 2 meters tall with a dark, wood-color shining carapace and weighing 110 kg, you can run as fast and as long as an Olympic athlete, are adaptable, capable of surviving in harsh climates and your physique resembles that of a highly muscular bodybuilder.

Your body is controlled by the subesophageal ganglion located in your chest rather than your head. Due to this unique feature, you can continue to move even after decapitation, as long as the subesophageal ganglion remains intact and there is an open passage to your lungs. You are a perfect omnivore, able to consume anything with nutritional value. However, you can no longer blink.
objects.title: Roach Ergaster

objects.text: Your body has transformed dramatically. Your posture is now hunched, covered entirely in thick, coarse fur. Sharp claws have emerged from your hands, and your head has taken the shape of a powerful wolf, complete with a keen snout and sharp fangs.
