You possess the heightened senses, agility, and primal instincts of a wolf, while retaining the dexterity, and adaptability of a human.
objects.title: Werewolf

objects.text:
“It’s Morbin’ Time!”

As you look over yourself, you still look human enough, yet feel a bit out of sorts: you feel cold to the touch, a paleness to your skin much like the dead, your canines fangs, even feeling groggy or uncomfortable while daylight shines through, and the shine of your eyes glares crimson. There’s no doubt, you’ve taken the form of a vampire. 

This might have benefits such as heightened senses, increased strength, speed, and agility. The caveat largely stems from your primal instincts and desire for blood, the latter of which can temporarily nourish you and your powers.

How you look as a vampire also varies depending on your Appearance: if you’re Handsome/Beautiful, an aristocratic grace and unnaturally breathtaking beauty cling to your every move; if you’re Average, no notable traits appear aside from looking like a corpse at a glance; if you’re Hideous/Ugly, hideous traits like a more bat-like or Nosferatu look will be the bane to whatever normalcy you clinged to.
objects.title: Vampire

objects.text:
Your body has been drained of all liquids, and turned into sandy particles. This however has not killed you, you remain conscious and aware of your surroundings as if each particle of your new body is an eye for you to see through. 

This sand is also capable of basic movement, however this movement is sluggish, imprecise, and struggles with complex movement.

If any of your sandy body gets separated from the largest concentration of your mass it will become regular sand.

Luckily your new sandy physiology comes paired with a basic power armor exoskeleton specifically designed to interface with, encase, and protect your sandy body, while allowing human equivalent freedom of movement. It will also count as part of your body as far as power interactions go.

Your sandy internals, and power armor exoskeleton will slowly regenerate any damage, or lost mass as long as you live at a rate similar to a normal human’s healing factor.

You also gain a basic power armor tinker specialty allowing you to customize your exoskeleton to fit your needs. Alternatively instead of just modifying your starting power armor it is also entirely possible for you to build a new power armor exoskeleton from the ground up for further customization freedom, and just transfer your sandy internals to that new exoskeleton. With enough technological development it might be possible to make a new exoskeleton that looks completely human. 

If your current exoskeleton is destroyed beyond repair, and your sand survives then your power will over the course of a few days form a new basic power armor exoskeleton around your sand in cocoon like fashion if your sand isn’t moved to a backup exoskeleton within a few hours.
objects.title: Rubric

objects.text:
The name is rather misleading, as you can have as many of any body part as you want. Two hearts? Seventeen arms? Thirty-four legs? A hundred eyes? Totally doable. The more of any particular limb or organ you add, the stronger or more enhanced it becomes. 

For example, having ten eyes doesn’t just give you better peripheral vision—it makes each individual eye five times sharper than an average human eye. The same goes for every other body part. Add extra arms, and each arm will be exponentially stronger. Stack up hearts, and your stamina and endurance would become superhuman. You have the one time opportunity to choose how many of each part you want, so you could go for just one extra leg or transform yourself into something entirely monstrous and absurdly powerful. The only limit is how far you're willing to push the boundaries of what a body can hold.
objects.title: Many-Limbed One

objects.text: You have become a mermaid, with the lower half of your body transformed into that of a sea creature—its species is yours to decide. You possess both gills and lungs, enabling you to breathe in water and on land, though you must be careful not to use on the wrong ones. You can manipulate water that you are in direct contact with, using it to propel yourself swiftly through the depths. Your voice carries a melodic power underwater, but on land, your singing transforms into a high-pitched scream, potent enough to cause harm with prolonged exposure.
objects.title: Mermaid

objects.text:
Your resulting form has become the missing link halfway humanity and primates. The embodying legend of Big Foot, the Yeti, Wild Men, and among other cryptids all at once. You are a massive, ape-like creature. Standing between 7 to 9 feet tall, your body is covered in thick, coarse, dark hair. Your shoulders are broad, and your arms are long, extending almost to your knees, with large hands that end in thick, blunt fingers. Your face is a mix of human and ape, with a heavy brow ridge, deep-set eyes that glow faintly in the dark, a flat, wide nose, and a mouth with slightly protruding lips.

You possess an innate talent for survival and stealth, whether in the wild or any environment. Your strength allows you to easily overpower ordinary humans, with your natural power matching that of Olympic athletes.
objects.title: Sasquatch

addons.title: True Passenger
addons.text: Through integrating your ability to possess living beings into your passenger-like physiology, you have developed the ability to take a Host of your own, giving access to a limited or otherwise restricted configuration of your powers and capabilities. You can take Hosts who are already parahumans, though in that case, you form a one-person pseudo-cluster, giving them a secondary power which must be weaker than their primary power. Alternatively, you can give a parahuman more control over their powers by leveraging your crystalline supercomputer-like physiology; you cannot enhance their control and give them a secondary power at the same time. This is effective enough to give Damsel of Distress the same level of control as Bonesaw’s modifications gave her. Even in the worst case, you can give someone the ability to turn off their power. You cannot, however, bestow Hitchhike to your Host, and without any other powers, you can only give minor to moderate Brute/Thinker ratings.

objects.text: Your form is highly reminiscent of that of a shard, only extremely limited and far smaller. You are a crystalline supercomputer, with specific pathways and patterns focused on whatever powers you currently have. You can choose how big you will be, from at minimum human sized to at maximum the size of a building, with the bigger you are the stronger and more control you will have over your powers. You are able to absorb most forms of energy to sustain yourself. Your exact appearance is based off your shard.
objects.title: Passenger

addons.text:
Thanks to your Tinker speciality, you are able to customise, refine, and repair your body. 

Beyond this, you gain the ability to integrate medieval technology into your form, treating it as an extension of yourself. You can extend your sense of self to nearby devices, allowing you to control them as if they were part of your body, provided they are within reach of your awareness and consistent with your nature.

Siege weapons, mechanical contraptions, armor components, and other medieval devices can be connected to your presence and controlled as naturally as your limbs. The complexity and size of the object influence how easily it can be controlled. Larger and more intricate devices place increasing strain on your mind and coordination. However, items you construct personally through your Tinker skill integrate more seamlessly and exert far less mental load. You cannot extend your control to anything beyond the scope of medieval technology as defined by your Tinker ability; more advanced or unfamiliar mechanisms remain inert to your influence.

You may continue expanding your form, adding layers of weapons and armor, potentially assembling yourself into a towering golem of interlocked armours and weapons. You can even bind yourself to full siege engines, such as catapults or battering rams, and use them as your body—moving, aiming, and firing them as easily as lifting a hand.
addons.title: Medieval Siege

objects.text:
You are a sentient, living piece of armor, fully aware and imbued with life. You can choose your form—whether the imposing plate of a medieval knight, the elegant curves of samurai armor, or the disciplined structure of a Roman soldier’s lorica segmentata. The only requirement is that your form provides nearly full-body coverage. This can optionally also come with weapons.

This comes with advantages: you possess the inherent durability of armor, able to withstand significant damage. Additionally, you’re free from the frailties of a flesh-and-blood body. As long as your structure isn’t utterly destroyed, you can endure and persist through remarkable challenges. You can regenerate, no faster than an average human but it’s still good enough to patch minor scratches with ease. Lastly, you have minor telekinesis limited to your body parts, meaning in theory you can split apart and have each part attack independently, although you don’t have the multitasking to do this well.
objects.title: Living Armour

objects.text:
You have the head, tail and optionally, the legs of a bull. You possess peak human strength, durability and endurance, and your height is at least 1.8 meters tall. When charging at something or someone, your physical capabilities are temporarily boosted.

In addition, you also have a sixth sense for direction and an instinctive ability to navigate underground tunnels or labyrinths.
objects.title: Minotaur

objects.text:
You’ve been turned into some kind of artificial life form. Whether an Android/Gynoid, Robot, Biomorph, Artificial Life Form, or Construct. 

This opens the artificial life section in the character section.
objects.title: Robotkin

objects.text:
Your body has become made from a crystalline material, stronger than steel. While this fundamentally makes you quite difficult to harm, you’re also in the form of a scorpion. 9ft from head to tail you stand roughly 5ft in height, not counting the stinger that rises a further 2ft above you. 

Your body conducts electricity extremely well, having an additional organ to store it in in your core. This core also houses both of your Coronas while your actual mind is simulated by your Shard. When electricity passes through you, you can store it within your core, releasing it from your tail’s ‘sting’. Additionally, great amounts of electricity can heal fractures and breaks in your new crystalline body.
objects.title: Crystal Scorpion

addons.text: Your gem has become a perfect cut, the absolutely pinnacle of gem-kind. Your physical capabilities allow you to throw down with most Brutes and vastly outpace anyone who lacks a solid Mover rating. Additionally, your shapeshifting is vastly easier, becoming intuitive to use.
addons.title: Perfect Cut

addons.text: Your gem is no ordinary crystal, but rather a tiny piece of Shard flesh. As the material your gem is made from is technically alive, it passively repairs itself and you are capable of expending energy to vastly accelerate that repair, increasing your survivability. Your ability to absorb most forms of energy removes your reliance on food to gather energy. Lastly, for the purposes of Passenger you always count as if you were at least building sized, greatly increasing your strength and control of your powers.
addons.title: Sliver

addons.text: Your ability to program your own mind and your ability to condense parts of your mind into crystals have combined with your own crystal nature to allow you to reproduce, albeit in your own way. You are capable of programming a personality and mind and condensing it into a crystal, which can then be planted into the ground. From there, the crystal will absorb the minerals, energy, and life in the nearby ground until it is ready, at which point it transforms into a proper Gem and leaves the ground. Be warned however that this can have negative effects on the environment and can only be used so many times in a single area before it runs out of resources to absorb. While Gems you create come programmed with a mind and personality, you can allow them to grow beyond their default state should you desire so. Additionally, should you possess Sliver then you can selectively share weakened versions of your powers with Gems you create during the process of creation, although once a Gem is formed you can’t change what powers they have.
addons.title: Progenitor

addons.text: You have gained a small pocket dimension attached to your Gem which you can use to store and retrieve items. While it initially only has a few cubic meters worth of storage space, with time the space available to you expands, allowing you to eventually store entire warehouses worth of items and equipment. Should you possess Progenitor then Gems you create also come with the ability to form their own pocket dimensions.
addons.title: Pocket

addons.text: Through your ability to replicate objects, you have gained the ability to project a personalized weapon made from the same hard-light as your body. This weapon is separate from the normal limits of Handmade, but comes with its own limits instead. Your weapon can be any non-Tinkertech handheld weapon or even tool, however once created it is unable to change its form, so once it’s form is decided it’s going to stay that way. Should you possess Sliver then your weapon becomes capable of channeling your powers, such as a sword channeling Striker powers or a gun or staff firing stronger versions of your Blaster powers. Should you possess Progenitor then Gems you create also come with the ability to form their personal weapon.
addons.title: Personal Weapon

addons.text: Your increased efficiency with condensing knowledge and your ability to download information from other living beings have combined with your ability to upload minds into crystals to become Gems and have been taken to their logical extreme. You are capable of downloading a person's entire mind and uploading it into a crystal, allowing the person to undergo rebirth and become a Gem like you once the crystal finishes gestating. However, the process of downloading the mind is intensive and thorough enough that it destroys the brain of the person in question, preventing you from simply cloning someone over and over again. If the person being reborn is a parahuman, they retain whatever powers they possess before being reborn, in addition to whatever powers they gain as a Gem. If you have Perfect Cut, Sliver, Pocket, or Personal Weapon then reborn Gems gain the benefits of those addons.
addons.title: Rebirth

addons.text: Your crystal core now possesses the ability to emulate a crystal you have previously touched, allowing you to access the powers it would provide without having to have said crystal on hand. While you can only emulate one crystal at a time, the power provided is actually stronger than normal. You can switch what crystal you are emulating from memory with a few seconds of focus, although if you have an example on hand you can switch to it instantly. When a crystal is being emulated your Gem takes on the appearance of said crystal and your default body also develops some minor aesthetic changes that reflect the aesthetics of the emulated crystal. If you have Sliver then not only is the saved power much stronger but you also gain the ability to use up to 6 power expressions of the same crystal at once, for example a Ruby could provide not just pyrokinesis but also a sizable enhancement to physical capabilities. Perfect Cut provides a similar and stacking boost to the strength of power expressions, but does not include the ability to have multiple expressions. If you have Progenitor then when you create a Gem you can have it be templated off of a crystal you have on hand or are currently emulating, with the Gem gaining the matching power expression. If you have Sliver then created Gems can express up to 3 power expressions at once, although they cannot swap what crystal they are emulating.
addons.title: Living Earth

objects.text:
Your body has become that of a Gem. What most see as your physical form is in fact a hard-light projection sourced from your core, a gem-like crystal embedded somewhere on the surface of your body.

This comes with three major benefits. First, as your body is a hard-light projection you are capable of shapeshifting, capable of assuming just about any form given time and practice. Secondly, you gain a decent Brute and Mover rating as your hard-light is capable of greater physical exertion. Lastly, as it is just hard-light, should your projected body be subject to lethal harm it will simply dispel, leaving behind your gem, and as long as your gem remains intact you may simply reform your body. 

However, when you lack a physical form you also lack all forms of sensory input and the repeated dispelling and recreation of your body can induce fatigue, making it harder to reform your body. Furthermore, damage to your gem disrupts your ability to maintain a consistent physical form, leading to uncontrollable and detrimental body changes, and should your gem shatter entirely you will perish.

Lastly, as an inorganic being you no longer require most forms of sustenance such as oxygen or water, surviving solely through energy you gather through converting food you consume directly into energy.
objects.title: Gem

addons.text: Every movement you make has an inhuman element to it, from bending your fingers backwards to grab something, to robotically smooth yet jittery motion. These movements amplify your ability to induce fear, some might even be driven to terror simply from observing you. Thinkers will have a harder time predicting your immediate actions, causing rapid onset headaches in a large number of those that try.
addons.title: Uncanny Movements

objects.text: You look… strange. There’s something off about you, your proportions are out of shape, you don’t move as any living thing is supposed to, or you act in such shape that will send a shiver down someone’s spine by your presence, eliciting alienation or discomfort... with your frame of mind changed, making it worse. On its own, you’ll look seemingly human, yet your face/body/behavior will be unsettling to anyone, feeling you’re out of place or not fundamentally human and perturbing state of mind. Your physical abilities, more so your agility, speed, and stealth are increased, finding it easier to find places to hide; you also have an intuition of how to induce fear and disquiet in people, but that’s neither here nor there. You additionally gain a minor shapeshifting to your shape your form in subtle, small, to middling ways, limited only intuitively geared to fear factor or uncanniness. Bundled with other mutations, turns your mutation into something utterly alien, more than you already were, adding terrifying traits they couldn’t possibly possess, for example, adding more pronounced avian traits to Harpy’s face to accentuate the mutation’s divergence from the human form. This also adds certain instincts and proclivities from the mutation’s sources, like animalistic instincts and urges nudging your mindset and personality, hampering your functioning or understanding of society. While the undertone of fear remains, your Appearance also changes the noticeable feeling that others experience, like awe if Handsome/Beautiful, to revulsion/dread if Ugly/Scarred.
objects.title: Uncanny

addons.text:
Instead of a gem embedded on the surface of your body, your skull is a quartz-like crystal. This dramatically increases your survivability, as you can project hard-light flesh and skin covering over your skull, shielding it from harm.

You also regain your senses as you can form hard light sensory organs, as well as maintain sight and hearing even when not doing so.

Your hard light merges with the rest of your bones, allowing you to instantly reform them when they break, removing the need to replace them if they are lost.

As long as a piece of your skill the size of a pinky knuckle bone remains intact, you will be able to recover gradually.

**If you have Rebirth or Progenitor, your gems will also benefit from this**
addons.title: Crystal Skull

addons.text:
Your ability to not only control your own bones but grow and shape them has allowed you to circumvent some of your limitations and transformed you into a new form. 

You passively grow an extra layer of bone armor over your skeletal form, shielding your more vulnerable parts from the world. While the formation of bone armor is automatic, with a bit of effort you can choose not to if you so desire.

You can rapidly “regenerate” any lost bones by making what bones remain grow to replace the lost pieces. Additionally, the powers amplifying the durability of your bones have compounded, resulting in your bones being tougher than all but the strongest terrestrial metals.
addons.title: Bone Knight

objects.text:
You are an animated skeleton, appearing like a human skeleton with light blue flames in your eye sockets instead of eyes.

As a skeleton, you no longer require things like sleep, air, or food. You also no longer feel pain as you don't have pain receptors; despite the lack of sensory organs, you retain your sight, hearing, and a dulled sense of touch, though taste and smell are lost entirely. 

Your bones have the strength and durability of pure iron and will slowly regenerate stronger if broken; if you lose bones entirely, you have to replace them with locally sourced bones as you cannot regenerate new bones(if you have regeneration that allows regeneration of lost limbs this limitation is lost), you cannot replace your skull. 

Your skull is your sole weak point, and you will die if it is destroyed.
objects.title: Skeleton

objects.text:
You are now a kitsune, a mischievous humanoid fox spirit (even if you are not actually a spirit). You now feature a pair of fox ears and fluffy tails, which are golden by default, but you can choose a different color, as well as subtle fox-like features that blend naturally with your human form. While normal kitsune gain tails as they grow older, you start with all nine. You can also elongate your nails into a set of very sharp claws.

You have enhanced agility with an uncanny grace in movement, as well as heightened senses. You now have keen hearing, sharp eyesight, and an acute sense of smell, allowing you to detect hidden details and subtle shifts in the environment. You can also freely change between your humanoid kitsune form, and a full fox form.
objects.title: Kitsune

objects.text:
You have become a Voidbourne, a species born from within reality's fractures–the void that occupies the "space" between planets. Your body no longer fears the void of space, as you are its child. You can travel through the vacuum of space without any additional protection, unaffected by the lack of air, crushing pressure differences, the killing cold, the radiation from the stars.

Your skin resembles a living night sky–an endless black-blue sheen scattered with stars and drifting nebulae–and your eyes resemble miniature suns. Unlike your exterior appearance, your insides are fairly mundane, with a biology somewhat similar to humans, but as if humans had taken the next evolutionary step: you have secondary organs alongside your vital ones, ensuring you can survive even if you lose one set. All of your organs are also more efficient, as they were designed for survival.

You possess a unique form of "flight" that is bound to the vacuum of space. You cannot fly on planets or in atmosphere; your propulsion only functions in the void, and briefly during entry and departure–enough to guide your trajectory, stabilize your descent or ascent, and correct your approach. Once you are truly within an atmosphere, your flight fades, leaving you grounded like anyone else.

In addition, you have an affinity for anything related to space, distance, and dimensions. You can sense spatial distortions, notice when something "doesn't fit" in the geometry of an area, and intuitively understand routes and angles in three dimensions. With effort, you can exert minor influence over space you are in direct "contact" with, such as subtle adjustments to orientation, momentum, and positioning rather than true teleportation. This is useful for fine control in the void of space and for navigating breaches, folds, and other dimensional anomalies when you come into contact with them.
objects.title: Voidbourne

addons.text:
You are a true Wizard, with the skill to prove it. As such, you’re able to substitute your ‘mist’ in extremis to make up your charges. 

At any point, you can cause all of your mist to recede into your body, allowing you to fill a maximum of three charges from it by absorbing all of it (or fully filling your charges with Archmagus). 

However, doing so is irreversible, and you will need to produce more mist over time to replenish what was lost, usually by eating more to compensate for its recreation.
addons.title: A Real Wizard

addons.text: You’re able to dispense the writing of your cards onto your mist rather than actually having to do the apprentice-work of writing them down! While this does not make your cantrips more powerful natively, it does allow you to produce them much faster, simply generating ink onto the page. This would allow you to test theories on your formulas, and never be without a cantrip. Unfortunately, as they are generated from your mist, if you wanted to record a new cantrip then you would need to write down the formula as usual.
addons.title: That’s Apprentice Work!

addons.text:
You are able to absorb your ‘mist’ with your Scepter. However, as truly programmable matter, absorbing it into your scepter allows it to be used to enhance the other ‘slots’ while it is inside. 

Placing it into a Weak slot will in turn enhance the current ‘strong’ slot, making it half-over more powerful than it was, while placing it into the ‘Stong’ slot itself would enhance everything in the ‘weak’ slot below it similarly.

Additionally, were you to fill multiple ‘weak’ slots with absorbed mist, you can repeat this enhancement up to six times, one for each ‘weak’ slot. In turn sacrificing the various options available to you for raw power.
addons.title: What is a Wizard Without a Staff!

objects.text: Your face and upper body become a smooth black mass fused to the inside of a hooded cloak-like second skin that hangs loosely over your form. The only features breaking up the darkness are bioluminescent markings mimicking eyes, a mouth, or both. In actuality the entirety of your upper body senses light like an eye, and you feed through an aperture on the inside of your “hood,” below your “face.” You exude trace quantities of a translucent mist-like programmable matter that will respond to your thoughts. This mist is highly efficient at storing energy, which allows it to either draw energy out of what it touches to rapidly chill it or release energy to rapidly heat it up to the point of starting fires. It can also build up static to release an electric shock capable of jump-starting machinery or stopping a heart. The mist can refract light to change color allowing for the creation of illusory objects that can even hold up to tactile examination, though larger illusions will be more fragile due to the mist being spread out and at large scales they will become translucent. It can also simply be used to push with the strength of a strong wind (but significantly more control), allowing you to move small objects with your mind or throw off a person’s balance. Other tricks are likely possible with some scientific know-how, though nothing very large in scale. You do not have any secondary Thinker abilities relating to the usage of your mist or to multitasking using it while performing other tasks. Using the mist is attention-consuming, but you can reach the point of it being second nature through practice. Your diet will change to involve large quantities of strange chemicals and energy-dense substances that are not edible to humans, to support the production of your mist.
objects.title: Wizard

objects.text:
Your body is highly armoured, more akin to a beetle or other chitinous insect than a human. More attractive variants of this could look like natural knights, while the disfigured would truly emphasise the mandibles, joints, and other insectoid elements. 

Additionally to this armour, you have a pair of compact gossamer wings that allow you to take flight for a limited time. Additionally, as your body is not constructed like humans, it’s largely fluid internally, allowing you to sustain great damage and still regrow limbs (though rather slowly).
objects.title: Chitinous

objects.text:
Rather than having anything recognizable as normal biology, your physical form becomes a bubble of non-euclidean escher-like space occupied by countless different doors constantly shifting around one another. By default the only things you are able to do are drift across the ground at the speed you can walk and open or close the doors inside you. You don’t even inherently possess any senses.

Inside each door is something completely random; giant sensory organs that will give you ways of perceiving the world, jets of water, tentacles you can control to manipulate objects, wild animals (including alien ones), boxing gloves on springs capable of sending low to mid level brutes flying, portals into deep space, basically anything an entity has access to. As the scale of the effect in question increases the probability of there being a door with it drops sharply, so getting something on the scale of the Triumvirate or Endbringers would be like winning the lottery and getting something on the scale of an entity is literally astronomically unlikely.

You have no control over what comes out of a door and don’t know what is in each one. The doors will tend to produce effects that are at least somewhat helpful to you in the moment, but not necessarily what you want to happen.
objects.title: Hall of Doors

objects.text: Should you not be satisfied with the other selections, feel free to create your own mutation, building it to fit whatever concept you have in mind. This option allows you to create a custom altered form, choosing the overall theme (animalistic, mythic, alien, elemental, mechanical, etc.), the visible traits (limbs, size, skin/fur/scales, sensory organs, etc.), and the core perks your body grants (such as enhanced durability, ability to surivive in vacuum, ability to breath underwater, better aim, better balance, etc).
objects.title: Custom Mutation

rows.title: Lucky Mutations
rows.titleText: These Case 53 mutations come with their own minor powers in addition to the others you select. Your choice in the appearance section influences what you will look like as outlined in the Case 53 description. If some of the options specify a partially human appearance, such as Arachne or Dryad, you can choose to alter it to suit your preferences if you prefer something more alien or exotic. Further alterations are also possible with the Power Tweak perk.

rows.title: Tier 2 Powers
rows.titleText: These powers are powerful enough to give you a fighting chance against an Endbringer, mano a mano.

addons.text: You are no longer limited in growth, however powers become exponentially harder to grow the stronger they are.
addons.title: Unlimited Power

addons.text: The villainous tasks will appear in the form of quests and grant you rewards and penalties through the system.
addons.title: Villain System

addons.text:
Thanks to being able to absorb zero-point energy into its own reserves, it is possible to level up your abilities beyond what you were previously capable of.

It is also possible through [Calculation] to turn zero-point energy directly into experience points. Experience points gained this way will require a decent amount of zero-point energy. Your shard may also begin experiencing diminishing returns on the amount of experience points gained if you use this method too much in a given time frame. Negentropy removes this restriction.
addons.title: Over Leveling

addons.text:
You now gain a secondary system all based on the employees you have under you. This system will take track of everything that makes them suited to work under you and will provide the best tool's for you to make them better, whether it’s auto-generated video lessons to help a struggling employee overcome a weakness, food and drinks that boost physical or mental performance, or subtle behind-the-scenes adjustments that make operations run more smoothly—this system ensures your workforce thrives.

The benefits don’t stop at productivity. You gain access to the full potential of your employees' abilities. In need of a skill like [Coding] or [Law], you can temporarily borrow their proficiency. You can also passively absorb a portion of their [EXP], whether it's from skill progression or level-ups—if your system includes such mechanics.

If an employee is loyal enough to offer their life for you—whether due to genuine devotion, manipulation, or other reasons—they become something lesser: a unit that will carry out any command without hesitation, questioning only for the betterment about completing the objective.
addons.title: [Insert Place] Development System Aid!

objects.text:
Your Shard grants you access to a game-like system to manage your power(s). By default, you have access to a basic system which includes attributes and the ability to grow by gaining experience. You gain experience by completing quests or defeating enemies (does not need to involve killing them) and can increase your attributes by training. How the system works in details depends on the Shard, two people with this power can have systems that work differently.

All other powers you select interface through this one and unlock their ability to grow. As you use them, your powers will grow in strength and will unlock new aspects.

Your growth potential is not unlimited, however. Your Shard can only support a certain amount of total progression. This limit will be communicated to you.
objects.title: (Trump) Gamer System

objects.text: You can create and shape magnetic fields within a 100-meter range, field formation is instantaneous, powerful, and extremely precise. You are limited only by your concentration, focus, ingenuity, materials at hand, and the space available within your range. This can be used for applications such as manipulating, compressing, and launching metal, or anything else you can get to work through magnetic field interactions. This comes with a passive defensive shield that will protect you fully from shockwaves, and deflect magnetic attacks such as metals, electricity, or plasma.
objects.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Magnets, Son! How do they work?

objects.text: You can not be harmed, arrested, detained, captured, imprisoned, or otherwise obstructed by any non-powered persons or non-sapient beings. Immediately before making such an attempt, they will decide to spend the next hour zealously trying to kill their compatriots and then themselves.
objects.title: (Master/Stranger) If Anything Were To Happen…

addons.text:
Your body constantly refines itself for maximum efficiency, strength, and resilience. Every action—whether sprinting, lifting, or fighting—triggers precise adaptations. Sprinting increases speed, weightlifting enhances endurance, and combat sharpens movement and reaction time. Your body eliminates inefficiencies, ensuring that every gain improves overall performance.

You also adapt to external threats. If something nearly kills you, your body ensures it won’t happen again by reinforcing itself against similar dangers. Heat, force, and trauma trigger permanent resistance. Your muscles continuously harden and densify, making you stronger and more durable over time. With enough training and survival experience, your body becomes nearly indestructible.
addons.title: Muscle Baby

objects.text: As you train, your body adapts. While you will always look human, you no longer have a glass ceiling stopping you from becoming stronger. As long as your training is strenuous, you will always get stronger. The training has to be enough to make you sweat, and your muscles need to hurt at least a little from lactic acid build-up. Fighting will get you significantly more gains than just training.
objects.title: (Brute) Unlimited Potential

addons.text: Your virtual Ancient Shard and your current Shard-like physiology have now merged into a single, cohesive entity. You are now more akin to a bud, although purposely limited. While you now have no actual size limit, two soft limitations exist. First, the bigger you are, the more energy is required to sustain you and perform any meaningful action, with the amount needed increasing exponentially. Second, expanding your size can complicate daily interactions and tasks, making normal life cumbersome. This however is not all drawbacks, as you now have a better time replicating powers, with those on the level of “The Fragile One” being entirely within your capability. You also now come inbuilt with the ability to project an Avatar if you ever feel the need to do so.
addons.title: Shard Bud

addons.text: Your ability to replicate natural phenomena through understanding meshes well with your abilities as a Shard. Your ability to sense the various wavelengths at work allows you to better comprehend any physical phenomena you observe, while your ability to influence the physical world through understanding makes the creation of powers based on your knowledge and understanding incredibly intuitive. All of these benefits are exponentially greater in strength should you possess Natural Way, such that you can understand all but the most complex of powers with but a single glance and replicate them with little effort.
addons.title: [Comprehension]

addons.text: Your mastery over bio-crystalline flesh and the creation of living beings from it allows you to circumvent your size limitations to a certain extent in a very unique way by unlocking the secret to [Budding], the creation of new Shards from the [DATA] and flesh of existing ones. At will, you can create a virtual Bud of your Shard self, creating another virtual Shard based on the configuration your Shard self was in when it Budded. This virtual Shard can then be assigned to someone, whether that be yourself or someone else, allowing them to use whatever powers it is configured for. Be wary, however, as the act of Budding is very energy-consuming. These virtual Shards have their own separate energy reserves to fuel the abilities they supply, which must be managed; otherwise, they die, although you can supply energy from your reserves to them and vice versa. Be wary that you can easily drain your Shard’s reserves by creating too many Buds quickly without proper energy generation, although Negentropy negates this risk. If you possess Shard Bud, then you can take this one step further and use Maker of the End to create actual Shard flesh from your body, rendering your virtual Buds true primitive Shards in full. This also circumvents your need to worry about creating too many Buds, as your Shard isn’t simulating virtual Shards but actually creating new ones. Create enough Shards, and you might as well be a primitive Entity, with a network of Shards and powers at your disposal.
addons.title: [Budding]

addons.text:
Powers you create are no longer limited in strength or scope, allowing the results of your simulations to rival The Triumvirate; with enough time and creativity, you might even be able to take down an Endbringer on your own. What's more, any powers you create also benefit from the jail-breaking properties of Cronus.

Your Brute enhancements are likewise magnified, making you stronger and tougher than most other Titans.
addons.title: The Primordial Titan

objects.text:
Your power grants you all the abilities and attributes of an ancient Shard, the ancestors of modern Entities, from before they merged into the first Entities and left their homeworld. You are not actually an ancient Shard; you continue to be whatever species you are naturally, with these abilities and attributes merely being an emulation created by your power.

The abilities this emulation grants you include innate mid-tier brute strength, regen, and durability, the ability to travel to nearby dimensions that aren’t blocked, the ability to safely absorb large quantities of “basic” energies like heat, radiation, and electricity that you can store and release at a later time at a nearly 1 to 1 ratio with only minor energy loss, the ability to see various basic wavelengths for miles in all directions including into nearby dimensions that aren’t blocked, the ability to quickly mentally process and store large quantities of information, the ability to sense and manipulate space-time by a limited degree in a small area around you, and the ability consume and breakdown nearly any type of basic matter for fuel.

You may also study the abilities and attributes of other creatures, including parahumans, and, through these studies, replicate those abilities and attributes with your own power for personal use. Though, because of the complexity of modern shards and the protections their abilities have against being understood by the unauthorized, you’ll struggle to produce abilities this way that are more complex or powerful than those that “The Fragile One” possesses, except for basic abilities like heat manipulation that can be considered extensions or evolutions of capabilities you started with.

This replication and copying ability is accomplished by mentally manipulating the false biology of a simulation your power provides of the ancient Shard your power is emulating to accurately represent an ancient Shard with those abilities.

All the abilities and attributes this power grants are accurately represented in the simulation of the ancient shard this power is emulating. You can manipulate the simulation to a large and precise degree, which accurately affects all the abilities your power grants based on the simulation. All alterations to the simulation must be biologically possible for a Shard, with your power providing a pseudo-thinker power to understand ancient Shard biology.

The simulation also has a total size limit equal to only that of an average modern shard, so you can’t just keep growing and adding to your simulated shard to have all your abilities derived from the simulation at full power and maximum capabilities. At the same time, you will eventually have to make sacrifices and compromises in your various “builds” of the simulation.

Your true body acts as the equivalent of an Entity avatar in the simulation your shard is emulating. If you develop the right capabilities in the simulation, you'll be able to do anything to your body that an Entity can do to their avatars.

You must fuel all of these abilities yourself, with running out of energy being fatal for you. You start full of energy and can store as much energy as your actual Shard has the storage capacity for.

With just this power, you do not start with FTL or space travel capabilities, the ability to communicate with modern Shards, or the ability to have hosts of your own, though you may eventually develop such abilities with the right alterations to the simulation.

If you have taken the negentropy perk, the way it manifests for this power is a bit unique. Instead of just eliminating your need to worry about your energy reserves, it provides you with a modest passive energy generation rate for your fuel reserves, rapid enough to bring you from an empty tank to full in thirty minutes. Running out of energy will also no longer be fatal; it will merely knock you unconscious for a few minutes.
objects.title: (Trump/Breaker) Emulation of an Alien Caveman

objects.text: Titans are Parahumans who have undergone a 'broken' Second Trigger, which results in their shard taking full agency over their body. You have dodged losing control of your body, but have still gained the ability to transform into a state where your Shard is dominant and all of your powers lose their limits. Any powers you take are buffed to be at around the level an Endbringer might be, and you have access to the full breadth of your shard. All Titans also have massively increased durability.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Cronus

addons.text: Your insides’ dimensional layering melds with your Endbringer body, causing reinforcing layers to appear the closer an attack gets to your core. It works by compressing and compacting multiple layers, more durable and dense than the previous one, in proportion to your core’s proximity, to such an extent that any attack that isn’t All-or-Nothing will find it nigh-impossible even to reach your core.
addons.title: Tártaros

addons.text:
In an attempt to fix the connection between you and it, your shard has, predictably, made things worse. Your body and core are no longer composed of Endbringer flesh, but rather the same bio-crystalline material that serves as the source of parahuman power: Shard-matter. This further boosts all of your powers by 25% and reduces all damage you take from non-esoteric sources. 

Finally, due to being made of shard-flesh, you are highly resistant to the unwanted Master, Stranger, Thinker, and Trump parahuman powers. If your powers are Shardless or you possess the Esoteric Knowledge perk, this resistance also applies to non-shard powers that would fall under the same classifications.
addons.title: Autochthon

objects.text:
While your appearance is still human, your body is that of an Endbringer—something that was never human, lacking all conventional organs. While it can flawlessly imitate any function of the human body—being considered “alive” for the purposes of the Manton Effect—its ultimately inhuman nature renders you immune to powers that target humans, such as those belonging to Regent or Imp.

Your body is extremely dense and composed of layers of increasingly durable flesh wrapped around a central core. This gives you incredible strength, durability, and speed. Any injuries dealt to you will leak a black ichor but will eventually regenerate flawlessly—so long as your core remains intact. If your core is destroyed, you will die.

Like an Endbringer, you cannot be easily predicted by most Thinker powers, with you being a total blind spot to precognitive abilities like those possessed by Contessa. You lack a power on the same scale as that of the Endbringers, instead any other powers you might possess are 25% stronger.
objects.title: (Brute) Typhon

objects.text:
With each purchase here, you gain your own personal Endbringer changer form. Your form’s appearances and abilities can be left to chance or alternatively you can use the available customization section to decide your forms powers and overall appearance. You can intuitively control your Endbringer forms with as much natural ease you do your own body.

All forms you gain via this power will be of at least comparable strength and capabilities of the canon Endbringers. While you can use your non-Endbringer powers in this form, your Endbringer powers can only be used while in the associated Endbringer form. When your Shard runs out of power, you’ll find yourself stuck in whichever form you were in at the time.
objects.title: (Changer) The End-Becomer

objects.text:
With each purchase here, you gain control of your own personal Endbringer. Your Endbringers will be loyal and obedient, able to follow any directions you give them—which can be communicated by your voice, mind or even another method—as long as they are capable of completing the task.

You can choose the intelligence level of your Endbringers, whether that is something alien, computer-like, human-level, animal-level, simply a puppet you have to direct, or something else entirely.

Your Endbringer’s appearance and/or abilities can be left to chance, or alternatively, you can use the available customization section to decide their powers and overall appearance.

All Endbringers you gain via this power will be of at least comparable strength to the canon Endbringers.
objects.title: (Master) Bringer of the End

objects.text: You have the ability to create Tinkertech versions of the city-destroying kaiju known as the Endbringers. Each Mecha-Kaiju has an inbuilt Artificial Intelligence (AI), Ablative Armor, self-repair mechanisms, a Power Replication System (PRS), and the same basic physical capabilities as the average Endbringer, at a minimum. Your machines can be controlled either from within as their pilot or remotely from outside. The inbuilt AI handles the minutiae of controlling specific systems, while you provide overall direction and goals. You can assign various Mecha-Kaiju to others for control, but their loyalty will ultimately lie with you as their creator. The Ablative Armor is composed of a unique material layered and compressed into a hyper-dense final form, allowing your creation to survive damage comparable to that of any of the canon Endbringers. The Self-Repair Mechanism will restore all but the most severe damage within 24 hours, provided resources are available. The greatest weapon of your mechanical creation is the PRS, which can analyze any singular power, develop it to the scale of an Endbringer, and deploy it as the primary armament of your device. Each Mecha-Kaiju can operate only one PRS-emulated power at full capacity—or multiple at reduced capacity—and it takes at least 24 hours for a PRS to change the powers it is emulating. The greatest weaknesses of your machine are its core and the time required for construction. Its core is a combination of a central processing system and power supply, and if damaged or destroyed, your mech will be rendered inoperable until you repair or replace the components. The construction time for each Mecha-Kaiju can range from one to three months, depending on material accessibility and available resources.
objects.title: (Tinker) Mecha-Kaiju

objects.text:
You can create a large number of inviolable forcefields, your only limit is visualization and concentration. You must be able to keep track of all the forcefields you create, a multitasking power greatly increases the number you can manage at once. 

Each individual forcefield can be at most 400 square meters in surface and 10 centimeters thick, multiple fields can interlock to form a larger one. You can control the permeability at will. Nothing short of Sting can penetrate these. The edges of these forcefields are sharper than anything any Tinker has ever made, unless you intentionally smooth them out.
objects.title: (Shaker) Inviolable

objects.text:
This power is the conceptual mirror to Eidolon, while he can have three strong powers, you can have 20-30 weak powers.

You have a total of 75 points to allocate to your powers. A single power cannot exceed 5 points. A power's point worth is roughly proportional to its potency which is roughly equal to it's rating plus one ('Thinker 0' costs 1 point, 'Blaster 4' costs 5 points, etc.). Powers with hybrid rating ('Mover/Stranger 3' or 'Mover 3, Stranger 1') tend to be rated higher than simple abilities but less than the sum of their parts. You cannot summon duplicate powers or powers too close to an existing power. Tinker and Trump powers have their own, stricter, summoning rules (left to the author).

It takes up to 90 seconds to summon a power and decreases exponentially for weaker powers. If a power is invalid (too powerful) the summon will fail once it reaches the maximum time. You can recall previously summoned powers for a fraction of the initial time and a multitasking power allows you to recall multiple at once. You can dismiss any power instantly. All effects dependent on those powers will stop when the ability is dismissed but lingering or permanent effects remain (like Tinkertech or body-alterations).

You're a precognitive blindspot to everyone but the entity. Negentropy increases your point capacity to 125 and maximum points per power to 7.
objects.title: (Trump) Aliena

objects.text:
You have Eidolon's powerset. This lets you have 3 strong powers at a time, though you can instead exchange strong powers for 2-3 weaker ones each. You need to either be actively using the powers, or trying to keep hold of them, otherwise they will fade shortly after reaching full power.

This power will take into account your desires but it ultimately decides what powers you get based on what it thinks you need. You can place basic requirements such as 'it must be a laser power', or 'it must grant me a form of flight', or 'it must be a tinker power'.
 
The strong powers this power can grant will be heads and shoulders over the powers of most parahumans. All powers will take a couple of minutes to build up strength, though they're still usable before reaching full strength. You will not be able to create or control Endbringers, and are a precognitive blindspot to everyone but the Entity. 

Negentropy lets you hold five strong powers at a time.
objects.title: (Trump) Eidolon

addons.text:
Your Ideal Transit power now works through your flickering. As a result, your flickering is far more efficient, able to pick states effectively instantly and instinctively without needing to specifically pick varying states.

This can allow you to immediately flicker the best ideal state of anything you affect, such as being able to heal, swap locations, alter the air around you to poison your enemy, swap equipment, all at the same time, without having to put any thought into it, your power picking the ideal state needed.

This also allows you to let your power choose the perfect power to slot, as well as multiple powers, or whether a power occupies multiple slots if applicable. This doesn’t mean you give up control to your power; you can still freely decide all this as normal, this just ensures you won’t ever actually need to.
addons.title: Ideal State

addons.text:
The distinctions between Ignis Fatuus and Eidolon disappear, mutating the power further.

You now possess 7 slots for powers. You can also break down a normal slot for 4 weaker powers, and back, and can still choose to hold a power in more than one slot to exponentially increase its potency.

While you’ll be able to immediately call up a power at full strength, and hold it as long as you’d like without effort as before, your power will get continuously more and more powerful the longer it’s held. 

The number of slots you have is increased to 12 if Negentropic/Shardless, and a normal slot can be exchanged for 6 weaker powers.
addons.title: Ignis Magnis

addons.text:
Your powers are far more potent now, able to summon powers three times as powerful as before with the same slots. 

Your powers also evolve far faster than before, and when you call upon an ability, it’ll allow you to immediately call anywhere from normal strength to the greatest heights you’ve reached with it, meaning you won’t have to wait for it to reach prior heights. 

You can also allow it to summon abilities of its own choosing now as well, its selection far more fluid and powerful, and often ready to meet any need before the need even arises. You can choose your own abilities still, but often won’t need to.
addons.title: Pyrphoros

objects.text: You can “flicker”, allowing you to page through realities and possible states of yourself and those you touch and swap them in either piece by piece or as a whole. By using another state that is not injured, you can swap their states and heal them. By finding and swapping the states of a nude person with another that is clothed, you can clothe them. You can even swap positions with another possible state, allowing teleportation. You cannot use this to grant others powers. Your power doesn’t have to actually swap with an existent version, although you can. Rather, the power focuses on possible states, states such as location, health, etc that your power overlaps and swaps with your current state. Finally, you gain one power slot that you can individually swap out at will, such as a powerful aerokinetic power capable of offense or defense. The power can only be as powerful as a single power that a full-powered Eidolon could summon. You're also a precognitive blind spot to everyone but the Entity. If you pick Negentropy, you gain two additional power slots and can choose to have a power be held in more than one slot, each additional slot dramatically increasing its power.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Ignis Fatuus

addons.text:
When you turn into an Alternate Self you automatically copy their powers and can choose to steal them. You can also do the reverse, give them a power you have taken/copied.

Oberon and Manager fuse into one inheriting each other strengths and covering their weakness. You can store an infinite amount of powers and use 10 (14 with Negentropy) of them simultaneously, compatible powers synergize and amplify each other and can occupy the same slot.

A power will temporarily become stronger the more versions of it you can use. As an example, the same power through Overlay, Copy, and Taken triples all of its aspects.
addons.title: The Dagda

addons.text:
Any skills you have through an Alternate Self is elevated to the highest possible level. Using a Skill from an Alternate Self together with the same Skill from Polymath elevates it beyond the limit, becoming a power, the elevation of a high enough skill from an Alternate Self will not need a duplicate skill for it to become a power. You could cut titanium with a stick through Swordsmanship, shoot bullets that never miss with Marksmanship, or create superpowered medicine through Apothecary. The strength of those powers scales with any power boosters you have without you even needing to use the power booster. Those powers are affected by Oberon/Manager the same way any other power is, you can't steal them with Manager but you can still copy them.

You can slot Thinker and Tinker powers from your Alternate Selves into a Polymath slot.

Any Thinker and Tinker powers you have that didn't come from Skill Up will have all their aspects doubled.
addons.title: Skill Up

addons.text:
You can use Amalgam to fuse with up to 10 Alternate Selves. This fusion works the exact same as Amalgam with the exception that your mind is the only dominant one, you can anytime choose for it to go back to an equal combination of minds.

You can control how many traits the fusion displays. You could have the appearance of one, the clothes of another, and weapons of yet another one.

When fusing you can choose whether it's your body combining with an Alternate Self or the body of an Alternate Self combining with yours. When you unfuse you can choose the destination of each member of the fusion, you can go to an Alternate Reality of one of the selves you were combined with or go to a reality you have been in the past.

The limit to how many Selves you can fuse with slowly increases.
addons.title: Unusual Dimensional Hopping

addons.text: You experience all possibilities, what was/is/will/could be, the possible and impossible. You see everything simultaneously in milliseconds, every second of the past/present/future, every second of what will and never will be. This will have no negative effects on your Self. You know how likely and unlikely each possibility is to occur and why, giving you the capacity to know the most likely future. Omniscient and Vision fuse into one, you no longer have any blindspots and no knowledge can harm you. Your Selves from visions are valid targets for your Overlay (or Flickering if you have Endless Reflections) If you have Endless Reflections, your flickering will act before something happens; someone shot you? Nothing happened, because you already were out of the way before they pressed the trigger.
addons.title: Conclusion One

addons.text:
You can completely change your reality using the realities from your Alternate Selves as a base, you can completely change everything to make a total copy of their reality or change only parts.

You do not have to be watching an Alternate Self for the changes you made in your reality to persist, the changes are permanent but you can anytime revert them.

When you make changes that you are in the middle of, like when you completely copy an Alternate Reality, you can opt to change your body to be a copy of the Alternate Self that resides in that Alternate Reality making your original form and your Alternate one and the same. This can be undone anytime.

You still have total control over Reality within 250 meters. The less you move the greater this range becomes, shrinking every time you move, the less lucid you are the faster it grows. Moving will not decrease your base 250-meter range, only the additional range. Breathing or moving your arms is fine, walking or flying is not.

You can see more than 10 realities simultaneously. The more you exceed 10 realities the less you are aware of your own body and your surroundings.
addons.title: Paint the World

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to view alternate realities by posing “What If?” questions, allowing you to view a vast range of possibilities. From something as simple as you have made a different choice to something entirely unrelated to yourself. This can range from questions such as “What if I hadn’t gone out yesterday?”, “What if I had Triggered with Alexandria’s powers?”, “What if science had a massive breakthrough that skyrocketed technological advancements 1000 years prior?”, and much more, those questions can include multiple deviations. You can view up to 10 separate realities at the same time.

Regardless of what differences there are, you’ll always view it through the senses of an alternate version of You, as well as possessing a fundamental understanding of how it came to be. You’ll be able to experience each reality with no more difficulty than you would just own.

Each reality and the beings within them have an identifier, a name that describes the deviation. By using that identifier you can ask a ‘What If’ question using Alternate Realities/Selves as a base.

The access to those realities is kept in a mental archive within your mind, allowing you to access them yet again if you switch from one reality to another and wish to go back. Asking the question that made that reality will make another variation for possibilities are endless.

You can pick one alternate version of yourself that you are viewing and can overlay that version of You onto yourself, gaining access to any deviations they have. This will allow you to utilize any abilities those alternates of you possess, as well as any equipment they have. When transformed your true body will slowly shift to match that of your alternate you, this can be both detrimental as well as beneficial. This shift is incredibly gradual and will entirely reverse if the change is held for less than a day.
objects.title: (Thinker/Breaker) For The Want Of A Nail

objects.text: You have Hero's power. You are a highly versatile Tinker that specializes in wavelength manipulation. This power allows the mimicry of the Entities' Stilling power.
objects.title: (Tinker) Hero

objects.text:
You are nearly invulnerable. No effect or force can negatively affect you physically except for Sting or the Siberian. This extends even to the functions of your own body, meaning that you never tire, require no sustenance (air included), and even negative mental effects are limited to the point that you don't have to worry about stress doing permanent mental harm, as most of your mental faculties are off-loaded to your Shard. Even sleep is just for pleasure or relaxation rather than a need to refresh yourself.

You have incredible amounts of strength and can fly and move at supersonic speeds, with perfect maneuverability and reaction time to match. Your mind is enhanced just like your body, skyrocketing your mental capabilities to superhuman levels, with absolutely perfect memory retention and recall.

The field that pervades your body providing these abilities also extends itself to things you are touching, letting you ignore the effects of physics when you apply your strength and speed. You have more leverage than should be possible when you grab something, exert immense force with minor motions, large objects don't collapse under their weight, and catching or carrying people at extreme speeds won't harm them. You are an unstoppable force and an immovable object.
objects.title: (Brute/Mover) Alexandria

addons.text:
When 'claiming' parahumans, your shard now takes over the entirety of the associated shard network and transfers it to your dimension instead of just a select sub-network. This means that, instead of only acquiring a specific parahuman and their direct shards, you can access their entire shard network. As such, you can generate shades of other hosts, even if they died years ago or are still living, by using the mental 'imprints' of hosts from the shard network. These shards can be accessed directly in your dimension and you can exchange energy between them to boost specific shades or recharge them.

The shades of parahumans you produce by using their shard 'imprints' no longer fade over time, rather they retain all of their abilities, memories and intelligence as they were in life and are completely loyal to you. Your shades also no longer have any range limitations and you retain constant awareness of them, enabling you to mentally command them at any distance. You have a greatly increased number of shades that you can have active at full power at once, up to 9 total, and Negentropy will increase your maximum limit of shades by 1 every month.

Your power sight is also far clearer, allowing you to perfectly comprehend the inner mechanisms of parahuman's shards, their history and their powers. A word of warning; claiming highly important shards will draw the attention of the Entity if they're part of its network.
addons.title: Ereshkigal

addons.text: As a Titan, you can now spawn a much greater number of ghosts at once and can have them leave your immediate presence.
addons.title: Titan Valkyrie

addons.text: Your shades can now use Paramount. When you summon a shade, you may give it any power you could access through Paramount, on top of whatever power that shade may possess. Each shade has its own separate Paramount budget. Shades do not have the build up time that Paramount typically has, able to swap abilities on a moments notice. This also gives you access to Blank Shades, these are shadowy non-descript shades granted a power you can access through Paramount. They are not claimed from dead parahumans and do not come with a pre-existing identity or original powers. If you possess Negentropy or are Shardless, you gain the ability to shape your Blank Shades into any appearance you prefer. If you possess Elfame, any power you claim is automatically liquidated into Paramount. Instead of remaining only as a shade’s original power, its SP value is permanently added to your Paramount budget. This increase applies to every Paramount budget you control, including each shade’s separate budget. The liquidated power is also added to your Paramount inventory, allowing you and your shades to call upon it through Paramount normally. Because the claimed power has been liquidated, the shade it came from no longer has to keep that power as its inherent ability, allowing you to reshape or rewrite that shade’s basic ability at will. Any upgrades or fusions utilizing Paramount are also carried over.
addons.title: Paramount Shades

objects.text: You have Glaistig Uaine's powerset. You can claim the powers of any Parahumans that die within your range and can kill any Parahuman by touching them or a manifestation of their power. You can summon shades of the Parahumans whose power you have claimed, these shades resemble their living form but exaggerate certain features and focus on the costumes and other things associated with their powers. You can generally have 3 or so shades active at a time, but can have more active at the cost of them being made weaker. You have a sight-based ability that lets you see images based off of the powers of other Parahumans and how they interact with the world, this gives you enough detail that you can even see trigger events in some cases. Negentropy let you summon an additional shade.
objects.title: (Trump) Faerie Queen

addons.text: At any time, you can choose whether you possess someone new if you die or if Rebirth will activate and resurrect you in a copy of your current body. If you choose for Rebirth to activate, your powers will remain unaltered, letting you keep your current body’s power at full strength; however, this still relies on having Rebirth charges when you die, otherwise Butcher will activate as normal. You can also, at any time, spend Rebirth charges to resurrect and free a person from your collective. Anyone you resurrect in this manner will be completely removed from your collective, resurrected in a copy of their body as it was when you first possessed them. If you resurrect anyone with this addon, both you and that person will retain access to their power, though they’ll have it at full power while your version will still be subject to the Butcher Shard’s mechanics. If you resurrect someone while still possessing their original body, you’ll still keep that body; they’ll just get a copy. If a person you resurrect with this addon later becomes the target for your Butcher power again, you won’t gain a second copy of their power. Although, like always, while in their body, you’ll have access to the full strength of that power.
addons.title: Butchered Rebirth

addons.text:
Now, when you possess a new body, you can choose for that body to change, becoming the same kind of artificial being as the Artificial Reincarnation you originally chose in the CYOA, with all the same capabilities.

New bodies you possess will still look like the former owner if the Artificial Reincarnation in question allows, such as Android/Gynoid, Human Morph, Pod Morph, or Construct.
addons.title: Artificial Inheritance

addons.text: In addition to faking your death, you can pull off the real deal as well. At will, you can instantaneously and painlessly end your life. Normally, this wouldn’t be that good of a power, except for the fact that you are the Butcher. Thus, when you die, you simply reincarnate into the nearest Parahuman.
addons.title: Kill Switch
Vociferous Chorus
addons.text:
Every mind manifested via (Master/Trump) Butcher per incarnation is added to your vast collective of pre-existing voices; placing them under your direct mental command.

All your voices can talk to you or each other, be assigned tasks, organised into groups, muted or rendered entirely inert. You can instinctively use their memories and skills as if they were your own or even let them pilot your body. Newly incarnated voices may remain hostile but pose little threat as you can simply quarantine them.

As a bonus, you've gained a unique type of mental multitasking that lets you individually interact with every voice simultaneously, no matter their number. This helps you easily manage them all and to consider every voice's input; preventing mania like the Butcher.

objects.text: You have an altered version of the Butcher's power. When you die, you reincarnate into either the last person to attack you or the one who killed you (your choice). You retain all your original powers at 100%, as well as those of your most recent incarnation, but all powers of those in between are half as strong. All the minds of the people who have killed you are in a mental room with you and can communicate with you. You control the room but cannot mute or remove any of the people there, but you can put them to sleep (which would, effectively, mute them unless they snore). You control who is in charge of the body. You can access any of the memories of people in your mental room and give them to others in the room, including yourself.
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Butcher

objects.text:
Your very being is entwined with energy on fundamental levels. You can fire blasts of light whose properties and effects are within your control. Forking or homing lasers, freeze beams, disintegrating spheres that orbit around you in a pattern, and even beam lasers that heal. All of these and more are within your capabilities. At its strongest, a single one of these can easily destroy a skyscraper. You can fire a dozen blasts at once and coordinating such barrages is trivial for you.

You are also able to fly, reaching the speed of light in an instant. Your mind will automatically compensate for relativistic time dilation by slowing down or speeding up.

You can switch back and forth between a Breaker state that removes all physical needs and quickly restores you to perfect physical condition. In this state, most attacks are simply absorbed, with only the strongest able to put you down before the damage is gone. Your vision is perfect, as it encompasses the entire electromagnetic spectrum, and no longer degrades with distance.
objects.title: (Blaster/Mover) Legend

objects.text:
Kingmaker grants you the power of the ultimate wise old mentor archetype. With this Thinker ability, you can choose up to five parahumans to take in as students and intuitively understand their strengths, weaknesses, and optimal training methods. Through your guidance, even the most naive and unremarkable individuals with weak powers can be transformed into once-in-a-century geniuses, capable of achieving greatness and potentially challenging deities.

Your wisdom shapes their intellect and skills, empowering them to become heroes on the path of greatness. As the Kingmaker, you wield the ability to unlock and enhance the powers granted by shards, turning even the weakest powers into formidable forces capable of leaving an indelible mark on the world.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Kingmaker

objects.text:
You have a shaker effect of approximately 10 meters that increases the natural intellect, ability to learn and process information of people in your range to equal 0.0001% of all of humanity. To visualise this, take every human alive, calculate their total mental capablities combined, and get exactly 0.0001% of it. That 0.0001% is the amount of brainpower those under the effect of your power gets. This allows you to teach and educate many people into becoming not just competent but pure geniuses unrivalled in their respective fields. 
 
The effect would naturally wear off once they leave your range; however, the skills and knowledge gained while under its effects will remain.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Genius Friends

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to peer into the future, providing perfect knowledge of events that will transpire up to 100 days ahead from the viewpoint of your future self, this precognition has no blind spots. Within this temporal scope, you can perceive a single absolute future, a path that is predetermined to unfold unless you take action to alter it. This power bestows upon you the advantage of foreknowledge, enabling you to prepare, adapt, and potentially change the course of events.

However, wielding this formidable gift comes with two significant drawbacks. The first limitation is that your precognition ability can only be updated once a week. Once you intervene to alter the foreseen future, the knowledge of the consequences will not be revealed to you until the next update. Until then, you must navigate the altered timeline with uncertainty, eagerly awaiting the moment when your power will refresh and reveal the ramifications of your choices.

The second drawback of this power is the psychological toll it exacts on you. Upon every update of the future, you instantaneously experience all the emotions and sensations you would have encountered during the original 100-day timeframe. These emotions, whether positive or negative, surge through you in an instant. However, your mind gains a remarkable resilience, protecting you from being overwhelmed by this torrent of feelings. Though you will feel the pain, sadness, happiness, or other emotions that would have accompanied certain events, they are substantially muted. For instance, if you were destined to be stabbed in the original future, the pain you experience when actually stabbed is significantly reduced, dampened to a fraction of its actual intensity.
objects.title: (Thinker) Precognition

objects.text: You are good with numbers to a Parahuman degree. You perceive this power as elaborate mathematical notation floating in the air. You can dodge attacks, predict future actions, identify weak points, sense the surrounding area through vibrations, perfectly measure things with a glance, leverage your strength perfectly, and much more. You wouldn't have a hard time predicting and manipulating the world economy.
objects.title: (Thinker) Number Man

addons.text: You can use your three Groundhog Day resets as quicksave slots, which expire the next time you wake up or when your resets replenish.
addons.title: Quicksave

objects.text:
You can set a save point (in space and time) to which you will return when you die. You can only move the save point forward in time, an initial save point is created when you first gain this power. You can choose to truly die instead of returning. Your memory of past events is slightly enhanced to remember past loops.

This power creates a real time travel loop as such it has no blind spots and cannot be detected except by other powers that manipulate the timeline.
objects.title: (Thinker) Time-Loop

addons.text: Your touch-applied devices are no longer restricted to conventional explosions, but can release any AoE-effect you can think of. You are able to freely adjust effective radius at will until the actual moment of detonation. The maximum range of your exotic explosions is two miles, the blast-radius of a MOAB. Though while you always have at least a rough idea of what the ultimate result of a detonation will be, sometimes the exact effect will be randomized. So while you know that anything caught in the blast will be completely destroyed, you may not know if that's because the blast will make everything it touches crumble to dust or because it creates a contained singularity that sucks it all into itself.
addons.title: Exotic Ordinance

objects.text:
Through physical contact, you possess the ability to discreetly attach an imperceptible explosive device onto individuals and objects, That only you can see. The destructive potential of the device can be precisely calibrated, spanning from the potency of a conventional military hand grenade to that of the formidable GBU-43, colloquially known as the Mother of All Bombs (~11 tons TNT). At your discretion, you retain the capability to adjust the explosive yield at any given moment subsequent to attachment, as well as determine the desired time of detonation.

There is no limit to how many bombs you can attach at a time.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Bomber

objects.text:
You have 7 slots (10 with negentropy) which can either be filled with a skill or a Thinker power.
