When you slot in a skill, you can use it at the highest possible level. These skills include the mastery of a single style of martial arts, a field of medicine or science, cooking, juggling, and more. Anything that can be learned you can have. Skills that require a muscle memory provide it.

The Thinker powers you can have are limited to at most a rating of 5 on the PRT scale. Powers that operate on your senses and observations will tend to be more accurate than those that require external information (like precognition).
objects.title: (Thinker) Polymath

addons.text: Your Magik expands to new horizons. Cantrips can be cast without prior preparation at the cost of mana, proportional to their rank, if you have their formula memorized. The strength of your cantrips now scales based on Arcanist, with their highest rating equivalent to an 8 on the PRT scale. Cantrip sets transform into spell sets which allow you to prepare spells from any system and cast them without expending mana. Each spell set can accept 39 levels worth of spells, distributed however you want. Arcanist spells are assigned a level based on their strength. (Note: If you have upgrades, the value scales based on the highest number of total spell levels granted.) You also have the ability to prepare six focus spells which are automatically heightened any spell to the highest level you have discovered and successfully cast once across all systems. Focus spells have no mana cost and a fixed 2 second cooldown, regardless of level.
addons.title: Magik Meister

addons.text:
Your mastery of spellcasting and arcane constructs have fused into the creation of specialized Arcane Focuses. Now for every spell you possess or later develop, you gain access to a corresponding Arcane Focus Construct Scheme tailored to that spell and a narrow category of related effects.

Casting any spell through its specialized Arcane Focus significantly reduces its energy cost and moderately increases its power and stability. Simply holding any Arcane Focus, regardless of specialization, also triples your Arcanist energy regeneration rate, although this regeneration bonus does not stack with multiple Arcane Focuses.

Additional, you may freely draw arcane energy from either Armiger or Arcanist to fuel the other which has created a new ability. By deliberately destabilizing an Arcane Focus or other sustained construct, you may massively amplify a single spell cast through it. Doing so destroys the construct and permanently disperses its locked arcane energy, which then must be restored through Arcanist’s natural regeneration rather than instantly reclaimed.
addons.title: Arcane Focuses

objects.text:
You have the ability to cast spells with a variety of magic that can reproduce the effect of non-Tinker powers. While your Shard provides you with a basic library of spells in each system and an intuitive knowledge of them, you will have to research and invent more powerful spells. Your spells will not be stronger than what Eidolon could do in his prime.

You have a pool of energy to cast spells, you have enough to cast your most powerful spells a dozen times in a short timespan. The pool takes 30 minutes to fully recharge. Permanent spells like summons, buffs, and auras reserve part of your reserve while they are active and release the energy when they are canceled or expire.
objects.title: (Trump) Arcanist

objects.text:
You have the ability to use psionic techniques that can reproduce the effect of non-Tinker powers. While your Shard provides you with the basics and an intuitive knowledge of how to shape the energy, you will have to research and experiment to produce more powerful results. At most, you will be as strong as Eidolon was in his prime.

Your pool of energy is enough to use your most powerful techniques a dozen times in a short timespan. The pool takes 30 minutes to fully recharge. Permanent effects like constructs, buffs, and auras reserve part of your reserve while they are active and release the energy when they are canceled or expire.
objects.title: (Trump) Kineticist

addons.text: As a master of both arcane martial styles and summoning arcane implements, you may establish a flow between your disciplines and constructs that makes them become much more powerful in tandem than they would be individually. You may develop disciplines based on welding your arcane constructs as well as hone the powers of your constructs into new disciplines and techniques. You gain a library of schemes for use in conjunction with your disciplines that improve themselves as you hone them. You also gain an intuition for experimenting and training with your disciplines and schemes to find synergies. When you synergize construct abilities and disciplines simultaneously or in quick succession, you may trigger a combo and immediately perform another discipline or conjure another construct. Chaining these together will increase the power of subsequently executed disciplines and constructs. A properly executed and sustained combo could fell an Endbringer. You may choose to execute a power as the finishing move, which immediately releases all the built-up energy of the combo into that power’s effect before ending it. A power used without synergy has a chance to end the combo, as will failing to successfully use a power. Your combos will also instantly break if they overextend both your energy pool of arcane reserves, though one can sustain the other until the combo ends. Long-term effects triggered during a combo retain the benefits from it for up to an hour or six hours as a finishing move, or until the effect itself ends. With Arcane Focuses, you may cast spells or use a construct as a focus as part of your combos, which instead of building up power in the combo itself, extend your reserves for the length of it, allowing you to push the combo further. With Artificer<\i>, objects enchanted with patterns adapted from disciplines or arcane schemes can also be used in conjunction with and even become overcharged by combos.
addons.title: Arcane Weaponmaster

objects.text:
Your Shard grants you access to a basic library of supernatural combat disciplines: techniques, maneuvers, and invocations that channel energy through trained movement, weapon use, or sheer force of will. By executing these techniques, you can reproduce the effects of non-Tinker powers.

Some techniques enhance the user directly. These techniques reinforce the body, sharpen the senses, empower weapons, amplify strikes, or project attacks over great distances. Others manifest energy outward, allowing you to form barriers, unleash blasts, shape temporary constructs, manipulate the battlefield, or produce elemental, kinetic, and exotic effects.

You possess an intuitive understanding of the techniques granted to you, allowing you to perform them immediately. However, true mastery requires refinement and experimentation. With practice, you can modify existing techniques or develop entirely new ones, expanding the breadth and potency of your current disciplines.

At your peak, your overall power can rival that of Eidolon in his prime, though at the start, you are only at the level of a decently powerful street-tier cape.

You possess a reserve of energy that fuels your disciplines. Your reserve is sufficient to perform your most powerful techniques roughly a dozen times in quick succession, and fully replenishes after thirty minutes. Techniques that create lasting effects, such as sustained enhancements, constructs, or barriers, reserve a portion of this energy for as long as they remain active.
objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Martial Adept

addons.text: Using the block logic of your grids, you may increase the efficiency and ease of construction of your Armiger schemes. By imagining and manifesting individual pieces of a scheme in the shape of blocks, you will gain a much more intuitive understanding of how arcane energy flows through them and how their effects manifest. This block based construction also makes the constructs more modular and reconfigurable, though they may not be reconstructed while manifested. You may also roll random restrictions that you may choose to apply to schemes that not only reduce the draw of your arcane reserves, but can provide boosts if successfully designed around. You may directly manifest your active grids as arcane constructs using both your grid energy and arcane reserves at a slightly more efficient rate for both. You can also transcribe grid patterns into schemes for use as arcane constructs when not in either an active or inactive grid, though they become more costly unless refined and improved. You gain new blocks that may be configured on a grid to provide additional effects or enhancement to a manifested arcane construct or to set an active grid to convert grid energy into additional arcane reserves instead of usable powers. With Build it Brick by Brick, you may prepay for power bricks with a portion of your arcane reserves which may be paid back with Artificer charges or grid energy. You may also transcribe arcane construct schemes into instruction manuals so that you can build them with enchanted bricks. Lastly, you can do the opposite and record brick constructs you have built as arcane schemes. Optionally, your arcane constructs can take a much blockier toyetic aesthetic.
addons.title: Orange Transparent Chainsaws

objects.text:
You possess the ability to manifest temporary weapons, armor, and accessory constructs made from condensed arcane energy.  Each construct is shaped from an arcane scheme, a structured blueprint capable of reproducing the effects of non-Tinker powers, provided those effects are embodied in physical form.

You begin with a vast library of inefficient schemes spanning a wide range of power levels. While fully functional, these initial schemes consume excessive arcane energy due to structural waste and design inefficiencies. As you study and refine this library you will be able to create more efficient schemes, reducing their energy cost.

You also possess a fixed Arcane Reserve. Manifesting a construct locks a portion of this reserve for as long as the construct remains active. When dismissed, the allocated energy is immediately returned. The more powerful or inefficient a construct’s scheme, the greater portion of your reserve that must be locked to sustain it. 

However, regardless of efficiency, no construct’s power can be greater than what Eidolon could summon in his prime. Otherwise, constructs have few limitations with no inherent range limit or attention required once manifested. 

In the beginning, you will be able to manifest simultaneously up to five constructs each worth 7 SP. With mastery and optimization, you may sustain a few dozen Tier 1 equivalent constructs at once.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Armiger

addons.text:
You can now place your charges and enchantments into (Trump) Manager’s slots, allowing you to use the abilities directly.

Likewise, by applying more charges to an ability, you can improve upon it, further refining it. This applies to both abilities derived from enchantments and abilities copied and stolen by others.

Powers replicate and/or stolen by (Trump) Manager now also have their pattern automatically recorded for replication by (Trump/Tinker) Artificer. Alongside this, you can now also place powers held inside manager into objects like you would with your enchantments.
addons.title: Administrator's Engineer

addons.text:
Your mastery of construct schemes and enchantment patterns have fused into a unified arcane production system, granting you two new abilities. 

First, you may prepay enchantments on physical objects or constructs using your Arcane Reserve, temporarily locking a portion of that reserve in place of charges. You may later invest Artificer charges to repay this cost and reclaim the locked reserve, effectively treating your reserve as a loan. Once fully repaid, the construct stabilizes into a permanent enchanted object no longer sustained by your Arcane Reserve.

Second, you may record Improved Arcane Schemes within your Armiger library. These schemes may incorporate up to three Artificer enchantments in addition to their native Armiger effect while only requiring Arcane Reserve equivalent to the scheme’s base ability. Improved Schemes are unique and cannot be manifested more than once, functioning instead as singular items stored within your Armiger library, effectively transforming it into a pocket inventory for enchanted equipment.

Furthermore, if you delete an Improved Scheme from your Armiger library, you recover 75% of all charges invested into its enchantments but at the cost of permanently destroying the item in the process.
addons.title: Arcane Foundry

addons.text:
You no longer need to rely solely on your Shard to research patterns. You have the ability to study and understand existing patterns, derive new ones, and include elements from your spells, techniques, and invocations; your Shard will validate the patterns for problems and point out errors if there are any.

Objects can be enchanted using the energy from your pool instead of charges, you can also spend charges to reduce the energy cost and vice-versa.
addons.title: Thaumaturge

objects.text:
You can enchant objects with non-Tinker powers by touching them, with a maximum of three enchantments on a single object. You can choose whether the object grants the wielder use of the power, or has a variant of the power itself. This power does not allow creating Variable Trump powers like Eidolon, picking from a fixed set is possible like Othala's power. At their highest, your enchantments will be on the same level as what Eidolon could do in his prime.

To enchant an object you need a pattern and enough charges to empower the object. Patterns can be researched by tasking your Shard to research a power, this usually takes 6-8 hours per power. You can have up to 3 (5 with negentropy) concurrent research. You gain 12 charges (18 with Negentropy) every day at midnight. Charges do not expire.

The strength of the power is proportional to the number of charges invested, with the minimum being 3 charges. The efficiency of charges drops by 20% recursively (100% - 80% - 64% - 51% - 40% - etc.) for every 36 charges invested into a single power up to a maximum of 216, reaching the level of Eidolon. It takes 30 seconds to empower an object regardless of the number of charges used.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Artificer

addons.text:
You’ve gained the ability to enchant your ingredients, equipment, and/or potions to greatly empower what you can create. The more enchantments, the greater the effects.

You may also expend charges to bypass the traditional requirements for brewing potions. A single charge can remove the need for a transmutation circle, automatically transmuting the required ingredients. Two can be used to create the potions immediately upon having all the necessary ingredients.

Conversely, your Alchemy can also augment your Artifice. You can create highly toxic potions that temporarily accelerate your charge generation, transmute metamaterials that are highly receptive to enchantments, and brew alchemical solvents to dissolve enchanted items and reclaim a portion of invested charges.

Finally, potions are no longer limited solely to physically expressed powers.
addons.title: Enchanting Alchemy

addons.text:
Your mastery of alchemical brews allows you and others to better handle the buildup of Toxicity from potion consumption. When consuming potions of weaker potency, the body absorbs them with minimal to no Toxicity buildup, enabling frequent use without consequence. However, higher-potency potions still create Toxicity at the normal rate. This refined control allows you to experiment and blend weaker potions without risking rapid Toxicity buildup, even during extended use.

Additionally, you can now create special Detoxifying Elixirs that can actively purge Toxicity from your system when ingested. When used in moderation, they effectively reduce Toxicity buildup, allowing for a reset to potion use. However, over-reliance on these elixirs may cause the body to destabilize, rapidly increasing Toxicity instead, potentially pushing the drinker into dangerous levels without warning.
addons.title: Toxic Love

objects.text:
You can create potions from formulas that will have power-like effects when consumed and the ability to create transmutation circles to change materials into others.

You have intuitive knowledge of how to develop new formulas. Natural ingredients as well as brewing equipment are required to create the potions. Consuming too many potions in a short amount of time creates Toxicity and can have adverse health effects on the user. The effect of your potions will fade once it's purged from the drinker's blood. Those potions are limited to powers that can be expressed physically such as regeneration, super strength, enhanced senses, invisibility, etc. At their most powerful they will be as strong as a mid-tier cape.

You have intuitive knowledge of how to create transmutation circles. To perform a transmutation, you need to inscribe the circle on a surface and place the required ingredients inside then touch the circle to activate it. You cannot create materials with power-like properties unless you can study them, this applies to Tinker materials (like alloys). You are not limited in size however the objects must fit within the transmutation circle, at big enough sizes this means taking into account the Earth's curvature. The time to transmute is proportional to the volume.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Alchemist

objects.text:
You can summon fantastical creatures, beasts and beings of your own design, customising their appearance and bestowing them with non-Tinker powers of your choice.

Your creations can take a myriad of forms, whether a serpent that turns into living lightning, a fox cloaked in illusions or a cyclops with a high Brute rating. Each day you receive 1 Charge. By spending 2 Charges, you can manifest a new, very weak creature with abilities equivalent to 1 SP in combined strength, or, alternatively, you can invest Charges to empower an existing creature. Your Charges stockpile and do not expire.

A creature's overall potency scales with the total Charges invested in it, increasing by approximately 1 SP for every 2 Charges spent. As such, they would reach 2 SP after 4 Charges, 3 SP after 6 Charges and so on, until capping off at 15 SP with 30 Charges. For example, an avian beast that might initially only levitate could, through further investment, progress until they can fly at hypersonic speeds.

Their baseline physiology consists of crystalline-like flesh which is as durable as steel and they can range in size from as small as a cat up to as large as a pony. You are aware of all your creatures and may mentally communicate with them to issue directives. They are intelligent, loyal to fault and can act autonomously per your will.

You can summon your creations within your local vicinity as well as de-summon them at any time. They naturally regenerate, healing from major wounds in under a week, but can be destroyed if damaged enough. Your creatures cannot possess fully variable Trump powers, like Eidolon, but more limited versions, akin to Othala, are feasible.
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Magical Menagerie

objects.text: You can shapeshift into various forms, fantastical creatures of your own design, each with their own set of powers — a black panther able to meld with shadows, a massive hawk that rides on air currents at the speed of sound, a owlbear that calls on the power of nature; your imagination, and the number of charges at your disposal, are the only limits. Each day you gain 6 charges (or 9 with Negentropy); they can be spent to design a new form or to improve an existing one. It takes 3 charges to create a new simple form, based on an existing animal of medium size (ex: wolf); each size increment beyond this requires three more charges. You can also spend charges to alter the form with more exotic traits, such as hardened scales and a prehensile bladed tail for your panther form; the number of charges this takes depends on how complex the changes are and how far they deviate from the base template; purely cosmetic changes, such as an exotic fur color or patterns, cost a single charge. Your other powers still work while transformed. On top of this, you can use charges to grant your forms non-Tinker powers. Each form can have a maximum of three distinct powers, and their potency scales with the total number of charges invested. It takes 3 charges to create a power with a PRT rating of 1, with each level costing an additional number of charges equal to that level times tree; for example, a pattern with a rating of 3 costs 18 charges, and the maximum rating of 8 costs 108 charges. You cannot possess fully variable Trump powers, like Eidolon, but more limited versions, akin to Othala, are feasible. Instead of dedicated powers, you can also use part of your power capacity to alter your other powers, such as boosting the effects of Arcanist while in your moonkin form; the number of charges scales the same way as powers, in increments of 20% up to 200%. You can create as many templates as you want but only 3 can be active at once. It takes 5 minutes to switch active templates, during which both templates are unavailable. You can spend 30 charges to increase the number of active templates, up to a maximum of 9. If your Shard runs out of energy while you are transformed, you will be stuck in whichever form you were in at the time.
objects.title: (Trump/Changer) Wildshape

addons.text:
You may now use your ability to research power Patterns with Artificer to reduce the creation cost of Summon Cards and Spell Cards that share similar abilities.

When creating a new card, you may designate up to three related power Patterns to influence its design. The first related Pattern reduces the card’s creation cost by a 1/4th, the second reduces it by 1/3rd, and the third reduces it by 1/2 of the original cost. Only Patterns that are meaningfully related to the intended card will provide benefits with those that are too conceptually distant having no effect.

Furthermore, this relationship is reciprocal. When enchanting an object using a power Pattern, you may designate up to three related cards you possess to reduce the enchantment cost using the same ratios listed above. When creating a card or power Patten you will instinctively understand what kind of enchantments and cards they can be used to create in the future.

Finally, your charge economies are now fully interoperable. Charges generated by Artificer and Cartomancy may be freely spent as though they belonged to either system.
addons.title: Reciprocal Research

addons.text:
You can now fuse Cards together. 

These Fusion Cards can be created by combining multiple cards to create a single, more powerful composite card, provided the contributing cards follow a coherent thematic or mechanical logic. 

For example, fusing a Young Dragon Summon Card with a Fireball Spell Card could produce an Elder Fire-Breathing Dragon Summon Card, while combining a Fireball Spell with a Wind Bind Spell might yield a Fire Tornado Spell Card.

To perform a fusion, you simply select two or more cards outside of battle and expend charges. The chosen cards are then consumed, and a newly created Fusion Card is immediately generated.

The charge cost for this fusion scales with the number of cards fused, the complexity of the resulting effect, and how far the fusion deviates from the original components.
addons.title: Fusion Cards

addons.text:
Your arcane power has harmonized with your Cartomancy system, allowing you to subtly influence the fate of your draws. By expending arcane energy, you may generate Destiny, a temporary fleeting resource used to manipulate probability.

When drawing a Card, you may spend Destiny to bias the probability toward a specific Card currently in your Deck. The more Destiny invested, the greater the likelihood the desired Card is drawn with minor investments slightly tilting probability, and substantial amounts making the desired Card overwhelmingly more likely. 

Furthermore, if you refrain from manipulating your draws for a significant period of time, you begin passively accumulating small amounts of Destiny, even if your arcane energy is depleted.
addons.title: "Its not Cheating, its the Heart of the Cards!"

objects.text:
You have the ability to create Cards of Power that grant a variety of effects for the user. However, your Cards cannot produce effects stronger than what Eidolon could have achieved in his prime.

You gain 6 charges (9 with Negentropy) every 24 hours. It only takes a single charge to create a Card with a PRT rating of 1. You can upgrade a Card to a higher rating, with each level costing a number of charges equal to that level. For example, a Card with a PRT 2 rating costs 3 charges total, while a PRT 10 rating costs 55 charges.

There are two types of Cards you can create: Spell Cards, which apply effects to you or the environment, and Summon Cards, which manifest objects or beings of various forms to aid you.

Spell Cards can invoke any singular effect you can imagine, such as manipulating elements, granting flight, or healing. The only restriction is that they cannot generate new powers themselves.

Summon Cards can create objects or beings of your design. They can generate multiple instances if appropriate—such as a swarm of Bees. Each object or summon has three slots (five with Negentropy) for pre-loading powers via Spell Cards.

Your Deck can hold up to 40 Cards (60 with Negentropy), serving as a reserve from which you draw new Cards. Additionally, you have three slots (five with Negentropy) for activating Spell Cards and three slots (five with Negentropy) for Summon Cards.

When in use, the Cards hover in mid-air before you, glowing with a golden light. They are constructs formed by your power and are immune to all conventional attacks, though all-or-nothing attacks can damage or destroy them.

At the start of combat, you can “draw” your hand of five Cards (seven with Negentropy), and you can draw a new Card every few minutes to replenish your hand.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Cartomancy

objects.text:
This power manifests as a large book (20x30cm) which has a thick cover decorated with strange yet mesmerizing patterns. The book generates 6 charges (9 with Negentropy) every 24 hours; they can be spent to create new power patterns and record them inside of the book. 

It takes one charge to create a power with a PRT rating of 1, with each level costing an additional number of charges equal to that level; for example, a pattern with a rating of 3 costs 6 charges, and one with a rating of 10 costs 55. The rating of the power is fixed at creation time and cannot be changed after the fact.

A pattern takes 3 pages for a power with a rating of 1, and one additional page for each level, up to 12; in total, the book has 250 pages, 150 of which can be used to write powers, while the rest is reserved for components. You can only create a pattern if the book has a enough blank pages in a row. You can erase a power from the book but not move them.

Patterns are split into rectangular regions made up of two types of components: dense sequences of square characters, and complex circuit-like diagrams. You only have a basic understanding of this system. You can copy blocks into the back 100 pages of the book and re-use them to modify existing powers, or to reduce the cost of creating new powers, the blocks are not consumed in the process.

Every power with a rating above 1 has its pattern scrambled beyond the first three pages. As you use the power, the pages will clear up and the power will become stronger; the time depends on the final strength, a few hours for weak powers and up to eight weeks for the strongest. Powers also drain energy a battery inside of the book, which takes 30 minutes to fully recharge; depending on the type powers, such as ongoing effects, they can also siphon off part of the regeneration or reserve part of the pool.

The book can hover around you within arm's reach, its position is locked relative to you, and can be mentally directed. You can stash the book away into a pocket dimension but lose the ability to use the powers stored within.

Finally, you can spend charges to upgrade some aspects of the book: 5 charges to add 10 more pages to either section or 5 charges to increase the size of the battery or recharge rate in 10% increments, up to 100%. You can only spent 60 charges in total for upgrades, this information is shown inside the back cover, and can spend 10 charges to reset them. You can also create more books, 30 charges for the first, 60 for the second, 90 for the third, and so on; the books share charges but each has its own battery and upgrades; each book also increases the number of charges generated by 2 every cycle up to 12.
objects.title: (Trump/Tinker) Grimoire of Shards

objects.text:
You can summon and control dolls. You can create an arbitrary amount of dolls but only have up to 10 active dolls at once. You can see, hear, and feel (but not smell and taste) through your dolls. Your maximum control range is 1000 meters, if a doll goes outside that range it will deactivate. Your capacity to multitask matches the amount of dolls you have active. You cannot summon your dolls further than at arm's length (~60cm or 2ft).

By default the dolls you create have the same strength, speed, and resistance as your own body but no other powers. When created they will not have any clothes. The size of your dolls can range from 10cm to 80cm and must have a human form.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Doll Master

objects.text:
You have the ability to copy extremely weakened versions of  the powers of Parahumans and three slots to use those powers with. To copy a Parahuman's power you must get within a meter of them. If you copy the power of an Endbringer or Entity, you get every single power they have separately, instead of just one power.

You can switch what power is in your slots at will. Every day you get a charge (two with Negentropy) you can use to increase the strength of a power, though you can save these charges as well. Once a power reaches the same strength as the original, you can no longer dump charges into it.

On average it takes 7 charges to fully charge a weak power, 14 charges to fully upgrade a mid-level power, 21 charges to fully upgrade a high-level power, and 28 charges to fully upgrade an extremely powerful power.

You can also use those charges to increase how many slots you have, to a maximum of five. It takes 30 charges to fully increase the number of slots you have, though before you fully gain a new slot you can place an even weaker version of a power in that slot. For example, if you have a slot that has 15 charges put into it, the power is half as powerful as it would be if it were in a full slot. You can increase the number of daily charges by investing 60 and 90 charges, up to a maximum of 3 (or 5 with Negentropy).

Your powers, even when strengthened to their max, will never be the same as the original Parahuman's power. Instead, they will be a side-grade, a power that could have come from the Parahuman's Shard, but didn't. You can spend 3 charges to reroll the power expression.
objects.title: (Trump) Replicator

objects.text: You can extend the cutting edge of a bladed object, the longer the edge the farther it extends. Also gives you unconscious feelings in regard to Parahumans and influences other Parahumans' Shards to such a degree that they can be considered to be an unconscious extension of yourself.
objects.title: (Striker/Master) Jack Slash

objects.text: You can answer any question anyone asks you, except that if you don't have Negentropy, you can't answer how to solve/negate entropy. You can ask yourself questions and automatically know the answer to any question asked of you, even if the answer to that question harms you.
objects.title: (Thinker) Omniscient

objects.text:
In a radius of 50 meters around you, with nothing but your will alone, you are capable of shaping the physical world. Moving objects, generating and manipulating all forms of energy or matter, or even creating constructs of everything the physical world has to offer.

The world is a vast ocean of vibration, matter, and energy to your senses, and all it takes is a thought to send it moving according to your wishes. Complex systems such as biology and technology will require a great deal of practice before you can reliably work them the same way you would matter and energy, with other powers here being far better at doing so and developing faster.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Omni-Kinesis

addons.text: (Mover) Door Me and (Mover) Ideal Transit meld together, you no longer need to have a seen a location to open a portal to it, instead now you can freely target a location the same way you could with Ideal Transit. Now it’s a matter of choice whether you move through portals or teleportation whenever you wish.
addons.title: Ideal Portal

objects.text: You can make portals to anywhere you've seen since triggering, even if only through pictures or videos. As many as you want, and anything that passes through one keeps all its momentum.
objects.title: (Mover) Door Me

objects.text:
The counterpart to the vicious power of the Endbringer, you gain immense power in conflict resolution, gaining these abilities to help you resolve conflict.

You're enveloped in a passive aura around you, equal to half a mile radius, completely disabling a Shard's Conflict Drive. This has the effect of soothing emotions, canceling violent impulses, and inducing minor joy and euphoria in all those within your aura range.

You can cancel any powers actively being used for conflict within your line of sight. You gain a Thinker ability which lets you sense all violent emotions, thoughts, and actions within your aura range.

You also become a Free Tinker, with minor enhancements, however, you are given a massive boost in one area under a period of 6 hours after you witness active conflict that could be best stopped by that specialization, e.g., you see pyrokinetics fight, you get a massive bonus in cryogenics, heat absorption, and dispersion Tinkertech specialties.

You are not given incredible strength, only equal to a Brute 4, your speed equal to a Mover 8, while your durability and stamina get massive boosts, giving you enough to go at your best for at least 3 days straight and your durability is strong enough to easily tank Endbringer attacks and at least 10 full-power Entity attacks.
objects.title: (Master/Tinker) Peacebringer

addons.text: When used in conjunction with Jack Slash's ability, you are able to manipulate shards like Jack Slash manipulates Hosts; they also become more like their host during interactions with you, such as The Shaper acting more like Amelia, or The High Priest acting more gruff and hungry like Eidolon. In addition, [Query]'s range is boosted to 120ft.
addons.title: [Broadcast]

addons.text: You developed offensive, defensive, and complemental applications for Shards’ data requests or additional Network functionalities for personal or Shard [Data] protection from data leaks or influences depending on your capabilities: Having Shard-Like allows your Shard to simple ”front-end” countermeasures such as spoofing or sending junk [Data] masquerading as requested [Data] misleadingly leading a Shard on a false trail or conclusion or aggressively taking action with "time-sink" data, cognitohazards or other damaging tactics to other Parahumans. This doesn’t largely damage the offending Shard, but the Parahuman (most commonly Thinkers) consciously requesting [Data] from you. Having (Trump/Tinker) Shards largely helps with the Shard’s “back-end”, with [Data] encryption, [Data] allocation and storage, along with a broad array of Shard-based and [Data]-based protections and assault methods such as [Data] bombs, [Data] firewalls, [Broadcast] filters, [DoS], [Viruses], etc. This only affects/damages the Shards, with the Parahuman being none-the-wiser. Having (Stranger) Shroud easily specializes your Shard [Data] defenses to basically “the art of theatricality and deception”: Concealment of your Shard’s dimensional location, deviating [Data] requests, Shrouded [Data] packets, chief among the ever-developing defensive processes your Shroud will devise. Procuring all of this… will comprehensively and directly manipulate the [Data] flow of other Shards to misdirect or deflect any sensible information, and outright injecting a backdoor on the opposing Shard, while also retaining all skillsets. Essentially become a Shard InfoSec/CyberSec specialist, to a bonafide Shard Hacker.
addons.title: [Access Denied]

addons.text:
Instead of being crippled for the [Cycle’s] sake, your Shard [Broadcast Array] is as good as new, with revitalized communicative and networking abilities.

One of the many uses of your Array is extending your Shard communication abilities to a greater range, with [Query’s] range stretching further than nearly a kilometer, acting more like a Radar where you’re aware any surrounding Shard’s [Designation/Function] and [Expression/Power], as well as their Host’s [Current-Procedures] on greater detail than before due to a refurbished [Array] allowing greater bandwidth and latency optimization comparable to a full-fledged [Broadcast] Shard. Just with the [Broadcast] add-on, other Shards’ interactions are often influenced by their [Hosts], taken or mirroring their personality traits, making it easier to strike [Data] exchanges or outright discussions disclosing sensitive information about generally anything if you establish a good rapport.

The few most distinct usable abilities you obtained through this [Array], is its full manifestation: Entity-to-Entity Communication necessitates a quantious amount of [Energy] and [Force] to convey a [Word], which you gain a multifaceted manifestation gaining various forms: you can simply express an idea to anyone and the whole world knows it, both destructively as both abstract screams within their minds to long distances, a shout capable of rending anything for Entities to comprehend you on their terms, among others.
addons.title: [Mass Comms Array]

addons.text:
Access Denied: Root/Administrator access only.
This incident will be reported.
addons.title: [ACCESS]:[DENIED]

objects.text:
You gain the conscious ability to reach out and speak to other Shards, allowing you to have reciprocal understanding and transmission between you and Shards.

You can use this to request [Data] packet transfers between your Shard and themselves and gather environmental or personal information they might have access to, such as [Host-Data] and [Power/Expression-Data.Ping] enabling your Shard to replicate their powers or implement it on either of your current powers. This relies on your ability to get the Shard to agree with your request and comply with their demands or trade.

You gain an awareness of a Shard's current [Power/Expression] and [Designation/Function] within 30ft of its user and a burst of information pertaining to their rank, function, and potential power within the Entity network when you connect with them for the first time. This power also assures that the Shards you interact with will not report back on your abilities, interactions, or plans (with Shards unable to sense your Negentropy unless you bring it up).
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) [Query] [Response]

objects.text:
Your body emits an undetectable virus within a small range of 5ft around you. You can choose which people are actively infected with a thought, as everyone touched by the aura their infection lays dormant.

The actively infected limit is 200 and Shard users take up more than one slot depending on ability, Eidolon, for example, takes 100 while Alexandria takes 35.

Endbringer's cores are the only part that can be infected with this power, the range still applies but it must be concerning the core. An active Infected Endbringer costs 120 (you'll need some help for this one, for sure).

The infected will begin to act differently from their normal selves, becoming more powerful ability-wise as well, they will also begin to hate what you tell them to and think about things as you do. These changes are not instant but slow-going, taking about a week.

While you can change an Active Infected back to a Dormant Infected, this will take only 30 seconds and will remember everything they did during their active time. They will almost certainly assume you Mastered them if you ever gave them direct commands but will assume nothing other than the fact that they were acting strange if all you did was a subtle influence.

After activation, they will be incredibly loyal to you and never question why, they will hang on to your every word and command even dying for you. When not near you they will act on your mental commands, or in your best interests (with Entities being immune).
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Logic Virus

objects.text: You can give yourself any one of the Tier 1 powers in this CYOA. The power takes a couple of minutes to build up strength, although it's still usable before reaching full strength. Possessing Negentropy or being Shardless removes the need to access from an existing list, instead allowing you to summon any power you can think of that is equal to a T1 power. You also gain a secondary thinker power that is a catalogue of the current list of T1 powers, which now includes all powers from Power Copy, as well as all Upgrades and Fusions that don't exceed 15 SP, and allows you to instantly and intuitively choose from it. It will continue to expand as you summon new powers.
objects.title: (Trump) Paramount

objects.text: Every day you get to roll for 3 random powers. However, these powers are completely random, last for a random amount of time, and how powerful these abilities are is also completely random (never higher than a 9). After a power disappears, you can roll for another power. There is a 1 in 100 chance that a random power is permanent and will not disappear. This chance is not affected by luck powers. When you get a permanent power, you gain another slot to roll powers in so that you are always able to roll for 3 powers. The powers may be inconvenient to you, such as an aura that causes everyone within to have bad luck, including you.
objects.title: (Trump) Randomizer

objects.text: You can create a projection that is a hole in reality, only selectively affected by physical forces, and it can extend this effect to anyone and anything it's touching, except yourself. The projection can be in any shape and form you wish; you can alter its form at any time when summoning it.
objects.title: (Master) Manton

objects.text:
You can create and control long astral needles with precision at up to 50mph. When a needle is piercing someone you can access and harvest something from their mind. This could be a memory, skill, personality trait, or anything else that is purely mental. You can then inject what you took into yourself or someone else. You can remove and insert partial aspects, such as taking hatred toward something and putting it into someone else tied to something else. You can only interact with aspects of the thinker's powers that would remain even if the Parahuman's power was nullified.

Your needles can access the corona of pierced parahumans. You can harvest and inject traits of powers, such as methods of control, power-granted senses, and other such things.
objects.title: (Blaster/Master) Pithing Needle

objects.text:
You will have the powers, skills, and abilities people of a certain collective think you have. For instance, if you choose the PRT you will have all the abilities, powers, and skills that they think you possess. The more people in a collective the more stable this power is. And over a certain amount, the powers gained are much stronger than what anyone thinks. If the majority of the global population thinks you have something, you possess that power permanently. However, you cannot become strong enough to destroy the planet. But if they think you can move the stars, you'll be able to gain a power that lets it seem like you can.

You can swap between which collective you are currently gaining powers from, but it takes a couple of minutes. The more a collective disagrees with what you possess, the more unreliable and weaker it is.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Who Do You Think I Am?

objects.text: You can warp yourself and those you touch anywhere you ask. If you want to go somewhere safe, you will teleport somewhere that will be safe. If you want to teleport somewhere that will help you achieve a goal, you will teleport to a location that can assist with that. You don't even need a clear image to teleport.
objects.title: (Mover/Thinker) Ideal Transit

objects.text: Hear that? Perhaps you didn’t. Sound and vibrations are yours to control. Among these abilities, is the power to generate and control shockwaves; you can generate shockwaves strong enough to send large cyborgs flying off their feet, or to destroy objects, to the point that you could easily collapse buildings with them. Alongside this, you can also manipulate or shatter things with acoustic resonance. You are also able to use vibrations for sensory purposes, such as with echolocation. This manipulation of vibrations also allows you to deafen or even remove sound and vibrations from you and your surroundings, rendering yourself and/or the environment silent.
objects.title: (Shaker) The Sound of Silence

objects.text:
You can create and visualize alternate dimensions and universes that allow you to send designated targets within your vision to them. This is accurate enough to send handheld tools or even worn armor to different pocket dimensions while being held. You can even send yourself or other people there. While there are a vast amount of options, you can create hostile miniature dimensions that can have a variety of different effects that don't match normal physics. Such as Dimensions where Machines cannot work or Dimensions where it perfectly matches a universe.

You cannot create sentient life with this ability. And the effects of the created dimensions apply to you as well as anything or anyone there.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Dimension Tripper

objects.text:
You can change your shadow to be a replica of a single person that possesses all the abilities, skills, and knowledge of the subject. You have complete control over it and can utilize the replica to be indistinguishable from the original. It can even pretend to be a real person. 

The phantom can swap between chosen forms freely, but they must be real. The phantom cannot be larger than your own shadow. For the duration of the Phantom's existence, you no longer have any shadows.
objects.title: (Master) Perfect Phantom

objects.text: Your self-belief has power. As long as you believe yourself to be something, you will be it. This lets you instantly teleport to any location by believing you are there, heal from any wound by believing you are unscathed, or change your form by believing that it is your appearance. The only limitations are that it cannot augment your powers or mind, create items, or affect others. You cannot believe you have the powers of Eidolon and suddenly have the powers of Eidolon or believe that you are the richest person in the world to get money. This power also maintains your consciousness if you assume a form that doesn't have a mind, such as a pool of water. Your consciousness is maintained even in death, allowing you to resurrect yourself.
objects.title: (Breaker/Changer) Cogito Ergo Sum

objects.text:
You can create a monster based on the sins of the selected person. Their strength correlates to the amount of good and bad sins they've committed in their life based on personal ideology. Its power will be capable of countering the chosen target.

The monster's intelligence and strength scales directly to the number of sins the target selected. You can target them from anywhere as long as you know their name. If they committed enough sins, the monster would be able to outsmart their enemy like some kind of 5D Chess. If the monster defeats the target, they shall stay and help you for other things.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Sin Manifestation

objects.text:
You're a Tinker specializing in biological plagues and horrors. You can build all sorts of weapons that can wreak havoc on the population. From zombie viruses to fungus that infects anything alive, you can even create creatures that overtake sewers and create earthquakes. Your zombies are even able to use their knowledge, skills, and powers in life to best infect others.

You can make yourself or others immune to any form of pathogen or infection even if you didn't create them. Your zombies won't target you or your work either even if you're a perfect meal.
objects.title: (Tinker) Infection

objects.text:
You specialize in a conceptual form of tinkering centered on Solarpunk, the idea of a sustainable future where nature and technology exist in harmony instead of opposition.

Your work spans a wide range of fields, including renewable energy, arcology design, climate technology, alternative materials, drones, medicine, horticulture and agriculture, full prosthetic limbs, terraforming, genetic and biological enhancement, and information storage. If a piece of technology fits within the ideals of a thriving Solarpunk future, you have the potential to create it. 

You can also redesign existing technology to fit those ideals. A gas-powered car could be converted into a solar-assisted electric vehicle, or a standard smartphone could be rebuilt using safer, longer-lasting materials, your creations are built to function reliably for generations.

Alongside this, you possess a Thinker power focused on the societal side of progress. You understand how to reshape systems so they actually support people. This includes redesigning economic structures to prioritize communities over profit, ensuring access to basic needs like housing, food, and healthcare, and developing governance systems that allow real democratic participation. When applied correctly, these changes can create stable, long-lasting societies.

Finally, you have a Striker ability that allows you to convert plant matter into usable technological components through touch. These components function like their inorganic equivalents but retain plant-like properties. If damaged, they can be planted in soil and will regrow. 

You can also give them reproductive traits, allowing them to grow into plants that produce more of that component, and even crossbreed them to create new variations. These plant-based components are resistant to supernatural interference and cannot be altered by other plant manipulators.

Reject the doom and praise the Sun!
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) Solarpunk

objects.text:
You specialize in a conceptual form of tinkering that goes against the principles of Solarpunk, envisioning a potential future that diverges from the sustainable ideals of harmonizing nature and technology. Your expertise lies in areas that deviate from renewable energy and environmentally conscious practices. Instead, you focus on fields such as fossil fuel extraction, heavy industry, resource exploitation, advanced weaponry, surveillance technology, genetic manipulation for profit-driven purposes, and disruptive technologies with little regard for ecological balance.

With your knowledge, you excel in redesigning technologies to maximize efficiency, profit, and power, often at the expense of environmental well-being. You have an enhanced memory for these exploitative practices and possess the ability to manipulate and corrupt plant material for industrial purposes, devoid of their natural properties. These modified components resist supernatural manipulation, making them impervious to chlorokinetics or any other form of natural influence. Embrace a dystopian vision and prioritize the pursuit of power and profit over environmental sustainability.
objects.title: (Tinker) Cyber Dystopia

objects.text:
You have a Tinker power that is twofold while focusing on the same fundamental concept: the mind. The first aspect concerns the mind and all of its physical aspects and the second aspect focuses on psionic power and the tech to manipulate it.

To begin with, the sciences surrounding the mind comes to you as naturally as breathing. Neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology, computational and developmental sciences, medicine, engineering, and even the study of intelligence are all fields you instinctively understand. As long as something fundamentally concerns the mind, you can create it, whether that means advanced neural scanners, treatments for neurodegenerative diseases, or bioware and cyberware that improve memory, intelligence, and cognition.

Your greatest strength, however, is biological and neural engineering. You can build biological supercomputers from neural structures, develop sophisticated BCIs, redesigning the brain from the ground up even maybe add some more lobes in there, make nervous systems more efficient, and even create entirely new structures within the brain. You could preserve a brain outside the body for decades before placing it into a new one with the person experiencing almost no interruption, or alter lesser creatures until they possess genuine sapience. Memory manipulation, modification, and implantation are also within your reach, as are skill implantation and other forms of direct neural engineering. You can bring this expertise into other fields as well, such as improving VR interfaces or preventing unwanted effects when technology directly interacts with the human mind. And, naturally, you understand the darker applications of this knowledge just as well.

You also possess a Thinker aspect centered on psychology. By studying someone's behavior, you can gradually build an increasingly accurate model of how their conscious and unconscious mind works. With enough research, you could become a world-class psychologist and an exceptional therapist, capable of understanding people on an individual level rather than relying only on broad behavioral models. You can use that insight to develop personalized treatments, mental routines, and interventions for psychological or neurological problems, making your understanding of the mind useful even when no Tinker technology is involved.

The second aspect allows you to push the limits of what the mind can do through psionics. You can develop technologies, biological modifications, and procedures that induce psychic abilities in living creatures, whether they are sapient or not. By altering the mind and nervous system to generate and manipulate psychic energy, you can grant basic abilities such as telepathy, telekinesis, ESP, psychic blasts, shielding, and mental enhancement. Those are only the foundation; through experimentation and studying other forms of mental power, you can create stronger psychics capable of things like elemental manipulation, glimpses of the future, psychometry, long-range astral projection, or even mind control.

You can also engineer artificial psionics, creating machines that reproduce or interact with psychic phenomena. Artificial psychic neural circuits could allow machines to communicate without conventional signals, while telekinetic systems could let drones manipulate objects far heavier than themselves. You can build weapons powered by psionic energy, devices that implant skills through psychic stimulation, equipment that enhances or suppresses psychic abilities, and defenses against telepathy and mind control. Given enough development, you can even devise ways to permanently remove psychic powers from someone, treating psionics as another field of engineering rather than something that must occur naturally.

At the highest levels of your understanding, even consciousness itself becomes something you can work with. You can determine what actually constitutes a living person's identity and use that knowledge to transfer their consciousness into another body without creating a mental duplicate or losing the original person in the process. The result is genuinely the same individual, not a copy that merely believes they are. Unless, of course, you deliberately decide to make a duplicate, you sicko. At your zenith, the mind is no longer simply something you understand or manipulate; it is a field you can preserve, redesign, enhance, extend, and ultimately push into entirely new forms of existence. The mind is your oyster, and you love shellfish.
objects.title: (Tinker/Trump) Mind is Matter and It'll Make the Whole World Go Round

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge specializing in mega factory, mass production, and industrialization. With expertise in building massive industrial complexes, optimizing production lines, and managing vast logistical networks, you become a master of this advanced field. Your abilities encompass constructing colossal factories, automating processes on an unprecedented scale, and streamlining the mass production of goods. Armed with this knowledge, you revolutionize industrialization, reshape economies, and propel civilizations into a new era of productivity and abundance.

With your combined expertise in mega factory, mass production, and industrialization, you become a visionary leader, driving the rapid expansion and transformation of industrial landscapes. You harness cutting-edge technologies, employ advanced robotics and artificial intelligence, and optimize resource utilization to fuel unprecedented levels of output. The world becomes your canvas as you create towering manufacturing complexes, interconnected networks of production facilities, and vast supply chains spanning entire continents. Your mastery of mega factory technology propels you to the forefront of innovation and economic prosperity, forever shaping the destiny of civilizations.
objects.title: (Tinker) The Factory Must Grow

objects.text:
You acquire the unparalleled skill and knowledge to invent anything that is theoretically possible within a century. With a deep understanding of scientific principles, engineering concepts, and innovative thinking, you possess the ability to bring forth groundbreaking creations and technological advancements.

Armed with this expertise, you can conceive and develop revolutionary inventions, pushing the boundaries of what is achievable in various fields. From advanced robotics and artificial intelligence to renewable energy solutions and space exploration technologies, your creative potential knows no bounds. With your visionary mind and mastery of scientific principles, you become a catalyst for progress, shaping the future with inventions that were once only dreams.
objects.title: (Tinker) Upcoming Century

objects.text: You gain technological knowledge specializing in mega structuring and stellar engineering. With expertise in harnessing stellar energy, constructing colossal structures, and optimizing production on a massive scale, you become a master of this advanced field. Your abilities encompass building Dyson Spheres, creating interstellar factories, and designing intricate supply chains. Armed with this knowledge, you reshape celestial bodies, unlock untold potential, and become a visionary architect of a grand technological civilization in the cosmos.
objects.title: (Tinker) Dyson Sphere Program

objects.text:
You possess the power to manipulate plants in countless ways, shaping them to meet your every need or desire. 

This power gives you an unlimited capacity to multitask and complete mental awareness over all plants within a 1 km radius of yourself. You can control plants within this radius but it is limited to those you have directly interacted with; for example, planting, watering, tinkering or physical contact. Through this, you can make any plants under your control grow, move and act as you desire.

You can massively accelerate the growth of any plants under your control, enabling them to develop within days rather than months or years. You are capable of enhancing their strength and durability to be equal to the toughest natural woods and can increase their size significantly beyond what's normally possible. You can freely modify their shape if you have enough plant material to work with and adjust the characteristics of the plants under your control to possess particular properties. This encompasses natural properties that plant species have, such as toxin production, fire-resistant bark etc, but can also include the properties of plants that you subsequently create through the tinker aspect of this power.

Your tinker focus is broad and versatile, allowing you to tinker with any plant species you come across and beyond. You can vastly improve and expand upon the original properties of plants, such as augmenting their ability to photosynthesis, or also develop completely new properties in your plants such as secreting strong acids, generating bioelectricity or actively camouflaging. You can intermix different species of plants together to form hybrids and create entirely new species to suit your purposes such as predatorial meat-eating trees, flowers with explosive seeds and much, much more. This power noticeably improves and synergises well with any other plant-based power.
objects.title: (Master/Tinker) Master of Green

objects.text:
You now have the ability to manipulate darkness and shadows with precision and control. Able to create, shape, and harness them for various purposes. While Darkness is mostly used to cloud everything into complete obscurity, it can also be harnessed as both the absence of light and a tangible substance. With it, you possess the capacity to manipulate entities existing within darkness, establish and dissolve shields and areas of absolute darkness, construct tools and weaponry sharp enough to rend through steel like a hot knife through butter, make shadowy servants that are able to go toe to toe with high-level brutes, teleport vast distances by traversing through shadows, your versatility with this power is bound only by the extent of your imagination. Your range extends within a radius of 200 meters around you. You also get unlimited multitasking with this.
It is worth noting that powers based on light are particularly potent against you. However, your ability to withstand and resist these light-based abilities increases in darker environments, allowing you to maintain a stronger defense against them.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Nyx

objects.text: With this power, you can manipulate light with precision and control. You have the ability to create, shape, and harness light for various purposes. While light is typically used to illuminate everything, it can also be harnessed as a form of extreme heat and a tangible substance. With this power, you have the capability to manipulate entities within light, establish and dissolve shields and areas of blinding light, construct tools and weaponry sharp enough to rend through steel like a hot knife through butter, create radiant servants that are able to go toe to toe with high-level brutes, teleport vast distances by traversing through bright light, and your versatility with this power is only limited by your imagination. Your range extends within a radius of 200 meters around you, and you can also harness unlimited multitasking with this power. It's worth noting that powers based on darkness can pose a significant threat to you, but your ability to withstand and resist these dark-based abilities increases in brighter environments, allowing you to maintain a stronger defense against them.
objects.title: (Shaker/Mover) Eos

objects.text:
Imagine being able to pull out any object from your favourite stories, as long as it fits on a screen or a page. You can reach out and grab anything from fiction, whether it's a magic wand, a lightsaber, or a sonic screwdriver. The only catch is that the more powerful the item is, the more energy it drains from you. The more popular and widely known the item is on the other hand, the easier it is for you to access it. So you can't just grab some obscure artefact from a forgotten book and expect it to work. But you can use Harry Potter's invisibility cloak or Doctor Who's psychic paper with no problem. 

You start out being able to summon objects equivalent to a PRT Rating 5 in power if they're somewhat well-known. Over time this power will grow, particularly with practice and usage, allowing you to summon stronger and more obscure objects. The maximum power of an object you could theoretically acquire is limited to a PRT Rating 10.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Fictiportation

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to transform into a nightmarish creature of flesh and bones. Your body undergoes a terrifying metamorphosis, granting you a range of unique biological abilities and advantages, turning you into a grotesque amalgamation of writhing tendrils, razor-sharp teeth, and flexible appendages. Your very form is now highly malleable, granting you the ability to shapeshift into any form you can think of and allowing you to effortlessly navigate through cramped spaces and contort yourself to fit into tight crevices.

Your physical prowess is greatly enhanced, enabling you to shatter barriers and crush obstacles with your raw strength. Additionally, your regenerative capabilities become extraordinary, allowing you to heal and adapt rapidly from any wounds and instantaneously reattach severed body parts.

In this form, you possess an arsenal of biological attacks. Your tendrils can lash out, ensnaring and pulling enemies towards you, while your teeth can tear through flesh and bone effortlessly. Consuming the biomass of defeated foes replenishes your vitality and grants you knowledge of those you've devoured. The more biomass you possess the stronger you become. 

Your biological adaptations extend to your sensory capabilities as well. Your perception is heightened, allowing you to sense the biological composition of living creatures and analyze their vulnerabilities. This enhanced awareness grants you a form of weak precognition, enabling you to anticipate your opponent's moves to some extent.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Carrion

objects.text:
You've gained the ability to generate a flesh seed from your own blood, which, when planted into the ground, triggers a macabre transformation of the surrounding land and living creatures.

At its initial stage, the flesh seed will sprout into small, grotesque plants that will begin to twist the other flora and fauna around it into biological abominations. These abominations exhibit a primal nature, driven by their insatiable hunger for flesh and their instinct to grow and adapt. As you progress and nourish your creations, they evolve and become increasingly formidable, growing larger, more complex, and more dangerous.

The twisted biome you cultivate possesses a symbiotic relationship with you. As the progenitor of this horrific ecosystem, you share a psychic link with the creatures and plants under your control, allowing you to exert influence over their actions and direct their growth. Through this connection, you gain an understanding of their needs and motivations, enhancing your ability to guide and command them.

As the twisted biome expands, it begins to exert an influence over the surrounding environment, gradually warping and distorting the land. This transformation grants you an increasingly advantageous position, as the corrupted environment supports the growth of even more formidable and monstrous beings.
objects.title: (Changer/Master) The Flesh That Hungers

objects.text: You have 3 regenerating charges of power a day that can be invested into a [Liminal Threshold], which can be defined as the boundary between any two differentiated areas, investing a charge of power into the Liminal Threshold creates a separate layer of reality called the Liminal Landscape, that things cross into if they pass over the invested liminal threshold. This is a directional threshold, and connected thresholds can be used to implement other bits and pieces into the landscape. Each charge increases the size of the Landscape as well as the depth of your control over it. Your control over the liminal space is determined by the amount of charges you have, + whatever charges are invested in the landscape. You are able to change multiple properties of the landscape beside the topology, within the landscape you can summon or create tools/interfaces in order to allow you to change and manipulate any of the sensorial features of the Landscape Such as sound, lighting, smell, and various other cosmetic or aesthetic things. You cannot directly control around living things, but your speed of change is rapid outside that area.
objects.title: (Shaker) Liminal Landscaper

objects.text:
You have gained the incredible power to reconstruct the molecular structures of anything you touch with astounding precision. By making contact with an object or individual, you instantly comprehend their molecular arrangements, granting you the power to rearrange and alter them at will.

With this knowledge, you hold the ability to reconstruct your own body, granting you the power of pseudo-shape-shifting. Through precise manipulation of your molecular structure, you can adapt your physical form to suit various situations or assume different identities.
Initially, the range of your Overhaul power spans approximately 99 meters from your point of contact. However, as you grow in mastery and experience, both the potency and range of your abilities will expand over time. This gradual growth ensures that you can exert your influence over a broader area and manipulate molecules with increasing finesse.

In addition to these extraordinary capabilities, Overhaul grants you the option to disassemble, restore, or reshape any target you touch. Whether it is living or non-living, the choice rests in your hands.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Overhaul

objects.text:
You possess the ability to create flawless simulations of any individual from around the world within your mind. These simulations act as your personal teachers and advisors, dedicated to guiding and supporting you in your endeavors. Regardless of the person's identity, they willingly offer their knowledge and expertise, without any ulterior motives or intentions to harm or betray you.

Engaging with a simulated advisor allows you to benefit greatly from their wisdom and experience. While learning under their guidance, you experience twice the benefits, while requiring only half the effort. This advantage accelerates your learning and enables you to acquire any skill that your simulated advisor has mastered.

It is important to note that while the simulations can impart knowledge and skills, they cannot grant you powers or abilities that are beyond your inherent potential. You can only acquire abilities that align with your existing capabilities, and the range of expertise possessed by your simulated advisors.

You are capable of maintaining one simulation at a time, ensuring a focused and dedicated learning experience. Although you can create simulations of anyone, you can only change the individual being simulated once every three days. However, you have the freedom to drop the simulation at any time should you desire a change or feel the need to explore a different mentor.
objects.title: (Thinker) Simulacrum Advisor

addons.text:
Your power serves a unique purpose beyond merely stress-testing the Entity scientific database from the ground up. It is tailored to detect anything overlooked by the Pair, deemed unreliable to test, or considered a dead end. Specifically, your ability is honed to challenge the scientific database against any new phenomena it encounters, including Out of Context anomalies or forbidden avenues like the spatial camouflage of Core Shards or the Virtual Space called the Firmament/Shard Space.

As a result, your only limitations lie in phenomenons you can only personally research for various reasons. You possess the capability to investigate phenomena such as Magic, Psionics, QI/CHI, or any Out of Context problems you encounter, even without possessing Esoteric Knowledge (Your research speed will accelerate tremendous if you have it though).
addons.title: Innovation

addons.text: You can create tinkertech that perfectly replicates any power that you’ve had an opportunity to analyze. This doesn’t not have to be a 1:1 recreation, instead this allows you to break down the principles behind the power and freely use it for your own uses, including building tinkertech that perfectly replicates it.
addons.title: Copyright Infringement

addons.text:
Your shard was designed to bridge the gap between the mystical and the technological. Your spells, techniques, enchantments and schemes are no longer restricted from Tinker effects, and you may integrate your arcane abilities into your tinkertech.

You can create magical effects that encode or teach schematics or partial tech trees (full tech trees with Archmage) you have already researched, instantly assemble blueprints, or provide insight into your tinker research. You can also cast or enchant tinker-adjacent effects like conjuring bound tools, transmuting resources, or fueling tinkertech with your own energies. 

Tech trees for arcane implements such as data-storage tomes, electronic totems, wands and staves, biotinkered familiars, power-generating altars and more that can interface with and enhance your arcane systems become available to you. You may also use your arcane techniques to create magitech components for tinkertech; such as runic engravings, elemental crystals, alchemical materials, mythical creature cells, mana-based energy systems and more.

You may use the knowledge gathered by researching spells and patterns, honing techniques and disciplines, or refining schemes in order to invent new tinkertech and unlock tech trees based on the principles of those arcane abilities. Similarly, when you research or iterate on your own tech trees or analyze other tinkertech and powers, then you may contribute your findings and innovations to your arcane knowledge as well.
addons.title: Unity of Magic and Technology

objects.text: You are an Omni-Tinker with access to every technology tree, however, your access is initially limited, but as you create Tinkertech, your access to these trees expands. Initially, your inventions closely resemble conventional technology. Yet, by crafting Tinkertech, you unlock greater access to every technology tree involved in its creation. Furthermore, studying Parahumans and other Tinkers' technology grants partial access to their respective trees. With extensive analysis, you can eventually gain full access to any capability possessed by those Tinkers, and even create Tinkertech that replicates or is based on any power you have sufficiently analyzed.
objects.title: (Tinker) Research And Development

objects.text:
You have six powers:

Your primary power is a Master power that lets you influence anyone in your vicinity, which realigns parahuman cognition into being your subjects.

The second power is telekinesis; as a powerful long-range expression of this ability you can fly, have super-strength, and manipulate objects and people. Your telekinesis manifests as fractal patterns in the air, and although you are only capable of moving inorganic objects, you are capable of seizing people by their clothes.

Third, you have a touch-based Trump ability that lets you tune abilities and defenses in a manner akin to Scion.

Fourth, you have a danger sense. Your danger sense will alert you to the strength and direction of any danger that you face. If the danger is overwhelming, such as in the case of Scion or Contessa, you will feel danger with a distinct lack of direction.

Fifth, you have a personal power battery, that you can tap to strengthen your abilities for limited amounts of time. When used in conjunction with your Master ability, the influence can spread between capes like a virus.

The sixth power is unknown. You may freely decide what it is so long as it's no stronger than high Tier 1.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Goddess

objects.text:
You’re a Tinker capable of creating The Machine Army, a swarm of self-replicating, self-enhancing AI machines that even without a Tinker to maintain them, could take over a town and remain a persistent problem for years, capable of incorporating foreign Tinkertech and spreading even through multiple attempts to contain them. The Machine Army has a multitudinous decentralized cell structure, with all cells marching to a common purpose while still independent.

The Machine Army by design will take the time to 'seed' solid surfaces, wherever they go, with metallic-looking ores for future machine growth. If left unattended, these seeds will hatch into new and full Machine Army installations, they are hard to make out and find due to being partially extradimensional.

The Machine Army can infect a building and slowly, but steadily, replace the entire structure with murderous facsimiles. The same buildings later can be armed and put on tracks, turning them into massive siege weapons. Machine Army collects and recycles organic matter and sometimes uses its victims as parts of mechanisms. 

The Machine Army lays traps for people by becoming buildings, or more accurately, becoming facsimiles of buildings, in an attempt to lure people inside. Until a target enters, the machines remain dormant, but when individuals wander into the trap they will activate and kill the intruders.

Even without actively interfering with them they can adapt continuously about once every year or two, discovering a new trick or piece of research that could then be incorporated into their arsenal, some examples being: 
-Big cannon-drones. Which have serious destructive power. 
-Slave-Mechs. Drones which captured people to use as both hostage and power supply. If a captured hostage had powers and/or a trigger event while captured, the relevant machine would try to borrow the hostage's powers to empower itself.
-Meat lockers. These drones run organic computers and act with fervor and unpredictability.
-Inter-dimensional technology. To compress itself into interdimensional pockets that will pop open and continue to spread if they are attacked.

As the Tinker capable of creating this swarm you can greatly influence how The Machine Army acts and develops, like branching out their capabilities and making them develop flight, shielding, or intelligence. Using the Tinkertech of others to greatly advance their versatility, or altering their behaviors and breeding cycles, whether by planting hidden seeds of them all over the country or taking over the ocean with none the wiser. 

Although there's quite a lot of ways you can focus their growth it's still going to take them time to improve, even though your oversight over that growth can drastically speed up the timetable as you prune and lead them towards the functions you desire them to excel in.

Lastly you're exceedingly capable at subsuming self-improving machines and putting a leash on them, be it your own or those of others who’ve gone rogue.
objects.title: (Tinker) Machine Army

objects.text:
