You can make golden doorways back in time for around a few minutes. It takes concentration to open them and maintain them, so you can only open them nearby or through a screen. It gets harder and harder to chain multiple portals so you can't travel through days and days on end. Anyone passing through will replace their past selves but now have their future's injuries and possessions.

You can make a "time bomb" by looping light between two portals, aided by your power to become increasingly powerful with time.

(You're unable to go before your entry unless you have Homecoming.)
objects.title: (Shaker) Phir Sē

objects.text: Anyone who has you on their mind loses their connection to their shard, causing them to be unable to use their powers. This power is always active by default, but Holding Back allows you to decide who is affected.
objects.title: (Trump) Nullification Hazard

addons.text:
Your ribbons have learned from your ability to create hardlight constructs, gaining a new application. Separate from your hardlight limit, you can shape your ribbons into constructs, capable of perfectly mimicking the shape and properties of matter, subject to the same requirements as your hardlight, i.e. understanding blueprints and chemical makeup.

Of course, as you can simply create more ribbons you’re not really bound by a total mass limit, however in order to exert control over your ribbon constructs you must have a ribbon remain in contact with them. 

Additionally, created constructs can express drained powers like normal, allowing newfound applications such as a gun which fires a combination of Blaster powers or a physical barrier imbued with a Brute power for durability.
addons.title: Ribbon Constructs

addons.text: Your ribbons have subsumed your Breaker power, transforming it. Rather than simply cloaking yourself in metallic ribbons, you instead directly convert your body into the same kind of power draining ribbons you produce. This conversion is not permanent and can be undone at will, and while if the ribbons that made up your body were destroyed you will reform damaged, you can also heal by simply absorbing other ribbons to replace the lost ones. You can even selectively convert only part of your body into ribbons instead of a full transformation, allowing for things like unraveling into ribbons to dodge attacks or briefly transforming a wounded region to absorb ribbons to heal. This transformation retains all of (Breaker) Lord of Loss’s benefits, however as you are composed of your power draining ribbons you can also drain power and express drained powers. As a side effect, this allows you to effectively sidestep the limitation of being unable to use drained powers yourself while transformed.
addons.title: Candeloro

objects.text: You are able to create ribbons from your body that you have precise telekinetic control over. By default they are as strong as steel, and they can get stronger by leeching powers off of living parahumans they touch. As you drain parahumans, their powers get weak and weaker until they are gone forever. While you do not get these powers yourself, you will have control over the different powers that your ribbons manifest. Your ribbons may have an unlimited number of powers, and they all share them with each other, making it impossible to lose them without outside trump influence. It takes 8 minutes to completely drain a parahuman's powers, and you may turn off the leeching at any time.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Ribbons

addons.text:
Your connection to plant life has expanded beyond just the magical plants you sow. Now, any plant under your control—whether ordinary or supernatural—can develop powers over time. You are no longer bound by the slow, halving growth rate of your magical plants, as even mundane flora can be uplifted through your influence, starting with minor enhancements like increased resilience, faster growth, or subtle elemental affinities. Over time, these normal plants can grow into something far more powerful, gaining abilities similar to—but not quite as strong as—your magical plants.

This greatly expands your influence, as you’re no longer limited to the plants you personally sow. Forests, gardens, and even wild weeds can become conduits for power, growing stronger the longer they remain under your watch. Because you can now enhance all plants under your control, you have more ways to support and accelerate the growth of your magical plants. A grove of empowered trees could feed life energy into a newly planted magical seedling, speeding its development. You can crossbreed between plants, creating new hybrids that has the strength of both its parents. Even weeds and invasive species become valuable assets, growing into defensive barriers or spreading new abilities through the land like wildfire.

Your power is no longer limited to what you plant yourself. Every root, stem, and leaf you command has the potential to become something extraordinary. With time, even the most unassuming plant could evolve into a force of nature, and the forests under your dominion could grow into realms of power, reshaped entirely by your will.
addons.title: Verdant Patron

objects.text:
You can grow magical plants that can grow Shards of their own, causing them to gain powers. When you first plant them, you can choose a theme that the power will take on, though the exact specifics will be random. They grow at a rate of 1 SP every 3 days, but the growing rate halves every 15 SP. Every day you can choose to either sow a new plant or boost the growth of a previous plant, causing it to instantly grow 3 days of growth in any direction you want. The ways these plants may manifest their powers vary, but you have a natural psychic link with your plants, allowing you to control their powers. 

These manifestations may be things like plants that shoot fireballs, slow time around them, or even grow fruit that when consumed give temporary powers. By taking care of and showing love to your plants, you can slightly encourage how the plants improve their powers, with their surrounding environment playing a heavy factor. New plants may germinate from the seeds of these plants, though they will only start half as strong as the original, and grow half as fast.
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Magical Plant

addons.text: Your aura’s benefits, from the subconscious calculation and intuitive control, to the understanding of what lies within it, now apply to the entire radius of your reality alteration and not just the 15 cm nearest to you.
addons.title: The Dictator

addons.text:
Your 15 centimeters of control is no longer calculated from your body, but also your mist, vastly increasing its range. While you still have to manoeuvre your mist into position to use it, any amount of it counts as ‘you’ and thus even a small mite would produce a 15cm orb of your aura and its associated benefits.

If you have Archmagus, with its ability to blanket entire landscapes in your mist, you would become an utter force of nature.
addons.title: Grand Magus

objects.text:
You possess near-absolute dominion over all forces within a 15cm radius of your body. In combat, you can unleash punches and strikes that appear ordinary but carry unimaginable force, amplifying the energy behind them to levels beyond comprehension, resulting in devastating impacts akin to meteoric collisions. Or, through your precise control over kinetic energy, effortlessly drain the momentum of bullets fired at you, suspending them in mid-air as harmless projectiles.

Beyond raw strength, you can even manipulate all electromagnetic fields near you. With a touch, you can render electronic devices useless or generate devastating surges.

Furthermore, your mind is enhanced, enabling subconscious calculations of the forces you control with precision. This heightened cognitive ability allows you to effortlessly and intuitively manage the vast array of forces at your disposal, ensuring unparalleled and seamless control over the forces within your 15cm radius.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Tyrant

objects.text:
You have gained the power of Inversion, allowing you to manipulate the cause and effect of your actions within a 30-minute timeframe. With this ability, you can achieve astonishing feats by bending time to your advantage.

In your everyday life, simple tasks like packing your bags, or cooking become instant as you invert cause and effect, making your bag already packed with precisely what you would have included, or a meal already cooked the moment you walked into the kitchen. However, the accuracy of the outcome decreases the further in time you go, due to the increasing variables of possibilities. Within the first 10 minutes, you maintain nearly 99% accuracy in achieving your intentions. At the 20-minute mark, your accuracy remains around 90%, while at the 30-minute limit, it decreases to 80%.

In combat, your actions become unpredictable and unstoppable. You can fire a gun, and by inverting cause and effect, the bullets appear to have already hit the target before you even pull the trigger. As with everyday tasks, your accuracy diminishes as you approach the 30-minute limit.
objects.title: (Breaker) How The Turns Have Tabled!

objects.text:
You are able to recreate any natural phenomenon you understand, such as combustion, gravity, erosion, or even atmospheric pressure. However, to do this, you must fully understand both how the phenomenon works and how it will interact with your target or surroundings. It is not enough to know that something happens—you need to know why and how.

The better your understanding, the stronger and more controlled your effects will be. If your knowledge is weak or incomplete, your power may be unstable, weak, or fail completely. Simple effects, like generating heat through basic combustion, may be relatively easy if you understand oxygen’s role in the reaction. More complicated effects, such as electromagnetism or quantum interactions, require greater knowledge—both of the phenomenon itself and how it manifests and affects the place where it manifests.
objects.title: (Shaker) Natural World

objects.text:
You are able to animate and manipulate objects to fit your needs. However, the objects need to meet specific guidelines in order for you to do so. The objects must be palm-sized before they are animated and will grow to human-sized after the animation process is complete. To use this power, you must spend time using the objects and detailing or improving their quality. The durability and quality of the animated object are directly related to the starting material and the amount of time you spend using or improving it. 

The power of the animated objects is directly related to how you understand the rules governing the object's source material. Melee weapons or ballistics, which have simpler rules, can be easier for you to replicate than more complex systems, such as magic, which can have highly varied and unpredictable attacks. 

Shard limitations prevent the user from making anything that would match the power of an Endbringer. In addition to those limitations, the duration of your minions is tied to your stamina; the more you create at once as well as the more complex the rules their powers work by, the more stamina it costs to maintain.
objects.title: (Master) Chessman

objects.text:
"Mix and Match" gives you the ability to copy and combine components of powers, fusing, modifying and forging them to create usable abilities. By looking at a Cape, you will gain an understanding of how their power works, and of each component. You can copy no more than three components from each cape. 

You can make as many powers as you want, but you can only have 3 active at once. It will take a few seconds so swich powers.

The strength of each power is capped, with a peak power level equivalent to peak Eidolon. The construction of Trump powers has specific guidelines to prevent altering rules, such as permanently acquiring or creating other powers, as well as bypassing the limited capacity of the power. However, creating temporary copies of powers is allowed.
objects.title: (Trump) Mix And Match

objects.text:
After touching your target for a minute, you are capable of erasing your target's existence, including other people's memories of them and all traces of their identity in the form of photos, documents, and the like, preserving only your own memories of the target. This does not have an inherent protection from keeping others from noticing that they have lost their memories.

After you have erased their existence, the target becomes a featureless humanoid creature that you can control. This creature retains any skills or powers the target had. The target’s mind will be trapped in a room where they can experience everything their transformed body is experiencing.

You can undo this control, returning them to their original state and making all information of their existence return.
objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Identity

objects.text: This power grants its user the ability to revive themselves in a replicated body after their original form dies. When the user dies, a replicated body is created next to the corpse. The user's consciousness is then transferred to the replicated body, which resembles the original, allowing them to continue living. The replicated body will have all the equipment and objects on their original body's person, although it is limited to no more than three times their weight. The user may also control their original body after their death, transforming it into a zombie connected to the user as a hive mind. However, they are limited to only four zombies under their control simultaneously.
objects.title: (Master) Dead Body

objects.text: You can absorb the DNA of a single parahuman via touch, which can be used to produce a single clone of that parahuman. You can create multiple clones of a specific Parahuman. The cloning process takes 180 minutes, and the user can only create one clone at a time. During the cloning process, minor alterations to the clone's physical appearance and power expression can be made. You have a telepathic link with the clones, allowing you to command them from afar. All clones produced retain the original's memories and are capable of acting on their own. They are able to solve complex problems and think for themselves, and are given autonomy to make their own decisions. They are still loyal to their creator, but they are not completely obedient and can act independently if they believe it will benefit the creator. You are unable to create clones from other clones.
objects.title: (Master) Cloning

objects.text:
From Flesh to Metals. To veins and wires. From brains housing debatable definitions of sapience to powerful AI cores to blood and coolant; there is a long list of different specialties that can focus on either wetware or hardware. Sometimes merging in limited ways but all the same a difference between them. Biology can grow and evolve but can be slow when it comes to strong change. Technology is the aspect of progression and adaptation, able to be improved on countless times, but it is static if nothing pushes it forward, it will stagnate and rust.

But you? You, my good friend, are the singularity in both fields. You specialize in Techno-Organics or Bio-Mechatronics, deleting the boundaries between hard and wetware to create something better than the sum of its parts. From a set of power armor that can fused and stored within one's body granting increased protection to access to advanced weapons and digital systems. Creating modules that absorb other unclaimed tech and adapting to a system. Devices that can regenerate or even T.O.-nanites that can think and make quick adjustments faster than an average nanite could. Produce advanced T.O.-ware that can grant someone advanced nanotechnosis with nothing but a simple pill or shot maybe even a way to transfer one's consciousness perfectly with no error after enough study. Beasts of all shapes and sizes can be made, all outfitted with technology weaponry integrated into them so deeply that their descendants will have their modifications. The sky is the limit and nothing can hold you back.
objects.title: (Tinker) Techno-Organic

objects.text:
Unleash your inner Bond villain and turn any object into a reality-warping device—whether it be a gun, car, or even toaster—granting it phenomenal power. Convert your weapon into a devastating, space-shattering super beam; transform your car into a space-time manipulation device; or even turn your toaster into a device that can heat the entire world and launch it off its orbit.

However, these devices will come with a high price, requiring vast amounts of resources and manpower. Specific rare elements serve as the cornerstones of the devices—elements that cannot be fabricated in a lab or purchased commercially, but are found in locations that may be dangerous and inaccessible.

Obtaining these resources can consist of a trip to a challenging location, such as a deep-sea trench for heavy water, a core sample from an unstable glacier, geodes from the Earth's mantle, or mineral deposits from the dark side of the moon.

Other resources may require materials from someone’s possession or even be regarded as national treasures—such as the Hope Diamond—to work. The actual diamond itself is needed, not a similar stone or even an atomically perfect replica, as there is always a crucial component that facilitates the enormous power of these superweapons.

Your arsenal of super devices grows with your familiarity with technology and your ability to apply those specialties to new weaponry—such as robotic giant robots that grow as they eat metal, or mutagenic spores that can mutate the planet.
objects.title: (Tinker) Supervillain

objects.text:
You are capable of reviving deceased individuals and returning them to life. They will all have the (Brute) Zombie power. The longer a subject has been deceased before resurrection, the less memories and mannerisms they will retain. 

Zombies are free to act independently, though those who have been dead for longer will display less independent thought. The power of a revived individual will affect the amount of points required to control them. You start off with 100 points (150 with Negentrophy).

A zombie of an ordinary human will take up one point, while a zombie of a parahuman with a power equivalent to T1 will take up 5 points, a zombie of a parahuman with a power equivalent to T2 will take up 20 points, and a zombie of a parahuman with a power equivalent to T3 will take up 60 points. Finally, zombies of ordinary animals will take up less than two points, depending on the abilities of the animal.
objects.title: (Master) Undead

objects.text: Your senses have been greatly expanded. You can now extend your senses, for example, to see wide areas, multiple things at once, in other universes, whole cities, anyone, and anything. You can even recognize someone calling your name in an entirely different universe. You can scale your ability up and down to your normal senses at any time, and you can choose which senses get amplified and which don't. You can choose to exclude certain areas or subjects from your sight if you wish. You have also been granted the ability to actually make sense of everything you see, capable of easily handling the load of information that comes with seeing everything at once. Looking at everything at once is no more difficult than looking at a single thing at once in normal vision. You can bestow your vision on anyone you touch as well, and you can optionally choose to withhold your ability to withstand the information load to paralyze those you touch.
objects.title: (Thinker) Clairvoyant

objects.text: The power of creation is in your hands! How quickly you create complex matter from seemingly nothing entirely depends on the scale, complexity and your understanding of the end product. Creating a cubic foot of steel would only take moments, while an assault riffle will take minutes. However, something complex like a modern car would probably take a few hours or more, assuming you understand its inner workings.
objects.title: (Shaker) Baryonic Creation

objects.text: You gain an extensive understanding of planetary formation, evolution, taxonomy to build tinker structures that artificially restructure worlds to contain sustainable habitations for sentient/sapient life with sufficient time and resources (as well as per-existing conditions). You also gain a comprehensive understanding of sociobiology (stuff like behavioral simulation, population biology and game theory) as well as models on altruism and evolutionary strategies through intuitive socio-metrics tailored to pinpoint precisely how to expedite the growth of complex and sapient life through evolutionary pressures.
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) Gaia's Hand

objects.text: The opposite of [Gaia's Hand], you know how to construct tinker structures that methodically reduce a planet's capacity to sustain and grow life. Build massive structures that poison a planetary biosphere, or leverage your intuitive socio-biological understanding to gradually undermine the natural selection of a few planet's species in order to introduce fatal flaws in their biological makeup. This would obstruct progressive acclimatization to environmental changes, starting a domino effect that would eventually lead to ecological collapse.
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) Hades Protocol

objects.text: You gain three slots to put tinker specialties that you can hold for up to three weeks each or change after at least one. They are random, usually single-word things, like 'flames', 'robots', or even 'frogs'. While what you can build is vast in your specialties, they must fall within their topic: you wouldn't be able to create a cloning machine with 'robots', but could build an amphibian tank with 'frogs'. You can mix the specialties for better results, and things once built can be built again even after the specialty change, and can even be incorporated in new ones. You can maintain any tinker tech as well, regardless of your specialty. You don't have to change all specialties at once, but can’t hold the same one for longer than three weeks.
objects.title: (Tinker/Trump) Tinker of Chance

objects.text: You harbor an unparalleled awareness and insight into all entities that possess knowledge of you. This ability manifests as a sixth sense that enables you to detect their presence and discern the depth and nature of the information they hold about you. You can subtly manipulate those who are privy to your existence, as the number and specificity of those who know you dictate the extent of your control. Once at least 200 individuals possess knowledge of you, you can possess one person to act on your behalf for 10 minutes. Upon surpassing 500 individuals possessing knowledge of you, you are capable of possessing three individuals simultaneously for 1 hour. With more than 1000  individuals possessing knowledge of you, you can possess 10 people simultaneously indefinitely, with this cap increasing with further exposure. Your capacity to multitask scales with the number of individuals you can possess.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Memetic King

objects.text:
Choose a Punk specialization (Atompunk, Dieselpunk, Biopunk, Arcanepunk, Clockpunk, Nanopunk, etc.) and gain beginner-level knowledge of it. At level 0, you acquire basic knowledge of personal gadgets, equipment, and tools to Tinker. As you progress and reach an arbitrary level of production/infrastructure, you have the option to either level up within the same specialization or choose another one. A level-up is qualitative, allowing you to comprehend and produce more complex and far-reaching technologies, such as vehicles, bases, and troupe equipment.

At level 5, you become proficient in building all non-space-specific Tech of that specialization, giving you the ability to create entire continental structures and make world modifications. This includes societal, mechanical, auto-catalytic, or mental constructions, such as designing governmental structures or ideologies for the masses.

All level 2 specializations synergize in a positive feedback loop, allowing you to produce increasingly advanced Tinkertech and push the boundaries of what's possible within each specialization, capable of merging multiple Punk styles seamlessly so they're not separated.
objects.title: (Tinker/Trump) Embrace the Punk, Become PUNK

objects.text:
You have a trump version of Leet’s power, meaning you can manifest and use any possible combinations of powers at any level of strength a Shard can hand out to a host in a normal Cycle. These powers and any effects that rely on those powers last for up to a day each, then fade away.

Unfortunately, this power comes with drawbacks similar to Leet. While you can attempt to manifest the same power on separate occasions, the more alike a power you manifest is to a power you have previously manifested, the worse it is. This manifests in multiple ways: the power might be weaker, less accurate, harder to control, or fail to activate at all.

You can’t summon another copy of a power while you have a version of that power summoned, and while nothing is stopping you from using hundreds of different powers at once to overcome the weaknesses of repeated powers with sheer quantity, your power will be far more critical of you and the data you generate the more powers you use at once, leading to if you aren’t a good host and have a good relationship with your power for your power to start sabotaging your powers more severely. For example, a power to generate flames might not come with resistance to flames and might be extremely difficult to control.

If you use every possible power that can be handed out during a Cycle at once but don’t generate as much data as a Cycle in its entirety does in a day; well, you might be able to fight The Warrior’s avatar to a standstill while the entity is playing around for that period but at the end, your power will levy severe penalties against you regardless of your previous relationship with your power, unless you reached endgame QA and Taylor level host-Shard bond affinity.
objects.title: (Trump) Fading Star

objects.text:
Your allies are mushy, squishy and weak. Your enemies are dangerous and powerful. There are ways around this, but you cannot allow your allies to die so easily. As such, those you designate as allies grow powerful biological scales over themselves, capable of stopping most kinetic impacts (up to even Behemoth punching them) and even esoteric defenses that allow your allies to withstand up to 40% of the damage they would normally take by the enemy.

The scales have a third function. As the biological scales grow over your allies, they undergo a biological change, allowing them regeneration comparable to Lung in his base form, as well as Breaker defenses half that of Immune Response. These biological alterations fade with the scales after the battle ends, but they will allow your allies even further survivability. 

If you do not have allies, you can instead grow them from yourself, biological living entities made of these same scales. They are much weaker, and far more stupid, and will only ever last two minutes, but you can create a dozen before replenishing.
objects.title: (Master) Dragon-Mail

addons.text: You can now Tinker on your power Tinker specialty, be careful not to unintentionally weaken it.
addons.title: Restriction Removal

addons.text: Maker of the End’s specialty and principles allow for Tinkering with the bodies of Shards themselves to a certain extent, such as growing new Shardflesh for projects or repairing and modifying existing Shards should you get physical access to them. Should you possess Shard-Like you might even be able to create your own Shards, growing and coding them from the ground up. This greatly expands your capabilities, allowing you to manufacture your own powers.
addons.title: Shard Matter

objects.text:
You are a genuine power Tinker, meaning you create devices that interact with powers in general including your own. 

This power has a lot of leeway in how you go about it. Maybe you give a mundane individual the potential for a power via a simulated Trigger Event, giving them an appropriate ability based on the Shard they connect with and the parameters of the simulated Trigger. Or instead, you force a Second Trigger on an already powered individual. 

You are also able to make devices that empower and refuel Shards, make it easier for their users to control their abilities or use them for longer periods overall, or make temporary or permanent alterations to their powers. 

Though there is a drawback: the creation of these devices is especially costly and complicated at first. This power is unable to interact with itself.
objects.title: (Tinker/Trump) Power Tinker

objects.text: You possess a unique ability to harness the laws of cause and effect, allowing you to create technology that can bend and manipulate reality in incredible ways. Your creations are capable of achieving seemingly impossible feats. such as the creation of a spear that's able to strike a lethal blow through the heart regardless of the circumstances, or the creation of a machine that can simulate the effects of a cause, giving you a prediction of the future. However, you must acknowledge that this power is not without flaws, as some effects are simply impossible to achieve, such as trying to strike a lethal blow through the heart when the target has no heart. Your technology is extremely costly to create, and it is considered a blindspot due to its effects.
objects.title: (Tinker) Cause And Effects

objects.text:
Whenever you encounter a problem, this power will provide you a mental list of Tinker-tech blueprints that, in some way, provide a solution to that problem, all generated from a decently advanced but generalized Tinker-tech database. Mentally selecting one of these blueprints will cause your power to fabricate the selected option, making it instantly appear either in your hands, on your person, or nearby, whichever is most convenient. 

Your power will do its best to provide a variety of options for each problem you encounter, although they won’t necessarily be perfect solutions. For difficult problems, this will often require a level of trial and error on your part with the different solutions it provides to reach a satisfactory result.

For example, say you are fighting Lung and need to deal with him before he hurts anyone. A few of the options your power could provide might be giant robots designed to distract him and lure him away from populated areas, power armor, forcefield generators, fire negating technology, bombs that could destroy him before he has a chance to ramp up, or even a machine gun loaded with Tinker-tech tranquilizer rounds.

This is real Tinker-tech made from real materials and is not dependent on your power to exist besides creating them in the first place.

You are a real Tinker, being able to mentally draw upon your power’s tech base to Tinker just like any ordinary Tinker. This lets you manually build any of the technology your power mentally provides you the blueprints for, should you desire. In the same vein, you are able to maintain and modify any technology you or your power have produced.

You are able to mentally save any of the blueprints your power provides, so you have access to them even when the problem that prompted them disappears.

You can use your Tinker capabilities to rapidly and mentally alter the design of the blueprints your power provides, allowing you to adapt as a situation evolves or make the designs better fit the problem at hand. This does not alter technology already created by you or your power.

The tech base of this power does not include megastructures. This power also cannot fabricate anything past a 500-meter radius of your body, which includes any technology that would surpass that radius in size.
objects.title: (Tinker/Stranger) Might Make Other Tinkers Mad

addons.text: Your ability to blur the mental lines between Host and Shard has been influenced by your ability to blur the physical lines between the two as well. You may inflict temporary Titanhood on anyone you use Connection on, transforming them into a true merger of Host and Shard, both physically and mentally. As with Connection, you can fiddle with the ratio of the transformation to some extent, allowing you to choose whether those affected undergo full Titanification or are closer to the Human Shard upgrade in nature.
addons.title: Full Synchronization

addons.text: Your ability to communicate with or influence Shards has influenced Connection. Now, when using Connection on someone, if their Shard’s ranking is lower than yours you can give them Directives, missions/orders they are compelled to complete. Once the effects of Connection fade, any Directives given also fade. If someone’s Shard has a ranking greater than or equal to yours you cannot force Directives on them, however you can attempt to negotiate with their Shard and get it to willingly accept a Directive. If you have [Broadcast] then you can force Directives on Shards with an equal ranking to your own, although you still need to negotiate with those of a higher ranking. Lastly, [Broadcast] also allows you to remotely cancel the effects of Connection, allowing you to revert someone under the effects of Connection to their normal state at will, regardless of range.
addons.title: [Directive]

objects.text:
With a touch, you can alter the power of a parahuman by modifying the Corona Pollentia. Doing this makes the mind of the Shard and its Host slowly merge, resulting in the shard having greater control and the Host’s mind degrading, the more you modify the connection the quicker the merge happens and the more the host power is amplified. With a touch, you can return the connection to normal, but the Host’s mind will need time to become whole again, the further the Host and Shard are merged the longer it will take for the Host’s mind to recover.

When you alter the connection between Host and Shard you can give the host a new power that the Shard could have given during the Host’s Trigger Event by sacrificing parts of the existing power with the new power potency being directly proportional to the sacrifice, for example, giving a pyrokinetic the capacity to slowly fly by reducing their control over their fire.
objects.title: (Trump) Connection

objects.text:
With a mere touch, you can gain a copy of the memories, skills, and powers of your target. These abilities are permanently gained, and your target will experience a period of weakness.

Be vigilant of the consequences. The memories gained can, and will influence your identity. Certain thoughts and beliefs may be either overwritten, or at the very least somewhat influenced by your target's memories and thoughts.

(This power can affect Non-Parahumans. This also doesn't affect your appearance)
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Split

objects.text: You possess the ability to transform into a gruesome creature covered in mouths and hands. When perceived by others, the target will experience a gradual decline in their mental state. The effects of this decline can manifest differently depending on the individual and can lead to varying degrees of delusions, panic, and paranoia. Once this transformation has occurred, the effects will continue to intensify over time, making the target increasingly susceptible to manipulation and control. Even without prompting them, the targets will act in your favor, their actions assisting you in reaching their goals.
objects.title: (Breaker/Master) Eldritch

objects.text: When you activate this power, you can force any combination of two objects or people to not exist relative to each other. They appear to vanish from each others’ perspective, and any third party observing them will see them look and move straight through each other. Anything that either of them does will not affect the other until you put an end to the power’s effects. Anything that a person is holding or wearing is shunted alongside them. This power can also be used by you.
objects.title: (Breaker/Stranger) Vanish

objects.text:
Anything that hears you sing has their perception of you erased; this affects any senses, even power-granted ones. They can't see, smell, hear, or even feel you. Do note that even if someone can't feel their hands touching your face, they can still feel their own hand being stopped by something.

Your singing can also make someone act upon their intrusive thoughts; someone driving could end up hitting a tree because they thought of it or jumping off a cliff.

Anyone killed by you, be it directly or indirectly, has memories of them erased from this world. Their parents do not recognize the face on the pictures of their house, and their significant other can't seem to remember who they lived with.

(This doesn't work through recordings or electronics; it also can't affect entities.)
objects.title: (Shaker/Stranger) Call of Oblivion

objects.text: You possess the ability to act as an intermediary for any exchange between two willing participants. These exchanges can include anything the participants own, including physical, mental, and even esoteric possessions like age, lifespan, traits, and even powers, but they can’t affect anybody besides the participants. The participants must have a verbal or written agreement approved by the broker, and none of them can be under a Master effect.
objects.title: (Stranger/Trump) Exchange Broker

objects.text:
You are now the proud owner of a Multiversal Emulator. Searching the multiverse, your shard will project a random sentient minion that will emulate a real person. They can be anything, from a mighty wizard to a seasoned knight, and even, perhaps, a talking vending machine.

While you can command this minion, they are an independent person who will be loyal to you. While they will reflect the personality of who they emulate, they will retain the memories of each interaction and mannerism. 

These projections will never be someone ordinary, and will always carry unique powers and skills. Each emulation comes with an energy pool of 20 “points”, and has a handful of skills and powers you can learn from them. Each skill/power is 10 points worth, and they can be acquired either by training, or by spending energy to acquire them. Your emulation can also use this energy to use special actions such as using their powers or delivering special attacks. When the current emulation runs out of energy, they will disappear and be replaced by a new one. At the end of each emulation, they may leave an item associated with them.

The range of your emulation is up to two hundred meters from you. The Emulation can’t be permanently killed and will respawn an hour later if so. Negentropy raises the emulation energy pool to 30, and Esoteric Knowledge makes your power authentic copies rather than your shard emulating them. Shardless counts as you having both perks.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Multiversal Emulator

objects.text:
Anyone and everyone fears you; they believe you are the strongest and most dangerous, to the point they don't dare even try to confront you. This is the effect of your power, which can affect any biological lifeform, no matter the range. There won't be any particular reason why they believe this, and even when confronted about their logical fallacy, they will still think you are the strongest, unable to see reality.

Be ready for everyone, including friends, family or lovers to fear your every actions. Unless if you take Holding Back.
objects.title: (Stranger) S-Class

addons.text:
Your cells developed technorganic traits through your Tinker Specialty, recovering their cellular structure while retaining their programmable micro-tech capabilities, a fusion of both mechanical and organic worlds both in body and mind, using biology’s malleability and growth capacity in conjunction with technology's ability to adapt and progress, you become a more versatile and adaptable being through this mutation.

Among the many functions available to you is: full control of adaptations for any environment, obstacle, or threat; interfacing faculties on both technological and organic fronts; changing into a living factory/energy plant/arsenal through self-created constructs/mechanics from one’s body; a fully cybernetic mind; lastly, full awareness and control of oneself at a macroscopic and microscopic level. All already possible uses of your original power are pushed to the forefront.

Your cells’ degradation rate is slowed, when they could’ve died 100km away from you, they behave more akin to airborne viruses having slighter better reach and survivability, by the time your cellular improvement is continuously experimental, with a notable upgrade over months, although more comprehensive in scope.
addons.title: Greyed Shape

objects.text:
Your cells are like Nanomachines now!

Your cells are now as small as nanometers and can do many things. Including, but not limited to: resisting extreme temperatures, changing your appearance, living without a brain, virtually limitless memory, unlimited multitasking, super computer-like thinking speed, superhuman capabilities, hardening at will, and so much more!

There are some things you should be aware of. Your cells perform worse the farther away they are from you, with a limit of 100km before they become inert. Your cells do improve, but it will take 10 years before there is a noticeable difference. Like nanomachines, you are still limited to the resources you have at your disposal. You can also specialize cells, but it would make them worse at other tasks.
objects.title: (Breaker) Nano Cells

objects.text:
You gain the power of a Pokémon Master in the real world due to your ability to create random Pokémon relatively nearby, although your control over this is lacking in terms of both how many you create and what specific Pokémon you create. You also have the ability to influence what Pokémon you create by controlling where you create them, since your power creates Pokémon in environments suitable for them. Additionally, this comes with a few auxiliary powers to suit this power. 

You start out with 10 Pokéballs and 5 Potions in a limited sized personal pocket dimension which can be accessed from your pockets as well as a personal bag like a backpack, the first Pokémon created by this power will be Starter Pokémon of which you will be able to catch one of your choice before the rest try to escape, you gain a Thinker power aiding in finding, understanding, caring for, interacting with, and training Pokémon, and finally, through traveling and conflict, you randomly get more Pokémon equipment such as Pokéballs, Potions, Evolution Stones, Berries, and Key Items like Fishing Rods specialized in catching Water-type Pokémon, with less 'valuable' items obviously being more common. 

As a last few important notes; This cannot create Legendary and Mythical Pokémon, Pokédex entries such as Drifloon kidnapping children may be inaccurate, Pokémon naturally heal through rest, Pokémon can subsist off of both food suitable for them and conventional food, Pokémon can learn more than four moves, and Pokémon are generally relatively benign unless they are disturbed.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Pokémon Go

objects.text:
In your eyes, all Parahumans and power effects (including yourself) around you have an energy pool inside them; the stronger the powers, the more energy they contain. The longer you look at this energy, the more you know about the power, initially gaining one to two-word generalizations like "Awareness" or "Heat Generation". As you look more, you start to know things like "Always On" or "Needs Touch". Look long enough, and you will know everything about a power, including its weaknesses and applications. Seeing the power in action increases the speed at which you acquire knowledge about it.

With a touch, you can drain that energy; it takes longer to totally drain the more energy there is; draining a power effect will weaken it until it ceases to exist, and draining a parahuman will undermine their power to the point it’s obsolete and they aren’t capable of using it. You can drain energy at range and affect multiple targets, but it's slower than using touch, becoming even slower with distance, and the more targets you are draining simultaneously. With time, a parahuman will regain their power; the longer it takes, the stronger the power is. You can also do the opposite, being able to transfer the energy you collected — following the same rules as draining — allowing you to apply your capacity to boost and create new aspects of powers into ones that aren't your own.

You can expend energy to temporarily boost part of a power. Like increasing range, decreasing the time necessary to do something, or giving a new aspect to it. ¼ of that boost becomes permanent; a power that temporarily gained 6 meters to its range now has permanently an additional 1.50 (or one and a half) meters to its range. If you temporarily gave (Trump) Eidolon an extra slot, you would permanently have it but only be able to slot powers that are ¼ the strength.

Creating new aspects will cost more energy than boosting an existing one and will cost more the more it deviates from the theme and mechanics of the power, new aspects take more energy to boost compared to the base power. Giving your Water Manipulation the capacity to see the future by looking at water would take much less energy than giving your Earth Manipulation precognition while giving your Water Manipulation the capacity to control Ice would take even less energy.

Any powers you enhance will start releasing electricity-like energy or a glow when they are used. This energy/glow happens either on the power itself or on the part of your body where it originates from. Sometimes both happen to either.

This power is best used in bursts to conserve the stockpiled energy and because continuous use won't keep increasing the permanent boost. Powers affected by Feast cannot affect Feast.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Feast

objects.text:
You can create ‘saves’ of the area and people around you. The longer you stand still while taking the save, the wider the range becomes. Once you take a save it’s stored within your power. You can have up to 7 saves at once.

You can summon these saves at anytime, allowing you to swap your current surroundings with any previously captured moment in an instance in a manner similar to that of Labyrinth. The saves will act normally, and will not know that they are not the real deal, although they can deduce it with time. This means that if one of the saves sees you as an enemy, then they will attack you like normal.

The duration of your summoned saves depends on its size and your experience. The bigger the summoned saves, the harder it is to maintain. Once the save is dismissed, the area returns back to how it was before you deployed your save.

Note: Entity Avatars and Endbringers can be saved, but unless you have Queen Shard they will be limited at the power level of what they have shown during their fights. If you have Negentropy and Queen Shard you can create saves of the Entities true body.
objects.title: (Shaker) Snapshots

objects.text: You now possess a nearly unlimited short-range power-copying ability–unfortunately, this comes with multiple caveats: For one, you cannot actually use the copies yourself, with them instead being used by semi-independent Master projections created by this power. Said projections resemble small, cutesy, plush toy-like versions of their original users, which bear personalities patterned after the original person, albeit with exaggerated traits and a strong mischievous bent. While they are still ultimately loyal to you, they will be prone to interpreting your orders creatively depending on the copied individual. You can only have one copy of any given power each, and if any of your projections are destroyed or dismissed, you will need to find the original parahuman(s) they came from and copy their power all over again. (Note: While this power can copy Tier 3 powers, unless your Shard is of Noble ranking any copies will be diminished to the upper limit of Tier 2)
objects.title: (Trump/Master) Highly Marketable

objects.text:
This power is designed to study and learn all martial arts techniques and other ways of fighting for future cycles. The Shard will learn and study these forms of combat from fictional sources or even real sources and then allow you to learn them. Mastery in the arena demands dedication, requiring individuals to immerse themselves in training to attain power.

The Arena, a distinct world accessible at will, allows participants to physically enter an environment similar to either a Dojo or an Arena, depending on their needs. This enables interaction with others and the surroundings. Although impervious to death within the arena, the user will feel pain. You are the only one who can enter the Arena, and you will exit the arena from the location that you entered from.  

Upon entering, individuals acquire an energy pool utilized to summon either fictional or real personas willing to impart their arts and fighting styles. Each mastery requires a year or more of dedicated training, limiting the summoning of new mentors until a sufficient level of expertise is reached. Mastery expands the energy pool and enables the summoning of more formidable mentors. Regular training within the arena contributes to energy growth, albeit at a lesser rate than mastering new skills.  

Potential mentors can include martial artists, ranged fighters, and even skilled swordsmen, encompassing any physically oriented entities. Summoning high-caliber figures requires substantial energy. Students may use energy to learn specific powers or skills from their mentors, creating a weaker version that necessitates further training for enhancement. Only one power or skill per teacher can be copied, and simultaneous summoning of multiple mentors is prohibited. You could instead choose to summon waves of enemies to fight to your heart's content or to train.

The arena introduces a slight time dilation effect, allowing individuals to progress in strength over time, breaking limitations through sustained effort and dedication.

With negentropy, the ability to copy multiple powers or skills arises, contingent on available energy. The energy pool experiences significant growth during arena training or general mastery, presenting an enhanced avenue for personal development.

All Replicated Esoteric Energies are not real and can only be imitated unless you take Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge.
objects.title: (Trump) The Arena

addons.text: Your body is constantly refined and optimised. All new genetic growths will be analysed and stored, allowing you to use Bio Energy to permanently retain them. You don’t need to consume biomass to generate Bio Energy anymore, as you can now passively generate Bio Energy.
addons.title: Optimised

addons.text:
You can freely absorb any biomass acquired from your sacs and convert it into Bio Energy and vice versa. This Bio Energy can subsequently be used as you please, whether in the construction of your monsters, the healing and enhancement of creatures via your cocoon-like sacs or simply for yourself. You no longer have any limit to how strong any of your monsters can become although the stronger they get, the more Bio Energy is needed.

The ability of your sacs to break down organic material has also improved tremendously, making the sacs capable of dissolving any organic material into slurry (and subsequently Bio Energy) nigh-instantaneously.
addons.title: Bio Matter = Bio Energy

objects.text:
Upon consuming biomass, you are capable of collecting and storing genetic data, as well as absorbing a special type of energy called Bio Energy. 

Utilising Bio Energy, you are able to change and modify your biological makeup using the genetic information you have stored. The more complex the genetic information, such as that of a Kryptonian, the greater amount of energy is required to transform your body into the desired state.

You may also utilise Bio Energy in a few additional ways. If you are in need of a specific sort of biomass to carry out a particular transformation, you may utilise Bio Energy to generate it. If you have sustained wounds or injuries, you may employ Bio Energy to promote healing. Additionally, you are able to tap into the potential of Bio Energy to temporarily enhance the capabilities of your physiology.
 
If the amount of Bio Energy stored within you exceeds a particular threshold, your body will initiate a process wherein you evolve in an accelerated manner, optimising your current biological state before storing the genetic data of your enhanced form.

You gain a few additional changes, your jaw is greatly boosted, allowing you to chew through steel. In addition to that, your stomach acids are able to break down practically any organic material.
objects.title: (Changer) Bio-Assimilation

addons.text: Beast of Gaia and Avalon have both synergized thanks to their shared effects on animals. Avalon uses this connection to give your summoned animals an enhanced healing factor along with enhanced durability and stamina. It is also now possible to summon up to three animals without Negentropy, with Negentropy allowing for an immediate five and causing that amount to grow at an accelerated rate.
addons.title: Arcadia

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to call and summon animals to aid you. You can radiate an inaudible frequency reaching up to five kilometers that any non-sapient animals will feel compelled to follow. Additionally, you can summon a single non-sapient animal of your choice at a time from anywhere on Earth–you can choose to summon any animal possessing a certain characteristic, any animal of a specific species, or even a specific animal such as your pet. 

You can even access the past and summon any animal or creature to the present moment. This includes alternate Earths where different species may have thrived. You can send it back to where you summoned it from and summon a different animal at any time, and if it sustains significant injuries, it will be automatically unsummoned and returned to its original location. You will receive detailed descriptions of all creatures available for summoning. It's worth noting that animals or creatures brought from the past to the present cannot breed.

Any such called or summoned creature will be loyal to you and will be empowered similarly to a mid-range Brute; a monkey could flip a car, while an elephant might be able to win a toss-up against a tinkertech monster truck. You can also share the senses of any animal you called or summoned, and even communicate with them.

Over time, this power will induce physical changes in the user, such as small fangs, slit eyes, claws, or even a tail. Additionally, you gain heightened senses akin to those of the animals you control. Eventually, your ability to communicate with animals you summoned or called will be extended to every animal.

If you have Negentropy, you can now summon up to three animals simultaneously, and the number of animals you can summon will grow over time.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Beasts of Gaia

objects.text: You are capable of making monsters that spawn from pools of a black, tar-like substance that drops from your body. The shape, abilities, and size of these Grimm are decided by you and the size of the pools from which they spawn. Grimm made by this power are all highly aggressive, can sense negative emotions, are made of the same substance that created them, and have boney protrusions coming from their body, usually in the form of masks or armor. There is no limit to how big your Grimm can be, however it takes increasingly more stamina to do so. You have a slight master power that lets you command them telepathically, however you cannot command Grimm that are too far away to hear you. You can only grant abilities that are equal to or less than 10 SP.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Grimm Pools

addons.text:
About face maggots, stand at attention! Learn from a soldier who's reached perfection.

All of your soldiers are able to imitate your skills, no matter what is. This is also applied in reverse, so if they get good at a skill, then you'll get good at it too.

This also comes with a uncanny ability to teach, which might seem strange to others.
addons.title: Subordinates and Superiors

addons.text:
Your soldiers aren't tall anymore—quite short, in fact. But not to worry, they aren't any weaker because of it. If anything, they're stronger.

Your soldiers, tanks, and other units shrink down to miniature toy versions of themselves. However, they retain all their original power—speed, strength, firepower, and more—as if they were still full-sized. Each individual can return to their original size if needed. For vehicles, the driver determines the size, with it's passengers shrinking accordingly.

Optionally, your soldiers can be green.
addons.title: Bad Company

objects.text: You have your own personal army with technology equivalent to World War 2 comprised of 1000 soldiers, 300 armoured personal carriers, 240 armoured cars, 25 tanks, 30 fighters, and 15 bombers. They are appropriately manned with the required personnel. If you summon them, it will look like they come out of a portal. If someone or something is ever destroyed, they or it can be summoned to peak condition after a week. All of the soldiers are 110% loyal to you, willing to eat and die in your name. They aren't exactly resistant to master effects, but their loyalty will never waiver. You always know where your soldiers and equipment are and if they are still in working condition. Any information they gather will be known to you. They also know what you know and what you want them to do.
objects.title: (Master/Thinker) Personal Army

addons.text: You can fill one of Polymath slots with one of your Plus or Equal, allowing you to temporarily access the evolved version of those Abilities.
addons.title: Skilled Manifestation

addons.text:
Your Abilities become valid targets to be granted to someone, more specifically, their Unevolved/Unfused/Unleveled selves are the valid targets. Essentially, it allows you to grant to someone an Ability at the strength it was when you first got it.

This works exactly like Endow, you just can use your Abilities in place of a T0.
addons.title: Bestowal Manifestation

addons.text:
By keeping a Skill for a time, you will gain an Ability that not only is a copy of that Skill but also is 108/108 of the original Skill at the time of the copy instead of 1/108. This allows you to retain the Skill while freeing up a slot for something else.

What this means is that if you copied the capacity to create fire at 1/108, and later the original user of the power was capable of controlling fire in addition to increasing the output of their fire, when you receive the Ability based on that Skill, you won't be able to control and create fire at the same level the original user can now; you will only be able to create fire at the same level they could when you copied it.

These Abilities do not count towards your daily limit of 5 Abilities.
addons.title: 108+ Manifestations

addons.text:
‘The skin of your non-dominant hand has the color of a canvas, drawings representing your Abilities fade in and out of it. You can feel sensations and feelings coming from them—almost like they are alive—the warmth of your Fire Creation, the confidence of your Forcefield, the giddiness of your Flight.’
 By writing or drawing on this canvas you can direct what Abilities you will receive daily. Draw a sword and you could receive the capacity to create swords you have wielded, write Fire and you could receive the capacity to absorb it. Your Abilities have gained a level of sentience and perhaps even sapience depending on what they are. This intelligence increases when they level up. As the one they are bound to, your Abilities will use their newfound intelligence to help you, maybe your Future Sight is constantly communicating with your Danger Sense and Forcefield in order to protect you, or maybe a Multitasking-dependent power starts using its own mind to manage itself.
addons.title: Ink Manifested

addons.text: You can apply the effects of One Letter, adding/removing/changing one letter in each of their names to grant them new, comparable effects, to each of the abilities you get once on the day you make them. You can revert these changes if you wish, but they will otherwise last indefinitely.
addons.title: Customizable Manifestations

objects.text:
Every day, you gain 5 random very weak Abilities, and you can use as many as you want simultaneously. The strength of what you receive fluctuates a little bit, but it will never be very powerful nor completely useless, going from slightly below T0 and T0 to rarely low T1.

Abilities are divided into three categories: Minus, Plus and Equal. Minus are powers like slight resistance to heat or launching things you are touching as if you used your hands. Plus are skills like being better at throwing knives or crafting medicine. Equal are a combination of Minus and Plus, essentially Abilities that contain both a power and a skill, like being able to walk on any surface combined with a very good balance.

Each power has a level starting at 0 and can go up to 10, and repetitive use will raise their level; the time it takes to do so depends on their strength and level. When an Ability reaches level 10, it will either evolve itself or allow you to fuse it with another Ability that has reached its limit; doing either of them makes the Ability level 0 again, though it doesn't become weaker. Levelling up an Ability adds its initial strength to itself. Example: When "Resist an additional 100 degrees of heat" becomes level 1, the 100 degrees would become 200, another level up would raise it to 300, etc. Example of the Evolution of an Ability: The capacity to generate fire from your fingers becomes the capacity to create fire from your entire hand. Example of the Fusion of Abilities: "Increased Memory Retention" with "Being able to think faster" would result in "Even better memory and thinking speed and the capacity to play your memories like a video in an instant.".

When you receive copies of an Ability you already possess, you can feed it to that Ability to raise its level, skipping the time necessary to train it entirely. All of your Abilities have names that you can use to search for them using a mental search engine.
objects.title: (Trump) Idle Manifestation

objects.text:
You are capable of travelling at incredibly high speeds, up to Mach 600. Your movements create a shockwave that can knock nearby objects (or people) off their feet, and you can use your own body as a weapon, ramming into targets at incredibly high speeds. Your body is also empowered to the degree needed to operate at such high speeds.

You are also capable of breaking your body into millions of tiny fragments made of plasma, which can move separately and recombine at will, dramatically increasing your maneuverability and evasiveness.

Transforming into your Breaker form and reconstituting immediately heals you, and you’ll automatically shift into your Breaker form if enough damage is taken.

You have a secondary Thinker ability that allows you to perceive and navigate through your surroundings at high speeds, detecting obstacles and predicting your enemies' movements.
objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) Starburst

addons.text:
You can blacklist powers from working against or on you at all and can apply conditions to each blacklist. Punch a Brute? Their durability doesn't work if you are the one doing the damage, a Blaster shoots at you? Their attack will either pass through you harmlessly or will simply disappear if it touches you, Clairvoyant? He cannot see you and things around you appear in a different way so they don't give away there is supposed to be something there. You can turn this on/off at will.

If a power is being used against or on you, you can change its Manton Limit or add one if it doesn't have it. You can also do this to those you are overriding. Though applying conditions you can make it switch between what it originally was and what you changed it to, you can apply conditions to switch between multiple Manton Limits.
addons.title: Treason is Forbidden

addons.text: You can use Manager's capacity to manipulate your powers on anyone you are overriding.
addons.title: Admin Credentials

objects.text:
By touching a Parahuman you gain the capacity to activate, shut down, and control their power not as if it was yours to begin, but beyond, Clockblocker never knows how long his power lasts but you would, Eidolon can't choose his powers but you can. You gain access to the Shard's data acquired from studying that specific powerset and ones similar to it, what this means is that you can use a Parahuman's power better than they ever could. When you are no longer touching said Parahuman you lose the control you have over their power but retain the data acquired.

When you override a Parahuman's control over their power it mutates, becoming detrimental to them and beneficial to you. The mutation disappears when they are no longer affected by your power, resurfacing every time they try using their power against or on you. If you took control over Teacher's power it would alter the loyalty aspect depending on what would be beneficial to you, like changing who is loyal to who or changing loyalty to disobedience, the other aspect of the power is able to cause minor boosts to any power without shifting its parameters and the Thinker/Tinker powers it gifts is slightly stronger.

As long as they are being affected by your power you can steal the protection against their own powers any Parahuman has and either use it yourself, give it to something else, or return it.

If a power has "something" it can't affect, like inorganic or organic matter, it will treat you as that "something" and if a power bypasses the Manton Limit it will suddenly have one when it is used on you e.g. Cherish would be unable to sense or affect your emotions because to her power you have none. Behemoth would be unable to use his Kill Aura on you. You can turn it off/on, alternatively you can instead selectively blacklist certain powers from being affected by this and apply conditions to this blacklist, allowing you to for example be only affected by Panacea if she is healing you in a way you approve.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Override

addons.text: Your muskets can now be any mundane, modern firearm. They will appear fully loaded. The firearm automatically disappears after it has used up all its ammunition.
addons.title: The American Way

addons.text: You can create musket variants of any gun you have made before. If you have The American Way then you can summon full fledge versions of any gun you have made, although it will be under the same restrictions, making it disappear after it has used up its ammo.
addons.title: The 2° Amendment

addons.text: Instead of bullets, your Musketeers shoot the lasers that (Blaster) Laser Bullets produces. The maximum range of your lasers is now the same of a bullet. You can still only shoot one projectile per Musketeer.
addons.title: Futuristic Musketeers

objects.text:
Your shard enables you to summon single-use muskets around you, which turn into mist and disappear after use. These muskets are extremely durable, capable of withstanding multiple hits from mid to high-tier brutes before breaking. Additionally, they have virtually zero bullet drop when fired. You can choose how powerful each musket is when summoning it. Once fired, the musket ball can be strong enough to pierce titanium and even cause high-tier brutes to have second thoughts. You can summon as many muskets as you want, but you are only limited to having 200 active muskets around you at a time.

Your shard also grants you the power of telekinesis when summoning your muskets, along with excellent marksmanship. This telekinesis allows you to manipulate and control the muskets as if they were another limb, knowing their exact positions and where they are aiming at all times. The telekinesis also extends to controlling the musket ball once fired, making it easier for you to hit your targets accurately.

Although you have perfect control over the muskets when they are close to you, your telekinetic control weakens with distance, reducing both accuracy and control.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Musketeer

objects.text:
You have gained access to three types of power slots: the Source, the Evolver, and Storage. The Source power slot can interface and copy the ability of any Parahuman you know of while the Evolver power slot starts with any power you can think of with a limit of 5 SP. The Source power slot and any other power you have will then, upon your choice, feed its usage, data, and analysis to the evolver power slot, slowly evolving the power inside into new forms over time through the source’s usage which will cause the Evolver power to take on capabilities and characteristics of the Source power’s [Data].

However, this is a slow process with many powers taking months to evolve due to the growing time tripling in length for every doubling of SP past the beginning 5 SP until the maximum of 20 SP (or never if you have Negentropy). You can then store these evolved powers into one of 5 Storage slots where they can held in their current state until you wish to use them by placing them inside the evolver slot again.

If you have Negentropy you can generate a new Source slot by deleting a power and its [Data] worth 20 SP or more, a new Evolver slot for a power worth 10 SP or more, and a new Storage slot for a large fight’s worth of [Data] and power. If you have Esoteric Knowledge you can copy powers from a person (real or fictional) you know of with powers equal to or less than 20 SP.
objects.title: (Trump) Evolution and Escalation

objects.text:
You have a single (three with Negentropy) slot that is filled with a random power of varying strength that is designed to help you in some way. This power lasts anywhere between 1 to 10 seconds and you do not receive a power that you couldn't use within those seconds, so you wouldn't receive a power that would let you see powers if there is no powers nearby. These powers can be as strong as prime Eidolon and any active external power effects cease to exist after the power is substituted while permanent ones stay.

What power is given to help you will be always mostly random even if the situation is the same, instead of always receiving some sort of Brute power everytime you are about to be hit you might end up with reactive teleportation for example.

You consciously and unconsciously know what each power you receive can do and can use them as if you had them for years.
objects.title: (Trump) Ephemeral

objects.text:
You have a collection of powers that you can choose to use. You are limited to only one at a time if particularly powerful, three at a time if very weak, or two at a time if anywhere between both. These powers can be as strong as prime Eidolon. Each power has a sort of battery filled with energy that is consumed when you slot that power. Emptying a battery makes a power temporarily unusable until it is filled again by removing the power from the slot and waiting.

The strength of the power determines how much energy it consumes while slotted, your strongest powers last less than 10 seconds while your weakest lasts 1 minute.

Negentropy increases the limit of the amount of Powerful/Weak/Middle powers by one. It also increases the battery life of yours powers, your strongest powers last 30 seconds while your weakest last 2 minutes.
objects.title: (Trump) Battery Powered

objects.text:
You have a collection of powers that you can choose to use. You are limited to only one at a time if particularly powerful, three at a time if very weak, or two at a time if anywhere between both. These powers can be as strong as prime Eidolon. Every time a power is used it decays until it is completely unusable, when not in use it will regenerate. This decay affects aspects of the power, so sometimes it will affect the entire power, only a part of it or switch between what it is affecting, e.g fire creation and manipulation? Using it would for example eventually remove the creation aspect leaving only manipulation and using the manipulation would eventually remove that too.

The strength of the power determines how much use is needed to completely decay it and how long it takes to regenerate. Very powerful? A couple uses are enough to become unusable and would take a while to completely regenerate, very weak? Should last you a while and would take a couple minutes to completely regenerate.

Negentropy increases the limit of the amount of Powerful/Weak/Middle powers by one. It also doubles the amount of uses a power needs to completely decay and halves the time it needs to regenerate.
objects.title: (Trump) Decaying Strength

objects.text:
You have five powers: Super Strength, Invulnerability, Flight, Variable Vision, and Super Speed. These five powers however are not always at their full strength as you can only have one active at full power at a time while the others only work at a diminished capacity.

Your Super Strength at full power would allow you to surpass even the strength of Alexandria and allow you to dig into the upper layers of an Endbringer, then again, it wouldn't do much to the deeper layers. In its weakened state your super strength decreases significantly however you would still be allowed to exert enough strength to the point where lifting 20 tons would be difficult but not extremely tiring.

Your Invulnerability at full power would allow you to withstand attacks from even the strongest of foes as it would function similarly to Glory Girl’s shunting ability as any incoming attacks would not damage you, however, this would not discount the fact that physical impact will still move your body through space. In its weakened state, regardless, your invulnerability would function in a much more mundane form by dispersing impacts to your body up to a point where getting hit with a car wouldn’t hurt but having a semi-truck fall on you would almost surely kill you.

Your Flight at full power would allow you to fly at hypersonic speeds easily surpassing the speed of sound by many times. However, in its weakened state, your flight would permit you to fly on a level below the speed of sound yet still extremely fast.

Your Variable Vision, unlike your other powers, is a miniature collection of vision-based abilities such as laser vision, x-ray vision, and telescopic vision. At full power your laser vision would be comparable in strength to a standard blast from legend, your X-ray vision would allow you to see through anything even dimensionally distorted space, and your telescopic vision would defy the curvature of the planet and allow you to see up to 100 kilometers away. However in their weakened state, your laser vision would be comparable in strength to run-of-the-mill bullets in terms of power, your X-ray vision would decrease to the point where heavy metals would be too dense to see through, and your telescopic vision would reach a mere kilometers away.

Finally, your Super Speed at full power would allow you to move through and perceive the world around you at Mach speeds. In its weakened state, however, your physical and mental speed would decrease to around that matching a bullet train.
objects.title: (Trump) Suite of Powers

addons.text:
With Unity, your merging with your passenger applies the ideas of Communion, seamlessly establishing a connection where there is more synchronization between the Host and Shard, avoiding the mental degradation through the communion’s deeper connection and understanding, which in turn helps with directly communicating and endearing oneself to your Shard knowing their preferences and utility function. Exchanging a single point Corona Pollentia and Gemma with being spiderwebbed across your brain, allowing your power’s grasp and variable strength to be magnified the more you commune and act conforming your Shard’s objectives and simple [Data] collection.

This agreement is enough to side-step some of this power (and Shard)’s imposed restrictions to a degree.

What follows is the humanization of your Shard, growingly becoming fully sentient, in turn.
addons.title: [Communion][Synchronization]

addons.text:
Entropic Decay supplements Unity manifesting its dark reflection, that is Distinction or Disunity, granting them the additional application to forgo or deny anything from reality, using Entropy as the basis for their separation.
 
Being innately extensive it only applies Indiscriminately or when Targeting overarching components of reality; forgoing or denying anything causes you to be independent from any part or concept within an area of 300m², being outside or separate of any physical law in your range, an expression of freedom with the repercussion of a Pseudo-Breaker form conveying this. 

This, unironically, causes immutability from All-or-Nothing powers like Sting or Stilling, as you forsake the very foundations of which their All-or-Nothing effects originate for them to affect you.
addons.title: [Otherness]

addons.text:
Your Networking abilities are built up and given wider access through Unity, coalescing into one. Cornerstone aids in the affinity, both in an individual and parahuman perspective, allowing full malleability, synthesis, and all-around sensitivity of the members’ entirety. Quartermaster aids in the members' maintenance or guidance, evolving this into a Union with all of the parts being metaphorically One. All powers, skills, and perks percolate and consolidate into a repository of knowledge and power, acting in concert with the needs and wants of the Union, being more responsive and adaptive.

All members have the same abilities to share in the performance.
addons.title: [Concert]

objects.text:
Oneness. Harmony. Synthesis. Concepts Shards or Entities are aware of yet wholly unfamiliar in a closer view. It is to be expected, naturally, that while the beings are terrifyingly intelligent in terms of critical thinking, both in technical and adaptive means, they lack any capacity for lateral or abstract thinking for the life of them. That is why the Cycle exists: on the back of other species they draw upon their creativity to find the solution of limited resources, of Entropy.

Taking notice, the Entities endeavored to study these notions in the only way they could: missing the forests for the trees.

What they come up with is still commendable all the same by their standards, as this power is the result of applying the value of Unity in their eyes. 

You can unify and merge with any and every material or tangible object, either a person or parahuman, an element or component of your vicinity or world (like the asphalt of the pavement or the phenomenon of friction), with your unification being targeted or indiscriminate.
