Few can withstand this. Most are left broken, their consciousness unraveling under the strain. And while these echoes dissolve after a week, their original body remains lost in an unknown world, with no clear path home.

Lastly, this state grants you a unique mastery over light—though not sunlight. Any beam that enters your fractured form is refracted, intensified, and then unleashed in a dazzling burst. Unlike everything else that passes through you, you alone dictate where these beams emerge, allowing you to shape them with precision. Even the faint glow of a weak flashlight can be twisted—into a deadly weapon, its scattered rays striking with enough force to shatter stone.
objects.title: (Breaker) Kaleidoscopic Fractural Flowering Lens

addons.text:
You consume not just thoughts and emotions, but the fragile threads that bind them—memories woven with feelings, identities anchored by both cognition and sentiment. Your hunger seeps into the deepest layers of the mind, devouring the very connection between who a person is and how they feel. By feeding on someone’s thoughts, you strip away the emotions tied to their memories and beliefs. Conversely, draining intense emotions allows you to unravel the cognitive structures built around them. This creates a vicious feedback loop: erasing one weakens the other until nothing remains.

Victims of your hunger aren’t left as simple empty shells; they become hollows; brain-dead, mindless husks with active bodies, entirely under your control. They retain basic motor functions but possess no will or awareness of their own. They exist only to carry out your commands; without explicit instructions, they will stand idle, even neglecting fundamental needs like eating or sleeping, eventually wasting away if left unattended.

Your regurgitation is no longer out of your control, and the fluid can now be a manifestation of everything you’ve devoured—not just raw emotions, but thoughts, memories, and desires distilled into a tangible, liquid form. This psychic substance is potent and dangerous; anyone who ingests it experiences an overwhelming surge of whatever essence it contains, whether it’s the clarity of a stolen memory, the burning drive of a devoured desire, or the free spirit of a dream. However, creating this fluid results in less growth and power from the original act of feeding.
addons.title: Going Hollow

addons.text:
Your mind now grows without limit, evolving even in the absence of external stimuli. The process that once required the consumption of other minds now unfolds naturally, though devouring cognitive beings still accelerates your development exponentially, flooding your consciousness with new pathways, insights, and raw psychic potential.

Your consciousness no longer resides solely within you; it stretches outward, saturating the world around you with psychic influence. In areas saturated by your psychic imprint, your abilities grow stronger, more precise, and significantly harder for others to resist, as if reality itself bends more easily to your will within these domains.

Even death cannot sever your hold on existence. If your body is destroyed, your mind persists as an independent, disembodied force—a living echo untethered by flesh. In this state, you can infiltrate the consciousness of others, embedding fragments of yourself within their minds. Given time, these fragments grow, corrupting and overwriting the host’s identity until you are reborn, reshaped by the vessel but retaining your essence.

However, this form of existence is not without limits. Without anchoring yourself to a physical body or remaining within areas marked by your psychic imprint, your consciousness begins to fade over time. The absence of a vessel or a tethered domain weakens your presence, eroding your mind into scattered echoes until nothing of you remains—just lingering fragments lost in the vast mental landscape you once dominated.
addons.title: Psych Ward

addons.text:
Your hunger no longer stops at consuming minds; it now fuels an ever-expanding reservoir of psionic potential. Every thought, memory, emotion, or cognitive imprint you devour doesn’t just grant you fleeting insight—it becomes a permanent part of your evolving arsenal. The minds you consume act as blueprints, allowing you to intuitively reconstruct and refine abilities they had as psionic techniques.

You now possess a second energy reservoir—one with no upper limit, but which cannot replenish itself naturally. This pool is filled exclusively by converting the raw cognitive essence of what you consume into psionic energy. Cognitive material turned into psionic energy can no longer be used to grow or enhance your own mind.

Lastly you gain the ability to overload your psionic techniques, pushing them beyond their natural limitations. Overloaded abilities manifest with exponentially greater force, range, and complexity—transforming simple telekinetic blasts into city-level shockwaves or turning momentary mental intrusions into complete, instant domination. The only limit is the fuel you’re willing to burn.
addons.title: Psionic Engine

addons.text: Your increased neural density and brain complexity compound with your burgeoning psychic prowess, qualitatively enhancing all effects Cognitivore can produce, from the speed you drain cognitive essence to the strength and control of your ability to affect physical reality with just your mind. More impressive however is the effect gathering cognitive essence has. When you gather cognitive energy your brain grows, forming more neurons and wrinkles and strengthening the effects of Opposite of A Smooth Brain. This has no upper limit, so if you absorb enough cognitive energy your brain can end up a recursive fractal, minorly warping space-time to grow endlessly denser and more complex. This forms a feedback loop which effectively doubles returns as absorbing cognitive provides the usual benefits but also strengthens Opposite of A Smooth Brain which in turn amplifies the benefits of Cognitivore even more. This is multiplicative and scales incredibly highly, meaning that with enough neural complexity you can perform feats like ripping buildings apart on a molecular level or creating shockwaves strong enough to level city blocks. If you possess Psych Ward then the passive cognitive improvement from it also applies, your brain passively growing ever more powerful.
addons.title: Recursive Wrinkles

addons.text: You are capable of using the brains of everything under your control as extensions of your own mind, a distributed network of neural nodes. This allows you to draw on the cognitive energy and processing power of beings under your control, enabling feats of much greater strength than if you were merely using your own mental strength. The power you can draw from something is dependent on its own mental prowess.
addons.title: Distributed Processing

objects.text:
You consume the minds of cognitive beings to enhance and expand your own mental abilities. This process doesn’t involve physically devouring brains, but rather absorbing the cognitive essence, knowledge, memories, experiences, and mental energy of your targets. Those you feed on are left brain-dead, their minds hollowed out and their consciousness erased. If you consume only a portion of their cognitive essence or if the target has exceptional mental resilience, recovery is possible.

At the beginning, this manifests as accelerated thought processes, allowing you to analyse situations with incredible speed, make split-second decisions, and process complex information effortlessly. Your memory becomes near-perfect, capable of recalling even the smallest details with crystal clarity, and you can juggle multiple lines of thought simultaneously without confusion or fatigue.

As you continue to absorb more minds, your mental capabilities evolve beyond the limits of normal human cognition. You’ll reach a critical point—a bottleneck—where your brain undergoes a transformation. This is when your abilities shift from enhanced intellect to true psychic phenomena. You begin to perceive the hidden layers of consciousness, sensing the emotions and surface thoughts of those around you with ease. With further growth, you can establish telepathic links, allowing you to communicate silently and instantly over great distances.

Eventually, your mind’s influence extends beyond thought alone. You develop telekinetic abilities, enabling you to move, manipulate, or even crush objects with sheer willpower. The more cognitive energy you consume, the stronger these powers become, potentially allowing you to reshape your environment, control multiple objects at once, and exert influence over both minds and matter.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Cognitivore

objects.text:
You can manifest tiny miniatures of existing stars that compose constellations and link them together in order to recreate their constellations. They can be manifested on either your surroundings, your body, or both.

Those constellations can be used to manifest a variety of effects based on them, while you can direct the effects some aspects are fixed and you are limited to a single interpretation per constellation at a time—this doesn't limit how many constellations you can use at once, just how many effects you could manifest from single constellation. Using Sagittarius as a example: You could shoot normal arrows that hit exactly where you want to, or instead shoot arrows made of boiling water basing it on the Teapot Asterism that can be found in constellation, or even base it on how Sagittarius in Astrology are said to be natural explorers and thus manifest arrows that lead you to somewhere you want to go by leaving behind a trail; or you could inspire yourself with Nergal and manifest wings out of the constellation in order to fly, since the effects originate from the constellations it would need to be in your back.

As might be obvious by now, without applying symbolism or knowing their composition your stars will be nothing but pretty lights. With 88 constellations to draw power from and countless ways to interpret then you have gained a very versatile ability, you might end up becoming obsessed with the stars but hey, that's a small price to pay for power.

(Note: If you are in a place where none of the 88 Constellations exist in order to learn them, your Shard will slowly drip feed you knowledge about them in order to allow you to use your power and will also allow you to use the local equivalent of the Constellations.)
objects.title: (Trump) Constellations

addons.text: Your ‘Zones’ no longer have a size or numerical limit, allowing you to produce densely packed ‘clusters’ of technology with numerous specialties, each newly capable of overlapping with each other, building upon each other’s specialty within their zone’s overlap.
addons.title: Now Clusters Hate You Too

addons.text: Now instead of having the Tinkertech appendage fall off in the case of incompatible specialties you can instead shunt off the old one entirely into another space. It will continue to improve in this ghostly dimension, focused on its original specialty. You can freely swap the ones stored in this dimension to become your current one. Note that while the technology is stored in this dimension they do not affect your current body at all.
addons.title: My Power Does The Workshopping For Me

objects.text:
You can now grow Tinkertech designs out of your body. To do this, you designate parts of your body with a ‘Tinker specialty’, these can range from a single hand to an entire limb, each of which is able to operate their ‘specialty’ independently to a maximum of seven independent ‘zones’. Each of these ‘zones’ will then begin to grow technology within them matching the ‘specialty’ chosen. The longer a zone has the same specialty, the more dense and layered the technology will be, operating new functions and modes.

For instance, you can select a ‘Gun’ specialty within your arm, and expect continued development of firearm technologies, laser cannons, aiming assistance and so forth within it. These will continue to grow, and cannot be stopped, eventually completely subsuming the limb and making it very difficult to fully utilise outside of its specialty. 

Changing the specialty causes the non-relevant technology within the zone to jettison itself from your body, your flesh quickly regenerating around where it was. Any of this technology is treated as regular, if damaged, tinkertec and is unlikely to be useful unless repaired or reattached with an appropriate specialty. Any technology that fits within the new specialty can remain, though stringent links will cause loss of efficiency within these pieces.
objects.title: (Tinker/Changer) Will Make Real Tinkers Mad

objects.text:
You gain the ability to revive beings who died. But you need to spend a special energy to do so which you only gain by killing other sentient beings and burying them in the ground. While you have to personally bury the corpses, you can kill by indirect methods like paying others to kill for you or spreading diseases. The amount of energy gained depends on the fame and reputation they have obtained during their lives, so killing a famous hero or celebrity would net you enough energy to revive several non-remarkable people. But this is also true in reverse, as reviving a well-known historical figure could cost the lives of thousands.

The energy gained is also affected by the emotional investment towards the killed being, so a widely beloved or hated person will give much more compared to a person who is just known by a lot of people, but nobody really cares about them.

The revived beings will always be perfectly loyal and servile towards you, and they are mastered in a way where their personality will morph to gain an overwhelming respect and gratitude towards you for being revived, making their new purpose in life to serve you. The revived will always return to the form and age they were most famous for.

If you are Shardless/Negentropic, then those who are revived will be affected by their reputation gaining minor powers in line with them, or even have their original powers boosted and/or changed in minor ways to fit their history.

Finally, if you have Homecoming, it becomes possible to revive dead fictional beings by reaching into their universe, but their cost will be calculated based on their fame in their original setting.
objects.title: (Master) Grave Caller

objects.text:
You can summon up to 200 flying Snakes made from common elements such as earth, water, fire, and wind, and more basic esoteric ones such as light or shadow. Those snakes are controlled with your mind similar to how Skitter controls bugs alongside a small multitasking power to help with control. Those snakes all can control the element they are made from akin to a mid-T1 shaker/blaster power each, shooting a fireball or razor-sharp wind wave.

Those snakes also have the physical strength to lift a normal car on their own, and the only way to kill one is to injure them with an opposing element such as Water for Fire or Wind for Earth. You also can combine multiple snakes of the same element as one giant snake named a ‘Basilisk’ that has the power of a mid-tier shaker/blaster power but at the cost of the snakes making it up dying as the cost of the transformation is too much for them, resulting in the transformation lasting only 10 minutes if you were to use all of your snakes.

Negentropy lets you summon 100 more snakes, and Esoteric Knowledge lets you make snakes of even more esoteric elements like Time and Shardless give you both.
objects.title: (Master) Elemental Snakes

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to actualise any form of pseudoscientific belief into your immediate surroundings. These effects have various intensities, but clearly suffer from a form of Manton Limit, vastly reducing their effectiveness on living beings.

The effects you can cause range from minor ‘mastering’ alterations to someone’s behaviour from their astrological sign to changing the entire flow of a fight by applying feng-shui and negative energies to the room you’re in.

As you learn more of these pseudosciences you could begin manifesting energy vampirism, Electrogravitics, or Free Energy theories, making you a bane and boon to Tinkers and Thinkers everywhere.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) Pseudoscientific Manifestation

addons.text: Your power extends beyond simply people—now, your insight extends to anything you can interact with, whether they are objects, animals, or simple materials.
addons.title: Know It All

objects.text: With a single glance, you know and more importantly, understand, everything about a person; from their personality, their quirks, their deepest darkest secret, to why they act with arrogance, why they have a love of the color purple, to even how they’ll react or interpret something, even if entirely abstract. This isn’t merely a question of knowing them and what they’ve been through but a true understanding of them at the deepest level, and this in turn, can be used to make you their greatest ally, seeing every flaw and able to help them, or their worst enemy, able to predict their every move before they are ever able to even think of making it. This can be toggled between needing an intentional activation or left to act passively. Moreover, the power works on both the conscious and subconscious level; it won’t overload you with information—instead, it’ll slip in and meld with your understanding and comprehension of people as if you had always known them. This comes with an inherent understanding and supernatural skill at how to best utilize this knowledge. This also updates anytime you interact with them in any manner.
objects.title: (Thinker) I Know You Better Than You Know Yourself

objects.text:
You can now revive anyone who has died, as long as you have access to their biological material.

By touching the deceased’s biological material, you can form a cocoon around it, which rapidly develops into a restored version of the person. This process typically takes one day. The revived individual returns with all their memories and in their physical prime, free from any debilitating diseases or birth defects. If the person was a Parahuman, they would also regain their powers unless their shard had chosen a new host and was unwilling to support multiple hosts. Additionally, you can use this ability to heal the sick and injured if you wish.

Once per day, you can expand this power into an area-of-effect revival, forming cocoons around all deceased individuals within a ten-mile radius. This mass resurrection brings all the cocoons directly to your vicinity and completes the revival process within seconds, but it leaves you severely exhausted.

If you possess esoteric knowledge or a shardless power, this ability becomes a true resurrection, restoring not only the body but also the soul of the deceased. Furthermore, your revival range and usage limit may increase.
objects.title: (Striker/Shaker) Born Again

addons.text:
Your ability to excite particles has evolved into something far more destructive—you now weaken molecular bonds upon contact, causing materials to degrade and collapse at an accelerated rate. Anything exposed to your flames or plasma doesn’t just burn; it crumbles, disintegrating into embers and dust as its structural integrity is forcibly unraveled.

This effect extends to anything within your plasma field, meaning even near misses from your fire or heat waves can compromise structures, corrode metals, and cause reinforced barriers to fracture and fail. Living beings suffer more than burns—cellular bonds weaken, flesh loses cohesion, and bones become brittle as their very structure destabilizes. Even flame-resistant or energy-based defenses offer little protection, as your power does not simply destroy through heat, but through fundamental decay.

With precision, you can apply this effect selectively, allowing you to cut through armor and obstacles while leaving surrounding areas untouched. However, at full intensity, your power can turn battlefields into wastelands of molten slag and drifting embers, making prolonged engagements hazardous even to yourself.
addons.title: Torch It

addons.text: Your power no longer merely generates heat—it reshapes the very behavior of excited particles, turning them into catalysts for an unstoppable chain reaction. Whenever you excite matter, it begins to pull in neutral particles while repelling others that are also excited, spreading the reaction outward in a self-sustaining cascade. Each new particle that falls into this state gains the same properties, compounding the effect and increasing the overall energy of the system. The more energy you pour into an event, the further and faster the ignition spreads, allowing you to precisely control whether you are merely igniting a single target or triggering a planet-wide inferno. Given enough power, even the sky is not safe—entire atmospheres can become a roiling sea of plasma, ionizing in great waves that expand until nothing remains untouched. Unlike normal combustion, this reaction does not rely on fuel or oxygen; it is a fundamental shift in how energy propagates, making even typically inert substances vulnerable to destruction. At its most extreme, this cascading excitation warps physics itself. As the reaction accelerates, highly energized areas gain unnatural density, creating pockets of localized gravitational collapse that pull in surrounding mass like miniature stellar cores. The hottest regions become so dense that they begin to distort spacetime, leading to strange and unpredictable gravitational effects. If allowed to continue unchecked, the energy buildup can reach a point of no return, where the sheer mass and pressure within a single ignition site force it into a new state of matter—one that can collapse into a singularity or erupt into a new star. The end result depends on the scale of the reaction and how much control you exert over its growth. However, if you do not have Negentropy, your shard will rapidly exhaust itself and burn out, perhaps even burning itself from your flames.
addons.title: Supernova!

addons.text: You have become a thermodynamic singularity, the living embodiment of a white hole. Unlike black holes, which consume matter and energy, you are a constant, inexhaustible eruption of heat and radiation, an unstoppable force pushing outward against the universe itself. At will, you can unleash this power, turning your body into an unrelenting source of energy that expels waves of plasma, electromagnetic radiation, and raw heat at levels beyond comprehension. This energy surge does not require fuel, nor does it diminish over time. Matter caught in your presence does not simply burn—it is forcibly disintegrated, pushed apart at the atomic level, expelled from cohesion itself. However, this effect is fully under your control, allowing you to scale the intensity of your emissions or suppress them entirely. When activated, your presence warps the battlefield into a roiling inferno of superheated plasma and gravitational repulsion, making it all but impossible for anything to approach you without being hurled away or obliterated. You can generate incomprehensible thermal pulses and ionization storms, emitting bursts of gamma rays and X-ray radiation strong enough to scramble electronics, overload sensors, and create luminous, fiery shockwaves visible for miles. You do not simply set fire to your surroundings—you rewrite the flow of energy itself, causing cascading chain reactions that send unstoppable waves of heat and radiation across entire battlefields. At your highest output, your plasma emissions burn so intensely that they can be seen from orbit, and the very air itself ignites into expanding sheets of nuclear fire. Unlike natural phenomena, your energy does not diffuse or settle—it only grows, spreading outward indefinitely unless consciously controlled. The sheer intensity of your output means even distant observers risk exposure to deadly radiation, and prolonged use could transform entire regions into inhospitable wastelands. However, if you do not have Negentropy, your shard will rapidly exhaust itself and burn out, unable to sustain the relentless cosmic blaze that defines your existence.
addons.title: White Hole Incarnate

objects.text:
You are able to excite the particles that make up your body, rapidly increasing your temperature until you become a living plasma generator. As you activate your power, the molecules within you vibrate at extreme speeds, producing temperatures ranging from 1,500 to over 10,000 K (2,200–17,540°F). At lower intensities, your body burns like an open flame, igniting materials on contact. When fully unleashed, you transition into a state similar to ionized plasma, glowing with the blinding brilliance of a solar flare. In this form, you are not just burning—you are radiating intense electromagnetic energy, from visible light to infrared and even high-energy ultraviolet radiation. This radiant heat alone can ignite flammable objects within meters of your presence, and prolonged activation may cause the ground beneath you to melt into slag.

Your body passively excites surrounding gas molecules, creating an ionized plasma field that extends outward. You can exert control over the excited particles around you, allowing for directed bursts of flame and controlled propulsion. By pulling in and energising atmospheric gases, you create self-sustaining jets of superheated plasma that grant you flight, functioning similarly to an advanced rocket propulsion system. The force of this expelled plasma generates enough thrust to keep you airborne. You can launch concentrated blasts of fire that exceed 20,000 K (35,540°F), hot enough to momentarily rival the temperature of a nuclear explosion in localized bursts. These projectiles do not simply burn—they carry enough energy to ionise matter on impact, breaking molecular bonds and causing structural disintegration. The sheer intensity of your attacks means even indirect exposure can cause severe burns, while electronics within close proximity may fail due to electromagnetic interference.

You can make the surrounding air rapidly superheat, creating thermal updrafts that can escalate into firestorms, with hurricane-force winds feeding the inferno you leave in your wake. At extreme output, your body radiates X-rays and other ionizing emissions, making prolonged use hazardous not only to enemies but to bystanders and even yourself without proper control. To sustain this level of energy without burning yourself to ash, you have a form of heat resistance through a specialised energy field that prevents your molecules from succumbing to the same incineration you unleash on the world.
objects.title: (Breaker/Blaster) Flame On

objects.text: Whenever you commit a crime or break a law your everything is enhanced. Skills, powers, body, and etc. The greater the crime the bigger the boost, with the severity and context diminishing or increasing said boost. As such, you could gleefully murder a innocent person and receive a 50% boost, or jaywalk and receive a 1% boost. The laws that are used are the ones from wherever you were born and the location you are in.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Criminality

objects.text: You can freely violate Newton's Third Law of Motion, which states that "for every action force exerted, there is an equal and opposite reaction force". You are capable of reducing or outright negating the reaction force for any force you directly produce. For example, you could casually push your hand through a two-foot-thick metal wall like melted butter, facing no resistance, deliver powerful blows with no recoil or lift objects far heavier than your body should be capable of simply by reducing the pressure pushing back against you. This is not just limited to kinetic energy but applies to any physical force you directly exert, whether via your body or your powers. You could unleash unstoppable Blaster effects that pierce without losing momentum or move through matter in an electrical Breaker form with zero resistance. You have perfect innate control over this power and how it manifests, preventing you from accidentally sinking straight down into the earth's core or losing traction when walking. This power cancels out against other All-or-Nothing abilities, with both effects mutually nullifying one another. However, this power only applies to the action forces that you directly produce, so any external force inflicted on you will still operate exactly as expected. In essence, your actions are an unstoppable force but you remain a very moveable object.
objects.title: (Brute/Trump) Non-Newtonian Force

objects.text:
Should you perish at the hands of a parahuman, whether through a direct application of their power, a tinker device, or something more roundabout, you can use your opponent's power to resurrect yourself.

After you die, you will have a few moments of clarity, allowing you to choose which power to use as a resurrection vector—in case there were numerous attackers that contributed to your demise—as well as mentally recuperate from the pain and trauma of death.

During the resurrection, your body will be completely remade by your opponent's power, giving you an existence akin to an autonomous, self-sustaining ability, complete with the power reminiscent of the one that killed you that will persist for as long as your new form does. Depending on the exact power of your opponent, your new body and the manner in which you resurrect can be rather bizarre. For example, getting killed by Jack Slash may see you reborn as a collection of wavelengths transmitting cutting force; you may become a living information when killed by Tattletale; and getting killed by a tinker may cause their shard to force them to build a new body for you. As part of your opponent's power is diverted to sustain your form, their own power becomes significantly weaker.

After resurrection, you become immune to the direct application of the power you now embody, as well as similar powers, although you are not invulnerable and can still be damaged and even killed through indirect means or other powers. Should the same parahuman successfully kill you a second time when you embody their power, your form will become even stronger, with their power weakening once more. After a few of your deaths, they may be left completely powerless. On the other hand, should you be killed by a completely different parahuman, your form will be discarded, and a new one will be created based on the new opponent's power.

Do note that you can still be killed by a normal unpowered person or someone immune to having their power tampered with, like an Endbringer. And unless you possess some other means of resurrection, this death will be final.
objects.title: (Trump) Yomotsugaeri

objects.text:
You can produce a singular 1 m<sup>3</sup> cube that contains a real-time scale model of any area that you are aware of. This projection is perfect, replicating the landscape, people and objects exactly as they exist in the real world.

By interacting with the model, you can remotely physically affect the corresponding location. Actions such as lifting a diminutive car with your hand or setting a tiny door on fire with your lighter will cause the real-world counterpart to experience equivalent results. The projection can be created and dismissed at will.

To observers in the affected area, these changes appear to be the work of an invisible, untouchable entity. You could manipulate furniture as though playing with a dollhouse or crush a miniaturised figure, simultaneously flattening them in reality. This can include your current surroundings, aiding in reconnaissance or combat.

The model’s scale can be freely adjusted, from 1:1 up to a 1:24 ratio, determining how it corresponds to the real world. As such, your projected model can cover a maximum space of up to 24x24x24 metres in size, enough to encompass a small apartment block. This power has no inherent range limit beyond standard shard constraints.

Only physical phenomena can be transmitted through this power, such as kinetic force, combustion, electricity etc, preventing more abstract phenomena, namely parahuman abilities like Trump or Master effects, from being directly channelled.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Scale Model

addons.text: You can now force any parahuman rendered an ‘avatar’ to instead become a full fledged titan under their Shard’s influence. Similarly to avatars, you do not have direct control of these Titans, but they will run out of energy exceptionally quickly to compensate for their massively increased power and energy drain.
addons.title: AMEND

addons.text: Your tether into usual Shard operation allows you to control the Avatars directly, through the Shard, essentially puppeting them in an indirect fashion. Additionally, as the Shard is under your control, you can send its signal through other crystallised organisms, essentially making each of them vectors for any parahuman power any combination of suborned shards could make.
addons.title: SUBORN

objects.text: In between your knuckles are a series of holes, from these holes you can fire barbed needles at high speeds. These needles are barbed and designed to shatter on impact with armour, turning into microscopic shrapnel to be breathed in. When these barbs make their way into a body, they begin to secrete a liquifying agent. Starting from the wound outwards (potentially from inside their lungs if fragments are inhaled), the victim begins to liquify then crystallise, with nothing short of amputation able to stop the spread. When completely crystallised the body begins to act spontaneously, under the direction not of you directly, but your Shard, responding to your emotions and impulses. When a living organism is crystalised, your Shard is able to act through it with impunity, and with far less restrictions than through its host, essentially allowing the Shard to express itself in any number of alternate ways aligning with its purpose, albeit limited to its original ‘level’ of power expenditure (and thus being far less than a speculative Titan counterpart). How this will express in your case depends almost entirely on other powers you possess. By default, however, your shard exists to sabotage Data collection, with most of its expressions specifically being devised to baffle traditional Entity collection methods. When the spines impact another Parahuman, after crystallising, their Shard is able to act through the host in much the same way as your own, but unlike normal crystallised humans, you will not have control over this one, leaving it free to its own devices. As the Shard continues to act through its Host however, it will begin to find its data corrupted, and its power waning as it expends more and more, eventually being fully siphoned of power to sustain the ‘avatar’ and your shard.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Se Adapta

addons.text:
You now constantly acquire new Skills or Powers that have the exact strength necessary to solve their reason of existence—though still limited by the SP cap—but where before you needed to desire or need something for them to develop, now merely existing is enough for your power to gift you Powers/Skills. You could lie in your bed and suddenly have the power to always be wearing comfortable clothes, or walk outside and not need sunscreen even on the sunniest of days.

These Skills/Powers are still bound to the three loss conditions.
addons.title: Coddled by the Plot

objects.text:
Whenever you need or want it, you will spontaneously develop a Skill or Power at a level that, alone, would need a bit of effort to solve what you needed it for. Skills are capped at their possible limit while Powers are capped at 15 SP.

Always remember that, alone, those Powers/Skills can only deal with your situation if you put effort into it. You need to defeat someone wielding a Gun? You can now take a couple shots, so better make it count to strike them down. Need to hit a moving target? Increased Marksmanship that just needs you to be completely focused to be 100% accurate.

Those Powers/Skills are somewhat temporary but can stack with each other for greater effects. Essentially, there's three ways you can lose a Skill/Power: you solved what you gained them for, resulting in a 60% chance to lose them; you exited a conflict, with a 30% chance for each Skill/Power related to the situation; and finally, every 24 hours each of the Skills/Powers you gained have a 30% chance to disappear.
objects.title: (Trump) As the Plot Demands

addons.text:
Rather than your Shard doing the work of turning you into a Dragon every time you use your power or manage your fire breath, it has instead modified your body to mutate into a dragon yourself through the development of unique organs skirting the edge of biological plausibility.

This leaves with a biological system that envelops your spinal column, extending from your cerebellum to the tailbone. The system spatially folds and contains the mass that your Dragon form has shunted the excess organic matter to a pocket space, shifting all its poundage to it, leaving you at your usual weight. Once changing into your form, clothing and equipment are then stored in said pocket space in return.

Your flammable breath is generated by glands between your respiratory system and larynx that synthesize a hyper-flammable chemical compound similar to gasoline or napalm, with another gland close to the larynx igniting this compound, achieving fire breath using the larynx’s stimulation as a trigger.

Your DNA is a wondrous composition of genetic information. Now, with a quad-helix structure, you are practically a different species, only tangentially related to modern humanity.

Your ability to passively mutate your body has grown to the point of allowing you to emulate simple Tier 1 powers. However, complex powers like Tinker powers, most Trump powers, and things like Dimensional, Temporal Manipulation or True Precognition are simply beyond you.
addons.title: Why be Yourself When you can be a Dragon Instead

objects.text:
You can transform into a classical western dragon roughly 25.2 meters (88 feet) long from head to tail with a wingspan of 30.2 meters (99 feet), and a weight of 16 tons (32,000 lbs). This dragon form has scales of a color of your choice, and with a near-instantaneous shapeshift.

You can remain in your draconic form indefinitely and be unable to age when under this transformation, though you still age normally when in human form. You retain your full mental faculties and personality without being affected by your dragon form's instincts and biology.

Your dragon form has strength, durability, regeneration, and speed that rival the highest of Brutes. 

With strength comparable to Alexandria, you can effortlessly tear skyscrapers apart and flatten mountains, or fight Behemoth to a standstill. Unlike Alexandria, this physical strength originates from your abnormal physique. It does not come with a forcefield that allows you greater leverage or prevents objects from crumbling under their weight.

While you are not invincible, your durability allows you to walk off a point-blank nuclear explosion without scratching your scales, though All-or-Nothing effects will cleanly tear through your scales. To balance this, you possess an incredibly potent regeneration, allowing you to regenerate in seconds as long as your Corona Pollentia and Gemma are intact. This also makes you immune to non-tinkertech modified diseases, poisons, and radiation.

Your speed on land rivals that of modern supercars, approaching 300 km/h; it is nothing compared to the hypersonic flight speed you can reach. Even with your large and heavy body, you have near-perfect maneuverability, and your reaction time is enhanced to allow you to fully control even at extreme speeds.

Last but not least, you can breathe fire; you can control the amount of fire your breath expels from merely a campfire's worth to a level comparable to a volcanic eruption. However, you cannot control this fire after you breathe it, so be careful about accidentally burning down your house or the city it's in.

Your clothing and equipment are stored within a small pocket dimension when you are in your dragon form. When returning to your human form, your clothing and equipment return to the position and orientation they had when you originally changed forms. Optionally, you can prevent clothing and equipment from being stored. However, unless it takes your dragon form into account, whatever you wear or have on your person will most likely be destroyed.

While your draconic form has opposable thumbs on the two front legs, your overall fine control does not match your human form, dramatically reducing your ability to utilize tools in your dragon form.
objects.title: (Changer/Brute) Here There be Dragons

objects.text:
Every week, you gain a new form—each with a distinct appearance and unique set of powers. These forms are generated randomly, their features and traits often wildly different from your base form. This can range from being older, younger, of a different gender, or with entirely unfamiliar physical proportions and racial features. Despite these differences, each form remains biologically the same species as you, ensuring that you never shift into something non-human or entirely alien—no animals, no machines, no non-sapient lifeforms as long as you are human.

Each form has 5 SP worth of powers, randomly selected from your Shard’s catalog. These powers are exclusive to that form and are accompanied by 10 CP worth of complementary skills. The skills are tailored to match the form’s abilities and can range from combat, survival, performance, technical expertise, or something stranger.

In addition, every form comes with a generated backstory—memories, preferences, and personal context that was made up by your shard. While these memories don’t override your own, they can influence your instincts and behavior while in that form, making each transformation a shift not just in body, but in mindset.

You can store an unlimited number of forms, building a growing library of alternate selves. However, you can only transform into one form at a time. 

Staying in a form and practicing with it can improve its abilities. After roughly a month spent training in a specific form, that form gains 1 additional SP worth of power and 2 CP with of skills.

You start with zero forms.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Manifold Forms

addons.text:
By combining the recursive Archive access of Madness Palace with the precision engineering of Power Tinker, you gain administrator-level interaction with the Shard Network. Shards no longer appear as alien mysteries but as nodes in a vast system, each with functions, permissions, and processes that can be mapped, analyzed, and rewritten.

You can isolate a Shard’s active routines, expose hidden parameters, and edit the rules that shape its powers—restrictions, efficiency, trigger logic, or even the branching pathways of its growth. The Madness Palace provides the recursive heuristics to interpret this alien code, while your Tinkertech stabilizes the link long enough to enforce changes. This allows you to repair or stabilize failing Shards, hybridize abilities, forge artificial linkages, and even rewrite how triggers unfold.

These edits come with danger. Your bridges into shardspace rely on invasive, fragile methods—implants, neural rerouting, vat-brains—and each attempt risks drawing attention from defensive routines buried deep in the Network. Corruption, feedback loops, or parasitic data structures can destabilize both Shard and host. Worse, the recursive logic of the Madness Palace bleeds into your work, threatening to erode your mind until you become less a Tinker and more an administrative process endlessly running in shardspace.
addons.title: Sys-Shard Admin

addons.text:
Your mind no longer needs to directly wander the dangerous halls of the Madness Palace. Instead, you weave it together with a lattice of Computronio nodes, creating a distributed network of thought that explores in your stead. These nodes project into the Palace, dipping into its endless archives and returning only refined, stable fragments of knowledge.

The result is a stream of coherent blueprints and safe insights, stripped of the toxic excess that would drive even the strongest thinker to ruin. The knowledge is limited to what a specialist in that field could produce—meaning you will never pull back impossible nonsense or shortcuts to powers outside your scope—but what you do receive is immediately usable and free from corruption.

This network scales with your resources. A handful of nodes provide trickles of inspiration; a true computational lattice can harvest breakthroughs across multiple disciplines at once. The mad brilliance of the Palace becomes ordered, compartmentalized, and safe—no longer whispers that gnaw at your sanity, but blueprints that expand your workshop and strengthen your reach.
addons.title: Photonic Crystals Cluster

objects.text:
You are a Tinker whose mind is irrevocably linked—by accident, design, or cosmic oversight—to the [SHARD] Archive, an extra-dimensional, multi-temporal vault that stores fragmented, recursive knowledge siphoned from countless realities by the Shard Network. To you, this forbidden vault is known only as the Madness Palace—a labyrinth of half-remembered truths and broken blueprints never meant for human eyes. A stray permissions glitch gave you full access to its infinite halls, and every step deeper bends your mind further under its impossible weight.

At baseline, you’re already an accomplished Tinker, capable of building tech decades beyond contemporary human science—matching any mid-tier generalist in the field; however, that's just a very shallow and equally vast amount of knowledge curated by the [SHARD]. But with the Madness Palace, you reach far beyond mundane genius. You don’t receive intuitive designs the way normal Tinkers do. Instead, you mine corrupted data fragments, conflicting heuristics, and partial schematics buried in recursive logic. Making sense of it demands sheer brilliance—and invites creeping insanity.

Your specialty is meta-specialization. The Archive does not limit you to a single technological field; instead, you freely hybridize disciplines—splicing together physics-defying engines, mimicry frameworks, or power-channeling rigs once thought possible only for other Shards. The deeper you “dive” into the Palace, the stranger and stronger your creations become. But every deep dive leaves a mark: disorientation, obsessive thought loops, hallucinations, and the slow erosion of your stable identity. Dive too deep, too often, and you risk becoming a living query loop—a mind fragment endlessly running in the Archive’s backrooms.

All your Tinkertech is whiteboxed: you fully understand every twisted line of logic and can replicate your inventions at will. But your designs are so warped and layered that anyone else trying to reverse-engineer them risks mental collapse—rendering your work effectively blackboxed to everyone but you (or someone equally mad).

The Madness Palace doesn’t grant infinite time or perfect focus. Every session spent plumbing its depths erodes your sanity and identity, piece by piece. Shallow dives yield stable, reliable tech within normal Tinker boundaries. Deep dives promise world-breaking innovation—and the gnawing certainty that the Archive is not just feeding you data, but quietly learning from you in return.

In the end, you are an omnidirectional wildcard Tinker: your greatest strength is a vault of forbidden, cross-dimensional knowledge—and your greatest threat is the unraveling mind that must wield it.
objects.title: (Tinker) Madness Palace

addons.text: All Sankta are automatically connected through a separate instance of Networking, which only connects to Sankta but does not degrade with distance and allows rudimentary telepathic communication via transmitted feelings and intent. If you possess Networked Networking or Interconnected Networking, then the Sankta network instance also functions as a power network as well.
addons.title: Flock

addons.text: The wings of a Sankta are no longer cosmetic, partially inheriting the traits of whatever power(s) triggered the addon, i.e. True Wings bestows generic flight and nothing else, Winged One slightly boosts any powers possessed, and Icarus provides vastly increased speed and a protective field in exchange for the possibility of being temporarily damaged and rendered non-functional when the field is damaged.
addons.title: Seraph

addons.text: All Sankta gain the ability to manifest a single personalized weapon, of the same kind as your power. For instance, with Did You Say Initial Release?, their weapon can only be a ‘cold weapon’; however, it will possess the ability to channel powers, while Miss Militia or Hana would allow for guns but would lack the channeling ability. If you possess Bankai? Not Quite then Sankta also gains the ability to manifest a personalized set of apparel - each piece able to be manifest separately - which channels powers as well. To clarify, Sankta cannot change their personalized equipment, being restricted to manifesting a single form best suited for them. Your own abilities remain unchanged even if you make yourself a Sankta.
addons.title: Pact Weapon

addons.text: Type: Humanity binds the power of the Sankta to their very DNA, transforming an artificial state of empowerment into a true racial transformation, their halo and wings not mere power manifestations but a fundamental part of their body. As this is a true racial transformation, the effects are permanent and can be biologically passed down and inherited. All Sankta benefit from the effects of Type: Humanity, possessing triple helix DNA. Additionally, Exile actually becomes worse. Being Exiled doesn’t transform someone back into their original race; instead, it merely strips them of the features which denote a Sankta, halo shattering and wings fading. This leads to effects like ghost limbs and body dysphoria as the mind struggles to cope with the traumatic loss of part of its body. Lastly, if you possess Flock, then the strengthened connection Sankta possess allows for the sharing of evolutionary data, meaning that if one Sankta develops a beneficial mutation, all Sankta can manifest it as well.
addons.title: Rebirth

addons.text: Your Tiefling physiology has corrupted the Sankta, transforming them into Sarkaz. This is most evident aesthetically, halo blackening and wings transforming into a black unlight which leeches the light from their surroundings. Sarkaz also manifests horns, a tail, and the heightened resilience and minor pyrokinesis of a Tiefling. Lastly, you automatically start as a Sarkaz. If you have the physiology of a Devil instead, then Sarkaz also exhibits the affinity for manipulation, minor wing functionality, and enhanced pyrokinesis and physical capabilities of a devil.
addons.title: Sarkaz

addons.text:
The Sankta network takes jurisdiction over your ever-growing world dimension, transforming it into a pocket city-state that any Sankta can access freely, whether entering directly or opening portals with a size from small enough to barely fit a bullet through up to the size of large semi-trucks.

At the core of this dimension lies Laterano, a bright and beautiful city of Gothic architecture with all the infrastructure needed to support its Sankta inhabitants. As new Sankta are connected to the Law, the city grows in size and creates new infrastructure.

This ensures that every Sankta has their base needs covered, with the city providing fully furnished housing with all the needed amenities, such as food, water, electricity, and even a separate layer of internet for the city's digital needs.

This city also generates non-residential properties like farms, bakeries, or workshops that Sankta can take possession of with relatively little effort. This works through the Halo, reading when a Sankta has relevant skills and generating the corresponding properties needed to use those skills. These properties adapt to their owners and their needs, growing with them or expanding if they hire other Sankta.

While nothing prevents non-Sankta from entering one of the portals that a Sankta creates, the city simply does not make allowances for them. Unless a Sankta decides to open a business catering to outsiders or they convince a Sankta to let them live with them, they will be left homeless and without any form of accommodation, supplies, or access to automated infrastructure.
addons.title: Laterano

objects.text:
You possess the ability to transform others - and optionally yourself - into Sankta, denoted by the presence of a unique and personalized halo and pair of luminescent wings, although the wings are entirely cosmetic and do not bestow flight.

The Halo of a Sankta grants them an empathic mental connection to each other, allowing them to feel the emotions, pain, and intent of other Sankta. Additionally, Sankta are bound by “Laws” which punish negative actions and reward positive ones, albeit only when committed towards other Sankta. All Sankta possess an innate awareness of the Laws which bind them, meaning they cannot violate them out of ignorance. Merely thinking about violating the law is enough to cause minor negative feedback, akin to slight pressure or a minor headache.

To elaborate, selfless actions provide not just positive feelings, but in the case of Parahumans, also provide minor but compounding boosts to the control and strength of their powers so long as they do not commit a punishable act. Conversely, harmful acts that inflict suffering on others result in Exile. Exiled not only lose the benefits of being a Sankta but also the ability to understand other beings - even non-Sankta - on a fundamental level.

This inability to understand extends to the point of being unable to understand speech, writing, expression, or even recognize features, leaving them truly and utterly alone in the world, save for the incomprehensible shades of those they once knew. The inability to understand is so strong that it functionally goes both ways to a certain extent, as Exiled are fundamentally unable to communicate with others. On the flip side, Sankta who do possess haloes find themselves functionally unable to see and register Exiled as people, instead seeing them as something along a particularly smart animal, a beast in the wilderness.

You do not have to touch others to convert them; instead, you're able to convert any being that enters a 100-meter radius.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Sankta

addons.text: Turns out, when your mentality focuses on the right set of actions and inputs to reach a goal helps a lot with the ability to branch out from any movement. Your Thinker powers meld with Move Cancel to plan and improve its effectiveness, seeing the “best” routes and picking the “right” branches as combos on your head. In turn, it makes your “branches” instantaneous, done in quick succession, moving from one area to another or immediately onto the next opponent, where you’ll be all over the place from anyone’s point of view. This guidance also helps with power synergies (if you have any). Inputting a combo to plan a successive path of “branches” will inevitably result in a Super. A Super Cancel being a cinematic attack made from one of your powers at your disposal (or Move Cancel) that causes a high degree of damage or puts the enemy or obstacle at a disadvantage. How this Super manifests is always up to you. Having Stacked Move will change up this synergy’s mechanics to “stack” the combo you make in your favor, adding several ways how an input or combo is performed, speeding your chance for a Super, resulting in different unpredictable effects, like “wavedashing” or “crouch dashing” while on the cusp of a Super.
addons.title: Super Cancel

addons.text: Sometimes, slow and steady wins the battle, with Your Only Move’s ‘pause’ opening FGC’s eyes in reading your opponent: every ‘pause’ will tell you their weak points, what moves they’ll lean on, you’ll be fully aware and sharply reading the opponent, to the point you’re already know how to begin and end a match with the strategies to boot. As a result, all your combos are freeform, where there’s more fluidity in the range of combos you’re able to do or act on, as long as you ‘pause’ to plan these out. Be ready to make some strings! Having Brain Playstyle/Super Cancel and/or Body Playstyle will expand your capability further, with the former’s intuitive awareness of your “branches” will refine your ability to see the “best” branches to the point it is already “done”, the opponent only catching up when they’re on the ground or already dead.
addons.title: ULTRA COMBO!

objects.text: "Wombo Combo!" You can visualize yourself as if your body is a fighting game player character while you're using an imaginary controller as input for your actions. This ability can help you in executing tasks much more effectively. As you can do things that require a skill set you're not as experienced in or as talented in, as if you're just clicking a few buttons. The more complicated the combo input is, the more complex the things you can do. A quick example would be cooking a hard-to-execute recipe. You can do so without cooking experience, so long as you execute the button inputs in your head. The more complicated the combos are, the tastier it becomes. You don't think up a combo yourself; your ability gives you a list of ones you can try. You can still fail if you haven't gotten the grip of the combo you are trying to do, however. Nothing that some practice couldn't fix. Life is a video game, and you're a pro gamer.
objects.title: (Thinker) FGC Mentality

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to forcibly interface with and override the control matrix of any Endbringer within 100 meters of you, regardless of whether they were created by another Shard, Entity, or other means.

However, this reprogramming is not instantaneous and varies based on a target’s strength and proximity. At maximum range, several minutes are usually required to gain control of most Endbringers. But as this distance shrinks, so too does the time required, with even brief physical contact allowing for near-instant subjugation.

Any interruption in this reprogramming, such as the Endbringer leaving your 100m radius, resets this process in its entirety. Moreover, most Endbringers will sense your attempt to control them and respond with overwhelming force or the desire to flee. Simply staying in the required range can become a desperate struggle for survival.

Furthermore, you instinctively perceive the exact amount of time required to complete reprogramming for any Endbringer within your range, granting you perfect awareness of how your power interacts with them. Once reprogramming is complete, your control is absolute and permanent, overriding all prior loyalties, programming, and commands, and, in the absence of orders, acting independently in ways consistent with your Shard’s directives.

Finally, any Shard-boosting perks you possess (such as Negentropy, Esoteric Knowledge, or Pocket Shard) extend to your controlled Endbringers. In particular, Negentropy drastically accelerates reprogramming, reducing the time required to subjugate even an Endbringer at maximum range to as little as one minute.
objects.title: (Master) End-Controller

addons.text: With your ability to integrate pseudo-spiritual and other esoteric energies into your technology, you have managed to take your specialty from merely being technology that resembles magic to technology that uses magic - or at least 'magic' - to function. In simpler terms, your ability to integrate pseudo-spiritual energy into technology allows you to cut corners and resources costs by using it as a substitute and to smooth things over, furthering the illusion of magic. An example of what this would allow you to create is a magical girl transformation device which allows the wielder to use their own spiritual energy to enhance themselves and cast a variety of “spells” with the majority of energy and resource costs coming from the user themselves.
addons.title: Technology is Magic

objects.text:
You know the trope where it turns out a complex and powerful magic system is actually a form of technology? Yeah, this Tinker specialty revolves around that concept.

Consider essentially any and all common uses for magic in the fantasy genre, and this Tinker specialty will probably have some method to replicate them with technology. Whether that be wands controlling the elements, enchanted items, summoned magical creatures, or even something like the existence of mana.

Some examples could be mana taking the form of a versatile biocompatible nanite design implanted in a user to let them directly cast spells. Golems are pretty simple, just robots and AI with a fantasy aesthetic. Alchemy through medicine and poison. Enchanting items could work by installing modifiable energy field projectors into the desired objects. Even a curse of bad luck is possible through the use of a long-range probability manipulating device.

Powerwise, a good example for the low end of this power would put you in the same level as a hedge wizard: simple levitation, the odd light illusion, maybe a few electro zaps here and there.

Upon reaching your full potential, however, you’ll be the equal of the average high-fantasy wizard, meaning you’ll be able to do things like rain down elemental destruction on cities, raise legions of golems or undead, teleport, empower people to match the greatest of Brutes, easily heal any injury short of death, or even make powerful laser beam shooting swords that can only be wielded by those who are worthy.

Despite the versatility and strength of this power, it does have one glaring limitation: namely, any tinkertech beyond the basics will need to have an integrated computer to function. The programming for these computers is unique in that the way this power drives you to naturally program them always incorporates a story describing possible feats that can be done by the tinkertech in question. This can dramatically increase the construction time for even simple pieces of equipment, especially if you try to fight this impulse.

Your tinkertech will also only work at peak efficiency and effectiveness when you are using it to perform actions described in its story. It’s not all bad, though; once you adjust to it, you’ll find this story-based programming language to be an incredibly elegant and effective form of coding.
objects.title: (Tinker) Magic is Technology

addons.text: Unbound by the constraints of Shards, there is no soft cap to your development. Given enough time and resources, you can iterate your way to creations beyond comprehension—superweapons capable of destroying galaxies, god machines that warp reality, and more.
addons.title: Ad Infinitum

objects.text:
Much like String Theory, you are a Free Tinker with a slight twist. In your case, rather than your creations being on a time limit, your Tinkering methodology has a Focal Tinker flair.

As a baseline, you can build pretty much anything; however, your initial creations are below even conventional technology in capability, being more along the lines of DIY projects. However, by studying your creations, you gain an understanding of how to make a new version that is improved in some way.

This process can occur multiple times, each iteration of the project growing more advanced, although at a certain point, you will reach a soft-cap due to Shard restrictions. Thus, the optimal usage of this power is to create something, then study it before creating an improved version, before repeating the process over and over again.

Additionally, this process of studying something to build a better version can be applied to any technology, not just your own, although you will still have to work past the blackboxing of other Shards if you want to study another Tinker’s tech.
objects.title: (Tinker) Iterative Design

objects.text:
Your power is designed with one purpose and one purpose only: to kill. Your power grants you access to 5 slots, 5 mutable channels you can slot with lethal vectors with which to express your powers.

Burning, cutting, poison, monsters, explosives, ablations, concussion, predations, fragmentation, entropy, gravitation, toxic bloom, and countless others catalogued by your Shard. These are not mere elements or base themes either, no, they’re mere examples, slots can hold anything your power deems a viable method of killing,

Slots can be swapped freely, but only loaded effects are accessible at any point in time. Every vector expresses only lethality. No healing, no shields, no utility—only lethal function. Fire cannot warm, predators cannot guard, poisons cannot numb; their function is to end life and nothing else.

Slots are freely expressive, a single vector that can be expressed in endless ways. Entropy may be represented as a corrosive fog, collapsing terrain, or withering weapons. Vectors can also be freely combined, such as <u>Predation</u> and <u>Toxic</u> bloom to create fungal beasts, ablation and gravitation to create singularities that shear matter, mix <u>Fire</u> + <u>Monsters</u> + <u>Poison</u> + <u>Explosion</u> to create a dragon spewing toxic, explosive fire while slashing with razor-edge claws.

Once loaded, slots can be expressed in any combination, in any number of ways simultaneously. This means you can summon poison blades, caustic acids, and creatures that breathe fire and explosive poison gas, you can deploy fire pillars, exploding spiders, and poisoned blades—all drawn from the same slot pool.

By default, the power is efficient, using no more force than necessary. But you control the scale. Ablation can strip buildings layer by layer or erase entire blocks. Gravitation can pull a man to his knees or mimic the collapse of a star. Flames can flicker or burn as plasma jets that scour cities. Scale brings collateral.

Your Shard also remembers: once you create something, from razor-wire entropy traps to collapsing predator hives, you can recall it instantly as a stored configuration.

Your power’s effective range manifests in two hundred square meters; the Manton Effect holds, so you cannot use it to spawn your effects directly inside a living being, although near them is fine.
objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Fatalis Engine

objects.text: You didn’t do that. And if you did, it wasn’t that bad. And if it was, you didn’t mean it. And if you did, they deserved it. No matter what you do or say, everyone who experiences it will see you as having been entirely right. Not because their reasoning has been tampered with, but because their perception of the world has been altered to construct an alternate reality where you would be right, and everything the people affected experience will be filtered through the lens of that reality. This doesn’t wear off; anyone who has had their worldview changed by your actions will continue to live their life seeing only what your power lets them see, automatically filtering out any and all evidence suggesting you could have been wrong, until they either die or have their perception tampered with by you again. The simulation they are trapped in is flawless, taking the knowledge and feelings of the target into account to cut off any suspicion they might have before they even start to feel it. Not even Tattletale would be able to tell something is wrong in the world if she fell under your power’s effect.
objects.title: (Stranger) Extenuating Circumstances

addons.text: This power’s functionality has transformed, harkening back to one of its original purposes for the Entities: the creation of customisable projections able to pass as members of a host species. With (Breaker/Trump) Custom Avatar, you don’t have just one alternate form. Instead, every avatar you create is stored as an individual template that is freely accessible. Additionally, the reservoir that fuels your transformations now refills passively at a baseline rate equal to what would be generated through normal relaxation. There is no upper limit to how many templates you can create, though transitioning between them consumes your reservoir, with the cost scaling proportionally to the degree of deviation between the two forms. Beware that your mind can still be influenced by the alien thought processes of forms your shard emulated in cycles past.
addons.title: Custom Projection

addons.text: Every body born of Amon Syndrome has become more than a copy; they now manifest as projections, sustained by your shard through the exact same framework as your ‘primary’ body. As such, every projection you create possesses the same durability and extraordinary regenerative capability as your original body. You may summon or dismiss projections at will and can materialise new avatars within a hundred metres of any existing body. This does not increase your "pool" of power for avatars. Additionally, you may designate any projection as your ‘primary’ self at any time, seamlessly transferring your full suite of abilities to that body. Even if your ‘primary’ body was somehow annihilated beyond recovery, your shard would simply reroute into another active projection, preserving your continuity of self.
addons.title: Continuity of Being

objects.text:
You have gained a power akin to Scion’s avatar, your physical self now existing as a material projection. Your shard continuously heals and maintains both your body and consciousness, rendering you effectively unkillable by conventional means.

You regenerate any damaged tissue nigh instantaneously, fast enough that even those with parahuman senses may fail to register it. You can fully control this process, altering its speed and scope at will. Total erasure of every atom of your body would only see you being immediately reconstituted.

Your body’s ‘template’ will update automatically to ensure any beneficial alterations, such as tinkertech and so on, can be integrated into your body and so similarly restored. As a side effect, your shard will permanently maintain you at peak condition and safeguard your mind in a manner akin to Alexandria.

This doesn’t prevent you from being trapped or restrained. Your shard can potentially run out of energy replenishing your body, although it may take decades of continuous damage to achieve this.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Self Projection

objects.text:
With this power, you are given the ability to create a core of darkness within an enclosed space by piercing the floor with a sufficiently sharp object such as a knife or screwdriver. With this core of darkness established, a field of darkness is formed and spreads to encompass the entirety of the room.

When the room is completely enclosed in darkness, over the course of an hour, a pocket dimension is procedurally formed, influenced by your imagination and perspective of the location, and based on the objects within the location. Various individuals and structures based on the items within the room populate this pocket dimension. Such natives have an ingrained loyalty to you for creating them and universally wield 8SP worth of powers expressed in ways befitting the object of their origin.

People of the real world entering this pocket dimension, excluding you if you so choose, have their clothing, form and possessions transformed into items based similarly on their wielder's personality and their form into more combat suitable forms. Such as a hoodie becoming a spiked set of leather armor or a pencil becoming a carbon-reinforced wooden sword. This can also exclusively provide unpowered individuals with 10SP worth of powers when within this realm, however they will lose these powers when leaving. Parahumans, such as you, are exempt from this temporary boost.

This pocket dimension can be destroyed in two ways. Whether by illuminating the pocket dimension with a sufficiently strong source of light, or by destroying the core of darkness maintaining its existence.
objects.title: (Shaker/Master) Dark Worlds

addons.text: Your ability to manifest tinkertech in your environment has settled in quite well with your ability to design and manifest equipment for buildings. Where before you could only create mundane hospitals, factories, or military encampments, now you can turn them into the nodes from where your tinkertech propagates. As you apply further focus on officiated buildings or areas, their equipment and surroundings begin to transform into tinkertech at a rapid pace, suited for the designated purpose of the officiates. For example, a hospital might eventually grow into a full on medbay you would see on a starship, or a military encampment might start producing its own robotic soldiers. A road network grows solar panels and kinetic receivers that transform the energy of the cars driving atop them into usable electrical energy. An art museum gains a Master rating. Schools, offices, apartments - so long as it is an officiate, it can grow tinkertech. More focus and more time means more advanced refinement of this tinkertech.
addons.title: City of Tomorrow

addons.text:
A voice whispers into your ear, now, tickling your ear’s inner canals. Uninterrupting, but ever-present, like a newspaper birdie at your shoulder. The information it whispers is of the city, when you think of it. Of any city. It speaks of the people in their hustle and bustle, the quiet troubles they stew within that the rush of this day and age cannot whisk them away from. It speaks of the time, as it ticks from your phone, watch, and hippocampus. The corners of the city where the lowly trod and the criminals hide, the abandoned dusts where ambitious projects lay to the wayside, and the seasons when winds and insects come and go.

And your mind pieces it all together to create a painting of past, present, and future. At any time you wish, so long as it has happened in your vicinity, and so long as it happened in the bounds of a city - and even the rustiest pipe in the deepest of forests counts as a stretch of a city - you know what happened, how it happened, and what it will make happen. Omniscience bounded in gray. Your creations especially amplify your awareness, with the voice whispering louder near them, more detailed in explanation.

You are now capable of applying influence with your urbanism, for you are aware of the city in its entirety, and thus act as its Will, translating its vibrations and musings into plots that could decide the fate of nations. Your manipulation of the smaller things - from signs to logos, from typography to parking lines - sharpens when you utilize it alongside your awareness. Subliminal messaging on a mass degree, unable to be perceived by most even as you walk among the crowd. In days, you could change the air of a city to be transient, as people unintentionally act in ways that would lead to its decline. In weeks, you could organize mass protests for bloodsport, breaking records with how many people attend and how far politicians go to appease them. In months, you could change the world on a global scale. And if you were to focus this manipulation for or against a singular group or person, you can be sure that you decide their fates alone, with their lives putty in your hands. Martyrs, scapegoats, heroes and villains, handmade all by you.
addons.title: La Citadelière

addons.text:
You are no longer limited to the manipulation of urban spaces, nor the transformation of a single ecosystem at a time. Rather, your power has ascended to a breadth and depth most will envy: simply, Environment Manipulation.

Within a range of 20 miles, you are now able to manifest and manipulate any mundane environment, and are capable of controlling, adding to, and removing from these environments at both a micro and macro scale, including biological entities. You are not limited to singular environments either. You could will into existence a bustling desert locale on one half with a winter wonderland on the other half, or turn into a jungle that gets continuously dense and dangerous as you near its center. You possess full knowledge and control over any entities you directly create, from memories to life cycles to instincts and more, and are well-equipped to handle and take advantage of this knowledge.

Additionally, when creating biological entities, you can fabricate entire lives for them at a moment’s whim, allowing you to create societies where both man and animal coexist together, or are at war with one another, or simply entirely fake ones where they believe they have always existed. However, you may only create memories and lives that you believe are capable of happening or occurring. These memories can include the learning of any skill and profession, meaning that any animal or human you create could be fully learned and capable of virtually any task you put them to.

While you are still capable of becoming the environments you create, you no longer have to meld into them to fully control them, with this function instead becoming a defensive and mobility option, letting you essentially teleport anywhere within your 20-mile radius, and allowing you to propagate your domains rapidly.
addons.title: Vastness Over Yonder

objects.text:
You can generate and manipulate urban utilities and structures. The city around you is under your complete control and oversight, from the tiniest nook to the tallest monuments, letting you perceive and manipulate every element of the city's infrastructure as an extension of your will. You can manipulate the way roads turn, the writings on signs, which floors elevators stop on and which stations trains go to. You can shift, lower, raise, or sink entire city blocks, and seal off streets into inescapable mazes. If it is part of the scenery and within the bounds of concrete, it is inside your domain.

From any available surface, you can rapidly extrude these very same utilities and structures with enough force to kill most average Brutes - asphalt roads complete with sidewalks, telephone phones and electrical networks, streetlights and underground plumbing and more. Within the span of a second, you could grow an entire block’s worth of buildings or larger ones such as skyscrapers, with these monoliths of concrete quickly rising from the ground or from each other. While they only begin as nondescript, regular (if a tad brutalist) architecture, with focused effort you can ‘officiate’ them. They gain detailed interiors and specialized fittings: hospitals with operating theaters and diagnostic equipment, factories with functional assembly lines or fortified compounds with armories and defensive emplacements. Anything you create comes with its necessities such as underground plumbing or reinforcement. You can also dig out subterranean passages to allow for tunnels and subways. Your creations will remain permanently unless you choose to dissolve them back into the earth.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Urbanist

objects.text: You have been granted the power to create new powers, but instead of wielding them yourself, you grant them to others. Every day, you gain a charge which you may use one or more of to fuel your power.
