This power has four aspects, Imbue, to grant a new power to someone, Alter, to modify Imbued abilities, Upgrade, to improve the strength or versatility of Imbued powers, and Reclaim, to take back that which you Imbued. Imbue is the act of infusing charges into someone to grant them powers. Simply come up with a power that is possible to exist while touching someone and the charges will take that form. You may be as specific or not as you want, the charges will fill in any gaps in your design. There are limits to this however. Each charge is only equal to roughly 1 SP of power, so any power you create will be limited by the amount of charges used (i.e. if you grant superstrength, they aren't toppling skyscrapers with only 1 SP of it). Another limit is that you can only Imbue any specific person with up to 3 SP of power within a given day. Finally, a person can only hold one Imbued power at a time. Alter is the act of modifying the 'blueprint' of an Imbued power, therefore changing its expression. Each power you create has a blueprint detailing how it works, and you may examine it by simply touching its host. You may redesign the blueprint whenever you want, but in order for the new blueprint to take effect, you must expend a charge to Alter the power to fit the new blueprint. You can do this as often as you want, and any previously used designs are saved, allowing you to create a wide range of possible expressions to instantly Alter to for just about any situation. The main limits are that the power must still cost as much total SP as it did before and that the power must still be in line with its core mechanics, i.e. a power to heal through time reversal could become the power to harm through time acceleration, but not the power to read minds. Upgrade allows you to increase the SP an Imbued power is worth, therefore making it better. Whether you simply up its parameters or add new expressions like giving a Striker Healer a Blaster power in the form of regeneration inducing energy beams is up to you. The main limit to this is that Imbued powers have an upper limit of 15 SP, and again you can only add upwards of 3 SP of power to a specific person in a given day. Reclaim allows you to take back charges Imbued into others simply by touching them. Note that you aren't taking the powers themselves, but the charges used to make them. This is an inefficient process, so for every three charges you try to Reclaim, you only get one charge while the others vanish. Additionally, this process is stressful to the person it's used on. If you move slowly, you can Reclaim one charge every five minutes with them only feeling mild discomfort, but you can also instantly Reclaim your charges, causing damage proportional to the number. For an otherwise normal human, this would be at most a broken finger or minor internal bleeding if one charge were Reclaimed this way, but fifteen at once would outright kill them. Note that charges spent Altering a power cannot be Reclaimed, only those used to Imbue and Upgrade powers. Note: You do not possess innate immunity to powers granted with Power Broker nor do you have any sort of Master power to influence those you give them to. So maybe don't give that sleezy looking guy a Master power if you aren't already immune to them?
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Power Broker

objects.text: Through touch you can steal the powers of a Parahuman. The stealing occurs at a rate of 1% cumulatively per 1 second, thus taking 100 seconds to completely steal a power. You can store and use as many powers as you want, and they are massively amplified, which means even if you only managed to steal a low percentage of someone's power it would still be somewhat useful. When you increase the percentage, the amplification is redone using the new baseline. For example, if you stole 100% from Grue you could have the best of his Pre and Post Second Trigger, amplified to a greater degree. You would be able to instantly cover an entire city with your darkness — said darkness completely absorbing all energy interacting with it, removing scents, hidering movement by increasing the effort to do so, and nullifying all powers caught within while letting you access all of them as good as their users could. You would also have perfect control over your darkness, being able to shape it into all sorts of things and even turn it into a liquid or solid, this control would also allow you to selectively adjust the properties mentioned before, like excluding an ally from the power nullification. Finally, you can allow others to not have their sight hindered by your darkness. While if you stole 1% you would be able to blanket a room with your darkness, and reshape it into fragile solid constructs that absorb a small amount of energy. Each power also comes with a permanent physical mutation, all your mutations will never clash with each other in the sense that if you had both ice and fire nails they would change in some way so they can coexist, this won't stop you from looking like an abomination due to all the powers you stole. Grue's mutation would for example be that any black color in your body absorbs all light that touches them, essentially becoming 100% Black.
objects.title: (Trump/Changer) Hoarder

objects.text:
You are a free Tinker of unprecedented scale and capability. The catch being that all the designs this power provides are either incomplete, flawed in some fashion, or otherwise require substantial refinement to be of practical use.

These designs can fall on a sliding scale between a technically functional prototype that works but is in need of severe optimization, fragmented pieces of a design or theory that hints at something theoretically technologically possible, and everything in between.

The reason for the state of these designs is because this power is a repository for technological designs dreamed up by the host species of previous cycles that were unfinished or otherwise in development by the end of those cycles.

While the Entities have made use of all they could gleam from these designs, the potential remains for a new mind with the right creativity and work ethic to produce new and potent innovations from them, which is the reason for this repository's existence.

These designs can originate from civilizations who consider simple sticks and stones to be the height of technology, to those who consider the fundamental principles of reality to be guidelines instead absolutes, and everything in between. 

At the absolute highest point of technological progress this power provides it might touch on principles comparable to a tier 3 Tinker power, you’ll just need to put substantial work in if you ever want to approach those heights.

Finally, due to the nature of this repository your Shard hasn’t made any changes to the designs it provides that would require Shard assistance to be made or function. Though some percentage of the designs might still be blackboxed in some form from their original creators, overall you’ll still have a vastly easier time sharing your technology with others than most Tinkers.
objects.title: (Tinker) Unfinished Dreams

addons.text: You can now create physical bricks based on the blocks you have developed for use in your grids that can be used with the same logic to make tinkertech constructs. These bricks can range anywhere from the size of a regular lego brick to the scale of a person to a minifigure. Bricks can only connect to bricks of the same size. You can also tinker any object or materials into the shape of bricks you can build constructs with. Objects tinkered into bricks will continue to function but do not gain any new properties or capabilities besides the change in shape. You can use Artificer charges to apply patterns to bricks in order to enhance your constructs. At the full charge cost, you can create bricks that power themselves and give the entire construct new capabilities, conversely you may put an enchantment on a brick at reduced charge cost, though it will require a power brick to function. With Enchanting Alchemy, you may directly transmute materials in a transmutation circle into enchanted bricks. In any case, enchanted bricks function better than normal bricks and will be able to fully interact with other bricks in the same construct. You may also use your grids and their block logic to create and modify patterns. These constructs are fueled by power bricks that are created by expending either Artificer charges or a large amount of grid energy. Power bricks provide a steady output of power that is used by bricks in the construct without much need for maintenance. Power bricks can only fuel bricks that are up to five grid spaces away from them in any direction, though you may put multiple power bricks in a construct. You can also make other types of energy bricks, such as transformer, battery or capacitor bricks to improve the energy efficiency of your constructs. When creating a power brick, you may decide to roll a random restriction or condition on it, similar to the blockages from your grids, which provide greatly increased power outputs and other boosts when successfully built around. Brick-based constructs are easy to build and highly modular and reconfigurable, and while the bricks themselves are still blackboxed as normal, you are not restricted from creating instruction manuals for putting them together. However the constructs will be prone to breaking apart completely on hard impacts and can be pulled apart with bare hands unless security-, durability-, or defense-type bricks are built into them.
addons.title: Build it Brick by Brick

addons.text: You can fuse blocks together to create unique unstable blocks with unpredictable effects. These unstable blocks can have multiple effects that combine together, as well as effects you might not even know until you slot them into a grid and might run in inconsistent but powerful ways with each use. The unstable blocks might also have unconventional shapes or restrictions and drawbacks that make them even more powerful when successfully slotted. Each unstable block is unique and can only be slotted into one grid at a time, and the more unstable blocks in a grid may cause unforeseen consequences. You can combine as many normal blocks as you want, and experimenting with formulas may give you a better understanding of how to get the types of blocks that you want. You can also brew slightly toxic potions that give you extra grid energy, psychedelics that reveal unforeseen grid patterns for you to use. You may also make single-use power potions based on grid patterns or candies based on blocks that can apply their modifiers to other capes’ powers. With Build it Brick by Brick you can experiment to create unstable bricks that provide strange and powerful interactions with the rest of the construct, as well as soup up power bricks to provide increased energy in a wider area, but with volatile effects on the bricks it powers.
addons.title: Bootlegos

objects.text:
You have access to twelve grids. Up to six can be active at once. Each grid is a 9×9 layout where you place functional blocks. The more complex a grid is, the more energy it costs to run. Simple layouts are efficient and stable. Dense or layered designs burn power quickly.

Blocks represent basic operations such as targeting, movement, projection, transformation, filtering, and conditional logic. When activated, a grid executes as a single structured effect. Instead of raw force, the system favors precision, letting you build effects that would normally require multiple separate abilities.

Each grid comes with built-in blockages that restrict certain cells. These are not purely drawbacks. Some blockages grant benefits if worked around correctly, such as reduced energy cost, duplicated outputs, longer duration, or limited free activations. Good designs account for these limits instead of ignoring them.

You may reroll a grid at will. You can reroll the entire grid, only its blockages, or only the special properties of individual blocks. This allows refinement without starting over. Any rerolled element is replaced with a new, compatible option.

Rerolling or modifying a grid takes up to one minute of uninterrupted focus and can only be done on an inactive grid. Active grids are locked and cannot be altered, preventing on-the-fly reconfiguration during combat or execution.

Energy cost scales with instruction density and interaction depth. Linear effects are cheap. Conditional logic, multi-target resolution, or chained interactions raise costs rapidly. Pushing a grid too far risks instability, resulting in partial execution or complete failure.
objects.title: (Trump) Just Like Legos

objects.text:
By maintaining uninterrupted contact with a Parahuman for a certain amount of time—depending on their powers potency and their relationship with their Shard, anywhere between half a minute and four minutes—you can take their power and manifest it as an eerie looking liquid in a small crystalline vessel of your choice—or in any existing vessel you are touching at the time. 

Any unpowered person that fully consumes the liquid will obtain the power it contains.

A Parahuman drinking a Witchbrew results in them gaining a version of the power contained within that is drastically decreased to an equivalent of a Tier 0. Non-Parahumans drinking a mix of Witchbrews results in a random one working normally before all others, and the rest being applied to drinker as if a Parahuman.
objects.title: (Trump) Witchbrew

objects.text:
Nanites suck, don’t they? Tiny little machines that supposedly solve every problem in existence with enough technobabble and handwaving. Nanite gel you smear on something and it instantly repairs the damage? How? How do they analyze structural failure and reconstruct complex systems that quickly? Nanite swarms that float around converting other matter into more nanites? That doesn’t even make sense. CHEMISTRY AND ATOMIC BONDS DON'T WORK LIKE THAT! Where does the energy come from? What about the heat output? Conservation laws don’t just take a vacation because the plot or super-tech shenanigans says so.

Fortunately, you are a Tinker who refuses to play that game. You specialize in designing technology that counters, disrupts, and outright annihilates nanotechnological systems and devices. Force fields, hardened structural lattices, and environmental barriers that prevent grey goo or hostile micro-machines from infiltrating and rewriting matter are well within your capabilities. You can create defensive systems that remain stable even when submerged in active nanite swarms, allowing you to operate safely where others would be consumed. Your weaponry is tailored to pierce nanite-enhanced materials and bypass self-repairing augmentations, exploiting coordination limits, signal dependencies, and material weaknesses. You can design AOE devices that disable or flash-fry micro-machines all the way down to the femto-level, breaking swarm cohesion and rendering adaptive systems inert.

But your expertise doesn’t stop at destruction. The other half of your specialization lies in interacting with the world at extremely small scales without relying on microscopic robots at all. Instead of swarms, you use fields and directed energy. Magnetic confinement systems, electromagnetic manipulation arrays, plasma shaping frameworks, telekinetic-force analog technologies, and Directed Energy Fabrication platforms allow you to reshape matter directly. You rearrange bonds through controlled energy gradients, stabilize or destabilize atomic structures, and fabricate materials by inducing structural change rather than assembling them piece by piece with machines. Nuclear transmutation and controlled alchemical processes are within reach, not through self-replicating bots but through precise, field-driven manipulation of fundamental interactions, with the necessary containment and heat management built into your designs.

Where others cheat with tiny robots, you weaponize physics. Nanites are a crutch. You build the counter and the better alternatives.
objects.title: (Tinker) Man Fuck Nanites! All My Homies Hate Nanites!

objects.text:
Within several hundred feet of yourself you have perfect awareness of every other person; from where they are and how they are moving—both in relation to both you and every other person in your radius—to their current health and well being, and down to what they are currently feeling, thinking, experiencing, and intending. 

This knowledge appears from a first person perspective as if you are personally possessing each and every individual, experiencing everything they do yourself, simultaneously, across all people within your range.

You have infinite multitasking and perfect physical coordination in regards to this power. 

<small>As an example; you would be able to precisely stab or shoot someone in your range exactly where you wanted—assuming your base physical abilities and skills were up to par—and know where they were aiming with their own weapons and whatever traps they had planned as you do so.</small>
objects.title: (Thinker) The Human Perspectives

addons.text:
Your Slices may now be imbued with Faultline’s ability, letting them split the molecular bonds holding materials together upon contact.

This enables them to bypass most forms of physical durability, cutting through substances such as diamonds like butter. Your Slices don’t inherit the same Manton Limit and retain their lethality against living targets. You may freely choose whether a Slice carries this enhanced cutting property or remains purely kinetic in nature.

Conversely, the interaction between these two powers also removes the Manton Limit from Faultline’s touch as well, allowing you to separate flesh and bone as easily as stone or steel with direct contact.
addons.title: Clean Cut

addons.text:
Cutting is an art; what matters is not just the cut itself, but knowing how and when.

At first glance, the most obvious change is that your Slices can now operate anywhere within your line of sight compared to your original 100 metre radius. More importantly, however, is that your enhanced intuition has integrated with your power to cut, becoming a potent Thinker ability in its own right.

Instead of consciously working out how best to cut, your shard constantly analyzes and predicts your opponents, environment and any unfolding scenario. This information is fed back to you as an innate understanding of the optimal placement, timing and geometry of your attacks, naturally guiding them so they align with your intent and interests.

As such, you instinctively perceive where, when and how to make the optimal cut for any given scenario. You can target specific gaps in a defense or apply the exact force and technique required for the result you want; such as performing surgery without medical know-how or paralyzing someone from the neck down by severing their spinal cord.

This power operates even when you are not consciously directing it. If a sniper were to fire at you, you might casually produce a Slice to intercept the bullet, deflecting or even ricocheting it back towards the shooter despite having no prior awareness of their presence. You’re aware of this guidance and can decide how much to rely on it, letting your power automatically act when milliseconds matter.
addons.title: Cut the Gordian Knot

objects.text: You possess a remarkable capacity to ‘cut’ within a radius of 100 metres around you via a singular, specialised function: Slice. This ability generates a nearly two-dimensional, invisible plane of pure shearing force that moves through space to cause a cutting effect. The concentrated kinetic energy each Slice carries is entirely under your control, ranging in strength from cutting a blade of grass to effortlessly cleaving through reinforced steel buildings at its peak. A Slice may originate anywhere within your radius and can take any orientation, length, curvature or angle that fits within that area. You can direct its exact motion and trajectory, having it travel at extreme speed, orbit you or remain fixed while rotating. The edge thickness of a Slice can range from 1 cm to 0.1 mm at its sharpest. You may form any number of Slices simultaneously and mentally control all of them with perfect precision and awareness. This enables complex applications such as shaving someone without a single nick, rapidly repeating Slices that mimic a chainsaw or dense lattices of overlapping cuts akin to a barrier, repelling and shredding objects. Slices may also travel beyond your radius if they retain sufficient momentum, though you lose control over their trajectory and their force will naturally dissipate over distance. You can freely dispel any generated Slice instantly and are physically invulnerable to your own power, preventing any self-injury.
objects.title: (Shaker) Slice & Dice

objects.text:
You possess a potent and versatile Trump ability that allows you to expand and re-express Parahuman abilities using the 12 standard power classifications (Master, Blaster, Thinker, Tinker, Brute, Striker, Changer, Stranger, etc.). You may affect an unlimited number of individuals over time, but can only actively target roughly a dozen Parahumans at once.

Whenever you first encounter a Parahuman, a secondary Thinker ability automatically classifies their power and internally catalogs it as a deck consisting of 1 card plus 24 slots, all but one of which start empty. Each power classification is represented twice among the slots.

Your power identifies the category their ability is most intrinsically aligned to (such as Shaker for Vista or Tinker for Armsmaster). Their current expression is catalogued as the base card, occupying one appropriate slot.

From there, the simplest option is to begin filling additional slots. When you choose a slot to fill, the target’s power mutates to express that category in a way organic to their original ability, broadening its scope rather than granting a separate or disconnected power. You choose which category to add, but you do not choose the exact expression; it emerges from the shard based on the target, the current power expression, the user, and surrounding context.

Each new expression is potent enough to be considered a new power in its own right, at minimum rivaling the original ability. However, it does not exist in isolation. Instead, the expansion integrates directly with what is already present. The power does not grow through generic, grab-bag, or cluster-like additions; rather, the base power itself becomes more capable.

For example, expanding Grue’s Shaker ability with a Mover slot might allow him to teleport between dark spaces with a moment of focus, and instantly within areas suffused by his darkness. Filling a Thinker slot could grant awareness of everything occurring within his darkness at all times. A Master slot might allow him to drain the will and stamina of those caught inside it, and so on.

As different classification slots are filled, the power becomes broader, more versatile, and more potent as its components operate as a coherent whole.

When the second slot of a given classification is filled, the power begins to compound upon itself. While it still broadens, it also gains noticeable depth. For example, if Armsmaster had only his base Tinker slot and you filled nothing but his second Tinker slot, his power would grow to rival Hero’s in both potency and versatility.

As additional slots are filled, the power continues to broaden and strengthen—not by accumulating discrete abilities, but because each new expression reinforces the entire power. Even a single added category typically produces flexibility comparable to or exceeding the original baseline, and as more slots come online, their interactions compound. The ability evolves as a unified organism, with each component feeding into the others. 

You may fill slots all at once or gradually over time. These expansions are permanent unless you rescind them. Because the specific expressions are context-driven, order matters: earlier expansions influence later ones, and adding the same set of categories in a different sequence can produce drastically different outcomes.

Once a specific expression has manifested, it is catalogued as a new card in your internal deck representing that target’s power. If you later rescind a slot, you may refill it either to generate a fresh expression or to re-express a previously recorded version by using the corresponding card. This allows you to lock in certain mutations while letting others continue evolving, enabling piecemeal refinement without full control over the final result.

Some cards are dependent on others, as later expressions can build on functions created by earlier expansions.

All changes are persistent unless you choose otherwise. You may rescind any added slot at will and refill it later, either allowing a fresh expression to emerge or reinstating a previous one.

Crucially, you may also rescind the base card itself. When this happens, you choose whether the power is re-expressed through one of the other categories, leave it up to chance, or you may re-express the power in the same category, causing the target’s entire power to reroll its core expression while remaining within the same classification.

A target can never be left without a base card; your power enforces that at least one of the twelve basic category slots is always occupied.

As a result, rescinding and re-expressing the base power never weakens a target in absolute terms, though it may radically alter how their ability functions and can sometimes produce substantially stronger or more versatile outcomes depending on the resulting power.

You also possess secondary Thinker abilities that allow you to flawlessly remember and track every card you have recorded, every configuration you have created, and how each behaved in practice. This also lets you keep track of everyone you’ve affected, allowing you to manage your beneficiaries.
objects.title: (Trump) Tarot

objects.text:
Your very being is entwined with energy on fundamental levels. You're able to manifest constructs of energy whose effects and properties are completely within your control. For example, shields that automatically move to intercept attacks, constructs that affect temperatures, shields that destroy what comes in contact with them, and even shields that can selectively nullify phenomena. All those and more are achievable. At its strongest, one of these shields could stand up to a prolonged assault from Behemoth, though its surface area would have to be no more than 20 square meters and require a buildup of several minutes.

The stronger and more complex the effects you impart on your constructs, the longer the buildup you need before their creation, with the average construct taking less than a second when its size is less than a car.

Your constructs are free-floating and capable of being moved through the air by yourself freely. You also possess a secondary Thinker power that allows you to know where each of your constructs is in relation to yourself. Any constructs more than 100 meters away from you disappear automatically.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Epic

objects.text:
You feel a timer ticking down inside your head that starts at a random length anywhere between one day and one month. The closer it gets to zero, the better you can tell exactly how much time is left. When the timer hits zero, one of three different things happens at random:

The first thing that can happen is you get a permanent random power that at its weakest is 5 SP and at its strongest is 10 SP. The power's actual effect is also random but you are guaranteed to be able to use said power. Afterwards the timer starts over.

The second thing that can happen is the timer immediately starts over with a new random length. Then a random number from one to five gets picked, and for that many timers in a row, each one will instantly skip half of its time the moment it starts. For example, if the random number is three and your next timer is set to ten days, it immediately jumps down to five days left; the following timer, eight days, becomes four days; and the timer after that, four days, becomes two day. Each time these timers reach zero, they will trigger another randomised outcome, picking between the 3 options again.

The third thing that can happen is the timer starts over with a new random length, and the next time you actually get a power, the lowest and highest possible strength of that power both increase by 5 SP. This keeps stacking up every time you get this outcome until you finally get a power. For example, if you get this outcome five times, your next power will have its strength range increased by 25 SP, so the original 5 to 10 SP turns into 30 to 35 SP. After you get that boosted power, the strength range goes back down to the normal 5 to 10 SP for the next time around. 

Each time the timer reaches zero, it’s akin to a Trigger Event, regardless of which of the three happen. This means it’s a complete blindspot to Thinkers.
objects.title: (Trump) Totally Accurate Randomiser Run

objects.text:
This ability can become whatever your target believes is your actual powers. 

You can only pick one target at a time, and you can use the abilities they perceive you totally having so long as they keep believing. This however, also includes weaknesses they think you may have.

The target has to fully believe this however. As such, if they know the true nature of your power, the power would lose effectiveness, as they can't just suddenly convince themselves that you have an ability they know you don't actually have. This can potentially be mitigated by tampering with their memories? Possibly.

You can change targets any time.
objects.title: (Trump/Breaker) Sophist

objects.text:
You have a collection of a hundred powers between 1 and 15 SP. They are distributed such that each PRT Classification has at least 5 powers whose primary classification matches.

You can use up to 3 powers at a time. If a power is swapped out, it will be available again the next day, essentially entering a cooldown.

You have a Thinker component that allows you to know the names of the powers within your catalog and what they can do.

Finally, you are highly resistant to Masters and Thinkers, messing up their powers such that those of lower strength don't work at all, and those of higher strength suffer heavy interference.

You may choose what's in your collection or let it up to fate.
objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Catalog

objects.text:
Tinker powers are generally a mix of actual advanced technological knowledge with a dash of shard trickery to enable the construction of machinery that currently-available tools aren’t advanced enough to construct on their own.

You have none of the former and so, so much of the latter. You aren’t provided any technological knowledge beyond what you would have without this power, but your shard warps physics on everything you do work on to make it function as though it were far more advanced, drawing on your intentions and the design of the object.

You could fold a piece of paper in half repeatedly to give it an edge so fine it can slip through the gaps in molecules, or make a potato battery that somehow generates more power than a nuclear power plant, or clumsily construct an apparatus out of sticks and leaves that can fly faster than a fighter jet with perfect maneuverability.

The better an object would work without shard interference, the more effective the boost will be. If you have other tinker powers this will work to boost the tinkertech you make massively, creating something far more powerful than either power could do alone.

Other tinkers are probably going to make fun of you.
objects.title: (Striker/Tinker) Cargo Cult

addons.text:
You can manifest colonies you have access to into pocket dimensions that you can physically enter, or with preparation and energy, overlayed onto your physical world. Because of the anomalous topology of these realms, you must cast a protective field around yourself and others when entering them.

Due to how the sprites construct their colonies from archived power expressions gleaned from adjacent shards, the matter, atmosphere and inhabitants are basically extensions of these expressions. Matter, energy and beings drawn from these pocket realms are more potent than those normally conjured, but also more unstable and not under your direct control.
addons.title: Morian Zenas

addons.text:
When researching techniques or designs, you can ask power-sprites for secrets from their colonies that can be developed or incorporated into your systems.

The secrets the power-sprites give you come from power expressions developed and archived by the host shards in past cycles. Because past host species had vastly different natures and understandings than humanity, the secret powers fed to you will be difficult for you to comprehend without the help of the sprites. 

Due to the truly alien lens of these power expressions, they interact strangely with power expressions of the current cycle, though they still work by the same overarching rules of shard expressions.
addons.title: Apocrypha

addons.text:
When exploring and interacting with the realms and colonies of power sprites, you may find or be gifted grimoires, called storybooks, containing several usable power expressions from the realm that can be added to your Grimoire of Shards library. Storybooks have the same types of recharging batteries as regular grimoires. Taking and studying these storybooks costs none of your Grimoire charges.

Rather than containing esoteric patterns that unscramble as you use the power, the powers of the storybooks are transcribed as stories in a human language you understand. By reciting the passages of these stories, you will be able to cast the power expressions they record.

However, while the words are in human language, the actual content of the stories is almost incomprehensible to those not from the storybook’s original colony. The more you understand the culture and unique logic of the original colonies, the more sense these stories will make to you through Evoker’s thinker effect. Through understanding, you will be able to recite the power expressions more efficiently and at stronger power ratings, and come up with more versatile uses for those expressions.
addons.title: 36 Lessons

objects.text:
Your shard is host to countless colonies of highly social miniature shard-like energy sprites. These sprites feed on the shard’s energy, which they use to develop powers and shape into their own realms to inhabit within the shard. Your Shard’s purpose is to manage the Entity’s relationship with these sprites.

The culture of the sprites and structure of their colonies is influenced by which shard cluster they inhabit. The sprites can use their own energy to use power expressions that have been recorded by those clusters, and making colonies appear to be “themed” around certain types of power expression. This also affects the forms the sprites take, how they act, and what they value in their realms. You gain a minor Thinker power that allows you to comprehend the alien sociology and topography of these colonies by filtering them through a lens based on fictional and mythological tropes you are familiar with.

By meditating, you can project your mind into these colonies and treat with their inhabitants. Time spent projecting to a colony should only take an hour or two in the real world, but from your perspective, time may seem fluid and surreal as events follow a dreamlike logic. You can also search for new colonies while meditating, though sprites you contract can give you hints and directions to the kinds of colonies you are looking for.

By befriending, outsmarting, defeating or completing tasks for the sprites in their colony, you gain the ability to conjure these sprites into the physical world in a semi-corporeal state. You directly control the summoned sprites’ actions through a psychic link. The conjured sprites can be physically harmed, but if destroyed in your realspace, they will simply be cast back into their colony where they must spend some time reforming.

Each sprite is adept at a specific power expression of the shard cluster their colony is built around. At the start, you have access to around three colonies, and a dozen sprites from each with powers equivalent to 4-7 SP. The strongest sprites can range up to 12-15 SP. You have a psychic bandwidth that can summon half a dozen sprites at a time, which grows with your reputation in their realms.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Evoker

addons.title: A Queen’s Benefits
addons.text: The connection that (Trump) Queen gives between the benefactor and benefactee, as well as the ability to change the makeup of the powers granted at will, now extend to these power-granting trumps as well. The particular arrangement of the benefits the other two powers grant are also extended, depending on which one you have. The powers granted by the two requirements do not count towards the total amount that (Trump) Queen can give.

objects.text:
With a touch you can grant up to 15 SP worth of powers to a non-parahuman, though no singular power may exceed 10 SP. You may distribute it whichever way you like, such as one singular 5 SP power, or fifteen 1 SP powers, etc.

You retain a connection to your granted powers regardless of distance, allowing you to modify them at will and control them as if you were the user — of course, the later means you can only make it do what it actually can, unless you use the former to cheat of course. This also gives you a controllable two-way telepathic connection, and the capacity to access their senses.

Lastly, your granted powers makes their users develop a certain attitude towards you. It could be loyalty, love, a desire to protect, etc.

Note: if the Parahuman population is numerous enough that finding a non-parahuman is rare, you will be able to grant powers to Parahumans too, as it would be too annoying to use this otherwise.
objects.title: (Trump) Queen

objects.text:
Your Shard has grown fascinated with the concept of meta-principles that humanity not only generally follows but has deemed ‘morality’. As a result, your power is now based on the vague concept of Karma that your Shard has managed to gleam.

The base benefit of this power is that anyone you strike or attack in any way gets an increased amount of damage proportional to the amount of ‘sins’ they have committed. If they kicked a few puppies, then a punch will feel like being hit with a sledge hammer, but if your target is someone like Jack Slash, then just giving them a paper cut would be enough for them to get completely bisected dozens of times over. This can also bypass defensive powers, as it works on targeting the person instead of whatever is between the strike and the target.

This damage multiplier works on two ‘opinions’, one of which your Shard gets from generalizing the base morality of everyone within the range of the 777 Miles (1250 Kilometers/roughly the size of Texas), and the other is from your own morality. If you are fine with someone kicking puppies, there would still be a damage multiplier because most other people are against that, but the increase would be less that what it would be if you also were against the violence on dog kind.

Finally, you also get a ‘sense’ for how ‘evil’ someone is, with the more bad karma they have making a bigger sensory range and stronger feeling of revulsion.
objects.title: (Striker/Trump) Karma

objects.text: Your Shard has granted you a multi-faceted power centered around the manufacture of paper and the creation of origami constructs. The Tinker side of this power allows you to rapidly create any form of paper—for a very broad definition of paper—and even develop new varieties. Sandpaper already exists, but your power could create truly waterproof paper, fireproof paper, or even paper as durable as steel. This aspect of your power comes with a minor Thinker ability to intuitively understand what counts as paper and what doesn’t. The Striker side of the power is much more direct. You have the ability to rapidly form origami—and kirigami—constructs out of paper. The real benefit is that anything you make can take on the physical abilities—and size—of what you model it after. An animal-based construct, for example, will be able to move and react as if it were the real creature, obeying simple commands. Constructs based on tools and weapons can act as if they weren’t made of paper; an origami gun, for instance, could fire origami bullets if you really wanted. This side of your power also lets you fold paper—and paper-like things—with such precision to excel at origami. This does have a few weaknesses. First, your constructs are recognizably still paper, with the durability and vulnerabilities typical of paper. The Tinker side of this power does allow you to mitigate this, but at the expense of having to produce enough paper yourself. Your power does not do well at replicating humans and utterly fails to copy non-physical traits or abilities.
objects.title: (Tinker/Striker) Origami

objects.text:
Gouge is a counterpart to Sting. While Sting lets you pierce all defenses, Gouge allows you to completely prevent all forms of healing.

No form of regeneration, healing, time manipulation, or even resetting will remove the damage caused by this. As a side, you may choose to prevent the wound from actually killing the target. Additionally, the injury will always be fresh and won’t get an infection unless you want it to. You can choose to end this effect or avoid using it at any time.
objects.title: (Striker/Blaster) Gouge

objects.text:
Within a range of 100 meters, you are able to comprehend, perceive, and lock in any emotional or physical sensation felt by those around you. This makes a target incapable of letting go of an emotional or physical sensation, but does not prevent them from feeling other or even contradictory sensations.

Not only could you lock in someone's anger or panic to make it so they can't calm down, but you could even lock in something like the sensation of their leg going forward to make it feel like their leg is constantly moving. If they were to try to course correct by moving their leg backwards, you could also lock in that sensation at the same time. If they were to lose balance briefly, you could lock in that loss of balance to completely disorient them, and when this inevitably leads to a spike of panic, you can lock in that panic at its very height, which would likely beget even more panic that you can lock in.

Aside from the ability to send practically anyone into a self-feeding spiral of emotions or unbalance, you can use your power more subtly to lock in small amounts of specific emotions, such as locking in a small bit of happiness while talking to someone.

You are granted greatly enhanced multitasking, and you are able to lock in and perceive all of the major senses, excluding sight. Power granted senses may fall under your purview if they are sufficiently tied to an emotional or physical sense, such as a sense of movement from flight, or potentially a sense of dread from danger-sense.
objects.title: (Master/Shaker) Sensational Stasis

addons.title: Soulsong
addons.text: Your psychic mastery and Wraithbone have become inseparable. Wraithbone naturally resonates with psychic phenomena, acting as both a conduit and amplifier for your abilities, while the instinctive language used to shape it has become an extension of your own psychic will. By weaving your song with Sonder’s usage, you can subtly refine, strengthen, or alter your psychic effects with a level of power and precision far surpassing what you were capable of before. Likewise, your creations are no longer limited to being mere technology. Wraithbone can directly channel, store, and manipulate your psychic power, allowing your devices to replicate, enhance, or automate many applications of Sonder. Mental communication networks, autonomous psychic constructs, memory archives, dream interfaces, anti-Master defenses, cognition-enhancing implants, and countless other devices become possible, limited only by your imagination and the time needed to cultivate them. This affinity extends naturally to other psychic powers as well. Psychokinesis can be integrated into your creations to produce tools with unparalleled telekinetic precision or constructs capable of manipulating themselves as though alive, while [Connectivity] Issues can be woven into Wraithbone to create devices that interfere with, redirect, or reinforce a Parahuman's connection to their Shard, from protective wards to sophisticated shard-disruption technology. The song of your mind and the song of your Wraithbone have become one and the same.

addons.title: Spirit Matrix
addons.text:
Your mastery over Wraithbone and cognition have become inseparable. Rather than merely consuming minds to strengthen your own, you can crystallize fragments of cognitive essence into Wraithbone itself, preserving memories, knowledge, skills, instincts, and even echoes of personality as permanent psychic matrices. These matrices serve as the minds of your creations, granting them genuine intuition, creativity, and adaptability beyond even the most sophisticated artificial intelligence, while remaining completely loyal to you.

Every Wraithbone construct containing a Spirit Matrix automatically becomes part of a living psychic noosphere, seamlessly exchanging thoughts, memories, sensory data, and processing power with every other connected creation. Information spreads across the network instantaneously, allowing your constructs to learn from one another, divide complex tasks between themselves, or pool their intellect into a greater whole before separating once more. 

Every new mind you harvest enriches the network's collective knowledge, while every new creation expands its reach and processing capacity, transforming your Wraithbone into an ever-growing civilization of living machines united by a single harmonious chorus.

addons.title: Symphony Eternal
addons.text:
Your mind, your Wraithbone, and the countless spirits preserved within it have become inseparable aspects of a single existence. Every Spirit Matrix retains its own personality, knowledge, and expertise, yet each also forms part of an ever-expanding psychic chorus, freely exchanging thoughts, memories, perception, and processing power through a living noosphere spanning every Wraithbone creation. Independent minds may cooperate, merge into greater intellects to solve impossible problems, or separate once more, allowing the Chorus to continuously evolve rather than merely grow larger.

Soulsong has likewise transcended a solitary performance. Whenever you sing to shape Wraithbone or weave your psychic power, every preserved voice may join yours, harmonizing into a literal chorus whose combined will guides the material with impossible precision and complexity. The knowledge, creativity, and experience of every spirit contributes to each creation, allowing countless minds to work in perfect concert where once only one could. Every construct produced by this Chorus carries a fragment of its collective song, joining the living network the moment it is born.

Your psychic imprint permeates this entire symphony, spreading wherever your Wraithbone endures. Every new mind preserved enriches the Chorus with fresh voices and perspectives, while every new creation expands both its reach and its collective intellect. Should your body be destroyed, your consciousness simply becomes another voice among the Choir, sustained by the harmony of countless echoes until a new vessel can be cultivated or another host claimed. Destroying you no longer means killing a single individual—it means silencing an entire civilization whose song grows richer with every voice it welcomes.

objects.text:
You specialize in the creation of Wraithbone, a living metamaterial grown through song rather than manufactured through conventional engineering. By singing in an instinctive language, you cause Wraithbone to grow, branch, and reshape itself into complete devices with every component seamlessly integrated. Wraithbone is lightweight, exceptionally durable, slowly repairs itself over time, and can serve as everything from structural support and circuitry to armor, sensors, power conduits, and energy systems.

Your specialty revolves around Wraithbone itself rather than any single field of technology, allowing you to create an enormous variety of advanced devices. Weapons, armor, drones, autonomous constructs, vehicles, medical equipment, forcefield generators, infrastructure, tools, and intricate works of art are all possible, provided they can be expressed as a unified Wraithbone construct. Rather than assembling parts, you cultivate your creations, guiding their growth as the material responds to your voice, intent, and design until it reaches its final form.

You possess an innate understanding of Wraithbone, allowing you to freely repair, reshape, merge, or recycle existing constructs into entirely new creations. As your mastery grows, so too does your ability to harmonize with the material itself, increasing both the speed and precision with which it grows. While complex projects may require hours or days of continuous singing, every creation emerges as a seamless whole without the need for conventional tools, fabrication, or assembly, with the finished construct often displaying a level of elegance and integration that traditional engineering cannot easily replicate.
objects.title: (Tinker) Bonesinger

objects.text: By touching someone, you are able to reset someone to the absolute weakest their power has ever been, and in doing so, gain the power you stole for yourself. If you were to steal the added strength of a parahuman undergoing a power boost derived from their Sechen ranges, the powers you receive would be temporary echoes of power, but if they had permanently increased the strength of their power, the gains would be permanent. You have no limit to how many powers you can have or use. For instance, if you were to steal Taylor's strength when she was in a tough situation, you may temporarily gain her power with a range of a block or two, likely with less ability to finely manipulate the insects and comprehend their senses. If you were to steal Taylor's strength when she was an experienced parahuman, having increased her base range by impressing her shard, you would permanently gain her power, with however many blocks of range you're taking away from her, possibly ending up at an equal strength to her. This power is most noticeable when used on Tinkers, as in most cases, you would be resetting their tech tree back to square zero. If you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless, this will reset people to a baseline based on their potential, but will not take away their knowledge. Their body and any special abilities will be reset to a baseline for their age as if they had never trained, but they would still keep any innate potential or knowledge of techniques. As always, you will be given permanent or temporary access to any strength or power you steal, depending on whether their strength or power was permanent or temporary.
objects.title: (Trump/Striker) Sechen Leech

objects.text:
At full offense, you can fire energy beams with a Sting-like effect capable of ignoring all defenses and tearing through Endbringers like they're nothing, leaving you with a forcefield that can barely hold up to a normal human's punch.

At full defense, you have a barrier that can absorb, deflect, and otherwise nullify all types of attacks before they can harm you or your allies, in exchange for a beam barely able to scratch paint.

You are able to change the offense-to-defense ratio at will, but doing so will take time, depending on how big the change is, with the most drastic changes taking up to 30 seconds.
objects.title: (Trump) Offense or Defense
(Trump) Sword And Shield
objects.text: You have two slots for powers, aptly named the Sword slot and the Shield slot. These powers normally take around a minute each to ramp up to full strength, which maxes out at the same level as peak Eidolon, and there is no limit on how long you can keep a power in a slot. You are capable of ‘skewing’ the build-up times of your powers, such as making your Shield slot take up to a day to ramp up while making your Sword slot start at full power. To unskew this would take as long as ramping up your slowest slot. You have control over what powers you get, but you can also choose to cycle them randomly if the need ever arises. Within your Sword slot, you are capable of manifesting a variety of 'offensive' powers, such as telekinesis, lasers, or fireballs. The main limitation is that you won't gain the normal secondary powers that they come with: you won't get the ability to breathe in smoke with pyrokinesis, and you won't become quicker to react or have any form of multitasking when summoning a salvo of lasers. This slot is incapable of using powers such as healing or power-granting. Your Shield slot is capable of holding a myriad of 'defensive' powers, such as a Stranger effect to make you unnoticeable, regeneration, or invulnerability. The limitation of this slot is that the powers used cannot extend beyond you and your clothes. This slot is also unable to summon abilities such as future sight or clairvoyance. Having complementary powers in each slot can lead to synergies between them, including working in ways that violate slot limits, such as having pyrokinesis in your Sword slot and then gaining the option for a flame-based Breaker state in your Shield one, even if that would be impossible to have otherwise. Finally, you are highly resistant to Thinkers, messing up their powers such that those of lower strength don't work at all, and those of higher strength suffer heavy interference.

objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) A Curse Upon Thee
objects.text:
The idea of a curse under a Parahuman model seems novel to your Shard, so giddy with potential that it runs with the concept. Taking the form of an area-wide effect that applies to anybody you “curse” (a person in particular, a group, or a small city’s population), your power will use a collection of small power expressions, such as micro-telekinesis, light probability and physics bending, and minor master effects bordering on conditioning, to name a few, to set a permanent effect, with the appearance of a curse upon the victim(s).

Severity and lethality will dull in scale; a mere person's "curse" will crescendo into elaborate happenstances that’ll be potentially deadly, escalating into an inevitable end, while a hundred will experience occurrences that might severely injure, but generally make them miserable without outright killing them. Further diluted if your curse scales to a small city, with your power only capable of generating happenings that build an air of malaise or misery upon the populace, while they are not severe, the curse compensates in frequency and prevalence.

For your power to come into effect, you must directly declare the conditions, reasons, and the effects to the victim(s), clearly and cleanly for them to hear, as that's the moment they register the curse takes effect, i.e., “For the fact of robbing me of rightful estate, I curse your blood to a life of scarcity and failure to its pursuit, falling to men of ill-repute”.

There are a lot of ways to break a curse; going back on the curse’s reason in the first place works well in the case of victim(s), but you can always lift the curse at will once you feel satisfied that your victim suffered enough grief.

addons.title: “Are you perhaps intending to pursue me?”
addons.text: With It Gets Worse, your curse loses its constraints. The range and scope of power expression of your curse manifest are more daring, from warping space-time, inexplicably bending a car’s destination, coincidentally colliding into targets, to creating a collection of dimensional and probabilistic events to ensure the humiliation, misery, and/or death of the victim(s). The need for a clear declaration is removed entirely; if you’ve been wronged by the victim, no matter the intention or goal, a Curse will come into effect. It’ll worsen in severity for those who intentionally had it out for you or are actively pursuing you. As It Gets Worse acts as a cumulative effect, the more the victim tries to avoid or fight the Curse, the worse it’ll be.

objects.title: (Trump/Brute) Resurrective Incarnation
objects.text:
Whenever you die, your body and mind are completely repaired, and you are resurrected, and whenever you're resurrected, you will gain the power and mindset of a deceased parahuman. You will find that your personality and emotions will shift to align more closely with that of the deceased parahuman you're copying, and you will likely find yourself emulating them if you don't stop yourself.

The method of your death has an influence on what power you copy, as either the power or parahuman will always be related to the way you died. For instance, being killed by Hookwolf may lead to you getting a power based around metal, but it may also lead to you getting the power of a deceased Empire member, or that of a cape that Hookwolf had previously killed.

Upon dying, you lose access to the powers of whatever parahuman you were emulating previously, and your mind is no longer nudged towards their personality.

objects.title: (Shaker) Compliance
objects.text: Your power turns your presence into reality’s troubleshooter, minimizing entropy and rerouting probable causal and physical factors in your surroundings to guarantee a standard of compliance, where the environment works optimally regardless of circumstances. This apply to anything within your range of influence, including powers. Your power feels like wave washing over you every time a factor comes in your periphery, as if everything around you has a life of its own: Tinkertech or machinery “behaves” in your presence, working with no issues, no matter the structural flaws or wear and tear it has, and vice versa, etc. Generally, it covers an area within a 400-meter radius to ensure circumstances or factors stay calm and uncomplicated. Of course, you can use it at will, pushing an area or object to comply for a greater or focused effect, ensuring an Endbringer triage site doesn’t experience any hiccups or lost lives, for example. It passively ensures your survival, your power’s area expanding according to your relative well-being and stress, going up to half a kilometer at a personal crisis, where obstacles and threats are prone to misfortunes at a higher degree, where rifles may find themselves jamming in insubordination, other missing steps in a staircase, to the point of near-impossibility, among others. The power’s limitation comes from the fact that just because it ensures things are as they are, it sure doesn’t improve the odds, as it utilizes the current available causal and phenomenal factors around your effective area. Equivalent exchange: entropy is inevitable, and something has to give for your power to accomplish what it does: for a gun to jam, the potential entropy reroutes to the recoil, causing a series of events where it’ll cause minor, yet survivable, injuries. Conversely, you can take your power’s reign to actively accelerate entropy’s course of action under your area, as a consequence, liberating it from its constraints, for example, letting go of your power would cause the PHQ’s cracks and liabilities to become a crumbling Jenga tower, actively pushing for unfortunate “freak accidents”. This also enforces your idea of compliance, making water “walkable” by simply ensuring its surface tension isn’t broken, even affecting Parahuman mechanics.

objects.title: (Trump/Shaker) Lexicology
objects.text:
You can imbue descriptive ‘Words’ into yourself or any physical phenomena that you speak to within earshot, warping its properties and abilities to reflect that Word.

A Word must take the form of a prepositive attributive adjective (a ‘fast’ car or a ‘tall’ man). For example, infusing ‘Healing’ into an apple might cure those who consume it while adding ‘Sharp’ to a blade may let it cut steel like air. A target can be imbued with any number of Words at a time and they may be applied or removed at will.

To create Words, you possess a metaphysical, ever-filling Well of Power. By siphoning from this Well, you can inscribe a particular Word of choice into your endless mental lexicon as a permanent entry. Every Word, such as ‘Slow’, ‘Hidden’ or ‘Heavy’ etc, gains its own separate pool to draw power from.

At a minimum, unlocking a new Word takes 2 days’ worth of output and its initial pool capacity can only sustain a single effect comparable to a T0 power. For example, ‘Small’ might reduce a target's size by half while ‘Quiet’ could muffle someone's voice. This power reads your intent, ensuring each Word’s effect manifests per your desire.

You may spend Power from your Well to deepen a Word's pool directly. With half a week’s dedicated investment, ‘Explosive’ could make a coin detonate like an artillery shell when focused into a single effect; after a month it'd rival a megaton bomb. A Word's pool also grows naturally, albeit only at 1% your primary Well of Power's rate.

At its peak, a Word’s effects can match those of prime Eidolon in strength and scope. While a Word cannot surpass this cap, its pool may continue to expand, letting it fuel more effects simultaneously. A Word's available power may be split across multiple objects or concentrated into a single target for utmost potency.

With Negentropy, your Well’s flow doubles and your Words' potency have no upper limit.

objects.title: (Master/Tinker) Ghost Protocol
objects.text:
You can manipulate digital data, code, software, and computerized systems.

Even without any technical knowledge whatsoever, you can do anything that can be achieved through data and software, from altering and restoring information to creating self-improving and life-like AIs with just a thought.

The power translates your intent into whatever program, command, or software is required, so long as the result is theoretically possible.

This can create software far beyond current human ability and programs that let machines act in ways they were never designed to. However, this power cannot directly move matter, create hardware from nothing, or make a machine perform an action with no possible mechanism behind it.

objects.title: (Tinker) Particle Fever
objects.text:
You specialize in generating and utilizing exotic particles and physical fields. These range from tachyonic antimatter that triggers chain reactions backwards in time, to anti-gravitons that scramble local spatial structure, to defensive fields that harmlessly scatter most conventional energies. You can even hybridize the particle species you devise, or design complicated, multi-stage reactions to counter particular powers or produce precise effects, like burning up a particular strain of microbe while leaving somatic cells unharmed. With sufficient ramp up, you might even be able to synthesize non-baryonic materials, interacting with conventional matter along exotic scripts that you devise.

This is a highly versatile specialty, but particularly subtle applications require hyper-precise designs, as well as time-consuming and highly-intentional engineering. Where you really outshine other Tinkers is in the raw firepower you can produce. Tricks like Phir Se's anti-Behemoth blast will be within your regular arsenal once you're fully ramped up, though containing and directing your highest possible yields will be a challenge. Powering a small country (or a few minutes of unprecedently intense combat) would be a reasonable feat for one of your reactors.

Your tech doesn't violate conservation of energy, but might sometimes seem like it does, as the particles you devise can react favorably with the multi-layered structure of the multiverse and extract energy from unexpected places.

objects.title: (Mover/Breaker) Flight
objects.text:
You have the power of Flight. This might not sound impressive but you can go up to Mach 25, making you one of the fastest Movers around.

While moving, you have an invisible, skintight forcefield around you whose durability scales with your speed. It’s always enough to protect you from collisions and at your fastest, it becomes nearly invulnerable. Similarly, your thought speed accelerates per your velocity, helping you to maneuver.

You can also reduce your body’s friction, inertia and gravity, altering it from normal down to zero. This lets you accelerate to your top speed immediately, stop or change direction in an instant and become effectively weightless. This control naturally extends to anything you wear or wield.

Casual flight is effortless but sustained max-speed flight will be draining. You don’t need to breathe and are unaffected by nausea, sonic booms, G-forces, pressure changes or similar issues. You can fly indefinitely in the vacuum of space with no ill effects but your Shard stops you from going too far out.

You can temporarily extend aspects of your Flight to other people and objects upon touch. For example, you could reduce their weight or friction and even remotely maneuver them through the air. This works as a crude form of pseudo-telekinesis, letting you lift people into the sky with you or launch them away.

Propagating your Flight to others requires constant mental strain and awareness to maintain the effects; losing track of an affected target immediately ends your influence. The more mass you affect at once, the greater the drain on your mental stamina, limiting you to roughly the mass of a tank at most.

addons.text:
Power Guru can be used on powers stored inside (Trump) Manager, allowing you to grow your copied/stolen abilities over time, as well as on (Trump) Manager itself. Moreover, it treats each power individually with its cooldowns.

Power Guru can also be used once a month to generate a single power up to 15 SP held inside Manager. Purchases of Potency Increase (Power Guru) will increase the potency of the power you can generate to match Power Guru's cap.
addons.title: Self Guided Coding

addons.text:
Manager’s ability to copy abilities is expanded upon, allowing you to utilize the information and data from (Thinker) Vision as a vector for replication.

This allows you to replicate the abilities of anyone and anything capable of being seen in your vision. This also includes anything it could envision as an ability in itself. If it can be seen in a Vision, it can be replicated.

This is done by feeding the information from your (Thinker) Vision to your (Trump) Manager and allowing it to construct its copies as it normally would when encountering powers.
addons.title: Supervisor Override

addons.text:
You may now plant a power seed into a slot for (Trump) Manager, allowing it to grow there in place of a normal target.

Planting a power seed inside (Trump) Manager removes your ability to recall it; instead, it’ll simply be treated as an ability that was acquired by (Trump) Manager.
addons.title: Garden Seed

addons.text:
You can now direct Manager to replicate any of your own abilities to hold in its slots as you would the abilities of others.

In addition to the potential outcome of having multiple copies of your own abilities, as well as being able to manipulate them and their expression, this effectively allows you the ability to give out copies of your abilities to others. 

This also extends your power to manipulating your existing abilities, whether inside (Trump) Manager slots or not, allowing you to freely alter their expressions.  

You may also use this to replicate the abilities you gain in some manner from any of your other abilities, for example a power via (Trump) Paramount, to copy, manipulate, and distribute.
addons.title: Administrative Assistant

objects.text:
You can take/copy the powers of any Parahuman you touch, as well as give the powers you have taken/copied to others. You have fifteen slots to store powers and can have five of them active at a time. You can temporarily go over this limit, but you will suffer Thinker headaches that worsen rapidly the longer you are over your maximum limit.

Negentropy increases your active limit by 2 and your total slots by 5.

You can alter the powers in your possession by cycling through different expressions of the same power, modifying them by boosting one aspect at the expense of another or changing their restrictions. Multiple compatible powers can occupy the same slot and synergize together. Power compatibility depends on the power itself, not its expression.

This power works on Cauldron Vials and the Garden of Eden; you will get a random expression when getting those powers.

You can discard unwanted powers, but you will not be able to acquire them again unless you steal/copy them again. Copying powers can take a minute, but stealing them happens instantly.
objects.title: (Trump) Manager

addons.text:
Oberon and Fairy Queen merge gaining each others functions, you can now use any of the powers of any of your shades for yourself and you can now summon shades for any power you possess, replicated, stole, or otherwise acquired. This includes any of your own. 

Shades no longer need to look like their sources, and you can freely shape them as you wish, no longer beholden to looking like caricatures or even human-like and may reshape them into something new whenever you wish. You can summon the same ability and/or shade as many times as you want, as long as you have enough slots. 

Your slots are combined, capable of allocating them to summon a shade or any ability for yourself, and you can swap them at any time.
addons.title: Elfame

addons.text: Now your power will catalogue any power that you gain through your other abilities, whether it be summoned through a power like Eidolon or Paramount, or creating temporary powers such as Aliena, or any other manner, and a copy of it will be added to Oberon’s collection and can be freely expressed through Oberon’s slots.
addons.title: Second Copy

objects.text: You can gain a permanent copy of the power of any Parahuman you touch. This works on the substance in Cauldron Vials and the Garden of Eden, though adapted for human use. You can only have five of these powers active at a time, but rather than the Fairy Queen's ghosts, you have these powers for yourself. Negentropy increases your active limit by two.
objects.title: (Trump) Oberon

addons.text:
Your abilities over powers have been enhanced by Ignis Fatuus’s ability to hold multiple powers in one slot. Now you have the ability to create powers that are meant to be held in more than one slot, allowing you to spend more charges on them proportional to their slots (2 slots can be up to 10, 3 slots can be up to 15, etc.) thus allowing for the power to be drastically higher than it otherwise would be. In addition to this, you can now actively choose to hold a power in more than one slot, causing a drastic increase in its power for each slot.

Additionally, you can flicker and page through different states of your stored power, allowing you to recover spent charges on created or copied powers. However, doing so would make it as if you never had the power, meaning that you would be unable to recall the power pattern.
addons.title: Alpha Testing

objects.text:
You have 18 slots to store powers. You can only have 6 active at once, but you can instantly switch which ones are active. You can instantly empty a slot, but it takes 30 seconds to load a power pattern from memory.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (up to a maximum of 200 stored). You can use these charges to copy, create, and improve powers. You can use 1 charge to copy the power of a parahuman in your line of sight within 100m of you. You can use from 1 to 5 charges to create a new power; the created power will be random unless you constrain it. (1 charge would be around 3 on the PRT scale, 5 charges would be around 7). The more precisely you constrain a power, the weaker it will be.

You can expend more charges to tweak or improve the created powers further to your liking. The strongest power you can create would be equivalent to a Tier 3, weaker than Prototype. To prevent an overload, the number of active slots will reduce if you have powers stronger than Tier 2 active, down to only two if you slot the strongest power you can make. The only power you cannot reproduce is Eidolon, as your power already fulfills that function (that is, to select and interface with powers).

You have two secondary Thinker powers. One that allows you to perfectly recall power patterns, and one that allows you to understand the patterns, modify and combine them into new powers.

Negentropy increases your daily charges to 15 and your slots to 24.
objects.title: (Trump) Prototype

addons.text:
Your layered forcefields now attain Sting’s abilities, being applied to be Striker and Brute-based as anything coming in contact with your forcefield is disintegrated and disseminated through turning Sting on its head in conjunction with Destruction Barbie’s method of durability, shunting the impact back to another dimension; Sting, then, shifts both the impact and energy to adjacent dimensions across the Multiverse, “corroding” a material’s structural integrity as your volatile forcefield continuously shunts its atoms to other alternate timelines or dimensions.

If the force bypasses said defense, don't worry—every layer of your forcefields is incredibly tough, comparable to the crystalline folding layers of Endbringers.

And if the force is sufficiently powerful to ‘shatter’ a layer (or you willingly ‘shatter’ it yourself), it unloads a burst of Sting’s multidimensional energy to expand and destroy anything in a wide berth around your barrier.
addons.title: Breacher

addons.text:
Your All-or-Nothing Blaster powers helped remove Sting’s touch-based limit, creating a multitude of results depending on the power responsible.

Stilling’s wave manipulation can now manipulate everything within your radius’s laws of physics, stilling and agitating motion to physical force, spreading Sting’s All-or-Nothing effect in the area, creating both a prison and a trap for dimensional entities. As a blast, it spreads Stilling to all foreseeable realities, which comes close to physical nonexistence in Worm.

Scrub’s spatial shunting stops pretending to be a Blaster, becoming a precise spatial phenomenon where Sting helps in ignoring a target area’s defenses and counterattacks with Scrub clinically shunting molecules to other neighboring dimensions.

Damsel of Distress becomes a raging phantom Blaster power, a pinpoint warping of spacetime that silently bypasses and erases physics instantly hitting its mark, then creates a singularity of unstable dimensional whirlwind, annihilating or irreparably warping every version of the area with explosive release. This leaves its resulting trajectory with an area where the laws of physics are thin and recovering, reality’s fabric frayed at the seams.

But generally, regardless of how you achieve this, you’re able to imbue the 300m² of your surroundings with energy, selectively loosening physics’s hold within it, circumventing or manipulating physics after a fashion. This also infuses the area with a multidimensional All-or-Nothing effect capable of affecting Entities or phenomena that possess dimensional anomalies, a final Longinus.
addons.title: Longinus

objects.text: You can infuse anything you can touch, any projectile you fire, or any power you manifest, with the ability to ignore select laws of physics, including the ability to pass through anything. These will not pass through your own body unless you will them to. You cannot empower yourself with this. Along with this ability, you also have an intuitive understanding of angles, trajectories, as well as an enhanced sense of timing.
objects.title: (Blaster/Striker) Sting

objects.text: You regenerate near instantaneously, are far more durable than you otherwise would, have unlimited stamina and do not age past your prime, have no limits when it comes to how strong you can become through training, are beloved by nature and its inhabitants, and your willpower is increased.
objects.title: (Brute) Avalon

objects.text: Few things can harm you. Not because you're an ultra Brute or so fast you can't get hit. No, you have impossible luck. No one harms you because they get hurt, humiliated or even killed because they tried. The harder, more seriously, and more violently they tried to hurt you, the worse the response from your power. You can still get hurt by accident, or if a sufficiently durable and determined person tries hard enough. They might even live long enough to regret it.
objects.title: (Shaker) It Gets Worse

objects.text: Your whole body is a door to a pocket dimension. Your surface is a semipermeable membrane; you can choose what can pass and what can't. You can shift your shape, and using materials similar to skin, you can make yourself appear human. You can sound like whatever you want. If you let everything in, you become a very powerful vacuum. If you want, you can just walk through anything. You are completely invincible to all physical attacks, including Sting.
objects.title: (Breaker) And the Void Stares Back

addons.text:
Despite your Shard teeming with technological endeavors that defy comprehension and open new frontiers of scientific insight, its primary function seemed to be aiding in the discovery of unexplored knowledge that forms the innovative bedrock of science, being the [Cycle]'s field-tester of technologies and host species’ scientific achievements. Still, as it’s the nature of innovation, it doesn’t stray far from its origin, being innately limited by its foundations. This is no more, as Clarketech’s inclusion broke those hurdles.

Synergizing with Clarketech, it accelerates the power’s research development by leaps and bounds, backed by Clarktech’s Cycle-breakers, now white-boxed to expose the science of it all, turning into a savant in study. Analyzing Clarketech’s extremes and the potential it could attain as a basis, there’ll be no “ceiling” a tech tree can have while maintaining a full understanding of it; to transgress gravity as a fundamental force in one of your projects, an extraordinary grasp on how it works in the first place is essential, wouldn’t you agree?

As a result, this rapid understanding halves Revolution’s research time, e.g., taking a month to fully understand and utilize a narrow specialization at its full potential and how to tap into it in unfathomable ways. This, as previously said, opens the chance for white-boxed Clarketech for wider use, without Tinkertech’s weaknesses. Surely, other host species have discovered near-perfect methods for material preservation, haven’t they?
addons.title: [Breakthrough]

addons.text:
Your Thinker slots merge with your Tinker slots, massively enhancing the power and versatility of the Thinker powers you are capable of manifesting; specifically, your narrow slots can hold thinker powers up to a PRT threat rating of five, broad slots can hold Thinker powers up to a seven PRT rating, and last but not the least, your methodology slots can hold Thinker powers up to a threat rating of nine.
