Should you take any of the upgrades of (Master) Cloning, it will also be assimilated.
addons.title: Angrboda

addons.text:
Your power doesn’t just create direct clones, instead your power allows you to analyze and store the information from anything you touch, which you can then incorporate into anything you work on later. You can still create clones of them at will. 

This allows you to perform acts such as incorporating the powers of a Parahuman into someone else, creating exact clones of someone except loyal to yourself, to even creating the equivalent of possible children of templates you have had the opportunity to touch. 

This also allows you to generate clones without turning into your changed form, simply needing to touch biological material to affect it as you would with Panacea. On the flip side, your changer form can also be used to generate new things wholesale for your biokinetic abilities, allowing you to create things directly out of the glob. 

This allows you to incorporate the features of all that you would have normally just cloned into anything you work.
addons.title: Blueprint

addons.text: Your ability to summon shades of Elfame allows you to forgo the traditional method of creating a clone, instead, you can now sacrifice a slot to immediately make a creation with the features you want. The slot will regenerate after 1 hour.
addons.title: Instant Creation

objects.text:
With some alterations, you gain the horrific ability to clone anything you touch. Clones will typically resemble their source template but will still be distinctly different. You only have to have touched something once to make clones of them.

Things you clone are generally more powerful than their sources, typically healthier, and overall better in almost every way.

In the case of parahumans those you clone will typically possess a greater and/or alternate version of their source's power. You can choose what category they fall in or leave it entirely up to chance.

You can shapeshift into a giant, monstrous new form looking like a gray and red glob. This form is where you generate the clones, creating them directly inside the glob and releasing them. Your changer form can start incorporating the features of those you’ve cloned, becoming more mobile and powerful over time.

Clones will typically possess personalities similar to their sources, but will be innately loyal to you and won’t act against you, your goals, or instructions regardless of other factors. Note that this does not exclude them from being tricked or mastered to do so, only that they won’t do so willingly. If you’re Shardless or possess Esoteric Knowledge you can choose to make any of your clones Shardless as well.
objects.title: (Changer/Striker) Echidna

addons.text: Your ability to hide traps has been integrated into Shroud, allowing make any object you have touched covered by your shroud. This allows you to prevent any important documents, stashes of money, or your hard drive of homework from being detected by anything weaker than shroud itself. Your shroud will also adapt to the object in question, allowing it to things such as deflect sub-routines for files, encrypted and hidden from forensics; obfuscate and misdirect fields for large or group of objects; remove scents and so on. It is also possible to indirectly shroud others if they are in contact with one of these items. You can revoke this at any time.
addons.title: Enshroud

addons.text:
Knowledge is power, and you know this better than most. Your immunity takes upon a new dimension to itself.

You’ve been rendered completely immune to being perceived by Thinker abilities. Your future and past cannot be observed, clairvoyants cannot detect you, danger senses cannot warn their users about you, and even models constructed by the user's knowledge yield no results. 

This is pervading enough that you cannot even be perceived by noticing the blind spots in their sight, such powers simply acting as if you didn’t exist. 

This doesn’t prevent others from perceiving you or making their own conclusions, only that their powers will be of no help. 

You can still use Shroud’s normal ability to conceal yourself as normal, whether in the physical sense or otherwise.

As before you can, at will, allow selected thinker powers to perceive or set up parameters for which they work, such as when a specific person is using it or only when it is beneficial for you. You can rescind this allowance at will at any time.
addons.title: Hidden One

objects.text:
You can become completely undetectable both from a conventional and parahuman standpoint. This power comes from an endeavor to refine and specialize a Cloak Shard toward survivorship through imperceptibility from other Entities while being a culmination of different Stranger Shards into one. Being selectively customizable to your needs or concerns, the methods can vary according to one’s environment and opposition.

From a standard perspective, anyone is unable to perceive or recognize you in any shape or form, on a physical aspect, your power shrouds you off the electromagnetic spectrum turning translucently invisible, subtly canceling vibrations in your vicinity turning you inaudible, masking your scent to blend with the environment, dispersing your temperature signature, retroactively modifying any existent records or media as if you never appeared, your physical presence is essentially muted to the point of turning you selectively intangible; mental aspects such as using perceptive amnesia, distorting anyone’s memories, awareness and perceptions as to obscure your profile or mislead them to cover-up your intentions or actions; this can be used offensively for surprise and unperceivable attacks in combat situations.
From a parahuman perspective, Thinker powers enhancing and expanding the sensorial and intellectual range find themselves struck out from the power’s concealment, effectively removing you from their sights as if you weren’t there to begin with. Thinker powers based on simulating, data crunching, postcognition, pericognition, and precognition come up blank when assessing you, selectively obscuring aspects of yourself to either be a non-person to their powers or simply unsuspecting, effectively employing antimemetic mechanics.

The parahuman aspect is adaptive, appraising the probable vulnerability in the face of detection and responding accordingly.

This is feasibly regarded as the epitome of Stranger powers, with their mechanics using multiple methods of stealth, from physics to multi-dimensional exploitation to camouflage. Despite all this, the weaknesses you’ll encounter are Endbringers and Entities, which come from circumventing your abilities through the Cycle’s rules.
objects.title: (Stranger) Shroud

objects.text:
You are the enemy of all, for you become stronger the more opponents you have. This happens with your power adding the capabilities of everything that is opposing you or that is within 10 meters of yourself; if your opponents can do something, so can you. Intellect, bio-tinker augmentations, stamina, powers, visualization, multi-tasking, teleportation through tinkertech, and much more are yours to have.

Mundane Physical capabilities will only come from the one who has them the most while Mental and Abnormal (compared to average humans) capabilities will come from everyone, the same applies to equipment. Strength, Speed, and Stamina are an example of the first while Skills, Knowledge, and Powers are examples of the second. If an opponent’s physical capabilities weaken compared to others, you’ll draw from the next most capable opponent. For example, if you fought a mob of mooks and their leader’s stamina dropped significantly, you’d start absorbing the stamina of the mook who had the most. And if you faced someone with a gun, you’d find yourself able to shoot bullets at the same rate as them—whether from your fingers, palm, or thin air.

However, all these capabilities vanish the moment the opponents stop opposing you and move out of your range.
objects.title: (Trump) Rival

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to access and control the abilities of others and yourself in a broad but imprecise manner. 

This will allow you to remove restrictions, enhance abilities, alter them in broad strokes, and more. However this comes with inherent risks, one that must be carefully managed lest it kill it their wielder’s, and more importantly you.

The power works through touch and line of sight. 

The power works through three major methods. Power Amplification, Aspect Infusion, and Category Expansion. 

Power Amplification is the simplest method, through which you simply amplify the powers existing aspects. For example a telekinetic would be able to generate significantly more force and/or possess much more fine control. 

Category Expansion allows you to add additional capabilities to the power expression directly, allowing it to manifest new features. For example by adding a Master component to a pyrokinetic power it could allow the user to create sentient fire constructs.  

Aspect Infusion adds new aspects to the theme of a power, creating a new dimension to the overall power. For example by adding an aspect of weakening to a Trump focused on amplifying others, it could allow them to instead directly attack others by striping them of strength instead of enhancing them. This can also be used to remove specific limitations such as the Manton limit. 

These alterations can only be chosen in a broad manner, how many times it affects someone, how potent the effects are, and what categories and aspects are added, but the specifics on how these amplifications manifest are uncontrollable.

Each modification carries inherent risks that escalate with proximity of each successive alterations. For Power Amplification, a quintupling of the power’s potency can be considered enough to hit the end requirements of the first phase, with the multiplier’s maximum to hit the next phase doubling for each additional phase. 

The first phase, the initial alteration, will typically result in no alteration to the mechanics of the powers. 

For the second phase, Trigger Happy, the power will start to activate on its own at times. 

This can lead to unforeseen and potentially disastrous consequences, there aren’t many things one can say to explain why while in their civilian identity their heat vision activated all of a sudden and eviscerated a swath of innocents. 

For the third phase, Instinct Erosion, normally instinctive control over powers is lost. 

The user will need conscious effort to preform actions that were once reflexive. Brute powers that enhance your strength may have you accidentally ripping the arm off of someone you tried to shake the hand of, and powers that require a high degree of precision will be a nightmare to deal with.

For the fourth phase, Protection Nullification, inherent safeguards are stripped away, 

This greatly increases the risk of self harm or unintended consequences in the environment. This can result in your own powers burning you, cutting you, potentially backfiring in a permanently damaging if not lethal manner. 
 
For the fifth phase, Volatile Surge, results in the powers becoming incredibly volatile, risking catastrophic failure and complete loss of control. 

One progresses through each phase for each successive alteration within three months of the previous one, and will drop to the previous phase if one manages to avoid further alterations within three months. 

Each phase also doubles the power’s potency without counting towards the phase’s alteration threshold, this increase in power is permanent. 

The fifth phase, Volatile Surge, is repeated for each subsequent alteration after the fifth if it falls within the three month period, becoming increasingly unstable and chaotic the more alterations there are. 

The effects of each phase, except for Volatile Surge, can be partially mitigated with rigorous and focused training, but only by managing to get to a lower phase or out of the phases can the drawbacks be completely eliminated. 

If one manages to drop to a lower phase or out of the phase entirely you can improve upon their power again. In the same manner, allowing you to continuously improve their abilities. 

Be warned however that shard powers can be burned out by this, as the shard will need to reveal more and more power to its host, and potentially burn an incredible amount of energy to create new features. 

This drawback is removed if you are Negentropic/Shardless, and will allow you to use your own energy source to make their improvements and/or share the secret to Negentropy with their power source if you wish.
objects.title: (Trump) Jailbreak

addons.text:
Much like the environment and landscape within the Shardscape, you have complete control over the shards now present in this dimension. You can reshape and restructure them according to your vision. These shards can transform into cities, forests, or even celestial bodies, depending on their size. Any changes you make to their structures will not affect their inherent abilities and powers.

Shards can temporarily join together to exchange information and data. When you connect a shard to one in use, it will also passively improve their powers by receiving the shared information. However, the more shards that merge in this way, the diminishing the improvement in their powers will be.

Within this realm, the power of a shard can influence every aspect of it. Depending on its powers, it can transform the environment into a hostile barrier against intruders, safeguard and oversee the dimension, and alter the bodies and minds of those who enter the shardspace. This influence can also extend to you in a limited capacity: shards can monitor your presence, protect you by teleporting you to safety within the Shardspace at the hint of danger, or even teleport your enemies close to you to be confronted. This may lead to your shards quickly running out of energy if you use too much of their powers unless you possess Negentropy.

You have two methods for creating new shards from the existing ones in the space. The first method involves combining shards to form a single, larger shard that inherits all the abilities of the original shards. However, merging powerful or large shards can be challenging and risky; if not executed carefully, you might destroy all the shards involved. Additionally, the power of the resulting shard might exceed the capacity of the intended slot.

The second method involves "budding" new shards from existing ones, resulting in a shard with a variant of the original powers. For instance, if one shard controls earth and another creates limbs, the new shard might generate limbs made of earth. The power of the newly budded shard will be a random combination of the two original powers, averaged to half the strength of the combined abilities. Additionally, the original shards will be reduced to 20% of their strength for 24 hours.

As time passes and you gain experience, you'll discover new and powerful ways to utilize your shards in this space.
addons.title: Shard Landscaping

objects.text: A core aspect of the Entities' cycle is the distribution of their shards across a vast number of alternate universes. Thanks to shards' inherent multi-dimensional nature, despite being physically spread out on alternate worlds, they're also present and linked within a semi-virtual dimension called the 'Shardspace'. This dimension acts as a network in which shards can directly communicate and interact with the hosts they are connected to along with other shards. Your shard is vital to the Entities, being solely centred around the construction, maintenance and operation of this Shardspace. From this, you have gained the power to access an alternate version of this Shardspace. Your version of this dimension is completely empty with no shards present and has effectively nigh-infinite size. You possess a full mental awareness of everything that occurs within this dimension. You can permanently warp space inside the dimension to a certain extent, allowing you to manipulate the distances between objects and locations or adjust gravity in specific areas to walk upside-down, for example. The passage of time within this dimension is also completely separate from that of real space and you can modify it as you wish, either rapidly accelerating time in this dimension or slowing it. Thanks to its semi-virtual nature, you have full control over the landscape and environment of this dimension although it must possess the same basic conditions needed to support life as that on Earth. You cannot create sentient life. You could potentially construct huge cities, create forests that cover planets and support the existence of entire civilisations within this dimension. The real strength of this power lies in its ability to act as a connecting dimension across the multiverse; you can use this dimension and open portals from it to access almost any place within your shard's range limit such as alternate universes and other dimensions. You can open portals of any size and shape from real space to this dimension and vice versa as you wish. Due to its semi-virtual nature, transporting large amounts of energy or matter that was created in this dimension into real space will cause your shard to run out of energy as it attempts to substitute for it. Selecting Negentropy or Shardless negates this possibility. This power even allows you to open portals into typically blocked-off worlds and dimensions from interdimensional travel such as worlds which host a shard's main body as well as the Shardspace dimensions used by Entities and their shards to communicate, including your own Shardspace. This means you could potentially interact with your own Shard directly as well as others. Note that an Entity's home dimension containing its core shards is still inaccessible to you without a direct link to it. This dimension possesses strong safeguards to block interdimensional intrusions from outsiders, preventing unwanted access. While this is sufficient to block normal shards and Endbringers, Entities can quickly break through its barriers after some effort.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Nexus

addons.text:
[CONNECTION]

[LINK]

[EXPANSE]

Your Shard’s added functionalities to Shardspace—both Island and Nexus—synchronize and blur between one another, your Shard almost becoming hazy within Shardspace as it starts to transform into Nexus’ bridge into proper Shardspace, able to relocate and shift between both. This has several consequences, such as being able to manipulate your Island's surrounding environment and physics as it extends Nexus’s fine manipulation to itself, being enhanced once you merge with your Shard or fully Materialize it. Partially Materializing isn’t left unscathed, your fine control of Shardspace expanding as far as your Shardmatter and extending your sphere of influence to a full Trump aspect, where if a Parahuman is in the proximity of a Shardmatter-infested area is then analyzed, their Shard located for later use. Once touched or attacked, then, they’re irreversibly transformed into Shardmatter, almost like a hungering infection into the real world, forcibly Triggering dormant Parahumans with portals to your Island growing by the infection. Fully Materializing goes into an Absolute Territory, using both Hitchhiker and Nexus’ capabilities to impose a large section of Shardspace into the real world, with this area caged from local reality. This area takes Shard-like qualities, and, in time, all Parahumans’ Connections are brought to your [Domain] open for the taking. Another outcome on Nexus’ side is that your bridge between both semi-virtual spaces redefines it; it becomes the “shadow” Shardspace casts, any change made in Shardspace is reflected onto Nexus, and vice versa. This redefinition helps in triangulating all Shards’ (and their Connections) “location”, able to be invaded and promptly under your control, growing into a node where your abilities are channeled, but only if you achieve a fully realized Connection. But be careful of quickly expending all of your [Energy]. Fully Manifesting for a long time is a taxing event for your Shard’s life, in this case.
addons.title: [Expanse]

addons.text:
Tapping into the unfiltered lifeblood of Shardspace brings about the full potential of Materialization.

Your Partial Materialization and Full Materialization of your Shard fully manipulates and converts any matter and energy into Shardmatter and Shardspace’s energy signature, generating a dimensional field ruled by Shardspace’s rules. This field gives an iridescent crimson glare to the area, mirages alluding to Shardspace. In return, shaping Shardmatter is freeform, emulating structures and technology being powered by your energy, to the point of sculpting pseudo-Shards capable of imitating Shard architecture temporarily, that may act as relays or minions. 

Fully manifesting your Shard Avatar will encroach on Realspace to accommodate your Avatar by fully expanding your dimensional field to enclose an area comparable to a city, with the field fully at your control with Interdiction’s abilities.
addons.title: Interdiction’s Brochure of Iridescent Sights

addons.text:
A turning point occurred between your connection with your Shard’s Island and Keystone’s Network, reaching a boiling point.

Normally, Keystone’s main functionality revolves around moderating and optimizing the members’ Shards within your Network, but Hitchhiker will inevitably take it a step further. Now, the Shardscape Simulation is no more, the Shards from you and your members finding a solution; long live the Insular Mass, made from the Island of your members’ Shards with you at the center, integrating Hitchhiker’s abilities to your Keystone. Your Insular Mass takes charge of your past Shardspace Simulation you once had, while at the same time being the collective energy reservoir for all your members.

With your Insular Mass acting as both the resource for your items and energy all at once, the items you and your members create are composed of raw Shardmatter you mold into the shape of mundane equipment, acting the part. Charging up now is a steady affair, where all members can lower or raise the amount of power they wish, and the amount of power expressions it can manifest, going up to 10-20 20 SP highly synergizable power expressions they can develop using their Shard’s available [Data], while also removing the limitation of charging up one item at a time.

Aside from benefiting from Hitchhiker’s powers, your members have a greater say in your Network: when they are in need of a buff, their Shard will establish an internal ping within your Insular Mass, and in response, your Shard will arrange [Resources] and [Energy] back to theirs to strengthen their “bandwidth” in their Connection for a steady, permanent “buff”. Influencing Keystone’s functionalities at a deeper level, linking your items together, and the energy and power sharing/transference between members is now democratized, where all the items’ powers are pinged among members at all times due to your closer connection, while giving the option of opting up select powers how they see fit. 

Adding to that, when an item either breaks or burns out, your Insular Mass works as an anchor, recalling the item back into your collective resources. This extensive energy expenditure overclocks your Insular Mass, which lowers restrictions regarding Endbringers and Entities, making the items able to contend with the likes of an unrestricted Endbringer or Entity’s Avatar for a few days.

When Partial Materializing your Insular Mass, it overlays a clearer rendition of Shardmatter, transmitting sections of your Insular Mass to the world, broadening your Shards’ connection to you and your members, loosening their power restrictions as you optimize their powers in real time. Your items start to be at the level of relics, acting as external hard drives of [Data] that allows to host “ghost” versions of other Parahumans’ power expression when you ensnare or trap them. As if they weren't so lucky, any cape within your Partial Materialization will be flagged as “unauthorized access,” which allows your Shard to figure out their position and attack their Island, their powers glitching and backfiring.

Finally, Fully Materializing will bring forth the collective representation of your Insular Mass in its full glory, something you and your members can tap into once merging with the collective Shard Avatar, demonstrating your collective reservoir as a kilometer-wide landscape acting as an “item”, with anyone suffering cognitohazardous effects in your vicinity.
addons.title: Flashpoint

objects.text:
Do you know there’s a place where Shards roost and establish themselves the moment they connect with their [Hosts]? You sure do, your Shard spilled the beans the moment it reached out, a peek of the plane where the magic happens. 

Your Shard has arranged your connection to the Firmament as part of your power’s parameters: You get mental access to the Firmament every time you consciously request it, appearing almost immediately over your Island to embody your connection between you and your Agent. The Firmament is a semi-virtual space composed of a multiversal lattice, where the sightseeing attractions are your fellow Parahumans and their respective Islands.

At first, you possess no abilities outside of checking your connection with your Passenger and the settings thereof, such as your awareness of personal power parameters and expressions, and your semi-immortality derived from your Shard’s memory banks, being fashioned a “body” from the vitreous substance of your Island the moment you “enter”. A biological respawn, so to speak.

The more you cultivate and attune your bond with your Shard, though, you set a personal foothold for more overt functionalities allowed by your Shard: your access grows to be fully physical, freely managing your Connection without being involved in directly operating the [Data] or [Basis] of your powers, and merge with your Shard-Avatar for more applications.

Merging with your Shard grants a mix between [Query][Response] and Power Sight modulated for your comprehension (your Shard translating for you) while on Shardspace. You’ll perceive any Shard Communication as how we usually communicate, being more natural to your sensibilities, with any [Data] or [Broadcast] being partly decoded for your understanding with sufficient context on where to place a dialogue, such as other Shard’s designations, hosts, and roles in the [Cycle]. 

(Still, There are limits: you can’t influence or use your Shard’s received or historical [Data] for personal use unless you convince it otherwise).

Shardspace Access and Shard Merging is only merely the tip of the iceberg: for what’s an Island without an Ocean? Once you reach the pinnacle of your connection you come to be a “gateway” for your Shard’s Island, overlapping between Shardspace and Realspace, partially or fully materializing into the untamed sea that is reality. 

Partially materializing your Island causes surrounding matter to transmute into raw Shardmatter you can manipulate and make use of as a raw resource for both personal and parahuman use: piggybacking from it to enhance your Shard’s connection for a stronger bandwidth and ending up with a more potent power expression while temporary, or directly manipulate it to ensnare or trap any unlucky cape, easily tuning in their Shard.

(This pairs quite well with Connection, Override, Manager, Gestation or any other Shard power fully utilizing Shard Manipulation.) 

Fully materializing your Island brings it forth as it has always been: a full representation of your Shard’s domain of influence, rank, and specialization blending with your mental landscape, representing your connection with your Shard Avatar looming over, ever watchful. Any Parahumans close by will find a light cognitohazardous effect by directly gazing at your Shard Avatar, they aren’t supposed to know or be aware of [Cycle] secrets, after all.

This full manifestation offers Shard Merging applied to Realspace, truly unleashing your Shard’s full expanse from the possible power expressions you could’ve gained from different possibilities, and a freedom of [Data] collection from nearby Parahumans, akin to a temporary Ascension. Retaining your Partial Materialization abilities will always be in store.

Lastly, if you go as far as attacking an Island and succeed in damaging it, it reflects on the Host through glitches in their power, broken power expressions, or even potential fatal brain damage.
objects.title: (Thinker/Trump) Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Firmament

addons.text: Your Friendbringers and Endbringer Engine have fused and increased your number of starting Endbringers to 3 and your total number of Endbringers to 10.
addons.title: Three Times the Charm

addons.text: Due to the fusion between Friendbringer and Endbringer Engine the final strength of your Endbringers is raised to 80SP (however the growth rate is still 1sp per month).
addons.title: Improved Endbringers

addons.text:
Your cores' innate ability to empower one another has built upon itself, harmonizing and empowering itself.

You can now reassign your and your Endbringers' cores as you wish, with each core drastically empowered by the power of the one who possesses it. You can reassign the cores to either yourself or your Endbringers in any combination.

You may also choose to fuse cores, tripling the effect per core but likewise reducing the number of cores they have available and making them more vulnerable.
addons.title: Endbringer Cycle

addons.text:
Your ability to summon Endbringers has been further enhanced by the shear scale of energy you now produce through your cores. Now, not only can you freely transfer cores and energy between your Endbringers but all of your Endbringers are now summoned fully grown. 

To make matters worse for your enemies, outside of just fusing with your Endbringers, you can now freely transfer the abilities of your Endbringers between cores (including your own), allowing you to swap abilities between Endbringers and between Endbringers and yourself should their cores still exist. 

Be mindful that fusing cores still produces a tripling of energy production but comes at the cost of reducing the amount of cores that are available and making you and your Endbringers more vulnerable.
addons.title: An End To All

objects.text:
To the inhabitants of Earth Bet, you have been given perhaps the most terrifying power to exist—the power to create Endbringers.

However, while you possess the power to create Endbringers, the power is not quite as potent as its most notable user.

Thus, you have been given the ability to create completely loyal monsters that start weaker than their brothers and sisters. Each Endbringer you create will start with a core and enough spatial and dimensional folding energy to create the standard folding spatial flesh that all Endbringers use to protect their cores.

These weaker Endbringers will start with roughly 30 SP worth of power and can handle a couple of strikes from their fully grown brothers and sisters, but not much more.

They will then improve over time, growing bigger, stronger, and more durable at the rate of roughly 1 SP a month until they are fully grown and can match the strength of Behemoth and Leviathan (roughly 60 SP). You have complete control over the abilities they spawn with and how they will evolve.

A fully grown Endbringer may be given any group of Shard-based powers that total 60 SP and is not a power-granting or power-growing ability. Any power selected can be scaled up or down according to its chosen SP, so long as the total of all powers given to an Endbringer does not exceed 60 SP. Esoteric Knowledge allows an Endbringer to be given non-shard-based powers.

However, the construction of each Endbringer is extremely energy and processing-intensive, meaning that, while you start with an available slot, only 1 additional (or replacement) Endbringer can be made every month (can be reduced to a week with Negentropy) and only 7 can be alive at the same time. Also, if you spawn too many Endbringers in total without Negentropy, you run the risk of completely depleting your Shard.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Endbringer Engine

objects.text:
You have complete and absolute control of yourself. And I do mean complete, down to the molecular level. This grants you a multitude of benefits, one of them being an absolute immunity to outside influences on your body, including master effects, biological manipulation, and even molecular disintegration. This absolute control of your body means that you can fashion yourself into a living weapon; anything is possible, from making your skin as durable as if it were part of an Endbringer to reinforcing your muscle filaments to be so strong that they could easily contend with the strongest Brutes, rewriting the neural pathways of your brain so that they work better than most thinker-based abilities by sheer processing power. All of that and more, from growing wings to transmuting your blood properties to be as or even far more toxic than even the greatest Tinkertech poisons. Speaking of which, you now also possess the ability to completely heal yourself through consciously closing wounds (if you ever are injured).

But that pales in comparison to your ultimate ability: the capability to make additional Corona Pollentias. Now on its own, there is nothing to gawk about; then again, your command over your body allows you to flood the Pollentia with the stress hormones that a Shard would normally use for Crisis Points and establish connections, allowing you to gain more powers (from different Shards) and even direct it so you gain specific power classifications: Shaker, Master, Blaster, among others. There is a limit to how much power you can gain before they start to negatively affect you, though, being around 3 to 5. However, you can also easily get rid of a power by simply removing the Gemma and Pollentia responsible for said power.

<small>Note: Your absolute control over yourself renders attacks such as Stilling nearly completely useless; however, less esoteric attacks are completely effective. Also, your bodily functions (circulatory, respiratory, lymphatic, etc.) still need to be maintained for you to stay alive; despite that, you can do it manually or change the way they function freely.</small>
objects.title: (Changer/Trump) Intra

objects.text: This is strangely familiar, perhaps you were obsessed with a certain show before you triggered? You have a breaker state that augments your body and gives you access to a suite of powers tied to concepts. The Breaker State changes your clothing and appearance, though the clothing can only be what can be made in a mundane manner and the appearance change is limited to minor alterations. You can only change the default appearance of your Breaker State when you aren't in it. Living beings can't connect your Breaker State appearance with your normal appearance, even if they were extremely similar or hid nothing. The body augmentation consists of an increase in strength and durability — enough to carry easily and tank being hit by a car —, greater sight, smell and hearing equal to cats and dogs, and an increase of reflexes, agility and flexibility. These powers tied to the concepts are the default but you can exchange them for new ones as long they aren't stronger than the default and are still tied to their concept. The switch will take 5 minutes to take effect whether you are changing the powers to another or bringing them back to their default. You can only safely use 6 of those powers at a time, the more you go over 6 the greater the strain upon your body, you could straight up die by using all 20 at the same time, switching takes 10 seconds to take effect. Destruction: Cataclysm allows you to destroy anything through touch. The destruction starts at the point of contact and spreads up to 1 meter. You can control the spread to a certain extent, like making it slower, stopping it at certain points instead of going the full 1 meter, shaping the spread, selecting what is being destroyed, and even changing how its being destroyed. Creation: Lucky Charm creates what you need to achieve a desired outcome—being limited to the mundane and non-living—, whatever is made will have a red/black color scheme. You are limited to having one creation at a time, trying to summon a new creation will just change the existing creation into the new one. The creation appears either in your hands or close to you. Power Nullifiers can unmake those creations. Transmission: Kamiko allows you to create and control butterflies that are able to possess objects. By possessing an object someone is in contact with you can telepathically communicate with them, and if they agree you can alter their clothing in a major way and their appearance in a minor way, and either give them copies of your powers, the strength of your powers or a mix of both. With the exception of the telepathy, you can only do this to a single target at a time. Emotion: Sentibeing allows you to sense emotions and turn an object someone has an emotional connection with into a projection that embodies whatever emotions and desires they have ever felt. The powers and appearance are based on the desires and emotion used in the making of the projection. The powers can only add up to 15 SP. Only one of those projections can exist at a time. The durability of the projection will be the same as the object used to make it unless it has a power that increases it. You have a telepathic connection with the projection in order to command it. Submission: Venom allows you to imbue a sharp or pointy object with an effect that paralyzes living beings and halts the motion of non-living objects. Once you paralyze something you need to re-imbue the effect into the pointy/sharp object. The paralysis lasts 5 minutes. Protection: Shell-ter allows you to create a small green orb from your fingers, the orb follows the area it was created at but you can at will fire it as a projectile. You can choose a shape and then will the orb to change to it, turning it into a green forcefield, once it acquires that shape it cannot be changed. The forcefield is made of hexagonal shapes and you can only have one of them at a time. You can selectively choose what can pass through the forcefield. The forcefield can be bound to something inside it, meaning that if it was for example surrounding someone's head it would follow the head if the person walked. Illusion: Mirage allows you to create fragile visual illusions that may affect the other senses. Their fragility comes from any physical contact harder than a poke dispelling them. Illusions that are disrupted that way will disappear as orange smoke. Once an illusion is created it cannot be altered. Those illusions can't last more than 5 minutes. Multiplication: Multitude allows you to create clones of yourself by sacrificing your size, every time you create a clone your size is reduced by 1% non-cumulatively. The created clone will have the same size you will have after your sacrifice to make it. Your clones can also use Multitude, but their size is reduced cumulatively. Determination: Resistance allows you to cover yourself with a skintight forcefield that makes you completely immune to the powers of others. The forcefield is normally invisible but briefly reveals its blue color when initially activated and whenever a power tries affecting you. Elation: Clout allows you to gather a massive amount of concussive force on your fists in the form of a swirling purple and yellow energy. You can release this energy by punching, which causes an explosion-like shockwave capable of destroying buildings. You can control and shape the output, allowing you to for example gather only enough energy to heavily damage a car or concentrate the energy into a blast that explodes when it hits something. Evolution: The Burrow is a spherical pocket dimension the size of a bedroom that you access through a cyan circular portal, you exit it by opening the same portal in the location you were before you entered the Burrow. The walls of the Burrow are full with circular windows that allow you to see across time and space. Each window has an easier time showing certain locations and times while having a harder time showing other locations and times. Perfection: Elemental Dragon allows you to become Wind, Water and Electricity. You can only be one of those elements at a time. When you are your chosen element you can control more of that element by being in contact with it, the maximum range being 20 meters. When you become your chosen element you can generate more of it. Intuition: Second Chance allows you to set up a point in time where you can return to every time you use this power again. Returning too many times in a short period will cause injuries from past returns to start bleeding over in your current time. Migration: Voyage allows you to shoot a blue projectile that becomes a cyan portal to any location you desire, the blast doesn't need to hit something to create the portal. Hitting someone with the projectile will open the portal right on top of them and make the portal move itself to "shallow" them — sending them to the location you had in mind when you made the portal — and then immediately closing. This portal cannot be bigger than 3 meters. You can only have one portal at a time. You can make the portal suck anything close to one side to bring to the other side. Passion: Genesis allows you to create objects by drawing on air a 3D white outline of them. While the outline itself needs to roughly conform with the object, the size doesn't need to be the same. The object doesn't need to be created right on the exact place you drawed its outline, it just needs to be in the same direction. You can create anything mundane without the necessary knowledge of how they are made, and can create anything beyond the mundane as long as you have the knowledge to do so or you have powers that you could engrave on rhe object at the time of its creation, like arrows that can apply Cataclysm on whatever they hit. Power Nullifiers can unmake those objects. Derision: Uproar allows you to create a orange orb that causes the power of the target hit to temporarily be disrupted and malfunction, lasting 5 minutes. In order to hit the target with it you need to physically throw it. You can only have two orbs at a time, though once you hit someone with it you can create a new one. Pretension: Sublimation allows you to have any single power up to 10 SP. Those powers are fragile and may stop working with usage, needing to be summoned again. Adoration: Fetch allows you to create balls you would typically use to play with dogs, hitting an object with it applies a tag, which you can use to teleport it to you. Jubilation: Gift can be used in two ways, through eye contact and through touch. Through eye contact you can temporarily substitute someone's senses with something they desire. Through touch you can trap someone on a endless dream where their desires are granted, the only way for them to wake up is through outside interference or by them reality its all a dream. The touch version warps the sense of time of the targeted, a few seconds of real life would be decades of living in the dream.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Miraculous

addons.text: Instead of having a vague awareness of everyone with similar traits to you, you can focus on specific traits you have to gain a near-perfect awareness of everyone who has similar traits. Additionally, if anyone speaks your name or a title referred to you, you will have complete and utter knowledge of everything about them.
addons.title: Database

objects.text:
You are attuned to the essence of information—no, more than that, you are information incarnate. Every byte, every whispered word, every pixel in an image that pertains to you forms a vast network, a web of existence you navigate with ease. You live within these threads, making homes out of the records and memories of your existence. Your awareness extends to the whispers of your name, the trace of your image, and the mere idea of you. The essence of who you are resides in the data scattered throughout the world, and this makes you more than a mere being—you are a living, breathing entity woven into the very fabric of knowledge itself.

Your understanding of the world comes from the information it holds. When it concerns you directly, you possess complete and intimate knowledge—nothing is hidden, nothing is obscure. A mention in a conversation, a line in a database, a photograph on a screen, or a memory in someone’s mind—all these are extensions of yourself. If someone mentions you, you feel it like a vibration in the web that makes up your consciousness. Their words become another anchor point, another node in the expansive network of your existence.

The extent of your awareness is more nuanced than mere omniscience. While you have a complete understanding of information directly tied to you, your sense stretches beyond to include anything tangentially related. If you are blonde, you gain a faint, yet undeniable, awareness of every other blonde individual in the world. Their lives do not unfurl before you as an open book, but their presence is a hum, a flicker in your perception. It’s like standing in a crowded room where only certain voices rise above the din—you hear their whispers, sense their existence, but the details are vague unless you focus your attention. You are bound by threads that extend beyond the self, connecting to the broader world in a web of faintly glowing lines.

This power allows you to move through these connections, appearing anywhere where information about you resides. A rumor passed between lips, a photograph pinned to a wall, a digital footprint in a remote server—each of these points becomes a doorway. You do not travel through space as others do; instead, you fold reality along the lines of information. Where your name is thought of or your likeness is stored, you may manifest, a living ghost moving through the data streams of the world. To those who witness such appearances, it is as though you slip through the cracks of reality, emerging from the shadow of a mention or the reflection of a thought.

Beyond movement, you wield the power to manipulate the very essence of information. Information itself is malleable to you, like a sculptor shaping clay. You can destroy it, leaving a void where it once was. When you choose to destroy information, you can induce a Stranger effect, erasing the traces of that knowledge from reality. People forget details, files become corrupted, and memories fade. The information is removed; however, this doesn’t change what already happened, simply altering known history to make it that whatever information you destroyed never existed. The absence you create is more than a hole in memory; it is a shift to accommodate the new narrative you impose. It’s important to note that you do not warp Information in the sense of altering history itself; rather, you manipulate the knowledge and memories of others, subtly adjusting their perceptions so that they align with the narrative you create. 

Your nature as living information means you are not bound by a singular identity. You can graft new information into your very being, shaping yourself according to the knowledge you possess. If you decide to adopt the information that you are a ginger, then you gain the same semi-awareness of all gingers as if this trait had always been yours. Your awareness extends to those who share that characteristic, creating a faint hum in your perception of every ginger person in existence. In the same way, you can graft other aspects—traits, experiences, skills, even entire histories—transforming yourself with each new piece of information you integrate.

However, you are limited by the physical reality you inhabit. You cannot hold contradictory truths within yourself simultaneously; if you are currently a ginger, you cannot also be blonde at the same time. But this limitation doesn’t bind you entirely. Instead of discarding contradictions, you store them within a mental vault, like files archived for later use. You can switch between these traits, activating or deactivating them as needed. If a situation requires you to adopt a different appearance or characteristic, you can draw upon the stored information, effectively rewriting your own existence. To the outside world, this change is seamless—people perceive you as if you had always been this way, with reality subtly adjusting around the new narrative.

This means that while your external appearance or traits may shift, others will not notice any inconsistency. They will remember you as a blonde if that is what you choose to be, even if you had been a ginger the moment before. Photographs, memories, and even written records will warp to align with your current state, ensuring a complete integration into the fabric of reality. You can shift from being a seasoned warrior to a charming socialite, and the world will remember you accordingly. It’s as if the very history around you is rewritten to match your current self, smoothing over any discrepancies.

Your ability to graft information is not limited to physical traits. Skills, experiences, and even personal relationships can be absorbed into your being, becoming a part of your new self. You could integrate the combat techniques of a master martial artist, the scientific knowledge of a renowned researcher, or the memories of a seasoned traveler. These aspects become part of your identity until you choose to store them away, allowing you to seamlessly adapt to different roles and challenges. When you assume the knowledge or skills of another, it feels as though you’ve always possessed them, your body moving with the instinctual ease of long-practiced motions.

You have no fixed form, no unchanging nature. Instead, you are defined by the sum of the information you have chosen to integrate and the echoes of all the selves you have stored. This makes you as fluid and adaptable as the information that defines you, always changing, always evolving, yet anchored in the awareness of every aspect that has ever been part of your existence.

In a sense, you are both a storyteller and the story itself—reshaping the narrative of who you are and what you can be, bending reality to match your chosen role. Those who encounter you might think they know you, but that knowledge is always subject to change, always malleable. You walk through the world as a living enigma, a presence that is both ever-shifting and eternally present, defined by the information you hold and the secrets you choose to become.
objects.title: (Stranger/Breaker) Informatio

addons.text:
Cheat Shard Engine has subsumed your ability to copy and wield more conceptual properties, teaching itself how to manipulate more abstract and contextual variables and even doing away with the stamina and concentration requirements and your need for initial physical contact to copy and affect properties. Additionally, the intuitiveness of Proprietor of Properties extends to Cheat Shard Engine as well, making its usage easier and more intuitive.

This allows for an even wider variety of effects, such as amplifying someone’s charisma, lowering an object’s ’durability’ to make it easier to harm, applying the concept of ‘explosivity’ to something to turn it into a bomb, etc. To you, the world is merely a collection of traits and variables for you to manipulate as you see fit.
addons.title: Conceptual Abstractionism

objects.text:
Your Shard has a specialized role within the network: monitoring every conceivable variable it can detect. This ranges from the distance between two Shards, the number of atoms in a planet, quantum fluctuations over time, and even the exact wavelengths of various effects. Your Shard has complete access to the data observed by all Shards on the network, allowing it to perceive space, time, matter, energy, information, digital space, consciousness, technology, more—and crucially, to alter those variables. This means you can fine-tune, search, amplify, or even freeze specific parameters at will.

Your ability to control these variables manifests in various ways. For example, you could ensure a cup is always half full, regardless of how much liquid is added or removed. You could fix the distance between objects or prevent atoms from moving, freezing their electrons in place despite external forces like electromagnetic fields, gravity, or chemical reactions.

Your Shard's vast observational capability can be overwhelming. Initially designed to function independently, it was not optimized for use by a [HOST]. As a result, your field of vision is sometimes cluttered with overlapping data that may seem nonsensical. However, you can focus this abstracted information by concentrating on specific objects. At low levels of abstraction, you’ll perceive familiar concepts such as vectors, temperature, spatial coordinates, rigidity, and hardness. At higher levels of abstraction, you’ll see more complex information: atomic numbers, relative positions of objects, radiation signatures, and covalent bonds. At the highest abstraction, you’ll access phenomena like the Cosmic Microwave Background, quantum foam, and even inter-universal relations. The downside is that unless you're skilled at multitasking, you can only focus on one variable at a time, and it takes a moment to interpret what you're seeing.
 
When targeting a Parahuman, your power automatically "zooms in" on their Shard, providing essential data such as Shard-Host distance, power bandwidth, and wormhole metrics on the corona. You can adjust, amplify, or stabilize these variables—or even lock them to specific values. By manipulating the "think and do stuff" variable in their Corona, you can temporarily shut down their powers, holding this effect until you release it.

Additionally, you can locate the Shard's resting Earth, disconnect it from the Network, or reconnect it if desired. Beyond individual powers, you can impact Shards on a broader scale: "fix" Case 53s, reconnect dormant Shards to Zion's network, or supply energy to a Shard by modifying its "Total Energy" variable.

You can also manipulate physical reality—creating a miniature, self-sustaining star, forming a singularity that doesn’t pull matter, or binding atoms to simulate nuclear pasta's unbreakable density. On a smaller scale, you could keep a bank account balance permanently fixed, set surface friction to zero, turn diamond into a truly unbreakable material, make plastic a superconductor, or freeze your phone battery at 1%.
objects.title: (Shaker/Thinker) Cheat Shard Engine

addons.text:
You can incorporate a history for your characters, allowing you to weave them into the world’s history instead of simply creating them from scratch.

This could have potentially wide-reaching implications, letting you retroactively build an army.
addons.title: Huh Isn’t That

addons.text: Instead of simply creating from scratch, you can now call upon your Isekai power in reverse, capable of summoning characters/creatures the same way you would have sent them elsewhere. This allows you to summon creatures and characters as if they were sent by Isekai, although you can control whether this is a true summoning or whether it’s simply a background your power constructs for them. Whether summoning characters in a specific form of media or simply allowing your power to summon at random, it’ll summon someone that perfectly aligns with you, regardless. You can be as broad, specific, and vague as you wish. You must expend a charge to summon, and you are no longer limited to how many abilities you can grant or how far you can improve them.
addons.title: Reverse Isekai

addons.text:
Your ability gains a new dimension—you can now create objects as well as you could have life.

Alongside your ability to pull from books, you may now expend a charge to create items.

A single charge can net you an item worth roughly 6 CP or an item worth roughly 3 SP. More charges will grant greater and more powerful items, similar to your characters.

You can rewrite items at will, reshaping them into something else. Items have 6 slots (9 if Shardless/Negentropic) that can house abilities. As a result of the dimension of your power, you gain twice as many charges as before.

When creating objects, characters, or creatures, you gain a boost the more well-known they are. A character from a short story published at a local school by one of their students and liked and known by their classmates may have the character created a little more powerful and more skilled than they would be otherwise. A worldwide known and beloved character of a decade-old series could be summoned near, if not at their full strength, with a single charge.

This is based on the popularity and renown at the time you are creating/summoning them. The more your character is altered from the source material, the less effective the boost is.
addons.title: Book Worm

addons.text:
You can now grant your creations Perks and personal Drawbacks. It takes a single charge to grant them a single Perk or Drawback. A drawback can be removed by expending a charge.

You can use this to give your creations perks and drawbacks that you do not have, although their own versions will have a hole in their defense against you and your abilities. This can be waived if it would benefit you or if you simply would like it, although it can be reinstated at will.
addons.title: Author Fiat

addons.text: You have merged the fantastical with the tactical. Each member of your Personal Army now manifests a superpower upon being summoned. You choose the type of power each unit receives—whether pyrokinesis, teleportation, or something stranger—but you do not control its strength. Instead, each soldier rolls for their power level at the moment of creation, producing a distribution centered around PRT rating 5. Most will average between PRT 4 and 6, with a smaller portion reaching higher levels. Roughly 5% will land between PRT 7 and 8, while 1% may attain PRT 9 or even 10. The powers granted to your troops automatically integrate with the technology and skills they are given, allowing for synergistic combinations of gear and ability. A teleporting grenadier might blink behind enemy lines, while a forcefield generator could serve as a mobile shield wall for an entire squad. Every soldier’s equipment and abilities are seamlessly optimized to work in unison. In addition, you may spend a charge from Drawing Board to make an individual from your legion permanent. Doing so removes them from the Multiversal Legion troop limit, causing a new soldier to be randomly generated in their place, and allows you to upgrade, personalize, or grant skills to the permanent individual at the same rate and to the same extent as any other Drawing Board creation. You can also use a single charge to grant a specific human-level skill to an entire squad, or to reroll a squad’s powers entirely.
addons.title: Legion of the Drawn

objects.text:
You can create and summon life. Your power allows you to create characters and companions with a wide variety of histories and powers. You can summon them through your will and imagination alone, or you may use a medium for a boost.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (15 if you’re Shardless/Negentropic). You can use a single charge to create a character(s)/creature(s) that’s roughly on par with a normal human.

This can be a single creature or a group of creatures, although their combined power/danger level will be roughly the same as a single creation.

By spending more charges, whether during its creation or after, you can enhance its abilities and powers, widening its repertoire of abilities and enhancing its existing capabilities.

A single charge will allow you to grant them an ability that’s roughly a 3 on the PRT scale, with 2 charges needed to increase its rating by 1, to a maximum rating of 10 on the PRT scale for a single ability. They can hold up to 6 powers at the start and will be able to hold one additional ability with every month that passes after their initial creation. There is no limit to what kind of ability you can give them.

You can also spend a charge to grant them near superhuman skill in a specific skill; there is no limit to how many skills you can do for a single creation.

Their abilities can synergize and benefit from other factors, such as other trump abilities you possess, without it counting towards their limit on the charge improvements.

You can create and summon characters/creatures using nothing more than your will, but by utilizing mediums, the cost of producing them is significantly lessened, depending on their quality and type used. The medium is not destroyed or altered if used; it simply exists as a reference point for your power.

You may also spend a charge to rework them, altering/reshaping them into something else, although it will not increase their power by doing so, serving more as a rewrite of them than an improvement.

Poorly drawn images in crayon may yield almost no benefit, but a realistic 2D drawing could let you summon a version that’s already mildly superhuman and with one or two low-level powers with a single charge. A 3D sculpture could yield a much more powerful creation, even potentially granting it extra space for abilities or increasing the limit on how many charges you can use on them.

You do not need to create the media/medium; you may use existing ones to summon them, including the use of the creations of others for this. When using existing media as a reference, you can choose to alter it as you wish, so it’s not a 1:1 copy, if at all, using it simply as a reference for appearance, personality, and/or powers.

Regardless of what personality you give them, they’ll be intrinsically loyal to you, although you may find some interesting interpretations of commands depending on personality.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Drawing Board

addons.text: The spatial-temporal aspects of Epoch’s power — such as transporting objects to their positions up to ten seconds from the past or future and temporarily freezing them — have seamlessly integrated. You can now employ these more time-oriented spatial manipulations with the same range, volumetric area and precision as (Mover/Shaker) Displacement, significantly expanding your versatility. For example, you could teleport huge droves of enemies back to their positions from 10 seconds earlier or, to avoid imminent attacks, remotely teleport them to where they will be located up to 10 seconds in the future. You can also temporarily freeze vast sections of space at will, up to that of your maximum volume and a ten-second time limit. Do note that maintaining this stasis is a continuous use of your total spatial volume capacity.
addons.title: Chronal Displacement

addons.text: Your spatial and dimensional manipulation powers have merged into a cohesive whole. With (Shaker/Mover) Dimension Tripper, you can now transport large sections of space you are aware of from halfway across the world into dimensions and universes of your design. This ability also works in reverse, enabling you to teleport sections from your dimensions into the current universe. For example, you could teleport a region of space from a dimension where gravity is 100 times stronger or the ground is diamond. Be mindful, however, that areas of space from dimensions significantly different from the universe it is in will dissipate as the universe reasserts itself. The greater the divergence in fundamental laws, the faster the dissipation. To complement this, your control over your teleported spaces has improved. You can "phase" these spaces, regulating how "real" they are within the current universe and preventing them from fully overlapping existing matter. This enables you to precisely manage interactions between the two overlapping spaces, ensuring only the desired effects manifest. For instance, you could phase a dimension where machinery does not function over enemy tech. You can also use this to purposely hold areas from other dimensions out of sync to prevent dissipation. Note that maintaining this "phasing" requires continuous mental focus.
addons.title: Dimensional Trekker

objects.text: You have become the quintessential example of what is often called a ‘Blink’ Mover, a sub-classification centred solely around teleportation, thanks to your shard’s focus on the shifting and transportation of space. You can employ two distinct types of spatial teleportation. The first is a two-way ‘swapping’ teleportation in which two areas, along with any matter and energy within, are switched in location. The second is one-way teleportation; this effectively erases any matter and energy in the receiving area, replacing it with the incoming space, while creating a vacuum in the original location. For example, you could teleport away a section of air, leaving a vacuum, with that section of air then erasing and overlaying anything at the destination. This power has no specific range limitations, aside from standard shard constraints, allowing you to remotely teleport space around the world and even across dimensions. You do, however, have a limited total spatial volume of what you can teleport at once, equivalent to that of a sphere 1 km in radius. Within this limit, you can freely decide the dimensions of the space you wish to teleport and can teleport numerous separate areas simultaneously, though you are limited by your multitasking and overall maximum volume. This power is not Manton Limited and acts as an All-or-Nothing effect, capable of spatially cutting matter on an atomic level. While it can affect Endbringer flesh, Endbringer cores remain immune due to their safeguards and spatial warping properties. This power automatically accounts for and compensates for factors like momentum, planetary rotational velocity, energy transfer, etc. To aid in its use, you possess a secondary thinker ability that grants you conscious spatial awareness of everything in the area that you want to teleport from as well as the area that you wish to teleport to, though you need a clear mental image of both locations involved. This clairvoyant sense can even remotely scout out areas you have a clear awareness of. Finally, this ability also provides excellent innate finesse, fine enough that you can teleport complex 3-dimensional shapes, like cutting out a keyhole from a wall.
objects.title: (Mover/Shaker) Displacement

objects.text:
You can one time per week create a white pocket watch-like object called Record. A Record can engrave in itself the story of a Parahuman, their past, present, and future. By pressing its button you can insert the Record on someone, allowing them to become an Another—a distorted version of the recorded Parahuman. A Record is nigh-indestructible, the only way to destroy it is through the Parahuman they recorded, either through their powers or identity.

The engraving can be done in three ways. The first method is by being in the presence of the Parahuman. The second method is by being in the presence of something affected/made by their power. Finally, the final method is being present in a location significant to their story.

Whenever the power of the recorded Parahuman is used it will be weakened, if the power is completely gone then history alters itself so that their cape identity is erased from existence and only their civilian identity remains, with anything they did as a cape being attributed to others. But this alteration isn't 100% reliable, echoes of their existence remain, and some people might have vague memories while others remember them outright.

An Another is separated into two Transformations. The first is based on the civilian identity of the Parahuman, while the second is based on their cape identity, meanwhile, the Another can only be one at a time they can easily transition from one to the other. Those transformations are distorted, having physical mutations reminiscent of Case-53s and often incorporating elements from significant parts of the story of the Parahuman, like their allies and enemies, the way they died, etc. The cape transformation is much more monstrous than the civilian one. The civilian transformation has the name of Parahuman and the year of their trigger engraved in it, while the cape transformation has their cape name and the year of its creation engraved in it.

The transformations are accompanied by transitions based on their powers, like bursting into flames and dissipating to reveal the transformation. Transforming into the cape identity causes those nearby to hear the name of the Parahuman that originated that Another.

If an Another uses their transformations too frequently or for too long—with both at the same time accelerating the consequences—, they will start to have their mind slowly merged with a distorted mirror of the mind of Parahuman, with that mind eventually having a greater focus. While normally the merging could be undone by not transforming for a time, once the distorted mind becomes the focus the only way to undo the merge is by the record being destroyed. What is meant by "distorted mirror" is that mirrors appear to invert something yet do not quite do so, that's what happens with the mind of an Another, for example, a kind Parahuman results in an Another that is cruel by being kind.

Anothers have a slightly stronger manifestation of the power of the original. These variations will often incorporate elements from the significant parts of the recorded story. With time new powers based on the story are acquired and the existing powers gradually increase in strength through effort and use.

The civilian transformation has everything enhanced to the human limit, while the cape transformation is 3x that. Anothers can only be killed using the powers or identity of the recorded Parahuman—they aren't just revived though, they are reset back to peak condition, meaning that any fatigue acquired in battle (or possible damage to their powers) is removed—, thought when that happens the record will be broken instead of the Ex-Another dying.
objects.title: (Trump) Another

objects.text: You’ve gained access to the most efficient energy collection system the Entities have ever created. You’ve gained the ability to create and manipulate virtual particles, brief and transient particles arising from the vacuum. Your control over this power is incredibly limited but immensely potent. This power comes with 3 main abilities. First is the ability to create virtual particles, which must always come in pairs, within a massive radius of 20 kilometers. Whenever you create particles, they will immediately entangle and interact with one another to erase each other out of existence. This is where the potential lies, for virtual particles that normally come into existence right next to each other immediately obliterate. You can control where and when they manifest, as well as be able to untangle their existence from their pair. The second ability is that you can create a sort of virtual space, a crinkle in space-time where matter and energy cannot enter normally, where you can manifest one side of the virtual particles. What this means is that while you can freely summon virtual particles in real space, you can force them to interact with other forces, resulting in unique effects. For example, by summoning one virtual particle in real space and another in your virtual space, they can no longer interact with each other, effectively creating new energy in your virtual space, which your shard can collect for itself. As the universe must correct the imbalance in energy, this results in the virtual particles in real space becoming negative energy, which will instead obliterate whatever it interacts with, bringing the system that is the universe back into balance. The reverse can also be done, where instead of allowing virtual particles to sit in the virtual space alone and incapable of interacting with others and in turn unable to obliterate themselves and forcing them to become real, you can feed energy from your shard into the virtual space, allowing it to obliterate itself, but in turn, forcing its pair in real space to become real, effectively transmuting energy at an almost perfect conversion rate, the only loss of energy for your shard being the energy needed to start the reaction. You also possess the ability to manipulate virtual pairs in the same space, allowing you to freely alter the allocation of energy and matter throughout your range as well as control interactions between particles. Your shard will archive any matter and energy you and your power interact with, effectively building a catalogue of types of energy and matter it can transmute energy into. This catalogue will quickly expand, allowing you to be able to construct anything you desire with some time, which itself is incredibly intuitive once you know what you want to create. Because of the nature of these interactions, you have no theoretical limit to how much energy can be introduced to a system, although it’ll still retain equilibrium at the end of the interaction. The energy cost your shard has for the interaction is static for each interaction, regardless of the amount transmuted; all it needs to do is kickstart the interaction. This can be devastating if not wielded carefully; even a single kilogram of matter being transmuted to pure energy can result in catastrophic damage. Collected energy can flow to improve any ability you possess.
objects.title: (Shaker) Providence

addons.text: You can choose to design your Personas by using Drawing Board as a vector. You maintain your normal budget; however, you can now include Drawing Board's ability to create, enhance, and alter your Personas, and Drawing Board can now treat your Personas as if they were a normal creation of it. You can choose to speed up your Persona creation process by foregoing the normal allotted budget, relying entirely on Drawing Board to create the Persona as it would a character, but this, in turn, allows you the possibility of creating a Persona instantly by paying the cost. If a Persona lasts in a slot for at least a month continuously, you may spend a single charge from Drawing Board to move it from your slot to make it into its own creation, although it’ll clear your slot.
addons.title: Author Insert

addons.text: You can now summon your unused Personas as minions independent of you. You can freely communicate with each other and see through their senses, tap into their memories instantly, and coordinate flawlessly. Alongside being able to swap between Personas at will, you can swap where you are between the Personas that are active without swapping their locations or recalling them, able to effectively swap bodies between active Personas. This automatically happens if the Persona you are inhabiting is destroyed and there is an active one available.
addons.title: Triumvirate

addons.text:
You can use your Manager Slots to create and develop Personas as you would under Personas Slots, and you can store, hold, and manipulate Personas as you would normal powers.

This massively enhances your ability to tweak and alter your Personas at will, able to rewrite them entirely on a moment's notice.

You can also use Manager to hand off Personas to others. When doing so, you can choose one of two methods: one is by granting it to them as a Persona, allowing them to mantle the Persona as you normally would, or you can choose to allow the Persona to take over the person, effectively rewriting them into the Persona themselves.
addons.title: Luga

addons.text:
You can create Personas that your shades can take the form of. You may store as many Personas as you wish among your shades, although you are still limited by how many shades you can normally summon, and this does not affect your ability to summon and store Personas for your own personal use.

You may create Personas in your slots as normal, but instead of discarding them, you may choose to place them among your shades. While you can place Personas among your Shades and use them as Shades, you cannot move them back using this method.
addons.title: Gwydion

addons.text: Each Sensory you make through Character Creation will now be automatically added as a Persona after the ten years have passed. Those Personas do not count toward your slot limit, allowing you to accumulate an entire library of faces given enough time. Moreover, the limit of power for each new Sensory is now the same as for the creation of a Persona.
addons.title: Alt-form

addons.text: You can now construct your clones as you would your Personas, with all the benefits and advantages that Hive Mind and Persona would entail. Personas created in this way are not saved in your slots, although their template is remembered as normal if you wish to do so. Personas created in this manner are not restricted by the normal time frame required to manifest as they would in your slots, instead utilizing Hive Mind’s construction for its manifestation.
addons.title: I Am Legion

addons.text:
Each of the thousands of souls inside your mind has their own distinct Persona Slots available to them, same as you. This grants you a much greater arsenal to potentially draw from. They have as many Persona slots as you do, and each of their slots is as powerful as your own.

They will usually have at least one persona slot filled with a persona that they use to represent themselves. While you can draw upon any of these Persona slots as you would your own, the Persona slots themselves are created and maintained by their respective owners, and as such, they may create a wide variety of personas that you yourself may not have thought of or drawn up.

While you can converse with and ask your personalities to create specific Personas, they’re not beholden to it and can create whatever they wish with their own slots. While you don’t have direct control over the personas they create, you will still be as aware of them and their abilities, personalities, and quirks as you would be of your own.
addons.title: A Thousand Faces

objects.text:
You have 3 slots for which you design and store Personas.

Personas are different forms you can design, whose appearance, powers, equipment, skills, and even personalities are under your control.

Personas can be designed freely and have a budget of either 15 SP or double the total SP of your other powers combined, whichever is greater, for which you can design your powers.

Skills and equipment are also subject to this budget, with simple clothes or costumes not costing any part of your budget, but equipment and/or skills that go beyond the scope of your base form are calculated into your total budget.

A Persona's physical forms are entirely under your control—whether tall, short, muscular, a different sex, or any other variations one can think of. Likewise, a Persona’s personality and mind are also entirely under the purview of this power, not merely a facade, but able to adopt the mentality in full while wearing it.
