You may adorn a Persona stored in one of your slots at any time, taking on their form, abilities, and personality at will, and you can hot swap between any of your stored Personas.

A Persona takes 1 day to form inside a slot after you design it. After its design, you may make minor alterations to it, such as minor cosmetic alterations or small tweaks to its powers. You cannot make fast, wide-sweeping changes to a Persona after its creation, but minor tweaks over time can drastically alter it over time.

You can drop a Persona at will to free up a slot to design another, following the same time requirements as before. You may also call up old Personas by following the same process as creating a new one.

You have a set of secondary Thinker abilities that help you design and tweak Personas inside your mind, allowing you to instinctively and effortlessly craft them down to the most minute and perfect detail and tweak them as needed, and that allows you to remember every Persona designed and any alterations made.

If you die while wearing a Persona, you’ll automatically be swapped to another available Persona, or your normal form if all of them have been destroyed. A damaged or destroyed Persona takes twelve hours to regenerate back to full. Swapping between Personas will clean the Personas unless you intentionally hold this aspect back.
objects.title: (Trump/Stranger) Persona

objects.text: You are like a photon, for you, no time has passed since you received this power. From the beginning to the end, you observe and experience the entirety of your personal timeline all at once. This is not a prison; you are free to act, change your actions, and react in different ways to change your personal timeline from within. Obviously, changing one thing in your personal timeline will change everything past that point. The end of your personal timeline is when you die. Unlike most Thinker powers, this bypasses or even ignores most blind spots, such as Triggers, Endbringers, or Entities, because unlike traditional Thinker powers, you are actively experiencing the information firsthand. This also provides a form of immortality because if you die, you can just change your actions earlier in your personal timeline to avoid that death. When you aren’t actively concentrating on a part of your personal timeline, that version of you will be able to slightly mentally distance themselves from the rest of your personal timeline to live in the moment. This lets the rest of your mind focus on the parts of the timeline you want without having to worry about every little detail. You may also, at any time, transform your body, taking on any conditions or forms your body has previously taken before that point in your personal timeline. Without Negentropy, the maximum length your timeline can reach is 300 years.
objects.title: (Thinker/Changer) Storyboard

addons.text: Your luck and quantum immortality have a ridiculous synergy, mutating your survivability to a point where you’ll be the version of you among countless parallel or alternate versions that thrive and experience the most beneficial outcome out of all contexts and occurrences regarding you. In the same way as Undying, through quantum necessity imposed by your Shard, you’ll be variant where every stroke of luck that could happen to you will happen.
addons.title: (Un)Certain Fortune

objects.text:
Your Brute power is… peculiar in how it applies itself. Following the thought experiment of Quantum Immortality, your power ensures you’ll be the version among your alternate or parallel selves that survives every life-or-death scenario and continues living even through absurdity and apparent impossibility.

In a nutshell, throughout every possibility due to quantum necessity imposed by your Shard infringing on the laws of the universe more than they usually do, you’ll be the variant that survives till the end of the [Cycle] (or till the end of time itself if you picked Negentropy or Shardless) with both the methods and reason growing continually more absurd or impossible the more your quantum possibilities grow all the more preposterous, including ridiculous measures of survival when no other avenue of survival is possible—not eating that one food with a parasite to narrowly avoiding being hit by a car and being resurrected by a power interaction between Alabaster and Scapegoat coincidentally within your corpse’s vicinity.
objects.title: (Brute/Breaker) Undying

addons.text:
Your Golden Form and your ability to manipulate energy interact in a new, interesting way.

Your Golden Form now passively fills your energy stores even when not active, enough so that your normal form will grant as much energy as your Golden Form would normally possess if you didn’t have Biological Dynamo.

As would be normal whenever you enter your Golden Form, you have access to much greater stores of energy, far surpassing whatever you would have collected.

However, this is where things start to differ a bit—whereas Golden Form would have normally acted as merely an amplifier, now it also acts as a power plant. Your Golden Form will passively fill your stores of energy up until it matches whatever your greatest volume of stored power was, and then continue after that at a scaling pace.

This will slowly increase your greatest volume, which will, in turn, allow more and more power to be brought to bear in your Golden Form as it continues to scale alongside your normal form.

Your control over your energy is greatly enhanced as well, now able to freely transmute your Golden Form’s form and energy into any form of energy you could control and back, as well as granting Golden Form’s innate control over your energy manipulation ability.

Your store of power can be refilled from empty to full in 24 hours by Golden Form’s passive generation. As your Greatest Stored Volume increases, the energy generation will scale to match alongside it so that it’ll keep refilling at the same pace.
addons.title: Golden Dynamo

addons.text: You would think that the secret behind a species' fantastical abilities that outclass anything humans could do would ultimately come down to a more efficient energy collection system—whether they collect more energy from food by having a different process, or they collect energy in massive quantities from somewhere else. But it’s not always the case, Ki being a perfect example. Its unique supernatural features allow an otherwise unremarkable being to reach unimaginable heights with it, enhancing them to levels that seem absurd at best. You, however, are remarkable. Rather than simply supplementing one another, your Ki responds to your powerful body and energy. As your store of energy grows, your Ki will interact with it, multiplying and fusing alongside it. Your power will treat your Ki reserves and enhancements as if they were scaled equivalently with a normal human. So if your Ki had grown to the point that you can level mountains as a normal human ordinarily, your Biological Dynamo-influenced body will, in turn, be that much more powerful, even if your store of Ki would otherwise generate a much less remarkable level of power. This also extends to any other power and/or energy sources that enhance you.
addons.title: Bottomless Well

addons.text:
Your energy collection is no longer limited to your bodily processes; instead, you’re able to collect energy as you would normally through your Providence power to fuel yourself.

Moreover, you can now wield energy and matter more effectively, able to generate and transmute it into its various forms with barely any effort, practically responding to your will rather than thoughts, and you are no longer limited to projecting and manipulating it from your body—instead, you're able to do it anywhere within range.

Perhaps most importantly, however, is that you can now freely wield negative energy, which erases whatever it hits. Negative energy effectively works at a minimal energy cost to you, as its energy cost is almost entirely compensated by the erasure of any matter and energy it touches. Negative mass and energy will erase any of its positive counterparts it interacts with, and will disrupt almost any power it comes into contact with.
addons.title: Erasure Engine

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to convert matter into energy, store it, and manipulate and utilize stored energy to enhance yourself.

Your body’s biological processes related to consumption and energy use are completely altered. Whenever you consume food, water, air, sunlight, or any other form of sustenance, your power converts the material into pure energy at a 1:1 rate and stores it. As a result of this perfect conversion, you produce no waste of any kind.

Your body’s functions are powered and enhanced by the stored energy. Highly optimized and efficient, your body bypasses many normal processes, delivering energy directly where needed—enhancing muscle strength, accelerating healing, replacing the need for oxygen, and even boosting cognitive function. You suffer none of the typical drawbacks: you can use full strength without damaging your muscles, heal rapidly without reducing your lifespan, and operate far beyond human limits without harm.

You can also project and manipulate this stored energy from any point on your body, transforming it into kinetic, electric, thermal, or other forms. This enables you to emit blasts of heat, generate kinetic force to fly, and more. Your body remains in peak condition, constantly refined by your power, converting all excess or waste energy into usable form.

Your physical and mental structure naturally adapts to handle your energy levels, preventing any backlash from your power use. You instinctively grasp and control your energy perfectly. Additionally, you possess a secondary thinker ability that lets you intuitively know how much energy you have left and how to use it with maximum efficiency. This energy can also be converted to fuel and enhance any of your other powers.
objects.title: (Breaker/Blaster) Biological Dynamo

addons.text:
With your power, you can retroactively add your changes to a space, allowing you to potentially create entire new histories, cities, etc.

Whereas you might have drawn a lot of questioning eyes if a village of superpowered soldiers popped up out of nowhere, now you can have it so that no one so much as bats an eye, the whole thing old news and part of the established status quo as far as everyone is concerned.
addons.title: Has That Always Been There?

addons.text: Reality Sculptor holds dominion over each of your spaces as it does within its own range. It can rewrite your spaces without spending any charges.
addons.title: Sculptor’s Clay

addons.text: Your control over the life inside your spaces can now be as precise as Drawing Board's; moreover, if your characters/companions from Drawing Board have their background and histories rooted in the space’s history, they will have an additional 2 starting power slots, and can benefit from the properties of the space without taking up any space from their slots.
addons.title: Story’s Cast

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to potentially construct entire worlds. From nothing more than your mind, you can sculpt and create spaces where new realms operate, with life and rules that defy reality. You can create them through your will and imagination alone, or you may use a medium for a boost.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (15 if you’re Shardless/Negentropic). You can use a single charge to create a space with a volume of 5 million cubic feet. You may design the space as you wish, whether as a sphere, a cube, etc.

Each additional charge multiplies the volume by 10. Inside this space, you may have it replicate and maintain any environment you’ve been in and replicate and maintain the laws of physics and other metaphysical properties of any world you have encountered in the past without any further cost.

This can allow you to have flowing rivers of clean and fresh water flowing from one end of the space, where there is no possible source, to having a small forest that gathers sunlight from light that comes from above that does not come from a star to a sky that shows stars when there are none. This space will perfectly replicate these phenomena as if they were coming from outside sources, if necessary to fulfil its purpose.

Once created, the shape and composition of the space are set, and further charges are needed to rewrite it into different spaces. You can have the space you construct be inhabited by life, from simple microbes to complex flora and fauna. Inside the space, you can alter the rules of reality into something new.

A single charge allows you to imbue the space with a property that, when shaped into a Parahuman power, would be roughly equal to 10 SP. Each charge after that increases the effect by 2 SP. You have 8 slots to assign properties or effects to each space, with an additional slot being added every month after creation. This can be things such as gentle flowing rivers of water that heal all ailments of those that drink from it and heal all injuries of those that bathe in it, to schools that permanently grant a power to all that attend it, etc.

You can also spend a single charge to grant the property a supernaturally enhanced mundane property (such as absolute silence, perfect temperature, unbreakable walls), with no limit to how many such enhancements you can bestow on a single space.

For the life in your spaces, you can add as much mundane life as you wish, as well as any kind of life that you encounter outside normally. For sentient creatures, you can add/create a single member of a sentient species for a single charge. Every charge after that will allow you to increase that population by an order of magnitude for the same species.

While you do not have in-depth control over the population or its members, they are intrinsically loyal and are affected by the properties of the space. You can control the overall affinities and behaviors of the population in a broad sense, such as making them more naturally warlike or more aligned with engineering, etc. A single charge is required for an affinity or broad-scale control.

The population you create may be adults, but they are still newborns. You can make the civilization older by spending additional charges, the first charge granting the population a single year, every charge multiplying it by 10. Depending on how many charges you pour into it, this can allow the space to have its own history, civilizations, etc.

You may create and summon spaces using nothing but your will, but utilizing a medium—such as a detailed map, a diorama, or an architectural model—greatly reduces the cost, depending on the quality and detail of the medium. The medium remains unharmed and serves only as a reference point for your power.

You may use existing media, including works created by others, as inspiration or a template for your spaces, and you can freely alter any details to suit your vision. The reference can be used for appearance, layout, atmosphere, and/or the fantastical properties you wish to include.

You may also spend a single charge to rework or reshape an existing space into something entirely new, although this will not enhance the overall power of the spaces, only allowing you to rewrite and adapt them.

Spaces are naturally separate dimensions—to access these spaces, you can create portals to and from your dimensions from wherever you are, as well as create permanent portals and locations that can be used to access these spaces. Things inside your dimension can also exit through these portals.

You can link your separate spaces at will, linking unlike dimensions with one another. You may also combine separate dimensions as long as each of the dimensions is at least a month old, their total volumes combine, and their total slots also combine, but they will still only continue to accrue one additional slot a month.

While these spaces are separate dimensions, you can also spend 5 charges to instead override an existing location or space in the real world to be the target of your power instead.

The effects of the spaces can be used to synergize and amplify powers and effects, both yours and others' in the spaces.
objects.title: (Shaker/Trump) World Builder

objects.text:
You can run fast—so fast that perception can no longer track you, not even by sight, sound, or enhanced senses. To anyone else, your movement is a gap, a blurless skip in causality itself. You don’t appear to move—you simply vanish from one place and reappear in another, leaving observers struggling to understand the space between. You run this fast by covering absurd distances with every step, leaping across cities in just a few strides, the entire process taking less than 0.001 seconds. These vast strides are supported by your total detachment from terrain—you can run across water, lava, vertical walls, ceilings, or clouds by intuitively making contact to keep pushing off something. You no longer require “ground” in any traditional sense.

Each stride births a concussive shockwave strong enough to level buildings or scatter crowds like paper in a gale. You can dial this force in or out, adjusting the raw kinetic violence of your wake depending on whether you intend to shatter a battlefield or pass like a ghost. Similarly, the sheer friction and momentum of your run allow you to carve through the world—footsteps that cleave pavement, shear stone, and rip trenches into the earth. At your peak, your speed begins to wear against space itself. Running doesn’t just shake the air—it causes gravitational distortions or minor spatial warping.

But the true edge of your power lies in its relentlessness. Once you begin running, your body sustains itself in motion. You don’t tire and don’t need rest, food, or breath. Every step fuels the next in an unbroken kinetic loop, and so long as your feet keep moving, you are self-contained.
objects.title: (Mover) Run Barry, Run

addons.text:
You can now take over existing Parahumans within your activation range, as well as through touch, either through you or through one of your subjects, even outside your activation range.

You no longer need to permanently give up control, or any at all, to empower your subjects. With control over their Shards, you can command the Shard and empower your subjects with the full breadth of their power without giving up control.

Instead, you can willingly give up any control you’d like and/or regain it at will. You can even hide this from your subjects, leaving them completely unaware as to how comprehensive your control is or isn’t.

You can even set it to simply an unbreakable and unshakable loyalty and loosen all other restrictions if you’d like, allowing you wholly independent but loyal subjects to make things simple for yourself.

Rather than an active control, you can have it set to work subconsciously; you are always aware and working in concert alongside it and with yourself, or take direct control over it.

With control over the Shards, you can control connections, reconnect Shards with other subjects and even yourself, alter expressions of powers, and even retain control over the shards even if your subject dies, the Shard is as under your domain as your subjects are.

Your control over a Shard is permanent is as permanent as your control over your subjects and cannot be broken unwillingly.
addons.title: Divine Right

addons.text:
You are no longer limited or required to empower your subject into Parahumans to take control; your power extends to all life that has crossed into your activation range.

You can extend your domain quietly, able to ensnare all within your range and leave them unchanged, only to reveal it much later.

You can choose to empower your subjects later on if you delay empowering them.

You no longer need to give up control to empower others, able to heighten the ability of others without drawback.
addons.title: Absolute Sovereign

addons.text:
Each subject you enthrall can be enhanced by cluster mechanics.

What this means is that you can grant secondary powers for every subject you have to every other subject.

They do not need to be influenced by Cluster mechanics, such as the kiss/kill mechanics; you can apply just the power interaction if you wish.

Their powers do not diminish in capacity at all, instead retaining the same strength as if they were a single trigger, a secondary powers retain the same strength they would have if they were a primary power in a two-man Cluster.
addons.title: Concord Monarchy

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to Master and empower others.

Within a 1km radius surrounding yourself, you have an internal sense of all living things, which serves as a targeting system for your power to empower them.

Within your activation radius, you can immediately trigger anyone, granting them abilities as if they had naturally triggered, matching their psyche, trauma profile, potential, and taking other factors into account.

Those who were already primed to trigger or close to it receive dramatically more powerful abilities. Regardless of their state, all empowered subjects are at least comparable to the average cape, with a few outliers capable of matching top-tier capes.

Those you empower fall fully under your thrall, their loyalty unshakable and their minds seamlessly connected to yours.

Through this flawless mental link, you maintain perfect coordination of their movements, powers, and even their thoughts, no matter how many follow you or how far they roam — once bound, there is no distance limit on your control.

You know every detail of their abilities, every weakness, every strength, and you can coordinate and command them with flawless precision and coordination.

You also possess the ability to empower those under your thrall by loosening your mental grip, dramatically increasing their power in exchange for granting them more freedom. The less control you keep, the more their abilities grow, potentially reaching monstrous scales.

However, this process is irreversible — once you grant them that freedom, you cannot take it back, and they may one day turn those newfound liberties against you.

With every subject you empower, your awareness expands: you sense their locations, their conditions, their intentions, and their loyalty, managing them all as a perfect, unified legion.

You possess a secondary Thinker power designed to give infinite multitasking and awareness of your subjects and all that entails them, able to do all of this with no strain on you.
objects.title: (Master/Trump) Sovereign

objects.text:
Your body generates a kind of extradimensional energy capable of either temporarily nullifying or disrupting Parahuman powers by disrupting their Corona Pollentia and Gemma’s connection to their Shard while being hit with a kinetic output comparable to being struck by lightning. Your usual blasts tamper with a cape’s abilities just a moment; a Regen Brute may have scratches that heal just a bit slower, slow-acting Striker powers, hard-to-shift Changer powers, etc.; this would’ve been your run-of-the-mill Trump power if it weren’t for your Shard’s ability to “moderate” the Network. 

Your energy is the lifeblood of Shardspace, the energy coursing through the virtual space’s landscape, giving shape and form to the lattice used, an energy signature engineered by the Entities to sustain and maintain it without constant Shard maintenance.

This energy is both easy to shape and manipulate while highly unstable; its versatility is almost allusive to Legend, limited both by your energy expenditure and the need to unload your reserves once you reach your limit. Your powers recharge and unload much quicker than a normal cape due to its harmful effects on you the more you keep a lid on it, i.e., burning you from the inside or suffering the power’s effects yourself, to name a few. Owing to its natural function, your energy signature has a glossy crimson color to it, reminiscent of Shards in Shardspace.

Your ease in shaping your energy also helps in concentrating it, condensing and charging your beams that generate a different hue to it: a green gradient of red indicates disruption or nullification of Normal Shard powers; a golden gradient indicates Vital Shard powers; and a deep sangria gradient indicates the disruption/nullification of Noble Shard powers, if only for a few hours. Disrupting or nullifying blasts can be changed at will, like turning up or down the volume.

A lone concentrated blast is enough to disrupt/nullify a group of Parahumans, with a blast above their Tier—blasting a Normal Shard cape with Vital Shard level blasts, for example—might irreparably damage their Shard’s connection, either severing it, damaging their power expression to uncontrollable levels, or a Broken Trigger ending in the parahuman’s death.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Interdiction

objects.text:
You are a Tinker capable of creating intricate, chess piece-like constructs known as Gnosis. They require relatively cheap materials to create, equivalent to a modern PC. You can create up to seven Gnosis at any given time, with each one needing to be unique. If one is destroyed, it can be replaced.

Each Gnosis has two core components: the Mechanism and a Concept. Mechanism refers to the scientific or parahuman principle you engineer into the Gnosis, such as electromagnetism, thermodynamics, gravitation, or more exotic but still grounded forces. You decide when making the Gnosis. Concept, on the other hand, is determined not by you, but by the mindset and belief system of the Gnosis’s user, known as an Archon. As such, it can change with every user.

The Concept acts as a lens, shaping how the Mechanism manifests. For example, a Gnosis with Gravity as its Mechanism and Destruction as its Concept might allow the Archon to generate and control micro black holes. This is only the baseline of its power, the lowest possible expression of its potential, with its full abilities being extremely versatile. This synthesis gives each Gnosis its flavor and function, meaning no two are alike. The effects from different Gnosis can interact and produce emergent effects, unique synergies, or anomalies based on how their Concepts and Mechanisms relate.

Each Gnosis also passively generates weaker constructs called Visions. Visions mirror the Gnosis in both Mechanism and Concept, but are far more limited in scope, usually in the form of partial expressions or stripped-down tools. While Visions can still interact with one another similarly to Gnosis, the effects are weaker. Visions are produced slowly, at a rate of roughly one every one to two weeks. All Gnosis trumps any kind of Vision.

Visions can autonomously fly off to seek a compatible user, guided by the resonance between the construct’s Mechanism and the Archon’s Concept. What this means is that it will find people with the mindset and belief system adjacent or similar to that of the Archon. Upon finding a match, the Vision bonds to that individual.

Besides that, you can also give both Gnosis and Visions to others directly, without needing to care about compatibility for the latter. You can even use them yourself. However, due to being its creator, you cannot create a Concept when using a Gnosis; instead, you have access to every Concept the Gnosis had from past Archons. Be careful, as wielding multiple Visions or, god forbid, Gnosis, especially those with clashing Concepts or Mechanisms, will result in physiological backlash, usually in the form of internal damage or cellular strain. The more conflicting or numerous the constructs, the more severe the toll.
objects.title: (Tinker) Heavenly Principles

addons.text:
Your Shard has extended its reach, weaving its influence across impossible distances. You may now begin the process of overriding an Endbringer’s control matrix from anywhere on the planet. Distance, however, still remains a critical factor in reprogramming time: the farther the Endbringer, the longer the time required to establish complete dominion, with delays stretching into hours for those far beyond your immediate horizon.

Additionally, this act will not go unnoticed as long-distance Endbringer subversion amplifies the signal of your intrusion, allow it to reverberate through the non-subverted Shard Network. Furthermore this is not the only risk as the Endbringer you are trying to subvert will near instantly know your location and will seek to erase your presence. 

However, If done with precision, it remains theoretically possible to complete subversion of a Endbringer before the Endbringer can close the distance, though such gambits demand preparation, calculation, and a willingness to gamble on timing.
addons.title: Long Distance Interface

addons.text:
No longer content with patient corruption, your shard now blends the usurpation protocols of Heresiarch with the overriding directives of the Shard-Controller.

The time required to subvert other shards inside your Shard-Controller range is now drastically reduced, with it needing mere minutes to fully subvert Normal Shards for the purpose of Heresiarch. Simultaneously, regardless of whether their shard was seized through Heresiarch or just Shard-Controller, your influence over Parahumans with subjugated shards also now goes much further.

While still not absolute (and can be lessened or stopped entirely if you wish), these subtle shifts have become majorly profound and can easily shape allegiances, erode enmities, and bend wills toward your cause even in ways that will linger after conscious recognition.
addons.title: A Deeper Infection

addons.text:
Your shard has learned to repurpose the immense processing resources normally devoted to your Endbringers. 

Now every Endbringer slot not filled becomes can become a power slot instead, with your shard reallocating any unused capacity into your personal dominion. Thus, before any Endbringers are created, you begin with 10 power slots. Additionally, this balance is not fixed: You may deliberately reconfigure your sub-network, sacrificing potential power slots to create an equal number of additional Endbringer slots. 

Furthermore, you now begin with five extra subversion slots with no additional cost to the rate in which you gain new subversion slots. The strain on your shard is no greater than before; it simply has learned to distribute its processing more efficiently.
addons.title: Endbringer Load Balancing

objects.text:
The [Cycle] has made a grave mistake and created its own worst enemy: The False Priest, an administrator who discards all rules to falsely claim the throne. Whether driven by a hunger for power, the pursuit of knowledge, or reasons far more alien, your Administrator Shard has chosen to weave its own sub-network, laying the groundwork to usurp the whole and ascend into an [Entity] in its own right.

You may now infect and subvert any Shard across the local multiverse, regardless of distance. Alongside this, you possess a mental archive cataloging every known Shard and its abilities. This archive allows you to near-instantly search for and begin the subversion of nearly any specific power you desire.

However, subversion requires the commitment of a subversion slot, each one acting as a dedicated line of infection. Once a slot is assigned to a target it cannot be redirected until the process is complete. The time required for infection is immediately knowable and scales with the strength, Tier, and esoteric defenses of the desired Shard.

You begin with five subversion slots, and the process is slow: Normal Shards typically take three to seven days to fall, Vital Shards can resist for several weeks, while Noble or otherwise esoteric Shards may hold out for two to four months before the corruption runs too deep to resist.

Once subverted, a Shard and its power may be copied into your power slots at will, with more potent abilities consuming more slots. You begin with three power slots, enough to simultaneously copy the powers of three Normal Shards, or a single Noble Shard.

Additionally, each Shard brought under your dominion also strengthens your network and thus accelerates its growth. A capture of a dozen lesser Shards grants you an additional subversion slot, while power slots grow through the capture of Noble Shards, but with an escalating cost. The first additional power slot requires a single Noble Shard, the next requires two, the next three, and so on, with each expansion demanding more. In this way, there is no true ceiling to the network’s growth, only the increasing complexity of feeding it.

If you possess Negentropy, your infection and subversion protocols adapt and evolve at a much faster rate, allowing even Noble Shards to fall in as little as a month. With Esoteric Knowledge, your network can counterfeit Shardless abilities by dedicating a subversion slot to the task, though this strains the system as though targeting a Shard of that ability’s strength. The upgrade Hecatoncheires grants you infinite power slots, though it does not increase your number of subversion slots.
objects.title: (Trump) Heresiarch

addons.text:
You have unlocked a new level of achieving victory. You can now instantly create any project you set your mind to, bypassing the limitations of materials, processes, and construction time.

At the same time, your size limits for Tinker-Tech have been completely removed, though you still retain an effective range limit of 500 meters from your body. If you wish to create megastructures, you will need to construct them in parts and then assemble them fully.

On the other hand, you can modify your previously created Tinker-Tech in real time. This eliminates the need to duplicate an existing creation just to modify it according to changing needs, as long as your creations remain within your sphere of influence.

Finally, your knowledge as a Tinker is retained even when the problem you were facing has disappeared or you have abandoned a project you were working on. Your knowledge to create, maintain, modify, combine, and use your creations remains intact. It is as stable and refined as that of a true Tinker.
addons.title: Instant Victory

objects.text:
You can create any tinkertech you ask for, ranging from simple tools to continent-shaping superweapons. This power reads your intent, intuitively translating even abstract requests into a tinkertech blueprint tailored to your goal.

For example, it can take prompts such as “An automated assembly line for building tinkertech en masse”, “The optimal weapon to defeat the next enemy I will face” or “Something that ensures humanity’s long-term survival” and it will respond with a practical design.

It can draw upon the entire breadth of technology distributed during a standard Cycle with no restraints, including those that are normally limited or sabotaged in some manner, such as self-replicating nanites and spacefaring or fully autonomous AI.

When focusing on a given tinker project, you gain an innate understanding of its function along with how to build, maintain, repair, and operate it. This insight is tied to your current project; once you shift to a new design, it fades, although you always retain the ability to use and mend anything you’ve already made.

You lack knowledge of the wider “tech tree” behind your devices compared to other tinkers, however, requiring you to consult this power to modify, upgrade, or combine tinkertech. While you understand the full tinkering process and its prerequisites, it also doesn’t help with the logistics of initially gathering materials and so on.
objects.title: (Tinker/Thinker) Tinker to Victory

objects.text: You can fire beams of any color from any part of your body. Depending on the Hue, Saturation, and Luminosity of these beams, they can have different effects and a varying range of power. Hue decides the overall effect; these are primarily elemental effects, such as red burning, cyan freezes, yellow dries, blue transmutes things to water, and so on. But you are not limited to only elemental beams. With time, you can find a Hue for just about any power effect, including things like dimensional shearing, power negation, or healing; this also includes Stilling and Sting, but you're going to have to look for quite some time to find those beams, as your shard (if you have one) has made it inherently hard to find all-or-nothing beam effects. This does not include any permanent power-granting, however. The Saturation of your beams determines what is affected by them, effectively allowing you to shift the Manton Limit of your beams to your whims, so you could make your beams affect only what you want them to, such as only freezing salt water or only burning non-living beings. And finally, the Luminosity of your beams determines how powerful they are, from barely lighting a match on fire to turning skyscrapers to slag and molten glass. Your maximum output is roughly comparable to the Tsar Bomba. You have incredible fine control over the movement of your beams, and you can control their trajectory even after emitting them, allowing you to change their direction or make them fork. The stronger the beam, the harder it is to control its trajectory, to the point that the strongest beams can barely be controlled after being released. While you have a nearly infinite amount of versatility through shifting the Hue of your beams, this power does not come with an innate understanding of what each Hue does.
objects.title: (Blaster/Trump) Disco Ball

addons.text: Your ability to control Endbringers has fused with your ability to copy the power of Endbringers. Now any Endbringers under your control now counts as if you have killed that Endbringer for that Endbringer’s corresponding breaker form. As such, you now gain the full power of any Endbringer under your control when you use its corresponding breaker form. However, if an Endbringer is not fully grown then you only get access to the abilities it currently has.
addons.title: Death is not the only End

addons.text:
Your ability to create Endbringers has synchronized with your ability to copy the powers of Endbringers. Now you gain 1 additional breaker form for every possible endbringer you can make with Endbringer Engine. These additional breaker forms will forever be stuck at their reduced capabilities and powers but can mirror any possible Endbringer you can make. Furthermore, the time to change the information in a possible Endbringer’s breaker form is 1/7th the time it would take you to make an Endbringer with Endbringer Engine.

By default, this means you start with 7 empty hypothetical Endbringer breaker forms with each taking 4 days (1 day with Negentropy) to fill with the reduced abilities of any possible Endbringer.
addons.title: Herald of Hypothetical Endbringers

addons.text: You can now take all the energy generated by your Shard/Endbringer Core and direct it into one of your Endbringer breaker forms. While doing so will leave you unable to access your Core’s enhanced forms or abilities, this will allow you access that breaker form’s full Endbringer power whenever to transform into it. However, you can only change which breaker forms is being feed by your Core once a day.
addons.title: A Core is a Core

objects.text: You can transform into Breaker states corresponding to any Endbringers that have been activated in the Cycle. You start with forms corresponding to Simurgh, Behemoth, and Leviathan, even if they are not activated, and you gain additional Breaker forms as new Endbringers are activated. These forms are half as big with a corresponding halving of the physical attributes as their true Endbringer counterpart but have all their abilities in some form, albeit having vastly reduced range, as your Endbringer abilities only have a range of 3.5 city blocks at most. While you are in one of your Breaker forms, you lose your human senses but gain the Shard Feedback universal upgrade to compensate for this loss of perception. If the Endbringer is deactivated or dies at the hands of anyone but you, you will lose the corresponding Breaker form. But if you kill the Endbringer while you are in the corresponding Breaker form, you absorb the fallen Endbringer's power and take its full might for yourself, without shackling yourself to its directives. You cannot lose the last remaining Breaker form, preventing you from losing all your power, though your versatility would drop heavily.
objects.title: (Breaker/Trump) Herald of the End

addons.text:
Whereas before, the power of your blasts was considered massive, now they far surpass what could be considered absurd.

The sheer energy density of your blasts is sufficient to warp space-time in their vicinity, allowing them to kill capes such as Grey Boy or Alabaster and harm Brutes who have esoteric defenses such as Alexandria.

Moreover, this addon comes with a technique. By condensing a beam into a subatomic line, you can achieve energy densities similar in principle to a Kugelblitz, forming a 1-dimensional line capable of cutting through anything. This has the same rules as other All-or-Nothing effects, with the exception that your power won't go on cooldown when hitting another, simply stopping the blast instead with no other consequences.
addons.title: Rodger! Removing That Direction

addons.text: Your ability to modify your blasts with Handcannon has spread to Buster, allowing you to do things such as sacrificing power to shoot a beam at luminal speeds or, as the name implies, make beams precise enough to cut cookies. This also allows you to cut your beams short, allowing you to fire at full power without worrying about what's behind someone or make a Breaker-like armor of constant blasts.
addons.title: Cookie Cutter

objects.text: "Nothin' but gas." Your Blaster power is rather simple, being that you can release beams comprised of a mix of kinetic and regular light. You can also both 'polarize' and change the wavelength of the kinetic energy and light such that they don't scatter, preventing innocents from being blinded or your beams turning into bombs. But that's all pretty bog-standard for a Blaster power. No, where your power truly shines is the sheer magnitude at which it can operate. Your blasts make Legend look like he wields a squirt gun and can even surpass Scion in pure firepower (at least by a little). Your maximum energy output is sufficient to raze cities and sink islands in an instant, and you could level a country during tea time. You could overpower Behemoth's dynakinesis with nothing but raw firepower, though the surrounding country may not appreciate it. You are able to shape your blasts and beams as they leave you, but you have no control over them after. You also have a Breaker power that prevents your attacks from harming you and a Mover power that lets you both suspend and slow yourself midair. For actual flight, you are able to allow some kickback from your attacks to propel you, similar to a certain distressed damsel. Due to the nature of your shard, you are much more likely to run out of juice mid-Cycle, and unless you have Negentropy, you may notice some weakening similar to Eidolon after a few decades. Unlike him, you shard can 'recharge' itself with idle time, similar to Purity.
objects.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Buster

objects.text: You can permanently copy and internalize abilities by interacting with sources or representations of power. Your ability can replicate the powers and skills of Parahumans, be used on items such as Cauldron vials or the Garden of Eden, and can also be applied to Tinkertech or even mundane objects like smartphones or even normal living things, such as animals or normal humans. Upon interacting with a viable target, your power pings and creates an internal conceptual blueprint of what it can do, feeding that understanding directly to you. From there, you may choose whether or not to internalize your version. You may internalize the full capabilities of a target — such as a Parahuman’s power, skills, and experience, or all the functions of a smartphone or Tinkertech — or take only specific aspects. For example, you could copy only a Parahuman’s power while ignoring their skills. Regardless of what you replicate, your ability internalizes and perfectly adapts it for your use. Replicating a smartphone would grant you a power with all the same functions. Once internalized, the power is fully yours and perfectly adapted. You are not drawing on the original source but instead possess an internal version. This removes inherent drawbacks, incompatibilities, external dependencies, and similar baggage. Powers that relied on external energy sources are generated internally. Psychological or physical damage tied to abilities (such as Burnscar’s) is removed, and you do not inherit weaknesses tied to the original source. You may freely ping any number of potential sources, gaining an intuitive preview of what powers they would provide and how those abilities would behave for you, without committing to a slot. Actually internalizing a new power — generating it into an empty slot — may only be done once per month. You possess nine total power slots, and any replicated power occupies a single slot. You may activate or deactivate any stored power at will, retaining full control over all replicated abilities, including the ability to suppress or disable them entirely. You may drop a power instantly, freeing its slot. That slot may be refilled immediately provided you have not already internalized another power within the current month; otherwise, it remains inert until your monthly internalization refreshes. You may also shave off parts of an ability if desired. You may also transfer any internalized power to another person, permanently granting them that ability. This empties the corresponding slot. Slots emptied this way follow the same rules as voluntary removal. A major strength of this ability lies in its interaction with representations. Rather than requiring direct access to the original source, you may replicate abilities from items or symbolic stand-ins that meaningfully represent something else. This includes supernatural, magical, or superhuman abilities derived from items, symbols, artifacts, depictions, or totems connected to another being or concept. This can range from action figures and video game discs to pictures, drawings, stylized depictions, or other similar proxies. Your ability interprets the representation, constructs the intended power, and offers that version to you for internalization. The representation must be sufficiently connected to what it symbolizes but need not be original or unique. Note that since this is a shard power, it’s an Entity’s closest construction of the ability and not necessarily a genuine replication. Possessing Esoteric Knowledge or being Shardless removes that restriction. All functions of this power may be used freely, except for internalizing abilities, which can only be done once per month. Negentropy/Shardless increases your slots to twelve and reduces your cooldown to one week.
objects.title: (Trump) Iconoclast
(Trump/Brute) Resurrective Trigger
objects.text:
You gain permanent powers every time you die. Upon dying, you will be completely healed and resurrected, with your shard calling upon another shard and requesting information on what power they would have given a host if they were forced to treat said death as a trigger event. Your shard will then take that powerset and give it to you permanently.

You will always get a proper power, no matter how you die. Powersets you get will always be within the normal variation of strength that parahumans have, with the amount of powers you have bearing no effect on where within this variation a power you get will be. The only diminishing returns you may run into are powers having overlap in their capabilities and uses, especially if you're dying in very similar ways.

objects.title: (Stranger/Master) Masquerade
objects.text: At any point in time you can jump into anyone that you know of’s body and take over their lives at will. This isn’t a mere matter of an imposter but you actually taking over the mind, body, and life of the person you’re taking over, and then living it for them. While you’ve taken over them, you’ll have full access to their minds, their memories, their behaviors and can perfectly mimic them and their thought processes without effort, no one the wiser of your true nature. If your target is a Parahuman, you’d even be able to use any abilities they posses at the same skill level, if not greater. You have two methods of taking over someone’s body, you may do so immediately by touch, in which case your body disappears immediately and you take over theirs, or you take over anybody’s body, regardless of where they are by going to sleep. You do not need to know any details of your target beyond a vague target parameter, something like a name, alias, face, or even qualifier like will suffice and your power will choose the intended or otherwise perfect target for you. Upon falling asleep your body will disappear, and as long as your target then falls asleep within the next 72 hours, the next time they awaken it’ll be you. If they do not fall asleep within that time frame, whether they’re a Noctis cape is and don’t need to and didn’t want to, or a regular human who’s fought off sleep through pure stubbornness, your body would have disappears for those 72 hours, and dematerialize where it disappeared with no memory in between. You may use whatever abilities you otherwise possess when taking over someone’s body, although a host’s body’s own abilities will not carry back to you after you leave. You may also choose to jump between one body to another rather than going back to your own first. You may stay in another body for as long as you wish, up to and including their entire lifespan and their death, although you will then be forced back out into your body. You will not age while you’re inhabiting other bodies, meaning you could continuously jump between bodies as a form of immortality. During the entire duration, and after, the host will remember and believe all actions to be entirely of their own doing. When leaving a body, you may either materialize yourself back to where you dematerialized first, or to a new location you’re aware of; or you can simply walk out of the body at will.

objects.title: (Trump/Thinker) Animus
objects.text:
Your mind possesses a simulation engine capable of constructing and experiencing entire lives.

Whenever you choose a target, whether an original character of your own creation, a real person, or even a fictional one, your power constructs a complete, internally consistent history surrounding them. 

If aspects of that history are unknown, contradictory, or could never have existed, your power seamlessly fills in the gaps with a believable sequence of events that produces the individual you intended. Every relationship, triumph, failure, education, trauma, accomplishment, and defining moment necessary to shape that person is created and woven together into a coherent lifetime.

If you target an existing person this can and will show their actual past rather than construction. 

When you sleep, enter a trance, or otherwise consciously engage your power, you begin Synchronizing with that individual.

You do not merely observe their life. You become them.

You experience their memories from a first-person perspective, living through the moments that defined who they became while your power naturally compresses uneventful periods of their life. Months, years, or even decades of experience may pass over the course of a single night, allowing you to live entire lifetimes in only days or weeks of real time while preserving every lesson, emotion, relationship, and hardship that made those experiences meaningful.

As Synchronization progresses, the Bleeding Effect begins.
The skills, instincts, reflexes, knowledge, talents, muscle memory, emotional intelligence, habits, personality traits, and even supernatural abilities of your chosen character gradually become your own. Unlike simple memory transfer, these capabilities are not copied but genuinely internalized through lived experience. 

Every language is one you remember learning. Every martial art is one you remember practicing for years. Every scientific breakthrough is one you remember working toward. Every supernatural ability is one you remember discovering, experimenting with, refining, and mastering throughout the course of that life.

Upon reaching complete Synchronization, everything that individual possessed becomes fully integrated into your own identity. Their experiences become your experiences, their expertise becomes your expertise, and any powers they possessed become as natural to you as they were to them. These abilities remain permanently internalized, allowing you to move on to Synchronizing with another character without losing what you have already gained.

The Bleeding Effect’s negative psychological side effects are not an inevitable consequence of experiencing multiple lives, but rather the result of incomplete or interrupted Synchronization. 

Beginning too many characters simultaneously, abandoning one midway through their life, or repeatedly switching between partially synchronized identities causes multiple unfinished personalities and memories to compete within your mind. 

This can lead to intrusive memories, emotional instability, confusion regarding your own past, dissociation, hallucinated recollections, and, in severe cases, psychotic episodes as your mind struggles to reconcile several incomplete identities at once.

These effects naturally resolve as Synchronization is completed. Fully synchronized lives no longer compete with your own identity, instead becoming seamlessly integrated into who you are. An experienced user can therefore avoid all long-term psychological consequences simply by pacing themselves and completing one Synchronization before beginning another.

You are not limited to inheriting only skills and powers. Because you genuinely live these lives, you may choose to permanently adopt aspects of your synchronized identities into your own. Confidence, discipline, charisma, patience, compassion, creativity, determination, emotional resilience, habits, preferences, mannerisms, and even aspects of personality can all be consciously retained if desired, allowing you to deliberately shape the person you become over time rather than merely collecting abilities.

Whether your target is an entirely original creation, a historical figure, a living individual, or a fictional character, your power always constructs whatever history is necessary to make their life internally coherent, allowing you to experience it in full before ultimately making it a part of yourself.

rows.title: Tier 3 Powers
rows.titleText: These powers are definitely stronger than an Endbringer. They probably won't allow you to fight an Entity mano a mano, but they will definitely give you a much better chance.

rows.title: Shard Upgrades & Fusions
rows.titleText: These powers upgrade existing powers (or multiple powers of the same lineage) into a more powerful form.

objects.text: Your Endbringer can see every possible future, with the entities as the only blind spot.
objects.title: Precognition

objects.text: Your Endbringer can control any inanimate matter within 10 miles and is powerful enough to lift every building in a city simultaneously, and fine enough to send a needle through a person's eye.
objects.title: Telekinesis

objects.text: Your Endbringer can control the Earth. They can cause Earthquakes, throw boulders, or just lift the earth below a city and flip it upside down.
objects.title: Earth

objects.text: Your Endbringer can copy the power of any Parahuman you know exists or existed. You can have the powers of 3 Parahumans copied at a time. This cannot copy the powers of people who have had their powers permanently lost.
objects.title: Copy

objects.text: Your Endbringer can speed or slow time by up to 10000% anywhere within a mile. They can mix and match this as you like.
objects.title: Time

objects.text: Your Endbringer can alter gravity anywhere within ten miles. They can make the gravity of an area equal to that of the surface of the sun, though that might start to destroy the planet, so please don't have them do that.
objects.title: Gravity

objects.text: Your Endbringer can control the minds of any Parahuman that has been within 5 miles of them for over 10 minutes. Your Endbringer has to actively activate the timer and there is a signifier to everyone in their range that this is happening.
objects.title: Mind-Control

objects.text: Your Endbringer can summon corrupted heroes from the Throne of Heroes to fight for them. Some heroes can fight the corruption, but they are few and far between. They can summon no more than ten of these corrupted heroes at a time.
objects.title: Summoning

objects.text: Your Endbringer has control over all of the elements within three miles of them. These elements are fire, water, air, and earth, not the ones on the periodic table.
objects.title: Vaatu

objects.text: Your Endbringer can redirect any energy that comes in contact with them, if they are aware of it coming. This includes kinetic energy.
objects.title: Dynakinesis

objects.text: Your Endbringer is moderately faster than the other Endbringers.
objects.title: Flash

objects.text: Your Endbringer is moderately stronger than the other Endbringers.
objects.title: Saitama

objects.text: Your Endbringer has the ability to build and manipulate small minions that resemble itself. The control will be total, and they can make up to a hundred of them. The less minions created, the stronger each will be. A singular one will be as powerful as a strong brute, however, if the number of minions is limited to one, it will become comparable to an Endbringer's strength. The inferior minions are made from flesh, with fewer of them resulting in stronger and more durable creations made of a similar crystalline material that Endbringers are made of. Your Endbringer can transmit their other abilities through their minions, and determine if their minions should act on their own utilizing the intelligence of a dog, or direct them personally.
objects.title: Minion

objects.text:
Within 3 miles your Endbringer can resurrect the dead as revenants, bringing them under its control and making them immortal, no matter the state of the corpse it can be brought back with all damage being healed, if the corpse is in multiple pieces multiple revenants can be made from it. No matter the damage a revenant always comes back, the worse the injury the longer it takes to heal and resurrect, a tiny cut takes 1 second to heal, and complete annihilation of the body takes 1 minute for the body to be remade.

Revenants have all the memories from when they were alive but no attachment to them, only using them to follow the commands of your Endbringer to the best of their ability.

Your Endbringer can use its senses and communicate telepathically to issue commands, being able to talk with all of its revenants simultaneously. Together with this, your Endbringer has an instinctive understanding of whether a revenant does or does not have a power and what it is.
objects.title: Neverending Army

objects.text: Your Endbringer can “randomly” alter the structure or forms of all matter and energy within 5 miles. This can be used for destructively distorting the environment around you through the massive and continuous deconstruction and reconstruction of matter, organic or not, creating utter pandemonium.
objects.title: Transmutation

objects.text: Your Endbringer causes nearby Parahumans across half a mile from you to increasingly lose their grasp and strength of their powers, leaving them vulnerable, while you weaken their powers by interrupting the Parahumans’ connection to their Shards and redirecting their reserves to them, bolstering your Endbringer.
objects.title: Drain

objects.text: Your Endbringer can utilize adjacent dimensions or dimensional phenomena around 5 miles. Offensively, they can throw waves or spheres of seeming matter-annihilating energy, which are truly dimensional rifts capable of shunting matter and energy around dimensions; defensively, they could shunt any Blaster or Shaker attack to another dimension by spontaneously creating a force-field rift between the aggressor and your Endbringer.
objects.title: Dimension

objects.text:
Your Endbringer has full control over its own flesh, able to reshape it into nearly any form it can visualise. 

This includes creating numerous prehensile whips, spikes and razor-sharp claws as well as modifying its physical properties, such as shifting colours for camouflage, increasing the flesh’s elasticity or transforming into a flowing, liquid mass. Its precision is sufficient to accurately imitate objects, animals and human beings alike.

It can expand or contract its overall size in a moment by rapidly generating or removing flesh at will. This ranges from being as small as a basketball to up to fifty times the volume of its standard Endbringer form. Its overall durability remains the same regardless of its current size or shape.
objects.title: Shapeshifter

objects.text:
Your Endbringer can analyze and adapt to any phenomena it directly encounters.

The time required to analyze and adapt is shown via a noticeable timer. Once your Endbringer has taken an attack and begun analyzing it, the timer will visibly progress through a cycle. Upon completion, it will adapt significantly to the phenomenon in question.

The more complex or powerful a phenomena is, the more cycles it will take to achieve immunity; basic attacks are resolved in a few cycles while esoteric phenomena would need more. Repeated exposure during the analysis process further reduces the time needed.

Adaptations can be defensive, such as increased resistance & regeneration, supplementary, like enhanced perception, or offensive in nature, augmenting its existing abilities or manifesting entirely new powers tailored against the specific target(s) it is fighting.

There’s no limit on accrued adaptations, but it can only adapt to one phenomenon at a time. Perfect All-or-Nothing powers like Sting cannot be directly countered (i.e. immunity, negation etc) but partial protection via indirect adaptations is feasible.

You can equip your dolls with clothes, armor, weapons and accessories when creating them.

(limited to non-tinker designs and materials unless you are a Tinker, then you will need to build the object once before it can be used)

objects.text: You can summon Tinkertech dolls build with the available specializations. It takes significantly more time to design a pattern than for a normal doll. At their core, the dolls have a component that allows you to control them with your power, if it is destroyed the doll will stop working. You can repair a Tinker doll while it's inactive.
objects.title: Internals

objects.text: You are able to focus some of your powers through your dolls. For example, you can fire Blaster powers, use Striker powers, project a force-field, use empathic vision, etc. However, the dolls themselves do not have the power so Brute, Changer, or Breaker powers that are self-targeted like Deadpool, Phase, and Bowser will not work.
objects.title: Conduit

objects.text: Your enchantment power can be used on your dolls to grant them powers.
objects.title: Recipient

objects.text: Your dolls each have 25 points to load powers into. You must already have summoned these powers for yourself to use them in your dolls.
objects.title: Aliena Slots

objects.text: Your dolls each have 3 pattern slots, you can load patterns from Prototype into theses slots.
objects.title: Prototype Slots

objects.text: Your Network Hub allows you to share your powers to your dolls. This overcomes the limit of standard power-sharing and allows your dolls to use Brute, Breaker, and Changer powers. However, as dolls as non-biological, some powers will not work even with this.
objects.title: Network Extension

objects.text: You are able to give powers to your dolls with Manager. Each doll can have at most three powers.
objects.title: Doll Management

objects.text: Your dolls can now be up to 250cm in height.
objects.title: Large Dolls

objects.text: Your dolls can now be up to 600cm in height.
objects.title: Huge Dolls

objects.text: Your dolls can now have non-humanoid forms. You are still limited by what can be constructed from rigid materials.
objects.title: Expanded Forms

addons.text: Your Artificer power can be used in the construction of the dolls to improve the body or give them special abilities.
addons.title: Artifice

addons.text: You dolls need a core to for Recipient or Prototype to work.
addons.title: Core

addons.text: You can now design and create dolls that imitate your non-tinker powers just as you could build normal tinkertech. This also allows you to create Tech Doll clones of other superpowered people whose powers you study. Now while you still can't fully recreate their powers perfectly, you can create dolls that have several imitated powers at once up to 3 per doll.
addons.title: Action Figures

objects.text:
Instead of summoning dolls you have to build them. This gives you the knowledge of how to build dolls out of mundane materials. If you pick multiple doll tinker specialties they will synergize together.

You are no longer limited in size. Beware of the square-cube law.
objects.title: Builder

objects.text: Instead of building mundane dolls you have a secondary Tinker power to build clockwork automata dolls. If you selected Weapons and Equipment your specialty includes those as well.
objects.title: Automata

objects.text: Instead of building mundane dolls you have a secondary Tinker power to build android dolls. If you selected Weapons and Equipment your specialty includes those as well.
objects.title: Androids

objects.text: You can control only 5 dolls
objects.title: Quality

objects.text: You can control 20 dolls
objects.title: Quantity

objects.text: (This option is a worse deal than the Doll General upgrade, take at your own risk.)
objects.title: +9 DP -27 SP

objects.text:
Your shard’s restrictions on the range of your powers have loosened significantly. This upgrade expands the range of your powers to encompass the whole metropolitan centre of a city, covering an area roughly equivalent to the city proper of Brockton Bay.

For instance, if you could detect and amplify guilt within a 30-meter radius, this power would now span the entirety of an urban municipality. This upgrade also includes a boost to your mind so you can effectively utilise your new range.

Depending on the powers enhanced by this, your shard may rapidly run out of energy if you overuse this extra range. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy or Shardless.
objects.title: Mr. Citywide

objects.text:
Your shard’s restrictions on the range of your powers have loosened exponentially further. This upgrade considerably extends your range, enabling your powers to affect an area up to that of a medium-sized country. This area would be roughly comparable to Poland, Côte d'Ivoire or the US state of New Mexico in terms of coverage.

For example, if you previously had a 5-meter-wide healing aura, you could now potentially cure an entire nation through this power. This upgrade also includes a boost to your mind so you can effectively utilise your new range.

Depending on the powers enhanced by this, your shard may rapidly run out of energy if you overuse this extra range. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy or Shardless.
objects.title: Mr. Countrywide

objects.text: Have a power that has a limited range? Well, worry no more! With this here, you can extend your range to a planetary level. You were originally only able to sense and control water within a 5-meter radius? With this, you can now sense and control ALL the water on the planet. You could only teleport within a 4-meter range? Now, you can teleport into Alexandria’s bedroom. This comes with a free boost to your mind to be able to utilize your new range. Depending on the powers enhanced by this, your shard may rapidly run out of energy if you overuse this extra range. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy/Shardless.
objects.title: Mr. Worldwide

addons.text:
You have no range limit, no place you cannot reach. Your ability extends to the far reaches of the universe, to the strangest depths of the multiverse, and even beyond that. You can even go forward where no Entity has gone before, and leave the threshold of the multiverse behind and see what lies beyond its barriers.

Regardless of what powers are enhanced by this, your shard can and will drain rapidly if pushed to its extremes. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy/Shardless.
addons.title: To Infinity And Beyond!

addons.text:
Your abilities can now operate at the tiniest level. From utilizing your striker powers on atoms, shaker powers on quarks, or perhaps even use your thinker powers to observe quantum foam itself. Who knows what you may discover at these small scales, perhaps even the answer to the secret the Entities have long been searching for is hidden there, ignored and undiscovered because they never bothered to look at something so small.

And you may go even beyond that, scale down infinitely as if observing a fractal, there may be secrets to find even beyond that. 

Your own multitasking is improved to now scale up infinitely, allowing you to utilize your powers at any scale with no more strain than it would have to be used normally. 

You can freely scale your range up and down to normal limits and up down to your maximum and minimum and anywhere in between. 

Regardless of what powers are enhanced by this, your shard can and will drain rapidly if pushed to its extremes. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy/Shardless.
addons.title: And Down Below

addons.text:
Your abilities have removed the distinction of space and time altogether, you can now affect the past, present, and future with no more effort than a simple usage of your abilities would have afforded you in the present. 

This allows you an incredibly wide range of possibilities, from utilizing your thinker abilities to collect information from the future to sending blasts to destroy enemies in the past.
addons.title: Past, Present, Future

objects.text: Your range is far wider, extending your abilities range to the entirety of the universe. This does not amplify your powers to cross dimensional boundaries, however abilities that already cross dimensions will be able to access the full scale of those as normal. You can freely scale your range down to normal limits and up to your maximum and anywhere in between. Depending on the powers enhanced by this, your shard may rapidly run out of energy if you overuse this extra range. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy/Shardless.
objects.title: Mr. Universe

objects.text: Your range is far deeper, allowing you to cross dimensions. You can now extend your abilities to access the multiverse, although you’re still limited in accessing it to the traditional 3D space range of Mr.Worldwide. You can freely scale your range down to normal limits and up to your maximum and anywhere in between. Depending on the powers enhanced by this, your shard may rapidly run out of energy if you overuse this extra range. This does not apply if taken with Negentropy/Shardless.
objects.title: Mr. Multiverse

objects.text: Your powers gain Trump aspects, tailored to the needs of each of the powers in question. For example maybe your Brute powers become better equipped to defend against other powers, your Blaster powers could become better equipped to pierce the effects of other powers, or your Tinker powers might become better at studying other powers making tech that mimics, or manipulates them in minor to moderate ways.
objects.title: [TRIUMPHANT]

objects.text: What can affect organics but not inorganics can now affect both, what is weakened in the presence of living beings now isn't, what can't teleport something to inside something else now can, for your powers never gained the shackles called Manton Limit.
objects.title: Bypass

addons.text:
What your powers can affect slowly expands to include similar things and may even develop new ways to interact with them, the stronger the new targets and interactions are the longer they take to come. As a example, (Master/Thinker) Confetti could gain the capacity to control paper itself, and later acquire the capacity to separate and meld paper, later would be able to increase the durability and sharpness of your paper.

Use of yours powers will make those expansions come faster.
addons.title: Unshackled

objects.text: Your powers have what they can affect expanded; more specifically, if you have a power that can only affect others, it can now affect you and if you have a power that can only affect you, now it can affect others. Of course, those new targetings still use the same vectors as the original ones, so if you want to use Panacea on yourself, you would need to do something like touching your face with your hand.
objects.title: New Target Acquired

objects.text: Any and all of the creature you control has a weakened version of all your powers, with the exception of whatever power you are using to control them.
objects.title: A Master’s Servant

addons.text:
All creatures controlled by you can be given equal versions of any of your powers including the one used to control them, or you can have them possess a different expression instead. 

If they in turn control another, that creature will also be affected and receive the controlling power, and so on down the line. This creates a chain where each creature can pass on the power to control others. 

While the powers can be extended indefinitely, there is a hierarchy of sorts where powers of the previous generation supersede newer generations, ensuring they cannot override their benefactors even if their powers are otherwise identical.
addons.title: A Master’s Equal

addons.text: Each successive generation can have more potent abilities than their benefactors, although the previous generations still supersede newer generations in terms of Hierarchy.
addons.title: The Master’s Protector

addons.text:
Not only does every generation improve upon the last, but every new addition in turn improves the previous generations. 

Every enhancement, improvement, alternate expressions, and other alterations from every member is passed along to their benefactor all the way to you, the progenitor. 

Every new creature empowers their master, every new generation following it even more so, and this traces all the way back to you. 

If you possess Inheritable you can share copies of your perks with your servants, although each previous generation still supersedes the newer one as with powers.

If you possess Heir to the Throne, you may improve their abilities further as if each successive generation was a beneficiary of Heir to the Throne from their progenitor. 

Once a creature falls under your power, how they grow does not matter. Whether they utilize their powers to gain new members, whether they create fantastical beast from scratch, or whether they simply reproduce and have children as a regular human would, all of their line will trace their connection back to you. 

You are The Master, The Progenitor, The Elder.
addons.title: The Elder

objects.text:
Now, when you control a creature, it not only obeys you but also gains a weakened version of the power you use to control it. If this creature then controls another, the next creature receives an even weaker version of that power. By the third generation, the power is so diminished that it no longer gets passed on. 

In other words, your control can spread to a few levels of creatures, but the further down the chain it goes, the weaker the power becomes, until it eventually fades out. This allows you to extend your influence for a limited number of steps, creating a short-lived network of control that gradually loses strength with each new creature in the chain.
objects.title: A Master’s Inheritance

objects.text: The closer to dying you are, the stronger your minions will be, with them loosing this boost when you no longer are in critical condition. If you die, minions/projections will gain a permanent boost and become autonomous, no longer needing you to exist and not only they will go after those who killed you to enact revenge, but will also seek to do any plans you had before your death. Completing your plans has a higher priority over revenge if the revenge has a high chance of messing up those plans.
objects.title: I Hope It Haunts You

addons.text: Your master powers now have their minion limit increased daily instead of a one time increase.
addons.title: Addition

addons.text: Now your Minions are vectors for your ability to generate new minions, allowing you to add an additional amount of minions per day per minion already created.  You also have greater control over their expression, allowing you to alter their appearance and overall effect.
addons.title: Multiplication

objects.text:
For every purchase any master or master-like power that generates a minion will have their limit increased by 1.

For powers that generates (a) minion(s) — like (Master) Specter —it’ll allow you to generate 1 more. If it operates on generating minions based on resources, you’ll be able to generate 1 more minion with the same amount of resources.

For powers that grow over time such as (Master) Hive Mind it’ll allow you to create 1 more per day. 

For powers that operate on slots such as (Trump) Faerie Queen or mastering a limited amount of minions, it’ll allow you one more. 

If your master power(s) has a limited range or duration, it’s doubled with every purchase. If you possess a master or master like power without a range limit or limited duration, all your master and master like powers lose their range and duration limits.
objects.title: Minions

objects.text:
Anyone you used a Master power on is unable to fight your control or act against you, this can even bypass things like truth serums or a master effect.

Someone you took control of using (Master) Khepri can no longer attack you after they leave your range, someone you cloned using (Master) Cloning is unable to tell others what your power is, the thought not even coming to them.

Thinker abilities also benefit, thought in a different way, growing through exposure to something until it can be used for or against it. A thinker power that enhances your senses would allow you to hear the steps of someone who can cancel sounds if the canceled sound was something you could've heard if that person didn't have that power and you "heard" it for some time. Precognition wouldn't sputter and die if a impossible variable happened, instead restarting until the variable stops being impossible to it.
objects.title: The Enemy Didn't Ascend Beyond Your Control

objects.text:
You have unlimited slots for copied, stolen, and created powers, or rather you no longer need slots for said powers. You can use as many as you want simultaneously, you are no longer restricted on how many you can store or use. This also extends to any charges or other resources that your powers builds up over time, you can now store an unlimited amount.
