For powers such as Legion of Fae or (Trump) Power Seed that reduces your power to use them simultaneously, each power can now be used at 100%.

For powers such as Celestial Artificer or (Trump/Tinker) Artificer with enchantment caps, the caps are removed. You can place as many as you want/have charges for.
objects.title: Hecatoncheires

objects.text:
For every purchase, any power that produces and/or uses any kind of internal resources or has limited uses, whether in a specific form has that resource doubled. 

Any power that produces and/or uses any kind of internal resources, or has a limited number of usages by a certain metric, has that total amount increased. 

Whether it be a mana pool, a limited number of uses in a specific time frame, charges, or other kind of metric, they’re all affected. 

Moreover the regeneration speed of the resources remain the same, so powers that would regenerate from empty to full in 24 hours would still take no more than 24 hours. 

Every purchase increases the resources and uses by 100%. This is not multiplicative. If you purchase this 10 times, it will increase by 1000%.

For example, after 1 purchase, (Trump) Prototype will have 20 (30 with negentropy) charges a day.
objects.title: Charged

objects.text: Charged is now multiplicative, each purchase doubling the amount of charges you would get.
objects.title: Doubled

objects.text:
Any power that has a recharge time, time limit, or time requirements, or other time based factors has them either halved or doubled, whichever is more beneficial for each individual aspect of a power. 

For example, powers with a resource pool such as mana will regenerate twice as fast, powers that mutate or evolve will do so in half the time, powers that rely on charges regenerate them in half the time, powers that can debilitate enemies for a certain timeframe can do so for twice as long, etc.

Each purchase again halves or doubles the time factor again. 

For every purchase of this upgrade any power that has a recharge time or time limit halves or doubles the time respectively.
objects.title: Overclocked

addons.text: Now all of your creations will benefit from “A Master’s Servant,” even if they are not actively controlled, and every training and new advancement they make using your powers will be automatically inherited by your own original version.
addons.title: Ancestral Power

addons.text: Now “I Hope It Haunts You” will activate in reverse as well, granting you a boost after every creation of yours is in critical condition and even a permanent boost if they are killed and/or destroyed. The boost will scale based on your minion’s relative power level compared to yours, so the destruction of your most powerful creature would grant you a major boost, but a swarm meant for surveillance would only grant a minor boost.
addons.title: Wrath of the Creator

objects.text:
You become the manifestation of the greatest attributes of your creations. This upgrade creates a link between you and all of your creation’s through master, tinker or other similar powers, and if they have attributes or powers beyond your own, you will be brought up to their level. This will make you equal to your strongest creations.

For this power to activate, you must be the primary contributor to the creation of said being, but it is still possible for others to assist as long as you are responsible for at least 51% of the procedure. You can inherit any attributes and powers, but only permanent ones will be retained (even after your creation is killed and/or destroyed), with any temporary boosts or powers remaining as long as they are active on the user you are inheriting them from. Any powers you have duplicates for will be combined to have the best of their features, with incompatible versions becoming separate powers you can call upon. 
This link will also appear on beings sufficiently modified and/or remade by yourself, even if you are not their original creator.

With Negentropy or Shardless, your restrictions on what counts as your creation will lessen, making you capable of forming links with beings made through automations or even by your own creations as long as they can be traced back to you as their “ancestor”.
objects.title: Best of my Own

objects.text:
Each of your powers gain a new master component, the ability to summon minions to express your powers through.

This allows you to summon minions to use your powers, whether in full or a portion, in your stead. 

Whether it being to summon a minion that harbors a tinker power that you can then set to operate building things for you, or whether you’re utilizing (Trump) Eidolon and choose to create a minion that is harboring one of the powers that you would normally use.

The powers, slots, resources, and other aspects are allocated to the minion while they use it, so you’d have no access to it unless you reclaim it, but they do share the properties they would have as if you still held them.

You can manifest, shape, and alter your minions however you wish, and can combine as many powers as you want, or divide them by their components. You can create as many minions as there are aspects of your powers.
objects.title: Master: Minion

objects.text:
Your Striker powers, be they touch-based or melee ranged, have now also developed a Shaker aspect if possible.

This means your Striker powers can be freely projected over a distance rather than being limited to touch or close quarters. Striker powers which initially possessed some form of limited range component will have this factor significantly enhanced while touch-based Striker powers will develop a ranged component.

The new maximum distance or area these powers can affect depends on the power. Striker powers with a small melee range aspect have their maximum range limit multiplied by 100 or expanded up to 100 feet, whichever distance is greater. If the Striker power is touch-based, it can gain a ranged aspect that either: a) matches the maximum range the power had via touch, or b) operates up to within 100 feet of yourself, whichever distance is greater. Standard Manton Limits still apply unless otherwise stated.
objects.title: Striker → Shaker

objects.text:
One of your powers has essentially tripled, now composed of the original, its opposite, and an alternate expression — these new aspects are equal in strength to the original. The alternate expression can be basically anything as long as it stays on theme with the original. The opposite expression doesn't need to be a 1:1 reversal, so Fire Creation wouldn't necessarily lead to Ice Deletion, it could be Slowness Creation instead.

As an example, (Mover) Stamina could acquire the capacity to make those in a small area around you extremely tired by using its opposite while its alternate would give you the ability to use a powerful but ephemeral boost that needs to be recharged every couple of minutes.

Each selection allows you to apply it to one more power. This only affects the exact power you apply it to, so for something like (Trump) Idle Manifestation it would apply to Idle Manifestation itself, not the powers it gives.
objects.title: Newton's Third Law (One Power)

objects.text:
All of your powers — including temporary ones — have essentially tripled, now composed of the original, their opposite, and an alternate expression — these new aspects are equal in strength to the original. The alternate expression can be basically anything as long as it stays on theme with the original. The opposite expression doesn't need to be a 1:1 reversal, so Fire Creation wouldn't necessarily lead to Ice Deletion, it could be Slowness Creation instead.

As an example, (Mover) Stamina could acquire the capacity to make those in a small area around you extremely tired by using its opposite while its alternate would give you the ability to use a powerful but ephemeral boost that needs to be recharged every couple of minutes.
objects.title: Newton's Third Law (All Powers)

objects.text: With every selection you can add one more Alternate or Opposite expression into your power(s).
objects.title: More Expressions

objects.text:
Any power that copies or creates powers will now give you the option to instead gain the power one Trigger Event higher. If you take this option, the newly developed power or power copied from someone who has only triggered once will work as if they were it was the Second Trigger version of that power. Any power copied from someone who has a Second Trigger could work as if the original user had gone through the hypothetical third trigger, and so on.

Any power that goes through this second or third trigger will gain new features and upgraded potential at the cost of putting a heavier power strain on the shard that the power comes from. For example, removing a touch-based power's Manton Limit on touch while enforcing other of the power's aspects as a offset.
objects.title: Second Sight

addons.text:
Your power now has an infinite [ARCHIVE] of every possible and potential power, component, combinations, fusions, variations, and expressions.

This comes with a number of secondary thinker powers to manage this. 

The first is [PARSE], the ability to immediately parse through your archive to find exactly what you’re looking for, subconsciously aware of any possibilities and able to bring it up to the forefront for use.

The second is [INTUIT], the ability to intuitively understand any blueprint, power, etc on an instinctive level, as well as a perfecting your ability to replicate other powers/effects through your existing powers, becoming effortless and seamless. 

This allows you the ability to intuit every detail, quirk, and application of a power you either possess or come across, as well as its underlying nature and features, in addition to granting natural and effortless control over any power you possess or otherwise encounter. 

This also makes you an incredible teacher, capable of understanding any ability you encounter and helping them uncover new applications, as well as providing you insight into possible weaknesses against enemies.  

As before, this provides the blueprints and information needed to build powers/abilities for power creation power, it doesn’t reduce the cost of producing the power.
addons.title: Catalogue

objects.text:
Your power will now automatically catalogue any powers that come within a 100 meter radius of you, recording its blueprint. 

This will allow you to subconsciously know how you can replicate a power, its effects, and/or its principles using your own existing abilities, such as using a shaker power that could feasibly reproduce the effect of someone’s blaster power. 

In the event you possess a power that allows you to replicate and/or produce powers, it will give your power a mental blue print to build the power and its principles, allowing you to use it as a basis to start with, although the resources needed to make the power would have to be spent as normal. You can also use this to branch out into other expressions or possible powers. 

If your power allows you to replicate and/or copy a power, your power can now do so at will as it would as if they were present, even if they aren’t, using the mental blueprint in its stead.

The range will begin at a minimum of 100 meters. But it also allows you to piggyback off the range and vectors of any powers you possess to enhance this, including powers that operate on line of sight or have a range greater than 100 meters, potentially extending it significantly.
objects.title: Shard Automation

addons.text: Your host has lost any control over any power they had. Now? As their shard it’s all under your control. They don’t have a say in it.
addons.title: Auto Shard

objects.text:
You have become your master power, bound intrinsically to another being. This transformation grants you all the abilities and forms that your mastered subjects once possessed, but at the cost of being permanently linked to another individual.

You share a constant telepathic link, allowing for seamless communication and an awareness of each other's thoughts, emotions, and intentions. However, this bond comes with a physical limitation: you are unable to stray beyond a certain range, determined by the extent of your master power's influence. For example, if you have (Master/Thinker) Confetti, the you would possess all scraps of paper smaller than a square inch within 100 meters of your partner, no more than that.

Despite this tether, you retain a significant degree of autonomy. Your relationship with your partner is more akin to that of Manton and the Siberian—instead of Skitter's control over her swarm, where her will dominates and directs, your bond is a two-way street, with both you and your partner contributing equally to your shared power. If your partner dies, you die too.
objects.title: The Minion

objects.text:
By learning and practicing, you can turn any temporary powers you have into permanent ones. As the temporary powers are learnt and practiced, they will “stick” as a massively weakened version first, which can grow up to the level of the original temporary power. This will also work on others if you can grant temporary powers and also want them to be able to.

The time and effort required are based on the generic power level of the temporary power, with a Tier 0 taking a few days’ worth of dedicated effort, a Tier 1 taking about a few weeks, a Tier 2 about a few months, and a Tier 3 taking up several years.

This will also work on slot-based powers, so powers like (Trump/Striker) Endow could grant a sixth power if somebody learnt one of the previously granted ones. Or you would get your points refunded with (Trump) Aliena if you managed to master one of the summoned powers.
objects.title: Learned Permanence

objects.text:
A profound insight has occurred by expanding your connection to your powers, bestowing you with a potent secondary mental ability for all your powers.

You now possess complete sensory awareness across the entire scope and range of your powers, rather than being limited to your normal senses or your abilities' standard sensory feedback. This is to the extent of matching a shard's full perceptive capability concerning your powers and their interactions.

This resulting heightened perception allows for an unparalleled degree of insight and precision over your powers. For instance, if you can control gravity within a 50-metre radius, you would have full real-time awareness of all gravitational forces and interactions within that range, down to the atomic level.

This does not grant you an awareness of factors beyond what is related to your powers nor directly improve your powers themselves. For example, if you had a Thinker power that allowed you to see visions of the future, you would not gain senses like X-Ray Vision or see further into the future but you could perceive every visionary detail with nigh-absolute clarity.

Despite this vast influx of information, your mind is adapted to effortlessly process it without risk of overload or distraction. You may lower this sensory input, selectively filter it or turn it off entirely. If your powers already provide a level of enhanced perception and awareness it is improved to match the level of detail, range and ease of use that you would gain through this upgrade.
objects.title: Power Feedback

objects.text: You can extend the reach of your abilities into further physical dimensions, enabling them to have an impact in the past, future, and across dimensional boundaries. This extension is subject to the inherent range limitations of each individual ability, with the 'distance' over which you can reach determined by the metric of the dimensional structure you're affecting. Because of this, reaching through time is horrendously inefficient, with a range of 1 light-second roughly corresponding to affecting targets 1 second into the past or future.
objects.title: Dimensional Projection

objects.text: Your area of effect (AOE) powers have become more malleable, allowing you to manipulate the shape of your AOEs. You can freely move an AOE's point of origin to another location, or even bind it to an object or being, causing the AOE to move when it's linked mass moves. Another facet of this increased malleability is the ability to diffuse or condense your AOEs in a tradeoff between strength and coverage. Keep in mind the tradeoff is in area, not distance, so if you want to make your 2x as big in every dimension, it would cost 8x the power. The maximum power that can gained from reducing area is capped at 64x, though you can reduce area further if you so desire.
objects.title: AOE Manipulation

objects.text:
You lose access to one of your powers, only being able to bestow it on others rather than use it yourself at all. The person or people the power is bestowed on gains all the benefits of having the power, though at any time you can choose to retract their abilities.

Anything under your direct and conscious control (ie. a hive-mind or second body) still counts as ‘yourself’ for the purposes of Bestow.
objects.title: Bestow

objects.text:
Your powers now operate much more smoothly, requiring almost no conscious effort on your part. Your danger sense is also much more refined, capable of intuiting a much greater deal of information, almost acting as form of clairvoyance.

Your ability to anticipate danger is now tied directly to your reflexes and other powers, allowing your powers to act in your defense, even when you’re unaware, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated. They’ll automatically move your body out of the way such as activating your flight, teleporting you away, or even simply moving your body’s muscles reflexively to defend you.

This will only happen should you under normal circumstances wish for it, allowing you to harm yourself if you wish, albeit it’ll automatically minimize it as much as possible to meet your need.
objects.title: Automatic Defense

objects.text:
All of your powers are now operating under a single premise: if you were to want it to happen, it will. You’ll never fail to activate your flight when you jump off a building, won’t accidentally drop your force field because you got distracted, never forget to return to human form before making your way through a small door, etc.

The same goes for any constructs you may create with your power, with them now capable of acting as you would wish them to even when not aware. They’ll collect information if you normally would wish them to, they’ll fight an enemy if you would normally direct them to do so, etc. They’re capable of acting entirely autonomously, always acting in a manner that you would agree with.
objects.title: Autonomous

objects.text: Now your barriers, forcefields and anything similar, will cause a copy of whatever damage was supposed to go through them back to its origin. This mean that if you, for example, had the Glory Girl power copy, someone punching you would result in them also being punched. Damage is generally reflected relatively in the same position, so a laser to the face will affect the attacker in the face.
objects.title: Thorny Shielding

objects.text: You have gained the ability to pre-load a single attack that if triggered will automatically attack the one who triggered the barrier at point blank range.
objects.title: Offensive Barrier

addons.text: All minions are now effected by the obsession drawback directed at you, including those that were already sapient. You may be able to convince them to share, but you should still be careful about how many you have.
addons.title: A Minion's Obsession

addons.text: You can now alter the minion's personality down to the most minute detail as well as change their appearance. Additionally, you can change these aspects at any point.
addons.title: Greater Lucidity

objects.text: Master powers that grant minions who aren't sapient now bestow sapience upon them. They are inherently loyal to you, but you have limited control over their personality, only able to influence it in broad strokes. They will still follow your orders but will otherwise do as they please with their time when not given a task. If you wish you can have the power create the personality itself at which point it will create one at random. Custom personalities are set when you gain the effected minion and cannot be changed afterward.
objects.title: Lucid Conjuration

objects.text:
Any power that creates or enhances objects over time can now be accelerated by consuming additional materials. Instead of waiting for set time intervals, you can produce more as long as you have the necessary resources. This applies to powers that require cooldowns, periodic charges, or time-based crafting, allowing you to bypass those restrictions through material substitution.

For example, (Trump/Tinker) Artificer normally requires charges to enchant objects, with a set number generated each day. With this upgrade, instead of using those charges, you can replace them by expending materials, letting you create enchanted items without being limited by daily charge generation. Similarly, Ringbearer, which typically allows the creation of only one ring per month, can now produce rings without delay, provided you have enough resources to substitute for the time requirement.

This upgrade does not increase the overall potential of a power, only its speed. You cannot exceed the inherent limits of what the ability allows, only reduce the time required to reach them. Additionally, this upgrade works like a tinker power, making you need to build or alter the item you are making or enhancing. This also means it can benefit from tinker based upgrades.
objects.title: Tinker Charges

addons.text:
Your unspent pool is the same pool as your Architect Charges. 

This means you can use your unused points here as Architect charges, and the reverse also holds true in that as you produce Architect Charges they will count for the unspent pool. You retain the boost from what you would have had from them individually, meaning Unspent’s boost bumps up from 1% to 2%. 

You also gain the ability to deactivate any portion of your pool at will, able to use it as normal as charges but prevent it from passively enhancing your powers, if you wanted or needed to for one reason or another. You can always undo this as well. 

Unspent’s starting pool of charges rounds up to create a full charge your Architect could use, to create a simple full charge for the pool. 

Meaning if you possess 3 SP left over, it would round up to 4 for a full charge. This number also changes, going up if Increased Potency (Architect) is bought, likewise this also does not happen if Side Benefits (Architect) is bought, as lesser charges are a charge your Architect could use and are granular enough. ⁨
addons.title: Same Pool

objects.text:
All remaining points increases the overall strength of your abilities by 1% per point.

2 SP left over results in a 2% increase in all powers, having 3 SP and 1 CP left over results in a 4% increase to all your abilities, etc. For powers with multiple numerical values this boost applies to the end product of all values.

You may choose to have the boost focused on specific values at the cost of the boost to other values, or to have the boost stripped from one power to instead be applied to another power.
objects.title: Unspent

objects.text: Your points are now multiplicative, each one increasing the strength by 1% and compounding.
objects.title: Multiplicative

objects.text:
You forgo the boost to your powers entirely, in exchange the boost becomes the guaranteed passive rate of growth your power will experience over the course of a year, regardless of your own actions. 3 remaining SP points results in a 3% passive rate improvement.

You can improve your powers if you can normally do so, this merely adds a passive growth that you may further improve upon.
objects.title: Compounding Interest

addons.text:
You can change your allocation at will, allowing you to freely swap between enhancing all your powers, to allocating them to specific powers, perks, and skills. 

Moreover you’ve gained the ability to actually degrade your powers, taking the points and strength they had to enhance others. 

You can degrade it all the way down to 0 points, effectively turning it off. You can also leave the pool’s effect inactive, if you wish to refrain from enhancing a power,  essentially treating it as an unallocated pool.⁨
addons.title: Reallocation

addons.text: You can now also freely swap whether points are put towards your passive rate growth or allocated towards boosting your powers.
addons.title: Passive/Active

addons.text:
Your pool of power can now be spent freely in any manner you wish. 

What this means is that you can now apply your pool of power on yourself as normal, or pour it into others, to enhance them as you would yourself. This can be taken back at will. 

This can be used to grant abilities if you possess a power that can generate, share, or otherwise give out abilities.
addons.title: Donation

objects.text:
Instead of allocating a boost to all powers, you may instead opt to take the value of the points, all or in part, and directly apply it to a power, skill, or perk that uses the points, removing the enhancement to all powers those points would give in exchange for enhancing them to the price point they represent.

As an example, allocating 20 points to a 10 SP power would amplify it and bring it on par as if it existed as a 30 SP variant of itself. 

This can be used to create horizontal or vertical upgrades, able to simply increase the ability in a straightforward and simple manner by increasing its overall power, or be used to add new facets to itself, or some mix of the two. You control how this manifests, such as an enhanced or innate skill for a power, or some supernatural element to a skill, or anything else you can think of.
objects.title: Investment

addons.text: An additional 7 SP is added to every calculation of equivalent SP.
addons.title: Unexpected

objects.text:
Your power now improves through all powers and resources to develop powers that you accumulate over time, as well as powers that allow you to express other powers. 

For powers that can copy powers, they will grant the equivalent’s cost for their most powerful ability as long as they are not expressed. 

For powers that have limited slots for use, they are given the equivalent of their most powerful power’s SP equivalent for every active slot that is not used, and for any slot that is used for storing powers.

If the power can copy or store a power, and it does not have a limit to the strength of the power it can store, but it does not have a power copied or stored, then it will give a boosts equivalent to the SP cost of its own worth. 

If it only has powers that are weaker than its own SP cost, then it will give a boosts equivalent to the SP cost of its own worth. If it has a limit to how much power it can hold in a single slot, it will be granted the boost as if its slot was holding a power at its cap. 

For powers that do generate powers wholesale, you are given a boost equivalent in cost to the most powerful ability you could generate using your resources that you do not use. 

The same goes for powers that are variable like powers such as Eidolon, instead allowing you a boost for each slot that you do not use. 

Points are now counted at 5% per point instead of 1%.
objects.title: Unused

objects.text:
Any master power that generates minions now allows you to customize their appearance in any way you wish. This effect is primarily cosmetic and ignores mass/volume requirements and the square-cube law. 

For example you can make a wolf companion appear as an elf but this would not grant it the magical abilities of an elf. Similarly you could make that wolf look like a lizard but it wouldn't become cold blooded. Raising the size of a minion does not raise their strength or lower their speed in proportion. 

They are altered so that any changes to their body would not negatively effect them. The change in weight won't hinder them, they will be able to move any new body parts as if they had been born with them, etc.
objects.title: Shape Minion

objects.text:
To be a true conjurer is to be shielded by your minions. As long as you have at least one active minion, you gain a bastion. Any creature under your control is considered a minion—including other instances of yourself, such as clones, as well as those under the effects of mind control.

While this effect is active, you gain resistance to any unwanted external influence that directly targets you. This includes mind control, binding magic, soul theft, and even physical damage. As long as you have a single minion, your bastion grants you immense resistances. You can withstand missiles, endure psychic attacks, or resist reality warpers with ease.

Your bastion can grow even stronger in proportion to the number and power of your minions. A magical dragon will boost your resistance to magic, while an Endbringer could enhance your defense against shard-based effects. The more powerful and numerous your minions, the stronger your bastion becomes. As long as you have at least one active minion within a country’s distance, your bastion remains intact.
objects.title: Bastion of the Conjurer

addons.text:
Now simply mentioning anything about you is enough for your powers to operate through. A stranger calling upon your name for help could find themselves teleported to a safe space, a sick child can call upon you and find their illness gone, etc. Songs and tales about your valor could result in a master effect that raises moral in those that hear it, or perhaps tales of your incredible healing touch and kind nature imparts healing effects upon those that listen. 

Like before you can establish certain triggers to result in certain effects, or allow your power to subconsciously respond in ways you would have done so if made aware.
addons.title: Speak of the Devil And He Shall Appear

addons.text: Now your power works simply through awareness of your existence, it does not matter if they call upon you, it does not matter what they say or who they are. If they are aware of you in any capacity, whether through firsthand knowledge or diminished and mutated over thousands of retellings of myth and legends, diverging into entirely different stories and characters over countless millennia and generations of languages, your power can effect them. Moreover, when impacting them you can make sure they are fully aware that it is you doing so with absolute certainty if you wish, even if there is no evidence of it. As before you can control how your power manifest and is utilized, even if not fully aware. You do retain subconscious awareness of all instances of your powers.
addons.title: Even in Silence I Am Here, for Names Have Power

objects.text:
Your power now works through any kind of medium. Implant Master commands through a live television broadcast, throw fireballs through a recorded video, and impart Shaker effects through stories that when read aloud result in your power taking effect. 

You can control how this manifests allowing you to implant effects in some scenarios but not in others, such as Master commands upon enemies when they read your commands but not upon allies, even if you're not directly aware of them.
objects.title: Media Sensation

addons.text: Your powers infuse the network, allowing your creations to draw on the ability that originally produced them to continuously regenerate in case of damage even without your conscious input.
addons.title: Power Grid

addons.text:
You can connect others to your network. While it would not grant you the ability to control them, you can still communicate just as well as you could with your creations.

Additionally, no longer limited to being in your presence, those connected to your network would continuously benefit from the Engine of Escalation should you allow it.
addons.title: Guest User

objects.text:
Your every creation, from simple objects to living beings, is now linked both to you and your other creations via a mental network.

Through this network, you are always aware of the position of your creations, can communicate with them, and can even remotely control them should they have the means to act on your commands. For example, you can control any electronic device you made, but you can't make a sword fly unless it was enchanted to do so.

This network cannot be detected or tampered with by anyone not connected to it, and inside it you are an undisputed authority—everything and everyone can act within the network only to the extent you allow them.

Lastly—the network has no range limit and can even persist across dimensions and universes, with the only way for something to leave it being if you sever the connection yourself.
objects.title: Network

objects.text: You can use objects as an expression of yourself. Such as the tip of a spear counting for your Striker powers or clothes as part of your Brute powers.
objects.title: Teddybear

objects.text:
Your reach and versatility has exponentially expanded as you can now propagate Teddybear through and beyond any material connected to your initial point of contact, up to a maximum of 200 metres away. You're no longer limited to just objects directly touching you; you may now have remote objects serve as a manifestation of yourself as long as there is an indirect physical link.

For example, you could extend this effect from your feet, through your shoes, into the ground and onto a nearby door. If you had a Brute power, the door would gain your Brute aspect.
objects.title: Pillow Fort

objects.text:
You can use your powers through your powers, through things made by you, and through the consequences of your powers/creations. If the channeled power cannot do anything to what it is being used on it will change in order to be able to do so.

Channeling Tattletale through tinkertech repaired by (Tinker) Repair would make Tattletale get no wrong information about the tech and would increase its deduction capacities in relation to it and anything similar. Channeling (Blaster) Bloody Hell through a wound made by (Striker) Edge would make the blood within the wound erase matter around itself. Channeling (Trump) Eidolon through a knife made by you would result in the knife gaining three random powers made specifically to work with knives.
objects.title: Channeling

addons.text: Trumped the Trump adds a dimension of control to your insurance policy. You can now channel Saboteur through powers you share or bestow, including adding a self-destruct or backdoor function at your discretion. For example, you’ll be linked to any stolen or shared ability only in terms of its usage and the situation in which it is used, which you can exploit by timing a self-destruct function at the most inopportune moment. This turns your insurance policy from a reactive measure to a proactive one, allowing you to enforce loyalty to anyone you lend your powers to preemptively, or within a relay of your making, such as Quartermaster or (Trump) Network Hub.
addons.title: Frame-Up

addons.text: Your insurance policy also applies to your Objects of Power, which defensively lash out at thieves to prevent any unwanted use before fully self-destructing.
addons.title: LoJack

addons.text:
Your Thinker and/or Master defenses now trigger a backlash against anyone trying their luck, as part of a contingency measure from Saboteur. The intensity depends on the offending party’s strength and expression, designed to cause a violent reaction with the power’s vector.

In Thinkers’ case, you’re a de facto Thinker cognitohazard; scanning or probing causes an acute Thinker headache, rising in severity the more they try or keep pushing their luck. For example, Tattletale will find it easier to glean some information due to how her power works, but sees it painful when pushing her power further, including her power’s growing lack of effectiveness, the more she fishes for information, with the risk of losing consciousness.

In Masters’ case, they struggle to find a purchase with their powers or try to affect your feelings or perception, suffering the equivalent of Thinker headache with several symptoms such as nausea or nosebleeds.

Goes without saying that this won’t come into effect when you allow some powers to perceive or influence you.
addons.title: Backlash

objects.text:
Sometimes, there’s an inevitable situation where you’re up against the metaphorical wall of a power manipulator, capable of draining, stealing, negating, or copying your powers with no guarantee of recovery or reprisal on your part. A wasted investment for a build you invested so much time in, there has to be a solution!

Well, fear no more! With this upgrade, an insurance policy will come to your power’s aid, tampered with in such a way that when used/activated/meddled by the power copier/stealer/manipulator, it rebounds or self-destructs on them. This adds an element of caution if you haven’t taken Trumped the Trump, as this doesn’t stop anyone from generally manipulating or losing your powers, just adding some incentive not to do so.
objects.title: Saboteur

objects.text:
Any power you possess that requires you to meet conditions to scale or unlock features can now scale on its own over time. For example, a power that requires you to fight a minion to unlock it or complete a quest to unlock an aspect will instead unlock those things should you wait long enough. 

The time required depends on the potency of the unlock. For example, Half-Saiyan (Dragon Ball Series) may take only a couple weeks for vastly enhanced natural senses, while it may take a few years for it to affect your Super Saiyan forms or Oozaru form. There is no limit to how many upgrades you can unlock this way.
objects.title: Eh, I Can Wait

objects.text:
When you shift into a Changer form or transformation, your other abilities now scale relatively to match the strength and nature of that form instead of your base state. Your powers now maintain the same relative effectiveness compared to the transformed body as they have in your base form.

This scaling follows the form: abilities are enhanced vertically if the transformation is a direct upgrade (more of the same), optionally shifting thematically and horizontally if it is a sidegrade, and gain both effects if the form is superior in both power and versatility.

If your base form changes due to another power, your transformations automatically rescale to remain relevant, ensuring they always function as a relatively meaningful increase over your normal baseline.

All abilities used while transformed behave as if they belong to that form, matching its scale, capability, and traits.
objects.title: Scaleshifter

addons.title: Free Swapping
addons.text:
Your Freedom of Choice has now expanded into your Objects of Power. Any OoP that makes you choose an option out of multiple at purchase, such as Millennium Items (Yu-Gi-Oh!), now lets you swap out your choice for any other option at will.

Do keep in mind that swapping an option out ends all effects maintained by it, so if you for example switch out the Millennium Rod for the Millennium Ring, anyone under the Rod's control would be immediately freed.

objects.text:
For any power you have that requires you to make a choice upon selection, such as (Breaker) Other Side of the Coin or (Master) Stand, you can instead change that choice at will. For example, this would allow you to change what powers you'd had selected with (Master) Stand at any time.

This does not effect powers that allow you to make choices after the fact, such as Retrofitting or Architect Jr.
objects.title: Freedom of Choice

objects.text: You have been given the knowledge of how to do one technique, whether pre-existing or knowledge for one particular use of your powers. Whether this be a specialized use of your time manipulation, an existing technique from Dragon Ball for Ki, a Jutsu from Naruto, or so on. This does not include explicitly magic spells, so things like specific Fairy Tail spells would not be viable. It does not strictly give you the fulfilled requirements to do it if it has them, like a strict strength level. It also puts you at only a beginner level for all techniques chosen.
objects.title: Technique Teachings

objects.text: Your powers that rely on charge resources no longer suffers from a limit on how many charges can be stored. Powers such as (Striker/Trump) Dauntless would gain a repository to store generated charges.
objects.title: Uncapped Charge Storage

objects.text: Any Power you have that has a maximum number of targets it can affect simultaneously now has its cap removed. You want to have twenty students with (Thinker/Trump) Kingmaker instead of just five? Go right ahead. You want to use (Striker/Trump) Perk to dole out Perks and Drawbacks to your entire school? Knock yourself out. In the Nick of Time should apply to everyone you've ever met instead of just a select few? Your funeral.
objects.title: You Get a [X], You Get a [X], Everybody Gets a [X]!

addons.text: Your ability to revoke the powers now extends to any and all powers and abilities even remotely traceable to you. This includes any inherited powers of your descendants, powers of those who received them from someone you gave powers to, etc. So long as a chain of powers can be traced to you, your authority is absolute.
addons.title: Disownment

objects.text: You can disable, permanently or temporarily, any and all powers, objects of power, or enhancements you grant other people. If you granted someone a physical object, you can summon it back into your possession instead of disabling it; any soul or ownership bond will transfer to you.
objects.title: Revocation

objects.text: Any powers that let you control something or has an output, you can now become it. A hydrokinetic can become water, a laser Blaster can become lasers, etc.
objects.title: Emerge

objects.text: Any powers you have that use charges come with one additional cycle’s worth of charges already stored for every time this is taken.
objects.title: Pre-charged

addons.title: Coolness Enhancement
addons.text:
Your powers now no longer automatically shape themselves into their coolest form. Instead you gain an ability to customize the expression of your powers according to your imagination. In return, if you design an expression of power suitably impressive it may now actually improve the effects of your powers. Shaping fireballs into flaming dog-heads may improve accuracy or damage as the constructs slightly adjust their trajectory to hit a dodging enemy or bite down and stick to the target for a moment before exploding.

The improvement is small but notable, however dependent on the spectacle of the power. If your expression looks lame or weird, the power used can actually weaken.

It is also possible to trade in damage your power does in favor of a secondary effect, especially if you design its expression in a silly or cartoonish way. Hitting someone in the face with full strength while having your blow produce a loud BOINK-sound and maybe adding a few stars or birds flying around the victim's head may end up doing next to no damage, but instead stun and dizzy your enemy for 2-3 seconds.
Using an electricity-generating power designed to make the target's skeleton visible in the light may now force the target's body to spasm into silly shapes, though the moment the lightning cuts off the at worst slightly singed enemy is immediately free to keep fighting.

This shifting can also be used in non-humorous ways to for example decrease the damage of an attack in return for making it faster, more accurate, or hurt more on hit.

Regardless, the overall boost is relatively minor, any larger alterations requiring a trade-off reduction elsewhere.

objects.text:
Your powers become more visually and audibly impressive. Instead of simple fireballs, your pyrokinetic constructs now take the form of flaming swords or birds made of fire shooting at the enemy. A power that lets you fire energy-beams may now appear to be two beams, one going in a straight line while the other spirals around the first. A power that calls down lightning-strikes now makes a giant beast of lightning peek out of the clouds before striking down your foes. Even normally plain Brute-powers now result in every punch or kick releasing a visual distortion as a shockwave accompanied by loud smashing-sounds reverberating from the point of impact.

You can also make your powers appear sillier, with a electrokinetic power for example making an enemy flash brightly and have their skeleton become visible when hit, or making your attacks make cartoonish crash and boink-sounds.

It should be noted that this in no way alters the strength, speed, or accuracy of your powers, all changes are purely cosmetic to make them look more impressive or entertaining. If you give someone an electric shock as powerful as getting zapped by static electricity, then even if you make arcs of electricity dance all over the person you're zapping still only gets a small static shock.

This effect can automatically shape any power you apply it to, altering it into whatever would be most impressive while adhering to your aesthetic preferences. Though obviously it has no effect on powers without noticeable indicators it's being used, like Thinker- and most Stranger-powers.
objects.title: Showy

addons.text: You can now safely give or copy the true version of esoteric powers instead of the standard version. This means for example when you copy a time reversal power, instead of getting a shard power that simulates reversing time, you get a power that can actually reverses time.
addons.title: Hiding Greater Truths

objects.text:
Your ability to conceal information is greatly enhanced, allowing you to obscure data even from the shard network itself. Normally, this would be a minor improvement to stealth and encryption capabilities, but knowledge of the [ANSWER] unlocks a deeper application of this effect.

Any power that grants, modifies, or distributes abilities may now confer a Negentropy-aligned version of that power instead of its standard form. Likewise, any ability that duplicates, emulates, or transfers powers may apply this same Negentropy modification to copies, including those used by yourself.

This ensures that the [ANSWER] cannot propagate through the shard network under any circumstance, including indirect replication, observation, or systemic inference by entities such as Scion. You may also suppress awareness of your knowledge of the [ANSWER], revealing it only by deliberate choice.
objects.title: Black-boxing the [ANSWER]

objects.text: For any power that has randomness in its operation, you can now control which outcome you receive every single time. From landing a critical hit with each strike to deciding what you will receive from a gacha.
objects.title: Derandomisation

addons.text:
You can freely manipulate what the inverted expression of your power is, including only partially inverting it. Examples would include turning Skitter's power into Rodent Control with slightly worse multitasking, or having Fire Generation become Fire Manipulation. 

These aren't fixed at their creation, but changing what exactly their expression is will take some focus. Having Tailor Made will remove this limitation, while having its addon will make the changes instinctive in their use.
addons.title: Transposition

addons.text:
Your main power, its opposite, and its alternate can all be interchanged with each other. You could have any combination of them, such as having three copies of the original or having two alternate expressions and an opposite. You can choose for these to be copies of the power expression you had for that type or for them to be new alternates/opposites, effectively giving you a total of three alternatives and three opposites to cycle through.

This doesn't remove your ability to invert any of the powers gained, nor does it remove your ability to invert Newton's Third Law itself. If you have the Transposition addon you could effectively become a worse version of Eidolon by changing the expressions of your powers.
addons.title: Three's A Crowd

objects.text:
You can cause any power you have to invert, becoming its own opposite. Things such as range and power level remain unaffected, but the essence of the power will reverse, such as Fire Generation becoming Ice Generation. All secondary powers will invert as well, so you don't need to worry about having fire resistance when you're making ice cubes.

For powers with no clear opposite more unique powers can arise. For example, Skitter's power allows her to control nearly limitless insects, while its inverted version would allow you to control a single human.

You can undo this inversion at any time. Notably you don't have much control over what the inverted power is, though it does tend towards the most obvious answer. You won't ever be surprised by what an inverted power is.
objects.title: Inversion

objects.text: You have been enlightened to the truth that progression fantasy readers and rpg players have known since time immemorial. Support skills? Whack. Healing teammates? Whack. The only thing that matters is numbers go up!. Your powers have become twice as strong in all metrics–speed, strength, range, accuracy, etc. The real treat however is the fact that the destructive aspects of your power have been further doubled twice over. This only applies to purely destructive uses: if you use telekinesis to pick up an object it will only be twice as strong; use it to crush that same object and it will act as though it was eight times its base strength. Hopefully you added False Swipe to your move pool, because as a consequence of this your powers are extremely lethal, to the point where most battles end with your opponent being turned into a fine red paste.
objects.title: DPS Methodology

objects.text: One thing most people never consider, given all the animal, alien, and other forms or states they take, is that many of them don’t have the capacity to speak a common language or communicate. Whether that’s due to not breathing—such as if undead—or having wildly different vocal cords and jaw structures—or the form of a cat—as intelligent as cat’s might be, they’re never going to speak English. Now, you can always speak in any language you know, regardless of the form or state you’re currently in. Even if you are in the form of a rock, you’ll still possess the ability to have your say.
objects.title: I Can Speak Clearly Now

addons.title: The Meat Must Grow!
addons.text:
Your biomass can be instantly stored within a separated dimension based in your Bag of Holding or Inventory, removing its weight from your physical body. The storage space is effectively limitless, allowing you to accumulate as much biomass as you can produce without being burdened by its mass.

The stored biomass functions as an automatic reserve, similar to an HP pool in a video game. Any biomass required for regeneration, healing, growth, mutation, adaptation, or the creation and maintenance of biological systems is instantly drawn from storage. Likewise, excess biomass will be instantly stored in the storage.

You can freely control how your biomass is distributed between your physical body and storage. The transfer is instantaneous, allowing you to expand, reduce, regenerate, or reorganize your body without being restricted by the amount of mass you can physically carry.

Do you want to have a planet's made of meat? Or maybe stars made of blood? Or even a solar system's worth of mutations that would fit right into some Lovecraft-inspired media? Go for it.

objects.text:
Your body will never be forced to compromise its chosen form in order to evolve. Any power, mutation, evolution, adaptation, or biological transformation that would normally alter your appearance will instead preserve your preferred form while retaining the benefits of the transformation.

If a transformation genuinely requires your body to change its shape or develop a new physical feature to function, you gain a Changer Button that allows you to consciously switch that feature on or off. When disabled, your body returns to your preferred form without losing the underlying evolutionary gains.

Your body can also store an effectively limitless amount of biomass, allowing you to continue accumulating biological mutations without reaching a hard storage limit. This biomass still has physical weight, however, so accumulating too much of it can become a practical problem.
objects.title: True Superiority

rows.title: Universal Power Upgrades
rows.titleText: These powers upgrade existing powers (or multiple powers of the same lineage) into a more powerful form.

addons.text: Stacking has never felt so good. Your "selecting" and "stacking" motions and actions are clearer when 'pausing', immediately grasping which actions cause the most damage or are the most effective in a particular situation, and understanding the amount of physical force you exert with it and its outcomes. The possible actions grow more consistent with one another when similar, whereas if different, know how they synergize or enhance your movements.
addons.title: Body Playstyle

objects.text:
Move Cancel widens its scope, its area expanding to a radius of 200m, loosening its restrictions of how many branches you can split before and after the 30-second limit, from nearly a thousand actions both realistically and unrealistically possible for you.

Aside from “branching” and “selecting” your movement and/or courses of action, you can stack up similar or different actions at varying times between them, as long as they are in a similar spatial and directional position. This has the consequence of stacking the resulting physical force for each stacked movement.
objects.title: Stacked Move

objects.text:
With this upgrade, your feathers are made of crystal-like flesh and even an individual feather is comparable to a Brute 1 in terms of durability, strength, and speed. The limit of feathers you can manifest at once is also increased, up to one thousand.

Additionally, the feathers become sharper as they are bound together, in addition to increasing their durability, strength, and speed. The feathers also transfer their increased characteristics to your whole body when bound to you. When all are bound together, their strength and speed are just shy of Alexandria's, their durability is comparable to the inner layers of Endbringers, and their edge becomes monomolecular.
objects.title: On Crystal Wings

objects.text: When you teleport, you can choose to pull all loose objects (living or non-living) within a 3-metre radius with you, with them all arriving in the same relative location to you.
objects.title: All Together

objects.text: You now need to blink in order to teleport. Winking instead of blinking teleports you to half the intended distance.
objects.title: Please, Blink!

objects.text: You aren't limited to just your legs anymore, you can interact air with your entire body. Use it to climb, swing, hang in the air upside down, and make ridiculous poses.
objects.title: Ladder to Heaven

objects.text:
Now, you no longer need to reach top velocity, simply staying in motion is enough. Every step, every movement, no matter how small, contributes to an ever-growing reservoir of speed and strength. The longer you stay in motion, the faster and stronger you become.

You can also choose to reverse the effect. By consciously slowing your speed, you can redirect the energy into raw physical power, sacrificing velocity to exponentially enhance your strength. 

This improvement has also sharpened your mental faculties even further. As your motion builds momentum, your thoughts, reflexes, and decision-making accelerate alongside your physical prowess. You can process information and react with unparalleled precision, even in the heat of battle or during complex maneuvers.

However, this power is still bound by your stamina. The longer you remain in motion, the quicker your endurance diminishes.
objects.title: Don’t Stop Moving

objects.text:
You have gained the power to Banish and Exile.

Banish: You can distort the spatial signature of any target you can detect. This temporarily teleports them to a location of your choosing, though they will be teleported back after a few seconds. This power has a cooldown when utilized on the same individual, which increases in duration depending on the relative strength of the target. It doesn't affect targets far stronger than you.

Exile: You can permanently teleport any target to a location of your choosing. However, this has a chance to fail, which greatly increases on stronger individuals. If you want to use this ability semi-consistently, the target will have to be decently  weaker than you. You cannot make an exile attempt on a target more than once per day.

Your normal summoning no longer requires consent if the person you are trying to summon is weaker than you.
objects.title: Banish and Exile

objects.text: You can now teleport yourself to the location of anyone you’ve ever seen, as long as they are in the same dimension and there is enough open space for you to appear safely within 10 feet of them. The person you are teleporting to is aware of your incoming arrival and can refuse to let you teleport to them if they wish. This also works with people you have seen an accurate image of. If the teleportation is refused, you remain in your current location.
objects.title: Reverse Summoning

objects.text: You can now set tethers that consistently affect the two points they connect, such as keeping combatants pinned to the floor or preventing them from approaching each other, without sacrificing your ability to switch tethers. Once a tether is set with a timer, it cannot be adjusted (except by manually switching to it in your mind) unless it’s in your line of sight. These tethers no longer require your active focus. However, the longer they persist, the more strain they inflict; 20-30 minutes is sustainable, but hours of continuous use will quickly exhaust you unless you train further. If an external force (e.g. someone’s friends) tries to break your tethered connections, it may cause additional strain unless you choose to release the tether.
objects.title: Staying Attached

objects.text: You are no longer limited in how many tethers you can maintain within your line of sight. While this reduces the strain of managing multiple tethers, it doesn’t eliminate it entirely. You gain enhanced multitasking capability, allowing you to handle these tethers effectively, even if some move out of sight (though this incurs the normal strain and can exhaust you quickly). This upgrade unlocks new opportunities - like using multiple tethers to rip something apart or supporting an object’s weight more evenly.
objects.title: Many Connections

objects.text:
This damned power…

- Anaqi

Now you truly do have infinite stamina. No matter the power, your stamina is treated as effectively infinite.
objects.title: Tireless

objects.text:
No longer do your Force Constructs have to be inanimate, they can now have a mind of their own. These Force Elementals have both memory and intelligence, allowing them to be rational and make decisions on their own. They can control their body to the same degree that you can but are granted no additional senses besides their default tactile one. 

These Force Elementals are still linked to you, allowing you to control and telepathically communicate with them. They are not sentient and lack creativity, causing them to be unable to come up with their ideas and solutions to problems, likewise not being able to feel emotions. They have complete loyalty towards you, but have no desires of their own, causing a lack of initiative.
objects.title: Force Elemental

objects.text:
Your pyrokinesis has evolved, granting you power over fire and flame rather than just cinders and ash, and you can now regenerate using fire instead of just cinders and ashes. All of the things that you make out of cinders and ash are capable of withstanding ten times the force that they previously could. 

In addition to this, your burning core has also evolved, becoming so dense and hot that it could be considered a miniature sun. It has also become durable enough to withstand a nuclear bomb.

Alongside this, you can temporarily or permanently gift someone pyrokinesis focused around either cinders, ash, or fire, though this will temporarily weaken you by one ninth for a lunar cycle per individual you give powers to.
objects.title: Ruler of the Primordial Flames

objects.text: You are no longer limited to just your universe, allowing your manipulations to cross to other universes within your local multiverse. Taking Homecoming makes this ability Omniversal given the correct medium.
objects.title: Multiversal Warping

objects.text:
Your powers have evolved, allowing you to become the embodiment of primordial Earth. This has increased the range of your terrakinesis to 2.5 kilometers, along with gifting you complete metallokinesis and granting you the ability to generate any form of earth from your body.

You also gained the ability to create living constructs out of earth that will obey your orders and commands with complete obedience, but the intelligence of your creations will be lacking at first.

You also gain the ability to absorb earth into your body, transforming you into a Titan of Earth. While in this form, the earth that has become your body is 100 times more durable than it originally was. Along with this, you can heal by absorbing nearby earth, but while in this form, your ability to generate earth is no longer accessible. Along with this, you are limited here to a height of 100 meters, and your body is reminiscent of its original form.

(Earth in this context means crystals, gems, metal, stone, sand, or dirt, meaning anything non-organic that can be found in the earth counts as earth.)
objects.title: Primordial Earth

addons.text: You have become the very embodiment of the primordial Gaia, the mother Earth herself. This has led to the range of all of your abilities reaching 10 kilometers. Along with this, your ability to generate matter now includes living matter, animals, and plants of all kinds, natural or artificial, that can now flow from your form. Instead of losing the ability to generate matter while in your Titan forum, it is now stronger than in your normal form. Though the durability of your Titan form remains the same, you can now absorb plants alongside all forms of Earth to increase their size and heal. You are no longer limited to 100 meters your Titan form can now reach one kilometer in height.
addons.title: Primordial Mother

objects.text: Your powers have evolved, allowing you to become the embodiment of Mother Earth. This has increased the range of your terrakinesis to 1 kilometer alongside giving you agrokinesis within 100 meters and gifted you the ability to heal and rejuvenate plant and animal life within 10 meters. You also possess the ability to improve or modify any living creature that you are touching.
objects.title: Mother Earth

objects.text: Your range to detect and control water now resets every time you encounter a water molecule, essentially acting as a relay point. Thus, you can manipulate any water 5 meters away from water you already control, and then extends to 5 meters further past that. You can chain this up to your maximum range, which is around a lake. The more relay points you have, the worse your detection and control get.
objects.title: Tidecaller

objects.text: After summoning a sufficiently dense minefield, you can choose a target inside the field, which will cause all of your mines to immediately home towards it.
objects.title: Hellzone Grenade

objects.text: You now gain the ability to interact more with your created calcified space-time. You could tinker with them, creating essentially indestructible armor. You could create bombs with them where they destroys themselves which destroy space and time in the area they inhabited. The rate you can create the calcified space also has also greatly improved, you can envelope a person in your invisible energy near instantly. You also gain mental immunity to time based effects. If someone altered the timeline, while your body will be affected your mind wouldope yourself in calcified space-time but since your mind is still active you can dismiss it after some time.
objects.title: Frozen Space Time Maker

objects.text: Your weather control has gained a significant power boost, increasing its range by about 20% as well as the maximum intensity of weather you can manifest: Where originally you could create weather at the peak of what was possible on earth, you could now create phenomena like rainfall so thick it turns roads into rivers, blizzards that can bury entire towns, thunderstorms strong enough to fry entire power grids, or artificial heatwaves hot enough to burn forests or melt asphalt.
objects.title: Heavy Weather

objects.text: Your weather control has been greatly broadened, allowing you to generate highly unnatural weather and even some more exotic meteorological phenomena: Some examples of new "storms" include snowing radioactive ash, raining blood, frogs, acid or actual fire in the form of embers/sparks, or even forming disorienting/hallucinogenic auroras.
objects.title: Wild Weather

objects.text: You are capable of manifesting your weather on a much smaller scale. For things such as rain, lightning, or other similar forms of weather, this will take the form of miniature clouds forming and generating the desired effect. These clouds can also mimic weather effects that would not usually come from them, such as sunlight.
objects.title: Weather Report

addons.text: Anyone who dies in your mist instantly becomes one of your spectres. The bigger you mist, the more spectres you can summon, with them able to wander the entire mist freely. At the base, you can summon up to 5 spectres at once in your mist and the number will grow as the mist does. Your spectres also take on more creepy and horrifying forms when in the mist, giving off a sense of wrongness and unliving to those who see them.
addons.title: Ghost of Ones Past

addons.text: The illusions become stronger the longer people stay within your fog, reaching to the point that they can physically be harmed by them. Additionally, their sense of direction is weakened drastically, making it near impossible to leave your mist, as even teleports will likely be redirected to another part of your mist.
addons.title: Encroaching Fog

objects.text:
The mist you now summon has taken on eerie properties. Everyone, with the exception of you, in the mist are affected by illusions. To every person within the fog, the world around them transforms—shadows of the long-dead flicker in the corners of their vision, and the landscape subtly reshapes itself into eerie scenes of your choosing, however you cannot alter the true nature of physical objects— a wall remains a wall, a floor stays solid beneath your feet—but within the mist, they appear transformed. You can mask reality, making a stone wall look like the decaying facade of a gothic cathedral or turn the ground into worn cobblestone streets. Whether it’s the grim, twisted streets of gothic London, a haunted forest, or an ancient battlefield, the mist bends perception to your will, overlaying its ghostly veneer onto the real world.

But the mist's horrors run deeper than mere illusions. Should anyone perish within it, their essence is trapped, condemned to wander the fog as a ghostly wraith. These spectral prisoners are bound forever to your mist, haunting and tormenting any new intruders who dare enter. They cannot actually do anything beyond speak in pain within the fog, but they will radiate a sense of wrongness to anyone who sees them.
objects.title: Unseen Under The Mist

addons.text: You become a Living Calamity. Bedlam randomly occurs contained in your area, while retaining all features of CF.
addons.title: Calamity

objects.text:
Your disastrous area widens to an area of 1km², with your initial limitations all but gone.

You now summon a ton of natural crises and discharge them accumulatively, hurling one endgame scenario after another, in all directions. The possibilities broaden, with all the disasters the Entities encountered across their Cycles, both natural and sophont-made, yours to choose from.
objects.title: Malum

objects.text: All your stages have an additional 9 SP to spend on powers for each purchase you make. You can only choose powers from the tier 2 and 3 sections if you have the proper shard ranking. In addition, you can now take Tinker, Thinker, and Master powers.
objects.title: Theater Stage

objects.text: You gain an additional stage for each purchase you make. You now control your stages, altering their environment to suit you. You can even leave it behind or center it around other people and can use multiple stages simultaneously. However, if they cover the same area, you must choose which stage wins. In addition, every purchase adds a block radius.
objects.title: Multi-stage

addons.text: Your expertise in infection and virology has supercharged the potency of your diseases, turning them into far more than mere pathogens. When contained within you, they no longer simply mutate passively; instead, they evolve with alarming speed, drawing on the knowledge from your tinker specialty. Harnessing the principles of tinker-based bioengineering, your diseases adapt and strengthen, developing powers akin to those of engineered enhancements. These evolved pathogens take on extraordinary traits—ranging from accelerated spread and heightened resistance to specialized effects that can sap energy, disrupt bodily functions, or manipulate mental states. Left to develop inside you, they become more than infections; they transform into tools of power, a devastating arsenal that you alone can wield and unleash at will.
addons.title: Plague Doctor

addons.text:
All of your diseases now function as extensions of your own cells, transformed by the same sentient awareness and cooperative intelligence that drives your body’s microscopic defenders. This unique adaptation offers several powerful advantages. Each strain of disease within you has developed a rudimentary intelligence, capable of basic strategic thinking and capable of adapting to complex environments even when released outside of your body. When unleashed, these intelligent pathogens are able to grow in a targeted, controlled manner, adapting their mutation paths to better survive and spread in the host or environment they encounter. Your virome benefits from the biodiversity and becomes stronger and more robust. 

Most significantly, you retain a level of control over your diseases even after they are released. Initially, your influence is limited to simple commands, such as preventing replication, self-destructing, or lying dormant. However, as you practice and refine this control, you can direct your diseases with greater precision, commanding them to target or avoid specific individuals, manipulate their spread rate, or remain undetected within a population. Over time, this mastery allows you to wield your diseases not merely as infections but as a precise and selective biological tool, acting only where and how you intend.
addons.title: Disease Born

addons.text: Your corpse-like body can now swell and transform, undergoing intense mutations that grant you an array of powerful enhancements. Your skin distorts and your muscles bloat, taking on an almost monstrous form that radiates unnatural strength. These mutations not only increase your physical capabilities but also imbue you with specialized abilities—enhanced resilience, augmented strength, and unique offensive traits, adapting you for both survival and combat. The longer you remain in this state the more mutations you can gain. You can transform back at any time.
addons.title: Tyrant Virus

addons.text:
Through your extended reach, every conceivable disease from across the entire multiverse now resides within you, each one adapted to coexist and thrive within your body. This includes not only pathogens from countless worlds but also viruses, bacteria, parasites, and prions from alternate realities and divergent timelines. You are a walking archive of infections, carrying diseases that defy known science—some with properties that break the laws of physics, others capable of affecting not just organic life but machinery, energy, or even supernatural beings. These multiversal diseases evolve and intertwine within you, merging their unique characteristics to create entirely new strains that no single world has ever encountered. 

You are a living nexus of infection, embodying the collective virulence of infinite universes.
addons.title: A Thousand and One

objects.text:
Your body is a living reservoir of disease, harboring every known illness ever to have afflicted humankind, with the exception of artificially engineered diseases. Your diseases includes every conceivable pathogen, from viruses and bacteria to fungi and prions, your arsenal covering the full spectrum of infectious agents known to humankind. 

You can control the spread of these diseases, choosing at will to release them into the world or contain them within yourself. Once released you can use your gas to have temporary control over them, but as they grow further away from you this control slowly disappears. You can choose to release only specific diseases if you wish. When contained, these pathogens don’t simply remain dormant—they interact, evolve, and mutate within your body, merging and adapting in new and unpredictable ways. 

Your body has also been altered, allowing you not only to endure this vast and virulent collection but also to thrive amidst it. The diseases, rather than weakening you, seem almost symbiotic, making sure you never get sick and is instead always be slightly above your natural peak health.
objects.title: The Plague

objects.text:
You can infuse the environment with your power the longer you have it under control. The longer you sustain control over an area or object, the deeper this infusion goes, allowing you to manipulate it with precision and ease, as if it were a part of your body. Within your range, controlling these infused elements is seamless and effortless, like moving your own hands.

Even outside your range, your influence lingers. Infused parts remain under your control and maintain their connection to you indefinitely—until you actively shape or manipulate them again. When you do exert control, the infusion gradually degrades, but the rate of this diminishment depends on how deeply the area or object was infused. The more time and energy you’ve invested in the infusion, the slower it degrades with use.

Moreover, you can feel, hear, and sense through the infused areas as though they were extensions of your body. You also gain the mental capacity to multitask and make use of this sensory feedback, allowing you to monitor and act across multiple areas simultaneously.
objects.title: Roots

objects.text:
You now wield full control over the manifestation of any flare you produce, enabling you to finely adjust its magnitude, size, duration, intensity and so on when influencing non-static phenomena.

This control extends to the phenomena itself during the flare, granting you precise manipulation over it. For example, you could telekinetically direct the flames from a lighter into a focused beam or guide an electrical spark to strike a specific target like a lightning bolt.

This control also applies to more esoteric phenomena, including the powers of other parahumans. While flaring their powers, you can potentially override their control over their abilities temporarily, imposing your own will if you choose. However, this influence is very brief and doesn't give you any intuitive understanding of their abilities.

Keep in mind that your flares still have the same restrictions as before such as lasting a maximum of ten seconds.
objects.title: Controlled Flare-ups

objects.text:
Your ability to create barriers has been enhanced beyond its previous limitations. Firstly, you can move any barriers you make so long as they are within a 3-meter radius of yourself. Second, your capacity to make barriers has moved beyond the singular allowing you to create hundreds if you wish so long as they are within 3 meters of yourself. Lastly, you can alter the shape, form, and visual appearance of your barriers so long as they are within 3 meters of yourself.

Should a barrier be left more than 3 meters from yourself it quickly loses its inviolable nature and quickly dissipates over 15 seconds.
objects.title: More Shapely

addons.text: Their body will reflect the pain they experience or feel within your field, including the self-inflicted pain you transfer similar to King, mutilating and defacing those unfortunate enough to be inside your Land of Pain. This can range from brutish to poetically ironic depending on the conscious influence of your Thinker aspect.
addons.title: Gnashing of Teeth

objects.text:
Now you grasp the depths of the hold pain has on the mind. 

Your power now touches and evolves into a free and fine-control manipulation of pain as well as a Thinker aspect granting a painful intuition, that is, an insight on the subject of anguish and suffering both physical and emotional, alongside vague snapshots of painful moments from people on your pain field. 

Your range stretches far and wide to 3 (and a half) city blocks with the chance of reaching further depending on your field’s population density, providing free reign on sensing, inducing, amplifying, and suppressing the physical and emotional pain of anyone inside your field. Your Thinker aspect supports your most unusual applications such as the ability to recreate someone’s most painful moment as a simulation, whether emotional or physical, or actively torment people using your Thinker understanding of pain.

You have grown drawn to pain, finding something transcendental in it, whether you show it with leather, spikes, and self-mutilation is up to you.
objects.title: Demons to Some…

addons.text:
Your sensory enhancement grows into direct control of sensation’s breadth, accompanied by your Thinker aspect diversifying its insight on the nuances of pain, sensation, and pleasure.

It is the dominance, the pursuit, of exploration of the edges of experience.
addons.title: Pain and Pleasure

objects.text:
You've seen pain’s depths, why don’t you feel it all?

Your power expands its reach far beyond pain, with all sensations, including pleasure being in your purview. Enhancing any sensation or pleasure of anybody within your zone usually creates an addictive psychological dependence, to the point of looking for the next threshold or conflating pain with pleasure, aside from causing usual sensory overload and brain damage. Transferal also diffuses any pleasure you experience throughout anybody, causing a positive feedback loop.
objects.title: …Angels to Others

objects.text:
You can place a new rule every 1 minute within the same 200-foot radius where a previous rule was established, layering multiple effects in a single location. Each additional rule increases the total affected radius by 10%, gradually expanding the zone in a widening circle.
