All active rules coexist within the same space, but they must remain compatible—if any rule contradicts or conflicts with another, the entire framework destabilizes and all rules vanish immediately. As always, rules must be simple, non-harmful, and incapable of influencing minds or powers.
objects.title: Mandate

objects.text:
There are no rules on what rules you make. The previous limitations—simplicity, restrictions on affecting minds or powers, and the prohibition on directly causing harm—are removed. 

You can now establish complex, abstract, or paradoxical laws, influence perception and cognition, alter or suppress abilities, and enforce effects that may directly harm individuals. However, if your rule is attempting to grant powers or power-like effects then its strength cannot exceed 10 SP.

The range remains confined to 200 feet, and only one rule may exist at any given time.
objects.title: Lawless

objects.text: The strengths and scope of your Bounded Field are now from another world. You can now use the space itself as a boundary line to be as wide-reaching as you like at the cost of [Energy] and stamina. These bounded fields can contain 4 to 10 effects at once, being far and powerful in scope—Shaker effects such as meteorological and terrain changes, Stranger/Master effects for confusing and controlling crowd control, to the point of re-creating another location or moment in space-time, though not at the scale of (Shaker) Snapshots. In return, you can transport or move any Bounded Field you’ve placed.
objects.title: Bounded World

objects.text: The acceleration of resource declination now applies to usages beyond just personal. Batteries deplete faster, heat disperses faster, and Parahuman constructs and power effects lose power and dissipate quicker. Wherever you go, you leave a wasteland devoid of resources and energy.
objects.title: Drought

objects.text:
Every grain under your active control begins to vibrate with an anomalous friction, each one generating heat that bleeds into its neighbors and the surrounding environment in a cumulative cascade. A fistful of sand grows uncomfortably warm, a swirling cloud becomes a convection oven capable of blistering skin and igniting paper, and a full-radius sandstorm escalates into a furnace hot enough to melt aluminum, warp steel, and turn the air itself into a lethal inhalant.

The heat generated by your sand interacts with water differently. H2O in all its forms treats the sand's heat as if the sand were two or three times hotter than it actually is. A decently sized puddle warmed by sand no hotter than ordinary sunlight will dry out as if it's being brought to a slow boil. Ice sublimates directly to steam rather than passing through a liquid phase. Humidity itself is driven from the air, leaving the atmosphere within your radius searingly, unnaturally dry. Heat still transfers naturally, so time is still required for the energy to move from sand to water and spread from there. This effect isn’t Manton Limited against others, meaning the moisture in living tissue, eyes, mouths, and lungs of others are as vulnerable as any standing water.
objects.title: Red Desert

objects.text:
You can disperse your physical body, transforming it into sand you can control, merging your consciousness across all sand under your control within your 25-meter radius. Injuries in your flesh body are healed by drawing ambient sand into yourself, each wound closing as sand equal to the damaged volume transmutes into pristine tissue, while in your dispersed state any lost grains are simply replaced by pulling more sand from the environment into your gestalt. So long as enough sand within your radius remains to host your mind, you cannot be killed by conventional violence aimed at any single portion of the mass. Your tactile sense expands into full sensory immersion across every grain under your control, granting you omnidirectional sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch throughout the entire radius simultaneously. 

By expending your physical stamina, you can generate new sand that expels directly from your body as the origin point. This production is exhausting at scale, with enough sand to rebuild a lost limb costing the same energy as a full sprint, while a steady trickle for minor repairs or environmental seeding can be maintained about as easily as a brisk walk. The generated sand is indistinguishable from natural material and immediately integrates into your control radius and your distributed consciousness.
objects.title: Dust to Dust

objects.text:
You now possess a dynamic Brute rating that increases in environments your other powers create. If your power is one that alters the environment or affects others, the consequences of that alteration become a wellspring of physical potency for you. 

For example, if you have (Shaker) Frenzied Flame, your Brute rating begins to climb with every lick of fire that dances within your vicinity. A single candle's worth would grant a negligible tick upward, but a raging inferno of your own making would see your strength surge to Herculean levels, your skin harden against blows and heat alike, and your wounds knit closed with accelerated haste. If you have (Master/Thinker) Fear then the more intense the terror of those nearby, the greater your Brute rating becomes. In a room of calmly fearful individuals, you might be notably tough. But in a panicking crowd gripped by outright horror, you would become a nigh-unstoppable juggernaut.

This only works with powers whose primary and immediate effect is to change the environment or directly affect other minds and bodies. Powers that create projections, independent minions, or purely personal enhancements do not work. A projected double or a summoned creature does not count toward your Brute rating, no matter how powerful they are. Similarly, a power that only modifies your own senses or grants you a personal breaker state would not create the conditions needed to fuel your durability and strength.
objects.title: Homefield Advantage

objects.text:
Your Corona Pollentia is now fused with every cell, making it impossible to kill you without the complete annihilation of your body. Furthermore, your regeneration speed has been significantly enhanced, allowing you to regenerate from a single cell within seconds.

You may optionally have your Corona Pollentia maintain its natural state, with it only being located in your brain, but with the same benefits, making you no different from any other Parahuman.
objects.title: Deadpool+

objects.text:
Upon falling asleep or being unconscious your body will instantaneously heal all direct and indirect harm done to it, from tiny injuries to fatigue, lost limbs, to even fatal damage, it even heals damage caused by powers including your own like a thinker headache.

You can benefit from this at a much slower pace by closing your eyes or reducing the light you can perceive, a tiny cut would take 1 second, while a lost limb would take 30 seconds..
objects.title: Nightly Reset

addons.text: Your blood’s property of not counting as blood connected to you means that you now passively store any spare blood your body produces and actually use it as if it was the blood of another. Regeneration powers which increase the rate at your body produces blood would also increase the rate at which your storage passively increases.
addons.title: Self-Replenishment

objects.text: You can store blood in a pocket dimension within your body for later use now, and its effects are no longer temporary. Additionally, you are no longer capped at Endbringer levels of strength, though each increase gets progressively harder the stronger you get. Stored blood can be used for powers that need it like (Brute) Vampire and (Shaker/Striker) Viral Blood.
objects.title: Blood Bag

addons.text: As long as your feet are touching the ground, you will be able to find strength to lift anything. If you are unable to lift something, your power will activate to give you the strength to do so. This isn’t perfect however, as the more strength you lack to lift something, the more time it takes for your power to give you that strength. In addition, if you are able to lift an object immediately with your current strength, then the boost of strength from its weight will come immediately.
addons.title: Titan’s Bane

addons.text: Every second you carry something heavy, you gain a small, permanent boost in strength, endurance, and overall physical capability. The heavier the object you carry, the more significant the boost you receive. It accelerates muscle development and enhanced stamina, making you progressively stronger and more resilient. Not only does your physical strength increase, but your body also adapts to stress more efficiently, improving cardiovascular health, metabolic rate, and recovery speed.
addons.title: Carrying the Heavens

objects.text:
The force field around you now boost your strength when carrying heavy objects. The heavier the objects you carry, the greater your strength and speed becomes. Where carrying heavy loads would typically slow someone down, it instead boost your ability when you do so.

For example, you are able to lift a small car effortlessly. As you hoist it above your head, the field amplifies your muscles, making you not only strong enough to carry it, but also faster and more agile. The car's weight triggers the field to enhance your speed, allowing you to sprint at superhuman speeds while holding it, easily leaping over obstacles and covering great distances in mere seconds. While carrying that car, your punches can shatter steel, your kicks crushing the earth.

The boost doesn’t appear immediately, taking up to a few minutes to reach its full strength. The boost will only activate if you can already lift the object with your current strength.
objects.title: Weight of the Sky

addons.text: As long as your feet are anchored to the ground, you will have limitless endurance. You could carry something till the ends of time and not get tired from its weight. You will never buckle, unyielding to tiredness. In addition, the defence gained from your powers, both (Brute) Atlas and Beast of Burden included, will be shared with whatever you are carrying.
addons.title: Titanic Might

addons.text:
You can now lift non-solid things, vastly expanding the scope of your abilities. Air, water, and even intangible energies are now subject to your immense lifting power. You can manipulate vast volumes of water, creating towering waves or serene floating spheres, all with the same ease you would handle solid objects. You also gain a limited control over whatever you lift, Manton limited against working on people.

For example, with air, your abilities grant you command over the winds. You can create powerful compressed air, tornadoes, etc. Another example is that you can lift and gather light to create fields of darkness, or you could harness electromagnetic forces to disable electronic devices or create powerful electrical strikes.
addons.title: Burden of the Earth

objects.text:
The force field around you now boosts your endurance when carrying heavy objects. The heavier the objects you carry, the greater your durability and stamina become. This enhancement allows you to lift weights for far longer than normally possible, with your stamina increasing proportionally to the load. Additionally, the force field stabilizes your posture and reduces fatigue, enabling you to maintain high energy levels and focus for extended periods. With this augmented resilience, you can perform strenuous tasks without the usual strain, recovering faster from exertion and sustaining peak performance longer.

The boost doesn’t appear immediately, taking up to a few minutes to reach its full strength. The power will only activate if you can already lift the object with your current strength.
objects.title: Beast of Burden

objects.text: Ignition start.   Let the sparks ignite within your heart. May your veins surge with molten fire. Surrender to the inferno, let passion consume you—unrelenting, insatiable, ever-burning. Something within you has changed. Your body has undergone a profound metamorphosis, a transformation fueled by the very essence of combustion. At the core of it all lies your Ignited Heart, the roaring engine that now governs your lifeblood, regulating and refining the volatile power within. No longer merely human, you are a living jet engine, sculpted into humanoid form—your biology rewritten, your anatomy reforged to sustain and harness the unyielding force of ignition. Your blood is no longer a passive river flowing through your veins; it is fuel—a high-energy, combustible substance capable of unleashing devastation. In its liquid state, it burns hot enough to liquefy steel within moments. Aerosolized, it becomes an explosive of terrifying potency, each vial comparable to the yield of a Hellfire missile. Regardless of form, your blood ignites on command, needing only a visible connection to combust into searing destruction. Your body now bears the unmistakable hallmarks of your transformation. Inlets and exhaust vents have formed across your frame, running along your arms, elbows, hands, fingers, calves, heels, and feet, each one an outlet for the power raging within. The most critical of these lie at the center of your chest—tubes extending from your torso, linked to vents along your back and shoulders, ensuring optimal thrust, air compression, and fuel mixture. These modifications are not mere aberrations; they are the conduits through which your might is realized. Be mindful—your jet propulsors are not mere enhancements; they rival the raw power of modern fighter jets, scaled down to a human frame. Their flames will melt steel and reduce most materials to cinders within seconds. If left unchecked, you risk devastation in your wake. Beyond propulsion, your exhaust vents can also expel streams of pressurized, burning blood, turning them into weapons as much as tools of mobility. Maintain them well—neglect will breed complications. With your newfound mastery, you can selectively ignite individual limbs, propelling yourself in short, violent bursts. Each step, each movement, can be fueled by controlled detonations, granting you staggering speed and force. However, your true power lies in Heartfire Mode—the ultimate expression of your abilities—The Apex of Ignition itself. When engaged, the turbines embedded in your body awaken with a deafening roar, sending out waves of searing heat and thunderous sound that devastate everything within a 100-meter radius. The world around you burns, the air trembles, and you ascend—propelled by the sheer ferocity of your thrusters, achieving nominal flight. In this state, you move with the velocity and maneuverability of a supersonic jet, capable of toppling buildings and outpacing the fastest aircraft known to man. To sustain such power, your perception has evolved, granting you enhanced kinetic vision—a sharpened awareness that allows you to process motion at extreme speeds, keeping up with your own movements. Furthermore, your regeneration has been drastically accelerated—one that, while strong, will have trouble regenerating limbs, taking you days to properly accomplish the feat, compensating for the immense strain that your abilities place on your body. But even you are not limitless. Heartfire Mode is a double-edged sword. The immense strain it places on your body will rapidly deplete your fuel reserves, overheat your ignition core, and push your frame to its absolute threshold. It is not a state meant for prolonged engagement. Instead, it is an ultimate move—one to be wielded in decisive moments, when overwhelming force is the only path to victory. Master your flames. Control the inferno. Become the storm that burns through the sky.
objects.title: Promethium Vitae

addons.text: Your ability to cause damage concurrently throughout whatever you hit can now be augmented by the ability to cause an instant implosion simultaneously throughout every atom within whatever you hit. This also has the strange effect of causing a huge demonic skull-like visage made out of cracks behind whatever has been struck.
addons.title: The Death

objects.text: Your left arm has undergone an evolution in form and strength now able to access a new stronger, even more attack-oriented form. The “armored skin” of your left hand now sharpens into blades giving you more of claws than fingers. This comes with the bonus that your ability to cause damage equally over a surface area is enhanced to the point that any damage caused on one area of something through this arm is now damaged at every instance over or in whatever was struck. Additionally, the strength you can exert with your left arm has now reached new levels equaling that of Alexandria as you can lift in the hundreds of thousands of tons with effort.
objects.title: Left Arm of The Devil

addons.text: Your “shield” appears to be a much more viable weapon as you can launch powerful beams from your arm. However, this beam, if charged, would begin producing “exhaust” from the back of your shield showing how much it has charged up and reflecting its capacity for damage, this charging process would rapidly get to the point where your blast could cause damage to Endbringers. However, you could also use the charged “exhaust” to augment a punch turning your invincible arm into an invincible rocket punch.
addons.title: The Direct

objects.text: Your right arm has undergone an evolution in form and strength now able to access a new stronger even more defense-oriented form. Your right forearm’s “armored skin” stretches and fans out into a badge-like shield. This comes with a bonus of your “shield” arm becoming invulnerable as its defense becomes comparable to Alexandria’s as a type of stasis rather than a mundane form of invulnerability. However, this invulnerability is centered only on your arm and no other body area. Additionally, the strength can exert with your right arm has now also reached the levels of Alexandria as you can lift in the hundreds of thousands of tons with effort.
objects.title: Right Arm of The Giant

addons.text: You possess the capability to completely nullify any powers that come into direct contact with your skin. Additionally, if you are fully within a hostile environment, such as deep underwater, you gain enhanced healing that can recover from any kind of injury. This includes regenerating from wounds, burns, lost limbs, and other physical damages.
addons.title: Load Bearing

addons.text: You can now purge all power effects and Master influences on objects or people within your radius, as well as extend your radius to 10-meters. If you are in a hostile environment, this ability will protect others and provide them with the means to survive, such as supplying oxygen or granting immunity to memetic hazards.
addons.title: Filtration

addons.text: If you are in a hostile environment, such as a natural disaster or the depths of the ocean, you gain the full benefits of Desperation even if you are in a stable mental state. If you are also in an extreme mental state, Desperation is further improved.
addons.title: Thalassophobia

objects.text: Even if your skin is breached, you remain unaffected by environmental hazards or targeted effects. Powers, such as Thinker, Master, and Trump powers, cannot be used on you unless they also possess enough force to at least break your skin. Any effect that does not injure you cannot affect you. In hostile environments, such as underwater, you can explore just as well as on land. Your senses are not hindered by things like darkness, and you can move just as fast as you can run, allowing you to explore dangerous environments with ease.
objects.title: Pressure Hull

objects.text: You aren't limited to being topped out at 50x maximum human potential; instead, you will become 50x stronger. If you find yourself below the maximum capabilities of a human, don't worry, for you will still be able to reach 50x the maximum human potential.
objects.title: Real Pumped

objects.text:
The impact of your final attack shall never fade. Once inflicted, the damage from this final strike cannot fully heal, leaving a permanent mark on your target as a reminder of your power. For ordinary individuals, this means that the wound from your last attack will stubbornly refuse to close, lingering as an unhealing injury that resists all attempts at natural or medical healing.

For those with regenerative abilities, the effects are equally unavoidable. No matter how advanced or rapid their healing powers, they will bear a permanent scar from this final attack. Even those with extreme powers over their own biology—such as biokinesis or high-level shapeshifting—will find that they cannot erase this mark. The scar remains untouched by any form of manipulation, possession, or self-reconstruction. This scar will forever become a weak spot, as their regeneration will be slowed if not outright removed at this spot.

This does not enhance the raw power of your final attack beyond its initial buff.
objects.title: Lasting Legacy

objects.text: You can use your powers through your constructs, like shooting Blaster powers using their mouths. Compatible powers can additionally be channeled through a Liquid or Gas—with the Liquid version also working through the blood and fangs of the constructs—, you could quickly fill a room with a Tattletale Gas that tells you information about anything it touches or shoot a torrent of Traveller Liquid that burns things. The Liquid/Gas can additionally be Poisonous/Venomous.
objects.title: Toxic Power Channeling

objects.text:
As long as your Phylactery stills exists you can't permanently die. Dying merely turns you into a invisible and intangible presence that cannot interact with the world nor go far from your Phylactery, and eventually you will resurrect, regaining your original body. The shorter the time you needed to create your Phylactery the longer you will need to resurrect, the opposite is true, the longer the creation took the less you need to wait. If you have multiple Phylacteries through Horcruxes the resurrection time will use the one who took the longest to be made.

Don't despair, you don't need to expend your entire time as a unseen presence bored out of your mind, you can retreat into your Phylactery to sleep until the time you will revive, remaining unconsciously aware of anything happening around the Phylactery.
objects.title: Wannabe Lich

objects.text: The truth is, everything already is your Phylactery, they are merely deactivated, and the creation of a Phylactery is actually you awakening one of them. Since you are awakening instead of creating, the time needed to awaken a Phylactery is half of its creation time and the negatives you would've suffered when creating them no longer exist. If you die without having a awakened Phylactery a new Phylactery will be awakened, which does means your resurrection time will take a bit longer because you will need to wait for the Phylactery to be awakened for them your resurrection timer start. You are still limited to only having a single Phylactery if you don't have Horcruxes.
objects.title: Inevitable

objects.text: Rather than evenly spreading incoming damage across your entire body, you direct it toward the most durable and least vital areas, minimising the risk of critical injury. This significantly reduces the chance of sudden death from accumulated damage.
objects.title: Focused Protection

objects.text: And now you don’t have any requirements! Even if only a single cell remains, you will continue to live and heal! If you’re reduced to just a cell, the first thing to come back won’t actually be your head, but instead your spine—then your skeleton, then muscles, and right before skin, your brain. Have fun!!!
objects.title: Life Is Pain

objects.text:
Instead of Pollentia and Gemma you have a small, spherical core in your brain, about the size of a marble. This core is basically indestructible, requiring something on the level of String Theory's drivers or an Annihilator to destroy it. So long as this core exists, you won't die. Ever.

You are capable of thinking and using your powers so long as this core exists.
objects.title: Itsy Bitsy Endbringer

objects.text:
You not only empower but also diminish. 

What this means is that you can amplify the overall abilities of you and all your allies by however many of you there are, while diminishing your opponents by the same factor. 

Your rate of improvement is also massively increased, each additional member treated as a +1x multiplier to the group. 

Ten of you would see you and your allies amplified 10x over, smarter, stronger, faster, your abilities more potent, while your enemies would see them diminished by the same factor, weaker, slower, less potent, etc. 

In order to be considered allies you and another merely need to share some kind of goal or see each other as some allies of some kind. In order to be considered enemies they merely have to work in opposition to you or be considered one by you. 

You can keep this from effecting certain targets if you wish and can toggle this effect entirely, but if left on it’ll work indiscriminately, even those you may not be aware of, affecting all those that aid or hinder you. 

In addition to this, you and your allies seem to find yourselves incredibly in sync with one another, almost as if you were one person, seemly able to intuit each others intentions and actions and changes without even communicating and operating seamlessly. This can be selective and dialed at will.
objects.title: Quantity Has A Quality All Its Own

objects.text:
The stronger and tougher your body is at base, the more energy you’re able to store. Your physical condition directly increases the size of your reserves, allowing you to stay enhanced for longer or push harder before running out of energy.

Your recovery rate also affects how quickly your energy comes back. If your body naturally heals quickly or recovers stamina faster than normal, that same speed now applies to your energy regeneration. The faster your body bounces back, the sooner your energy refills.
objects.title: Well of Aura

objects.text:
Your wool has become much stronger and even gains some new attributes. The wool has gone from being able to take trucks crashing into you, to being able to withstand attacks from Endbringers! Of course, this is assuming melee attacks and the like. But on top of that, the wool has also impacted your muscles. Connecting to the nerves painlessly, you now have access to heightened strength! If you were in a fight with an Endbringer and you hit as hard as possible with your wool-covered limbs, you could take off 3 layers in one attack.

The negation properties of your wool have also strengthened. Even Blaster powers and, when your head is encased in wool, Master powers have been reduced. If they had absolute mind control, you could instead fight it off with a strong enough will or other defense. A Blaster with Pyrokinesis would simply give you a toasty feeling while you stand in a blaze of fire.
objects.title: Black Sheep, Have You Any Wool?

objects.text:
You evolve into a vastly more efficient destroyer.

You can now sense structural weaknesses in any non-Manton limited target. These weaknesses appear to your perception as visible fault lines, internal stress cracks, or pressure points. Your body then automatically targets these weaknesses with your attacks, whether you are striking directly or applying indirect stress. 

For example, you can see the hidden fault lines running through a brick wall before you punch it. You could also sense the internal stress lines spiderwebbing through a support pillar just by looking at it. Your fists, feet, or even your shoulder will naturally adjust mid-motion to land exactly on those vulnerable points.
objects.title: Wrecker

objects.text:
You become a surgeon of ruin, able to demolish with microscopic precision.

You have gained perfected control over the amount of force and stress you channel into structural weaknesses. You can now dictate exactly how a target fails, down to the smallest detail. For example, you could stomp your foot at a specific point on the ground with a precisely measured amount of force. That stomp would create a single hairline fracture that grows in only one direction, snaking across a parking lot. The fracture would avoid certain areas while targeting others, eventually causing a nearby building to tilt and fall exactly where you want it to land. You could also tap a glass window so that it shatters outward in a perfect circle rather than cracking randomly, or kick a load-bearing column so that the floor above collapses in a slow, controlled sequence.

This extends to delaying or staging destruction across time. You could place a small, precise crack into a dam wall that remains stable for hours, then return later to add a second crack that causes the first to propagate catastrophically. This lets you cause failures to appear natural or accidental, since the cracks and breaks follow genuine structural logic rather than looking like brute force damage. A building you demolish can be made to look like it collapsed from age, weather, or poor construction rather than parahuman intervention.
objects.title: Demolition

objects.text: Your Immunity Frames aren't limited to the same type of attack. Any time you take damage, you will become immune to all damage for 1 second.
objects.title: Universal I-Frames

objects.text:
Your body no longer merely behaves like steel—it is formed from living composite alloys that retain the function of flesh, blood, and bone. Your structure carries the strength, density, and resilience of advanced metals, with your blood existing as a molten, metal-like fluid that continues to circulate and sustain you. You are harder, heavier, and more durable than before, with your strikes carrying the weight and impact of dense alloy rather than simple steel.

As your heart rate rises, your body temperature rises with it. The hotter you get, the faster and more flexible you become, your blood flowing more freely and shifting through the colors of heated metal. Your performance is tied to your overhaul health and mental state, improving as you settle into combat and dropping if you lose conscious.

This heat also drives your regeneration. Damaged areas soften, glow, and fuse back together as your body reforges itself. You can speed this up by forcing damaged sections back into place, physically reshaping yourself to recover faster. As your temperature builds, your body begins to radiate heat, making contact increasingly dangerous and allowing your strikes to burn and deform what they hit.

External sources of energy that would normally heat or stress a body instead feed directly into your system. Fire, radiation, electricity, and even the heat generated from impacts are absorbed and converted into internal heat, letting you reach higher-output states without needing to build it up through exertion alone.

You now also extremely heavy, highly conductive, and susceptible to strong magnetic forces but generate the mass of your body ex-nihilo.
objects.title: Living Alloy

objects.text:
Should you absorb or consume the blood of a parahuman, you can now temporarily gain a one-to-one copy of their powers in addition to enhancing your physical attributes.

The duration of a copied power is directly proportional to the amount and quality of blood assimilated. As a baseline, one pint of freshly drawn blood would be equal to roughly twelve hours worth of use. There’s no hard limit to how many powers you can possess simultaneously although their duration will eventually expire.
objects.title: Jus Sanguinis

objects.text: You will be able to now revive anywhere between 10 seconds to 1 month after dying. When brought back to life, you will appear in a safe spot.
objects.title: Revive

objects.text: The user will be able to now gain one charge every week, and have no limit on capacity. The user can gain charges faster by being in near death situations (combat) without dying.
objects.title: Immortal

objects.text: You may now spend a charge to forcibly activate Rebirth while still alive. This causes you to instantly die and be revived as per normal. This is useful if you get trapped in a Grey Boy loop, forcibly transformed into a rock, or are otherwise subjected to a fate worse than death and can't simply kill yourself normally. This power now also activates automatically if you are rendered permanently comatose or otherwise incapable of consciously doing anything against your will such as by being frozen in time or being reduced to a vegetative state while still technically being alive.
objects.title: Spontaneous Rebirth

objects.text: You can now absorb four elements at once. They have separate pools for stockpiling, but they can be used together.
objects.title: Elemental Master

addons.text:
Your body isn’t just thin and flexible anymore. Now, it is fully foldable, with you capable of manipulating your form as if it were made of paper. Every part of your body, from your head to your toes, can be reshaped with precise folds, letting you transform, shapeshift, and compact yourself with nothing but a thought. You could, for example, crease yourself into geometrical layers to reinforce your own durability, or turn your arms and legs into folded, natural blades.

By ‘pressing’ yourself further flat, you could make yourself invisible to an enemy while running directly at them, or fold into yourself recursively to store kinetic energy that can be released when you stop holding onto the folds. With creative folding, you could even turn yourself into a paper airplane that could actually glide quite a fair distance. Naturally, the power comes with all the necessary secondaries that would propel your usage of it to its full potential: superhuman proprioception, an instinctual understanding of geometry, and the like.
addons.title: Origami

objects.text: The thickness of your Breaker state is now even further reduced significantly, down to roughly the level of most commercially available paper: Naturally, this greatly increases the flexibility and force multiplier of your Breaker state, elevating you from just ‘mildly’ superhuman to a solidly mid-level Brute/Mover. In addition, should your durability be high enough through Brute powers, you could even exploit the thinness of your form to use your own body as a makeshift bladed weapon or cutting tool.
objects.title: Paperman

objects.text:
The thickness of your Breaker state has been reduced one last time, to just about 0.01mm; down to the point of rendering you so thin that you start to become transparent, that you would be carried away by stiff breezes if not for retaining your mass.

In your new Breaker form, you've breached into high-level Brute/Mover territory, able to shrug off the vast majority of conventional personnel-level weaponry, run and climb as fast as high-speed trains without losing control or precision, and use your body to cut through softer materials like plants even without enhancements from other Brute powers- and potentially saw through or chip away at harder substances, if you tense your body right.

Additionally, this new thinness means your ability to contort and fold is even further elevated to absurd levels, vastly increasing your stealth and exploration capabilities to the point that only powers or completely sealed objects could deter you. You could even reliably fire yourself like a bullet, if you knew how to contort and flex your body properly.
objects.title: World's Flattest (Wo)Man

objects.text:
Instead of only flattening your body in one direction, you can now also compress yourself along a second axis, transforming into a near line-like state.

This exponentially amplifies your physical strength, durability and speed as your mass and force are proportionally concentrated into a far smaller volume. In this form, you are a high-level Brute: able to puncture steel with a single strike, move faster than the eye can follow and take hits from anti-tank weaponry.

It also greatly enhances your flexibility, mobility and concealment to the point you can slip through a mesh of security wiring, hide in tiny crevices and become almost imperceptible from certain angles. You can alter your compression, reshaping and resizing to suit any situation.

Notably, this synergizes with any upgrades that further reduce your Breaker state's thickness, allowing you to thin yourself beyond all conceivable constraints and push your abilities to the height of superhuman extremes.
objects.title: Stick Man

objects.text: As a logical extreme to your ability to compress and flatten, you've now unlocked the last limits on your power and can compress yourself in all three dimensions, down into a small "dot" an inch in diameter - roughly marble-sized. While in this third state, you gain a minor supplemental Mover ability while it's active; you can mildly shift and "bend" your mass as needed, as well as expanding or contracting to a two inches or a quarter-inch in size, to use your massively enhanced strength in such a bizarre form, allowing you to roll and "jump" around with the full breadth of your frankly absurd compressed attributes. With this, you can now exert levels of force that firmly puts you in the high upper-class of capes, though actually fighting back competently will take decent training: Your strength still isn't quite enough to compete with a highly-ramped Lung, but both he and capes like Alexandria would struggle to meaningfully pierce your durability - though this is still no protection from All-or-Nothing effects outside of dodging and hiding. With Paperman, your base size is shrunken down to a quarter of an inch, and with World's Flattest (Wo)Man it is further reduced down to just 1/16 - roughly equal to a grain of sand. With the Origami addon as well, your degree of "flexibility" is roughly doubled as well.
objects.title: The Point

objects.text:
Your Breaker state now has an additional 10 SP to spend on powers for each purchase you make. You can only choose powers from the Tier 2 and Tier 3 sections if you have the proper Shard ranking.

In addition to the additional SP to spend your Breaker states now also gain the ability to fly free of charge!
objects.title: Stronger Side of The Coin

objects.text: You have gained yet another Breaker state with alternate powers. You can spend up to 10 SP on powers for this form (excluding Breaker and Changer powers). You don't have access to your other powers in other forms.
objects.title: Another Side Of The Coin

objects.text: Your Breaker State can now have Changer and Breaker powers.
objects.title: Versatile Side of the Coin

objects.text:
Instead of being powers held by your Breaker State, your Changer and Breaker powers can now instead be part of it. You choose whether it's all or specific ones.

They still consume the budget, but you now have less transformations to worry about.
objects.title: Chimeric Side of the Coin

addons.text: Your mist undergoes a transformation, merging with your wendigo form. It now radiates an intense, bone-chilling cold, causing a thin layer of frost and even snow to accumulate on everything within its reach. This mist grants you an almost omniscient awareness of all things within its bounds, allowing you to perceive every movement and detail. Moreover, the mist no longer relies on your physical presence to be sustained. The longer you maintain the mist in a specific area, the longer it can persist independently, with this duration extending even further as the mist absorbs the stamina and energy of others.
addons.title: Snowy Fog

objects.text:
Your Wendigo form has been altered, granting you access to a few new abilities.

You can now choose to partially transform, rather than fully becoming a Wendigo, manifesting weakened versions of your Wendigo traits without needing to alter your appearance. You also gain a heightened senses of intuition and perception that enable you to hunt and predict the movements of your prey.

You can gain minor mutations from any form of organic matter you consume, with multiple feedings required to gain a noticeable boost unless the creature is non-mundane. Consuming animal parts bestows their abilities, such as slight night vision from an owl, a minor enhancement to smell from a bloodhound, or limited aquatic capabilities from a fish. Eating specific plants can provide minor benefits like photosynthesis for energy, slight camouflage from chameleonic plants, or minor toxin resistance from poisonous flora. Abilities gained from these mundane mutations can only reach up to a maximum of 2 SP.

Consuming parahumans or non-mundane creatures, such as bio-tinker creations, allows you to absorb up to 10% of their powers. The extent of this gain depends on your inherent synergy with the powers and the level of assistance you received in hunting your prey—the more help you had, the less you gain. Acquiring similar powers can create synergistic effects, enhancing your abilities further.
objects.title: Wittikka

objects.text: You now possess the ability to locate and phase into “Out of Bounds” areas—those hidden, non-existent spaces that lie beyond the intended boundaries of the world. These areas are normally inaccessible, but you can slip into them at will as long as you reach an entrance. Once inside an Out of Bounds area, the rules of reality break down, allowing you to traverse great distances, bypass obstacles, or remain undetected by enemies. These spaces can also act as secret caches, where you can store items or trap foes in a place where they can’t escape. These spaces are blind spots for average shards, Endbringers and Entities can find them, even access them depending on their powers.
objects.title: Out Of Bounds

objects.text: When you possess an object, you’re able to animate and control it as if it were an extension of yourself. This means that a statue you possess can move, shift, and perform actions under your control. Similarly, other inanimate objects can be made to exhibit motion or behavior beyond their typical function. For instance, a book can open and turn its pages, a chair can walk across the room, or a clock can tick backward. The extent of this control is limited by the object's size, complexity, and concentration. You are also no longer injured if the item you are possessing is damaged. You still cannot possess living beings.
objects.title: Possessor

addons.text: Your explosion now includes esoteric effects from bombs you have made before. You don’t have control over what bomb effects will be used. The strength of the effects will be based on the strength of your explosion. After reforming, you will be temporarily immune to the esoteric aftereffects.
addons.title: Esoteric Self

objects.text:
You now have access to a reservoir of energy that gradually builds over time. This energy can be spent to amplify your explosive power, enhancing both the range and intensity of your detonations. Each time you reform, your energy generation temporarily increases by 10%, and while this bonus stacks, the rate of increase diminishes with each stack.

In addition, your base explosion is now tied to your physical strength and size. The stronger and bigger you are physically, the more devastating and far-reaching your explosions become. The blast radius and force scale directly with your physical might, allowing for greater destruction with minimal effort. As your explosions grow in power, they require less energy to boost, making you more efficient and deadly as your strength increases.
objects.title: Self Destruction

objects.text:
Your ability to superimpose yourself has mutated, allowing you a new ability. 

You are simultaneously one person and a hundred people. Every action you take is not just the effort of one individual, but as if a hundred minds and bodies are seamlessly working together in perfect harmony.

When you think, it's as if a hundred brains are processing information, analyzing every angle, and synthesizing the best possible solution. Every word you speak carries the weight of a hundred voices, resonating with the collective wisdom, experience, and perspective of your entire inner team. When building something—each piece is placed with the precision of a hundred hands, each measurement calculated by a hundred minds. The planning, the construction, and the final details are all handled as if an entire team is at work, but it’s just you, effortlessly coordinating every aspect.

This ability doesn't allow you to do a hundred things at once; instead, it ensures that everything you do is supported as if a hundred people were behind it. Every action you take is amplified by the collective strength, skill, and focus of a hundred individuals. When using this ability, you cannot perform multiple actions simultaneously on a quantum level.
objects.title: A Company

objects.text: You can now bestow properties of your other powers to the energy in your Energy Well. For example, if you have (Striker) Wither, you can make your energy have the “decay” property and make it decay anything it touches.
objects.title: Energy Valve

addons.text: You can even drain more esoteric forms of energy such as magic, chi, and life force, as well as convert energy from your Energy Well into them.

objects.text:
You have become an energy vampire of sorts, able to drain any energy you come into contact with and use it to refuel your Energy Well - or any other form of internal energy used for powers. Additionally, you can drain past the point of refueling and overcharge yourself, boosting your strength temporarily until you run out of excess energy.

The speed at which you drain energy is fast enough to protect yourself from most energy-based threats like fire or lightning or do things like touch someone and stop them by draining their kinetic energy. You can also drain energy through manifestation of your energy, such as beams which sap the energy of anything they hit. It also becomes easier to convert energy from your Energy Well into other forms of energy like heat or electricity, especially ones you have already absorbed.
objects.title: Darkstar

objects.text:
Your shard has restructured part of your existing Energy Well so that, instead of functioning purely as continuous output, a portion of your power is condensed into discrete units known as Motes. These are not raw energy, but stored resolution potential—power deliberately withheld to be spent at decisive moments.

Spending a Mote forces a single action to resolve. For that instant, the shard does not discard the action due to immunity, suppression, timing constraints, or scale mismatch. An attack can deal damage where it normally would fail. A defense can stop something that should be unavoidable. The opposing effect still applies, but it does not negate the exchange. The action happens once, cleanly, and then normal limits immediately reassert themselves.

The number of Motes required scales with difficulty. Minor rule violations—such as landing a hit through layered durability or reacting during a suppressed window—may cost a single Mote. More extreme actions—parrying an attack flagged as unavoidable, harming a heavily protected target, or acting through multiple overlapping constraints—require progressively more Motes. Attempts to force resolution against absolute effects, compounded defenses, or overwhelming scale mismatches quickly become prohibitively expensive and cannot be sustained.

Motes do not increase strength, range, or output. They do not overpower opposing abilities. Instead, they prevent hard failure, ensuring the shard treats the action as valid rather than null. Movement, damage, or interception occurs even in situations where it would normally be denied, but only for that specific exchange.

Your total Mote capacity is finite and regenerates gradually, with recovery accelerating during rest or low activity. Excessive expenditure temporarily stalls regeneration and induces heavy internal resistance, making movement and power activation feel sluggish and weighted. This strain is uncomfortable but non-damaging, and fades as the reserve stabilizes.

With continued use, practice, and shard approval, you may unlock limited extensions of this system: brief persistence of a resolved effect, conditional triggers that expend Motes automatically, or forcing a single action to resolve across multiple targets. These extensions remain tightly constrained, always confined to short windows and isolated interactions, preserving the reserve as a tool for decisive moments rather than sustained dominance.
objects.title: Essence Reserve

objects.text:
Instead of only being able to move along a fourth axis, you now become a four-dimensional being. Your biology no longer obeys the limits of three-dimensional space.

Your body extends into the fourth axis, meaning that only a strange cross-section of your silhouette and geometry will ever be visible for most others, the only parts of you capable of interacting with the world. You can rotate parts of yourself along the fourth axis, letting you bypass obstacles, change shape to evade or lockpick by physically manipulating the pins, and reposition and ‘slough off’ regular three-dimensional wounds or power effects.

Your perception has become similarly enhanced, allowing you to perceive mostly in full what you could see in 3D, like taking in all of a person from the pattern on their shoes to the inside of their hoodie.

Lastly, due to your nature as a fourth-dimensional being, your shadow has also become three-dimensional, allowing you to puppet it around using specific movements to allow for bluffs or just… really good shadow puppets by making it shapeshift.
objects.title: Axiomorph

objects.text: You can now use your power in two ways, Return and Restart. Return works almost exactly like the base power, allowing you to go back up to five minutes by replacing your past self in totality—which means while you retain your growth and anything you were in possession of, things like injuries and fatigue will also remain. While you can spam Return, you can't go back farther than five minutes from your original future. With Restart, every five minutes a save point is created and replaces the previous one—it follows the time of the world and not you personal one, so Return doesn't affect when it will be created, through your save point will change to match what it was supposed to be at the time. This save point can then be leveraged in two ways, at will or by dying. Regardless of which condition you used, your mind replaces your past self from that save point—as such, it retains anything solely related or confined to the mind.
objects.title: Autosave

objects.text: Your gain the ability to control secondary elements related to your main element, like ice and mist for water elementals, or manganese and cobalt for an iron elemental.
objects.title: Greater Elemental

objects.text: You gain control of one more element.
objects.title: Additional Element

objects.text:
Your Gamer Body now operates like a game with a notoriously exploitable physics engine. Rather than obeying real-world biomechanics, your movements are governed by a set of game-like rules filled with quirks, unintended interactions, and "bugs" that can be reliably exploited through skill and practice.

You can bunny-hop to build momentum, strafe-jump, preserve velocity through sharp turns, perform instant 180° pivots, edge-slide, crouch-slide, vault impossible obstacles, and abuse terrain geometry to move in ways that ignore conventional biomechanics. With practice, you may uncover entirely new "exploits" unique to your own physics engine.

Likewise, your interactions gain a game-like abstraction. You can manipulate objects, open doors, operate machinery, or pick up items without precise physical contact, provided they are within normal interaction range. Your body also ignores many forms of movement interruption, allowing you to continue acting through impacts, recoil, and lesser injuries that would normally stagger or interrupt others.

Like any good speedrunner, the better you understand your own engine, the more tricks you can discover. Some may border on the absurd, but none outright violate the underlying rules of your power.
objects.title: Physics Engine

addons.text:
You will never need to worry about a Friend permanently losing their power growth if they are ever killed or destroyed. If a Friend is revived, all of their accumulated power growth is fully preserved, no progress is ever lost.

However, the standard limitations still apply as you cannot alter, enhance, or otherwise modify a Friend’s power unless you possess a Trump ability. Likewise, if a Friend is destroyed and replaced by a new one, the previously accumulated power growth cannot be transferred to the replacement unless you have a Trump ability that explicitly allows it.
addons.title: The Friendbringer Engine

objects.text:
Your new Friends can now have 15SP of powers (or 20SP with Negentropy), with a maximum of three powers each. You can only choose powers from the Tier 2 section if you have the appropriate Shard rank and cannot pick any of the Endbringer powers, Doll Master, or Friendbringers. You can strengthen/weaken powers from the list to a different cost or substitute them for powers of equivalent strength that aren't listed.

They can also have flight for free at their ground speed. If one of your Friends is destroyed, you can have them revived instead of creating a new one. When a new Friend is created, you can choose their appearance and powers.

Once a Friend is created, it is not possible to modify their powers unless you have a Trump ability that allows you to transfer powers between individuals.
objects.title: Improved Friends

objects.text: Each purchase allows you to design an additional Friendbringer.
objects.title: More Friends

objects.text: Each purchase increases your Friendbringers total strengh by 5SP and the maximum amount of powers by 1.
objects.title: Even Stronger Friends

addons.text: You possess a subtle master/stranger effect that enhances how people perceive you based on your presentation. As a general, you exude an authoritative voice and presence, even when speaking softly and while lying in bed. If you're portraying yourself as a typical student, one of your traits will become your defining "personality" to others, regardless of whether you act in a manner contrary to that trait. This ability effectively counters the Pint-sized drawback age attention, ensuring that people take you seriously, irrespective of your age.
addons.title: A Mask, A Presence

objects.text: Your sphere of power has expanded even further, now enabling you to operate on a planetary scale within any type of governance system, whether it's social, organizational, or political. You gain expertise in all the skills necessary for your role and can enhance the abilities of the employees under you. This places you at the pinnacle of leadership, whether in governments, monarchies, businesses, or smaller roles such as research or platoon leadership. No more paperwork problems at least.
objects.title: The Mastermind

objects.text: Instead of an exact copy of yourself, you can create a different appearance for any of your clones. This is limited within the possible range of whatever species you are or any combinations of races, beings, or minions that fall under your abilities. Instead of just granting each clone a copy of all your abilities, you can decide to assign specific ones instead and alter them on a whim.
objects.title: Multi Faced

addons.text: Your power has grown. Now, you are able to choose if you wish to make it impossible to lie or to simply know whether someone is lying, telling half truths or full truths. From there, you can twist it. If someone claims to have survived a war (a truth), you can make it so that this is a lie in their head, or if someone said that they dislike fighting (a half truth), you can make it a truth and turn them into a true pacifist. This fabricates the necessary memories to make the truth make sense to the target. This doesn’t give/take away any skills, instead the memories gained will explain away on why they have/don’t have certain skills. Perhaps that while they never were in a war, they picked up fighting from the streets, or they are a pacifist due to gaining an enlightenment.
addons.title: Someone is Lying

objects.text: In your presence, no one can tell a lie. This power is retroactive, making it that any statements said in your presence must be followed, no matter what. If someone said they will kill Butcher in front of you, they will do so, even if they don’t want to. This doesn’t magically increase their capabilities, so you can’t just have someone say they will kill an Endbringer and expect it to work.
objects.title: The Truth and Only the Truth

addons.text:
Truth is unalienable. It is the foundation our reality is built, aids in parsing our experiences, and helps us orient ourselves. 

This is now a tool. 

You can twist the truth and lies within the hearts and minds of humanity within your World, turning a declaration into an incontrovertible truth they’ll act upon regardless of compliance, turn a lie into a truth on a dime on their innermost thoughts and beliefs, a half-lie to a truth to make it “real” on the liar’s eyes. Their minds assist with this with memories and suitable shifts in their personality. 

This exposes them to what they are to blame: Being liars. A Truth they’ll keep to the grave. 

Exposing them to others’ Truth causes them to unravel both physically and mentally by the constant incongruency between who they assume to be and who they actually are. 

What does a liar do when he’s dead?
addons.title: He Lies Still

addons.text:
Your power can now be offensively utilized, weaponizing Ego Stripping through either personally confronting the person vitriolically or diplomatically of their lies, causing both psychic and physical damage depending the person. The more deep-rooted the lie the more severe the damage can be. Among the effects that tend to appear are: psychological feedback by tearing apart different pillars of the Ego that keep the target from seeing and internalizing the Truth such as projection, abstraction, binary identification, among others; painful stings of pain across the body reaching to outright tearing the body apart (this scales according both the target’s refusal and depth of lie), etc.

Extreme cases of using this have the target's Ego Death as a consequence.
addons.title: Shadow Confrontation

addons.text: People within your World aren’t open only to their personal and surrounding truths but most of all, they also understand their context and subtext, particularly their emotional and psychological factors. It is forcefully putting them into a process of Jungian Integration, but a form of heartless improvement; clashing and melding both the unconscious and conscious Psyche without the authentic effort from the victims. False enlightenment.
addons.title: Individuation

addons.text:
People within your World aren’t open to their personal and surrounding truths but most of all, they also understand their context and subtext close by their emotional and psychological factors; this is propped up through both a sense of clarity and sharpness guiding their path, so is finding an Imago Dei to aspire towards, letting themselves to a genuine process of Integration, it crystalizes or leads up to a genuine Individuated Self, a grounded form of enlightenment, so to speak…

Fulfilling the power’s end goal.
addons.title: Imago Dei

addons.text:
It has been long since the Curtain of the Hidden and Unsaid unveiled itself for the world to see. 

Until now.

You ring up the curtain to the True Shape of all Things, people are unwilling participants in this play with your World being a getaway to this reality. It plays up as an antithesis to SEP (Someone’s Else Problem), the mind’s inability to tear their gazes away from a car crash knowing the outcome and be consumed by curiosity that leaves a mark on their minds, they are urged to See what the World hides behind a veneer of secrecy, bestowing everyone within your World a perception gazing deep to anything they look around, what secrets it holds, the sins that occurred on a place, are among the many horrifyingly enthralling discoveries they will encounter within your world.
addons.title: Lifting the Dusted Veil

addons.text: The Truth Hurts, admitting it is the first step for Repentance. Your World now doesn’t have a filter on how hurtful a Truth can be to someone, the more guarded they are against it the more agonizing it is to a person. Emerging from this synergy, Truths concerning guilt, wrongs, and concepts generally associated with acts to others causing all scopes of pain are undertaken and revealed in your World for all to see, and for them to come to grips with. This can range from a misdeed or sin they did with no acknowledgment or acceptance on their part, to your World forcibly causing them to experience the Truth and the Pain it caused.
addons.title: Repentance

objects.text:
Your power’s range and area have greatly expanded to the size of 3 to 5 blocks depending on populational density. It also extends to open anyone within your range of others’ truth concerning them, especially those connected to the user by parental or fraternal bonds. This, successively, reaches out to those familiar or fraternal bonds and applies it against the user and vice versa. 

A brutal version of exposure therapy and psychoanalysis. A World where lies are left behind, leaving only the Ego/Self confronting itself for its lack of acceptance.

You gain a lengthened understanding of others’ unconscious and internally repressed truths accompanying the external truths relating to them, no matter if it’s their family or friends' thoughts or opinions concerning them. They are also incapable of lying in spirit, as your power compels them not to fall back on pretense, rationalization, or self-delusion about anything to communicate within your World and force the person to process and internalize the Truth whether their compliance is or isn't a factor. It has the consequence of permanently healing delusional mindsets, cognitive distortions, and deep-rooted rationalizations.
objects.title: World of Revelations

objects.text:
You can change the appearance of the Scepter of Power into another type of portable object -- such as a book, gauntlet, or even another type of staff -- as long as the form factor remains roughly similar. This change is purely cosmetic and does not change how the scepter functions.

If you had gained the capacity to create one-use translucent shields using a Shield, and then changed expression and it turned into a one-use skintight forcefield, you would be able to freely switch between both.
objects.title: [Thingy] of Power

objects.text:
The power expression of a object is recorded, allowing you to quickly switch the power expression of a object to any one you had previously.

If you had gained the capacity to create one-use translucent shields using a Shield, and then changed expression and it turned into a one-use skintight forcefield, you would be able to freely switch between both.
objects.title: Remembrance

objects.text: Remembrance becomes an Archive for your power expressions, allowing you to access all of them even when you no longer have the object that made them. Though you can't make more power expressions nor amplify it if you don't have the object.
objects.title: Archive of Expressions

objects.text:
Now the strength of a power expression is influenced by the object that is absorbed by the Staff but it will never be weaker than what Scepter of Power gives as a base, instead adding to it. The expression of a power is also affected by powers that a object has by itself like something augmented by (Trump) Enhancer.

The Staff now has 3 Strong slots and 9 Weak slots, gaining a new weak slot every month and a new strong slot every three months. The Staff can create 9 yellow crystal Orbs that can go 1km apart from itself. You can use yours senses through those Orbs and they can be linked to a slot allowing a power to be used through them, this will change the Orbs appearance to align with the object and power it is linked to.

The Staff can now share its durability with you and it can withstand 3 punchs from Alexandria without breaking. You can link a Non-Staff power to a Strong slot, amplifying its strength as if it was a power from the Staff.
objects.title: Royal Scepter

objects.text: Needing your Staff to have constant contact with something in order to absorb it would normally be annoying, but now its no longer the case because you can now bind an object to a slot. Objects bound to a slot will count as being in contact with the Staff even if you let go, which allows you to absorb larger things by just letting the process keep happening in the background. Trying to fill a bonded slot with a different object will interrupt the process.
objects.title: Attachment Issues

objects.text: Those influenced by your power now can preach the good word, spreading a memetic desire to worship you and propagate your teachings. Direct exposure leads to a permanent bond of reverence, while indirect exposure, such as through the preaching of those affected, can be overcome with avoidance over time. However, even if freed from the memetic control, individuals remain oblivious to any shift in their behavior or the implications of their previous actions.
objects.title: Evangelism

objects.text: The threshold required for your power to take effect is much lower. Now only a positive interaction is required for it to take effect.
objects.title: Adoration

addons.text:
Due to being present at multiple locations, you can swap your copies with each other or your main body at will. Furthermore, you can swap something one copy sees with something within the range of another copy. For example, if one body is perceiving a target, you could swap them with your main body (or clone) which is located inside a secure containment facility.

Your position control ability also extends to objects. You can also influence the 'state' of objects after you swap them. If you swapped with someone while you were standing up, you could choose to be sitting down, reading a book after the swap. The change in state is Manton Limited, applicable to only yourself or inanimate objects. You can use this to change the direction, action, momentum, etc. of objects but cannot directly change their position after the swap. If you have any other teleportation or space warping powers, they also gain this trait. 

Finally, you gain a minor thinker power to sense the mass of all objects and people in a 10m radius around you, to help you determine if you can use position control. If you have other thinker powers which extend your perception, such as (Thinker) Byakugan or Mind's Eye, your mass sense extends to that range.
addons.title: Web of Tricks

addons.text:
Your ability to gain the processing power of your bodies has gained a massive increase in potency, rendering your previous accomplishments laughable. You gain the processing power and computational capacity equivalent to an unchained Dragon, though still less versatile since you are not an infomorph. You could simultaneously have hundreds of conversations at once while still being able to analyze thousands of micro-expressions of each of your conversation partners.

Your mind has become alien, as the puny mortals are unable to comprehend your vastly superior thought processes. It is difficult for thinker powers to predict your actions, and simulation shards often just give up because they don't want to waste the energy trying to simulate your mind. Master powers also rarely function against you, as one body being compromised would barely affect your thought processes. 

You always have the maximum processing power of your entire 'pool' of bodies, even if you do not actually have any bodies created.
addons.title: Laplace's Nightmare

addons.text: Your afterimages now do not have to repeat your exact action, and you can instead control what they do. You can preset this before you create the afterimage, or control it in real-time as the afterimage is created. The afterimages also stick around for longer, lasting about 5 seconds before fading.
addons.title: For the Swarm!

objects.text:
Rather than being simply clones, the copies you create are now simply "yourself" but present in multiple locations at once. You now share all senses and thoughts, allowing for your copies to act as extensions of yourself. Your clones are also far less fragile, now requiring multiple attacks or a solid hit from a Brute before going down. You can still dispel these bodies at will. You now gain the combined processing power and learning ability of all your bodies at once. 

You now have a "pool" of power which you can distribute whenever you create new bodies, so you can have specific avatars you create be stronger than others. Your maximum amount of avatars has also increased to 200. If you focused the entire pool into one body, it would be equal strength to you (though still far more fragile). If you split the pool evenly among 200 bodies, they would all have ~1% of your combat power, but still have all of your senses (including power granted ones), utility abilities, thinker powers, processing capacity, etc. at full strength.
objects.title: Amon Syndrome

objects.text: Each individual can perform two deliberate actions per turn instead of one. Additionally, synergy actions are introduced, which are automatic responses triggered by specific conditions or actions taken by others. For example, if an ally is attacked and their health drops below a certain level, a healer can automatically restore some of their health. Similarly, a counterattacker can respond instantly to an enemy's strike, or an ally can assist with additional attacks when another ally engages an opponent. These synergy actions do not count towards the two regular actions per turn.
objects.title: Extra Action

objects.text:
Your Shadow has evolved into a Shade, gaining a few abilities. First, it can now directly engage and attack other shadows, inflicting physical damage on the person or creature that casts the targeted shadow. This ability effectively allows your Shade to strike at foes from a distance or even in total darkness. Additionally, your Shade can consume other shadows, a process that not only harms the original owner but also transfers their strength and vitality to both you and your Shade, enhancing your physical abilities and extending your Shade's reach and potency.

Moreover, by consuming a shadow, your Shade gains access to the memories and experiences that took place within that shadow. This means that by devouring the shadow of a person or creature, you can uncover their secrets, learn about their past, or even gain insights into hidden locations or plans. The more shadows your Shade consumes, the stronger and more knowledgeable it becomes, gradually evolving into a powerful entity with its own reservoir of collective memories, drawn from the countless shadows it has devoured.

As a final ability, your Shade can now cloak itself in the shadows it consumes, allowing it to adopt the appearance, size, or even the behavior of the shadows it has eaten. This makes it an excellent tool for deception, infiltration, or laying traps, as your Shade can disguise itself as a seemingly harmless or mundane entity before striking.
objects.title: Shade

objects.text:
Your clay creations are now capable of not only mastering a skill at "birth" but also continuously improving that skill beyond its initial level. The base proficiency of their skill is directly influenced by your own expertise in that area, meaning that the stronger your skill, the more advanced the starting point for any newly created humanoids. These creations enhance their skills at an accelerated rate, far faster than any ordinary being, even without needing to practice, simply by performing tasks, engaging in challenges, or even existing in certain environments.

As they operate, these humanoids continuously refine and sharpen their abilities, reaching levels of mastery that would take a human years to achieve in mere hours or days. Additionally, if multiple humanoids possess related skills, their proximity and coordination can lead to cross-pollination of techniques, resulting in new hybrid skills or advanced strategies that can also be transferred to you. Upon unsummoning or death, all the improvements the humanoid has made to its mastered skill are instantly transferred back to you, including any unique techniques or insights it developed. This transfer process is seamless, allowing you to wield the enhanced skill as naturally as if you had trained for years. This doesn’t mean that you become equal to your creation, as you only gain a portion of the enhancements it developed.
objects.title: Clay Specialist

addons.text: As the creations continue to hone their skills, their minor abilities will evolve, becoming increasingly refined and potent over time. If they are unsummoned or destroyed, and you create a new clay figure with the same skill, the power of these abilities will slightly diminish but retain the progress made, allowing the new creation to quickly regain and further build upon its predecessor’s advancements.
addons.title: Specialist Clay Parahuman

objects.text: Your clay creations now develop minor abilities that align with the specific skill they were given at birth, enhancing their effectiveness in unique ways. For example, a creation made with the skill of archery might gain enhanced vision or the ability to intuitively read wind patterns or even an ability that makes their arrow accelerate the longer it’s in the air, while a creation specialized in martial arts could develop heightened reflexes or the ability to sense an opponent’s intentions or superhuman strength and regeneration. These abilities are tailored to complement and amplify the core skill, making each creation not just a master of its craft but also equipped with specialized talents that give it an edge in various situations.
objects.title: Clay Parahuman

objects.text: Your minion can have an additional 5 SP to spend on powers for each purchase, the existing limitations regarding powers still apply; this upgrade allows you to choose powers of Tier 2 or above if you have the proper Shard ranking.
objects.title: Revenant

objects.text:
Beyond controlling machines, your brain now operates as a hybrid of biological and computational power, granting you enhanced cognitive and cybernetic abilities. You can upload, download, and create complex programs directly within your mind. Your mind can act as a server, storing vast amounts of digital information, which you can compartmentalize into mental “files” for easy retrieval. 

You can instantly download knowledge, data, or skills by connecting to external databases, networks, or even other cybernetically enhanced minds. Memory or skill acquisition is instantaneous, but complex information takes time to integrate fully. You could develop programs within your mind to enhance your thinking processes, allowing for mental simulations, calculations, and predictive modeling. These mental “apps” can function like advanced AI, advising you or automating tasks. You can even act as a hub for nearby devices or electronic systems, connecting and controlling them, turning them into relays for your control, allowing you to bypass your previous range limit. You can become a network access point, enabling connected devices to share data through you, as well as give you control over all of them.

However, processing too much data at once can lead to mental fatigue, equivalent to the effects of sleep deprivation. Additionally if someone gains unauthorized access to your brain, they could exploit it as they would a hacked device, risking information leaks or mental manipulation. Lastly your “meaty computer” is vulnerable to digital threats. Low-level viruses are easily neutralized or ignored by your brain’s natural filtering, causing minor inconveniences. Advanced threats such as tinker-designed malware pose risks equivalent to memetic hazards and master effects, potentially disrupting your mental systems or causing memory corruption.
objects.title: Techno Brain

objects.text: If the target dies through the strain of their hearts, the Heart Demon can fully manifest, gaining their host's abilities, warped by the negativity the Heart Demon is made of. The Heart Demons are loyal to you, however this loyalty isn't absolute. They can and will disobey orders, especially when it goes against their nature (which for most Heart Demons include positive acts). If you have Regrets Behind You then the manifested Heart Demon will be far stronger, even gaining whatever reward their host would have had if they had succeeded.
objects.title: Demon Possession

objects.text: Now if you wish you can make a different variant  of Heart Demons. These can give a greater reward for defeating them, at a dangerous cost of failure. These Heart Demons are more aggressive and stronger, meaning if you are too weak willed it is likely you will die in a few hours in pain and agony. However, if you manage to defeat this specific type of Heart Demon, you will gain a boon. For people who has no powers, they will Trigger and gain one tailored to the trauma they moved passed. For people with powers, their powers gain a major boost in strength and gain thematic boosts based off their trauma, which for Parahumans is likely their trigger event.
objects.title: Regrets Behind You

objects.text: You have shed one of your former limitations. Now, in the event of your death, your clones will remain active. If at least one clone survives for a period of 24 hours after your passing, you will "revive" by either reabsorbing all active clones into a new vessel or inhabiting the last remaining one. When absorbing a duplicate, you may also choose to consume them to heal yourself or to retain them, restoring an empty duplicate slot within your daily limit of 10, allowing you to summon them once more. However, if the absorbed clone has already exhausted their own daily limit, they won't be able to duplicate themselves again, even if you were to resummon them. Finally, you can now tap into the senses of your other duplicates—though this is one-way, as they cannot access yours.
objects.title: Human Tide

objects.text:
Your control over thrown objects transcends typical limitations, including the Manton effect, allowing you to manipulate living matter in proximity to the object. Additionally, any object under your influence remains in a "flight" state as long as it is moving relative to the Earth. This includes being stationary on a moving bus seat or embedded in a living being's body.

Your mastery over the field is extraordinarily fine-tuned, enabling you to influence the muscles and nerves of a person if an object like a pen or coin becomes embedded in their flesh. This level of precision extends to manipulating brain functions by directing objects to interact with specific regions. For instance, you could affect logic and reasoning by targeting the frontal lobe, influence memories by interacting with the hippocampus, or alter emotions by stimulating the amygdala.
