The only restriction is that the object/person must maintain movement.
objects.title: Embedded Influence

objects.text: You can now make three clones which look completely identical to you. They no longer have a range limitation and instead expire five minutes after being summoned, with a cooldown as long as the duration they were summoned. They can follow a set of instructions once they’re created, though you no longer have direct control over them after making them. They still can’t affect anything, but can follow instructions like screaming when finding an enemy, clapping their hands every five seconds and other such behaviors, though they can’t remember more than three such instructions. These clones produce twice as much smoke when dispelled than before.
objects.title: Bunshin no Jutsu

objects.text:
Your power is now constantly on, though surprisingly it doesn't automatically take control of sapient beings, instead it now needs consent from those beings in order to allow you to control them.

Essentially, it will constantly tell them why it/you is asking for control—which manifests as a pleasant buzz in the back of their mind if they aren't paying attention to the information—and what your power can do, and if they accept your power will tell you why and you now have control over them. They can telepathically speak to you while under your control and take back their consent anytime—with it being the only for you to release them.

In compensation for you no longer being in able to solve your problems by just walking towards them, once someone consents you can control them regardless of distance—with your 10 meter range merely being just the range you initially need to take control. Non-sapient beings can also go beyond your range without exiting your control.
objects.title: Consent Matters

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to just telekinetically manipulating objects with your instructions; now you can verbally animate almost any non-sentient physical phenomena you encounter.

Whether it's the roaring flames from a fire, the air itself, the light filling a room or more esoteric physical forces like Parahumans' Shaker or Blaster effects, they will all obey your directives.

Anything you command will act with the intelligence of an average adult human, intuitively understanding and interpreting your orders as intended. While they can make limited decisions within this framework, they remain non-sentient and lack personal initiative, being unable to act spontaneously beyond the scope of your orders.

You could command electricity to dance the tango or have the ground beneath your enemies sunder, all according to your spoken word. Keep in mind that the magnitude of the phenomena you can influence and wield is still based on your own strength.
objects.title: Animatus

objects.text: Your commands no longer fade after an hour—they persist indefinitely, remaining active until you choose to dismiss or overwrite them. These commands now function best when structured like a program: logical, modular, and capable of executing conditionally based on predefined triggers or instructions. Objects still lack initiative or creativity, but you may now embed sequences of conditional behavior, loops, and responses to simple stimuli (e.g., “If door opens, move to intercept” or “Repeat this motion until instructed otherwise”).
objects.title: Program

objects.text:
Dreams no longer pull you in—you step into them willingly, body and all. You don’t fall asleep to walk among dreams anymore. You cross over, fully awake, bringing the real with you into the unreal. Your physical form passes through the veil, and anything you carry passes with you—clothing, tools, weapons, artifacts, even entire packs or items held in hand.

But more than that, what you bring can stay. If you leave something behind—drop it, plant it, hide it—it remains within the dream. Not as a memory or an echo, but as a permanent fixture in the dreamer’s inner world. The next time they sleep, it will still be there, waiting exactly where you left it. A blade on a table. A photo in a drawer. A book that now always rests by their bedside, no matter the dream.

These objects become part of their dreaming reality. The dreamer may not recognize that it wasn’t always there—may not even question it—but it will influence them. Maybe subtly. Maybe deeply. A message scratched into the back of a mirror. A comforting item they start to rely on. A strange device they grow curious about night after night.

You can build, stockpile, or plant things in their subconscious over time. You can even create recurring meeting places, returning to find your belongings exactly where you left them. You can even store objects inside people’s dreams—using them like living, unconscious vaults. Hide weapons in one person’s mind, documents in another, treasures in a child’s recurring fantasy forest. No one but you can retrieve them, and no one else will know they’re even there unless you bring them in.
objects.title: Fluid Like Dreams

addons.text:
The dream world is no longer just a place to explore—it’s a road. You can now use your dream hopping not just to move between minds, but to physically travel. Enter through one dream, and when you exit into another, your body comes with you. You will awaken beside your new target in the real world, no matter how far away they are.

Distance, walls, oceans—none of it matters anymore. The world sleeps, and you walk its secret roads.
addons.title: Path of Dreams

objects.text:
Distance means nothing in dreams now. It no longer matters where you are in the waking world—or where they are. Once you’ve entered a single dream, you can use it as a stepping stone to travel deeper, further, stranger. From within one sleeping mind, you can now leap into others, moving from dream to dream like walking through connected rooms in a house built from sleep.

The dreams themselves provide the path. If the dreamer you’re currently inside imagines, remembers, or simply dreams about someone else—if that person appears in the dream, even in the background—you can lock onto them. That imagined presence becomes a door, and you can step through it into the real sleeping mind of that person, wherever they are in the world.

But you don’t need to wait for the dream to offer a path. You can create one.

Through subtle influence, you can shape the dreamer’s thoughts—steering their dream, guiding their imagination, nudging them toward dreaming of the person you want to reach. The more familiar the dreamer is with your target—emotionally, visually, or through memory—the easier it is to bring them into focus. Once your target appears, even if just for a moment, the connection is formed, and you can slip through it into the real mind behind that image.

Of course, your target must be asleep and dreaming. If they’re awake, unconscious, or in a dreamless sleep, the path will fail. But if they are dreaming, you’ll find them waiting, unaware of the bridge you just crossed.

You can use this method to cross vast distances, hopping from mind to mind, dream to dream. Each dream connects to another through fragments of memory, imagination, or emotion. You could start in the dream of a friend, move to a stranger they passed on the street, then drift into the dream of someone that stranger once knew. With enough time, you could reach anyone in the world. Anyone dreaming, anywhere, is within reach—so long as someone else has thought of them.

This network of dreams is chaotic, full of dead ends and looping paths, but with experience and instinct, you can begin to chart your own routes. With enough finesse, you might even follow chains of connection back to people you’ve never seen or heard of—but who matter. Who needs to be found.

Do make sure to take care not to overdo this, as your physical body is still sleeping and will die if neglected for too long.
objects.title: Dream Hopping

addons.text: A bond doesn’t need to start in the waking world. Now, time spent within someone’s dreams also builds their aura—just as if you were beside them in reality. Even strangers you stumble upon while hopping from mind to mind will slowly begin to resonate with your presence if you linger. Talk to them, influence their dream, shape it around them, and the connection will grow. Given enough visits, enough shared moments in the sleeping world, even someone you’ve never met while awake will eventually develop a strong enough aura to let you enter their dreams freely, from anywhere. You may become a recurring figure in their nights—an unseen guardian, a phantom friend, or something stranger. They may not know your name. But they will dream of you. And through those dreams, the bond will deepen.
addons.title: Echoes of Contact

objects.text:
People leave marks on dreams—and you now leave a mark on people.

Everyone you interact with now passively begins to develop an invisible aura, tied to your presence. At first, it’s faint—just a spark from a passing conversation or a glance across the room. But the more time you spend with someone, the stronger this aura grows. Shared words, shared moments, shared memories—all of it deepens the bond, whether they’re aware of it or not.

This aura governs your influence over their dreams. At low levels, you can nudge their dreams more easily, subtly bend the tone or shape of their sleep without needing to be physically present. Their minds become slightly more open to your presence, and your dreamshaping comes with less resistance.

But as the aura strengthens—through deeper connection, familiarity, trust, or even shared conflict—so too does your reach. Eventually, when the bond is strong enough, you can enter their dreams from anywhere, regardless of where they are. No proximity is needed. If they are asleep, and if their aura is strong, you can simply reach out and step in.

You don’t need to be in the same room. You don’t need to know where they are. All that matters is the strength of your connection, and that they are dreaming.

Do note that by forgetting you or losing familiarity with you, this aura lowers and can even disappear completely.
objects.title: Dreaming of Friends

objects.text:
Your presence no longer needs to do all the work. Everyone who has fallen under your influence becomes an extension of your reach—a living, walking vector capable of spreading your ambient authority to others. As these individuals move through the world, they carry your social gravity with them, subtly reshaping conversations, dynamics, and group structures wherever they go. They don’t need to preach or persuade; simply by being there, they generate the same kind of shifting group alignment that first drew them to you.

The strength of this influence scales with the degree to which the vector has internalized your leadership. New recruits radiate a faint pull, enough to soften resistance and raise curiosity in those around them. But the longer someone has been in your sphere, and the deeper their transformation, the stronger their effect becomes. At their peak, your most loyal followers become full secondary nodes of influence, spreading the same ambient pressure and charismatic distortion that you do, indistinguishable from your own presence in how they shape others.
objects.title: Recruiters

objects.text:
You can now make a special type of Critter by squeezing together hard plant matter, like sticks or bark. This type of Critter is called a Commander. Commanders have the same basic body shape as normal Critters, but thinner, looking much like stick insects.

Critter Commander are far smarter than normal Critters, capable of distinguishing individuals, keeping complex if-then commands in mind, and even dynamically solving issues and working around unexpected problems.

Commanders can give other Critters new orders using chirps and squeaks, which they can also use to transmit information to each-other.
Commanders can pantomime, point, and write information down in any language you understand.

Commanders can still climb on walls and ceilings, and are faster than normal critters, but lack any meaningful carry capacity or strength.

Commanders last ten times as long before collapsing as normal Critters do.
objects.title: Critter Commanders

objects.text:
The speed at which the worms integrate into host brains has drastically increased. Now it only takes 24 hours for the larvae to grant access to sight, and only another 24 hours to grant full mind reading.

Additionally, the worms gain a 'next stage' of their lifecycle, which you have to manually trigger. They can only enter this next stage after they have been in their hosts for 48 hours and their host is unconscious. Upon triggering, the worms will induce in their hosts a 10-hour-long coma, during which they cannibalize, restructure, and replace parts of their hosts' brains.

When the hosts next wake, they will have massive memory loss, as well as notable loss of cognitive function (roughly equivalent to a 20-30 point IQ reduction in humans; for simpler animals, the effect is lesser). Additionally, they will be unable to feel or experience anything, except at the behest of the worms, which can invoke any sensations, emotions, or other feelings in their hosts.

Unfortunately, upon metamorphosing into this next stage, the worms acquire a finite lifespan—only lasting 3 weeks before they expire, taking their hosts with them when they do.
objects.title: Cerebriensis Dominans

objects.text:
You no longer rely on corpses to create your insects. While you can still use dead bodies in the same way as before, you’ve gained the ability to produce them directly from your own flesh. By shedding parts of your body, you can trigger the same transformation process that happens when you touch a corpse. The shed material rots and reshapes into your insect creations just as it would from dead flesh.

Your body regenerates whatever you lose, the process finishing within a day at most, though it drains your body’s nutrients while it heals. The bigger the shedded part, the more time and nutrients needed. Eating and resting speed up recovery. You cannot shed more than what your body can safely survive without. The pieces you shed separate cleanly, without blood loss or open wounds, leaving behind smooth, sealed flesh that begins regenerating immediately.
objects.title: Shedding Flies

objects.text: Poison Ivy’s biggest limitation is its reliance on existing plant life, well no more! You now possess the ability to induce floral growth anywhere in your range, even in areas where there didn’t use to be any. Hell, you can cause plants to grow where they shouldn’t be able to at all, such as flowers blooming in arid desert or vines sprouting from concrete.
objects.title: Overgrowth

objects.text:
Your mental siphoning no longer stops at 25% percent, in fact it doesn’t stop at all. While the cognitive drain you can impose on others starts at 25%, with every minute a target remains within your range that siphon increases by 1%. 

Similarly, the higher the drainage percentage, the longer the benefits last for you at a ratio of 1 minute per percentage. Meanwhile, the mental faculties of those you drain no longer recover instantly once they leave your radius and instead return at a rate of 1% per minute.

Be careful not to completely drain someone’s brain 100% as that will render them completely brain dead and likely kill them. However, in the event that you do completely drain someone then the increase in mental capacity you got from draining them becomes permanent.
objects.title: The Vacuous

objects.text:
When creating a Worker you may forgo the Stranger effect that gives them a background in your world, replacing it with a Stranger effect that expands the Worker's lack of self-preservation to others.

Other people when viewing your Workers will immediately realize that they are in fact not human, and will treat them as disposable minions made by your power, regardless of their obvious sapience and emotions. Only factors such as strategic value and courtesy may lead to someone preserving your Worker.
objects.title: Anti-Union

objects.text:
There is now no lower bound on how small a favor can be. Even trivial acts of everyday courtesy, such as holding a door open, saying “bless you” after they sneeze, apologizing for bumping into them or simply sharing some snacks with someone, can create a corresponding favor.

While such minor favors yield negligible influence and are inconsequential on their own, they can accumulate dramatically over time. To help exploit this, you can now also call in multiple favors simultaneously for a single request, using their combined influence to match that of a normal favor, or, in the case of several major favors, equal a life debt.
objects.title: Accumulated Debt

objects.text:
You may now treat any favor owed to you, regardless of its original significance, as equivalent to a life debt when it is called in. Once invoked, a favor exerts overwhelming influence, compelling an absolute Master effect over the individual for its duration.

Such favors are unequivocal in their execution, preventing individuals from resisting, reinterpreting or hesitating in carrying out a request to the best of their ability. You could make someone willingly commit actions they once found unthinkable or order them to fight to the death for you with no hesitation.

Affected individuals will still rationalize away their behavior and remain unaware that they are being influenced in any way. Despite the favor’s potency, certain powers may negate its triggered Master effect and all your requests must remain coherent, finite and within the person's physical capabilities.
objects.title: Life Debt

objects.text:
You tinker far faster than should be physically possible.

You also require fewer tools and equipment to do so, materials and components seemingly altering themselves to suit your design.
objects.title: Heterodyning

objects.text:
Your shard's manipulation of reality while you build Tinkertech has become even more blatant. Not only are components altered to suit your design, but you now unconsciously manifest small amounts of materials and energy out of seemingly nothing. Even space and time are subtly warped while you're in the midst of your tinker fugue, enabling you to tinker impossibly fast.

You can freely adjust how much your shard warps reality when tinkering. At a minimum, you're the same as a normal tinker
objects.title: Shard Spark

addons.text:
The loosening of your shard's restrictions on its capacity to manipulate the laws of physics while you construct Tinker tech has consequently also significantly boosted the level to which it can distort reality to maintain your Tinker tech.

Instead of its previous 50%, your shard can now meet up to 100% of your Tinker tech's basic fuel, energy and matter consumption demands to ensure it continues working. Furthermore, your Shard's ability to automatically repair your damaged Tinker tech has also improved. It is now capable of restoring and repairing any damage present, up to a total of 30% of your Tinker tech's mass, regardless of which components are missing or impaired.
addons.title: Tinker's Extended Warranty

objects.text:
Your shard's influence over your tinkering now extends to the tinker tech you create. Your shard will constantly support the performance of any tinker tech you make instead of just aiding your tinkering process. This includes providing limited automatic maintenance for your tinker tech, such as repair and cleaning, as well as partially supplying some of the basic necessary energy and materials for its continued functionality.

Your shard can provide up to 50% of any required fuel and matter for your tinker tech's sustained operation. Your shard's ability to repair your tinker tech extends to being able to restore up to 10% of the mass of any of your tinker constructs if they are damaged. As such, your tinker tech still requires sufficient traditional energy and material input to continue functioning, along with your assistance in the event of major damage or equipment failure.

A consequence of this effect is that anything capable of blocking your shard will also impact your tinker tech, returning it to operating as normal. This can be negated by Trumped the Trump. Excessively vast material and energy demands can potentially result in your Shard running out of energy although Negentropy or Shardless negates this.
objects.title: Tinker Shard Support

addons.text: These powers are affected by [SHARD OS UPDATER] through their connection to the tech tree that they are based on.
addons.title: Applied Technological Development

objects.text:
Now you also get a non-tinker power based on each and every power you’ve purchased that gives you access to a tech tree/the ability to build advanced technology.

These powers are based on the concept and functionality behind the tech tree in question, and are about as strong SP wise. An example could be (Tinker) Destruction giving a power very much like (Shaker/Trump) Still Aura but nowhere near as versatile being hyper specialized in destruction.
objects.title: Applied Technology

objects.text: All of your machines grow and adapt, assimilating new technologies and improve themselves. All upgrades are recorded and sent through the link, allowing the other machines to gain these upgrades as well as you knowing what and how these upgrades work, allowing you to create upgraded machines.
objects.title: Singularity

addons.text:
Your connection to your machines has become profoundly greater. You can now grant any of your machines the ability to use your powers without the need to transform them into biological entities. 

If you choose to transform them into biological versions, these entities gain even more advantages. They can now stay connected to you regardless of distance, maintaining a continuous link that extends your reach far beyond typical limitations. Additionally, these biological machines act as powerful relays. As long as any nonbiological machine stays within a 1 km range of a biological machine, they form a network that allows all connected machines to stay within your control link. 

In addition to these features, the biological versions of your machines have the ability to cannibalise corpses to directly create new machines from themselves. This gruesome capability allows them to rapidly self-repair, expand, and evolve by absorbing and repurposing organic material from fallen enemies or any available biological matter.
addons.title: Chosen Blood

addons.text:
The transformations of your machines are now even greater. Upon becoming their fleshy mechanical selves, they become two to three times more powerful than their base state. In addition to this, they also passively grow, with their flesh identifying and repairing faults within themselves. 

For instance, a defensive turret could grow additional layers of organic armor, making it far more resistant to damage. A scouting drone might evolve enhanced sensory organs, allowing it to detect enemies and resources from much greater distances. Combat-oriented machines could develop bio-organic weaponry, such as acidic projectiles or venomous spines, providing them with new and unpredictable attack methods.

Furthermore, the machines can adapt to their environments. A machine operating in a toxic swamp could develop resistance to corrosive substances and even utilize the toxins in its own weaponry. One operating in a freezing tundra might grow insulating layers of blubber and fur, becoming more resilient to cold and improving its stealth in snowy conditions.
addons.title: Bloody Machine Soul

objects.text:
You can now use any of your powers through your machines, even transferring your mind into them. To do this, you must transform the machine into a biological version of itself, composed of flesh, blood, and bone, containing your DNA. This transformation merges technology with organic material, creating a hybrid entity capable of channeling your abilities.

While you don’t necessarily need to transfer your mind to control these transformed machines, doing so allows for more precise and direct manipulation. Even if you choose not to transfer your mind, you will still be acutely aware of every sensation the transformed flesh experiences. This includes the constant agony resulting from your DNA not being inherently suited for such transformations. Fortunately, this power comes with enhanced pain resistance, allowing you to endure the relentless pain while maintaining control and awareness.

These biological machines retain their original functionalities, enhanced by your powers, and their new organic components give them a degree of resilience and adaptability that pure machines lack.
objects.title: Blessed Flesh

addons.text: Now, every time you start a fugue, not only will all tinkers in the area be effected, even others will gain weaker copies of all the tinkers powers. You effectively master everyone, including yourself, into working together to create a single piece of tech. If someone who was affected was a non-tinker parahuman, they will also gain a minor tinker variant of their own power while in the fugue state, losing it after everything is over.
addons.title: Explosive Fugue

objects.text: You are able to trigger a tinker fugue among yourself and others tinkers, having your shards temporarily connect to one another. You and the other affected tinkers will begin to work together to create something. This also loosens the restrictions on the affected tinkers' ability while they are in the fugue.
objects.title: Mass Tinkerer

objects.text: As long as the group follows your safety protocols, you can grant them various boosts and have an increased affinity for your tech. They can gain an extremely weakened version of your (Tinker/Thinker) Safety, allowing them to sense the safety of their surroundings as well as how to improve the safety.
objects.title: Safety First

objects.text: Your specialization extends to the application of physics, engineering, and chemistry to build objects on extremely small scales (Nano, or pushing it, a little smaller).
objects.title: Nano-Fab

objects.text: Not only you can fashion contraptions using sound or vibrational frequencies, but you can also use sounds and vibrations themselves in the form of music. It can range from record production to audio engineering surpassing conventional limitations, such as implanting subtle or overt Master effects within your work.
objects.title: Sound Engineer

objects.text:
You specialize in material gathering and processing, extending your expertise to encompass the creation of various industrial plants. This includes the development of processing plants, recycling facilities, refining structures, and more.

You could build volcanic foundries capable of refining lava into tons of pure metals every hour, massive offshore rigs that extract various minerals dissolved in ocean water, as well as more traditional automatic tunnel boring machines that could excavate every scrap of value from miles of earth in mere months.

This pairs well with any autonomous Tinker powers.
objects.title: Supply Chain

addons.text:
The technology you create is no longer just durable—it is truly indestructible, persisting until you personally disassemble it. Your inventions do not simply resist degradation; they actively adapt to survive any threat. Whether exposed to extreme temperatures, corrosive substances, or outright physical destruction, they will endure, learning from every attempt to destroy them. Even if thrown into a volcano or submerged in acid, your devices will emerge intact—and likely improved.

This extends beyond mere physical resilience. Any flaw, malfunction, or inefficiency encountered throughout an invention’s existence is analyzed and corrected, ensuring perpetual optimization. No problem is left unsolved, no failure left unaddressed. Even user error is treated as a defect to be eliminated, making your technology foolproof in the most literal sense. If someone misuses your creations once, they will never be able to do so again—because your designs will have already adapted to prevent it.

Your philosophy is simple: Dare the universe to make a better idiot. It won’t matter—because no one can be stupid with your technology twice.
addons.title: No Idiot is enough

objects.text:
You now have the ability to beef up your technology to unprecedented levels, such as ensuring it operates in perfect condition for centuries without the need for inspection even less maintenance.

You can direct these enhancements in a specific way without degrading the technology's base function. For instance, a cryo-gun could be enhanced to withstand the conditions at the center of a pulsar, though its resistance to cold remains unchanged. Similarly, a clock could be enhanced to display accurate time even within a black hole, though it wouldn’t be able to resist gravity inside the black hole while making everything better would make the clock work on the mantle of the earth or buried on the bottom of the ocean.

As an added benefit, you can choose not to enhance your tech in any specific way and instead make it immune to all-or-nothing effects. This means you could create objects capable of countering the Siberian, canceling the effects of Sting, or truly affecting Alexandria, though it still falls on the technology itself to stop the object once the effect of the power is cancelled, so a fragile shield can still be broken, even if it's All-or-Nothing attribute is cancelled. This immunity can prevent complete nullification or destruction of your tech by such effects. 

Additionally, the “Only Sith Deal in Absolutes” Perk can make all your tech have this effect without any cost.
objects.title: Immortal Tinker Methodology

objects.text: You can now improve all aspects of your Tinkertech, at the cost of giving it a crippling weakness. You could make a giant, death robot but it will have a clear weak spot at its chest.
objects.title: Achilles

objects.text:
You can fine-tune tinkertech to seamlessly accommodate its users. Whether crafting a sword perfectly tailored to its creator's grip, a firearm with a weight precisely suited to its wielder, or a user interface designed with the considerations of ADHD/Neurodivergence in mind, you adeptly enhance efficiency, usability, and comfort to meet the unique needs of each individual. With your adjustments, even an ordinary person wielding a tinkertech firearm can stand toe-to-toe with the prowess of an average soldier.

Do note that this type of technology is the antithesis of mass production.
objects.title: Personalised

objects.text:
When gears you make share a similar theme, combining them activates a set effect, enhancing their performance. The effectiveness increases the more items there are in the set, however, in exchange, the set effect can only activate when all the set gear are used.

This effect varies based on the theme of the set, offering tailored boosts for different gear combinations. For example, a Steampunk-themed set grants the power to be immune to and shoot out high-pressured steam. Another example is a Nature-themed set granting regeneration abilities as well as the ability to communicate with plants.
objects.title: Sets

objects.text: As you advance your understanding of technology, and discover new applications for that technology; your related powers will update with new capabilities based on that technological development.
objects.title: [SHARD OS UPDATER]

objects.text:
Your power has evolved to give you something akin to a 'memory' with regard to your Tinker specialisations and their respective technology. You can now operate, maintain, adjust and build any Tinker tech, regardless of your current specialisation, so long as you've built it at least once before. You can integrate and mix previously built Tinker tech from old specialisations into your new Tinker designs and vice versa with ease.

Through this 'memory', you can compile a wide-ranging foundation of Tinker tech from your previous specialisations, enabling you to better tackle any difficulty you come across. Your Tinker specialisation can now also be retained for a longer period of time, up to a maximum of 3 months, irrespective of whether the initial problem selected has already been solved.

If you possess a Vital Shard, you can potentially acquire Tinker specialisations that are equivalent to a Tier 2 Tinker power in strength and capability.
objects.title: Multi-Variable Tinker

objects.text: You now know how to make any mundane things up to 10 years in the future of Jack of All Trades database. Some things like the Wheel won't have any advancements. Any advanced tech you make is not blackboxed like normal Tinkertech.
objects.title: Mundane Savant

addons.text: Along with this, your limit in regard to how advanced you can make your AIs has been loosened. Now, with your Code specialization, you are able to make your creations with full sentience, up to the level of Dragon if you truly want them to. You could also simply make advanced enough AI that are so close to sentience, that they fool almost everyone into believing that they’re human.
addons.title: Machine Hearts

objects.text:
Your power to create robots has extended the reach of its database into a similar field of study, that being androids, automata, and other such machines that are human in appearance. The appearance of these androids (unless designed otherwise) will be able to fool even the most astute or observant of people into believing that they’re human, with only Thinkers, other Tinkers, and metal detectors being able to infer or uncover the truth. 
This upgrade synergizes well with many Tinker powers.
objects.title: FaeR: Automata

objects.text:
You are adept at identifying and exploiting the weaknesses of all capes. You can dissect their powers and vulnerabilities with pinpoint accuracy. You gather data on a cape’s power, combat style, psychological profile, and any known or hidden weaknesses. Once you have identified a cape's weaknesses, you can design and fabricate technology specifically tailored to neutralize or counteract them.

Whether it's a device that disrupts telepathic signals, armor that absorbs and redirects kinetic energy, or gadgets that exploit a superhuman's specific physiological vulnerabilities, your creations are unrivaled in their precision and effectiveness. Your technology ranges from simple, single-use items to complex, multi-functional systems, all designed with the singular purpose of neutralizing a specific target. For instance, if a cape has a deep-seated fear or trauma, you can develop a device that triggers illusions or sounds related to that fear, causing them to hesitate or lose control in battle. Or, if a cape is vulnerable to electricity, you can generate an electromagnetic field in their vicinity, saturating the area with high levels of electricity, disrupting their powers.

In addition to your technical prowess, your power also helps you to deploy these devices in the most opportune moments, ensuring maximum impact. You are not just a creator but a tactician, using your inventions to outmaneuver and outsmart even the most formidable foes.
objects.title: Utility Belt

objects.text: Rather than becoming a focal tinker, you gain the ability to greatly enhance technology you create, provided you dedicate yourself exclusively to it and its related variations. If you decide to shift your focus to a different technology, you can do so, but the more technologies you try to develop at once, and the more distinct they are from each other, the smaller the boost you’ll receive from this ability.
objects.title: Less Is More

objects.text: Not only can you build massive, robust structures with ease, but you can also now apply those same principles to smaller-scale designs. By choosing to scale down your technology, you can retain its durability, power, and resilience, while also streamlining its production. The catch? Anything you choose to miniaturize will be extremely dense and weighty. This added mass comes with substantial benefits: the heavier the tech, the stronger it becomes and the more straightforward it is for you to create. Compact mechas, heavy-duty armor, dense drones, and powerful hand-held devices are all within your grasp, each with the durability and toughness of their larger counterparts. Do be warned that most of your heavy tech might be unusable for many, even a simple handgun will weigh as much as an average adult male.
objects.title: Heavy Metal

objects.text:
You are able to transform your concoctions into aerosolised gases, enabling their effects to be delivered through the air. 

You can control the concentration and spread of the gas, tailoring its reach and impact to suit your needs. From precise, localised dispersal to wide-area effects, the flexibility in deployment significantly enhances the tactical value of your work.

The aerosolised form retains all the original properties of your potions but does not exceed their inherent strength. At best, the gases are only as potent as the potions you can already create, meaning you cannot amplify their effects beyond your existing capabilities.

Lastly, you also gain the ability to make gadgets designed to contain and release these gases effectively. These devices are tailored to your needs and include items such as pressurised canisters, timed-release capsules, smoke grenades, and environmental diffusion systems.
objects.title: Aerosolised

objects.text: Your expertise now extends beyond Tinkertech—you can understand, maintain and repair anything, no matter how complex or obscure. Whether it's a cutting-edge quantum computer, a blacksmith's forge, or an alien medical device, you can instinctively grasp its structure and function well enough to keep it in top condition. However, this does not grant deeper expertise in specialized fields. For instance, while you can maintain and repair a life-support machine, you won't gain medical knowledge needed to diagnose when it should be used. Similarly, you can refurbish a rifle, but won't instictively know how to shoot it accurately. Additionally, while you can understand what something does and how to repair it, this does not grant you the ability to craft it from scratch. However, this deep understanding makes reverse-engineering far easier. If you have the necessary knowledge and tools, you can significantly reduce the time and effort required to recreate or modify an object. This upgrade also enhances your previous ability to combine Tinkertech, allowing for smooth integration of non-Tinkertech components into hybrid inventions.
objects.title: Understanding, Maintenance, Repair

objects.text:
You are now capable of making devices that can rapidly transform the genetic structure and physiology of those they are used on between various pre-programmed forms. 

These devices can contain many different transformations of your design that they can rapidly swap between, but starting out your basic transformation watch will average a maximum of ten transformations.

These transformations may include cybernetics or even be entirely mechanical so long as they retain some form of DNA.
objects.title: Thinly Veiled Ben 10 Reference

objects.text:
Your biotinker specialization in creating life has expanded and now also allows you to make it so that your creations can take on two forms—a mostly inert form, small enough to fit within a pocket or capsule of some kind, and a larger form that is more oriented to whatever purpose you build them with.

Additionally, while your creations can shrink and grow, you are also able to develop them and give them powers, either based on yours (aside from this tinker power) or those of other parahumans, though this does require genetic samples of sorts.

You also now have a secondary minor specialization in creating launching mechanisms for your shrunken creations.
objects.title: Monsters That Come From Pockets

objects.text:
Your techbase has expanded; now, when you condense materials, you can further fold space and edit the dimensional structure of those materials.

This gives the materials in question multidimensional properties similar to Entities or Shards. This has several applications, as the uses for these materials also expand the more multidimensional they become. Say a multidimensional marble of iron might just be the perfect centerpiece for a portal gun that lets you travel to other universes, or a multidimensional brick of neutronium could let you make a reactor capable of powering a planet for a billion years.

Your power still doesn’t let you make black holes, even by accident.
objects.title: Super Dimensional Material Science

objects.text:
Instead of your devices immediately tearing themselves apart under the strain of overclocking, they first begin to overheat. By routing this excess heat into specialized sinks and dissipators, you can stave off catastrophic failure for as long as you can keep your inventions cool. As you overclock your devices harder, they generate exponentially more heat, making cooling - not raw durability - the new limit. With sufficient cooling, your tech runs hot but stable, pushing past its limits without melting down. But if you fall behind and the heat builds faster than it can be bled off, your machines will cook themselves from the inside out, or worse, turn into bombs.

This upgrade pairs phenomenally well with (Tinker) Thermal, allowing you not only to push your devices harder than ever, but to weaponize the excess heat in the form of searing-hot projectiles, focused thermal beams, or a flash of heat that melts armor and cooks anything behind it.
objects.title: Overheat

objects.text: If before you could only overclock your tech until it screamed for mercy, now you can underclock it—running systems so efficiently they practically nap through existence. Dialing performance down increases reliability exponentially, with some devices lasting functionally your lifetime at minimal output. Be warned: at the lowest setting, your masterpiece might need a literal jumpstart to wake back up. Practical uses include creating deep-sleep vault systems, long-life probes, self-preserving constructs, snarky potato-powered AI's, or emergency backups that will still be running when the cycle ends.
objects.title: Works Under 1.2 Volts!

objects.text:
You now gain the ability to create lab assistants that can either be in the form of basic robots or cybernetically and biologically augmented humans.

These lab assistants can be programmed to possess mental copies of your Tinker specialties. This allows you to manufacture artificial Tinkers with a high degree of independence from you. 

You just program these artificial Tinkers with the blueprints and Tinker knowledge you want them to possess. This ability to decide what blueprint and knowledge to give these robots or augmented humans essentially allows you to give them variations of your own specialties, though you can’t grant them capabilities you yourself don’t possess. But give them enough technological know-how and they could easily iterate creating new knowledge and technology.

The only real restriction on this upgrade is that the Tinker power or aspects of a Tinker power you are making a copy of has to actually revolve around knowledge and building stuff manually. As such these copies won’t possess any additional abilities tacked onto that knowledge you might have like “Might Make Other Tinkers Mad” ability to manifest Tinkertech out of thin air.
objects.title: Basic Lab Assistants

objects.text:
The symbiotes you create are no longer constrained to being non-intelligent; they can now develop into fully sapient creatures.

These entities can feasibly possess intellect up to, or even surpassing, that of an ordinary person, demonstrating strategic independent thought, advanced memory recall and creative problem-solving capabilities.

You can shape these symbiotes’ cognitive processes and personalities to suit your needs, such as engineering a swarm intelligence, instilling predatory instincts or biologically hardwiring them with unwavering loyalty to you if desired.
objects.title: Evolved Minds

objects.text: You are now capable of making Faster Than Light (FTL) technology. This primarily manifests as making FTL vehicles capable of traveling dozens of light-years within hours. Despite the destructive potential such speed promises, you’ll find that this Tinkertech is incapable of physically interacting with outside matter when traveling at FTL speeds, allowing you to hit a planet at FTL in a ship and safely phase through it. This upgrade also includes the ability to create FTL communication equipment and FTL sensor technology to communicate and navigate over such vast distances. The forms of FTL your technology revolves around are not affected by the time dilation such speeds would usually be subject to. Meaning a FTL drive you build will keep a 1:1 time synchronization with the normal passage of time. When taken with a Shard power origin, you’ll find this upgrade is still restricted by your Shard’s range limitations, meaning without some workaround, you’ll lose access to your Tinker powers when past that range. Your tech will still work, you’ll just lose the capability to maintain or build Tinkertech at such ranges. One final thing to note is that this upgrade only covers FTL technology by itself, and that "the rest of the owl" to build a proper spaceship, like anti-grav or life support, isn't included. So you could build an FTL car or plane pretty easily, but the holy grail of a spaceship needs another power to fill in the gaps or cooperation with other Tinkers.
objects.title: Faster Than Light

objects.text:
Your Tinker speciality has taken on a far more conceptual focus; that of comfort in all its many forms.

Whether it is inhumanly perfect thermal comfort to warm or cool the soul, psychologically pleasing visual aesthetics, clothing optimised for ideal tactile and pressure satisfaction, scents and smells that elicit contentment or sounds that encourage positive thought patterns, this speciality is surprisingly versatile.

This speciality also encompasses ease and pleasure in equal measure, letting you create devices centred around reducing personal day-to-day hardship and stress as well as inducing satisfaction and enjoyment in a more direct manner.

This may take the form of small servant robots that anticipate and attend to your every whim, massage machines that methodically relax all the muscle tension in your body, comfort foods engineered to literally melt in your mouth or even devices that directly evoke nostalgia, reassurance and emotional comfort into your brain.

Note that there can be addictive effects from overuse due to the parahuman levels of comfort caused although you may adjust this so that none of what you make leads to permanent addiction.
objects.title: A Comfortable Life

addons.text: The speed at which you tinker is increased even more, specifically to 100x faster than the average Tinker. If the greatest Tinkers of all time came together to form a pantheon, you are undoubtedly this pantheon's equivalent to Hermes/Mercury through the speed of your output alone. Not only is the (still reckless) strategy of tinkering mid-combat more viable than it's ever been, but you excel with it in such a way that you could be considered an A-Class threat purely by the merit of you and anything around you being effectively considered as your personal workshop. If you start tinkering on a van with nearby scrap, then by the time the PRT arrives, the entire van could have been finished being converted into a hovercraft with low-end camouflage.
addons.title: Tinker Trismegistus

objects.text: The already ludicrous speed at which you tinker is further increased. Now you tinker 50x faster than the average Tinker. If it was ever debatable before, it is now undeniable that when it comes to the tinkering process, you are the Fastest Tinker Alive. What was once a reckless and possibly suicidal strategy is now... notably less hopeless, even if it still is reckless at the end of the day.
objects.title: Tremendous Tinker Time-Saving

objects.text:
Any item built using the Jack of All Trades database may now be constructed using an optimized design process.

When building an object, you gain a pool of 100 design points that can be allocated across its characteristics. These include reliability, power output, mass or volume, efficiency, material cost, durability, or similar attributes.

Each point represents a proportional improvement. You may heavily specialize—such as producing a missile at one-hundredth the normal cost, one with one-hundred times the power, or any combination in between. For example, you could build a laser that is slightly more energy-efficient while being drastically more powerful or compact than standard designs.

Design points may be distributed across individual components rather than the device as a whole. However, components enhanced this way are treated as separate targets for effects that interact with powers or enhancements. If a battery is built with vastly increased capacity while the rest of the device is enhanced normally, external powers would affect each component independently.
objects.title: This Little Thing?

objects.text:
Your tech has grown to encompass far more in terms of what it can manipulate as well as what form it can take. Make a grenade that can cause a miniature thunderstorm, an assault rifle that can fire hail. Even armor that can repel all weather phenomena. Against Leviathan, you'd be able to make technology that could dispel his Tsunamis with a sudden heat wave that literally evaporates the water.

This even extends to unknown ways to manipulate it. Like being able to control animals via their weather-based instincts. Use an electrical storm glove to direct bugs under (Master/Thinker) Skitter's control, or a machine that can activate a dog's infrasound detection and prevent Hellhounds from attacking you.
objects.title: Weathergod

objects.text:
Your shard is wholly dedicated to the concealment and protection of information. Any encryption, authentication, black-boxing, or anti-tamper method you create is reinforced, making it effectively immune to reverse engineering through both conventional means and parahuman abilities.

Thinker powers, memory extraction, simulations, predictive models, clairvoyance, and similar effects can never recover the underlying design. Even Endbringers cannot simply query the shard for answers, forcing them to reverse-engineer your work manually like anyone else.

Only the Entities themselves can override your shard's restrictions, making them the sole exception to your otherwise absolute secrecy.
objects.title: (Tinker) Perfected Encryption

objects.text:
Now your capabilities have expanded much further into training. Specifically, you have vastly expanded on the drug side of thing into a semi-vague Medicine path. From a pill meant to reduce your Lactic acid build up to nearly imperceptible levels, to a syringe injection to make your pain receptors only react in truly needed situations while working out, and far more.

Not to say medicine is the only expansion, as your weights and overall equipment now CAN accommodate powers equally while expanding. Put a Brute/Changer able to grow super arms and let him punch bigger and bigger targets to make his fists even harder. Give any form of a speedster a super treadmill that goes faster and faster with them. 

Even Thinkers can now be given equipment in the form of you being able to make equations and problems for them to solve (Although you yourself will not remember what the answer is if it's something you don't naturally know). Masters and Strangers, you can build artificial intelligences that can be affected by the power, allowing them to train the intensity, duration, and utility of the power. Other categories, you can build more and more technology built around training their powers.
objects.title: Juice em' Up, Roid em' Out!

objects.text:
Instead of wearing a single cape’s full costume, you can mix and match attire from multiple parahumans to create hybrid costumes that let you wield several powers at once.

The strength of these granted powers is proportional to how much a person is visibly wearing that cape’s costume. So long as at least 20% of your body is covered in parts of their attire, you might wield their powerset as if wearing the full outfit. Below that threshold, however, their potency diminishes with less coverage.

For example, you could feasibly wear Eidolon’s helm, hood and cape over a matching copy of Alexandria’s black costume, enabling you to access both of their formidable powersets at once. This also doesn’t improve your multitasking ability, so actually using numerous powers together competently might be a challenge.
objects.title: Patchwork Cosplayer

objects.text: No longer are you just stealing skills, now you can copy them instead. Not only will the copied skills be just as effective as the original, they’ll be personalized for your specific usage. In addition to that, you can even pass along copies of your skills to others, teaching them with ease.
objects.title: Sharing is Caring

objects.text: In addition to tripling the maximum size of your fireballs—and by proxy, the rate at which you can generate them—you now have access to a handful of new materials to make them from; burning coals, sulfur/brimstone, lava, or molten metal, and even napalm.
objects.title: JUST. FIREBALL.

objects.text:
You gained the ability to construct dolls through which you can manipulate others. After constructing or getting a basic doll, you can imbue it to utilize your power. When imbuing a doll with your power, you have two choices concerning linking to someone. Either you can establish a permanent link to someone upon the doll’s creation, or to leave it blank. 

If a link is established at creation the doll’s connection can temporarily or indefinitely be overridden as long as the doll has something attached to it representing another target, but will immediately revert if the item loses contact with the doll. The doll will require no item to affect its normal target. 

If a doll is left blank, you can instead establish permanent links later on as long as you attach something representing the target on the doll. If it directly belonged to the target such as a lock of hair, the doll’s link is established immediately, if it merely represents the target such as a commonly distributed picture such as a newspaper clipping it takes 1 day for the doll’s link to establish. Once the link is established the item no longer needs to be attached, and the link can be overwritten with another by simply following the process again. 

The link is permanent unless broken by you. If the link is broken and the doll is still intact, you can establish it with someone else or a previous target without having to construct a new doll. The doll after you imbue it becomes almost entirely indestructible, requiring an All or Nothing power to destroy it. This includes any writing you make on the doll yourself. 

By holding the doll you can will it to grow into a person sized doll, allowing you the room to write on them, and to shrink it back to normal size at will. Whatever you write on the dolls becomes true for the one they’re affecting. The dolls will know what you intend with each word you write, so writing “tall” will make them as tall as you wanted them to be. You still have to make your wording complete. 

By focusing you can imbue a word with far more meaning into it than its normal definition, turning into a Major Word, taking effect when they are written and bypassing the need for full wording. You can create a Major word once a week, after creation the Major word can be used as many times as you want. The Major Word can also be used normally whenever you wish, and the same word can be turned into multiple versions of a Major Word, producing different effects with the same writing.

You have a limit of 10 words per doll upon creation, however each day the doll remains in existence the limit of words increases by half. Others can write on the dolls if you allow it, but only if you allow it. You can wipe off any writing at anytime without any effort.   

The doll can also be used to manipulate a target in the more traditional way, such as throwing them or crushing them by crushing the dolls. This only happens when you wish for it to. The target does not need to be a person, the doll can affect any being.
objects.title: Vodou

objects.text:
Your beams are what make the enemy lose hope. When you reveal your attack, everyone stops what they are doing to make concessions for you. You are like a walking nuke in their eyes.

Your beams are just strong enough to make the enemy lose hope, and back off. Does it need to look like it's as powerful as a Tsar Bomba to scare the enemy? Well, your beam sure does look like it's as strong as one. Obviously, it doesn't actually do anything, as it's all purely visual and noise.

Its lethality has also gone from mildly ticklish, to moderately ticklish.
objects.title: SUPER DUPER MURDER DEATH BEAM

objects.text: Powers that you’ve recently burned will give your flames a temporary thematically related boost, i.e., burning a speedster might make your flames spread faster; an object empowered to be tougher might make your flames harder to stamp out; a teleporter might let your flames teleport gaps to spread to more flammable materials; etc.
objects.title: Pyrotechnic Colourant

objects.text:
Your body is infused with the same starlight that forms your fragments, granting you superhuman strength, agility, flexibility, and healing. You’ll find attempts to improve your physical condition more effective than normal, recovering from even the most fatal wounds with enough time. 

You can absorb crystals to supercharge these powers temporarily with a fist-sized crystal allowing you to restore entire limbs in moments. Supercharging your healing will allow you to achieve nigh-impossible feats, like restoring your eyesight if you’re nearsighted.
objects.title: Might Of The Stars

objects.text:
Your connection to starlight has deepened, allowing you to form crystals even under the sun’s baleful light, albeit at half effectiveness. You can make up to 80 pebble-sized crystals in one night if you do nothing else. 

Your telekinesis is far more precise, allowing you to manipulate your crystals at even greater distances, ensuring they meet their targets. You can now 'mold' the shape of your crystals through your telekinesis, allowing you to change them from their spherical form. You have a far greater understanding of where every crystal is relative to yourself.
objects.title: Astral Coronation

objects.text:
You can connect your fragments, forming shields able to absorb the equivalent force and damage of all the composition explosions resulting from connected fragments. The size and strength of your shields are determined by the number and size of the crystals used.

The ‘charge’ in your shield is used up with every impact, draining the composite crystals of their starlight. Your telekinesis has been enhanced, allowing you to manipulate your crystals and move your shields with further haste and precision than what was previously possible.
objects.title: Fragments Unified

objects.text: You can grant replicas of your Weapons Platform to others or bestow upon them lesser versions. The full version endows the same benefits as the original Weapons Platform, including the ability to absorb weapons and generate ammunition. However, you retain the authority to limit their version of the Weapons Platform as you see fit. And while they possess it, you can reclaim control over it at any time.
objects.title: Enlistment

addons.text: Your precision with Phase Touch is massively increased, and it can also ignore Manton Protection, allowing your arms to sink into the skin and flesh of your target and freely mess around with their insides without causing an outside wound. This also allows you to put back the bones you removed or put other objects inside their bodies.
addons.title: Bad Touch

addons.text: Thanks to your unwavering grip, your weight limit increased to 10 times what you could hold with your grip strength.
addons.title: Big Pickings

objects.text:
Now, by pointing at your target, you can partially ignore any Manton protection they have and seamlessly pull bones out of their body, teleporting them into your hand. Your limit for pulling out bones is based on what you can hold onto with your grip strength.

This also comes with an instinctual knowledge of analysing and understanding skeletal structures.
objects.title: Bone Collector

objects.text:
Now you can permanently swap out the level of mastery and experience between two skills of anyone. Because of this, even completely unknown skills can be targeted, as you are not hindered by the experience difference between skills, so you could swap something common, like the skill in their native language, for something niche, like the skill in installing air conditioners. This will also affect their talents and abilities related to said skills, so if an athletic person’s skills in hiking are swapped for fanfic writing, their talents will also change accordingly, and even their ability to tell apart wild plants will change to something like noticing bad tropes in writing.

If you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless you will be able to target supernatural skills as well.
objects.title: Forced Re-Spec

objects.text:
If your target is unaware of your attack, this could be as simple as not seeing it, it will bypass all defenses—no matter how powerful or esoteric they are—ensuring the strike lands and deals damage with absolute certainty. 

Bonus damage from these sneak attacks starts with a 2x multiplier and continues stacking with each successful unnoticed hit. The stacking bonus resets if the target dies or if you switch to a different target.
objects.title: Sure Critical Hit

objects.text:
Now, you don’t just enhance the speed of an object in motion—you amplify its overall effectiveness with every passing second. The longer an object, projectile, or blaster power stays in motion, the greater its power, doubling its effect every second it remains airborne. This amplification affects not only its speed but also its destructive power, force, and any additional effects tied to the object. While the boost is immense, it still operates under diminishing returns.

For instance, a simple rock might start as a harmless projectile, but given enough time in motion, it can strike with the force of a cannonball, shattering obstacles in its path. A blaster beam could grow hotter, denser, or more volatile the longer it travels, turning an ordinary energy shot into a devastating explosion. Similarly, a thrown vial of poison might have its toxicity multiplied with every second it remains airborne, increasing its lethality upon breaking.
objects.title: Need For Speed

objects.text: You can apply the effects of Charged Beam and/or Charging Beam on any of your Blaster powers.
objects.title: Charging Blast

objects.text: Your blasts no longer stops at the first thing they hit, they continue traveling onward till they reach the edge of your range (that being a mile).
objects.title: It Keeps Going...

objects.text: Your Shard’s simulations of what you hit with your blast are now far more complete. Now whenever something is struck by one of your beams the simulated destruction will be applied to the whole object so long as it does not exceed a 30-meter diameter from the origin where the blast hit if it does all parts in the area will be destroyed with the rest being left untouched.
objects.title: By A Football Field!

addons.text: Compounding Glutton’s All-or-Nothing effects practically jailbreak your Shard’s profound chasm in its “stomach” desperate enough to gorge itself with the fabric of reality. Your mouths lose their form, vaguely “crunching” at matter’s atomic bonds or “slurping” energy from motion or kinetics, even “grinding its teeth” against the space and time to cram as much [Energy] as possible, best be careful to overload your Shard and let it rest.
addons.title: Eater of Worlds

objects.text:
Your craving leaves a deep hole in your “stomach” to such a degree your power does away with being discreet, appearing as undulating maws surrounding you, constantly indiscriminately consuming energy and matter with no end in sight, searching for any kind of sustenance. 

Feeding from all this, your power extends its reach the more it eats, apart from amassing range and improving use, additionally gaining an All-or-Nothing effect capable of gnashing the last Endbringer layers or bypassing Alexandria’s stasis, due to eating away at a microscopic level, wearing down their very structure. This additionally grows your power’s characteristics, namely, its rate of consumption or your mouths’ aggressiveness.
objects.title: Gnawing Hunger

objects.text: Your Gandr has now been upgraded to what's known as a Finn Shot. A Finn Shot has roughly the destructive power of a pistol bullet. Not only that but the aura itself has strengthened, even if the size hasn't increased, with it now being able to knock out a normal person purely through close exposure to it. Lastly, your Finn Shot now partially bypasses conventional durability through its increased strength.
objects.title: Finn Shot

objects.text: Your Gandr has been significantly changed to something called a Freischütz: Magic Bullet. By saying "Freischütz" instead of merely firing one Finn shot, you now fire 7 consecutively, with each "bullet" getting progressively stronger by roughly 20%. This translates to about a 120% strength increase on the 7th shot. Optionally, you may sacrifice some of your health to empower the seventh shot even further.
objects.title: Freischütz

objects.text:
What once began as a single droplet has turned into a steady flow. Each day, the amount of the metallic-like substance you can materialise increases by approximately two cubic centimetres, gradually increasing the total mass you can manipulate.

This materialised matter is also no longer an unchanging object but can be shaped according to your will. You can warp and sculpt it into any form you can clearly envision: a razor-sharp blade, a needle-like projectile, a shifting coil of rope or a flat platform to stand upon.

You can even freely split this material apart into multiple constructs or merge them back together as needed. Each individual construct can be manoeuvred independently as your multitasking scales in tandem, letting you coordinate swarms of strikes seamlessly.
objects.title: Deluge

objects.text:
Your acceleration is no longer capped at supersonic speeds; you can now instantaneously propel any projectile you fire to hypersonic velocities of up to Mach 10.

At these extremes, even the smallest objects become lethal. A pebble can pierce armoured vehicles while heavier projectiles could strike with forces rivalling modern tank munitions or more. You are shielded from side-effects such as deafening sonic bangs or backlash.
objects.title: David’s Railgun

objects.text:
Your first strike is now not only guaranteed to hit first, but also go through any defenses they possess. That is to say, any and all protections that are not inherently innate are directly bypassed by the strike. This includes the target’s durability, regeneration, ability to ignore damage, size, and many more factors, all weaving together into one absolute statement: the First Strike can kill even the mightiest.

For example, intending to slash Aegis across the eyes while he’s seeing through the pores of his skin would blind him and bar him from adapting into seeing ever again (at least without someone like Panacea’s assistance), while intending to slash Crawler’s achilles’ heels would cripple him severely and prevent him from adapting anything that would allow him to move on his feet or stem the bleeding from them, but not from growing wings or deciding to make like a snake. Against parahumans such as Fenja and Menja, your strikes would leave lacerations matching the ones you could have given to them if they were human in size. You can kill them if you strike to kill.

Naturally, for entities that would already normally be resistant or immune to any damage you could inflict, such as the Endbringers, you’d need more effort to do anything of significance against them.
objects.title: Cast The First Stone

objects.text:
Your blasts have been massively boosted, from conical blasts that can flatten buildings to pencil thin blasts that can cut through warships. Your most concentrated blast is capable of piercing to the core of an Endbringer with a moment of sustained fire, though it would be unable to damage it. A blast this concentrated would also be too small to aim or exploit the damage, being only as thin as a needle. Good for cutting off their limbs, though.

On top of that, you are now able to have multiple modifiers on at once, though more than two will start to cut into the power of the blast. This includes some new ones like having multiple blasts at once or making them explode on impact.
objects.title: Artillery

addons.text:
You have become the undisputed master of orbital deployment, reshaping battlefields through precision drops that function as full forward-deployment nodes. Each call can deliver fortified structures, advanced defenses, mechanized units, or elite soldiers as though you were commanding an RTS from orbit.

Your arsenal now includes modular fortress sections that unfold into walls, towers, and bunkers; anti-air and point-defense grids; and shield pylons that form domes or protective corridors. Support structures such as drone bays, field hospitals, fabrication pads, stealth generators, and localized gravity-dampening fields can also be deployed instantly.

Offensively, you can summon siege platforms, rail-cannons, mobile artillery nests, and mine-scattering drones. Your mechanized support ranges from tanks and combat mechs to transports, walker sentries, gunships, and modular exo-frames, with automated crawlers capable of constructing additional defenses on the field.

Your troopers arrive as elite drop units—ODST-style shock troops, Helldiver-like commandos, or precision paratroopers—supported by specialized squads such as shield phalanxes, jump-jet skirmishers, combat medics, drone-handlers, or autonomous robotic platoons that fight with perfect coordination. Every drop lands ready for battle, turning any battlefield into your warzone within moments.
addons.title: Feet First into Hell

addons.text:
You have ascended to the absolute apex of orbital firepower, wielding the authority of an entire fleet’s worth of artillery platforms with nothing more than a thought.

As a result, the preparation time for your Orbital strikes are now completely eliminated. Now you can lay down multi-kilometer wide-area barrages to transform entire regions into rolling firestorms, grid-pattern saturation strikes can collapse fortresses in minutes, and seismic payloads can fracture mountains, shatter bunkers, or create new valleys across the landscape. Each strike can persist for as long as you desire, maintaining pressure until nothing remains standing.

For precision work, your authority is no less terrifying. You can summon pinpoint railgun slugs that arrive at near-relativistic velocity, gravimetric spears that implode enemy formations, or focused energy beams that carve through targets with surgical finality. Microburst strikes can neutralize single threats without disturbing allies mere meters away, while layered fire missions allow you to combine multiple artillery types into coordinated kill sequences.
addons.title: Death From Above

addons.text:
You have gained absolute orbital oversight, effectively turning the skies into an all-seeing network that tracks, analyzes, and follows every movement within your chosen theater. Now your power acts as if you have countless reconnaissance satellites and stealth observation drones synchronize into a single, seamless grid that feeds you perfect real-time awareness.

You can perceive troop movements, hidden bunkers, cloaked units, and underground activity as easily as if they were standing in daylight. Thermal signatures, energy readings, stress fractures in walls, and the simple heartbeats of enemy soldiers all become part of your mental map. Your vision extends across spectra—infrared, ultraviolet, radar, LIDAR, gravimetric, and exotic forms of detection unavailable to any modern military.

Even in total darkness, storms, or hostile interference, your awareness remains absolute with the battlefield becoming a transparent, layered hologram mapped directly onto your senses.
addons.title: Eyes in the Sky

objects.text:
In addition to now being able to choose your summoned items, you can now also access a broader arsenal of support gear, weapons, and temporary upgrades, including ordnance strikes and tactical assets reminiscent of FPS stratagems and killstreaks.

This includes explosive payloads such as incendiary bombardments, EMP bombs, or concentrated plasma/artillery blasts. Alternatively, you can choose specialized tactical drops can be summoned such as automated turrets, portable shield generators, radar scanners, or common combat vehicles.

Regardless of the item chosen, it can now come in more rugged canisters up to the size of a large car.
objects.title: Freedom Dispenser

objects.text:
Your Trick Cards can now be turned into ‘Trap Cards’ which passively store their effect instead of releasing on contact. These can be triggered remotely, have timed delays or even linked together with other cards for chain reactions.

When creating a Trap Card, you may program it with conditional triggers and set responses. While there’s no limit to how many or how complex rules can be, they require deliberate thought to be applied to a card, limiting their intricacy in hasty scenarios.

The maximum number of Trap Cards you can have ready mirrors that of your Trick Cards capacity. You remain aware of all your Trap Cards and can mentally activate or remove their stored effect at any point, regardless of prior programming.
objects.title: Trap Cards

objects.text:
The baseline strength of your Trick Cards has jumped five-fold and may now last for up to a minute, opening up far more potent and diverse applications than before.

One of your cards might detonate with the force of a landmine, teleport a target a short distance away, project a brief illusion upon impact, shrink an item, inflict overwhelming fear into someone or alter their gravity to float. 

While touching a Trick Card, you can also purposely ‘charge’ them, à la Gambit, to amplify their effect upon release. This boost scales as a multiplier per the square root of the number of seconds spent charging. So it’d take 4 seconds for a factor of 2×, 9 seconds for 3×, 25 seconds for 5× etc.

There is no strict upper limit to how far a Trick Card can be charged but they do require exponentially longer periods of time, i.e. boosting the power of a card by 60× would involve an entire hour of uninterrupted charging.
objects.title: High Stakes Hand

objects.text:
Your beams are no longer limited to simple light amplification. Whenever you fire using Lighthouse, you can alter the type of stimulated emission used, changing what the beam is and how it interacts with the world.

You can produce standard LASER emission for precise, long-range beams with strong cutting and burning capability, or shift into MASER emission, creating microwave-based output that spreads more easily, transfers energy through materials, and interferes with electronics. By applying SASER principles, your beams instead carry vibrational force, allowing them to disrupt structures, induce resonance, and deal damage internally rather than just on the surface.

With greater output, you can push into higher-energy forms such as X-ray laser emission, greatly increasing penetration and destructive potential. You may also convert your beam into a PASER-like stream, turning it into accelerated particles that strike with direct physical force instead of pure radiation. More specialized forms, such as SPASER emission, allow extremely localized interaction at surfaces, while FASER-like control lets you adjust frequency and properties mid-shot.

At the highest end, you can approximate GASER-like emission, producing localized gravitational effects that influence movement, pressure, and mass rather than relying solely on conventional energy transfer.

These changes do not increase the total energy provided by the light source, but they allow you to apply that energy in far more effective and varied ways, adapting each shot to the situation at hand.
objects.title: Stimulated Emission Modulation

objects.text: Your viewing now applies retroactively. Any location or person that you have seen during your viewing, you can now apply this power on too. The restriction of it having to have been within the past day has been lifted.
objects.title: Perfected Past Sight

objects.text: Your Bribery power's master component is greatly empowered allowing you to successfully bribe more people for far, far, cheaper than it normally would. Yes, including getting people to kill each other over ice cream bars, although with something that extreme it would take a significant amount of convincing for most people to even consider.
objects.title: Klondike Bar

objects.text: Sean Connery, Baba Yaga, The Punisher, The Boogeyman, The First Hunter, The Big Boss, Doctor Van Helsing—what do all of these names have in common? They are all elderly individuals working in professions where people die young. Now, you can claim to be their equal (or even surpass them by cheating using powers). You can't lose in any skill-based combat, whether it involves cold weapons like swords, shields, even armor, or hot weapons, whether they are old, new, or Tinker-tech. Everything about you, including your limbs, is to be considered lethal and would almost certainly be banned by the Geneva Convention. Not even precogs on the likes of Cortessa or Ziz can match your skill! Just don't expect this to save you if they drop a nuke on your head.
objects.title: The Old

addons.text:
Any ghosts you raise now also gain the ability to use a (Master/Stranger) Ghostfreak, while your specter gains the power to possess objects and people. Furthermore, you can mark locations, allowing any ghost of your choice to stay and wander around the marked areas.

Lastly, if your body were to die, you could exist in your specter state, although it would be draining for you and you would be required to rest for at least 666 minutes. To rest, you must possess someone or something, although it's up to you to fully control them or just go along for the ride.
addons.title: Haunted

objects.text:
With this, not only can your summoned spirits leave their bodies, but they also can possess people and objects, including you if they have your permission. The spirit can only go 5 meters away from you, and you can store them in a pocket space where they can see/hear through your eyes/ears. 

The Spirits are also more likely to obey your commands, and the longer they have been summoned the more they obey you.
objects.title: Possessed
