addons.text: You can glean the history of any object you wield, allowing you to recreate the feats of its past wielders. While you won't be able to copy their abilities, you'll still be able to imitate their skills and expertise. A sword that has slain countless enemies will allow you to cut through ranks of foes as if they were butter, albeit with some difficulty. A gun from a sharpshooter will allow your aim to improve to a near-perfect level, only missing on rare occasions. You hold an unparalleled understanding of your weapons, allowing you to wield them with ease and lethality.
addons.title: History’s Weapon

objects.text: You are as skilled in the use of any tool or machine you've touched within the last hour as though you have practiced with it your entire life. The object itself will gain an increase in effectiveness, and never degrade when you use it (a sword gets sharper and never dulls, a shield gets more durable and never dents, etc).
objects.title: Weapon Master

objects.text: By thinking of something, you can get a number that dictates how dangerous they are to you or those close to you. The higher the number the worst the danger. For example, by thinking what is the cause of the Case 53s, you will probably get a high danger number as Cauldron doesn’t like being known. This also automatically activates on anything (Thinker) Danger Sense detects.
objects.title: Danger Level

objects.text: Not only do you have X-ray vision, but also microscopic and telescopic vision. Additionally, your vision is perfect, encompassing the entire electromagnetic spectrum, and no longer degrades with distance.
objects.title: Micro and Tele

objects.text: You now gain up to 5 SP total whenever you take a role. For example, if you take the role "Chef", you will gain a 4 SP tinker ability to cook food and a 1 SP thinker ability to know your target's favourite food. If you have Actors On Stage this can grant others powers based off the roles you give. This is optional.
objects.title: Role Mastered

addons.text: Those affected by your powers will also have their equipment altered to fit their role. If given the role of “Policeman”, the targets clothes will be altered to look like a police outfit, at least superficially so.
addons.title: Costumes

addons.text: Those affected by your powers will truly believe that they are their role. A person who is given the role of a “Traumatised Soldier” will not only act like one, but truly think they are one. While the effects are permanent as long as they have their role, it can be broken if someone points out the inconsistencies of their beliefs.
addons.title: Inner Actor

addons.text:
Now the area around you is also altered to suit the situation. You now have the ability to enforce a “script” upon everyone and everything under the effects of your power. The “Hero” always beats the “Villain”, the “Side Character” is always secondary to the “Main Character”, etc.

Note: you can’t make things too absurd happen. It has to have some kind of build up, plot progression, etc. You can also choose to have a “script” continue on from an earlier “script”, essentially making a sequel. Your power weakens the less your “script” makes sense.
addons.title: Stage Set

objects.text: You now have a Master power that allows you to enforce specific “Roles” onto people within your surroundings. For example, you can make Alexandria play the role as a “Helpless Maiden”, and she will be forced to only act in a way a “Helpless Maiden” would act. Or perhaps you can make Armsmaster play the role of “Comic Relief”, thus forcing him to act in a humorous manner. Whenever you force a role onto someone, this grants them the skills needed to play that role.
objects.title: Actors on Stage

addons.text: Your control finally reaches the entire Collective Unconscious of Humanity, which means, you can change mankind’s collective archetypical paradigms and foundations globally.
addons.title: Collective Unconscious

objects.text:
Your Master power deepened even further, instead of enforcing “roles” onto others with the world agreeing, you now control the very framework these roles are based on: Archetypes.

Archetypes are patterns, images, and models fundamentally instinctual within humanity, leading to a common understanding or sense of values; inherited from our ancestors generally conforming to accepted designs and interpretations, they can be altered per individual personal nature and experiences. You administer this essential part of our psyche to the point of irrevocably changing someone’s psyche.

For example, you can change someone’s archetype when it comes to another, whether it be a friend or co-worker, to someone reprehensible and acts accordingly against the latter; you can fabricate an archetype that causes anyone to mark you as forgettable or unable to be remembered; you can even remove an archetype from someone, that is a criminal, and eliminate the Criminal Archetype within his psyche, which outright erases any prospect of delinquent behavior.
objects.title: Archetype Controller

addons.text:
Your insight deepens. You no longer gain headaches from using your Thinker power. Now, you can even see physical representations of knowledge, information, and the like. Additionally, all the physical representations are willing to answer questions you ask them, most even giving you information without prompting, and they are now more likely to obey you even if you don’t give them anything in return. 

You can now also create these representations by temporarily losing parts of yourself. By sacrificing your anger, you can make a physical representation of anger. Know that these creatures are still unable to directly interact with the physical world.
addons.title: We Need More Eyes

addons.text:
When sleeping, you can transform your simulated operation room into a simulated reality mirroring the twisted world you see. You will appear near your body. You will not be able to affect the physical world; however, your ability to affect the twisted world has grown even greater. 

By attacking or altering the twisted versions of others, you can effectively alter their true selves. For example, a skinny, corpse-like form usually means that the person is overworked and tired, so by inflating and reviving their twisted version, you can make them more energetic and lively. 

Your range in how far you can travel from your body is 10 blocks. If you tag others, you can grant them (Thinker) Twisted World, thus allowing them to not only see the twisted reality but also your dreaming avatar.
addons.title: The Dream

addons.text:
You see the dark corners of reality and bring them to the light. You can physically manifest the twisted reality that you see into reality, superimposing it over the true reality. You can summon the physical representation, all of them having a memetic influence over anyone who perceives them.

Your most interesting power is to superimpose the twisted variants of others onto themselves, allowing them to see themselves in their truest form.
addons.title: Lucid Dreamer

addons.text: Your powers have evolved into a chilling synthesis of perceptive abilities, allowing you to read the emotional history of anything you can see, and even slightly beyond it. When you focus on an object, person, or place, you can see past events happen in real time, only replaced with horrific creatures embodiying the true self and thoughts of those involved. These visions are deeply rooted in the emotions that permeated those moments, providing an almost hauntingly clear understanding of the past. This is particularly effective in spaces where emotions and desires are strong or have been strong.
addons.title: Bare Witness

objects.text:
Your sight has grown stronger, allowing you to see deeper into reality. Now, any powers meant to obscure will not work on you. Be it invisibility, memory alteration, or clouds of darkness. 

Additionally, you can now see physical representations of emotions and desires. They regularly take the form of twisted mythological creatures and tend to either follow and latch on to people, or congregate in an area. You can communicate with these creatures, even make deals with them. They can choose to latch onto people you ask them to, causing their target to be affected by whatever emotion and/or desire the creature represents.
objects.title: Eldritch Sight

objects.text:
It is now possible to step into the cinema screen itself, allowing those in the cinema to wander around the memory and observe things that wouldn't have otherwise been picked up from the original perspective.

Elements that weren't directly observed in the memory will fuzz and gain more of a dreamlike tone the further away it is from anything that has been, providing less information to normal senses and Thinker powers. This fuzzing starts off unnoticeable and transitions into being minor over roughly 60 metres of any directly remembered point, more quickly intensifying past that until it eventually devolves into a nigh useless liminal space that repeats the environment from the memory in an increasingly garbled and warped fashion.
objects.title: 4D Experience

addons.text: Your mental catalogue feeds on the data you receive with every use of your precognition, filling out with people from the future, allowing you to search and filter for possible traits, skills, and powers within the seen future. This will also reduce the cooldown of Precognition in cases where there is a lot of overlap in the future, as the Group Finder acts as a database for every creature filling out previously obtained unchanged data.
addons.title: Pre-Loaded Catalogue

objects.text:
Your mental compass evolved into a full-blown catalogue with every creature on the planet closest to you. This catalogue also has a search engine included, which allows you to filter for any combination of traits, skills, and powers that can also interpret your thoughts to the point where you could filter even for being similar to a mental image you have.
The tracking capability of the power also improved into a mental GPS, which loads the environmental data from your own memories, making it more detailed and precise in areas you are accustomed to.

This will also heavily synergize with any other thinker powers, as they gain access to all data in the catalogue, even for creatures you didn’t actively memorise or look up.
objects.title: Group Finder

addons.text: Thanks to your accuracy during a parry, you will automatically attack weak spots. Your counter-attacks can cause effects such as temporary paralysis, disorientation, or even disrupting other’s abilities. Additionally, your heightened senses allow you to perceive the flow of battle in slow motion for a brief moment after each parry, giving you a tactical advantage.
addons.title: Git Gud

objects.text: Upon successfully parrying, your body can executes a precise counter-attack aimed at exploiting your opponent's momentary vulnerability. This counter-attack is delivered with exceptional accuracy, causing significant damage. The strength of your counter-attack scales with the strength of the attack parried. The counter-attack cannot be dodged or parried, as space itself bends to ensure your strike lands.
objects.title: Parry This You Filthy Casual

objects.text:
Your ability to create plans has been comprehensively upgraded. You gain a subspecialty in creating non-linear plans which arrange countless events in order to create a general 'trend' that favors your goals. Even if one specific plot fails, your overall situation is hardly impacted and your failure is covered by countless subplans. Due to your careful planning, you will usually gain something regardless of the outcome of an event.

This subspecialty is further supported by a boost to your planning capabilities. Your plans now border on precognition, and you can set long chains of events in motion with a single inconspicuous action. This can lead to countless "coincidences" and "reasonable developments" which continuously favor you and your goals. However, some individuals may notice the repeated coincidences and realize they are being manipulated.

Your plans also have a larger scope. If you focus your efforts on a single city, you can establish control with ease, setting up major events which benefits your goals without anyone even noticing your manipulations. You can chain several of these plans together to completely dominate the trend of the times. This is massively increased in both potency and scope if you have an actual precog power or with an allied precog.
objects.title: Manipulator

objects.text:
Your powers have evolved beyond merely glimpsing the future to erasing it. You can now 'erase' a stretch of time starting at the present moment and going up to 10 seconds into the future.

During this erased span, the world, excluding you, carries on as it was supposed to. The effects of the actions you would have taken during this timeframe still happen. If, for example, you had stabbed a person in the erased time, stab wounds would still appear on that person at the time you would have stabbed them. Meanwhile, you turn invisible and intangible, able to move around and reposition yourself, rematerializing (though not inside solid matter) once the period of erased time concludes.

Additionally, when the ability ends, anyone who would, within the erased timeframe, perceive any difference between a world where your 'erased' actions occurred and one where you disappear from existence during the erased timeframe loses all memory of that timeframe. This also works on recording equipment of any type.

This ability has a cooldown equivalent to the duration of the erased time.
objects.title: King Crimson

objects.text:
You have transcended merely skipping along the timeline—now, you drag an eraser along the timeline itself.

When you use King Crimson continuously for 10 seconds (or longer, in case you have abilities that extend the duration of King Crimson), the cooldown for it is eliminated. Additionally, you can queue activations of King Crimson to automatically happen as soon as cooldowns permit.

Combining these two changes, when you activate King Crimson for 10 seconds and then queue up another usage, your body doesn't ever exit intangibility, giving you intangibility indefinitely if you simply continue queuing King Crimson activations. Though from the world's perspective, you continue to materialize in between King Crimson activations, the effects of the actions you would have performed continue to happen.

So when you start chaining King Crimson activations, from an outside perspective, it looks as if every 10 seconds you both teleport and restore your body to how it was before, while also erasing the last 10 seconds of memories from everyone you encounter. Untouchable, untrappable, and unrememberable, you become an unstoppable walking discontinuity.

Unfortunately, this power does come with one limitation: the maximum queue length is 10 activations. This poses no problems while you are conscious, as you can simply add more King Crimson activations before the queue runs out. However, if you ever need to sleep or are unconscious for more than 100 seconds, you will be returned to tangibility once the queue is exhausted.
objects.title: Emperor Crimson

objects.text:
Your future sight is now recursive, taking into account not only the future but also your reaction to it, compounding upon itself until a 'perfect' future is reached. This allows you to accomplish near-impossible tasks such as blocking a speedsters attacks or defeating a trained opponent by virtue of all futures where you fail being discarded.

The only way for you to fail at a task is if it is truly impossible, or if it is impossible to achieve within 10 seconds (such as a poison taking 11 seconds to kick in). Your body can be guided to follow your visions perfectly, as to prevent human error from messing them up. You can choose to look through discarded futures or only see the end result.
objects.title: The I

objects.text:
In addition to receiving legitimate prophecies about the future, you can now say whatever you want and declare it as a prophecy, which will modify causality to make the event more likely. Want to win the lottery? A few words, and it's yours. Have a rival you despise but cannot touch? Tomorrow, they somehow don't remember to put on their mask when caping. These events will have no trace of your involvement and will appear completely natural, often just attributed to good or bad luck. However, if you continuously create unrealistic occurrences around someone, they could realize something is off.

The more realistic a possibility is, the greater the chance that it occurs after you create a prophecy. Conversely, the more important/powerful a person, event, or location is, the harder it is to influence. Something like controlling a coin toss would have a near-perfect accuracy rate while getting Contessa to forget her morning coffee would have a far greater chance of failure. Rather than complete failure, most high-level prophecies only achieve partial success, with some aspects of your declared prophecy coming true or to a less absolute degree. For example, a prophecy stopping someone's resurrection could instead slow it down.  However, even the most likely occurrences have a small chance of total failure.

This ability can be used to influence anyone/anything on the planet and can be used repeatedly on the same target(s) without consequence, though it raises the possibility of someone noticing something is off. You can declare prophecies by writing them on any surface or speaking them out loud. Nobody has to hear your prophecies for them to come true.
objects.title: Out of the Mouth Comes Evil

addons.text:
Your power intensifies whenever you choose to bring misfortune upon others. You can weave a series of minor negative events that, when combined, lead to devastating outcomes far beyond mere bad luck. Small injuries may worsen into severe illness, a minor conflict may escalate into betrayal, or an accident may result in death—or even something worse than death. With each curse you declare, you can set off a chain of miseries that erode the well-being, sanity, and even the soul of your target.

Your curses work like threads woven into the fabric of someone’s life, subtly and invisibly binding them to a path of suffering. These events will still appear perfectly natural, with no trace of your involvement, often dismissed as unfortunate circumstances. But as minor ailments become life-threatening diseases, and fleeting anxieties deepen into madness, those who fall victim to your power are caught in a downward spiral that feels inevitable, as if fate itself has turned against them.

However, as before, the scale and impact of your prophecies depend on the significance of the target. Influencing powerful individuals or deeply fated events remains challenging, and the most intense curses may manifest partially or in distorted ways. Yet, with persistence, even the mightiest can find themselves slowly undone by an endless series of “bad days.”
addons.title: Song of Despair

addons.text:
When you look at a person, their innermost self is unveiled to you in vivid detail. Every shameful secret, every hidden flaw, every regret and vice they try to conceal is laid bare, exposed with stark clarity.

But it doesn’t end there. You witness not only the burdens they carry but the path that stretches ahead of them—their future, marred by looming failures, by the heartbreaks and missteps yet to come. When you look into a person’s future, your vision is limited to the shadows that lie ahead. You don’t see their joys or triumphs; instead, only the negative fragments are revealed to you. You witness their failures, their regrets, and the moments of despair that await them. These glimpses show only the heartbreaks, disappointments, and struggles that will mark their journey.

At the end of this path, you see their death—a hazy, shifting image of how they might die. The image is fluid, ever-changing, because even the act of your observation subtly alters the future. Your vision of their end is like a flickering candle, casting shadows that evolve and reshape with every glance.
addons.title: Cassandra

objects.text: ”As you are so fond of singing of tragedy, it seems only fair that I should provide you with material. Your visions shall be filled with all the hardship and horrors your songs fail to prevent; this I decree, and so shall it be." You are truly a child of despair and tragedy. As a seer of doom, your prophecies now hold even more weight when they foretell suffering, loss, or catastrophe. Your predictions related to dark events—such as illness, injury, death, and ruin—become unerringly precise and amplified. You can foresee with uncanny accuracy the key figures, specific locations, and exact dates and times of catastrophic events. Sometimes, you are even granted vivid flashes of the future, moments in which you witness unfolding scenes in startling detail, allowing you to identify the individuals whose actions or fates will play pivotal roles in these looming crises. Alongside this ominous foresight, a new ability manifests within you: a penetrating insight into the darkest facets of human nature. With a mere glance, you perceive a person’s most hidden flaws and shameful secrets. Their sins, their vices, and the weight of their guilt are laid bare before you, leaving no room for pretense.
objects.title: Melpomene

objects.text:
Your skill at finding patterns has now been greatly enhanced to cover the field of "cryptology." This not only refers to actual ciphers and scripts, but any act of "prying into mystery." With cursory investigation, you can psychoanalyze the intentions, motivations, and desires of others. With a serious investigation, you can decrypt the true names of Shards based on a Parahuman.

You can supernaturally unravel any sort of linguistic concealment or mathematical cipher by finding relations between words, numbers, and keys to determine the encryption method. For example, you could complete the thousands of steps to turn a coded language into actual words, or find the password of an important account via solely the public key. This only helps you find patterns in the information you already know. The reverse is also possible. You have the ability to create long and complex systems of encryption to encode all sorts of information. This applies from programming, physical messages, etc. to more obscure things like your mental state.

You gain a natural boost to your deduction capabilities and thinking speed. Your mind performs calculations at a speed far faster than an ordinary civilian can comprehend. This is to the extent that you can thoroughly analyze the longest and most complex mathematical proofs in a matter of seconds.
objects.title: Cryptologist

addons.text: Each one of your thought processes can potentially scry a location, allowing you to watch over multiple locations at once. However this is only part of your potential, something which supports the main application, for you now have a third mode to your gaze. When you scry a location you can optionally have your gaze manifest as an ethereal floating eye of a size and appearance of your choice - although it defaults to a copy of your eye - which can be controlled remotely. While this does restrict your sensory input to things that are in line of sight of the eye, it is a valid eye as far as (Changer/Trump) Eye Guy is concerned which means you can assign a power to it. Additionally, you can manifest as an eye for every thought process you dedicate to them, and can even scry the same area multiple times to manifest multiple eyes in a single area.
addons.title: Argos

objects.text:
Instead of creating a scrying orb, you may "cast" your gaze at any location, including those you have never been to before. This allows you to use all of your senses, including supernatural ones, at that location. 

Your gaze has two modes. One is completely silent and undetectable, allowing you to watch locations or stalk people with nobody noticing. The other creates an invisible, intangible pressure at the location of your gaze, making people aware they are being watched. This pressure is strong but non-lethal. You can freely toggle between the two modes.
objects.title: Divine Gaze

objects.text:
You can now summon a projection of a shark known as the Debt Shark. While it can act as a real shark, protecting you or attacking your enemies, its true power lies in its ability to collect debts from those who owe you. The Debt Shark can claim anything that belongs to the debtor and gave you: skills, memories, talents, unique traits, health, lifespan, and even their powers.

However, its power comes with certain limitations. The primary condition is that the target must owe you a debt. Debts can take any form, from money to promises. You can only collect an equivalent value of the debt. For example, you cannot take someone's powers if they owe you just one dollar. But if someone owes you a billion dollars and hasn’t paid it back for years, you can take almost everything from them except their life. Alternatively, you can compel the debtor to serve you until the debt is fully repaid.
objects.title: Debt Shark

objects.text:
You begin to physically and mentally embody traits from your dreams. Each time you wake, a piece of your dream stays with you, shaping who you are in the waking world.

Dream of being a soldier, and you might wake with the endurance, reflexes, and strength of someone who’s undergone years of grueling physical training. Spend a night as a predator stalking its prey, and you might carry the heightened instincts, sharper senses, or even the fearsome presence of a wild animal. Live the life of a rugged cavemen braving harsh elements, and you could wake with thicker skin, cold resistance, and a body adapted to survive the unforgiving wilderness.

The longer the dream, the more traits you inherit. These traits accumulate over time, layering and intertwining into a version of you that is more than human—a blend of the countless lives you’ve lived in your dreams. Be wary, as you might end up waking up a different person than the one who went to sleep.
objects.title: More Than A Dream

objects.text:
You gain a clairvoyant sense within a mile of yourself of any of your assigned filters. 

Your perception of your assigned filters is now also greatly enhanced, it’s no longer a mere indicator but a way to sense the intricacies of whatever your power pings off. 

Your power now also works through your other senses, able to intuit an incredible amount of information, such as hearing conversations from areas of danger through your filter of Danger. 

You do not need to use your senses, your subconscious and conscious mind will take in all the information seamlessly and allow you to effortlessly adapt and use it to your advantage, but it’s a vector to use as to your discretion. 

You no longer need to rely on sensory senses for your filters, but you can still manipulate your perception of these filters, extending now to your other senses, able to set things such as noises or smells to different filters, still with no impairment on your part. As a bonus, you get a controllable form of synaesthesia.
objects.title: Color Of Thinker

objects.text:
You can reset the day at will, going back to the last time you woke up, you can do this a total of three times per day. You can only do this up to 24 hours into the future after which the reset point moves forward to where you'd normally have woken up. Dying forces a reset. 

While in the presence of blindspots your power will be disabled, with a death during that time using up all of your leftover resets and giving you a major Thinker headache. You’ll still reset, but your memory of the blindspot will become very spotty and you’ll be mentally incapable of warning people of the danger. 

If you have another power with replenishable charges, a cooldown, or something time-dependent then a third of each reset day's time will count as real for the purpose of that power.
objects.title: Groundhog Day

objects.text:
Your power is no longer limited to moments of failure or incapacitation. Instead, you can now summon Voices at will, crafting experts to suit your needs in any given situation. Whether you need the strategic mind of a general, the knowledge of a master hacker, or the finesse of a con artist, you can call upon a Voice perfectly suited to the task.

This allows for greater flexibility and preparation—no longer must you wait for hardship to gain expertise. If you anticipate a challenge, you can preemptively create a Voice to guide you. These Voices retain the same interactive qualities as before, able to take over momentarily to provide precise guidance or allow you to integrate their knowledge seamlessly into your own thinking.

However, frequently summoning new ones can result in a Thinker Headache that affects both you and your Voices. If pushed too far, you or the Voices may even blackout.
objects.title: Answer To All Things

objects.text:
Your Voices are no longer just knowledgeable guides—they now come with abilities of their own. Each Voice possesses up to 3 SP worth of powers, primarily Thinker or Tinker abilities that align with their expertise. A survivalist Voice might have an innate danger sense, while a brawler might have predictive combat instincts. A hacker Voice could gain an intuitive understanding of code, letting them analyse and break security systems at a glance.

While Thinker or Tinker abilities are always accessible, non-Thinker/Tinker powers (such as Brute, Mover, or Blaster powers) can only be used when the Voice is in control of your body.
objects.title: Voices of the Strong

objects.text:
Your power no longer merely informs you of six objects you will need. Instead, those necessities are already gathered, packed, and waiting before they become relevant.

Once every 24 hours, your power designates a nearby storage location—such as a locker, bag, storage compartment, vehicle trunk, room, or similar plausible container—which contains items predicted to be useful for the next day or a specific upcoming event.

The limitation shifts from quantity to volume. Rather than six individual objects, you may receive any combination of items that reasonably fit within the available space, from numerous small tools to a single larger piece of equipment.

Contents continue to prioritize importance. Supplies relevant to survival, conflict, opportunities, or significant upcoming circumstances are favored over minor conveniences.

Items remain mundane and contextually plausible. The power does not create impossible resources, but arranges for unusual levels of preparedness.
objects.title: Prepared for Anything
Power Simulator
objects.text:
You are no longer merely a prodigy of powers; you understand them in a manner no other can match.

You have gained the ability to analyze powers to an unparalleled degree. Witness a pyrokinetic ignite his hands, and you'll know everything from his ignition methods all the way to his safe heat tolerances and the ideal fuel for his flames. Beyond simple understanding, you can pull precise data from minimal exposure.

Less apparent powers, such as Master or Thinker powers, take longer to recognize. You must either have direct exposure, or an understanding of an individual's baseline, but you will inevitably begin to notice the effects, and from their your power will extrapolate everything.

But that is only part of what your new understanding allows.

You are now able to simulate entire powers, creating mental models detailed down to the finest minutiae. Any form of power, of any scale, can be imagined. You could simulate a hydrokinetic power, and get accurate readings of the power operating as if you were moving a glass of water, or an ocean. You can measure the precise characteristics of any power you can think of, truly an unparalleled mind in the mechanics of power.

This power synergizes extraordinarily well with power creation abilities, as well as abilities that learn through studying other powers.

objects.title: Dunning Imposter
objects.text:
Your talent can now manifest through an extreme disconnect between your actual skill and your perception of it. If you genuinely believe you are incompetent despite overwhelming evidence to the contrary—an almost reverse Dunning–Kruger effect—you gain the same prodigious skill even when you don't actually dislike the task. You may know you are exceptionally skilled while still believing your work is terrible, your success was luck, or that anyone could do what you do.

This can also manifest as misery over being so good. Even if you enjoy the task and genuinely want to perform it, you can become frustrated or distressed by your own ability, feeling that you should absolutely not be this good at it. As long as your actual ability conflicts with how you believe you should perform, the ability remains active.

The original limits remain: your skill can reach only the level of the greatest human practitioner in history, enhanced by approximately twenty percent.

You can choose to fast forward anything you touch to a possible future state instead. You still retain the same amount of control as previous, allowing you to selectively choose how and what gets fast forwarded.
objects.title: Fast Forward

objects.text:
You can drain or give your chi to others. Giving your chi will empower and heal them, while draining the chi of others will harm or even kill them while strengthening yourself. 

At the cost of a whole person’s worth of Chi, you can bring back the recently deceased. They will be weakened and require daily chi from you for at least a week.

Note that giving your chi will weaken you, and if you don’t have enough chi you will die.
objects.title: Chi Master

objects.text: Your catalogue is no longer solely limited to mundane properties. This allows properties that are more conceptual, such as sentimental or economic value, coolness, intuitiveness, floatiness, or even sapience. Unlike mundane properties, these are not physical, and as such may be combined in normally impossible ways. For example, it may be beneficial to imbue conceptual floatiness onto a complex contraption, as it might break due to the changing of it's internal composition if mundane floatiness was applied.
objects.title: Conceptual Catalogue

addons.text:
As the objects are infused with intelligence, they undergo a remarkable transformation, transcending their inanimate nature to assume human forms. This metamorphosis imbues them with a semblance of humanity, each embodying traits reflective of their original purpose. 

A sword, now transformed into a human, wields an aura of elegance and grace, possessing the innate ability to slice through any obstacle with a mere touch. Alongside this formidable power, they may possess additional abilities such as heightened agility, keen perception, and a mastery of combat techniques.

Similarly, a car transformed into human form exudes a palpable sense of speed and efficiency. With the power to manipulate kinetic energy to propel themselves forward at astonishing velocities, allowing them to traverse vast distances in the blink of an eye, they command the roads with unparalleled swiftness. Accompanying this primary ability, they might possess secondary powers such as enhanced reflexes and intuitive knowledge of navigation.

They can stay in this form indefinitely, as you no longer have any stamina drain to keep them summoned, however you have a limit to how many human forms you can grant per week, that being 10 forms per week.

You can choose their appearance, or you can simply allow it to be random or based of their original form.
addons.title: Spirit Materialisation

objects.text:
When you touch an object, whether it's a sword, a sleek car, or a house, you can infuse it with sentience. Once awakened, these creations become more than mere objects, gaining the ability to act autonomously. A sentient sword may wield itself with precision, a car navigates winding roads with ease, and a house tidies its own rooms with care.

These creations, now imbued with intelligence, not only serve you faithfully but also develop a sense of loyalty akin to reverence, recognizing you as their creator. Beyond their newfound autonomy, they possess additional capabilities such as self-repair and the ability to manipulate themsleves with minor telekinetic prowess, allowing them to move despite not having the anatomy for it.
objects.title: Spirit of All Things

objects.text:
All objects now have a minimum of 7 charges. Amplified objects will take an entire hour to fully recharge. The first charge used on an object lasts for 2 minutes, with each subsequent charge increasing the duration by 1 minute.

Using a charge can improve the general capabilities of an object by a factor of three. However, you can also choose to decrease the amplification in certain areas and concentrate it in others (such as focusing all amplification of a knife on the sharpness). If you use 3 or more charges at once, the object becomes empowered and obtains a unique ability derived from its nature and the focus of the amplification. For example, a knife with amplified sharpness may gain the ability to project its blade at a distance, permitting it to cut enemies from a distance. 

Additionally, using 3 or more charges permanently enhances the quality and strength of the object by up to 1% of the amplified state. As a result, the object slowly transforms into a form that better aligns with its current abilities (e.g., a switchblade that has had sharpness amplified multiple times may evolve into a dagger). Amplified objects cannot permanently gain a unique ability.
objects.title: Noble Phantasm

addons.text:
Now anything boosted by Weapon Master will also temporarily become a Noble Phantasm. It remains in this state for an hour after you let go. 

After accumulating a collective time of 1 year under this effect, the object will permanently evolve into a True Noble Phantasm.
addons.title: Eternal Arms Mastery

objects.text:
You can turn a single object into a permanent Noble Phantasm, allowing it to permanently be in a state as if all of its charges were activated. The base item will also gradually improve at a rate of 1% of its amplified state, as if the charges were constantly expended. These objects can be used by others without any limit.

After a full year of an object in this state, it will turn into a True Noble Phantasm, making it no longer reliant on your power and freeing you up to choose a new item to affect with Knight of Owner. The transformation can be accelerated by using the object in real combat or for the purposes the object is designed for.

Should you happen to also have Negentropy, then you can have three objects at once benefit from Knight of Owner.
objects.title: Knight of Owner

objects.text: You no longer lose control over blood you’ve previously been in contact with. This allows you to exponentially spread your control and form an endless crimson tide from the blood of your enemies.
objects.title: Crimson Tide

objects.text: You may raise and lower the temperature of any blood you control while keeping the state unchanged. This allows applications such as cooling your blood to prevent overheating or superheating blood to the point of spontaneous combustion while attacking others.
objects.title: Sanguine Celsius

objects.text:
Your powers can now land critical hits as well! In other words, if your power crits, then it will be more potent. Double your strength temporarily and land a critical? You will now be quadruple as strong as before!

The odds of a critical remain the same as before. The duration of a critical effect depends on what it affects, but it won't exceed 15 seconds. This does not apply to passive abilities.
objects.title: Nat 20

objects.text:
You can crit your attacks, but what about that overpowered attack your opponent is about to hit you with? Well, don't worry, you get to roll the same dice you roll for your attacks for defence instead. 

Rather than amplifying your attacks, your enemy's attack will be weakened correspondently. So roll a 2x, and the enemy's attack will be divided by two; 3x, divided by three; and so on.
objects.title: Critical Block!

addons.text: You aren't limited to just rerolling crits anymore; you can reroll any result that relies on luck.
addons.title: Inspiration

objects.text:
You have obtained 3 Luck Points. You can spend a Luck Point to reroll a critical hit and choose which result you want. You have a pseudo-Thinker ability that allows you to instantly decide whether to reroll or keep a previous result. Your Luck Points are refreshed back to 3 ever 24 hours.

Each purchase gives you an extra 3 Luck Points.
objects.title: Feat: Lucky

objects.text: Your criticals can land criticals! The odds are the same as before.
objects.title: Critically critical!

objects.text:
DOOOOOODGE!

And dodge you did. You twirled on your feet and launched into a backflip, ready to snap the bad guy's neck and save the day— oh no! You slipped instead of doing a backflip, giving your enemy a clean shot at you!

Attack they do, and wazzat? They missed?! Well, that's not quite right. See, what actually happened is that you rolled a critical dodge. This means that you were retroactively never hit by that specific attack. How? It just didn't. Don't ask questions.

Now, that's what happens when you roll a simple 2x crit. In that situation, you would just not have been hit. But if you roll a 3x crit, now the power starts working differently. For every multiplier above 2, you gain one second to instantly recover. This does not mean you get to attack in that instance, only to get back up on your feet. This is beyond your control as your power does so automatically.

Rest assured though, you will not be disorientated by this, as you will instinctively know what happened.
objects.title: Critical Dodge!

objects.text:
You can increase the power of your critical hits! You start at a 1x multiplier, which is your base crit damage. Each purchase increases this multiplier by one, so one purchase doubles your crit damage, two purchases will triple it, and so on.

Go forth, you min-maxer, and out-punch the world!
objects.title: One Fat Critical!

objects.text:
When you heal, you roll the same dice as before, but instead of dealing damage, it's about how fast you can recover from wounds! The moment you are healed in any way, the dice are rolled, amplifying the potency of the heal by the multiplier rolled. For example, a 2x multiplier would be twice as effective. The buff lasts for 15 seconds before it's rolled again. If a roll fails afterward, then it will stop until a separate cast happens or you are fully recovered.

This does apply to passive heals. It only rolls after you are hurt and start to heal. Only then will the dice be rolled once more.
objects.title: Critical Heal!

objects.text: It seems you don't have to just crit your healing anymore, you can crit any form of restoration! Stamina, magic, qi, chi, chakra, you name it, you can crit it's recovery rate! The same rules apply as before.
objects.title: Critical Restore!

objects.text: For five minutes, you will land only critical hits. The odds are simple: 80% for 2x, 12% for 3x, 6% for 4x, and 2% for 10x. This is refreshed every 24 hours. This is also applicable to other crit-related upgrades, like Nat 20 and Critical Block.
objects.title: 5 Minute Crit-Man!

objects.text:
For every critical hit, you have a 5% chance to refresh your 5-minute guaranteed crit. Refreshing on a 2x will simply give you the 5 minutes back, but for higher multipliers, the timer increases by 5 minutes for each. For example, landing a 10x crit can grant you a 50-minute guaranteed critical hit. If you land a refresh crit while you have a guaranteed crit active, it will add to your timer.

Simply put... the game was rigged from the start.
objects.title: JACKPOOOT!!!

objects.text:
It seems, that when you land a critical hit, you have a 1% chance to do a black flash, an attack that deals an additional 2.5x damage on top of what you did, critical strike included. This also put you into "the zone." This will make you feel on top of the world as you operate above your potential, and gain a small insight in all of your abilities.

The potential increase is dependent on your critical hit. So for every multiplier of 2, you operate 20% further then what you could before. So a 2x crit would mean you operate at 120%. A 3x would be 130%, and 10x would make you operate at 200%.

This effect only lasts for as long the fight goes on, and it can not stack on another black flash, although nothing stops you from doing another black flash for that extra damage and extra insight. Although if you do land a better black flash then the last, that will overwrite it.

There will be harmless black sparks that will appear where you strike, with the size dependent on your critical hit.
objects.title: Black Flash!

objects.text:
No longer do you need to outright land criticals to land a Black Flash, although you will only be able to operate at 110% without a critical. Everytime you do a black flash though, your odds of landing another increases by another 0.5%, and the potency of the flashes increase by 10% as well. So if you land a second black flash, you will operate at 121%, and you will do 2.75x the damage. A third would allow you to operate at 133%, and do 3.025x the damage.

Remember that the damage multiplier only comes after you operate at a higher potential. Naturally, this only lasts as long as the battle persists, and will die down otherwise.
objects.title: Blessed By The Sparks of Black!

objects.text: Your ability to infuse nano-thorns has been greatly strengthened, and you can permanently allow objects to hold the passive version of your power, letting you create nano-thorn armor and weaponry. Furthermore, you can infuse them with the active version with the duration you could infuse previously. Armsmaster is going to be pissed.
objects.title: Nano Barbs

objects.text: Using your nano-thorns as a basis, your powers evolve deeper into quantum-level physical interactions. Developing into a localized field of quantum teleportation to sunder and disconnect any molecular bond, your passive mode becomes a disintegrating field that spreads stray atoms as radiation, as it’s difficult to control, and your active mode becomes an All-or-Nothing effect able to bypass exotic phenomena like Alexandria’s time-locked body or the Siberian’s projection.
objects.title: Shear

objects.text: The effects of your power can now be extended to your non-melee attacks. You can eliminate or minimise the knockback effect of your attacks, channeling the force to amplify your attack’s impact and speed. This adjustment keeps your opponent from being pushed back, allowing you to stay close and deliver a relentless series of blows without interruption. With each successful hit, your attacks become progressively stronger and faster. On the final hit of your combo, all the accumulated knockback from your previous strikes will be unleashed, launching your opponent with tremendous force.
objects.title: Combo Combo Combo

objects.text: Your ability to halve things expanded, allowing you to apply the lost halve of whatever you affected to yourself or anything you are touching. This will always work from a perspective, so in specific scenarios it can affect things other than yourself, like halving the sharpness of the target's sword, which can transfer that lost sharpness to your own if you also touch another blade. This can be applied to anything you can imagine working on, like taking half of your opponent’s physical strength, taking half of their height, or even more esoteric applications like taking half of their power’s range or half of their luck.
objects.title: Dividend

addons.text:
Your unique ability to integrate your nerves into objects has synergized with your power to fuse with machines, creating a remarkable new capability. When you fuse with a machine, your glowing, metallic nerves spread throughout its structure, connecting with every component and system. This connection grants you an unparalleled understanding of the machine’s inner workings, as if its blueprints and functions are imprinted directly onto your mind.

Beyond merely understanding the machine, your presence automatically identifies any flaws or inefficiencies in its design. You instinctively know how to optimize and improve it, refining its performance and durability. This transformative touch means that any machine you fuse with doesn’t just function at its current capacity—it becomes the best possible version of itself.

Moreover, your nerves do more than just enhance the machine’s design; they also act as a power source. By channeling your energy through the machine, you can temporarily push it into overdrive, maximizing its output and capabilities far beyond its normal limits. This surge of power allows the machine to perform feats that would otherwise be impossible, though only for as long as you maintain the connection. Overuse leaves you exhausted.
addons.title: Wired Nerves

addons.text:
Overcharged by the electric power of your nerves, your cells have become something far more aggressive and formidable. Now, whenever your nerves infiltrate anything or anyone, your cells follow through those pathways like an unstoppable invasion force. Once inside, they begin to systematically take over, replacing the original structure with a cellular replica that mirrors its properties.

Whether it's a machine or a person, the transformation is total. By the time the process is complete, what you control is no longer the original entity—it’s a living extension of yourself, made entirely of your cells, with your glowing nerves pulsing beneath the surface, retaining the capabilities they had before their transformation. These new creations are under your permanent control, acting as autonomous agents that can carry out your will. You can use them as vectors, spreading your influence even further, each one a part of your growing network, linked back to you through the glowing web of your nerves.

Doing this takes a lot of energy and is extremely time consuming.
addons.title: Cellular Takeover

addons.text:
The energy coursing through your nerves is now limitless, a boundless wellspring of power that you can tap into at will. With a thought, you can unleash bolts of lightning from your nerves, sending arcs of raw electricity crackling through the air. You could overclock your body to move and react as fast as sound. This power is awe-inspiring, capable of devastating anything in your path with the sheer force of your electrical fury.

However, this limitless energy comes with a dire warning. While the power behind your nerves may be infinite, your physical body is not. Overusing this immense power can push your body beyond its limits, risking catastrophic damage. The more you channel this overwhelming energy, the greater the strain on your cells, organs, and nervous system. If you're not careful, the very force that grants you such extraordinary abilities could tear you apart from within.
addons.title: Endless Core

objects.text:
Your nerves have evolved, now capable of being overcharged to generate potent surges of electricity. You can electrify anything your nerves touch, enabling you to incapacitate opponents with a paralyzing shock, effectively tasing them with a mere touch. You can even channel this electricity internally to accelerate the rate at which your brain processes and transmits information, granting you a form of superspeed that sharpens your reflexes and quickens your thoughts to near-instantaneous levels. But the true extent of this ability goes even further.

Using your nerves, you can hijack the nervous systems of others, temporarily overriding their control and seizing command of their bodies. Your glowing, metallic nerves can infiltrate their own, allowing you to manipulate their movements and actions as if they were an extension of yourself. This only works while your nerves is touching them however with practice you can leave “programming” into your targets bodies that remains even after you are no longer in contact with them.

Overused of the electricity in your nerves leaves you exhausted, with even your brain working slower than normal.
objects.title: Overcharged Nervous System

objects.text: Your ability to grip things has expanded into the power to treat any substance or physically present phenomena as if it was a solid object with a consistency of your choice. This allows you to bend and mold phenomena as you see fit. Walk on fire, throw lightning, and bend light. This does not extend to more exotic and non-physical phenomena such as Master powers or Vista’s space warping.
objects.title: Interactable

objects.text: Now, you can interact with exotic and non-physical phenomena like they’re things to be molded and shaped by you. So long as it can be perceived, it can be held. You can grasp space, pulling it over yourself like a blanket, letting attacks simply wrap around and through you thanks to the warped geometry. You can snatch moments of time, holding pockets of stasis like they were clay jars of water - both solid and liquid at once. If you’ve something that can let you see thoughts - even just the synapses between neurons - you can pluck them right out of someone’s head. Even power effects can now be manipulated physically, so long as their output is able to be sensed by you. Pulling a green sheen from someone possessed would immediately release them. That basically-flesh-armor around Bitch’s dogs? Snatch it right off their hides. Grey Boy’s bubbles? Let the tormented be freed - you can even keep them as souvenirs or shields.
objects.title: To Grasp Abstraction

objects.text: Rather than just make you next attack physically stronger, it now instead strengthens your powers as a whole. This boost grows for as long as you stay rooted in place. Once you do move, it only lasts for a second.
objects.title: Stillness

objects.text:
When the thorns absorb enough blood, they grow red flowers called Crimson Blooms. These flowers release roots that invade living beings, spreading quickly through their bodies and taking control of their movements.

The Crimson Blooms also produce a pollen that speeds up the decay of organic material, breaking it down rapidly. This process provides nutrients for the thorns, allowing them to grow faster and produce more Crimson Blooms.

Lastly, your thorns now simply go into a “deactivated” state when they don’t have enough blood.
objects.title: Crimson Flower

objects.text:
Your power evolves, gaining a Master component. The faceless husks you create are no longer passive victims—they are now your puppets, their bodies bound to your will. They move and act as you command, perfect extensions of your intent, impervious to hesitation or fear. While under your control, they can even perceive the world through supernatural means, compensating for their lost senses through an eerie, otherworldly awareness.

Their minds, however, remain trapped in absolute darkness, severed from their bodies yet still able to feel every ounce of pain inflicted upon them. They cannot resist, they cannot disobey—they can only endure.

When ordered into combat, your faceless thralls fight without restraint. They can push their muscles beyond human limits, utilizing 100% of their physical strength with no concern for torn ligaments, broken bones, or ruptured organs—wounds that instantly regenerate anyway. They do not flinch, do not falter, and do not stop, attacking with relentless, berserker-like aggression.
objects.title: Faceless

addons.text:
Your faceless thralls no longer remain as mere blank husks—you can now grant them false identities. As long as you do not return their original faces, you can equip them with any face from your collection.

Each faceless can store up to three different faces but may only wear one at a time. With a simple command, they can swap between stored faces, allowing them to shift their abilities mid-combat or adapt to new threats as needed.

Though they regain limited autonomy through these faces, their minds remain trapped in the void, still unable to resist your will. Their bodies move as you dictate, their borrowed faces shaping them into whatever you require—soldiers, spies, or nightmares wearing stolen skin.
addons.title: False Faces

objects.text:
Your control over stolen faces expands beyond yourself—you can now bestow them upon others. Anyone you choose may receive a face from your collection, gaining all the abilities and attributes that come with it. They can summon or dismiss the face at will, shifting between their original form and the granted visage as needed.

However, they can only hold one face at a time. If they wish to use a different one, they must return the currently equipped face to you before receiving another.
objects.title: Face Giver

addons.text:
When you grant a face to someone, it now carries the same transformative power as when you wear it yourself. The recipient fully takes on the target’s form, from their appearance to their physical traits. However, you control what aspects they gain—whether it’s just the body, the memories, the powers or the full package.

You can tailor this to your needs, granting allies the knowledge or skills while allowing them to keep their original form. Or you can use this offensively, flooding your enemies mind with foreign memories, conflicting instincts, and identities that don’t belong to them while keeping anything useful away from them. The sudden rush of experiences can leave them dazed, disoriented, or even break their sense of self entirely. You can even make them only experience the negative experiences of the face you give, further weakening their minds.
addons.title: Facade

objects.text:
Your power now lets you take more than just a face—you take everything. When you steal someone’s face, their entire body becomes smooth and featureless, like a mannequin. They remain trapped in their frozen state, unable to move, sense, or change.

When you wear a stolen face, you don’t just gain its traits—you become the person it belonged to. Your body shifts to match theirs exactly, from their height and build to their voice and fingerprints. You also gain their memories, skills, and any powers they had, using them as naturally as they could.

You can still switch faces instantly, letting you change forms, abilities, and knowledge on the fly. You still can only wear one face at a time. Be wary of wearing a face for too long, as their mind might start to bleed through.
objects.title: Full Face

objects.text:
Death is no longer the end for you. If you are killed while wearing a stolen face, you can rip it away in an instant, restoring yourself to life without a scratch. The price is the face itself—you lose it forever, unable to reclaim it.

The original owner, trapped in their deathless state, is freed in the worst way possible. The moment their face is discarded in this manner, they take on the full force of whatever killed you. A fatal wound, a broken neck, a burned-out husk—whatever should have ended you now becomes their reality, and they die instantly.
objects.title: Discarding Identities

objects.text:
You can swap bodies with anyone within your line of sight. You also now retain access to any and all powers you purchased no matter your current body.

Swap with a Parahuman and you can use their powers while in their body, though you’ll lose those powers if you swap to a new body. 

Swapping bodies is permanent until you desire to move to a new body. At no point are you required to return to your original body if you want to swap with anyone new. Nor does the condition of your original body affect you in any way if you don’t reside in it.
objects.title: Freaky Friday

objects.text:
You can now manifest armor in addition to your cold weapons. The armor must match the same tech level limitations, just traditional “cold” armor: chainmail, scale, plate, reinforced leather, etc., with heavy siege-era suits as your upper limit. This armor, like your weapons, can be imbued with your powers. The result is passive or reactive abilities based on your other powers—an armor laced with Brute traits might absorb impacts or reflect kinetic energy, while a Stranger-infused helm could erase your presence from sight or memory.

You can now summon multiple items at once, limited to what you can actively wield or wear. Wearing armor counts as wielding. If you have two hands, that might mean a sword and shield, or two spears—plus whatever armor you have equipped. You cannot summon gear you can’t maintain control over; if you drop it or lose focus, it dissipates shortly after.

If you have powers that allow you to wield more—telekinesis, extra limbs, duplication, etc.—you may use those to increase the number of weapons or armor pieces you can summon and control.
objects.title: Bankai? Not Quite

objects.text:
Your control now extends beyond hostile actions — even the environment and yourself gain substance under your will. Space, time, and thought become things you can grasp and wrestle with. When someone tries to teleport you, you can seize the empty air as if gripping the rim of a hole, anchoring yourself in place. If a speedster dashes past, you can grab the thread of their motion, stretch it, and react before they even finish their move.

Deception and mind tricks hold no ground before you. A lie spoken near you takes shape like a string of smoke — you can pluck it, snap it, and watch the truth bleed through. Fear or despair made manifest can be crushed beneath your heel, the emotional weight breaking apart like fragile glass. Even Thinker plans or simulated foresight take form in your sight, scrolls and threads that can be torn apart to unmake the destined outcome.

You can punch sense back into the deranged, suplex nightmares into the dirt, and brute-force illusion into logic until it shatters. By asserting Violence on the intangible, you turn defiance into a physical act — if reality doesn’t agree, you make it.
objects.title: You Coward

objects.text:
Instead of being able to directly shift your smallest cold weapon into your biggest one and vice versa, you now are limited to only being able to convert the weapon to one with roughly the same size as it or the nearest bigger/smaller one, though you can skip up to 10 centimeters of the size.

You know exactly what cold weapons you can currently turn the weapon you are touching and what progression you need to follow in order to reach the weapon you want.
objects.title: Size-Based Conversion

objects.text:
Instead of automatically turning others' bodies against them you instead have a ‘deathtouch', a Thinker ability that enables you to attack an opponent's body in a way that forces it into working against itself, by doing things like giving heart arrhythmia or causing carbon dioxide bubbles in their blood. 
This also allows you to enable other bodily functions of theirs, whether it’s giving them an adrenaline rush, making them empty their bowels or temporarily disabling their inner ear to remove their balance.
objects.title: Dripfeed

objects.text:
Your Black Flash exponential increase in force is increased by .5, and your performance enhancement increases by an additional 20% for each purchase. 

So a single increase moves the exponent to 3, and your performance increase to 140%. Two would be 3.5 and 160%, and so on.
objects.title: Vanta Flash

objects.text:
Like any good Multitool your Micromanipulators can now switch modes, this new mode expands your telekinetic manipulation from a tool for delicate work into a force capable of affecting matter on a much larger scale. The same basic principles remain, but your precision is greatly reduced in exchange for greater range, volume, and raw force.

In this mode your telekinetic field can now extend several meters from your body, allowing you to move, pull apart, crush, bend, weld, or reshape large objects without touching them. You can dismantle vehicles, shift machinery, tear through walls, manipulate construction materials, or assemble large structures with relative ease.

You can affect entire sections of an object at once rather than individual components. However, fine manipulation becomes extremely difficult. Separating complex mechanisms, manipulating individual molecules, or performing delicate repairs is far beyond this power's intended use and is vastly easier with the original Micromanipulator mode.
objects.title: Macromanipulators

objects.text: Your ‘Budget’ of mass increases by 10,000kg for each selection of this upgrade.
objects.title: Mass Budget Increase

objects.text: Whenever you burn you fat, a portion of the temporary strength will stay, creating muscles in its place.
objects.title: Growing Fat

objects.text: The more obese you are, the higher your durability becomes. You also gain a regenerative factor. Blunt attacks become completely ineffective and any wounds you suffer will heal rapidly.
objects.title: Stronger Fat

objects.text: You can transform into multiple animals that are smaller than you. The total volume of all the animals you transform into must be no more than 150% of your original volume and no less than 100% of your base volume. All the animals will be connected via a hivemind that you control. You can absorb any of the animals back at any moment. If you transform back into your human form with less than your base total volume then you will suffer injuries.
objects.title: Swarm

objects.text: You can now take the form of any classical fantasy creature, such as a dragon or unicorn. The abilities of these forms match what the wider population believes they possess, such as a dragon's flight or their ability to breathe fire.
objects.title: Mythical Kingdom

objects.text:
You can now absorb surrounding matter and turn it into minions, which you can control and shape as you see fit. The more durable the materials and the more minions you try to make at once, the longer it takes to create, up to a minute max when making dozens out of esoteric materials. The higher the durability of your minions, the greater their strength. However, the more matter you use to create them, the less dexterous they become. Your minions are capable of functioning independently if you provide them with a task, possessing only slightly lower levels of problem-solving skills and critical thinking than you.

Your minions have a potentially infinite lifespan, but their bodies gradually deteriorate over time, with the rate of deterioration increasing as they age. For example, a steel minion may only be able to last a week before its rusty body falls apart.
objects.title: Golem Maker

objects.text: Rather than relying on the slow and permanent changes of the cocoon, you can now instantly adopt a temporary, specialized form. These temporary transformations are tailored to adapt your body to enhance your abilities. Unlike the cocoon, which reshapes you gradually, this form shift is immediate but wears off after an hour. For example, a pyrokinetic might briefly transform into a being wreathed in flames, with skin resembling molten rock, significantly boosting their pyrokinesis and removing many limitations, including Manton Limits. After your transformation ends, there is a three hour cooldown. If you have Once a Caterpillar, Now a Butterfly then you have control over the specifics during each transformation, even having a database of each unique forms you have taken before during the transformation. If you have Constant Refinement then the forms in this database will constantly evolve as if they are in the cocoon when not activated.
objects.title: Combat Form

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to supercharge your cocoon, transforming it into a vessel for extraordinary evolution. When you enter the cocoon, you enter a deep hibernation-like state, during which your body undergoes rapid and radical alterations. Before the process begins, you have the power to choose the specific focus of your transformation. Whether you desire enhanced speed, strength, intelligence, or any other attribute, the cocoon will adapt your biology to align with your chosen goal.

As you remain in the cocoon, your body mutates at an accelerated rate, granting you superhuman capabilities that reflect the focus you selected. The longer you stay within the cocoon, the more profound and specialized the changes become. For instance, if you choose to prioritize speed, your new form will emerge with multiple T0 abilities designed to maximize velocity—such as enhanced reflexes, increased muscle efficiency, and even specialized organs or limbs that push your speed to the limits of what is physically possible. If you choose to focus on a power you have, not only will the strength of this power increase you will also gain multiple minor secondary powers to boost it further. These enhancements are deeply integrated into your new biology, giving you a permanent edge in the area you chose to refine. 

You can, to a degree, choose your appearance after undergoing mutations in the cocoon but it comes with a trade-off: the more you focus on aesthetics, the less potent the abilities you gain. However, this reduction in power can be mitigated by extending your time in the cocoon, allowing the mutations to fully develop despite the customization.
objects.title: Once a Caterpillar, Now a Butterfly

objects.text:
You no longer need a cocoon, instead your body is constantly refining and improving itself, generating minor powers based off your current requirements and desires. This no longer just affects your body, but your actions too. In time your power will refine them until they can be considered T0 abilities. This process is slower and uncontrollable in comparison to entering your cocoon. 

In addition, you can now actively accelerate the rate of growth in the cocoon, at the cost of nutrients in your body.
objects.title: Constant Refinement

addons.text:
You’ve gained the ability to turn into more classical forms of Non-Human in old human myths. From the classical Vampires of Eastern Europe, Leprechauns of Ireland, Dwarves of Scandinavia, to even the somewhat more modern stories of the Lilliputians. 

Moreover you’ve gained the ability to tap into the “modern” monsters, the Case 53s. Now you can fully replicate the forms and abilities of more well known Case 53s. For those that have not made their way into the public eye you’ll still have to encounter in order to replicate, although you’ll be able to replicate their ability in full even if it’s not tied to their form. 

You are no longer limited to just touch in order to replicate their form, as long as they get within your line of sight you can replicate their form.
addons.title: Creatures Lurking in the Dark

addons.text: Now your abilities extend to the aliens of the Omnitrix, now able to freely incorporate their abilities into yourself as you would other creatures.
addons.title: Creatures Lurking Among the Stars

objects.text:
You can freely shift and combine your various forms together. Shift your muscles into that of a tiger, your eyes into that of a hawk, coat your lion’s maw with the venom of a cobra, and more.

Your power has also expanded to cover the entirety of the Animalia Kingdom, regardless of size. 

Moreover these changes experience none of the problems that these kinds of chimeras would normally exhibit, so feel free to mix various forms across any number of kingdoms as you wish, from the cold blooded reptiles and the warm blooded bobcat, to the south american bullet ant and the african elephant.
objects.title: Chimera

objects.text: Your power has progressed to the point of archiving and manipulating previous bodily and genetic traits, personally controlling them to build a personalized body structure.
objects.title: Heterosis

objects.text: Any powers you have can now be used through the mouths you create, becoming stronger and often gaining new aspects or altering existing ones. For example, instead of shooting a blast with (Blaster) Epilepsy you could choose to channel it into a scream, which not only would make it affect multiple targets but also travel at the speed of sound.
objects.title: Yapping

addons.text: Your ability to manifest oral structures is now connected to your ability to adapt your mouths for consumption, capable of picking and choosing whatever feeding system would fit your purposes best. This vastly refines and optimizes your ability to feed (e.g. letting you unhinge your jaw like a snake’s while growing multiple rows of teeth akin to shark, using this growth to rapidly grind down anything you have your gums around). As with the aforementioned use case, you may now hybridize oral structures however you wish, letting you create unique configurations of mouths tailored to any consumption task you see fit to perform.
addons.title: Hungry Hungry

objects.text: You can now manifest the jaws, teeth - generally the oral structures of any creature found in the animal kingdom. Lamprey rings, beaks, baleen, snake fangs, and the like. Each mouth retains its natural functions and properties, scaled to fit your chosen placement. Like with your normal mouths, you can alter the insides of these mouths as well, extending into the adjustment of their natural properties such as poisons or flexibility.
objects.title: Maw-nagerie

objects.text:
Your bones now have an all-or-nothing defence—completely unbreakable under any mundane force. Should this all-or-nothing defence fail, it is also now made of an advanced steel alloy, giving them a higher base defence. Despite this change, your body remains perfectly balanced. The steel integrates seamlessly with your organs and muscles, causing no complications or risk of metal poisoning. You retain full mobility and strength, but now with the added security of an unyielding core.

Additionally, your claws have undergone a significant upgrade. What were once bone claws are now sleek metal blades forged from the same indestructible material as your skeleton. These blades possess an all-or-nothing cutting power, allowing them to slice through any mundane material effortlessly.

While this transformation grants incredible durability and power, it is not without its downsides. The added weight of your steel skeleton makes swimming nearly impossible, as you sink like a rock in water, turning even shallow bodies of water into potential hazards. Additionally, while the Manton Limit prevents others from directly manipulating your steel bones through powers, it offers no protection against indirect methods. This means you remain vulnerable to forces like powerful magnets, which can disrupt or even immobilize you under the right conditions.
objects.title: Adamantium Bones

objects.text: You now have two retractable bone claws in each arm and one in each foot, all naturally sharp and significantly tougher than ordinary human bone. The claws retain their incredible sharpness, capable of cutting through steel with ease.
objects.title: X-23

objects.text: You can now affect dead cells in addition to living cells. Additionally, you can now freely revive dead cells and kill living cells, while maintaining control over both in either state.
objects.title: Dead Cells

objects.text:
You transform into a different type of jungle: an urban or rural ecosystem, or any man-made environment. Your area expands into a 10-mile radius, where empty establishments, buildings, streets, and avenues fill your ‘self’, with facsimiles of ‘people’, layouts, and everything that’s part of an urban or rural ecosystem—cars or tractors, for example—at your command, shift a building to another corner, shift the streets to be roundabouts, direct ‘people’ to dog-pile anyone, etc.

If there’s no command for your facsimiles, they’ll pantomime a resemblance of a bustling city or rural county.
objects.title: Concrete Jungle

objects.text:
The longer you remain in your transformed state, the larger your biome expands, gradually increasing your influence over a wider area. If left unchecked, your biome can stretch for miles, growing in complexity and detail as time progresses. 

Additionally, you can now manifest two separate biomes simultaneously—such as a volcanic region and an icy tundra—existing side by side without the two interacting unless you will it.
objects.title: Expanding Biome

addons.text: Double feedback. Strikes and hits that you take both induce tremors in your biology and slowly grow your form. Goliath can now apply to even the tectonic plates on your body, hardening the gaps between the plates into mountain ranges and hills and valleys, which in turn only make any reprisals greater as these geological formations on your skin split, crack, and practically explode from the immense pressure placed on them. Larger geological formations such as mountains will also tend to develop very pressurized magma chambers over the course of a couple seconds while undisturbed, pushing your opponents to keep striking at your most durable spots in spite of the damage done to themselves. Not only that, but as your size increases, so does your ability to exert inertia, the laws of reality growing a bias towards your actions in terms of physical force outputted by you, favoring your actions. Note that it only applies to force outputted by you and not against you - a scaling strength multiplier, not a durability multiplier.
addons.title: Megathrust Quaking

objects.text:
Your biology is no longer of stone upon your transformation. It is of Earth. Your changer form has become a walking, geologically hyperactive lithosphere. 

Your flesh acts like continuously shifting tectonic plates, consistently in motion at the microscopic level. When struck, your living rock and stone fracture no matter how weak the hit actually was, before immediately reforming to grind against each other with great strength, violently generating great amounts of energy depending on the strength of the hit.

Damage creates fault lines across the body, and as the plates shift back into place, the friction produces bursts of sparking heat and seismic shockwaves that radiate outwards from the point of injury. A deep enough cutting injury might split them entirely, but your ‘regeneration’ would pull them back together like colliding landmasses, producing tons worth of force and heat. A blunt strike would instead cause subduction, which would momentarily absorb the impact before delivering a swift reprisal outwards in the form of explosive tremors.
objects.title: Continental Flesh

objects.text:
Your transformation has evolved beyond just changing your form—now, the pieces of you have a life of their own. Any part torn from your body no longer simply lies limp and useless. Instead, these fragments can move independently, acting on their own with a level of intelligence comparable to that of a clever monkey. They can scurry, climb, and even coordinate basic tasks.

These living scraps are not bound to their initial size or shape. Like you, they can absorb fabric to regenerate and grow, stitching themselves together into new forms.
