A small torn-off piece might skitter away like a living patch, seeking out material to restore itself, while a larger segment could reshape into an entirely separate puppet-like entity, ready to assist you in combat or reconnaissance. These offshoots are not mindless; while not capable of speech or complex thought, they exhibit a mischievous animal cunning, following simple commands and acting with a degree of self-preservation.

As they grow, these fragments will inevitably develop stable muppet-like forms, and once they do, they tend to stick with them. Whether they take on the shape of crude, childlike dolls or intricate, expressive puppets, their appearance influences their temperament. A stitched-together wolf might be aggressive and loyal, while a raggedy, floppy rabbit may be jittery and anxious. You can let these forms emerge naturally, shaped by their experiences and absorbed materials, or directly mold them into whatever shape you desire. Regardless of their form, they remain inherently loyal to you, acting as extensions of your will. Over time, they may develop quirks, preferences, or habits, making each one a distinct, albeit simple, personality within your growing patchwork family.
objects.title: Muppet Show

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to the absorption of knowledge and skill alone—now, by drinking blood, you can siphon the very powers that reside within others.

When you consume the blood of a powered individual, you gain access to a faint echo of their abilities. This echo begins as a mere fragment—only about 1% of the original strength—and fades as the blood leaves your system. However, with repeated feedings from the same source, and shorter intervals between each consumption, the power strengthens and persists for longer durations. Drinking different bloods in between slows the rate too. Eventually, if the cycle continues uninterrupted, you can achieve full replication of the power, permanently integrating it into yourself. This takes close to a year at minimum.

If a power come from their physiology, you also gain the ability to undergo partial transformations that reflect the origin of the ability. This could manifest as hardened skin, wings, claws, or other physiological changes necessary to channel the effect.

The taste of blood has also changed. Powers carry a distinct flavor, rich and often overwhelming, and those gifted with rare or complex abilities produce blood that is intoxicating, euphoric, and dangerously addictive. While you don't need to worry about overdosing, getting addicted will mess with your mental state.
objects.title: Tepes

objects.text: You gain the ability to extend 1 more tails from the same area as your original tail for each purchase of this ability, with each extra tails having all of the same capabilities as the original and benefiting from add-ons. As a bonus the maximum length of all tails is increased by twice your height each time you purchase this ability.
objects.title: Re-Tail Order

objects.text:
Now the effects of Armored Skin apply to everything you wear, not just the strongest piece of armor. Similar benefits don’t stack, so this doesn’t allow you to stack a bunch of durability to become greater than the strongest piece of your armor, however this does open the door to great versatility. 

You could become immune to electricity by wearing rubber boots, be protected from the cold using gloves, and even tinkertech meant to conceal just your face would affect your entire body.
objects.title: Fullbody Effect

addons.text:
The all-encompassing nature of Dire Canidae now extends to any animal you can transform into, allowing you to transform into an amalgam reptile, ursidae, felidae, and aves, among others.

If you have Chimera, this applies to any alterations, such as transforming your arms into those of the amalgam reptile and your legs into amalgam felidae.

If you have Mythical Kingdom, this applies to any similarly defined creature found in myth, such as dragons and vampires.

objects.text: Rather than just a wolf, your changer form now incorporates all the best traits from every animal under the Canidae family tree, stacked on top of each other wherever possible, and all scaled to the same degree as (Changer) Dire Wolf. This includes dogs, wolves, foxes, jackals, coyotes, dingoes and many other dog-like mammals.
objects.title: Dire Canidae

objects.text: “Your Shard figured out what a Dragon is… still not a Dragonfly.” Your Changer state now manifests as a colossal creature standing nearly fifteen meters at the shoulder and over fifty meters from head to tail. The shape is unmistakably draconic, with a broad chest, powerful limbs, and a sweeping tail, but every surface gleams with chitin rather than scale. The carapace shimmers with metallic greens and bronzes under light, and four enormous wings rise from your back like translucent banners of glass, each one large enough to cast the ground below into shadow. Your head is still that of an insect, with vast faceted eyes and a long proboscis framed by serrated mandibles, yet its proportions and posture evoke the silhouette of a dragon more than a fly. The original features of your form have all expanded to match your size, being boosted by a whole magnitude. Your vision is panoramic and layered across multiple spectrums, able to detect heat, motion, and ultraviolet signatures miles away. The vibrations from your wings generate shockwaves, strong enough to uproot trees or scatter siege engines, while your exoskeleton can shrug off heavy artillery and repair itself within minutes through accelerated molting. Your flight has become impossible in scope, guided by instinctive gyroscopic balance that lets you maneuver through storms as if they were still air. With the new magnitude of your size, your body has developed additional features that fill the newfound internal space and refine your biology toward something that more closely resembles the dragons your Shard finally understood. Your carapace is now overlapping chitin plates that mimic draconic scales. Each plate interlocks with the next, refracting and polarizing light through microscopic wing-like membranes layered within the structure. This makes your armor capable of reflecting heat, dispersing energy, and adjusting color to match environmental conditions. Beneath the armor lies the biological heart of your new form, a massive metabolic core that channels every chemical reaction in your body into heat, motion, and raw energy. It functions as both a reactor and a circulatory pump, converting matter into energy with almost perfect efficiency. Excess heat glows through the seams of your body in faint orange light, especially at the joints and thorax, and this energy drives every major function of your body: flight, regeneration, and breath. The heat and current generated are so intense that they can be felt radiating from you even at a distance, and your wings use that same energy to maintain thermal balance and propulsion, keeping you aloft in ways that defy normal aerodynamics. Your breath weapon, once a corrosive enzymic spray, now manifests as true biological fire. Your metabolic core superheats the enzyme-laden fluid until it reaches plasma-like temperatures, and your wings compress the surrounding air to ignite it as it leaves your proboscis. The stream burns white and gold, accompanied by a roar of air displacement. The heat output is devastating, capable of melting through stone walls or turning armored vehicles into slag. Finally, your body radiates a field of pheromonal and infrasonic influence that completes your transformation into something unmistakably draconic. It saturates the air with complex bioelectric and chemical messages that trigger primal reactions in all nearby life. Smaller creatures are driven to flee or submit; sapient beings experience a pressure of awe or fear that feels almost supernatural.
objects.title: More Dragon Than Fly

addons.text:
Your Eeveelutions now gain an additional form, essentially a third evolution for each Type. These third stage evolutions hold power to rival a mid-tier legendary Pokemon, each possessing powerful stats and unique abilities worthy of legend, such as your Leafeon form's third stage being able to grow a whole forest in a day.

Keep in mind that while legendary in power, the difference between a mid-tier legend and a top-tier legend are vast. For example, Flareon's third stage evolution would rival Entei in power as a Fire Type legendary, however it would pale in comparison to Primal Groudon. Just as your Ghost Type Eeveelution form's third stage could match Spectrier, but Giratina could easily overpower it.
addons.title: Legendary Eeveelution

objects.text: You have shed Pokémon’s transformation versatility in favor of focusing on a single evolutionary line, that of Eevee. However, in doing so, you have broken the limitations of the common Eevee and become the pinnacle of Eevee-kind. You can transform into an Eevee or Eeveelution, even non-canon ones, for each Type, such as a Ghost Type Spectreon, and your IVs/stats are beyond perfect for an Eevee. Furthermore, each form has its own version of Water Absorb, causing attacks of the same “Type” to heal it, even self-damaging moves. For instance, if you were a Flareon, any form of pyrokinetic attack would be fundamentally incapable of harming you, instead healing you. Lastly, Abilities and Moves such as Magic Bounce or Mimic count parahuman powers as Moves, so Espeon can reflect powers such as Victor’s skill theft, which would count as a form of debuff stat Move.
objects.title: Eeveemental Flux

objects.text: You can now transform into ANY Pokemon, including legendaries and mythicals. Pokedex entries still don't apply.
objects.title: Legendary Pokemon

addons.text:
Rather than need a mass of cells equal to your brain for full cognition, this ability has been pushed to its absolute limit. Any individual sentient cell is now sufficient to easily host your entire consciousness and memories.

This enhanced capacity naturally extends to your Corona Pollentia. Even if you were reduced to a single living cell, you retain complete and unimpaired control over all your powers despite lacking any neurological structure.

As a side effect of this potential for decentralisation, your cells can remotely communicate with one another through their shared connection to your shard. As such, you can continue to think and act as a unified whole, even if you were reduced down to a blood spatter or a thin red mist.
addons.title: Last Cell Standing

objects.text:
Your cognitive processes are no longer solely reliant on your brain. If it is harmed or rendered non-functional, the task of hosting your consciousness and memories can instead be assumed by any of the sentient cells in your body.

This lessens your mind's fragility, reducing your vulnerability to headshots and other forms of cranial trauma. This capacity for decentralization also extends to your Corona Pollentia, allowing you to retain control over shard-based powers even when lacking a conventionally intact Corona Pollentia structure.

To replicate your normal mental performance, a minimum mass of cells equal in number to that of your normal brain is required. The cells hosting your mind do not suffer any loss of efficiency from this additional burden.

If insufficient cells are available, your cognition and memory decline in proportion to the deficit. This also doesn’t improve your regenerative ability, meaning you can still rapidly bleed out and die if your head is severed.
objects.title: Somatic Mind State

objects.text: You gain two more tentacles, totaling 10, but only they retain the full maximum length while your original eight can only extend up to half of that. Your tentacles now also retain the full capacity of your own senses, and become even better with the proper equipment.
objects.title: Architeuthis Dux

objects.text: At one selection, your tentacles can come anywhere from your back instead of being confined to a specific location. At two selections, they can come from anywhere in your body.
objects.title: Free Tentacles

addons.text: The selections from Free Tentacles still work, restoring back/body tentacles depending on their level of selection.
addons.title: Free^2 Tentacles

addons.text:
Thanks to Comakinesis, you now have absurd control over your hair tentacles, to the point that they can shapeshift in the same way as the second selection from Shifting Tentacles. Not only that, but your precision with them is so much you could make a straight cut that would remain so down to the atoms. You can also somewhat mismatch properties, like making a fleshy octopus tentacle as durable as titanium.

Also, the maximum length of your tentacles will now increase as you grow older.
addons.title: Tentacle Hair^2

objects.text: Instead of coming from your back you can turn every single hair in your head into tentacles.
objects.title: Tentacle Hair

addons.text: With every selection you can choose whether you are gaining a full-length or half-length tentacle. You can have a maximum of 24 half-length and 6 full-length tentacles with just this, depending on other choices you might have more, just remember that for every 8 eight half-length tentacles you can have 2 full-length.
addons.title: Extra Tentacles

objects.text: Every selection increases the amount of tentacles you can have by 1.
objects.title: More Tentacles

objects.text: Every selection increases the maximum length of your tentacles by 1 meter.
objects.title: Longer Tentacles

objects.text: With every selection you can double the amount or length you get through More Tentacles and Longer Tentacles. So at one selection you would get 2 tentacles per selection of More Tentacles, at two 4, at three 8, and so on, same applies to Longer Tentacles.
objects.title: Multiplied Tentacles

objects.text: At one selection, you gain the capacity to change your tentacles in the same way the base power can, but at will. With the second selection, you can freely shapeshift your tentacles.
objects.title: Shifting Tentacles

objects.text: At one selection, multiple compatible powers can be channeled at the same time. With the second selection, you no longer have a limit in that at all.
objects.title: Multifaceted Tentacles

objects.text:
The Tinkertech limitation on your changer form is now lifted, allowing you to transform your body into any weapon you know how to build, but while the weapon to body volume limitation stays the same, a change has been made to acompany the exotic types of ammunition.

Unlike the infinite ammunition for normal weapons, Tinkertech weapons you shift into require your physical stamina to generate ammunition. 

The more complex or energy dense your weapon's ammunition is, more stamina it takes to generate, so no spamming BFG 9000s. 

Even if you don't have a Tinkering power, this upgrade comes with basic sci-fi weapons such as plasma blasters and sonic cannons but they are extremally basic and lackluster at best.
objects.title: Sci-Fi Arms Upgrade

addons.title: The Form Remembers
addons.text: Shapeshifting your equipment no longer damages it or reduces it's functionality though this works best when it can be easily translated, a laptop turned into a phone works just as well but a sword probably can't retain its edge in the form of a baseball bat (though when shifted back to a sword it will regain said edge).

objects.text:
Your shapeshifting is no longer limited by the clothes you already wear, as you may instantaneously conjure mundane clothing, accessories or props onto your body, as well as transmogrify any you are already equipped with. If removed from your person, the next time you shift your clothing, anything conjured disappears and transmogrified items return to their original state (if unharmed).

Anything that requires electronics, complex moving parts or solidity will only function cosmetically without external items that possess such features, for example body armor or melee weapons will look real but are as effective as foam. Transmogrified items can only be shifted so much without interfering with their functions or potentially breaking them, with such modifications exerting you in the same way as physically bending or crushing them to fit would, with it being impossible to alter some objects in this way at a certain point without a greater than human strength. A phone cannot become smaller or thinner than the electronics within lest it crush them (though it may grow larger into a mobile tablet), a gun must maintain its mechanisms in order to fire lest they become mangled, and a sword cannot be made into a knife lest it permanently lose its length.
objects.title: Clothes Maketh the Man

objects.text: All changes to powers via Scramble are permanent.
objects.title: Permanent Change

objects.text: You can now completely control how the affected powers express themselves. This allows you to change powers horizontally at will, though they cannot change in overall strength or versatility.
objects.title: Controlled Tweaking

objects.text:
You go from swapping the expressions to swapping the source of powers into shardless by cutting the connection between the user and the host for beings who received powers from an outside source and then replicating said power as a shardless one in the user. This process can take up to a few minutes, requiring you to be in direct contact with the user or the host, and can be detected by the power source, albeit it can never prevent it from happening.

In the case of parahumans, this will damage the Corona Pollentia, making it impossible for them to trigger with a new power.
objects.title: Shardbreaker

objects.text:
Your network has been upgraded, with your hub in particular being significantly improved: Your hub members may each access seven powers with zero loss in strength, while you in particular may use up to twelve without any power loss, and potentially up to twenty-five. For each power past the twelfth, you incur a slowly-increasing penalty in their strength, capping out at 50% for a full set.

Should you happen to also have Negentropy, then your hub members may access ten powers, and you may access the full twenty-five powers without any more loss in strength.
objects.title: Network 2.0

objects.text:
You are able to create Sub Networks within your primary network. You can now designate members of your main network as Administrators, granting them the ability to form and manage their own subnetworks. Administrators have full control over their subnetworks, including deciding which powers their members can access and how they are distributed. Subnetwork members are fully independent from the main network and other subnetworks—they cannot access powers or resources from outside their own subnetwork unless they are also a member of those other networks.

Administrators can use up to 8 powers simultaneously within their subnetwork (separated from the 5 powers from the main network), with every 1 additional power over 8 dropping the strength of their power by 20%, with 20% strength being the lowest it can go, while subnetwork members can access up to 3. Subnetwork members have no awareness of the main network or other subnetworks unless they are explicitly added to them, maintaining a clear separation between groups.

Administrators can also create partitions within their subnetwork, allowing them to restrict which powers their members can access and control how abilities are distributed. 

You retain full access to all subnetworks, including their members, powers, and configurations. While subnetworks operate autonomously, you can allow Administrators and their subnetworks access to powers from the main network. You can even make a specific power mandatory and remove the Administrator’s ability to remove the power from their subnetwork. This option is entirely under your control, giving you flexibility in determining how resources are shared across your system.
objects.title: Virtual Network

addons.text: Now in addition to allowing you to add non-parahumans to your network, you gain the ability to trigger/awaken anyone you add to your network.
addons.title: Sign On Bonus

addons.text:
Those in your network are all subject to Loyalty Insurance, regardless of whether they possess abilities or not. 

You can choose to whom this applies to in your network, in any manner. Whether that means it affects everyone as soon as they’re added; whether you choose to apply it manually, under certain parameters, or whatever else you want.
addons.title: Close Network

objects.text: You can now add non-parahumans to your network. They’ll gain access as normal members do, and if and when they do trigger or awaken, their abilities will be accessible on the network as well.
objects.title: Free Access Network

objects.text: You can now Tinker with your Crystalized powers, allowing you to modify them in numerous ways. Fusing, splitting, splicing, and even growing new crystals from the fragments of previous ones are a few instances of these modifications. You are significantly more skilled than other Tinkers at incorporating these crystals into your creations, enhancing their ability to house, manage, and interface with these crystals.
objects.title: Crystal Tinker

addons.text: You can hand out any number of personal and power related perks and drawbacks that you have or have had to those who possess at least one power handed out by Quartermaster. If you take back all powers you have given them, then they lose any perks you have given them as well. Your amount of copies is increased to 15 (30 with Negentrophy/Shardless). You still retain your limit of copies that you can hand out without powers.
addons.title: Basic Set

addons.text: Whenever someone enters your hub, you gain a permanent copy of their ability for yourself and additional copies to hand to others. You can share as many powers/perks as you wish among those in your hub.
addons.title: Supply Chain

addons.text:
You may optionally have your power slowly change those you have given out powers to, slowly shifting them into your perfect companions. You may instead optionally allow your power to simply enforce absolute loyalty on those you have affected, or simply not affect them at all if you wish. This can be done on a case by case basis and can be changed at anytime. You have a subconscious awareness of the location of all those within your network, and are able to freely set up and allow telepathic communication between members, and can also summon and teleport members to each other’s location, you included. You can extend these capabilities to anyone you have gifted a power/perk to. If and when you choose to release someone the changes you have made remain, although they are no longer maintained by your power and as such those effected can change their loyalty and behavior as they normally would. 

(Note: If you have taken any companions from the companion section or followers of some other kind, you may optionally choose to apply the effects of General upon entry to any of them, granting any combination it could grant that you wish, up to you power’s limit. If you would wish your power to shift them into your perfect companions, you can opt for it to have already been done so.)
addons.title: General

addons.text: Your allotted copies are now endless, you may hand out as many copies of anything you can hand out, in whatever combination you wish. You can recall these at will as normal.
addons.title: The Endless Horde

objects.text: Soulmate has upgraded, you can now hand out to 10 (15 with Negentrophy/Shardless) copies of any powers and power related perks you have to anyone. You only need to know either what they look like or their name to do so. You will never give a power to someone you didn’t mean to. You can take back any power you have at any time, and those you give out powers cannot stop you from doing so regardless of other factors. Your own powers and perks trump any you give them unless you would wish otherwise. You choose what power/perks or combination of powers and perks you give out, meaning you can give one person a single power and someone else another, as long as you don’t hand out more copies of than you have. Those you have given powers/perks will retain them up until you have taken them back, meaning they can keep them after your death if you do not recollect them by then. Powers you have handed out cannot be used negatively against you unless you would wish it to.
objects.title: Quartermaster

addons.text: Your ability to plan has improved in regard to making people trigger, such as making a single, continuous plan that increases the rate of triggers or a plan that causes a cluster trigger. Not only that, you also gain the ability to influence what powers appear when they trigger, to a degree, by controlling the circumstances. Your plans allow you to permanently scar the minds of those you trigger, in a way much like Simurgh bombs.
addons.title: Shard Connection

objects.text:
You bypass the usual blind spot on trigger events; in fact, your power focuses entirely on them. By focusing on someone who triggered, you receive a vision of the trigger event they experienced. By focusing on someone who has a Corona Pollentia but has yet to trigger, you receive an intuition as to what could cause them to trigger.

This comes with a minor thinker power that helps you leverage this information, making situations where your target will either trigger or second trigger.
objects.title: Trigger Sight

objects.text: You can see physical representation of shards. Their appearance will always be a mix between their host’s current abilities as well as the Shard's own specialty.
objects.title: Shard Sight

objects.text: Your ability to see powers has evolved to be able to completely see and perfectly understand the inner works of Shards and Powers. As a result, any power that allows you to copy powers by touch now works by line of sight up to a max distance of 100m. This power only sees shard-based powers without Esoteric Knowledge and does not change how long your power takes to copy powers.
objects.title: Shard Insight

addons.text: In addition to Eos & Selene, you are also able to summon Carbuncle — a small (and adorable) fox-like creature with a forked tail — in its Ruby (Fire), Emerald (Wind), and Topaz (Earth) variants. Carbuncle has its own mana pool and is able to cast five spells: Ruin, a bolt of energy that deals elemental damage to a single target; Outburst, an area of effect attack that deals elemental damage to all targets in a 2m radius; Strike, a charge that deals elemental damage to a target and stuns them for a few seconds; Radiant Aegis, a barrier that halves the strength of blows and harmful energy-based effects in a 2m radius; Lux Solaris, a pulse of healing energy that applies the effect of Cure to all allies in a 2m radius. When Carbuncle has a full mana pool, you can use the Summon Ifrit (Fire), Summon Garuda (Wind), and Summon Titan (Earth) spells to transform Carbuncle into a more powerful form. The upgraded form has a mana pool of 240 and lasts for 30 seconds. It has an appearance that matches its element, around two feet tall and vaguely demonic, and possesses an expanded array of elemental spells as well as control and creation of its specific element in a radius of 10m. Once its mana is exhausted or the summon time expires, Carbundle reverts to its base and cannot be summoned again for one hour. Only one summon can be active at once.
addons.title: And Carbuncle Too

addons.text: Rather than just spells to summon another entity, through your ability to merge with others you have also gained the inversions of the normal Summon spells, Mantle Eos, Mantle Selene, and Mantle Seraph. When casting a Mantle spell you overlay whatever you would be ‘summoning’ on yourself instead of summoning it as a separate entity. When Mantling something you gain cosmetic traits reminiscent of it and gain all of its abilities, including adding its mana pool to your own. While you can only Mantle one entity at a time and still need to meet the summoning criteria; i.e. if you want to Mantle Seraph you need to be at full Mana and be Mantling Eos or Selene - once you have Mantled something you can use your powers as normal, even regenerating Mana. Additionally, you do not have to un-Mantle at any point, even past the point when a summon like Seraph would disperse, however holding a Mantle past the point your other half would have dispersed incurs minor but persistent backlash such as a Thinker headache, so don’t get too comfortable. If you have And Carbuncle Too then you also gain the spells Mantle Carbuncle, Mantle Ifrit, Mantle Garuda, and Mantle Titan.
addons.title: Mantling

objects.text: You gain the spells Summon Eos, Summon Selene, and Summon Seraph. The first two allow you to summon either Eos or Selene to assist you with healing, each fairy has its own mana reserve which functions similar to yours but their spell list is restricted. You can only summon one fairy at once. Eos, which takes on the appearance of a 12 inch tall glowing fairy with green wings, is focused on direct healing and can cast Esuna, Staunch, Cure, Regen, Raise, and Shell for half their mana cost. Selene, which takes on the appearance of a 12 inch tall glowing fairy with red wings, is focused on support and can cast Holy, Bless, Curse, Greater Elemental, which grants elemental creation, and Silent Dawn which prevents a parahuman from using their power for 1 second. Summon Seraph can be cast while either Eos or Selene is summoned and their mana reserve is full. This will transform them into an angelic figure with a pair of glowing wings around two feet tall for 30 seconds. Seraph has a mana reserve of 240 that does not refill and can cast any of the spells of either Eos or Selene. Once its mana is exhausted or the summon time expires, Seraph reverts to Eos or Selene and cannot be summoned for one hour.
objects.title: Eos & Selene

addons.text: Your deck of major arcana expands to 18 cards with more varied effects that can enhance, protect, and heal your allies. You also gain a deck of 6 minor arcana with offensive effects. The Arcana spell is modified to draw 3 major arcana and one minor arcana from their respective decks when cast, it also gains a 30 seconds cooldown; you no longer gain the star sign when the card is drawn. Shuffle returns one major arcana back to its deck and draws a new one. Divination applies the effect of one arcanum in your hand to the target and grants you the matching star sign. Minor Arcana grant the void sign when played, which can be used to increase the potency of your other offensive spells. You can hold up to 3 void signs and each sign doubles the strength of a spell when consumed; multiple signs can be consumed at the same time.
addons.title: Horoscope

objects.text: You gain the ability to use new spells to bolster your allies and hinder your enemies. Arcana - Draw one major arcana from your deck and gain the matching star sign. You can only have one arcana draw at any moment and can discard an arcana at will without losing the star sign. Shuffle - Return your drawn arcana to your deck and draw a new one, does not remove the star sign. Divination - Apply the effects of your arcanum to a target. Only one arcanum can be active at once on a target. Astrodyne - If you have three star signs, apply their effects to all allies in a 2 meter radius of a target for 15 seconds. Solar Sign: Gradually restore stamina. Lunar Sign: Gradually heal wounds. Celestial Sign: Boosts powers by 10%. Has a cooldown of 30 seconds. Earthly Star - (Recharge: 120s) Summons miniature star at your chosen location. It can be detonated at will, casting Gravity on all enemies and applying Cure to all allies in a 2 meter radius. Every five seconds the Earthly Star remains in place, it costs one additional mana and increase the effect of detonation by 100% up to a maximum of 400%. Macrocosmos - (Cost: 6 mana, Recharge: 120s) Absorbs 50% of all wounds your allies receive in your range for 15 seconds. At will or once the timer ends, applies Regen and Shell for 10 seconds on your allies and redirect all absorbed wounds on your enemies. Major Arcana The Balance - Grants a Solar sign and doubles strength and toughness for 30 seconds. The Bole - Grants a Solar sign and doubles agility and speed for 30 seconds . The Arrow - Grants a Lunar sign and grants a random minor elemental Blaster power for 30 seconds. The Spear - Grants a Lunar sign and grants a random minor elemental Striker power for 30 seconds. The Ewer - Grants a Celestial sign, removes all harmful parahuman effects, and shields against them for 30 seconds. The Spire - Grants a Celestial sign and grants flight at run speed for 2 minutes.
objects.title: Celestial Intervention

objects.text: Your repertoire of spells expands to include more defensive spells. Carapace (S, A) - Create a spherical barrier around someone that lasts until broken or dispelled; adds more layers when cast multiple times on the same target, each layer can absorb punch from a Brute 2 or shot from a Blaster 2. Haima (cost: 6 mana) - Create a cube-shaped barrier around someone that lasts until broken or dispelled, the barrier has 5 layers that can each absorb punch from a Brute 2 or shot from a Blaster 2; one layer regenerates every 10 seconds. Kerachole (cost: 6 mana, recharge: 60s) - Create a spherical barrier with a radius of 2 meters around a point in your range, this barrier blocks Blaster powers and dampens Shaker powers by 30% for 20 seconds; the barrier can be damaged and broken with sufficiently powerful attacks. Every 20 seconds, you gain one charge of White Lily (up to three) which can be consumed to increase the strength of an active barrier by 50% (additive) up to 200%, extend the duration of an active barrier by 100% (additive) up to 500%, or return an active barrier to full strength. When one of your barriers is broken, you gain one charge of Blood Lily (up to three) which can be consumed to cast retaliatory spells. Dosis - Shoot a beam of energy from a point close to you at one target with five times the strength of Malefic. Dyskrasia (2 charges) - Rain down beams of energy in a radius of 2 meters around a point in your range with five times the strength of Malefic. Toxikon (3 charges) - Create three pairs of energy spheres anywhere within your range and shoot beams of energy between them, the beams have five time the strength of Malefic and pierce through targets.
objects.title: The best defense is a good defense

objects.text: Your repertoire of spells expands to include more offensive spells. Aero (cost: 2 mana, recharge: 5s) - Create a sphere of air filled with razor-sharp currents next to one target within your range and detonate it, the blades of air are five times stronger than Malefic on the primary target and two times stronger on any other target within a 50cm radius; when cast, has a 20% chance to make the next cast of Jolt free. Fire (cost: 2 mana, recharge: 5s) - Strike one target within your range with a burst of fire that is five times stronger than Malefic on the primary target and two times stronger on other targets within a 50cm radius; when cast, has a 20% chance to make the next cast of Jolt free. Stone (cost: 2 mana, recharge: 5s) - Strike one target within your range with an explosion of stone shards, the fragments are five times stronger than Malefic on the primary target and two times stronger on any other target within a 50cm radius; when cast, has a 20% chance to make the next cast of Jolt free. Thunder (cost: 4 mana, recharge: 30s) - Creates an electric storm that randomly strikes at targets within a radius of 2 meters of a point in your range between 1 and 3 times each, each bolt of electricity is two times stronger than Malefic; every hit has a 10% chance to paralyze a target for 2 seconds. Blizzard (cost: 4 mana, recharge: 30s) - Create a storm of ice shards that strikes at every target within a radius of two meters a point in your range with four times the strength of Malefic and slows them down for 2 seconds. Jolt (cost: 6 mana, recharge: 60s) - Strikes one target within your range with an energy blast ten times stronger than Malefic. Scatter (cost: 2 mana, recharge: 5s) - Strike every target within a two meter radius of a point in your range with an energy blast twice the strength of Malefic; when cast, has a 20% chance to make the next Thunder or Blizzard free and able to be cast instantly.
objects.title: What's a Red Mage anyway?

objects.text: Your repertoire of spells expands to include more options. Runic Bolt — Create a glowing rune in your hand or anywhere within two meters of you that shoot a guided bolt of energy swirling with runic symbols at your target. Runic Bolt has the same strength as Malefic but randomly cycles through elements when cast. Runic Glyph — Create a glowing glyph on a surface or in the air anywhere in your radius which can either be set to detonate immediately or when an enemy comes into contact with the glyph. The glyph hits every target within a 2 meter radius. Runic Glyph has the same strength as Gravity but randomly cycles through elements when cast. When you cast runic bolt or glyph, you gain one rune of the corresponding element, up to a maximum of three. The runes float around your wrist, showing the current sequence, and vanish after 30 seconds. Runic Invocation (cost: variable, recharge: 5s) — Consume the stored rune sequence and trigger the spell that matches it at the costs of 1 mana per rune in the sequence. Each sequence creates a different spell, the longer the sequence the stronger the spell. In total, there are 125 possible spells that you'll have to discover. Runes and Elements: Kon (Earth), Zan (Wind), Rah (Fire), Gon (Lightning), Heo (Ice)
objects.title: Random (Runic) Bullshit Go!

objects.text: Now it’s not just physical scars you receive powers from, but mental ones as well.
objects.title: Mental Scars

objects.text: You can now choose to second trigger any power created by Just the Thing. While you may not choose how this second trigger manifests, it will aim to best fit your current circumstances. Second trigger will last for only 5 minutes, after which there is a 10 minute cooldown where you are blocked from using the target power.
objects.title: Even Better

objects.text:
Do you know The Fragile One, the Shard of Victoria Dallon? They are far from a unique existence; every cycle produces vast quantities of Shards like them. Shards that are odd, redundant, flawed, or otherwise extremely limited that The Entity is reviewing before recycling any deemed useless.

These Shards are sent to a [JUNKYARD] sub-network managed by an Admin Shard for processing at the end of The Cycle they are formed. It turns out the Shard you connected to is an Admin Shard in charge of one of these [JUNKYARD] sub-networks.

Every single power you access comes from connecting to one of the Shards in this sub-network. Seeing as you might be their last chance to prove themselves before being recycled these Shards will not hold anything back, and will give you access to each, and every ability they possess when you establish a connection to them. With those additional powers all still only counting as taking up one slot as far your primary Shard connection to the [JUNKYARD] Admin is concerned.

Though considering this is a sub-network of Shards similar to The Fragile One each Shard only has between 1-5 powers or so, and these powers aren’t particularly strong, still only 5 SP at their strongest. These additional powers usually synergize with or are otherwise useful when used in conjunction with that Shard’s strongest/primary ability, occasionally however you’ll get an additional power like The Fragile One’s emotion aura which has no real connection or synergy with that Shard’s other abilities.

Like The Fragile One every single one of these Shards gives you a basic form of flight about as capable as The Fragile One’s version. This is because that type of flight is considered a basic power any Shard can grant. Though some specific Shards will be able to grant you alternate flight powers depending on their abilities.

This upgrade also increases the slots of Just the Thing by two.
objects.title: Junkyard Database

addons.text: You manage to steer the adaptations your powers and mutations will go allowing you a measure of control over both.
addons.title: Controlled Chaos

objects.text: You have a measure of control over the powers that develop due to any situation, for example, if you fall you can steer your power towards a type of flight instead of slow falling.
objects.title: Controlled Escalation

objects.text:
Your powers have undergone a significant upgrade, allowing you to receive charges once every day instead of once every six days, with the ability to store charges indefinitely. How you can utilize these charges has expanded: you can now use a charge to maintain a power beyond the 24-hour mark (repeatedly), expend two charges to enhance an existing power or spend five charges to temporarily acquire a power slot that expires after 24 hours.

Furthermore, experiencing seven power changes within a day triggers a "jackpot" event, where all your powers are altered. There is a one-in-seven chance that all your powers will be magnified to their full potential and custom-tailored to address your current situation. However, achieving the "jackpot" reduces the likelihood of it reoccurring on the same day exponentially. Additionally, your power ceiling has been elevated to the extent that the strongest power you can attain rivals that of Eidolon at the peak of his abilities.
objects.title: Lotería

addons.text: The combined effects of these upgrades working in conjunction has made your power even stronger. First your ability to create an additional slot is now doubled allowing for a total of 5 slots at a time. Much like poker you now have the chances of getting a “full house” where 3 powers are the same number along with 2 powers also being the same number, this grants you a combination of the previous two effects with the higher number becoming a focal point for synergy with the lower number working as a multiplier for the synergizing powers.
addons.title: Full House

objects.text: Your power slots are now assigned a random number from 1 to 12 whenever they are rolled. Whenever power slots have the same number this causes the powers to strengthen doubling or tripling the powers strength as appropriate. However whenever the numbers line up in succession (ie: 1,2,3) your powers synergise with the power with the highest number being the focal point of the effect.
objects.title: Know When to Holdem

objects.text:
Your shard has given you an the authority over the probability of your power rolls, allowing you to weigh the odds either in or against your favor. The way this works is by choosing to weigh the chances of a power roll against yourself you build up a charge of “luck” for when you want to weigh the odds in your favor. In order to build up any substantial charge of “luck” to guarantee even one power at its strongest that you would absolutely want/need however would take at the very least 21 power rolls or a week of bad luck, that would be spent all on that single roll.

When the odds are against you the chances that you can roll good powers naturally are not 0% just lower than average about 1/7th your normal chances.
objects.title: Penalty Game

objects.text: Darkness blacker than black and darker than dark, I beseech thee, combine with my deep crimson. The time of awakening cometh. Justice, fallen upon the infallible boundary, appear now as an intangible distortions! I desire for my torrent of power a destructive force: a destructive force without equal! Return all creation to cinders, and come frome the abyss! Explosion! Through the use of chants and exaggerated gestures, you can dramatically enhance any ability or skill you possess. The longer and more exaggerated the chant and performance, the greater the boost. For example, if you're solving math problems, delivering a grand, over-the-top chant while striking dynamic poses will amplify your calculative abilities to an extraordinary level, allowing you to process complex equations with superhuman speed and precision. There is no limit to how strong it can get, just how long of a chant you can say and how much you can exaggerate your gestures.
objects.title: Immortal Godly Demonic Jade Emperor Chant of the Seven Heavenly Providence Divine Samsara Buddha of 1000 Virtues and Sins™

objects.text: You have unlocked your inner barbarian—your powers now surge with the sheer volume and passion of your shout. By roaring your intent, you amplify both control and strength, each word shaping the effect based on your action. A powerful yell like “Crush!” intensifies your physical force, while a fierce “Pierce!” hones precision and focus. The louder and more passionately you shout, the greater the boost, making your powers sharper, stronger, and more focused. Longer, more detailed warcries create complex effects, such as “Shield against all harm!” to reinforce your defenses. You can also get more basic, giving a raw, general increase simply by wordlessly screaming.
objects.title: AAAARRRRGGGHHH!!!

addons.text:
Your ability to create power seeds has mutated horizontally, allowing you to imbue almost anything with a power seed. While your power seed can be imbued into almost anything, it’s gained two new particular power vectors for its abilities.

First is seeding, through which you generate an actual plant seed from any part of your body. This plant seed can be of any type of plant that you know of, have ever touched, seen, or otherwise encountered in any manner. You can manifest as many of these plant seeds as you wish, in any variety of combinations allowing you to create a veritable garden.

The plant seed will grow a power imbued into it throughout its maturation, at the end when it reaches maturity and starts producing fruit or vegetables of its own, which can be eaten to give its consumers fantastical abilities. Moreover, continued cultivation of further generations of the same foods can empower the abilities even further.

You can choose to cross-breed across different power seeds offspring to try to produce different expressions or fusions, perhaps even generate entirely new abilities with enough breeding. 

The plant will cultivate the power it is imbued with at the same rate as you normally would, you can also amplify it as normal, and direct effort to cultivate the plant will increase its overall potential by half. You can also choose to imbue weaknesses into the power such as removing the consumer’s ability to swim to increase its potential by half again. 

When the seed is created you may opt to choose the theme it will produce, you can then choose whether the plant will produce the same power for every piece of produce, or if it’ll cultivate a different expression for every piece of produce, or some mix of the two at a ratio of your choice.

You can re-elect this option again for every subsequent generation, allowing you to imbue randomness or keep it predictable for every generation. You can also choose whether the seed will focus on horizontal or vertical upgrades for the power for every generation after the first or some mix of both. You can also choose what theme the power will focus on for each generation, or whether you simply want it to focus on its existing one, however, this will not produce a new power but merely help direct the theme of the new generation’s alterations to its existing power. You may also choose to leave the theme entirely random. You may let random evolution play a part as well, allowing some products to be better producing greater powers while others produce weaker ones.

You can opt for the seedling to show some signs of its unique nature in its physical form, such as Fruit that seems to be covered in swirls and marks denoting it power giving nature, or perhaps a tree with bark that looks like ash and leaves that are always orange and almost like their on fire in the right angle, although they’re mostly cosmetic changes. The produce provided may also have some hints of the powers it grants through its taste. 

Without your direct hand in its cultivation, subsequent generations will generally stick to the same theme as previous generations. You can also choose to just have the generations produce the same product over and over again, with minor mutations changing over time but no faster than normal mutations through evolution. 

Power generated through these kinds of seeds is unable to be recalled at will, but you can partake in their consumption to obtain their benefits like anyone else. Anyone may eat as many as they please, granting the potential for you as well as others to harbor multiple powers. You can choose to restrict this to particular species lest unwanted pests start to develop abilities.  

The second ability granted to you is the ability to imbue your seeds into existing life, such as animals for a similar effect as you would on humans.
addons.title: Garden of Elysium

addons.text:
Your innate ability to cultivate alongside your higher quality seeds has amplified your ability to plant and grow powers. 

The first benefit is that your seeds will now grow at a rate of 3 SP a week till it reaches 30 SP where it becomes mature. Your boosting ability is similarly amplified, now the powers your boosting improve at a rate of 3 SP to a maximum of triple the SP of the original power.

The second benefit is that you can now imbue multiple seeds into someone at the same time, however each seed must be at a different level of potential from one another. 

If you possess Hecantocheires you can imbue any amount of seeds of the same potential into someone. Be wary however as unless you’re Shardless or possess Negentropy, this possesses the capability to quickly drain your shard dry.
addons.title: Garden of Cultivation

objects.text:
The power seeds that you create have their 15 SP cap increased to 25 SP, after which it’ll continue to grow as it normally would. 

You can increase their rate of rate of growth till their natural SP cap by reducing their overall potential; each SP it’s reduced by doubling the speed of growth. 

Your ability to recall gifted powers has been enhanced to allow you to allocate them as you will, whether to yourself, others, or even back to the original recipient. additionally you are now able to use all powers at 100%
objects.title: Elysian Seed

addons.text:
Now you can imbue rooted seeds with copies of any and all power-affecting perks that you possess.

For example, if you have Trumped the Trump, power seeds cannot be drained, suppressed, stolen, etc. If you have Holding Back, they can be toggled and dialed by their user.
addons.title: Imbued Seeds

objects.text:
Now you increase rate of growth of power seeds by rooting them during creation and implantation. Rooted seeds will grow twice as fast as unrooted seeds but can't be recalled or allocated.

This double growth rate will be preserved even after the rooted seeds have matured. They also counted separately from unrooted, so rooted and unrooted seeds can grow together simultaneously.
objects.title: Rooted Seeds

objects.text: Now, instead of a week, with each selection, the seeds will need one less day for the same growth. With all 6 purchases, the rate of growth will change from SP/week to SP/day.
objects.title: Faster Growth

objects.text:
Now, when reallocating the strength of a power, you can choose to allow not just the strength, but the theming elements of the weakened power to be transferred as well, giving the boosted power new or improved abilities based on the weakened power instead of those of the boosted power.

For example, weakening an emotion draining power to strengthen a pyrokinetic power could grant the flames produced by it an emotion draining effect, essentially fusing the two powers into a stronger whole.
objects.title: Blurred Lines

objects.text: Your can now change aspects within an individual power, such as dropping its range to boost its strength.
objects.title: Terafocused

objects.text:
When something bad happens to you, whether it’s a painful breakup or a tough loss in battle, the experience leaves its mark. It stays with you, shaping and motivating you. The memory of it can drive you to push harder, tapping into a reserve of strength you didn’t know you had. For instance, after a breakup, you might spend long hours at the gym, arriving early and leaving at closing time. By the end of the week, you will find yourself with a growth spurt and an Adonis body.

Note that this isn't the healthiest way to grow. Your power forces your mind and body to relive the experience and putting it into a state of stress, exhaustion, or even overwork to amplify your capabilities. Only once you get over the experience will it allow you to rest.
objects.title: Facing Inner Demons

objects.text: You can now invert this effect, instead choosing one person to act as the servant, with you instead taking the role of the Master.
objects.title: Reversed Roles

addons.text:
Rather than grant whole powers, you can instead bestow specific cantrips you know upon others. In order for you to be able to bestow a cantrip upon someone you understand the formula and rules of said cantrip well enough that you can create variations of it.

This includes not just the ability to cast the cantrip but also knowledge of the formula and your understanding of it, allowing them to potentially alter the cantrip like you can, with every alteration they make feeding back to you.

If you so choose to you can lessen the understanding the recipient initially has of the cantrip, forcing them to uncover its principles and rules firsthand, which may end up providing new avenues of research as your beneficiary can expand in an entirely different direction as you.
addons.title: Reverse Warlock

objects.text: You now have an alternative way to give others power. You can give a copy of whatever power you have without losing it yourself, said copy only having up to 30% of your full power. In addition, much like how a shard controls the power of its host, you do the same. You can alter the expression of the power you give, weaken or strengthen specific parts of the power, and more. At the star,t you can only give one copy at a time, but this slowly grows as the people with the power copy use their new power. Any growth in the copied power (besides the modifications you did) will also be gained by your original power.
objects.title: Patronage

addons.text:
The effects of this are extended to Permanent Reminder, allowing you to gain powers from causing other people to have scars. Those people become much more prone to scarring than normal. You need the Mental Scaring upgrade in order to be able to use mental scars.

These powers are created following the same criteria and level of strength as similar scars on your own body. Death in someone you scarred will delete the corresponding powers from that person.
addons.title: Using Others As A Canvas

objects.text:
Now you gain powers from causing other people to be injured, not just from suffering injuries yourself. 

These powers are created following the same criteria and level of strength as similar injuries to your own body. They also last as long as that injury exists, though unlike your body this power won’t heal other people letting those powers last far longer in most cases. Death in someone you injured will delete the corresponding powers from that person.
objects.title: Who said it had to be your body?

objects.text:
Normally you can only have one cluster at a time and can't add new clustermates to your existing cluster, this is no longer the case. Whenever you trigger a potential parahuman you can choose to add them to a existing cluster you made or create a new cluster. 

You now have the ability to remove someone from your clusters or shift them from one to another. Removal causes to that someone a similar effect to that of undoing a cluster. Shifting from one cluster to another results in secondaries being changed/removed/added.

When you make a cluster you yourself gain a primary based on a possible trigger event of yours, this is the power other clustermates will have their secondaries of you based on. This primary will never be stronger than your strongest clustermate.
objects.title: Cluster Bomb

objects.text: Your power inversion evolves to be strictly beneficial to you, being automatic without LOS reliance and reflecting instead of just reversing. You reflect power effects onto the user regardless of their Manton Limit. This applies to any power classification, even Thinker and Master powers; Thinker powers are shared with you, countering the opponent’s use; Master powers are turned against the opponent’s, with Trump and All-or-Nothing powers canceling each other.
objects.title: J.O.Y.: Joke’s on You!

objects.text: By delving into the lives of your targets, your counter’s gains grow exponentially. A normal kill still adds just 1 point to the counter, but if you take the time to learn about them—such as their name, where they lived, their daily habits, or who they loved—the points gained increases exponentially. The more knowledge you have, the greater the increase. Knowledge is literally power for you to reap, and the more intimate your understanding of a life extinguished, the stronger you become.
objects.title: Oh It’s Personal Now

objects.text: Instead of a flat increase, your power now grows multiplicatively with each kill. If a kill increases your counter by 1, your abilities increase by 1%, but each new increase compounds on top of the last. If you have the Worthy Prey upgrade, this effect also applies to the points gained per kill—meaning a kill that grants 100 points would double your current power.
objects.title: Multiplicative Growth

objects.text: Your counter no longer treats all lives as equal. A normal kill still grants just 1 point, but the stronger your victim, the greater the reward. Power, skill, and resilience all factor into the gain—those who stand above the average grant exponentially more. A veteran or a cape will each be worth more than a common bystander. The truly exceptional—those whose strength shapes the world around them—can yield dozens or even hundreds of points upon their demise. This scales based on what is considered “average” strength, so if on average everyone (including civilians) is a Brute 1 then killing a Brute 1 will still only give 1 Point.
objects.title: Worthy Prey

objects.text: Each time you make a purchase, your ability to steal stronger powers increases by 5 SP. For example, after your first purchase, you’ll be able to steal powers worth up to 15 SP. With a second purchase, this limit rises to 20 SP, and so on.
objects.title: Greedy Thief

objects.text: You now have the ability to steal powers that exceed your normal limit. For instance, even if your maximum capacity is 10 SP, you can still steal a power valued at 15 SP. However, this comes with specific restrictions. First, the greater the difference between the strength of the power and your limit, the longer it will take to successfully steal the ability. This means that more powerful abilities require significantly more effort and time to claim. Second, once the power is stolen, it will be reduced in strength to align with your limit. In this case, a 15 SP power would be scaled down to 10 SP, making it usable but less potent than its original form. These limitations ensure balance while allowing you to access abilities beyond your natural range, though not without cost.
objects.title: My Own Size

objects.text: Each purchase of this upgrade increases the total cost of the amount of powers you can use at once by 15 SP.
objects.title: More at Once

objects.text: Anybody who possesses information about you will be subconsciously compelled to reference, do research on, or spread this information. The strength of the compulsion scales with the amount of information already there, while piggybacking off of any existing desire to disseminate knowledge of you. An average bystander you walked past in costume will note you being ‘strange-looking’ to others as an off-comment, while Watchdog - if you’ve done something that assigned them to your case - will eventually obsess over you.
objects.title: Limelight

objects.text: By granting multiple complementary powers your granted powers can work synergistically akin to an addon, as such the more similar powers you grant, the greater the overall boost they give to the powerset.
objects.title: Synergy

objects.text: Rather than diluting into a singular T0, every single power that makes up the one you chose becomes a T0 version of their own.
objects.title: Bulk Sale

objects.text:
Once a month you can randomize the expression of your copy. If you familiarize yourself with an expression for some time, when the cooldown ends you can bring your copy back to that expression rather than randomizing it again.

If you have Bulk Sale you can choose how many of your copies to randomize, regardless of the quantity it will enter in cooldown.
objects.title: Lesser Roulette

objects.text:
For each purchase you may either pick another Power Copy power to get a Knockoff version of, or alternatively may pick the power you picked for Knockoff again to get another version of it.

For the latter you can either stack it on top of the other one if you keep it the same, though this would still leave it as merely being 2 T0s worth, or alternatively, can liberally interpret in what way it’s weakened and strengthened. 
Whether to take another interpretation like with Alexandria’s flight examples or to the point of merely focusing on a singular aspect of the power and magnifying it in exchange for other parts of it losing potency or being removed altogether. 
Taking Glory Girl as an example, you could re-interpret the T0 version of her power as: 
-A shield that protects from environmental discomforts and provides increased push off from surfaces while active. A passive Master aura that makes it more fun to be around you as well as slow falling.
-A Master aura granting you a degree of control over the moods of others as well as allowing you to actively resist Master effects and powers.
-A shield that allows you to maintain your momentum in any direction and stops your momentum when it pops or you disable it.
-Punches that make people sad and knock them upwards.

The more focused the interpretation the more powerful it will be, the shield in the first interpretation would be much weaker than the one in the third one for example.
Though its potency is ultimately still limited to the level of a T0 power and can’t be changed once selected.
objects.title: Off-Brand Variance

addons.text:
Bulk Sale now extends to Temu Copier, though it works a bit differently. When you copy a power, you have the choice between copying it as whole — at the cost of weakening all of them to fit the strength of a single T0 — or copying a singular power, still weakening it to T0, but less than it could've been.

You aren't limited to one or the other, nor do you lose out on the other powers of someone if you only copy one. You simply need to break physical contact and then touch them again in order to make a different copy — copying the entire powerset and then a single power is fine, trying to copy the singular power two times is not.

Powers from the same origin become 50% stronger when used together.
addons.title: Individuality

addons.text:
Not only can you randomize any of your copies, but the cooldown is now one week and applies per copy rather than the whole. Besides that, rather than randomizing you can instead try choosing the expression yourself, if its stronger than a T0 or doesn't fit at all what the power is supposed to be the attempt will outright fail and it will enter in cooldown.

The same applies when you copy a power, you can either choose or randomize. The difference is that if what you choose is too strong it will be appropriately weakened, and if it doesn't fit it will adjusted to be.
addons.title: Adjustment

objects.text:
Besides your initial choice you can now copy T0 versions of the powers of anyone through touch—this includes the Endbringers and the Entity. You are limited to only using up to 10 of those copies at once on top of your original copy.

With time all your T0 Copies will start blending into each other a bit, the speed depends on compatibility with some happening instantly and others taking days. Say you copy Behemoth's dynakinesis and your version allows you to slowly generate and conduct it through touch, and you also copied Leviathan's water echo and your version essentially creates a water clone of you that quickly dissipates into a puddle, now you would be able to create energy clones or water clones that become electrified puddles of water.
objects.title: Temu Copier

objects.text:
By beheading others, you can attach their heads to your empty neck, giving you access to their skills and power. You can get glimpses of their memories but nothing concrete. 

This can work on rotten heads or even simple skulls, but due to their degradation, you will not be able to fully access their skills and powers.
objects.title: Headhunter

objects.text:
From your neck you can sprout out withered wood-like branches. You can connect heads to these branches, giving you access to their skills and abilities as if you attached them directly to your neck.  

You start with two branches, and with time will slowly gain more.
objects.title: Figurehead

objects.text: You can assign quests to others as long as you are aware of their location. They can accept or decline, with a limit of three active quests at a time. Rewards function the same as your own, scaling with difficulty and granting improvements in relevant areas. You do not benefit directly, but you can guide others’ growth by setting meaningful challenges. Quests can be abandoned, and you can modify or revoke them before completion, though changes require acceptance.
objects.title: Questgiver

objects.text:
Your interference with powers has evolved to continuously block them, weakening their Shard connection and minute dimensional distortion hindering their functionality, especially for Shakers, Strikers, or Blasters. Under an area of 150m², you slowly diminish and weaken the power of Parahumans in every sense (range, effectivity, responsiveness, etc.), up to making them near-unusable.

This depends on the time they stay within your area, from a couple of minutes having several malfunctions or hiccups on their powers, to being almost obsolete to how they work or respond when staying more than half an hour.
objects.title: It’s All Downhill From Here

objects.text: Now for every thirty seconds that are removed from the timer of a power that power will have all its aspects boosted by 50%, if an aspect can't be boosted then instead the power gets a new one.
objects.title: Timed Buff

objects.text: Magik Adept gains one additional set of cantrips.
objects.title: More Cantrip Sets

objects.text: Every set of cantrips of Magik Adept gains 6 more slots, the proportion of ranks stays the same.
objects.title: Bigger Cantrip Sets

objects.text:
Your power provides you with basic knowledge on how Magik formula work; this allows you to understand how the language is structured, what the various shapes, symbols, and equations mean, and how they interact with each-other and affect the spell as a whole. 

This knowledge is closer to having a large reference manual memorized than an intuitive understanding; this repository expands to cover upgrades, if taken.
objects.title: Magik Apprentice

addons.text:
As an Archmage, your ability to create one-use scrolls has expanded to encompass the creation of Rituals. Like a scroll, a ritual involves writing down the full formula of a cantrip onto a physical object, however, unlike scrolls, rituals can be written on any object instead of just paper or similar medium. However, this is minor compared to the main divergence between rituals and scrolls.

Rituals have the unique property of being able to be scaled up endlessly, allowing you to stack a theoretically infinite number of alterations and metamagiks into a cantrip in exchange for increasing the size and complexity of the formula. You can even apply the same metamagik multiple times, although doing so becomes exponentially more complex with each repetition. 

Additionally, a Ritual isn’t restricted to just a single formula, with metamagik's loosening of the rules allowing you to chain formulas together to create increasingly complex and nuanced effects, at the cost of increased size and complexity as you not only have to include the formulas of all cantrips you include but also tie them together in a manner which satisfies the internal rules of the formulas and your Shard.

Rituals aren’t without their downsides however. For starters, the size of a ritual formula can quickly balloon in size as you try to add and modify effects beyond their normal limits, turning from something which fits on a piece of paper to something which barely fits inside an entire room and potentially even beyond that if you make the formula complex enough. Secondly, rituals are incredibly finicky and require greater precision scaling with their size and complexity. 

Worst of all, an improperly prepared ritual does not simply fail to function. Instead, it backfires, often violently. The severity of the backlash scales with both the complexity of the ritual and the magnitude of the mistake. A minor mistake in a paper-sized ritual might result in a small fire, while a major failure in a room-sized ritual could unleash an explosion powerful enough to level a building.
addons.title: Discount Ritualist

addons.text: Your ability to create rituals has evolved through the synthesis of two distinct methodologies. By integrating the framework logic of Ritualised Magik into the scalable inscription system of Discount Ritualist. Your rituals are no longer one-use mega-scrolls, but reusable architectural arrays. In addition, you can effectively use any ritual from Ritualised Magik in this way, no longer being constrained by its singular slot. The permanent geometric array of each Ritualised Magik framework acts as a containment and compiler system for the mega-formula, catching errors in logic, symmetry, or notation during the activation sequence and simply rejecting the casting without releasing the stored energy. This means you are free to push the boundaries of complexity and scale without risk as failure only cost wasted components. This also means your rituals are now reusable. The site itself, once constructed and validated, remains a permanent fixture that can be activated repeatedly so long as you replenish the consumable components that serve as the medium for the mega-formula. Lastly, your rituals now support modular complexity management through nested sub-rituals. By applying your understanding of magical grammar from Ritualised Magik, you can break a massive stacked and chained formula into discrete, validated segments, each one defined and stabilized by its own smaller ritual site. These sub-rituals produce stable symbolic outputs that act as variables or function calls within the master framework, allowing the final activation formula to remain compact and elegant even as the total working encompasses the complexity of an entire room or building.
addons.title: Academic Ritualist

objects.text: You can write down the formula for a cantrip on a sheet of paper — or similar medium — to create one-use scrolls. You will need to empower them during your preparations — at the cost of one extra minute per scroll — and can cast them by simply touching them.
objects.title: Scroll Savant

addons.text:
Grimoire Adept synergizes with Discount Artificer’s ability to permanently store Cantrips and creates something greater than the sum of its parts. The transformation of a repository into a grimoire is no longer temporary, but permanent. This also means that you can possess multiple grimoires at once.

This effectively allows you to bypass the need to prepare cantrips as long as you have the cantrip written down in your Grimoire, although you may need to prioritize which cantrips go in a grimoire, as carrying around and using grimoire with every cantrip shoved inside would be rather unwieldy.
addons.title: True Grimoire

objects.text: During your preparations, you can spend an additional 20 minutes to temporarily turn one of your repositories into a grimoire, allowing you to cast any formula within by opening the book on the right page and pulling the cantrip out. When used this way, it takes 10 seconds per rank to recharge. The grimoire reverts to normal after 24 hours or when you empower another repository.
objects.title: Grimoire Adept

objects.text:
You gain the ability to research metamagik formula the same way as cantrips. Your power provides you with 12 formula with basic effects and by studying how they work you can apply knowledge you acquired from your cantrips to further create more metamagiks.

Metamagiks are modifiers for cantrips that represent your newfound capacity to alter on the fly how they work, they allow you to change how a cantrip works with the caveat of artificially increasing their rank when used—keeping all of the disadvantages of doing so and none of the benefits.

You have the ability to prepare a set of 3 metamagik formula at the same time as your cantrips; each upgrade to the number or size of cantrip sets increases the number of metamagik formula you can prepare by 2. Metamagik is applied during casting time, resulting in the cantrip being treated as having a higher Rank. Rank 9—whether natural or artificial—cantrips can also be modified with metamagik, but the penalty is that the casting time is increased by 5 while prepared and 6 when spontaneous while recharge is increased by 10 while prepared and 11 when spontaneous.

For example, the Boucing Spell metamagik would allow you to allow try hitting something once more if you missed, while Heighten Spell would genuinely increase the rank of a cantrip, essentially allowing you to take a gimplise at what it could become.

You can't apply the same metamagik multiple times to the same cantrip.
objects.title: Metamagik Acquisition

objects.text:
You gain the ability to research a distinct class of cantrips: Rituals. Your power provides you with 12 base ritual formulas to start, and by studying how they work, you can apply knowledge acquired from your cantrips to further create more. As with cantrips, each ritual formula must be written down in your repository, filling an A2-sized page. Your power will check the formula and reject invalid ones. You can slot a single ritual into each of your two cantrip sets, occupying a separate slot within that set. This separate slot can hold a ritual of any rank up to Rank 9.

Rituals are a self-contained category of cantrip that produce persistent states instead of immediate effects. Each ritual formula defines a category of effect it governs and activating it shapes that domain into a lasting phenomenon. Duration is always extended by default, with all ritual effects lasting a minimum of one hour even at the lowest ranks, scaling dramatically upward with rank. A Rank 9 ritual can sustain its effect for days or longer. In exchange for this longevity, rituals take far longer to cast than standard cantrips. A Rank 0 ritual requires 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting, with an additional 15 minutes added per rank. A Rank 9 ritual would require a full 145 minutes to complete.

Rituals are organized into their own tier structure identical in scale to cantrips. A Rank 9 ritual caps at an equivalent PRT rating of 6. They can be prepared and slotted exactly like cantrips: you meditate for 10 minutes while holding your repository to slot a ritual into your prepared slots, and it occupies that slot while active. Rituals have no recharge time and can be cast again immediately, though the full casting time and component cost still applies each time.

You can construct any number of ritual sites by physically arranging components and geometric arrays at a location. To activate a ritual, you must stand within a constructed site's bounds and cast the corresponding slotted ritual cantrip, permanently consuming the site's components. If the ritual's effect is still active, successfully casting it again in this way refreshes its duration without interruption, meaning no stacking the same ritual in the same area. To cast the ritual again, you must first replenish the consumed components at the site. Ritual sites can be reused indefinitely so long as the components are replenished. If a ritual's geometric array is damaged while the effect is active, the effect ends instantly, but no other harmful consequence occurs.

For example, a Ritual of the Hearth (a Rank 4 ritual) can produce a persistent warmth aura that heals and wards against cold, blanketing a campsite for several hours. A Ritual of the Hunt (a Rank 6 ritual) can create a lingering sympathetic bond across a city, whispering the target's state and distance for a full day.
objects.title: Ritualised Magik

objects.text:
You gain access to a new kind of formula structure: the Set Formula. Unlike cantrip formulas, which define individual cantrip effects, the Set Formula governs the rules that determine how your cantrip sets function; how many cantrips you can prepare, which ranks are allowed, how fast you can switch sets, how long it takes to prepare them, and how many sets you can have. The Set Formula is significantly more complex than even a rank 9 cantrip, needing an A1 sheet of paper. It uses recursive logic, nested symbols, and an internal structure far more intricate than anything you’ve worked with before.

To make changes to the Set Formula, you must copy it into your repository and edit it manually, just like a cantrip. Your power will still verify whether a formula is valid, but the standards are harsher — even a small misstep will result in rejection, and you are given no explanation why. Unlike with cantrip formulas, accepted Set Formula modifications become a permanent part of your spellcasting framework. However, to make further changes later, you must work from scratch on a new version and pass validation again.

Editing the Set Formula can grant powerful benefits: more cantrip slots, the ability to store higher-ranked spells, faster switching or preparation times, chain casting, or additional sets. However, the formula has a limited capacity for complexity. It behaves like a hidden character limit or memory cap; the more features you add, the more efficient your formula must be. Poorly optimized formulas will still work if accepted, but side effects may include longer switching delays, slower preparation times, or other subtle penalties. The more compact and efficient your changes, the more powerful your system becomes but simply adding without properly managing the structure will only cause issues.

The Set Formula cannot be used to alter the fundamental mechanics of cantrips themselves — such as casting time, cooldown duration, or the need for components. It governs only how cantrips are selected, stored, prepared, and accessed — not how they function once cast.
objects.title: Magik Thaumatology

objects.text:
