You can now refine the structure of individual cantrip formulas, carefully reworking their logic to eliminate redundancies and compress their symbolic patterns. Where the base versions of your spells follow the broad design provided to you, an efficient variant represents your own effort at rebuilding the underlying structure so it runs with less strain. The result is a cantrip that still produces its full effect, but does so with less effort on your part, effectively lowering the time it takes to cast and the delay before it can be used again.

An optimized cantrip always retains the rank of the original version when being prepared, but for the purposes of casting and recharging it behaves as if it were of a lower rank. A cantrip may be reduced by as many ranks as you are able to achieve through study and rewriting, all the way down to an effective rank of 0, where it can be cast instantly and has no recharge. However, the difficulty of achieving each reduction grows at an exponential rate: the 1st rank of reduction is considered baseline difficulty, the 2nd requires 4 times as much precision and efficiency, and the 3rd requires 16 times as much. Each additional step multiplies the challenge of validation by 4.

The process of achieving efficiency requires extensive study, careful rewriting, and repeated failures. Each attempt at refinement must be validated, and even small missteps in symmetry or notation may cause the entire formula to be rejected. When successful, however, the streamlined version becomes a permanent addition to your repository, taking up twice the space it used to take. This means the 1st reduction requires 2 times the normal space, the 2nd requires 4 times the normal space, the 3rd requires 8 times the normal space, and so on.
objects.title: Magik Efficiency

objects.text:
You gain an internal, indestructible copy of your physical repository. By holding your physical repository for ten uninterrupted minutes, you can generate a virtual version of its contents. This internal copy can be accessed at all times and can fully substitute the physical repository when preparing or swapping cantrips.

You cannot edit, alter, or modify the internal repository directly. All changes must first be written and then uploaded from physical pages. You do not need the full repository to upload, any random paper can work. When uploading, you can choose to either add the page as a new entry or to replace and overwrite an existing page in the internal repository.

If you lose your physical repository, you retain full access to the internal copy and can continue preparing and swapping cantrips from it. However, without a physical repository, you cannot edit, improve, or alter the contents of your virtual repository in any way.
objects.title: Internal Repository

objects.text:
Your virtual repository evolves into a self-contained magical study, allowing you to not only preserve and recall your formulas, but also to directly edit, expand, and refine them within your mind. This effectively replaces the need for physical writing materials when designing new cantrips or modifying existing ones. Instead of relying on paper, you can enter a structured mental workspace — a vast scriptorium of shelves, books, and geometric diagrams — where you can directly write in your internal copy.

Within this mental scriptorium, you may manipulate symbols, geometric arrays, and formulae as if sketching them in real space, allowing for an intuitive grasp of their relationships. When made this way, your power provides a greater amount of validation as you work, highlighting which parts of your formulas are causing the contradictions and failures, although still not explaining why and how.

Formulas stored within the Internal Scriptorium organize themselves automatically. New pages are catalogued, indexed, and cross-referenced without effort on your part, granting perfect recall of any symbol or structure you have worked on. Navigation becomes effortless: you may summon up a page, compare two variants side by side, or browse entire categories of related cantrips in moments. No pages can be destroyed unless you want them to be, and even then you can easily have it recreated should you wish.
objects.title: Internal Scriptorium

objects.text:
Your design restrictions become flexible over time, based on how the powers you’ve granted are used. Each time someone you’ve empowered uses their gift—especially in new, clever, or unexpected ways—your Shard takes note. The more often and creatively they apply it, the faster your restriction on reusing similar traits or mechanics begins to loosen.

If a power sees frequent, inventive use, its core traits may become available again for future designs within weeks. If used less often or in straightforward ways, the refresh takes longer. However, no matter how rarely a power is used or how simple its application, every one of your created abilities will fully refresh after six months.
objects.title: Refresher Course

objects.text:
In Jekyll mode, your Thinker or Thinker-adjacent powers sharpen dramatically. Sensory augmentation, predictive models, pattern recognition, strategic overlays—whatever mental tools your powers provide, they now hum with clarity and intensity. Calculations resolve faster, insights come cleaner, and complex mental constructions solidify with effortless precision. Thinker abilities that once required moments of preparation can now operate near-instantaneously, unfolding in parallel with your hyper-accelerated thought. Any power that benefits from intellect, analysis, perception, or inference becomes not only more effective, but more deeply integrated with your continuously evolving mental state.

In Hyde mode, the transformation works in the opposite direction but with equal depth. Any Brute or Brute-adjacent powers—be they strength-based, durability-focused, regenerative, or mobility-enhancing—are pushed further, becoming more explosive, more unrelenting. In this state, your powers begin to express themselves with a raw, primal immediacy. Defensive powers become harder, faster to activate; offensive powers hit harder and recover faster; even passive enhancements find new depth, as if your body instinctively channels every available resource toward battle readiness. There is no finesse, only escalation: the closer you are to violence, the more your abilities rise to meet it.
objects.title: Formula H+

objects.text:
In Jekyll mode, where thought and perception reign, all Brute or Brute-adjacent powers you possess become less effective. The body is deprioritized, its instincts blunted by an intellect that sees brute force as inelegant, inefficient, even dangerous. The more you lean into reason and insight, the less your powers can draw from the raw material of your form.

In Hyde mode, the opposite occurs. all Thinker or Thinker-adjacent powers you have grow cloudy, distant, or outright inaccessible, as your mind simplifies itself to suit the demands of combat. Higher-order reasoning, predictive modeling, and nuanced analysis are dulled or overridden by immediate need. Even powers designed to aid in strategy or perception become unstable—intermittent, distorted, or painfully slow compared to the rapid feedback loops of the battlefield. 

This doesn’t hinder powers outside of those domains.
objects.title: Cognitive Dissonance

objects.text:
Instead of one power that is 4 SP or less you may give up to 4 SP worth of powers.

Any addons that a person meets the requirements for will also be granted, if you so wish.
objects.title: Many Gifts

objects.text:
You may give multiple powers to the same person. Every power still costs a slot of the 12 you have.

Any addons that a person meets the requirements for will also be granted, if you so wish.
objects.title: Greedy Children

objects.text:
The time it takes to cultivate a trait is drastically lowered, able to see returns within hours. A few hours spent training stamina and speed and you’ll be able to reach a stable 60 kilometers per hour, train strength for a day and you’ll be able to lift a couple tons, etc. However, this increased speed is subject to diminishing returns relative to how advanced the trait being cultivated is. 

The more a trait is trained, the longer it takes to see results until the rate of development returns to the original rate of growth, at which point it stops slowing down. The rate at which development slows is logarithmic, meaning a fast drop at first which starts to peter out over time.
objects.title: Tutorial Power Levelling

objects.text:
You can double your power, but that isn't your limit. At will, you can go even further. triple, quadruple... There's no telling how high you can go now.

Although your strength, power, senses, etc. is multiplied as high as you want, each level gives an equal level of strain, your stamina drains even faster, and your body starts to tear itself apart. Your muscles start to rip, your bones creak, and your nerves are screaming.

But it's not all bleak though. By training your body to become stronger, your body can tolerate higher and higher levels of this ability, but there is a slow, but undeniable level of diminishing returns.

If you stay at just the first level though, you will only experience the normal level of stamina usage.
objects.title: Fist of the King of Worlds

objects.text: Instead of being able to manifest 10 Tier 0 Powers at a time, you have a budget of 10 SP that you can use to manifest Tier 0 powers and their upgrades and fusions in this CYOA.
objects.title: Eidolon’s Younger Cousin Dave

objects.text: Instead of Rainbow's T0 powers growing to 700% strength when you expend [Time], they are temporarily enhanced to 7 SP powers. You also get a shiny prismatic aura while expending [Time].
objects.title: Prismatic Boost

objects.text:
Once and only once, you may empower someone in ways that are equal yet opposite to your own powerset. As an example, if you have an Order Divinity from the Shardless Fragmented Divinity power, they might receive the Chaos Divinity.

Alternatively, instead of empowering someone, you could make your equal out of nothing—in which case, you’ll receive a clone of yourself to be your equal. If your equal is such a clone, while they might have identical memories and bodies to you they’ll find themselves instinctively reacting to situations in ways opposite to how you would.

This is not to the extent of compromising morals or deep held beliefs you have; for example, if you are kind-hearted and slightly dislike fighting, your clone might like fighting but they’ll remain kind-hearted so they’ll fight just for fun instead of truly hurting anyone. Opinions you hold little emotion about at the time of creation will also be the same between you and your clone.

Powers that don’t have an easy opposite like having access to a sci-fi tech base, generic enhanced physical capabilities, or being a member of a specific species may be the only point of commodity between you and your equal’s powerset. Though there will be differences even then, whenever and wherever possible. So for example, if you are a Universe 7 Saiyan, your opposite might be a Universe 6 Saiyan.

Your equal will benefit or suffer from any perks and drawbacks you have if it makes sense, so your opposite might not suddenly become rich if you have the Wealthy perk but benefiting from Blank, Crippled, or Acclimation is fair game.

Your equal will not receive any variation of this upgrade.
objects.title: Your Equal and Opposite

objects.text: You Hunters Mark has been upgraded. Your Mark can not only last 16 hours instead of 8, but it also now has a cooldown of only 2 hours. Additionally, your attacks are now 50% more effective, instead of 25%.
objects.title: Enhanced Mark

objects.text: Prey are very rarely alone, so sometimes just one Mark isn't enough. To combat this, you can now have up to three Marks active, though each target is limited to one active Mark.
objects.title: Pack Hunter

objects.text: What use is having three Marks when you don't have three targets? To fix this simple inefficiency, you can now apply multiple marks to a single target.
objects.title: Giant Slayer

objects.text: You may now choose details of each Alexandria Package granted by you on a case by case basis. Templates for all used components and their combinations are recorded by your power with automatic intuitive indexing for later referral and reuse. You may manually store new templates by making them without targeting a person.
objects.title: Bespoke

objects.text: Alexandria Package granted by you may now have a second Distincta, with same limitations as first.
objects.title: Twin Tailed

objects.text:
You can now modify any powerset you manifest, adjusting its components, aspects and functionality, provided it remains within your 4 SP limit.

This allows you to redistribute a powerset's capabilities to suit your needs, such as reducing a Blaster’s range to amplify its force or shaping a Master effect to influence more targets at the cost of less precision. You can’t change it into something entirely unrelated, however, i.e. a Thinker into a Brute; its core concept must remain the same.

You are also no longer bound by the original parahuman’s power ceiling and may enhance or expand a powerset beyond its initial scope. For example, Über’s ability could be boosted so that, instead of gaining proficiency in a specific technique, it provides complete mastery of an entire skill, including its fundamentals, to a notably superhuman degree.
objects.title: Adjustable Arsenal

objects.text:
Rather than be limited to parahumans, you may also select Tier 0, Tier 1 and Tier 2 powers in the CYOA, including their upgrades.

You could select (Tinker) Detection and Analysis, (Tinker) Surveillance and (Tinker) Communication and use their natural synergy to create peerless tinker-tech for reconnaissance. Alternatively, by combining (Master) Papillon, (Master) Gold Digger and (Changer) Beauty, you might compel others to hand you riches like candy.

Note that the max strength of 4 SP still applies to what you manifest.
objects.title: Auxiliary Armory

objects.text:
Upon selecting this upgrade, the maximum SP of a feasible powerset increases by 2 SP, raising the cap from 4 to 6 SP. Each additional purchase continues to extend your limit: 8 SP, 10 SP, 12 SP etc.

With a single purchase, you could fully replicate powersets such as Skitter, Kaiser or Marquis. Upon further investment, you can reach even higher, potentially matching the most powerful parahumans around, like Eidolon or Contessa.
objects.title: Two-Bit Tohu

objects.text:
Upon selecting this upgrade, the number of replica parahuman powersets you can manifest increases by one, raising your total limit from three to four.

Each additional purchase further expands how many you can maintain at any one time: 5, 6, 7, 8 possible powersets and so on.
objects.title: Variety of Visages

objects.text:
You are now accompanied by three semi-sentient floating masks. Their base design is up to you, so long as it's reasonable, and they will change their appearance based on the capes and/or powersets you have summoned.

They are very connected to you, having the capacity to sense and talk — having their own voice, yours, and the cape they are imitating — which you can make use of but also making it so they reflect your mood and desires in behavior and appearance. They cannot go farther than 4 meters from you.

By wearing a mask you can have access to the skills of the cape its associated to. And you can also transform into said cape to make proper use of their skills, being able to choose any point in time of said cape to transform into. Injuries transfer between forms.

The amount of masks scales with the amount of powers you can summon.
objects.title: Masking

objects.text:
Instead of a flat 1-minute time needed to summon a power, it now takes 15 seconds per 1 SP. 

So 15 seconds to summon a 1 SP power, 1 minute to summon a 4 SP one, 2 minutes to summon a 8 SP power if you have the upgrade for it, and so and so forth.
objects.title: Variable Summoning

objects.text:
Your enchanted items no longer need to be crafted.

You can target a power within range, causing it to condense into a physical Object of Power based or equal to its source given enough exposure.

These objects naturally take on forms that reflect how the power is used. Perception-based abilities may manifest as lenses or visors, physical enhancements as gloves or suits and control-based powers as headgear or focus items, etc. The form is not fixed, but it will always align with the way the power expresses itself.

Creation takes time based on complexity and requires you to remain nearby, but no active effort is needed once the process begins.
objects.title: Thingamabobs

objects.text:
Now when you copy a power with Supportive Copier it isn’t bound by a weeklong timer, instead it is permanently added to a mental archive of powers at your disposal. While you still only have three slots for power copies, you are able to freely and instantly swap powers between your mental archive and those slots with no need to ever recopy that power again. 

You are also now able to give other people copies of your power copies directly from your mental archive. No need for the power in question to be in a slot. Touch is still required to be able to give them these copies though.

The final aspect of this upgrade makes it so that you are able to give Parahuman’s whose powers are in your mental archive Supportive Copier’s direct power boost from range, assuming they aren’t currently boosted by Supportive Copier and are alive,

Both the power boost you can provide and the power copies you can grant other people, still only lasts a week if they aren’t reapplied.
objects.title: Support Catalog

objects.text:
Now when you copy a power with Supportive Copier it isn’t bound by a weeklong timer, instead it is permanently added to a mental archive of powers at your disposal. While you still only have three slots for power copies, you are able to freely and instantly swap powers between your mental archive and those slots with no need to ever recopy that power again. 

You are also now able to give other people copies of your power copies directly from your mental archive. No need for the power in question to be in a slot. Touch is still required to be able to give them these copies though.

The final aspect of this upgrade makes it so that you are able to give Parahuman’s whose powers are in your mental archive Supportive Copier’s direct power boost from range, assuming they aren’t currently boosted by Supportive Copier and are alive,

Both the power boost you can provide and the power copies you can grant other people, still only lasts a week if they aren’t reapplied.
objects.title: Escalating Resistances

objects.text: You can create an Avatar to interact with the outside world while you stay inside your pocket dimension. This Avatar looks like you and has your powers at 50-70% strength. You can either fully control it or simply place commands for it to follow.
objects.title: Avatar

objects.text:
The boundaries of your pocket dimension expanded, stretching 100 meters in length and 49 meters in width, the size of a football stadium. 

Over time, this space will continue to expand autonomously. With each passing month, your dimension will burgeon, expanding outward from all sides by an additional 100 meters. Up to a maximum to the scale of Earth itself.

You can summon and resummon anyone of your choosing, but that's the extent of your control. This space has the conditions to sustain life the same as earth.
objects.title: World Dimension

objects.text: Your pocket dimension no longer moves at the same speed as the world around it. Instead its internal time can be adjusted from 1:1 with the outside world to 100 times slower. You do not have to worry about running out of air and the like while inside.
objects.title: Time Dilation

objects.text: People won't notice you even if you attack them now. Nothing you do or say will get them to acknowledge your existence. They will still be able to perceive you, but they will not be able to act on that knowledge consciously. They will subconsciously move away to avoid hitting you, and will not question why they are suddenly hurt if you attack them, in fact they will not even act on the fact that they are hurt.
objects.title: Unseen

objects.text: You can now share and make people immune to the effects of your power.
objects.title: Together, We are forgotten

objects.text: If someone prays to you or just refers to you in some way, and express some desire, you can make it come true, no matter the distance. The same limitations apply as before; 3 wishes per person, and theoretically accomplish it within a month.
objects.title: Prayers received, Wishes granted.

objects.text: Now you can accomplish the wishes based on your own desires instead of the target’s.
objects.title: Monkey Paw

objects.text: Your restrictions have been loosened. You can now grant your own wishes, but the same limitations for people still apply to you. Wishes are regenerated once a month, and it's now what you can theoretically achieve in a year, instead of a month.
objects.title: Genie from Wish.com

addons.text:
Your gaseous state has been greatly amplified by your ability to detect and manipulate information. Now, instead of turning into a gas vulnerable to fire, electricity, and winds, you gain access to a state in which your being is encapsulated within several glyphs, symbols, and runes, which are constantly flickering, changing, and moving. They will remain inside a 1 ft radius of each other.

In this state, reality views your being as 'information'. This means you can freely phase through walls, attacks, and anything else that information can go through. You can use this to freely enter and exit gray boy bubbles, go through (but not pop) The Siberian, etc. On the other hand, powers that directly affect information, such as devices made by (Tinker) Meme or (Tinker) Information, can interact with you in this state.

These symbols appear floating near your body's center of mass. You can move at your max running speed and cannot change elevation unless you have a flight power.

Since this state is so volatile, you can only safely remain in it for 15 seconds at most. Once you exit this breaker state, there is a cooldown equivalent to the number of seconds you spent in the breaker state.
addons.title: Information Form

objects.text:
Your awareness over information regarding yourself has grown. 

When someone directly thinks of your name, you are immediately aware of who it was, their exact location and the context of their thoughts. Furthermore, you will be able to directly read their mind for the next 20 seconds after they think of you. This can even work with something like your organization's name, assuming you are the leader, founder, or in an authoritative position. If someone thinks of you but avoids names of anything related to you, you instead gain a vague understanding of their location and the context.

If someone directly speaks your name out loud, you are aware of them, their location, what is being said, and who it is being said to, including the exact context. You can leverage this connection to express any of your powers within a 20 meter radius of the person, for the next 20 seconds. You can selectively "bookmark" specific individuals, contexts, or phrases. This will "ping" you mentally whenever they trigger this ability.

The target doesn't have to think or speak your actual name: a cape name, nickname, or titles which specifically refer to you work just fine, as long as either you or the speaker associates those titles with specifically yourself. Even nicknames or pseudonyms for your organization will be picked up. However, your true name is more "clear", and speaking it will allow your gaze to penetrate memetic defenses, concealment/stranger abilities, and even temporal anomalies like rewinding time. General references such as 'She' and 'His' which can apply to a multitude of people won't get your attention even if they refer to you.
objects.title: Don't Speak Her Name!

objects.text: Your ability to surprise anyone has gone in an interesting direction. You now can fool anyone into getting into even the most obvious of traps. Have a cop fall down an open manhole, have a person stand right underneath that anvil, or just ask your annoying neighbor to try on these handcuffs. They won't realize the deception until the trap has actually sprung. This doesn't enhance the trap in any way. A brute in handcuffs isn't going to stay in handcuffs for long. Either way it happens, your victim will certainly be surprised that they actually fell for that.
objects.title: Cask of Amontillado

objects.text: You can now directly affect each other and the other's surroundings through the call. This means that not only can you interact with objects and environments in the blended reality, but you can also use your powers across this shared space. If the other picks up an object in your environment, they are able to instantly take it to their location. Similarly, any action you take can influence their environment, such as moving a piece of furniture or altering the landscape, will happen in real time. Your powers can now be wielded across the connection, enabling a full range of interactions as if you were truly there together in a unified space.
objects.title: Face to Face

objects.text: Every part of your body is poison, one that can now spread. Anything that goes into your body is poison. The air your breath out causes brutes to weaken and become sick, your sweat can kill a regenerator and your rotting flesh can cause a plague. The stranger effect still applies, so the cause of death will be completely gone, with everyone seemingly dying of natural causes. You can toggle the poison effect at will.
objects.title: Cursed Body

objects.text: The moment you stand still, people think you are a creepy mannequin. They won’t question why you are there and will think what you are wearing/holding are a bunch of props. They will mostly ignore you. This works even if people see you stop moving.
objects.title: Mannequin, No Not That One

objects.text:
By persistently denying a truth and asserting your own version of reality, you can gradually overwrite your target’s perception with your lie. With enough repetition and conviction, you can make them believe the most absurd fabrications, such as the sky being black, and once this false belief takes root, nothing—no amount of logic, evidence, or persuasion—can convince them otherwise. 

However, the strength of your power is not absolute. The more deeply ingrained the original belief, the harder it is for your influence to take hold. If your target is confident in the truth, their resistance will be stronger, requiring more time and effort to erode their certainty. You must carefully chip away at their reality, methodically dismantling their convictions until your version becomes their new truth.
objects.title: Gaslight

addons.text: Now, when you use Metamorphosis while possessing someone, you will also speed up their power-boosting process at the cost of rapidly consuming the nutrients in their body. Thanks to the healing aspects of Metamorphosis, you can also now harmlessly separate from your host and you no longer affect their mental abilities negatively, albeit the more you speed up the process, the more pronounced the mutations become.
addons.title: Symbiotic Metamorphosis

objects.text: Your possession now has some new aspects. You now are always in control when you possess a person. The longer you possess someone, the stronger their powers become, up to a maximum of 3 times in raw power. Beyond that, they start mutating, increasing in versatility and better altering their body for the powers they have. However, the longer you possess a person, the harder it becomes to separate from them, hurting as if you are being ripped apart. The growth varies, with the stronger the host the longer it takes to grow, but at maximum it will take a week to reach 3 times power before their body starts mutating. If you leave the body, the mutations and boost in powers will remain. The more their body has mutated the dumber they become, possibly even becoming effectively brain dead.
objects.title: Parasect

addons.text: Now you are no longer limited to affecting 5 people with your power. Albeit after you actively bestowed the 5 powers, it will become a passive process. Whenever somebody becomes so emotionally attached to you through the empowered Harem Protagonist effect amplified by the Positive Multiplier, they will mentally “break”, triggering with a Dere type power in line with the original 5 types, but not limited to them, making new type of Deres possible, like Deredere, Dandere, Ahodere, Uzadere, Kichidere, etc… This is not a natural power trigger so even people without a Corona Pollentia can be affected and just like the base power will stack on top of existing powers
addons.title: Emotional Overflow

objects.text:
Your master power has undergone a change allowing you to bestow/affect powers to/of those affected by it, however this is at the cost of limiting the number of people who can be affected to 5. In addition to granting these powers you now slightly alter the personality of those you master, additionally you can only bestow one of each power to each of those affected. You are also now capable of “aiming” your master power, still not being capable of shutting it off but being able to choose who you affect. with the effects of your mastering disappearing near instantly unless you lock them in by bestowing them a power. There are five powers you can give to those under your power.

Tsundere–this power grants the affected an escalating Brute package that starts roughly equal to one of bitch’s empowered dogs and increases with their anger (soft capping at Antares level). When given to someone who is a parahuman this shifts their powers to be centered on more direct attacks with their original powers also growing with anger.

Himedere–this power grants the affected a master power that makes others view them as an authority figure making others believe what they say is right and causing them to obey their orders this excludes you and others affected by your power. When given to someone who is a parahuman this shifts their powers to become master based expression either creating a projection or bestowing their powers on those they command.

Hajidere–this power grants the affected a stranger power that allows them to go completely unnoticed by those around them excluding you and others affected by your power. When given to someone who is a parahuman this shifts their powers from a direct combat application into ones more suited for sneak and surprise attacks.

Kuudere–this power grants the affected a breaker power that renders them impervious to mundane forms of attack at the cost of limiting their ability to interact with the physical world, additionally when in this state they are able to “absorb” injuries of others allowing for healing. When given to someone who is a parahuman this shifts their powers to ignore brute like effects as well as causing their own powers to “inflict” absorbed injuries on to those they are used upon.

Yandere–this power grants the affected a similar brute package to tsundere (though without the ability to increase in strength) along with a thinker power that allows them to devise perfect plans for protecting you and others affected by your power. When given to someone who is a parahuman this shifts their powers to be more able to defend a group of people.

Finally those now under your control now instead of battling for your attention now cooperate instead working as a streamlined unit.
objects.title: Dere Dere

objects.text: You can selectively choose if and who associates you with any action you’ve escaped from, effectively dissociating you from any action you’ve taken. Your time requirement for line-of-sight to be broken has been shortened to 30 seconds.
objects.title: No Face, No Case

objects.text: The stranger effect surrounding your arguments has grown even stronger, to the point that it’s practically impossible for anyone to argue with you as long as you don’t try to obfuscate anything. You could cite your source as “I made it up” in a rigorous academic debate and it wouldn’t just be accepted, it would be seen as a far superior justification for your argument than an actual study or survey. You could even get people to trust you as a valued member of their team by stating you intend to betray them, and they would never see an issue with that fact.
objects.title: Based Gigachad

objects.text: The moment someone stops hearing your voice, they take damage proportional to the time they spent hearing you uninterrupted. Listening to a sentence or two in conversation before replying would cause mild headaches, while listening intently to a long performance would make them explode when they stopped hearing you. This applies to inanimate objects such as audio recorders as well.
objects.title: Anytime it Hurts, Play Another Verse

objects.text:
If a person possesses knowledge of any secret you have designated, whether they learned it by bypassing your probability defense, through a Thinker power, by luck, from your own accidental revelation, or because they already knew it before you designated it, and that person subsequently attempts to use that secret against you in any way, including blackmail, exposure, physical harm, social manipulation, coercion or even telling a third party, a lethal probability cascade activates against them.. 

Your power orchestrates a chain of highly improbable but physically plausible events that escalate toward the person's death, with the strength and speed of the cascade proportional to the directness of their hostile intent: someone merely threatening to tell others might suffer a crippling accident, while someone actively trying to kill you using the secret could experience catastrophic equipment failure, sudden medical emergencies, or fatal environmental events.

The cascade operates under the same probabilistic rules as the base power, meaning the target's chance of survival never reaches absolute zero. A sufficiently lucky, durable, or powerful individual could theoretically survive, and certain high-end Thinkers (such as Contessa) might navigate around the effect entirely by never acting on the secret directly. However, for most targets, survival requires abandoning all hostile use of the secret immediately and permanently; persistence accelerates the probability of death with each successive attempt.
objects.title: You Dare Use My Own Spells Against Me, Potter?

objects.text:
When splitting timelines you may give your simulated self non-thinker powers equal to 20 SP, be that one 20 SP power or twenty 1 SP powers. The only limitation to these powers is that they cannot affect the minds of those in the simulation including yourself beyond their senses and what those senses are capable of feeling, including pain. 

This means that you could give yourself a power that destroys someone's coordination, or induces immense feelings of pain, but you could not give yourself a power that slows down their or your perception of time, actually slows down time in the area, or induces an emotion.

If someone were to die in a simulation they would simply pass out in the real world, barring circumstances such as the shock of something in your simulation inducing a heart attack.

Certain combat thinker powers, such as your fists moving on their own at absurd speeds, are allowed by your power. The main limitation is that they cannot give you information or have an effect on your perception.
objects.title: Nothing Is Stronger Than a Stranger's Dream

objects.text:
You are no longer as limited in the powers that you can give your simulated self. You may give your simulated self any thinker, master, or other mind-altering powers, so long as they're at most the strength of a Tier 1 power, or Tier 2 if you have a Vital Shard.

In some scenarios this is practically identical to just having the power yourself, or otherwise almost as good. For instance, you could truly master someone with a simulated master power, or gather information using a simulated thinker power.
objects.title: Chamber Made Of Glass

objects.text:
The amount of SP you can give your simulated self is increased by 5 for every purchase of this upgrade.

If you have Chamber Made Of Glass your thinker and master powers are still limited to Tier 1 without and Tier 2 with Vital Shard.
objects.title: You Can't Just Give Yourself 999 In Everything!

objects.text:
You have gone beyond suppressing specific sensory details into the realm of purely contextual framing, letting you abstract information and its relevance for any event. 

For instance, you could reshape the semantic framing of a conversation so that its existence, general topic and tone is remembered but not its precise contents or conclusions. Likewise, a moment of terror might be recalled without any clear memory of what was feared or their exact reasoning behind it.

Furthermore, you have full conscious control over this effect and its application. You can intuitively determine which details of a scene are suppressed and which remain noticeable, allowing for precise, selective targeting rather than general blurring.

Through this, you can actively direct people’s attention either away or towards a particular focus. An observer might vividly remember your sunglasses and hat while glossing over your other facial features or they might fixate on the presence of a gun while failing to recall who was holding it.

The effectiveness of this power remains constrained by the informational scope and density of the event in question. The simpler or ‘narrower’ the event is, the more difficult it becomes to suppress particular details from serious scrutiny.
objects.title: Ignoring the Elephant

objects.text:
Whenever you change your body or appearance, this power provides three separate effects which may be used independently or together.

First, Anyone you choose to still recognize you will do so without difficulty, regardless of how drastic the change is. 

They understand that you look different, but have no difficulty identifying you as the same person. This is an ongoing effect which may be enabled or disabled at will. 

Second, you may cause others to accept alterations to your appearance as mundane or otherwise naturally explainable rather than inherently supernatural. A drastic change may still be surprising or noteworthy, but observers will instinctively interpret it through ordinary explanations rather than concluding that something impossible occurred.

They remain aware that your appearance has changed, but instinctively regard the change itself as no more unusual or concerning than something mundane such as a haircut, tan, weight change, or similar alteration. 

You choose who this recognition and normalization applies to. This is likewise an ongoing effect which may be enabled or disabled independently of recognition.

Finally, make a transformation retroactively consistent. 

This alter memories and records to make your current appearance consistent with your apparent history. 

Photographs, videos, identification, medical records, measurements, written descriptions, and similar evidence update accordingly. Changes that would normally develop over time are reflected appropriately throughout your apparent history; becoming 6’4”, for example, would cause childhood memories and records to show a natural progression toward that eventual height.

This retroactive alteration is a persistent change rather than an effect you must maintain. 

This does not alter the past or change what actually occurred. Only memories, records, and other representations of you are revised sufficiently to make your current form consistent with your apparent history.

When making such a change, you may also incorporate the recognition and mundane-acceptance effects into the revised memories and records, causing people to remember you accordingly without requiring those effects to remain actively maintained.

Each of these three functions may be applied separately, combined in any arrangement, or withheld entirely.

This power does not grant any ability to transform or alter your body. It only applies these effects to changes produced through other means.
objects.title: Always Been This Way

addons.text: Both timelines are real and considered "experienced" by Persisting Growth, allowing you to gain all personal improvements from both timelines. For example, if you exercise in one timeline, the other timeline will benefit from it too.
addons.title: Synchronous Growth

addons.text:
Your ability to loop now extends beyond personal improvements. You can carry over up to 10 different achievements into each new loop. These achievements could range from amassing $10 billion, killing a Cape, or even swapping the flag on the Moon for a Mexican one. The key benefit is that you no longer need to repeat these tasks in subsequent loops—they are automatically accomplished.

The achievements you can bank are limited to tasks where you were the primary contributor or completed the majority of the work. For instance, if you shot Coil with a gun, in the next loop, Coil would simply drop dead with a bullet hole, without you needing to find the gun again. Similarly, if you defeated an Endbringer, you wouldn't need to recreate the conditions necessary to do so again. As long as you did the bulk of the work, such as building the weapon or imbuing it with a Sting-like effect, it will be automatically replicated in future loops.
addons.title: Banked Achievements

objects.text: No longer does your Time-Loop carry over only information. It now carries over all personal improvements gained during a loop, no matter the origin.
objects.title: Persisting Growth

objects.text: You have five save points instead of one. You can set up an auto-save in one of the slots, by default it will save every day when you go to sleep or at midnight.
objects.title: Multiple Save Slots

addons.text: Both timelines are real and considered "experienced" by Undo-Redo, allowing for you to live them out simultaneously. This also naturally makes Coil recursive and immune to blind spots.
addons.title: Synchronous Looping

objects.text: You no longer have a limited amount of save points, and they are no longer only visitable via death. Instead, you may revert to any moment in time that you have experienced, and you may do so at will. You cannot revert to before you got this power unless you have Homecoming.
objects.title: Undo-Redo

addons.text:
Your Ward knowledge is brought to an Archmage level, extending it reaches to Hexes and Boons, Hexes focus on offense, cursing your enemies with misfortune and hindrances, bringing about setbacks and calamities. These dark incantations have a variety of effects, from impairing an opponent's physical and magical abilities to draining their decisions or magical abilities. On the flip side, Boons focus on support, bestowing blessings and advantages upon your allies. These enchantments can enhance their strengths, protect them from harm, heal and empower their abilities, and provide strategic advantages in battles.

While Wards remain neutral and demand a Ward Stone, Hexes and Boons rely more on a sympathetic link, necessitating a symbolic connection between two entities. The stronger the symbolic link, the more seamlessly they can be treated as inherently connected, defying the conventional notion that things are separated by mere space.
addons.title: Magic Language

addons.text:
Your knowledge of Wards has now been expanded to include the application of Chi, granting you the ability to make talismans and formations.

Talismans are strips of paper used to cast spells with Chi. These can produce a variety of effects such as taking lethal damage, increasing your punching power, or even setting something ablaze with fire. While this is a bit redundant and slower than your actual magic spells, talismans have the advantage of delayed activation, allowing you to set up complex traps with what is effectively a magic trip mine.

Formations are an array of these talismans being used in conjunction with each other to cover a wider range. These are Wards made with Chi but have the benefit of not setting off a chain reaction if one of them gets destroyed. The Formation still stops if one of the Talismans is destroyed, it just doesn’t destroy all of them, making it an easier fix. Sadly, the multi-component nature of Formations makes it harder to link multiple Formations together, with multiple Talismans needed to simply act as routers between just two. It is thankfully much easier to link Wards to Formations, with a single Talisman on the ward stone itself being all that is needed. Nevertheless, you might want to do this even if you're just linking Wards, as the Talismans can act as a layer of protection on the Ward Stone, being destroyed in its place if something happens.
addons.title: Spirit Language

addons.text:
You gain the ability to use your Chi to convert your Potions into Pills. If used by itself, the most notable benefits will be increasing storage and shelf life. Storage because Pills take up less room than potions, with about ten Pills taking up as much space in a bottle as one potion, with no loss in efficiency to boot. Shelf life because the transformation into a Pill also makes them less vulnerable to loss from getting dropped and foreign elements contaminating their contents. This doesn’t prevent you from mixing Potions either, with Pills easily dissolving into any other Potion you make.

The interesting part about this comes when you consider the nature of chi. Due to its effect of increasing the user’s health, it is possible to reduce or even eliminate Toxicity. This isn’t foolproof; consuming sufficiently powerful potions in rapid succession will generate Toxicity regardless of the amount of Chi you use in the conversion process, simply because the body can’t handle that much power at once. You could cheat this by designing a Pill whose only effect is to give the user enough Chi to overcome the Toxicity, but the effect won’t be instantaneous, meaning they still suffer from the effects until their body recovers. This will take longer in normal people, but those with Brute, Changer, or any other power that affects their body will have their recovery rate significantly boosted. In theory, someone with a strong enough bodily power could overcome Toxicity in less than a second with the application of Chi. In practice, you’re never going to see it happen unless you happen to convince someone like Alexandria to start popping your Pills like crazy. It is inadvisable to attempt this because it makes you sound like a deranged drug dealer asking to be turned into hamburger meat.
addons.title: Pill Alchemy

objects.text:
Arcanist, Kineticist, Artificer, Alchemist, Martial Adept, Armiger and Magical Menagerie are upgraded to the next level.

Arcanist gives you access to more magic systems as well as the ability to design your own. Your energy pool and recharge rate are multiplied by 10. Your spells are no longer limited in strength. Your Kineticist abilities are affected similarly.

Artificer's enchantment cap is raised to five and you generate 6 more charges per day. Your enchantments are no longer limited in strength.

With Alchemist, you can create potions that can have a permanent effect on the drinker. Your potions can now grant powers on par with a high-tier cape. You can transmute metamaterials that are more easily enchanted, or that can conduct, store, or enhance spells, as well as various power-like effects. The transmutation time is now proportional to the circle's area instead of the volume.

With Magical Menagerie, the number of Charges you receive each day has increased to 3 and the cap on the maximum strength of your creatures has been removed. Additionally, the total baseline size range of your creatures has also widened; ranging from being as tiny as a mouse up to as large as a Blue Whale.

With Wildshape, the number of charges per day increases by 3, and the limits on the number of active forms and maximum strength and number of powers are removed.

With Martial Adept, you have access to far more esoteric and powerful martial arts, techniques, formations, etc., and the ability to design new martial power systems, create domains, and create far more powerful techniques. Your energy pool and recovery rate are multiplied by 10. Your techniques are no longer limited in strength.

Your Arcane Reserve size is multiplied by 5 and the max cap on the strength of your arcane schemes is removed.

With this, you could potentially destroy an Entity if you put your mind to it.

(This doesn't give you additional abilities, only upgrades what you already have.)
objects.title: Archmage

addons.text:
Your Summons may develop a pool of Arcanist energy that will allow them to cast spells you allow or command them to.

You can also draw directly from their Arcanist energy pools for your own spells, and summons can combine and share their energy together.

By meditating, you or your Summons may greatly increase their Arcanist energy pools. They may not cast spells while meditating, and lose the increased pools when they stop. However, they can become a powerful mana battery for you or other Summons.
addons.title: Summoned Focusers

addons.text:
Your Summons gain a pool of Martial Adept energy which they may use to perform disciplines that you train them in, which they may execute combos with.

Summons may be summoned as part of your combos and participate in them. They may synergize their powers with yours to feed the combo, and the built-up power boosts their attributes up to two hours after the combo has been successfully completed, or twelve if summoned as the finisher.

You and other Summons may join up to perform team combos by cycling combo power between eachother and synergizing their moves together.
addons.title: Summoned Weaponmasters

objects.text:
You may now build constructs as autonomous Summons. By designing a scheme as a Summon, it will be able to operate on its own while summoned like a minion. Summons are mainly defined as different from constructs by being able to autonomously act and make decisions without your direct commands, as well as evolve themselves. To make a Summon, you must take or study a greatly improved scheme and engrave an array of essence channels in the scheme. More essence channels will allow the Summon to make more complex decisions and grow faster.

Summons start with an increased draw on your arcane reserves. However, the more a Summon is used, it will gradually develop its own essence which allows them to sustain themselves with less draw, as well as evolve their capabilities, attributes, powers and autonomous capabilities. More efficient and powerful Summons develop essence faster. At peak essence development, a Summon will both draw only a fraction of your reserves and be greatly more powerful and versatile than a similarly designed construct.

You may create animate bodies for your constructs and design them with attributes like defense, wisdom, fire resistance and others, as well as basic attacks, skills and perks. The construct’s main power will synergize and contribute to which attributes it has. If an animate construct or any summon is damaged, it must draw from reserves to repair itself while desummoned. If a Summon or animate construct is destroyed, then its scheme is deleted and must be rebuilt from scratch.

You gain an expanded library of scheme templates that are based on creatures, drones and other animate entities. Animate constructs do not have to be Summons, though you will have to drive them with mental commands for all but simple tasks, nor do Summons need to have animate shapes. You may also add simulated personality interfaces and active logic to any construct, animate, Summon or not, but only Summons can grow these into an actual intelligence and personality through essence development.

While this adds a Master aspect to Armiger, it does not supersede your ability to make normal constructs with Master powers for a more straightforward summoner experience. Summons built on schemes with Master powers may summon and control their own minions.
objects.title: Siralim

addons.text: Your Network Hub allows you to share your powers to your dolls. This overcomes the limit of standard power-sharing and allows your dolls to use Brute, Breaker, and Changer powers. However, as dolls as non-biological, some powers will not work even with this.
addons.title: Doll Network

addons.text: You are able to give powers to your dolls with Manager. Each doll can have at most three powers.
addons.title: Doll Manager

addons.text:
Your dolls are now valid targets for your Interface Modules, allowing you to grant your dolls powers depending on which modules are linked to the interface. 

Additionally, by linking a Computational Core to the Interface Module, you can create control programs or basic VIs which allow your dolls to operate outside your control range and even act independently. The basic VI for the dolls uses the same base kernel as your embedded VI assistant and is likewise not sentient or able to evolve into an AGI without you designing the capability yourself.
addons.title: Doll Designer

addons.text: You are able to give powers made with Shards to your dolls. Each doll can have at most three powers.
addons.title: Doll Shard Builder

objects.text: Your ability to summon and control dolls is greatly increased. The number you can control at once increases to 20 (30 with Negentropy) and the range expands to 10km (20km with Negentropy). They can be summoned up to 5m (16ft) away from you. This upgrade includes all of the doll upgrades in the Doll Powers section. Your dolls are four times as strong, fast, durable, and are able to regenerate 1.6L of volume per minute , they are also capable of levitation. The range of sizes of your dolls expands from a cube 2cm per side to 6m and forms are no longer limited to humanoids. It is possible for a doll to exceed the maximum size, for each increment of 6m it will take up one more doll slot. You gain the two Doll Tinker specializations (Automata and Android) and are capable of either building OR summoning dolls created with those specializations as well as any other Tinker specialization you have access to. You are able to focus some of your powers through your dolls. For example, you can fire Blaster powers, use Striker powers, project a force-field, use empathic vision, etc. However, the dolls themselves do not have the power so Brute, Changer, or Breaker powers that are self-targeted like Deadpool, Phase, and Bowser will not work. Your dolls can be empowered through the following means: Enchantment/Artificer at the cost of charges, Aliena for 25 points worth of powers, Prototype with 3 slots, sharing powers via Network Hub or up to 30 SP (48 with Negentropy) worth of powers. For the last option, dolls with 12 SP or less worth of powers uses one slot, 18 SP or less uses two, 24 or less three, and 30 or less four. The use of a Tier 2 power increases the cost of a doll by two slots. The use of a Tier 3 power increases the cost of a doll by four slots. You are able to store up to 5 dolls inside a pocket space and can summon them at will from there. (This is primarily useful for Tinker dolls.)
objects.title: Doll General

objects.text: You are now able to give life to the Dolls you build. These dolls cannot be summoned and must be carefully and painstakingly built from the ground up using your tinker specializations. Dolls made this way can be converted into true sentient robots using the Automata specialization or true parahumans using the Android specialization. Dolls built using this method can initially be given powers using any method that your dolls can be given powers. However, once they are made sentient only powers that effect others can be used. Once these dolls are sentient, they can go beyond your max range and no longer count toward your max doll count as they now count as true sentient beings and Companions. However, once made sentient, you no longer have control over the former doll in question, and master powers of any kind created with Doll General cannot be used on them, although other master powers can be used. This means that these new sentient beings start as allies but can betray you for any reason a normal Companion would, predominantly neglect, abuse, or outside mastering (if not shielded from it).
objects.title: Life Tinker Specialization

objects.text:
You can consume Cauldron Vials for more Powers without mutations or danger by sacrificing Levels. 

Should you lack the levels to safely consume them, you could potentially suffer permanent side effects such as hallucinations, detachment, loss of humanity, irreversible physical mutations...
objects.title: Unlimited Shard Works

objects.text: You gain an additional slot for your powers for every purchase.
objects.title: More Slots

objects.text: Your powers now reach their maximum strength in only a few seconds, and your power now allows you to select specific powers you'd like from the range of previously used options. Any powers you gain will not fade until you dismiss them, or select new ones. This power pulls choices as much from your subconscious mind as your conscious one keeping an element of randomness to the powers selection.
objects.title: High Priest

objects.text: While within your liminal space, you can become immaterial and construct an avatar using materials available within the space, as well as the features or characteristics of objects or creatures within.  This avatar cannot leave the liminal spaces, but with negentropy can allow you to travel between all liminal landscapes even if they aren't adjacent.
objects.title: Liminal Avatar

objects.text: Instead of memetically nullifying powers, you temporarily steal them, gaining weaker versions of the powers that you nullified along with the victim's understanding of how to use them. While them getting you off their mind does rid you of such stolen powers, the knowledge about those powers is not lost.
objects.title: Stolen, Actually

objects.text:
Your unparalleled skill and knowledge in invention expand even further. You now possess the ability to invent anything that is theoretically possible within a 300-year timeframe. Furthermore, your deep understanding of scientific principles and engineering concepts has been greatly enhanced, allowing you to further expand any field of technology you're working on.

With your newfound capabilities, you can push the boundaries of innovation and create advancements that can even surpass the initial 300-year projection. As time goes on, your creations become increasingly advanced, revolutionizing technology in ways previously unimaginable.
objects.title: The Man Of Tomorrow

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to only cloning parahumans. You can now absorb the DNA of multiple beings, and then produce clones of them simultaneously. This allows you to create a small army of clones, each with different powers and abilities, based on the original parahumans. 

Time taken to produce clones is also shortened to 60 minutes. If Fusion Master is taken then its shortened to 10 minutes.
objects.title: Clone Master

objects.text: You are no longer limited to only cloning parahumans. You can absorb the DNA of multiple creatures, and then produce a single clone that is a fusion off all of them. The resulting fusion is loyal to you and is an effective ally, able to use the combined abilities of both original parahumans. There is no limit to how many creatures that can be fused at once.
objects.title: Fusion Master

objects.text:
You’ve become an unstoppable force and an immovable object. When moving, you can choose to make your body an unstoppable force, capable of punching aside and piercing through any non-absolute defense. You can also now selectively choose what forces apply to you and to what parts of your body, rendering you immune to non-absolute attacks.

As you have no Master to project you, you can freely flicker in and out of reality, allowing you to effectively teleport short distances and reconstitute yourself in the event your defenses are somehow overcome. You can selectively share these properties for a few minutes at your choice with anything and anyone you touch.
objects.title: Siberian

objects.text: You power of creation has now expanded, allowing you to create exotic matter from seemingly nothing. Exotic matter is the colloquial term used to describe highly  "unnatural" matter that is not composed of protons, neutrons and electrons. One of the most common forms of exotic matter in nature is a so-called 'nuclear pasta', a form of structured neutronium that can only exist within the crusts of neutron stars.
objects.title: Exotic Creation

objects.text: You can now become strong enough to destroy the planet and more. However, to reach such a level in strength you need at least a continent worth of people to strongly believe that you have such a level of strength.
objects.title: Memetic Me

addons.text:
You now start with no real limit on how many Personas you can maintain at once. 

You also now have a composite form, where not only do you gain the fused abilities of all your Personas, you even gain access to potential Personas you do not currently have, essentially becoming something akin to an infinite being. This is highly draining and despite how grandiose it sounds, it is extremely hard to make use of this at first, as you will essentially need to somehow be able to mentally control an infinite amount of variations of yourself based of the infinite variations of people's perception of you. You mind existing in infinite different versions with an infinite amount of personalities and traits with uncountable amounts of contradictions. A very straining process that you likely won't be able to handle without a lot of practice.
addons.title: To Be or Not To Be

objects.text:
You can now create and embody multiple Personas, each representing a distinct facet of how others perceive you. These Personas function as separate manifestations of the power derived from specific perceptions, allowing you to harness varying abilities simultaneously without conflict or unreliability.

You can maintain up to three Personas at once, each tied to a collective perception of you. Slowly, as you use and get used to the Persona you will be able to maintain more. Swapping between Personas is instant and has no cooldown. Personas are self-contained; powers from one do not interfere or weaken the others, in fact conflicting or inconsistent perceptions no longer weaken your power. Instead, disagreements are automatically assigned to the most relevant Persona, maintaining full power stability.

Personas are semi-autonomous in thought and can offer insights or solutions based on their specialized powers, akin to an internal team of advisers. You retain ultimate control but benefit from their unique expertise and knowledge. Additionally when embodying a Persona, your appearance subtly or dramatically shifts to match the perception, making you more convincing and enhancing the believability of your abilities.
objects.title: Persona

addons.text:
Your Tinker specialization has now expanded from magtech to cover every possible aspect of electromagnetism with almost no restrictions. As a tinker, you are to the electromagnetic force what Hero was to wavelength manipulation. 

You can construct Tinkertech that creates illusions by manipulating electromagnetic light or build magnetic monopoles, advanced masers, absurdly efficient electromagnetic generators and even weapons that can negate the electromagnetic force entirely in a small area, destroying matter itself.

Through your incredible grasp of this fundamental force of the universe, there is now little you cannot eventually do under the scope of electromagnetism with enough time, effort and materials.
addons.title: Electromagnetic Miracles

objects.text: You gain a Tinker specialization in magtech and related fields, allowing you to, among other things, expand your range using mobile range extenders and automate the field creation/operation
objects.title: Magnetics, Daughter! This is how they work!

objects.text: Your power will now periodically reset itself based on how impressed it is by data you generate, fights you get in, and situations you encounter, restoring your access to its full might. Though if it isn’t super impressed, it will only partially reset itself, restoring access to powers you were, by its standards, generating the most data with. This resetting happens every couple of weeks to months, depending on how you’ve been using your power.
objects.title: Phoenix Star

objects.text: You no longer gain just an answer to any questions you pose, instead you gain true comprehension and understanding of all answers you get. Instead of simply knowing that 2+2=4, you now truly understand why and how. This also applies to any knowledge you come across in any manner. This knowledge cannot harm you in any way, regardless of its nature.
objects.title: Comprehension

objects.text: Each purchase increases the amount of mentors you can have at once.
objects.title: Increase Advisors

addons.text: The maximum range of the effects of your exotic detoniations is increased to the blast-radius of the Tsar Bomba, which is 22 miles. The occasional involuntary randomness of your bombs is removed, leaving you free to decide the exact effect of each bomb, with randomization staying an option you can select. You also gain an immunity to all exotic effects of your bombs, though you can allow yourself to be affected so that your healing-bomb fixes you as well.
addons.title: F.O.A.B.

objects.text:
The explosive potential of your bombs has been elevated to the atomic. Your yield can now range from the smallest grenade blast to the colossal power of the Tsar Bomba, a human-created fusion bomb with a yield of 100 megatons.

Moreover, you have acquired specific immunity to any harm when your bombs detonate. For instance you can now set off numerous of your nuclear bombs, with you in the center of explosions, without experiencing any bodily harm.
objects.title: Tsar Bomber

addons.text:
You possess an unprecedented ability to interact and communicate with non-parahumans as if they were parahumans themselves. You will be able to obtain extensive knowledge of these individuals, enhance your charismatic traits in their presence, and even orchestrate situations that work in your favor when faced with conflict.

In addition, your power can now manipulate entire organizations' subconscious at once, compelling them to act according to your desires.
addons.title: Sender and Receiver

objects.text:
The power’s restrictions regarding employing bladed objects to project cutting edges are lifted, merely performing invisible cuts and slashes as long it is in your field of vision. This frees you from being dependent on any blade or sharp object, adjusting the telekinetic edge’s precision, cutting power, and length.

Your parahuman intuition is more overt this time to the point where is consciously notable to yourself and others, playing interference on thinker powers by feeding false data, getting more detailed information from parahumans, enhancing your charisma against other parahumans, coincidentally creating situations that fall in your favor when it comes to conflict, or finally, obstructing hostile hosts through shard exploitation.
objects.title: Cleave and Lacerate

objects.text: Your Shard has a unique sense of history and sentimentality, a quality almost unheard of among its kind. You are not the first, nor even the latest in a line of wielders; rather, you are the newest host of the Butcher shard, inheriting not only its power but also the cumulative experience, minds, and abilities of all those who held this shard in the past. The abilities of previous hosts will be diluted due to the passage of time, but they are always present. Though generally weaker, certain powers of past hosts might still surge to their original strength or even beyond through power interactions. The strength of these inherited powers depends on your shard rank. With a Vital rank, previous hosts’ abilities are capped at an equivalent of 3 SP. At Noble rank, they reach up to 8 SP. If you acquire Negentropy, this dilution is removed, allowing you to access all past hosts’ powers at full strength. With a Vital rank Shard, you will only get the previous hosts from the most recent cycles. If you have a Noble rank Shard, you will get all the hosts since this shard's creation, which is around the time the cycles first began. Either way, you are getting at least a few dozen, if not hundreds, hosts. Additionally, the minds of all former hosts reside alongside yours in your mental space, alongside the minds of anyone who has killed you. Though you cannot silence these voices entirely, you can put them to sleep if needed. You can access memories from any of these individuals, gaining insight, knowledge, and skills that span generations.
objects.title: Hosts of an Old Age

objects.text: While you normally reincarnate into the last Parahuman or living being that either killed, attacked, or caused your death, no matter the means (having them on the passenger seat and their potential powers, with you at the helm), this upgrade turns your power on its head. Your power evolves to obtain the mind, skills, and powers of any Parahuman (or Shard-based organism) you kill or die within your 5-meter radius, as well as keeping your normal Butcher bodysnatching. When pillaging, you can choose between three power expressions from the original Parahuman, each a variation of the original without losing their main ability. As a counterbalance, your Shard only allows you to use your pillaged powers and skills at full strength and potential for your current ‘life’, halving their effectiveness on subsequent reincarnations. That’s not all, before pillaging another, you can sacrifice their potential mind, powers, and skills for a trait in line with their potential power/being sacrificed, i.e., a Trump can alter how Pillage functions or interacts with other pillaged powers; a pillaged clustermate grants an awareness of their clustermates for potential Pillaging; a Parahuman skilled in either Electronics or Parkour can provide a permanent talent for it, and so on. Then again, you can instead sacrifice a pillaged Parahuman to permanently alter or upgrade another power you may have, pillaged or otherwise. What’s more, it can even be used to permanently keep a power from weakening when reincarnating, or restore it to full strength if weakened already. Mind you, this does not apply to any minds or power gained via your Butcher hostile takeover, and T2 or T3 powers may require multiple sacrifices to empower or maintain them.
objects.title: Pillage

addons.text:
You can summon the people you Pillaged as Shades. They will have both their original power and your version of their power. They can act from any range apart from you and possess all their mental faculties should you choose, you will be able to communicate and share senses with them regardless of distance.

While you are now able to Pillage from anyone, not just Parahumans, normal people do not grant any resources but if they possess any skills you have access to them. If they are summoned as a Shade, they can use any of your Tinker powers that you possess. You gain twice the amount of resources you could before.
addons.title: Gravekeeper

addons.text:
Your Thinker and Tinker powers automatically combine to create a Nexus. The Thinker and Tinker powers you obtain can be used to gain unique benefits that boost the capability of applicable powers. A material Tinker’s knowledge can alter and improve the kinds of metals a metal-generating power could produce, or a precognitive Thinker could assist with your aim. Perhaps due to the strange way your brain now functions, you are completely immune to anything that tries to influence your mind.

You can also modify, enhance, split, combine, and change the expression of your powers. You’ll also be able to spend resources to create powers in a slot, freeing the slot after creation. However, you don’t need to do this for Thinker or Tinker powers, as they can be copied without occupying a slot. Discarding a power in a slot transfers any resources invested in it to another power of your choosing. Additionally, you can predict the result of your modifications to powers before you make them.
addons.title: Nexus

addons.text:
Your nature is something different, straying away from a normal Shard and becoming it’s own thing. Not a Shard or a Parahuman, something different. Limitations that a normal shard may have doesn’t exist and your powers can take actions that would even hinder the Cycle.

Predator gives 25% more resources every purchase instead of 10%. Your body is a manifestation of your power, and even if it dies you can come back at a designated location(s). But creating new Avatars takes some time to recalibrate with your powers causing them to be weaker for a short while and consumes energy. You’re also capable of communicating with other Shards.
addons.title: Amalgamation

objects.text:
Your Shard comes from an evolutionary offshoot species of the Entities and specializes in hunting them for resources and knowledge. Pillaging a Parahuman directly connects to their Shard and consumes them for resources.

Every purchase of this upgrade improves the resources gained from consumption by a fixed 10%. So 10 purchases enhance the amount of resources gained by 100%. This causes any powers you obtain to be stronger than the original as well as restores more energy for your Shard.

Your powers can go beyond their initial strength, you can cannibalize powers for resources and [DATA] gained to improve a different power of your choosing. Cannibalizing a power to another power with a similar nature is twice as effective. If a power is upgraded by a certain amount past its limit, it will mutate in various ways. This works on any power you possess.

Shards are vaguely capable of feeling something different about your Shard. While it is not enough to raise any alarms, Parahumans feel a bit of distrust towards you. This gets stronger the more Predator Upgrades you possess.
objects.title: Predator

addons.title: Ideal Incarnation
addons.text:
You now have incredible agency when re-incarnating; able to take over nearly any living individual, parahuman or not, so long as they can feasibly emulate your mind, including beings such as Dragon.

Perhaps more importantly, this ability operates via a goal orientated mechanism, automatically selecting the nearest viable match to your preferences. This allows for even vague, abstract requests when deciding your next host; such as “the most powerful parahuman alive” or “the best person to complete [insert objective]”.

Note that you still can't transfer into beings such as Endbringers, Titans or Entities due to the inherent Shard safeguards in place.

objects.text:
You are able to alter the parameters that your Butcher power uses to select those it possesses at will.

So instead of only possessing Parahumans who kill you, or the last to attack you. You can set the parameters to things like; female bodies only, is willing to be possessed by you, and has a tinker power. You can even set pretty subjective parameters like being morally reprehensible. Essentially any parameter you can think of you can set for your Butcher power.

You can set as many or as few parameters as you like as long as you have at least one.

The only rule is that the parameters cannot directly be set to specific people, like only resurrecting you in Alexandria’s body. Instead if you want to possess a specific person you’ll have to set as many parameters to traits and conditions you can think of that that person possesses or meets and hope you get lucky.

If a parameter you set is impossible to fulfill your power will default to your Butcher power’s original parameters.
objects.title: Directed Butchery

objects.text: You can resurrect possessing the bodies of mundane humans now, if no parahuman bodies are available or a mundane human was responsible for your death.
objects.title: Mundane Butchery

objects.text:
When transferring to a new body, you can now selectively keep or discard features from previous incarnations, seamlessly overlaying and adding them to your new self.

You could preserve particular physical traits such as a muscular build, 20/20 vision or useful Case 53 alterations, reshaping your current host to match. Your next body could be converted into a 1:1 clone of your original self or be a patchwork, made up of dozens of others. This also covers mental aspects such as memories and skills but you can't erase the voices of those you have incarnated into.

However, you have no permanent repository for these traits or skills etc. Anything you choose not to carry into your next incarnation is permanently lost unless you somehow reacquire it later on.
objects.title: Legacy of the Many

objects.text:
Your power as a Pokémon Master has been upgraded to the next level. 

Firstly, your power can make Legendary and Mythical Pokémon, albeit they will be created much further away from you to be created in areas suitable for them and safe for you. 
Secondly, you also start with a Pokédex item which can share information on each Pokémon you encounter. 

Thirdly, you gain the ability to set large areas as 'regions' including templates of regions such as Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Hisui which influence the creation of Pokémon within that area to fit the region, albeit with those regions limited to what may already fit the area. 

Fourthly, you gain a minor Pokémon equipment tinker power enabling you to make equipment such as Pokéballs as needed so long as you have supplies and time, albeit this cannot be used to create Master Balls and you start only able to make common equipment. 

Fifthly, your Thinker power has been improved to warn you of dangerous Pokémon as well as aid in tracking down Legendary and Mythical Pokémon.
objects.title: Pokémon: Let's Go!

objects.text:
Your precognition cooldowns have been significantly reduced, allowing you to see into the future more frequently. The cooldown has been reduced from one week to one day, which gives you more opportunities to use your ability to anticipate events. Additionally, you can further shorten your precognition cooldowns by shortening the amount of time you can see into the future. For example, instead of seeing a full 100 days into the future, you could choose to constantly see one day ahead. You can also do the reverse, seeing further at the cost of increasing the cooldown.

The psychological toll of experiencing the future in an instant has also been reduced, making it less debilitating and easier to handle. Only the most serious events or experiences are likely to affect you in any meaningful way.

This also gives you a better understanding over cause and effect, allowing you to better predict how your actions can change the future you seen.
