objects.title: Precog

objects.text:
When you touch any non-intelligent object or creature, it suddenly transforms into a horrific and monstrous mutation of its former self. The mutated monster will inherit the object's intended purpose or natural abilities, transformed to ludicrous extremes. 

For example, a Matryoshka doll might evolve into a gargantuan doll with the ability to summon smaller versions of itself. Another example is a simple sunflower transforming into a giant plant monster capable of shooting beams of sunlight. You could also make a figurine of a hero grow to become a lifesize version that has the hero’s power and personality.

These minions will possess their own self-awareness and are completely subservient to you, their master. Their duration is tied to your stamina; the more you create at once, the more stamina it costs to maintain. You can use extra stamina to control the appearance, personality, and abilities of your minions. You can choose to scale down the strength of your minions to minimize the stamina cost, although you can also do the reverse.
objects.title: Monster Squad

objects.text:
Now, you possess the ability to materialize replicas of the equipment wielded by your mentors. All such gear is securely stowed away within a pocket dimension, ready to be summoned into the real world. However, there is a restriction – you can only conjure one weapon and one set of armor simultaneously. The process of crafting your mentor-inspired equipment requires the expenditure of energy, and once forged, the equipment becomes a permanent addition to your arsenal. It's essential to note that the replicated gear won't inherit any enchantments or powers from the originals.

To further customize your arsenal, you can invest energy to imbue your replicated equipment with a scaled-down version of any power or enchantment possessed by the mentor's gear. With consistent training, these powers and enchantments have the potential to gradually evolve, eventually reaching their original strength. This dynamic system empowers you to tailor your equipment to your unique style while providing room for growth and development.
objects.title: Equipment Manifestation

objects.text:
This archive delves into alternate or alien worlds visited by entities in the past, cataloging various alien and mythological creatures and animals that can be summoned by the user. It's important to note that these creatures cannot reproduce. Among the creatures available for summoning are kitsunes, dire wolves, dragons, and even extraterrestrial beings from other worlds. Each creature retains its natural abilities.

The Archive provides a comprehensive mental list of summonable creatures, complete with detailed descriptions, species names, and any special abilities they possess. This wealth of information empowers users to select the desired creature for their needs, giving them full control over their summoning choices. However, users are limited in the number of creatures and animals they can summon, as they are not natural to your version of Earth.
objects.title: Otherworldly Archive

objects.text:
You now gain a pocket dimension with an ocean and an island that act as a home to any creatures you summon or control. This Power enables you to carry around your animals and creatures. The island has an ecosystem that is changing and adapting to any animal or creature that lives there; the island is expanded as animals or creatures are added over time; and as the island expands and grows, new biomes will appear, allowing you to have different areas like a snowy region or a tropical area. If you are able to summon mythical or extra-terrestrial animals and creatures, then two new islands will be added for them. 

Animals and creatures can now breed with the same member of their species and crossbreed with others. This feature is only available inside the sanctuary. Any creature or animal that is hurt is returned to the sanctuary to heal.  Please note that small and big game will be naturally included on the island, allowing for the animals to hunt each other or the various types of small and big game located around the island.
objects.title: Wildlife Sanctuary

objects.text:
Your personal army has improved, letting you summon more soldiers, vehicles, and equipment than you started with.

You have no limit to the number of soldiers or vehicles you can summon, only how many you can summon at once. Per week, you can summon an additional 50 soldiers, 5 lighter vehicles, such as armored cars, 5 heavier vehicles, such as tanks, 5 smaller aircraft, such as fighter planes, and 2 heavier aircraft, such as bombers. The vehicles you summon will have their crew summoned with them.

Your soldiers are now superhuman, which opens the door for new classes of soldiers you can summon. Your standard soldier now possesses peak human physical capabilities, as well as an increase in skill, allowing them to make key tactical decisions on the fly. Your soldiers can also summon needed ammunition for both themselves and any vehicle you summoned. You will even find yourself and your soldiers immune to friendly fire.

You can summon ‘classes’, special types of soldiers that have their profession ramped to higher capabilities. These build off of your standard soldiers, keeping their superhuman capabilities. These classes are split into two versions, lesser and higher.

Lesser classes are classes that provide a smaller amount of effects. This can range from a cook who can produce extremely good food, a general who can command an army without giving an order, a medic who can induce regeneration or a mechanic who can repair vehicles at an abnormally fast rate. A single lesser class can be summoned once a week.

Higher classes are the pinnacle of classes, with a variety of potential powers this can range from a cook that makes food that grants abilities, a general that has a lesser version of your summoning abilities, a medic that can bring back the recently deceased, or a mechanic that can maintain and repair tinker tech. A single higher class can be summoned once a month.

Should any of your soldiers die, they can be re-summoned after an hour, and any damaged vehicle will find itself fixed and in a retrievable position after an hour.
objects.title: Personal Military

objects.text: Your army’s technology level has increased to the level of the world at the end of the Vietnam War. Your current equipment and vehicles are updated. New vehicles are added to your arsenal, including 24 transport helicopters, 12 attack helicopters, 20 transport planes, 15 reconnaissance planes, 5 electronic warfare planes, 20 river patrol boats and a mobile riverine base. The crews needed for these vehicles are added to your army.
objects.title: The Trees Started Speaking Vietnamese

objects.text: Your army is now advanced to the modern age. From modern 5th generation planes to advanced main battle tanks, you gain units fit for the modern age. In addition, you now have a unit dedicated to drone operations. You gain 10 large UAVs, 15 small UAVs, and 5 Unmanned Surface Vehicles. You gain the required equipment and operators to operate these.
objects.title: Desert Storm

objects.text: Your army’s technology has now advanced to near-future technology. This stocks your army with lower end tinker tech. From military exoskeletons to laser rifles, your army now looks like it is out of a sci fi movie.
objects.title: Advanced Warfare

addons.text: You can now replace naval and artillery units generated by Personal Army upgrades with equivalents from the technology trees you understand. These replacements fully integrate into your army but remain "user-specific" in nature, tied to the units they are summoned with and unable to be repurposed outside of their intended use.
addons.title: Strategic Overhaul

addons.text:
You and your summoned soldiers gain complete knowledge of the strategies, tactics, and doctrines optimized for your advanced technology. This includes an understanding of how historical wars might have been fought with your technology, allowing you to apply refined, battle-tested approaches tailored to your equipment.

In essence, you and your forces acquire the tactical expertise of hypothetical wars shaped by your advancements. This eliminates disparities in strategy when utilizing multiple tech trees, ensuring your forces can seamlessly integrate diverse technologies and maximize their potential in complex combat scenarios.
addons.title: Tactical Integration

addons.text:
Your summoned units now retroactively gain any items or equipment they would have had if they were summoned at this moment, ensuring all your forces benefit from your most up-to-date technological advancements. Additionally, soldiers no longer vanish if you lose access to a specific tech tree, making your army more stable and reliable over time.

Your summoning rate now scales additively, doubling for every 10 SP you spend on Technology or Tinker powers. For example, spending 20 SP increases your production rate to triple its base level. This scaling applies to all summoned forces, including soldiers, vehicles, and both lesser and higher classes, allowing your army to grow larger and more powerful as you invest in technological expertise.
addons.title: Vanguard Evolution

addons.text:
Your military can now "mix-and-match" elements from different tech trees you have access to, such that you could have a hypothetical piece of equipment using the "greatest hits" of each tech tree if you wished. For example (supposing you had access to everything mentioned), you could have a tank with the chassis and numerous hardpoints of a 40k Baneblade, the brain-computer interfaces, crew automation, and hover propulsion of a Cyberpunk Basilisk, Star Trek phasers replacing the coaxial machine guns, and a Star Wars turbolaser replacing the main gun.

You can choose the exact arrangement of the tech, and you have an intuitive sense for what combination of tech would be optimal for what role, so you know what combinations would be good for a heavy tank like that just mentioned, versus that of fighter aircraft, explosives, small arms, etc.
addons.title: Multiversal Horizontal Integration

objects.text:
Your Personal Army can now be equipped with any individual-level technology you know how to build. This includes equipment derived from powers you personally have, such as Tinker Powers or Technology and Artifice Powers. If you possess no such abilities or knowledge, this upgrade will have little to no effect.

However, if you do, the results are transformative. For example, if you understand Star Wars technology, your soldiers can be summoned with stormtrooper armor and blasters, and vehicles like AT-ATs or TIE Fighters can replace their tank and airplane counterparts. While each piece of equipment must follow a single tech tree, your army and soldiers as a whole can mix technologies from multiple trees as long as you understand them.

All equipment generated through this upgrade is “user-specific” and tied directly to the soldier or vehicle it was summoned with. These items cannot be stockpiled, reverse-engineered, exploited for resources, or used by others, and they disappear if the soldier dies.

The adaptability of your army is directly linked to your knowledge. If you lose understanding of a particular tech tree, any soldiers or vehicles using that technology will immediately vanish. Furthermore if you gain knowledge, by capturing or reverse engineering technology, you can incorporate that new technology into your soldiers.

This upgrade allows your Personal Army to become a versatile and powerful force, limited only by your expertise and imagination.
objects.title: Multiversal Legion

objects.text: Your army now has a naval detachment of the same technology level as your army. Your naval detachment consists of 1 carrier, 2 battleships, 2 cruisers, 3 destroyers, 3 frigates, 2 submarines, 2 minesweepers, 1 hospital ship, 5 landing ships, and 2 auxiliary ships. Your naval forces will be staffed with the appropriate personnel and equipment on board, and will posses the same benefits and loyalty as your army.
objects.title: Air Land and Sea

objects.text: An artillery and mortar detachment has been added to your army. You gain 24 stationary artillery pieces, 30 mortar teams, 17 rocket artillery pieces, and 16 self-propelled artillery pieces. The crews needed to operate and target these are added to your army.
objects.title: And The Caissons Go Rolling Along

objects.text: You can train more than just your muscles; you can now enhance every aspect of your body. This includes fortifying your immune system against toxins, toughening your skin to resist bullets, and accelerating the development of other abilities or powers. While an intense and harsh training regimen will boost your recovery capabilities, gradual increments will ensure more stable adaptations, providing a solid foundation for long-term improvement.
objects.title: Superior Training

objects.text:
The stronger, faster and generally better your physical form, the more potent and effective your powers become. Additionally, by pushing your powers to their limits, you can further strengthen and refine them. Through repeated exertion and reaching new thresholds, your abilities evolve, becoming stronger, more versatile, and adaptable. The more your powers grow, the stronger your physique becomes as well.

Temporary boosts to your physique will similarly give temporary boosts to your powers.
objects.title: Power Muscles

addons.text: The number of Abilities you receive daily doubles every week. Together with this you always are aware of how much doing something will improve you.
addons.title: Unlimited Manifestations

objects.text: Each selection doubles the Abilities you receive daily. This also gives you a vague sense of what the Abilities you will receive are, like "Increases your resistance to something" "Fire related" and "Helps with distant enemies".
objects.title: Even More Manifestations

objects.text:
The Abilities you receive no longer go beyond 1 SP, not even going beyond T0, and more often than not you receive Abilities that are worse than T0s. They are also often very hyperspecialized, things like "Your nose can't become itchy" or "Clean your teeth with a thought" are way more likely than something like the T0 Organized Mind.

In compensation, you no longer have a limit on how many Abilities you receive daily. One moment you may gain two Abilities 30 minutes apart and the next you may gain 10 in 20 seconds.
objects.title: Lesser Manifestations

objects.text:
Sometimes the randomness of this power might be a bit frustrating, right? Now your power considers both your desires and your future up to a month from now to determine what Abilities you will gain. While this doesn't affect how likely you are to get a higher SP Ability rather than a lower one it will make sure whatever Ability you gain will be somewhat useful for the reason it was given to you.

Maybe there's a chance of a friend dying and now you occasionally receive Abilities that might prevent that while you also occasionally receive some Abilities that would help you cope (Like say, the capacity to make any type of Ice Cream) if you don't succeed in saving them, or maybe you will want to climb a Mountain next week so in that period you occasionally receive Abilities that would make it easier and safer to do so.
objects.title: Useful Manifestation

addons.text: Your Abilities not only come at level 10 but they also come as if they already had a single evolution.
addons.title: Never Was Equal

objects.text: The limit on the strength of your Abilities has been removed. Rather than a month, all of the past/present/future is taken in account when your Abilities are selected and now it can not only affect how strong between the minimum and maximum SP cap the Ability will be but also can give you Abilities regardless of chance.
objects.title: Unequal

objects.text:
Every selection will make higher SP Abilities become less rare by shifting the baseline, doing so makes it so any Ability that is below that baseline becomes a freebie. Select this one time and now the baseline for the rarity is 1 SP T1s while every time you would've gotten a T0 had you didn't have this upgrade you not only still gain that Ability but it doesn't count towards your daily limit.

For every selection above 5, the SP cap is increased by 2. Negentropy allows your 15 SP cap to manifest T2s.
objects.title: Higher Manifestation

objects.text: Your Abilities already come in their level 10 state, allowing you to immediately evolve or fuse them.
objects.title: Leveled Manifestation

objects.text: Tired of having useless or unneeded abilities. Don’t want to bother leveling them up? No worries! With this, you can sacrifice any unwanted abilities to level up an ability of your choice. The level of the ability you're sacrificing will determine how much the chosen ability will increase. For example, a Level 0 ability can upgrade a Level 2 ability to Level 3, and a Level 1 ability will level up a Level 0 ability to Level 2. A evolved or fused ability will always max out an ability.
objects.title: Sacrificial Manifestation

addons.text: Your Abilities are stronger, acting as if 10 instances of them were combined into one.
addons.title: It's High Quality

addons.text: You gain back the ability to level up your Abilities, but it no longer works through use—instead, you must sacrifice a existing Ability in order to level up another, with the end result adding the levels of the sacrifice to its own.
addons.title: Worth It

objects.text: Your Abilities can no longer infinitely grow—levelling is gone and as such evolving or fusing them is no longer possible. Your Abilities still can be used together and synergize, they just can't become brand new ones anymore.
objects.title: Devolution

objects.text:
You can turn multiple powers into a Set, creating a Set reduces the cost of the powers of that Set by 1 point and gives it back to you, but in compensation makes it so using any of your powers that are in a Set becomes slightly weaker when used with powers outside or inside another Set.

If the powers on a Set have synergy they will instead have their cost reduced by 2 points. If you have multiple Sets and they follow a theme the powers will cost 1 less on top of their previous reductions. The cost of a power cannot go below 1.

As an example, powers that cost 4, 3, and 1 points will instead cost 2, 1, and 1 points in a Synergy Set, make another Set whose theme with the first one is "Defense" and it will instead be 1, 1, and 1.

Sets act as a single power. Their components can still be used without one another but thanks to it acting as a single power a Set will allow you to use what that combination of powers was meant for with greater ease.

Besides all of that, you can summon Sets you discarded instead of individual powers, and the restriction on summoning powers that are too similar to one you already summoned is lessened, you still can't summon duplicates.
objects.title: Set Bonuses

objects.text:
Aliena’s point capacity now increases an additional 5 points (8 if Negentropic/Shardless) every week for you to utilize. 

Duplicates and similar powers can be created freely now. All other limitations still apply.
objects.title: Aliena Engine

objects.text: Each purchase increases the amount of points Aliena increases by every cycle by 5 (8 if Negentropic/Shardless).
objects.title: Aliena (Charges)

objects.text: Each purchase halves the amount of time it takes for Aliena to increase points.
objects.title: Aliena (Frequency)

objects.text:
Whenever you send someone into the testing world, time and reality warp around them, causing their minds to twist and their bodies to mutate. Within this hellish realm, they undergo a grotesque transformation that leaves them nearly unrecognizable—another monster among the horrific inhabitants of this world. This process of transformation takes precisely 6 days, 6 minutes, and 6 seconds.

During this time, their mental state deteriorates under the relentless torment and warped reality, while their physical form becomes increasingly monstrous, adapted to survive the harsh environment. Once the transformation is complete, you gain their loyalty, and they can be summoned as part of your power.

However, if you choose to bring someone out of the testing world before the transformation process is complete, they will still have undergone significant warping, but they may retain some semblance of their former humanity. These individuals will be not be loyal to you, as their time in the world has not fully bound them to your will.

You have the option to exempt certain individuals from this effect.
objects.title: That’s Hell You Are Walking Into

objects.text:
All Parahumans in the testing world now gains a new passive ability when summoned: a thematic shaker effect. This power reshapes the environment around them to reflect their personal theme, which is influenced equally by their core abilities and the nature of their trigger event. 

For instance, a parahuman whose trigger event was tied to decay might find their surroundings crumbling and eroding, causing structures to deteriorate and the ground to become unstable. Conversely, a parahuman with a theme of fire might see the environment perpetually scorched, with flames and unstable terrain creating hazardous conditions. If a parahuman's trigger event occurred in a hospital, their thematic shaker effect could reflect the trauma and distress of that experience, causing the environment to become a nightmarish version of a hospital, with decrepit, blood-stained rooms, flickering lights, and unsettling medical equipment. 

This alteration enhances each parahuman’s capabilities and modifies the environment to align with their powers and experiences. The result is an ever-evolving, dangerous landscape where the environment continuously adapts to reflect the nature of its inhabitants. You also gain an increase in the number of summons you can have at once, now being three (five with negentropy). 

Note that not all parahumans you can summon play nice with each other, at least half cause the trigger event of the other half after all.
objects.title: Gates Of Hell

objects.text:
Your connection to the Shards making up Goddesses's cluster has reached its maximum potential, greatly enhancing all your powers and resulting in unrivaled pre-eminence.

Your Master power now affects anyone, not just Parahumans, continuously aligning their cognition into being subservient to you when in your presence. The telekinetic power you possess has had its Manton Limits removed, allowing you to affect organic matter with the same ease as inorganic material and you can now toss buildings the size of skyscrapers.

Your Trump ability to automatically tune your personal defenses is now instantaneous and provides you with a perfect, nigh-absolute defense or immunity against any threat. It still can only tune to negate a single threat, power, or effect at a time but you can prioritise which danger to tune to. To complement this ability, your danger sense provides far more detailed information about threats than before, conveying their precise nature, source, strength, and timing. You can sense indirect, non-immediate threats such as traps and accurately predict attacks up to an hour into the future.

Your fifth power, your personal power battery, holds significantly more energy and can recharge faster, allowing you to maintain enhanced abilities for longer periods. You can strengthen multiple powers at once although this will quickly drain your battery depending on the level of boosts provided. Finally, your last power has also improved in strength to now be on par with a low Tier 2 power.
objects.title: Sovereign

objects.text:
By understanding how a power works, you can not only nullify it, you can deal extra damage. For example, by understanding how physics is altered by a Parahuman’s Breaker state, you can create an attack that is perfectly suited to destroy them and their Breaker state. Similarly, by comprehending the mechanics of a Blaster’s power, you can create a defense that not only neutralizes the attack but also rebounds the damage back to the Blaster.

This also helps you copy other Parahuman powers by understanding how they work and their effects on the world. You gain a minor thinker power suited to help you do this.
objects.title: Natural Way

addons.text: Whether they are allies, enemies, or mere bystanders, anyone with knowledge of you will be influenced by your presence, each in their own way. They begin to adopt traits that resemble yours, subtly altering their behaviors, ideals, or ambitions. Should you die, you gain the choice to forego rebirth. Instead, you can channel your essence into those who remember you, amplifying the traits they’ve inherited from you. In doing so, your legacy lives on, woven into the thoughts and actions of those who carry your memory, shaping the world through their new perspectives. This effect is permanent, so as long as anyone gets information of you, even after you have truly died, traits belonging to you will begin to appear in them.
addons.title: An Idea Is Eternal

objects.text:
As long as even at least 100 people retains knowledge of you, true death is impossible. You are bound to the thoughts and memories of others, ensuring that you will always be reborn through those who remember you. The time it takes for your rebirth depends on the depth of their knowledge and understanding of you; those with only a vague memory of your existence will take years, while those who have studied you deeply can accelerate the process. If a person is surrounded by others who also know of you, the combined awareness speeds up your resurrection.

Before your rebirth, the target begins to change subtly, adopting characteristics that echo your own. They may develop similar mannerisms, personality traits, or even ambitions and goals that mirror yours. Their thoughts might become more aligned with your perspective, and their desires may start to resemble those you held in life. As this transformation progresses, you gradually replaces them, until finally, you return, fully reborn.
objects.title: You Can’t Kill An Idea

addons.text:
Your claiming range enters any afterlife connected to the universe you are in. It will gradually increase within them until it encompasses the entirety of it.

Besides that, you can now claim the dead even when they weren't in your range when they died. As long as something of importance to them — like their house or a person they had a friendship with — or that is connected to them — like the tinkertech of a dead parahuman or the dried blood of someone whose corpse is unreachable but left a trail behind — is within your range, you can claim even those whose bodies were completely erased.
addons.title: Usurper

objects.text:
Now both your Death Touch and your claiming range no longer are limited to just Parahumans. Any sentient/sapient being that dies within your range or that you use your Death Touch on will be claimed, allowing you to summon them as shades.

You have a mental world that houses those you claimed. It changes to accommodate all within but you can freely alter it, the only limit is that you can't intentionally harm those within.
objects.title: Walking Afterlife

addons.text: By hanging around and gathering data from Parahumans, you can obtain traits from their Shards without requiring you pillaging their Shard. The traits you can obtain changes based on the parahuman you are analyzing.
addons.title: Gleaning

objects.text:
Besides seeing a visual representation of someone's power and Shard you can now access and parse through all the data the Shard of a Parahuman has. This includes any and all information it has on its host.

Using this acquired data, your own shades will slowly incorporates part of it to improve their own powers. Your power will do the same to itself.

All of this also applies to the data the Shards of your shades has, so even without encountering any other Parahumans your Shades would still improve.
objects.title: Deeper Insight

addons.text: You are now constantly in your Wild Hunt state and your need to hunt Parahumans is something you can safely ignore with ease.
addons.title: Army of Death

addons.text: Your Shard creates a permanent connection with any Parahuman that enters your claiming range and will conspire to cause their death depending on your wishes. This permanent connection means they will be claimed even if they leave your claiming range.
addons.title: Ankou

addons.text:
Pillage's range to claim the minds and powers of those who didn't die by your hands is now equal to that of Faerie Queen.

When you claim a Parahuman you gain two options: You can choose all three expressions of a power resulting in you gaining three shades — each being able to use one of the three expressions — but you won't have gain the actual power of the original. Or you can choose one of the expressions and the power of the original, resulting in a single shade that can use both.
addons.title: Manannán mac Lir

objects.text: Once a month, you enter a state called The Wild Hunt where you can use all your shades at once, your shades not only use weakened versions of each other's powers but can summon and command lesser copies of your other shades, with those copies having alternate expressions instead of a copy of the powers of the originals. Essentially, your original shades are the Commanders and the lesser copies are their Subordinates. You can make your shades explode, any Parahuman caught in the blast radius immediately dies and is then claimed, doing so causes the shade you sacrificed to take a while to be summoned again. Sacrificing a Commander will cause all of its summoned Subordinates to also explode. You can control and slowly emit a black miasma that weakens those who touch it, when you are in the Wild Hunt state all your shades can emit this miasma, and the speed it appears is dramatically increased. You and those you are hunting can see through the miasma, it wouldn't exactly be a satisfying hunt if your prey can't fight back after all. When in your Wild Hunt state you have a need to hunt Parahumans using the full might of your Faerie Queen-related abilities.
objects.title: The Wild Hunt

objects.text:
In addition to seeing a visual representation of someone's power and Shard, you can now see the death of a Parahuman.

Look at a Parahuman and you will see with extreme accuracy all the ways they could die in the future and even know the exact reason. You know the time of those deaths, both in the sense that it will happen "in the year XXXX at the month XX in the day XX at the hour XX:XX", and in the sense of "in X hours, X minutes and X seconds". You also know how likely each death is and even why.

If you have Walking Afterlife, then instead of witnessing only the death of Parahumans, you witness the death of everything.
objects.title: Seeing Death

objects.text: Normally when your shades die they would need a bit of time before returning, now they recover instantly.
objects.title: Instant Recovery

objects.text:
In addition to the original 7 save slots, your power now includes access to a repository of significant events from past cycles recorded by your Shard. You can overlay these events onto the current environment, temporarily blending past and present. People and elements from these events act as they did originally, without fully realizing they are echoes of a different time.

Rather than recreating entire events, you can choose extract specific aspects—like a combatant’s actions, environmental effects, or strategies used in a past conflict. This allows you to alter the battlefield subtly without bringing the whole event back. However, larger or more chaotic events are harder to control, and they might leave behind fragments that linger longer than intended. If used repeatedly in the same place, it can leave behind traces of past cycles, making the area prone to further anomalies.
objects.title: Age Forgotten

objects.text:
The essence of your chosen power has fully infused into your very being, granting you the ability to transform into a pure Breaker state in which you consist entirely of your “element”, whether light or dark.

In this form, you can manipulate your size, shape and overall consistency at will, allowing you to shift seamlessly from being as solid as steel to as fluid as running water. You can regenerate in this form by drawing upon your respective “element” from your surrounding environment as fuel. Additionally, you are self-sustaining in this Breaker state, no longer requiring food, water, air, or sleep, and can remain in this form indefinitely.

However, in this Breaker state, you are particularly vulnerable to powers and abilities tied to your opposite “element”. Despite this weakness, environments containing significant amounts of your chosen “element” will help you withstand and resist these attacks.

If you possess both (Shaker/Mover) Nyx and (Shaker/Mover) Eos, this vulnerability to extremes of light and dark is completely removed and you can blend both light and dark simultaneously into your Breaker state, producing a harmonious duality that greatly enhances your versatility and power.
objects.title: Chiaroscuro

objects.text: Now you are guaranteed to roll a permanent power as one of your first ten rolls. Not only that but Randomizer now also includes a pity system, if it’s been one hundred rolls since your last permanent power your next roll is guaranteed to be permanent.
objects.title: A Freebie and a Pity System

objects.text:
Either you or your Endbringer can now freely switch between your human and Endbringer form while retaining all your abilities between both forms. 

For your master power, this provides your Endbringer a human form of your choosing for them to take, as well as a personality that is immutably loyal to you, autonomous, and complementary with you.
objects.title: Monster Inside

objects.text:
Your Endbringer(s) can now freely use your non-Endbringer powers at the same strength that you can normally use them at. These powers do not get any power boost or duplication and instead are simply extended to your Endbringer(s) as if they are extensions of your body similar to that of a limb. 

This means for powers like (Trump) Manager, your Endbringer(s) can use already copied powers, and copy powers of those touching it, but does not have its own independent slots and the number active and storage slots remain the same.
objects.title: Conflict Engine Power Networking

addons.text:
Your Naming extends beyond objects and beings—you can Name your techniques, granting them thematic and cultural power. A move’s Name must embody its purpose and execution, aligning with its essence to enhance its effects. For instance, a quick, piercing strike called “Sky Fang” might become sharper and faster, invoking the image of a predator’s swift attack from above. Similarly, a defensive maneuver named “Zephyr’s Embrace” could gain an almost supernatural grace, redirecting attacks like a breeze shifting the air. A move called “Raijin’s Descent” might gain electrical effects, while “Promethean Flame” could burn with rebellious intensity.

To make full use of the Name, calling it out before activation of your technique will dramatically boost its effects.

The requirements to Name skills or abilities are similar to Naming in general, with lesser names only needing to be said out loud and stronger ones requiring rituals.
addons.title: Technique Naming

objects.text:
You can now bestow Names upon objects and beings, granting them abilities or altering their nature based on the symbolic and cultural meanings behind the Name. A Name must resonate with the target’s self-image or intrinsic nature to fully take hold, as Names draw their power from the target’s essence as much as from your intent.

For objects, this resonance is based on their physical form and intended purpose. A spear, for instance, cannot accept the Name “Excalibur”—it is not a sword, nor does it embody the same qualities of chivalry, kingship, or truth. However, a spear named “Gungnir” could gain properties tied to unerring accuracy and divine authority, as these qualities align with both the spear’s nature and the mythic associations of its Name. Similarly, a simple lantern named “Hearthlight” might become an eternal source of warmth and safety, while a rusted shield named “Aegis” could gain the unyielding strength of divine protection.

Living beings, by contrast, must accept and internalize the Name you give them for it to take effect. A person’s self-identity is a critical component of the Naming process. If you attempt to Name someone “Achilles,” they must see themselves as a great warrior, a figure of resilience, or someone destined for both glory and vulnerability. If they reject the identity the Name represents—whether consciously or subconsciously—the power of the Name will not take root. If they can embrace their Name, the effects will fully take hold, reshaping and bolstering their abilities with the Name’s meaning. For example, if someone who thrives on risk and believes in their own ability to overcome obstacles accepts the Name “Fortuna,” they could find themselves surrounded by uncanny good fortune, with events subtly aligning in their favor.

You also have the ability to create Epithets or Titles, which are easier to bestow but carry lesser effects. Unlike full Names, Epithets do not fundamentally alter the target’s nature but instead grant minor enhancements or symbolic traits. A warrior given the Title “The Unyielding” might find their endurance subtly bolstered, while someone called “Whisper of the Winds” might become eerily silent and quick. Titles are simpler to attach, as they require less resonance with the target’s core identity, and they can even be applied temporarily for specific purposes.

The process of Naming is a ritualistic act that demands focus, intent, and a deep understanding of the Name’s symbolic weight. To successfully invoke a Name, you must speak it with clarity and conviction, with stronger names needing gestures that reflect its meaning. For instance, bestowing the Name “Mjolnir” on a hammer might involve inscribing runes on its surface, symbolizing the legendary hammer’s connection to storms and divine might. Similarly, naming someone “Medusa” might require presenting a reflective surface to embody her mythological ties to petrification and fear. However a weak Name, will require little more than speaking it with unwavering conviction. For example, naming a stone “Pebble” might only demand that you hold it firmly in your palm, as the act itself confirms its identity.

Renaming is possible but difficult, especially for objects or beings already deeply tied to their existing Name. Overwriting a strong Name requires significant effort, as it involves unraveling the symbolic resonance already embedded in the target’s essence. For instance, renaming a blade already known as “Bloodletter” to “Peacemaker” would require a dramatic symbolic act, such as reforging the blade or breaking it entirely to sever its connection to its previous identity.
objects.title: Naming of the Soul

objects.text: Paramount no longer requires powers created or summoned through it to build up to their full strength. Instead, they manifest immediately at their full available power from the moment they are brought into use.
objects.title: Immediate Manifestation

objects.text: Instead of being limited to just a single T1 power at any given time, you have 12 Slots that each represent a PRT classification. Those slots can only hold a T1 power whose primary classification matches theirs.
objects.title: Classification Tokens

addons.text: Now, beyond having the 15 SP budget for powers, your classification-based slots also become 15 SP each. Unfortunately, they still function similarly to how they did as slots and as such can only be spent on things that have them as their primary classification, so, for example, the Master Budget can only summon powers that are primarily Master. Their SP don't increase with multiple selections and, as such, are limited to a maximum of T2 powers.
addons.title: Freeform Classification

objects.text: The bonus from Negentropy is now innate. Instead of being limited to a single T1 power at any given time, you gain a 15 SP — 20 with Negentropy or Shardless, 25 with Noble Rank/Essence — budget that can be freely allocated between anything that fits it. Paramount’s catalogue now includes everything under the Power tab that fits your budget, weaker versions of anything that exceeds that, and finally any custom ones you summoned. Anything under the Shardless banner will of course be an imitation if you don't have Esoteric Knowlegdge or Shardless. The catalogue will continue to expand dynamically as time passes — such as incluing variants of a power — even adding anything that was added to the Power tab after you got this. To summon things equivalent to T2, you need Noble Rank/Essence or Negentropy/Shardless, and both for T3 and up equivalents. Thanks to the above you can now edit the addons/synergies of your summoned powers, such as substituting an existing one for something else you might want. Each additional selection beyond the first increases your budget by 5 SP — 10 if you have Noble Rank/Essence.
objects.title: Freeform Selection

addons.text:
You gain an additional Paramount slot focused on upgrades and enhancing other powers.

Its budget is equal to your Paramount budget, including any increases provided through Freeform Selection, and may be distributed between multiple powers rather than being limited to a single selection.

This budget may be used to enhance powers obtained through your Classification Tokens or any other powers you possess whether normal powers or powers gained via other powers such as (Trump) Eidolon. It may also be added directly onto the budget of another Classification Token slot, and your normal Freeform Selection budget may likewise be added onto those slots.

As a result, a power could, for example, receive the budget of its Classification Token slot, additional budget from Freeform Selection, and further budget from the Upgrade slot at the same time.
addons.title: Classification Token: Upgrade
Integration
addons.text:
Paramount may now incorporate any other powers you possess into itself. Doing so adds that power’s full SP value to Paramount’s available budget, which may then be freely redistributed through Paramount to create or enhance other powers.

Rather than acting as an overarching power that contains everything granted through it, Paramount instead functions as a central hub that stores your available budget, maintains its catalogue, and serves as the point through which powers can be designed, created, altered, and released for use.

Its normal available budget represents the portion currently unallocated, while powers you already possess are treated as portions that have already been drawn from its catalogue

You may freely return these powers, in whole or in part, to Paramount's available budget and redistribute their SP value to create or enhance other powers. Likewise, you may reduce a power to a weaker variation to free part of its value, or allocate additional budget toward it to reach stronger variations.

Likewise, you may reduce a power to a weaker variation to free part of its value, allocate additional budget toward it to reach stronger variations, or otherwise bring powers back through Paramount for alterations available to it.

The incorporated power is not lost, disabled, or altered in the process. 

Instead, Paramount begins functioning as a central hub for your powers, drawing upon their combined value while allowing each of them to continue functioning normally.  

You may incorporate any number of powers this way, adding their values together with Paramount’s existing budget and any other increases it possesses.

The powers themselves remain separate once released and continue functioning normally while retaining any benefits, modifications, or interactions they receive through Paramount and its other functions. 

Returning or altering them through Paramount does not inherently strip away anything provided by its other upgrades, fusions, or related effects unless those effects specifically require otherwise.

Paramount's total budget therefore grows to encompass the powers available through it while still retaining its normal functions and interactions. 

This also naturally expands your catalogue to cover the other powers and upgrades for your new budget. 

This is an additional function of Paramount and does not replace any of its existing abilities. Inversion may also still be used on Paramount itself normally.

addons.title: Not Only Powers
addons.text:
Paramount is no longer limited to summoning powers. Its budget may now also be used to summon Skills, Perks, and Drawbacks, treating them as additional selections available through Paramount.

Skill, Perks, and Drawbacks function as they normally would and must still make sense as valid selections. 

All Skill, Perks, and Drawbacks within your budget are recorded in your budget with weaker variations for those outside your budget limits. 

These may be created, exchanged, and redistributed through Paramount in the same manner as its powers, using the same available budget.

objects.text:
Your Freeform Selection budget can now be used to enhance other powers you possess, allowing you to reach their higher-level versions by supplying the remaining cost through your available budget.

Universal Upgrades and similar selections were already available through Freeform Selection. This simply extends that flexibility directly to powers themselves, allowing the budget to be added onto an existing power rather than requiring it to be used only for separate selections.

Your catalogue also expands to include any expanded or higher-level variations of powers available through this interaction. This will also naturally expand if you somehow gain powers later on as well, whether through another power or other circumstances.
objects.title: Expansion

objects.text:
Your expertise now encompass the full spectrum of advanced technologies necessary for a spacefaring civilisation—not just its construction, but its defense and dominance. You transcend the role of an architect laying the groundwork for a cosmic empire and become the driving force behind its survival and supremacy.

You have blueprints for technologies that span every aspect of interstellar life. From sophisticated domestic systems that enable millions to thrive in the void of space to military innovations that ensure the safety and expansion of your civilisation and even advanced faster-than-light (FTL) spacecrafts. Dyson Spheres and colossal megastructures power this vast infrastructure, sustaining life and industry on a scale that rivals the stars themselves.

You also gain an expertise in space warfare. You are capable of designing and deploying weaponry and defenses that can stand against any threat, including other advanced civilisations. Your arsenal includes planet-cracking superweapons, fleets of AI-driven warships, orbital defense networks, power armour made to protect its user from the void of space, and shields capable of withstanding the most devastating cosmic forces.
objects.title: Space Warfare

objects.text:
You lose the ability to turn into a Titan, but in its place, you begin a slow transformation into something even more. On the outside, you still look human. Nothing about your appearance changes but deep inside, your body is slowly being replaced. Instead of flesh and blood, you’re becoming something entirely new—your cells turning into high-dimensional crystals tied to your Shard.

This change is fueled by how much you use your powers. The more you use on them, the faster and stronger they grow. Over time, your abilities become far more powerful than before, reaching the level of Titans.

Eventually, this transformation reaches its peak. By the end, you won’t just be a person with a Shard. You will be the Shard in human form, having complete control over the manifestation of your powers and understanding of the entire process. You keep your thoughts, feelings, and personality, but now with access to unimaginable strength and abilities. You would be the perfected fusion of Titans and Khepri.

How long this takes depends on your Shard. If your Shard has a lower rank, the process speeds up. If your Shard has a strong connection to you, liking and aligning with your goals, the transformation happens even faster.
objects.title: Human Shard

objects.text: You can now use three different effects per constellation at once and the quantity will gradually increase over time.
objects.title: Unleashing The Stars

objects.text:
Bringing forth your adversaries’ sins and vices in physical form wasn’t bad enough for their psyche, wouldn’t it be fun if those projections caused mental distress, psychological damage, and the general feeling that they’re in perpetual agony at their walking sins’ touch? As it is written for the destiny of sinners lacking absolution.

Your sinful manifestations gain power over the sinner they were from, causing guilt, remorse, and misery the more they’re near their sins so much. Hence, it psychologically scars and "spiritually" wounds the person, leaving a throbbing pang of pain afterward, so best hope their sins don’t reach out as much as a graze, or else they’ll feel the full brunt, feeling gut-wrenching misery. If it’s unbearable enough for them that they succumb to unrecoverable mental trauma, their “sins” will take over the sinner’s body, becoming one with their worst selves and under your control.
objects.title: Gehenna

addons.text: Everytime you commit a crime you gain an Ability and a object related to it, like say robbing someone could give you enhanced stamina to flee and a gun to help with the next robbery.
addons.title: Unlawful Manifestation

objects.text: The first time you commit a crime/break a law you gain a minor power that helps with it, like a really small inventory if you stole a candy from a store. Each time you commit that same crime again 5 times you gain yet another minor power.
objects.title: Unlawful Powerup

objects.text: Your suite of powers have lost their weakness and are now all acting at full power at all times allowing for you to use your collection of abilities at full power.
objects.title: Full Tilt Suite

objects.text:
You are no longer confined to teleporting yourself and others but can now warp anything you touch. With a mere thought, you can transport objects; either taking them with you or sending them anywhere you desire.

You could drop a live grenade into an enemy’s lap or deliver crucial intel straight to the right hands. To start, you can teleport items weighing up to 2 metric tons instantly. Beyond that, however, each additional 200 kg of mass requires one extra second as your power takes time to scale up before teleporting.

You can exert your physical and mental stamina to expedite this process, reducing the time needed. This comes at a cost: the more mass you handle, the more it exhausts you. Over time and with practice, your maximum capacity, speed and efficiency will improve, enabling you to move heavier items faster.

You also have an innate awareness and selective mental filter that lets you intuitively choose what is transferred. You could, for instance, teleport out of a cell while leaving behind any restraints or warp someone without their weapons. This applies to whole items only, preventing you from tele-fragging.
objects.title: Dead Drop

objects.text:
You can now travel through time as easily as you can space. This can also be used to travel to alternate timelines. 

This can also be used concurrently or separately from your ability to travel through space, able to simply travel to a specific point in time without moving through space, essentially transporting you to that same point in space, or they can be used together, taking you to a different time and location simultaneously. 

This power’s innate targeting works just as well as before, allowing you to use vague parameters to transport yourself. This can also be used to target specific time even when you’re not aware of the specific time, such as “when Eidolon triggered” despite not knowing the date or even year when it happened. 

As a natural result of the power expanding in this manner, your power will also slowly grow to include more dimensions to travel through when made aware of it.
objects.title: Ideal Time

addons.text:
Your power no longer centers merely on yourself for going or coming. 

Instead, you can now send something somewhere else without even being in their presence. 

Send enemies from their homes to heavily fortified prisons, intel about supply routes hidden in an enemy general’s desk sent right to lap of the head of the defending army, all without ever coming within the same hemisphere of either.
addons.title: Dead Letter

objects.text: Your power now also works in reverse, able to bring things to you rather than traveling to them. Your power works in the same vein as before, able to target vague targets such as doctor if you needed or wanted one to come to you.
objects.title: Two Way Street

objects.text:
Previously you bent causality to make the outcomes of your actions unfold on the spot. Now, you have taken this a step further — you can invert cause and effect over a span of time that includes other uses of Inversion, creating a recursive effect.

Essentially, this upgrade allows you to compress a full sequence of inverted actions under one overarching inversion. For example, you might invert cause and effect multiple times to instantly buy food, return home, cook a meal and clean up. By utilising Inception, you can affect this entire chain of events, so the full process appears to have finished prior to starting.

This recursive inversion exponentially increases what you can achieve, allowing complex, laborious tasks to resolve in a moment. In combat, you might use Inversion to dodge, move and strike immediately. With Inception, however, you could skip the entire fight sequence, ending the battle before it even kicks off. 

This recursive effect is limited to a single ‘layer’ of nesting, however. You could alter the cause and effect for a segment of time that contains applications of (Breaker) How The Turns Have Tabled!, but you cannot invert it again beyond that. You are still bound by the power's original constraints, such as the 30-minute limit and decreasing accuracy.
objects.title: Inception

objects.text:
This power’s previous limitation on transmitting esoteric effects has been lifted. You can now channel parahuman abilities and similar effects via the scale model, whether they originate from you or another source.

These scale based on the model’s size ratio, allowing powers with limited range or intensity to increase proportionally as represented in the model. For instance, an aerokinetic ability restricted to a five-metre radius could instead generate a powerful, full-scale hurricane within the model’s corresponding real-world location.

You might nullify another parahuman with a Trump power that usually requires line of sight, fire off a weak laser beam that triggers a huge detonation in the targeted area or enforce a far-reaching Master effect that typically needs close proximity to take hold.
objects.title: Through the Looking Glass

objects.text: You can now create real things out of nothing by adding to your model. If you paint part of the model, the real version will become painted the same way. If you place an object into the model, a full-sized version of that object will appear in the real world. For example, if you put a small spider into the model, a giant spider will appear in the matching real-world location. These creations are physical and behave just like the real thing. Anything done to them—such as damage, movement, or setting them on fire—will also happen to the object you added to the model. If you crush or burn the giant spider, the small one inside the model is affected the same way. However, these created things are not permanent. As soon as you dismiss the model, everything made through it disappears instantly. They leave nothing behind, no matter how large or complex they were. Additionally, if you try to insert something too complex into the model—like tinkertech or trump empowered items—your shard will push back against recreating it. This resistance manifests as physical strain, growing worse the longer the complex object remains inside the model. This is rendered void if you have either Negentropy or Through the Looking Glass.
objects.title: Manifest Construct

objects.text:
You may choose which manifested additions remain after dismissal of the model.

Constructs no longer need to be universally temporary; each may be allowed to vanish, remain for a limited duration, or persist indefinitely or permanently.
objects.title: Permanent Construct

objects.text:
You may peel back, separate, or expose portions of the model without damaging what it’s representing. 

Buildings may be opened, terrain may be parted, hidden compartments, etc may be viewed in cross-section, and layered spaces may be inspected safely. 

This can be done via your power, rather you manually pulling apart and fixing the pieces, also granting you telekinetic control over your model and all its components.

These changes can be observational only, or can propagate.
objects.title: Open

objects.text:
You may freely reshape the scale model’s dimensions, even while it is active, redistributing its total available volume into any configuration you desire.

The model’s total volume may not exceed its current maximum (as determined by Model Size Extension and other upgrades), but its length, width, and height may be altered arbitrarily. 

You could compress the model into a thin, city-wide sheet, stretch it into a long corridor, or flatten it into a table-like slab, provided the overall volume remains constant.

This can allow you to do things such as converting your model into a kilometer-long strip that traces a highway or river, flattening the model into a vast tabletop map for strategic oversight, or forming a narrow vertical column to track a skyscraper from foundation to rooftop

This reshaping is instantaneous and may be adjusted continuously while the model persists.
objects.title: Reconfiguration

objects.text: The linear dimensions (i.e. length, width and height) of the scale model are doubled upon each purchase. This increases the total volume eightfold with each selection, from 1 m<sup>3</sup> to 8 m<sup>3</sup> to 64 m<sup>3</sup> and so on.
objects.title: Model Size Extension

objects.text: The scale model’s maximum size ratio increases by 8 with each purchase, For example, from an initial proportional ratio of 1:24, it would progress to 1:32, then 1:40, 1:48, 1:56 and so on.
objects.title: Model Ratio Amplification

objects.text: The Skills/Powers you receive are no longer temporary.
objects.title: The Author didn't Forget

objects.text: The SP cap is raised to 20 SP and the Powers/Skills you receive will always come at the exact strength necessary to deal with the situation you wanted/needed them for as long as it doesn't exceed the SP cap.
objects.title: Favored by the Plot

objects.text: Your Shard accelerates your growth by expanding your starting reservoir of forms. Each time you purchase this upgrade, you gain a greater batch of pre-generated forms immediately—ready to use without needing to wait for the weekly growth cycle. The number of forms granted follows an exponential pattern: the first purchase grants 1 form, the second grants 2, the third 4, the fourth 8, and so on.
objects.title: Form Archive

objects.text: Your Shard accelerates your growth by reducing the time between each form’s arrival. With every purchase of this upgrade, the interval for generating new forms is halved. The first purchase lowers the time from 1 week to 3.5 days, the second to 1.75 days, the third to 21 hours, and so on—progressively shortening with every purchase.
objects.title: Accelerated Cycle

objects.text: Your Shard accelerates your growth by increasing the number of forms you receive each week. With every purchase of this upgrade, the weekly amount of generated forms doubles. The first purchase increases the number to 2, the second to 4, the third to 8, and so on. Each new form still arrives with 5 SP of powers, 10 CP of skills, and a fully formed backstory, expanding your personal archive at an ever-growing rate.
objects.title: Exponential Bloom

objects.text:
Each of your forms now manifests with its own personalized set of gear. This equipment is tailored to match and complement the form’s powers, designed to support its abilities and enhance its combat or utility potential. The gear is strictly limited to mundane technology—tools, weapons, armor, and items that exist within the boundaries of non-powered science. Despite this, the selection can be highly specialized, often reflecting the form’s background and function.

Alongside the gear, each form gains an additional 5 CP worth of skills specifically tied to the use, maintenance, or tactical application of that equipment. These skills exist separately from the form’s standard CP allocation and are rooted in the form’s projected familiarity with its gear, ensuring they can wield it effectively from the moment of manifestation.

The equipment itself is not physical in the traditional sense—it is projected along with the form, only existing while that form is active. When the form is dismissed, the gear vanishes with it, leaving no trace behind.
objects.title: Integrated Loadout

objects.text:
Your shard has refined its override and interface protocols beyond Endbringers, granting you the ability to forcibly access and subjugate the control matrices of any shard-based intelligence within 100 meters. With this, you may target any Shard-based intelligence, such Master projections, Case-53 mutants, Titans, and even Shards themselves.

As before, your target’s strength and proximity impacts the time need to reprogram their control matrix. Subjugating lesser shard constructs, such as normal shard Master Projections, may take only seconds even at max range. For more complex hosts, such as Titans, seizing control may still take several minutes of uninterrupted connection. Regardless of the target, physical touch still functions as a direct access point, enabling near-instant subjugation of any shard-based intelligence short of an Entity.

Unfortunately, for most Shards your reprograming of their control matrix cannot fully seize control of the shard or its linked parahuman. Instead, your influence manifests at the shard-human interface level, producing unconscious shifts in the parahuman’s behavior and thought processes.

Parahumans affected in this way may develop a baseless affinity toward you, prematurely dismiss negative information, or become unusually willing to cooperate against their better judgment. However, as this change is at the unconscious level, once recognized it can easily be fought against.

Moreover, more powerful beings remain especially sensitive to your intrusion attempts. Tier 3 Shards, Endbringers, and Titans often detect tampering long before control can be established and may react with immediate hostility or attempts to disengage entirely, making such capture attempts inherently dangerous .

In addition, you still maintain your ability to propagate all shard-boosting perks you possess (such as Negentropy, Esoteric Knowledge, and Pocket Shard) to all your captured Shard-based intelligences with  Negentropy, in particular still drastically reduces capture times for all captured beings.
objects.title: Shard-Controller

objects.text: With this upgrade, you can iterate more than just technology. Anything that can be construed as a “creation”—whether it be a martial arts style, a training plan, or something stranger—can be iterated; picked apart and put back together in a more developed fashion.
objects.title: Polymathic Iteration

objects.text:
This upgrade expands your Tinker specialty with technology that would allow you to essentially become a pagan god.

Technology that lets you listen to prayers, grant blessings, curses, biological immortality, enhanced physical capabilities, perform large-scale fantasy element manipulation, healing, all things you could do without this upgrade in some form or another. What this upgrade does is make them easier to accomplish, in the middle of your Tinker tech tree instead of towards the end.

A few examples of tech explaining these capabilities could be healing, enhanced physical capabilities, and biological immortality taking the form of medicine, cybernetic augmentation, and genetic modification.

Your endgame for this Tinker specialty becomes truly fantastical, increasing your potential strength and versatility tenfold, which among other things, lets you do things like reverse causality, terraform a desert in days, hypnotize a metropolis, cross the span of the multiverse in a single step, or even revive the dead.
objects.title: Divinity Or Technology

objects.text: Your power unlocks the ability to swap Directives, changing the purpose of the slot system. Instead of only lethal intent, you can shift into alternate domains. Slots define the flavor, Directive defines the goal. Your Directive is just as flexible as your slots are. You can only have one Directive at a time. A Directive of Movement could have Explosives become shockwave propulsions; Monsters become mounts or carriers; Cutting becomes spatial slicing that opens paths. A Directive of Construction could involve burning for welds, poison becoming acid for shaping stone, Cutting as precision carving, or Monsters as scaffolding or labor. This and much more become available.
objects.title: Directive Shift

objects.text:
You can now assign up to 5 Directives at a time, allowing you to use them concurrently, each tied to your slot system. Just as Ablation and Entropy can combine into a single effect, so too can Construction and Lethality, or Movement and Suppression, or any number of other directives.

A predator swarm (Predation) built for lethal assault (Lethality) can also serve as carriers (Movement) or spread infection (Corruption).

Entropy + Gravitation can reshape terrain (Construction) while simultaneously crushing intruders (Lethality).

You can also layer them. Toxic Bloom spores might carry suppression effects alongside lethal poison, stunning enemies as they die.

You might run a lethal frontline while simultaneously constructing fortifications and spreading corruption through the rear.
objects.title: Multiple Gears

objects.text:
You are now capable of Imbueing more than one unique power into a given person. This means someone you empower can be a vehicle Tinker, a healer, a teleporter, a projection Master, AND a nullifier Trump if you desire it, or any other arbitrary combination of abilities you want! Or, you know, you could just stack five types of superstrength onto one person so they can throw down with Alexandria. It's up to you.

Each purchase adds one more 'slot' for powers, starting at 1 slot at zero purchases, and up to 5 slots at four purchases. Each power possesses its own independent SP limit.
objects.title: Power Broker Quantity

objects.text: The SP limit for the powers you create is increased. Each purchase increases it by 2 SP, for a maximum of 25 SP per power at 5 Purchases. You are still limited by the 3 SP Imbued or Upgraded per day rule.
objects.title: Power Broker Quality

objects.text: Each purchase of this upgrade grants you one additional charge per day, up to 5 charges per day.
objects.title: Power Broker Rate

objects.text:
In addition to acting as the intermediary between two people to exchange esoteric aspects, you may also begin make exchanges including yourself and others, or even just yourself.

For example, you may exchange a year of your life for a boost in physical power. The resulting boost will be equivalent to, in some way, a year of your life.

Your Shard facilitates these exchanges, so while the results could be potent and exactly what you want, there is also a chance that the Shard’s alien mentality might cause a misunderstanding and slight deviation from what you desire.

In general, it’s best to be as specific as possible when making Vows. As another example, if you had Alexandria’s power you could say, “I Vow, in exchange for my eidetic memory for the duration of this fight, my cognitive and reactionary speed will be proportionally increased.”

The specifics of this vow may decrease the resulting boost, but you are have also guaranteed that you’ll get your eidetic memory back after the fight is done, though you likely won’t be able to have perfect recall of the fight itself.
objects.title: I Vow…

objects.text:
You now have the ability to create a new category of card: Trap Cards.

Trap Cards are developed in the same manner as Spell Cards, but instead of being activated immediately, they are designed to be "primed" and held in reserve within specialized Trap Slots. You have three of these Trap Slots (five with Negentropy) that exist separately from your Summon and Spell Slots. 

When a Trap Card is created, you must also define a default trigger condition that determines when the card will automatically activate when primed. However, you may also manually trigger trap cards at will or assign special temporary triggers to an already created Trap Card whenever you want. 

However, adding or modifying triggers to a trap card costs charges. This charge cost scales with the trigger’s complexity, range, generality, informational requirements, and whether it’s permanent or temporary to that card.
objects.title: You Activated My Trap Card!

objects.text: You have gained the ability to burn charges to do a combat scrying. By expending a chosen number of charges, you may look at that many cards from the top of your deck, select one of them, and immediately play it without placing it into your hand. Your deck shuffles after each use of this ability.
objects.title: Srcying Charges

objects.text: Your crystals can now regenerate back to whole, taking twice as long as the time it took to reach that state. They also no longer dissipate when they become black. Finally, by darkening another crystal you can regenerate one of your other crystals by the same ratio, sacrificed crystals regenerate as normal.
objects.title: Enduring Crystals

objects.text: You can now choose to instantly learn any skill you wish, provided you’d be able to learn, use, and understand it otherwise. You can utilize this for example to master Karate but won’t be able to master Earthbending, unless you possess the ability to Earthbend on your own. Any skills that would require muscle memory will be granted through this, and any skill or muscle memory that you need to forget and revert for any reason can be done so at will.
objects.title: Taskmaster

objects.text:
Your ability to claim another being’s power for yourself no longer requires their death.

Now if you simply defeat a target in a meaningful physical or mental confrontation then you may steal or copy their power without killing them. The conflict must be genuine and consequential with both combatants meaningfully trying to win. Trivial victories, staged defeats, or friendly spars do not qualify. 

Furthermore, this process may not be repeated if you already got a copy of that person’s power before in the past, regardless of if you still have said copy.
objects.title: Stupid Laws, Won’t Let Me Have Any Fun!

objects.text:
Instead of simply negating the reaction force you act like a theoretical object with negative mass. This means forces which would push back against when you act are instead added to your own force. Running through a wall will not only provide you with no resistance, it will actually increase your acceleration. Striking a more durable surface will magnify the effect of your blows.

This again applies to any physical force you can exert through your body or your powers. You still have perfect control over this, so you won’t accidentally get sucked through a surface you touch or go flying when you’re trying to move around normally.
objects.title: Negative Mass Drive

objects.text: Slice has taken itself to the next tier and transformed into Slash, gaining a far greater scale and capacity for destruction. Firstly, your operational range has expanded by a factor of ten. You can now generate and manipulate Slashes anywhere within a one kilometre radius of yourself; all while maintaining the same level of inhuman accuracy, awareness and control you had with Slice. Similarly, the effective cutting edge of your Slashes has been enhanced to the same degree. They can range from being as sharp as 0.01 mm to as broad as 10 cm. At their upper end, they cease to behave like cuts and instead act as solid pillars of kinetic force, hitting huge hammer-like blows. Lastly, the maximum kinetic energy a single Slash can carry has escalated, far surpassing what was possible with Slice. At full output, a single motion could cleave through vast swathes of buildings across a city, tear entire city-blocks apart in the blink of an eye and retain enough momentum to travel for several miles past your original range.
objects.title: Slash

objects.text: You now have access to a second, alternative function: Sever. At first glance it resembles Slice, but rather than a kinetic force, Sever acts as an All-or-Nothing effect that spatially forces matter apart. You can designate a two dimensional plane of any size and shape within your range and, once applied, anything intersecting that boundary is instantly separated, no matter its density or durability. A single Sever can form a gap equal in width to your Slice’s edges, adjustable as needed. You may exert any number of Severs concurrently within your radius, applying and maneuvering them across any feasible angle, plane or geometry with the same ease and skill as your Slices. However, they cannot occur or extend beyond your range. With this you could hollow out a perfect sphere from a stone block, carve straight down to the innermost layers of an Endbringer, cleanly split a tank into a dozen parts without harming anyone inside or layer hundreds of Severs on top of each other to turn an enemy into a fine, bloody mist. Together, Slice and Sever place the power to part the world itself at your fingertips.
objects.title: Sever

objects.text: Each time this is taken you gain another set of slots for each power classifications from your original 24. (36, 48, 60, etc)
objects.title: Additional Set

objects.text:
For each time you take this upgrade, the range of your Shaker aura will double. 

(15cm -> 30cm (1ft) -> 60cm (2ft) etc.)
objects.title: Domain Enlargement

objects.text: You now have complete control over your 15cm radius. Where before you were able to manipulate the forces available, now you can create and destroy matter, distort reality, and make impossible creations. Unfortunately, things you create cannot leave your radius without breaking down to base physical laws over the course of an hour. For instance, if you created a wall of stone, it would stay, but a sword that’s anomalously on fire would quickly lose that fire until you brought it back into your radius. Additionally, as you are ‘within’ your radius, your control over your surroundings now extends to yourself allowing you to warp your own body, warping and shaping it as you please. Changes to your brain however can be rather dangerous if done without careful consideration.
objects.title: The Great Dictator

objects.text:
You are capable of simultaneously perceiving the world through two filters: one showing the normal reality everyone else sees, and one showing a world where no powers or similar anomalies (besides yours) have ever existed and everything is a completely mundane analogue of itself, which you can interact with to affect things in the real world in the same way.

For example, you could walk up to a portal through space and, treating it as a mundane door, simply close it, or go toe-to-toe with a combat thinker whose reliance on their power translates to inelegant fumbling through your power’s filter; if you were at an Endbringer fight you could treat them as simply a large, violent person and shoot them with an ordinary handgun to grievously harm or kill them. You’re still immune to powers and to indirect effects of powers, and may still allow yourself to be affected if you wish.
objects.title: Only Sane Person

objects.text: You can discard a power from your catalog, upon which a new one will take its place. The new power will be random, the price and/or classification of the one sacrificed having no influence over it.
objects.title: Catalog Rotation

objects.text: Every purchase gives you more attitude to imbue your granted powers with. You can choose anytime which of your selected attitudes you want to give someone — such as all of them or loyalty to one person and fear to a different one — and change it anytime.
objects.title: More Atitudes

objects.text:
Now you can puppeteer the bodies of those granted a power by you. You can do it partially or in full, allowing you to briefly guide their hands to better make use of a power, use their mouth to speak with a enemy, etc.

You also gain unlimited multitasking to handle this.
objects.title: Hijacking

objects.text:
Your power is no longer limited to making others believe you’re the strongest. Instead, you may impose one or more impressions or reputations that others instinctively believe about you.

You can make yourself seem like the most loved, most feared, most trustworthy, most competent, funniest, greatest hero, best doctor, best basketball player, and practically any other concept or reputation. 

People will sincerely believe these impressions, even without evidence, and unconsciously rationalize away anything that contradicts them.

This affects anyone or anything regardless of distance. It does not grant the actual skills or traits, only the unwavering belief that you possess them. You may freely add, remove, or change your chosen impressions at will.

Unless you take Holding Back, the effect applies equally and indiscriminately to everyone, including friends, family, and lovers.
objects.title: THATS WHY HES THE GOAT, THE GOAT!

objects.text:
You can physically manifest your simulacrum at will rather than simply a mental version.

This physical copy will be as powerful and capable as the original. 

You can freely dismiss and resummon them to fix any damage.
objects.title: Physical Simulacrum

addons.text:
Due to your more refined dimensional folding inherited from Ladon, you possess far greater control over the expression of your body's true dimensions, along with vastly more mass to manipulate due to Ladon's layer compression and compacting.

Your ability to circumvent the normal laws of physics compounds with Titanic's control over your size, mass, gravity, and inertia, allowing these properties to be distributed unevenly throughout your body instead of applying uniformly.
