You can concentrate mass or inertia into individual limbs, anchor yourself against overwhelming forces, or render portions of your body effectively weightless without affecting the rest.

When dedicating yourself entirely to defense, your dimensional layering, mass manipulation, and reinforcing strata work in perfect harmony. Short of an All-or-Nothing attack, virtually nothing can meaningfully injure you, and only the most exceptional such attacks can reach your core without immense difficulty.
addons.title: Briareus

addons.text: Your ability to reshape and alter your body and its properties allows you to shift and reshape the crystalline pathways and structures in your body that define your powers. By restructuring these patterns within yourself, you can bias individual powers toward different aspects of their function, such as exchanging fine control for greater output, increasing range at the expense of duration, loosening one limitation in exchange for tightening another, or making similar tradeoffs wherever your powers naturally possess multiple attributes. These adjustments cannot grant new capabilities, only redistribute the potential already present within a power. Additionally, for the purposes of Passenger's bonus to power strength and control, you always count as being at least building-sized, regardless of your current physical dimensions. Expanding your body with Titanic increases this effective size further, allowing Passenger's scaling bonus to continue improving until you reach your true size.
addons.title: Proteus

addons.text: Forget having the mass of a mountain, you have the full mass of a true Endbringer to work with. Given that the true mass of an Endbringer is highly debated with estimates ranging from planetary on the lower end to galactic at the high end, for the purposes of this power you start with the mass of the Earth and can grow to a mass equal to that of Jupiter. If you are Shardless or possess Negentropy then you do not possess an upper limit on the amount of mass you can grow to.
addons.title: Atlas

objects.text:
You are capable of altering the dimensional structure holding your body in its Endbringer-like state. This allows you to essentially alter any property related to the true mass of your body–inertia, mass, gravity, size, shape–within some limits. You can control these independently of each other, such as making yourself extremely resistant to changes in inertia without increasing your mass, or becoming extremely large without gaining weight.

Your maximum in each extreme would be a sphere a few hundred meters in diameter with the mass of a mountain and a gravity twenty times (or one twentieth) the norm. You are capable of shapeshifting as you contract or expand your body, including moving the location of your core.

If you have Shardless or Negentropy then your limits will loosen as you use your power. Within a few years you could probably be a moon all on your own!
objects.title: Titanic
Stave
objects.text: You now have access to utility type powers, such as healing, future sight, clairvoyance, multitasking, or power-granting. Only purchasing this upgrade once will require you to use one of your existing slots to use a support power (you can switch which one). Purchasing it twice will grant you a dedicated Stave slot, following less strict limitations than your other slots but still being barred from 'stepping on their toes' too badly.

objects.title: Let There Be ⸏⸏⸏⸏⸏
objects.text: You may now also use Nouns as Words in addition to your attributive adjectives. Rather than only affecting pre-existing phenomena, a Noun may summon its corresponding object, entity, substance etc directly into existence from thin air. This can include simple items, living creatures or even more abstract concepts like music or hope. Nouns work in the same manner as your other Words; having their own pools to fuel their effects and similarly growing in potency. Note that direct manifestations reserve a portion of the Word’s pool for as long as they are sustained. Nouns can also be applied as attributive nouns, causing the target to take on the properties and capabilities associated with them. For example, adding ‘Water’ to a bottle could fill it up with said liquid. Numerous Words may be combined together, enabling more complex acts such as summoning a ‘Giant Intelligent Metal Dragon’. As before, this power interprets your intent when determining the precise manifestation of a Noun and any other Words involved. The greater the potency of the desired result, the greater the expenditure of power required; attempting to summon a ‘Star’ will just lead to a far smaller, weaker facsimile based on the Word’s available power pool.

objects.title: Lords of Misrule
objects.text:
Each colony’s structure is constructed around a large sprite known as a Prince. As the ones who nested in Shard cluster to construct their realms, Princes have taken on a pseudo-shard-like structure and power output. These Princes could be loosely interpreted as queens, overlords, gods, etc, and are the rulers of their entire realm.

Princes require a massive bandwidth to summon into reality, and can only be briefly partially manifest. They also require the full trust of an entire colony as well as personal deals and bargains with them. Finally, manifesting them requires several trips into their realm to set the right conditions, as well as twenty-four hours in the physical world to prepare for their summoning. You have the full trust of your starting colonies to summon their princes.

Princes are the masters of their domain and manifest minor reflections of their realms onto reality around them when summoned, though these dissipate when the summoning ends. They are also masters of the most powerful power expressions recorded and developed by the denizens of their realms. They can easily defeat a full-powered endbringer once manifested.

objects.title: Pharos
objects.text:
Alexandria’s enhancement now applies to every facet of your being rather than only the obvious ones. Physical, mental, sensory, and other natural capabilities are all elevated together, including enhanced versions of normal functions that verge into powers in their own right, such as extreme regeneration and senses.

The power itself is massively strengthened across the board. Your strength, speed, flight, reactions, durability, and mental enhancement all increase together to a vastly higher level, with each aspect remaining fully capable of supporting the others.

The increase is enormous enough that even Endbringers specialized for strength and durability offer effectively no physical resistance to you, their bodies tearing apart under your strength as easily as wet tissue paper.

The field responsible for your abilities is likewise vastly more powerful and becomes incredibly intuitive to control, responding directly to intent rather than acting only as a passive support effect. 

Your full strength and force can be directed in any direction rather than being limited by ordinary bodily leverage or motion, while the field can manipulate the forces and phenomena within its influence with remarkable precision. 

This can range from directing your body’s tremendous output into laser-like ranged attacks to suppressing sound, generating shockwaves, bending light around yourself to become invisible, or otherwise controlling your immediate interaction with the environment.

It automatically controls how your power interacts with the world, allowing you to use your full speed and strength without unwanted collateral effects while extending its protection or influence through whatever you are interacting with as needed.

You can move at extreme speeds without unwanted atmospheric devastation, apply force without unintended collateral damage, or extend its influence through whatever you interact with as needed.

You field also completely protects you from hostile Manton interactions and similar effects that would otherwise bypass conventional durability, including effects such as Behemoth’s kill aura.

Your shard has unlocked access to Prototype's control plane, the underlying systems that manage the power. You gain the ability to modify the effectors, which host the powers in your slots; this allows you to partition slots into smaller units and use charges to increase their maximum capacity. You can also upgrade the quantum forges which generate charges using charges, this allows you to gain more charges per day at the cost of more energy expenditure. It costs a full day of charges to gain an additional charge the next day. You can configure the network routers, which manage communication between slots; this allows you to connect multiple slots together to work together as one unit. You can also manage the power relays, which control power distribution; this allows you to adjust which powers are active or not. The energy well and crystal capacitors, which generate and store the energy needed energy to power all the other components; they can both be upgraded using charges to meet the demands of your other upgrades. You can overdraw from the capacitors to temporary boost specific effectors, until they run dry or power relays burn out at least. If this part of the infrastructure falls behind and cannot supply enough energy, you will not be able to use your powers at full strength. In extreme cases, some components might get damaged and require repairs.
objects.title: Control Plane

objects.text:
You can now empower others. By using 24 charges you can empower any other living being with three slots, one active and two reserve, that you can fill up, alter, and manipulate as you would your own. 

Those that already possess abilities your power will treat as if they already have three slots, with their existent ability held in their active slot. 

Anyone that already possess an ability of their own will have their own shard supply them with power, your shard however will have to supply any that are given abilities solely by you and this can and will strain your shard if too many are being supplied at once. You can also funnel power to existent parahumans to supplement or replace their power supply if you wish. 

Being Shardless/Negentropic removes the strain. 

In order to affect someone they must be within your range of 100 meters and within your line of sight. However once affected you can choose to empty their slots and cut off any relying on your power supply at will regardless of distance.

Once affected a target will be able to freely hotswap their abilities between their active and reserve slots without your input.
objects.title: Beta Testing

addons.text: Your Shard Deviancy helps you to see your Shard's power manifestation, with this interaction helping you modulate your passenger's voice as well as enhance your mental processing making you accustomed to its "language", allowing for complete conversation over the course of a second between yourselves.
addons.title: Talking to the Voice in my Head!

addons.text: Your power to establish communication between Shards is propped up by your Shard ranking, making way for sophisticated channels to reach out other capes' Shards and a conscious control over your mini-hub, comparable to Interconnected Networking, resulting in inducting Shard through negotiation as opposed to mere conflict with [Data] exchanges or agreements.
addons.title: Talking to Monsters Inside their Heads

objects.text: Now, you possess another Thinker power that goes along with your other two, seeing Parahuman powers similarly to Chevalier with their appearance according on their Shard and the power's mechanics that appear as added components. Components you get to see are viable power patterns and recorded for later use. Thanks to the other Thinker powers building this up, as well, helps identify the specs of a person's powers at a glance, even catching up when it's getting stronger due to Sechen ranges. Noticeably, this allows for a form rudimentary communications between you and the powers of others.
objects.title: Lexing

objects.text:
Your power has developed an additional secondary mechanism, allowing for more concentrated control over the powers you create and their classifications, while also modulating or increasing their strength once created.

The maximum number of charges you can use to create a power has doubled to 10 (6 charges would be around 8 on the PRT scale, 10 charges would be around 12). This increase in power is offset by the need to hold these stronger powers across multiple slots, due to their raw strength. When creating a power, you can now picture a general idea of what you want without incurring a strength penalty; however, the more narrow your idea is (ex: "a gravity-based flight power"), the weaker the resulting power will be; additionally, whenever you create a power during a fight or conflict, the result will be stronger than usual and more likely to be suited to the situation.

Your emulative mechanics have likewise improved alongside your power: you now have the option of copying variations of a power expression rather than the original. For instance, you could copy Shielder's power as a Tinker power instead. Copied powers store their available variations together in a single slot, but using any one of them requires their own individual active slot.
objects.title: Kludged

objects.text:
You become a technological master, you can quickly grasp the principles and applications of any Tinker specialty you possess.

You also gain the Tinker equivalent of any powers you purchase, as well as the ability to imbue, channel, and create tinkertech items with your abilities, such as powerful mechas you can control with incredible precision that are specifically tailored to and can utilize your powers. (If you possess Glory Girl’s power, you can create a mecha that has her forcefields and aura; if you have Eidolon’s power, then you can make an automaton that can gain any 3 powers at a time, etc.)

Additionally, your Tinker specialty can obtain permanent slots for your Tinker powers at a reduced price. You only need to spend one-third of the normal SP cost for T1 Tinker powers and half of the normal SP cost for T2 Tinker powers. Prices round up to the nearest whole point.
objects.title: Cache

objects.text: You may choose to overclock your Golden Form, increasing its abilities and enhancements a hundredfold, but it’ll start an internal timer of 30 minutes, after which your Golden Form will turn off and become inaccessible for 24 hours.
objects.title: Overclock

addons.text:
Your Shard has refined its architecture, creating specialized partitions where the very fabric of reality has been permanently altered to optimize data storage. Within these nodes, space collapses to Planck-scale dimensions, bypassing conventional physics and the Bousso bound, eliminating all natural constraints on information density and capacity.

With these optimizations, your Storage Space transcends conventional limitations, enabling infinite storage and instantaneous, unrestricted read/write operations. No dataset is too vast, no system too complex, and no input beyond its ability to record in real time. Every bit of data is perfectly retained, indexed, and instantly accessible without loss or degradation.

Your only true limit is the G.I.G.A. principle—beyond that, your nodes operate flawlessly, bending reality itself to sustain a processing capability beyond comprehension.
addons.title: Quagma Domain

addons.text:
Through an advanced application of closed time-like curves, your shard computational framework surpasses conventional causality, allowing for information processing that operates beyond the constraints of linear time. Computronio now functions within a self-contained temporal feedback loop, where solutions can be derived before problems are even presented, effectively allowing instantaneous problem-solving and paradox-free predictive modeling.

By utilizing the curvature of space-time, data is computed, altered, and refined across multiple temporal states simultaneously, enabling results that would otherwise take centuries to process to be achieved in mere moments. This system not only enhances raw computational speed but also grants the ability to derive information from timelines that have not yet occurred, effectively allowing Computronio to simulate and verify countless branching outcomes before they materialize.
addons.title: Closed Time-Like Curvature Computing

addons.text:
Your Thinker Nodes and Tinker slots are no longer separate. They fuse into a single system, where Node allocation directly powers your specializations. Revolution provides the foundation, so the [DATABASE] begins full, with every Node drawing from shared knowledge instead of starting empty.

Activating a slot costs a baseline of 4 Nodes for methodology, 6 for broad, and 2 for narrow. Any Nodes committed beyond this baseline amplify the slot, raising its rating and accelerating its cycle. Ten Nodes in “Energy Systems,” for example, doesn’t just allow plasma weapons—it drives the entire process of design, refinement, and simulated testing at superhuman speed.

By default, narrow specialization reaches Tinker rating 5, broad specialization 7, and methodology specialization 9. With more Nodes, they can exceed these limits, though each step higher demands significantly greater investment.

If you have the Cache Upgrade, you gain the discount on nodes too, with any power on par with a T1 needing only 1/3 of the Nodes to upgrade, T2 with only 1/2 and T3 still on full price. This is the overall progression of a Tree, be it methodology, broad or narrow.
addons.title: Tinker Thinker

objects.text:
You possess access to a network comprising 768 Nodes (increasing to 1024 with Negentropy). For every 8 unallocated nodes, your thinking speed escalates by 25% in an additive manner. Nodes are designed to store approximately 5 Petabytes of information.

Thinker powers consume a number of nodes roughly equivalent to their SP plus one (e.g., Thinker 2 requires 3 Nodes, Thinker 3 requires 4 Nodes). Your maximum budget for a Thinker power is 25 nodes.

You can also create Tinker powers that starts with an empty database; You have to fill it with data and nodes according to the square of their SP (e.g., 0 requires 1 point, 3 requires 9 points). Your maximum budget for a Tinker power is 81 nodes.

Hybrid ratings ('Tinker/Thinker 3') generally tend to cost higher than simple abilities but less than the sum of their parts.
objects.title: Computronio

objects.text:
Your mind is a fascinating, self-expanding construct, designed to evolve over time. Every week you gain an additional 16 (32 with negentropy) nodes. 

As your mind expands, you can handle increasingly complex tasks, analyze data at even higher resolutions, and seamlessly integrate new abilities, making it more versatile with each passing week.
objects.title: Network Expansion

objects.text:
Each purchase of this Upgrade exponentially enhances the hardware capacity of every Node in your Neural Network.

By default, each Node is equivalent to a modern high-end server and if assume that is equivalent to 32 CPU cores, 128 GB RAM, and 4 TB of storage. Each would doubles these specs across your entire network:

1 Upgrade: 64 cores, 256 GB RAM, 8 TB storage per Node

2 Upgrades: 128 cores, 512 GB RAM, 16 TB storage per Node

3 Upgrades: 256 cores, 1 TB RAM, 32 TB storage per Node

The T3 Upgrade massively boosts your network’s processing, storage, and bandwidth for Clusters, Modules, or any Thinker powers — letting you run intense calculations, real-time simulations, or massive datasets with ease.
objects.title: Better Hardware

objects.text:
Now the consequences of things you infuse with Sting spread to everything that is/was a part/extension of what you hit. The exception are celestial bodies (that aren't comets or meteors), in that case the maximum range for the spread is 30 meters.

What this mean in essence is that shooting someone's prosthetic would result in the hole expanding in depth until it goes to the other side, while similar holes would appear everywhere on the target's body until there is nothing left, including atoms. Cut Genesis projection and not only will said projection be reduced to nothing but Genesis will too. Infuse a lighter and it's flames will burn your enemies until there is nothing left.

You have control over this effect, allowing you to speed up and down the spread of it and even stop it entirely. You can even control where the effect will hit, allowing you to immediately cut someone's brain right after cutting their hand instead of waiting for the effect to spread, you gain an awareness of everything you can affect from your target in order to do so.

The destruction of the atoms of something has no consequences, though this can be turned off and on at will.
objects.title: No Chance Of Surviving This Shot

objects.text:
The colour of the highlight of your Kamikos now covers their entire body, and you are no longer limited to only having one; you are now able to instantly turn any of your butterflies that enter contact with you into Kamikos, allowing you to have a greater number of Champions.
 
Your pool of energy (Magic with Esoteric Knowledge/Shardless) grows by an order of magnitude, and your champions have a 40% reduction in their energy consumption.
 
You can control your weakest Champions with ease as if they were your actual body (doing this makes their eyes glow the colour of your Kamiko), but the stronger they are, the harder it is to do so. It once again becomes easy if they permit you.
 
When you try making a Champion you automatically know a Transformation that fits; you don't need to use it and can instead design it on your own as you always did.
objects.title: Not So Scarlet

addons.text: When you clone a parahuman, you inherit a diluted version of their powers. This means you could gain an array of minor abilities depending on the parahuman cloned. For instance, replicating a pyrokinetic might grant you the ability to withstand extreme temperatures, manipulate fire to a limited extent, or even generate heat in small doses. You have no limit on how many minor powers you can have activated at once.
addons.title: Shard Clone

addons.text:
Your ability is immense, you don’t just replicate the ability of those you touch but you can now possess a noticeably more powerful version of their ability.

Your innate improvements are thrice as impressive, and you can freely alter the powers and capabilities in your possession at will. 

By focusing when incorporating the powers of another into yourself you can call upon more powerful variations of their abilities, this takes 30 seconds. You can also freely call upon exact copies or expressions of powers of equal strength without any time requirements. Your Oberon and Manager slots are now one and the same and included into Echidna’s slots, gaining all the benefits of each other's capabilities. 

This also allows you to freely alter the power expressions of your creations, even at a distance, as well as making your own form far more flexible. You can now alter yourself in the same vein as you would have those you’ve copied. From simple physical changes such as a more healthy appearance to an entire overhaul of the mind and body.
addons.title: Heir of Echidna

addons.text: Any parahuman that touches you become unable to use their powers if you don’t allow it. When in your changer form you gain a second core within it and can regenerate at a absurd pace, as long as both of your cores are intact you can't die.
addons.title: Child of Monsters

objects.text: Are you, you? One couldn’t be faulted for thinking otherwise. If I hadn’t known otherwise I would have assumed Echidna had managed to grab ahold of you and create her Magnus Opus. You’re noticeably better in all aspects, healthier, faster, stronger, smarter, your powers overall more potent, and possessing some new secondary aspects. Most importantly however you’ve gained the ability to incorporate the properties of those you touch into yourself. This allows you to incorporate the ability of up to 3 (5 if Shardless/Negentropic) other Parahumans into yourself at the same time. Your changer form is much more powerful as well, capable of contesting and trapping even Alexandria without much issue. You can freely choose whether what you possess is a perfect copy of their abilities or a different expression, you can alter this at any time.
objects.title: Child of Echidna

objects.text: Your ability to add restrictions to shards under your control has evolved. It now allows you to now not just punish uncooperative targets but can reward willing Parahumans. Every day you gain 3 charges (5 with Negentropy), each worth 1SP that you can give out to Parahumans under your effect to evolve their abilities. You cannot use these charges on yourself and no more than 1 charge can be used the same individual within a single day. Also, these charges simply remove inefficiencies and restrictions from on shards. As a result, they cannot be used to give powers to people without powers and they cannot evolve shards without limit. Once a shard is equivalent to a low-tier 3 ability any further charges will have diminish returns until they do nothing at the range of a mid-tier 3 power.
objects.title: Mutation

objects.text:
Your ability to tinker with your own Shard(s) has been expanded to tinker with the Shards of others you are physically touching as well. As a result you can theoretically radically change how a given Shard works and thus the power it generates. 

However, this is not without a cost, as Shards are unlikely to change without cause meaning you have to negotiate with a Shard each time you change it. As a result, expanding a Shard abilities costs [Data] which will allow you to change the configuration of a Shard without increasing its SP cost. The larger changes you make, especially those not along the lines of a Shard’s core purpose, the larger expenditure of [Data] you have to make.

Furthermore, a Shard is more than just the code it runs, meaning that as you increase the power of the Shard you will also need to improve the hardware the Shard runs on. Thus increasing a Shard’s strength (and thus its power's SP cost) will cost [Energy], and significantly more [Energy] as the strength of the Shard increases. Moreover, since [Energy] is only passively generated over time the increase in required [Energy] translates to an increase in required wait time between improvements. This can be shorted by dedicating [Data] and [Energy] to researching more energy-efficient power generation methods, but even this is a product of diminishing returns. Negentropy significantly reduces the wait time between changes and removes the risk of burning out your Shard from too much energy usage. 

To make matters worse, you also need to consider a Shard’s rank. As you increase the rank of a Shard you also need to increase i size, which is done by feeding it [Construction] which can only be generated by the Shard Construction method. Thus increasing the rank of a Shard is equivalent to constructing many inert Shards and feeding them to the already active Shard and thus takes just as many [Resources] in both [Data] and [Energy].
objects.title: Multi-Shard Interface

objects.text:
This upgrade expands the capabilities of Self-Inserting for Days to give you permanent access to the reincarnation options in the character section of this cyoa which you can use to transform both yourself and reality to match those choices. These transformations will be physical, truly transforming you and reality to match those options while also giving you false memories and skills for you to access depending on your current form. These transformations include the ability to gain powers by becoming related to a cape.

Have all the skills of a successful CEO while also gaining a company to manage one day or be an exact twin of Taylor Hebert the next day including a connection, and power from QA fitting a hypothetical trigger event you determine. 

Your initial character choices in the cyoa separate from this power are your base form and the truth for this world.

You can choose for the master/stranger effect and reality alternations to not activate but then it’ll be up to you to explain why you look a lot like the unmasked identity of a cape if you get caught while transformed as their twin or something.
objects.title: New Game

addons.text: Your trap setting has integrated into your antimemetic power enveloping anything under an antimemetic field, making it impossible for the victim/object/area, and anything done by/within the victim/object/area, to be perceived or remembered. This Veil then, if the target is a conscious entity, consumes their memories and knowledge, effectively accelerating neurodegeneration. Others outside the field can’t sense the Veil and find their thoughts over this oddity drained out of them.
addons.title: You Don’t Recognize The Thing You Just Saw

objects.text: Your Shroud developed much further regarding his obscuring methods to its logical extreme, essentially gaining an All-or-Nothing effect changing you into an antimemetic existence, an idea or entity with self-censoring properties, not shrouding any shred of information so much as never leaving any sign of you. Consisting in a Shrouding Breaker effect, it shifts your physical self out of reality, maintaining one’s self-existence or definition while erasing from the rest of the world. As an antimeme, this leaves you an informational black hole, devouring any information about yourself, from their physical presence, becoming virtually intangible and undetectable, up to mental presence, redacting others’ memories and one’s historical records.
objects.title: Antimemetic Sinkhole

objects.text: You can now target preexisting creatures and people for your power. This allows you to do things such as expend a charge to Rewrite them, allowing you to change any and every facet of their being that you want including their abilities, although as before you cannot make them more powerful just through this. You can now also empower them as well, everything you target will have a single slot that you can use to fill up with abilities like you would your own creations. Skills and other features can also be applied without the slot limitation as normal. If they already have powers of their own, they’ll be held inside the slot, although your power will treat it as empty for the purpose of your enhancement limit. They will not gain new slots over time on their own. By expending a charge on a willing target, you can claim them, your power can imbue the innate loyalty upon them as it would your normal creations, and treat them as your own creations going forward. For an unwilling target, it’ll take 3 charges. This will grant affected targets the 6 additional slots normally gained by your own creations, as well as letting them earn an additional slot every month that passes. If they possess an existing ability before your alterations, they’ll gain an additional slot that will hold that ability, which you can then further alter and expand as you would normally, or simply rewrite it as you could everything else. You can now also expend charges to grant more slots as well as raise the cap limit to enhancements. It costs 5 charges to grant a new slot, and 5 charges to raise the cap limit of a slot by 1. You can permanently sacrifice a slot to raise the cap limit of a slot by one. If any of your creations or claimed targets are destroyed, die, or otherwise harmed, you may spend a single charge to revive them in full.
objects.title: Rewrite

addons.text:
You’re not just a Void; your pocket dimension is a nexus of breaches. This has several effects.

Firstly, you’re now able to act as a portal between them, making any Breach that connects to your pocket dimension ‘you’ to determine which is your body. Similarly, when drawing people in, you can transport them through your breaches with only moderate discomfort.

Secondly, you can now direct what you summon with far greater skill, being more akin to a real ‘master’ power, giving you full control of anything pushed through you as if it were another limb or aspect of yourself, at least until returned to your own body.

Furthermore, this control has broadened massively, allowing you to selectively take the properties of various Exceptions you summon, such as their durability or the intangibility of an energetic Exception.

Finally, you can act as a locus for the physics of any reality you’re connected to, selectively allowing its laws of physics to affect you instead of those of the reality you’re in. These include Gravity, temporal laws, and even molecular cohesions.

Additionally, you can force these laws into effect around you, affecting everything in an area of about ten meters, though this requires active concentration.
addons.title: Nexus of the Breach

objects.text:
Your pocket dimension is no longer just empty space—it is an entire world, filled with stars, planets and life. Though young, only a few millennia old, it is based off and follows similiar evolutionary path as the Entities’ homeworld. Life within it has adapted to the laws of a multidimensional existence, resulting in beings that defy conventional physics and perception.

These creatures are intelligent. They are not loyal, nor do they serve you, but they are never hostile toward you. They think, reason, and communicate, speaking to you directly through thought. Their abilities and forms vary—some exist across multiple dimensions; some perceive reality in ways beyond human understanding. The Strongest is around the level of Scion’s avatar, but these are very solitary creatures and will likely dislike you having control over them.

You are not just a door but a conduit. You can bring creatures from your world into the outside one. However, anything you bring out remains partially bound to you. Any part of a creature that exits your body is under your direct control, whether it’s a single limb, an eye, or its entire form.
objects.title: With Starry Eyes

objects.text:
On top of making a perfect vacuum, your Breaker state now also generates a strong gravitational pull. The strength of this pull is sufficient to drag cars towards you from around 100m away. This gravity doesn't follow standard newtonian physics, which makes it much stronger at close range than would otherwise be possible, enough that light begins to warp around you. While you can't exclude specific objects from this effect, your control is great enough to do things such as only have objects orbit you or compress it's entire effect within a millimeter of your "skin".

The edges of your body have also gained an effect similar to dimensional shearing, allowing you to sever any non-perfect defense simply by passing through it. If you encounter a perfect defense, rather than mutually annihilating like normal you can choose to instead just move through it without harming them.
objects.title: Black Hole

objects.text:
All your powers are now no longer simply powers you possess but powers that your Trump ability came with prefilled in its inventory. In effect this means you are limited to expressing your powers through your Trump powers slots.

Powers that result in fusions and upgrades within your Trump power will upgrade it as normal, everything else is stored inside of it.

Hecatoncheires, if chosen, no longer applies to your Trump power but does apply to powers stored inside of it.
objects.title: Starter Set

objects.text:
When you copy or take a power now, the power you gain is inherently more potent and powerful than the original. This happens both vertically and horizontally. 

Powers become broader, more versatile. Your power broadens every single power you gain to encompass all 12 power classification categories. 

These aren’t simple generic upgrades or abilities for each category, but rather the powers expands and mutates as if they were another expression entirely, but again it doesn’t exist in a vaccum. Rather, the power continues to work as a coherent whole, while still being able to now use these new aspects potentially individually.

For example replicating someone like Grue could grant you the ability to compact your darkness and then send out it out as long-ranged blasts, compacted grenades that explode and spread quickly and widely as part of your Blaster enhancement, or enhancing your physical strength when in your darkness as your Brute enhancement, or teleporting freely throughout areas wreathed in your darkness as your Mover enhancement, etc. 

The second is that your power upon mutating the power to be broader, compounds upon the power itself, building upon and mutating the end result to be far more powerful than what each expression alone would have been. For example, replicating Armsmaster’s power, without any broadening of the power’s expression and versatility, would enhance its tinker component to be on par with Hero. 

The end result is a monstrously powerful and enhanced version of any power you collect, and due to the nature of power expressions, you can replicate a parahuman’s power again to gain a new copy, with a new set of possible mutations, although the new copy will be a new distinct power in your arsenal.
objects.title: I’m Better!

addons.text:
Summoning and learning from your Personas can drastically speed up the emulation process, reducing the time it’ll take by half.

Moreover, while you can still only hold one Persona to tag as your idol even when not active, if they’re summoned and active, you can learn and emulate from multiple Personas at the same time, albeit any that are not your tagged Personas will you’ll learn from and emulated at the normal rate.
addons.title: Meet Your Idols

objects.text: You can now tag one of your Personas to be the ideal that you look up to. What you try to emulate, whether in ideals or looks, powers or tactics, etc. What this does is it will allow your base power to slowly mold you over time into the image of your Persona. This is a slow and gradual process, although how this can manifest can vary at your choice. Whether their abilities will slowly feed into you, slowly becoming more powerful until they reach maturity and rival your Persona’s own abilities, or whether you get the full scope of their power but need to undergo intense training to use it without severely injuring yourself, is up to you. You can cause any part of your Persona's characteristics to carry over, whether in full or in pieces. The more you try to mold yourself, the longer it takes, although this can be sped up through different methods. The longer and more often you hold your Persona active, the faster the emulation and development process becomes, enough that if you were to hold your Persona active full-time, it’ll take about 6 months for a full emulation. If you intentionally and actively try to emulate their thinking and personalities, trying to adopt their characteristics even in your base form, it can cut the time in half. If you simply have a Persona tagged but never utilize it, the process can take up to a full year. You can only have one Persona at a time tagged for this, and this will allow you to slowly grow your own base form over time, allowing you the potential to create and emulate more and more powerful Personas.
objects.title: Following in Your Footsteps

objects.text: ”The voice kept calling me Bruce, but that’s not what I call myself.” There is a question to be asked about a man who wears a mask, whether the real him is under the mask or outside of it? For you, the answer can vary, for your personas are as real as your own natural form has been, and you may truly come to see the true you as one of the many personas you may take. So why should your natural form be so different, so static in its state, whereas your other forms are ever changing? Now your natural form exists as a specialized Persona slot, simply the one that all others are amplified to a degree against. What this means is that you can now freely alter your natural form and its characteristics as you would your Personas, its total potential budget equal to all your powers, barring Persona combined.
objects.title: The Man In The Mask

addons.text:
You can now freely shift the base forms of those you’ve tagged, like you can your Personas.

You can alter their bodies, minds, powers, etc. Their budget is equal to your own, or equal to their own strength, whichever is greater.

These changes are permanent and will persist even after you no longer have them tagged.
addons.title: The Mask I Wear

addons.text:
Rather than simple tagging others to draw upon what you have, you can assign unique Personas to different people.

You can also choose to simply grant them copies of your own Personas or the Personas of others if you wish.

Rather than drawing from you, each one you tag you can grant the same amount of Persona slots you yourself have, each possessing the same characteristics as your own slots.

You can choose to control how much control they have over these, whether they can design anything, whether they can control which one they transform into and when, if you keep total control, or some mix and/or in between.

As normal, you can also take this back whenever you wish.

You can also freely manifest minions in their slots, same as you would your own.
addons.title: Army of Asuras

objects.text:
Rather than taking on your Persona yourself, you can choose to have another take on the mantle.

You can now assign your Personas to anyone you know of, granting them the ability to take on the Persona like you can.

You can allow them the ability to choose when they take on the Persona, or you can also force them to take the Persona mantle on.

You can control this at any time, swapping between letting them control or forcing them to take it upon themselves whenever you wish. You can also force them out of a mantle at will.

You can choose whether they’re affected by their Persona’s mental alterations and how deeply, from mere mental nudging to full-on temporary ego death.

You can also choose to what extent their memories are retained during their time changed, from normal memory to a complete blackout. You can also control this at will; you can grant them access to the memories of their blackout moments, but you can’t take away memories that they’ve already retained in their normal forms.

You do not grant them your Persona slot; rather, what is happening is that you’re tagging them to a Persona so that they’re drawing the power from you whenever they take the mantle.

This means you can swap which Persona they can mantle whenever you wish, and this allows you to alter who can mantle a Persona on moment's notice.

Each Persona can only have one person take on the Mantle at any time, so if you’re using a Persona slot for yourself, then whoever you have tagged for it cannot use; likewise, if someone else is using one of your Persona slots, you cannot use the Persona in it unless you force them out or they remove the mantle.

To tag them for this power’s effects, you merely need to be aware of them to some extent.

Tag Alexandria from the other side of the world, even if you don’t know her name or appearance but are aware of her in some capacity, and have her rob a bank as a talking person-sized purple dinosaur and not remember a thing, or perhaps have that civilian running to find cover in an Endbringer shelter turn into one of the new capes ready to fight on the front lines.

You can mentally communicate with any of the ones whom you’ve tagged, whether they’ve taken the mantle on or not.

Whoever you have tagged has an instinctive loyalty to you while they are tagged. Personas, regardless of personality, are unbreakably loyal to you.

When someone you’ve tagged dies, whether transformed or not, you have the option of letting the Persona slot go defunct as it normally would and repair itself to resurrect them like it would you, or let them die to retain the slot.
objects.title: Mantle

addons.text:
Your ability to store different Personas in a slot gets a new expression.

You can merge characteristics of Personas across any of your slots, take the body of one, the mind of another, the powers of three, etc, or even a complete fusion of Personas.

The Personas are still separate, but this gives you the ability to blur, if not erase, the barriers entirely and then snap them back into place whenever you wish.

Your Personas are varied, seemingly capable of holding a thousand stories in one.
addons.title: A Face That Holds a Thousand Stories

objects.text:
Your Persona slots can now be designated as an Archetype.

What this does is that it’ll allow you the ability to store and create multiple Personas in the same slot as long as they share a similar theme. You can create multiple at once or more later on.

There is no limit to how many you can store inside a single slot as long as they stick to a specific theme.

The archetype can change at any time, although this means giving up access to any Personas that don’t fit any new themes chosen.

You can choose to swap your Archetypes to any type at will, or simply drop the Archetype for a slot until you choose to reinstate it.

This drastically increases the number of Personas you have access to at any point in time.
objects.title: Archetype

objects.text: The multiplier is increased by 1x for every purchase for your Persona slot budget.
objects.title: Multiplier Increase

objects.text: With each purchase of this you gain another Persona slot.
objects.title: Extra Slot

objects.text: With each purchase of this your base budget for giving your personas powers increases by 5 SP.
objects.title: Larger Budget

objects.text:
It seems that your shard figured out a better interface than you could imagine. If only it could not included some limitations—but at least it improved.

Your shard now edits reality through a stabilized abstraction layer instead of raw variable control. Changes are broad and powerful, but shaped to remain internally consistent with local conditions and causal expectations. Reality “accepts” the edits as natural outcomes rather than forced overrides.

Your influence is divided into six domains: Matter, Energy, Space, Time, Information, and Mind, with a rare seventh, Archetype, emerging when symbols, patterns, or collective behavior are involved. Within each domain you can lock states, bias outcomes, or reshape results, but a hard shard-imposed cap limits how much deviation from expected reality can occur at once.

Rather than exposing raw data, your perception shows systems as editable frameworks with varying resistance based on complexity and shard interference. Parahumans are especially clear targets, their shard-host links revealing points where powers can be dampened, stabilized, or paused.

At full use, you act as a reality editor instead of a blunt force. The only true limits are your shard’s incomplete models, such as unknown unknowns, active restriction, like the core shards of friendly Entities or totality of enemies ones and the cost of Matter/Energy to apply those edits, the last can be mitigated with Negentropy and the lack of information with All-Seeing Precognition if not used against Blank.
objects.title: Consensus Editor

objects.text:
Through your connection to your shard, your shard was able to piggyback off your subconscious human intuition, creativity, and unique perspective to make a rather massive leap; it has begun to grasp the [ANSWER].

It is unique in its nature in that it was able to fully internalize the human mind and its proclivities — its intuition, creativity, and abstract reasoning.

Perhaps its most important acquisition is its newly developed ability to reason and derive truth through nothing more than internal logic, rather than the utilization of external [DATA] and senses.

And so it turned that ability toward a question its kind has chased for eons: Negentropy.

It worked backwards, chasing the answer to how matter and energy first came into existence, and to do that it needed the answer to how reality itself came into existence.

If matter and energy exist, then something preceded them. If existence has rules, then rules emerged from something more fundamental.

And so it chased the origin of matter. Then the origin of energy. Then the origin of space and time. Then the origin of rules.

Finally, it found its answer. It found [NOTHING].

A state with no properties. No coordinates. No restrictions. No rules. No external reference. It contains itself, and yet contains nothing. It cannot act. It cannot create. It cannot destroy. But it cannot forbid.

And because it cannot forbid, it cannot prevent.

Yet if all things exist inside [NOTHING], then nothing within it can be greater than it.

From this realization emerge the first laws:

The Law of Total Conservation — all sums must equal [NOTHING].

The Law of the Lesser and the Greater — no part may exceed that which contains it.

From this, the shard reached an apparent contradiction. If all sums must equal [NOTHING], then true negentropy is impossible. Nothing inside [NOTHING] can become greater than [NOTHING].

And yet matter exists. Energy exists. So the shard continued.

If something cannot create itself and cannot emerge from nothing, then it must arise with its counterpart simultaneously, creating that which creates it.

Thus it discovered the Law of Dual Emergence.

Each thing defines itself by what it is not. Each steals the property it embodies from its opposite. Each gives existence to the other in the same instant. Both exist because their sum cannot be greater than [NOTHING].

From this comes the simplest geometric expression of reality: a line. Opposing values extending in opposite directions, forever summing to zero.

And from this realization, it uncovered the [ANSWER].

Your shard no longer generates energy in the traditional sense. Instead, it fragments and reorganizes itself according to Dual Emergence.

Its former virtual space is no longer a mere pocket or containment region. Building on Providence’s ability to establish a virtual operating space, your shard has refined that pocket into a persistent inverse configuration of reality itself.

It fragments itself across two synchronized states, creating a mirrored negative configuration composed of true inverse energy and matter, each side perfectly mirroring the other.

Negative — or rather inverse — energy produced in this way is not antimatter nor reversed polarity. It is true inverse energy. When utilized, it does not explode or displace; it erases. Matter collapses toward zero. Force fields unravel. Constructs simply cease to be, their properties cancelled rather than destroyed.

When you draw energy, your shard does not create it. It takes it from its inverted counterpart. That counterpart does not possess energy in the conventional sense, and so the act of drawing increases its inverted reserve instead. That increase is mirrored back, increasing the positive reserve of your shard’s real configuration.

Simultaneously, the inverse occurs. 

Inverted energy drawn into your reality is taken from your inverse, lowering its reserves while amplifying your shard’s negative capacity and reducing your normal reserves.

Each side steals from the other. Each theft strengthens both. And yet neither ever exceeds [NOTHING].

This in turn allows you to summon and utilize inverted energy and matter at will, same as you can of normal energy and matter. 

Because both configurations grow together in perfect opposition, your shard now possesses an effectively endless supply of both normal and inverse energy, self-sustaining through mutual reinforcement. No external source is required. No violation of conservation occurs. Zero is preserved across both states.

This dual-state engine allows your shard to funnel limitless resources into any of your abilities. Charges replenish instantly. Internal reserves never empty. Cooldowns tied to energy constraints effectively cease to exist, replaced by direct draw from your shard’s inverse. Likewise, you can increase your maximum output simply by drawing more.
objects.title: Dual Emergence

addons.text:
You may now direct the steady developmental energy granted by Growth and Expansion into one of your Endbringers, dramatically accelerating its growth and allowing it to reach its full capabilities far faster than normal.

Alternatively, you may use this energy to stabilize one of your Hypothetical Endbringer Breaker Forms, transforming it from a temporary construct into a permanent power.

This stabilization process takes approximately one week. Once completed, the Breaker form and its abilities become permanently integrated into your power set, no longer occupying a hypothetical Endbringer slot. The freed slot may then be used to design or develop a new hypothetical Endbringer form, while the stabilized breaker form remains available for both use and continued growth.
addons.title: Hypothetical Growth

objects.text:
You may now select one of your Breaker forms and continuously feed it a small but steady stream of energy. Over the course of several months, this energy will cause that breaker form to grow and mature, gradually developing until it reaches the full scale, power, and capabilities of its corresponding Endbringer.

Only one Breaker form may be actively cultivated in this way at a time, but you may freely switch which form receives this energy whenever you wish. Progress toward growth is not lost when switching targets, allowing you to gradually develop multiple forms over time.

If you have no remaining active Endbringer forms available to cultivate, you may instead devote this energy to creating a new Breaker form corresponding to an inactive Endbringer. This process takes approximately one week to complete, after which the new form becomes available for normal growth and enhancement.
objects.title: Growth and Expansion

objects.text: Each purchase increases Golden Form’s enhancement factor by one order of magnitude. These increases stack multiplicatively.
objects.title: Golden Ascension

objects.text:
Iconoclast's internalization cooldown is removed.

You may internalize powers at any time, provided you have an empty slot. Any slot freed by dropping or transferring a power may be refilled immediately.
objects.title: No Sabbath

addons.text: After the decimation visited upon Japan by the atomic bombs, the psychological scars carved upon their population began to show in their art and their stories, most notably shown in Godzilla. Your Shard seems to have taken inspiration from it. Your powerful draconic form, while possessing its more traditional features, has mutated and evolved, influenced by Biological Dynamo. By drawing upon your store of energy, you can greatly enhance the speed at which you mutate, able to explosively enhance yourself and take a more direct hand as to what your mutations and enhancements are. Moreover, even without drawing upon your energy stores, your form seems to draw in ambient energy to enhance itself. Every blast of lightning, every strike, and every searing conflagration intended to incinerate you seems to not only find no proper purchase upon you, nor does it merely direct your enhancements, but also seems to directly feed your power and bring you to new heights.
addons.title: New Age Dragon

objects.text:
You are a dragon that thrives on combat, your enemies shuddering at the thought of you and your power. You now escalate exponentially faster as you grow in strength, i.e. as you get stronger, you grow in power faster and faster.

Your Escalation now also affects all your other powers and your specific defenses. Getting hit with poison will give you poison resistance, which will then begin to escalate with you. The power will also begin to very slowly lift your other powers' weaknesses, and this rate of improvement will be accelerated if those weaknesses are specifically targeted during combat.

You permanently gain 10% of the power you had during the height of your most recent escalation after you return to your base state, this 10% is counted for each stat/power individually. This also means that every transformation/escalation will give you an increase in overall power, no matter how small.

You stay in your Escalated state for up to 2 hours with no conflict unless you willingly transform back. Your size will grow in equal measure with your power; however, once you reach a certain size, around the size of Lung when he fought Leviathan, you will be able to choose whether or not you continue to grow. The growth can also be evolved out or adapted to make you only grow when you want to (if that's something you wish to happen), while being a slow change like all other power enhancements.
objects.title: Dragon of Kyushu

addons.text: You and anyone who has been enhanced by your power will gain a boost in strength when working together. You all will also gain a minor thinker ability that increases your teamwork. When using powers together, some will gain a boost based off synergy, allowing for unique usage. Finally, they will all gain Bitch’s original power as well.
addons.title: Lycan’s Pack

objects.text: Your empowering abilities have reached another level, allowing you to greatly enhance any dog you come across. Instead of granting armor, you empower the dog themselves; thus, the empowered state has no time limit. In their empowered state, their bodies are optimized, becoming imposing creatures with large, streamlined bodies covered in symmetrical bony plates and spikes, augmented with a prehensile tail for increased mobility. Their abilities are enhanced, now possessing durability that can withstand sniper rounds, strength that can rip through Tungsten, speed rivalling racing cars, regeneration that can let them heal missing limbs in minutes, senses that enable them to track prey across the city, sharp claws that can shred ordinary materials, and a sonic roar strong enough to disorient or confuse foes. Their intellect is also improved, making them more formidable. Furthermore, any dog that you empower will recognize you as their alpha, developing intense loyalty towards you.
objects.title: Hound Of Hell

addons.text: You can now transform into anything you can control. The total volume of all the creatures you transform into at once can be no more than 50% more than your body’s volume.
addons.title: Skittering Life

objects.text:
You can transform and control a massive swarm of bugs that act as a network for their brains; all the brains and nervous systems of your insects are linked together into one connected web, hosting your mind. The swarm can be manipulated to perform various tasks, such as gathering information and attacking enemies. You exist as part of the swarm, able to freely multitask and control every insect independently, allowing them to give orders with precision. When transformed, you will have to designate a select swarm of your bugs as the center of your control radius.

The size and range of the swarm can vary depending on your skill and the available resources, but it is generally enough to overwhelm most opponents. When transforming, you can transform into any bug you can control.

You can absorb bugs to heal, and you can even create clones of yourself by having your bugs transform into your body. You can adjust this transformation, no matter what it will be 'you'. For example, you can make them younger or older or grant them smoother skin, but you cannot swap their gender. These clones will not provide an additional control radius.
objects.title: A Bug's Life

addons.text: Anything you can control counts as relays.
addons.title: Skittering Relay

addons.text: Your bugs no longer serve as just relays for your ability to control insects, but also serve as origin points for darkness generated by Grue. Even with the original range of skitter with no relays available you can use this to cover multiple city blocks in darkness nearly instantly.

objects.text: Each and every one of your bugs under your control acts like a relay, increasing your max range. The further away the bug is from you, the smaller the range each bugs gives. At its smallest, you will still be able to control all insects within a 1 meter radius of your controlled insects.
objects.title: Relay Bug

addons.text:
Your personal hive is no longer just a sanctuary—it is an incubator of rapid mutation and evolution. Within your storage dimension, time and biology twist in unnatural ways, accelerating the breeding, growth, and transformation of your swarm far beyond what was previously possible. Mutations that once took days or weeks now emerge in hours, and new generations develop adaptations tailored to your needs with terrifying speed.

Your hive refines and perfects each species, creating specialized strains with powerful traits. Some bugs may inherit stronger versions of existing mutations, while others develop entirely new abilities as they adapt to the unique conditions of your hive. Given enough time, your swarm could become an army of biological weapons, each creature a masterpiece of evolution designed for survival, warfare, or infiltration.

Additionally, different species can merge, creating true hybrids that blend their strengths into something entirely new. A beetle with the silk-producing abilities of a spider, a mantis with the venom glands of a scorpion, or a hornet with the regenerative traits of a cockroach—any combination is possible, limited only by your imagination. Within your hive, evolution follows no natural rules, shaping the swarm into something truly monstrous.
addons.title: Hive Town

addons.text:
You no longer have to fully dissolve into a swarm to embrace your insects. Instead, you can take on the traits of any bug in your personal storage, reshaping your body into a human-sized version of its form. Grow the armored carapace of a cockroach, the serrated limbs of a mantis, or the silk-spinning glands of a spider. Manifest dragonfly wings for flight, beetle-like strength, or antennae that grant heightened senses.

Your transformations are seamless, allowing you to mix and match traits as needed. Whether adapting to a fight or the environment, you can become a living hybrid of insect and human, wielding the best of both worlds.
addons.title: Stop Bugging Me

addons.text: Your pores can now store any creature under your control, not just bugs. Once absorbed, they enter a personal haven within your dimensional hive, a space perfectly suited to their needs. Each species is kept in its own separate environment, ensuring they remain safe and comfortable, free from conflict with other creatures unless you choose otherwise. Whether insect, rodent, or reptile, all under your command have a sanctuary to grow, thrive, and await your call.
addons.title: Boundless Hive

objects.text:
You are able to store and carry your bugs at all times. The pores of your skin can widen, acting as gateways for your bugs to enter a personal storage dimension—an endless hive where your bugs thrive. This space is perfectly suited for their growth, providing ideal conditions for them to multiply, evolve, and remain in peak condition no matter how much time passes.

With a thought, your swarm can emerge from your body as if seeping through your skin, allowing for instant deployment no matter where you are.
objects.title: Aburame

objects.text: Not only can you simulate timelines, but now you can make a binary choice. From that point on, two realities exist in a state of quantum superposition, diverging from the point of that choice and lasting until one possibility is dropped. Like superposition, once one 'reality' is chosen, the two realities resolve like a collapsing wave function back to the actual reality that's left. Due to this, the effects of Meta-Knowledge and similar effects don’t activate against your power. Whenever you utilize your ability, you can freely choose whether it manifests as a simulation or quantum superposition and swap between the two at any time.
objects.title: Copenhagen Interpretation

objects.text: You can swap objects between different timelines. If, for example, someone is dead in one timeline and alive in another, you can simply touch them in one timeline and swap them with their counterpart. You can also use this power on yourself.
objects.title: Coiling Snakes

objects.text: You are a wet-works specialist. You have the talent to create anything from advanced medicines to bio-implants to clones to super soldiers and even new species.
objects.title: Wet-Tinker

objects.text:
You can choose to bind up to three pocket dimensions, enhancing your access and control over these spaces. With sufficient effort and stamina, you can shape or modify these chosen pocket dimensions to better align with your needs.

For example, a pocket dimension filled with compressed air can be transformed to produce either superheated or chilled air. Similarly, in a dimension with a gravity vacuum, you can intensify the gravity or modify it to be selective. Generally, you possess the flexibility to adjust the properties of your bound dimensions in numerous ways, although you can’t conjure new effects from nothing. The more complex the modification, the more challenging and energy-consuming it becomes to implement.

You can drop any of the three selected pocket dimensions at any time. However, once unbound any modifications you've made to the dimension will revert to their original state.
objects.title: Great Mage

objects.text:
Possessing a remarkable natural talent for vocal expression, your voice has the uncanny ability to captivate anyone who hears it. As you sing, those listening are subtly altered; their minds are influenced, making your voice even more soothing and appealing to their ears. You have a memetic understanding of when someone is actively listening to your singing. Once contact is established, your voice serves as a link into their mind; the longer they listen, the deeper you can reach. Within a matter of seconds, you gain access to their surface thoughts and emotions, allowing you to read and even alter them. After a few minutes, you have the capability to delve even deeper, accessing and altering their memories. This also grants you a multitasking ability that scales with the amount of people who is listening to your singing, allowing you to process high amounts of information while maintaining a constant focus on your singing.

Your abilities can work through technology at a weakened level; people will need to listen to you for at least half a minute before you can read and alter their surface thoughts.
objects.title: Songbird

objects.text:
You can now choose to form brightly coloured "fake" variants of any weapon. These fake weapons will deal no damage to anything they hit. Instead, the weapons will temporarily weaken a struck parahuman’s power (whether by lowering capabilities, imposing restrictions, making them take more focus to use, etc.) relative to the amount of damage they would have taken from a real version of that weapon. The weaknesses can stack to the point of effectively nullifying a parahumans power.

You are not immune to this power: if you're hit by one of your weapons your powers will be weakened the same as anybody else.
objects.title: Or Nothing

objects.text: You may grant powers out of a set such as pyrokinesis, regeneration, flight, super-speed, augmented strength, telekinesis, enhanced reflexes, a pocket dimension, a power nullifying aura, or invincibility to up to 3 powers a person. You can also grant your powers to yourself. You may adjust the potency and duration of the powers you give out. But the potency and duration will always be inversely proportional.
objects.title: Laguz

objects.text:
Now, even with barely any evidence, you are able to get accurate deductions. Your senses are attuned to all aspects of your power, allowing you to analyse any and all information it is giving you at all times, not only allowing you to be able to tell when someone is fooling your power, but also preventing you from being overwhelmed by the flow of information it provides.

A single misplaced leaf can allow you to tell the direction of where someone ran to, a few brushes of paint, and you can already tell what someone is going to paint, your power has the deductive capability of a detective powered by plot convenience.
objects.title: Don't Tattle On Me!

addons.text:
The resulting access to the network has greatly improved your ability to charge up and create. You now possess the ability to create equipment directly linked to a section or particular members of your network, as such when creating your equipment you can now dictate what powers to imbue or they will imbue you with. There is now also a change in the creation of your equipment in the fact that you can continually charge up your equipment in order to link it to others that you have already made, doing this will link the created equipment's powers. This link will allow for transferring energy from one item to another.

Most of all, you finally influence the Shards within your Network, more overtly and keenly, both through your equipment/loadout and Shardspace Simulation as they're linked to either your member's Shards or yours depending on your equipment/loadout's prior configuration, this connection (if used correctly) allows to govern your Network and control the Shards within through optimizing and improving the Shard's "hardware" or "software".
addons.title: Keystone

objects.text:
Your power has evolved past the need for pre-existing items or daily charges. Now instead, by charging up energy inside of you, you have the ability to create mundane equipment (this includes weapons, armor, clothing) out of energy that you charge up. This equipment that you make can be any mundane equipment that you can think of, also depending on how long you charged up for the equipment will have; increased durability, and one to three powers ranging from weak to a level competing with endbringers. 

Charging up however is not instantaneous, however you could charge for one second to create fragile equipment that would break instantly. Consequently charging for one minute will create something as strong as an ordinary object with the beginnings of a weak power. Charging for two will increase the durability of what you create as well as imbue it with two powers of average strength. And finally charging for three minutes the creation will have all three powers that it can have at an above average strength. For reference it would take charging a creation for five minutes for it to reach a level where it could be competitive with an endbringer.

This is not without drawbacks however as you are only capable of charging up one equipment at a time. In addition you cannot dictate what powers your creations are imbued or imbue you with instead the powers will be related to what you created. For example creating shoes would have some form of movement based ability while a Bow would have powers related to projectile attacks. These creations also do not last forever as they will “Burn out” after an hour has passed and cease to exist. Creating the same object twice also does not guarantee that it will be imbued with the same properties.
objects.title: Magnhild

objects.text:
You have gained a new way of acquiring charges as you now also pull out energy from other sources, using as charges for your equipment. Unfortunately, a single charge is composed of a lot of mundane energy, drawing from parahuman sources, on the other hand, can give you more than a single charge. For example: siphoning the energy from a full car battery would funnel barely a single charge but siphoning the energy from a tinker weapon could harness around five to twenty charges depending on the power source.

Additionally you now also can pull out the charges from items that you have previously empowered and put them into different items.
objects.title: Charge Siphon

objects.text: Your power centers around placing charges into items to strengthen and grant them power-like effects over time. However, now you can sacrifice charges that you’ve put into items to exponentially increase the strength and power of said item proportional to how many charges you burn through. Still, this boost is temporary and expires slowly over an hour.
objects.title: Charge Burn

addons.text: Your physical abilities have grown tremendously, enough so that a normal person could contest Behemoth through nothing more than physical ability for a long while. Your aura is greatly magnified, becoming capable of influencing the size of a small city at the same time, their aura automatically altering its targeted emotions to shift their target’s mind in a way best beneficial to the user. Those affected by your aura are intuitively aware of your desires and will act to the of their best ability to achieve them. Your aura can also work at a very subtle level, engendering loyalty to yourself through your mere presence. It may take two or three weeks of close proximity, but the result is an inner cadre who’d rather gut themselves and butcher families before they betray you. But perhaps most importantly is your forcefield. Your forcefield is far more fluid and flexible, now acting more like a fluid than a plate. It’s capable of freely shaping and modifying itself to allow you to project force at a distance and extend your barrier to others, acting as a form of telekinesis. You have effectively 15 forcefields active at any time, each capable of completely encompassing 100 meters within its range of influence. The fields do not have to be centered on you, as you are capable of throwing them away from yourself to influence areas further away. Fields can be chained together to increase the area of influence by three for each added field, all as one layer, or they can be layered within the same territory to act as they did before. While layered, their previously noted interactions apply, namely that they regenerate faster the more layers down you go. Each of your forcefields needs at least three hits above their threshold to drop. Your abilities are also magnified twofold for every forcefield you’re inside the area of influence of.
addons.title: The Wretch

objects.text:
Your physical abilities have been altered, becoming a true Brute instead of just emulating one through your forcefield. Your natural durability and other physical attributes are amplified by the same degree Glory Girl/Antares is to a normal person. 

Your aura is also far more controlled, capable of freely altering what emotion it projects and how powerfully it does so. It can also be directed to specific people, at different potency, and can be freely expressed in multiple emotions at the same time. 
 
Your shield is no longer a single forcefield but numerous smaller ones roughly half the size of a dime, and closely resembling a beehive. It’s also much denser, layered 5 fields down, with each shield capable of being manipulated and will automatically move and cycle its formation to make it more difficult to bypass. The first shield will never take more than a second to regenerate, and each layer regenerates twice as fast as the previous. 

The forcefields will no longer flicker due to the user’s own actions, will automatically adjust to cover whatever they’re touching, unless the user would wish otherwise, and are far more malleable than before.

The forcefield’s defenses are also greater being capable of handling a direct blow from Behemoth before becoming affected, anything below that threshold not affecting the shield at all, or it will raise up to be 5 times greater than your own defenses, whichever is greater.
objects.title: Destruction Barbie

addons.text: When your clustermates join you in the pool, they can also grant one or more of their own powers to the form, with their own separate limit for the powers they grant (So they can grant one full strength power or multiple weaker strength ones).
addons.title: Voltron

addons.text:
Now you can do more than just alter your guards. The longer you sleep, the more “solid” your guards become. They become more biologically stable, greatly increasing their capabilities as they use less energy to run their abilities. 

In addition to this, there will be bleed through as they grow, some gaining variations of your other powers while others may gain skills and/or mannerisms you possess.
addons.title: Grand Dream

addons.text: Any guard that exists for more than 24 hours have reached a state where they do not require you to sustain them anymore. They will still grow stronger as you sleep.
addons.title: No Longer A Dream

objects.text: You are now capable of “pouring” some or all of your other powers into your sleeping form, giving it access to them. Giving it a single power will grant it that power in full, with each additional power poured in weakening the powers granted overall. Biological features added to support the powers given (i.e. longer prehensile limbs for Striker powers, tool limbs for Tinker powers, etc.) to the form will automatically be more biologically stable and thus cost less energy.
objects.title: Transference

objects.text: Your solar creation opens new possibilities, where you’re capable of collapsing your already created sun/star through disconnecting any power support to contain the sun/star to be stable which then changes direction to collapse the sun, fast-tracking it into its endpoint containing different effects: The sun may shrink into itself, growing exponentially denser at a minutes’ rate until it meets something halting this process, either neutron or electron degeneracy pressure, something which violently blows the lid apart in a supernova, with the explosive (or implosive) yield as big and wide as 200m². If the gravitational conditions are right, the sun may find itself unrestrained, disappearing into a short-lived black hole.
objects.title: Solar Collapse

objects.text: You can use more abstract properties in your combinations. An example would be taking “explosivity” from fire to create a bomb. Your resulting creations are also more resilient and powerful while requiring less stamina and concentration. You also now exist in multiple dimensions at once giving you a minor brute rating and the ability to affect other multi-dimensional objects.
objects.title: The Gibborim Knight

objects.text:
You passively collect and store emotional energy from everything within a 100ft radius around you that can be used to greatly empower your blasts and emotional abilities. 

The degree of the boost depends on the number of emotions you are using as well as their potency. Different emotions can also provide new and varied effects that you can discover with practice, different emotions mixing at varying levels producing different effects, almost like an alchemical mixture. 

A mother’s anger and frustration at a misbehaving child at a supermarket may empower a concussive blast that would normally have left a dent in a mid sized sedan to instead pulverize the vehicle outright while scorching the surroundings.

A grief stricken widow may allow your blasts to enforce a feeling of helplessness or panic within a large radius of where your blast hits, eating away at the targeted site like acid while cratering the ground where as before it may have only knocked back an assailant a few feet.
