Freshly triggered capes tend to produce a massive amount of potent energy and emotion for your use. 

You can also collect and store the emotional energy of anything hit by blasts, even outside your range, and will actively feed on any emotions produced as a result of your actions. 

While you passively collect and store energy, this effect has no impact on those in range, unless you actively choose to amplify the effect in which case you can choose to rapidly drain the emotions of everything in range inducing an incredibly powerful feeling of apathy, nihilism, and listlessness, eventually people just stop moving and staring into space. 

You can also target this effect at specific people instead of leaving it as blind effect. 

Your thinker ability is also amplified, capable of intuitively understanding the emotions of others and the context of them. 

With minor effort this can be used to accurately interpret their thoughts and actions rather than the heavy guesswork required before. 

Your blasts are also noticeably more powerful, able to fling a car without amplification or much effort. 

The emotional energy stored can also be used to amplify the user as well as any other powers they possess, however it’ll take practice to discover the specifics of what produces what. 

You can also directly project emotion, stored or otherwise, upon anyone in your range, without having to imbue it into your blasts. 

Your power can, and automatically will, store and use your own emotional energy the same as anyone else’s.
objects.title: Valiant

objects.text:
Instead of being limited to just micro-telekinesis, your powers now operate through a vast range of micro-Shaker effects; manipulating the laws of physics in your favour. For example, these tiny Shaker effects could include adjusting gravity, manipulating electromagnetic energy, influencing chemical reactions or even minuscule spatial-temporal effects.

Furthermore, you've also acquired an incredibly subtle micro-Master effect component to your power, allowing you to ever-so-slightly influence the thoughts and emotions of yourself and others within your range. Any 'alterations' done by these effects, both Master and Shaker, are practically imperceptible although these slight changes will subsequently lead to greater, noticeably beneficial outcomes i.e. appearing as incredible 'luck'.

Practically speaking, this significantly expands the situations in which your 'luck' appears. For instance, your powers could adjust the electricity within a slot machine for you to win big while also implementing a very subtle Master effect on the casino staff, influencing their thoughts to overlook any suspicions.
objects.title: Four-leaf Clover

objects.text:
Now, instead of receiving vague, fragmented memories when both of you are asleep at the same time, you can fully access their entire memory whenever you fall asleep, whether they are conscious or not. This link is deep and precise, allowing you to sift through their experiences and recall their skills with complete clarity. Every detail is available to you, from their long-term memories to fleeting moments, effectively allowing you to live through their life as if it were your own. Their expertise, knowledge, and instincts become fully usable, seamlessly integrating into your own mind and body when needed.

But it doesn’t stop there. Any mental power you possess, such as master effects, can be projected directly onto them through this connection, regardless of distance, at a reduced strength.
objects.title: Reverse Cannibalism

objects.text: You can now automate the process. By pushing an object into the ground, you can choose to create a “tree”. The tree’s appearance is based off the object. The tree will passive grow the object, creating duplicates constantly. The more complex the object, like tinkertech, the longer it takes to grow, with the longest being 1 item per day. The only limitation is that you have to be able to lift the object you are trying to make a tree for.
objects.title: Money Grows On Trees

objects.text:
Anyone you control now also gains the ability to self-explode, spreading your influence further. Each explosion increases your reach, allowing you to infect entire crowds rapidly. However, with every detonation, a permanent fragment of the person detonated will remain within you. These fragments begin to accumulate, and if too many belong to individuals who hold deep resentment or hatred toward you, they start to coalesce. This force can attack you from within, causing psychological damage, and if left unchecked, may fracture your sense of self or even override your control.

Simply giving time for your mind to stabilise can reduce and remove the chances of that happening.
objects.title: Veni, Vidi, Vici

addons.text: Your powers are incorporated into your form, automatically giving you new directions and giving you new specialties that can enhance that specific power. As you use your powers, they will evolve to counteract whatever they go against. If you can throw fire and a wall blocks it, it could grow the function to phase through walls. If your powers are insufficient to hurt the enemy, it could specialize itself into a form that will grow strong enough to hurt the enemy. Your powers can now learn from each other, granting their traits to each other.
addons.title: Power Creep

addons.text: Your incredible adaptive abilities synergize with your capacity to understand and assimilate esoteric phenomena to make you the ultimate survivor, capable of thriving in every scenario. The only weak spot left on your regeneration is your Shard (and not even that if you have Shardless); other than that, you’ll keep coming back even if you have nothing left to regenerate from. Likewise, your capacity for gaining new capabilities has expanded to unimaginable new heights, reaching the point that the more effective a weapon should be, the worse it is against you, because you will quickly adjust to it and turn its effects on you into a strength. Being trapped in a Grey Boy bubble would do nothing to hold you in place while allowing you to rewind and fast-forward your body along its personal timeline at will. Having the laws of physics rapidly altered on you would transmute you into alien forms of matter with unpredictable effects, but it wouldn’t stop you from doing anything. Even if you were completely erased, you would still be able to affect the world while being unaffected by it in turn.
addons.title: Hard-to-Destroy Parahuman

objects.text:
You can evolve yourself through combat; by engaging in various situations or battles, you can accumulate mutations. However, the amount you gain from fighting a specific phenomenon decreases over time, but putting yourself in greater danger can yield more. While you evolve in a way that enhances every aspect of yourself equally, you can also choose to evolve in a specific direction, like ‘Faster’ or ‘Stronger’. You can also improve your current form to specialize in one aspect by reducing the aspects of others.

You have 4 primary directions you can specialize in: Sheer, Conceal, Reversion, and Spindle. You can swap between these forms quickly at a moment's notice if needed. The greater you are involved in certain directions, the better it will become. For example, specializing in Sheer grants multi-dimensional functionality. Not only could it replicate All-or-Nothing, but it also grants passives such as pocketing your organs into a core. Spindle improves your ability to move, granting things like flight or speed. Congeal focuses on improving your size, strength, and sensory capabilities. And Reversion enhances your regenerative abilities. While they are all in different directions, they can build off each other like a web. Borrowing from each other to get even better.

As you encounter more situations, you will be able to evolve in more directions than the primary 4 and grow even stronger. When not in combat, you can choose to return to a human form. Your human form’s appearance will be mildly impacted by your evolutions, such as Congeal, which could make you taller. Even while in human form, all your mutations still apply. If you evolved a lot towards Sheer, your organs are in a durable core. If you evolved a lot in Reversion, time can rewind, restoring you to perfect condition. You can evolve to counteract All-or-Nothing.
objects.title: Jabberwocky

objects.text: Instead of merely knowledge, you can draw skills, experience and intellect of people around you. The skills and experience remain for an hour, while the intellect will be lost once out of range.
objects.title: Prodigy

objects.text:
This power has evolved, transforming it into something far more potent and dangerous. The monstrous illusions you produce are no longer fragile but can instead possess durability, speed and strength up to a Brute 3 rating. Additionally, your illusionary creatures are now more versatile and have stronger abilities, such as releasing poison gas, emitting sonic shrieks or generating acid spit.

You have full control over the appearance of these monsters when encasing your victims, such as their size, overall physiology and natural abilities. Finally, your connection to your monsters has deepened, granting you full conscious awareness and mental control over them.
objects.title: Psychogenesis

objects.text: Your power has now moved past the necessity to imbue objects with your power as you now can fire off blasts that carry the effects of Sting.
objects.title: Who Needs Bolts

objects.text: Your power has moved past merely ignoring the laws of physics and advanced to violating and manipulating said laws. You can now imbue nonliving objects you touch with effects that mirror those of other powers you have observed, from flying through the air unabated to creating crystalline structures on impact to even restorative effects by rewinding an object. These effects can also be set on time limits and timers up to fifteen minutes.
objects.title: More Than Just Physics

addons.text:
Firstly, you have gained the formulas for all Runechild spells, allowing you to enhance or modify them. More important however, is your newfound ability to convert any formula into a runic form, applying the effect of the formula to whatever the rune is attached to for as long as the rune remains intact. 

The way a runic formula applies its effect is a bit malleable, maybe it constantly applies the effect of the cantrip to the target or maybe it lies dormant until activation and unleashes its payload all at once. Whatever the case, runes can be attached in many ways, from paint or etched inscriptions to tattoos or sewed patterns.

While you can apply as many runes to something as will fit on it, the more complex a formula the more intricate it’s runic form, requiring either immense precision, a very large rune, or even both at the same time in the case of particularly advanced and powerful formulas.
addons.title: Runic Artificing

objects.text: You’re no longer exclusively limited to the telekinesis rune, instead you gain access to spells which you can invoke by inscribing runes on objects. This includes opening and closing locks, finding people and teleporting things. These spells might have different requirements as well, like the finding spell needing a unique object to find someone and making you feel ill if you overuse it. You’re limited to the above spells at the start, but with research, combat and experimentation can discover new ones, though they’ll rarely be stronger than a cantrip would be.
objects.title: Runechild

objects.text:
Your Shard's relationship is good enough that it discloses its archive of every species that came into your Shard's machinations, being a nigh uncountable amount of genetic and biological [Data] from alien flora, fungi, and fauna under different or extreme evolutionary factors you can cross-reference and recreate in your biokinesis. This also comes with a knowledge of how said alien flora, fungi, and fauna will interact with the local flora, fungi, and fauna.

These loosening of restrictions also opens your ability to tamper or create other organisms aside from carbon-based life-forms, including silica-based, helium-based, etc.
objects.title: Invasive Species

objects.text:
When you bury bones in the ground, preferably in rich soil, they will emerge as fully formed skeletons clad in bone-crafted armor and wielding weapons also made of bone. These skeletal warriors are completely autonomous, able to tackle complex problems and follow your commands with precision. The strength of the resulting skeleton depends on the quantity and quality of the bones used—more bones or stronger ones will produce a more powerful creation. If a skeleton warrior died, their remains turn into dirt.

You have control over the bones of your skeleton soldiers, shaping their weapons, armor, and even their forms during battle to adapt to your needs.
objects.title: Spartus

addons.text: Your body has refined your digestive system to new heights, ensuring that it remains a steadfast, reliable weapon and enabler for the hunt. Your ability to customize your vomit has skyrocketed beyond normal proportions; if you so chose, your spit could be solid shards that strike with the power of a bullet, fragile crystals designed to splinter inside entry points to maximize bleeding, or mucus that stretches across a room before solidifying, building protective barriers that could keep most within or outside.
addons.title: Gurgling Beneath The Surface

addons.text:
Both your bile and regenerative fluids have become adaptive. When landing on a shield constantly shifting through material after material, your bile will make an effort to do the same, ensuring that its rate of corrosion remains strong and static. Against living tissue it shifts according to your subconscious designs, from paralytic to nerve agent to pain receptor stimulant and back. 

Your hacked up regenerative fluid has similarly undertaken a life of its own, fueled by your acids and further increasing its value. It now focuses on disabling its target as much as possible rather than the diversity that makes up your mutations - living, breathing payloads. From rapidly calcifying tendrils wrapping around joints to growths that seep into skin like tumors while pulsing signals back to you, it will ensure that your target will not escape no matter what. Your esophageal tract has also become refined, letting you shoot bile as if it were from a rifle, build it in the back of your throat as an explosive torrent, or a combination of both, shooting in pulses as though your throat were a machine gun.

Lastly, your digestive system has now connected to the pressurized sacs that allow you movement, counting them as stomachs. This not only significantly increases your ability to output vomit, but also greatly increases your versatility as you can mix chemical blends of your sick within them. Then, with a violent expulsion, you can make them burst; a forceful blast of vaporized digestive fluids, coating the area around you in an acidic cloud with a stench most foul. Whether it’s mustard gas, knockout juice, or any other concoction is for you to decide.
addons.title: Digestive Ordinance Array

objects.text:
Your mutations no longer stop at tracking—your body now shifts to make you the ultimate hunter, evolving with every chase to better trap, disable, and kill your prey.

As before, you develop new tracking adaptations over time, but now, your transformations extend into offensive and predatory traits. Your senses heighten beyond mere detection—your nasal slit refines to read fear pheromones, blood chemistry, and even heartbeats, letting you anticipate movements before they happen. Your ears stretch and contort, granting pinpoint echolocation that can track movement even through walls, while your skin gains electroreceptors, letting you sense living beings in absolute darkness.

Your body warps further to match the hunt. When chasing a target, your form mutates dynamically, optimising itself in real-time—longer legs for speed, wider wings for gliding, bladed talons for striking, or reinforced bones to endure impacts. The inflatable growths that once helped with flight can now be repurposed, expanding into pressurized launch sacs that let you burst forward at terrifying speeds or collapse inward to release deafening concussive blasts.

Your vomit-based abilities also mutate in disturbing ways. Your body can now generate specialised bile, each strain tailored for the hunt—some sticky like industrial glue, some corrosive enough to melt steel, and others paralyzing on contact. When necessary, your stomach can even weaponize your own regenerative fluids, allowing you to spit chunks of rapidly regenerating flesh, which latch onto enemies like grotesque leeches, sapping their strength while feeding off their bodies.

The longer you pursue a target, the more your body shifts to counter their every move. There is no escape. Once you’ve set your sights on someone, you will always be able to find them… and now, you are built to finish the job.
objects.title: Hunting Horror

objects.text:
Your mastery of positional swapping has expanded beyond simple displacement, now allowing you to exchange esoteric and physical properties between two targets. Heat, moisture, color, speed—so long as a property is real and measurable, it can be swapped.

This ability still requires at least two targets, and the exchange occurs simultaneously, maintaining the balance of transferred attributes. You can cool a searing metal bar while warming your food, extinguish a fire by transferring its heat into a block of ice, or even change the color of a fabric by swapping colors between a liquid and a cloth, slowing a bullet by trading its velocity with a thrown pebble or cooking food instantly by exchanging the dryness and cold of raw ingredients with the heat and dampness of boiling water.
objects.title: Esoteric Equal Exchange

objects.text: Previously, you needed to be close to an individual for hours before gaining full control over their nervous system. Now, that delay is gone. The moment someone enters your range, you can override their bodily autonomy instantaneously. This immediate takeover dramatically enhances your potential effectiveness, both in combat and otherwise. You could force a gunman to drop their weapon before they pull the trigger or hijack hostile capes the second they are in your sphere of influence, forcing them and their powers to serve your purposes. Your other limitations still apply, with your level of control degrading the more individuals you attempt to command simultaneously and the farther away they are from you. As an added benefit, however, the side effect of your coordination worsening in parallel with your controlled targets has been removed.
objects.title: Monarch

objects.text:
Your power to unravel and rebuild non-living material has become a perfect storm, with both the speed and scale at which you can affect matter acting on a far grander scale.

A car that required 3 to 4 seconds to dismantle could now be taken apart in just a tenth of that time, while a concrete road barrier could reform in the blink of an eye. This process is restrained only by the size and mass involved rather than any strict limits. However, deconstructing and restoring something as huge as a skyscraper would still take many hours.

Moreover, your control over the leaf-like fragments you produce has also improved to match. You possess a scaling capacity to multi-task for every fragment you produce, regardless of how many, granting you full spatial awareness and fine telekinetic control over each individual piece. Note that their fragile nature remains unchanged.
objects.title: Petal Blizzard

objects.text:
Your power has grown beyond the projection of just individual limbs. You can now embed your entire body, allowing you to manifest a complete, full-sized projection of yourself from another surface composed of similar material.

This power is also no longer restricted by distance, so long as you can visualise the target location and it contains a compatible material, you can create a projection at that point. The only limits to your range are your awareness and those inherent to your shard.

To aid your usage of this power, your projections provide you with a limited form of remote perception. You are able to sense through your projections as if you were physically present, albeit only through the sensory organs formed (i.e. sight via eyes, hearing via ears etc). You can adjust the sensory input as preferred.
objects.title: Talos

objects.text: When you have a technique slotted in, you gain proficiency in it at a rate equal to how fast you’d progress by actively learning the chosen technique. This works even while you’re asleep.
objects.title: Idle Über Technique

objects.text: You’re now capable of affecting anyone who’s ever perceived you and can create large-scale illusions that are perceivable by anyone in your range. You can even affect people without needing for them to directly perceive you as long as they’re near you, though in exchange you can only inflict subtle hallucinations this way.
objects.title: The Mathers Giant

objects.text: You have a Shaker ability that spawns minions around you. The minions that you create are all around ten to twelve feet tall, with some being obese. They are human, and can be both men and women. These minions also produce a shaker effect that changes the area around them and can self-replicate. The minions are not inherently aggressive but respond to threats and agitation. You can produce more than just fleshy beings, like for example an enormous boneless creature ten times your size.
objects.title: The Mother of Mothers

objects.text:
Aside from being harder to notice or remember, another quirk you gained from your powers is expressing your powers as an aggressive form of cognitohazard. When coming in contact or within your earshot, you may cause harmful effects, such as head pain and paranoia, mainly from the fact that you removed some part of their mind related to your discovery. Maintaining contact worsens the effects, twisting and wiping memories out of their head, to the point of identity loss and total brain death.

You can switch between your normal powers and vice versa, aside from your on-off switch.
objects.title: Anantashesha

objects.text: There is now no maximum to your speed or the rate at which you can accelerate yourself. You could begin to move so fast that Legend would appear frozen in time if you so wished. Your limit still applies, and at a certain speed you lose the ability to affect the world at all. You'll phase through things less dense than you, and can control to what degree things such as gravity or momentum apply to you, allowing you to do things such as run up walls.
objects.title: Celerity

objects.text:
You have a Cauldron tattoo engraved, etched, tattooed, or otherwise branded on some part of your external body. Even if your physiology would make such branding difficult, if not impossible, it is present nevertheless and just as hard to remove as your Case 53 mutations.

The specifics of where and how this branding is placed on you are up to you.

<Small>Note this tattoo does not come with a complimentary amnesia package, forcing you to endure your embarrassing memories on your own.</Small>
objects.title: Cauldron Tattoo

addons.text: Your control over your skin has unlocked the true potential of your shapeshifting. Your ability to change your shape combined with your ability to control your skin’s texture and color allows you to perfectly replicate the appearance and feel of people and objects. With this you can do things like disguising yourself as someone else or even furniture to ambush someone. You are also able to increase your density and hardness to the level of stone instead of human skin.
addons.title: Mimicry

addons.text: Your voice has gained a curious quality. At will you can imbue your voice with the ability to induce pain and disorientation in those who hear it akin to Thinker headaches. These effects are both physical and mental, so Brutes and even those whose mind is hosted on their Shard are susceptible to it.
addons.title: Tekeli-li

addons.text: Your acidity has majorly increased in strength, enough to quickly dissolve almost any non-Tinker material with ease. Furthermore, you can now make the outer layers of your body acidic as well, providing more combat viability.
addons.title: Caustic Form

objects.text: You are no mere slime, but a Shoggoth. Your shapeshifting is much quicker, able to quickly reshape your body on the fly. This provides you opportunities for stealth or combat, from becoming a puddle on the ground to transforming into a whirling mass of pseudopods or even creating multiple mouths with which to feed and bite. Your shapeshifting isn’t good enough to properly mimic the appearance of other people or objects but can approximate rough shapes. Your acidity is also increased, enough to melt through most materials.
objects.title: Shoggoth

addons.text:
Your ability to create and spin webs has been qualitatively improved, your body is much more efficient in creating webs, allowing you to get more out of your stamina and internal fat stores. Furthermore, you can also exert some level of control over your thread to move and redirect it in ways it’s not supposed to. Lastly, as a spider should. you can sense vibrations through your webs, allowing you to know when something has been caught in them.

All together this allows you to spin and weave vast webs and traps, turning entire buildings - possibly even neighborhoods - into your personal domain.
addons.title: Weaver

addons.text: In addition to having your fangs become incredibly sharp and strong, another part of your body has been affected by Sharp Teeth. You have gained the ability to shift your forelimbs into scythe-like blades which you can apply Sharp Teeth’s effects to, making them incredibly sharp and durable. You also gain a decent increase to your Brute rating to better use your new weapons.
addons.title: Reaper

addons.text: Your control over your skin pairs oddly with your carapace. You have more freedom in what colors your carapace can be and gain an intuitive sense for the colors of your surroundings, allowing you to truly camouflage yourself. Additionally, you can further harden your carapace to survive blows far beyond what you normally could.
addons.title: Stalker

objects.text:
You my friend are all spider, you’re not even lucky enough to be humanoid. As a consequence of your fully spider body, you no longer have a mouth capable of normal speech, so communication is going to be a chore for you unless you have some other power which can counteract this.

Still, it's not all bad and there are some upsides. Your venom has become incredibly potent, enough to quickly kill most organic beings. You can be any size between a medium dog and a minivan, although once you choose your size you’re stuck with it. You also gain a minor Brute and Mover whose strengths shift depending on your size, i.e. the smaller you are the greater your Mover rating and the larger you are the greater your Brute rating.
objects.title: Taratect

addons.text: You have come full circle, from humanoid armor, to a weapon, and now back to a humanoid form, becoming a Sword - or other bladed weapon - Spirit. As an inanimate object you lack a physical gender, so Ritsuka is fundamentally reworked to account for this, transitioning into the ability to take a normal human form, at least on the surface. See, you can scale this transformation or even transform parts of your body back, such as changing your flesh to the same steel as your blade-self, sprouting copies of your blade from your body, or turning your nails into miniature blades. You also gain the ability to conjure temporary copies of your weapon form, separate from Handmade’s normal limits. Accompanying this is an increase in the strength of your self-targeting telekinesis, allowing you to maintain maximum mobility even in human form. Additionally, through a bit of rules lawyering the copies of your weapon form still technically count as you, so they can be manipulated using your telekinesis for passable ranged combat. Of course your weapon-form benefits as well, with Sharp Teeth making it so you always possess the durability of titanium and remain razor sharp. It also grants you the ability to customize your weapon form a bit, changing color or even shape to a certain extent. If you’re a sword you can’t suddenly become an axe, but you can change from a broadsword to a dagger, claymore, etc.
addons.title: Sword Spirit

objects.text:
You aren’t even armour anymore, instead you are a weapon. Your form is now a cold weapon of your choice—be it a sword, a mace, or even a ranged weapon like a bow. If you are a ranged weapon, you can create and regenerate your ammunition, though this happens at the slow pace of human healing.

In exchange, your telekinetic control has grown far stronger. You can now launch yourself with the speed of a bullet. However, while you can travel quickly, your mind cannot keep up with fine control at such speeds, limiting your accuracy in movement. If you are a ranged weapon, this stronger telekinesis also allows you to guide your projectiles in flight, though doing so requires concentration.
objects.title: Living Weapon

addons.text: The durability of your bones has been extended across your entire body, but is especially prevalent in your leathery skin, enough to allow you to tank high caliber bullets and crash through walls unimpeded. Additionally, your physical strength increases to match your size, allowing you to strike with enough force to tear steel and shatter brick, to say nothing of what you do to unenhanced humans.
addons.title: Greatwyrm

addons.text: You are adapted for ranged combat, your body specializing in utilizing your flame breathing abilities to great effect. Your enhanced ability to vomit synergizes with your ability to regurgitate flammable acid, allowing you to spew fire at much greater ranges, with greater force, and in much greater quantities, while your understanding of angles and trajectories allows you to aim your fire with unnerving accuracy. Furthermore, your ability to modify the viscosity of your vomit allows for more versatility when breathing fire, such as spraying tight streams of flame or spewing balls of fire which splash against and stick to objects like some sort of biological napalm. Lastly, your increased oxygen intake has caused your flammable acid to become hyper oxygenated, burning hot enough to melt steel. Possessing Projectile, Projectile Vomit further increases your range and the force at which you can expel fire, and Upchuck takes all attributes of this to their utmost extreme.
addons.title: Flamespitter

addons.text: You are adapted for aerial combat, your body specializing in the speed and agility needed to dominate the skies. Your draconic wings inherit all the beneficial traits of True Wings such as their ability to regenerate or fold up into your body, while your increased physical capability and oxygen intake allows you to fly at much greater speeds and heights than before, all while retaining perfect control due to your increased reaction speeds. Additionally, your becomes an odd mix of scales and feathers, forming durable stone-like feathers which are nonetheless just as flexible and light as normal feathers, providing simultaneous maneuverability and protection so as to better survive potential impacts in the air. You may optionally possess a second set of wings for even greater speed and maneuverability.
addons.title: Swiftwing

addons.text:
You are adapted for survivability, your body specializing in regenerative capabilities with a splash of acidity for defensive measure.

Your increased stem cell production compounds with your flawless healing and increased bone mass as a dragon, accelerating further and granting you a very noticeable boost in regenerative capability. Additionally, your prioritization of survival grants you two additional fully functional heads, allowing you to potentially survive decapitation.

Accompanying this is an alteration to your blood, becoming caustic enough to corrode or at the very least damage most mundane materials. This makes attempts to harm you up close ill advised as coming into contact with your blood is damaging.
addons.title: Hydra

addons.text:
You are adapted for aquatic combat, your body specializing in surviving and navigating within the ocean depths.

Your body is built to resist the immense pressure of the deep ocean, your internal organs compressing yet remaining functional even when subject to the weight of innumerable tons of water. Your eyesight has developed beyond being merely 20/20, now being able to pick up even the slightest trace of light, allowing you to see clearly in all but the absolute darkest depths of the ocean. 

Lastly, your wings are also adapted to be able to function like fins, reducing drag and propelling you through the water with the same ease they do air.
addons.title: Seadrake

addons.text:
Through your hydrophilic ooze and temperature manipulating abilities you have developed an odd mutation; frost breath.

You possess an internal gland which produces a pressurized and aerosolized variant of your Hydro Ooze which retains its extremely hydrophilic nature while having an extremely low freezing point. At will you can release this aerosolized substance from your mouth at high speeds. 

Coupled with your ability to release solar energy as directed thermal effects, this allows you to spray a freezing aerosol which attracts water and freezes everything it touches. Lastly, your cells have developed to become extremely efficient at cold-based thermal effects, allowing you to use them to much greater lengths without having to worry about running out of energy.
addons.title: Frostspine

addons.text:
Through your energy feeding and electro-magnetic abilities you have developed an odd mutation; the ability to absorb and harness electricity.

In addition to absorbing solar and ionizing radiation, you can also absorb electric charge with the same efficiency as solar radiation. To assist with this, your body has adjusted to be able to safely conduct large amounts of electrical energy - your scales in particular becoming a highly conductive biological metalloid - allowing you to quite literally bite an active power line and suffer no consequences.

You have also gained another use for your stored energy—empowering your ability to create electromagnetic fields to be more powerful and versatile. 

This can manifest in simple ways, such as a localized electromagnetic pulse to disrupt electronics, or in the form of directed electrical effects from your body, such as making your body electrified or even breathing a crackling beam of lightning from your mouth. However, doing so for an extended period of time would quickly burn through your reserves of energy.
addons.title: Sparkscale

objects.text:
You’ve grown to a great size, large enough to be comparable to large cars rather than other humans, and with a weight to match. 

You possess two great wings sprouting from your back allowing you to take flight and four powerful legs. Unfortunately, you possess no hands for fine dexterity. Your skin is leathery and durable, and can be either made up of tough keratin scales increasing your durability or feathers increasing your speed and maneuverability in flight. 

Additionally, your tail is extremely powerful and dextrous, and you possess the ability to breath fire by regurgitating a weak but flammable acid from your stomach, which you can then ignite as it passes.
objects.title: Dragon

addons.text: Using a specialized process derived from photosynthesis, you have developed the ability to absorb and metabolize vast amounts of toxins from around you, enhancing your growth rather then hindering it. This process pulls toxic substances out of the air, water and land, renewing the environment and allowing other life to flourish.
addons.title: Purifying Tree

objects.text:
You are now a fully stationary tree, unable to move from your location. Your species can vary, but you are large, durable, and self-sustaining. Your body passively absorbs sunlight, water, and nutrients, keeping you alive indefinitely. Physical damage is meaningless unless it destroys you entirely, as you can regrow lost branches, bark, and roots over time. You have limited movement—your branches and smaller parts can shift slightly, but meaningful movement requires Tinker enhancements. With enough modification, you could eventually control even your roots.

You emit an aura that passively makes the surrounding area fertile, accelerating plant growth. This effect strengthens when you absorb sunlight, allowing plant life to spread rapidly in your vicinity.

You have a Tinker power specifically focused on plants. By using your aura, you can guide plant growth to naturally develop complex biological structures that function as Tinkertech. This applies to both external plants and your own body, letting you modify yourself over time. The plants you create are naturally self-replicating like any living organism, allowing them to spread and sustain themselves without direct intervention. The only exception is yourself—while you could theoretically grow another tree like your own body, it would not inherit your powers, only the biological enhancements you have made to yourself.
objects.title: Great Tree

objects.text: Now we're talking; you're no longer simply reminiscent of a demon; you basically are one now! Your physical abilities have been enhanced to give you a mover rating of one and a brute rating of two. Your pyrokinesis has been enhanced to the degree that you could throw a basketball-sized fireball every few seconds that's strong enough to knock someone over and crack a rib or two. Your enhanced pyrokinesis could also let you heat your body up to the level of causing second-degree burns or even lighting wood on fire with prolonged contact. You also grow a pair of leathery bat-like wings that, while not strong enough to let you fly, would let you glide. You now have a slight affinity for manipulation and wording your sentences in tricky ways.
objects.title: Devil

objects.text:
You are no longer one suit of living armour; you are four suits of armour, and you can control the four of them with the same ease you could control one. The suits of armour have to be the same 'theme'; for example, you could have them all be elegant mediaeval armour, but you could not have half of them be samurai armour and the other half Roman armour.

Your quad body situation has had an interesting effect on your powers; each armour suit only has your other powers at 33% potency. The main ability your bodies have is the ability to combine; you can temporarily combine all four suits into one multi-limbed armoured giant that, without any other powers, has a brute rating of four, but if you have other powers, their potency is increased to 120%. At the start, you can only maintain this fused form for a few minutes before falling apart; this time can increase with training.

If you have Living Weapon, then you are instead four weapons that have the ability to combine into a siege weapon like a small trebuchet or a battering ram.
objects.title: Armoured Squad

objects.text:
The technology that composes your body is Tinkertech. You can maintain yourself even if you aren't a Tinker yourself but only a Tinker can modify or improve your body. If you possess relevant Tinker powers, your body incorporates tech from their library. Otherwise, you are simply "generic" Tinkertech.

Stacks with the Tinker Construction Perk if both are taken, improving the sophistication and capabilities of the technology that composes your body.
objects.title: Tinkered Production

objects.text: BE NOT AFRAID! Rather than being beautiful and serene, you’re more on the ‘Otherworldly and terrifying’ end of the spectrum. While this understandably makes you worse at interacting with others, it does come with a certain majesty. Additionally, no longer locked to a humanoid bodyplan your body gains multiple new functional pairs of arms, wings, eyes, animalistic features, and even entire faces. Notably you are not limited to biological phenomena, and inorganic material can be incorporated into this new form. Additionally, your halo has become… strange. Ranging from bone, circling your body and connected to you at odd angles to a great corona of fire perpetually behind you to all viewers.
objects.title: Biblically Accurate

addons.text:
You’re doing a terrible thing. Existing, that is, specifically the way you’re doing it.

You might have thought you were something eldritch before, but the fundamentally unnatural… nature, of your mutation, added to another source of disconnection from reality, has resulted in something deeply appalling. Your permanent Breaker state of independence from the laws of physics is overclocked, twisting you into something that must not obey any laws at all.

You are immune to any and every outside influence; kinetic energy, gravity, time, interdimensional forces like Sting, wavelength manipulation, stranger things still, none of them have any effect on you whatsoever. In fact, without Holding Back you literally cannot be affected by them even if you wanted to, you’d have to “play-act” them having an effect and shift your body to copy what should be happening. By the same token, the manner in which you unnaturally contort your form is freed from all limitations. You can consider yourself free from the bounds of form, location, and physically or logically possible movement, able to slip through the gaps in quarks or grab someone from the front face-to-face and then spin them around to the other side to face you, both your hands free, even as your hands are still wrapped around them.

Entangling yourself with reality when you are in a state of such profound alogicality would, as you may have guessed, have some strange effects. You may distort the laws of physics to such a degree that it becomes inaccurate to call the result “physics,” “laws,” or, indeed, “of.” The ramifications, and potential applications for you, are truly limitless.

The Neverwas, its addons, and The-Shouldn’t-Be’s addons all pull you even further away from correctness and comprehensibility. With all of them, you might achieve a state of complete irrational indeterminacy and exist beyond all logical definition.
addons.title: The Defi/ant/lement/nition/

addons.text:
They’re right to be afraid of you; you’re what’s going to take their place. In every aspect of your being you surpass the peak of human achievement entirely. You can shrug off a carpet bombing, chase down a fighter jet, and break down the walls of a nuclear bunker. You’re just as superior mentally, outcomputing the most advanced supercomputers and making the greatest historical supergeniuses in a field look like blithering morons the moment you apply yourself to it, just by winging it with intuition and basic reasoning.

Thanks to Crystalline Humanoid’s ability to rapidly evolve and alter your body plan your shapeshifting is no longer restricted to the vaguely humanoid body plan, having access to a far greater variety of forms. Your mutations are also much stronger and more fluid, able to strain or subtly break the limits of biological possibility and occur instantaneously when you will it.

The innate aura of wrongness around you is also much stronger now, adding a sense of inevitable and inescapable doom powerful enough to make even the extremely strong-willed give up on life in the face of the overwhelming dread and horror you represent. People will quickly jump to viewing you as an existential threat.

If you possess Jade Flesh then your abilities are amplified even further. Your electric discharge also gains unique properties, moving as though it were being guided by an intelligence loyal to you and creating distortions similar in nature to those affecting your form in whatever it interacts with, allowing you to use it to physically warp your surroundings in eerie ways and attack and defend with it in a manner that ignores brute force and durability.

If you have Diamond Cortex then your psychic abilities become powerful enough to manifest your thoughts into reality as phantom objects or beings of a similarly uncanny nature to you, telekinetically reverse the explosion of a nuclear bomb, and brainwash crowds of thousands of people at once.
addons.title: Humanity’s Replacement
Concealed Menace
addons.text:
Your shapeshifting capabilities have taken your social chameleon abilities to even greater heights, capable of seamlessly replicating the physical characteristics of any person you choose. But that isn’t the real benefit of this, no the real benefit is that your ability to fake and fit in has reached the point of being able to fake normality. 

By taking a more normal form you can conceal your unnerving presence to the point that only those with supernatural perception or instincts will be able to determine that something is off and even then it’ll be tough to pinpoint exactly what. 

Of course this concealment only lasts so long as you maintain a suitable disguise, so showing any signs of your inhumanity will negate the benefits of this.

objects.text:
If before you were just slightly off, now you are very blatantly not right. You are clearly something that has never experienced human reality and doesn’t understand how it works badly imitating a human.

Your body is completely inconsistent in terms of proportions, appearance, and position. You’ll shift and contort in ways that aren’t possible for anything made of matter, much less a human, like a poorly AI-generated video that fails to keep track of what’s happening or remember how physics works. Everything about you carries a pervasive feeling of utter wrongness, triggering an instinctive overwhelming fear of you, and you intuitively know how to play to that to inflict terror enough that seasoned veterans of conflict and horror who have seen the worst the world has to offer would freeze up and tremble before you.

Your physical abilities are further enhanced, to the point you could slit a man’s throat with your finger, dart across an empty room so fast that no one notices until you come to a stop, and blend into the background in places where no one would ever think they could miss you. Your shapeshifting is, as you may guess, much more potent; your body is almost entirely fluid, and as long as you stick to roughly the same body plan you are entirely fluid, able to slip through the grate of a vent, turn your fingernails into two-foot-long knives, wrap your fingers around a human throat several times, or seal bullet wounds shut.

Other mutations are taken even further away from human than they were with just Uncanny, making them more pronounced and stronger but much more bestial and unnatural, bordering onto incomprehensible, with instincts to match.
objects.title: Just Plain Wrong

objects.text:
There are a handful of previously unknown properties of your mist. The major one is that it converts external matter into more of itself. This means that rather than only ever having small amounts of mist to perform parlor tricks with, at any moment you can have an entire landscape’s worth to use. The sheer quantity of mist under your control drastically elevates the scale of what you can do to the point that you look like a reality warper from an average person’s point of view.

Using all that mist to absorb or release thermal energy means you can achieve serious extremes of temperature, ranging from hot enough to make steel start turning liquid to cold enough to make the air do the same. Not just that, since the massive bubbles of extreme temperature are capable of disrupting weather patterns, you can theoretically control the weather through very precise use of temperature control.

On a similar note, using massive amounts of mist to build up a static charge allows you to create actual bolts of lightning to harness as a powerful makeshift Blaster ability.

With all the mist available, your illusions are now capable of being very solid, allowing you to effectively create objects or transmute matter by converting it into mist and then shaping it into a solid illusion. You could even make functioning machinery by using the mist’s properties to replicate its workings, though this will be complicated to do, won’t work on tinkertech, and might not even work on all regular technology. The objects you make are still made of your mist and only superficially take on the properties of what they resemble.

By creating a massive fog of mist and using its light refraction you can create some very impressive special effects, like seemingly changing the color of the sky or “warping space” by altering the path of light reflecting off of objects.

Your mist still moves at the same speed regardless of the extra mass, which means that you can output much more force than that of a strong wind by putting more mist into it. An entire landscape moving as fast as a strong wind can be very destructive.

The mist is not Manton-limited, so you can turn people into more mist.
objects.title: Archmagus

addons.text: Your energy problems persist with your Avatar, with the need to sustain yourself, as your energy reserves also count as your lifespan. This binds your Avatar with your true body, needing to feed and look for large amounts of matter and energy to keep living day-to-day. This improves your energy absorption to the point you’ll be immune to energy-based attacks and able to drain a Parahuman’s a quarter of their stamina and power reserves.
addons.title: Running Out of Fumes

addons.text:
Your physiology and self-projection power have merged into their likeness. Your Avatar becomes energy-efficient to be a negligible drain to your true body, allowing wiggle room with your Avatar’s general functionalities.

Your bio-crystalline Avatar builds up on its abilities, where you could metabolize energy to sustain your Passenger-like physiology and repair your Avatar; you can now absorb energy from any attack at a 1:1 ratio, “eating” Leviathan’s high-speed attack, metabolizing it to your internal reserve to your true body back on your pocket dimension and instantly repairing your Avatar, every survival strengthening and bolstering you.

As your true self resides in your true Passenger body, linking your mind with all your biocrystalline body including your Avatar is already a given you could before, able to out-scheme the Simurgh for a time if you burn through most of your reserves. Your Avatar’s newly developed energy efficiency borne from this synergy will stop this from being a reckless decision.

Upgrading your template to be superhuman isn’t out of the question now, beneficial alterations you haven’t thought of—beneficial Trump effects like Othala, Two, etc.—will be integrated and evolve upon. All the belts and whistles are still there, but they’ll be comparable to a highly evolved system that can bench a small car and outrun high-speed cars.

Finally, channeling your powers through your Avatar is comparable to notable Hosts like Sleeper or Ash Beast, expanding their strength and depth as before, having the potential to be an S-Class cape on your own with a 10 SP power of any rating.
addons.title: True Avatar

objects.text:
Your mutations have merged, causing your physiology to function similarly to an Entity’s Avatar, with your true body folding into a pocket dimension while projecting a bio-crystalline avatar into real space.

Your true body is now a titanic chunk of Shardflesh approximately the size of the Empire State Building, leaving your calculative prowess enormous, which massively improves the power and control you have behind your abilities. You can expend energy to grow in size, with the pocket dimension your true body projects growing in conjunction, leaving you with no true hard limit on how large you can get. 

You project a bio-crystalline Avatar into Realspace. This avatar emulates humanity in form, appearance, neurology, and structure, but not coloration. Instead, your body is a colour of your choice, such as Scion’s gold or Eden’s Silver, etc. You still have white teeth and sclera. Despite your body's unusual composition, its skin and flesh are soft like a human’s, and your hair is like silk. 

Your “human” organs function properly, though they are unnecessary, as your Avatar is only that, an Avatar. Any mass you can swallow breaks down into energy at a near 1:1 ratio, which is sent to your true body to grow, regenerate, or empower your abilities. You can also absorb energy that touches your skin, giving you an incredible resistance to energy-based attacks, as you simply absorb them as fuel.

Your Avatar has an emulated Corona Pollentia, which serves as the lens you project yourself into real space. You can also regenerate your Avatar by replacing damaged parts with undamaged matter taken from your true body.
objects.title: The Avatar

objects.text:
You have evolved from a mere orc into a true Oni. You have grown up to three meters (9 ft 9 in) in height and are rippling with muscles. Your skin has turned from green to red (or any other Oni adjacent color) and you have gained horns upon your head in a design of your choosing.

But you didn’t just gain aesthetics with this, you’ve also gained a minor brute rating including enough strength to toss a car around and a minor healing factor capable of keeping you alive and moving even while impaled in several places. 

Your combat instincts also grow in scope, allowing you to better understand and manage a field of battle while instinctively using your fists or weapons to your best benefit.
objects.title: Oni

rows.title: Shard Fusions
rows.titleText: Sometimes, when you have multiple powers, they'll combine into something stronger.

objects.text: You have absolute control and understanding of all carbon based lifeforms. You also can control biology at three times the rate you could before.
objects.title: Biobringer

objects.text:
You've achieved what remains out of reach for the vast majority of Tinkers: the near-instant transposition of blueprints from your mind into reality.

With a single touch, you can overwrite the entirety of any living thing's biology, replacing it with one of your own design. This is not limited to animals, nor is it limited to your touch alone. The microbes in your body and on your skin, the root system that connects a forest, and someone standing barefoot in the grass on the other side of Central Park are all fair game; as long as the connection is through living biological matter, it makes no difference how many degrees of separation there are.

You can make any change to bodies and brains (and by extension, minds) or create any living thing you can imagine. It doesn't matter if living things don't actually work the way you intend, nor does it matter if what you've done bends certain laws of nature or physics. It. Just. Works. If it's theoretically possible with biology, you can do it... with one exception; for the time being, at least, you must still adhere to the law of conservation of mass, limiting you based on the target's existing biomass. You could, for example, break a target into multiple smaller creatures, but you could not make a target larger without the addition of more biomass.
objects.title: Barbas & Buer

objects.text: If you give positive emotions to someone while simultaneously hiding them with your actions, you can give them a modified version of Twice Critical’s boost. This boost will instead rely on the stamina of the other person and possess the ability to be increased with training, acting as a slower version of (Brute) Unlimited Potential. That is to say that as long as they continuously train to the point that they strain themselves, they will continue to grow stronger without limit. The gains made by this boost are permanent and will not be removed if the boost is revoked.
objects.title: Tsundere

objects.text:
You can now enchant any object you have in your pocket dimension, with any object inside being considered a work in progress. This means that you can enchant multiple objects at once or focus on one object to speed up the enchantment process. Objects stored in your pocket dimension can now be launched out at the speed of sound. 

You additionally gain the ability to make original enchantments that do not require you to copy another power. These enchantments are based on mythical treasures thought up by man. These enchantments work best when used on an object matching the mythical treasure in question, with deviations in form resulting in the enchantment weakening to various degrees. None of your enchantments will be stronger than a nuclear bomb.
objects.title: Babylon Workshop

objects.text: You can bring three people with you when you time loop.
objects.title: Golden Trio and their +1

objects.text: You can take control over any single one of the existing Endbringers, while keeping all your other powers as well as getting theirs.
objects.title: The End-Usurper

addons.text: Your personal Endbringer form allows you to fuse with your minions either together or individually, providing you and your minions with either the ‘regular’ 50% boost or an even further enhanced 75% boost by combining with them both. If you die, it is possible for your minions to create a new core to resurrect you. You are still subject to the same core damage as your minions, with the triplicate fusion possibly killing all of you within an hour of usage. You also gain a thinker power that allows you to coordinate your actions from across the globe.
addons.title: In Our Image

objects.text:
In return for replacing your usurped Endbringer with an original one, a synergy has formed between your Endbringer minions, making them two parts of a greater whole. Your Endbringers now split their powers between each other to specialize in those powers to make them twice as strong. They additionally gain enhanced coordination between each other to allow them to cover for each other’s weaknesses.

In case one of them is destroyed, the core of the other Endbringer will begin mitosis to grow a new core from which its twin shall be reborn. This will take about a month at a minimum, depending on its energy usage, unless you have Negentropy, then it will take a week at a minimum.

With both Endbringers intact, it is possible to partially reverse this process to fuse them into a dual-core Endbringer. While this allows for all their combined powers to be boosted by an additional 50%, it is significantly energy-intensive and may result in damage to both of their cores if sustained for too long. Negentropy removes the potential to damage their cores, but they may still enter a “sleep mode” if they use too much energy.
objects.title: Formless and Empty

objects.text:
Both your Endbringer and Titan characteristics have now merged into one, transforming you into a true Endbringer in human form.

In addition to your Endbringer physiology, you no longer transform into a state where your shard is dominant and instead all your powers are now constantly at around the level an Endbringer's might be, complete with total unrestricted access to all the capabilities of your selected shards.

A word of warning, significant overuse of your powers will result in your shard rapidly running out of energy depending on their energy intensity. This can be negated by selecting Negentropy or Shardless.
objects.title: Advent of the End

addons.text:
The constructs known as Endbringers weren't originally meant to be as powerful as they are, instead being formed by accident. Your existence is now another such anomaly. Your powers relating to Endbringers and Titans have all fused into one, resulting in becoming a construct massively more powerful than what any Entity would normally create.

Firstly, all of your powers, both Endbringer or not, are at the level of a standard Endbringer while you're in your baseline human form. Transforming into your Endbringer form further boosts all your powers to a terrifying degree in both strength and scope. Powers normally capable of destroying cities in your new baseline state are instead able to destroy large countries with ease while stronger powers are similarly magnified even further.

Secondly, your existence as the Emperor of the End also affects other Endbringers or Titans, causing them to recognise your seniority and pre-disposing them to follow your orders. You are still required to initially get them to obey you, either through a very convincing argument or a sufficient demonstration of force, but after that they will remain loyal to a fault.

Lastly, your Endbringer physiology has reached its final stage with three cores available that you can move around and even use to split apart into three separate human/Endbringer forms if you desire. You rapidly regenerate your body significantly faster than normal Endbringers or Titans although restoring a destroyed core will take substantially longer. Your strength, speed, durability and density have all been further increased by half again.

(Note: If you have Negentropy you can convince Endbringers, Titans and the vast majority of Shards to join your cause far more easily in return for THE ANSWER. Beware the Entities learning about this as they will likely destroy you to get it.)
addons.title: Emperor of the End

objects.text: Your Endbringer powers have synergized, enhancing each other’s abilities, and unlocking new features. Typhon is a power that makes your body that of Endbringer flesh by default, it allows you to use any of your Endbringer form's powers outside of that form. However, any such powers will be reduced to approximately the level of a low Tier 2 power. End-Becomer now allows you to take any of your non-Endbringer powers and temporarily replace one of the powers granted by End-Becomer with it. When replaced, the new power's strength will be boosted to a level similar to that of the power being replaced. Both Typhon and End-Becomer grant you an Endbringer core. You can now move both cores within and between either form, though the form you are in must possess at least one core. As long as a core survives, you cannot die, and any damaged or destroyed cores will slowly regenerate over time. With an extra core, your strength, density, durability, and speed are doubled in both forms. The power boost granted by Typhon increases to 50%, with Negentropy—or Shardless—increasing it further to 100%. Additionally, End-Becomer gains two “blank” slots to boost non-Endbringer powers.
objects.title: King of the End

addons.text:
The Endbringer minion you obtained from Bringer of the End or The End-Usurper has mirrored your evolution, becoming a fellow Anti-Endbringer. This does not mean you get three visions of disaster. You get one vision that is shared between you, as well as a thinker power allowing you to coordinate whatever you all build in response.

You also get a permanent 50% boost when using The End-Becomer for each Endbringer you control.
addons.title: Guardians of Hope

addons.text:
Your powers as the Bringer of Hope are now available in your human form, with both your Endbringer and Anti-Endbringer powers being reduced to being high T2/low T3 in strength. Typhon’s power-boosting aspect is also increased to 75%. 

All available powers when using End-Becomer are now affected by a general 75%, with the added 50% boost when facing S-Class threats becoming 75% as well.

Your durability and stamina have also increased, with your human form being almost as durable as your Endbringer form was and your Endbringer form becoming nigh invulnerable. If you somehow manage to get severely injured and lose both your cores, you will have about 2 hours to live unless you possess a power that can heal yourself. After that, you will have a 12-hour period where your regular powers are returned to base level, your Endbringer powers are at high T1/low T2 strength, and you are unable to use End-Becomer.

If you have Negentropy, all power boosts are increased to 150% and The End-Becomer receives three blank slots instead of two. Additionally, your powers are not reduced in strength during your healing periods, with it now requiring 6 hours to regain your Endbringer form.
addons.title: Symbol of Hope

addons.text:
You have evolved beyond bringing hope, beyond symbolizing hope, and have become hope itself. You are now a God of Hope, or something very close to it.

On top of all your regular powers being boosted to Endbringer level, every power you have receives a 100% boost in human form. In Endbringer form, measuring the boost your powers receive becomes difficult as you could very well destroy the moon with your newfound strength. You can even become stronger than that as you receive a permanent 100% boost to both forms for every Endbringer or Titan that becomes your subordinate. Be careful not to use all of your shards reserves at once.

Your Stamina and Durability don’t massively increase. Instead, your ability to survive without cores and regenerate them align so that you can sustain your Endbringer form for three hours after the destruction of all your cores. You can also divert your regeneration ability from your body to speed up the regeneration of your cores, potentially growing at least one back during the three-hour limit and sustaining your form. If you are not able to regenerate in time, you will transform back into a human and be unable to transform again until all three cores have regenerated. Your powers will still be at Endbringer level but will lose their boost until at least one core has grown back.

Your Endbringer form now appear completely divine, making people who’ve seen you and especially those whom you’ve saved compelled to worship you as their new God, with even your human form looking more holy. Word of warning, it is in your best interest to keep an eye on these people. Any crimes that they commit out of religious fanaticism will likely be attributed to you, even if you don’t have any mind control powers. It will be hard to stop a religion from forming entirely, so it is best to make rules they must follow so the public eye won’t pin all of their crimes on you.

If you have Negentropy, all of your boosts are doubled to 200% and you will be able to sustain your boost even without cores.
addons.title: God of Hope

objects.text:
A paradox has occurred inside your body. Your opposing powers to become an Endbringer and to counter Endbringers have collided, but instead of a disaster, a miracle has been born. Your Endbringer form has become optimized to counter other Endbringers, making you a sort of Anti-Enbringer

When you use The End-Becomer, you will find that your Endbringer form’s powers have received a general 50% boost, with you gaining another 50% for every Endbringer or S-Class threat you are facing at the time. Your Endbringer form is now ethereal in appearance, making even a monstrous form look somehow holy to onlookers. Your durability and stamina have become immense in this form, meaning that it takes at least 10 full power attacks from an Entity to injure you and even if severely injured you can survive up to 1 hour after your core has been destroyed. It is possible to not die when the time is up by turning back into human if you have a power that can instantly regenerate you. However, you won’t be able to access your form again until a full 24 hours have passed from the moment you finished healing and your regular powers will be slightly weaker during this period.

Your abilities from PeaceBringer are also integrated into your Endbringer form, having also changed in the process. You can now radiate an aura of empowerment with a radius of 10 miles. Within this aura, you can grant all living creatures you desired the strength of a level 3 brute and enhanced healing capable of restoring even lost limbs within an hour. Those within your aura will also become afflicted with a burning sense of hope and a minor thinker power letting them gain insight on how to survive in multiple disasters. The result of these effects combined means that you can cut down the casualty rate of Endbringer attacks by 50% by simply being there.

Finally, you receive the ability to know when and where large-scale disasters will occur within 24 hours and what kind of disaster it will be. This also triggers PeaceBringer’s tinker ability, allowing you to prepare tinkertech for whatever disaster will arrive. Your skill in tinkering is also boosted, drastically reducing the time you need to build your tech. The limit on how powerful your tech can be is also reduced to the point you could make tech capable of restraining Endbringers for a small but decent period. The only blind spot to this is the Entity, but this only applies to it directly, you can still sense that a disaster will occur but won’t know what causes it.
objects.title: Bringer of Hope

addons.text:
You are Behemoth, in the flesh. Your Endbringer form not only inherits all of Behemoth’s powers but is also unshackled from all the possible restrictions and directives he was placed for the Cycle.

Your command over energy applies to all types of energy in the physical world, being a master at it. Your range is near Mr. Worldwide both in perception and utilization. Common demonstrations are complete and utter disruption of the electromagnetic layers, changing the Earth’s relief map from massive faults, volcanic eruptions, and the resulting earthquakes, and simply becoming a living bomb sufficient to sink the world into a Dark Age.

If Behemoth exists in the world you are in, you can retroactively take his place.
addons.title: Hadhayosh

addons.text: You are to Endbringers what Endbringers are to humans. Your existence has retroactively altered history, removing Endbringers in its entirety. You gain access to an additional 20 Endbringer cores, as well as granting you the powers of Tohu, Bohu and Khonsu. Beyond that you gain all the powers in the Endbringer Power Section. You can use any of these powers at once. Each of your abilities are massively enhanced, and even more so when in your Endbringer form. Each Endbringer power you do purchase is also mutated and amplified, becoming far more flexible and powerful as well as losing any of its restrictions, enough to defeat 3 other Terror Drones with just one of the Endbringer powers. That is not all however, you can choose to have your Endbringer cores divert their power solely to empowering any of your powers, multiplying its strength upon itself for every core diverted to it. Which core empowers which power can be altered at any time. If you somehow die, it will destroy one of the 21 cores you have. After its destruction you can revive and gain a power set perfectly made to counter the previous attacks/powers. This can also be done without death, and/or directed allowing you to generate a new power set based on conscious, or subconscious if you allow it, desires, although this will typically take longer. Any destroyed cores will naturally regenerate after a month, although additional powers can increase the speed of this. If Negentropic/Shardless this regeneration is dropped down to a day and you can generate a new core every month. Be aware that options that increase the amount of Endbringers will increase the total amount of cores you have available, and options that increase the strength of Endbringers will increase your own.
addons.title: Terror Drone

addons.text: Even the greatest and most powerful of Terror Drones are nothing but ants before you. You are the greatest threat the world has ever known, they could bring armies of parahumans, Titans, and Endbringers to bear against you and all they could hope to accomplish is to die quickly, for they would be nothing more than gnats caught in the winds of a cataclysmic storm. Your powers build upon itself once more, amplifying and increasing to absolutely terrifying levels, you are going against the very principles of what an Entity would allow to exist. Your Endbringers powers are converted into slots for Paradigm as normal, however they are supercharged, adding the equivalent of what you would have had as a Terror Done on top of each Paradigm’s slots power which is in turn empowered to the same degree your Endbringer form would have empowered your abilities. Your physical abilities are similarly enhanced, each core in use amplifying them further. Your cores now empower every ability you possess, although you can choose to focus them for greater effect. Beyond that you are immune to pain, debilitation, physical needs, and permeant injury, able to operate at full effectiveness even when reduced to nothing more than a single core. You also receive alien senses that depends on what powers you use, able to perceive the world directly through your abilities even when your form is reduced to nothing. The number of additional cores you have available to you has gone up to 100, however what a core means has gotten a little loose. They’ve become as flexible as your own form. You can now freely modify the nature of your own form and cores as well as any of your Endbringers. Do you wish to be an angelic monster made of pure fractal light, your death requiring the destruction of your ever shining core in complete darkness? Maybe as a living equation whose presence is expressed by the strange warping of reality as you pass through it, only able to be slain if you're unraveled by a complex mathematical formula that renders you down to zero? Maybe even as nothing more than a normal human, your cores being the lives of others, possessing the durability of a core and the regeneration of an Endbringer, unable to die unless those people are first killed. As before, you can freely change your nature and cores as easily as you can your own form. The full destruction of your form, your cores, and your other Endbringers is needed to kill you. You can split off your own cores to create other Human/Endbringer forms, one for each form, if you desire. Each form can be given its own unique shape and nature, and they can be made entirely autonomous from you although still follow any commands or desires, subconscious or otherwise. Your ability to construct power sets is now instantaneous, no longer requiring death. Instead in order to combat you someone must bring to bear an unholy amount of different powers and tactics and use them fast enough that you don’t adapt, a very unlikely scenario. More than likely all they’ll manage to do is delay the inevitable. You can allow the Endbringers to have existed once more, each as powerful as the most powerful Terror Drones with a single core from you. Their powers and forms are as malleable as your own and they can each possess any power and perk you would have possessed at the same scale as you would have without this addon, although your own will still bypass theirs. You can gift them any of your own abilities and/or Paradigm slots for greater effect, and can reclaim it at will. They will each possess one of your cores rather than their own as they are formed from you. You can choose whether they existed before you and you are now taking over, or whether they were always from you, even unwittingly if you are a reincarnation. You can freely create more by casting off one of your cores to construct one. Each additional core they are granted increases their power as they would your own. You can also assign a Core to another, turning them into an Endbringer and granting and/or amplifying their power to match. When regenerating a core you can use this to resurrect others you’ve made into Endbringers. You can reclaim your core and remove their status as Endbringers whenever you wish. Anyone who’s been transformed into any Endbringers will have their powers replicated as new a power set for yourself, if they had any. You’ll retain it even if they stop being an Endbringer after. If you're a reincarnation or character insert you may retroactively turn your companions and/or other people that are close to you into Endbringers. You can reabsorb any made Endbringers and their cores back into yourself as well, and can communicate with, use their senses and see their memories, and take over their forms at will. You can alter their personalities and programming at will, same way you would their form. Cores will regenerate within a day and a new one can be generated in a month (1 Hour/1 Week for Negentropic/Shardless), cores can be pushed outside of your body and left somewhere else, acting as a seed to regrow your body. A single seed core can regrow your body within a day. The more cores you carry the faster your regeneration is in general, your cores can also be allocated into a pocket dimension, being shoved into your form when the previous one is destroyed allowing you to continue fighting without having to regenerate around another core. You can render a core inert if you wish, allowing you to regenerate it if you ever need to for some reason, such as being unable to retrieve a seed core. You carry all your power and abilities in both human and Endbringer forms. Options that increase the power of Endbringers will also increase your own, and options that increase the amount of them will also increase the amount of cores you possess.
addons.title: The End

objects.text:
Your powers have greatly grown, mirroring Behemoth.

All of Behemoth’s known abilities are merely manifestations of his Energy Manipulation, while you imitate an approximation.

You’re a Tank rivaling the greatest of Brute short from Alexandria, although something of a close one at that. Your strength and durability work side by side for excessive shows of brute force, creating earthquakes from stomping or punching the ground with enough strength, producing powerful shockwaves with each physical action, with every part of your being radiating strength.

Furthermore, your ability to absorb kinetic energy from opposing attacks has grown more powerful, allowing for you to exponentially increase your durability along with your strength.

Your ability to control flames and heat has spread to a destructive quality, breaking havoc on anything and anyone to the point it reaches 1400°C, turning a rock into magma used as projectiles or collateral. Your handle of fire, and heat, so is their phenomena is clear-cut enough to extend to volcanic fields, explosive forces, and the like.

Your manipulation of physical forces is specialized in energy, uplifting your abilities. Your range has expanded to 500m², able to manipulate electricity to guide and control lighting on your own or cause electromagnetic pulses, radiation, and sonic energy to emulate Behemoth’s signature roars and absorb or redirect energy. You can use this as a sixth sense around you.

The resulting combination of your abilities is the creation of a smaller but no less intimidating Kill Aura around 5m², you bypass the Manton Effect and manifest energy from within anyone close enough, immolating them from the inside.

You can let out a majestic roar at will, by controlling sonic energy. This roar gradually grows more powerful until it can tear out eyeballs and cause buildings to shudder.

(If you have Normal Shard, then you have normal shard blindspots.
