If you have Vital shard, you are a natural blindspot to most thinkers, with only the Endbringers partially immune and the Entity fully immune, and your only blindspots are the Endbringers and the Entity. If you have Queen Shard, your only blindspot is the Entity and you are a blindspot that no one but the Entity is partially immune to.)
objects.title: Hero Killer

addons.text:
You are Leviathan, in the flesh. Your Endbringer form not only inherits all of Leviathan’s powers but is also unshackled from all the possible restrictions and directives he was placed for the Cycle.

Speed and proper perception are refined to grander levels both on land and water, with Mach 15 on land while Mach 50 while underwater or there’s water around, traveling at dizzying speeds throughout the world.

Your restriction of fine water control is lifted, able to manipulate any substance or material containing water around you, bring forth meteorological phenomena like downpours and storms, tsunamis, creating water pressures on aquifers around coasts eroding the coastland’s integrity to the point of sinking cities or islands on its own.

If Leviathan exists in the world you are in, you can retroactively take his place.
addons.title: Jörmungandr

objects.text:
Your powers have greatly grown, mirroring Leviathan. 

You are a macro-scale hydrokinetic, the base range of hydrokinesis is now the size of a large city such as New York, and can be further extended to the size of an extremely large island, such as Newfoundland or Kyushu. Your control is also better, and you can manipulate liquid water as if it was another limb. Your control now extends to non-liquid forms of water, such as steam and ice, though this control is much weaker than liquid water. However, with some time you are capable of converting them back into a liquid state.

Your ability to manipulate density is also extended to your water. Any water you control is automatically dense enough to rip through steel, and grows denser the longer you control it. You can also build up water pressure and tension, allowing you to level a city using aquifers given enough time. 

Your speed is greatly enhanced, and you are now capable of moving up to Mach 3 on a bad day. This speed is increased to ridiculous levels in water, you can move so quickly that you are essentially teleporting. Despite your increased speed, your flexibility and dexterity are immeasurable, you could simultaneously perform several complex surgeries at once without any error.

Rather than creating fiery copies, you now leave a water "echo" whenever you move. For instance, if you make a casual swipe of your hand, instead of the displaced air filling the space back up, it is replaced with water compressed enough to tear through buildings. This water follows the direction and speed you were moving at, so if you launch a punch at Mach 3 and suddenly stop, the water echo will be moving at hypersonic speeds. This is normal water, so hydrokinetics (including yourself) can control it. Weapons and equipment count as part of yourself.

(If you have Normal Shard, then you have normal shard blindspots. If you have Vital shard, you are a natural blindspot to most thinkers, with only the Endbringers partially immune and the Entity fully immune, and your only blindspots are the Endbringers and the Entity. If you have Queen Shard, your only blindspot is the Entity and you are a blindspot that no one but the Entity is partially immune to.)
objects.title: City Killer

addons.text:
You are now the Simurgh, in the flesh. Your Endbringer form not only inherits all of the Simurgh’s powers but is also free from all the limits she was placed on.

You can create any piece of technology from the past or future, as long as you have interacted with it at that time. Your precognitive abilities allow you to plan tens of thousands of years in advance with ease. In addition, with a glance, you can perfectly analyze a person, from the day they are born to the day they die. You subconsciously nudge things your way, making small changes to meet your long-term goals. Your control over matter is complete, as your telekinesis can tear apart atoms and even nudge the Earth in its orbit, with effort.

If the Simurgh exists in the world you are in, you can retroactively take her place.
addons.title: Ziz

objects.text:
Your powers have greatly grown, mirroring the Simurgh.

You temporarily gain access to all Thinker/Tinker powers within a 10-kilometer radius. You retain these powers for a day after they leave your radius, and retain a weakened version of their power, having around 20% of the original strength. Additionally, you are able to recreate and reconfigure tinkertech in your range even if their tinker isn’t there, although you will not be able to retain its ability.

Your singing can act as a sonar, allowing you to scan the area by singing. Your voice has also been enhanced, allowing your song to cover an entire city. The longer you sing, the further your song reaches, growing at an exponential rate. You can sense through whoever hears your song, seeing what they see, feeling what they feel. You also gain a boost in your understanding of the subtleties of the mind, allowing you to make minor, but profound changes to your target's mind, ones that may not be discovered for years.

Through the info gained from singing, your simulations have been greatly boosted. Now, even without singing, you can effortlessly simulate up to a few months into the future/past. Through your sonar-like singing, you can perfectly simulate at minimum one and a half years into the future/past of everything that will happen in the area, and through your memory reading, you can perfectly simulate everything the target has once experienced, and their various possible futures.

Your telekinesis has grown too, allowing you to telekinetically carry entire cars with little effort. Your fine control is great enough that you can construct extremely fine technology with your telekinesis. Your weight limit is also now only counted for individual objects rather than the total of everything you are carrying.

(If you have Normal Shard, then you have normal shard blindspots. If you have Vital Shard, you are a natural blindspot to most Thinkers, with only the Endbringers partially immune and the Entity fully immune, and your only blindspots are the Endbringers and the Entity. If you have Noble Shard, your only blindspot is the Entity, and you are a blindspot that no one but the Entity is partially immune to.)
objects.title: Hope Killer

addons.text:
You are now Khonsu, in the flesh. Your Endbringer form not only inherits all of Khonsu’s powers but is also free from all the possible restrictions and directives he was placed under for the Cycle.

Your mastery over time is now absolute, allowing you to manipulate it on a massive scale. You can accelerate, decelerate, or freeze time for entire regions, creating vast temporal zones where seconds stretch into centuries or decades collapse into moments. Your power to shift time pockets is unrestricted, enabling you to create overlapping layers of time dilation across the world simultaneously.

Your constructs of time are no longer bound by proximity or size. You can create massive temporal barriers, spanning entire cities, trapping everything within endless, unbreakable loops of repeated actions and moments. These loops are so seamless that even those caught inside them are unaware they are repeating the same actions, creating a sense of eternal stagnation and despair.

You are a living paradox, existing in multiple timelines simultaneously. This allows you to rewrite your recent actions retroactively, changing events to favor your goals. You can undo defeats, recreate destroyed constructs, or even place versions of yourself across different points in time.

If Khonsu exists in the world you are in, you can retroactively take his place.
addons.title: Aion

objects.text:
Your powers have greatly grown, mirroring Khonsu.

You now wield time as a weapon on a massive scale, capable of accelerating its flow within a radius of 5 kilometers. Within this range, you can create up to three distinct time-acceleration zones, each about the size of a city block. Within these zones, time flows so quickly that even the most resilient opponents are reduced to dust in moments. These zones degrade weapons, armor, and the environment, hastening the collapse of entire battlefields.

You have full control over the permeability of these zones, deciding whether biological life or objects can enter or exit. This grants you the ability to trap enemies, deny reinforcements, and reshape the battlefield into chaotic arenas of rapid decay and confinement.

Your teleportation has evolved into a near-limitless ability. By building up temporal energy, you can teleport to any location within your dimension. However, doing so collapses any lingering time-acceleration zones, forcing you to balance your mobility with your control over the battlefield.

Your mastery over time extends to your own body. By layering accelerated time bubbles within yourself, you can regenerate injuries at incredible speed and withstand blows that would otherwise incapacitate you. These time bubbles also amplify your physical durability, as deeper strikes are slowed, allowing your body to recover even mid-battle.
Your presence itself also creates subtle temporal distortion. Within your immediate surroundings, time becomes unpredictable for your enemies, causing their perception to speed up or slow down randomly. This throws off their coordination, disrupts their combat rhythm, and forces them to fight at a disadvantage.

The resulting combination of your powers makes you an unparalleled master of battlefield control. You disorient, weaken, and overwhelm your enemies with surgical precision. Wherever you walk, time bends to your will, eroding all resistance and leaving even the mightiest foes helpless against the inexorable tide of accelerated entropy.

(If you have Normal Shard, then you have normal shard blindspots. If you have Vital shard, you are a natural blindspot to most thinkers, with only the Endbringers partially immune and the Entity fully immune, and your only blindspots are the Endbringers and the Entity. If you have Noble Shard, your only blindspot is the Entity and you are a blindspot that no one but the Entity is partially immune to.)
objects.title: Eternity Killer

addons.text:
You are now Tohu, in the flesh. Your Endbringer form not only inherits all of Tohu’s powers but is also free from all the restrictions and directives she was placed under for the Cycle.

Your three faces no longer merely borrow abilities—they now embody the ultimate evolution of any power you claim. You can wield and perfect the abilities of three individuals simultaneously, amplifying them far beyond their original limits. Each power becomes an optimized version of itself, stripped of weaknesses and elevated to its most potent form.

You can now draw abilities from across the multiverse, bypassing dimensional boundaries and temporal limitations. Once acquired, these powers are permanently added to your arsenal, and your three faces can seamlessly switch between them, adapting to any situation with terrifying precision.

You are the ultimate counter-specialist. Not only can you take powers, but you can rewrite and reshape them, twisting them to perfectly counter any opponent. This instinctive understanding of abilities allows you to dismantle strategies before they even begin. No power is beyond your comprehension or adaptation, and you excel at finding and exploiting vulnerabilities no one else could see.

Your can also split into 3 separate bodies with each of your faces capable of acting and using their power in different locations across the world. This makes you a simultaneous, omnipresent threat capable of dominating multiple battlefields at once.

You are the embodiment of adaptability and supremacy. No matter how unique or intricate an ability may be, it becomes nothing more than a mere tool in your hands, turned ruthlessly against its owner. Even the greatest heroes are reduced to helpless novices, struggling in vain against the inevitability of their own defeat.

If Tohu exists in the world you are in, you can retroactively take her place.
addons.title: Athena

objects.text:
Your powers have greatly grown, mirroring Tohu.

You are now capable of temporarily acquiring the abilities of three individuals anywhere on the planet, living or dead. The powers you acquire are not mere imitations—they are perfected, stripped of any inherent weaknesses, inefficiencies, or limitations. With these refined abilities, you wield them with unmatched precision and expertise, far beyond what even their original wielders could achieve.

When you take a power, your body shifts to display three distinct faces, each corresponding to one of the individuals whose abilities you’ve taken. These faces act as symbols of mastery and dominance, forcing your opponents to confront their own potential weaponized against them.

Your powers are not limited to simple replication. You can seamlessly combine and adapt the abilities you acquire, creating devastating synergies that defy conventional logic. This allows you to exploit vulnerabilities in ways your enemies could never anticipate. Furthermore, your understanding of the powers extends to their origin and mechanics, granting you an unparalleled ability to formulate countermeasures, strategies, and exploits against any foe.

Your existence is a walking antithesis to potential and power—an ultimate counter to any who dare oppose you. Where others see their strengths as weapons, you turn them into their undoing. A form of dominance as terrifying as it is overwhelming, you are not just a wielder of power but a reflection of everyone’s greatest strengths turned into their worst nightmares.

(If you have Normal Shard, then you have normal shard blindspots. If you have Vital shard, you are a natural blindspot to most thinkers, with only the Endbringers partially immune and the Entity fully immune, and your only blindspots are the Endbringers and the Entity. If you have Noble Shard, your only blindspot is the Entity and you are a blindspot that no one but the Entity is partially immune to.)
objects.title: Nemesis Killer

addons.text:
You are now Bohu, in the flesh. Your Endbringer form not only inherits all of Bohu’s powers but is also unshackled from the restrictions and directives she was placed under for the Cycle.

Your dominion over reality has transcended geomancy. The very fabric of existence within your domain bends to your will—space, gravity, matter, and even the air itself become instruments of your wrath. You can create zones of crushing pressure, zero gravity, or nightmarish landscapes. 

Your reach now extends far beyond cities, turning entire continents into nightmarish voids of chaos and destruction. Your constructs have evolved into autonomous manifestations of pure energy—faster, deadlier, and disturbingly intelligent, working in perfect unison to enact your will.

Within your domain, the concept of stability ceases to exist. Time fractures, space folds upon itself, and the very ground becomes an unpredictable weapon. Entire landscapes dissolve into warped, incomprehensible geometries, collapsing under the weight of impossible forces. Where you tread, there is no escape, no shelter, and no chance of survival.

If Bohu exists in the world you are in, you can retroactively take her place.
addons.title: Tartarus

objects.text:
Your powers have greatly grown, mirroring Bohu.

You are now capable of fusing with the earth itself to become a towering monolith of destruction, reshaping the world around you on a massive scale. Your control begins with a radius of 5 kilometers and grows endlessly the longer you remain stationary, encompassing entire cities in less than half an hour.

Within your domain, the environment bends to your will. Buildings twist into towering spires, walls rise to block escape, and the ground churns into unpredictable, shifting terrain. Doors, windows, and streets can collapse or seal entirely, isolating enemies and funneling them into meticulously designed kill zones.

Your power extends beyond mere destruction and precision-engineered constructs. Crushing walls, frictionless surfaces, shifting pitfalls, and elaborate mechanical traps emerge and dissolve as needed, turning the terrain into the perfect weapon against any foe.

Within this ever-changing chaos, you can summon physical constructs forged from the terrain itself. These earthen minions are swift, relentless, and as durable as the material they’re formed from. Acting as extensions of your will, they corral enemies into traps, reinforce your defenses, or overwhelm them with sheer numbers.

Spikes remain your most omnipresent weapon, emerging without warning from any surface in your domain. Razor-sharp and lightning-fast, they can pierce steel and flesh alike in an instant before retracting to strike anew.

Your domain is no mere battlefield—it is an extension of yourself, a living weapon of unrelenting destruction.

(If you have Normal Shard, then you have normal shard blindspots. If you have Vital shard, you are a natural blindspot to most thinkers, with only the Endbringers partially immune and the Entity fully immune, and your only blindspots are the Endbringers and the Entity. If you have Noble Shard, your only blindspot is the Entity and you are a blindspot that no one but the Entity is partially immune to.)
objects.title: Reality Killer

objects.text:
Your specialties have fused into a greater whole, allowing for the creation of semi-sentient, hyperdense, and crystalline constructs. In order to create these constructs, your Shard has given you 2 secondary powers:

Material Expansion: You can grow any biological or crystal-based material via touch. You can control the minute details of this expansion. For example, if someone had brain damage, you could regrow it in such a way that they are loyal solely to you. You don't have to touch the exact organ: you could regrow someone's heart with a handshake. 

Density Expansion: With a touch, you can expand the density of any biological or crystal based material. Interestingly, this change in density does not impact weight. You can use this power in either direction, increasing something's density to the point of invulnerability or spreading it thin enough to be invisible. 

You can affect yourself indirectly by cutting off flesh, applying your powers, and reattaching it.

With these new capabilities, you can easily create beings like Blasto's failed Simurgh clone, Morrigan. Your creations have high Brute and Mover ratings, resilient enough to endure several blows by Alexandria-level Brutes. With resources and time, you can create Conflict Sentinels, the weaker version of Endbringers planned by Eden. However, these creations of yours do not have unique powers beyond their Brute rating and any biological abilities you add in yourself.

Your power has a unique interaction with Endbringer Flesh. Instead of your power failing to act, you can slowly apply your Material and Density Expansion to create more. If you somehow had access to an Endbringer flesh sample with all of the layers, you could create a perfect Endbringer clone, including the powers. However, this will require extensive research. Your creations literally live and die for your goals, like the Simurgh.

You are an expert in creating crystal-based biological components, living crystal organisms, and manipulating/creating Cauldron Vials from Shards. You can generally determine how mixing certain Shards will impact the final product, and minimize (or maximize) the risk of horrific mutations. If you had access to an Entity corpse and several "volunteers", you may even be able to perfect the formula completely.
objects.title: Maker of the End

objects.text:
Thanks to the [DATA] of your other abilities, your monster manufacturing power has unlocked its true potential and turned you into a [Construct] builder. A [Construct], in essence, is a mobile autonomous superpower-bearing minion made of hyper-dense crystalline flesh engulfing a "core". They are all completely loyal to you and immune to Master powers (they will also not listen to your orders if you are mastered into giving them one), Thinker powers will have trouble assessing them and Trump powers will fail to affect them most of the time.

Your power will generate energy at a 1 SP rate per day which can used to form the core for your minion with up to 50 SP maximum for their creation, modifications can be made to it to shape the general aspect of your [Construct] while energy can be used from your reserves to upgrade, repair and modify it as you wish. You can also give any of them up to tier 2 powers, they can have multiple powers but too different ones might cause instability or outright failure, tier 1 has a one-to-one ratio for each SP allocated for the corresponding powers, and tier 2 has a one-to-two ratio.

Once done, the core can be activated with a moment of concentration to unleash your [Construct], its body being quickly constructed from energy stored in the core. Said core is the only essential part of your [Construct] and any damage done to the rest is nothing but cosmetic and will regenerate rapidly. Do note however that the cores of your creatures do not possess the dimensional defenses of true Endbringers and can be damaged by regular powers, though they are extremely thought and increase in durability the more energy you spend on a specific one.

Finally, know that each time you create a new core, an energy link is created with your power toward your new creations. The more links you have, the slower your power will give you free energy to create new ones until you reach a bottleneck at around 8 cores. You can also reverse their deployment to return them to their core, putting them in a "dormant" state where their energy use is lessened.
objects.title: Conflict Drive Architect

objects.text:
Your ability to summon people from other worlds has been enhanced. It can now be used with your ability to create monsters to summon permanent crystalline-organic copies of warriors from other worlds.

Each selected warrior can only be as strong as an Endbringer and uses one of Endbringer Engine’s slots, but can be summoned at roughly 40sp with all the memories, skills, weaknesses, and abilities of their real selves. They will then ramp up to the strength of a full-grown Endbringer (or about 60 SP) at the rate of 1 SP a week. These copies are completely loyal and can be used in any role, from teachers and healers to frontline combatants.

Summoning these copies costs zero resources or charges from any power besides Endbringer Engine.

Additionally, without Esoteric Knowledge, these copies are simply simulations of real people and thus only emulate their powers, severely limiting their ability to pass on their abilities.

Furthermore, you must be mindful of your energy expenditure, as without Negentropy, you will run the risk of depleting your shard if you use your crystalline-organic warriors' most powerful abilities too often. Remember to keep in mind that all of the energy your summons use comes from your Shard.
objects.title: Army of the Impossible

addons.text:
With the increase in power of your Administrator power you have not only doubled the rate of growth of your summoned Endbringers but also spawned three new abilities. 

First, the scale of the powers that can be stored in your Administrator power’s slots has further increased. 

Secondly, you can now summon a temporary additional fully grown Endbringer at the cost of a high tier 3 powers from your Administrator power. Furthermore, you also have the ability to do the opposite, shutting down an Endbringer to gain access to an additional high tier 3 power for yourself to use. 

Finally, can now fuse with and take control of any one of your Endbringers, allowing you access to both your Administrator power and that Endbringers abilities and durability.

However, be mindful that all of your Endbringers and your own abilities all draw energy from the same source. Meaning using too many Endbringers abilities without Negentropy runs the risk of completely depleting your shard.
addons.title: A Super Administrator and their Army of Nightmares

objects.text:
It seems your Endbringer Engine isn’t some mere downgraded emulation but a fully fledged version. As a result, the strength of the powers you can hold in Administrator power has massively increased, and your ability to control and design your Endbringer’s powers is further enhanced.

With Negentropy, you are a true nightmare, and the final strength of your Endbringers is raised to 80 SP (however, the growth rate is still 1 SP per month).
objects.title: Fractured No More

objects.text: You know when you're being simulated and can either act differently in the simulation or just shut the simulation off altogether. You recall all simulated memories after the simulation ends unless the simulated version of you decides otherwise.
objects.title: Meta Knowledge

objects.text:
You can permanently grant people any knowledge or power you have, including this one, without using up a wish. In exchange the recipient must lose something that is of equal value to them. You also have the option to waive the exchange fee, but this will require using up a wish. The value of what you are granting them is judged based on two factors. 

The first is how much personal value the power or skill has for them. This not only includes their conscious wants but also their unconscious needs. The second is the inherent value of what they are receiving. A power is more valuable the stronger and more versatile it is. Knowledge is more valuable the less people know about it and how hard it is to learn. You will always be aware of what the total value is.

It is possible for something with a low inherent value to have its total value significantly inflated if the person values it that highly. However, such an event would require them to have extreme amounts of desperation or obsession.
objects.title: Equivalent Exchange

objects.text: As long as you make it look like an accident, if you sabotage a business no one but the business itself will blame you.
objects.title: Cabbage Corp

objects.text: As long as the group knowingly doesn't follow your safety protocols, you can ruin their business and no one but the business itself will blame you.
objects.title: OSHA Inspector

objects.text: If the employees and workers in the group/business are physically and mentally unfit to continue work, yet continue to do so, you can ruin the business as well as those causing problems and no one but the business itself will blame you.
objects.title: OSHA Inspector v2

addons.text: Those working for you will gain a major boost in their abilities. If they do not do the work they are required to do, the boost will weaken.
addons.title: Employee of the Month

objects.text: People who follow your plans will gain a significant increase in their abilities. Straying from the plan will reduce the potency of the boost. This also removes the face to face requirement; allowing you to send orders from anywhere, as long as the other party can hear it.
objects.title: Strategies

objects.text: You can use Miss Militia's power with any Tinkertech weapon you've touched.
objects.title: Soldier of the Future

objects.text: You can convert any Tinkertech you analyze to a biological version of the tech.
objects.title: Biotech

objects.text: When altering yourself with Self-Biokinesis you are not limited by the matter in your body, you can create extra matter from nothing.
objects.title: Biomass Generation

objects.text: As long as it originally came from your own body, you can control/sense/use your powers through your flesh regardless of range.
objects.title: Fleshy Bits

objects.text: If you've beaten a Parahuman in battle, you permanently have the 50% as powerful version of their power, even when you have a 100% as powerful power active. You can have an unlimited number of those 50% as powerful powers active.
objects.title: The Legion of the Fae

addons.text: Your parasite can now take control over their host instantly instead of needing to wait for them to weaken. Furthermore, you now have a hive mind that can be accessed by you holding all the knowledge of all the independent creatures under your control. All knowledge all the creature under your control is yours to use, even the stolen knowledge from the parasites. You no longer merely control the body but even have access to the mind.
addons.title: The Flesh Betrays

addons.text: When in control over a host, the creatures can choose to preserve their host’s life at the cost of forcing them into excruciating pain and making it so that the parasite is unable to enhance their host body when they take control. Using their half dead host, the parasites can create new larval for you, each having in-built growths that resemble their parents. This will allow you to bypass the daily 9-10 limit.
addons.title: They Hunger

objects.text: Your ability to create larvae and control insects is now fully synchronized, unlocking a new level of power. All creatures spawned through Breed now gain access to a breaker state—a parasitic form that allows them to invade and feed off a host from the inside. Once a parasite enters a host, it begins to rapidly drain their nutrients, leaving even the strongest individual frail and wasted within days. An obese person could be reduced to a skeletal, malnourished figure in a day or two. The parasite can control the host. The weaker the host, whether physically or mentally, the longer the parasite can maintain control over their body. During this time, the host’s body is not only sustained but enhanced by the parasite’s growing strength, amplified two or threefold by the nutrients they consume. The creature can also access the full range of their host’s memories and knowledge, using it to their advantage while the host is alive. If their host has a power, the creature may grow to replicate a version of said power. The host's death is inevitable, typically occurring within a week of infection, but all of the host’s knowledge, skills, and insights are preserved within the parasite even after death. After Host death, the parasite will be forced to leave its breaker state until it finds a new host. By this point it would have already grown greatly, at the very minimum they would have left their Laval state already.
objects.title: Body Snatchers

addons.text: The strength of the creatures you create is based off the amount of times you create them. The longer you have them created and more often you create them, the stronger and more mutated they become. At some point, you could, for example, create a centipede with enough venom to kill Alexandria.
addons.title: Ōmukade

addons.text: You are not limited to insects anymore, instead able to create a pair of super-versions of whatever you can control by your sides.
addons.title: Mukade’s Skittering Swarm

objects.text: You can now create a pair of any and all insects from the sides of your body. They will also gain superpower like biology, for example spiders will be able to make threads thinner than hair and stronger than tungsten, while remaining sticky enough that nothing has a chance to escape. Their stamina is tied with yours.
objects.title: Mukade’s Skitterforge

addons.text: You can mutate anything you can control, giving them traits from one another. The senses of a dog, the vitality of a roach, the toughness of a boar, etc..
addons.title: Skittering Swarm

addons.text: The more an insect is mutated, the bigger they increase your range.
addons.title: Swarming Mutants

addons.text: You can transform into mutated bugs, although the more mutated the bugs you transform into the less bugs you transform into.
addons.title: Monstrous Insects

objects.text:
You can cause your bugs to rapidly grow and evolve, gaining special traits not naturally available, such as invisibility or fire breathing. Any additional powers you may have can be expressed through your bugs. (Bugs with tactile telekinesis, or bugs with natural biological tinkertech for example.)

Your bugs also become more independent, able to understand and obey your orders even when outside your control. The longer a bug remains under your control, the greater the changes and stronger they become. You can even cannibalise other bugs under your control to increase the rate of other bugs mutations.
objects.title: Bug Evolution

objects.text: You can control not only rodents and bugs, but any non-Sapient lifeforms not resistant to Master effects.
objects.title: Skittering Legions

addons.text: You can fuse anything you can control together to create clones of anyone you have controlled. These clones are completely under your control, and has all of their original powers. The clone bodies must remain within 200 meters of yourself, as they will break apart back to their base components if not. If you make clones of yourself, they will also have a personal power radius which can increase the range of your control.
addons.title: Hive

addons.text: Your authority over the minds of others has subsumed your technopathy, extending its reach to the digital realm as well, for what is a mind if not a biological computer. While you cannot control purely mechanical machines, you do possess absolute control of any software within your range. You can even use digital connections to extend your control beyond your normal range, however your authority is no longer absolute in machines outside your range.
addons.title: Machine Life

addons.text: Your ability to control Shards through physical contact with their Hosts has extended your control even further, with the Shards of those who enter your range automatically falling under Gestation’s sway. As a side effect, this allows you to bypass powers which would make people immune to your control, as you can simply use their innate connection to their Shard to gain a backdoor to their mind.
addons.title: [Authority]

objects.text: Your powers have fused, now your range is determined by the complexity of your targets minds. You could control all the bugs within a 5 kilometer radius or control all humans within a 200 meter range or anything in between. In addition to this, you gain a minor thinker power in relation to coordination, allowing you to do complex operations with those you are controlling. This allows you to have all those you are controlling to seamlessly work together.
objects.title: Dominion

addons.text:
Anything you control now can grow via eating, growing in size, strength and intelligence. They are also able to gain powers through the same methods of your rats.

Beyond that, they also gain the ability to gain minor powers through eating objects or creatures. Eating more of that objects or creatures, or similar objects or creatures, will strengthen that power, or to gain a new power from that object. 

They can only have up to 5 of these powers active at once, with each power growing no more than 3 SP.

Your creatures can breed with one another, even crossbreeding being possible, letting the powers and mutations they have fuse and awaken in their children. These children will always grow to be stronger than their parents, by at minimum 1%. 

You can also vomit and create any creature you control. They will be fully matured upon creation, however any ability and/or mutation of your vomited creature have must have been gained by another one of your natural creatures, in other words you cannot create new abilities, only recreate ones already gained.
addons.title: Legionarius

addons.text:
All the creatures under your control now passively evolve, their natural traits pushing past their natural limits and becoming minor powers in their own right. A spider’s venom capable of killing regenerators, a dog’s sense capable of detecting stranger effects, etc. Any minor power they may gain through eating is now reflected upon their appearance, and can grow to a maximum of 5 SP, with no limit on how many minor powers they can have.

Once they become humanoid, they will gain a specialized power based off all their powers and mutations. Their specialized power will be no weaker than that of an average parahuman. They can only gain one specialized power through maturity.

Children of your creatures will inherit a weaker version of both their parent’s specialized power, and will gain a derivative of these powers after reaching maturity.
addons.title: Monstrum

addons.text: You can transform into a swarm of your mutated and/or hybrid creatures, however any ability and/or mutation of your created swarm have must have been gained by another one of your natural creatures, in other words you cannot create new abilities, only recreate ones already gained. In addition, within a limited range of your “body” you can have complete control over any of your creatures, even if they have completely matured.
addons.title: Typhoeus

addons.text: Your control over your rats no longer degrades as you mutate and improve them. They can still act independently and will be loyal if they leave you range. You can choose to give them independence or to completely control them down to their involuntary actions.
addons.title: Deus Rattorum

objects.text:
You can now enhance rats that you control, but doing so results in decreasing your ability to sense through them. Your rats will all gain the ability to independently grow by eating.

Your rats can gain the traits of what they eat. If they eat a dog, they can gain slightly enhanced senses. If they eat the flesh of parahuman, they can gain a minor power based off their target. For example, if they eat a pyrokinetic they can gain the ability to rapidly heat their body although this will still burn them if they can’t handle the temperature. If they eat the corona potentia (or the brain if Shardless) they can gain a variant of the target’s powers.

Your rats can breed with one another, letting the powers they may have fuse and awaken in their children. The pups will need only 1 day to mature.

After reaching a certain size, about 5x their original size, they will mature, with their growth altered, and they will instead slowly become more humanoid. Their humanoid form will still be obviously non-human. They will grow more intelligent, and you will lose direct control over them in exchange they will be extremely loyal to you, seeing you as their creator and obeying you even when out of your range.

Any rat you vomit out now will come out fully matured. However any ability and/or mutation of your vomited rat has must have been gained by another one of your natural rats, in other words you cannot create new abilities, only recreate ones already gained.
objects.title: Muroidea Imperator

objects.text: If you repair their corpse, you can bring anyone back to life. They will not have any brain damage or memory loss.
objects.title: Resurrection

objects.text: Your Arcanist and Artificer powers synergize giving you access to the ability to create Wards, spells that are anchored to an area using ward stones. Wards can be connected together to pass information between them. Ward stones are not affected by the enchantment limit, be careful what you mix together however. If a wardstone is destroyed it will collapse all wards it is powering and those it is connected to.
objects.title: Ward Master

objects.text:
You can now use your charges in place of other requirements. 

For powers such as Arcanist, Kineticist, Martial Adept, etc, this means you can use your charges to cast effects in place of your reserve of power. Due to the nature of a charge’s otherwise eternal lifetime, a single charge equates to your entire pool of energy. 

A single charge is treated as equivalent to your full reserve of energy. When used this way, the charge fully pays the cost of the effect without reserving any portion of your pool.

This allows permanent effects (such as summons, constructs, buffs, or auras) to be sustained independently, freeing your reserve for active use. These effects persist without draining your energy and can be dismissed at will. This included permanent effects on others, objects, or locations as you would yourself. 

Additionally, charges may be used to cast abilities directly, allowing you to bypass reserve limitations entirely when needed.

For Alchemist, this means you can use charges to replace ingredients entirely, and if you’ve already created a potion in the past to simply activate the effect through a charge. 

For Armiger this will allow you to improve your designs through your charges. This will also allow you to summon constructs through charges rather than your reserve of power, when constructs are dismissed they return your charges same as they would your reserve.

If you possess Ward Master, you can now use your charges to create wards. You no longer need to anchor them to a Ward stone, instead able to treat them similar to permanent effects, just tied to locations or objects if you wish.
objects.title: Cambium

addons.text:
Your knowledge of creating “life” has been expanded by your chi. The application of spiritual energy has allowed you to give this “life” back to the dead in the form of a corpse puppet, commonly called a Jiangshi.

A Jiangshi is a mindless servant created using dead bodies. This is not a zombie; the flesh and bone of the puppet is as “alive” as your other creations. The main benefit of this is that a Jiangshi can use the abilities it had in life, and in the case of parahumans, their powers as well. In the case of those with powers, they will require chi to be injected into their core to properly use them. They can still operate as a “normal” worker without chi but will be unable to use any of their powers.

Chi can also be applied to the cores of both your Golems, Homunculi, and even your Holmcrosses to strengthen them and prevent their destruction in both combat and harsh environments. It is also possible to combine all of your creations into a Holmpucross. The integration of your magnum open into a flesh puppet not only grants it free thinking and growth, but also the ability to drain chi on its own, turning its core into a pseudo-dantian. This will allow it to become much stronger and grow at a much faster rate.
addons.title: Corpse Puppetry

addons.text:
You can now turn cores into bricks that can drive brick constructs as autonomous creatures. Simply placing the core in a brick construct will bring it to life. Living constructs can be taken apart and reconstructed with new parts without harming them.

You can also now make bio-organic bricks to put together into creatures that can be animated by the core bricks, such as eyes, organs, joints as well as brain bricks that enhance the core’s intelligence but do not contain the self.

You can also roll specific quirks to choose to add to a core brick or normal core that should be developed around to grant a golem or homunculi increased capabilities. All cores will also now have a 7x7 internal block grid which can be fitted with a limited selection of blocks to modify and enhance a golem or homonculus’s existing capabilities.
addons.title: Brickasaurus

objects.text:
You now have the knowledge and capability to create one of the most invaluable assets for production power: Manpower. This entity operates tirelessly, without the need for rest, sustenance, betrayal, or interruption unless absolutely necessary. It ranges from the "Inorganic" and "lifeless" Golems to the "alive" and "breathing" Homunculi.

Golems are engineered for straightforward and systematic tasks, lacking creativity or deviation from their base orders. Conversely, Homunculi are "alive" entities capable of delicate tasks and some degree of "thinking outside the box" within their basic framework. While the creation and directives for these entities are not confined in scale and scope, humanoid forms of average size and capabilities prove the easiest and most efficient to manufacture.

Regardless of the type you create, they all possess a "Core" component at their foundation, serving as the sole driving force. This core animates the materials comprising their form, which can vary from liquids, gases, solids, to even exotic types of matter, with the "core" being their principal weakness and the site of their most fundamental functions. The material of this core and the quality, quantity, and focus of the enchantment will define the general stats, modus operandi, and capabilities, such as speed of movement, carrying capacity, reaction time, and more.

Your "Magnus Opus" is the Holmcross, a Golem/Homunculus hybrid that embodies the best qualities of both at its base form. Crafted from Life-impregnated steel, blood (and organs), and magic, it possesses the remarkable ability of free thinking and growth, symbolizing a fusion of artistry, science, and magic.
objects.title: The Life Maker

addons.text: Power Copied with Fighting makes me stronger, Manager, and Oberon can be shared with the party.
addons.title: Copied Powers

addons.text: When you die, your party members return with you to the last save point.
addons.title: Time Loop & Save Slots

objects.text: Soulmate is integrated into the Gamer system, allowing you to create a party an invite members. You start with one party slot and get a new slot every 10 levels. Party members can use the Gamer system as you would as long as they are in the party. Their own powers (if they have any) are integrated into the system. You can share weakened versions of your own powers with them.
objects.title: Four is a Party

objects.text:
Your Time-Loop has gained added security from your ability to evade detection from thinkers. Thanks to Shroud, you gain an adaptive local obfuscation to powers capable of perceiving or handling timelines, and difficulty of ascertaining changes or opportunities within your Time-Loop. It puts forward the notion that while these powers are aware of your Time-Loop, they're often confused or don't have any easy footing, as Shroud either distorts their perception to be misdirected.

If you have Blank, your timeline is instead shifted onto a unique layer of reality, making all other powers that manipulate the timeline unable to detect or interact with your Time-Loop.
objects.title: Sole Looper

objects.text: You can choose to see an unlimited amount of visions, but at the cost of them being ten seconds long. You can also use this ability within other precognitive visions, including Schrodinger. You are able to subconsciously filter these visions into specific scenarios so that they don't overload your mind.
objects.title: Optimal Choice

addons.text: Instead of 10 seconds, each of your visions can last at least 5 minutes.
addons.title: Limitless Paths

addons.text: You can now pause and choose from a number of select futures, the number of futures and the length of those futures are inversely proportional. You can see and choose either from five futures, each lasting indefinitely, all the way up to a hundred futures, each up to a day long. You do not have to select a future to see it.
addons.title: Nidhogg

objects.text: Your five visions can last indefinitely, although if you choose one of the vision the other 4 must be dropped.
objects.title: 5 Coiling Serpents

objects.text: Your clones can now last indefinitely, however will be far more vulnerable to the effects of time, aging faster and being erased instantly if under the effect of any time based power (such as Clockblocker).
objects.title: Paradoxical

addons.text:
Your Animals Friends have become even stronger. They have a total of 15SP for powers (or 20SP with Negentropy) to put towards a maximum of three powers. You still need the appropriate Shard rank to select T2 Powers and cannot pick any of the Endbringer powers, Doll Master, or Friendbringers. You can strengthen/weaken powers from the list to a different cost or substitute them for powers of equivalent strength that aren't listed.

In addition to both the free flight and the ability to back up your friends if they are destroyed, they can alter and boost each other’s power sets in the same way they could do your own power set. It is also possible for you to alter their power sets in turn, allowing you to either change their powers temporarily or permanently after about an hour of contact.
addons.title: Super Animal Friends

objects.text:
Friendbringers has assimilated Spirit Animal into itself and copied or absorbed a powerset-generating ability of yours, evolving greatly in the process: In exchange for the minor drawback of requiring all of your Friends to take on animal or animal-like forms, you now have a total of six Friends, and each of them may be any size that Spirit Animal could manifest.

Furthermore, your Friends now all have a secondary power that allows them to alter and boost your powerset: By either riding, carrying or otherwise directly interecting in a similar way with a Friend, they can change your other powers in a manner thematically appropriate with whatever animal they resemble, almost always in a way that directly upgrades it - an avian Friend might alter your Blaster, Striker or Shaker abilities to include razor feathers, or alter your Mover abilities to include gliding or outright flight, for example.
objects.title: Animal Friends

objects.text: Every living being that your are actively aware of is part of a Health Network, where damage may be redistributed to anyone else in the network at your wish. If you cannot react fast enough, damage will automatically redistribute according to a priority system that you control.
objects.title: Health Network

addons.text: When you assimilate someone, their powers are assimilated as well, allowing everyone in the hive mind access to them at the same time.
addons.title: Power Assimilation

objects.text: When you dominate someone, you can choose to add them to your Hive Mind, joining them with your stream of consciousness. This gives your Hive Mind perfect control over them, and causes any effects from domination to last forever instead of degrading. You may undo this at any time.
objects.title: Assimilation

objects.text: All your powers now benefit from the energy stored in Solar, empowering them proportional to the amount of currently stored solar energy. At full power you can tank nukes with Man of Steel or level mountain ranges, with Soaring through the Sky like a Flying Bison you could circle the globe in an hour or use it as a type of flying super speed for omnidirectional mid combat purposes. Each exertion with these powers uses up energy stored by Solar proportional to the energy required for the task you performed. Solar now charges much quicker; you can go from empty to a full tank in a week.
objects.title: Generic Superman Expy

objects.text:
You have become a sentient swarm of virus. Outwardly, you appear normal, but you possess an array of extraordinary abilities that revolve around your symbiotic relationship with the viral hivemind and the fusion of organic forms within your being.

You command a vast hivemind comprised of creatures and entities under your control. This sentient swarm operates as an interconnected collective consciousness, allowing you to communicate and share knowledge instantaneously with every being within the hivemind. Any creature created or influenced by your virus becomes a part of this hivemind, further enhancing your control and expanding your reach.

Through your viral infestation, you possess the ability to place parasites within individuals who come into contact with your virus, whether through touch or inhalation. These parasites grant you unparalleled insights into their thoughts, actions, and memories, enabling you to learn anything they know. You can also seize control of their bodies, usurping their motor functions as if they were extensions of your own being.

Your fusion of man and plant grants you an exceptional reservoir for holding biomass, far surpassing the limits of what should be logically possible. This excess biomass can be channeled to fuel your abilities, enhance your physical attributes, create unique biological traits, or form a wide range of biological structures and items. You have the power to craft organic weaponry, fortifications, and tools, each imbued with unique effects and properties tailored to your needs.

Within your hivemind, you hold absolute dominion. You can orchestrate intricate strategies, coordinate the actions of your minions, and exploit their collective knowledge, allowing you to manipulate the growth of plants and creatures from vast distances, morphing them into new forms to adapt to any situation.
objects.title: Yaldabaoth

objects.text:
You have become the Celestial Artificer, gaining the ability to enhance items through two primary functions: Upgrading and Enchanting. Upgrading allows the wielder to elevate an item's rarity, which determines its level of power and quality. The rarity levels are as follows:

* Trash (Gray) - These are mundane items without any effects, akin to common everyday objects like rocks or kitchen knives. They can hold a single enchantment.
* Common (White) - Representing Items with weak effects. Possess 2 enchantment slots and costing 3 charges to raise from Trash.
* Uncommon (Green) - Moving up the ranks, Uncommon items possess 3 enchantment slots, and a Mundane rarity can be upgraded to this level with 7 charges.
* Rare (Blue) - With 5 enchantment slots, their potential for unique effects is expanded, and they can be upgraded from Uncommon with 13 charges.
* Epic (Purple) - Powerful Items with 7 enchantment slots, and requiring 19 charges to upgrade from Rare.
* Exotic (Yellow) - Minor Artifacts possessing 9 enchantment slots, and requiring 25 charges to upgrade from Epic.
* Unique (Red) - Representing Grand Artifacts, Unique items have 12 enchantment slots and need 32 charges to upgrade from Exotic.
* Legendary (Orange) - The penultimate, items of this grade possess 15 enchantment slots and can be upgraded from Unique with 40 charges.
* Mythical (Black) - The pinnacle, these are Divine Artifacts, with 20 enchantment slots, and are immensely potent, requiring 50 charges to upgrade from Legendary.

The second function, Enchanting, involves applying anomalous effects to items. Every enchantment costs a single "Charge," and wielder gain three Charges every day. The only limits of enchantments is the wielder creativity, from enhancing a blade's sharpness to imbuing healing aura or curses onto an item, with higher rarity grades unlocking access to more powerful and unique enchantments. Mythical and Legendary enchantments may require more than one Charge to be applied.
objects.title: Celestial Artificer

objects.text:
Your power has transcended conventional limitations and no longer distinguishes between inorganic and biological matter. You may now enchant people, animals, plants, and even yourself as if they were standard objects.

This does not increase the maximum strength, complexity, or number of enchantments a target can hold. Instead, living beings are simply reclassified as valid enchantment targets within your existing Artificer framework. Biological enchantments, such as reinforced muscles, or manifested wings, become intrinsic to the target, instinctively controllable, and may be smoothly scaled down to their natural baseline if desired.
objects.title: Living Relic Artificer

addons.text: Your artificer powers merge together. The amount of charges you produce a day is increased by 15 (20 with Shardless/Negentropy), and each level grants thrice as many slots. You require half as many charges to level up. Charges don’t have diminishing returns.
addons.title: Craftsman’s Workshop

addons.text: Your “arcane” grandmaster powers merge together. The amount of charges you produce a day increased by 20 (30 with Shardless/Negentropy), and each level grants five times as many slots. You require half as many charges to level up. Charges don’t have diminishing returns.
addons.title: Archmage’s  Workshop

addons.text:
Araboth and Paradigm merge and coalesce into one ability. The amount of charges is cut down to half however each charge has crystallized into something greater, roughly thrice as powerful as before. Once you reach the Mythical level the amount and potency of charges you produce will double, and continue to do so every time you reach it again. 

You lose the extra starting slots granted by Araboth and no longer have inactive slots. In exchange, the distinction between an Araboth slot and Paradigm slot disappears; each becomes capable of using the powers and enchantments their component powers could produce, and will mutate and adapt as Paradigm normally does. This also applies to the base power as well. Paradigm will be able to contain more powerful abilities as you make your way through the upper levels, similar to enchantments. 

The enchantment process takes a more flexible approach, allowing you to not only generate new abilities on the fly but rapidly advance them by pouring more charges into them.
addons.title: Sigillum Dei

addons.text:
Araboth subsumes Manager, adding its capabilities to itself and mutating new ones. Manager’s slots are added to Araboth. 

Powers copied or stolen by manager can now be added to your slots, and you can manipulate powers enchantments as you would before. This also copies the power’s pattern for yourself as well for later recreation. 

However the biggest change is you can now enhance and enchant other people the same way you would yourself or items.
addons.title: Arakiel

addons.text:
Araboth’s path of improvement and enlightenment can now be extended beyond yourself and applied to other living beings. However, other beings begin at Grey level with only one starting active power/enchantment slot and three storage slots.

Like you, they may swap powers between storage and active slots, and they gain three additional storage slots for every new active power/enchantment slot they acquire as they climb toward Mythical.

Once you reach Mythical level, you may also spend Charges to enhance Araboth itself, such as increasing the number of Charges you gain daily or granting others the ability to generate Charges. The sky is the limit so long as your shard still has energy left, a very real risk you run without Negentropy.
addons.title: Raziel

addons.text:
All previous restrictions on Araboth are removed.

Not only can you now begin refining Araboth itself before reaching Mythical, but you may also start refining non-physical targets, such as concepts, abstractions, and fundamental laws. You could, for example, refine someone’s humanity, the law of gravity, or even the distance between the Earth and Moon.

Anything that can be meaningfully defined as an existing “thing” is now a valid refinement target.
addons.title: Zaphkiel

addons.text:
Refining and improving only “existing” concepts is no longer sufficient to contain you. You may now create something from nothing.

You may use your Charges to bring entirely new physical objects, beings, systems, or metaphysical constructs into existence. This can be as simple as creating a mundane tool, or as extreme as manifesting a fully real copy of a favorite fictional character, complete with their internal structure and potential.

You may also create wholly new abstract principles, such as personal laws of physics, novel metaphysical forces, or localized conceptual frameworks that exist around or within you.

As before, the more powerful, complex, or far-reaching the created object or concept is, the more energy it requires to bring into existence.
addons.title: Metatron

objects.text:
You’ve started to walk the path of self-improvement and enlightenment, enhancing and enchanting your body and items alike. Prototype subsumes Celestial Artificer, gaining the ability to enhance yourself, expanding your overall power, and granting enchantments to yourself. Your starting point is Grey.

Your powers meld together flawlessly, allowing you the capability to swap out Enchantments and Powers on both yourself and items you’ve enhanced, you have no restrictions on the kind of powers and enchantments you can make. The sum of their parts are greatly enhanced as well in comparison to their components. Legendary and Mythic enchantments no longer require more than 1 charge and you can spend additional charges to further amplify and tweak existing abilities. 

Upon reaching Mythical level, you can spend the equivalent amount of charges it would take getting from Grey to White, to once again magnify your potency by the same degree it would the first time as well as granting you the same amount of additional slots to store powers. You can follow this until you once again reach Mythical level, letting you restart the process. This applies to both objects and powers. You can freely swap whatever you have stored in your items with your own collection and vice versa.

You produce 10 charges a day (15 with Shardless/Negentropy), and the amount of slots you gain with each level stays the same, however, level Grey instead starts with 6 active slots instead of 1. They also always have twice as many inactive slots to store other enchantments/powers that they can instantly swap out. You can take back/reallocate reallocate your charges at any time. Shardless/Negentropy increases the initial starting slots to 8 and inactive slots will be thrice as many active slots.
objects.title: Araboth

addons.text:
Through the fusion of Engine of Escalation and Paradigm, your shard has mutated into the Kaleidoscope Fractal Core, allowing it to brute force access to the vast Data catalogs of The Warrior, The Thinker, The Wanderer, and even the esoteric Data of Shardless. This seamless integration removes the constraints of power tiers.

Initially, your maximum powers are limited to the equivalent of Greater Keystones, but with time, this will progressively expand in scope. When confronted with challenges lacking immediate solutions, your powers instinctively provide the most appropriate options available. Moreover, the number of power slots will gradually increase over time, further enhancing your versatility.

Furthermore, the Kaleidoscope Fractal Core continually scans your surroundings, gathering and generating new Data. This constantly evolve your catalog and ensures that it's constantly adapts, refines, and refashions itself to meet your ever-changing needs and challenges.
addons.title: Kaleidoscope Fractal Core

addons.text: You are not an Endbringer, you are The Endbringer. Your powers are enhanced massively, growing by an order of magnitude, and you now possess all your powers in either form. Your Endbringer powers are now instead additional slots for Paradigm. But most importantly your form is now malleable just like your power set, you are now able to change forms with a moment’s concentration. You’ve now also gained command of all existing Endbingers and each Endbringer has been given the perks False Corona Pollentia, Pocket Shard, and Negentropy and may also grant them the ability to take a human form. You may also grant them lesser copies of any perks you possess. You can also create more Endbringers if you’d like and may freely modify any already created. You may gift any Endbringer any power/perk you possess.
addons.title: The Endbringer

addons.text:
Your power has evolved, removing the limitations of the number of slots and focusing on available power. You can now break down or fuse your slots in any combination, from adding them all together or breaking them down to the cost of a T0 power. 

Your slots automatically adjust to optimize energy usage. Alongside Paradigm's normal passive power creation, you can instantly construct and add powers to your library, as long as your slots have sufficient power, as well as freely modify powers in your possession. 

You can modify powers in your possession by cycling through different expressions, boosting one aspect at the expense of another, changing its restrictions, altering its interactions with other powers, or modifying its mechanics entirely. 
Your flickering ability is greatly enhanced, removing its prior restrictions and extending to the largest range among your powers or 100 meters, whichever is greater. You can expand your library of powers and freely modify any of your powers through flickering, with the process becoming intuitive and effortless. 

Powers you wield through Paradigm have much greater synergy than they would otherwise, producing far greater results when used in conjunction than they would normally. 

Your normal slots are increased by half (doubled if you have Shardless/Negentropy). You also possess a secondary thinker ability to effortlessly manage and reconfigure your slots.
addons.title: Harmonic Engine

addons.text:
Your knowledge repository and Perk/Drawback provider have consolidated within Paradigm, allowing the creation of a standalone set of slots numbering in 7, where you allocate a particular Skill, Perk, or Drawback to either use yourself or share with a companion, teammate or enemy. Your mental catalog broadens to additionally include a comprehensive list of every possible Skill, Perk or Drawback; except for Negentropy, Esoteric Knowledge, and anything that specifically requires either of the two unless you have them. The sharing restrictions are still dependent on it needing to make sense to be bestowed to anyone.

These Skills, Perks, or Drawbacks are accessed through Endless Reflections, compiled, and then (wishfully) mutated, not unlike Skill Up, as a result of reaching out to Paradigm’s Catalog then synthesizing it with Polymath and/or Perk’s repository, but achieving the same result with more overt paranatural traits, such as glaring physical enhancements to support it in the case of Skills. All of the Skills, Perks, and Drawbacks are also susceptible to Paradigm’s adaptive growth.

With Kaleidoscope, the scope and scale of Skills, Perks or Drawbacks extend to those yet come or never meant to be, applying the same process of scouring and adaptation to them.

With Harmonic Engine, your Skills/Perks/Drawbacks are now free-form, malleable on their construction and modification, and able to be fused with any other power, skill, and what have you, while also being just as synergistic with any slot. The sharing process is more flexible, using your flickering to impart any Skill/Perk/Drawback.
addons.title: Criteria Benefactor

addons.text:
Your creativity leaves a mark on Paradigm, with Fictioportation lending a hand and using Paradigm’s Slots and resources to power itself, you can pull and create more sophisticated and stronger objects, being able to materialize an object from a story or fictional work you’re closely familiar with using Paradigm’s library of powers as [Data] support as a strengthening method, a refinement of the tool itself. The quality and strength of said objects depends on the source of [Data] the object was drawn upon and energy expended to materialize it e.g. a Nanothorn Halberd made from Kaizen doesn’t compare to the same object made from (Tinker) Jack of All Trades.

This has the quirk of being capable of modifying and changing details and features of the object in the creative process, wishing to add traits you want to your liking. Objects like common Items and Tinkertech are fair if you focus your objects to draw from the Tinker Specialties you have on your Slots.

Having Kaleidoscope Fractal Core causes your [Data] support to encompass the Shardless section’s Objects of Power and their blueprints, being able to mold and form them as if they’re the real deal. The strength and potency of said Objects of Power/Items are limited by your understanding of the logical and illogical foundations of the Object of Power you wish to shape in your vicinity or hand, determining the amount of time and energy you spend producing it, e.g., the Legend of Zelda’s Master Sword, while formidable, stand grounded and down-to-earth in their feats and capabilities factoring its low-cost in materials, energy, and time, and so forth.

You also can materialize Tinker projects from this using any of your Tinker Specialties or Shardless Techbases as a template being limited by, again, your understanding of the project you’re visualizing.

Having Criteria Benefactor allows particular Slots relating to your exchange and yield of OOPs to be permanent, namely, Multiversal Marketplace or the Celestial Market where you can interchange your Objects of Powers, Items, or Tinkertech for greater offers.
addons.title: Engine of Creation

addons.text: If Paradigm’s adaptability wasn’t enough for you, then subsuming Eidolon’s Prismatic Copy-Cat timed power budget and Shard Automation’s constant survey of power manifestations yield a versatility of immense proportions. This starts by compiling slots into their barest essentials, analyzing weak points and logical weaknesses best covered by synergistic elements and Paradigm’s foreknowledge, and then decompiling them in an instant. These findings isolate part of the power, setting internal sub-powers made using Eidolon’s Prismatic Copy-Cat. Made from (and for) the power itself, these add beneficial or innovative elements, thereby developing new capabilities for your powers, which you can tweak and mutate by hotswapping as needed, and using the [Time] you accumulated to overcharge them with more depth and scope to both your sub-powers and vice versa, effectively jailbreaking them permanently. What’s more, this sub-system reaches new levels as Paradigm not only adapts to any potential challenge, but it also implements the abilities and capabilities of anyone you find or encounter. How would this work? With Shard Automation's constant cataloguing, Paradigm takes the initiative of constructing and calculating the best countermeasure against an opponent or obstacle using the blueprint it either has or recently obtained under the heat of the battle. For example, whenever the opportunity to fight Alexandria arises, your power will use her power’s blueprint to counteract or utterly trounce her, automatically slotting Oxygen Manipulation with a sub-power of Oxygen Deprivation, replicating her durability by building a power to induce a state quantum status, or bypassing her durability by speeding her body’s temporal state so fast that it moves through time once again. Mixing these parts creates a machine of arguably limitless potential, where a blueprint snowballs into the making of an arsenal ready to face anything. These added mechanics apply Paradigm’s redefinitions of Kaleidoscope Fractal Core and Harmonic Engine as well.
addons.title: Recompilation

addons.text: Integrating a copy of High Priest and Aliena's improved system improved Paradigm’s synergy capabilities. An ordinary [Data] intersection between Set Bonuses and (Trump) Catalog, the latter’s array of powers improves your catalog in terms of versatility, such as depth and scope, being more semantically based. Meaning, your powers will be an enhanced Unshackled and [TRIUMPHANT] from the get-go, with the potential of Second Sight every time you continuously use a slot, upgrading your slots’ power to their next step. Set Bonuses encourage your remaining slots’ powers for synergy, creating interactions between them best viewed as reciprocal hypothetical add-ons in the CYOA or Fusions, acting as a single slot on Paradigm, your saving resources taking shape in your Set’s strength. Meaning, Set Bonuses’ mechanics apply here. Using Paradigm’s precognitive evolving capabilities, your synergy abilities will progress as a single power, immediately stored as a new power pattern on your catalog.
addons.title: Samuh

objects.text:
Paramount and Eidolon have merged, becoming something greater than the sum of their parts, and granting you unparalleled versatility. With this upgrade, you can choose up to two Tier 3 powers, three Tier 2 powers, or five Tier 1 powers. You can now directly choose which powers to get through a catalog in your mind, and these powers are instantly accessible and come with an innate understanding of how to use them effectively.

What sets Paradigm apart is its power growth and adaptation. As you use your abilities, they continuously evolve and become more powerful, adapting to different situations. These enhancements are permanent, allowing you to constantly improve and refine your powers over time.

Additionally, the Paradigm upgrade provides a unique advantage by making you a precognitive blind spot. This means that no one, including the entity, can predict your actions or intentions. This ability grants you exceptional strategic planning capabilities and allows for surprise attacks.

Note: If you also possess Negentropy, the speed at which your powers grow and adapt increases threefold. Furthermore, it expands the number of powers you can possess to three Tier 3, five Tier 2, or eight Tier 1 powers.
objects.title: Paradigm

addons.text:
You can now choose the world you send people to and/or set specific parameters/filters for it, as specific or broad as you want, or choose for it to remain under your power’s discretion as normal. 

For example, this allows you to send people to any of the Worlds shown in the Alternate Earth section, including any potential AU modifiers, for their Isekai Journey including yourself.

Your power will build a catalog of worlds and filters you’ve used in the past for ease of use in the future. This comes already prefilled with each of the settings and AU modifiers, different world modifiers, etc in this CYOA.
addons.title: Planned Trip

addons.text: When sending someone to another world you may now choose to reincarnate them fully, using your sensory power as a vector you can send people into another life entirely. You still send them as normal, instead of creating a sensory for them your power simply constructs a life and body for them there. You may also optionally choose to create a sensory instead. Regardless, each one you send will still be able to gain new abilities from their travels. Similar to your ability to determine their settings, you can choose how specific or broad you control their new life, as well as when they finally awaken. Whether they are aware as soon as their born or upon a specific age or event, whether their reborn as a human, or down to the most minute detail such as their hair color, etc. You can be as broad or specific in as many different things as you want, you may even be incredibly vague if you wish, such as saying you simply want something to be epic, your power will align it perfectly. Whenever you make a reincarnation, it will be saved as a template for further reference similar to how you may establish settings. Your power will choose the setting, and methods of entry, and the specifics of any reincarnations if applicable on its own unless you deliberately choose any of these aspects yourself.
addons.title: The Time I Was Reincarnated As A….

addons.text:
You can now go incredibly in-depth with creating the character. 

You can choose abilities, choose their backgrounds, their reincarnations, the settings they go to, etc.

You have a set pool of power that you can choose to shape their abilities. This pool can be used to create unique abilities suited to the affected targets, grant them skills, items, or even perks.

Likewise you can also establish drawbacks, negative effects that either affect the user, such as strange unavoidable impulses, or the world, such as inserting monsterous beings or apocalyptic events into the setting whereas they otherwise wouldn’t have been, or even simply ensuring they’ll have significant hurdles to overcome such as enemies.

The pool of power can be increased by sending the target to more dangerous worlds or establishing drawbacks, the more dangerous the world and/or drawbacks, the greater the pool grows. 

The size of the pool equals to the amount of power you can imbue a sensory with on a world similar in danger to Earth Aleph as a starting reference.

Now if you use a medium, you are no longer limited to your own strength, but if you surpass your 1/10 limit then the targets success is no longer guaranteed. You can now send as many sensory as you can normally produce, sending the target directly does not count towards your sensory limit.
addons.title: Create Your Own Adventure

objects.text:
With a touch you can transport people into alternate realities, sending them on an adventure tailor made with their strengths and weaknesses in mind. Once the adventure is complete, they will return to where they were originally, with no more than a few seconds having passed.

You possess the power to transport individuals to alternate realities, crafting personalized adventures that cater to their strengths and weaknesses. Time inside the alternate reality may pass differently, the entire experience will only last a few seconds in their original reality, and they will return to the same place once their adventures has concluded. Additionally, they will retain all the knowledge and abilities they acquire during their adventures. They cannot gain Shardless powers unless you have esoteric knowledge. You can use this power on yourself, but it is recommended to give yourself at least a week long break after each adventure.
objects.title: Isekai

objects.text:
You can now clone any biological lifeform, no longer limited to parahumans. During the cloning process, you can absorb the clone's abilities, knowledge, and skills, adding them to your own. This allows you to have a wide variety of powers at your disposal, which can be used in a variety of ways. The absorbed powers will slowly decay with use and will be lost after multiple uses. Any passive powers you may gain can be deactivated at will. Additionally, the absorbed powers can be combined to create new abilities, giving you an almost unlimited number of ways to use your powers. Finally, you also gain the ability to transform your body, adding traits from creatures you absorb.

You can regain the use of lost powers by transforming your body and adding the traits of their original owners. For example, transforming your arm into Alexandria’s arm will allow you to regain access to her power; however, the power will be limited to only Alexandria's arm and will not spread to the rest of the body.
objects.title: Clone Absorber

addons.text:
You can use your points to turn any ghost you summoned into a wraith. Wraiths can fly at a low altitude and transition between intangible and tangible states at will. They retain any power they had in life. They have autonomy but are instinctively loyal to you. 

If taken with Possessed, they are also able to possess others and use their powers through them. If they possess their reanimated corpse, their power is greatly boosted.
addons.title: Wraith

addons.text:
Your necromantic mastery has been honed into a perfected art as your tinker specialization meshes perfectly with those you revive via (Master) Undead.

With your power sustaining them, decay no longer hinders your work when tinkering. Once infused with your tinkertech, these corpses place far less strain on your Master power, notably reducing their point cost. The more tinkertech you build into them, the less they cost to maintain until, with sufficient augmentation, they require no points at all.
