Lastly, your grafting techniques have progressed to the point that they appear seamless to the average eye. This skill extends to deceased parahumans, enabling you to graft their corona pollentia and potentially access their powers in full, rather than just a limb.
addons.title: Frankenstein’s Mentor

objects.text:
Your power to control undead has evolved, and your mastery over it has grown significantly. 

You now start off with 150 points (300 with Negentrophy) and receives an additional 10 points (20 with Negentrophy) every month. 

You gain a minor tinker power, specialising on corpses. You can fuse your undead, creating powerful frankenstein monsters. If the need arises, you can absorb your undead, fusing with them by grafting their dead bodies to your own. If you fuse with corpses of a parahuman, you can gain access to their power, although limited to that particular part. 

For example, by fusing with Shadow Stalker’s arm, you can make said arm enter her Shadow State, but the rest of your body will be unable to do the same. Fusing with an undead make them no longer cost any point to maintain.
objects.title: Lich

objects.text: You have opened your eyes, and seen the light. You gain the ability to conjure up salt-like constructs that enhance your prepared food, imparting permanent effects. An example is food that increases intellect, making the one who eats it less of a Failure. Rejoice, and share your culinary delights.
objects.title: MSG, King of Flavor

objects.text: Your physical strength increases exponentially through consistent training. Repeating the same routine every day amplifies the effect; however, missing even one day resets the growth rate to its base level. The rate of growth scales with your current stats, meaning that the stronger you are, the faster your rate of growth increases. After completing 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10 km run every day for three years without air conditioning and with nothing but a single banana for breakfast, your sneeze alone becomes powerful enough to blow away all the gas on Jupiter.
objects.title: Saitama's Will

addons.text: You still have limits on how powerful you can become. Even if you make it that people think you can destroy a planet, you will not gain such a level of strength. Nonetheless, you will still gain a power that makes it seem like you can do so.

objects.text: You possess the ability to modify information about yourself, and the degree to which you can alter it varies with the number of people who have knowledge of you. If only a few people are aware of you, you can only alter information of your name. Once you attain a continental level of familiarity from people, you can transform any aspect of your identity, including your abilities and appearance. Physical and Mental information is effected by this power, so even written documents will have been changed.
objects.title: Sealed King

objects.text: You have been released, your form true. You can do more than merely change information about yourself, you can change those who have such information. Any being who holds knowledge of you can be effected, their bodies and minds twisting and changing into forms that befit their roles as your eternal servants. The more knowledge they have, the bigger the changes possible. They can gain special powers and capabilities from their new forms, and they will also gain a weaker version of (Trump/Thinker) Who Do You Think I Am?, as they will gain minor powers, skills, and a false appearance based off what others think of them. They will be incapable of controlling this aspect of their power, and they will gain a mix match of powers and forms based of what various groups think of them. They will also gain the “Odd” drawback.
objects.title: Great Old One

objects.text: Your powers and effects no longer degrade and may be held as long as you wish. However you are now limited to the slots of (Trump) Oberon to wield your powers in.
objects.title: Eternal Star

objects.text: You can freely move through time. You are capable of rewinding, pushing forward, or pausing time. You can use this power to move yourself or others to where they were at any moment, move things to where they're slated to be at any moment in the future, or pauses things for no limits, releasing at a whim.
objects.title: Timeless

addons.text:
Now, the creations you make with Realistic Army fall under the influence of Fictiportation. They transition from becoming animated inorganic figures that imitate the original into flesh and blood entities that perfectly replicate the original.

This includes animals, entities, materials, and objects created through Realistic Army, which will become their real versions once you apply your touch of realism. A wooden statue that personifies a phoenix can directly transform into its authentic version. This completely removes the inherent weaknesses of the material from which they were originally made and transforms them into what the original should truly be composed of.

Your creations have been elevated to a PRT classification level of 12, which is sufficient to create objects and entities capable of matching or surpassing not only Endbringers, but also Scion and possibly the Entity itself.

However, you are limited by the amount of energy, maintaining the same restrictions as Fictiportation. With constant use, practice, and the passage of time, this limit will increase. There is no limit to the number of objects, entities, and materials you can convert, and you can even create multiple copies of the same instance.

If you possess Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless Essence, then your touch of realism in your creations will go beyond PRT classification level 12.
addons.title: Fiction Army

addons.text:
The creation of golems and dolls has merged, giving rise to artificial creations that you can generate instantly or construct through your specialty as a Doll Tinker.

This not only removes the need to create or find an inorganic figure that resembles any entity you wish to bring to life, but also eliminates the limitation on power sharing. If previously your dolls could not wield powers for themselves such as those of Deadpool, Phase, or Bowser, now they are capable of using such powers.

By being able to grant independent life to your artificial creations, they also gain access to powers that require consciousness or autonomy. These include Tinker specialties or mental and sensory qualities of Thinker-type powers.

Through the Doll Tinker specialty, the inherent qualities of each of your creations can be modified, copied, combined, removed, degraded, or enhanced. This means you possess a crude method of modifying the powers of each of your creations. For example, creating figures that embody a demon and an angel would grant each their own set of powers based on their representation. However, combining both entities would allow the creation of a figure that possesses both sets of powers and can even develop new and more powerful abilities as a result of merging two different sources.
addons.title: Spontaneous Toy

objects.text: You can now extend the effects of (Striker/Trump) Idol Theory into any golem you animate. Not only that, when animating statues that resemble people, these statues will gain the memories/skills/powers of these people. The Golems will still be loyal to you.
objects.title: Realistic Army

objects.text: Your newfound specialization possesses the unique ability to create gear that surpasses the sum of its individual components. You have the skill to craft Shields or Armors that not only absorb attacks but can also utilize the absorbed energy to power your Armor, recharge your Shields, or even redirect the energy back through your Guns/Swords. Moreover, your Armor has the capability to enhance your Shields, and your Attacks can extract energy from adversaries, be it blood, electricity, or even esoteric elements like momentum.
objects.title: Full Set

objects.text: You can grant your simulated advisors an avatar inside your simulated reality, allowing them to give you a more hands on assistance when teaching you. Time in your simulated reality is also quickened, making 3 hours inside the simulated reality equal to 1 hour in the real world.
objects.title: Hands On Learning

objects.text: You can back up the memories of any of your advisors, and imprint it into a body that you are touching. Not only does this not overwrite the new host's original powers and experiences, they also gain the power of the advisor. To do so, you need three things. First, you must cultivate a good relationship with the advisor, and second, you need a body that has at least 50% similarities with the advisor's own body, and finally you need the consent of the original host of the body (master powers cannot influence this decision). The process will take around 10 minutes, and the advisor's will lose their inherent loyalty afterwards.
objects.title: Backed Up Advisor

objects.text: Your advisors have evolved from simple advisors to Mentors. With their permission and approval, you can acquire their abilities by either training with them, or spending energy to instantaneously gain their powers. Additionally, your energy reserves are now increased, enabling you to access up to 30 energy points (45 with Negentropy).
objects.title: Simulacrum Mentors

objects.text: You are now a Berserker class servant, or at least you have the capabilities of one. You have been bestowed with immense capabilities, including the ability to grant individuals the power of Command Seals. By using these Seals, individuals can compel and buff you to perform extraordinary feats. Your powers and physical prowess have been greatly amplified, giving you the strength to rival Alexandria. In addition to that, you also gain Battle Continuation, a Skill that allows for the continuation of combat after sustaining mortal wounds. With this kind of raw power on your side, you stand a far greater chance at achieving victory on the battlefield. However, be warned that the immense strength granted by your Berserker status may come at a cost, as it may result in a loss of sanity or rationality, making it challenging to control your actions and emotions.
objects.title: Berserker

addons.text: When used on a parahuman, their transformations will reflect their abilities. Upon activating their hybrid form, they will receive a boost to their main power, doubling the SP cost, and gain numerous secondary abilities. The total SP cost of all secondary powers will be the same as the original SP cost of the parahuman's main power.
addons.title: Fenrir’s Chosen

addons.text:
Your werewolf form is altered by the addition of Fenris, granting all of Fenris’ properties, in addition to your claws gaining a similar All-or-Nothing effect which allows them to carve through anything like warm butter. Additionally, your werewolf form is cosmetically altered to be more symmetrical and visually appealing, although all the benefits remain unchanged.

Yet this is not the greatest benefit of this alteration, no, that honor belongs to how your ability to bestow others with a copy of your Changer ability is impacted. When transformed into either full wolf or hybrid form, they gain a weakened version of Fenris, able to grow stronger by consuming matter.
addons.title: Skӧll and Hati

objects.text: You gain and can grant anyone a permanent changer ability. When used on a human, they can change into a canine, as well as a hybrid between a canine and a human. If used on a canine, their intelligence is boosted; they gain a human form and a hybrid form that mixes their canine features with their human ones. The hybrid form boasts enhanced strength, durability, agility, and an asymmetrical covering of bony plates, spikes, exposed muscles, calcified flesh, and prehensile tails. Even in their base form they will have increased strength, regeneration and senses.
objects.title: Werewolf

addons.text: You can now grant a hybrid form for any animal, and can be used on any animal. You could give a human a hybrid bear form, or grant a cat a hybrid human form. You can even give a fish a hybrid snake form if you felt like it instead.
addons.title: Were-Beast

addons.text: You can now empower any non-supernatural animal from any planet you've been to, creating a personalised transformation that further boost their abilities.
addons.title: Beast of Hell

objects.text: You can turn yourself and others into any non-supernatural animal from any planet you've been to. When transformed, you and your targets will gain subconscious behavior or whatever animal you transform them into.
objects.title: Beast Time

objects.text: Your specialization extends to include quantum and particle physics. With it you can create computers and programs that alter the world around them. The more powerful the effect the more powerful the computer needs to be. Basically letting you create Shaker/Stranger effects.
objects.title: Reality Hacker

objects.text: You are capable of receiving messages from the future. Since computer science is nothing but messages, this means that data itself is spread across time. To decode and interpret these future messages effectively, you will need immense processing power in case of (Tinker) Quantum Computing, or a vast decentralized network with using (Tinker) Software. In the case of using both, a small 15 meters square of computing to relay and decode complex messages is fine.
objects.title: Theoretical Communications

objects.text:
While Reality Hacker can easily accomplish this within local reality, this removes the logical limitation of using computers as a medium, becoming a Free Tinker specialization. You are capable of creating any Tinker project using the study of the physical properties of nature at an atomic and subatomic level, by tapping into the cosmic strings formed in the first epoch of creation, you manipulate the inner workings of the universe you reside in, replicating any effect or phenomena you have an intimate understanding of by pinging off Theoretical Communications’ and Interdimensional data from alternate future selves to expedite the research process, mockup, and manufacturing process. 

The range of what you can devise in Tinkertech is boundless aside from which you’re able to: A mine-like device capable of setting off shifting Z-axis of the atoms of an area 300m2 to emulate an All-or-Nothing effect, a gauntlet able to mimic a refined version of Scapegoat’s power without the drawbacks, creating a wristwatch that’s able to create a macro-level phenomenon of Quantum Immortality when switched on, creating a generator that generates matter and energy straight from the vacuum state, a quantum teleportator able to transfer anything’s quantum information without any loss or hiccup to another point in spacetime, etc.

This is one specialization where one’s limitations come from limited resources, energy expenditure, and imagination, nevertheless, that’s easily remedied by thinking up an extradimensional energy-matter extractor throughout several alternate universes, mass manufacturing and making it compact drone-wise, and using it to source a project that links you up with your alternate variants in intellect and ingenuity, so the sky’s the limit.
objects.title: Quantum Projects

objects.text: Your improvement/augmentation focus in the physical, the mental and the spiritual alike.
objects.title: (Un)Holy Trinity

addons.text:
By integrating your predictive programs with temporal communication technology, you achieve the capability to harness closed timelike curves, surpassing traditional causality constraints entirely.

You can make computing systems that exist within a self-sustained temporal loop, where outcomes and solutions are calculated instantaneously - even before the problems are presented. Leveraging space-time curvature, data becomes fluid across past, present, and future, enabling instantaneous predictive analytics, paradox-free future modeling, and simulations of infinite branching timelines.

Through this enhanced computational framework, processes that conventionally require immense computational resources and extensive temporal analysis can be resolved immediately, effectively granting near-infinite analytical precision and genuinely precognitive problem-solving capabilities.
addons.title: Closed Timelike Curvature Computing

objects.text: You can program more than computers. You can code brains, and even shards. However, you need specialized equipment in order to do this. You can create programs that analyze and draw conclusions, creating programs with Thinker powers. This even allows for limited precognitive abilities using incredibly complex analysis programs. Requires extensive data input and processing power to work, however.
objects.title: Shard-Like

objects.text: You are not limited to electronics, managing to create wetware, gooware, molecular, Optical/Spintronics or even Stochastic computers and more.
objects.title: Turing-Machine

objects.text:
The potential of Solarpunk and the arboreal knowledge of Lorax, have fused into this. While Solarpunk still allows you to fuse nature and technology, you have a far greater depth when it comes to focusing on trees and their produce. Large towering trees that could hold large towns and even small cities, these trees so tough they could survive an Endbringer assault. 

Your Chlorakinetic power is also enhanced from a touch-based power to a ranged power of at least 20m, to the point where you can implement your tinker designs into plants as long as the said plant is a variant of a tree. Oak electrical generators, Birchwood supercomputing center, Weeping Willows with kinetic branches to beat people to death, and yes you can even create spaceships with trees. Have Fun!
objects.title: Solarpunk: "I SPEAK FOR THE TREES!!"

objects.text:
Solarpunk and Magical Plants have combined into something new. When creating plant-based components, you will be able to connect them to shards and grant them powers. Based on the power that manifests, the component it is made from will be able to utilize it in some way. A plant-based computer core with temporal powers could get highly accurate data from the future or past, a power core for a generator with the power of heat absorption allowing to power itself from the surrounding temperature, or even an empowered repair component that causes a device to regenerate damage taken. 

You also understand how to automate these components and treat them like pieces of technology, programming them how you'd like.

Finally, your psychic link is upgraded to a form of technopathy. But this will only work if said technology has a component you made within it, the longer the component resides within the device the more control over its functions you will obtain.
objects.title: Solarpunk: Esoterica

objects.text: You maintain the powers of Jack of All Trades and Tattletale, however, whenever a tinker or thinker enters a radius of one hundred feet of your body these two powers start learning from those parahuman’s powers and permanently improve themselves. This does not give your powers all the capabilities of those parahumans, it just enhances your powers with ten percent of the capabilities of the copied parahumans, with those capabilities perfectly integrated into the two base powers. Similar technological knowledge in tinker powers or functionality in thinker powers does not stack when copied by your power from different parahumans, instead only unique or superior attributes are copied and integrated.
objects.title: Simurgh Lite

objects.text: Whenever you make a deal with someone, regardless of whether or not they know about your abilities, an invisible contract is formed. If the other party does not uphold their end of the Deal, you have the power to take anything from them, but the severity of what can be taken is limited based on the severity of the breach. The longer they owe you something, the more you can take from them as interest.
objects.title: Debt

addons.text: The Living Force and Irresistible Force Paradox have combined to grant total authorship over force interactions within Tyrant’s domain, paired with perfect precision down to the smallest scale. You alone decide which motions, pressures, energies, and impacts are permitted to occur, while any touch can carry that authority directly into a target’s structure. Furthermore, your authority can propagate through touch, expanding to encompass anything you touch. Within your range you suppress enemy momentum, heat, recoil, shockwaves, or movement entirely. Simultaneously, you can assign force where none existed before: pinning objects in place, collapsing fortifications inward, or forcing machines to tear themselves apart through contradictory vectors. This authority is absolute and surgical. A fingertip on armor can transfer irresistible internal stress that bypasses the surface and shatters what lies beneath. A tap on the ground can freeze a city block in immovable stillness or send controlled rupture lines through only hostile targets. A touch on a person can harmlessly negate their motion, lock their limbs, or render them unable to generate force against you. Your greatest strength is your precision, you could tap a single atom and transmit unstoppable kinetic intent through an entire structure, unraveling planets, disabling machines, or incapacitating targets without collateral damage. Conversely, you can strike someone with the same certainty but only enough force to pin them harmlessly in place forever.
addons.title: Absolute Force Edict

objects.text:
Your main ability centers around the manipulation of forces acting upon or originating from your own body, and it operates with next to no upper limit. This means you can output forces equivalent to several megatons worth of TNT with nothing but a casual flick of your wrist, reach absurd levels of superluminal speeds during flight, and endure the entirety of the world's nuclear arsenals ten times over without sustaining a scratch. Your strength reaches staggering levels, allowing you to move celestial bodies with raw strength alone or reshape continents with little to no effort.

As your power isn't dependent of your muscles or any physical component, you can lift things and people without worrying about structural integrity or their safety as your field protects them and the environment from any adverse effects caused by you if you don't want them harmed. 

When it comes to defense, you have two options: you can either neutralize incoming forces, rendering bullets harmless as they cascade harmlessly around your feet, or redirect these energies back towards their source, causing projectiles to ricochet and fists to shatter against your unyielding chest. When not consciously controlling the vectors of your power, you inadvertently nullify the full spectrum of forces your abilities can harness, dramatically weakening cosmic forces to the point where the epicenter of a black hole pulls no harder than a gentle breeze, the searing heat of a star's core registers as mild discomfort, and standing at the epicenter of a supernova merely tousles your hair.

Your sensory abilities are elevated to unparalleled levels of extremity. You possess the power to fine-tune your hearing, enabling you to decipher conversations spanning entire planets. Your vision allows you to discern intricate details of distant alien worlds simply by gazing into the night sky. You can even perceive the intricate dance of strings and quantum particles held within the palm of your hand. 

Your movements are executed with subatomic precision, allowing you to snatch bullets from the air effortlessly or effortlessly outmatch even the most skilled hand-to-hand combatants at their own game. You have transcended the need for any form of sustenance, whether it be the physical requirements like air, nourishment, water, or sleep, or more abstract psychological ones.
objects.title: The Living Force

objects.text: Pulling from discrete entities that have entered or are a part of your landscape your gamer system can set up theme designed levels in order to challenge you. You can choose the starting conditions and different aspects of the generation conditions, including gameplay, privacy settings, and different narrative frameworks based on the assets. Once selected the player loses control of the generation process and will have to re-enter the landscape to begin the level. The complexity and depth of the generated levels is dependent on the number of charges stored in the landscape + stored in you. This can integrate different aspects of your powers or gamer-related systems.
objects.title: Liminal Levels

addons.text:
Your powers fuse with one another, merging seamlessly and gaining each others features. 

You’ve become far more flexible and precise in how much you can alter powers. You can now rewrite a power entirely, from its most core concepts to its more nuanced applications. 

When making a change to a power, you can now opt to choose to do a single immediate change, or to apply a growth booster.

A power no longer has any limit to how many times Growth Booster may be applied to it, although they cannot be held on the same power concurrently. 

Applying a Growth Booster will trigger the month long cool down, although rewrites and alterations of a power, including adding side grades, may be done as normal. Power Guru upgrade may be applied as normal once the cool down is completed, even if the Growth Booster is still in place. 

Power Guru’s cool down is now applied to individual powers, rather than individual parahumans. 

Power Guru can now also be applied to yourself and any power you possess, although you're still subject to the limitation and rules of Power Guru.
addons.title: Exponential Power

objects.text: You can jailbreak powers. Doing so lets you free up other people's abilities by taking off their limitations or unlocking new capabilities, but there are some limits. First, you can't change the core concept of the power, so a person with pyrokinesis won't suddenly become a chrono kinetic. You can give power properties of another power by being in contact with two capes at once. Second, the more changes you make, the longer it will take before you can do it again. The longest you'll have to wait between jailbreaking someone is a month. Each person you work with has their own cooldown period, so there's no need to wait to help others. Lastly, each change can only increase the power's cost by 15 SP or double its original cost, whichever is less. You can still give side-grades to powers without cooldown.
objects.title: Power Guru

objects.text:
Power Guru’s SP cap per change is increased by 1 SP per purchase. 

Power Guru’s SP maximum power increase is now fixed at the SP cap, regardless of the affected power’s SP value before.
objects.title: Potency Increase (Power Guru)

objects.text: You now possess the ability to perceive pseudo-spiritual energy as it flows through electronic devices. By channeling this energy through your hands, you can apply various effects to it. These effects include deactivating it, crashing it, inducing a sleep-like state, freezing its operation, or causing it to lose concept of time. Such altered states are challenging to reverse without the use of pseudo-spiritual energy, making settings where they "don't exist" nearly impervious to disruption.
objects.title: Techno-Magica?

objects.text:
You have discovered how to go beyond simply interfering with electronics using spiritual energy. For you see, spiritual energy is still energy, and you are an energy tinker. Everything you could do with electricity can now also be done with chi and other spiritual energies. From chi batteries, spiritual wiring, to even gasoline powered chi generators, you can do it all.

This even synergizes with your other tinker powers, allowing you to use spiritual power in your tinkertech. You could make prosthetics powered by the user’s own spiritual energy, chi powered weaponry, or just use it to upgrade your computer.
 
Even your other esoteric energies are not safe from your revelation. With the boundaries on what your power considers energy broken, it becomes possible to analyze these energies and also integrate them into tinkertech. This has a side effect of optimizing your usage of any powers that seem to absorb or interact with said energies.
 
If you have esoteric knowledge, then even good old-fashioned magic will simply become science you don’t understand, yet.
objects.title: Yes, Techno-Magica.

objects.text:
With this power, your runes can become a conduit allowing them to act as a bridge between your pocket dimensions or telekinesis. You can now inscribe runes on any object, effectively turning them into anchors. These runes can be finely tuned to control various aspects, such as the type of dimension they access, their activation duration, and the intensity of their effects. However, the stronger the rune, the longer it takes to inscribe, with the process varying from a few seconds to several minutes. You can only have up to 30 runes at a time.

You possess complete awareness of your runes' locations up to a 50-meter radius and maintain a faint sense of their presence up to 500 meters away. Additionally, you can activate any of your inscribed runes mentally. Should you move beyond a 1000-meter range, your runes will become dormant but will reactivate upon your return to the area.

The aesthetic of your runes can be customized to any form of symbology or lettering you prefer.
objects.title: Magus

objects.text:
You can now “tune” your runes with great precision, allowing you to carefully control the energy or matter drawn from your pocket dimensions. Instead of just releasing raw energy or matter, you can shape and direct this energy in specific ways that interact smoothly with the physical world. For example, you can summon projections with the rune acting as its core. For instance, air from a compressed air dimension could form into a swirling, semi-autonomous air elemental, capable of blocking attacks, knocking objects aside, or creating gusts to carry items.

You can also enhance the effects of your runes by placing them close together to create a feedback loop, where they interact to produce stronger or combined results. For example, two runes tuned to gravity might create a stronger gravitational field together, making objects feel heavier or move more slowly within a certain area. If a rune drawing from superheated air is placed near a compressed air rune, the combined effect could create a powerful blast of high-speed, heated air capable of burning or cutting through obstacles.

Through a “symbiotic rune system,” you can also link your runes in clusters, so they work together to create ongoing effects. As long as you are within 1000 meters, these clusters can maintain their power for extended periods. A cluster of compressed air runes could form a kinetic barrier that blocks or slows down incoming attacks, while a group of gravity runes might create a small area with stronger gravity, making it harder for enemies to move or escape.

You now no longer have a limit to how many runes you can have active at once.
objects.title: Sage

objects.text: Don't fancy a battle? Need something eliminated? Planning a massacre? Now, the question isn't whether it can be killed, but rather, how brutally and stylishly you want it done. You possess the power to kill anything, whether it's a person, a machine, or even abstract concepts like 'this conversation,' 'his reputation,' or 'her bank account'. If something can be terminated in any conceivable way, you have the knowledge and capability to execute it flawlessly automatically. Should you choose to hold back your lethal abilities during a confrontation, you can 'pull your punches' with deliberate intent and when it comes to caring or showing concern you can 'give zero fucks' about anything whether in whole or in part.
objects.title: Atropos Wannabe

objects.text:
While entities would not normally engage in combat with one another, the presence of those like the Destroyer means that they need at least some form of defending themselves. While developing destructive powers is easy, the hard part comes into play when it comes to cognitive defenses. See, most of these predatory entities know that getting into a long fight will result in loss of energy of both them and their target. They are thus constantly developing methods of concealing themselves so that they may stalk their prey and strike at the opportune moment to ensure maximum energy efficiency. Your shard is the response to that.

Your Shard can be thought of as a counter to Shroud. While Shroud is constantly updating its defenses to hide your information, your shard works to break those defenses. Comprehension is used in conjunction with Atropos Wannabe to collect information on the target to determine what is typically referred to as a “blind spot”. Then, using The Enemy Didn't Ascend Beyond Your Control and Automatic Defense, it performs what can best be described as a DDOS attack on the firewall protecting that information. Additionally, your near clairvoyance is combined with the cloaking of master effects to preemptively scrub any traces of the hack, preventing all but the most advanced safeguards unable to detect the breach in security. With each new piece of information obtained, your Shard will develop appropriate counter measures to eliminate the threat.

This anti-stranger protocol can also be thought of as an anti-master protocol as well. This is because any master effect you are put under can also be interpreted as a blind spot, limiting your actions regarding certain decisions. This will allow you to break any master effect you fall under with enough time. This time will be dependent on how powerful the master effect is and how much information it has on similar master effects. This even includes master effects that physically control the brain, with Automatic Defense’s similar emergency protocols acting as a base. It is also possible to stay under a master effect should you so choose, either because it is part of an enhancement from an ally or to wait to strike when your target least expects it.

A word of warning, while it is possible to hack the high level of protocols guarding information about Endbringers and the Entities, their high level of security means that, without careful planning, they are likely to discover the hack. Your shard will quickly retreat when discovered should it be necessary, but trace elements of the hack will not be as thoroughly scrubbed. This means that it is likely that they will use this information to find you, whether you are ready for them or not. It is also not possible to gain information on those with Blank.
objects.title: Nowhere to Run

objects.text: You have up to 10 “real” branches under a 1km area, completely free to “select” possible courses of action as “branches” for them, “stacking” it with another movement or action regardless of similarity, or “glitching” your moves that flickers between possibilities of movement and maneuvers within that moment no matter the space, position, or action.
objects.title: Game's got Glitched

addons.text: With time and enough Titans, you can start a fusion. The connections strengthened, and your minds meld, transforming into a proto-entity. Note that this doesn’t mean you are as strong as a true Entity.
addons.title: Proto-Entity

addons.text: Causing parahumans to turn towering beings of crystalline flesh is a bit noticeable, and given that you don’t even have the ability to become a Titan yourself anymore, kinda odd. Now, when you inflict a Second Trigger on someone they gain the effects of Human Shard instead, starting with a loosening of restrictions as if they had simply undergone a Second Trigger, but with time they will transform into a Shard in human form like yourself. The network functionality of Titan Network remains unchanged.
addons.title: They Walk Among Us

objects.text:
You can cause Parahumans to have a 'broken' second trigger, becoming a titan and connecting to you in a network. Like you, they will retain full agency. They will not only have access to all the powers from their Shard, but also be able to use abilities of other Shards in the network, although to a far more limiting degree.

You will be the 'head' of the network, but if a shard with higher/same ranking then yours join the network, they can attempt to forcefully seize control.
objects.title: Titan Network

objects.text: Accelerated Evolution now makes use of the information Danger Sense provides and starts adapting you in response to danger as it receives that information. The more intense the danger and close to present it is the more effective the adaptations become at helping you survive it.
objects.title: Quantum Evolution

objects.text:
Your feathers have now gained the ability to deflect projectiles, accelerating it in the process depending on the amount of feathers bound, from an half-again acceleration with a single feather up to thousands of times with all of them bound together; with Crystal Wings, this increases to an acceleration of millions of times with all feathers bound together. 

You also gain the ability to fire off your feathers as high-speed projectiles, going ten times faster than normal in a straight line. Finally, you gain a minor Thinker ability that grants you instinctual knowledge of trajectories as well as the ability to calculate travel time of any object.
objects.title: Refract Wings

objects.text: Your powers of kinetic absorption have now evolved, allowing you to take in all forms of energy that you're struck with or produce. What this means is that you won’t suffer any hit or damage—it being neutralized—as all the energy required for this will be absorbed. Your limit on outputting energy has now also been removed. In addition to this, your energy usage has now also undergone an expansion; whereas you can still use your energies to boost yourself and your other powers, you can now use your absorbed energies to make energy constructs from your crimson energy. Finally, you can now also enter a Breaker state that allows you to continually take in energy and release it at full power.
objects.title: Force Multiplier

objects.text:
Both Randomizer and Paramount work normally at first except every ten rolls from Randomizer that fail to result in a permanent power; you will be given a pity roll randomly selected from the list of Tier 1 powers Paramount can access that is guaranteed to be permanent.

After all paramount powers are made permanent, pity rolls stop happening.

If you use the same power through Randomizer and Paramount at the same time, their overall power can be combined and doubled in strength.
objects.title: Paramount Pity Rolls

objects.text:
Retaining the functions from each power, you now have a “phone book” containing a person’s psyche and memories, capable of manipulating them to the point of melding them into a gestalt of multiple people; this has a peculiar effect on their existent powers, synthesizing into a power made from a sum of their parts, possibly shape how it’s expressed by editing the person or gestalt’s recollection of their Trigger Event.

You can overwrite others with a person or gestalt of your choosing by physical touch.
objects.title: Gestalt Simulator

addons.text: You can grant a person a single skill permanently, although after they gain said skill, they must wait a month before they are able to gain another skill. Even without that, they can quickly learn any skill they have been granted, as portions of it will remain even after it is lost. Additionally, the effects of your powers last longer, now all lasting at least a month before they fade away.
addons.title: Student, now the Master

addons.text: The number of skills and thinker/tinker powers you can grant increases the more they have been under the effects of your power. For someone who has been under the effects of your power for over a year, they would be able to have 10 skills and 3 thinker/tinker powers (20 skills and 7 thinker/tinker powers with negentropy).
addons.title: Learning More

objects.text:
You can grant another person a thinker/tinker power or a wide range of skills. While you can only imbue a single thinker/tinker power (or three with negentropy) per person, you can imbue up to seven (or ten with negentropy) skills. Bestowing more skills or a more potent thinker/tinker power strengthens the loyalty the target has for you, with them becoming completely fanatical to you at the highest level. Note that while this is the case, they can still function and are able to think for themselves, as long as what they are thinking about isn't related to you.

The duration of your boosts, however, is inversely proportional to their strength — the more potent the thinker/tinker power or the more skills granted, the shorter its duration, lasting up to a year at most and a week at least.
objects.title: The Taught

addons.text: If this wasn’t enough, you also cause every affected to go into a hysterical episode, ticking off at their Sechen ranges to cause a violent power boost predictably, and the affected not knowing friend from foe.
addons.title: Perfect Storm

objects.text:
Diabolical. That’s how you can think about this.

Why? How about the ability to consciously and remotely cause any Parahuman or Non-Parahuman to relive the worst moment of their lives? Does that count?

In detail, while you do retain your original capabilities, do you want to know more? Because you are also liable to cause any parahuman to vividly experience their Trigger Event, causing enough distress to Second Trigger. For potential parahumans, you either create a fabricated Trigger Event in their minds according to their mental stressors and/or psychological weak points so you can make them experience said simulation, or simply use Trigger Bomb for the process. To non-parahumans process is similar, with the detail of developing a Corona Pollentia to accomplish the same.
objects.title: Origin Story

addons.text:
When making a film, production is also defined as the process or management involved in making a film, play, or record. This synergy now applies to Shards and, by extension, this power. 

Now you consult and direct Shards to voluntarily select “characters” of your choosing in the promise of [Data] collection. Your stories are more fine-tuned and intricate, using a blend of gardener and architect styles to make your story feel as you envisioned or satisfy your goals. 

Your “scouting” is more robust in picking <s>targets</s>“talent”, by perceiving the Shard’s information.

This in turn makes the Shard a part of the story, too, with you capable of picking up [Data] from your “character” on the “resolution” to replicate a part of their prospective powers.
addons.title: Shard Production

addons.text: Your Parahuman and Conflict Drive Intuition and Control melds with your storytelling, you can integrate and modulate the Conflict Drive of your “characters” within and out of the story, to further create a sense of self-fulfilling prophecy and establish Sechen limits to your “characters” at the story’s “resolution”. Your insight from your “characters” extends more than parahumans, but also potential parahumans by sensing their dormant connection and gaining sensitive information, exploiting this to enhance the drama (and the resulting power’s strength) and consequently your work.
addons.title: Paint the Town Red

addons.text: At the time of your story’s “resolution”, you overtly exert control over their Shard with all the entails. Following this makes you capable of coordinating your “characters”, being easier the more time it passes, being off-set your character being nothing more of an “extra” with no agency or control of their own.
addons.title: Micromanaging
Grand Playwright
addons.text:
Clock King’s immense planning and directing capabilities have taken your ability to create Stories to the next level, allowing you to operate on a far grander scale.

You can now write and direct multiple stories simultaneously, with entirely separate plots unfolding all across the world. More than that, your mastery as an Author allows you to weave these seemingly unconnected stories together, causing them to overlap and create knock-on effects that eventually form and drive an overarching narrative of your design. At your peak, your influence could reach a continental or even global scale.

The result is something akin to a Franchise, where a variety of stories can each have their own themes, characters, and plots while still contributing to a larger cohesive narrative. Characters and events can cross between stories, with seemingly minor details in one plot becoming significant in another, allowing the separate stories to gradually flesh out the world and intertwine into something greater.

You could increase Triggers in one area while decreasing them in another, cause an uptick in certain kinds of power sets, subtly direct parahumans to accumulate in certain areas and form relatively stable competing factions, shatter a grand alliance that has made things too stable into multiple warring groups, and so on.

You could be considered the one who writes and directs the “script” for the Cycle—the Hand Behind the Curtain who dictates the flow of people and events, distributing powers and directing parahumans to be where they need to be in order to maximize the generation of [Data].

addons.title: Self-Supplied Casting
addons.text: Your stories have provided a new use for the Junkyard Shards, giving them an opportunity to redeem themselves and prove that they are capable of producing worthwhile results. Rather than simply attracting Shards with the promise of interesting [Data], you can directly assign Shards from the Junkyard to your cast members, providing some level of direct control over the resulting power by dictating which Shard is sourcing it. You can still entice outside Shards to partake in the story like before; however, you’re no longer entirely reliant on them or their whims. This pairs very well with Shard Production, Inquisitor, and/or Junk to Gems, allowing for even greater control over the fine details of Shard connections and powers, as well as using the [Data] gleaned from the resolution of a story to refine the relevant Junkyard Shards.

objects.text:
The sum of the parts comprising this power becomes a story. 

You scout <s>victims</s> ”characters” for your story, either parahumans, potential parahumans, normal people to view their powers or trigger visions, probable or not. Any “character” has a faint aura to indicate they’ve been “cast” for the story to unfold. In the case of a normal person, they begin developing a Corona Pollentia by attracting a Shard’s attention, foreseeing potential [Data] collection with your story.

The Plan you concoct turns into a tight “storyline” foretelling the “character’s” fall or tragedy: The story’s “conflict” is often characterized by a feeling of impending doom, a drawn-out sense of foreboding for the “character’s” part. Being none the wiser, they are afterward thrust into the most excruciating moments in their lives, with anyone involving themselves in the story playing a part in this by assuming “roles” or “archetypes” progressing the plot, and once the resolution is nigh a flashback detailing unbeknownst to the “actor” occurs to further add salt to the wound which promptly enters the “resolution”, ending with a resulting parahuman or a Second-Triggered parahuman. The resulting power in terms of expression and strength always depends on the story’s elements, factors, and “scenes” (according to Trigger Theory) that you write into the tale.

Assuming you composed a story to create an “ensemble” or Cluster, you can control the Cluster’s setting and dynamics to your liking with you at the helm, by shifting the Kiss/Kill of your <s>puppets</s> ”actors” to be more amenable to you. It makes it easier to start a group.
objects.title: Making of a Tragedy

addons.text:
Your wings have become like your manifested shields, inviolable and capable of absorbing energy from any attack, but thats not all as your flight speed has now appropriately become superhuman like your body allowing you to fly at up to mach 1.1. When in flight you are now capable of using your stored up energy to increase your speed even further into the realms of the supersonic. Additionally your wings absorb any sonic booms released as you fly and are capable of releasing them as you please.

Now like your shields your wings are inviolable and absorb attacks, however unlike your shields your wings can use this energy to create inviolable feather flechettes to attack your enemies. These flechettes like your shield can be enhanced with stored energy to detonate a shockwave upon impact or to be given enough piercing power to shoot through anything on your same dimensional plane.
addons.title: Vibranium Wings

addons.text:
Your ability to create shields has been greatly bolstered by your ability to imbue said shields with inviolability. From now on the base materials of your shields you create will become indestructible to all non esoteric attacks, as well as your designs now being capable of being powered by the stored energy.

More over you are now capable of tactile modifications to any hand held shields you create allowing you to change and modify  their functions on the fly so long as the component parts would be the same. And finally the scope at which you create shields has been drastically been enhanced to the point where making a shield that functions in all possible instances of reality would become a doable feat given enough time and study.
addons.title: I Am The Shield

addons.text: Your wings are now not only enhanced by your powers but are now capable of being enhanced and altered by the shield technology which you create. By placing your shields between your two wings on your back you modify your wings to take on the properties of said shield from a shield that stops time for defense, to a wide dispersal energy shield for a city making your wings gigantic. Even your inviolable feather flechettes are modified giving you a wider range of attacks at your disposal.
addons.title: Sam

objects.text:
Your powers have merged together to enhance your defensive and offensive abilities. Your physical abilities have past the realm of peak human and into the superhuman with your strength enough to toss a car with effort and tear through metals with your bare hands. However this is secondary to your new shield based abilities.

Firstly your ability to imbue an object with your shield properties has become semi-permanent ending only when you wish it to, additionally the shape of which you can imbue your shield effect into is no longer limited to a circular object meaning you can have shields of different shapes and even larger sizes (though still something that can be held). In conjunction with this the power of yang it has merged wholly with your created shields making it so that said shields absorb all attacks and energy directed to it.

This energy can be stored within the shield imbued with it indefinitely (even if you remove its inviolability), but what you can do with it is really the fun part. You are capable of using up the  stored energy in a manner of attacks, a major one being a shockwave from your shield the strength of which varies with the energy used, additionally though you do not need to be holding said shield to release the energy shockwave. You can also use stored energy to enhance your shield while in motion courtesy of Boomerang, making it so that your inviolable shield becomes like an inviolable saw through the air capable of cutting through anything on your same dimensional plane.
objects.title: Best Offense Is A Good Defense

addons.text: Through a loophole in the resurrection mechanism, Mental Healing effects are now permanently integrated into their very being, curing all mental and physical ailments indefinitely. This profound change means that any illnesses or psychological issues they had are resolved forever given enough time, even if the effects are diminish when they are away from your presence with the Perk-like Well Adjusted being a constant on they lives now.
addons.title: Shell Shocked No More

addons.text:
One of the most challenging aspects to address is a damaged soul, and this is evident even in the presence of your power. Your ability can mend, grow, and nurture souls, restoring them to their prime and beyond. This process provides proper rest and peace to this vital part of a being. When the flesh and mind deteriorate for no apparent reason, your power identifies the cause in the negative material possessed by living beings, fixing the issue and reinforcing that point of failure.

For beings made entirely of negative materials, your power makes them more "real" by stabilizing their existence. This transformative effect corrects the inherent instability caused by their composition, solidifying their presence and reducing their ethereal or volatile nature. The result is a more resilient, balanced, and harmonious spiritually existence.

By addressing the soul's well-being, your power not only heals but also strengthens, ensuring that the mended soul can withstand future challenges.
addons.title: And one Enigma is Solved

objects.text:
You possess the ability to heal more than just physical ailments; you can also mend minds afflicted by emotional, logical, improper healing, or genetic disorders, as well as those affected by master/strange/shaker effects or any other way a mind can be damaged/fault.
Your Healing Circle now extends to yourself, providing passive healing over time, with the option to increase its intensity through focus or decrease its radius or stop one way of healing (Physical or Mental).
You have the effects of the Perk Well Adjusted at all times unless you take holding back and will impose its influence on others, even Shards if they are connected like Khepri/Fairy Queen, while the person is under effect, it will persist for a time after the target left the area, but will soon fade.
The effect is not subtle with the person and the area of effect glowing.
objects.title: Mental Healing

objects.text:
Your powers over metal have fused and your abilities are now far greater than the sum of its parts. 

You can easily manipulate all metals with incredible precision within a 4-kilometer radius of yourself. You can freely generate any type of metal or alloy by expelling it from any solid inorganic surface within your radius; using this ability you're capable of producing up to a hundred cubic metres of steel a second. You can construct metallic structures ranging from barriers and buildings to weapons, armour and equipment with the only limit to what you can build with metal being your imagination and understanding.

Your control over metals allows you to shift any metal from solid to liquid states of matter (and vice versa) as you please while you telekinetically manipulate it. You are even able to alter the physical properties of the metals that you control to match that of other metals such as giving Silver the density of Tungsten although this effect will slowly fade if the metal leaves your radius.

At a baseline, your natural physical condition has been enhanced to give you superhuman strength, speed and durability equivalent to the toughest Tungsten metal alloys. Alternately, you can turn into a completely malleable metallic form containing a small marble sized core capable of withstanding a nuclear blast. This form grants you a 10-fold increase in strength and durability alongside a phenomenal level of regeneration that matches the speed at which you can generate metal. 

Finally, you possess a secondary Thinker ability which provides you with absolute awareness and comprehension of all metals within your range down to the size of a grain of sand as well as an unlimited capacity to multitask.
objects.title: Iron Age

objects.text: Any and all metal you create/control is enhanced, permanently gaining the traits of Vibranium. In addition, you are able to temporarily turn any metal you touch into Adamantium, a metal that is virtually indestructible. You can choose to make it pure Adamantium or a Vibranium/Adamantium alloy. A blade of pure Adamantium is capable of cutting almost any non-exotic substance. After a week the Adamantium will return back to its state before its transformation.
objects.title: Vibranium Core

objects.text:
Whenever you fall unconscious, you create a zone where you can superimpose objects and locations from pocket worlds into it. Your zone increases the longer you are asleep. You will have extremely high control and a limited omniscience over the details of your zone. You can even warp space of your zone to a limited degree, similar to Vista except that you take longer to warp space and your warped space is more permanent, remaining until your zone is removed.

In addition to that, you can create projections that can wander in your zone. Your projections can have various appearances and abilities, although the less biologically stable the form is, the more fragile they become.

You can remove your zone by waking up.
objects.title: Daedalus

addons.text: Your creations can now gain the power of your domain. If you, for example, create a world where machines don’t work, then you can imbue a breaker/shaker effect on your creations, allowing them to keep said property, making technology incapable of working around them.
addons.title: Denizens

objects.text: You no longer have any issues with lucidity. Instead of superimposing objects and/or locations from other worlds, you can choose to make a world and impose it into our reality. The only real limit is your own comprehension. You can make a world where gravity doesn’t exist and then impose its properties on our world. You can also create locations inside your world and superimpose them on our reality. You still cannot create living beings.
objects.title: Alice in Wonderland

objects.text: You are now capable of massively increasing the range of Fluctuation, albeit with a catch: When this new function is activated, the range of your power amplification/weakening jumps up from 50 meters to a full kilometer, but music of a genre of your choice plays over the entire radius of your newly-expanded range. This music must be at least audible to the average person, but can be loud enough to drown out everything but shouting, and is omnidirectional but slowly gets louder as those affected near your location.
objects.title: Leitmotif

addons.text: In addition to their higher-dimensional forms, your creations have also taken on a multidimensional form, allowing them to infect and alter reality in even more ways. They now have the potential to completely remake the laws of physics. This new level of control over the fabric of reality gives you the power to mold the universe in ways that were previously unthinkable, perhaps even incomprehensible to an ordinary man.
addons.title: Multi Dimensional

objects.text: You can create higher-dimensional objects, such as Tesseracts. Due to human limitations, people will be unable to properly comprehend these objects. By staying around your creations, they will gain insight, allowing them to comprehend these objects at the cost of getting affected by various memetic hazards. These hazards can reach the point where they begin to warp both the minds and bodies of their targets, causing their target to "ascend", becoming a higher-dimensional object themselves. In theory, and with enough practice, your memetic hazards can even "infect" anything. You can also use this specialty to improve any other tinkertech you make, bestowing its unique properties to it. You can make yourself immune to the effects of your creations.
objects.title: Higher Dimension

addons.text:
Your tentacles are able to sustain themselves in a new way now. By touching a parahuman, they are able to absorb and drain them of their power. 

From then on, your tentacles are able to exhibit weakened versions of this power. Any Kraken you summon, or transform into, will be able to exhibit the power at full strength.
addons.title: Magical Kraken

objects.text: You are able to transform into and create tentacles within 100 meters of your location and control them up to a distance of 1 kilometer. These tentacles have the unique trait of absorbing water to enhance their durability and strength. If they are out of your range of control, they can also absorb water to sustain themselves. If enough water is absorbed, the tentacles can transform into miniature Krakens. You can generate and maintain multiple mini-krakens, but they require nourishment to survive outside of your control range. Additionally, if you transform into your changer state while submerged in water, you can transform into a colossal Kraken. You can use any striker power you have through your tentacles.
objects.title: Tentacles Everywhere

objects.text:
Inspired by the incredible Esper ability of Accelerator, your mathematical prowess and control over vectors have been combined into the overwhelming power known as Vector Manipulation. This power grants you the ability to create a thin field maintained by mathematical formula around yourself, enabling you to manipulate vector values of anything near you.

With this ability you can control various vectors, such as those related to kinetic energy, heat, electricity, and gravity. Initially limited to phenomena governed by physical laws known to humanity's laws of physics, your mathematical prowess allows you to incorporate vectors from unknown sources so long as you can analyze and adapt them into your equations, such as exotic matter, space-time distortions, parahuman powers, and potentially even phenomena unknown to the Entities like magic. As a result this adaptability may allow you to bend even the most foreign rules of reality to your advantage.

Your (Thinker) Number Man power has been enhanced to the point of enabling you to do things like predict and dodge attacks effortlessly, foresee future actions, identify weak points in your opponents, precisely measure objects, leverage your strength flawlessly, sense your surroundings through subtle vibrations, and sense the internal vectors of things you touch while simultaneously using attacks and defenses which require complex calculations. These mental capabilities provide you with unparalleled strategic insight, making you a formidable force in any confrontation.
objects.title: Accelerator, The One Way Road

addons.text:
Your ability to cultivate anything has not only enhanced the speed at which you can grow your dantian but has also expanded your mind in the process.

You gain the ability to cultivate a martial dao. With this, you can now optimize your chi to fit certain specializations. A sword dao would enhance your use of chi when using sword techniques, a fire dao would give you the ability to attack and heal with fire, etc.
 
You are limited in scope to only 3 daos, with choosing a new one requiring you to abandon one of your current daos, losing all your progress with it and having to start anew. If you have negentropy, your knowledge of your previous daos is still retained when selecting new daos, but without powers that enhance learning or multitasking, you will only be able to make progress in three at the same time.
addons.title: Martial Dao

addons.text:
Your energy pool of magical energy has reacted to your dantian, becoming your middle dantian in the process. This will provide you with multiple benefits.
 
First, this will allow you to use your spiritual and magical energies to either substitute or supplement each other for a variety of effects. However, substitution of chi with magic is slightly inefficient, with your spells becoming a bit weaker than if done regularly and vice versa. Supplementation, on the other hand, does not suffer from this problem, with spells instead becoming stronger than before, potentially doubling its power if enough chi is used. The same rules apply to your upper dantian if you have one, with your spells tripling in power if all are used.
 
You gain the ability to absorb ambient magical energy and increase your middle dantian in both size and quality, just like your lower dantian. It is also possible to inject your chi from your lower dantian directly into the middle dantian, transforming it into magical energy in case there is no ambient magical energy. This process, however, requires precise control during the conversion and is not advised during the heat of battle.
 
As a variation of your magical energy absorption, you can instead choose to absorb magical energy directly from other people. A normal person doesn’t have a lot of magic, but people with powers tend to have much more depending on how “magical” that power is. A person with the ability to blast fire from his hands will give you more power than someone who set fire with their mind. Take note that while absorbing all of someone’s magic may not kill them, it will still heavily weaken them and possibly put them in a coma.
 
It is also possible to reverse this process and give magic to people, with the effect being like giving someone chi, but enhancing related powers alongside their health as it reacts to their chi.
addons.title: Middle Dantian

addons.text:
Your psionic energy pool is now transformed into your upper dantian, giving you more options of what to do with it.
 
It is now possible to substitute energy from one dantian to another and combine their energies to strengthen their effects. Your psionic techniques can use energy used from your other dantians instead of psionic energy at the cost of slightly weakening them. The same is true with using your upper dantian’s energy to substitute for another’s. Combining your psionic energy with the power of another dantian will instead result in your psionic techniques potentially doubling in strength, tripling if all of them are used and vice versa.
 
You can also increase your upper dantians size and quality by absorbing ambient psionic energy. It is also possible to convert chi into psionic energy with time and effort, allowing you to cultivate in environments without abundant psionic energy. The same rules apply to other dantians as well, with one energy being transformed into another in case the different energies cannot be found.
 
You can also absorb psionic energy directly from other people. People with thinker or other mind related powers will provide more psionic energy than other people. Take note, absorbing all of someone’s psionic energy won’t kill them but it will leave them in a coma, assuming they don’t have a power that lets them act without thinking. If they do have such a power, it will be automatically activated until they can properly recover said energy.
 
Lastly, you can give someone your psionic energy, enhancing their thinking and mind related powers directly, along with their health and other powers indirectly as it interacts with the energies inside them.
addons.title: Upper Dantian

addons.text:
Your mastery of cultivation has allowed you to break the barriers of common sense and combine the power within all three of your dantians. Your spiritual, magical, and psionic energies have all combined within you to form soul energy.
 
With soul energy, your martial daos, spells, and even your psionic techniques are all quadrupled in power. Substituting the use of one dantian for another no longer results in energy loss, as soul power is used in all of them. You may also effortlessly combine your different techniques into soul arts which are even stronger than your regular techniques due to being optimized for soul energy.
 
Your dantians are all now linked to each other, meaning that cultivation one cultivates them all. This has the unfortunate side effect of slowing down your cultivation due to requiring each of the different energies to combine them into more soul energy, as a single energy only provides one fourth of the potential gains you would have obtained before. This can be circumvented, however, by directly absorbing soul energy from your environment. Ambient soul energy is generally rare, with soul energy typically being found within places where people worship, mourn, or have died in large quantities, with the objects used to carry out these activities also absorbing gaining some soul energy in the process.
 
It is possible to absorb soul energy directly from people, but this has the side effect of leaving them with a feeling of emptiness in their soul. This is assuming you don’t completely devour their soul.
 
You can also give soul energy to people instead of ripping it out of them. This will not only revive the recently deceased back to full health but increase all of their powers four-fold before the energy is used up.
 
Assuming you have Negentropy, you might be able to reach a level of power so high, you could fight an army of entities and live to tell the tale.
addons.title: Martial Soul

addons.text: The ultimate expression of art is embodiment. Everything explodes. You now understand this fundamental truth. Your chi, subsequently, is able to take on energetic exothermic properties and you are able to induce explosions of nigh anything at will via your chi, splitting targets into energy and their constituent parts near instantly. Explosions of any type—from simple fire to concussive to nuclear—can never harm you, and are simply converted into more of your chi. Likewise, your technological grasp has expanded. You can now substitute your chi for any energetic exothermic reaction required by your technology, and enhance them even further. Technology built by you cannot be worn down by explosions. Instead, such chi-explosions can now be worked to strengthen whatever is containing and directing them. To such an extent where use of the technology works to repair it. You are capable of creating engines to accelerate the growth of your own cultivation and accumulation of chi, as well as creating technology to administer any other ability you have via exothermic reactions. From explosions delivering full revival and healing, to slow falling and flying fires.
addons.title: The Dao of the Dao of EXPLOSIONS!
Imaginary Chi
addons.text:
Imaginary Energy and the Chi in your Dantian have merged completely, creating a new form of energy known as Imaginary Chi. Existing at the boundary between spiritual and higher-dimensional energy, Imaginary Chi is the origin from which both spiritual and conventional forms of energy can be derived, possessing all the spiritual qualities of chi alongside the unparalleled versatility of Imaginary Energy, allowing either system's techniques to seamlessly benefit from the strengths of the other.

Unlike ordinary chi, Imaginary Chi is not static. Through cultivation, it is continuously refined into an ever purer, denser, and more fundamental state, increasing not only its quantity but also its quality. As your understanding deepens, the potency, efficiency, and versatility of every technique fueled by it naturally improves, unlocking applications that would have been impossible with lesser forms of energy. There is no true limit to how refined your Imaginary Chi may become.

To you, the distinction between life force, spiritual energy, and conventional energy no longer exists. Any energy you generate or absorb can be effortlessly refined into Imaginary Chi, while Imaginary Chi itself can be expressed as virtually any form of energy or power with negligible loss.

objects.text:
Your energy well has synchronized with your chi, evolving it into an elixir field, or dantian. With this, all energy inside your energy well becomes chi, multiplying both its power and recharge rate by 10. This does not remove any of the previous capabilities of your energy well, with anything you could do with the energy well now also being achievable using chi, with new possibilities such as regeneration now available to you.
 
Your ability to absorb chi now spreads to the environment as well, allowing you to absorb the ambient chi of the natural world around you. Through this, you can increase the size and quality of your dantian, cultivating to higher levels of power.
 
Your ability to give chi is also enhanced, with your dantian allowing you to give even more chi than before. It still requires an entire person’s worth of chi to revive them. However, because your chi has been enhanced, they will no longer require daily doses of your chi to fully heal. They will instead be able to recover by themselves after that point, with the process being sped up by giving them more chi. If you have enough chi, it is possible to completely bring the recently deceased back to full health in a single moment.
 
With this power, you could potentially cultivate to become strong enough to destroy the avatar of an entity. If you have Negentropy, your growth limit is removed, meaning that even the entity at its full power might be destroyed by you.
objects.title: Lower Dantian

objects.text:
Your powers have converged, granting you the form of the ever-enigmatic and fearsome Pyramid Head. With this transformation, all your physical abilities receive a significant boost, their potency increasing further as you feed on the fear surrounding you. Alongside this terrifying strength lies your dominion over mist and fog, making it an extension of your will.

This fog permeates your very being, clinging to your every step like an ever-shifting veil that obscures your silhouette and presence. Its formless nature allows you to slip from the minds of those who lose sight of you, vanishing like a fleeting nightmare. The fog lingers, a haunting specter that is impossible to forget yet impossible to fully grasp.

But your influence is not confined to this shroud. You can extend the fog's reach, expanding its suffocating grasp to engulf entire towns. All caught within this oppressive haze succumb to its relentless effects—a miasma that saps strength from the body and mind. As it slowly gnaws at and dismantles its victims, limbs grow weak, thoughts scatter, and even the strongest wills may begin to fray. The fog's insidious touch manifests as a constant, ever-present dread, a whispering unease that devours resolve and sanity alike.

For parahumans, the fog brings an even greater curse. Their powers fade over time, gradually weakening until they are rendered completely powerless if they remain trapped for too long. The fog's potency intensifies as the night deepens, reaching its zenith at the stroke of midnight when fear saturates the air, amplifying the horrors within.

Your mastery over this fog extends further still, allowing you to mold it into constructs in any way you so desire. These forms are as durable as high-grade steel and grow stronger in proportion to the fear saturating your domain. Whether as weapons or barriers, your fog becomes an impenetrable fortress and a harbinger of despair.
objects.title: Pyramid Head

objects.text: Should anyone die under the influence of your song, not only will all information about them be erased, but they will also be revived as a featureless humanoid creature that you can control. They will retain any skill or power they have in life.
objects.title: Forgotten Call

objects.text:
The ranges from 'Byakugan' and 'Blink and you Miss it' merge into a singular 35 meters radius that gives you absolute awareness over everything inside it. You no longer have a cooldown for your teleportation.

Normally your awareness is bound to yourself, but you can detach it from you and move it around at 1 km/s. You can instantly teleport your awareness to anywhere you can visualize, see, or think off.

You can freely teleport things inside your awareness to anywhere within it—as long ss there is space—, you also count as one of those things. If your awareness is detached, you gain the capacity to teleport yourself and/or anything you are touching to it—you can also teleport around your body what you are touching, like from one hand to the other. You can't teleport separately something in possession of a sapient being—that isn't you—, meaning you can't take away someone's weapon if they are holding it.

Finally, you can impart your interactions on what you teleport and decide its orientation—as long as its non-living. What this means is you could for example make a rock launch itself as if you had thrown it with all your might or instantly switch a knife to reverse grip.
objects.title: Scry and Die

addons.text: Now you can turn others into imps permanently with a single touch while also removing the gradual weakening of your master effect. The transformed will still need 15 weeks for their power to mature.
addons.title: Devil’s Touch

objects.text:
The fused power limits the capabilities of Power Seed, making it only usable in conjunction with Imp Master. Now, when you first turn somebody into an imp, you must also enhance them with a power seed, which will be restricted to and only develop while they are in the form of an imp. The imp form will also reflect the power given via the power seed; for example, a water-manipulating imp could have blue skin and webbed feet, but it will always resemble an imp in general body shape, including the horns and tail.

With this upgrade, the duration of the Imp transformation becomes 6 hours, which doubles for every sp worth of power seed development, becoming permanent when the seed fully matures.

The gradual weakening of the master effect becomes complete when the seed matures, granting the imp complete free will beyond your control.
The complete transformation can only be broken by the master taking the power(s) for themselves and returning the target to their original state.

This transformation will overwrite Case 53 mutations.
objects.title: Imp Maker

objects.text: Your Tinker power’s specialization is now geared to causing the most amount of chaos possible, with a bigger and boggling scale to boot. In place of a countdown, you now possess a sense of a place’s stability and security; the more concord and order a place has, the less effective your power is in projects, designs, and functionality. What’s the solution? You burn the house down, of course! The more chaotic your actions are, with your tinkertech or simply yourself, or how catastrophic your surroundings are, your power rewards you with loosening its knowledge, giving more inspiration plus allowing you to tinker more easily. The projects you tinker with are colored by the element that enhances the power: Chaos. Bombs or knick-knacks capable of mindbending disorder, destructive megaprojects able to upend the world through sheer havoc, gadgets (or just about anything) with no drop of sense as to what it does or why it does what it does, to say a few. Scion only knows of the mayhem you’ll bring.
objects.title: Chaotic Tinker

objects.text:
Your abilities to plant, grow and boost powers have coalesced together to transform you into an incredible cultivator of powers, both in others and yourself.

Your enhanced ability to plant power seeds now causes them to start at 2 SP instead, growing and budding at a rate of 2 SP a week before finally maturing at a total of 20 SP. Similarly, boosting your own and others' powers also causes them to grow at an improved rate of 2 SP a week up to a maximum of twice the original SP cost of the power.
