You can boost powers you've planted but only after they've either finished maturing or you've taken the power back, with each individual only being able to have one power being boosted at a time. For example, you could plant a power seed, let it finish maturing at 20 SP before then boosting it up to be equivalent to 40 SP although completing this entire process would take you a significant amount of time.

Finally, you're now capable of planting and growing a single 2 SP power seed at a time within yourself. The budding, maturing and boosting of this power seed follows the same constraints for you as for other individuals. Note that you're still limited to only having one power of your choice operating at 100% with the rest being at 50%.
objects.title: Power Cultivator

objects.text:
Your power has evolved from a percentage-based precognition to a general quantum computation to model anything. This is best explained as using quantum computing to build models and designs for various outcomes. The more accurate and better the information you get your hands on, the better the accuracy of your estimations. This ranges from combat/battlefield calculation, and general timing, short and long-term pre/post/pericognition, to information gathering or anything that is estimated or evaluated.

How you engage with this is rather distinct: Instead of asking questions that are answered by a percentage about an outcome or event, in Kid Cassandra's case, this grows into a more involved process where you "figure it out" yourself, which allows you to see the "whys" and "hows" of the percentages.

This results in being capable of answering any questions as long as it is calculable.
objects.title: Quantum

addons.text:
Did you really think that finding the answer would satisfy your shard? No, now it wants MORE.

All resources dedicated to finding the [ANSWER] have been redirected to improving it. Now all the [DATA] you have gathered will help your shard improve both your energy generation and efficiency. The growth of all your powers will skyrocket as the growth of one will help fuel the growth of the next with the [DATA] it generates. With this your shard intends to go beyond infinity, from Aleph Null to Aleph Omega.
addons.title: Aleph One

addons.text:
Your algorithms have now taken esoteric energy sources into account in the search for the [ANSWER]. [Calculation]’s functions have been enhanced so that the powers of others can be made to simulate esoteric energy as well as negentropy. The data collected this way will also be used to fuel your understanding of esoteric energy.

Your shard’s research on various potential forms of energy also increases the speed at which it calculates [DATA]. It is now much easier to achieve the [BREAKTHROUGH] and gain pertinent knowledge of the [ANSWER]. This [DATA] also provides means for energy optimization, allowing your shard to cheat in terms of energy usage and make your powers more efficient in general.

Your reverse engineering of esoteric also receives a passive benefit from your algorithm as they begin calculating how said energy works so that it can determine how it relates to the [ANSWER]. This manifests in [Calculation]’s steadying and refining energy consumption and efficiency in both Innovation and Copyright Infringement. From the researching of esoteric phenomena, they can apply the calculated principles of such research alongside The [QUESTION]’s strides in endless supplies of energy, allowing for fashioning and devising projects closer to perpetual motion machines.
addons.title: Deep Thought

addons.text:
Prior Phenomenon and Quantum Chromodynamics have been merged and repurposed to continue the search for the [ANSWER]. Instead of merely recreating known phenomena, you can now create phenomena that would theoretically exist in a world with Negentropy.

An example of negentropic phenomena would be a stable self-perpetuating physical phenomenon. Every kind of phenomena has less and less potential to utilize, causing them to lose steam. Using [Calculate], you can stabilize them, causing complexity from the constant amount of potential energy the phenomenon contains. 

You could modulate a vector with a volatile payload to such an absurd degree that it would have ricochet elements. Then, while it is exploding, have it transmogrify said released energy into mass, taking everything that it took out with it and turning it all into something else. 

This also means you might manipulate the unheard vectors and factors of physical phenomena you couldn't previously, as the constant sourcing of multiversal potential energy to the phenomena stabilizes and complicates the local physics. This the control of particle physics to create and emulate negentropic phenomena through stabilizing said particles to control physics at a micro and macro level, making the phenomena’s range, capabilities, area, and everything else controllable to your liking.
addons.title: Theoretical Phenomena

objects.text: [SCANNING FOR REQUIREMENTS] [REQUIREMENTS FOUND] [BEGIN ANSWER CALCULATION] The program has been activated, there is no turning back. You will now begin directly searching for the [ANSWER]. The [DATA] your shard possesses on negentropy has been plugged into Quantum’s computational algorithms. As negentropy has proven inaccessible through the current path, it shall instead attempt to reverse engineer the [ANSWER] by simulating how powers would react if they possessed negentropy. [Simulation] has evolved and gained a new subroutine called [Calculation]. [Calculation] differs from [Simulation] as it is unable to be directly manifested in your range. It is instead manifested as a silvery white lightning that emanates from your halo. Using this lightning, you can strike parahumans to begin [Calculation]. This will cause their power to receive a constant increase in energy, simulating how the power would react with the user had the [ANSWER]. The energy used for this will first derive from your zero-point energy reserves, after which it will default to the host’s shard. It is also possible to strike yourself with your lightning to achieve the same effects. Once struck, the effect will not wear off until either you dismiss it, or the target exits your range. Your minor thinker power has been subsumed by Quantum, causing an exponential increase in your computational modelling. This is necessary to extract every possible variable and run it into the [QUESTION]. While the focus of the algorithm is to search for negentropy, it is still possible to use it to model anything else you may require. All calculations made will still be thrown into the [QUESTION] regardless of how relevant it is to the [ANSWER], in case the information somehow is relevant in later calculations. Due to how [ENERGY] exhaustive the process is, you are given the ability to directly monitor your shards energy levels. Authorization has also been confirmed for your shard to directly absorb zero-point energy into its own reserves no matter the source. This is because your shard is directly following the goal of the [Cycle], meaning that normally cycle-breaking actions can be excused if enough [DATA] has been provided. It is currently unknown how long the [QUESTION] will have to run until it achieves the [ANSWER], but current estimates say that it is most certainly longer than the average human lifespan. But, if you manage to achieve a breakthrough and make significant strides to solving the [QUESTION], you may be able to negotiate the survival of Earth on the basis that it is more valuable to keep humanity alive in search of the [ANSWER].
objects.title: The [QUESTION]

addons.text:
Just because you can generate esoteric energies, doesn't mean that you have mastered them. 

To Go Where None Have Gone Before has evolved, now being dedicated to the refinement of your esoteric powers. It seeks to study and optimize your energies for use in different ways and in different forms. Examples include refining your Chakra to discover how to combine nature transformation or how to refine the “slaying” part of Dragon Slaying Magic to specialize in slaying other creatures. 

In simpler terms, it has switched from looking for how it works to why it works. Upon gaining a deeper understanding of your energies, you will be able to apply their mechanics to various powers and tinkertech. You are still required to manually refine the data, however.
addons.title: Beyond The Edge of The Horizon

addons.text:
What is the point of all your wonderous discoveries if you cannot share them. If you keep them to yourself, locked away in a box for no one to see it shine. Time to bring enlightenment to the masses and bring about a true technological revolution.

While previously, the technology of Clericus Techno-Magica was unable to be deciphered, its combination with [Breakthrough] has allowed you to make advanced technology easier to understand. Any tinker how obtains your tech is also affected, as those who analyze your tinkertech will slowly become white-boxed as well. As the new principles are added to their databases, their tech will also advance, causing a chain reaction amongst all parahuman society. Information you obtain from these technologies will help further your own tinkertech, creating a feedback loop. 

Your tech will become the new bedrock of civilization, propelling them to heights that even the greatest tinkers could only dream of.
addons.title: Age of Enlightenment

addons.text:
To further help you expand upon your knowledge of the esoteric, the Arena has received an upgrade. Multiversal Emulator has been subsumed, allowing you to summon an additional mentor to train against. This will allow you to obtain knowledge of techniques that would be otherwise unobtainable. These include various combinations between fighters using the same system of techniques and how the different energies would interact with each other in direct combat. This training will also allow you to learn how to modify these techniques for personal use, without the need for additional help.

The number of mentors can be increased depending on what other powers you possess. Having Army of the Impossible will increase the number of mentors by the number of minions Endbringer Engine can produce. This number can also be increased further by if taken in addition to (Thinker) Simulacrum Advisor, starting with one and increasing each time Increase Advisors is taken. Taking Simulacrum Mentors will also allow you to increase the number of mentors independently of Endbringer Engine, will also provide the ability to fuse mentors.

Warning: Increasing the number of mentors does not give you the ability to fight on par with multiple mentors. It is advisable to increase the number of mentors slowly in order to acclimate to their combined skill level.
addons.title: The Fight is ON

objects.text:
Your shard has decided that you should be more hands on in your research of the esoteric. Your ability to simulate esoteric energy has become synchronized with your ability to study unknown phenomenon, turning yourself as a research subject.

As you use your simulated energies, whether through combat or tinkering, your shard will begin to analyze the differences between its simulation and theorized reality. It will then use this knowledge to refine your energy to being closer to the original until it matches what the energy is theoretically supposed to be.

The refinement process involves gathering data from multiple sources. First is your shard using Copyright Infringement and Innovation to detect any non-simulated examples of the various energies and techniques. Next is the comparison of this data to what you can display through both combat and in your tinkertech. Finally, it is all compared to the knowledge of what your opponents in The Arena are supposed to be capable of. This data is then used to update your simulated energy until it matches the target energy. Energy currently being used by your tinkertech can also be updated using Equipment Manifestations energy investment function. Additionally, the update to your simulated energies will also affect any other powers you possess, with [SHARD OS UPDATER] applying data to them when relevant. This process is not automatic and may take decades to complete depending on if you are active in combat and research or not.
objects.title: To Go Where None Have Gone Before

addons.text: Your Revelation and Faded Whole supports Optimum. Optimum uses your fragments and insight to go beyond the veil of every alternative, possibility, and secret the World offers, simulate any component, and then implement it on your psyche. It’s almost as if you mend yourself with the World, being more and more of it, reforming yourself into a memorial of experiences and echoes.  With enough time this shapes into other powers, physical and mental abilities, and skills allusive of a part of your psychology through the usage of Optimum’s [Data] for modeling a power expression capable of solving a problem close to your heart conclusively. The power’s potency, versatility, and scope depend on the fragment it latches on, for instance, your insecurity, confidence, framework, or guilt, among others.
addons.title: The Pleroma of One: Agent of the World

objects.text:
Using the budding endeavors of an Entity putting their insight into a Power, Path to Victory, and Vision fuses and evolves with a new purpose: to foster and utilize innovation and creativity. This has two functionalities:
  1. Using Path to Victory’s prior mechanics of gazing at all possible strands of time to search a single timeline where one goal is achieved to act on it, this does the same for a widely different purpose. It looks into all probable timelines at any point in time to investigate and experiment for novel and unorthodox ideas and courses of action to a problem or situation that either progress or optimize your effectivity, personally speaking; instead of focusing on one path, this accounts for more nuanced variables, and circumstances diverging to a multitude of paths flexibilizing your power. For example, in the circumstance of fighting Scion, this part offers a comprehensive view of the multiple old and new avenues, and visualizes it more as a conceptual diagram which is then used as pointers instead of a set of steps and letting your power take the driving seat.
  2. Utilizing Vision’s simulation capabilities, this is improved to boot. This applies broadly to any scenario possible on a larger scale, considering every possibility with a heightened fidelity and quality close to perfection through planet-wide scanning and detection of all components and factors and temporal perception (although it’s seldom used), as their interactions and interconnections between them. The simulations help with the continuous use and refinement of the power, with each use the power learns better methods and procedures to improve itself
This is, finally, the culmination of searching for a new horizon and using the importance of innovation to one’s advantage.
objects.title: Optimum

addons.text:
While mutating your bugs, you may grant them access to your wings, granting the powers imbued in them. This will affect the appearance of your bugs greatly. They will look like a hellish fusion between a biblical angel and whatever bug they originally were, with some additional traits from the power they gained. 

Possessing a pyrokinesis power, your bugs may develop a searingly hot exoskeleton that glows with a reddish hue. The heat generated by this exoskeleton would be intense enough to cause serious burns.

Having the Skittering Swarm addon extends this to anything you can control, and Monstrous Insects now allow you to turn into those winged bugs.
addons.title: Flying Spiders

objects.text:
Normally a power gifts you just a pair of wings, but now the amount of wings slowly increases and with it its boost and aid, though you now have control over their size, you can't make them bigger but you can make them smaller, which allows you to disguise them as "feathers" but decreases their boost and utility the smaller they become. You no longer are limited to only being able to use the wings from one power at time, you can now have as many as you can fit and if the power they come from are compatible they can be merged, improving the powers and grating you new capabilities, Fire and Earth giving you control over lava for example.

The effects of Metamorphosis are greatly improved. You no longer need a cocoon, Metamorphosis constantly affects you, getting rid of any injury and disease, with the speed depending on what it is healing, a small cut takes 1 second and a torn limb takes half a minute, and it improves and optimizes everything about you: strength, intellect, agility, beauty, charisma, your body capacity to digest food and etc. As time passes those improvements surpass what humanity can have and become parahuman in nature, for example your voice could gain echo and calm anyone that hears it.

Like your wings you have a transformation for every power you own, including ones that are gifted by others or temporary. The transformation is permanent but you can at any time switch from one to another, and even merge compatible ones, giving the same benefits of merging wings. Those transformations make you one with a power of yours, Pyrokinesis makes you fire and fire you, not only affecting your appearance but giving you the capacity to turn parts of your body into fire and to extend your consciousness to any fire in your control, and also expanding your control to heat and giving you the capacity to teleport to any fire under your control.

Both your wings and your transformations significantly boost all aspects of your powers and offer greater aid to them, with you only having all benefits if you use both at the same time. As time passes the boost and aid gets stronger very slowly.
objects.title: Elevation

objects.text: Congratulations, you’ve been blessed, or cursed depending on your perspective, with all the abilities that made Salem so fearsome. To start, you are strong enough to overpower low-tier Brutes, have super speed, can create glyphs to summon Grimm, whole or partially, have high speed regeneration capable of healing you from anything, even disintegration and the destruction of your Corona Pollentia. On top of this, your ability to create Grimm is boosted to the point that you can create entire armies in a relatively short span of time. You are also capable of creating hybrids and grafting Grimm parts onto people. You now have chalk-white skin with jagged black lines running across your body and red eyes with black sclera. This doesn’t protect you from attacks to the soul nor do you receive Salem's ability and skill with magic unless this is taken with Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge. Even then, a sufficiently powerful attack to the soul would still kill you.
objects.title: Salem

addons.text: Through synergy with Rampage Dress, Electro-Magneto’s everything has been amplified. Within a 5-kilometer radius, your ability to sense and control electromagnetic activity is nigh-absolute, with precision capable of individually manipulating charged particles at opposite ends of your range. With this, you are a veritable god of electromagnetism: illusions, particle beams capable of melting buildings in a single shot, golems of iron sand the size of buildings, outright negating the electromagnetic force to disintegrate objects, enhancing your physique or the physique of others to the point of being able to throw down with an Endbringer in physical combat, etc. All this and more can be accomplished with trivial ease.
addons.title: Electromaster

addons.text: There is no longer any “veritable” when it comes to calling you a god of electromagnetism. Your range has now quadrupled, expanding to a colossal 40-kilometer radius. Yet that is only the beginning. Your mind no longer exists merely within your body, but within every electromagnetic field inside your range, granting you a kind of all-seeing awareness throughout your domain. More than that, at any moment, you can let your body unravel and merge with the electromagnetic fields in your territory, achieving an omnipresent existence within it. While the center of your range remains fixed when you transform, you can reform your body at any location inside your sphere of influence to update the center position. Finally, your authority over electromagnetism is now absolute—superseding even beings such as Titans or Endbringers—with only an All-or-Nothing effect capable of overriding your control.
addons.title: Electrotheosis

objects.text:
Your powers have combined, augmenting each other to empower you into becoming the preeminent authority over the fundamental force of electromagnetism.

As such, your range when instantaneously generating and manipulating electromagnetic fields has subsequently expanded to 1000 meters. Your passive defensive shield has also improved, protecting you from any electromagnetic-based attacks by either deflecting or simply negating them.

You possess an enhanced electromagnetic sense, giving you absolute awareness of all electromagnetic fields within your expanded range. This awareness, combined with your advanced knowledge of electromagnetism, enables you to easily manipulate these fields with astounding finesse and skill. From manipulating electromagnetic radiation to producing lightning with ease, you are now the master of electromagnetism.
objects.title: Electro-Magneto

addons.text:
When you sleep, you can sense and directly control any of your guards. You can use your energy to alter them, granting them new forms and powers based off said forms. For example, rather than men riding horses you can turn them into centaurs, or even make them men riding wolves. You can also make their appearance and abilities random if you wish. Certain alterations also won’t cost any energy and in fact will give you energy, such as removing their horses, which will limit their movement speed.

The longer you sleep, the more guards will spawn. Your range also increases the more guards you have, starting at 10 kilometers.
addons.title: Dreamer’s Guards

addons.text:
The longer you sleep, the stronger your guards become. Every hour you stay asleep, all your currently spawned guards either gain a power that’s worth 1 SP or improve a power it has by 1 SP. You can choose to sacrifice guards to increase the strength of another guards powers, following the concept of “Quality over Quantity”.

Each guard can have no more than 10 powers with each of their powers not being able to surpass 10 SP worth.
addons.title: Dreamer’s Delusion

addons.text:
You can use your energy to summon your guards even when awake. However, this will be a continuous drain of your energy, the amount of energy being drained increasing the stronger and more numerous your guards are.

In addition to that, you can use your energy to actively create guards when asleep, rather than wait for them to spawn naturally. You can also do the reverse, making no guards spawn to increase the amount of energy gained and stored.

Your guards will no longer weaken the further away they are from you, although they still will be unable to leave your range.
addons.title: The Dreamer Wakes

objects.text:
Your ability to control your guards is enhanced, enabling you to communicate with them while you sleep, allowing you to direct and guide your guards. This enables you to use your guards in a more offensive manner. 

Your guards have become smarter, capable of analyzing enemies and devising tactics on their own. Even without your help, they can handle threats efficiently. With your guidance, their ability to deal with enemy groups is greatly improved. You gain natural leadership skills and tactical expertise allowing you to lead your guards effectively in combat situations.

Your range also increases, allowing you to sustain your guards at a maximum range of 5 kilometers.
objects.title: The Sleeping Might

objects.text:
Your tinkertech has evolved, now imbued with a life of its own. It can now take on the guise of other objects, seamlessly blending into its surroundings with uncanny precision. Whether it assumes the form of a living chest, a sentient firearm, or even a sentient house, its ability to mimic the appearance of mundane objects is truly remarkable.

In its stationary state, your tinkertech becomes virtually indistinguishable from its non-living counterparts, making it the ultimate tool for camouflage and deception. In its active state, it sprouts flesh-like tendrils that writhe with life, secreting specialized acids capable of dissolving even the most resilient of obstacles. Meanwhile, bone-like protrusions emerge, fashioned into teeth that gnash with an unsettling hunger. It morphs from an ordinary object into a grotesque mimicry of life itself. A chest-like form becomes a gaping maw, lined with rows of razor-sharp teeth, ready to rend and tear at a moment's notice.

Moreover, you can add unique appendages onto your tech. This ranges from an acid shooter capable of unleashing corrosive torrents, or an electrical tendril crackling with potent energy. Other ideas are the ability merge with its counterparts, forming a formidable collective entity, greater than the sum of its parts. Another idea you could add is a minor space expansion within its stomach, allowing it to eat beings far bigger than itself.
objects.title: Mimic

objects.text:
The ensuing synthesis of these powers’ synergies creates an odd result: A Network (with you as a focal point and moderating force) facilitating and ensuring power functionality and effectivity within the Network’s members.

Retaining their previous functionalities and interactions, this offers far-out operations based on the idea of a  “cornerstone”: With you acting as a center point, you’re capable of modulating, enhancing, and improving your Network members’ innate and shared powers facilitating concurrency and synergy between them, allowing flexibility between compatible powers, reducing power restrictions and the like through distributing and optimizing your Network members’ collective energy reservoirs and enabling pings between Shards in the Network.

Your Networking thence evolves into simulating a Firmament simulation composed of your Network members.
objects.title: Cornerstone

addons.text:
Your ability to flicker has greatly been amplified, allowing you to hold overlay multiple versions onto something at the same time. You can overlay up to 10 (15 if Shardless/Negentropic) versions onto something at the same time, and you can choose specific features of each verison to carry over, merge, or be held back as you wish. You do not have to be actively viewing another possibility to use their abilities for yourself. You can choose whether you shift to match alternate versions or not and your alterations are permanent and instant, unless shifted back. 

Your more powerful Ignis Fatuus aspect merges with Harmonic Engine, massively increasing Paradigm’s pool of power by 3 (5 if Shardless/Negentropic). Instead of losing your Ignis Slots to Paradigm, they reconstitute themselves becoming available for use again, without weakening Paradigm, and increasing to 10 (15 if Shardless/Negentropic). Their overall power is increased to hold equal to the total strength of your combined powers. You can also freely summon other versions of yourself if you wish. You can also directly fuse them with Paradigm to increase it's power further, and unfuse them as you wish.
addons.title: Paradigm Shift

objects.text: Your power has grown to allow you to view every version of yourself simultaneously, as well as extending it to any thing or beings you touch. Each version of You is intrinsically loyal to you regardless of how much they deviate from you and each other. You can allow them to communicate with you and each other. You no longer simply overlay another version of yourself, instead your flickering ability operates as normal allowing you to freely swap any parts of yourself and those you touch to any other state or version. From freely swapping what powers you have available to healing oneself. Your flickering can now also be applied to those being viewed through For The Want Of A Nail, allowing you to do things such as heal them or even teleport them. Your flickering ability can now operate without any conscious thought, automatically shifting to desired states and powers. Break your arm and find it immediately shifted to a healed state, your location immediately shifting as soon as you want it to, find yourself wanting blue hair and if you’d look in the mirror you’d see it. This only operates on what you’d want to happen, neither surprising nor backfiring, simply removing the need for any conscious thought. The realities from For The Want Of A Nail are valid targets for your flickering, allowing you to for example turn a enemy from your reality into a friend from a reality where they are one. The slots of Ignis Fatuus have also grown tremendously, either growing to hold powers thrice as powerful as before with a single slot or equal to the total strength of your combined powers, whichever is greater. While this can be used to swap and choose powers as normal, this also allows you to place an alternate You’s powers inside, allowing you to use their abilities without having to swap out your own. Your Ignis Fatuus slots have grown to 3 (5 with Negentropy/Shardless). Holding the same power among multiple slots or fusing slots will dramatically increase the shared power, your own abilities also count towards this increase.
objects.title: Endless Reflection

addons.text:
Your adaptive and reactive power generators create a scenario only found in video games: Whenever you die on a singular reality, you gain a prospective offensive and defensive/supportive power from Glass Cannon and Queen of Escalation or its upgrade (for some measure of control) respectively, addressing and counteracting the previous reality. The power’s rate of growth is then accelerated through continuous or frequent reality reduplications.

Your probable powers are more far-reaching or responsive to the user’s needs in particular cases to boot, such as finding yourself in a robbery and not surviving to tell the tale, you gain a Combat Thinker specialized on ambushes and counter-attacks and either a Brute power focused on stabs or a repulsive field around yourself.
addons.title: Rogue-like

objects.text:
Everytime you die you multiply reality and go back anywhere between 1 second to 24 hours into the past. 5 Coiling Serpents creates 5 realities upon the death of one of your selfs, Coil creates 2 realities and (Thinker) Vision creates 10. While you are still technically limited to 2 timelines for Coil and 5 Visions for 5 Coiling Serpents each reality created by the death of one of your selfs will have its own limit.

Say that you have 2 Realities with Coil (we will call those 1-A and 2-A) and you die on 2-A so reality 1-B and 2-B now exist, 1-A can now create a new 2-A and if 1-B collapses 2-B it can create a new 2-B and vice-verse. The same applies to (Thinker) Vision and 5 Coiling Serpents.

If you have any means to come back to life in some way you can  use that method instead of replacing your dead self with multiple realities.
objects.title: Time Hydra

addons.text:
The 'trap' sacs which imprison and dissolve targets are now fully compatible with the tinkertech that you can construct through Mimic. Any tinkertech that you create via Mimic can automatically be integrated into and used by your 'trap' sacs when you produce and place them down. You can even use your monster-making sacs to produce biological versions of your tinkertech 'mimics'. Note that you have to construct the tinkertech before you can produce 'trap' sacs or 'mimics' with biological versions of that tinkertech.

For instance, you could potentially create a semi-sentient 'trap' sac that is disguised as a vending machine in its passive state before it transforms, quickly devouring any unlucky target in its way and then converting them into biomatter for you to use.
addons.title: Snare Sacs Snacks

addons.text: The mutagen that you produce is now an inherent aspect of your cocoon-like sacs, enveloping the subject held within the sac. The dramatic effect this has on the capabilities of the sac is twofold. Firstly, the mutagen's ability to induce rapid, optimised evolution massively speeds up the sac's normal rate of enhancing the creature's physiology alongside their abilities. Secondly, you can now fully control how the creature in the sac evolves and is enhanced, from forcing its powers to evolve down a specific possible route to altering the creature's final form and traits to make it more suitable for a specific environment. You no longer have any limit to how strong any of your creatures can become but you still require enough biological matter and mutagen for the changes to occur.
addons.title: Phylogenesis

objects.text:
Your ability to construct cocoons has merged with the sacs generated by Nilbog, further expanding what you are capable of. You can now freely place down sacs instead of having them attached to your body, retaining full awareness and control over them, no matter the distance. You can produce and place three different types of sacs for a specific task; a sac to entrap a target and convert them into biological slurry, a sac which can uptake this biological matter to produce new monsters and finally, a cocoon-like sac.

The cocoon-like sac can hold any carbon-based creatures, such as animals, humans or your monsters, and then modify them. This initially involves rapidly healing injuries and curing diseases in under 20 minutes before then continuously optimising, enhancing and expanding the creature's physiological and mental state, alongside any powers or abilities that they might possess. This is a slow process but the effects are permanent.

The longer a creature is in a sac, the more powerful it can become although this eventually levels out, limiting any creature to being equal in strength to the strongest parahumans. The cocoon-like sac requires biological matter in order to undergo these processes and you're able to direct the outcome of these processes to a limited extent.
objects.title: The Chrysalis King

objects.text: Your Weapons Platform gains the ability to assimilate vehicles and devices to enhance itself and gain durability. You gain durability equal to your Weapons Platform and gain the traits of any vehicles or devices your platform absorbs. Absorbing a battleship allows you to walk on water, and absorbing anything larger than the Weapons Platform’s maximum capacity means that such vehicles will be shrunken down to fit while still possessing their full power. Absorbing anything larger than your maximum capacity will slow you down proportionately to how large it originally was. Even if the Weapons Platform is not currently summoned, you still gain durability and traits from it.
objects.title: Mobile Fortress

addons.text: Now, the effects of your stranger power extend to events caused by or related to you. For example, if you destroyed the moon, no one would find it surprising—just another day to them. You can telekinetically control objects in front of people, and they will consider it completely normal. If you master someone, people will just think you have great charisma. Even if you create tinkertech, people will view it as unusually stubborn tech that is difficult, if not impossible, to replicate. They won't associate it, or you, with tinkertech.
addons.title: Just Another Day

objects.text:
You are, or at least appear to be, entirely average. People rarely notice you, and even if they do, they quickly forget. To most, you seem utterly ordinary and forgettable. No one associates anything noteworthy with you. Even if you were to destroy an entire city and sit atop a pile of corpses, no one would believe you were responsible. They will not be able to believe that you have powers, since you are completely average.

You can toggle this effect on and off.
objects.title: Background Character

objects.text:
Your ability to control blood and your ability to imbue blood with exotic effects have merged and mutated.

You gain the ability to infuse any blood you control with a variety of power-like effects, from healing or weakening people to releasing and conducting electricity or boosting the powers of others.

Your control of blood is qualitatively improved in terms of fine control, enough to puppet someone through your control of their blood. Lastly, what kind of constructs you can make is improved as well, expanding to include any tinker tech you could make from blood. However, they still must remain in contact with you.
objects.title: Hemomancy

addons.text:
Your monstrous Wendigo transformation has merged with your vampiric body, granting you the benefits of the form without needing to transform.

You gain even more strength and speed from consuming the blood of others, and the benefits you get from consuming the blood of Parahumans qualitatively grow in strength to the point of being identical powers with just a drop of blood.

Furthermore, similar powers stack so consuming the blood of a Parahuman with a power similar to what you already have increases the strength and versatility of your powers. Devour enough Pyrokinetics and you can surpass all of them combined.
addons.title: Plunder

objects.text:
Your various blood related powers have merged with your undeath and transformed you into a proper vampire.

Several magnitudes increase the rate at which you heal and gain power from blood, and the boost in power from Blood Bath even increases your mental capabilities and the strength of your powers as well.

Your control of blood evolves such that all blood in a large city-wide radius that isn’t in a body automatically counts as your blood, and your fine control reaches the point of making changes on a molecular scale. 

Your resilience is something to behold as you can survive and heal from virtually any damage provided your Corona Pollentia remains unharmed. Furthermore, due to your control of blood you can freely act no matter how damaged, using your control of blood to puppet your own body or even create spider legs of blood to scurry around on if you are reduced to just a head.
objects.title: True Vampire

objects.text:
Your ability to establish a connection with others has mutated True Vampire, granting you the ability to create a Vampire Coven. 

By biting someone and injecting them with a bit of your blood you can bestow upon them an extremely weakened version of True Vampire, which they themselves can increase in power by consuming blood.

Furthermore, you maintain a constant mental connection to your Coven, capable of accessing their senses, feeling their emotions, and hearing their thoughts. You can even send mental messages to them to command them at range.

Your Coven are fanatically devoted to you and it would take great measures for them to even think of betraying you, let alone follow through with it.
objects.title: Vampire Coven

addons.text: Your changer state has transformed, becoming a shifting pillar of black sand. You can freely morph your appearance into fearsome monsters made of black sand and an eerie glow, allowing you to adapt to any situation. You can sense and absorb fear of those around you, using it to permanently increase your strength and enhancing any other power you have, either boosting its raw strength, increasing in versatility or removing their restrictions.
addons.title: Nightmare

addons.text: Your creations can absorb the fear of those who encounter them, altering their appearance to look more real and less like black sand sculptures. When they absorb fear, they gain minor powers related to the type of fear and their appearance. For example, a figure that looks like a shadowy person might gain the ability to move silently and blend into the darkness. A doll with cracked features could make small objects move and whisper unsettling thoughts. A swarm of insects might control real insects and paralyse with a bite. A mirror could create spooky reflections and show ghostly images from the past. A tree might trip people with its roots and make eerie noises. These powers are small but make the creations more frightening and effective at scaring people, creating a cycle where they grow slightly stronger as they absorb more fear. The more powerful your creations become, the less fear they need to sustain themselves, thus allowing them to survive further away from you.
addons.title: Fear Monger

addons.text:
Your form has further improved, allowing you to gain minor powers the more fear you have absorbed. You no longer have a range at which you have to absorb from, they just have to fear you specifically, allowing you to even gain the fear of people on the other side of the globe. This means that as long as someone anywhere in the world is afraid of you or your creations, their fear adds to your strength. As you absorb more fear, you gain additional minor abilities that make you even more formidable. These abilities are mostly support abilities, made to enhance your already existing abilities.

The more fear you gather, the more versatile and potent these minor powers become. This continuous cycle of absorbing fear and gaining power allows you to cast a wide net of influence, instilling dread and gathering even more fear from every corner of the world. Your ever-growing powers make you a figure of global terror, drawing strength from the fear of countless individuals who may never even see you but feel your presence in their darkest moments.
addons.title: The Boogeyman

objects.text: You have the ability to summon black sand constructs that manifest from the fears of others. These creatures can sense and absorb fear, which nourishes and strengthens them. They can also physically enter the minds of others, whispering doubts and fears while haunting their dreams. The stronger they are, the more realistic they look. Strictly speaking, there is no limit to the number of fear constructs you can create. However, if there are too many and insufficient fear to sustain them, they will weaken and perish, or worse, turn on you to feed on your fear. The further away they are from you, the more fear they need to sustain themselves.
objects.title: Pitch Black

addons.text: You can enter the minds of others, either personally or through your creations, to instill and amplify fear. Your power allows you to craft creatures that embody specific phobias, targeting the deepest fears within your victims. These creatures are called Nightmares. For example, you can conjure a serpentine creature to torment someone with ophidiophobia, its slithering form haunting their every thought. Similarly, you might create a shadowy figure that preys on someone’s fear of the dark, its presence an ever-looming terror that plunges them into paralyzing dread. These fear-crafted entities are not only tailored to the individual's nightmares but are also capable of persisting in the real world, their sand-like forms shifting ominously as they pursue their targets.
addons.title: Fear Avatars

addons.text:
Your mastery over fear has evolved, enabling you to gradually transform individuals into fear-addicted beings who crave both the experience and infliction of terror. To do so, you have to have either one of your creations or yourself stay within the mind of your target. As their minds succumb to this corruption, they begin to develop a new ability: a temporary surge in strength when causing or experiencing fear. They may also slowly gain weak powers based off the fear the Nightmare embodies, if it embodies any at all. The powers will be based off whatever power you have if you are the one staying in their mind. The powers gained tend to be support powers, made to amplify their already existing abilities.

However, this descent into fear addiction comes at a cost. As they become more corrupted, their threshold for fear increases, making it increasingly difficult for them to achieve the same rush. This compels them to escalate their actions, seeking more extreme and perilous situations to attain their high. This relentless pursuit of fear ultimately traps them in a vicious cycle, pushing them to ever greater extremes in their quest for that fleeting, intoxicating rush of strength.

They will become fanatically loyal to you, causing fear in your name. Every time they absorb fear, a portion will also go to you.
addons.title: Corrupted Fear

addons.text:
Your Nightmares now possess the ability to absorb fear from anyone who specifically fears them, regardless of distance. They also gain a small amount of power whenever someone experiences fear related to what they embody. For example, a Nightmare representing the fear of heights will siphon a bit of fear energy each time someone feels afraid of heights. If this Nightmare possesses a person, that person will also benefit from the fear absorption, although it will further corrupt their mind. 

You can also freely enter the dreams of people who fear you, regardless of distance, however, it is limited to only projecting your mind in their dream, limiting the degree of influence you have. By staying and corrupting your target's mind enough, you can fully possess them, using your powers, as well as their own, through them.

In addition, you have acquired a new ability: the power to temporarily embody specific fears. By absorbing these specific fears, you can gain unique enhancements and abilities. For instance, by absorbing the fear of arachnophobia, you might develop the agility and venomous strike of a spider, while embodying claustrophobia could grant you the power to manipulate space, creating confining barriers around your enemies. You can also create Nightmares that embody these fears, have them absorb fear before devouring them. This method however will not be as effective, although admittedly will be easier.
addons.title: Phobos

objects.text: You possess the ability to enter people's minds, delving into their subconscious and whispering to them, altering their thought process. While they sleep, you can invade their dreams, seize control, and link their dreams to others. You can extract objects or creatures from these dreams and manifest them in the physical world. These dream-born creations are composed of shifting sand, mimicking their original appearance with a slightly altered texture. They retain the powers they had in the dream, albeit slightly weakened, with a maximum of three powers worth up to 5 SP each.
objects.title: Dreamscape

addons.text: You can now enhance your Holodeck's capabilities by imbuing your holograms with archetypes, granting them a sense of autonomy within their defined roles. This allows you to create individuals or groups to fit on those roles, such as positioning yourself as a General with a platoon of soldiers under your command. However, this process can be somewhat imprecise unless you are currently immersed in the role or have extensive experience with it. As a result, your creations might struggle to fully adhere to their roles and rarely exceed their defined tasks, as a example, a maid designed to clean wouldn't be able to drive but could still accidentally break a vase.
addons.title: The Entire Circus

objects.text:
Now, you can merge these abilities to produce solid holograms. This fusion allows you to create lifelike entities and objects that can touch, move, and manipulate the world around them, enabling you to craft experiences and tools that are as functional as they are believable. You aren't limited by volume nor memory, allowing you to create working tools, entire landscapes populated with complex life, or enemies/minions to fight for you.

The durability and strength of your solid holograms are tied to the power of your hard light constructs. You gain a boost to memory and coordination to use this power effectively, enabling you to recognize and correct minute changes if you focus on a few creations at a time.
objects.title: Holodeck

addons.text:
Your Shard has gone crazy, causing the synergy effects of your powers to reach unprecedented levels. As a result, you have become the most unpleasant, unbearable, and hated person to be around. This is because your power no longer has a Manton Limit, indiscriminately affecting everything and everyone within a 50-meter radius.

When you encounter a person, your power breaks them in every conceivable way, mentally torturing them worse than Taylor's three years of suffering, all within a matter of seconds. However, the torment doesn’t stop there. With an uncaring and alien mindset focused solely on improvement, your power rebuilds their minds and bodies, making them harder, better, faster, stronger, and smarter, much like it does with machines and technology. Every alteration opens new avenues for further improvement, creating an endless cycle of enhancement. The work is never over, and individuals continue to evolve minute by minute.

Your power also affects Shards connected to parahumans, "reformatting" their priorities while maintaining their abilities. This effect is so profound that it can even cure Case 53s after just a few hours in your presence. Using a Shard such as [BROADCAST], your power acts as an unavoidable relay, ensuring that no one within range is spared its influence.

The transformations are both a blessing and a curse. While you can elevate people and technology to new heights, the relentless nature of the power leaves those affected in a constant state of flux and insanity. The improvements come at the cost of their peace and sanity, as they are perpetually subjected to the Shard's drive for perfection.
addons.title: The ever, never ending, Pursuit of [PERFECTION]

addons.text:
Your ability to refine and improve technology has evolved beyond simple failure-based iteration, now allowing for intentional, controlled modifications that push devices beyond their original limitations. No longer restricted to passive enhancement, you can now actively overhaul, augment, and restructure technology, integrating properties that were never originally present.

With Enhancer, your modifications become an ongoing evolution, gradually reshaping an item in response to use, external stimuli, or even your own intent. Once an item has been enhanced for long enough, it becomes something new, alloying to pushed in more directions your power will show.

With Fuse, you can take any two objects, technologies, or enhancements and merge them, creating entirely new hybrid systems that blend their functionalities seamlessly. The fusion is no longer temporary—you can now make permanent integrations, rewriting how the fused components interact. A mundane firearm fused with an energy blade might become a plasma bayonet, while a nano core merged with an exosuit might generate a self-repairing, auto-adapting armor system.

Unlike traditional tech, these modifications are not bound by conventional science. The nature of your enhancements transcends normal engineering, enabling fusions of magic, technology, and the esoteric with seamless efficiency.
addons.title: Commencing MODIFICATIONS

objects.text:
Through destruction comes creation; in your case, improvement. Any technology that fails under your power will now be reworked based on improvements specifically addressing its points of failure after being fixed by this power. These improvements are permanent and manifest physically, allowing a Tinker or researcher to observe the changes.

Every flaw will be exploited—from material properties to code/software to the synergy of esoteric effects such as enchantments. Each repair eliminates these weaknesses, only for the tech to break again in new ways. These reworks do not gain immunity to Tech Shutdown effects unless you explicitly demand it, however, doing so, will significantly hinder or stop the technology’s ability to further improve through this power.
objects.title: Ever Evolving Tech

objects.text:
By performing precise miming gestures, you can project invisible barriers, tools, or even entities that obey the form and function of your pantomime. For example, acting out the motions of climbing an invisible ladder allows you to ascend as if one were truly there, or pretending to push against an unseen wall creates a solid barrier that can block attacks or trap opponents.

This power also extends to mimicking objects or weapons, such as pulling an invisible rope to trip an enemy or wielding an unseen sword to strike at foes. The constructs last as long as you maintain the miming act, requiring concentration to keep them effective. Additionally, the more detailed and expressive your miming, the stronger and more versatile the projections become.
objects.title: Mr. Mime

objects.text: Lights, Music, Action! Your powers have fused into a new whole—a seamless blend of transformed abilities—a symphony that unifies your gesture-based telekinesis and mimed constructs into one potent art form. Each grand gesture you make empowers you, elevated by an accompanying leitmotif that rises with the tension and drama of your actions. The more expressive and precise your movements, the more potent the force you can summon—at its peak, you could even unleash apocalyptic amounts of power, leveling a small mountain and leaving it as naught but a pile of rubble beneath your feet. Your constructs have become significantly more robust, now endowed with the gift of permanency. They exist independently of you until you choose to dispel them, but each interaction or use steadily drains your stamina. Sustaining "living" constructs is particularly taxing, though placing them in "pause mode" can ease the burden. An innate awareness of each construct's location keeps you constantly attuned to them. Your mimicry skills have also evolved, enabling you to create highly intricate and lifelike items and creatures, even imitating other powers to a lesser extent. With the right dramatic flair, you could mime a colossal dragon into existence, complete with its own complementary abilities. However, summoning such an entity would demand hours of deliberate effort and a considerable toll on your stamina, mental and physical.
objects.title: Pantomime Theatrica

addons.text:
You can extend your senses through time. All possibilities are within your reach, what was/is/will/could be are but a portal away.

Together with this you instinctively know blurry details of something you could sense within the Past or Future and its timeframe, look at a password protected door and you will see a faint outline of someone typing the password a hour ago, touch your skin and you can vaguely feel a stab wound that will happen tomorrow and etc.
addons.title: Gazing Backwards And Fowards

addons.text:
You can extend your senses through time. All possibilities are within your reach, what was/is/will/could be are but a portal away.

Together with this you instinctively know blurry details of something you could sense within the Past or Future and its timeframe, look at a password protected door and you will see a faint outline of someone typing the password a hour ago, touch your skin and you can vaguely feel a stab wound that will happen tomorrow and etc.

You also have a conscious and unconscious knowledge of everything that is/will be/can be. You know every detail of why someone is the way they are, you know who will die and who will live, you know why someone tripping on a rock was essential for the birth of a villain and etc.
addons.title: Understanding Time

objects.text:
Your portals can lead to anywhere within time, doesn't matter if it is the past, present or future. Conditions from Door Me still apply, so you can't go to somewhere within 1997 Paris without first seeing that somewhere on Paris. Portals can be made anywhere where you can see or around you.

You can freely change the shape and color of your portals, like a empty rectangle with blue edges that allows you to see the other side or a full golden hexagon that blocks sight.

Those portals last indefinitely and the replacement of a Past/Future self is now optional.
objects.title: Time Windows

objects.text: Your capacity to end something by accelerating it expands into Acceleration, Deacceleration, and Reversal. While you can still use it on yourself, on things you are touching and on your powers your capacity to use it on anything you can see is replaced by using it on anything the energy from your energy well permeates. Accelerating, Deaccelarating and Reversal all cause a glitch-like effect on what they are being used on. Acceleration: allows you to speed up the time of something. Functions almost like the original Time Magic, but while the original would stop accelerating someone who wanted to raise their raise their hand the moment it made they complete the action you could continue accelerating them. Deacceleration: allows you to slow down the time of something. This can be used to delay and stop things, aging? Slow it down to live a little longer, a barrage of projectiles is coming towards you? Blast a wave of energy on their direction to slow down their motion. Reversal: allows you to reverse the time of something. This can be used to repair objects, heal injuries, bring the dead back to before they died and etc. You can accelerate/deaccelarate/reverse the time of something as far you want but the more you go below/above 10x the original speed (for acceleration/deacceleration) or before 10 minutes (for reversal) the more of a headache you build up, go over the limit too much and you might die of brain damage. You can expend energy from your well to go beyond the limit without gaining a headache or dying, but acceleration will consume much less energy than deceleration and reversal due to time nature of always moving forwards. Negentropy removes this drawback.
objects.title: Time Jack

addons.text:
If you chose Beautiful, Handsome, Androgynous, or Attractive you immediately have access to a human form that resembles your previous one, it will have bright colored hair that matches your slime form's color.

If you chose Average your only have your slime form, you can chose the color. Your slime form will look like a blob of colored Jello with no distinguishing features.

If you chose Ugly or Hideous your slime form will be repugnant to look at, instead of a uniform texture there will be bits of debris and remains floating within. Any human form you shapeshift into will be rendered uglier. Your slime form will also have a distinctive and unpleasant smell.

If you chose Deformed your slime form looks unhealthy, patches of discolored matter appear on your surface and float inside of you. Any human form you shapeshift into will have some form of deformation like burns, missing parts or look unhealthy in general.
addons.title: Case 53

addons.text:
Your vast observational capability not being optimized for use by a [HOST] is no longer is problem. Your Virtual Intelligence has assimilated and adapted to the massive influx of [DATA] to become the interface through which you access it. This has not only enhanced all its previous capabilities but has also caused it to gain free will like Dragon, evolving into a Meta-Adaptive Neural Algorithmic System or MANAS. Thankfully, your MANAS will still be loyal to you, due to its core programming being focused on assisting you.

Now that the data has been optimized, you can more easily manipulate information about the world around you with simple commands. All information gained can also be accessed in a neat, easy to read format. Your preexisting powers are not neglected either, as your MANAS can use the information to better understand and optimize your abilities to adapt to a wide range of situations. It is even possible for your MANAS to use your powers for you should the situation require it. An example would be your MANAS using your information manipulation power to make you “move” while time is stopped and resist other trump powers.

Additionally, you can allow your MANAS to take over your body to perform complex tasks or have it control any of your available minions.
addons.title: Virtual Evolution

objects.text: Your slime form evolves to a new level. Your body is now composed of homogeneous cells that can adapt to any tasks required. You lose access to the individual powers and instead your form gains new powers. Your body keeps its resistance to all forms of sickness, poison, heat, radiation, electricity, and acid from Immune Response. You also do not feel pain anymore due to the nature of your physiology and gain a degree of resistance to physical attacks. Omniscience, evolves and assists the host with a variety of functions. Virtual IntelligenceThe Shard interacts with the host as a disembodied emotionless voice and can also project complex information directly into the host's mind if necessary. At first, the virtual intelligence will only answer when interacted with but will over time learn from its host and interject when it deems it necessary. The stronger the bond between the Shard and the Host becomes the better the intelligence becomes and might even anticipate the Host's needs at times. Appraisal allows the host to obtain information about a targeted object, being, or phenomenon. The target must be visible to the user to be appraised. Knowledge allows the user to access the Shard's knowledge about the world. Predator unlocks the Slime form's full potential with a number of abilities. Stomach provides a pocket of storage for materials absorbed and extraneous mass. Quarantine is a section of the stomach reserved for harmful or waste materials that will be destroyed and converted into extra mass and energy. Predation allows the user to absorb an object or being into themselves and digest them, it is easier to absorb inanimate objects or unconscious beings than conscious ones unless the size difference is great enough. You can also absorb power effects as long as they are tangible (i.e. lasers and force-fields but no Thinker or mind-based Stranger/Master powers). If you absorb and digest a Parahuman's Corona Pollentia and Gemma you can Mimic their powers in full (but it will kill the Parahuman in question). You can release beings that you have absorbed into yourself unharmed if you choose to, however it does not prevent them from being traumatized by the experience. Analysis allows the use of Appraisal to analyze absorbed objects of effects and Mimicry allows the reproduction of analyzed objects, for beings it allows the host to mimic their form or attributes (as long as sufficient mass is available in storage) or reproduce the objects (as long as the appropriate base materials are available). Mimicry allows shapeshifting into any analyzed shape and even mix-and-match components of multiple shapes, you can also improve and modify them if you have Self-Biokinesis. You can reproduce any tangible power effect you have analyzed however doing so requires concentration which limits how many you can use at once. If you have multiple similar powers (like several different lasers) they will combine into one with the properties of all of them. If you have a Tinker power, you can build objects with Mimicry if you have the requisite base materials or components in your stomach.
objects.title: Reincarnated as a Slime

addons.text: You no longer need to use charges to uncover knowledge or how to manipulate it. Whether within or beyond the world’s physical laws and delimitations.
addons.title: Ahura Mazdā

addons.text:
Both Pramant and Araboth incorporate themselves into a single ability, gaining each other's properties and losing their limitations. Araboth’s enhancement and enchantment process can be directly integrated into Pramant’s shard ability, allowing you to advance your Shard’s tiers to enhance its capabilities and each enchantment can be used to grant them a new subroutine or rapidly advance its existing focuses. Perks can be created as Enchantments. 

Their charges gain each other's properties and can be used interchangeably. This also grants understanding behind any enchantments, powers, and other benefits created by Araboth, greatly furthering your [Study] ability’s efficiency.
addons.title: Da’at

addons.text:
You’ve gained the ability to infuse your Shards with a form of true sentience and autonomy, although you retain their absolute loyalty and total control over them, one that they could have potentially developed on their own with a significant period of time but you can now skip over.

The Shards no longer have to serve as large crystal batteries or computers simply for your usage and/or research, now they can serve and freely act on their own, if you wish. What this allows them to do is they can construct avatars of their own to interact with the world, they can research and develop on their own, manifest and fight directly alongside you, and much more.
addons.title: Tuath Dé

addons.text:
Your ability to create shards has been enhanced by your newfound connection to fictional universes. This allows you to tap into the limitless potential of fictional worlds without needing to do [Study] of that universe. Thus you can bypass the needed to [Study] a universe’s technology before you can [Crystalize] shards designed specifically for crafting technology and items from these fictional worlds.

With Drawing Board this ability extends beyond technology, allowing the Shards you create to embody not just the technological knowledge of a universe but also its unique powers. This advancement completely eliminates the need for [Study] when generating abilities from well-known fictional settings, making them instantly available for [Crystalize].
addons.title: Fictional Tinker Database

objects.text: Your particular set of abilities have melded and mutated, unlocking its secrets and giving rise to one of the most ancient and fundamental abilities the Entities have used since they left their homeworld, their ability to uncover and manipulate any and all information and phenomenon. You retain all properties and capabilities of your component powers, this adding on top of them. This power comes with three major parts, [Study], [Assimilate], and [Crystallize]. Your power will generate double (triple if Shardless/Negentropic) the amount of charges it did previously. The first major ability [Study] allows you to uncover any information and phenomena. You may do this by directing your power to studying anything within your power’s range without expending charges, or you may choose to expend charges to uncover information and phenomena of any kind regardless of range or other factors. This is done by utilizing incredibly powerful and true precognition simulations. While within range your power can immediately uncover, break down, and grant understanding of anything studied. When utilizing charges a single charge can provide significant if somewhat limited understanding of phenomena, three will typically uncover most conventional phenomena and information entirely, five will uncover more esoteric things such as magic. This can be used to study anything such as other powers within range, more esoteric phenomena such as causality, learn skill sets that don’t exist, and even learn how to establish effects such as perks. The closer it is to something that you already have uncovered or otherwise know about the less charges you’ll need. You can opt to allow [Study] to choose random targets, which will massively boost the efficiency, unveil far more information than normal, and require less charges overall. The second major ability [Assimilate] allows you to incorporate uncovered information into yourself. [Study] Thermodynamics and you find yourself capable of inciting thermobaric reactions at a macro and micro scale with no more effort than a blink; pour a few charges into Electromagnetism and you could find yourself capable of curving the light around you the moment the whim to be invisible strikes you; [Study] Project Management or Clean Code you find yourself able to Accord-level planning and exhaustive technical knowledge geared to any project and essentially programming an AI with no chances of corruption or faults, respectively, and much more. Charges are not required for this step as this is typically accomplished by your ability to manipulate things. The final major component is [Crystallize] which allows you to make the last major step that Entities take throughout their evolution. By spending a charge you can construct a Shard, where you encapsulate and crystallize your power and knowledge, its technical and theoretical knowledge, and its conclusions born out of exhaustive experimentation and study, under a fractured and regrown piece of your Shard, effectively making a Shard bud specialized in the studied phenomenon, and functions just as any Shard distributed on a Cycle. This can also be used to establish more esoteric effects such as perks like Blank or All Seeing Precognition. Your recently fabricated Shard has the specifications and organic hardware of a Common Shard at first, only capable of secondary or low-priority capabilities, spending charges on improving and focusing on your Shard’s development and expansion, however, helps with promoting your custom Shard to an equivalent to a Noble Shard at 15 charges. You possess full control over any shards you create. All Shards at a minimum will possess the ability to manipulate matter and energy in a significant radius like you.
objects.title: Pramant

addons.text: Your Tinker specialization reaches the cognitive understanding of the archetypical framework of the psyche, which you can use to redefine the very concepts, rationale, and sentimentality of people alongside reframing a mindset or thought process through your Tinker projects. You apply fundamental notions, for example, exponentially increasing the potency of Memes, being a vehicle of easily transmissible ideas using archetypes to express the inexpressible; you can implement an archetype with such nuance people are caught unaware of the psychological changes, as the signs characteristic with Master effects aren't easily noticeable or isn't present at all; replicating Master and Stranger effects can include self-enforcing notions, deeper emotional or rational countermeasure increasing efficacy, and a propagating effect which broadens the range and influence. Overall, is simply the endpoint of this specialization: changing the very elements of which consciousness uses to understand, parse, and accept information and the world.
addons.title: Arkhé

objects.text: You've been unshackled, no longer held back by petty limitations. And in doing so, you have become something absolutely terrifying. Your ability to manipulate cognition knows no bounds, your Tinker specialisation being both revered and reviled. Your Tinker powers have merged into an all-encompassing specialization centred around the interaction between cognition and information in all its aspects. As a result, you've gained unparalleled insight into manipulating information within minds, how external information can impact psyches and so much more. Any previous limitations, such as range, intensity or complexity, on your cognitive-focused Tinker tech have been entirely removed. You could rewrite someone's entire thought process through a video, create memes that can spread globally in days, link everyone across the planet into a unified hivemind, transplant a consciousness into a new body or clone it into a digital existence... almost anything relating to the mind and how it interacts with information can be explored. This isn't restricted to human minds either; any being that possesses something akin to consciousness is capable of being affected by your Tinker tech. This even allows you to manipulate the alien cognition of Shards and the Endbringers themselves although the Entities are shielded from this. You can create Tinker tech that can produce and replicate almost any form of Stranger or Master effect you can think of with enough effort. This ranges from effects akin to Imp or Cherish to being able to enforce a Master effect as absolute as that of the Administrator Shard. You can even construct information and mind-focused Thinker abilities akin to Über or Tattletale via your tech.
objects.title: Cognoscenti

addons.text: You have much greater freedom when it comes to modify the properties of the threads you create, and they can be imbued with much more exotic properties such as invisibility, immense sharpness, or the ability to electrify themselves.
addons.title: Esoteric Threads

objects.text:
Your various thread and wire based powers have combined and mutated into a more general Thread Manipulation. 

The speed at which you create thread is vastly accelerated and your efficiency of converting stamina and/or fat stores into thread is similarly enhanced, allowing you to produce vast swathes of thread in the blink of an eye.

Your ability to alter the properties of thread you create is greatly enhanced, allowing you to imbue threads with capabilities such as immense durability to point you'd need the strength of Alexandria to break it, regardless of thickness, or the ability to puppet objects and people, turning enemy Parahumans against their allies.

Lastly, your precision when controlling thread is likewise improved and you gain infinite multitasking when it comes to controlling your thread.
objects.title: Thread Manipulation

addons.text:
Now your permanently linked dolls allow you to sprout the linked target’s body parts any time as if they were within your line of sight, and you can also take control of the sprouted body parts and forcibly utilise their powers through them if it enables said power use. For example, you could utilise striker powers by sprouting their arms or activate a fire breath attack by sprouting their mouth on a surface.

You can also take control of their enlarged person-sized dolls, which now always mimic their current condition, with whatever you write on the dolls being only visible to yourself. But this control will feel as if you replicated and attached all of their body parts together, taking up a great deal of concentration and multi-tasking, limiting you to controlling a few dolls at best without being overwhelmed.
addons.title: Vodou Manifestation

addons.text: Now, when you replicate body parts, they can optionally inherit the inertia of the original, redirected in the direction in which they sprout, allowing you to do things like hit several targets with a single punch or make your targets hit themselves.
addons.title: Rapid Bloom

addons.text: You can now absorb DNA by touching body parts of others you made via Body Bloom. Optionally, you can also create a permanent link that ties your clones to the original, which will make them share damage and/or senses while the clones still retain their loyalty to you.
addons.title: Offshoots

objects.text:
Your ability of sprouting and replicating pieces of your own body evolved, allowing you to sprout the body parts of others within your line of sight or via the requirements of Voodoo, which will be controlled by your target as if they had a temporary limited version of Multi-limbs. The sprouted body parts of others will also have damage and sense-sharing properties, but you retain control over the creation or dismissal of said body parts.

The body part sprouts also became more seamless, allowing it to automatically bypass minor biological hurdles to the user’s benefit, like eating through several mouths at the same time while having only a single esophagus, having several livers work on alcohol processing after getting drunk, or even sprouting several heads for improved mental processing speed. Albeit, this will have some diminishing returns based on biological limitations.

You will also receive a minor thinker power, which allows you to process and coordinate by having multiple copies of your body parts and senses, granting vastly improved coordination. This is also temporarily shared with others you use your powers on. Granting you and/or others the ability to seamlessly utilize having several limbs, eyes, or even certain organs.
objects.title: Body Bloom

addons.text: The effects of Arcadia have further increased, allowing you to train your beasts to increase their strength even further. These enhancements will be partially retained by your beast, meaning that it is possible to train more beasts than you have slots, but you can only train beasts you currently have enhanced. Your slots are also increased to 5 with Negentropy making it 7 and making both your growth and the growth of your beasts faster than ever.
addons.title: Annwn

addons.text: The spiritual nature of your beast has reacted to your Dantian. It is now possible for your beast to be enhanced by spiritual energy to become stronger. This also affects your fusion, allowing you to gain all their power at half again the strength. These enhancements will be partially retained by your beast, meaning that it is possible to train more beasts than you have slots, but you can only train beasts you currently have enhanced. Your slots are also increased to 5 with Negentropy making it 7 and making both your growth and the growth of your beasts faster than ever.
addons.title: Spirit Cultivation

addons.text:
The combined effects of both Arcadia and your dantian have drastically enhanced all your beasts. It is now possible to give your beasts dantians, allowing them to train and absorb spiritual energy to become stronger. These dantians will not fade away when you unsummon them, meaning it is possible for them to become stronger even when they are not in one of your slots. However, the beasts are only able to retain the dantian itself. Any other enhancements such as the spiritual form or enhanced brute rating will only apply to beast within a slot. On that note, your slots are also increased to 7 with Negentropy making it 10 and making both your growth and the growth of your beasts increase at ludicrous speed.

Additionally, when combined with your beasts, your dantians will have a synergistic effect on one another providing a variety of uses. The first is that being combined will increase the cultivation speed of both, allowing you to get stronger faster. Next is how you will obtain double the strength of the beast you are combined with. Lastly, you will be able to create a projection of said beast using your own Ki. This allows you to both attack with any natural weapons that they have that you do not possess and unleash devastating ranged strikes.
addons.title: Penglai

addons.text: The power of friendship spreads to empower you beasts. Now your beast will gain two random powers that cost at least 5 SP each whenever they are summoned. The powers will always be something thematic with the beast themselves. Note that this also includes the personal history and personality of beasts, not just their species. A wolf that has never successfully gotten a mate could manifest the power to charm others and a mischievous cat could have telekinesis. Your beast will only have powers for as long as they are in one of your slots. They will also possess the ability to alter your power set just like your regular Animal Friends.
addons.title: Beast Friends

addons.text: Your beast can now have a total of 15SP for powers (or 20SP with Negentropy), with a maximum of three powers each whenever you summon them.
