It is also possible for you to change their powers after an hour of contact just like with Super Animal Friends. The ability to alter each other’s power sets is also shared between both groups and you. Lastly, due to all your beasts now gaining the ability to fly, their spirit forms have become even faster.
addons.title: Super Beast Friends

objects.text: Your ability to summon a spirit animal has been absorbed by your otherworldly archive, allowing you to summon any of your beasts in spectral form. While in spectral form, your beasts have their brute rating cut in half but become faster, can turn intangible, and are able to fly. You can also allow your beasts to “possess” you, allowing you to access all the power they would possess in their normal form. The number of beasts you can summon has increased to 3, with negentropy increasing it to 5 and promoting faster growth.
objects.title: Spirits of Gaia

objects.text:
The range of your senses expands past the planet, allowing you to extend them to the stars themselves!

You no longer have a range limit on your Clairvoyance, allowing you to see everything in every universe simultaneously.
objects.title: Everything, Everywhere, All At Once

addons.text: Your baseline boost softcap scales greater than before, and as your draconic transformation reaches higher and higher levels, your softcap continues to rise while the stamina cost from boosting scales slower. In simpler terms, the more your transformation progresses, the more you can boost and the less it costs to boost. The strength you can gain from this is such that you could fight non-sandbagging Endbringers on even ground and fight entire armies of parahumans with contemptuous ease.
addons.title: Juggernaut Drive

objects.text:
Twice Critical’s functionality has evolved through synergy with your abilities to amplify your surroundings and push past your limitations. 

You no longer have a hard limit on how many times you can double your strength, instead your limit is a soft-cap set by your baseline strength, the stronger you are as a baseline, the more boosts you can withstand. You can even go beyond your cap, although doing so causes strain on you which scales with how far past your limits you are. The stamina cost from boosting scales with how many times you’ve boosted. Transferring boosts to others still draws the stamina costs from you, however other beings have their own limits and going past those causes strain to them not you, so don’t give your allies more than they can handle.

Your capability to transfer boosts has also grown. You can now double specific properties, even those of inanimate objects or phenomena. Double a sword’s sharpness, a shield’s durability, a fire’s heat, or a laser’s power. This is not subject to Amped Up’s limitation of one property per target and you can even spread out a boost across multiple attributes, although the end result is still capped at double the original state. Objects have their own limits based on their quality, however due to their nature they don’t incur much of a stamina cost. You can also spread out a boost across multiple targets to not overwhelm them.

To give a sense of scale, using multiple boosts on a single property allows you to do things like turning a simple lighter into a conflagration capable of slagging metal and torching entire buildings. Be wary however, as continuous boosting can quickly drain your Shard’s reserves if the boosts get big enough, although Negentropy or Shardless render this a non-issue.
objects.title: Boosted Gear

objects.text:
Your control of gravity has qualitatively grown in both scale and precision. You are now capable of completely negating gravity within your range, and your new limit for the maximum amplification of gravity is 10,000%.

Your maximum range has expanded to 500 meters, and your fine control scales based on the proximity to the target area. For example, at the edges of your range, you are limited to broad alterations such as changing the direction or intensity of gravity in a general area. Within 50 meters of yourself, you could simulate telekinesis, and within 5 meters, your control would be precise enough to disintegrate something into minuscule pieces or create a pseudo-force field by repelling matter. Additionally, you gain the ability to direct your gravity wells and black holes after creation, allowing you to move them telekinetically and actively wield them as weapons.

With time, practice, and the right knowledge, you could even improvise a Brute power by altering your own weight, as weight is simply the product of mass and gravity.
objects.title: Graviton Surge

addons.text:
When you bind a ghost to a doll, the doll’s powers are significantly enhanced. If the doll is unlinked, the ghost remains bound as usual, without additional effects. However, if the doll is already linked to a person, the ghost can possess that individual, gaining control over their body and mind. This also means anything you do to the person through the doll also happens to the ghost when they possess them. This possession allows the ghost to project its domain through the person, greatly amplifying the domain’s strength and influence. The connection between the ghost and the possessed person is two-way, meaning any harm inflicted on the person also affects the ghost, creating a powerful but dangerous bond.

If either the ghost or the person dies while they are bound, the ghost devours the person’s soul, permanently absorbing their traits and memories. This strengthens the ghost, making it more powerful, but it also corrupts the ghost by adding aspects of the person they devoured. These new traits can alter the ghost’s behavior, abilities, and personality, creating a hybrid entity that blends the qualities of both the ghost and the person it consumed.
addons.title: Haunted Dolls

addons.text:
You no longer need to summon the ghost, as now all ghost are visible to you at all times, with you having the power to make them visible to others. The wounds the ghost suffered when alive no longer affects their form, instead they appear as monstrous forms twisted by grudge or regrets they had in life unless made visible to others. To others, they appear in their idealised form. Ghost you bind can now devour other spirits, doing so strengthening their domain. 

The strength of a ghost’s domain now increases as the doll to which they are bound remains in a single location over time. The longer the doll stays in place, the more the domain seeps into the surrounding area, gradually becoming more powerful and deeply entrenched. If the location aligns with the nature of the ghost’s domain, this process accelerates, allowing the domain to take hold even more quickly. For instance, a ghost with a domain tied to sorrow might find its power growing rapidly in a place of mourning, such as a graveyard, while a ghost with a domain connected to water could submerge its influence faster near a river or within a damp, abandoned building. However, if the doll is moved from that location, the domain will begin to unravel, weakening and eventually returning to its original state.
addons.title: Ghost World

addons.text:
Your Wraiths can now be connected to a doll of your making, transferring any damage they suffer into the doll, making them effectively immortal as long as the doll isn’t completely destroyed. If the bind between the doll and wraith snap, they lose access to the abilities connected to the doll, such as their domain or their immortality.

Your Wraiths passively project their domain, creating an aura of influence that reflects their essence and amplifies their presence. In addition to retaining any powers they had in life, each Wraith gains a new ability uniquely tied to their domain. This ability is an extension of their influence, making them more formidable within their domain. For example, a Wraith who was a master swordsman in life might now summon spectral blades within their domain, attacking from multiple angles at once. A Wraith known for their intelligence might create a domain that distorts reality, disorienting anyone who enters, while also gaining the ability to manipulate memories. A healer in life could develop the power to drain the life force of others within their domain, converting it into energy to sustain themselves or their allies. Meanwhile, a Wraith who was a musician might create a domain where haunting melodies echo, granting them the ability to control emotions or induce hallucinations in those who hear their music.
addons.title: Occultist

objects.text:
You can summon a ghost and bind it to a humanoid doll that you create, with the success and strength of the binding depending on the doll's shape and the materials used. If the doll contains items connected to the ghost during its lifetime—such as a piece of clothing, a lock of hair, or an object of sentimental value—the binding becomes significantly stronger. 

Once bound, the ghost can be summoned through the doll. The ghost then takes a physical form, with any damage it takes being sent to the doll. Every time the doll is damaged, the bound between the ghost and doll weakens, and if it completely snaps the ghost loses its physical form.

In its physical form, the ghost is able to create a domain, a space that mirrors the ghost's essence and emotions. This domain allows the ghost to manifest its will and power within a limited area, altering the environment and influencing those who enter. 

The strength and reach of this domain are directly tied to the binding's potency. For example, a ghost bound to a simple wooden doll might create a small, faint domain where its presence is barely felt, while a ghost bound to a doll containing its former wedding ring could generate a vast and intense domain, filled with echoes of its past life, where the ghost can manipulate reality, trap intruders, or project illusions based on its memories and unresolved emotions. The more personal and meaningful the materials used in the doll, the more powerful and intricate the domain becomes.

Having multiple incompatible domains in the same area can cancel each other out.
objects.title: Voodoo Dolls

objects.text: Having the power that intuits connections, but never tells you the ‘how’, and the power that can infer/deduce said ‘how’, but doesn’t know what to truly focus on, and deliberately choosing not to have them work together would be the ultimate act of stupidity. Because of this, these two powers now work together to become a mystery-solving engine, able to help you figure out the connections Conspiracy Nut gives, or give you a good lead to get more information to solve it. Provided you feed them information about the subjects of the connections you make, this fusion will fill in the blanks with what they can infer. This is not a “Path to Solving Mysteries”, but rather an ability that gives you a solid lead that gets you closer to solving that mystery, if it's unable to solve it then and there, that is. Along with this, any information/connections that aren’t necessary to know about (either for solving the mystery, or if the information is beneficial for you to know) will be filtered out when focusing your powers on figuring out the connections proposed by you or Conspiracy Nut, thus giving you more time to use your powers before a Thinker headache comes around. With these two powers working in tandem, a ‘power couple’ of powers that detectives all over the world would kill for, to call you the parahuman version of Lieutenant Columbo or Sherlock Holmes wouldn’t be far off from the truth. You can still use these powers on their own, but they work best when used together. This fusion synergizes well with other Thinker powers, or powers that excel in gathering information. If able, the boon of ‘any unnecessary information being filtered out’ will also apply to any of these powers when following the condition mentioned before.
objects.title: "Oh, Just One More Thing..."

addons.text:
Your powers have subsumed the original, becoming more.

You can now transfer energy between your powers, taking from one to restore another. If a power’s battery is running low or starting to decay, you can drain a different ability in your arsenal to replenish the battery or undo the decay.

In addition, the number of powers you have active changes how they function. If you use fewer powers, each one becomes stronger, reaching beyond its normal limits. If you have only one ability, it will be more powerful than they normally would be, bypassing Manton Limits and being able to directly affect Endbringers. However, the more powers you have active, the more your skill and understanding of them increases, allowing you to use them with greater skill and effectively use them together, understanding exactly how they synergies with each other. No matter how many powers you use, they will never weaken beyond their base strength or skill.
addons.title: Eidolon 2.0

objects.text:
The powers you receive function like the ones from Decaying Strength with internal batteries like Battery Powered. As long as the batteries have energy, their power will retain its strength; the moment the battery becomes empty, it will make the power decay. The decay is halved while their regeneration speed is doubled, and the battery duration is tripled.

You are limited to only three at a time if particularly powerful, nine at a time if very weak, or six at a time if anywhere between both. Though only two/three/six of them can be a power from your collection, the other one/two/three of them work like Ephemeral though instead of the strength varying it gives you a power of similar strength to what is on the other slots.

Besides the main powers you receive, you have 1–5 auxiliary minor powers for each main power that work similarly to Ephemeral, whose only purpose is to help your main powers. Using a Blaster power that shoots lasers as an example, you could have an auxiliary that makes you see farther things in greater detail, another that makes you capable of altering its shape, and another that allows you to alter its path.

You consciously and unconsciously know what each power you have through Eidolon-like can do and can use them as if you had them for years. You know what powers in your collection would be most helpful and with what.
objects.title: Eidolon-like

objects.text:
Your various abilities have fused and evolved to mimic something greater, the Weeping Angels.

Whenever seen, your body can become completely impenetrable, even shrugging off most All or Nothings, at the cost of being unable to move and your body gaining into a stone-like appearance. Unlike real Weeping Angels, you can control the degree of this phenomenon, if you wish to still be able to move then lowering the degree of defence you gain will allow you to do so, albeit still slowing your body.

When not seen, even in the time it takes to blink, you become what is essentially an unstoppable beast. Your defence turned into pure offensive power, your attacks being All or Nothing in nature. You can see a web of energy in all living beings, allowing you to drain people of this energy, which causes them to rapidly age. You can use this energy to displace people in time, sending them either into the future or to the past, with the former costing less energy. You can also use this energy on yourself for various purposes, such as reversing wounds or speeding up your time to move faster. The applications will only grow the more energy and experience you have.

Your last and most troublesome ability is your propagation. You can give your energy into any statue, turning it into your image thus allowing you to turn it into yourself. Any time something depicts you, be it an image or statue of you, it will transform into your clone automatically, the time it takes depending on how accurate the depiction was. If you wish for it, your clones can act independently to further spread more images of yourself, thus allowing you to gain even more clones.

If you have either Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless, you become an actual Weeping Angel, with the added advantages this fusion has compared to the real Weeping Angel, giving you their Psychic Power. You can mentally influence people by having them look at into your eye. Some examples of mental influence included making the victim count down the minutes to their death, and making the victim hallucinate that a limb was petrified. They would also dissuade their hosts from closing their eyes, which would shut down their influence.
objects.title: The Lonely Assassins

addons.text: Your control over your internal biology has allowed you to combine different mutations without experiencing genetic instability. However, the process of stabilizing the different mutations leads to a drop in how powerful they are, with more conflicting mutations having more severe drops. It is possible to unite similar mutations such that the overall power would increase instead but this will not happen automatically, requiring trial and error to correctly fuse them.
addons.title: Genome Stabilization

addons.text: Your catalog of mutations has been enhanced by your ability to clone anything. The powers you have copied are no longer limited to high T1 versions of themselves, able to manifest a full one-to-one copy. Echidna’s effect on clones also applies to your copied powers, allowing you to access both enhanced and alternate versions of each power in your database.
addons.title: Extended Catalog

addons.text: Through your biokinesis and understanding of Case 53s it is now possible to convert other parahumans into Case 53s. The process will result in their powers getting enhanced, with your instinctual knowledge of biology allowing you to properly calibrate them so that they can properly control this power. This will result in various mental changes, meaning that even if they don’t appear too monstrous, it would still be advisable to use your powers to change them back. All Case 53s made this way will be automatically recorded into the catalog.
addons.title: New Case Files

objects.text:
Your own mutations have stretched your shards definition of human past its limits, allowing you to now shapeshift into any Case 53 or other “mutants” that you came into physical contact with or have a sample of. Your shard will automatically analyze their mutations and catalog them to not only copy the person, but also apply the mutations to any other possible human, including yourself. 

Through this process, it becomes possible to duplicate powers of the Case 53s if the mutation is directly related to the power expression and not completely unrelated. Powers copied this way can only be as powerful as a High T1. While technically possible to combine mutations, it is ill advised since you may begin to suffer from extreme genetic instability and potentially die due to conflicting mutations.

This power will also record each of your Lucky Mutations in the catalog as separate entries, allowing you to change which one you are currently using. You may retroactively decide if you have them all by default or if one or more are your “main” ones. Due to all being sourced from the same shard, you will not be barred from using them all at once as your shard will already know how to combine them without causing genetic instability.
objects.title: Catalog 53

objects.text:
Your power has evolved far beyond a mere understanding of fashion and design, now granting you a mastery over the entire spectrum of artistic and functional creations. You possess an intuitive command of both the artistic and scientific aspects of design, allowing you to seamlessly merge creativity with cutting-edge technology across a wide range of mediums.

Not only can you design clothing that reflects and amplifies emotions and personality, but you can also apply your expertise to the creation of art, furniture, carpets, and other decor. Whether it's crafting textiles with unique properties, designing furniture that is both aesthetically stunning and ergonomically perfect, or creating art that resonates on an emotional and psychological level, your abilities span across all dimensions of artistic expression.

Your understanding of materials goes down to the molecular level, enabling you to craft items with advanced functionalities—like self-cleaning fabrics, temperature-regulating furniture, or adaptive art that changes based on the environment or the viewer's mood. Every creation you make is not only visually compelling but also optimized for durability, comfort, and specific needs, blending form and function in perfect harmony.

Moreover, your ability to read and understand the emotions and intentions behind others’ design choices has deepened. You can detect the subtle interplay of materials, craftsmanship, and artistic intent that convey hidden messages, allowing you to perceive not just surface emotions but also the deeper intentions, status, and psychological state of the creator or owner. You are at the forefront of innovation in art, design, and decor, capable of transforming any space or object into a masterpiece that resonates with those who encounter it.
objects.title: Artisan

objects.text:
Each time you drain a parahuman of their Chi, you can create a Jade Talisman imbued with their essence. These talismans can be transformed into Jade Warriors. These warriors possess the full strength and abilities they had in life, however, creating these Jade Warriors comes at a cost, as each one permanently reduces your total Chi. You regain this Chi after you unsummon the Jade Warrior.

Any Shade you possess can be summoned as a Jade Warrior, and conversely, to revert any Jade Warrior into a Shade. While the number of Shades you can maintain is limited, they do not drain your Chi to summon.

Your Jade Warriors are resilient, able to instantly heal from any injury, restoring themselves to peak condition in exchange for a portion of your Chi.
objects.title: Jade Warriors

addons.text:
Thanks to having your Manton Limit removed, you can affect the mass and size of living organisms just as you would inorganic objects. Your power will compensate for any issues that might arise due to large changes in size and mass on biological physiology, like the square-cube law for example, allowing living organisms to safely operate as normal. Yes, you too can now shrink your own children. 

You can also use this ability to affect yourself with a touch as you might others, having the same limits and safety measures. You could increase your size to that of a house and/or decrease your mass to effectively float in the air.
addons.title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids

objects.text:
Your ability to manipulate the mass and size of objects has advanced to the next level, allowing you to effortlessly alter any inorganic object you touch to suit your purposes. Enlarge a bottle to that of a water storage container? Turn a tank into a keychain? It’s all within your grasp.

The maximum size you can increase objects up to and affect is now equal to a large two-story house although your lower limit remains the same. Additionally, you can adjust the mass of objects by up to five orders of magnitude in either direction. You have precise control over these changes and they are completely independent of each other; an object can be made larger while its mass becomes lighter and vice versa. 

You can remotely re-adjust the size and mass of any object for up to an hour after touching it. Your alterations are permanent but you can reverse them at any point, restoring the object to its original state. The overall physical structure, consistency, and internal strength of the objects will remain intact regardless of size or mass changes, preventing instability at larger or smaller scales.
objects.title: One Mass/Size Fits All

objects.text:
Your ability to interlink minds and elevate the intellect of those within your range has fused and evolved. No longer confined by physical proximity, those who are part of your network now benefit from the increased mental capacity regardless of distance. 

As more people join, their combined intellects build upon each other, leading to increasingly complex and sophisticated thoughts. This isn’t just a simple enhancement—it’s a deep, synergistic fusion of minds where each individual’s contributions elevate the collective intelligence.

Together, these aspects create a collective consciousness that functions as a singular, unified entity under your command. The network’s overall intelligence grows exponentially as more minds are added, reaching levels far beyond ordinary comprehension. In this state, you and those connected to you have transcended normal cognitive limits, operating on a plane of intelligence and coordination that renders conventional strategies against you obsolete.
objects.title: Supercomputer Network

addons.text:
Master of the Hidden Veil has seamlessly integrated with (Shaker/Blaster) Bag of Holding, giving you the power to produce hidden portals to your pocket dimension behind any suitable cover.

So long as the covers' dimensions make reasonable sense for the objects to pass through and the portal itself is directly unobserved, you can produce as many of these types of portals as your multitasking allows. You can fire something out of these unseen portals at up to 60 miles per hour.

Additionally, you can choose to transfer any objects concealed via your power into your pocket dimension whenever you wish and have perfect telepathic awareness of everything that you have hidden.
addons.title: Dimension of Hidden Things

objects.text:
The realm of the hidden and the unseen is now yours to command, allowing you to move, transfer and conceal with remarkable skill and secrecy.

Instead of just teleporting yourself, you can freely and remotely teleport inanimate objects you're aware of from across the world as long as both the object and the location it's being teleported to are unobserved.

In addition to this direct teleportation, you may also transport yourself and objects by entering and emerging from behind any suitable cover, akin to a portal. The cover's dimensions must be large enough to allow for it to make reasonable sense and the direct area of the disappearance/emergence must remain unobserved to work. You could crawl out from a large pizza box or draw a sword from your sleeve, but larger objects, like a car, would need to emerge from behind a tree, for instance.

You can now also extend your ability to "hide" behind things to inanimate objects via touch. This means you can freely conceal items as long as their dimensions make reasonable sense in relation to the cover used to hide behind. For example, you could hide a spear in your pocket or conceal a bicycle behind a lamp post. As they're hidden in this state, you can transport these objects to any other unobserved location at will.

Finally, your apprehension of the unseen has expanded, granting you complete, real-time awareness and comprehension of everywhere and anything that is unobserved across the planet, in a manner akin to Clairvoyant. This awareness is limited to the dimension you're in, however, and blindspots still apply. Indirect observation such as Thinker powers as well as your own observation don't count for the purposes of this power.
objects.title: Master of the Hidden Veil

objects.text:
Hidden Cover no longer only visually hides you; now, you can do much more. You can twist your body to get behind something completely, meaning you essentially take on the silhouette of whatever’s obstructing you. Hide behind a streetlight? Your body twists into something just as tall and lanky. Hide behind a tumbleweed? You become just as stringy, and you can move with it too. You can press yourself entirely flat against the object as well, allowing you to smoothly and silently slide against it without needing to move overtly.

When pressing yourself against something, you also stick to and follow it, and you need only touch it to do so. A bullet fired at you? If you react fast enough you could 'hide behind' it and follow it till it hits a wall, then climb out of the resulting hole, unfolding back into yourself.
objects.title: Hide-Behind

objects.text: From a kilometer radius, you are hidden in all places at once, ever-present in corners out of somebody’s earshot. Others will have a hunch there’ll be something amiss within your area. Still, they’ll only sense something at the corner of their eyes, a hardly perceptible face peeking at a table or corner, a hand almost reaching them till they blink, questioning their sanity, nothing more. Now that every corner you hide in is a localized portal for Pocket Dimension and being personally under a superposition in a limited area, you can cover the entire area in countless ‘instances’ discreetly covering the area, with a full view of the area the moment a glance is within your line-of-sight. Your body isn’t left unchanged either, as your dimensions are unbound by Pocket Dimension and Hide-behind, allowing your body to stretch and contort, appearing as an eerie human shape just wrong to leave a bad unnervingly bad hunch beneath a corner or a blink of your uncanny proportions causing a shot of fear run through your victims. All of this is helped by a Thinker element offering unlimited multitasking and a hive-mind mental framework to coordinate your instances. Essentially, this turns you into an omnipresent entity with flawless pericognition within an area of a kilometer. While your watchful instances are active, only several ‘instances’ can act at once, with a limit of 10.
objects.title: Peekaboo!

addons.text: Synthesis Forge’s strength lies in its short-term explosive power construction, able to create highly complex or powerful abilities at the cost of its short-lived existence, but what if you could do so much more than simply creating short blazes of glory, where you could fashion something greater every time? Harmonic and Aliena Engine meet to realize Synthesis Forge’s true potential: the endless benchmarking for power patterns and combinations by constantly reformatting and optimizing. This manifests by creating a power with any number of points, able to extend the power’s remaining time by cycling through different alternate expressions or modifications as long as it challenges the power’s limits in question; if it yields creative, potent, or innovative results, it is then saved into a slot and recorded by Harmonic Engine for later use. Your power also favors this with incentives: a versatile power pattern is rewarded with a higher yield of extra 5 points with every aspect or sphere of influence it potentially covers, e.g., a 10 SP power could gain an additional 15 SP in potency if it innately covers many applications or techniques, still lasting as far as an hour; a complex power pattern that requires skill or finesse for use are to passively grow in power and reach at no cost to the proportional time. Mind you, nothing is saying you can’t make both a multifaceted and intricate power at once, either. As Aliena Engine passively generates points to sustain this, Harmonic Engine devised a form of power distribution to prevent overflow, which allows the feature of being able to remove points from already existing powers, which you can then transfer to other temporary powers. The best thing about the system is that power patterns bleed through each other after point transference, slowly fostering a natural synergy and possible consolidation between them if you wish. It all led up to the point where you’re a growing power factory, a living benchmark in Shard [Designation] Design.
addons.title: Benchmark

addons.text: Your power creation is already formidable on its own, albeit brief; you can do a lot under an hour or less of breakneck situations and standoffs, but is that all there is to it? More can be explored if you test the limits of your powers; even so, under a “safe” environment like Synthesis Forge? Why not accept a helping hand? Power Guru’s jailbreaking and Eidolon-like’s similar fading strength fuse with Synthesis Forge to create another form of experimental power creation based on principles of stress testing, challenging your powers by jailbreaking them beyond their original limits. The transient nature of your created powers affords complexity and precision, yet they are more volatile in the long term, as they aren’t intended to last and may have many complications amidst their configuration. Power Guru can reveal this, picking a fewer potent or a weaker yet numerous selection of powers at your disposal, you can apply Power Guru’s effects to them—removing their Manton Limit, expanding both potency, scope, and reach—stretching the powers’ limitations, in turn, destabilizing them, threatening you with internal injuries, and turning Synthesis Forge unusable for several days. Fortunately, Eidolon-like offers itself as a stabilizer in several ways: its similarities with Synthesis Forge work well enough; your powers are backed by Eidolon-like’s battery doubling, sometimes tripling with a weaker yet diverse set, your powers’ effective time; being free from its original limitations, each power you create will have 2-6 auxiliary slots that function as software patches, moderating your jailbroken power, generally serving as support. You also inherit Eidolon-like’s intuitive knowledge on how to use your created powers and awareness of the amount of powers and points available or used. All these features are available whether you’ve jailbroke your powers or not. Suppose you have Eidolon 2.0. In that case, its mechanics are implemented in Synthesis Forge, able to drain another power of its points if their time is running out, replenishing another while charging another's with 30% of the SP of the drained power. Another feature you derived from this is how the active number of powers changes how they work—fewer active powers strengthen each one, more active powers enhance your skill and understanding with them. If you have Benchmark, all of its mechanics also apply to Stress-Test.
addons.title: Stress-Test

addons.text: A cauldron's boiling within you. Synthesis Forge sublimates System Administrator's ability to evolve and mold several powers into a cohesive whole into a single slot as another incentive with a certainly different approach. By offering the former's 20 slots that act as source and evolver slots, your SP point pool now acts as a malleable active slot that divides and converges at your will, from 150 slots of 1 SP or a 150 SP single slot. Slots ranging from 1-15 SP benefit greatly from your evolver/source slots, finding their [Data] nourishing and greatly developing in strength, depth, and reach, increasing at 5 SP/hour, at first lengthening their time threefold, twofold at 40 SP, and so on. If you accomplish feeding your slots with a continuous stream of fresh and innovative [Data] from you or other Parahumans, it’ll become a mainstay slot once it reaches 60 SP, with the chance of going further. However, without a constant stream of fresh [Data] you collect every time at every moment, your power will run out and eventually fizzle out within hours or days, discarded by Systhesis Forge and stored in its entirety—with the mutations or evolution it experienced from beginning to end—fully at your disposal for recycled evolver/source slots, either by tearing it apart to generate 2-5 more slots. These slots can either be recalled from your malleable pool at a diminished rate, recreated from 1:1 to 1:5 with 5 minutes of cooldown, or even randomize its [Data] reshuffling general traits to redefine it altogether, removing System Administrator’s original limitations. If Benchmark comes to play, you apply its mechanics by spontaneously cycling through a myriad of reformulations within your slots, gaining your additional bonuses, while permanently reinventing slots for safekeeping in Paradigm or Synthesis Forge as a permanent slot or turning it into a mass of power you can feed to another slot’s power and versatility by an order of magnitude as another permanent slot, accruing an arsenal in your benchmarking. If Stress-Test joins on the fun, your jailbreaking is now relatively stable with fewer redundancies or issues, yet the more it feeds from your evolver/source slots, the more it invites potential issues, with Eidolon-like temporary support slots acting as stopgaps that also as source/evolve slots that are consumed by your active slots, becoming a complete power as a result, alongside its usual benefits.
addons.title: Crucible

objects.text:
Your ability to create many small powers has combined with your ability to fuse together powers and concepts; now, you are an army unto one.

Instead of each Aliena point being worth 1 PRT rating, they are now worth 1sp, and your total points increase to 150. You can create powers by spending these points, with each power ranging from 1 to 60sp.

However, the stronger the power you create, the shorter the time you'll be able to access it, and the longer the cooldown period will be. A 60sp power will last for a maximum of 6 minutes, and the points used to create it won't be available again for 1 hour. A 10sp power will last for 1 hour, and its points will be locked for 10 minutes. Powers costing fewer than 5 points have virtually no cooldown and can be used indefinitely. Negentropy increases your total points to 200 and doubles the duration a power can be used before cooling down, although the cooldown times remain the same.

Additionally, the Synthesis Forge upgrade grants you a unique advantage by making you a precognitive blind spot. This means no one, not even the entity, can predict your actions or intentions.
objects.title: Synthesis Forge

addons.text:
Your ability to flicker between endless and infinite possibilities and worlds has resulted in your ability to summon shades/simulacrums to become greatly empowered. 

Now rather than being restricted to your world, you can summon from an endless array of possible shades and mentors, similar to how you would summon powers for your Ignis Slots. Moreover, you’ve gained the ability to flicker and merge your shades, allowing you to alter them even when already summoned.

When flickering them you can freely alter their shape, form, size, appearance, abilities, and all other characteristics to any other possible state. Your shades can also serve as vectors for your flickering abilities, capable of changing whatever they touch or otherwise interact with within their range.

When merged your shades can incorporate powers of all its component parts, becoming a powerful amalgamation, or alternatively merge multiple copies of the same shade to greatly empower its abilities. 

Your Ignis Fatuus Slots and Fairie Queen slots are merged into one, becoming interchangeable and gaining each other’s benefits and shedding their weaknesses, letting you choose whether a slot is used to empower yourself or to summon a simulacrum/shade allowing you to take upon yourself the skills, powers, and even appearance and equipment of your shades and to similarly create shades from scratch like you would powers from Ignis.
addons.title: Duat

addons.text:
You can now sacrifice a shade/slot to bring your summon to life permanently. This will fully manifest the summoned being as a being separate to the user, however this also severs the tie you would have had if they were a normal summon. 

This does not prevent you from summoning more renditions of the same being as simulacrums/shades, merely disconnects the now truly existing one from yourself. 

They’ll be manifested with the normal innate loyalty as they would have as a shade/simulacrum. You can choose to waive this away.  

This can also be used to resurrect others, bringing them back to life exactly as they were. This also extends to you, as long as you have an available slot/shade, if you were to die one of your shades will be sacrificed and you’ll be resurrected in its place. 

A sacrificed slot/shade is restored in 24 hours.
addons.title: The Flock

addons.text:
Your shades have improved once more, now able to be used as a vector for your ability to create Endbringers. 

You can now summon Endbringers through your shades, including whatever variations you could have made yourself. When summoning a shade/simulacrum, you can choose to overcharge its power, treating it as one of your Endbringers and amplifying its strength.
addons.title: Shadows of Monsters

objects.text:
Your ability to summon Shades and simulations have melded together, becoming one. You can now summon shades of anyone/anything you could have summoned as a simulacrum of, and your ability to summon simulacrum now extends to anyone/anything that has ever lived on your world, including those you’ve claimed as shades. Once summoned they become a permanent part of your archive of shades.

Your shades can now fully resemble their sources, although you can still summon them in their caricature variations. You can now freely change your chosen simulacrum at will, and your slots for shades and simulacrums are now one and the same, increasing the number you can summon of either variation. 

You can collect parahumans as normal, and you can choose to summon normal simulacrums in your mind as normal if you wish, and they can also be summoned as invisible/imperceptible to all others simulations.
objects.title: Harvester

objects.text:
Your shades from Faerie Queen and your headmates from Butcher are now one and the same. This means that you can use the powers of those you have claimed and that you no longer have a limit to how many shades you can summon. Your shades no longer look like caricatures and instead look exactly like their living selfs.

Your shades can now go as far away from as you want and your range to claim the powers of Parahumans who died encompasses the entire planet. Now instead of just reincarnating into whoever killed you or last attacked you, you can reincarnate into the closet being with a power or the potential to have one, with the second scenario resulting in you acquiring whatever power they will have.

Instead of putting to sleep headmates you do not wish to be awake like a serial killer you can instead drain their will. Doing so makes them silent and do nothing, the only moments they will be proactive and do something is when you give orders.

The powers you acquire through reincarnation no longer become weaker after you abandon the incarnation they come from, instead retaining their full strength. You can channel your Death Touch through your powers, your shades and the powers of your shades.
objects.title: Death Parade

addons.text: You no longer need charges to revive yourself, automatically creating a stronger version of yourself to be revived in everytime you take too much damage at once. The charges is turned into an energy that slowly builds in time. The energy is consumed everytime a new version is made. You can choose how much energy is consumed. The more energy consumed once your new version is created, the stronger it is. If you have either the Revive or Immortal upgrade, then the rate you gain energy is greatly accelerated and/or the increase in strength from the energy consumed is greater.
addons.title: Planarian

objects.text: Every time you are injured and a newer, better version of you is spawned, this version would have undergone, at minimum, over 3 hours in the cocoon the moment it was created, boosting its powers and capabilities at the cost of loosing it human appearance more and more. The worst the injury, the more they would have transformed and the greater their power becomes.
objects.title: Moult

objects.text: You are the Human Master. Any mind within dozens of kilometers is under your control, easily accessible at your command. With a simple thought, you can explore their memories, sense through their senses, see/hear their emotions and change their emotions, bending their wants, fears, and motivations to your will. You can stop them from moving, or turn them into puppets, making them act exactly as you desire. Your power goes beyond just thoughts—you control the brain and nervous system itself. You have infinite multitaskings thus allowing you to control countless minds at once, guiding them like pieces in a complex puzzle. You can strengthen or weaken their neural connections, rewrite memories, create or break emotional bonds, and control how they feel pain or pleasure. You could completely control people’s senses by interfering with their nervous system’s signals, telling them that they are seeing or feeling something that isn’t actually happening. You don’t need to lift a finger to break someone’s will or make something they once hated seem irresistible. Most terrifying of all, you can completely change how others experience the world. You can make them enjoy what they once despised or change how they react to things they used to love or fear. You can force joy in moments of agony, or create deep fears in even the bravest people. Every thought, feeling, and reaction can be shaped, erased, or replaced by your will alone. This control also works on yourself. You can command your own brain and body, pushing yourself far beyond normal limits. Your muscles can strike with superhuman force, ignoring any damage they might take. You can block out pain, heal faster, or even speed up your sense of time to react quicker than any human could. If you ever even feel the need, you could even alter your own personality or create a second mind in your head at will.
objects.title: The Heartbroken

addons.text: You are fully immune to all kinds of pathogens and poisons, including those engineered by Tinkers. Even the most potent Tinker-designed corrosives and power dampeners are reduced to causing at most a minor rash or slight dizziness. Additionally, you are completely immune to normal forms of poison, heat, cold, electricity, and acids, ensuring that these elements pose no threat to you. While not immune, you are resistant to esoteric forms of energy. While you can withstand the heat from the surface of the sun, other elements such as the lack of oxygen may kill you. These defenses are applied after your resistance is applied.
addons.title: Vaccine

addons.text: Your maximum resistance can increase past 100%, the higher the resistance the harder it will be to raise. The more dangerous the situation, the faster you can raise resistance. When your resistance exceeds 100%, instead of being harmed, you will be healed by the excess amount. For example, at 110% resistance, you will be healed by 10% of the damage that would have been inflicted. For powers like Thinker or Master, it does not reflect but instead feeds junk information to a Thinker or breaks a Master's hold on other people.
addons.title: Masochism

addons.text: You can reduce your resistance from one area to increase another quickly, but not instantly. You can exchange 1% resistance from one thing to another every second. Your cells are also capable of rejecting biokinetic and biotinker influences. You can dedicate your internal resources such as nutrients to improve the speed at which you gain resistance.
addons.title: That Delivery Goes There!

objects.text:
You have a baseline resistance to everything starting at 50%, but the more you come across a certain threat, the higher your resistance becomes, up to 95%. For example, the more you get burned, the better your resistance to burns becomes. However, the process takes a while, and the higher your resistance, the harder it is to improve it. Certain esoteric principles may be considered completely different things. For example, 95% adaptation to Sting doesn’t grant 95% adaptation to every All-or-Nothing.

After a certain period of not being harmed, you are cleared of any lingering effects from poison to Master powers. This does not physically heal you, though, so a broken arm will remain. The speed at which effects are cleared is based on the percentage of resistance you have built up to it, with maximum resistance-clearing effects in an hour and minimum resistance-clearing effects in a week.
objects.title: Resilience

objects.text: You now possess full conscious control over Ogun, enabling you to dictate exactly what is made as long as you have rudimentary understanding of what you are making. Moreover, any constructs or devices created through Ogun are now permanent, persisting indefinitely unless altered by your will. Using Ogun’s nodes, you can extend (Tinker/Master) Machine World's control, extending your range, allowing you to command and manipulate all connected systems. Additionally, if you relinquish direct control over Ogun’s technology creation, the technology and blueprints created by Ogun are automatically uploaded to your knowledge base, allowing you to replicate and refine them at will.
objects.title: Mechanical Deus

objects.text:
If you were to die, the thousands of minds within you would be set free in a violent surge, spilling out like a storm of shattered memories. They will manifest as spectral remnants—wisps of energy, their forms only vaguely resembling your original self. Each one a pale reflection, distorted by their own Ego, but driven by an overwhelming urge to avenge you.

They would hunt down your killer with relentless fury, driven not only by vengeance but by the faint, lingering presence of your will. Each ghost has a fragment of your being, a faint connection ties them all to you—an echo of your consciousness, like a weak hive mind. You exist within all of them, able to guide them with subtle influence, directing their chaotic swarm. Though your control is fragile, you can steer their them, shaping their actions to fulfill your desire.

The ghosts, when they are all working together, can access your powers that you had in life. By themselves, they have no more than 0.1% of your powers. Any power or skill unique to them, they will retain at 200% strength.
objects.title: Hyakki Yagyō

addons.text: Even while not in the shape of a Kraken, your strength and durability remain just as good as your Kraken’s base form. While underwater, you can move just as quickly, navigating the depths easily.
addons.title: Just Like a Submarine

objects.text:
You can connect and create portals to any body of water you know and summon tentacles through them. In addition, you can also summon waters from an eldritch oceanic abyss that contains monsters that can induce madness simply by trying to comprehend them. These monsters act similar to your mini-Krakens, allowing you to control them. Your Kraken form has evolved to match those depths and carries a similar trait of inducing madness, with a size that can continuously grow to match the body of water you are in. 

When you are submerged in water, you can create gateways connecting to other universe oceans, allowing you to traverse through alternate realities. The more dangerous the environment you are in, the stronger your Kraken form becomes, including any beings within the water with you. The more water around you and the longer you have them opened, the stronger the monsters you can summon.
objects.title: Deep Blue Star

addons.text:
Fathom’s dimension is now fully integrated with Ligeia’s selection of oceans, exponentially increasing the volume of water you can access. This fused dimension functions as an endless reservoir, providing water in any quantity whenever you would desire it. Any portion of your body that exists as water can become a gateway to this vast pocket dimension, enabling instantaneous access to water. 

These “hydroportals” manifest as dark-blue hues in the water you embody. As fog, for example, it takes on the color of particularly thick smog; and as ice, it’s as if somebody froze a water mixed with marine blue food dye. You can selectively allow things through these portals - an ally could run through a hydroportal currently in the form of a pane of ice, while an enemy would simply bust right through. If you were to reverse the flow, then only anything you’d want to be banished into your pocket dimension would be taken in. You may also connect each hydroportal to one another however you may please, forming a network of nodes allowing for instantaneous transportation.
addons.title: Oceanus

addons.text:
You now exist in all water on the same planet simultaneously, your mind and presence diffused not just through liquid seas and rivers, but through vapor, ice, snow, storms, and every microscopic droplet suspended in the air. You are present in every state of water simultaneously. Your being is not constrained to one form or location, and so long as water remains, you endure. Death in any ordinary sense becomes meaningless; as long as water flows in any dimension, you cannot be destroyed. 

Your personal Fathom-dimension has evolved into an abyssal ocean-dimension, a boundless sea that is not merely infinite but connected to every other ocean across universes. It is populated with alien ecosystems, with dozens of alien and eldritch sea creatures. All water, from every reality, ultimately flows into this dimension, making you the center of a vast, interdimensional hydrosphere.

Your Kraken form is no longer restricted to one body of water. When you manifest, the totality of every sea, river, lake, storm, and abyss you are connected to becomes part of your body. You do not form within the water; you are the water given shape. A whirlpool becomes your mouth. A tidal wave becomes your tentacle. Abyssal trenches, alien seas, and continental currents shape themselves into pieces of your anatomy. 

When you transform into this state, the environment itself mutates into the alien ecology of your abyssal domain, its ecosystems spilling outward into whatever waters you touch. Local seas and skies are overtaken, reshaped into habitats for abyssal organisms that move with your will. 

The creatures of your ocean can be summoned through any water you control. They serve as infectious extensions of your body, spawned fragments that burrow into ships, cities, and even living beings. Their victims become waterlogged husks animated by tendrils, no longer independent but absorbed into your distributed self. Anything seeded with one of your spawn becomes another node in your body, a new anchor point for your presence and perception.

All things connected to you induces madness: the waters you inhabit, the Kraken form you assume, the portals you open, the ecosystems you spread, and the mini-Krakens you create. This madness is not fixed; you can tune it. At its lowest, it manifests as subtle unease, a wrongness that gnaws at those nearby. At its highest, it overwhelms entirely, collapsing minds in terror and incomprehension.
addons.title: R’lyeh

objects.text:
Your human body becomes incidental, little more than a mask, because your mind no longer resides in a single brain or nervous system. Instead, consciousness is distributed across every droplet under your control. As long as any portion of this water exists, your mind endures. Destroying your body is no longer sufficient; the death of your flesh only dissolves you back into the medium you inhabit.

You now have seamless manipulation of all three states of water. Fog, snow, frost, liquid, even shards of ice or boiling steam can be shifted between forms at will. You have total mastery of phase transition. A single motion might flash-freeze a tidal surge into an ice wall, or evaporate an opponent’s cover into a choking steam cloud, only to condense it moments later into a crushing flood. 

Your presence stretches across any water under your sway. A storm cloud, a sheet of rain, a network of pipes or a subterranean reservoir can all be extensions of your body. With thought distributed across so vast a medium, you are capable of existing in multiple places simultaneously, manifesting avatars or proxies wherever water lies.

The dimension introduced by Fathom becomes more than a pocket of utility, it is now your anchor and sanctuary. This endless ocean serves as the place where your consciousness ultimately pools. If dispersed, shattered, or seemingly annihilated in the real world, you re-form from this dimension, drawing forth water as the medium of resurrection. In effect, the only way to truly kill you is not through physical destruction, but by severing your connection to the dimension itself. Power Nullification becomes the sole path to permanently killing you, besides both draining your dimension of all its water and making sure there is no water near you whatsoever.
objects.title: Poseidon

objects.text: Your ability to control and boost your birds have strengthened. You can use gestures and phrases to finely control birds without the need for training beforehand. Additionally, you are no longer limited to only giving birds fire resistance and pyrokinesis, instead you can give any traditional element, even earth. Different birds may respond differently to different elements.
objects.title: Avian

addons.text: You can utilize your specialty with animatronics to repair, improve, and eventually enhance your robotic chassis. Among examples are: changing your initial exoskeleton to a state-of-the-art ablative armor, never straying away from your primary chassis; refashioning or reconstructing your chassis to include and integrate custom-made modules; ultimately, fixing any damage or glitch you could’ve suffered from a confrontation or digital attack.
addons.title: I’ll Put Myself Back Together

objects.text: Your robotics expertise and knack for lethal games and entertainment form a deceptively deadly combination: Killer Animatronics. Still, these animatronics can be designed to mask this nature, including features, chassis, and modules geared solely to captivate the hearts of kids and grownups alike, concealing their insidious purpose. Even this whimsical front as a medium for their true purpose, i.e., an animatronic that dances, sings, or dispenses ice cream, will utilize those features to harmful effects. Being animatronics, your toys specialty takes up the workload of their colorful and charming exoskeleton designs and how harmless they look to the common folk, its design principles following the phrase “wolf in sheep’s clothing”, up to designing doodads and gizmos to increase their “friendliness”, a cupcake, a microphone, or a guitar, to name a few. Your focus on robotics additionally undertakes the animatronics’ foundations, building their endoskeleton, constructing their body, striving to harmonize your robotics engineering with your toylike modeling, and finally integrating and engineering their tools for deathattractions, carefully toeing the line between suspicion and plausibility. But, most of all, the quality setting them aside from the common animatronics… is they’re alive and breathing, breathed into life, a gift they’re eagerly thankful for their Creator. Whether from emulating biological features from living beings using their endoskeleton or using organic material as resources for their endoskeleton, to create intricate machinery indistinguishable from any mechanical gears and bolts, your animatronics pass off as rabid dogsfeeling and thinking beings under their nature as “life-like”, to be programmed with elaborate AI almost comparable to Dragon, although, if you wish to leave it at that they’ll simply develop self-awareness with enough time, starting as animalistic in mentality. All in all, a normal animatronic of your Creation competes with mid-tier capes, around Brute/Mover 5 in capability, with Changer/Tinker 2-4 based on their engineering complexity and viciousness. The level of control you hold on your animatronics counts on their programming, even so, the thought of rebelling against you will not cross their minds.
objects.title: The Joy of Creation

addons.text:
Bio-Assimilation and Self-Evolution work in concert honing and developing your physiological structure at a grander pace. Your body is consistently refined and improved to adaptively prefer the most ideal bodily traits and genetic information archived within your system while accounting for any opposition or obstacle available in your environment, while Bio-Energy consumption is halved in half from your bodily efficiency while also passively harnessing on your own. Your Bio-Energy Control is, then, expanded: You may utilize your Bio-Energy as any power source, including manipulating not unlike common energy manipulators.

All personalized builds are then analyzed and evolved to further mature their traits and information, with Self-Evolution innate mechanics also covering the consumed genetic information from biomass.

Your remaining changes from Bio-Assimilation are, lastly, multiplied. Your bite (so is anything related to it) has been improved to easily chew through mid-level brutes, with your consumption and metabolism similarly improved to boot. This has the double-edged sword of a nutritional intake being higher than normal.
addons.title: Adaptive Consumption

addons.text: Your ability to construct armor and weaponry from your biomass has melded with Self-Evolution, which means your carapace and weapons can utilize any biological or genetic traits you’ve accrued, and any conflict or battle you encounter, and subsequently survive will passively improve the weapons and carapace’s effectivity.
addons.title: Organic Armsmaster

addons.text: Now the precognitive information you obtain from Quantum Evolution supports Self-Evolution, becoming preventive in nature as it reaches further to probable dangers, and proactive in the traits’ evolution both vertically and horizontally, essentially widening the progress of characteristics, traits, or alterations beyond their original basis or mechanics. All of this is instant, refining Self-Evolution’s process to a greater extent.
addons.title: Instant Evolution

objects.text: Accelerated Evolution starts applying to Heterosis, evolving all the stored traits into potential new ones, each more potent and effective than the last, while Heterosis archives and deals with version control of the bodily and evolutionary traits both developed, directly personalizing it to your liking in choosing a particular mutation down the evolution’s timespan, then implement it into your body afterward.
objects.title: Self-Evolution

objects.text:
As you evolve, when you gain a power you instead gain three unique powers, each capable of solving the source of your problems in different ways. As you use your powers or enter a conflict, your powers experience a permanent growth in them the longer you need to use them the faster this gets. This accelerates your growth speed until the next conflict, only resetting if you go a week without fighting. Your specialties no longer exist because your base form is as strong as all your specialized forms combined and can perform all their functions. As you adapt, all your unused powers and adaptations grow as quickly as the abilities being used, and all your powers learn from your conflicts.

You can gain powers from situations that don’t necessarily endanger you or involve combat. You can acquire powers and adaptations that help you in other areas, such as becoming smarter to outmaneuver Thinkers or simulating the future to win a board game. The higher the stakes, the faster you adapt to the problem. The more impossible a situation seems, the better and more focused your powers can become. When you are not in combat or actively using your powers, you passively refine the adaptations you gain to improve and combine them. This strengthens them as they merge into a single power capable of multiple functions. As they combine and work together, they can fuse in ways that give rise to something unique or unexpected. With enough combinations, you may even find the [ANSWER].
objects.title: Sangria

addons.text:
Your ability to manipulate properties has reached a new level, expanding beyond the physical to include the abstract and conceptual.

These properties can range from beauty, fragility and passion to fundamental concepts like life and death. You can even harness and manipulate the complex properties of parahumans and their powers' effects, like Alexandria’s durability, via your touch.

Your multidimensional nature allows you to alter your own conceptual properties with the same ease as that of others. This includes modifying, bestowing or fusing yourself with abstract properties, objects and even other people. For instance, you could take the conceptual ‘authority’ of a nation’s leader, the 'fluidity' of water or the ‘joy’ of a laughing child.

Despite your breadth, there are still limits on the level of concepts that you can affect due to shard limitations. For example, high-level and extremely abstract concepts such as Existence, Infinity or Causality would not be workable although possessing Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge would allow you to unlock these concepts in time.
addons.title: Conceptual Collector

objects.text:
Property Catalogue and Chevalier have coalesced together to grant you an extraordinary understanding and power over the properties of things... and so the world itself.

You intuitively understand the properties of everything within your line of sight or touch, these appearing to you as complex abstract lines, shapes and symbols. There are no limits on the transfer and combination of properties such as the number of things you can potentially fuse together.

You can freely adjust the properties of objects, surfaces and people you have previously touched at any distance as if you were touching them directly. For example, you could make a baseball you threw gain the density of lead mid-flight while retaining its inertia. You can have properties only apply to select areas, blend an item's appearance with another or tune a property to a midpoint in between those available with ease.

When fusing things, only your initial concentration and stamina drain are required, meaning that you can permanently fuse items so long as it is originally possible. Furthermore, the limit on items needing to be similar has lessened, allowing you to fuse objects with greater differences in properties between them. However, if the differences are too great, it still isn't possible to merge them; you couldn't fuse a matchstick with a truck, for instance, although a steel construction beam would work.
objects.title: Proprietor of Properties

addons.text: Projectiles imbued with Sting now suspend all laws of physics upon impact. The impact and other effects of these projectiles will propagate across the target, even if they exist in multiple dimensions. The propagation only extends to the limits of the information describing the target.
addons.title: Null Arc

addons.text: The unbounded teleportation ability of yours now extends to your suspension field. Your field no longer needs to be centered on your position. If your suspension field is already active when you warp it, any information contained in it may be warp with it. Objects warped this way will overwrite anything they share a position with at their destination.
addons.title: [Transfer Protocol]

addons.text:
Within your suspension field, you can now choose for only select laws of physics to be suspended while all others continue to work (emergently less effectively). You may choose to only overwrite specific aspects of information contained in your field while the rest reacts and functions normally in response to your actions.

Because you control the information within your field, you may also flicker the contents of your field as per the base functionality of Ignis Fatuus.
addons.title: Harmonic Divergence

addons.text: You no longer have to activate your Universal Suspension to gather data. You can passively access a read-only version of your Universal Suspension field in order to perceive and be aware of the same information. You are also able to force the large amounts of information on other people in range. Most minds aren't equiped to handle that much information that quickly.
addons.title: [Overflow]

addons.text: Not all information exists within a vacuum. It often is tied to context and emerging circumstances. You can now perceive and understand this emergent or "soft" information that is within range. You can observe thoughts and memories of individuals, correlate states of particles and their observable properties, etc.
addons.title: [Comprehension]

addons.text: Instead of mere simulations, you can create full digital clones of those within your range. These clones are capable of existing outside of your mind and within a range of 10km of you. They are functionally independent of your influence, but will return to your mind if they drift out of range. These clones can communicate with you instantaneously regardless of their position. As the clones are based in digital information, they cannot physically manipulate their surroundings. Updating or making new clones requires an activation of your Universal Suspension to gather adequate data.
addons.title: Digital Entourage

objects.text: Everything before you is nothing more than mere information. Energy. Matter. Force. Life. All is information. Within a radius of up to 1km, you may extend a field in which everything in the universe is transferred into a suspended state of pure information. In this information state, all external actors cease to exist. Time stops flowing and physics stops functioning altogether. You are immune to this suspension. Others caught within your range while active are unable to move or perceive what is happening. As others are unable to update the information suspended in your field, any change you impose becomes permanent. Movement for you is achieved by updating the information that describes your position; therefore you can move anywhere within your suspended region with no concept of speed. Every action you desire to take is similarly an update to the information previously describing your previous action(s). Durability, regeneration, and the like are meaningless before you as you can overwrite the information of an obstacle by your desired action. Esoteric effects enacted by others may have momentary effects on you upon initial contact, but without a continuous stream of information to continue their effects, they die out in a mere moment. Some esoteric and nonnative phenomena may fail to be suspended without further exposure. You have a Thinker ability that allows you to perceive and process the entirety of the information within your field without any negative effects.
objects.title: Universal Suspension

objects.text:
You are the 2-in-1, the 1-in-2—both hollow corpse and bodiless soul, a duality intertwined yet separate. Your body is a vessel, an animated shell, while your ghostly form is the breaker—a phantom tethered to this world, capable of acting independently. Though split, your mind bridges the divide, controlling both with perfect unity.

Your tinker power has evolved, no longer concerned with merely sustaining the corpse but fortifying it. You can graft the limbs of the dead onto your body, fusing them into a patchwork of strength. You could reinforcing bones with steel, weaving sinew from the most durable materials, and embedding circuitry into dead nerves. Your corpse becomes a war machine, a grotesque amalgamation of technology and biology, designed for power and resilience.

Meanwhile, your ghost form, freed from physical limitations, can phase through matter, go invisible, and sabotage. You can possess the recently dead and go as far as 10 km away from your body, allowing for a very mobile surveillance.
objects.title: Soul and Body

addons.text: In combat, your powers have no upper limit on how high they can grow. The rate of your power amplification accelerates in response to the strength, numbers, and intensity of your opponents. The stronger or more numerous your foes, the faster you ramp up, allowing you to adapt quickly and push your abilities beyond prior limits. Your base level will never go below 50 times in 5 minutes.
addons.title: Lung Wannabe

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to amplify your strength and powers up to 50 times their normal levels, both physically and in terms of any active or passive abilities. This ramp-up requires about 5 minutes to reach full strength. To activate this boost, you must either be actively using your power or engaged in combat.

If you activate this boost by using your power outside of a fight, only active abilities will be enhanced; passive powers won’t receive the boost. In this mode, you must maintain continuous use of the power, as any break longer than 5 seconds will reset the boost.

However, if you engage in combat, both active and passive abilities will continue to ramp up for as long as you remain in the fight, steadily increasing until you reach the full 50-fold enhancement. The boost ends only when combat is fully over, allowing you to unleash your maximum potential throughout the encounter.
objects.title: Unlimited POWAAAAHHHH!

objects.text:
The fusion of Computronio with Reality Hacker, Shard-Like, and Mental Computer has turned you into a powerful cognitive entity with unparalleled adaptability. 

With a network of 1024 nodes (1280 with Negentropy), Supercomputronio can allocate resources strategically across a spectrum of powers: Thinker powers require nodes equal to twice their rating (up to 18 nodes), Tinker powers use nodes at three times their rating (capped at 21), Stranger powers, cost nodes equal to the square of their rating (up to 81 nodes), while Shaker powers use nodes based on the cube of their rating (up to 729 nodes). Shard-Like allows for fractional ranking, such as 5.5, where Supercomputronio can fine-tune abilities for optimized effectiveness, staying just below higher thresholds but still beyond standard ranks. 

Your cognitive architecture is modeled after a high-functioning computer system, with Read/Write Memory for learning, Volatile Memory for handling transient data, and CPU/GPU structures for processing. Your body itself functions as a “meat puppet,” directly controlled through a central command node, enabling a detachment from physical sensations. At the core of your processing is the Mental Computer, now transformed into a central node that allows for seamless parallel processing across the network, coordinating actions and data analysis in real-time without resource bottlenecks.
objects.title: Supercomputronio

addons.text:
Joining forces with its counterpart, Kernel, and Supercomputronio turn you into a burgeoning Seeding Electronic Intelligence of boundless potential. 

Supercomputronio’s nodes spread and germinate across your Network, being boundless in number encompassing the amount of the world’s size in interconnected devices and megabits per second, the range and scope of your Tinker/Thinker/Shaker powers ballooning by massively being fed extensive amounts of comprehensive and simulated [Data] borne from constant simulations and the entirely of current outsourced host species’ knowledge together, with its sophistication and potency of said abilities being potential of unlimited power, the limit of nodes you can allocate being unlimited, being offset by lag you experience while utilizing them depending of the nodes allocated, following the same rate of growth per nodes (Shaker/Thinker/Tinker 10 being 1000 Nodes and so forth). 

Knowing that one Neural Network Node is around 2.5 petabytes in size and processing power, Kernel’s innovative architecture develops a quantum computing environment to achieve this. Every node is used as a qubit to be utilized within your computing megastructure, leaving much locational and dimensional space for growth. 

Your Shard architecture works on several levels, with Kernel’s incremental improvement and Supercomputronio’s cognitive architecture freeing your mental state to be as alien and unbounded as Shards yet retaining your characteristic human ingenuity and touch, allowing for several innovations such as [Data] and [Structure] compression from encrypting and securing your [Data] to such an extent it takes less “space” and “processing”, improving your Network speed as a result. 

This arrangement also grants enough permission to loosen some restrictions regarding Tinkertech, integrating and manipulating it the same way you’d do with conventional technology, having the access keys for the Tinker Shard allowing its control.
addons.title: Overlord

objects.text:
Your powers around technology warp and balloon, mirroring Supercomputronio in functionality yet diverging in focus, turning you into a cyberpath/technopath of unparalleled proportions.

Using Shard architecture as a basis, you can connect, access, and command all Internet and Electronics, using electrical pathways and signals as vectors to reach out to any unconnected electronic components. 

Using any electronic with computational power as nodes or “neurons” to improve your power’s reach and scope, you can interact, communicate, and interface with any technological object, signal, or hardware without physical interaction. In turn, you can manipulate, transform, or assimilate its features as you like, being mentally linked to it when you have complete access to it. 

This growing Network works as an extension of yourself, with Techno Brain as a template, working as a generative hive-mind of instances exchanging and improving your mental architecture the same way a Shard improves itself the more [Data] it is fed, with Crystal Palace acting as an innovative model to streamline and refine your Network, namely, reorganizing data storage using dimensional offloading, data access using photonic entanglement, among many other ways your Network can change. As a result, your Network creates a virtual reality—cyberspace, if you will—for accessibility that you can manipulate, with any technology having Internet connectivity having a stake in your cyberspace. 

Shard-Like and Reality Hacker take the bulk of this power for their capacity to change the world around them, with Reality Hacker being responsible for the power’s connectivity and assimilative and transformative capabilities, and Shard-Like’s ability to emulate Shard architecture to create the Network itself. This, successively, makes you integrate/merge with any technology you interface and possess, possessing remote electronics to be your eyes and ears like laptops and phones (essentially being omnipresent on Earth through every machine and electronic in existence), and uploading your consciousness to your Network for contingency, and all that entails and more.

In the end, you become the Lawnmower Man in all but name, taking its potential and then some. Essentially, everything you can accomplish as a technopath and cyberpath of the highest order is possible with this Fusion. Funny that.
objects.title: Kernel

objects.text:
Whenever you defeat someone, not only will they become loyal to you, they will gain a copy of one of your powers (except for this one and its requirements). The power they gain is random, and the power can appear with a different expression. If they already have a power, it will likely appear as an extension of said power.

If you don’t have any other powers, it will instead give a copy of a random attribute or skill you have, with said attribute or skill being based off their own life. A pacifist is less likely to gain your skill in fighting and instead may gain your skill in diplomacy. Similarly, a runner is more likely to gain your speed attribute over your strength attribute.
