Opponents that have already been defeated by you once and gained a copy less than a week ago will be excluded by the power.
objects.title: You Can Be Like Me

objects.text:
When wielding any object, you unlock a unique set of techniques associated with that item. For example, holding a sword grants access to a variety of swordsmanship styles, each with specialized movements, stances, and strikes. These techniques are not purely physical; as you perform them, power-like effects manifest, enhancing each strike with energy, speed, or elemental power. For example, a sword slash that shoots out an arc of flame, or an arrow shot that explodes on contact.

The more you use a particular type of item, the deeper your mastery becomes, allowing you to gain more complex and stronger techniques. This progression is organic, building on your experience and mastery rather than just raw strength.

However, switching to an item that differs significantly from your current one—such as transitioning from a sword to a dagger—affects your repertoire. Techniques that were second nature with one weapon may not carry over easily to another. Instead of directly transferring skills, you begin developing new techniques tailored to the nuances of the new item. The greater the deviation between item types, the more distinct the skill sets become. This doesn’t remove your ability to use your previous techniques, just force you to use new ones associated with your different item.
objects.title: Technique God

addons.text:
Chaos (Chaotic Tinker) and Order (Gaol). Two diametrically opposed concepts in the eyes of humanity, ever realizing there’s never one without the other. Chaos is required to create and transform, to fill empty space, and to keep things running and spinning. Order is needed to organize, and make sense of this, giving a purpose, a reason to exist behind their spontaneity, all for a structure that is suitably labeled as chaotic to those who see its boggling complexity. What is chaos, if not incomprehensible order? 

Your expertise on both Chaos and Order begets Dominion on an unimaginable scale: creating circumstances that engender conflict, disasters, and catastrophes enhances your tinkertech’s scope and reach to Order, elaborating ways to stamp out opposition and possible ways for either containment and resolution, further establishing your Dominion; creating structures of oppression and subjugation boost your tinkertech’s scope and reach to Chaos, fashioning all manner of viciously absurd and wild destructive projects, which gives “hope” to your subjects.

All this is shaped to create a greater system of coercion: A False Flag. Creating Chaos as a pretense to enforce Control, always under other names, other culprits, and many scapegoats, granting the full enhancement on these conditions. Creating Order as the devious gift of false hope all to take it back, cobbling up identities and stories, devising wars against ghost nations, discharging projects and creations of pure unadulterated Chaos made by the so-called freedom-fighters or insurgents, your subjects find no choice but to see you as their best they have, your full improvement likewise granted on said settings. A clasp in the vicious cycle of Chaos and Order.
addons.title: False Flag

addons.text: Your full control over your nationwide machine of tyranny requires advocacy, an institution geared to “guide” and “prepare” the populace’s hearts and minds, a way to win them over, and a path to keep it that way. Good thing you possess tinkertech’s full breadth of cognition and information. Cognoscenti supports Gaol around several methods: controlling information to oversee your populace’s perception of the world, disseminating mass media to perpetuate accepted thought processes and ideas, elaborating bureaucracy and methodology geared to shape others into perfect workers through subtle mental conditioning, etc. This assures the (imposed) loyalty within anyone within your purview once the memetic and cognitive control systems are arranged.
addons.title: MK Ultra

objects.text:
You become the architect of worlds marked by Tyranny or Decimation. 

Having the full capacity to create tinker or non-tinker projects spanning nations able to conquer, dominate, and subjugate anything on your path, putting together systems or societies capable of exploiting resources and manpower to uphold and preserve your controlling industrial complex the same time supplying materials and capital to further expand your reach. Once conquered, you assemble any type of government or institution solely focused on authority, power, discipline, and the consequences thereof.

Both your Prison and Control specialties meld to lay the foundation of megastructures and conventions in compliance’s favor being either soft or hard in approach. You might model it in the style of They Live, any Sci-fi punk story, Orwell or Huxley alike, no matter how you administer it, all are forms of coercion.

SCP works for circumstances or dissents hard to contain or keep in check, bringing more cabbalistic methods of administration and repression, ending up in subversion through research and understanding.

All of this organizes environments for the sole goal of inspiring conflict from this oppression and others’ frustration at the danger and lack of agency, generating a higher rate of parahumans; a facilitator of the [Cycle], demanding and forcing a species under duress of an oppressing position to undergo crisis points, further progressing the [Cycle’s] goals of stress-testing powers on different worlds to an abundance of stressful experiences or activities.
objects.title: Gaol

addons.text:
Anathema now possesses counteracting and offensive features to deal with any opposition: Retribution can counterattack by constantly repealing capes’ safety measures resulting in powers jamming and backfiring, almost like a Broken Trigger, Glory Girl will likely be killed by her forcefield by choking or the field’s constant shifting within your area. J.O.Y. will, in turn, reflect and inverse power effects applying to the attacker back to you, i.e. for a brief minute you reverse Alexandria’s invulnerability on the short second of striking you, her a heap of broken bones.

Reasonably, this can be turned on and off.
addons.title: Minus-i

addons.text: Anathema can apply Completely Mundane’s effects to any Parahuman close by, essentially denying any Parahuman effect or repercussion within a 1-kilometer-wide radius. Their powers have their characteristic displays, with the quirk of never leaving either a mark or effect—as if they didn’t exist in the first place—leaving Parahuman as defenseless to any conventional opposition. Affected parahumans are unaffected by parahuman effects, yet they’re practically powerless in return.
addons.title: Old World Order

addons.text:
If your powers weren’t enough, you wouldn’t play fair either. 

Aside from your Null-field, you can passively drain and funnel [Energy] and [Data] from any Parahuman within your Null-field when negating their abilities or the more they use them if Old World Order is in effect, nourishing your Shard with [Data] and [Energy] the more Parahumans are within it and are nullified. 

This manifests in several ways: due to being more concentrated yet uniform, [Energy] can be harnessed for more general bodily and mental enhancements that strengthen and refines your biology (more effectively than (Trump/Shaker) Drain Battery, being a spread effect in your body and mind); aside from personally using [Energy], you can spend this [Energy] to implement the copied [Data] from other Parahumans for power creation, your [Energy] consumption being more efficient than usual extending your time with a slot, especially with stronger powers, and the discarding of a power doesn’t eliminate it, merely saves the essential configuration for later use.

Entity-based restrictions still apply, like being unable to nullify or drain Endbringers or Entities.
addons.title: Blasphemy

addons.text: You won’t be denied the balance you’re unforgivingly imposing on these puppets that called themselves capes, something you’re very good at. Your abilities to drain the Parahuman’s [Energy], [Data], and everything else has fused with Parahuman Anathema, draining and funneling everything about the Parahuman, essentially [TAKE] or [DENY] their Shard from ever being used except yourself, removing them from the Cycle entirely. This works if the cape had extensive contact with your Null-field, and while you can selectively choose who and what to drain, anyone within your Null-field would feel increasingly exhausted as if energy’s sapped out of them, nourishing your Shard and yourself with both your adversaries’ body and mind and their Shard’s [Data] and [Energy]. This manifests in several ways: When not fully draining a Parahuman or [DENY], due to being more concentrated yet uniform, [Energy] can be harnessed for more general bodily and mental enhancements that strengthen and refine your biology (more effectively than (Trump/Shaker) Drain Battery, being a spread effect in your body and mind). aside from personally using [Energy], you can spend this [Energy] to implement the copied [Data] from other Parahumans for power creation, your [Energy] consumption is more efficient than usual extending your time with a slot, especially with stronger powers, and the discarding of a power doesn’t eliminate it, merely saves the essential configuration for later use. This temporally denies Shard Connection over 3 months, their Shard on low-power mode recharging its faculties. Fully draining a Parahuman, or [TAKE], has the quirk of obtaining the full [Data] package at your disposal—or the Shard itself—able to be modified and customized to your liking, even interacting with other [Data] to create new powers or synergies once you combine them when separate, able to increase their potency and scope the more [Energy] you invest in them. Fully [Taking] the Shard is lethal to the Host, leaving them a shriveled husk, catatonic, or permanently powerless and weakened.
addons.title: Summa Blasphemia

objects.text: You are the epitome of Trump Nulls: An All-or-Nothing Trump Null. Your power-nullifying powers have integrated to create an incredibly effective override for parahumans and parahuman effects. Possessing an enclosing and invisible oval-shaped ‘Null-field’ over a 2m radius from you, while constantly active at first to even loss of consciousness or sleep, it can be consciously turned on/off. This ‘Null-field’ completely negates a Parahuman’s connection with their Shard, including power constructs or effects such as Miss Militia’s weapons, Gallant’s emotion sense and blasts, Oni Lee’s teleportative duplication, and Clockblocker’s All-or-Nothing Striker power, Tinkertech in general (leaving it inert or obsolete), among a myriad of others. This extends to normal objects under a power effect, namely, a baseball launched by a Brute or Shaker, including Containment Foam for being mass-produced by parahuman hands, to name a few. Some objects, such as Bastard Son’s or Dauntless’ weapons/objects are restored to normal lacking any influence from said capes. It likewise encompasses Thinker and Master classifications, preventing Shards from reaching and gaining a drop of info or hold over you, practically giving ad-hoc Mental Barrier and Blank at middling levels. Evidently, once leaving your null field Parahumans recover their powers and reestablish their Shard Connection. This has several features inherited from this power’s components: Animos and Hatchetface give a Trump/Brute power proportional to the amount of Parahumans within a radius of 200m, sacrificing Animos’ Changer form to focus more on its power-canceling traits; this takes on an offensive form of extending your Null-field by a snap’s moment to said radius, completely shutting down capes left and right and leaves them vulnerable while earning an increase on physical abilities geared on disabling parahumans and deception. This extension is theoretically infinite provided there are enough capes in your proximity for your Null-field, only limited by happenstance and usual Shard restrictions, speedily expending its full tank once your Null-field’s range assumingly reaches worldwide. Power Slowdown and Confusion can selectively be applied to Parahumans delaying and hampering their powers, worsening their power expression causing them to experience out-of-control disruptions, dilution, and aftereffects leaving their powers in disarray even after leaving your Null-field if you want. Exonerate, being the biggest component for this, has a Trump Card, strangely enough… and it’s that its effect can be permanent at your leisure, say, a chair you’re sitting on turns into an All-or-Nothing extension of your power, or a person once you touch can be impervious to any parahuman effect or construct. All this burdens you with the mantle of the Parahuman Bane: capes have an underlying unease around you, you vaguely sense where a Parahuman is and can be and easily locate them at the drop of a hat in sight, even a faint urge to prod and probe them on their powers. You’re Anathema, a Parahuman’s polar opposite. The [Cycle’s] Equalizer. Note: Having Negentropy or Shardless essentially makes the effects of your nullification more long-lasting after Parahumans leave your null-field, only slowly regaining their powers after 10 minutes, with the chance of permanently negating their powers after continuous contact at your discretion. Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless expands your effectiveness to Shardless powers.
objects.title: The Parahuman Anathema

objects.text:
Each time your bone breaks, it regenerates quickly and heals back stronger, steadily enhancing your durability and resilience. You can also seamlessly graft bones together, fusing separate pieces into complex shapes, structures, or armor with ease.

Your perception has expanded to let you see the bones of any creature in your line of sight, allowing you to control them directly and bypass the Manton Limit. This means you can fracture, immobilize, or reshape the bones of others remotely, using them as weapons or barriers on command. Once a bone is under your control it no longer needs to be under your line of sight for you to keep control over it.

Additionally, you gain an increased ability to multitask for every bone under your control. This lets you manipulate multiple bones individually, executing complex actions simultaneously across your body and any bone you command.

Finally, your body can now function independently of flesh and muscle, with your bones temporarily taking over essential functions. Though this form is highly taxing and drains stamina quickly, it allows you to continue fighting even when severely injured, relying on your reinforced skeleton to carry you through the battle.
objects.title: Marrow

objects.text:
Your body now slowly transforms, your muscles, tendons, and ligaments undergoes a gradual metamorphosis, becoming bone. When injured, your body no longer heals in the traditional sense but rapidly replaces damaged areas with bone substitutes. These replacements seamlessly take on the function of what was lost while retaining the incredible strength and resilience of bone. If the bone substitute is damaged it will rapidly be repaired, becoming stronger and more durable as well as more effective at what it was originally designed to do.

This isn’t limited to yourself. With this new level of control, you can bestow similar transformations onto others. By using your ability to manipulate bone, you can “heal” others by guiding their skeletal structure to replace damaged tissues, allowing them to recover, although this will leave their bodies with lingering signs of their transformation.

Your control over bone marrow has also deepened. From the bones you command, you can produce blood of any type, whether for yourself or others. Whether it is to replace lost blood in an ally, provide the rarest blood type for a specific need or even just for intimidation by making the bones you control “bleed”, your power to “squeeze blood from bone” can extremely useful.
objects.title: Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva

objects.text:
You can now enter the Mirror World simply by being reflected in a mirror. Additionally, you can bring others into the Mirror World, as long as they are reflected in the same mirror as you. The reflection of everyone in the Mirror World remains visible in the real world’s mirrors, allowing others to see their location—but not interact with them.

Within the Mirror World, you can influence both realms. Manipulating objects in the Mirror World directly affects their counterparts in the real world. For instance, shrinking a car’s reflection in the Mirror World will cause the actual car to shrink. You can also distort localized time in the Mirror World, creating pockets of warped time-space in the real world. You can even distort yourself or those you bring inside, making yourself bigger and stronger or others smaller and more fragile (both of which is reverted if either of you leaves the Mirror World).

Your most dangerous ability is the power to “shatter” individuals by breaking the mirrors that reflect them. However, this comes with a risk, as the same rule applies to you—if a mirror reflecting you is destroyed, you could suffer severe consequences. Though you have a higher chance of surviving this compared to others, as your power will protect you, it will still be very painful and draining.

The Mirror World still lacks living beings, with the exception of those you bring in. Your abilities still can not directly affect Endbringers and Entities.
objects.title: Shattered Mirror

objects.text: You now have the ability to passively sense fear, permanently growing in strength and powers from absorbing specific fears you encounter. For example, by absorbing someone’s fear of spiders, you can gain the ability to summon or control them. This also gives you a new form, its appearance based off what types of fears you absorb the most of. When you are in this form it boosts all your fear based powers. The more fear you absorb, the greater your power becomes, amplifying your abilities as the intensity of fear increases. If you have any other powers, they will also be able to grow through fear you absorbed, slowly being altered and taking traits of whatever fear you use to feed them.
objects.title: To Fear It Is To Give It Power

objects.text: Your flames crackle and flare a mad glint, something hungry and tired, so tired of the world, of its complexities, the misery and hardship that comes with it. This flame will burn it all, so that all be one, once again. Your fire shows an encroaching and/or corruptive trait, any living thing scorched or burned will be corrupted or driven to a frenzy by your flames, slowly “burning” their body and mind, in turn, twisting and warping them to chaotic messes, or their minds are left charred by the Flame’s leaving them stark raving mad. The mere flame’s heat is enough to set a man into delirium. This applies to anything, as well, deteriorating everything your fire burns, as if losing its form and essence–or “order”, to say the least, e.g. a chair will lose the form of “chair” in the middle of burning, the flames seemingly melting the chair’s “order”. Whether your fire has the heat of a bonfire or a supernova, your control over your flames spreads through your flames of chaos, a sickly yellow in intensity, blazing more as writhing worms eagerly search for their next meal. Ruler of the Primordial Flames adds an element of fine control, completely mastering your flame’s havoc, your ashes and cinders receiving the searing madness of your flames, as you can radiate and infect people with your madness, gift the flame’s frenzy for a short time, and your core taking the appearance of a corona with a wild ebb and flows of flames, resembling a frantic fiery iris. Hellfire completely exacerbates your Frenzied Flame’s destructive potential, wreaking havoc as far as the eye can see, easily and rapidly corrupting and destroying anything in your path in an instant; one moment, there was a park, a Protectorate Team doing PR around the southwest, you sweep an area with your flames; there’s no park, whatever you could call the silhouettes, charred shapes once bodies, and anything else that melted away in chaos, the rest faded away in ashes. The entire Central Park. If you have any other flame based powers, they can be expressed through this one.
objects.title: Lord of Frenzied Flame

objects.text:
Your powers centred around kinetic energy have unified together, granting you near-complete control over all kinetic-related energies and forces within your vicinity.

Your control over kinetic energy extends to a 200-metre radius of yourself. Within this range, you are capable of seamlessly absorbing, imbuing, redirecting and transferring nearly all kinetic forces, whether they're related to motion, acceleration, impact, friction or otherwise. Furthermore, your capacity to store kinetic energy has become virtually limitless, allowing you to even absorb physical attacks from an Endbringer.

Complementing this control is a secondary ability that provides an intuitive awareness of all kinetic energy transfers and movements within your sphere of influence. This understanding is detailed and immediate, enabling you to instinctively react and alter the energy dynamics around you if under threat.

Thanks to this awareness, your application of this power is also capable of being highly elaborate. For example, you could potentially emulate telekinesis via the remote application and manipulation of objects' kinetic energies. However, such fine manipulation requires intense concentration with your multitasking capacity also limiting how much you can manipulate at any given time.
objects.title: Kinetics & Dynamics

objects.text:
The combination of your various darkness powers has elevated you to the illustrious status of being the very manifestation of darkness.

Your weakness to light is diminished, but not removed entirely, and your range increases by two orders of magnitude, enough to drown some smaller cities in darkness. The power of your shadows is greatly magnified, such that your shadowy constructs may tear through Endbringer flesh like butter, only encountering difficulty with the deepest layers. Your Shade is even further amplified by this, becoming a veritable juggernaut even from the moment of its creation and only getting stronger from there.

Your Breaker form has shared traits with your Shade, gaining its ability to attack, consume, and mimic shadows and giving the Shade the Breaker Form’s ability to absorb darkness to regenerate. Additionally, absorbing darkness no longer just heals but also increases strength temporarily, such that “consuming” the darkness of a large cavern would be enough to manhandle Endbringers with ease. You can even merge with your Shade, forming a single existence with the combined power of both of you.

You possess much expertise traveling and manipulating the sea of shadows, being able to lurk within it’s depths indefinitely. Furthermore, you are able to use your shadows as a bridge to banish others into its abyssal darkness, trapping them there and using its darkness to smother the light within them. Furthermore, smothering someone within the shadow realm counts as consuming them, increasing your power and knowledge.

Lastly, your initial pool for creating shadowy servants has grown in size, enough that you could create a single servant on par with an Endbringer, and continues to grow at a much faster rate when in darkness. Furthermore, the strength of your servants has increased as well, with their baseline starting point already being high-level Brutes. With this you may eventually create an entire army of servants on par with Endbringers.
objects.title: Erebus

objects.text:
The combination of your various light powers has elevated you to the illustrious status of being the very manifestation of light.

Your weakness to darkness is diminished, but not removed entirely, and your range increases by two orders of magnitude, enough to drown some smaller cities in light. The power of your light is greatly magnified, such that your radiant constructs may tear through Endbringer flesh like butter, only encountering difficulty with the deepest layers.

You no longer need to be stationary in order to absorb sunlight, in fact you’re no longer restricted to just sunlight at all, being empowered by any form of visible light. This also applies to the gathering of light for Purity. Continuing with the changes to Purity, your supply of light energy refills much quicker and can be used to increase your strength and empower any power you possess, as opposed to just being expended to fire beams.

Your ability to draw upon and influence existing light is also increased, able to manifest your powers from any light source in your range, and even increase the strength of manifested powers depending on the brightness of said light source. Accompanying this is the ability to magnify any light source within your range, as well as make the manifestations of your light non-lethal.

Lastly, your ability to create illusions is bolstered as well, removing any light based limitations to your illusions and even granting the ability to make your illusions only perceivable to individuals you choose. This allows you to do things such as blinding flashes of light which only your enemies can see, or create glowing outlines of enemies within range for your allies.
objects.title: Aether

addons.text:
The assistance of your powers based on sound and vibrations helped the Empire of Sound also to manifest its control of cymatics for you to use without the need of Tinkertech. You can manipulate and create vibrations that are naturally attuned to cymatics, which can be modulated to melodies containing specific effects. These melodies are still tempered by your intentions and refined by your mind, able to handle the sheer influx of information you’re calculating to modulate your power.

Thanks to its more “artistic” creative process, the strain and exhaustion you suffer from the more theoretically complex or large-scale feats are offset.
addons.title: The World is a Song

objects.text:
Your control of the physical, either by conducting an orchestral interplay of matter and energy and/or being smitten by nature’s song, is now dancing to the tune of your anthem.

Your knack for engineering tinkertech for sound and music, while using your control of vibrations as a medium, went through a breakthrough owing to its newfound handle of cymatics, vibrations giving matter form which, accordingly, when vibrated generates energy. Attuning your tinkertech to these frequencies is as easy as a tune-up, taking many forms: a guitar, a microphone, a Sound or DJ deck balancing ease-of-use and intricacy. 

How this works is simple, your music and melodies contain frequencies and vibrations modulating and altering the world at large and/or emulating the world’s experiences tempered by your message/intention and what you intend with a track, the physical world adjusting by “mood” and “vibe” of the song or melody, to see creation come undone.

Almost anything can be accomplished through this, with imagination and Entity-imposed restrictions being the only limitations.
objects.title: Empire of Sound

addons.text:
You’ve become a walking fortress and siege engine, as your ability to create and manipulate defense structures and improve upon their foundations is incorporated into Armamentarium.

Armamentarium improves the constructs’ formidability, with turrets gaining adaptability in the shape of mobility and cutting-edge tinkertech, e.g., mobile missile launchers or AI-assisted ionic rays; barriers are now more responsive to the environment and opposition, e.g., barriers adapt an electrostatic coat to avoid climbing; and minions inherit the skills of those who utilized Armamentarium’s armament as echoes of warriors.

All of this helps to build siege engines and strongpoints, a stronghold’s polar opposite: turrets become artillery and ordnance, barriers take an offensive use, and minions fire set off suppressive fire to gain ground.

Your energy pool efficiency is enhanced to make a defense that leaves Rogal Dorn blushing with only half of your energy expenditure, aiding in loosening your inherent limitations on summoning weaponry and strongpoints.
addons.title: The Sieging Stronghold

addons.text: Your [Cycle] restrictions on how catastrophic you can be are lifted. With Chaotic Tinker, once your seed of havoc is born, the most dangerous weaponry and ordnance the Entities ever encountered are free to be summoned: war machines to raze cities, a matter-annihilating cannon, or a grav-gun that fires black holes, anything that of short ruins the ecosystem of a planet is on a charred silver platter.
addons.title: WMD

addons.text: Your weapons platform evolves your modifications to your summoned armaments. Aside from enhancing Weapons Platform to a circular perimeter and allowing your weaponry to be absorbed by it, you can now apply any of your Tinker specialties to your summoned armaments, such as (Tinker) Huge Scale, fashioning a plasma rifle of the size of a Schwerer Gustav. Should you possess Esoteric Knowledge, you can also apply any of your Tech and Artifice powers to access their catalog of weaponry and incorporate their features and advancements in your armaments.
addons.title: Bang Virtuosity

addons.text: Every single one of the weapons in your stockpile can instead be manifested as a ‘blank’ gun, with each one capable of focusing on and adapting to a different target. Furthermore, ‘blank’ guns now develop an order of magnitude faster, allowing for quicker deployment of truly powerful and personalized attacks.
addons.title: First Strike

objects.text:
You attained Armamentarium’s full potential, at least what’s afforded in a [Cycle].

You can bring a stockpile of weaponry, around a thousand (1000) from every stretch of the imagination, collected by the Entities’ previous host species. Ranging from primal armaments (i.e. swords, spears, halberds, shields, scythes, etc.), modern (handguns, SMGs, rifles, snipers, LMGs, rocket, and grenade launchers, etc.), to sci-fi-like weaponry (holo-weaponry, energy weapons, mass-drive weapons, etc.). And that's not all, with defensive armaments such as armor/exoskeletons, too. This contains the advancements and specialties they relied on in all the exotic and alien splendor.

This stockpile is unilaterally and telekinetically controlled, each weapon a mental instance to handle its mechanisms as well as modifying its attachments and blueprints, even including exotic effects to any part of the payload or chassis, such as kinetic-absorbent slugs or automatic laser rifles with ray-beam modes. When it comes to controlling your weaponry, instead of disappearing once their mags are empty, they automatically refill, and your marksmanship is further honed to its own caliber: do you know what those assassins from Wanted can do with a gun? It’s that with ricocheting as a cherry on top… nearing as a homing effect.

Although your armory is war-ending, there are some limitations: the more complex and dangerous an armament, the more taxing, with less variant weaponry you can conjure, i.e., you can use an array of 1000 .22LR pistols or rifles with no sweat off your brow, yet more than ten thermobaric nuclear energy LMGs? Not if your life counts on it. Oh, and your Shard prevents you from summoning the most devastating of the bunch, for "fairness" sake, it said.
objects.title: Armamentarium

objects.text:
In combination with your ability to see the weaknesses of others, you have gained a secondary application of your ability to create weapons. Rather than form a known mundane weapon, you can instead have your energy take the form of a ‘blank’ gun, which adapts to destroy a given target.

Once the ‘blank’ gun is conjured, you can focus on one single entity or object, at which point the gun will begin to change and evolve, growing more advanced and powerful in directions specifically designed to leverage weaknesses and destroy the target in a single shot. Examples include a double-shot mass driver to destroy a personal shield and follow up with a kill shot using another projectile, a laser or explosive to destroy all of a regenerator’s cells in a single shot to prevent them from regenerating, or even a projectile subject to a lesser version of Sting to pierce conventionally unbreakable materials.

This doesn’t have a hard cap in the size, strength, or complexity the gun can achieve, so given sufficient time, you can get a gun capable of defeating Endbringers, although it’ll take several minutes to develop to that point, and the gun will likely be unwieldy. The topic of time also segways into the other weakness of this power, that being that once the target of the adapted gun is destroyed or changed, the gun’s adaptations automatically reset and start from scratch, so you can’t focus on an Endbringer for a while before turning your newly formed god gun against your average Brute.
objects.title: One Shot, One Kill

addons.text: As the ruler of the sky you aren’t content to merely control the wind alone. No, with the inclusion of other elemental powers your control has extended, allowing you to become a living storm of unrivaled power. Anything you could do with wind now extends to all aspects of a storm, namely water, lightning, ice, and snow.
addons.title: Living Storm

objects.text: You are the ultimate aerokinetic, a true master of the Sky. Within the range of (Shaker) Storm, you possess absolute control and awareness of the air itself, seemingly to the point of omnipresence. You can freely control the air in your range, compressing and directing it however you please. From razor sharp whirlwinds, explosive bursts of pressurized air, or even stable wind constructs, you mold the essence of the sky to your whims. You can even form animated constructs, ranging from emulations of animals to perfect copies of yourself. Your control is fine enough to create a skintight shell of razor sharp wind around yourself and move with full range of motion without harming yourself. This control can also be used to fly at immense speeds, simultaneously propelling yourself forwards and shifting air to prevent friction and drag, allowing you to hurtle around at ridiculous speeds all while retaining your awareness of your surroundings by sensing through the air itself. Your control also allows you to fire Air Blasts from any point in your range while also massively increasing their power and range, enough to level cities at full power. Despite this increased range, the power of your Air Blasts actually increases the closer the firing point is to your palms, with concentrated blasts directly from your hands being able to drill through all but the deepest layers of an Endbringer. Your Breaker state from Custodian can now be freely entered and exited as you please, and with your increased control over wind you can fashion a physical avatar even when in this Breaker state. Additionally, as your avatar is made from the same wind you have absolute control over, it doesn’t need to stay in any one form, allowing you to mimic shapeshifting by simply changing the shape of your avatar. This can also be used to mimic teleportation within your range by dissolving into air only to reform your body elsewhere. Your control is not Manton-Limited, allowing you to control the air inside other people, enabling actions such as literally ripping the air out of someone’s lungs. Your only real limitation is areas where no air exists, as there is nothing for you to control there.
objects.title: Zephyr

objects.text:
Your various powers have merged into a more cohesive powerset centered around a single Archetype, the Monkey King.

Your physical attributes and regenerative abilities have skyrocketed, rendering you all but immortal and capable of throwing down with the strongest of Brutes. Your shape shifting has grown and shed all but a few of its shackles, allowing you to assume the forms of any biological creature with no regard for size. Whether it be a tree, a giant version of yourself, or a perfect replica of someone else, the shape of your body is yours to decide.

You are no longer restricted to just 100 clones, now each one of the hairs on your head can be smoothly and painlessly plucked and turned into a perfect clone, each indistinguishable from you in every way and possessing all of your powers at full strength. While transforming into a mythological creature does grant you the powers commonly associated with it, you cannot transform into another person to gain their powers.

Your sensitivity to supernatural phenomena and ability to see the underlying layer of reality has sublimated to become a pair of Golden Eyes, capable of seeing the Truth of the world. No more can your vision be obscured by illusions or darkness, your eyes piercing through all which seeks to block your perception. Your ability to discern what powers are doing grows greatly as well, providing an intuitive understand of the actions and mechanics of any power you observe.
objects.title: Monkey King

objects.text:
Your ability to inflict bad luck and cause disaster have merged and stabilized with the inclusion of Energy Well, increasing your ability to inflict disaster to the point of absurdity and allowing you to embody the archetype of “The Butterfly Which Causes Disaster.”

Jinx evolves into a passive aura which drains the luck of anyone within a 1 km radius of yourself, bolstering your luck at the expense of all others or even directly converting the luck into more energy for your Energy Well. You can even control how much is drained, from a slow and subtle draw to a nigh-instantly draining someone.

You have absolute control over what disaster Malum summons and how they manifest, to the point of being able to fake various Shaker and Blaster powers like aerokinesis and electrokinesis when used in combination with Energy Well. This control even encompasses Bedlam, allowing you to precisely dictate where Bedlam zones occur and how severely reality breaks down.

As part of the Archetype your Energy Well has developed an intuitive and innate form of manifestation in the form of constructs made from a malleable black and purple pseudo-matter which is especially good at channeling the effects of Jinx and Bedlam, to the point of inflicting pseudo-entropy where the target suffers critical malfunctions and basically just spontaneously falls apart. You also intuitively know how to form butterfly wing constructs which allow you to fly, allowing you to gaze from on high at the destruction and havoc you wreak.
objects.title: A Butterfly’s Wings

objects.text:
You can use your absorbed sound energy to enhance your breaker form. By investing sound energy into it, your breaker form’s wings grow both in size and number, enhancing your speed, maneuverability, and flight altitude. The structure of each wing changes, gaining flexible chains of vertebrae-like bones that provide exceptional dexterity and allow for precise movement. These chains can also lock together into rigid formations, enabling your wings to act as durable barriers or blunt-force weapons.

When the eyes on your feathers close, their barbs become active, capable of piercing clothing and skin to inject a potent stimulant. This chemical heightens pain perception and prevents unconsciousness, forcing victims into prolonged, agonizing states. Their screams, amplified by the effects of the stimulant, provide you with a renewable source of sound energy to fuel your form. Detached feathers can be launched as projectiles, capable of detonating sonic bursts, creating localized shockwaves that harm and disorient enemies.
objects.title: The Many Winged Angel

addons.text:
Well, lucky you, your power answers against any threat by simply freezing it over…! That would’ve been so pointless if your area of influence wasn’t expanded to a 100-foot radius. 

Your Shard will scan for any threats around you. If something pings off its senses when in your area, it’ll reflexively freeze anything that should’ve harmed or killed you within 100 feet. One evolution due to range’s extension is being capableof  “freezing” the physics of an object, such as the kinetic energy of a bullet and the fall of a box.
addons.title: Timeout!

objects.text:
You can freeze objects, people, or areas in time for any exact duration between 30 seconds and 15 minutes, and the effect is completely stable. There’s no risk of the frozen object unfreezing on its own, no matter how long it’s frozen. When you freeze something, you see a visible timer in your vision that shows how much time is left before the effect ends. At any moment, you can choose to unfreeze something early, leaving other things still frozen if you want. 

In addition to that, you are completely immune to all forms of time manipulation. This includes effects like Gray Boy’s time loops, Bakuda’s temporal bombs, or any other powers or devices that alter time. You can move freely through areas affected by these effects, completely unaffected. This doesn’t work on time loops. This has an interesting effect when interacting with your own time stopped objects, allowing you to interact and alter them even when they are inviolable to all other things (bar All or Nothings).
objects.title: Timekeeper

objects.text: Do you know what happens when entities can’t or won’t manage their cycles properly? YOU, you happen. You are now a living simulation of a cycle’s worst-case scenario, where the ice breaks, and reality itself goes along with it. You have gone far beyond simply finding cracks hidden in reality. Now, you make them. Manifesting as what appears to be black lightning, these cracks can connect not only to out of bounds areas, but through them to the firmament itself, directly connecting it to reality. The scale of your lightning is dependent on whether or not you are in titan form. Outside of titan form, the lightning will only be able to make them slightly bigger than your average lightning strike, just enough to walk through. In titan form, the lightning can be big enough to swallow skyscrapers whole. You can leave any crack you have made in place or dismiss it in either form. Cracks can also be overlapped to make bigger cracks. In either form you can use the cracks as a form of transportation, warping from shardspace to realspace and back again wherever you remember. These cracks can influence parahumans, messing with their connections to their shards. Their powers will get slightly weaker around them, diminishing the further inside the firmament they go. You can also use the cracks in a more offensive manner, directly cracking both people and objects to horrific results. Only All-or-Nothing defenses possess the ability to resist such attacks, but only the small ones. Larger cracks such as those in your titan form will see their ability to weaken powers allow the cracks to negate this defense, leaving them nothing but chunks of flesh. You can use the cracks as a form of transportation, warping yourself and others from shardspace to realspace and back again wherever you remember. Your shard self will make it so that you don’t lose connection to your shard when in shardspace. Finally, through the connection of realspace and shardspace, a horrifying possibility has arisen. You can use the cracks to move your shard self to realspace, interface with the shard-flesh of your titan body, and combine them to become a pseudo-entity. This form drastically boosts not only your cracking ability but also any other powers you possess to the level of what an entities avatar may display. This is not the full power of an entity, just as much as what Scion casually displayed on the Golden Morning. This is heavily draining on your energy reserves, and if your shard runs out of juice, you will die alongside it. Though it should be noted that shards are just as vulnerable to being “cracked” as anything else. With this in mind, it might be possible to kill the entity with this heightened power, assuming you manage to catch them unawares.
objects.title: Icebreaker

addons.text: While simultaneously claiming a Parahuman transforms and reshapes their Shard to be a self-contained world, superseding itself both in existence and abilities, it can additionally change it into a physical representation of its specialization, as well, becoming an embodiment of a concept using Inner Beast as groundwork for its transformation, becoming pocket worlds into themselves, likewise, shaping their portion of your realm to their colors. Being lower conceptual beings, their abilities play fast and loose with how reality plays out, provided they are within the Being’s scope. These Beings can be connected to other Hosts, conferring power of cosmic proportions, taking the role of Inner Gods. You can also connect and control their development or state within Saṃsāra, using their powers for yourself, knowing they’re intrinsically a part of you.
addons.title: Nirvana

addons.text: Ignis has plunged parts of your realm into disarray, pocket dimensions where it shifts between reality and unreality, where exists what couldn’t and shouldn’t, unthinkable concepts or hypotheticals you can venture far enough to recognize as nonsensical in a traditional framework–it shouldn’t be there in the first place… yet exists, nevertheless.
addons.title: Karma

addons.text: Pramant now serves as the Brahma of Saṃsāra, building upon Shards of ideas and experience to create worlds and fragments of existence within, able to potentially forge your little slice of the Multiverse within your Multiversal Lattice.
addons.title: Dharma

addons.text:
Your Saṃsāra also implements your Cycle-breaking frameworks to bridge the gap between Reality and your realm as cracks of chromatic lightning manifest around you, these cracks being links to several Worlds of your realm, both gate and warden, that is, you can transport yourself through these cracks and appear somewhere else with another crack as you calculate your realms dimensional coordinates that align with Realspace. These cracks vary in their effects on Parahumans aside from diminishing their powers, disrupting, distorting, or utterly going out of control when Parahumans come into contact with your realm.

This additionally grants your Titan body the ability to be a gateway between Realspace and Realmspace, your Shardself being undistinguishable from the realm itself as Saṃsāra undergoes its cycles of evolution and liberation. Fully interfacing your Shard with your Titan body bridges your realm with reality, bringing your full power as Deva into the land of the living.
addons.title: Mokṣa

objects.text:
The Firmament is known for its makeup of Multiversal Lattice, a semi-virtual dimension adjacent to the usual structure of reality across the [Cycle’s] landscape, where every Shard interacts with one another and the Host’s foundations are established. 

Imagine this world taking a life of its own.

Every time you claim a Parahuman their Shard attains a little bit of [DATA] from your [Expanse] management, their Island mutating and evolving, growing more “alive”, gaining too much definition to such a virtual landscape it enlivens it. The more Parahumans you claim, the more Shards experience this change, turning Shardspace into a whole realm just as it is a Cycle: Saṃsāra. This Cycle revolves around the redefinition of a Shard’s functionality within and beyond Shardspace, shedding away past evolutionary throwbacks and building upon a Window to better frameworks of [Data] and [Structure]; this, in kind, changes your Island, expanding its reach and metaphysical weight.

Enough claimed Shards within the Network cause the Firmament to warp into an evolving planar fixture upon reality, now gaining definition as opposed to the apparent virtuality it had at first, ever-expanding and ever-changing, to the point of reaching out to different stretches of the Multiverse making rifts and openings to other worlds and dimensions, no longer needing Shards to maintain the realm, these Shards now worlds onto their own, from their laws of nature and physics to flora and fauna. This culminates in Shardspace’s transformation to Saṃsāra, becoming equivalent to the Bleed or the Nexus of all Realities; your Shard manipulates this realm as Deva, where you can send and travel to any Alternate Earth connected to Saṃsāra’s connective tissue, that is, any Earth you have chosen.
objects.title: Saṃsāra

objects.text:
Your powers have coalesced into a nightmare scenario for all tinkers. You now possess the power to directly manipulate the black-box of any tinkertech you have analysed. 

Using Techno Brain to interact with the black-box directly, you then use your computer brain and enhanced blueprinting skills to reproduce the design of the tinkertech in your mind. Once that is done, Reproduction’s weakening of the black-box interacts with your ability to make black-boxes, effectively giving you the encryption keys to manage the black-box you have analyzed. Your mental analysis of tinkertech will be slowed down by how complex the design of it is. This can be sped up by either analyzing similar tech or tech by the same creator. From here, one of two options can be chosen, you can either completely remove the black-box, converting it into real tech, or change the access keys, causing the item to be registered under your ownership instead of its creator’s. Either way, you gain full knowledge of how to properly use the technology.

When you do this, it effectively means that the original owner can no longer properly tinker with the tech they have already made. Normally, they would eventually understand it again due to still falling under their specialization, but your encryption abilities make it possible to strengthen the black-box to the point where they can’t. This effective means that they are interacting with the tinkertech as though they were a non-tinker, completely unaware of how tech they made is even supposed to work. If you manage to hack the black-box of their tinker-tech while they are using it, this will result in them getting what is effectively a thinker headache from the mental dissonance. Prepare to be hated by tinkers worldwide.

As an added bonus, your black-boxing abilities also mean that your computerized brain now has proper fire walls against unwanted intruders.
objects.title: Black Hat Hacker

objects.text:
You now possess full administrative control over all clusters you make. From power expression to kiss-kill dynamics, all of it is under your strict control. In addition, you may even include members of your network into these clusters, increasing your possibilities. Should you decide to remove a member from one of your clusters, you may optionally choose for them to keep any extra powers they may have received from the cluster or remove even the memories they had made while inside the cluster.

This also lets you purchase cluster choices without a cluster in order to apply them to clusters you have made. If you have a cluster, then its mechanics take priority over any of your clusters.
objects.title: Cluster Bunker Buster

objects.text: You now slide around on a small platform of air slightly above the ground, this protects you from your nemesis... a small pebble in your way. Skate to your hearts content in areas you formerly couldn't reach... Enjoy!
objects.title: Hover Skater

addons.text: Your Breaker state inherits Damsel of Distress’ power, incorporating the unstable space-time phenomena into your Caustic or Raze Breaker state, granting controllable All-or-Nothing destructive capabilities while phasing or running, fully annihilating material composition, or while moving, partially offering spatial and temporal traits aiding on your traversal.
addons.title: Walking Calamity

addons.text: Starburst integrates and melds with your Breaker states into one: evolving into a Breaker form comprised entirely of Tachyons, a hypothetical particle that always moves faster than light, largely putting your past benchmarks to shame. Your Tachyon Breaker Form fully sinks into Savitar’s capabilities, distorting the space-time continuum, being present in different locations at the same time, personal All-or-Nothing defenses and offenses, and control of your physics.
addons.title: Tachyon

addons.text: Your Breaker states now dabble with temporal phenomena, capable of adjusting their personal time and those you touch or grace, absorbing or accelerating the time of anything when you race around them. This also allows you to travel through time at several points, creating temporal duplicates you command for a longer time than normal, their only downfall being time-based powers instantly “correcting” their place in time.
addons.title: Remnant of Time

objects.text: Your Mover and Breaker powers turned you into a God of Speed, moving at mind-boggling speeds without physical motion, essentially moving so fast you ignore or affect reality. You have near-full control of your motion, location, and local dimensionality; running from one place to another, ignoring any obstacle or terrain by quantum tunneling through any matter impeding you. You can choose between your caustic, destructively sharp, or personal field that protects you from local reality’s “obstacles” which you fully manipulate, evolving into your Breaker state: Caustic allows to phase through matter, corroding and disrupting their composition while controlling a form of caustic energy, Raze retains its prior abilities while providing control of the sharpness, shockwaves or vacuums you cause when moving, mid to long-range, and Armor protects you from any physical phenomena or reality in general while still able to interact with it. Finally, your mobility and maneuverability besides your perception are incredibly advanced to compensate, fluidly moving around any environment or conditions or skillfully carrying speedy actions with grace and skill. Be careful of losing sight of yourself by how fast you’re going.
objects.title: Savitar

addons.text:
Your ability to simulate a shard, your ability to modify your shard and your ability to communicate with shards have granted you the ability for your simulated shard to become real as far as any other shards are concerned.

Your simulated shard will be able to exchange [Data] between itself and other shards near you, the data being of higher quality when gotten in combat as gratitude for the other shard’s opportunity for new [Data].

You also gain the capacity to make a T3 Power now, however, you cannot make a bud of this new T3, and the stress that this power would bring to your shard alongside everything else will make your reserve of energy empty very fast without negentropy.

If you are Shardless, this addon will let you pretend to have a real Shard, other Shards are none the wiser unless you specifically tell them about it.

Your ability to bud is also improved, allowing you to not need a tinkertech creation to make a bud, just a significant enough power akin to a mid-tier T1.
addons.title: False Shard

addons.text:
Your Simulations are no more, they are instead fully real, both your workshop, scrapyard, and shard simulation are in fact access to alternate dimensions based in your nexus. This has a few effects; first of all, you can now create true buds of your shard inside Nexus, second of all your simulated shard is an actual shard that your Shard has access to for experimenting, third of all you can use the reality manipulation of Nexus to create materials for your tinkering.

It is not all sunshine, however, as material created with Nexus always acts as the lowest quality possible, and now the body in your workshop/junkyard simulation has a need to eat, sleep, and such things.

Both of those drawbacks can be negated with Negentropy, and if you do not have it there are only so many shard buds you can make before overwhelming your shard.
addons.title: True Simulation

addons.text: Now, instead of having to kill and claim the shard of the parahuman you want the power of you can instead copy them both, acting as if you claimed them normally alongside getting copies of both the Shard and Parahuman in your Nexus and Simulation.
addons.title: Claimer of Faeries

objects.text:
Your mental simulation powers have fused, becoming more than the sum of their parts.

Now your Tinker Tree access with Scrapyard is boosted to start at a “mid-level” Tinker, while still keeping your ability to improve.

Your ability to summon Tinker creations as either Tinker objects or Trump powers gains a new ability: to have your Shard emulation subsume those creations inside itself, acting as a proper power now. This change lets you surpass your emulation’s size limit by simulating the process of “Budding”; these Buds are still closely linked to you and can be shared with someone else.

Your emulation is boosted by allowing you a greater size limit, allowing you to create T2 powers than before at the expense of other powers being left behind, something easily worked around by creating and storing a Bud of your T2 powers. However, this is only possible if the T2 powers in question were simulated Tinker objects in the first place.

All these simulations work as modules, able to either be fused together and use an Avatar from your emulation to interact with both Workshop and Scrapyard, or be kept relatively separate with few connecting points for your Shard emulation.

Due to these meeting points, you are capable of making use of Scrapyard’s found materials or made in your Workshop to work on your Shard emulation for greater effect, as well.

You’ll still need to develop various ways to generate energy for your emulation once you reach a certain threshold of powers created to your Shard or simulated Tinkertech, as normal generators of your emulation work but aren’t the best for high-performance. You can instead devise an energy converter to improve the emulation’s efficiency for energy gathering, partially relieving the risk of energy exhaustion.

If you have Negentropy or Shardless, you’re no limited by size or the type/nature of powers you can create. Additionally, it provides the formation of simple junk you make use of, yet isn’t complicated enough to be more than raw materials in both your Scrapyard or Shard emulation. Keep in mind that this doesn’t clear the need to closely check your energy levels, more so enabling the construction for more negentropic generators by integrating your Tinkertech on your Shard emulation; each of these are costly on your resources and produce the same amount of energy as your normal emulation reserves.
objects.title: Emulation of a Scrapyard Shard

addons.text: The inviolable nature of your barriers has rubbed off on your energy manipulation, allowing you to infuse your hard light and lasers with the same All-or-Nothing effect. Now your hard light can block anything short of Sting itself and your lasers can effortlessly pierce all but the bottom-most layers of an Endbringer. You also gain the ability to control the permeability of your hard light and lasers.
addons.title: Impregnable

addons.text: Your hard light and lasers now function as conduits for your electromagnetism manipulation, able to be used as vectors to influence things beyond point-blank range. This can be used for feats such as explosions or laser blasts which function like EMPs, or constructs which hit harder and are more durable than they should be.
addons.title: MASER

addons.text: Your ability to shape hard light has subsumed your ability to create force elementals, allowing you to bestow life and animation to anything you create from hard light. This isn’t reliant on the form of the construct, so you could just as easily animate a bunch of floating swords as you could a giant dragon. Additionally, with extra effort and energy you can make your constructs more ‘real.’ What this entails is that the construct now becomes permanent and alive, not dissipating even once you stop actively upholding it. Furthermore, while you can still take control of these living constructs, they gain their own nascent minds as well which can learn and develop into full sentience given time. Living constructs passively repair on their own, but their regeneration can be sped up by actively providing more energy to them. Your Shard will only support up to 72 living constructs, so if you want to make more you’ll have to disperse one of them. Having Shardless or Negentropy removes this limitation.
addons.title: Ars Goetia

objects.text:
Your various New Wave powers - buds of a single Shard - have been reconsolidated into a single more cohesive whole. You are able to conjure and shape energy into a variety of forms, such as lasers, force fields, or hard-light constructs. 

You possess incredibly fine control over the shape of the constructs you create, able to shape them to perfectly mold to an existing object or person for either first aid or restraint purposes. You can also telekinetically control and move your constructs, guiding them even in great swarms. You can imbue your constructs with a variety of effects, from anchoring to people or objects, growing in size and power with time, exploding on command or when touched, etc. 

Your fine control over your own hard light has influenced your Breaker form as well, allowing it to be shaped with the same ease any other construct is. This control also extends to the lasers you fire, able to choose the details of what is fired, from thin piercing beams to short spreads of concussive blasts. You can also modulate the intensity of your lasers and constructs, all the way up to being able to tank blows from Endbringers and easily punch holes through mountains. 

As an added bonus, your flight is improved - now easily breaking the sound barrier all while retaining pinpoint precision. You are fully immune to your constructs and anything produced by them, in addition to possessing perfect vision and an immunity to being blinded.
objects.title: Light Bringer

addons.text: You are able to imbue your miniature suns with the same anomalous properties. Furthermore, by expending a portion of your stamina, you can transform one of your miniature suns into a permanent entity. Once solidified, this sun will hover motionlessly in place, radiating its light indefinitely until it is intentionally destroyed or otherwise extinguished.
addons.title: Curse the Sun

objects.text:
Within a radius of 500 meters, you can grant sunlight anomalous properties, transforming it into a force of destruction and horrifying transformation. The sunlight alters the environment within the radius, turning the sky into a hazy, oppressive yellow-orange hue and raising the ambient temperature slightly. Living creatures exposed to this sunlight begin to melt, their bodies dissolving into a sentient, malleable mass of flesh. The process is agonizing and varies in speed depending on the intensity of the light. Melted beings retain consciousness, basic motor functions, and if they were parahumans, their powers remain intact in this new state. Brutes or Breakers may be able to resist this. Melted beings can fuse together, combining into larger, stronger amalgamations with heightened physical and predatory capabilities.

You can focus the sunlight on specific areas within your radius, intensifying its effects in that zone. The enhanced sunlight melts creatures faster and increases the anomaly’s potency, but this comes at the cost of weakening its effects across the rest of the radius. 

The sunlight has no effect on you. Instead, it constantly rejuvenates you, invigorating both your body and mind. You are sustained entirely by its energy, immune to fatigue, and healed from any injury.

Your lasers powered by sunlight can also be granted this anomalous effect, with it being far stronger and more concentrated than normal sunlight. These lasers instantly induce an All or Nothing variant of the melting process on contact, bypassing the any form of resistance. The concentrated anomaly can pierce through barriers, ignite surfaces with searing heat, and spread the transformative effect more aggressively, even in areas shielded from direct light. 

The melted flesh beings can understand and obey your commands, acting as extensions of your will. They are sustained even without the presence of the anomalous sunlight, persisting indefinitely in their altered state. Instinctively, they seek out other melted beings to fuse with, growing stronger and more dangerous as they combine. When they infect new individuals, they almost always fuse with them immediately, creating larger, more powerful amalgamations.

You can also sculpt the melted flesh with precision, reshaping it into forms of your choosing. This allows you to craft grotesque constructs for utility, defense, or offense, such as barriers, weapons, or autonomous creatures. Additionally, you can temporarily fuse with the melted mass, merging your body with it to drastically enhance your strength, durability, and adaptability. In this state, you become an extension of the anomaly itself, wielding its power with unmatched control.
objects.title: When Day Breaks

objects.text:
Your power shifts from being able to turn into tentacles to turning into an amorphous mass of muscular intestines, lined with digestive enzymes. Your intestines can extend and retract unexpectedly quickly, letting you strike fast from a distance or sling your way across a space with agility. These intestines are covered in external villi to maximize surface area for the creation of digestive acids. 

Your acid copies the all-or-nothing nature of your mouths, allowing it to melt through anything at the same rate as anything else. It’d melt through cotton as fast as it could melt through titanium, which is very fast. You can also utilize peristaltic waves on anything caught by your intestines to crush with the help of your strength. Anything nutritious digested by your acids further hastens your regeneration, whether it’s up close melting some poor cape or from a distance being flung at a bystander.
objects.title: Salamander Shell

objects.text:
Your multitude of powers has fused into one cohesive idea: The World Serpent

Your serpent form is now much greater, being tens of thousands of kilometres long and being durable enough that anything less than an All-or-Nothing effect is bouncing clean off your scales, with strength enough to flatten cities with your movements. Despite these improvements, two facets of your changer state have increased the most.

The first is your poison, both the quantity and potency to such a degree that your poison breath can eclipse an entire city with a single breath, and the poison itself is an All-or-Nothing effect where everything not immune dies within seconds. The second is your growth; the longer you are in your changer state, the larger and stronger it grows. The growth speed is absurd, and the only limit to your growth is the fact that the larger you are, the more energy your shard needs to sustain it (Shardless/Negentropy negates this weakness).
objects.title: Miðgarðsormr

objects.text:
Something about you changed once some of your powers came to mingle… a living city, a testing world of Shards that ravages the mind and brings forth their traumas and pain’s warped repercussions in the flesh, a world where all is laid bare, and the physical epithet of punishment, culminate into a something Other—Ungodly.

It results in overlaying a plane of existence that fogs over a cities-wide area, bridging another plane of existence where people’s deepest and darkest truths of themselves manifest as warped and twisted creatures with less than best intentions, the fog rusting and corrupting every corner into another world altogether, filled with these monsters. 

It is a cold and dreary purgatory, although Hell will be a greater analogy for the unenlightened. Hell on Earth’s entrapment and perversion with Pyramid Head’s fog wears down anyone within your Otherworld, with monstrosities taken out their greatest nightmares and deepest depths of their mind, a haze that saps over their mind and body ever so slowly, and the more the push on into their hellish landscape and done no headways to metaphorically burying the hatchet of their pain and sorrow will cause them to lose their humanity at every step and be part of the monsters they fend off. 

While retaining your previous abilities, your connection to this Otherworld grants several sub-powers:

You become a Presence within your area, your consciousness bathing the rusted walls and floors–a God of your Domain–able to control the layout, the fog’s intensity in effects and visibility, and everything about your plane. 

The monsters, of course, are part of you as just as much a part of the victims’ psyche, your Otherworld eagerly painting and framing itself by the victims’ lies and deep-seated truths, a form of psychological warfare that tears the victim’s spirit if they don’t have what it takes to keep moving forward, their Fear a fuel for ramping your plane’s reach and scope; as enough dread you foster, it allows for some of your esoteric applications like spatial anomalies like labyrinths, temporal anomalies like time-loops, pseudospiritual introspection, and calls from the “afterlife” (with Shardless and Esoteric Knowledge playing it straight).

The Fog, though, is your signature control tool: aside from its usual abilities, it serves as a vector for your Otherworld, setting it in and holding its mainstay. Now, those touched by the Fog are unconsciously aware of their deepest truths and lies, you being no exception, trying your best to manifest it on either monsters or trials.

Then for those whose mettle didn’t last long, your Fog takes and sinks its teeth, swallowing them whole for other uses, such as spitting them out broken and deformed by their failures and faults they couldn’t face and rise against, a grotesque caricature of their former selves.

Being quasi-dimensional, imagination is your only hurdle aside from the fog’s languid expansion. Another limitation is those with nothing left to fear or hide, the Fog passes through, never going through your Otherworld.
objects.title: The Hills Have Gone Silent Since You Came…

objects.text:
Manager has integrated the resources of Evolution and Escalation into itself, expanding upon its previous capabilities. You have a total of 20 slots with which to copy powers and can have 7 of them active at a time. This limit can be exceeded but will result in severe escalating thinker headaches until you stop.

Your active slots gain the functionality of both source slots and evolver slots. This means that you can copy the power of any parahuman you know with no SP limit if you have an active slot empty. You are still required to touch a parahuman should you wish to take away their power. If you do not wish to make a power copy using a slot, you can instead use them to create any power you can think of with a limit of 15 SP.

The slow pacing of the original evolver slots has been fixed in part due to your ability to modify your powers. This is caused by the abundance of [Data] produced by your various modifications fueling the evolution of your powers. Your power modifications can also be used to guide the evolution in specific directions. 

Your ability to put similar powers into the same slot has also been enhanced, with the evolution process converting them into a cohesive power set. You can also evolve radically different powers in such a way that they become compatible with each other, allowing for them to be combined.

You may discard any power you have copied or created but will not be able to access that power until it is recopied, recreated, or stolen once more. Recopying a power will take about 5 minutes without contact but will be instantaneous with contact. Recreating powers is more complex, with the process taking about 5 minutes but with the caveat that you cannot recreate multiple powers at once. Stealing a power again can only be done through contact but is instantaneous.

Negentropy increases the number of slots you have, raising your active limit to 10 and your total slots to 25. You also gain the option to either create a new slot or increase your active limit by sacrificing [Data]. A new slot can be added by sacrificing 20 SP worth of [Data] while your active limit can be increased by sacrificing 10 SP worth of [Data]. Esoteric Knowledge give the ability to copy the powers of non-parahumans you know about.
objects.title: System Administrator

objects.text:
Your abilities to charge and absorb energies have fused, allowing you to rapidly and exponentially generate your own energy for use in combat. Your charge-up time is now exponential, allowing you to build up an equivalent of minutes' worth of energy in three seconds. Additionally, your ability to distribute kinetic energy to what you touch is now much less limited in restrictions.

For example, pushing your energy into the air could cause an air cannon-like effect, or cause a beam of energy to shoot forth, depending on how you go about it. On that note, your governance over your energy that you absorb or generate expands to the point where you can freely craft it into tangible objects under your full control—from a baseball bat made of energy to a flexible snake. Additionally, with finer control, you can perform actions such as flight or forms of telekinesis through subtle manipulations of your energy.
objects.title: Felony

objects.text:
Your body has become an unholy incubator, swelling with the weight of unborn monstrosities. As you grow fatter, more of these creatures develop within you, their strength and size increasing in proportion to your own mass. The largest and most powerful take time to gestate, but if you burn your fat reserves, you can force them into premature birth. These infants will be disconnected from you, having no cord and are free to roam beyond your normal reach, however they will have a drastically limited lifespan, surviving no longer than an hour before collapsing into lifeless husks.

Your overwhelming bulk serves as both armor and a fortress, layers of flesh absorbing impacts while your infants nest within, waiting to emerge. When threatened, they can retreat into your folds for protection, vanishing beneath your massive form before bursting forth again when needed. Striking you is futile—your body cushions the force of blows, and wounds rapidly close as your mass shifts to compensate. Any physical attack that doesn’t annihilate you outright is simply swallowed into your body, rendering conventional assaults meaningless.

The more your infants feed, the stronger and larger you become, their gluttony fueling your endless expansion. When they consume, the energy is transferred directly to your body, increasing your fat reserves and allowing you to generate even more offspring. If they manage to devour something substantial, you may instantly swell in size, your body growing heavier and harder to stop. You can use the infants to carry you around.
objects.title: Broodmother

addons.text:
Your grotesque, bloated form and your Eldritch breaker state are now permanently fused. You are an approximate replication of what your shard believes is a god-womb, based off literature on Earth, a living shrine of mouths, limbs, eyes, and churning organs.

Your Children are born in your image. No longer merely monstrous, they each carry with them a fragment of your alien presence. Every Child, even the smallest, sprouts additional mouths—not for speaking language, but for chanting, for groaning, for whispering your unknowable will. These mouths speak in voices that are not theirs—sometimes yours, sometimes the voices of those you’ve eaten, sometimes things from past Entity Cycles.

When multiple Children are nearby, their mouths begin to harmonise. The sound is not a song, but a psychic dirge that corrodes will and implants compulsions. The longer a target hears it, the less they remember why they were resisting. Victims may fall into a fugue state, wander into the arms of your Children, or carry out your will without understanding why. The more Children in range, the stronger the effect, until entire battlefields fall silent beneath the groaning chorus of the Thousand Young. 

Once every month, if you have fed deeply and suffered through unrelenting hunger and mass consumption, you may bring forth a Herald of the Black Goat—a special Child, towering and obscene, brimming with mouths that scream your unfiltered madness into the world. When this Herald cries out, it overwhelms both mind and matter. Sound bends terrain, cracks stone, and ruptures the sanity of anyone who hears it. Hallucinations take hold instantly. People see loved ones twisted into monsters, allies as enemies, or become convinced they are already dead. The Herald’s screams act as psychic smog: only your kin can navigate cleanly within it.

These Heralds cannot be rushed. Each one takes at least a month of internal gestation, requires obscene caloric intake, and must be birthed at the height of your gluttonous cycle. But once they stand, they are not minions—they are prophets, spreading your influence with every impossible sound.

There is no resisting the Mother of a Thousand Young. There is only the slow, shivering realization that you were always going to kneel.
addons.title: Womb of Shub-Niggurath

objects.text:
You no longer give birth to infants or custom-bred monsters as separate creations. Instead, everything that emerges from your immense, heaving form is part of a singular lineage—your Children. Each one is a grotesque fusion of crushing, bloated strength and precise biological design, molded within your body according to your will during incubation. They are your kin, your spawn.

Every Child is born connected to you by a thick, sinewy umbilical cord. While linked they are extensions of your being. You share strength between one another: when a connected Child becomes stronger, you become stronger, and so do all others in the web. The cords transmit not just physical power, but awareness and instinct, binding all attached Children into a single, distributed organism with you at its heart. They can see through each other’s eyes, feel through each other’s skin, and fight as one monstrous, multi-bodied intelligence.

Your Children can detach themselves at will, sacrificing the shared strength and awareness for greater autonomy and range. Disconnected Children become fully independent, able to roam, hunt, and fight far from your body with all the cunning and physical power you’ve built into them. Additionally, all Children have extremely strong grips that double in strength every second they hold on, this trait in every single one of your Children no matter their form. 

So long as they survive, they can return and reattach, rejoining the bond and restoring the shared might between you. These cords also serve more than connection—they are your second mouths. When latched onto organic matter—dead flesh, fresh meat, living prey, or even waste—they begin to break it down and consume it. Everything devoured this way is digested and returned to you as fat, swelling your reserves and feeding the growth of new Children.
