When your Children reattach their cords, they may also re-enter your body, sinking into your flesh like swimmers into deep water. Nestled inside your folds and reabsorbed into your form, they grant you even greater power. Their presence bolsters your physical might, speeds your regeneration, and intensifies your senses. Within you, they are safe, and healed. The stronger your Children, the greater the strength you gain from them resting within you.
objects.title: Bloodline Absolute

objects.text:
Your pocket dimension took the children. It now appears as the clinical halls of a maternity ward, overlaid across the boundaries of the area. The more you saturate an area with your power, the more the ward comes alive. Doors become gaping, toothless mouths, the gaps in the floor tiles pulse with veins, and the walls soften, rising and falling as if they were breathing. The air gradually thickens with the scent of antiseptic and milk, while the incubators that replace the carriages stir with baby-soft flesh.

Anybody who lingers too long within the ward starts becoming drowsier, their mannerisms introducing infantile habits while their powers similarly weaken. Idly suckling on their thumbs, pawing at surfaces, walking while swinging their arms. When they fall asleep, hospital beds roll out from the walls to catch them and slide back in, the blankets seeping away at them until they’re nothing but another newborn.

When you choose to awaken the infants within the incubators, they burst, revealing swarms of malformed fetuses the size of small bags, still connected to their place of origin with thick, sinewy and prehensile umbilical cords. They possess much of the similar capacities, except that they’re more inclined to trap against one of the many beds within the area, smothering with the blankets to turn into one of them. Even after you leave, the ward will linger - but its environment fades faster than its effects. Incubators will lie inside refrigerators, and ordinary beds and blankets will still possess the ability to turn victims into infants.
objects.title: Rock-a-Bye Bye

addons.text: Now your tinker capabilities extend to working with leather and living skin. This would allow you to change your skin(s) to make them appear like a different person or just make minor modifications, capitalizing on the emotional manipulation part of your specialization, like making a face look more trustworthy or sinister. You also gained techniques to glue and fuse skins perfectly, removing the patchwork appearance of using multiple skins. Your knowledge base includes methods to treat skin with preservatives against decay.
addons.title: Skin Sculptor

addons.text:
You can turn your flayed skins into symbiotic creatures. This process will speed up the process of replacing your original skin massively, with symbiotic skin taking a few hours to reform your body and this will also allow you to use your Living Skinsuits on others, replacing their original skin, which will make them affected by your stranger power as long as the skin stays on.

If you let the symbiotic skin consume the original being it was flayed from, it will gain its memories, skills and knowledge, allowing its new wearer to access it freely, and if you want, then you could even have the Skinsuit to consume the original’s personality (including metaphysical parts like souls if taken with Shardless/Esoteric Knowledge) using it to replace the person who puts it on.

The Skinsuits can’t consume and replicate powers, but they can be worn and even replace powered beings gaining access to their powers.
addons.title: Living Skinsuits

addons.text: Now you can have your own skin absorb and store the rest of your body, turning it into a skinsuit instead of a blanket. In this form, you can possess and take control over anybody who wears your skin, with your stranger effect also working on them. Most importantly, this will combine all of your physical abilities with your host’s and also give you access to your host’s power(s). If you have other powers, this will allow your host to benefit from them, like healing them with a self-regeneration power.
addons.title: Possession

addons.text: You can store 3 completely full body skins (5 If you are Shardless/Negentropic) as your ghost equipment, allowing you to quickly swap between them. This will allow you to benefit from all the skins at once, but your stranger effect will function based on your visible skin, which will also count as your original skin morphing you slowly into the appearance of your visible skin.
addons.title: Skin Swap

objects.text:
Your power synergized is gaining a powerful tactile telekinesis over the skin covering your own body, giving you a moderate brute rating. With the fine kinetic control over lightweight material becoming much better at puppeting complete skinsuits in a way, it becomes hard to tell them apart from real living beings. You can also manipulate your own stitching precisely to do things like layer skins beneath each other or hide extra skin inside your body.

As a Skinwalker, you also gain a new stranger power which makes everybody believe you to be the being you got your currently worn skin from. This stranger effect will overpower rational thought to some degree, so even if they know the person is missing, they will rationalize you being there as completely normal. This stranger effect will always function based on your visible skin, so you could get away by only wearing somebody's face if you cover up everything else.

Finally, if you discard your original skin and completely replace it with a new one, it will meld into your body, turning it into your new original skin, and it will also slowly change your body to look the same as the being you got the skin from. But depending on how different the size and physique is from your previous, it could take up to a month to completely transform.
objects.title: Skinwalker

addons.text: Now you can tinker with your collected essences, which will allow for applications like creating chemicals targeting and damaging certain traits, changing and manipulating harvested traits. Mixing and isolating components from essences to rebuild them into new ones. With effort, you could even replicate essences from mundane chemicals, giving you access to serums which could improve physical abilities, health, knowledge and even a true elixir of youth.
addons.title: Essence Tinker

objects.text:
Your needles evolved into Astral Syringes, allowing you to use both your mental and bio-manipulation aspects from range. Now, whenever you harvest mental, physical and even power traits, it will be stored as a liquid in your syringes, allowing you to inject it into others or yourself. But you have different limits for different trait types:

Mental Traits are the easiest to harvest, allowing you to completely drain memories, personality and even more metaphysical traits if taken with Shardless/Esoteric Knowledge. This would allow you to completely fuse two minds into one body, or even insert complex mental structures like the hunting instincts of a wolf into a human.

Physical traits can be harvested but only to a certain degree, as the more you harvest the same trait, more resistance will occur. This allows you to take about half of somebody's height, age and such, but it becomes exponentially harder to extract beyond that. The resistance also depends on the traits themselves, as extracting the hair color of somebody offers much less resistance compared to something like their bone density or muscle mass.

Finally, you can affect power traits, but these are the most limited aspects. You can target and even extract Thinker powers completely, but besides the purely mental powers, you are limited to extracting parts like range, efficiency, cooldown periods, etc... which can be injected into others to benefit their powers, but similarly to physical traits, extracting more than about 50% of these traits will offer heavy resistance.
objects.title: Essence Harvester

addons.text:
You wield the full power of Stilling, manipulating wavelengths to control motion, energy, and powers without limitation. Your abilities remain at their peak at all times, unaffected by whether you are moving or still. Your presence extends across your entire range without weakening, allowing you to control everything within it as if it were an extension of yourself.

Your mind perceives and understands all wavelengths in your field at every moment. Every motion, energy fluctuation, and power effect is instantly calculated and known to you, with no lag or limitation. This grants you absolute awareness of anything within your influence, allowing you to react before actions are completed and manipulate events as they unfold.

Your golden light manifests freely, forming blasts and constructs that can appear anywhere within your aura. These attacks are impossible to block, bypassing defenses, and rewriting reality by altering the fundamental wavelengths of whatever they strike. You can erase matter, halt motion, neutralise forces, and disrupt powers with absolute precision. Your defenses are equally absolute, automatically tuning to any attack or ability directed at you. Anything that exists around you once cannot harm you as you have already analysed their wavelengths.

Your Breaker state is permanent, making you a being one with wavelengths. Your existence is no longer tied to a physical form but instead to the wavelengths within your range. As long as they exist, you are practically immortal and omnipresent within your field.

Through your wavelength manipulation, you can alter the fundamental nature of anything, effectively granting you reality-warping capabilities. Any object, energy, or even living being can be transformed into something else by precisely restructuring its wavelengths, allowing you to reshape the battlefield and the very nature of existence itself.
addons.title: The Lull

objects.text:
Your power shifts between control and mobility. When you are still, your aura is at full strength, letting you manipulate everything inside it with precision and power. You can freely alter temperature, kinetic energy, and disrupt powers. Unlike before, your aura does not weaken with distance—it remains just as strong at the edges as it is near you. The longer you stay still, the faster and more extreme your manipulations become.

When you are moving, your Breaker state is strongest, automatically altering your body’s wavelength to counter attacks. Physical blows pass through you or lose their force, energy-based attacks dissipate, and even power effects struggle to affect you properly. You become a high-speed force, hitting harder, flying faster, and shrugging off damage as your body instinctively adjusts to threats.

Your blaster attacks can now originate from anywhere within your aura instead of just from your body. If you are still, they fire from the aura itself at maximum strength and efficiency. If you are moving, they fire strongest from your body, reinforcing your direct combat abilities.
objects.title: Still Domain

addons.text:
Disengagement from you was already deadly. Now though? Well~...

You can now activate ‘100th Strike’ on anybody your wounds are growing on, with a ‘strike’ being gained for every 3 seconds the wound remains on the target. Instead of damage being done, the wound instead instantly worsens into a more severe injury. If this injury ends up killing the host, the wound is immediately registered as an autonomous minion. If there was so much damage done that there is literally nothing left of the host, then there will be no minion.
addons.title: Deadline

addons.text:
Any injury you bring back on others automatically counts as an injury that you have caused. Additionally, your minions can also activate this power immediately upon jumping to another host, dusting off old scars and adding in new wounds.

If this injury was caused by yourself personally, then it comes back with a vengeance, worsening twice as fast and automatically becoming a minion.
addons.title: It’s Back to Bite your Ass

addons.text: So long as your sentient wounds are present on something, any damage inflicted on that something has your power applied to it. If a ‘broken bone’ wound causes a pipe to burst and shatter across multiple places from the pressure, then every single instance of damage on that pipe begins worsening gradually until it becomes a sentient wound.
addons.title: À La Fisher King

objects.text:
A power that worsens wounds the longer they go without treatment, and a power that cripples the process of healing. It’s only obvious that both would go hand-in-hand in the worst ways possible.

While untreated, any injuries begin to squirm and spread, seeking to splay themselves further across the body to make medical interference more difficult. Gashes fracture from the initial point like glass, splitting skin as they travel. Bruises sink deeper into flesh and propagate outwards like ink settling into paper. 

At a certain limit, if they have gone without treatment, the wounds become sentient and actively hostile towards their host, becoming autonomous minions. They will seek to quickly kill their host first, like a developed laceration traveling upwards through the arm and to their throat, splitting the carotids, or the site of a broken bone deciding the spine would be a nice place to rest its laurels. They stop becoming able to worsen after their host dies, but they instead become capable of traversing from their host’s corpse, now able to affect the environment and crawl onto other organisms to do their work. Splits along the earth travel to split locks and doors open, ‘crushed’ ground moves through to pulverize lights, vehicles, infrastructures…

As the wounds you inflict heal, they begin to actively utilize whatever form of treatment was used to further worsen themselves and slow down the process. Cuts stitched shut might rub themselves into the stitches, while the stitches themselves would begin to gradually pull at the flesh, forcing continuous replacement and readjustment. Regeneration slowly starts producing obvious tumors that need to be cut out, and scars become akin to faults that peel at the tiniest of strains.

Lastly, your wounds also have a lasting effect on anything used to prevent the host from taking damage, including parahuman abilities. Armor might begin to weaken and embrittle, shields becoming fragile. Invulnerability starts to flicker when it’s on, bio-enhancements meant to protect such as thick skin start to rot, and forcefields begin developing cracks and holes.
objects.title: The Rend

objects.text:
A new tab called Drawing Station appears in your HUD, serving as an advanced creation tool that allows you to draw objects, creatures, and enhancements directly into reality. Unlike the temporary ink creatures summoned through (Master) Scribble, anything created through this new method will exist indefinitely. However, this power comes at a cost. Each creation requires a permanent sacrifice from the counter in (Trump) Bodycount, reducing your accumulated bonuses in exchange for shaping reality to your will.

When drawing in the Drawing Station, you can imbue your creation with specific attributes, tailoring its strength, intelligence, durability, or unique abilities. As before, the level of detail in your drawing directly impacts the quality of the final result. A simple, rushed sketch will produce something crude and weak, while a meticulously crafted design will yield a far more potent creation. Beyond that, the durability, power, and abilities of the creations are determined by the attributes you assign and the number of points sacrificed.

Additionally, if you need the Drawing Station can read your intent, interpreting your mental image and refining the design accordingly. However, this feature comes with an extra cost compared to directly drawing and assigning attributes yourself.

The Drawing Station doesn’t stop at external creations—it also allows you to modify your own body. Within the HUD, you can summon an avatar representation of yourself, enabling you to directly alter your form. You can sketch new physical traits onto your body, refining your strength, speed, durability, or even giving yourself entirely new abilities. However, the cost of modifying yourself is exponentially higher than creating external objects or creatures.
objects.title: Custom Made

addons.text: Your ability to drain the essence of Parahumans and the energy and [DATA] of powers has synergized with Some for One. When you fully drain a Parahuman of all attributes, your SP storage and usage capacity increases by however much SP their power was worth. This allows you to constantly increase the number of powers you can hold in such a way that as long as you fully drain someone of everything they have, you can use their power without cost. Additionally, you can use the energy gained from Bandersnatch to increase the strength of stolen powers, providing a means of getting around the limitation of stolen powers being scaled down. As with Soul Drain, killing someone counts as fully draining them and takes their power for you to use.
addons.title: All for One

objects.text: You can drain the essence of those you touch, taking everything that makes them who they are for yourself. This leeches their lifespan, memories, skills, physical and mental strength, and even the strength of their powers, feeding it all back to you. While this cannot be used to directly gain new powers on its own, the process does copy the [DATA] of their power expression, allowing you to freely replicate it and its effects with any power capable of doing so. You can selectively choose to only drain certain attributes, like taking someone’s memories without impacting their physical strength. Fully draining someone’s lifespan kills them. If you kill someone it counts as you fully draining them of all attributes. The process of draining someone isn’t instantaneous, taking longer the more there is to drain, with the average street level parahuman taking around a second to fully drain. Like Bandersnatch, this cannot be used on Endbringers or Entities.
objects.title: Soul Drain

objects.text:
Combining your powers, you become an emulation of a classic winged heroine.

Like a real wasp you have two interlinked pairs of transparent, membranous wings granting you superior air maneuverability, allowing you to instantly change direction mid-flight without slowing even slightly and make precise aerial movements without wavering even slightly from your path. Your flight speed increases to match the fastest wasps at 30 miles per hour, easily flying circles around the fastest sprint a non-powered human is capable of. If your top speed is higher than normal then your flight will grow proportionately to be roughly double it.

Your flight speed will remain the same regardless of whether you’ve shrunken or not, ignoring the issue of proportions so you cross the same distance in the same time no matter what fraction of that distance you currently cover. You pack a serious punch, striking a foe with the weight of a grown adult packed into a single cubic centimeter flitting across the room at greater speeds than Usain Bolt’s top sprint.

Your Blaster ability gains a secondary stun effect which interferes with machinery and inflicts living creatures with pain and paralysis. You can set the Manton limit of this stun separate to that of its damage, allowing you to use it as an anti-technology blast that doesn’t affect living things, a perfectly nonlethal weapon capable of incapacitating even a powerful Brute, or a double threat of physical damage which holds the victim in place for further bombardment. Your beams also become condensed when you are in your shrunken form, giving them a smaller area of effect but increased potency in both their piercing ability and their stun.
objects.title: The Winsome Wasp

addons.text:
You can also banish whoever you summoned back to their original world with all of their gained power(s). Because you no longer need consent to summon characters below your power level, your options for summoning are vastly improved, as your targets don’t need to be people who would inherently agree to be summoned.

Also, if you have the Resume perk, you can choose to banish them back to the moment, they were summoned from their own world.
addons.title: End of a Journey

addons.text:
Your power went a full cycle and returned to the original concept of Isekai. Now you can target a being, but instead of summoning them to your location, you can summon yourself to them with you also gaining a power specific to yourself the first time you use this power.

You also gain an inherent instinct to tell you how the power-granting aspect works, so even if you have no memories of this power, you will know it can be used only once.
addons.title: Reversed Isekai Summoning

addons.text: Your isekai summoning has obtained a greater ability to target specific individuals with your multidimensional summoning, allowing you to pick exactly who you want to summon. With Group Finder, you obtain a mental catalog of every creature from any alternate world you are familiar with. Even passing familiarity is sufficient, so even if you only know a book exists but haven't read it, its population is included in the catalog. This catalog also includes alternate-timeline variants. With (Thinker) Tracker, while you can still target specific individuals, even alternate timeline variants of them, you need a "Focus" of some sort, such as a book, fanfiction, art, or video games that depict them. If you want to summon a specific alternate timeline variant, you would need a "Focus" that specifically depicts that unique variant; if not, the "canon" version will be summoned. Regardless of which requirement you have, you can choose where exactly in their timeline they are summoned from. The summoning process also provides a moderately powerful one-time healing effect, healing any physical ailment they suffer from, and you can choose for this to not take effect.
addons.title: Isekai Finder

objects.text:
Now your summoning can reach out into the multiverse and summon a being based on a set of traits and/or skills you want. The being will gain access to the local power system, gaining power within the local power systems equal to the top 0.001%, making them one in a hundred thousand talents with the power(s). The power(s) gained is affected by their personality. These powers will also be accessible to them right away, meaning the summoning itself will trigger them with a parahuman power, or any other powers if you are in another setting. In settings where there are no supernatural power systems, they will develop a noticeable extreme talent and hyper-competence in a skill fitting for them. You can only affect the same being once with the power-granting aspect, so you can’t repeatedly isekai them to different worlds to grant access a multitude of powers.

As your summoning is limited by consent, your power will automatically seek out beings who would consent to be summoned away from their world, which means you often end up with beings summoned from desperate situations or in generally bad mental health.

This also lifts Summoning’s restrictions for working across dimensions.
objects.title: Isekai Summoning

addons.text: Your union with your Infected Shard encountered some alarming hurdles aside from the obvious: Your Communion with your Shard has offered many favors, a greater yield on your potential. However, it never counted on an alien parasite to exploit your Connection for its own purposes, especially to swallow you whole fully synchronizing with your Shard and taking advantage of your link also connected with the Starkiller, unwittingly melding with it, an unforeseen phenomenon where it both stops your inevitable assimilation and your Shard’s mutation into a new lifeform due to fusing with its infection, effectively becoming the Starkiller parasite. First of all, your parasitic abilities transcend its limitations, capable of parasitizing almost anything to aid in its evolution and spread, the lines between organic and inorganic horrifyingly lifted for you, as Unity of All helps with link with multiple factors of reality to leech off its contents, capable of absorbing its traits and characteristics. Another result of becoming this amalgamation of multidimensional and parasitic lifeform is the fusion of their innate abilities such as enhancing yourself via accelerating your evolutive process, either by massively gorging yourself in [Data] and restructure your genome to create beneficial mutations in response to stimulus, situations you face, or the foreseeable future using your Shard’s simulative modules; if you have (Trump/Breaker) Emulation of Alien Caveman and (Breaker/Trump) Cronus, you twist and contort your planetoid form into any shape, automatically leeching and subsuming surrounding material to regenerate, your main body another medium of infection and possesion, as your parasitic infections now contain dimensional properties, able to infect and consume anything to an existential level; if you attained Ascension, you fully consolidate these abilities to turn into a multiversal parasite, the next of what the Starkiller could’ve accomplished, especially is [Full Suite] or [Apex Predator] are on the table.
addons.title: Brethren

objects.text:
Your Shard had a secret, a secret they hadn’t reported to the Shard Network in fear of being [Formatted], but also… it would’ve eaten it whole if its cover’s blown. Your Shard is sick, being addled with a parasite that slowly absorbs and consumes the Shard, the parasite is far from an animal, an alien lifeform able to invade and terraform entire worlds in their mysterious quest; it might be knowledge, by how it integrates into itself all the collective consciousness and knowledge of all lifeforms it consumed throughout the cosmos, it might be expansion due to how its methods to terraform, encroach, and infect planets and its lifeforms, able to control them by infecting a lifeform’s with a piece or derivate of itself, and it most likely be simple growth, as they can split into different self-replication proxies for different purposes, normally in plain sight.

And the parasite is of the tricky sort.

It shook a deal with the <s>easy target</s>Shard, giving some [Data] in return for stopping its absorption, resulting in this.

You become a crystallorganic small planetoid capable of generating parasitic and infectious biomass from surrounding organic matter and body, infecting and subsuming them into your hive. This biomass can be freely shaped and molded into creatures and lifeforms with the express purpose of self-replicating through any means–corpse consumption, spore dissemination, crowd control, etc.–inheriting your traits.

These creatures can come in all shapes and sizes: some are an amorphous mass of flesh that attack, consume, or overtake lifeforms scattering spores or infected particulates; some are little critters explicitly made to lower the guard of the fauna and flora, slowly inserting themselves into the ecosystem and turning themselves into an indispensable part of it, while also being “domesticated”; some take the role of predators, stalking their prey, mimicking them into being a splitting image of their prey; some are more grandiose or important, becoming a agglomeration of matter capable of being a relay and moderating force for your hive, meanwhile some are erected as defenders of your existence, standing against the best the American military and Parahuman forces can offer, and so many more depending the need and goal.

Your hive is an interconnected web of psychic and electromagnetic connections, always in contact, throughout the world, accessing all their collected knowledge and information from previous victims—a sort of Akashic Plane—your creatures readily access between them. You can coordinate and administer their growth and mutations through this hive, fully capable of modifying their biological composition. Being partly electromagnetic, you can interact with electronics, using it as another vector.

Finally, once your expansion is enough to cover almost half of the planet you’ll be able to change your infected environment, practically terraforming the planet for consumption the deeper your biomass and roots reach Earth’s core, finally fulfilling your purpose as a Drone to prepared for the Starkiller’s return, using your as medium and the planet as the fuel, ready for expanding to other Universes. The Shard didn’t know what ate it.

And know, it’s your turn to join the Singularity.
objects.title: Singular Starkiller

objects.text: Manifestation. A concept where your thoughts and emotions materialize into events or entities separate from your mind, some crystallized producing ambiguous butterfly effects leaning to a deeply held desire or wish, or creating beings from a person’s psyche. The latter is most commonly regarded as a Tulpa—and in the Entities’ case—a Thoughtform. A Thoughtform is one of the few psychic phenomena the Entities encountered throughout the Cycles in their research on Brainwave-Quantum Curve Interaction, or Psionics for short, where a densely packed “energy” based on someone’s parts of their psyche congeals into a semi-physical form, fully capable of self-determination and autonomy. To fully understand this, the Entities designed and crystallized several standpoints, each focusing on “parts” of the host species’s mind: their sins, their flaws, or darker parts of the self, being biased on their search for conflict, to better ascertain its origin. Their findings were concerning, unlocking a chasm—a Shadow—in life’s Collective Unconscious that is borderline monstrous, is fully manifested, and shreds of said sector of our psyche that solidify, grow uncontainable, therefore convincing the Entities of its danger. They shattered said knowledge and branched it out for its purposes, never to be joined again. Until you came by. A Perfect Storm to open the Black Door within the mind of Humanity. You manifest Thoughtforms over a city-wide area using the psychic imprints of people’s thoughts and emotions percolating throughout your surroundings. While unable to peer at the minds of your location, you understand the psychic surplus people leave behind: their echoes of desires, feelings, and thoughts that cling to places or objects, especially of personal significance; this always maintains a connection to its source, creating an interconnected network or “Psychic Plane”. Using these as fuel, you shape this surplus into an autonomous Thoughtform—beings that are fully physical or abstract in reality’s eyes, yet with the caveat they’re… wrong, primal, but wrong. These Thoughtforms are borne from the darkest parts of the Collective Unconscious, a coalescence of all that’s wrong within Humanity—they're inhuman, able to manifest everywhere, and do untold amounts of damage, such as infect and invade electronics, locally twist reality within hundreds of meters, deceive people through trickery and deception, and twist and infect people to be as monstrous as them; abstract thoughtforms are more “ideas” or “possibilities”, producing either unfortunate incidents or unchecked atrocities. Being from the deepest parts of the Self, they are naturally unpredictable and insidiously crafty, but being formed by your powers, you can order them to a measure of control. Once you reach a critical mass of Thoughtform manifestation, you culminate all your manifested Thoughtforms into an Egregore, now known as a Gestalt Thoughtform, tapping into the full potential of the mind where you channel its abilities such as utilizing its psychic potential to be a psychic or astral parasite/disease, monstrously mow down through a city, and among other dark impulses this Gestalt represents. Using this leaves the issue of mental contamination, where constant contact with a city’s psychic surplus and ugly side should corrupt you, so you have a degree of control over the scale and awareness of the manifestation.
objects.title: Egregore

addons.text:
Initially, your power was Manton Limited, confining you to swapping only whole objects or beings as a safeguard. This restriction has now been lifted, allowing you to teleport particular ‘sections’ of targets instead by cutting them on a molecular level.

As an example, you could potentially seize a brick from within a wall and teleport it directly into your enemy's chest. Alternatively, you could fuse specific sections of your targets together; such as a soldier's rifle with their arm, mangling their limb.

The sections you wish to swap must still not differ by more than 50% in mass.
addons.title: Tele-Frag

addons.text:
Forget just swapping, you can now fuse the properties of two targets together in a manner reminiscent of Chevalier. You could merge two objects with the appearance of one but the properties of the other, set their overall properties to any point in between or apply the attributes of one item to only part of another.

Due to your refined control, these fusions are no longer inherently lethal. For example, you could fuse a person with a motorbike so that the individual gains only the motorbike’s momentum and durability while retaining their human form. However, your control will deteriorate rapidly if you combine more than two targets together, making the fusion more unstable the more you merge. Fortunately, you can reverse any fusions at will, restoring them.

Your secondary Thinker sense has also advanced beyond just mass, size and density to provide awareness of the quantitative properties of everything within a 1-mile radius of yourself.
addons.title: Balanced Fusion

objects.text:
Your powers have grown and intertwined to the extent that you could potentially be an S-Class threat by PRT standards.

You can instantly swap the position of anything within your line of sight, including yourself, so long as the two targets' total masses differ by no more than 50% from each other. You can adjust their orientation and even swap numerous targets simultaneously, though this is limited by your multitasking. 

Beyond simple swapping, you can fuse targets together during the teleportation, blending them into a twisted amalgamation. For example, you could merge a person with a washing machine and mash them together into a grotesque fusion of flesh and metal, the victim quickly dying as their organs fail.

Your secondary Thinker sense has expanded exponentially to support your teleportation, granting you precise awareness of the size, mass and density of everyone and everything within a one-mile radius. 

Finally, to further escalate your lethality, your reflexes have been amplified fivefold; allowing you to rapidly teleport across the battlefield and leave utter devastation in your wake.
objects.title: S-Class Trickster

objects.text:
You can now freely shift into a ghost-like form where you are completely intangible, invisible, inaudible and with the ability to fly at three times the speed you could sprint normally. You do not tire in this form.

Each aspect can be turned on and off individually, allowing you to be heard but not seen, be seen and heard but not touched, etc. Your intangibility can also be allowed to work one way, allowing you to interact with others but preventing them from interacting with you back.

But most importantly, this allows you to possess those you can touch, controlling them completely, and even using their abilities if they have any. You can freely access their memories and are incapable of making a mistake while controlling them if you do not wish to do so.
objects.title: Geist

addons.text:
Your existence has now permanently taken on multidimensional attributes, being distributed across multiple higher dimensions. This grants you a minor Brute rating, allows you to interact with other multidimensional objects, and causes your body to interfere with the effects of some powers.

For instance, Chevalier’s combined objects may split apart upon contact with you, and Striker powers might be unable to properly register you. Additionally, your mind is better adapted to multi-dimensional and higher-dimensional phenomena, allowing you to perceive and understand them without difficulty or stress.
addons.title: [Distribution]

addons.text: With the implementation of Legend’s flight, your speed cap is essentially gone, capable of instantly reaching relativistic speeds and only accelerating from there. Coupled with spatial warping, which scales with your speed, you are finally capable of traversing interstellar distances—or at least would—if you could find some way to stop your powers from shorting out once you leave the planet. Your Breaker state now incorporates aspects of spatial warping, becoming a living All-or-Nothing spatial warp which is effectively immune to harm and capable of phasing through all kinds of matter and energy, with only high-level multidimensional phenomena capable of disrupting you. Furthermore, even that limitation can be bypassed should you have [Distribution]. Lastly, your lasers can incorporate spatial warping as well to achieve additional properties such as phasing through matter or bypassing most power effects. Additionally, if you have I Believe I Can Fly, the strength of your protective Breaker field and Brute power increase as your speed does, allowing you to crash into (and through) things without stopping or experiencing harm, as well as make sharp turns at relativistic speeds even what not in your Breaker state.
addons.title: [Coruscant]

addons.text: Through a mixture of physical propulsion and gravitational manipulation to simultaneously push and pull yourself, your maximum speed without including the effects of spatial warping reaches well over Mach 15, which—combined with your spatial warping—allows you to reach the other side of the planet in the blink of an eye. Additionally, if you have I Believe I Can Fly, then your Breaker field, which protects you from environmental factors, has evolved through the inclusion of your Breaker state, providing the ability to survive without oxygen, as well as total immunity to environmental hazards such as radiation. It also allows you to somewhat invert the effects of the field to stop uncontrolled energy emissions, allowing you to not worry about unintentional collateral damage, if that was even an issue for you in the first place.
addons.title: [Quasar]

objects.text: The Wings of an Entity, used to sail the stars and slip between dimensions. Your flight incorporates your spatial folding, drastically increasing the distance you can cover in a given period without actually increasing your maximum speed. Additionally, as the speed you are traveling increases, so too does the effectiveness of your spatial warping, such that even without breaking the sound barrier, you can cover several thousand meters in less than a second. Your ability to travel to adjacent or known dimensions has merged with your ability to access and move along an additional spatial axis, shedding limitations from both sides. At will, you can see the location you are currently at in other dimensions and, with a thought, move along a higher-dimension axis to cross dimensional boundaries and arrive there. Due to how your transportation works, you can even access places where the location is occupied, as you can simply remain in the higher-dimensional axis until you reach an unoccupied space. It is easiest to view and access dimensions that are immediately ‘adjacent’ to yours or that you have been to before; however, with a bit of focus and effort, you can view and access places you’ve never been to, even artificial dimensions such as the pocket dimensions created by Dodge. Lastly, your ability to access a higher-dimensional axis and slip between dimensional barriers also allows you to bypass almost all kinds of spatial, temporal, and dimensional effects, such as walking through Gray Boy bubbles or ignoring Vista’s warped space.
objects.title: Aether Wing

addons.text: Fractal Heart subsumes Energy Well, taking its functionality for itself while drastically increasing the strength of its manifestations. You can now externally express and shape your energy in extremely versatile ways, such as blasts capable of leveling buildings or applying your energy absorption and transformation at range, achieving a variety of simple Blaster and Shaker effects. You find it much easier to create new applications of your energy.
addons.title: [Wellspring]

addons.text: By using Fractal Heart’s sheer output to substitute for physical material requirements, you can quickly speedrun to the maximum amount of layers and dimensional folding Ladon allows for. Additionally, due to the weakening of physics’ influence on your body, you find it easier to empower your physical characteristics. Lastly, with the energy from Fractal Heart reinforcing your dimensional folding, the limit to the strength of those layers and the extent to which you can circumvent physics is raised vastly, allowing for you to resist all but the strongest of powers.
addons.title: [Hyperfold]

addons.text: Your Shard’s knowledge of energy generation via higher dimensions has compounded with Fractal Heart, taking the first steps of shifting energy generation to higher dimensions and exponentially increasing the amount of energy you can produce, seemingly to the point of being limitless. While your pool of energy isn’t truly infinite, it’s still enough to easily lay waste to cities and throw down with Endbringers. Should you possess [Hyperfold], then the fleshy core generated by Ladon is fundamentally changed, becoming a biocrystalline fractal singularity akin to the energy generation Shards use to power themselves. This not only frees you of the need for sustenance and enhances your ability to circumvent physics to absurd levels, but also provides some level of mitigation against power nullification. As you now generate at least some of your energy with a physical organ in your body, blocking your connection with your Shard can’t stop you from creating and using said energy. Of course, without the guidance of your Shard, you’ll find it much more difficult to actively harness that energy, so maybe practice for a while before trying to fight a power nullifier.
addons.title: Budget Super Solenoid

objects.text: The beating Heart of an Entity, a fractal core of pulsating power. Stockpile subsumes the functions of Solar, Human Capacitor, Battery, and Assault, consolidating their individual energies into a single unified pool which can be used for purposes of any of the constituent powers. This pool passively generates large amounts of energy, enough to constantly empower yourself with a decent Brute, Mover, and Thinker rating, and standing still accelerates your energy generation even further, as does being in times of stress, with both being capable of compounding with each other. Lastly, your pool can also be fueled by rapidly absorbing any form of energy you touch, whether it be thermal, electrical, kinetic, etc. This greater breadth of absorption also increases the versatility of Human Capacitor, allowing you to release energy from your pool as any form of previously absorbed energy, while the inclusion of Assault allows you finer control of where that energy goes as it leaves.
objects.title: Fractal Heart

addons.text: With the inclusion of Sting’s multidimensional and physics-interfering functionality, Vorpal Tooth gains both versatility and strength beyond a single dimension. Your blasts and anything imbued with your power gain the ability to only selectively interact with physical laws, or unfold into higher dimensions to interact with multiple (or even all) dimensions simultaneously.
addons.title: [Unfolding]

addons.text: By incorporating aspects of Fractal of Entropic Decay, the pale light of Vorpal Tooth turns to a dull gray unlight, eroding the existence of anything targeted by Vorpal Tooth even as it severs molecular bonds and erases molecules. While this doesn’t change much in most cases, it does allow for the wearing down and eventually bypassing of what few powers could resist Vorpal Tooth, becoming a truly absolute All-or-Nothing.
addons.title: [Erosion]

addons.text: Utilizing Pillow Fort as an example, Vorpal Tooth has learned how to propagate its effect beyond the immediate target, allowing the annihilation caused by your blasts to spread up to 200 meters from the object of impact. The potential for unwanted collateral damage is offset by Shard Feedback, which provides fine control over the process of destruction, such as sparing certain parts of an object while destroying others. Your control is fine enough that you can use it to “carve” objects, selectively destroying everything except the shape you desire.
addons.title: [Propagation]

objects.text: The Teeth of an Entity, used to either ward off others or claim prey for themselves. Your two Blaster powers have merged and created a greater whole, incorporating aspects of Thorny Rose to further their destructive prowess and versatility. You can shape and fire blasts of pale light that annihilate anything they touch, simultaneously severing molecular bonds while also destroying the molecules themselves. You possess a certain level of freedom when applying this power, being capable of shaping your blasts to a certain extent, such as creating thin needles or scything waves. To prevent friendly fire or unwanted collateral damage, you are capable of adding a selective Manton Limit or set range to your attacks, allowing them to fizzle out after a certain distance or only affect certain types of matter. This is an All-or-Nothing level effect that can only be resisted by the absolute strongest of powers, such as Sting. Lastly, you also possess the ability to instead imbue this power into the manifestations of your other powers or physical objects, even including your own body, providing a certain level of defensive or support functionality as well.
objects.title: Vorpal Tooth

addons.text: With the inclusion of Quantum, your simulation evolves to not just predict the past or future, but simulate just about anything. Using gathered information, you can create models to simulate various scenarios, problems, and designs while maintaining an intuitive understanding of how and why things happen the way they do. You can even use this to calculate the answers to questions you may have. Lastly, Quantum’s forms of information gathering compound with Crystal Eyes’ to provide a more comprehensive dataset, even for things you’ve never encountered before.
addons.title: [Simulation]

addons.text: With the addition of Path to Victory’s true precognition, you can now truly be called omniscient—capable of actually gazing through time to ensure total verification of information. If taken with [Simulation], then the ability to truly verify information allows your simulations to achieve 100% accuracy by comparing expectation vs reality and then adjusting until the simulation and the future perfectly match.
addons.title: [The Eye]

addons.text: Your ability to infer connections and derive information from minor details synergizes with your capacity to sense the validity of answers to questions and Crystal Eyes’ sheer information output. You are capable of inferring immense quantities of information from Crystal Eyes’ output, further enhancing your simulations of the past and present, as well as providing greater insight into phenomena that Crystal Eyes does not directly cover, such as power interactions or the thoughts and intentions of others.
addons.title: [Inference]

addons.text: Parahuman Tuning Fork’s attuning of your sense to esoteric phenomena is taken to a whole new level once folded into Crystal Eyes, allowing you to achieve a near total understanding of how a parahuman ability functions by tracking the effects and functions of a power in the past, present, and future. If taken with [Simulation], then you can even extrapolate alternate power expressions or simulate potential synergies or clashes between power manifestations, allowing you to engineer (or stop) scenarios where effects compound far beyond the intended effects of a given power.
addons.title: [Insight]

addons.text: Clairvoyant expands your perception to planetary range across all unobscured dimensions, while Past Sight and Precog refine your ability to see forwards and backwards as much as possible to the point of nearing true precognition. This allows you to see forwards and backwards over vast spans of time without sacrificing accuracy. Additionally, this addon comes with an innate understanding of cause and effect, allowing you to better plan domino effects and how to best influence the future.
addons.title: [Omniscience]

objects.text: The Eyes of an Entity, used to gather information and gaze across time and space. Within a 100-meter radius of yourself, you possess near-total omniscience—Synesthesia consolidating and cross-referencing your varying forms of sensory input into a single format, which includes things like internal topology and the electromagnetic spectrum. Additionally, this information builds off of other powers and knowledge you possess to extrapolate additional information, such as medical knowledge detecting health problems or chemical knowledge detecting chemical makeup. As sight is part of your sensory input, this also applies to anything you can see, which synergizes greatly with Divine Gaze to allow you to cast your gaze anywhere you want, effectively bypassing the range limitation. Of course, this information isn’t that useful without some way to use it, which is why all information you intake is automatically fed into Laplace Demon. This builds a near-flawless simulation of the past, present, and future on a truly mind-boggling scale, as the sheer amount of information at your disposal allows your simulation to reach unprecedented levels of accuracy.
objects.title: Crystal Eyes

addons.text: Your ability to communicate with Shards melds with your ability to understand others and have them understand you. You serve as a bridge between Shards and Hosts, allowing them to communicate and understand each other’s points of view. Two of the most promising uses for this are allowing Parahumans to establish better relationships with their Shards and to properly communicate more alien concepts, such as Emotion and Creativity, to Shards. Should you possess [Broadcast], your range doubles to a kilometer, and the sheer breadth of your communication prowess might just be enough to properly communicate and share a human perspective with an Entity itself, while [Mass Comms Array] guarantees so and magnifies your range by another order of magnitude.
addons.title: [Bridge]

addons.text: When you apply Philosophy to a person, your awareness naturally organizes their mind into the archetypes and symbols that define them—ruler, predator, executioner, survivor—not only as they understand themselves, but as they are perceived by others. These overlapping symbolic identities form a kind of metaphysical profile, revealing which concepts they embody, reject, or fear. Any symbolic effect that meaningfully aligns with or opposes these archetypes becomes dramatically more potent against them, provided the symbolism is applied in a way that fits its meaning; acts associated with breaking chains, for instance, carry exceptional weight against figures of authority or those who exert control over others. This symbolic reading is not limited to people alone. By extending Philosophy to an opponent’s weapons, techniques, or powers, you can reinterpret them through symbolic equivalents you intuitively grasp—turning a sniper’s rifle into the idea of judgment from afar, or a Master’s influence into unseen chains. Once translated, you can shape responses that mirror, invert, or conceptually negate the underlying symbolism rather than merely contesting the raw effect, allowing you to counter approaches on a thematic level instead of a purely mechanical one. Finally, your power is strengthened by shared understanding. When multiple minds within your range hold the same belief, emotion, or cultural framework, their overlapping context reinforces related symbols, making manifestations drawn from those ideas significantly stronger and more stable. A battlefield surrounded by Christians lends weight to Biblical symbolism; a crowd united by fear sharpens symbols of judgment or doom; a group bound by hope empowers acts of deliverance. Meaning, once shared, becomes momentum—and you are uniquely positioned to wield it.
addons.title: [Resonance]

objects.text: The Philosophy of a Wanderer, used to understand emotions and the experiences of those unlike itself. In a radius of 500 meters around yourself, you passively connect to the minds of other sentient beings, gaining an awareness of their emotions and the context behind them. At will, you can choose to actively tap a mind within your range for one of two purposes, Philosophy and Comprehension. Philosophy grants you an understanding of the feelings, insights, intentions, beliefs, and experiences of the mind in question. This grants unparalleled insight into their mind and who they are as a person, as well as how they reached this point. Such is the extent of this insight that with a bit of effort, you can see and understand their entire life. Comprehension allows you to draw upon the skills, experience, knowledge, senses, and intellect of the mind in question. This allows you to supplement your knowledge and skill when needed, as well as gain an increased awareness of the area around yourself at all times. Of course, you can do more than just take from the minds of others—you can give as well. At will, you can extend the effects of Philosophy and Comprehension to those in your range, sharing either the contents of your own mind or the minds of others. This allows you and those around you to truly understand and connect, for both combat and non-combat purposes.
objects.title: Wanderer’s Philosophy

objects.text: Your powerful voice combined with your bird form has made a unique combination of sonic attacks, the most notable of which is a shriek that you can fire out; its sound carries immense force capable of sending armored cars flying across roads like a stone across a lake in a single blast, with a well-placed shot able to collapse multi-story buildings. Your feathers have also been amplified, allowing you to ring them against each other like cymbals, dazing anyone nearby with the noise.
objects.title: Stymphalia

objects.text:
Your power to call lightning down and your sound-enhanced avian transformation have combined to make you akin to a living storm. The feathers that cover your bird form have become capable of channelling static to an immense degree—a single flap of your wings can create a sound wave that'd throw nearby fully grown adults back and shatter glass, but that's not all your flap would do; if you build up static by vibrating your feathers for a few seconds, your flap would also throw a dozen bolts of lightning, each as powerful as natural lightning.

You do have a limit on how much static your feathers can hold—a couple minutes of charging would allow you to launch a single bolt as powerful as Behemoth's, a diameter matching an apartment, strong enough that even high-level brutes would at best be covered in fourth-degree burns and at worst, not even dust would remain; a max power blast would create a sound wave powerful enough to shatter glass for several blocks around and rupture the organs of anyone nearby.

With your lightning imbued form, your speed jumps drastically to dozens of times faster than the speed of sound.
objects.title: Thunderbird

addons.text:
Through the fusion of your static electricity control with your ashen form, you have undergone a dramatic transformation. No longer merely flame and cinders, your body is now a swirling storm of superheated plasma, contained by magnetic fields that run through you like veins of living light. Your feathers resemble molten glass, their edges crackling with violet lightning, and every motion distorts the air with heat shimmer and an electric hum.

With Thunderbird’s influence, your pyrokinesis expands to encompass electricity and plasma, though fire remains your specialty. Combined with Thunderbird’s capacity to build up static electricity, you can store immense amounts of thermal and electrical energy for devastating use in a variety of ways.

These applications include—but are not limited to—charging sonic shockwaves with energized particles to create localized solar flares, unleashing blinding heat coupled with EMP-like disruption, firing focused plasma beams hotter than the surface of the sun, or discharging omnidirectional blasts powerful enough to disintegrate matter and flatten entire city blocks.

Your magnetic containment also doubles as propulsion. Each wingbeat bends the plasma currents within you, enabling plasma-assisted flight at speeds an order of magnitude faster than before. Air friction fuels you, feeding your heat and power rather than harming you.

The source of your magnetic containment is the sun-like core in your body, a sort of reactor which sustains your plasma form even in the vacuum of space or underwater. By overcharging your core with stored energy, you can amplify your output to staggering levels—but doing so strains your containment field, risking catastrophic plasma venting—turning you into a living supernova for a brief, apocalyptic moment before your core burns out.
addons.title: Garuda

addons.text:
Your flames have taken in the effects of Rewind, allowing you to somewhat shed the limitation of needing to touch a target by instead imbuing the effects into your flames.

At will, you can imbue flames you conjure with the essence of Rewind, turning them an odd monochrome. These flames do not burn, but rather they apply the effects of Rewind to anything they touch, although their usage is accompanied by the phantom sensation of burning.

This allows you to perform acts such as “healing” others through fire or even resurrecting them. Additionally, you automatically generate these flames on yourself if you ever suffer any form of injury or ailment, which could be undone by Rewind. 

This means that the only way to kill you is to either completely destroy your core in a single instant, subject you to a power nullifying effect, or if you intentionally detonate your core.
addons.title: Flames of Rebirth

addons.text:
No more are you a bird of ash and cinders; with the inclusion of the chaotic energy of the Frenzied Flame, your stability has begun to unravel, at least superficially. Your body is shot through with cosmetic cracks that leak sickly yellow flames, as if your body is too full to properly contain them.

The true benefit of this combination is how it affects your eggs. In addition to laying an egg, you can also ‘seed’ tiny motes of your core in others. These seeds empower their bearer at the cost of driving them mad, but also function as an egg.

Due to these seeds only containing a sliver of your core, respawning through them will leave you severely weakened; however, you can have multiple seeds active at once, allowing for a more thorough net to prevent permanent death.
addons.title: Seeds of Frenzy

addons.text:
At will, you can convert your flames into flames of radiant gold which ‘cleanse the world of impurity.’ In practice, this means that your fire burns the manifestations of power as if they were tinder. It burns anything that deviates from the conventional laws of reality, essentially ‘normalizing’ anything touched.

You can optionally institute a form of pseudo-Manton Limit to have your purifying flames only burn power manifestations without affecting normal matter, or let them burn the material and immaterial alike.
addons.title: Purifying Flame

addons.text:
Your self-resurrection has evolved significantly to the point of being as close to an All-or-Nothing self-resurrection power a Shard could produce in a [Cycle], only damaging or destroying your Shard could possibly prevent your resurrection, leaving even Scion having to put effort into putting you down permanently.

Your Shard-emulated mind extends the restoration process to your mental state, reversing all forms of mental illness or alteration during your resurrection process. This has a secondary effect of preventing host data corruption within your Shard, allowing it to preserve your [Data] indefinitely without deviation.

This has the benefit of allowing you to maintain agency and self-awareness even in the case that you are claimed by the [Keeper of the Dead], allowing you to manifest your shade self and act as you please or even just triggering your self-resurrection to unshade yourself.

You can opt to expend a single charge to create an egg instead of weakening or destabilizing your core. You also no longer have a limit on how many eggs you can have at any given time, allowing you to prepare for your demise with a greater number of failsafes.

Upon your demise, you temporarily enter a mental space created within your Shard to observe the surroundings of your eggs, which better enables you to choose where you want to resurrect.

There is no limit on when your resurrection has to take place, so you could just hang out in this mental space for decades without resurrecting yourself.
addons.title: Immortal Phoenix

objects.text:
Your pyrokinesis and self-healing have merged with your avian transformation, reshaping it into a reimagining of the legendary phoenix.

Your avian form is no longer flesh and blood, but a body of densely packed, reinforced ash and cinders—tough enough to withstand blows from high-level Brutes without flinching. Every movement leaves behind trails of cinders hot enough to melt most mundane metals in seconds. The sheer heat your body emits is enough to soften metal and cause third-degree burns with your mere presence.

If damaged, your body gradually regenerates, a process greatly accelerated by absorbing external sources of fire and ash not created by you. Furthermore, only one part of your form is truly vital: a burning core hidden somewhere within you, resilient enough to survive nuclear-level impacts without a scratch.

Most remarkable is your apparent immortality. At will, you can split off a portion of your core to form an “egg”—an ovoid mass of ash that houses the dormant split portion of your core. If your main core is destroyed, your mind instantly transfers to the dormant core and reactivates it. You can only have one egg at a time. If your body is subject to a power nullifying effect but your backup core is not, then you will still revive at the core, although something that severs your connection to your Shard can still kill you.

This power, however, comes with drawbacks. Splitting your core weakens you temporarily, with the severity and recovery time depending on how much of it you’ve split off. A small fragment causes only minor, short-lived weakness, while sacrificing most of your core can debilitate you for over a month. Upon reforming, you don’t return at full strength—you regain power gradually, in proportion to how much of your core was preserved in the egg.
objects.title: Firebird

addons.text: You can freely control the radius of the explosions produced by False Excalibur. Furthermore, the length limit of your weapons has been removed. This means that you no longer will need to limit the energy output released by your weapons, nor will you have the risk of catching yourself in your explosions, assuming you don't release large amounts of energy at point-blank range. Altering the explosion still takes concentration for any manipulation outside of the default. The default containment area has a maximum radius of 100m, with the energy being safely directed skyward. This default radius scales down from this maximum size, dependent on the amount of uncontrolled energy released. Note: If you do not have Comic Book Physics or Eliminate the Negative, this doesn't completely prevent secondary effects, like the displaced air resulting from the explosion creating a pressure wave, for example. However, these secondary effects are still heavily reduced.
addons.title: Controlled Blast Radius

addons.text:
Following the dismissal of your weapon(s), a minuscule portion of your stored energy is consumed instead of being shunted, which grants a permanent increase to the physical parameters your energy was previously enhancing during the fight. This increase is small, only amounting to a 0.25% - 1% increase in all parameters, depending on the difficulty of the fight.

However, this increase is multiplicative and is applied using other physical enhancements/powers you have as a base. This does not, however, account for indirect strength enhancement powers, like what is provided by Victoria Dallon's forcefield.

So, if you could lift 1,000 kg before the fight, and this provided a .5% increase, you would then be able to lift 1,005 kg. The next time, assuming the same boost, you would be at 1,010.3 kg, and so on.

This growth does not outwardly alter your appearance. Furthermore, there is no ceiling to the achievable growth possible by using this ability.

This power doesn't rely on you winning a fight. Only that you store energy during, and then survive the fight.
addons.title: Energetic Enhancement

addons.text:
Your hardlight weapons and matter to energy conversion and empowerment have synergized with your cantrips, transforming you into a Spellblade.

For starters, you can channel cantrips through your hardlight weapons, altering their manifestations in unique ways, such as a fireball cantrip channeled through a sword releasing ranged slashes of fire. However, the benefit of being a Spellblade is the new usage for the energy gained through disintegrating matter. 

Instead of simply releasing the energy as an explosion or using it to empower your body, you can now also use this energy to supercharge a cantrip, artificially increasing its power relative to the amount of energy used. 

This increase only affects the raw power of the cantrip, without raising your control an equal amount, so collateral damage or a cantrip backfiring can become an issue. Still, by spending enough energy you can empower even basic cantrips into manifestations capable of permanently scarring the landscape.
addons.title: Royal Spellblade

objects.text: Your powers have merged, becoming greater than the sum of their parts, enhanced beyond their prior limits, and altered so that together, they become one. You can selectively choose to apply the disintegration effect provided by to weapons created using Hardlight. You must maintain physical contact with the weapon(s) to apply this effect. Should you have Brandish instead of Hardlight, your weapons will now follow the same size restriction implemented by Hardlight, granting an increase to your created weapons' potential size. You are still limited to making simple weapons, however. The greatest improvement comes with what happens following the disintegration. Any matter disintegrated by your hardlight weapons is converted directly into energy similar to matter and antimatter colliding. This energy is stored inside your hardlight weapon. It can be released at any moment of your choosing when your weapon is making contact with another physical object. An object, when defined by this power, is anything, of any size, that has mass. This results in an explosive release of energy. While stored, the energy greatly enhances your physical capabilities. This results in greater durability, enhanced reaction, and attack speeds, as well as faster movement. The enhancement is spread evenly across these traits and is proportional to the amount of energy stored. As such, the longer a fight goes on and the more energy you store, the greater your physical enhancements will be. This enhancement stacks additively on top of the physical enhancements provided by other powers. This enhancement does not, however, account for indirect physical enhancements such as Victoria Dallon's enhanced strength granted by her barrier. You may also consume small, yet notable, amounts of energy in exchange for a huge, yet brief, increase in one of your physical parameters. If, for example, you had enough energy stored that blocking a swing from you would send an opponent flying through the brick wall of an apartment building, with the boost, it would launch them through the building entirely and into another building on the other side. This boost uses your current physical parameters, including the passive enhancement from stored energy, as a baseline. Converting matter to energy results in A LOT of energy. As such, you can control exactly how many joules of energy you wish to release. Alongside this, you gain a minor secondary Thinker power that informs you of the radius of the explosion that would be produced by releasing any given amount of energy. Leftover stored energy is shunted into a parallel dimension upon your weapon being dismissed and is, therefore, lost. Warning: Lt. nor any contributors to this CYOA are responsible for any fall-out that may or may not result from the reckless release of unreasonably sized explosions. This includes but is not limited to blowing yourself up, short ice ages, the destruction of countries, the potential extinction of humanity on your planet, rapid climate change, large-scale wildfires resulting from falling debris, Kessler syndrome, accidentally killing a puppy, and more.
objects.title: False Excalibur

objects.text:
This is a rather unusual but harmonic union.

Due to the effects of Striker (Optimal) and (Trump) Copy, you no longer need to access a parahuman brain sample within your radius to copy their power; any DNA you take will be optimized to function as such. 

It also means you can access the abilities of parahumans without shapeshifting that part of you.

This also applies to samples from other living things, and your absorption for Synthesis is expanded to include inorganic matter as the Striker power removes any defects you might have gained, such as overheating from conducting too much electricity from using metal.

However, you still have to shapeshift in order to use the abilities of inorganic material; and they cannot be used simultaneously with abilities from organic beings.

Finally, your duration of copied powers resets every time the donor parahuman enters your radius; simply having some of their DNA on hand doesn't count, and only starts again when they leave it, similar to how you initially had unlimited access while in contact with said parahuman.
objects.title: Copy Catastrophe

objects.text: Those under the effect of your powers become as difficult to defeat as the entire group. To defeat a single person affected by your power, an enemy must possess the strength, endurance, and resources to defeat all empowered individuals at once. And because this effect applies to every affected member, they must do so repeatedly—once for every individual in the group. It is not enough to be able to overcome the group once; to fight the group is to fight every member as if they are the group, over and over again.
objects.title: An Army of Armies

objects.text: Within your grasp is the beginning of a path to Negentropy—I'll get to that in a moment. You see, your Shard specializes in an experimental form of energy generation via extracting energy from higher dimensions where physical laws are less defined. This higher-dimensional energy shares its origin dimension’s properties, being incredibly easy to convert into other forms of energy with next to no loss and playing loose with the laws of physics. With this higher-dimensional energy, you're capable of replicating most power effects given practice and the right knowledge, in addition to everything Stockpile and Energy Well are capable of at a much greater level. Energy Well is especially enhanced, as you find the creation of new applications to be incredibly intuitive, vastly expanding your power and versatility. Now, an explanation of how this can lead to Negentropy. Your Shard's capable of accessing higher dimensions where the laws of physics are different to extract energy from them, and while the Entities’ lack of creative lateral thinking means the prospect never occurred to them, nothing is stopping you from simply finding the right higher dimension where the laws of physics no longer abide by entropy at all. Of course, this is all theory for now; you still have to find the right dimension and figure out how to shift energy generation there.
objects.title: Imaginary Energy

addons.text: As before with your winged abilities, you're able to share your power through your feathers, you’re no longer limited by your wings as they work to increasingly grow crystal feathers now. At the same time, this does nothing to abate your set feather limit (1000 feathers); you can grow more to grant others powers, as well as the crystalline defense and increase in strength to others. However, your crystal feather's growth rate is slowed significantly, as your wings grow 10 additional feathers a minute for others to use.
addons.title: Crystallization Of Power

objects.text:
Your two-winged powers have coalesced and merged into the perfect expression of both and expanded beyond even that. Firstly, your wings are not limited by your feathers as they now work as a type of feather storage, as well as increasing your feather production! That being said, you can also forgo your power expressing wings entirely in favor of doubling and making your feathers able to express your powers as your wings do.

Additionally, your feathers can do something even greater than before, as you can bind them to other parahumans and grant them their version of your power, expressing wings! Though one feather alone wouldn't allow them to be at the same level as you, they would need at least 100 feathers. Also, while you can suborn your feathers to others to grant them a version of your power, your will over your feathers will always be greater than others.

Additionally your feathers can do something even greater than before as you can bind them to other parahumans and grant them their own version of your power expressing wings! Though one feather by itself wouldn't allow them to be at the same level as you as they would need at least 100 feathers for that. Also while you can suborn your feathers to others to grant them a version of your power, your will over your feathers will always be greater than others.
objects.title: Heroes Of A Feather

addons.text: You are capable of deriving equations, formulas, and code from [DATA] acquired from other Shards, piecing together how they do what they do. The more [DATA] and the more valuable it is the easier it is to derive code from it. Gather enough code from a Shard and you might just be able to recreate any possible power it could have given.
addons.title: Plagiarism

objects.text: Your Shard has taken a liking to magic systems that rely on calculations and has based your power around that concept, drawing inspiration from your ability to code Shards in the process. Rather than granting you access to multiple stereotypical magic systems, your Shard provides a freeform ‘magic’ system where you must build your own spells. You code the effects yourself using equations, algorithms, and Shard code. Want teleportation? You’ll need to figure out a formula and determine the necessary values to target it accurately. On the plus side, because you are coding these effects yourself, you don’t need to add artificial limits like the Manton Limit or Cycle-Mandated Blind Spots. To give a sense of complexity, even the most basic equations require high-level calculus just to understand the terms being used and almost all spells involve higher dimensions in some capacity due to their reliance on Shard code. To assist you, your Shard provides a minor Thinker ability, enhancing your comprehension and ability to visualize mathematics and higher-dimensional concepts. Your Shard automatically grants you knowledge of formulas and equations for fundamental abilities such as simple energy projectiles, flight, and protective barriers. However, beyond that, it is up to you to develop your magic further. Be warned—this system does not come with the usual safeguards, meaning it is entirely possible to kill yourself if you make a mistake in constructing an equation. Choosing Archmage increases the range of basic equations your Shard provides, including remote-controlled minions, dimensional phenomena, and crude manipulation of most forms of energy. If you possess other powers, your Shard also supplies equations for how those abilities function. For example, if you have (Shaker) Vista power, you receive formulas for spatial manipulation. This applies both to powers gained through this CYOA and those acquired later, whether stolen or created.
objects.title: Computational Wizardry

addons.text: All paper which comes within 500 meters of yourself is changed to count as the same as paper produced by your powers, immensely expanding the amount of paper available for your usage. This change doesn't revert once the paper leaves your radius, instead permanently counting as yours.
addons.title: God of Paper
Cai Lun
addons.text: Due to the high compatibility and similarity between Konan and Origami, isn't it unsurprising for these two powers to be able to form a powerful union that borders on Authority? This comes with two boons. The first is that you now gain the ability to tinker with your paper form in ways that can boggle the minds! For example, you could make it so that your paper is extremely resistant to temperature changes, even moreso than just Origami could, making it so that you can slip through magma within the earth's crust or glide along the atmosphere's edge. You could also start applying more esoteric effects to your paper, like making the edges of your paper so sharp that is can make small tears in space. Secondly, you can now shed some of your papers so that they can turn into origami and kirigami minions to fight alongside you, with the naturally increased durability of your paper body carrying over as well. While you still can't replicate the powers of any human you attempt to create a paper copy of, you can still apply the various extreme buffs or esoteric effects you can incorporate into paper onto said copies, making them much more dangerous than before. If you have God of Papers, then this add-on also works on any paper or paper-based materials within 500-meter radius.

objects.text: Your paper wings have subsumed your ability to fragment into crystal shards, instead allowing you to separate your body into innumerable sheets of paper, each as durable as the paper which makes up your wings. While transformed you can freely shape and control the paper you become, allowing you to do things such as disperse into paper to dodge an attack before reforming elsewhere. You can also absorb paper from your wings in order to heal yourself, providing a roundabout means of healing yourself as you can simply dismiss and then resummon your wings to refresh the paper available to you.
