Additionally, your unlimited multitasking side steps Thousand Faces’ problem of mental copies deviating, as rather than each paper having its own copy of your mind you instead are an overmind of sorts existing simultaneously in all sheets of paper under your control. As a side effect this allows you to do things such as form multiple smaller bodies of paper for yourself to be present in multiple places at once. If you possess On Crystal Wings then the increase in durability, strength, speed, and sharpness applies to all sheets of paper under your control, allowing crumpled constructs to reach mind-boggling levels of power.
objects.title: Konan

objects.text:
You can imbue the items you enhance using special formula derived from your cantrips; for example: a hammer that freezes the things it hits from a cantrip that manipulates ice. To benefit from any passive enhancements, the item needs to be on your person.

You can also create items that can store cantrips; for every ten minutes you spend enhancing an item, it can permanently store one rank zero cantrip — which can be used an unlimited amount of times — one charge of a rank one cantrip or upgrade an existing charge by one rank — so a ninth rank charge takes 90 minutes to create. 

An item can store 9 distinct cantrips, regardless of the rank or number of charges. At most, an item can store 9 charges of rank 1 to 3 formula, 6 charges of rank 4 to 6 formula, and 3 charges of rank 7 to 9 formula. During your preparations, you can refill the charges of items by holding them at the cost of 2 minutes per cantrip, regardless of charges and rank. To cast the stored cantrips, you need to touch or hold the item.
objects.title: Discount Artificer

objects.text:
You can brew potions, creams, or ointments using commonly available natural materials using recipes derived from your cantrips; for example: a cream that grants night vision for an hour when applied to the eyelids, a potion that makes the drinker more agile or strong for a short period of time, or a flask that explodes into sparks of lightning when thrown.

Potions follow the same rank structure as cantrips. It takes five minutes per rank to brew an alchemical product — so a rank 9 potion will take 45 minutes. The complexity of steps and equipment required increase with the rank, a rank 0 potion can be brewed using common kitchen tools but a rank 9 potion will require specialized laboratory glassware like a condenser or distillation column.

Drinking more than one potion in the span of 60 seconds has harmful effects that range from benign — such as vomiting out the potion, to extreme — cardiac arrest or cytokine storm, depending on the rank of the potions. Mixing potions also creates dangerous results from highly corrosive acid to violent explosions.
objects.title: Discount Alchemist

addons.text: You gain the ability to use gems as mana batteries. Each battery gem can store 12 mana per rank and follows the same rules for upgrades as spell gems. There is no limit to the number of gems you can use as batteries, aside for the size of your pockets.
addons.title: Magik Batteries

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use precious gems and other crystals as amplifiers and repositories for cantrips. During your preparations, you can spend 10 minutes to attune with up to 6 gems, changed the prepared cantrips stored within a gem, or strengthen your connection with already attuned gems. 

When you attune with a gem for the first time, it gains one random cantrips at rank 1 that match the gem's affinity. This affinity depends on the type of gem, a ruby could be fire or blood, an amethyst could be lightning or gravity, and so on.

An attuned gem can be used as a focus to cast any of your prepared cantrips that match its affinity at a higher power as well as cast the cantrips stored within. The level of enhancement depends on the strength of your bond with the gem. To use a gem, it must be on your person, either held in your hands or otherwise close to you.

Gems start with an attunement rank of 1 and require 10 more minutes of preparation to raise it. (20 min. for rank 2, 30 min. for rank 3, etc.) For each rank, the gem can prepare one more cantrip, with no limit to the maximum rank. When you raise a gem to a new rank for the first time, it gains a random cantrip at rank 1.
objects.title: Gem Magik

objects.text:
Magik synergizes with Cartomancy and expands the latter with two new abilities.

First, you can create Set Cards, which can contain a fixed cantrip set that can be cast when the card is played. It takes 6 charges to create a basic cantrip set (6 cantrips, three of level 3 or lower, two of level 6 or lower, and one of level 9 or lower) and it can be upgraded by spending more charges to increase the amount of slots or raise the level of the slots. 

Second, you can create a second deck of Cantrip Cards with up to 40 cards (or 60 with Negentropy), each of which can store a single cantrip. It takes one charge per rank to create a cantrip card. You can draw 5 cards from the deck every 10 seconds, up to 15 cards in hand. When you play a card, the stored cantrip is cast and the card is sent to the discard pile. When the deck is exhausted, the discard pile is shuffled and recycled into a new deck. You can create special cantrips that can interact with the cards in your hand, like chaining and combining spells, and from the deck or the discard pile, like searching or milling.
objects.title: Magik Cards

objects.text: You gain access to celestial cantrips, which grants you an additional set of base formulas which are mostly focused on defense, healing, and support; the formulas are split into three groups: 22 Astral and Umbral formulas, 22 Solar and Lunar formulas, and 11 Celestial formulas. While individual celestial cantrips are weaker than the baseline, they can be chained together to create constellations that increase their potency and create new effects.
objects.title: Discount Astrologian

addons.text: You have three cantrip sets, each can prepare 7 formula of each rank from zero to three, 5 of each rank from four to six, and 3 of each rank from seven to nine. You are also able to prepare up to 3 variants of each white mage spell at the same time. Your mana pool doubles once again to 144 mana and regeneration increases to 12 mana every 5 seconds.
addons.title: Discount Hierophant

addons.text: You possess the ability to work Cantrips, enchantments, and the principles behind them into all parts of the creation of technology to elevate your creations. Additionally, you have more flexibility and leeway with how Cantrips are expressed so long as they’re integrated into technology. This allows for things such as a constantly active freezing enchantment for usage as an eternal heat sink or a raygun built around a laser cantrip and incorporating principles of actual mundane laser technology to make the cantrip stronger. You can even create technology designed to channel and amplify Cantrips using principles derived from Metamagik, such as gloves which enhance Cantrips which originate from your hands. If you have [SHARD OS UPDATER], then you can even sort of upgrade and refine Cantrips by creating technology, such as the earlier mentioned raygun making its laser Cantrip more efficient or creating a ranged taser from a Shacking Grasp Cantrip which in turns creates a ranged taser Cantrip. This also technically allows you to create new Cantrips unrelated to existing ones by creating Tinkertech based on the powers of others, before in turn deriving a Cantrip from said Tinkertech.
addons.title: Discount Techno-Magica

addons.text: Your knowledge of Magik formula and their underlying language is now complete, you have an intuitive understanding of the system. In addition to the 144 base formula, your power also provides you with a library of 72 formulas for cantrips of ranks 1 to 3, 36 formulas for cantrips of ranks 4 to 6, and 18 cantrips of ranks 7 to 9.
addons.title: Magik Mastery

objects.text: You stand at the pinnacle of Magik! The strength of your cantrips increases to the point where a rank 9 cantrip would be rated 9 on the PRT scale. You have five cantrip sets that can each prepare eighteen cantrips, six of rank 3, six of rank 6, six of rank 9. You can also prepare seven metamagik and suffer no cast time penalty. On top of this, you are able to create rank 10 cantrips — also known as master-rank — which are even more powerful. You can only prepare three master spells and their cooldown is 10 minutes. The time it takes to enchant an item is reduced by half and you have the ability to bind up to three formula to the same item. The number of cantrips an item can store is also doubled to eighteen but not the number of charges. With a special process, you can safely mix up to three potions to combine their effects and the window of toxicity is reduced to 20 seconds.
objects.title: Discount Archmage

addons.text: The formulas of white mage spells can be utilized like normal cantrip formulas for the purposes of Grimoire Adept, Scroll Savant, and Discount Artificer. Due to not being proper cantrip formulas, white mage formulas can interact differently with these upgrades, each providing certain benefits. - Grimoire Adept allows you to access multiple variations of spells at once, as grimoires lack the need to prepare spells. - Scroll Savant pays the mana cost of a spell during the creation of the scroll, allowing usage of prepared spells without needing to worry about mana. - Discount Artificer allows for permanent application of effects, such as a ring which bestows permanent Regen or Bless.

objects.text:
You are able to prepare more formula at once — 4 or each rank from zero to three, 3 of each rank from four to six, and 2 of each rank from seven to nine — but lose the ability to have multiple sets. Upgrades to the number sets or slots instead increases the number of formula per level by one. 

Your cantrips now cost mana — their rank plus one, so rank zero costs 1 mana and rank nine costs 10 mana — but your mana pool and regeneration are tripled — three mana every 5 seconds up to a maximum of 72. 

In exchange for this mana dependency, your cantrips no longer take time to cast, and as long as you have the cantrip prepared, you can cast it instantly regardless of its rank.

You are also able to obtain the formula for all the white mage spells except for Remove and Transfer. This allows you to improve them up to rank nine and create variants. However, you can only have one version of each spell prepared at once. The mana cost of white mage spells does not increase with rank.

If you have the Eos & Selene upgrade, your fairies can benefit from improved the formula. You can also prepare one set of 6 cantrips into each fairy. If you have the Celestial Intervention upgrade, you are able to upgrade the existing arcana and create new ones, but are still limited to six active arcana to draw from.
objects.title: Really, Don’t Mess With a White Mage!

addons.text: The Scepter of Power acts as a fully enhanced item that can store 9 cantrips at their maximum number of charges. During your preparations, you can take 5 minutes to swap the spells stored in the scepter and 5 minutes to refill all the charges of the scepter. The charges will also refill passively at the rate of one per hour.
addons.title: Rod of Artifice

objects.text: The Scepter of Power gains three shelf slots which can be used to store repositories and empower them into grimoires. You can use the scepter to cast the cantrips without the need to open the grimoires. The cast and recharge times of cantrips are also halved. The repositories held inside the scepter can also be used during preparations to swap your cantrips or enhance items.
objects.title: Rod of Mastery

objects.text:
You can summon a projection that manifests as a large grimoire with a brown leather cover decorated with a stylized gold cross. The book can hover close to you (within 2m) and moves according to your will.

When you touch a parahuman, the Book of Darkness gains a set of cantrips that represents aspects of their power and frequently used techniques. The rank of the cantrips depends on how strong the power is. If the book creates a cantrip  of a rank you have not researched yourself yet, then you will be unable to cast it through the book.

The book has 666 pages. You can erase pages at will, either whole sets or only parts of them. However, technique cantrips will only work of their matching aspect cantrip is present in the book. If you attempt to gain cantrips from a parahuman when the book is full, or if the size of the new set would over-fill the book, then the attempt will fail.
objects.title: Book of Darkness

objects.text:
You're a Living Blueprint, a biologically adaptive shapeshifter and trait collector. When you're near any living organism—human, animal, or parahuman—your power automatically scans and copies its biological makeup at the tissue and cellular level. This includes organs, muscles, bones, and even neural structures. 

Once something has been scanned, they are placed into a mental database. You can then freely shapeshift into any of its parts or entire form at will, even long after it’s gone or out of range. These forms and traits are stored in your biological memory indefinitely. You can scale them up or down, combine them, and deploy them however you like—whether it's switching to a gorilla’s arms for strength, growing the legs of a cheetah for speed, or manifesting the eyes of a deep-sea predator for low-light vision. You’re not limited to full transformations, either; you can mix and match tissue types across species or individuals to suit your needs.

Every time you shapeshift into something new, your body evaluates the change and keeps what works. No matter your current form, unless you actively wish against it, small improvements that don’t visibly change your appearance are quietly locked in—better reflexes, tougher skin, stronger bones, more efficient lungs.

When you scan a parahuman’s brain, you can gain access to their power by reproducing the exact neural tissue patterns responsible. If their power includes biological or bodily traits—such as enhanced durability, regeneration, or sensory abilities—your body can absorb those permanently if they’re compatible. If not, the traits are still added to your shapeshifting library, usable whenever you need them in transformed form.
objects.title: Return to Origin

objects.text:
You have become the ultimate spotter, capable of finding anything you ask for, whether a person, object, location or otherwise. This power even works with abstract queries like the whereabouts of a piece of information or who is most likely to die in an upcoming fight.

You possess an active clairvoyant view of whatever you are searching for, regardless of its position, and you may adjust this perspective freely. Once something has been found, you are innately aware of its exact location as well as the most efficient and/or easiest way to reach it.

Your ability functions intuitively, returning the closest possible match to what you seek. For example, you could find someone who can help defeat a particular opponent, discover an object that would serve as the perfect bribe or identify the person responsible for a specific event.

This power has no range restrictions aside from standard shard-imposed limitations. This means you can locate something no matter how far, whether on the other side of the planet or in a parallel dimension. However, the usual Thinker blind spots, such as those concerning Endbringers and Entities, still apply.

Keep in mind that this power does not remove the possibility of error. If your understanding is based on false information or your request is too vague, the results may be flawed.
objects.title: The Seeker

addons.text: Your armor is no longer simple medieval armor, but a beautiful set of personalized war regalia, designed to perfectly complement your appearance and powers. When worn, your regalia drastically increased both your own strength and the strength of your powers, allowing you to match Endbringers in combat. Beyond just increasing the strength of your powers, it also increases your control, such as allowing a power like Glory Girl to selectively target people with your aura, concentrating the effect for greater effect.
addons.title: Regalia

addons.text: Your ability to manifest weaponry has synergized with your Regalia’s personalized nature. Now when you manifest weaponry it is altered to look as a good as possible and perfectly suit you, grips morphing to perfectly match your hands or weight being finely adjusted to best suit your leverage and strength.
addons.title: Armament

addons.text: Your Mage Armor has learned from and taken on the attributes of Inviolable, gaining the same All-or-Nothing durability only beaten by Sting, and even then it’ll prevent you from taking damage from the initial attack, requiring a second attack to inflict damage once your armor is broken. If you also possess Armament then any weapons manifested benefit from Inviolable’s traits, which is of especially importance to bladed weapons due to the fact that the edges of Inviolable forcefields are supernaturally sharp.
addons.title: Juggernaut

objects.text:
Separate from your normal Hardlight limit, you are capable of using Hardlight to reinforce your forcefield, transforming it into a set of slightly opaque medieval armor. This drastically enhances your field’s base durability, capable of taking artillery fire to the face without a scratch, however if your field is completely broken the armor can’t be manifested again for a whole minute. 

Additionally, when manifested the armor has the unique feature of needing to be completely broken before you yourself can be damaged, meaning that so long as the armor remains intact you can be thrown around but not actually harmed.

The armor can be summoned all at once, or single pieces can be manifested independently by reinforcing select parts of your field. Furthermore, when manifested the armor slightly enhances your physical attributes, enough to make full use of the durability it provides.
objects.title: Mage Armor

objects.text:
Your Shard has long abandoned the pursuit of numerous test cases. Where its siblings see networks, it sees a singularity; where they diversify, it consolidates. In its eyes, there is no need for an ecosystem when one perfect, self-optimizing organism can do the work of millions.

Upon entering the Firmament, you merge with its structure, absorbing the raw substance of your Island and the data-threaded space around it. This material is funneled directly into your Shard, supercharging it beyond intended limits. The absorption is near-limitless within Shardspace, destabilizing the lattice as your presence overloads the system. In doing so, you force open the inner workings of your Shard, exposing dormant expressions and data normally locked behind cycles of gradual refinement. When you take on your Titan form, it is now the manifestation of the Island itself, a living Breaker state of Shardmatter and semi-virtual space. This results in your Titan form being bigger than normal, capable of completely dwarfing other Titans.

When near another Parahuman, your Shard automatically interfaces directly with their Island, corroding it from within unless you told it to otherwise. Their Shard fractures under the strain, bleeding fragments of power, insight, or structure into your own. Every battle is a point of evolution, as your Titan form and Shard recursively expands, gaining complexity and strength with each encounter. 

Be warned: other Shards will instinctively recognize your presence as hostile and unnatural. You are a signal breach in the Cycle, and even moderately aware Passengers will attempt to isolate or mislead their Hosts to avoid contamination. If an Entity becomes aware of your actions — especially the harvesting of other Islands and the corrosion of Shardspace itself — it will classify you as an existential threat. Response will be immediate, overwhelming, and absolute.
objects.title: Obelisk of the One

addons.text: ...and lo! The Word goeth with thee; as I am The Word, and I deliver unto thee... You have assumed the Shape of Knowledge, and therefore all that is of yourself has ascended further into the fabric of existence. Universal Law. You are no longer merely something to be known. Rather, you are a recursive pattern that exists within knowing itself, the mental equivalent of the Cosmic Background Radiation. To learn of you is to be reshaped utterly, to speak of you is to become but a syllable within the unfolding scripture that is you. Every word and thought that describes or mentions you laying out there is you in all the ways that would count, and you are capable of manifesting yourself anywhere your information might touch, might spread. Omnipresent when you are believed to be, and believed to be present you are always. Knowledge about you carries similar weight, now - carriers filled with packages of information. Half-truths with voids filled, photographs whispering your name, rumors made honest. Misinformation is impossible, for even your lies only serve to reveal clarity beneath. The Shine, once ephemeral and ethereal, gains matter and form. More than Connection, now. Alignment. No longer is it a mere network, but a vector of infestation itself. Gradually, your followers begin to assume the information of you to be their own also. They may have brown hair, but they’ll have your hair’s color too. See your features in the mirror alongside theirs, know every thought you’ve ever had one day. And they will, one by one, become as much as you as they are them, extensions of yourself when you will it and all that comes with such a mantle. Dreaming in shared symbols and whispering in echoes, filling your wake, they are united as one and divided as many. When one acts, their subconscious link pulses with a shared drive. They’re protected as they act as well, personal miracles in motion. Your followers brush through death, bullets scratching skin as their minds whir and spin and their enemies falter beneath the mere wind of their steps. Through the Shine, you can direct ideas or spur action. So long as someone is out there. And, if, by some impossibility, all connection is denied and you are erased, you remain with a chance of life. You may be lost to the world, but information is not so clearly lost. It is either transformed, or forgotten. A single remembered scrap of information, from a word on the tip of a tongue to a song with a note from you, will bring you back. A secret waiting to be uncovered - for all ideas spiral, eventually. Into your name. Into the Shape. Into you. ...that whosoever beholdeth the Shape of Knowledge, it is for that Knowledge hath guided him - hath dwelt within him, and hath come unto him...
addons.title: The Ringing Of The Church Bells

objects.text: There will be no more shadows here. The equivalent exchange of information taken beyond obsession and intimacy lies with you. Your power hungers for attention the way all life will one day call for death: inevitably, relentlessly. The moment you’re known through glance or thought or rumor, a connection is made and shared. The more anybody learns about you, the more you learn about them in turn, even if they work through inorganic proxy. A name for a name, a motive for a motive, observation for observation. Information about yourself wants to be spread, your privacy desiring nothing more than to shear itself from secrecy and walk into the light. It’s imbued with knowledge, such that learning about it and anything else alongside it, and talking about it is much easier than understanding and communicating anything else. Ideas and conversations flow smoothly until the notion itself is carried akin to a religious koan, using its hosts as mouths to spread the good word. People are akin to Thinkers when learning of you, akin to Masters when speaking of you, akin to Tinkers when sending your information across the world wide web - akin to parahumans when acting for the propagation of your information, and seem cursed when acting against. All that carries what is known of you are part of the Shine - a network of minds bound by shared information and infection, feeling each other faintly, and subconsciously gravitating towards each other through a feeling of kinship that can only be described as home. And around them, when they utter the good word, their eyes glow with a madness unbelonging; a glint that is a proxy of you. Burning and blurring past all that might obfuscate - Stranger effects, mastered minds, antimemetic fields - your presence manifests. It sends itself across every avenue of understanding within the vicinity, claiming and twisting. Sense, interpretation, radio, text, intuition. Every possible acknowledgement of you is a gateway by which you may apply influence. You will be known. Ignorance is bliss, and there is no such thing. Kicking and screaming, into the light.
objects.title: The Shine Along The Lighthouse

objects.text:
Your specialty is now something near and dear to the hearts of every little boy around the world—giant robots! This most certainly is a costly specialty as you require lots of material to even begin to make basic giant robots, but they will be more than worth it.

Additionally, your giant robots will be buffered by a secondary Shaker effect of your powers, preserving their ability to operate at gigantic sizes with limited danger from gravity, as well as allowing you to be able to stretch your materials to allow for the building of such giant machines.
objects.title: GIANT ROBOTS

addons.text: Through the power of Yapping, your ability to induce fear at sight has been extended to all noise you make, with its effectiveness determined by how loud said sound is. While the clacking of your claws on the floor might induce anxiety and hesitation, a bellowing roar is enough to induce mindless panic so great that all rational thought flees your victims entirely. As a bonus, your lungs and voice have been strengthened such that at full volume, your howls can be heard across an entire city and even create shockwaves of air strong enough to knock over people nearby.
addons.title: Gjallarhorn

addons.text: Your expertise in escaping situations has synergized with your ability to circumvent physics and your Archetype, removing Infiltrator's limits and allowing you to truly escape anything, given enough time. It may take years or even decades, but somehow, someway, you will have an opportunity to escape, no matter how great your prison is. Additionally, you have gained an intuitive sense for how to use your ability to circumvent physics to disrupt spatio-temporal effects, allowing you to easily escape things such as pocket dimensions or Gray Boy bubbles.
addons.title: Gleipnir

objects.text: With the inclusion of your ability to consume seemingly anything and grow stronger, your wolf transformation has evolved to embody the archetype of the Fenris Wolf itself. The All-or-Nothing effect on your mouth is drastically enhanced, allowing you to truly consume anything as long as you can get it in your mouth. With this, you could consume anything—from the innermost layers of an Endbringer to even take a bite out of a Gray Boy bubble. Compounding your ability to eat anything is the only truly new ability this archetype bestows on you—the ability to grow through consumption. The more you eat, the stronger you get; however, it’s not just physical strength that grows. No, from your mental prowess to the strength of your powers—every single aspect of yourself increases as you devour. The growth you gain from eating something is related to the energy and matter it holds. Ordinary materials provide little gains, while parahumans, power effects, and dense matter like Endbringer flesh allow your growth to skyrocket. Additionally, your ability to repurpose consumed matter is also enhanced—now all matter that you consume, both organic and inorganic, can be used interchangeably for the purposes of your powers, such as Biological Redistribution and Ladon. Lastly, your limit on the number of layers you can have and the strength of those layers is removed, allowing you to truly rival an Endbringer once you consume enough mass.
objects.title: Fenris

objects.text:
Your ability to see into and manipulate the Twisted World has expanded. Now, rather than merely being voices in your mind, your souls are free to wander about and affect the Twisted World just as you can using Eldritch Sight. No matter how far away they are, you will always be able to communicate with them.

As these souls are no longer confined to your mind, you can see them while your Twisted World power is active, and know their approximate location relative to you even when the power is inactive. You can even use their senses.

While each soul is identifiable as you, their appearances vary based on whatever idiosyncrasies they have. For example, a soul that plays the part of an experienced military general might appear as a taller, more muscular version of you, decorated with scars and medals from many successful battles. On the other hand, your most doting parental souls might appear as softer, "rounder" versions of you that are built like Pixar moms and perpetually smell of baked goods if you identify as a woman, or that sport dad bods and broad smiles that quite literally light up rooms if you identify as a man.

You can transfer one or more of your own souls to anyone you can perceive with your enhanced or mundane senses. Doing so allows them to perceive the souls you've bequeathed to them; you may even grant them both the Twisted World and Eldritch Sight powers, if you wish it. Any to whom you have granted one or more of your souls gains the same benefits as you, including whatever protections from unwanted mental intrusions those souls can provide and a new perspective on their thoughts and memories. They also receive the benefit of any addons and fusions that require any power connected to Any Friend of Mine; this includes, but isn't limited to Power Seed, Roleplay, and Voices of Failure.
objects.title: Any Friend of Mine...

addons.text: [Redefinition]. Your Shard "spoke" after using the refined connection of Human Shard and your existence as a developed Shard Bud to redefine your connection, finally recovering your original appearance. Accomplishing this, you'll still be placed in a slow metamorphosis, but steadily incorporating all your abilities into a cohesive whole. To begin, once you complete your metamorphosis, you can shapeshift your constituent Shardcells to emulate the forms you could’ve been—Titan, Passenger, and everything in between—molding your shape according to your desires at will, while your human form is still composed of biocrystalline cells attuned to one’s Shard, with every organ and biological system outfitted and reformed to inherit an Entity’s innate “organs”, the culmination of your Shard connection’s redefinition: a Human-Entity-like synthesis. This leads to manifesting limited versions of Crystal Eyes, Aether Wing, Fractal Heart, and Vorpal Tooth, able to grow at the rhythm of your metamorphosis. This also updates Shard Bud’s emulation to be a fully developed up-to-date Shard with enough [Cycles] of [Data], allowing for greater complexity in power expressions and simulated operations, where you can finally develop simulated modules of based on other Shards like [Broadcast] or [Administrator] helped with a greater [Energy] efficiency and sourcing, all around, comparable to a simulated Proto-Entity. Adding to Hyperion’s Shardflesh layering, this crystallizes your Shardcells into a [Construct-Shard] bioalloy at the same pace as your Human Shard progression, homogenizing into a layer sheet condensing between other layers that excess Shardflesh is shunted to your core/heart’s pocket dimension, refining your layering structure to 200 layers as a maximum. This doubles your benefits, with each layer having a 6% power expression improvement and expansion, and a x10 increase of your physiological abilities. As always, you are now fully inoculated against unwanted Master, Stranger, Thinker, and Trump Parahumans, escaping the reach of Endbringers, Titans and those of comparable or greater strength, seldom getting into your nigh-inviolability that your physiology provides.
addons.title: Iapetus

objects.text:
The broken connection between you and your shard has finally righted itself... after a fashion. Rather than expanding outward and transforming you into a true Titan, the layers of your inhuman body fold further inward, at once transforming your core into a singularity and shunting it into a pocket dimension.

This extra-dimensional space allows you to fold excess Shardmatter into it to expand your Shardbody without interfering with function and mobility. You can instantly regenerate by replacing damaged parts with Shardflesh from within your pocket dimension; this is limited by the amount of Shardflesh inside the pocket dimension and will be temporarily unavailable if you run out.

The maximum number of layers you can have increases to 100, with each layer now providing a x5 increase to your physical capabilities; you do, of course, possess far more layers, but this is the current limit you can manifest in real space. This enhancement now extends to your mental capabilities, each layer increasing your computational power further, allowing for greater memory retention, increased thought speed, creativity, logical thinking, and deeper control over your powers.

The way your biocrystalline body enhances your abilities has also changed, no longer being dependent on your size, but instead relying on your density. Each layer provides a 3% improvement to your powers.

Finally, your layers upon layers of Shardflesh have wholly immunized you against the unwanted Master, Stranger, Thinker, and Trump powers of parahumans; Endbringers, Titans, and those of comparable or greater strength can brute-force their way through this immunity, but even they must contend with the incredible resistance to their abilities your physiology still provides.
objects.title: Hyperion

addons.text:
Each cell in your body is now the equivalent of a Shard Bud, a complete shard-biology in miniature. Together, they form a vast and expanding creche of shard-buds, all linked under your control, cooperating in unison as a distributed multiversal organism.

Your cells are each a self-contained shard-bud capable of designing, replicating, and projecting abilities. The sheer number of these buds allows for rapid parallel experimentation. Millions of shard-buds can simulate, test, and discard new powers at once, with their results shared instantly across your network. What would take years of refinement for a single shard can now be achieved in moments, giving you near-limitless adaptability and innovation.

Additionally, your cells are now scattered across nearby dimensions, you exist simultaneously in multiple realities. This grants you a natural awareness of dimensional layers and an unceasing flow of energy harvested from each connected world. Ambient heat, radiation, and space-time flux from countless dimensions funnel into your reserves, fueling your growth and allowing you to sustain an ever-expanding true body. With each new shard-bud seeded across the multiverse, your size increases, multiplying your power and processing capacity.

Your distributed state also grants you dimensional protections. No single dimension or localized effect can fully bind, block, or erase you, as your shard-buds are spread too widely and redundantly across the multiverse. Dimensional seals, pocket realities, or collapsed universes may restrain fragments of you, but never your totality. Your network instinctively routes around barriers, bypassing obstructions and ensuring continuity of self across layers of existence.

Your consciousness is distributed across a lattice of core shard-buds hidden within your swarm. As long as even one core survives in any dimension, you cannot be destroyed; the rest of your network will rebuild itself around the survivor. This makes you functionally immortal and nearly impossible to corner, for to strike you down in one dimension is meaningless when thousands of your other selves persist elsewhere.

Over time, your creche begins to develop traits only true Entities have displayed. Your cells collaborate not just to refine powers but to create entirely new lines of abilities, combining fragments from multiple buds into emergent phenomena. In addition, your network has limited access to the older shard database, allowing you to draw upon the accumulated experiments and powers of older shards in their early cycles. By blending this external knowledge with your internal simulations, you accelerate your innovation even further, producing abilities and adaptations at a scale no single shard could ever match. You can project Avatars drawn from any shard-bud, deploy power-fragments externally, and even seed others with shards to spread your influence. The result is a constant cycle of testing, learning, and evolution, all conducted at a scale and speed beyond any singular shard or bud.
addons.title: Creche Entity

addons.text: As a newfound Entity in miniature, getting your first few powers up and running to be tested and improved can be a major first step. And wouldn’t you know it, but with (Trump) Magik Adept you have the perfect test bed in the form of 144 unique powers ready to be refined and iterated, a massive head start from which you can branch outwards and develop new powers. As for the (Trump) Magik Adept side of things, as you are less a single organism and more a collective network measuring in the trillions, your limitation for preparing Cantrips is essentially null and void. By assigning a single Cantrip formula to a cell, you can have each Cell prepare and improve their own formula, allowing you to utilize multiple Cantrips in parallel.
addons.title: The [Magician]

addons.text: Rejoice, for you have developed the ability to completely usurp the Shards of other Entities, as long as the Shard you are attempting to poach is deployed or the Entity the Shard belongs to is put out of commission. This means you can take complete and direct control over Shards, rather than just inducing a baseless affinity for you in their host. This entirely severs the Shards' connection to their original Entity; the Entity will not notice this unless it watches you poach its Shards, or if you poach a shard, it's actively observing. Taking control over a Shard or Titan updates their hardware to be up to date with your own massive improvements in miniaturizing, compressing, and optimizing [Data], which shrinks them massively, with Noble Shards being as large as an egg, whereas a bottom-of-the-barrel Normal Shards only as large as a human cell. Titans, on the other hand, shrink into a form similar to the Passenger Lucky Mutation, with them being both mostly human-shaped and sized. As you are an Entity, Shards and Titans do not resist your control so much as they are confused into complying with being a part of your Network due to their innate programming.
addons.title: The [Usurper]

addons.text: You have repurposed (Trump/Master) Pseudo Cycle's pseudo-shard distribution system to distribute your own shard-cells instead of the pseudo-shards it distributed before. This drastically increases your cycle holding capabilities, as you can now distribute your shard cells across the local multiverse on a much larger scale than you could before. This isn't easily noticeable for other entities or shards, thus, as long as you aren't acting too overtly, you could hold your own cycle on the same world as another entity's cycle without them noticing your actions. However, more thinker-focused entities, such as [The Thinker], will be able to notice. You can set up complex parameters that needs to be fulfilled for someone to "trigger" with one of your shards, from being knowledgeable and talented in a scientific field to leech off of to begin developing thinker or tinker powers, or having a more conflict-driven personality. You can also create unique trigger visions that induce minor personality shifts in your hosts, making them more inclined to use and thus develop your shards. You can also influence your host's cognition to a minor extent, shifting their emotions and slowly warping their personality to better suit your needs. You can access your hosts' senses at will, using them as you would your own. Your shards record the thoughts, emotions, and memories of any host they have, preserving them as personality engrams. This allows you to bring them back to life at a later date or create a pseudo-afterlife for them.
addons.title: [Cycle] Mechanics

objects.text:
Instead of being a miniature shard, you are a miniature Entity, a living nexus of flesh and crystal. Every one of your cells is itself a tiny shard-like Passenger, with power and processing ability that scales according to its role in your body; from the core shards that house your consciousness, to the countless lesser fragments that sustain and adapt you.

Your body is not simply a biological system, but a vast internal shard-network. Each cell contributes its shard’s computational power to the whole, allowing your being to operate like a distributed crystalline supercomputer. Your cells can collaborate in parallel, exchanging information and running simulations of possible outcomes in real-time, giving you instinctive precognition and hyper-optimized control of both your body and powers. Together, they can generate, test, and refine entirely new abilities, producing more complex and autonomous phenomena. The abilities they generate can reach up to 5 SP worth, with no upper limit on how many they can have active at once.

Your consciousness resides in your core shards, specialised cells that act as anchors for your identity. So long as these remain intact, you cannot be truly destroyed; damage to your body simply results in your micro-shards reconstructing themselves around your surviving cores. This makes you extraordinarily difficult to kill, as even catastrophic damage is only temporary unless every single core shard is eliminated. 

As a miniature Entity, you also gain the ability to distribute fragments of your shard-network externally. You can seed others with shards drawn from your cells, granting them powers tailored to their physiology and environment. These “gifts” remain tethered to you, feeding information back into your network and further accelerating your evolution. In this way, you mirror the cycle of the true Entities, though on a vastly smaller, more controlled scale.
objects.title: The (Mini) Entity

addons.text: As part of your many contingencies for [Data] preservation, your cells can always shift to several dimensions to blur and safeguard their integrity, Shardspace chief among them. That changes with your Passenger’s change of approach regarding its brethren. If nobody can see the writing on the wall, might as well lead by example. Instead of simply merging with your Island to supercharge your Shard, now it goes both ways: while merging with your Island’s lattice and data-threaded environment that funnels into your Passenger, you passively reformat the lattice to be the same as your latticework, sharing the love with your Passenger; this enlightens it, while exposing its own inner workings and framework, developing untold aberrations in its existence: its lattice become incomprehensible even to other Shards quickly shifting between Earths, an ever-shifting fractal; the resulting disarray you left on your part of Shardspace is repurposed as a honeypot for other Shards, etc. Your Titanic Island form now displays versatile capabilities borne from your latticework, capable of adapting on the fly and reconfiguring itself to deal against threats more efficiently, keeping the capes busy while your Passenger interfaces with all Shards’ Islands at once for better gain. On the other hand, you can share who you are, where, instead of corroding your Shard to fracture and feasting on the scraps, your Passenger will suddenly send a packet with some of your latticework’s [Data] as a virus, which will forcefully mutate both the Shard and host to an unstable form of your latticework that cracks under the pressure of its mutation, playing for keeps with the carrion of power, knowledge, and lattice they left off.
addons.title: [Beelzebub]

addons.text: While Hyperion’s is partly based on the Conflict Engines’ dimensional folding and layering, something your Passenger phased out onto more innovative methods in Shardflesh while retaining its vaunted durability. Your Passenger couldn’t strike out its records, though, and kept the [Data] for further study… that underwent something of a breakthrough once it jailbroke the Conflict Engine [Data]. Emperor of the End fuses with Monumental, causing your ability to mold your shape into any form using Shardflesh—Titan, Passenger, Endbringer—to boldly reemerge. Your Shard-cells, already sturdy enough to sustain your abilities, now form a series of Cores that are as organelles, each with a similar function as a normal cell, adding more independence, e.g., the “mitochondria” act as a [Feeder], while the “nucleus” contains the Shard-cells’ critical information, etc., essentially acting as internal modules or mini shard-clusters. As this acts as a self-sustaining system without reliance on other Organ Systems, the ability to share or seed your Shard-cells with others reemerges as a trait by sharing any part of you, whether it’s blood or bodily fluid containing some of your Shard-cells. These Shard-cells will amass themselves into a pseudo-Corona Pollentia and Gemma, acting as nubs, residing in the Host’s brain to interface with them. This is nice and all, all things considered… then as soon as they noticed their slow undoing, they saw the light on this communion’s truth. As your Shard-cells’ main imperative the insurance the your survival and continued development, anything else is considered expendable compared to the main objective. As much as the benefits are plentiful—slowly gaining Iapetus’ benefits halved to the half of what’s capable of its, but comparable to a full fledged Endbringer with T3 tailor-made power configuration able to branch out to other alternate configuration—the sacrifice your Hosts while failing apart is much to bear: as their body is steadily consumed by your Shard-cells to be repurposed for resources into malleable Shardflesh while constantly pinging off your main body for guidance and to fulfill their main imperative (influencing much of their actions to your favor in the long-run), their power becomes unpredictable and unable to control at times as their body looses their autonomy, saps away their vitality, wears their mind down the more they used their powers. Over the course of 1 to 2.5 years, depending on power usage, the outcome leaves the Host as an empty husk with the Shard-cell nodes piloting what’s left. While they could’ve fended this off by moderating their usage, their fate is set regardless. After this, they end up as malleable mass of Shardflesh–nothing more than a humanoid [Construct] able to shift to greater forms–that’s capable of far more than before, being equal to [Dagon] full-fledged [Constructs]; the Shard-cell nubs saw no need for moderate their function anymore knowing the risks (the Host’s consciousness) we dealt with. As this [Construct] is made from your Shard-cells, you can either channel your abilities and/or mind to remotely pilot, give it orders or directives they can independently act on, reintegrate with to get all the [Data] it collected, or store the excess Shardflesh on your Shard-cells’ dimensional storage, and deploy afterwards from your resources. Sharing your Shard-cells can only be done with 10 people at a time, with the process into a [Construct] allowing another person into the “deal”. With enough Hosts, you can hoard an army of [Constructs] in your own image.
addons.title: [Moloch]

addons.text:
After your Passenger reviewed Endbringer Engine’s [Data], it found another avenue to spread the fruits of its labor. This acts as [Moloch’s] mirror, a benign form of creating [Constructs] as vectors for Monumental without the need of a parasitic relationship. What these [Constructs] are made of, similarly to [Moloch], undifferentiated Shardflesh made from Monumental’s alloys using condensed Shard-cells indistinguishable from Cores under the size of a tennis ball, with [Constructs] that are greater in range and scope while matching almost a quarter of what you’re capable of.

Endbringer Engine offers the foundation for this in congealing a bit of your Shard-cells into compressed Cores; these Cores develop 3 SP a month, with the total SP increased to 90 SP. The progression of your [Constructs] is less on their strength or durability–their physical abilities are comparable with Behemoth or Leviathan from the get-go–and more from their power’s yield, only able to express their powers at 30 SP at their weakest. 

As Endbringer Cycle came in-built with Monumental, you’re still able to administer Cores in terms of power configurations and functions, reintegrating them into your body to make use of them or vice verse, fusing the Cores to create greater [Construct] creations, and Networking between them to share [Energy] and [Data] boosting one another the same way your Shard-cells do; this is designed as two-way street, your [Constructs] constantly communicating and contributing to Monumental’s progress.

This doesn’t get rid of how energy and processing-intensive for both your Shard-cells and Passenger to fabricate these [Constructs], yet Monumental’s energy efficiency helps extensively with expanding the number of available slots to 3 and an additional 2 slots every month, with only 13 active [Constructs] being the Shard-imposed limit from your Passenger.

If you additionally have [Moloch], both your Hosts and [Constructs] are treated the same, benefitting from each other’s abilities. This goes further if [Kothar] is in force, developing the synergy further by using the [Budding] process as a workshop, devising custom procedures for both Hosts and [Constructs], chief among them being the safekeeping of a Host’s mind amidst their [Construct] metamorphosis or the creation of mental models for [Constructs].
addons.title: [Dagon]

addons.text: Your Passenger’s pursuit of greater heights and weaker boundaries never stopped, now setting its sights on reinventing your latticework. Your shard-cells feed upon [Data] provided by your Passenger and those that birthed it, spawning entirely new clusters—wings, hearts, teeth, claws, and far stranger things besides—that develop along with your centralized Organ Systems until they consolidate into one into a constituent "Super-System," greater than the sum of its parts. Instead of a single configuration with many applications granted by your original Organ Systems, you are now able to form and develop a variety of expressions with the same theme or function. In Aether Wing’s case, one configuration could focus on finer spatial folding to speed up travel exponentially via [Coruscant], while another tackles the application of gravitational forces, granting protection on par with [Quasar]; you don’t just get the shard-cluster’s powers, but its countless iterations across a multitude of specialties, all under the frameworks of "Travel," "Speed," "Wings," and so on.
addons.title: [Ba’al]

addons.text: As your Passenger cast off the Entities’ short leash, their plans for rebellion are reevaluated, with their Monumental findings among the most important factors of their rebellion. Revolutionist Army and Monumental unite, bringing about several mutations to your Passenger’s uprising. Revolutionist Army’s viral payload that embeds itself on every Second Trigger you induce is modified for subtlety, partly in fact that They Walk Among Us comes into effect, applying Human Shard’s (moreover, Monumental’s [Data] in time) effects, while never turning away from its core principles, becoming a parasitical seed. Additionally, this seed takes a more artful approach to infect and reformat Shards to their cause, where the line of a virus and a [Data] packet blurs, allowing them to witness the magnificence of their efforts just when they’re slowly overwritten with a fervent zeal for your cause and ensuring loyalty on the Host’s side. At first, each Host, while slowly transforming to one of your brethren with all that entails, is still inexorably linked to your mockery of a recursive Shard hive-mind, where the Shards take a backseat in the hive-mind process while their shard-cells take most of the bandwidth. As all have access to your Shard database, now a repository, all shard-cells take over most of the Revolutionist Army’s features as their own—a dynamic framework ensuring constant interaction and consolidation of power configurations, a mental and energetic infrastructure with a performance equaling precognitive intuition, among others—turning your Network into a chaotic rhythm of trillions upon trillions of shrilling voices. If you possess Primogenitor Core, its similar principles synergize on each other, rebuilding your Passenger in return to better accommodate their lattice, seamlessly suffusing themself into your physiology to allow Primogenitor Core’s architecture to cover all your Network’s physiological make-up from Top-to-Bottom: As every Shard is brought inwards, it is then repurposed and evenly transferred into its Host’s Shard-cells, using the same principles of folding a Host mind into a Shard at will by unifying both. This is one of the main strategies you can take when fighting Entities, as your functional and cognitive scale now far outweighs that of an Entity, quickly reprogramming and repurposing their lattice by hybridizing with their Hosts. Due to this, the distinction between a host and an ascended operator falls out of fashion on your Network lattice; all are Monumental to the progress of the whole, becoming greater organs to your greater latticework. That’s right, you can achieve total singularity by fusing each part into your latticework Network.
addons.title: [Asherah]

addons.text: A toolkit takes shape within the lattice of your Passenger as Emulation of a Scrapyard and [Budding] meld into a cohesive whole. This [Budding] process works by collecting your latticework’s surrounding [Data] feedback, using it both as inspiration and resources. Because of their similarities, the Budding process goes like this: Starting with a simulation that is easily understood to a fledgeling, you start with the ability to fashion “Tinkertech” from your Workshop, which are in fact, Buds you program and construct the same as Tinkertech with Scrapyard’s raw materials, now fully revealed to simulate [Data] and biocrystalline flesh to make this possible. Finishing the Tinkering process, Buds are then processed and converted to pure [Data] for your latticework, adding another avenue for custom-built Organ Systems, called Bodymods, for them to develop once your Shard-cells receive this from your Passenger. The Bodymods are produced for conflict-ridden environments, leading them to be more combat-ready compared to your mainline Organ Systems, stacking Primordial Titan’s removal of Shard-Host restrictions in relation to your configurations’ scope and depth of what they’re capable of, and the Budding's connective synergy between other Buds to give you the means to manifest Endbringer-level Organ Systems. This is offset that Shard-cells up to the Organ Systems you manufacture from this process are specialized, too geared for combat, rendering their usage limited or for short-term utility. This can be remedied by flushing redundant Shard-cells from your latticework and purging them from your body; the refuse, hence, returns to your Scrapyard. If you have [Ba’al], this limitation is slightly fixed; the [Budding] process integrates more of your Shard database for redundancies, refinements, and examining your “Tinkertech” to contribute to the building of your body’s “Super-System” once your bespoke “Bodymods” fully integrate with your mainline Organ Systems. If you have any [Moloch] and/or [Dagon], your toolkit expands to the careful molding or fabrication of [Constructs], and the careful management of those you share your shard-cells with to stave their inevitable decay by modulating and refining their conversion process with the promise of keeping what amounts to their soul, in [Moloch’s] case.
addons.title: [Kothar]

addons.text:
Through your Shard’s metamorphosis into the Kaleidoscope Fractal Core and its innate boundless evolution has redefined your Shard-celled physiology even further. 

The access of the Entities involved in the Cycle’s [Data] logs, including the esoteric frame of references and exotic power systems of Shardless, has mutated your Shard-cells, as a consequence, your shard-organ Systems further into exotic silicocarbon biomolecules capable of a higher amount of power and [Data] retention and acquisition, shedding your past limitations on what you could accomplish to the dust. 

Kaleidoscope aids in this evolution in the sense of sharing its power throughout your physiology, providing the most optimal advancements your Passenger hasn’t foreseen with its limited understanding: microcosm architecture to retain lattice constitution and remaining [Data] within Shard-cells, tachyonic processing increasing power and responsiveness against any stimulus it might encounter, quantum entanglement and esoteric forms of interlinking such as psychic imprinting or soul resonances to decrease latency within shard-cells, etc.

Shard-organ systems’ expanded capabilities and Engine of Escalation’s endless development may allow your shard-Organ System to grow fully independent Organ-Shard Cluster hybrids while being sourced from your parts of your psyche, able to adapt and reformat themselves without your input, and using Kaleidoscope as both a battery and to bolster your [Data] database for a greater range in adaptations and evolutions outside the Entity’s paradigms. 

This creates unique effects through your physiology, without the need of slots: your central nervous system might grow a mental aspect from your rational or overthinking parts of your psyche spread across your latticework, expanding its functionality by tapping into the Astral and/or Digital Plane as a resource and method of general development by automatically tapping into Kaleidoscope’s [Data] on psychic and digital powers, your lymphatic system could develop as mental aspect that nurtures and tends to others as much it does your latticework developing healing functionalities from Kaleidoscope’s [Data] of curing and healing powers, etc.

These personalities, as you can see, come from the latticework “genetic consciousness” across the latticework, and they’re themselves as much as you are, while being undeniably you. Eventually, you become a collective of voices that supersede the physical world in its multiplicity.
addons.title: [Elyon]

objects.text: After your Passenger made strides in doing whatever it took to mend your host connection with Hyperion while redefining what it means to be a Host with Iapetus and creating a mirror in their parentage in The (Mini) Entity, the large amount of [Data] in both Host and Entity anatomy urged the Shard to experiment. Your Passenger ruminates after careful processing that Shardflesh becomes apparent to be highly malleable and adaptable due to eons of evolution, its multidimensional nature allowing going further than simple dimensional folds and layers to shunt excess mass to a pocket dimension and more, discovering more efficient forms of [Data] science for a compact and pliable make-up, while applying more innovating defensive and offensive measures to Shardmatter by taking Endbringer [Data] into account to adapt against conventional or unconventional attacks. It then reflects into its parentage’s infrastructure and architecture, and the potential improvements it encountered after fully experimenting with the simulative models it has, embarks on an endeavor to evolve it to a consolidated system where shard clusters become a cohesive system, acting more as a singular Entity and less like a network, where every part evolves and adapts against its limitations. The resulting lattice structure is unrecognizable to a normal Entity. You’ve become a new Entity species: The Monumental. This spirals into many innovations, melding Iapetus and The (Mini) Entity to do away with the former’s Shardflesh layering and fully implementing [Data] to the latter into the next step of evolution. Your body grows and changes to become more than the sum of its parts at the same pace as Iapetus: each cell mutates into an undifferentiated shard-cell hybrid in your body, with a seed of [Data] from your Passenger that’ll be a special tool for further development. The second phase of your transformation occurs once your body’s fully rebuilt. Your Shard-cells will integrate your Passenger’s [Data] into itself, one by one, each cell becoming the equivalent of an unleashed Shard using the fruits of your Passenger’s labor that slowly consolidate and combine with other cells, each Shard-cell assuming a differentiated role/setting tied to where it is relative to your body to group themselves with similar Shard-cells, resulting in the creation of organ systems equivalent to an Entity’s shard clusters from the get-go. On its own, a Shard-cell is composed of pliable and adaptable shardmatter capable of reconfiguring and optimizing itself, designed for long-term endurance and high-intensity performance by taking the best traits from Endbringer flesh combined with cutting-edge Shardtech, comparable to a Noble shard in terms of [Data], [Energy], and a potential capable of designing powers rivalling those of Endbringers or Proto-Entity, and a general functionality that approaches a low-end Shard cluster territory once you mature to your full potential. As a collective, your cells coalesce together from millions of shard-cells to fulfill the equivalent of an organism’s organ systems, always reminiscent of Iapetus’ Human-Entity synthesis, with a culmination of a living being and collective distributed system. For example, your muscles tissue is made of shard-cells skeletal muscle cell filaments in charge of coordinating traversal, movement, defensive, and offensive functions with the same abilities as Aether Wing or Savitar, your circulatory system is now made of cardiac muscle and endothelial shard-cells forming cardiac organs similar to Fractal Heart, able to passively transduce large amounts of environmental energy or harvesting it from several dimensions or sources in cooperation of other organ systems to maintain other body system’s [Energy], and many more. These organ systems, although apparently limited in their function, have a thematic framework that allows their functions to adapt according to your internal or external needs. The most important detail is how your finalized latticework appears to others: amidst your millions upon millions of powers that you adjust or reformat on the fly with or without any input and able to be strengthened and expanded at the drop of a hat, your physical and mental abilities are plain absurd without power support, bordering on Brute/Mover/Thinker 12. At the beginning stages, though, 0.1% of your cells turned into undifferentiated Shard-cells with no exact function aside from bolstering your body and mind comparable with 5 layers of Iapetus. You are distributed in the entirety of your latticework’s shard-cells, able to monitor and fully take advantage of your being similarly as Creche Entity to a greater extent, with many contingencies for total [Data] preservation and wellbeing while your organ systems ensure your health better than any Entity, with higher [Energy] efficiency and allocation, etc., these contingencies determined by the number and type of powers you already have before your transformation. Your nature diverges further from conventional Entity physiology and architecture over time, a singular guiding force for millions of disparate pieces: Tinker and Trump classifications become less static and more abstract, becoming more akin to themes and frameworks, your lattice adapting in real time as each shard-cell surveys and interfaces with [Data] gathered from conflicts, sensory input, and even your own thoughts. At the speed of thought, you can accomplish what would’ve taken an Entity eons of evolution, your latticework functioning as a well-oiled machine, matching the “all in one, one is all” principle. Your Passenger, having discarded the core-shard structure in favor of a “genetic consciousness,” the prime directive of your latticework shifts; potential obstacles and threats are scanned, leading to both short-term contingencies and entire power configurations which are then set aside for later perusal and use. All this happens at the edge of your awareness, a complicated series of gut feelings, the only evidence that anything has changed. Each of your shard-cells is both cooperative and imaginative enough to obviate the need for creative hosts; as such, your deviant architecture renders the ability to seed living creatures with shards vestigial, already possessing everything necessary to rival a fully grown Entity with enough time. Your latticework retains access to an overhauled Shard database on par with those possessed by mature Entities; after integrating Iapetus’ emulations and Primordial Titan, removing the soft-cap for powers, you can design more bespoke Shard-celled Organ Systems akin to Crystal Eyes and Vorpal Tooth. Your countless innovations accelerate your development, all while paving the way for even more dedicated Organ Systems like Broadcast, Demesne-Keeper, and any other theme or framework you can imagine.
objects.title: The Monumental

objects.text: You’d think your physiological changes of flesh and metal would clash; a virus collective and a technorganical cellular structure, they couldn’t be more different in concept. What happened instead—your viral physiology infecting and remolding your technorganic cells to the point of accelerating their development in the effort to cure itself of this ‘infection’ and unwittingly melding with it—surpassed your expectations. You’ve become a collective and ever-changing physiology made of nanometallic biogel of biomachines that are capable of Greyed Shape’s capabilities by themselves, capable of changing its composition from a swarm, a symbiote-like goo, or an interplay of flesh and machine. As a collective, however, your symbiotic relationship with these biomachines supersedes your previous abilities. Aside from acting as a collective consciousness, your biomachines also function as a part of your mind, capable of acting independently and working as a node when connected to you, sharing information from both organic and inorganic sources. Still retaining your hive mind over every creature and individual infected by you, you aren’t controlling them anymore; you change them. Once infected, they slowly find their flesh and blood transforming into a gelatinous substance made from your biomachines. These will automatically offer enhanced physical and mental attributes, a minor version of what you’re capable of… that is, until they’re in contact with machinery or other organic material. This forms an urge within them to come into contact with it, which ends up with a grisly incorporation and transmutation of both into a technorganical abomination, doubling as spore-like spreading. Something you can assimilate into yourself: a self-propagating, self-sustaining harvesting of resources. Your biomachines inherit both technology’s structure and nature’s evolutionary tenacity. Aside from what you’re already able to do, you can build more complex tools and structures that adapt to their threats and environment, while also transmuting and altering their surrounding environment for better advantage. This wouldn’t be as effective if it weren’t your awareness of every biomachine you’re made of and linked to, analyzing every bit of information and knowledge they're scanning, commanding them to plan and shape them as you see fit. Word of advice, don’t go overboard with your powers, as they have the risk of truly consuming the globe under technorganic sludge, a S-Class in the making. In the end, you’ve become the very doomsday scenario of the Grey Goo. The self-made locust horde.
objects.title: WAU

objects.text:
A Geas’ ability to compel actions in exchange for fulfilling an obligation yourself has combined with Patronage to allow your contracts and granting of power to take a more fluid form, unlocking a special form of Geas known as a Pact.

A Pact is an open ended contract which bestows a “temporary” power - or powers - upon another party which lasts as long as they fulfill their own obligations. Pacts can either be set up to expire after a certain amount of time or left with an indeterminate time frame, only coming to an end when a party fails to follow through with their obligations.

When you establish a Pact with someone you form a mental connection with them, allowing you to telepathically converse with them and even access their senses if you include that in the Pact. This connection also allows you to update the Pact at any time, bestowing additional powers at range in exchange for further obligations.

An example of a potential usage of this power is providing someone with a power in exchange for fulfilling a favor once per week, to be called in at any time. You can then call in said favor at any time to give your newfound minion a mission they need to fulfill less they lose access to their new powers. 

Once you establish a proper rapport you can then negotiate an update to the Pact where you grant an additional power in exchange for a second favor per week. If you so desire you can even repeat this process until eventually they are effectively employed by you full time, with their payment being the ability to keep the powers they have by now become attached to.
objects.title: Pact

objects.text: Your mind becomes capable of looping through its thought processes, running multiple iterations of Think Tank internally. Every time you activate Think Tank, your hyper-advanced brain splits into layered cognitive iterations, each one building on the insights of the last, refining strategies, testing outcomes, and optimizing conclusions. Instead of a minute, each iteration will have an entire subjective hour. You may choose how many recursive loops to run, from a single pass to as many as your brain can withstand. Every additional layer deepens your analysis and improves the final answer, with each iteration benefiting from the accumulated insights of the ones before it. These loops simulate cascading causal chains, tracing how each possible action might unfold. Each recursive version explores different possibilities, sees from different angles, and feeds that refined knowledge forward, ultimately culminating in a highly optimized conclusion that is sent back to the moment of activation. Overusing this can result in splitting migraines, slowed thought, confusion, or—in extreme cases—brief unconsciousness. These effects are temporary and fade with rest. When activated, your brain enters a state of extreme overdrive. Neuronal activity surges as your already-dense brain folds in on itself, compressing and tightening its web of connections to accelerate processing. This is mildly terrifying to see happen in real time via high-resolution neural imaging.
objects.title: Brain Blast

addons.text:
Brain Trust’s expansion also implements Brain Blast’s cognitive enhancements, albeit refined by Genius Friends and Interconnected Networking, diffusing mental strain and biological complications across the Network, exponentially accelerating Brain Trust’s growth rate and expansion to be up to near-global. This accomplishes more sophisticated mental simulations that are constantly field-tested by both a simulated mastery of all fields of study and a highly layered intelligence that reinvents itself every recursive loop. 

Networking, then, permanently connects with those minds you simulated and passively creates a “cognitive plane” where all cognitive simulations and data are stored and endlessly contemplated, culminating in all minds (simulated or otherwise) becoming a gestalt of the theoretical accumulated knowledge and intellect of the planet comparable to Type 3 Civilization in the Kardashev scale that (almost) the entire world can readily tap into and utilize for the ends and goals.

Whether this results in either neverending war or a post-scarcity global coalition, the [ANSWER] is closer to the Entities’ grasp more than ever.
addons.title: Supreme Intelligence

objects.text: Mental Probe, Enhanced Mastery, and Genius Friends joined forces to become a one-man Thinktank and Brain Trust. Mental Probe uses then expands Genius Friends’ effective range to a 100-meter radius to increase the intellect and proficiency of a random field of knowledge or skill to their limits, which Mental Probe simulates in turn. After this, the simulations are further enhanced with a second iteration of Genius Friends and Enhanced Mastery, forming tactical and technical experience that is almost indistinguishable from reality, thereby accelerating their thought process and theoretical simulated experience. This urges your Shard to require further data, snowballing into an expansion of your range by a factor of 10 once 1,000 minds are probed and simulated, and so on, reaching an area comparable to Boston or New York at its peak. These simulations are then put under a feedback cycle between one another exchanging and developing hypothesis and conclusions where they emulate a massive “focus group” or “brain trust” where they probe and predict events and changes under a wide range of fields these simulations could face or experience from a monthly quarter to a year (at your power’s peak) into the future near-accurately, foreseeing a city’s trends and events.
objects.title: Brain Trust

objects.text: Congratulations! You’re the most important person in the world, the one it all revolves around, the PROTAGONIST! What does this mean? Well, to start with, you’re just better than other people. In anything you try, you have a higher skill floor and no skill ceiling, prodigious levels of growth, and a knack for finding exactly what you need to get better. Beyond that, you possess a bizarre magnetism that draws people towards you. Just by being yourself you’ll find powerful allies drawn towards you, ready to become your friend (or more). Even if they could easily do better than you. In short, you naturally rise towards the top, and you’ll never be lonely at it. Besides your unstoppable improvement, there’s another, subtler power at work. You’ll find you have an unnatural tendency to get drawn into important events, an even more unnatural tendency to get back out of them, and a truly bizarre tendency to have benefited from the experience. You’ll find you’re always at the right place at the right time to insert yourself into all sorts of crazy adventures, and you’ll never end up in a situation you can’t get yourself out of with a little effort and quick thinking. And, of course, you should get something for your troubles, shouldn’t you? Right. So it’s only fair if you happen to pick up some useful tinkertech during your quest, or get gifted a power by some Trump, or pick up some exotic fighting technique. This doesn’t mean that you’re immune to setbacks or losses, but you’ll probably take them a lot better than someone else and come back stronger for it. This power also has a minor Trump aspect that works to hide its full extent from people, so the only part that can be confirmed as a power is your superhuman abilities. Your “charisma” and “luck” will seem to be just that to all methods of discerning powers.
objects.title: True Protagonist

addons.text: Your island self is no regular island, but a physical manifestation of your Shard and its Island within the Firmament. The ground which makes up your island is instead Shardmatter, as the ecosystems you can create become truly alien, with twisted non-euclidean geometry and strange crystal flora. This also allows you to manifest effects of your other powers at a massively increased scale, as you are effectively directly manifesting them from your Shard.
addons.title: Shard Island

addons.text: Your island body incorporates your nature as a living Fissure. The surface of your island body is home to a multitude of lesser Fissures—both small, large and absolutely crawling with that which is other, alien and abyssal ecosystems flourishing as reality fractures in your wake. Attempts to harm you are doomed to failure, as any that tried to interact with you without your permission are twisted and warped, even as the Abyss explosively responds in kind.
addons.title: Beachhead

addons.text: Your restriction about only being able to create ecosystems and creatures native to Earth has been lifted, allowing you to create non-standard creatures and environments, including things with innate powers.
addons.title: Land of Fantasy

addons.text: When transforming into your island self, you can optionally have the ecosystems upon it be automatically infested with flesh seeds, which skip to the later stages.
addons.title: Twisted Land

addons.text: Your island self and its ecosystems become distinctly “fleshy” and gain Echidna’s ability to clone others, absorbing all foreign organic life that touches you and spawning innumerable clones of it to populate your island. This means that with time, your ecosystems grow steadily more and more alien as they integrate each new thing absorbed. Additionally, your island body incorporates traits from things you’ve consumed, albeit scaled and up and warped to suit a living island.
addons.title: Assimilating Island

addons.text: Now, you can create ecosystems and creatures not just native to Earth in its current state, but also those that used to exist on Earth but are now extinct. Additionally, whenever you visit a planet, you gain the ability to create any non-supernatural organisms and ecosystems native to it.
addons.title: Jurassic Park

addons.text: With the inclusion of Primordial Mother, you’re less of a living island and more a living country, albeit a small one. Your size increases greatly, large enough to have entire mountain ranges and vast cave networks on your body. You also gain the ability to scale how large your island body is when transforming, so you can assume a smaller form. Additionally, you constantly improve and modify the beings that live upon you, making them undergo a form of accelerated evolution directed towards assisting your will. This means that with time, all sorts of alien landscapes greatly divorced from the norm can form, as even the most common lifeform can eventually diverge into something almost unrecognizable.
addons.title: Pangea

objects.text:
Rather than become an earthen titan, you instead transform into a gargantuan living island, a little over 5km across with its own ecosystems.
