You effectively have full control over every detail of this island and the flora and fauna that reside upon it, both when initially formed and as things develop, with the sole restriction that you cannot create ecosystems and creatures not native to Earth (or whatever planet you are on).

You also possess the ability to sprout a multitude of earthen legs from the underside of your island body, allowing you to stand up and move around even while transformed. Additionally, you do not age while transformed.
objects.title: Krakoa

addons.text: With your Shard’s interest in magical creatures, along with your magic/psionic/martial arts system(s) of course it would give each form their own spells or techniques. Now whenever you enter a mythical creature form you gain new power subsystems based on the creature’s anatomy and legends. For example turning into a Unicorn with (Trump/Brute) Martial Adept would give you sets of techniques based around using your horn and swift charges. A Dragon form with (Trump) Kineticist might have a psychic aura of fear and/or awe. Turning into a Chimera and having (Trump) Arcanist grants fusion spells. Not only do they grant new sets of techniques, ones that you already possess that might share common ground with the form have improved efficiency and potency. A basic blast used in a phoenix form might become enough to level a skyscraper, or a spell to raise an army of undead minions might become as cheap as a spell to resurrect a handful when used as a vampire. Lastly you can use your beast forms as inspiration for techniques that can be used in any form.
addons.title: Beast Mysticism

objects.text:
Your Shard was utterly attracted to humanity’s concept of mythical creatures. Rather than simply granting you transformations based on common belief, it delved into ancient, obscure, and even lost myths. Leveraging its vast stores of alien genetic [DATA], the Shard constructed living, plausible versions of these mythical creatures, reverse-engineered through xenobiology and evolutionary simulation.

You can now transform into any mythical creature, regardless of size, instantly. The previous growth mechanic of one inch per second is removed; your Shard’s improved biological processing allows you to assume forms on demand at any scale up to and including continental size. There is no upper size limit now, and shifting forms is no longer constrained by time or stamina. All transformations maintain full internal consistency, meaning organs, biology, and systems scale proportionally and functionally. Do note that the bigger the form, the more alien the experience—thus, the more effort needed to control it.

Additionally, the powers of your forms are no longer bound by modern or common interpretations of mythical creatures. Instead, your Shard incorporates all known interpretations, from the past, present, obscure, and forgotten. If a culture once believed that a phoenix could speak with the dead or that a manticore’s tail could manipulate gravity, those abilities are accessible within those forms.

A side effect of the use of alien biology introduces minor passive abilities from said aliens rather than the fantasy creature. These minor abilities may include additional senses, internal adaptations, or utility-based features like regenerative properties, toxin processing, or electromagnetic sensitivity. They may also remove certain weaknesses associated with your specific form. And because your forms are based on hard biology rather than supernatural constructs, they interact cleanly with physical reality. 

For example, a siren form can interface with sonar or underwater comms or a phoenix form might emit measurable radiation and use it for scanning or heat-based propulsion. Breaker-like effect prevents these forms from hurting you or collapsing under their own complexity, so there will be no issues such as internal organ failure, biological contradictions or collapse and backfiring.
objects.title: Beast King

objects.text:
Your human form now retains the full physical and power-based attributes of your dragon form at all times. This includes all Brute-level strength, durability, regeneration, elemental traits (fire breath), resistance scaling, and speed. You may optionally prevent aging beyond your physical prime. If you choose to age, only your appearance changes; your capabilities remain unaffected.

This isn’t to say your dragon form is meaningless. The sheer size of your dragon form means you have the benefits of momentum, force transfer, inertia and more. Additionally, this form also has a passive Breaker-type field that removes negative physical constraints such as leverage, friction, structural strain, or recoil. Only beneficial physics apply. This field does not prevent power-based debuffs unless they are physics-based.

Escalation in combat still applies, but its growth curve increases more steeply while in dragon form. Any increase in resistance (e.g., poison, electricity) becomes permanent and continues to scale upward with repeated exposure. Once resistance is high enough, you can also develop powers based off it. Escalation also now functions while not in combat, though at 10% normal speed, for as long as you are in your dragon form. You permanently retain all of the growth from your escalations, too.

Your dragon form also gains several new traits. This ranges from acidic blood, flames that burn non-flammable materials, functioning in any environment, including a vacuum, scales that can absorb 80% of energy from incoming attacks and convert it into stamina and regeneration and a few more minor things. In addition, these traits continue to grow and evolve independently, even when not in use or separated from your body. For example, spilled blood becomes more acidic over time, flames grow hotter the longer it is not put out, and shed scales become more durable, eventually functioning as high-end Tinkertech-tier materials. These detached traits cannot be consciously recalled or controlled, but are linked to your overall escalation state.
objects.title: Ancalagon

addons.text: Your draconic evolution has reached its final stage. Your dragon form is no longer just a weapon, but the template for a new dominant species, forged in fire, blood, and escalation. Allies you empower through Dragon Eggs now receive the full effects of Dragon of Kyushu and (Master) Dragon-Mail instead of only (Brute) Lung. Their escalation rate increases to 75% of your current escalation rate while within range, and they now echo 50% of your resistance adaptations while in combat. After a battle, empowered allies retain 20% of the peak escalation reached. These values are tracked and stacked across multiple battles. You no longer have a weekly cap on the number of permanent biological minions you can create. You may now produce unlimited constructs, with all previously established attributes, regeneration, and Breaker defenses intact. Constructs begin with 50% higher base stats compared to before, and their intelligence baseline improves from animal-level to low-human equivalence with passive growth scaling to combat experience and focused training. Intelligence development continues to scale with time and environmental exposure, up to high-human intelligence levels. Minions and empowered allies now possess shared escalation synergy. While within 100 meters of each other or yourself, all escalation rates are increased by 10% per individual within range, stacking additively with no upper limit. This resonance does not require active coordination and functions passively, however only applies to entities empowered or created by you, and does not extend to other parahumans or constructs.
addons.title: Dance of Dragons

objects.text: You are no longer a solitary apex predator, but the beginning of a species. You can permanently grant any ally (Brute) Lung. You can freely give and take away this power. These empowered allies gain the standard Lung escalation: transformation over time in combat, pyrokinesis, and enhanced senses. Outside of combat, they return to a base state. However, while fighting alongside you, these empowered allies escalate faster. Their escalation rate is linked to yours: they escalate at 50% of your current rate or faster if explicitly coordinated. If you gain resistances or power adaptations mid-combat, they may echo those effects at a reduced rate. These benefits only apply during active combat and in proximity to you (range ~100 meters). When returning to their base afterwards, they will also maintain 5% of the peak power they reached in their highest escalation. Each ally tracks their peak independently. Your biological minions created from (Master) Dragon-Mail become permanent. They no longer expire after 2 minutes and persist between battles unless destroyed. They retain the same biological durability, regeneration, and Breaker defenses, though their stats are initially weaker than empowered human allies. Their intelligence starts at animal level and increases over time, with active training and education accelerating this. Minions gain minor escalation if they remain alive and participate in combat. Each battle survived grants them a 1% increase to their base stats (stacking, cumulative), up to a soft cap of 50%. They do not gain new powers unless exposed to unique stimuli, and cannot exceed human intelligence without dedicated long-term care. You may have up to 12 permanent minions created per week.
objects.title: Dragon Eggs

addons.text: Rather than just being the bargain bin Triumvirate, you also have bargain bin variants of Cauldron powers, becoming something akin to a dollar store version of Cauldron. By integrating Numerical Boy into your Path to Victory [Bud], you reach a level close to the Path to Victory held by Contessa after The Thinker restricted it. You can path just about anything; however, some significant restrictions remain. You can only run a limited number of paths at once, with only a single path not having a limit on how long it can be, three paths lasting up to a month, and eleven paths lasting up to a week. You do not get to view your paths in detail or a significant degree of context surrounding your paths or the steps; you only get a summary and general understanding of how your paths interact and conflict. You also cannot model your blind spots, preventing you from working around your limitations to any degree. And last but not least, you have to fuel your paths yourself using collected [Energy], with every week’s worth of precognition draining the [Energy] equivalent to the blast yield of the Tsar Bomba. You can use a petajoule of energy to readjust your paths after encountering blind spots or to account for new triggers, allowing you to preserve your paths rather than them canceling out and wasting your energy entirely. Divine Gaze integrates (Thinker) Byakugan into itself, growing to give you a total awareness of anything within a 50-meter radius. You also gain a total awareness of everything within 50 meters of where you cast your gaze. You can cast your gaze into other dimensions and other Earths. You are sensitive to others calling your name, allowing them to catch your attention even if they are outside your perception range. This allows you to cast your gaze on them even without knowing where they are. You can create a dozen pairs of portals rather than just a single pair. This, along with divine gaze, allows you to instantly open portals anywhere you can cast your gaze, allowing you to open portals even to other dimensions and Earths. Your Breaker form becomes an invisible and intangible gaseous material, allowing you to phase through material objects while remaining unobserved. Due to your energy absorption, you are no longer weak to fire or electricity, and you can resist winds through your flight. Finally, your ability to wipe the memories of others grows significantly, allowing you to wipe anything from just the last five minutes to all of their memories while having perfect control over what gets wiped. This prevents you from erasing something you don't want to, allowing you to maintain things like language, education, or anything else required for basic function while erasing the rest.
addons.title: Dollar Store Cauldron

addons.text: By integrating (Trump) Paramount’s collection of tier one powers into (Trump) Daimon’s own catalog, you gain the ability to slot these tier one powers into (Trump) Daimon’s three slots, effectively giving you four slots. Unlike (Trump) Paramount, powers no longer require a few minutes to reach full strength. You can also draw upon this vast amount of [Data] to construct beam-blaster powers for Folktale, allowing you to expand its repertoire to near-endless degrees.
addons.title: Cardinal

objects.text: You have become the bargain bin version of the Triumvirate. Your slowed physique has integrated your ability to absorb energy passively, magnifying it to make you nearly invulnerable to energy-based attacks. This allows you to absorb any form of energy that comes into contact with you above a minor shove and convert it into [Energy]. You can then use this [Energy] to fuel both the powers you create through Daimon and the beams originating from Folktale. You gain the ability to absorb energy at a 30-meter radius actively; this is significantly less efficient than your passive absorption, as it uses some energy to expand your reach beyond your skin, causing a 5% to 10% loss of energy. Your flight has integrated your ability to weaken gravity's influence on you, elevating your flight speed to allow you to fly up to Mach 5, just below the threshold to reach hypersonic speeds. You can use your energy absorption to absorb the sonic booms your flight causes. This also speeds up your cognition and perception to match. You also form a tactile telekinetic field based on gravity manipulation. This field extends to cover your clothes, equipment, and anything you interact with to enhance your leverage, prevent things from collapsing under their own weight, and allow you to catch someone falling at high speeds without breaking their neck by absorbing the momentum while negating g-forces. Your ability to copy [Data] from other Shards enhances Folktale's ability to create beam variants from absorbed energy. Manifesting as a similar power to (Trump/Mover) Spright, just reconstructing copied [Data] as beam-blaster expressions rather than as Mover powers. You have complete control over the specifics of these reconstructed beam powers, from deciding their effect to something as frivolous as their color and shimmer pattern. These alternate beams become permanent expressions of Folktale rather than adding to Daimon's catalog, allowing you to use them freely regardless of what power you access using Daimon. With your enhanced brain evolving into a perfect memory and indexing, you can store copied [Data] indefinitely, allowing you to preserve manifested powers in a mental catalog. You can swap powers between your catalog and your slots in an instant, but you are still limited to only using three powers at once.
objects.title: Triarchy

addons.text: Pathfinder or The Seeker has opened Top-Down View’s capabilities, leading you the way to becoming the ultimate navigator. This lifts your range and accuracy limitations, substituting it with gaining less accurate data and information the farther you are from the effective area. Top-Down View’s map now features a search for the whereabouts of anything you’re looking for, with your map becoming an interactable overview where it passively finds and stores points of interest that you can place a marker on. Seeker offers indications and clues that narrow down the more data you process, while Pathfinder helps in calculating the most optimal path to anything you’re after with enough information; this contains advantages, shortcuts, the chance to avoid time sinks, and even allows you to be as covert or misleading depending on your Path. Together, Pathfinder helps Seeker to lower the margin of error, keenly computing the right Path to find or track anything with no loss of data or time, being self-correcting against any complication or eventuality, your Paths always updating in real-time, then it compiles more information.
addons.title: The Wayfarer

objects.text: Your reconnaissance powers merge into a technical scanning and detection marvel, capable of interpreting all the factors and data of an area and compiling them into a comprehensive map overview, akin to a Top-Down View of a 10km² area. Full Profile helps in ascertaining the area’s details and intricacies; meanwhile, Augmented Picture measures and correlates with other information you are aware of to accurately create a visual and general overview. Your mind visualizes it with HUD’s aid alongside your clairvoyant powers such as Eagle Vision, Dreamer or 3rd Person POV, heightening your perspective as a map window pictured in a user-friendly manner. Your power’s depth and fidelity at understanding and visualizing this information is rich and seamless, anticipating developing situations and actions by predicting its ebb and flow with the already analyzed data, signalled as markers or pop-up windows on your HUD. Its limitation is accuracy, as your power’s reliability is proportional to the amount of information it can picture and process, taking a certain amount of time, approximately 1-2 hours, to be relatively accurate at a 1km² area, and so on.
objects.title: Top-Down View

objects.text: Your shard is no longer bothering to even try being subtle in the ways it helps you. Your “luck” has begun outright warping reality to ensure you always get a perfect outcome. The world around you will shift and contort to minimize the effort it takes for you to do anything, any item you need will conveniently show up even if it has to fall out of the sky to do so, your most idiotic and impulsive plans will turn out to be exactly what you needed to do to win while the most brilliant and calculated plans of your enemies will turn into a series of complete blunders that only help you. It’s like the universe is bending over backwards to retroactively justify why every action you take was actually perfect and correct. Nothing happens to you without somehow being a net positive to your quality of life.
objects.title: Ultimate Luck

objects.text:
Did you know Eidolon's power and a version of Glory Girl's aura used to be a singular powerset belonging to a different character? You are now a stronger version of that; the union of your two powers caused heavy alterations to all of their functions.

Your flight turned into a telekinetic field that extends 5 centimeters from you and can not only be selectively applied and spread to things touching you, but also subconsciously used. It doesn't work on anything going faster than 80mph relative to your own speed, and it can only wrap around the entirety of something if it's loose and smaller than a two-story house; otherwise, it just wraps around a section of it—touching a door would only affect the door, touching a stick would affect the stick. The subconscious aspect of your telekinetic field is geared towards helping you, doing things like subtly adjusting your arm to actually hit a target, stopping your feet from triggering a trap, and unlocking a door you plan on going through. Over time, the size and speed it can handle will increase.

Your forcefield now has a sort of adaptive defense. Your forcefield will automatically tune its defense against a singular thing that has broken it in the past. Doing so makes it so the forcefield can't be broken by it again for as long as it is still tuned—in situations with more than one source of damage, it will prioritize the lesser evil. It considers separate sources of damage to be different even if their mechanics are the same, so a punch and a kick would count as different despite both being melee attacks. After a long time, similar sources will merge, allowing more things to become ineffective simultaneously.

Your aura is now an actual Master effect with a range of 100 meters, but with temporary effects, and it not only affects others but also you. It will control emotions and sentiments—shifting, weakening, strengthening, inducing, etc—of anything within range to an ideal state for a set time. When necessary, you can do it yourself, but only to a few targets at a time; you can also control the strength and behavior of your aura. By default, it will try to be subtle with its changes. An attempt at smiling would appear genuine, trying to cry would yield actual results, an ally could get a boost in confidence when they have a plan that might genuinely work, while a enemy would temporarily hesitate when about to deal a killing blow, etc. Long-term exposure eventually leads to someone being a valid target even outside the range.

And finally, your rotating powers work differently. As main powers, you can have five strong powers or nine weaker ones, but alongside them, you also gain fusions of those powers at half strength. Powers no longer start weakened, can last up to an entire day and are very likely to be exactly what you want if you aren't in a situation where "good enough" isn't enough. Powers you get can also influence your other three powers, like personal invisibility being shareable through your telekinetic field.
objects.title: Mary Sue

objects.text:
Your specialty has evolved from creating technology to creating the minds that create technology. You are a Tinker who builds other Tinkers.

Instead of simply giving them pre-programmed blueprints, you can transfer the fundamental knowledge and instincts of a specific Tinker specialty. These artificial Tinkers are fully autonomous, capable of independent invention within the domains you grant them. They can refine existing designs, produce novel prototypes, and even collaborate to accelerate research.

However, due to their immense complexity, they are incapable of self-reproduction; you alone possess the knowledge and capability to create new Tinkers, each one a unique megaproject that demands vast resources and your utmost attention.
objects.title: (Tinker) Tinkers

objects.text:
Each time you create or improve a device, the act of iteration not only strengthens that design but also branches into new technological insights, unlocking further nodes of understanding across multiple fields. The linear growth of Iterative Design becomes exponential, as every cycle of rebuilding becomes a catalyst for broad scientific breakthroughs. For instance, refining a crude plasma torch doesn’t just create a better cutting tool; it may simultaneously grant you new footholds in energy storage, materials engineering, and directed plasma physics.

Unlike the baseline Iterative Design, where one design improves along a single path, you may now develop multiple branches in parallel. A prototype no longer leads to one “next version” but can fork into entire families of related devices, each evolving independently. A single drone prototype may give rise to stealth, combat, and utility variants, each running its own iterative cycle while feeding knowledge back into your broader technology base. This parallelization creates adaptive ecosystems of Tinkertech rather than isolated projects, dramatically accelerating both practical utility and experimental diversity.

The paradigm also applies iteration not just to physical devices, but to the very structure of your tech trees. Every time you refine a project, you are also pruning inefficiencies in the conceptual pathways of your Shard’s research domain. For example, working on a railgun may reveal a faster route into advanced superconductors and magnetic confinement technologies, skipping over years of mundane groundwork. Each improvement is both an advancement of a device and a reconfiguration of your entire scientific framework, letting you reach late-stage concepts at greater speeds.

Finally, as your iterative cycles accumulate, they begin to crystallize into archetypal design templates. These are perfected philosophies of invention — distilled, universal blueprints for entire categories of technology. Once you have refined a field deeply enough, any new project within that domain begins at the level of the archetype rather than at a baseline. Say you’ve iterated heavily on energy weaponry: future plasma rifles, laser arrays, or particle beams won’t start as fragile prototypes but will instead emerge already at military-grade quality, needing only minor tweaks for specialization. Similarly, a biotech archetype might allow you to instantly produce advanced healing serums, gene-editing tools, or symbiotic armor without working your way up from crude prototypes.
objects.title: Iterative Research Paradigm

objects.text:
The time for evolution is nigh, and it is you who will reign in our species’ next form. Living Machine and Cybernetics have been fused and are now an aspect of Oh, the Humanity. With this fusion, you have stripped away nature’s slow, stumbling hand and replaced it with precision, direction, and purpose. Humanity is no longer bound to the compromises of biology; every cell, every organ, every limb can now be redesigned as an instrument of deliberate power and capability.

You can create augmentations that surpass any mechanical variant through sheer organics. Neural bio-ware can be grown to enhance the mind in logic, pattern recognition, and calculation until it matches the capacity of supercomputers. Musculature can be engineered to lift tons, run faster than sports cars, and absorb kinetic impacts not as damage but as fuel for healing or bursts of strength. Bones and organs can be reforged to shrug off tank fire, falls from skyscrapers, or pressures that would crush a submarine.  Within the chest, you can plant a bioreactor that powers all of these systems, making food and water unnecessary and eliminating waste entirely.

The sensory world itself bends under this design. Optical bio-ware grants nanoscopic resolution, perfect filtering of perception, telescopic focus, or even the ability to emit coherent beams of destructive light. The skin can host micro-matrices that read touch, heat, vibration, or magnetic fields with surgical precision. Neural lattices can distribute processing throughout the body, cutting reaction times to the edge of possibility and letting the flesh think as fast as the mind.

The human body also becomes its own arsenal. Combat augments can be as subtle as mono-molecular claws sliding from beneath the nails or as overt as internal factories producing plasma charges that melt steel with ease. Tissues can be cultured to harden instantly on impact, turning the body into armor. Blood can carry dormant vesicles, inert until triggered into weapons. Even new hybrids of muscle and neural tissue fibers that process thought and act as one. Design a procedure that allows someone to generate a strength-enhancing exoskeleton from either their entire body or parts of it.

Every flaw in the human form can be corrected (our spines, retinas, nervous system, arteries, etc), our very weaknesses can be erased with surgical suites the size of warehouses containing bio-pods, organic nanite cultures, and automated systems capable of rewriting a patient from the marrow outward. These augmentations can be grafted individually or spliced into the genome, ensuring that descendants inherit not by chance but by design. No more lottery of traits, children will be born already bearing the scaffolds of chosen enhancements, a living continuation of deliberate and controlled evolution.

Control remains absolute. These augments are not alive, not independent, not semi-sentient. They are organs, tissues, extensions of the host, and nothing more. They respond only to the one they are built for, locked by unique neurochemical signatures and resistant to tampering. Any who attempt to interfere leave scars and residues that cannot be hidden. Your work is so seamless that even other cyberneticists struggle to distinguish your bio-ware from machine implants, yet yours are always three times superior in every metric.

This fusion works with other Tinker powers as well; any other Tinker power you have, you can create some augmentations based on the specialty that you obtain. Choosing Kinesis would allow you to design implants that can grant someone the ability to manipulate matter like a weak form of telekinesis; it could be synergized with other Tinker powers just as the main specialty does. Manton Limits would make it so all your designs are protected specifically against biokinetics, fleshwarpers, biomancy, and the like.

Sanguis Ex Machina is not the addition of parts, but the rewriting of what it means to be human. You can heal any injury, erase any ailment, and build organs nature never conceived of. You can remove hunger, thirst, fatigue, frailty, and even mortality in all but name. The common man is made transhuman at your touch, and entire bloodlines can be sculpted into dynasties of perfection. Nature has played its role and has had its chance. Now it is your turn.
objects.title: Sanguis Ex Machina

addons.text: Rampage Dress’s particle and cellular level precision supercharges your electromagnetic transformation. While transformed, you can individually manipulate both electromagnetic forces and charged particles in your environment—electrons, ions, plasma, specific currents inside living beings or machinery, etc—with gross ease. This opens up a wide variety of possibilities to you: read or interfere with neural signals in real time, form particle streams into beams or whips, shape contained plasma fields into constructs, create illusions through the principles of illusion optics, or simply control charged particles to create vibrations and, by extension, sound. When transformed, you may only be able to interact through electromagnetism, but in those interactions, you are god.
addons.title: Electromagnetic Avatar

addons.text: With the inclusion of (Shaker/Breaker) The One Who Tamed Lightning, Rampage Dress drastically amplifies the level at which it can operate. Your range for both controlling and sensing electromagnetism has quadrupled, and your output has been amplified by several orders of magnitude. This allows for applications such as electromagnetic pulses spanning several neighborhoods, particle-beam barrages capable of leveling city blocks, or simply amplifying your physical capabilities to the point of being able to flatten buildings and tank blows of similar power.
addons.title: Meltdowner

objects.text:
Your ability to control and sense electromagnetism has deepened, providing immensely precise control within or extremely close to your body as well as the ability to sense and individually pick out electromagnetic fields within a 250-meter radius. Your control is precise enough to manipulate electrical signals at the cellular level or even manipulate individual charged particles.

This is primarily used to stimulate your cells and draw out further strength and potential, with applications ranging from strengthening your sense of smell by increasing the sensitivity of your olfactory cells to rapidly accelerating your regeneration to the point that people could mistake you for having never been injured at all.

However, it is also possible to perform applications such as turning yourself into a human taser, creating charged particles to use for particle beams, or modifying your personal shield to disrupt or deflect powers or attacks that utilize charged particles as well.
objects.title: Rampage Dress

objects.text:
A sliver of Scion’s might has taken root, causing you to mirror the Entity’s avatar in miniature.

Your version of Stilling has shed its original limitation, allowing it to operate at full potency across its entire range, no longer subject to dilution. Furthermore, its effective radius has expanded considerably, enough to envelope an entire city. With this, you can replicate much of Scion’s arsenal: flight, super strength, power negation and more.

By compressing it into a smaller space or focused direction, you can project Stilling outward as condensed blasts, beams and constructs that reach beyond your normal range, albeit this proportionally reduces your total coverage. You could fire arcing lasers that level towns on the horizon or ignite forests, reminiscent of Gold Morning.

In parallel, your awareness has heightened to provide continuous sensory perception of every wavelength within your aura’s standard radius. Your shard has boosted your cognitive capacity to handle this vast influx of information, enabling manipulation of these wavelengths without loss in coordination or accuracy.

Your projected body is also no longer as tightly bound to a single reality as before; you can traverse dimensional boundaries to enter pocket realms or alternate worlds akin to walking. However, you can only peer into and access worlds directly adjacent to your current reality, requiring step-by-step travel, or to dimensions with an existing link to them.

Lastly, you have a limited form of Path to Victory. You can see the steps needed to work towards or achieve a goal within a ten-second window and instinctively execute them with flawless precision. During this, the future you perceive matches that path, almost making it feel like you’re just “going through the motions”.

This path continuously recalibrates in real time, automatically updating the future you see as time, circumstances and goals change. By shifting your intent or queries, you can glimpse alternative possible futures and gather information, but only within ten seconds.

All combined, you appear as a microcosm of Scion; weaker but no less daunting.
objects.title: Scion Junior

objects.text:
“We stole the sun from the sky, to power the machines of our invention, to spite the Gods that have abandoned us. And when they finally come back, to bring the extinction of our species…

We will be ready…”

Somehow, you have managed to make two conflicting concepts work together with minimal issues.

Your ability to exploit and harvest resources has massively increased, thanks to Solarpunk’s renewable initiatives.

Using your harvested resources, you can now build renewable factories, sending production skyrocketing despite using only half the materials.

You could even cover entire deserts in solar powered hydroponics to produce human grade kibble. It might not taste great, but it’s packed with all the nutrients a worker needs to stay healthy.

And finally, your crowning achievement: you’ve learned how to artificially seed habitable planets, just so you can periodically harvest their resources.

Yet this is only scratching the surface, with time and research you’ll unravel the secrets of this unholy amalgamation of progress.

You’re no longer chasing shortsighted profit or naive protection of nature. You are creating perfect, self-contained ecosystems where nothing goes to waste, and the profit is eternal.
objects.title: Eclipse Punk

objects.text: “Your Shard has decided that the distinction between insect and dragon is a matter of insufficient imagination.” Your Changer state becomes an intermediary apex form—an insectoid draconic wyrm forged from every lesson your Shard has learned so far. This hybrid body stands roughly ten meters at the shoulder and stretches nearly thirty meters from horn to tail, a perfect fusion of chitinous precision and draconic presence. Your body is sheathed in layered dracochitin, plates that blend the refractive, shimmering qualities of insect wings with the overlapping resilience of draconic scales. Each plate flexes and ripples like living armor, shifting hue depending on angle, mood, and the environment. These layers breathe with your movement, opening micro-vents that release heat, pheromones, or corrosive vapors. Your wings—now six instead of four—form a triple-stacked array. Two pairs are long and glasslike, suited for stable gliding and draconic soaring; the third pair is smaller and inset, capable of vibrating at impossible speeds to produce instant acceleration or hovering capability. The combined structure makes your flight effortless, silent when you choose, and explosively fast when you desire. Your head retains compound eyes, but each lens is now faceted with internal metallic laminae, giving them a subtle, emberlike glow. You process motion across thousands of micro-perspectives, yet your Shard has given you a draconic fovea—one central layer that provides razor-sharp targeting across miles. Your mandibles remain, but the proboscis has evolved into a retractable, spined structure that can function for feeding, sensory analysis, or delivering venom. Your breath weapon has evolved and mutated into the full realization of everything your Shard has attempted before, splitting into two separate versions which can be used individually or combined into a composite breath. There is the normal breath of white hot fire, but also a spray of a gel-like sticky substance which clings to surfaces and burns like thermite and is incredibly toxic. Combined they turn into a stream of incandescent emerald fire laced with a virulent curse of poison and rot which withers flesh and pits metals pit as the venom seeks molecular weaknesses. Inside your body, your metabolic core works in tandem with an acid furnace, a specialized organ cluster inspired by the legend of Nidhoggr. Your hemolymph circulates through this acidic crucible, imbuing it with properties that are simultaneously toxic, caustic, and thermally reactive. When spilled, it burns like acid, smokes like venom, and flashes into fire when exposed to high kinetic stress, resulting in anything that pierces your armor being punished with a gout of toxic steam and boiling viridian fire capable of withering flesh, corroding alloys, and choking machinery. Furthermore, it is not merely reactive—alive with enzymic agents that adapt to the chemical or biological composition of whatever they contact, optimizing their destructive potential.
objects.title: 100% More Dragon, 200% More Bug

objects.text:
You wield a single, unified biokinetic ability: within a 500 metre radius, you can perceive and manipulate all carbon-based biological matter, encompassing every organism, tissue and cell.

You are capable of telekinetically exerting enough force on a target to casually squash an elephant into a bloody, minced paste or surgically cut through bone like melted butter. There’s no limit to the amount of biomass you may affect at once within your range.

You also have unlimited multi-tasking capacity and passive intuitive awareness over all carbon-based biological material around you, down to the genetic level. This greatly increases the scale and speed at which your biokinesis can operate although fine-tuned alterations still take time and focus.

For example, you could remotely heal large numbers of hospitalised patients simultaneously, crush the organs of your foes in the midst of battle, deftly control individuals’ nervous systems to turn them into your puppets and use their powers or telekinetically lift your allies so they can fly alongside you.

However, while you can exert force on your own body to maneuver it, your shard’s restrictions on precisely biologically changing and modifying yourself, akin to Panacea, are still in place.
objects.title: Discount Shaper

objects.text: Your tech-level, ability to work with subpar materials, and reality-warping assistance from your Shard scale with how much you need your creation in the immediate term. This scales off of true need, so if you’re simply preparing for a big fight which could kill you you might get a bit of an extra boost, but you were say, dying in a locker with nothing but rotting tampons and bugs, you could feasibly build a handheld one-use teleporter with nothing but a few metal shavings from the locker, some bug shells and nerves, and your own blood.
objects.title: Emergency Construction Protocols

addons.text:
Your causality speciality has been folded into your temporal specialty and been similarly jailbroken. This massively boosts your ability to interfere with the flow of time and natural order of cause and effect. 

This allows for the achievement of effects unbound by the flow of time or natural progression of events, such as a projectile phasing through an obstacle because in some arbitrary future the obstacle isn’t there, or climbing gear allowing you to climb “nothing” because there used to be a building in this location.

At the peak of this specialty you can induce an effect completely unrelated to its cause (or even without one entirely), weaponize paradoxes to cause a target to experience critical existence failure, or even completely overturn causality to retroactively remove or alter something while keeping the rest of the series of events unchanged via temporal anchoring; for example healing an injury by making it so the wound which caused it never happened in the first place while also not altering any other events in the process, leaving the present untouched save for the lack of injury.
addons.title: Atemporal Architecture

addons.text:
Your spatial and interdimensional specialities have merged with your unchained temporal specialty to unlock the full breadth of the Entities’ mastery of space, time, and the dimensional fabric. This even overlaps with Power Tinkering to a certain extent, as you are entirely capable of interfacing with and replicating the interdimensional functions upon which the entire system of Shards and Parahumans rests. 

You can create stabilized and hidden pocket dimensions, hyperbolic time chambers which are larger on the inside, containment fields which isolate the target outside of reality and cut off dimensional access (disabling and/or shielding from Parahuman powers in the process), scanners which trace the dimensional connections between Parahumans and their Shards, a sword which severs space, and much more.

You can even recreate the effects of some Parahuman powers via the underlying mechanics of drawing from or shunting to other dimensions. At the height of this tech tree is stuff like a technological recreation of Sting, a device which fiddles with or optimizes the connection between a Parahuman and Shard in order to influence their Power’s functionality, or even opening a path straight to Shardspace.
addons.title: Spatio-Temporal Specialization

objects.text: Through [TRIUMPHANT] and the inclusion of temporal-based computing, your Tinker specialization has been jailbroken and expanded from temporal dilation to cover every possible aspect of time with almost no restrictions. As a tinker, you are to temporal manipulation what Hero was to wavelength manipulation. This allows you to accomplish essentially any temporal effect the Entities are capable of, albeit in technological form. Teleportation via skimming the time stream? Check. Stasis bombs? That’s child’s play. A gun that fast-forwards targets into dust? Totally doable. Hell, you could even create things like a “healing” serum that literally rewinds damage or a time-locked suit functioning like Alexandria’s power. This power is capable of creating a fully functional and unrestricted time machine—although without Negentropy or extensive efficiency refinements you won’t be getting more energy out than you put in, and the energy costs will be immense.
objects.title: Temporal Tinkering

addons.text:
Supreme Intelligence spreads your psychic prowess to every member of your collective, more than that however, your collective shares its processing power and psionic energy - and in the case of Parahumans your Shards share resources and energy as well. 

Each addition to the network further increases your collective power, expanding the web of ascendant minds. As your collective’s psychic prowess grows, the “cognitive plane” formed becomes more and more real, transforming into a semi-virtual reality akin to Shardspace, a true Akashic Plane. 

The logical apex of this is the complete subsumption of the human race into a single gestalt consciousness, a psionic equivalent of an Entity whose sheer collective psychic might is enough to effortlessly warp reality on a global scale and whose intelligence makes achieving the [ANSWER] inevitable. The only question is whether your Shard will run out of power before you manage to achieve it.
addons.title: Cognitive Singularity

addons.text: Your own burgeoning psychic prowess has influenced and amplified your psychic Tinkering, unlocking new avenues of development. The most apparent change is that your psychic technology now encompasses Psychokinesis and Kineticist, allowing you to create devices which replicate most powers. However, you also gain the ability to create true mechanical minds. Not AI as they are commonly perceived, but self-sustaining and growing psionic entities housed in circuits and steel, ‘machine spirits’ if you will. These artificial minds can use their psionic energy to alter, repair, or even enhance their vessel beyond what it would normally be physically capable of.
addons.title: Nous Mechanicus

addons.text: Your Psionic Ascension, coupled with a few upgrades, has taken Absolute Territory Field to a whole new level. Within the range of your psychic reach, you are effectively a God, able to arbitrarily dictate the rules of reality, no matter how specific or nonsensical. If you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless you can even establish laws governing esoteric or conceptual effects.
addons.title: Absolute Domain

objects.text:
Your psychic powers have fused together into a single unified whole, taken beyond their previous limits. 

For starters, every aspect of your psychic prowess - both your starting prowess and your speed of growth - has magnified by an order of magnitude, allowing you to “hit the ground running” so to speak and skip the early stages of your growth. 

Most impressive however is the fact that you effectively don’t have a hard cap to your growth, your mind and psychic prowess able to grow ever greater. Eventually you’ll be able to transcend your physical body entirely and exist as an entity of psionic energy which is effectively a god of the physical world.
objects.title: Psionic Ascendancy

addons.text:
As a Lich, your Shadow Extraction has been taken to the next level. To start things off, your pool of energy for maintaining Shadows has doubled in size and now slowly grows even when not in dark areas.

Now onto the interesting parts. Firstly, you can now raise the Shadow of an Endbringer or Titan, should you manage to get your hands on their corpse. However, the energy costs needed to maintain them will be worthy of their full strength.

Second, and more interestingly, you can now permanently expend some of your energy pool to enhance a Shadow, making it stronger and potentially even evolving it and its capabilities to greater heights. The energy cost to enhance a Shadow scales with its current capabilities, so enhancing a random street-tier parahuman to Triumvirate levels would still be cheaper than even minorly loosening an Endbringer’s limitations.

Your ability to Tinker with your Undead has also mutated, streamlined by your Shadows’ ethereal nature. Shadows can be combined for a slight energy cost, becoming hybridized into a composite whole greater than the sum of the individual Shadows. While multiple Shadows can be combined into one, they cannot be combined if one of the Shadows is itself a combination of other Shadows. The combination of multiple Shadows requires less energy to maintain than the sum of its original components.
addons.title: Legion of Shadows

addons.text:
As the embodiment of Darkness, you do not merely raise Shadows—you rule over them.

Your dominion is reflected in the sheer scale of your energy reserves. Your pool of energy for maintaining Shadows is gargantuan, so vast that it would take casually raising the population of a modern first-world city to put a noticeable dent in your stockpile. This is before even accounting for your passive energy generation, which has itself scaled alongside the size of your reserves.

This supremacy extends to the refinement of your Shadows. Your ability to enhance or combine them has been greatly improved: upgrades require less energy to apply, and weaker Shadows are automatically refined upon being raised. Even the Shadow of a completely ordinary civilian or animal is elevated to rival a street-tier parahuman from the moment of its creation.

Combination, too, has reached its apex. Shadows may be merged freely, without cost, and the process can be performed recursively—fusions combining with other fusions to produce ever greater composite beings. When doing so, you may choose whether the result is permanent or temporary, granting unparalleled flexibility in how your Shadows are deployed.

Finally, your mastery over Shadows has turned inward. Your ability to combine them now synergizes with your power to become a living shadow, allowing you to merge Shadows with yourself and wield their forms and abilities as your own.
addons.title: Shadow Monarch

objects.text: Your shadow monster and undead-creating powers have combined to produce Shadow Extraction, a unique form of necromancy. Rather than directly raising a corpse as a minion, you instead extract the “shadow” of a deceased being from its remains, creating a shadowy figure akin to the Shades produced by the Faerie Queen. Shadows are created from a template drawn from the body from which they were extracted, possessing all of the powers and knowledge of their original. However, as “shadows” who are fundamentally not the same existence as their origin, they are untethered from preexisting attachments or loyalties, experiencing their origin’s experiences from a detached perspective. Extracting a shadow is free; however, only a certain number of Shadows can be maintained at once, dictated by the amount of energy you have available and the strength of the Shadows being maintained. Stronger Shadows require more energy devoted to them in order to sustain their existence. If you cannot sustain a Shadow then it will simply dissipate, being permanently lost to you. The energy you use to maintain Shadows is a combination of the energy pool from (Master) Shadow Servant and the points from (Master) Undead, meaning that through Shadow Lands, your pool slowly increases in size in dark areas. Like normal shadow monsters, raised Shadows can be stored in your shadow.
objects.title: Shadow Extraction

objects.text: You have integrated (Stranger) You Are A Dragon And That's Okay, (Stranger) Catch Me If You Can, and (Stranger/Master) Trend Setter capabilities into your SEP field, transforming it into a NOP field. Now, instead of shifting perceptions into believing your actions are someone else's problem, it simply makes them not perceive a problem. Regardless of how abnormal or horrific your actions may be, no one will bat an eye. As such, you do not face consequences for your actions, as nobody can tell you were supposed to face one in the first place. This means the IRS won't harass you for tax evasion, nor will you be pulled over for speeding, and the cops won't arrest you, even if you commit major crimes in public view. This is strong enough to distort the thoughts of Thinkers or those trained in anti-master or stranger protocols, leaving even the PRT unable to detect your influence, and thus won't target you. You can extend this field to affect others, internalizing the actions you take as okay and that there is nothing that should or would prevent them from doing the same actions themselves, such as dignity or the law. This notably does not prevent their conscience from preventing them from doing any such normalized acts. So a good person isn't going to join you in murdering people in the streets.
objects.title: No One’s Problem

objects.text: ”60 seconds to Midnight.” One second is all it takes. All hell breaks loose. Calamity consolidates into a single truth: “Ashes, ashes, we all fall down.” All your powers unite to embody the very concept of a Crisis. While your powers remain as they are at first, once you kick this fusion off by letting your powers interact, it’ll be irreversible. It goes off like a bomb; a city quarter engulfed by a second’s notice. Loosely following a pattern you can guide but never fully control, as all means of fine control went out of the window the moment your powers came together. A Butterfly’s Wings begins with flooding the area with Energy Well’s calamitous energy signature, slowly growing your influence; Jinx and Calamity manifest by design, able to synergize with Fatalis Engine’s engineered lethality, smearing and brushing ruin, yet on a looser scale. The latter can be guided, but is largely random, slotting semi-random slots designed to intensify lethality and agony. Then, the ace in the hole takes effect: time starts to crawl and stretches to the point where a moment lasts an hour, with every second feeling like an everlasting moment. ”37 seconds to Midnight.” Every second enhances the power’s influence and range by a factor of ten, from a city quarter, an area comparable to the biggest state in the United States in ten, to almost the globe. As We Know It comes to play: apocalypses and revelations make themselves known, every flavor and art form entailing the End forming a collage and a joint effort to make their mark upon the Earth. Every attempt, and every defiance in survival, is met with whiplash: Jinx and Calamity will redouble their efforts, appearing targeted to the plain eye; Fatalis Engine is refined with creative, lethal applications within its slots, adding flavor to the former disastrous calamities; and As We Know It merges it all together to a cohesive yet chaotic whole. ”11 seconds to Midnight.” At the last seconds, it crescendos into a ruinous symphony, with all resulting in snuggling the world on an ever-shifting doomsday, each outmatching the other. All people outside the splash zone experience utter hopelessness at their inevitable turn; every attempt at understanding is faced with a strong Stranger/Master effect, creating a sense of foreboding at every new nugget of information they encounter about your power. The least they can do is take the brunt with their chin up. ”Clock strikes 12, Midnight Arrives.” At the end of it all, there’ll be nothing left to save, with all that remains is the silence of the coming after: Memento Mori. Thus, the Cycle begins again. Your Shard’s Manton Limit, of course, or else this would’ve been short-lived or suicidal, ensuring your survival after your 1-minute doomsday. It, consequently, guarantees you find yourself in another place afterwards in the last second, another area where the air is rife with misfortune; it doesn’t matter how or why, you’ll be there, your finger already about to pull the pin for the rebound.
objects.title: One Second to Midnight

objects.text: On second thought, wouldn’t it be so wasteful to leave civilization to its own devices without the chance to bounce back? Sure, a post-apocalyptic landscape is an environment rife with [Data] and Hosts, but no safety net they can fall back on; quite a way to squander resources for nothing. But what if you hold back? You draw it out? You make it quick enough to be efficient, but long enough to make it last? It’ll be another kind of Hell, that’s for sure. By scaling your effective range from a half-global scale to a small village, starting from 5 city blocks as a base, you’re able to fully control the variables and factors surrounding or contributing to your engineered ruin, rather than broadly steering it toward a theme or tone of your preference. You don’t lose your original range, more so reclaim your range the more havoc and mayhem you produce, adding half a kilometer to your range every time you cause irreparable damage that ensures a 10 Trigger Events. Owing to your control at a micro and macroscale, you might as well activate One Minute to Midnight remotely, at least a hundred kilometers or less, generating one or several self-sustaining bubbles made of A Butterfly’s Wings’ energy with all that entails, with 5 bubbles being the best you can do at the beginning. Within, you can carefully pick your disaster’s ingredients and spices, Fatalis Engine is expanded and fully at your disposal in terms of selecting and removing the factors influencing the overarching themes of Doomsday, Ceaseless and As We Know It, including tailor-made woe and ruin to the population’s worst case scenarios. You draw out these insights by your newly developed awareness within the bubble, using the energy suffusing the area, and feel its probabilities, analyzing the worst possible aftereffects for the population, cross-examining their collective psychology, and available probabilities. It adds an element of fully embracing its underlying purpose as a breeding ground for Parahumans, ensuring the needed environment for Crisis Points in the Cycle. It also has the consequence of lowering lethality, ensuring survivability, and unnecessarily destroying civilization at every use.
objects.title: Let No Crisis Go to Waste

objects.text:
(Trump) Rainbow and (Trump) David's Trash Can have fully fused.

Instead of being tied to individual powers, [Time] is now tied to each of Eidolon's Younger Cousin Dave 10SP points, they will only accumulate [Time] while being used for a power. Whenever a power is changed or dropped, the associated points will lose half their [Time]. 

In exchange for being able to use 10 SP worth of powers at once, the [Time] accumulation rate for each point is now 1/10. You must expend [Time] from all 10 points to activate the boost.

Prismatic Boost has reverted back to a percentile boost, but now enhances powers to 1000% strength instead of 700%.
objects.title: Eidolon’s Prismatic Copy-Cat

addons.text:
I stand corrected, you weren’t truly the master of Time, at least not until now. With the inclusion of proper time travel and negentropic principles, you have truly transcended time, your ability to alter its flow being unmatched. 

Time travel, temporal duplicates, true precognition via literally observing the future, all this and more can be done with ease. If you were so inclined and didn’t need to worry about energy costs, it is entirely plausible for you to alter the flow of time across an entire planet.
addons.title: Χρόνος

addons.text: Inception has introduced a new direction for your temporal mastery and timeless nature to expand, transforming you into an acausal existence. At a passive level, your body and actions violate causality; in fact, it takes effort to abide by the laws of cause and effect. Arriving at a location before moving because you decided to be there, acquiring food without making it because you were hungry, etc. This also severely loosens restrictions like how many times actions can be recursively inverted and the length of time you can invert. If taken with Χρόνος then your limits are fully shattered, allowing you to recursively fold and alter causality across an entire year's worth of time.
addons.title: Acausal Existence

objects.text:
Your timeless nature has seamlessly assimilated your other temporal abilities, jailbreaking your power and rendering you the undisputed master of Time. You can rewind, freeze, slow, accelerate, or skip time for anything you choose, ranging from individual objects or people to entire regions of space and everything in them, even precisely targeting select portions of something without affecting the greater whole. 

This has a wide variety of applications. Seemingly teleport by moving to a place you could potentially be in the future, turn obstacles into dust by instantly aging them several millennia, “heal” by rewinding the target to a previous state, accelerate yourself to move faster, etc. As a side benefit, if you are ever mortally wounded or killed your power will automatically rewind your body back to a healthy state, akin to Grey Boy or Alabaster.

Additionally, you can selectively ignore temporal effects and interact with them/their contents as if they were normal, allowing you to do things such as freeze a sword in time to wield it as an All-or-Nothing weapon or freeze your own body’s condition, replicating Alexandria’s durability.
objects.title: Chronos

objects.text:
Your unique powers influence your burgeoning Entity-like physiology, driving you off the evolutionary path that resulted in modern entities into something even they could only describe as “a monster.” You’re a destructive force that sustains itself by messily devouring planets, stars, and other Entities.

Rather than develop shards that can break off of your body you have remained one contiguous being. From your perspective, that is. With all your reality- and spacetime-warping powers you no longer obey the usual layout of reality. Your body exists somewhere inside itself, between the Collective Unconscious and a wonderland dimension outside reality. You move through time as naturally as the entities move through dimensions, and if anything you’re better at interdimensional travel. Extensions of you can poke out into reality, reaching into all manner of different times and places. These arms can range in scale from no larger than a human forearm to geographic landmarks that can be seen for miles, but they all contain a dimension within them that contains the entirety of yourself, including the arms which contain the dimension you are in.

Any of your arms is stronger than a Gestalt Thoughtform, adding the chaotic and maddening nature of your frenzied flame, oceanic abyss, and otherworld fog to the psychic influence you possess to make each one an eldritch presence in its own right, capable of rewriting minds and fully upending the order of the world. Your actual body, so much more vast, could literally shatter half a solar system, across every dimension, at every point in time if you moved entirely into realspace and put in the effort.

Your arms can drag anything that comes near them into their dimension, following the same rules as Fenris; even esoteric effects like Gray Boy bubbles can be dragged in, and this counts as devouring for the purpose of growing your own power. The things you drag into you are digested by your chaotic elemental powers, but you can choose to un-digest them and spit them out from one of your arms. Anything recreated this way will be subtly warped in an undefinable way, even if you were to choose to faithfully reproduce it, and it may not interact with reality in the same ways it once did.

Your species, if others than you truly exist as more than a cautionary tale shared among Entities, have a method of hunting by traveling to an inhabited planet and rewriting its history to drive the dominant civilization into division and conflict, making them more enticing targets for a cycle, then lying in wait. When an Entity or group of Entities lands they are soon dragged into the arms and digested. Shortly afterwards the planet is torn to pieces and the largest pieces are devoured, and they move on to another hunting ground.
objects.title: The Beast

objects.text: Your two tentacle powers fuse, giving you access to many more tentacles and allowing you to partially convert your body into tentacles. Full transformation is now 3 times better and also affects the strength of your power channeling — you receive 1/3 of the benefits when not fully transformed. The transformation no longer needs hydratation, and your tentacles can get a perfect grip even if they were made of grease.
objects.title: Tentacle Monster

objects.text:
Your wings and tentacles fuse, becoming ten limbs that can switch between both. Their designs add up together, and they can manifest in each others locations — so for example, shoulder wings can appear in the place of waist tentacles. Upgrades that applies to one will also apply to the other, such as More Tentacles, or Elevation.

Their boosting adds up together, and now works a bit differently. Not only can each limb channel a different power, but you can also temporarily fuse up to ten channeled powers at a time — the strength of the result and the quantity of powers involved will determine the strain upon your body and mind. The flexibility of tentacles and the freedom of wings also offers you one final thing, the capacity to channel variants of a power through your limbs, in turn also temporarily giving you them — of course said variants must be something that can reasonably be seem as such, you aren't getting concrete manipulation out of (Master/Thinker) Skitter.

You can optionally get a halo that matches the design of your limbs.
objects.title: Winged Tentacles

objects.text:
Through a fusion Citrine's zone of attunement and Finger Painting's permanent alteration of surfaces, Citrine's attunement has gained permanence.

The once fixed yellow hue to your zone is now variable; its color changing from effect to effect. This hue can be imbued into anything within your Zone, or the area itself, making your effects permanent.

This allows you to create materials and even areas of infinitely variable properties. From blue bubbles of distorted gravity to indigo hyper adhesive sand.
objects.title: Palette

objects.text: You have merges your two states. Your body now exists in a stable, exaggerated cartoon form. You retain the core elongated proportions, towering height, and extended reach of Odd Proportions, but its grotesque, uncanny appearance is overwritten by the aesthetic of Exaggerated Figure. The result is a rubbery, elastic, and solidly built cartoon physique. Your durability synthesizes both powers into a unified defense. You possess the dense, superhuman toughness of Exaggerated Figure layered with the unconventional damage processing of Odd Proportions, which now operates on cartoon logic. Blunt impacts cause compressive, localized deformation, meaning your body may dent, stretch, or flatten, before snapping back to shape with minimal injury. This makes you highly resistant to cumulative trauma, area attacks, and kinetic force. Your primary physical vulnerability shifts to precise piercing and cutting damage. Your strength is both the raw, amplified power of Exaggerated Figure and the leveraged, momentum-based force of Odd Proportions. A new element is controlled elasticity; your limbs and torso can stretch and snap back within a defined limit, effectively doubling your already immense reach for strikes and grabs. This elastic property also grants you rapid, lurching mobility, allowing you to cover large distances with springy leaps or pull yourself toward anchored limbs. Lastly, your power subtly warps local physics to accommodate your cartoonish movements, causing them to be exponentially more effective than they should, favoring dramatic and visually impressive actions over subtle ones. This state is permanent and cannot be toggled off without Holding Back. Your presence is overwhelmingly conspicuous, marked by a charismatic, larger-than-life aura.
objects.title: Be The Cartoon

objects.text:
When your Shard first deployed into the Cycle, it does something different from the standard Shard pattern by looking into the countless simulations created by the host species, often referred to as 'works of fiction' for inspiration. It found something in a form of a certain character from a 'horror game' on one of the many Earths.

As you can imagine, with you being the Shard's host, you now have shed your fleshy body and become the character of its inspiration: Bendy the Ink Demon.

To begin, your default form is now that of a cute, charming, rubber-hose cartoon demon sharing the same height as Vista, though you still have the ability to shift into other forms that you can come up with thanks to your malleable nature as an entity made of ink. Regardless of whatever form you take, one thing that stays consistent is your altered physical attributes. You can punch through tanks, moves thrice as fast as a speeding car, and are durable and elastic enough to survive a punch from Alexandria or getting flattened by Behemoth.

In addition to this, you gain a new minor Thinker ability that makes you a professional expert in drawing and painting, which has led to the Inkling and Mirror Images aspects of your powers evolving at a nightmarish rate, making you a S-Class threat surpassing Nilbog and Glaistig Uaine herself, if villainous ambition is your chosen path.

Yet, this pales in comparison with your Ink itself.

You Ink has permanently taken on the 'Toon Physics' that your Be The Cartoon power has granted, and this allows any and all of your ink constructs to gain the wacky and illogical powers of cartoons. This means that an anvil of Ink would weigh more than enough to sink Alexandra several feet into the ground, a stick of dynamite made of Ink would explode with enough force to fling an Endbringer into the air, and more wacky stuff. As a final bonus for this, you have the option to 'paint over' a person with your Ink to temporarily grant them a limited form of Be The Cartoon.

For a finishing touch, you gain a decent knack for music and performance arts.​
objects.title: Ink Demon

addons.text:
Your movement and the kinetic interactions you perform during it are now temporally anchored, becoming causally locked events. Upon initiating a movement to strike a target or exert force upon an object, the successful impact and application of force are established as an immutable past fact within your local timeline. For the target or object, your force is treated as having already been applied the moment your motion begins; any subsequent attempt to dodge, resist, phase, precognitively evade, or teleport away is retroactively rendered futile, as the causality of their evasion or resistance is overwritten by the fixed fact of your successful contact. If your intent is to move somewhere, the causal lock ensures nothing can stop you, as you are already there and the world is merely catching up.

Your movement is now an expression of absolute causal authority, allowing your body to translate its unstoppable force into motion completely unimpeded by inertia, air resistance, or spatial friction, making you a magnitude faster than before.
addons.title: Too Slow, Flash

objects.text: Any kinetic force you generate carries the absolute properties of being both Unstoppable and Immovable. This force cannot be blocked, dampened, redirected, or negated by any defense, power, or law of physics within the world; it acts as an inviolable command for motion and impact upon whatever it touches, while remaining utterly unaltered and unopposed by the world in return. This is an Absolute effect, trumping all other All-or-Nothing defenses and offenses, including Sting. Your complete invulnerability nullifies all recoil and structural stress, allowing you to safely channel and release the full, unlimited magnitude of your strength without any risk of launching yourself, enabling force output an order of magnitude greater than before.
objects.title: Irresistible Force Paradox

objects.text: Compatible methodologies detected. Recombining… There are four fundamental forces which control everything in the universe. You can control all of them. And by understanding all four, you have found how they connect and learned how to master the original force that existed for the first fleeting instants after the Big Bang, before symmetry broke and one thing started being different from another: Strong Symmetric Force. Strong Symmetric Force combines the qualities of the other forces. It’s stronger than the Strong Nuclear Force, in excess of 100 Undecillion times the power of gravity, but like Gravity and unlike Strong Force it is capable of acting on a macroscopic scale. Because it is all of the fundamental forces in one, there is nothing it cannot influence: any form of matter, any kind of energy, the very fabric of spacetime, all can be controlled. Any trick you could perform using one of your component powers can be reproduced in any medium using their fused form. However, it always applies to every medium, since there is no distinction between them for this force’s purposes. To finely differentiate between individual substances or types of energy you will need to delicately pick through them and move each instance separately with the finesse of a surgeon, which you are entirely capable of doing thanks to your combined supplementary Thinker powers working together. Alternatively you can ignore that and simply recreate the Big Bang on everything within multiple kilometers of your position. That works too. Your manipulations will also act as an All-or-Nothing effect of unprecedented potency, arguably just an “All” effect. You can force any physical phenomena to take place through fine control of Strong Symmetric Force, and it will supersede almost any effect that could be produced, even by the entities. Only similarly fundamental manipulation of reality can possibly resist you, and as the root you have the advantage. It won’t be long before you’re no-selling Stilling blasts from Scion with symmetric shields and then tearing through spacetime to assault his main body with singularities and blasts of energy that tear apart the quantum foam.
objects.title: Universal Domination

objects.text:
Your Shard has taken an interest in manipulating the immaterial and conceptual aspects of reality and has thus bestowed that ability to you.

With a combination of your various perception abilities allowing you to see beyond the veil of the physical and into what doesn't exist in a tangible sense, you are now able to channel your abstractional manipulations through your telekinesis in order to cause mass alterations to your surrounding conceptual existence.

What this means in practice is that when someone enters your range, you can do various things from grabbing and stealing their strength to give to yourself or others, seizing the very space you occupy in order to make projectiles miss you, slapping blaster, master, or even stranger powers to the side, or even squeezing a person's thoughts until they fall unconscious or die.

The limits of this power rely on your Shard Ranking for anything that could affect Shards themselves, the level of energy your Shard is willing to expend in order to help you, and your own understanding of how broadly this ability is able to be applied.
objects.title: Abstraction Malleability

objects.text:
Your powers of obliteration, nullification, degradation, and annihilation have merged into the ultimate eraser tool of the Entities. You can erase anything out to the edge of your Blaster powers’ range in a blinding flash of scouring light. All you have to do is designate a target, whether it’s a physical existence, a force, or something arbitrary like “love” or “memory,” and your Shard will springboard off of your conception of it to rapidly analyze whatever makes it up and create a negating agent for every aspect of it, rapidly reducing it to nothing within the area you cover. Larger, tougher, or more complex things will take longer, but all will eventually be erased.

You cannot directly erase entropy unless you have Negentropy or Shardless, but you may stumble onto the answer to combatting entropy by erasing other laws of physics. Having Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge boosts this to be able to truly target concepts as well as interact with esoteric aspects to targets.
objects.title: The Opposite of Everything That Matters

objects.text:
Your titan form becomes the perfected version of the Khepri system which faced Scion in direct combat and nearly won.

You are capable of controlling any living thing, for the broadest definition of living. Humans, animals, plants, bacteria, aliens, AIs, robots, other titans, even full independent shards. You probably cannot fully take control over an entity, but you are capable of influencing its shard network and forcing it to devote effort to resisting your control. Your control is absolutely precise, down to the most basic bodily functions of the thrall, and with the addition of Canary’s and <s>Imp’s</s> the-unknown-stranger-who-accompanied-Khepri’s shards you are also able to edit their minds, altering memories, controlling senses, and placing long-lasting mental blocks or compulsions on the fly.

You perceive the entirety of the multiverse at all times, and with Khepri’s multitasking and Shén Yù’s comprehension you are able to understand everything you perceive as both discrete objects and as parts of a larger system. This allows you to predict how events will unfold without your intervention and what will change if you do interfere in any given part, allowing you to remain several steps ahead of the rest of reality and leverage even seemingly underwhelming force to mind-bogglingly grand effect.

Your control’s range is over two miles by default, but you effectively have no real range limit because you can link any two points in space, letting you transmit your power anywhere. You can teleport yourself or anything else anywhere instantly and create rifts in space that can block attacks and absorb or expel matter and energy. This is not Manton limited, allowing you to tear objects and people apart by creating rifts in space, even scattering their atoms across the entire multiverse if you wish.

You possess a massive battery of energy from Two’s shard, more than twenty times that of the average shard, that can be distributed at will to boost the strength and control of your or another’s powers. You can overcharge the shard connection of dozens of parahumans to the point they all automatically experience a broken trigger and titanize simultaneously. You are also able to do the reverse and drain the shards of other parahumans or any external power source to charge into your own shard.

If it was you fighting Scion in Gold Morning, you might have won without needing psychological warfare.
objects.title: Titan Ra

objects.text:
Your Shard has taken a particular interest in what some humans call, 'The Indomitable Human Spirit'. As a result of this, your Shard has decided to experiment directly on just how far this 'Human Spirit' could take you. 

Your powers have fused, resulting in a power that directly relies on your conviction to grow. The more you work for whatever personal goal you have, and the more you refuse to give up whenever the going gets tough, your Spin, your *Spiral* gets channeled through your triple helix DNA, directly evolving your body and genetics in a slow but progressively exponential and  powerful path to the heavens. 

That's not all your Spiral can be used for though. It can also be channeled into boosting your Aura, which has fused completely with your Mage Armor, resulting in a slightly more malleable and more powerful energy. This new *Spiral* energy is able to create crude weapons and fire off short-to-mid range blasts. When you channel your Spiral into your Aura, not only do your directly increase the pool of Aura you can draw on to strengthen yourself, but you can also increase the size of your Armor, with the potential to grow as large or even larger than the Behemoth. 

Lastly, when your Conviction and Will are at their peak, you can directly manifest your Spiral into a unique and power Drill construct.
