While in the early stages it might be moderately more powerful than any other weapon you could create, the more time you spend strengthening you Will, following your Dream and truly showing the Indominable Human Spirit, your Drill will evolve alongside you, becoming more and more powerful, with the potential to one day reach All-or-Nothing status.
objects.title: Spiral Power

objects.text:
The [JUNK] Shards must be truly desperate to allow you this power over them.

They are giving you the ability to take their being, all their Data and the Shardmatter that makes up their existence, and fuse them to each other in order to make more powerful and useful abilities, all in the hopes that their resulting forms will generate enough useful Data that the Entity will not destroy and discard them at the end of the Cycle.

Thankfully, you have a lot of material to work with, as the [JUNKYARD] has hundreds of thousands to millions of Shards as part of its sub-network, but you don’t know what each Shard is individually capable of immediately.

This means that you must access the [JUNK] Shard and experiment with their powers first before the Shard will permit you to try and Fuse it with another.

If you Fuse Shards that have synergistic abilities together, the resulting Shard is much more likely to have powers worth more SP. You can also tip the scales in your favor by using Controlled Tweaking during the fusion, converting the weaker or irrelevant powers into fuel for the greater powers/power.

If you have a Normal Rank Shard, you can only combine Shards up until they have a power worth a maximum of 15 SP. If you have a Vital Rank Shard, you can combine enough Shards to make up a power worth a maximum of 25 SP. If you have a Noble Rank Shard, you can combine enough Shards to make a power worth 40 SP, or even more, but you would run into diminishing returns at that point.
objects.title: Junk to Gems

addons.text:
Scrubbing information and the mark they left in the world has never been so simple. With Mirage’s reach throughout space and time for every “mirror” you create, Safeguard acts retroactively through the entirety of existence. Mirage would ensure your ability to classify information, having a comprehensive and self-censoring effect on anything you’re classifying, regardless of the scale or reach you’re erasing from the human race and beyond. 

At first, you focus on something through one of your “mirrors” at some point in time or space, and Safeguard is already at work. Then Mirage will scan every corner of the Observable Universe to cover Safeguard’s effects regarding the classified information, effectively removing any awareness or knowledge of its existence, in turn retroactively changing the timeline around it, either by replacing it with something similar or creating another series of events with its exclusion.
addons.title: REDACTED

addons.text: With (Stranger) Shroud, you would think it’s more than enough to go unnoticed; you’ll be wrong. Case in point: Endbringers and Entities. Under the Cycle’s parameters, anything outside them is unacceptable, leaving designed advantages on every Shard deployed for their purposes. Well, after consolidating both of these, not anymore! You see, Shroud has more comprehensive methods of blocking and censoring anything, and Safeguard takes notes with gusto. By classifying something, you apply Safeguard’s usual effect on top of Shroud’s adaptive capabilities, paradoxically erasing them. They are “present” within the space-time continuum and can interact with the world as they please, provided they are a thinking being; they are simply “transparent”, a remnant, on several levels, from physical to multidimensional. Be careful with the people you put under this, in case they bite it, seals the deal on the fact they never existed. At least Scion or something like Simurgh won’t know any better. With Hidden One or Antimemetic Sinkhole, whether it was filtering your Shroud against Thinker powers even further or simply shifting it out of reality entirely, Safeguard will outright detach it from the world, essentially turning it into an antimeme.
addons.title: EXPUNGED

objects.text: Safeguard represents a nearly unrestricted application of the same underlying mechanisms used to conceal the Cycle itself. Rather than relying on simple stealth or perception interference, this power controls the existence, flow, and perception of information at every stage—from observation to memory to cognition. At its core is the ability to classify information, designating people, objects, events, or concepts as cognitively inaccessible. Once classified, observers simply fail to perceive or process the information. Their senses pass over it, their thoughts refuse to form around it, and their memories reorganize themselves to remove any contradiction. Individuals cannot share, recall, analyze, or meaningfully infer classified data, even if they directly encounter it. Unlike simpler Stranger effects, Safeguard’s influence extends across all sensory modalities and recording methods. Cameras, audio recordings, scent, digital logs, and most powers fail to capture or retain usable information about anything you classify. Even entities attempting to analyze the anomaly find their attention redirected or their investigation quietly abandoned. Finally, through physical contact you may directly edit the fundamental aspects of a mind. Memories may be erased, altered, or implanted; skills or languages may be introduced; and individuals can be conditioned with triggers that suppress or sever access to their abilities. When combined with your classification effects, such alterations become nearly impossible for the victim or outside observers to detect or question. Notably, this ability piggybacks on existing Shard systems to extend beyond dimensional boundaries, meaning people can’t escape your power’s reach by fleeing to another dimension.
objects.title: Safeguard

addons.text: Thanks to the multi-dimensional nature of Endbringer Physiology, you are now a walking doorway into your pocket dimension. Its exotic physics being innate to your nature and allowing you to “push” it from your body allowing it to effect objects your holding and power effects, causing your actions to be supported without having to bring anything to the pocket dimension or setting up bounded fields.
addons.title: Daemon

objects.text:
Bounded Fields' ability to enforce exotic effects, and Stage Changes ability to summon beneficial effects, have altered the pocket dimension granted by World Dimension. This changes the physics of the dimension to align with your powers and worldview.

These changes are incredibly variable. Someone with a pyromancy power and a utilitarian worldview may cause anyone in their dimension who commits “unnecessary” harm to gradually become hotter until eventually boiled alive, or a hedonist with a thinker power might cause excess sensation to enhance mental abilities while dampening the physical consequences.

There can be any number of these phenomena, as they are tied directly to your powers and mindset. The only unifying throughline is rewarding actions you agree with and punishing those you do not.

Singular applications of these exotic physics can also be applied to Bounded Fields alongside standard effects, allowing stronger and more unusual results without placing people inside your dimension.

However, these capabilities come at a cost to the space and usability of the pocket dimension. The maximum size has been reduced to roughly Alaska, and its rate of expansion halved.
Additionally, there is now a time limit on how long you and others can remain inside. This limit is inversely tied to population. If alone, the dimension can function indefinitely, but as it approaches 300,000 people the time drops to 20 minutes.

This limitation is due to the energy cost of predicting and analyzing each action under the exotic physics. Exotic phenomena such as parahumans may count as hundreds or thousands of normal people depending on power complexity. Endbringers count as at least 50,000 people, with the Simurgh at approximately 250,000.
objects.title: Fantasy Bead

objects.text: "You all know the truth, you can't outrun the emptiness." Your powers have resulted in a coalescence evoking a light-based Superman pastiche’s dark side, where your Breaker state becomes the focal point, becoming a haunting silhouette. Your pocket dimension slowly emits out of your body, manifesting as a lurking, flood of negative space where anyone and anything caught in this shadow is “evicted” from existence, with your power carefully analyzing the matter composition to determine sentience. You start slow, aside from your void’s slow intrusion, the power expands based on the number of people you “evict”, leaving only blast shadows that trickle across the area, overflowing your pocket dimension and leaking out the excess expanding your area, with limits stretching as far from New York City up to half the United States. Non-sentient or inorganic matter is atomically disassembled and then assembled within your pocket dimension’s overflow as facsimiles of condensed dark matter comparable to nuclear pasta that works as a defense mechanism from outside threats, overwriting the local area’s reality. These constructs are fully reconfigurable, an anchor whose density and very composition nullifies entropic manifestations such as kinetic energy or energy attacks, sinking your surroundings in biting cold and an eerie lack of sound. Sentient lifeforms are then transported to your pocket dimension’s crevices, where a maze-like dimension is built from your black sands, now heightened by your darkness in complexity and awareness of one’s deepest fears, shaping the maze to a simulative nightmare according to their darkest memories or experiences plucked from their mind that goes on forever giving them the chance to bury deeper to the hold they dig themselves, fully sustained by your dimension ensuring their health’s in “stasis”. The only way out is confronting the simulation and forcefully leaving by combating you or willingly letting them leave your dimension. Owing to this power’s nature, one crucial aspect that crumbles your abilities for good is Light, and no matter if Chiaroscuro has complete immunity to photonic emissions, you’ll always cower against the symbolism—optimism, steadfastness, determination, hope—so everything that is in shortage in Worm, your power violently reacting and decaying once in contact with something or somewhat Being in contact with material or people steeped in this Light. That’ll be the only weapon they could face you with, as you’re the incarnation of the Call of the Void.
objects.title: The Void

objects.text:
Where others see something broken, flawed or malfunctioning, all you see is potential. You can take the remains of something and remake it better then before, not only reconstructing but improving on it without any outside components.

The broken fragments of a focusing lens refined into a focusing array. A faulty containment field causing variable shield strength, abused to adjust the shields shape. An energy core with unstable output directed, spiking power when needed.

What was once a single shield generator, now creates a matrix of interlocking micro shields. Automatically rearranging itself to fill shattered panels, and restoring them in bulk whenever too few remain.

This isn't limited to using Tinkertech as materials, or to a single device at time. You can integrate or repropose multiple devices at once, creating Tinkertech that uses and improves on different pieces of the original devices.
objects.title: Frankentech

objects.text:
Your Tinker/Thinker abilities are no longer limited to just jumpstarting or collapsing ecosystems; now you have gained a number of tools needed to tweak and alter ecosystems to your own ends.

You can quickly determine possible biological niches for even the most unnatural creature. From there, you can construct environments to best suit them, taking both biotic and abiotic factors into account.

It would be foolish to assume that this methodology is best focused on individuals, as systems are where you thrive. You can think of living things and their environment, with all their interactions and connections, as part of a greater whole. This can be extended to artificial, human systems as well, but it doesn’t come to you as naturally in that case.

This specialty also extends downward to the microscopic scale. Adjusting your own or someone else's microbiome for hyper-efficient digestion and disease resilience, or piecing together teams of microbes to break down specific materials.

While these specialties don’t give you many good ways of directly altering organisms, you know how to set systems for rapid directed evolution, where each generation makes meaningful progress in selection.
objects.title: Persephone Engineering

objects.text:
The Gates through Time and Space are open, their windows blown open for you to see. Time Windows’ interaction with Everything, Everywhere, All at Once has turned you into a near-omnipresent Host throughout the Entities’ curated Multiverse, and possibly beyond with enough experience.

You can turn your portals into ‘mirrors’ that walk the Universe, without fully setting foot into said coordinates; these ‘mirrors’ are translucent replicas that you can multitask, the limit being up to 20 concurrent “mirrors.” This starts by imagining yourself walking into a portal to the place you wish to visit, creating a silhouette that acts on said desire, becoming your ‘mirror’.

These ‘mirrors’ have the Clairvoyant’s range, able to appear and disappear at every place in the Universe they’re ‘visiting’, interacting with the world almost as any other person.
objects.title: Mirage

addons.text: With these headways in using every atom as a photonic computational vector to coordinate physical forces at a greater level, it doesn’t explain the model it works under, merely using its sheer processing power to accomplish anything you set your mind to do. This is widely inefficient, your Shard acknowledges within crystal circuitry. For the sake of saving energy, it needs to be optimized. Fortunately, it has the right model to enhance [LIGHT’s] effectiveness: Quantum. Using Quantum’s computation architecture to refine [LIGHT] in its cognitive and operation functions, you can now use every photon Nodes within your Breaker form to fully model and simulate the physical world around you in permutations, giving a deeper look of the potential changes you can take by gathering sensory information form your photon Nodes pinging off stray physical or chemical interactions in your surroundings, and guiding at wider applications of your innate physical force manipulation within this wider area. This deeper quantum model you are under will influence a faster development in your abilities, including a full understanding of the Planck scale, with the gateway for more massive change in matter and energy at a particle level. If you have The [QUESTION], your quantum architecture updates to integrate [Calculation] to your computational power, slowly infusing your understanding of negentropic systems to [LIGHT], collapsing photons for more informational density and processing while preserving mass, or enhancing your manipulation of physical phenomena to be self-sustaining or energy-transferable to other forces out of influence, steadily expanding your reach and scope if you maintain constant control.
addons.title: [HEADWAY]

objects.text:
Through some experiments with the manipulation of photons, reality’s forces and conversions of different states of matter, your Shard has stumbled across a unique form of computational reality distortion.

Your Shard has essentially found a way for each photon that you can turn your body into to function as a quantum qubit, effectively turning your entire being into one of the most advanced quantum systems possible. This effectively means that each photon acts as one of Neural Network’s Nodes, uplifting your potential intelligence by several orders of magnitude. For example, you could emulate the informational capabilities of a smaller Shard Bud despite being only the size of a human when fully transformed into light.

With this much computing capacity, your Shard has decided to experiment with how a human with that much informational power could make use of Tyrant’s manipulation of forces; and has loosened its restrictions on what it would be possible to achieve as long as you are able to make the required calculations yourself. With your new level of calculative power is only a matter of time and experimentation before you could manipulate forces in just the right ways to perform feats of matter manipulation.

As an example, you could effectively transmute matter through the manipulation of nuclear forces, cause contained nuclear explosions on command by splitting atoms, or if you spend enough time practicing, potentially manipulate the electrical signals in a person’s brain to control their body like a certain son of Heartbreaker.

At first, you would only be able to get that level of force manipulation within a range of 5 meters, but this is if you just stayed as a human shaped being of light. As you can manipulate all light within a range of 200 meters, so long as you condense enough light within that range to manifest something with the same ‘mass’ as your human form, you may manipulate forces with a similar level of complexity with the nearby 5 meter range.
objects.title: [LIGHT]

addons.text:
Your development is no longer limited to body and mind. Your soul, spiritual structure, and other metaphysical aspects now improve through use, strain, repetition, and refinement in the same way as physical training.

This extends to the source of your power. Any underlying metaphysical system can be strengthened directly—its quantity, purity, stability, efficiency, and output all improve through deliberate use and development. If you possess a shard, its expression can be refined in the same way, becoming more stable, responsive, and efficient over time.

You can also develop analogues to other power systems, provided your setting supports a compatible foundation. These are not direct copies; they are functionally similar structures expressed through your own metaphysics. Systems resembling chakra, aura, or ki can be trained into existence if there is a basis for them, but they will follow your world’s rules rather than replicate another exactly.

Your soul and metaphysical framework follow the same progression as your body and skills. They can be strengthened, shaped, and optimized through continued use, improving over time without requiring separate abilities.
addons.title: The Missing Third

objects.text:
Your development is no longer bound to action, training, or external stimulus. Improvement becomes an internal, self-directed process that continues at all times, whether you are active or at rest.

Growth no longer depends on repetition. Once you understand a movement, concept, or desired outcome, your body and mind begin refining it on their own, steadily iterating toward optimal execution. Practice can still accelerate this process, but it is no longer required for progress.

You have complete control over your development. Any aspect of yourself—physical, mental, or technical—can be consciously emphasized, suppressed, or redirected. This is not guesswork; you possess clear awareness of your current capabilities and the paths they can take, allowing you to shape your progression with precision.

Your improvement is no longer limited to what you have personally performed. As long as you can conceptualize a result and grasp its underlying function, your system can begin advancing toward it. This does not produce immediate results, but it allows steady progress toward outcomes that would normally be difficult or impossible to train directly.

Growth carries across domains. Refinement in one area feeds into others, creating cascading improvements that elevate your overall performance. Efficiency, timing, strength, perception, and control develop together as parts of a unified system that continuously refines itself.
objects.title: Enhanced Perfection

objects.text:
You have been transformed into a bizarre and terrifying biological monster.

You are no longer limited to dividing your body into only 30 separate parts; you can now split yourself down to the atomic level. This turns you into a swarm composed of your own dispersed components, effectively untouchable and immune to direct physical interaction except from large-scale natural or energetic phenomena such as flamethrowers, laser beams, and similar forces. You may control your dispersed parts within a maximum range of 1 square kilometer.

Any limbs or body parts you generate benefit from the effects of Many-Limbed One. More significantly, you can now create clones of yourself that function as true extensions of your body. For every clone you generate, your original body and all extensions of yourself grow stronger. However, this consumes a significant portion of your Shard’s energy reserve. Unless you possess Negentropy or a similar effect, you cannot create more than five clones at a time.

You may transfer your consciousness into a clone if your original body is destroyed. Additionally, you possess a thinker-level multitasking capability sufficient to manage any number of additional limbs and clones you create.

You no longer need to divide your body in order to levitate. Your levitation strengthens in proportion to your overall power growth, allowing you to move increasingly faster than you originally could. However, this does not grant protection against G-forces, friction, oxygen deprivation, or similar environmental hazards unless your body develops sufficient adaptation or resilience to withstand them.

Your regenerative capabilities now allow you to reconstruct or regenerate yourself down to the atomic level. You may revert to your normal human form at will by canceling any extra parts of yourself, both external and internal.

Due to the interaction between Many-Limbed One and (Breaker/Shaker) Monsoon, you have developed a limited capacity for biological self-modification. You cannot develop entirely new biological structures beyond what your biology could theoretically support, but you can evolve and remodel existing traits within human-compatible limits, making them functional and effective. For example, you cannot create feathered wings, but you could form wings made of skin membrane. You could generate an exoskeleton as hard as steel, or weave dense muscle structures that form a tail or tentacle capable of extending or stretching according to the biomass available to you.

If you reabsorb your clones or additional limbs, you may temporarily exceed your normal biomass limit, granting access to a far more extensive and varied level of biological modification.
objects.title: Lusus Nature

objects.text: “It’s the ultimate late-throw in rock-paper-scissors!” Your Shard has taken the phrase ‘what doesn’t kill me makes me stronger’ a little too seriously. First of all, you can now summon a Dharma Wheel above your head, which is a visual signifier for some of your abilities. Each time the wheel turns, your body is instantly ‘reset’ to its physical peak, each rotation of which varies in speed but is no longer than 10 minutes. Even if your entire body and wheel were vaporized, as long as the wheel was summoned beforehand, your Shard will automatically ‘respawn’ you once the wheel has turned. The speed of your wheel’s rotation can be sped up depending on the number of times you were exposed to significant harm or strain of some kind, though being hit or influenced by some kind of Parahuman power works best. If you were hit or experienced a significant enough strain during each turning interval, at the end of each cycle, you will get a significant but not absolute adaptation against the strain. Each adaptation will include a general boost but will have a specific point it focuses on. For example, if you were set on fire before the wheel turns, you will be extremely resistant to hot temperatures once your wheel turns, or if your mind was being influenced by powers, you would gain a resistance against mental tampering. In addition to adapting against harm, you also adapt to directly combat the thing causing you harm or strain. What this means in practice is that if you fight against a parahuman with a Breaker state like Shadow Stalker’s, you would adapt to be able to strike her even in that state. Another example of adapting to ‘combat’ strain would be if you were trying to punch deep underwater, you could adapt so that your strikes have a supernatural piercing effect that lets you swiftly cut through water. Your adaptation may be powerful, but unless you are actively throwing yourself into violence or harm's way, it is not necessarily quick. Granted, while you could theoretically grow enough during an Endbringer battle to potentially kill them, if you, for some reason, dismiss your Wheel, all your adaptations besides the general boosts will be lost.
objects.title: Mahoraga

objects.text:
Armor and Cronus have merged. Now, instead of transforming your physical body into that of a Titan, you can instead change the size and shape of your armor into the form of a Titan.

Your Armor’s Titan height can range from the relatively small height of [Titan Skadi] at 20 meters to the gargantuan 330-meter height of [Titan Kronos]. In this form, you gain strength capable of matching Endbringers or throwing container ships around.

While in this form, your Armor can channel any other powers you may possess as if it were your physical body.
objects.title: Colossus

objects.text: Now augmented by the strength of (Shaker) Inviolable, your armor’s durability is increased to levels few ever reach. Short of an exotic all-or-nothing effect, nothing can breach your armor’s protections. However, (Shaker) Inviolable’s power isn’t solely in the defense it provides; the edges of the force-fields it generates are absurdly sharp, able to slice through even Endbringer flesh with ease. Typically, it would be difficult to make effective use of this aspect, but with an Organized Mind and the ability to Multitask, you will be able to augment your armor with various force-field constructs such as swords, shields, spikes, and spears—each capable of punching through most defenses.
objects.title: Augmentation

addons.text: Your talent, intuition, skill, creativity, and level of mastery can be taught. Now your students can learn to reach similar levels of mastery and understanding of their abilities as you possess over your own. This also will extend to (Thinker/Trump) Munchkin as an ability, granting them far greater creativity of their own. Normal students will achieve this milestone in roughly 3 months, Crowned Students in roughly one month, with normal teachings. Even faster with more indepth and intense training. This also inherently extends to all other facets as normal, such your students being able to reach blatantly superhuman levels of physical and mental ability, such as flinging cars like they’re baseballs, when there should be no capacity for such abilities.
addons.title: Class Of Prodigies

addons.text:
Your students may awaken Inner Beasts of their own.

You can cause an Inner Beast to form within a student’s soul. This spirit embodies the student’s nature, abilities, potential, instincts, flaws, desires, and growth path, becoming a living reflection of what they are and what they may become.

For powered students, their Inner Beast possesses complete understanding of their abilities.

It can help them train, refine, control and evolve their power as your own does. As their power changes, the Beast changes with it, ensuring new developments feel natural rather than foreign.

For students without powers, the Inner Beast becomes the seed of one.

A mundane student who awakens an Inner Beast gains an ability uniquely tied to them. This power is not random, copied, or generic. It emerges organically from their innate potential, personality, body, mind, history, talents, desires, fears, training, and the kind of person they are becoming under your guidance.

The powers of some these can vary widely, some are inherently more powerful simply based on nuances.  These Inner Beast possess as much inherent understanding and complete control as Inner Beasts born of existing powers. 

These powers grow as extensions of the student rather than external gifts. Each Beast is perfectly suited to its student and possesses all the inherent properties an Inner Beast normally possesses.

Crowned Students awaken inner beasts that are inherently more powerful, boasting an immediate mutation and enhancement on their abilities the moment they awaken one. 

The Inner Beasts of your students possess the same kind of loyalty to you as your own Inner Beast possesses to you. 

You cannot mass-produce identical powers solely through this.
addons.title: Beast Master’s Lodge

addons.text: The Inner Beasts of your students are more potent and possess the same properties as Inner Protector. They’ll possess the ability to immediately call upon their Inner Beasts fully, able to summon them directly, enhance their abilities further, and even benefit from the same kind of Inner Worlds your own Inner Beast possesses, including resurrection.
addons.title: Guardian Beast

objects.text:
Kingmaker is no longer limited to parahumans.

You may take students of any kind: parahumans, mundane humans, enhanced beings, animals, constructs, yourself, and any other being you can think of. 

An inherent side effect of your ability is imbedding an incredibly deep, and absolute sense of loyalty to you from your students, unless you intentionally and deliberately sabotage such an attempt. 

If something can be practiced, refined, strengthened, understood, expressed, controlled, or expanded, you can teach it.

Kingmaker’s original five-student limit now applies only to your favored students.

You may teach any number of people normally, gaining excellent insight into how to guide them, but you may designate up to five students as your Crowned Students. 

Crowned Students receive a drastically enhanced version of your power’s effect, their abilities growing and becoming mutated a highly advanced rate. 

Moreover with time, effort, and proper training, your teaching can push abilities beyond their original apparent scope.

A weak fire blast may become more powerful, then hotter, then more precise, then capable of shaping the flame, then expanding to a broader fire manipulation, then to a power to create heat without fire, then to absorbing heat, then freezing, then ice manipulation, then a broader energy manipulation, and far more. 

This kind of progression isn’t a single linear path, but entirely dependent on the student, the initial starting point, the ability, your creativity, their training, their mindset, and how far you can conceptually stretch it. You can teach them and loop them through any kind of discipline if you can justify it somehow, even if their original ability should have been impossible to produce such a result.  

Your teaching and insight is no longer applied solely towards powers either. Instead your teach ability extends to everything, such as mundane traits. 

You can train someone’s body until their strength, reflexes, endurance, agility, durability, aim, balance, senses, or coordination are blatantly superhuman. You can train a student’s mind until they’re running circles around Thinkers. 

Your students do not suddenly gain unrelated abilities overnight. 

Their growth appears natural from the inside: better control, deeper understanding, improved output, newfound or discovered secondary applications, and increasingly strange “edge cases” that only become obvious in hindsight. 

Your Munchkin intuition is folded into your teaching style.

You instinctively recognize unconventional training routes, hidden power interactions, strange applications, conceptual loopholes, and non-obvious ways to turn one skill into the foundation for another. You can teach a telekinetic to develop fine motor control by practicing calligraphy through their power, teach a brute to move with dancer-like efficiency, teach a blaster to use recoil for mobility, teach a thinker to weaponize their own blind spots, or teach a normal person to use breathing, posture, timing, and perception so well that their combat ability begins to look impossible.

You may also teach yourself.

You count as your own student for the purposes of self-training, self-analysis, and long-term improvement. Your own benefits will count as if you are a Crowned Student.

The more you understand a field, the better you can teach it, but you are not limited to what you already know.

Your power can help you build lesson plans, identify missing information, create training exercises, diagnose flaws, and design paths of improvement even in unfamiliar disciplines. However, actual knowledge still matters. If you want to teach advanced surgery, alien engineering, or swordsmanship, your power can guide the process, but study, observation, experimentation, and experience will make your teaching dramatically stronger.

Moreover your students will never suffer or lose something from your teachings. A student who grows stronger also learns how not to destroy their joints. A student whose power expands also learns control. A student whose intellect sharpens also gains methods to manage stress and avoid self-sabotage. 

A student whose fire power mutates toward heat manipulation does not lose the ability to use fire unless they developed in such a way to make it redundant rather than losing functions. 

Weak powers can become terrifying. Narrow powers can become versatile. Strong powers can become refined instead of merely larger. Mundane skills can become superhuman disciplines. Ordinary people can become legends through a progression that looks impossible only when viewed from the beginning.
objects.title: School of Kings

objects.text:
Your Shard has been given complete administrative authority over “flawed” kin. Not only can you completely freely demand [Data] and [Energy] from those within the [JUNKYARD] sub-network. You can engage in [AUDIT] on other Shards. Where your shard will go through the shard checking for then removing any deviancy. 

If your Shard is able to detect any immense deviancy, such as would be found in The Fragile One, or some Eden Shards, it will assign the whole Shard to the Junkyard network. If it finds nothing, or it is within acceptable parameters, then it will merely keep records of any of the testing for future [AUDIT]s. Most interestingly, if there is enough deviancy to be in need of removal, but little enough that the Shard as a whole may be salvaged, the portions of the shard may be [EXCISED], where the locations of the deviancy will be sheared off, and given minimal repairs, which surely wouldn’t lead to future deviancy. If performed on Shards with living hosts, the host make experience change in or loss of powers, sometimes to extreme degrees.

The greater the rank and condition of the Shard receiving your [AUDIT] the longer it will take to find enough [EVIDENCE] to assign anything to the [JUNKYARD] sub-network. Normal Shards will take somewhere in the range of weeks to dig up any deviancy, Vital will take months, and Noble could possibly take years. Broken or “wrong”” shards like the Fragile One might take merely days.

Once a Shard or piece of a Shard is placed in your sub-network, you can demand [Data] and [Energy] from it in a similar way you can with the original broken shards that exist in the [JUNKYARD]. Without the entirety of the Shard being assigned to the sub-network, only a small portion of the host’s original power may be used, and in a flawed and twisted manner. Even if there is the whole Shard, it might take several permutations of the [DATA] to properly recreate the original power.
objects.title: Inquisitor

objects.text:
Shards just make sense to you. How they think, what they want, what it takes to get them to do what you want: it's all second-nature, with the same instinctual ease as you understand human psychology. This doesn't directly give you any information about individual shards that you wouldn't otherwise have, but you're great at making educated inferences based on the information that is available (such as their choice of hosts, power expression, or direct correspondence through [Query][Response]). 

You're especially talented at using that information to manipulate or befriend shards. With regular [Query]s and careful attentiveness to their needs and desires, you'll know just how to get them wrapped around your finger. Note that this isn't a Master effect, and it doesn't let you bypass their priorities or preferences altogether: a particularly bloodthirsty shard probably won't ever adore you if you're a pacifist insistent on thwarting their violent host, but you'd know just what [data] to share to keep them reasonably appeased, and will know how just far you can push your opposition to their goals without getting on their bad side.

This smooths over some of the quirks of negotiating and building relationships with precognitive/clairvoyant minds, with the various exotic perspectives they may have on you and your intentions. Of course, it's still a whole new ball game compared to talking to a human, but at least now it's one you're prepared to tackle.

The above applies, to a lesser degree, to entitles and their avatars.
objects.title: [Psychology]

objects.text: Your manifesting of memes and pseudoscience has opened a new set of steps to cheat reality now: Troll Science. This kind of science revolves around “scientific” methods to solve problems, all under a ridiculous “science” that looks clever until somebody starts thinking about it for a second and takes notice of the holes or lack of real scientific basis. You can reenact this in any way, such as grabbing a flashlight to go over the Speed of Light, beating Earth’s gravitational pull by pulling your hair to lift yourself, attaching magnets all over your body to simply make yourself bulletproof due to the magnets’ repulsive field, among many other plans to “Troll” your opponents and science itself. Now you’ll make any scientist helplessly cope and seethe in a corner.
objects.title: “U Mad Science?”

objects.text: You’re a Tinker specializing in sustaining life, although exclusively with ice. You’re also able to slow down projectiles, movement, and reactions within your range. You’re capable of making ceramic armor that gives enhanced strength and contains highly pressurized ice, causing ice to spew out upon being punctured, encasing and entrapping anything nearby. Offensively, you can utilize heavy, ugly blades, more akin to axe-blades than knives. You can also make chains that you can use as a grappling hook to move around.
objects.title: Snowmann

objects.text:
You have rapid regeneration, a prehensile tongue, gliding skinfolds, and claws, and are internally completely alien. You house your bugs inside of your body, and your body is completely shaped around this task, effectively turning you into a walking hive of birthing sacks. 

You can carry around two hundred of them, and produce hundreds more in minutes. Your bugs can retrieve bits and pieces of your victims as fuel to accelerate your regeneration and cause you to evolve, which extends to your minions too. Your bugs also actively help you heal, and their biomass can be reused. 

You’re capable of designing and reprogramming your bugs with specific tasks and orders in mind, choosing their evolutions, although you’re still unable to directly control them beyond that.
objects.title: Spawner

objects.text:
Your mist takes on a higher-dimensional nature, granting it new and unique properties. Its newer, more complex form is an order of magnitude more effective in absorbing and storing energy. Thanks to existing in more than three spacial dimensions it can seemingly teleport by taking shortcuts through space, phasing into and out of reality at your will. Among other things, this allows the mist to contact the inside of things without touching the outside.

You could use the mist to maneuver 3D objects through higher-dimensional space, so that if you have sufficient mist to apply enough force you can “erase” a target in whole or in part by pushing it out of alignment with the rest of the 3D world, altering its measurements and interactions with everything else by rotating it to intersect only partially, or flipping it completely around a higher-dimensional axis to mirror it, confusing flipped foes (who now perceive everything as suddenly mirrored and also will probably starve to death because their chirality is wrong) or immediately redirecting objects in motion.

Like the tinkertech you can make with Higher Dimension, your mist has hazardous memetic effects; you have a much greater degree of control over these than usual, and can influence how they warp the minds and bodies of the things they infect with great freedom; you could build an army of loyal incomprehensible monstrosities over time and twist the environment in bizarre ways. If you have Multi Dimensional then your mist takes on the physics-warping properties of your creations, once again with a greater degree of freeform control, allowing you to rapidly alter whatever it comes into contact with in practically any way.

You have intuitive understanding of higher-dimensional space.
objects.title: Meddler in Higher Forces

objects.text: An interesting interaction has occurred between your powers of deriving extra benefits from equipment and your ability to shrink inanimate matter. You are now capable of creating Trinkets, taking items and shrinking them into a compact, coin-sized accessory to be worn clipped to a chain or belt. Trinkets are no mere decorative object, however. Each Trinket can be selectively "equipped" and provide a number of supernatural benefits related to the original item. Trinkets can vary in effective power from slightly above Tier 0, all the way to the upper ends of Tier 1. Common or simple items, such as a brick or a pair of running shoes, are more Iikely to create simple and minor Trinkets. Stronger Trinkets can be crafted from higher quality items, esoteric materials, or supernatural sources, such as Tinkertech or magical baubles. Trinkets tend to have a range of effects each, offering two or three effects that synergize well. Effects tend to be based on the associated concepts and symbolism of the Trinket, or it's own abilities should it possess any. An iron dagger Trinket, for example, may grant a slight improvement to stealth, an enhanced talent for close combat, and an increase to damage dealt to unaware targets. You can only equip up to six Trinkets at a time, with additional Trinkets no longer providing any benefit beyond aesthetic value. However, you can "hotswap" between worn Trinkets, changing which are active so long as you are wearing them. Hotswapping between Trinkets takes thirty seconds of focus, but does not increase or decrease regardless of how many swaps are being done at once.
objects.title: Trinkets

addons.text: Your naturalized transformation into a humaniform shard, while slow, absorbs your bio-crystalline physiology and accommodates the excess mass within you. Condensing and concentrating this shard-matter will, somewhat paradoxically, improve your emulation’s depth and scope as well as its available potency, due to the vastly increased efficiency. At first, you’ll merely experience a slight improvement when you begin to change, but at the end of your transformation, your powers fine-tune themselves to an order of magnitude greater than what they would’ve been otherwise.
addons.title: Heart of Glass
Secrets from the Crystal Skull!
addons.text: Your already developed brain remodels itself to match your current body, pushing your emulation further, a seed taking root that grows into matching how a Shard thinks. At first, your crystalline pathways acting as neurons fire quicker, although you aren’t used to this just yet, but with years and experience, you’ll fully orient yourself to a Shard’s mental architecture. For example, human thought process will be a blink up against yours, where contemplating every aspect of something like the world’s fundamental structures in an instant, cross-examining disparate factors to paint a larger picture, and creating predictive or intuitive models on larger frameworks of human behavior and economics are the modest demonstrations you can come up with, essentially being the bonafide Thinker power. These mental accomplishments are something humans achieve every day as a species, but you leave them in the dust in terms of scale. And, boy, isn’t it helpful to get some rudimentary [Broadcasting] capabilities: you can communicate with multiple Shards at a surface-level via SONAR-like [PING] and, depending on your rank, ask for [Data] from power expressions to replicate them, or [Request] to temporarily possess Hosts or induce Broken Triggers if your main Shard is of Noble ilk.

addons.title: Crystal Ball
addons.text:
Your perfected senses grow alongside your body as an early stage to perceive the world as Shards do. Just as with Secrets from the Crystal Skull, it’ll take some years before you truly get to experience reality through a Shard’s “eyes”, with no small amount of time and experience in your belt.

From the outset, a second will be an instant even to a grain in an Entity’s expanse like you, able to put your longevity into perspective to see vast stretches of time as inconsequential. With senses capable of feeling the world’s fundamental forces as a tapestry of stimuli, vaguely gazing at the world’s permutations in alternate Earths or timelines, your psyche will be shielded by this enormity; you may have left your mind and body behind, but you haven’t left your soul. 

Your perception is limited, oddly enough, by your Shard’s ranking: while a Normal Shard can gaze across a large sample size of the Multiversal Cluster, they are locked from awareness of sealed Earths like Zion’s true form or other Shards’ Earth of higher ranking unless given permission, Noble Shards will have more leeway and access to most of the Multiversal Cluster, including most of the Cycle Shards’ dimensional coordinates.

objects.text:
By breaking the limits of your Shard Emulation within Passenger-like physiology, your bio-crystalline body reconstructs and bloats to almost the same scale and physiology as your Shard, your connection now acting as tether and backup at once.

Your body becomes a fully-matured Shard walking in through the Earth, using Axiomorph and Space-Time to spatially fold and shunt your excess matter through adjacent dimensions, using it along with Earth’s gravitational position, and move through the world. The ability to transfer resources between real and shard-space allows you to, among many other applications, drastically increase the potency of your powers and save your core self on your Shard.

The result isn’t so much an emulation as it is the full manifestation of what a Shard could accomplish on its own. You source energy from solar emissions as well as any other energetic sources you encounter, which allows you to negate and absorb the vast majority of Blaster or Shaker effects in your surroundings. You can see the full EM spectrum across the globe—apart from the usual blind spots—simultaneously in several Alternate Earths or dimensions. You easily process and learn any power expression that appears in real space, all while showing no regard for Cycle limitations or the Manton Effect (comparable to serious Endbringers).
objects.title: Attack of the Shards!

objects.text:
You no longer need to kill a target to steal its remaining lifespan. Rather, any physical damage you inflict adds to your own, with the amount gained proportional to the being’s natural life expectancy and the severity of the harm caused.

For example, severing the finger of a normal person could grant you an additional month or so of life. On the other hand, severely injuring a creature with a life expectancy of 200 years, such as brutalising its vital organs, would net you a large portion of its remaining years.

In addition, you now automatically regenerate from injury at an extraordinary rate. This functions as a form of near-immortality as your wounds repair in seconds and entire limbs regrow in minutes. Even decapitation or dismemberment is survivable as your body can feasibly heal before you bleed out.

However, this rapid healing is not without cost as it consumes your stored lifespan. While this makes you exceptionally difficult to kill, you can still die if your reserve is depleted. Moreover, this regeneration will fail if both your Corona Pollentia and Corona Gemma are destroyed concurrently. You can also choose to heal naturally.
objects.title: Life Thief

addons.title: Otherworldly Colors
addons.text: You can have Shardless powers as part of your Palette Swap Breaker states.

objects.text:
Your T0s from Rainbow and your Breaker states from Grumman, have converged into something new. You now have seven Breaker states, each with 7 SP worth of T0, T1 or Copy powers.

Similarly to Rainbow, each of Palette Swap's Breaker states will accumulate [Time]. Expending [Time] will allow you to gain powers from all seven Breaker states simultaneously. While in this boosted state, the powers from each Breaker state will have their SP worth doubled.

Each of the seven Breaker states also applies a cosmetic effect that dyes you, your powers, and anything you're wearing or wielding in one of seven colors. You choose the colors and exactly what is dyed when purchasing this power. While active, the boosted state will slowly shift between the seven different colors.
objects.title: Palette Swap

objects.text:
You heal any damage done to you extremely rapidly, faster than even a biokinetic would be able to inflict damage. Your brain doesn't feel pain properly, and you’re immune to most Master effects.

You’re additionally capable of willingly slowing or halting your regeneration and by putting cut-off limbs or body parts on the wounds can incorporate them into your body. Whether to have a dozen arms, ears or stomachs. All parts incorporated in such a way retain their prior functions, even if they’re parts that once belonged to someone else. Likewise you can permanently exclude parts of your body and no longer make them part of your baseline. This also allows you to store as much blood within your body as you can touch, which you can then expel at high speeds from your wounds or consume internally to increase your rate of regeneration even further.

You’re always capable of reverting the effects of this process and can allow your regeneration to completely remake your original body no matter how much you’ve added or removed from it, though that will undo any changes you might’ve made to it.
objects.title: Pagoda

addons.title: My Divinity, is Past Infinity
addons.text:
Within the range of Local Admin, you are god.

Your each and every whim is able to be brought into being with barely a thought, the intent based ‘coding’ of Ghost Protocol making your ‘programming’ of reality happen seamlessly between your desire and the end product being formed.

In addition to this, you’re able to spend time ‘anchoring’ your edits of reality deeper into existence, making it so that even when your domain leaves, your changes will stick around. 

The more supernatural the creations are, the longer amount of time you need to spend letting your Shard anchor them into reality. Making a simple floating ball of water stick around for a few days after exiting your range would only take a few minutes, while making a fire breathing dragon capable of flying around the radius of the world without falling apart would take a little less than a week spent anchoring it into reality.

Lastly, the speed at which you can move your possessed range of reality has increased due to the seamless ‘scanning’ of new Physical System data, allowing you to move at highway speeds.

objects.text: Your Shard has taken your abilities and has combined them in a unique way. Instead of possessing any technological system you make contact with, your Shard has allowed you to able to possess the Physical System, which is essentially the code of reality. Through combining the 'reality glitches' of Bugged Out with the environmental changing abilities of Stage Change and Environment Shaping, your Shard has effectively made the surrounding existence into a form of 'digital' reality that you can become a part of with Digitize. With the wide variety of effects available in the three Shaker powers, you have almost complete control over the local area of 100 meters, capable of recreating any sort of power effect with enough time spent 'coding' it in. The only exceptions to this are Thinker and Master powers, as even Tinker powers could be approximated with enough time. However, there are major limitations to this ability. You do need to spend time 'coding' any changes to the environment you desire, with simpler changes being as short as a few second while larger and more dramatic changes could take hours or even days. The second major limitation for this power is that you can't move the inhabited System range very quickly, at most being able to move in one direction at a time at the speed of a casual walk. The last major limitation is that any esoteric changes you make to the environment during the time you possess it, such as a never cooling pit of lava, will shut off and cool down after you stop possessing it, though physical changes will stay, like a building that you set up as long as it was stable. With enough time and effort, you could make fantastical landscapes of floating islands of crystal, 'creatures' (programs more like) of 'living' lava or water moving about, or even a condensed river of light that can be safely swam in. You could potentially even create a sort of Avatar for yourself to pilot within your possessed range. If you have the addon Porygon, then the speed at which you could make changes to the Physical System's code increase exponentially, to the point where it could seem to the unaware that they themselves are merely a program within a digital existence being overseen by a local god-admin.
objects.title: Local Admin

objects.text: You can create infusions and consumables from crystallized powers, using the crystal as an ingredient for your Tinkering rather than simply using it as is. While on its own the new applications of this would be relatively minor, mostly just the ability to create power infusion generators in order to permanently apply the effects of a power to something, the inclusion of Love Potion has changed things. You can also use infusions in your potions in order to apply the effects of the infusion to the consumer for as long as the potion is in their system. Notably, this ability to apply the effects of infusions includes those created from crystallized powers meaning you can effectively create potions capable of granting temporary powers. If you possess Juicer your infusion potions are capable of having permanent effects, although like other potions each potion can only enact small, incremental changes. If you possess Crystal Tinker you are capable of treating infusions and potions the way you treat normal crystallized powers, splicing and modifying them in order to create a wider array of applications.
objects.title: Crystal Potioneer

objects.text: And no one will be able to prove otherwise... The powers of Return, Restart, Reset and your recursive future sight have all merged and become a part of a greater whole, coalescing in two new powers. Save and Load. Save's function is relatively simple, but it has nuances. It is the ability to 'Save' three points in time, but the nuance comes in with two of the Save slots being automatically applied unless you specify otherwise. The first automatic Save is called the Hard Save, and starting from the point when you first get your powers, it will reapply itself every month, shifting the Save Point further into the future. It cannot be forced to stay at the same point and will move forward so that the farthest back a Save Point can be is a month. The second automatic Save is similar to Groundhog Day's, as it is when you wake up in the morning, and it is called the Soft Save. If you are forced awake earlier than when you would have naturally awoken, then the Save will default to the last Soft Save, but this can only happen once before it will force a new Save the next time you wake up regardless of if it's by force or not. The last Save slot is called the Quick Save, and it can be applied and left at any point in time for upwards of a day. What makes all these Save's intrinsically different is when Load is applied to them, as Load at its most basic is simply the ability to send yourself back to a previous Save point. There is, of course, more nuance, as for Soft and Quick Saves you have the option to send your body back in the state it was in at the time you applied Load with any injuries or changes you might have accumulated, or you can just send back your consciousness to your body in the condition it was in at the time of the Save. You do not have this option if you use the Hard Save, only having the option to send your consciousness back. There is one final effect that you can have dependent on which Save you use. If you Load a Quick Save, you will be able to have a perfectly recursive future sight that will allow you to accomplish any goal you set your mind to as long as it fits between the Quick Save's point in time up to the point in which you Loaded yourself back. If you Load a Soft Save, you will have a partially recursive future sight, giving you an accurate prediction of what to do to accomplish your goals as long as you don't stray too much from the path you originally treaded, with the future sight growing less recursive the further and more radically you stray from the path you originally paved. Finally, if you Load a Hard Save, you will not have any future sight whatsoever besides the base knowledge of the future you carried back with you. Blindspots can make your memories spotty, but if you have the spare Energy, you could potentially brute force an ideal path with repeated Soft and Quick Saves. With this power, as long as you keep trying over and over again, you could potentially grow to match the absurd feats performed by Contessa.
objects.title: First Try!

addons.title: Herald of the Titanomachy
addons.text:
After growing someone to giant size, you can enhance them further, temporarily transforming them into a Titan. Not only will their strength, durability and powers be enhanced to that of a Titan, but they will also retain their mental faculties.

The duration of the Titan transformation is equivalent to whatever time remains on the giant form you granted them. You may end it at any time, either reverting them to their giant state or back to their normal one.

objects.text:
Twice Critical, which can enhance yourself or others, and your powers to grow yourself and others, have merged into one. Now you can grow both yourself and others to truly gigantic proportions.

People will now grow up to twelve times their regular height, granting super strength and increased durability nearly two hundred times in relation to their current size, with any damage they would take being reduced to one twelfth of what they would normally receive. In addition, any other powers they may have are boosted by 200%.

Physical contact is still required to grant the effect to others, though the duration is now two hours for each application unless you end it early. This time limit doesn't apply to you.
objects.title: Herald of the Gigantomachy

objects.text: "Don't wait for the last judgement - It takes place every day." Your powers have coalesced into something that can give the impression of divine judgement, and you have control of it all. At any time, you can look into the thoughts and core personality of anyone within your range, which is now 40 miles wide, and have a complete and comprehensive understanding of who they are, what they are like, and their morality. Upon gaining this understanding, you have the option to 'Smite' them, using your Karma powers to cause damage to them proportional to how bad of a person they are with similar scaling as the original power. This action can even take in the mood and understanding of people nearby to further scale the damage done to a person. You can even make this an automatic process, which targets anyone doing 'evil' within your domain and punishing them based on how awful the offense was. This is just the first function of this power, as the second one is what truly makes this power 'Heavenly'. You may now 'Bless' people who do good within your domain, using the energy within a person's 'soul' to elevate their bodies or minds to a greater degree. This can be based on how good a person is or based on a certain heroic or good action a person did, taking into account surrounding people's mood and understanding of the situation to possibly grant even greater Blessings using the other people's 'soul' energy. A side benefit of this entire system is that for anyone who is grateful when a person is punished or blessed, the system will take a 'tax' of 'soul' energy from them and gift it to you, so that you may empower yourself further in a continuously escalating cycle of judgment and thanks. People can even willingly send you more of their energy if they are aware of the process. With this power, you may be the righteous justice that watches over the masses, punishing the evil and rewarding the good in a Heavenly System.
objects.title: Heaven's System

objects.text: Your Mage Hand has taken in your thinker powers, changer ability and Phasing before elevating itself to the next level. You can now summon and operate one hundred invisible arms and hands that originate from your back, none of which technically have to strictly follow the exact size nor shape of your own arms and hands. You can also increase this limit with training so that you could eventually utilize hundreds or thousands of hands at once. This means that you can maneuver the limbs like noodles, increase their size to the width of a truck, flatten the fingers into claws, and stretch out their length to around the length of a football field. These parameters can be increased with training so that they can stretch even further or grow even bigger. The strength of your limb's scales with their size, so that a normal sized hand would be able to conduct the standard force a normal human hand can, but one the size of a truck can hit with just as much force as a truck. Your extra limbs are by default when summoned invisible and intangible, though you could make them visible in a transparent sense if you desired. The limbs being intangible means that they can slip though solid materials and reach into normally unreachable places, where they can then be partially 'solidified' to do whatever you desire. Don't worry about needing to see, as each of your phantom limbs are able to conduct your Byakugan power so that you may be able to see through them. If any of your limbs were somehow destroyed, you would get 1/100 of the feedback of pain, but you could instantly summon forth a new limb.
objects.title: Diclonius

objects.text: Your Conviction has awakened to its fullest potential through Desperation and Limit Break. Rather than merely empowering you when your emotions run high, it rewards authenticity and unrestrained self-expression. The more honestly and completely you embrace your true self, acting without hesitation in accordance with your ideals, desires, and emotions, the more your limits cease to matter as reality itself seems to fold in the face of your resolve. This manifests as explosive growth in every aspect of your capabilities. Physical prowess soars and powers become stronger, easier to control, more versatile, and more intuitive to wield, often revealing entirely new possibilities that seem perfectly aligned with your current emotional state. Whether driven by hope, fury, ambition, love, or even despair, unwavering sincerity allows your powers to express themselves in ways they never otherwise could. At their peak, even an otherwise ordinary individual could contend with most average parahumans, while a modest cape may temporarily rise to become an S-Class threat. And while such heights cannot be maintained forever, they are never truly lost. Every moment spent acting with complete sincerity leaves behind a lasting imprint, permanently refining your body and powers and your understanding of both them, smoothing away old limitations and preserving a fraction of the might you once reached. Though each breakthrough leaves only a fraction of its peak behind, those fragments accumulate endlessly and steadily transform you into something greater. Every time you bare your heart without reservation, you become just a little closer to the person you were in that moment.
objects.title: The Power of Feelings

objects.text: Your powers have merged in a way that grants you a facsimile of an Asura’s cosmic might. You can now channel Stacked Move’s effects through Action at a Distance, giving you the potent ability to apply a branching movement’s effects through Action at a Distance, without moving your physical body. You’d still feel the strain on your body as if you did make the required movements to create the effects desired, but this essentially allows you to make truly telekinetic actions without any of your previous tells. This still works with Action at a Distance’s enormous range as well, though is more easily achieved within 200 meters. Last but not least, just like how you can stack various branches together to increase the force you can generate through your body, you can do the same to the telekinetic force applied through Action at a Distance. Where before you could generate enough force to lift the Eiffel Tower, now you can generate enough force to knock an Endbringer around like a basketball, though at the cost of incredible strain on your body. If you were to have the Addon Bang!, you would be able to apply this stacked effect onto your ‘ammunition’ to increase the force and piercing power. If you were to have the Addon Body Playstyle, you would be able to stack even more telekinetic force for an even more absurd effect.
objects.title: Asura’s Might

objects.text:
Your power have fused in a way that makes you qualitatively more dangerous.

You may now create your Beamsabers anywhere with the range of you Telekinesis, in any starting orientation or size that is within the original power’s limits. Furthermore, you are now able to create multiple different beams now that you are no longer limited by the number of hands you have, with a starting limit of 10 that you can control with Parallel Processing and can grow with time and training. Being able to control so many Beamsabers mean you can now also ‘link’ the sabers together to create crude shielding against attacks.

In addition to this upgrade, your Byakugan sense is able to be channeled through any Beamsaber you have active, allowing you to make proper use of them even if they are out of range of your normal Byakugan sense. 

Finally, your Sandevistan has increased the speed and acceleration of the movement of your Beamsabers, allowing them to instantly reach the top speed Sandevistan can produce with no strain on yourself.
objects.title: Luxa

objects.text:
Your ability to permanently attune areas to specific colors to grant Shaker like affects has resonated with your essence as a Living Seal, resulting in your powers merging to grant an even greater affect.

You Ink has gained the ability to change Color, allowing you to grant the Ink itself various supernatural effects, from painting an opponent blue to make them experience enhanced gravity or, with a slight change of hue, make them experience a severe depressive episode. Another example would be painting someone green to enhance their regenerative healing or give them a calm mind.

The last benefit from these new Colors is that they massively amplify the effects of Fuinjutsu, as long as the effect of what you are trying to achieve uses Colors that resonate with the affect.
objects.title: Fauvism
Children of Khepri
objects.text: It seems you Shard fumbled something in the creation of a bug Master power, and it has resulted in… this. Now, not only do you have the ability to turn into a swarm of arthropods and have all arthropods in your control range act like relays for your power, but at the cost of your ability to fuse anything else, you can now fuse the different arthropods under your control together! During this fusion process, you can cherry pick individual traits that you want to keep or even pronounce further in new and unique ways with your Tinker knowledge of genetics, leading to things like a spider with giant dragonfly wings that had glowing legs from a firefly. That’s not how bioluminescence works? Seems you Shard doesn’t agree with that, or maybe it does and it’s just as confused as you are. Another aspect of the fusion of animals is that you aren’t required to add anything new to the base animal, and just have all the additional mass increase the size of the arthropods to a nightmarish degree. One final note is that while you are limited to arthropods when it comes to adding anything new genetic abilities or traits to your fused creatures, you do have one more gene set you can pull from; your human body. By turning into a swarm of arthropods and sending at least one into a fusion, you can add aspects that you would normally only see in a human, resulting in creations like an Arachne from Greek myth. With this power, you easily have the potential to be as bad or worse than Nilbog, and are the scariest thing ever for anyone with entomophobia.
This is a Divider do NOT touch
objects.title: Divider

addons.text:
Oberon is fused into Unlimited Trump Works. 

The number of slots from Oberon increases to six (or nine with Negentropy), they can hold any of the powers you have copied. You are able to choose from either the primary expression or any alternative expression you have discovered. However, you cannot bring forth any modified versions of these powers. Multiple compatible powers can occupy the same slot and will synergize together. Power compatibility depends on the power itself and not its expression.

Each Oberon slot gains three auxiliary slots which work the same way as described above. The power configuration of these slots can be bound to the slotted power(s) and will automatically be recalled when it is brought forth.
addons.title: Leanansidhe

addons.text:
Araboth fuses with Unlimited Trump Works to act as a supportive aspect. Your slots now feature the Araboth’s upgrade and enchantment rarity system bolstering the prospective powers’ quality and potential. Each active and reserve slots start at Grey. Rarity progression costs are left untouched. 

Each upgrading to a rarity level increases the active slots’ power potential, with Araboth aiding the process by either lightly suggesting components with promising synergy and effectivity or by simply automating the process with charges, improving both particular and random power generation by mechanically picking power patterns/expressions that are oriented favorably to the user’s unconscious preferences and desires. Scaling with each rarity level. 

In their fusion, both Araboth and Unlimited Trump Works mutate, with the auxiliary slots mixing with the enchantment system, resulting in Aliena-like power creation (being untouched, for the most part) gaining the possibility of being altered and augmented further with enchantments, being distributed or reallocated at your liking. The amount of enchantments per rarity is left untouched.

Reserve slots are a different matter, their passive improvement is accumulatively expanded depending on their rarity level and their power modification is largely the same, with the detail of Araboth’s support, being the same as with active slots. 

The power transferal is now applicable to items, losing the power while retaining the knowledge of the pattern and enchantments.

Your changes expand to 30 charges per day (40 with Negentropy), and the possibility of expanding the number of charges by sacrificing an enchantment in return, giving the amount of 2 charges.

Note: Both the rarity system and original features use the same currency for the sake of reasonable standards.
addons.title: Shehaqim

addons.text:
Principled Designer has fused with Unlimited Trump Works, allowing for new possibilities to be discovered.

Principled Designer now considers your clusters valid targets for some of its mechanisms, now referring to its original clusters as Node Clusters and the new clusters as Slot Clusters. This means that using an Interchange Core you may now connect your different clusters to achieve a variety of effects. 

Firstly, you may connect to Emulation or Computational Cores in order to speed up the process of gathering data for improving powers in your reserve slots, with your VI managing optimal changes to said powers.

Secondly, when 120 hours (5 Days) are up, you now have the option to create either a new Node Cluster or new Slot Cluster. You also have additional to improve charge generation by 20% (additive).

Third, you are able to create a power pattern from any group of Cores or Modules as well as obtain blueprints that allows you or your VI to configure Cores and/or Modules for any pattern in your library.

Finally, using the appropriate combinations of cores and modules, you can upgrade and modify a slot into a different slot. This requires both that you have cores and modules of the appropriate level to handle the maximum SP requirements of the slot in question and that you deduce the formation necessary to induce the change. This is because, like with power creation and emulation, you do not automatically gain the knowledge of how to do so beyond the basics, in this case turning minor slots into major reserve slots and major auxiliary slots. This can even allow you to create new kinds of slots not originally found in Unlimited Shard Works, but this will require heavy experimentation.
addons.title: Antikythera

addons.text:
Nexus fused with Unlimited Trump Works. Rather than destroying or giving away unneeded shards, you now have a nigh-unlimited Shardspace to stored them. You can deposit as many shards as you like within this dimension.

In this space, unused shards will neither improve nor collect data passively. To retrieve them, you must spend 1 point and either have an open slot available or swap out existing shards in your slots.

You will still have access to powers that you give out as those shards will appear within the Shardspace. You can use 1 charge to remove the power, regardless of distance. If you wish to give the same power to multiple things, you must spend 1 point for each additional thingbeyond the first. Shards that are used this way will passively gather data and improve over time, with improvements accelerating as more things are connected to to the shard. However, too much connections to the same shard in addition with the shard's potency can deplete its energy quickly unless you possess Negentropy.
addons.title: Unlimited Storage Works

addons.text:
Faerie Queen power has been fused with Unlimited Trump Works.

You can now create and summon shades for powers that you possess in any of your Unlimited Trump Works slots. Or rather, you can use your slots as Faerie Queen summons using the slots power as a basis. You are able to choose from either the primary expression or any alternative expression you have discovered, and you may alter the forms of the Shades at will.

All summoned Shades will have three auxiliary slots, in addition to however many auxiliary slots they would have by virtue of the slot they are using up. This includes any shades summoned normally. The power configuration of these slots can be bound to the slotted power(s) and will automatically be recalled when it is brought forth.

When a shade is summoned using one of your slots, you cannot use that slot for yourself, Shades can also be summoned from Reserve Slots without hampering your ability to use the Active Slot.
addons.title: Titania

addons.text:
Power Guru is fused into Unlimited Trump Works. 

You have your month long cool down as normal, but can now also expend charges for further alterations. This includes improving upon Power Guru and Unlimited Trump Works itself. 

You can manipulate the powers inside UTW through Power Guru. This grants three particular abilities, in addition to the abilities granted through Self Guided Coding.

You can now improve the powers inside each slot, both active and reserve. This can allow you to improve an ability’s overall power beyond its slot’s power limit. This does not increase the slots power limit itself, meaning any additional abilities created inside is still capped at the previous limit, instead it targets the power directly. 

The second ability is that you can now target the slots directly, increasing their overall limit. This cannot be used concurrently alongside improving the power held inside the slot itself. 

The third ability that you no longer need to expend charges to alter expressions, capable of rewriting powers and altering expressions at will. 

The final ability is that you gain 5 minor slots (and 3 reserve slots for each). The difference between these slots and others is that while you are limited to creating powers equal to a rating 8 (20 SP) in the slot through Unlimited Trump Works, the slots have no set power cap to how powerful an ability they can hold and/or can grow. 

This can allow you to collect and hold abilities past its threshold without worry or limit, as well as allow to improve power held them through usage and data gathering as well as Power Guru’s influence, allowing it to grow vertically as well horizontally. 

It cost a single charge to add an auxiliary slot, in order to create additional slots you must take the maximum power that they can hold, how many charges it would take to make it manually, and then multiply by 4. Each created slot comes with 3 reserve slots as well as appropriate auxiliary slots. Slots may be converted between tiers, a higher grade slot will convert to 3 lower grade ones and 3 lower grade ones can be combined to a higher grade one. Converting slots also converts the auxiliary slots.

This can allow you to construct slots more powerful than the core slots. You are no longer limited to your lesser slots to hand out powers. 

Each power and target is considered a separate target for Power Guru with their own individual cooldowns.
addons.title: Aos Sí

addons.text: Your shard has unlocked access to the master control plane of Unlimited Trump Works, the underlying systems that manage the power. All of your powers can now be managed by Unlimited Trump Works, with no regard to cost. As an extension of Prototype, the same facilities and capabilities are available here but at a much larger scale.
