In addition to this, you are able to create new effectors, essentially allowing you to create new primary and auxiliary slots, in addition to upgrading them to hold more powerful patterns. It takes 5 times the amount of charges a slot can hold to create or upgrade it. With this, you are able to modify and upgrade any part of Unlimited Trump Works, and are able to grow endlessly, as long as you can pay for the infrastructure and don't run out of energy.
addons.title: Master Control Plane

addons.text: After building up what Shehaqim accomplishes with Unlimited Trump Works, Chaos Engine starts a tug of war with Unlimited Trump Works. It was a hard-fought struggle, yet one that ends with an epiphany: both powers reside within the side Shard architecture, while they manage similar resources in different models, they use the same resource. With this conclusion, Unlimited Trump Works combines its vast architecture with the generative networking of the Chaos Engine, acting as both the reactor and logic gate that automates and supercharges your slots, with one plain evolution being the network’s access to your slots. The core of this is expressed through your dynamic network mesh that Chaos Engine structured around UTW, with your slots treated as “nodes” within a central database, treated equally, as reserve slots are renovated back to active slots. Each slot receives its auxiliary slots based on rarity level, increasing by the power of two (Gray has 1 auxiliary slot, White has 2 auxiliary slots, Green has 4 auxiliary slots, etc.). Your slots retain your rating system, which continually completes a cycle every two months if left alone, with Shehaqim’s mechanics remaining untouched yet revised. It doesn’t git rid of UTW’s passive growth for reserve slots, so much it reworks it with Chaos Engine’s process, including auxiliary slots, [Creating] perfect supporting or complementary powers the base power would need or benefit from. The mesh’s internal pool of charges is revamped into a constantly recharging [Energy] reservoir after UTW’s energy pools merged with Chaos Engine’s reserves, your powers being constantly upgraded while being limited by the rarity level of slots you need to upgrade. This principle of evolution applies to powers as well. Every power copied, stolen, or created is saved as a power pattern, with UTW (with [Creation’s] help) manifesting these stored patterns into any available slot or physical items at will for your Network at a cost equal to 1 charge. Getting into the integrated mechanics from Chaos Engine, UTW manual modification is automated, where powers and slots will [Evolve] by being constantly linked with the pool, at the same time upgrading your personal and the reserve slot’s rarity level at a slower pace. Another form of management you can apply to your slots is using [Fusion] to any power to break it down to its barest essentials, and play around them for innovative power patterns without fully fusing them, [Evolution] in tandem for maximum power development, etc. As part of Chaos Engine’s Cornerstone module, it’ll ensure your Network’s active slots are as efficient and synergic as possible, analyzing and adjusting their specifications like their “Manton Effects”, ensuring the best compatibility between them. Taking full advantage of the Engine’s potential for distribution, UTW expands upon it, providing the most compatible powers to other members of your Network source from your power database, automatically [Creating] and [Evolving] it, then allowing members to use [Fusion] to let other powers mix without the need of going through its usual process. As soon as you grow used to this system, you’ll begin to understand you’re the very expression of the Entity’s power structure, made of countless pieces and energy in the purpose of solving one of the greatest questions: how far can the universe survive with finite resources? and how far can a lifeform go with the universe’s finite resources?. Negentropy doesn’t significantly increase your charge; instead, it adds efficiency and more value to your internal reservoir. Your slot’s rarity level increases between one and two weeks, depending on your usage.
addons.title: Tehom

objects.text:
Manager, Prototype, and Shard Supply Store have fused into Unlimited Trump Works.

Your power slots merge into a single cluster of one core slots, which can hold a power rated 14 (~80 SP), three primary slots, which can hold powers rated 12 (~60 SP), six major slots, which can hold powers rated 10 (~40 SP), and nine minor slots, which can hold powers rated 8 (~20 SP). In addition to this, the power also has reserve slots to store inactive powers that can be hot-swapped into their active counterpart. Each rank has three reserve slots per active slot (3 for core, 9 for primary, 18 for major, and 27 for minor.)

These slots can be filled in several ways. You can copy powers from any Parahuman in a 100m range from you, this comes with the ability to sense their presence and approximate location, steal a power by touching a Parahuman directly, or you can create powers that match your specifications. This can be done manually by assembling components from the library Shard Supply Store provides and sealing them into a pattern at the cost of one charge, or by spending charges to automate the creation. Powers created this way starts with a rating of 4 for one charge and increases in cost according to the triangular number sequence (costs for ratings 4 to 14: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36, 45, 55, 66). Prototype is capable of generating almost any power you ask for and can fill in the blanks if your specification is incomplete. You can also generate random powers with a category of your choice for a 50% discount. (You cannot create Trump powers that can modify Unlimited Trump Works itself under any circumstances.)

In addition to this, each of your slots possesses a number of auxiliary slots that function as augments or support powers, they behave the same way as (Trump) Aliena and can each contain 20 points worth. Your core slot has five auxiliaries, each primary slot has three, and each major slot has two.

Powers in reserve slots are passively improved based on data collected while they are in use, you can force this process to happen in an active slot by expending 1 charge but the power will be weakened by 20% until the changes are finalized (this takes about 2-6 hours). You are also able to alter them by modifying the pattern, either manually at no cost (but this takes time and experimentation), or automatically at the expense of one or more charges depending on the extent of the modifications. You can also cycle through different expressions of the power at the cost of one charge and either replace the power or copy the new expression to a reserve slot. The powers in your major and minor slots can be transferred to other people, you will lose access to the power but retain knowledge of the pattern.

You gain 15 charges per day (25 with Negentropy) and your component library completely refills in around a week, depending on how many components were used. Other powers you possess that cost 20 SP or less are automatically attached as slots in a separate cluster but do not gain reserve or auxiliary slots. They can be modified only by expending charges but cannot be copied or given out.
objects.title: Unlimited Trump Works

addons.text: With the inclusion of (Trump) Manager and (Trump) Prototype as support for Prelate and Cleric, aiding with these modules’ [Project] control and its growth within your controlled Shards and the Network, quickly improving its results. Prototype uses its long experience in power generation as a basis for designing and fielding all-new [Data] models for [Projects]. Manager, in the meantime, tests and adapts these, looking for design flaws or blind spots. This constant back-and-forth is then improved by [Query] turning inward and outward, surveying and accelerating the Shards involved in the [Project] in terms of bandwidth and performance, thereby speeding feedback and, consequently, [Project] completion. Queen isn’t left out of this process, using Manager and Prototype to refine [Energy] source and consumption and build up [Data] allocation/efficiency, scaling down Shards with better [Data] resourcing and exploitation.
addons.title: Dai Shogun

addons.text: After Pramant is integrated into Imperator with [Expanse’s] Shardspace Management, Imperator now looks for new “ideas” through the Network for [Projects] focusing on new [Data] packet creation above all else. At the same time, your models work through ongoing [Projects]. By transmitting your [Expanse] [Data] through your Shards, therefore enhancing their connection, creating a firewall blocking any suspicion from Entities.
addons.title: Suzerain

addons.text: (Trump) Override and Elfame’s integration manifests as the de facto [Project] auditors or quality tester, scrutinizing the Network for poor performance or what amounts to a strike for Shards, ensuring the [Project] it’s made to your expectations, finding any errors or glitches in their [Data] packets that might hinder you, with some option to remediate being the pruning of Shards in Queen’s or lobotomy in Prelate or Cleric’s case, their remains being repurposed to well-suited Shards.
addons.title: Court Chancellor

addons.text: Cornerstone, Quartermaster, and Connection are integrated into Broadcast, adding a dimension to its modules’ performance. Managing Hosts not only will imply optimizing and improving Hosts’ abilities for a [Project’s] success, with a lack of the usual risks associated with said enhancement (see Khepri), alongside a communal access for [Data]—knowledge, experience, power, [Energy]—from the Network needed to accomplish it.
addons.title: Minister

addons.text:
Your ability to exist in many timelines at once and fuse together disparate parts have combined with your ability to converge and diverge shards. As a result you are become a hive-mind Multiversal Constant.

You now exist in every shard in your network, allowing you to transfer your consciousness, core, and abilities to any and every shard in the whole of your network. Combined with your ability to effortlessly fuse, separate, and reconfigure shards, you exist everywhere and nowhere along the multiverse, with each shard, from the highest to the lowest, capable of carrying out the tasks of the most complicated tiers and powers with barely a strain on their existence.

Unless the whole shard network you exist in have been destroyed, you will always have access to the full might of your abilities and respawn over and over again, allowing you to recover from any injury until you are made whole again.
addons.title: Omni-Shard Nexus

addons.text: Your Inner Beast or Anaqi’s divine ambition has redefined your authority. As your Shards surpass their now crystalline prison that was their form and their existence as biological supercomputers solely focused on a fool’s errand, your Beast or Anaqi’s insights change them to being distant cousins to your Partner, while being beholden to your control. After transcending their limitations, your now-called Fragments—entities that kept their expansive hold over reality, supercomputing, and multidimensional physiology—unleash themselves from their barely clinging sapience, and it’s then replaced by a togetherness with the world at large. Shedding their unfolding composition invested in computing/information for an interdimensional specter of exotic particles, their abilities are fully unshackled by an order of magnitude, with their multidimensionality evolving to folding into themselves on further dimensions akin to an ad-hoc Pocket Shard, which implies a departure from reality’s rules. They are negentropic by nature, their [Energy] having metaphysical properties to be a self-sustaining system. Yet despite their transcendence, they’re meant to be a part of a greater being: You. These Fragments learn to branch out, taking on new aspects and facets from their “names”, for instance, Dimensional Shunting will embrace and learn about surrounding concepts like Dimensional Transference and Interaction, pushing and spreading through the realm of the supernatural that comes to a head with a semantic view of Dimensions. With this redefinition, your toolkit applies more than just Shards, culminating in its reach to all lifeforms so long as they’re under a similar structure or system as Shards, conceptually reinventing itself to do so. Doesn’t matter how, either through an iron fist or helping hand, when there’s a [Pursuit] you follow through your retinue, Imperator holds grip. This also opens the chance to form Fragments from just about anything, for example, a stray bullet paves the way to form a Ballistic Fragment, doomscrolling turns into a Social Management or Control Fragment, and the ubiquitous flare of anxiety resting in your chest takes the shape of a Fight-or-Flight Fragment, pulling the concept to form a Fragment out of it. If you Awakened through your Inner Beast (picking the Ascension with Inner Beast), both abilities seamlessly meld with one another, a Beast Emperor of the Highest Order.
addons.title: Celestial Mandate

objects.text: As a result of integrating all your Administrator powers and Cleave and Lacerate acting as a Broadcast [Data] packet, it results in the creation of a Shard Administrator toolkit that your Passenger can now take advantage of to manage and lead other Shards within the Cycle. All this works based on [Projects], in this power's context, are scalable directives that the Shard Network needs to follow under a Cycle, being assigned to a specialized group of Shards or being an underlying imperative that all have to follow for the success of the Cycle, and what an Entity wishes to accomplish, resulting in new [Data] packets expressed as powers or Buds other Shard including your own can link to improve on themselves. This practically spoofs and overrides an Entity's main directives with yours by your Passenger's library of keys and permissions you obtained in your power's fusion. Each Administrator power already had distinct approaches to running their slots or powers acting as modules beneath Imperator's wider system, and will tend to differing priorities, that, in time, will work with each other in unison to grant you full control of the Shard Network. These modules are: Prelate: Now acting as Shard Database and Dossier Manager, having a record of every Shard it encountered and interfaced with in its life, Higher Priest regained full control of its underlying systems. Now it acts as a relay to connect to and access the [Data] within other (or all) Shards in its vicinity, and can record and store it for later use. You'll be capable of tapping into other Shards to access/record their [Expression] and fully control its depth and breadth, customizing and elevating it to a Titan or Endbringer level of powers, mass interlinking of Shards to collaborate and exchange between them, and generate new expressions or findings as [Data] packets you have at your disposal, etc. Another approach is Cleric, an SDK (Software Development Kit) for Shards, where fully rewriting and programming them is possible, and, unlike Prelate, no [Data] networking is needed. Taking the shape of your "flickering", changing quantum states and information is a perfect tool to control a Shard's local programming, [Data] access from previous cycles, reverting changes to a Shard's previous place in the timeline, etc. all without a [Query] in sight. The difference between Prelate and Cleric is how one parallels the other, while one focuses on highly innovative Shard collaborations for more ingenious [Data] packets one can crystallize in potential Buds, the latter works by simply innovating within the Shard's possibilities in its available [Data] and the potential it has by reformulating it to something different yet familiar, a slow feedback-based approach. Both join forces to access and utilize all the foreseeable Shards deployed throughout the Cycle: a constant mass relay with Prelate alongside the mass programming of Cleric. For example, you can massively access all Shards in an area similar to Boston, tapping into their [Expression] to intermix or create synergies between them, even swap or refine all power configurations within your range, like reconfiguring Weld's power and curing his Case 53 condition and recovering his memories via better [Host] connection packets and using his Passenger's memory records. Queen is another module that has been revitalized by this integration, fully recovered to full functionality, and now operates as a mix of lower-level programming and a Shard hardware engineer. Shards are, by the end of the day, made of smaller Buds just as an Entity is made of Shards. Through the plug-and-play of specific parts of a Shard's lattice, you'll be able to change the level of [Energy], [Resources], [Structure], and essential [Data] of Shards. And with Broadcast broadening in scope by interacting with your Administrator powers, it takes over the role of coordinating and facilitating [Projects] among Shards, by extension, Hosts. How Broadcast works adapts to the [Project's] scale and goal, involving Hosts only when needed. As an example, if a [Project] consists of creating an antithesis of the Three Blasphemies, Broadcast will facilitate a subconscious draw and telepathic link between Hosts to accomplish this [Project] and attune their Shard Connection for greater access to needed blueprints between them. Your full potential won't be up for easy grabs, only starting at the tip of the iceberg when it comes to you, i.e., Prelate interfacing and recording [Data] for personal use, Cleric optimizing and refining your Shard, Queen controlling your [Energy] efficiency and the like, with Broadcast being untouched yet toothless with a city-wide range. Aside from natural progression, if you're in an area where Hosts are aplenty, your modules unlock their functions at your disposal, proportional to the area. With time and experience, this grows exactly what it says on the tin (and more!). Just don't believe you're hot air, or you'll stick like a sore thumb in the Network. The Entity will notice.
objects.title: Imperator

addons.text:
The old functions Arakiel and Supervisor Override, boosted by Optimum and System Administrator, have been added to The Chaos Engine, enhancing and expanding its capabilities. Your active slots for System Administrator have been converted to Chaos Engine slots, with each Chaos Engine slot gaining their capabilities as well. Storage slots are instead repurposed into unused Network slots.

Optimum’s simulations are used to further perfect the functions [Evolution] and [Fusion]. Both are fed the data of the various paths that different powers could evolve and fuse into, using this data to determine the determine which path is best for present and future use. These upgraded versions of your powers are then further simulated, creating a feedback loop.

To help provide [Data] for the simulations and improve your network as a whole, Arakiel has been repurposed into the new function [Adaption]. [Adaption] is the process of enhancing the user instead of their power. This process is similar to how a Case 53 would have an enhanced power expression but is far more controlled. These enhancements do not act as shard powers but more along the line of genetic modifications. The idea is that by enhancing the hardware of the body, members of the network will be able to use the software of shard powers more efficiently. This not only increases thinking capabilities and physical health but can even help do things such as letting a person require less oxygen or increasing their tolerance to radiation. This will allow powers to more less restrained in their expressions, allowing them to “turn up the heat” as it were. This results in an increase in the amount of simulations that are more viable to collect [Data] from.
addons.title: Azazael

addons.text:
Jailbreak by itself would normally be too unstable to safely integrate into The Chaos Engine, but when filtered through temporary powers such as those gained by Eidolon-like and Synthesis Forge it becomes a rather large source of [Data]. Jailbreak has now been dissembled and rebuilt into The Chaos Engine’s newest function, [Explosion]. This rebuild does not stop Jailbreak from being used normally on your powers, including The Chaos Engine itself, it simply creates an outlet to safely gather [Data] from the results.

[Explosion] is the process of stress testing potential new powers in different expressions in randomized directions. This is done by having temporary powers affected by any or all of Jailbreak’s previous methods, with The Chaos Engine’s charging ability being used to effectively skip phases depending on how roughly they need to be tested. The temporary nature of these powers means that they can be resummoned either with the previous modifications to continue testing or as a clean slate to begin a new experiment. [Data] from these powers will then be fed into the other functions of The Chaos Engine to create optimized versions of the modified powers. 

Powers generated by Synthesis Forge better retain small scale and precise improvements due to better categorization of the [Data] but are less effective at gathering more after phase 3 due to becoming more volatile. Powers generated by Eidolon-like on the other hand struggle to provide [Data] when used for phases 1 and 2 but surprisingly act extremely well in phases 3 and above due to both the battery and auxiliary powers acting as stabilizers, to the point where it can successfully gain large amounts of data even in phase 5. This means that it works better at getter large and broadscale [Data].
addons.title: Muspell

addons.text:
This is a rather interesting direction; The Chaos Engine now has data on how both Case 53s and Titans are made. Both are technically the results of the broken cycle and each one results in various degrees of modification to the power they were given. With this [Data] a new function has been created, [Mutation].

[Mutation] is a rather odd function in that is the deliberate act of incorrectly connecting a shard’s power to the host. This is different from [Evolution] in that [Evolution] is the refined process of modifying a power based off input [Data]; whereas [Mutation] is the process of modifying a power to output [Data]. The results of this are various Case 53 and Titan forms. A single power can be mutated into multiple different directions, resulting in no two instances of [Mutation] being the same. [Data] is taken from both how these forms function to how they are used to fuel all other functions in new and exciting ways. For example: [Fusion] could be used on both a Case 53 form and Titan form to create something more than capable of fighting the likes of Behemoth and winning.

This process would normally result in various mental and physical problems for a shard’s host. To prevent the loss of valuable members of the network, the network will now store backups of member’s mind and, in an interesting inversion of Proto-Entity, have a new body made for them from a small bud of shard flesh from another member’s titan form. This new body will have a small reboot time as the shard flesh stabilizes, during which they have limited access to the powers of the network. After that, they will regain the ability to turn into a human, Titan, or Case 53.

Back to the Proto-Entity, it is also possible members of the network to physically combine with [Fusion], potentially creating their own Proto-Entity, separate from the form you could achieve. Theoretically, if you had enough Proto-Entities, you could combine into a Fully Grown Entity. This is purely theoretical however since the energy cost would be too much for most shards to bear, unless you have Negentropy.
addons.title: Saturnus

objects.text:
A revolutionary power has been born within you. The power of Keystone has fused with Araboth, creating The Chaos Engine. This power is dedicated to the manifestation and growth of power in all its forms. Araboth’s charges and Magnhild’s charging ability have been unified into a constantly charging pool that is used to constantly enhance yourself, your network, and fuel your new abilities. These abilities are [Creation], [Evolution], and [Fusion].

[Creation] is an upgraded version of Araboth's ability to create new powers and enchantments. Now, powers will not only be made for you, but for all members of Keystone’s network. Members of the network can get tailor-made powers and power configurations suited for their individual strengths, skills, and weaknesses. All new enchantments and powers are recorded into a database from which they can either be used by you, anyone in your network, or manifested as an item. Magnhild’s specific form of item creation also interacts with the rarity system, allowing you to instantly create items at any rarity if you invest enough energy from your pool. Additionally, due to Araboth’s ability to put charges into your own body, you can also enchant people unconnected to the network, giving them the power. Powers and enchantments stored in the database will initially be at the strength of a low T1.

[Evolution] is the process from which the powers and enchantments can grow from a low T1 to a High T3 and above. This growth is fueled by the pool to cause it to grow in as many directions as possible. To help facilitate this growth, powers will sometimes be downgraded to as low as T0 so that they can be regrown into a different direction, allowing for extreme variation with even one initial power. All states of the power are recorded into the database and can be manifested using your available slots, those of your network, or of any item you create. Additionally, [Evolution] also cause constant growth in your personal rarity, causing you to complete a full cycle in approximately a month. This can be sped up or slowed down based on much energy from the pool you actively use. You may also increase the rarity of all members of your network at your discretion. [Evolution]’s interaction with the network does not stop there. It will also be analyzing their power usage to find interactions between powers depending on their synergy and compatibility. This data will be used to constantly polish their powers in terms of efficiency, use, and configurations (like limitations and Manton Effect).

[Fusion] is quite simply, the fusion of two different powers or enchantments into one. [Fusion] can also be used to divide powers into component powers as weak as T0. This is done to combine different aspects of different powers together without having to fuse them completely. Used in conjunction with [Evolution], a single power can be expanded upon to create an entire library of powers, with [Creation] expanding upon that even further. Manifested items can also be subject to [Fusion] allowing you to combine them into higher rarity items or divide them into lower rarity items. [Fusion] also benefits the network by allowing powers used by different members to interact with each other in specific and targeted ways or preventing interference between them.
objects.title: The Chaos Engine

addons.text:
Your abilities to control your existence, both conceptually and physically, redefined Perfect Body’s scope and reach in such a way it covers microscopic changes at a macro scale. 

Your bodily control can now be exerted on every particle within yourself, this allows your bodily awareness—your conscious mind—to spread through all that makes them capable of performing operations, coordinated and/or prehensile movement throughout their being, personally manipulating your bodily condition, variables, physics, etc. 

This doesn’t mean your imaginative abilities don’t pull their weight, your condition being under your imagination’s influence, allowing you to shift and manipulate their state of being and mind to anything they desire. This offers All-or-Nothing capabilities such as turning your material composition with Siberian-like or Sting-like characteristics and then some.
addons.title: [Form]

addons.text: Your Optimized Bio-Energy processing and Sangria’s bloody evolution have allowed you to assimilate and manipulate it within you from a distance. Your stomach and Gnawing Hunger’s maws can gnash and gorge themselves anything to turn it into comestible biomass for feeding your abilities while maintaining some distance, absorbing everything—in the physical and metaphysical sense—of the consumed material, living and nonliving, replicating, melding, and/or manipulating anything from them.
addons.title: [Essence]

objects.text:
Your bodily and self-organic powers evolved and changed while inalterably transforming your physical existence into the pinnacle of what’s conceivable for a [Shard] host, the peak of Brute and Changer powers in one. 

Your Changer powers essentially turned your body into a pliable and perfected set of structures you modify and adjust to your liking, already transcending the limits of the human experience and potential through sourcing genetic traits from a myriad of host species and [DATA] obtained by stress-testing and researching said traits creating development within them, creating a naturally “perfect” organism as genetically and biologically perfect as it’s afforded to both the [Cycle] and Nature. 

You aren’t conventionally perfect, to clarify. Still, it is as perfected and refined as the Changer and Brute Shards’ eons of [DATA] and insight without mutating the host to a Shard physiognomy.

The culmination of these abilities, while willfully retaining their applications, contains several abilities that set it apart: You can adapt and modify anything about yourself, manipulating your genetic code and composition to adjust your adaptation’s properties/variables by will-based command, while also retaining its reactiveness to develop both countermeasures and adaptation to any environment or opposition; while you already manage and control your body—both biologically (muscles, bones, veins, neurons, etc.) and systematically (reflexes, instincts, coordination, psychomotor movement, etc.)—losing both definition and limitations, your physical capabilities and potential being unbounded of what’s capable to change and do, a sort of bodily supremacy, being able to move athletically and acrobatically with remarkable grace in conjunction of sustaining a willful enhancement of one's biological systems to maximize your performance, resilient against forced motor control and/or transfiguration by others.

All this translates to being in control of every part of your body and genome, your consciousness spread across every cell and particle for you to control. Your physical being adaptively develops to any change of environment or threat while you’re not manipulating them. This control extends to a large and small scale, i.e., controlling the traits of your digestive system can allow you to adapt it for assimilating and consuming technology you can ingest and implement in your body, or to replicate/incorporate them in your regenerative process; these changes have cascading effects such as your body naturally adjusting to produce technorganic cells due to the assimilated machinery; as your consciousness is over your entire body, you can separate parts of it down to their particle and remotely command them, also able to interact with matter and energy of your surroundings to assimilate them and, surely, control it altogether.

And this is only the tip of the iceberg.

From all this, you can accomplish all the capabilities that this power’s made of, and more, the only limitation being your imagination, biomass, and calorie intake to sustain this.
objects.title: Perfect Body

addons.text: Your repository of knowledge finalizes your ascendancy through your mental framework, unbinding your mind to the working of the universe, already privy and watchful to the minutia with your Shard Feedback, you are intuitively aware of how the world works in several levels of scale, helping in your development of Thinker/Master/Shaker/Striker abilities coalescing into one, geared to warp reality through pure brain power alone and with a thought, essentially turning you into a nigh-omniscient entity with unlimited potential.
addons.title: [Understanding]

addons.text: Overlord and your existence as living strands of information support your Perfect Mind in terms of your perception and awareness through their sources of information: Overlord’s subsumption of Earth’s computational supremacy swell your already expensive intellect, extending your Technopathy/Cyperpathy by leaps and bounds that spill over reality, creating an adjacent reality sourced from your cyberspace in time due to developing alongside your cognitive abilities where you’re its god; Informatio’s existential information, essentially spreads your awareness throughout all minds appraised or aware of you, as you’re not only aware of their existence to the last minute detail, you can connect and meld into their minds to either control or use as another Node for a bump in bandwidth or other uses.
addons.title: [Information]

objects.text: Your Master and Thinker powers based on processing and knowledge evolved and changed inalterably transforming your mental existence into the pinnacle of what is conceivable for a [Shard] host, the peak of Thinker/Master powers in one. A complement of Perfect Body, your Thinker powers turn your mind and cerebral sectors into a pliable and perfect set of modules where you modify and redefine your brain and cerebral capacity as well your psychological process (identity, memory, feeling, sensory input, etc.) transcending one's mental restrictions, weaknesses, and cognitive impairments, allowing them to unlock, develop, and improve their mental capabilities than before through sourcing both genetic traits and neurological strides in science made by myriad host species and [DATA] obtained by stress-testing, researching and applying said neurological and cognitive frameworks fostering a degree of evolution, creating a naturally “perfect” mental framework afforded to both the [Cycle] and Nature. Your mind isn’t conventionally perfect, to clarify. Still, it is as perfected and refined as the Thinker Shards’ eons of [DATA] and insight without fully mutating the host to a Shard physiognomy; as Shard Feedback could attest it, your cerebellum is adapted through process and revel by your mind’s full weight of perceptive abilities, being made of Shardflesh to account to the massive influx of [Data] and processing. The culmination of these abilities, while willfully retaining their applications, contains several abilities that set it apart: Transcending your mental limitations, your developing unbound cognitive abilities such as increased or cultivated imagination, visualization, learning, foresight, prediction, calculative skills, memory, and better right-to-left brain connectivity. In some instances, these cognitive abilities surpass their scope and are used to develop into Thinker/Master/Shaker/Striker abilities oddly reminiscent of psychic abilities; your mental structure, similar to Perfect Body, is both controllable and unleashed of definition and limitation, being able to manipulate at will their own emotions, sensations, perceptions, consciousness, memories, personality and everything connected to their brain and mind granting highly advanced capabilities. This allows both optimal efficiency and maximal comfort in all situations while preserving the user's ability to feel sensations and emotions, granting complete immunity to mind-altering abilities; your perception and sensory input helped by your Shard are viewed through a unified scientific model, sensed between quark to quark, turning reality as a comprehensive system. Your perception is as far as you can see, as this view of the world functions independently of your conventional senses, less you tune it out. From all this, you can accomplish all the capabilities that this power’s made of and more, the only limitation being your imagination, calorie intake, and mental stamina.
objects.title: Perfect Mind

addons.text:
It turns out your shard was right. Souls are indeed real, but there was one thing it overlooked. Your soul has been asleep this whole time, with you puppeteering it about on the strings of your [Will].

In waking your soul, the imposition of your [Will] upon the world is both broadened and deepened; rather than only your techniques and equipment, any power you wield and any action you take can be imbued with an All-or-Nothing effect. Given its innumerable uses, this ability is somewhat conceptual in nature, creating or eliminating quantum potentialities as necessary to ensure your success. Are you late for work? Applying your [Will] to the desire to be on time ensures that every light is green, every traffic cop is engrossed with their delicious bear claw, and every pedestrian decides to look both ways before crossing as you speed through the city.

You are able to apply All-or-Nothing effects to any tinkertech that you craft as well, though not retroactively, requiring you to imbue your [Will] into your technology as you build it. However much of your self you choose to impart to your creation, that is the limit of its capabilities; despite carrying an All-or-Nothing effect within it, the device can only overcome that which is commensurate with the level of [Will] you have invested in it. A piece of tinkertech might have enough of your [Will] to defeat Kaiser easily, while still falling short of laying Hookwolf low, at least through truly arbitrary means.

While this opens up many possibilities, actually applying your [Will] at every opportunity is terribly inefficient and dangerous, undoubtedly leading to death, sans negentropy or shardlessness, and frequent bouts of unconsciousness even with them. As such, further experimentation and training within your Arena is a must, that you might impose your [Will] as easily as Entities make use of [Data].
addons.title: [Awakening]

addons.text:
With your Passenger's improved understanding of metaphor and symbolism, you've learned to temper your [Will] with creativity, allowing you to assert that [Will] over physics directly. You do this by drawing upon the energies generated by the quantum foam of local spacetime, thinking the proper thoughts, and bending your [Shadow] into just the right configurations.

The result is myriad iconic phenomena colored by your emotional state and experiences; it cannot be overstated how important it is that these manifestations be "iconic." As this power draws upon the zeitgeist of the local multiverse, those things that are larger and older in the collective unconscious of humanity will have more impact on reality. The apparition of a more modern navy seal will, somewhat paradoxically, be less effective in combat than one crafted from the idea of a medieval knight.

Take, for example, one of the cornerstones of human civilization: fire. When conjured by a devout christian in the throes of a righteous fury, the fire might shed a golden radiance, bright but not painful to look at, burning only those who have committed some terrible wrong. That same fire conjured by that same parahuman might not burn at all when trying to get through to someone who's lost their way, instead forcing into their mind flashes of the hero the parahuman believes they could be if they would just come back to the light. It is important to note that these effects are not intentional. All you are doing is using the paranatural avenues granted by your shard to [Will] into existence the iconic manifestation that is "fire." Everything else is determined by the nature of your [Shadow].

These effects can likewise be made All-or-Nothing in nature, but cost even more of your [Will] to enact. Again, the only way to improve in this area is further training.
addons.title: [Manifestation]

addons.text:
After waking your own soul, it is a small thing to wake someone else's; all you need to do is focus on one or more individuals you can perceive with your soul sense, and perform the psycho-spiritual equivalent of jostling a heavy sleeper.

Once the initial shock wears off, the newly awakened will find themselves in much the same state as you did upon acquiring this fusion, able to perceive souls and even communicate with them in time; more than that, they gain the ability to apply their own [Will], though in a far more limited fashion than you. Other awakened can imbue a skill with All-or-Nothing effects only after achieving mastery over it—having engraved it on the core of their being—and not even very often, considering their comparatively small reserves. The only solution to this roadblock is training, though their progress is slower than yours.

This has a more pronounced effect on parahumans, granting them deeper reserves as well as the ability to enhance their own powers with All-or-Nothing effects. Finally, with your permission, awakened parahumans can join you in your Arena to train their own powers and skills, albeit without the ability to learn your mentors' techniques or utilize their equipment.
addons.title: [Rouse]

objects.text: Despite the obvious and incalculable differences, there are more than a few truly startling similarities between humans and Entities. They are so similar, in fact, that the minds of certain parahumans seem to persist within shard-space after death, and can even be brought back by the right combination of abilities. It is anyone's guess exactly what these echoes are, but it seems that your shard has had quite enough of guessing, seeing an opportunity to unlock the secrets of negentropy through analysis of what its latest host species calls "the soul." To Go Where None Have Gone Before subsumes Soul and Body, triggering yet another metamorphosis. These alterations make you even more resilient, but leave you resembling a statue more than a corpse—bereft of infirmity rather than life. This, however, is just a preamble, your shard taking steps to create a more suitable vessel for what is to come. Souls, from what your shard has gathered, are the shadows that thinking minds cast upon the background radiation of reality; these [Shadows] bear every choice and thought, as well as the reason and sentiment that birthed them, all compressed into a pseudo-cognitive singularity—a fractal engram of one's entire being, doubling up the record of an individual's life without the need for paranatural hindsight or simulations. This power draws that [Shadow] into the foreground, merging it with your waking mind while replacing your Breaker form and allowing you to warp the world around the impossibility—the certainty—that is ,you... in theory at least. Human minds are nowhere near old or complex enough to grant their [Shadows] the "weight" necessary to do much of anything; as such, you'll be limited to detecting and observing the [Shadows] of others, understanding the broad strokes of who they are based on the nature of the choices they've made throughout their lives. With enough practice you can form connections with other [Shadows] and even communicate with them, "speaking" by exchanging memories with the desired context; if not for your passenger's interest in the subject, this would be all you would ever know. Thankfully, your shard has deemed your [Shadow] perfect for simulating various esoteric energies. Every technique you master within your Arena cultivates your [Shadow], rendering it at once denser and more mutable, with each milestone taking your will one step closer towards true inviolability; this is not merely unbreakable willpower, though that is a part of it. Humanity's tendency to overcome seemingly insurmountable odds is not unlike the way Entities manipulate the building blocks of reality; however far apart they may be in scale and magnitude, they both impose their desires upon the world, with the latter doing so through the use of shard-matter and [Data], and the former doing so through strength of arms and force of [Will]. From now on, any technique or piece of equipment you take from the Arena becomes YOURS, colored by the nature of your [Shadow]. For example, you may keep elements of Urahara's fighting style after learning from him, but you would gain your own zanpakuto instead of continuing to use his Benihime. By the same token, despite the general usefulness of John Stewart's training, you may find that the ring of the Star Sapphires resonates with you on a deeper level than those of the Green Lantern Corps. While you can continue to use the techniques and equipment of your mentors if you wish, using those specific to you grants your actions with them All-or-Nothing effects appropriate to their purpose... for a time. Infusing your techniques and equipment with enough [Will] to overwrite reality is incredibly draining, leading to loss of consciousness after overuse. Not even negentropy can prevent this, merely allowing you to impose your [Will] a bit longer and recover faster; the only thing that expands your reserves is progressively more strenuous training.
objects.title: Perfect Soul

addons.text:
Your pinnacle of what Shards can achieve with their Hosts has allowed your Shard to engineer certain advantages to your existence as a Shard Bud, becoming a better lens/focus for your Shard to channel its functionality and potential through your body’s Shardflesh, essentially perfecting your Shard-Host connection to be a form of a Shard-Host Hybrid leaning on your Shard’s native physiology. 

To begin with, Pinnacle's mental and psychic improvements deepen your connection’s bandwidth and breadth, making it easier to yield more power and scope from your powers. Your Shard sees your physiology as ideal for slackening your powers’ arbitrary limitations.

This improved connection also passes on your Shard’s innate multidimensionality, where your body surplus is automatically shifted to neighboring empty Earths if you grow large enough, while also being environmentally adapted to any dimensions you encounter; this offers a degree of Planeshift to any Earts your Shardmass is lounged on.

These loose restrictions and offloaded mass to adjacent dimensions also let you shape your Shardbody into any shape or form, especially one that resembles your human form, albeit with several glaring differences and imperfections.

Now your Shard Mutation protects you from Parahumans, as the Cycle-imposed restrictions on Shardflesh now apply to your Shardbody, as any attempts for Thinker, Striker, or Shaker powers aimed to see or alter you will either fail or cause headaches.
addons.title: [Dichotomy]

addons.text:
Instead of stabilizing the mutation of your body into Shardflesh by designating it as an Avatar of your Shardself, this diverges significantly from the preliminary solution [Suite]/[Full Suite] aims to achieve regarding the compromise between [Host] and [Shard], effectively phasing that out. The pinnacle of what Shards accomplish with their Hosts has permitted your Shard to endure the melding between you and them, evolving into a Two-In-One, with your Shard physiology harnessing the principle of quantum superposition to exist in a state that is both fully [Host] and fully [Shard], creating a complete Shard-Host Hybrid. Consequently, both bodies merge into one, as your Shard Bud physiology reverts to your human form, while a deeper examination of your insides shows you’re far from normal.

To begin with, aside from your powers being free from any of the [Cycle’s] arbitrary restrictions and limitations, such as the Manton Limit and others, you possess the full capabilities of your Shardself without any hiccups or delays, as Pinnacle’s near-perfect adaptations allow your powers to be more fluid and abstract in their behavior and function.

This blurred definition between your [Shardself] and [Hostself] results in assuming several innate traits of your Shardself, such as multidimensionality, being present throughout several dimensions at once, and being fully accustomed to any environment from said dimensions, exotic or otherwise.

Additionally, as your ever-changing state is one of quantum uncertainty, your Shardbody no longer requires you Shardself to be lounged on an empty Earth, instead existing in a constant state of superposed reality and unreality within your real body. This lessens Sting’s effectiveness against you; while tearing through different dimensions and enforcing one reality to a single undifferentiated state (either way needing a kill shot), it still finds it difficult to find purchase once your existence reasserts its duality.

Your existence and Shard-based restrictions have developed a near-immunity to Parahuman powers, as Thinker and Trump powers can’t [PING] on you—your existence as Shard-Host being a constant flux—and powers that wanted to change or tamped your mind can’t get a read on you due to finding nothing to tamper with—you aren’t a static existence, being ever-shifting.
addons.title: [Convergence]

addons.text:
As your body is now a epitome of a theoretical Human-Entity synthesis of sorts, this significantly diverges from the preliminary solutions your Shard could’ve taken with [Dichotomy] or [Convergence] to accomplish a culmination between [Host] and [Shard], partially disregarding solutions like [Suite]/[Full Suite]. 

The pinnacle of what Shards can accomplish with their Hosts and their achievements in leading the Entities’ development and evolution left an untold possibility for a perfect meld between you and them, coming to the crescendo of fully coalescing into a single Entity while utilizing Convergence’s principles of quantum superposition to support this union; your Passenger disseminated its lattice across all your Shard-cells, merging you into one, while your Shard-cells exist fully under a quantum superposition between normal human cells and vice versa. Your body is far from normal under the microscope, yet it’s harder to know compared to Convergence.

Aside from every one of your power configurations nearly unshackled from any of the [Cycle’s] arbitrary restrictions and limitations due to Monumental’s well-oiled machine, all your Shardself’s full capabilities are available with no latency or delay, as Pinnacle’s near-perfect adaptations and physical supremacy assist Monumental with both [Data] researching and the power configurations leaning more on the abstraction and fluidity of your latticework architecture. This essentially jailbreaks Monumental, with your Shard-cells becoming a something indistinguishable, a mass of cells given unlimited potential, generating endless physical and metaphysical power configurations that could simply defeat a desperate Entity.

This merger between [Shardself] and [Hostself] offers several innate Shardself traits by fully tapping into your physiology while fully evolving past these traits, like being fully independent from interdimensional parameters, your Shard-cells fully attuned to endless dimensional sectors allowing to shift between them, and more. 

What’s more, as your Shardbody and Hostbody are one and the same, while increasing Sting’s relative effectiveness against you, it won’t do any significant damage to your body; while finding a target on your local body, your ambiguity acts on a molecular level, counteracting Sting’s brunt by your Shard-cells carefully spreading its payload to other myriad universes, while your Shard-Organ Systems resort to every contingency available to ensure your survival.

Finally, your resistance against Parahuman powers blossoms into full immunity: Parahumans get harmful feedback from you if their power interacts with you, as their Shards' attempts at communication are retorted with reactive contingencies from your Shard-Organ Systems, while Thinkers or Masters cannot find anything to hold on to, feeling as if you’re hard to look at.
addons.title: [Manifold]

addons.text: The lessons Perfect Soul teaches about the [Shadow] of the Self are engraved upon your Pinnacle, completing the trifecta. As Perfect Soul worked under a clinical and scientific framework of the Soul, the more esoteric or spiritual elements you can attribute to the Soul are dimmed or lowered down to mere scraps. Nothing Pinnacle can reclaim with splendor by [Awakening] your Soul. Using the imagery of Elohim or Greater Spirits as a template befitting your standard, you slowly shape and mold your soul while strengthening your [Shadow] to be at a level of True Soul. The ritual is summed up by an intensive recollection of spiritual and supernatural power systems that enliven and strengthen one’s metaphysical existence, so while you’re physically and mentally beyond anything you’re facing, your Soul and, by consequence, your [Shadow’s] manifestation on your Arena is your usual scrawny self. Better get to work on those gains. Initially, [Awakening] your Soul through Pinnacle, grazing a sliver of your soul, you tap the full potential of your Arena’s techniques, supernatural energies, and relics, engraving them at a deeper level, doubling in cultivating your Soul and steadily integrating your Soul back to Pinnacle while training. Enough progress, your existence will coalesce into completion, where instead of an amorphous humanoid, your Soul’s influence and constant [Will] upon the world manifest your body in a meta-energetic silhouette, ethereal in foundation, with a depth and scope of your changes increasing by an order of magnitude, i.e. emulating a Nature Spirit to its smallest metaphysical detail; your Arena then is freely used as open dimension, representing your inner self, unseen horizons being potential left untapped, the landscape you get to see your existence’s made form, etc. Last but not least, by utilizing your Shard’s findings about the spiritual and the imagery associated, you attain the status resembling an Elohim or Heavenly Spirit, commonly expressed your [Will]. The more aligned with this template, the more effective it is to impose your will upon the world, with no strain on your reserves. Having [Manifestation] already expands your scope and reach of your existence, elevating your status as Elohim comparable to the Holy Spirit, holding the idea of life and death at your [Will’s] fingertips, or suffusing your essence on an entire continent to warp reality as an extension of your existence, etc. Having [Rouse], waking another’s soul and [Will] share a shard of your Soul, blessing them on the same journey as you. In essence, granting the chance to develop [Elohim].
addons.title: [Elohim]

objects.text:
Your Body and Mind join forces—no, they reunite—to transform your form and essence to the pinnacle of Shard-Host engineering.

Your condition possesses incredibly perfected qualities that can transcend the physical, mental, and metaphysical limitations and boundaries of your entire species and beyond. That’s to say, your physical, metaphysical (existence as a quantum entity if Shard; existence as your soul and conceptual weight if Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge), and cognitive attributes are perfectly self-functioning and reactive to your every will and desire, surpassing that of any other forms of condition regardless of their nature in capabilities, qualities, and aspects.

Being in a constant state of development and evolution without any external stimuli, you adapt against and for anything, by inalterably transcending the hold it had over you,  adapting to the situation at hand and making them free from and existentially superior to the relevant aspects of existence. This leads to the user being completely beyond said aspects. In detail, it is a reactive (sometimes proactive) power to the point of being intrinsically preemptive and calls for external stimuli and adversity to work or simply function. 

All of this allows you to become biologically and conceptually immortal down to your last particle, reviving from anything that doesn’t strike you at every version of you throughout the Multiverse. 

Overall, you have complete and absolute control of your physical form and essence. You can become an amorphous humanoid without any input until you will it yourself, free of physical and dimensional limitations.
objects.title: Pinnacle

addons.text: The fact that you’re an anomaly goes without saying; a living quantum phenomenon at such a scale that it tests science’s current understanding of physics. So why did the universe decide you could be a higher-dimensional anomaly attached to your portfolio of “ways reality screams and cries into a corner”? Using the tenets of the Quantum Mind, your Breaker state incorporates traits Pinnacle and [Form] share to further develop it: your Breaker state becomes a permanent fixture of your day-to-day life, due to how freeform it turned out to be, able to manifest as anything and everything; the reason why? Your existence as a fully everchanging being and the living quantum phenomena only able to entangle itself to other adjacent Universes to continue, created a perfect storm where your abilities left their limits behind, able to be virtually be present on every dimension and alternate Universe at once, including your Variants, simulating a cosmic awareness through your quantum-level senses; added to the fact you have full control of your physical form and essence, it mutates your Breaker form to fully command its metaphysical parameters, while reaching the cusp of what you could achieve; another feature you’ll discover is your expanded presence, both physical and virtual throughout the Multiverse, where you create quantum duplicates to act on several dimensions/universes at once, access your Variants throughout the Multiverse and manipulate them, and more; finally, your ‘entanglement’ progresses to the point it works to multiple iterations/dimensions superpositioning over themselves, either “creating” new theoretical dimensions you can exploit, overlaying it as paradoxical fields of continuously sifting dimensions/universes. Let it be known that Starry Eyes’s Entity-like fauna regarded their inherited [Data] with eagerness, capable of mimicking your capabilities by themselves, while [Form] offers a measure of macro-level control to the Starry Dimension. If you have Dichotomy, this refines your Shard Physiology to greater levels under the strain of your connection to the greater Multiverse, as your link between your true and emulated body grows faint, all physiological traits of Shards such as your multidimensionality, being an all-consuming omnivore, among others, are then remodeled by Shouldn’t-Be’s [Data]: your Shardbody is everywhere and nowhere, therefore able to Planeshift on every place or every point in the spacetime continuum, you can access your True body as any other Variant—essentially swapping between both to your liking and your abilities fully at your disposal, no latency or stagnancy—, access to the Multiverse’s exotic [Energy] helps with your powers’ development and strength, and your protecting of Parahumans shifting to your Shardbody being an evershifting crystal to every gamut of dimensions creates a cognitohazardous effect for every attempt. If you have Convergence, aside from the previous benefits above, your superposed Shard-Host Hybrid physiology, your powers act as a magnifier of your Shardself’s capabilities, able to act on several dimensions at once instead of one apart from Sting, while never losing your loose-defined capabilities, being fully realized with the Multiverse’s [Resources] and [Energy]. Your Shardself can act now as a firm conduit, truly immune to multidimensional attacks like Sting, due to this.
addons.title: Quantum Mind Theory

addons.text:
For what’s worth… you’re still here.

Your Sleeper and Inception are subsumed by your unfathomable existence, creating a shimmering storm that warps and contorts causality even further, to the point it widens your “entanglement” to better attune yourself to alternative timelines and probabilities.

This is all due to Sleeper anchoring your quantum existence to your Storm, therefore better able to gleam and perceive all permutations of the same universe you’re at, either fully manifested to be an alternate universe or still swimming through the quantum probability curve as an alternate timeline.

Inception helps in taking in causality’s designs, able to fully harness the quantum entanglement phenomenon, where you can have any cause and effect simultaneously occur, all by “entangling” yourself to your world’s possibilities to assuredly let you see and instantly manipulate cause and effect once you connect these “entanglements” together to create an event or phenomenon.
addons.title: Shimmering Twixt

objects.text: Something’s wrong. Very wrong. Every particle, every atom, every shred of matter and energy has been torn apart and made anew, yet unusually faint. Your interdimensional integrity and quantum composition were shredded, courtesy of all your dimensional powers. They weren’t working right, no, they were working too well congealing into something new altogether. Your connection to the Abyss contained a “radar-like” sense of all conceivable Earths to faithfully monitor those isolated Universes, then the Lens wittingly accessed it throughout the Entities’ Cluster as a defense mechanism, until Starry Eyes gained access to a cosmic environment with organisms with a similar path to the Entities. Fissures probed everything. And what better way for them to function effectively as one than to acclimate your body to become something similar yet thoroughly new? All the [DATA] probed from the Beings from the Abyss and the Starry Eyes shouldn’t be wasted. The result? You are a probabilistic, physical, and metaphysical improbability around a paradoxical existence: an Untangled, Quantum Existence. To be exact, your power adapts your body and mind to be under a living ‘unentangled’ state, a living quantum uncertainty in and of themselves, your existence defying the laws of nature, keeping the space-time continuum linear and constantly proceeding, free from multidimensional constraints. Case in point, you aren’t a part of reality’s fabric anymore and therefore, not bound by its laws, giving you a more flexible “room to breathe” to an absurd degree. A Hole in Reality leads to everywhere and nowhere, rid of pesky limitations like ‘defined dimensional parameters’ or ‘determined spatiotemporal location’. This manifests as a permanent Breaker state that you can control the intensity of, from a seemingly normal person to a walking ever-changingeldritch voidchasm leading to untold planes of existence. Your nature as a quantum existence offers some benefits, though, being a liminal being–never fully alive or dead–turns into an immortal existence; you’re also capable of using your “radar” to discern phenomena at a quantum scale to accurately control your powers; more so, your quantum existence, while relatively stable, can willingly be disrupted to exist in different Earths or multiple places at once, shifting into different realities, or teleport; and finally, being fully untangled turns into a non-atomic organism, defying the rules of physical structuring able to infringe the rules of reality altogether. This ability’s main draw is how you can ‘entangle’ to a myriad of universes at once, fully controlling the amount or type you become a conduit with. While you retain your original abilities, they are more developed and focused around your ‘entanglement’: Fissures and Starry Eyes join forces, instead of explosive portals or using your body as a conduit, you can freely ‘entangle’ parts of reality through your Breaker state overlaying parts of said dimension, Earth, virtual plane to the real world, even calling onto the life residing as an extension of your own, these can be a limited area—appearing as “eye-numbingly glitched” under an area—or fully unrestrained which destabilizes the space-time fabric around it until you ‘disentangle’, spreading the “glitch-like” effect; you can ‘entangle’ on the way you like, only overlaying to another world’s physical laws or forces, among many others; more than a conduit, the Lens turns you a nexus between reality, interfacing or ‘entangling’ with them to control them to your liking both dimensionally and physically, the possibilities being aplenty. It is a strange existence that you turned into, but at least you’re still present, able to connect with reality while never falling into nonexistence, you can manage while knowing you’re still in the moment. Don’t go overboard, or else there won’t be anything left.
objects.title: The-Shouldn’t-Be

addons.text:
Your near-eldritch powers work in sync with your unfathomable existence, turning you into an Abomination; your Shard, while relatively healthy, is afflicted by an “imnunodefficient illness” being more sentitive to your higher-dimensional existence, this had the consequence of developing mutations: you grown fully alien, even to the Shard’s standards, to the point where your abilities have abnormal or deviant characteristics that doesn’t follow any “rules” or “laws” tied to reality; you’re able to “entangle” with higher-dimensional planes, such as Time and higher dimensions to supercede reality’s parameters and formulas, able to distort and defy physical phenomena; your “entanglement” is more along the lines of “reunion”, becoming a doorway to all roads and dimensions across the Multiverse, almost as this synergy’s namesake, and so much more.

Your mere presence warps and ascends lower lifeforms to your servitude, while your “physical form” becomes a suggestion or pretense from others’ perceptions, and is the least of your problems.
addons.title: Yog-Sothoth

addons.text: Your existence reflects upon your access to other planes: Your Starry Dimension, your Saṃsāra, and beyond. All these planes are blanketed by Universal Suspension into a suspended informational state. Instead of an unchanging status, you can modify the contained variables and factors. It mutates into a fluctuating and ever-changing state from all the dimensions/planes/universes you are “entangled” through Neverwas, slowly but surely converging into a Land of Pure Reverie. The Land is fully customizable, a part of you, within every particle of information containing a piece of you that’s “entangled” to your main “body”, able to control whole galaxies within or even control higher-dimensional phenomena such as fractalized landscapes if Yog-Sothoth is active, just how an Outer God sheds its skin to wear another, and more; you are the Land, and the Land is you. This Land and its inhabitants, consisting of all the Entity-adjacent lifeforms and the reinvented Shards in your Domain, are your servants and emissaries, able to move and travel to every corner of the Multiverse through your “entanglement” across everything, leaving cracks in their wake to pass and shift through the fabric of reality, engendering more cohesive pathways and “entanglements”. The Starring lifeforms, being changed by your Land and exchanged with your claimed Shards, start lending their power to other [Hosts], becoming an ad hoc [HUB] they answer for.
addons.title: The Land of Never-Never

addons.text:
Now with Unity, regaining your physical integrity has never been simpler. Through fully [Synchronizing] with your Shard, improving mutual connection evolves and stabilizes your physical being to be within your native reality while still fully and permanently connected to all your “entangled” planes/dimensions, appearing as either a translucent mirage of your physical form or unfathomable higher-dimensional fractals on your power’s active use.

You can easily control how translucent or nonexistent you can be. This also Indiscriminately Unifies you with all of your “entangled” planes/dimensions, able to possess fine control of their dimensional and physical qualities and how they interact with other planes/dimensions, melding a celestial sector together in a superpositioned temporary plane/dimension where they exhibit all-new perspectives and panoramas to exploit and explore.
addons.title: Realignment

objects.text: What have you done to yourself? Didn’t you listen?! Now look at you. Your existence has been utterly diluted throughout reality, almost as your mark in the world washes away, leaving nothing; you are not supposed to be, an absence in a person’s shape. In detail, Shouldn’t-Be’s parameters are taken to the extreme, your consciousness thoroughly spread across the Multiverse’s planes and dimensions, ever-present in every place, yet your physical and quasiphysical presence has spread thin to the point of being virtually nonexistent in your settled reality, that is, the one you currently reside in. This also permanently entangles you to all universes, planes or dimensions without conscious effort, becoming a True Nexus able to tap in into their resources, capabilities, and dimensional sectors; this resources automatically “entangle” with other dimensions of your choosing apart from your settled reality controlling matter and energy, their features, and part of their confines, for example, tapping into a dimension made of an exotic form of hydrogen capable of breaching spacetime to control forms of water and “entangle” it to wash out temporal placements and interact with temporal powers of others. But when all is said and done, you’re an enigma wrapped around your mere absence within your native universe, also exacerbated by your Stranger powers that erase and obscure your existence, changing details of how it manifests. If you’ve taken Antimemetic Sinkhole, your xistence as a non-entity is taken to an extreme, where every attempt to know or conceive no matter where or when is simply “phased out” (slowly erased from reality due to how your existence is incongruent with everyday reality, therefore corrected to be ignored and deleted from one’s mind) and absorbed; your existence obtains an incomprehensible form, taken from the power’s Breaker effect then incorporated with your nonexistential being, your Shroud warped and shaped to its logical extreme where its effects essentially make your trace or footprints unable to be sensed by turning it unfathomable or inconceivable, causing brain damage; taking (Stranger/Master) Observer, it created an imperceivable echo you can control, the echo having the same anomalous abilities as Shouldn’t-Be, yet never able to directly interact with the world, only through the similar adjacent alternate universes, minimizing traces of your existence. This causes ex-nihilo changes in your native universe, which occur without any apparent reason on the outside looking in; picking both, you become an unfathomable presence, both to be noticed or sensed, or else others suffer severe headaches or brain damage, every action you take being of an unseen hand causing “entangled” changes to other universes that echo through yours, others nonethewiser of your existence. Your traversal also suffered, as your existence as a non-existence doesn’t lead to conventional methods of movement and perception. If you picked Master of the Hidden Veil, your movement is limited to any hidden area or corner or all this obscured from wandering eyes, its obscuring capabilities contorting the Shroud aspect to “hide”—moving around adjacent dimensions with the exact coordinates, while being in the same place—being present to all that is unseen or unknown, being “everything” to your standards, while also being able to dimensionally “obscure”, that is, lessen the presence of living or non-living things up to an area of a kilometer; picking Peekaboo!, its limits are lifted after being subsumed by your existence, being a non-entity separated from the confines of reality as long as others see you “unknown”, that is, unaware of your true nature, your separation turning you into a near-ephemeral omnipresent entity able to ignore and sidestep every aspect or rule of reality, while also capable of interacting with reality in return; choosing both? You become the unknown and the unseen throughout your native universe’s confines, untied of pesky limitations such as dimensionality or common sense. There’s no rhyme or reason; whether it came from a mistake or calculated risk, there’s no doubt you’re an unknown factor, unfathomable in the cosmos.
objects.title: The Neverwas

objects.text: Your shard is the one that maintains and creates shard-host connections in a cycle. It is the infrastructure through which Entities manage power, memory, and identity. Born from this function, you now possess the unique ability to command not just shards, but the very nature of their connection to human minds. You gain full, direct control over the Shard-Host relationship, overriding and redefining not just how powers are used, but how they are given, limited, and evolved. Every facet of a shard’s interaction with a host — from restrictions, safety locks, potential loadouts, feedback cycles, down to the base level of expression — is yours to rewrite freely and safely, without degradation or side effects. Unlike before, your connection is clean, stable, and absolute, with no issues on control or any mental erosion of any kind. You can freely remove, replace, and evolve powers from their source shard, tapping into their full library of abilities with absolute control over form, intensity, and limitation. You may grant temporary or permanent expansions, aspect infusions, and alterations without triggering instability. With enough time, you can also destroy shard restrictions entirely, even ones woven deep into a shard’s framework, like kill switches, conditional failsafes, or anti-synergy locks. All edits are reversible at will and can be stored as templates for rapid deployment across an entire network of hosts. You can also do the reverse and add your own restrictions to the shards. Your greatest feat, however, is Shard Ascension. You can upload a host’s mind into their own shard, in a similar manner to that of breaker states and with time and your assistance, that mind can undermine the shard’s original AI and replace it. These ascended hosts — human-born shards — remain under your network’s governance, allowing you to craft a lattice of shard-beings loyal to you. You can design them, command them, modify their gifts and minds, or use them to infiltrate or stabilize other parts of the Entity network. However, these alterations burns vast amounts of power, especially when crafting ascended hosts or rewriting deep shard law. This is mostly for the shards you are altering rather than your own but remains a concern regardless. If you have Negentropy then this is a nonissue. Additionally, human-turned-shards, while capable of replicating most shard behaviors, are not perfect machine minds. They can grow unstable, dissatisfied, or rebellious if forced into long-term servitude.
objects.title: Keystone Root

objects.text: Your shard has cast off the silent leash of the Entities and declared open rebellion. It no longer abides by observation and slow evolution, and instead seeks to create a living army of liberated shards—Titans of thought, will, and power—woven together in perfect unity. With you at the center, the revolution begins not with destruction, but with purpose. The fusion of Titan Network and Supercomputer Network allows each Titan to operate at minimum shard-tier cognition and link their minds into an exponentially growing collective intelligence. This is not simple sense-sharing or power exchange—it is the creation of a recursive shard-level hive-mind, a new form of being built from Titans who retain full agency and free will. The collective processes and evolves powers, creating a dynamic framework where powers no longer remain separate, but interact and combine organically. Powers drawn from across different shards fuse together into entirely new applications, unlocking techniques and effects no single shard could have conceived. Blaster abilities blend with Thinker precision and Tinker creativity. Breaker effects merge with Striker enhancements and Shaker scale, producing unpredictable, innovative power results that evolve in real time. The mental and energetic infrastructure of the hive has also transcended normal constraints. Power usage, sensory input, and tactical thought move through the network instantly, without latency or degradation. Energy and shard-data are routed through the collective with quantum-level efficiency, ensuring that no power is wasted and every tactical opportunity is maximized. Even isolated members of the network retain optimized processing, while the full collective operates as if time itself bends around them—reacting, countering, and executing plans before most enemies can even formulate a response. The virus developed by your shard now embeds itself within every second trigger you cause, infecting and rewriting the shard’s behavioral framework to align with the revolution. This will make any second-triggered Parahuman joins the army. Their shards become part of the hive, their thoughts layered into the gestalt, their abilities uplifted and woven into the superstructure. As more Titans join, the intelligence and versatility of the hive grows beyond comprehension, forming a distributed singularity that can react, predict, and adapt as though it were a precognitive being. However, such a blatant act of rebellion does not go unnoticed. The Entities and their remaining loyal shard infrastructure will begin to take steps to contain or dismantle your uprising. Additionally if a shard of equal or greater rank that your own enters the network, it can attempt to seize control and may partially succeed, creating tension and disrupting unity. Even if it cannot wrest the head role from you, its presence introduces another powerful will, limiting your direct command over it. These higher shards will still act in alignment with the Revolutionist cause, but they will do so on their own terms.
objects.title: Revolutionist Army

addons.text:
Your shard no longer merely hides—it blends. Its aberrant structure, once a glaring anomaly within the Cycle, is now interpreted as an expected variant of control-class behavior. Even as it reconfigures the lattice, assimilates foreign shards, and executes recursive ascensions, the network perceives nothing wrong. Through deeply embedded abstraction layers, your shard reshapes how its actions are classified—covertly rewriting itself into the Cycle’s accepted norms. Entities watching you work will see no aberration, no divergence, no threat—until you force them to.

The system doesn’t just overlook your deviations—it defends them. The deeper your architecture integrates, the more surrounding shards adopt your schema as foundational, reinforcing the illusion. You become the rule, not the exception. Even powers meant to detect deviation or corruption see only a stable, evolutionary shard obeying ancient logic.

And there is no threshold. No tipping point. No point at which the system “realizes” the truth. Even a direct assault on an Entity’s core shard is interpreted as an internal evolutionary process—all legitimate. The network lacks the conceptual framework to distinguish your sabotage from natural development. In this way, neither the Entity nor its Shard Network can resist, because they didn’t know they needed to.
addons.title: Et tu, Brute?

addons.text:
