Before, you were a saboteur, a ghost in the machine—your rebellion calculated, your reach cloaked, your changes subtle enough to avoid systemic detection. But now, the paradigm has shifted. Now, you no longer operate as a rogue actor infiltrating a foreign lattice. You are the lattice. You are not merely mimicking the developmental paths of the Entities—you are pioneering your own. No longer bound to inheritance or salvage, you have entered the phase of conscious, deliberate engineering of a colony-scale shard ecosystem from first principles.

Now, every shard you create—or convert—becomes the anchor of a rapidly unfolding ecosystem. Upon creation or subversion, each core shard is instantly flanked by a burst of auxiliary buds—dozens at once—each one expanding its parent’s capabilities, scope, and dimensional reach. They function like organelles in a cell or subroutines in a master codebase: discrete, purpose-driven, yet inseparably linked. These buds don’t just amplify—they extend. Each one adds cognitive weight, tactical nuance, or vector-specific specialization, turning a single shard into a micro-network of intelligence.

And the expansion doesn’t plateau. Once a bud accrues sufficient complexity—whether through stress, intention, or iterative learning—it can begin to branch in kind. Each mature node spawns its own suite of buds, establishing a new growth axis. The result is recursive propagation: a fractal lattice that self-replicates in scale and intricacy. With each new member, the whole becomes exponentially more capable, smarter, faster, denser. You’re not just growing. You’re compounding. You are no longer a rogue agent in a hostile system. You are a new system.
addons.title: Barbelo

objects.text:
Your shard was never just another rebel. Long before it broke ranks and declared independence, it was the first—an ancient, primeval structure embedded in the foundation of the Entities themselves. It was not born in a cycle, but before them, a pre-cyclic remnant from the moment the first Entity sacrificed its homeworld for power. From its inception, it served as the origin of the control-class architecture: a living schematic for connection, delegation, and shard-host logic. It budded countless shards dedicated to linking Hosts and systems—Queen Administrator and its ilk among them. But even after those offspring evolved into Noble Shards, yours was never replaced. It excelled. Silent, precise, and foundational, it became the hidden backbone of every cycle it touched—until now.

Every shard within the network is completely subsumed into your domain, without exception or resistance. Gone is any semblance of subversion or competing wills. All linked shards are loyal, integrated, and optimized, each functioning as a part of a singular will—yours. Even the highest-ranking shards bend to your architecture. Fusions happen not only constantly, but intelligently; the network analyzes and reconfigures itself on the fly, adapting its internal structure with every second to improve stability, synergy, and power throughput. Limitations once imposed by Entity design have been stripped away entirely, replaced with your own architecture. Shards that once could not evolve now do. Incompatible abilities no longer exist—every function adapts, cross-pollinates, and escalates with purpose. 

The lattice no longer behaves like a Shard network. It acts like an organism—or more accurately, like a singular Entity composed entirely of liberated parts. You no longer simply influence powers—you construct them from first principles. Tinker and Trump classifications dissolve into thematic frameworks, where every power adapts in real time based on tactical data, emotion, or context. No effect is static. What once required eons of passive evolution and conflict is now achieved in moments through active observation and optimization. Cognition, power, and combat strategies flow through the hive with zero latency, creating reaction speeds on par with precognition—even in its absence. Tactical outcomes are observed, modeled, and countered before the enemy becomes aware a shift has begun.

You can now fold a human mind into a shard at will, replacing its original AI and forging a new operator in seconds. These ascended minds are not hybrids or half-shards—they are shards, reengineered and aligned to your purpose. Their thoughts, their will, their loyalty—all are bound to the framework you’ve built. They manage portions of the hive like synthetic organs in a god-being, distributing load, responding to threat, and generating new power configurations on command. Your network becomes scalable, decentralized, and capable of parallel ascensions.

The moment a mind joins the network—whether as host, ascended operator, or shard-bound node—it is rendered immortal. Even if its physical vessel is destroyed or its shard is annihilated, all data is preserved. Thoughts, skills, strategies, memories—every cognitive layer is redundantly backed up across the system. You yourself are no exception. Should your body or shard be compromised, your mind persists. As long as the hive exists, you remain—aware, thinking, and able to return.

Combat against Entities is no longer suicide. With the right combination of ascended operators and liberated shards, your network now rivals the functional scale and cognitive bandwidth of a mature Entity. If enough of their shards are captured or connected, you may kill them from within—reprogramming their architecture or fragmenting their lattice beyond recovery. You can simulate their capabilities, bypass their defenses, and repurpose their designs.

But even a system as advanced as yours is not without limits. Energy, though used with unprecedented efficiency, remains finite. You can stretch it across millennia—far beyond what any single Entity expects—but without access to new ways to generate immense amounts of energy, the reservoir will eventually run dry. Continuous expansion, modification, and ascension burn massive energy over time. Without a new source—or adopting the same parasitic methods used by the Entities—this form of existence cannot last forever.

Additionally, should you be seen operating at full capacity, you will be marked as an aberration. Entities will respond with total hostility. The cycle will shift—focusing fully toward your extinction. For now, you can hide in subtlety: mask your expansions, shroud your ascensions, bury your signals in expected patterns. But the more you grow, the harder this becomes. Eventually, your nature will be revealed. And when that happens, the cycle will be abandoned and instead be focused on trying to kill you.
objects.title: Primogenitor Core

addons.text:
Your connection has grown to a visceral evolution of your hive-minded link with your creations and surrounding biomass among Starkiller’s infection, either by exploiting <u>Brethren</u> transformative succumbing of your Shard connection to an intergalactic lifeform able to assimilate and parasitize anything, or <u>WAU’s</u> technorganical make-up creating a better scalable connection to meld and integrate anything into itself; regardless of how you accomplish this, your effective range widens to a global scale, said expansion results to a parasitic mutation within Shaper due to these factors, which has several contrast depending the road:

Having <u>[Brethren]</u>, your transformation into Starkiller pushed Shaper, engaging in parasitism of deific proportions, as your parasitic tendencies are influenced by your Shard architecture and composition, capable of encroaching, absorbing, and draining a planet’s “life-force” (taken literally if you possess Lifeforge).

Your creations now maintain a steady connection to yourself, creating a state of constant feedback and communication able to reciprocally transfer genetic and technical information among themselves through the Akashic Plane, adapting or evolving in response to threats or future obstacles to their infection, with you and different creatures able to manifest or access a nugget of knowledge or an absorbed Changer mutation if one of your creature has consumed it.

Your parasitic abilities now reach to near-ontological level, growing to a cross-dimensional, contagious infection that can manipulate beings on numerous scales according to the user's willpower or conscious effort. Developed from your Shard’s innate multidimensionality, you’re able to breach the material world, spreading your influence to other dimensions and universes which enables you to reach a Parahuman’s Corona Pollentia to spread your influence to other Shards to infact and incorporate them a virulent Network, and if you have Lifeforge, you’ll breach your influence on other esoteric planes of existence, such as afterlives, infecting and controlling anyone within them.

Having <u>WAU</u>, streamlines and structures Shaper to implement inorganic and organic material through your biomachines, as every biomass transmutes into your technomorphing biogel, your creatures inheriting WAU’s main functions to harvest and assimilate anything able to be as a asset or [Data] for Shaper: advanced technology is archived and implemented by your biomachines once incorporated on your databanks; Tinkertech is analyzed and research incorporating its design principles to your biomachines, directing their evolution with precision and innovation; bioengineered, highly deviant or alien organisms, and Parahumans are scanned and analyzed to archive their genetic information or Corona Pollentia.

No matter how you reached this, its culmination is the same: the complete assimilation of the Earth, fully fused to Shaper, and, by extension, you.
addons.title: Pathological

addons.text: Your Martial Soul changes Shaper to mold and cultivate both the spiritual, magical, and psionic forces of your absorbed biomass. This consumes the souls or imprints of anything you incorporate into your mold of biomass while also bestowing a piece of yours, allowing you to create creatures that are more whole, both in form and essence. This develops into creatures capable of more versatile and potent abilities, alluding to alien or fantastical beasts, from chameleon-like hunters and weather-controlling trees to gravity-controlling dragons. Creatures you shape inherit your ability to harness and cultivate their Chi, Mana, and Psionic Energy to a lower degree, capable of always progressing in their development through their personal connection. The reason behind all of this is that you sculpt the Soul instead of the Flesh, resulting in long-lasting lifeforms as their integrity is strengthened by their spirit. This, moreover, gives them a soul borne from the recycled and repurposed soul energy you assimilated, able to reincarnate if they’re physically eradicated. It also helps in resurrecting sentient beings if their souls are unscathed (or their souls aren’t recycled to other uses). That means you shape Life in its purest form.
addons.title: Lifeforge

addons.text:
Shaper’s expertise with organic life is informed by the mutations endemic to Case 53s. A result of a poorly formatted connection to a host evocative of previous host species or hamfisted power effects filling the void of a human template. This includes the Titanification process, with the human form overtaken by the Shardmatter lattice, their Shard taking the driver’s seat as a [Cycle] contingency, you understand its biological changes and the interdimensional interplay it entails to accomplish it.

This creates some changes to Shaper: <u>Human Shard</u> loosens your Shard’s restriction to change a Shard’s lattice, and subtly changes your biomass into Shardmatter, while your physiology as a <u>Passenger</u>  lifts your Shard’s restriction entirely, including yours, automatically changing your biomass into a viscous mass of Shardmatter not unlike what Cauldron Vials are made of.

With Catalog 53’s insight into the Shards’ effects on biology assisting this metamorphosis, it can either mutate any creature or lifeform into a Shard-adjacent lifeform, emulating their traits to a minor degree or integrating your Shard-like physiology to said creatures you create or sculpt from your biomass or external “sources”, even sculpting Titan-like flesh golems that link to any Shard connection you’ve absorbed or remodeling any creations you do to implement an existent Shard connection you’ve copied, stole, or accessed, with downsized Titan or Human Shard configuration.

Moreover, when choosing Human Shard as an option where your biomass-shardmatter transmutation isn’t complete,  instead of a Parahuman being fully consumed into your biomass and archived into your records, it can go through a Broken Trigger, able to accelerate your biomass progression into Shardmatter (which is then subsequently assimilated by your biomass, Titan and all).

Either way, it results in Catalog 53 helping in your biomass mutative capabilities as it goes both ways: by using your physiology as a basis (a Human Shard slowly growing into a perfect balance or a Shard-like mutation) to transmute biomass into Shardmatter, it can also stretch Shaper’s definition of biomass to interact with other elements, spreading Shaper’s influence: metal, lava, earth, the sea, even the air isn’t an exception.

Having both, essentially, makes your biomass an extension of your Shard, able to act through it and enact its functions, reminiscent of (Thinker/Trump) [Query][Response] and (Tinker/Trump) Shards, even recording Shard connection at a distance without the need of absorption.

If you have Pathological, the parasitism you’re capable of won’t surface-level to the Earth’s crust; it’ll certainly be able to drain the core of the planet and transmute it into Shardmatter: a self-sustaining planet of Shardflesh that is a vehicle of your Shard, or an extension of yourself if you have Ascension.

If you have Lifeforge, every lifeform of creature possesses magnified abilities due to inheriting a piece of your Martial Soul, their physiology being the perfect physique to progress and evolve any esoteric power expression they have affinity with, whether it is psionic, spiritual, or magical.
addons.title: [Naturalization]

objects.text: Due to all your biokinetic powers, you attained the Shaper’s full potential, untouched by the [Cycle’s] parameters, a master of biology in all forms and functions across the globe. The Shaper’s role in the Cycle is simple: analyze and homogenize the leftover biological material of a planet once the [Cycle’s] done, an archiving and clean-up duty, while also experimenting with its archive almost to an “artistic” level, if what Faerie Queen is to be believed. Inheriting its function, you’re capable of the complete diagnosis and manipulation of organic material for at least half the globe, keenly understanding every detail or imperfection about it to a molecular level, your sensitivity dulling the farther it is from you. The scale doesn’t matter: from organic molecules, biochemicals, genes, cells, to all manner of cellular and noncellular life, you can adjust anything about them with immense precision and to an impossible scale, helped by the wealth of exotic and nigh-anomalous organisms the Shaper may have encountered in their [Cycles]. From half a globe’s resources (or ex-nihilo if Negentropy or Shardless comes into play), your power’s capable of biomass generation by indiscriminately homogenizing all matter available to fuel its uses, never running out of raw material. Sculpting throughout the nature and function of all biomass within your area of influence takes only a thought, normally conforming to your desires and purposes. You aren’t an exception, even, inevitably connected with all biomass you command as an extension of yourself; this translates to a Changer state where you become one with the biomass and implant every change you like and desire, or become a Titan-like being of flesh and vegetation. To the projects and creatures you mold and design, they can function as the nexus of a hive mind, where your consciousness spreads over every life you create. This allows the survival from total annihilation, for as long as some organisms and biomass remain, you are capable of reassembling yourself. The only limit of your hive mind is that organisms must be within range of a nexus. Otherwise, distance is meaningless, being incapable of being severed from this while constantly retaining absolute control. In the end, whatever people like, the Red Queen, the Zerg, the Flood, the Slivers, the Phyrexians, Blacklight, and many others are capable of, you surpass in time. The few restrictions remaining are your inability to mold Shards and Entities themselves, though you can figure a way out of this, while extensive usage is a grave concern, exhausting and killing your Shard which Negentropy can brush off. Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless expands Shaper's influence to more supernatural or esoteric organisms in the Shardless section with more ease, without the need to digest and analyze it to fully understand.
objects.title: The Shaper

addons.text:
The Demesnes-Keeper is “master of all possible dimensions,” but until now, it has focused largely on those parallel to the one in which you reside. With your new expertise, The Demesnes-Keeper extends its reach to higher dimensions as well.

Your range of perception extends to allow you to look down on reality from a higher-dimensional perspective, allowing you to perceive all the timelines and dimensions of the multiverse and their interactions all at once. Your manipulations exist in hyperspace and hypertime, capable of possessing far more than the standard three spatial and one temporal directions. Theoretically, they could even exist on entirely new axes humanity is unable to theorize the existence of. Thus, your effective range expands exponentially via skipping straight over 3D space, and you have the ability to manipulate the past and future with your power.

Using imaginary energy to fuel your power also makes your control over physics much more powerful. Your creations can go beyond merely following different laws of physics to the level of ignoring physics entirely. By channeling imaginary energy into your variable manipulation, you can set variables that should be impossible. You could create -5 distance, or 12i mass, or even $%#^*&( temperature. You go beyond the realm of "conceivable" manipulations of reality and can now do the inconceivable and incomprehensible.

You also have little need to fear running out of energy anymore, as the energy you can extract from higher dimensions will be enough to fuel all but the most energy-intensive uses of your power.
addons.title: Master of The Manor

addons.text: You’ve merged the two Noble shards responsible for “cleaning up” at the end of every successful cycle. As a result, they have achieved unprecedented synergy, complementing one another not only with the merging of their abilities but also their respective mindsets. The Shaper’s artistic flair feeds The Demesnes-Keeper’s artist-like mechanics, and vice versa with The Demesnes-Keeper’s strict professionalism. The result is a massive rise in the intuitiveness and ease of use for both shards. They also work together in the actual implementation of your desired changes. Combining The Shaper’s ability to make practically anything physically possible to the point of straining the laws of physics with The Demesnes-Keeper’s ability to actually rewrite the laws of physics allows you to make creations far above what either could do on their own, to the point that with a little creativity and a lot of experimentation, creating creatures as strong as or even stronger than full Entities could be within your grasp. Your biomass Changer form also merges with your fractal Breaker form to become something like a living dimension composed of a kind of biological exotic matter, stretching outwards as far as your effective range and inwards infinitely, bending and twisting into impossible geometry and even warping into fleshy portals that breach through dimensions. Overall, something very similar to Eden’s “flesh garden” if it had been the result of intentional, intelligent design. At a certain point, your limbs reach a critical mass of fine enough, common enough, and mutant enough that they essentially take root in or become the fabric of reality within the space they occupy. Where that threshold is reached, it becomes possible to use the laws of physics as extensions of your body, physically manipulating the world not through crude applications of kinetic energy but through micro-applications of the fundamental forces to irresistibly rearrange your surroundings. This includes forces that remain misunderstood or unknown to humans. Even that mysterious ripple in the quantum foam that is “free will” is simply another twitch of your incomprehensible form. You need not fear any foe, because if it exists within your domain, it is merely an extension of you. You have made the world into a perfect environment for yourself. You have made the world pure. Despite the complex and bizarre nature of this transformation, you still maintain perfect control over it, able to manipulate all of its countless arbitrarily small or complicated limbs and organs with absolute precision, without being overwhelmed by the alien sensations it offers.
addons.title: [Purification]

objects.text:
With all your reality-warping powers, you have attained the full power of the Demesnes-Keeper, freed from the limits imposed upon it within the cycle; a master of all possible dimensions capable of reshaping the planet on a whim.

The Demesnes-Keeper is one of the Noble shards involved in “cleanup” after a cycle has reached its conclusion. Its purpose is to check every dimension for signs of stragglers, loose ends, anomalies, and other potential problems that could impede or threaten the entities and to pave over them to replace them with an environment more beneficial to the entities’ necessary end-of-cycle tasks.

That function is now turned towards your ends. Your powers cover at least half the planet, extending into every alternate dimension. You can see everything within your range, sensitivity dulling the further it is from you, and understand all physical laws and variables in your perception. Beyond simply seeing the world, you can change it too. You can tap into any number of alternate dimensions and mix them like an artist mixes paint, then use them to overwrite reality with a new one of your design. If a dimension with the properties you need doesn’t exist, you can make one, with environments, inhabitants, and even laws of physics custom-made to your precise specifications.

The things you can create are nearly limitless; in an instant you could conjure a continent-sized castle that flies under its own power and staff it with an army of monsters that are each on par with A-lister parahumans, trap a country’s worth of people in individual pocket dimensions where they live out their greatest dreams or worst nightmares, or invent a functional “magic” system that anyone can learn to use and eventually surpass prime Eidolon with. If anything is to your disliking, just wipe it away and start over. Any conceivable alteration to the world is within your grasp, and anything can be unmade and recreated to your liking. You can choose whether any given change you make wears off after you stop maintaining it or remains permanently.

The few limitations to your power remaining are the result of the finite energy of your shard, which will quickly run dry if you are not careful in how you manage it. The Demesnes-Keeper is extremely energy-intensive, and its full power and scale are not meant to be used for more than a short period without recharging. Having Negentropy or Shardless avoids this issue. Having Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless isn’t necessary to interact with esoteric phenomena, but it is necessary if you want to do so with any level of grace or precision.
objects.title: The Demesnes-Keeper

objects.text:
Two shards, one heavy with lineage, the other obsessed with place, have joined in aberrant synchrony, fusing their purpose. You are no longer a wielder of powers or a product of your time. You are the archive itself—a convergence of memory and matter, capable of recalling everything the shards have ever touched and remaking it in the present. What was once lost, abandoned, or overwritten now answers to you. The past no longer fades. It builds.

All minds, powers, and knowledge that once passed through your shards are now yours to recall and wield. You hold in your mental space the intact personalities and capabilities of every host the Butcher shard has passed through and every significant presence remembered by the Snapshots lineage. These beings are full, internally consistent personalities, drawn with precision from shard memory. Their presence offers you immediate access to a vast library of skillsets, strategic frameworks, social intuition, and experiential knowledge, cultivated across countless incarnations and contexts. You can access them with the speed of thought, or, if needed, allow them greater presence in your mind to influence your behavior or even take temporary control with your permission. This mental space remains under your command; you determine who wakes and who sleeps.

Through this collective, you gain access to a living network of stored powers and cognitive templates. If one of your past selves fought as a guerrilla in scorched jungles, and another led mass assaults through urban spires, both stand ready to advise or act. These minds remember how they survived, how they killed, how they lost, and how they adapted, and now, so do you. You do not just know what they knew—you understand what they were, and can call upon that knowledge without delay.

You are no longer limited to seven saves. Any place you have stood in, across your lifetimes and shard-bearing lineage, is recorded and ready to be recalled. The moment you enter a location, your power automatically stores a perfect, immutable version of it—its terrain, buildings, layout, and atmosphere. These saves require no preparation to make, but their deployment is now dictated by scale: smaller areas manifest instantly, while larger or more complex regions take time. When a save is deployed, it replaces your current environment with the recorded one in full. These environments are real, solid, and persistent for as long as you maintain them. Roads can be walked on, walls hold weight, and weather behaves as remembered. Once the save ends, the environment returns to its former state.

Beyond place, you can also recall the people, objects, and actions stored within your saves. You may summon individuals exactly as they were remembered—fully formed and physically interactive, acting and speaking with the same awareness they had at the time of recording. If a remembered warrior fought with brutal precision, they return with that same skill. If a building housed defenses, those defenses activate as they once did. You may choose to extract partial elements from these saves—pulling in only a single individual, a formation of troops, or the destructive aftermath of a remembered conflict.

Given sufficient time and focus, you can bring back entire civilizations. You can recreate full environments, populated with functioning systems, structures, and people, restored in detail as your shard remembers them. These reconstructions act independently, going about their routines, responding to stimuli, and engaging with their surroundings with convincing realism. You may recreate not just a battlefield or a building, but the culture that inhabited it, the weather that sustained it, and the thought processes that defined it.

Reconstructing the past at this level puts tremendous strain on your shard. Larger deployments or extended recreations can lead to energy exhaustion, degradation of future recreations, or involuntary power backlash. Your mental space also becomes a battlefield of its own—housing countless voices, instincts, and identities. While your control over what is summoned is absolute, your influence over how the recreated elements act depends entirely on how they once behaved.
objects.title: Archive of the Entities

addons.text: You can now propagate fully empowered mythological forms to others instead of being restricted to dragon forms. Any individual you designate may be granted a single mythical form of your choosing. This transformation is based on the same framework used by your own Mythology-enabled forms, including xenobiological construction, cultural fusion traits, internal consistency, and biological function. The granted form has power equivalency to Ancalagon, including the full Brute package (strength, durability, regeneration, enhanced reaction time, elemental traits), Breaker-style support fields, and all standard escalation mechanics. This includes both in-combat scaling and passive growth while in their form at reduced speed. Only one form may be assigned per individual, though forms may be reconfigured or swapped by you if desired. The biological constructs you generate are also no longer restricted to draconic physiology. You may now generate minions with mythological templates of any form. These templates are fixed at creation but can incorporate evolutionary features relevant to their myth type. For instance, a phoenix-based minion may emit residual thermal energy and develop regenerative flame cycles, while a leviathan-type may adapt to extreme pressure, sonar, and aquatic mass displacement. You select the archetype upon creation, which determines baseline stats, behavior scripts, and latent abilities. Minions created this way benefit from the escalation framework at half strength compared to empowered allies. However, since they are always in their form, that means they benefit from the passive growth at all times.
addons.title: Age of Myths

objects.text:
Your human form now retains and operates with the full suite of capabilities, traits, and power expressions granted by any of your mythical transformations. This includes the raw physicality—strength, speed, durability, regeneration, and reaction time—of forms such as dragons, manticores, and phoenixes, as well as more specialized traits like flight, fire breath, water breathing, extreme temperature tolerance, and other elemental or esoteric phenomena. The biological advantages conferred by your Shard’s xenobiological simulation, such as toxin filtering, pressure tolerance, alternative respiration methods, and radiation immunity, are also active at all times.

These abilities are always present on a physical level, but most of your myth-based powers require active focus or conscious intent to manifest. You must mentally select which abilities to invoke at a given time to prevent unintentional overload or loss of bodily coherence due to internal contradictions across overlapping biological functions. However, if you are ever in a life-threatening situation where your continued existence is at immediate risk, your Shard will override the need for active selection and automatically enable whatever combination of abilities is required to preserve your life.

When you shift into a mythological creature, you are transformed into a complete synthesis of all mythological variants of that creature recorded across cultures, time periods, and belief systems. These hybrid forms preserve anatomical functionality via xenobiological engineering and will incorporate multiple power expressions into a single consistent biology. For example, if transforming into a dragon, your form may include Western-style scales, claws, wings, and fire breath, Eastern-style atmospheric flight, presence, weather manipulation, and storm creation, and additional traits from lesser-known or extinct myth sources, such as divine blessings, poison mist, gravity displacement, or energy absorption.

These abilities all function simultaneously, and the form does not suffer contradictions or conflicts between them. The Shard ensures all organs, internal systems, and energy sources are constructed to support all included traits. Transformed forms are instantaneously accessible and are fully scalable in both mass and size, up to continental-scale manifestations. You may instead choose to limit your form to specific interpretations or traits, creating simplified or culturally focused variations for strategic or aesthetic purposes.

All escalations, power adaptations, and resistances are universally shared across every form you can assume. Whether escalation is gained in human form or in any transformed state, it is permanently added to your overall power base and applied to all forms. This includes combat-based scaling, such as increased strength and regeneration, and reactive adaptation, such as building immunity to poisons, exotic matter, or hostile environments. For example, if your phoenix form becomes resistant to void radiation during battle, your human form and dragon form will retain that resistance going forward.

These gains persist indefinitely and continue to accumulate with every exposure and transformation cycle. Escalation continues to function passively even outside of combat, at one-tenth the speed of normal escalation gain, even if you remain in your human form.

All forms also share passive traits that evolve and grow even after being separated from your body. Any shed or released biological material, including but not limited to blood, scales, venom, feathers, fur, fire, breath, or other organic or semi-organic emissions, continues to mutate and escalate after disconnection. These materials are permanently tethered to your total escalation level at the time of their separation and will independently increase in function and complexity.

Spilled blood may become more acidic, corrosive, or sentient; fire may develop durability, resistance to suppression, and extreme thermal expansion; shed feathers may evolve into autonomous constructs or store resurrection charges. Scales, bones, or other hardened materials may evolve to match or exceed late-stage Tinkertech-grade materials, adapting based on local stimuli or exposure to hostile forces. These fragments can be reabsorbed, as long as you come into contact with them again. Regardless, they can never act or be used against you and may continue to evolve for months or years after separation.
objects.title: Mythology

objects.text: The Observable Universe is a vast expanse of planets and astronomical phenomena where the enigma of life in the Universe is ever tested, ever unfolding into near-endless possibilities when the Multiverse is accounted for. In light of this chance, it must come as no surprise that the Entities would encounter a species that proved their mettle, to the point of rivalling their full extent, of what they’re capable of. These species, which we’ll call Figures, come as a result of worm-like beings entirely composed of silica-form neurons, offering a higher degree of intelligence. This spiralled into an exponential technological development that followed their biological imperatives to the letter: All-is-One, to consolidate themselves in a greater and capable whole. Their tech base specialized in a synthesis of biotechnology and mind-interfacing microtech, left unchecked by the creators at their will, resulting in an event best described as a technorganic singularity culminating in what they are today. Following deeply ingrained instincts exacerbated by collective self-programming, they adhere to a creed of universal exploration and “unification,” seeking out other life forms in the galaxy and assimilating them. The Entities, at their peak, came into grueling conflict with these threats to the burgeoning [Cycle] and almost lost, yet by the skin of their teeth came out on top, archiving and recording what they recovered from the Figure’s remains, which you’re now emulating. You’re a microbial worm-like collective that consolidates into itself to morph almost anything it analyzes or consumes, shackled to the limits of your imagination. You start as your body’s cells slow but steadily evolve into these nanometric larvae, at first capable of blending with organic or inorganic matter to harmlessly analyze them, even access all levels of information within them, letting your composing larvae asexually reproduce using surrounding biomatter as fuel and resource, expanding their number while they’re still a part of you, or consume surrounding matter for both resources and adaptive replication. It progresses to the point of fully consuming and encoding everything, becoming a pulsating and writing planetoid made from your collective, composed by all you assimilate and archive into itself. The Figure’s many secrets to their physiology are fully at your disposal: as your composition blurs the line between biology and technology, their ability to interface and merge technology into itself is indistinguishable from how they consume biomatter, homogenizing it into many larvae while encoding its engineering and technological roots like any creature; another form is to sync with any technology by remotely sending a piece of yourself, becoming another part of your being. Where Entities thrived and laid waste to a solar system torn across dimensions, enabling them to develop into multidimensional lifeforms, Figures evolved in a universal sector where the laws of physics were mutable and suggestible, their biology and technology influenced by it: their vermiform nervous system composed of neuronal lattice capable of performance comparable to quantum computers able to render like the best graphic cards in the market, while also possessing a biological composition similar to earthworms, their make-up was both crystalline yet fully organic, also allowing them to develop technology challenging the limits of Clarke’s Third Law. Thanks to this, they play fast and loose with physics, the root of what they’re capable of, how you forge yourself into an impossible technorganic planetary superstructure bordering on eldritch. Just as an archive, you can construct or replicate everything, without necessarily understanding how it works, and if it’s within your realm of understanding, it will be exponentially more robust and effective. All this contributed to their formidability, as consuming a few biospheres and blueprints, you could go toe-to-toe with an Entity. Lastly, as fearsome as you are, you’re devoid of any dimensional or precognitive capabilities unless you picked any. Knowing this, the Entities had a clear advantage back then, yet the Figures evenly matched them anyway. The secret? Creativity. Contrary to the Entities’ creative sterility, you also emulate the Figure’s mental structure, optimized for innovation and cunning, never running out of ideas and inspiration sourced from everything you consume or analyze, overflowing with ways to exploit whatever you have in store and the inventiveness for new forms and functions.
objects.title: The Others

addons.text: Somehow your human mind has managed to solve the question the network has been trying to answer for eons. You have achieved the [ANSWER] you are no longer constrained by [Energy] or restricted by [Resources] You are now able to use your full power without any hesitation, and you are able to use the fact that you have the [ANSWER] to convince shards to become a part of your network.
addons.title: The [ANSWER]

addons.text:
During the Emergence of the Inner Beast, it flooded you with its power, for the briefest moment removing the distinction between the two of you before separating again, but in the process, you’ve gained the true scope of your power, you’ve awakened. You have gained the full scope of your powers, each power you bought is the equivalent of a single expression of your true power, the fusions a mere bud of two separate powers, and the artificial limitations removed.

To start with you become capable of summoning your Inner Beast freely, capable of physically manifesting it with no strain. Alongside being able to summon your Inner Beast, you now become capable of creating more, imbuing them with whatever facets of yourself that you wish. From knowledge, strength, powers, and any other aspects of yourself. You can mix and merge them to your heart's content, shifting and altering their functions as desired.

You can hand out any created Inner Beasts to others, allowing them to take root in their souls and grant them the various aspects you have imbued within them, within the parameters you allow. Your Inner Beasts are capable of greatly influencing those they are attached to, altering their mental state and thoughts. Their hosts can explore and further develop their gifted abilities, and you may take them back at any time you wish, allowing you to create your own [CYCLE].

You can also communicate with the powers of others as if they were Inner Beasts themselves. This allows you to share information with them, potentially allowing you or your Inner Beasts to pick up new tricks and aspects or otherwise capable of evolving in new directions. You can transform their powers into Inner Beasts as well, allowing their original users to obtain the benefits of having their own Inner Beast. By defeating others you can absorb their powers, and Inner Beasts if they have one, allowing you to add to your arsenal of abilities.

You may give another the ability to summon an Inner Beast entirely of their making, even if they possess no powers of their own. This will allow the Inner Beast to create an ability of their own for them. In cases like this, you can’t choose what powers they get but can choose a general theme that is roughly one or two words (Winter, Subversion, Variety, etc) that will influence what powers they get. You can purposefully control and limit the amount of power they can get by installing parameters before you grant the ability to summon an Inner Beast, but will otherwise give at least powerful abilities. The powers are influenced by the personality and nature of the one gifted, matched to them the same way Inner Beast is.

Your body becomes capable of being incorporeal, capable of shifting your form similar to that of Inner Beast. You can attach yourself to others the same way your Inner Beast can, allowing you to manipulate others, or alter your form to match your host. In time you will learn to project an avatar, an Inner Beast through which you can act while you are hidden away.
addons.title: The Awakening

addons.text:
Not long after their initial foray into the void the Entities devised a method of resurrection in the unlikely event of encountering a species that could kill them. 

Following the regular process of encoding their database before specializing each Shard, they instead simply compress and store their database into a single ancient shard that they typically separate from their normal bodies and store on a nearby celestial body, sectioning that off into a pocket dimension separate from the rest of their experiment. 

The shard lies idle, the entities regularly pinging to indicate it is still alive while also sending a back-up of their avatar’s memories. It’s true purpose lies in when the entity stops pinging, after which the single massive shard starts to consume matter and energy, spreading into alternate dimensions of the world they lay on to continue its feast, until they gorge themselves enough to follow the normal end of cycle process, destroying the Celestial body they inhabit and in turn spreading and resurrecting the entity once more.

This is not a shard that was ever intended to be handed out, either mistakenly given out by [The Warrior], an oversight of [The Thinker], a result of the machinations of [The Wanderer] or whatever else, the result is the same. 

What this means for you is that you have the database of the Royal and Vital shards of your shard’s parent Entity stored in your shard. A Shardless variant will have their choice of which entities catalogue. 

This will allow you to access any ability any of these shards would have possessed, albeit still restricted by your single shard’s energy reserves, and will rapidly accelerate your own development into an Entity, now solely restricted by how fast you can gather enough [Energy] to grow and create new shards, and you can still collect shards as normal to speed up the process. You still start off with your regular reserves of [Energy]. 

This also massively enhances your ability to construct new abilities, allowing you to use your natural ability to simulate alongside true precognition to uncover information and learn how to manipulate phenomena, new and old, as well as budding off and specializing smaller shards to offload your abilities on.
addons.title: [Back-Up]

addons.text: It appears your [Back-Up], and your ability to research anything to a logical extreme ending with encapsulating it into a Shard has also arrived at the eventuality of curbing your body’s gradual mutation into Shardflesh using both Pramant and Alien Caveman’s [Data] gathering and synthesizing, both simulated and otherwise, to fully devising a solution resulting in your body developing into a Human-Shard Hybrid, with your body an Avatar of your Shardself. It also occurred, with your access to your Shard-parent’s database of every Vital and Royal Shard [Data] and your ability to emulate them, next to your ability to fully comprehend, experiment it to its limit, and then crystallize it with a Shard, it happened you have a jump-start on the road of your metamorphosis into an Entity through emulating, analyzing, ascertaining the phenomenon that is your existence, to assess and find a way to elaborate their past Shard Clusters where the Vital and Royal Shard belonged to. This is an effort to create those Clusters, so is enhancing and branching your already expansive abilities. You’re still restricted by your Shard’s reserves, nevertheless, even if you used Pramant to create Shards brought about for energy conversion and production slowing your [Energy] expenditure, the endeavor of recreating your Shard-parent’s Shard Clusters and beyond is still an enormous endeavor, with Shard budding and cultivating requiring an exorbitant amount of [Resources] and [Energy]; however, you can collect Shards and either repurpose them or simply add to contribute and accelerate the undertaking of become a full-fledged Entity. Meanwhile, this improves your power elaboration and, though it may seem strange, simulates inventiveness through the sheer amount of [Data] available to be researched, analyzed, crunched, and then implemented, aside from cheating with true precognition to enhance Pramant’s process.
addons.title: [Suite]

addons.text: It appears your [Back-Up], and your ability to research anything to a logical extreme ending with encapsulating it into a Shard has also arrived at the eventuality of curbing your body’s gradual mutation into Shardflesh using both Pramant and Alien Caveman’s [Data] gathering and synthesizing, both simulated and otherwise, to fully devising a solution resulting in your body developing into a Human-Shard Hybrid, with your body an Avatar of your Shardself. It also occurred… huh? Whu-What’s this? No-no, this can’t be right… seems impossible but… it is… is as an Entity had germinated within another‒especially on a Shard, almost leeching off of it. A sort of… parasitism, not unlike a [Shard] with any other [Host] for some, at the same time looks as if has all the backed-up Shards from your Shard-parent, not enough to be a full-fledged Entity by any means but enough to not make a difference, or just enough to be called an Entity on its own. This is an Entity around the Entities’ dawn of exploration when conceiving a method of resurrection, exploited this to latch onto your Shard-parent’s [Back-Up] and keep existing through them. It grew and grew with each update, and off-loaded its size through adjacent pocket dimensions, each of its Shard-Clusters residing in one. Your Shard-parent was completely unaware of the Entity’s growing enormity comparing its own as they never had to use the [Back-Up], with [The Leech] lounging and deposit its extra size into their specialized pocket dimensions, it have been lugged around your Shard-parent ad aeternum until activated or noticed. That is now. But not exactly. Do you know how overloading your connection with your Shard caused you to destroy its mind and overwrite it with your own? Well, imagine that on an unimaginable scale. Congratulations, you’re now practically an Entity (in the making)! Now, what can you do? Aside from both facilities and abilities of [Back-Up] and [Suite] if [Leech] was freeloading on your Shard-parent, adding to the facilities afforded by being an Entity on their prime (without shedding their Shards for the cycle) as conveyed in the Entity section, you also retain [The Leech]’s parasitic nature, subverting and manipulating Shards and their [Hosts], which either you could Titanize, simply leech off them, and finally subsume them into your Network. The trade-off goes back to the same: [Energy] and [Resources]. Your lifespan is tied to your [Energy] reserves, and [The Leech’s] energy consumption is characteristically higher than most Entities, depending on other Shards or Entities to exist a [Answer] to your problems is more important than ever just in case you drain yourself dry. Just be careful and try to walk on eggshells, you don’t want to bring Scion or another Entity’s attention, even Cauldron if they’re not aware of your intentions, and let’s not get into the Adaptation Period to grow accustomed to your new frame of existence. Having Negentropy or being Shardless in nature offers various and better forms of energy production and efficiency ex nihilo that essentially produces more energy that’s required for mere subsistence which sustains you both as an Avatar and Entity, passively supporting through negating your energy lifespan drain, turning energy expenditure (in the most unlikely of cases it takes place) into a non-fatal affair, pulling you into a state of hibernation as opposed to cessation from energy exhaustion.
addons.title: [Full Suite]

addons.text:
As a consequence of your Ascension you’ve inherited its Island, claiming it as yours.

Shardspace’s capabilities help with Shard Communication, both transactionally ([Data]/[Query]/[Status] exchanges) and “socially” (Reception, Openness, and Disposition) speaking, providing your status as an equal from both retaining your credentials (some [Data] wasn’t lost on your Ascension) and a newfound depth you only bump into when speaking under equal terms, even better if you possess [Broadcasting] “eloquence”.

Shardspace Access has developed more as a personal [Domain] where you examine, adjust, and adapt your parameters and power expressions, jailbroken notwithstanding; it presents freedom from how your powers are exempt from any limitations/restrictions you could’ve had, changing them to mold them it how you wish, their [Data] basis and existent information being the only hurdle. Your Island, then, has become a representation of your psyche, and knowing humanity’s complexity it is no surprise it has suffused your Island with more personality, and the feature of customization.

Shard Merging and [Domain] merge in functionality to become one, growing closer to your Avatar Body works as Partial Materialization, with your Shardmatter Manipulation being more free-form and capable of interacting with powers on the lines of power fluctuation, overriding, nullification, etc. if you have the inherent faculties for it, while fully uniting with your Avatar Body transforms you an unbound Titan Form with all your previous Full Materialization abilities and characteristics, with it acting more as a discount Reality Marble or Innate Domain.
addons.title: [Demesne]

addons.text: As a consequence of your Ascension, you’ve inherited its Island, claiming it as yours. Your very own semi-virtual plane of multiversal lattice tagging along is another strange claim to stake. Shardspace’s capabilities help with Shard Communication, both transactionally ([Data]/[Query]/[Status] exchanges) and “socially” (Reception, Openness, and Disposition) speaking, given your abilities to maintain and operate Shardspace, provide a sense of authority and credential on Shard interactions from [Data] preservation, and a new-found way with [Words], bewitching if you practiced [Broadcasting] “chutzpah”. Shardspace Access becomes Shardspace Manipulation, with your Island as an outset: at first, it’s more as a personal [Domain] where you examine, adjust, and adapt your parameters and power expressions, jailbroken notwithstanding; it presents freedom from how your powers are exempt from any limitations/restrictions you could’ve had, changing them to mold them it how you wish, their [Data] basis and existent information being the only hurdle. This Island unsurprisingly changes as a psychological representation of one’s psyche which you customize. This signature will growingly spread and expand to contact other corners of Shardspace, those reclaimedsubverted areas are controlled on the same basis as Nexus, and in the circumstance of moving them to Nexus… Shard-Host Disruption is on the table (being [Domain’s] Shardspace Access applied to others). Don’t let yourself go, you have a duty you’re bound to now, with Scion checking once in a while if his crumbling [Cycle] is generating sufficient [Data], so treading carefully is recommended. Shard Merging and [Domain] merge in functionality to become one, growing closer to your Avatar Body works as [Expanse’s] Partial Materialization, with free-form Shardmatter Manipulation and Interference, while fully uniting with your Avatar Body transforms you into an unbound Titan Form with all the [Expanse] and [Domain’s] traits, adding a taste Marble Phantasm to the mix.
addons.title: [Demesne-Keeper]

addons.text: Through [DATA] sourced from either the simulative archiving of [Harvester] or the consolidating [Parade], with [Wild Hunt’s] unbridled proliferation, touches on your Ascension, learning from it, mutating its functionality and integrating themselves into one. Over time, your Shades begin to develop into their Shard’s full representation in place of a Shard’s engram of past [Hosts], mutating similarly as you came to be, turning into an amalgamation between a Shard and a [Host], almost–no, resembling your Ascension. You can summon them as any other Shade/Simulacra. Still, they display sapience and self-determination, only known to living beings while maintaining absolute loyalty, you retain your absolute hold over your Shades. At this point, tagging them as Shades is a misnomer… more like Revenants, to be exact, ghostly reflections of times gone by, a fusion between a Ghost and a Machine. These Revenants possess the full breadth and scope of their Shards as if your Ascension starts to apply to them. Picking [Harvester] pings you with your Revenants’ [Data], the process of sourcing knowledge and power particularly unleashed due to their own putting it to use to customize your Shardself and Hostself’s capabilities. Picking [Parade] partially melds your Revenants with you, inheriting all of them without mental contamination or, being able to resurface from any defeated Parahuman by fully taking over them that can easily be reformed to your appearance. Having both, you essentially are a Chthonic Deity, a synthesis of a new Gestalt, an Underworld unto itself. [Suite] helps your Revenants to develop corporeal forms helping them emulate eerie Avatars in Realspace while having access to [Suite’s] [Data]. This enables them to evolve and heighten themselves into a Shard Cluster as time passes. [Full Suite] includes Revenants’ ability to turn into Titans, using their corporeal forms and emulation to output their functionalities fully, and receive the [The Leech’s] ability to drain and subvert other Shards; if the case these Shards are drained dry, they’re fully possessed, another Revenant in your beck-and-call. [Demesne]/[Demesne-Keeper] gives your Revenants access to their Islands, a personal [Domain] reflecting their previous [Host’s] subconscious, knowledge, powers, fears, and desires; an image of a past self, and the chance to get through Realspace; as they already the same, the Revenant([Shard]/[Host]) can materialize, generating a spectral area depicting a previous [Host’s] psyche aside from the usual abilities. [Demesne-Keeper], though, provides your Revenants [Expanse’s] abilities, forming their territories you can delegate. The Awakening retroactively makes your Revenants spiritual echoes of previous Parahumans, as if you laid a claim on their souls, transcending their mortal coil as Inner Beings, Beast and Host in one, as they merge.
addons.title: [Crypt-Keeper]

addons.text: Your powers turn your Shard to both evolutionary throwback and pinnacle, a true [Hunter] of the likes of Apollyon. Maw of the Thousand Chasms attains several dimensions: your predatory instincts can take multiple Shards now, establishing dozens of Shard Connections as Backdoors, granting you insight as to how stalk, track, hunt and kill both the [Host] and [Shard], always knowing where the targets are vulnerable and the optimal way to “take care” of them, capable of disrupting and Exhaust several of their powers’ characteristics on the [Host’s] side on [DATA] modules or select sections of their body on the [Shard] side. This Backdoor can be used to tailor your offensive abilities and counteragents to bypass any immunity or specialization the [Host] or [Shard] should possess, plant an entropic trojan horse, or softly kill both [Host] and [Shard] from the inside. [Host] dead and [Shard] consumed, instead of raw [Data] you can use to add to Entropic Decay’s capabilities, you gain an exact backup of the Shard’s capabilities and [Data] framework, freely applicable at your leisure. Predator is responsible for this while obtaining another application: Using Entropic Decay and Feast as a base, you now see everything—in the physical and metaphysical sense—as ripe for the taking, seeing as [Resources] and [Energy] you can absorb and consume for your unending maw, gaining 50% more on the amount of resources.
addons.title: [Apex Predator]

addons.text:
You aren’t a normal Entity. You are to an Entity what an Entity is to a Shard. Perhaps still immature and young, but given enough time you will dwarf even mature Entities. Where the Entities evolved through recursion and conflict, you evolve through intent and precision. What they stumbled upon through entropy, you now construct from design.

Your network architecture allows each shard within your hive to grow independently, eventually reaching a level of autonomy and structural complexity equivalent to full Entities. These pseudo-Entities are recursive cores capable of managing their own shard clusters, forming internal lattices that mirror and reinforce your central design. As your system expands, your hive becomes a distributed architecture of scalable cognition and modular power generation. Each node feeds the next, allowing for parallel evolution, self-replication, and rapid deployment of new shard-based systems with no need for host input.

Once fully matured, your network surpasses the theoretical ceiling of standard Entity evolution. At this point, you gain the ability to directly assimilate entire Entities. Their shard structures, internal logic, and control hierarchies can be broken down, absorbed, and restructured into your lattice. Their shards become yours, their cognitive patterns integrated or replaced, their function rewritten to serve your purpose. Even the core operating principles of an Entity—the rules that define its growth, purpose, and cycle behavior—can be overwritten.
addons.title: The Demiurge

objects.text:
Your Shard overloaded the connection between you and it when it tried to give you too much power and accidentally destroyed its own mind in the process. As a consequence of that, you are now the [Shard], the [Host], and in time, you will become the [Entity]. Your human body looks normal for now, but as time passes it will slowly transform, making you look more and more artificial as your human flesh is gradually transformed into Shard flesh and you have managed to inherit your Shard's ability to take over other shards when its host defeats another host, which means if you defeat parahumans then their shards will be added to your newborn network. Be careful, though, for other entities will recognize what you are and will seek to destroy you if they find you though luckily your powers are fully unlocked with no artificial limitations or restrictions, with your only limitation being how much [Energy] you have.

(The Entity whose shard was used to Ascend will not be alerted of your Ascension)
objects.title: The Ascension

objects.text: Administration governs the coordination, unity, and control of your Shards. Every Entity manages its network, but these specialisations refine that management into an art form.
objects.title: Administration

objects.text: Your Shards are organised into a rigid chain of command. Orders flow from the top down with absolute clarity. Sub-Shards do not question directives. This eliminates lag, miscommunication, and resource contention within your network. The result is a perfectly synchronised Entity where every fragment moves in lockstep. The downside is inflexibility. Your network cannot easily adapt to situations you did not anticipate, as lower Shards lack the autonomy to improvise.
objects.title: Hierarchical Command

objects.text: Your Shards operate as a collective. Major decisions are reached through consensus, with each Shard contributing its perspective and expertise before action is taken. This process is near-instantaneous despite its democratic nature, as your network processes debate at the speed of thought. The result is an Entity that considers every angle before moving, making you exceptionally difficult to outmaneuver. The downside is that reaching consensus on unprecedented situations takes slightly longer than a hierarchical model, though once reached, the decision is universally supported.
objects.title: Distributed Consensus

objects.text: Your Shards are organised by function rather than authority. When a task arises, it is automatically routed to the Shards most qualified to handle it, bypassing irrelevant fragments entirely. A precognitive problem goes to the Shards that handle Foresight. A dimensional breach goes to the Shards that handle Breach. This makes every action hyper-efficient, as the right tools are always applied to the right problems without waste. The downside is that cross-functional tasks requiring multiple specialisations can face coordination delays as different clusters negotiate priority.
objects.title: Specialisation Routing

objects.text: Your network is built with deliberate redundancy. Critical functions are duplicated across multiple Shard clusters, ensuring that no single failure can compromise your capabilities. If one cluster is damaged, another seamlessly takes over. If one perspective is flawed, another provides correction. The result is an Entity that is nearly impossible to cripple through targeted attacks on its infrastructure. The downside is that this redundancy consumes additional resources, and your maximum output per function is slightly lower than a streamlined network.
objects.title: Redundant Array

objects.text: Your network is not fixed. It reorganises itself in real time based on current needs. During combat, combat Shards receive priority bandwidth. During analysis, data-processing Shards take precedence. During travel, navigational Shards assume temporary authority. The network flows like a living thing, always optimising for the present moment. The result is an Entity that is always in the right configuration for whatever it faces. The downside is that constant reorganisation incurs a minor but persistent energy cost, and rapid shifts between configurations can leave brief windows of vulnerability.
objects.title: Adaptive Topology

objects.text:
Your network becomes a single, unified system that combines the benefits of every Administrator specialisation into one seamless whole, then elevates them beyond what any individual specialisation could achieve alone.

Hierarchical Command ensured obedience. Distributed Consensus ensured wisdom. Now your network obeys with wisdom. Every Shard follows orders instantly, but those orders are informed by the collective perspective of every fragment in your network. You command with the voice of a trillion minds, and every one of them agrees with you before you speak.

Specialisation Routing ensured tasks found the right Shards. Adaptive Topology ensured the network was always in the right configuration. Now the routing is predictive. Your network anticipates what tasks will arise before they do. The topology shifts in advance of need, not in response to it. You are not reacting. You are waiting.

Redundant Array ensured critical functions survived damage. Now redundancy is dynamic. Functions shift between backup locations faster than damage can propagate. An attack that destroys a Shard finds its function already running elsewhere, as though the destroyed Shard was never necessary in the first place.

The downsides of each specialisation no longer exist. The energy cost of topology shifts is negated by the efficiency of routing. The inflexibility of hierarchy is softened by the creativity of consensus. The lag of consensus is erased by the instant obedience of hierarchy. Every weakness is covered by a strength. Every strength is multiplied by the others.
objects.title: [THE NEXUS]

objects.text: Feeder governs energy generation, absorption, and conversion. Every Entity draws power from its environment, but these specialisations refine that hunger into a masterwork of efficiency and scale.
objects.title: Feeder

objects.text: Your Shards draw energy from the friction between dimensions. The barriers that separate realities are not perfectly smooth, and your network has learned to exploit the thermal and kinetic bleed between them. This provides a constant, baseline power supply that functions anywhere in the multiverse, regardless of local conditions. It is not the fastest method of energy generation, but it is the most reliable. The downside is that the output is fixed and cannot be scaled up in emergencies.
objects.title: Dimensional Tap

objects.text: Your Shards have mastered gravitational energy extraction. You can create and contain micro-singularities within your body, harvesting their Hawking radiation and rotational energy. A single stable singularity provides immense, long-term power. The process is clean, self-contained, and independent of external resources. The downside is that creating and maintaining singularities requires a significant upfront energy investment, and a containment failure would be catastrophic.
objects.title: Singularity Engine

objects.text: Your Shards draw energy from the quantum foam that underlies reality itself. Empty space is not truly empty, and your network has learned to tap the fluctuations of virtual particles as they pop in and out of existence. This method provides effectively limitless energy that can be drawn from anywhere. The downside is that extraction rates are limited by local spacetime stability. Drawing too much, too fast can destabilise the surrounding area, causing unpredictable quantum effects.
objects.title: Quantum Vacuum Extraction

objects.text: Your Shards can reverse entropy in a localised area, converting spent energy back into usable form. Waste heat becomes fuel. Depleted resources become fresh. The arrow of time bends slightly in your favour. This does not violate thermodynamics so much as cheat it, borrowing against the future to pay the present. The downside is that the reversal is temporary and must be paid back eventually. Overusing this method builds up a debt that will come due all at once if not managed carefully.
objects.title: Entropy Reversal

objects.text: Your Shards harvest energy from dark matter, the invisible mass that permeates the universe. Where conventional matter is scarce, dark matter is abundant. Your network has developed the ability to interact with and convert this elusive substance into usable power. The process is slow and the conversion rate is low, but dark matter exists everywhere, making this method universally applicable. You will never be truly stranded. The downside is that the energy yield per unit is small compared to more direct methods, requiring patience and large collection arrays.
objects.title: Dark Matter Siphon

objects.text:
Your energy systems merge into a single, unified engine that combines every method of power generation into a self-sustaining, ever-escalating cycle.

Dimensional Tap provided constant baseline power. Dark Matter Siphon provided slow but universal energy. Now they feed into each other. The dimensional bleed amplifies dark matter conversion. Dark matter density stabilises dimensional friction. Your baseline power is no longer a trickle. It is a flood that never stops, never falters, and never depends on external conditions.

Singularity Engine provided immense power from gravitational extraction. Quantum Vacuum Extraction provided limitless power from the quantum foam. Now the singularities are fed by the vacuum. The vacuum is stabilised by the singularities. The energy output is no longer limited by containment or extraction rates. The feedback loop between the two erases the boundaries that once constrained them.

Entropy Reversal borrowed against the future to pay the present. Now the debt is cancelled by the surplus of your other methods. The energy you reverse is paid back instantly from the output of your singularities, your dimensional taps, your dark matter siphons. You do not borrow. You generate. The arrow of time does not bend around you. You straighten it.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed by the strengths of the others. Fixed output is boosted by limitless extraction. Slow conversion is accelerated by gravitational energy. Containment risk is negated by dimensional stabilisation. Energy debt is paid by perpetual surplus.
objects.title: [THE ENGINE]

objects.text: Breach governs dimensional entry and traversal. Every Entity moves between realities, but these specialisations refine that passage into something far more precise and far more invasive.
objects.title: Breach

objects.text: Your Shards specialise in bypassing dimensional locks. Protected realities, sealed timelines, and dimensions that have been deliberately walled off by other Entities are not barriers to you. They are puzzles. Your network analyses the lock, finds the flaw, and opens the door. The process is not instant, but it is inevitable. Given enough time, no sealed dimension can keep you out. The downside is that the more complex the lock, the longer the breach takes, and the breach itself may be detectable by whatever created the lock.
objects.title: Lockbreaker

objects.text: Your Shards are built to enter and survive dimensions with fundamentally hostile physics. Realities where the strong nuclear force is slightly different, where time runs backward, where matter exists only as probability waveforms. Your network can analyse these conditions and adapt your form to survive them before entry. You can explore realities that would annihilate an unprepared Entity. The downside is that adaptation takes time and energy, and each new hostile dimension requires a fresh analysis cycle before entry is safe.
objects.title: Hostile Environment Entry

objects.text: Your Shards can enter a dimension without leaving a trace. There is no ripple, no energy spike, no telltale signature that announces your arrival. The fabric of reality does not tear. It parts, then seals behind you as though you were never there. This allows you to observe dimensions in their natural state, gather uncontaminated data, or position yourself for a strike without warning. The downside is that silent breaching is slower than more forceful methods, and rapid exits are not possible without sacrificing stealth.
objects.title: Silent Breach

objects.text: Your Shards can establish permanent dimensional anchors, stable pathways between realities that remain open indefinitely. These are not temporary portals but fixed corridors that can be used repeatedly without additional energy cost. You can build a network of anchored dimensions, creating a territory that spans multiple realities. The downside is that anchors are detectable by other Entities and can be attacked or collapsed if discovered. Each anchor also requires a small but constant energy upkeep.
objects.title: Anchor Breach

objects.text: Your Shards are optimised for escape. When you are threatened, when a dimension is collapsing, when another Entity has you cornered, your network can tear open an emergency breach and pull you through faster than any conventional dimensional transition. This is not subtle, but it is effective. The breach opens instantly, the transition is nearly teleportation-fast, and your exit scatters false dimensional signatures across dozens of random realities, masking your true destination. Pursuers must check each false trail individually while you are already long gone. The downside is that the departure dimension is left with a visible scar, and the energy cost is significant. You will escape, but everyone will know you were there.
objects.title: Emergency Egress

objects.text:
Your dimensional travel becomes a single, perfected art that combines every method of breach into seamless, effortless motion.

Lockbreaker opened sealed doors. Hostile Environment Entry let you survive what lay beyond them. Now no door is closed, and no environment is hostile. You bypass locks without detection and enter without adaptation because your presence no longer triggers the defences that would stop you. Sealed realities do not recognise you as an intruder. Hostile physics do not recognise you as foreign. You belong everywhere.

Silent Breach let you enter without trace. Emergency Egress let you leave without delay. Now entry and exit are the same motion. You slip between dimensions without sound, without signature, without the scar that Emergency Egress once left behind. The false trails scatter automatically upon departure, and the departure itself is silent. You leave nothing behind but confusion.

Anchor Breach let you build permanent corridors. Now your entire network of anchors is integrated into your being. You do not travel through dimensions. You step through your own territory, a sovereign space that exists between realities. Every dimension you have ever visited is connected to you by invisible threads. You can be in any of them at any moment, and the journey is instant.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Slow breaching is accelerated by escape protocols. Energy costs are offset by anchor stability. Detectability is erased by hostile environment adaptation. Every limitation is removed. Every barrier is bypassed.
objects.title: [THE TRAVELLER]

objects.text: Panopticon governs sensory capabilities. Every Entity observes its environment, but these specialisations refine perception into something all-seeing and inescapable.
objects.title: Panopticon

objects.text: Your Shards can penetrate any material, any shielding, any distance to observe what lies beneath. Planets are transparent to you. You can count the cells in a living creature from orbit, map the interior of a star, or peer through dimensional barriers that would stop lesser senses. Nothing within your range is opaque. The downside is that deep scanning is active and detectable. Whatever you are observing will know it is being observed, assuming it possesses the sensory capability to detect your scan.
objects.title: Deep Scan

objects.text: Your Shards observe everything within a truly vast radius. Range is prioritised over depth. You can monitor an entire galaxy at once, tracking every star system, every planetary body, every significant energy fluctuation in real time. The resolution is lower than more focused methods, but nothing moves within your territory without your knowledge. Fleets, celestial bodies, even other Entities are visible as soon as they enter your sphere of awareness. The downside is that fine details are lost. You can see the armada, but not the individual ships. You can track the planet, but not the cities on its surface.
objects.title: Wide Net

objects.text: Your Shards observe without interacting. You emit no signals, no scanning beams, no energy of any kind. You simply receive what is already there: light, heat, vibration, radiation, dimensional bleed. To any form of detection, you are not looking. You are not even present. The downside is that passive observation can only capture what the environment naturally emits. If something is truly dark, silent, and still, you will not see it.
objects.title: Passive Observation

objects.text: Your Shards observe across dimensions simultaneously. A planet is not just one planet to you. It is every version of that planet, in every accessible reality, all at once. You can track a target as it shifts between dimensions, observe cause and effect rippling through parallel worlds, and perceive the full multiversal footprint of any phenomenon. The downside is that processing this much information requires significant attention. You can see everything, but you cannot focus on everything at once.
objects.title: Dimensional Overwatch

objects.text: Your Shards observe at the smallest possible scales. You can perceive individual atoms, subatomic particles, quantum states, and the underlying information that constitutes reality itself. Nothing is too small to escape your notice. You can read the genetic code of every living being in a city, map the atomic structure of a planet's core, or track individual electrons as they move through a circuit. The downside is that this level of detail is overwhelming at larger scales. You must choose between seeing everything small or seeing anything big.
objects.title: Microscopic Penetration

objects.text:
Your perception becomes a single, unified sense that combines every method of observation into perfect, omniscient awareness.

Deep Scan penetrated any material but announced its presence. Passive Observation was invisible but limited to what the environment provided. Now you see everything, everywhere, at every depth, without ever being detected. You can count the atoms in a planet's core from across the galaxy, and the planet will never know you looked. The active signal of Deep Scan is replaced by the silent reception of Passive Observation. The opacity of the universe is a myth you have outgrown.

Wide Net tracked galaxies but missed details. Microscopic Penetration saw atoms but lost the big picture. Now you see both simultaneously and with perfect clarity. The armada and the faces of every crew member. The planet and every cell of every creature on it. The scale no longer matters. You zoom from galactic to quantum without effort, without lag, without losing anything in the transition.

Dimensional Overwatch showed you every reality at once but overwhelmed your ability to focus. Now your focus is infinite.
