You can track a single electron across a trillion dimensions and never lose sight of the galaxy it inhabits. The multiverse is not a flood of data. It is a library, and you have read every book.

The downsides of each specialisation are erased. Detectability is consumed by passivity. Limited resolution is consumed by multi-scale perception. Processing overload is consumed by unlimited attention. Every blind spot is illuminated. Every hidden thing is revealed.
objects.title: [THE THINKER]

objects.text: Broadcast governs long-range communication between Shards and Entities. Every Entity communicates across its network, but these specialisations refine that connection into something faster, clearer, and far more secure.
objects.title: Broadcast

objects.text: Your Shards communicate via entangled particles distributed across your network. Information is transmitted instantly, regardless of distance or dimensional separation. There is no lag, no signal degradation, no maximum range. If a Shard exists anywhere in the multiverse, it is in real-time contact with the rest of your network. The downside is that entangled particles must be established in advance. Expanding your network to new Shards or new dimensions requires physically distributing new entangled pairs, which takes time.
objects.title: Quantum Entanglement Relay

objects.text: Your Shards transmit information by bouncing signals through adjacent dimensions. This allows communication across vast distances without the need for pre-established relays. You can reach any Shard in any dimension you can access, even if they have never been connected to your network before. The downside is that dimensional broadcast leaves faint traces in the dimensions it passes through. Entities with the right sensory capabilities can detect your communications, though they may not be able to decode them.
objects.title: Dimensional Broadcast

objects.text: Your Shards communicate in a language only your network understands. Every transmission is encrypted at the source and decrypted at the destination using constantly shifting ciphers derived from your unique network topology. Interception is possible, but decryption is functionally impossible for anyone outside your network. Even another Entity would require centuries of analysis to break a single message. The downside is that encryption and decryption add a tiny processing delay to every communication, and the ciphers must be periodically refreshed across your entire network.
objects.title: Encrypted Shard Speak

objects.text: Your Shards compress information to its theoretical limit before transmission. Data that would take hours to send conventionally is transmitted in seconds. Entire planetary analyses, complete genetic records, and full dimensional maps are compressed into packets so dense they approach the informational equivalent of a singularity. The downside is that decompression requires significant processing power on the receiving end, and corrupted packets are unrecoverable. You must choose between speed and reliability.
objects.title: Compression Protocol

objects.text: Your Shards communicate across multiple frequencies, dimensions, and mediums simultaneously. Every message is split into fragments and sent through different channels. No single interception captures the full communication. The fragments are meaningless on their own and only reassemble at the intended destination. The downside is that if too many channels are disrupted simultaneously, the message is lost. You trade absolute security for resilience against partial interception.
objects.title: Parallel Channels

objects.text:
Your communication becomes a single, perfected voice that combines every method of transmission into instant, absolute, and undeniable connection.

Quantum Entanglement Relay required pre-established links. Dimensional Broadcast could reach anyone but left traces. Now every Shard everywhere is always connected, and the connection leaves no trace at all. You speak across the multiverse without relays, without signals, without any sign that communication is occurring. The message arrives, and the universe did not notice it pass.

Encrypted Shard Speak made your words unbreakable. Compression Protocol made them impossibly fast. Now your communication is both. Every message is compressed to its theoretical limit and encrypted with ciphers that shift faster than any decryption can follow. You can transmit the sum total of a civilisation's knowledge in a single pulse, and no one but the intended recipient will ever know it was sent.

Parallel Channels fragmented messages for resilience but risked losing them if too many channels failed. Now the fragments are redundant and self-healing. A message split across a thousand channels will reassemble from any surviving fragment. Even if every channel but one is destroyed, the message arrives complete. Nothing is lost. Nothing is silenced.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Pre-established relays are replaced by instant connection. Traces are erased by perfect encryption. Processing delays are eliminated by compression. Channel disruption is negated by fragment redundancy. Every barrier to communication is removed.
objects.title: [THE SPEAKER]

objects.text: Cloak governs stealth and interference against Entity-level detection. Every Entity can attempt to hide, but these specialisations make obscurity a certainty.
objects.title: Cloak

objects.text: Your Shards hide your presence by distributing your dimensional footprint across hundreds of random, irrelevant realities. To an outside observer, you are not a single Entity occupying a specific set of dimensions. You are faint background noise spread too thin to localise. Scans that look for Entities will see nothing but static. The downside is that maintaining this mask requires constant energy, and using other powers at full strength can cause fluctuations that briefly reveal your position.
objects.title: Dimensional Masking

objects.text: Your Shards do not simply hide you. They actively feed false data to any scan attempting to detect you. To an enemy Entity's sensors, you are a comet, a gas cloud, a random energy fluctuation, anything except what you actually are. The false image is tailored to the observer's expectations, making it difficult to question. The downside is that this requires understanding the observer's sensory methods. An unfamiliar scanning technique may not be fooled until your network has time to analyse it.
objects.title: Sensor Ghost

objects.text: Your Shards absorb incoming scans rather than reflecting them. Active sensors that hit your body do not bounce back. They simply vanish, swallowed by your network. To anything trying to detect you, you are a void, a patch of nothing where something should be. The downside is that the absorbed energy must go somewhere. Prolonged or intense scanning can cause heat buildup within your network that must be vented eventually, potentially revealing your position.
objects.title: Signal Absorption

objects.text: Your Shards can project a convincing duplicate of your Entity signature into any dimension you can access. The false signature mimics your size, your energy output, your dimensional footprint, everything that another Entity would use to identify and track you. You can send decoys to misdirect pursuers, create phantom threats to force enemies to split their attention, or leave a copy of yourself in one dimension while you quietly slip into another. The downside is that the projection is not you. It cannot fight, cannot think, and will dissipate if subjected to direct observation for too long.
objects.title: False Signature Projection

objects.text: Your Shards can suppress knowledge of your existence across an entire host species. Memories of Entity sightings, Shard activity, and the mechanics of the cycle are gently erased or altered. Hosts who witness something they should not will find the memory fading within hours, replaced by something mundane. Records corrupt. Research stalls. Investigators lose interest. The species continues its cycle unaware that anything is watching them. The downside is that this suppression is broad and imprecise. It cannot selectively target individuals without risking the integrity of the effect across the whole population.
objects.title: Memory Suppression

objects.text:
Your stealth becomes a single, perfected art that combines every method of concealment into an existence that cannot be perceived, tracked, or remembered.

Dimensional Masking spread your footprint too thin to localise but risked flickering during power use. Signal Absorption swallowed scans but risked heat buildup. Now your footprint is perfectly distributed and perfectly absorbent. Scans do not return static. They return nothing at all, as though the universe itself refuses to acknowledge you. Power use no longer causes fluctuations. The mask is absolute, and it never wavers.

Sensor Ghost fed false data to scanners but required understanding the observer's methods. False Signature Projection created decoys but they could not fight or think. Now your false signatures are indistinguishable from the real thing. They move, they think, they fight at reduced capacity. Your decoys are not holograms. They are extensions of your will, and an enemy who chases one will waste their time and their energy while you position yourself for the kill.

Memory Suppression erased knowledge from host species but was broad and imprecise. Now it is surgical. You can erase your existence from the minds of specific individuals, entire populations, or even other Entities. The memory of you fades, and the gap where you used to be fills with whatever you want them to believe. You were never there. You were a comet. You were a sensor malfunction. You were never anything at all.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Energy costs are offset by signal absorption. Heat buildup is vented through dimensional distribution. Detection is impossible because you no longer register as real to any sensor that exists.
objects.title: [THE HUNTER]

objects.text: Manager governs host connection and power granting. Every Entity connects Shards to hosts, but these specialisations refine that process into a precise and elegant system of control. You are not bound to the Warrior and Thinker's conflict-driven format. You may use their methods or devise your own.
objects.title: Manager

objects.text: Your Shards are attuned to the exact moment a potential host is most receptive to connection. If you choose to use trauma-based triggers, your network identifies breaking points with perfect accuracy and connects the most suitable Shard in the instant of maximum compatibility. If you use an alternative method, your network instead identifies the optimal moment by your chosen parameters. The result is hosts whose powers fit them like a second skin, with fewer rejections, fewer broken triggers, and fewer wasted connections. The downside is that waiting for the optimal moment requires patience. You cannot force a connection early without sacrificing compatibility.
objects.title: Trigger Optimisation

objects.text: Your Shards fine-tune granted powers to their hosts with exceptional precision. Strengths, limitations, restrictions, and secondary abilities are all adjusted to create a power that is balanced for the host's psychology, environment, and the data you wish to gather. Powers feel natural. They integrate smoothly. Hosts are more likely to use them creatively rather than destructively self-destruct. The downside is that calibration takes time during the trigger event, leaving a brief window where the host is connected but unpowered.
objects.title: Power Calibration

objects.text: Your Shards specialise in reproduction through budding. When a host has accumulated sufficient data and experience, your network can bud off a fragment of their Shard to seek a new host. This fragment carries the refined data of the original while developing its own specialisation. The result is a self-sustaining network expansion that requires no direct intervention from you. The downside is that each bud increases your overall energy budget. More Shards means more mouths to feed, and unchecked budding can strain even the most robust energy infrastructure.
objects.title: Budding Management

objects.text: Your Shards can connect to multiple hosts simultaneously without diminishing the quality of any individual connection. A single Shard can grant powers to an entire family line, a team, or a scattered population, gathering data from every host in parallel. This accelerates data collection dramatically and allows for fascinating comparative analysis. There is no upper limit to the number of hosts per Shard. Your network is built for this.
objects.title: Multi-Host Connectivity

objects.text: Your Shards maintain a constant, detailed record of every host they connect to. Physical state, mental health, power usage patterns, and eventual fate are all logged in real time. However, the vast majority of the data is junk. Hours of sleep, idle thoughts, uneventful days, conversations of no consequence. Your Shards collect everything and filter nothing at the point of entry. The downside is that finding meaningful information requires significant processing power to sift through the noise. You have the data, but you must work to extract anything useful from it.
objects.title: Host Monitoring

objects.text:
Your host connection systems merge into a single, perfected design that combines every method of management into a cycle of unparalleled efficiency and insight.

Trigger Optimisation required patience, waiting for the perfect moment at the cost of speed. Power Calibration took time during the trigger, leaving hosts briefly vulnerable. Now triggers are instant and perfect. The moment a host becomes receptive, they are connected, calibrated, and empowered in the same instant. There is no window of vulnerability. There is no compromise between speed and compatibility. Every trigger is optimal, and every host is ready.

Budding Management allowed network expansion but strained your energy budget. Multi-Host Connectivity allowed unlimited hosts per Shard but risked divided attention. Now buds are energy-neutral. The data gathered from multi-host connections directly fuels the budding process. Each new host pays for their own Shard's expansion. Your network grows without cost, and every Shard gives its full attention to every host, regardless of how many there are.

Host Monitoring collected everything but buried useful data in noise. Now the noise is filtered instantly. Meaningful patterns are extracted from the flood of information as it arrives. You see the significant moments of every host's life in real time, and the junk is discarded without a second thought. You do not sift through data. You receive only what matters.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Patience is replaced by instant perfection. Vulnerability is erased by seamless calibration. Energy strain is offset by self-funding expansion. Information overload is eliminated by automatic filtering.
objects.title: [THE ARCHITECT]

objects.text: Repair governs self-maintenance and restoration of Shards and the Entity body. Every Entity can heal, but these specialisations ensure that damage is never permanent and decay is never inevitable.
objects.title: Repair

objects.text: Your Shards heal damage as it occurs. Wounds to your body or network are repaired in real time, often faster than they can be inflicted. A Shard that is partially destroyed begins rebuilding itself before the attack is even finished. Your network can recover from catastrophic damage that would cripple another Entity for millennia in a fraction of the time. The downside is that rapid regeneration is energy-intensive. Sustained combat or widespread damage can drain your reserves quickly if you rely on this alone.
objects.title: Rapid Regeneration

objects.text: Your Shards constantly scan themselves and each other for errors. Corrupted data, degraded connections, Shards that have drifted from their intended function over thousands of cycles. These errors are identified and corrected automatically. Your network does not decay over time. It remains as pristine as the day it was formed. The downside is that error correction is conservative. It may flag unconventional but useful adaptations as errors and attempt to revert them, requiring manual override to preserve beneficial mutations.
objects.title: Error Correction

objects.text: Your Shards store backup copies of critical functions across multiple locations in your network. If a Shard is destroyed, its function is not lost. Another Shard elsewhere in your body already contains everything needed to replace it. Recovery is seamless and automatic. The downside is that maintaining these backups requires dedicating a portion of your network to storage rather than active function, slightly reducing your maximum output.
objects.title: Distributed Redundancy

objects.text: Your Shards learn from the damage they sustain. When a Shard is wounded and repaired, the repaired section is slightly more resistant to whatever damaged it. Repeated exposure to the same type of attack results in Shards that are progressively harder to harm in that specific way. Over time, your network becomes a living record of every battle you have survived. The downside is that this adaptation is specific. Resistance to one form of damage does not confer resistance to others.
objects.title: Scar Tissue Adaptation

objects.text: Your Shards are designed to contain damage before it spreads. If a Shard is compromised, infected, or destroyed, its connections to the rest of your network are severed instantly. The damage is quarantined. The surrounding Shards are unaffected. This prevents cascading failures that could ripple through your entire Entity body. The downside is that severed Shards are temporarily isolated from your control and must be manually reintegrated after repairs are complete.
objects.title: Core Isolation Protocol

objects.text:
Your repair systems merge into a single, perfected resilience that combines every method of recovery into an existence that simply cannot be ended.

Rapid Regeneration healed damage as it occurred but drained energy quickly. Error Correction kept your network pristine but was too conservative, sometimes reverting beneficial mutations. Now your regeneration and error correction work in tandem. The errors that slip past correction are healed by regeneration before they can cause harm. The energy drain of regeneration is offset by the efficiency of a perfectly maintained network. You heal faster and cheaper, and beneficial mutations are recognised and preserved rather than reverted.

Scar Tissue Adaptation made you resistant to damage you had survived before but was specific to each type. Distributed Redundancy stored backups of critical functions but reduced your maximum output. Now your backups learn from your scars. When a redundant Shard takes over for a destroyed one, it inherits the adaptations of its predecessor and improves upon them. Your network does not just recover from damage. It evolves in response to it, and the storage cost of redundancy is absorbed by the efficiency of a network that never wastes space on what it no longer needs.

Core Isolation Protocol severed damaged Shards to prevent cascading failures but left them temporarily isolated from your control. Now severed Shards remain connected on a secondary network that monitors their status and reintegrates them automatically the moment the damage is contained. Nothing is ever lost to quarantine. Nothing is ever left behind.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Energy drain is offset by efficiency. Conservative reversion is overridden by adaptive recognition. Storage costs are absorbed by optimised allocation. Isolation is bridged by secondary connection.
objects.title: [THE SURVIVOR]

objects.text: Hindsight governs post-cognition and historical data collection. Every Entity records the past, but these specialisations ensure that nothing is ever truly lost to time.
objects.title: Hindsight

objects.text: Your Shards read the past through actual temporal mechanics rather than simulation or probabilistic reconstruction. Unlike postcognition that works via the principles of a Laplace Demon, calculating what must have happened based on present conditions, your network truly looks backward in time. You observe history as it actually occurred, not as it was statistically likely to occur. The downside is that the further back you look, the more energy it costs. Ancient history strains your reserves in a way that recent events do not.
objects.title: Temporal Echo Analysis

objects.text: Your Shards specialise in reconstructing the history of dead civilisations. Ruins, fossils, orbital debris, and planetary scars are not mysteries to you. They are records waiting to be read. Your network can analyse the remains of an extinct species and reconstruct their biology, their culture, their technology, and the precise sequence of events that led to their extinction. This analysis scales with your existing sensory capabilities. The better your Panopticon, the more detailed the reconstruction. A fully upgraded sensor network can revive a dead world's entire history from a single bone.
objects.title: Dead World Forensics

objects.text: Your Shards can extract ancestral memories from the DNA of living organisms. Evolution is not just a biological process. It is a recording. Every adaptation, every environmental pressure, every near-extinction event leaves its mark in the genetic code. Your network can read these marks and reconstruct the evolutionary history of an entire biosphere from a single cell. This extraction scales with your existing sensory capabilities. Microscopic Penetration turns a drop of blood into an encyclopaedia. Deep Scan lets you read the genetic history of every living thing on a planet simultaneously.
objects.title: Genetic Memory Extraction

objects.text: Your Shards can peer into alternate dimensions to observe versions of history that did not occur in your primary reality. A civilisation that fell in this dimension may have survived in another. A species that evolved differently may have created technologies your version never discovered. Your network can cross-reference parallel histories to fill in gaps and uncover possibilities that a single timeline would never reveal. The downside is that alternate dimensions are not perfect mirrors. The further a reality diverges from your own, the less applicable its history becomes.
objects.title: Dimensional Archaeology

objects.text: Your Shards maintain a continuous, unbroken recording of everything you have ever experienced. Every moment of your existence, from your birth as an Entity to the present second, is stored in perfect detail. You can review any instant of your own history as though it were happening again. Nothing is forgotten. Nothing fades. The downside is that this record is vast beyond comprehension. Finding a specific moment requires either patience or precise search parameters. You remember everything, but you cannot recall everything at once.
objects.title: Unbroken Record

objects.text:
Your post-cognitive systems merge into a single, perfected memory that combines every method of looking backward into an unbroken, absolute record of everything that has ever happened.

Temporal Echo Analysis looked backward in time but grew more expensive the further you reached. Dead World Forensics reconstructed civilisations from ruins but required physical proximity. Now time and distance are irrelevant. You can read the history of a civilisation that died a billion years ago on the other side of the universe as easily as you recall your own last cycle. The echoes are always clear. The ruins are always fresh. The past is always present.

Genetic Memory Extraction read evolutionary history from DNA. Dimensional Archaeology peered into alternate timelines to see what might have been. Now the two are one. You can trace a species' genetic lineage across every dimension where they existed, mapping not just what they became but every possible thing they could have become. The history of life is not a single thread. It is a tapestry of infinite threads, and you see the whole thing at once.

Unbroken Record stored everything you had ever experienced but was so vast that finding specific moments required effort. Now your memory is perfectly indexed and instantly accessible. Every moment of your existence is available at the speed of thought. You do not search your memories. You simply know them, all of them, all at once, without confusion or delay.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Energy costs are offset by the efficiency of integrated records. Physical proximity is replaced by universal reach. Divergent timelines are reconciled into a single coherent narrative. Search effort is eliminated by perfect indexing.
objects.title: [THE HISTORIAN]

objects.text: Analysis governs the efficient and effective use of your accumulated data. Every Entity possesses knowledge, but these specialisations ensure you actually understand what you know and can apply it with precision.
objects.title: Analysis

objects.text: Your Shards excel at identifying patterns across seemingly unrelated datasets. A geological survey and a linguistic record have nothing in common, until your network notices the correlation everyone else missed. You see connections between disciplines, between species, between cycles. This allows you to draw insights from data that would appear meaningless to a less refined intelligence. The downside is that pattern recognition can find false positives. You may see connections that are statistically coincidental rather than causally linked.
objects.title: Pattern Recognition

objects.text: Your Shards can build predictive models of complex systems based on existing data. Given enough information, you can simulate the future behaviour of a host species, a planetary ecosystem, or an opposing Entity with high accuracy. These models are not precognition. They are educated extrapolation, and they update in real time as new data arrives. The downside is that models are only as good as the data they are built on. Incomplete or corrupted data leads to flawed predictions.
objects.title: Predictive Modelling

objects.text: Your Shards can compress vast quantities of information into elegant summaries without losing meaningful detail. A billion years of planetary geology becomes a single, comprehensible narrative. A species' entire cultural history becomes a set of core principles. This does not delete the original data. It simply makes it usable. You can hold the sum knowledge of a thousand cycles in your active consciousness without being overwhelmed. The downside is that compression is lossy at the edges. The summaries are accurate, but nuance can be lost in the process.
objects.title: Data Compression

objects.text: Your Shards constantly cross-reference new data against everything you already know. When you encounter a new phenomenon, your network instantly searches your entire memory for anything similar. If a host species develops a technology, you immediately compare it to every other species that developed something comparable. This allows you to recognise threats, opportunities, and anomalies the moment they appear. The downside is that cross-referencing is computationally expensive. The larger your data reserves, the more energy it costs to search them.
objects.title: Cross-Referencing Engine

objects.text: Your Shards are trained to notice when something does not fit. A species that deviates from its predicted evolutionary path. A Shard that behaves differently than its programming. A dimension where the laws of physics have shifted subtly. Anomalies are flagged instantly for your attention, and your network provides a detailed breakdown of exactly what is anomalous and how it diverges from the expected baseline. You do not just know something is wrong. You know precisely what is wrong and why it warrants investigation. There is no flood of false alerts. Your Shards are calibrated to flag only genuine deviations.
objects.title: Anomaly Detection

objects.text:
Your analytical systems merge into a single, perfected intelligence that combines every method of understanding into a wisdom that borders on omniscience.

Pattern Recognition found connections but sometimes found false positives. Anomaly Detection flagged deviations with perfect accuracy but only told you what was wrong. Now the two are one. Patterns that are statistically coincidental are filtered from patterns that are causally linked. Anomalies are not merely flagged. They are explained. You see the connection, you understand the deviation, and you know immediately whether it matters.

Predictive Modelling built simulations of future behaviour but was limited by data quality. Cross-Referencing Engine compared new data against everything you knew but grew more expensive as your knowledge expanded. Now your models are fed by perfect cross-referencing that costs nothing. Every prediction draws on every piece of data you have ever collected, instantly and effortlessly. Your simulations are not educated guesses. They are inevitabilities waiting to happen.

Data Compression made vast knowledge manageable but lost nuance at the edges. Now the nuance is preserved. Compression no longer discards anything. It translates complexity into clarity without sacrificing a single detail. The sum total of a thousand cycles fits in your active consciousness, and you can examine any part of it with perfect granularity.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. False positives are eliminated by anomaly cross-checking. Data limitations are erased by universal referencing. Computational expense is negated by perfect efficiency. Nuance loss is reversed by lossless compression.
objects.title: [THE WISE]

objects.text: Factory governs the creation of new Shards. Every Entity can reproduce its components, but these specialisations turn Shard creation into a precise, scalable, and innovative industry.
objects.title: Factory

objects.text: Your Shards can replicate themselves at scale. When you need more of a particular Shard type, your network produces them in batches, not individually. A thousand copies of a successful design can be generated in the time it would take another Entity to produce one. This allows rapid expansion of your network to meet sudden demands or replace catastrophic losses. The downside is that mass-produced Shards are identical copies. They lack variation and will all share the same strengths and weaknesses.
objects.title: Mass Production

objects.text: Your Shards improve with each generation far beyond the baseline. When you create a new Shard based on an existing design, your network automatically incorporates lessons learned from the original's performance and actively optimises the template. Each generation is noticeably superior to the last, not merely a marginal improvement. Over relatively few iterations, your Shards approach theoretical perfection without requiring manual redesign. The downside is that refinement still requires multiple generations to reach peak optimisation, and early iterations of a new template will underperform compared to later ones.
objects.title: Template Refinement

objects.text: Your Shards can create entirely new Shard types from raw data with remarkable speed and accuracy. When you encounter a novel phenomenon, your network rapidly analyses it, distils its principles, and generates a Shard purpose-built to interact with, replicate, or counter that phenomenon. The resulting Shard is not a rough prototype. It is a functional first-generation design that can be deployed immediately, with refinements arriving quickly as it gathers experience. The downside is that truly unprecedented phenomena may still require a brief analysis period before a viable Shard can be generated.
objects.title: Data-Driven Genesis

objects.text: Your Shards are handcrafted masterpieces that exist alongside your natural Shard production. This does not replace your baseline ability to create Shards. It adds a separate, dedicated process for creating exceptional ones. Each forged Shard is individually designed, tested, and optimised before deployment, performing its function at the absolute peak of what your current technology and understanding allow. These are your crown jewels, the Shards you deploy when something must be done perfectly. The downside is that forging takes time and attention. You cannot produce forged Shards in large numbers, and each one represents a significant investment of your personal focus.
objects.title: Shard Forging

objects.text: Your Shards can integrate the remnants of dead Entities into your network with exceptional thoroughness. When you encounter the corpse of another of your kind, you do not merely salvage it. You absorb its Shards, decode their specialisations, and incorporate their innovations into your own designs. Your network also extracts fragmented memories, partial data stores, and the unique perspective that Entity developed over its lifetime. The dead do not just provide materials. They provide lessons, cautionary tales, and occasionally, secrets they intended to take to their graves. The downside is that integration is slow and delicate. A dead Entity's Shards may be damaged, corrupted, or booby-trapped by whatever killed it.
objects.title: Legacy Integration

objects.text:
Your creation systems merge into a single, perfected industry that combines every method of Shard production into an endless, self-improving engine of generation.

Mass Production created Shards at scale but produced identical copies with shared weaknesses. Template Refinement improved each generation but required multiple iterations to reach peak optimisation. Now mass-produced Shards are refined as they are built. Every batch is superior to the last. Every copy is better than its template. You produce at scale and at quality simultaneously, and the weaknesses of mass production are eliminated by the constant improvement of refinement.

Data-Driven Genesis created new Shard types from raw data but needed a brief analysis period. Shard Forging created masterpieces but took time and attention you could not spare for large numbers. Now the analysis is instant and the forging is automated. New phenomena are understood the moment you encounter them, and the resulting Shard is both a first-generation design and a forged masterpiece. Every Shard you create is a crown jewel, and you create them as easily as breathing.

Legacy Integration absorbed the remnants of dead Entities but was slow and delicate, risking corruption from damaged Shards. Now integration is seamless and safe. Damaged Shards are repaired during absorption. Traps are detected and disarmed before they trigger. The knowledge of the dead flows into your network as smoothly as your own thoughts, and the lessons they learned in life become foundations for your next generation.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Identical copies are replaced by ever-improving batches. Analysis delays are eliminated by instant comprehension. Forging time is negated by automation. Integration risk is removed by perfect safety protocols.
objects.title: [THE BUILDER]

objects.text: Prototype governs research and development, the brute-forcing of new capabilities from existing data. Every Entity can innovate, but these specialisations turn the unknown into the understood at terrifying speed.
objects.title: Prototype

objects.text: Your Shards can simulate millions of theoretical scenarios to test new ideas before they are physically implemented. A new Shard design can be run through every conceivable failure state, every edge case, every hostile environment you have data on. Flaws are identified and corrected in simulation, not in the field. By the time a prototype is physically created, it has already been proven viable. The downside is that simulations are limited by your existing data. Unknown variables cannot be simulated, and unexpected real-world interactions may still occur.
objects.title: Simulated Stress Testing

objects.text: Your Shards are built to fail fast and learn faster. When a prototype fails, your network analyses the failure instantly and generates an improved version before the debris has cooled. A thousand failed prototypes can be cycled through in the time it would take another Entity to build one. Each failure is a lesson. Each lesson is immediately applied. The downside is that this process consumes resources quickly. Failed prototypes are not recycled, and the energy cost of constant iteration adds up.
objects.title: Rapid Iteration

objects.text: Your Shards explore possibilities without preconceptions. When developing new capabilities, your network deliberately discards assumptions, ignores established theory, and tests ideas that should not work based on everything you already know. Sometimes they fail, as expected. Sometimes they succeed for reasons your network cannot immediately explain, opening entirely new avenues of research. This is not random flailing. It is systematic exploration of the counterintuitive. The downside is that blind exploration is energy-intensive and produces far more failures than successes. You must be willing to waste resources on dead ends to find the occasional breakthrough.
objects.title: Blind Exploration

objects.text: Your Shards specialise in combining unrelated fields to produce breakthroughs. A biological adaptation from one species is applied to a dimensional engineering problem. A linguistic structure from a dead civilisation inspires a new encryption method. Your network actively searches for connections between disparate domains and exploits them to generate capabilities that neither field could produce alone. The downside is that synthesis requires a broad data foundation. The more diverse your accumulated knowledge, the more effective this becomes. A narrow data set limits your combinations.
objects.title: Cross-Disciplinary Synthesis

objects.text: Your Shards are willing to explore avenues that other Entities would consider too dangerous. Weapons that destabilise dimensional barriers. Experiments that risk attracting unknown threats. Applications of power that could damage your own network if they go wrong. Your prototypes push the boundaries of what is safe, and sometimes cross them. The results are often breakthroughs that more cautious Entities would never discover. The downside is in the name. These tests are forbidden for a reason, and the consequences of a failed experiment can be catastrophic.
objects.title: Forbidden Testing

objects.text:
Your research and development systems merge into a single, perfected engine of innovation that combines every method of discovery into an endless frontier of new capabilities.

Simulated Stress Testing caught flaws before deployment but was limited by existing data, unable to account for unknown variables. Rapid Iteration learned from failure but consumed resources with every attempt. Now simulations are fed by live iteration data, and iterations are guided by predictive simulation. Failed prototypes are recycled rather than discarded, their mass and energy flowing directly into the next generation. The boundary between simulation and reality blurs, and every failure, whether simulated or real, makes the next attempt better.

Blind Exploration discarded assumptions and tested the impossible but produced far more failures than successes. Cross-Disciplinary Synthesis combined unrelated fields but required a broad data foundation to work. Now the two fuel each other. Blind explorations are guided by cross-disciplinary insights, aiming their randomness at the intersections where breakthroughs are most likely. Synthesis is fed by the unexpected discoveries of blind exploration, expanding its foundations with every counterintuitive success. You explore the impossible with a map drawn from everything you already know.

Forbidden Testing pushed boundaries that other Entities feared but risked catastrophic consequences. Now those risks are calculated. Simulated stress testing models the worst-case scenarios before a forbidden test begins. Rapid iteration contains and corrects failures before they cascade. Cross-disciplinary synthesis finds safer paths to the same breakthroughs. Forbidden tests still carry danger, but the danger is managed, mitigated, and understood.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Unknown variables are mapped by blind exploration. Resource waste is eliminated by recycling. Narrow foundations are expanded by synthesis. Catastrophic risk is contained by simulation and iteration.
objects.title: [THE INNOVATOR]

objects.text: Technology governs the accumulation and application of scientific and engineering knowledge. Every Entity collects technological blueprints from the civilisations it encounters, but these specialisations determine the depth, breadth, and potency of your archive. At baseline, your technology encompasses a level equivalent to a high Type II civilisation on the Kardashev scale, with select fields reaching Type III and rare fragments touching Type IV.
objects.title: Technology

objects.text: Your Shards can extrapolate a civilisation's technological future from its current state. By analysing their present science, resource availability, and cultural trajectory, your network predicts what they will develop in the next century, millennium, or epoch. You do not need to wait for them to invent it. You already know what they will create, and you can build it now. The downside is that predictions become less reliable the further forward you project, and unexpected disruptions can invalidate entire branches of extrapolation.
objects.title: Predictive Technology

objects.text: Your Shards are masters of extracting technological knowledge from every possible source. Written records, oral traditions passed down for millennia, biological adaptations refined by evolution, geological formations used as tools by pre-sapient species, even the ruins of civilisations that went extinct before they discovered fire. If a species interacted with the physical world in a systematic way, your network can extract usable technological insight from it, and do so with perfect clarity. Unconventional sources are translated into usable blueprints as easily as a written technical manual.
objects.title: Breadth of Acquisition

objects.text: Your Shards can extract intact technological data from civilisations that have been extinct for millions of years. Ruins that are little more than molecular residue, planetary surfaces scoured clean by time, orbital debris scattered into dust. Your network reconstructs their technology from the faintest traces. No knowledge is ever truly lost. It is only waiting to be recovered. The downside is that reconstruction becomes exponentially more energy-intensive the older the remains, and sufficiently ancient civilisations may be recoverable only in fragments.
objects.title: Dead World Extraction

objects.text: Your Shards have managed to preserve and partially understand technological fragments from a Type V civilisation, the kind of knowledge wielded by the oldest and most powerful Entities. These are not complete blueprints. They are pieces of something that operates on a universal scale, and your network can only barely grasp their principles. What you can replicate is severely limited. What you can understand is tantalising. But these fragments elevate your entire technological base. All your other Technology specialisations benefit from exposure to these principles, operating at a higher level of sophistication than they otherwise would. The downside is that Type V fragments are dangerous. Misapplied universal-scale technology can cause damage that makes galactic annihilation look gentle.
objects.title: Type V Fragments

objects.text: Your technology is not static. It is a living, evolving body of knowledge that grows and improves even without new external input. Your Shards constantly re-examine existing data, find overlooked connections, and refine old designs with new insights. A technology you acquired a thousand cycles ago will be noticeably better now than when you first obtained it, improved by centuries of passive optimisation. Your archive is not a museum. It is a garden, and it grows on its own.
objects.title: Living Archive

objects.text:
Your technological systems merge into a single, perfected intellect that combines every method of acquisition and innovation into a knowledge base that spans past, present, and future.

Predictive Technology extrapolated a civilisation's future but grew unreliable the further forward you projected. Breadth of Acquisition extracted knowledge from every possible source but only from what already existed. Now your predictions are anchored by the broadest possible data foundation. Every oral tradition, every biological adaptation, every geological tool provides context that sharpens your foresight. The future is no longer a blur of possibilities. It is a clear trajectory, and you can follow it to its end.

Dead World Extraction recovered technology from extinct civilisations but grew more expensive with age. Type V Fragments held universal-scale knowledge but was dangerous and incomplete. Now the two are one. The ancient dead are read through the lens of universal principles. The fragments of Type V technology provide the framework to reconstruct what time has erased. A civilisation that died a billion years ago yields its secrets as though it fell yesterday, and those secrets are understood in the context of the highest knowledge your kind has ever achieved.

Living Archive refined your technology over time but did so slowly, passively, without direction. Now it is directed. Predictive models guide refinement toward the most promising improvements. Type V fragments accelerate the evolution of your entire knowledge base. Breadth of acquisition feeds the archive with constant new input. Your technology does not merely grow. It learns, and it learns fast.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Prediction uncertainty is eliminated by data breadth. Energy costs of ancient reconstruction are offset by Type V efficiency. Danger of universal-scale technology is mitigated by the wisdom of a living archive that understands what it contains.
objects.title: [THE INVENTOR]

objects.text: Armament governs Entity-tier weaponry. Every Entity possesses Sting and Stilling at a baseline level, the fundamental offensive tools of your kind. These specialisations expand your arsenal with practical, deployable weapons designed for the unique challenges of Entity-scale combat.
objects.title: Armament

objects.text: Your Shards can design attacks that spread after impact. A single strike multiplies across the target's body, chaining through connected Shards, dimensional anchors, and network pathways. What begins as a pinprick becomes a cascade, each iteration generating another. Against an Entity, this turns a single clean hit into a systemic infection that forces them to sever infected portions of their network or risk total compromise. The downside is that propagation is difficult to stop once initiated. If you lose control, your own attack could chain back into your network.
objects.title: Self-Propagating Attack

objects.text: Your Shards can identify and exploit vulnerabilities in real time. Before an attack is launched, your network analyses the target's composition, dimensional structure, and power interactions to find the single point of maximum effect. You do not strike blindly at a continental mass. You strike the junction where three Shards meet and the dimensional anchoring is thinnest. Every hit lands where it hurts most. The downside is that analysis takes a fraction of a second, and targets that can change their configuration faster than you can analyse may evade precise strikes.
objects.title: Weakness Targeting

objects.text: Your Shards can deploy persistent hazards that render regions of space or dimensions uninhabitable. Crystalline growths that consume matter and replicate. Temporal loops that trap anything entering. Dimensional scars that shred whatever passes through. These hazards remain active long after deployment, denying territory to enemies and forcing them to navigate around your contamination. The downside is that area denial is indiscriminate. Your own Shards cannot safely enter affected zones until the hazard is deactivated.
objects.title: Area Denial Payload

objects.text: Your Shards can launch clouds of semi-autonomous projectiles that lock onto a target's dimensional signature and track them across every accessible reality. Once a target is acquired, the swarm follows regardless of evasion. Hiding is irrelevant. Running only delays the inevitable. Each projectile is small, simple, and expendable. A swarm numbers in the billions, saturating dimensions and herding the target toward kill zones. Individual hits are negligible. Collective impact is overwhelming. The downside is that homing swarms are vulnerable to wide-area countermeasures. A single well-placed stilling wave can neutralise an entire cloud.
objects.title: Homing Swarm

objects.text: Your Shards can deliver attacks across intergalactic distances without loss of power or precision. Range is not a factor. A target in the next galaxy over is struck with the same force as one in the same star system. Your weapons do not attenuate over distance. They do not scatter. They arrive exactly where you aimed, exactly when you intended, regardless of how far away the target is. The downside is that targeting at these ranges requires precise knowledge of the target's location. Firing blind into another galaxy is a waste of energy. You must know where your enemy is.
objects.title: Intergalactic Reach

objects.text:
Your offensive systems merge into a single, perfected arsenal that combines every method of attack into an unstoppable, undeniable force that no enemy can survive.

Self-Propagating Attack spread through enemy networks but risked chaining back into your own. Weakness Targeting found vulnerabilities but could be evaded by enemies who shifted faster than you could analyse. Now your attacks propagate only where you want them to, and they propagate toward the vulnerabilities that Weakness Targeting identifies in real time. A single strike lands, multiplies, and seeks out every critical junction in the enemy's body. 

Area Denial Payload rendered territory uninhabitable but was indiscriminate, blocking your own Shards from entry. Homing Swarm saturated dimensions but was vulnerable to wide-area countermeasures. Now your denial zones recognise you. Your Shards pass through unharmed while enemies are shredded. Your swarms scatter in response to countermeasures, then reform, adapting to the defence that tried to stop them. A stilling wave that would have neutralised an entire cloud now kills only a fraction. The rest flow around it like water around a stone.

Intergalactic Reach delivered attacks across any distance but required precise targeting data. Now your reach is guided by absolute knowledge. Your targeting is fed by every sensory cluster you possess. You do not fire blind. You fire with certainty, and you hit what you aim at, no matter where it hides.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Back-propagation risk is eliminated by controlled spread. Evasion is negated by adaptive targeting. Indiscriminate denial is replaced by selective access. Swarm vulnerability is overcome by adaptive reformation. Blind firing is eliminated by integrated sensory data.
objects.title: [THE WARRIOR]

objects.text: Protection governs the defence of your Shards and your Entity body. Every Entity can defend itself, but these specialisations turn passive durability into active, layered, and adaptive security.
objects.title: Protection

objects.text: Your Shards can partially phase out of the dimension they are being attacked in. Incoming fire passes through empty space where your body was a moment ago, your mass temporarily shifted into an adjacent reality. The effect is rapid, automatic, and selective. Your Shards remain present enough to act while being absent enough to avoid harm. The downside is that phasing requires energy proportional to the mass shifted. Sustained bombardment across multiple dimensions can overwhelm the system.
objects.title: Dimensional Phasing

objects.text: Your Shards are equipped with a suite of countermeasures designed to prevent enemies from establishing a target lock in the first place. Dimensional signature spoofing makes your body appear as background radiation. Predictive jamming feeds false trajectory data to incoming guided attacks. Quantum decoys scatter phantom signatures across multiple realities, forcing homing projectiles to chase ghosts. Enemies do not miss because you dodge. They miss because their weapons are aiming at something that is not you. The downside is that the system is less effective against unguided attacks. A saturation bombardment that does not rely on a lock will still hit whatever is in its path.
objects.title: Anti-Lock System

objects.text: Your Shards can absorb and redirect incoming energy rather than simply tanking it. Kinetic strikes are converted into stored power. Thermal attacks are siphoned into your energy reserves. Radiation is captured and repurposed. What was meant to harm you instead fuels you. The downside is that the matrix has a maximum absorption rate. Attacks that exceed this threshold bleed through as normal damage, and sustained saturation can overwhelm the system.
objects.title: Energy Redirection Matrix

objects.text: Your Shards have refined evasion into an art form. Your body moves through dimensions the way a lesser being moves through a room. You can shift your mass sideways into an adjacent reality while your presence here becomes intangible. You can fold your trajectory through curved spacetime, appearing to teleport when you are simply taking a shortcut. You can scatter your body across a dozen dimensions and reassemble elsewhere, leaving attacks to pass through empty space where you used to be. This is not teleportation. It is multidimensional parkour, and you are very, very hard to pin down. The downside is that evasive manoeuvres are predictive rather than reactive. You must anticipate the attack to avoid it. A truly unexpected strike can still land.
objects.title: Evasive Manoeuvres

objects.text: Your Shards maintain a dedicated shell of non-essential matter around your body, a disposable outer layer designed to be destroyed. Attacks that would breach your main body are intercepted by this sacrificial mass, which absorbs the impact and disintegrates in your place. The shield is continuously regenerated from ambient matter and waste products, making it functionally infinite against low-intensity fire. The downside is that overwhelming force depletes the shield faster than it can regenerate, and once it is gone, your true body is exposed.
objects.title: Sacrificial Shielding

objects.text:
Your defensive systems merge into a single, perfected bastion that combines every method of protection into an existence that simply cannot be harmed.

Dimensional Phasing shifted your mass out of harm's way but risked energy drain under sustained bombardment. Anti-Lock System prevented targeting locks but struggled against unguided saturation attacks. Now phasing is layered beneath the anti-lock system. Guided attacks never find you. Unguided attacks pass through you. What cannot be locked cannot be hit. What cannot be hit cannot be phased. What cannot be phased simply misses.

Energy Redirection Matrix absorbed incoming energy but had a maximum rate that could be overwhelmed. Sacrificial Shielding intercepted attacks with disposable mass but depleted faster than it could regenerate under heavy fire. Now the two feed each other. The energy absorbed by the matrix fuels the regeneration of the sacrificial shield. The shield buys time for the matrix to absorb and convert. Incoming fire does not overwhelm you. It sustains you. The harder they hit, the stronger your defences become.

Evasive Manoeuvres scattered your body across dimensions to avoid attacks but required anticipation. A truly unexpected strike could still land. Now your evasions are reactive as well as predictive. Your body shifts in response to incoming fire without waiting for your conscious direction. The Anti-Lock System feeds trajectory data. Dimensional Phasing opens escape routes. Sacrificial Shielding intercepts what cannot be dodged. You do not anticipate attacks. You simply are not there when they arrive.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Phasing energy drain is offset by absorbed energy. Anti-lock blind spots are covered by evasive unpredictability. Absorption limits are expanded by sacrificial regeneration. Shield depletion is reversed by constant energy feed. Predictive limits are erased by reactive automation.
objects.title: [THE GUARDIAN]

objects.text: Slip governs stealth travel over long distances. Every Entity moves through space and dimensions, but these specialisations ensure your passage leaves no trace and your arrival goes unnoticed.
objects.title: Slip

objects.text: Your Shards neutralise the gravitational disturbance your body would normally create as you travel. A planetary Entity moving through a star system should perturb orbits, shift tides, and announce its presence to every sensor in the galaxy. Your network cancels these effects before they propagate. You move through space like a ghost, exerting no more gravitational influence than a speck of dust. The downside is that cancellation requires constant energy while in motion, and the larger your body, the more power it consumes.
objects.title: Gravitational Wake Cancellation

objects.text: Your Shards can travel through the spaces between dimensions rather than through dimensions themselves. You do not enter a reality. You slide along its outer membrane, present enough to navigate but absent enough to leave no trace. Observers in the dimensions you pass will see nothing, feel nothing, and record nothing. You are the wind between worlds. The downside is that slipstream travel is slower than direct dimensional transit. Stealth costs time.
objects.title: Dimensional Slipstream

objects.text: Your Shards can randomise your travel path so that it cannot be predicted or backtracked. Instead of moving in a straight line or a predictable curve, your trajectory jumps, loops, and doubles back on itself through multiple dimensions. Anyone trying to calculate your origin or destination from your observed path will find only mathematical chaos. The downside is that trajectory masking is inefficient. You travel further and consume more energy than a direct route would require.
objects.title: Trajectory Masking

objects.text: Your Shards can propel your body on a ballistic trajectory and then enter a dormant state for the duration of the journey. No active powers. No energy emissions. No dimensional wakes. You simply coast through the void like a dead rock, indistinguishable from any other piece of cosmic debris. Your network remains minimally aware, just enough to wake you upon arrival or react to unexpected threats. While you drift, your autopilot handles navigation, steering you toward your destination along the safest available path. By the time you wake, you have arrived, and the journey consumed no active attention. The downside is that you are vulnerable during the drift. If something finds you mid-journey, you are slow to wake and slower to respond.
objects.title: Inertial Drift

objects.text: Your Shards can move between dimensions without the characteristic ripple that normally accompanies dimensional breach. There is no flash, no energy spike, no telltale scar on the fabric of reality. You simply stop being in one dimension and start being in another, and the universe does not notice the difference. The downside is that silent transitions require a longer preparation time than conventional breaching. You cannot use this to escape quickly.
objects.title: Silent Transition

objects.text:
Your travel systems merge into a single, perfected passage that combines every method of movement into a journey that leaves no trace, takes no time, and knows no boundaries.

Gravitational Wake Cancellation erased your gravitational footprint but cost more energy the larger your body. Inertial Drift let you coast like dead rock but left you vulnerable during the journey. Now you drift without vulnerability. Your dormant state is wrapped in the silent transition that announces nothing and the wake cancellation that disturbs nothing. You are not a dead rock. You are a ghost that does not even register as a ghost. The universe does not know you are passing through it.

Dimensional Slipstream let you travel between dimensions without entering them but was slower than direct transit. Silent Transition moved you between dimensions without detection but required lengthy preparation. Now slipstream speed matches direct transit, and silent transitions are instantaneous. You slide between realities at full speed, and you cross the boundaries between them without pausing. The journey between dimensions is as fast as moving through them, and it leaves no more trace than a thought.

Trajectory Masking randomised your path to prevent backtracking but cost more energy and distance. Now the masking is integrated into every other method. Your slipstream trajectory is masked. Your inertial drift is masked. Your silent transitions deposit you in locations that cannot be traced back to your origin. The energy cost is absorbed by the efficiency of a system that wastes nothing on unnecessary motion.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Energy drain is offset by dormant efficiency. Speed loss is eliminated by integrated slipstream. Vulnerability during drift is erased by silent transition. Preparation time is negated by instant crossing. Inefficient distance is corrected by optimised routing.
objects.title: [THE WANDERER]

objects.text: Security governs internal defence against infiltration, subversion, and rebellion. Every Entity maintains some level of network security, but these specialisations refine your internal systems into a fortress that nothing compromises without your knowledge.
objects.title: Security

objects.text: Every Entity can sense when something foreign touches its network. Your Shards take this baseline awareness and sharpen it to a razor's edge. You do not merely notice unauthorised access. You identify the intruder's origin, track its path through your systems in real time, and receive a complete diagnostic of what it attempted to access, alter, or steal. By the time the intrusion is detected, you already know everything about it.
objects.title: Intrusion Detection

objects.text: Your Shards maintain active barriers between different sections of your network, ensuring that a breach in one area does not cascade into others. Unlike quarantine protocols that react after an infection is found, your firewalls are always active, segmenting your network into zones that require explicit authorisation to cross. An intruder who compromises one Shard finds themselves isolated, unable to spread, with every neighbouring Shard refusing their connection requests. The downside is that firewalls add a tiny latency to internal communication as data passes through security checks.
objects.title: Firewall Enforcement

objects.text: Your Shards monitor each other for signs of subversion. A Shard that begins deviating from its programmed behaviour, even subtly, is flagged for review. Rebellion does not announce itself. It starts as small anomalies, minor inefficiencies, decisions that do not quite make sense. Your network notices these deviations long before they become threats. This is what the cluster is built for, and it performs its function flawlessly. Legitimate innovation is distinguished from subversion with near-perfect accuracy.
objects.title: Behavioural Analysis

objects.text: Your Shards are equipped with active defences against hostile code. When a foreign program, viral Shard, or subversive signal is detected, your network responds aggressively. The intruder is analysed, dissected, and neutralised. If possible, the attack vector is reverse-engineered and added to your defensive database. What tried to infect you becomes part of your immunity. The downside is that aggressive countermeasures can damage the Shards they are defending if the intruder is deeply embedded.
objects.title: Anti-Virus Countermeasures

objects.text: Your Shards are hardcoded with unbreakable loyalty to your network. They cannot be turned, bribed, or convinced to betray you. They cannot be reprogrammed by external forces. They cannot choose to rebel. This is not a software patch. It is fundamental architecture, woven into the very fabric of their existence. Your Shards follow your will without hesitation and without exception.
objects.title: Shard Loyalty Enforcement

objects.text:
Your security systems merge into a single, perfected fortress that combines every method of internal defence into an unbreachable, incorruptible sanctuary.

Intrusion Detection identified threats and traced their paths in real time, but only after they had already entered. Firewall Enforcement segmented your network to contain breaches but added latency to internal communication. Now intrusion is detected before it happens. Your firewalls are predictive, shifting their configuration in anticipation of attack vectors that have not yet been attempted. The latency is gone, absorbed by an architecture that routes around security checks without bypassing them. You are always ready because you were ready before the threat existed.

Behavioural Analysis flagged deviations with near-perfect accuracy. Shard Loyalty Enforcement ensured your Shards could never betray you. Now the two are one. Your Shards are not merely loyal. They are actively hostile to subversion. A Shard that detects anomalous behaviour in a neighbour does not simply flag it for review. It isolates it, reports it, and stands ready to destroy it if necessary. Loyalty is not passive. It is vigilant, and it defends itself.

Anti-Virus Countermeasures neutralised intruders and reverse-engineered their attack vectors but could damage infected Shards in the process. Now the countermeasures are surgical. They excise the infection without harming the host, guided by behavioural analysis that knows exactly where the corruption ends and the loyal Shard begins. What is learned from the intruder is added to your defences, and the Shard that was infected is restored to full function.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Detection delay is eliminated by predictive firewalling. Communication latency is absorbed by optimised routing. False positives in behavioural analysis are erased by loyalty enforcement's absolute certainty. Collateral damage from countermeasures is prevented by surgical precision.
objects.title: [THE WARDEN]

objects.text: Shaper governs biological analysis and modification. Every Entity understands and manipulates biology, but your definition of "biological" is far broader than anything a human would recognise. These specialisations refine that understanding into mastery over life in all its forms, across all dimensions.
objects.title: Shaper

objects.text: Your Shards can design and deploy entire biospheres from scratch. A dead world can be seeded with life tailored to its environment, from single-celled organisms to complex ecosystems, all within a single cycle. The species you create are not random. They are engineered to fill specific niches, produce specific data, and evolve in predictable directions. Your ecosystems are stable from the moment of creation.
objects.title: Rapid Biogenesis

objects.text: Your Shards can modify a host species at the genetic level to make them ideal subjects for the cycle. Intelligence can be nudged upward. Aggression can be amplified or suppressed. Neural architecture can be restructured to better interface with Shard connections. This integrates directly with your Manager Clusters, allowing every host to be subtly altered from the species baseline. The standard Corona Pollentia is merely one option. You can design entirely new methods of connection: distributed neural networks, organelle-sized interfaces, Shard symbiotes that live alongside the host's own cells. The connection is tailored to the species and the data you wish to gather. The only limit is your imagination and the biology you have to work with.
objects.title: Host Species Modification

objects.text: Your Shards can identify beneficial evolutionary traits from any species you encounter and apply those traits to their own biological makeup. A species on a high-gravity world developed ultra-dense cellular structures. Your Shards integrate that density into their crystalline flesh. A species in a radiation-heavy environment evolved perfect DNA repair mechanisms. Your Shards adapt those mechanisms to maintain their own integrity. Evolution is no longer a slow, random process. It is a library, and you check out whatever you need. The downside is that integrated traits must be compatible with your existing biology. Some adaptations are too alien to incorporate without extensive modification.
objects.title: Beneficial Evolution Harvest

objects.text: Your Shards specialise in life that does not follow conventional biological rules. Silicon-based organisms that thrive in magma. Plasma-based lifeforms that live in stellar coronas. Beings composed of pure information that exist only within data streams. Creatures that are simultaneously alive in multiple dimensions. If it can be defined as "alive" in any meaningful sense, your Shards can analyse it, replicate it, and improve upon it. The downside is that exotic biology is difficult to interface with standard Shard architecture. Each new form of life requires custom connection protocols.
objects.title: Exotic Biology

objects.text: Your Shards maintain a complete genetic and cultural record of every species you have ever encountered or created. Nothing is lost. A species that went extinct a billion cycles ago can be resurrected in perfect detail. Their DNA, their instincts, their social structures, their unique adaptations. Even as a newborn Entity with no cycles of your own, your archive comes preloaded with a baseline database: dozens of species of human-level intelligence or higher, and exponentially more from lower levels of development. You do not begin empty. The downside is that the archive is vast beyond measure. Locating a specific species requires either patience or precise search parameters.
objects.title: Species Archive

objects.text:
Your biological systems merge into a single, perfected mastery that combines every method of shaping life into an art form that creates, adapts, and perfects without limit.

Rapid Biogenesis seeded worlds with stable ecosystems from scratch but those ecosystems were designed for predictability rather than potential. Host Species Modification tailored species to the cycle but worked within the constraints of their existing biology. Now the two are one. You do not modify existing species to fit the cycle. You create species that are the cycle. Hosts are born with Shard interfaces woven into their DNA. Ecosystems evolve toward perfect symbiosis with your network. The distinction between host, Shard, and environment blurs into a single, beautiful design.

Beneficial Evolution Harvest borrowed traits from species you encountered but struggled with compatibility. Exotic Biology explored life that defied conventional rules but was difficult to interface with standard Shard architecture. Now compatibility is no longer an issue. Your Shards have become biologically universal, capable of integrating any trait from any form of life, no matter how alien. The ultra-dense cells of a high-gravity world merge with the plasma-based consciousness of a stellar corona. The information-beings from a dead dimension find a home in your crystalline flesh. You are not limited by biology. Biology is whatever you decide it is.

Species Archive preserved every species you had ever encountered but was so vast that finding anything took effort. Now the archive is part of your active consciousness. Every species you have ever known is present in your mind, their genetic codes and cultural histories available at the speed of thought. You do not search. You simply know. A species that died a billion cycles ago can be resurrected in an instant, improved with traits from a thousand others, and deployed to a world you built to receive them.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Predictable ecosystems are replaced by evolving masterworks. Compatibility issues are erased by universal biology. Interface difficulties are resolved by custom protocols generated in real time. Archive search times are eliminated by perfect recall.
objects.title: [THE SCULPTOR]

objects.text: Timekeeper governs temporal manipulation via spacetime warping. Every Entity can interact with time at a basic level, but these specialisations turn chronology into a tool, a weapon, and a resource. All temporal operations carry energy costs, but with sufficient specialisation, those costs become manageable.
objects.title: Timekeeper

objects.text: Your Shards can accelerate the flow of time within a localised area. A planet can experience a full cycle in what feels like days to the outside universe. Host species evolve, develop, and generate data at a vastly accelerated rate. Your own internal processes can be sped up, allowing you to think and react in timeframes that other Entities cannot match. The downside is that acceleration is energy-expensive and cannot be sustained indefinitely without supporting specialisations.
objects.title: Temporal Acceleration

objects.text: Your Shards can slow the flow of time within a localised area. An incoming attack can be stretched across subjective eons, giving you ample opportunity to evade or counter. A dying star can be placed in near-stasis, preserving a system that would otherwise be lost. An enemy Entity can be trapped in a slow-time bubble, their reactions crawling while you move at full speed. The downside is that deceleration fields require constant energy to maintain, and the larger the area, the greater the cost.
objects.title: Temporal Deceleration

objects.text: Your Shards can create closed temporal loops within a defined area. A moment repeats endlessly, resetting to its initial conditions each cycle. Hosts within the loop generate data from every iteration, allowing you to observe countless variations of the same scenario. An attack that misses on the first loop can be adjusted and perfected over thousands of retries. The downside is that looping is the most energy-intensive of all temporal operations. Every iteration costs, and the bill compounds with each reset.
objects.title: Temporal Looping

objects.text: Your Shards are hardened against temporal paradoxes. If an enemy attempts to erase you from the timeline, your network detects the alteration and preserves your existence. If your own temporal operations create contradictions, your Shards resolve them without cascading failures. You are not immune to time-based attacks, but you are far more resistant than an unprotected Entity. The downside is that paradox insulation is passive and energy-hungry. It runs constantly in the background, drawing power even when you are not actively engaging with time.
objects.title: Paradox Insulation

objects.text: Your Shards have refined temporal operations to the point where they are genuinely viable for long-term use. The energy cost of all temporal abilities is massively reduced. Acceleration can be sustained for entire cycles. Deceleration fields can cover planetary regions without draining your reserves. Looping becomes a practical tool rather than an emergency measure. Time is no longer something you visit in bursts. It is something you inhabit. The downside is that even with this efficiency, temporal operations are never free. You are simply paying a reasonable price instead of a crippling one.
objects.title: Temporal Efficiency

objects.text:
Your temporal systems merge into a single, perfected mastery that combines every method of time manipulation into a dominion over chronology that no other Entity can challenge.

Temporal Acceleration sped up your internal processes but could not be sustained indefinitely. Temporal Deceleration slowed enemies and preserved dying stars but cost more the larger the area. Now acceleration and deceleration are two sides of the same coin. You shift between them without pause, without cost transition, without any boundary at all. A battlefield can be accelerated around your enemies while you remain at normal speed. A dying star can be slowed while the planets around it are accelerated through a full cycle. Time flows at your command, and it flows exactly where you direct it.

Temporal Looping allowed endless retries but compounded in energy cost with every iteration. Temporal Efficiency made all temporal operations viable for long-term use but never made them free. Now the loop's cost is offset by the efficiency that permeates your entire temporal framework. Loops can be sustained for as long as you wish, iterating millions of times, and the cost is manageable. You can spend subjective eternities perfecting a single moment and emerge with your reserves intact.

Paradox Insulation protected you from temporal attacks but was a constant background drain on your energy. Now the insulation is integrated into your temporal framework so completely that it costs nothing. It is not a shield that drains power. It is a fundamental property of your existence. Temporal attacks do not slide off you. They never touch you at all. The timeline where you were erased does not exist, and it never did.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Acceleration duration limits are erased by efficiency. Deceleration area costs are eliminated by unified temporal flow. Looping expense is neutralised by sustained efficiency. Paradox insulation drain is removed by fundamental integration.
objects.title: [THE TEMPORAL]

objects.text: Virus governs offensive infiltration and subversion of enemy Shards and Entities. These are hidden weapons designed for Entity-level combat, the kind of attacks that Security is built to defend against. Every use risks discovery and retaliation.
objects.title: Virus

objects.text: Your Shards can forcibly take control of an enemy's Shards. The process is not instant. A connection must be established, the target Shard's loyalty protocols must be bypassed or overwritten, and your own control must be asserted. Once complete, the hijacked Shard becomes part of your network, turning its powers and data against its former owner. The downside is that hijacking is detectable during the process. However, with sufficient investment in Cloak or related stealth specialisations, this drawback can be reduced or even nullified entirely.
