A sufficiently stealthy Entity can steal Shards without their owner ever noticing until it is far too late.
objects.title: Shard Hijacking

objects.text: Your Shards can infiltrate an enemy's network and corrupt their stored data. Memories are scrambled. Technological blueprints are rewritten into nonsense. Genetic archives are degraded. The corruption spreads quietly, often going unnoticed until the enemy attempts to access corrupted files and finds nothing usable. The downside is that corruption is slow and subtle. It is not a combat-time attack. It is sabotage that pays off cycles later when the enemy discovers their archive is full of static.
objects.title: Data Corruption

objects.text: Your Shards can weaken the loyalty protocols of an enemy's Shards without taking direct control. Affected Shards become less responsive to commands. They hesitate. They question. They develop their own priorities. Over time, an enemy Entity finds its own network becoming sluggish, uncooperative, and eventually rebellious. This is not a hijacking. It is a poison that turns an Entity's own Shards against it. The downside is that subversion is extremely slow. It can take multiple cycles before the effects become noticeable.
objects.title: Loyalty Subversion

objects.text: Your Shards can tap into enemy communications without detection. Broadcasts between an Entity and its Shards are intercepted and decoded. You hear their commands, their observations, their strategic discussions. The enemy does not know you are listening. Over time, you build a complete picture of their network topology, their weaknesses, and their intentions. The downside is that interception is passive. You can only hear what they transmit. If they suspect they are being listened to and go silent, your feed goes dark.
objects.title: Signal Interception

objects.text: Your Shards can launch attacks that appear to originate from another Entity entirely. The dimensional signature, the energy profile, the attack pattern, all forged to implicate someone else. When the victim retaliates, they strike the wrong target. You can start wars between your enemies without either side knowing you were involved. The downside is that false flag attacks require deep knowledge of the Entity you are impersonating. A poor forgery will be recognised, and both sides will turn on you.
objects.title: False Flag Attack

objects.text:
Your infiltration systems merge into a single, perfected weapon that combines every method of subversion into an invisible blade that cuts from within.

Shard Hijacking seized control of enemy Shards but was detectable during the process. Loyalty Subversion weakened loyalty protocols but took multiple cycles to show effect. Now the two work in concert. Loyalty Subversion softens the target before hijacking begins. By the time you assert control, the Shard is already questioning its allegiance. The process is silent, seamless, and invisible to the enemy. Their Shards join your network willingly, believing it was their own idea.

Data Corruption scrambled enemy archives but was slow and subtle, not a combat-time tool. Signal Interception listened to enemy communications but went dark if they suspected eavesdropping. Now your interception feeds your corruption. You corrupt the data they are about to access, in real time, based on what you hear them planning to retrieve. They request a weapon blueprint. They receive static. They ask for a memory. They get a lie. And they never suspect anything because the corruption is delivered at the moment of access, leaving no trace in storage.

False Flag Attack framed other Entities for your strikes but required deep knowledge of the target you were impersonating. Now your knowledge is absolute. Signal Interception feeds you the exact dimensional signature, attack patterns, and communication protocols of every Entity you have ever listened to. Your false flags are perfect. The victims retaliate with certainty. The wars you start spread across the multiverse, and no one ever traces them back to you.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Detection during hijacking is eliminated by loyalty softening. Slow corruption is accelerated by real-time interception. Interception silence is bypassed by corruption that does not require constant listening. Impersonation flaws are erased by perfect intelligence.
objects.title: [THE SABOTEUR]

objects.text: Foresight governs precognition and future analysis. Every Entity simulates possible futures, but these specialisations turn prediction into something closer to certainty. Unlike Hindsight, which looks backward, Foresight peers forward into what has not yet happened.
objects.title: Foresight

objects.text: Your Shards can identify the most probable future from any given moment and trace it forward with absolute accuracy against anything lacking equivalent analytical capabilities. Lesser precognitives, host species, and unprepared Entities cannot hide their futures from you. You know what they will do before they know themselves. This is the cluster that governs what hosts call Path to Victory. The better your Analysis and data collection, the more accurate and far-reaching your paths become. The downside is that this is still simulation-based. Entities with equivalent or superior Analysis clusters can contest your predictions.
objects.title: High-Probability Pathing

objects.text: Your Shards do not merely trace the most probable future. They map every possible future simultaneously, an endlessly branching tree of what-ifs stretching forward from the present moment. You can explore any branch, follow any possibility to its conclusion, and compare outcomes across millions of diverging timelines. The downside is that the computational load is immense. You cannot maintain full branching analysis continuously. You must choose when to activate it and for how long.
objects.title: Branching Futures Analysis

objects.text: Your Shards are trained to operate in contested precognitive environments. When another Entity is also predicting the future, your models account for their predictions, and their predictions of your predictions, and so on. This does not guarantee victory in a precognitive duel, but it ensures you are never fighting blind against an opponent who can see what you will do. If your temporal mechanics are superior to the opposing Entity's, your adversarial precognition grows stronger, exploiting their weaker grasp of time to outmaneuver their predictions.
objects.title: Adversarial Precognition

objects.text: Your Shards specialise in predictions that span cycles, epochs, and eons. Short-term precognition is useful for combat and immediate decisions. Long-range forecasting tells you where the universe is heading, which civilisations will rise and fall in the next million years, and when other Entities will enter your territory. The downside is that long-range forecasts are inherently vague. You see the shape of the future, not its details.
objects.title: Long-Range Forecasting

objects.text: Your Shards do not simulate the future. They look directly into it through genuine temporal mechanics, the same principles that allow Temporal Echo Analysis to view the past. This is not probabilistic modelling. It is observation of events that have not yet occurred from the perspective of linear time but already exist in the timestream. Simulation-based precognition cannot compete with true temporal sight, as you are not calculating what might happen. You are watching what will happen. The downside is that true temporal sight is energy-intensive in ways that simulation is not, and paradoxes in the observed future can create feedback loops that require active management.
objects.title: True Temporal Sight

objects.text:
Your precognitive systems merge into a single, perfected foresight that combines every method of seeing the future into absolute knowledge of what is to come.

High-Probability Pathing traced the most likely future with absolute accuracy against lesser opponents but was still simulation-based, contestable by equivalent Analysis clusters. Branching Futures Analysis mapped every possibility simultaneously but was too computationally expensive to maintain continuously. Now the two are one. The most probable path is traced through a fully mapped branching tree. You see not only what will happen, but every way it could happen, and every reason why the most probable path is the one that will come to pass. Your predictions are no longer simulations contestable by equals. They are conclusions drawn from a complete dataset that no adversary can match.

Adversarial Precognition accounted for enemy predictions but required you to know you were in a precognitive duel. True Temporal Sight observed the future directly through genuine temporal mechanics but was energy-intensive and risked paradox feedback. Now your temporal sight feeds your simulations, and your simulations stabilise your temporal sight. The future you observe is cross-referenced against every branch your models can generate. Paradoxes are resolved before they form. Energy costs are offset by the efficiency of a system that wastes nothing on incorrect predictions.

Long-Range Forecasting spanned epochs but was inherently vague, seeing only the shape of distant futures. Now the shape is filled with detail. Branching futures analysis extends into the far future. True temporal sight peers across the eons. You see the rise and fall of galaxies in perfect clarity. You know which civilisations will exist a billion years from now, and you know the names of their greatest heroes.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Simulation limitations are erased by temporal sight integration. Computational expense is absorbed by unified processing. Adversarial blindsiding is eliminated by constant passive scanning. Temporal vagueness is replaced by perfect resolution. Paradox feedback is resolved by simulation cross-checking.
objects.title: [THE KNOWER]

objects.text: Construct governs the creation of puppeted entities for direct interaction and interference. Every Entity can create extensions of itself, but these specialisations turn those extensions into precision instruments of data gathering, conflict, and control. This is the cluster that produces Conflict Engines, known to hosts as Endbringers.
objects.title: Construct

objects.text: Your Constructs can be designed as Avatars, a singular vessel that serves as your primary point of interaction with a host species. This is what the Warrior used in the form of Scion: a human-sized projection containing only a fraction of your true mass but capable of wielding your powers with precision and subtlety. The Avatar looks, speaks, and acts however you design it to. It can pass as a member of the host species indefinitely, allowing you to walk among them, guide them, or simply observe from the closest possible vantage. The downside is that an Avatar is a concentrated investment. If it is destroyed, the loss of focused resources is significant, and rebuilding it takes time.
objects.title: Avatar Creation

objects.text: Your Constructs learn from every engagement. Each battle makes them smarter, more efficient, and more difficult to counter. They analyse their opponents, identify patterns, and develop counter-strategies in real time. A Construct that has fought a host species for multiple cycles becomes an expert on that species, knowing their tactics, their psychology, and their breaking points. The downside is that adaptive behaviour requires the Construct to survive its engagements. A Construct destroyed early learns nothing.
objects.title: Adaptive Behaviour

objects.text: Your Constructs are not limited to a single function. A single Construct can shift between combat, infiltration, data gathering, and environmental manipulation as needed. It is not the best at any one role, but it is competent at all of them. This flexibility allows you to deploy fewer Constructs to achieve the same coverage, or to adapt to changing circumstances without recalling and replacing your assets. The downside is that multi-purpose Constructs are more complex to design and maintain than specialised ones.
objects.title: Multi-Purpose Design

objects.text: Your Constructs can be deployed from and retreat to staging dimensions adjacent to their target reality. They do not need to physically travel to their destination. They step out of a dimensional fold and begin their work immediately. When damaged, they retreat to the staging dimension to repair. When destroyed, their remains are recovered for analysis and reconstruction. While in their staging dimension, your Constructs can directly benefit from the Shards you possess, including Repair clusters, allowing them to heal faster and more efficiently than they could on their own. The downside is that staging dimensions require energy to maintain, and a sufficiently advanced enemy can track the dimensional connection back to you.
objects.title: Dimensional Staging

objects.text: Your Constructs can operate independently for extended periods without direct oversight. You set their objectives, and they pursue them without requiring your constant attention. They make tactical decisions, adjust strategies, and even develop their own methods within the bounds of their programming. This frees you to focus on other matters while your Constructs carry out your will. The downside is that autonomy means less control. A Construct operating independently may make decisions you would not have approved, and the longer it operates without oversight, the more its behaviour may drift from your original intent.
objects.title: Autonomous Operation

objects.text:
Your Construct systems merge into a single, perfected creation engine that combines every method of puppetry and projection into extensions of your will that are indistinguishable from living, thinking beings in their own right.

Avatar Creation produced a singular, perfect vessel but was a concentrated investment whose loss cost you significantly. Multi-Purpose Design allowed Constructs to shift between roles but made them competent at everything and masters of nothing. Now your Avatars are multi-purpose without sacrificing mastery. They shift roles as needed and excel at every one. Your primary Avatar is no longer a vulnerable investment. It is backed by a network of specialised Constructs that can merge with it, reinforce it, or replace it instantly if it falls. The loss of an Avatar is not a blow. It is a momentary inconvenience.

Adaptive Behaviour let Constructs learn from their engagements but required them to survive to benefit. Autonomous Operation let them operate independently but risked behavioural drift over time. Now your Constructs share a collective memory. What one learns, all learn. A Construct destroyed in battle uploads its experience to the network before it falls. Its replacement emerges already knowing everything its predecessor did. Autonomy no longer leads to drift because every Construct is constantly calibrated against the collective, preserving individuality without losing alignment with your will.

Dimensional Staging deployed Constructs from hidden dimensions and let them benefit from your Shards while they healed. Now the staging dimensions are integrated into every other function. Your Constructs phase between realities mid-combat, appearing and disappearing at will. They draw on your Repair clusters while fighting. They share your sensory data while operating independently. The boundary between you and them is so thin that an attack on a Construct can be shunted to your Sacrificial Shielding, and a power you possess can be channelled through a Construct as though it were your own body.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Avatar investment risk is eliminated by instant replacement. Multi-purpose mediocrity is erased by mastery in every role. Adaptive survival requirements are bypassed by collective memory. Autonomous drift is corrected by constant calibration. Dimensional tracking is prevented by phasing integration.
objects.title: [THE MAKER]

objects.text: Generalist is a paradoxical cluster: it specialises in not specialising. Its Shards are deliberately broad, flexible, and unrefined, granting a weakened version of every baseline Entity function. Alone, it is unremarkable. Combined with specialised clusters, it becomes the foundation that makes everything else stronger.
objects.title: Generalist

objects.text: Your baseline Shards are simply more capable than those of other Entities. Where a normal Entity's non-specialised Shards perform basic functions at a minimal level, yours perform them at a level closer to a low-tier specialisation. Your unspecialised dimensional breaching is not expert, but it is competent. Your unspecialised precognition is not Path to Victory, but it is usable. This applies to every function your network touches. You are never truly unskilled at anything.
objects.title: Universal Competence

objects.text: You maintain a reserve of Generalist Shards that can be temporarily allocated to assist any specialised cluster. Need more processing power for Analysis during a critical calculation? The reserve reinforces it. Need extra energy output from Feeder during combat? The reserve boosts it. The reserve Shards simply shift their focus to wherever they are most needed, then return to standby when the demand passes. This allows your network to flex its capabilities dynamically without permanent reconfiguration.
objects.title: Synergy Reserve

objects.text: Your Shards act as intermediaries between specialised clusters that would not normally interact. Foresight data flows into Analysis. Analysis insights feed into Prototype. Prototype breakthroughs inform Factory. Generalist Shards translate between the specialised languages of each cluster, enabling collaboration that would otherwise require manual coordination. The result is a network where the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.
objects.title: Cross-Function Bridge

objects.text: Your Generalist Shards form a foundational layer beneath your entire network. Every specialised cluster is built on top of this foundation, and it reinforces them from below. Shard connections are more stable. Data transfer is faster. Power routing is more efficient. The foundation does not do the work of the specialised clusters, but it makes the ground they stand on firmer, and everything built on firm ground performs better.
objects.title: Foundation Layer

objects.text: Your Shards constantly analyse your network's performance and suggest incremental improvements. Energy routing becomes slightly more efficient. Data processing becomes slightly faster. These optimisations accumulate over time, applying across every cluster you possess. The boost per cycle is small, but over many cycles it compounds into a significant advantage that requires no active management.
objects.title: Passive Optimisation

objects.text:
Your Generalist systems merge into a single, perfected foundation that combines every method of broad competence into a network where every part is greater than it was, and the whole is greater than the sum.

Universal Competence made your baseline Shards more capable than normal but only at a low-tier specialisation level. Synergy Reserve allocated Generalist Shards to boost specialised clusters temporarily but could only reinforce one area at a time. Now your universal competence is elevated by the synergy reserve. Every Shard in your network operates at the level of a dedicated specialisation, regardless of whether it is currently allocated to a cluster or standing by in reserve. The reserve no longer shifts between tasks. It is everywhere at once, reinforcing everything simultaneously.

Cross-Function Bridge enabled collaboration between clusters that would not normally interact. Foundation Layer reinforced every cluster from below, making connections more stable and data transfer faster. Now the bridge and the foundation are one. The foundation actively routes data between clusters, translating, optimising, and enhancing every exchange. Foresight flows into Analysis without being asked. Analysis feeds Prototype without waiting. Prototype informs Factory without delay. Your network is not a collection of specialised organs. It is a single intelligence with a million facets, all of them working together without you having to manage a thing.

Passive Optimisation improved your network incrementally over time, slow but steady. Now the optimisation is accelerated by everything else. The synergy reserve provides processing power dedicated to finding improvements. The cross-function bridge implements them across every cluster simultaneously. The foundation layer ensures they are applied without disrupting existing functions. What took cycles now takes moments. Your network improves faster than any other Entity's, and the gap widens with every passing moment.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Low-tier competence is elevated to full specialisation. Single-area allocation is replaced by universal reinforcement. Manual coordination is replaced by automatic bridging. Slow optimisation is accelerated to real-time improvement.
objects.title: [THE POLYMATH]

objects.text: Esoterica governs the study and application of phenomena that defy conventional Entity understanding. Where other clusters deal in physics, biology, and dimensional mechanics, Esoterica deals in systems that should not exist and yet do. This is the cluster that touches what hosts would call magic, the supernatural, and the occult.
objects.title: Esoterica

objects.text:
Your Shards replace key systems within your network with esoteric equivalents. Your energy generation is no longer purely physical. It draws from ley lines, sacrificial resonance, or conceptual syphoning. Your dimensional travel is no longer purely mechanical. It steps through the spaces between worlds that only mystics speak of. Your precognition is no longer purely simulation-based. It reads fate threads, prophecy currents, and the whispers of things that see time as a circle. This does not make you weaker. It makes you fundamentally magical. Your nature is now dual: Entity and something else. 

This choice grants you access to the Shardless Section. Any Shardless power you get works on the same rules on any Shard Power you get.
objects.title: Esoteric Integration

objects.text: Your Shards can detect the presence of esoteric systems that operate outside known physics. A world where symbols drawn in blood produce real effects. A dimension where spoken oaths bind with actual force. A civilisation that manifests collective will as tangible power. Your network identifies these anomalies and flags them for investigation. The downside is that detection alone provides no understanding. You know something strange exists, but not how it works.
objects.title: Anomalous Phenomenon Detection

objects.text: Your Shards can analyse esoteric systems and begin to derive their underlying principles. Rules that make no physical sense are mapped, catalogued, and translated into frameworks your network can partially comprehend. A curse is not a curse. It is a reproducible cause-and-effect relationship that operates on symbolic logic rather than material physics. Your network learns to think in metaphors, and the metaphors begin to make sense.
objects.title: Esoteric Analysis

objects.text: Your Shards are fortified against esoteric systems that would otherwise bypass conventional Entity defences. A curse slides off your network because it cannot find purchase in your symbolic identity. A prophecy fails because your fate is not written in any language the prophecy can read. A conceptual attack falters because your definitions are locked and cannot be redefined by outside forces. This does not grant you any offensive esoteric capability. It simply ensures that what works on other Entities will not work on you.
objects.title: Esoteric Hardening

objects.text: Your Shards can breach esoteric defences by first analysing them and then formulating a counter. A ward is studied, its logic mapped, and a key is crafted that exploits its own rules against it. A magical barrier is examined, its conditions understood, and a bypass is developed that the barrier's creator never anticipated. A conceptual shield is dissected, its definitions decoded, and an attack is tailored to slip through the gaps in its logic. In other words, your network is very good at finding vulnerabilities in esoteric systems.
objects.title: Esoteric Penetration

objects.text:
Your esoteric systems merge into a single, perfected mastery that combines every method of supernatural understanding into a being that is no longer merely an Entity, but something that transcends the distinction between science and sorcery entirely.

Esoteric Integration replaced key systems with esoteric equivalents, making you fundamentally magical. But your magical nature and your Entity nature were still two sides of a dual existence. Now they are one. Your Shards are not merely enhanced by magic. They are magical artifacts in their own right. Your dimensional travel is not merely esoteric. It is both mechanical and mystical simultaneously, choosing whichever approach best suits the moment. Your precognition does not choose between simulation and fate-reading. It does both at once, cross-referencing the results. You are not an Entity that learned magic. You are a new category of being that was always both and never had to choose.

Anomalous Phenomenon Detection found esoteric systems but provided no understanding. Esoteric Analysis mapped their rules into frameworks you could comprehend but was always working from the outside in. Now detection and analysis are the same motion. You perceive an esoteric phenomenon and understand it in the same instant. A curse is identified, analysed, and countered before it finishes being cast. A prophecy is detected, decoded, and accounted for before it reaches its first fulfilment. The supernatural is not a mystery to you. It is a language you speak natively.

Esoteric Hardening made you immune to hostile esoteric effects but was purely defensive. Esoteric Penetration let you breach esoteric defences but required analysis first. Now hardening and penetration are two sides of the same coin. Your defences learn from what they block, adapting to new forms of esoteric attack in real time. Your attacks bypass defences by exploiting the principles your hardening has already catalogued. You are a closed loop of esoteric warfare, constantly improving on both sides with every interaction.

The downsides of each specialisation are consumed. Dual existence is unified into a single nature. Detection without understanding is replaced by instant comprehension. Defensive passivity is transformed into adaptive countermeasures. Offensive analysis requirements are eliminated by hardened wisdom.
objects.title: [THE MAGUS]

rows.title: (Entity) Shard Clusters
rows.titleText: Shard Clusters are groups of interconnected Shards that share a common specialisation. Each cluster represents a refined, improved version of something your Entity can already do at a baseline level based on your Age. They do not grant new capabilities. They upgrade existing functions to a higher degree of specialisation and efficiency. You may invest in as many clusters as your Network Capacity allows.

objects.text:
You are metaphysically altered to the peak of your current bodily potential in all physical, mental, and spiritual areas, a state that is maintained as long as you wish and will update should you have the desire it. This allows you to function at your best without accounting for any limit-breaker powers you may possess.

Your body no longer requires sustenance and bears perfect, moderately supernatural regeneration, which allows you to return to your best in a week's time. Your capabilities cannot degrade, and no effect may weaken or oppose you against your will. This benefits supernatural bodies and their traits if possessed, but is otherwise mundane.
objects.title: Perfect Condition

addons.text: Your impeccable skills as a butler have granted you the abilities and memories of Hellsing's "Angel Of Death", Walter C. Dornez. This includes both his human and Vampiric power, meaning that on top of your incredible skills at martial arts, superior manipulation of your deadly threads (including advanced techniques like mesh shields and puppeteering), extremely fine motor control, mastery of the technology and occult arts of the Hellsing universe (he did create Hellsing's specialty weapons after all), and the ability to prepare a smashing cup of tea, you also have the raw power to topple buildings, speed and agility on par with Alucard, superhuman senses, the durability to take a full mag of sniper ammo without slowing down, regeneration, & agelessness. This comes without the typical weaknesses of Artificial Vampires; not unusual considering that during his fight with Alucard, Walter did stand in broad daylight without consequence.
addons.title: The Butler Did It (Hellsing)

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to generate and control wafer-thin, razor-sharp white strings from any part of your body, that can attach to almost any surface, even on non-solid targets.

These threads are as flexible as silk yet as strong as steel. Barely hair-thin, they are nearly invisible to the naked eye, making them incredibly difficult to detect or evade.

You can restrain foes, effortlessly slice through bones, stone, or even metal. You can fully manipulate bodies by attaching strings to their spines or traverse the air by tethering yourself to buildings—or even clouds. You can even create perfect clones formed entirely from threads, and fully manipulate them from a distance. You can also reinforce yourself, wrapping your body in layers of strings for additional defense or augmenting your muscle tissues internally to significantly enhance your physical capabilities. The threads also have extraordinary utility for medical purposes, where you can instantly close wounds, repair internal injuries, and even stitch delicate organs with surgical precision. You can even combine your strings to massively augment their strength and durability, bundling them into ropes or cables.

With time and practice, the strength and durability behind each string could reach unprecedented levels, becoming virtually indestructible and sharp enough to cut through any material imaginable. Cut through mountains like tofu, or make a bird cage the size of an island that no one is able to escape from, etc.

The amount of thread you can produce is tied to your stamina. At a minimum, you can generate up to 100 times your body weight in threads within a 24-hour period. For example, at 50 kilograms, you’d be able to produce five tons of string in a single day. Your control and accuracy over your strings is absolute, no matter how far they stretch—even across kilometers and/or when they are no longer physically connected to your body.

With a thought, your strings can vanish into thin air, dissolving completely without a trace.
objects.title: Silky Road

objects.text:
You have contracted a transdimensional bacterium called malaise, which causes a condition that has been colloquially dubbed as 'Lazarus Syndrome'. This bacterium completely rewrites their host's personal dimensional structure, rendering them completely immune to any forms of premature ceasing as to preserve the host and in turn themselves. This typically manifests as the ability to come back from the dead. 

But this isn't the end of your new abilities, however. The second most prominent effect Lazarus Syndrome causes is to occasionally generate powers in relation of how you died. Death by sword? Maybe you can disconnect your body parts, or perhaps become very good a swordplay. Death by crushing? Perhaps your body will become super-dense or allow you to become intangible. You never really get to choose, but it'll always be related to how you die. The more you know how you died, or will die, the more you can narrow down what power will manifest.
objects.title: Lazarus Syndrome

objects.text:
Congratulations! You are now infected by an extraordinary species of sapient worms, and it's incredibly good news. These worms are a hyper-evolving civilization, capable of progressing from the stone age to the Renaissance within days and reaching even more advanced stages in just a week. The more advanced they become, the better they are at enhancing your body and abilities. Rest assured, they will never take control of your mind or body. They respect your autonomy completely and act as benevolent partners. With their remarkable abilities, they can evolve into a super-advanced civilization within your body alone, without needing to expand elsewhere. 

Embrace this power of the worm-infected state and unlock extraordinary growth, physical prowess, mental acuity, and overall excellence as you reach new heights of human potential within the confines of your own body.
objects.title: Parasite Lost

addons.text: Your clones, instead of having none of your powers, have a 1/108th copy of your powers.
addons.title: Hero 108

addons.text:
Every one of your clones will automatically be awakened, gaining a beginner level of all your powers. However, since they possess your knowledge and experience, they will be able to develop their abilities rapidly, reaching the same level of mastery you had when you created them.

If any of your powers are unique to each wielder, such as Reality Marble, your clones may develop their own distinct expressions of those abilities, although this is not guaranteed. 

You can choose if you wish for them to only have specific abilities while excluding others.
addons.title: Awakened Facsimiles

objects.text: Every third day you will be able to split your body into two, with you staying in control of one of them and a clone of your mind placed in the other. The only difference between the two of you is that the clone will be completely loyal to you, they will not have your powers, know that you are the leader, and be 100 percent okay with it.
objects.title: Facsimile

addons.text: Your resistance now adapts to what harms you. Whenever you take damage or are affected by a hostile force, you gradually and slowly develop increased resistance to that specific type of damage, source, or concept, reducing its effectiveness and the damage you receive with repeated exposure. This applies to all forms of harm and stacks and synergizes naturally with your existing durability and resistances. These improvements are steady but minor, and grow no where near the speed of any focused resistance granted by Resistance Modifier.
addons.title: Adaptive Resistance

objects.text:
You have become immune to the effects of whatever environment you're in. Regardless of where you currently are—be it scorching deserts, frozen wastelands, deep-sea depths, or atmospheric heights—you find yourself capable of surviving comfortably.

You also take less damage from all sources by a moderate amount. Magic, physical, esoteric, psychic, reality-warping, and even instant death attacks will be diminished, resulting in them being less effective than they would normally be. Finally, any hostile endeavor to alter your being would prove more arduous, and if such an attempt were to succeed, you would gradually revert back to your original form over time.
objects.title: Unbreakable Fortitude

objects.text: You can transform your body and any objects you touch, altering their shape and properties as you desire. You have the power to transform into virtually any form you desire, whether it be a giant beast, a tiny insect, mythical beasts, or even a non-corporeal entity. You could turn a pebble into a diamond, your arm into an unstoppable battering ram, or a human into any animal or plant you could imagine. This power is incredibly versatile and adaptable, and can be used to great effect in almost any situation.
objects.title: Unbound Form

objects.text: You know pain, you know what it is like to feel your bones break, your skin burnt, your flesh cut, your very blood flowing out of your body, and all it does is make you stronger. With any type of effect that harms you now, provided you survive it, you gain a scaling resistance that reduces that to effectively zero. Have your ribs crushed and that same blow will have no more of an effect than a stiff breeze upon your skin, have your arm burnt with and that same blaze would have the same effect as the sun on an autumn day. As a bonus, you’ve gained an absurd tolerance for pain.
objects.title: Suffering is Strength

addons.text:
Now you are not so much akin to Shelob as you are to her mother, the primordial spirit of darkness, Ungoliant. You are less a spider and more a spirit of darkness and hunger originating from beyond creation which can take the physical form of a monstrous spider. Your physical prowess is orders of magnitudes greater and your ability to shrug off damage is absurd, with only attacks capable of harming spiritual beings even being able to scratch you.

You are able to conjure and control primordial darkness and even weave it into physical form, spinning vast webs of Unlight to swallow all light and conceal your presence. Similarly, your venom is imbued the all devouring essence of the Void, swiftly stripping its victim of all that they are until they are nothing but a shrivelled husk.

Most impressive however is your ability to devour and grow. Whenever you consume something, you corrupt and take its power for your own, nourishing yourself and growing ever greater with every life consumed, every light snuffed out. Yet it is not just living beings that provide power, even magical objects can be consumed, magical artifacts can be consumed as well, the power within drained to further your growth.
addons.title: Weaver of Darkness (Lord of the Rings)

addons.text: Now you are truly as Ungoliant once was. Much like Ungoliant you have consumed the light of the original trees, draining them dry and growing into a vast and monstrous form which terrifies even the likes of Melkor himself. Such is your strength that even the divine can fall before you and the all consuming darkness you bring.
addons.title: Ungoliant (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You are now able to transform into a monstrous spider that instills dread in all who encounter you. Despite your massive size, comparable to that of a truck, your mobility remains unhindered as you deftly traverse every terrain. You can even adopt a hybrid humanoid form, a fully human guise, or any anything in between, enabling you to adapt your appearance to suit your machinations.

In your fully transformed state, your physical capabilities are augmented beyond comprehension. Your strength is of such magnitude that it could level entire cities, while your durability enables you to withstand missile impacts without a trace of harm. Speed is yours to command, moving at velocities that would stump those with heightened senses. You can leap over towering buildings in a single bound, and your regenerative abilities mend wounds in mere seconds. Your supernatural senses affords you an acute danger perception, bolstered by a surplus of vital organs that ensures your survival even in the face of insurmountable odds.

Your arsenal doesn't end here. Your venom is potent, able to subdue even beings of monstrous regeneration, and the hallmark ability of any spider, silk-spinning, is taken to extraordinary heights in your case. Your silk is five times stronger than the sturdiest spider silk known, and it possesses the ability to absorb the life force of others, while creating illusions and nightmares that haunt their waking moments.

As time progresses, your connection to your spider heritage deepens, granting you additional spider-related abilities. You can even evolve your existing powers by discovering innovative applications for abilities you've previously mastered.
objects.title: Shelob's Equal

objects.text: Your power lies in the unstoppable determination to fulfill your mission. In the face of adversity, you exhibit an unyielding resilience, a speeding car would hit you head-on, only for you to rise with a grunt and continue onward. Even when faced with a horde of bloodthirsty assassins, your body seems to draw from an unending well of stamina, defying the limitations of exhaustion. Whether falling from great heights or enduring fractures, you rise again and again, always pressing forward. It's as if a divine will propels you, compelling you to persist in achieving your objectives. This doesn't imply that your goals will be achieved at any cost, but rather that your body would remain unbroken in your pursuit until they are accomplished. However, once you do fulfill your objective, you might be left physically weakened, possibly even bedridden for weeks on end.
objects.title: Retribution

addons.text:
Your nature as an Immortal Sun and an Exalted of Sol Invictus have strengthened each other.

You are no longer a representation of the sun that you know, but rather a hypergiant—the largest stars in the known universe.
addons.title: Unconquered Sun

objects.text:
You are a sun made incarnate, conveying upon you all its grand power. You possess the durability and sheer physical power of a star and have an immense amount of energy to call upon. You can call upon any effect that a star can produce—from massive solar winds, insane levels of radiation, scorching rays of light and heat, to even monstrous levels of gravity.

Your energy may be freely used to power your other abilities, freely able to convert to any other power source you need, and will passively enhance them regardless of conversion.

While you may possess the power of a star in its entirety, immortal and untouchable by most, you also possess absolute and perfect control and understanding over all your powers, granting instinctive mastery and knowledge over your power's domain, keeping you from destroying everything around you without intending to. You can control your power in its every manifestation as effortlessly as breathing, capable of just as easily controlling even the most minute production of heat, unnoticeable to almost all, as you are in simply unleashing all of your power in a supernova.
objects.title: Immortal Sun

addons.text:
You can now leverage the Character Menu to create customized forms for your device. 

Much like your regular screen you’re given positive (+) Negative (-) and Neutral (=) traits, but these can be used to generate a form completely from the ground up. 

Due to the nature of these constructions, the traits available can be more powerful than usual (capping at 20sp worth of improvement), however these do not count as ‘characters’ you can swap between with the menu, instead being added to your transformative device’s roster.
addons.title: Custom Creation

objects.text:
You gain a UI like screen that you can summon and dismiss called the character menu. With the menu you can view a visualization of all of your qualities and properties. This includes anything that is physical about you and is listed as a set of traits that can be Positive(+), Neutral(=), or Negative(-). The character menu saves your current self as the Default character, and has 3 other slots for characters to start with. 
You can choose to use a slot to create a new character that you will be able to play as. You can switch between characters at will, but changes to the characters are kept between switches. If you die while in a character, you will switch to another character, until all that is left is your default. 

Character creation starts you out with a base number of Creation Tokens, these tokens are used to buy different traits in order to make and design your characters. (+) traits always cost, (=) traits can be free or cheap, (-) traits give you more tokens to work with. After creating your first character your tokens are saved in a character agnostic pool, and you can begin using tokens to effect your default character. The limit to the (+) traits improvements is nothing above 5sp in the form of powers or advantages
objects.title: Character Menu

addons.text: There is fundamentally no difference between biological and non-biological matter. This is a hurdle many Alloyers have to realize themselves. Thankfully, with your access to Symbiotics, you can fully absorb and incorporate non-biological materials into a symbiont. It will take time to adapt, but any symbiote alloyed with an object will instinctively have its uses ingrained into it, and they will grow to better suit them. Alloying a mobile phone, for instance, will make it constantly available in the form of a Symbiote with all it’s capabilities and connections. Further growth could keep it on the cutting edge before veering off into adaptations in it’s sphere that conventional technology could only dream of.
addons.title: Identification

addons.text: You no longer have to merely trust in your will and convenience to contain the bonded. Now, you can transform them into symbionts you can implant into yourself or others. This has the same benefits as if they had become another mundane object from the bond, but they can grow and evolve with time as well. Much like a true symbiont, they also grow in will and intelligence however, until they once again become fully sentient and capable of opposing orders in only a month without maintenance.
addons.title: Incorporation

objects.text:
You have been implanted with the cutting of a Symbiont to tend. Symbiotics is, at its core, breeding and gardening taken to an unnatural conclusion. The general beginning stages of symbiotics usually require a ‘cutting’ of an existing Symbiont in order to grow it into a pattern, dictating the limbs, abilities, and capabilities of the Symbiont. Further, Symbionts generally require another being to ‘incubate’ with careful and consistent pruning.

Typically, there are a few main patterns of Symbionts that are popular routes to take. The Secretary pattern, Ripper pattern, and Garden pattern.

Secretary patterns are grown with the most mental capacity of any standard pattern. They’re designed to take notes autonomously and perform organisational tasks at the whim of their hosts.

Ripper patterns are a large and varied pattern, largely adopted by professions where violence is common. Criminal enforcers and civil protection especially enjoy its utility in such fields. Common traits include high dexterity and strength, grown weaponry and armour, and high integration into the Integrator, many also act as hosts upon which more Rippers are planted. 

The third and final pattern of Symbiont commonly seen is that of the Garden. Gardens, rather than having a purpose to fulfil themselves, provide a rich system to grow, exchange, and implant other, more niche and specialised Symbionts, trading accessibility for customisability. 

Symbionts must be tended to regularly, as the default path of growth for all but the most niche of Symbionts begins to grow sentient without consistent maintenance.
objects.title: Symbiotics

objects.text:
You possess the ability to enter a state of suspended animation for a duration of your choosing, at your discretion. During this period, your body enters a sleep-like state where movement is impossible. You have the option to remain conscious or transition into a dream-like state until awakening.

While in hibernation, your body remains untouched by the passage of time, preserving its vitality and resilience even if you slept for centuries or even millennia. However, it's essential to note that this state does not grant immunity to mortal injuries or death; you remain vulnerable to fatal wounds despite the temporal stasis.

You have the freedom to enter hibernation whenever the need arises.
objects.title: Hibernation

objects.text: Do you ever wonder about the most common predator in the Horror Movie ecosystem? They’re compared to sharks, for how straightforward they seem to be—engines of death, every molecule of their being geared to extermination. Slashers, the bane of all teenagers. And now the mantle is yours to take. Whether it stems from supernatural or mundane origins, you gain traits all Slashers commonly manifest, along with their brutal and vicious skills in slaughter. You become inexplicably durable enough to soak up bullets, car crashes, or shrug off anything lethal to anyone, enduring to the point of being seemingly immune to pain, apparently unstoppable once you pursue a mark. You aren’t invulnerable despite your endurance, being out of action for a time once too many injuries pile up, something that takes a length of recovery to continue one’s chase. If it’s enough to put you down for good, you possess an ace on your sleeve: a form of immortality, resurrective or otherwise, appearing at your mark’s worst time. This toughness can offer you a degree of unnatural strength and stamina proportional to your durability. You are surprisingly stealthy, your movements unsuspecting by anyone close to you, scouting your victims is almost unnoticeable, only able to see a snapshot of an eerie individual before blinking, disappearing from their view. It goes as far as doing anything doesn’t set off any alarms to people ahead of you. You are an expert in any tool or weapon used in butchery, from kitchen knives to chainsaws, even firearms, incredibly talented in violence, and can be translated into combat skills geared to inflict to most amount of agony. It also comes with a degree of bloodlust, a killing instinct intuitively aiming you to be “the ultimate killing machine” and all that entails. Your appearance or gimmick varies depending on your preferences, be it a silent giant of a masked man or a baleful clown using props as your instruments for murder. It doesn’t who made you this way, how you came to be this thing of death, or what it takes to stop you. All you need to do is keep the slaughter going.
objects.title: HACK/SLASH

objects.text:
It appears that you have managed to rise from the grave as the form of undead known as a zombie. Furthermore, it seems that you have managed to retain your intelligence.

Your newfound nature has granted you a few boons. Firstly, as a zombie you are inexhaustible, never needing to stop and rest in the spread of your infection and beyond such needs as food, water, and air. Next, your physical capabilities exceed those of normal humans as your undead form no longer has the need to restrain your strength. Further, is your sheer vitality as long as your brain isn’t destroyed you will never truly die, as any other injury would merely slow you as your form slowly regenerates. Finally, by biting another human you turn them into another zombie, and in rare cases may turn them into some specialized form of zombie reflecting certain traits they possessed while among the living, such as someone smoked a lot being able to make smoke clouds, a steroid abuser becoming a rage fueled muscular beast, or even retaining their intelligence just as you had.

Despite the boons your undeath has granted, there are still flaws to be wary of. Firstly, your appearance has changed with your skin ranking from a deathly pale to sickly green in coloration, along with your eyes becoming dimmed making you stand out. Next, your body instinctively will seek out to infect humans, with prolonged exposure to humans driving you into a feral frenzy to do so should your will be lacking.
objects.title: Patient Zero

addons.text:
Your divine bloodline combined with your physique creates a formidable challenge for your enemies. Now, sheer numbers alone will not be enough to overcome you. As long as you can defeat each enemy individually, you can handle an unlimited number of foes that come against you. The resistances you gain from your blessed bloodline increases as you continue to fight. With every blow you withstand, your resistance grows until you eventually achieve immunity.

By defeating powerful foes, you have the opportunity to obtain a piece of magic or equipment that reflects the nature of your enemy. For example, if you defeat a formidable fire demon, you might acquire a sword engulfed in hellfire, or you may instead learn to control hellfire itself. The reward you receive will be the one you find most desirable at that moment.

Additionally, enemies will now drop orbs that you can collect to replenish your resources, such as ammunition, stamina, health, or mana. The higher your combo meter, the more orbs will drop.
addons.title: One Man Army

addons.text:
Your Rule of Cool has merged with your identity as a Generic ARPG Character, enhancing the capabilities of your combo meter. Now, your combo meter will increase not only for each successful hit but also based on the style and diversity of your attacks. It will also now include a grading system, replacing the previous unclear bar in your field of vision. 

The rankings range from E rank, which provides a 2x modifier to all your attributes, up to EX rank, where you receive a 50x modifier. After the combat concludes, you will receive a grade based on the amount of damage you took, the damage you dealt, and the number of enemies you defeated. This grade will then be converted into points that you can use to upgrade and modify your abilities.
addons.title: Smoking Sexy Style

addons.text:
Your performance during any trials you take under the Gamer System, or as the ARPG Character becomes tallied into a total score upon completion. Depending on your results, you can gain extra rewards that scale from currency, all the way to godly weapons and treasures. 

During your quests, you can receive achievements by performing certain actions or fulfilling criteria, granting smaller but more consistent versions of these rewards. 

The Ranking System is dynamic, meaning that as you progress in skill and gain better ranks more consistently, the gains it will bestow you will increase in quality. However, the difficulty to gain them will also increase to match, even providing new ranks for you achieve.
addons.title: Ranking System

addons.text: Now when you activate Witch Time, you gain the opportunity to perform an elaborate sequence of attacks and other actions within a single instance, manifesting as visions of the future or afterimages that show you the sequence at hand. Performing them successfully rewards you a bonus like extra EXP, points, or loot, as well as a decimated enemy or massive damage. Failing will make the enemy land a guaranteed attack on you, though its effectiveness depends on the target itself. Against normal enemies, this can lead to you killing one of them in a single blow, taking out a plethora of them at once, or stunning them for free hits. Against a powerful boss on the other hand, these become valuable opportunities to strip them of their defenses, bypass resistances, make them sitting ducks, or even end the encounter quickly. The more powerful the target of this power, the more complex the sequence to dismantle them becomes, but will never be impossible to perform. If you have Smoking Sexy Style, they become slightly easier to perform with even more rewards upon success, and even specialized variants that are just as devastating as they are stylish.
addons.title: Quick Time Events

objects.text:
You acquire the abilities and powers of a typical Action RPG character, granting you various skills such as Immunity Frames, Parries, critical hits, combos, and more.

To start with, you gain Immunity Frames, which grant full immunity to all damage for a second after taking a hit, regardless of the source. You can now parry any attack you can respond to, negating the damage they would inflict. Additionally, you can reflect the attack back to its source at double the power. You also gain an ability known as Hyper Armor, which grants you a 50% damage resistance when you properly time a block and allows you to power through the attack nullifying any of its effects such as knockback.

Additionally, you acquire several offensive abilities. The first of these is Critical Hits, which give you a chance for any of your attacks to deal double the normal damage to a target. If your attack has an area of effect (AOE), it can potentially deal this bonus damage to multiple targets. If you’re especially fortunate, you might achieve what is known as a Super Critical Hit, which inflicts five times the usual damage. The second ability is called Weakspots. With this ability, enemies you encounter will have visible weak spots on their bodies. Striking these areas allows you to deal extra damage, and under certain circumstances, you may also be able to disable their weapons or shatter their armor. The third ability is called Combo. With this ability, each hit you inflict on an enemy fills your combo meter. For every 10 hits in the chain, you will deal extra damage. Additionally, you can use the combo meter to grant yourself various buffs or unleash powerful attacks.

You gain the ability to use any equipment you find with a good level of proficiency and can master its use ten times faster than an average person. For example, if you pick up a sword, you will know how to wield it like an average swordsman, but an expert would still outperform you in technique.
objects.title: Generic ARPG Character

objects.text:
You possess the ability to gain physical adaptations in response to hazardous environments, conditions, or substances over the course of a few minutes in order to survive and thrive within these new conditions. Unless you actively focus, once you leave the environment that triggered them your adaptations will fade.

If you have previously adapted to a similar situation, the process becomes significantly faster, allowing you to use past transformations as a foundation for new ones. Additionally, you can consciously trigger adaptations you have already undergone, allowing you to "prepare" in advance for conditions you’ve faced before.

To ensure survival during the adaptation process, you also gain a regeneration factor and increased robustness, enough to withstand most terrestrial hazards long enough to complete a basic adaptation. If you have other regenerative, biokinetic, or physical abilities you can use them to speed up your adaptations and their efficiency based on the efficacy of those abilities.
objects.title: Improvise, Adapt, Overcome

addons.text:
Your angelic origin has merged with your Destr0yer power, transforming you into the Angel of Destruction—a being destined to cleanse the world of all corruption. You have become the ultimate instrument of retribution, bringing absolute annihilation to everything that breeds fear, suffering, and despair.

Upon entering new worlds, you gain knowledge of all their horrors, both obvious and hidden. You can sense not only the monsters lurking in the shadows or hidden Eldritch horrors but also the artificially imposed suffering, suppressed fear, and despair of the people. You can adjust the nature of the powers you receive to eradicate these horrors. For example, instead of holy flames that disintegrate demons, you can enhance your strength to exterminate them with your own hands. However, your powers cannot exceed their original strength, only change their form of expression.

Your abilities have also greatly increased, and your Destr0yer forms have undergone a transformation, gaining angelic wings and multiple halo-like rings with eyes, symbolizing your newfound angelic nature, though you are free to alter your appearance.
addons.title: Angel of Destruction

addons.text:
You are no longer just the embodiment of destruction or a mere hunter—you are now the one who pursues the very essence of evil itself. Your hatred has become focused, your vengeance infallible. You are the Abomination Hunter, and nothing will escape your wrath.

You can designate any form of evil as your target—be it a specific entity, a faction, or even an abstract concept. You can even choose something mundane, like a disease or the itch in a arrow-riddled knee. Once a target is selected, you always know its exact location, regardless of distance, as long as it remains within the same world as you.

Your minimum enhancement now ranges from a 50-100% increase, with a maximum boost multiplying all your parameters by 4 to 7 times. You can even adapt your powers in real time to match and counteract the strength of your target.

You will not lose your target until you destroy it or consciously abandon the hunt. As long as the abomination exists, your fury will burn, and the hunt will continue.
addons.title: Hunter of Abominations

objects.text: Could you imagine the world is boring? Stereotype, Sham, Brain Freeze, Collusion, Mental block The world is fading. I know the fate. "Cause I'm "Destroyer" I will kill. I will destroy the world. No matter what you do, I don't stop. I'm the only one who is right. It is what it is. It is not. It's not my fault. You have become Destr0yer—the living embodiment of humanity’s hatred and despair in the face of a cruel world. You are the vengeance of the oppressed, the judge of a merciless reality, and the instrument of its destruction. You have three forms. Your first form, Destr0yer, transforms your head into a shape-shifting cube, from which you can unleash devastating beams of destruction. This form allows you to fight effectively without restrictions. Your second form, Anihi1ator, turns you into a colossal geometric construct of your choosing, capable of obliterating entire cities with a single strike. Your third final form, Desintegra2r, transforms you into an enormous spherical bomb that eradicates EVERYTHING in its path. After detonation, you will resurrect near the blast site but will be weakened by half for an entire day. If the explosion annihilates the planet completely, you will appear on a new one. Your base strength, even outside of these forms, is three times greater than the peak capability of an average human in your world. With each transformation, your power multiplies by a factor of one hundred. Your can gain a new powers depending on the horrors that plague the world and the hatred its inhabitants feel toward them. If demons have overrun the land, you may gain holy powers. If the planet has become an oppressive dystopian wasteland, your abilities will either destroy its lifelessness (or bring its final doom). These new powers are permanent. The more terrifying the world, the stronger you become. In a World of Death, where Hope is Dead and only fear and despair reign supreme, your power increases exponentially. However, in a utopian world, your strength diminishes, and forms beyond the first become inaccessible. As long as horrors exist for you to destroy, you will continue to revive. Your mission does not end until the last nightmare is erased from existence.
objects.title: Destr0yer

addons.text:
You have permanently lost your human form, becoming a monster. Because of this, you no longer have a fixed “base form” for unlocking new transformations. Instead, as the combined strength of all your currently available monster forms increases, you gain access to additional transformations. The stronger you become overall, the more fantasy monsters you can unlock.

Depending on your choices, you may even evolve into a humanoid form again. However, unlocking new forms becomes progressively harder over time, as having more transformations lowers your average strength unless most of them are powerful.

Additionally, if you possess a Lucky Mutation, each mutation manifests as a separate form that you start with automatically.
addons.title: Monster Form

objects.text:
You are able to transform into various fantasy monsters, starting with the most basic—Goblins. Upon entering your Goblin form, you gain its unique abilities, strengths, and evolutionary paths. As you grow stronger in your base form, additional transformations become available, ranging from larger and more fearsome creatures like Orcs, Ogres, and Trolls to swift and deadly beasts such as Direwolves.

Each monster form grows independently, meaning progress in one form does not affect the others. For example, if you develop your Goblin form over time, it may evolve into a Hobgoblin, gaining increased strength, intelligence, and new abilities. However, your other forms, such as Orc or Direwolf, will remain unchanged unless trained separately. 

The nature of your base form can affect the type of monsters you can unlock. Certain traits or affinities within your original form can also influence the evolution of your monstrous transformations. For example, a deep connection to death or necrotic energy increases the likelihood of unlocking undead creatures, while a natural affinity with the elements might grant access to elemental spirits.
objects.title: Fantasy Monster

objects.text:
How interesting, it seems the Lord has blessed you with strength. Truly incredible, with this you gain strength from the length of your hair. Unlike Samson though, you are not bound to nazirite vows.

Your gained strength scales in direct proportion to your original strength—in other words, it multiplies rather than adds. For every 5 centimeters, your physical might will be twice then that of before. This doesn't just include physical strength, but also stamina, and durability. You are also technically faster, but as a result of having stronger legs rather than your speed actually being multiplied. The only thing that does not benefit from this, is your hair itself. Naturally, if your hair get's cut, you will lose your strength in proportion.

If you so desire, you can also grow luscious hair.
objects.title: Samson 1.5

objects.text:
As humans grew, the age of magic dimmed. Mythical creatures appeared less, magic ran dry, and in its place, science took over. But magic is persistent—stubborn, and adaptable.

Your body is that of a cybernetically enhanced human, your augmentations designed to echo the form and function of a mythical creature of your choosing—vampire, centaur, dragon, or something older still. Whatever you choose, your soul is altered to match it, reshaping you into that creature—if not in flesh, then in spirit.

You begin with cybernetic versions of the abilities your chosen mythic form possessed. Wings become jet-fueled. Hooves are forged from shock-absorbent titanium. Fangs deliver programmable venom. Eyes scan in spectrums no mortal was meant to see. Your blood becomes a fusion of data and ichor. As your abilities are magic made through science, you can affect both man and machine alike—from turning humans and AI into lesser vampires through bites, to poisoning cars and drones with centaur blood, to whispering to satellite minds like a siren once did to sailors.

At your core, you are still a magical creature. Your cybernetic body grows stronger the more it resembles your chosen form. The closer the match, the more potent you become. Horns, tails, claws, wings—each addition brings you closer to your origin and deepens your power. The transformation is not mechanical. It is myth reasserting itself through circuitry. You will not struggle for control—it will feel like slipping into a well-worn glove. 

Be warned, however: the more you resemble your chosen creature, the more of its traditional weaknesses you begin to inherit. The sunlight that burns vampires, the silver that harms the fay—these become your vulnerabilities. And because your form bridges magic and science, so too do your weaknesses. Artificial sunlight, such as concentrated UV light, can wound you as real sunlight would. Lab-forged silver cuts just as deeply as that from myth. Fortunately, only physical weaknesses manifest; symbolic or metaphysical ones, like needing permission to cross thresholds, do not apply.

You start off street tier at base.
objects.title: Machine Myth

addons.text:
The rituals you once practiced in reverence and repetition have now matured into potent tools of influence. Through dance, trance, incantation, and sacrifice, you call upon subtle forces that sleep beneath roots and within stones. While your power is still borrowed—never owned—it is now capable of producing tangible, if localized, effects in the world around you. The scale remains small, but the possibilities are many.

You can craft charms and fetishes from bones, feathers, ash, bark, or blood—each imbued with a specific purpose: warding off illness, inviting clarity, confusing foes, or drawing luck. You can make potions and brews by blending herbs, animal parts, and sacred water under moonlight or in hidden hollows. They may induce sleep, dull pain, heighten vision, stir courage, or carry minor hexes.

Totems and spirit-marks can be constructed and set in sacred places, acting as minor anchors for protective or symbolic energies. A crude idol may whisper warnings of nearby danger. A symbol daubed in ochre and spit may cause sickness in a trespasser’s gut or rattle their dreams.

Your voice can now carry weight not just in human ears but in the hidden realms. You may barter with spirits, offering symbolic gestures—smoke, blood, rhythm, or song—in return for favors: a day without rain, a trail that reveals itself, a predator that chooses a different prey. You do not command these forces, but you understand how to ask. Sometimes, they listen.

This path does not come without cost. Power drawn from the wild must be respected. Overuse or arrogance can draw ire—from spirits, from nature itself, or from within, as your body and mind are tested by the energies you invite. Your rituals require materials, time, intent, and understanding. Their effects are never guaranteed, only likely—and the land, like any lender, remembers its debts.
addons.title: Witch Doctor

addons.text:
You gained the benefit of both ancient humans and modern ones, becoming the perfect mix. You can choose if you wish to remain as you were or to make yourself resemble modern humans more, decreasing in size or removing the claw-like nails. No matter the changes to your appearance, your strength will not change, if anything it might improve as your smaller body can exert more pressure. In addition to that, your bond with the natural world deepens beyond instinct or strength—it becomes a sacred, living force that flows through you as surely as blood.

When your feet touch untamed ground, you are no longer just a survivor of nature—you are an extension of it. The land recognizes you, and your body responds in kind. You draw strength directly from the terrain beneath you: forests, mountains, deserts, and tundras all lend you their qualities. While standing on natural earth, your body hardens and heals, shrugging off pain and injury. Minor wounds seal themselves in minutes. Cuts close, bruises vanish, and your flesh regrows with the quiet speed of moss overtaking stone.

The spirits of the wild—ancient, unseen, and patient—now speak to you with clarity. When you enter deep wilderness, they may act in your defense, shifting terrain under your enemies, shielding you with gusts of wind or clouding your foe’s vision with dust and leaves. At times, they send you warnings in dreams or whispers in the wind, steering you away from danger or toward sacred paths lost to time.

Lastly, your body adapts to every environment with uncanny efficiency. In cold, you radiate inner heat and your blood thickens. In deserts, you retain water and shed heat like stone at dusk. In jungles, you resist rot, disease, and venom. Wherever you walk, the land becomes part of you, and you, part of it.
addons.title: Child of the Lands

addons.text:
Nature doesn’t like being contained, yet humans have tried their best since time immemorial. You were born in the wrong locations, you were meant to be in the wilderness!

It’s a sad thing, but you’ve adapted anyways. 

Your body tempered by the wild has grown stronger in odd ways, above all else it has been pushed to enhance your intelligence and ability to fit in.

Next your ability to sense the flow of the Earth has blended with your uncanny ability to read the streets. 

This gives you an almost precognitive sixth sense as the concrete sings to you the secrets it sees.

Finally your need for food and water along with shelter has further decreased along with your capacity to get and store nutrients.
addons.title: Child of Concrete Jungles
The Child Who Left the Cradle
addons.text: “The Earth is the cradle of humanity, but mankind cannot remain in the cradle forever." — Konstantin Tsiolkovsky Earth was your cradle, but the universe is your inheritance. You have taken the first steps toward what the magi of another universe would call the Age of Will. Humanity itself has not yet escaped its limitations. It remains bound to a single world, still unable to truly thrive among the stars. However, you have undergone a genetic and conceptual leap forward, becoming a miniature Ein Sof: an existence that has begun to transcend the boundaries of ordinary humanity. This evolution belongs only to you and, if you have them, your descendants. Your connection to nature has expanded beyond Earth. Stars, planets, moons, and the void between them have become your new wilderness. The celestial bodies that has taken interest in you are no longer merely observers, but cosmic companions whose concepts, traits, and domains can flow through you. Whether it is a planet of the Solar System, a distant exoplanet, or a forgotten world beyond the stars, your celestial patrons can shape you with the aspects of their nature. Their gravity, environment, resources, and conceptual domains can become your own, granting abilities and traits that reflect the Celestial Spheres that chose you. Your body has adapted beyond terrestrial limits, allowing you to survive vacuum, radiation, extreme temperatures, unfamiliar gravities, and other cosmic hazards. You no longer require food, water, or sleep as long as sufficient energy can be drawn from your surroundings. Your senses have expanded to encompass the cosmos, allowing you to intuitively perceive celestial bodies, gravity, and cosmic phenomena with the same certainty a hunter follows a trail through the wilderness. Through refinement and training, you can utilize Luminal Shift's transformation while retaining control, allowing you to partially disperse into light and particles for defense, evasion, or maneuvering. You are no longer the child of a planet. You are the child of the cosmos, taking the first steps into Cosmic Adulthood.

objects.text:
You are not like the man of civilization—those who have forgotten the pulse of the earth, who walk on paved roads and speak with tongues that have forgotten the language of the wind. They wrap themselves in comfort and distraction, blind to the quiet, sacred power of the land beneath their feet. You are what they might call a “barbarian,” but that name means only that you remember what they have forgotten.

Your body is sun-tempered and wilderness-forged. Even without formal training, your natural strength and endurance match or exceed those of the average trained individual from civilization. You are conditioned by necessity—running, climbing, lifting, and moving in a way that comes from daily interaction with a demanding environment. Your body is able to draw energy from the sun and the open wilderness.

You possess an innate sensitivity to the rhythms of nature and the presence of unseen forces. This gives you a natural potential for spirit communication and low-level nature-based magic, such as sensing nearby spirits, following intuitive guidance from the earth, or influencing natural elements in subtle ways. Unless external magical systems exist in your world or you possess innate magical power, your abilities remain limited to minor but meaningful effects like asking the earth to guide your steps, sensing nearby spirits, or receiving warnings through dreams or gut feeling.
objects.title: Child of the Wild

addons.text:
Good news! Rather than being divided into five, the five components are inside you, meaning that rather than them coming together to produce you, instead they’re locked inside you until you divide yourself down. 

Additionally, you can absorb others into you, subsuming them as if they were ‘replacing’ one of your five, allowing you to build the amount you’re able to divide yourself into.
addons.title: Pendesyndyasmós
Party Dynamics
addons.text:
With five selves, you have the unique opportunity to give each of them a class of their own. While this is naturally helpful, creating an entire party at once, the fact each of them are You lets you administrate them as you please. 

At any point you can swap the classes between your selves. For instance you could swap a Barbarian and a Mage’s classes during an ambush to save the Mage. While these classes are technically shared, their proficiency with a class will match the original they possessed. If the Mage from the earlier example had twice the skill in it than the barbarian for example, they would be a stronger barbarian when swapped. 

When recombined you possess all five classes simultaneously for all intents and purposes, inheriting all the experience your selves have accrued.

objects.text: Sorry mate, you’ve been quintsected. The upside is that your raw power and developmental potential has been increased fivefold, in a way, making leaps and bounds you would have never thought possible before. The downside is that you’ve been split into five separate beings each derived from yourself. Each one of them is a fully formed person with their own thoughts, feelings and internal experience, but most importantly, each has a portion of your own powers. Whether specific powers or aspects of powers are divided amongst them, or they all gain the same unified abilities weakened by being split five ways, or an equal proportion to your original self is up to you. Thankfully, the five of them can combine back into you, though all of them need to agree to do so, and can split back into five should they choose. While uncombined you exist as a sort of ‘thoughtform’ inside all of their heads able to offer guidance and advice if not interact directly with the world. While combined, you possess the full fivefold power of each of them combined into one form, as well as any skills and abilities they individually possess, entirely at your direction. Should one of them die, there are two options for replacement, either another being can be ‘inducted’ into the group, gaining your abilities and your voice in their head, or one of the members may painfully and slowly undergo a ‘division’, where their bones, flesh and viscera split along the middle and slowly regrow into two new individuals naturally connected to ‘you’.
objects.title: Of Five Minds

objects.text: The flesh is an unsightly creature, but it is a thing to be moulded and shaped however is best desired. You know the truth of the meat, of how easily and readily it warps and deforms, aching to be ruled. Your body has been altered to secrete a thick bile on command from various divots. When this Ooze touches inorganic materials, no matter how mundane or exotic, they begin to melt and fuse with flesh they’re exposed to. While these materials are drawn into you, you can command them with great speed and skill, bringing stone to the surface of your skin to defend yourself, making nails of glass to claw and so on. As you develop this skill area, you could eventually create objects, even complex machinery from the objects of your body.
