Notably, there’s no fundamental difference between ‘organic’ matter and ‘inorganic’ matter, in essence giving you limitless access to bone, keratin, sinew and organs as mainstay tools of your new trade. Eventually, as you grow and understand this, you’ll be able to produce ‘inorganic’ materials within yourself in the same way, only adding to the possibilities of your warping The Bile does not differentiate between your flesh and others, allowing you to fuse objects and materials into others in much the same way, or merely smear the bile onto their skin and let them half-melt into a congealed sludge with the concrete floor below them. The final area of note available to you is ‘division’, where you can actively break off a piece of yourself, sinew snapping, and meat pulsing to create small creatures, somewhere between a ‘familiar’ and a ‘minion’. They instinctively follow you as their creator and master, but otherwise will need to be specially moulded to perform complex actions and tasks, with masters able to create living screaming war machines that could bring nations to heel.
objects.title: The Rulership of Flesh

addons.text:
Due to the effects of the serum, you now look human — or close enough to pass without drawing attention. Your skin has been restored, smooth and natural in tone, masking the layers of hardened muscle and embedded tech beneath. Scars have faded, and the glowing circuitry that once traced your body has dimmed or retracted beneath the surface. 

Your eyes, while still cybernetic, are disguised with synthetic irises and pupils, capable of mimicking natural movement and emotion. Your facial structure has been subtly reshaped to resemble your original human form or something close to it — expressive, relatable, and convincingly alive.

This doesn’t undo your enhancements, but it cloaks them behind a carefully engineered facade. Your voice modulator now matches natural vocal tone and cadence, allowing you to speak without mechanical distortion. You no longer move with the rigid weight of a machine; instead, your stride is fluid, your gestures human. 

Heat signatures, biometric scans, and surface-level examinations will no longer flag you as anything more than a highly fit individual.
addons.title: Humanity’s Soldier

addons.text: Your body has done what most cannot — it has adapted to Grimjaw. Rather than burning itself out with each use, your system now metabolizes diluted strains of the mutagen continuously, feeding a slow trickle of rewritten DNA into your bloodstream. Integrated into your spinal column is a regulated dispersal chamber — a subdermal reservoir that creates trace amounts of the mutagen and distributes them in pulses. It creates a steady war-state, allowing you to always operate above your original limits. Your metabolism is constantly rebuilding tissue before it degrades. Claws may not protrude from your fingers, but the grip is strong enough to crush ship armor. You both heal faster and hit harder even without your cybernetics. Additionally, your body now carries a hardpoint mount for a pure Grimjaw syringe — built into the chest, directly beneath the skin, protected by reactive plating. When triggered, the serum floods into your system instantly. The result is a compound reaction: the existing low-level Grimjaw saturation amplifies the raw dose, multiplying the effect. The transformation is faster. The power, sharper and more violent. For those brief 25 minutes, you are not just a weapon — you are extinction in motion. What would kill another user from rejection or overload simply resets you. Your cybernetics — the same embedded regulators, thermal cores, and neuro-feedback filters that stabilize your Super Soldier systems — now regulate the resynchronization phase of Grimjaw. No matter how many doses you’ve used or how much your biology has adapted, your recovery window never increases. You will always return to baseline within three days. However, what little of you that looked human is gone. Your silhouette is wrong — broader across the shoulders, too deep in the chest, with arms that reach too far and move too smoothly. Your spine arches subtly backward from the reinforced growth, creating a posture like something evolved to run on all fours. Muscle cords occasionally ripple too high beneath the surface, flexing involuntarily as your internal systems self-correct. Your face is nearly unreadable: jaw overdeveloped, neck layered in dense connective tissue, and eyes that gleam faintly from behind hardened optics. When you breathe, there’s a wet mechanical sound as air passes through filtration vents carved directly into your ribs. If you have Humanity’s Soldier then these mutations will not be visible, and you will look like a normal human in your base form.
addons.title: Built Better

addons.text: Rather than being adapting to Grimjaw, you adapted to Primecurrent. Your body houses a full-body saturation system based on Primecurrent’s nanite-enhanced compound. From your spinal column, the regulated dispersal chamber continuously generates trace amounts of the upgraded strain, cycling it in controlled pulses through your bloodstream. Every grafted system, every reinforced joint or ocular rig is now enhanced by the bioelectric interface of the serum, supercharging your tech with a bottomless energy well. Your cells never degrade—they are preemptively repaired. Your nerves are a constant current. And while you cannot release blasts of lightning like an overcharged reactor, your touch carries enough voltage to drop armored targets and fry unshielded machines, laced with ambient radiation that eats through organic and synthetic matter alike. From your hardpoint mount, it’s filled with a dose of uncut Grimjaw: Primecurrent. Once activated, the chamber floods your already-enhanced system with a direct infusion of the raw compound. The reaction is immediate, overwhelming, and exponentially more potent. For those 25 minutes, you gain limited control over common energy: releasing thunderclaps from your palms, bending magnetic fields to launch yourself into low-flight arcs, and projecting ocular bursts of concentrated thermal energy—heat vision, stripped-down plasma beams, and electromagnetic burns. Your body is also further mutated giving you near immunity to pure energy based attacks. Like before, resynchronisation will never be more than three days thanks to your systems. However, your body is also now even further mutated in its base, with bioluminescent and pulsing flesh holding immense energy visible through your skin. If you have Humanity’s Soldier then these mutations on your base form will not be visible.
addons.title: Built Greater

objects.text:
You are the product of the greatest minds on Earth, the first and only successful Super Soldier. Years of classified research, bleeding-edge science, and battlefield experimentation have fused man and machine into something formidable. Combat drugs course through your enhanced bloodstream, your physiology has been torn apart and rebuilt, and your mind has been drilled, programmed, and shaped into a weapon that does not falter.

Your training is a synthesis of every major combat doctrine across the planet. You fight with the precision of special forces, the endurance of marines, and the strategic oversight of high-ranking officers. You’ve trained in jungle warfare, urban sieges, underwater infiltration, zero-G maneuvers, and mechanized armor piloting. 

You can dismantle, reassemble, and operate nearly any weapon or vehicle. Every combat style, from close-quarters combat to long-range sniping, is second nature. You carry in your mind the hard-earned experience of a veteran who’s fought and survived the equivalent of two global wars, complete with the instincts and scars that come with it.

Beneath your skin lies a lattice of kinetic dampeners, muscle amplifiers, and reflex boosters, allowing you to absorb explosions, redirect force, and move with precision no unaugmented human can match. Your arms can punch through reinforced steel, your legs can leap across rooftops, and your eyes — equipped with thermal, night, motion, and x-ray overlays — serve as surgical instruments of war, tracking threats, calculating distances, and syncing with aerial drones. 

A neural interface accelerates decision-making, enabling you to react before others even process the threat, while embedded regulators suppress pain, exhaustion, and hesitation, keeping your body operational long past its natural limits. You also have a neural-feedback system which accelerates muscle memory development, locking in complex techniques through reinforcement when movements are executed correctly and disrupting them when flawed, ensuring every failure sharpens your performance.

Your biology, what remains of it, reflects a commitment to survival above all else. Your body mass has increased, your muscles are thicker and more efficient, and your bones have been reinforced with carbon-threaded structures. Your skin, altered in tone and texture, is resistant to radiation, chemical exposure, and extreme temperatures. 

Your lungs filter toxins. Your liver can process poisons. Your heart can regulate output under strain, and your blood carries agents to clot wounds and kill infection instantly. Your immune system has been reengineered to fight off every known pathogen, and your healing ability is nothing short of brutal efficiency — not fast, but thorough, pushing your body to recover from trauma most would never survive. 

Yet for all your power, there is nothing human left in your appearance. You are massive — standing nearly seven feet tall, your frame is thick with dense, corded muscle and reinforced plating. Your skin is a patchwork of rough, synthetic grafts and altered tissue, discolored in places where radiation shielding and chemical resistance have left it uneven and leathery. 

Metallic lines crisscross your body, glowing faintly with embedded tech, and ports for maintenance and data input are visible along your spine, forearms, and neck. Your face is more machine than man — eyes replaced with multi-lens optics that whir and adjust independently, jaw reinforced with carbon-steel hinges, voice modulated through a rasping speaker embedded deep in your throat. 

You move with a mechanical precision, deliberate and heavy, as if the world itself must yield to your weight. Whatever you were before — a soldier, a human being — has been consumed by function. You are not sleek, not elegant. You are a tool of war, built to survive, built to kill, and unmistakably not human.
objects.title: The Super Soldier

addons.text:
You are no longer just enhanced — you are refined. Every augmentation, every gene edit, and every line of synthetic tissue was custom-made to fit your body, your needs, and your lifestyle, crafted by private clinics and elite engineers.

This doesn’t add anything new to your capabilities — instead, it perfects what was already there. Your genetics were tailored with extreme precision, ensuring near-zero biological rejection or hormonal imbalance. Muscle tone, organ support, and metabolic functions are all individually calibrated, resulting in minimal long-term strain or maintenance. Every cybernetic component was sculpted to your exact proportions, seamlessly integrating into your nervous system, musculature, and skeletal frame without excess bulk or latency.

The result is a system that operates more smoothly, lasts longer, and demands less from you. Where standard models show wear over time, yours remain stable. Where others need downtime or recalibration, you stay active and clear. Everything simply works — quietly, perfectly, and without complaint.

Visually, you are a masterpiece. The synthetic elements are subtle, polished, and aesthetically flawless. Your features, posture, and movements are effortlessly graceful. Cybernetics blend into your skin like high-end jewelry or designer techwear — not only accepted, but envied. The uncanny edge seen in mass-market models is gone. You are fully human in presence, yet undeniably superior in design.
addons.title: Upper Class

objects.text:
You’ve received the standard suite of bio-editing and entry-level cyberware common in society. It’s the kind of mass-produced enhancement available to anyone with stable income and basic healthcare access — reliable, widespread, and designed to improve quality of life.

Your body has been genetically tuned for efficiency and durability. Minor illnesses, seasonal bugs, and common allergens are unable to affect you, thanks to an upgraded immune profile engineered to handle the biological background noise of urban life. Your metabolism is cleaner and more efficient, meaning you need less food, generate less waste, and maintain steady energy throughout the day without caffeine or constant snacking. Small injuries — cuts, bruises, sprains — heal quickly and cleanly, and your body generally avoids inflammation or long-term strain.

Sleep comes easier, with optimized neural rhythms and hormonal balancing, just four to five hours is enough to keep you fully rested, mentally sharp, and emotionally stable. Your brain processes information faster, learns new skills more easily, and forgets less. You retain focus longer, make more measured decisions, and rarely find yourself overwhelmed by stress. Panic, burnout, and fatigue still exist, but they’re softened — blunted by quiet, always-on regulation systems that keep your baseline calm and clear.

Your senses are subtly enhanced, able to pick out a face in a crowd faster, hear your name spoken across a noisy room, or notice a sour smell before food spoils. Eye-linked interfaces display simple overlays — time, location, messages, or reminders — projected directly onto your field of vision. You no longer rely on handheld devices for most digital tasks. Thanks to a basic neural interface, you can connect wirelessly to smart homes, transit grids, workspaces, and public systems with a thought, navigating the world effortlessly. 

Light cybernetic additions support and expand your capabilities. A discreet data port behind the ear handles direct uplinks when needed, while biometric sensors beneath the skin track vitals like hydration, hormone levels, and fatigue. Your ocular implants respond to light levels and can zoom slightly for detail work or distant reading. Internal memory tagging lets you mark moments — like saving snapshots of what you see or hear — for later playback. All components are low-maintenance, modular, and designed for regular civilian use.

Despite your upgrades, you’re not exactly subtle. Between 10% and 30% of your body includes visible cybernetics, placed in high-exposure areas: the face, neck, forearms, or hands. You might have glowing vein-like circuits, translucent ports, or synthetic musculature visible beneath your skin. You’re aesthetically pleasing by design — symmetrical, well-proportioned, and clean-cut — but there’s an artificial precision to your appearance that makes people look twice.

Lastly, this body is not built for combat. While you’re resilient, efficient, and more capable than any baseline human, you are not reinforced, armored, or hardened for violence. Sustained physical trauma, high-velocity impacts, or battlefield conditions will overwhelm you quickly. These enhancements are meant for survival, productivity, and high-functioning daily life — not war.
objects.title: Sci-Fi Civilian

objects.text:
It seems you ended up losing your original limbs during a skirmish with the Coalition of Mankind. You can now gladly call yourself a veteran pirate with a body built for spitting in the Coalition's eye.

Your new frame is a black-market classic built on an un-hackable analog foundation. Power comes from triple-redundant piezoelectric-thermal cells in your chest and pelvis, converting your body’s motion and ambient heat into fuel. Your strength is driven by hydraulic-myo hybrid muscles sheathed in nanofuel fluid. You can punch through a standard airlock door or dead-lift over 800 kilograms. 

The frame’s speed is explosive but inelegant; hydraulic actuators allow sprint bursts near 70 km/h and powerful vaults, but you have minimal fine control. Reaction time is enhanced via a cortical spike array that bypasses biological nerve lag, translating intent into motion with mechanical speed. A crude, monochrome HUD is projected directly onto your vision via the cortical spike array; this feed is one-way, providing you system data but accepting no external inputs, making it impossible to hack.

Your skeleton is a laminated ceramo-metallic lattice that deforms rather than snaps, letting a "broken" arm remain functional. A dual-fluid circulatory system includes an oxygen-rich emergency coolant that can be shunted to damaged areas for anaerobic operation. Every critical system has backups: triple hydraulic lines, isolated organ chambers, and decentralized processing. You can absorb tremendous blunt force, shrug off shrapnel, and remain combat-viable with up to 60% system failure. You can operate at high-output for hours before cumulative damage forces a shutdown.

Your outer layer is a dermal mesh of micro-emitters and reactive pigment cells. It emits scrambled signals to defeat weapon lock-ons and projects IR/UV patterns to fuzz cameras and optics, making you a shimmering, hard-to-target blur in a fight. Your major trade-off is that under peak strain, your system shunts an oxygen-rich emergency coolant to muscles, allowing anaerobic operation. This creates toxic metabolite buildup which causes searing pain, muscle tremors, and cellular damage if pushed beyond its short duration. These toxins are uniquely potent and flush from your system far slower than in a baseline human, making the resulting pain more intense and lingering long after the crisis has passed. Additionally, the system runs hot, requiring cool-down periods, and the cortical spikes cause chronic headaches.
objects.title: Sci-Fi Pirate

addons.text:
It seems that through combining your nature as classical Frankenstein’s Monster with the advantages of One Piece’s Giants, you have gained the abilities of Toho’s Frankenstein’s Monster.

Your physical might have grown to match your newfound stature, as you are to giants what you were to humans before. 

Most importantly, you have Toho’s Frankenstein’s Monster’s greatest attribute, its healing factor. Your ability to heal is extraordinary, able to regrow a hand in minutes, and completely reform from just a heart in years. It should be noted that there are two limitations to said healing. Firstly, its speed is dependent on your protein intake, and secondly, it can be negated through intense amounts of electricity, as seen with descendants of Toho’s Frankenstein’s Monster.

You may, optionally, also gain the ability to shrink down to a human-scale, like Gaira and Sanda, the descendants of Toho’s Frankenstein’s Monster.
addons.title: Gargantuas

addons.text: It seems you are Dr. Frankenstein’s fear made manifest, as you have learned the process of building your kind. Furthermore, you also gain knowledge of similar variations of the process, such as using electricity or creating animals like dogs.
addons.title: Dr. Frankenstein

addons.text:
Your two Frankenstein natures have combined to refine your physique and raise your physical capabilities to all new heights. 

Your newfound strength and speed allow you to tear through steel and concrete like they were cardboard, send trucks flying with a single hand, and move fast enough to appear as a blur to the naked eye. Meanwhile, your endurance and metabolism render you heavily resistant to heavy-arms fire, capable of exerting yourself for days without rest with no exhaustion, able to heal from most wounds that get through before your eyes, and even regrow limbs in just a week.
addons.title: Refined Physique

addons.text:
It seems that with your knowledge of Arcane Magic you have enhanced yourself by utilizing the processes used in creating the various types of Flesh Golems from D&D and Pathfinder.

Through these enhancements you have gained quite the plethora of immunities and powers, such as healing from lightning and negative energy attacks, generating and firing blasts of electricity, and immunity to magic, non-magical physical attacks, and even having your form altered.
addons.title: Flesh Golem (D&D/Pathfinder)

addons.text:
It seems that the corpses used to create your body had possessed quirks, resulting in modifications to your creation that parallel that of a Nomu.

In particular, your physical capabilities and quirk capacity now match that of a complete High-End Nomu, like Hood, whilst still retaining your enhanced intelligence. As a result, you are a powerhouse capable of smashing through buildings and enduring similar blows, facing several pro heroes on even footing, and even having up to six quirks.

Finally, you may choose to either retain your uncanny appearance or to instead have an appearance akin to the other High-End Nomu.
addons.title: Frankenstein’s High-End

objects.text:
Through grave robbing and mad science, you have been reborn—or more accurately, remade—as the classic horror creature, Frankenstein’s Monster.

As Frankenstein’s Monster, your body was crafted to surpass what humans are normally capable of—and it is a complete success. Your form grants you strength great enough to tear a man limb from limb and crush a cottage; speed that allows you to outrun a stag; and swiftness that rivals an eagle. 

Your stamina and hardiness are nothing to scoff at either: your stamina is great enough to perform feats like climbing the Alps or swimming the English Channel without rest, while your body’s hardiness allows you to survive in environments like the Arctic without discomfort and heal from wounds in a fraction of the time, without medical aid.

Notably, even your cognitive capabilities are enhanced. You can learn, understand, and comprehend at such speeds that you could go from a mental infant to a genius multilingual scholar in under a year. Finally, the most impressive facet of your body is that you possess a form of biological immortality, in that you no longer age and are immune to disease.

As a side effect of the craftsmanship used to form you, your visage is quite unsettling. You now stand an intimidating eight feet tall, with a broad and muscular build to complement your stature. Furthermore, your features are sculpted in a manner that should be beautiful, yet come off as uncanny due to your abnormal skin color—a mixture of corpse-pale, sickly yellows, and greens, along with the stitching that binds you together.
objects.title: Frankenstein's Monster

addons.title: Thaumic Geoengineering
addons.text:
Through your ability to serve as a walking leyline and living source of magic, your terraforming abilities have expanded beyond the physical world and into the realm of magic itself.

You can terraform a planet's supernatural landscape as easily as its physical one. Leylines, mana-rich regions, spiritual environments, magical resources, enchanted landmarks, and other mystical phenomena can be created, altered, or erased on scales ranging from local regions to entire planets. Just as you can engineer biological ecosystems, you can engineer magical ones, designing self-sustaining networks of magical energy and supernatural infrastructure from the ground up.

Likewise, your biological engineering now extends into the creation and cultivation of magical life. Beyond merely designing organisms, you can seed entirely new magical species, bloodlines, supernatural gifts, and other hereditary mystical traits, guiding their development over generations as naturally as any other ecosystem.

By feeding magical energy into your terraforming processes, you can dramatically amplify their scale, speed, and potency. Vast magical environments that would normally require centuries to emerge can instead be established in a fraction of the time, while the energy demands of your more intensive abilities are significantly reduced.

Given sufficient time and resources, you can transform a mundane world into a thriving magical one, create entirely new systems of magic, and cultivate planetary-scale mystical ecosystems capable of sustaining and propagating themselves indefinitely without further intervention.

objects.text:
With this power, you have been transformed into a living hyper-advanced terraforming device. 

Through your physiology alone, you have become capable of terraforming any terrestrial planet, such as Mars or Venus, into environments hospitable for life in only a few decades. This is through your physiology, granting you various elemental abilities themed around manipulating the environment and biological systems.

For example, manipulating the gases in the air, minerals in the earth, liquids such as water or magma, and the temperature anywhere between absolute zero and thousands of degrees Celsius on a planetary scale. You can also manipulate gravity to mimic telekinesis, allowing you to either fling thousands of tons of excess material off a planet into space or attract nearby meteors to increase a planet's mass.

So long as a planet has the materials required, you instinctively know how to manipulate them to form a functioning ozone layer and magnetosphere.

Even creating life isn’t beyond you; forming complex proteins and biological systems out of raw minerals, or manipulating existing biological systems with a thought. At first, you’ll be limited to basic single-cell genetics, but with experimentation, you will be able to create entirely custom lifeforms.

Your elemental, gravity, and biological manipulation abilities have two invisible spheres of influence that you can switch on and off, both centered on your body. One of these spheres can easily encapsulate the average terrestrial planet. You can use it to slowly but surely terraform a planet over the course of a few decades. It isn’t capable of fast or overly rapid displays of power, but it can be kept constantly active, working in the background to achieve your goals.

The second sphere is only a few miles in length, but it is capable of rapid and massive shows of strength, including but not limited to imparting hundreds of tons of material with enough force to move miles in seconds or rapidly change the temperature within the sphere over a thousand degrees in the blink of an eye.

The second sphere is much more energy-intensive than the first—it is to the point where for the same energy required to terraform a planet over the course of decades with the first sphere, you can moderately use the second sphere for a few hours. You can have both spheres active at the same time if desired.

Paired with these abilities are enhanced senses relevant to the ability in question. This includes but is not limited to: geo-sense, temperature tracking, gravity senses, and bio-sensing. Everything and anything needed to understand a planet’s current state and what’s needed to terraform it, these senses cover a planetary range and come paired with an enhanced mind, letting you easily process all the information these senses produce while multitasking.

Using this combination of abilities to terraform is incredibly intuitive and instinctual, allowing you to focus more on what you want to terraform a planet into instead of how.

Besides your various other abilities, your body has also become superhumanly durable, comparable to a terrestrial planet like Earth; as part of this enhancement, your body is also protected from radiation, immune to conventional poisons, and has lost the need for breathing. Finally, just like other forms of life, you are capable of manipulating the genetic makeup and biological systems of your body.

Perhaps the most impressive aspect of your physiology is the fact that all of these abilities are powered by your metabolism, which is so effective and efficient at generating and storing energy that with a single average human meal, you could terraform Venus into a paradise for life over the course of a few decades and not even be winded.
objects.title: Terrestrial Shaper

objects.text:
Your physiology is unlike that of any other— for within you rests an egg. Its origin is unknown, but its function is absolute.

When you suffer a life-threatening wound, one that would otherwise end you, the egg cracks.

Your current body collapses, rendered useless, while your consciousness transfers instantly into the yolk within. For five seconds, you exist in a state of pure vulnerability, undergoing a rapid metamorphosis. And then—you are reborn.

From the yolk, a new form emerges. Its appearance may differ, molded by your own subconscious will, but its essence remains yours. This new body is a refined vessel where your physical and mental capabilities are enhanced tenfold, your abilities evolve, your previous skills ascended to new heights—and all prior wounds vanish, including any damage to the egg.

Should you again fall to a mortal blow, the cycle repeats. The egg cracks once more. From the shattered yolk, you are reborn a second time, another form with an aesthetics of your choosing. This form is once again Ten times more powerful than the second form, your body, minds, and skills pushed to even newer levels.

If a fatal wound finds you again in this third form, the egg will break a final time, and you will be returned to your original form, with your original stats—reset, but still alive. 

This cycle has no defined end, endlessly renewing with each near-death. However, you are still not immortal. While in the yolk state, during those crucial five seconds of transformation, you are vulnerable. Killable. If you are destroyed then, before your rebirth completes—there is no coming back.
objects.title: The Egg Came First

objects.text:
You have bathed in the blood of the dwarf Fafnir, and in doing so you have stolen the dwarf’s might, binding his cursed strength to your flesh forever.

You can transform any gold into gleaming, luxurious scales that layer over your body, with purer gold creating more beautiful and durable plates. The more gold you use, the more scales you grow. The more scales you possess, the stronger each individual scale becomes and the larger your body grows, your frame elongating and thickening as your form becomes more reptilian. The bigger and more reptilian you look, the more draconic abilities you unlock: first searing fire breath, then leathery wings strong enough to lift your mass and more with time. Your abilities scale endlessly with every coin and ingot you transform into your scales, gaining more abilities, so long as they can be argued to be “draconian” in origin.

Any supernatural property of an item you transform into your scales is retained and spread throughout your entire body. For example, if you turned a gold ring that had the power to detect lies into one of your scales, you will be able to use that power as if you yourself were wearing the ring.

At any time you can reverse the transformation, peeling your scales back into the original gold, rings, or treasures they once were. This also happens involuntarily if they are torn off your body.
objects.title: Scales of Fafnir

objects.text:
You carry the ancient legacy of owl spirits—creatures that watch from the shadows, silent and ever-seeing. This power grants you the ability to transform freely between a human, a majestic owl, and a hybrid form that merges the strength and grace of both. Your transformation is instantaneous and entirely under your control.

In your owl form, you are far more than a bird of prey. Your wings are broad and soundless, allowing flight at speeds faster than sound without disturbing the air. You pass through the world unnoticed, avoiding even magical or technological detection. Your body is lighter than air yet stronger than steel—your feathers, while soft in appearance, form a natural barrier that can shrug off blades, bullets, and brutal impacts with ease.

Your senses are extraordinarily sharpened. Your eyes cut through darkness and distance, capable of detecting heat, motion, and even the lingering presence of powerful emotions or events. Your hearing is so refined that you can detect a heartbeat through stone, hear whispered words across vast spaces, or feel the subtlest tremble in the air from hidden movement.

You may also assume a hybrid form—a lithe, humanoid body marked with feathered patterns, equipped with sharp talons and wide wings. In this form, you blend human skill with the primal power and instincts of the owl. You are a swift and ruthless combatant, capable of rending through armor with talon strikes and warding off attacks with the dense layers of your plumage.

You can draw forth and launch cutting feathers from your wings, aimed with flawless accuracy and the force of flying daggers. These feathers can pierce metal, shatter stone, and tear through even the most resilient defenses. In close quarters, you may wield your feathers like elegant, curved blades—forming swords, daggers, or other edged weapons from your own body, reshaping them in the heat of battle.

As a creature bound to silence and shadow, you can move without leaving behind any trail—no scent, no footstep, no breath of wind. You adapt effortlessly to hostile surroundings, using your keen instincts and awareness to remain one step ahead of both prey and predator.

Your connection to the owl's legacy grants you an eerie calm and awareness. You often know things before they are spoken—detecting intent, reading body language with perfect clarity, and sensing when someone is hiding something, even if you cannot yet say what. You are not omniscient, but your intuition borders on the uncanny.
objects.title: Watcher of Silent Wings

objects.text:
This power grants total control over a wolf-based transformation state, with no rigid boundary between forms. You may remain fully human, become a full wolf, assume a humanoid hybrid body, or stop anywhere in between. Every change is voluntary, smooth, and precise. You can bring out only the traits you want in the moment: sharper eyes, a heavier jaw, fur, claws, fangs, longer limbs, digitigrade legs, a tail, thicker musculature, or a more bestial frame. You never lose your mind, speech, or self-control while transformed.

Even in human form, your body is permanently altered. Your baseline strength, durability, speed, reflexes, stamina, and recovery are all raised well beyond human limits. Your senses become predatory in the truest sense: smell capable of tracking individuals across old trails, hearing sharp enough to pick out breath, heartbeat, or footfall through cluttered environments, and vision tuned for motion, darkness, and distance. You move with a level of balance and body control that makes climbing, sprinting, pouncing, grappling, and sudden redirection feel natural.

Your hybrid form is the main war-body of this power. It is built for close violence, pursuit, and survival. Your frame becomes larger, denser, and more explosive without sacrificing agility. Your claws and fangs become natural weapons capable of rending armor, biting through reinforced materials, and carving into targets that would normally shrug off ordinary blades. Your hide, bones, and musculature harden dramatically, letting you take impacts, gunfire, and blunt trauma that would cripple most fighters. At the same time, your movement stays clean and efficient: fast acceleration, brutal leaps, sudden lunges, and a low, grounded stability that makes you difficult to throw off balance.

Your full wolf form begins at roughly the scale of a large natural wolf, but it is not limited to that size. You can increase your mass and stature as needed, growing into progressively larger and more monstrous versions of the same body plan, up to a maximum of roughly twelve meters tall at the shoulder and over twenty meters from nose to tail. At the low end, the form is suited for stealth, tracking, and mobility. At the high end, it becomes a true siege-beast, large enough to overpower vehicles, tear through barriers, crush fortified positions, and dominate open ground by sheer physical force. The larger you become, the more your strength, bite force, durability, and momentum increase.

Your regeneration is one of the most terrifying aspects of the power. Minor wounds vanish almost instantly. Deep cuts close in seconds, shattered bones force themselves back into place and mend rapidly, torn muscles reweave, severed flesh rejoins, and damaged organs recover with alarming speed. Even catastrophic injuries that should leave you crippled or dying can be endured and healed from in active combat. As long as enough of your body remains intact and your brain is not cleanly destroyed, your body will fight to rebuild itself with brutal determination. Lost eyes, ruined hands, mangled limbs, and massive trauma can all be restored, with the process becoming faster and more violent the deeper you are in your transformed states. Unless an enemy can inflict overwhelming damage faster than you can recover, putting you down for good is extraordinarily difficult.

This power also carries a strong survival bias. Harsh cold, exhaustion, hunger, rough terrain, and extended pursuit affect you far less than they should. You are built to keep moving, keep hunting, and keep fighting long after others would collapse. There is a hard, ancient presence to your transformations, especially in your larger forms. The closer you move toward the upper end of your size and physical force, the more overwhelming that presence becomes. You seem less like an animal and more like a living calamity wearing the shape of a wolf.
objects.title: Crown of the Wild Fang

objects.text:
You carry the sovereign essence of lion spirits—ancient kings of heat, dust, blood, and golden light. This power grants you complete control over a lion-based transformation state. You may remain fully human, become a mighty lion, assume a humanoid hybrid form, or shift only specific traits as needed: golden eyes, sharpened teeth, retractable claws, dense muscle, a sweeping mane, tawny fur, padded hands and feet, heightened senses, or a heavier, more predatory frame. Every change is voluntary, precise, and under your control. Your mind, voice, and identity remain your own in every form.

Even in human shape, your body carries the mark of the lion. Your strength, speed, reflexes, balance, stamina, and durability rise far beyond ordinary limits. Your movements become smooth, grounded, and powerful, built around sudden bursts of force and decisive action. You can sprint with explosive speed, leap great distances, climb with clawed precision, and strike with enough force to break bone, dent metal, or send armored foes crashing backward.

Your senses become those of a supreme predator. Your eyes pierce darkness, glare, smoke, and distance with ease, tracking motion with terrifying clarity. Your hearing can separate individual breaths, heartbeats, footsteps, and shifts of weight within a crowd. Your sense of smell can identify people, fear, blood, sickness, old trails, and hidden bodies even through cluttered environments. Once you have marked a presence, losing it becomes difficult unless it is deliberately concealed by powerful means.

Your full lion form is majestic, swift, and devastating. You become a great tawny beast of muscle, fang, claw, and commanding presence. Your body is larger and stronger than any natural lion, but still shaped for speed, agility, and controlled violence rather than monstrous bulk. Your claws can rip through armor, stone, and reinforced barriers. Your jaws can crush weapons, tear through defenses, and hold enemies with terrible force. Your hide, bones, and muscles become dense enough to withstand blades, bullets, impacts, and harsh conditions that would destroy ordinary flesh.

Your hybrid form is the royal war-body of this power. You stand as a leonine humanoid with powerful limbs, sharp claws, fanged jaws, a heavy mane, and eyes that burn with predatory authority. In this shape, you combine human skill with the raw dominance of the lion. You can grapple, pounce, slash, tear, and overpower enemies with brutal efficiency. Your claws can extend or retract at will, allowing you to fight with precision or savagery as the moment demands. Your mane and hide form a dense natural guard, soft to the eye but capable of dulling strikes, deflecting cuts, and absorbing crushing blows.

Your roar is a weapon of spirit and force. When unleashed, it can shake the air, rupture concentration, stagger enemies, crack fragile materials, and send weaker foes into instinctive fear. Those caught beneath its full weight may find their courage faltering, their bodies freezing, or their will bending under the pressure of your presence. Against stronger opponents, the roar still disrupts rhythm, weakens resolve, and announces your dominance like thunder across open ground.

You possess the authority of the pride. Your presence can calm allies, rally the fearful, and impose order in chaos. Those who stand with you feel steadier, braver, and harder to break. Those who oppose you feel the pressure of being judged by something older than civilization—a predator that does not posture, hesitate, or waste motion. This aura is not mind control, but it weighs heavily on instinct, confidence, and morale.

As a creature of sun, dust, and blood-warm earth, you adapt naturally to heat, hunger, fatigue, and rough terrain. You can stalk silently despite your strength, lie still for hours without losing focus, and explode into action the instant an opening appears. Your instincts are sharpened toward timing, territory, weakness, and command. You can sense when a foe is about to break, when a group is losing cohesion, or when someone is masking fear behind bravado.

The lion’s mantle grants you a calm, imperial ferocity. You do not rage blindly. You wait, watch, measure, and strike when the moment belongs to you. In battle, you are not merely strong—you are decisive. Every movement carries the weight of a predator that knows exactly when to pounce, when to maul, and when to let silence remind others who rules the ground beneath them.
objects.title: Mantle of the Sun-Mane

objects.text:
You carry the ancient legacy of orca spirits—hunters of the cold sea, rulers of the open water, and silent monarchs beneath storm-dark waves. This power grants you complete control over an orca-based transformation state. You may remain fully human, become a full orca, assume a humanoid hybrid form, or shift only specific traits as needed: smooth black-and-white skin, sharpened teeth, powerful lungs, reinforced muscles, a dorsal fin, webbed hands and feet, enhanced hearing, pressure-resistant organs, or a heavier marine frame. Every change is voluntary, precise, and fully under your command. Your mind, speech, and self-control remain intact in every form.

Even in human shape, your body carries the strength of the deep. Your physical power, durability, stamina, reflexes, balance, and recovery are raised far beyond ordinary limits. Your muscles become dense and efficient, built for explosive motion and relentless endurance. You can swim with impossible speed, dive without strain, strike with crushing force, and withstand impacts, blades, bullets, and violent pressure shifts that would ruin a normal body.

Your body is perfectly adapted to all aquatic environments. Saltwater, freshwater, brackish water, freezing seas, deep oceans, rivers, lakes, swamps, and flooded caverns are all equally survivable and navigable to you. Changes in pressure, salinity, temperature, and oxygen availability never hinder your movement or performance. When submerged, you may draw breath through hidden or manifested gills, allowing you to remain underwater indefinitely without losing your ability to breathe air on land.

Your senses are tuned for the world beneath the surface. Your hearing can detect movement through water across enormous distances, picking out heartbeats, splashes, shifting currents, and the vibrations of hidden bodies. You possess a powerful form of echolocation, allowing you to map your surroundings in perfect detail even in total darkness, murky water, storms, caves, or crushing depths where sight becomes useless. You can sense the shape, size, speed, density, and position of nearby objects and living creatures through reflected sound.

Your full orca form is massive, sleek, and terrifyingly powerful. You become a black-and-white predator of immense grace, capable of moving through water with silent speed and overwhelming force. Your tail can launch you like a living torpedo, shatter stone with a single strike, or send waves crashing outward with brutal pressure. Your jaws can crush armor, tear through reinforced materials, and hold prey with inescapable strength. Your hide and blubber form a dense natural defense, protecting you from cold, pressure, weapons, and blunt trauma.

Your hybrid form is the war-body of the black tide. You stand as a powerful humanoid marked by smooth dark-and-white patterns, strong limbs, webbed claws, sharp teeth, and a commanding dorsal crest. In this form, you combine human precision with the raw might and aquatic instinct of the orca. You can fight fluidly on land or in water, grappling with crushing strength, striking with tail-like force, biting through defenses, and using your weight and momentum to break larger opponents. Near water, your movements become even more dangerous, flowing from calm stillness into sudden, devastating violence.

You can command sound as a weapon. Your clicks, calls, and focused pulses can disorient enemies, rupture balance, interfere with concentration, and strike through armor as concussive force. Underwater, these sonic attacks become especially devastating, traveling through the environment with brutal clarity. You can stun prey, collapse fragile structures, disrupt machines, or send pressure waves tearing through a battlefield.

As a creature of depth, cold, and black water, you are difficult to track or predict. You leave little disturbance when moving through water, can vanish into darkness or glare, and can read currents, pressure, scent, sound, and motion as naturally as sight. You instinctively understand ambush, pursuit, terrain, and group tactics. You can tell when a target is panicking, when a formation is weakening, or when prey is about to make a desperate mistake.

The orca’s legacy grants you a calm, predatory intelligence. You do not simply overpower your enemies—you study them, guide them, exhaust them, and strike when escape has already become impossible. Whether beneath the waves, along the shore, or in flooded ruins, you move with the confidence of something that knows the deep belongs to it.
objects.title: Sovereign of the Black Tide

objects.text:
You carry the ancient legacy of badger spirits—unyielding guardians of earth, root, stone, and shadowed dens. This power grants you complete control over a badger-based transformation state. You may remain fully human, become a full badger, assume a humanoid hybrid form, or shift only specific traits as needed. Every change is voluntary, precise, and entirely under your control. Your mind, speech, and self-command remain intact in every form.

Even in human shape, your body carries the toughness of the deep earth. Your strength, durability, stamina, balance, pain tolerance, and recovery rise far beyond ordinary limits. You become difficult to move, harder to injure, and nearly impossible to intimidate. Your muscles are dense rather than flashy, built for grappling, bracing, crushing, and forcing your way through resistance. You can endure punishment that would drop most fighters and keep advancing with grim, relentless purpose.

Your senses are sharpened for hidden things. Your sense of smell can track individuals through soil, rain, crowds, old trails, and enclosed spaces. You can detect blood, fear, sickness, rot, minerals, water, hidden chambers, and disturbances in earth or stone. Your hearing can pick out movement underground, behind walls, beneath floors, or through thick brush. Darkness, smoke, dust, and cramped spaces do little to hinder you.

Your full badger form is compact, fast, and ferociously strong. Though smaller than many predators, your body is packed with unnatural power. Your claws can carve through packed earth, wood, stone, concrete, and armor plating. Your jaws can crush bone, tear through restraints, and latch onto enemies with terrifying force. Your hide, fur, and dense body structure protect you from blades, bullets, blunt impacts, falls, and crushing pressure. Once you dig in, few forces can pry you loose.

Your hybrid form is the war-body of the burrow. You become a broad, low-centered humanoid marked by dense fur, powerful arms, heavy claws, sharp teeth, and a stance built to withstand impact. In this shape, you combine human skill with the badger’s brutal tenacity. You can tunnel through barriers, rip open defenses, grapple larger opponents, tear weapons from their hands, and keep fighting at close range where your strength is most dangerous. Your claws can extend or retract at will, allowing you to climb, dig, slash, hook, or anchor yourself with perfect control.

You are a master of earth and enclosed terrain. Soil, mud, gravel, clay, roots, rubble, and stone yield beneath your claws as though weakened by your presence. You can dig tunnels with impossible speed, collapse unstable ground, create hidden shelters, breach walls from below, and move through underground spaces without becoming lost. You instinctively understand pressure, weight, tunnels, foundations, and weak points in structures. Given even a small opening, you can widen it into a path.

Your defensive power is extraordinary. When you brace yourself, your body becomes like a living wedge of iron. Charging enemies crash against you and lose momentum. Heavy blows glance off or sink into your dense frame without stopping you. You can shield allies behind your body, hold doorways against superior numbers, survive being buried, and crawl free from debris that should have trapped you. Pain sharpens your focus rather than breaking it.

You carry the wrath of the cornered beast. When wounded, surrounded, restrained, or protecting something you claim as yours, your strength and ferocity surge. Your strikes become heavier, your grip harder, your movements more direct, and your refusal to fall almost supernatural. This is not mindless rage; it is stubborn, controlled violence—the certainty that anything trying to remove you must first survive you.

As a creature of burrows, roots, and hidden paths, you leave little trace when moving through earth or undergrowth. You can vanish into tunnels, crawlspaces, ruins, forests, or broken ground with unsettling ease. You adapt naturally to darkness, confinement, poor air, rough terrain, cold soil, and long periods of stillness. Ambush, pursuit, defense, and escape all become instinctive arts.

The badger’s legacy grants you a grim and immovable spirit. You do not need to tower over others to dominate a battlefield. You endure, dig in, tear through, and refuse to yield. Whether holding a line, breaking a fortress from below, or dragging a stronger enemy into close quarters, you carry the certainty of something that cannot be frightened away, worn down, or forced from its den.
objects.title: Bulwark of the Iron Burrow

objects.text:
You carry the ancient legacy of serpent spirits, granting you complete control over a snake-based transformation. You may remain human, become a great serpent, assume a humanoid hybrid form, or shift individual traits at will. Your mind, speech, and identity remain unchanged in every form.

Even in human shape, you gain extraordinary reflexes, flexibility, balance, grip, stamina, coordination, and durability. Your movements are silent, fluid, and precise, allowing you to slip through tight spaces, escape restraints, climb quietly, strike with sudden speed, and move with unnatural control.

Your senses are attuned to heat, scent, movement, and vibration. You can see in darkness, track scents with a forked tongue, detect fear, blood, sickness, poison, and familiar individuals, sense warm bodies through darkness or thin cover, and feel footsteps, heartbeats, machinery, and danger through surfaces.

In full serpent form, you become a massive, powerful snake built for stealth, speed, and constriction. Your scales resist weapons, temperature, terrain, and pressure. Your coils can crush bone, bend metal, immobilize armored foes, and drag heavy prey where you choose.

In hybrid form, you combine human skill with serpentine precision. With scaled limbs, fangs, slit eyes, flexible joints, and either legs or a coiling lower body, you can strike from unnatural angles, evade by bending around attacks, climb walls and ceilings, crush enemies, and use your tail to balance, seize, trip, anchor, or restrain.

Your venom is fully controlled. You may inject it, spit it, coat weapons with it, or suppress it entirely. Its effects can numb, weaken, blind, slow, paralyze, burn through resilience, or bring a target near death without killing them. You can also produce antivenom to save allies or spare enemies.

You are a master constrictor, able to sense weak points in armor, joints, breath, balance, and blood flow, then apply crushing pressure exactly where needed. Your grip is quiet, intelligent, and nearly impossible to escape.

Your scales respond to your will, smoothing for stealth, hardening into armor, rising into cutting edges, dulling your outline, or flashing warning patterns. While you cannot become invisible, you are extremely difficult to notice when still, especially in darkness, grass, ruins, crowds, branches, alleys, or broken terrain.

You can shed damaged outer layers to remove poisons, infections, clinging substances, tracking marks, lesser bindings, and minor wounds. Greater healing requires rest, warmth, food, and safety, but your recovery remains unnaturally efficient.

You can slow your breathing, lower your presence, survive long periods without food, and remain motionless for hours. Heat, cold, hunger, darkness, tight spaces, and long waits rarely disturb you. You understand patience, ambush, escape routes, weak points, and the perfect moment to strike.

The serpent’s legacy makes you calm, quiet, and lethal. You waste no motion or warning. In battle, your danger is sudden and absolute: a bite, a coil, a flash of venom, and the realization that escape was lost before the fight began.
objects.title: Grace of the Viper

objects.text:
You bear the ancient legacy of raven spirits: watchers of battlefields, messengers of dusk, and keepers of secrets. This power grants full control over raven-based transformation. You may remain human, become a raven, take a humanoid hybrid form, or shift only specific traits. Every change is voluntary and precise, and your mind, speech, and self-control remain intact.

Even in human form, you gain heightened speed, reflexes, balance, stamina, durability, and coordination. You move with sharp, predatory grace, able to leap, climb, glide, perch, dive, and strike with uncanny control.

Your senses are enhanced. You can see through darkness, mist, rain, glare, and great distances, while your hearing can isolate whispers, track movement, and detect hidden threats. You can also read subtle signs of fear, guilt, injury, tension, or deception.

In raven form, you become a large, silent black bird with powerful wings, keen eyes, sharp talons, and light-drinking feathers. You fly with exceptional speed and precision, slip through shadows, cross long distances without tiring, and endure far more harm than any ordinary bird.

Your hybrid form is a feathered war-body with wings, claws, sharp features, and cold, watchful eyes. It combines human skill with raven mobility and instinct, letting you fight from air or ground, strike from blind spots, and escape before enemies can respond.

Your wings can launch hardened black feathers like knives, piercing armor, splitting stone, cutting weapons, and carving through defenses. At close range, you can shape your feathers into blades, knives, hooks, or other cutting weapons, altering them freely in combat.

You also possess the raven’s gift for omen and memory. Places marked by violence, grief, betrayal, or powerful emotion may leave echoes you can sense, drawing your attention to bloodshed, death, lies, or moments heavy with fate.

Your voice can mimic sounds, voices, accents, calls, and machines with eerie accuracy. Your cries, whispers, or croaking laughter can distract, lure, unsettle, or make foes feel watched. Against the guilty, fearful, or wounded, your call can strike like an ill omen.

Darkness, storms, ruins, forests, cities, graveyards, rooftops, and high places are natural hunting grounds to you. You move quietly, leave little trace, find ambush points and escape routes instinctively, and know when attention slips.

The raven’s legacy grants calm, watchful cunning. You are patient, observant, and ruthless when an opening appears: not merely a creature of shadow, but the black wing overhead and the blade-feather falling before the cry is heard.
objects.title: Omen of the Black Wing

objects.text:
You carry the ancient legacy of fox spirits, creatures of twilight paths, hidden dens, moonlit fields, and wandering flame. You can freely transform between human, fox, and humanoid foxlike forms, or manifest individual traits without fully changing shape. Your transformations are precise and instinctive, and never interfere with your mind, voice, or sense of self.

The spirit of the fox enhances you in every form. You possess heightened speed, reflexes, balance, flexibility, stamina, coordination, and recovery, along with keen senses capable of following subtle sounds, scents, movement, and other traces that would escape ordinary notice. Your movements are naturally light and controlled, equally suited to pursuit, escape, exploration, and sudden violence.

Your fox form is swift, quiet, and difficult to catch. Its appearance can vary according to your nature, from an ordinary-looking fox to something unmistakably supernatural.

Your hybrid form combines your human shape with whatever foxlike traits you desire, such as ears, claws, fangs, fur, unusual eyes, markings, or tails. You may possess as many as nine tails, each an expression of the supernatural power carried within your blood. As that power grows, your presence can become increasingly strange, beautiful, fearsome, or otherworldly.

You can conjure foxfire, an eerie flame shaped by your will. It may burn like ordinary fire or take on more supernatural qualities, appearing as drifting lights, spectral flames, illusions, apparitions, or other manifestations. Foxfire responds readily to cunning and imagination, making it especially effective for deception, distraction, concealment, and misdirection.

Your supernatural instincts also sharpen your awareness of people and places. You are adept at noticing hidden intentions, weaknesses, danger, unusual details, and opportunities, whether reading another person’s behavior or navigating an unfamiliar environment.
objects.title: Veil of the Cunning Ember

objects.text: “Some warriors train to master one weapon. I train to carry them all.” You can carry and operate a vast number of weapons and pieces of armor without losing mobility, speed, or access. All gear must be physically placed on your body, but a dimensional overlay removes weight and bulk. Despite appearing overloaded, you move as if lightly equipped. Weapons can be drawn, swapped, or sheathed at any moment—even during rolls, dodges, strikes, or while airborne. Switching never breaks your flow; transitions are instant and naturally sync with your movements. A spin can draw a blade, a landing can ready a spear, and a slide can resheathe a weapon mid-motion. You can chain techniques from multiple trained weapons into fluid, continuous sequences. There’s no clash between styles—your body adjusts instinctively to maintain balance and form. Your hands always reach for the right tool without hesitation, automatically selecting the best weapon for the moment whether you’re under pressure, mid-air, or responding to sudden changes in the fight. Any item on your body is instantly accessible, no matter its placement. Whether strapped to your back, hidden in a boot, or locked into a shoulder rig, you can draw or stow gear from any position, even while in motion. This partially applies to armor as well. You can wear layered or reinforced protection that would normally restrict movement without suffering penalties. While armor can’t be swapped in combat, you can stack defenses far beyond practical limits while remaining fully mobile. However, you gain no skill from this power. If you aren’t already trained in a weapon, carrying it offers no advantage. Additionally, you’re limited to what you can physically pack onto yourself. Every item must be strapped, holstered, or secured somewhere on your body. If you can’t fit it, you can’t bring it.
objects.title: Over Equipped

addons.text:
As long as your will and focus hold strong, you cannot die. With enough willpower, you can struggle and hold your body, soul, and mind together even in the face of attacks or circumstances that would reduce it to dust. Eventually, even recovering and adapting, as long as you can hold on long enough. This does not prevent the damage or injuries; it merely prevents you from falling to pieces and dying.

*Note: You have to be at least instinctively aware of an overwhelming sneak attack to resist it. If something bypasses all your senses and reduces you to nothing in an instant, you're out of luck.
addons.title: I AM IMMORTAL

objects.text: Being crippled is temporary. Strength is forever! What would be considered utterly crippling to others is an inconvenience to you. Pure willpower supplements all of your bodily needs, from food to air—to anything else. Circumstances, environments, and training regimens that would kill someone else, you instead see as training opportunities. With months of repeated exposure to suicidal conditions, you'll eventually grow to be able to treat them as normal. On top of that, your fleshy limits are now firmly soft caps. You'll continue to grow stronger as long as you push yourself with even more extreme training. It is also far harder for whatever strength you gain to be diminished permanently without you simply losing the will to go on. If you rekindle that will, however, whatever power you lost will begin to return. This does not prevent old age from affecting you. Through sheer stubborn will, you'll be able to survive long past the point your body would normally cease functioning. Made worse by whatever lingering or new injuries you have to deal with. If your willpower is great enough, you can even survive and function past normally lethal blows—like having your chest cored out—though only for as long as your will and focus don't slip. This power also grants you supplementary 'shonen' effects. Drama is a source of power you can tap into, such as increasing the power of your abilities by shouting their names, amplifying psychological pressure via posing, and other quirks.
objects.title: I AM THE SHONEN PROTAGONIST

addons.text:
Long ago, your fae lineage ruled over a sacred forest, bound to it by blood and pact. When the forest god fell and the pact shattered, your blood remembered. The Grove Beast is not a curse, it is the reawakening of your ancestral claim.

You retain all core features of the Grove Beast, but your form is marked with signs of high fae heritage. Your horns resemble tree branches entwined with golden leaves and ghostly blossoms. Your mane is streaked with silver-vine or hanging moss that glows faintly in moonlight. Your presence imposes unnatural stillness upon natural surroundings, animals pause, trees turn toward you, and even storms seem to falter.

You gain instinctive command over wild creatures and plant life. Animals below human intelligence obey simple directives (flee, attack, guard, follow) without training. Plants move subtly in your presence; vines open paths, roots trip enemies, trees lean to shield you. You cannot control them with perfect precision, but they respond as loyal subjects would to a sovereign’s intent. These reactions are strongest within natural or wild environments and weaken in artificial or urban spaces.

You passively emanate a weak divine aura that causes lesser spirits of nature such as feylings, dryads, moss wisps, and similar entities to approach or linger nearby. They cannot be commanded directly but can be bargained with, and their presence acts as a loose early-warning system for spiritual threats or magical disruptions.

You also begin to awaken memories of your fae ancestors, snippets of rituals, spells, and names long buried. This ancestral memory grants you an intuitive grasp of your older magic, strengthening your spellcasting. While you retain access to folk magic from the Fae-Blooded origin, you are no longer limited to natural materials like herbs, bones, or carved stones. Instead, you may use your own body as a medium. You can draw runes into your skin with a claw, shape blood into symbols, shed hair as foci, or use breath, growls, and scent to enact enchantments. This reduces the preparation time of your spells to mere moments, allowing casting in the middle of combat or under duress.
addons.title: Beastly Heir

objects.text:
A forgotten forest god has cursed you, transforming you into a Beast. A wild guardian cursed to embody beastly creature that stalks the underbrush and every primal instinct that stirs in the dark.

Your body is massive, hunched like a gorilla. Your arms are sinewy and long, built for both climbing and crushing. When you rise to full height, you tower like an ancient tree, nearly eleven feet tall. Your legs are shaped for pouncing, digitigrade and feline, thick as tree trunks to carry your body. Your gait silent despite your size, and you are able to explode into terrifying bursts of speed. You are overwhelmingly strong, as a single blow from you can shatter stone, while your grip could pulp bone like fruit. Your legs let you run as fast as a cheetah while also leap the height of treetops.

All your digits, be it hands or feet, have claws. They are a hybrid of bear’s talon and sabertooth fang: curved, black, and glinting with a natural sheen like volcanic glass. These claws are able to cut straight through modern tanks with effort. Long fur covers most of your body, thickest around your shoulders and chest like a wild mane. Underneath the fur was scaled, leathery skin, tough enough to match chainmail.

Your face is a blend of predators. A broad, long muzzle like a bear juts from a skull, while your lower jaw can unhinge, revealing rows of carnivorous teeth like those of a deep-sea horror. Your pupils can catch even the faintest motion in the night. Your wolf-like ears twitch with unnatural precision, catching the rustle of a mouse or the flap of a raven’s wing from afar. Antler-like horns rise from your skull, thick, ridged, and brutal, like goat horn, each tougher than stone.

Though your body is made for battle, your soul still hears the forest’s voice. You can speak to animals and sense the subtle moods of plants such as the panic of grass beneath trampling feet or the groan of a poisoned root.
objects.title: Grove Beast

objects.text: Steel is my Body and Fire is my Blood A pitch-black steel alloy from the future, one that would be later used to forge a bow that would be wielded by a red archer. This alloy has been imbued into your body, binding with every cell until flesh and metal became one. Your body took on the same properties once reserved for that bow, a living weapon of unbreakable steel, powered by your will. Your skin becomes as tough as reinforced armor but keeps the flexibility of its original form. It bends, stretches, and feels no different to the touch, yet no blade can cut through it, and no bullet can pierce it. When struck, the force spreads instantly across your surface, nullifying the impact before it can harm you. The resilience of your skin rivals tank-grade composite plating, yet it moves and responds like flesh. It has also darkened as a result, taking on a more tanned hue. Your muscle fibers turn into dense cords of metallic strands, each one as strong as the suspension cables holding up a bridge. When they tense, the force output multiplies to inhuman levels, with your arms capable of crumpling reinforced concrete, and your legs able to leap several stories high. You can lift between fifty and one hundred tons under sustained exertion. Additionally, using your full strength causes huge amounts of heat to build up, enough that your body glows with embers, hot enough to sear flesh. Your bones are replaced with a structure of diamond-like steel, unbreakable and perfectly balanced. They distribute impact evenly through your body, preventing fractures even when slammed by extreme pressure or explosive shock. No amount of blunt trauma can shatter your internal frame. You can fall from heights that would reduce normal bodies to pulp, land unharmed, and keep moving without hesitation. Your organs gain a layer of metallic reinforcement, flexible but durable enough to resist crushing forces and heat. The blood running through your veins turns rich with iron, dark and heavy, enhancing oxygen and energy transport. This lets you survive where the air is thin, temperatures are high, or toxins fill the air. Your internal systems continue to operate long past the limits of ordinary biology, each beat of your heart pumping liquid metal that feeds the machine your body has become. But maintaining this form demands immense energy. Every movement consumes power far beyond what your natural metabolism can supply. To prevent collapse, your body regulates its baseline output to that of an ordinary human, activating its full potential only when energy reserves are abundant. Without constant replenishment, your systems begin to slow, eventually locking your body in place until restored. The added density compounds this cost: you are several times heavier than before, each step leaving cracks in the ground, each vehicle groaning under your weight. While this doesn’t exactly affect your agility, it will affect your day-to-day life. Finally, your steel composition makes you vulnerable to electromagnetic interference. Strong magnetic fields or directed EMP pulses can disrupt your movement, causing spasms, paralysis, or total shutdown of muscle control until your system resets. Electric discharges can trigger uncontrolled contractions, and your iron-rich blood can briefly magnetize under high field exposure, slowing circulation. Even though your armor makes you nearly invincible to physical harm, environments saturated with electromagnetic distortion remain a critical threat.
objects.title: Wrought Iron Body

objects.text:
You rule your own size. At will, you flow anywhere along a continuous range from a fingertip speck to a horizon-striding colossus: as small as 0.1 mm, as tall as 1,000 km, and any height between. The change is smooth, precise, and under perfect control—you can ease up a centimeter at a time or surge in a single heartbeat.

Your mass, density, and weight obey you as surely as your height. You can keep proportions and strength constant, or scale them to match your new size. When becoming immense, you may suppress your gravitational footprint and shock effects so your presence doesn’t shatter the world; when becoming minute, you can prevent air currents and surface tension from tossing you about. Clothes, gear, and anything you choose to carry scale with you automatically unless you decide otherwise.

Your body, voice, and senses re-tune to fit. Vision stays sharp whether you’re peering between dust grains or looking down on continents; hearing and speech remain clear without deafening others or drowning in thunder. Touch, balance, and proprioception never betray you. You can move delicately at mountain height and strike with force at insect height, skipping the usual square-cube penalties by intent.

When you shrink, you may choose to appear de-aged, a wolf becoming a wolf pup, a dragon becoming a hatchling, a person taking on a younger look, purely cosmetic unless you will otherwise. The effect can extend to clothing and equipment, matching the illusion. You may also carry the look of age forward on a giant scale if it suits you.

Your environment yields to your decisions. If you wish, the space around you buffers against collateral harm and pressure, letting you stand among cities without crushing them or slip through keyholes without disturbing a mote of dust. With a thought, you can share your scaling with any object you’re touching, bringing equipment up to your size or miniaturizing it safely to carry along.

Nothing about the change surprises you. Your momentum, posture, and stance remain consistent through the shift; you keep your footing when you grow, and you don’t stumble when you shrink. Whether striding across oceans or threading between raindrops, you are exactly as large—or as small—as you mean to be.
objects.title: Sovereign of Scale

addons.text:
Golden Form and Stockpile mutate, developing a new relationship.

Stockpile and Golden Form continue to work normally, but now your Golden Form seems to grow more powerful over time. 

Stockpile has developed a new reservoir tied specifically to and exclusively for Golden Form.

This pool of energy is similar in scale to Golden Form’s power as the Principle Pool is to the Stockpile power, and works in the same manner. 

What this means is that this new reservoir of power’s purpose is to enhance Golden Form’s transformation, making it permanently more and more powerful over time the less it’s used.  This new pool of power is not accessible for other powers, its only purpose is to enhance Golden Form’s transformation over time.
addons.title: Plus Ultra

objects.text:
You now possess a power that continuously generates and stores its own energy.

This energy can be used to empower your body—enhancing strength, durability, speed, and similar physical traits—or expelled outward as destructive energy blasts.

This also enhances traits such as reaction times, senses, etc. needed to appropriately handle the power. 

You may distribute this power freely, empowering your entire body for broad enhancement, concentrating it into specific limbs for stronger strikes, or expelling it externally in powerful, focused or widespread electrical discharges.

Whenever you empower yourself or release this energy, it manifests as blue-green electricity. The more power you concentrate or release, the more intense this electrical effect becomes.

Your body is fully protected from any harmful side effects of this power, allowing you to use its full output without risk of self-injury. 

Alongside this, you also carry an intuitive sense of the amount of power you can use and how to best use it for your purpose. For example, being able to use the exact amount of power needed for when you want to throw something or aim your electric discharge with precision. 

Your power consists of three major components, a generator, a principle pool, and a secondary pool. 

Your generator is always active. It continuously produces energy on its own without drawing from any other sources. The strength of the generator scales with the size of your Principal Pool.

The Principal Pool is a deep reserve of stored power. You can neither use it, nor can it be depleted in any manner. The generator produces energy equal to 2% of the current size of the Principal Pool per day.

The Secondary Pool is the portion of energy you can actively use. This is the energy you draw on to enhance yourself or unleash attacks. It has a maximum capacity equal to 1% of the Principal Pool. When depleted, the generator prioritizes refilling this pool first.

The generator first fills the Secondary Pool. Once the Secondary Pool reaches its maximum capacity, excess energy flows into the Principal Pool. As the Principal Pool grows, it increases the generator’s output and the maximum capacity of the Secondary Pool

Because of this feedback loop, the longer the power is left unused—or the less completely the Secondary Pool is drained—the faster the power grows. Over time, this allows the power to compound and increase exponentially.

This power is not limited to physical enhancement alone; its power is universal and can be easily channeled to any ability you possess. This can result in anything from simple increased potency to outright evolution or mutation of abilities. For example, turning a minor float power into true high-speed flight.

You begin with a substantial amount of energy already stored, your secondary pool having the equivalent to either the output of a powerful thunderstorm or three times your own power, whichever is greater, and your principal carrying its scaled amount. This does mean that power is more potent and scales with the amount of power you have available at the start.
objects.title: Stockpile

objects.text: You’ve gained the ability to duplicate yourself, able to create autonomous copies of yourself. You and these clones share a soul and hivemind, able to freely share thoughts, memories, an experiences and can flawlessly communicate and coordinate. You can create temporary and permanent clones. You can create up to 1000 temporary clones that last an hour before disappearing, or up to 100 permanent clones. You can mix and match up to your limit, every 10 temporary clones equating to 1 permanent clone. You can dismiss a clone at any time, regardless of its circumstances. This means you can even dismiss a clone caught in a Grey Boy loop or one of Bakuda’s bombs. When creating a clone, you can replicate the items you have on your person, including clothes and equipment, up to the total mass of your own body. These are real, but will disappear once away from the clone’s immediate presence (~100m) after an hour, or upon the clone’s dispersal. Each of your clones possesses the full breadth of every power, perk, and skill you possess except this one. When creating clones, you can summon them anywhere within a 10km radius. They appear in a flash of black smoke, and they disappear in the same way. If a clone dies, you’ll be able to create another after 10 minutes. If you die, any of your active clones will become the real you, seamlessly passing along your soul and memories and allowing you to escape death. A clone’s trauma is not shared by the rest of the hivemind, including any damage. This also applies to your own body if you can respawn through a clone. This doesn’t mean that it’s forgotten, but rather the damage this would inflict does not carry to the rest. This effectively negates any permanent damage as long as another clone is alive and summoned. This means mental attacks that would have harmed the clone, more esoteric effects like soul attacks, etc only harm that one instance of the clone, and are effectively negated to the rest of the clones, and more importantly, you. The same principle applies if your real body also dies or is left behind, allowing you to escape the harm as long as there is a clone you can jump to. If you die without any clones active, but have the ability to make a clone, a new body will spawn in the safest place within 10km.
