This can also be primed to allow you to respawn later on rather than immediately, allowing you to potentially fake your death. You may also freely swap places with any of your clones at a whim, and can set it so that you automatically swap with a clone upon their creation. If you wish, you can also freely choose to simply switch bodies with a clone, the clone body becoming the real you.
objects.title: Many Men

objects.text:
By focusing on an existing internal structure such as a specific muscle, a length of bone or an organ, you can command it to violently proliferate, pulling raw material from your biomass reserves. A forearm bone can spike outward, then branch and form new joints to become a segmented whip. A latissimus dorsi muscle can swell, rupture through the skin, and extend as a crushing tentacle, complete with its own new neural pathways. The process is fast, visceral, and loud, accompanied by the sounds of tearing skin, cracking bone, and wet, sliding flesh.

The first limitation is your material. You can only initiate growth from pre-existing internal tissues: muscles, organs, bones, tendons, ligaments, and nerves. You cannot affect what is purely external or non-living, meaning hair, fingernails, dead skin, or the very top epidermal layer are inert to your power. You can also grow teeth, as they are living structures with nerve and bone connections. You can create an external stomach to secrete acid, but you cannot grow new skin to cover the wounds your power creates. You also have no direct control over the form of what you create. You can provide a general biological imperative, such as "a limb to hold," "a weapon to pierce," or "a shield to protect." The resulting structure that erupts from your body is just as likely to be a simple, jointed arm as it is a muscular tentacle or a bony, skull-like appendage designed to bite and clamp onto the target. Your power treats your baseline body as the only permissible foundation.

The second limitation is that all new growth must be a continuous, physical extension of something already present. You cannot create a free-floating organ or a detached muscle. A new gripping limb must start as an outgrowth of your pectoral muscle, linking to your nervous and circulatory systems. However, what you create does not need to conform to natural biology, only to the rule of connection. You can grow an optic nerve from any existing nerve cluster, branch it across your body, and create a functional eye at its terminus. Furthermore, your power is additive and permanent. Once you grow a structure, it is now a part of you. You cannot "un-grow" it or reshape it after the fact. You cannot shrink or change your baseline.

The final limitation is fuel and processing. Every gram of new tissue requires biomass, which you must consume and store. Your digestive system is supernaturally efficient and capacious, able to process and store up to fifteen times your current body weight in dense, condensed biomass reserves without impairing your movement. You can eat wood, grass, spoiled meat, and most toxic substances with near-total immunity. Anything that wouldn't instantly kill a normal human is nullified, and even instantly lethal toxins are 99% neutralized, leaving only a faint shadow of their effect. Without fuel, you cannot use your primary power, and your power will begin to cannibalize your own non-essential tissues to fuel its creations.

All your creations are bound by fundamental biological constraints. They require blood flow, oxygen, and constant metabolic fuel to remain viable and functional. While your power will never create a structure that immediately kills you by blocking your airway or severing a major artery, it does not guarantee efficiency or effectiveness. A new limb might be weak, poorly articulated, or energetically wasteful. A new sensory organ might provide a confusing, unusable stream of data.
objects.title: Flesh Garden

objects.text: You have been afflicted with the 「Curse of Eternity」, becoming a 「Blood Fiend」 as a result. The curse affixed to your soul is an insidious one—layers of intertwined maledictions worming into every crevice of your being, so byzantine in fact that it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say you have become a living curse. Its effects render you “eternal,” a perverse affront to the natural order. The curse anchors your soul to the world itself, corrupting it like a festering wound, with the aura it exudes resembling the Miasma of Witches—for the 「Curse of Eternity」 operates akin to an imperfect imitation of an Authority. So long as its layered bindings endure, you cannot truly die, existing suspended between life and death: neither dead nor alive, trapped in a limbo of endless dissatisfaction, still retaining the desires of the living yet forever unable to truly sate any of them. This everlasting hunger inevitably centers around a single fixation tied to your personal “Sin”—a vice from life that you can never stop pursuing. It might manifest as either: an obsessive need to drink in pursuit of a flavor long lost, a yearning to feel the wind against deadened skin, or an incessant craving to experience an emotion now dulled beyond reach. Though older 「Blood Fiends」 may learn restraint, this core desire remains absolute and unshakable. Upon death, your body will completely regenerate and resurrect, its speed depending heavily on your remaining mana. Moreover, by virtue of the curse, even in the face of total annihilation, your heart shall remain inviolable. And should your Gate be currently indisposed, the curse will, instead, slowly absorb any ambient mana available to restore you. As a 「Blood Fiend」, you likewise can replenish and expand your Od through draining the blood/life energy of others, steadily strengthening yourself over time. With prolonged feeding, your physical and magical power can grow monstrous enough to rival the ancient dragons. However, even eternity is not without weakness. Fire can hinder your regeneration, and without mana, resurrection becomes impossible, leaving you trapped inside your heart if there is none. A stronger 「Blood Fiend」 may, by the predatory nature of your shared curse, overpower and devour your soul, stealing everything that makes you “you,” including memories, skills, and even Divine Protections (assuming you have such). Worse still, an Authority wielder can actively suppress the curse—overriding its lesser “cousin” entirely—and thus permanently kill you. If you wish, you can pass down the eternal curse—by draining another’s Od to the brink of obliteration, then feeding them your blood and tainted mana. Once done, they’ll die within the next hours, before rising again as your childe. A portion of your accumulated strength is imparted to them during this rite, alongside an instinctive compulsion to obey you, binding their mind to a strict ruling hierarchy broken only via final death.
objects.title: Blood Fiend

objects.text: “Heavy weapons! Bearing Two... Five... Zero.... Degrees. Heretic armour in the open. Fire! Kill the traitorous dogs! For Unity! For the Primarch! For Humanity!” The Astartes. The super soldier project that the remaining Cauldron members created to combat the Arch-Traitor's forces. Aspirants are taken from veteran regiments of the Alliance of Independent Systems' forces, then surgically and biologically augmented to become transhuman warriors of significant strength, speed, skill and intelligence. Hardened bones, lightning reflexes and redundant organs were just the tip of the spear when it came to modifications, depending on the battlefield role and Legion that the aspirant was seconded to. Devastator Squads gained even better eyesight, whilst Eliminator squads would be given the ability to slow their heartbeat. All of these upgrades were designed to be symbiotic with the previous enhancements, meaning they could keep their operational flexibility on the battlefield. When the Astartes project was in its infancy, it was noted by lead researcher, Riley Davis, that the test subjects would develop unnatural coordination with their fellows. It was then enhanced by various therapies on the orders of Doctor Mother, turning it into a fully fledged psychic connection between them. This allows for members of a squad to be in sync with each other and share information, thoughts, mental fortitude and emotions psychically. The connection also permits a battle brother to share it with other, lesser minds in greater numbers. Though the strength of this bond is much weaker. Originally designed for just shock assaults, HVT extraction and battlefield elimination. The Astartes came to be incredibly skilled warzone commanders whilst being living archives on strategy, tactics and more, able to direct entire galaxies of the war by themselves. They were then given a larger portion of commanding roles as the Heresy progressed, much to many mortal commanders' chagrin. You are one of these super soldiers, with the role and legion up to you. You also gain the arms, armour and training of a veteran battle brother.
objects.title: Astartes

objects.text:
Your flippant wish to die peacefully of old age has been twisted into a curse. Your body now has a singular mandate: to prevent your end by any means necessary until advanced senescence is achieved.

Your body's tissues operate on a principle of desperate, brute-force functionality. Your heart will beat with torn muscle fibers violently seizing, your lungs will draw air through scar tissue by traumatic force, and your nervous system will re-route signals through damaged pathways, causing agonizing spasms that allow movement. You have no regeneration, but your body parts simply refuse to cease operation. Your blood will clot abnormally fast, your muscles will contract around wounds, and your organs will distort their own failing structures to maintain minimal, painful function.

The strength of this is tied solely to your age. As you grow older, your body's inherent resistance to death intensifies. An older body will power through damage that would have killed a younger version of you, its tissues becoming more stubbornly resilient to shutdown with each passing year. This creates a feedback loop: your advanced age makes it harder to die, and because you do not die, you continue to age, which in turn makes it even harder to die. You are cursed to endure toward a distant, ruinous old age.

This does not halt or reverse aging; you will still grow frail and suffer all degradations of time. It provides no comfort, only base functionality through agonizing processes. It offers no redundancy; if an organ is destroyed, it is gone, and your body will merely force remnants to compensate in a failing manner. All wounds, illnesses, and degenerative conditions remain and accumulate normally.
objects.title: I Want To Live

objects.text:
You are the flesh-wrought, forged by disciplined ritual and metaphysical reshaping. You undertook the Seventy-Seven Day Crucible: thrice-cycled fasts under sun and moon, breathless hours submerged beneath freezing water, and the carving of sigils into the skin with powdered iron and salt. You stood before the solar cross at dawn and declared the Self as sovereign law.

Through a confluence of Daoist Internal Alchemy and Nordic berserker hardening, your musculature has been supercharged through ritual qigong and kiai-based impact trance. You can exert force sufficient to crumple a steel I-beam with both hands. With focus, you can leap twenty vertical feet from a standstill. Sprinting at full force, you can smash through reinforced concrete walls with a shoulder slam. Your bone density is such that you can withstand high-speed vehicular impacts, and non-ballistic blunt force without injury.

Ritual exposure to ice and fire has hardened your nervous system, allowing you to endure temperatures from -50°C to 100°C without clothing indefinitely. You require two hours of sleep per 48-hour cycle and can operate under total sleep deprivation for ten days before measurable degradation. Your body does not enter full metabolic crash unless deprived of food and water for over twelve days. Your skin bears thirteen protective glyphs derived from syncretic magic: Solomonic hexagrams, bind-runes of Thor and Tyr, and geometric seals taken from Ifá divination patterns. These glyphs function as active magical resistance fields.

You are immune to mid-tier hexes, ancestral curses, necromantic influence, and entity-based possession attempts. When in proximity to ritual magic, you can sense it as a field distortion, akin to a shift in gravity or vibration. Direct magical attacks, such as curses, sigils, and spells disperse on contact unless powered by beings greatly stronger than you. You are invisible to advanced divination, and only direct soul-name invocation can locate you.

You possess innate magical talent refined through ritual trance, abstinence, and repeated invocation of planetary harmonics. Beyond giving top of the line talent in learning and using magic, it also allows you to draw from archetypal elemental forces through the autonomous alignment of your etheric body. These elemental reinforcements activate subconsciously and alter your body's metaphysical composition in reaction to external stimuli. 

For example, when attacking, your body calls Fire, allowing your strikes to burn through barriers. When defending, Earth rises in your flesh, reinforcing your structure to absorb impacts. While in motion, you enter Air, reducing drag. When wounded, Water flows through your internal channels, slowing blood loss. These reinforcements require no conscious activation and cannot be interrupted without the complete nullification of magical forces in the area.

Your mind has been reshaped through the Astral Skull Rite, an internal visualization training using runes, geometric cubes, and sound vibration to fuse your conscious and subconscious perception. You can recall any memory with total clarity, including sensory data such as ambient temperature, smells, and heartbeat of others. You can detect intent before speech, seeing the muscular contractions that precede decision. You can track hypersonic movement, reacting fast enough to swat down projectiles moving at subsonic speeds. In low-light or zero-light environments, you navigate with full orientation and spatial mapping.
objects.title: The Flesh-Wrought Sentinel

objects.text:
You can transform into a beast the size of a horse, a fusion of scorpion and eagle. In this form, your body is that of a giant black scorpion, your carapace dark and gleaming like polished obsidian. From your back, a pair of enormous eagle wings unfurl, feathered in deep blacks and midnight blues, allowing you to take to the skies with powerful beats. Your face remains somewhat human in the center but is framed by a scorpion's mandibles and crowned with multiple dark eyes that see perfectly even in absolute darkness. Your tail curls up over your body, the stinger at its tip dripping with a viscous fluid.

In this form, your strength is magnified enormously, your pincers capable of crushing steel and your legs carrying you with terrifying speed across any terrain. The exoskeleton that covers you is armored enough to turn aside small arms fire and blade strikes with ease. Your tail can strike with blinding speed, the stinger injecting a potent venom that can paralyze a target within moments. The wings grant you true flight, agile enough for aerial combat yet powerful enough to carry you for hours. You can blend into shadows as if they were physical cover, becoming nearly invisible in low light, and when you submerge yourself in or drink any significant amount of water, your wounds begin to close and your stamina rapidly replenishes.
objects.title: Scorpio, Beast of the Sea and Skies

objects.text: You’ve gained the power of cannibalism. For 24 hours after eating parts of a being you killed, you gain various benefits depending on what you consumed. The potency of the benefits is proportional to the might of the thing killed. A mundane cow would give you incredibly minor benefits for instance, while the gifts from dragon’s flesh would be massively stronger. By drinking the Blood, you heal dramatically faster than a normal human being. By eating the Bones, you grow tougher and more resilient to damage. By eating the Brain, you can access some of the creature’s memories, and can speak any languages that were known by it. By eating the Eyes, you become more canny and perceptive. By eating the Flesh and muscle, you loose fatigue and gain stamina. By eating the Heart, you gain a minor amount of spiritual or magical talent that the creature possessed. By eating the Liver, you become resistant to poisons, possibly immune depending on the creature's strength and its own natural immunities. By eating the Tongue, you can imitate the voice, calls and languages spoken by the being perfectly, though not understand them implicitly. You can eat multiple parts of one being. Additionally, novel parts like non-standard organs and offals can give more esoteric effects depending on the entity being eaten.
objects.title: Consumer

objects.text:
My condolences. It appears you are the last survivor of an alien world straight out of a comic book, or at least, that's how it seems to everyone else.

Your strength, durability, and endurance now mirror what one might expect from someone born on a planet with crushing gravity. Muscles that should only be capable of human effort now produce far greater force, allowing you to lift vehicles, hurl massive objects like the Atlas Stone and strike with devastating power capable of shattering concrete or receive the same in turn with only bruising.

Gravity itself feels lighter beneath your feet. Your legs can unleash explosive force that turns jumps into soaring arcs, clearing rooftops of houses or crossing large distances in a single bound. Landings that would cripple others become little more than a heavy step for you.

You wade through the atmosphere as if it isn’t there, wasting far less energy with movement and allowing you to move faster than ordinary physics would comfortably allow. Air resistance seems reluctant to hinder you, letting you accelerate quickly, pivot with ease, and carry momentum in ways that appear almost cinematic.

Your stamina also benefits from these altered rules. You tolerate extreme exertion with little fatigue, allowing you to fight, run, or labor for extended periods without slowing down. Recovery from strain is similarly accelerated, as if the limits that normally enforce exhaustion have simply loosened their grip on you.

You possess no overtly supernatural abilities—no energy beams, no flight, no elemental control. Yet the world around you bends just enough to make your physical feats possible. Where others must obey strict biological limits, you move according to the broader logic of comic book physics.

Even though nothing has changed with your physiology, its merely as if you came from an alien planet with much harsher conditions advancing your physical capabilities by leaps and bounds... literally.
objects.title: The Last Child of -

objects.text:
So long as a part of you lives on, you can never truly die, literally. While you don't exactly have regeneration, you can keep hanging on so long as an organ of yours is intact. It could be any organ, from your heart to an eye, so long as it was once a part of you, it is "you". This also counts organs that were donated to you, so long as it became a part of your body, it counts for this power.

What this does is even if you are torn apart, your organs will not decay, remaining functional even years out of your system. While this works well for survivability, as you could live even when you're disemboweled for example, that is not the biggest advantage of this power. No, this power truly shines when your organs are transferred to someone else.

Upon being placed in another living body, you will slowly gain control. At first, you will only be able to mildly influence your host (or hosts if your organs are put in multiple people). They will start to act similar to you, your personality bleeding into their psyche. In this state, you can feel everything they can feel. The weaker their will is, the easier it is for your influence to grow.

Later, you may get a choice. Form a symbiotic relationship with your host, letting them continue to exist in the driver seat of their body, with you gaining a telepathic connection with them, forming a partnership with your host. Or, you can fully take over, a choice you can always go for, fully becoming them and destroying their psyche.

Other smaller benefits this ability has is if you have any powers tied to your physical form, it will transfer to your new host, even mutating them to suit your needs. As you take over, your host will also start to look similar to you, but not a complete copy. Finally, even when not fully taken over, your host will persist even when they are also torn apart, once again, these organs belong to you, they are now "you", and you will remain.
objects.title: Organator

objects.text: Reversing entropy is a dream for many, and you are capable of doing it on a small scale. This ability allows you to gather thermal energy from the surrounding air within a sphere around you. You gain immunity to any temperatures altered by this ability or similar effects. Collected energy is stored within you and can at any moment be converted into kinetic energy, granting ability to neutralize incoming attacks, deliver mighty blows without using any muscles and move at incredible speeds. However, this process isn't perfect, especially in the beginning. Its efficiency is only slightly better than ordinary muscles, half of the spent energy is wasted as heat that warms your own body. With training, you can improve efficiency of this ability, as well as the gathering radius and the depth of temperature reduction.
objects.title: Heat Engine

addons.text:
Your action hero luck and larger-than-life competence become infused with true heroic destiny. Coincidences no longer merely benefit you—they increasingly place you where you are needed most. Villains find their plans unraveling around you, innocent people cross your path before disaster strikes, and opportunities to save others seem to appear at just the right moment.

When acting to protect, rescue, or inspire others, your action hero talents dramatically improve. Your instincts become sharper, your adaptability faster, and your improbable luck stronger. The greater the stakes and the more selfless your actions, the more reality bends to support your efforts. While this cannot guarantee victory, it ensures that as long as your resolve endures, there is always a chance for the hero to prevail.
addons.title: Heroic Action Star

objects.text:
You possess the improbable talents and subtle reality-bending luck of a classic 1980s action hero. 

Weapons rarely jam in your hands, vehicles perform beyond their limits, and fortunate coincidences occur with surprising frequency. 

You instinctively learn combat, survival, driving, piloting, and tactical skills at an exceptional rate, quickly reaching elite levels of proficiency. 

Explosions, falls, and other dangers seem less lethal to you, while your courage, charisma, and determination allow you to overcome seemingly impossible odds. 

Though not true reality warping, the world often bends just enough to make your daring actions succeed.
objects.title: 80s Action Hero
SANTA
objects.text: You better watch out... You better not cry..! Hohoho, fear not, for you are here. Dashing through the snow, a red streak passes by. They would fly, spreading Christmas cheer this silent night, no matter the time, no matter the cost. You are now hereby chosen as the one and only, brand new Santa Claus. As Santa, you are empowered by the wonder of the holidays, both literally and figuratively. The abilities this title gives you gains more strength during Christmas season, or whatever is the closest equivalent in your setting. Otherwise, you have the ability to transform into "Santa Claus" at will. This gives you super strength, speed, cryokinesis, lie detection, and the ability to summon a minion or an item related to Christmas, such as a flying sleigh, a reindeer, a yeti, or a handful of elves you can order around, finally, you are much more durable than an average person, able to quickly recover non fatal wounds so long as you have cookies and milk. You are not immortal however, for the title of Santa had passed down for long generations every time Santa dies. A Santa could be anybody, of any race, gender, or even species. So long as Christmas remains a strong influence in your world, you will remain in power. So you best do your best to make sure people do not lose their Christmas spirit. How you go about it, whether by giving away presents every year, or spreading Christmas propaganda as a megamaniacal Saint Dictator, or through something else, you decide. Just remember. You know know if they've been bad or good. So they better be good for goodness sake!

addons.text:
Your G-Cells have enhanced your Gamma Transformation. You are no longer limited to radiation, now capable of absorbing any form of energy, including the Power Cosmic and other higher-tier energies.

Additionally, the angrier you become, the more heat your body emits—similar to the Red Hulk. At peak levels of rage, the heat you produce can rival the intensity of a nuclear explosion. Unlike the Red Hulk, you won’t suffer from burnout while generating this immense energy.

Moreover, your G-Cells continuously adapt to the strain caused by your energy absorption. Over time, this adaptation will allow you to handle increasingly larger amounts of power, pushing your limits further than ever before.
addons.title: Burning Hulk

addons.text:
When you're seriously injured, your body detonates in a burst of nuclear fire—a volatile fusion of gamma radiation and raw fury. This explosion doesn’t just vaporize your surroundings—it kickstarts a regeneration process that heals grievous wounds in seconds and sends your strength skyrocketing.

Upon detonation, your physical power is amplified by x5 for one minute.
The power of the explosion—and the duration of the boost—scale with your anger. At peak rage, the multiplier can climb to x10, with up to three minutes of enhanced strength and near-total regeneration.

You may choose to suppress the explosion when injured, storing the nuclear fury for a more strategic release.
addons.title: Nuclear Anomaly

addons.text:
Your Hulk form has been modified to gain abilities similar to those of Clayton Cortez, or Weapon H. You possess the combined mutant abilities of Wolverine, Sabretooth, Domino, and Warpath. You also possess an adamantium skeleton, which when combined with Wolverine’s abilities and the nanotechnology you’ve been modified with allows you to shape your skeleton into blades and spikes, along with using your bones as projectiles. 

Finally, your most powerful and bizzare ability allows you to change your gamma signature to replicate the abilities of other gamma mutates, such as the superhuman intellect and psionics of the Leader and the energy absorption of the Red Hulk. Unlike Clayton, you possess a natural intuition for gamma, and have full knowledge of how to best channel this power based on your current needs and wants.
addons.title: Living Extinction

objects.text: Much like Bruce Banner, you are now host to a rage-fueled alter ego. Stress or injury will cause you to transform into a hulking, irradiated brute. In this form, you possess massive super strength, durability, stamina, regeneration, speed, and resistance. In combat, all of these abilities scale higher as your rage grows, though you will eventually hit a soft cap. When transformed, your looks are two levels below your standard appearance.
objects.title: Gamma Mutate (Marvel)

addons.text:
After your Mutant power absorbing frenzy, you seem to have absorbed a few non-Mutant powers as well, namely those permanently absorbed by Rogue herself; Carol Danvers (as implied by the power this addon is attached to) & Simon Williams, also known as Wonder Man.

You have an ionic form (without the downsides such as Simon's infertility), giving you super strength & durability comparable to The Sentry or Gamma Mutates, superhuman speed, super senses (particularly relating to energy), energy manipulation (including but not limited to ion bursts, flame projection, eye beams, electromagnetic manipulation, & energy constructs), flight, functional immortality (including agelessness, self-sustenance, & regeneration), shapeshifting & size manipulation, teleportation, and the many "mundane human" abilities of Simon Williams, Carol Danvers, & Anne Marie.
addons.title: Wonder Man (Marvel)

objects.text:
Perhaps an experiment went sideways, or maybe it was just a fluke, but you now find yourself empowered by a fraction of the Space Stone, one of the six elusive Infinity Stones.

This grants you a generally enhanced body beyond the realms of what's possible for a human or kree to achieve naturally, and an internal store of cosmic energy you can call upon. Your internal store of energy is vast enough for you to empower yourself many magnitudes higher than your base, once you learn to control your output.

Enveloping yourself in your cosmic energy allows you to comfortably survive in the vacuum of space, tank large amounts of blunt force, survive targeted artillery fire from the Sanctuary II starship, and eventually even survive plunging through a planet's crust into its mantle and core.

Your cosmic energy benefits more than just your durability, granting the strength to send the likes of Thor across an ocean with a single punch, and eventually perform the aforementioned task of plunging through a planet's crust. You also attain the ability of flying at high speeds, being able to reach escape velocity within seconds and reach light speeds in space.

Your attunement to the Space Stone also grants you potent energy manipulation abilities in general. You are capable of firing destructive photon blasts, and absorbing energy attacks including things such as Thor's lightning. At your peak, you will be able to impart enough energy to damage the likes of Ultron empowered by all six of the Infinity Stones.
objects.title: Marvelous (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text: This ancient jewel, powered by Cyttorak, the ruler of the Crimson Cosmos, binds to the user's soul and transforms them into the unstoppable Juggernaut. Usually, Cyttorak as a bid of the Wager of the Octessence, would choose an Avatar through his Crimson Gem, binding their Soul to him to be his agent back on Earth. Not this time, Cyttorak saw something within you that, at least, pleased him to offer you his Avatar's blessing, with his power enveloping you, turning you into his Exemplar: The Juggernaut, a nearly unstoppable force of nature. The Juggernaut boasts of near-limitless strength, stamina, and durability, granting exorbitant levels of invulnerability, enough to go toe to toe with a moderately angry Green Scar or the Mighty Thor, evenly fighting to a draw along a winning chance. You are completely self-sustained as Cyttorak’s Avatar, finding air, sustenance, or sleep unnecessary, while also an immunity to contaminants of any kind. The self-perpetuating mystical energies endowed by your Patron cover all your needs, a perpetual motion lifeform by any other name. When it comes to boons, a personal force field you can control and extend, also bolster your already physical ability, more so your durability. A field strong enough to withstand attacks like Thor’s God Blast, Adamantium-made weapons, or the very presence of Oblivion himself, leaving you completely unscathed. It can also absorb and redirect energetic attacks. With enough power borne from favor, one can levitate to, dare I say, fly. Should your force field and immense durability meet their match for you to be injured, your regenerative healing factor comes to the rescue, healing at an accelerated rate from wounds on the level of being utterly flayed down to a skeleton. For convenience’s sake, Cyttorak has also given you the ability to alter your size between a normal human to being 80ft tall mountain of a person. The greatest power bestowed by Cyttorak’s great glory truly fitting of the name Juggernaut is that you come to be the embodiment of an Irresistible Force. The moment you advance in a certain direction, it is virtually impossible to halt your movement unless you want to. While it is possible to slow you down, unless it requires an attack on the scale of Thor’s God Blast, you won’t be stopped. As a consequence of being an Avatar, you gain immortality from “natural” means not enough to overcome the power of the Crimson Cosmos. Your single weak spot is your mind, which fortunately your armor suit from the Crimson Cosmos shields against almost all psychic attacks, being comparatively durable as you. Please bear in mind your enemies can and will remove your helmet–while no easy feat, is on the table if you’re careless. Note that you still have the difficulties and complications borne from hosting an extradimensional god of destruction, though they are lessened by Cyttorak’s personal “liking” of you.
objects.title: Avatar of Cyttorak (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have been experimented on with a dangerous new designer drug called D-Lite. Like the final test subject, you have gained the ability to generate and control both the Darkforce and Lightforce, unlike the previous two subjects, who only gained access to one or the other of the two forces. 

Through the application of both energies, you could use them to varying effects. For instance, empowering yourself to greater degrees of durability, strength, and speed will let you be able to fight heroes like Spider-Man and trade blows with him relatively easily, even being able to send the Web-crawler flying through two buildings with but a single blow. You also possess the ability to project this energy outside your body, shooting out blasts of condensed Darkforce energy that look like black-and-white electrical energy. 

Furthermore, by touching someone, you can imbue them with Lightforce energy, healing them from any disease or illness. You are also able to endow them with varying levels of durability, strength, and speed, similar to what you possess. With Darkforce energy, you can corrupt those you touch, altering their personalities and morals to be more evil or immoral. This brings out the evil in people's hearts, even if they have none, and amplifies it until they are subservient to your interests. This ability is more effective the more morally good a person was before they were corrupted. 

With time, you could find a variety of new uses for the Darkforce and Lightforce, able to do more than what you could when you started with this power. Examples such as creating a symbiote from the remaining enzymes in a previous host are just the tip of the iceberg. Your power grows with the more negative emotions you feel or absorb from others. 

Unlike the original Mister Negative, these powers don’t create a new persona.
objects.title: Mister Negative (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your Starling ability to channel energy has expanded to include the entire electromagnetic spectrum, giving you powers similar to Monica Rambeau.

You can transform your body mass into any form of electromagnetic energy—such as visible light, radio waves, electricity, X-rays, microwaves, infrared, ultraviolet light, cosmic rays, gamma radiation, and high-powered lasers. Once you shift into an energy form, you can remain in that state indefinitely.

In energy form, you can fly using any wavelength and even move at extreme speeds—up to the speed of light when you become a beam of light. Some energy forms, like X-rays, allow you to phase through solid matter, while others, like invisible wavelengths, can make you undetectable to the naked eye.

You can release powerful blasts of electromagnetic radiation without losing physical mass. You can also absorb and redirect energy, making you a living conduit of power.

Your control over light lets you create realistic holograms and alter your appearance, though these illusions don’t change your actual shape or mimic biometric features. You can also become a “solid light” form, allowing you to interact with the physical world while still in an energy state. Additionally, you can alter your size—growing larger or shrinking smaller as needed.
addons.title: Spectrum

addons.text:
Your Eternal physiology has allowed you to withstand tapping into far more dangerous forms of interdimesional energy, forging a direct connection to the antimatter-rich Negative Zone. This transformation has made you a living anti-matter generator—an immensely powerful being whose abilities rival those of Blue Marvel.

You possess superhuman strength and durability on a level capable of challenging even the Sentry, and enhanced senses like microscopic vision and superhuman hearing. You can manipulate antimatter in a variety of ways: unleashing devastating blasts, forming defensive barriers, or shaping the energy into constructs that mimic telekinesis. By channeling antimatter into your limbs, you can drastically amplify your physical strikes.

Crucially, you can stabilize antimatter, preventing it from annihilating positive matter on contact. This allows you to safely interact with the world around you without causing catastrophic destruction. In addition to matter manipulation, you can fly at speeds far exceeding Mach levels and survive unprotected in the vacuum of space.

However, your power comes with a singular vulnerability: Neutronium—a rare and exotic substance native to the Negative Zone. Exposure to it disrupts your antimatter balance and can prove fatal.
addons.title: Blue Marvel

addons.text:
Exposure to Terrigen Mists has caused your Starling ability to channel energy to react in a strange way. You are now capable of producing an unknown particle capable of interacting with ambient electrons. 

This can be used to create various phenomena ranging from enhancing your physiology, energy blasts, force fields that can redirect projectiles with the force of a meteor, transmutation of matter, disabling the powers of others, creating anti-gravitons, and a quasi-sonic scream with enough force to destroy planets. 

Unlike Black Bolt, the production of this particle is not tied to your speech center. As a result, you possess full control over your scream and do not have to undergo mental training to ensure you don’t end up destroying everything around you.
addons.title: Black Bolt

objects.text:
You have become a Starling—a rare being attuned to the interdimensional lattice of the Multiverse. As a Starling, your body is a living conduit for interdimensional energy, granting you incredible physical and metaphysical capabilities.

You possess supersonic flight, powered by the raw kinetic force of dimensional energy coursing through you. Your strength is immense—enough to rip reinforced steel doors from their frames and even contend with gods like Loki in direct combat. Your body is a fortress: impervious to bullets, resistant to intense heat and flames, and capable of surviving unprotected in the vacuum of space. Time treats you differently; your cellular aging is vastly slowed, allowing you to live for centuries without the toll of age.

Most extraordinary is your power to tear open star-shaped portals—gateways between realities. These stellar apertures allow you to traverse the Multiverse at will, and when used creatively, can function as devastating weapons, slicing through matter and space alike. You can access the Starling Highway through these portals—a metaphysical path connecting countless universes beyond normal comprehension.

Your connection to the Multiverse isn’t just physical—it’s instinctual. You possess a metaphysical awareness that lets you sense direction, danger, and dimensional shifts with uncanny precision. Unlike America Chavez, whose powers come with immense physical strain, you navigate interdimensional space effortlessly. Time travel is also within your grasp, though it requires a catalyzing force to unlock the temporal aspect of your portals.

Finally, you can channel the core energy of your being into combat. This inherent force amplifies your strikes to supernatural levels, allowing for techniques like releasing concussive shockwaves with a stomp.
objects.title: Starling (Marvel)

objects.text:
You possess powers similar to those of Ulysses Klaw, allowing you to transform your body into solid sound. However, unlike Klaw, you retain the ability to revert to your human form at will.

In your sound form, you have immense strength—capable of lifting and hurling tanks effortlessly and overpowering opponents on par with Spider-Man. You can fly, phase through solid matter, and unleash sonic waves reaching up to 170 decibels. Additionally, you can release concussive blasts with the force equivalent to 3,000 pounds of TNT.

The solid sound that composes your body has unique properties: it can absorb and reflect any force used against it, redirecting the impact back to its source. It is also malleable, enabling you to reshape yourself into various forms, such as a bus or a stampede of animals. You can even create constructs made of the same solid sound, which share your durability and other traits.

Your sound form is nearly indestructible—you don’t require food, sleep, or oxygen, and conventional injuries have little effect. Even severe damage, like vivisection, is more of a nuisance than a true threat. If harmed, you can regenerate using ambient sound, including something as simple as nearby conversations.

However, you have two critical weaknesses. First, you are highly vulnerable to Vibranium, which can absorb sound energy and destabilize your form. Second, your sound form relies on a medium that supports sound propagation. While you don’t need oxygen to survive, you will dissipate in the vacuum of space where sound cannot travel.
objects.title: Power Klaw (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have somehow been granted the abilities of a Kymelian, similar to the four children of the Powers family. However, you have received the full powers rather than a fraction of them. Kymellians possess the ability to manipulate energy, mass, acceleration, and gravity to various degrees, and your abilities are on par with those of the Power Pack.

Gravity: You can create fields that alter gravity, either increasing or decreasing it around objects. This can also be used to enhance physical blows, simulate telekinesis, and levitate.

Acceleration: You can fly at speeds faster than sound and close to the speed of light. Your body produces a protective aura that can withstand blasts from Ultron. You can also teleport to places as far away as a spacecraft in orbit. You can create a rainbow trail that can be solidified into platforms and hammocks that can break a person’s fall. 

Mass: You can alter your density into an intangible mist or an eight inch form with superhuman strength and durability to the point where you can send beings as strong as Kurse and Sphinx flying. You can also create “density fields” that can be used as shields and cushions.

Energy: You can disintegrate inorganic and organic matter in the general vicinity to fuel the creation of energy blasts that can blow holes through spacecraft and can be used with enough precision to shoot guns out of people’s hands.

As a bonus, you also receive the ability to heal both yourself and others from minor injuries and sicknesses.
objects.title: Power Package (Marvel)

objects.text:
Much like Simon Williams and Erik Josten, you’re body has been reconstructed into an Ionic form. Essentially a fully energy being able to create an ionically charged flesh ‘Shell’ able to be changed as you please, you’ve been rendered near invulnerable due to your life not being tied to this shell, immensely strong due to its enhanced tissues and capable of supersonic flight by charging the field around it.  

Furthermore, as a being made of energy, you can expend this energy to create blasts of force, create constructs and even alter magnetic fields; however doing so consumes the energy you’re made up from and greatly exhausts you when overused. 

Most severe however is Ionic Energy’s volatility. Theoretically, Ionic Energy could duplicate and create novel abilities to suit the wielder, however in practise this power fluctuation is tied deeply to their psyche and certainty, with self-doubt and loathing potentially destabilising them into a fine energy field that would need to (and likely be incapable of doing anything but) pull itself back together to be functional.

Additionally, as an energy being, weapons that primarily involve energy dispersal or fluctuation are acutely more dangerous and capable of causing great harm.
objects.title: Ionic Form (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have undergone the process to become a Prime Sentinel—a human infused with advanced nanomachines and designed to serve as a sleeper agent in the war against Homo Superior. Unlike most who endure this procedure, you retain full independence and complete control over your actions.

The nanotechnology integrated into your body grants you an array of formidable abilities. You possess superhuman strength, capable of lifting a collapsed building overhead; durability sufficient to withstand blows from Colossus; and energy blasts powerful enough to incapacitate Cyclops in a single strike. You can generate force fields, utilize combat computers that rapidly calculate optimal responses to unforeseen threats, and fly at speeds comparable to Cannonball. Self-repair protocols function as a healing factor, and you have a limited capacity to adapt to other powers. Additionally, you can inject others with nanotechnology, creating new Prime Sentinels under your exclusive command. When necessary, all of these enhancements can deconstruct back into dormant nanotech, allowing you to pass as an ordinary human.

Despite your immense power, you are not without weaknesses. Your systems operate within the limits of a human body, meaning severe physical trauma or extreme energy overloads can disrupt your nanotechnology. Furthermore, as a biomechanical organism, you are inherently vulnerable to electromagnetic interference.
objects.title: Prime Sentinel (Marvel)

objects.text: With each purchase here, you receive one of the powers of Marvels First Family, the Fantastic Four. First is the famous Reed Richards, also known as Mister Fantastic. Mister Fantastic is most known for his ability to bend, stretch and warp the shape of his body in an almost unlimited number of ways. With skin virtually immune to damage, Reed must consciously relax his powers to allow small portions of his skin to be penetrable however. Second is the ever lovable Thing, Ben Grimm. With an organic rock body, the Thing has superhuman strength and durability, able to lift entire buildings, and survive some of the harshest conditions. Just like Ben Grimm, you don't age while in the form of the Thing, but unlike the Ben, you will retain the ability to switch your “Thing” powers on and off. Next is Susan Storm, the Invisible Woman, with the ability to bend light around herself and become invisible, or render objects transparent. Susan Storm also possesses the ability to generate various psionic shields and barriers in a myriad of forms, for a variety of uses. Finally is Johnny Storm, the Human Torch. Able to convert his body into a fiery, plasma-like state at will, Johnny can manipulate the flames generated into a variety of blasts, streams, and shapes. This form also allows the Human Torch to fly via jets of flame emitted from his feet. As an added bonus, regardless of how many of the First Family's powers you choose here, you have the ability to safely, and easily create the unstable molecular suits of the Fantastic Four. Note: This power only gives you the most famous powers of the relevant member of the Fantastic Four, not any skills, knowledge, items or other powers they might have possessed.
objects.title: Fantastic First Family (Marvel: MCU)

addons.text:
You also receive the powers of a fledgling Geryuganshoop, the self-proclaimed strongest psychic in the universe. You can mentally communicate with any being who has ever entered a 30 meter radius from you. 

Furthermore, you have telekinesis within your radius as well -- this isn't particularly strong, only at the level of lifting rocks and small objects around you. However, your control is excellent, you can individually control the minute movements of items, as well as completely remove friction, a nigh-impossible feat even for powerful ESPers like Tatsumaki. You passively apply friction-removal to yourself at all times, further boosting your already impressive speed.

You also gain Geryuganshoop's skill in managing the Dark Matter Thieves, since all Boros cared about was fighting. You have a supernatural talent with administration, logistics, and tactics. Your tactics accommodate for the unique powers of individuals and create powerful combination techniques with your allies. You are also adept at turning any enterprise into a profitable venture, to the extent that a hodgepodge of warriors from various planets can purchase, maintain, and refit a top-class military spaceship, even while engaging in no mercantile activities whatsoever.
addons.title: (Future) Greatest Telepath!

addons.text:
Like Boros, you have a natural love for the art of combat. Instead of giving up, you laugh through the pain of getting cut into thousands of small pieces while clobbering your opponent with your counterattack. Whenever you see an opponent, you can identify their general fighting style, strengths, and weaknesses. Your energy-sense combined with your combat instincts allow you to mentally sort through all individuals you are aware of and determine which would provide a challenge for you, in any way.

Your ability to improve during combat is far greater, now allowing for you to create new techniques on the fly to counter that of your opponents. When facing truly unstoppable opponents, your physical and mental improvements are visible, and your opponents will notice you getting stronger and stronger as the fight continues. With every fight, you grow stronger, tougher, faster, and more skilled.

Your natural prowess as a warrior attracts other powerful individuals to band together under your command, and you have a supernatural charisma which would make them spend their entire lives performing mind-numbingly boring tasks for you.
addons.title: (Future) Worthy Opponents!

addons.text:
All of your magical and supernatural energies you currently have, and those you acquire in the future, have merged into a single personal energy pool which has their combined attributes and properties. 

You can absorb various types of energy in order to boost your own maximum energy density, control, and maximum reserve. This applies to any energy, including sunlight, however, the more exotic an energy is, the faster your growth rate. You are talented in discovering, creating, and determining the properties of various types of energy you encounter.
addons.title: (Future) Energy Singularity!

objects.text: "Once, I traveled the universe, ravaging everything in sight." You have the powers of the species of Lord Boros, Dominator of the Universe and leader of the Dark Matter Thieves. Your potential is the same as Boros himself, however you start at the same level he did before his conquests. You can choose if this is an actual species shift or if you merely have the same abilities. The primary ability you have gained is energy detection and manipulation. You can sense all sorts of different energies: electricity, heat, kinetic energy, etc. Furthermore, you can determine the energy level of an opponent's soul, giving you a general understanding of their power level. However, some individuals who rely on brute strength may be far stronger than what their soul implies. This energy/soul sense works through any other supernatural senses you have, so if you had Mind's Eye it could extend to cover the same radius. By expending your personal energy, you can create various energy projectiles, such as beams, needles, balls, etc. in a 50 meter radius around yourself. This merges with any of your other magic-based projectiles or Blaster powers, increasing their strength and allowing you to manifest them anywhere within the same radius. Starting out, this is limited to small bursts of plasma, but eventually you can unleash sky-covering barrages. Energy has merged with your very being. You passively extrude an aura of power and control around you, and your surroundings crackle with electricity upon transformation. You can combine your detection and energy manipulation abilities to send a burst of visible, blue energy in a city-wide radius. This energy will provide you with feedback similar to echolocation, granting you the positions and energy levels of every lifeform within the area, and perfect understanding of the terrain. However, this is quite energy extensive and it takes a few minutes to get feedback, so it cannot be done in combat. You can punch through brick walls, face-tank a ballista, and fight at speeds equivalent to a high-performing sports car. Your can accelerate to this speed in an instant. At will, you levitate and fly, equivalent to your maximum running speed with the same level of superhuman dexterity. Furthermore, your species has evolved to survive in extreme conditions, particularly allowing you to withstand high-temperatures and lava with ease. You have an excellent regeneration rate, with small cuts closing milliseconds receiving them. You can regenerate from as little as a single finger, though this takes a while. You cannot create clones with this power and any already existing biomass or body parts of yours are pulled towards each other when regeneration for increased efficiency. You have a trump card in the form of your "Meteoric Burst" transformation, which massively amplifies all of your abilities. You can maintain this state for a few hours with no consequence, but any longer and you will receive a massive backlash when you transform back. With enough training, your abilities in the Meteoric Burst become your new base state, and your transformation is increased in strength to always have the same power-boost ratio. You can choose the appearance of this transformation, or even make it appear the same as your normal appearance. However, your true potential lies in your growth rate. By challenging worthy opponents in life-or-death battles like Boros did, you can increase the strength of all your powers and physical attributes massively. You are a genius when it comes to combat and can easily develop your own fighting style which integrates all your powers and create training plans to develop your abilities to their full potential.
objects.title: (Future) Dominator of the Universe! (One Punch Man)

addons.text: Your undying rage and fighting spirit now resonate and amplify each other, making them more powerful than ever before. With each attack you land on an enemy or damage you receive, both your fighting spirit and fury will build at an accelerated rate, with no limits. Any damage healed by bloodlust will not reduce your fighting spirit, and the duration of Undying Rage can be extended based on the amount of fighting spirit and fury you currently have. After combat, instead of the power you gained rapidly fading away, it will be converted into a healing effect to help you recover. Additionally, you will retain 10% of your peak power from any combat encounter as a permanent increase to your base strength, making you stronger with every fight.
addons.title: Unbridled Rage

objects.text:
You now possess the powers of the S-Class hero, Metal Bat. You inherit his immense speed, strength, durability, and fighting skills, enabling you to fight multiple demon-level threats simultaneously and even hold your own against a dragon-level threat for a while.

In battle, you grow stronger based on how much damage and anger you have accumulated. As the fight progresses, you become faster, stronger, and significantly more resilient. This ability also allows you to push beyond your physical limits, enabling you to fight at your full strength despite severe injuries, such as major blood loss or broken bones. Additionally, your fighting spirit also makes you highly resistant to mental attacks.

However, be cautious. As powerful as this ability is, it has its limits. Your body can only endure so much damage before it collapses, and your fighting spirit quickly fades once the battle ends. If you sustain enough severe injuries, you risk dying when the fighting spirit that sustains you dissipates.

As a bonus, you also gain a nigh-indestructible metal bat to use as a weapon.
objects.title: Metal Bat (One Punch Man)

objects.text: Awakening to a new form of living, you have now become a Cyborg, your body fully outfitted with combat-ready cybernetic enhancements similar to Genos at the start of his journey of being Saitama's disciple. Now, you no longer need to eat or drink, never experiencing fatigue the same way humans do, and instead can run off of nuclear energy, or if you so desire, biofuel. Indeed, your heart has been replaced with what is known as a "CORE". As for your overall capabilities, those are the interesting part. As byproducts of your enhancements, you become capable of shattering concrete from mere leaps, destroying steel or stronger materials with all-out punches, and able to endure more punishment due to your physiology, able to fight despite considerable damage to your body; your cybernetics, rather than being cumbersome, help you move faster than the average human eye can see and react, able to keep up with opponents faster than you for a considerable amount of time. These enhancements weren't left without some heat, either: your palms are armed with a pair of Incinerator Cannons that fire streams or bursts of heat/fire/plasma over considerable distances, jet boosters in your shoulders aiding both in speed and limited flight, arm-blades, detachable limbs you can replace and recall, and an array of sensors that can detect heat signatures, fast-moving objects, and other phenomena.
objects.title: Dr. Kuseno's Blessing (One Punch Man)

addons.text:
Your God Hand abilities have resonated with your mind and soul. Now, each has its own 12 lives, yet all three share resurrection, attack nullification, and "immunity against an attack you have experienced previously."

Instead of simply dying 12 times to be permanently killed, your enemies must deplete the 12 lives of your mind, body, and soul. Failure to do so—regardless of whether all 12 of your body’s lives are lost—will result in you coming back over and over without expending any of your remaining 24 (mind and soul) lives. To defeat you, they must either strike you with an attack that simultaneously causes the death of your mind, body, and soul, or find a way to physically kill you 12 times, mentally kill you 12 times, and destroy your soul 12 times, all in unique ways.

One strike of Hydra Venom will consume all 36 of your lives. While each life still requires a day to heal, your mind, body, and soul have independent timers, meaning you could theoretically regain three lives in a single day.
addons.title: BASAKA WA DARE NI MO MAKENAI SEKAI DE ICHIBAN TSUYOI DAKARA!

addons.text: The poison immunity inherent to you as one of the Three Great Monsters has not just removed God Hand's one weakness, but actually inverted it. Because in addition to poisons and alcohol incrementally empowering you, consuming them now also increases the speed with which you recover spent lives, with the amount of time gained depending on both the quantity and the potency of the poison or booze. Hydra venom however, once God Hand's Achilles Heel, will now instantly restore your reserve of lives back to full, no matter how many you had left previously.
addons.title: Inversion of the Great Oni

objects.text:
This is the continuously active-type Noble Phantasm of Hercules that grants him a "body that knows no death." It is a blessing/curse of the gods, representing immortality, that was granted to him for completing his Twelve Labors in life. It lacks an overt external manifestation such as a weapon or armor, but is the body of the user itself. Because of this, it transforms your body into a tough suit of armor that acts similarly to a conceptual weapon in practice, as a side effect coloring your body like lead.

God Hand has three effects: Resurrection up to 12 times, attack nullification, and "immunity against an attack you have experienced previously."

God Hand applies a conceptual defense, meaning it cannot be worn down. It defends against all attacks of B-rank quality and lower, regardless of the attack being physical or magical in nature. It also grants the effect of automatic regeneration, including resurrection after death, reviving you with a stock of eleven extra lives. You have lives equaling the number of lives, rendering you an "immortal" being who must be killed twelve times to be fully eliminated. For you to be damaged, an attack of A-rank quality or above is needed, meaning that a C-rank attack, no matter how amped up, would still be nullified by God Hand. Even should an attack be capable of destroying the world, since it lacks the Metaphysical Weight needed to get past God Hand.

Unlike Magic Resistance that completely nullifies the attack, God Hand instead allows the attack to take effect without registering any damage. This allows you to attack without even thinking of defense due to it, since they will simply bounce off without leaving a mark.

Multiple lives can be taken at once if the set amount of damage of each life is exceeded from an attack. While any damage can be healed within minutes, the lives lost require a day to heal for each life taken, though this can be sped up by dumping massive amounts of energy into God Hand for faster restocking of lives or healing. Every time you are harmed by an attack, regardless of whether it leads to death or not, you will gain resistance after you heal. In the case of being damaged by flames, you would gain around "+100 fire resistance" after healing. Rather than rendering them "completely ineffective," it makes subsequent attacks almost useless against you. No matter the power of the ability used to kill you, it will be nullified after you resurrect. Even the greatest attack will not be effective on you twice and will require different methods to take each subsequent life.

The one weakness to God Hand due to Heracles' legend is that it is ineffective against Hydra venom. One single strike from a venom-coated dagger is enough to eat through all of God Hand's lives and possibly kill you if you don't set yourself on fire like Hercules once had to.
objects.title: God Hand: The Twelve Labors (Type-Moon)

addons.text: You are no longer human, fully embracing your monstrous self. The less “human” you are, the greater the power you will gain.
addons.title: Monstrous Strength (Type Moon)

addons.text: You are now far more werewolf than a normal Sirius is. As a result, your beast-like state is far easier to access, enhances you far more, and has less of a limit. Physically, when using your beast-like state, you now gain claws and sharp and pointy canines. But as a side effect of being more of a werewolf, you are naturally more beastlike. With time, you could learn to transform like the ancient Sirius could.
addons.title: Beast Blood

objects.text: Your true history and existence have been distorted by the monstrous reputations and gossip. As a consequence, your abilities and appearance have been rendered to conform to this. This is both a boon and a curse. This will empower your capabilities, but beware as the more power you gain from this skill, the more distorted you are, and the more monstrous you become, warping both mind and body. Be careful to remember who you truly are, and not be consumed by these distortions.
objects.title: Innocent Monster (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
So long as your will to survive demands it, your body will continue to regenerate—even from the most grotesque and catastrophic injuries—without pause. The intensity of your regeneration is directly tied to your sheer desire to live, allowing wounds to close faster the stronger your resolve becomes.

This process ignores the typical need for stamina or supernatural energy, forcibly postponing all physical backlash of such an act until after the threat to your life has passed and the effect of Battle Continuation wears off.

However, once survival is no longer the immediate concern, your body will demand its payment back in full. The accumulated debt—every torn muscle, shattered bone, and drop of blood spent—will strike you all at once. Which may plunge you into a coma, render you unconscious, or leave you in a state of extreme exhaustion and collapse. The severity and duration of the aftermath will depend entirely on the magnitude of the damage you endured.
addons.title: Guts

objects.text:
You can push your body past its natural limits, continuing to fight even under the most horrific conditions—as if nothing were wrong. Whether you've been disemboweled, lost a significant portion of your midsection, suffered from a neck wound that should have been fatal, or are simply missing your entire lower half, you can keep going, driven solely by your will alone.

As long as your determination and will to survive remain steadfast, you're able to move and fight until your body is—so utterly ruined beyond repair that it may no longer function.

While this ability allows you to persist through fatal injuries, it does not ensure your survival once the effect ends. Even if you defeat your enemy, you may—still succumb to your wounds afterward.
objects.title: Battle Continuation (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Through a combination of your unique constitution and your ability to draw strength from the sun and the time of day, your restrictions have eased and your power has grown. Your greatest form, known as The One, is now active between 9 AM and noon, and again from 3 PM until sunset. This means it no longer activates briefly at the peak of noon but instead remains active for several hours each day, even manifesting twice within the same day. Further empowered by the Numeral of the Saint, this form is three times as powerful as it would have been on its own.
addons.title: Solar Trinity

addons.text:
The combination of your solar- and lunar-attuned well of mana, along with your unique constitution, has eased the restrictions once placed upon both. From the moment the sun begins to rise, your mana will naturally regenerate, increasing in speed as it approaches 9 AM. At this holy hour, you gain the infinite mana supply that was once only available at noon, and the double boost to your magic now combines with your constitution’s similar enhancement to become a sixfold increase to every stat, parameter, and power.

Previously, your constitution’s effect ended at 3 PM, but now it lasts until sunset. And due to your well, the entire cycle activates again at midnight and continues until 3 AM.
addons.title: Cycle of Radiance

objects.text:
Like Gawain, the Knight of the Sun, you possess a special constitution—one that draws power from the light of the sun itself. As its golden weight settles upon you, it grants a portion of its might, making you more than you were. While under its daylight glow, your strength sharpens, your magic flows with ease, your steps grow lighter, and your stamina holds firm. You breathe easier, simply feeling better.

But it is during the sacred hours—between 9 AM and noon, and again from 3 PM until sunset—that this ability truly makes itself known. In these windows, you become three times greater than before, with every stat, parameter, and power accounted for.
objects.title: Numeral of the Saint (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Once, long ago, you were only a mere man, ignorant of the T̶̤̅͐ṙ̶̛̭̤̣͚͊̑̀͆̿́͗̀͆͒̌͒̓ǘ̴͚͈̤̤̞̲̮̤͎̳̠͍̓͊̎̈͐̈̽̇͆̂̅͋̚͠t̷̖̳̫̓͆̈́̀̄̒͒͌̓͘͠͝͝ḩ̸̩̱̘̝̟̘͛͌̇̀͜. Now you are greater, closer than ever to ascension and death in equal measure. After a trip to Yharnam and the signing of a Eldritch contract, you were given a blood transfusion, resulting in you gaining incredible power and an Eldritch blessing. 

You are gifted with power far above that of a mortal man and even greater than your fellow infected—you hit with enough force to level city blocks and move with speed effortlessly surpassing sound; your agility is even more frightening, as you now move like an Olympic acrobat in combat.

You can take as much as you can dish out in a pure contest of durability, even greater due to your enhanced healing factor which heals injuries, excluding complete organ destruction and limb removal, in mere minutes. This healing is massively accelerated by the injection of blood, and blood infused with Eldritch energy is even more effective. Your senses are similarly enhanced to an inhuman degree as you gain a preternatural tracking ability and a bonus in all attributes when fighting Beasts.

As a hunter, you also gain more esoteric abilities such as being able to now see and interact with the horrifying eldritch forces that occupy the cosmos. This awareness will start small with things like minor eldritch creatures but it can grow to the point of being able to safely interact with Eldritch Gods.

Your blood also now acts as a divine vessel of power, enhancing its effectiveness in all magics and granting imbued weapons and artifacts with greater power in both offense and defense. Blood from fallen/murdered enemies can be used to enhance yourself, physically, mentally and magically. It even has the capacity to enhance the potency of the eldritch power rushing through your veins.

You are also granted incredibly powerful "bullets", eldritch in nature, with can be loaded into any ranged weapon with a thought. This supply is limited, however, and can only be replenished through a sacrifice of your own blood or after a 24-hour period. You have eldritch blood vials for healing which also replenishes every 24 hours, and there is no other way to get these back unless you make your own.

You are now functionally immortal—every time you die, you are transported backwards, in both time and space, to a safe, secure, and personally significant place. and will be able to teleport to a relatively safe place within 100ft of your body after you get there. You will always appear exactly 5 minutes before you died or before you engaged in whatever battle you may be participating in.

Be warned, however, for all the good this power does, it is also easily capable of great harm. This power makes you capable of withstanding the Eldritch truth but it does not make you able to handle the stress and strain this puts on you, for your Will will be your only guide on this long and winding path ahead.

Even greater a danger is that of Beastdom, the blood has granted you a second persona so to say. It is not intelligent or sapient in any capacity but if your will ever breaks, the strain of the ever long night becomes too much and bloodlust eats at your senses. This other persona will eat what is left of you and spit out a vicious beast, one that is even more powerful than you and dangerously skilled—it will kill many and you will be its first victim.
objects.title: Hunter (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Embrace the Fear of humanity and transform into a Devil that embodies those fears. As you activate this ability, you undergo a terrifying transformation, assuming the form of a formidable Devil that embodies a specific concept feared by humans. For example, as a Storm Devil, you can conjure sudden heavy storms and call down lightning strikes to unleash devastation upon your foes.

The strength of your powers as a Devil is intricately tied to the level of fear humanity harbors towards the concept you embody. The more they fear and believe in the power of the concept, the stronger you become, fueling your abilities with their collective terror.

In addition, you possess the ability to form contracts with humans, allowing them to borrow a fraction of your power in exchange for a cost they must pay. This contract enables them to wield a portion of your fearsome abilities, empowering them in battle, but they must bear the consequences or fulfill the agreed-upon terms.
objects.title: What Do You Fear? (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
You are the physical incarnation of a warship into human form. As a ship, you can walk on water as if it were land and move at the speed your ship half can (~35 knots). You have the displacement and radar cross section of your ship-self, on land you can consciously alter this to avoid destroying the floor.

At will you can summon your rigging which is a representation of your ship-self's equipment. Despite their small size, your weapons deal damage that can even exceed their full-sized counterparts. In addition to this, due to MSSB (Magical Sparkly Shipgirl Bullshit), you have minor mystical abilities that allow you to enhance your performance beyond your normal limits for a short time.

You are limited to ships of light tonnage, Submarines, Destroyers, Light Cruisers, Light Carriers, or Support Ships from the second world war or before. You will have the appearance of a girl even if you were not before. Light ships tend to look on the younger side.
objects.title: Light Shipgirl (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
You are the physical incarnation of a warship into human form. As a ship, you can walk on water as if it were land and move at the speed your ship half can (~35 knots). You have the displacement and radar cross section of your ship-self, on land you can consciously alter this to avoid destroying the floor.

At will you can summon your rigging which is a representation of your ship-self's equipment. Despite their small size, your weapons deal damage that can even exceed their full-sized counterparts. In addition to this, due to MSSB (Magical Sparkly Shipgirl Bullshit), you have minor mystical abilities that allow you to enhance your performance beyond your normal limits for a short time.

You are limited to ships of high tonnage, Battlecruisers, Battleships, and Aircraft Carriers from the second world war or before. You will have the appearance of a girl even if you were not before. Heavy ships tend to look on the older side.
objects.title: Heavy Shipgirl (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
You gain phenomenal strength, speed, armor, flight and energy beams. At their base level, these attributes are on the level of a high tier cape. You have a power reserve that you can call on to focus into one of these attributes to supercharge it. In extreme cases you can even draw against your other abilities to “max out” an attribute giving you staggering capabilities.

Your body will slowly improve over time to reach peak human physical ability, your looks will also improve with it. Your biology is heavily modified, your skin takes on the appearance of solid gold (or another metal if you with it so) and your blood is a purple liquid.
objects.title: Maxima (Grrl Power)

addons.text:
There’s an awful lot of you you go around. Your Inner Beast can act on each of your bodies independently, both able to take control of them, as expected, and being able to be substituted for one in order to physically manifest.

If manifested like this, your Inner Beast benefits from most any effect that would count one of your bodies as ‘you’, including the resilience gained from having less bodies present.
addons.title: Beasts of Burden

objects.text:
You can teleport to any place you've been to before or anywhere within your line-of-sight. Whenever you teleport, you can choose to move one of your existing bodies there or create a new body at the destination. You can have a maximum of 5 bodies at a time, and you can dismiss any body at will unless you have only one.

Your mind exists simultaneously across all of your bodies and your multitasking capability increases with the number of bodies you have active. Your physical strength and resilience double for each body under 5 to a maximum of 16.
objects.title: Harem (Grrl Power)

addons.text: Your transformations are derived from the Red, the force that permeates and connects all animal life in the universe. As your connection to this Elemental Realm deepens, you become able to access more and vastly stronger transformations, such as the mythological with creatures like dragons or demons, or even aliens such as a star conqueror or Tameranians. With practice you could develop the ability to produce chimeric forms or even transform into speculative animals through The Red's connection to all Animal life, real or otherwise.
addons.title: The Bleeding Edge

addons.text:
Your connection has become a bit strange, allowing you to mimic robotic or similarly machine species as much as animal life. 

While on one hand this allows you to mimic more species, and furthermore mimic technology you have an understanding of similar to your animal transformations, it also allows you to retain integrated tech as you transform in any number of configurations similarly to a partial transformation. 

For instance, integrating a plasma cannon and transforming into a wolf could let you choose whether the cannon was mounted on the wolf, internal from the mouth, or something stranger besides.
addons.title: Booyah?

addons.text:
Sometimes it pays to have the universe’s genetic repository on your wrist. 

In addition to having Earth’s creatures at your disposal, possession of the Omnitrix gives you access to the fauna of their home localles. While initially this includes the obvious ‘Predators’ such as the Panuncian of Hathor and the Tyrannopede of Terradino, it encompasses the vast majority of animal life from these homeworlds. These are treated much the same as any of your other beast transformations.

This notably only includes Animal life, notably not including flora or mineral life that fulfils the same role in their ecosystems, like might be found in a ‘complete’ Nematrix.
addons.title: And Beyond!

objects.text:
You have become the Avatar of all Faunas, ala Beast Boy. This grants you an extraordinary ability to connect with and transform into the vast array of Earth's fauna. With a mental catalog and perfect indexing of every single creature that has ever existed on Earth, you possesses unparalleled knowledge of their strengths, weaknesses, and capabilities. This comprehensive understanding extends to every creature's biology, behavior, and innate abilities.

The power allows you to swiftly shapeshift into any animal form contained within your mental catalog. This transformation can seamlessly transition between forms, adapting to the needs of any situation. Whether it's the keen eyesight of an eagle, the agility of a monkey, or the strength of a gorilla, you can selectively manifest specific animal aspects without undergoing a full transformation.

Any animal form you harness are at its absolute peak potential. Even in partial transformations, the manifested animal aspects are maximized, pushing the boundaries of natural ability. Through training and practice, you can enhance these forms, making them even stronger than their natural counterparts.
