Moreover, the mental catalog of fauna continually updates itself. Whenever you explore a new planet, your mental catalog of the Faunas expands. This ensures that you always possess the most up-to-date information and can adapt to the unique creatures you encounter in alien worlds.
objects.title: Beast of No Nation (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Just as Diana is a descendant of Zeus, you are now also descended from the gods. Your divinity merges seamlessly with your Amazon heritage, bestowing a vast array of improvements and new abilities. You aren't limited to just the gods however, you could instead descend from another prominent figure in Greek Myth. 

Perhaps gaining an inheritance of powers from Medusa or Hercules? Maybe even from the Chimera, Minotaur, or Cerberus? You have full control over how these powers manifest, and they will continue to improve and adapt to you over time.

You could also apply this to gods and other creatures outside of the Greek Pantheon.
addons.title: Divine Inheritance
Amazon Prime
addons.text: Your perfect physicalities and divine blessings have synergized, making you the ultimate example of an Amazonian warrior. You're now stronger & tougher; enough to lift 30,000 tons with no effort and come out unharmed after tanking hits from ballistic missiles. Your regeneration rate also has increased; minor to moderate wounds fade in a blink of an eye and severe ones, such as pulverized bones and missing organs, require at most a day to heal. You are now faster too; in atmosphere you easily surpass hypersonic speed and can even reach 0.999c in space. Your mental and magical strength have also reached new heights; multilingualism, perfect memory, genius-level intellect, and enough sorcerous might to rival the Homo Magi are now yours to have. If you also have the Princess of Themyscira upgrade, then any powers that have measurable numerical values are enhanced by a factor of 3. Additionally, you may choose to also gain the powers/skills of any version of Diana you would like. From Pre-Infinite Crisis Wonder Woman's dimensional teleportation to the arcane spells of her Absolute version, these are just a few examples of your expanded repertoire.

objects.text:
You’ve been blessed by the Olympian Gods, being reborn as an Amazon. This bestows you with several abilities, starting with superhuman strength, durability, speed, agility, stamina, and reflexes.

You can fly, along with your senses and healing factor also being enhanced. This allows you to recover from mild to moderate injuries within seconds, as well as achieve self sustenance and immortality.

Unlike other Amazons, you have full access to these powers even when outside of Themyscira.

You have the potential to match or even surpass the physical and fighting prowess of Princess Diana, as well as the combat knowledge from all styles of Amazon martial arts, all forms of weaponry on Themyscira, and proficiency in horseback riding.

Finally, you have an increased affinity for learning and wielding magic.
objects.title: Amazon (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You've become a conduit of the Speed Force—a cosmic energy field centered on velocity and movement—granting you superhuman abilities, much like Barry Allen, The Flash.

The primary power this grants is super speed, but the Speed Force also grants several auxiliary abilities, including—but not limited to—accelerated healing, a protective Speed Force aura, and, with training, electrokinesis, dimensional travel, and time travel.

While you begin at speeds comparable to Jay Garrick—roughly 20 times the speed of sound—you’re rapidly becoming faster and have the potential to surpass all known speedsters. To match this velocity, your reflexes and perception scale proportionally, and you can even channel the Speed Force to accelerate your thoughts while stationary.
objects.title: Speed Force (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You've become a conduit of the Still Force, a cosmic force opposite of the Speed Force based on entropy and inertia, and allows its conduits to negate motion, with the potential to induce and accelerate the force of entropy.

With the Still Force, you can decelerate or halt the aging process, drain the life force from others, steal the motion of everything around you to the point that time seems to stop for you and you seem to have super speed to others, as well as even create physical constructs. With enough power and mastery, you can use the Still Force to stop the expansion of the universe.
objects.title: Still Force (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You've become a conduit of the Strength Force, a cosmic force similar to the Speed Force based on gravity, density, mass and the Force of Motion.

With the Strength Force, you can manipulate the mass and density of your muscle and bones to enhance your strength and durability to the point of becoming almost invincible, capable of tanking almost anything, and increasing your strength with no limits. This makes you always as strong as you need to—being able to lift, adapt and sustain by any means related to the Laws of Physics, such as mass, gravity and force. This can make you or anything you choose to affect as infinitely heavier, tougher, denser and/or muscularly more robust. Using it on yourself causes an increase in size.

The only drawback is that when you apply this power to increase your strength, you lose a bit of your invincibility and vice versa. Using the Strength Force, you can manipulate gravity and the Force of Motion in many ways, such as changing your relativity in relation to your strength output, making your punches even more powerful than they should; covering your body in stones and fiery rocks, and even causing the earth to shift at your will.

With enough power and mastery, you can create constructs made of Strength Force energy and even compact mass to deform spacetime to form a black hole.

Your power can use Infinite Values in terms of mass, force and gravity, meaning you can increase them infinitely—although, having this energy can be very catastrophic to spacetime if used irresponsibly. It also provides you the protection to function with unnatural mass, density and gravity without the laws of physics stopping you or destroying everything around.
objects.title: Strength Force (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your ever-shifting molecular structure inherits Unbound Form’s composition, settling into complete control of your physical being. Aspects such as your density, size, shape, quantity, chemical, material, and genetic composition are yours to manipulate in every conceivable form, your molecular structure fully under your command, your creativity being your sole limitation. Unbound Form’s alteration also mitigates your weakness to extreme temperatures, as your plasticity gains insulating and dissipating qualities. You also benefit from infusing your boundless shifting qualities to objects/people you touch, turning a pebble into a mouse and vice versa, while also bestowing your powers on inorganic/organic materials for a variable time, its standard limit being around half an hour after contact.
addons.title: Formlessness

objects.text:
You exist in a fluid state, not entirely liquid nor solid, with complete control over your molecular structure. With this control, you have the capability to shape shift into various positions and sizes impossible for ordinary humans. You can stretch your limbs and body to superhuman lengths and sizes with no limit to how far you can stretch. You can flatten yourself to slide under a door. You can shrink to a few inches in height or grow to rival skyscrapers. Your stretching powers also grant you super human agility and strength.

In addition to the powerful shape shifting, you are nigh invulnerable, able to withstand corrosives, punctures, and concussions without sustaining any injury. Your body is resistant to high velocity impacts that would kill an ordinary person, resistant to blasts from energy weapons, and is completely bullet proof. Your body is able to regenerate and assimilate lost or damaged tissue and does not age.

However, you are weak to extreme heat and sudden temperature changes, inducing a change of phase, rendering you completely solid or completely liquid. You will also lose your integrity if exposed to solvents such as acetone.
objects.title: Plastic Man (DC Comics)

addons.text:
As an energy being at your core, your abilities have become massively more potent while trapped inside your Dilusteel shell. Your ability to play with the fundamental forces of the universe is near limitless within your understanding, giving you incredibly fine control over your matter manipulation and creation.

Similarly, as a being of pure energy, when your shell is pierced you’re no longer in danger of your shell leaking radiation when ruptured. Instead, you can shed your shell to assume your full and stable energy form until you can rebuild the shell.

Additionally, your physical body has a sort of ‘grounding’ effect, performing a low level ‘psychic maintenance’ on your mind, keeping you largely stable in most circumstances, or at least allowing you to return to such a state.
addons.title: The Unthinkable

addons.text:
Being unable to bring yourself together, your Dilusteel skin can perform two purposes. 

Firstly, it can form a body allowing you to act independently. While this allows you to act within your own form, you lose any benefits from your Ionic Form while within your Dilusteel shell. 

Secondly, when imbuing someone so you can act through them, you can cover their body with Dilusteel, and use any of your own abilities through them at their full might. Being two minds this might actually make you more effective as you both can focus on different aspects while acting (having one focus on altering the surroundings and the other focus on physically brawling for instance).
addons.title: Imbuement
The Atom Project (DC Comics)
addons.text: With control over pure nuclear power and the Quantum field, you’ve become a walking architect of matter. With near complete dominion over the material world, you’re far more able to affect things on the grand scale, as well as the minute. From exchanging individual atoms, rearranging molecules piece by piece, to turning barren asteroids into lush paradises, warping gravity, and tearing holes in spacetime. If this wasn’t enough, as the pinnacle of the Atom Project you’ve gained access to its most dangerous aspect, the ability to disrupt metahuman powers. With a little analysis and effort you can nullify, replicate or create metahuman abilities and other exotic effects by tampering with the quantum field and stabilising it into reality. If you have access to the Shine through The Fury of Firestorm then this will extend to magic and magical effects as well, allowing you to edit and warp its rules in your vicinity through your connection to it.

objects.text:
You gain a connection to the Quantum Field similar to that of Captain Atom and Major Force. First, this gives you the ability to partially or fully coat your body in a metal called Dilusteel, granting you a superhuman physiology that allows you to keep up with Kryptonians. Beneath the Dilusteel, your innards become pure energy, granting you the ability to sense energy like electronic transmissions and to see at the quantum level.

Second, you possess powerful energy manipulation and absorption, capable of producing blasts that can hurt beings as strong as Martian Manhunter. Your capacity to absorb energy is virtually unlimited. This can range from quantum energy, red sun energy, and antimatter, just to name a few possibilities. You can also manipulate other fundamental forces, with applications such as gravity manipulation that can be used for flight. 

Third, you can create and manipulate inorganic or organic matter almost instantaneously. Creating dark matter is practically effortless for you, as is turning arrows into butterflies or people into dust.

Finally, you have the ability to travel through time. For now you can only make  jumps an hour into the past or future, but with extreme training you can travel to any time period.  You can also travel to other realms and universes through the Quantum Field, but this is extremely difficult even with practice. Your quantum energies also give you high resistance to magic and telepathy.

All of the above powers can be enhanced even further by drawing on the Quantum Field.

Unlike Captain Atom, you do not have to worry about being thrown forward into time if you absorb too much energy.
objects.title: Quantum Field (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your High pushes you further into desire, with nothing to stop you. Every time you ignite, your flames will permanently burn brighter, your powers grow stronger, and you feel even BETTER. Nothing is impossible for you; the question is, are you High enough to do it?
addons.title: High Monster

addons.text: Thanks to your first-hand experience, you gained a talent for making alchemical drugs involving addictive substances. Your psychokinetic flames can be used in alchemy to transfer the effects of any substance you are high on to anything you are cooking up. Allowing you to turn even simple healing potions into addictive elixirs that will give cravings even after a sliver of exposure.
addons.title: Drug Lord

addons.text: Your powers evolved even beyond, turning you into The Addiction Devil. This allows you to give anybody an addiction to anything and control its associated side effects on a conceptual level. You could make them crave literal poison, give them shivers without praying your name, or get them hungover from tap water.
addons.title: Addiction Devil

addons.text:
Everything you tried up until now was mere child's play. If cocaine is your god, then it just blessed you with its ambrosia.

When you use the ambrosia, you gain the strength to go toe-to-toe with the Man of Steel himself while having all other abilities heightened to that level. When sprinkled into other drugs, they'll also elevate you to similar levels in their respective abilities.
addons.title: Cocaine Ambrosia

addons.text: The power of the Black and White Powders have combined within you for explosive results. When you ingest both gunpowder and cocaine in a balanced mixture your flames become a constant explosion, tearing the very atmosphere around you asunder! Your pain immunity mixes with your healing factor, renders the weapons of mere mortals nothing before you. Time itself practically screeches to a halt when you are gripped in the flaring fire of your high. With enough experimentation, you can discover similar drug and explosive combinations that provide different benefits. Be warned, you must never let the scintillating flames of your high burn out, lest you be brought low by the crash.
addons.title: Bakugo on Crack

addons.text: People say that addiction is a sin, except that can't be true, for it is the greatest of virtues, and the high you get is a gift from God. The use of the Blessed Blunts imbues you with the sacred power of a Saint, all of your powers are infused with holy energy while under the influence of the Blessed Blunts. You have become a divine instrument of your God's will.
addons.title: Saint of Addiction

objects.text: Cocaine is my god… And I am the human instrument of its will! You gained the powers of Snowflame, the cocaine-fueled supervillain. When you are high on an addictive substance(s), your every cell burns with white-hot ecstasy, igniting your whole body with psychokinetic flames, giving you a massive all-around physical boost and pyrokinetic powers, as well as immunity to pain, accelerated thought, and heightened mental senses. By default, your power runs on cocaine, but it’s possible to use it with other substances, which may grant different abilities with the effects of supernatural drugs massively empowered. Your touch can also induce the effects of your own drug-fueled high, depending on what kind of substances you consumed to activate your power. Your body and mind adapted, allowing you to live a drug-addicted lifestyle without major implication. You will still feel the complete effects of the substances, but they don’t cause any long-term harm to your biology, with this even removing pesky side effects like being hungover from alcohol. But be careful as this doesn’t prevent psychological addiction, so you can and will become an addict, and no one is safe from your Terrible Amazing Power.
objects.title: Snowflame (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Something has changed. Your body, once only mutable clay, has absorbed the divine potential of the Clay of Life. The line between mimicry and creation has blurred. Your transformations—already uncanny—have crossed into something deeper, more real.

By drawing on the Clay of Life within you, you can reshape yourself into creatures or people with such completeness that you are no longer merely a lookalike—you are functionally identical to the form you take. You gain not just the outer shape, but also the biological traits, abilities, and natural functions of your chosen form. You can become a creature with wings and truly fly, take on gills and breathe underwater, grow venomous fangs and produce real poison. As long as you have enough Clay of Life to support the transformation, your body adapts at a fundamental level, behaving as though it were genuinely made of flesh, bone, or scale—though, beneath it all, you remain clay.

You can also do what Clayface once accidentally did—you can separate a part of yourself, imbuing it with your consciousness. You can inhabit your creations mentally, controlling them as extensions of yourself, or, given enough clay of life and mastery, let them act semi-independently, puppets with your intent or something dangerously close to it. These entities are limited by your available supply of Clay of Life, as only that clay can support true animation or autonomy. Regular clay remains inert beyond your personal control and cannot achieve the same depth of realism or function.

Any form or creature made using Clay of Life is freed from the usual weaknesses of clay. They are not vulnerable to water, extreme heat, or cold in the way your original form was. However, in becoming more lifelike, they also inherit the natural vulnerabilities of whatever they resemble. A cold-blooded creature may become sluggish in cold weather; a flying creature might suffer from wing tears or hollow bone fragility.

You also gain a new, subtle power: the ability to convert your body’s normal clay into Clay of Life over time. Passively, this conversion happens at a rate of 1 cubic centimeter per day. With focused effort, you can actively accelerate the transformation, achieving somewhere between 10 to 20 times that rate depending on your concentration and stamina. This allows you to expand your supply over time without needing to wait for the monthly additions.

When your next 30-day cycle completes and your Clay of Life is replenished, the new volume is automatically absorbed into your clay body, merging seamlessly with your form. As a result, your shapeshifting grows more powerful, more stable, and more disturbingly lifelike with each passing month.
addons.title: Annie

objects.text:
Your flesh is no longer flesh. Your bones, blood, and skin have all been replaced with living clay—dense, viscous, and fully under your control. You gain the full metahuman ability set of Clayface, becoming a being of pure morphable matter.

You can twist and contort your body into nearly any form imaginable. You may swell into a monstrous colossus, flatten into a slick pool, stretch into tendrils or blades, or forge limbs into blunt weapons or precision tools. Every part of you can be reshaped in real time, limited only by your creative vision and your ability to control your mass. You can slide through cracks, climb surfaces by molding grip into your hands and feet, or erupt from the ground with sudden force.

You also gain the power to mimic other people with astonishing physical accuracy. With enough observation, you can replicate someone’s body, facial features, and even voice so perfectly that you could fool nearly any eye or ear. However, this transformation is entirely external. You do not form real bones, organs, or internal systems—everything remains clay beneath the surface. A close enough inspection, magical scan, or medical examination would reveal the truth: you are a seamless imitation, not a true copy.

Your clay body grants immense resilience. You are immune to bleeding, bruising, and broken bones—because you no longer possess any. Conventional weapons are almost useless against you: bullets, blades, and blunt force simply pass through or displace your form. You can recover from most physical damage near-instantly, reassembling yourself with a thought. You no longer need to eat, breathe, or sleep. You do not age. Poisons and diseases no longer apply to you. You are no longer limited by the needs or frailties of biology.

However, your new form comes with vulnerabilities. Water is your greatest natural enemy. Sufficient exposure to water—whether through heavy rain, high-pressure hoses, or submersion—can weaken your cohesion, dilute your mass, and render you unable to maintain complex shapes. In such a state, you may collapse into an inert slurry, needing time and effort to reconstitute yourself. Extreme cold can harden you and make you brittle; extreme heat can soften you into something formless and sluggish. While your body regenerates, losing too much clay can weaken you or limit your transformations until you regain it.
objects.title: Clayface (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Your body, once a radioactive curse, now serves as the perfect medium for the Firestorm Matrix. Where others must share the burden of Firestorm’s power between two minds, your phosphorus-irradiated form adapts to it alone—painfully, violently, but completely. You are no longer just a nuclear anomaly. You are the atom's will, given wrath and purpose.

The fusion of the Matrix with your already-unstable atomic structure stabilizes both and unleashes something far more dangerous: an awakened resonance with The Shine—a scarcely understood, possibly pre-universal force that permeates all expressions of fire, plasma, and atomic change. Rumored to be the hidden layer beneath both flame and fission, The Shine manifests unpredictably but with unmistakable power.

Through this connection, your control over radioactive fire and plasma evolves into elemental manipulation at a quantum level. You may ignite or snuff fire with a thought, manipulate ionic bonds directly, or destabilize matter into radiation and reforge it into new forms—crude transmutation through destructive force. Unlike standard Firestorm users, your abilities are instinctive, aggressive, and often irreversible. You do not rearrange atoms—you burn reality down and rewrite the ashes.

Your very presence now distorts Geiger counters, magnetic fields, and the minds of weaker telepaths. Flames near you warp unnaturally, casting no light. Plasma responds to your mood. You have become a living crack in the atomic order—a walking paradox tethered to The Shine.

You are not just a man of fire. You are its consequence.
addons.title: Monarch of The Shine

objects.text:
You have undergone the same atomic catastrophe as Dr. Alex Sartorius—Doctor Phosphorus. Your flesh has transmuted into a translucent shell of burning phosphorus, your skeleton glowing like a walking reactor. You are a living nuclear furnace, eternally ablaze with hellish green fire that cannot be extinguished.

You emit intense heat and radiation capable of igniting steel, melting concrete, and poisoning anything nearby. You can launch nuclear flame, superheat the air into plasma, and incinerate a tank in seconds. Immune to fire, heat, and radiation, your body no longer requires food, water, or rest—only containment.

Your strength and durability are massively enhanced—enough to crumble walls, punch through concrete, and endure bullets, explosions, and blows from metahumans like Frankenstein or Clayface. Your reflexes are fast enough to react at Mach speeds.

However, due to the transformation your appearance has become inhuman, your visage a haunting reminder of the cost of tampering with atomic forces. 

Like the element that remade you, you are unstable, lethal, and unrelenting—a walking meltdown waiting to happen.
objects.title: Doctor Phosphorus (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Your understanding of and ability to generate different materials and substances has been supercharged by your Osmosian physiology, now extending to incredibly complex and esoteric structures.

Firstly, you can generate far more complex substances, such as biological matter and even DNA, through the same process as other materials, needing to come into contact with more esoteric forms before being able to re-create them (though with trial and error you could theoretically manage some rudimentary success).

Secondly, you’re no longer limited to only physical pieces, able to construct and become various forms of energy just as you can with matter.

Finally, the complexity of objects you can create has increased massively, allowing you to generate full technology from your body, as long as you have the mass to sustain it and the understanding of its mechanisms to create it.
addons.title: Protean

objects.text:
You are the newest Metamorphae, a being crafted by the god Ra to battle the serpent Apep. Though your default patchwork form may seem odd, it grants unmatched versatility. Your malleable body can stretch, grow giant, shapeshift into human and animal forms, and produce duplicates.

You possess superhuman strength—enough to fight Kryptonians—and durability that withstands blows from the likes of the Flash and Despero. You can regenerate from nearly any damage, even atomization, by absorbing mass.

Your true strength lies in elemental transformation and control. You can transform into and project various substances—including liquid nitrogen, lava, acid, or knockout gas. You can become a gas for stealth or flight, liquid for evasion, or forge limbs into weapons or tools. With mastery over chemistry, you can transmute objects—even powerful artifacts like the Orb of Ra—into other elements, guided by an intuitive grasp of the periodic table. You can even produce extraterrestrial elements like Kryptonite, but you would need to come in contact with them first to understand their composition.
objects.title: Metamorphae (DC Comics)

objects.text:
There are those whom Death can’t take, notably, when it is a result of playing God. Thanks to undergoing an experimental injection of Tektites, a form of nanotechnology, you’ve gained abilities similar to the Resurrection Man, doing what it says on the tin, with a twist: you resurrect each time with a random power.

To be more in-depth, you become an immortal being in the general sense of the world, never aging or feeling its effects, to the extent of being nearly impossible to die. You find it impossible to be sick or need to eat, drink, or breathe. You resurrect instantly and automatically to any death you suffer, perfectly regenerating and recovering from any injuries and damages, no matter whether internal or external, you gained during and before your death, without a trace of scar. This extends from dismembering to plain bodily destruction. Your recovery puts you in a peak human condition, as healthy as possible. Oddly enough, you never lose a shred of your memories and personality if your head is destroyed.

Your resurrection offers a random power that is loosely linked to your most recent death, acting as a defensive measure to prevent the same death again, powers ranging from disposable to extraordinary, turning you into a being more powerful than the entirety of the Justice League if you “come back” right. Resurrecting replaces your previous power with the current one.

Your Tektites can also allow you to quickly chew and digest any substance, no matter the quantity, which stems from generating a variety of digestive enzymes that act on specific substances, making them easier to chew and digest.
objects.title: Resurrection Man (DC Comics)

addons.title: Mother Eye
addons.text:
Being created from new God technology, your Mother-Box has upgraded and enhanced you. Not only does it take all the responsibilities of Brother Eye and perform them to a far greater extent, it naturally feeds the strange energies into you, making you more akin to an ad-hoc New-God than anything you were previously.

By integrating the Mother Box into you you could harness this metaphysical technology and manage it though you, growing and adapting ever further as it facilitates your growth into a true god.

Furthermore, if you have any OMAC upgrades, the Mother Box would supercharge their own adaptive abilities, dramatically increasing the speed of this development.

objects.text: You have been modified by New-God technologies, turning you into a cyborg force of nature. Linked to the sapient satellite BROTHER EYE, you share a near telepathic connection to Brother Eye due to a brain-implant allowing you to converse with it. By itself it’s not only a potent surveillance tool capable of satellite imaging in a range of spectrums but carries a teleporter capable of transmitting a small crowd, and self-upgrading with technology available to it besides. It’s greatest defense and feature however, is you, it’s OMAC. You are a completely normal human until you receive Brother Eye’s signal, at which point your body grows and warps into a behemoth super-soldier fueled by technology pilfered from the New Gods. As this One-Machine Attack Construct you never tire, your reflexes are hyper-tuned and you’re tough and strong enough to survive hits from Superman, though unlikely to win the fight. Additionally, you can fire blasts of raw energy from your hands and chest with great force.
objects.title: One-Machine Attack Construct (DC Comics)

addons.title: Yes. I. Can!
addons.text: "100% -> 110% -> 120% -> 130%..." Your body is a perfect fusion of flesh and machine, with each side inheriting the strengths of the other. Your biological body can push your cybernetics beyond their normal specifications, while your cybernetics reinforce your biology against the consequences. You can temporarily exceed the hard limits of your body and technology through sheer determination. When something absolutely must be done, you can force your systems beyond their rated output, overclock your processors, drive your servos past their safety limits, and push your biological strength and endurance beyond what should be possible. The greater the need, the further you can push. A damaged Sonic Cannon can fire despite being over its operating limit, a failing power system can produce one last burst of output, and a body that should have collapsed can keep moving long enough to finish the job. This does not permanently increase your capabilities. Once the crisis passes, the consequences catch up with you. Overheated systems may shut down, damaged components may fail, and your body may be left exhausted or injured. However, while you are pushing yourself, your limits become suggestions rather than absolute barriers.

objects.text: Your body has been rebuilt with advanced cybernetics similar to Victor Stone from the Teen Titans show. Rather than replacing your humanity, the technology works alongside your biological body, granting enhanced strength, durability, and endurance while turning you into a walking arsenal and computer. Your cybernetic body is strong enough to overpower large opponents and perform feats far beyond human capability. It can withstand heavy impacts, extreme temperatures, and considerable physical punishment, although sufficiently powerful attacks can still damage or sever your mechanical components. Your primary weapons are a pair of Sonic Cannons built into your arms, capable of firing powerful sonic blasts over considerable distances. Smaller sonic weapons can also be deployed from your feet, while missiles can be launched from your shoulders and chest. Your body can produce various tools directly from its limbs, including saws, welding equipment, and other useful devices. Your limbs are detachable and can remain connected through cables or operate remotely. Detached hands and arms can be used as grappling devices, projectiles, or remote cameras, making them useful for reconnaissance and utility as well as combat. Your cybernetics include enhanced vision, targeting systems, sensors, communications equipment, and computer processing. You can interface directly with electronic systems and possess extensive knowledge of engineering, robotics, physics, and computer science. You are capable of designing and maintaining advanced machines, including vehicles such as the T-Car. Your cybernetics can be upgraded and repaired with suitable technology and parts, allowing your capabilities to expand as you gain access to better equipment. You are an exceptionally capable combatant and engineer, but your greatest strength is versatility. Whether fighting with your Sonic Cannons, brawling with your enhanced strength, building new technology, or using your cybernetics to solve an unexpected problem, you have the tools to handle almost anything. Note: The cybernetics are purely advanced human technology with no New God tech involved such as a Mother/Fatherbox.
objects.title: Cyborg (DC Comics: Teen Titans)

addons.text: Like Super Android 13 and Super 17, you can absorb materials into your body to become even greater than your current form. Whether it's raw metallic alloys, parts of another Android, advanced technology, or other esoteric sources. This can result in either simple enhancements, mutations, or a complete overhaul to your current form. You can both power down and change back to them as if they were your equivalent of a Saiyan Transformation. You have full control over the design of these forms.
addons.title: Super Androids

addons.text: It seems you've been implanted with parts from the Galatic Patrol Prisoner, OG73. An Android who can copy the powers and abilities of whoever he touches at the back of the neck. Thanks to the 108 Skills, you only need to be in close proximity, but physical contact—especially grasping your target's neck—will make the process much faster. Once successful, you receive a perfect replica of their powers and techniques, enough to be equally matched with them. If the target is weaker than you, then your own strength remains unchanged. However, you can only hold up to 3 powersets at a time, which uses 36 of your total slots per set. Any less will make the copied powers worse than the original, but provides the perk of malleability by fusing other powers into a set. Unlike OG73, once a powerset is formed, it stays with you permanently, unless willingly uninstalled.
addons.title: OG73
Engine Of Refinement
addons.text:
Your Infinite Energy Engine has been completely replaced by the Engine of Escalation, becoming a far more sophisticated and self-improving power core. 

Rather than merely supplying endless energy, it continuously refines every aspect of your android body, enhancing its efficiency, durability, and energy output beyond even the greatest creations of Dr. Gero, including Super 17. 

As a being engineered to wield limitless energy, you can safely channel the engine's full output at all times without straining or damaging yourself, allowing every improvement to be utilized immediately instead of being restricted by your body's capacity.

objects.text:
You have now become a robotic or cyborg human, whether a creation by a mad brilliant scientist in an underground laboratory or through a top-secret government project. The origins of your transformation are inconsequential, because you now embody the epitome of human evolution, with a powerful physical structure housing a core capable of generating an infinite amount of energy. This energy sustains your physical capabilities indefinitely, surpassing the heat death of the universe and enduring beyond. Fatigue is no longer a concern, and you can unleash energy attacks without limitation. However, this does not impede your potential for further growth in power and potency, similar to the progression observed in Saiyans or humans. 

There are no self-destruct mechanisms or failsafe programs integrated within your being; as you are entirely autonomous. Nevertheless, it is important to note, that your newfound form may lead to detachment from human emotions, potentially fostering a misguided sense of superiority. This can be mitigated through self-control and discipline.
objects.title: Androids (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
Having absorbed other androids, you have achieved your perfect form, a state of being that cements your position at the apex of the food chain. In this form, every aspect of your being experiences an exponential boost, elevating your intelligence, power, potential, coordination, and techniques to the highest attainable representation. This pinnacle of evolution marks only the beginning of your journey, as your perfect form now becomes the functional baseline for even greater heights.

In your perfected state, you experience unprecedented progress in training and development. Previously arduous and time-consuming endeavors now yield results thousands of times more rapidly, you also can tap into the power of your genetic heritage, whether accessing the Saiyan's transformations or the Frost Demon's. You are capable of unleashing a boundless might of your illustrious lineages.


The entire universe now bears witness to a being whose very existence redefines the boundaries of what is achievable.
addons.title: Perfect Form

objects.text:
You are now a bio-android of unprecedented genetic potential, a combination of the most potent genetic material from four distinct species: the Saiyans, Frost Demons, Namekians, and Humans. This amalgamation grants you a plethora of attributes, abilities and techniques, each species contributing to the creation of an unparalleled being.

From the Saiyans, you get Zenkai, allowing for exponential power growth after recovering from near-fatal injuries. The Frost Demons provide the ability to survive in the harsh vacuum of space and a resilient physique, making you adaptable to the most unhabitable of environments. With the regenerative abilities of the Namekians, you possesses a rapid healing factor, making recovery from injuries almost instantaneous.

Your single weakness is unique organ that acts as your Achilles' heel, requiring its destruction to achieve a permanent demise. Though you have the ability to relocate this tiny organ at will to any part of your body.

You start at your first form, and has the potential to amass more power through the absorption of life force through a special tail-like appendage, affixed to your back. While this is the fastest means of attaining strength, you also have other avenues to unlock your full potential.
objects.title: Bio-Android (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You've merged with the Big Gete Star, assimilating all of its abilities within you. You may choose if it comes with a sentient AI helper, or be a silent extension of yourself. 

You can coat your body in a mix of metal and wires, either partially or wholly, reinforcing your physique to be as strong and durable as titanium, with your freedom of movement still intact. You can also manipulate these wires for a variety of feats and attacks, such as tendrils that can stretch for miles, additional limbs, various shapes and constructs, reinforcing your internal organs, and then some. 

You have remarkable regeneration, to the point of reconstructing yourself even as half your body is cut clean off, or blown to bits. This relies on being able to connect and reform those destroyed parts, and will use any organic and inorganic material present within the environment to speed up the process. After each successful regeneration, the material of the Gete Star adapts and improves itself, becoming stronger and denser to avoid the same injury again. However, enough force and power can easily overwhelm and cancel out this process, and if every ounce of you is destroyed completely, you will be killed. 

You can create perfect clones of yourself indefinitely, all connected to a hivemind and will be absolutely loyal to you. They will also possess perfect copies of your abilities as well as the previously mentioned regeneration. Creating these cost resources in the form of matter, both organic and inorganic, but will be permanent once created. You can also create technology using this method.

You can absorb and assimilate any machinery and technology, gaining any and all functions, abilities, knowledge, and other aspects for yourself. This can also apply to organic matter to absorb their lifeforce and energy, or even be bestowed to others and grant them access to the Gete Star's powers. As the main host, you have full authority over the hivemind and other hosts, and choose what they do or don't have access to. 

Most importantly, you can "plant" a piece of yourself into the environment, absorbing the lifeforce and other energies of the local area, and even the entire planet you stand on to broaden the scope of your abilities and for other purposes, allowing you to operate on a massive scale. 

Note: It's highly recommended to have some form of protection should your main body be defeated or killed, as the entire hivemind and Gete Star will go down with you.
objects.title: Gete Star Host (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
The Robot Body, also known as the Alien Weapon Unit, is a formidable creation design by an Alien for unknown purpose. This unique body grants you incredible abilities and immunities. You require no maintenance, able to adapt and regenerate, as well as gaining resilience allowing you to initially withstand conventional and military-grade firearms, though tanks may pose a challenge. Furthermore, you are able to enter a temporary boosted form that greatly multiplies all your abilities tenfold. 

Equipped with a jetpack featuring folding thrusters, your body is capable of limitless flight, even in space. Your immense strength enables you to effortlessly toss multiple people or lift multiple planes simultaneously. You can easily rip apart meteorites with ease.

Your mind, housed within a supercomputer, enables you to run swift simulations to predict outcomes, aided by an advanced A.I. that compiles data 24/7 through your enhanced senses that can perfectly hear and see within a radius of 100 km. 

Your body possesses a direct interface with technology, allowing you to access satellite links, cameras, social media, and government databases. You can remotely manipulate banking systems, automobiles, and electronic screens. By integrating electronic devices, you gain USB ports and the ability to locate individuals near technological equipment. You're even equipped with a medical technology that grant you the ability to cure wounds, diseases, and even resurrect the recently deceased.

In the event you become unconscious due to damage, your body enters autopilot to neutralize the threats. Built-in weapons include multi lasers, rockets, an invisible laser weapon, arm cannons, and a self-destruct mechanism capable of obliterating half of Earth.

Within this robotic form, you become an unstoppable force, equipped to face any challenge that comes your way.
objects.title: Aliens Are Real, And They Turned Me Into A Robot! (Inuyashiki)

addons.text:
Your fel blood and ancient werewolf heritages have mixed to make something far more monstrous: a fel-infused hellhound, ominously known as a Hel Hound. By drawing on this transformation, you become far more beastlike and demonic, with your eyes and veins glowing a putrid green, instead of a Sirius’s bright blue, as fel energy floods your body. This results in your beast-like state being significantly more powerful than that of even the strongest Sirius, allowing you to draw far greater strength at the cost of becoming more demonic and increasingly consumed by rage and destruction.

While in this state, your resistance to magic is greatly enhanced, wounds inflicted by your claws are harder to heal, and by channeling fel energy, you can coat your physical attacks, particularly your claws, in fel fire, which burns hotter than ordinary flames and is far more difficult to extinguish.

But overusing this power, or losing yourself to rage and the urge for destruction, may permanently twist your mind and body, leaving you more demon than man.
addons.title: Hel Hound

objects.text: You have consumed the blood of Mannoroth the Destructor. Felfire now flows in your veins, empowering you to greater heights. This massively increases your ferocity and instinct for violence. All of your physical capabilities are mildly increased, and this is more effective the more powerful your physiology, though there are diminishing returns. You are now slightly resistant to magic.
objects.title: Fel Blood (Warcraft)

objects.text:
You have a multitude of abilities, you are capable of Inorganic Disintegration so long as the target of this ability isn’t directly attached to a living creature. This is no small scale ability, you are capable of wiping away entire skyscrapers in one go. You have incredible control over the fine details of your disintegration. 

You are able to create and manipulate force fields (in a color of your choice). The surface area of these force fields is controlled at-will. These force fields are near-invulnerable. You have an invisible force field around you at all time, this is permanent and requires no conscious maintenance. You may also shape your force fields into constructs, making up any form of your choice (roads, globes, gloves, disks, walls, etc.). Creating a globe and constricting it around someone is an easy feat for you. You are capable of flight through your force fields. Even Hard-Light Spears numbered in the hundreds can be made with ease. 

You are able to instantly heal any wound, no matter the severity. This has no cooldown and may even be able to revive the dead. You have superhuman strength. The most important of all your abilities is your capacity to give weakened forms of your powers unto others. These gifted powers will last for as long as you will.
objects.title: Limelight (The Reckoners)

addons.text:
Your ability to give away your physique and a piece of your soul has combined and fused together to become more potent than before. 

Those healed by your power will no longer have a decrease in their lifespan. When you grant someone your power it opens a connection between you and the receiver, through this connection, you can give or take things from the receiver as you please this not only includes raw power but also memories, information, skills, ability, and battle experience as much as you want to or from the receiver.

The taking of power is no longer lethal or harmful unless you want it to be and any additional power they may gain through personal growth is also yours to command.
addons.title: Blessing of the King

objects.text: You have received a special transferable physical energy. This energy improves your physique, raising all physical attributes to a superhuman level. You can shrug off bullets, throw cars, and run multiple miles in a minute. You receive the secondary powers required to function at this increased level. You will no longer age beyond your peak, as this energy constantly keeps you in your peak condition, not allowing you to regress with age or lack of up-keep. The special energy that fuels your physique is transferable, allowing you to give away your physique to others at will, though this gifted portion will not regenerate over time.
objects.title: The King's Body (The God of High School)

objects.text:
You inherited a portion of the King’s Power, the innate Divine ability of the Jade Emperor Ohkwang. 

This power allows for the manipulation of the Four Fundamental Forces of the Universe. Strong Force, Weak Force, Electromagnetism, and Gravity. 

The King himself was able to fling whole planets around the solar system like pinballs, or disintegrate half the bodies of High Gods with a wave of his hand, and his true successor, Han Dae-Wi, will be every bit as mighty. 

You however, have only received a portion of this power. You could fly or destroy whole houses with a thought or construct various weapons and items from thin air but the heady heights of power the Kings possessed are years away for you. 

As time passes and you practice your power, you will grow in both the control you have, the range of your ability and the magnitude of what you may effect. This ability turns one of your iris’ wholly black, with a golden Omega symbol in place of your pupil, at least when the ability is in use.
objects.title: Wisdom of the Sage (The God of High School)

objects.text:
You once held a position of extraordinary significance. In a previous existence, you were revered as one of the High Gods, an entity of immense power capable of reshaping the very foundations of this world. However, for reasons unknown, you perished or lost your divine abilities, only to be reborn as a child in your current race. Recently, you have begun to reawaken your dormant powers, as detailed below.

These powers and abilities, as well as any supernatural artifacts associated with them, can be accessed through a transformation into your godly form. Initially, this transformation will be draining, but with time and practice, you will extend its duration until it becomes a permanent state.

Your reincarnation bestows upon you several powers derived from your former self. Select a God, Monster, or other Mythological Figure from legends to serve as the basis of your original identity. Your powers and items will be modeled after this chosen entity.

Firstly, you inherit the physical prowess and life essence of a celestial being. Your strength allows you to obliterate entire worlds with a single strike, or hoist them above your head with some effort. Your speed surpasses that of light by a magnitude of at least a hundred thousand, and you possess the resilience to endure blows capable of shattering planets, akin to how humans withstand attacks from their fellow beings. Your life energy is so potent that a mere release of your power could submerge an entire world, and your life energy-based abilities are equally cataclysmic, capable of ending worlds as surely as your physical might.

Additionally, you acquire two distinctive and exceptional powers, as well as two unique items inspired by the legend of your original self. These items are comparable in potency to the fabled tools wielded by the Monkey King, such as Yeoui/Ryu Jingu Bang or Yongpyo. It is also possible to transform powers or remarkable feats associated with your chosen entity into original items, ensuring they remain rooted in their authentic legend.

Embrace your reborn divine nature and wield these newfound powers and artifacts, for you are destined to leave an indelible mark on the world that resonates with the echoes of your legendary past.
objects.title: Reincarnation (The God of High School)

addons.text:
Within your body, the hyper-evolving worms, already a remarkable civilization capable of rapid advancement, find themselves in close proximity to the potent energy of the Mantra Reactor. This fusion creates a supercharge of evolution and development, accelerating the worms' progression to unprecedented levels. As they receive the divine energy of the Mantra Reactor, their enhancements become amplified, propelling the might of your transhumanist divine form and their utopian civilization into unimaginable heights.

But the synergy doesn't end there, thanks to the presence of the Mantra Reactor, the worship and devotion of the worms are magnified immensely, further fueling and empowering the reactor itself. This symbiotic relationship creates an endless positive feedback loop, where the strengthened reactor enhances the worms' worship, which in turn strengthens the reactor even more. As a result, there is a continuous and exponential boost in the speed of development and advancement for both the worms and the reactor, propelling them to unprecedented levels of growth and progress.

With this combination, you become a living divine nexus of boundless growth and transcendental energy. Experience the exponential evolution of the worm civilization within you, as their advancements reach unparalleled levels, creating an unending cycle of progress and worship, propelling you towards infinite possibilities.
addons.title: Achieved Inner Heaven, Literally In This Case!

addons.text:
You have a heightened affinity for wrathful Mantra, similar to an Asura.

Unlike others, you do not rely on worship or the sacrifice of mortal souls to generate Mantra. Instead, your rage alone fuels an immense surge of Mantra energy, reaching astronomical levels in the throes of battle.

As your fury and fighting spirit intensify, your Mantra reactor amplifies its output accordingly, allowing your power to grow exponentially without limit. This relentless surge enables you not only to match but to surpass opponents vastly more powerful in a short period of time.
addons.title: Inheritor of His Wrath

objects.text:
Within your body now resides a Mantra reactor, an extraordinary device that enhances all aspects of your physiology. You possess a transhuman divine form, granting you heightened strength, agility, and resilience. With this newfound power coursing through your veins, you become an unstoppable force, capable of achieving the impossible and surpassing the limitations of mere mortals. With your transhuman divine physiology, you stand as a living embodiment of the divine and a beacon of limitless potential.

In addition, you innately know the various applications of Mantra. This includes deep understanding of Mantra technologies, unlocking the ability to turn humans into Demigods, and construct massive war machines like the Karma Fortress or the Shinkoku Army Fleet.
objects.title: Mantra Reactor (Asura's Wrath)

addons.title: Senketsu Kisaragi
addons.text:
Your Kamui has surpassed its limits, manifesting as a Super Form you can access by drawing on your latent potential. Both of your abilities become massively amplified, enough to casually reach the earth's atmosphere in mere seconds, strength to smash through nigh impenetrable barriers, and treat fatal wounds like papercuts.

Your absorption powers become especially enhanced, to the point of not only absorbing Life Fibers, but the powers of sentient beings, taking them for yourself. Beyond that, your potential now has a passive effect for accelerating your Kamui's ability to adapt and grow stronger, as well as your own as a Life Fiber Hybrid.

addons.title: Dual Synchronization
addons.text:
It seems your Kamui was made from two alien parasites, that have somehow achieved equilibrium with each other, gaining several enhancements while also removing weaknesses. 

The Klyntar half can be fed with mere pints of your blood instead of brains or copious amounts of chocolate, and its vulnerability to sound and fire can be mitigated through the Kamui's adaption as well as a further enhanced tolerance and regeneration.

Meanwhile, your Kamui benefits from an even greater and more fluid shapeshifting ability, and can even cover your full body due to the Klyntar acting as a second layer above your skin. Allowing it to take on more forms and push them to ridiculous extremes with enough effort.

Depending on your Symbiote's further abilities, your Kamui can rapidly adapt to complement them or develop new forms around it. Such as the Symbiote Hybrid Upgrade to bestow fragments of your powers to others, create a hivemind of Symbiote Kamui empowered allies, and truly merge the powers of the Living Abyss and Life Fibers, or the Anti Venom Upgrade to heal or purify yourself and others.

objects.text:
Through some questionable experimentation, you have been infused with the alien life-form known as Life Fibers, which grants you an ageless superhuman body.

Your physical abilities are pushed to dozens of times peak human at baseline, allowing you to strike with multiple tons of force and gain speed just under Mach 1.

Beyond your increased physical ability, you also gain an extremely potent regeneration which is strong enough to allow you to survive any amount of damage so long as you are not cut from the opposite sides at a perfect angle with a weapon that is either made of Life Fibers or possesses potent supernatural abilities. This regeneration also grants you an adaptive evolution ability where, as you continue to fight and regenerate, you will continually grow stronger and allow you to quickly adapt to an opponent should they not be vastly stronger than you. 

You also gain the ability to absorb Life Fibers to grow stronger should you have a source to gain more of them. This will give you an explosive burst of growth depending on the amount you absorb and will quickly see you reaching unprecedented levels of power should have a reliable supply.

In addition, you also gain a Kamui outfit comprised of 100% Life Fibers and infused with your own DNA. As such your Kamui is fully sentient and becomes your lifelong companion able to mentally communicate with you though no one else will be able to hear them. By activating your Kamui by feeding it your blood through a handy wrist device included, it will envelop you in a form of stylish, flexible armor that is stronger and tougher than the toughest mundane metals but also perfectly flexible and breathable. While active, your physical abilities are drastically increased in the form of a powerful multiplier to your base abilities. However, to fuel your Kamui, it must feed upon your blood, and while your regeneration will be plenty to meet this demand, longer engagements will see both your regeneration and Kamui’s need for blood increase. Over time, you will become better in sync with your Kamui making it need less blood from you while also drastically increasing the amount of power it gives you while active, however your Kamui does have a limit to the amount of power it will be able to give you once perfectly synchronized. Additionally your Kamui possesses the same adaptive evolution you do to grow stronger but also can gain various useful transformations when pushed against the wall such that you will always eventually gain a useful counter to any opponent.

Lastly you also receive your own pair of Scissor Blades which are a pair of blades that combine to form a pair of Scissors, these blades have the ability to cut through esoteric materials, are immensely durable and can transform to grow larger up to the size of a skyscraper.
objects.title: Life Fiber Warrior (Kill La Kill)

objects.text:
Within the eternal struggle against the relentless demonic legions, a champion arises. You embody the unyielding might and unparalleled prowess for which the Sentinels are known, surpassing all adversaries in your path. 

Your arsenal knows no bounds, as you harness the power to carry a formidable cache of weapons, equipment, and ammunition, effortlessly summoning them from a separate realm. A mental menu grants you swift access to your vast array, ensuring you are never caught unprepared. The carnage you unleash is uninterrupted, for your weapons draw strength from the ammunition at hand, eliminating the need for time-consuming reloads. 

As you engage in combat, your keen understanding of demonic anatomy enables you to exploit vital weaknesses, turning their own bodies into instruments of destruction. The chaos of battle becomes your ally, as your unparalleled focus allows you to effortlessly multitask, assessing adversaries, ammunition levels, and strategic vantage points simultaneously. 

Your mastery of weapons is peerless, each strike hitting its mark with unwavering precision. In the aftermath of each demon's demise, their life force becomes a resource to be harnessed, empowering your healing, ammunition reserves, and armor reinforcement. 

As the Last Sentinel, you embody the legacy of the Night Sentinels in its entirety, bearing their indomitable spirit and surpassing their peerless skill.
objects.title: The Last Night Sentinel (DOOM)

objects.text:
You have rejected your humanity and transform into a twisted abomination of life and death. Your sustenance now depends on consuming fresh blood and converting humans into obedient, monstrous slaves. 

In this twisted form, you wield unparalleled control over your body, unlocking supernatural feats. Your very blood becomes a weapon, capable of taking the form of bullets or streams that can cut through stone effortlessly. Should harm befall you, swift regeneration heals substantial wounds and allows you to control severed body parts from a distance. Your body temperature can plummet to freezing levels upon contact, while your extended nervous system acts like tentacles, infiltrating and controlling the nerves of your enemies. Your hair and blood vessels gain the strength of an octopus, granting you formidable abilities to manipulate and control.

Your senses of smell, hearing, touch, and taste are heightened tenfold, granting acute awareness, and a tremor sense that works both on land and underwater, while your vision extends to an owl-like wide cone. Using tentacle-like extensions of your circulatory system, you can pierce flesh and effortlessly paralyze your prey. Your eyes possess a hypnotic quality to mesmerize and control those who meet your gaze.

Moreover, you have the power to infuse corpses with a small amount of your blood, transforming them into vampiric minions known as Zombies. These Zombies inherit the Blood Vessel Needle ability and retain previous capabilities, including intellect, as long as their circulatory systems remain intact.

You also gain the ability to teleport rapidly between shadows, concealing objects, and even corpses within their depths. By embedding fragments of your flesh into sentient living creatures, aggressive razor-sharp tentacles attack those who attempt to remove the spores.

Unfortunately, this comes with a weakness to the sun and things related to the sun, such as Hamon Breathing or strong directed UV Light.
objects.title: I Reject My Humanity (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
In a world where magic reigns supreme, physical strength may seem irrelevant, useful only for basic tasks. However, you possess an extraordinary advantage: your physical abilities are enhanced to godlike levels, surpassing human limitations. You can effortlessly shatter steel, lift castles, outrun lightning, and dodge railgun fire. Your durability enables you to withstand stab wounds and powerful spells at close range. Moreover, your physical training results in rapid and explosive growth in power, achieving in hours what would normally take weeks.

Your exceptional strength not only affects the physical realm but also allows you to manipulate and resist the supernatural purely through physical force. You can swat away fireballs and magical blasts, restrain ghosts in chokeholds, and defy mind control and curses. The possibilities are nearly limitless as long as you possess superior physical strength compared to your opponents.

The connection between magic and muscles is inseparable in your case. Your magical strength will always match your physical strength, and vice versa. Additionally, your magical abilities will always succeed against anyone whose magical skill and power are weaker than yours. Your attacks will unfailingly land, and your spells will invariably work. Even magic resistances, immunities, or anti-magic items are rendered useless against you as long as you maintain superiority.
objects.title: Magic And Muscle (Mashle)

objects.text:
Infernals are humans who have undergone Spontaneous Human Combustion after merging with their Doppelgänger in an alternate dimension known as Adolla, or Hell. This merge takes place after coming into contact with sparks of an Adolla Burst, an extra pure flame originating in Adolla, in the form of red insects. Usually Infernals only arise when an individual is incompatible with their Doppelgänger, a reflection of them as they are commonly perceived by humanity, which results in their loss of reason and a new tendency to rampage.

Infernals can vary widely in form, but all tend to take the form of fiery charcoal-like monsters. They have blackened skin that is at least partially enveloped in flames. An Infernal has much more strength and agility than they had as regular humans, and an ability to manipulate the flames produced by their bodies.

You, however, have taken this a step further. You have managed to retain your mental faculties, allowing you to keep your reason and awareness. However, you still have an urge to rampage and cause destruction. Your form is characterized by having horns and much stronger flames than regular Infernals. You are incredibly difficult to kill, due to equally improved defense and strength. You can brush off being shot by traditional weapons and only need to fear attacks from particularly strong Third Generation pyrokinetics.
objects.title: Demon Infernal (Fire Force)

objects.text: As a result of experimentation and injection with the Red Crystal, the host of the Nameless Worms, you have become a Deadman—and with it, awakened a Branch of Sin: an incredible power that manifests through your blood. However, unlike other Deadmen, who are each bound to a single niche ability, your Branch of Sin is truly unique—unrestricted in nature, granting you complete mastery over the manifestation and manipulation of blood, both your own and that of others around you. With refinement and control, you can replicate every ability seen within the series or even create entirely new ones. Some examples of your future potential include—creating floating blood mines, secreting poisonous blood that induces hallucinations, weaving hexagonal blood armor, forging scythes and blades, interfacing minds with machines, igniting your blood into flames, etc. Distinct from ordinary Deadmen, you don't need to injure yourself to activate your power. Instead, you can simply secrete blood harmlessly through your skin. As a side effect of harboring such a powerful Branch of Sin—and becoming the new Wretched Egg—your blood possesses unnatural endurance. Massive blood loss no longer hinders you, alongside a potent regenerative factor that allows you to regrow flesh, organs, and limbs when injured within a few seconds. Only the total destruction of your body, or the eradication of your Red Diamond, could bring you true death. Even when grievously wounded, you can continue fighting indefinitely, defying the normal limits of anemia and blood loss to do so. The pinnacle of your power is your transformation into The Wretch. In this heightened state, your regeneration accelerates exponentially, mending even fatal wounds the instant they occur as your blood bubbles and boils, rapidly forming new flesh to seal the damage. Your Branch of Sin becomes so empowered that you can use it to casually toss and destroy a cargo ship without breaking a sweat. Your dominion over blood stretches for miles—bending any blood within your line of sight effortlessly to your will. At full release, your power becomes catastrophic, capable of annihilating entire districts and sections of a city, echoing the disaster of the Great Tokyo Earthquake that submerged 70% of the metropolis. While this state grants you overwhelming benefits, it is also extremely taxing on your body and cannot be sustained indefinitely—at least for now. With time and mastery, however, you may one day maintain it permanently, much like Shiro herself. Finally, as the host and origin of the Nameless Worms, you can infect others, granting them their own Deadman powers—each one a fragment, a Branch, of yours.
objects.title: The Wretched One (Deadman's Wonderland)

addons.text: You have obtained all the weaponry Toji/Maki has ever wielded, right in your inventory. It is also bound to you, meaning that it can't be used against you, and that you can put it back into your inventory regardless of distance.
addons.title: Toji's Arsenal

objects.text:
Heavenly Restrictions are binding vows placed on a sorcerer’s body when they are born. These binding vows typically involve a trade-off, such as possessing an extreme amount of cursed energy but a frail body, or the reverse—having a powerful body but little to no cursed energy.

Your Heavenly Restriction, though, is one you’ve outmaneuvered. Even without sacrificing anything, your Heavenly Restriction grants you incredible physical might and finely honed senses, enough to notice subtle changes in the environment, such as shifts in temperature or air pressure—though not to the point of outright precognition.

You are also ‘invisible’ to any supernatural energy. This means techniques like Domain Expansion’s guaranteed hit do not function properly on you, and you cannot be sensed through energy-based detection. Even if you do have cursed energy or a similar supernatural force, the difficulty in detecting you remains the same.

Optionally, you may choose to embrace the full weight of the Heavenly Restriction. By allowing it to truly restrict you—such as losing access to your reserves of supernatural energy, or even physical limitations like the loss of certain limbs—you can further amplify the benefits. The greater the restriction placed on you, the more overwhelming the gains granted by the vow. However, a Heavenly Restriction cannot restrict what you do not possess. If you have no supernatural energy—whether it be magic bought from the CYOA itself, or energy from the world you’re in—it cannot be used as a source of restriction or trade-off.

The focus of the boost will match the nature of what’s restricted. If you restrict your cursed or supernatural energy, your physical body and senses are empowered. Conversely, if your physical body is what’s restricted—whether frail, injured, or impaired—then your supernatural energy and its potency are significantly increased.
objects.title: Heavenly Restriction (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
You have been transformed into The Terrarian, this transformation starts you at a peak human physique of your own design with incredibly potential for growth. You have the ability to craft everything in Terraria, both modded and un-modded, regardless if you are able to craft it normally. Although you may require other esoteric materials in place of the ones naturally used in the various recipes, all bosses will have a respective spawner that will be craftable no matter what realm you are in, however that does not equate to them being easy. Bosses will drop loot and material that are both natural to the Terraria world, and adapted to the realm you are in at the time of summoning. Everything crafted by you is indestructible and will not lose durability or experience wear and tear as such creations are now subject to Terraria Physics. 

You are able craft Life Crystals and Mana Crystals, as that is the only way to find them besides completing achievements from the endless list of Achievements that you have access to you. These Achievements can grant you bonuses that scale with difficulty, these bonuses can be anything from increases in damage to specific entities, to materials you require. There is no limit to the number of Life and Mana Crystals that can be earned through achievements, although there is a limit to the number of Life and Mana Crystals that can be used through crafting. 

You have access to an Inventory with no weight or quantity limitations, you only have to touch an object to put it in your inventory. No time passes for items in your inventory, they will be in the same condition as they were when stored. You start out with a limit of seven accessory slots, although more can be unlocked via Achievements.
objects.title: The Terrarian (Terraria)

addons.text:
As you possess the abilities of the galaxy's greatest hero, your Heroic Traits have responded, raising their potency beyond what they were previously, and with their introduction, the potency of your classes has grown beyond what even Commander Shepard could have imagined. Strength turns the abilities of a Soldier into an unstoppable juggernaut, able to carry weapons capable of taking down ships; Skill turns an Engineer into a blur of creation and demolition in equal measure; and Will empowers an Adept, as Biotics and Magic are able to reveal new tricks with each other and form a more powerful combination.

Optionally, you can include gear from Fable in your loadout that suits you, or merge it with your Mass Effect gear to create something the galaxy has never seen before.
addons.title: Mass Traits

objects.text: ”I’m Commander Shepard, and this is my favourite CYOA on the Citadel.” You are now Commander Shepard, the first human Spectre and the galaxy’s greatest hero, the one who defeated the Reapers themselves. Or at least you have all of their skills, knowledge, and powers. There are many versions of Shepard, they can be the galaxy’s finest soldier, its greatest engineer, or it’s most powerful biotic. You are all three at once, gaining the benefits of all three classes, and their mixed classes and specializations, perfectly mixed together and their benefits stacking on top of each other. You are the perfect N7 operative and Spectre. Your biotic abilities don’t rely on an implant, they now operate like an Asari’s innate biotic ability, and are incredibly powerful and precise. You are easily capable of tearing through a dreadnought, and have the precision needed to brush your teeth via biotics. Your use of this ability is as instinctive as walking, requiring no conscious thought on your part and can grow even stronger over time. You also somehow possess the ability and knowledge to create Element Zero through your biotics. Next you also receive a set of customized armor and weapons loadout from the franchise, with any associated mods and attachments tailored to suit your combat style. This can also optionally include a full set of cybernetics and gene therapy Shepard would have received. You are also given a unique and powerful Omnitool, capable of performing any function known from the franchise, and able to interface with any other technology you might acquire. This Omnitool never seems to run out of power or resources, and in the event it breaks you’ll find it repaired the next time try to use it. And finally, you gain Shepard’s legendary ability to somehow seamlessly encounter and integrate powerful new companions into your team. With minimal effort, it won’t be long before you’ll have a powerful, interesting, and perfectly loyal team under your command.
objects.title: Shepard (Mass Effect)

addons.text:
Your biotics no longer manifest in the traditional blue glow they blaze a vivid, nuclear green. Element Zero within your body has undergone a volatile shift, causing every mass effect field you generate to churn with atomic instability.

Your abilities now inflict both crushing force and radiation saturation. Armor and shielding steadily weaken under exposure, regenerative systems struggle, and powerful biotic blasts leave behind short-lived fallout zones that punish those who remain within them. Enemies struck repeatedly may suffer escalating radiation effects, their bodies destabilized at the cellular level, and suffer worse and worse effects from radiation poisoning.

On top of all this, it would seem that it's capable of being shared too, as companions who stay around you for over a year can start to develop Atomic Biotics of their own if you wish it. Though their own strength and skill with them will vary.

Be warned, though, for whilst this will increase your resilience to radiation, it doesn’t make you immune to it. This warning applies to companions as well.

Note: You may choose to use regular Biotics instead of Atomic Biotics at any time.
addons.title: Atomic Biotics

addons.text: You’re the ultimate apex of survival and power in the Wasteland, a being whose physical, mental, and tactical capabilities exceed any normal human or supermutant. Your body has been enhanced by a perfected strain of the Forced Evolutionary Virus, granting you peak strength, speed, durability, and regenerative ability without mutations or outward changes. Your body has double the strength and speed granted by The Wasteland Monster addon, and your Hellfire Power Armor has been properly modified to enhance your strength and speed by half that without breaking apart in the process. Should you have the addon Atomic Biotics, this strain of the FEV virus pushes your biotics even further, allowing you to turn simple biotic abilities like warp into explosions similar to those of mini nukes, not to mention making any radiation created by your biotics much more deadly.
addons.title: Nuclear Vanguard

addons.text:
Seems you've hit the jackpot, my friend, as along with all possible skills, perks, and abilities of the legends of the Wasteland, you have also gained those belonging to the Lineage of the Hero of Oakvale, which gave rise to the Heroes of Southcliff, Bower Lake, and Brightwall, to name a few (or, in other words, all Fable protagonists), with your Strength, Will, and Skill being at the peak said legends reached, with you able to go further.

It seems you completely broke the Vit-O-Matic Vigor Tester, as your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. system has merged with the Heroic Traits, with them pushing each other to be greater: Strength empowering Strength and Endurance, Will empowering Charisma and Intelligence, and Skill empowering Perception and Agility, with the things making you S.P.E.C.I.A.L. giving you the means to do things even William Black would be confounded by.
addons.title: Trait Jackpot

objects.text:
You have been assessed by the Vit-O-Matic Vigor Tester, and you're off the charts! You have all of the skills, perks, and abilities of the Wasteland's most legendary figures, both real and hypothetical. This includes the likes of a Tribal who beat Horrigan to death with his bare hands, a genius to match House or Elijah, or a multifaceted Courier who with guile brought whole nations to their knees. You are all of the above and more, as you gain the benefits of essentially being a "maxed" Fallout character from all of the games, with the mixed builds and specializations perfectly blending together and their benefits stacking on top of each other. You are ring-a-ding, baby, and you know it.

You are also given a unique and powerful Pip-Boy (or Pip-Boy variant), capable of performing an enormous variety of functions (targeting, automapping, keeping track of your current tasks, directly turning knowledge from books, digital records, or other kinds of media into skills and knowledge for the user, etc.) and never runs out of power or resources. It simply does not break, ever, and cannot be lost or stolen.

(The genius granted by this power is only the general intelligence, technical skill, and knowledge that you might expect from maxing your skills and taking the relevant Perks. If you want perfect knowledge of Fallout technology, you still have to take SCIENCE! (Fallout).)
objects.title: You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.! (Fallout)

addons.text: Having gained the power and form of the "King of Kaiju" and the "Symbol of Despair," your fortitude level has now skyrocketed, surpassing every Identified Kaiju in the series and imparting on you a monstrous level of power.
