With the cryokinetic abilities of No.6 at your command, you can freeze and plunge all of Japan into an eternal winter with your mere presence. Those foolish enough to challenge you must first endure the barrier of frost you emit, turning your foes into nothing but shattered ice. As the newly crowned King of Kaiju, you exude an aura that compels everything around you to cower in fear and submit, cowing those of lesser will. While your lesser brethren will always fall under your unyielding authority, bowing to your command.
addons.title: Kaiju No.6

objects.text:
Through some twist of fate, an alien lifeform has chosen you as its host, fusing with your very being and replacing your heart, in the process transforming you into a humanoid Daikaiju—something akin to Kafka Hibino, also known as Kaiju No. 8. But unlike Kafka, you'll never have to fear losing control; as your parasitic passenger is more than willing to grant you full reign over its immense power.

Just like Kafka, you can freely shift between your human and Daikaiju forms, whether partially or fully, with your strength increasing in proportion to the extent of your transformation. Even altering a single limb grants you the power to lift and hurl cars effortlessly, while your fully realized Daikaiju form lets you shatter buildings with a single punch. Your resilience matches your might, as most anti-Kaiju weaponry will barely leave a scratch, inflicting nothing more than superficial wounds.

As for now, your full potential remains locked, starting only at a Fortitude level of 8.0—meeting the bare requirements to be called a Daikaiju. But as you continue to resonate and commune with the entity inside, honing your abilities, your power will grow far beyond its initial limits.

At the heart of every Kaiju lies its Uni-Organ—its Core—the source of its monstrous abilities. Now, with your heart replaced by this pulsating wellspring of power—you've also gained a unique set of abilities. While all Kaiju draw their strength from this organ, no two share the exact same powers. However, you are the exception. You can choose any canon Kaiju from the series, with your Core becoming a perfect replica of theirs, granting you full access to all its devastating abilities.

The look of your humanoid Daikaiju form is ultimately up to you, but it will always bear traits reminiscent of the Kaiju—whose power you wield. If you choose Kaiju No. 4, your Daikaiju form may take on the appearance of a winged humanoid insect. If you embody the might of No. 6, your transformation could resemble a humanoid dragon, etc.
objects.title: Monster (Kaiju N°8)

objects.text:
With this power, your physical body has ascended and gain two divine physiques, each embodying the concept of Hardness. The first is The Indestructible Diamond Immortal Physique—a form of invincibility. Even with a minor completion of this physique, you become impervious to conventional weapons and greatly resist all mystical attacks, but even the mightiest magic will be hard pressed to scratch you without divine power. At grand completion, not even Gods and Demons can break through your invulnerability.

The Indestructible Diamond Immortal Physique also grants unparalleled regenerative capabilities. Any injuries inflicted upon you are instantly healed, leaving no trace behind. When activated, your body emits a radiant, golden metallic glow, symbolizing your impenetrable nature.

The second physique is The Furious Immortal Tyrannical Physique. This physique enhances your vitality and unlocks your latent potential during battles, allowing your power to rapidly surge, and grow stronger to overwhelm your enemies. The extent of this boost depends on your untapped reserve, but each boost is also permanent, increasing your base stats with every battle, and amplifying your potential.

Your journey begins with a minor completion of both physiques, gradually advancing through dedicated training and experience. Over time, you will reach half-completion, and ultimately attain grand completion—a level of power turning you into the walking embodiment of the concept Hardness.
objects.title: Immortal Physiques: Hardness (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
With this power, you gain two divine physiques, each embodying the concept of Softness. The first is The Eternal Physique—a path that leads to a life unbounded by time. This physique grants no direct advantage in battles, but instead, it extends your lifespan to an extraordinary degree. Legends speak of those who complete the Eternal Physique achieving true immortality. While this claim remains unproven, user who attain Grand Completion can easily live for countless billions of years.

Growth of the Eternal Physique is a slow and solitary journey, akin to a snail's crawl. Progress is measured in generations, with each phase taking countless decades to master, and for most, even three generations barely marks the entry into this Physique's fundamental realm. To succeed, unwavering determination and an unyielding spirit are essential to resist the world's distractions.

Upon reaching Grand Completion, the flow of time itself is your plaything. Moments can be stretch into millennia, and a million year will pass in a blink of an eye, even eroding Gods and their realm to nothingness to the tides of time.

The second physique, The Sacred Spring Physique, blesses you with boundless vitality. Every technique fueled by this Physique exceeds normal limits, potentially becoming dozens or even hundreds of times more potent. Swiftness and force amplify every technique's might, granting it unparalleled speed and impact.

However, the crowning attribute of the Sacred Spring Physique is its inexhaustible stamina. On a battlefield, you may not be the most dominant force, but your resilience is unmatched.

Your journey starts with minor completion in both physiques, gradually advancing through dedicated training and experience. Over time, you will attain half completion, eventually culminating in grand completion—a state where you become the embodiment of Softness, a master of time and vitality.
objects.title: Immortal Physiques: Softness (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
With this power, you are bestowed with two divine physiques, each embodying the essence of Yang. The first is The Solar Immortal Physique—a celestial physique that empowers you to ascend to the ranks of a divine star. This physique grants you mastery over all facets linked to a star's nature. From your very being, you can unleash a limitless torrent of sunfire and sunlight, wielding these scorching energies as weapons or tools. Additionally, the power to manipulate gravity resides within your grasp, permitting the creation of spatial rifts and the bending of cosmic forces to your will. As you attain grand completion, your presence becomes as unattainable as the sun high in the daytime sky, casting your brilliance upon all you survey.

The second physique, The Extreme Yang Immortal Physique, manifests as an indomitable sun that radiates from your chest. With it, you harness an unparalleled intensity of heat that can liquefy even the sturdiest of substances, and even space time. This blazing inferno can take on multiple forms, allowing you to unleash devastating attacks that incinerate all in your path. As you advance towards grand completion, not even abstract concepts can evade the all-consuming flames of your power.

Your journey starts with minor completion in both physiques, gradually advancing through dedicated training and experience. Over time, you will attain half completion, eventually culminating in grand completion—a state where you become the embodiment of Yang, wielding the might of celestial fire and incinerating energy beyond mortal comprehension.
objects.title: Immortal Physiques: Yang (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
Harnessing divine essences, you now possess two divine physiques that embody the concepts of Yin. 

The first, known as The Heaven Devourer Evil Physique, endows you with the power to create voracious black holes at will. These cosmic maws engulf everything in their path, consuming attacks, objects, and even altering the fabric of space-time through their gravitational pull. As you progress towards grand completion, your appetite grows, enabling you to devour even concepts and divine entities with ease. Your mastery over these cosmic rifts becomes absolute, a force to be reckoned with.

The second physique, The Void Physique, bestows upon you the ability to merge seamlessly with the surrounding space, rendering you practically untraceable. Cloaked in an ethereal fog-like presence, you navigate the realms as a phantom, appearing anywhere and everywhere at will. Your dominion over the space you embody is total, granting you control over the very dimensions that once confined you. With time and dedication, your command over space transcends boundaries, reaching grand completion where even the highest realms and dimensions bend to your will.

Your journey starts with minor completion in both physiques, gradually advancing through dedicated training and experience. Over time, you will attain half completion, eventually culminating in grand completion—a state where you become the embodiment of Yin, a force that devours and merges with the cosmos itself.
objects.title: Immortal Physiques: Yin (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
With this power, you are bestowed with two divine physiques, each embodying the concept of Pure. 

The first, The Void Imperfection Physique, renders you impervious and untouchable, be they offensive or defensive, prove futile against you. No harm can be inflicted upon your being, nor can any defense block your attacks, and ailments of any kind hold no power over you. Even the most potent of supernatural poisons or bewitching enchantments cannot effect you. As you progress toward Grand Completion, you transcend barriers and concepts themselves, attaining a state where nothing can touch you without your consent.

The second physique, The Soaring Immortal Physique, grants you unparalleled speed. Swift as a comet, your movements defy comprehension. Treasures and techniques pale in significance when faced with your incomprehensible velocity. At Grand Completion, your speed transcends even spatial confines, allowing you to traverse through any dimensional fabric. Your existence becomes a blur, causing spacetime itself to stand still in your presence.

Your journey starts with minor completion in both physiques, gradually advancing through dedicated training and experience. Over time, you will attain half completion, eventually culminating in grand completion—a state where you become the embodiment of Pure, an immortal being invulnerable to all harm and swifter than the fabric of reality itself.
objects.title: Immortal Physiques: Pure (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
With this power, you acquire two distinct divine physiques, each embodying the concept of Taint. The first is The Hell Suppressing Immortal Physique—a physique of immeasurable heaviness. When you activate this physique, the weight of your body increases to astronomical levels. Even a single drop of your blood becomes as heavy as thousands of pounds. Attaining Grand Completion in this physique empowers you to perform feats of extraordinary might—crushing gods with a single stomp and bending reality itself under the weight of your presence. You become a walking cataclysm, leaving devastation in your wake.

The second physique, The Sky Destroyer Immortal Physique, grants you boundless strength. Activating this physique enables you to unleash infinite physical power. You can tear the mountains asunder with your bare hands, grapple with dragons on equal terms, and shatter divine artifacts and weapons with sheer physical force. At the pinnacle of your journey, when you attain Grand Completion in this physique, even abstract concepts, and divine laws yield before your overwhelming strength.

Your journey starts with minor completion in both physiques, gradually advancing through dedicated training and experience. Over time, you will attain half completion, eventually culminating in grand completion—a state where you become the embodiment of Taint, a force of indomitable weight and strength.
objects.title: Immortal Physiques: Taint (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
Your existence becomes enveloped by an esoteric energy field, imbuing you with enhanced physical attributes and amplifying your existing abilities. At the outset, this grants you the strength to effortlessly lift cars, renders you impervious to low-caliber bullets, and accelerates your regeneration, allowing injuries to mend in mere minutes. With this energy shroud, you also gain the gift of flight and the ability to project formidable energy blasts from your palms.

Yet, the true potential of this power lies in its limitless capacity for evolution and rapid growth. The energy cocoon surrounding you exhibits an innate adaptability, rapidly growing in response to stimuli and challenges, while also enhancing the potency of your other abilities. As time progresses, this energy becomes significantly more powerful, even acquiring entirely new capabilities.

Proving its evolving nature, the original possessor of this ability was able to utilized the energy field to render himself impervious to mental assaults, breathe within the void of space, and protect himself while traversing through dimensional gaps. In less than a year, he progressed from struggling to destroy walls, to near singlehandedly repelling a colossal meteor poised to obliterate Earth.
objects.title: Mantle Of The Greatest Hero (Villain Initialization)

objects.text:
This is the forbidden technique wielded by the Akatsuki member, Kakuzu—the Jiongu, or Earth Grudge Fear. The technique turns your body into something akin to a rag doll, stitched together with black threads. You can extrude these threads to attack, defend, and extend the reach of your limbs. You can even use your threads to reattach the severed body parts of others.

The darkest power of the Jiongu, however, is the ability to steal the body parts of another and transplant them into yourself without rejection. This by itself allows you to extend your lifespan indefinitely—so long as you can maintain a supply of parts, at least.

The most valuable body part for this power is the heart. When you steal another being's heart, you also steal the powers that being wielded—though not their knowledge of how to use them. Through the Jiongu, you can hold up to five hearts—and thus their powers—within your body: your main heart and four spare hearts. Each heart also acts as a form of immortality; until all five hearts are destroyed, you will be nearly impossible to kill. A heart can even be given control of a portion of your threads and can become a semi-autonomous creature under your command.
objects.title: Jiongu (Naruto)

addons.text:
You have mastered the ability to bud spores of yourself which can grow into more Zetsu under your control. These Zetsu are not clones of you per se, and are a distinct type of being in their own right. Therefore, no matter what other powers you possess, these Zetsu will only ever have "From The God Tree (Naruto)" and anything granted to them from meta abilities that effect Master powers.

These are a true hive mind completely under your control, and can be created from fungal buds (this takes the longest), from Wood Release (instantaneous, but requires "Chakra (Naruto)" to use), from human bodies (the "standard" option), or from a specialized tree (faster than normal, but requires a much slower growing stationary plant to be nurtured first).
addons.title: White Zetsu Army

objects.text:
Your body becomes that of Zetsu. You heal faster, you can regenerate, and you can absorb or send others chakra by skin contact. You can even clone yourself, but it takes energy.

Your body is incredibly malleable, able to implant DNA of nearly anyone into yourself to gain extremely weakened powers. You can even shapeshift yourself, copying the energy level and looking (and feeling) exactly like who you're shapeshifted into. Sensors will be confused, unless they can sense emotions.

You also gain the Mayfly technique, able to put yourself into the ground or trees, even if the ground is stone, and travel nearly undetected.

Powerful detection methods are the only way for someone to detect you.
objects.title: From The God Tree (Naruto)

objects.text:
You have been injected with a Code, a one-time device that transmuted you into a regular frame, a biomechanical being composed of placenta and heigus particles. Your new form let's you switch between your human form and your armored form at any time. Placenta is a substance that can regenerate and reshape itself, making regular frames biologically immortal and resistant to damage. Heigus particles are a form of omnipresent background energy that exist in the vacuum of space, and generated by the Code now integrated into you, this energy acts as a hyper efficient fuel source that can be used to power your abilities and weapons. Regular frames also have access to a unique special ability or weapon that reflects their personality and preferences.

The first time you transform into a regular frame, the process is accompanied by a "transmutation light" a powerful beam that stretches into the sky. This phenomenon only happens once and does not occur in subsequent transformations. Initially, regular frames aren't much stronger than baseline humans, resulting in a mechanical skeletal appearance similar to frame disease sufferers. However, over time and by utilizing placenta and heigus particles, they can rapidly grow stronger, and create armor and various objects such as clothing and weaponry, including the infamous EBTG. At their peak, a regular frame has the potential to devastate entire worlds.

All regular frames possess potent physical capabilities, extremely high reflexes, the ability to "digest almost anything" and generally require no breathing or nutrition. They are immune to aging and can only die if their brain is destroyed, their head is severed, or their placenta is depleted before a fatal blow is struck.
 
By manipulating their own placenta, regular frames can create various shapes and structures, such as blades, shields, spikes, wings, etc. They can also use it to repair or modify other machines or devices that are compatible with placenta. For example, they could create a sword out of their arm, or fix a broken vehicle with their placenta. They can also utilize placenta as jet fuel, granting high-speed boosts, swift battlefield movement, and flight capabilities.

The flow and output of heigus particles in their body can be controlled by regular frames, allowing them to adjust their speed, strength, durability, and temperature. They can also use heigus particles to fire beams, blasts, or bullets from their body or weapon. For example, they could increase their speed to dodge an attack, or fire a heigus beam from their eye. While wearing any level of seal armor emits heigus particles, which can reveals your location, low seal level or no armor can mask this, but makes you more susceptible to attacks from other users.

Regular frames also have the ability to create anti-megastructure bullet (AMB), which is a powerful projectile that can pierce through Megastructure and Semi-megastructure, a near impenetrable material.

During the transformed state regular frames will have a personalized HUD with the same feature as Etherow when armored. The HUD displays the time remaining until activity cutoff (or armor disengagement), remaining heigus particles, seal level warnings, approaching threats, details about the special ability, and more.
objects.title: Regular Frame (APOSIMZ)

addons.text:
Your Hanma blood’s ferocity has been tempered by your faith, turning what might have been a sledgehammer into a scalpel, and redirecting your combat talent toward a higher purpose.

The scientific miracles and holy blessings you’ve received have combined with your Hanma blood to push your body even further, allowing you to handle most supernatural monsters and persevere through even the most severe injuries, should your healing not be fast enough for instant recovery. Your combat talent has expanded, enabling you to better identify the weaknesses of any monster you encounter. Even if you have no frame of reference for the creature, as long as you survive long enough, you will be able to devise a means to counter it in some form.

Additionally, your Demon Back has received a profound upgrade. Your faith can now empower it, and the stronger your faith, the more powerful you become.
addons.title: God's Daemon

objects.text:
Through some unique combination of scientific miracles and holy blessings, you have gained the powers, skills and knowledge to make you the equal of the Iscariot's trump card, Father Alexander Anderson.

You possess a greatly enhanced physical condition; your superhuman strength, durability, speed, reflexes and stamina enable you to go toe-to-toe with even a True Vampire. You also have an enhanced regeneration factor capable of healing a large hole through your brain in seconds although this regeneration ability can still be overwhelmed. In conjunction with this, you gain all of the fighting skills, experience and knowledge that Father Alexander Anderson possessed.

You can also summon an unlimited number of blessed bayonets, these can spontaneously appear in your hands at will, appearing to come out of nowhere. Each bayonet is made of blessed reinforced metal, dowsed in holy water and is both strong and sharp enough to pierce bulletproof glass. You can throw these bayonets at supersonic speeds and wield them with inhuman accuracy and precision. Additionally, these bayonets can also be linked with explosive charges in a chain, up to dozens at a time, to cause powerful explosions although this ability requires several minutes between each use.

Finally, you possess the miraculous ability to summon thousands of pages of holy scripture and use them for a multitude of purposes. These abilities range from constructing holy barriers to ward off evil beings, short-range teleportation or even restraining monsters via these holy pages. With further practice, you might discover even greater uses for this scripture. These powers are yours alone and aren't dependent on you being a 'good' person or even believing in an Abrahamic God to use them.
objects.title: Alexander Anderson (Hellsing)

objects.text: Your body has been surgically enhanced, allowing you to produce any type of gadget from your body. These gadgets can be released instantly and are fully integrated into your physical form, making them accessible at any time. As long as the gadgets do not exceed your body's size, you can produce as many as you need, making you a versatile and unpredictable threat in any combat scenario. The gadgets can range from simple tools to high-tech weapons and can be customized to suit your needs and preferences. Your ability to produce gadgets on demand makes you a formidable and adaptable foe, able to adapt to any situation and exploit your opponent's weaknesses.
objects.title: Go-go Gadget (Inspector Gadget)

addons.text: On top of being of Eldian blood, you are now a member of the Ackerman Clan, able to use the famous "awakened power", giving you the ability to intuitively understand "what must be done", with the physical power, athleticism, and natural inborn skill needed to carry it out. Your ability is on par with Mikasa, Levi, or Kenny.
addons.title: Ackerman Clan (Attack On Titan)

addons.text: You now have complete knowledge of the meager but hard won technology of Attack On Titan, including the many variants of 3D Maneuver Gear, Anti-Titan Artillery, the general pseudo-WW1 level of tech of the outside world, Eldian medical science, and Titan Weapon development.
addons.title: Yeagerist (Attack On Titan)

objects.text:
You are a Titan Shifter, and not just any Titan Shifter, but one similar to the original, Ymir Fritz. Unlike Ymir, all abilities you possess are your own, and under your complete control. Said abilities include all of the original nine Titan's abilities, immense strength, and a regeneration factor that would allow you to regenerate from anything as long as you have the will to live. 

As you grow more experienced with your powers you may develop new abilities for your Titans, and even make others into Titan Shifters themselves.
objects.title: Titan Shifter (Attack on Titan)

addons.text: Your own corruptive influence has now been infused into your similarly-corruptive Phazon, causing a recursive effect: Wherever your corruption spreads, twisting and warping the world, it now brings Phazon along with it, and your Phazon likewise becomes a vector for your corruption, greatly enhancing the spread of both. Additionally, your conditional immortality is enhanced by the inclusion of Phazon; so long as an area is completely corrupted with both Phazon and your influence, you no longer need to be within one of your domains to resurrect, instead slowly forming a new body within it from scratch should you perish elsewhere.
addons.title: Neo Phaaze

addons.text: Taking on an inky black with a soft blue-purple glow, your Phazon has absorbed the Darkness into itself, mutating and evolving into a greater form. Your Phazon now generates your Darkness within itself in addition to its own volatile energy, and said dark essence now carries and generates new Phazon as well. More than that, however, are the synergistic effects your Phazon now has; the corruptive substance now acts as a ‘binder’ of sorts for any darkness-based powers you have at your disposal, and its harmful effects now carry a supernatural edge, allowing them to work just as well against the mystical and/or paracausal as against the mundane.
addons.title: Dark Phazon

addons.text:
The uniquely corruptive nature of Phazon, combined with the way it blurs the lines between organic, mineral and other, and your unique ‘compatibility’ with it as the originator of this strain have helped to evolve your abilities as a Champion of Autochthon: The horrific, biomechanical Charms known as Voidtech, which invariably mutate and madden Exalts who use them, have their negative effects severely blunted by the superorganism, mitigating the worst of Dissonance and Gremlin Syndrome - and growing stronger as your transformation into pure Phazon progresses.

As unintended side-effects, the power of your Exaltation and its Essence will bond with your Phazon during the transformation, eventually granting the substance an additional spiritual edge to its otherwise ‘mundane’ capabilities, and possibly even turning Voidtech to pure benefit, the spiritually-boosted superorganism slowly replacing Void corruption with your own.
addons.title: Voidtech Mastered

addons.text:
Through the convergence of Chozo and Metroid DNA, your essence has become irrevocably intertwined with the corruptive might of Phazon. This fusion has elevated you beyond mere mortality, aligning your power with that of Dark Samus and the ancient, malevolent force once known as Metroid Prime. You are now a living nexus of Phazon, capable of unleashing devastating energy blasts, replicating yourself, corrupting matter and minds, bending space through teleportation, and soaring through the air with unnatural grace.

The echoes of those who once fell to Phazon’s influence now resonate within you. Rundas’s cryokinetic mastery, Gor’s fusion of flesh and machine, and Gandrayda’s electric dominion and shapeshifting abilities are yours to command. Your physical form has fully integrated with your Power Suit, transforming it into a second skin—one capable of manifesting  all of the technology it possesses.

You are no longer bound by the limits of your origin. You are evolution, corruption, and power incarnate.
addons.title: Hunter Prime

objects.text: You have been implanted with a sample of Phazon, a corruptive substance with a number of outstanding and dangerous properties. Normally taking the form of glowing blue fluid, ores or crystals, it is in fact a pseudo-organic pseudo-mineral superorganism capable of self-replication, and possesses both highly mutagenic and energy-generating properties. It is also highly radioactive, volatile, and toxic and corrosive to most life on top of that, killing many creatures that touch it and mutating the ones that survive into monsters. While you specifically will be exempt from the more lethal effects due to being considered this particular strain’s “progenitor”, others will not be so lucky. As the Phazon spreads inside you, it will gradually replace your ordinary flesh and blood with itself, enhancing your overall capabilities and granting the occasional beneficial - if sometimes disturbing - mutations. During this process, you will find yourself developing a number of abilities, such as generating and discharging Phazon energy, spreading your own internal supply to corrupt your surroundings, and even manipulating the Phazon in an area, such as forming solid Phazon constructs or controlling corrupted creatures and machines. This process can be accelerated by retaking and absorbing excess Phazon from any corrupted surroundings and creatures, though be warned that ‘overfeeding’ can lead to both physical and mental instability. At the height of your development, after becoming a being of solid Phazon, you will find your body slowly stabilizing and reinforcing itself, skin forming into durable Phazite and internals shifting towards newer, stranger functions - and then after that, beginning to develop its own miniature Phazon Core like those of Leviathans, substantially increasing your output when fully formed. Once complete, your form will be similar to that of Dark Samus in miniature; resilient, needless, and possessed of an array of abilities that make you a terror to fight personally, with only outside forms of Phazon-based weaponry being capable of getting through your defenses. As one last note: Phazon’s chaotic nature tends to interact very strangely with environments possessing exotic and/or unstable energies, with Aether’s split into two dimensions being a prime example. Should the substance be introduced to other, similar locales such as the Warp, or otherwise areas where reality is fluid or unstable, such as Shardspace, similar reactions may occur in the future.
objects.title: Phazon Infusion (Metroid)

objects.text:
You are now one of the so-called Übermensch, a superhuman soldier capable of devastating feats. 

Übermensch are ‘activated’ via the application of a catalyst called Wöden’s Blood resulting in superhuman physical condition and the ability to produce exotic energy fields known as the Halo Effect. A single activation can either enhance the Übermensch’s physical condition or the potency of their Halo Effect. For example, a destroyer could potentially have 1 physical activation and 5 Halo Effect activations.

Physical activations drastically enhance an individual’s physiology, allowing them to be capable of tearing apart steel and shrugging off bullets while Halo Effect activations grant them the ability to produce Halo fields that can disrupt matter on an atomic level. With enough activations and skill, you can even transmute and manipulate matter itself via the Halo Effect. Every further activation vastly increases your strength and capabilities in that select area.

Physical overexertion and overuse of the Halo Effect normally leads to Übermensch exploding but for you it will just cause tiredness and a severe headache. Übermensch also have significantly increased size due to their physical activations but you can also avoid this if you wish. You possess a total of 6 activations divided between enhancing your physical and Halo Effect capabilities in any manner of your choice.
objects.title: Destroyer Class (Über)

objects.text: Like the freljordian who experienced their clan being slaughtered like sheep in front of a nigh unstoppable force, and being tossed aside like an ant unable to resist, you’ve awoken your thirst for vengeance. Having assumed the mantle of Tryndamere, you’ve now gained his prowess in combat alongside his other abilities- especially his fury towards the Darkin. While in combat, your Blood Fury and Bloodlust abilities activate, enhancing your attributes and rage with every attack and kill. This bonus increases until your attributes are roughly double their base, and lasts until the end of combat. Due to your Bloodlust, your body now also regenerates damage taken, scaling in potency with your current rage and willpower. Finally, the peak of your power is your ability Undying Rage, which conceptually prevents you from experiencing death for a short period and instantly enrages you.
objects.title: Undying Rage (League of Legends)

objects.text: "You'd wish the world you know to end! Yeeeesssss..." Having let the Watchers subsume you into one of their creations, Cho’Gath, you’ve become a maw for the Void to fill its insatiable hunger. A perfect expression of the Void's desire to consume all life. Starting as a newly created avatar of The Terror of the Void grants you five innate abilities. One of which is its Voidborn Physiology, letting you exist and navigate through the unknowable nothingness that lies beyond reality. Second, you acquire the ability to unleash a barrage of Vorpal Spikes from your body, impaling enemies in a wide area. Thirdly, you can Rupture the ground, creating localized seismic events that damage and knock up enemies. Your fourth ability is a Feral Scream that creates a sonic blast which damages, disrupts, and silences enemies within the blast- preventing them from casting magic for a short duration. Finally, the signature power of Cho’Gath is its ability to Feast, where you attempt to devour an enemy within range, bypassing most resistances. If you successfully devour an enemy you permanently increase in conceptual health, durability, size, and strength in relation to its mass. "Death... is not the end for you! I have seen to it: for eternity, you are mine!" Optionally you may choose to gain the appearance of any Cho’Gath skin featured in League of Legends or retain your own visage.
objects.title: The Terror of the Void (League of Legends)

objects.text:
Within your body now courses powerful bioenergy, which gives you the power to transform into and use the abilities of various monsters from the world of Monster Hunters.

You start only capable of transforming into monsters on the same level as a Great Jagras. However, as your mastery continues to grow, you can begin to transform into increasingly powerful monsters, such as elder dragons and various monster subspecies.

Eventually, you become capable of creating and transforming into a hybridized form of different monsters or even using their power when not transformed.

Each time you utilize this power, you can release a great amount of bioenergy into the world, empowering wildlife and the global ecosystem as a whole. This process slowly but surely transforms it into one that can birth and sustain powerful monsters, similar to those in the world of Monster Hunters.

If you manage to take down these new monsters and devour them, you can add their power and form to your repertoire.
objects.title: Ecology Of One (Monster Hunter)

objects.text:
You have become a monster hunter, forged in a world where only the strongest survive. Through relentless training and a diet rich in Bio-Energy, you have become a powerhouse yourself. Your body is infused with Bio-Energy, granting you strength and stamina far beyond that of an ordinary human.

You can carry up to five tons without slowing down, wield massive weapons with ease, and traverse vast distances under hazardous conditions with barely a hint of fatigue, your stamina replenishing in mere breaths. Blows powerful enough to level buildings do little more than stagger you, and you strike back with equal, earth-shattering force. Your reflexes are honed to perfection, swift enough to dodge a lightning strike.

Beyond your superhuman physical abilities, you are a master of the hunt. Trained in every weapon and hunting style known to the Monster Hunter world, you excel in tracking, trapping, and using the environment to your advantage. No prey escapes your sight, and no battlefield is unfamiliar terrain.

Of course, no hunter faces the hunt unarmed. You are equipped with a weapon and armor set of your choosing, each piece carefully selected to complement your skills and fighting style.

As of now, the guild recognizes you as a high-rank hunter. With another year or two of experience, you could ascend to the prestigious G-rank—ready to challenge even the mightiest of Elder Dragons.
objects.title: The Hunter (Monster Hunter)

addons.text: You should not EXIST. An Abomination, a Monster, an Unholy union of flesh and steel, both a creature of man and man itself. Blood now flows through you without end, dense and full of life, SPECIAL; now a being that cannot die, for your blood will never cease, no damage shall be able to extinguish your existence, regenerating endlessly. What may have been death before is now just a minor setback. Perfect for a creature of war like yourself. You can now activate a battle mode, elevating all your basic abilities to a disturbing degree while adding new functions and twists. This mode is your greatest strength and weakness; burning through too much blood in this mode will force you into a dormant state until it regenerates. This dormancy is the closest you'll ever be to death in your eternal existence.
addons.title: Abominable Existence

objects.text: Mankind is dead. Blood is fuel. Hell is full. Humanity waged war for nearly two centuries, and you are the prototype - the epitome of martial prowess, the ultimate creation of war. You are a machine that is fueled by fresh blood. When blood comes in contact with you, it soaks through your armor. When this happens, you will be healed, and your weapons repaired. This does come at the cost of being somewhat fragile. If you absorb enough blood while you aren't damaged, you can double your durability. Do note that if you take too much damage, and heal too fast, you will accumulate hard damage, meaning you can't regenerate those parts for a short while. This can be undone by simply not getting hit for a short time, or absorbing an excessive amount of blood. You have 8 wings protruding from your back, and they help you in a variety of ways. Firstly, it enables you aerial maneuverability, dashing, and continuous sliding where you slowly lose your speed, even over bumpy surfaces and going uphill, instead of losing all your speed almost in a few seconds. You can also slam into the ground with a large amount of force, and send enemies into the air. You can only do these actions (dashing and slamming into the ground) as long as you have "stamina," for a total of 3 times, before having to give your wings a short break, usually 2 seconds for 1 "stamina." You can force your wings to do it regardless, but it will damage you. Another thing your wings do is store your weaponry, although it isn't limited to them. You can pull them out instantly, or put something in, with mere contact with your wings. You do not start with any of your weaponry, but you do hold the knowledge to create them. You do not need to worry about building the tools for the tools and such, as you can simply create them with sufficient blood. You are also able to reprogram your body to make it different, like being more durable, or giving yourself the equivalent of a grappling hook at the cost of higher blood requirements. You can also parry. More specifically, when you hit an attack, you can send it back with even greater force. The attacks have to be more on the physical side of things to be properly parried. For example, you can't parry fire. Ignoring that, short of an unstoppable force, you can parry anything. As a machine, you also naturally think at high speeds, able to make calculations for the most stylish efficient attacks.
objects.title: Supreme Machine (ULTRAKILL)

addons.text: Like Emerl, you can choose to copy the martial skill of one or more Sonic characters. By default, these will have abilities based on Sonic the Fighters, Battle, Frontiers, or any media where said character's martial prowess is on display. You can mix and match these or create your own original moveset. Also, depending on the martial powers chosen, you can get some bonuses. With Gotetsu Style Shotokan Karate or Hakkyoseiken, you can mimic the supernatural powers of these characters, like Blaze's flames, Surge's lightning, Shadow’s chaos powers, or Silver's psychokinesis. But will be street level compared to the absurd things the mentioned characters can do. With Rokushiki, you can gain all of that character's martial skill alongside a full Sonic Frontiers inspired moveset, due to all aspects of Rokushiki being applicable for it. With Fighting Instinct or The Brawler, you receive the martial skill to match them, and a natural adaptability that modifies it as your own, and evolves over time. Note: These benefits are not mutually exclusive. Meaning that you can take a different one regardless of your chosen martial power.
addons.title: Emerl Reborn

addons.text:
You can activate a state that boosts your physical, magical, spiritual, and other abilities tremendously. Either at will or by cultivating enough energy before releasing it as this state. The design of this form is tailored to represent your personality and powers perfectly. By default, yours will resemble Sonic’s, amplifying your core traits while emitting an elemental or particle effect of your choice. Which will affect your powers and add new properties to them, even if you have none. Otherwise, you can customize this form to create brand new expressions of them. 

For example, if you have White Mage, this can create a forcefield that both protects you and grants limited flight, similar to Amy’s Card Spin Boost. 

If you have Sendo, this can coat your body in a cloak of Hamon that burns everything around you, and project it as a ranged attack, similar to Knuckles' Drill Spin Boost. 

If you have Tech powers or an Ironman Suit, this can either conjure a piece of tech related to it in the form of a support item (weapons, armors, vehicles, tools, etc), or change the suit's to form have more features, similar to Tails' Cyclone Boost.

You can maintain these forms so long as you have energy to fuel them, and can cancel out or re-enter it at anytime. As you grow, so to will these forms, which are also stackable with other powers and even Super Forms.
addons.title: Power Boost

addons.text:
Just as Sonic himself moves through stages with effortless grace and coolness, or more accurately, the way his games set him up to move through obstacles with little to no player input. You can too!

If there’s a large death chasm before you with nothing to get across, save for some large pillars, you can effortlessly apply your speed, acrobatics and/or powers to wall jump from those pillars as a makeshift bridge. With a headstart in speed after crossing, and any additions your powers can apply. Shortcuts to cover large ground in minimal time, or straight up skip entire sections of an area become effortless for you to find and exploit. 

You’ll even find yourself running through complex paths, making instant turns, drifting at the perfect angles, and conquering obstacles like falling debris or unnatural surfaces easily, without even thinking about it. As if your movements are on autopilot.
addons.title: Boost to Win

addons.text:
You gain either an Extreme Gear from the Sonic Riders games or a vehicle from the Sonic and Sega All Stars Racing games. Regardless of which you choose, you can gain the other in time. 

Extreme Gears are hoverboards capable of flight, reaching ludicrous speeds, and generating solid air. They also come in the form of skates and motorcycles. 

All Star vehicles are cars that can transform into 3 different states: Normal Mode, Flight Mode and Boat Mode. The first lets it function like a normal racecar, the second transforms it into a plane, and the last into a speedboat.
addons.title: All Star

addons.text:
You gain access to one or both versions of the Soul Gauge from the Sonic Storybook games, with their full mechanics. This gauge is visualized in your mind or outward in any aesthetic you wish, and either vertical or horizontal. 

The gauge generates energy passively at a slow rate, and can be increased through methods like collecting rings, orbs, butterflies, cultivation, and converting your own esoteric energies. By spending any amount of energy from it, you can activate one of three techniques: Speed Break, Time Break, or Soul Surge. 

Speed Break is an equivalent to the Boost that makes you take the most optimal route to your destination, while automatically avoiding or fighting obstacles. Time Break is a pseudo Chaos Control that slows time to a crawl for everyone, except you. Soul Surge lets you oneshot most hordes of enemies or obstacles at immense speed within seconds, parry projectiles or attacks, and lay waste to a single target with hundreds to thousands of strikes in an instant.

These techniques only last for as long as you can maintain energy for your Soul Gauge, until depletion. Also, you can use it to amplify any other powers or techniques you possess.
addons.title: Soul Gauge

addons.text: You can now transform into a werewolf version of yourself, like the Werehog from Sonic Unleashed. Unlike Sonic’s experience, you aren't cursed by Dark Gaia, nor are you forced to transform during the night. You still trade your speed for greater strength in this form, being only faster than an olympic athlete at most, with reverting back to your original one taking a few seconds at least. In this form, you gain all of the Werehog's abilities and combat prowess. From his extendable limbs; Strength to lift giant robots and chuck them through the air; Retractable claws to tear through steel; and Unleashed Mode to go beyond your limits. You can also perform all of the Werehog's combos and techniques from Sonic Unleashed, plus develop your own. If you have supernatural powers or the Power Boost Addon, you can cultivate an equivalent to Dark Gaia Force to further enhance your abilities.
addons.title: Wereform

addons.text: You now have the psychokinetic abilities of Silver the Hedgehog. Your telekinesis is powerful enough to move objects up to 20 times your size and weighing several tons. You can levitate and fly at speeds close to Sonic’s, easily immobilize beings as strong as Sonic, and manipulate non-solid objects like fire and energy. You also have the ability to teleport, induce vertigo in enemies, and project psionic energy as barriers or energy blasts. Additionally, you have knowledge of all the techniques Silver has demonstrated in the series.
addons.title: Hope of the Future

addons.text:
You gain either one or the combined powers of Surge and Kit, allowing you to manipulate electricity and water on a massive scale. From charging yourself with electricity to then release it in one massive blast, running at the speed of light, absorbing all forms of electricity to empower yourself, generating a massive torret of water to form into various shapes, barriers, propulsion, or as flight, and many more applications.

As a bonus, you gain their cybernetic enhancements and cellular modifications from the Metal Virus, granting tremendous physical ability, durability and an accelerated healing factor. To the point of surviving lethal impacts from Eggman's strongest robots with nothing more than a superfical bruise, and contending with both Metal Sonic and the blue blur himself.
addons.title: Starline's Magum Opus

addons.text:
You gain the powers of Blaze the Cat, letting you exert your will over fire with majestic grace and efficiency. If you were a prodigy at firebending before, now you’re a master at it—letting you shape and control every single detail of your flames from temperature, to the rate of spreading, what it does and doesn’t burn, etc. You can manipulate fire outside of you, and are immune to all forms of it.

In addition, you gain all of her techniques. Such as the Burst Hover and Burst Dash to either glide through or zoom through the air; Axel Jump and Spinning Claw to become a whirlwind of fire that covers a large range; Axel Tornado to propel yourself higher, and Fire Boost to run at immense speeds while scorching everything infront of you.

Note: If you have the Chaos Emeralds, you can gain a Burning Form instead of a Super Form, which amplifies your Firebending to the point of becoming a walking volcano capable of hurling enough fire to destroy entire fleets of battleships, or fireballs the size of meteors. This is merely a cosmetic change, as you still retain the same benefits of the Super Form.
addons.title: Sol Empress

addons.text: You've become the coolest! So much so, that you can break the laws of physics and become nigh-inexhaustable, granting you all the abilities of the Trick Mechanic across all Sonic games. But unlike them, you don't need to launch off a ramp, just be airborne. From the Advance Triliogy, you can gain extra height, propel yourself in any direction, or force a fast fall by doing a stylish maneuver that correlates to it. From the Rush and Boost games, you can generate an additional stockpile of energy by performing a chain of tricks plus a massive influx by finishing it before touching the ground, or successfully enacting Rule of Cool, which will scale according to how impressive it is. This stockpile is infinite, and can be used to either restore your vitality and energy reserves, or to fuel and amplify any of your abilities. Optionally, you can place a cap on it that when full, allows you to temporarily draw on infinite reserves of it. Once this state ends, it will drop to half automatically, until you refuel it again. You also gain access to Quick Time Events, where you can mentally perform a series of button presses that—if successful—make you automatically perform the best course of action, break physics, and do the impossible. During this, your perception is slowed to give you a fair chance at them. You can activate it at anytime, or when it calls to you, but the more the odds are stacked against you, the harder they become.
addons.title: Trick System

objects.text:
Who's cool, blue, and has an attitude? Sonic, but now you can at least claim to be his equal in speed. You start off being able to comfortably hold a sustained jog at just over Mach 1, being able to move up to Mach 5 in small bursts. Eventually, with time, you'll be able to reach speeds of up to Mach 25. You also have the reflexes to react at these speeds, able to dodge or turn at a moments notice. You also have the acrobatic ability to grind on rails and jump off walls while maintaining your momentum.

You also can perform all of the moves as Sonic in the games, like the Homing Attack which locks on to a target and sends you flying at them at high speeds, or the Spin Dash, where you build up speed for a moment before launching forward. You can also, with practice, learn to perform moves like Chaos Spear, which sends destructive spears of chaos energy at an enemy, or Chaos Control, which lets you warp space to teleport.

You can choose to become a Mobian with this, a species that all resemble humanoid earth animals, or to remain as you are. The only difference will be the way you perform certain actions. Also, if you want, instead of running, you may choose to be able to project an energy field beneath your feet and skate instead. This won't affect your speed any, merely how you move. You also get a free pair of sneakers that will never break down, no matter how far or how fast you run in them.
objects.title: Fastest Thing Alive (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
Your body has been enhanced by billions of self-replicating nanomachines that fill your bloodstream, augmenting your body and providing you with supernatural abilities. However, these nanomachines are restricted by the amount of energy available to them. The main benefit of these nanomachines is that they grant you a regenerative healing factor, which protects your body and heals it from almost any injury. 
 
The only way to kill you entirely would be to destroy every individual nanite in your body, as the nanites possess a backup of your mind, with time, they will rebuild your body even from total annihilation or disintegration. Additionally, the nanites give you enhanced physical stats, such as the ability to easily smash buildings, reach supersonic speeds, and become more durable due to the nanites hardening in response to physical trauma.
 
Through the nanites, you also possess other abilities, such as enhanced cognition, as your mind can tap into the augmented processing power of the nanites, allowing you to predict the future or augment your senses with the nanites. You also possess a form of technopathy, being able to use nanites to control machines or absorb them into yourself and gain the function of the machine via shapeshifting parts of your body with nanites into various forms. 
 
The longer you have the nanites, the more advanced they become. Each new generation of nanites possesses adaptations learned from the previous generation, allowing for more varied abilities such as flight, matter manipulation, shapeshifting, duplication, enhanced technopathy, and more. The Nanites possess a rudimentary intelligence that grows with time the more nanites you possess.

As you explore the possibilities of the nanites, you will learn new uses and expand the abilities that the nanites can produce. The limits of this are yet to be seen and will be limited entirely by how long your nanites have been adapting to new scenarios.
objects.title: Project Bloodshot (Valiant)

objects.text: ’ Elite Troops assigned to Shinra's Public Security Division. Those who pass SOLDIER's rigorous screening tests are bathed in mako to further enhance their physical capabilities. Units are assigned one of three ranks depending on aptitude, but even SOLDIERs in the lowest rank are not to be underestimated. ‘ Having survived being subjected to a mutagenic mako infusion and alien DNA from Jenova, you’ve become a new SOLDIER recruit. SOLDIER’s are a super-soldier like private military working for the Shinra Electric Power Company that protect its interests and property. Becoming a new SOLDIER comes with a plethora of boons. SOLDIERS of all degrees are renown for their glowing eyes, and extremely heightened physical aspects, such as supernatural strength, speed, agility, and cognitive performance. Additionally they possess a closer connection to materia, abling you to use them with greater potency and frequency, while being simultaneously less taxing than should be possible. Unfortunately this process comes with the downside of mako-propelled cellular degradation. This will end up drastically shortening your lifespan in most cases and cause extreme pain the closer you are to unraveling at the genetic level. Lastly you are gifted a set of SOLDIER’s combat fatigues and a SOLDIER’s two-handed sword.
objects.title: SOLDIER 3rd Class (Final Fantasy VII)

objects.text:
You’re a Supublic, a type of superhuman whose origins trace back to when the Triad Prana were first discovered and Supublics were first created.

Moreover, you’re among the most powerful supublics to have ever existed.

Your power comes in 3 major parts.

The first is your physical enhancements. Your strength is enhanced to the point you could comfortably toss skyscrapers, punt someone with enough force to send them through multiple mountains while also destroying everything in their path, even send out powerful blasts of air through nothing more than simple movements due to your sheer strength.

Your durability is similarly enhanced, capable of shrugging off blows that flatten the city underneath you to fine grains of sand without so much as a scratch. This durability will also extend to more esoteric effects such as heat, corrosive substances, and more esoteric effects.

Moreover, if you’re significantly more powerful than your opponent, you can outright negate the effects their abilities would have on you, even if you otherwise would have no particular protection against them. Your stamina is also enhanced to match.

Your regeneration is not any more powerful than normal, unless your Skill is linked to it in some way, but injuries you do manage to get seem to have a greatly reduced impact on you, allowing you the opportunity to survive and possibly recuperate, given enough time.

Your speed is also incredible, faster than the speed of sound several times over, and with the reflexes to easily match that kind of speed. The speeds you can reach can devastate the surroundings.

The second aspect is your Skills, the superpowers every Supublic has as well as the unique Special Skill. Special Skills can range from Mind Control, Electricity Manipulation, Flight, pausing time and almost anything else you can think of.

Each Supublic has three inherent Skills, the Fall-Slow Skill, which allows them to slowly fall to the ground giving them a form of gliding, the High-Jump Skill, which allow them to leap incredible distances both vertical and horizontal, which alongside the Fall-Slow Skill allows most Supublics to emulate a form of Flight, and the Beam Burster, where the Supublic can collect their internal reserve of energy and unleash it as a powerful blast from their body.

The Beam can be unleashed from any part of their body, whether their hands, eyes, feet, or even an omnidirectional blast. Moreover, you can choose how much of your internal energy is directed to the blast.

Aside from that, each Supublic has a Special Skill; you may choose what yours is. Your Skill’s potency will be in accordance with your own level of power. Your skill may be a reasonable but powerful singular ability, such as Gravity Control, Precognition, etc.

Supublics have a reservoir of energy inside them that fuels their abilities and Skills. The greater your reservoir, the greater your power. Using your Skills also drains the reservoir, slowly depleting your energy.

You can run out of this energy, rendering you unable to use your Skills; however, your power, speed, and general enhanced physical abilities will remain. As your reserves diminish, however, you will feel a drain on your stamina, although even being completely tapped out of energy doesn’t make you feel more drained than a normal workout.

Your own reservoir of power is incredibly vast and damn near impossible to deplete without you trying to push your Unique Skill to its limit or trying to use the entirety of it to fuel your beam burster.

The energy will recover over time; the more powerful you are, the faster you recover. In your case, you can recover from being entirely depleted back to full within 15 minutes without other factors. Different states of emotion can drastically affect the speed you recover as well as the potency of your power. Extreme anger can drive the potency up, but it’ll drain the energy you use faster. A calm mind can reduce your recovery period, and if you can somehow exist in both states of anger and serenity, you can benefit from both states simultaneously.

You can also use this energy reservoir to enhance any of your other abilities as well, and this reservoir of energy will naturally grow larger over time and even faster through training. The more it grows, the faster it'll grow.
objects.title: Supublic (Sidekicks)

objects.text: Whether it comes from an ardent determination to do the right thing, a feverish drive to live as crazy as possible, or an undeniable motivation for what you cherish the most, something deep within you boils and burns up answering your resolve and iron will, HEAT flares out your body, your fighting spirit manifesting as an aura of wreathing flames. Your Heat focuses your body and mind into combat, building up your strikes’ potency and mobility’s swiftness, hitting with some ‘oomph’ and ‘swosh’, a sharpened mind to process it all for reflexes and sensing any offensive, and shrugging off injuries that leave lesser men on the dust. Fueling this Heat comes from all sorts of activities, mainly on scenarios that get your blood pumping, a run, smoking a quick one, or as fun as playing a competitive game or trolling an enemy, yet the most efficient and quicker way to stoke Heat’s flames is by fighting. Landing attacks and countering/evading your opponent's attacks are by far the fastest ways to build up Heat. But Heat’s main usage is burning it up for a devastating attack, a Heat Action if you will. Provided your environment, weapon, or fighting style, and how Heat you’ve built, the attack you perform is guaranteed to be brutal, damaging, and awesome, with the more Heat you burn for an Action the more damaging your attack. At first, your Heat Gauge (also an indicator of how much raw power and constitution you have) is as comparable as Daigo Dojima, but with enough blood, sweat, and tears, you’ll be among Legends like Kiryu Kazuma, Goro Majima, Ryuji Goda, among others. As a plus, you earn all of Yakuza Series’s Styles to be trained and practiced, with the implausibility and zaniness it entails, meaning you also inherit Yakuza’s Series absurdity both as a person and martial prodigy.
objects.title: Feel the HEAT! (Yakuza: Like a Dragon)

addons.text: Your ascention to God's Right Seat has awakened your full potential as a Saint, granting you the ability that would normally be only attuned to archangel Gabriel. You have gained the ability Divine Mother's Mercy, one that allows you to ignore any costs and limitations of magic as well as your body's. This allows you to draw on the power of the Son of God much more freely without the constant threat of burning out, tremendously raising your physical capabilities. You can now move at relativistic speed enough to dodge orbital lasers, your strength is enough to effortlessly throw multiple fortresses weighting tens of thousands of tonnes each, and your body has become nearly indestructible. The ability to ignore the limitations of magic allows you to use any magic you can learn, regardless of its source; as such, you can use normal human magic despite being a member of God's Right Seat, as well as any other that would normally be inaccessible to you for some reason. Lastly, as you now share in the holiness of Divine Mother herself, this trait constantly expels any sin you have, making you truly innocent. As such, this completely nullifies any punishment- or vengeance-based attacks that would be directed upon you.
addons.title: Divine Mother's Mercy

addons.text:
Under the influence of your body, which imitates the Son of God, the remnant clairvoyance Merlin possessed as a potential anti-christ fuse into your eyes, transforming them into the rainbow-ranked Mystic Eyes of Providence, a mystic eye derived from the Almighty God of Christianity.

As a rainbow-ranked mystic eye, when in use, your iris becomes akin to a chaotic swirling ocean containing all possible colors and possibilities. In essence, your eyes function like a fusion of Merlin's Clairvoyance and Solomon's own, allowing you to see the entirety of God's creation. Whether it be the past, present, or future, your sight reaches all things.

Even alternate timelines or dimensions, like dreamworlds, are not exempt from your sight; no part of God's creation is beyond your sight. This incredible amount of sensory information does not negatively affect you, regardless of whether it would otherwise cause mental or spiritual contamination. 

This does not come with understanding or knowledge of what you perceive and thus does not make you all-knowing, only all-seeing.
addons.title: Mystic Eyes of Providence

objects.text:
While humans are generally thought of as made in the image of God, you stand far closer than most, being a more high-quality replica, with organ placement and skeletal structure identical to that of the Son of God himself.

This special body of yours allows you to instinctively draw on the powers of the Son of God. This results in a body, mind, and soul much stronger than that of a normal human. You can hear a whisper from 10 meters away, see clearly for hundreds of meters, lift several tonnes of weight, move at hypersonic speed, as well as have durability enough to survive for a short while in the vacuum of space and subsequent atmospheric reentry and landing with nothing but your clothes on. You also have much more mana than a regular person or even seasoned magicians and your blood possesses a minor healing properties granting you immunity from sickness and moderately supernatural regeneration.

For all your powers, you also possess some weaknesses, as you are vulnerable to the weapons and attacks that harmed the Son of God, such as spears and other stabbing weapons, nails or crown of thorns.

Lastly, you can temporarily supercharge your body, drawing much more power, but this comes with the danger of dying from exhaustion, as your body won't be able to keep up with the power of the Son of God forever.
objects.title: Saint (Raildex)

objects.text:
You have become a reploid, a replicated android based off the design of X, the magnum opus of Doctor Light, the greatest scientific mind his world has ever known. You possess complete free will and thought processes comparable to humans, while physically being far more capable.

Reploids are often humanoid robots that wear bulky metal armor, especially around their forelimbs and upper body. 

You have a decent healing factor able to repair nearly any non critical injury you receive so long as you have enough energy and your body has the resources necessary for the repairs.

All reploids have a DNA program, a set of programming which builds their consciousness. This makes it similar to a human's soul, it also called a DNA soul. DNA programs are integrated into a reploid's entire body and can be extracted from the smallest parts of a reploid, similar to organic DNA. This DNA can be manipulated for various purposes, such as crafting weapons based on a reploid's physiology or resurrecting the reploid entirely. This DNA can adapt and change in response to stimuli much like organic dna, though it does it much more intelligently.

Your DNA will recognize armor and weapons that connect to your body as well as upgrades as a part of you to be maintained by your self-repair system.

As machines, reploids do not age, although they still require rest and maintenance to remain functional.

You are by default part of one of the later generations of reploids produced during the initial Maverick wars meaning you can look completely human if you desire. 

Through a combination of your armor and physiology you have durability similar to a modern tank, you are also equipped with basic plasma busters that you can transform either of your arms into while having your armor equipped. These plasma busters can rapidly fire small yellow bursts of energy that can melt through armor similar to your own in only a few shots.

You will know how to maintain yourself, which includes building technology and infrastructure to support your continued existence in the long term.

You also will know how to make basic Mega Man X era technology, particularly weapons and armor.
objects.title: Reploid (Mega Man X)

objects.text:
Codename: AMa-10, you are a second model of this line of mechanical lifeforms created by the Predesesors, engineered to assist humanity in terraforming planets and help build homes for them. Characterized by your impressive ability to learn and near-industructible structure, one that can reconstruct and reconfigure itself to adapt to all sorts of extreme or hostile environments/conditions.

Central to your design is the Gemini Cycle System, meaning so long as one of you exists, true "death" is impossible. Upon termination, your memories and continuity are transferred to your partner, who'll enter a cocoon state and reconfigure themself into your new form/iteration within several days.

During this process, you may also freely redesign your body, altering both its external structure and internal functions to suit your needs.

Your partner in question is something akin to a twin—another half of the same whole—a sibling and companion, though one not fully conscious in the conventional sense. Despite this, they understand you sincerely on an instinctive level. In their idle state, they'll follow you as a compressed, floating octahedron crystal.

When decompressed, your partner assumes the form of a crystalline, dragon-like entity clad in a resilient metallic exterior that's impervious to all conventional weaponry and even attacks capable of incinerating mountainsides. Any damage that does breach their defenses is then quickly repaired through an equally formidable regenerative capability.

They are also immeasurably strong, more than enough to hurl heavy-duty trucks as if they were toys, capable of physically contending with people like Skadi, without ever knowing exhaustion or tiredness. Moreover, your partner can move at speeds blinding even to the highly trained eye of Elite Operators, vanishing from view entirely.

Complementing this are their razor-sharp talons capable of smiting through physical material as though it were butter—though that's not all. They can even fire off beams of ultra-concentrated energy that'll erase almost anything it touches, reducing large cave systems to rubble or slicing clean through reinforced structures and into the horizon like an artillery piece.
objects.title: Mon3tr (Arknights)

objects.text: Robot Prince of Auchtertool Over thy robot kingdom rule! Electronic Lord of War Destined to reign forevermore! The Robot Prince of Aughtertool has returned, reforged. After his tragic defeat at the hand of the nuclear double wizard Zargothrax, the power imbued within by the Starlords of Eternity has found its new form: Yourself. Your new body is completely mechanical, free from the failures of biology, and wrought with powersteel, capable of taking great blows that would feel any lesser man. Great boronic wings sprout from your back, capable of flying at great speeds, and across the galaxy unaided. In addition, being forged to be a warrior king, your body is equipped with head-mounted (and concealed!) laser cannons within its eyes, wrist rockets capable of being powered by solar energy alone, and a great blade stored within your mechanised body. Your new Mind is possessed of the tactical wit and experience of lifetimes of battle. The prior Robot Princes of Aughtertool inhabit your mental matrices as advisors and confidantes. Each one a prodigy in warfare and rulership. As sovereign ruler and saviour of machines, you can imbue divides that have enough complexity with sapience uplifting them, and incorporating them into your network, the loyal citizens of Auchtertool. Through this you are also capable of bestowing the prior princes bodies of their own, but to have even a semblance of their own strength they'd have to be forged especially for themselves Should they die they’ll return to your inner matrices. Finally, as a result of your nature as a creation of the old gods of Dundee, you are possessed of a form of immortality. No matter in what method you perish, a new Robot Prince will be reforged somehow, and it will be as much the Robot Prince of Aughtertool as any prior or afterward. That is to say, have your memories and personality added to its matrix, imposing on it as the prior princes impose upon yours.
objects.title: He Has Returned (Gloryhammer)

objects.text:
You have inherited the mystical shapeshifting abilities of the Oina Tribe from Kamui, a spiritual bond that allows you to take on the form of a wolf seamlessly. This power is deeply connected to nature and the spiritual realm, providing you with unique physical and mystical traits.  

You can freely transform between human and wolf forms. Transformations are instantaneous and require no ritual or preparation, reflecting your mastery of this ability. In wolf form, your appearance incorporates unique traits such as fur patterns, colors, or markings that reflect your human identity.  

In wolf form, your physical attributes are drastically enhanced, allowing you to move swiftly and with perfect balance, outrunning most creatures and effortlessly traversing difficult terrain. You can carry and pull loads far heavier than your size would suggest, with the stamina to endure for hours. Your senses are heightened to extraordinary levels, enabling you to hear heartbeats through walls, track scents days old, and see clearly even in near-total darkness. Additionally, you retain the ability to speak and communicate fluently in wolf form, bridging the gap between your human and animal nature.  

You possess an innate bond with nature and spiritual forces, granting you the ability to sense danger, communicate with animals, and attune to the spiritual energy of your surroundings.

Adapt easily to harsh environments, using your wolf form’s natural resilience to cold and your human ingenuity for crafting and problem-solving. Form deep bonds with allies, increasing trust and coordination in groups. You gain an intuitive understanding of your companions’ emotions and intentions. Track prey or enemies with unparalleled skill, becoming a master hunter and scout.  

This power embodies the mystical and physical prowess of the Oina Tribe, blending their deep spiritual roots with practical abilities for survival, combat, and exploration. Whether as a lone wolf or leading a pack, you are a true child of Kamui, a guardian of balance and the natural world.
objects.title: Wolf-Blood Shapeshifter (Okami)

addons.text:
You gain access to an expanded weapon wheel, allowing you to have two more primary weapon slots.

Along with the ability to store and summon a variety of gadget weaponry. This includes grenades of different types, throwable knives, Molotov cocktails, and more.

Additionally, you can carry stims and other healing items, as well as ingredients and materials necessary for crafting. This allows you to create various drugs and throwable weapons from the games, such as toughness-enhancing drugs and pipe bombs. You are not limited to the original recipes and can learn to create new ones.

Your arsenal also includes tools for recreation and utility, such as grappling hooks for scaling walls and fishing rods with bait for fishing.

You inherit the combined skills and knowledge of every mainstream Far Cry protagonist, making you one of the most formidable guerilla fighters in the world. Furthermore, your tattoo grants you abilities inspired by the various perks available in each respective game.
addons.title: Guerilla Warfare (Far Cry)

addons.text:
You are no longer merely a beast of myth or a soldier of code—you are Wojtek, the living legend reborn. Inspired by the real Syrian brown bear who served alongside the Polish II Corps during World War II, carrying artillery shells at Monte Cassino and earning the rank of corporal, your existence now bridges the primal and the tactical, the feral and the disciplined. 

Your immense Runebear physique is now seamlessly integrated with the tactical acumen of an FPS soldier. Weapons adapt to your formidable size, scaling in both dimensions and firepower. A standard rifle transforms into a devastating cannon in your paws, and grenades detonate with amplified force, matching your strength. Ammunition is proportionally enhanced, ensuring that each shot delivers maximum impact.

Beyond ranged combat, your close-quarters capabilities are unparalleled. Drawing from military CQC techniques and your natural wrestling prowess, you can subdue enemies with bone-crushing holds and throws. Your movements are a blend of calculated strategy and raw power, making you a formidable opponent in any melee confrontation.

Embracing the spirit of your namesake, you possess an uncanny affinity for alcohol and coffee. Spirits, no matter how rough or diluted, taste smooth and nourishing. Strong liquor settles your body like a warm fire. Coffee, whether fresh or burnt, invigorates you like a power-up—restoring stamina, sharpening your senses, and stabilizing your focus with uncanny efficiency. Both provide the nutritional value of a full meal, sustaining you during prolonged engagements.
addons.title: Wojtek

objects.text:
You now possess the body of a first-person shooter (FPS) soldier, capable of regenerating to full health after a few seconds without taking damage. You have immense stamina, three weapon slots (primary, secondary, and melee), and a fully functional heads-up display (HUD).

Additionally, you gain the skills necessary to achieve proficiency in the use of firearms and the operation of most military vehicles, spanning from the early 20th century to the mid-2040s.
objects.title: FPS (Alternate History CYOA)

addons.text:
Your newfound martial arts prowess, and/or manipulation of energy merges seamlessly with your Burst Techniques, allowing you to develop new ones and improve them over time. This works within the limits of what your chosen martial style is. You’re also able to generate Burst Energy passively, and/or through other methods.

If you wish to activate a chain of Burst Techniques, you can assign 4 of them you know into a “Loadout”. From there, you can activate all techniques in rapid succession at any rate you choose and swap between them in real time. There are no limits to the amount of Loadouts you can have.
addons.title: Loadouts

addons.text:
You gain all the Chips ever created by the Nurse—attachments that grant you passive bonuses to new abilities. Like making you faster, stronger, or yielding more Burst Energy, to a double jump, enhancing your hookshot, or extending your range when equipped. You can only equip 3 at a time however, but with Loadouts, you can swap between them.

You also gain the knowledge to create new chips, add new slots for them, and other technology from Gravity Circuit.
addons.title: Chips

objects.text: You've become a Circuit, a host to an object that bonds itself to your very being, reshaping your previous body into one resembling any of the established Circuits, or of your own design. On top of gaining unique abilities tailored to you. As a foundation, you have the same physical capabilities as Kai, the Gravity Circuit. Who can sprint at incredible speeds, break solid metal his fists, carry and throw virtually anything with immense force, and is durable enough to match. You possess a hookshot that allows you to latch onto and swing from surfaces, as well as grab and pull objects toward you. As well as skill in brawling. That's not all however, as by fighting enemies, destroying objects, pickups, or other methods make you generate Burst Energy, which you can stockpile infinitely. You can use this energy to perform various Burst Techniques that aid in movement and combat. Such as the "Catch Interrupt" to counter an attack, "Heavenly Piledrive" to deal massive damage, "Rising Upper" for a fast uppercut, "Flying Strike" for a quick burst of speed, and much more. The cost of a Burst Technique is proportional to its overall power. Summoning a platform will barely cost you Burst Energy, while a beam intended to vaporize a target will consume more than half or nearly all of your reserves.
objects.title: Circuit (Gravity Circuit)
