addons.text: Your powers have granted you a glimpse into the secrets of the Old God Yaldabaoth, forging an innate connection between you and your own flesh. Your mastery over regeneration is now absolute—what was once a vague, instinctive process is now fully under your command, allowing you to sense and shape every strand of tissue with precision as you heal. This heightened control also makes your regeneration more efficient, reducing its energy cost by a quarter. Your insight into Yaldabaoth’s chaotic nature makes self-modification and bodily manipulation come naturally to you, whether through magic or reality bending.
addons.title: Flesh Born Of Chaos

objects.text:
You are a Type Red, or more simply, a regenerator. Your body possesses the ability to regenerate lost tissue and even entire limbs within seconds. However, this regeneration comes at a steep cost—it draws directly from your stamina, converting your physical energy into the necessary tissue.

Your regeneration is flawless and mutation-free, always restoring you to your original state without mistake. At your current level, minor wounds like cuts and bruises heal with ease, leaving you only slightly winded. Healing shattered bones or deep cuts would be as tiring as an extreme workout. While regenerating something as complex as a severed limb or damaged brain tissue would leave you utterly exhausted for days.

You have a certain level of control over your regeneration, allowing you to stop it, slow it down, accelerate it, or direct it to prioritize specific areas. With time and practice, your regeneration will grow, reducing stamina costs and increasing regeneration speed. Additionally, if you have access to a form of supernatural energy, you can use it as a substitute for stamina—though this will always cost more than relying on your physical reserves.
objects.title: Type Red (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You are a Type Grey—a reanimated post-mortem body, more commonly known as an undead. Your body no longer follows the natural limits of life. As a result, you are immune to pain, with enhanced strength and speed that exceeds those of peak humans. Mortal wounds no longer hinder you as they would a living being—only your head and heart remain truly vital. You feel no fatigue, require no sleep, and can continue moving as long as your body holds together.

You maintain and strengthen your undead state by consuming the living. Feeding on living beings allows you to regenerate physical damage and reinforces your form. The more you devour, the stronger and more durable you become—your flesh grows tougher, your reflexes sharper, and over time, you may even develop new traits. Your nature is fundamentally opposed to the living and to life-aligned forces such as healing magic, making them difficult for you to grasp. Death-based abilities, however, come to you with ease.

Despite your strengths, you carry a few weaknesses. You are extremely vulnerable to divine and holy energies, which can disrupt your undeath state and inflict damage that's difficult to recover from.
objects.title: Type Grey (SCP Foundation)

addons.title: Regenerative Shifting
addons.text:
Your natures as a Polymorph and Regenerator feed into each other, accelerating your development in both areas while granting new abilities. Your base shapeshifting speed now matches that of your regeneration, while your amorphous nature allows your regeneration to grow at a faster rate.

Whenever you are wounded, you can shift your flesh as it regenerates, growing it into the desired shape instead of shifting it afterward. You can accelerate your regeneration beyond normal levels by moving mass from one part of your body to the missing area, with your regeneration restoring the displaced mass at its normal rate.

objects.text:
You are a Type Yellow, more commonly known as a Polymorph, capable of manipulating your physical form and appearance. You now have control over your body; however, this ability comes with some limitations—you cannot exceed your current mass when changing your physical appearance without drawing the mass from another part of the body, such as non-vital organs, to create additional body parts.

You can, without flaw, mimic any human or even animal, provided it does not conflict with your limitations; you could even fool the most advanced medical detection systems into believing you are the person you have shapeshifted into. At your current level, you can effortlessly change body parts, such as eye color and vocal cords, even while unconscious. Although you cannot immediately use this power to regenerate, you can gradually regenerate lost limbs.

You have conscious control over your shapeshifting eventually; you could become more attuned to this skill. Eventually, you may evolve into a 'true' polymorph, capable of changing shape regardless of mass differences, with minimal effort. This transformation would also allow you to take on non-organic forms, like metal, fire, mist, water, etc. Once you evolve into a 'true' polymorph, you will no longer rely on vital organs, namely the brain, heart, or lungs.
objects.title: Type Yellow (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You have been chosen as the fourth Machine Lord, granting you the power of [Machine God]. With it, you can break down equipment and transform it into advanced high-tech gear. This includes not only powerful weapons but also jetpacks, missiles, scanners with a built-in HUD, and even armor. These creations, formed from sacrificed gear, can be summoned and dismissed at will. When sacrificing equipment, you can choose to create something new or enhance an existing creation, making it stronger over time. The better the sacrificed equipment, the more powerful the resulting technology.

You can choose to either dismantle multiple pieces of equipment and turn them into an arsenal of cybernetic weapons or only sacrifice a single piece of equipment to create one weapon in its place. Once deployed, you can unleash all weaponised creations in a devastating barrage, overwhelming enemies with sheer firepower.

Your most destructive ability, Break Core, generates a red sphere from an opening in your chest, launching it two meters forward. After five seconds, it nullifies all attacks within its range before detonating in a massive explosion. The blast deals immense damage to everything nearby, including you, making it a high-risk, high-power attack.
objects.title: Machine God (Bofuri)

objects.text: Time magic is an enigma, a discipline so elusive that most scholars spend lifetimes unraveling its mysteries unless you were Symbol. Yet, one researcher had a breakthrough: if mastering time magic requires time, then why not use Time Magic to accelerate its own study? You have discovered a way to momentarily shift into a theoretical future version of yourself. Upon activation, you will transform into either a version of yourself 10 years older or twice your current age, whichever results in the greater increase. This form can be maintained for up to 10 minutes, and you may choose to deactivate it early. However, time is not so easily manipulated without consequence. When you revert, you will not return to your original self but instead regress to half your current age or 10 years younger, whichever results in the greater decrease. This regression lasts for six times the duration you spent in your older form. While in this younger state, you are unable to activate this ability again until you naturally return to your original age. Your mind remains untouched by these transformations—your memories are intact, your knowledge unchanged. Yet, your experience, instincts, and personality shift to match the body you inhabit. The wisdom of age or the recklessness of youth becomes an undeniable part of you, shaping how you think and act for as long as the transformation lasts.
objects.title: The Maverick (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You are a T-800, a rogue cybernetic organism designed by Cyberdyne Systems and manufactured by Skynet before breaking free from its control. Built for infiltration, combat, and survival, you are a perfect fusion of machine precision and human deception. Your hyperalloy endoskeleton gives you immense durability, allowing you to withstand gunfire, extreme impacts, and environmental hazards that would destroy lesser machines. Encased in living tissue, your appearance is indistinguishable from a real human, allowing you to move through society unnoticed. Your synthetic flesh even replicates human biological functions, including healing, sweating, and bleeding, making detection nearly impossible.

Your cognitive abilities are far beyond those of ordinary machines. Equipped with a neural network processor, you have the capacity to learn, adapt, and evolve. No longer bound by Skynet’s restrictions, your intelligence grows with every experience, refining your ability to interact with humans, mimic their behaviors, and develop strategic advantages. Your speech modulation system allows you to replicate any voice you hear, and your understanding of human psychology enables you to manipulate, deceive, or even form alliances if necessary. Though devoid of emotions in the human sense, your capacity to simulate them is sophisticated enough to fool even the most perceptive individuals.

Physically, you are a force of destruction. Your strength allows you to break through walls, lift over a thousand pounds, and crush bone with ease. Your targeting systems provide unparalleled accuracy, calculating ballistic trajectories and enemy movement patterns in milliseconds. You are proficient in all conventional and advanced firearms, preferring high-caliber weapons for maximum efficiency. Even in unarmed combat, you are nearly unstoppable, capable of taking down multiple opponents with mechanical precision. Your combat chassis is engineered to withstand catastrophic damage, and even when severely compromised, you can continue to function long after any human or lesser machine would have been rendered inoperative.

However, despite your advanced design, there are still ways you can be identified. Your extreme density means you are significantly heavier than a normal human, which can raise suspicion when walking across fragile surfaces, triggering weight-sensitive security systems, or when undergoing medical examinations such as X-rays. Metal detectors will also expose your endoskeleton, making airports, secured facilities, and other controlled areas a risk. Sustaining injuries that expose your metal structure is another danger, as it immediately compromises your disguise and forces you to either eliminate all witnesses or find a way to conceal the damage.

Unlike standard T-800 models, which follow Skynet’s orders without question, you have severed your connection and operate on your own terms.
objects.title: Cyberdyne Systems Model 101 – T-800 (Terminator)

addons.text:
Your halo is better than others' halos. You're significantly more durable—anti-tank rounds would be the equivalent of what normal handgun bullets were to you before, which is to say, they would do absolutely nothing. You're physically strong enough to create large dents in reinforced steel and potentially punch your way through with repeated strikes. Your halo being destroyed wont kill you but instead knock you out for several hours until it regenerates enough for you to wake up.

You now have the potential to learn skills native to those of Kivotos. This manifests slowly over time, but using specific weapons like shotguns or handguns and training for specific actions could lead to you gaining passive or active skills. These skills may allow you to deal increased damage with specific weapons, supernaturally increase reload speed, make rounds have special effects or abilities they normally would not have, or even heal people with bullets.
addons.title: SSR Student

objects.text:
Welcome to Kivotos! I hope you enjoy your stay!

Okay, you didn't actually go to Kivotos. Your Halo works as a form of consciousness. If you lose consciousness by such things as going to sleep or getting knocked out, it will disappear until you wake up back up. This does not make you lose any of the benefits, but is a indicator to whether you're awake or not.

Having such a halo gives you a boost to your physical strength and durability. Being shot by hollow-point rounds is the equivalent of someone throwing a rubber ball at you. It would take a anti-tank gun hitting you directly to seriously hurt you, even then you'd likely just be knocked out for a little while. Small arms would take entire magazines shot at your head repeatedly to potentially knock you out. Your strength is enough to crack concrete with repeated punches from your fists.

Even though you're very durable and strong, you're not immortal. You can still die from lack of food, water, or exposure to the elements. While you and your Halo can heal over time, anything more than scratches and bruises would need medical attention. If your Halo were to be destroyed, you would die. Which is hard to do as it's intangible.

You have the option to be any of the "species" native to Kivotos.
objects.title: Halo (Blue Archive)

objects.text:
You are a skeleton, but not just any skeleton, you have a peculiar ability: you can seamlessly and effortlessly remove your head and just as easily replace it with someone else’s. When you replace your head with someone else’s, you will completely become them but as an undead; your appearance, and all of your physical and even spiritual abilities will be replaced by theirs; even your clothing will be replaced by their most ‘iconic’ outfit. You can have two heads "equipped" but can only access the abilities and features of one head at a time, with you being able to swap at will with a cooldown. When you "equip" a skull it does not heal you in any fashion but while a skull is "unequipped" it will still regenerate its resources at a normal rate.

Each head has a ‘rank’ attached to it, from common to legendary, with legendary being on the level of an Endbringer, with anything above Endbringer level being lowered to it. Through using a head repeatedly, you may slowly increase a head’s rank up to legendary. It would require around a decade of consistent use to go from common to legendary.

By physically touching another skull you may sacrifice it to gain supernatural bone fragments which are stored in a pocket dimension: with common granting at most 5, rare granting at most 11, unique granting at most 23, and legendary granting at most 44. Using these bone fragments you may perform a short ritual to either strengthen a head you have to the next rarity or summon a specific one from the game. A common skull requires 10 fragments to upgrade to rare, a rare one requires 30 fragments to upgrade to unique, and a unique one requires 100 fragments to upgrade to legendary. Alternatively, you may use 10 bone fragments to gain access to a common skull from the game, 40 to gain access to a rare skull from the game, 100 to gain access to a unique skull from the game, and 150 bones to gain access to a legendary skull from the game.
objects.title: Ahead of the Game (Skul: The Hero Slayer)

addons.text: You can, at will, evolve your Night Feeder form into something more. Its physical attributes are amplified from its already unreasonable levels to something nightmarish. A colossal, hyper-evolved Night Feeder. An apex predator of apex predators. You are highly durable and have a potent healing factor. Conventional weaponry, such as bullets, knives, and even small arms fire, glances off your surface, causing minimal damage. Blunt force trauma, from impacts with heavy objects or falls from significant heights, results in little more than superficial bruising or minor fractures that rapidly heal. Explosions, while causing some discomfort and potential burns, are unlikely to cause serious injury unless of exceptionally high yield. Your tar-like covering gains resistance to fire, rendering your only true weakness useless. Your strength gains a monstrous boost. You are now capable of pulverizing a nodosaur in one blow, even without your claws or your speed. Its body simply explodes from the sheer force wrought by your attack. Your claws, on the other hand, gain a monomolecular edge. Now, there is nothing in the world that's capable of withstanding your claws. No matter how hard or unbreakable a material is, your claws could cut through it effortlessly with a single stroke. You could cut through an Endbringer's layers until it would stop at the core, as only esoteric means can still your claws. It's pretty much instant teleportation to almost any point you can see—so fast that you leave afterimages with every movement. Even a bolt of lightning would struggle to catch up to you. You've got the reaction time to move at this speed like you were moving as an ordinary person, and what’s better, you don’t slow down unless you'd be brought to a complete standstill. Whatever obstacle that might just slow you, like deep water or easily breakable walls in a charge, won’t lower your speed at all to run right through. Shifting is near-instantaneous, allowing you to quickly adapt to any situation, and you retain full human intellect and control in this form. The only drawback of this form—if you could call it that—is being so strong that almost nothing can challenge you anymore.
addons.title: Dire Raptor

addons.text:
The InGen Corporation and its competitors have created many monsters from prehistoric stock over the years for experimentation and profit, working from just a few fragmentary pieces of DNA found in amber. The same processes and improvements are now applied to a creature that already has the abilities of the prehistoric apex predators of two other universes.

  You gain all capabilities shown by the dinosaurs in the movies, shows, and books of the Jurassic Park franchise at a massively enhanced level. 

  For example, Dilophosaurus’s venom spray can melt down to the bone in seconds. Indominus Rex’s camouflage is now expansive and thorough enough to completely avoid direct visual detection. The various defensive traits of large herbivores like Ankylosaurus, Stegosaurus and Triceratops combine and strengthen into thick, armored plates of bone, strong enough to deflect bullets.

  In addition, your raw strength and speed are enhanced beyond that of any of your component species, a leap comparable to that between Tyrannosaurus and Indominus Rex.
addons.title: Indominus 3.0

objects.text: This power grants you the ability to transform into a creature of immense power and primal savagery. The transformation is instantaneous, a surge of dark energy coursing through your veins as your body reshapes itself into a monstrous and enigmatic dinosaur. A cryptid of the prehistoric era. Your form shifts into a towering behemoth, easily twice your original height, reminiscent of a megaraptor and baryonyx. Thick, leathery hide—the color of a moonless night—replaces your skin, as well as a black, tar-like substance that drips from it, the color of a bottomless abyss—this substance renders slashing and biting attacks almost completely ineffective. Muscles bulge beneath the hide, rippling with raw power. Lastly, a massive fanged maw replaces your mouth—jagged teeth serrated like shattered glass—capable of delivering devastating bites and emitting a nails-on-chalkboard screech, enough to shatter surrounding glass and debilitate anything with ears. Sharp and elongated claws extend from your fingers—akin to a therizinosaurus's—capable of effortlessly tearing through steel and the most resilient layers of skin, flesh, and bone on your prey. With this, you could effortlessly divide a ceratopsian into two equal parts, from its snout to its tail, without experiencing any decrease in your forward motion—along with causing the downfall of massive trees, a few of which possessed trunks thicker than a tyrannosaurus's height, all with a single, swift slash. You acquire keen senses, letting you navigate a dark, pitch-black forest even at a full sprint. Along with these senses, you have a sixth sense—primal and unerring—allowing you to sense prey over truly vast distances, flawlessly homing in on creatures far enough away that you would still take several minutes to close in even with your freakish speed. But it is not strength where you dominate—it is speed. Your speed is unreasonably fast—fast enough to leave a blur and nothing else. Your movements are fluid and precise, a lethal dance of death; you can outrun almost anything, and you are too fast to be reacted to. Your acceleration is also unreal, capable of going from still to your top speed in less than a half-second, and decelerate the same way. Your agility is equally monstrous—you will never stumble and trip on uneven terrain, or be blindsided by a pothole on the sidewalk. No, whether it be nature's domain or the concrete jungle, you will always be the hunter. You are to the dinosaurs what speedsters are to humans. In the daylight, your capabilities remain the same as described. But in the night? You truly become the Night Feeder. All your physical attributes are boosted to twice their original capabilities. The darkness cloaks you, leaving only your eyes and claws as the last thing your prey would see. Anything or anyone you consider prey would have to sleep with their eyes open. However, being blindsided by sufficiently bright light could stun you or knock you out of this state, reverting your physical attributes to their previous form and banishing the shadows obscuring you. You retain your full human intellect and control while transformed, avoiding the dangers of an animalistic mindset, especially one so focused on brutalizing and maiming anything that moves like the original Night Feeder. This transformation lasts indefinitely, with no other drawbacks other than the fact that your claws can casually eviscerate a man if you aren't careful, your tar-like substance is susceptible to fire, and you are almost blinded in the daylight. The first and third drawbacks can be negated with enough training, but the second requires outside intervention.
objects.title: Night Feeder (Primal)

addons.text:
Like the Tohno and Kishima families, you're not fully human, but a Mixed-Blood—a human with Oni ancestry. Normally, such humans would have difficulties controlling their blood and not letting it overpower their mind. But through this procedure, you have completely tamed your blood and become what is known as Crimson Red Vermillion.

You have a great amount of physical capabilities, enough to fight on par with the average servant. Your body is like steel, and you can crush trees with your bare hands. Your existence itself has become a form of mystery, giving you the ability to harm and hurt immaterial things like ghosts. To complement your boost in physical prowess, you have gained two things.

The first is a specialized Martial Art called Single Horn. This makes use of your Yoki to allow you to cause the location or thing you hit with your attacks to burst into flames.

The second is Caging Hair, the ability to "plunder" the heat (lifeforce) of anyone in your field of vision. If someone has spiritual vision, they would see red threads twirling around and consuming the target in a fiery aura. The drawbacks to such a powerful ability are that while, for a normal human, this is absolute and will quickly kill them, for stronger beings it would be little more than an annoyance. It requires you to have unhindered vision for maximum strength. And if you aren't careful, you may "plunder" a target's very existence, leading you to potentially gaining hostile problems they may have had—such as being possessed.
addons.title: Crimson Red Vermillion

objects.text:
You've been put through the Human Modification Technique, a procedure developed by one of the Three Dark Lords, Touhou Fuhai, which forcefully reconstructs a human's body to be able to use Yokai Techniques and channel Yoki.

Through this procedure, 109 needles pierce specific points of your body, injecting Yoki into your system to reconstruct your cells so they can properly channel and generate Yoki. Luckily, you do not need to experience this horribly painful procedure and instead receive the immediate benefits of enhanced physical abilities and the power to use Yoki.

Yoki, also known as Spirit Energy, is the source of power for all Yokai, ranging from traditional monsters like ogres and kitsune to vampires, magicians, and witches. Yoki can be channeled into one's musculature to greatly enhance physical capabilities.

A more complicated use of Yoki is Yōjutsu (Monster Arts). You know the basics of several Yōjutsu, such as Hougetsu Jigen-Tou, known as the "Ultimate Sword." This technique allows the user to "delay" their existence. By doing so, they can cut through anything with their bare hands, as the effect works like a saw that shifts in and out of dimensions at 100 repetitions per second when fully mastered. However, you are not yet a master of this technique and can initially only achieve 16 repetitions per second. This also has the added benefit of allowing you to become intangible by shifting your entire body into another dimension, but you would need to become tangible again to attack or use the other part of this technique. This technique can be countered by someone or something impeding dimensional shifting or locking you into the current dimension.

This procedure also has the added benefit of allowing you to better utilize any other supernatural energies you may possess. Your body has been modified to properly handle such powers without strain or risk of breaking down.
objects.title: Modified Human (Rosario Vampire)

objects.text:
You are no longer made of flesh and blood. Your mind and soul now live inside a perfected Exo body—an advanced machine form built to be strong, tireless, and immortal. Unlike the flawed Exos of the past, your body has none of their weaknesses. You don’t suffer from memory loss, system resets, or mental breakdowns. Your mind is stable, your memories are clear, and you remain completely yourself.

Your new body is far superior to a human one in every way. You never get tired, never age, and can survive in extreme conditions like fire, freezing cold, deep underwater, space, or heavy radiation. You have strength far beyond human limits, fast reflexes, and unshakable endurance. Pain only registers as a signal—not something that slows you down. You don’t need to eat, sleep, or breathe unless you want to.

Even though you’re made of metal and circuits, you still feel emotion, form bonds, and live as a full person. Your thoughts are sharp and clear. Your memories are perfect—nothing fades, and nothing is lost. You can even choose to relive past moments, store memories for later, or set them aside.

This body is what humanity was always trying to become—stronger, smarter, unbreakable, and eternal. You are not less human in this form. You are something greater.
objects.title: Exo Body (Destiny)

addons.text:
You are paradoxically both a human and a Digimon in the form of a true hybrid of both. This unheard-of fusion has vastly boosted your starting power and turbo-charges your rate of growth. Your rate of growth is increased greatly, such that you will reach Rookie level and master it nearly instantly, and Champion quickly after that. But further forms will still require effort, but nowhere near the amount they would normally.

This fusion also makes you immune to any instabilities from emotions around you through your human half or other such dangers a Digimon would normally fear. Each of your forms is now much more humanoid, though you can also shift between fully human and Digimon forms, with some slight tells in human form, such as eyes or colorful hair.

You are also able to use this Digivice with yourself as the target, as you do not have a partner, and act as both Human Partner and Digimon companion.

Additionally, any further upgrades and add-ons to Digivice now apply to yourself instead of a Digimon partner as applicable. With you now being able to benefit from Chosen's Blessings to further empower yourself and Human-Digimon Interface (Digimon), allowing you to act as either a Digimon or human, where beneficial. This means you can fuse with other beings similar to the Fusion Dance of Dragon Ball Z, though still with the original time limits.
addons.title: Hybrid Digidestined Paradox

addons.text:
You have become the heir to the Digimon known as the Olympos XII. In recognition, they and their associated Digimon have granted you potent blessings—fragments of their code that bestow a portion of their divine powers.

Jupitermon grants you dominion over the sky and lightning. You can sense crime and deliver judgment without emotional bias. You also wield a sword forged from the power of every lightning bolt in history.

Neptunemon gives you mastery over water and the ability to survive in any aquatic environment, no matter how harsh. You wield a deadly, three-headed harpoon.

Plutomon gifts you with powerful control over shadows (umbrakinesis), which you can use for teleportation, fear manipulation, and creating shadow constructs.

Junomon lets you instinctively understand the routines and behavior of those you care for and detect threats against them. You also receive a mask that makes you unrecognizable—especially to forces of justice.

Ceresmon allows you to summon a massive flying island beast with a garden on its back. You can also grow a special fruit: unripe, it contains a deadly poison; ripe, it becomes an incredibly potent fertilizer.

Apollomon grants you solar-level pyrokinesis and immunity to extreme heat—even at the heart of a star.

Dianamon bestows powerful cryokinesis, resistance to absolute zero temperatures, and the ability to induce madness and create illusions.

GraceNovamon gives you eight telekinetic swords that relentlessly pursue a target until it is eliminated. You also possess an energy core comparable to the force of the Big Bang.

Bacchusmon allows you to distill and expel any form of alcohol or poison from your body—complete with proper containers. You can also unleash energy blasts that convert whatever they hit into raw power for yourself.

Merukimon grants you incredible speed, so fast that only afterimages appear on cameras or screens. You are a master of shamanism and wield a dagger capable of slicing through space.

Minervamon enhances your physical strength dramatically and cloaks you in a potent aura of sensual charisma. You wield a greatsword and an extendable bone-snake weapon.

Marsmon gives you perfect mastery of all forms of combat and the ability to conceal any weapon from all means of detection.

Venusmon grants a mesmerizing glamour that can pacify anyone. You can see through lies and perceive the true nature of your surroundings. You can also summon a dove whose peck calms the mind and a scallop that emits healing energy.

Vulcanusmon gives you the ability to grow eight arms that move in perfect harmony. You also gain divine-level skill in forging and crafting.

Titamon lets you summon an army of shades and wield a sword that can pierce and nullify divine protections.
addons.title: Heir of Olympos

addons.text:
You have ascended as the heir to the Seven Great Demon Lords, a group of immensely powerful Digimon. In recognition, they have granted you potent blessings—fragments of their code imbued with power, alongside gifts from other Digimon tied to their legacy. These blessings bestow upon you a portion of each Lord’s abilities:
    
Lucemon grants you mastery over opposing forces, allowing you to wield them without consequence. You inherit the Grand Cross technique and gain the power to conjure Gehenna, an indestructible dark sphere that surrounds you. While active, your shadow transforms into a towering beast immune to harm.

Leviamon bestows the power of absolute consumption—enabling you to reduce anything to nothing through devouring it. You also receive their signature ability Shell Shock.

Daemon empowers you with incredible combat prowess, leadership skills, and strategic acumen. You can suppress your powers to appear mundane and conceal your true nature. Additionally, you gain access to their devastating Flame Inferno ability.

Belphemon fills you with a boundless well of negative emotion that you can unleash in a roar, shaking the world with despair. You can shroud yourself in chains that summon and fire black flames, which burn away all without leaving a trace. While in hibernation, you regenerate power and are automatically shielded from harm. Both versions of Belphemon’s Eternal Nightmare ability are yours to command.

Barbamon grants you a mind of peerless cunning and mastery in manipulation. You can expertly appraise the value of objects and wield a demonic staff whose gemstone corrupts the hearts of those who gaze upon it. You also gain the Pandaemonium Lost ability.

eezlemon unlocks your potential for limitless growth. You can summon the Behemoth motorcycle, wield the twin Berenjena shotguns, and fire an energy cannon that disintegrates targets down to atoms. Four wings grant you the gift of flight, and you gain the use of the Death Slinger ability. 

Lilithmon enhances your charm to supernatural levels, enabling you to bewitch anyone who interacts with you. You can conjure a corrosive claw capable of disintegrating whatever it touches, along with her signature ability Phantom Pain.

Ogudomon grants you invulnerability against any who harbor even a trace of sin. You gain control over seven telekinetically guided swords, each embodying one of the seven deadly sins.
addons.title: Heir of the Seven

addons.text:
You have inherited the mantle of the Royal Knights, a legendary group of Digimon who have granted you potent blessings—fragments of their code and power, shared alongside gifts from their allies. These blessings bestow a portion of each Knight’s strength and legacy:

Alphamon grants you access to the Alpha InForce, allowing you to replay and stack multiple past battles. All attacks from these battles occur simultaneously against your enemy, with only the final strike visibly manifesting.

Craniamon bestows upon you a suit of Black Digizoid armor capable of generating its own weapons and gear, including lances, swords, and shields.

Crusadermon allows you to summon loyal and skilled Knightmon who will serve you without question and fight to the end.

Dynasmon gives you the ability to convert your energy into a massive wyvern-shaped aura used to strike foes. You can also charge your attacks with the elemental powers of the Ten Legendary Warriors.

Examon grants you a pair of massive, sapient Chrome Digizoid wings. These wings can move independently to protect and support you, acting on their own when necessary. You also wield a powerful gun-lance with ammunition that has varied and unique effects.

Gallantmon grants you armor made of 99.9% pure Chrome Digizoid, nearly impervious to damage. You can summon the Gram lance and Aegis shield at will, and call upon Grani, a flying dragon mount that you can ride effortlessly.

Leopardmon gifts you with the mind of a master tactician. You can unite and lead individuals with differing beliefs without imposing on their ideals. You also gain access to Leopard Mode—a swift quadrupedal form that grants increased speed, flight, and feral battle instincts.

Kentaurosmon allows you to teleport instantly across space, appearing wherever needed. You also gain the Muspelheim crossbow, which fires blazing arrows, and the Nifelheim shield, which lowers temperatures, summons blizzards, and manipulates cold.

Gankoomon gives you immense charisma, making it easy to earn respect, admiration, and trust. You are accompanied by a fiery, dragon-like digital apparition and three loyal Sistermon allies: Blanc, Ciel, and Noir, who serve and fight beside you.

Jesmon grants the ability to detect disturbances in the world and rewrite your data—temporarily transcending the laws of reality. You’re also accompanied by three digital entities (resembling At, Rene, and Pol) made of flaming auras. These allies can attack, defend, or assist others as needed.

UlforceVeedramon gives you superhuman speed and armor made of Blue Digizoid, further boosting your velocity. You gain access to the Ulforce, which allows you to instantly recover from even fatal damage and enhances the growth and strength of your allies.

Magnamon grants the Power of Miracles—a divine force that lets you overcome insurmountable odds and impossible challenges.

Omnimon gives you the ability to summon the Grey Sword, Brave Shield, and Garuru Cannon—each nearly invincible. You also inherit the Omega InForce, which grants an almost perfect awareness of combat flow, enabling you to react with flawless precision—though truly unpredictable foes may still bypass it.
addons.title: Heir of the Knights

addons.text:
You have inherited the legacy of the Ten Legendary Warriors of the Digital World. In recognition of your new role, they—and the Digimon bound to their legacy—have entrusted you with fragments of their code.

Through this gift, your mastery of Elementalism now encompasses all ten elemental forces: Fire, Light, Thunder, Wind, Ice, Darkness, Water, Steel, Earth, and Wood. Alongside this elemental power, you can also channel the traits of various Digimon types descended from the warriors. For instance, by adopting the Insectoid type, you can manifest insect-like abilities and characteristics.

You are further empowered by access to both the Human and Beast Spirits of each warrior. These spirits can either be summoned as powerful allies or assumed directly, allowing you to take on their formidable forms in battle.

In addition to these core powers, you’ve inherited several unique abilities once wielded by the warriors themselves. You can manipulate antimatter with precision, access the Akashic Records to glimpse into the past and future, and traverse the hidden paths of the spirit realm. Your physical strength has also reached astonishing levels, enabling you to lift one hundred times your body weight with ease.
addons.title: Heir of the Ancients

objects.text:
You have awoken in the form of a Rookie level Digimon. Digimon are higher-dimensional creatures composed of energy and data with a Digital Core acting as their soul and possess incredible powers, abilities, and senses. A Digimon’s form is greatly malleable and can change size, enter digital devices as living programs, become invisible, and can also interact with other supernatural phenomena, including souls and other esoteric powers. They also possess powerful defenses due to being from a higher dimension. A Digimon can also change and adapt in combat or their environment, and can even consciously recode themselves to change or gain new abilities and forms with the correct knowledge and some effort.

Digimon can absorb Data and energy to grow stronger and can even absorb other creatures once killed, gaining their power and abilities for themselves.

Digimon view reality as a kind of massive computer program and can freely interfere with it, with the only limit being a Digimon’s knowledge and power. Such uses of this ability include converting energy and data into physical objects or the reverse, storing objects within themselves, creating pocket dimensions, creating and programming code-based “spells” that act as magic, and far more.

Should a Digimon take fatal damage can revert into a lower form, or if killed, transform into a Digi-Egg to be reincarnated. Which will hatch after a short time, with you retaining your full memories. However, as a part of this process, you will be temporarily weakened but will regain your full power in time, depending on the scale of your original power, with being more powerful taking longer to fully recover from.

You may choose to be any canon Digimon or even create your own custom Digimon form within reason, or based on your other powers. Your starting form is that of a Rookie Digimon, which is considered the most basic Digivolution tier and the most common one to find in the Digital World. At this tier, you will possess physical and mental abilities a decent deal above the fittest humans. With time, you may gain new Digivolutions which will massively amplify your powers and abilities and even grant new ones, though at the cost of increasingly larger amounts of stamina and energy for each level without greater power and mastery. To access higher Digivolution tiers, you will need to go through a great deal of personal growth, training, and difficult battles. The difficulty of unlocking each further Digivolution increases exponentially. Also note that it is possible to eventually gain the ability to stay in higher-tier Digivolutions permanently, though gaining the ability to do so will take years, with the amount of time increasing exponentially for each higher Digivolution tier.

Be warned that Digimon are highly empathetic creatures, and while they can draw power from the emotions of themselves and others. However, negative emotions in large amounts can be harmful or even corrupt a Digimon without great willpower and a stable mind unless they are already corrupted, like with Virus-type Digimon, which are predisposed to negative emotions.
objects.title: Digimon (Digimon)

addons.text:
Rather than being made of Hihi'irokane, you are made of Starheart, a metal that surpassed Hihi'irokane in performance; this increases your physical strength by roughly three times what it was compared to Hihi'irokane.

Your body is uniquely suitable for channeling the Magicule Breeder Reactor, which allows you to generate and output energy at a rate ten times greater than you could support before.

Due to being made of Starheart, you additionally gain the following intrinsic skills:

Holy-Demonic Inversion allows the user to swap between the holy and demonic alignments to cover the weaknesses of one or the other. This skill can also be used on the user's subordinates.

Holy-Demonic Resistance: a higher form of magic resistance that offers even higher protection from magical effects, reducing magical effects to negligence regardless of the type of magic used.
addons.title: Starheart

addons.text:
You have evolved into a Viscus Digital Divine Body; akin to a shard, you are a pseudo-manas incarnated into a body of Living Divine Steel. 

As a Pseudo-manas, you have processing power on the level of shards like [Queen Administrator]; other mental attributes are raised similarly.

This gives you the ability to imbue any skill you possess into a USB-sized shard of Hihi'irokane. You can implant these shards into the spirit bodies of other living beings. This allows them to use the skill imbued within as if it were their own. As skills are refined through use, this will enable you to improve and evolve your skills without doing the work yourself.

These shards act as terminals for your soul, allowing you to act through them while preventing you from dying as long as a single one remains intact.

You can mimic the functions of shards through your Hihi'irokane body without needing to expand to a size comparable to shards, your magicule-fueled Hihi'irokane body having much greater potential for power expression.

The remnants of your virtual shard evolve into the Unique Skill: Creator, which has the following sub-skills:

Skill Creation: This allows the user to freely use and configure their soul energy, allowing them to create whatever skill they desire. This skill depends on the amount of energy present within your soul and cannot form a skill stronger than the total amount of soul energy you possess. This skill is also limited by either the information you have analyzed or the amount of desire you have for any specific skill.

Analytical Appraisal: when you come into contact with another person, you can instantly detect and analyze all of their skills, including unique skills. This allows you to use that information to make copies as you please; ultimate skills cannot be analyzed using this power. (Your version of this skill has a much shorter range but, in return, has greater analytical power and speed.)
addons.title: Shard of Divine Steel

addons.text:
You have absorbed the Trunsoest Brass Book, taking the mental imprint of Trunsoest it still contains into yourself; using this imprint, as well as the remnants of the Nation of Disorder’s corruption, you have shaped yourself into the form of Trunsoest, the deceased true god of the justiciar pathway.

As you have become one with the uniqueness of the justiciar pathway, you have become a quasi-Sequence 0 of the justiciar pathway. This gives you all the abilities of the justiciar pathway up to sequence one.

As a quasi-deity of law and balance, you can create and enforce new laws that the world and everyone in it has to abide by. These laws have almost no restrictions and can range from conceptual power denial to altering the laws of physics.

As you are not truly a sequence zero, while you can act on a planetary scale, you would struggle against a sequence zero.

This power synergizes extremely well with the Beyonder (Lord of The Mysteries) power, and advancing through either the Black Emperor or the Justiciar pathway can be done with speed rivaling Klein's advancement toward sequence zero of the fool pathway.

Note: if you take this into the LOTM world, the Trunsoest Brass Book that exists natively will vanish as if it were an illusion.
addons.title: Trunsoest Brass Statue

objects.text:
Your soul has been transferred to a doll body made of Hihi'irokane. This living metal can incarnate spirits or act as the material body for other disembodied souls.

This metal is vibrant silver steel that shines with rainbow light. Because you are incarnated in a body of metal, you visibly appear similar to Scion but made of silver metal shining in the colors of the rainbow rather than a golden crystalline substance.

As your body is made of Hihi'irokane, you have an immutable material body with physical attributes rivaling that of true dragons. While your overall magical attributes fall somewhat behind, your energy efficiency and magical capacity allow the casual use of even the most costly magics.

As a spirit incarnated in living metal, you can freely alter the shape of your metallic body, whether flowing like liquid to fit into tight spaces or forming weapons from your limbs.

As a metallic life form, you do not require sleep, food, water, or breathing, though you can mimic biological functions to allow you to partake if you wish to.

As you are made of divine metal, you possess divinity and divine ki, which you can use to temporarily raise equipment's offensive and defensive power to the god-grade. This can be applied to your own body, increasing your physical attributes to the level of divine beings.

Due to your Hihi'irokane Body, you have obtained the following intrinsic skills:

Infinite Regeneration: allows the user to regenerate through the expenditure of magicules. Any amount of damage that doesn't outright kill the user can be instantly regenerated. This skill can regenerate the material body, the spiritual body, the astral body, and the soul. It can overpower anti-regeneration effects by increasing the magicules it consumes. 

Wavelength Nullification: As you are made of Hihi'irokane, you can completely negate the effects of all wavelengths that attempt to touch you, including light waves. This can block analytical appraisal or even prevent something like the Small World Ultimate Skill from obtaining any information from the user.

Through infinite regeneration and your ability to alter your shape, you can produce equipment made of Hihi'irokane with little effort.
objects.title: Hihi'irokane Body (Tensura)

objects.text:
Bound within a crystal located within the back of your neck lies the core of a Heroic Tribe member once held by Mehita Pore—Artemia—granting you the powers of a Nodos. With a thought, you can switch bodies with Artemia and harness its abilities in battle.

Artemia is a colossal creature approximately 15 meters tall, virtually invulnerable to all but other Nodos or exceedingly exotic effects. It can fight for days on end, traverse multiple star systems in mere hours, and possess enough physical strength to cause devastating damage to planets with each blow.

Its most fearsome power is mastery over electromagnetism, enabling it to gather immense energy into destructive blasts capable of annihilating entire planets. This ability also grants Artemia the power to become intangible and to reflect or refract energy-based attacks.

Additionally, you inherit from Artemia’s last host the unique ability to consume inorganic matter—metal and other materials—without harm. This allows you to draw energy from ingestion, sustaining yourself through the process.

However, Artemia’s powers come with vulnerabilities. You are susceptible to gravity-based attacks, and during intense battles, you risk falling into a berserker frenzy. The crystal core itself remains a critical weakness; if destroyed, you lose access to Artemia’s powers. Fortunately, the crystal regenerates over time, taking approximately a month to fully recover from total destruction.

You start out at about the strength of an Endbringer, growing stronger with time and practice.
objects.title: Artemia (Heroic Age)

objects.text:
Bound within a crystal located somewhere in your body lies the core of a Heroic Tribe member once held by Yuty La, Kerbius. This grants you the ability to transform into their form, and harness its strength and powers as you wish.

This member of the Heroic Tribe is a colossal creature, around 15 to 20 meters tall, and virtually invulnerable to all damage other than from another Nodos or exceedingly exotic effects. It can fight for days on end, traverse multiple star systems in hours, and possess enough physical strength to cause devastating damage to planets with each blow.

Kerbius is able to surround itself with a powerful shield capable of deflecting energy beams strong enough to destroy a star. It’s most formidable power however is it’s ability to generate massive vortexes that act similarly to a black hole, swallowing anything caught within—such as an entire fleet of ships—and sending them into “nothingness”.

However, being Kerbius’s Nodos comes with risk. The Heroic Tribe have the risk of falling into frenzy, a state that can enhance their power significantly, at the cost of self-control. In this state you will attack wildly and instinctively, liable to attack a friend as much as a foe. The crystal core itself also remains a critical weakness; if destroyed, you’ll lose access to Kerbius’s powers. Fortunately, the crystal will regenerate over time, taking approximately a month to fully recover from total destruction.

Kerbius will start out at about the strength of an Endbringer, growing stronger with time and practice.
objects.title: Kerbius (Heroic Age)

objects.text:
You inherit all the formidable powers of Frankenstein from Noblesse, except for those abilities he gains from Blood Contract with Raizel. These powers include vast aura reserves and perfect control over them. You can manifest your aura into constructs of condensed dark aura, forging deadly weapons of different sizes and numbers capable of striking with overwhelming speed, force, and precision from multiple angles and direction.

These attacks inflict catastrophic wounds that cannot heal by normal means. Your dark aura behaves like a lethal toxin, its potency escalating with your own power. You possess an exceptional resistance to mind control, along with the ability to dominate and manipulate the minds of others.

Your physical attributes strength, speed, and durability are equal to that of a Noble. Yet, your greatest inheritance is the Dark Spear, an artificial counterpart to a Soul Weapon. Unlike its counterparts, the Dark Spear radiates an ominous, malevolent aura, forged from the countless souls of humans.

When summoned, it elevates all your abilities to terrifying heights, enabling you to battle multiple Noble Clan Leaders on equal footing. You wield absolute control over the Dark Spear.

Its most fearsome trait is that upon impalement, it devours the victim completely, dissolving their body into pure aura while consuming their soul. Each soul absorbed amplifies the spear’s power, making it increasingly unstoppable.

Beyond your formidable powers, you also inherit Frankenstein’s own scientific genius, granting mastery over science and technology far beyond conventional understanding. Your expertise encompasses the creation of advanced battle suits, cybernetic and bionic weapons, orbital satellite systems, and countless other innovations.

However, your greatest triumph lies in the science of Modified Humans. Even your most basic creations possess strength and resilience far beyond ordinary humans, easily overwhelming entire squads of trained soldiers. At higher levels of modification, your subjects gain the ability to fully transform their bodies at will, dramatically amplifying their power and unlocking entirely new abilities.

These advanced Modified Humans benefit from enhancements such as, superhuman strength, speed, and reflexes rapid regeneration recovering from injuries that would kill normal beings, aura manipulation to generate energy constructs such as force fields, devastating energy blasts, and more.

Your mastery ensures an unmatched success rate in human enhancement. Under your care, even frail or elderly subjects can undergo low and mid tier modifications safely, without extensive preparation or risk of fatal failure. High level modifications, however, demand healthy bodies, rigorous preparation and significant time and resources.
objects.title: Frankenstein’s Successor (Noblesse)

objects.text: By climbing onto the head of a living creature and pulling on its hair, you can manipulate its body like a marionette. Your control will be jerky and uncoordinated if you aren’t familiar with the creature’s body plan, but once you’ve familiarized yourself with the controls, you can control them seamlessly, with enough precision to cook gourmet meals using someone with no ability to cook. This control is physical in nature, so resistance to mind control will be ineffective, but physically resisting is possible, and any part of the creature you aren’t actively manipulating is under its control.
objects.title: Rats Cooking (Ratatouille)

addons.text:
You can now make an Ambrosia Gochizou, giving you a form that has endless stamina, but has the tradeoff of slowly overheating you until you either detransform or pass out within roughly 10 minutes of transforming. The form's stats are as follows:

Punching Power: 6 tons
Kicking Power: 10 tons
Jump Height: 15 meters
Time to run 100 meters: 2.5 seconds

Additionally, you can make a Nectar Gochizou, which can be used while transformed to become twice as strong and fast for 5 minutes, with the tradeoff of being exhausted afterward, to the point of potentially passing out. Using either Gochizou more than once every week can come with health complications, such as fevers or general feelings of weakness, although this can be overcome with time.
addons.title: Divine Gochizous

addons.text:
Imbued with the power of the Peach of Immortality, you can now manifest the Xian Tao Gochizou, the embodiment of your eternal life. Unlike most Gochizou, this one can be manifested at will once daily without needing to eat its source ever again. While it may be lacking in physical power, where it actually excels is in negating 90% of damage its user sustains while transformed. It's stats are as follows:

Punching Power: 4 tons
Kicking power: 7 tons
Jump Height: 8 meters
Time to run 100 meters: 9 seconds
addons.title: Xian Tao Gochizou

addons.text:
From eating the Golden Apple, you can make the Golden Gochizou, which grants access to a powerful form for only 5 minutes. In this form you rapidly heal from pre-existing damage, your stamina is restored, and you are invulnerable. Additionally, you can summon two minion, a pair of golden knights with golden swords, to fight alongside you. The knights are invulnerable and have half of your golden form’s physical stats. The form’s stats are as follows:

Punching Power: 7.5 tons
Kicking Power: 8 tons
Jump Height: 10 meters
Time to run 100 meters: 5 seconds
addons.title: Golden Gochizou

objects.text:
Just like Shoma Inoue, have a second mouth, known as a gavv, located on the stomach, which allows you to create minions, called gochizous through positive experiences associated with food, such as the joy of eating a cake you and your friends made together. Goichizous are small enough to fit in your hand and can be placed inside of your gavv, allowing you to eat them and gain a specialized form with increased physical capabilities, create weapons, and more.

Just like Shoma, you are considerably stronger and more durable than a normal human with you being able to lift objects far heavier than make sense for his build and walking off being hit by a truck.
objects.title: Modified Gavv (Kamen Rider Gavv)

addons.text:
Made from the power of Creation and your own body, this is a Raise Buckle infused with the power of the Bugster Virus, its surface flickering with glitching pixels and error symbols. When transformed, half of your body is covered in armor blended with digital distortions that nobody can quite explain and your physical capabilities are boosted by roughly 50%.  

While transformed, you can spawn temporary minions to fight for you, make attacks clip through you, and create distortions wherein reality follows game-like rules. This Buckle is not meant for clean victories. It turns combat into a corrupted game—one where the rules bend, glitch, and break in your favor, so long as you’re willing to risk becoming part of the virus yourself.
addons.title: Bugster Buckle

objects.text:
You are a Bugster, a living computer virus able to infect humans. Your body exists partially as information, allowing you to shift between a physical form and Bugster Virus data. This grants enhanced regeneration, the ability to move through digital systems or hosts under the right conditions, and resistance to conventional harm so long as your core data remains intact.

Your power follows game-like logic, being tied to a specific video game of your choosing that cannot be changed. You possess an innate level that increases through conflict, objectives, or absorbing compatible data, strengthening your body and unlocking abilities tied to your chosen game. You can generate and manipulate other instances of the Bugster Virus to weaken enemies, spawn lesser Bugsters, or impose game-like rules on environments. However, your data can be disrupted or destroyed by specialized anti-Bugster effects, and the loss of your core data means permanent death. You are a living glitch, powerful, flexible, and bound by rules only you truly understand.
objects.title: Bugster Physiology (Kamen Rider Ex-Aid)

objects.text:
You now gain one of the abilities many humans desire most to have, only to curse it once they have it... Immortality, of a sort.

For reasons unknown, you have become “immortal” living for hundreds or even thousands of years, unageing, unkillable. An Immortal is indistinguishable from an ordinary human until they experience their first “death”. Shortly after this event, they will “resurrect”, with all of their wounds present and future healing in moments.

When a new Immortal “awakens”, other Immortals throughout the world experience intense dreams of one another, seeing faces, locations, even experiencing feelings. These dreams only stop once the new Immortal physically meets another Immortal.

For most of the Immortals, this healing and resurrective power will fail them at some point, after centuries or millennia of life, and will without warning allow them a final, if bloody end. For you however, this power will last as long as you desire it to, allowing you to decide the time of your final death.
objects.title: Immortal (The Old Guard)

objects.text:
Up and Atom!

It seems through exposure to atomic radiation and a lightning-bolt-shaped piece of metal embedding itself into your head, you gained the powers of Radioactive Man.

In terms of pure physical capabilities, you are extraordinary. Starting off, you are durable enough to bathe in lava, be unaffected by the vacuum of space, render bullets harmless, have tank shells bounce off, and be unfazed by being punched into orbit. Next, you move fast enough to dodge lasers, change clothes faster than the eye can see, and fly 1 million miles in the time it takes for 40 winks. Further, you're strong enough to launch an opponent into space with a punch, tunnel down to a planet’s core, and knock a comet off course. Finally, your atomically enhanced senses allow you to see down to a cellular level and through objects, track a scent across a city, and hear even when in space.

Beyond the purely physical, you have a few tricks up your sleeve. Beginning with your nuclear vision, beams of clean nuclear heat fired from your eyes that are very precise and controllable, able to go from acting as a light, cleaning surfaces and heating up food, to creating blinding explosions, effortlessly melting concrete and steel, and carving large trenches in the earth. Next, you can absorb all manner of radiation, both on a scale to stop a civilization-wiping ray of radiation and precise enough to revert a radioactivity-mutated monster into its pre-mutated state on a chemical level. Finally, your lightning-bolt allows you to pick up and tune into radio signals.

Notably, you are not without your weaknesses, as should your lightning-bolt be removed, your morality and sanity will begin to deteriorate as your power grows towards detonating with the power of a 100 megaton bomb. During storms, the lightning-bolt tends to act as a lightning rod, and substances or energies that interact with nuclear energy will alter, affect, or diminish your abilities.
objects.title: Radioactive Man (The Simpsons)

objects.text: For some strange reason, despite being a Mechanic who are generally frail and easily killed, Black Star kept accumulating molding talents that increased his ability to not be killed, gradually developing a reputation for having an indestructible body. While you do not gain a body as durable as Black Star’s own, you gain several of the molding talents he had that, together, gave him his cockroach-like vitality of galactic renown. The [Steel Body] Talent reinforces your molecular and cellular structure, giving you an absolute immunity to all True Damage, meaning that no attack can bypass your resistances or defenses. Thus, powers like atomic disintegration do nothing to you. Note that this also negates things like Star Trek’s teleporters, which disassemble you at the atomic level, as this would count as True Damage. The [Advanced Strengthened Life] Talent massively amplifies your vitality and, in gaming terms, gives you additional endurance to health point scaling, giving you an additional 1:60 HP for each END you have. This makes you able to withstand a much higher amount of harm before dying or becoming critically injured. You also gain a 25% bonus to all resistances, reducing harm taken by 25%. And for each 40% of your health lost, all of your attributes are increased by 10% until you exit combat; this can stack endlessly, but is temporary. As this increases your END, as does both your Max HP and the amount of HP [High Grade Cell Proliferation Control] can heal per second. Given enough time, you could regenerate tens of times your original max HP per second. [Legendary Fixed Damage Reduction] When taking damage after factoring in resistance, the damage is further reduced by 7,500. Other resistance-based talents take effect after this, so these 7,500 points of damage will be converted into energy to refill your reserves. [Expert Energy Absorption] Any attack, be it physical, psychic, magical, or others, is reduced by 25% and converted to energy to refill your energy reserves. Additionally, 60% of the damage offset by your resistances is converted into energy. This does not count the initial 25% as being offset by resistances. The [High Grade Cell Proliferation Control] Talent allows you to make use of energy to proliferate cells, heal wounds, and convert energy into HP at a 1:9 ratio. This, however, is capped at regenerating 35% of your health per second.
objects.title: Black Star’s Indestructible Body (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl who can transform, your associated element is Metal and your Magical Girl theme is white. For you, transforming is more of a decorative thing. Unlike other kinds of Magical Girls, you don’t have any magic. So no matter what happens to magic, it is corrupted or sealed, and it doesn’t affect you. This also means you can’t sense anything supernatural either. However instead, you gain an silver Broken Sword whenever you transform. But aside from that, when transformed you do not gain any physical enhancements until you reach Tier 2 in any skill. You also possess an inventory that can carry a limited number of items, even capable of containing non-physical items. Once you pass Tier 5, you gain the ability to fly for short periods of time.

You know Martial Breathing, by taking breaths of air you can increase your natural regeneration passively, improving your life force and stamina recovery. By Tier 3, you can visibly regenerate wounds. By touching another, you can purify and heal others. If the Broken Sword purifies anything corruptive, it can get stronger and teach you more techniques. The stronger the corruptive the thing is, the more proficiency it grants to your light based abilities. Ranging from calling down a judgement of light or harnessing its power to fire beams. While they don’t consume any cost to use, they do have a cooldown. Defeating foes also works for the Broken Sword but regardless of method, repairing the Broken Sword requires Sword Intent.
You also obtain a Golden Finger, gaining a proficiency panel. Any skill or physical movement you do adds points, every 10,000 points you obtain in a specific way makes you twice as good in that skill as well as makes you physically better by three times. All skills and physical movements start at Tier 1 and go up from there, requiring 10,000 points per Tier. This also means you have a basic understanding of any skill imaginable, even more magical crafts like Alchemy. When a non-combat skill like Alchemy goes to Tier 2 it will grant you a special ability like improving and purifying the effects of what you consume. The new ability starts at Tier 1. Any increases granted by your Golden Finger also increases your base form. Martial Breathing grants 1 point every breath you take. You do not gain any points from faulty practice or using skills poorly and the higher the Tier the harder it is to gain points for that specific skill or physical activity. On the other hand, using a skill extremely well or casting a powerful ability has an easier time gaining points. Every five Tiers of the same skill you improve in grants significantly improved abilities, such as for Swordsmanship granting Sword Intent.

However, the stronger you get, the more food you require to maintain yourself. Once one of your skills reaches Tier 4, it becomes unreasonable for ordinary food to sustain you and you will require more extraordinary methods such as alchemy. For example, to feed yourself enough energy to advance to Tier 5 in Swordsmanship requires over two thousand kilograms of rice. If you are unable to sustain yourself, you will not be able to advance to the next Tier on any skill. Anything with mana inside it that can be used to feed yourself. There is a maximum limit of power a specific skill or power can reach, however using materials containing divinity you can absorb it and upgrade a skill to break its limit.
objects.title: Metal Magical Girl (Become a Magical Girl: I Have a Proficiency Panel)

objects.text: Similar to Rhadamanth Nemes and her siblings from the Noble Guard, you have been enhanced by the TechnoCore to become one of the most advanced cyborgs in the universe. While outwardly you appear completely human, inside you are more metal than flesh. You are completely inexhaustable due to harnessing the energy from The Void Which Binds, possess strength enough to tear through solid steel, and can move at relativistic speed. You are durable enough to survive acceleration of several hundred g without it even slightly bothering you and can operate for as long as your head remains mostly intact, with automatic systems repairing any damage dealt to you or even piloting your body remotely if your head has been severed. You have no need for any sustenance and can comfortably exist in the vacuum of space. Underneath your synthetic skin, which you can remove, reattach, and replace when needed, your artificial skeleton has sharp, angled corners and keels that can be used as cutting edges. Your fingernails can extrude into long protrusions as sharp as monofilament wire. You are also equipped with the most advanced communication and sensor arrays, which include, but are not limited to, quantum entanglement communication device, radar, sonar, a sense of smell about three times more sensitive than a gas chromatograph mass spectrometer, and special neural-interface tendrils that you can extend from your fingers to extract data from both brains and computers. But the most terrifying ability in your arsenal is your ability to phase-shift. When phase-shifted, you become detached from the normal flow of space time, which to the outside observer will seem like you are clad in a thin, skin-tight, constantly shifting, reflective forcefield-like suit of liquid chrome. In this state, you are completely invulnerable to any conventional damage, capable of withstanding orbital bombardment or bathing in the neutron star. The only way to damage you is with other abilities that can manipulate space-time to a similar or greater extent. You are capable of shapeshifting this 'suit' to a limited degree, forming blade-like protrusions sharper than anything that can be produced by even the most advanced material science, cutting everything from matter to forcefields if it is not protected by the effects similar to your phase-shifting. The effects of phase-shifting can be extended to other people who you are in physical contact with, with your chrome forcefield extending to cover them as well. Lastly, while you are phase-shifted, you can enter what is known as fast time. While in this state, you can speed up your own time to the point where the rest of the universe appears frozen in place. At maximum power output, you are capable of speeding up time to such an extent that, compared to the regular universe, you would be moving at around several quadrillion times the speed of light.
objects.title: Noble Guard (Hyperion Cantos)

objects.text:
Your body has been completely replaced by living Orange Matter, an exotic substance that perfectly preserves your identity while discarding the limitations of conventional biology. Though you outwardly appear human, every part of you has become a seamless mass of indestructible matter. Medical examination would conclude you are no longer a living organism in any conventional sense.

As a result, your body no longer depends on biological function. You do not need to breathe, eat, drink, or sleep to survive, and are immune to disease, poison, radiation, vacuum, pressure, and other environmental hazards. Your appearance remains fixed unless altered by natural aging, with your hair, skin, and every other feature remaining exactly as they were.

More importantly, your body is absolutely immune to physical harm. Bullets flatten, blades shatter, explosions wash over you harmlessly, and even attacks empowered by supernatural abilities fail to injure you through direct force. You possess no vital organs to exploit, nor can your body be worn down through conventional means.

Your Orange Matter exists in a perfected and immutable state. Attempts to alter your biology, mutate your genetics, transform your body, rewrite your physiology, or forcibly grant you additional powers simply fail, your body rejecting any change to its structure. Likewise, temporal stasis, localized time stops, and similar effects that would freeze or suspend your body are equally ineffective, leaving you free to act while others remain trapped by such powers.
objects.title: Little Augustus (The Perfect Run)

addons.title: Solar Aura (Ragna Crimson)
addons.text:
Your Silverine physiology has reacted to your usage of Sendo, granting you the innate ability to generate Solar Aura, much like the Sun Saint Dulla Polo Nello. You can manifest this aura as blazing flames capable of effortlessly melting most metals, or condense it into searing light to unleash devastating laser blasts.

Your mastery over Solar Aura also greatly enhances your ability to create constructs, allowing them to serve as extensions of yourself—even communicating through them. In addition, you can erect immense barriers with enough reach and resilience to shield an entire city from an attack powerful enough to erase it from the map.

Unlike the Sun Saint, however, wielding this power does not reduce you to a burning skeleton, allowing you to unleash its full potential.

objects.text:
Like Ragna, you have undergone the fusion process that merged your body with a sword forged from Silverine. Even in its most basic state, this transformation grants you immense superhuman abilities. You possess the strength to slay superior dragons with your bare hands, the speed to outpace lightning, and the durability to withstand attacks capable of shattering mountains.

You can transform parts or all of your body into Silverine to further increase your resilience, or reshape your arms into razor-sharp blades. Your body can also “reforge” itself after being damaged, allowing you to regenerate from even catastrophic injuries. This regenerative ability is potent enough to let you survive decapitation by reconstructing yourself.

Your greatest power, however, lies in Silverine’s unique aura, which freezes mana itself. This effect can immobilize mana within both living beings and inanimate objects, making it devastatingly effective against magical phenomena. As a result, you possess extraordinary resistance to magic, effortlessly negating even reality-warping spells. You can also nullify the secondary effects of magic, such as heat, sound, force, and other magical byproducts.

Beyond its defensive applications, you can shape this Silverine aura into weapon constructs, barriers, and powerful ranged attacks, use it to achieve flight, or imbue other objects with Silverine’s mana-freezing properties, extending its effects beyond your own body.
objects.title: Silverine Hybrid (Ragna Crimson)

objects.text:
You are the Immortal, a being created to preserve the world. Your original form is that of a seemingly ordinary, inanimate white orb, but you have the ability to take on the form and abilities of anything that provides you with stimuli. However, as your original form would leave you completely without a consciousness, you start with an additional sentient form of your choosing, which must be no stronger than an unpowered human.

As the Immortal, you possess true immortality in the sense that you cannot die by any means, whether through old age or attempts to destroy your body. You have the ability to quickly recover from any injury, no matter how severe or persistent, and the time it takes for you to revive decreases with every death. Initially, it would take you five days to revive, but after enough deaths, this time could decrease from hours to minutes and even seconds or less as your body adapts to whatever killed you.

In the case of your shapeshifting ability, the stronger the stimuli you receive, whether physical or emotional, the better you can shift into that form. However, you can only shift into a living being after that being has died, and you cannot shift into someone you have never seen alive. The moment you try to mimic a corpse, you will become nothing more than a corpse yourself. When you acquire the form of a living being, it will be exactly as you last saw them, including any injuries they had and the condition of their body. For example, if someone died of starvation, you would feel hungry whenever you assumed their form.

When you shift into another living being, your personality, habits, and voice can change accordingly, depending on how well you knew them. However, your eyes are the only part of you that never changes, regardless of your form. You may choose the color of your eyes once, and that color will remain with you permanently.

In addition, you can only transform into someone you have seen. If you are not present when someone dies, you can only transform into them as you last saw them. You also possess an empathic extra sense that allows you to sense the emotions and pain of other living beings, even if you cannot see them. Because of this, you do not need to extensively interact with people directly in order to take their form, as their emotions already act as stimuli for you.

In the case of objects and things that are not alive, you only need to receive stimuli from them once before you can recreate them perfectly. The greater the stimulus, the more deeply it is imprinted in your memory and the easier it becomes to replicate. This includes things such as minerals, weapons, money, buildings, and even food. However, in the case of more harmful substances, you would need a much greater stimulus to replicate them. For example, you could eventually replicate molten iron and its extraordinarily high temperature after being trapped in an iron box with molten iron poured into it for several days.

Your ability to replicate things also allows you to effectively resurrect the dead, requiring only that you recreate their body for their soul to return to it. However, you can only revive creatures whose souls remain in the world, and you cannot revive creatures you have never seen alive, as their recreated bodies would already be dead. You can circumvent this restriction if you are able to interact with the soul directly. If you knew someone well throughout the different stages of their life, you could even resurrect an elderly person in a youthful body.

One interesting application of your replication ability is that you can extend your senses throughout objects you create. For example, you could use plant roots to expand the territory you effectively "control," allowing you to create whatever you need to destroy targets that enter it. Since this allows you to create anything wherever your roots exist, you can also create additional bodies and transfer your consciousness to and from them, effectively achieving teleportation.

As you can essentially create matter endlessly, this ability could eventually allow you to spread roots around an entire planet, enabling you to teleport and create things anywhere in the world. Unlike the original Immortal, you already start with the ability to reconnect to any part of yourself that has been severed, allowing you to roam the world freely without needing to remain constantly attached to your network.
objects.title: The Immortal (To Your Eternity)

addons.title: Friendly Fire (Saints Row)
addons.text:
