You have acquired access to all the weapons featured throughout the Saints Row franchise. Just like in the games, you may access and switch between these weapons with a thought through a menu-like inventory at any time.

These weapons range from ordinary weapons such as knives, baseball bats, pistols, SMGs, shotguns, rifles, thrown weapons like Molotov cocktails and hand grenades, miniguns, sniper rifles, and rocket launchers, to more exotic weapons such as laser guns, the Shark-O-Matic, the Mollusk Launcher, the Reaper Drone, an energy sword, Cyberspace guns, a Disintegrator, a Dubstep Gun, and even a Black Hole Launcher.

Your weapons automatically replenish their ammunition over time, with the time required to recharge varying depending on the weapon's power, though none take more than 24 hours to fully recharge. In addition, these weapons include all of their canonical in-game modifications, and should you select the (Blaster) Unlimited Ammo Works or a similar option, all of your weapons will have unlimited ammunition.

objects.text:
Your life has become akin to a simulation, but by exploiting errant code, you can bend its rules to your will. This has granted you superhuman abilities such as super strength, durability, enhanced reflexes, super sprinting, and super jumping. These abilities allow you to kill ordinary creatures with a single punch, withstand kinetic and energy weapons, leap over tall buildings, outrun sports cars, run across walls and water, glide, perform air dashes, and generate a force field while super sprinting or dashing that significantly reduces the damage you take.

You can also see both your health and stamina bars. When you are outside of combat, you naturally regenerate any damage you have taken, and any creature you kill drops health pickups that are automatically drawn to you when you are nearby, restoring a moderate amount of health. On top of these abilities, you also possess four types of powers that you can activate at will: Blast, which unleashes a concussive force; Telekinesis, which allows you to lift a target with your mind and hurl it away; Stomp, which sends seismic waves through the ground and launches enemies into the air; and Buff, which grants a special effect to your every movement.

Each of these four powers also comes with a variety of elemental variants. Blast can be imbued with effects such as Fire, Freeze, or Mind Control. Telekinesis can use effects such as Life Steal or Lightning. Stomp can be infused with effects such as Gravity, causing enemies to float, or Shrink, allowing you to reduce their size before stepping on them. Buff can surround you with an aura of Fire, Freeze, or Lightning that damages nearby enemies while also imbuing any ranged weapons you wield with the same effect. This also includes the Explosion and Bling elements.

Finally, you possess one devastating special move known as Death From Above, which allows you to launch yourself high into the air before crashing into the ground. The higher your starting point, the greater the damage you inflict, with sufficient altitude allowing you to create an explosion comparable to a nuke.
objects.title: Super Saint (Saints Row)

objects.text:
You are no longer fully human, but have taken on some minor traits associated with felines. Your five senses have expanded several orders of magnitude. You can see clearly in near darkness, easily differentiate scents better than any bloodhound, easily track and triangulate sounds around you, etc.

Your head is adorned with an adorable, and quite functional, pair of cat ears. You have very sharp claws that you can easily retract or call to use at your fingertips. A cat tail completes your set of cat features and greatly improves your balance, easily compensating for complex motions to keep you upright. Your body, in general, feels lighter to you and is much easier to move in, granting you an improved acrobatic skill–enough to easily always land on your feet.

You have a special ability enabling you to seek out and find delightfully warm sunbeams and other locations of supreme comfort. At your leisure, you can emit a soft aura around you that enforces others’ perception of your adorableness and your need to be taken care of and protected. You are free to choose which breed of domestic cat you take after.
objects.title: Catfolk

objects.text:
Oh? It seems you're a mischievous fellow, huh. It makes sense, I suppose, as you're now a member of the yōkai race the Bake-Danuki. A powerful and mischievous creature, you now possess a multitude of powerful physical and magical abilities.

To start with, you now possess a much greater degree strength and agility, capable of outclassing even most brutes, as well as incredible senses capable of tracking someone that passed through even the most crowded of places days ago, or even hearing the heartbeats of others from the other side of a large building. Alongside this, you also possess the ability to manifest the appendages of your species at will, most notably the extremely dexterous and prehensile tail. You’ve been ingrained with muscle memory as if you had had these traits all your life.

The next is perhaps a Bake-Danuki's most well known power: You now possess the ability to freely shapeshift into anything you wish, capable of taking the form of anything from that of an old lady to even a massive building or boat.

And finally, perhaps your kind's most obscure power, is that by grasping a leaf in your hands, you may transmute it into whatever you wish, from living creatures such birds and dogs to inanimate objects such as a pen or kettle.
objects.title: Bake-Danuki

addons.text:
The "Hercules" Method which trains the user's mind, body and spirit into perfection has merged with your current existence as the pinnacle of perfection for your species, enhancing every aspect of yourself even further.

You now start out having fully mastered the Method, further improving your condition and all your innate racial abilities to such an extent that you could now almost be considered an entirely different species. If before you could fly like a bird? Now you fly at almost hypersonic speeds. Furthermore, your capacity to master abilities associated with your race has also improved to the point that you can spontaneously acquire and use these abilities with absolute mastery at will.

Through your efforts to reach perfection, you continuously develop and improve in all respects without limit at a rate similar to Dynamist Jr. This ability, however, preferentially focuses on enhancing your current capabilities instead of adding new ones.
addons.title: Transcendent Specimen

objects.text:
You are at the top of your species. Your physical and mental condition is unparalleled. Every aspect of your being is enhanced to be greater than any other member of your species. 

Inherent racial weakness find no hold on you. You could walk under the glorious light of the sun if you were a vampire, and retain your mind while bathing in the beauty of a full moon as a werewolf. All racial abilities are enhanced and your potential is no longer limited. 

You may even generate abilities unique to yourself through enough experience and determination. Mastering abilities associated with your species becomes significantly easier, such as shape-shifting into a wolf at any time as a werewolf or becoming proficient in blood magic as a vampire.
objects.title: Apex Specimen

addons.text:
It seems that through consuming dragon blood your divine blood has evolved, not only are your previous capabilities enhanced but you now have completely new powers such as manifesting draconic traits (such as claws, wings, and even a tail) through your magical energy. With time and training, this could evolve granting the ability to have an accelerated healing factor that allows you to survive even if your heart and brain are destroyed and even assume a fully draconic form.

With this, your Ichor has also merged with your dragon core, turning it into a Divine Dragon Core. This grants access to divine mana that can strengthen spells and give them divine attributes or be used as an alternative to faith. At this level, it's not that different from a weak divine core, but in time, you'll quickly rise to become a god and potentially a chief god. Only time will truly tell.
addons.title: Blood of the Dragon God

addons.text: At a certain level, supers begin to showcase power similar to that of gods, with each main class representing different aspects of the deities. The Divine blood running through your veins allows you to showcase some of this in advance, along with making your journey much easier. The Pugilist class represents the Body of God, the Psychic class represents the Soul of God, the Esper class represents the Thaumaturgy of the gods, the Mage class represents the Control of Laws deities wield, and the Mechanic class represents the Deity’s Equipment, as every true deity has a symbol of power or three. Nevertheless, your golden blood gives you a molding talent that ensures you will reach the highest of levels even if you don't work for it. [Golden Ichor] Due to the golden Ichor running through your veins, you experience passive growth of your physique, spirit, energy, lifeforce, and even grade. You gain +12 STR, END, AGI, +8 MYS, CHA, INT, +4 LUK, +144 Energy, and +1 END to Health Bonus per month, along with +1 main class level per year. As you gain 1 level per year, you will reach the pinnacle of Beyond A Grade within a few hundred years, even without dedicated effort or training.
addons.title: [Golden Ichor]

objects.text:
Somehow, the very lifeblood of the gods: ichor flows through your veins. A spark of divinity has embedded itself within your soul, transforming your heart into a generator that steadily produces ichor and pumps it throughout your body. This gift has granted you immortality, eternal youth, and extraordinary physical abilities. You can lift semi-trucks above your head, leap onto the roofs of three-story buildings, and run at a maximum of 100 miles per hour for half a day before feeling fatigued. Your regenerative abilities are greatly enhanced; you can regrow entire limbs within minutes and even recover from losing half of your head. However, this is not absolute immortality, complete destruction of your head will still be fatal.

On the esoteric side you become naturally resistant to curses, diseases, poisons, illnesses, and negative magical effects. Any that does take hold of you can be recovered from in a matter of hours to days depending on just how persistent and powerful they're.

Beyond physical enhancements, the ichor is rich in mana, allowing you to use your own blood as a reservoir for casting magic. This can serve as your primary magical source if you lack one or act as a secondary pool to complement any magical reserves you possess. Additionally, your blood, if consumed by another, acts as a powerful healing elixir that grants them regenerative abilities on par with your own for a few minutes and restores their mana. It can also be stored and used as a magical reagent or in item creation to amplify an item's power, so be cautious about letting it fall into the wrong hands.

Over time, the ichor will gradually transform your body, causing you to grow in power and, slowly but surely, evolve into an actual god. If you were already a god or divine in some other way this works as an amplifier to those powers.
objects.title: Blood of the Gods

addons.text:
You are no longer limited to being merely a composite of humanity; your power now extends to similarly affect any other species or race that you exist as.

Whether you are a vampire, orc, elf or any other being, you have become the singular fusion of your entire species. You possess all the traits, skills, knowledge, and abilities that your race has currently or has ever had in its history. If you are a hybrid of multiple races, you can become a composite of all of them respectively.

What’s more, all of the capabilities, attributes and talents you have gained from being the composite of your race are enhanced to be significantly greater than any other member, as befitting of being the Apex Specimen. For example, if someone from your race was a once-in-a-lifetime prodigy in nature magic, your aptitude, power and potential with nature magic would substantially exceed theirs in every respect.
addons.title: The Composite Genus

addons.text: You're no longer confined to just being the composite of humanity within your universe. Instead, your power now spans throughout your entire local multiverse cluster, making you the combined composite of every version of the Homo sapiens species from across all of these universes. As such, every trait, talent, knowledge and natural ability that any human has ever developed across your local multiverse, whether in the past or present, is now yours. For instance, if humans in one universe evolved to breathe underwater, you would have that ability. Likewise, you could tap into the complete scientific expertise of humanity from a highly technologically advanced universe.
addons.title: The Multiversal Composite

addons.text: You may now also become composite with those who would have had your abilities before you, as long as the power does not exceed what you have actually purchased. You get the composite abilities of those who do not have their abilities covered by a specific other upgrade or ability, unless you have those purchased as well. In the example case of "Chakra (Naruto)", this would mean that you would have any ability available to this universe's (or universes, plural, where relevant) "mundane humans" plus the abilities of all Chakra users without notable Kekkei Genkai or specific CYOA abilities based on them (like the Kage, the Sannin, the Akatsuki, the Jinchuruki, etc.), but you wouldn't be able to form a composite of the Uchiha clan unless you had "Sharingan (Naruto)", and even then you would be restricted from being composite with the reincarnations of Indra unless you had the relevant upgrade, and so on.
addons.title: The Lives Who Came Before

objects.text: You have become the Composite Human; the hypothetical result of the amalgamation of the best aspects of every modern human who has ever existed or currently exists into a single individual. You possess every skill, trait, knowledge, experience and natural biological capability that any member of Homo sapiens sapiens has ever had without any fault or drawback. Your physical condition and genetics are the pinnacle of humanity. You have the conditioned muscle mass of the strongest weightlifters, possess peak human senses, have enhanced durability thanks to abnormally high bone density, can run hundreds of kilometres without rest and can hold your breath for over 24 minutes, all to name but a few. This also includes more exotic attributes such as Marfan syndrome which grants exceptionally flexible joints or congenital analgesia, enabling you to feel no pain. You may freely turn off and on particular traits and can display seemingly incompatible traits simultaneously. For example, you could concurrently have the light nimbleness needed to perform acrobatic stunts alongside the sheer muscle mass required for peak human strength. Moreover, you can freely change your appearance, drawing upon the many features humans have had throughout history and the modern day. Do you wish to be as tall as Angus MacAskill, have the eyes of Audrey Hepburn or the beard of Frederick Douglas? It's all possible. However, it is your mind which is perhaps your greatest asset. Your intelligence is the best of humanity in every respect, enabling you to achieve mental feats on par with the most brilliant savants and geniuses of all time. Your charisma matches that of legendary leaders, your creativity mirrors the greatest artists and your wisdom draws from the collective insights of the most renowned philosophers. Furthermore, you possess every skill or expertise that any human has ever had. You know and understand all human knowledge across every possible field of study, are a master of every martial art ever created (including muscle memory), have perfect fluency in all forms of language, have intimate familiarity with every historical human event… the list goes on and on. You have an unlimited memory through which you can store and recall all of this information. This knowledge continuously updates as all of humanity's thoughts, actions and memories flow into you; even permitting a form of pseudo-mind reading if desired. Finally, while this power is based upon modern humanity within this universe, it will update no matter where you are, allowing you to become the composite of all Homo sapiens sapiens of the universe that you are in so long as they are purely “human” (so not a hybrid, post-human etc). The more powerful the version of humanity, however, the longer it will take you to acclimatise to become a composite of them.
objects.title: The Composite Human

addons.text:
You now also possess the powers inherited from the other children of Ymir—the Dwarves. This greatly enhances your affinity for crafting, extending it to encompass nearly all forms of creative works.

Whether it is in blacksmithing, where you can forge weapons on par with Mjölnir or the fetters that bound Fenrir; weaving, where you can craft cloaks of invisibility that hide you from the senses of mortals; or brewing, where you can create meads capable of granting divine inspiration from blood and much more—you excel in all of these arts.

You achieve this by using esoteric and conceptual ingredients such as the roots of a mountain, the sound of the wind, honor, or anything else your imagination can conceive.
addons.title: Dvergr

addons.text:
You are akin to the other children of Loki, granting you the potential for limitless growth in power, such that, over time, you can rival even the mightiest of the gods. You need only look to your siblings for inspiration.

Fenrir, who grows endlessly and was chained by the gods out of fear; Jörmungandr, the World Serpent, whose size allows him to encircle Midgard and whose venom is capable of slaying even the strongest; or Hel, ruler of the Underworld, who holds dominion over all souls not claimed by Odin or Freya for their halls.

This heritage accelerates your journey towards godhood, with your previously chosen abilities and affinities evolving over time. They will eventually become tied to your domain and take on a conceptual nature, further cementing your divinity.
addons.title: Child of Loki

addons.text:
You are now a Magician and Illusionist with the same level of skill as Útgarða-Loki. This grants you the ability to create illusions capable of even deceiving Gods and enchanting the World, giving form to the formless.

With this power, you can ensure that whenever someone attempts to strike you, they hit nothing but the ground, oblivious to the fact that you haven’t even moved. You can shape the land to appear as a grand castle filled with actual food that can be eaten and much more.

Your mastery of enchantment extends far beyond simple illusions. Drawing inspiration from the legendary deeds of Útgarða-Loki, you can shape wildfire into a man with an insatiable appetite, transform thought into a being with the speed of the mind, embody old age as an undefeatable old woman, link the World Serpent to a cat to make it immovable, or create an "endless" drinking horn connected to the ocean.
addons.title: Útgarða-Loki

objects.text:
You are a Jötunn, a being descended from Ymir, the First Giant. Compared to the Gods, you are more an aspect of nature manifested—a part of the True Wild rather than civilization.

This does not mean you are incapable of being civilized, however, as many Jötunn and Gods have intermarried throughout history.

Jötunn are beings of immense power and magic, most often but not always distinguished by their towering size, standing several heads taller than a human, and often wielding the destructive forces of nature. For instance, you can hurl boulders weighing several hundred tons, sprint at speeds of several hundred meters per second, or recover from fatal wounds in mere days.

They appear in many forms, from a stunning 10-meter-tall woman, a monstrous creature with ten heads, or even in the shape of animals. As a Jötunn, you can freely choose your form, as long as it exudes a supernatural aura—whether as a massive human or an animal with hair, beard, or fur made of leaves, or anything else that strikes your fancy.

You obtain immense physical and magical might. Many Jötunn are deeply connected to the elements and the world around them, granting them exceptional affinities for specific magical arts or physical prowess that surpasses their peers.

However, you are not restricted to your chosen affinity. Many Jötunn become master craftsmen, skilled weavers, fearsome warriors, or insightful seers capable of foreseeing the future and delivering prophecies far beyond their initial talents.

You can also uncover the hidden paths to the mysterious realms of the Jötunn—secret ways concealed in the mountains, the twilight horizon, or even the flickering flames of a fire.
objects.title: Jötunn

addons.text: Universal Power Plant has made an odd connection with your elven physiology. Now, when you visit a new universe and they have an elf or elven equivalent, you have the option of turning into that species of elf after a month. You also have this capability to immediately turn into the elf of any power or OoP you have that contains elves or the equivalent species in the universe they originate from.
addons.title: Universal Elf

addons.text:
Congratulations, my friend! You're an elf! Woohoo! Oh, wait... you've always been an elf? Well, to be more specific—you're now an Arknights Elf!
 
Congratulations on becoming one, btw. Elves are a bestest most perfect race ever after all~! ☆

As one of the rarest beings in Terra, all of your natural gifts have been elevated. You possess enhanced magical control, greater physical abilities, and an intelligence that now rivals the genius of (Mu)Muelsyse.

As elves were all children born from a Feranmut, your connection to nature is deepened to reflect that, allowing you to communicate with, control, and understand the world around you like never before. You also have a special affinity for a specific biome—including but not limited to lush forests, icy tundras, vast deserts, or the ocean—making that specific environment an extension of your power.

But beware! While these powers make you formidable, they do come with a drawback. Should you become infected with Oripathy, you'll expire in less than a month! So try not to be infected now, ya hear?—your life depends on it!
addons.title: ELF!

addons.text:
Your falna does not start off blank and having nothing to help you climb. Instead, you have the spells, skills, and developmental abilities of Lefiya Viridis—such as the Abnormal Resistance, Magic Resistance, and Mage ability that improves your magic, reduces the mana cost, and makes a magic circle under you when you use a spell.

This gives you the spells Arc Ray, which fires a streak of light that can change direction to chase opponents and can explode with the incantation "Alio"; Fusillade Fallarica, which is a wide-area attack fire spell, and finally Elf Ring—when the spell is chanted, you can use any other elf's magic if you know the incantation and/or effects of the magic.

Besides these, you also have the skills Fairy Canon, that increases the effects of magic, which doubles even this boost if used with attack magic, and Double Canon, which allows you to keep a single spell you've chanted as a ring on your left arm, allowing you to immediately use that spell whenever you want. You can only keep one magic circle like this on your arm at a time, and it uses mana for each use with the keyword to use it being canon. This spell can be Elf Ring.
addons.title: Thousand Elf

objects.text:
You're an elf—you have pointy ears, are naturally beautiful, and have a talent for magic. As is common with elves, you have great vision, capable of seeing things clearly up to 5 miles away, even at night.

You also have enhanced balance, such that you could run on a tightrope without fear of falling. You have an uncanny connection to nature, allowing you to perfectly map out various types of terrain. Getting lost is a near impossibility.

Furthermore, all mundane and even some supernatural animals are naturally pacified near you and generally non-hostile unless they are provoked. This is more effective for magical animals and creatures who are more connected to nature. You can also identify the properties of various flora and fungi at a glance and determine if they are safe to eat or poisonous.

All elves have lifespans in the hundreds of years. Because of the magic flowing through you, your physicality is also further enhanced to be far greater than what your lithe appearance suggests. You’re roughly twice as strong and as fast as a human of similar fitness.

You have the option to instead be a half-elf, which has no real downsides outside of having smaller ears compared to a full-elf.
objects.title: Elf

addons.text: Due to your connection with the Universal Power Plant and your dwarven origin, you have acquired a unique ability. When you visit a new universe that features dwarves or a dwarven equivalent, you can choose to transform into that type of dwarf after a month has passed. You also have the capability to immediately turn into the dwarf of any power or OoP you have that contains dwarves or the equivalent species in the universe they originate from. You also learn of the culture and history of any dwarven race you turn into.
addons.title: Universal Dwarf

addons.text:
Due to your dwarven heritage and your natural talent as a craftsman, you feel a surge of inspiration whenever you enter a forge or any other space dedicated to a craft. Ideas and thoughts flow effortlessly, and your need for food and rest fades away as long as you are engaged in your craft. You have exceptional dexterity with your hands, enabling you to use them like precision tools for crafting intricate objects such as watches and motherboards. When you work, you can subtly alter the properties of the materials, allowing, for example, a metal to be molded like clay for easier shaping.

Anything you have a hand in creating will be immune to the passage of time and issues like rust, wear and tear, and other factors that could negatively affect its quality. The only way to truly destroy something you have made is by applying overwhelming force to break it.
addons.title: Dwarven Craftsman

addons.text: Your dwarven heritage has transformed the nature of the Shipment. Now, every material you obtain will have been refined by a dwarven master skilled in the appropriate craft. This refinement significantly increases the potency of the materials and grants them exotic or magical properties, depending on what is most suitable. Additionally, you will receive double the quantity whenever you request rare, exotic, powerful, or dangerous materials.
addons.title: Dwarven Materials

objects.text:
You are now a dwarf, a race known for its exceptional craftsmanship and formidable prowess as warriors. Dwarves typically stand between 4 and 5 feet tall and possess a stocky build. Your physical attributes tend to be above those of even trained humans, with your strength, durability, and endurance being your most notable attributes. A dwarf can typically lift many times their own weight with ease, toil in their mines for days without tiring, and can withstand wounds that would leave other races in critical condition. Additionally, dwarves also possess extraordinary vision, seeing in their dark caverns as if it were daylight.

Dwarves are also resistant to many ailments and poisons and can easily withstand extreme temperatures. They also live for much longer, usually living to be a few hundred years old and sometimes reaching up to a thousand. Their mind are equally resilient, capable of withstanding the passage of time without issue. A dwarf never has to worry about forgetting anything, as their experiences and knowledge are firmly etched into their memory.

Dwarves are natural craftsmen, talented in all types of crafts and their necessary tools. Even if a dwarf were to pick up a new craft, they could easily figure it out and improve as they go, naturally refining their techniques and correcting mistakes along the way. When it comes to technology, they have an intuitive understanding, with complex devices, advanced engineering, or intricate machinery just making sense to them. They can build, repair, and upgrade things that most people wouldn’t even know how to approach. While dwarves are natural craftsmen, they also make for formidable warriors. With their ingenuity making them formidable tacticians and their powerful physical prowess leaving them as walls of steel on the battlefield.

Though none of this is the most notable trait of dwarves, it being their majestic beard. Any dwarf is able to grow a long and majestic beard, no matter their sex; it is extremely easy to comb and maintain. One unique trait of a dwarf’s beard is that the hair of it is much sturdier than it should be, being equal to iron and with proper care being able to be as solid as good dwarven forged steel.
objects.title: Dwarf

addons.text:
Your seed was not meant to be made. A quirk of biology, physics and esotericism has enhanced your nature. 

Your shapeshifting has dramatically increased in potency, allowing you to alter your form in manners undreamed of by most of even the elder Star-Children. Altering your body plan in radical ways and creating entirely new biological abilities.

Your enhancement pool has similarly deepened, now able to have lasting effects on anything it alters, even when not actively enhancing. Additionally, the pool itself has doubled in depth allowing you twice as much energy to make these empowerments.

Finally, your Star-Seeds are dramatically more potent and somewhat self-aware, actively able to find similar hosts to yourself, guaranteeing a pantheon of incredibly able, and at least somewhat like minded fellows as opposed to simple luck.
addons.title: Antiqua Stella

addons.text:
When the universe became colder, when empires uncounted and numerous died in a great cosmic ending, two seeds collided together. A seed of the Astrum Populi, destructive and stabilising, and a seed of the Stella Populi, Mutative and unpredictable. In the vast void they mingled and merged, finding purchase in the other eternally battling for dominance. 

At will you can change which presentation you want to express, Stella or Astrum. When presenting as one you have access to all of its abilities and idiosyncrasies, but any benefits from them do not follow as soon as you switch to the other form. 

In addition, you can access a third fused presentation, a dual expression of both the Stella Populi and Astrum populi at the same time, giving you access to all the benefits of both at the same time.
addons.title: Astralis Populi

objects.text: Billions of years ago, the heat spread among the universe was enough to provide liquid water virtually everywhere. In this ‘Goldilocks Universe’, the Stella Populi were born, died, and spread the seed of their existence back into the stars frozen in meteors that would one day be dragged into a gravity well and birth them anew. Welcome to your destiny, Star-Child. You’re a Stella Populus, one of the Star Peoples. As a successor to the Populi, you have a number of abilities, these can be largely defined as Mutability, Empowerment, and Legacy. Mutability defines itself by your new form. Composed of a mutable matter, your form is somewhat malleable, able to reconfigure and heal itself from most injuries. Your consciousness is spread out evenly among your body, meaning losing your head would only lose memory equivalent to the mass lost, with cognitive function being restored as the biomass regrows. Furthermore, due to this mutability, you’re able to make small adjustments to your body, not enough to radically alter your body plan, but sex, appearance, lactose intolerance status, age and other minor matters of the physical body can be altered to your discretion. This does make you functionally immortal, at least biologically. Empowerment is composed of a pool of energy inside you roughly equivalent to 10SP, though this can increase with training and strenuous use. This can be distributed both into the abilities endemic to being a Star Child, such as your inherent shapeshifting or regeneration, or into any other abilities that you possess, in order to enhance their power, or make modifications as you see fit within the energy you can assign. Once the energy is returned to the ‘pool’ any ability you possessed is returned to its original form and will need to be actively altered again to restore any changes you made. Legacy is the final aspect of the Stella Populi. Much like your progenitors, you have an occupation with legacy, able to create ‘seeds’ that can pass your nature onto others. This both allows you to create new Star Children, the same way you have become one, and allows you to pass on your particular strain, including any abilities you yourself possess. Naturally, as their progenitor, you can alter the seeds you produce to edit out any undesirable traits to pass on, including other powers, allergies and other features. You can produce a single seed a month, but can store them indefinitely by simply submerging them in water, then either storing them yourself or sending them into the stars, another capsule as the elders once did.
objects.title: Stella Populi

addons.text:
Your seed is perfect, the crowning achievement of the universe’s oldest prosecutors. A quirk of biology, physics and esotericism has enhanced your nature.

Your Certainty has become immutable, making most physical attacks merely glance from you in material form and pass without a trace as void-stuff. 

Your Dissent has become ever deeper, now having lasting effects on those it touches, leaving half of the energy leached from them in your void able to enhance your abilities.

Finally, your Star-seeds are more potent and somewhat self aware, botha actively able to find new hosts while set out, guaranteeing a pantheon of incredibly able, and at least somewhat like minded fellows as opposed to simple luck, and also far more capable in their clash of wills when used as a weapon, drawing more energy faster when successful.
addons.title: Antiqua Astrum

objects.text: Billions of years ago, the heat spread among the universe was vast, burning and horrific in all places. In this hellish primordial universe, the Astrum Populi were born, died, and spread the seed of their existence back into the stars constructed from steel in meteors that would one day be dragged into a gravity well and birth them anew. Welcome to your destiny, Void-Child. You’re an Astrum Populus, one of the Star Peoples. As a successor to the Populi, you have a number of abilities, these can be largely defined as Certainty, Dissent, and Dispossession. Certainty defines itself by your body. Composed of stalwart void-stuff it’s immutable and untouchable. Your physical form is selectively tangible, but more importantly cannot be changed by outside sources without exponentially more energy than would otherwise be required. This does make you functionally immortal, at least biologically. Dissent is composed of an empty void inside you, its size can increase with training and strenuous use. This void can draw powers and abilities from anyone or anything nearby and converted to an ‘energy’. Not only can this energy then be distributed into your own abilities to enhance or modify them, both from being a Void-Child or into any other ability you possess, temporarily, but also naturally removes potency from the source they were stolen from. The energy slowly decays and returns to its source over a period of twenty-four hours, and once it is gone, any ability enhanced with it is returned to its original form, and will need to be actively enhanced or altered again. Dispossession, the final aspect of the Astrum populi is occupied with the ‘legacy’ of your others. The final sons of a terrible form of our universe, the Astrum found purchase in ‘judging’ the worthiness of other species' existence, developing in their new, kinder universe. Much like them, you can deny the birthright of your enemies, selectively pruning enemies of their gifts given by time worn fate or luck of birth. Once a month you can produce a star-seed, this can be used to perform two actions, either sending it out into the cosmos to find another person to become a Void-Child, or firing it directly into the target to force them to justify their existence. The victim must succeed in a clash of wills, in turn ‘justifying’ their place both in the universe, at least to the Astrum Populi’s metric. If they succeed, the Star-seed fizzles and dies, if they fail, it plants itself deeply inside of them, sapping away energy and strength, granting a permanent link to the Dissent, and a permanent source of energy to it.
objects.title: Astrum Populi

objects.text:
The Ornathi are a species of avian peoples native to the plane of Vaniterra, You’ve been given the three-part ability of their creation. Physically, the Ornithi come in a variety of forms & subspecies. When they reproduce, the calorie intake of the mother has radical effects on the resultant Ornathi’s body. Usually these are classified as distinct ‘forms’. Subspecies meanwhile, are denoted by resemblance to mundane avians, most commonly Owls, Ravens, Swans and Hummingbirds. The most commonly cited varieties of Ornithi are as follows;
  • Swav; Requiring the least caloric intake, The Swav are by far the smallest variety of Ornithi, looking like simple mundane birds. Due to the nature of the Ornithi, the Swav exploded in proportional population when food became scarce, contributing to a lack of labor to farm food, exacerbating the issue.
  • Ravi; Appearing as mundane birds of supernatural size, the Ravi are the next lowest requirement of food, emerging in sizes varying from the size of a large toddler, to matching a fully grown human in height, and triple the wingspan.
  • Ome; The most common in the modern day, Ome are virtually indistinguishable from humans, often exploiting this resemblance by integrating with human communities on their home plane for better living standards.
  • Hesit; Heist are the second most common variety of Ornithi to be seen in the modern world, appearing much like the Ome, but with varying features that betray their origin. Often these take the forms of wings, feathers, talons and beaks. Even so, they still conform to human averages when not taking these into account.
  • Sverh; The Sverh are extremely rare, with very few confirmed cases known to exist in the modern day. Physically they appear to be akin to the Swav, as small birds, but actually are a large number of these ‘Swav’ like birds, comprising a full, intelligent, singular creature.
  • Elga; There are records of the Elga, but no modern examples to speak of. Supposedly, when in times of extreme abundance, the Elga are the final extreme of the Ornithi, composed of a mass of wings and eyes that nonetheless can see, manipulate objects, and possess great talent in Crystalic magics as if natural. It is believed these are distorted rumors and myths.
    • Though Ornithi age at a similar rate to humans, they demonstrate a natural aptitude for natural magics and physical learning akin to prodigies within these fields. That said, in anything sufficiently ‘esoteric’ such as various magical systems or the concept of mathematics, they’re no better than a Human.
    The first method of creating Ornithi is by consuming an internal energy well. This well refills excruciatingly slowly, with the energy required ranging massively with each Ornathi ‘type’. A Sverh would run your initial pool completely dry, while you could produce twenty Swavs before reaching the same point. This pool grows over time with use, but this is more akin to exercising a muscle. Similarly, Ornithi you create require 50% more energy (additively) per ‘simulated’ year of their life. The Second method of creating Ornithi is by making physical contact with another person, during which you may convert them into Ornithi rather than their previous species, though their type will be determined almost exclusively by the converted person’s physical wellbeing, though you can ‘angle’ towards one end of the spectrum. The Third method of creating Ornithi is by simply having children of your own, as any child you create will naturally be Ornithi of varying types relating to the nutrition of the mother, as is normal with Ornithi births. Ornithi you create are not under your direct control, instead being considered their own beings, though their maturity is largely dependent on their age at generation in the case of the first creation method, though they’re likely to see you in a parental manner unless they were actively converted into Ornithi through the second method.
objects.title: The Gift of Ornithi

objects.text:
You have become the ultimate fusion of dragon and human, blending raw draconic power with the adaptability and finesse of humanity. Your body carries the strength and grace of a dragon while maintaining your human form.

Your legs are shaped with powerful, digitigrade structure, enhancing your speed, balance, and agility. You can move at speeds exceeding 100 km/h on foot and leap over 20 meters in a single bound. Uneven terrain, vertical walls, and broken surfaces pose no obstacle.

A strong, fully prehensile tail extends from your spine, providing perfect balance and serving as a flexible limb. It can strike with the force of a sledgehammer, support your body weight, grasp with near-human dexterity, and act as a stabilizer or weapon in both movement and combat.

A pair of grand dragon wings can be summoned or dismissed at will. When present, they grant true flight, allowing you to soar at speeds up to 400 km/h and maneuver with high precision, capable of vertical takeoff, silent gliding, and diving at terminal velocity. In combat, your wings can buffet enemies or shield your body like plated armor.

Your face is marked with a sleek dragon snout that adds a sharp, dignified edge. Despite this, your voice remains clear, your words flowing easily. Horns curve elegantly from your skull, framing a mane of hair that falls in wild waves, enhancing your presence. Your eyes, glowing from within, reflect your strength and perception, allowing perfect night vision, thermal vision, and the ability to detect movement and energy signatures within a 300-meter radius.

Your body is shielded by tough, yet sensitive dragon scales that adapt and move with you. These scales can resist high-caliber firearms, withstand temperatures from -200°C to 2000°C, and absorb kinetic impacts equivalent to high-explosive charges (roughly building-level durability). Blades shatter or glance off; fire and lightning wash over you with minimal effect. Despite their toughness, your scales are flexible and responsive to touch.

Your hands retain a human-like shape but end in sharp, retractable claws—capable of tearing through reinforced steel and stone. They remain hidden until needed, unobtrusive in social situations and lethal in battle.

Your strength is immense, allowing you to lift and throw objects weighing up to 100 tons, punch through reinforced concrete, and create shockwaves with your strikes. You can easily overpower most mundane or supernatural creatures and match even high-tier superhuman beings in raw might.

Your body can withstand the harshest conditions—from surviving vacuum exposure and underwater pressure to enduring direct hits from anti-tank weapons. Falls from extreme heights, battlefield explosions, and high-speed collisions can injure but not kill you.

Your healing is swift and efficient. Moderate injuries close within minutes. Deep lacerations, organ damage, and shattered bones heal in under an hour. Lost limbs regenerate within 24 to 72 hours. You are immune to disease, poison, and most toxins; your metabolism burns them away within seconds.

Your senses are razor-sharp. You can hear heartbeats within 30 meters, detect scents across kilometers, and see clearly across long distances and total darkness. You can track movement at high speed, notice microscopic detail, and perceive energy fluctuations or magical auras.

Upon gaining this form, you can choose the color of your scales, eyes, and hair, shaping your appearance as you wish once. This form grows with you. As you train and adapt, your strength, senses, and abilities will evolve. Your wings will carry you farther, your strikes will become more precise, and your mastery of your draconic self will rise with experience. In time, you will stand as a true legend—a perfect balance of human will and draconic power.
objects.title: Dragonkin

objects.text:
You now possess the magic of those most mysterious and alluring creatures of the deep blue sea: the Merfolk. With this power, the entirety of the underwater depths becomes yours to explore.

Beneath the waves, as a Merfolk, your legs fluidly transform into the long, sinuous, scaly tail so commonly attributed to your kind. The water, in all its forms, becomes as breathable to you as the air above. Your body and senses instinctively attune to this submerged world, granting you the resilience to survive the crushing pressures of the deepest ocean trenches and the clarity to see within its dim light as clearly as day.

As a true creature of the sea, the ocean itself whispers its ancient secrets to you. You possess an innate ability to communicate with all its diverse denizens, and you intuitively grasp the complex dance of currents and tides, understanding how the weather shapes the very fabric of the ocean.

Your profound symbiosis with the ocean allows you to command water. While this power is most potent with the sea's own currents, any water will respond to your will. Initially, you may find yourself barely able to stir the water closest to you, but with practice and time, warping the tides on a grand scale or summoning colossal Tsunamis will be well within your grasp.

Your voice, to many who hear it, will be the sweetest sound imaginable, capable of moving hearts and bringing men to tears. With time, its melodic power will resonate across the waves themselves.

But even with such power, a lonely existence awaits if you are all by yourself in the vast emptiness of the ocean. Therefore, the sea bestows upon you these final, precious gifts. First, you can grant another the ability to breathe and survive within the ocean's depths. And second, when the moon is full and the tides are high, you possess the extraordinary power to bestow all the abilities of the Merfolk upon anyone you choose within the sea.
objects.title: Child of the Sea

objects.text:
You are no longer a human, but a Sintelic. The Sintelics are a sapient species native to the oceanic world of Elyria, located in the circumbinary habitable zone of the Trinity Prime system. As of the modern interstellar era, the Sintelics are a core member species of the Federation of Worlds, aka the Xeno Alliance by their enemies.

Physically, Sintelics are tall, tripedal beings, standing around 2.1 meters and weighing between 130 and 155 kilograms. Instead of two legs like humans, they have three lower limbs arranged radially in a triangular base, giving them excellent balance and allowing stable movement over unstable or wet terrain. Each foot ends in three wide, gripping toes. A thick muscular tail, about 1.2 meters long, extends behind them, acting as a counterbalance when walking. Above the pelvis are two long, multi-jointed arms with six fingers each — five arranged radially and one opposable. These hands are highly dexterous, capable of delicate and complex manipulation. Sintelic musculature is denser than a human’s, and their overall strength is about 25–30% greater than that of a human of equivalent mass.

Their skin is smooth and covered in active chromatophores — pigment cells that can change color in patterns and pulses under neural control. These are most concentrated along the arms, chest, neck, and face. When engaged in communication, emotion, or other states, their chromatophores flash in color pulses up to 15 times per second. These flashes can express emotional states (anger, attraction, fear), emphasis in speech, or even structured syntax. With training, it can be used for camouflage. Sintelics also regulate body temperature and light absorption through these cells. Their large, elongated eyes are horizontally stretched and contain four types of photoreceptor cones, enabling tetrachromatic vision. They can perceive wavelengths from near-ultraviolet up near-infrared.

Sintelics possess a tripartite brain. It is distributed in three major lobes. The upper dorsal brain is responsible for logic, memory, and problem-solving, similar in function to the human neocortex. The ventral “empathy ring” — a thick, circular band of neural tissue running around the upper spinal column — processes social signals, emotional tone, and group resonance, allowing them to interpret subtle cues in body movement, vocal sound, and skin flashing, making them pseudo-empaths and master cold readers. A third lobe, located in a hardened cranial plate between the shoulders, is called the spatial-resonant module. It specializes in interpreting vibration, low-frequency sound, and ambient environmental signals. This part of the brain gives Sintelics the ability to detect subtle harmonic patterns in their surroundings — in air, ground, or water — and plays a key role in their highly developed spatial reasoning.

Fundamental to Sintelic cognition is an innate sense of rhythm. Their nervous systems are tuned not merely to detect sound or light, but to resolve sequences of change over time — patterns in waves, pulses, oscillations, and frequencies. This rhythm sensitivity is embedded at both the sensory and cortical levels, allowing them to perceive time not as a linear abstraction but as a field of fluctuating cycles. They can rapidly detect resonant frequencies in their environment — from the oscillation of a structural beam to the breathing pattern of a living creature — and instinctively synchronize with it. This makes them exceptionally good at harmonic alignment. For example, their movement and reflexes are rhythm-locked, allowing them to move in perfect coordination with their environment. They can cross unstable terrain by stepping in sync with shifting ground or dodge hazards by “feeling” its movement rhythm before it fully executes. This, paired with their cold reading, gives them what can easily be mistaken for precognition.
objects.title: Sintelics

objects.text:
Born in the hollow shell of Nytharion—a supermassive, naturally formed planet with the mass of 100 Jupiters and a self-sustained fusion core at its heart—you have become a Golgari, an apex evolutionary product of one of the most extreme environments in the known galaxy. The Golgari are known as one of the hardiest and most formidable species in the Federation of Worlds.

Standing at 10 meters in height and weighing 70 metric tons, Golgarians possess a towering bipedal frame optimized for balance and power. Their body is sheathed in a crystalline-ceramic skin. Beneath this armored epidermis lies a hybrid skeletal framework consisting of an endoskeleton fused with external bracing ridges that act as shock absorbers during movement and blunt-force impacts, allowing Golgari to survive violent collisions and EM shockwaves. Their muscular structure grants them strength to lift over 50 times their body weight and resist extreme G-forces. Their circulatory system relies on synchronized peristaltic contractions in ferrofluidic vascular channels, which use magnetically charged plasma to transport nutrients and bioelectric signals throughout the body.

Beneath their crystalline-ceramic skin, networks of magnetically charged ferrofluid pulse in rhythm with their movements, allowing them to sense and subtly influence electromagnetic and pressure fields. Their neurons fire through magnetically amplified ion channels, enabling them to generate controlled EM emissions through tactile interaction with matter. This allows them to reroute energy flows, disrupt nearby electronics and fracture stone by shifting internal stresses. This ability grow with time and experience. With enough mastery, some Golgari have been known to release concentrated arcs of electromagnetic energy—effectively discharging lightning from their hands. 

Golgari are able to perceive across the UV, visible, IR, and soft X-ray spectra. They possess a magnetoreception, mapping magnetic field lines in real-time across kilometers, granting them what is effectively a sixth sense. Their base hearing is no better than a humans but is augmented by infrasound reception, able to detect seismic-level vibrations from hundreds of kilometers away.

Cognitively, the Golgari are tri-lobed entities, with their primary brain housed within a thoracic vault. Two sub-brains reside in their lower spinal region and abdomen, allowing for distributed reflex processing and local control of limbs. Their neurons function via magnetically amplified ion channels, enabling near-instantaneous signal transmission and communication through pulsed EM emissions.

The Golgari are immune to most ionizing radiation levels and their bodies contain regenerative nanocyte clusters that allow for limited self-repair of both soft tissue and dermal armor. Most notable is their ability to enter a temporary stasis when deprived of electromagnetic energy, preserving cellular integrity for decades until reactivation is possible. Golgari are biologically resistant to thermal extremes between −200°C to over 800°C and can withstand vacuum for extended periods by sealing their dermal ports. 

Outside of Nytharion, the Golgari exhibit minor physiological instability due to environmental mismatch. Their magneto-receptive neural systems become less precise in regions lacking strong or dynamic magnetic fields. Their reliance on ambient electromagnetic energy for optimal metabolic function causes a gradual decline in vitality under prolonged field deprivation, requiring artificial EM environments or charged plasma intake to maintain peak performance. Luckily there is no risk of any permanent damage or death, merely lower outputs.
objects.title: Golgari

objects.text:
You are a Zhevan, a crystalline, resonance-based species. Their name is not their own, but a phonetic construction to approximate the first harmonic signature recorded in their presence: “Zhe-vaa-an”. Their true names were resonance chords, layered vibrations transmitted through mineral substrate and atmosphere. The Zhevan were once valued members of the Federation of Worlds. Their extinction was caused by the Coalition of Man’s geothermal strip-mining during the Resource Fronts.

The physical structure of a Zhevan appeared as a towering crystalline form. Most Zhevan stood between 3.2 and 6.5 meters tall. These structures were composed of an organic-silicon crystal lattice, doped with rare earth elements like neodymium, praseodymium, and lanthanum. Protrusions—ribbed vanes, curled spines, or organ-like facets—emerged along their flanks and dorsal structures, acting as finely adjustable acoustic resonators.

Internally, Zhevans had no organs, circulatory system, or nervous system. Their “brain” was not centralized but distributed throughout their crystalline mass. Layered photonic waveguides within the lattice allowed for both high-speed signal routing and parallel computation, analogous to a quantum optical neural net. Certain deep core layers acted as memory storage, using stable interference nodes to encode long-term information, while outer strata served as reactive computational shells that constantly adjusted to environmental input.

Resonance was everything to the Zhevan. Perception, communication, computation, locomotion, and defense were all mediated through harmonic manipulation. They emitted a broad spectrum of finely controlled acoustic and electromagnetic waves, using them to analyze their environment. Their echolocation extended across low-frequency seismic pulses, mid-range acoustic scans, and high-frequency terahertz signals, allowing them to “see” through rock, metal, and atmosphere with extraordinary detail.

Offensively, they could emit highly tuned vibrations capable of exciting the resonant frequency of a structure or material, causing it to fracture or even disintegrate, able to calculate near instantly the needed frequencies. In defensive roles, they could nullify the energy of attacks, cancelling them through destructive interference. They were also capable of localized levitation and crushing forces through acoustic radiation pressure and field modulation. Similarly, they could manipulate local magnetic fields, allowing for remote activation or disruption of devices and shielding.

Zhevan derived energy from geothermal gradients. The base of their body included massive basal plates and spines which channeled heat. As long as geothermal energy flowed and structural damage was avoided, a Zhevan could persist for millennia. However, their unique biology came with vulnerabilities. The most immediate danger was disconnection from geothermal sources; even a few days without energy input would initiate computational slowdown and, eventually, a form of dormancy from which they could not awaken without external reactivation. Worse still, the loss of resonance integrity—caused by damage to internal crystalline pathways—could lead to fragmentation of memory and identity. Lastly, while they could solve complex equations within picoseconds, abstract reasoning or creativity required reconfiguration, making philosophical or strategic thought an hours-long process.
objects.title: Zhevan

objects.text:
You have become a Nith’Raal. The Nith’Raal hail from the dark, drifting planet Aeluun-5, a rogue ice world cast out from its original solar orbit eons ago. Nith’Raal are isolationist, and while they have dealings with the Federation of Worlds, they tend to keep to their own homeworld.

The Nith’Raal are long, sinuous beings, measuring up to 2.5 meters in length, with a semi-rigid central body and fifteen radial appendages extending from a midsection ring. Their skin is composed of a flexible nitrile-ceramide matrix that resists both pressure and crystallization. Their limbs are highly articulate and end in trifurcated pads equipped with micro-suction cups and chemical receptors.

Internally, the Nith’Raal lack centralized organs; instead, they possess a distributed biological architecture, with redundant organ clusters spaced throughout the body. Their memory is not encoded chemically as in humans, but physically, within crystalline lattices known as crystocytes—silicon-based nodes embedded throughout their tissue, particularly near their core. These crystals resonate with neural frequencies, storing memory as organized vibrations and structural patterns. As they matures, these crystals grow, allowing for long-term recall that can span centuries.

Their respiration and metabolism rely on redox reactions between nitrate and sulfide ions absorbed from hydrothermal plumes. They can go months without active feeding, subsisting instead on stored molecular charge and environmental scavenging.

The Nith’Raal possess no eyes, but perceive the world with an integrated suite of electroreceptors, chemoreceptors, and cryotactic sensors. Chemoreception is hyper-advanced—they can detect minute molecular trails, using them to analyse and and infer an organism’s health, age, and intent. Their cryotactic sense allows them to “see” by measuring thermal absence: the way heat flees objects and pressure shifts influence surrounding cold, granting them a detailed perception of their surroundings even in complete darkness.

The Nith’Raal can extrude a nitrogen-based gel from glands embedded in their limbs, which instantly hardens into crystalline structures when exposed to cold currents. This allows them to construct defensive barriers, sharp weapons, or intricate latticeworks for sound resonance or communication. When threatened, they can also release a sudden burst of supercooled volatile ammonia that flash-freezes the surrounding water, creating instant cover or freezing smaller threats solid.

Outside of their native world, the  Nith’Raal suffers biological vulnerabilities. Their nitrogen-silicon biochemistry is highly unstable in warmer, oxygen-rich environments; exposure to temperatures above −50°C begins to unravel their cellular membranes, while oxygen acts as a corrosive agent, rapidly degrading their nitrile tissues and neural crystocytes. Their internal systems rely on dense pressure and liquid ammonia; in Earth-like atmospheres, they desiccate, lose chemical cohesion, and suffer catastrophic thermal stress.

To survive in Earth-like environments, you are given a specialized exosuit that replicates the cold, high-pressure conditions of the Nith’Raal homeworld. While functional, the suit limits Nith’Raal’s natural mobility and sensory range, making them slower and more withdrawn outside their native environment.
objects.title: Nith’Raal

objects.text:
You have become a Morphonte. Feared and revered in equal measure, Morphontes are one of the most enigmatic species within the Federation of Worlds. Their reputation hinges not on power or technology, but on their terrifying mutability—each individual can become a different being entirely, in form, mind, and function.

Morphontes have no fixed adult appearance. At birth, they present as soft-boned bipedal neutrals: hairless, gray-skinned, sexless, and with symmetrical features and minimal organ specialization. All extremities are rudimentary and modular—limbs consist of multicompartmental musculature and digitless manipulators that can split or fuse, depending on the morph. Skin texture and color are phenotypically passive, adapting to environmental variables but lacking any consistent pigmentation unless a morph is triggered. Eyes remain fluid in hue and reflective density, suggesting an adaptive visual system in flux.

Internally, Morphontes possess a distributed organ system with several redundant and partially differentiated clusters. Organs form, dissolve, or rearrange during transformation. Key to their biology are pluripotent cell reservoirs located in marrow, mesentery, and along the central nervous axis. These function as active stem-cell engines, capable of rapid differentiation during transformation phases. 

Morphontes have a unique kind of DNA made of layered gene-circuits called morphic channels. Each channel holds the complete blueprint for a different body form, including physical traits, brain wiring, hormones, and behavior. These blueprints get activated only when the Morphonte undergoes a deep, irreversible shift in self-identity, detected by a brain region called the transmorphic lobe.

Once triggered, a powerful hormonal surge begins a full-body transformation: the body breaks itself down and rebuilds entirely into the new form. While core memories are preserved in protected brain areas, their emotional tone may change. Each new form has different strengths, some get sharper senses, healing abilities, or become able to survive in a vacuum, hyper-specialized for specific roles.

Beyond full transformations, Morphontes constantly adapt in smaller ways. Their bodies subtly shift based on emotions, beliefs, needs, or even expectations. These “soft changes” can affect skin, voice, posture, pain sensitivity, scent, or hormone levels. Even things like cultural pressure or a fight-or-flight moment can trigger these shifts within minutes.

However, full transformations are incredibly draining. They leave the body vulnerable, requiring massive energy and rest, and carry a high risk of error. If a Morphonte has a fractured sense of self, such as like inner conflict or trauma, they can suffer cascade morphs: a chain of unstable transformations that damage the body and mind.
objects.title: Morphontes

objects.text:
You are now a Thalassid. The Thalassids are one of the members of the Federation of Worlds, known for their utility in amphibious warfare, underwater construction, and hazardous environment exploration. They maintain a reputation as reliable laborers, scouts, and shock troops in both military and civilian Federation infrastructure.

Thalassids have a humanoid shape but are covered in a thick orange exoskeleton made from a composite of chitin and calcium carbonate. Their outer shell is naturally resistant to physical damage, allowing them to withstand blunt trauma, small-caliber ballistic fire, and moderate cutting weapons. They can survive pressure at depths up to 400 meters and tolerate exposure to acidic environments for short periods. Their four arms include two primary arms from the shoulders with six fingers each, two of which are opposable, and two smaller secondary arms from the waist with four non-opposable fingers each. Their head is connected directly to their torso, encased in the same exoskeletal armor, leaving no visible neck.

Thalassids have a high-density muscle structure capable of lifting up to 400 kilograms under Earth-like gravity, with short bursts of force capable of breaking stone and denting, or with extreme effort tearing, metal. Their musculature uses a combination of hydraulic pressure and direct fiber contraction. They have multiple hearts and a semi-open circulatory system using hemocyanin-based blood, allowing them to maintain strength even in low-oxygen environments. Their endurance is limited by their need to molt periodically; failure to do so causes systemic collapse. However, between molts, they are capable of sustained physical labor and high-impact combat performance for extended durations.

Thalassids possess decentralised nervous systems, with a central brain and multiple ganglia clusters that allow limb-level processing. Their upper limbs can operate semi-independently, improving multitasking and combat effectiveness. They are capable of both precise manipulation and brute-force exertion, depending on the task.

Thalassids breathe through both gills and spiracles. They can operate underwater indefinitely and on land for as long as ambient humidity is sufficient. To survive in dry environments, they possess internal sacs that store spare water, which they use to both hydrate their tissues and cool their body. These reserves allow them to function on dry land for extended periods without external moisture, though prolonged arid exposure will eventually drain their internal supply. 

Their electroreception organs, based in the face and antennae, give them a 15-meter range of passive electrical field detection, allowing them to track living creatures and navigate in total darkness. Their compound eyes offer wide-angle vision and can perceive ultraviolet light. Their tongue functions as a piercing, tubular organ capable of shooting outward up to 20 centimetres, used to impale and extract fluids from prey. Mandibles on either side of the tongue are capable of slicing or crushing matter, allowing them to feed on both soft and armored organisms.

Thalassids do not age in the conventional sense; instead, they continue growing slowly over time. While molting slows drastically with age, eventually they fail to successfully molt due to accumulated metabolic inefficiencies or environmental stress, which leads to death. Even then, they general live up to 200 years minimum before such failures.
objects.title: Thalassids

objects.text:
You are a Noxraptora — one of the apex predators of Zethas, a planet of lightless fungal labyrinths and deep subsurface biomes. While most Noxraptora exhibit intelligence equivalent to Earth’s corvids or chimpanzees, there are multiple exemptions, you being one of them. Noxraptoras are see as dangerous predators by the Federation of Worlds, being quarantined to their home planet.

Your true body stands at 2.4 meters when fully extended, though in most situations you remain partially folded, appearing far smaller. The entire outer surface is made of rigid, articulated plates of carbon-rich biomineral — visually similar to obsidian but textured like volcanic glass. These plates are pointed at the limbs and joints, tapering into spines and spikes. When required, you can compress your body to less than 20% of its length, limbs tucked within overlapping torso plates.

Your internal anatomy is concentrated within a narrow, ribcage-like thoracic vault. Unlike vertebrates, your ribcage is formed from overlapping, living plates which flex subtly to accommodate movement and damage. Within this cavity floats a yellow membrane sac, semi-transparent and filled with compound molecules that double as fuel and signaling chemicals. All organs are embedded in this membrane. Wounds to your core are lethal, but extremely rare as they must bypass your armored folding and deceptive exterior first.

Your muscular-hydraulic system allows you to transition from stillness to full extension in under 0.2 seconds, unleashing explosive kinetic bursts — enough to pierce chitin plating or snap a half-meter-thick fungal stalk with your forelimbs. A single uncoiled leap can clear 7 meters horizontally, and 3 vertically. Your body produces a venom that paralyzes prey, enzymatically liquefying their soft tissue to allow feeding via hooked mandibles and a prehensile tongue. This way, a medium-sized organism can be consumed in under an hour.

Though you lack traditional flesh, you have a specialized dorsal organ that can extrude and chemically program pseudotissue — a soft, pliable mimic layer formed from protein-based polymers and living microbial colonies. With this, you fabricate entire false bodies over your skeletal frame, generally when you are compressed, allowing you to shapeshift. The pseudotissue is purely cosmetic but it provides convincing texture, smell, and silhouette. It can however cause the uncanny valley effect, especially by social creatures. You can incorporate real biological components — skin, fur, chitin — harvested from killed prey. The pseudotissues chemically treats them to preserve decay and integrate them seamlessly into your false form using a series of anchoring tendrils that extrude from the armor seams of your folded form.

Your vocal chamber is divided into three independent segments, each capable of generating distinct harmonics. You can precisely replicate known environmental sounds, warning calls, or the speech patterns of intelligent species — if exposed long enough. You learn mimicked vocalizations by ear, storing the resonance patterns in layered inner-ear nodes lined with tunable hairs. Within an hour of listening, you can simulate vocalizations well enough to fool even experienced animals or sentient beings.

You see via a mix of low-frequency infrared and subtle pressure wave detection. Your “eyes” are recessed nodules tuned to thermal gradients and atmospheric disturbances — you detect motion and temperature, not color. This makes you nearly impossible to blind or trick with visual illusions. You can sense prey heartbeat at up to 3 meters through walls made of porous biomass. Your olfactory organs are chemical readers; you track not by scent, but by reading airborne molecular decay chains — your environment is a chemical map of everything that has died, lived, or bled nearby.
objects.title: Noxraptora

addons.text:
Descended from Murrh who became trapped in Nytharion’s deep wells, reshaped by millennia of selective pressure and Golgari symbiosis, you are a Golurh, a lineage fused predatory instinct with magneto-crystalline resilience.

Standing over thirty meters in length with wingspans exceeding one hundred meters, Golurh are giants even among giants. Their frames retain the powerful reptilian-theropod foundation of their Murrh ancestry, but every surface is sheathed in crystalline-ceramic armor grown from layered dermal plates. Their reinforced hybrid skeleton blends the hollow efficiency of avian air-bones with Golgari-style external ridges, forming a lattice that disperses both gravitational stress and electromagnetic recoil.

At the core of their adaptation lies a vaulted structure nested along the thoracic spine. This organ projects a superconductive electromagnetic field that partially counteracts the Golurh’s immense mass, allowing them to lift their own body with little to no metabolic strain. In flight, this field couples with their wing strokes to generate lift and drag manipulation far beyond atmospheric norms. By charging their superconductive neural pathways, they can railgun themselves forward in sudden bursts, accelerating in straight lines at velocities no biological flyer could otherwise achieve.

Golurh perceive across ultraviolet, visible, infrared, and soft X-ray bands, their crystalline lenses filtering harmful radiation into usable sensory input. Magnetoreception inherited from the Golgari has expanded into kilometer-scale electromagnetic mapping, granting real-time navigation through planetary fields and even low-orbit trajectories. Their infrasound sensitivity allows them to track tectonic activity, while retained heat-pits in the jaws and wing membranes read thermal gradients and atmospheric currents.

Their circulatory system is a ferrofluidic lattice, charged with magnetically amplified plasma that synchronizes both nutrient flow and EM conduction. Neurons threaded with superconductive filaments fire in cascades, enabling both lightning-speed reflexes and controlled electromagnetic discharge. Even young Golurh are capable of venting arcs of plasma. In space, they reorient and accelerate by shaping their own electromagnetic sheath against planetary fields, turning their entire body into a living coilgun.

For survival, Golurh have merged the hibernation strategies of both ancestors. They secrete a stone-ceramic cocoon like the Murrh, while simultaneously entering Golgari stasis, halting cellular decay. Within this double-layered shell, they are nearly impervious to cosmic radiation, geothermal extremes, or micrometeor impacts. They can lie dormant for centuries, drawing a trickle of energy from ambient cosmic rays and planetary fields until reawakening.

Yet this hybrid form bears its own limits. Even now, they are still inferior to proper spacecrafts. Their railgun propulsion, while devastating in short arcs, is inefficient for sustained interstellar migration, forcing them to combine ballistic bursts with long hibernation drifts.
addons.title: Golurh

objects.text:
Born in the violent dawn of the cosmos, seeded on the unstable worlds that formed in the aftermath of quasi-stars, you are a Murrh, one of the oldest great predators to ever evolve.

Measuring twenty-five to thirty meters in length with wingspans of eighty to one hundred meters, your frame is a fusion of reptilian and theropod traits: deep chest anchoring colossal flight muscles, powerful hindlimbs for quadrupedal vaulting launches, a stiffened tail for steering, and a crocodilian skull lined with serrated teeth. Your wings are supported by elongated digits and clawed thumbs, while your body is sheathed in thick leathery hide and overlapping scales.

You possess three sets of eyes; forward-facing for depth perception, lateral for panoramic awareness, and a tertiary set tuned to ultraviolet and polarized light. You analyze chemical traces in the air through a Jacobson’s organ analog, while pressure-sensitive ridges on your skull register barometric shifts. Heat-sensitive pits across your jaws and wing membranes allow you to read thermals and wind currents with precision, ensuring efficient long-distance soaring.

A unidirectional, bird-like lung structure feeds into a reinforced network of hollow, air-sac-filled bones, forming an internal system of pressurized reservoirs. Within these chambers, inert gases are compressed to extreme densities, while reactive gases are sequestered in separate sacs, mixed and ignited only when thrust is required. These can be vented in precise pulses for fine maneuvering or discharged in explosive rocket-like bursts.

At lower altitudes, the compressed gases act like living jet-thrusters, while at high altitude the mixture transitions into controlled combustion, propelling you into near-orbital arcs capable of breaking through the atmosphere. Skin-assisted gas exchange and buoyancy sacs lighten your massive body, enabling efficient soaring, high-altitude flight, and limited orbital maneuvers.

Your body’s layered metabolism and ultra-efficient digestion lets you draw on phosphagen, glycogen-like polymers, fat, and hydrocarbon reserves. One massive kill can sustain you for months, supporting long migrations or extended torpor.

Instead of sleep, your body hibernates. In torpor, your body secretes a stone-like cocoon that insulates, camouflages, and conducts geothermal heat to trickle-charge your metabolism for decades or centuries. When you awaken, the cocoon is shattered by sheer muscular force, leaving fractured stone husks in your wake.

Your body is also made for space travel, being innately radiation-resistant, your tissues shielded by pigments and your DNA reinforced by redundant repair systems. Your stone-secretion cocoon functions in vacuum as well as on land, insulating against temperature extremes, dispersing radiation, and resisting micrometeor impacts. Within, you can hibernate indefinitely, drawing energy slowly from cosmic rays that saturate your body. Your hollow bone reservoirs and air sacs double as maneuvering systems in space, venting compressed gases to adjust course.

Yet here lies your greatest weakness. Space travel for your kind is not true flight but drift. Even with atmosphere-breaking thrust, once free of gravity’s pull you are unbearably slow in the void, dependent on momentum and patience, your migrations measured not in years but in millennia. You cannot achieve faster-than-light travel or even chemical-rocketry velocities, but instead ride gravity wells, hitchhike on asteroids, and wait.
objects.title: Murrh

addons.text:
You aren’t a normal Amazonian. You are from a splinter sect known as the Disciples of Varkhala—a militant order so extreme in its devotion to war that even the hardened tribes of Thal’Serra speak of them with unease. Among the Amazonians, where strength is revered and battle is sacred, Varkhala stands apart. They are not warriors in the traditional sense. They are war made flesh—disciples of violence, fanatics of combat, who believe that the highest purpose of existence is to fight, and to die fighting.

Varkhala takes infants from bloodlines tested for endurance and ferocity, raises them in stone temples deep within the Nirakal Spines, and burns all trace of identity from them. No names. No family. No past. You are stripped of everything but your body, your mind, and the path of the Sharuun Doctrine—the sacred scripture of Varkhala. To live is to train. To breathe is to prepare. To kill is to worship.

Your training eclipses even the brutal rites of traditional Amazonian war schools. While others train for mastery, you train for obliteration. You are drilled day and night, your muscles broken and rebuilt, your nerves hardened, your bones tested in ritual fractures.
