You spar with real blades, fight against starvation, and meditate in agony. Every waking moment is shaped toward a singular ideal: perfection in combat, at the cost of all else.
addons.title: Disciples of Varkhala

objects.text:
From the blood-soaked jungles of Thal’Serra comes a race built for war—engineered by ancient, forgotten forces. Amazonians may appear human—tall, lean, striking—but beneath the skin lies something far more formidable. Your bones are dense and fracture-resistant; your muscles fiber-rich and capable of explosive force without fatigue. Your reflexes operate at heightened thresholds, processing motion faster than the human eye can track.

You heal faster. Scars fade quickly. Your immune system adapts to poisons, venoms, and pathogens beyond scientific explanation. Your senses—especially sight and hearing—are sharpened for combat: tracking a blade mid-swing or detecting the shift of a footfall behind you. Most Amazonian children are born female, though males are not unknown.

Your kind does not die easily, nor age like others. While humans wither, Amazonians remain in peak condition for centuries. But longevity brings expectation. Life is not idle. From the moment they can walk, children train in blade, spear, and fist. By adolescence, they’ve survived trials meant to kill the weak and forge the strong.

You are forged by this crucible—a master of war. You are trained in both Yalara—the dual-spear style that overwhelms squads with speed and flanking strikes—and in Kherak-din—the shieldless art of turning blocks into kills and parries into dislocations. You've trained blindfolded, underwater, in silence. Battle is as instinctive as breath.

While Amazonians are known to revere the wilderness, your connection to the land is not mystical, but practical. You use it as a weapon. You’ve been trained to track through the thickest foliage, ambush from the trees, and fight in the suffocating heat and murk that would cripple lesser warriors. Survival is part of the curriculum. You know which roots nourish and which ones kill. You’ve drunk rain from your own palms and slept with one eye open beneath predator-haunted boughs.

You are a weapon—refined, sharpened, and unbreakable. You carry with you the honor and fury of a warrior society that has never known conquest. In a world of armies, you are an army. In a world of soldiers, you are a legend.
objects.title: Amazonian

objects.text:
You possess a physique similar to the Forgotten Human King, a ruler who pursued the fundamental, primal strength beyond civilization.

This physique means that your biological development was perfectly set up from birth for peak performance. This optimal growth was achieved because key developmental chemical messengers, such as those controlling growth and cell production, were naturally supercharged and perfectly balanced throughout your maturation. This chemical priming resulted in a physical baseline far exceeding natural limits: your bones are structurally denser, your muscle fibers possess unparalleled contractile quality, and even your organ systems operate with flawless, inhuman efficiency.

You also have total and instant control over the production and release of every single chemical messenger within your internal factory. You can fine-tune your internal chemistry to achieve temporary biological supremacy: for instance, you can instantly flood your system with a perfect mix of energy chemicals like Adrenaline to achieve a state of "Super-Focus" where you can react faster than any animal, seeing fast events almost in slow motion. Conversely, you can instantly turn off stress and pain chemicals like Cortisol to ignore catastrophic injuries, so you can keep fighting even with broken bones. Furthermore, you can boost chemicals for red blood cells and muscle growth, allowing you to rapidly fill your blood with extra oxygen for an effective maximum speed and endurance that could sustain Olympic marathoner performance for days straight without getting tired, or immediately start fixing severe muscle damage after intense exertion. You also gain perfect command over the scent signals released externally by adjusting them internally, allowing you to precisely adjust the type and amount of chemicals you emit.

As your skill improves, your body evolves to synthesize Super Hormones, specialized molecules that are much stronger and work better on cells than their natural counterparts. These specialized internal chemicals exponentially boost your capabilities beyond what the natural messengers can do. For instance, a powerful version of your growth hormone can grant controlled, localized bursts of cell growth, potentially accelerating the healing of a torn organ or a deep cut in hours instead of weeks, as long as your body has food and nutrients to build with. Another could amplify muscle contraction efficiency to such an extreme degree that you can effortlessly shatter concrete with a single strike, far beyond the limits of simply maximizing natural Adrenaline. These Super Hormones will also continue to optimise and improve your growth and body.

The primary limitation of this power is that you are still bound by the basic rules of physics: you can't make something from nothing. Activating high-concentration hormone states forces your body into a huge energy debt. Utilizing a Super-Adrenaline burst that grants peak strength and speed comparable to lifting a small sedan, for example, will burn your energy so fast that you'll immediately suffer from crippling low blood sugar and totally worn-out muscles afterward, equivalent to several hours of constant exertion compressed into minutes.
objects.title: Inner Body Strength

addons.text:
Child of War— That is what they called you, superhuman even as a “mundane” human. Your body is built to kill and is resistant to the very concept of death itself.

Anything you can possibly survive, reality seems to bend itself so that you do—within reason. For example, if you are supposed to be beheaded, your head will remain just attached enough to keep you alive, allowing you to do your best impression of the Saint Denis of Paris.

Upon seeing any martial art, you instantly know how to perform it. Within 2 to 6 hours, the martial art will have adapted itself to perfectly suit your physique.

Within 3 to 5 days of intense training, your martial arts skill reaches superhuman levels: a standard haymaker, even as a “mundane” human, would tear through a plate of steel.

For magical or power-based martial arts, if you lack the natural ability required to use it, your mind automatically replaces the missing component with the closest possible alternative. The further your mind has to reach, the longer the adaptation takes.

For example, you could easily recreate Bakugou’s explosion-based combat style from My Hero Academia using firebending from Avatar: The Last Airbender, whereas it might take a week of intense training if you used waterbending instead.
addons.title: Genius Child of War

objects.text:
You were born different. You didn’t train to be strong — you always were. From the moment you could stand, your body was a weapon: a precision-built engine of muscle, bone, and instinct. You are a human predator, a creature of raw biology pushed to the absolute limit. While others strive to reach their peak, you are their peak.

Your skeleton is brutally overbuilt — thicker than steel pipes, dense enough to resist trauma that would reduce others to pulp. Your blood runs thick with hormones — growth factors and aggression-fueled chemistry. Your skin is thicker, tougher — almost leathered, capable of shrugging off cuts and scrapes that would leave others bleeding. Your muscle borders on unnatural: heavy, fast-contracting, biologically optimized for raw power. You generate force far beyond human norms: a casual, untrained punch can dent metal siding or send a grown man flying, and a full-force strike can leave small holes in concrete. You can deadlift engine blocks, leap over cars, or crack walls with a well-planted stomp.

Your nervous system fires faster than thought. Your reflexes are driven by a limbic system that dominates your mental architecture, with balance as second nature, and your proprioception being unnervingly accurate. You react to motion before it registers consciously — dodging projectiles, catching thrown blades midair, or slipping through tight combat spaces with acrobatic ease. You learn physical movement — martial arts, acrobatics, fine motor tasks — in a fraction of the time it takes others, and will find yourself extraordinarily talented in using such skills.
objects.title: War Born

objects.text:
You possess a rare genetic anomaly that causes your body to grow continuously, with no natural cap on your potential size. Unlike normal growth, which halts after puberty, your physiology is permanently locked into a heightened anabolic state. This is akin to experiencing the most beneficial aspects of puberty, indefinitely. The only true limiter of your size is your caloric intake. Your mass is directly proportional to how much food you consume. Eat more, and you grow. Eat less, and you shrink. Your body scales accordingly, with perfect proportionality, adapting its entire internal architecture such as your muscles, bones, organs, and even your nervous system, to whatever size you achieve. 

At average human height, you possess ordinary human strength. However, as you grow, your strength scales exponentially. At twelve feet tall, your strength increases eightfold, allowing you to lift over 1,200 pounds with ease, smash through barriers, and leap significant distances. At twenty feet, your power is roughly twenty-seven times that of a normal human. You can throw cars, rip trees out of the ground, and punch through reinforced concrete. At fifty feet, your strength reaches over 200 times the human norm. You can toss military vehicles, bend steel girders, and cause small quakes just by stomping.

You are not bound by the square-cube law. Additionally, your endurance, stamina, and durability remain perfectly balanced with your size. Your skin thickens proportionally, your blood vessels expand, and your internal organs increase in output and efficiency. You maintain full cognitive function and coordination, regardless of how massive you become. Even your senses adapt, sharpening with size to prevent sensory dulling. You can see and hear with clarity over greater distances, and your reflexes remain intact no matter how big your limbs become. 

Your caloric requirements are vast and scale directly with your size. At six feet tall, maintaining your baseline physique requires around 2,500 to 3,000 calories a day, typical for a healthy adult. At twelve feet, you need roughly 20,000 calories daily. At twenty feet, you’re consuming close to 55,000 calories a day. At fifty feet, you require over 400,000 daily calories to maintain equilibrium. At one hundred feet, you need well over 2 million calories per day. Falling short of your daily intake causes your body to downscale, gradually reducing your mass until your energy needs are once again balanced with your consumption. Sudden deficiencies can trigger abrupt reductions in size as your body reallocates energy to preserve function.

Fortunately, your metabolism is built for this. You process food with incredible efficiency, extracting nearly every usable calorie from whatever you consume. Your digestive system is optimized for speed and adaptability; raw meat, fat, carbohydrates, oils, your body uses it all. You can consume food in quantities and densities that would kill an ordinary human, and your stomach adjusts to accommodate the volume.

Alongside this immense physical power comes a powerful regenerative system. Your body can heal from almost any injury, from broken bones and lost teeth to severed limbs and organ failure. This healing is rapid and efficient, though it is not free. Every act of regeneration draws directly from your caloric reserves. Losing an arm, for example, might cost tens of thousands of calories to regenerate at human size. At larger sizes, that cost rises exponentially. If you don’t have the energy to sustain such a repair, your body will begin to consume its own mass, shrinking slightly to compensate.
objects.title: Natural Born Giant

addons.text:
Your Titan Aspect is fully awakened and bound to the sea and the storm. You are Oceanborn, a half-Titan whose dominion fuses water, lightning, wind, sound, and pressure into one unified system.

In human form, you command water on the smallest scales, altering density, pressure, and flow with precision. Lightning travels through that water without losing potency, electrifying everything submerged under your control. Each strike generates concussive shockwaves, carried by water and air alike. Wind and sound bend to you instinctively, granting aerial mobility, sonic perception, and the ability to stagger enemies with pressure alone. Submersion grants amplified strength and healing, while storms energize you, accelerating both recovery and evolution.

The sea itself recognizes you as kin. Waves turn in your favor, tides rise or calm at your will, saltwater freshens at your touch, and marine life instinctively serves you. Radiation still fuels your growth, but storms and oceans now do the same — immersion in lightning storms or ocean depths restores stamina, heals wounds, and forces adaptation.

As your Titan heritage scales, so does your reach. Ponds become oceans under your command, thunderstorms grow into typhoons, and with enough training and radiation, you gain the ability to shift regional climates. Your hybrid storms drain energy from everything caught inside them, replenishing your reserves while wearing down enemies and structures.

In Kaiju Form, your colossal body becomes a living storm system: ridges crackling with electricity, scales glowing like bioluminescent currents, your aura cloaked in permanent rain, thunder, and pressure waves. Each step shakes the earth, each roar blasts like a sonic weapon. You are amphibious, equally suited for ocean depths, land, and air when carried by storm currents. Armies shatter before you; Titans recognize you as both rival and sovereign.

You are not restricted to one shape. At will, you can remain in human guise, shift into a hybrid with partial Titan traits, or assume a full Kaiju body. Beyond that, you can modify these forms as you please — altering your appearance, features, or proportions to match your preference, without losing access to your powers. Whether human, hybrid, or colossal, you can always embody the form that best suits your will.

The Oceanborn Titan is more than an inheritor — it is a living embodiment of sea and storm. You are tide and lightning, current and gale, predator and sanctuary, and your dominion stretches wherever water and storm exist.
addons.title: Oceanborn Titan

objects.text:
You are the direct offspring of a Monsterverse Titan. Your existence is possible because Titans are not only apex predators but sovereign intelligences, capable of either taking human form to walk among mortals or creating life by giving a fragment of their essence. Whether you were born of union or essence, your body and soul carry the mark of the Kaiju. From birth you exist in two states: a human form that lets you pass among mortals, and a Titan inheritance that strengthens and evolves with time.

Even in your human state, you are far beyond mortal limits. Your muscles are ten times denser than a peak Olympic athlete’s, letting you lift several tons with effort and strike hard enough to crumple steel. Your bones are reinforced to the point they can withstand the impact of high-caliber gunfire or a multi-story fall without breaking. Your senses are sharpened to match apex predators: an eagle’s sight (able to see details at two miles), a wolf’s scent (able to track a trail across kilometers of shifting ground), and a bat’s echolocation-like hearing (able to pick out heartbeats or breathing in a crowded room).

Environmental extremes that would instantly kill a human—such as walking in the −100 °C cold of Antarctica, enduring 1,000 atmospheres of deep-sea trench pressure, or standing in volcanic vents hot enough to melt lead—barely challenge you. Injuries close within minutes to hours instead of weeks, infections cannot take hold, and venoms or toxins are burned out of your system within moments. Finally, you are immune to your parent’s dominion: if your parent rules nuclear fire, you stand unharmed at ground zero of a detonation; if abyssal pressure, you can walk uncrushed at any depth; if volcanic flame, molten lava parts around you; if stormborn lightning, megavolt discharges only empower you.

You may look human, but no weapon or environment built for humans can truly break you.

Your Titan heritage is not static; it scales with age. Where mortals grow weaker as they age, your blood only pushes you forward. Each year your strength, speed, and resilience expand. Wounds that might have scarred become fuel for adaptation. Powers inherited from your parent grow in proportion, beginning as flickers and sparks but swelling into destructive, battlefield-level abilities. Radiation is your greatest food and fuel, healing you instantly and triggering mutation. Every surge of radiation you consume strengthens you further, accelerating the pace at which your body evolves. Where a human plateaus, you continue climbing, and each stage of your growth brings you closer to true Titan power.

Your bloodline also grants access to places where mortals cannot tread. The Hollow Earth recognizes you as kin, its caverns and luminous jungles feeding your essence rather than rejecting it. You can walk through deep ocean trenches without fear, survive volcanic rivers, and linger in domains where your parent once ruled. These environments do not resist you; they empower you, offering both sanctuary and accelerant for your development.

Your inheritance is twofold. The first is the direct aspect of your parent, giving you their dominion over a primal force. If Godzilla is your sire, nuclear fury becomes your weapon; if Mothra, radiant energy and bioluminescence; if Ghidorah, storms and lightning; if Rodan, volcanic fire; if Kong, brute force and earthbound might. But you are not merely an extension of their legacy. In time a second aspect emerges, wholly unique to you. This Titan Aspect is not chosen by your parent but awakened by your own nature, giving you dominion over a new force. Eventually you will command both, wielding an inheritance and an individuality that no Titan before you has combined.

As you age, your Titan form asserts itself. At first, the signs are small: glowing ridges across your back, scales flickering on your skin, energy bleeding through your eyes. In adolescence you can shift partially, gaining height, mass, and claws or wings for battle. By adulthood, you unlock your full Kaiju Form, a colossal body on par with the sovereign Titans themselves. Your form is not a copy but a distinct creation, influenced by your parent but defined by your own essence. With time and radiation, your Titan body continues to grow, rivaling and eventually surpassing the size and power of most known Kaiju.

Other Titans will sense you immediately. Some may bow, recognizing you as kin and heir. Others will challenge you, unwilling to yield their place in the hierarchy. But whether as human, hybrid, or full Kaiju, your place in the Monsterverse is secured. You are Half-Titan: a being who grows stronger with every passing year, who feeds on the marrow of radiation, who travels freely through the Hollow Earth, who bears the aspect of your parent and your own, and who will one day be acknowledged as a true Titan in your own right.  

Note: you can freely change between either your own Kaiju form or the one you inherited from your parent, the same goes for aspects.
objects.title: Half-Titan Child

addons.text:
The perfect, inhuman humanity that comes with being a created lifeform has been softened or outright eliminated. You've regained the spark of life and the drive that pushes humanity forward, whether this has been instilled in you at your "birth" or learned due to your life experiences.

You are truly considered to be human. Using almost any classification, you will not be seen to be any different from the rest of the human race on a spiritual level, and as such, you cannot be persecuted by man or the divine for the manner of your creation.
addons.title: Homebred Humanity

addons.text: The epitome of conventional homunculus design, squarely following in the footsteps of the Einzbern's design. Created first with an ideal set of Magic Circuits as your foundation to perfectly complement your intended Magecraft specialty, and then built around them in turn. As a result, you'd be better defined as "Magic Circuits with a human form" than anything else. With this highly specialized set of Magic Circuits, you are incomparable to others within your chosen field, as your circuits elevate you to heights unseen. Which may take many forms—from those similar to Aoko Aozaki's deceptively simple circuits, capable of immense rotational power that gave her the title of "Magic Gunner" and fully demonstrate the Fifth Magic; to configurations like Svin Glascheit's, half-fused with his blood vessels, letting him display his Beast Magecraft to great effect, etc. Though no matter what, their capacity and output will exceed that of the average practitioner by a factor of one hundred. And as with most homunculi, you are also preloaded with information—mainly pertaining to your craft, including its history, theorums, foundational knowledge, and select spells—enough to establish you as a first-class magus of the Fes rank.
addons.title: 「Justeaze Series Replika」

addons.text: A homunculus made within the depths of the Titan's Pit, your design differs sharply from conventional homunculi architecture, shaped by the distinct goals and philosophies of your creators. Created to be a being purely optimized for computational ability: a "pseudo-Spiritron computer given human form." Though this doesn't mean your Magic Circuits were neglected. On the contrary, they are of solid quality and quantity—adequate to be classified as B Rank—they just simply, however, aren't your main focus. As a specialized homunculus, your capacity for calculation, numerical comprehension, and abstract reasoning surpasses even the most advanced modern AI. In raw analytical ability, you'll approach the level of the BB herself—though still one step beneath her overwhelming magnificence~ Being a genius with few equals, you're likewise preloaded with a curated archive of Atlas Institute history, techniques, skills, and inventions. Not a complete record, but more than enough to serve as a foundation—befitting a high-grade homunculus designed to assist your masters.
addons.title: 「R.A.N.I. Series Replika」

objects.text: Streamlined. Perfect. Artificial. A creation of man, made in their image: a replication of their existence, yet one lacking the distinct "rough edges" and struggles that help define humanity. With every biological system and process being rendered "perfect" and undeniable in its effectiveness, extending to even your DNA. Much of the so-called "junk" data originating from your progenitors has been culled and replaced with purposeful redundancies that let your kind, in theory, be ageless, while safeguarding it against damage. As such, you may be considered the ultimate, optimized "next stage" form of humanity—having all of their advantages with none of the drawbacks, turning all of their aspects (physically and mentally) to eleven, by a factor of ten. However, your "flaw," if it can even be called that, is having none at all. Which, in effect, has created a point of inhumanity within your kind, stripped of that particular "spark," making you utterly and fundamentally alien to ordinary sensibilities. Standing so far above the baseline, you cannot simply comprehend the flaws of your progenitors—your mind free of humanity's inherent neurosis and their general drive for more. Note: This deliberate biological design also makes you an ideal vessel for any power taken within the CYOA, allowing you to draw out its full potential with little to no faults others might suffer.
objects.title: Homebred Homunculus

objects.text:
Nukleans are creatures characterized with explosives as their heads. As indicated by their looks, they are masters of explosions, their bodies capable of producing explosive material through their skin and using that to fight their opponents. They could also temporarily do a much larger explosion by sacrificing limbs and other body parts, and so long as ironically it ain't their heads, they can take a few days to regenerate their lost body parts due to this attack. Note however that they only regenerate those they use for explosions, losing limbs for any other reason won't be regenerated.

Finally, they come in many flavors depending on the type of bomb their heads look like. From the weaker yet a bit more versatile fire cracker heads, to the more explosive dynamite heads, you are encouraged to be creative with what type of head you may have, so long as it is based on an explosive.

Nobody truly knows where they come from, all they know is they were feared for a history of Nuklean individuals being unhinged  battle thirsty  warriors in the past. Maybe that's what they are? Avatars of War? And you are now one of them.
objects.title: Nukleans

addons.text:
Oni were often referenced in legends as sources of natural disasters aside from massacres and diseases. Well then, your racial heritage, along with a peculiar Oni variant, has given rise to the Reiki race.

They are a race superior to the Oni in all aspects, at least five times stronger than they were before. Their Oni form now rises to 5 meters tall. Additionally, your regenerative capabilities can now heal dismemberment and decapitation in a matter of seconds, as long as your spark of life is not instantly extinguished.

You now gain a form change based on auto-biokinesis and the natural talent of being undetectable to any means of tracking of supernatural and mundane nature. But you are still traceable by powerful means such as clairvoyance or sensory abilities backed by divine energy or similar potency.

As incarnations of natural disasters made flesh, you are blessed to be masters of the elements through sheer power and will, whether magical or spiritual power, without even needing to resist. This allows you to generate and manipulate as much as you wish. But for complex or advanced elements like sand, space, metal, and others, they still resist your tyrannical influence.

As a race that nearly touches the divine, your soul has been sublimated beyond your limits. This brings a natural talent for psychic and spiritual abilities.

Many legends do not limit themselves to associating the name Oni with violence and brutality. Among them are tales that include talent for poisons, curses, and diseases. This grants a strong affinity for any magical or spiritual power of the same concept, along with a body resistant to such elements. Initially, you can cast a simple paralysis curse that lasts 5 seconds on victims and use your own blood as a source of terrible poison or disease.
addons.title: Reiki

addons.text:
You have inherited the great abilities of the Kijin who hold high governmental positions within the Jura-Tempest Federation.

From Benimaru’s legacy, you gain mastery and affinity on the level of a demigod of flames, as well as great talent in the art of war.

From Shion’s legacy, you gain the ability to use any power or mode that involves a berserker state without losing your rationality or emotional calm.

From Souei’s legacy, you gain great talent in the arts of concealment, espionage, assassination, scouting, and mastery of any weapon related to his profession. You can apply poison and paralysis effects to any weapon or projectile you use via any supernatural energy you possess.

From Shuna’s legacy, you gain mastery and affinity on the level of a demigod of magic. You can eliminate any casting requirement for spells in exchange for executing magic purely through your will, though you must still meet the energy cost of casting.

From Kurobe’s legacy, you gain great talent in craftsmanship of any kind. You can even perform reverse engineering on any object you analyze. However, the more complex the object, the longer it will take to uncover its secrets.

From Hakurou’s legacy, you gain great talent in all forms of martial arts, both unarmed combat and the use of bladed weapons. You can analyze, understand, and replicate any martial technique you can perceive, as long as it is physically plausible.
addons.title: The Six Superiors of Jura-Tempest

objects.text:
You are an Oni of legend, a being born from the age of gods and storms. Your body towers above humankind, for even the smallest Oni at full maturity stands a full head taller than the tallest of men. Your body is carved from strength itself, powerful, broad, and impossible to weaken. No matter what you eat or how you live, your body never grows heavy or frail. From your forehead rise your horns, smooth and strong, curving upward like the roots of the mountains. They are the same color as your skin, blending seamlessly into your flesh as if they have always been a part of you.

Your strength is that of the earth itself. With focused effort, you can shatter boulders, bend iron, and uproot ancient trees. The longer you live, the greater your might becomes, your muscles growing and senses sharpening.

Your body heals a hundred times faster than a man's. Even if you are struck down, your flesh can knit itself whole again with enough time. Severed limbs can be regrown, and as long as a spark of life remains within you, your body will rebuild itself. You are ageless, untouched by sickness or the frailty that burdens humankind.

Beneath your skin lies a quiet magic, a natural illusion that hides your true form from mortal minds. Those who look upon you see your true size, yet their thoughts smooth away the strangeness of it. To them, you appear striking and beautiful, touched by an otherworldly charm that softens fear and draws their gaze without their knowing why.

You can smell the sins of another, and to you, the wicked have the sweetest scent. Evil clings to them like spice and smoke; the more corruption a soul bears, the richer and more tempting the aroma becomes. It is the perfume of sin, warm, heavy, and alluring, like meat roasting over flame.

This scent awakens your hunger. Your stomach is the sacred engine of your being, the source of your boundless vitality. All meat is a delight to your tongue, and every bite feeds the power burning within you. When you feast, your body surges with strength. Your muscles tighten as if newly forged, your skin glows faintly with heat, and your vision sharpens until you can see the heartbeat of the world. Though the rush fades with time, a trace of it always remains, slowly building your might across centuries. The rawer the meat and the greater the sin of the one consumed, the greater the effect.
objects.title: Oni

addons.text:
Born of a union between a mortal and a Baobhan Sith noble of the Unseelie Court, you are not a diluted descendant but a direct child. Your body was shaped by mortal flesh, yet your essence is rooted in the dark wilds of the Otherworld. The Court acknowledges your lineage; you are recognized, named, and bound by its cold laws. The Unseelie see you as kin, a predator wearing a human soul.

Your physical form has stabilized into a perfect equilibrium of human and fae biology. Your flesh carries both vitality and malice, preserving itself against all decay. Mortal diseases, poisons, and the passage of years cannot touch you. Your organs do not degenerate, your blood remains pure, and your body maintains a steady balance between strength and grace regardless of age. Know that you can still be killed by violence.

In your normal state, your presence exerts a constant, passive influence over emotion and perception. You can subtly modulate the emotional state of those nearby within a limited range by amplifying attraction, trust, or fascination. The effect does not overwrite free will but skews natural feelings toward your favor, making persuasion and feeding nearly effortless. This emotional field can be maintained indefinitely at low strength and intensified at the cost of focus or magical energy. When concentrated, it can induce a mild trance or elation lasting several minutes, sufficient to pacify or disarm an individual.

Your fae form no longer requires the consumption of human blood to manifest. You can trigger it through focused expenditure of your internal fae magic. By performing a short ritual using appropriate materials, you can draw on the ambient power of the Otherworld to trigger your transformation. The transformation would be both brief and weaker compared to if you had consumed blood however. 

Your feeding method has evolved beyond consumption of blood. You may drain vitality through skin contact, breath exchange, or direct proximity during moments of heightened emotion. The process extracts life force, converting it into raw magical energy that can be used immediately to heal yourself, enhance physical performance, or power spellwork. Prolonged contact with a victim can leave them pale, weak, and disoriented, though typically alive. Draining completely is possible but unnecessary and wasteful.

The vitality you collect is your fuel. You can store limited amounts of it within your body. This reservoir powers can be used to file your fae magic instead of needing any materials.

By virtue of your bloodline, you possess Unseelie favor. Spirits aligned with the Unseelie, entities of frost, shadow, and silence, acknowledge your rank instinctively. They will not harm you unless directly commanded by a higher authority, and you may issue simple commands to lesser spirits. These commands are limited to observation, distraction, sabotage, or assassination on small scale. Unseelie shades can infiltrate unseen places, deliver messages, scout distant areas, or silently kill weak or sleeping targets. Invoking this power requires a verbal summons and expenditure of magical energy or stored vitality, and each task binds the spirit for a limited duration before it returns to its domain.
addons.title: Child of the Baobhan Sith

objects.text:
At some distant point in your lineage, a Baobhan Sith mingled her blood with that of a human. The centuries have thinned that essence, but traces remain potent enough to shape your body and soul. Your blood carries a dormant hunger, an instinct that remembers the taste of human life.

In your natural state, your fae heritage manifests subtly. Your skin is pale and even-toned, resistant to blemish and slow to bruise. You heal faster than an ordinary person, your body metabolizing injury and fatigue with greater efficiency. Your senses are slightly sharpened; you can track movement in the dark and pick up faint scents of water, blood, and plant life with ease. Your endurance in wild terrain is remarkable. You tire slowly, walk silently, and rarely lose your way. You are stronger, faster, and more coordinated than an average adult, though not yet beyond mortal limits.

When you drink human blood, your dormant traits awaken and the fae nature asserts control. Your body transforms within seconds of ingestion. The skin along your legs splits and reforms into the lean, muscular limbs of a deer, covered in short, pale fur. The feet end in cloven hooves capable of gripping uneven terrain and delivering crushing impact. Two horns emerge from the scalp, branching like polished ivory antlers, vascular and sensitive to air movement. The musculature of your entire body tightens and refines, allowing bursts of speed and strength that exceed human physiology by a wide margin. You can accelerate faster than the eye can follow, closing several meters in less than a second. Your reflexes improve to the point of reacting to projectiles or attacks almost instantaneously. In this state, you can exert force sufficient to tear through metal restraints or break bone with minimal effort. 

A faint, involuntary glamour radiates from you while transformed. This effect is not hypnotic in a supernatural sense, but it manipulates human sensory processing; individuals who look upon you perceive your movements and voice as captivating, often freezing or hesitating in confusion. This glamour cannot be consciously disabled while the transformation is active. The state itself is energy-intensive and can only be sustained through the consumed vitality. Once that energy is depleted, your body reverts automatically to human form, leaving you back in your base form again unless you drink more blood. 

Your blood, while strong, also has its weaknesses. Exposure to sunlight while in either form causes discomfort proportional to intensity. In human state, it triggers mild skin irritation, headaches, and fatigue. In the awakened form, sunlight acts as a suppressive field: your muscles stiffen, reaction speed drops by half, and energy needed to maintain the transformation increases, reducing its duration. Contact with pure iron produces acute pain and localized paralysis. The metal disrupts the magical conductivity of your tissues, temporarily nullifying the fae energy and undoing your transformation locally.

Additionally, the blood that fuels your power must be human. Animal blood does not contain sufficient vitality to activate your transformation, though it may prolong it slightly once active. Each activation requires at least several ounces of fresh blood consumed directly or indirectly. Residual traces of blood stored for more than a few hours lose efficacy.
objects.title: Descendant of the Baobhan Sith

objects.text:
You become a Titanoboa. A typical adult length ranges from 12.8 m to 14.3 m, with body mass around 730–1,135 kg. Your strength reflects that size: constriction pressure is decisive against large animals and light vehicles, and you move smoothly in water or on land.

You operate best around water. You travel through rivers, swamps, culverts, and canals with minimal disturbance, can remain submerged for long periods, and launch from cover with a single burst. Banks, drains, reed beds, and flooded lots function as reliable routes. You can climb when needed, drop quickly when the path goes down, tail-flick from water to land, and roll a target under with little splash. Vegetation and debris yield when you push through.

Your sensory set is practical and precise. You sample scent with the tongue, track heartbeats through water and ground, and read heat and motion in low light or murk. Your jaws open wide for large prey and close with a controlled bite when you want a clean grab. Once your coils lock, resistance drops off rapidly.

You have durable stamina. Stillness does not fatigue you, and short, fast strikes don’t leave you winded. Cold, rain, and shade don’t meaningfully reduce output. Shedding clears injuries and venom, restoring clean, intact scales. Rough ground and impacts slow you less than expected for your size.

Your presence affects behavior. Animals fall quiet when your shadow crosses water, and crowds tense before they see you. You are not a dragon or a myth—simply the largest snake the world remembers. In tight alleys, reed beds, storm drains, and jungle rivers, you control the moment between first sight and final outcome.

Your thinking stays steady. You plan routes, time approaches, and maintain focus for hours. You decide how a scene ends: immobilize and warn, or finish cleanly and move on.
objects.title: Primeval River-Titan

addons.text:
You are born of a lineage older than the stars—a child of the Cosmic Dragons, beings whose hearts ignited galaxies and whose wings stirred the first storms of space. Their blood reawakens within you, dissolving the boundaries between mortal and celestial. You remain draconic in form, yet every breath and heartbeat now echoes the rhythm of the universe. You are both creature and current, a living expression of the Cosmos itself.

The Dragon Heart within your chest evolves into a stellar core, generating pure Cosmic Essence—the fusion of light, gravity, and creative force. This energy replaces all others, feeding you endlessly while refining every aspect of your being. Strength and endurance rise to planetary magnitude; your body becomes a stable field of energy rather than flesh and bone, impervious to heat, vacuum, or pressure. Wounds close in moments as the Heart reassembles your form from ambient radiation, making destruction little more than delay.

Your Dragon Form transforms into a being of living starlight. Scales shimmer like galaxies, wings unfurl as auroral arcs, and your eyes blaze with the glow of newborn suns. You can shrink to mortal scale or expand until your body eclipses moons. Each movement bends gravity and light, and your breath carries the power of stellar birth and annihilation—plasma, fusion, and compression bound into a single destructive symphony.

Power flows through instinct rather than artifice. You command the fusion and radiation of stars, the weight of gravity, and the patterns that shape matter itself. You can ignite or extinguish suns, forge or collapse worlds, and sculpt stellar winds into weapons or shields. You condense interstellar dust into new planets and raise them into orbit, or reshape existing ones through controlled cataclysm. Space folds around you, allowing instantaneous motion or devastating distortions. The force of your presence alters the curvature of reality itself, stabilizing fragile worlds or crushing dimensions unfit to bear your weight. Every form of energy—heat, light, magic, or divine power—feeds back into your Heart, refined into endless vitality. You see through all spectra, from the movement of atoms to the flow of time, perceiving the fragile seams that hold existence together. Creation and destruction obey your balance; with equal grace you can end decay or restore life to dying worlds.

Your aura expands into a stellar field where gravity, light, and motion bend in harmony with your will. When fully released, it can envelop worlds, shielding or burning them depending on intent. Each motion carries the pressure of tectonic shifts, each beat of your wings scatters storms and redirects magnetospheres. Even silence becomes an act of power; reality settles where you rest.

The Draconic Den within your soul ascends into a Cosmic Domain, a self-sustaining region of space shaped by thought and inhabited by suns, nebulae, and crystalline fragments of light. It is your sanctuary and forge, where you rest, create, or dream new worlds into being. Anything born within this Domain can be moved freely into the greater universe. There, your energy replenishes faster than it can ever be spent.

Travel requires no portals or artifice. Your essence resonates with the underlying structure of existence, whether it is a multiverse, omniverse, or manifold continuum. By aligning your energy with its hidden frequencies, you glide through reality itself. Within a single universe, you cross galaxies in moments, manipulating gravity and light as wings. Across greater planes, you follow the natural currents that connect all realms, vanishing into collapsing light and appearing wherever you wish. From beyond the edges of creation, you may view every world as a point of illumination and descend into any of them at will. Your aura extends protection to anything within its reach, ensuring safe passage through even the most turbulent folds of existence. You do not trespass upon reality—you are part of its design.

Your instincts and emotions evolve alongside your power. The territorial nature of dragons becomes cosmic stewardship, guiding balance across the stars. Emotion flows slower, deeper, and more deliberate, mirroring the rhythm of suns and nebulae. You may nurture worlds or witness their death with equal serenity, yet through discipline, you remain tethered to empathy and purpose. You are no detached god but a willful guardian of creation’s cycle.

Everything that defines the Half-Dragon remains, but magnified beyond measure. The Dragon Heart, aura, and form retain their nature while functioning on cosmic principles. You no longer wield elements—you shape the forces that create them. Every motion, every thought, carries the authority of gravity and light. You are the Cosmic Dragon, sovereign of the stars, forger of worlds, and living embodiment of the universe’s eternal pulse.

Note: Synergizes perfectly with Dimensional Dragon Descent, and all draconic evolutions. The Dimensional and Cosmic lineages complement each other—one defines the framework of existence, the other fills it with energy and life. When united, they form a complete harmony of creation and structure.
addons.title: Cosmic Dragon Descent

addons.text:
You are the descendant of a Dimensional Dragon—one of the prime architects who built the lattice of existence. Where cosmic dragons forged stars, your lineage shaped the boundaries that hold those stars in place. When your blood awakens, reality ceases to contain you; you become the axis around which it folds.

Your Dragon Heart expands into a dimensional nexus that refines all energy into Dimensional Essence—the substance of geometry made fluid. This Essence lets you stretch, compress, or rewrite the coordinates of space. Your body is stabilized through infinite layers of reality, its mass anchored in higher dimensions. Impact disperses harmlessly through these folds, and distance itself bends to your will. Strength, endurance, and defense scale with spatial density rather than size; every motion ripples through multiple planes at once.

In dragon form you are a creature of mirrored light and shifting perspective. Each scale reflects a separate layer of existence, and your wings glimmer like corridors to other worlds. To three-dimensional eyes, you appear fluid and impossible—present in several places at once. You act across dimensions simultaneously, a single consciousness projected through countless reflections. Your breath manifests as compressed space, a distortion that twists and erases whatever lies before it before snapping reality back into balance.

Space and structure obey instinct. You expand or collapse environments, fold continents into patterns of light, or suspend regions within pocket realms. You open doorways between any two points and shape the rules within them. You merge or isolate realities, forge new worlds, or stabilize failing ones. Everything you touch becomes part of a greater geometry that remembers your imprint.

Your existence spans dimensions. You move, perceive, and think across universes and timelines at once, every projection acting with full awareness. You phase effortlessly through matter, slipping between layers of reality to evade or strike. You can anchor regions of space to prevent travel or fracture them into mirrored zones that trap intruders.

Your aura manifests as living geometry—a field that bends the world into new angles. Within it, direction loses meaning, attacks curve away, and time follows the rhythm you impose. When extended, it can envelop worlds or entire planes, imposing structure on chaos or dissolving unstable realms into stillness.

The Draconic Den evolves into a Dimensional Domain, a self-sustaining universe defined entirely by your design. Gravity, time, and even thought follow patterns you choose. You may fill it with oceans of glass, endless sky, or inverted mountains. The Domain expands as you grow, serving as home, fortress, and creation engine. You can open its gates anywhere, summon its landscapes into the outer world, or fold it safely within your Heart.

Travel for you is redefinition. You do not cross distance—you rewrite it. Each step rearranges the coordinates of space, allowing instant passage across galaxies or between realities. Companions within your aura travel safely, untouched by the distortions you command. To others, your movement appears as mirrored light collapsing inward before blooming elsewhere.

Your instincts have outgrown territory. You feel the balance of existence itself: when realms overlap, when boundaries weaken, when the weave of reality frays. You act to restore equilibrium. Emotion flows with geometric precision—measured, calm, absolute. You are both guardian and architect, shaping harmony among infinite worlds.

All that defines the Half-Dragon endures, magnified through dimensional mastery. Your Heart is a nexus of folds, your aura the blueprint of creation, your body the junction of countless realities. You no longer traverse space; you decide where it begins and ends. You are the Dimensional Dragon—the living geometry of existence, architect of realms, and stabilizer of all creation.

Note: Synergizes perfectly with Cosmic Dragon Descent, and all draconic evolutions. The Cosmic and Dimensional lineages complement each other—one defines the framework of existence, the other fills it with energy and life. When united, they form a complete harmony of creation and structure.
addons.title: Dimensional Dragon Descent

addons.text:
Your draconic lineage no longer aligns with a traditional element. Instead, you embody Shape—the principle that defines how ideas take form and how structure exists. You are not simply a creator or craftsman. You are a dragon whose nature governs the transition from concept into reality.

Unreal Foundry and Blacksmith of Potential fuse into a single function. Creation and crafting are no longer separate actions. When you will something into existence, it is formed and perfected at the same time. Structure, material, and purpose are decided instantly, without process, tools, or time unless you choose to slow the act for refinement.

You hold complete authority over non-living form that you create. Materials are not limited to known physics or substances. You may define how something behaves as you create it—its density, durability, energy interaction, and structural rules—so long as they remain internally consistent. Your creations obey your logic rather than the laws of the world.

Anything you create remains within your control. You can reshape, repair, or reconfigure it instantly, even in the middle of use. Weapons evolve between strikes, defenses adjust to incoming force, and structures shift in response to your intent. This applies across all scales, provided they originate from your power.

Through your forging aspect, every creation may carry embedded concepts that function as inherent properties. A weapon can be defined to cut beyond durability, a barrier to nullify specific forces, or a structure to remain fixed regardless of pressure. These effects are bound by clarity and coherence, but within that, they are absolute.

Your mastery of craft is not diminished—it is elevated. You may still forge and create through traditional methods. When you do, your skill surpasses any mortal or conventional creator, producing works of unmatched quality, precision, and function.

You are not bound to craftsmanship, but when you engage in it, your works often surpass instant creations, carrying refinement, intent, and layered conceptual structure only true craft can achieve.

Only those who embody the concept of forging or creation itself—beings whose existence is tied to those principles—may rival or exceed you. Against all others, your skill stands without equal.

Your draconic body becomes an expression of this authority. Your scales may be redefined at will, adapting their properties in response to threats. Your claws impose structure on contact, interacting beyond simple force. Your breath becomes an extension of Shape, forming constructs, projecting matter, or breaking structures into reclaimable form.

Your Draconic Den evolves into a Foundry Domain. Within it, your control becomes more precise and efficient. Complex creations require less effort, new materials are easier to conceptualize, and your understanding deepens with every act of creation. It serves as both workshop and reserve, storing designs and perfected constructs while accelerating your growth.

This power is self-contained. The Dragon Heart fuels all manifestation, converting your energy into sustained creation without external reliance. As your strength grows, so does your scale and precision, eventually allowing large-scale environmental shaping through direct application of your authority.

You are not shaping matter as a tool.

You are the standard by which form exists.
addons.title: Dragon of Shape

addons.text:
Your draconic aspect embodies Genesis—the origin of life in its most fundamental form. You are not a creator who shapes from outside. You are the source from which life emerges. All aspects of existence—body, function, and soul—are unified under your authority, allowing you to create living beings as complete entities rather than incomplete constructs or hollow shells.

You gain the ability to generate life directly. Through your will, you may form organisms of any design, ranging from simple creatures to complex, fully realized beings. These creations possess true biological structure and fully formed souls, capable of independent thought, growth, and development. They are not bound to a single form or pattern, and may be shaped according to instinct, design, or purpose.

Your power manifests as a primordial medium—a flowing, ocean-like substance that represents life before defined form. This “Sea of Genesis” is not water, but a living substrate from which all your creations emerge. It continuously produces new life, sustains existing organisms, and reshapes environments into ecosystems aligned with your presence.

Any being that comes into contact with this Sea may be affected. At your discretion, they may be left unchanged, healed, altered, or broken down and reconstituted into new life. This process does not simply destroy—it rewrites, converting existing structures into forms aligned with your Genesis. Individual identity can be preserved, altered, or erased depending on your intent.

Your creations are not limited to monsters. You may produce animals, sentient species, hybrid beings, or entirely new forms of life. Each is complete, stable, and capable of growth. Through Originator of Monsters, you may accelerate this process, rapidly producing species, converting others, and establishing lineages that expand and propagate under your influence.

Your own body reflects your nature as the source of life. You may adapt your form by integrating traits from your creations, refining yourself into an apex organism. This adaptation is selective and controlled, allowing continuous improvement without instability.

Your Draconic Den evolves into a living ecosystem. Within it, your Sea of Genesis expands freely, creating, refining, and sustaining life without limitation. It serves as both origin point and proving ground, allowing you to experiment, cultivate species, and establish complete biological systems.

You do not command life.

You are where it begins.
addons.title: Dragon of Genesis — Primordial Origin

objects.text:
You are born of dragon blood. Whether the direct child or descendant of one or many dragons, your body unites mortal adaptability with draconic physiology. Lineage strength or origin does not matter—this heritage stabilizes every ancestral influence into a single, controllable form. Dragons instinctively recognize you as kin and treat you as favored unless you oppose them.

Your physical capacity surpasses that of any known mortal or hybrid, but it grows naturally through age, experience, and mastery. Even at the beginning, your body operates at a level far beyond human limitation. In human form, you can lift and strike with power capable of demolishing fortified structures, move faster than sound, and endure high-caliber weaponry or powerful elemental attacks without permanent injury. Your strength and reflexes refine as your Dragon Heart matures, and your endurance deepens with each battle, feeding both instinct and body.

In hybrid form, your physiology amplifies severalfold. Muscles tighten, scales emerge, and draconic energy reinforces your entire frame. Every motion carries destructive force; a single strike can shatter boulders or send shockwaves across battlefields. Flight becomes instinctive and highly maneuverable, and you can engage multiple opponents for extended periods without exhaustion. Wounds heal within minutes as the Dragon Heart circulates restorative energy through your body.

When you assume your full dragon form, your physical might and elemental output reach extraordinary levels. Even a young Half-Dragon can destroy mountains or carve valleys with a single breath attack. As your strength matures, your power grows to reshape entire landscapes—continent-scale force released through claw, wing, and flame. Your body endures artillery, magic, or natural cataclysms without yielding; scales harden beyond conventional destruction, and regeneration restores massive injuries in moments.

At the center of your being beats the Dragon Heart, a living energy engine that sustains every dragon. It generates and refines all forms of power—mana, ki, chi, divine essence, or any other energy you possess—into a single, high-density source known as Draconic Power. This energy functions as a universal replacement, stronger and more efficient than its originals, capable of fueling any ability without loss. In its resting state, the Dragon Heart maintains equilibrium and regeneration; when activated, it floods your body with amplified output that multiplies both physical and magical performance. As you grow, its capacity expands, eventually powering external systems or serving as a secondary soul anchor should your body be destroyed.

You command three stable forms: human, hybrid, and dragon. In human form, your appearance is unremarkable though your strength and resilience remain enhanced. Hybrid form reveals your draconic nature—horns, scales, wings, claws, and tail—granting major boosts to every attribute, controlled flight, and limited breath attacks. Dragon form unleashes your full potential: a complete draconic body capable of sustained flight, overwhelming force, and large-scale elemental assaults. Transitions between forms are instant and seamless, and you may retain partial traits from one form while in another.

Your elemental or ancestral aspect defines your energy type, breath weapon, and innate resistances. Fire, lightning, ice, earth, light, darkness, crystal, chaos, and void are common examples. Breath output is fully adjustable, from concentrated beams to wide-area blasts. Over time, you may evolve or combine elements through mastery and experience, though adaptation to foreign systems requires additional powers or add-ons.  You may choose your element or aspect. 

Your Draconic Aura is a tangible field generated by your body and soul. It projects force and authority proportional to your strength, distorting air, suppressing weaker energies, and provoking instinctive fear or respect. You can release or suppress it at will; when flared, it reinforces your body, sharpens reflexes, and serves as a limited defense against lesser attacks. Proper control turns it into both weapon and shield.

Linked to your essence is a Draconic Den, a private subspace accessible by thought or through a brief rift. This domain mirrors your aspect—volcanic, crystalline, storm-filled, or otherwise—and acts as your home and recovery site. Inside, regeneration, energy restoration, and mental balance increase dramatically. The Den grows alongside your power and can later develop into a full domain through upgrades.

You inherit the instincts and traits of Dragon kind. Territorial awareness, pride, protectiveness, and ambition are natural tendencies. You may hoard objects of value or knowledge, defend those you claim, and react strongly to challenges or insults. These drives heighten focus and determination but can lead to possessiveness or aggression if unchecked. Learning discipline over these impulses is part of mastering your nature.

Your body continues to evolve. Scales strengthen and adapt, gaining properties such as energy absorption or reflection through combat and exposure. Instinctive combat memory grants proficiency in flight and energy control even without training. Your mind resists fear, domination, and mental intrusion, remaining clear under pressure. Stable genetics ensure any descendants or recreations inherit controlled versions of your power.

This archetype is self-contained yet merges flawlessly with all dragon-related powers or bloodlines. Physical strength, aura intensity, and energy output scale with age, experience, and lineage. You can inherit and harmonize multiple draconic ancestries simultaneously, and dragons universally acknowledge you as one of their own. You embody the balance of human intellect and draconic supremacy—adaptive, disciplined, and powerful enough to stand among the greatest creatures of any world.

Note: You can choose to be the child or descendant of a Dragon God of your choice.
objects.title: Half-Dragon

addons.text:
You have always been different from the others. Born larger and stronger, you were often the one who provided food for your village, by hunting some of the larger creatures of the tundra.

But one day you discovered an Ichor Pool in a cave and accidentally fell in it.

This has twisted you into a 12 meter tall titan with the brute strength to tear through Titanium with the same ease you once did through Steel.

If you have Fel Blood, you subsume the corruption, tripling your strength and causing you to grow another 3 meters.

If you have Blood of the Gods, you gain some minor shapeshifting abilities as you fight off the corruption. You can now shift between your normal size and your titanic form, or anywhere in between with your strength scaling proportionally.

If you have both you will manage to purify and absorb the ichor, gaining both effects and allowing you to also take on a human-like form, though it won’t stand up to close inspection.
addons.title: Blood of the Firstborn

objects.text: “Never thought my life was that interesting, but they disagree. Traded enough Ichor Steel to make a sword for my tale!” Hailing from the Frozen Wastes these mysterious creatures are well known for three things, their obsession with stories, their ability to safely harvest Ichor Steel, and their insanity. You are now one such creature. Your body is covered in shaggy white fur, with great branching antlers upon your head, wide flattened fox-like ears, and possessing a long bushy tail. But most notable are the claws upon your hands and feet, and the shark-like teeth in your mouth, wickedly sharp and unnaturally tough, they are easily capable of tearing through 5 inches of steel with only the slightest resistance, as well as leaving deep gouges in titanium, though thankfully they can be retracted when not needed. But even greater is your mind; ever cataloging the things you see and hear, you never forget anything after experiencing it once, for good or ill. Unfortunately you have also inherited their madness, born of their corrupted creator’s blood. You often hallucinate, seeing and hearing things that are not there - or things that were there long ago. Your friends will abandon you…
objects.title: Fylakes Istorias

objects.text:
Your true body is as a mountainous, sentient colony of tentacles residing in a compact pocket dimension. Your presence in this reality is facilitated by a single, permanent dimensional aperture, through which you extend a fraction of your mass. This mass forms a dense, interwoven network of countless octopus-like limbs that fill and animate a meticulously crafted human shell. There is no internal skeleton or distinct organs; every contour and volume of your human shell is sculpted from these tightly wound muscular coils, scaled in thickness to mimic human anatomy but possessing vastly greater strength, making even a tendril the width of a finger as strong as a well-built man's arm. Each tentacle's surface is lined with powerful suction cups capable of an immense, unbreakable grip, allowing for perfect manipulation and terrifying adhesion.

This physiology grants regenerative and brute force abilities, limited to the controlled release of tentacles. You cannot reconfigure the braid to alter the human shell's shape, but instead can extrude additional prehensile tentacles or crushing appendages from any of its surface and heal any injury by withdrawing damaged fibers and regenerating them from your core dimension. The shell can compress its woven structure to slip through narrow gaps or swell slightly with additional mass for bursts of strength, but cannot undergo dramatic physical transformation without damage. Your perception is a proprioceptive web felt across every straining fiber, granting you total kinetic awareness and the ability to sense through the grip and vibration of each sucker.

Your anchored dimensional tether is your weakness. Your shell is sustained by a constant, delicate connection to your core self. This link can be strained by excessive mass-transfer or rapid extrusion, potentially causing a destabilising feedback loop where your true form begins to involuntarily breach reality, tearing and damaging your shell. You also need to eat. Consumed material is digested and translated into dimensional energy for your core form, and is also the raw material used to repair and, if the shell is ever completely destroyed, slowly weave an entirely new one. Without regular and substantial consumption, you will begin to cannibalise the flesh-suit from within. Finally, while nearly invulnerable to conventional injury, you are vulnerable to forces that disrupt dimensional integrity or spatial connections. A targeted attack on your anchor point could sever the tether entirely, causing catastrophic collapse of your puppet form and potentially stranding your consciousness.
objects.title: Coiling Within

objects.text:
You are an outlier, a freak of nature within your own race. Your body has developed several unusual yet advantageous genetic anomalies. These are rare mutations or lost traits that occasionally appear within a species but are almost never seen together in a single individual.

Your physiology possesses multiple beneficial mutations that carry no inherent drawbacks. In a normal human, these might include conditions such as Lactate Dehydrogenase Syndrome, which allows the body to process lactic acid so efficiently that muscles rarely tire, or Tetrachromacy, which expands vision beyond the standard human color spectrum. You gain a collection of similar mutations, enough that even an otherwise ordinary human could reasonably be considered superhuman.

This power also adapts to whatever form or species you possess. If you were a dragon, you would manifest rare or exceptional mutations that might theoretically occur within dragonkind. The same principle extends to magic, spiritual, or esoteric powers that grant physical traits, allowing you to develop genetic anomalies tied to things like magic circuits, meridians, or bloodlines.

Your body is still limited by the natural potential of its physiology. These mutations must remain within the boundaries of what your species could potentially achieve. This ability cannot create impossible traits, such as a human suddenly obtaining the ability to fly. Instead, it produces extreme but still biologically plausible anomalies within the limits of your physiology.
objects.title: Genetic Anomaly

objects.text:
Your body is that of literal Blue Blood Royalty-sacred, sovereign, and set apart from birth. Within your veins runs blood the color of deep royalty, marking you as something other than common flesh. Your flesh was always meant to be more, to endure more, to be more than any other.

This manifests as a form of physical perfection and supremacy. You are stronger, faster, more resilient than your efforts alone would explain. Illness burns out faster. Wounds close sooner. Fatigue touches you lightly and leaves quickly. Your form refines itself toward whatever ideal you hold, molding itself into what royalty should look like and simply becomes it.

Beyond the physical, your body carries a ”metaphysical” weight in the World.

Your life radiates beyond you, replenishing the world, burning and repelling negative spirits. Magical bindings meant to hold lesser bodies can be grappled and broken with raw strength, curses meant to wither or bind can be removed through breathing, and transformations you undergo forcefully or willingly are purged of weaknesses and gain a royal air. Even for rituals and contracts, the weight of your blood can crush thousands.

Physical perfection and supremacy are how Royalty reveals itself. Your body simply is what it was always meant to be.
objects.title: Body of Royalty

addons.text:
Your absurdly dense, rope-fibered musculature proves to be the perfect host for your unlimited growth potential, the two mutations synergizing in ways that rewrite your metabolic rules.

The caloric requirements of your growth are slashed to one quarter of their original values, your hyper-efficient baseline metabolism stretching each calorie four times as far as it should, meaning you can sustain sizes that previously would have required a small farm's output. As you grow larger, your muscles do not simply scale in size but compound in density, each new layer of mass packing down tighter than the last, so that at fifty feet you are not merely two hundred times stronger than a normal human but significantly beyond that, your tissues approaching the density of forged steel.

Lastly, your body permanently retains ten percent of the largest size you have ever achieved, this minimum locked in without any caloric cost whatsoever, so even if you starve for months you will never shrink below that imposing foundation.
addons.title: Friend, I Haven't Even Used This Stuff Yet

objects.text: Your Abs have Abs! Your body is now the absolute peak of human size, so massive that anyone else attempting to match your muscle mass would die from steroid overdose before getting halfway there. If anyone checks, they will find you used not even a drop of drugs or any fancy tech. Your entire physique is just pure, natural gains. You stand between roughly 2 meters and 2.2 meters tall, weighing between 160 and 210 kilograms of solid muscle with virtually no body fat. Every muscle group bulges so extremely that your muscles themselves have visible muscle definition. Your muscle fibers are braided together like high-tensile rope rather than running parallel, making your physique impossibly dense. Despite your overwhelming bulk, your speed and flexibility remain completely unhindered, allowing you to move like an Olympic athlete a fraction of your size. You can consciously flex any muscle group at will, causing it to visibly swell even larger for intimidation or posing. You can deadlift a small truck weighing over three tons with maximum effort and throw a grand piano across a room as a warm-up exercise. Your punch force is equivalent to a hydraulic press, shattering bones into gravel on contact. Handgun bullets lack the energy to penetrate more than an inch or two into your ropelike muscle tissue before stopping completely, and baseball bats simply break against your flexed torso. Maintaining this physique requires nothing more than eating regular meals and staying reasonably active, as your body handles all the complex hormonal and metabolic regulation automatically.
objects.title: I Ate Bane

addons.text:
Your dual abilities to attach extra parts has allowed you to not only use the parts of those you take at their original strength, but enhanced and made greater than even the original owner had possessed.

Similarly, as Afixion has little weight on the user’s psyche beyond what would be natural, the corruptive strain on your own through grafting has similarly been lessened.
addons.title: Grafting²

addons.text:
No longer limited to creatures, you can affix technology and other artificial objects to your body to gain their properties. 

While this naturally includes robotic and technological parts as with Bio-Machine, it also allows you to attach relics and artifacts to yourself to gain their abilities similarly to any parts you’d attach. 

This also allows you to offload some of Bio-Machine’s strain from your soul onto your body, allowing you to incorporate more technology in a timeframe.
addons.title: Techno-Biology

addons.text:
Your ability to absorb and mimic whatever you touch has allowed you to retain a semblance of these materials and substances, not unlike a minor affixion. This serves two purposes. 

Firstly, it allows you to retain access to anything you’ve absorbed before, albeit slightly less potent as it follows the same rules as your other affixions.

Secondly, it facilitates your amalgamated forms, taking much of the strain off of your mind by offloading these mutations onto being affixions.
addons.title: Semi-Permanence

addons.text:
As a spiritual attachment, whenever you plant a piece of your soul into someone, you can take a commensurate part and affix it to your own. 

This piece of their soul acts like affixing any other part of them, with the exceptions that it is always at 100% the strength of the original, and that it has little effect on your outward appearance.

Additionally, as killing someone with your spear absorbs their soul into you, doing so now allows you to, in essence, ‘affix’ it to your own, further stealing not only all of their strengths and abilities but their memories and any other spiritual connections they may have.
addons.title: Spiritual Affixion

addons.text:
Not only do these forms you can take count as ‘Affixions’, and thus benefit from them, allowing you to enhance these forms, or even amalgamate them together.

Firstly, as your forms count as affixions, you can choose to instead transform partially, rather than fully, allowing you to lessen the strain of taking a form by only tapping into part of it (A dragons wings, some of a leviathan’s tentacles, etc)

Secondly, by taking an additional affixion from the enemy you defeated, you can, instead of affixing it traditionally, use it to enhance the form you have taken, making it more powerful than the original, albeit requiring more training to grow accustomed to.

Finally, you can use one of these additional affixions taken to create an amalgamated form between two defeated foes, enhancing their benefits, merging capabilities, and mitigating weaknesses. Unfortunately, you will need at least one new affixion to combine with one of your forms to create a merged one. Fortunately, creating a merged form does not destroy or replace the original used to create it.
addons.title: Amalgamation

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to attach pieces of other creatures to yourself to gain their power. 

Your body is covered in specialised cells that allow you to affix these parts to your body, or even implant them internally if need be, completely free from any chance of rejection. After affixation, these pieces act as if they  were your own limbs, including a minor co-ordination enhancement to compensate for the additional limbs, organs, eyes, etc. 

The primary benefit of this however is that you will gain the strengths and skills of any creature whose parts you attach to yourself, including powers and esoteric abilities. While usually these are only 75% the strength of the original, this can be increased to their full strength by attaching a relevant part to yourself (the brain of a psychic in your ribs, the legs of a speedster, etc). 

Your body naturally adapts to make attachment points cohesive (if not necessarily aesthetically pleasing).
objects.title: Affixion

addons.title: Crystallized Ichor
addons.text:
Your golden ichor and the elixir of life in your veins have fused, becoming an ichor rich with life itself. The elixir of life's ability to heal yourself becomes wider ranging, purging weaknesses as it heals. You are now able to burn away your human imperfections in a tiny fraction of the time it took before. The effects of this are likewise supercharged as expected, allowing you reach heights you could only dream about before. This applies to any biological powers that you have, allowing you to swiftly evolve them. 

However, where this combination really shines is when you allow another to drink your ichor. In addition the effects of the elixir of life, their own imperfections will be burnt away, as if they had the Prima Materia flowing through their veins. What's more, you can choose the direction this goes in, giving you the ability to choose how others are improved by your ichor. The gift of your ichor allows you to improve others as you like. 

Finally, should you allow someone to drink an entire cup of your ichor, they can permanently gain the benefits of Promethean Ichor. Their heart will crystallize and they'll begin to improve, guided by the Prima Materia in their veins.

objects.text:
Instead of blood, a more primordial liquid now flows through your veins. Your body has become a fountain for the elixir of life, a primeval fluid of miraculous properties. Your heart endlessly pumps this elixir out, allowing for infinite production of the elixir beyond conventional biological constraints. 

The most basic benefit is healing: Ingesting even the tiniest amount can restore a human to peak condition, cleansing them of all disease and undoing all damage, regardless of how severe the injuries sustained were. Moreover, a shot glass' worth of elixir can fully resurrect a person from death. Even if only a single fragment of bone remained of their corpus, a complete new body would simply form around it. 

Further consumption will enhance the recipient's mind, body, and spirit to the theoretical maximum of what they can achieve, transforming them into a paragon of their species. Drinking a full cup of elixir would grant someone total agelessness and even a minor healing factor. Lastly, the elixir of life acts a highly potent source of mana, with a single drop having the potential to act as fuel for a dozen spells.

As the source of the elixir, it is naturally saturated within every fiber of your being at all times, granting you unparalleled immortality and regenerative powers as you gain all benefits of the elixir but with a thousandfold increase in potency.
objects.title: Fons Vitae

objects.text:
Your genetic foundation has been comprehensively upgraded. Where most life is built upon a double helix of DNA, your biology is structured around a far more stable and efficient quadruple helix.

The massive redundancy and stability of this genetic architecture renders your biology uncompromising. You are functionally immune to cellular degradation (effectively halting natural aging), disease, and radiation, while also being highly resistant to biological corruption and mutation.

You remain entirely recognizable as yourself - a human remains a human, a dragon remains a dragon - but the biological substrate of your body operates on a completely different level. Every cell, muscle fiber, and bone in your body is drastically tougher, faster, stronger, and more energy-efficient. 

This improvement also enhances any inherent biological abilities you possess.
