A dragon’s flames burn hotter, a vampire’s regeneration is faster, and a Kryptonian body processes solar energy far more efficiently. While this power grants no new abilities, it pushes existing ones to their absolute theoretical limits.
objects.title: Superior Clay

objects.text:
You are an Avali, a raptor like feathered alien hailing from your icy home planet of Avalon. Also colloquially known as space chickens.

You are short, standing at 1-1.2 meters on average. You posses slick, slighting oily feathers meant to handle the cold and regulate body temperature, with your patterns being the only hint of sexual dimorphism as AMAB Avalis tend to have iridescent banded patterns while AFABs are two toned with speckles on their feathers, these feathers also allow you to float and glide in low gravity planets such as Avalon. You have four ears which makes hearing your primary sense, giving you super hearing by human standards, and the ability to communicate through specific sounds uncaught by humans. You aren't a water based life form and instead run on ammonia which is seen mostly through your purple blood, making you adapted to cold environments and struggle with Earth-like temperatures, though this can be mitigated through cybernetics. Finally, that is what your Avalis are known for... immense capacity for cybernetic enhancements, beating even other species, to the point it is common for Avalis to have full on conversions into something completely synthetic.

As an Avali, you gain access to their tech, particularly their cybernetic enhancements as it is a rarity for an Avali to not be cybernetically enhanced at all. Some of the common augmentations are Guardian Nanites that helps regulate health (though you may still need to go to the hospital for major injuries and illnesses), and an Environmentsl Protection Pack (EPP) which helps you adapt to any environment, bypassing your biology's need to be in the cold. Finally, you get neural implants which connects you to the Nexus, an augmented reality based Internet of sorts for all Avali citizens, which might be useful should you wish to connect with your people. And considering Avalis need to be in Packs which accept and support them, maybe that is something you would love to seek out?

Overall, you are one of the most longstanding nomadic space faring races in the galaxy. Your technological prowess is your power, and your people are in the stars willing to back you up should you need them. Go forth youngling, and seize your destiny.
objects.title: Avali

addons.text:
Rather than becoming obsolete because of your natural ability to fly, your wings have mutated dimensional properties. You can now use them to directly breach into hyperspace or other dimensions you are familiar with, or are adjacent to the one you are in, with only a single flap of your wings.

Furthermore, you gain an innate grasp of how to navigate hyperspace. As long as you know the coordinates of your destination relative to yourself, you can find an ideal path to get there. This also gives you a talent for general interstellar navigation and celestial cartography.
addons.title: Dimensional Wings

objects.text:
You have become a Dark Archangel, a naturally immensely powerful psychic being, that has been forcefully sealed into a prison of flesh and blood. Your fleshy prison is naturally more robust and resilient than a human's; your physique is roughly six times as powerful and enduring in all respects.

The immense psychic might you were born with has been burned as fuel to elevate your psychic potential and talent, as otherwise you would have lacked the ability to grow in power, rather than being fixed at the point of having to spend weeks to destroy a planet's surface.

Your fleshy prison appears similar to a human, the only difference being a pair of angelic wings with feathers as dark as the abyss on your back, and your form being of an unearthly, timeless, inhuman beauty, though not in an uncanny valley way. You are not human, and humans will notice.

In exchange for the power you have lost, you have gained an incredible affinity for psychics, limitless potential within psychics, and unparalleled talent for all aspects of psychics. You can develop psychic techniques that the most talented psychics can only dream of, and progress through psychic power systems in record-breaking time.

You can naturally awaken any local psychic power system at will, and you can even convert preexisting psychic powers into a form compatible with the local system, though that is optional.

Your wings allow you to fly at supersonic speed, and you can retract and open them at will, allowing you to hide them, though your unearthly beauty remains. Clothing that covers your back does not restrict your wings.
objects.title: Dark Archangel

addons.text:
Your draconic self adapts well to your already dragon blooded body. You now have far more precise control over the dragon manifesting in your dreams, amplifying your already immense physical prowess, turning your body more beastial than humanoid even when trying to look more human. This means that even in your least draconic form, you just have that aura coming off of you that makes almost everybody tremble in your might. This also gives you full control over your full dragon form, no longer needing a separate personality which takes over when you're asleep and in danger, instead, having the instincts to be never taken aback when resting again. You are now truly a monster, the very power you were seeking when you took hold of that need to get stronger.

Finally, even your ability to create more dragons are improved. You now have the choice into either turning them into a Dragonkin, or giving them your blood, making them a Half-Dragon. With all that power, you are also able to take it away, stripping them of their abilities should they prove too ambitious and want to take your place as the god among them. Even then, your growth potential is heightened further by the perfect synergy of your body and your dreams, and so long as you follow the Core of your draconic being, you could grow exponentially stronger so that nobody would dare take you down.

Go forth pride of the dragons. Seize the power that's meant for you and only you.

Furthermore, you gain an innate grasp of how to navigate hyperspace. As long as you know the coordinates of your destination relative to yourself, you can find an ideal path to get there. This also gives you a talent for general interstellar navigation and celestial cartography.
addons.title: Dragon Made Manifest

addons.text: Instead of becoming a Mulawin or a Ravena, your draconic self taps into a far more ancient type of creature which you shall then be turned into. You are a Florante, what is potentially the only remaining dragon-like ancestors of the Philippines' winged warriors, though that is at least a theory as to what they are. Florantes posses magical abilities similar to their Mulawin and Ravena counterparts, except they possess leathery wings with shiny multicolor scales (though you may determine the color scheme and patterns). They do still possess some feathers, in particular, they have a long feathery mane that looks more lion than bird. This is foreshadowing for their further abilities which their bird brethren don't have. Like other dragon dreamers, they can partially transform their body parts into draconic forms, but theirs specifically turn into feathered dragons, characterized by their lion-like plumes covering their heads. The gems representing their cores are now empowered by elemental magic, even moreso than other dragons as nature seems to accept you as its master. You can command the winds with a swish of your wings, call forth tidal waves, bend the trees to your will, and summon a burning inferno. Such power rivals the Sangre of Encantadia where Mulawins/Ravenas tend to be seen. You are essentially a magical marvel. So embrace the long hidden primal roots of the bird folk. Embody the wrath of nature, the domain that is your birthright. Your dreams now makes you a lord, so embrace your childlike fascination with the wilds and claim this power as your own.
addons.title: Lipad Ng Florante

addons.text:
Whatever Object of Power you chose, it is now blessed with your draconic core. The Object shall have some sort of gem forged into it, which is of course, based on the gem from your dreams. This gem is near indestructible, unable to be removed from the object unless you destroy the object itself. It is the source of its power as well as your influence over whoever ends up as the lucky owner of this artifact which you are now.

You have some influence over folks who align with your core drive, being able to compell them into taking you or using you in some way. And even if they aren't necessarily similar to you, you can slowly influence them into acting aligned to your goals. What truly gets folks to make use of you as an artifact however is the transformation you give them. They are the ones who gain your draconic abilities, with contact or usage of you as an item giving them the same abilities as what would've been your dream dragon. What's best is the more they are compelled to rely on you, the more your bond with them will grow, until finally, you can speak to them in their minds and even appear in their dreams.

Two things could happen at this point. If they formed sufficient trust with you, you could opt for a partnership with them, forming a symbiotic relationship with your wielder who shall develop the abilities you provided them to the best of their efforts. This of course lands you an ally who can learn to utilize you in creative ways while loyally staying by your side. If this doesn't work out however, you can choose to destroy them internally, fully taking over their body through possession. And thus, you now get a powered body of your own, fully fused with what you once was, a warrior you yourself molded for your benefit.

Whatever you choose, you are now a provider of power. Many shall seek to take you for themselves. But who could truly be worthy of you?
addons.title: Dragon Core Artifact

objects.text:
It is believed that the dragons of old are the manifestations of every creature's want for power. The essence of these dreams were crystalized into gems, which at first, could only be vaguely seen in the minds of their would be wielders. At some point however, in a huge burst of emotion, these gems will fully take over their host's mind, body, and soul. This turns them into huge, vaguely reptilian creatures, which then proceeds to wreak havoc, their selves lost in the dragon of their dreams.

You are one of the lucky few who survived this.

Your dreams have manifested into a transformation. You can partially transform your body parts into draconic forms, for example, manifesting jaws on your arms or growing wings. Your body becomes the vessel for the dragon underneath, giving you the typical benefits a dragon would have such as elemental breaths, flight, and super strength, all compressed into your small form. The nature of the dragon you manifests depends on the specific "Core" of your dreams, the overall thing that drives you.

A quick example of a Core could be "Law", which drives you to follow a certain code, with your breath powers having a mind control esque effect. Another example could be "Knowledge", which drives you in pursuit of learning, also giving you a wider range of elemental breaths that you can manipulate based on your knowledge on its chemistry.

You can also fully transform into your full draconic form, which has the potential to manifest into several shapes and sizes so long as it is somewhat reptilian. To do so, you have to let yourself fall into slumber, trusting your draconic half to protect you, which tends to be an automatic defense response if you're unconscious and in danger. With the dragon manifesting a personality which only focuses on your survival.

Lastly, you also have the ability to create more dragon dreamers. This is through a ritual done via sleeping at the same time as your target. You will have to allow them to witness the gem that lies inside you. Should they accept your offer to be your kin, they will be given a shard of your gem embedded into them, transforming them into a weaker dragon with your exact same abilities. If they refuse however, you can force the transformation upon them, turning them into loyal drakes that are loyal to you, but losing their original sense of self. Do be careful on who you share your abilities to however, for if a dragon connected to you wishes to be more powerful, they can slay you and devour the gem that's actually deep within your core. This way they can steal your draconic abilities, making them the only master of their dreams.
objects.title: Dragon Dreams

addons.text:
You now have complete control of your spore cycle and how your spores spread and grow across your world, terraforming it into a complex, multi-layered dungeon ecosystem. You can guide how your progeny adapt to their environments and which aspects of powers and metaphysics they incorporate, creating new species to fill different niches in the same ecosystem.

You and your progeny can even shift away from being dungeons into several different adjacent niches with their own strengths and weaknesses.

For example, Villages specialize in social monsters that provide service to local populations, and Facilities allow themselves to be domesticated and provide materials in exchange for labor energy.

Haunts prefer subtle and psychological prodding of their visitors for substance, while Arenas spawn a few powerful monsters in a single large chamber, rather than sprawling outward.

Incursions are smaller but spread more aggressively and tactically, while Raids are massive and create dangerous traps and monsters, but dominate entire ecosystems.

Certain species can evolve to parasitize or symbiotize other dungeons, like Randomizers, which copy and hijack other dungeons’ monster production, Trap Rooms which feed by killing a host dungeon’s visitors, Treasuries, which give a host extra treasure to lure more visitors, and Bastions, which defend an entire region’s dungeon ecosystem.
addons.title: Dungeon Speciation

objects.text:
You are a Dungeon, an arcane geobiological superorganism. Once rooted in place, your body rapidly grows into a large sprawling labyrinthine internal structure that also connects and adapts to local metaphysical systems.   You can manifest an avatar with all of your powers from your core that allows you to explore your own structure and interact with the world normally.

You adapt immediately to the local environment, culture, technology and metaphysics once you take root, even absorbing and metabolizing pollution or corruption. Your anatomy starts to meld into your local environment, internals copying the shape of nearby architecture and ecosystems. You can also choose to incorporate the metaphysics of your other powers.
 Your body grows to around fifteen large rooms and several corridors at the start once you take root, and grows much larger and more complex with time and energy, up to a few hundred rooms. Your brain is stored in a central core at the bottom of your structure, and your organs are spread out into decentralized clusters. As you grow larger and more complex, you can develop sub-cores in certain wings. You can influence what kind of structures and layouts grow inside of you.

Your biology is sustained by a diet of absorbed physical, mental, and spiritual exertion of foreign bodies inside of you. Death inside of you also provides a large burst of sustenance, but isn’t necessarily more efficient than keeping visitors sustained and active over long periods of visitation. Ideally, you would want to maintain a steady stream of long term or repeat visitors to feed on local populations, though it is possible to adapt to other feeding habits.

At intermittent periods, you will eject small room-sized burrowing spores into the atmosphere of your world that will slowly start to form new dungeons once embedded. Your progeny are as intelligent as you are, and will form their own adaptations and specializations depending on where they take root.

Your body also spawns pseudobiological monster constructs. Monsters defend your body as well as challenge visitors. While they normally hold back in order to draw the most energy out of visitors, they become more aggressive when they detect actual attempts to harm you. More powerful monsters spawn in open chambers near major organ clusters. Monsters mimic local biology and myth and can wield local power systems or your own. You can shape their behavior patterns and abilities, but they are not under your direct command, and can't survive long periods outside your body.

You have a few ways to incentivize visitors to help you feed:

You can disgorge monsters into the surrounding area as dangerous nuisances in order to provoke local populations into responding. This will automatically happen if you go too long without being fed.

By granting monsters social intelligence, they will be able to guide, trick or negotiate with visitors and nearby populations. They will also form small societies in pockets of your body away from the main chambers and corridors that are loyal to you and your interests.

The certain body tissue are transmuted into materials that are aesthetically pleasing, industrially useful, or metaphysically resonant to local populations. These materials are deposited in chambers adjacent to the most active areas of your structure to draw visitors to them. Certain monsters can produce useful biological products that persist after destruction, and intelligent monsters can refine them into goods and technology as well to trade or place in active areas.

Your entrance and campfire-like nodes in certain calm zones of your body dowse visitors in metabolic microbes to absorb their exerted energy. These microbes are metaphysically active and can increase the strength, intelligence and natural powers of particularly productive visitors or even grant them new abilities. These microbes can also transmit information to other dungeons that the visitors explore.
objects.title: Living Dungeon

objects.text:
At first glance, you appear to be a typical merfolk. You possess a swift swimming tail of any aquatic creature of your choice which can transform into a set of legs at will. Your voice could also lull people into lowering their guard towards you, the typical arsenal of a siren.

But you aren't any mere sea dweller.

You are royalty, the result of a supposed ancient union between the draconic rulers of the sky and the aquatic rulers of the ocean. As such, your abilities manifest as a perfect hybrid of both. The true monarch of both blue worlds. The carp who jumped over the waterfall to become a dragon.

As such, through expending some energy, you are able to take the form of an aquatic dragon. The look of your dragon form resembles the fish tail you already picked. As a dragon, you have an intense presence that intimidates people into submitting to you, a far more immense version of your siren voice. You also gain considerable size and durability. Truly befitting a monster such as you.

Finally, you gain mastery over the elements of fire and water, able to bend it to your will. Royal dragon blooded merfolk before you are even able to manifest fish like familiars called "Santelmos", creatures which are made of fire, which you can then send to do your bidding or track down and strike at your enemies.

Overall, you have the potential to rule the skies and seas. Master your gifts, and wear the crown you are born to earn.
objects.title: Bridge of the Skies and Seas

addons.title: True Shard Bud
addons.text: You are no longer an emulation of a shard bud, but in fact a true bud, essentially a freshly split off fragment of your parent shard. If you have the Shard power origin then you are still networked with your progenitor while if you have Shardless or Patron then you are a fully independent newborn shard. Either way, the imposed limitations you are under are no longer as restrictive as before. You're physically still the same size if not a bit bigger now, but fortunately for the population of the planet you live on you now have access to the standard shard ability to shift your mass across multiple dimensions, reducing your form to less than a hundredth of its true surface area, although without supporting powers you will be forced to maintain at least that much mass in this dimension. Also because of this, your issues with power consumption are no longer as bad as before, as you now draw energy from the mantle of one or more uninhabited dimensional variants of the earth as well as other sources available to you such as the solar energy that hits your form. You now have an even easier time replicating powers, going beyond "The Fragile One" as now a host of powers are possible to emulate including powers on the level of the Triumvirate. However, you still lack the innate knowledge and experience proper shards possess, thus you will be limited in the complexity of and how many powers you can maintain at once since you are forced to handle the details yourself; Alexandria is possible to replicate while Eidolon is a pipe dream. Theoretically you could grow to one day match the basic feats of a Nascent Entity, but that is a minimum of several millenia of practice and size growth away with this power alone, centuries if you have Negentropy or Shardless, and far longer to surpass them. You may channel these powers through your avatar or use them with your true body, though be careful to not break the biosphere if you do the latter since at that scale even a basic blaster power might carve a hole in the planet. If you want, you may even create multiple avatars, though you may want to emulate some form of enhanced multitasking power if you want to control them independently, and each avatar shares the same 'pool' of power meaning any use of them beyond being additional vectors to launch attacks from will weaken them proportionally. Your innate durability and regeneration are now far better, as being made of shard matter means you can easily reabsorb damaged tissue or replace it by transmuting absorbed matter into more shard matter over time, and you have no obvious weak points aside from a central processing node located near your 'center'. Considering that you can move it into another dimension if needed, you are pretty much unkillable by conventional means, especially as emulating a power to absorb energy would allow you to literally 'eat' nuclear explosions. The most interesting effect is the change to your inner ecosystem. All lifeforms within your body are now made of shard matter, with a vast multitude of forms including sapient bioforms who are essentially a society of people who all have the Passenger power along with the ability to emulate powers as you can capped at 5 SP strength. All of these beings are 'linked' to you in a pseudo network, working to maintain your body and serving various subfunctions. The more animalistic organisms are completely autonomous, at most vaguely responding to conscious desires, but the sapient beings will follow you as if they were deployed shards with you as their entity, though you are free to allow them full autonomy if you wish. If you want, you can alter your form in a number of ways thanks to the innate nature of shard matter as a form of living programmable matter. For example, you could adapt your emulated powers and form to become a living vessel, allowing for space traversal much like the entities, although it is highly recommended that you absorb a large amount of matter and energy beforehand so you don't starve to death unless you are negentropic. Alternatively, you could have a portion of your mass attempt to emulate earth topology so as to make it possible for normal humans to live on and within your form, although your flesh isn't in any way a viable food source so they will need to import plants and animals. If you have certain Trump abilities such as Power Seed or Power Broker, you could use your flesh as a medium to grant powers similar to Cauldron vials, however doing this with unfamiliar species like non-humans may lead to mutations until you refine the process.

objects.text: You... are big. Which, in many cases, is a bit of an understatement. You're not some paltry, ant-sized kaiju. You're, at minimum, the size of a small continental plate. You're still a living, breathing thing, but you now operate at a scale few other organisms can come anywhere close to matching. You are a superorganism. For all intents and purposes, wherever you are- You are the geology. This, of course, has led to some changes. Your outer appearance is... vague. Eldritch even. If you were human before, you're only vaguely humanoidish now- with a hefty dose of squinting and from far, far away- and look closer to a extremely talented and mutated contortionist. Not that anyone would really be able to look at you properly, with your body crushing and shoving continents aside under your bulk as you float atop the mantle. Still, hands, feet, a torso, and a head. The works. Maybe more of each than would be normal. Despite such size, you are capable of moving. To the detriment of both any mortals remotely nearby, and the stability of the ecospheres and continents around you. Beyond what other powers you may have- that may have been warped and enhanced by your new geobiology- you are incredibly durable. Nuclear bombs at the scale of modern day just simply aren't enough to do more than sheer off a few layers of your skin with a direct blast. Even if one is set off inside you, you can almost 'walk' it off unless it is placed in a very vulnerable area like your brain- if for some reason you don't have extras or a distributed neural network- and even then, you'd have decent odds of surviving with a minor case of severe brain damage. Your regeneration- for your size- is quick, as it is an extension of your ability to purposefully rearrange your internal matter to a degree; shifting the location of and reshaping organs and veins and bones as needed, with changing 'passages' needing an hour or twos of minimal effort. The most interesting bits- depending on one's enthusiasm- is what has come to live inside you. Even normal-sized organisms are hosts for ecosystems of smaller ones, much less beings of your scale. The organisms that have made their homes within your flesh range the whole gamut- from parasites, to mutualistic symbiotes, to normal biological cells warped and grown to the extreme. All of which are subtly affected by your will, with more intelligent and empathic being able to follow and hear your directions. Among them are even sapient beings that mimic yourself- if you weren't a superorganism- that inherit weaker versions of your powers. These sapients live, die, and form communities within you, and are utterly loyal and protective of yourself. Despite being so large, you don't need normal food or sustenance to survive. Only partially needing to 'breathe', and quasi-feeding off the heat and motion of the molten core beneath you. You would not be able to survive in the vacuum of space, or on a planet without a molten core to rest atop, but otherwise your needs are quite minimal. Just try to avoid someone setting up a national park in your throat.
objects.title: Superorganism

objects.text:
You are a servant of death.

Once a dying soul, whatever embodiment of Death that exists had instead taken you in as their weapon. What this means is that you are now imbued with a non aging body, a physical form that is able to shift into a shadowy ectoplasmic goop that can harden and create constructs which you can weaponize against those whom you deem deserving of death.

As Death's chosen familiar, you start off not having full agency over your power. The current Reaper would routinely call upon you, and they can mold your body to their whims. While in whatever state you are on, you are simply tasked to follow whatever order your Reaper has. The Reaper cannot fully control you, and you are still able to rebel if you want. Outright disobedience however may result in your body corrupting, you turning more and more into goop until you cannot sustain your form anymore. Thankfully, the Reaper is normally reasonable, able to return your body to normal so long as you compromise with them. It's fine though, after all, someday, you *will* take their place.

Once you've gain enough mastery over your powers however, your Reaper shall put you to the test, you are to collect a particular soul, the specifics is up to your Reaper. Once you succeed, you will finally be made a Reaper of your own right, having full control of your powers and now free to create as many familiars as you like. You shall now have the mastery over your soul and others, and now it is clear, your time as a familiar is simply molding you for this role you are meant to have.

You are an angel of death, earn your feathers and you may be the reaperman everyone fears.
objects.title: The Reaper's Familiar

addons.title: Robozon-1
addons.text: You have now become what Robozons consider one of their few "Legends": Robozon-1. In myth, this Robozon could fly through space at FTL speeds between planets, Terraform with just its sheer might, and more. It could create more of its species just by wishing it. It could even convert others into Robozons that bent to its' will. Now, you aren't quite capable of ALL of that, but very close. You can indeed initiate FTL, but that has a recharge period between uses proportional to how far. In Star Wars, something like Coruscant to Tatooine would take a month to recharge, longer if you strain yourself while waiting. While you can't terraform, you become strong enough to punch entire holes through mountains visible from the other side. However, the final part of the myth is fully true. If you were to inject your code into another being in some way, it can transform them into a Robozon version of themselves, non-biological powers entact, with a loyalty towards you unless ruined by you. Finally, you also become able to absorb knowledge of what you integrate into your database and how they work.

objects.text: Robozons are theorized to be from a distant corner of the galaxy. After all, not all life is Carbon-based. In this case, you are a silicon based lifeform. Your thoughts are data, the code that flows through you is your DNA, and more. What's more, your form is only pseudo-limited. Instead of Humanoid, you can be an animal, a vehicle, a 3D shape, etc. However, you are VISIBLY mechanical, and your appearance isn't quite human even if you pick a humanoid shape. Robozons are capable of technopathy, along with supreme ease of integration into their systems. If they encounter a human minigun, they simply need to hug it close to them for a minute, and they will be able to morph parts of their bodies into miniguns. Or if they were to be hit with a lightsaber from Star Wars and they could act fast enough, they could take it in and be able to become a Lightsaber Porcupine, although that would waste the Kyber Crystal much faster. Finally, you can communicate with technology like you would any other being. Talk to a traffic light, and it'll tell you anyone it remembers going through a red light, or stopping long enough to get a good look at them. Talk to a spaceship, and learn any and all information in its databanks no matter its defenses. Technology is generally inclined to at least hear you out no matter what, but further interactions depend on stuff like how its owner treats it, and the personality gained from experiences. The Millennium Falcon from Star Wars could be an experienced older man, but distrustful of authorities, or the Omnitrix could be a child wise beyond his years with so much knowledge from alien life.
objects.title: Robozons

addons.title: Medusa (Kid Icarus Uprising)
addons.text:
Through the mixing of dark magic, divinity, and your Gorgon nature, you have ascended. Now you have gained the knowledge, traits, abilities, and skills of the Goddess of Darkness and Queen of the Underworld herself, Medusa; you optionally may also gain her appearance.

With your newfound power and status, you could mold and shape souls, communicate telepathically, sense presences, create pocket dimensions, shift to sizes that breach the cloud line, read memories, cause natural disasters, know all manner of dark magic, infuse your petrifaction into your magic, strike with the force to trigger earthquakes and maim other gods, and much more.

addons.title: Sideless Effect
addons.text: Through the newfound inert property of your blood, you can now choose which effect your blood has, independent of which side it is from. Each drop is a choice of healing, harming, or just regular blood.

addons.title: Modified Pegasus
addons.text:
It seems that your horse has been further modified, using your Gorgon nature as a catalyst, gaining the traits of Pegasus.

Now, your horse cannot only fly with the grace of an eagle even at speeds matching its maximum upon the ground, but also create springs of clean, fresh water just by striking its hooves on the ground.

objects.text:
You have become a variant of Gorgon, being a beautiful, powerful, and very dangerous creature.

From your head flows long, curly hair that shifts and merges into mentally controlled snakes, that bear the strength to easily crush a man to death, and venom potent enough to kill over a hundred men with a single bite.

From your back sprouts a pair of golden wings that allow you to match even the greatest of eagles and hawks in flight. Whilst your body is coated in dragon-like scales, that have even steel weapons shatter upon you, and grant you claws that slice like masterwork swords. Further, beneath the surface, dense and coiled muscles grant you the might to crumple steel plate like cardboard and rival horses in speed.

The blood that flows through your veins is capable of both great healing and harm. Blood that is from your left side harms, being fatal to mortals, whilst that from the right nourishes, cures disease, and can heal nigh-anything save death.

Most famously is your eyes and gaze, as should you wish, you can cause those that meet your gaze to turn to stone, with only those possessing a potent magical resistance avoiding such a fate. However, even without the petrification, the fierceness and intensity of your eyes and gaze can cause deep fear and momentary paralysis in those that see them.
objects.title: Gorgon Variant

addons.title: You are my Master
addons.text:
By designating your Rider as your 'Master', you can evolve the transformations you're capable of even further. Beginning with all around improvements and an exclusive trait or ability that perfectly complements both of you, but more importantly, you can have multiple variant forms for the same Rider. 

For example, with an aggressive Rider wielding fire powers, you may become a Phoenix-like form that represents their maximum potential, a blazing sword capable of manipulating lava, or even armor that makes them immune to all forms of fire and absorb it for further power.

The deeper your bond with your 'Master' and through training, these forms can become more varied and stronger, to the point of even becoming multiple of or switching between them simultaneously.

objects.text:
You are a Mount.

A strange shapeshifting creature who gains new forms and abilities depending on who or what you are currently bonded with. This is done through a lead you can manifest around your neck like that of a horse. When held by a willing Rider, you become some sort of large armored creature capable of carrying your partner, with whatever properties of this form being dependent on your rider and what sort of bond you share with them. Some quick examples might be a large knight with a powerful blade, with your partner riding on your back. Another could be you becoming a high tech motorcycle with rocket launchers strapped on your sides. There are nearly endless possibilities, all dependent on you and your rider's capabilities, both alone and together.

If you and your Rider posseses powers outside of this ability as well, you may share them so long as they are riding you. You may also have multiple Riders at the same time, but too much will overtax you, causing you to be suddenly transformed back into your typical form without being able to use your Mount abilities for a while, at least until you regain your energy. This is a high risk high reward move however, as with the right combinations, you can work together with your riders to form absolutely broken builds, all with the right combination and trust with one another.

Finally, outside of manifesting your Mount form, you are free to look like whatever you please, though most of your abilities are not as effective outside of having a rider. This is a good species to be if you wish for a more cooperative ability, as your strength is the strength of your closest allies. So choose wisely on who you'd rather ride you.
objects.title: You are my Rider

addons.title: |-|u^^@n?
addons.text:
If you so wish, your powerful form is hidden behind a veneer of humanity. No longer is it a simple form built for your powers, instead acting as a monstrous increase to the influence of your more inhuman forms, doubly so for any form that mirrors one of your other powers.

Whereas before your larger forms would be barely noticeable, now you could tower over hills and leave craters in your wake. You could spread yourself as a shadowy mass across a whole city and still be able to act as a tangible thing across its entirety. If you have a power over souls, you could become an intangible reaper untouchable to all but the most powerful, and a power over the mind would let you spread across populations.

A small side effect of this interaction is that real forms are slightly unstable, as your power begins to favor the eldritch and ever-changing over something solid.

You don't need to worry about being vulnerable in your humanity, as said before it is a veneer, and a thin one at that. Damage to it won't harm you, only reveal the horrors beneath.

objects.text:
Your form is less a matter of biology and more one of ideas and shapes. Your shape is bound only by how much influence it possesses, as not even a physical form is required; if anything, a definite shape is harder to hold as compared to something like writhing mass of shadowy teeth and eyes, though that isn't to say it can't be done.

Influence, in your case, is merely a measure of how much you can affect the world, as well as how much it can affect you. You could become a towering behemoth, but you'd be nearly insubstantial; you could become an area of distorted reality, but you'd barely be noticed; you could become a character in a game, but the npcs could cause you very real harm.

If you have powers that deal in influencing things, the forms you take based on them will be stronger. Having a power over the mind would allow you to become a powerful cognitohazard, while having telekinesis would allow you to become a giant with much more heft.
objects.title: Without Form
Bunny in a Hat
objects.text:
Through a miraculous occurrence, you have been blessed by Magic, transforming you into a humanoid rabbit with all the benefits that come with it. Initially, you may freely choose your appearance, including traits such as rabbit ears, a tail, or rabbit legs, but you must possess at least one distinctly rabbit-like trait.

You are partly composed of magic. You are ageless and entirely immune to mundane illnesses and other biological ailments. You have no need for food, sleep, or other biological necessities, nor can you become intoxicated; however, you may still choose to eat, sleep, or otherwise indulge if you so desire. Furthermore, you can heal from non-fatal injuries as long as you possess sufficient magical energy.

You possess a modest mana capacity, but do not innately know any spells. As you grow older and make greater use of your mana, your capacity will steadily increase.

You are naturally gifted in the magics of illusion, trickery, luck, and concealment. These forms of magic come to you with remarkable intuition, as naturally as breathing. You are especially talented at manipulating magical energy, allowing you to control it with effortless ease, near-perfect efficiency, and virtually no waste.

As a rabbit, you are sensitive to anything magical, spiritual, or supernatural. Your nose and ears can detect magical energy from kilometers away, while your eyes can perceive things that would otherwise remain hidden. Through your senses, you can read magical energy like a book, allowing you to deeply understand spells and how they function. Your luck is also slightly supernatural, subtly bending circumstances in your favor. This can make your everyday life more comfortable and may occasionally allow you to come through at just the right moment in combat.

Finally, you are bestowed with a magical hat, which can take the form of either a witch's hat or a magician's hat and freely transform between the two. The hat belongs exclusively to you and is mystically bound to you. It cannot be destroyed, stolen, or lost.

By reaching into the hat, you can access an infinite inventory capable of containing anything that can fit through its opening, including magical energy. In dire circumstances, you may also hide inside the hat and cause it to vanish, allowing you to reappear at a location you have previously visited. Using this ability is extremely exhausting at first. With practice, however, the strain gradually diminishes.

addons.text:
Your ability to firebend and your Super Soldier Serum have combined to make a form of stable pseudo-extremis. Your body can now produce far more chi and has a deeper connection to it, with it passively enhancing your body above what the normal Super Soldier Serum gives and granting a major boost in regeneration. This mix of pseudo-extremis has also improved your metabolic process, raising your body's natural temperature and heat generation. 

Through manipulating your chi, you can now enhance both your body and this advanced metabolic process, allowing you to produce more heat and fire independent of your connection to the sun, and while it still uses your breath, it is far less demanding and you require less of it, possibly even producing fire and heat without breath for more chi and it being weaker.
addons.title: Extremis

addons.text: You gain the modified variant of Extremis used by Tony Stark, trading the claws, fire breathing, & electrical manipulation of the original for technopathy, digital consciousness, vastly accelerated & improved mental ability comparable to a supercomputer, no need for sleep, agelessness to go along with the super healing, and adaptation. You also gain an Extremis compatible set of armor & an RT node to make use of the Stark Variant's superior cybernetic integration.
addons.title: Stark Model Extremis (Marvel)

addons.text: You have gained Deathstroke’s ability to access brain functions on a cellular scale. This enables you to further enhance your physiology on top of what the Super-Solder Serum already provides. It also boosts your intelligence to the point where you can outsmart beings as smart as Batman. Your arsenal expands to include all of the weapons, armor, and gear used by Deathstroke, with the exception of the Godkiller sword and daggers. Finally, you gain all of the knowledge, experience, and skills of Deathstroke.
addons.title: The Other Terminator (DC Comics)

addons.text:
On top of the base enhancements from the serum, you receive the same ones as Luke Cage. You have strength that can lift over 25 tons and strike with enough force to send villains like the Rhino or Tombstone flying with one punch. 

Your musculature, bones, and skin become so dense that it's now as hard as titanium steel. Easily shrugging off gunfire, breaking nearly all mundane weapons or objects on impact, and withstand most mundane and supernatural attacks without a scratch. 

In the event that something does trump your immense durability, you have an accelerated healing factor that, while not Wolverine level, significantly improves your recovery and healing rate.

Lastly, like Luke Cage himself, you can increase the potency of your abilities through training.
addons.title: Burstein Process

objects.text: Your body has been enhanced by the Super Soldier Serum. All of your strength, speed, reaction time, durability, agility, reflexes, stamina, healing, mental processing, senses, and longevity have been pushed beyond peak human levels. Many will say that you are the next step in human evolution.
objects.title: Super Soldier Serum (Marvel)

addons.text: "Just like Shang Chi trained me. No long-range attacks. Up close and personal. Targeting nerve clusters! Pressure points! Striking with spider-speed. Hitting with spider-strength! And that, my friends, is what we call -- the Way of the Spider!" You have mastered the Way of the Spider, a unique martial arts style developed by Peter Parker and Shang-Chi following the loss of Peter’s Spider-Sense. This fighting style uses Peter's superhuman capabilities, his high level of acrobatics, and his combat training from Captain America. Originally created to compensate for the loss of his Spider-Sense, the style was further honed with its eventual return. This fighting style is so advanced it has been used by Peter to beat Spider-Woman and even stalemate Shang-Chi, who is one of the best martial artists in Marvel.
addons.title: Way of the Spider

addons.text:
Your connection to the Web of Life and Destiny has brought structure to your abilities. The raw power you gather with Galvanisation can now be controlled with far more precision, mimicking the abilities of Anansi’s chosen: Miles Morales.

Your body, now a more efficient conductor of various energies, can, with sufficient buildup, release beams of energy of varying strengths from your hands.

You can use the bioelectric field surrounding your body—the same one spider totems use to wall-crawl—to contain the beams and mold them into constructs like energy webbing. Simple weaponry such as swords and shields come to you naturally, with more complex structures possible with practice.

Through proper control, you can shift the wavelengths of the skintight energy field and alter how it interacts with light particles, allowing you to bend them and camouflage yourself within your surroundings.

The energy you create has been altered on a fundamental level. By filtering it through your blood, it has become far more effective against those who have undergone biological enhancement through chemical processes.

Through the application of the Mark of Cain technique—wherein a spider totem increases the strength of electrostatic pull around their hands to grasp matter or flesh, often causing pain—you can forcefully rip magical energies from objects and creatures, including spells, curses, and bounded fields.

Lastly, your Spider-Sense has been enhanced by your electromagnetic prowess. By focusing your sixth sense through local energy fields, you can see through solid matter to detect potential threats. Currently, you can only perceive vague outlines, but with practice, your perception will become clearer.
addons.title: Gifts of Anansi

addons.text:
It seems that through using the knowledge of the BIONICLE universe, you have modified your abilities as a Spider-Totem to include and merge with the traits and abilities of spider Rahi.

With this change your arsenal has expanded tremendously. With retractable fangs and claws, you can inject the mutagenic Hordika venom, the shrinking Sea Spider venom, the paralytic Silver Chute Spider and Dagger Spider venom, or the highly deadly Fikou venom. From your mouth and body, you produce thick green webbing that is both capable of easily restraining individuals with superhuman strength, and can be infused with your venoms to inject into struck targets. Fire-off discs of energy from your body, called Rhotuka, that can be infused with powers. You can even do things like mimic voices, change colors to blend in, skate on water, slow your bodily processes down, and survive polar and volcanic extremes without issue.

As an optional bonus, you can know the Visorak language.

Note:
The base power that Visorak can infuse into Rhotuka is that of Paralysis, with each breed having their own additional power. Boggarak cause their target to swell and float when used underwater, or crumble to dust via dehydration when used on land. Kahgarak opens portals to a pocket dimension in which no light exists. Keelerak infuses acid that can eat through nearly any material, even the nearly-indestructible protosteel. Oohnorak causes numbness to the point of incapacitation. Roporak drains the energy of the target. Suukorak creates a shrinking electrical field around the target. Vohtarak causes such an immense burning sensation that the target is incapable of focusing on anything besides their pain. Finally, Sea Spiders, while not Visorak, have the power to induce temporary stasis infused into their Rhotuka.
addons.title: Spider Rahi (BIONICLE)

addons.text:
"We're only swinging because Alchemax used me like a lab rat. I wouldn't be their tool. And I won't tolerate the Cabal. I can't. Hopefully, I'm not alone in that." — Spider-Man (Miguel O'Hara)

Your affinity for Spider-Man-related gadgets has allowed you to study the Beyond Batsuit and combine its technology with that of Marvel 2099, amplifying your strength, durability, and reaction time beyond what they were before, along with adding to the suit.

The most notable upgrade added to the suit is our Spider-leg-like appendages, which are controlled by the suit's onboard AI assistant, rivaling Miguel's own Lyla, with said Spider Legs being able to function as additional arms or connect together to form a cape, while the suit's systems have been upgraded to be on par with dedicated supercomputers, increasing their effectiveness. Another notable advancement is smart energy webs that can be used as normal web-slingers or from your fingertips, giving you additional options along with other Spider-themed gadgets.

But you are more than your suit, as, like Miguel, you gain fangs that can deliver paralyzing, NON-TOXIC venom that you're immune to, along with your nails being able to become razor-sharp, letting you dig into surfaces to climb, and being able to produce organic webbing from the spinnerets in your forearms.​

addons.title: SP//dr
addons.text:
Through your connection with a Perfect Mecha, your Spider-Totem powers have bled over and enhanced it, increasing all its capabilities several times over as it gains new forms based on those used by fellow Spider-Totems. Namely, this is expressed through your mecha being able to transform into the various iterations of the SP//dr mech usually piloted by Peni Parker (3145), from the small one-seat mech to the building-sized giant monster battlers.

Should things turn truly dire, your Mecha can take on a massively empowered form known as the Leopardon, similar to the one piloted by Leopardon from Planet Spider, and with the greater power it can transform into a ship known as the Marveller, able to take you anywhere in the universe.

objects.text:
You now possess the proportionate powers of a spider, similar to those of Spider-Man or one of his contemporaries (Silkworm, Spider-Woman, Spider-Gwen, etc.).

Your baseline strength enables you to lift up to 10 tons, add your perfect balance, lightning-fast reflexes, and agility and you can even dodge a point-blank rifle burst. Your stamina allows you to endure intense physical exertion for hours on end, as well as the trademark ability to cling to almost any surface. Most impressively, your durability is formidable—you can withstand impacts that could flatten city blocks, shrug off the collapse of entire buildings, endure a direct hit from a speeding train, and still walk away, compliment that with a mild healing factor, closing deep wounds within hours and fully mending broken bones within a day, and you are truly a very hard bug to kill. Normal humans would literally break their bones on your body, if you decided not to roll with their hits, due to how tough you are.

Your most unique ability is your spider sense, a heightened form of precognition that warns you of potential or immediate threats. It connects seamlessly with your superhuman reflexes, allowing you to avoid nearly any injury unless you consciously override these automatic reflexes. You can discern the severity of the danger by the strength of your response to it. This ability is complex and holds untapped potential that may reveal further uses with exploration and experience.

You also are privy to the knowledge on how to build Web-Shooters and any Spider-Gadgets to help you out.
objects.title: Spider-Totem (Marvel)

addons.text:
Rather than a Mutant, you may be a member of Homo novissima, the highly evolved successor to Homo Sapiens. 

The Children of the Vault have much the same expression as mutants, but are genetically isolated enough that they do not appear when detecting the X-Gene. Additionally, they have multiple forms of biotechnology and design schematics hardwired into their being, making them more inclined to the usage and development of advanced technology than their Mutant cousins.
addons.title: Child of the Vault

objects.text: Your X-Gene is activated and your latent mutant powers awaken. The powers you gain from this are up to you, but must be Alpha level and you will be able to train them through practice. You are guaranteed to not be physically mutated in an unappealing way.
objects.title: Homo Superior (Marvel)

objects.text: You have undergone the process of Terrigenesis and have awakened to your Inhuman powers. The powers that you now have are up to you. In addition to your chosen power you also posses super-human strength and durability capable of lifting over 1 ton and brushing off small arms fire, additionally you posses super-human longevity allowing you to live for 150 years. You are guaranteed not to be physically mutated in an unappealing way.
objects.title: InHomo Supremis (Marvel)

addons.text:
You are now on the level of Uranos the Undying. Your power exceeds that of many Omega-level mutants, to the point where only beings on par with Legion could hope to match you, and even then it would likely be a mutual kill.  All of your cosmic energy abilities have been augmented to their peak, along with all possible permutations of said abilities shown by Eternals. Feats like transmutation on the level of Sersi and psionics on the level of Druig are child’s play for you.

Your Gate of Babylon gains access to the armory of Uranos. The armory has powerful weapons such as self-replicating machine armies, plastic and silicon recreations of animals that can self-repair, metallic slime, eels made of fractal embers, beings made of light and angles that can shoot laser beams, and radiation elementals to name a few. You also have access to the Hex, who are loyal to you rather than the Machine or the Celestials. The output of these weapons can even exceed your durability. However, the weapons can be hacked and turned against you. 

Finally, you gain all of the collective knowledge accumulated by the Eternals over the course of their existence. Even mundane skills like Kingo’s swordsmanship are in your arsenal.
addons.title: The Undying

objects.text:
You have now become an Eternal. Eternals are an evolutionary offshoot of humanity called Homo immortalis. This branch of humanity was created by the Celestials to be at the absolute peak of what humanity could achieve evolutionarily. They were then gifted and infused with Cosmic Energy, which gave them great powers and abilities to look after the human race throughout the ages.

As an Eternal, you are immortal and are immune to things like toxins, diseases, age etc., and have a healing ability that, should you be injured somehow, you could regenerate any injured or missing tissue as long as a significant portion of your body's molecules are not dispersed.

At your baseline with no cosmic energy, your physical capabilities are such that your strength is a match for a peak-condition Spider-Man, Luke Cage, and such. Your agility, reactions, movement, and running speeds are such that you can dodge light. Your durability is where you shine in that you can take hits from an un-angry Hulk, Hercules, and an unworthy Thor and keep on going for a few days. Your intelligence is so great that you can come up with technology millennia in advance of the modern day or pick up and master new skills in days to weeks. Your senses are superhuman, allowing you to hear in a few city blocks, smell like the greatest animals of Earth, see everything for 1 mile, etc.

And all this is without the greatest gift of the Celestials to the Eternals, Cosmic Energy, the energy of the Universe itself. With this gift, your true potential as an Eternal is realized. You can enhance all your physical abilities such that your strength can allow you to throw hands with an angry Hulk, a worthy Thor, Hercules with his godhood, an actually harm them, and if you're smart, defeat them. Your agility is such that you now view light as standing still and can fly the cosmos under your own power by manipulating gravitons around yourself. Your durability matches your strength in that it takes hits from an angry Hulk and a worthy Thor to make you bleed. Your life force is augmented by Cosmic energy, bolstering your metabolism so that you no longer get tired from any physical exertion, need to breathe, an can travel space without any equipment. Your intelligence has been enhanced such that you are capable of interpreting DNA code at a glance, accurately enough to determine parentage. You have basic cosmic awareness with a range as big as a planet, have perfect memory and indexing, such that memories are to you as 'real' as the present, with your most vivid memory dominating your perceptions. Your senses are now godly, allowing you to see through solid objects, the entire electromagnetic spectrum, telescopic vision to see objects in clear detail at long distances, even minuscule things like strands of DNA while in orbit casually, and with a bit of focus, down to the microscopic level.

This is only the basics of what cosmic energy unlocked for you. It also gave you telekinesis/molecular manipulation that at its peak can create whole ships from the molecules around you or create inviolable shields that can last for hours, telepathy to read and even manipulate the minds of others, illusions, teleportation, and the ability to manipulate cosmic energy in the form of beams from your eyes or beams, flashes, and blasts from your hands as various types of energy (gravity, various electromagnetic, quantum, etc.).

As of right now, you can only enhance yourself with the energy and do the bare basics of the above skills, like reading minds of those close by, or moving objects around a room and shooting basic cosmic energy beams from your eyes and hands. So you are given a database in your head on how to train your abilities to the highest levels that an Eternal can reach.
objects.title: Homo Immortalis (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Deviants are one of the three groups that resulted from the Celestials’ experiments on the human race and other species such as the Skrulls and the Kree. These experiments divided those species into three branches: Deviants, Eternals, and the baseline race.

Deviants possess an unstable genetic code that causes random mutations, making each individual incredibly unique; however, this instability often results in grotesque appearances. If a Deviant undergoes Excess Deviation, they grow larger and stronger and may develop new abilities, but they lose their sanity in the process. A Deviant experiencing Excess Deviation can even become a colossal monster capable of destroying an entire city.

Deviants are genetically similar to Earth’s mutants, but their unpredictable mutations ensure that offspring bear little to no resemblance to their parents. They are widely despised by their counterparts, the Eternals, who regard them as abominations and enemies. In turn, the Deviants resent the Eternals for their favored status and perceived superiority granted by the Celestials. This mutual hatred has fueled a war between the Eternals and the Deviants that has lasted for millennia and spread across the galaxy.

As a Deviant, you possess an ability similar to that of Kro, the Deviants’ general. You have conscious control over your body’s structure, allowing you to manipulate your own genetic makeup. This grants you a superhuman physique, including enhanced strength, durability, stamina, and speed, and allows you to shapeshift at will or even grant yourself new abilities. You can become immune to disease, halt aging while maintaining a youthful body, and command your body to rapidly heal from injuries. However, you are not nearly as strong or as durable as an Eternal.

Through practice and mastery of your abilities, you can grow stronger in much the same way an Eternal hones their powers. Over time, you may even learn to intentionally trigger Excess Deviation while retaining conscious control. Reaching the level of an Eternal such as Ikaris would take years of effort, while matching the might of the greatest Eternals, like Zuras, would require centuries or even millennia.
objects.title: Homo Descendus (Marvel)

addons.text:
On top of being an Asgardian, you have become a Valkyrur, an ancient race with powerful abilities exceeding that of normal humans. They can run at the speed of motor vehicles, cut bullets out of the air, have bullets bounce off their bare skin, and punch through tank armor, but none of this is new to an Asgardian. Rather, the new ability you have gained is to activate, synthesize, and use Ragnite, an anomalous material with numerous unusual properties.

Ragnite can levitate, generate, conduct, and direct incredible clean energy (either stably or as explosive force), enhance your Valkyrur powers even further, rapidly heal severe injuries, create powerful armor plating or ammo coating, be turned into chemical weaponry, or any number of other applications. It's like petrochemicals, nuclear material, & magic crystals all rolled into one.

You also gain mastery over all technology discovered in the world of Valkyria Chronicles, allowing you to make full use of your newfound Ragnite. This includes super-tanks, Ragnite generators, naval vessels, Ragnite nuke equivalents and energy beams, anti-tank weapons, body armor & personal weapons, Artificial Valkyria cyborgs, and many other things besides.
addons.title: Edelweiss (Valkyria Chronicles)

objects.text:
Your physiology and soul have been reborn as an Asgardian, giving you power fit for a young deity. Amplifying your physical attributes to lift 30 tons, exert yourself in physical activity for 24 hours straight, withstand high temperatures, heal from mortal injury, and move at sonic speeds. At bare minimum.

Your longevity extends far beyond the thousands, making you age much slower and immune to all earthly diseases. You aren’t immune to the effects of aging however. 

As a natural born Asgardian, you have innate talent in armed and unarmed combat, weaponry and horsemanship. As well as Allspeak, allowing you to communicate with any and all living beings, regardless of language.

You possess an aptitude to manipulate mystical and cosmic energies for various applications such as: teleportation, shapeshifting, physical augmentation, forcefield creation, and destructive blasts.

Finally, whether through natural talent, training, or some other method, you will develop a specific set of powers based on your area of expertise and/or personality. All of which, you will have complete mastery over.
objects.title: Asgardian (Marvel)

addons.text:
The Death Seed has seen you as its rightful heir due to your celestial nature, combining with the seed of power that you consumed from Ego to the level that even something similar to the Life Seed would be incapable of separating you from the Death Seed. While you are far from reaching the levels of any known Celestials, you are beyond the insignificant Celestial known as Ego. Perhaps with time, you could match the heights of power other Celestials are known for, given the Death Seeds' nature as an evolutionary machine. 

The Death Seed has given you knowledge on how to go about using your Cosmic Energy in the area of biokinesis. You could replicate the various genetic experiments that the Celestials have done across the Marvel multiverse, creating your own version of the Mutans or perhaps the Deviants and Eternals. The Death Seed will also go about making sure that these beings are under your control, similar to the creation of the Horsemen, if you so wish. 

As the Death Seed has kick-started your evolution into that of a true Celestial, you don't have to worry about the fragmented portion of Ego within yourself being removed, halting your ability to use your Cosmic Energy any longer. The Death Seed has also undergone an evolution, having experienced the Cosmic Energy of a celestial body. The budding artificial intelligence has evolved into a truly loyal entity that can assist in your use of Cosmic Energy, thanks to its previous experience in being utilised by the Celestial Entities known as the Celestial Gardeners.
addons.title: Celestial Gardener

objects.text:
It seems that a certain Star-Lord is not the only successful Half-Celestial child that managed to awaken their abilities; these powers are not quite the strength of a normal Celestial, perhaps due to the nature of Ego or due to you only being Half-Celestial, regardless, as you have consumed one of the seeds that have awakened your powers. You are beyond normal mortality, and the seed serves as your connection to your powers until they have fully stabilised. Should it be disturbed, your powers will slowly fade until you are a normal human, and the seed has had time to regenerate itself.

As a celestial, you will possess a few powers, uplifting you further from being a simple mortal. Beginning with your body being far stronger than that of a normal human thanks to your unique genetics enhancing your physical capabilities, throwing humans around like ragdolls into rocks and smashing away walls with ease, not only are you physically strong, but your durability and regenerative powers are beyond normal to the point that you could wield the raw energy from an Infinity Stone despite not wearing any method of shielding yourself that damaged the Hulk even when having such methods of shielding himself and regenerating yourself just as fast from any damage taken in minutes. As with all Celestials, you are biologically immortal. 

You possess the ability to manipulate Cosmic Energy, although to a smaller level than any other Celestial; as with Peter and Ego, you can manipulate this energy to create solid energy constructs and manipulate the molecular structure of reality and matter, such as when Peter transformed himself into Pac-Man to fight his father or the duplicates that Ego made. As you fully explore this power, you will find new uses for this power and grow in potential as you slowly break away from the limits, perhaps to the point of becoming a full Celestial.
objects.title: Ego Trip (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text:
The next step in human evolution is your genetics; you have evolved well past human limits, becoming as close as a normal human can get to being a mutant without being one. While others rely on fancy superpowers, you have pure strength to get you by. Your strength and durability have been raised well beyond normal human limits, allowing you to crush a building with pure, unadulterated power. People with fancy magical powers never train, so one good hit could knock them over like a deck of playing cards. This is not just limited to giving you strength; you also possess enhanced durability and speed, allowing you to keep up with those who are stronger than you by a slight margin. You are fast enough to outrun fast cars and those who have been enhanced with the powers of a spider and precognition.

Despite not being supernatural, you also possess a high natural level of resistance towards supernatural powers that are targeting you, walking straight through magic that very well should kill you.
objects.title: Mankind Redefined (Marvel)

addons.text:
You have followed the path of Karn, the Master-Weaver. As an Inheritor that is a Spider-totem, you’ve also followed his connection to the Web of Life and Destiny. While the web itself is a means to travel the multiverse, your connection to it gives perchance to see into it as an unmatched scrying tool, and a means of subtle manipulation. With time, patience, and practice, you could orchestrate the fate of a multiverse.

Just be careful not to follow karn’s path so faithfully you replicate his fate
addons.title: Master Weaver

addons.text:
The pure life-energy endemic to being Captain Universe provides you with more than you could ever gain hunting totems. Due to this, you generate enough life energy to live and use your powers as if you’d just absorbed an especially powerful totem at any time. Consuming excess life energy will still empower you further, but survival will never again be a worry.

The Web of Life and Destiny is also comprised of this power, and your abilities to sense, manipulate, and embody it as Captain universe have further enhanced the precision of your energy sense and universal travel vastly.
addons.title: Sated at Last

objects.text:
Radioactive spiders are everywhere these days, good business for the exterminators. You’re possessed of the physiology of an Inheritor, including flight, super strength, speed, reflexes and durability enough to hunt the Totems that are a staple of your diet. 

The main feature of your new physiology however, is the ability to absorb life energy. This absorption further enhances your other abilities in line with the general quality of the energy absorbed. Animals provide barely enough energy to survive, regular humans can barely sustain you and your abilities, but powered humans can enhance your abilities after absorption. The very peak of this being Totems (the most common being Spider-totems), which contain a vast amount of energy capable of enhancing your powers for great lengths of time. The Inheritor Morlun, for instance, was able to move faster than the preternatural ‘Spider-sense’ of many Spider-Totems after having gorged himself on them. 

This sensitivity to life energy also allows you to track the life energy of those you’ve felt before, ensuring your quarry will never escape. The pinnacle of this sense is the ability to traverse the Web of Life and Destiny as a means to track your prey. While this was originally intended to allow you to traverse the multiverse in pursuit of a totem to feed on, It also acts as a form of generalized multiversal travel through the web, as almost every universe has at least one Totem within it.

Finally, as long as you have a steady amount of life energy, you cannot die, and will heal from wounds (though you will require more energy than usual).

Unfortunately, these powers come at the cost of necessitating the absorption of life energy to survive. While surviving off of animals is possible, as is not killing hosts while feeding, both will severely weaken your new physiology. Similarly, unless you possess a strong will the feeling of feeding will become highly addictive.
objects.title: Inheritor of Solus (Marvel)

addons.text:
Through ownership of the Soul Stone, you have formed a symbiotic bond with it, making you immune to its control and allowing you to counter powers equivalent to the Soul Stone’s abilities when used by others. As an added bonus, the Soul Stone is permanently bound to you and cannot be stolen.

This bond allows you to understand any being, regardless of language, by communicating directly with their soul. You can scan a target for a soul, sentience, life, or residual memories, as well as see through illusions and break mind control. While the Soul Stone’s power to absorb souls and gain their knowledge cannot affect beings without a soul, you possess the ability to grant a soul to anyone. Only beings capable of challenging the Stone’s power can evade absorption.

Within the Stone’s Soul World, inhabitants are spiritually linked, and their strength depends on the power of their soul, with no outside abilities carrying over. As the Stone’s owner, you can enter and exit the Soul World at will, retain most of your powers, and exercise special control over reality within the realm.

Your bond with the Soul Stone also enhances your energy and matter manipulation, and granting you the ability to wield mystical energy for various purposes—including resurrecting beings by imbuing their souls into bodies and transmuting those bodies to match their original form. The Soul Stone’s augmentation has empowered you to the point where you can challenge entities such as Mephisto within his own realm. You can also unleash a “karmic blast,” an attack that overloads or disrupts the spiritual center, or anima, of a target—capable of incapacitating Quasar and other cosmic beings, with only those possessing truly unbreakable willpower able to resist it.
addons.title: Master of all Souls

objects.text:
You have a unique physiology, designed to be the perfect human, and have emerged as a powerful cosmic being similar to Adam Warlock. Your superhuman strength, speed, stamina, agility, and durability rival those of Thor and Thanos, and you possess a genius-level intellect. Your body can also absorb energy to sustain itself, eliminating the need for food or water.

You have the ability to manipulate cosmic energy, enabling you to project energy blasts, create energy shields, manipulate matter and energy, enhance your physical abilities, heal, and fly at supersonic speeds—even reaching FTL speeds when outside an atmosphere—and you possess a powerful healing factor. While you can be killed, you never truly die, as your soul is so strong that not even Death can claim it, allowing you to be reborn after death within a regenerative cocoon that alters your biology, evolving you on a subconscious level with each rebirth.

Your superhuman senses allow you to detect space anomalies such as black holes and teleportation, as well as locate or generate wormholes and other irregularities in space on a cosmic scale. You can perceive auras, souls, and genetic structures, and you possess cosmic awareness. You are resistant to time and reality manipulation—including that of the Time and Reality Stones—possess powerful telepathy similar to Moondragon, and can see through time.

Your unique physiology has also transformed you into an Avatar of Life. This grants you the ability to find a path to preserve that which would otherwise be beyond saving, while elevating your understanding of life and souls to the highest possible level. Furthermore, you exist outside the loop of destinies, rendering your actions unpredictable even to those possessing supernatural foresight or cosmic senses granted by the Infinity Gauntlet.
objects.title: Perfect Cosmic Being (Marvel)

objects.text:
You are a Strontian—a purple-skinned race of immense power. Even ordinary Strontians possess strength capable of annihilating armies, speed that surpasses the sound barrier, durability that shrugs off high-caliber bullets, and the ability to survive unaided in space. They can also fly and unleash devastating, highly concentrated energy beams from their eyes.

What truly defines a Strontian, however, is their unique ability to empower themselves through sheer willpower and unwavering self-belief. The stronger their confidence and sense of purpose, the greater their power grows.

You have undergone the Gladiator Enhancement Process, elevating you to an Alpha-Plus-level Strontian. This transformation has pushed your abilities to godlike levels This transformation has pushed your abilities to godlike levels when operating at your peak Confidence: You can shift planets from their orbits and Fist Fight Beings like a Serious Hulk & Thor, you move at hypersonic speeds and are virtually impervious to all physical damage, you can fly through cosmic Phenomena an not have to worry about being Harmed, Your invulnerability also extends to all diseases, infections, toxins, corrosives, and radiation.

By harnessing and manipulating gravitons, you defy gravity itself, granting you flight at speeds rivaling the fastest starships—capable of reaching faster-than-light velocities in hyperspace.

Your ocular heat beams burn hotter than the cores of stars. Your vision penetrates to the subatomic level, allowing you to perceive the smallest possible structures.

Should you ever be injured, your accelerated healing factor instantly repairs damaged cells, tissues, and bones with incredible speed and efficiency. This same regeneration ensures you remain in peak condition, drastically slows your aging.

If your belief in yourself wavers you can lose alot of your power, if your will is not strong enough or if a psychic gets clever they can weaken you. Also having the Mohawk is Optional though Stylish
objects.title: Strontian (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your Skrull physiology has been augmented, giving you the abilities of the first Super-Skrull, Kl’rt (as well as the Fantastic Four he imitates).

While Skrull do not gain abilities from their shapeshifting, Super-Skrulls by comparison are enhanced to give them superhuman abilities. The first, ‘Kl’rt’ mimicked the Fantastic Four, allowing him to use the strength of The Thing, Stretch in ways impossible for normal Skrull like Mr Fantastic, create forcefields and turn invisible like the Invisible Woman, and light himself on fire both totally and partially like The Human Torch. 

You can combine these abilities in many ways, creating force fields in your flames so they don’t extinguish, using the Thing’s skin on your arms and then stretching them great distances to create more momentum etc.
addons.title: Super-Skrull (Marvel)

addons.text:
With the ‘rediscovery’ of K-Class  Skrull mutants (read: ‘change in policy about murdering them in the crib’), the Skrull Empire was able to recreate their greatest weapon, the Warskrull.

While a normal Skrull can only take the appearance of their ‘template’ not the powers, you’ve become a Warskrull, encoded with special nanotechnology to be able to duplicate the abilities of a Template used. 

With this you can duplicate the abilities of anyone you’re copying, though this will be proportional to the amount you’re copying them. For instance, you could gain the magical skill of a sorcerer but only to the same extent as them if you took their form completely. However, this means you can sacrifice potency for versatility by making partial transformations from different people.
addons.title: Warskrull

objects.text:
You’ve been transformed into a Skrull, A warlike species primed to infiltrate anyone anywhere in the effort of expanding their empire. Descended from reptiles, modern day Skrulls are the descendants of ‘deviants’ that managed to eclipse and exterminate their Prime and Eternal genetic cousins.
