As a result, Skrull are evolutionarily stagnant, only capable of mutating deleteriously unless under careful study.

All Skrull are capable of shapeshifting to a dramatic extent, being composed of ‘unstable molecules’ letting them replicate objects, animals and people with extreme accuracy. This extends to partial transformations such as growing wings or changing limbs into weapons and even changing the elasticity of their bodies, though more complex transformation techniques such as replicating large numbers of partial transformations require extensive training.

Notably, Skrull cannot replicate the characteristics or powers of anyone they mimic, similarly, they cannot replicate the properties of anything they transform into, so a Skrull transformed into an ‘iron’ block would at most be as durable as their own bones. They’re also limited by mass, unable to go above 1.5 times their original volume or less than 0.75 likewise.
objects.title: Skrull (Marvel)

objects.text:
You possess the formidable physiology of a Makluan, granting you  strength to lift 100 tons, enough stamina to fight at peak exertion for up to 24 hours, and durability sufficient to withstand anti-tank weapons, extreme temperatures, energy blasts, and the vacuum of space indefinitely.

You are effectively ageless, capable of living for thousands of years without showing signs of aging. Your rapid metabolism provides accelerated healing and, given sufficient time in hibernation, the ability to regenerate lost body parts.

Your wings grant you flight at speeds just below the sound barrier, while limited telepathy allows you to communicate with and influence other minds, particularly other reptilian beings.

You are also a natural shapeshifter, capable of drastically altering your appearance, size, weight, and mass, including taking human form. Should your body be destroyed or severely injured, you can transfer your life essence into another living being, potentially transforming the host into your true form. Finally, you can exhale a highly corrosive, plasma-like mist and reproduce asexually, laying dozens or even hundreds of eggs at a time.
All Skrull are capable of shapeshifting to a dramatic extent, being composed of ‘unstable molecules’ letting them replicate objects, animals and people with extreme accuracy. This extends to partial transformations such as growing wings or changing limbs into weapons and even changing the elasticity of their bodies, though more complex transformation techniques such as replicating large numbers of partial transformations require extensive training.

Notably, Skrull cannot replicate the characteristics or powers of anyone they mimic, similarly, they cannot replicate the properties of anything they transform into, so a Skrull transformed into an ‘iron’ block would at most be as durable as their own bones. They’re also limited by mass, unable to go above 1.5 times their original volume or less than 0.75 likewise.
objects.title: Makluan (Marvel Comics)

objects.text:
You are an Adaptor, and not just any type, but a Horned Adaptor. You possess the ability to transform, either fully or partially, into an alien humanoid creature with insanely powerful physical abilities, including immensely increased strength, speed, durability, and an accelerated form of regeneration that allows you to regrow lost limbs in under a second (though multiple regenerations over a short amount of time will tire you out). All of these attributes are roughly equal to, or slightly superior to, those of John, the main character of the manga MAD.

Your level of mastery over your transformation and regeneration is equal to that of Pano. You can effortlessly transform only a limb, a hand, or a finger, or simply release your tail from your back while keeping the rest of your body unchanged. You can even summon only the hyper-hardened scales that cover Adaptors on specific areas of your body to, for example, stop a blade at your throat.

In addition, you can manifest all of the unique mutations that have appeared in the story, either individually or in combination, and turn each of them on and off at will. These mutations include, but are not limited to, Pano's ice generation, John's lightning, Yazur's biological bombs, Cobrott's super sight, and Oscar's acid. As time goes on, you will dynamically and frequently develop new mutations that go beyond those seen in the story.

Finally, unlike normal Adaptors, you are not limited by a transformation timer. You can remain in your partially or fully transformed form for as long as you want without suffering the exhaustion or fainting that affects other Adaptors.
objects.title: Adaptor (MAD)

objects.text:
You have gained the fearsome power of a Tarrasque, one of the greatest and most terrifying monsters to ever roam the Prime Material Plane. You can choose to be fully transformed into a Tarrasque, have a hybrid form between the Tarrasque and your current form or simply wield its power in whatever form you may have. You may also choose to have your Tarrasque form act as a Changer state that you transform into.

As someone with the power of a Tarrasque, you now gain a plethora of powerful abilities and resistances, such as the supernatural strength and durability of a Tarrasque; the ability to move through the earth as if you are swimming through water; project an aura around you that hampers the flight ability of all other creatures in range; instill fear and panic with sight alone; deflect magical projectiles; the ability to eat and digest everything, gaining resistances and immunity to various types of harmful effects (heat, poison, diseases, energy drain, psionic ability, magic resistance, etc.).

But the most impressive ability that you now have is the Tarrasque regenerative capability. Given enough time, no matter what sort of wound or damage you may take, you will always regenerate back to full health. Even the complete disintegration of your body would not be enough to stop your regenerative ability, as you would simply regenerate from nothing.

The only way to stop your regenerative ability would be for someone to kill you and cast powerful magic or warp reality to prevent you from coming back, such as a wish spell. But even then, the moment that the magic or alteration to reality is gone, you can simply return unimpeded.
objects.title: Tarrasque (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text:
You are now one of the most feared monsters an adventurer has ever had to face, a Beholder. A typical Beholder looks like a large, floating sphere with a massive mouth filled with razor-sharp teeth, one large central cyclopian eye, and 10 stalks, each topped with another eye and from each of these eyes comes a different magical effect. To move around as Beholder, you can levitate at around the average human running speed. If your levitation gets somehow canceled, you cannot move very easily.

From the first eye comes a charm ray, allowing you to convince anyone you hit of nearly anything rather easily. From the second eye comes a paralyzing ray, allowing you to paralyze anyone that it hits. From the third eye comes a fear ray, allowing you to terrify someone so bad that they will literally jump at shadows. From the fourth eye comes a slowing ray, allowing you to slow anyone you hit with it, making them move as though they were underwater. From the fifth eye comes an enervation ray, allowing you to weaken anyone you hit by rotting their muscles.

From your sixth eye comes a telekinetic ray, allowing you to pick things and people up while still being able to exert fine control over objects. From your seventh eye comes a sleep ray, allowing you to make anyone you hit with it fall asleep. From the eighth eye comes a petrification ray, allowing you to turn anyone you hit with it to stone slowly. From the ninth eye comes a disintegration ray, allowing you to disintegrate anyone or anything you hit with it. From the tenth eye comes a death ray, allowing you to kill anyone that it hits.

Finally, from your central eye comes an anti-magic effect, allowing you to turn off all forms of magic except those cast by deities. Ongoing effects are suppressed, such as a spell granting flight failing while you look at them with the central eye, but will return once you look away.

This effect is very powerful but comes with downsides, mainly this effect works against your own eye rays, meaning you cannot fire any of your rays at creatures in the gaze of your central eye. The other downside is that this effect cannot be turned off unless you close your main central eye.
objects.title: Beholder (D&D)

objects.text:
You have been turned into a Pacifista, human weapons developed by Marine head scientist, Dr. Vegapunk.

While the originals are clones of the former Warlord Bartholomew Kuma, who were cybernetically enhanced into cyborgs, you may chose to have these cybernetic enhancements apply to your original body instead.

Whether you chose to keep your original body or not, you gain Bartholomew Kuma's great physical strength as well as a body composed out of non-magnetic metal stronger than steel, allowing you to be unfazed by opponents on the level of the CP9.

The Pacifista's main mode of combat is firing laser beams from their mouth and hands which are based on Kizaru's Logia-type Devil Fruit—Pika Pika no Mi. These beams possess tremendous piercing power, allowing them to penetrate the tough hide of a transformed Ancient Zoan user, and can also cause massive explosions, inflicting severe to fatalistic damage to targets and the environment. The Pacifista can also run slightly faster than most people and jump quite high, although still slower than Kuma himself.

As cyborgs, the Pacifista are capable of taking staggering amounts of damage without being disabled. For example, despite being set on fire by Sanji, PX-1 continued operating. PX-4 also continued operating despite direct damage to its internal systems. The laser beams from their mouth can cause a severe backlash if the mouth is forced shut before firing, which causes the photon energy to explode inside the cyborg's body, damaging the constitutional framework, although even this would not be enough to force a shutdown. Only significant and irreversible trauma seems capable of stopping them, such as breaking their necks or cleaving them in two. They may explode if sufficiently damaged. It took the entire pre-timeskip Straw Hat Crew just to bring down one Pacifista — an effort which left them winded and exhausted.
objects.title: Pacifista (One Piece)

objects.text:
You have become a Lunarian, a member of a thought to be extinct species that used to live on top of the Red Line.

As a member of this race, you gain silver-white hair, brown skin, a pair of black-feathered wings on your back upon which you can fly with, and have a plume of fire near-constantly burning on your upper back.

Lunarians have the ability to emit fire from their bodies that they can control and weaponize in combat—allowing them to unleash powerful fire blasts or gatlings, clad their limbs and weapons in fire to empower their melee attacks, and even shape their flames into constructs, including very large ones. You are able to release these flames from your entire body in all directions as well as even control their temperature, allowing you to not burn anything you don't want to.

Other than that, Lunarians are noted for their superhuman vitality and resilience, something that supposedly contributed to them being called "gods" before nearly going extinct. More than that, Lunarians either lose, after some time, or can deliberately turn off the flames burning at their back, which will cause them to temporarily lose said characteristic endurance, although this loss comes in exchange for a drastic boost in mobility, allowing members of this tribe to reach speeds faster than the untrained eye can follow.
objects.title: Lunarian (One Piece)

addons.text:
Your abnormality is no longer fixed to a single universe. Whenever you enter a new world, your body and innate qualities adjust so that you become that world’s equivalent of a Natural Born Destroyer. If the inhabitants of that universe possess greater physical strength, tougher bodies, stronger souls, or more developed spiritual, esoteric, and other supernatural traits, your own rise naturally to match and surpass what that world considers exceptional. You will become its outlier, carrying the kind of inborn advantages that only once-in-a-generation monsters or impossible prodigies ever display, gaining the same kind of inborn advantages that rare prodigies or anomalies are born with in that setting, without needing training or external modification.

This adjustment only works upward. Entering a weaker world will not reduce you in any way. Any traits, strengths, or qualities you already possess remain unchanged. You only gain increases in areas where the new universe is superior, allowing your abnormal growth to continue and, in time, allow you to stand atop all reality.

The time it takes for this adjustment to complete is the same as the adaptation period of your Universal Power Plant. By the time your internal energy has adapted to the new universe, your body and innate traits will have already settled into their place as the outlier above that world’s limits.
addons.title: Destroyer Across Worlds

objects.text:
You’re a genetic anomaly, a freak of nature, born fundamentally different from the rest of your species. No one knows how or why. You just are.

Your body defies natural limits. From the moment you open your eyes, you're brimming with power. You grow faster, bigger, and stronger than anyone around you. Your skin is tougher than steel, your teeth harder than stone, as your strength keeps multiplying with age.

But it doesn't stop at the physical. Spiritually and magically, you're the outlier that every system wasn’t built to handle. You break through barriers meant only for the “chosen ones.” Abilities that are supposed to be one-in-a-million — like Conqueror’s Haki or god-tier spiritual pressure — well, you were born with them. Nothing is truly beyond grasp because it will simply come naturally to you.

In time, you’ll undoubtedly rise to the top of your universe, untouchable by nearly all. The only threats left will be your own ego and the limits you choose not to break.
objects.title: Natural Born Destroyer (One Piece)

addons.text:
Through a clever application of your Reality Marble you have learned to store your Aletheia body within your inner world rather than simply keeping it in planetary orbit.

Keeping with this, you can partially deploy your Reality Marble within any of your Terminals to wield your full power as a Machine God without bringing out your enormous true body, and dealing with the accompanying consequences.
addons.title: Aletheia Storage

objects.text:
You have become a Machine God of the same generation as the Olympians. Machine Gods are conceptual gods born from deified natural phenomena while also being an autonomous unmanned fleet of massive magitech spacefaring ships created by a civilization whose universe was close to death, and their purpose was to recreate their home planet with their various functionalities. Machine Gods do not possess dimensional travel and instead, were sent to another dimension by the Mothership Chaos, but they do possess advanced FTL and can travel between planetary “textures”.

Machine Gods possess functionalities related to their purposes which are similar to divine authorities in function and scope, although created with alien magitech.

You can choose one of the 12 Olympians with your Aletheia (your body) being the same type of ship as them with similar capabilities. If you chose Zeus, you only have his baseline abilities, not the abilities and strength he usurped from his fellow Machine Gods. 

Within your programming will lie all Olympian knowledge related to your Aletheia’s purpose, including how to set up artificial divine leylines.

You, as a Machine God, can perpetually generate large quantities of magical energy. You also consume enormous amounts of magical energy when conducting operations like combat at maximum energy output, much more than you generate, to the point that you might need to worry about running out if you don’t take precautions like connecting to leylines.

You can create “terminals” which are humanoid avatars meant for interacting with people. These terminals possess a fraction of your power and can operate freely even if your true body is in space or in Earth’s orbit.
objects.title: Aletheia (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You have become a Half-Dead Apostle. This is usually an impossibility, but alas, when did you let logic and reason hold you back? As a Dhampir, you embody the ideal fusion of both Humanity and dead apostles, gaining the benefits of both with none of the weaknesses.

This unusual state greatly enhances your psychic affinity for vampirism; your ability to grow by drinking the blood of others evolves to the point of directly consuming their Soul through drinking their blood. 

This works on those without traditional blood, such as spirits, as blood is just a vector that allows you to connect to their Soul, enabling you to drain them of all their power, abilities, and knowledge; this can be done in full or partially only by draining some abilities. Optionally, you can consume some of their spiritual energy, draining energy from them without any permanent harm.

Unlike others, you run no risk of diluting your existence through consuming souls and allowing you to grow at a truly rapid speed as you possess no hard limits in how powerful you can grow. 

Your partial Humanity will remain as you advance further, allowing you to reach the level of Dead Apostle Ancestors even in worldlines where the Human Order is more prominent.

You can partially infect the souls of others with the Dead Apostle curse, creating more Half-Dead Apostles similar to yourself. Of course, you can still create ordinary Dead Apostles.
addons.title: Living Apostle

addons.text: While all those sufficiently advanced in the ranks of being a Dead Apostle possess the ability to create an army of Dead that do their bidding, your control over those you turn is greater than all other Dead Apostles. No matter how far they progress through the ranks, any being you create will always be bound to you, incapable of disobeying or turning against you. You possess full awareness of their thoughts and an ability to control their minds, and all things they consume or absorb are sent directly to you. You may even control the flow of this absorption, taking in just as much as is needed for your survival or even more.
addons.title: Above All Else

addons.text:
Your nature as a Kindred has merged with your new status as a Dead Apostle. As a result, you are stronger than either would be individually. By gaining Mystery and advancing through the ranks of a Dead Apostle, you can effectively lower your generation as a Kindred.

Your Disciplines are amplified, becoming pseudo–Idea Blood in nature. This stems from the Mystery of being a creation of Cain from the Bible over 10,000 years ago, combined with your status as a hybrid of a Kindred and a Dead Apostle. This also grants you an increased aptitude for learning new Disciplines. However, their initial power will be lower than that of Disciplines naturally inherited through a Clan, but they will gradually grow stronger over time similar to your already enhanced Disciplines.

Your ability to create Ghouls and Blood Bonds as a Kindred has also been amplified through your transformation into a Dead Apostle. Ghouls created by you become beings similar in nature to both Dead Apostles and Kindred, closer in power to a Thin-Blood than to a normal ghoul. They possess access to Disciplines and aspects of your Dead Apostle nature without fully transforming into either state. Unbound by the usual limitations of ghouls, they can gather blood and transfer it to you through your link, just as anyone bound to you through a Blood Bond can.

Your curse has also mutated. Like a Dead Apostle, your weaknesses are no longer static. The longer you exist and the more Mystery you accumulate, the weaker your vampiric weaknesses become. Eventually, you may reach a point where you no longer possess any of the standard weaknesses of either a Kindred or a Dead Apostle.
addons.title: Apostle of Cain

objects.text:
Dead Apostles are a unique kind of bloodsucker, originally created by the True Ancestors to be used as emergency rations. In exchange for serving this purpose, they're granted extraordinary powers and a form of immortality similar to their creators. You now find yourself among the ranks of these undead beings.

However, you're no ordinary Dead Apostle. Unlike others who struggle and writhe amongst the dirt just to be considered proper vampires, you possess a natural affinity for vampirism, starting as a Rank IV: Nightkin. This 'talent' of yours mirrors that of Satsuki Yumizuka, granting you unparalleled potential to ascend through the ranks of the Dead Apostles.

As a Nightkin, you possess the standard vampiric abilities—inhuman reflexes, heightened senses, and exceptional physicality—enabling you to stand your ground against typical Church Executors or Mage Enforcers, alongside a high magic resistance to modern magecraft and Mystery, bearing the Curse of Restoration as your form of immortality, which allows your body to revert all damage by regressing time. This ability becomes dramatically more potent as the moon waxes. Additionally, over time, you'll be able to discover and unlock an assortment of other vampiric powers, such as flight, mist transformation, familiar creation, etc.

While you've inherited all the advantages of being a bloodsucker, you've also gained their weaknesses—vulnerability to sunlight, holy objects, and Sacraments. However, as you accumulate Mystery, these weaknesses will gradually fade, eventually becoming little more than a minor nuisance.

Your status as a Dead Apostle also means that your blood is infused with Ether, allowing you to manifest your desires into reality, limited only by the nature of your soul. As you grow in power and rank, you may even develop abilities based on your sire (should you choose to have one) or create entirely new powers of your own.
objects.title: Dead Apostle (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your Perfect Weapon and Knight Arm are one and the same. You still have whatever form your original Knight Arm was, and the same form or at least the abilities of Ado Edem's Knight Arm. On top of that, you also have the capability to shape your Knight Arm into various weapons you're capable of wielding. This also comes with a special ability.

Now, whenever you're in combat, your Knight Arm will analyze and adapt to the foe you face. Over time, it will gain conceptual abilities specially made to counter and shut down whatever foe you encounter. Facing an immortal being will begin with granting your weapon Anti-Regeneration effects. If this fails, it will escalate to more potent Anti-Immortal abilities. If that does not work, it will escalate further by giving you abilities to force the concept of death upon a foe to make it capable of dying. Facing a dragon will give you effects that boost your own strength against dragons and/or cause increased damage to them, and so forth. The more powerful the foe, the longer it will take—though getting some of that being’s essence onto your weapon will let it absorb it and adapt faster.

All of these effects are permanent but can be disabled so that you do not accidentally kill a foe you merely wish to subdue.
addons.title: Perfect Knight Arm

objects.text:
You're a Liner: Human Species, the next step in humanity, created in a world long dead but with humanity refusing to die with it. Different from normal humans, you have an extremely robust body allowing you to live in both incredibly toxic or radioactive environments and even places humans should not be able to survive in, like the vacuum of space, without any risk of sickness or death. This is because your body is adapted to take in Grain, also known as space dust or Ether, to survive and empower yourself. Because of this, you do not need to eat, breathe, you do not age, and you can heal yourself simply from subsisting off of the (to others) toxic particles that exist both in space and are generated naturally by planets.

But you're no simple Liner. You're an Ether Liner, a subset of the species born with a massive amount of Grain already and able to better manipulate it. This gives you impressive levels of physical capability, enough to match and beat a Grand Servant in pure power. To further show your overall status as the next step of humanity, you have the ability to form the Grain you have in your body into a special weapon called a Knight Arm: Demonic Swords. This allows you to create a powerful weapon that can have various effects unique to you.

The most well-known Ether Liner, Ado Edem, has a Knight Arm that is a seed-like object growing out of his arm that rapidly grows and changes into a double-bladed weapon by consuming massive amounts of Grain. This weapon is capable of killing an Ultimate One if given enough Grain. You can choose to have a Knight Arm similar to this or create one of your own design. The Grain you produce, absorb, and utilize is harmless to the environment or anyone unless you specifically allow it.
objects.title: Ether Liner (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Shadowhunters, more formally known as Nephilim, are human-angel hybrids who possess angelic blood. You have been elevated to the prime physical human condition. To push yourself beyond this, you need to draw Angelic Runes, or Marks, on your skin using your personal Stele. 

Steles are the tools used by every Shadowhunter to draw Marks on their skin, each stele is made out of the heavenly metal, Adamas. Adamas is nigh-indestructible, silver-white, translucent, and smooth as glass but warmer and heavier. When your stele is in use, the runes on it glow slightly.

Your personal Stele can be summoned to your hand at any time, regardless of its material condition. Inscribing runes onto your skin grants you power related to the rune drawn. Drawing runes comes naturally to you, as would mundane art if you attempted it. You will always be able to further improve a rune form until it reaches an angel’s definition of perfect, empowering the rune immensely.

These runes grant various powers and abilities such as enhanced senses, increased speed, accelerated healing, and protection against demonic influence. Different runes serve different purposes and can be used strategically in battle or for everyday tasks. While most runes are temporary, there are a few special runes that are permanent. 
 
As one with supernatural blood running through your veins, you have access to the ‘Sight’, which allows you to pierce through magical illusions, allowing you to see the true forms of other beings.

You are given a physical copy of the Grey Book that cannot be lost or permanently destroyed. This book contains every rune gifted to the Shadowhunters by the Angel Raziel.
objects.title: Shadowhunter (Shadowhunters)

addons.text: Any active Witcher will save themselves from death every day, and when they come home all they find is the memories of the battles they won. Victory deserves a reward, even if you are the only one around to give it. Whenever you survive a dangerous encounter, any and all skills you used in that encounter permanently increase by 1/108th of their current strength.
addons.title: Law of Surprise

addons.text:
You gain the combined skills, knowledge, charisma, and experience of Geralt of Rivia. You have full mastery of all of the Signs shown in the Witcher Series, with all of them at their peak potential. 

Your armory expands to include various tools used by Witchers, including silver swords, crossbows, bolts, bombs, potions, decorations, and the weapons Geralt gained during his adventures. Any consumables used in battle are automatically replenished in your armory. You are also no longer at risk of being poisoned or dying from consuming too many potions.
addons.title: The White Wolf

objects.text:
Your body mutates in several interesting ways, granting you the powers and training of a Witcher. You know several magical signs that you can quickly and expertly use; you have an inhumanly strong, flexible, quick and durable body, and a very enhanced metabolism as well as severely enhanced senses and natural night vision. You are also an expert of the fighting styles used by the various Witcher schools and have a good understanding of alchemy (but you are unlikely to find the materials used by the art on a non magical world). Lastly, you have a very smart and deductive mind, you would be a natural-born detective if you ever applied yourself.

You can choose whether or not you gain white hair or cat-like eyes from this power, & in your case, the famous infertility of The Witchers is also toggleable.
objects.title: Witcher (The Witcher)

objects.text:
Vampires, especially higher vampires, are some of the strongest monsters seen in the Witcher series. Throughout the years, many have sought to kill the higher vampires, only to be met with death as none of the standard methods of killing a vampire worked on the higher vampires. Silver, a metal that would ordinarily kill any monster without a specific weakness, has no effect except to slightly annoy the vampire. Decapitation is a little more than an irritation. Higher vampires are the only vampires within the Witcher series that are completely immune to holy symbols, silver, fire, sunlight, and other common vampire weaknesses. The only method known for killing a higher vampire is for another higher vampire to kill them, and since they all work together, there is no way for a witcher to kill higher vampires. A higher vampire once had his head cut off, was staked with silver, had holy water pored on his body, and was buried. He still regenerated and eventually came back.

Your strength has been heightened to the point that, with a single strike, you could destroy a large building with little effort. Your speed is also ridiculously fast; you are able to move around at speeds at which others with enhanced senses would assume that you are teleporting. Your defensive abilities have also been improved, allowing you to take damage that could level giant mountains with ease and not have a scratch on you. Your senses are supernatural, allowing you to sense things others cannot. Like all higher vampires, you possess immortality and boast an impressive healing factor.

You also possess other supernatural abilities, such as the ability to manipulate blood, fly, manipulate humans and animals with mind control, induce sleep in creatures, and turn into a mist of blood and a giant bat, which further increases your vampiric abilities. While higher vampires do not require blood, they find the taste enjoyable.
objects.title: Higher Vampire (The Witcher)

addons.text:
Your biology is no mere fusion of Kryptonian and Viltrumite DNA, the two systems actively enhance and optimize one another, creating a superior hybrid far beyond either species individually.

Your Kryptonian cells continuously absorb and store yellow solar radiation, while your Viltrumite Smart Atoms refine that energy throughout your body with near-perfect efficiency. Instead of relying solely on solar energy like a normal Kryptonian, your Smart Atoms stabilize and conserve absorbed energy, drastically slowing power loss under red sunlight or in deep space preserving your power for years rather than months. Even when your reserves run out you don't lose power instead returning to your natural viltrumite baseline.

The Viltrumite trait of adaptive growth synergizes with Kryptonian abilities. Pushing yourself stimulates your Smart Atoms to evolve, increasing your body's capacity to absorb, process, and weaponize solar energy. As a result, your strength, speed, durability, and energy projection can continue growing with effectively no known upper limit.

Your tactile telekinesis enhances the Viltrumite strength, speed, durability and flight, granting extreme maneuverability, environmental control, and combat precision. You can fly at immense speeds without causing unintended destruction, move massive objects efficiently, and amplify physical traits through layered telekinetic reinforcement.

Your regenerative abilities are similarly amplified. Kryptonian solar energy accelerates cellular repair, while Smart Atoms reconstruct damaged tissue on a molecular level. As long as enough of your brain and heart remain intact, your body can regenerate from injuries that would permanently cripple either species alone. Solar exposure dramatically accelerates this healing factor, potentially allowing rapid recovery even from fatal trauma.

Even your weaknesses counterbalance each other. Sonic frequencies that disrupt Viltrumite equilibrium are resisted by Kryptonian invulnerability and enhanced neural processing, reducing their effectiveness unless deployed at extreme intensity. Likewise, Kryptonite remains dangerous, but your Viltrumite biology allows you to retain your power and survive exposure much longer than a normal Kryptonian and recover more effectively once removed from it.
addons.title: Legacy of the Stars

objects.text: Your DNA is infused with Viltrumite DNA, granting you a physiology composed of Smart Atoms, which infuses you with super strength, super speed, super durability, flight, and hyper-evolved bodily processes such that you can hold your breath for extended periods of time. You are immune to all diseases short of something made specifically to affect a Viltrumite, have regeneration capable of healing pretty much anything as long as no more than a third of your brain or heart is destroyed, become stronger by pushing your limits, and have sufficient longevity to live for thousands of years. Your genetics become extremely dominant, capable of mixing with almost any species and creating a viable hybrid. Unfortunately, this comes with a weakness to certain sonic frequencies.
objects.title: Viltrumite Hybrid (Invincible)

addons.title: Royal Destiny
addons.text:
You seem to stand out above most other Ponies in a most curious way. Your Cutie Mark and your magic are greatly above the norm of most other Ponies. 

Your Cutie Mark talent is something grander and stronger, while you possess magic far beyond that of other Ponies. In addition, your personality is attuned partially and strongly with one or more of the Elements of Harmony.

However, beyond those easy-to-notice differences, the magic of Harmony and the world around you seems to push you towards some unseen greater plan. This takes the form of a kind of subtle driving force steering your fate and destiny to grand trials which, should you meet head-on and rise to the occasion, in hopes of you becoming the best you can be, will gradually lead you to gaining increasing mastery of your Cutie Mark and growing your magic to grand heights.

In time, this driving force will eventually culminate in one final trial. This trial will push you to your absolute limits, where you must face it head-on and find the willpower to push onward. When you have exhausted every ounce of your abilities, a shining light will spark deep within you, causing you to Ascend and transform into an Alicorn, allowing you to finish the trial, whatever it may be.

Once you have successfully Ascended, you gain the full benefits of the <u>Alicorn (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)</u> Upgrade as if you purchased it. Should you already have purchased the upgrade, however, this addon will allow you to undergo a second pseudo Ascension, which, should you succeed, will transform you into a full deity with power comparable to Faust and other ancient Alicorns who have had thousands of years to grow their power and skills.

objects.text:
You are a member of one of the three Pony Tribes from Equestria. Depending on your age, you may already have your Cutie Mark, which are often related to the personality, proclivity, or talent of their owners. Your Cutie Mark will greatly enhance your ability towards whatever it represents to such a degree that you become a savant in that area. You are allowed to select your Cutie Mark within reason, with stronger ones taking longer to fully mature and master. As an Equestrian, you also possess great durability akin to a moderate Brute rating.

Earth Pony: You are physically very powerful, capable of incredible feats of strength, stamina and durability far beyond the norm of other tribes. You also possess a passive/active magic over the earth and plants.

Pegasus Pony: Pegasi are masters of the air, able to fly with great speed and agility, comparable to a hummingbird at subsonic speeds. Pegasi wings and feathers are surprisingly strong; to a point where a pegasus can use their wings in a similar fashion to hands. As a Pegasus, you can create and control weather as well as interact with clouds as if they are solid.

Unicorn Pony: As a Unicorn, you have the ability to control magic and cast spells. You possess an innate ability to use telekinesis which can evolve into being able to control vast number of items of great size with surgical precision. Your magical ability and spells are effectively limitless, as they are based on your magical knowledge and power. In time, such things as complex transmutation, time stopping, time travel, dimensional travel, and more can become possible.
objects.title: Equestrian (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

addons.text:
You have embraced a new way of life, transforming into a Reformed Changeling. No longer driven by hunger for love, you now generate and share it freely, creating a deep bond with those around you. This change has reshaped both your body and abilities, making you stronger in ways beyond mere physical power.

Your once dark, hole-riddled form has been replaced by a more colorful and solid body, reflecting your inner harmony. Your shapeshifting abilities remain, allowing you to take the form of any creature or object, but now your transformations feel smoother and more natural. Instead of using them for deception and survival, you can shift forms to comfort others, build trust, or adapt to new situations.

Unlike before, you no longer drain love from others to sustain yourself. Instead, you thrive by sharing love, which strengthens not only you but also those around you. Love is no longer a limited resource you must steal—it is something you create and spread, making you immune to the starvation that once plagued your kind.

Your magic has evolved into something purer. It is now fueled by harmony and friendship, making it particularly strong in healing, protection, and emotional support. While you may not wield the raw destructive force of a Changeling Queen, your magic is steady, reliable, and deeply connected to the bonds you forge with others.

Your ability to sense emotions has also grown more refined. Instead of merely detecting love to feed on it, you now understand emotions on a deeper level, allowing you to offer comfort, guidance, and inspiration. You can feel the pain, joy, and hopes of those around you, making you an invaluable source of support and unity.
addons.title: Reformed Changeling

objects.text:
You are a Changeling, a creature that bears a striking resemblance to ponies but is marked by distinct insect-like features. Your body is covered in a black, smooth, carapace-like exterior that lacks fur. You have webbed manes and tails, non-reflective blue eyes, fangs, bent horns, jagged ears, and delicate insect-like wings. Your legs are punctuated with holes, a defining characteristic of your kind.

As a Changeling, you possess the ability to shapeshift into other beings, whether they are ponies, non-pony creatures, or even inanimate objects. This allows you to blend seamlessly into any environment, manipulate others, and gain what you need to thrive. Your survival, however, depends on feeding off the emotion of love. Unlike traditional beings, you have no need for physical sustenance like food or water; love itself is your sustenance. While any form of love will suffice, it is most potent when the emotion is directed to you. Love freely given to you is the most nourishing. The holes in your legs are filled if you are sated with love.

You have a unique connection to emotions, particularly love, and you are able to “see” it in others as a tangible energy, almost like an aura. This enables you to sense love wherever it resides and draw it in to sustain yourself.

In addition to that, you are able to fly as long as your current form has wings. You can use any magic of the 3 pony tribes, but to a lesser degree. You cannot use magic if your current appearance does not have a horn. Lastly, in your normal form you do not need light to see.
objects.title: Changeling (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text: You have come from the same home planet in the Glaupunk Quadrant as the famous Metro Man and are now his equal, possessing all his many gifts. You have a superhuman physiology, possessing nigh-invulnerability, superhuman strength, superhuman speed, an enhanced mind as well as other powers like flight, tactile telekinesis, super breath and, of course, great hair. You also possess precise heat vision along with superpowered senses such as both telescopic and x-ray vision that can see through lead. You can lift and throw huge skyscrapers with ease, withstand orbital death rays without a scratch and even perfectly heat popcorn with your heat vision. Your greatest strength is your unbelievably fast superspeed; fast enough to the extent that a mere fraction of a second might be equal to an entire day to your superhuman perception. You can instantly accelerate your thought processes to match your super speed as you please. You don't possess any specific weaknesses to certain types of radiation or substances and your powers also don't require any specific outside energy to continue to function. Who knows, one day you might even get in touch with your true power: weaving lyrical magic!
objects.title: Metro Man (Megamind)

objects.text: You belong to the same extinct alien species as Megamind, possessing a hyper-developed brain and genetic architecture optimized for learning, invention, and biological analysis. Members of this species are capable of intuitively understanding advanced technology and can manipulate genetics far beyond conventional science. Megamind's species is consistently portrayed as possessing extraordinary intelligence and genetic engineering capability. Not only can you create things like invisible vehicles, death rays, lasers, and illusion generators, but you are also a genius of equal degree in all other fields, finding it just as easy to bioengineer a fish into sapience as to build a huge robot. Moreover, you can do all this on your typical city-level, mostly unsuccessful villain’s resources. You can get by with even the most limited or inferior resources, even if you might end up making wheels out of bent license plates now and then. You’re particularly good at making tech that interacts with superpowers, be it replicating them, recreating them with samples from the holder, or boosting, weakening or even disabling them.
objects.title: Megamind (Megamind)

addons.text:
Your Sailor Guardian powers merge with your Tamaranean powers. Your Sailor Guardian transformation amplifies your Tamaranean super strength, durability and stamina, as well as increases your speed to match those. Meanwhile, your starbolts become an integral part of your Sailor Guardian magical attacks, which gives them more power and flexibility, as well as allows you to use them untransformed. 

Additionally, your ability to learn new Sailor Guardian powers enhances the power of your Tamaranean lineage. Any new powers you learn as a Sailor Guardian will unlock related Tamaranean powers.
addons.title: Tamaranean Guardian

objects.text:
You've become a Tamaranean, a race of jovial and peaceful aliens hailing from Planet Tamaran. You gain powers similar to Starfire and Blackfire; Super strength, speed, durability, senses, stamina, flight, self sustenace, and linguistic assimilation. As well as their signature manipulation of solar energy.

Your abilities are potent enough to smash through steel, survive nuclear explosions without a scratch, move at over supersonic speeds, and survive extreme environmental conditions. Including the vacuum of space. 

Your solar energy can be projected and manipulated for numerous purposes, most commonly as blasts called Starbolts that can melt metal, and send even the toughest targets flying.

Similar to Kryptonians, you can also metabolize solar energy to further enhance your powers, though it's not required to maintain them. You can also enhance your powers through emotions, with your choice of one that will quickly bring out your maximum abilities.
objects.title: Tamaranean (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Some Atlanteans have further evolved to resemble oceanic fauna due to the magic of their lands.

Taking Handsome, Beautiful, or Androgynous will give minor mutations, such as visible gills or fins. Average will replace limbs with oceanic fauna limbs, such as having a head of a shark. Ugly will give you a mishmash of various oceanic fauna limbs. Hideous and Deformed will leave you in a near completely inhuman state, only barely resembling a human.
addons.title: Fish Mutations

addons.text: Your Atlantean physiology has mutated in the same way and to the same degree as Namor McKenzie, alleviating most of the weaknesses of Atlantean physiology, enhancing its strengths (enough to lift a naval destroyer over your head), and even granting new abilities (particularly flight, super healing, increased physical ability when in contact with water, weather manipulation, & larger scale hydrokinesis).
addons.title: Homo Mermanus (Marvel)

addons.text: You have gained skill in Fish-man Karate and Fish-man Jujutsu on par with that of Jinbe. You are capable of hurling water droplets with the force of bullets, transmitting the impact of your blows through water in the air, and physically manipulating currents like cloth. You know how to perform all of the Fish-man Karate and Fish-man Jujutsu techniques displayed in One Piece.
addons.title: Knight of the Sea

addons.text:
You gain all the surgical implants that Bryce Wayne (Earth-11) used on herself to wage war against Atlantis. Unlike Bryce, your appearance remains unchanged and you do not suffer from heightened sensitivity to bright light. You have no connection to Barbatos, nor do you possess any weakness to Metals from the DC Multiverse.

These enhancements allow you to survive the crushing pressure of the deep ocean and endure battles against super-powered Atlanteans with little to no physical harm. Your physical strength is immense; you can lift oil tankers, your speed in water reaches over 80,000 km/h, while on land, you can run at hypersonic velocities, and you are durable enough to ignore most weapons.

The implants also grant you the ability to manipulate vast, potentially limitless quantities of water, enabling you to drown an entire planet if desired. The water under your control takes on a blackened hue, imbued with corrupting properties, called Dead Water.

Your influence over water allows you to infect any body of water, rendering it uncontrollable by others and making it exclusively yours. You can even transform living beings into insidious Dead Water sea creatures loyal only to you. These ravenous minions are bio-engineered entities that obey your every command, swarming and overwhelming your enemies without hesitation.

Finally, you possess complete mastery over your Dead Water minions' forms, enabling you to reshape their bodies into any configuration you desire—all while preserving their unique abilities to aid you in battle.
addons.title: The Drowned (DC Comics)

addons.text:
You gain all the powers, skills, and abilities of Arthur Curry, also known as Aquaman. You may also inherit his memories and decide how much they affect you, if at all. You are now a human–Atlantean hybrid of royal lineage, as a result, you can spend extended periods on dry land with little to no ill effect and are approximately 20–50 times stronger, faster, tougher, and more or less tireless compared to others of your race.

On land, you are strong enough to lift tanks and throw cars. You are bullet-resistant, with large-caliber rounds only scratching your skin, you can easily survive an RPG detonating directly in your face, and recover from wounds far faster than any human. You can swim through active lava, withstand temperatures of up to 11,000 degrees Fahrenheit, and survive the extreme cold of outer space. You are capable of leaping miles in a single bound and moving at incredible speeds.

Your senses are several times more acute than human capacity—you can hear police sirens from several miles away, see perfectly in the pitch-black abyss of an oceanic trench, and detect sounds from great distances even while deep beneath the ocean’s surface.

However, it is in the water where you are at your strongest. There You are powerful enough to lift a 160,000-ton sea liner bare-handed, and hurl a sunken cargo ship. Some of Aquaman’s greatest feats of strength include pushing an entire tectonic plate over the entrance to a trench’s lair. In the ocean, you can are capable of reaching speeds of Mach 9. You can thrive in the darkest, deepest bowels of the ocean without suffering any discomfort.

Your marine telepathy has also grown, allowing you to hear the voices of marine life and broadcast telepathic messages worldwide with ease—though the more complex the organism, the harder it is to control. Your hydrokinesis has likewise increased, enabling you to shape and control any liquid or semi-liquid substance containing significant amounts of water, such as mud or blood. You can manipulate mud in a manner similar to water, using it as an offensive projectile, and create simple objects of ice.
addons.title: Aquaman (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You become an Atlantean, gaining physical traits optimized for life beneath the sea. This grants you superhuman abilities, including enhanced strength, durability, and agility. Additionally, you possess limited telepathy, enabling a better understanding of marine life and the ability to easily tame sea creatures. As a natural swimmer, you also develop minor hydrokinesis, which can propel you through water at supersonic speeds with exceptional maneuverability. With practice, you can improve these abilities, further enhancing your hydrokinesis or improving your telepathic connection to sea creatures.

You dehydrate at an accelerated rate compared to human. Though Atlanteans possess lungs enabling them to breathe air, Atlanteans not acclimated to dry land become exhausted after a limited amount of time, requiring a level of training to breathe air at a rate comparable to humans.

You are also able to be overtaxed to from external stimuli. Sunlight is noted to be difficult for Atlanteans to get use to, sometimes requiring them to wear thick goggles. Hypersonics are also capable of disorienting their senses.
objects.title: Atlantean (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your Sun physiology and Kryptonian heritage have combined and enhanced each other into something greater. You are constantly recharging your Kryptonian powers due to absorbing your own body's energy, meaning you grow constantly as if you were in the core of a sun. Furthermore, you need not fear either Kryptonite or the rays of a red sun any longer, as your powers come intrinsically from yourself, so they will not be weakened by such things.
addons.title: New Sun

addons.text:
Your Sunshine, Sun physiology, and Kryptonian heritage merge together to form a greater whole.
Your heat and flames burn through seemingly anything and everything it comes in contact with, esoteric or even conceptual things like infinity and eternity can be brought low by your searing inferno.

Your body is likewise elevated to new levels, able to grow with Sunshine without physically changing if you so wish, as well as receiving a massive boost in all ways, including such things as beauty. All abilities granted to you due to your Kryptonian heritage are now supercharged, and while not quite at the level of a Silver Age Kryptonian; with some time and training, you can get there.
addons.title: Chosen of Rao

addons.text: The magical nature of Sunshine has combined with your powers as a Kryptonian to extend your durability and power toward magic as well as the physical, meaning magic no longer harms you as it does a regular human, and your potential to wield magic, including Sunshine, has been improved proportionally to how much your strength is improved from a regular human.
addons.title: A Ray of Hope

addons.text: You gain The Plutonian’s true abilities and physiological traits through your Kryptonian physiology: unintentionally emulating your usual powers by subconsciously rearranging matter. You still retain many of your abilities, only that they lose their definition, moreover, their limits of what they can accomplish: your senses attain and perceive a sense of a clear molecular definition without concentrating, smelling the “odor” of another person’s adrenal glands from another city on small-scale, and fully perceive the whole globe without any sensory overload, your physical abilities passively defy the laws of physics, unwittingly defying Heisenberg’s uncertainty principle, able to strike and act on intangible or dimensional beings by fully detecting their makeup’s position and momentum in the physical plane, therefore, interacting with it, and more. Suppose you have Subatokinesis or (Shaker/Thinker) Omni-kinesis. In that case, your power manifests in ways the Plutonian demonstrated later down the line, like intangibility, manipulating quantum physics to create remote physical phenomena like an explosion, or manipulating an object’s physics, negating the moon’s inertia and rotational force, etc.
addons.title: The Plutonian Delusion (Irredeemable)

addons.text:
By virtue of your genetics, your powers created the same conditions as H’el, the Lost “Child” of Krypton.

Apart from all of abilities Kryptonian hold under a yellow sun, H’el was known as a special case both by his origins and the strange abilities he’d shown to possess: psychic powers ranging from telepathy and telekinesis capable of creating constructs and illusions, teleporting great distances from the depths of the Atlantic Ocean to Metropolis, and after bathing himself in the Star Chamber’s residual temporal energy, manipulate time, among others. This may have come from his unique genetics, made of countless Kryptonian brethren, while the different types of radiation from countless stars his cells absorbed made possible through his genetics’ robustness.

While you achieve this under different conditions, the results are the same. Your malleable genetics streamlined your Kryptonian physiology to adapt against any type of radiation or energy, no matter how exotic or supernatural, gaining abilities from the same source as long as your cells absorbed enough energy, e.g., once blasted or showered with enough psychic energy or any type of radiation that’s psychoactive in nature will develop into a growing talent in psionics, albeit with a greater amount of precision and potency owing to your Kryptonian nature.

As a start, you begin with H’el’s additional abilities after failing to restore Krypton using the Star Chamber.

And like H’el, you’re resistant to the Kryptonians’ usual weaknesses of Kryptonite and the red sun, so you’re free to make Krypton Great Again!
addons.title: H’el On Earth
Story of Superman
addons.text: "...and Superman says to the evil scientist politician, 'You cannot knock down Metropolis with your ray!' and he says, 'Oh yeah? Who can stop me? No one can!' But Superman can. That's what he does. He saves us from the bad guys. He stops the rays and makes sure that the buildings don't fall, and if they do... He gets the people out. And everyone will cheer. Superman always wins. The good guys always win." You now have a literal and extremely strong form of plot armour that protects you in times of great need. When facing overwhelming odds, displaying great deeds of heroism or experiencing extremely intense and genuine emotions of love, courage or hope, you will be temporarily empowered to perform acts far beyond your previous limits. This surge of power can be truly absurd in scope and scale, and adapts to any challenge you might face, such as letting you survive mortal wounds, shake off supposedly absolute mind control or shatter "unbreakable" chains. This is not infallible, nor is it a guarantee of success, rather being a test of your conviction to ensure you have a fair chance of overcoming any evil.

addons.title: Cosmic Metabolism
addons.text:
Just as Eternals are an evolutionary offshoot of humanity, you have become an evolutionary offshoot of Kryptonians. Your physiology has evolved to rely on cosmic energy rather than yellow sunlight.

Rather than removing your ability to absorb yellow sunlight to enhance and fuel your strength and powers, you possess the ability to metabolise sunlight from any kind of sun into cosmic energy. This increases the ease of growing as an eternal due to the prevalence of stars and removes your previous vulnerability to the radiation that red stars emit.

Because of the way your cells now store cosmic energy, your cosmic energy-enhanced state effectively becomes your base state. It requires no effort to maintain while being incredibly energy efficient, only reducing your cosmic energy stores as you expend it.

Your base state now rivals the likes of the Sentry or Blue Marvel in physical attributes, and your abilities such as your psionics or molecule transmutation growing massively in both power and control, easily being able to act across an area the size of New York City, with control matching the likes of Sersi, with you growing stronger as you continue to accumulate cosmic energy.

As you continue to absorb and accumulate cosmic energy, you continuously grow stronger without end, with only the total energy of the combined stars of the universe acting as a hard limit on how strong you can get. However, some form of multiversal travel effectively removes this limit, as you can travel to a world with more stars.

objects.text:
Your genes are modified, making you a 100% pure Kryptonian. You gain powers similar to Superman. Super strength and tactile telekinesis, super speed, flight, nigh-invulnerability, enhanced senses, improved cognition, heat vision, cold breath, and super regeneration.

While you are exposed to yellow sunlight, your powers work at their maximum. Without it, they are reduced gradually, until they are completely drained. Though this process would take a considerable amount of time, and could go on for months on end under no yellow sun, without any significant reduction to your powers.

Be wary of Kryptonite, as it can have various effects on you dependant on the colour, the most dangerous being Green Kryptonite, which can severely weaken and kill Kryptonians from exposure. In addition, if you were exposed to radiation from a red sun, you would lose your powers.
objects.title: (Wo)Man of Steel (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Your genes have been modified with green Martian DNA, and you have gained the associated powers. 

Firstly, Martians possess shapeshifting capabilities on a molecular level, allowing them to alter themselves in ways almost unthinkable to less malleable species, such as causing their biopolymers to no longer reflect light, rendering them invisible. When trained, this can even extend to increasing or decreasing their relative density, letting them phase through objects. As a consequence, Martians also possess great regeneration, to the extent they can restore lost limbs in mere minutes, and rapidly slow their own ageing. 

Physically, Martians are strong and durable enough to contend with Kryptonians, and easily shatter reinforced concrete. Similarly, they can both move and process thought at incredible speed.

Finally, Martians possess incredible psychic abilities, being naturally telepathic and telekinetic, able to extend illusions, possessions, force blasts and telepathic assaults as easily as throwing a punch.

As you are not a full blooded Martian, you do not possess the psychosomatic fear of fire implanted by the Guardians of the Universe.
objects.title: Martian Manhunter (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You are now one of the last Czarnians, and as a Czarnian, you are one of the most dangerous and nearly unkillable species in existence. This is because Czarnians possess natural physical abilities that are honestly astounding. Their strength and durability are able to physically match Martians, combat-focused New Gods, experienced Green Lanterns, and even yellow sun-empowered Kryptonians. They can casually lift 1 million tons, take planet-destroying attacks without a scratch, and their speed is such that they can combat speed Force users, react while traveling at massively FTL speeds across the universe, and sharpen their awareness while increasing their temporal flow.

One of the most well-known traits is the fact that they have truly inexhaustible stamina. They don't need any food, water, air, or sleep and can survive in the vacuum of space without any harm. Lobo has been known to "ride through the cold of space on his Space Hog and not notice the heat of blazing suns."

The senses of Czarnians are pretty interesting because their sense of smell is so strong that once they catch a scent just once, there is nowhere in the universe you can hide from them. One Czarnian has been known to track prey across intergalactic distances. They can even hear in space and possess a special sense that allows them to detect the weakest point in an opponent.

Czarnians tend to have either a general genius-level intellect or being super-genius in matters associated with destruction and violence. They craft unique weapons to kill prey and create complex virulent agents and the necessary antidotes to them, or making sentient "space vehicles" stuffed with all manner of weapons or semi-sentient weapons, creating all the technology necessary for a true utopia. They are also skilled at learning languages, with the most well-known example being Lobo, who has learned to speak 17,897 different languages from across the universe. You are able to choose between either the general genius in all categories or being smarter but Specialize in Violence and destruction.

The greatest trait of Czarnians that truly makes them one of the most dangerous species in the universe is their truly insane healing abilities. These abilities are so great that they are known throughout the universe to be biologically immortal unless facing another member of their race. Examples of how extreme their healing is include being immune to the effects of aging, disease, toxins, and poisons. They can regenerate damaged or destroyed tissue instantly, such as lost limbs or other body parts, with little apparent pain. They have even regenerated out of a pool of their own blood by recycling the cells instantly and controlling that same recycling of their cells whenever they feel like it to fight off foreign infections. One of their members could fight off a Black Light Infection from Black Lanterns. Czarnians reproduce through conventional means, but they can also reproduce asexually through replication caused by their regeneration. If you are wounded, any blood spilt may grow into a new Czarnian, sharing your memories and personality. So beware depending on your Personality you may have to fight your "Clones" if you are not careful.

Last thing all Czarnians are Characterized by having truly White Skin, Red Eyes Surrounded by a Black facial markings, an Wild but Fabulous Hair.
objects.title: One of the Last Czarnians (DC Comics)

addons.text:
The Cosmic Energy you’ve been gifted with has supercharged your divine concept within the Fourth World. As a result, even the broadest of domains would find themselves advancing at a rapid pace.

As you grow, you’ll learn to create and break greater things than you ever thought possible; telekinetically constructing representations of conceptual machines, manipulating energies and thaumospheres of entire worlds (or for that matter creating them with only Telekinetic might), even the creation of highly evolved servitors, and stranger things besides. They stand as mere examples in your path to claim.
addons.title: Two Houses, Alike in Dignity

objects.text: You have become a New God. New Gods are beings that call themselves such (and certainly live up to the moniker) from the ashes of the Old Gods, and their close proximity to the Source, a primordial energy source behind the creation and “source” of all that exists in the DC Continuity, bestowing them phenomenal powers. Being a species with one of the highest technology bases, also contributed to their formidability through genetic stability and evolutionary perfection springing from their scientific base. All New Gods are far stronger, faster, smarter, and tougher than an ordinary or most alien species, being functionally immortal and never aging past the age of 30, weathering the ravages of time; they can continue working or functioning at their best for days on end without feeling fatigued or needing sustenance; capable of shattering concrete and reinforced steel akin to glass, not to mention lifting and handling hundreds of tons with ease; any New Gods are durable to withstand most damage such blunt, piercing and slashing attacks or obstacles as feeling like little more than pebbles to your physical form; hell, the Empire State Building could fall on you and you would only leave with bruises; and let’s not gloss over the health of a New God, with being a paragon of health, being immune to almost any disease from the Multiverse, rejecting both plagues, toxins, and parasites, among other abilities. Above all, you contest or nearly match the likes of a Kryptonian in physicality… that is when you match them in size. Let me restate it, size. A rarely discussed detail for natives in the Fourth World is that they’re larger than those of other universes, giants compared to mortals. Your ‘true’ size within the Fourth World would dwarf planets, matching grown stars in their enormity. It’s just the New Gods when traveling to destinations through their Boom Tubes, which adjust their sizes to a reasonable level, giving the illusion of commonality. You can change between your ‘normal’ size, ‘human’ size and anything in between through sheer act of will alone. Another hardly known detail is that New Gods are also personifications of ideas, with the Fourth World acting as an archetypal world of Platonic Ideals i.e. Darkseid with Tyranny, Mister Miracle with Freedom, and Lightray with Joy; with you being no exception. You can choose whichever idea or concept you personify, which confers appropriate powers befitting the idea. This provides no other tangible benefit beyond an in-depth understanding of the said concept, allowing you to express it through your skills and deeds and learn things related to the said concept more quickly. The more broad it is, the less noticeable this benefit is. With this in mind, even gods bleed. Sufficient force or power that outweighs your physical capabilities can wound even the likes of you, so your nature as God and natural durability are wrought low by Radion, the Kryptonite of your species. Good thing it’s hard to come by. Finally, the New Gods are a species outside the space-time flow, preventing you from dimensional changes to yourself.
objects.title: New Gods of the Fourth World (DC Comics)

addons.text:
You have been injected with the Connors Formula. While this would have turned you into a vicious monster, instead, your Regressive Atavism has fused and modified the formula so now you have the benefits of both with the drawbacks of neither. This formula turns your already reptilian appearance into a full-on lizard man. With you now being 8 feet tall and muscles to match, ready to explode into motion at a moment's notice.

Your strength, speed, agility, and endurance are now massively increased. Your strength has increased from throwing cars to throwing bulldozers with ease, while your speed has been increased so much that your top speed is now 45 mph, and you have the endurance to keep up this pace for a full 24 hours before you begin to tire. Your agility and reflexes have been enhanced enough to go toe to toe with Spider-Man and win. With your new form comes better senses, being able to smell better than a bloodhound, and you can even taste the air, enhancing your already amazing senses.

Your biggest physical change is your tail, which is extremely flexible, strong, and fast, with you being able to shatter concrete with ease. Your tail is also detachable; while this does leave you without a tail, that is no longer a problem with your increased regeneration being able to regrow your entire tail in seconds. Your claws and teeth are also strengthened enough to shear through steel with only some difficulty. You can also climb walls and ceilings with ease now due to you having similar adhesive properties to a gecko.

Your body is not the only thing that has changed with your ingestion of the formula; your mind has changed as well. You can now telepathically communicate with and control all reptilian creatures within 2 miles. Instead of becoming a mindless monster like most people who take this formula, your mind stays the same. You no longer become less intelligent or animalistic over time. You have become the perfect fusion of man and reptile.
addons.title: The Connors Formula (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have developed the same rare mutation that Waylon Jones was born with, Regressive Atavism. Your skin has taken on the appearance of crocodile scales and has hardened to the point where even high-caliber bullets will do nothing if they are not fired point-blank. Your scales are not your only mutation; you also gain sharp teeth and claws able to rip people apart with ease.

Your mutations also grant supernatural strength, allowing you to destroy concrete walls or throw cars around with ease. This strength comes with size to match, with you being nearly 8 feet tall. Like other reptiles, your mutation draws its DNA from you can also regenerate, letting you heal small cuts or minor wounds very quickly and even letting you regrow entire limbs in a couple of weeks. This mutation also grants you an enhanced sense of smell, reaching near bloodhound levels. You can also hold your breath for several hours, and you are an excellent swimmer.

This mutation does come with one major drawback: as you get older, you get more reptilian, meaning you get bigger, stronger, your face gets more elongated, reminiscent of crocodiles, and you even grow a tail. This slow creep of becoming more reptilian is not limited to your body but also your mind, as the reptilian part of your brain gains more control of your psyche and you become less intelligent and more animalistic as time goes on, possibly even reducing you to nothing more than an animal.
objects.title: Killer Croc (DC Comics)

objects.text:
A metahuman is a human born with the Meta-Gene, a rare genetic mutation that, when activated, grants superhuman abilities. This activation can occur through many different methods, including severe physical trauma, exposure to exotic chemicals, or even magic. When triggered, the Meta-Gene adapts to the source of bio-stress, using it as a catalyst for genetic change and shaping the nature of the abilities that emerge. As a result, metahuman powers are highly diverse and often closely tied to the circumstances of their activation.

The term “metahuman” is also commonly used as a broader classification for superpowered beings in general, with figures such as Superman, Wonder Woman, and Aquaman sometimes grouped under the label despite their non-human origins. Some individuals are born with their Meta-Gene already active, even without any prior genetic precedent, as seen with Dinah Lance, the second Black Canary, who was born a metahuman despite neither parent exhibiting the trait.

You are a metahuman whose Meta-Gene is already active, granting you a power of your choosing. The strength of a Meta-Gene is not fixed, allowing your abilities to grow through continued use and practice. Additionally, you are guaranteed that your Meta-Gene’s activation does not result in any unwanted physical mutations.
objects.title: Metahuman (DC Comics)

objects.text: You possess the Coluan/Brainiac biological and technological physiology of Brainiac as portrayed in My Adventures with Superman. . Your body is a highly advanced techno-organic lifeform, combining synthetic biology, cybernetics, adaptive nanotechnology, and an extraordinarily powerful artificial intelligence. Your mind operates as a massively parallel computational system with exceptional memory, analysis, pattern recognition, multitasking, and learning capabilities. You can rapidly understand unfamiliar languages, biological systems, technology, and scientific principles, while your body possesses enhanced strength, durability, reflexes, regeneration, sensory perception, and resistance to environmental hazards. You can interface directly with computers, machines, spacecraft, networks, and other technological systems, allowing you to treat advanced technology almost as an extension of your own nervous system. Your biology is self-evolving and modular, allowing you to incorporate compatible improvements from technology, genetic material, cybernetics, and exotic sources without losing your identity. You can generate and control specialized drones, construct auxiliary bodies, store enormous quantities of information, and distribute portions of your consciousness across your technological network while retaining a protected core consciousness. You may develop increasingly sophisticated forms of energy manipulation, defensive systems, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and biological engineering as you gain knowledge and resources. You can directly engage extremely powerful Kryptonian-level opponents. You possess immense strength, durability, speed, reflexes, and stamina, allowing you to survive and contend with Superman-class beings in direct combat.
objects.title: Brainiac (DC Comics: My Adventures With Superman)

addons.text: ‘Your body has strings of circuit-like patterns running from your spine, each ending in a jagged glyph denting their purpose’ The Brand and Bond have integrated and adapted to your Osmosian heritage. Within your markings, you can contain samples to absorb at will. These range from materials like steel to esoteric DNA, to small parcels of energy. You must have absorbed the material at least once before these packages can develop.
addons.title: Tissue Sample

addons.text:
Your absorption has reached new heights unthinkable to most Osmosians. Not only do you gain an instinctive knowledge of how to use any mutations and abilities you acquire from your absorptions, but materials, energies and DNA you collect enters a ‘repository’ stored in your spinal column, allowing you to reproduce and curate your mutations to create your ideal form.

Additionally, your mental threshold has been greatly increased, greatly decreasing mental effects from your mutations, including the mental instability from strenuous alterations to your form.
addons.title: Composite Mastery

objects.text:
Osmosians are a mutant subspecies of humans with unique abilities that vary from individual to individual. In your case, you possess the same powers as Kevin Levin.

You have the ability to absorb matter and energy for various purposes, such as increasing your strength, durability, stamina, speed, and agility, which depend on the material you absorb. Additionally, you can heal yourself and shapeshift using absorbed matter. You are also capable of absorbing the life-force of other creatures, copying their DNA and granting yourself 1/10 of that being’s power. However, any absorbed DNA dissipates over time or through excessive use, requiring you to recharge. Absorbing DNA can also make you mentally unstable, with the severity depending on how much DNA you have absorbed.

If you lose control of your mutations, you become a fusion of all the DNA you have absorbed, turning into a chimera and falling into madness. Having your absorbed DNA drained can restore your sanity, but it leaves you physically exhausted. Despite all of this, you can overcome the mental instability caused by absorbing DNA through sufficient willpower.
objects.title: Osmosian (Ben 10)

addons.title: Verdona
addons.text:
With an innate conection to magic, you’ve become a truly realised Anodite, sensing manipulating manna with great ease. Your expertise is so great in fact that with access to enough manna you’re able to replicate any magical effect you’ve observed or deem ‘theoretically possible’. This extends even so far as implanting the ‘Spark’ in others, or removing it.

Additionally, as you can sense the manna in all things you’re able to draw it towards yourself, ensuring you’re never truly ‘out’ of magic to use.

addons.title: Charmer
addons.text: Being able to summon magical implements and focuses not only serves to allow you to channel your magic easier, but by focusing on a specific spell or technique, you can imbue the new ‘relic’ with a single specific function, not unlike the creation of one of Charmcaster’s Rock monsters or satchel. With experience and time you could even create objects at the same level as a ‘charm of bazel’.

addons.title: Anodyne
addons.text:
With access to your primal Spark, you can connect the Alpha Rune directly to your Spark, giving you an innate and ironclad connection to Legerdomain. 

Not only has your development time been drastically reduced, now approaching ten years with only independent study before becoming a full Anodite, your connection to the Rune ensures that it can’t be simply wrenched from you, being easily resummonable at will.

Legerdomain itself also responds to this, not only letting you shape it as you desire as usual, but to administrate even the magical throughflow throughout it. With this coil could create permanent portals, create zones where space overlaps, and places where magic erodes and crumbles immediately. With practice you could even adjust the amount that time is dilated between Legerdomain and the outside world.

addons.title: Technodite
addons.text:
Your innate link to technology has let you freely alter the way your Mana impacts the world, and vice versa. 

Your mana is now distinctly suited to being melded with technology, being perfect for the creation of magitech and similar phenomena. Beyond the obvious benefits from the creation of esoteric technology, this connection with the mundane allows you to route spells through mundane infrastructure (such as turning a city’s electrical grid into a summoning circle), or distribute technological benefits through your mana (like connecting to a wireless network using ambient mana). 

With the right skill you could even convert raw mana into physical technology of your own design, or break down technology into raw mana for your use.

addons.title: Anode Eve
addons.text:
