With mastery over matter and mana you’ve become able to connect the two with extreme efficiency, giving you immense control where the mystical and material overlap.

Initially you’ll simply be able to break down matter around you into raw mana to do with as you please, or convert raw mana into material likewise. 

However as you grow in skill and strength, you’ll be able to construct complex machinery and relays, create magical focuses seemingly from nothing or even create whole people by forming soul and body at once.

addons.title: Devlin’s Inheritance
addons.text:
Due to your Spark, and the Osmosian ability to absorb energy, you’ve gained the ability to empower yourself using pure mana. 

While this confers the usual benefits of absorbing energy, it also allows you to empower your spells far beyond what they would usually manage. These range from simply improving a shield’s durability, to draining an entire leyline of mana to summon a giant rock monster.

Additionally you can use mana to form a ‘link’ to anything in your mana can reach, letting you use your Osmosian abilities on it, absorbing the relevant material, energy, or DNA.

objects.text:
While your genetics remain unchanged, a spark of magic ignites within you as you become a young Anodite - an entity of pure mana. Your newfound nature makes it easier for you to learn magic and manipulate mana. You start off as one in a 'normal' fleshy body and about as strong and skilled as Gwen Tennyson at the start of Alien Force, and can learn to take the 'true' Anodite form with time and practice.

At first all you'll be able to do is form shields, platforms, and energy blasts. However, with time and training, you can learn to do much, much more, potentially reaching Verdona’s level of power and skill.

Teleportation, Size Alteration, Invisibility, Telepathy, Memory Manipulation, and Healing are among the possible abilities you can develop.

Just be careful not to lose yourself, with intense enough emotions it’s not unheard of for young Anodites to take on their ‘true’ form earlier than they are prepared for, this can lead to the normal ‘human’ body being destroyed in the process.

After approximately 60 to 70 years of independent study, or significantly less with a capable mentor, you could achieve the level of a fully realized Anodite. Mastering your powers would enable you to seamlessly transition between your normal ‘human’ form and your ‘true’ Anodite form. This form greatly enhances an Anodite's abilities, allowing them to accomplish feats that were once unattainable.

<small>Note: Typically pure mana is pink or purple in colour, but other colours for less pure mana exist, you will be able to freely choose the colour of your mana, and what colours your ‘true’ Anodite form will take.</small>
objects.title: Anodite (Ben 10)

addons.text: You are not a monster but a devil. The blood of the legendary Hanma lineage and the blood of the Saiyan race have granted you incalculable strength and potential. Not only do you learn and adapt in combat faster than any other Half-Saiyan known on earth. Like the Saiyans from Universe 6, you have the ability to unlock and master the Super Saiyan forms much more easily than the Saiyans from Universe 7. Your Hanma lineage also makes it easier to learn and harness the Ikari form, while thankfully, your innate battle instincts allow you to not be overcome by the Rage of the Oozaru while still requiring the necessary mental and spiritual training to not let it consume you in battle.
addons.title: Wrathful Demon

addons.text:
Your unleashed potential has released the awesome power hidden within your Half-Saiyan heritage. Now, just like Gohan, you too can use the Beast form. This form’s power is enough to rival the Autonomous Ultra Instinct.

It does come with one drawback: loss of control. The usage of this power can make your anger swell and cause you to go berserk and lose all rationality. While you are even stronger during this state, unless you can overcome your rage, it is incredibly reckless to use it.
addons.title: Further Beyond

addons.text:
Your unleashed potential has released the awesome power hidden within your Half-Saiyan heritage. Now, just like Gohan, you too can use the Beast form. This form’s power is enough to rival the Autonomous Ultra Instinct.

It does come with one drawback: loss of control. The usage of this power can make your anger swell and cause you to go berserk and lose all rationality. Thankfully, your Hanma heritage allows you to easily counter this and use the rage as an additional power boost.
addons.title: Even Further Beyond

addons.text:
Your DNA has transformed remarkably, resulting in a perfect balance between these powerful warrior races: the Viltrumites and the Saiyans. This fusion has given rise to a new hybrid warrior, a being that surpasses the strength of both lineages while embodying their finest traits and abilities.

As a result of this unique genetic amalgamation, your Zenkai ability—an inherent trait of Saiyans that grants them increased strength after recovering from intense battles—has been exponentially enhanced. Your Zenkai boosts are no longer restricted to after recovering from near-death injuries, as seen in the average Saiyan; instead, you experience subtler yet increasingly powerful Zenkai boosts that grow stronger the longer a fight continues.

Moreover, your ability to adapt in combat has reached unprecedented levels. You can effortlessly learn and develop new Ki techniques that have never been seen before. Your control over Ki enables you to perform feats that others cannot. This capability not only makes you a formidable opponent but also evolves dynamically with each battle.
addons.title: Perfect Warrior Race

addons.text: The Self that is Oozaru changes with your existence as a Child of Forces beyond the veil of the world. In layman’s terms, your Fera or Uratha abilities mutate your Oozaru form, by extension your Ikari form, into an innate technique you can sink into and make use of using your Oozaru’s Rage and Nature as fuel, resulting in a more potent and denser Ki, although harder to shape and channel, it’s far more powerful once mastered. This adds a more profound connection to the spiritual and natural elements around you, fueling a technique where you can shapeshift your Oozaru form as a Fera or Uratha would, harnessing it from nature’s Ki, including turning into a War Form, always able to combine it with your Super Saiyan transformations; it’s not a full-fledged SSJ4, is doesn’t seamless blend your Oozaru and Saiyan form, more often equal to a in-between state, so not as stronger. This connection helps in harnessing Gifts as Ki Techniques, a school of techniques where you become intuitively aware of the spirit world, the closer you commune with it. Having An Apocalypse Forsaken allows you to layer your Oozaru forms to the point of furthering or altering your SSJ4 transformation progress, ballooning the transformation’s power and abilities. If you have Wrathful Demon, your Fera or Uratha also creates from changes with your Ikari form, making it more attuned to nature’s changes, passively able to harness a planet’s energy, tripling both your potential and form.
addons.title: Shaping the Rage Within

addons.text:
Like Goku Black, you gain Zenkais not from near-death experiences but by simply feeling pain or rage. These scale with the amount of each you experience, provided you are in control or survive the ordeal, and can function afterwards.

Self-inflicted pain can also work, but unless you're willing to cut off your limbs, or throw yourself into torture chambers, it won't amount of much. In real fights, however, this compounds into truly awe-inspiring surges of power. Leaving stronger and growing faster than otherwise, regardless of the result.

Your anger can be channeled for more precise versions of Gohan's Rage Boosts, trading wild and explosive displays of overwhelming power for more focused and calculated methods to decimate your target. This can lead to generating new abilities or applications for what you already have, tailored to you, such as Goku Black's Scythe.
addons.title: This Pain Will Make Me Stronger!

addons.text:
Through the fusion of two of the universe’s most extraordinary bloodlines, your DNA has risen beyond mortal limits. You embody the merged might of Kryptonian solar supremacy and Saiyan warrior evolution—a hybrid whose potential eclipses both species.

As a Kryptonian–Saiyan, your body absorbs yellow sunlight to generate limitless power. This solar energy fuels and amplifies your ki, accelerating Zenkai growth into a continuous evolutionary loop: every injury healed and every moment in sunlight increases your strength, speed, and resilience.

Your physique approaches near-invulnerability, capable of enduring planet-shattering forces. Strength scales with both emotional intensity and solar charge, enabling world-breaking strikes, impossibly fast movement, and ki–solar attacks capable of mimicking stellar phenomena.

Kryptonian cells act as perfect ki channels, granting precise control and allowing hybrid techniques such as Solar Burst (condensed sunlight + ki detonation) and Crimson Ascension (stellar-charged aura amplification). Heat vision, flight, enhanced senses, and ki mastery all operate in tandem.

Your Saiyan instincts fuse with Kryptonian discipline, unlocking hybrid transformations. Under a full moon—or heightened emotion—you can enter Solar Oozaru, combining Great Ape might with solar empowerment.
addons.title: The Saiyan of Tommorrow

addons.text:
The first thing that urked true fear about the Saiyan race is the Super Saiyan Transformation, as Frieza can attest to. You are now the ultimate symbol of this fear, a Saiyan that proves to your kin their limitless potential. Any supernatural energies, or special techniques that are foreign to you can be modified into a Saiyan Transformation, akin to Ultra Instinct for Goku, and Ultra Ego for Vegeta. This is achieved in three steps.

The first step is to have a fundamental understanding of the foreign energy or technique you wish to adapt. The second step is to be comfortable in using it, to the point of second nature. The third and final step, is the self modification process so your body "understands" it. This goes by faster with a teacher.

For example, after learning Nature Chakra, you can achieve a transformation similar to Sage Mode, and wield power equivalent to when Naruto first attained it. Mastering all forms of Haki can lead to attaining a form that transcends what was previously thought possible with it. Even something like Nature Magic can lead to a form that makes you the Avatar of Gaia, and more. Furthermore, it will manifest itself in a way that's perfectly compatible with you.

From there you can improve and adjust the form through continuous discipline, even mix it with your old Saiyan Transformations to create unique results like with Super Saiyan Blue and it's evolutions, push it beyond its limits, or create an entirely different Transformation line based on it.

Just don't go too crazy on the hair okay?
addons.title: We Saiyans Have No Limits!

addons.text:
Through the combination of Saiyan evolution and Demon heritage, you become one of the most dangerous beings in the universe. As a Demon-Saiyan hybrid, you have both the prodigious combat prowess and myriad of darker abilities from your lineage. 

These combine to make you a prodigy in both Ki and Magic, becoming a rare being who can utilize both simultaneously. The same principles to grow in both blend harmoniously, and the techniques you can create are limited only by your imagination and ability to realize them. 

Your thirst for combat and darkness also affects your very being. Your presence becoming darker and twisted to resemble the Evil Saiyan, Cumber. Such as emitting an Evil Aura that can corrupt those in your wake, becoming Berserk versions of themselves, or exerting a pressure that fills all around you with fear. Your transformations also become further amplified and mutated, bringing out the best of Saiyan might with Demon magical arts, physical characteristics, and versatility. 

Regardless of how you advance, or how tainted you become, you will always retain full control of yourself. Even as you succumb to immense emotion or demonic influence.
addons.title: The Saiyan Raised in Hell

addons.text: You are a Saiyan who has conquered death, and all who know this will fear you because of it. When you receive a Zenkai from normal conditions, it will be much more potent than average, and will not fall to diminishing returns as easily when you advance beyond the need for it. At worst giving a slight, but noticeable buff to your abilities, or wherever you're currently lacking. However, with either of the choices selected, you gain new benefits. From Battle Continuation, Second Chance or Retribution, that critical state becomes the trigger for your primal instincts to be at their best. Sharpening senses, dodging with uncanny grace, striking with monstrous power, and moving with more precision than should be possible. This high is great enough to replace all your pain and fatigue with battle lusted ecstasy, and as long as you don't fall, you will keep going. It will remain even as you heal from this state, but wane overtime. From Prime Soul, you transcend what was thought possible with Zenkais by facing the full brunt of death and becoming reborn from it. For reference, even as weak as Raditz, dying in his position will make you come back three to five times stronger. While suffering either the torment of Frieza or the Androids before death would make you become reborn as a Super Saiyan or even higher. Either way, you see near-death or death itself as an opportunity, not an obstacle.
addons.title: Perfect Zenkai
S-Cell Surplus
addons.text:
You gain an unusual mutation to your S-Cells, the specialized cells within all Saiyans which allow them to become a Super Saiyan. 

This Mutation allows you to partially tap into the power of your Super Saiyan Transformation in incremental amounts without fully transforming. While doing so your eyes and aura will change as if you transformed but not your hair unless you fully transform into a Super Saiyan or fully transform to the next level of Super Saiyan. This partial transformation allows you to conserve your energy and stamina at an unprecedented level compared to normal.

Additionally this boon grants you partial access to your first Super Saiyan transformation though only the embers of it with you being at most able to draw forth a quarter of its true multiplier.

Lastly this boon greatly accelerates the rate at which you unlock and master your Super Saiyan transformations.

objects.text:
You now embody the fusion of two lineages, seamlessly inheriting the distinctive traits and remarkable abilities bestowed upon you by both your Saiyan and non-Saiyan parentage.

Your mixed heritage affords you a prodigious potential for growth and power. Compared to your pure-blooded Saiyan counterparts, you possess a natural affinity for channeling and controlling ki, enabling you to access it with greater ease and finesse.

You also exhibit physical characteristics typical of Saiyans, such as proportionally enhanced physical resilience, Zenkai that empowers you to rise even stronger after each near-death experience, allowing you to surpass previous limits with each resurrection, and a natural affinity for combat. Additionally, a tail, a symbol of your heritage, represents the dormant might of the Oozaru, waiting to awaken if your gaze falls upon the radiant full moon.

On top of your Oozaru heritage, you have the potential to realize another tier of power altogether: the Super Saiyan. This blonde spiking-up of your hair comes with an immense power increase, letting even the weakest Saiyan be able to take on small armies. You have 2 options to achieve this initial form: either to experience an immense amount of anger, or to train enough that you unlock the form out of a need.

Beyond this form, there lies many more Super Saiyan forms, albeit some with strict requirements...

It is within the depths of your being that an untamed wellspring of power lies dormant, poised to surge forth during moments of heightened emotion and unwavering determination. This reservoir of energy, once unleashed, propels you towards unimaginable heights, echoing the extraordinary journey of Gohan as he realized his true potential through disciplined control and focused training.
objects.title: Half-Saiyan (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
Like Cooler and Frieza, you've pushed the limits of your Frost Demon heritage by putting in the once-useless effort of training. How this manifests is up to you, from going beyond your Final Form to resemble the mutation that is Final Form Cooler, the mockery of the Super Saiyan that is Golden Frieza, and its apex of Black Frieza, or something else entirely.

The universe shall remember why your kind is to be feared.
addons.title: Emperor of the Universe

objects.text:
You have now become a member of the Frost Demon race, you have the ability to customize your physical appearance as long as it remains consistent with the characteristics of the Frost Demon species. While Frost Demons are typically weak, you have been bestowed with a mutation akin to Frieza, elevating your potential to a similar level. Your powers possess an immense magnitude, to the point where you may find it necessary to assume multiple forms in order to suppress your base form, as a mere gesture could inadvertently obliterate entire planets. However, through discipline and mastery, you can learn to control your powers without the need for multiple forms, and even attain new forms that greatly augment your base one, provided you are willing to expand the efforts to achieve such levels, though you can do so with relative ease. 

In addition you have also gained telekinetic abilities, the ability to survive in space, regeneration, a highly resilient physique, and the capacity to paralyze your opponents by injecting a potent venom through retractable bone spurs concealed within your forearms. As a Frost Demon, it is expected that you will live an extended lifespan of thousands of years, affording you the freedom to explore the universe at your leisure.
objects.title: Frost Demon (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You have now undergone a transformation into a Majin being. Your physical form consists of a highly malleable substance that can be molded and utilized in various ways. Due to the resilient nature of your gum-like body, you possess immunity to blunt traumas, and your exceptional regenerative abilities allow for complete recovery from any injury, except for total atomization, rendering you nearly invulnerable. Furthermore, by assimilating individuals through absorption, you gain the ability to incorporate their characteristics and powers, resulting in significant enhancements to your entire being. With the antenna situated atop your head, you possess the ability to utilize magic. This transformative magic grants you the power to metamorphose individuals into sustenance, though the full extent and potential of this magic can only be realized through your own exploration and experimentation.

Unlike the stereotypical intelligence limitations of Majin beings, you fortunately retain all mental faculties and intelligence that you possessed prior to the transformation.
objects.title: Majin (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text: ”All you have… Plus a bit extra.” Whether through Shenron’s blessing or your own efforts, you’ve attained a transformation akin to Orange Piccolo. Enabling you to rival the power of saiyans, even those with god ki and above. You may design this form however you wish, including the new color of your skin.
addons.title: Power Awakening

objects.text:
You have become a member of the Namekian species. Namekians are a magical race with physical and magical abilities split into two clans: the dragon clan, which focuses on mystic potential, and the warrior clan, which focuses on physical potential. However, being part of one clan does not mean you cannot learn the techniques of the other clan.
 
Namekians possess a wide range of abilities, including increased hearing range through two antennae above the head, sharp teeth, talon-like nails, a regenerative healing factor, telepathic capability, magic potential, the ability to survive on only water for nutrients, and the ability to stretch limbs and grow in height and size. You can also heal others and create magical items within the limits of your strength.
 
As a Namekian, you can fuse with others of your species, awaken dormant powers in others, and even spawn new life from eggs regurgitated from your mouth. You can also customize their appearance and abilities. Additionally, you can transfer your soul into an egg if you know you are about to die. Namekians can only die if their brain is obliterated or they run out of energy to regenerate.
objects.title: Namekian (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text: The Tuffles are a race of highly advanced aliens wiped out by the barbaric Saiyan during the Saiyan-Tuffle war. The last of the Tuffle created a pair of genetically superior life forms, parasite-like organisms, which they infused with the DNA of the Tuffle King engineered specifically to seek out the destruction of the Saiyan race as revenge, one of these pair being you. Your body is now totally malleable, down to the cellular level, allowing you to freely reform and reshape yourself or turn into liquid and even regenerate from a single cell. Your primary ability, however, is the possession of other beings, something you can do by entering the body of another through even the smallest cut or opening and overpowering their will to resist. Once possessed, you may change the host to look more and more like you as time goes on. You'll have full control over their body and mind and begin to assimilate their power and memories. Provided you stayed in their form for long enough, even a powerful Saiyan such as Vegeta would, at most, only need a few days to fully assimilate in this fashion. If you wish, you may leave the host before taking all of their power and instead lay an egg inside their brains. This egg will hatch in a few minutes and brainwash the host into being a loyal servant to you, even to the point of attacking their own families, possessing all the power that you left them. If you decide just to assimilate all their strength and leave, they will be left as a lifeless husk once you have exited their body. For every loyal follower you have acquired, you can establish a link with them, allowing you to draw out their energy and turn it into power for yourself, increasing your raw strength in proportional to the energy taken. It would take the energy of thousands, if not millions, of beings to make much of a noticeable difference if they're nowhere near as strong as you are. You now carry the Legacy of the Tuffle; go and return it to what it once was.
objects.title: Tuffleization (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text: You gain a transformation that elevates you from an ordinary demon, to the pinnacle of demons. In this form, your abilities rise to the level of the gods themselves, gaining your own form of God Ki to boot with similar properties. But even this godly power is only a stepping stone, able to adapt into many different variations based on your archetype, source of power, origin, or experimentation. Should you meet the right conditions, you can advance into the various upgraded versions of this form throughout Dragon Ball Heroes and Xenoverse, and further refine them through training. Even create your own unique ones. Note: Possessing the Awakener Power, Demon Generals Upgrade, or Broken Pantheon Upgrade will let you bestow this power to your subordinates. Even turn those you wish into Demons.
addons.title: Demon God(dess)

objects.text:
You've become a Demon from the world of Dragon Ball, born in the aptly named Demon Realm. An umbrella term for a wide variety of creatures of the same name, but with wildly different appearances. From the traditional ones like Dabura, Devilman, or Janemba, to more subtle and humanoid ones like Glorio, Towa, or Arisu. 

As a Demon, you possess a natural aptitude for combat, with a variety of methods to enact it to make you a versatile member of your kind. But if you prefer specialization, you can choose, once, to distribute your talents into either strength, magic, and/or expertise in a certain field. Either way, you will stand as someone comparable to your archetype, like Janemba or Dabura as warriors, Demigra as a wizard, or Towa as a scientist. 

Depending on your kind of Demon, you can have a few unique or bizarre abilities, such as Dabura's petrification spit or Janemba's portals. Also, you may gain a unique OoP suited to you, like a sword or wand. It is indestructible, can be summoned back at will, enhance your abilities, and grows alongside you. 

As a Demon, you have a lifespan bordering on 10,000 years, which adds on the stronger you are. All things aligned with darkness and evil are second nature to you, and will grow faster in powers founded on them.
objects.title: Demon (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
Your MUSE gains the same functions as Granolah's AI Companion, Oatmeal. Not only able to assist in mundane tasks, but can further elevate your Cerealian abilities by being a second pair of eyes for you. 

It can scan the surrounding area up to 10 meters, provide aim assist, act as a crosshair for your sight, warn you of danger, or offer general advice based on your situation. 

Oatmeal will grow alongside you, improving to be the best helper it can be.
addons.title: Oatmeal
Prime Cerealian
addons.text:
Through unlocking your potential, you've awakened both of your eyes at their maximum ability, and can climb to reach the power of Post Wish Granolah through training, without losing your lifespan. 

All of your Cerealian abilities are a cut above the rest, with accuracy so great that even those with Ultra Instinct will have a hard time not being grazed by your shots at minimum. Plus your reserves and potential with Ki or any other supernatural power skyrocketing to the extreme.

Note: Should you have an ocular power from this CYOA, like the Sharingan, Six Eyes, or Byakugan, you become the perfect host for them. Elevating their abilities and effectiveness beyond what was possible.

objects.text:
You've become a Cerealian. A humanoid race of warriors and engineers, capable of creating great industrial works and being refined fighters in their own right, with a normal lifespan of 200 years. 

You can fire powerful blasts from your fingers for a variety of long and mid-range attacks, and if you possess Ki or any other supernatural energy, they can be further augmented for other purposes 

You have a unique ability called the Evolved Right Eye, granting you telescopic sight and prodigious sniping prowess, to the point of landing a headshot on a moving target from miles away. As well as see the vital points of your targets, giving you a crystal clear bullseye to aim for that guarantees maximum damage. Should you wish to examine your target, this eye can pierce through the physical world to see everything from their organs, the smallest muscle movements, or even the flow of their Ki. 

Your left eye can also awaken this ability through training, doubling your already exceptional prowess with the first.
objects.title: Cerealian (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You've become a Kai—one of the core deities of the Dragon Ball Universe. You exist outside the realm of mortals, standing above and observing their activities the same way they view television, causing your abilities to naturally transcend theirs. You have unaging immortality, allowing you to live for millenia, but can still be killed, though even the afterlife can't do much to you because of your very nature. 

As a deity, you naturally possess God Ki, and can manipulate it as easily as breathing. With a grabbag of techniques derived from both Ki and Magic, these include but are not limited to: 

Telepathy to communicate across your entire local universe; Telekinesis powerful enough to bind, paralyse, or lift many targets with no resistance; Healing potent enough to restore someone from fatal condition to full health near instantly; Magic Materialization to manifest objects and matter great and small as you please; and the Kai Kai to teleport anywhere across the local universe, including the afterlife, other dimensions, or planes of existence. Provided that you’re aware of them.

Any techniques, powers, or magic systems you possess can be taught to mortals, and be blackboxed by needing specific requirements (character traits, bloodlines, states of mind, etc) to be considered "worthy" of them. You will also be an excellent teacher for this, as effective as King Kai was for Goku at bare minimum. Furthermore, your divinity expands your own potential and aptitude with said powers, so you can create techniques worthy of being sought after in the first place.

You have combat prowess and experience equal to Zamasu, incase you ever need to get personally involved in the mortal world. You may also choose to have Zamasu's techniques or create your own. As well as potential equal to the Grand Supreme Kai, allowing you to contend with beings as strong as Moro. You may also have the ability to awaken the potential of mortals like Elder Kai.

Most importantly, due to your role of protecting and nurturing the local universe, you have an instinctive sense for doing so regardless of the world you're in. This can manifest by becoming alerted of threats before they strike, training the correct mortal to defend their home world, knowing who to contact in the divine hierarchy for emergencies, and much more.
objects.title: Kaioshin (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
Your power is now comparable to Post Wish Gas, though it will still take some time to truly reach there. Your magical abilities become further elevated in direct proportion, with a boost to your talent in magic as a bonus.

More importantly, you've mastered your Inner Nature Unleashed state, removing the drawback of going berserk and avoiding death by rapid aging, allowing you to safely wield its power. Should you have any other magical powers, they will become further enhanced in this state.
addons.title: Awakened Form

objects.text:
You've become a Heeter, a race of humanoid aliens with varied talents in combat and business. You have combat ability and potential equal to Gas—though your actual power is at his Pre Wish state. You are a master at both armed and unarmed combat, plus various weapons, further accentuated by your abilities in Magic. 

With Magic Materialization, you can conjure weapons, constructs, and objects limited only by your imagination; Axes, pikes, spears, swords, hammers, shields, wrecking balls, wires, giant spike walls, etc. As well as magical barriers, blasts, and shapes like additional limbs or spectral objects.

With Telekinesis, you can move these conjured objects with your mind effortlessly. You have an enhanced multitasking ability to be aware of how many you're manipulating and use this effectively. It can also be used for other purposes. 

Note that these are only your specialties with Magic, so you can still learn and practice other kinds or forgo these entirely for something else like Elementalism, Healing, Mind Manipulation, or Transmutation.

You can transform into a state called Inner Nature Unleashed, which amplifies your powers and all other aspects of yourself, but can make you go berserk should you fail to control it. You can still draw on partial portions of this power to make it more manageable but less effective.
objects.title: Heeter (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
Instead of being just a Pokémon, you are now a Pokémon-human hybrid. This grants you a number of useful benefits.

For one, you can now freely switch between human, Pokémon, and a specialized humanoid hybrid form. This hybrid form is naturally stronger than your pure Pokémon form and, due to its human aspect, blunts your natural weaknesses to Pokémon moves and Type energies you would normally be vulnerable to.

Additionally, just as Pokémon with human trainers tend to grow stronger at a faster rate than their wild counterparts, as a hybrid, you will benefit from accelerated growth compared to others of your species.
addons.title: Poké-hybrid

addons.text:
Thanks to the Evolution power, your ability to Evolve as a Pokémon has been jailbroken. Allowing you to not only evolve into your final form more easily but also continually evolve into even higher, new, more powerful original Pokémon. Do note, however, that each further evolution will require greater and greater effort from you in training, battles, and personal growth.

Also, you gain the ability to use all forms of temporary evolutions, such as Mega Evolution, Gigantamax, and Terastallization. This ignores any normal limits, such as Pokémon that do not normally have a special evolution for the above, and will create entirely new original forms for you, appropriate for your Pokémon species. 

Do note, however, that using these temporary forms will demand a huge amount of stamina and energy from you to be used, much less for long periods. Also, Mega Evolution will not have any effect on your mind, such that it may force you into a berserk rage, losing control of your enhanced abilities and powers.
addons.title: To Evolve Even Further Beyond

addons.text:
Your Pokémon physiology and awakened Aura have merged, granting you unique advantages.

As a Pokémon, your Aura is naturally divided into two reserves: your HP Pool and your Move Pool. With your Aura awakened, both reserves have doubled in size, vastly expanding your stamina and combat potential.

In addition, your Move Pool can now fuel your Semblance, letting you sustain and unleash it for far longer and with far greater frequency than before. On top of that you can use new variants of your Semblance by channeling different Type Energies into it.
addons.title: Aura-Sync

addons.text:
All Pokémon derive their power from the life energy known as Aura. As such, it should come as no surprise that being an Aura Guardian provides numerous benefits to a Pokémon.

Through this add-on, your Aura reserves are greatly increased, granting you a sizable increase in all of your physical characteristics and powers. This increase allows you to hit a good deal above your pay grade compared to another Pokémon of equal Level to yourself.

Additionally, this increases your ability to master your Aura far easier and allows you to tap into the Bond Phenomenon, granting you access to a form of pseudo Mega Evolution similar to that of Ash-Greninja.

While in this form, your species' primary stats will get a major increase while other stats will get a smaller, though still noticeable increase. Also, your species' primary special move or one chosen by you will get a special upgraded version that is vastly superior to the original version.

Just like Ash-Greninja, you will initially only be able to use an incomplete form of Battle Bond, which will demand a great amount of stamina and energy to use, while also only offering a moderate increase in power. However, with training, you can lower the stamina and energy cost greatly and increase the power granted to grand levels comparable to Mega Evolution. Should you possess the ability to Mega Evolve, both transformations may be stacked, though doing so will push your body and energy reserves to their absolute limits.

Unlike Greninja, you do not need a partner to use the Bond Phenomenon to transform.
addons.title: Battle Bond

addons.text:
You gain what could be described as a savant-level ability in using Aura for moves and in general. This new talent allows you to master moves typical to your species at an unprecedented speed, even allowing you to learn moves far quicker than even the most talented Pokémon of your chosen species. You are also no longer limited to moves from your chosen species move list but can learn and master any move and type energy with a bit of effort.

Through this new power-up, you have also unlocked the ability to use the secret art of Z-Moves.

Z-Moves are incredibly powerful, enhanced versions of regular Pokémon moves that can normally only be performed by a Pokémon through the aid of a corresponding Z-Crystal item, a limitation that you need not worry about.

You begin with the ability to use one Z-Move matching your typing, and through training, you can unlock additional Z-Moves of your type and others with greater effort. If your species does not already have a signature Z-Move, you will be able to develop your own, though doing so will require significant effort. You can also convert a move into a Z-Move version with great effort, drastically increasing its power to unimaginable levels.

Using a Z-Move is extremely exhausting and should be done sparingly. However, like other limitations, this one can be overcome with enough training and experience.
addons.title: Z-Moves

addons.text:
As the apex of your species, you have now become an Alpha Pokémon.

Alpha Pokémon are much larger and stronger than other members of their species. Unlike regular Alphas, you are not affected by the rage that usually afflicts them, though you may choose to retain the blazing red eyes.

Additionally, you benefit from perfect IVs, can learn powerful moves easier and have your starting point boosted to the equivalent of Level 30.
addons.title: Alpha Pokémon
Aura-Digital Interface
addons.text:
You have become a miraculous, perfect hybrid of both Pokémon and Digimon, turning you into a paradoxical being of nigh-unfathomable power and potential that is vastly stronger than the sum of its parts.

As a baseline, you no longer have any difficulty maintaining a physical form thanks to your Pokémon heritage, though you can still easily shift to a purely digital, energy-based state when desired. 

Your Pokémon Aura has combined with your Digimon heritage to become Digital Aura, a much stronger and more malleable form of Pokémon Aura with properties of Digimon Data and energy. You can consciously examine, manipulate, and reorganize your Aura and Type Energy in ways that would be impossible for normal Pokémon, as it now gains the properties of computer data. With this newly combined energy, you can create entirely new moves in the form of "programs," allowing you to freely create and modify new ways to use your powers. With this new energy system, the only limits that exist are your creativity and work ethic in using and growing your powers.

As a final benefit, your two evolution systems have become intertwined. Pokémon Evolution is now analogous to a permanent hardware upgrade, permanently increasing the ease at which you can access and unlock new Digivolution forms while also drastically reducing the cost and strain of using them. Each time you evolve your Pokémon species, you will gain access to increasingly powerful Digivolution trees. This means that each of your Pokémon Evolutions is treated as being akin to an increasingly stronger Rookie-level Digimon, giving them access to the entire Digital Evolution tree. For example, a Pikachu would have different and stronger Digivolutions than a Pichu, and would in turn be surpassed by those of a Raichu. If you are a Pokemon species without an evolution, you will still benefit from this empowerment, though it begins weakened but will grow over time and with training, allowing you to unlock more powerful Digivolution forms over time.

Finally, temporary power-ups like Mega Evolution or Dynamax can also stack with Digivolution, though this costs vast amounts of energy and puts immense strain on you while using it; this can be overcome with significant training.

objects.text:
You become a Pokémon, granting you heightened physical abilities and possibly enhanced mental capabilities, dependent on the species you choose, along with powers based on the selected Pokémon's Typing(s). As a Pokémon, you also enjoy greatly increased vitality and durability, gaining the ability to recover from injuries quickly, and fully recover your energy within hours to days based on the severity.

You may select any non-Mythical or Legendary first form evolution of a Pokémon of your choice. You can evolve to your final stage evolution without requiring Evolution Stones or other unusual conditions. Though evolving will require a mix of training and personal growth in order to reach your final evolution.

Every Pokémon possesses a power known as Aura, a type of life energy that all Pokémon have, which is inherently attuned to your Pokémon Typing(s) and is naturally separated into two different pools. One grants you an "HP" bubble, significantly increasing your durability and allowing you to withstand substantial damage until it is depleted, at which point you may fall unconscious. This "HP" bubble is generally difficult to manipulate and, under normal circumstances, its inherent Typing(s) cannot be changed. In contrast, the other pool is highly malleable and is used to fuel your Pokémon moves.

To start, your powers and abilities are limited to the level of a freshly hatched Pokémon of your species, equivalent to level 5. Your starting abilities include not just enhanced physical and possibly mental traits but also the capacity to use the moves and Type elements your chosen Pokémon has access to. You begin with a small number of Moves and a basic understanding of the Type Energies inherent to your chosen species. You have the potential to learn any move your species can naturally acquire, and with enough training, even moves typically learned only through TMs. Also, you can create new moves and techniques using the Type Energies your species possesses.

For context, Pokédex entries are considered soft suggestions and may not be entirely accurate, but may become so as you become stronger.
objects.title: Pokémon (Pokemon)

addons.text:
You have mastered the intricate aspects of Skaven Science, which encompasses a wide range of inventions that the Skaven race has discovered over the ages. Your newfound knowledge allows you to create a variety of remarkable contraptions, each a testament to the Skaven's ingenuity and resourcefulness. 

You have also gained insight into creating more devices based on Skaven Science innovating where possible. Moreover, you have gained the ability to engineer artificial warp stones, which serve as potent sources of energy to power these innovative devices.
addons.title: Skaven Science

addons.text: You now possess not just the knowledge of Skaven technology, but the full skillset of a Clan Skryre Warlock Engineer, which includes the masterful usage of all Skaven technology in combat without blowing yourself to smithereens, whether you're operating a jezzail, a warpfire thrower, or a doomwheel, as well as being able to do near-instant field repairs when something starts breaking down and swiftly comprehend and skavenize any new technology you encounter, making it far more potent though occasionally unstable. Your mastery over skaven technology rivals that of Ikit Claw.
addons.title: Warlock Engineer

addons.text: Your skills as an assassin have integrated with your nature as a Skaven, expanding to grant you all the knowledge and skill of a Master Assassin of Clan Eshin. Your skills in infiltration, assassination, and sabotage is uncanny, allowing you to perform an unnoticed murder or arranged accident in the middle of a crowded city of humans as a bipedal rat. You are skilled in a variety of weapons and tools, ranging from various types of blades, poisons, and thrown weapons like throwing stars and poison wind globes, jezzails, as well as chemicals like acids that allow you to quickly and silently deal with issues like barred windows. You're also skilled in using your body as a weapon, including your tail both to snap necks as well as strangle, or simply to wield yet another weapon like a third arm. You're also skilled in the subtle yet extremely effective magic of Clan Eshin known simply as the Art of the Silent Death. No target is beyond your reach, your skills rivaling those of Deathmaster Snikch.
addons.title: Master Assassin

addons.text: Having stolen the secrets and lore from Nurgle's followers and stealing its blessing for yourself, you have gained all the knowledge and skills of the Plague Monks and Plague Priests of Clan Pestilens. You have a near encyclopedic knowledge of diseases and know how to brew entirely new plagues symptoms customized to your exact specifications, provided you have time and proper ingredients. Combined with the pilfered occult knowledge of Nurglite cults this allows you to weave disease into magic, granting you access to the Lore of Plague unique to Clan Pestilens, letting you reduce enemies to virulent sludge as well as enhancing yourself and your allies with bursts of frenzied strength and manic bravery. Any pox or plague you create is added to the miasma radiating from you, leading to it constantly increasing in potency. With enough time and effort, your knowledge of disease and aura of malady may come to surpass that of Lord Skrolk, whose mere presence makes life around him shrivel and succumb to a putrid death.
addons.title: Plague Priest

addons.text: You gain all the knowledge and skills of a Clan Moulder Master Mutator, both in the fields of breeding fiercer warbeasts as well as further enhancing them with mutations to create truly monstrous abominations. You can also turn this craft on other beings to create anything from living furniture to a rat-ogre with the implanted brain of a human. You are an artist of flesh of bone, your skills in both breeding and augmentation comparable to those of Throt the Unclean.
addons.title: Master Mutator

addons.text: You gain all the skills of a Clan Moulder Packmaster, being able to effectively lead warbeasts into battle and send them to rend apart your enemies. You also know how to train beasts for tasks, being able to understand their thoughts and actions on an instinctual level, and are gifted at using pain most effectively to mold any beast to your will. Your connection to any rat-based creature is borderline supernatural, such beasts seemingly instantly loving you, eager to follow your every command with no risks of misunderstandings and willing to give their lives in your service, your bond and gift to command verminous beasts rivaled only by Skweel Gnawtooth himself.
addons.title: Packmaster

addons.text: You grow a pair of horns, turning you into a Grey Seer, one of the scholars and spiritual advisors of Skavenkind, the prophets of the Horned Rat. This comes with a great deal of knowledge on various topics, and if the Skaven exist in your world you will be an expert on the various Clans present and will be awarded fearful respect by any non- Grey Seer Skaven you meet. You possess great knowledge and skill in the occult lores of the Skaven, spanning more benign fields such as prophecy as well as the more potent yet unstable arts of the Lore of Ruin.
addons.title: Grey Seer

objects.text:
Your body and DNA have undergone a remarkable transformation, granting you the formidable abilities of the Skaven. These creatures are often depicted as human-sized rats, characterized by their fine, thick fur, which not only provides insulation but also protects them from harsh environmental conditions. The Skaven have evolved over centuries in inhospitable surroundings, making them more resilient and durable than humans. 

In addition to their impressive toughness, Skavens possesses extraordinary speed and dexterity. They can move with surprising agility, enabling them to outpace even the fastest human opponents. This combination of speed and coordination makes them exceptional in both combat and evasive maneuvers.

Skaven possess a unique form of intelligence that enables them to innovate across various scientific fields, provided they receive appropriate education and mentorship. However, their minds are primarily attuned to the subtleties of court intrigue. They excel at plotting, scheming, and manipulating others, often outsmarting those who may seem more powerful or intelligent. 

Furthermore, all Skaven have an innate connection to the mystical arts, which grants them a heightened aptitude for magic, particularly in the disciplines of Plague and Ruin. This magical affinity provides them an advantage over human mages. Additionally, they exhibit a peculiar resistance to the corrupting effects of the warp and the winds of magic corruption.

You may choose which clan you belong to.
objects.title: Skaven (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
You gain the Warp-based powers of the Legion of the Damned, such as rounds burning with Empyreal fire, unlimited ammo, selective intangibility, strength, skill, durability far in excess of a normal Astartes, and the psychic divination to always be in the right place at the right time.

You do not suffer from the effects of the Legion's Warp contagion.
addons.title: Legion of the Damned

addons.text: "We are the hammer!" You are one in a billion aspirants who have successfully completed all the required trials to become a Battle Brother of the Grey Knights. The Grey Knights are a chapter of Astartes whose task is to deal with any threats originating from the Warp. They are the ultimate weapon against Chaos; as such, they have the authority to take any action necessary to complete their mission. You receive the necessary training and knowledge to confront the Warp and its denizens, ranging from the lowliest Neverborn to the Greater Daemons of the Ruinous Powers. You were trained extensively on how to use your Psyker abilities and have touched upon every discipline known to the Imperium. You possess the essential skills to be a member of any of the ten brotherhoods that comprise the Chapter. The Gene-Seed of the Grey Knights does not originate from any of the Emperor’s sons, but from the Master of Mankind himself. This grants immunity to Chaos corruption and bestows slight anathemic properties upon you, allowing you to permanently slay Daemons. You gain the ability to summon a sacred tome known as the Liber Daemonicum. This tome holds all of the knowledge the Grey Knight Chapter has gathered over its extensive history, from its infancy when it was first founded by Malcador the Hero, to the present day of the Imperium. Should the need arise, it can serve as a focus for your psychic abilities. It is a beautifully crafted tome, with pages illuminated in silver and bound to a spine carved from the thigh bone of a martyred saint. It holds exactly 666 pages, with the tome acting as a Data-Slate, allowing each page to carry a lot more information than usual and allowing you to zoom in or out. Due to being a Grey Knight's Battle Brother, you can requisition special equipment for your Wargear.
addons.title: Grey Knight

addons.text: "Suffer not the alien to live!" You have been selected to join the esteemed rank of the Deathwatch, a Chapter of Astartes comprised entirely of veterans gathered from all loyalist Chapters. The sacred task of this Chapter is to deal with any xenos threat that the Imperium may face. They receive extensive knowledge, training, and skills to fulfill this mission. Every single Battle Brother of the Deathwatch is, in turn, a masterful artist in dealing with the xenos and the threat they represent. The Deathwatch serves as the strong arm of the Ordo Xenos, granting them the authority to take any action necessary to complete their mission. You have undergone the hypno-indoctrination necessary to fill your mind with all the knowledge the Deathwatch has gathered during their Long Vigil. As a result, even if you encounter an unknown xenos threat, your subconscious mind will provide you with information about their weaknesses and how to defeat them. You could also learn to use their technology with basic proficiency after only a brief inspection. Due to being a Deathwatch Battle Brother, you can requisition special equipment for your Wargear.
addons.title: Deathwatch

addons.text:
Librarians are a specialized role within an Adeptus Astartes Chapter. They are the archivists, tasked with recording and preserving the lore of their chapter, their activity over the galaxy, and all of their gathered knowledge over their millennia of activity. All librarians are psykers who have been trained extensively in the use of their power and resist the temptation of the Warp, all the while undergoing the training of a regular battle brother. They possess an unbreakable will, capable of enduring the demonic whispers that are trying to tempt them with ease and continue to do so for centuries. 

While in combat, a librarian can be both an unstoppable force and an immovable fortress, able to tear fortifications asunder and withstand orbital bombardments. Five psychic disciplines are known to the Imperium: Biomancy, Divination, Pyromancy, Telekinesis, and Telepathy. Each of those disciplines can be used in various ways, whether offensive, defensive, or utility. The mightiest of librarians can do wondrous things such as tear space to teleport vast distances, resurrect their fallen brothers, and step outside of time.

You possess an ability that sets you apart from other librarians, detecting corruption in all forms, from lies and deceit to the taint of chaos. With just a glance, you can accurately determine if someone is corrupt, and by listening to someone speak, you can discern truth from falsehood. Additionally, you can sense if an area has been profaned simply by approaching it, even if no outward signs indicate such a condition.

As a Librarian battle brother, you can requisition special equipment for your Wargear.
addons.title: Librarian

addons.text:
A Techmarine is more than just a full-fledged battle-brother of his Chapter; he is the engineer and technician responsible for ensuring that all equipment operates effectively. Techmarines create new weaponry and ensure that vehicles function properly, often joining the battlefield to operate these vehicles. The Space Marines rely heavily on technology, and without the expertise and support of a Techmarine, the Astartes war machine would come to a standstill.

To gain the necessary knowledge of machines, every Techmarine is taken to Mars to be inducted into the ways of the Adeptus Mechanicus. As a result, they are as well-trained as the Tech-Priests themselves. Your mechanical abilities match those of your brothers under the Omnissiah; you can build, maintain, and repair all technologies your Chapter uses. 

You have a unique ability that sets you apart from other Techmarines. Within a 100-foot radius of you, any machine functions more efficiently, undergoes self-repair as it is used, and cleanses itself of corruption. Bullets can penetrate materials that typically require higher caliber rounds, and armor repairs itself as it sustains damage. All machine spirits within your area operate at 150% effectiveness to please you, and they do so without incurring any damage.

As a Techmarine battle brother, you can requisition special equipment for your Wargear.
addons.title: Techmarine

addons.text:
An Apothecary and an Apothecary Biologis are specialized roles within an Adeptus Astartes Chapter. Although they are full-fledged battle brothers, Apothecaries act as combat medics on the battlefield, tending to the wounded and helping them return to the fight. They are responsible for implanting gene-seed organs into Aspirants and monitoring Neophytes to ensure that there are no mutations or rejections of the gene-seed. They are also responsible for collecting samples of any Xenos species they encounter and studying them to identify the enemy's strengths and weaknesses.

In addition to these duties, Apothecaries perform surgeries, including implanting cybernetics into injured battle brothers. They also serve as research physicians and are experts in bioengineering. Their most critical responsibility is retrieving the gene-seed from fallen battle brothers, which is essential for the Chapter's continued existence. You gain the necessary knowledge, skills, and training to excel at this role.

You are an expert in the most advanced medical techniques and biological sciences available in the Imperium. There is no risk of rejection or mutation when you implant or graft organs. Similarly, when you integrate cybernetics, patients adapt to their new enhancements quickly and seamlessly. You can perform surgeries in half the usual time without increasing the risk of failure. Furthermore, whenever you take a sample from a xenos species, you will be able to understand the entity's nature, along with its biological strengths and weaknesses, after only a few hours of study. Your knowledge of xenos biology allows you to adjust any medical or bioengineering technique that works on one species and effectively apply it to any other species you encounter.

As an Apothecary battle brother, you can requisition special equipment for your Wargear.
addons.title: Apothecary

addons.text:
Chaplains hold a special rank within an Adeptus Astartes Chapter, serving as their spiritual leaders. These warrior-priests focus on the psychological and spiritual well-being of their brethren. They are also responsible for teaching new battle brothers the traditions and beliefs of the Chapter. In battle, they lead from the front, inspiring their fellow Astartes to reach new heights through both words and actions. As a Chaplain, you possess a comprehensive understanding of the rites, rituals, and traditions specific to your Chapter.

A defining characteristic of a Chaplain is their faith. By demonstrating a strong conviction in your beliefs, you can wield your faith as both a sword and a shield. As long as your faith remains steadfast, you will be resistant to mental challenges and spiritual corruption. 

When you recite the rites and litanies of your faith, your mere presence becomes anathema to enemy spellcasters, greatly hindering their ability to channel their powers. Their spells may be disrupted, countered, or completely nullified with minimal effort on your part. The sheer strength of your devotion creates a barrier that makes it considerably more difficult for anyone to cast spells in your vicinity. Casting a spell in your presence requires an immense exertion of power, and even then, most attempts are thwarted before they can fully materialize.

Additionally, you possess the sacred knowledge and ritual skills required to create and bestow Purity Seals. These seals, inscribed with holy scripture and blessed through sacred rites, are affixed to the armor and weapons of your battle-brothers, serving as divine shields against the corrupting influence of Chaos. The seals provide layered protection; each additional seal enhances the bearer's resistance to the corruptive effects of Chaos and heretical sorceries. Each Purity Seal is meticulously crafted using special wax and is bound to the wearer through your rites and prayers, forming an unbreakable bond that repels unholy taint.

Due to being a Chaplain battle brother, you can requisition special equipment for your Wargear.
addons.title: Chaplain

addons.text: “We were too few and they too many. The path was too dangerous. The cost was too high. Others may rely on such excuses for their failures. We do not enjoy such luxuries.” Chosen for your absolute spiritual purity, you have now joined the ranks of the Purifiers. They are the spiritual backbone of the chapter used to guard artifacts and entities that would even give a Grey Knight pause due to their corruptive affects. Teleporting into warzones, the Purifier Order are wreathed in psychic flames infused with their purity, permanently weakening and killing those it touches down to the very soul. This is supplemented by using a Daemon's True Name to harm or command them and you are granted an instinct into figuring out True Names, then using it against your mortal foes at the most critical moment. Garran Crowe, the current warden of the Black Blade of Antwyr, is your equal in all things. A flawless soul who is incorruptible, save for falling by his own choice. Alone, his unbreakable will keeps the daemon within the blade and unable to tempt any unwitting mortal into doing its bidding. Rumours suggest that Crowe has awoken a dormant genetic strain of The Emperor of Mankind, to explain his ability to see the warp differently, allowing him unique insights into the nature of chaos. This rumour has been put too rest, you have indeed been blessed with the Emperor's Genome, increasing your physical and psychic strength as well as your purity as your soul grows. Your duty is one of unending sacrifice. If you wish, you may take the Black Blade of Antwyr as part of your Wargear.
addons.title: Warden of the Black Blade

addons.text:
You inherit the full intellect, knowledge, and capabilities of Fabius Bile, the infamous Primogenitor of the III Legion, though without the Corruption, The Blight, and the various other unwanted Mutations. Every discovery he accumulated across ten millennia of experimentation is now yours: mastery of genetic manipulation, cloning, and radical biological engineering. You possess complete understanding of the techniques he learned from countless sources—the genetic sciences of the Laer, the grotesque arts practiced by the Drukhari Haemonculi, and the countless refinements he developed through his endless pursuit of the Knowledge Held by The Emperor that allowed him to creat the Adeptus Astartes, and The Primarchs. 

With this knowledge comes the capacity to reproduce many of his greatest accomplishments, including the methods used to construct perfect gene-forms such as his flawless clone of Fulgrim, restored as though untouched by the corruption of Slaanesh. Your understanding even extends to the secrets of Wraithbone—how to shape, cultivate, and manipulate it. Where Bile himself lacked the psychic Ability to sing it into existence, you possess that capability, though only this ability, unless you take Epsilon-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k) or its Upgrades.

Alongside this inheritance comes the growing metaphysical phenomenon born from the devotion of Bile’s creations. The emerging minor warp god formed through the reverence of the New Men now recognizes you as its center, and is within a personal Warp realm, though it will only hold it, and its might, and may not be used for anything else. At your will, roughly a Million of these engineered beings—witches, overseers, gene-crafted elites, and countless experimental strains—may gather to you. To them you are indistinguishable from their creator: their Pater Mutatis, the father of their species. Their loyalty is absolute, their purpose to serve your vision of human evolution.

You also gain a modified version of The Chirurgeon, the biomechanical Device that once attended Bile. This version has been altered so that its semi-sapient will is anchored entirely to your interests. It cannot modify you without your approval and will never enact changes that are not beneficial or explicitly permitted.

Finally, you possess a unique advantage beyond even Bile’s own capabilities. As a biomancer, you can apply this immense body of genetic knowledge without the need for conventional laboratories or surgical infrastructure. Through direct manipulation of flesh, gene, and life-force, you can grow clones, reshape organisms, design entirely new species, or rewrite living bodies in moments. What once required centuries of experimentation and entire laboratories can now be performed through your will alone—an art that blurs the boundary between science and sorcery, perfectly suited to the grim genius of the Primogenitor.
addons.title: Pater Mutatis

addons.text: Matt Ward smiles upon you. You are not just a Space Marine, you're The Space Marine. To all chapters, not just those bearing your Primarch's Lineage, you'd be their spiritual liege; the one they look to with reverence as a beacon of The Emperor's and the Primarch's ideals. The natural abilities that you've gained from inheritance, such as the Raven Guard Stealth abilities or the Imperial Fists talent in defensive warfare has now been magnified within you. Though you are not exceptionally stronger or tougher than any other Veteran Astartes, you know intimately how to best leverage your enhancements to achieve the results you want including imitating feats of greater strength. As befits Matt Ward's favourite creation, you've gained the fate of un-helmeted named Ultramarine Character; the rank and file can no longer put you in the ground, only those who would be classed as an "Epic Hero" can end your duty to The Emperor of Mankind. If you take Wargear, this Wargear will be the best that the Imperium could provide, including many armaments filled to the brim with relics of the Dark Age of Technology and/or weapons used by your Primarch.
addons.title: Matt Ward's Greatest Creation

objects.text: “My faith is my shield, and my Fury is my sword!” Gene-forged in the hallowed halls of one of the many Fortress Monasteries throughout the Imperium. You have become a Space Marine, transhuman super soldiers produced for the defence of the Imperium and Mankind. Implanted with twenty-two different organs designed to take you from scrawny youth to seven-foot-tall killing machine.  The average human would stand very little chance against you, even if they were a veteran of a hundred battles, for you can close a distance of ten meters in a heartbeat and smash a skull with your bare fists. This also gives you abilities beyond the standard superstrength, such as spitting acid to inhuman levels of clotting factor or a fused, bulletproof ribcage. You are also superior to your firstborn brothers, implanted with organs that magnify your already potent capabilities.   A being of your stature shouldn't move at the speeds you do. This causes a phenomenon called Transhuman Dread; the innate wrongness of your movement causes those with lesser mental fortitude to freeze up in fear or even run away at the display of your might. Comparatively, you are, for all intents and purposes, immune to the effects of fear. No tremors can shake your aim and no indecision can stop you from doing your duty. You truly are a bulwark against the terror.  You may decide which chapter or legion you belong to, along with the relevant training of a newly promoted battle brother. Please Note: This does not give you any Wargear.
objects.title: Adeptus Astartes (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: The inevitable successor of the human race, you have been transformed into an immortal and nigh-indestructible superhuman like the God-Emperor of Mankind (but not his equal). With a mind equal to a supercomputer, and a body equal to a Primarch of old that can regenerate from almost any injury however grievous due to an immortal soul, you can lead humanity to a golden age of prosperity or eternal damnation. But be warned, for all your potential and power, you are not unkillable.
objects.title: Perpetual (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
A one-in-a-trillion expression of genes, you are now both a Blank and a Navigator, these two unique strains of humanity merging in beneficial ways. To the noble Houses of the Navis Nobilite, you would be a genetic prize beyond compare. Your Warp Eye is not hindered in any way by your Null aura; it becomes acclimated to your Pariah status and can continue to peer beyond the Materium without impairment. Additionally, your Blank aura works during travel to ward both you and your charges from potential dangers; otherworldly creatures will be cowed, and any natural hazards, such as Warp storms, will be calmed in your presence.

As a result of your psyker abilities all being indirectly accessed through your Warp Eye, they won't be affected either. Furthermore, your nature as an Untouchable means you are now completely immune to the harmful effects and madness of the Empyrean or other immaterial realms when looking into them, instead of merely being resistant. As a side effect, you no longer gain any mutations, unless they are purely positive in nature.
addons.title: Personal Gellar Field

addons.text: "A child of Asuryan dares to gaze into the realm of Slaanesh? How bold..." As with all things born of the Warp, the Aeldari excel. Somehow, you are now both a Navigator and have the biology of an Eldar. Perhaps you are some dark Pre-Fall experiment, or an invention of the Haemonculi? No matter the reason, your resistance to the warp and potency as a Navigator are improved, similar to how an Eldar psyker is stronger than a human of the same grade. Incredibly, your Warp Eye gains the ability to gaze at the Materium and the Immaterium simultaneously. As a result, you now no longer need any sort of external navigational tools whatsoever, with things like the Astronomicon proving redundant when you can check your approximate position in realspace in real time. You will never need guesswork or calculations to determine your location in whatever realm you're in if you need to check your position, making any trip vastly smoother and faster.
addons.title: Xenos Witch
Novator
addons.text:
Your psychic abilities are greater than a normal Navigator, because you are a Novator. Your mutations will grow more extreme, gruesome and unsightly, a visible sign of the power and skill you hold for members of the Novis Noblitie, other Navigators bowing before your might and wisdom.

Where, as before, you could only sense the Warp through abstraction, you are now capable of using your Warp Eye to observe the true nature of the Warp through a polarized state. Somehow your body and mind have stayed strong, resisting all traces of bodily failure and incipient madness that usually afflict Navigators of this strength.

Your life expectancy now exceeds 800 years with the potential to replace the Paternova should they die. In such a case, the strongest of Novators will become Heirs Apparent, their bodies mutating and their powers strengthening.

The Heirs Apparent will fight to the death, becoming stronger and mutating further with each demise, eventually gaining the ability to survive underwater, in poisonous environments and even in the hard vacuum of space itself. The last one standing ascending to replace the Paternova.

addons.title: Paternova
addons.text:
You are the Paternova, the guiding father or mother of the Navis Nobilite whose powers transcend the Warp itself. Your psychic powers not only outclass all other Navigators, but are the source of their strength, for without a Paternova all Navigators' powers diminish.

Every house of the Novis Noblitie would obey your word, ruling from the Palace of the Navigators at the center of the Navigator's Quarter on Terra. You know both the Navigators' origins in the lost history of Mankind, and the full potential of a Navigator's psychic abilities. Your Warp Eye now revealing the true depth of the Warp, no longer requiring any filter or polarization.

Your body has mutated, able to survive underwater, in poisonous environments and even in the hard vacuum of space itself, your life expectancy now exceeding 1000 years. Your altered form is now perfect for handling the vast psychic energies required to amplify the strength of each and every Navigator.

addons.title: Proavusnova
addons.text:
You have ascended to a higher tier of existence, for you have become the Proavusnova, Chaos God of Truth and Destiny, your gaze reveals the secrets of past, present and future, everything laid bare for you to see. As a God born from the Navis Noblitie, you hold a connection to all Navigators, the Paternova is no longer singular, but a title given to your Champions.

Each Navigator's Warp Eye acts as a focus for your power, allowing you to channel a fragment of it through them. Though doing so to any Navigator below the strength of a Novator will put an immense burden on their body and mind, with only your Paternovas able to handle a true fraction of your might.

Through a specialized ritual, you or one of your Patronova can elevate a regular Psyker into a Navigator. This puts great strain on the recipient, their DNA rewritten to grant the Navigator Gene, their head splitting open revealing a newly formed Warp Eye, their mind forced to witness the Warp as all Navigators do.

Your connection to Warp Eyes has allowed you to establish a Webway connecting them, conduits crossing through the Immeterium, allowing instantaneous travel without fear of the fickle tides of the Warp or the horrors it holds. In order to act as a gate to your Webway, a Navigator must enter a trance-like state, devoting all their power to maintaining the bridge. Your Paternovas are the exception, as they have the strength and willpower required to maintain it without the trance.

objects.text:
You are now a psyker, and not just any psyker, but a Navigator. No one knows when or how your kind came to be, but the mutations that define you have made Navigators one of the most dangerous and invaluable tools of the Imperium.

Aside from the superficial changes to your physique, like sharp claws, teeth, and pale color of your skin, you've also grown a third eye on your forehead, known as the Warp Eye. This eye makes you resistant to the Warp's harrowing side effects, ensuring the stability of your mind and soul, and enables you to pierce the veil between the Materium and the Immaterium, between reality and the nightmarish realms beyond. 

Through this eye, your psychic powers differ from others, as they are the result of your innate connection to the Warp and the legacy of your genes. You would see the Warp like none can see it, and be able to guide yourself and others through this dimension with such accuracy that it's like you're treading the back of your hand.

You will inherently know all the techniques cultivated by the Navis Nobilite over thousands of years, even before the empire had a name. From reading the threads of souls as if you were reading an open book, to unraveling those threads and destroying the soul completely; to exposing your eye to a mortal mind and bleeding them into the Warp, sapping their sanity; to making their skin boil and combusting them from the inside with a single gaze. You can pull entire starships into the Warp, dooming them to an eternity of hell, and bend Warp time with real time, essentially granting you minute precognition and localized time control, among many other abilities. You may not be able to psychically lift mountains, but you can easily topple titans by crushing them from the inside out.

Your life expectancy exceeds 600 years, and the older you become, the more potent and devastating your powers grow. The durability of your Warp Eye increases as well, until it crystallizes into a dark orb so resilient that it can withstand even atomization without a scratch. As long as your third eye remains intact, your body can fully reform and regenerate from it.
objects.title: Navigator (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
A synthesis resultant in pure perfection. Your natural abilities are heightened, as expected, but that is not the most pressing matter. 

That would be your adaptive capabilities, which are dramatically enhanced, allowing you to adapt to your opponents mid-fight, becoming a true monster on any battlefield you enter.
addons.title: Apex Specimens

addons.text:
While the Tyranids represent the peak of natural evolution, the Aeldari are the result of meticulous bio-engineering by the Old Ones, perfected by their arcane bio-sciences. With these two philosophies brought together, your combined biology has taken on the best of both worlds. As a result, your biology automatically takes on the most efficient configurations available to it, and you gain an instinctive ability to design the mutations to your form with a marvellous complexity, compatibility and compact nature without sacrificing function. This has the side effect of providing an inherent aesthetic to even the most outlandish of your alterations, both within and without.

You're also able to expand your genetic library through experimentation on your own body and the intake of new genetic material, via a finer control of your own mutations. It's as if you have access to your own personal gene-lab; you can always be in the process of slowly improving your biology, whether cultivating and splicing biological adaptations beyond those encoded in your genome, or learning new ones wholesale from absorbed biomass. Practically speaking, however, this takes time, energy and focus, rendering it inoptimal in combat. Furthermore, it's practically impossible to go beyond the bounds of what your DNA is capable of; you won't be able to become a silicon-based life-form or shift your biology into being composed of incorporeal etheric energy, at least not without extreme amounts of sampling and experimentation. Finally, you have an easier time incorporating or producing more esoteric expressions of your biology, such as the resinous bones and extreme genetic stability of the Eldar, the distortion fields of the Hrud or even the ecosystem-like symbiotic internal biology of the Tyranids.
addons.title: Engineered Evolution

objects.text:
In a hidden laboratory, a clandestine project unfolded, shrouded in secrecy and whispered about in hushed tones. It spanned decades, involving major wars, legendary master assassins, and even Space Marines, all aimed at bringing down the Maerorus Temple's failed experiment, and in the end, they succeeded—or so it seemed.

The Maerorus Temple, now forgotten, and only exists as a name recorded in forbidden archives, has finally achieved their dreams, and gave birth to their Magnum Opus—you. Your DNA is now intertwined with the very essence of the Tyranids and countless other Xenos, transforming you into a shape-shifting warrior of terrifying power. Your genome carries the codex of hundreds of Xenos DNAs, allowing you to adapt your form to any situation. With bare hands, you take down hordes of foes, absorbing their biomass to heal and mutate, growing spikes, tendrils, or altering your form as needed.

Moreover, an innate intuition for assassinations and combat is etched into your very genome, enabling you to rival the best agents of the Officio Assassinorum. You are a formidable force on the battlefield, embodying the deadliest skills of an assassin and a shape-shifter - truly the perfect Child of Maerorus.
objects.title: The Magnum Opus of Maerorus (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Your mind radiates with an intense brilliance, infused with the energy of the Warp, granting potential on par with the most exalted Aeldari masters of the Warp. The depths of your potential are staggering, akin to the towering peaks of genius that define the finest warlocks. Just as a human breathes effortlessly, so too do new Warp techniques emerge organically from your thoughts, flowing with ease and clarity.

While an ordinary human might emit only the faint flicker of a candle's flame, you embody the roaring blaze of an inferno pulsating with boundless Warp potential. Your grasp on the Warp transcends mere instinct; it offers you a profound understanding that opens doors to innovative applications in technology and sorcery alike. You not only wield the Warp with unparalleled finesse but also pioneer groundbreaking methods that meld this otherworldly energy with engineering marvels, transforming the very fabric of reality around you.
