Each discovery is a testament to your remarkable aptitude, further establishing your legacy as a master of the Warp.
addons.title: Path of the Seer

addons.text:
You embody the Harlequins, personifying both the Dark and Twilight Troupes and encompassing every role within their ranks—from Troupe Masters and Shadowseers to Death Jesters and Skyweavers—while invoking the solitary, lethal skill of a Solitaire. In this endless war theater, you deliver a flawless performance, merging art and combat into a seamless dance of death.

As a warrior-acrobat whose every move blurs the line between art and annihilation, you bring to battle an elegance and skill unmatched by any foe. Sinister, mercurial, and enigmatic, you reflect the strangest and most inscrutable aspects of the Aeldari. Your mastery of the physical and mystical arts, combined with lightning speed and breathtaking precision, makes you a terror on the battlefield. For the Harlequins, every motion is an act of theater, every strike a powerful performance of legendary masques—delivered with passion, flair, and a hauntingly elegant brutality. Your movements defy logic: sprinting, leaping, and weaving, you become like silk caught in a hurricane, effortlessly eluding even the keenest aim.

Relying on unmatched agility and skill, the Harlequins are unbound by the constraints of brute force. Your holo-suit warps your image into a mesmerizing storm of color and fractal patterns, making you an elusive, shifting mirage that leaves enemies pouring fire into illusions. Yet, when you strike, your reality is undeniable and devastating. For you, the roar of gunfire is a rhythm, the dying cries of foes a chilling accompaniment as you whirl through enemy ranks. Each attack is a story, each kill a verse, as you carve terror into the minds of all who dare oppose the artistry of the Harlequins.
addons.title: A New Player In The Show

addons.text: Blanks should be impossible for the psychically-attuned Eldar race, but you've managed to appear as a one-of-a-kind anomaly; your psyker potential is inverted. Similar to how Aeldari psykers are stronger than humans of the same category, the strength of your Null aura is increased by a proportionate degree compared to human Blanks. You'll find applying and controlling your Pariah nature much more intuitive, being able to match the techniques of the Culexus Temple and the Sisters of Silence.
addons.title: Reversed Polarity

addons.text:
You are something the modern Imperium would deny even exists, a hybrid of humanity’s greatest transhuman warriors and the ancient, alien Aeldari. Your body carries the immense physical might of an Astartes, tempered by the grace, speed, and finesse of the Eldar. The result is a form that strikes with brutal force yet moves with a fluidity no Marine could hope to match, reflexes so sharp they seem impossible to track.

Your mind is just as dangerous: accelerated with Eldar quickness of thought but grounded by the tactical clarity drilled into every Space Marine. You are clever in ways that unsettle both species, as you’re able to process battlefields at a glance, intuit the flow of combat, and exploit weaknesses with ruthless precision. Martial skill comes to you effortlessly. You absorb combat styles like a dry field drinks rain, and what would take others decades to master becomes second nature after mere weeks. With blade, bolter, or bare hands, you fight like a paradox: the blunt inevitability of Sigismund blended with the dueling elegance of an Eldar Exarch.

Your soul burns brighter than a human’s yet steadier than an Aeldari’s, granting you an innate psychic sensitivity without the volatility or obsession that plagues your progenitors. You can feel the Warp and hear its whispers, but you stand more resilient to corruption than either race.
addons.title: The Forgotten Kin
Kabalite (Warhammer: 40k)
addons.text:
The Dark Eldar of Commoragh are in a sense the vampires of the 41st Millennium, a pallid breed of dark masters siphoning the spiritual power of their victims souls, so as to retain their health and increase their power. Now you have access to this power as well, along with a few others associated with the Dark City.

Naturally, Slaanesh does not have a reserved claim on your soul as she does the other Eldar, and you are in no danger of dying from a lack of torment, even if you could match the absurd excesses of the Kabals that necessitate staving off She-Who-Thirsts (which is doubtful, to say the least). Therefore, the ability to siphon the souls of others to increase in health, beauty, power, & ability (whether physical, mental, or psychic) appears to you purely as a boon.

Of course, that is not all you have at your disposal, for you have received Haemonculi modifications fit for an Archon. You are as strong as a Wrack or Incubus, you are as nimble as a Succubus or Hellion, as strangely entwined with shadow & the Immaterium as a Mandrake, & with as many optional Haemonculus bespoke traits as you choose (like acid blood, Scourge wings, implanted gravitic crystals, sharp prehensile bone tails, serpentine abdomens, & so on).

addons.title: Child of Aelindrach (Warhammer 40k)
addons.text:
Prolonged exposure to the Void has transformed you into a being akin to the Mandrakes of Aelindrach. Your physiology has been fundamentally altered, granting you physical power that places you closer to an Ork than an Eldar in raw strength. Your flesh also possesses a supernatural camouflage that renders you nearly invisible anywhere beyond direct illumination, allowing you to melt seamlessly into the darkness.

This transformation grants you dominion over shadow itself. You can step through one shadow to emerge from another, blanket entire areas in impenetrable darkness, and otherwise manipulate the dark as an extension of your will.

You also gain the ability to conjure and command Balefire, a ghostly, freezing flame that defies conventional fire. Those touched by it are paralyzed as its unnatural cold takes hold, while its eldritch flames burn through both flesh and soul alike.

objects.text:
You gain the physiology of an Eldar, better known as the Aeldari. With a lifespan of a few thousand years, untouched by illness, imperfection of old age, or disease. Although they may superficially resemble humans—primarily differing in their unusually sharp ears and generally taller stature—the comparison is limited to outward appearance. Beyond that, their biology, mentality, and even their very souls are entirely alien.

Your body moves with supernatural grace and speed, appearing as a blur to those who cannot keep up. Your mind operates at a pace that far surpasses that of most human geniuses, rendering them seemingly uneducated by comparison. Additionally, your strength exceeds that of the average human; it would take an augmented human to match your level of power. You could effortlessly push your hand through a human's chest to crush their heart.

All Aeldari are psykers to some degree, being stronger than a human of the same psyker type. Even an untrained Aeldari could read the thoughts of a living being from a glance, while those with a modicum of training or experience could manipulate or crush the minds or weapons of foes with a simple glance. While you do not possess training, you do know how to go about making wraithbone.

Aeldari experience everything to a greater degree than humans; this can lead to them floating to the extremes of life. Do try not to birth a Chaos God in your new realm.
objects.title: Aeldari (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You now have knowledge of all of the technology of Hero Society, from moving city-sized islands, to Quirk Enhancers like the Trigger drug or David Shield's Quirk Enhancement device, to the various kinds of robots used for both training and security, and the many kinds of support equipment that exist. Due to the highly personalized nature of support equipment, this also includes technical knowhow equivalent to someone like Mei Hatsume, or that of both notable members of the Shield family, so that you can easily create custom pieces.
addons.title: I-Island

addons.text:
Quirk training, while still intense, becomes significantly less demanding. Your soul merges with your Quirk Factor, subtly altering it to improve your Quirk with every usage and each time it's pushed to the limit. It also gives an intuitive sense for how to best train your Quirk, which goes as far as knowing when to rest and what regimens best exercise it.

Beyond mere improvements, it can also develop secondary characteristics that give your Quirk much more versatility. For example, if you had Kirishima's Hardening, you'd develop the ability to eject stone from your body as sharp needles, or coat your hardened body in those needles like a porcupine. These mutations are based on what your soul learns from Quirk usage, and what's needed to either overcome your current odds, or to best aid you in the future. 

As you become more proficient with your Quirk, the threshold for training it will lessen, which can easily lead to a Quirk Awakening. Even then, your Quirk will not stop improving.
addons.title: Smart Quirk

objects.text:
Quirks are a supernatural ability that resulted from a biological evolution. All Quirks come with an underlying Atlas Quirk, which grants Quirk wielders the required secondary superpowers they need in order to function without harming their users—this Atlas Quirk allows for the possibility of superpowered possibilities through training alone. Shōta Aizawa is a grand example of this, fighting on par with other heroes and villains without a quirk that increases his physical capabilities. Quirks are unique to the individual and are presented in one of three ways. You are able to select any single quirk that is not One for All or All for One. This can instead be left up to chance if you wish.

Emitter Quirks: Emitter Quirks allow individuals to generate, control, and/or release certain substances or energies. Emitter Quirks make up the majority of Quirks, leading to a wide variety of properties and abilities.

Transformation Quirks: Transformation Quirks alter the user's physical appearance or grant them special features. This can include turning into an animal, growing extra limbs, or changing body parts. Transformation Quirks generally require a certain level of focus to activate them, preventing accidental activation. Transformation-type Quirks are the only known type of Quirk that can bestow the user attributes they do not normally exhibit by default.

Mutant Quirks / Heteromorphic Quirks: Mutant Quirks cause a permanent abnormality to the user's body that is directly related to the power or enhancement. Mutant Quirks cannot be turned off, as they are permanently active, this allows them to be far more resistant to quirk nullification.
objects.title: Quirk (My Hero Academia)

addons.text: Due to both the modifications to your body and the quirks you possess, your body has begun to change and mutate in an attempt to adapt to these quirks and the environmental factors around it. You are now capable of growing and retracting massive amounts of limbs and flesh, just as easily as you would with hair, nails, or skin, allowing you to adapt to new threats and challenges, and so on.
addons.title: Quirk Singularity Theory

addons.text:
Not only are you capable of using your abilities to their full potential, but the abilities themselves have been bodily enhanced by celestial energy to match one of the fabled ‘Horsemen of Apocalypse’.

Additionally, your mind has similarly been enhanced, resistant to all but the most virulent of compulsions and psychic attacks.
addons.title: Horseman of… (Marvel)

objects.text: Similar to Tomura Shigaraki, your body has undergone intense modifications that increase your physical attributes to a level comparable to All Might in his prime. These modifications not only enhance your physical attributes, but they also amplify any powers you possess, enabling your body to fully utilize their potential. This power also allows you to be a worthy vessel, capable of handling the stress that comes with such formidable abilities.
objects.title: Body Modification (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
Your Mazarin-Rashoud node is activated and you gain incredible powers from subconsciously manipulating the four fundamental forces & quantum physics. The powers you gain from this are any you could take during default character creation (Such as Mega-Attributes & Quantum Powers) and you will be able to train & expand them through practice or special meditation.

Mega-Attributes are exactly what they sound like, consisting of those things that a human can do now, taken to the next level, such as strength, speed, & endurance becoming Mega-Strength (the kind that can lift an oil tanker over your head), Mega-Dexterity (enough to search a large building in less than a second), & Mega-Stamina (enough to survive a MOAB to the face), intelligence becomes Mega-Intelligence (enough to beat super-computers), Mega-Wits (enough to react to new information at FTL speeds), & Mega-Awareness (enough to have true "super senses"), social skills & looks become Mega-Appearance (enough to literally, rather than figuratively, look divine), Mega-Manipulation (enough to singlehandedly determine who ends up as US president while tending bar in Havana), & Mega-Charisma (enough that even your haters will have a shrine to you in their room).

Despite how impressive that likely sounded, the real meat are the Quantum Powers. There are almost no limits to Quantum Powers, save for whether your own Quantum rating permits it, whether you have enough Quantum energy to do it, & whether you have learned the ability in question. This extends all the way up to universe creation and near boundless reality warping.

There are however some caveats; namely Taint and the issue of Psi. Your awakening of an M-R Node allows you to manipulate the four fundamental forces as modern science knows them, but partly closes off access to the secret fifth force, Psi. This isn't so much a drawback as it is a limitation, but it should still be kept in mind.

The issue of Taint is far more serious; pushing too far or too fast with your powers will mutate your body and mind, sometimes unrecognizably. At low levels i.e. temporary Taint, it can be removed or burned off, while at high levels i.e. permanent Taint, it can give you Aberrations, such as green skin, wings, a third eye, or callousness & cruelty towards others. No matter how it is expressed, Taint makes you less "human".

You don't need to worry about Quantum age restrictions. Note that despite being a Shardless power, an M-R Node looks remarkably like a Corona Pollentia, even to medical experts.
objects.title: Nova (Trinity Continuum)

addons.text:
You gain the ability to create the various Anti-Ghost technology from the show, such as the powerful Ghost Hunter technology used by Valerie Gray, or the technology of Jack and Maddie Fenton’s company Fenton Works. This includes things such as anti-ghost weapons, energy barriers, various armour, transport vehicles, and of course both the Fenton Thermos and the infamous Ghost Portal.

Though be warned, should you choose to create a Ghost Portal, it will connect to the same one as from the show, for better, or for worse...
addons.title: Anti-Ecto Technology

addons.text: Well now, how did you manage to get your hands on these? No matter, now you possess two of the most legendary items in all of the Ghost Zone, the Ring of Rage and the Crown of Fire, these are the Regalia, the Crown Jewels of the Ghost Zone, formerly in the possession of the King of Ghosts, Pariah Dark. The Crown of Fire has the power to command and control the Ghost Zone and all of it’s inhabitants, in worlds without such a dimension? It has the power to create one. Either way this allows you to remake the Ghost Zone in your own image. Any citizens of the Ghost Zone will obey your commands as their king, and none could ever even dream of betraying you. The Ring of Rage is no less powerful, as the Crown grants you the realm to rule, the Ring gains you the subjects to command. With this item you can convert other beings into Ghosts, whether that is a full transition, or a half one is up to you. Together they make you the new King of Ghosts taking the place of Pariah Dark, all spirit’s and entities that might be considered a ‘Ghost’ will automatically acknowledge this position should you wish it. As the King of Ghosts you have the right to utilize any powers that a Ghost could develop Note: You can choose to either rule directly as an absolute ruler, or set up a loyal–and effective–government to rule in your stead. You can change this at any time, or select any level in between.
addons.title: The Crown of Fire & Ring of Rage

addons.text:
You gain a Ghostly Obsession as per canon of Danny Phantom. Ghosts, by nature, each have an Obsession that prevents them from passing on. These Obsessions are both a source of great power and weakness. A Ghost will gain abilities based on their Ghostly Obession, such as for Danny Fenton/Phantom “Protection”, The Box Ghost with Boxes, Skulker “The Hunt”, and so on. Ghosts are compelled to follow their Obsessions to a critical level, and by following them, they may grow in power and abilities fitting their theme and Obsession. But should they not follow them, they will wither in power and eventually fade away, finally passing on. 

Thankfully, as a Half Ghost, this is more of an itch rather than a full mental compulsion. Though failing to follow it long term will be heavily detrimental to your mental health, and eventually, your physical health if you ignore it for a long time.
addons.title: Ghostly Obsession

addons.text:
You gain the intriguing ability to split yourself between your Human and Ghost halves safely, though with limits. Each of your halves is still “you” in all senses of the word, such as in mind and spirit. You will never need to worry about one side betraying the other, as you are still one entity, just split in half between your Human and Ghost halves. While you are split, you cannot access any of your Ghost powers until you remerge. Also, you can assign any of your mental or spiritual powers to your Ghost Half while split. But by doing this, you will lose access to those powers until you remerge.

At the start, you can only stay split for around an hour, but this duration can be lengthened with time and effort through training and use. When you remerge, you gain the full memories, experiences, and growth your other Half experienced and gained.
addons.title: Ghostly Fission

objects.text: He could walk through walls, disappear, and fly, He was much more unique than the other guys. Your molecules got all rearranged, now you're a halfa from Danny Phantom, half-ghost and half-Human, granting you access to a variety of abilities, prime among them a half-ghost transformation, the design of which is up to you. Halfa’s have access to only a few Ghost powers to begin with, with more developing and becoming available as they grow in power. You will find you can most easily use your powers in ghost form, but with enough effort can use most of them in your human form. Your abilities initially start out with an enhanced physiology, with increased strength, speed, endurance, agility, durability, reflexes, stamina, and balance. Other common Ghost powers included are flight, intangibility, invisibility, ecto-blasts, the infamous overshadowing and the famous ‘Ghost Sense’. As you grow in skill and power, you will find yourself developing your abilities in many ways. From your original abilities simply growing stronger, to learning to manipulate ghostly ectoplasm to form a variety of constructs, powerful Cryokinesis, or Pyrokinesis, and the ability to change your ghostly body in variety of ways, many things are possible. When you reach your full potential as a halfa, you will begin to unlock some of the rarer Ghost abilities, among them the ghostly wail that wreaks havoc on cities, Weather Manipulation, Size Alteration, Sleep Inducement, Shape-Shifting, Probability Manipulation, Emotion Absorption, Ghost Portal Creation, Plant Manipulation, Technopathy, Wish-granting and more. You’ll find these grow stronger and more versatile as time goes on.
objects.title: Half-Ghost (Danny Phantom)

addons.text:
You are no ordinary Prime Conduit, but one standing on the brink of something far greater—possessing the potential to rival, perhaps even surpass, the Beast himself. You wield the full breadth of Cole McGrath's abilities at his peak, augmented by terrifying new powers that set you apart.

Foremost is the overhaul done to your vessel. The synergy between Galvanism and your Conduit nature has expanded your energy capacity to near-limitless levels, sustained by a constant passive drain that fuels a regeneration far beyond anything most Conduits could imagine. As wounds that'd cripple others will close in moments, limbs lost can be recovered by simply draining a source of their power. And with training, even total annihilation cannot claim you. Like the Beast, you can rise from the brink of nothing, so long as your will endures.

Likewise, your energy drain has evolved, no longer being restricted to just ambient electromagnetism. Now capable of siphoning Ray Field Energy itself, letting you strip other Conduits of the thing that fuels their power and leaving them defenseless. Alongside this, your mastery and usage of Mana Burst (Lightning) is also perfect.

However, your most fearsome ability is to shed your body entirely, becoming a being of pure, crackling electricity. Whilst in this state, every ability will be tremendously amplified, though at a severe cost to your reserves.

And yet this isn't all you're capable of. With mastery, you may ascend to the throne of electromagnetism itself, commanding its vast might according to your whims.
addons.title: Kessler

addons.text:
"Powers don't kill people. Oh, no... it's the person behind the powers that kill people" — Cole Macgrath

It seems your connection to the karmic balance of the universe has merged with the Conduits' natural ability to enhance their powers in different ways according to their karma. This manifests as an increase in both the power and versatility of your abilities as a Conduit. These enhancements range from developing more auxiliary abilities that reflect your karma (such as your attacks healing civilians instead of harming them if your karma is positive, to more specific things like a Conduit being able to absorb the bioelectric energy of people throughout an entire city) to a 5x multiplier of your Conduit's power. 

It's important to note that these enhancements aren't instantaneous. You have to accumulate karma, either positive or negative, for these changes to become noticeable. A good indicator of your progress is your karma "ranks" (these ranks being the same as those in the game) are the changes in the effects on your powers that will manifest according to your karma

Karma depends on your actions, not on what you think is for the "greater good" (though never say never to simply being a bloodthirsty psychopath). At the end of the day, the road to hell is paved with good intentions, and all it takes is a little lust for power to make you truly *Infamous.*

This addon synergizes especially well with powers that allow you to accumulate positive or negative karma more quickly, or powers that shift your karmic balance one way or the other, such as Hero or Demon Lord. 

(As a bonus, if you have the "Kessler" addon, you will gain Lucy Kuo's cryogenic powers or Nix's napalm manipulation, depending on your karma.)
addons.title: Karmic Overdrive

objects.text:
You have become a Prime Conduit, someone who, through one means or another, has awakened their dormant Conduit Gene and acquired superhuman abilities. A Conduit’s powers vary from individual to individual, ranging from elemental, inorganic and organic matter or energy manipulation to more exotic abilities such as psychokinesis and gravity manipulation.

As a Conduit, you are capable of absorbing, manipulating, projecting, and even assuming the properties of your powers. For example, a Smoke Conduit can transform into smoke, while a Paper Conduit can take on the characteristics of paper. These powers also grant you enhanced mobility, allowing you to travel vast distances quickly and glide through the air.

Awakening as a Conduit also triggers a process of molecular reconstruction, granting you superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, agility, and a healing factor. You can further develop your abilities through practice and by surviving life-threatening situations, which not only enhance your existing powers but also unlock new applications of your abilities.

Conduits often experience some form of physical mutation, ranging from minor to extreme, as a result of the activation of their Conduit Gene, such as Cole’s glowing blue eyes or Nix’s red skin.
objects.title: Conduit (Infamous)

objects.text: You are capable of opening all 10 Gene Locks through training alone no matter the quality of the Art. Even the Fabled Life Door is not beyond your grasp. You have talent greater than Han Sen. You do not require any external materials to increase the your mind, body, or soul. You are able to learn Hyper Geno Arts without any Geno Solutions. You have a library of all the Hyper Geno Arts that have existed at any time, and the Sutras they are based off of. You may pick 5 Arts/Sutras to have basic proficiency with initially. You can comprehend any martial arts you come across with ease, and create new ones from your knowledge. Eventually you will develop a Super Body on the level of Han Sen’s, you may either create your own, or pick one from Super Gene itself. After constant use of a Hyper Geno Art or Sutra, you experience condenses itself into a weapon (Geno Core) that best represents the Art it originates from and how you use it. They start out relatively weak, yet grow stronger with use. Only after you form a Geno Core and unlock the tenth Gene Lock of a Sutra are you able to condense gene armor. Your Gene Armor may be an Armament, presenting as a sword, spear, gauntlet, or armor. It may also be Xenogeneic, instead of forming something physical, it gets absorbed by your body and strengthens it. Xenogeneics are generally stronger than Armaments at the cost of probable insanity. You have no risk of going insane due to having a xenogeneic gene armor.
objects.title: Hyper Geno Arts (Super Gene)

objects.text:
You are a Fanalis, a member of a powerful race descended from the Red Lions of the Dark Continent. Fanalis are considered the strongest race in the Magi world, renowned for their superhuman strength, durability, stamina, senses, speed, and agility. Distinguished by their red hair and eyes, Fanalis excel in hand-to-hand combat.

They are capable of breaking from steel handcuffs, sending opponents flying with a single kick, leaping several stories high, creating shockwaves with their shouts, lifting and shattering boulders with their fists, tracking others by scent, and breaking through barriers harder than steel.

You inherit the Fanalis combat style and begin as strong as Masrur, though your strength scales with your physical maturity—meaning you would be significantly weaker as a child. However, unlike other Fanalis, you are not limited by low magoi reserves.
objects.title: Fanalis (Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic)

addons.title: Priestess of Thunder
addons.text:
You gain the skills, knowledge and if you wish the appearance, memories, and items of Himejima Akeno, the Queen of Rias Gremory's peerage and daughter of the Fallen Angel Cadre Baraqiel and Himejima Shuri.

Your demonic power rivals that of a Ultimate-Class Devil. You are proficient in elemenal magic, capable of controlling fire, ice, and water, though your true specialty is lightning. You can create devastating thunderstorms over a whole country, effortlessly capable of leveling mountains with concentrated lightning strikes and easily able to paralize your enemies and cause excrutiating pain without killing them thanks to extreme fine control over your electricity.

By combining your inherited light power with your lightning, you wield Holy Lightning, producing dense, sacred bolts that are exceptionally effective against evil beings. You also possess a Fallen Angel Mode, manifesting up to eight black wings that greatly enhance your magical power and the potency of your Holy Lightning.

Beyond combat, you are an expert magician with proficiency in Shinto Magic, Teleportation Magic, Defensive Magic, Summoning Magic, and Purification. You can summon powerful oni familiars and legendary youkai, purify evil spirits, reinforce magical barriers, and teleport yourself or others with ease.

objects.text:
Half of your DNA is that of a Devil—whether that’s from your birth or your reincarnation is entirely up to you.

By their very nature, Devils are stronger, faster, and more durable than ordinary humans. They often appear mostly human, other than a pair of black, bat-like wings that can be concealed at will—though some families may have distinctive features. 

As creatures of the night, they have the ability to see in darkness as easily as in daylight. However, exposure to regular sunlight can be draining for a Devil, similar to how a human might feel after staying up all night. They possess a general vulnerability to light based attacks, though a strong enough Devil will eventually develop a resistance to this weakness.

In addition to their physical attributes, you inherit their Demonic Power—an adaptable force driven by your own imagination. This power allows you to produce a wide array of effects, including manipulating elements, creating illusions, hypnotizing, teleporting, altering memories, translating languages, and even changing your appearance.

You start with the energy reserves of a mid-class Devil, but your powers will grow stronger as you gain experience and mastery.
objects.title: Half-Devil (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You became a vampire, a species native to the world of Draconic Deus. Vampires have superhuman physical capabilities and a set of unique powers, including the ability to control bats and insects, turn into a flock of bats, partially transform into bats, including a manifestation of flight-capable wings, and change their own appearance to their liking.
They also have the ability to manipulate the elements of darkness and shadows, which are further empowered during the night, and to create and manipulate mists, which allows them to erect barriers, search for individuals, and even turn into mist directly to become intangible.

Vampires can create their own peerages without any limit in a simple ritual that requires them to bite a person’s neck during a full moon, which turns their victims into vampires under their absolute rule. But this method is not guaranteed to work as some people who have a weaker resistance to supernatural powers will turn into a ravenous undead instead, which also turns other humanoids into undead by biting them, spreading like a zombie plague until all of them are eradiated or the vampire who turned the first undead is slain.

Vampires are immortal, but they have to drink blood occasionally to stay alive and are incapable of consuming anything else. Vampires are also incapable of healing themselves without sleeping in a dark, constrained space like a coffin or a cardboard box. They also have a general weakness for sunlight, can’t enter buildings unless invited to do so, cannot walk across running water, and hate garlic, as it as extremely foul for their senses. They are also weak against holy objects and powers.

Vampires grow in power by drinking the blood of stronger beings, which is especially effective if that being is considered a virgin, but on rare occasions, they can become drunk on potent blood or even become sick from consuming too much at once, with similar symptoms as poisoning.
objects.title: Vampire (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You have become a Dragon—a dragon native to the world of Draconic Deus, that is.

To begin with, Dragons are beings born from large masses of power with high intelligence that act freely and selfishly upon their desires. Due to this nature, they are one of the strongest, admired, respected, and feared races of their world.

As for their form, dragons are incredibly varied from the classical western dragon, the graceful eastern dragon, or even a mighty dinosaur who were a type of Earth Dragon. A noted detail is that a dragon’s form can change such as gaining black scales upon becoming an evil dragon or simply changing their sex because they felt like it.

In terms of shared characteristics, all dragons possess immense magical power, superhuman strength, and incredible durability—such as Earth Dragons who, despite being the weakest type, are able to easily match entire groups of high-class devils in power. Additionally, it is noted that all dragons do possess the ability to effortlessly take a human form, with there being little difference in power.

Further on the shared abilities of dragons, three of note are Outrage, Immortality, and Dragon Gate.

To start, Outrage is the most dangerous ability inherent to all dragons, as should a dragon enter a great enough rage, they will enter Outrage which in turn multiplies their power several-fold, allowing them to match foes that would normally completely outmatch them. However, the flaws with Outrage is that once entered, the dragon will not stop until their target or themselves are dead, requiring an outside force to sing a calming melody specifically for said dragon to calm it otherwise. 

Next, Immortality is the unique property possessed by dragons, as it allows them to not stay dead so long as their soul is partly intact. In particular, it allows them to have their souls remain within the world even if their bodies were completely destroyed, their souls will simply regather power until they have enough to reform back into the world.

Finally, Dragon Gate is a magic solely unique to dragons, as it creates a portal to and from the location known as Dragon Range, a dimension solely home to dragons. Furthermore, with training, it could be used to launch projectiles from one’s home in said realm, like how Fafnir did with his treasures.

Beyond the shared abilities, a common ability possessed by dragons is a Fire Breath that scales with their own power. Furthermore, with training and magical knowledge, a dragon can alter and increase the power of their fire breath, such as Tannin who trained his to have the power of a meteor or Vritra who mixed curses into theirs. It should be noted that some dragons can develop alternatives in place of this such as lightning breath.

Some potential weaknesses you should remember is that: firstly, under a dragon’s throat, lies a reversed scale. If touched, it will enrage them potentially to the point of Outrage. Secondly, dragons possess an instinctive urge to create a hoard of what they like as treasures, and they are very protective of said treasures, going so far as to chase after thieves for centuries to get their treasure back.

Finally, you also gain the beginnings of experience in the field of growth you choose as a dragon. Notably, three paths of growth have been shown among dragons—mastering and refining one’s innate characteristics like Tannin and Crom Cruach, mastering all manners of magic like Vritra and Aži Dahāka or finally, min-maxing a specific ability or trait like Ddraig and Albion.
objects.title: Dragon (High School DxD)

addons.text: You can choose to be a descendant of a Heroic Spirit, which will grant you talent for their skills. This will also qualify your blood as a catalyst to summon your own ancestor.
addons.title: Heroic Spirit Descendant

addons.text: Every time you reincarnate, you will gain talents from your new parents while retaining every talent you inherited in your previous lives, which results in a stockpiling effect with your overlapping talents strengthening each other.
addons.title: Serial Inheritor

addons.text:
The shadow of your ancestor can be seen through you, their presence echoing in your every step. Even without conscious effort, you now passively begin to absorb fragments of their legacy. Their skills, knowledge, and philosophies gradually emerge within you, as if awakening from a distant memory etched into your blood and soul. This inheritance unfolds over time, refining your instincts, sharpening your understanding, and deepening your natural affinity toward their craft.

While you cannot learn or manifest abilities entirely beyond your nature—for instance, you won’t suddenly gain magic if you possess no magical powers—you can still recreate echoes of such abilities through supplementary means. With the use of tools, techniques, or alternative systems, you can produce near-faithful replications of abilities your ancestor once wielded. These adapted expressions may lack the raw authenticity of the original, but they remain highly effective, shaped by your inherited insight and ingenuity. The deeper your bond with your lineage, the more vividly their essence manifests within you—guiding your growth, inspiring your actions, and occasionally stirring faint echoes of their will in moments of need.
addons.title: Shadow of Legends

objects.text:
You become a descendant of famous historical being(s), inheriting their talents.

Becoming a descendant of a famous swordsman will grant you an inherent talent for using swords, and these talents can also translate to their modern counterparts, just as a famous poet would have a general talent for modern written artistry. You can also inherit some other minor benefits, like the fact that a hero beloved by gods will also grant you charisma toward those same gods.

If you choose a hero who wasn’t known for having descendants, you can also be an inheritor of their spirit, getting the same benefits as a descendant. You don’t have to necessarily choose famous heroes for your ancestors; you could optionally choose beings like famous villains, devils, angels, yokai, etc.

You can optionally choose to look similar to your ancestor(s) either right away or have their inherited traits appear as you master your inheritance, like your hair colour shifting slowly or your physique developing to be similar to theirs as you train.

Albeit you will inherit your ancestor’s talents, this by itself doesn’t give you access to their powers, so even if you become the descendant of a famous magician, this by itself doesn’t grant you the ability to use magic.
objects.title: Heroic Bloodline (High School DxD)

addons.text: Your Demon Breathing and nature as a Demon Child has synergized greatly with your transformation into a demon. Your raw potential, compatibility, and affinity for Demonhood has rendered you particularly receptive to the blood which transformed you and allows you to grow at an unprecedented rate, easily reaching the level of an Upper Moon Demon. Additionally, your Demon Breathing perfectly complements your Blood Demon Art. You can punch outside your weight class, able to fight on par with some of the weaker Upper Moon Demons. Possessing the addon Onigo takes this to even greater extremes, raising your potential and rate of growth to unfathomable levels and allowing you to eventually surpass even a Progenitor Demon given time.
addons.title: True Oni

objects.text:
You are cursed with Demon Blood. You have a deep, insatiable craving for human flesh, though this can be overcome by a sufficiently strong will. Eating people will make you stronger; it will get exponentially harder to grow the closer you get to the level of an Upper Moon. You have infinite stamina and start at the level of a Lower Moon, many times faster than sound and strong enough to destroy a large building, you can also regenerate from all wounds not inflicted by Wisteria or sun-infused/boosted materials albeit not instantly, wounds will close at a visible rate and limbs will regrow within 1 hour of removal if no weakness is used to boost the attack. Your senses can cover about 1 mile, being able to accurately see, smell, and hear within that range if focused. You have absolutely perfect night vision.

You are weak/take extra damage from Wisteria, and it will not allow you to pass through it. The sun will disintegrate you, and sun-infused/boosted materials will cause you extra damage and will kill you if used to decapitate you. Muzan Kibutsuji holds absolutely no power over you.

 You can select any known Blood Demon Art or create your own; it will start at the level of Lower Moon 6, Rui.
objects.title: Demon (Demon Slayer)

addons.text: The resonance of your blood with Yamato has imbued you with the power of The Devil Knight, The Alpha and Omega, The Storm that is Approaching, The Deadbeat dad of deadweight. Harness the might of one who, through tragedy, bloodshed, hard work and effort, succeeded in developing the talent inherent to the blood of Sparda. All of Vergil’s abilities, as well as Devil Arms, are in your reach.
addons.title: The Alpha And The Omega

addons.text: The resonance of your blood with Rebellion has imbued you with the power of the world's premier Devil Hunter, The Legendary Dark Knight, and The Son of Sparda. Harness the might of one who casually mouths off to demon gods, a laid-back hunter who despises work and loves strawberry sundaes, and has succeeded in developing the innate talent within their blood to become even stronger than Sparda. All of Dante's abilities, as well as Devil Arms, are within your reach.
addons.title: Son of Rebellion

addons.text:
In his attempt to sever his human weaknesses, Vergil unintentionally gave form to his trauma, creating demonic entities rooted in painful memories. Inspired by this phenomenon and empowered by the magic of Memory-Make, you have developed a new form of magic known as Vision-Make.

Like V, you can summon demonic entities born from memory—Griffon, Shadow, Nightmare, and Phantom already fight at your side. While these beings have distinct personalities and occasionally clash with your decisions, they remain fiercely loyal to you. In time, you will gain the ability to manifest other entities, such as Cerberus or Geryon. Unlike V’s version of this ability, your familiars are perfectly capable of dispatching enemies on their own without your help.

Additionally, you can “memorize” the powers and traits of the demons you create. You might harness the electric might of a Blitz, the blinding speed of a Fury, or the arcane strength of a Luchasia. As your mastery grows, this ability can evolve to the point where you can emulate the power of beings as formidable as Urizen—or even Mundus himself.
addons.title: Vision-Make

objects.text:
Through your veins runs the blood of the Legendary Dark Knight Sparda. A powerful demon who rebelled against his own kind to protect humanity. This too turns you into part-demon, granting you incredible physical abilities as well as various unique abilities thanks to your demonic heritage.

You start strong enough to shatter a giant statue with a single strike, being able to move at mach 20, healing strong enough to be unfazed from being stabbed and shot, and regeneration so fast that being bisected heals instantly. But be careful, your regeneration can be overwhelmed after a very long and exhausting fight.

You can use your demonic energy to teleport, create platforms in the air to jump off from, imbue your weapons and ammo with it and do possibly many other things with it.

You possess a transformation, your Devil trigger, a demonic form that increases all your powers tenfold.
objects.title: Descendant of Sparda (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
By some chance the blood of Númenor runs true in you, nearly as much as it does among the royals of Gondor and Arthedain. You are one of the Dúnedain, or Men of Westernesse. Tall, dark-haired and grey-eyed, and more noble in spirit and body than other Men despite the fading of your kind. You possess the gift of foresight to some degree, though it is not infallible nor predictable. You are stronger in body than any among mortal Men, and in lifespan you can expect to live two centuries or more.

You inspire those around you by your mere presence, and can ward off the effects of fear on your men. You have some innate talent for the healing of wound and hurt. There is an innate air of authority to you, like the Kings themselves, and even those who have never met you will at least recognize it. You can seemingly without effort give great and inspiring speeches.
objects.title: Blood of Númenor (Lord of The Rings)

addons.text:
The Winds of Magic have resonated with your draconic nature, granting you the traits of the great Emperor Dragons of Mallus. You are far more attuned to the Winds, manipulating them with an ease that would leave even elven mages green with envy and smiting entire armies on your own with magic, breath, claw, and fang.

By focusing on a particular Wind for a few days, you can shift your form to further attune with it and even further increase your already formidable aptitude in its domain, becoming a Doomfire Dragon through Aqshy, a Carmine Dragon through Shysh, a Forest Dragon through Ghyran, a Storm Dragon through Azyr, an Ice Dragon through Hysh, or even a Warpfire Dragon through Dhar, though once the novelty's worn off, you can always shift back to your base form or that of a different Wind. The longer and more often you stay attuned to a particular Wind, the faster you will be able to retake its draconic form.

Regardless of shape, you already have only a short time of growing left before you rival the mighty Kalgalanos the Black, Father of Dragons, in stature. And from there? No one knows, but one thing is certain: the land will darken beneath your shadow, and the world quake with your tread.
addons.title: Emperor Dragon (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text: You are a dragon; your teeth are swords, your claws are spears, your tail is lightning, your wings are a hurricane, and the magic fire is death. The dragons of Middle Earth are no normal creatures; created by Morgoth to be the ultimate weapon of war that would turn the tide of battle, they didn't originally have wings or spit fire. They were creatures of dark magic and evolution made manifest, growing in size and strength with each passing week with no end in sight. They could live and continue evolving forever, so long as nothing killed them. Doing so was no easy task, as the scales that covered them blocked most attacks launched at them. The first ability made apparent to all new dragons is the hypnotism they possess, which can overpower most creatures in Middle Earth and rewrite a person's whole mind with enough practice and age. The next ability would be the magical fire, which can melt anything due to its magical properties. The final ability that is possessed by each dragon is the ability to grow in size infinitely, increasing every ability you have, biological or otherwise. The best example is Ancalagon, who at the time of his death was well above mountains, To such a degree that when he was killed, he destroyed the largest mountain of Middle Earth by crushing it underneath his mass.
objects.title: Fire Dragon (Lord of The Rings)

addons.text:
You embody the essence of humanity, able to seamlessly blend various forms and races into your human form. In this unified state, you possess the complete human experience in mind, body, and spirit, while retaining all the benefits of your diverse forms without their drawbacks. Your human form is adaptable, capable of incorporating traits from your other forms. For example, by combining your human form with that of a dragon, you can choose to appear fully human or possess draconic attributes such as horns, wings, or a tail. The decision is yours to make.

If you have children, they will be humanoid beings with predominantly human features and traits. You possess limited control over determining their characteristics. Furthermore, your offspring can inherit the powers you possess, provided you grant them permission. With sufficient concentration, you even have the ability to selectively decide which powers they will inherit.
addons.title: The Body of Man

addons.text:
As the first human, and the Sleigh Beggy. You possess an innate ability to connect with and earn the affection of supernatural beings, and humans, a trait unlike any other. This extraordinary gift has captured the attention of Alaya, the collective consciousness of humanity itself.

Alaya, recognizing your potential and the profound impact you have on the supernatural realm, has developed an unbreakable bond with you. This is not simply love; it is an all-consuming obsession, a deep-seated desire to understand and protect the one who holds the key to bridging the gap between the human and the otherworldly.
addons.title: Beloved of Humanity

addons.text:
Adam & Eve, Ask & Embla, Mashya & Mashyana. From two, all of humanity was born, thus it is only fitting that as humanity's progenitors, your Significant Other will carry the same mantle.

Your Significant Other is the Eve to your Adam, and through your Soul Marriage, you two will meet again through any reincarnation, as you will always find one another. The love you have for each other will lead you back to one another and grant you both protection, so that any force trying to lead either of you astray or keep you separated WILL fail. Fate and misfortune are denied, as schemes and tricks are rebuked without mercy. Even if someone tries to pretend to be one of you, the love you share will not only reveal the fake but also convince THEM not to stand in your way, and perhaps even assist you due to how strong and pure your love is.

When together, both you and your Significant Other will see a massive increase in power and skill, as your abilities multiply upon one another (effectively by the power of 2 [^2]), making you a formidable force unto yourselves. A non-combative form of this is the love you have for each other and for humanity, as your love becomes a radiating force that fills the world, subtly affecting it to make it a better place for you and your children. Accidents are less likely to happen, people experience moments of self-reflection that lead them to become better versions of themselves, and small epiphanies occur that make the world overall a better place and give them strength to overcome obstacles in their way. It’s almost as if people sense a loving mother and father supporting them.

Another minor note: you and your Significant Other CAN start a species without concerns about a lack of biodiversity. So, if you ever need to restart humanity, or any other species you may have, just know you're all set.​
addons.title: Two Halves of Perfection

addons.text:
Your eyes have opened beyond what the divine ever intended. With the All-Seeing Eyes of God, you no longer see only the surface of powers, you see their source. The radiant threads that bind beings to higher powers, the channels through which divinity flows, and all things that were never meant to witness now lay bare before you. And in that unbearable clarity, your eyes begin to reflect it.

Where the Eyes of the Lord once faltered, your new sight pierces that limitation. Upon witnessing a technique or ability that is externally sourced, be it divine blessing, infernal pact, artifact-induced effect, or spiritual bond, you may now replicate its function through a process of internal divine reconstruction. You do not take the source, nor do you sever the connection between the originator and their gift; instead, your body and spirit, shaped in the image of the gods, forge a mirror to what has been seen. The recreated ability behaves identically in practice, though it is generated through your own inner essence and will.

However, replicating the effects of an external power places unique stress on both your body and perception. The greater the difference in power or nature between you and the source, the greater the toll. Your body, though divine in shape, may suffer internal collapse, burning veins, or systemic shock when mimicking forces far more powerful than yourself. Simultaneously, your eyes, the fusion of Divine Reflection and All-Seeing Truth, may begin to splinter under the pressure. Should you push beyond your limits, you risk cracking the ocular spirit itself, causing feedback blindness, visual bleeding, or temporary disconnection from the ability to reflect at all.
addons.title: Lonely God
The First Sinner
addons.text:
Instead of the conceptual Adam you will instead become Lilith, the first woman and devil. You lose your authority over, and love for humanity, in return for an inborn dominance over all devils and demonic beings in your world. Though be warned, the creatures of hell are more resistant to rulers than mankind. While you now take the form of a devil, at your core you will always be human, something that can be both a boon and drawback. Even as a supernatural being you will retain all the perks of having a human soul, including their talent for limitless growth and exploration, while overcoming their mortal needs and failings.

Just like your physical power your magical ability will equally become immense, generating magical energy endlessly. While your Eyes of the Lord will still work on physical techniques, they are adjusted to focus more on understanding supernatural phenomena and abilities. With your insight you can rewrite and replicate spiritual, esoteric and magical powers with ease. Having eaten the Forbidden Fruit of Knowledge you are able to wield all magic humanity has discovered for itself, and instinctively learn new magic mankind discovers once they do, though you will only gain academic knowledge without deeper insights or practical experience.

You can also influence souls to a degree, preventing their dissipation outside of a body, and use magic as a pure spirit if your body dies. By adding spell formulae to a person's soul you can affect them in many ways, such as making binding contracts, restricting their powers, allow them to use magic innately, or even alter their conceptual species to become demonic in nature.

objects.text:
You are the progenitor of mankind, the first human from which all of humanity has descended. Your love for humanity knows no bounds, and you are willing to face insurmountable odds to protect your children, even if it means battling the gods themselves. Your endurance is unimaginable, able to continue fighting for a short period after your body has died. Created in the image of a god, your beauty is even admired by beings like Aphrodite. Your reflexes are so impressive you are able to dodge punches that are faster than light. Your durability is remarkable as well, enabling you to withstand powerful blows from divine beings. Your charisma towards humans is immense, capable of touching their hearts and uniting them, if only temporarily. Regardless of the powers or strength you acquire, you will always retain the ability to assume a human form. For you are human. 

As the first man, you were destined to rule over all Earth's animals. Most creatures will naturally be friendly towards you and may even lend you their aid. Additionally, you possess the Eyes of the Lord, which possess the ability of Divine Reflection. These eyes allow you to perfectly replicate any move or technique you witness. They even grant you temporary biological adaptations to accurately reproduce certain techniques. However, there are limitations to these eyes. They cannot replicate techniques dependent on external sources; they only work for different forms of inner power or energy. The strain of perceiving opponents' attacks puts a certain amount of pressure on your nervous system. Pushing your eyes to their limits causes your body to overheat, and further abuse risks rendering you blind, with bleeding occurring from your nose, eyes, and ears. Consequently, you lose the ability to use Divine Reflection.
objects.title: The Progenitor of Man (Record of Ragnarok)

addons.text:
You are not the only Progenitor. You have a twin, the blue to your red, or the red to your blue. They, too, are a Chiropteran, and if their blood ends up inside of you or any Chiropteran you create, it will crystallize you or them, causing a swift death. Your twin is equally at risk from your blood.

However, this isn't entirely negative. Both of you can now breed with each other's Chevaliers to continue your species. Any Chiropteran carrying future twin royalty will lose their poisonous blood, ensuring the safety of their offspring.
addons.title: Twin Bloodlines

addons.text:
You're not just a royal Chiropteran, but the progenitor of your species. This grants benefits other queens and kings do not have. Such as no longer needing to hibernate—regardless of whether you have Chevaliers or not, you will not need to worry about spending decades at a time sleeping.

You also have access to the many unique and special abilities that tend to sprout up at random in specific Chiropterans. This includes, but is not limited to: creating shockwaves by swinging your arms, shooting out blasts of sound from your mouth that tear gouges through earth, a limited form of telekinesis allowing you to shatter iron chains or glass, your Chiropteran form’s skin being hard enough to ignore anything not heavy artillery, shooting projectiles, and a limited form of telepathy.

Finally, while your physical capabilities didn't visibly grow much, you instead have greater regeneration. Things like completely missing limbs can be restored just as fast as bullet wounds would. And you do not lose strength from not eating—whether that's blood or human food.
addons.title: Progenitor

objects.text:
You are an Original Chiropteran, the King or Queen of your species. While you appear as a normal human with striking red or blue eyes, you are, in truth, a vampiric bat-like creature capable of shapeshifting and exhibiting superhuman abilities.

Your speed allows you to move faster than the human eye can follow, your strength lets you effortlessly demolish stone walls, and your endurance enables you to shrug off bullets from handheld guns, healing wounds in mere seconds. These traits become even more potent as you consume more blood. Your shapeshifting abilities allow you to alter your human form to any appearance you desire, and you can partially transform parts of your body into your Chiropteran form.

Your Chiropteran form, which you can design yourself, dramatically amplifies all your physical abilities. While ordinary guns may have posed a threat before, in this form, only something as powerful as an anti-tank rifle could pierce your hide. You do not require food, as you can subsist solely on blood. Alternatively, you can choose to consume human food instead, though this will weaken you, reducing your strength to just above peak human levels. You do not age and are biologically immortal, unless killed.

As the Progenitor of your species, you have the ability to turn others into Chevaliers, Chiropterans who possess a lesser version of your powers. With sufficient scientific knowledge, you or others could potentially create lesser Chiropterans or even variants such as the Schiff.

You can remain active for ten years before you begin to grow drowsy and enter a hibernation that may last for decades. If you have no Chevalier, your first hibernation can be delayed for up to fifty years.
objects.title: Chiropteran Royalty (Blood+)

addons.text: Your status as the Ultimate Lifeform is no longer limited to Earth or its lifeforms. Whenever you enter a new universe, your body automatically adapts to that world’s physical laws, species, and supernatural systems, evolving to physically, mentally, and spiritually maintain your position as the Ultimate Lifeform. Exposure to foreign environments, organisms, or energies causes your cells to adapt and restructure themselves, developing new organs, traits, and internal functions suited to that world and reflecting the characteristics of its inhabitants. You can freely assume the biology of any native creature and reproduce their natural or esoteric traits and specialized organs, combining or improving them as desired, and may absorb material or lifeforms, whether biological or esoteric, through contact to integrate useful traits directly into your own body. Any energy source required by local abilities is generated internally through your evolved biology, allowing you to naturally utilize and sustain that world’s power system. This adaptation removes the previous limitation on your Understanding, allowing you to replicate and improve abilities even when they depend on foreign or setting-specific energies, as you now adapt to possess whatever is required. These changes only occur upward and never diminish qualities you already possess. The process follows the same adaptation period as Universal Power Plant, and by the time your internal energy stabilizes, your body and capabilities have already adjusted to place you at the top of that universe’s lifeforms as its Ultimate Lifeform.
addons.title: Universal Lifeform

objects.text:
You have become the sole embodiment of the Ultimate Lifeform, the apex being of Earth's food chain. You are distinctly unique, even from any alternate versions of yourself.

You possess immense physical strength, capable of flipping islands, and unmatched durability to withstand similar devastating blows. Your speed surpasses even the swiftest Stands, rendering you invisible to the naked eye. Even if reduced to a single cell, your regenerative abilities restore you to full health within seconds. Complete control, awareness, and knowledge over your biology grant you the ability to modify your features and transform individual cells into sentient creatures like birds or other animals. Moreover, by mere touch, you can extend this control to reshape other beings as you see fit, instantly comprehending their biological makeup. Unlike others, you can harbor multiple Stands within yourself, surpassing the single Stand restriction.

Your mental prowess is equally unmatched. Your memory and intelligence eclipses that of any human, enabling you to acquire years' worth of knowledge and information within moments. Your senses surpass even the most acute abilities of the animal kingdom, enhanced by an array of sensory organs beyond human capacity.

However, your most formidable and deserving attribute of the "Ultimate Lifeform" title is your Understanding. Through mere observation of an ability, you can replicate and perfect it, assimilating the powers of others at a superior level. You can create superior abilities based on those you have copied, endowing them with amplified abilities surpassing the original versions. There is, however, one restriction to this ability: you can only replicate powers within your own capability. If an ability relies on an energy source you lack or cannot acquire through bodily transformation, you cannot replicate it.

You are no longer weak to sunlight; if you have Hamon Breathing, you can become the most powerful Hamon User in history.
objects.title: THE Ultimate Lifeform (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
You are a Pillar Man, a member of an ancient species of superhumans.

Your existence is defined by perfected, immutable physiology. You are ageless and immune to all mundane disease and poison. Your natural strength, durability, and speed are immense, completely dwarfing even the vampires created by the Stone Mask. Your body possesses a powerful regenerative factor, capable of healing grievous wounds and instantly reattaching severed limbs. Even catastrophic damage is not fatal; you can survive and fully regenerate your form from just your brain or a major organ.

Your intellect operates with superhuman precision and speed, granting enhanced recall and accelerated learning. You intuitively grasp complex systems, languages, and skills upon observation. As demonstrated by the Pillar Man Santana—sealed since the BC era with no knowledge of modern technology—you can analyze and master entirely foreign concepts, like disassembling a complex firearm, in mere seconds. Your senses are extraordinarily sharp, allowing you to perceive living heat, track scents over vast distances, and detect minute vibrations in your environment.

 Manipulating your body is as intuitive as breathing. You have absolute, conscious control over your cellular structure, allowing you to reshape bones, liquefy organs, stretch limbs, and contort your form to slip through impossibly narrow spaces or flatten against surfaces. Your primary method of sustenance and a potent weapon is cellular absorption. Upon touch, your cells release a digestive fluid that breaks down other lifeforms at a molecular level, absorbing their essence. This process can be deployed with creative tactics, such as absorbing a host from within their own body. Your cells also induce a paralyzing euphoria in victims. This  is ineffective against beings such as hamon users, as your cells are able to sense the solar energy within theirs.

Your existence has one flaw a major vulnerability to ultraviolet solar energy. You are not as frail as a vampire, but sustained, direct sunlight acts as a lethal poison. Prolonged exposure will cause your body to petrify and crumble into dust.
objects.title: Pillar Man (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
You have turned into a ghoul. As one, your body possesses physical abilities several times greater than the average human, heightening every aspect of your physique to inhuman levels—able to casually toss people like ragdolls, outrun speeding cars, shrug off small arms fire with minimal damage, and pinpoint footsteps through a crowded street, etc.

Ghouls also have a remarkable regeneration factor, healing minor wounds in seconds and recovering from severe injuries within days, a process accelerated by consuming flesh.

However, a ghoul's arsenal would be incomplete without their trump card—the kagune, a predatory organ comprised entirely of Rc cells.

Once released, a kagune grants a significant boost to your base stats, with its form, function, and point of emergence being determined by Rc type—each carrying its own unique characteristics:

Ukaku: A wing-like kagune released from the shoulder area. Lightweight and specialized in high-speed attacks.

Koukaku: A heavy, high-density kagune released from below the shoulder blade. It is the sturdiest Rc type, excellent for defense, but its weight and lack of speed make it difficult to wield.

Rinkaku: Scaled tentacles released from the lower back around the waist, known for its brute strength and superior regeneration. Though due to their Rc cells' liquid nature, they're easier to destroy, offering little defense.

Bikaku: A tail-like kagune released from around the tailbone. Balanced and versatile, it lacks any notable strengths or weaknesses but performs well in all areas, making it a reliable all-rounder.

Regardless of type, you'll only begin with one kagune.

Finally, you cannot eat normal food and require human flesh to survive. You're also altered to a degree, allowing you to change a portion of human flesh you consume into Rc cells, thus allowing you to grow stronger.
objects.title: Ghoul (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text:
You become an Ultima Sunt, beings that were manufactured by the Gods, built for war, and betrayed due to their potential in surpassing their creators. Ultima Sunts are originally heteromorphic slime-like creatures that gain new forms, abilities, and optimized hybridizations by either assimilating/consuming genetic material or profound energies. Every Ultima Sunt has the (non-nerfed version) [Unlimited Growth], [Beckon], [Evolution], [Pinnacle Intellect], and [Ultimate Stealth] abilities from Boundless. 

[Unlimited Growth] – These beings possess no form of limitation in gaining more power.

[Beckon] – Ultima Sunt can mentally manipulate their prey with mild suggestions on how to act when they are within their line of sight or general AOE.

[Evolution] – All newly collected genetic material and esoteric energies are rapidly optimized for use in new hybrid forms that ‘accentuate the positive’ and ‘negate the negative’.

[Pinnacle Intellect] – All memories, data, and experience consumed by Ultima Sunt’s are stored away in each individual cell. Making the whole being operate faster then the strongest quantum computer.

[Ultimate Stealth] – Ultima Sunt’s possess the ability to cloak themselves, hiding them away from the world in almost all manners but the space they reside in. 

Due to their history, these beings are generally not tolerated by the Gods in any way, shape, or form. Albeit there exist two cases where they still exist due to favorable circumstances. Another shortcoming of the race is their base infertility due to being originally artificial in nature and only made for war but can be overcome with esoteric methods.
objects.title: Ultima Sunt (Guild Wars)

objects.text:
You have transformed into a dextro-protein alien reminiscent of the Quarians—fragile yet exceptionally skilled in technology. Standing shorter and slighter than the average human, your delicate frame includes unique features such as three thick fingers per hand, digitigrade legs ending in three toes, and refined facial features. While your blood remains red, your physiology reflects a stark vulnerability: a perilous immune system weakened by generations in sterile environments.  

Your innate brilliance with electronics and mechanics allows you to intuitively improvise, repair, and fine-tune complex systems. This knack for technology is unmatched, making you a natural engineer. However, your dextro-protein biochemistry restricts your diet to specialized foods, as standard (levo-protein) meals are either nutritionally worthless or outright toxic. Survival demands access to compatible sustenance, adding another layer of difficulty to your existence.  

Without protection, microbial exposure poses an extreme risk. Even minor environmental contact can lead to life-threatening infections. Your immune system cannot adapt naturally, requiring constant vigilance to avoid contamination. Illnesses and injuries escalate rapidly without advanced medical intervention, making your existence inherently fragile.

To counter these vulnerabilities, you are equipped with a specialized Quarian enviro-suit. This high-tech outfit is tailored to your unique biology, shielding you from harmful pathogens and maintaining a sterile environment. It incorporates advanced filters, sealed compartments, and modular components, ensuring survival even in hazardous conditions.  

The suit’s design balances practicality and aesthetics, reflecting your personal style while maintaining full functionality. Whether you prefer a sleek, minimalistic look or a visually striking outfit with glowing circuitry and decorative elements, the enviro-suit is a perfect blend of form and function. It serves as both a symbol of your Quarian heritage and a vital tool for navigating a world hostile to your delicate physiology.  

Your technological brilliance is a testament to your species, but it comes at the cost of a fragile existence reliant on careful planning, precision, and the protective armor of your enviro-suit.
objects.title: Quarian (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
You have transformed into a turian, a disciplined and militaristic dextro-protein alien species from the Mass Effect universe. Your new form is strikingly avian and reptilian, blending sleek metallic features with a proud and commanding presence.

You now stand taller than the average human, between 190–210 cm, with a lean yet powerful physique. Your body is covered in a metallic carapace with trace amounts of thulium, making you highly resistant to radiation and minor physical harm. This natural armor gives your skin a distinctive sheen.

Your face is adorned with mandibles around your mouth, adding a raptor-like elegance to your appearance. Males have swept-back crests, while females possess larger, expressive eyes with a cat-like quality. Your hands consist of two long fingers and an opposable thumb, tipped with talons, providing enhanced grip and dexterity. Your legs are digitigrade, giving you a raptor-like stance and improved agility.

You can choose unique tattoos or markings, representing your colony of origin. These are a source of pride and identity among turians, signifying honor and heritage. A strong sense of duty and public service now permeates your mindset, making you naturally organized, focused, and cooperative.

Your carapace grants you enhanced protection against radiation and heat, allowing you to survive in harsher environments without specialized gear. Like quarians, your biochemistry is dextro-amino-acid-based, meaning you must consume specialized food compatible with your biology. Levo-based meals are toxic to you.

Your training and instincts as a turian grant you enhanced spatial awareness and tactical thinking. You can quickly assess situations and develop effective strategies in the heat of battle. Turian physiology is naturally efficient, granting you greater stamina, agility, and resilience in both combat and strenuous activity. Your form embodies a balance of elegance, discipline, and strength.
objects.title: Turian (Mass Effect)

addons.text: "You’ve come a lot farther than you should have — but then you haven’t met (blank) either. Your ride’s over, mutie. Time to die." The combination of your peak Super Mutant biology and Power Armor technology has fused into an unholy mix of biologically induced evolution and man-made technological terror. Unlike the living hell that is Frank Horrigan, you are granted one mercy: you can remove the Power Armor—though it remains quite difficult to do. Regardless, you are far more powerful while wearing it. You are stronger than Nightkin, able to run at roughly 100 miles per hour; with your mass and momentum, you’re almost like a pickup truck traveling twice that speed. On your own, when sufficiently enraged, you could bench-press a modern tank—or more. You can tank laser and plasma fire with ease; the only real threat is a room full of plasma turrets. Even then, you’ll go down swinging.
addons.title: The Wasteland Monster

objects.text: Out of all the creatures created by the Forced Evolutionary Virus, you are among the most dangerous. Like other Super Mutants, you are stripped of your normal human appearance, and now becoming a large green giant, going between 7 and 9 feet tall. They are capable of ramming through concrete walls with some effort, running 35 mph, and their rage is like none other. As well, you will be capable of tanking most conventional weapons with relative ease, although missiles and high-yield energy weapons are very much a danger to you. You in particular are a mix of strains. You keep your intelligence like those of the Institute strain, as well as the sheer physicality and growth potential as the Vault 88 Strain. You have psyker potential, although that needs to be awakened. Procreation methods are not destroyed if desired, and in fact, could lead to stronger offspring.
objects.title: Forced Evolutionary Virus (Fallout)

objects.text:
You are one of the most feared predators of the Wasteland, the fearsome Deathclaw. In particular, one of the Enclave’s Intelligent Deathclaws, allowing you to retain your intelligence and linguistic capabilities.

Standing 10-12ft tall, you are a carnivorous, reptilian creature designed for warfare, and as such are quite a powerhouse. With the coordination of your sheer muscles, armored plating, and loose skin resulting in you being able to knock around and flip cars, casually break through concrete, puncture steel armor, run upwards of 40 mph, dodge and weave gunfire, and only be irritated by small-arms fire. Whilst, the combination of your finely honed senses of smell and hearing with a forked tongue allow you to detect and find invisible targets, and track scents over great distances and for several days.

Further, weaponizing your might you sport a variety of armaments. Upon your head sits a pair of thick horns capable of goring a man and enduring clashes with your kin. Your mouth, housing a combination of jaws and teeth, can shatter bone and sever limbs. The end of your tail is a heavy weight that can pulverize bone when swung. Finally, the most notable are your claws, reaching the length of a man’s forearm at longest, and possessing the strength and sharpness to slice an unarmed man in two in a single swing or punch through even power armor.

Finally, you can optionally have a set of large robes and face coverings, fitted for you to pass as a strange humanoid like Goris had.
objects.title: Intelligent Deathclaw (Fallout)

addons.title: Anti-Ajin Special Forces
addons.text:
You possess the training and expertise of the Legendary Anti-Ajin Special Forces, granting you an exceptional mastery of anti-immortal warfare. You have thoroughly studied Immortal physiology, regeneration, reformation, resurrection, and other supernatural phenomena, with their tactics and weaknesses drilled into instinct.

You gain a sixth sense that allows you to recognize when someone is an immortal within moments, allowing you to quickly devise methods to contain, incapacitate, or potentially kill them. Even entirely new forms of immortality can be quickly reduced to a solvable problem through observation and experimentation.

As both an Ajin and a hunter of immortals, your extensive training has caused your IBM to become five times denser and more potent than that of a highly experienced Ajin, allowing you to fill stadiums with IBM particles and create multiple Black Ghosts. You also possess precise control over its density, manifestation speed, decay, and behavior.

With sufficient understanding, your IBM can reproduce the properties of esoteric materials and supernatural energies. You can also shape it into weapons, defenses, traps, tools, and other constructs.

Your anti-immortal training has given you exceptional creativity in exploiting your own immortality and IBM. You can actively regenerate unlike standard Ajin, allowing you to turn your immortality into a weapon or even a means of teleporting vast distances to the largest 'chunk' of you.

You also receive a full set of military equipment and armor that counts as an Object of Power. Each piece is extensively customized for you and incorporates minor uses of local super-technology or supernatural modifications.

objects.text:
Oh, it seems you suffered an accident, and whatever identity you were supposed to have already died, but fear not, you lived again. Welcome to the ranks of the undying: the Ajin.

As an Ajin, you generate an esoteric energy called IBM (Invisible Black Matter) that's three times more dense than those of a rookie Ajin. You can manifest enough IBM particles to perfuse a large room or manifest your IBM constructs, like Ghosts, for longer durations and in greater quantities.

IBM has unique properties that make it fascinating. It is undetectable when unmanifested and impossible to study even when manifested. You have fine control over your IBM, allowing you to adjust its manifestation speed, decay, and perceptibility. With practice, you can mimic the characteristics of other materials or energies. At advanced levels, your IBM can serve as a substitute power source for your other abilities.
