As an Ajin, you have a form of immortality. Whenever you die, you will be revived and reset to a functional state. All wounds, ailments, and fatigue are removed, and lost limbs, organs, and other body parts are regenerated from your IBM. If your body is torn apart, pieces within a certain radius will be integrated, while anything outside that range will be recreated from your IBM. Reformation and regeneration are unstoppable processes.

Most Ajin can manifest a sapient IBM construct called the "Black Ghost." Your Ghost is an extension of yourself and can be mentally controlled. It has limitations in terms of time and distance, but with experience, it becomes more capable of functioning independently, as well as shifting it's form. The Ghost can learn mundane skills and can be physically strong and resilient, but it is not invincible.

Your Ghost can utilize your supernatural abilities and can learn to use them independently. However, its will be limited by your own skill, and you will bear the cost of these abilities.
objects.title: Ajin (Ajin: Demi-Human)

addons.text: You are able to tap into your most primal, animalistic side, making you an unstoppable force of nature. You can allow your instincts to take over, as you become filled with primal fury that further enhances your physical abilities. Your strength, speed, and reflexes all increase greatly, allowing you to perform superhuman feats. Additionally, your senses are heightened, allowing you to quickly identify and hunt down any potential prey. You become driven by instinct and instinct alone, with no higher thought or reasoning clouding your mind. In this state, you project an an aura of primal power and strength, able to make an ordinary man faint.
addons.title: Ancient Instinct

addons.text: Since the dawn of time, you have evolved and adapted to survive in a hostile environment. Through the process of evolutionary simulation and environmental conditioning over millions of years, you have become an instrument of war, your every attribute customized for the sole purpose of annihilation. From your birth, you have been subjected to the harshest of trials, resulting in an optimized form, perfectly suited for combat. As a living weapon, nothing is left to chance, every aspect of your being is tailored for the ultimate destruction of your opponents.
addons.title: Ancient Demon

addons.text:
You are a true beast of a man.

On top of your superhuman attributes, you are also a master of ancient and resourceful tactics, able to make the most of any situation. With your survival experience and knowledge of the land, you can navigate any terrain, find safe shelter, and even hunt for your own food.

You are a skilled hunter with vast knowledge of the wilderness, allowing you to track and capture prey with ease. You are an expert at stalking and ambush hunting, able to move through the environment with quiet and precision, getting close to your prey without being noticed. You are also an excellent tracker, able to follow the footprints of animals and identify their behavior patterns. You are also able to use your knowledge of biology and anatomy from being a hunter to identify the weaknesses of your enemies, and exploit them for your own gain.
addons.title: Ancient Wisdom

objects.text:
You are a superhuman creature that stands over 8 feet tall with an unusually high level of muscular development. Your physical traits resemble those of a sahelanthropus, but with a few key differences that set you apart from any known species. Your upper and lower canines are enlarged and sharp, resembling something between a human's and a carnivore's teeth. You also possess claws on your fingertips, allowing you to easily climb and grip surfaces.

Your neck vertebrae are extra-thick and developed, resulting from the evolution of a quadruped stance. This is reflected in your muscular frame, which makes it difficult for you to wear modern clothing. Your forearm, lower legs, and neck are all heavily developed, giving you immense physical strength and endurance.

Your muscular structure and neck vertebrae also make you extremely resistant to injuries. You can withstand three 9-mm shots to the abdomen at point-blank range, making you incredibly durable and strong. You are also able to kill T-Rexes without the use of weapons, thanks to your sharp canines, claws, and physical strength and endurance.

In addition to your physical strength and endurance, you have a commanding presence and are able to make any animal run away in fear after seeing you. You are a true apex predator, feared and respected by all those who cross your path.
objects.title: Ancient Human (Baki the Grappler)

addons.text:
Through your resonance with the Nanatsu-yoru, you have awakened as one of the Nanaya—a bloodline of psychics bred for a singular purpose: the extermination of demons and Mixed-Bloods. Refined through generations of ruthless selection, the Nanaya were forged into the most lethal assassins the Demon Hunter Association has ever known.

At the heart of this legacy lie the Pure Eyes, also known as the Eyes of Purity. This psychic inheritance grants the ability to see that which is normally unseen. Though the way it manifests varies between individuals—some may see spirits, others pierce illusions or sense thoughts and emotions as shifting colors—they all, however, exist to aid in fulfilling the clan's sacred duty of upholding the natural order through the eradication of the unnatural.

This purpose is then carried out through the Nanaya Assassin Arts, a killing art that pushes the boundaries of human potential. With Flash Dash, you vanish from sight—blitzing across ceilings, walls, and rooftops with fluid, predatory grace, turning any space into your hunting ground. Flashing Scabbard allows you to unleash a flurry of strikes in a single breath, cutting down foes before they can even react.

Every movement is precise and deliberate, refined to the point where even tearing a person's head from their shoulders takes minimal effort. You rely not on raw strength, but on instinct, leverage, and speed—amplifying your power through pure technique.

Your natural talent for the Assassin Arts rivals that of Shiki Tohno, whose potential was said to surpass even his father, Kiri Nanaya—the most feared assassin in the clan's entire history.
addons.title: Nanaya Clan

addons.text: You’ve inherited the combined skills of the assassins from the Order in Sakamoto Days, making you one of the most dangerous individuals on the planet. This includes the unparalleled swordsmanship of Takamura, who can deflect bullets and slice through buildings with ease; the masterful disguise abilities of Yoichi Nagumo, who can even mimic someone’s reflection; and the overwhelming combat prowess of Taro Sakamoto, capable of turning cough drops into deadly projectiles and stopping a speeding bus with nothing but a signpost.
addons.title: The Other Legendary Hitman (Sakamoto Days)

objects.text:
You carry the blood of the Kure clan within you, a clan of assassins that are notorious throughout the criminal underworld. Besides being assassins, the Kure clan is also known for its practice of selective breeding to create a race specialized for combat, which it has done for the past 1300 years. As a result of this selective breeding, members of the Kure clan possess a powerful physical body that far exceeds a normal human by a wide margin, with a pain tolerance that can take deep wounds and shrug them off to continue fighting as if nothing has happened thanks to over 20 types of different endorphin produced by their body.

You also possess knowledge of the Kure clan's martial art, especially the technique called Removal, which allows the user to consciously remove the brain limit on their muscular strength output and access their body's latent potential. You have a Removal rate of 100% and have equal talent to Kure Raian. You can choose whether or not you have the black color eye of the Kure clan or not.
objects.title: Taboo Descendant (Kengan Ashura/Omega)

addons.text:
You gain every documented genetic anomaly and bodily modification found throughout Kengan Ashura and Kengan Omega, with only two exceptions: the hereditary traits of the Kure and Wu clans, and the mutation possessed by Meguro Masaki and his clone that converts pain into pleasure. Everything else becomes part of your physiology in a precise, controlled, and perfectly synergized manner. This includes Rihito’s dramatically reinforced, razor-sharp fingernails combined with monstrous grip strength capable of carving through flesh and steel alike, as well as Hajime Hanafusa’s self-engineered body—bones refined into razor sharp blades, which you can eject at will, not requiring the springs Hajime needed to eject them from inside his forearm and an impossibly potent immune system armed with a grotesque catalog of hyper-adaptive antibodies capable of harboring viruses lethal to ordinary humans, as well as all the virus's he has ever held in his body, as a bonus you have a powerful regeneration limited solely to parts of the body affected by these various modifications, such as your palms, or the soles of your feet, as well as the modifications themselves.

You also inherit the Inaba Clan’s hair, preternaturally long, incredibly beautiful, densely packed, and immensely strong, able to move like a whip or binding cable. Your frame mirrors Kono Haruo’s natural build and furnace-like metabolism, granting raw physical might that once allowed him to shatter boulders and topple trees in his youth, as well as healing at the limits of human biology. Yohei Bando’s range of motion and joint elasticity becomes yours as well, enabling techniques that would maim lesser bodies—such as dislocating your own limbs mid-strike to generate the devastating “Whiplash.” You also gain Hong Xiao-Hu’s bodies capabilities accelerate the secretion of natural painkillers, granting inhuman pain tolerance. Finally, Karo Yoshinari’s giant-like sense of balance and unshakable core strength settle into your body, allowing you to maintain absolute stability fighting aboard a storm-tossed vessel.

As a final enhancement, your physique is refined to withstand and execute every high-level secret technique across the Kengan series—arts that normally push even monsters to the brink. The Advance, the Fallen Demon, Devil Lance, and every similarly extreme method become fully accessible to you without crippling backlash, enabling you to use each one all together for as long as you wish. And if you possess the power Niko Style (Kengan Ashura/Omega), this refinement extends further, allowing you to safely harness Kiryu's volatile interpretation of the Koei Style, and effortlessly combine both Niko Style and Koei Style into a single superior Martial art, if you possess the power Master Martial Artist (One Punch Man), you may do the same with every other martial art, or style of combat you learn, through this CYOA or any other means, whether copying or learning.

objects.text:
You are a freak of nature who has a rare mutation that causes your muscle to be 52 times denser than the average human being, giving you even greater physical strength than those of the Kure clan. Your musculature is so dense, it can even provide extra protection for normally weak and vulnerable areas like the back of the neck and throat.

You also have access to a technique called Blast Core which allows you to compress and release your muscle like a spring for a burst of explosive force.
objects.title: Superman Syndrome (Kengan Ashura/Omega)

addons.text: Your Hanma blood resonates with your Oni race. Its limits have been removed and pushed beyond humanity, you gain the power of an Ogre. You are constantly in your Oni state, you can choose if your horns are visible, and revel in conflict. From every battle you gain strength, from each opponent gain knowledge, from each defeat you gain wisdom. Roar and fight, for your blood demands it!
addons.title: The Ogre

addons.text:
The incarnation of the Oni God is a once in a multi-century event. As said incarnation your physical prowess is thrice that of any other Oni asserting your superiority as the pinnacle of your race. Your skill with your elemental affinity is magnified to the point that only a Great Spirit of that Element could hope to exceed you in skill. But even without skill the sheer amount of mana you can absorb and circulate would allow you beat down most opposition with brute force.

You may not be the Color of the other elements but your natural skill at magic has given you above average affinity in the remaining five elements. As an added bonus you also gain the Secret Oni Art called Clairvoyance which allows you to synchronize with the vision of anything that have the same wavelength, allowing you to overlap your vision with theirs. Beings stronger than you have the ability to fight this off but you can continuously change whose vision you're looking through.

This is not all benefits, The Oni God is a blood thirsty deity who constantly speaks in your head demanding you to kill everyone and everything around you. You must do your best to not become consumed by it's voice less you fall into madness.
addons.title: Oni God

objects.text: You are an Oni. Outwardly, you look no different, but you can enter your Oni form, manifesting a pair of horns. In this state, your physical capabilities greatly surpass humans, capable of killing monsters with your bare fist. You also passively absorb ambient Mana, boosting both your physique and magic. Do be careful, as there is a chance of your going berserk.
objects.title: Oni (Re:Zero)

objects.text: You are… a yellow octopus? You are an Anti-matter creature with unique and powerful abilities! You possess multiple tentacles. You are incapable of taking harm from anything besides Anti-Anti-Matter weapons. Your skin has the ability to change color, which allows you to express emotions and camouflage yourself. You can also generate a mucus that serves as a support agent for various purposes, such as waterproofing, cleansing, adhesive, and even as a substitute for tears. When faced with a severe threat, you have a special ability known as Absolute Defense, which allows you to compress your body into a small sphere, not much larger than a baseball. In this form, you are completely impervious to harm, with even a nuclear warhead unable to scratch you. However, this state leaves you immobile and susceptible to being carried around. You have a maximum speed of Mach 20, allowing you to move incredibly quickly. Learn more about your unique capabilities, and unlock your full potential.
objects.title: Umm… Sensei! (Assassination Classroom)

addons.text:
Not only are your general traits improved significantly, but as a symbiotic organism, you can impart this trait onto your hosts, rendering them ‘Apex’ in much the same way you are. 

The manner in which this can present is highly dependent on the host species itself, but as it stems from you it will not stay if you are somehow removed, and will always benefit you in at least some manner.
addons.title: Apex Symbiont

addons.text:
As your OoPs are now physically grafted onto your body, you can decide whether the items grafted are part of your true parasitic body or the default host you gain on entry. 

Adding them to your body has the possibility of being inconvenient due to your relatively small size depending on the item, however it does allow the Naquadah in your blood to be used as a fuel in emergencies. 

However, adding them to your host means in order to use them in a new body you’ll have to physically transfer them over, which can range in difficulty depending on the OoP.
addons.title: Cyber Worm

addons.text:
As you’re not fully grown, you’re a Prim’ta rather than a fully grown Goa’uld. 

While in theory you could control a body, as you’re not fully grown you’ll only be able to take control of a host for brief periods, which they’ll experience as blackouts. 

As you cannot control your body 100% of the time, your human form has been exchanged for a loyal Jaffa (a human enhanced by your presence) of a corresponding age to Pint Sized which you can communicate with, and will keep you safe and secure.
addons.title: Prim'ta

objects.text:
The children of the gods, a narcissistic title that the Goa’uld gave themselves, are an aquatic species of parasites or symbiotes (depending on who you ask) that originally came from a desolate planet of primitive lizard-like species. They took hosts and conquered the galaxy. However, this was not always the case, as the Ancients originally hoped for them to take over as the watchers of the universe for them, took them under their wing, and taught them secrets of the universe that they used to instead take over the universe.
 
Despite being quite small, they are rather strong as they can burrow through skin and bone, wrapping themselves around the nervous system and taking control of whatever poor fool was unlucky enough to be near them at the time, and as several Goa’uld would say, nothing survives of the host. They had unbelievable control over the host, being able to kill them at will when needed or release a deadly poison that was released when killed or removed from the host. All Goa’uld possess genetic memory, being able to have the accumulated knowledge of every Goa’uld before them with technology that could convince most of the galaxy into thinking that they were gods. All Goa’uld could also enhance their host to superhuman levels, heal them when necessary, and prolong the lifespan of a host to unnatural levels.
 
Goa’uld also possessed Naquadah within their blood, an unnatural addition to them that allowed them to use the technology that they built. You possess the knowledge of every Goa’uld except for the knowledge that Anubis gained while he was ascended.

Through the Cyoa, your current body or the body you choose to be either Inserted into or Reincarnated into will be transformed into a perfect body for you to inhabit. You can also use your powers through your host.
objects.title: Goa’uld (Stargate)

objects.text:
“In fact, they were first. We’re the second evolution of this form” ~ Carson Beckett

Your body has evolved into that of an Ancient from the era of Atlantis, commonly known as a Lantean or Atlantean. This represents the final known stage of Ancient evolution before their civilization declined and its remaining members either died out or Ascended.

You possess the Ancient Technology Activation (ATA) gene and an innate compatibility with Ancient technology surpassing that of virtually any other species, including modern Humans, who are themselves the second evolution of the Ancient form.

Your mind has likewise advanced to Lantean standards. Your memory, comprehension, intuition, and learning speed are extraordinary, allowing you to understand unfamiliar languages after only brief exposure and rapidly grasp even highly complex subjects.

You also receive the general education and knowledge expected of an average Lantean at the height of their civilization, including their understanding of science, technology, medicine, history, philosophy, mathematics, and other major fields.

Your advanced physiology has awakened one ability associated with powerful Ancients or those approaching Ascension. Examples include Telekinesis, Telepathy, Energy Manipulation, Healing Touch, or Technopathy. With time and development, you may awaken additional abilities.

Unlike the original Ancients, however, your evolution does not force you toward Ascension. You may remain in your physical body indefinitely without consequence.

You still possess the potential to Ascend should you choose to pursue it, though doing so will require time, further development, and the proper mental and spiritual state.

Ascension is a choice, not an inevitability.
objects.title: Lantean (Stargate)

objects.text:
You have gained the physiology of the Wraith. Your new physiology has altered your body in numerous ways, significantly enhancing your physical strength. You can now effortlessly lift and crush a human's head with one arm, moving beyond the typical range of human vision, and exceeding speeds that the naked eye can perceive. Your skin has taken on an unnatural shade of green, and your hair has turned white; you are capable of living for thousands of years.

Wraiths derive nourishment from the “life force” of humans and other living beings. Draining the life force from a living entity is a painful process, akin to torture, as it rapidly accelerates ageing and leads to death. Wraiths typically drain life force slowly, savouring the transfer; however, they can also almost instantaneously drain all the life force from a living being. You could also reverse this process and instead transfer excess life force into a human, which can even revive the dead, should you choose to do so. This transfer of life force is often employed to gain loyal worshippers.

You possess an extraordinary healing ability that is directly linked to the amount of life force you have absorbed. This life force acts as a resource for healing, enabling you to recover even from death and significantly extending your lifespan. As long as you have life force available, you can ultimately regenerate and continue living indefinitely.

All Wraiths are natural telepaths, capable of reading the minds of others and influencing their thoughts. They can provide visions of ghosts or shrouding yourself from detection. With time, you can learn to expand your telepathic abilities.

Another feature of the Wraith is their limited biokinesis, which enables them to alter the structure of living matter using life force. This ability is frequently utilized to construct their various spacecraft, including the hive ships and Wraith darts employed during their conquests in the Pegasus galaxy.
objects.title: Wraith (Stargate)

addons.text:
Now, instead of just being your run-of-the-mill Asuran, you gain the technology and capabilities of another nanotechnological race: a Mental Model of the Fleet of Fog.

While you still appear initially as just another human, your mental model now grants you the strength to jump more than 40 meters without issue, rip apart a tank with your bare hands, and move at speeds exceeding those of top Olympic athletes.

With your much more advanced Asuran nanotechnology, you do not need a Union Core—though you can craft one if you wish—your nanites' significantly greater computational power grants you an exceptionally powerful Wave-Force Armor, capable of withstanding direct nuclear strikes without significant damage.

Finally, you are capable of creating a ship-form for yourself—a hull body utilizing the best of Asuran and Fleet of Fog technology—achieving something greater than the sum of its parts.
addons.title: Mental Model

addons.text:
You now have access to the Meta-Nanites—five specialized nanites that access the Dominion Code and are capable of granting the user physical godhood.

While these tiny machines typically do not grant you their full power immediately—requiring patience and practice—with your Asuran physiology they instead bestow upon you their complete abilities to manipulate your surroundings and reality in a variety of ways, effortlessly reaching the scale of a planet.

The Purple Nanite commands Technology, the Blue Nanite controls the Elements, the White Nanite masters Gravity, the Green Nanite rules Space-Time, and the Orange Nanite governs Matter and Energy.

By default, this grants you access only to the five canonical Meta-Nanites. However, if you have access to other variants of Meta-Nanites, these can also be integrated into your new form. Any Meta-Nanites integrated into your form are impossible to detect, suppress, steal, or destroy, as your Asuran Nanoform immediately restores them from any attempted changes.
addons.title: Divinitas en Minutus Machina

objects.text:
Instead of arriving in your new world in a fleshy, biological body, you arrive in the form of an Asuran instead, with a body formed of countless microscopic nanites combining together. With your purchase here you are capable of perfectly replicating all features and abilities of an organic form. 

While they may appear like an ordinary human by default, they are much stronger than the average person, capable of sending someone flying with a simple push. Their nanite composition renders most projectile weapons useless, as bullets simply pass through their forms. Any wounds they receive almost instantly reform with no degradation to the Asuran’s overall capabilities. An Asuran is also capable of “reading” the minds of organics by utilizing the nanites that make up their body to interact with an organic brain, allowing them to flawlessly simulate environments to interrogate their targets.

One of the most insidious abilities of an Asuran is their capacity to “infect” others simply by touch. A moment of contact is enough to seed someone with nanites, which begin replicating inside their host’s body, consuming it and slowly transforming them into a new Asuran. Any Asuran you “convert” in this way will share a subspace link to the Asuran Network—less a hive mind and more a group chat—with you as the undisputed leader. This connection allows you to restore any destroyed Asuran and share updates and intelligence. This ability can also be used—albeit much slower—to recreate various forms of technology designed and built by their creators the Lanteans.

Asurans are, by their nature, very difficult to harm or kill. Most physical attacks are ineffective, and while some forms of energy can disrupt their forms—and potentially kill them—they adapt rapidly, becoming resistant or even immune to those weaknesses. The easiest way to “kill” an Asuran is to have another Asuran do it.
objects.title: Asuran (Stargate)

objects.text:
A long time ago, there was a family that had just lost their child to a werewolf. In an effort to protect their children, the mother, who was a witch, found a spell that could protect their children and the parents from ever feeling the loss again. However, she did not use the original spell and modified it twice, adding to it. You have been transformed into one of these vampires, being one of the original lines of vampires. As a creature of the night reanimated through magic, you have several powers because your physiology has changed, giving you superhuman abilities.

As an original vampire, your superhuman strength allows you to toss humans around like nothing, crush buildings to pieces, and, with enough effort, destroy an island. Depending on how old you are, your abilities could be much stronger. You also possess superhuman speed and agility, being able to move faster than human eyes can see. Even some supernatural creatures with enhanced senses can't keep up with you, and your reaction time is just as fast. Your senses have also been enhanced by being able to hear conversions from blocks away from the source, smell things from the side of a city, and see in complete darkness. Along with the super strength comes increased durability that allows you to take blows that would destroy buildings just fine and a regenerative healing factor that can heal anything within seconds, so long as you have not been beheaded. Like all vampires, you have immortality.

Besides the physical powers, you also possess mental abilities that are supernatural in nature. Being able to enter and influence the minds of others, controlling thoughts or influencing them, erasing memories, creating illusions, and more. You can sire other vampires by feeding your blood to humans; this can heal humans without turning them, though if they die they become vampires in transition, and if they feed on a human they forever turn into a vampire or die if they don't. The vampires you create are loyal to you. Vampires also possess some minor miscellaneous abilities like controlling the weather, controlling small animals like wolves or birds, manipulating elements, shutting off their own emotions, flying, and even shape-shifting. Vampires get stronger with age, and the more blood they consume, the stronger they get. The less blood they consume, the weaker they get. Vampires possess a weakness for sunlight, white oak stakes, decapitation, and vervain. The older a vampire is, the less affected they are by these weaknesses. You gain a daylight ring and the knowledge of how to create one, although you do not possess the magic needed for its creation.
objects.title: Original Vampire (Originals)

addons.text: You are the product of unholy combinations; the only other hybrid was made when the mother had an affair with a werewolf. Being the unnatural combination of the original vampire and werewolf, you have undergone a metamorphosis as your abilities are enhanced well beyond those of either supernatural species. Your strength has surpassed that of an original vampire, and you could go against an original vampire older than yourself, being able to easily destroy islands and break continents with enough effort. Your vampiric speed has combined with the speed and agility of the wolf being able to go around at speeds massively higher than hypersonic and, with effort, break into the speed of light. Beyond this, you are no longer affected by any of the normal weaknesses that other vampires face and can step into the sunlight without worrying about burning. You may also now control your werewolf side and combine the forms into one, enhancing your abilities further.
addons.title: Hybrid

objects.text: Werewolves are cursed beings that shapeshift into a large, fearsome, and extremely dangerous wolf during the night of the full moon. They were cursed by a witch as revenge for killing her tribe. Werewolves possess a supernatural strength far beyond that of humans, even when in human form, being able to match young vampires. Werewolves are vastly faster than most supernatural beings in and out of wolf form, being able to outspeed vampires who have been alive longer than one hundred years. They also possess higher durability than humans, being able to tank damage that would kill humans due to their natural durability and a superhuman healing factor; however, unlike vampires, they are mortal. A werewolf's senses are vastly more potent than those of a vampire. When transformed into a werewolf, all abilities they possess are further enhanced to a significant degree, even more so when there is a full moon, being triple strength when under a full moon and twice as strong when transformed. Werewolves possess a potent venom that is lethal to vampires and humans alike and brings hallucinations and eventually, death to all that of a normal vampire Original vampires are only slightly affected by the venom.
objects.title: Werewolf (Originals)

objects.text:
You are the result of a secret experiment that fused human and angelic DNA, creating a new hybrid species that possesses some of the traits and abilities of both. No longer are you mere human, but a Half Angel, a being that can challenge the mysterious and powerful creatures that threaten humanity’s existence.

As a Half Angel, your body and mind have been enhanced beyond human limits, granting you superhuman strength, speed, durability, intelligence, and perception. You can easily lift several tons of weight, run faster than sound, heal from most wounds in minutes, and process information at incredible rates. You also have enhanced senses that allow you to see in the dark, detect heat signatures, and use echolocation. You are a formidable opponent in any physical or mental challenge.

Furthermore, you now have the ability to generate and control an AT-Field, a powerful force field that is the manifestation of your soul. Your AT-Field is comparable to weaker Angels, such as Matarael or Shamshel, and can withstand conventional weapons and some N2 explosions. You can also shape your AT-Field into various forms, such as blades, spikes, shields, or wings. You can use your AT-Field to fly, levitate, or jump great distances. You can also use your AT-Field to attack enemies by projecting it outward or shaping it into different forms. Some examples of offensive uses of AT-Fields are slicing through objects with razor-sharp edges, crushing targets with immense pressure, or blasting enemies with beams or waves of energy.

Your AT-Field also allows you to adapt to any environment or situation by altering your physical body. For example, you can breathe underwater, survive in space, resist extreme temperatures, or camouflage yourself. You can also learn to mimic some of the abilities of other Angels such as energy blasts, regeneration, or mind probes.
objects.title: Angelic Aberration (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

addons.text:
You are the embodiment of evolution within the divine hierarchy—a being who stands as the next generation of divinity. Just as the Olympians rose to surpass the Titans, and the Titans overthrew the Primordials, so too are you destined to rise beyond the Olympians. 

When Zeus wrested power from Kronos, who took his power from Ouranos there existed a prophecy foretelling that he, too, would be overthrown by a successor, just as he had overthrown his father. Through cunning, might, and relentless determination, Zeus shattered this prophecy and secured his place as King of the Gods, ruling supreme over Olympus. His reign might have endured forever—if not for you.

You are the Next Generation. Fate and Prophecy themselves align with your ascension. The Crown of Heaven is your birthright, waiting to be claimed. Unlike the gods who came before you, your potential is unparalleled. 

You are not merely destined to match the power of Zeus; you are designed to surpass it. Where others rely on the faith and prayers of mortals to sustain their strength, you need no such crutch. Your power grows inexorably, fed by the raw essence of your divine lineage and the inevitability of your destiny.
 
Your dominion over the divine is not confined by traditional boundaries. Your Domains are vast and flexible, extending their influence far beyond the constraints placed upon other gods. 

Where others might be bound to their realms, you possess the ability to intrude upon Domains outside your control. You are immune to suppression, even in the heart of another god’s territory—a feat that defies the natural order of the divine hierarchy.

So rise! Overthrow the Lord of Heaven and seize Olympus as your own. You are the righteous successor, the herald of a new divine era. The Crown of Heaven is not merely a prize; it is your destiny.

Stand unyielding in your purpose, for no other shall ever surpass you. You are the pinnacle of divinity—the culmination of power, potential, and purpose.
addons.title: New Generation

addons.text:
In the annals of divine legend, it is well known that every god and goddess possesses a weapon or symbol that embodies their Domain and serves as an extension of their power. 

These sacred artifacts are not merely tools; they are manifestations of divine will, forged to reflect the unique essence of their wielder. Now, you too have been granted such an armament—but yours surpasses all others.

The Perfect Armament, unmatched in its versatility and power, is uniquely attuned to you. Unlike the static relics of other deities, your weapon evolves and transforms to align with the breadth of your Domains. Any other Symbol of Power you own can also be merged with this Perfect Armament and and benefit from its effects.

For each Domain under your control, the weapon reshapes itself into a form that perfectly embodies the essence of that Domain. It is as though the armament is a living aspect of your divine nature, ever-changing to suit your needs and amplify your power. 
Beyond its adaptive nature, the armament possesses another extraordinary function. It can create independent instances of every form it assumes, allowing you to arm multiple manifestations of yourself simultaneously. 

Should you choose to manifest multiple bodies, each one will wield its own version of the Perfect Armament, fully retaining its might and properties without any diminishment of power. This unique feature ensures that your strength and influence remain unparalleled, regardless of how you choose to project yourself across the cosmos.

With the Armament of the Divine in your grasp, you stand as a true embodiment of divine ingenuity and supremacy. No other deity can rival the perfect synergy between you and your armament. Whether you stand alone or command an army of your own manifestations, your power remains absolute.

Wield the armament that reflects your divinity. Dominate every Domain you claim. Let the cosmos bear witness to the unparalleled might of your divine armament.
addons.title: Armament of the Divine

objects.text:
You have become a Minor God within the Greek Pantheon. By virtue of your divine nature, the need for sleep, food, and water has become irrelevant. You also have the ability to shapeshift into different forms.

You're impervious to conventional mortal weapons and attacks. For example, a sword would require enough force to cleave an island in two just to have a chance of injuring you. Even then, such a strike would likely do little, as you possess extraordinary regenerative abilities. Grievous wounds that would be fatal to humans heal within seconds to minutes for you, and what a mortal might consider a fatal blow would feel like little more than a sharp punch to you. Though, immortal slaying weapons and divine attacks completely ignore this passive defense. 

But physical resilience is only the beginning of your power. As a Minor God, you preside over a specific domain. While it is not vast, it grants you the ability to use and create abilities and magics aligned with your domain. For example, as the god of water, you could manipulate water to raise tides, purify lakes, or even summon magical constructs of water and command sea life. This domain also allows you to bestow blessings upon others, granting them powers or abilities tied to your domain. The potency of these blessings depends on both your personal strength and the magical capacity of the recipient. They will lose these blessings if you either take them back or you die. 

Your divine strength grows through worship. You might be able to ascend to a Greater God with more domains if an entire continent's worth of people worship you. Even without followers you would still grow in power as you age.
objects.title: Divine Physiology (God of War)

objects.text:
As a result of being infused with the Diamonds' essence, you leave behind your organic, fleshy body and are transformed into an Era 1 Gem. As a Gem, you become an energy-based being, with your gemstone serving as your true body and your humanoid form acting as a projection of light imbued with mass. While your physical form can be changed at will, your gemstone remains unaltered, serving as your core identity. You may choose to become any Gem shown in the Steven Universe series, excluding a Diamond, or alternatively, create a never-before-seen Gem.

Your basic Gem abilities include shapeshifting, fusion with other Gems, regeneration, agelessness, gravity adaptation, photokinesis, gem storage, weapon manifestation and superhuman strength and durability. The strength and effectiveness of these abilities vary depending on your Gem type. In addition to these standard abilities shared by most Gems, you also possess a unique power tied to your specific gemstone. This power could range from elemental manipulation, such as controlling water or fire, to more specialized abilities like foresight or ferrokinesis. While you instinctively understand how to use your unique ability, you do not yet have full access to its potential. With practice, patience, and effort, you can achieve full mastery.

As an energy-based being, you draw power from light, effectively making you a solar-powered entity. While you do not require food, water, or air to survive, you can still partake in these activities for enjoyment. Your immunity to environmental hazards, such as extreme temperatures, radiation, and toxins, makes you well-suited for survival in even the harshest conditions. As a Gem, your existence depends on the safety of your gemstone. If your gemstone is damaged, your abilities permanently weaken unless healed, and if it is shattered, your consciousness is fragmented, killing you.

In the event of fatal damage that does not include your gem, you "poof," releasing your physical form and retreat into your gemstone to regenerate a new, undamaged body. While this process restores you, it also leaves you vulnerable, as you remain defenceless during regeneration.
objects.title: Gem (Steven Universe)

objects.text:
As a human that is half gem, you possess a unique physiology and are able to use all the standard abilities of gems. Similar to Steven, your abilities are initially dependent on your emotions. However, as you learn to hone your abilities, you can use them more naturally, no longer requiring emotions to use your unique abilities.
 
You are able to shapeshift effortlessly into anything that you desire, temporarily altering your physical form to anything that you can think of, such as transforming into a giant monster or a lion. This takes skill in order for it to be used properly, and the use of this power is initially strenuous. Through this power, you can change how old you are by being functionally immortal. Through the power of your gem, you have gained the ability to regenerate from any wound; however, unlike a normal gem, you cannot normally just ‘poof’ and transform into your gem in order to regenerate from your wounds. If you happen to be killed, then your gem would enter a dormant state and recreate your body, and so long as your gem is unharmed, you can be restored. Like other gems, you possess the ability to summon a weapon from nothing, and what this weapon is will be completely up to your desires. Each weapon is unique and specifically tailored to the personality of its wielder. These weapons can be further upgraded, but if they break, you will not be able to summon them for some time.

With your enhanced physiology comes enhanced strength beyond that of a human. In the beginning, this strength is enough to smash a car apart with your bare hands; however, as you grow in understanding your power, you can increase this strength to be able to easily shatter a continent. You also possess a supernatural durability, able to withstand being hit with a force that could easily destroy a city, and like your strength, this ability grows with your understanding of your gem nature. You also possess immunity to temperature and things that would ordinarily kill a human, such as lava, diseases, poisons, radiation, and other harmful substances. Your speed is also enhanced; initially, this speed is slightly above that of a normal human, and with training, you could slow down your own perception of reality and move faster than most man-made objects.

Like all diamonds and gems, you possess an ability that is purely unique to yourself, such as the mind control seen by white diamond, the electrical abilities seen by yellow diamond, or the emotional control seen by blue diamond. As you learn more about your abilities, you could even learn to do anything shown by any gem in the show, including Steven. You also possess the ability of fusion, being able to combine with other gems, combining your strength with the person you fuse with, and gaining new abilities. This, however, is often seen as a deeply personal experience.
objects.title: Diamond-Hybrid (Steven Universe)

objects.text:
You are the result of a sophisticated and precise process of hybridization and adaptation that has fused the best traits of Gauna and humans. You are a perfect chimera, a being that transcends the limitations of either species and possesses a harmonious and seamless blend of abilities.

Your appearance reflects your unique nature, as you combine the strengths of both Gauna and humans in your form. You have amazing healing powers that can mend any wound, telekinetic flight at hypersonic speed, continent-shattering strength, and a continuously adaptive and evolving mega-structured placental layers that allow you to survive through nearly any physical attacks, or in the most extreme conditions, such as an explosion that destroyed a gas giant without even a scratch. You also have a keen aptitude for both Gauna-like modifications and human cognitive skills.

Your body is covered by a versatile and adaptable placental layer that you have unrivaled control over. You can shape and manipulate it to create drones that can scout and spy for you, remotely operating them and receiving sensory input from them. However, using them too much will slow down your healing rate, as they consume some of your placental layer.

You also have an energy organs that emulate the Gauna's ability to store and focus different types of energy, such as heat, light, electricity, or radiation. You can use this energy reserve for various purposes, such as enhancing your physical abilities, creating energy weapons, or manipulating the environment. However, some energies can be unstable and dangerous, so you need to be careful with them. You also absorb energy from your surroundings over time, which can be beneficial or harmful depending on the type of energy.

You have a natural grasp of Gauna anatomy and physiology that gives you an edge in combat and survival. You can spot the weak points of other beings, lure and confuse them with controlled energy emissions, or exploit their vulnerabilities with precision attacks. This knowledge also applies to intelligent beings, giving you an advantage in finding their flaws and weaknesses.

One of your most powerful abilities is the power to mentally dominate other beings through physical contact, taking over their bodies for a short time. You can extend this power to multiple targets, but you need to focus to maintain control. If you lose control, the dominated beings may go berserk and attack you or others. This power can be useful for infiltration, interrogation, or manipulation.

As the apex of Gauna-human integration, you have a mega-structured placental layer that grants you incredible powers. You can grow any technology that you understand or have the blueprints of from your body. This allows you to create technology that is only theoretically possible or beyond the current level of civilization. You can also integrate technology into your body seamlessly, enhancing your capabilities even further. Your mega-structured placental layers can nullify particle-based weapons with ease, as they are automatically absorbed. Even gravity-based weapons will be less effective against you, as your advanced placental layering reduces their impact. However, don't forget that your True Core is still your weak spot, though it is very hard to reach through your formidable mega-structure layers.
objects.title: Perfect Chimera (Knights of Sidonia)

objects.text:
You have become a Festum, a silicon-based alien race that originated from another dimension, and strives to assimilate all life in the universe for eons. Through this transformation you gain the ability to have near-omnipotent control over matter and energy using your mind, and you can communicate telepathically with each other and other lifeforms.

However, your transformation is not into an ordinary Festum. You are the ultimate Festum, possessing the powers of all the different varieties of Festums. You can change your appearance at will with your shape-shifting ability, creating and using various forms of energy such as lasers, plasma, electricity, gravity, and antimatter with your energy manipulation power, and generating and utilizing various forms of matter such as metals, crystals, liquids, gases, and organic substances with your matter manipulation skill.

But above all, your core skill is assimilation, which grants you the capacity to absorb anything you touch or consume into your being, and acquire their knowledge, memories, abilities, and characteristics. You can also share what you assimilate with other Festums you create or command. You can produce new Festums from your own body or from what you assimilate with your reproduction feature, and control them with your mind and direct them to your objectives with your mind control power. You can also merge with them or split from them to adjust your power or focus.
 
You now gain an innate trait of resistance, which makes you immune to nearly any attack or damage that is not specifically designed to harm Festums. And even then, you have a natural attribute of regeneration, which enables you to recover from any injury or loss of mass rapidly. You also have a nature of immunity, which makes you unaffected by conventional weapons, diseases, poisons, radiation, and environmental hazards.

Furthermore, you have a key advantage of adaptation, which allows you to adjust to any situation or environment you encounter, and enables you to constantly learn, and evolve to acquire new skills and abilities from what you do and what you assimilate.
objects.title: The Azure Festum (Fafner In The Azure)

objects.text:
You are now a natural Werewolf, one the few beings able to keep up with an Elder True Vampire. You are equal to Millennium's trump card, known simply as "The Captain".

You possess a greatly enhanced physical condition; your superhuman strength, durability, speed, reflexes, and stamina are incredible, putting you in the same tier as Alucard and Father Anderson. You also have an enhanced regeneration factor capable of healing a completely mutilated body in seconds, only halted by the use of silver. You can turn into mist to avoid even this source of damage, strikes simply going through you, though you will still need at least a semi-permeable form if you want to attack.

You can also transform into your "Werewolf Form" fully or partially according to your preference, changing shape and enhancing your physical abilities even further. This is also compatible with your mist form.
objects.title: Der Wehrwolf (Hellsing)

addons.text:
It's not enough to be a Vampire; you want to be THE Vampire. You have absorbed the complete essence of Alucard.

This includes his memories from his youth in Romania to his visit to Integra after integrating Schrödinger's soul. This includes his skills, from being a warrior, a general, and a king, occult and sorcerous knowledge, marksmanship, and anything else he learned in his long and storied life. This includes his equipment, from dual pistols, to medieval weapons, to the HMS Demeter. This includes every soul he's ever absorbed in his six centuries of life (even those he expelled from his body during the attack on London or the millions he absorbed during his fight with Walter). The souls restore themselves if ever lost thanks to the power of Schrödinger; no soul will ever escape from you which you do not permit. Finally, this includes every ability either only seen being used by him, like intangibility, blood control, telepathy, and telekinesis, or those belonging to a soul he absorbed, such as Tubalcain Alhambra's playing cards, the raw power of Baskerville, Rip Van Winkle's magic bullets, and of course Schrödinger's immortality and teleportation.
addons.title: The Bird Of Hermes

objects.text:
You have gained the powers of a True Vampire, a powerful demon that feasts on the blood and souls of those it kills. While each vampire, when they reach a certain amount of strength, gains an ability unique to themselves, the common powers include superhuman strength, which allows you to tear apart humans as if they were wet rags and kill any man easily. If you are starved, your strength is substantially diminished and barely above that of a human of similar size. Particularly powerful vampires can eviscerate whole battalions of soldiers in a matter of minutes as well as causing considerable structural damage when at full strength. Superhuman speed and reflexes True Vampires are considerably faster than even the most trained humans. With their supernatural speed, they can appear as a flash of light to the eyes of a human being, and they can easily dodge automatic gunfire. All vampires have infinite stamina and can survive conventional attacks that would kill any ordinary person. You are generally resistant to most forms of attack, with decapitation or impaling the heart being the only exception that could kill a True vampire.
 
One of the most notable vampire abilities is drinking blood, which is the main sustenance for vampires. Consuming blood allows you to gain more strength and, as a result, become more formidable. Once you consume one's blood, the victim's soul is taken, and you gain a bunch of benefits for it, including regenerating a body part that is dismembered. You also gain the abilities of the souls that you have consumed; you gain extra lives for each soul that can take the place of the death that you would otherwise face. You may also use the souls as familiars; however, while they are outside of you, they can no longer be used to avoid death or use the abilities that they hold.
 
You can read and speak directly into the minds of those you have sucked blood from. This power is said to extend to all beings. You can also manipulate the minds of weaker-willed beings. You can create and command several different kinds of underlings, including servant vampires, familiars, and ghouls. Although for the creation of a vampire, it is required for the person to be a virgin and also of the opposite sex, those who do not fit the requirement turn into ghouls mindless zombies that you have complete control over. You also have minor shape-changing abilities that you can use to transform yourself into those you have consumed the soul of.
objects.title: Elder True Vampire (Hellsing)
Super Snooper (Super Fuzz)
objects.text:
A bizarre accident has awakened extraordinary physical and psionic potential within you, granting a remarkably broad array of superhuman abilities. 

Your body possesses immense strength, allowing you to effortlessly lift and throw automobiles, tear through steel, overpower large groups of opponents, and perform tremendous leaps. 

You can outrun speeding cars, react fast enough to evade gunfire, and endure bullets, explosions, crushing impacts, electrocution, and falls from great heights with little lasting harm. 

Your enhanced stamina and accelerated healing let you fight continuously for extended periods, while your heightened senses—including telescopic and X-ray-like vision—allow you to perceive details beyond normal human limits. 

You can also breathe underwater indefinitely and achieve controlled flight through a combination of your physical power and supernatural abilities.

Your awakened psionic powers are equally versatile. Telekinesis allows you to precisely manipulate objects ranging from small items to automobiles and even fully loaded trailer trucks, whether for combat or delicate tasks. Telepathy enables you to communicate mentally, sense nearby thoughts, and detect the intentions of others. 

Extrasensory perception grants an uncanny awareness of hidden objects, distant events, and imminent danger, often manifesting as brief flashes of precognition moments before something occurs. 

You can hypnotize individuals through focused concentration, compelling simple actions or leaving them temporarily compliant, while your heightened psychic intuition lets you make seemingly impossible deductions and instinctively understand or communicate with animals. 

Although exceptionally flexible, your psionic abilities remain local in scale, require concentration, and cannot reshape landscapes, dominate large populations, or perform the reality-altering feats of the world's most powerful psychics.

Despite the breadth of your powers, they all share a single, crippling flaw: exposure to the color red instantly suppresses every aspect of your superhuman physiology and psionic abilities. Any sufficiently vivid source—whether clothing, paint, lights, signs, or ordinary objects—reduces you to a completely normal human until the color is no longer within your sight.

addons.text: Congratulations! You have ascended above the limitations of Man and Vampire, and became a Dhampir. As the ultimate fusion of mankind and the Greater Nobility, your power and influence surpass the strongest of either. Your supernatural adaptability and evolution have been magnified to unfathomable levels. You possess the ability to adapt to any situation or opponent, gaining new abilities and strengths as needed. No numerical advantage can overcome your might, and victory is assured as long as your adversaries lack the same level of ability as you. Instead of just one improved trait, now all of your being gains a massive boost. Your strength, speed and intelligence naturally reach the pinnacle of what the Greater Nobility could ever reach, and your beauty is an epitome of grace that would captivate even the gods. Your physical body is a marvel and can be called both divine and human, capable of enduring immense punishment that could even fell the strongest Greater Nobles, while lacking all the weaknesses of normal vampires. To put it simply, you are the equal of the legendary vampire hunter D. As The Progenitor of Man your Eyes of The Lord are further enhanced. They allow you to create perfect counters by studying your enemies' original powers, abilities, and techniques, and developing mirror opposite powers that neutralize them. This follows the Dualism Theory of man, ensuring that your chance of victory never goes below 50% regardless of the situation or enemy faced. Additionally, as more enemies gather against you, your strength increases exponentially, making it impossible for anyone to defeat you unless they possess abilities equal to yours.
addons.title: The Ascendant Dhampir

objects.text:
Congratulations! By acquiring this power, you ascend to the esteemed status of a Greater Noble Vampire, an elite lineage that has reigned over both humankind and vampire-kind for countless millennia. As a Greater Noble, your attributes receive a massive boost, including a truly impressive immortality that that would baffle even gods, restoring your physical body from any injury by warping space-time itself. Your powers far surpass those of ordinary vampires, and even the traditional weaknesses of your kind hold little sway over you. You can be atomized and still return to the realm of the living, fully intact and with all your possessions in pristine condition. Only exposure to sunlight, a stake through the heart, or by negating your immortality can other even begin to pose a threat to your existence, however with all these gifts comes the thirst for blood.

But that's not all—your chosen attribute, be it strength, speed, or intelligence, undergoes an unprecedented augmentation. The boost is so immense that it surpasses even the capabilities of other Greater Nobles. With enhanced speed, you can traverse vast distances in an instant, leaving infinity in your wake. Opting for strength empowers you to effortlessly create chasms as deep as the Mariana Trench with a single, unintentional swing of your sword. And if you select intelligence, your mind blazes brighter than the sun, far surpassing even the most brilliant geniuses. Additionally, your intellect grants you immunity to mind control, and illusions become mere child's play for you to decipher and overcome.
objects.title: The Greater Nobility (Vampire Hunter D)

addons.text:
You are no longer a mere Second Progenitor; you now have the complete essence of the First Progenitor Sika Madu, better known by his demon name, Shikama Doji.

You have all of the memories and abilities of this being who was the paragon of vampires, demons, & Seraphs all at once, as well as that of his son (who he personally created from divine Light) Mikaela, and his son's human vessel in the modern day, Mikaela Hyakuya.

This includes their mastery of magic and science, every ability ever displayed or potentially available to any of the aforementioned species, & the equipment fit for a being that contested God.
addons.title: The First (Seraph Of The End)

objects.text:
You are now a Vampire with power equivalent to the Vampiric Progenitors, the nobility of the Vampire race.

Specifically, you're equivalent to a Second Progenitor like Saito or Urd, who are so fast they can effortlessly dodge and catch gunfire or the attacks of lesser Progenitors, or even reach a building on the other side of a city in a split second, agility great enough to dodge missiles shot at you in mid-air or leap tall buildings, strength enough to rip even other powerful vampires to shreds or create massive craters with your bare hands, resilience enough to continue fighting equally with a group of lesser Progenitors even with most of your body destroyed, and with regeneration great enough that the only way to capture you would require your entire skeleton to be smashed to bits first just to slow you down for long enough, with dismemberment and decapitation only being annoyances.

Your senses are far superior to any human or animal, able to see right through illusions, see things enormous distances away even in pitch black darkness, hear stealth helicopters from miles away or tell what's going on in a city sized area, hunt purely by smell, and even detect things such as demons with a "sixth sense".

You're also granted the basic equipment of a Vampire, with a uniform, a wristband or ring that prevents you from burning up in the sun, and a First-Class Vampire Weapon of your choice. Given your similarity to Saito, you may have his modifications as well.
objects.title: Vampiric Progenitor (Seraph Of The End)

objects.text:
Similar to Alexander Corvinus, you too have been infected with a virus that would ordinarily kill an average mortal; however, through some genetic fluke or some other source, your body has mutated the virus into being more beneficial than harmful. Similar in nature to the variation of the virus that Alexander Corvinus gave to his children, yours is in flux. Your strain will accept any DNA that has been transferred into your system, enhancing the virus to be even stronger than before. The strain is ever-evolving; the longer you live, the more the virus will change in ways that are beneficial for your continued existence.

Without any modifications, the virus gives you several abilities well beyond those of an ordinary human, such as immortality, eternal life free of any disease, and immunity to the effects of aging and poison. The virus also provides an accelerated healing factor that allows for almost instantaneous regeneration, so long as you don't have your entire body disintegrated all at once to an atomic level. You possess a supernatural strength that can destroy buildings with ease. Supernatural speed that, even with enhanced senses, looks like teleportation, as well as enhanced control of speed, additionally grants you the ability to react to things and see the world as though it were slowed down. Enhanced durability and endurance enable you to get shot at and get right back up, or have a building thrown at you like it was nothing.

Through the evolution of your virus, you can gain a myriad of abilities, such as the ability to read memories through blood, the ability to read the minds of others, and more, as your strain of the virus evolves beyond its current strength. As mentioned earlier, if you gain the DNA of any being in your blood, your virus will react and give you abilities based on the creature. Such as gaining standard vampiric abilities from the DNA of a bat or the abilities of a werewolf from the DNA of a wolf able to transform into a wolf-like creature. Your virus seems to want to combine everything it comes across to evolve to new heights.
objects.title: Corvinus Strain (Underworld)

addons.text:
Your Gourmet Cells awaken within you, integrating into your body and becoming a foundation in your future evolutions, turning into a set of powerful talents.

[Endless Appetite]
After consuming a Lifeform, you gain 20 – 100 permanent attribute points randomly distributed across stats based on the target’s strengths, and +24 – 96 to maximum Energy. Repeated consumption of similar Lifeforms will significantly reduce these gains. There is a low chance to obtain one Talent or Specialty related to the consumed target (rarity and success rate depend on target strength).

[Gourmet Assimilation]
When dealing damage, restore 10% of damage dealt as HP and 5% as Energy. For every 10% HP the target has lost, these effects are increased by 50%, up to 5 times the base effect. This effect lasts until the end of battle and is reset upon exiting combat.

[Metabolic Overdrive]
Your body can enter a high-consumption state at will. By burning your Energy and Stamina, you convert them into a metabolic surge that enhances your body. This increases your basic attributes, attack, Critical Rate, regeneration, and ability strength depending on the amount of Energy and Stamina consumed after every judgement. The duration is equal to the time you maintain this consumption. After this ability ends, you enter a weakened state that lasts three times the duration of the ability.

[Gourmet Lifeform Physique]
Your Gourmet Cells continuously enhance and reinforce your body with overwhelming life force, greatly improving your physical capabilities. +25% STR, +25% END, +20% AGI, +20% to all resistances, and +15% Stamina. Your senses are significantly enhanced, improving reaction speed and perception.

Your Gourmet Cells further strengthen your body as you grow.
Lv1 – Lv100: Every 10 levels, +2% Max HP, +1.5% Max Energy, +1.5% Stamina, +1% Damage Efficiency, +1 END to HP conversion.
Lv101 – Lv200: Every 10 levels, +3% Max HP, +2% Max Energy, +2% Stamina, +1.5% Damage Efficiency, +2 END to HP conversion.
Lv201 and above: Every 10 levels, +4% Max HP, +2.5% Max Energy, +2.5% Stamina, +2% Damage Efficiency, +3 END to HP conversion.

As you have gained Gourmet Cells, you produce Appetite Energy, the fundamental energy of the universe that embodies good taste, the desire for food, and even life force that drives the evolution of life. With the acquisition of Appetite Energy, your evolutionary potential has been magnified exponentially. You can use the Appetite Energy of your Gourmet Cells as a secondary resource during evolution, acting as a reserve that can be expended to stabilize, speed up, enhance, and redirect or even control your evolutionary outcomes. When present, it vastly improves the breadth and quality of evolutionary choices and removes the risk of unstable mutations and death during evolution and ascending the hierarchy of life. 

Additionally, the risks of consuming genetic enhancing or modifying items become virtually nonexistent, and any side effects are greatly mitigated as if you have perfect compatibility. There are still normal diminishing returns when repeatedly using the same enhancer however.
addons.title: Gourmet Cell Lifeform

objects.text: You have been injected with Gourmet cells. Gourmet Cells are physical embodiment of savoriness and Appetite Energy, the source of life and all known ingredients. You gain overwhelming life force, extremely increased physical strength, speed, athleticism, stamina, endurance, and senses. Eating unique food may also lead to useful adaptations. The more abundant and delicious your diet, the greater effect gourmet cells will have. This also gives you enough luck to easily find rare ingredients for cooking and a talent to cook dishes delicious enough to make Satan weep.
objects.title: Gourmet Cells (Toriko)

addons.text:
It seems more has been implanted in your mind than a tadpole, as you have now received the technical knowledge on how to replicate many of the creations of the ilithid race.
  
  These may be items that store, enhance, or alter thoughts and emotions, like Resonance Stones or Thought Extruders. As psionic powers are extensions of these thoughts and emotions, you can use similar devices to augment your abilities.
 
 You can make servitors like the body-snatching Intellect Devourers, the hive-minded Cranium Rats, and shape-shifting Oblex. Although without a supply of illithid tadpoles, you are unable to create some of the more powerful creatures.
 
 You also know how to both brainwash and biologically modify thralls. In ways such as bombarding their minds with false emotions and memories, overwriting even the idea of rebellion from them. Implanting the necessary biological augmentations to fulfill their duties, whatever they may be.
 
 Lastly, you know how to pilot and create the dimension-traveling ships known as the Nautiloids.
addons.title: Illithid Artifice

objects.text:
You are undergoing the process of ceremorphosis, which will gradually change your body into that of an Illithid, a sadistic race of aberrations feared by sentient creatures on many worlds across the multiverse due to their powerful psychic abilities. Inside your brain wriggles a tadpole, which has seemingly undergone a change from its normal behavior. Due to this change, or perhaps due to some other force, you won't be affected by ceremorphosis like normal and will get to keep your normal personality and soul.

Through gaining the tadpole, your brain has already been altered, initially allowing for the use of abilities that others would find unnatural. The first psionic ability that you have developed would be Authority, mentally dominating those who have a weaker psionic presence than yours, delving in and out of their memories, and changing things for better or worse. The second psychic ability that you have gained is telepathy.

As your psychic abilities grow stronger, the more access you gain to the various abilities that being an Illithid grants. Such as the ability to create black holes or change into a displacer beast. Eventually, with enough time, your tadpole will fully evolve, letting you transcend into an Illithid form. This form allows you to access the full might of an Illithid being able to go toe to toe against an evolved elder brain and mentally dominate it. This also comes with a hunger for brains that will enhance your psychic ability.
objects.title: True Soul (Baldur's Gate 3)

objects.text: "The Lord of Murder shall perish, but in his doom he shall spawn a score of mortal progeny. Chaos will be sewn from their passage." You are no longer just a regular mortal, as you carry the divine blood and essence of the God of Murder within you. As one of many children conceived through Bhaal’s scheme to persist beyond his death, you carry a divine spark of the Lord of Murder within you. You live far longer than a normal mortal, with the blood of a god letting your life stretch into centuries if you were once human, or even longer if you were not. As a demigod of murder, you have become vastly better at the concept of bloodshed and murder, finding it easier to grasp any skill that has anything to do with the above. Your learning rate is also boosted; you learn most things twice as fast as normal, and double that if it relates to your Bhaal’s portfolio(s) or domain(s). You are not constrained by the mortal limits normal people have, as you hold a divine spark. You could also grow further and maybe become a true god should you gain enough divine power and worshippers. You possess a talent for murder, capable of slaying those traditionally unkillable. Your attacks bypass defences that would otherwise grant immortality or invulnerability. As you hold the divine spark of murder, even conceptually immortal beings become mortal within your grasp. This does not negate their powers; it renders them susceptible to your lethal intent. Furthermore, you can transform into the Slayer form, similar to that of Bhaal’s avatar on the mortal plane, the Lord of Murder. The Slayer form doubles all your abilities and turns you into a rage monster. This form is truly monstrous. The Slayer form lasts a few hours initially but can be trained further. As a Bhaalspawn, you face a singular weakness: a persistent urge to murder that infiltrates your dreams. While these whispers seek to compel your actions, Bhaal’s influence wanes outside the Forgotten Realms; with sufficient willpower, you can resist these dark compulsions.
objects.title: Dark Urge (Baldur's Gate 3)

objects.text:
You are a descendant of William Black, one who has the blood of an Archon that is as pure as William Black's blood. By being an archon, you have gained the ability to use all three Hero traits: Strength, Skill, and Will.

When you do something related to one of the Hero Traits, the trait becomes more potent. If it's Strength, you become stronger, more vigorous, and faster. If it's Skill, you can become skilled at unnatural rates, become faster, and more stealthy. And finally, if it's Will, your magic reserves increase and you seemingly become more knowledgeable.

Magic, the act of William. With Will, you can do a variety of things, like casting a fireball, lightning, and blasting the area surrounding you with a wave of fire. Or if you want to have more physical spells, then you will find yourself being able to use things like a Physical shield, which surrounds you with a protective sphere of energy that will absorb all damage at the expense of Will.

There are many things Will can do, but note that some spells have a moral inclination, meaning that you cannot master and go further with some spells. For example, some spells like healing, would require you to be morally a good person, and draining the life out of someone will require you to be a morally terrible person.
objects.title: Archon (Fable - The Lost Chapters)

objects.text:
Like Samus your DNA has been modified with Chozo genetics. Your physical abilities are now above the human peak, letting you run and jump in ways that would put an Olympian to shame. Your muscles are denser and more efficient than a regular human, making you much stronger and more durable, and your senses, particularly your eyesight, are greatly enhanced.

But that's not all. You have also had the DNA of a Metroid bonded to your genetic code. In addition to resistance to energy weapons and attacks, you can also absorb any energy you come in contact with, which will heal and nourish you. Particularly, you can consume the life energy of a living organism in seconds, leaving a desiccated husk behind. Be aware however, you have also inherited the Metroids weakness to cold, and will be weakened heavily by it. Also, rare and exotic energy sources may cause unexpected mutations resulting in new abilities. This has also had the minor side effect of making you nearly immune to disease and parasites.
objects.title: The Hunter (Metroid)

objects.text:
You are now the equal of the Queen of Blades herself, Sarah Kerrigan. You are durable enough to endure tank shells and barely flinch, strong enough to fling those same tanks around like toys, and fast enough to dodge being shot at by those tanks in the first place, and cross a battlefield in seconds. Additionally, you have a fantastic regeneration ability, being able to heal in seconds from almost anything, though this can be overwhelmed if enough damage is taken in a short amount of time. Finally, you also possess a pair of organic blades that are sharp enough to cut through almost anything.

But it's not just your body that has been enhanced. You are now a psychic of incredible power. You can make yourself invisible, have telepathy so powerful it takes effort to not read someone's surface thoughts, telekinesis strong enough to lift tanks and crumple them easily, and at the upper level, create city sized psionic storms that rip apart anything within them at the molecular level.

Finally, you have the most important ability the Zerg possess. Your body is in a constant state of evolution, always making small adjustments to make itself stronger and more efficient, making you more resistant to things that harm you, and occasional mutations to give you new and useful abilities. This is a relatively slow process but you can massively improve your ability to evolve by consuming the biological essence of others. By doing this, you can not only evolve faster, but can also incorporate useful traits your prey possesses.

You can choose whether you have the biological armor or still appear human, a form that's between the two, or simply shapeshift it on and off at will.
objects.title: Queen of Blades (StarCraft)

addons.title: False Xel’naga (Starcraft)
addons.text:
You become a hybrid of Protoss and Zerg, embodying the immense power that comes from uniting the two races. Your physical abilities are elevated to an extraordinary degree, allowing you to effortlessly keep pace with beings as powerful as Kerrigan after her transformation on Zerus and to pose a genuine threat even to warriors of her caliber. Your psionic abilities are enhanced in equal measure, making feats such as gravity manipulation, plasma projection, teleportation, and even self-duplication second nature.

Yet your transformation is imperfect. Unlike a true Xel’naga, the Zerg’s Purity of Essence and the Protoss’ Purity of Form have not fully harmonized within you. As a result, you cannot draw equally upon both at all times. Instead, you must choose which aspect of your nature to emphasize, causing your body to shift toward a form that is predominantly Zerg or predominantly Protoss. Each form grants greater access to the strengths of its respective heritage while diminishing the influence of the other. You can transition between these forms with relative ease, adapting yourself to the demands of any situation.

objects.text:
You have become a Protoss, one of the two races chosen by the Xel’naga to carry on the Infinite Cycle. Standing three meters tall, you possess strength and speed that far surpass those of most species, with the power to lift up to 10 metric tons. Your body can sustain itself on nothing more than light, water, and oxygen, and you can endure long periods without light when necessary. Your senses allow you to identify individuals by scent and see with exceptional clarity in low-light conditions.

The Protoss are best known, however, for their extraordinary psionic potential—the trait the Xel’naga called the Purity of Form. Your mind operates at an astonishing level, capable of processing multiple lines of thought and countless possible outcomes within a single second. Your psionic aptitude eclipses that of most Protoss, making telepathy and mind reading as natural as speaking. Beyond that, your powers can manifest in countless ways, including generating protective shields, empowering tools and weapons, unleashing devastating psionic blasts, and even materializing, manipulating, or fusing matter through sheer force of will. Your psionic potential is on par with legends like Tassadar and Zeratul.

Finally, you may choose the Protoss faction from which you originate, determining the psionic disciplines to which you have the greatest natural affinity. The Khalai excel in defensive techniques and utility-focused abilities. The Nerazim wield the Void to master stealth, deception, and unparalleled mobility. The Tal’darim specialize in overwhelming offensive power, drawing strength by siphoning the energy of others.
