Your chosen faction influences your talents but does not limit your potential. History has shown that exceptional Protoss, such as Tassadar and Artanis, were able to wield both the Khala and the Void, demonstrating that mastery of multiple traditions is entirely possible.
objects.title: Protoss (Starcraft)

objects.text:
You've become a Seedrian, a race of aliens who resemble mobians, but with features derived from plants and dinosaurs. Unlike the rest of your species, you can wield the abilities of both genders simultaneously. Also, regardless of your actual gender, you can model yourself with features from both. 

From the males, you have superhuman strength, speed, and durability comparable to Sonic and friends, which can be pushed several magnitudes further by transforming into a dinosaur. In this form, you can easily tower anywhere from 10 to 50 feet tall, shred through entire battleships and tank their strongest missiles with ease. You don't suffer the potential for death from this, though constant usage and overexertion can make you exhausted.

From the females, you gain an empathic connection to all plants, allowing you to extend your senses through them, use telepathy, and perform various feats of Plant Manipulation, like Cosmo's vines. By deepening this connection, you can attune to your world's Planet Egg—it's very "soul". From this, you can directly communicate with the planet itself or all who dwell on it, your abilities are further enhanced, and can achieve worldwide cosmic awareness. If this connection is broken, you lose these benefits. 

As a bonus, you gain Cosmo's ability to gracefully glide through the air, and a great affinity for nature powers.
objects.title: Seedrian (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
You've become the closest thing the Sonic universe can classify as demons, a Zeti. You stand taller, stronger, and better than the average mobian, who can challenge Sonic himself or one of his friends in single combat, and trade even blows or give them a hard time. As well as a lifespan the measures in the thousands.

Through sheer strength and durability, you can rival Knuckles or Shadow on your own, shrug off blows from either easily, endure extreme fatigue, are highly resistant to pain and other aliments, and have willpower to keep going in spite of them. You have the innate ability to manipulate magnetic fields, which can be used to bend all machines and technology to your will, with just a gesture. This can be used to disable security, create malfunctions, overwrite system functions, or attracting objects derived from technology like metals. This is absolute regardless of protections.

More importantly, you have a unique set of powers based on your personality and overall design as a Zeti. You can choose to inherit the powers from one of the Deadly Six, or create your own. These include Zavok's gigantificaion and firebreathing; Zor's umbrakinesis and cloning; Zeena's energy whips; Zik's telekinesis and martial genius; Zomon's durability and burrowing; or Zazz's speed and energy projection.

Note: You can alter your physical abilities to focus on other attributes like acrobatics, speed, reflexes, defense, healing, etc. The default template simply makes you comparable to Zavok, the leader and strongest member of the Deadly Six.
objects.title: Zeti (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
You've become a member of the Black Arms, a race of biologically immortal aliens who seek to conquer other planets to feed on their lifeforce and advance their own kind. You are free from the shackles that bind you to them, and would be the default leader if your race wasn't extinct, thus making you the Host of the Black Arm's Hivemind.

Your physical form is similar to either Eclipse the Darkling or Shadow the Hedgehog, thus being comparable to them in physical ability, manipulating Chaos Energy, and can perform the same moves as them—like the Homing Attack or Spindash. Though you can choose to alter your appearance to resemble native members of your race, like a standard Black Arms Soldier, one of the giants, or look like it's progenitor, Black Doom. Speaking of him, as the new leader of the Black Arms, you gain all of his powers.

From shapeshifting that alters your size, add or reduce biomass, create autonomous extensions of yourself and change your shape into forms like Doom's Eye; Induce a psychic link that connects targets to the Black Arms Hivemind, thus bending them to your will, communicate via telepathy, or inflict psychic damage to them; Levitation to float above the ground or flight equal to your ground speed; Intangibility to phase through objects; Illusion Projection on a scale that recreates memories, or change the environment to the point of replicating the zero gravity of space; And manipulate energy in the form of slashes, fire, and meteors.

As a bonus, you gain a great affinity for psychic and chaotic powers.
objects.title: Black Arms Hybrid (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
The blood of Draculae herself flows through you, providing speed enough to be nothing but a blur, the durability and regeneration to absorb gunshot after gunshot, and eternal life in your prime to boot. Channeling the Elsewhere through your new form also lets you fire projectiles made of it, of varying strength and appearance. The only way you can be harmed for a long time is to be stabbed with a wooden stake, but even this will take multiple stakes and a small army’s worth of conventional damage to finally kill you.

The Soulsblood also gives you a side benefit, allowing you to create monsters by warping people with your blood. Ravenous ghouls and werewolves at the lowest investment, being given a few drops of your blood, slowly increasing to animate statues, and grotesque ‘burnt men’ made from dozens of corpses each. Unless you specifically give someone your soul blood, they will never become a vampire.

Due to your connection to the Elsewhere beneath the world, you can use it to the full extent of Draculae. The Elsewhere has myriad purposes, providing resources from seemingly nowhere and creatures and places from your memory. Even unconsciously, the Elsewere will lengthen locations with these memories. A childhood home stitched with your old school, toyed and recombined, ordered only by the humor of the Elsewhere itself.

Being immortal enhances everything you are and everything you were. You’ll have time to become cruel and lonely. You’ll have time to let your scars fade. In the end, destiny is yours.
objects.title: You Keep Going (El Paso Elsewhere)

objects.text:
The blood of Valyria is strong in you granting you the potential of its members in their prime:
You are supernaturally beautiful like all members of House Targaryen and if you want may have silver-gold hair and violet-purple eyes. You have talent in Swordsmanship and a keen military mind on the level of Aegon the Conqueror, Daemon Targaryen, and Aemon the Dragonknight, the wisdom of Jaehaerys I and maester Aemon Targaryen and the charisma of Daenerys Targaryen.

Like Daenerys, you are resistant to heat and immune to conventional fire. You have an affinity to anything related to blood and fire and your blood may be a potent ingredient for magic.

You will also have Dragon dreams, a premonition-like dream ability often involving dragons, but be careful how you interpret them else they may lead you astray.

And finally, you may gain a Valyrian steel sword of your choice and a freshly hatched dragon bonded to you.
If you take care of it well, it might even surpass Balerion the Black Dread in size in its lifetime.
objects.title: House of the Dragon (A Song of Ice and Fire)

addons.text:
Instead of the monstrous White Walkers from the show, you are now one of the fae-like Other of the books, regaining the traits and abilities that were reduced, altered, or removed. As an Other, you are tall and gaunt, but not emaciated or grotesque, with skin pale as milk and possessing an inhuman, elegant, yet dangerous beauty. In addition to greater strength, you now also have inhuman speed and grace, your tread leaving no traces in the snow.

You gain incredible artisanship with ice, turning what was once crude craftsmanship into fine and detailed works, seemingly delicate yet effortlessly deflecting steel or cutting through chain-mail as if it were silk. You can manipulate ice in ways incomprehensible, giving it mystical properties, letting you create things like reflective armor that shifts color with every step and camouflages its wearer perfectly at anything but the closest of ranges, and, with a lot of time and effort, even create living ice to shape into constructs to mold creatures such as ice dragons larger than the Targaryen ones and with a breath of extreme cold.

You gain an ice spider mount, and can choose if it will be a living creature or a construct of living ice.
addons.title: Other (A Song of Ice and Fire)

objects.text:
You are an Other, more commonly known as a White Walker, a human reborn through ancient and inhuman magic. White Walkers look very human but have gaunt, greyish-white skin, pure white hair, and glowing pale blue eyes. As a White Walker, your body is no longer shackled by mortal limits, such as being physically stronger than humans, being extremely durable, not aging, not needing to breathe, eat, drink, or sleep, and immunity to diseases and fatigue. You are also functionally immortal and can only be killed through specific methods. However, if damaged, your body requires hibernation to slowly heal itself.

Additionally, as a White Walker, you have a very powerful affinity for the cold, necromancy, and ice magic. This is to such an extent that, through ice magic alone, you can form a crystal sword that is cold enough to shatter steel and bronze on a hit, sharp enough to easily decapitate a man, and potentially strong enough to pierce the hide and scales of Dragons. You are also a herald of winter; now you are not only immune to the cold, but your mere presence brings winter's chill. This is to such a level that the cold you radiate naturally can extinguish fire, making you highly resistant to all but the most extreme heat.

Lastly, your most powerful gift is the ability to revive the dead as Wights. You can revive anything that has died and command absolute servitude, but you cannot revive bodies that have burned. Once raised, Wights do not decay further, can control severed limbs remotely, and accurately obey your commands. However, they are destroyed instantly when exposed to intense heat or fire.

Despite your new body's many abilities, you will crack and fall apart if exposed to powerful fire magic, heat strong enough to bypass your natural cold aura, or stabbed with obsidian or any other highly fire-attuned material.
objects.title: White Walker (A Song of Ice and Fire)

addons.text:
Your chakra and your Sirius blood have made an interesting combination. Firstly, you will gain knowledge and mastery of all Inuzuka techniques, jutsu, and family taijutsu. Second, and more importantly, the deepest recesses of your Sirius blood have been given form through a wolf summon. This summon diminishes the mental effect your beast blood has on you to almost zero while still allowing you to tap into its power. The effect of your Sirius Blood enhancement is also empowered when performing cooperation ninjutsu with your new ninkin. 

Your summoned ninkin is semi-immortal, with it being able to regenerate even after death through you and your bloodline while also having the ability to grow along with you. As a result of naturally being one, your wolf innately knows your intentions, allowing you to perfectly coordinate anywhere and instantly. Naturally, this wolf is pure white with shining blue eyes, but that may change based on your other abilities.

You may also make summoning scrolls connected to your ninken, allowing others to summon your wolf.
addons.title: Inuzuka Blood

objects.text:
You are from an ancient werewolf race called the Sirius. Through interbreeding with humans, your race has lost its ability to transform but has enhanced physical characteristics and good instincts. Your race as a whole are ancient enemies of vampires, and as a result, your sense of smell is especially attuned to blood, and you have near-perfect night vision. 

Alongside your enhanced characteristics, you have the ability to undergo a slight transformation, with your eyes turning a bright, shiny blue and your blood veins near your eyes glowing a bright blue. Through this transformation, you can call upon your werewolf characteristics, supernaturally enhancing your physical characteristics, but the more power you draw from this state, the more beast-like you start to act. There is a limit to the amount of power your beast-like state can draw. 

The beast-like state is more effective the more powerful your physiology is, but there are diminishing returns. Optionally, you can have Yulily's 3-section staff with intermediate-level mastery.
objects.title: Sirius (Sirius the Jaeger)

objects.text: What an anomalous existence you've come to be. Something that, by all rights, should not exist and absolutely would not have—had it not been for the folly of Man. You now possess the same powers and (un)natural abilities as Shin Godzilla, becoming a skyscraper-sized, vaguely lizard-like kaiju with a grotesque appearance, clocking in at a height of nearly 120 meters, or nearly 390 feet. Optionally, you can keep your current form and forgo the Kaiju form entirely. Alternatively, you may choose to keep your current form but have the ability to call upon your Kaiju form and transform at will. Regardless of your choice, you will have full access to everything this power has to offer. Your body is immune to most modern conventional weaponry and will rapidly regenerate if injured. Your blood is superheated and extremely hot, burning and melting anything it comes into contact with. You are a walking nuclear reactor, constantly generating energy, which can be charged and fired from your mouth as a single beam of energy, capable of effortlessly slicing through blocks of skyscrapers. Additionally, you may shoot multiple beams from the dorsal plates on your back or a singular beam from the end of your tail. You can also produce a cloud of smoke that can be ignited into a thermal flame from your mouth at will, spreading fast enough to burn entire city blocks in less than a minute. All of this is thanks to your body's constant state of evolution. You are constantly changing and adapting to your environment and your own abilities. You will quickly develop resistance to things that harm you and new abilities to combat these threats as well. If parts of your body are separated from you, they won't lose this ability, regenerating and evolving into their own being. The original Shin Godzilla went from a mutated amphibious creature to the same tower of organic terror that you are now over the course of a few days, and you share this prodigious rate of growth. Eventually, over countless years of growth and evolution, you could become something akin to a ‘living universe', as the original might have, had it not been stopped. This constant mutation puts your body under extreme duress; fortunately, you won't experience constant agony like the original.
objects.title: A God Incarnate (Godzilla Franchise)

addons.text:
Your biological nuclear reactor has undergone a mutation, triggered by the immense bioenergy that surges within you. The radiation you now emit is laced with this force—no longer a mere catalyst for growth, but an agent of accelerated evolution.

Flora and fauna exposed to this transformed energy no longer just thrive—they evolve. Rapidly. They acquire not only the traits and forms found in the world of monster hunters, but also those drawn from titanic beings once thought impossible.

Trees reach titanic proportions, their trunks as hard as diamond. Some bear fruit that induces aggressive cellular growth, others emit spores that override survival instincts.
Predators take to the skies on wings that generate kinetic shockwaves with each beat. Others prowl with hyperdense musculature, leaving craters with every movement as they absorb the new ambient energy you emit, fueling their frenzied assaults.

This energy now seeps into the land you walk upon, embedding itself in the very soil and in every lifeform it touches. Any creature or plant that absorbs it begins to radiate this energy themselves—lesser in quality than your own, but still transformative in effect.

Humans are not naturally receptive to this force through direct exposure, but those who consume plants or beasts imbued with your evolved energy may begin to display signs of passive absorption, unlocking dormant traits or accelerating physical development.
 
Even minerals are not immune.
Ore veins, crystals, and geological structures exposed to this energy for long periods may transmute into entirely new substances, reactive or stable depending on the saturation and duration of exposure. Some become organic-conductive compounds; others, volatile cores waiting to be harvested or weaponized.

(Note: The energy you emit is now partially influenced by what you consume. By consuming highly mutated or charged creatures, minerals, or flora like Mana, your inner core can mimic or mutate further, altering the composition and function of your radiation over time.)
addons.title: Evolution Catalyst Core

objects.text:
You are the equal of the King of Monsters himself—Godzilla. Now, a towering, saurian-like daikaiju, you stand nearly 120 meters (roughly 400 feet) tall, an unstoppable force of nature. Amphibious by design, you thrive just as easily in the ocean's crushing depths as on the tallest peaks on land.

Your strength is immense—able to lift over a hundred tons with ease. And with a body that's nearly impervious to conventional weaponry, capable of shrugging off even a direct nuclear explosion. Only another kaiju of a similar size and strength or esoteric weapons designed to bypass durability—such as the Entities' Sting or the Oxygen Destroyer—pose a real threat to you. Even then, you can keep fighting through severe injuries, and your healing factor ensures that you'll quickly recover if given time and have the opportunity to rest.

Beyond sheer physicality, you are a walking nuclear reactor of raw, untamed energy. Radiation flows through you like blood, constantly fueling your immense power. It sustains you, accelerates your healing, and replenishes your strength. When exposed to large amounts in a short period of time, this energy pushes you past your natural limits, making you stronger, tougher—elevating you to greater heights, triggering an evolution that reshapes you into a more powerful form. In the face of death, a massive influx of radiation could even pull you back from the brink.

You can also weaponize this power, unleashing a devastating atomic breath capable of drilling through the earth or releasing a massive nuclear pulse to vaporize anything in your vicinity.

Despite your radioactive nature, the energy you emit isn't destructive to life. Instead, it promotes growth—plants thrive where you walk, and animals grow stronger in your presence.

If you prefer, you can either retain your human form while still gaining these powers, become a human-sized kaiju, or exist as a hybrid of both. Alternatively, you can treat your kaiju form as a Changer state, allowing you to shift between forms at will. Furthermore, you can choose for your appearance to be like one of the other versions of Godzilla that exist, even some combination of those, instead of the Monsterverse version. This won't affect your abilities, just your appearance.
objects.title: King of Monsters (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become the Fire Demon himself, Rodan. You are a humongous bio-volcanic pterosaurian daikaiju, standing at 46.9 meters with a wingspan of 265.5 meters.

Your physical capabilities are truly impressive. Despite your size, your speed and maneuverability allow you to reach Mach 2.5 in flight and perform maneuvers like an aileron roll. As a side-effect, it creates cyclonic drift streams capable of leveling entire cities instantly. Your body's durability grants you extraordinary resistance to extreme heat, allowing you to comfortably hibernate in magma. You are immune to conventional weaponry, making you incredibly difficult for non-alpha kaiju to harm. Even wounds like a gaping hole in your shoulder barely affect you.

Also, your Titan physiology allows you the ability to feed on all forms of radiation and grow stronger from it, while emitting your own form of unique radiation that is beneficial to and promotes life.

Beyond your physical prowess, you are considered bio-volcanic for a reason—your internal magma system. This system is a raging furnace within you, a river of molten rock reaching 1,200°C that courses through your very being. It leaks out from the ends of your wings, a fiery offense that burns with the intensity of a thousand suns. Furthermore, you possess the unique capacity to trigger volcanic eruptions simply by flying over them. Your presence alone sets the earth ablaze.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Fire Demon (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You are now a colossal extraterrestrial daikaiju, a three-headed dragon of unmatched proportions.

Standing proudly at a towering height of 160 meters, you are among the largest titans ever recorded. Your wingspan stretches an impressive 400 meters, and your formidable weight registers at a staggering 141 thousand tons, establishing you as the undisputed apex predator wherever you roam. Yet, your extraordinary physiology extends far beyond mere size and unmatched physical strength.

Your consciousness is divided among three heads, affording you the option to control them collectively, sharing thoughts and sensations seamlessly, or to govern each head individually, granting the other heads distinct personalities where you can instantaneously communicate with them telepathically.

But your evolutionary design is a testament to magnificence, as your abilities are not only numerous but overwhelmingly potent. You wield Meteorokinesis and electrokinesis, and from each of your three mouths, you unleash yellow gravity beams capable of disintegrating even the most resilient of materials. Clad in golden scales and possessing remarkable durability, you could withstand nuclear blasts with minimal harm, while your prodigious regenerative abilities can mend decapitated heads and grievous wounds in mere seconds. You are impervious to the ravages of time, thriving for millions of years without growing frail, and only growing stronger, you also do not require oxygen to survive. You are also able to absorb and consume energy further enhancing your abilities and general stats.

Your only true vulnerability lies in the simultaneous atomization of all three heads, preventing your consciousness from transferring to another part of your body for regeneration. Each of your heads boasts razor-sharp teeth capable of piercing the sturdiest armor, delivering a paralyzing venom at your command, an agile but powerful prehensile twin tails with retractable spikes on the ends. Your flight speeds can reach approximately Mach 1, propelled by immensely powerful wings capable of generating hurricanes with a single sweep.

if you want, you can choose to simply gain these powers and remain human, or be a human sized kaiju instead, or some hybrid between the two. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into. Additionally, you can choose for your appearance to be like one of the other versions of Ghidorah that exist, even some combination of those, instead of the Monsterverse version. This won't affect your abilities, just your appearance.

You are an apex predator, an alpha titan whose mere presence and piercing alpha roar commands submission from all who dare oppose your might but prove to be weaker.
objects.title: Titanus Ghidorah (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become the Crystal King himself, Spacegodzilla. You are a massive extraterrestrial crystalline saurian daikaiju, standing at 120 meters in your combat mode. You are capable of taking a flight based mode for interstellar travel, with an impressive length of 250 meters.

Your physical capabilities are nothing short of astounding. You can hurl a 160,000 metric ton foe hundreds of meters with a single flick of your tail and evenly challenge the King of Monsters himself. Nuclear weapons are mere annoyances to your durability and regeneration, and even being frozen by the Absolute Zero Cannon or blasted by Godzilla's atomic breath cannot truly harm you. Your flight mode is a blur of speed, moving at Mach 3 within the atmosphere and reaching near FTL velocities beyond its confines.

Your physiology has also granted you a wide array of impressive and devastating abilities. To further augment your durability is your Photon Reactive Shield, a crystal-like shield you can manifest at will that can disperse and reflect energy attacks. To combat foes from afar, you possess your Corona Beam, a lightning-like energy beam fired from your mouth and shoulder crystals. This beam’s path can be manipulated during and after firing to curve and move to bypass obstructions and defenses, digging into the target and exploding. You also possess a form of telekinesis known as Gravity Tornado that, while slow-moving, is powerful enough to ensnare some of the strongest daikaiju. This can be used to augment your physical attacks, adding a crushing force to your blows.

Beyond the abilities mentioned before are your two greatest synergistic abilities—your geokinesis and energy manipulation. 

Your geokinesis takes the form of ginormous crystals you can use to attack and defend with, and generated by spores you produce. Your crystals are incredibly powerful, capable of engulfing cities in mere minutes, providing enough energy to sustain a civilization, siphoning energy from nearby sources, empowering both yourself and other daikaiju, and even triggering the creation of entirely new daikaiju. 

Your energy manipulation is incredibly versatile. You can control the Corona Beam, conduct energy through touch to enhance your physical abilities, and absorb energy from nearby sources, maximizing this absorption through your crystals and storing it within the crystals on your shoulders. You can also generate an aura with effects similar to an EMP.

For all your immense power, you do have a weakness in the form of your shoulder crystals—if they are destroyed, your accumulated energy within them is lost and they are quite slow to regenerate.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: Crystal King (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become the incarnation of the Oxygen Destroyer itself, Destoroyah. You are an enormous crustacean daikaiju, standing at 120 meters tall in your perfect form along with a length of 230 meters and a wingspan of 210 meters. Your physiology is composed of trillions of near-microscopic organisms, each barely larger than a grain of sand.

Your physical capabilities from your physiology are incredible, your durability exceeding that of most daikaiju, such as surviving several blasts of the Red Spiral Ray, whose power is over 160 times the surface of the Sun and that exploits one of your greatest vulnerabilities. Your strength is just as monstrous, able to send 100,000 metric ton daikaiju flying hundreds of meters with your blows, taking them into the sky with you just using your tail, and even overpowering Heisei Godzilla who has accidentally cracked a tectonic plate with a slam.

Due to your unique physiology, you have gained a unique form of adaptation and regeneration. Your regeneration takes the form of division and recombination as you can split into your lesser forms to avoid destruction and overwhelm a foe then recombine completely healed. Your adaptation takes the form of DNA absorption—this functions by dissolving the target’s cells with Micro-Oxygen then using the genetic code to further evolve, allowing for drastic changes such as going from an exoskeleton to an endoskeleton.

Beyond the capacities mentioned before is your primary offensive ability, the Micro-Oxygen Beam. This beam's effects are twofold—it triggers immense explosions and devastation on contact with inorganic matter, and disintegrates organic matter. In your perfect form, it is powerful enough to kill Godzilla Junior and harm Burning Godzilla.

You also possess two additional offensive abilities to complement your primary offense, being your energy drain and Variable Slicer. Your energy drain works through the pincers on your tail or if in your lesser forms, as a set of secondary jaws you embed in the target. Your Variable Slice unleashes the immense energy stored in your horn, channeling it into a powerful beam slash. This attack is potent enough to severely injure Burning Godzilla and potentially even kill Godzilla in his normal form.

For all your great and terrible power, you do have some weaknesses. If any of your forms are slain, all the organisms that compose it will die along with it. You also possess a vulnerability to extreme heat as they can destroy the micro-oxygen within your body, severely injuring you. Furthermore, near absolute-zero cold can prevent you from splitting into your lesser forms, making it easier to slay you. 

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Oxygen Destroyer Incarnate (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become one of the Twin Guardian Deities of Earth, either Mothra or Battra. Furthermore, you have gained a loyal twin who possesses the abilities of the deity you didn’t become. You and your twin are enormous, divine moth daikaiju. 

You and your twin will initially start in your larva forms, being 120 meters long as Mothra and 90 meters long as Battra. Further metamorphosing into your Imago forms, you and your twin will be 65 meters long with a 185-meter wingspan for Mothra and 73 meters long with a 180-meter wingspan for Battra.

As twin deities, you and your twin share a variety of capabilities. Your Larva forms share being amphibious, able to traverse through the water at 56 knots and survive on the ocean floor for hours. Your Imago forms share their flight capabilities at Mach 3 normally and escape velocity in Bursts. You can survive the vacuum of space. As guardian deities of Earth, you share the ability to foresee, detect, and locate threats to Earth and Nature, as well as telepathy that can be used for off-world communication. Finally, your most impressive shared ability is rebirth, as upon reaching your Imago form, you can lay an egg that you will be reborn as, with your memories intact, should you die.

Despite being twins, you and your twin will possess a variety of abilities unique to said twin based on which deity they are.

As Mothra, your physical capabilities are impressive. You are strong enough to cause pain to a daikaiju like Godzilla in your Larva form, whilst being able to knock the wind out of him in your Imago form. You are durable enough to survive and endure being tossed around and rag-dolled by daikaiju as strong as Godzilla in both forms.

As Mothra, you will also possess a variety of supportive and disruptive abilities to cover your weaker physicality. In your Larval form, you can spray silk from your mouth that is strong enough to bind other daikaiju and can also be made acidic to further weaken those it binds. In your Imago form, you possess three notable abilities. Firstly, the ability to fire Ultrasonic Beams from your antennae that can also be used to inject energy into an ally. Secondly, the ability to discharge arcs of electricity from your wings and through touch. Finally, you can release powder-like scales in three forms: poison, energy reflection, and healing.

As Battra, your physical capabilities are immense. Your strength is great enough to briefly contest Godzilla in your Larva form and smash apart meteors in your Imago form. Your durability is great enough to be unaffected by Atomic Blasts, magma, and even being hit hard enough to create a fissure. 

As Battra, you will also possess a few abilities to complement your combative nature. In your Larva form, you possess the ability to burrow for miles and to fire your Prism Beams from your horn, although very inaccurately. In your Imago, your Prism Beams have become accurate and strong enough to tear apart meteor fragments; furthermore, you have also gained the ability to discharge energy through your feet and stinger.

Beyond all mentioned beforehand lies you and your twin's greatest facet, your telepathy and combined might. Your telepathy has two scales, for far distances up to a global scale, both of you can generally sense each other's location and status, whilst within line of sight, you can completely communicate your thoughts and feelings to each allowing for an incredible level of coordination. Your combined might is showcased when you two combine your Scales and Prism Beams into the Endless Refraction Prism Beams, an attack strong enough to render Godzilla injured and unconscious in moments.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form, or you may choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: Twin Guardian Deities of Earth (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Bionic Monster herself, Biollante. You are an enormous rose, human, and Godzilla hybrid daikaiju, standing at 120 meters tall.

Your physical capabilities are monstrous. Your hybrid physiology has granted you strength great enough to effortlessly burrow through the earth, have your tendrils punch holes through daikaiju like Heisei Godzilla, and even restrain Destoroyah. Your Godzilla DNA has granted you immense durability, being immune to conventional weapons, requiring power seen in other daikaiju to even harm you. Your greatest physical attribute is your regeneration, allowing you to heal and survive almost any injury, such as having a part of your head vaporized and completely healed moments later or heal from a small chunk of your core/heart over several days.

Beyond your physical capabilities you have also gained a variety of abilities being; Acidic Sap, Energy Spores, and Green Jail. 

Acidic Sap is a radioactive corrosive sap that you can both shed like blood and spray from your mouth. It is corrosive enough to harm Heisei Godzilla and melt a human near instantly.

Energy Spores is your ability to transform your body into golden spores, primarily used to avoid death and reform later completely healed but it can also be used to travel to locations you would normally be unable to reach such as the Moon or infect an individual and convert them into your core/heart.

Green Jail is your ultimate restraining ability, creating a prison around your target using your tendrils that is strong enough that even Heisei Godzilla was incapable of breaking out, with the sole drawback of this ability requiring you to have a constant source of freshwater to maintain it.

For all your monstrous power, you do possess a weakness—your core/heart. Should your core/heart become damaged, your physical abilities would drastically diminish, and should it be destroyed, your body would instantly wither to dust , ending your life.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Bionic Monster (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Ancestor Titan herself, Shimo. You are a gargantuan quadrupedal reptilian daikaiju, standing at 162.45 meters tall. 

Your physical capabilities are truly monstrous, surpassing alpha Titans like Godzilla and Ghidorah. Your strength is enough to send the likes of Godzilla flying hundreds of meters with a toss, and to support the weight of multiple daikaiju using you as a mount. Your durability is enormous—being immune to conventional weapons, unaffected by nuclear-level attacks, and even being relatively unharmed by the atomic breath of an Evolved Godzilla. 

Also, your Titan physiology allows you the ability to feed on all forms of radiation and grow stronger from it, while emitting your own form of unique radiation that is beneficial to and promotes life.

Beyond your physical capabilities, your nature has granted you a form of Cryokinesis. This Cryokinesis encompasses a variety of abilities based around freezing, such as your Frost Bite Breath, Cold Aura, and Radiation Burst. It's also noteworthy that you possess the sheer power to trigger an ice age with these abilities.

Frost Bite Breath is a beam you can fire from your maw, possessing incredible freezing capabilities. It can turn entire city blocks into ice, freeze other daikaiju solid in mere seconds, and even trigger massive snowstorms with a single blast.

Cold Aura is the intensely freezing temperature you emit, causing the very land around you to freeze with each step. You are even capable of near-instantly freezing an entire bay simply by making contact with the water.

Radiation Burst is the ultimate expression of your cryogenic power, unleashing an explosive burst of radiation. This results in events like icing over Greenland in minutes and achieving absolute zero around you.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Ancestor Titan (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Fierce Dragon himself, Anguirus. You are a humongous ankylosaurian daikaiju, standing at 40 meters tall and 160 meters long.

Your physical capabilities are astonishing. Your strength allows you to effortlessly burrow through the earth, bite with enough force to cause Destoroyah pain, grapple evenly with Godzilla, and even nearly strangle him with your prehensile tail. Your agility is surprising for your build, allowing you to leap over other daikaiju and roll at high speeds. However, your greatest physical capability is your sheer durability—you are immune to conventional weaponry, unharmed by falling into fissures and magma, unaffected by being used as a flail, and able to endure blows from Godzilla, King Ghidorah, Gigan, and even Destoroyah.

Beyond your raw physical capabilities, your body has granted you quite a few helpful traits. To complement your defensive nature, you possess a spike carapace capable of causing harm to even the likes of Destoroyah and King Ghidorah. You can also curl into an armored ball and roll at high speeds towards your unlucky foe, making use of your spiked carapace. Despite what one might expect from your form, you are a great swimmer, able to match Godzilla himself. To complete your offensive options, you can emit an Ultrasonic Roar capable of shaking buildings apart and knocking other daikaiju back.

Beyond your physical capabilities and helpful traits lies your greatest attribute—your sheer determination and tenacity. You can keep fighting far past the point where others would give up, unwaveringly facing foes that others cower before. You could be repeatedly beaten down by the sadistic Destoroyah, yet get up each time because you aren't done yet. You could nearly die to Mechagodzilla, but your best friend needs your help, so you get back up to help them fight Mecha-King Ghidorah.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into. Additionally, you can choose for your appearance to be like one of the other versions of Anguirus that exists, even some combination of those. This won't affect your abilities, just your appearance.
objects.title: The Fierce Dragon (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Guardian of Okinawa himself, King Caesar. You are a gigantic shisa daikaiju, standing at 100 meters tall. 

Your physical capabilities are immense. Your strength allows you to contend with other daikaiju, leap hundreds of meters, and perform feats like kicking the 60,000 metric ton Anguirus like a soccer ball. Your agility lets you execute maneuvers like a scissor kick mid-air. Finally, your durability, like most of your fellow daikaiju, renders you immune to congenital weaponry. 

Beyond your physical capabilities, you also possess the ability Prismatic Eyes and mastery of charms. 

Prismatic Eyes is your ability to redirect an enemy's energy attack back at them with amplified force. It works by absorbing an incoming energy-based attack into your right eye, then releasing and firing it back out of your left eye, increasing the attack's power tenfold.

Your mastery of charms allows you to perform feats like exorcising the spirit of an immensely powerful psychic ghost even in the midst of battle.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into. Additionally, you can choose for your appearance to be like one of the other versions of King Caesar that exists, even some combination of those. This won't affect your abilities, just your appearance.
objects.title: The Guardian of Okinawa (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Guardian of Seatopia himself, Megalon. You are a towering insectoid daikaiju, standing at 120 meters tall. 

Your insectoid physiology bestows upon you a remarkable range of movement. Your wings enable you to ascend through the air at Mach 3, while your powerful drills allow for subterranean travel at the same incredible speed. You can even navigate the depths of the ocean at Mach 4. Finally, your spring-like limbs propel you upwards, reaching a maximum height of 10 kilometers. 

Beyond your remarkable mobility, you have also been granted immense physical prowess. Your strength allows you to engage in physical combat with other daikaiju, and when combined with your powerful drills, your punches can penetrate the hides of even formidable creatures like Godzilla, creating devastating shockwaves capable of leveling city blocks when delivered during flight or after a powerful leap. Your carapace, with its diamond-like hardness, renders you impervious to conventional weaponry. Even your softer tissues possess remarkable durability, allowing you to withstand even the most intense attacks. While a direct hit to the eyes with mazer fire might momentarily stun you, it will not inflict lasting harm. Similarly, you can even accidentally swallow a Geothermal Napalm without suffering serious consequences.

On top of your physical capabilities, you also possess two more abilities—Beast Killer Light Ray and Geothermal Napalm.

The Beast Killer Light Ray, a searing yellow beam of energy, erupts from your horn. This potent weapon possesses the destructive force to obliterate man-made structures with ease. At full power, it can inflict near-fatal damage upon even the most formidable daikaiju, such as Biollante, with a single, devastating blast. Your arsenal also includes Geothermal Napalm, fiery red darts launched from your mandibles. These projectiles detonate upon impact or, at your command, with a timed fuse. Their explosive force is capable of leveling city blocks and inflicting significant damage upon other daikaiju, such as Godzilla, knocking them down and engulfing them in flames.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into. Additionally, you can choose for your appearance to be like one of the other versions of Megalon that exists, even some combination of those. This won't affect your abilities, just your appearance.
objects.title: The Guardian of Seatopia (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Cyborg Monster himself, Gigan. You are an enormous alien cyborg daikaiju, standing at 100 meters tall.

Your physical capabilities are commensurate with your imposing size. You possess the strength to engage in titanic clashes with other daikaiju of comparable stature, such as Jet Jaguar and Godzilla, matching their power blow for blow. Your remarkable durability renders you impervious to conventional weaponry, allowing you to continue fighting even with injuries that would be fatal to lesser beings. Even decapitation, a wound that would normally spell certain doom, cannot immediately incapacitate you, a testament to your extraordinary resilience.

Beyond your purely physical capabilities, your cybernetic enhancements have bestowed upon you a formidable arsenal of weapons and abilities. These include Antigravity Flight, Hammer-Claw Hands, Bloody Chainsaws, Universal Cutter, Scattered Light Beam Gigarium Cluster, Bladed Slicers, Ninja Revival Technique, Infrared Vision, and a Flamethrower.

Antigravity Flight grants you the ability to soar through the atmosphere at Mach 3, and in the vacuum of space, you can encase yourself in a diamond-hard shell, propelling yourself at a staggering Mach 400 

Hammer-Claw Hands are 45 meter long metallic hooks/scythes in place of hands, that are sharp and strong enough to slice through the flesh of powerful daikaiju such as Godzilla. They also possess both launchable grappling hooks on the undersides that can reel targets in and explosive charges to add detonations to impacts. These can be switched with Bloody Chainsaws.

Bloody Chainsaws are 40 meter long dual chainsaw hands that are sharp and strong enough to pierce Godzilla’s hide, cut off Mothra’s wings, and slice through the hull of an alien warship. They also can be used like threads for short-bursts of high-speed movement. These can be switched with Hammer-Claw Hands.

Universal Cutter is the rotating buzzsaw built into your abdominal area that is incredibly strong and sharp, able to effortlessly cut through the flesh of daikaiju like Godzilla and Anguirus. A mere hit and run with this was capable of tearing Godzilla’s shoulder open.

Scattered Light Beam Gigarium Cluster is a laser fired from your eye visor that explodes like a cluster bomb. The power behind the explosions generated depend on how far the laser was fired from, with short-range shots being able to destroy city blocks and knock out knock out daikaiju like Mothra.

Bladed Slicers are guided razor discs that are shot out of hidden slots in your upper torso, these discs are sharp enough to effortlessly slice through the flesh of daikaiju such as yourself. Notably, these discs will boomerang back around should they initially miss. Be wary as if they miss a second time, you may be in their path.

Ninja Revival Technique is a device hidden within your claws that allows you to revive yourself, so long as both of your claws remain intact.

Infrared Vision and Flamethrower are rather straightforward, with your visor able to shift your vision to show infrared signatures, and being able to breathe 5,000°C flames flames from your mouth.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities while retaining your human form. You may also choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your Kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into. Additionally, you can choose for your appearance to be like one of the other versions of Gigan that exists, even some combination of those. This won't affect your abilities, just your appearance.
objects.title: The Cyborg Monster (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Grotesque Invader itself, Orga. You are a towering, knuckle-walking mutated alien daikaiju, standing at 100 meters tall.

As befitting a creature mutated with Godzilla’s DNA, your physical capabilities are truly terrifying. Your raw strength is enough to restrain the likes of Godzilla, casually lift and toss hundreds of thousands of tons one-handed, and leap hundreds of meters both vertically and horizontally with ease. Meanwhile, your durability, whilst somewhat fragile by daikaiju standards, is enough to render you immune to conventional weapons. However, your regeneration more than makes up for it, near-instantaneously healing you from even entire chunks being blown off, and recovering from things like head impalement or exploding outwards at a visible rate.

On top of your physical capabilities, you do have some additional abilities. Starting off, built into your shoulder is the Wave Motion Cannon, a biological weapon that fires beams of kinetic energy capable of leveling city blocks and launching daikaiju hundreds of meters away. Next, you have retained some telepathic capacity, able to interact with and control familiar machinery. Finally, you can drain and incorporate the DNA of others at a visible rate through biting or in moments via full consumption through an unhinged jaw and torso, essentially able to become a perfect clone of the target.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities whilst retaining your human form, or may choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Grotesque Invader (Godzilla Franchise)

addons.text:
You carry the combined combat experience of every human, mutant, and alien who has ever faced the kaiju of the Godzilla and Gamera Franchises. From military commanders coordinating city-wide defenses, to scientists devising powerful weapons, to mutants and other superpowered beings engaging monsters directly, all their combat experience is second nature to you now.

Your knowledge encompasses the strengths, weaknesses, and combat tendencies of Godzilla, the Mechagodzillas, Mothra, Gamera, Rodan, King Ghidorah, and every other canonical monster from the Godzilla and Gamera Franchises. You instinctively know how to exploit their vulnerabilities, predict their behavior in urban or natural terrain, and wield technology, military hardware, or environmental hazards to your advantage.

It doesn’t end there. You also possess the strategic foresight to organize evacuations and coordinate disaster response during a kaiju attack, and can draft plans to reconstruct destroyed cities within a year, matching the efficiency of nations in the Godzilla and Gamera movies to do the same.
addons.title: Kaiju Combat Veteran

objects.text:
You are a mutant, a genetic descendant of both humans and xiliens. This mixed heritage has granted you an M-Base, resulting in you gaining superhuman capabilities. 

You are fast enough to appear as a blur, avoid explosions, run on walls, and even dodge bullets while on a motorcycle. You are strong enough to leap 50 meters into the air, and be unmoved from the recoil of heavy armaments. You’re durable enough to be relatively unharmed from being flung by the attack of a lesser daikaiju, or punched through concrete pillars. Your reflexes and perception are great enough that you perceive and follow bullets after they have been fired. Besides physical capabilities, your M-Base has granted you latent psychic ones, in the form of weak telekinesis and telepathy.

Beyond the capabilities mentioned before is what sets you apart from your fellow mutants—that you are a potential Keizer with potential rivaling Ozaki. Upon learning to wield your Keizer Energy, your capabilities would skyrocket, being to mutants what mutants are to humans. It is also noted that Keizers can infuse their Keizer energy into another to massively empower them, and potentially cause them to physically evolve.
objects.title: Potential Keizer (Godzilla Franchise)

addons.text:
By being both a Mutant and a Houtua has brought you to new heights. 

The telepathic nature of the Houtua mixed with the Mutants' latent psychic capacity has resulted in you not merely being a potential Keizer, but instead a fully realized one. 

Furthermore, your Keizer Energy has infused into your scales, granting them the same properties possessed by Mothra, being capable of reflecting and disrupting energy abilities, healing, turning poisonous, and disrupting technology.
addons.title: Keizer Hybrid

addons.text:
Your divine and symbiotic inheritances have merged, turning you into a demigod of Mothra, the Goddess of Rebirth. As a demigod of Mothra, you have gained two variations of Mothra’s own abilities.

Firstly, you have gained a variation of Mothra’s form of rebirth. Through consuming an exhausting amount of stamina, you can create a human-sized egg that allows you to be reborn with your full capabilities and memories intact should you die. 

Secondly, you have gained a variation of Mothra’s metamorphosis. You can cocoon yourself to undergo a metamorphosis into a more insectoid form, gaining additional limbs, chitinous armor, wings, and a stinger. Within this form you could even learn to perform weaker versions of Mothra’s abilities, like spewing acidic silk, firing beams from your antenna, and rapid firing your stinger. You can, of course, cocoon yourself again to revert to your normal form.
addons.title: Demigod of Rebirth

addons.text:
By possessing both a connection to Mothra and knowledge of the occult has resulted in you gaining the knowledge and ability to use the mystic abilities seen in the Godzilla Franchise. 

Whilst initially, you will be limited to weaker abilities like understanding kaijus, limited mind control, and protecting against possession and psychics, it will grow into far greater feats like teleporting anywhere in the world, clairvoyance, creating golems on par with King Caesar, and even devouring the souls of dozens at once.
addons.title: Kaiju Mystics

addons.text:
It seems that the FEV’s introduction has mutated your form to gain traits and abilities akin to a mixture of the Mothmen found within Appalachia’s wasteland and Mothra herself, whilst still retaining the benefits and traits found within super mutants. 

Starting off, you gain the following physical characteristics. Your eyes now grow brightly orange, green, blue, red, or magenta. Chitinuous plating capable of negating most conventional weaponry takes the place of your skin. A second set of arms emerges from you, equipped with mantis-like claws in conjunction with your hands. Sprouting from your back are a large pair of moth wings that allow you to hover and fly, and can also be wrapped around yourself like a cloak. Finally, at your waist is a stinger-equipped abdomen, wielding a paralytic venom.  

Next, you gain two new abilities linked to your physiology. From your wings you emit a secondary type of scales, that comes out as a shadowy short-lived dust that can mask your movements, disrupt and deflect energy-based attacks, and, if inhaled causes acts as a neurotoxin that causes hallucinations. From your antenna you can focus the chittering noises that you can produce either rapid-fire concussive blasts of sound, or emit a large shockwave that staggers and disorients those within a few meters of you.

Finally, your innate psychic abilities of the Houtua, cosmic awareness of the Mothmen, and Psyker potential of the FEV have granted you access to Fallout’s psyker abilities on par with individuals like The Master and Lorenzo. You could crush power armor like a tin can with telekinesis, see into the future, create an aura that shreds the weaker minds, and control all manner of beasts.
addons.title: Moth Evolution

objects.text:
You have become a Houtua. The Houtua are the descendants of humans that lived and evolved in a symbiotic state with Mothra after Godzilla terraformed the world to suit itself.

In comparison to humans, the Houtua possess a few notable differences. Physically, they have ornate white markings upon their bodies, antennas that extend from their hair, and tend to be shorter but more muscular. 

Whilst ability-wise, they are all capable of telepathic communication that is automatically translated into the subject’s head as its native language, can learn languages in mere days, and most importantly secrete scales that were essential for their survival on the terraformed earth. 

In particular, their scales allow them to breathe the highly toxic air of the Earth, be unaffected by the ambient radiation and poison of plant life, and even be unaffected and incapable of assimilation by the grey goo-like nanometal.
objects.title: Houtua (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Smog Monster itself, Hedorah. You are a colossal pollution-based daikaiju, standing at roughly 60 meters tall in your bipedal form, though your body is an ever-shifting mass of toxic sludge capable of changing shape to suit your needs.

Despite your seemingly amorphous body, your physical capabilities are formidable. Your strength allows you to wrestle with monsters such as Godzilla, crush buildings beneath your weight, and overpower most opponents. Your durability is exceptional, as conventional weaponry is almost completely ineffective against your semi-liquid body. Blunt force, piercing attacks, and even losing massive portions of your body are little more than temporary inconveniences, as you can simply flow back together and regenerate by absorbing additional pollutants from your surroundings. Unless your entire body is thoroughly dried out or otherwise neutralized, permanently destroying you is an extremely difficult task.

However, your true power lies not in your raw strength alone, but in your ability to spread pollution. Your body constantly releases poisonous sludge, corrosive acidic fluids, and dense clouds of toxic smog that rapidly contaminate the surrounding environment. Merely being near you is hazardous to most forms of life, with prolonged exposure causing severe illness, suffocation, chemical burns, and eventual death. The pollution you spread lingers long after you have departed, rendering entire regions hazardous to inhabit.

Your amorphous physiology grants you incredible versatility. You may freely reshape your body, forming tendrils, pseudopods, shields, additional limbs, or flowing through openings far too small for a creature of your size. Physical attacks often pass harmlessly through your body with little lasting effect, while enemies attempting to grapple you risk becoming trapped within your corrosive sludge.

You may split off portions of yourself ranging from fist-sized blobs to massive fragments, each capable of moving, attacking, and surviving independently while carrying a fraction of your consciousness. These detached masses will continue feeding upon pollution, allowing them to regenerate and grow, which can be recalled back into your main body, restoring lost mass and merging their growth into yourself.

You also possess multiple forms of locomotion. By compressing your body into a streamlined aquatic form, you can move effortlessly through water while feeding upon pollutants. Alternatively, by transforming into your flying form, you may propel yourself through the air at tremendous speeds by expelling jets of toxic gas, leaving vast clouds of poisonous smog wherever you go.

To complement your physical abilities, you can fire concentrated streams of corrosive sludge capable of melting steel and flesh, project acidic mist, and unleash your signature Hedrium Ray from your eyes, a focused crimson energy beam powerful enough to devastate buildings and wound fellow daikaiju. Your body also continuously generates sulfuric acid and toxic chemicals, making direct contact with you dangerous even for powerful monsters.

Perhaps what makes you so terrifying is your endless capacity for growth, as pollution is both your food and your lifeblood. The greater the contamination of your surroundings, the stronger, larger, and more resilient you become. Toxic waste, radiation, oil spills, heavy metals, and airborne smog can all be absorbed to restore injuries and steadily increase your power. If left unchecked in a heavily polluted world, there is effectively no upper limit to how powerful you may become.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities whilst retaining your human form, or may choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Smog Monster (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You are a hybrid child of the draconic kaiju Belloc, the King of the Kaiju.

The mixed heritage you possess has altered your appearance, your skin becomes thick scales, from your forehead sprouts short horns, your nails elongate into claws, your teeth sharpen into fangs, your pupils shape changes into reptilian slits, and from your back sprouts a pair of retractable bat-like wings.

Your heritage has granted you impressive physical capabilities, rivaling daikaiju despite being human-sized. 

Your strength is great enough to allow you to break the bones of a daikaiju, bite through metal, and bat away a thrown metal structure. In terms of speed and reflexes, they are great enough for you to land multiple blows on a daikaiju before it can react, outrun an avalanche, and give military organizations trouble tracking you mid-travel. Your durability is immense, especially in regards to heat; you could shrug off being ping-ponged between two daikaiju, be unharmed by being slammed through a stone pillar by a daikaiju, be immune to most conventional weaponry, and only be annoyed by magma and the Belloc’s fire. Your senses are grand, heightened to the point where you could sense danger, possess night vision, and perceive emotions, magical energies, and the electromagnetic spectrum. On top of all this, you can also breathe underwater.

Beyond your physical capabilities lies the greatest trait you have inherited from Belloc—his ability to breath fire. Fire Breathing is your most dangerous ability due to how instinctive it is to use and how powerful it is. Its instinctive sheer ease of use would allow you to perform feats such as shaping it into rings after just a day of using it, while its sheer firepower is astonishing, able to nearly-kill lesser daikaiju with a single burst, shake a cavern large enough to house several daikaiju, and stagger and hurt even other flame-resistant daikaiju.
objects.title: Heir of Belloc (Firebreather)

addons.text: Your Belmont skills have expanded to include Zangetsu's skills from Castlevania's spiritual successor, Bloodstained. This includes Zangetsu's Soul Arts, his subweapons, & the sword Zangetsuto itself. You can also sound like David Hayter whenever you want.
addons.title: Zangetsu (Bloodstained)

addons.text:
You have become the heir of the Belmont clan and inherited a hypothetical Magic Crest that the clan would have created had they been a mage bloodline, with all events of the Castlevania series existing within the world of Type-Moon.

As a clan whose duty is to hunt monsters that prey upon the innocent rather than pursue the Root, this Crest embodies nearly a thousand years of accumulated mystical martial arts and magecraft, focused exclusively on combating supernatural threats such as phantasmal beasts, Dead Apostles, and even evil magi.

Contained within the Crest is a vast library of knowledge: an exhaustive encyclopedia of all things supernatural, numerous combat styles, and thousands of spells gathered from magecraft traditions across the globe, with an emphasis on sacred sacraments utilized by the Holy Church.

When wielded to its fullest potential, the Crest grants the ability to battle and even slay a Rank IX Dead Apostle Ancestor or, at the very peak, a True Ancestor. While initial mastery of the Crest and its knowledge does not allow such feats immediately, you are still leagues beyond most Executors of the Holy Church or Enforcers of the Clock Tower, and can dispatch Rank VII Greater Dead Apostles with moderate difficulty.

Furthermore, the centuries-long buildup of mystery has amplified the natural traits of the Belmont bloodline. Physical prowess, magical talent, and potential have been elevated far beyond the baseline power. 

Most importantly, the clan’s innate defensive power has evolved across generations: in addition to its great resistance to harmful supernatural effects being increased even further, it now offers a complete conceptual negation of all such effects that carried less than a thousand years of mystery or any equivalent metaphysical weight.

If you also possess the Vampire Killer whip, it manifests as a powerful Mystic Code imbued with the conceptual properties of Evil Annihilation and Rejection of Eternity.

Evil Annihilation: The whip inflicts additional damage upon beings deemed monstrous or evil. The greater the burden of karma a target has accumulated, the more devastating the effect.

Rejection of Eternity: This property strengthens the whip’s ability to impede regeneration and resurrection. It now nullifies immortality, prevents regenerative abilities from functioning, and ensures that those struck down by the whip cannot return from the dead.
addons.title: The Belmont Heir

objects.text:
Within you flows the blood of the Belmont clan, a powerful lineage of holy warriors dedicated to hunting creatures of the night to protect humanity. The Belmont clan is the sworn enemy of the dark lord Dracula.

Each generation of the Belmont clan is stronger than the last. As its latest member, you possess even more potential than Julius Belmont, the strongest Belmont and the greatest vampire hunter ever.

As a Belmont, you have received extensive training to combat creatures of the night. You are a master of weapons, a formidable martial artist, an incredible acrobat, and an unrivaled scholar of all things supernatural. This training lets you identify supernatural threats and determine how to overcome them quickly. Even when encountering something entirely new, you can swiftly analyze the strengths and weaknesses of your foe and devise an effective counter.

Your strength can casually shatter giant golems of stone or steel, and your speed allows you to keep up in combat with Dracula himself. Thanks to the Belnades side of your family tree, you also have incredible potential and talent in the magical arts.

The holy power coursing through your veins grants you incredible resistance against most of the powers wielded by creatures of the night. This enables you to resist effects such as petrification, extreme temperatures, poison and disease, death manipulation, existence erasure, time stop, and more.
objects.title: Divine Bloodline (Castlevania)

addons.title: The New Breed (Drakengard)
addons.text:
In the chamber of the Bone Casket, a kind of immaculate conception occurred, one that fused one who bore a draconic pact with one who bears a seal keeping the Watchers at bay. The being born from this conception was a kind of "human dragon", a human with the power & qualities of the dragons, an inverted Messiah with the power to protect the world from God. You are such a one.

You can fly freely through the skies with spectral wings that can extend or retract from the pact-mark on your back. However, you have made no pact, & have little need of one. Your might exceeds that of pact-bearers, equaling that of the mighty dragons, allowing you to wrestle with beings that can slay the divine.

On top of all this, just like the timeline where the dragon Angelus entered our modern world, you are innately magical, & bring mastery of the magic arts of the Drakengard universe (as well as the possibilities of magic in general) wherever you go. As White Chlorination Syndrome was specifically caused by the corpse of The Watcher, rather than by Angelus (whose Maso was safe enough to inject into human tissue), it is most likely safe to use without causing Maso contamination.

objects.text:
You are no longer fully human, owing to one of the First Dragons being one of your parents. This affords you a great potential to grow into and numerous abilities to make that so. Like your draconic parent, you are able to transform your body. Just as easily as they can adopt a human form, you can take the form of a dragon.

However, this ability to fully transform has been sealed into a Dragonstone to protect you from the degeneracy that awaits any long-lived or powerful dragons. Without the Dragonstone, you can transform on your own, but will eventually go mad.

Fortunately that seal is only on your full dragon form; you can easily transform only parts of your body into draconic equivalents to make use of during combat. Conjure your dragon antlers to boost magic casting, transform your left arm into a powerful lance to skewer your enemies, or transform your right arm into a gaping maw to chew adversaries up or fire blasts of energy like an esoteric cannon.

Your connection to a god-like being also affords you several other abilities:

A minor boost to vitality, strength, and durability to an ally you're close with and directly supporting in close combat.

An approximately 20% boost to how fast you grow to meet development milestones.

The ability to boost the potency of your dragon-form attacks by about 50%.

An ability that depends on how lucky you are that negates about half the damage that an ally within a 1 meter radius would take from an attack.

A passive manipulation of probability that boosts the likelihood of activating your abilities by about 10%.

A minor curse that affects an opponent after a relative round of combat that debuffs their strength, magic, skill, speed, luck, and defenses by a minor amount.

Finally, the ability to make use of any offensive skills of an ally you're close with that is within a 1 meter radius.
objects.title: Half-Dragon (Fire Emblem)

addons.text:
Your universal aptitude for learning includes the ability to naturally learn skills from the Fire Emblem universe. This can occur through repeated practice or by instinctively gaining them as you perform actions related to the skill. Additionally, you naturally begin developing all skills associated with dragons.

Examples include:

Dragonskin, which halves damage taken and negates instant death effects and poison.

Rightful God, which increases the likelihood of your skills or abilities activating by 30%.

Ancient Dragon Wrath, which causes your attacks to deal additional damage to your target, depending on whether their physical or magical defense is weaker.
addons.title: [Skill]

addons.text:
You're considered the Avatar Class by default. This does not change your initial class but effectively fuses with the first class you choose. What this means is that you have the ability to discern the general skills, level of power, and location of everything in an area during combat. Additionally, you can determine how much damage someone would take or receive if they are attacked by someone else.

This also grants you several passive skills, such as Paragon, which doubles the speed at which your classes grow; the ability to rewind time by a few minutes, but only to the start of a battle you just participated in; and a self-preservation ability, where if you die, time rewinds to a safe point in your past.

On top of this, you gain access to weapons, items, tomes, clothing, armor, and even mounts associated with any class you choose, similar to those from Fire Emblem. For example, becoming a Tactician might grant you a Levin Sword, while choosing Soldier could provide an Iron Lance. A Mage could receive various tomes, a Pegasus Knight might obtain a Pegasus, and choosing to be a Dragon Child or Dragon Lord could eventually grant you powerful and iconic equipment like Tyrfing or Sigurd's Silver Sword as your class grows or when you promote.
addons.title: Avatar

addons.text:
Instead of just a Crest you have a Crest Stone which can be your Dragonstone or even a secondary one if you wish. This does not change you into a Nabatean if you do not wish it to but will give you similar abilities to them such as your blood being able to give others your Crest.

Plus whatever Crest and weapons you choose you have your own Crest you can design the ability of, you also get up to 3 Sacred Weapons you can choose the appearance and abilities of. A sword and shield or a pair of boxing gloves count as 1 Sacred Weapon.
addons.title: Crest Stone

addons.text:
You've mantled Archbishop Rhea, also known as Saint Seiros and the Immaculate One. You have the option to decide how much of her you take—such as adopting her appearance, memories, and even subsuming her soul—or simply just the power that comes with it.

You gain access to all of her knowledge accumulated over 1,000+ years of life, including her vast repertoire of magic, alchemical prowess in creating homunculi, golem creation, necromancy skills, expertise in tactics and strategy, combat prowess, and governing skills in managing a religion for a millennium. This includes all her skills and abilities she had in all 4 routes and in 3 Hopes.

In addition to her sacred weapons, you gain all the items she possessed in life, such as the Chalice of Beginnings. On top of having the Crest Stone of Seiros, you still have the option of possessing up to one more Crest and up to three more sacred weapons. Alternatively, you can choose to further empower your Crest of Seiros, making it twice as strong or giving it new abilities and optionally increasing the effects, durability, and power of your current sacred weapons by thrice by essentially stacking your three new sacred weapons into them. For example, the Seiros Shield could go from cutting all damage you take from monsters in half while healing you 33% of your maximum health automatically every minute to making you immune to damage from monsters and healing 99% of your health automatically every 20 seconds.
addons.title: The Immaculate One

objects.text:
You are a Manakete, a type of dragon native to the Fire Emblem series. As a Manakete, you have sealed your dragon form within a Dragonstone to prevent yourself from degenerating into a feral dragon. You can live for thousands of years, and regardless of the type of dragon you are, you possess the ability to learn, create, and cast magic.

In your humanoid form, you are physically weaker than the average human in the Fire Emblem worlds unless you undergo rigorous training. However, even in this form, you are at least as strong as a peak human on normal Earth.

In your dragon or partial dragon form, you are extraordinarily powerful, capable of easily killing most humans with a single attack and defeating dozens of moderately superhuman foes. However, you may still be vulnerable to stronger opponents or overwhelming numbers.

The types of Dragons you can choose to be are:

Fire Dragons: Typically bulky and look closer to Western Dragons.

Ice Dragons: Sleeker type of Dragons who can breath blasts of ice.

Mage Dragons: Usually Serpentine kind of Dragons who specialize in magic and are immune to magic attacks. 

Divine Dragons: Considered the strongest tribe, have a more majestic appearance and their attacks are very effective against other Dragons. They also have a great affinity to light and faith magic.

Earth Dragons: Bulky, armored with no or small wings. Very good with dark magic.

Fell Dragons: Extremely attuned to dark magic and a rival in power to Divine Dragons. You have the ability to bringing back corpses as undead.

Astral Dragons: Can travel between worlds and dimensions.

Nabatean: Instead of having a Dragonstone you have a Crest Stone in your body. Your blood is capable of giving humans and their bloodlines crests which allow them to have extended lifespans and powers somewhat based on your own.

Your Dragonstone is indestructible and can be teleported back to you if you lose it.
objects.title: Manakete (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
Your DNA has been infused with the DNA of an Ultra, similar to Shinjiro Hayata. This grants you enhanced physical attributes beyond those of normal humans and the ability to fly. For instance, you have the strength to put dents in steel and throw the average person hundreds of feet in the air, and you can reach the height of a building in a single jump. Your durability, endurance, and agility are equally enhanced. Similar to an Ultra's inner light, your body can produce an energy called Spacium, which you can manipulate in various ways, such as beams, energy discs, and energy shields.

However, this power also comes with an intense innate sense of justice, preventing you from abusing your powers and giving you a sense of responsibility to dedicate yourself to peace and justice. Additionally, you gain a custom-tailored Ultraman Suit that you can summon and dismiss at any time by willing it and making the iconic Ultraman pose. Rather than enhancing your powers, this suit focuses them for more optimized use.

Furthermore, when wearing the suit you can activate a special mode called "Limit Release" that makes you emit a red light when activated, allowing you to access your Ultra powers at full capacity, elevating your might to extraordinary heights, albeit leaving you exhausted afterward.

While you are not as powerful as the Giant of Light, it is possible for you, through constant and intense emotional stimuli, to break your limits and reach the same power level as the Giant of Light.
objects.title: Ultraman Factor (Ultraman)

addons.title: Esper Garden
addons.text:
The souls of any creature within your garden can be treated as Magicite—the physical remains of Espers when they die. Each of these souls grant you a minor benefit while slumbering. Such as sharpening senses, retractable claws, innate knowledge, etc.

They also increase your growth rate in learning certain types of magic, different applications, or specific spells based on the characteristics they had in life. Such as a bird ingraining you with the knowledge of a spell to shoot feathers, or a phoenix to augment your fire magic for healing.

You can also expend your own mana to summon one of these souls as a familiar. Depending on what the soul once was and the amount of mana spent, they can range from ample support to terrifying beings of legend.
