objects.text: You are the child of a human and an Esper, gifting you with an ocean of power, potential, and aptitude in all things magic, or other supernatural powers. Even without formal training, or knowledge of your true abilities, you can manipulate any form of magic present in the world innately, as if it was second nature. With access to any magic system or magical powers, you will automatically become a prodigy with it, and can quickly grow with training and understanding. Due to being a part magical creature, you have your own internal pool of mana which can fuel any of your abilities and augments your body to become peak human in all aspects. Alongside other benefits like disease immunity, slower aging, and a longer lifespan. Your reserves will naturally be greater than any human magic user, and will replenish on their own. You also have an ability called Trance to transform into an Esper. This form doubles the potency of all your abilities and grants flight great enough to travel the earth at supersonic speeds. Unlike Terra Brandford, you can maintain this state so long as you don't run out of mana. You may design your Esper form as you wish.
objects.title: Half Esper (Final Fantasy VI)

addons.text:
Remember the many many years of dispute that scholars had over your species not being descended from dragons? Well it's time to prove them wrong.

You can now partially or completely transform into a dragon. Whether it be growing wings to smack people or create gusts of wind, turning your hands into claws to tear through steel like butter, or releasing breaths of fire and even magic to kill your foes, you've become a menace to society. The sheer amount of aether you possess has saturated every single cell, to the point that people wouldn’t be wrong to say you are entirely made of it.

Even when not partially or completely transformed, your mana burst is three times as powerful as before, and your skin is twice as durable as the strongest known metal in the world.
addons.title: ROAR O'DRAGON, ROAR!

addons.text:
You have some Oni in your ancestry. You don’t gain a set of retractable horns like Oni, but instead, your current horns constantly draw in mana, as if you were an Oni with their horns out. This allows you to effectively remain in an empowered state, making you as strong as both your Au Ra and Oni bloodlines combined.

If you ever need more power, your horns, along with your luminous limbal rings—if they weren’t already—will glow like an Oni’s, doubling your strength.
addons.title: Bio-Luminescent Horns

objects.text:
A humanoid species known for their scales, tails, and horns that cover parts of their body. There have been many disputes over whether or not they're truly descended from dragons or merely just look similar.

Either way, you're an Au Ra. You can choose to be a Raen, known for their white scales and solitary lifestyle, or a Xaela, distinguished by their darker scales and stronger focus on hunting. The differences between them are minor: Raen have slightly more speed and enhanced effectiveness with healing magic, while Xaela are a bit stronger and more resilient. These are only slight bonuses that don’t scale over time and are negligible if you train.

Regardless of your choice, you have aether. Aether is the foundation of all life and magic on Hydaelyn. It is found in all living beings and is an essential building block of creation. The various schools of magic have learned to draw upon aether and use it to empower their spellcraft. You do not know any spells, but you can passively use aether to strengthen yourself. At the start, this would allow you to perform physical feats that would be greater than a human of similar physical fitness by almost half. This would only increase as you train and learn to harness your aether.
objects.title: Au Ra (Final Fantasy XIV)

addons.title: The Ultimate Hunter
addons.text:
Your status as an Apex Specimen takes the Yautja pursuit of biological perfection to its logical extreme, making you an idealized version of the genetically enhanced hunters exemplified by the Upgrade Predator. Beyond further perfecting your existing Yautja physique, your sensory organs can perceive virtually the entire electromagnetic spectrum, shifting between useful bands at will. Extreme wavelengths function more like specialized radiation or signal detection than ordinary sight and do not allow you to simply see through solid objects.

Your senses have developed entirely new capabilities. You possess predatory echolocation, emitting otherwise inaudible frequencies and interpreting their return to form a detailed three-dimensional map around yourself, allowing you to hunt through darkness, smoke, foliage, visual camouflage and partial cover. Your already formidable chemoreception has likewise become a biological forensic scanner, letting you recognize individuals by scent, follow incredibly faint trails, distinguish blood and biological compounds, identify poisons and disease, and perceive hormonal changes associated with fear, aggression or injury.
You possess conscious control over your alien physiology. Your adaptive dermis can alter its color and texture for natural camouflage or rapidly harden selected areas into biological armor capable of resisting gunfire and powerful melee weapons, while your musculature, circulation, sensory organs, jaws and similar structures can be temporarily reconfigured to better suit the hunt. This is not shapeshifting, but extremely sophisticated control over structures your body already possesses. Your natural resilience has similarly developed into accelerated regeneration, rapidly sealing wounds, knitting fractures and replacing damaged tissue, though catastrophic damage can still require a Medicomp or other advanced treatment.

Most importantly, you have perfected the Yautja practice of genetic adaptation. Using the complete Predator scientific and technological knowledge provided by Yautja Elder, you can analyze suitable organisms and employ Yautja biotechnology to deliberately engineer compatible biological traits into yourself. Samples must be obtained, the trait understood, and the modification properly designed and integrated over time; you cannot simply consume DNA and acquire someone's powers. Purely magical, spiritual, conceptual or otherwise non-biological abilities cannot be reproduced this way, nor can fundamentally incompatible biology be copied wholesale.

Your body is also exceptionally receptive to Yautja technological augmentation, allowing you to safely integrate cybernetics, sensory implants and other Predator biotechnology into your physiology. Biological evolution and Yautja engineering can therefore be developed together, allowing you to continually refine yourself into exactly what your species has always aspired to become: the ultimate hunter.

objects.text:
You possess the body, instincts, skills, and accumulated experience of an exceptional Yautja Elder, including their immense strength, speed, durability, senses, tracking ability, stealth, survival skills, and mastery of the Hunt. Despite possessing an Elder's experience, your body is at the physical prime a younger Yautja could achieve, free from the decline that normally accompanies such age.

You also possess complete knowledge of Yautja science, engineering, medicine, craftsmanship, and technology across the Predator franchise, sufficient to reproduce, maintain, modify, and create anything made by the Yautja given appropriate materials and resources.

Finally, you receive a fully customized loadout of Yautja armor, weapons, tools, and hunting gadgets of your choice, all fitted specifically for you and accompanied by the knowledge and skill required to use them to their fullest potential.
objects.title: Yautja Elder (Predator)

objects.text:
You are now a Beastman, a member of the species Homo sapiens bestia, the closest living relative to humanity. Like humans, you share a common evolutionary lineage, with your last shared ancestor diverging after Australopithecus around 2 million years ago. However, your biology is unique—your genetic code is built not from human DNA, but from a specialized substance known as Beast Deoxyribonucleic Acid, or Beast DNA. This DNA unlocks extraordinary potential within you.

In your natural form, you are an anthropomorphized version of a specific animal species, embodying its physical and instinctual traits. Yet, you possess the ability to assume a completely human form at will, in which no external signs of your beast nature are apparent. However, this transformation is not always under your control—when overwhelmed by powerful emotions like fear, anger, sadness, or excitement, your Beastman form may break through, revealing your true self.

Beyond this shape-shifting ability, the Beast Factor that courses through you grants superhuman abilities linked to your animal form. If you are a bird Beastman, you may sprout wings, granting you flight, and develop sharp talons to grasp and strike like a bird of prey. If you are a rhino Beastman, your immense strength and durability will be accompanied by a horn, turning you into a living battering ram capable of devastating force. Each Beastman’s powers are as unique as the animal they represent. You can choose which animal your Beastman form is.
objects.title: Beastmen (BNA)

addons.text:
Primus has seen you and granted you the power of a Prime. As a Prime, You’re the pinnacle of a Cybertronian, a true inheritor to the Thirteen, as such, your physical abilities have been enhanced dramatically. 

As well as being able to keep pace with, and exceed many of the greatest cybertronians, you excel in one specific field. Whether this is artifice like Solus, the might of a combiner like Nexus, Sheer physical might like Megatronus, or something stranger, it is a field in which you excel beyond the point of reason, it being as natural to you as breathing.
addons.title: Legacy of the Primes

addons.text:
You have become monstrous, a beast of Cybertron’s myth, a Sparkeater. 

At first blush you look like any other Cybertronian, unfortunately it doesn’t persist. Your mouth opens too wide, your paint chips and rusts faster than natural. However, in exchange you’re faster, stronger, and more durable than any Cybertronian your size has any right being, able to throw any mech short of a combiner with ease. 

Additionally, knotted throughout your torso are a series of four tendrils met at the end with three articulated blades you can control to a fine degree easily as strong as your arms. These blades can tear through a Cybertronian’s chassis like a knife through butter allowing you to reach the spark within like cracking a crab.

As a cybervore, your primary food source is the sparks of others. You can track these sparks across entire cities at a time. Once discovered, you’ll need to violently extract the spark in order to consume it, placing it into your chest cavity where it will be slowly digested leaving a metallic husk. Alternatively, you can use any ‘spark-like’ food source such as mystical sources or souls. Or you can simply insert humans or similar organics into your torso and reduce them to a fine pulp to extract energy from but this is vastly less efficient.
addons.title: The Nightmare with a Thousand Names

objects.text: Your body has been transformed into that of a Cybertronian, a type of technological organism native to the planet Cybertron. While larger and smaller specimens exist, you have a standard body plan, ranging from 3 to 10 m in height. Unlike normal machines, Cybertronians are composed of a type of living metal known as sentio metallico, giving them a self-replicating cellular structure and genetic code, like most organic life forms, and are powered by a rarified energon core known as a Spark. In addition to being remarkably durable, having natural lifespans typically lasting millions of years, their most notable feature is the ability to take on an alternate mode; typically, this is some sort of vehicle, though other forms, such as weapons, other machines, and even animals, are not uncommon. While you can only have one alternate mode at any given time, sentio metallico is highly malleable, and taking on a new one is as simple as scanning something else, allowing you to blend into your environment easily. You also have the ability to project a holomatter avatar, a hard light construct which can emulate the appearance of a human (or whatever the dominant species on your current planet happens to be), either to better interact with humans, or simply so you don't look like you're going around without a driver in vehicle mode.
objects.title: Cybertronian (Transformers)

objects.text:
You become part of the Incubator race, appearing as a small, cat-like creature with white fur and four ears, with one pair looking like cat ears and the other pair looking like rabbit ears with golden halos and a pink pattern of your choice on your fur.

As an incubator, you can telepathically communicate with other sapient beings, and you can choose to be invisible for everyone or only selectively appear for your chosen targets. Teleport freely to anywhere you wish. And while you gain no extra physical power, you will obtain a replicative type of immortality that, whenever you die, allows you to reappear instantaneously next to your corpse, retaining all of your powers and knowledge. You can also consume your old corpse to also restore your mana with whatever is left in the old body.

You also have the ability of creating soul gems and harvesting energy from emotions. By taking the soul out of somebody and converting it into an egg-shaped gemstone and then giving it back to them, you can grant them the ability to transform into a magical girl form, which grants them an all-around physical boost and a unique set of abilities based on their soul, as in the power called “Mahou Shoujo".

Finally, you also gain the power to grant a single wish for them, which is fueled by their magical potential, with the exceptionally talented magical girls being capable of fueling world-changing wishes.
objects.title: Incubator (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
You're an Ancient—an umbrella term for the largest group of Terran races. Ancients are humanoids adorned with bestial traits reminiscent of animals or certain mythical creatures of Earth. The extent of these features varies from individual to individual, with some resembling fully bipedal versions of the creature they're based on.

As an Ancient, you may select your race from within that group. Whether you opt to outwardly exhibit either more subtle, minimal features or pronounced ones—and to what extent—is entirely a matter of personal preference.

Moreover, to put it lightly, an Ancient is many times more physically adept than an Earthling (homo sapiens). Ex: which can range from throwing spears with the force of a .50-caliber rifle or greater, to shrugging off a bear trap as if it were a toy, or effortlessly pulling a 2,000 lb crossbow as though it were less than a quarter of the draw weight, etc.

Note that your race also plays a role in these abilities, based on the animal/creature those traits are derived from.

<small>Regardless of the race chosen, you'll stand out as an above-average individual of your kind, with the potential to grow stronger through consistent training and discipline.</small>
objects.title: Terran (Arknights)

objects.text:
An ancient and diverse coalition of tribes and sister races, the Teekaz were the original endemic race of Terra, or Kazdel in their old tongue.

And by some measure, you've become one of the races classified under the Teekaz: an umbrella group of humanoids whose features resemble monsters, demons, and particular supernatural creatures from Earth. Within this diverse collective, you can pick any race that falls under their banner, each with its own distinct strengths and weaknesses. However, the "Ten Kings" Sarkaz tribes will be off-limits to you—that said, you may still opt to be a regular Sarkaz.

On average, the Teekaz possess incredible physical prowess, letting them stand toe-to-toe with some of the strongest races among the Ancients and Elders alike, namely the Ursus, Vouivre, or Forte, as a few examples.

For reference, even the Sankta—the physically weakest among them—are heads above the most elite special forces operatives Earth can offer. Coupled with their prodigious affinity for Originium Arts and lifespans up to the centuries. It's little wonder then why they're feared and respected by the rest of Terra.

<small>Regardless of the race chosen, you'll stand out as an above-average individual of your kind, with the potential to grow stronger through consistent training and discipline.</small>
objects.title: Teekaz (Arknights)

addons.text: The blood of your ancestors and the blessing of Yaoshi runs strong in you, metamorphosing you into something more, an abomination which carries the benefits of both the Borisin and Foxian races, all the strength and regeneration of a Borisin with the dexterity and eloquence of a Foxian. Your lifespan is greatly extended, allowing you to easily live for millenia. You have a certain level of control over your Moon Rage mutations, allowing you to retain your more visually appealing Foxian form if you want to. Additionally, you can also assume a more bestial form at any time, akin to a vulpine Borisin. If you were to take this with Warhead (Honkai: Star Rail) you would be akin to a pseudo-Emanator of Yaoshi given the sheer strength of the Abundance’s blessing within your veins. Your blood would be capable of transforming other species into Foxians as well as Borisin or maybe even the same kind of Foxian/Borisin hybrid you are, albeit to a lesser level.
addons.title: Warfox

objects.text:
The more brutal of the two Children of Duran, the Borisin. 

The Borisin are a race of bipedal wolf like creatures with long lifespans and incredible regeneration. They are generally physically greater than humans to a degree.

The Borisin have 3 major abilities, Lupitoxin, Moon Rage, and endless mutation

Lupitoxin stimulates the production of fear within the bodies of other creatures to a frankly incredible degree. Moon Rage causes intense growth of the bone and muscle structure which is shortly fixed by their aforementioned regeneration. And as the Borisin consume more and more flesh they gradually grow stronger.

You may optionally pick up the skills or traits of one of the 6 major packs of Borisin. The Eclipse Pack, which mutates faster than any other of their kin via the consumption of other species’ genetic information; the Chiseltooth Pack, who are the Borisin’s masters of genetic sorcery, and make much of their biomechanical beasts, weapons, microbes, and Beast Ships; the Sableclaw Pack, who are known for terrorist tactics, concealment, hunting, and having incredibly good senses of smell; the Bloodwind pack is best known for beast riding and divination; the Rhinohound Pack is focused on more mechanical forms of technology to make powered exoskeleton armours; and the Whitewolf Pack is best known for disguise infiltration, assassination and being even more vicious and cruel than the average Borisin.
objects.title: Borisin (Honkai: Star Rail)

addons.text:
Thanks to the introduction of bioenergy into your body, all of your innate traits as a Xianzhou native have been amplified to an absurd degree.

Your physical abilities now surpass even the mightiest elder dragons, granting you the strength to toss creatures like Dalamadur or Zorah Magdaros around with ease.

Your regeneration has also become extraordinarily fast and potent. You can restore your entire body from nothing more than a pile of gore to perfect condition in under a minute. If someone attempted to decapitate you with a supersonic blade, the wound would heal faster than the sword could pass through your neck, making it appear as though the blade simply phased through you without cutting anything. However, this regeneration is not truly limitless. It draws from the bioenergy stored within your body: the more severe the damage, the more energy it consumes. As your reserves deplete, your regeneration slows accordingly.

Your Core Esse has likewise evolved into a full-fledged bioenergy generator, continuously producing and storing what is effectively an endless supply of energy. Because your body now houses such an immense reservoir of bioenergy, it undergoes constant evolution and adaptation, growing stronger over time simply by existing.

If you choose Ecology of One to unlock this add-on, you will gain immediate access to the full potential of that power, including the ability to wield every element found in both Honkai: Star Rail and the Monster Hunter universe.

If you choose The Hunter to unlock this add-on, you will gain a set of evolving weapons and armor. These armaments are innately part of your body, allowing them to share your regenerative abilities when damaged. They can also shapeshift into any type of weapon or armor you require, adapting alongside you to overcome whatever situation you face. When not needed, they can be stored away or resummoned with a mere thought through your Core Esse.

If you choose both Ecology of One and The Hunter, you gain access to an empowered state that massively boosts your abilities and renders you nearly unkillable. In this form, you can regenerate from a single scrap of DNA to full health in less than the blink of an eye and rapidly adapt to any threat. However, this state rapidly consumes both bioenergy and stamina. If used carelessly, you may deplete your reserves entirely, leaving yourself completely vulnerable afterward.
addons.title: Imperishable Vitality

objects.text:
You have become a Xianzhou native—also known as Homo Celestinae, a race of humans granted immortality by Yaoshi, the Aeon of Abundance.

Although you appear indistinguishable from an ordinary human, your internal biology is profoundly different, granting you several advantages unavailable to baseline humanity.

As a Xianzhou native, you naturally possess regenerative immortality that prevents you from aging beyond your physical prime. Any injury you sustain, so long as it is not instantly fatal, will eventually heal. While the regeneration is not fast enough to regrow a limb mid-battle, and major injuries still require time to mend, it is powerful enough that you could even survive decapitation, provided your head is reattached quickly.

However, this regeneration comes with a drawback: your body constantly tries to return to its default state. As a result, most cybernetic implants and biological modifications ultimately fail, as your body rejects and expels them over time.

Like all Xianzhou natives, you possess a special organ known as the Core Esse, the source of your regenerative immortality. When properly activated, the Core Esse unlocks your full potential, granting superhuman strength, enough to lift and wield weapons weighing thousands of pounds with ease, and the ability to manipulate elemental forces.

The Core Esse also serves as a natural reservoir and engine for internal energy. This gives every Xianzhou native the latent potential to become an exceptional martial artist or cultivator. It is said that when the Core Esse awakens for the first time, a Xianzhou native instantly gains the equivalent of a century of martial cultivation. However, this awakening is difficult to trigger and usually occurs only in life-or-death situations.

You, however, are unique among the Xianzhou. Neither you nor your descendants are susceptible to becoming Mara-struck, unlike other long-lived beings. In addition, your Core Esse is already fully activated, granting you superhuman physical abilities and mastery over an element of your choice.
objects.title: XianZhou Native (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
You’ve survived the Meta-Morph surgery and become a MANTIS, a human granted strength by being grafted with modified Honkai genes called Meta-Morph ICHOR. MANTIS all have the instinctual urge to undergo Active Honkai Reaction, transforming them into the form of the Honkai Beast that make up their genes. Unlike other MANTIS, you will not have to actively suppress this urge constantly but heightened emotions might cause you to cascade and lose control triggering the transformation.

You may choose to have the genes of nearly any Honkai Beast, as long as its strength does not surpass that of Emperor-class, gaining all of its abilities for yourself.

Regardless of the specific abilities of your chosen Honkai Beast, you also gain the basic abilities common to all other MANTIS. Physical enhancements that let you strike with strength surpassing ballistic artillery with the durability to match, movement speed many times above the speed of sound and biological immortality that completely halts your aging along with removing any need for food, water and air.

You also gain Honkai Resistance and Adaptability at a level that allows you to fight against Judgement-class Honkai Beasts, although trying to do anything other than hold off a Herrscher as you are now would be an uphill battle. The manipulation of Honkai energy allows you to perform a wide variety of feats that range from simply enhancing your already superhuman strength to applying elemental effects, healing and regeneration, resisting esoteric phenomena and even stopping time. Unfortunately, anything beyond the basic reinforcement application will be a challenge to learn and develop, trying to replicate the Herrscher’s Time Fracture for example may take you centuries to even recreate without any aid.
objects.title: MANTIS (Honkai Impact 3rd)

addons.title: Embrace Finality
addons.text:
You are Kiana Kaslana, adapted to your identity and chosen reality. You may begin at any point in her growth, inheriting the memories, skills, and relationships established by then, with later benefits awakening immediately or through matching growth.

You have passed the Cocoon’s test and become its chosen bearer of Finality. Your connection persists across worlds, including those without Honkai. If the original Cocoon is destroyed, its Authority remains within you, allowing you to sustain and eventually reproduce its functions.

You may manifest Kiana’s Herrscher of Finality battlesuit and weapons, altering their appearance to express your identity. These manifestations of your Authority may be summoned, repaired, reshaped, or dismissed at will. You inherit her final combat style, integrating martial skill with her Herrscher Authorities.

You safely contain the energy drawn toward Finality, releasing only what you intend. Your presence never causes an eruption unless permitted.

You inherit Kiana’s victory over the cycle. Repeating apocalypses and systems demanding civilization’s destruction have no claim over you or those you protect. Through Finality, you can eventually overturn such cycles.

objects.text:
You descend from Kevin Kaslana and Dr. MEI through House Kaslana. You are neither Kevin’s clone nor reincarnation and inherit none of his memories or completed power, only his family’s stabilized legacy.

Your body contains an inheritable form of the MANTIS genome Kevin received from Parvati, an Emperor-class Honkai Beast. You required no Meta-Morph surgery; generations of refinement made these genes compatible with your other species and genetics. You neither radiate Kevin’s lethal cold nor become trapped in an Active Honkai Reaction.

Even unawakened, you can lift twenty-five metric tons. You can run, leap, and fight under ten times Earth’s gravity. Your other attributes are proportionally superhuman, letting you redirect vehicles, survive building-shattering impacts, and follow combat ordinary humans cannot. Training raises these benchmarks.

Natural terrestrial cold is harmless to you. Supernatural cold, absolute zero, and immunity-piercing effects can still threaten you until your inheritance develops.

Your internal energy sustains rapid regeneration. Cuts close in seconds; broken bones and damaged organs mend within minutes. If you remain alive, normally lethal cranial or internal trauma heals within hours. Initially, you cannot regrow limbs, rebuild a destroyed body, or resurrect, though awakening strengthens this healing.

You can absorb, store, and channel Honkai energy that would corrupt or kill ordinary humans. Without Honkai, this resistance adapts to similar corruptive, mutagenic, or transformative energies, protecting you without granting mastery over them.

The natural Kaslana Stigma is engraved within you, preserving your adaptability, combat instincts, growth, and MANTIS potential. Meditation, dreams, crises, or awakening may draw you into its Stigma Space, which contains the bloodline’s trials, memories, and remnants. Exploring it reveals family history and teaches control, but its knowledge and techniques must be understood and earned.

Awakening your Parvati genes improves every physical attribute, regeneration, Honkai capacity, resistance, and combat perception. Your ice affinity advances from chilling objects and creating frost to generating ice, freezing battlefields, suppressing heat, and weaponizing temperatures far below those naturally found on Earth.

Partial transformations manifest selected Parvati traits. A complete Active Honkai Reaction initially multiplies your physical performance tenfold, letting you lift at least 250 metric tons with proportional striking force, speed, durability, and stamina while greatly enhancing regeneration and cold manipulation. These are starting benchmarks; training and evolution can raise them without a fixed ceiling.

Early transformations may cause aggression, bloodlust, mutation, or difficulty recognizing allies. Discipline eventually lets you transform freely, manifest individual traits, control the degree of change, and retain your mind.

You are highly compatible with Divine Keys, Stigmata, battlesuits, and Honkai equipment, enduring their backlash better than ordinary wielders. This grants no equipment, and powerful releases may still injure you. Your protective drive strengthens resistance to fear, despair, corruption, possession, and mental interference without overriding your will.

You may inherit House Kaslana’s silver-white hair and blue eyes, blend them with your appearance, or retain your coloration. This legacy passes to descendants without dilution, granting the natural Stigma, Honkai adaptability, and MANTIS potential; you decide whether artificial children receive it.

You begin far below Kevin. With training, you may equal or surpass Kallen, Siegfried, or Bianka in using the bloodline. Reaching Kevin’s complete MANTIS power or transcendent state requires extraordinary growth or additional powers: your ancestry grants the path, not the achievement.
objects.title: Kaslana (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
You have become a member of one of the tribes of the Serpentine, a race of cold-blooded humanoid snakes. Physically, the Serpentine race possesses humanoid bodies with snake-like heads, except for the leaders of each tribe, and all Anacondrai possess long serpent tails rather than legs.

Notably, the Serpentine race is divided into five tribes with differing abilities. These tribes are the Hypnobrai, Fangpyre, Constrictai, Venomari, and Anacondrai.

The Hypnobrai have the ability to hypnotize those who maintain eye contact with them. Further, they can place post-hypnotic commands in an individual, turning them into a sleeper agent that they can perceive out of the eyes of. It should be noted that should a reflective surface be used, a Hypnobrai’s hypnosis could be turned against them.

The Fangpyre have the ability to produce a venom that can turn those they bite into snakes, be they living beings or objects. Simple beings or objects will gain snake-like traits immediately, but more complex lifeforms like humans will slowly transform over time. In the accidental case where a Fangpyre bites themselves, they will permanently grow a second head.

The Constrictai have super strength that allows them to borrow and dig through like a drill, and perform a constricting grip that grows harder to escape the more the target struggles, but conversely becomes easier to escape the more the target relaxes.

The Venomari possess the ability to spray out a hallucinogenic venom. Said hallucinations tend to be in the form of the target's worst fears. They also possess immunity to acids and toxins, and are able to lie in pools of such substances for hours without issue.

The Anacondrai possess the greatest physical capabilities among the Serpentine, able to move fast enough to appear as a blur to the human eye, lift and smash through boulders, and endure just as much force. Notably, they also possess fireproof scales, the ability to turn invisible, and the ability to consume whole prey that rivals themselves in size.

Finally, it should be noted that, like all Serpentine, you are vulnerable to the melody of a snake charming flute, which can cause you pain, weaken or negate your abilities, and control you.
objects.title: Serpentine (LEGO Ninjago)

objects.text:
Your physiology has been altered, transforming you into an Insect Human after inhaling the Jungle Juice pesticide (also known as Power Killer) while using it to kill an organism. This organism is known as your Complex, and you may choose which creature you are a hybrid of. The pesticide covers the entire phylum of Arthropoda. Some exceptions exist, such as Hwanyeong Yu, who has both the Firefly and Cordyceps Complexes, granting her healing abilities due to the latter.

Insect Humans exhibit a wide range of appearances. Some retain a mostly human form with practical insect-like mutations such as wings, a tail, or insect legs, enabling them to blend into human society. Others, however, develop monstrous, insectoid forms, making it nearly impossible for them to live among humans without being noticed.

As an Insect Human, you possess superhuman abilities unique to your Complex. These include enhanced strength, durability, stamina, speed, and agility. For example, an Ant Complex would allow you to lift up to 1 ton, while a Bee Complex would grant you the ability to produce and manipulate honey. A Tiger Beetle Complex would allow you to move at supersonic speeds.

Each Insect Human can develop special techniques called Defense Mechanisms, which take advantage of their insect traits. These techniques can be enhanced through training. For example, Suchan Jang’s "Hunting Rifle" enables him to fly at high speeds and crash into opponents, while Dowha Cheon’s "The Gauntlet" covers her in scorpion armor, increasing her strength in percentages.

Insect Humans can grow stronger by learning about their Complex and training their natural abilities. However, the darkest method of gaining power involves consuming other Insect Humans. While this can enhance their abilities through continuous feeding, it leads to addiction and causes them to lose control, entering a state known as "Blackout." In this state, their sclera turns black, their feral instincts take over, and they gain significant power, but at the cost of their humanity.
objects.title: Insect Human (Jungle Juice)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of viral organisms from the world of Resident Evil has helped you refine your nature as an Evolved, granting you abilities and traits derived from a select number of viruses.

From Las Plagas, you gain the ability to infect and control organisms without needing to consume them. You can distribute your consciousness, allowing portions of your biomass to act independently while remaining linked; the loss of one node will not cripple the whole.

With the G-Virus, instead of merely reallocating your biomass to regenerate, you re-actively evolve in response to damage—transforming an arm into a new combat form mid-injury. Even if you were to be “killed” you could rebuild your body over time without external biomass, making it nearly impossible for you to be truly eradicated. Additionally, independent biomass that is scattered or separated from you can survive for extended periods, eventually allowing regeneration from even the smallest fragment.

The T-Virus grants you the ability to create purpose-built forms, such as antifreeze cells for the Arctic or toxin-filtering organs for heavily contaminated environments. You also gain the ability to transform areas into virus-friendly zones, populating them with creatures made from your biomass or mutated infected under your control. Your mutation speed is increased, shortening the time between environmental exposure and optimal adaptation, and enabling combat evolution without conscious planning.

The C-Virus grants abilities such as multi-form simultaneity, allowing one arm to become a hammerfist while another forms a shield simultaneously. Sections of your body can also detach and fight independently, with each section retaining limited intelligence.

The Uroboros Virus enhances you with a vastly increased absorption rate, allowing you to devour entire crowds of organisms—and even vehicles—in seconds. You gain the ability to transform into kaiju-sized constructs composed entirely of biomass, and every organism you absorb improves you without any downsides.

Finally, through the Megamycete, you can store absorbed memories like an archive within your mind and even perfectly recreate individuals you have consumed, restoring them without degradation or loss. You can spread your essence across entire urban areas, turning buildings, terrain, and organisms into extensions of your awareness—granting you total sensory dominance within infected zones.
addons.title: Refined Evolved

addons.text:
Through the power of the Hercules Method, the Blacklight Virus that makes up your body has evolved drastically beyond its normal parameters.

Your body is no longer a semi-formless mass of bio matter that only appears normal on the surface, but now is able to perfectly mimic the full biology of your original form or the form of whatever unfortunate creature you absorb. 

This has drastically increased all of your abilities exponentially as your control over the Backlight Virus of your body becomes absolutely perfect to the atomic level, while also allowing nigh-instant transformation in any way imaginable.

The speed at which you grow stronger through the Hercules Method reaches light speed as you no longer need to suffer, slowly transforming your body beyond the limits of normal flesh. You gain mastery that would normally take years in a matter of days, reaching the level of its creator and beyond within a few years at most. 

Through this combination, your ability to grow stronger through adaptation and evolution has become turbocharged, allowing rapid evolution towards any path you wish. Additionally, with some effort, you could turn yourself into a bio-punk factory, creating complex biological creations made purely from your own body's bio matter.

Should you possess any other Hercules Method addons, they will also benefit from the light-speed rate at which you can master the Hercules Method.
addons.title: The Black Method
The Powerhouse Of The Cell (Parasite Eve)
addons.text:
You have gained control over your mitochondria, through a combination of your self-biokinesis & your advanced knowledge of molecular biology. In particular, your knowledge of parasites has granted insight into the relationship between cells & mitochondria, as well as the incredible power found therein.

Through your control of mitochondria, you can alter your form, rapidly heal from injuries & cure yourself of ailments, revive yourself from death, manipulate & produce heat or electromagnetism, force others to spontaneously combust, assess the condition & weaknesses of your enemies, mutate them to your whims, make them sluggish & slow, confuse them, steal their mitochondrial energy for your own use, give yourself armor, make yourself faster, & turn into a powerful flying "super-form" by letting your mitochondria run amok. You can also take over the bodies of other people, called "Overdiving". Mysteriously, you can even time travel this way.

objects.text:
You have been infected with the Blacklight Virus, a weaponized variant of the Redlight Virus, which has transformed you into a sentient living mass of biological material with limitless potential. You have gained control over your body through the virus, allowing you to create weapons from your body, such as swords, claws, whips, or any other form your imagination can conceive using biomass. Additionally, your senses—vision, smell, and hearing—are vastly superior.

When you consume the biomass of another being, you absorb their memories, powers, and skills acquired during their life. By consuming the biomass of others, you can enhance your abilities, increasing attributes like durability, strength, and various physical and mental traits. You also can shapeshift, altering your form using your biological control or emulating the forms of those you consume. However, as you consume more biomass, your overall density will increase.

Your regenerative capabilities are exceptional, allowing you to survive gunfire or even tank fire without issue, as long as you have access to biomass. The only event that could cause significant destruction to your body would be a nuclear blast. Even in such a case, as long as a small portion of your blood remains, you shall regenerate. 

The evolution of your virus grants you access to a wide array of new abilities with time and biomass. The virus seeks to combine with everything it encounters, driving it to evolve to new heights by integrating with different viruses or biological data and becoming more potent.
objects.title: Blacklight Virus (Prototype)

addons.text:
Seems mom didn't leave you with nothing. Locked away in a space pocket accessible through your holographic computer are three red gems.

These gems look like the crystals you can generate from your body. But they are immutable and unbreakable. Unlike your crystals these don't just help you control yourself but greatly enhances you.

 Your senses are far greater, able to track through scent and hear even the faintest sounds from miles away. Strongest amongst your senses is your eyesight, now able to see a rock on the moon from Earth. See multiple wavelengths and in absolute darkness. A necessity in deep space. Your sense of taste on the other hand is still below average.

 You can now move at light-speed, please don't do this on or near a planet as you still have to contend with physics. You're now strong enough to punch a mountain to rubble, and durable enough to be hit by a falling meteor. You can now regenerate from even the smallest bit of yourself, even your own ashes. 

Your energy attacks are now stronger and faster. You can fire off a full power blast in an instant strong enough that you can turn a city into a crater. You can teleport to anywhere you have been in the past.

You now have several new powers. Low level telepathy able to feel and communicate with nearby minds. Touch based technomancy able to understand and repair machines. But you must be touching their inner parts not their casing. Some control over water and earth. With water you can create whirlpools and waterspouts. With earth you can move and shape it to do things like make large hands to grab with.

You can split yourself into six different bodies but this weakens you until they either recombine or five of them die and the last recovers.

Finally you can use negative emotions in an area to summon and control evil spirits. These can't be hurt by physical means. The more negative emotions lingering in an area the stronger the spirit.
 
The combination of telepathy, technomancy, and your own brain lets you connect on both a conscious and subconscious level with your holocomputer. You now passively learn at all times and whenever you wonder about something you can reach out to the holocomputer for help.
addons.title: Mother's Keepsakes

objects.text:
You are an artificial deity created by an actual goddess as an experiment. Part god, part crystalline computer, and part incredibly dense, hyper adaptive alien sea urchin. Your eyes are yellow, your ears are long and rectangular, and while you have better senses then humans your sense of taste is nearly nonexistent.

 Able to survive without breath or food and water. Age means very little to you, at 5,000 you will still be a teen and stop aging entirely once in your prime. Your mind is like a computer. You never forget anything, you can analyses whatever you encounter cataloguing every detail and constantly cross referencing things on a subconscious level. This combined with your senses makes you highly perceptive and helps you learn at an accelerated pace.

 You can run and fly quick enough to reach escape velocity, are strong enough to topple a large building, and durable enough to only be annoyed when said building falls on you. Regenerate from just your bones, astral project yourself, turn intangible, and teleport within eyesight.

 You able to fire energy from any part of your body. These blasts are a combination of heat and kinetic energy. The more you fire at once the less powerful they are. Inversely the larger the blasts the more time it take to make. At best one large blast can wreck a city street but takes a good four seconds to charge, at worst you can instantly hit tens of thousands of enemies hard enough to irritate them. Or you can keep the energy in your hand and use it as a energy blade.

 Your power tends to fluctuate giving you a hard time controlling yourself. Trying to punch a boulder might turn into a hit as weak as a child's. Or slapping your friend's back may be deadly. You can fix this with a tiring process that forces your body to create a round red crystal. Embedding these in your body will balance your energies and grant great control over yourself. Having three will put you at peak performance at all times in every way. Exact control over your body, and energy. These crystals tend to shatter if over stressed too much at one time.
objects.title: Artificial Chousin (Tenchi Muyo)

objects.text:
You are an astral, people of the stars and the astral realm. Your god abandoned the Sky realm to its Sky God twin, Bahamut (not to be confused with Bahamut the omnipotent) and ascended to a new existence. As one of its chosen people, you are blessed by the Star God of Creation and Immortality.

These blessings mean you possess immense magical power, portions of its own divinity, limitless mana, everlasting immortality from lacking a concept of death and destruction, and lastly, the divine power to create matter and energy from where none existed before. Ergo, creating things ex nihilo and being negentropic.

With this might, you’re a blessed conqueror hoping to assist your god in merging with its twin to become omnipotent once again. Let all future conquests quake and kneel before your superior technology, immense knowledge, and mastery over the very fundamentals of creation.
objects.title: Astral (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text:
You've become a Moon Dweller. 20,000 years ago, your people fled from the world’s catastrophe aboard a silver city ship to colonize the moon. To survive these harsh conditions and environments, advanced technology beyond the Sky Realm was employed with extensive cybernetic and nanotechnological bodily modifications that have left many hyper-logical and emotionally shunted.

Fortunately, you do not suffer this drawback, with the best government and military combat augmentations money could buy granted to you, giving you an unparalleled metabolism capable of digesting and assimilating any material, along with superhuman strength and endurance. These augmentations also bestow a “sixth sense”; this heightened perception allows you to see the world in four dimensions, meaning you can glimpse past, present, and future along a higher-dimensional axis, manipulate minds or machines, and endure endless battles without rest.

Also, you do not need to fear death, as a cloned body (with a backup of all your memories included) will be provided each time you face your end. Remember, your bodies are now so durable that it takes the disintegration of your molecules to put you down.

Now go, proud descendant and claim new territory for your people.
objects.title: Moon Dweller (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text: You are now an Ice Elf, also known as a Hyakki or Ice Slayer. You look similar to humans but instead have blue skin, white hair, piercing white eyes that almost seem to glow, and long, pointed elven ears. As an Ice Elf, you’re naturally skilled with both archery and daggers, handling them with speed and precision. You also have a natural ability to infuse your weapons with ice magic, turning arrows and blades into tools of frozen destruction. While you don’t know advanced ice spells yet, you have a strong connection to this magic, so learning more will come naturally with time and practice. You also have a natural ability to thrive in cold environments, able to survive harsh, frozen landscapes with minimal resources. Like all Ice Elves, you have the skill [Stealth]. This skill lets you blend into your surroundings so completely that you become invisible, both physically and magically. It’s incredibly useful for sneaking past enemies or setting up the perfect ambush. However, it costs a big chunk of mana to activate and continues to drain your energy while it’s running. You have the potential to equal Baruka.
objects.title: Ice Elf (Solo Leveling)

addons.text: The combined power of the Monarchs of Shadow, Frost, and Destruction has given rise to a new being greater than its predecessors. You now bear the combined power of all the Monarchs shown in  the Solo Leveling series, which also includes Sung Suho. From Baran’s lightning to Querehsha’s poisons, all of their powers are at your disposal. The armies of the Monarchs now swear loyalty to you as well.
addons.title: The Bringer of Ragnarok

addons.text:
The world of Monster Hunter is for all intents and purposes ruled by the living forces of nature known as Elder Dragons. As you are the King of Dragons, why should you not rule over it? You possess the full power of the Monster Hunter ecosystem at your disposal. You can generate any element or combination of elements (Emperor’s Roar, Crimson Demon, Tenshou, etc) shown in the Monster Hunter at the same level of power and control as your fire magic. 

You can even give yourself the biological adaptations of the monsters, like enhancing your blows with explosive Brachydios mold, arming yourself with the natural chain blades of Arkveld, or generating and controlling a sea of liquid metal like Harudomeguru. Any outside forces needed for these adaptations are compensated for with your magic. All of these adaptations are scaled up to match with your Monarch physiology, and you have full control over them. Finally, all of the monsters in Monster Hunter are your subjects and join your army of destruction, allowing you to summon and command them. Even the mighty White Fatalis will bend to your will.
addons.title: King of all Elder Dragons

addons.text:
You have gained the power of Acnologia, the Arcane Dragon Slayer. Acnologia is capable of absorbing any type of magic in Earth Land, but your status as a Monarch allows you to go one step further. You are capable of understanding and using any of the magic shown in the Fairy Tail series. This includes Lost Magics like Arc of Time and the Black Arts. If the magic requires an item to use, you can create it with your own power. 

You can even wield abilities like the Curses of the Etherious, the Spirit Arts of Elentear, and Alchemy. All of the mentioned abilities are scaled up to befit your power as a Monarch. Finally, you can naturally create Lacrima to pass on some of your power to others. Those who take in this Lacrima will undergo partial dragonification and become loyal to you. You do not have to worry about motion sickness or any of the other issues associated with dragons.
addons.title: Arcane King of all Dragons

addons.text:
You have inherited the full power of every dragon within the Elden Ring universe, wielding complete control and mastery over their abilities. This includes glintstone, ice, ghostflame, Fortissax’s death lightning, the frozen lightning of the Dragonkin Soldiers, and Bayle the Dread’s flame lightning, along with full mastery over Dragon Cult and Dragon Communion incantations.

Most notably, you possess the might of Placidusax at his peak. You command the red lightning of the ancient dragons with unrivaled precision, unleash searing golden flame in devastating, laser-like blasts, summon ferocious storms, and shift into a mist form for swift and ethereal movement.

Above all, your body functions as an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone incarnate—capable of warping time itself. This divine trait allows you to strike down gods on par with the Elden Beast and grants your existence the ability to transcend time entirely.
addons.title: Dragonlord of Destruction

objects.text:
You have become the heir of Antares, the Monarch of Destruction and King of Dragons. This grants you immense strength, speed, and durability far greater than that of the Shadow Monarch, along with the ability to alter your appearance at will and communicate telepathically. You also gain immense mastery of fire magic, to the point where you can create massive explosions using a few streams of fire. 

Your two primary skills are Dragon’s Fear and Breath of Destruction. Dragon’s Fear is a mana infused shout that can drive enemies weaker than you into a state of immense despair and panic. Breath of Destruction is an immense torrent of fire that can be released from your mouth or hands at around the speed of light with enough power to reduce the average S-Rank Hunter to ashes, destroy immortal summons, and even permanently scar beings as powerful as Sung Jinwoo.

Like the other Monarchs, you possess the ability of Spiritual Body Manifestation.  This grants you the ability to transform into your true form of an enormous red dragon, or a human-dragon hybrid. You can manifest parts of your true dragon form while still in a humanoid form, like striking your opponents with a massive dragon claw.

Finally, you inherit Antares’s army of dragons. They can assume a human form and are completely loyal to you. Any draconic beings you encounter in future worlds will obey your commands.
objects.title: Monarch of Destruction (Solo Leveling)

addons.text:
This procedure perfected the spotty procedure done to you. You're not some half-Yoma always at risk of falling into a cannibalistic frenzy should you use too much Yoki. No, you can use all your Yoki now without fear. Your surgical scar is gone, and your overall powers are at the level of a Number 1. You have great talent in manipulating Yoki, allowing you to use Youjutsu to more easily create techniques, and it would not be hard for you to recreate all the known techniques used by other Claymores.

Your Awakened Form is more of your true form—you can completely awaken and revert back as you wish, without care. Its power is equal to an Abyssal One. If you were a No. 1 Claymore already, then your overall power is on the level of Teresa, and your Awakened Form grows to match.
addons.title: Asarakam

objects.text:
You have undergone a surgical procedure that involves an incision from your throat to your pelvis, during which some flesh from an Asarakam, also known as Dragonkin, was implanted in your body before being stitched back up. Through this procedure, you become Half-Yoma, gaining pale or silver hair, silver eyes, an immortal lifespan, potentially elfish ears, and Yoki. The incision is unhealable with your Claymore abilities unless you awaken.

This grants you a significant increase in physical abilities, allowing you to move faster than a human can track, possess the strength of at least ten grown men, and survive on only a tiny amount of food each week with no waste produced. You require no more than an hour of sleep per week at most and have regeneration powerful enough to reattach limbs, which heal in seconds, or even regenerate a new limb in minutes if you flare your Yoki.

Yoki is the greatest advantage of a Claymore. At all times, you naturally use 0% of your Yoki, but by tapping into more, you can greatly enhance your abilities or even create unique techniques—such as swinging your arm so fast that your sword moves at multiple times the speed of sound or extending your arm well beyond its normal range. However, using Yoki irresponsibly is dangerous.

At 10% Yoki usage, your eyes turn gold, and your pupils become slit. At 30%, your face begins distorting into something monstrous. At 50%, your entire body takes on a more monstrous form, granting you a massive increase in power. Your theoretical limit is 80%, and giving in to anger can cause you to unconsciously use more and more Yoki.

Anything beyond this will cause you to completely lose control and transform into an Awakened Being—a man-eating Yoma. This new form vastly surpasses your previous one in power, and you may even regain the ability to take human form. However, your mind will be so warped that if you previously had reservations about killing, now it would simply feel like mealtime. Depending on your mental fortitude before awakening, the changes could be minor, or you might no longer be recognizable as yourself. It is possible to also stop yourself from completely transforming past 80% if you have a very powerful strength of will or connections with others, succeeding in this will allow you to temporarily go over 80% in short bursts without fear of completely transforming.

You gain a Claymore—your namesake weapon—which is indestructible, and somewhat esoteric. This weapon is considered an Object of Power. You also receive the traditional Claymore uniform.
objects.title: Claymore (Claymore)

objects.text: Dragon teeth, dragon tail, burnin' dragon fire, A real live wire! American Dragon! You are now a fully-fledged member of the Order of the Dragon and a World Dragon. This means that you are a dragon and are capable of fulfilling this important responsibility. World Dragons hold a position of authority and are designated to serve as protectors and mediators among the various species and members of the Magical Community hidden around the globe. Each World Dragon is tasked with overseeing a specific portion of the world, typically the country where they reside, but they may also be assigned larger or smaller territories. They are trusted to exercise good judgment, and barring intervention from the Dragon Council, their authority is final. You may choose a territory in the world to guard and protect as your own. As for the powers of a dragon, dragons are beings that are born and grow up appearing to be human, possessing an innate source of draconic magic. This magic remains mostly dormant until the dragon reaches approximately 13 years of age, at which point it begins to manifest more fully. One of a dragon's most well-kept secrets is their ability to shapeshift or transform between their human and dragon forms. This transformation can be complete or partial, depending on the dragon's needs. Over time, the shape of the dragon form will gradually change, reflecting the dragon's growth and personal evolution. The colors of the dragon form typically match the dragon's favorite clothes or colors. In their dragon form, dragons can fly even without wings, relying on magic to achieve speed and maneuverability in the air. Their teeth and claws can easily shred steel. Their tail is long, with impressive strength and the ability to extend itself to lengths significant enough to bind targets with it. A dragon's most notable ability is their breath weapon; most dragons can breathe fire at will, though some may breathe other elements, such as ice or lightning. The hide of a dragon's form is covered in tough, magic-resistant scales, making them highly resistant to damage. However, be cautious, as there are weak points within this protection, particularly on the underbelly and behind the ears. There are additional powers and features that you will have the opportunity to discover and develop over time, but those are yours to explore. Lastly, be wary of Sphinx Hair; dragons have a weakness to this material. Prolonged exposure can even render a dragon unconscious.
objects.title: Dragon Up! (American Dragon)

addons.text:
Through your nonhuman heritage and access to thaumaturgy, you’ve awakened a dormant magical bloodline. This rare lineage greatly enhances your innate sensitivity to EVE fluctuations and amplifies your ability to manipulate ARad fields.

Unlike most other Type Blues, your bloodline acts as a natural conduit, granting you more intuitive control over thaumaturgic phenomena. More importantly, your magical heritage is attuned to a specific branch of practice—one that demonstrates greater stability, reduced backlash, and a remarkable capacity for spontaneous variation.

In addition, your magical bloodline has fused with your nonhuman heritage, granting you an instinctive understanding of related forms of thaumaturgy—such as draconic fire manipulation or fae illusions—and the ability to easily develop new techniques within that domain.
addons.title: Magical Bloodline

addons.text: Through your nonhuman heritage and divine touch, you have awakened a dormant divine bloodline. This rare lineage greatly enhances your innate resistance to Akiva Radiation and amplifies your ability to invoke miracles. Unlike most other Type Blacks, your bloodline acts as a natural conduit for a single Divine Domain to manifest; this domain represents a single concept or symbol. These can be natural phenomena like light or fire, more exotic metaphysical phenomena like thaumaturgy, or social constructs like war or the law. Even without followers or faith, you can use miracles from this domain freely, though their power is tied to your bloodline and starts at street-level potency, growing as your bloodline grows instead of being affected by the faith you have. However, you suffer no erosion from using this domain or its miracles. Your bloodline also acts as an anchor, as you can lean into being a god of your chosen domain to resist the eroding effects of the weight of faith. This resistance is only as potent as your bloodline is, so the stronger your bloodline, the more faith you can withstand.
addons.title: Divine Bloodline

addons.text:
Your partial transformation can now extend into your Type Indigo cybernetics. By drawing deeper on your hybrid nature, you can temporarily manifest advanced mechanical augmentations.

The basic use allows you to summon enhanced versions of your innate cybernetics, temporarily improving their output, efficiency, or specialized functions beyond their normal state.

You may also manifest different cybernetic modules not originally part of your body, such as sensor suites, reinforced limbs, integrated tools, or specialized weapon systems such as shoulder mounted missile launchers. These begin at lower-grade same as the starting cybernetics from Type Indigo, place strain on your body, and disappear once dismissed or overused.

Repeated use allows these temporary augmentations to adapt and improve over time. Through continued summoning and training, they can develop in the same way as your original cybernetics, becoming more refined, stable, and powerful.
addons.title: Machine Coolantline

objects.text:
You are a Type Pink—a human hybrid. Your humanity has fused with a nonhuman heritage of your choice, granting you a supernatural trait. Choose a single nonhuman lineage—such as dragon, fae, or direwolf—and gain one major feature from it. This might be a fae’s wings, a direwolf’s nose, or a dragon’s scales. In addition to this primary trait, you also develop a few minor passive traits based on your chosen heritage—like a fae’s natural charm or a direwolf’s bestial instinct. You can reveal or hide your features at will, freely shifting between your human and hybrid appearance.

You also possess the ability of partial transformation, allowing you to temporarily manifest additional traits by tapping deeper into your lineage—like sprouting extra heads if you chose a hydra, or additional limbs if your heritage was an asura. These transformations come at a cost, placing strain on your body the longer they are used.

Your connection to your heritage begins weak, with all your features starting around street-level potency. However, with time and dedication, your bond will strengthen. Partial transformations will gradually unlock new features and traits. Eventually, you may even achieve a full transformation into your nonhuman form. The time and difficulty required for this depend on the strength of your lineage—becoming a squirrel might take a few days, while transforming into a phoenix could demand decades of training.
objects.title: Type Pink (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: You are a Chimera, a Nature Spirit born to uphold the balance of the world, capable of communing with Nature and wildlife alike. Once, you stood as an apex among your kind, a master of form, a force of creation and destruction alike. The wilds answered your call, life bent to your will—but as all things must, you fell. Death took you, and when you returned, you were diminished—reborn as human with your past sealed away, waiting to be reclaimed. Chimeras are shapeshifters, each bound to creatures that lived during their lifetime. The most ancient among them remember beasts long lost to time, their bodies shifting between leviathans and titans of lands forgotten. But power among your kind is not equal. The lowest are Changelings, bound to a single form—a reflection of their personality. Swarms exist as countless smaller selves—as a legion of their given creature. Skin Dancers shift fluidly within a single genus, while Beast Masters, unbound by such limitations, command any creature in their vast memory. At the pinnacle stand the True Chimeras, the rarest and most formidable. They hold the power of those below them but transcend them entirely, weaving together traits from multiple creatures to forge bodies that defy common sense. It was from them that myths were born—harpies, centaurs, dragons, beings that shouldn't exist, etc. And unlike Swarms, they divide and reform, becoming flocks, tides of any beasts they so desire, shifting endlessly. Their dominion extends beyond the flesh—forests twist at their whisper, roots strike on command, and plants become living extensions of their will, able to manipulate life itself. They are not just Nature's servants. But also its hands and executioners. And once, you stood among them—not just as another True Chimera, but something beyond even that. A force to rival Ralabast—the first and mightiest of your kind, your twin, your equal. Together, you shaped the world and bent the sky and earth to your whims. But death stole more from you than most, leaving you caged in lesser flesh. Now, you awaken as a fragment of what you once were—a Skin Dancer, bound to a single genus, capable of dissolving into swarms of any creature within that genus, but nothing more, for now. Yet even diminished, your nature remains. As a Chimera, you'll also heal faster than most, wounds closing in minutes and hours instead of days or weeks. In time, through hardship and revelation, you'll reclaim what was lost. Whether through patient rediscovery or the crucible of struggle, you will remember. And when you do, the world will tremble once more.
objects.title: Chimera (Urban Animal)

addons.text:
Your ability to devour others’ bodies and even souls to grow your own power has merged with your other ability to devour others’ bodies to gain some of their power. This has created a new ability—one that allows you, instead of just naturally eating someone, to absorb them by simply eating a portion of them, like some of their hair. Doing it this way will rapidly absorb them into you, granting you one of their abilities, powers, magics, skills, etc., while also giving your own current overall power a boost on top of it. Any beings absorbed by you can be summoned again as familiars with all their powers. If they're destroyed and you fail to reabsorb their body, then you will lose them as a familiar but keep any powers you gained already. Beings significantly stronger than you need to be eaten the normal way.

You also have the option to select up to 9 different beings that, if you eat or absorb, you will gain all of their power, traits, and abilities. Each one is stored in one of your tails, and summoning them will not suffer the same risk if they die, as they will naturally be absorbed back into you. You can choose to remove any of these specific beings from being in one of your tails, thereby losing most of the benefits you gained from them. You cannot put a being you removed from your tail back into that position.
addons.title: Beast of Cherishment

addons.text:
Your two natures of an evil fox spirit and demonic cultivator have fused. Unlike others, your spirit does not resist chaotic or destructive corruptive power. Your very essence is perfectly suited to it, becoming one in nature with its flow. The volatile energy that corrupts lesser cultivators is perfectly absorbed and stabilized within you, aligning effortlessly with your nature. 

You will no longer be twisted by it or consumed by its madness. Instead of drifting away from who you were, you remain entirely yourself, no matter how far you rise. Every being you consume strengthens you without consequence, and your cultivation accelerates far beyond what should be possible. Each act of feeding advances your growth in a fraction of the time it would take any normal cultivator, and the souls you consume now yield far more of the power they once held.

As your strength increases, so does the depth of what you can take. In the beginning, you absorb fragments such as traits, abilities, or instincts. But with time and growth, you begin to extract more—skills, talents, connections, even their fate itself and other esoteric things can be pulled into you, with everything they had. The more powerful you become, the more complete the transfer. What once required consuming the entire body may one day need only the slightest contact. There is no fixed limit to what you can claim, only what you are strong enough to carry.

Finally, you have also gained the ability to perfectly mimic those you consume. Even a small remnant is enough: blood left behind, a torn scrap of flesh, anything that once belonged to them. From that trace alone, you can assume their full identity in body, behavior, and presence. You copy their voice, mannerisms, energy, and aura with no flaws. However, this mimicry does not grant you their powers, only their appearance and presence. You can hold multiple forms at once, switching between them at will.
addons.title: Eater of All Faces

objects.text:
If people first see you, they would think you're but a simple nine-tailed kitsune. They would probably be lured in, thinking you're harmless or even beneficial. But in reality, you're something much worse.

As a Gumiho, you have the ability to shapeshift between various humanoid forms or the form of a nine-tailed kitsune. Unless you concentrate perfectly, you may fail to completely hide what you are, which could lead to things such as tails or ears being visible. Your physical abilities are impressive—you can jump high enough to clear trees, move fast enough that most humans would not be able to react in time, and hit hard enough to cave in a man's chest with a punch. You also possess minor powers of illusion and the ability to manipulate dreams, implanting ideas into the minds of others. Magic is also in your repertoire; you have some ability to cast spells using elements such as thunder, wind, or foxfire.

The true terror is not your current abilities, but your carnivorous hunger for the souls, hearts, and livers of others. With your skill in magic, you can manipulate and mind-control prey, luring them somewhere unnoticed, where you can feast upon their flesh while devouring their very soul. Every time you do this, you grow a little stronger—your magic becomes more potent, and your lifespan increases. The more powerful the person you devour, the greater the boost you receive. There is no limit to how powerful you can become—only whether you can reach that point before people become aware of the rising casualties and attempt to kill you before you grow too strong.
objects.title: Gumiho (Gaston's Re:Zero CYOA)

addons.text:
Through the mingling of giant blood and magic power you have gained the abilities and traits of Seven Deadly Sin’s Giant Clan, whilst still retaining the boons that Primal's Giants grant.

As a member of the Giant Clan, your size now grows to between 20 and 30 feet, and you now age at 50th the rate as a human would. Furthermore, your physical capabilities have grown, allowing you to single-handedly level cities and fortresses. Notably, you also possess a connection to nature that allows you to sense the animals, plants, metals, and minerals in the area around and below you.

As a member of the Giant Clan, you also possess Creation and knowledge to perform Drole’s Dance.

Creation is the exclusive magic power of the Giant Clan that allows them to mold and shape the earth and other minerals to their desire. Through it, Giants are capable of coating their forms in metal for greater strength and durability, creating constructs to aid them in battle, and reshaping the battlefield to their advantage, like gargantuan waves of mud and pillars of razor-sharp spikes to crush and tear through their foes. It should be noted that the power of Creation is not solely dependent on a giant's strength and magical energy, but instead relies heavily on how deep their connection to nature is.

Drole’s Dance is a sacred dance of the Giant Clan that, upon being performed, will deepen its dancer’s connection with nature and increase their magical energy tenfold.

Finally, you possess the potential to match and even surpass Drole, the legendary ancestor of the Giant Clan.
addons.title: Giant Clan (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
You have become a member of the peaceful race of giants within the world of Primal. As a giant, you stand around 10-12 feet tall and possess a muscular build naturally. 

Through your sheer size and physique, you have been granted extraordinary physical capabilities. You are strong enough to send rows of humans flying with a mere punch, shatter steel chains with your bare hands, and overpower large beasts like an enraged T-Rex. Your endurance, meanwhile, allows you to be unharmed by attacks like an arrow to the throat, only get minor wounds from the bone-crushing bite of a T-Rex, and face hundreds in combat with barely any signs of exhaustion.
objects.title: Giant (Primal)

objects.text:
You are a Vampire, a monster that sustains itself by drinking the blood of humans and livestock. Vampires are superficially similar to humans, but they possess several defining features: sharp fangs and red eyes. These eyes often have vertical, slit-like pupils.

The signature ability of the Vampire race is their ability to channel their unrivalled reserves of Yōki directly into their unique musculature, generating incredibly high levels of raw strength. This means that their muscles are powered directly and continuously by their Yōki, which allows them to generate incredible amounts of physical force in their physical blows and techniques.

The consequences of this ability in battle are tremendous. Most beings are severely injured or rendered unconscious upon impact, with only those of extremely high power able to recover from such blows. The sheer physical force generated can send enemies flying great distances through the air, often creating craters upon impact.

At the highest levels of the Vampire race, a strike can even disintegrate an opponent upon contact. At particularly intense levels of exertion, this power can also produce a visible discharge of energy manifesting as aura surges, often taking on bat-and-moon-themed forms.

As a species highly specialised for combat, Vampires possess exceptional regeneration and incredible stamina. Their regenerative response to injury can be almost reflexive, if not entirely automatic, allowing them to recover from severe damage with remarkable speed. In the rare event that they are struck by an enemy attack, they can endure tremendous punishment and continue fighting.

Another signature vampiric ability is the capacity to sense not only an opponent’s energy, but also their intentions. This allows a Vampire to perceive thoughts and movements without relying on conventional senses such as sound, sight, vibrations, or smell. In effect, it enables them to almost "foresee" an enemy’s attack and react accordingly.

The most basic skill naturally possessed by Vampires is their talent for deception. Through cunning and manipulation, they can approach individuals, charm them, and feed upon them. You also possess the ability known as Wealth of Power, which allows you to change your shape into nearly any form you desire. This includes transforming into creatures such as wolves, mice, bats, or mist—forms commonly associated with vampiric folklore. You can also alter parts of your body into weapons, such as transforming your arms into razor-sharp bat wings.

Vampires can bite others and inject them with their own blood through their fangs. The effects depend on the type of vampire providing the blood and the species of the recipient. Typically, a vampire may give their blood to another vampire who has lost a significant amount of their own, reviving them. If a human receives vampire blood, they will either fail to revive or temporarily gain vampiric traits accompanied by memory loss. If a human is repeatedly injected with vampire blood, they will eventually become a Ghoul or die from the overdose.

Despite their many strengths, Vampires do possess certain weaknesses. Due to its purifying properties, water is their greatest vulnerability. Contact with water disrupts their Yōki channeling and sends a shock through their body, similar to being struck by an electrical current. Silver is another weakness that can harm Vampires, particularly blessed silver.

You begin at the same level of power as Inner Moka at the start of the series.
objects.title: Vampire (Rosario Vampire)

objects.text: A Mutant in a cage. Your body has been transformed, mutated into a great squid-like flesh pile, contained inside a mobile killing machine. There are three aspects to being a Dalek, the Body, the Casing, and the Mind. The Dalek Body, designed by the crippled genius Davros, is a mirror of his vision. A hideously deformed cyclopian squid-like pile of flesh that does not die naturally but does still age, eventually rendering into a semi-sentient sludge. It’s tendrils are prehensile and capable of fine manipulation, and similarly when lacking a shell it can latch onto other species and hijack their nervous system to puppet their body, all the while leaving the victim conscious and in great pain. Additionally, Daleks possess minor psionic ability, useful largely just to interface with their casing and protect from attack.
