The Casing of a Dalek, created from the imaginably named material ‘Dalekanium’, is highly resistant to conventional attacks, including not only the resistant shell but a personal forcefield to defend even that. With both, it’s resistant enough to survive short jaunts in the Time Vortex with only minor injury. Due to being powered by a variety of sources and backups, including Vortex generators, Psionics and Static Electricity Converters, it’s highly unlikely it will ever lose charge. It is capable of flight, possesses the critically self-cleaning eyestalk, and self-repair functions. The casing also has self-destruct capabilities that can be modulated to cause varying amounts of destruction. Conventionally the casing is armed with a ‘Gunstick’ and ‘Manipulator arm’ capable of modulated lethality attacks and general technological manipulation respectively. Your mind has also been adapted. While Daleks are arrogant and prone to rage, they’re also manufactured to find patterns, and when organised to hyperfixate on issues until they are rendered completely nonexistent through the Pathweb, an artificial hive-mind containing all Dalek knowledge. Single Daleks meanwhile are highly intelligent, if slightly uncreative. As you yourself are becoming one, you’ll likely find yourself smarter, but prone to respecting strength. If unmonitored, you could find yourself falling into a a Might-makes-right tendency that has resulted in the vast majority of Daleks developing into Fascist tendencies or Noblesse Oblige with very little in between. Should your casing ever be destroyed, the Dalek mind is created with the knowledge to create others, though this is resource intensive and may require step-by-step upgrades to achieve. Similarly, you possess the knowledge to make armaments and additional equipment to serve your new body.
objects.title: I OBEY (Doctor Who)

addons.text:
You're not a simple, fresh-starting-out Dullahan. No, you've got experience under your belt and a lot of practice in how to use your powers. Your physical strength is greater than before—enough to pick up and throw a truck uncoupled from its bed with the same effort you'd use on a vending machine.

Your shadows have fused with all the various weapons and armors you had, creating a special type of both that combines all their benefits. This means your shadow-made armor is significantly more durable than any known mortal metal while weighing nothing, and your shadow can also rapidly change between all your various weapons in under a second.

Even your horse has fused with your shadow horse. It is now twice as powerful, twice as fast, and can wear armor to the same level of durability as you. If you wish, you could summon two horses at the same time, whether that be in actual horse form or their other forms.
addons.title: Fairy Knight

objects.text:
Looks like Celty is not the only Dullahan roaming Akihabara. To the outside observer, you look like a normal human... well, a normal human that has its head separated from the body and a shadow substance emitting from your neck. But this is only what people can see. In reality, your body is nothing more than a shadow of your head. Because of this, you do not need sustenance, you have effectively infinite stamina—thereby meaning you cannot grow tired. Any wounds you take may still hurt, but will heal rapidly and thereby amount to nothing in the end. Your head itself also has potent rapid healing that, unless something completely destroys it, will heal.

You have a noticeable increase in physical capabilities compared to a human—nothing too extreme, but you could pick up and chuck a vending machine pretty easily. The shadows you emit are completely devoid of light and can be shaped and formed in various ways, such as making clothing for yourself, armor, or even weapons such as scythes or swords. To go with your powers, you need a horse. Made from your shadows, your horse can also grow a carriage or transform into a motorcycle with or without a side car. If you find any other vehicle and swallow it in your shadows then your horse can transform into that vehicle too.

You do have a weakness, though—your head. Normally, "separating" your body from your head would be impossible, as you could simply reform the body back to where your head is. But something capable of separating souls could cut the connection from body and soul, leading to your body effectively becoming a different person with no memories—as it's all stored in your head—and your head becoming comatose until (or if) both halves come into contact with one another again.
objects.title: Dullahan (Durarara!!)

addons.text:
Your divine and immortal demon blood has resonated with your mystic eyes, granting you the powers of Kishirika Kishirisu.

In addition to your incredible physical strength and resilience, you have 12 different demon eyes that you can call upon and grant to others, including but not limited to:

Magic Power Eyes - Which allow you to directly observe the flow and quantity of magical energies.

X-ray Eyes - Which allow you to peer through non-living matter, so long as it isn’t obstructed by dense magical power

Clairvoyant Eyes - Which allow the user to see far away. Rather than acting as a scope, the Clairvoyant Eyes seem to change the perspective of one's vision, with the amount of mana determining the distance from the user.

All-Seeing Eyes - Which allow you to see all things in the world, even being able to find specific people, and peer into labyrinths. However, a dense enough magical power can hinder, but not completely obstruct, the sight of these eyes.

Foresight Eyes - Which allow you to see into the future, or at least possible futures. The Further one tries to see the more the possible futures diverge, blurring together and disorienting the user.
addons.title: Great Emperor of the Demon Eyes

addons.text: Your demon blood has resonated strongly with your Laplace Factor. In addition to supercharging the traits and characteristics you already inherited from it, you now have access to echoes of Demon God Laplace’s skills and memories, which become clearer and more expansive as you grow in strength. Given time, you are all but guaranteed to match or even surpass Laplace as one of the strongest beings to ever walk the Six-Faced World.
addons.title: Demon God Laplace

objects.text:
You are a member of the Immortal Demon Tribe, granting you a powerful physique common among the demon races, and more importantly the tribe’s namesake immortality.

Your regeneration is so potent that it would only take you moments to reconstitute from half your body being blown apart, with the scattered pieces of your flesh attempting to rejoin the largest portion of you in the area for a time. Should you fail to recover parts of your body, whether because they were destroyed or simply blown too far away to return, you will assume an appropriately shrunken form until you recover your original mass.

Your immortality is such that you can even return from complete physical annihilation, though it might take you thousands of years to do so. The only attacks you must truly fear are esoteric anti-immortal arts or techniques that bypass your immortal body and assault your mind or soul.
objects.title: Immortal Demon Tribe (Mushoku Tensei)

addons.text:
You've pushed your magical power to its absolute pinnacle and beyond as a Half Genie. Your innate mana pool is now as vast as the ocean, making even the greatest pure human mage look like an ant compared to you. It also regenerates at a much faster rate, near instantly if you were to only use your previous spells, and a few minutes at most spent if half or more of your reserves were spent. Also, your current spells are now strong enough to dwarf the feats of human mages.

Simple fireballs can now become gargantuan infernos, storm clouds can now darken the sky before smiting the earth with the wrath of Zeus, pikeballs become semi autonomous guardians that strike anything who possess a threat to you, your shields convert the brunt of whatever struck them into mana, or blast the attacker away with a burst of raw magic, etc. You can also learn any kind of magic much more easily.

Your animal transformations however, they received the biggest buff. Not only are ones you can already become improved, they can also evolve and mutate. Instead of a normal monkey, you can instead become a gorilla, including a giant one. A harpy to a Roc, or mermaid to a siren. But that's not all, as you can also transform into the various monsters and bosses from the Shantae series. Like the Giga Mermaid, Squid Baron, the Seven Sirens, slimes, nagas, golems, etc.

With the potential to shapeshift into any other creature within the world you're in as long as you've at least seen or know it for reference.
addons.title: Half Genie, Full Power!

addons.text: You are something unheard of to most Djinns—a half human, half genie. That changes their views on you significantly. Perhaps you're both related somehow? Either way, this newfound union benefits you by having a full blooded genie as a mentor in all things magic, and several other benefits. If you took Aladdin's Lamp, you can eventually learn to grant wishes for both yourself and others. At first, even simple wishes will demand alot of mana from you, but can be mitigated overtime until it costs close to nothing to grant a wish, provided its within your power. Due to your hybrid nature, you aren't restrained to the rules of of the Djinn and there's no upper limit to what your wishes can do. But the Djinn will still insist to use this responsibly. If you took Genie of the Ring your bond through it allows you draw mana from the Genie, or pour your own into it to improve them overtime. This allows them to develop new techniques within the ring on par with Speed Break and Time Break, store spells within it to be cast later, or even meta-manipulate your own magic. Wish granting from them is still possible, and won't follow the rules of the Djinn, but can still be rejected and will take time. At first they will be able to grant you one wish and will max out at three. However, the strength of the genie determines what they can grant and the time needed to regenerate another set of wishes.
addons.title: One and a Half Genies

addons.text: You've transformed dancing into the ultimate expression of your magic. Becoming a fluid, formless, and BEAUTIFUL instrument of its will. You can cast and chain a myriad of spells continuously just by dancing. With just a mild performance able to cast fireballs, orbiting spikeballs, defensive forcefields, and supportive magic circles. While a more intense and passionate one could produce three times as much and more advanced spells like teleportation or summoning. The nature of your dances can also influence what spells and effects you produce. Like a shaman ritual dance to call elemental spirits to your aid, a traditional ballet sequence to conjure miniature tornadoes, capoeira to heighten your agility, or breakdancing to project long range slashes. At your current level, your dances can produce phonenoma that affects everything within a 10 meter radius of you, which can increase with training. Furthermore, your weapons become enchanted and autonomous magical constructs. Moving both on their own and at your command to strike with the same fluidity and precision as your own sublime movements. Your animal forms also gain buffs by chaining certain dances before transforming.
addons.title: Dance Through the Danger

objects.text:
You are the child of a Genie and human, gifting you a great level of aptitude in using magic, but it is semi limited in scope, as you cannot grant wishes, and even your grandest display of magic can't compare to that of a full blooded Genie. Though your magical abilities will be stronger than any normal pure human magic user.

You still retain some benefits of your Genie lineage, as you are immune to diseases, have an extended lifespan, a moderate healing factor, an innate rechargeable pool of magic, and your physical abilities are above peak human. As well as several abilities from the Shantae series as spells. 

A few examples are shooting fireballs, conjuring 3 pikeballs that orbit around you, summoning a lightning storm cloud, a shield that can absorb and reflect attacks, or incasing yourself in a bubble to float in midair.

Your most important ability taken from Shantae herself, is her shapeshifting dances. Allowing you to transform into many creatures such as a monkey, crab, harpy, elephant, spider, tinker-bat or mermaid as examples. You may choose an alternative method to activate this.
objects.title: Half Genie (Shantae)

addons.text: "May the winds of time carry you for eternity" You have tapped into the history of the ancient Earth Dragons that crash landed onto Avalice eons ago, and carry their knowledge of advanced technology. As the last representative of their kind. From this ocean of knowledge, you learn how to create the technology that made Planet Avalice the way it is today. From robots with advanced AI like Pangu, relics that can power an entire planet like the Kingdom Stone, to warmachines that can blow up the moon like Bakunawa. You can also make creations showcased by Aaa, Milla, Lord Brevon, Serpentine, and other geniuses throughout the Freedom Planet franchise.
addons.title: Bakunawa

objects.text:
You are an anthromorphic animal from Planet Avalice, ranging from many mundane and mythical creatures designed from eastern cultures. Ranging from pandas, basset hounds, wildcats, bats, dragons and much more. 

By default, you have the capability to move at the  supersonic speeds of Water Dragons, and develop some signature traits and abilities based on your species and other powers from this CYOA. 

For example, the natural strength, resilence and ability to manipulate stone and crystals as an Earth Dragon will make you a formidable Earthbender, or the speed and underwater breathing of a Water Dragon making you a prime wielder for Atlantean Magic. 

This even extends to the little things, such as the heightened sense of smell of a basset hound, natural agility and claws of a wildcat, flight as a bat, etc.
objects.title: Avalician (Freedom Planet)

addons.text: In the shadowed ruins of forgotten altars, the practice of Dragon Communion took root—an unholy rite where mortals consumed the hearts of dragons to claim their power. These rites, shunned by the Golden Order, twisted the soul and body alike, birthing creatures neither man nor wyrm. Runebears, hulking beasts carved with primordial symbols, are said to be the failed offspring of such rituals. Yet your path is not one of failure. Through the consuming of Dragon’s Blood, your communion has deepened, and something ancient stirs awake within you. With your soul now bound to a true mana core and brimming with draconic potency, your Runebear form becomes more than brute force. You channel the breath of ancient dragons—not through summoned apparitions, but directly from your throat. All Dragon Incantation are available to you. Though no ethereal dragon head materializes, the might behind each exhalation is unmistakably draconic. Your Mana Burst ability now fuels these breaths, letting you rain devastation with the terrifying immediacy of a beast given voice by a god. Your body, already colossal, has begun to mirror the dread silhouette of the Magma Wyrms. You have grown further, your chest broader, bones heavier, and scales—thicker and darker—emerge beneath matted fur. Your innards twist with the molten force of dragonkind: organs resistant to heat, sinew laced with mana, a throat adapted to contain the power you now wield. Yet you remain yourself. You are not a dragon, nor merely a beast, but a hybrid horror—conscious, wrathful, and unnaturally alive. Where others devolve into instinct or flame, you persist. A new breed of dragon. A Great Runebear.
addons.title: Great Runebear

addons.text:
You have gained all the skills of Kuma, both father and son. Trained directly by Heihachi Mishima, you now wield a version of Mishima Style Fighting Karate modified for a body of claws, muscle, and fur—fusing brutal grappling, unpredictable stances, and surprisingly agile strikes into a unique and devastating combat form. 

Your swipes, slams, and uppercuts carry precision behind their primal weight, capable of knocking elite martial artists across arenas or breaking through the defenses of high-tech war machines. You gain access to Kuma’s signature techniques like Hunting Bear Stance, unpredictable mix-ups, and powerful command throws that can suplex foes twice your size. 

You can read enemy moves, parry with surprising dexterity, and confuse even seasoned warriors with your hybrid of feral instinct and martial discipline. Your intelligence scales with your power, allowing you to learn and adapt mid-battle, turning even comedic techniques into lethal tools. You are no longer just a beast or just a Mishima—you are the bear that knows karate, and all who face you will learn to take that seriously.
addons.title: Kuma

addons.text:
Your connection to druidism and your ability to embody and transform into various supernatural creatures has fused with your species of being a Runebear. Now, you have the power to change between your bear form and that of a human or any other species you might also be. Whether this is because you were always the bear and simply learned how to appear more human, or because you were always human and have made a spiritual connection with the embodiment of a Runebear, will be up to you.

Either way, this grants benefits. The most obvious is being able to fit through doors. The second is that you retain half of all the physical attributes you had in your bear form and have the ability to partially or completely transform back into it. The third is that you've gained several traditional abilities and passives expected of a Guardian Druid. This includes, but is not limited to: passively reflecting a tenth of all damage taken from magic or supernatural attacks back at the attacker, temporarily going berserk to increase your speed by 15% and double your strength, and all spells cast while as a bear being stronger from also scaling off your strength.

You can choose to change your Runebear Form to that of other traditional druid bear forms, such as Ursol, while keeping your size and power.
addons.title: Guardian Druid

objects.text:
You are now one of the strongest non-boss threats to walk the Lands Between: a Runebear. Towering above most creatures, your body is the perfected brutality of primal ursine force—matted fur, bulging muscle, and ancient runes that pulse with unknowable power. Your snout curls in a permanent snarl, and your claws fell trees like wheat. Your chest glows with cryptic runes—some say remnants of dragonkind sorcery, as Runebears may be twisted echoes of dragons, reshaped from eating dragonhearts.

As a Runebear, you wield overwhelming physicality: lightning-fast lunges, bone-breaking swipes, and roars that ripple through the air like shockwaves. Your paws can crush men in a single blow, and your reflexes mock your size. When enraged, your onslaught becomes unrelenting, your body driven by the burning force etched beneath your hide. Arrows, blades, and blunt force glance off your frame—only focus and discipline can bring you down. Your senses are grotesquely sharp: movement doesn’t escape you, blood calls to you, and the quietest heartbeat is a beacon.

Worse still is your persistence. Unlike beasts that retreat or hesitate, you press forward. Once you engage, it is to the death—yours or theirs. In tight quarters, your speed and weight catch foes off guard; by the time they understand the threat, your claws are already on them.

But you are still a bear. An outsized, unnatural one. This brings constant, inescapable issues: human life is simply not built for you. Doors, beds, clothes—none fit. Even with your mind intact, your voice is twisted by a snout not meant for speech. People will flee or fight. You are too large, too wild, and too dangerous for the world you once called home.
objects.title: Runebear (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
You are now a member of the alien dinosaur-like species known as Dinaurians.

As a Dinaurian, your form is remarkably similar to that of humans in both build and overall structure, with a few notable differences. Unlike humans, Dinaurians possess skin tones in the light blue range, marking under their eyes, long elf-like ears, a long reptilian tail, and digitigrade legs.

Onwards, as a Dinaurian, your physical capabilities greatly exceed those of a human. In particular, you and your kin possess the strength, speed, and durability to perform feats like leaping dozens of feet into the air, kicking through metal plating, weaving through gunfire, and receiving only minor injuries from impacts that send several ton vivosaurs flying.

Finally, Dinaurians have the unique ability to transform either partially or fully into what they refer to as their Battle Form, which is the form of a specific dinosaur. Further, Battle Forms are both significantly stronger than what the dinosaur they are of and possess elemental abilities of one of the following: air, earth, water, fire, or neutral. An example of this would be a raptor whose claws are capable of effortlessly slicing through metal alloys stronger than any modern humanity possesses, and can fire pillars of flame from its mouth.
objects.title: Dinaurian (Fossil Fighters)

addons.title: Deathforged
addons.text:
You are no longer limited to possessing whatever corpses happen to be available. Through your mastery of necromancy, you can design and construct a body to your specifications, your skill being the only true limit. You can also restore your body, replacing damaged or missing parts with suitable remains or regenerating them directly with death-attribute mana.

Moreover, mere exposure to death mana gradually strengthens your body, accelerating its natural mutations and improving its durability and capabilities over time. You can also infuse mana directly into your flesh, accelerating this growth and actively shaping its development, allowing you to cultivate new traits as your mastery of death-attribute magic improves.

objects.text:
You're a homunculus, an immortal undead parasite capable of possessing dead bodies until said body becomes damaged to the extent that it becomes unusable. As long as the body remains yours, it won’t rot - instead, it gradually mutates, gaining durability and raw power with every day it survives. If your host’s head is missing, you conjure a flaming facsimile that sees and hears but cannot speak. 

Yet, despite your immortality, you're harmless without a body — little more than a crawling husk, capable of at most latching onto someone in an attempt to suffocate them to death.
objects.title: Homunculus (Dead Cells)

objects.text:
You are Khanivore—a living weapon, a beast sculpted by genetic warfare and unforgiving design, but your mind remains untouched by savagery unless you choose it. You retain your full intelligence, awareness, and personality. The instincts of the monster are yours to command, not the other way around.

Your body stands nearly three meters tall, built with a dense, digitigrade frame of sleek muscle and armored flesh. Your limbs end in bone-forged claws, sharp enough to carve through steel and tear beastie hide with ease. Both your upper and lower jaws contain protruding snout blades, perfectly shaped for impalement and point-blank dismemberment.

Your long tail can split into four prehensile tentacle-blades, each capable of stabbing, wrapping, climbing, and anchoring with extreme force and control. You can scale walls, cling to ceilings, leap from perch to perch, and strike from impossible angles. Even your movements are a threat, your tail able to whip through flesh and armor alike, or carry you with terrifying precision.

Ridges of quills line your upper spine and skull, and jagged, bladed fins sprout from your elbows and shins—lethal structures that tear through enemies during motion and deny your foes the ability to hold or bind you. Your smooth and seamless form is layered with dense muscle and flexible armor, built not to impress, but to kill without pause or waste.

Inside, your biology is as brutal as your exterior. You are packed with redundant organs—four hearts, twelve lungs, coiled nerves and backup clusters of processors and synthetic tissues to ensure your survival under nearly any condition. If one system is damaged, another takes over. You bleed when struck, but the wounds are rarely fatal. Even if a blade pierces where your heart should be, three more are still pumping. Pain is merely data. Damage is a delay. You continue moving, fighting, and destroying.

You possess monstrous physical strength, enough to rip limbs from socket, crush armored skulls in your claws, and smash through reinforced defenses. Your agility and reflexes allow you to dodge, leap, and scale any structure, turning entire battlefields into terrain for your ambushes. Your body can withstand explosions, high-caliber weaponry, extreme force, and massive trauma. You can survive in heat, cold, toxic environments, underwater pressure, and most hostile biomes with a little difficulty. You are fully amphibious, capable of moving through land or water without losing speed or effectiveness.
objects.title: Khanivore (Sonnie’s Edge)

objects.text:
You are a Ghostrunner—an elite biomechanical assassin forged from vat-grown tissue, cybernetic augmentation, and precision-engineered martial programming. Modeled after prototypes like Jack, your body is designed for high-speed urban warfare across dystopian vertical megastructures such as Dharma Tower. At full capacity, you are an apex predator in the cyberpunk biome—where speed, perception, and surgical violence define survival.

Your transhuman frame blends artificial tendons, myomer bundles, and servo-enhanced joints, granting you movement beyond biological limits. With perfect equilibrium supported by internal gyroscopic stabilizers, you navigate vertical terrain with ease—wall-running, leaping, and rebounding across rooftops and corridors at lethal velocity. Under threat, your hyper-reactive nervous system accelerates time-perception, letting you dodge bullets, parry energy blades, and process environments with machine-perfect clarity.

Central to your function is the Atma Core, a neural chipset installed at your brainstem that fuses biological and digital cognition. It links you seamlessly to the Net, allowing you to interact with augmented environments, override digital systems, and mask yourself from standard surveillance and targeting AI. To hostile networks, you are an anomaly—unreadable, undetectable, and unreachable.
You possess an arsenal of integrated abilities optimized for close-quarters domination. You can dash mid-air in any direction, propelled by hydraulic overpressure bursts capable of releasing kinetic shockwaves that knock back foes, deflect projectiles, or propel you into combat. Your nano-edge blade channels high-frequency energy arcs that cleave enemies at range, while digital phantoms and ephemeral weapons capable of stunning or impaling digital construct's on the net. Temporal cognition filters let you plan, move, and strike in what feels like slow motion, giving you the advantage even against enhanced or parahuman opponents.

Firearms are incompatible with your operating protocols. In dense arcology environments, ranged ballistics would compromise air integrity and infrastructure. Instead, your sword serves as an extension of your will—balanced, unerring, atomically sharp, and endlessly adaptable.

Despite your strengths, you are not invulnerable. Your chassis resists radiation, toxins, extreme pressure, and gravitational stress, but concentrated kinetic trauma or EMP disruption can disable key systems. Additionally, Thinker or Tinker level intrusions targeting your Atma interface may exploit vulnerabilities in your cognitive or sensory systems.
objects.title: Ghostrunner (Ghostrunner)

addons.text:
Your divine essence has forged a bond with the Greater Will, transforming you into a being worthy of serving as its vassal. Your cosmic powers have grown immensely—now capable of mimicking celestial phenomena such as pulsar blasts and the event horizon of a black hole.

You can harness the energy of the Elden Ring to unleash homing blasts, forge golden weapons, breathe golden flame, heal others, and transmute matter into any form you choose. Over the course of decades, you may even learn to impose your own order upon reality—just as Marika once did.
addons.title: Elden Spawn

objects.text:
You have become a Star Spawn—a bizarre and alien lifeform unbound by the order of the Erdtree. Your body is a strange fusion of organic matter and stone, shifting between animalistic and humanoid shapes. Unlike most Star Spawn, your form is not fixed; you can alter it at will to adapt to your surroundings. Your intellect remains unaffected by these transformations.

You can compress your body to roughly human size, though you cannot exceed the size of an Astel.

While you can shape natural weapons from your shifting form, your true strength lies in your affinity with gravity—a power equal to that of an Astel. Your command over gravitational forces is so refined that you can even teach the basics to others, though few can match your potential.

Basic applications include attracting and repelling enemies, precise telekinesis capable of forging blades from the environment, and unleashing blasts of compressed gravitational energy. Beyond these, your power enables even grander feats: opening portals for teleportation, calling down meteor showers from the void, and manifesting explosive cosmic phenomena such as nebulae.
objects.title: Star Spawn (Elden Ring)

addons.text:
A parasitic demon bonding with a symbiotic being, that's a recipe for disaster, and you are now the proof. Alongside the new host of abilities presented to you and the elevation of your already brutal strengths, you live up to your namesake as a parasite. 

Able to feed of the thoughts, emotions, memories, and even powers of those around you by absorption, or passively through latching a piece of you onto them. Leeching off of Shinobi lets you mimic their fighting style, weapons, and natural skill with them easily. Your new friend will shapeshift to fit them accordingly. 

Finally, you can assume a human form. With all details malleable as long as it remains as such.
addons.title: Abyssal Yoma

addons.text:
Your rage now carries the will of a long sealed Rasetsu, who fought with all she had to fulfill a promise to serve Fubuki at all costs. 

As you succumb to rage your power is enhanced fourfold at the start, and will continue to do so as you sink deeper into wrath. Your growth as a giant is also affected, allowing you to exceed skyscrapers or even higher if you will it. 

As a result of your willpower, you can generate new abilities for yourself--provided it's something you're plausibility capable of. 

Growing your nails, horns, and fangs is a no brainer, muscle growth and bone density also. Projecting air from your punches, or extending your limbs is passable, but not conjuring magic if you have no means to do so.
addons.title: Rasetsu's Resolve

objects.text:
You are a Yoma, a parasitic demon from another dimension born from the bloodshed between shinobi. As such, your species are their ultimate enemy, but you in particular stand out among them. 

Your physical abilities exceed that of normal Shinobi, where one could shatter stone and potentially steel, you can topple a building with your raw strength alone. If you really push yourself, entire blocks can crumble at your feet, and your punches can cause local earthquakes. In fact, you are so dangerous that it will take a squadron of several elite shinobi just for the chance to put you down, or seal you away. 

Your willpower and rage elevate your physical might even further. Allowing you to unleash more power, resist many effects like bindings, and mental attacks, and become a giant. Towering 10 feet tall at minimum, with potential to grow further. 

Your power rivals Rasetsu, Yasha, and Shura, some of the strongest Yoma in existence behind Fubuki's Mother.
objects.title: Yoma (Senran Kagura)

objects.text:
You have become a vampire from the world of Tensura, turning you into a nearly immortal Majin with overwhelming magical energy and vitality. Your flesh does not decay with time, giving you an endless lifespan.

Your appearance is similar to that of humans. However, you have piercing crimson-red eyes, pointed fangs to drink the blood of your victims, and claw-like nails that you can retract, leaving them nearly identical to those of humans.

As a vampire, you solely derive sustenance from the blood of others, with humanoids and those with magical ability tasting better and sustaining you for longer. While you cannot derive sustenance from ordinary food or drinks, you can still eat for pleasure.

As an immortal majin, you have great physical and magical power, enough to effortlessly slaughter a village of a thousand inhabitants overnight without tiring. With effort, even a small town will fall before dawn.

As a vampire, you do have a crippeling weakness to sunlight, and will ignite when in direct sunlight, which will kill you in a matter of minutes. With time and training, you can evolve into a surmounter, eliminating this weakness of yours.

As a vampire, you have the following intrinsic skills:

Blood Raise: Though feeding someone or a corpse your blood, you can bring them back to life as a vampire of lower power than you. This requires the corpse to be mostly intact, and if their soul is destroyed or absent, a brand new soul containing their host's memories will be born in their body.

Charm: You can hypnotize and temporarily control the thoughts of your target and even alter their memories with suggestions.

Coercion: You can exert pressure on a target or group of targets using your voice. This pressure helps coerce targets into compliance or intimidate them. With enough willpower, it is possible to resist or counter coercion with another form of coercion or haki.

Paralyze: You can paralyze a target with a touch. This paralysis effect can be applied to any of your attacks, be it weapons, skills, or magic.

Self-Regeneration: You can regenerate as long as your material body has not been completely destroyed and you possess the magicules required to fuel this regeneration. Even missing limbs and organs can be regenerated, although the brain can only be regenerated if you can remain conscious without it.

Shadow Motion: You can sink into shadow space, allowing you to use it to travel vast distances. Shadow space is connected to each and every shadow in the world, each of which becomes a door for you to enter or exit from. There is no air inside the shadow space, forcing you to hold your breath while inside.

Steel Strength: You can expend magicules to increase your physical strength, allowing you to convert your naturally high magical power directly into physical might. This is very efficient compared to physical enhancement magic, providing more physical strength for the amount of magicules used.

Transform: As a Vampire, you are a natural shapeshifter; you can freely alter the appearance of your physical form, ranging from mimicking someone else's appearance, changing gender, or even transforming into animals or clusters of smaller animals, such as clouds of bats. As long as a single such bat survives, you survive.

Additionally, unlike traditional majin, having children the normal way won't weaken or cripple you.
objects.title: Vampire (Tensura)

objects.text:
You have become a slime from the world of Tensura, although with enough intelligence to be considered a Majin. As with all monsters, your body is now made of Magicules, granting you the ability to survive without needing sleep, water, or air, along with an endless, ageless lifespan.

Your appearance as a Slime is a liquid-like substance, formless in nature, that can change into any shape you wish. Although more detailed shapes require more effort and concentration, the longer you take them, the more concentration is required. You may optionally chose to instead be a diffrent color then the default blue slime.

As a monster, you possess the potential to evolve once you have enough Magicules, although most slime never reach this point due to being naturally unintelligent, low Magicules, and dying before they can ever reach the required Magicules to evolve. Your own evolution will be determined by what materials, monsters, or other beings you manage to absorb via your skills of Absorption and Dissolve, gaining unique evolutions based on what you consume and obtaining enough Magicules.

As a Slime, you have the following intrinsic skills:

Absorption: an intrinsic skill of slimes that allows them to absorb matter in their bodies when combined with Dissolve, keeping any Magicules they consume and adding to their own small reserves of Magicules.

Dissolve: an intrinsic skill of slimes that allows a slime to dissolve and break down matter into its base components of energy and other materials in other worlds. Dissolve can be used to dissolve regular matter into Magicules for your consumption.

Self-Regeneration: an intrinsic skill that allows the user to regenerate their body from even minor injuries by spending Magicules, restoring it to a perfect state. A slime consists of identical cells that serve as both neurons and muscles simultaneously. You can keep regenerating so long as a single cell of your body remains, and you possess enough Magicules to regenerate.

Unlike most Magicule based lifeforms you will not be crippled or weakned if you have a child.
objects.title: Slime (Tensura)

addons.text:
Your connection with the Voice of the World has resulted in the development of a new Unique Skill, echoing the feats of the Insectar’s great ancestor, Hive Master.

Hive Master contains the following sub-skills:

Stomach: Allows you to consume much more than your body would otherwise allow. Anything within your stomach can be digested for data and energy or simply stored for later use.

Analysis: Allows you to more effectively analyze and adjust any data you acquire. As a result, your metamorphosis can now be conducted much more quickly, ensuring that even remaking yourself from the ground up shouldn’t take more than a couple of days. Additionally, this subskill allows you to analyze and reproduce arts and some skills that you consume.

Kin Creation: Allows you to sacrifice a portion of your total strength to generate subordinate creatures. At your current strength, you’re only able to create non-humanoid Insectoids with limited intelligence, but with further development, you could produce powerful Insectars like yourself. The exact qualities of each of your kin are up to you, limited only by the data you’ve acquired and the strength you’re willing to lose.

Lineage: At its most basic, this affords you a measure of control over your kin, ranging from a slight influence to complete domination, depending on their strength relative to yours. With some finesse, you could remotely analyze any skills or arts acquired by your progeny as they grow and evolve, or even invoke Predation on them to drain both their energy and data, lifting you to even greater heights or letting you imperfectly reincarnate them upon death. Note that this sub-skill only functions on kin that remain within your Soul Genealogy.
addons.title: Unique Skill: Hive Master

addons.text:
You’re no longer a mere Demi-Spiritual Lifeform, for you are a true Spiritual Lifeform who has awakened to Divinity. More specifically, you are a Divine Insect, an Ultimate Lifeform capable of contending with True Dragons.

As such, you are immortal, with the ability to freely convert your unaging material body into a spiritual one, and vice versa. In practice, that means most “deaths” are little more than temporary setbacks for you, as you can eventually reconstitute from anything short of the destruction of your soul’s Heart Core or the complete depletion of your impressive energy reserves.

Additionally, the malleability of your Hihi'irokane has prompted evolution in your Intrinsic Skills:

Universal Shapeshift (formerly Metamorphosis): Allows you to freely and instantly change your body’s appearance and properties, removing your previous need to enter a weakened cocoon state. 

Universal Sense (formerly Compound Eyes): Allows you to perceive nearly all things within an extremely wide radius. It is an enhanced version of Mana Perception with superior sensory capabilities. You can perceive not only light and sound, but also killing intent, heat, sound waves, and more within your range.

Soul Consumption (formerly Predation): Allows for the consumption of nearly anything, letting you acquire data on skills that reside inside souls, as most Unique Skills do. Additionally, you can imbue this effect into any of your other abilities, potentially providing you the ability to devour things over larger areas and at greater distances.
addons.title: Divine Insect

addons.text:
You are not just any Divine Insect, you have all the power and abilities of the great Progenitor of the Insectars, Zelanus.

As such, your base energy reserves are greater than even Veldora, and your combat capabilities are such that you could compete well against Milim Nava, The Destroyer, so long as she isn’t in her Rampage state.

Additionally, your Unique Skill: Hive Master has been integrated into the Ultimate Skill: Sephirot, Lord of Life whose sub-skills include the following:

Life Domination: Grants you immense authority over Life and Death, providing you a diverse range of powerful abilities, including resurrecting the recently dead and manipulating the energies contained within the body and soul. Most relevant to you, however, is the ability to restructure and optimize the body and soul of both you and all of your progeny using your gathered data and energy. Additionally, this authority allows you to absorb all of the skills and even experiences of whatever souls you consume, which can be incorporated into yourself or your kin at your leisure.

Spatial Domination: Allows you complete control over the Element of Space. Gives you the ability to freely switch between spaces and perform teleportation easily, as well as block or restrict others’ spatial abilities even further and in a wider area than Spatial Manipulation.
addons.title: Insect Lord

objects.text:
You are an Insectar, a Demi-Spiritual Cryptid subspecies famed for their powerful and varied physical abilities and unusual intelligence among their Cryptid peers.

As a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform, you can live for centuries, and your Spiritual Body contains all of your mental processes, such as thought and memory storage. This means there’s no truly vital structure in your Material Body, such as a brain, which allows you to theoretically recover from any physical damage, should you have the means to do so. 

Likewise, exceeding the bounds of material life also provides you with deep energy stores and the ability to exert strength beyond your physical limits.

As an Insectar specifically, you possess the following Intrinsic Skills:

Compound Eyes: Specially constructed eyes that provide great dynamic vision and spatial awareness.

Exoskeleton: Your body is covered in an armor of biological metal, equivalent to Magisteel in base durability and magic conduction. By running energy through it, you can also produce a Magic-Jamming effect on your exoskeleton's surface, providing you a measure of resistance to aspectual magic.

Predation: Allows you to extract energy and data from anything you consume. This process is less efficient for inorganic materials, materials with a sufficient amount of magical energy, and can be resisted by those with a will. This allows you to acquire data on skills that reside in the material body, such as Self-Regeneration, and the spiritual body, such as Perfect Memory.

Metamorphosis: You can, over the course of an hour, shift your exoskeleton into a cocoon, allowing you to reconstruct your entire body using your available energy and the data you’ve gathered with Predation. This process can take anywhere from a few hours to a week, depending on the extent and complexity of your changes. As such, it would be relatively simple to just remake your exoskeleton out of an entirely different material, but it would be much more difficult to extract a single superior quality from a material and weave it into the current makeup of your exoskeleton while adding new limbs, structures, and the like. To start, you have access to extensive data on a variety of arthropod features (wings, stingers, scythes, pincers, etc.), which you may use to customize yourself beyond your shelled-humanoid default. Be warned, however, while undergoing this process you are exceptionally vulnerable, as any attack capable of piercing your old exoskeleton is sure to inflict grave damage on your unfinished form.
objects.title: Insectar (Tensura)

objects.text:
You are an Elemental, a Spiritual Lifeform born from a large conglomeration of natural energy aligned toward a given Element.

Choose one of either the Five Great Elements, Water, Fire, Earth, Space, and Wind, or the two Higher Elements, Light and Darkness, you are now a newborn Greater Elemental of that Element. Note that the Five Great Elements have a cyclical relationship where each triumphs over the next in the list, while Light and Darkness have a separate balanced relationship. 

As a Spiritual Lifeform, you are ageless and quite difficult to completely kill, as even destroying your Spiritual Body is only likely to result in reducing your strength and some mental degradation, such as memory loss and personality alteration. Additionally, the appearance of your Spiritual Body reflects both your self-image and your preferences, meaning it can be largely customized to your liking.

All that said, as you lack a proper Material Body, you need to possess some kind of vessel in order to interact with the material world and be perceived by the spiritually unattuned. Luckily, as a spirit of the natural world, it’s possible for you to form suitable vessels out of accumulations of your Element. You could also opt to possess another vessel, such as a golem, person, or magical construct.

As an Elemental, you have innate command over powerful Elemental Magic of your alignment, which allows you to create and manipulate your Element, or even derive additional energy from existing instances of your element. 

It’s important to note that, despite being called magic, Elemental Magic’s effects are actually the result of manipulating natural energy and thus fully obey the natural laws of the world. As such, it’s unaffected by anti-magic measures like Anti-Magic Area but can be counteracted through similarly natural means, like a fire spell being put out by a sufficient amount of water.

In addition to your magic, you have 3 Intrinsic Skills:

[Element] Manipulation: Allows you to manipulate existing instances of your element, independent of your Elemental Magic. When combined with your magic, this skill can allow for exceedingly delicate control or devastating effects produced by focusing one’s spells. For example, a novice Fire Elemental (like yourself) could easily burn an ordinary armored human to a crisp with their magic but would struggle to melt through metal. With the addition of this skill, that same elemental could focus their spell into a superheated laser capable of cleaving through both the human and their armor.

[Element] Attack Nullification: Makes you immune to damage using your element. Notably, this does not apply to damage by things like Aspectual Magic, as such effects are the result of Magicules mimicking the effects of an element. Likewise, when true elemental attacks are otherwise enhanced or augmented, such as with Battle Arts or Skills, they might bypass or reduce the effectiveness of this skill.

[Element] Transformation: Allows you to convert your Spiritual Body into your element. On its own, this is not particularly useful, but in conjunction with your other skills and magic, it allows you to create stable physical vessels with relative ease and wield your power to its fullest.

Taking full advantage of your skills, you are roughly equivalent to Rank A under the Free Guild system, meaning you are a credible threat to an entire town, closer to a minor natural disaster than a living being.
objects.title: Elemental (Tensura)

objects.text:
You have evolved into an Enlightened, a demi-spiritual life form. This is considered the correct way for humans and demi-humans to evolve.

This evolution allows you to permanently store memories in your spiritual body and use it as a thinking device. This allows you to maintain consciousness in the event your brain is completely destroyed.

As you now think using your spirit body, your mental faculties are leagues above what your fleshy brain could support. This allows enhanced thought speed, multitasking, and information processing. With time and experience, as well as an increase in power, your mental attributes grow even further.

As you have partially sublimated your flesh to a higher existence, you possess a high magicule capacity and tolerance, a vast mana reserve, and an aptitude for magical precision.

Additionally, your partially sublimated flesh bestows you with incredible physical strength and vitality. Your physical strength is sufficient to fight greater Majin on equal terms, and with the assistance of your magical abilities, you could match a sub-demon lord-level Majin. Your vitality provides a lifespan in the thousands of years.

You have the potential to evolve further along the correct path. Given time and training, you will gradually sublimate your flesh in full, become a saint, and potentially even gain divinity as a Divine Human.
objects.title: Enlightened (Tensura)

addons.title: Daemon Lord
addons.text:
You are no longer a mere Greater Demon, you have physically incarnated and evolved twice over to become among the strongest Demon Lord Seeds.

Your intrinsic knowledge and skill with Aspectual Magic now allows you to effortlessly command all but the most powerful and precise spells (and even those in time). You even have the potential to compete with lesser Ultimate Skill wielders with your magic alone.

Additionally, your Intrinsic Skill: Material Creation can now create items comparable to Legend-Grade Equipment, items that generally only occur after masterwork items spend centuries, or even millennia, evolving in magicule-rich environments.

addons.title: Devil Lord
addons.text:
You have reached the apex of Daemon-kind, an evolutionary stage previously thought exclusive to the Primordial Daemons. You are a divine existence comparable to the True Dragons in both strength and immortality.

Your already impressive command over Aspectual Magic has become effortless and nigh-absolute, in addition to expanding to include the all-destroying height of Dark Magic, otherwise known as Nihility Magic. Even Ultimate level magic would count as little more than a light greeting from you.

Your Intrinsic Skill: Material Creation can now create items equivalent to Mythical-Grade Equipment, sentient items that grant their acknowledged wielders strength comparable to awakened beings like Chosen Heroes and True Demon Lords.

Finally, and perhaps most troubling for your enemies, you are now capable of reviving from even complete soul destruction, with all your memories and personality intact.

addons.title: Diable Chevalier
addons.text:
You have incarnated into a body that is abnormally compatible with your daemonic soul, evolving you into a Devil Chevalier in the process, this evolutionary step is considered a half-way point between Greater Daemons and Archdaemons, achieved when a strong Greater Daemon incarnates in a material body.

This significantly amplifies your power to the point you could annihilate your Greater Daemon self in a single attack. Your magicule reserves have increased tenfold. Your power has reached that of a sub-demon lord, while still a good ways away from a Demon Lord, you could, with sufficient preparations, bring down nations.

Your devil imagination-based magic is assimilated into your aspectual magic, reforming into the following intrinsic skill:

Spell Creation: You can expend magicules to create new spells; these spells conform to your desires and intentions, having the effect you intend or want it to have. The power of these spells depends on the amount of magicules consumed when activating this skill. You can control how many magicules are used when activating this skill.

You do not share the weaknesses of devils, as you are a Daemon, even if your material body originated from one.

addons.title: Unique Skill: Daemonic Rebirth
addons.text:
You have absorbed the Evil Pieces into your daemonic soul, breaking them down to recreate their ability to reincarnate other ensouled lifeforms as devils, the Unique Skill: Daemonic Rebirth, which has the following subskills:

Soul Corruption: You can reincarnate other lifeforms into Daemons of a lower evolutionary step than yourself, so as a Diable Chevaliers, you can reincarnate lifeforms into Greater Daemons. This means that should you become a Devil Lord, you can only create Daemon Lords.

Evil Piece Creation: Through your Material Creation Intrinsic Skill, you can create a limitless supply of Evil Pieces that are bound to you as their King, allowing you to create a peerage that exceeds the traditional number limitations. These reincarnate those it is used on into an incarnated lesser daemon, while maintaining their original appearance in the process. If these are used on a daemon of a higher rank, they are incarnated without falling to lesser daemons.

Evil Crystallization: You can crystallize and imbue common, extra, resist, and unique skills into the evil pieces you create. This allows you to create unique evil piece variants or mutation pieces, which have different sub-abilities than rooks, bishops, or knights. This doesn't alter the core ability of evil pieces, which is to reincarnate people into incarnated daemons.

Sow Evil: You can expend magicules to forcibly uplift a lifeform into a Demon Lord Seed, strengthening them massively, enhancing their skills, and awakening at least a single Unique Skill. Demon Lord Seeds you sow can become True Demon Lords even if they are recognized as your subordinates.

addons.title: True Daemon
addons.text: You have become a True Daemon of Type-Moon, such daemons are thought to be brought forth by the lord, which is in line with the origin of the Daemons of Tensura, whose Daemons were brought into existence through Veldanava’s creation of the Seven Angels of Origin. As an Incarnated True Daemon, you exist even without a Unit Designation or by cladding yourself in the Ideations of Man, an ability shared with the Great Mothers/Fathers of Faekind. With this, your Reality Marble evolves into the Intrinsic Skill: World Marble, making it a fundamental aspect of your being, not just an expression of your mind. As it is stored deep in your heart core, it cannot be suppressed by external influence, nor can it be stolen. This Intrinsic Skill generates two to three subskills derived from the mechanics of the world it generates, allowing you to use some of its power without manifesting the world marble itself. As your magic circuits are made obsolete by your aspectual magic, they are shed, with your aspectual magic allowing you to realize any magecraft through the emission of magicules alone. Your capacity for magecraft, though, is leagues above what humans are capable of, as your entire existence is used as the cause for the spells you cast. Even in the modern era, your spells are as powerful as those at the peak of the age of gods, allowing you to cast spells on par with Anima Animusphere, and should you find yourself in an era where mystery is abundant, your spells could even surpass the likes of divine authorities.

objects.text:
You have become a greater daemon. A naturally occurring spiritual life-form derived from the Great Holy Spirit of Darkness. 

Greater daemons typically possess an inhuman appearance similar to what people think a demon should look like, but you retain your human-like form though with the horns, claws, and demonic wings all daemons possess. These demonic traits can be hidden at will.

While as a Daemon you do not have a material body of your own, but you can form a temporary magic body to interact with the material world and be perceived by humans.                 

Like all daemons, you possess an intrinsic knowledge of aspectual magic that allows you to cast a variety of spells, aspectual magic is a form of magic that makes use of magicules to rewrite the laws of nature and manifest phenomena from the user’s imagination.                                                                                                         

Aspectual magic requires a strong mental image of the phenomena you wish to create and a certain level of understanding of the world’s laws. incantations, hand seals and other rituals can be used to reinforce your mental image. This is also limited by your ability to use magicules.

As a Greater Daemons you have three intrinsic skills.

Magic Resistance: You possess an immense resistance towards magic, reducing the magical effects to the point of negligence. Though you can still be affected by sufficiently powerful magic. However this magic resistance has reduced effectiveness against magic that forcefully imposes the laws of nature on you.

Material Creation: You possess the ability to create material objects by expending magicules or by converting your own mana directly. if your understanding of what you are creating is poor the quality may suffer.

Possess: Allows you to attach your spiritual body to objects or people. This allows you to use the possessed body as your own material body. if you find a body you come to like you can possess it on a much deeper level incarnating yourself in it truly making it your own rather than merely possessing it.

As a Daemon you can evolve further if you meet the requirements, given enough time and effort you can evolve into a Devil Lord, something only primordial daemon have reached before.
objects.title: Greater Daemon (Tensura)

addons.title: Intrinsic Skill: Hardening
addons.text:
Your connection to the Voice of the World has crystallized the defensive quirk of your Aura into a proper Intrinsic Skill, Hardening.

At the expense of your energy, you can temporarily raise the durability of your body, potentially allowing you to withstand any physical phenomenon with enough energy investment.

With the combination of your Hardening and Magic Nullification skills, your defense is nearly perfect, leaving you vulnerable only to exceedingly esoteric abilities or a conceptually opposing ability to your Hardening skill imbued with a superior amount of energy.

addons.title: Intrinsic Skill: Magic Domination
addons.text:
Your Intrinsic command over Aspectual Magic allows you to draw even more power from your Magic Nullification skill. You can now extend your magical inviolability beyond your body, weaving that quality into any of your spells.

As a result, your spells are essentially unstoppable before any non-physical means. Your barriers allow you to extend your magical nullification across wider areas, while your attack spells unravel all magical defenses they meet and are extremely difficult to magically heal so long as any of their influence lingers.

objects.text:
You are a True Giant, a Divine Spiritual Lifeform born from the earth itself, capable of facing the likes of True Dragons on even grounds.

As a divine being, you are immortal, with the ability to freely convert your unaging material body into a spiritual one, and vice versa. In practice, that means most “deaths” are little more than temporary setbacks for you, as you can eventually reconstitute from anything short of the destruction of your soul’s Heart Core or the complete depletion of your impressive energy reserves.

As a True Giant, you also possess a great aptitude for wielding your Aura, allowing you to intuitively develop and use a great variety of Arts, ranging from simple physical enhancement, to devastating blasts of force, capable of altering the landscape itself. Additionally, a quirk of your Aura lends you disproportionately high defensive power when enhancing your body.

In addition to your Arts, you possess two powerful Intrinsic Skills:

Gigantification: The most recognizable ability of your species, with it you can expend your energy to increase your size and base physical abilities. This allows you to go from a ‘mere’ 7-8 ft tall superhuman, capable of boring through concrete with your bare hands, into a 70-80 ft tall natural disaster, capable of crushing entire fortresses with a single, unenhanced, strike. With some finesse, you can even selectively enlarge parts of your body or eventually use the physical power of your enlarged state while maintaining your smaller appearance.

Magic Nullification: Completely cancels out nearly any magical effect that directly affects you. As such, you enjoy near-absolute immunity to even the grandest magical attacks and barriers unravel at your barest touch. However, for all its power, this defense is not entirely fool-proof. This skill only nullifies magical phenomena that directly affect you, meaning magical enhancements and enchantments on your opponents will remain intact. Likewise, magic that enacts purely natural phenomena will not be nullified, meaning if someone summoned a boulder to strike you, it would naturally hit you, but if that same mage launched a conjured boulder it would dissipate harmlessly on contact. You are able to weaken or deactivate this skill at will, allowing yourself to receive desirable spells, such as healing or teleportation.
objects.title: True Giant (Tensura)

addons.title: Royal Child of the Stars
addons.text:
You are the second child of Veldanava, sharing the same father as Milim Nava, though with a different mother. Your powers and abilities as a Dragonoid have been further enhanced by your divine lineage, fortifying your scales and defenses to be nearly impenetrable to all but those of equal or greater strength. You can passively draw small amounts of energy from surrounding stars, using it to power spells or heal yourself when needed, enhancing your endurance in both battle and recovery.

Your command over Star Magic and related powers has also advanced significantly, granting you enhanced range, versatility, and devastating impact. Whether your opponents are spiritual or physical beings, they are not safe from your attacks, which now have the ability to penetrate both realms. As the child of the Star Dragon Veldanava, you possess the ability to travel through the void of space without harm.

In addition to your unique powers, you inherit the same skills and equipment as your sister, Milim Nava, and share a skill bond with her. Beyond these shared abilities, you will develop exclusive skills of your own through your divine lineage, including Extra, Unique, and Ultimate Skills. As Veldanava’s second child, you have a deep connection to the Voice of the World, granting you more frequent skill advancements and a natural rapport with this force—unless your actions should provoke its wrath.

Any being you name becomes your follower and can receive power or skills through a soul corridor. Should you have or create a world, these followers will permanently inhabit it, with full rights to live there. Whatever culture, civilization, or city your followers establish within your realm will naturally become an integrated part of your world.

As a demigod, ascension to full godhood will bestow upon you dominion over the universe and its stars. This Cosmic Domain enables you to draw energy from stars across existence, limited only by proximity. You can summon stars against your enemies, harness plasma from stellar cores, and even trigger a star to go supernova. With this Domain, you can freely create stars, summon miniature star forms into your hand to gift others, and wield an infinite self-sustaining star as your energy source—a source that will neither decay nor alter.

If you belong to a race with the potential for multiple domains, the Cosmic Domain will occupy one of those domain slots.

objects.text:
Dragonoids are a unique species born from the union of a True Dragon (a creature typically incapable of biological reproduction) and a High Human. However, your lineage is even more extraordinary: while one of your parents is a True Dragon, you can choose the heritage of the other, allowing a fusion of races—whether it be demigod, devil, kitsune, Saiyan, or any other. This choice shapes your character’s unique traits and abilities.

Visually, Dragonoids resemble a blend of human and dragon. They have a human-like form with draconic features such as scales, wings, horns, and a tail, which they can conceal to appear fully human. If your second parent’s race has unique characteristics, you may switch between your draconic and inherited traits or combine both to create an ideal fusion of species.

Although Dragonoids are imitations of True Dragons, they are classified as Divine Beings and possess power that rivals their dragon ancestors. They have an immortal material body that doesn’t age, although you can deactivate this trait until you reach your desired age. As one of the strongest races in the world, your natural abilities are profoundly enhanced.

Your power also reflects the Aspect controlled by your True Dragon parent, granting you skills tied to this element. As a Dragonoid, you acquire unique and ultimate skills more frequently and can hold more of these abilities than most other beings.

Over time, as you attain certain skills, you will eventually evolve into a True Dragon. This evolution will unlock access to divine powers inherited from your parents, enhancing all your abilities and influencing future evolutions. This divinity synergizes particularly well if your other race also has divine traits, amplifying your overall strength.
objects.title: Dragonoid (Tensura)

objects.text:
You are born a Toone, an alien race resembling the cartoons of our world. Due to the Toones' first contact with humanity, you gained access to Ballyhoo, a power based on people's admiration on one person. As such, you are powered by people's love of you.

Ballyhoos take the form of abilities based on technology, animation, or television functions. Some quick examples include:

Frame by Frame, the Ballyhoo of Pops (Popeye), which allows him to see the possible near futures like looking at frames of animation.

Dead Air, the Ballyhoo of Bugs (Bugs Bunny) which let's her summon a static space around her which sucks stuff it touches, making them disappear, minus its user (who can use it as makeshift portals instead).

Closed Captions, the Ballyhoo of Dee (Dexter's Lab) which can read a target's surface thoughts, helping in predicting their moves, understanding their language, etc.

You may later gain the Ballyhoo of other fellow Toones as well. Be warned though, the stronger your Ballyhoo is, the more you'll end up hearing people "watching" you. Tread with caution when overexerting your new powers.
objects.title: Ballyhoo (Scoob and Shag)

objects.text:
You are a dragon, specifically a dragon from the World of Wings of Fire. You can choose one of these Dragon tribes to be from:

IceWings: This tribe has adapted themselves to the cold. Their scales are made to thrive in Sub-Zero climates, have serrated claws for easily gripping ice, eyesight adapted to see through snowstorms and the Frost Breath as a weapon.

MudWings: One of the physically stronger tribe, they also possesss Flame Breath in warmer places and the ability to hold their breath for upto an hour. Mudwings hatched from eggs the color of blood have scales immune to fire.

NightWings: Scales the colour of night, the dragons of this tribe have Flame Breath and Nightvision. Their true powers can only be activated while hatching, those who hatched under the light of one moon gain the power of Foresight or Mindreading, those who hatched under under the light of two gain both, and those who hatch under more find both of these abilities much stronger.

RainWings: The 'Rainforest' tribe, the dragons of this tribe can spit a corrosive venom able to dissolve all things organic and change the colour of their scales to camouflage themselves against any backdrop. It is necessary that a Rainwing sleep a few hours daily under the Sun or they grow lethargic and lose their ability to change their colour.

SandWings: They have adapted themselves to the harsh conditions of deserts, better at handling their thirst and hunger than any other tribe. They have Flame Breath and their tails end in venomous barbs akin to scorpions. The venom is powerful enough to kill full grown dragons with a single strike.

SeaWings: Unlike the other tribes of Pyrrhia, SeaWings do not have a breath weapon, instead they have adapted to breath under water. They are exceptional swimmers, with wings and tails adapted for propulsion and steering underwater, and their eyes have evolved to allow them to see clearly beneath the surface. Additionally they have have bio-luminiscent stripes, which they can flicker to communicate underwater.

SkyWings: They are the fastest fliers of any dragon tribe due to their enormous wings and endurance, and they are built for flying longer distances because of their high stamina. They have Flame Breath and sharper visions than most tribes.

HiveWings: Powers in this tribe vary from dragon to dragon, these include: stingers extendable through wrists and/or tail, fatal venoms through teeth, claws and/or stingers, paralyzing nerve toxins in claws and/or tail stinger, spraying acid or emitting putrid smells. Additionally, they have an internal clock which tells them when rainy season is coming.

SilkWings: They are the only tribe which hatch without wings. At the age of 6 they undergo a metamorphosis, where they spin and stay in a cocoon for five day, emerging out with two pairs of wings and opened silk glands on their wrists. Some have the ability to make Flamesilk, special kinds of silk which can go from just golden in colour to hot enough to burn through stone. Like HiveWings they too have an internal clock which tells them when rainy season is coming.

LeafWings: They have the ability Leafspeak, to communicate with plants and seeds able to convince them various things from growing faster to attacking someone. Like RainWings they too absorb energy from Sunlight.

You can choose to be a hybrid, but your traits and powers would be weaker for it.
objects.title: Dragon (Wings of Fire)

objects.text:
You have become a Matoran, the first species made by the Great Beings.

Matorans are a small biomechanical race designed for construction and labor that are naturally inclined to be good-natured. In particular, their bodies are around 85% mechanical, with components such as the muscles and lungs being organic. 

Furthermore, Matorans all possess access to a replenishing reservoir of an Elemental Power within them that grants them a minute elemental trait based on their element, like extreme heat tolerance for fire or an internal compass for magnetism. The elements are the following: Fire, Water, Air, Stone, Earth, Ice, Light, Lightning, Magnetism, Plasma, Gravity, Sonic, The Green/Jungle, Iron, and finally Psionics. You may choose which element you possess.

It should be noted that Matorans do still possess biological needs, they need to breathe, sleep, eat, and drink either water or liquid Protodermis. It should be noted that Matorans possess two methods of eating, firstly by grasping the food source in their hands and directly absorbing its energy, or secondly by ingesting food with their mouths, although this is seen as repulsive to them. An additional need of the Matoran is to wear their Kanohi (Mask) as, when removed, it will weaken them and, if removed for a prolonged period, will render them comatose.
objects.title: Matoran (BIONICLE)

objects.text:
Humanoid-equine esque tricksters said to serve as guardians to specific forests. You are born a Tikbalang, a creature based on Filipino mythologies. 

As a Tikbalang, you are gifted with illusionary powers, able to glamour yourself to shapeshift into many humanoid forms and even lead people astray by using your trickery to leave them confused. This is actually most effective in forests where the trees seem to look familiar and yet not, leaving your victims trapped to be your playthings there until you get bored of them. A lot of Tikbalangs seem to also shapeshift as Sports Cars to make their speed seem plausible to normal humans.

You also seem to have connection with Elementals, particularly with the Wind due to your massive speed able to cause tornadoes in your wake. Your biggest weakness however is the three thickest sharp spine like hair on your mane, as if somebody manages to take those from you, you will be cursed to be under their service until they pass away.

The forest is yours my little trickster spirit, leave humans quaking in fear will you?
objects.title: Tikbalang (Trese)

objects.text:
You are a Troll. Native to Alternia, Trolls are a species of humanoid insects with grey skin, black hair, and Orange-yellow gradient horns. The primary identifiers between trolls being the various shapes these horns can take, and the colour of said troll’s blood which also acts as a signifier for their caste system.

Physically, Trolls are moderately more resilient than humans largely owing to the fact they possess few bones, rather being filled with a large amount of viscous liquid that carries nutrients to the organs as opposed to a human circulatory structure. Additionally, Trolls tend to have a surprising tendency towards mutations such as extra eyes, arms, horns, polycoria etc. Adult trolls range from 5-10ft in height with all trolls maturing at the same rate despite living for vastly different lengths of time.

Low caste trolls specifically (Composing Rust, Bronze, and Gold bloods) are both most numerous and tend to live 40, 60, and 80 years respectively. Notably however, lower caste trolls are likely to develop mild telekinetic abilities that grow in potency with training over time, or a kind of animal telepathy in the case of Bronzebloods. 

Mid-caste trolls meanwhile (Olive, Jade, and Teal bloods) can live for two centuries or longer, and focus more on specialised roles as a form of middle-class. Olivebloods are notably more agile and ‘wild’ while Jades spend most of their time in the birthing caverns facilitating troll reproduction. Tealbloods meanwhile take the form of specialist roles; Lawyers, secretaries and other ‘white-collar’ work.

High-Castes (Cerulian, Indigo, and Purple bloods) can easily live for thousands of years. In addition, each segment of the high caste excels in a specific area. Cerulianbloods specifically have a much higher chance of developing mind-controlling psionics of various kinds. Indigobloods are astounding physical specimens of the species, Purplebloods meanwhile are the functional ruling caste of landwelling troll society, and have access to mighty psychic ‘chucklevoodoos’ which are often used in conjunction with physical might to cull their ‘lessers’.

Violetbloods meanwhile, are the troll 1%, a royalty that abandon the land all together to become amphibious with fins and gills, second only to the Heiress and Empress themselves.
objects.title: Troll (Homestuck)

objects.text:
You are an UmaMusume, a horse girl, or a horse boy, if you prefer. This means you possess the abilities of a horse within a human body. You have the running speed, endurance, strength, reflexes, durability, and hearing of a horse. After reaching your physical peak, you no longer age in appearance. You also have horse ears and a tail. 

However, you are not an ordinary UmaMusume. You are an elite among elites, surpassing Symboli Rudolf and Tokai Teio. Your potential may even rival the legendary racehorses Eclipse and Secretariat. 

After reaching your potential with training and development, you approach the speed of a racing car. You can sustain 65–70 km/h for several kilometers, accelerate to that pace in about 10 seconds, and reach bursts of 80–85 km/h at your maximum. Your body is as strong as iron, and your reflexes are nearly as sharp as a cat’s. 

You also hold advantages beyond other UmaMusume. Your body is exceptionally healthy and resilient; common problems that afflict horses rarely trouble you. If they do, you recover within days or weeks through rapid regeneration. You regain stamina quickly and can maintain peak performance well into old age. 

Additionally, you are naturally talented in racing and running, mastering related techniques and skills more easily than most. You also possess the mental framework to handle stress, burnout, overtraining, anxiety, and other mental challenges typical to UmaMusume. 

Finally, you are blessed by the Three Goddesses. Your luck surpasses even the most lucky humans, and hardships that threaten your happiness almost never reach you. You could easily win a scratch-off or survive a plane crash with almost no injury. Your actions still have consequences, but the most extreme negative outcomes are softened. This blessing is especially effective against malicious external threats, weakening or even nullifying their plans. Still, its protection has limits; do not expect to survive threats of Endbringer-level and beyond.

Now, go out there and run with all your heart.
objects.title: UmaMusume (UmaMusume)

objects.text:
You are no longer bound by the limits of the human condition. Your flesh has been rewritten, your bones reforged, and your spirit entwined with a lattice of nanomachines that work in endless harmony with your biology. As an Enhanced ES Operative, you exist as a perfected warrior of the Galactic Organization of Trade and Tariffs, born from centuries of refinement and designed to serve as both blade and shield in conflicts that span entire star systems. Even without awakening your true ES ability, you are a being who stands far above the realm of mortals, operating at a level of power that can shatter armies and endure the storms of worlds.

Your body is a masterpiece of bioengineering. Muscles coil with inexhaustible strength, sinew moves with fluid speed, and reflexes snap faster than energy beams. You can lift what machines struggle to move, outrun vehicles, and fight continuously without fatigue. Your nanomachines hum through every cell, tirelessly repairing damage, neutralizing poisons, and regenerating flesh even in the heat of battle. They slow and reverse the effects of time, ensuring your youth and vitality remain untouched while decades and centuries fall away around you. Death for you is never final; your body may be destroyed, but your memory is preserved in the flow of reincarnation, allowing you to return again and again to continue your work, carrying your identity and skills across centuries of rebirth.

As an operative, you are a master of combat in all forms.
