Centuries of missions and retained experience grant you mastery over unarmed martial arts, advanced weaponry, infiltration, espionage, and tactical command. You do not simply fight—you dominate the battlefield with precision, weaving together skill and instinct in ways that overwhelm even the most disciplined opponents. Your senses sharpen beyond human capacity; you perceive the world with clarity that lets you track movements no eye should follow, read intent in the smallest gestures, and detect the faintest energies that ripple through reality.

Your existence is not limited to combat alone. You are equipped for survival and adaptation across every environment. You can operate in the void of space without hesitation, endure the crushing depths of alien oceans, or walk unburned upon volcanic plains. Gravity, atmosphere, radiation—none of these are barriers to you, for your body and nanomachines adapt seamlessly to conditions that would annihilate ordinary life. This makes you more than a soldier—you are an explorer, a pioneer, a force that moves unchallenged through the galaxy.

Though your body and skills are extraordinary, your role carries weight beyond personal might. Enhanced ES Operatives are the vanguard of stability in a fragile galaxy, enforcers of order, and sometimes executioners of necessity. You embody the strength and will of your organization, yet remain an individual, defined by your own beliefs and choices. Even stripped of the more flamboyant gifts of your peers, you are feared and respected, for your foundation is already a weapon few can match.

The truth of the Enhanced ES Operative is simple but profound: even without awakening the deeper abilities that slumber within, you are already beyond the reach of mortals, already a legend written in flesh and steel. Your body is your fortress, your spirit your weapon, and your existence the declaration that humanity, reforged and perfected, can rival gods.
objects.title: Enhanced ES Operative (Kiddy Grade)

addons.text:
With a new flame-red hide, it seems that you possess the same mutation as Devil Dinosaur.

This mutation has elevated your might to the next level. Now, your strength allows you to treat giant boulders like soccer balls, fling other dinosaurs hundreds of feet away, lift shipping containers, and even knock down small buildings. Further, now, your durability allows you to take blows from the Hulk, have gunfire bounce off of you, and only be stunned by an army-killing laser.

Finally, this mutation has also boosted your intelligence, allowing you to create technology like mental interfaces, mechanical limbs, and laser weaponry.
addons.title: Devil Dinosaur (Marvel)

addons.text:
It seems that you have gained the skills, strength, and size of both Heart and Baku from You are Umasou.

Your body is now so large that dinosaurs like a full-grown T-Rex or Triceratops are barely larger than just your head. This grants you the strength and durability to create shockwaves with every attack that can send other dinosaurs flying several feet back, deliver headbutts that violently shake and crater cliffs, have the bite of another T-Rex fail to pierce your hide, counter the quakes of an erupting volcano with a roar, and even use your little arms to lift and grapple with those who rival your own size.

Meanwhile, your newfound skills allow you to defeat entire packs of similar-sized megatheropods on your own with ease, use a form of kickboxing that is modified for you, and develop techniques like a drilling headbutt to match the power of those several times your size.
addons.title: Baku and Heart (You are Umasou)

addons.text:
It seems that you have undergone the evolution into a Deinos, a race described as a near-perfect species.

Starting off, as a Deinos, your mind is comparable to a supercomputer, granting you the intelligence to create handheld railguns and other sci-fi innovations just from handling a modern firearm. Further, it also allows you to communicate with others via thoughts, including very different species like humans, allowing you to empathize with them.

Next, your natural strength is on par with servants, with your durability being further enhanced by the biowaves you generate; an electromagnetic field negates shockwaves, making physical attack nearly useless against you.

Finally, you and your kin possess both the ability to camouflage like a chameleon and to perform a form of photosynthesis, resulting in you only needing sunlight and water to survive.
addons.title: Deinos (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Through the mixing of sheer size and fire, you have become the second coming of Dinosaur King’s Black T-Rex.

With your newfound nature, your height has seen a significant increase, as you now stand a whopping 5 stories tall. This has resulted in your strength, durability, and firepower becoming monstrous.

Starting off, you can now effortlessly crush and knock down small to medium buildings, create shockwaves that send superpowered dinosaurs flying, smash through future alloys without much issue, and even fling dinosaurs biting you off by several feet just by flexing.

Next, your durability renders many forms of attack pointless on you; even elemental blasts capable of leveling buildings will fail to scratch you. Like your predecessor, it will take attacks like 14 superpowered dinosaurs combining their powers into a fusion attack, three times, to finally bring you down.

Finally, with the firepower you possess, you can produce building-sized fireballs, flames that melt through several floors of metal, damage robots capable of overpowering dinosaurs, and even pillars of flame that rise hundreds of feet.
addons.title: Black T-Rex (Dinosaur King)

addons.text:
It seems that you have also gained the physical capabilities of Dino Crisis’s T-Rexes. With your newfound capabilities, your speed, strength, and durability have seen an increase.

With your newfound speed, you can walk faster than a trained soldier can run, run fast enough to keep with a helicopter, and swim at speeds to match a hovercraft.

Strength-wise, you can now knock down steel supports without noticing, casually shatter concrete barriers, knock down and crumple security doors with ease, and even significantly damage modern tanks with your blows.

Your most impressive increase is your durability. Most modern handheld weapons are useless on you; tank fire now only stuns you, and anti-armored weapons like anti-tank rifles and RPGs require hitting soft spots like your eyes to wound you. Further, even being subject to things like large gas explosions or immense electrical discharges only briefly knocks you unconscious. To bring you down, it requires high-grade explosives going off inside you, military-grade aircraft ordinance, or simply being absurdly strong like Dino Crisis’s Giganotosaurus.
addons.title: Cyclops (Dino Crisis)

objects.text:
You are now the terrifying megatheropod of the Great Beyond, the Original Sharptooth. With each step, the earth shakes, as you are an enormous T-Rex, comparable to sauropods like apatosaurus in size.

As a result of your immense bulk, your sheer might is absurd. Your strength grants you the power to smash through boulders that surpass you in size, shake an entire cliff with a headbutt, and leap over a hundred feet in a standing jump. Whilst your durability allows you to take a human-sized thorn to the eye and only be temporarily blinded in that eye, fall into a chasm over a mile deep with debris and be rendered unconscious but mostly unharmed, and be slammed through a stone wall without any harm.

Finally, like your might, your tracking capabilities are also astounding. You are able to sniff out and follow your target even as they traverse through lagoons, swamps, volcanic wastes, and even mountains.

Optionally, you may choose to manifest this race as a changer form instead.
objects.title: Original Sharptooth (The Land Before Time)

objects.text:
Now you belong to the Melusine race—the daughters of Elynas, a dragon-like creature that came from the “cosmic abyss.” The Melusines themselves arose from their “father's” bleeding wounds and the fragments that fell into those wounds.

Melusines are small (130–140 cm) bipedal humanoid creatures with tails, mitten-like hands, short legs, two horns resembling the rhinophores of sea slugs, human hair, and sometimes small wings, which, however, do not allow them to fly. All melusines are female, although they have no pronounced sexual characteristics. Each melusine has a unique combination of body color, hair color, and pupil shape and color. In any case, their appearance can be described as extremely cute.

Melusines are physically weaker and less agile than humans, but they live much longer (up to immortality—in 400 years, none of them have aged). They do not get sick and feel great both in water and on land, being excellent swimmers. Their perception is much more developed than that of humans, allowing them to see what is hidden from human eyes, including faded or disappeared traces, many shades of one color, the past of objects and their true meaning, as well as hidden connections. However, their sense of beauty can differ significantly from that of humans, as can their taste and smell, which can lead to some of their dishes appearing to humans as “biological weapons” or “culinary disasters.” They see the sun as a “bright black ball in the sky.”

It is widely acknowledged that you would make an ideal investigator.

Like the “born” Melusines, you will receive your “token” — a detail or fragment with which you will feel a strong connection.

At the beginning of your journey as a Melusine, you will be able to hear Elyna's voice, which will help you adapt to your new life, teach you everything you need to know, and provide moral support.

You will also develop a heightened sense of justice and kindness.

You can choose a different gender, but in the end, it won't change much. You can also choose a form of self-expression through a hobby such as art, cooking, or poetry... But be prepared for people not to appreciate it.
objects.title: Melusine (Genshin Impact)
Baku (Genshin Impact)
objects.text:
You are a dream eater Youkai known as Baku. Traditionally, Baku take the shape of colorful, tapir-like creatures, though you have long since learned to transform into a human. In human form, you have distinctive eyes, pointy elf-like ears, a smooth, soft, cow-like tail and attractive features. You have no physical advantages over humans beyond slightly better hearing and eyesight, though you are ageless.

You are a dream eater, and dreams are your primary source of sustenance. You can also consume emotions and memories, though these provide only small amounts of nourishment. Eating bamboo and other greens is also an option, though they provide little nourishment. Other foods, such as meat or sweets, can be eaten but do not fill your stomach.

Whether it be dreams, emotions or memories, whatever you may eat, its contents will affect the taste. Particularly bad tasting dreams might give you stomachache or indigestion.

Consuming someone's dreams requires entering their dream by physical contact. You experience whatever you eat, though you can suppress the memories and experiences to some extent. Once you consume something, it disappears, causing the individual to forget it.

You can also manipulate and control dreams, induce sleep, fabricate new dreams or enter others’ dreams. As you consume more dreams, you will discover new stronger applications for your dream manipulation.

Eating someone's dreams, nightmares, emotions, or memories can be used to heal any of their mental or spiritual problems, whether it be mundane or supernatural, even if the source of the problem is not related to dreams, emotions or memories. The more serious the issue, the longer it will take to heal, ranging from a day to a week. Extreme cases, like problems caused by divine authority or conceptual curses might take longer, but you can still fix them within a month. Consuming dreams gradually increases the potency of your dream eating ability, allowing you to deal with more serious problems with greater ease. 

Alternatively, you can drain someone of their hopes and emotions, leaving them a husk of their former self. However, doing this is more difficult against someone with a stronger will than yours.

While consuming dreams, you can also harmlessly immerse yourself in them to slowly learn whatever skills or gain whatever experience is being displayed. This only grants experience and mastery, so it cannot grant you powers that you could not otherwise already use.

You are also extremely talented in caring for others, tending to their body, mind and soul, and bringing them comfort and relief. Your talent in all things related to healing, whether mundane or magical, is unparalleled. As long as you have access to a supernatural energy, such as mana, you can easily develop supportive abilities. Finally, you possess a comforting aura that naturally eases others into a state of relaxation and slowly heals their mind and spirit.

addons.text:
A small lattice of nano-crystalline material has been implanted along your spinal cord and woven into your cerebral cortex. This tiny, precise implant was designed to merge a Spartan’s unmatched physical and tactical capabilities with a Huntsman’s greatest asset: their aura. While a Spartan may not notice immediate benefits, the augmentation has a profound impact over their long-term growth. Over months, it gradually reshapes the body, transforming the Spartan into a perfect conduit for their aura, allowing energy to flow seamlessly through every fiber of muscle, bone, and nerve. As this process continues, both combat prowess and aura mastery are steadily amplified, enhancing reflexes, defensive capabilities, physical performance, regeneration, and even cognitive function, until the Spartan becomes a living embodiment of their own power.

The first effects observed by Spartan operatives are usually linked to their omnidirectional forcefield, which increases in density and strength, allowing them to withstand blows that would have previously left them injured. As they acclimate further, they also notice a considerable rise in their overall physical parameters. This improvement appears to be a passive boost, the result of a deeper synchronization between their aura and their soul, allowing the body to channel energy more efficiently and enhance natural capabilities far beyond ordinary limits. Interestingly, this augmentation of physical prowess appears to be directly linked to a Spartan’s aura reserves, with research so far unable to determine a ceiling for how far their strength, speed, reflexes, and endurance can eventually increase.

The greatest benefit observed among Spartans is the increase in natural regeneration, enabling them to recover from non-lethal major wounds within hours, allowing them to operate outside of supply lines for extended periods. Additionally, due to the precise placement of the implant along the spinal cord and cerebral cortex, Spartan operatives experience enhanced cognitive function, with heightened intelligence, faster processing, and sharper perception, further complementing their physical and auric evolution.

The increase in auric conductivity and sensitivity has allowed Spartans to control their aura with seemingly perfect control and shape it in ways previously unheard of. This heightened sensitivity acts as an extra sense, allowing them to perceive the flow of aura within their surroundings and react to attacks that would have otherwise gone unnoticed, granting an almost preternatural awareness in combat.
addons.title: Nano-Crystalline Implant
Spartan Training (Halo)
addons.text:
You have the Augments, you have the armor, and now you have the training. After having survived augmentation, and being granted your own suit of Mjolnir armor, you have now also been granted the full and in depth training expected of a Spartan 2 Elite Super Soldiers. 

Given the equivalent of 10 years of heavy training where many others would have given up, you have persevered through. Thanks to your effort (and your luck) You’ve been granted the designation Spartan-001, and possess an aptitude for a specific skill, such as Kelly-087’s 
Speed, Linda-058’s skills with a sniper, or Frederic-104’s skills in Close quarters combat. You also know the secret signals the early Spartan 2’s developed to communicate with each other and differentiate each other even when wearing identical armor. 

Even if you happen to be a non-human species this also allows your augments to become fully compatible with your specific biology, ensuring that no matter what, they will be at least some improvement over any higher evolution of physiology with no negative effects. 

If you happen to be in the Halo Universe, you can choose to have gone through the training with the other Spartan 2 members, and maintain a Treasured and respected relationship as siblings with all Spartan 2s.

objects.text:
Your body shows the effects of having undergone the Spartan II augmentation prodecures. These augmentations are specially built and designed to create superhuman soldiers, capable of acting as an elite military force to defend and protect humanity. While many subjects who went through these procedures showed varying levels of compatibility to the augmentations, some even rejecting them in catastrophic failure, you appear to have adapted to them like they were meant to be a part of you all along. 

Your bones are grafted with an advanced carbide ceramic material, leaving them virtually unbreakable. Your muscles have been enhanced with various protein complexes, leading to increased muscle density and reduced lactase recovery time, enhancing strength and stamina without excess bulk. Your thyroid is implanted with a platinum pellet that regulates and improves your growth hormones, leading to boosted skeletal and muscular growth, increasing height and size without extreme hormone imbalance. Your retinas have been modified, enhancing blood flow, leading to marked visual perception improvements. Finally, your nervous system has been modified, reinforced, and enhanced, leading to a manyfold increase in your reaction times, fast enough to let you practically percieve the world in slow motion when subjected to adrenaline, deemed 'spartan time' by UNSC personnel. On top of this, the nervous system enhancements provided a benefit only anecdotally seen in some spartans, a noticeable increase in intelligence, creativity, and memory.

As a result of these enhancements, you stand over two meters tall, and weigh in at twice that of a typical human of your size. As a result of your physiological enhancements, you're fast enough shortly after undergoing these enhancements to exceed 60km/h, strong enough to curl approximately three times your body weight, and striking with around 4000 neutons of force, enough to cave in a human skull with a single punch. Your reaction times are at a baseline, a lightning fast 20ms, many times that of the fastest human, and enhanced even further when subject to adrenaline or with AI assitance. Your eyes are nearly capable of true dark vision. As a reminder, this is what you are capable of as a freshly enhanced spartan II. Spartan II's are well known to simply grow more powerful with age, so expect these figures to rise over time. 

While this does not grant you the training that typically accompanies full grown battle ready spartans, you are fully adapted to your new physical form, a one man army beyond that of human capability.
objects.title: Spartan II (Halo)

addons.text: Rather than being an ordinary Mind Dragon, you are a Sequence Two: Discerner, a genuine mythical creature. As the Visionary Pathways mythical creature form is a Mind Dragon, you are a Mind Dragon twice over. As a Sequence Two, you would have been considered a subsidiary god in ancient times, though in modern times, you would be an Angel. You can easily assume human form, listen to and respond to prayers on a planetary scale, bestow blessings and boons on others, and traverse the spirit world directly as long as you have accurate coordinates, which you can obtain from prayers. As a Mythical Creature, you can shatter beyonder characteristics to free them from sealed artifacts and eliminate any corruption within them, as well as resist sefirot’s ability to form a connection to anyone who knows of their existence. You can also cast your gaze into the astral world. Your already high affinity for the Visionary pathway increases drastically, making reaching Sequence Zero: Visionary near-inevitable, only requiring a handful of years at most. If you possess the True Mythical Creature upgrade, you begin at Sequence One of the Visionary Pathway instead, often referred to as an Archangel, with all corresponding traits, powers, and capabilities elevated to that level.
addons.title: Sequence Two: Discerner

addons.text:
As an Angel of the Visionary pathway, you have used the blasphemy slate to gain control over the Chaos Sea, becoming its owner. Your control over the Chaos Sea is around the same level as Klein had over the Sefirot Castle when he was a Sequence Two: Miracle Invoker.

The Chaos Sea is projected onto your spirit body, allowing you to perceive it in its entirety. Although the Chaos Sea is large enough to almost completely fill the earth's core, this perception does not overwhelm you or distract you.

You can enter the Chaos Sea at will, allowing you to take advantage of the Divine Kingdom that naturally emanates from its core. This Divine Kingdom takes on the appearance you want it to have, and has a defensive barrier even True Gods working together would be unable to break through. It also provides concealment that even the True God of the White Tower pathway could not see through.

The aura of the Chaos Sea permeates and integrates deep into your physical and spiritual body, enhancing your strength roughly comparable to a Sequence One: Author, though you lack the abilities and authorities of an Author. Through the Chaos Sea, you can borrow the abilities of lower sequences of your high sequence group, as well as parts of the same sequence abilities.

The aura of the Chaos Sea also extends your lifespan indefinitely.
addons.title: Owner of the Chaos Sea

objects.text:
You have become a Mind Dragon, a majestic western dragon with scales akin to greyish-white stone slabs, and pale-golden with vertical slit pupils.

Your wings have a bone-like structure with metallic leaf veins running through them. A grey membrane seemingly engraved with various patterns and symbols covers these bony wings, which are large enough to support your large and heavy body during flight.

The symbols covering your wing membranes depict complex knowledge within the mind domain. Given study, you can derive mystical knowledge from these symbols and patterns, allowing you to learn how to create high-level rituals, charms, or mystical artifacts.

You can run and fly at speeds surpassing high-speed bullet trains and easily tear through steel blocks with your claws, and your lifespan is in the range of thousands of years.

As a Mind Dragon, you have some limited innate power corresponding to the Visionary pathway, though your abilities come from stabilized racial mutations, not beyonder characteristics.

You possess a Mind Dragon Breath, allowing you to directly stimulate and harm the target's body of heart and mind. This leaves their mind in chaos and hinders their ability to form coherent thoughts. It deals area-of-effect damage.

You can also enter and traverse the Sea of Collective Subconsciousness. This allows you to transform your material body into an illusory state to bring it along. This enables you to effectively teleport to anywhere there are living beings or enter their mind islands to interfere with their dreams or thought processes over a long period of time.
objects.title: Mind Dragon (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text: You are a Squiddle, a race of tentacled aliens who are separated into 4 castes. Depending on which is the sets of powers you'll end up naturally having. You may choose to be one of them. These castes are: The Eat Most are the highest of the pyramid. They are capable of temporarily turning into gaseous forms and changing their size and density, within a limit. They can get up to the size of a small house and as small as a tiny dog. They also tend to have the most tentacles on their heads. The Eat More are the second highest. They possess camoflage and invisibility abilities, and can make their limbs sticky for wall crawling. As such, they tend to release more ink than their other fellow squiddles as it is necessary for their ability set. The Eat Moderately are the second lowest of the caste. They have mantles on their heads that are used for flying, making them one of two of the caste able to fly. They can also perform minor illusions and mimic sounds. And finally, the Eat Less squids, known to be the caste of freaks and mutations. They tend to have vampiric characteristics, and are capable of bioluminescence, their bodies looking like glass whenever they glow. They are also resistant to powers that involve mental manipulation like mind control or illusions. All these powers are well and good however, but you must know, a Squiddle's life is on a time limit. Unless you are able to delay your aging, you are going to grow and mutate into a Horrorterror, a tentacle covered monstrosity who is born from your worse traits, turned into a being of pure anger and hunger. Sooo, good luck with that. Otherwise, the moment you enter your chosen world, you will be given a Mermaid, which is what squiddles call the almost completely white animal resembling creatures in their planet. They are hyper intelligent, and are the source of your powers. You are then given a choice, get all of your abilities at once by killing this mermaid, or spare the creature and earn a mentor and a companion. One who would slowly give you it's abilities until you are ready, maybe potentially even delaying your evolution into a horrible creature? This power is with a cost, are you willing to risk it?
objects.title: Squiddles (Agoraphobia / Homestuck)

objects.text:
You have become a Genome-Cyborg — a human whose DNA and genetic structure have been artificially altered by microchips created by Dr. Eric Jobs. These chips contain the genetic material of various creatures, granting you the ability to painlessly transform into anthropomorphic beasts. However, unlike ordinary Genome-Cyborgs, you are the Ultimate Genome-Cyborg, similar to Luke Custer, meaning you have no limit on how many genomes you can assimilate.

You have nine Beast Forms, which are as follows: Werewolf, Merman, Wendigo, Garuda, Minotaur, Dragon, Grizzly, U.W.H., and Weretiger. Each Beast Form grants a superhuman physique, enhancing your strength, durability, and reflexes, along with unique abilities depending on the form. In addition to physical enhancements, every Beast Form also wields control over a particular element — for example, the Merman can manipulate water, the Wendigo manipulates ice, and the U.W.H. manipulates gravity.

At first, you will only have access to the Werewolf Form, unlocking others as you gain experience with your transformations and meet specific conditions — such as diving into water to unlock the Merman Form. While Genome-Cyborgs originally required additional Genome Chips to acquire new forms, your chips are capable of self-improvement, allowing you to gain additional Beast Forms by absorbing the DNA of other creatures in any way (such as drinking their blood or ingesting a strand of hair). However, you must still meet the necessary conditions to access each form.
objects.title: Genome-Cyborg (Project Altered Beast)

addons.text:
You have ascended to the upper ranks of the Demon Clan, and your physique now reflects that elevated status. All of your previous abilities have been amplified to the level of a member of the Ten Commandments, with the potential to one day rival Meliodas at his peak. For perspective, Meliodas was so overwhelmingly powerful that he singlehandedly tipped the balance of the Holy War in favor of the Goddess Clan.

Your enhanced physiology grants several new advantages: a far more potent aura capable of instilling fear even in beings as strong as the Sins; five additional hearts; the power to compel individuals bound by contract to obey your commands; and the ability to possess human bodies as vessels.

Finally, you inherit the full arsenal of skills and combat experience Meliodas accumulated over more than 3,000 years of battle.
addons.title: Wrathful Ascendency

addons.text:
You have become a Nephilim—a rare hybrid of the Goddess and Demon Clans, with Tristan Liones being the only other known example. This transformation grants you the divine abilities of the Goddess Clan in addition to your demonic powers. Chief among these is Ark, a form of magic that manipulates light particles into beams, blades, barriers, and other constructs. Ark also provides potent healing, capable of curing injuries, illnesses, and even curses. As an added boon, you gain access to Breath of Bless, a spell that empowers its targets while subtly brainwashing them into fervent, unwavering zealots.

Finally, you can exploit the natural incompatibility between Darkness and Ark through a technique known as Annihilation, generating an explosion that erases matter outright, bypassing both physical durability and magical resistance.
addons.title: Nephilim (Four Knights Of The Apocalypse)

objects.text:
By drinking the blood of various demons, you have become a demon yourself and inherited their racial abilities. Your physiology is now powerful enough to contend with a sealed Meliodas and the other Sins, granting you rapid regeneration, resistance to most poisons and toxins, a second heart,  and the ability to fly with newly grown wings. You also wield the Demon Clan’s Power of Darkness, enabling you to shape a dense, shadowy substance into a variety of offensive and defensive forms.

Because you’ve consumed the blood of a Gray Demon, you’ve gained access to its exceptionally dangerous techniques: Dark Snow, Dead End, and Black Nebula. You also command Hellblaze, an inextinguishable black flame capable of negating the regenerative abilities of beings like Ban. Additionally, you can steal souls through physical contact, consuming them to restore your strength and absorb the memories they hold—though this ability can backfire if the soul’s will is overwhelmingly strong. All of these powers are doubled in potency at night.

However, you possess one major weakness: holy magic, such as the Goddess Clan’s Ark. Holy magic breaks down the Darkness particles you create. Though it won’t kill you outright, it can severely hinder your combat effectiveness.
objects.title: Demon Reactor (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
You have become a member of the Goddess Clan, one of the five major races, created by the Supreme Deity shortly after she herself was brought into existence by Chaos. Members of the Goddess Clan possess angelic wings that allow them to fly, and when they use their magical powers, their eyes turn orange and manifest a triskelion symbol. Some may also display divergent traits, such as Tarmiel possessing multiple heads.

A Goddess’s power is generally distinguished by the number and size of their wings. They also appear to have the longest lifespans among the five races, capable of living for several thousand years. Though they are not actual gods like the Supreme Deity, the Goddess Clan is an extremely powerful race, capable of standing on equal footing with the Demon Clan. However, despite their immense magical power, they require a physical form to directly affect the world. If they exert themselves to their utmost limit, they may lose that form and be forced to inhabit a vessel—such as an object—in order to continue existing.

Members of the Goddess Clan share several common abilities. One of these is Ark, a magical technique that generates light particles, often enveloping the target in a dazzling sphere of light that tears their body apart. It is particularly effective against darkness, disintegrating it, though it can also inflict physical damage. Another ability is Purge, a technique that erases “abominable” souls, such as those of vampires and demons.

They also possess Healing, the ability to restore any living creature—even Demons, with sufficient control. They can heal injuries, cure diseases, and dispel curses. By channeling their healing power through Ark, they can use Invigorate, which counters negative effects such as severe physical trauma, miasma, or potent acids, restores health and stamina, and clears intense negative emotions like hatred and madness. Despite their formidable healing abilities, the Goddess Clan cannot resurrect the dead.

If they lose their physical body, a member of the Goddess Clan can use Possession. By forming a consensual pact with an individual, they may use that person’s body as a vessel to house their soul, allowing them to continue existing until their original body is restored. However, this cannot continue indefinitely. The host organism becomes weakened or destabilized the more the Goddess uses their magical power and may eventually die. The more compatible the vessel is with the possessor’s magic, the greater the power they can wield—though it will still fall short of their original body’s full strength.

You begin with strength surpassing that of a standard Holy Knight, placing you on par with Red Demons, and you possess the potential to rise to the level of an Archangel.
objects.title: Goddess Clan (The Seven Deadly Sins)

addons.text: Hidden within the clicking, chittering swarm is a unique mind, still young, but growing more aware as time passes. You are not a single mere Sliver but a gestalt mind within a Legion. As such, you’ll find yourself beginning with an initial hive in the hundreds, working and acting as directed, each rife with pre-existing adaptations. Additionally, your limit on ‘Node’ Slivers have been rendered obsolete, becoming a truly limitless groupmind, no matter their position in the ‘hierarchy’. Finally, you’ve taken a position within the swarm’s greater mind, meaning that as long as either ten Slivers survive in your hive or a single 'Node', you will remain conscious and active. Should the hive be reduced below this, they will need to rebuild to ten before you become conscious again.
addons.title: Sliver Legion

addons.text: The question isn’t whether slivers will adapt to a world’s perils but whether the world’s perils will adapt to slivers. Your Slivers are uniquely bonded with the phyrexian Oil, allowing them to spread at an unparalleled rate. Not only are all your slivers capable of Progressive Evolution, bonding metals to their form to improve themselves, but sharing these adaptations as well. Additionally, creatures infected by the Glistening Oil can now be converted into Slivers at your direction, becoming utterly subsumed by the Swarm.
addons.title: Glistening Sliver

addons.text: “We are kinfolk,” explained Karn to the sliver queen. “Just as you need your progeny to complete you, so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole.” Possessing a Spark, unlike any Sliver before, you are capable of moving across the planes. Unfortunately, Slivers share knowledge of how to shapeshift their designs, and cannot copy a thing as esoteric as a Spark. Instead, when you planeswalk, you can leave a ‘Node’ in control of the Hive to await your return or contact. When you planeswalk, you can take up to fifteen Slivers with you to your next destination in order to create a new Hive on this new world. Should you return to a world with a Hive you previously created, you will naturally take control of its highest position.
addons.title: Migratory

addons.text: “They share more than their thoughts. We must shatter their link quickly!” —Hanna, to Orim Your ability to command and create slivers has been dramatically increased. Rather than waiting for Slivers to adapt or relying on external methods, you can now produce Slivers designed to fit specific niches and solve specific problems. As a single sliver transmits its knowledge to the hive, this allows your hive to be an even more exponential issue as developments are made to greater depths and speed than would otherwise be possible. In addition, you yourself are not limited to singular adaptations to share with the hive, being able to develop scores of them internally, including mutually incompatible adaptations, though you would have to choose which to share in such a case.
addons.title: Sliver Overlord

addons.text: As malleable as molten steel, but as dangerous as the finished blade. The Five of you are each a Node of the Hive. each of your fragments is guaranteed to begin with an appropriately dramatic ability it can share with the others, and the rest of the hive when it develops. Similarly, when the five form you, you are able to activate any of their ‘Node’ abilities, with the caveat that whenever one is not active, the others proportionally grow in strength. Ie if one were capable of acting as a ‘Sliver Queen’, focusing on this alone would allow you to disgorge legions of Slivers in minutes. Additionally, all Slivers of the hive count as ‘You’ for the purposes of your observation and maintenance through them, essentially making you manifestation of the greater hivemind rather than simply of the five.
addons.title: The Hive Five

objects.text: The end of evolution. You have become a creature of shared evolution, a Sliver. As a Sliver, you yourself are only unique in that you are a central node of the Hive Mind, one of six that can exist in any Sliver Hive. Slivers are a kind of Shapeshifter that share a group mind, sharing knowledge of adaptations and alteration between themselves. Slivers usually take one of two base forms; a long snake-like creature with a pointed head and single bladed arm in the chest that guides itself with a mix of echolocation, psionics, and electroreception, and a humanoid form crested with tentacular hair, bladed limbs and animalistic proportions. Though these forms look different, they can both exist within a singular Hive, fulfilling different roles. Slivers demonstrate rapid adaptation and mutation, shapeshifting to adapt to their environment. Individual Slivers have been known to develop wings, additional limbs, even hair follicles that generate mana. The caveat of this being that each sliver can only make one bespoke adaptation of its own. However, each Sliver can share their adaptations across the hive, allowing each sliver in the hive to gain the adaptation as long as the Sliver with the ‘master blueprint’ remains active. Eventually this can cause Hives to be absolutely monstrous forces in their environment, especially if they have access to some bespoke means of giving newborn Slivers bespoke adaptations that can then be passed to the rest. Each Sliver Hive can support six ‘Nodes’ of the group mind before they need to begin separating into multiple independent hives. These nodes usually have a bespoke function, like acceleration of Sliver births (Queens, The First), development of bespoke adaptation (Hivelord, Overlord), or even conquering death (Gravemother). Your Hive will begin with only yourself as its first Node. Sliver reproduction takes three primary forms; Breeding, Mitosis, and Transmutation. Firstly, Slivers can produce eggs approximately once every year. After six months the egg will hatch into a juvenile Sliver, capable of developing an adaptation of it’s own. Secondly, Slivers can perform a kind of ‘mitosis’, producing a duplicate of themselves. This is dramatically energy intensive and usually results in both Slivers’ exhaustion and can be fatal in extremis. This can be approximately once every ten years, and the resultant Sliver will be a complete duplicate, including the adaptation it has stored. Finally, you specifically can convert biomass into new Slivers, over the course of thirty seconds turning 60kg of biomatter into a juvenile sliver. Greater amounts of mass can be used to produce more or healthier slivers than this average. (the average human being is 65kg) It is worth noting, it is rather random to produce a Sliver on the level of a ‘Node’, usually coming once every hundred or so Slivers. In addition they tend to enjoy an ‘honour guard’ of twenty slivers nearby to dissuade aggression or action against them. Once all of your Hive’s ‘Nodes’ are filled they may seek your approval to consume any young Nodes that threaten their position rather than split into a young hive, though this can be curtailed with some effort. Do be wary. Unnamed Hives have decimated entire Planes, turned empires to dust and people to livestock.
objects.title: Sliver, Fragmentado, Remasuri (Magic: the Gathering)

objects.text:
You are an Elder Dragon, a species of ancient and magically powerful beings. Elder Dragons, unlikesome other species of dragons, can choose to be bipedal as well as walk on four legs. They have six limbs, and are usually about 30 to 40 feet tall. There's a lot of variation in what Elder Dragons can look like, but their coloring can be affected by the types of mana they can wield. Before the mending, an Elder Dragon on it's own could be considered powerful enough to challenge some gods and Planeswalkers. This is due to their natural advantages, but also due to their millenia long lifespan which allows them to accumulate great deals of magical knowledge.

You can choose your general size and look from the range that Elder Dragons fall into, as well as the colors of mana that you are proficient in wielding.
objects.title: Elder Dragon (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
A vampire is an undead, immortal, humanoid oddity sometimes referred to as “the king of oddities.” They are nocturnal monsters that suck blood not only out of hunger and instinct, but also to create servants, who in turn become vampires themselves. However, you are not like them. Instead, you descend directly from the strongest vampire in the world: Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade.

This lineage grants you numerous abilities, including superhuman strength (allowing you to kick down metal doors, lift a concrete roller with one arm, and effortlessly leap dozens of meters into the air), superhuman durability (surviving punches powerful enough to create craters and falls from dozens of meters that only crack the ground), and superhuman speed (able to cross 100 meters in five seconds effortlessly and move fast enough to appear as a blur to the human eye). Your vampirism also keeps your body in peak physical condition. You are biologically immortal and possess powerful regeneration that enhances your stamina, allows you to recover lost body parts and being split in half within seconds, and even regenerate from being reduced to ashes.

As an Oddity, you can see and interact with supernatural beings such as ghosts. You can drain the living essence of creatures—including other oddities—by sucking their blood, which also empowers you and reinforces your abilities. You are capable of consuming not only flesh, but nearly anything, including other oddities. You can shapeshift, such as transforming your arms into swords, turning into mist to teleport, and even altering your clothing. You are also capable of generating matter from nothing, allowing you to create objects of any complexity.

Your abilities are empowered by moonlight. You can share senses and emotions with any minions you create, and you possess a nearly flawless appearance with little to no need for hygiene. You can submerge yourself within another lifeform’s shadow, shaping its interior however you desire. You have night vision, can walk on ceilings as though they were floors, and can recover lost memories by forcing your hand through your skull and into your brain. Your blood and saliva also possess healing properties.

However, vampirism comes with severe weaknesses. Sunlight causes you to combust, and prolonged exposure will reduce you to ash. While your regeneration can eventually restore you, doing so would likely take centuries, if not longer. Once removed from sunlight, the flames immediately vanish, leaving no burn marks on your body or clothing. You have no shadow and possess no reflection in mirrors; silver is harmful to you, crosses repel you, garlic weakens you, and holy water melts your flesh.

As you age and consume more blood, your powers steadily grow while your weaknesses diminish. One day, you may reach the level of Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade herself—capable of causing objects to explode merely by glaring at them, traveling through time through the manipulation of spiritual energy, leaping from Antarctica to Japan in a single bound (the recoil nearly destroying the continent), claiming she could circle the Earth seven and a half times in mere moments, and that she could “destroy the Earth, but not the Sun.”
objects.title: Legacy of Kiss-Shot (Monogatari Series)

objects.text:
You have become The Dark Super Monster itself, Desghidorah. You are a gargantuan, amorphous magma-like organism turned three-headed space dragon daikaiju, standing at 50 meters tall and 100 meters long.

As befitting a creature of your stature, your physical capabilities are truly monstrous. The combination of your strength and durability renders you immune to conventional weaponry, merely annoyed by blasts capable of leveling cities, able to quite literally walk through mountains, generate hurricane winds with the beats of your wings, and be unharmed by several thousand tons of kaiju slamming into you at over Mach 80. Furthermore, you are quite fast as well, able to run 180 kilometers an hour, fly at Mach 23 in the atmosphere, and reach near-FTL speeds in space.

On top of your physical capabilities, you possess various abilities that further cement your status as a living extinction event. Starting off is your linked abilities of energy absorption and shapeshifting. As you can drain life energy from all organisms within kilometers of you, with both the ability to selectively target and plants being more yield efficient, to empower yourself and, with enough energy, evolve into new forms that can be consciously customized as it occurs. Next, you can generate, manipulate, and unleash magma energy in a myriad of forms, from flaming tornadoes, beams that accurately strike targets kilometers away, fire-breath that reduces forests into scorched infernos, and form a protective thermal barrier, all of which have heat and power compared to the surface of the Sun. Further on the fiery theme, you can create fissures and control magma with precision to strike airborne targets out of the sky. Finally, you can unleash bolts of electricity through a bite that are strong enough to injure kaiju like Mothra. 

All in all, you are a monster that could take on an entire race of Mothras and drive them to the brink of extinction.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities whilst retaining your human form, or may choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: The Dark Super Monster (Mothra Franchise)

objects.text:
You are a member of a strange and fearsome species known as “The Collectors,” scientific name Stellavita Gravitambulans. Your body, rather than resembling any biology conventional to Earth, is a loose cloud of cosmic material that dwarfs even a rocky planet, but which possesses comparatively little mass.

A significant portion of your mass is composed of a form of exotic matter containing a high quantity of Top Quarks, the heaviest fundamental particle known to exist. This gives it a disproportionately strong influence on gravity. You may freely release and maneuver these particles to create “gravity beads,” incredibly heavy points in space. These are the source from which the godlike powers of the Collectors are derived.

Using the gravity beads is how the Collectors alter the world around them, first and foremost by holding their mass together across the vast reaches of space they cover and granting them movement by pulling their mass along in a manner similar to pseudopods. If that proves insufficient the gravity beads can be used to collapse matter into a wormhole, transporting you across space.
Gravity beads can also be used on external matter to great effect. Collectors often use them to separate and reaggregate atoms into new forms as they wish, even transmuting the matter that makes up living beings and turning them into inanimate objects.

Further, gravity beads can be used to manipulate light for a variety of effects. The most basic use is to drive photons away from an area to create shadows that can be controlled at will. This can be used for the purpose of creating an “avatar” to interact with other, smaller entities. Other than that, you can condense photons into highly damaging beams or blasts, or even infuse tons of photons (and the energy they carry) into objects to make them highly unstable and explosive.

Despite all their power, Collectors do have one notable weakness. Methods capable of inducing radioactive decay, such as the elusive Omega Particles, cause the Top Quarks they make use of to change into the much lighter Up Quarks, negating the Collectors’ abilities and rendering them unable to move or act. When given time away from this effect you will be able to replenish your supply of Top Quarks and regain your strength, but it is entirely possible to leave you trapped indefinitely by exploiting this interaction.
objects.title: Collector (Speculative Wildlife Research Center)

objects.text: You are a Tumosapiens Sanguicola, or Rakt Janajati in your own language. Your body is a cluster of multiple undifferentiated cells which grows by assimilating nearby cells. In essence, living cancer. Your form is entirely plastic and can be manipulated freely; your cells can be used to construct any biologically viable structure, allowing you to customize and contort your body freely and arbitrarily boost your physical or mental abilities by simply producing more of the necessary kind of cell and remodeling your muscles or brain. You feed by absorbing radiation from your environment. The energy acquired through this method is stored within every cell within your body and can be used to enable your metabolic functions, or alternatively it can be released all at once in a powerful blast that exhausts you but is capable of dealing incredible damage. Beyond your natural biological capabilities, you are also augmented with the technology of the Rakt, specialized nanomachines that act as an extension of you and your abilities. They allow you to break through biochemical barriers and infect alien organisms, skyrocket your rate of cell production and ability to remodel a host’s body, and construct armor around the body of your host that protects it and boosts its physical capabilities. The nanomachines also vastly increase the amount of energy you are capable of absorbing and storing, to the point that with the right machinery to transmit it to you it would be entirely within your capabilities to store the energy released by the annihilation of a planet. Your nanomachines also give you greater control over your energy release, allowing you to reduce the risk of starvation carried by using it. With enough energy you can even unlock abilities like space travel and teleportation. Your cancerous nature also makes you ridiculously difficult to kill, because you can create backups of your consciousness encoded into tiny clusters of cells and scatter them throughout the world, and reunite them later to recreate your mind in the event of your main body’s destruction. If you care to do so, you can also asexually reproduce through the same method. Optionally, you can gain the mental adaptations possessed by the Rakt which prevent them from feeling empathy, which would compromise their parasitic lifestyle.
objects.title: Rakt Janajati (Speculative Wildlife Research Center)

objects.text:
You are a direct descendant of Oberon, the legendary King of Amber and your bloodline carries immense power. Your strength, endurance, agility and intelligence far exceed those of ordinary beings, making you not only a fearsome warrior but also a keen strategist.

Your body heals with remarkable efficiency, recovering from wounds that would be fatal to others and over time you can regenerate even lost limbs or organs. However ordinary weapons, such as swords or guns can still kill you if you are careless.

But most importantly, you have walked the Pattern, magical labyrinth that is the sentient embodiment of Order and had it burned deep in your mind and your very being. By doing so, you have gained the ability to walk the Shadows: the infinite parallel realities that span the multiverse with every world having its own infinite Shadows. With focus and willpower, you can reach any world you can imagine.

When travelling through Shadows, you visualise your goal whether specific or vague and the world around you shifts accordingly. The terrain, climate, stars and even the laws of physics change as you pass through layer after layer of existence.

With enough time and effort you can reach any world to find literally anything: an artefact, a new source of magic, or a reality where the impossible becomes true. The greater the difference between your starting point and destination, the longer and stranger the journey.

You may also bring others with you into Shadow. As long as they remain close and you do not rush the journey, even vast armies can be led safely across countless worlds under your guidance.

In addition to your Shadow mastery, you possess the rare gift of Trump Artistry. You become a skilled artist, who can forge paintings and illustrations that bridge the gap between image and reality. These “Trump” images act as permanent links across time, space and dimension, enabling communication, scrying and even transportation between Shadows no matter the distance.

With time and training you will be able to do gain greater control over Shadows. You’ll be able to scry and find things in Shadow merely with your mind and pull things from the Shadows to you, or pull from different Shadows and overlay various other rules/physics/metaphysics over the local reality to achieve various effects for example: You could stop magic or technology from working (except if Pattern/Logrus based magic is used).

This technique will be strenuous, requiring lots of concentration and the effects will only be temporary and locally limited, depending on your power, concentration and how foreign the change you enact.

Though you have walked the Pattern, your power stands apart from the eternal conflict of Chaos and Order and has no connection to any other Pattern. You walk your own path, bound not by destiny.
objects.title: The Prince of Amber (The Chronicles of Amber)

addons.title: Venom^2
addons.text:
The vampiric venom and Klyntar symbiote have perfectly assimilated, incorporating all unique properties into one being. The result is neither vampire nor symbiote, but a perfected organism. As the venom itself, you gain complete command over the crystalline body it inhabits, allowing you to generate, reshape, and replace it at will. So long as enough venom survives, lost limbs may be regrown, shattered flesh recreated, and even catastrophic injuries repaired. 

While remaining fundamentally humanoid, you may freely alter your physique, facial features, height, musculature, proportions, and other physical characteristics with perfect precision. 

Though the assimilation has severed all connections to Knull or any other part of the Living Abyss Klyntar were created from, the Klyntar's latent psychic potential remains. Your mind is heavily protected against telepathic intrusion and mental manipulation, while you instinctively perceive hostile intent before it is acted upon. Moreover, feeding now creates a complete psychic link to your victim. For as long as you drink their blood, their thoughts, memories, emotions, and subconscious are laid bare before you, allowing you to communicate mentally or explore every corner of their mind. Once feeding ends, only the memories acquired remain.

Every aspect of your already-supernatural physique is further enhanced. Your strength surpasses that of ordinary vampires, your speed and reflexes become difficult even for them to follow, your senses grow sharper still, and your durability is matched by your newfound regenerative abilities. Balance, coordination, and agility likewise approach physical perfection.

The Klyntar's instinct to absorb and adapt has merged with your vampiric feeding. Every creature whose blood you consume now leaves behind more than memories, allowing weakened aspects of their physiology, talents, and supernatural abilities to be gradually incorporated into your own. Though these echoes rarely rival the originals, they accumulate over time. 

Vampires are the exception; feeding upon them grants you the blueprint of their unique supernatural gift, which may be cultivated through practice until it becomes your own. Likewise, consuming the blood of non-humanoid creatures gradually expands your shapeshifting beyond the humanoid forms normally possible for you.

This perfected venom is inherited by every vampire you create. Those turned through your bite possess the same evolved physiology, regeneration, psychic defenses, danger sense, adaptive feeding, and mastery over their crystalline bodies.

They also inherit your greatest gift: sparkling has become optional.

addons.title: Energy Vampire
addons.text:
Your transformed nature is no longer sustained solely by blood. Any arcane, spiritual, divine, or otherwise esoteric energy may now nourish you as though it were blood, whether drawn from living beings or harvested from the world itself. Ambient magic, sacred or profane energies, radiation, enchanted substances, the breath of supernatural realms, or any other consumable source of such power may be absorbed through the appropriate medium, allowing your body to sustain itself without the need to feed conventionally. 

Should more energy be consumed than is required for your continued existence, the excess is retained within your venom, forming a reservoir that may be called upon whenever needed- though this does not provide you the bodily systems required to do so as any other user would, and thus you are capable of little power or finesse compared to a proper user, being of little more worth than as a pantry without extreme effort into developing your own system for each different energy, from base principles.

The extraordinary resilience of your crystalline body also allows it to accommodate such energies with remarkable efficiency. Where ordinary mortals would suffer corruption, instability, or outright destruction from attempting to contain foreign supernatural forces, your venom readily adapts to them, integrating their presence into your being with minimal adverse effects. 

This does not grant outright immunity to every consequence such powers may carry, but it allows you to survive wielding, withstanding, and accumulating esoteric energies on a scale impossible for all but the most exceptional of beings- provided you can do so to begin with.

addons.title: Transcendent Adaptation
addons.text:
The union of your adaptive venom and your expanded sustenance has erased the distinction between flesh and power. As your body learns from every essence you consume, your shapeshifting no longer concerns itself solely with physical anatomy. Whenever you feed upon a being whose form is affected by or affects an arcane, spiritual, divine, or otherwise esoteric energy, your venom gradually acquires the capacity to reshape both itself and its crystalline vessel into forms naturally suited to conducting, storing, producing, and wielding that particular force. 

These adaptations are neither instantaneous nor absolute; they develop through continued exposure, experimentation, and practice, each new example refining your understanding of what that energy permits. Every supernatural force follows its own principles and limitations, and your evolution remains bound by the inherent nature of the energies you assimilate. However, you can now adopt the structures and systems of any other users you feed upon, freeing you from your previous need to develop your own system to fit your own biology.

Over time, this process ceases to be mere adaptation and instead becomes transformation. With each new form of energy successfully integrated, the venom incorporates another fundamental aspect of existence into itself, expanding beyond its origin as a purely physical substance. The crystalline body gradually becomes less a necessity and more a preferred vessel, one expression of a being whose true nature increasingly resides in the countless energies composing it. As your mastery deepens, you become progressively less dependent upon maintaining a permanent corporeal form, able to fashion a physical body whenever one is required while existing otherwise as a unified entity, your venom-based self both organic and metaphysical.

objects.text:
You have gained the powers of a Twilight Vampire, a perfected predator whose body has been wholly transformed by an all-consuming supernatural venom. Every organ, cell, and drop of blood has been replaced by this venom, crystallizing your flesh into a flawless, diamond-hard substance that surpasses any natural material. Conventional weapons are rendered ineffective, bullets flattening harmlessly against your skin and blades shattering on contact. Only the overwhelming strength of another vampire or similarly powerful being can tear your body apart, and even then, the separated pieces remain animate until destroyed by fire.

The transformation reshapes you into an idealized version of yourself, erasing every imperfection and granting impossible beauty, smooth marble-like skin, and a voice of unnatural allure. Mortals are instinctively captivated by your presence even as their instincts recognize you as a predator. Your eyes reflect your diet, glowing crimson after feeding on human blood, golden when sustained by animal blood, and blackening as thirst overtakes you.

The venom grants immense physical abilities. You possess strength capable of bending steel and shattering stone, speed and reflexes beyond human perception, senses of extraordinary acuity, and limitless stamina. Your body neither ages nor tires, requiring neither sleep nor breath to survive. Sunlight poses no threat, but instead causes your crystalline flesh to refract light into brilliant facets, making your supernatural nature impossible to conceal.

You are no longer the body you once inhabited, but the venom itself—a living supernatural fluid that has consumed and replaced your former biology. The crystalline shell that bears your likeness is simply the vessel your venom inhabits and maintains. Your heart lies frozen, your flesh is cold, and your lungs serve only to imitate life when desired.

Blood is your only true sustenance. Once consumed, the venom extracts all nourishment required to sustain your existence while suppressing your overwhelming thirst, though animal blood can never equal the benefits of human blood. Your venom also serves as the source of your species; introduced through your bite or an open wound, it transforms those who survive the agonizing process into vampires like yourself.

The venom preserves your body in a state of absolute perfection, rapidly repairing cracks and other minor damage while seamlessly reattaching severed body parts. However, your form is immutable rather than regenerative. Destroyed flesh cannot be replaced, making complete dismemberment followed by the destruction of every piece by fire the only reliable means of killing you.

Finally, every vampire eventually awakens a supernatural gift unique to themselves, born from the interaction between their mind and the venom. These abilities vary enormously, ranging from extraordinary mental powers to impossible physical phenomena. Upon acquiring this power, you may freely choose your own unique gift.
objects.title: Vampire (Twilight)

addons.text:
"I once had a dream. In that dream, I went to a place where golden irises bloom. The people there were gentle and kind, the households were harmonious and prosperous. There were no wars, no strife. I do not know the name of that place, perhaps, it is called Utopia." 

Now you are not just a ratkin, but a representative of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, located beyond our galaxy. This empire is renowned for its peacefulness and respect for labor, but its inhabitants possess the tremendous courage and strength necessary for defense.

You are well aware of their technological capabilities and tactics, based on high maneuverability and incredible firepower. Although their heavy weapons may be unstable, they have considerable power and additional effects, such as EMP. Their equipment is always lightweight and functional.

This means that your technical products are always lighter, more functional, and more powerful in terms of firepower.

In addition to technological knowledge, you will also receive training in diplomacy and negotiation skills.

As a bonus, you can choose up to 3 cybernetic implants (from the game Rimworld) and install them for free. You also get a light power exoskeleton and an energy rifle for free.
addons.title: Oberonia Aurea Empire

objects.text:
You are now part of the ratkin race—cute and charming humanoids with rat-like features, such as large ears and tails.

Ratkins are small in stature (about 1.5 meters tall), with large ears and tails. They are highly agile and fast, have strong immunity, are resistant to poisoning, and can easily tolerate high temperatures and life in dark, confined spaces.

However, ratkins also have disadvantages: reduced strength and a lower pain threshold. Their average lifespan is 70 years.

As a member of this race, you become a formidable warrior who uses their small size combined with speed and agility to dominate in close combat. Ratkin excel at agriculture and earthworks, but they will find it difficult to engage in scientific work and construction.

You will also gain skills in cold weapon mastery, agriculture, blacksmithing (18th century level), mining, plate armor, and ratkin muskets.
objects.title: Ratkin (Rimworld Mod)

objects.text:
You have become a slugcat, a purposed organism, developed from what was once only a small slug that cleaned the inside of pipes.

Fully grown slugcats are about three feet tall when standing on two legs, these creatures are incredibly agile, moving, jumping and dodging with power and grace, they are also surprisingly good at throwing things. They have an omnivorous diet, similar to that of humans, they can also store inedible objects in their stomachs, regurgitating them with ease.
objects.title: Slugcat (Rain World)

addons.text:
If before you were the pinnacle of what could be made out of the human genome (though admittedly without humanity's psychic potential being realized), now you are the pinnacle of every species "normal" enough to have a detailed Starfleet medical scan on file.

Your body has been enhanced with the perfected human form of Class 1 Supervisors like Gary 7 (this becomes your genetic baseline prior to Augmentation, meaning that with it you far exceed even the greatest of the true Augments), Klingon toughness & organ redundancy allowing you to survive things that would kill most, the strength and invisibility of the Jem'Hadar (minus their dependence on ketracel white), the pheromones of the Orions and Deltans, the biological perfection of the Undine (including survival in a vacuum, regeneration from death, the strength to rip through starship walls, agelessness, & much more), & the malleable morphogenic matrix of the Founders & Iconians, allowing you to take nearly any form, with nearly any capabilities you can think of (including those of biology, energy, or technology).

Your mind enjoys the intellectual prowess the Cytherian probe granted to Lt. Reginald Barclay, psychic abilities (though still not on the level of Gary Mitchell or Charles Evans) such as the telepathy of a Betazoid or Reman, the psionic senses of an Aenar, the Talosian ability to create perfect illusions, the mind powers of the Vulcans (like the mind meld, katra transfer, emotional & pain suppression, mental & bodily self-control, healing trances, hypnosis, & an intuitive sense for formal logic), and the more versatile psionics of the Ocampans (which while starting at Kes's level, can improve with practice & study to the level of "super-Espers" like Charlie or Mitchell).
addons.title: The Nth Degree (Star Trek)

objects.text:
You are an Augment, a term used to describe the genetically engineered humans from the Star Trek universe. You have been altered just like the Augments from the Eugenics Wars, perhaps even surpassing them. You are the epitome of everything that the scientists who created the Augments aimed to achieve, the pinnacle of genetic engineering.

Your physical abilities are massively augmented. With but a single hand, you could lift someone and kill them by crushing their larynx. You are roughly seven times stronger and more durable than the strongest Olympic-level human. You have also become resistant to any known sickness, and even bioengineered retroviruses would have trouble breaking through your resistance; poison would do little better. Practically every organ in your body is augmented, with your heart muscles being three times as strong, lung efficiency boosted by fifty per cent, bone density also three times as strong, and enhanced blood for improved regeneration. Your lifespan would be twice that of even the longest-lived human in the 24th century, easily living around 500 years before showing the signs of aging.

Your intelligence and mental abilities are also augmented; you could run circles around the smartest men and women of the Federation's 24th century, matching even the likes of artificial intelligences such as Data. Your mind could be compared to that of a 24th century Federation super-computer, and it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that you might even be better at computing information, to the point that you could predict the timeline of events for an ongoing century long war from a singular peace summit. Your perception also doubles, being able to react to modern gunfire, or dodge energy weapons. You also learn quite a bit faster than a normal human being. It's no exaggeration to say you could conquer the galaxy with your new augmented nature.
objects.title: Augment Tyrant (Star Trek)

objects.text: You are a young Djinn, a member of a race of beings that appear human but are formed from smokeless fire and perform magic via wishes. Your average body temperature is higher than that of a human, at around 39°C. Initially, you will often struggle to use your powers in colder environments, though with experience, this limitation will pass for all but the coldest and iciest environments. As a Djinn, you are completely immune to snake venom, at the cost of a mild weakness to other venoms. Your lymph nodes contain more sulfur than a human's, slightly weakening your sense of smell, but with the benefit that blood-sucking parasites like mosquitoes do not bother you. You can expect to live for well over 500 years if you use your power conservatively, with each use shortening your lifespan slightly. You have the power to shape-shift into the form of any animal or object, while still retaining access to your thoughts and senses, and possess a limited form of telepathy to facilitate communication. One of the most well-known abilities of the Djinn is Transubstantiation, the ability to turn themselves into smoke and pour themselves into a vessel that is only partially within the material world. Because this space is not fully within the material world, it is possible for time to pass very quickly or very slowly depending on how you enter the vessel. Typically, you would have an inherited racial phobia of confined spaces, but somehow this "curse" seems to have passed you by. The primary power of the Djinn is the ability to channel the internal lifeforce of their being for an almost unlimited variety of effects, often referred to as wishes. These effects have few limits; they cannot create gems, resurrect the dead in any form, change the flow of time, create copies of the Djinn themselves, or undo the spells of another Djinn. Beyond that, any effect one can comprehend and picture the result of can theoretically be achieved. This leads to perhaps the most famous of the Djinn's abilities: to grant another being three wishes. They can offer this to anyone if they wish. The three wishes rely on the Djinn being able to picture the result of the wish; thus, they may fulfill any requirements while missing the true spirit of the wish if the recipient is not specific enough. A "fourth wish" may be granted to undo the first three, while any future wishes granted will always result in the opposite of what the recipient wished for.
objects.title: Djinn (Children of the Lamp)

objects.text:
You have become the Guardian of the Universe itself, Gamera. You are a genetically-engineered turtle daikaiju, standing between 60 and 80 meters tall.

As fitting your duty as the protector of Earth, your physical capabilities are astonishing. Your innate durability renders you immune to conventional weaponry, with your shell further rendering attacks from lesser daikaiju worthless. As for your strength, you possess the might to level buildings and tussle with other kaiju, further channeled through your tusks, claws, retractable elbow spikes, and razor sharp shell for maximum effectiveness. Finally, you're quite adept underwater, able to swim at 180 knots, and holding your breath for massive amounts of time via your lungs strong enough to create hurricane forces by inhaling.

Beyond raw physicality, you were made with quite the advantage. This being the Plasma Conversion Furnace, which, using your blood, converts heat, flames, high-energy voltages, nuclear fuel, and even mana from the world itself into plasma energy that your body stores and uses to fuel and your abilities and techniques.

Your go-to technique is Plasma Fireball, born by combing and compressing oxygen and plasma energy within your throat to create either streams or bursts of highly-explosive plasma. Furthermore, depending on the situation and location, you can mold it into new techniques like the High Plasma, Ultimate Plasma, and Banishing Plasma Fist techniques.

Perhaps your most noteworthy trait is your flight. Which functions by you pulling your head and limbs into your shell and firing flames out of the limb cavities, spinning like a frisbee, and further can both move at Mach 3.5 and be adjusted into a more jet-like configuration by extending your flippers and head for better control.

Some additional noteworthy abilities you possess are your regeneration and chromosome manipulation. For regeneration, you can enter a healing coma to both convince your foes you are dead and to heal in a mere fraction of the time required. Whilst, for chromosome manipulation, you can manipulate your own genetic structure to adapt to new environments, though this doesn’t change your mass.

Finally, if you wish, you may have these capabilities whilst retaining your human form, or may choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your kaiju form act as a changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: Guardian of the Universe (Gamera Franchise)

objects.text:
You have become The Evil God and Sacred Bird itself, Iris. You are a gargantuan, mutated, Atlantean biomechanical weapon, standing at 99 meters tall.

As befitting your size and nature, your physical capabilities are truly monstrous. You possess the might to casually punch holes through kaiju tough enough to survive direct nuclear blasts, as well as the durability to require comparable attacks to even harm you. This, of course, means you are immune to conventional weaponry. Furthermore, through a combination of jets and your tentaclancers, you can fly not only at Mach 9, but with the agility to casually dodge and weave through missiles and automatic fire. It should also be noted that you have quite a long physical range, as your tentaclancers can stretch to about 2 kilometers in length.

On top of your physical capabilities, you possess abilities that further make you quite the threat. Starting off, you can generate a barrier that allows you to physically deflect plasma-based attacks. Next, your tentaclancers’ barbs can open up to fire ultrasonic beams capable of effortlessly slicing through massive buildings and even durable kaiju, like Gamera. Further, your tentaclancers, when impaled into a target, can drain the life force, biological fluids, and genes of the target; this act nourishes you, evolving you with useful traits, and granting copies of the target’s biological/life force-based abilities, although modified to better work with your form. Finally, you can form psychic connections with another to grow stronger, even absorbing them into yourself for even more power.

If you wish, you may have these capabilities whilst retaining your human form, or may choose to be a human-sized daikaiju or some hybrid in between these options. Optionally, you may instead choose to have your kaiju form act as a Changer state that you transform into.
objects.title: Iris (Gamera Franchise)

addons.text:
You have gained an unusually potent talent and affinity towards the Dragon Kata and its teachings. Which allows you to learn and use it far better than any other Dragon before you, even including the likes of Purple Dragons, who naturally possess absurd amounts of talent in general.

Through this enhancement, you can use the Dragon Kata to such a level of mastery that it appears as an elegant dance of destruction to those who witness its usage. Beyond simply the martial aspects of the Dragon Kata, this also greatly enhances your ability to use Chi Manipulation, granting you far greater enhancement and ability to use Chi-based techniques. This also greatly enhances your ability to use your Dragon Element with far greater control and power, while lowering its energy consumption.

Note that, should you also possess the <u>Purple Dragon (Spyro Series)</u> upgrade, this addon will only help you master the power of your Aether Element quicker. For complete mastery, you still must purchase the <u>Pure Aether</u> addon. Though both addons will stack for an explosive enhancement to your power and skill with the Aether Element.
addons.title: Master of the Dragon Kata

addons.text: The power of Limit Breaker has broken the limits of your Dragon Fury, drastically increasing its power and effectiveness, but also removing its drawbacks. You can now use your Limit Breaker charges to activate your Dragon Fury, allowing you to use it without its normal drawbacks. The Power of your Dragon Fury has risen to unimaginable levels of power compared to its baseline.
