Whenever you activate your Dragon Fury your experience a powerful burst of healing energy and recover a large amount of your energy reserves. Spending 3 entire Limit Breaker Bars would fully heal and refill your energy reserves. While you are in your Dragon Fury, you become completely invulnerable for the short time it is active. However, while this enhanced Dragon Fury is active, you cannot refill any spent Limit Breaker Bars.
addons.title: True Dragon Fury

addons.text: As you go about your adventure, you will now begin to come across Crystals and other power-ups from across Spyro’s various games (every one of his games is applicable for this). You will primarily come across Crystals of various colors, with each granting you a certain benefit after being broken and absorbing the energy within them. Primarily, you will come across the following colored Crystals, though there exist other ones with beneficial effects. Red Crystals will heal you, Green Crystals will recover your supernatural energy and stamina Blue Crystals will grant “Experience” which you can spend to permanently increase your attributes and powers, Purple Crystals will refresh your Dragon Fury, allowing you to use it beyond your normal limits and without backlash. You will come across Red Crystals and Green Crystals most commonly, such that you will have ample opportunities to recover as long as you are careful not to overextend yourself. Other colors will be much more scarce based on their power and usefulness. You will also begin to come across various other power-ups, which may temporarily grant you an additional dragon breath element or turbocharge your natural element. Should you be exposed to enough of these power-ups, there is a extrodnarly small chance you will permanently absorb their power, granting you a new Element. Though it will always be weaker than your natural Element, at least unless you are also a Purple Dragon. Additionally, you will come across mountains of various kinds of gems, which hold great value, such that anyone will be willing to accept them in place of normal money. Any found gems will be stored in an extradimensional space, which you can freely access at will. Lastly, you may come across familiar characters from the Spyro games who will either teach you something useful, help you out with a problem (possibly at a ludicrous cost of gems in the case of Moneybags), or grant you some kind of temporary or permanent power-up or item, which may include weapons, armor, and other useful things.
addons.title: Legendary Adventure

objects.text: You have become a Dragon from the world of Spyro. This species of dragon takes the shape of a classic quadrupedal western dragon with six limbs. They possess surprisingly dexterous claws that function similarly to human hands and can comfortably move in a bipedal stance. These Dragons possess a lifespan of roughly around 1,000 years, though more powerful dragons may live longer. As a Dragon, you possess powerful physical attributes, potent senses, resistance to harmful magical and esoteric effects, along with great magical power and potential. Each dragon possesses a single Breath Element that their powers focus on, which coincides with the color of their scales (barring rare exceptions). A Dragon's Breath Element takes the form of their Breath Weapon and a powerful affinity towards magic, which matches their Breath Element. Breath Elements can take the form of typical elements like fire, ice, lightning, or can also be more esoteric elements like Poison, Fear, and Shadow. You may freely select which Element you possess as a Dragon, though you may gain additional Elements based on other purchased powers. These dragons have developed their own specialized martial art known as the Dragon Kata, which teaches how to use their entire body as a lethal weapon while also incorporating their Breath Element to create a carefully orchestrated dance of destruction. The Dragon Kata also incorporates teachings on how to harness one's inner Chi energy to further empower oneself and for various special techniques. You begin with a basic level of training in the Dragon Kata and its various disciplines, including how to use your personal Element and inner Chi. Dragons also possess the Dragon Fury, a power that allows them to call upon a hidden reserve of energy not normally accessible consciously to drastically increase their powers and physical attributes. Though Dragon Fury is extremely potent, it will only last no more than a few minutes at most and places great strain on you, such that it should be used strategically and only as a last resort.
objects.title: Dragon (Spyro Series)

objects.text:
You’re an eonus, a guardian of the time stream created by Father Time himself. Your body is a glowing spherical manifestation of a “local eddy” within the time stream, and your presence leads to causal irregularities; events repeating several times, strong memories of things that didn’t happen, effects preceding causes, and so on. Thankfully the irregularities will always be minor, just large enough to be noticeable without affecting anything vital. The color and intensity of the light you glow with depends on where you are in the time stream relative to the present. The further in the past your “center of existence” is, the redder you glow, while further in the future will make your glow bluer. If you are in exactly the present moment you glow an eye-searing white.

Eoni have the ability to manipulate time and all forms of energy other than primal, including planar energy. You can siphon any form of energy from the universe you are currently in, or from the time stream itself, in great amounts and manipulate it in whatever way you like. This includes magical kinds of energy, in universes where those exist. You can also shift, alter, or stop time in your immediate vicinity with the proficiency of a demigod of time.

You can cross between the time stream and other planes of existence at will. When moving through space you possess effectively infinite speed, and can appear anywhere instantly. You are able to move through the time stream freely, both forward and backward in time at a rate of roughly one year per second. Since you can offset your center of existence by a few seconds or minutes, you can easily "dodge" any attack directed at you. Not only physical attacks, but also abilities which target the mind, soul, or whatever else. The only attacks capable of affecting you are ones which somehow transcend linear time, and even then their effectiveness is somewhat reduced.

Eoni also have a special ability known as a time lock. This creates a “time bubble” around anything you target, sealing off that specific point in space and time from the rest of reality and allowing nothing in or out until you drop the bubble or it is somehow broken. This means any powers with an external source not on the person of whoever is using them will not function. When the bubble drops, its prisoners will be in a far different world.
objects.title: Eonus (The Primal Order)

objects.text: You are a Mulawin, a species of magical avian humanoids local to the Philippines. Seen as local legends due to their elusive nature as protectors of the environment as well as low population, Mulawins are a rare sight, even amongst other magical creaturea. You specifically might be a pureblood or a half human called a Tabon. Alternatively, you can be part of the red feathered Ravenas, the sworn enemies of the white feathered Mulawins who separated from them due to sympathy to humans, whom Ravenas hate for rampant deforestation. Regardless of what type of Mulawin (or Ravena) you are, you gain a couple of abilities besides just being able to fly. As a bird person you have super hearing and sight, able to zoom in and pinpoint targets from miles away. You could also briefly tap into a sort of super speed state, zooming in flight and running so long as you have the energy for it. Finally, you are proficient with swords as well as using feathers as darts in combat. You could also potentially learn how to utilize some magical abilities. The only two we have seen Mulawins/Ravenas could use is healing yourself and other people through touching them with your hands (though depending on the severity of the wound, you might be unable to heal it if it's bad enough), as well as, if you're proficient enough, the ability to fire magical beams at your opponents. Finally, the biggest weakness of a Mulawin/Ravena is their Ugat-Pak, a specific feather connected to their spine, which is the first feather they sprout when growing up. This feather contains their essence, memories, and abilities as a Mulawin. Plucking it off will cause you to lose your memories and your powers, essentially turning you into human. You are who we're seeking. Now, take flight.
objects.title: Mulawin (Mulawin / Encantadia)

objects.text:
You have been transformed into a Na’vi - a lanky and athletic blue-skinned humanoid alien from the Avatar franchise. 

You stand about 3 meters tall and mass about 200 kilograms. Leanly muscled, you are about four times stronger than a human. Your agility, proprioception, and balance are likewise enhanced and are further aided by your possession of a long prehensile tail. Your hands and feet now have three non-opposable and one opposable digit each. Your skeleton has improved durability from naturally-occurring carbon fiber. 

You have large eyes, a flat nose, and cat-like ears. Your eyes provide superior night vision and stereopsis, and your visible spectrum extends into infra-red. Your sense of hearing and smell are also enhanced, comparable to a dog’s. Your skin has bioluminescent markings distinctive enough to be used by other Na’vi to identify you; you can dim them at will for stealth purposes. 

Native to Pandora, a moon of a gas giant in the Alpha Centauri system, the Na’vi worship Eywa, a distributed global consciousness that serves as an ecological and cultural guardian. Eywa keeps the Na’vi in a primitivist state, forbidding metal-working, stone-working, and the wheel. Accordingly, you are adept at hunting, foraging, wilderness survival, and handicrafts – exceptionally so on Pandora itself and quickly adapting in any other environment. 

Na’vi society is composed of clans of several hundred individuals, who generally possess distinctive methods of animal handling, combat, crafting, and resource gathering specialized for their local environment. You may choose to belong to any canon clan or create one of your own design with comparable capabilities to canon, gaining familiarity with its habitat and culture. 

You possess a queue, a long neurological organ draping backward from the top or back or the head. Generally kept wrapped in a braid of hair, the queue enables you to psychically link with fellow Na’vi, other Pandoran lifeforms, and Eywa herself. This connection allows for the direct sharing of senses, memories, and other information; and it is used in taming Pandoran wildlife. 

A subspecies adapted to aquatic environments exists, with webbed digits, a broader tail, sea green skin, and nictitating membranes on their eyes. You may optionally possess any of these characteristics, or a similar set of adaptations to another biome of your choice. 

Na’vi evolved in an environment with lower gravity, higher air density, and higher carbon dioxide levels than Earth. You have sufficient environmental tolerance to thrive in an Earthlike environment or a similarly divergent environment from Pandora.
objects.title: Na’vi (Avatar)

addons.text:
You are an equal to Bheeshma, arguably the greatest superwarrior to ever exist. He was so mighty that the Pandavas, five of the strongest superwarriors there ever were, considered fighting him fairly tantamount to suicide, even with an army to support them. Now, so are you.

Even in the twilight of your life your strength is great enough to shatter armor “forged in the fires of six dying suns” while holding back with the intent to avoid harming your opponent. You are fast enough to chop off the heads of multiple superwarriors faster than any of them can see you coming, and tough enough that you could block a blow from the physically strongest superwarrior Bhima, wielding his techno-atomic mace described as a “one-man WMD,” using only one hand without so much as a bruise. Your skill in combat is just as incredible, enough that you could pull off feats with any random kind of weapon that an average superwarrior (if any superwarrior can be called average) would need to spend a lifetime specializing in the use of that one particular weapon type to match.
addons.title: Maharathi

addons.text: Like Gatokacha, you are half-superwarrior half-rakshasa, giving you abilities beyond either. Your strength is several times that of even the physically mightiest superwarrior, enough to use hostile cybernetically enhanced war elephants a hundred times your size as a throwing weapon. Your speed is great enough to be a blur to the sight of seasoned superwarriors, and your senses are keen enough to pick up on a single whispered word from across the world. You can conjure flames and shapeshift between your true demonic form and human form at will, and are empowered when you are surrounded by darkness.
addons.title: Half-Rakshasa

objects.text: You’re a genetically engineered soldier from an age before this one, when humanity was greater in all respects than it is today. Every single aspect of your being, from your strength to your appearance to your lifespan to your intelligence to your charisma to your personality, is enhanced hundreds or even thousands of times beyond human levels. In any field or profession you would be a giant among men. As the name implies, however, your truest talent lies in combat. You fight the same way a dog barks, a bird flies, and a shark kills. It’s more than a skill you learn, it is the truest expression of your being. As a small child you could cut thick, healthy trees in half with a regular sword like they’re silk ribbons and treat an active warzone like a playground. As a more seasoned warrior you could slay thousands, maybe millions of elite soldiers in less than a day without exhausting yourself, and that’s against soldiers from the previous age when the average person was superhuman by today’s standards. The feats you could accomplish through pure skill strain credibility; if you specialized in archery you could use a bow to fire so many arrows in rapid succession they form a solid wall, with enough accuracy that you could repeatedly strike a target’s bullseye from hundreds of meters away and split each previous arrow perfectly in half with the next, blindfolded. Even if you don’t want to fight, you possess an extreme natural aptitude for any skill that can be learned. You would have to actively pursue not achieving world-wide fame and power to not be recognized as the greatest mind of your time, arguably all time. Don’t make the mistake of thinking you’re beyond error, however. Even the legendary superwarrior Yudishthira, considered by many the ideal king, could be swayed by human vices and lost his kingdom for over a decade because of it. If you are some species other than human then that species will be the baseline you are modified from, and any unique abilities that species has are similarly amplified.
objects.title: Superwarrior (Grant Morrison’s 18 Days)

objects.text:
Milletians are a race of immortal beings that can take the form of any other race including non-humanoid ones. They possess the ability to freely exit a pocket dimension known as the soul stream. If a Milletian dies their soul is sent back to the soulstream and they can reconstruct their body immediately then return to the living realm. 

The soul stream only has one permanent resident: Nao, who acts as a guide of sorts for Milletians. Note that it is possible to soul trap a Milletian interrupting their ability to revive. They will inevitably break free however. Milletians can also freely travel between universes using the soul stream.

Milletians may possess multiple bodies with different abilities which can be stored in part of the soulstream. They may even grant newly created ones additional abilities. However newly created bodies cannot exceed the abilities of the Milletian current most powerful body and they can control only one at once. 

A Milletian's bodies are closer to malleable puppets made to host their souls than true bodies though they are still indistinguishable from a regular one.

They possess the ability to rebirth changing age, gender, appearance even and species once every 6 days. When they use rebirth they reset their growth while retaining anything they previously gained. 

For example if someone was reaching the upper limit of growth in magic they could rebirth retaining all of their abilities while allowing them to grow at the extreme rate of a beginner. Additionally they always act as if they have superhuman talent in anything they attempt. 

They mimic the abilities of any species that they take the form of acting as if they were one while unbinding themselves from unwanted connections related to their species. 

For example if they mimicked a pact demon they would not have to have a connection to hell if they didn’t want it but could still make contracts. 

If they rebirth into a different species they retain any race exclusive abilities they learned previously, though they can no longer progress with them unless they rebirth back into that race.

Any world will treat them as if they were a native allowing them to gain world exclusive abilities. For example should they go to Earth Bet they would automatically obtain a shard-like power though they wouldn't have a shard unless they wanted one. Abilities gained this way still suffer from their natural limitations. A shard-like power would still suffer from the manton limit and have limited ability for growth for example.

One of the Milletians' Special Abilities is to shrug off otherwise lethal blows. They have a chance to shrug off otherwise lethal hits through sheer willpower. If they take a blow that would kill them in one shot the attack is always negated. If they are already injured they have a 33% chance at base. This raises up to 66% at peak human willpower but can go as high as 90% at around twice that of peak human willpower.

With enough time their power can far exceed that of a mortal reaching that of true godhood and beyond.
objects.title: Milletian (Mabinogi)

addons.text: Demons are monsters that evolved to prey on humans, and your mentality now matches that of the others of your kind. While you can still experience certain feelings, like fear or anger, and are capable of even liking certain things and feeling proud of your skills as a mage, you completely lack any feelings of guilt or malice and view humans only as potential prey. You are incapable of comprehending such concepts as compassion or family and cannot ever completely understand or relate to other humans.
addons.title: Heart of a Demon

addons.text:
You are now strong enough to count amongst the Sages of Destruction. You possess one type of magic you have devoted your lifetime to studying, turning it into a force incomprehensible to humans or even elven great mages. You also possess a mana pool second only to the Demon King himself, enough to—should you possess the necessary spell—transmute an entire continent into gold.

You may choose any magic of one Sage of Destruction to be an expert with, like Macht's Diagoldze, for example, or invent a completely new one.
addons.title: Sage of Destruction

objects.text:
You are a demon, a member of a species of humanoid horned monsters with great affinity for magic. Unlike others of your kind, you do not possess their typical sociopathic tendencies, instead retaining a full spectrum of human-like emotions and feelings.

Your body is composed of and sustained entirely by mana, granting you ageless immortality and potent—albeit slow, barely faster than a human's—regeneration, allowing you to regrow limbs and survive wounds lethal to a regular human. However, the heart remains your weakness, and destroying it would lead to your death. You also possess enhanced strength enough to overpower multiple grown men as a child or shatter concrete with your strikes.

Your physiology makes you uniquely predisposed to and talented in magic. You possess an incredible sensitivity to mana, allowing you to effortlessly perceive its flow and gauge the strength of other mages; only those who have dedicated centuries to the art of mana concealment are able to fool your senses. This incredible talent also allows you to utilise flight magic as easily as humans walk on their two legs.

Usually, demons pick one type of magic unique to them and refine it over the ages, taking it to such heights that even elven mages who have lived for thousands of years cannot truly understand your spells. It would take decades of combined efforts of all human mages to decipher and develop countermeasures to even one of your techniques. However, nothing prevents you from branching out.
objects.title: Demon (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text: You have received the blessing of Aenea's DNA sacrament. This allows you to access and manipulate The Void Which Binds. Otherwise known as Plank Space, the Void is an infinite quantum dimension that permeates the universe, a plane that unifies the whole of existence and where every consciousness of those living, long dead, or those yet to be born resides. Now, you are able to communicate with these consciousness. Gain wisdom from those long gone, communicate and share thoughts and feelings with your friends and allies at intergalactic distances, and receive knowledge of the future events from those who will be born centuries from now, or even from your own future memories. You are capable of communicating and sharing feelings and knowledge with other sentient beings regardless of any linguistic barriers. You can also shut off other consciousness so that you are not constantly bombarded with foreign thoughts. You also gain the ability to freecast. As the Void is everpresent across all of space and time, by merging with the Void, you can travel to any point in space, be it a few meters to get to the next room or across galaxies, in an instant. You can travel yourself as well as transport others with you, from a couple of people to gigantic starships. When you travel to another world, you instinctively know the details of the world you are freecasting to. There is one major limitation, however. You can only travel to worlds or other places as long as there are, have been, or will be any living sentient beings there to serve as anchors and a source of knowledge about the place. The DNA sacrament is administered by ingesting the blood of someone carrying the special nanotech virus that rewrites the DNA of those that are infected by it. Along with fixing any genetic issues, the nanotech virus will also erase any unwanted foreign bodies; even advanced technological parasites that extend kilometres of connective tissue to every cell in the body will wither away in mere moments. By ingesting your blood, the others will also become attuned to the Void but will start much weaker, needing decades of practice to approach your level. They, by extension, also become the carriers of the virus and, thus, can spread it to others as well.
objects.title: The One Who Teaches (Hyperion Cantos)

objects.text:
You are a Kaiju-Human Hybrid. Kaiju-Human Hybrids are created by The Precursors, most likely to annihilate humanity just like their pure Kaiju counterparts. Their hybridization with human DNA grants them a human form, possibly to infiltrate human civilization before transforming into Kaiju.

This grants you the ability to switch between a human form and a monstrous Kaiju form. Even in your human form, you have immense physical strength, durability and agility. Your Kaiju form is that of a Category I Kaiju, you may either pick an existing Category I Kaiju for your form or design one of your own. Kaiju Category is metric for a Kaiju's threat level, it is based on measurements of each Kaiju's water displacement, toxicity levels and ambient radioactivity.
objects.title: Kaiju-Human Hybrid (Pacific Rim)

objects.text:
You are no longer human. Somewhere deep within your being now rests a Tacet Core—a living Reverberation Body that replaces your heart as the center of your existence. Your body has become a stable manifestation of living frequency, existing somewhere between flesh and energy. You can choose your appearance, though you possess a humanoid appearance by default whilst your true form is no longer fixed.

Your physiology is remarkably resilient. Conventional injuries no longer affect you in quite the same way as ordinary creatures. Flesh flows together like liquid resonance, broken bones knit themselves back into place, and damaged tissue slowly reconstructs itself so long as your Tacet Core remains intact. The destruction of your outer body is no longer synonymous with death; only the complete destruction of your Core can truly end your existence.

You instinctively perceive the world as an endless ocean of frequencies. Every heartbeat, spoken word, emotion, movement, and supernatural phenomenon generates unique vibrations that you can sense. With practice, you can distinguish individuals by their personal resonance alone, perceive hidden life through solid obstacles, and detect disturbances in the surrounding environment long before they become visible.

Your body is inherently mutable. Limbs may stretch, split, reshape, or dissolve into flowing masses of living resonance before reforming once more. Weapons, armor, claws, tendrils, wings, additional limbs, or entirely alien anatomy can be grown and discarded as needed. These transformations remain bound by your available mass and imagination, becoming faster and more refined with experience.

Rather than requiring conventional food, your Tacet Core feeds upon frequencies. Ambient resonance slowly sustains you, but sources rich in energy—powerful emotions, supernatural phenomena, combat, natural disasters, or defeated Resonators and Tacet Discords—greatly accelerate your recovery and growth. Excess energy may be stored within your Core for future use, though allowing your reserves to run completely dry will gradually destabilize your body.

Perhaps your greatest gift is Resonant Mimicry. By consuming sufficient traces of another being's frequency, your Core begins analyzing and recording its unique resonance. Given enough exposure, you may reproduce aspects of that being's physiology, instincts, and supernatural abilities through your own body. Early copies are imperfect and unstable, but repeated exposure gradually refines them into increasingly faithful recreations. You are not limited to a single adaptation, instead building a growing library of resonant imprints that may be mixed, modified, and combined into entirely new expressions.

As your Core matures, your very nature begins to evolve. Every frequency you absorb subtly alters your existence, allowing your body to naturally adapt to environments, hazards, and repeated threats. Over time you become increasingly difficult to poison, burn, freeze, corrupt, or otherwise destroy, as your Core continuously rewrites your biology in response to what it survives. No two mature Tacet Discords evolve identically, each becoming a unique reflection of everything they have consumed.

Though you retain your memories, personality, and free will, faint instincts accompany your transformation. You feel an irresistible curiosity toward unfamiliar frequencies and a subtle desire to consume powerful resonance whenever it presents itself. These instincts never override your mind, but they remain a constant whisper from the living Core within you, reminding you that consumption of frequencies is the natural state of your existence.
objects.title: Tacet Discord (Wuthering Waves)

objects.text:
You have been transformed into a Homo abominum americana, a rare and powerful subspecies of vampire. What sets these vampires apart from others of their kind is that, rather than be weakened by it, they grow stronger in daylight.

When exposed to natural light from the sun or the moon, you display enhanced physical capabilities. You can easily lift 15 tonnes as well as rip an entire human in half with your bare hands. You are durable enough to withstand sustained gunfire, resist extreme temperatures and even survive an explosion capable of destroying an entire city block, though you will be grievously injured after the fact. Major lacerations heal within seconds and severed limbs grow back in minutes. 

Bullets through the heart or brain are little more than an inconvenience, though complete destruction of your brain remains fatal. Disease, poison, and conventional toxins have no effect on you. You possess superhuman coordination, can move faster than the eye can see in short bursts and easily outrun cars in a sustained sprint with reflexes to match. Your senses are equally heightened: you can hear the faint rhythm of a heartbeat, see clearly in absolute darkness, and track prey over long distances by scent. 

Like all vampires, you are immortal and do not require oxygen to survive. Blood and natural light sustain your supernatural physiology. You can go weeks without feeding before eventually entering a deathlike hibernation. Likewise, a few hours without exposure to sunlight or moonlight has no noticeable effect, but a night under a new moon or even any prolonged period without natural light causes you to grow lethargic and drastically weakens your abilities. You grow weaker, your once bulletproof skin becomes vulnerable and your transformative abilities vanish. 

As long as you are sufficiently fed and empowered by natural light, however, you can exert yourself continuously without exhaustion. In essence, you are a vampire uniquely adapted to thrive in the light of day.

You can voluntarily transform by gaining yellow eyes, growing elongated fingers tipped with claws and distending your jaw to an inhuman length to accommodate massive fangs. These natural weapons are coated in a paralytic that makes it easier to catch prey.

Your blood carries the essence of your strain. Those who ingest it may inherit your vampiric nature, while any children you have with humans are born enhanced and with slowed aging. New people from new places (such as other dimensions or continents) being infected may even create an entirely new strain of vampirism, although the chances of this happening are low.

However, this power is not without its limitations. You have been granted powerful animalistic instincts. During periods of extreme hunger, fear, anger, or bloodlust, maintaining your human form becomes increasingly difficult. Should you lose control, you will prioritize feeding and eliminating perceived threats. Your reflection appears warped and distorted, resembling a funhouse mirror. Pure gold is highly corrosive to your flesh, and wounds inflicted by it heal slowly and may leave permanent scars. Though your regenerative abilities are extraordinary, complete bodily destruction will still kill you.
objects.title: The American Strain (American Vampire)

objects.text:
The blood of the mighty Hutts now flows through your veins, transforming you into one of the galaxy’s oldest, wealthiest, and most influential species. Your body reshapes into that of a Hutt, though you may freely choose your age, and appearance, ranging from a relatively lean and mobile Hutt to one rivaling Jabba or Grakkus in sheer mass. Despite your appearance, your body is perfectly healthy, and your immense bulk never hinders your movement unless you wish it to.

Your new physiology grants incredible physical resilience. Blaster bolts, extreme temperatures, toxins, disease, radiation, and harsh environments affect you far less than they would most species. Your thick hide is naturally resistant to injury, and your body possesses phenomenal stamina, allowing you to endure punishment that would incapacitate ordinary beings. You also age extremely slowly, enjoying a lifespan that can reach over a thousand years, with ancient Hutts often remaining active and powerful for centuries while retaining their health and vitality.

Like all true Hutts, you possess immense natural strength beneath your enormous frame. You can effortlessly overpower most humanoids, crush armor with your grip, and use your powerful tail as both a weapon and an additional limb for balance or restraint. Your body also stores vast energy reserves, allowing you to survive for extended periods with little food or water.

Your mind is enhanced alongside your body. Hutts are legendary crime lords, merchants, politicians, and schemers for good reason. You possess exceptional intelligence, a near-photographic memory for people, finances, and negotiations, and an instinctive talent for economics, diplomacy, logistics, and manipulation. You excel at building organizations, managing wealth, and recognizing profitable opportunities.

You instinctively understand and speak Huttese, Galactic Basic, and may quickly learn new languages far faster than an ordinary person. Your booming voice naturally carries authority, making others more inclined to listen during negotiations or displays of confidence.

You also inherit the natural charisma and commanding presence of the greatest Hutt kajidics. Whether you choose to become a respected ruler, influential businessman, benevolent leader, or feared crime lord is entirely up to you, but your instincts for acquiring power, allies, and wealth are second to none. With enough ambition, there are few limits to the empire you can build. 

(Note 1: it should be noted that Hutts are hermaphroditic, meaning that they posses both male and female reproductive organs. Though individual hutts will pick a single gender to identify as.

This is optional in your case, as you can either pick to be a single gender if you so wish, and other hutts will not find it strange or you may optionally pick to be like all other hutts and be hermaphroditic, the choice is yours, and either choice will not affect you mentally or emotionally.)
objects.title: Hutt Physiology (Star Wars)

addons.title: Slaughtermaster
addons.text:
You have become a Butcher, a priest of the Great Maw. More specifically, you're a Slaughtermaster, a particularly skilled Butcher gifted in the magical arts. In fact, you now have access to the unique magic of the Ogres, Gut Magic, also known as Gastromancy. This primitive yet powerful magic revolves around consuming specific objects, usually but not always parts of formerly living creatures, in order to manifest specific results, such as eating a hunk of granite in order to imbue its sturdiness and resilience on themselves and others, or shoving a handful of ribs, skulls and femurs into their mouth and crunching them up, causing the bones of the enemies to do the same inside their bodies.

Aside from magic, you also gain a near-immunity to poisons as well as the skill to prepare great feasts sufficient to feed an entire tribes by yourself. Though unless you take particular care, the meals you prepare are unlikely to be suitable for a refined palate... or indeed human consumption given your far more powerful digestive system.

You also possess a large apron with a number of meat-hooks to store ingredients, a Ogre-sized set of cooking tools such as cleavers, carving-knives, and meat-tenderizers that can in a pinch be used as war-hammers suitable to bludgeon a rhinoceros to death with, in addition to a massive cauldron nearly your own size that works as both a cooking implement as well as an amplifier for your Gut Magic. Your entourage of Gnoblars can now also serve as culinary aides for both your cooking and your Gastromancy.

addons.title: Firebelly
addons.text:
You are one of the select few that have undergone and survived the Flame Trial of the Fire Mouth, joining the illustrious ranks of the Firebellies. After being lowered into the volcano, scooping a load of lava, and then gulping it down, an act survivable only by the volcano god's blessing, its raging heat now dwells within you, giving you a number of blessings.

First, you are all but immune to fire and heat, and can breathe an inferno hot enough to melt steel on your enemies.

You also gain a magical affinity for Fire Magic, able to wield it with great intensity as you need not fear its flames turning on you.

Finally, your blood itself has changed, and any wound inflicted upon you will bleed searing magma, posing a real danger to both your enemy and their weapons if they try to engage you in melee-combat.

addons.title: Ogre Hunter
addons.text:
Your affinity with beasts has elevated you from a regular Ogre to one of the reclusive Ogre Hunters, loners who can take on and tame even the fierce beasts of the Mountains of Mourn. Your already impressive survival-skills have improved even further, letting you traverse and endure even the most inhospitable of climates. You also gain a natural instinct for how to both tame and take down any beast you encounter, even those that massively outsize you.

Now you have both a pack of five Sabretusks and three Blood Vultures to aid in your hunting. In addition to the two Rhinoxen you keep as pack-animals you can now choose to have either a Stonehorn or a Thundertusk as your personal mount in combat. They will be able to survive warmer and even tropical climates without dying or needing to hibernate in a glacier, though temperatures above freezing will still leave them irritated and even more bellicose than usual. Your horde of Gnoblars doubles in size in order to compensate for the increased amount of work your larger collection of beasts cause.

Finally, your personal arsenal is expanded by a set of javelins scaled to your size, a pair of great nets, as well as a Harpoon Launcher, an ogre crossbow that to humans would be considered a ballista. You will be skilled in their use and surprisingly accurate at even long ranges thanks to your incredible strength.

objects.text:
The ancient strength of the Mountains of Mourn now flows through your veins, transforming you into one of the mighty Ogres of Warhammer Fantasy. You grow to a towering height of 9 to 12 feet, your frame becoming massively muscular and broad enough to shrug off wounds that would kill ordinary people. Your bones become as dense as ironwood, your hide thick enough to resist arrows, blades, and small-caliber firearms, while your incredible endurance allows you to march, fight, and feast for days without tiring.

Your physical strength reaches truly monstrous levels, allowing you to lift several tons, smash through stone walls, uproot trees, hurl boulders, and overpower nearly any mundane creature in direct combat. Despite your immense size, you possess surprising speed and agility, able to sprint at frightening speeds, charge with enough force to shatter battle lines, and react far faster than most opponents expect from someone your size.

Your body possesses an insatiable appetite, requiring several times the food of a normal human to remain fully satisfied. Fortunately, your digestive system is capable of consuming and safely processing nearly anything organic, including spoiled food, raw meat, and other substances that would normally be inedible. Your constitution grants tremendous resistance to disease, poison, harsh climates, and exhaustion.

Like the greatest Ogre mercenaries, you instinctively understand brute-force warfare. You possess expert skill with enormous clubs, great weapons, axes, hammers, cleavers, oversized firearms, and improvised weapons, while also being fully capable of fighting bare-handed. You have a natural talent for intimidating foes, judging strength, surviving in the wilderness, and organizing supplies for long military campaigns.

You also begin your journey with a small but dependable retinue befitting an Ogre wanderer. You receive two loyal Rhinoxen, one already trained as your personal mount and the other equipped as a sturdy pack beast capable of hauling your supplies, treasure, and equipment across nearly any terrain. In addition, you may choose either a pair of Sabretusks, whose keen senses and savage hunting instincts make them exceptional scouts and guardians, or a pair of Blood Vultures, intelligent carrion birds that excel at reconnaissance, tracking, and locating food or enemies from great distances. 

Finally, fifteen fiercely loyal Gnoblars accompany you as servants, porters, cooks, laborers, and camp followers. Though individually cowardly and comically incompetent, together they prove surprisingly resourceful, eagerly maintaining your gear, carrying burdens, gathering supplies, erecting camp, and obeying your orders to the best of their abilities.

Finally, your body retains the remarkable vitality of the Ogre race. You recover from injuries several times faster than a normal person, can survive wounds that would be fatal to most races, and remain physically powerful well into old age. While not immortal, you enjoy a greatly extended lifespan and possess the raw might, resilience, and battlefield presence that have made the Ogre Kingdoms feared across the Warhammer world.
objects.title: Ogre Blood (Warhammer Fantasy)
Qu (All Tomorrows)
objects.text:
Your body has been transformed, mutated into a four-winged insectoid creature, bearing a slight resemblance to Brine shrimp in terms of body shape, with a single tail-like tentacle for grabbing and manipulating objects. You are one of the most terrifying things that would bring terror to any space-faring civilisation, a race of beings known only for destruction and biological monstrosities.

The Qu are a race of beings that long ago abandoned their original forms in favour of becoming something more suited to survive in space and are considered the perfect biological life form; they genetically augmented themselves until they became completely unrecognisable. 

They augmented their body to be some of the most biologically perfect beings in the galaxy. Considering themselves gods, they are capable of flight, nigh-immortal, not ageing, and have enhanced senses and are immune to any viruses, diseases, or other illnesses. 

Your mind has also changed, adapting to your new form and augmenting it, as the Qu altered their minds long ago to be biological supercomputers. However, most of your mind is focused on the field of biology, having an easier time working on genetic engineering and other similar fields due to the proclivities of the Qu; you have a genetic knowledge of biological manipulation projects that the Qu have already figured out, and your mind is also altered to be able to figure out galactic warfare.

The main ability the Qu possess is to shape the biology of other species, manipulating the biology through many different means. The Qu have this as an innate biological ability; they have also augmented it with nanomachines to enhance their skill at manipulating biology. One of the many notable ways they have used this is turning humans into literal bricks and then putting the changed humans into the walls.

Note: the average size of a Qu is massive at 10-20 feet long.

objects.title: Xenomorph (Alien)
objects.text:
You are an Ultimate Lifeform... now a Xenomorph XX121, or simply a Xenomorph, you have become a composite of all castes throughout the franchise. The ability of the Drone to spit acid and cocoon enemies, the size and length of a Warrior, and more.

You are able to infect victims with Facehuggers, and then Chestbursters like any good Xenomorph after laying an egg on command. Your agility and speed is unheard of, nearly faster than the eye can see thanks to the speed of the Runner caste. Your Strength allows you to rip through the bulkheads and walls of spaceships with ease thanks to your tail and razor sharp claws.

Your Dorsal spines also give a sensory benefit, allowing you to detect air movements from prey, and subtly detect heat movements, although not quite true thermal vision. You also have a secondary jaw, capable of bursting through any human skull with ease, the only defense being to dodge its incredible speed.

Finally, and your most impressive feat: Any eggs you spawn while not only have all that you do, but will adapt based on a host if you infect one, taking advantages from them for their future endeavors. All of your offspring will see you as the queen of the hive, and at the time of implantation or before they truly burst out, you can dictate their caste.

addons.text:
Your Unseen Hands have merged with your vectors and massively increased their growth and power. You know have one thousand vectors each with a range of up to ten thousand kilometers, each and every vector is capable of flattening a city block on its own and can merge with each other to increase their overall destructive power. 

Unlike before your body is completely capable of handling the power of your vectors and there is no risk of your body breaking down.

If you have Ten Thousand Hands of Avalokiteshvara you will instead have ten thousand vectors with a planetary range, and each vector capable of flattening half a town in one hit.
addons.title: Threat to Humanity

addons.text:
The legends of Diclonius' being mistaken for Oni are not simply cases of mistaken identity. Your horns take the place of Oni horns and are always out. Even without absorbing ambient mana, your physical strength and durability are inherently equal to that of your vectors—and vice versa. This unique trait eliminates any concern about the strain of your vectors growing too powerful and potentially breaking your body down.

Your ability to absorb mana from the atmosphere also extends to your vectors. Thanks to their unique capacity to shift frequencies and vibrate, they can absorb other forms of energy that travel through frequencies, such as electricity, radio waves, and even the vibrations of sound, converting them into mana. Both your vectors and your horns facilitate this remarkable ability.

You can still make Silpelits but if you allow it the virus will cause any born to be Oni like you albeit much weaker and no longer infertile.
addons.title: True Oni

objects.text:
Diclonius, also known as Oni, are a species separate from but similar to humans. They emerged from a mutation that some view as the next evolutionary step, poised to succeed humanity. You are a Diclonius Queen. The most distinctive traits that set you apart from humans are the two horns on your head and an enlarged pineal gland in your brain, which grants you the ability to deploy vectors.

Vectors are invisible, telekinetic arms that you can retract or extend at will. They are capable of vibrating at high frequencies and possess immense strength, easily bending metal and slicing through flesh as if it were water. Depending on the frequency of vibration, your vectors can phase through objects without physical interference, become solid enough to carry liquids, or even become visible, significantly increasing their strength and destructive force. Each vector can withstand low-caliber gunfire but will eventually falter against heavy-caliber attacks.

At the start, you have 14 vectors, each extending up to 2 meters in length. As a Queen, your vectors' strength, durability, number, and range will grow over time with repeated use.

A unique form of reproduction allows you or any of your Silpelits to infect humans with a virus via vector contact. This infection permanently alters the human's DNA, ensuring that all their future offspring will be Diclonius. These offspring, called Silpelits, are infertile but retain the ability to infect others, perpetuating the species. As the Queen, however, you are not infertile.

While your vectors will become more powerful as they develop, your physical body does not adapt to this growth. Overusing your vectors, especially at extreme scales such as planetary ranges, can lead to catastrophic strain on your body. This strain may cause your physical form to deteriorate and ultimately collapse. Any damage to your horns can will weaken your ability to use your vectors until they regrow.
objects.title: Diclonius Queen (Elfen Lied)

objects.text:
You are a type of spiritual being native to the netherworld, coalesced from the unsalvageable corrupted soul dregs fallen into the Abyss. Currently, you are a lowly creature that has only just passed infancy and assumed a definite form. As such, you fall near the bottom of the demonic hierarchy of power, though your fully developed ego sets you apart from other Lesser Demons. 

You now possess a number of inherent powers and abilities, including high purity magical power which you can instinctually use to enhance yourself, granting you the strength to rend steel plate armor with your bare hands alongside comparable enhancements to all your other physical attributes, and immunity to purely non-magical damage. Additionally, you gain the magical prowess of your greater brethren, if only at a level appropriate to your current strength, meaning you can create cantrip-level magical effects through will alone or use the Divine Spirit Language to focus your intention for more potent effects.

As a spiritual lifeform, a creature of pure ego and magic, the specifics of your form are initially entirely up to you but continue to shift according to your needs, desires, and your self-perception. Most demons of this level instinctually settle on effective but mediocre Imp-like shapes that take advantage of human-like appendages for dexterity without completely sacrificing combat advantages like claws, fur/scales, and wings. However, on occasion, certain demons settle on more bestial, insectoid, or amorphous shapes to maximize their preferred hunting strategies. 

While it might seem unimportant at first, given your inherent malleability, the form you initially settle on will have far-reaching impacts on your future as a demon. As your self-perception and chosen form create a sort of self-reinforcing feedback loop, which both drives and shapes your development as an individual.

To interact with the physical world, you can either form a temporary vessel out of your magic or incarnate in a physical body for greater stability and energy efficiency. That being the case, you cannot be physically killed, as destroying your physical vessel merely leaves you disembodied, and sufficient spiritual/magical damage will only banish you to the netherworld deprived of a proportional amount of your magical power. Permanent death is only possible by destroying your spiritual core, as a result of either a spirit-destroying attack from a much more powerful being or breaking your will to resist, which leaves your core vulnerable.

Your immortality is not, however, without its drawbacks. You may escape a permanent end, but by default you lack both the power and knowledge needed to leave the netherworld on your own. As such you will be stuck surviving its hostile environment and inhabitants like any other demon until you are called to a physical plane through an appropriate summoning spell, and there is no guarantee you will even be summoned to the same world twice or that a higher ranking demon won’t devour you before that.

As a demon, you do not naturally generate magical power, you need to rely on outside sources of it to replenish and grow your reserves, notably through the consumption of souls. For your purposes, souls with rich emotions and intellect are best, as they provide more pure magic and reinforce your ego, necessary factors for evolving into a more powerful spiritual existence. Those benefits are exponentially greater if the soul is obtained willingly through a magical contract rather than through force, as the soul no longer instinctually resists becoming a part of you.
objects.title: Lesser Demon (Akuma Koujo)

objects.text:
Now, you are a young Bijuu—a tailed beast, a creature taking the form of an animal, comprised entirely of a powerful red chakra. You’ll find yourself unable to be permanently killed; your chakra formed body will re-form in time. You can also speak telepathically to any of your fellow Bijuu and heal rapidly from any damage.

Bijuu are ranked in power by the number of tails—or tail-like appendages—they have, from One Tail to Nine Tails. Each additional tail represents an increase in their physical abilities and the amount of potent chakra that makes up their bodies.

You can choose to take the form and abilities of any of the canon Bijuu or select an animal for your form to be based on, along with an ability roughly equivalent to the powers of the known Bijuu. Each purchase here represents another tail being added to whatever form you choose, increasing your physical abilities and the amount of chakra available to you.

As a young Bijuu, while you have control over your body, the nuances of the various tricks and abilities it might be capable of will take time and practice to learn and master. Eventually, you’ll find yourself able to transfer chakra to others, heal, split your form and consciousness, take smaller and more humanoid forms, and launch the infamous Bijūdama—the Tailed Beast Ball.
objects.title: Young Bijuu (Naruto)

objects.text:
You are a Novakid, a sentient, alien, “gas-bag”, born from fragments of the Cultivator.

As a Novakid, your body is a humanoid shell of plasma that is magnetically shaped and generated from a metallic brand that acts as your face, protecting a mixture of vital superheated interstellar gases that, together, make you function as solid energy. Furthermore, your kind possesses high intelligence that makes technological advancement an ease as long as you combat your innate short attention span.

As a final note, upon death, Novakid will violently explode, leaving only their brand behind.
objects.title: Novakid (Starbound)

addons.title: Caliban
addons.text:
As you’re coursing with Void energy, you’ve become something of a chimeral prototype, able to wreathe Void and Tau together with fury and skill unmatched by other Tenno, even if you were to be inhabiting a Warframe.

Similarly, while Void energy would normally be lethal to your Sentient physiology, your constant link to the Void has mitigated this weakness greatly, allowing you to withstand esoteric energies far better than you once did.

addons.title: Archon
addons.text:
Your body has been fused with a Warframe into a great mockery of your old form. Gaining power, at the expense of your Sentient dignity, you’ve become an Archon.

In addition to your old power, you’ve gained access to the abilities and strength of your Warframe, making you incredibly resilient and allowing you greater control over the Warframe’s specific abilities. Archon Amar for instance was built from the fallen Amar the Wolf and a Rhino warframe, and leveraged both the Rhino’s incredible ferocity and his own guile into becoming the flame wreathed butcher of Narmer. 

If you have access to multiple Warframes, you can swap out which makes up your body, giving you greater versatility.

addons.title: Wanderer
addons.text:
The Sentients were created for terraforming, with the Light coursing through you, you’re able to take advantage of this heritage and act much like the Traveller once did, albeit on a much smaller scale. 

Much like the Traveller, you’re able to terraform areas of the world with your Light, using it to turn deserts into lush oases in your step. This can be furthered, using parts of your light to bestow small paracausal gifts and discoveries on others. This only furthers if you were to produce more Sentients for your hive, each acting as a font for the Light to flow through, iterative and cooperating in perfect unison.

objects.text:
The Sentients, once created by the Orokin to terraform the Tau system (and turned on their creators fearing they’d ruin Tau as they did Earth), are a bio-mechanical species. With the right tools, they can be re-engineered into myriad shapes. You are able to choose your initial shape from the ‘lower caste’ of the Sentients, from the highly resilient Brachiolysts, to Mimics that are able to disguise themselves as mundane objects. 

All Sentients are imbued with a form of esoteric energy called Tau that allows them to fly and powers many of the abilities, including the projection of this energy for combat. This energy also gives them their most useful ability. Each sentient is able to adapt to whatever is currently doing them harm. For instance, a Sentient taking a large amount of ‘heat’ based damage would become resistant to it and eventually immune. However, this resistance is not all encompassing, with only two ‘types’ of damage being able to be resisted this way at a time, of which they’re required to be exposed to first before adapting. 

This energy is also used in their reproduction, during which they fragment a piece of themselves and either allow it to grow into a full Sentient or attach it to another form of technology and let it turn into a hybrid. All Sentiments fragmented this way are born into a kind of hive mind with their progenitor though some chemical agents (like the Xenoflora or its derivative drug Bloom) can sever this link temporarily.

Notably Sentients are unable to adapt to Void energy, and extradimensional attacks remain a notable weakness for them. A fact which has made Sentients in the Origin System where such a thing is plentiful a relatively manageable threat.

Additionally, for Tau Sentients looking human is considered an aesthetically appealing, but unrealistic beauty standard.
objects.title: Sentient (Warframe)

objects.text:
You have become the host of Baoh, an artificial parasite created by Dress as a biological weapon. Baoh can form powerful biological armor around your body known as the Baoh Armed Phenomenon, granting you immense strength, speed, reflexes, and durability. You can smash through steel, dodge sniper rounds, survive point-blank shotgun blasts, and withstand collisions with armored vehicles.

Baoh also grants extraordinary regeneration. You can survive devastating injuries, reattach severed limbs, and even heal others through your blood. However, because Baoh resides in your brain, catastrophic brain damage remains fatal. The parasite is also highly intelligent and adaptive, quickly learning, improvising weapons, and developing new abilities when exposed to powerful threats.

Baoh provides numerous additional biological abilities. You possess an enhanced sense of smell capable of detecting emotions and even identifying phenomena such as mind control. This sense remains active while sleeping, making you extremely difficult to ambush.

Your offensive abilities include corrosive acid secreted from your palms, hardened forearm blades capable of cutting through metal, razor-sharp hair projectiles that can pierce steel and ignite, and up to 60,000 volts of bioelectricity. This electricity can suspend objects magnetically, strike targets at range, and produce enough explosive force to damage buildings.

Most importantly, Baoh is constantly evolving. With enough time or exposure to a powerful opponent, it can develop new adaptations specifically suited to overcoming them—even during a single fight. You can also use many of Baoh’s abilities without entering the Armed Phenomenon.

And unlike Ikuro, you don’t have to worry about Baoh reproducing by laying eggs inside you that eventually tear their way out.
objects.title: Host of Baoh (Baoh: The Visitor)

addons.text: "A new spark inspires a humble community" In your travels you will encounter various spirits that will be drawn to you. Because of your nature as a Sky Child, they will always be benevolent, nor can they pose any harm to you. They can offer various gifts such as powers, blessings, information, passage, and so on, in exchange of some favor, befriending them, a simple trade, or other means. After completion you can contact or summon that spirit at any time. Or better yet, have them join you as your companion. These spirits will typically resemble those found in the Kingdom of Sky, but other worlds will have different ones. They can be souls of the deceased, supernatural creatures, deities, eldritch creatures, demons, etc. You now possess a collection of candles that serve various purposes. They never blow out unless you wish it, can light up the darkest rooms, and replenish all forms of vitality and energy. Their most unique ability is being a universal medium of exchange. One candle will always be worth enough to purchase any one item from a merchant, can substitute as a magical regent, be used as an offering to a god, etc. You gain these candles by forging friendships, as additional rewards for helping spirits, and by finding them throughout and outside the Kingdom of Sky.
addons.title: Beloved of the Light

addons.text: "A long time has passed. Now we call to you. Go forth, child. Return our spirits to the stars." The Ancient Spirits, Elders, and Ancestors of Sky have revealed themselves to you. Offering to make you an avatar of not just one, but multiple constellations. To earn these, you must complete a series of tasks they propose, befriend them, offer them a candle, or whatever else they ask of you. Completing them is always within your power as a Sky Child. You can commune with these spirits at any time, and they are like guardian angels to you. From offering boons of power, providing effective training, sharing their memories, protecting you from hazards, warding off evil in your wake, etc. By growing closer to them, your abilities as a Sky Child and Constellation Avatar will grow and evolve over time. This is shown through a HUD that displays any and all details about your progress, but will by default, project them as incomplete constellations. Completing them proves your mastery over these powers, and rewards you with an “Ultimate Gift”. Throughout your travels within and outside the Kingdom of Sky, you will find other spirits like them scattered across the world. By befriending them, you can learn new abilities relating to either the setting you’re in, your constellations, or receive a boon to improve them. There’s also a chance to encounter Seasonal Spirits, which offer more exotic versions of these rewards. On occasion, you will encounter a merchant spirit who will sell various items to you. Some from the Kingdom of Sky, others from different sources, sometimes even the rewards of spirits you didn’t encounter yet.
addons.title: Legacy of the Elders

addons.text: ”A home away from home” Several new additions now adorn your little home, all gifted from the Kingdom of Sky. With a simple thought, you can teleport directly to your home and back to your previous location. Others can do the same when given your expressed permission. Within or outside your home is a Constellation Table — a stone circle that projects a tree of various constellations into the sky. These represent your connections with others. You can use it to contact them, find their location, send gifts, teleport to their location, and other such functions. They also have several utility functions, such as being a todo-list, monitoring your progress, a simple clock, refuelling your internal energies, playing music, etc. Several stone structures decorate your home, acting as portals to the many realms, locations, and places you’ve visited in your travels. Even to other dimensions and universes if you have Homecoming or other means to facilitate it. One of them leads to Aviary Village, a massive island filled with other Sky Children like yourself, as well as many other attractions. From shops that sell all kinds of items, a cafe full of patrons, several events happening frequently, and even several spirits. You can also explore the Kingdom of Sky from here.
addons.title: Return Shrine

objects.text: "Only the brave will attain the light." Rejoice, for you have been blessed. Your body has been remade anew, removing any and all blemishes, and resculpted to become a Sky Child. Gaining skill in mundane travel, allowing you to walk, run, swim, slide, etc for indefinite periods of time with no issue. You can choose to keep your original appearance, or not. Your first of many blessings is the ability to fly, which is fueled by "Winged Light". An attachment to your cape that empowers and sustains you with light, removing earthly needs from you entirely. Your second blessing is "Call", which lets out a low volume sound that lights the path forward for you. This can be for anything as grand as your next destination on a foreign planet, to as mundane as finding your lost possessions. You can raise the volume ever so slightly for others to hear if you wish. Your third blessing is the power of "Expressions", making communication and making friends a breeze without needing to say a word. Simply acting out a stance can convey your ideas better than you would've at normal communication no matter the cultural, language or other barriers. Pointing at something? They automatically know which way or thing you're referring to. Your fourth blessing is "Customization", granting you every single cosmetic available in the constantly evolving world of the Kingdom of the Sky for free. Whether you're still or on the fly, you can dress up yourself with just a thought, or project your closet as a screen visible only to you. Your fifth and final blessing is "Spells", granting you encyclopedic knowledge on many cantrips. These were never intended for combat purposes, but some could fulfill that role with some creativity. They still prove to be very useful however, you could summon objects like a ball, lantern or boat, start a bonfire, reduce your fall speed, share memories, and alter your size just to name a few.
objects.title: Sky Child (Sky: Children of the Light)

objects.text:
You are now a Necrofriggian, a moth-like alien species from the frozen world of Kylmyys. Your body is naturally resistant to extreme cold and heat, can survive underwater and in the vacuum of space, and possesses four large wings that can fold around you like a cloak. These wings grant you fast and highly maneuverable flight.

You can freely become intangible, allowing you to pass through solid objects, attacks, and living beings. You may phase your entire body or only individual parts, and while intangible your appearance becomes faint and ghostlike. Certain supernatural abilities and effects capable of interacting with incorporeal beings can still affect you.

You possess powerful cryokinesis, primarily expressed through your breath and hands. You can rapidly drain heat, freeze people or objects, cover large areas in ice, and create simple ice structures such as walls, spikes, restraints, or platforms. You can also freeze something while phasing through it, draining its heat from the inside.

Your body is stronger and more durable than a normal human's, and your claws, teeth, and prehensile feet are useful both for combat and climbing. You can safely consume metal and possess the natural reproductive cycle of your species, producing a clutch of eggs roughly once every eighty years.

Flying, phasing, and manipulating cold are natural functions of your body, becoming easier and more precise with practice.
objects.title: Necrofriggian (Ben 10)

addons.title: Belial Reborn
addons.text:
Rather than the above average Darkstalker, you hail from one of the noble families of Makai, elevating your soul to S Class. With strength on par with powerful figures like Merged Morrigan Aensland, Judah Dohma, and Galnon Voshtal. All capable of reigning at the top of Makai with little challenge. 

With further training, you may gain strength akin to the late first ruler of Makai and it's only S+ Class being, Belial.

addons.title: Smart Stalker
addons.text:
The malleable nature of your soul combined with your nature as a Darkstalker opens a world of possibilities for you. Where at first you had only a few unique abilities, you can now develop several. Even stretch the limits of what your species should be capable of.

For example, your shapeshifting can be pushed into full biokinesis on both yourself and others as a Demon, conjure and shape water from nothing as a Merman, absorb matter as Frankenstein's Monster, manipulate the length and elasticity of your bandages as a Mummy, etc.

objects.text:
You've become a supernatural creature from the realm of Makai, otherwise known as a Darkstalker. This includes all manner of creatures from folklore, legends, the occult, and superstition. Such as vampires, demons, werewolves, zombies, ghosts, reanimated samurai, beastmen, frankenstein's monster, or bigfoot. You can choose to become one of the many Darkstalkers from the franchise or an original one of your own creation.

Regardless of choice, you have the strength to be above average for your species, with your soul cataloged as B+ Class by the realm of Makai. As well as a suite of standard abilities for your kind, a few unique ones tailored to you, and a natural talent for combat. 

You can increase your power by strengthening your soul, whether through spiritual training or consuming the souls of others. Due to this you have a natural resistance against anything targeting your soul, scaling with your overall strength.
objects.title: Darkstalker (Darkstalkers)
Simurian (Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo)
objects.text:
You are now a Simurian, the extraterrestrial humanoid species native to Simuria. You possess their characteristic third eye, an essential supernatural organ that generates and regulates Rolloluca, the Simurian equivalent of Cursed Energy. This allows you to perceive curses, reinforce your body, manipulate your energy and learn the principles of Jujutsu Sorcery just as human sorcerers can.

Your third eye is more than an additional sense. When opened and deliberately focused upon another being, it can disrupt their mind, causing disorientation and potentially rendering weaker targets unconscious. With training, you can further develop the unusual sensory and information-gathering properties displayed by skilled Simurians.

You possess the potential to develop Innate Techniques derived from Simurian concepts rather than those normally found among humans. Such techniques can operate upon principles unfamiliar to Earthly sorcerers, and unlike humans, Simurians have demonstrated the potential to possess more than one Innate Technique. This does not grant you Dabura's Light, Maru and Cross' techniques, or any other existing character's abilities automatically; those must be acquired separately or developed through appropriate powers.

You may belong to any Simurian tribe appropriate to the setting. If you choose the Deskunte, like Dabura Karaba, you possess their vertical third eye, characteristic horns and natural affinity for manifesting their killing intent through Rolloluca. This makes your hostility itself perceptible and potentially dangerous, though its effectiveness still depends upon your personal power and training.

addons.title: Distant Invocation
addons.text:
Your Cerealian vision has become integrated with your third eye, allowing you to designate a remote point within your sight as the origin of your Rolloluca techniques.

Instead of every technique having to begin from your body, you can manifest its effect from a chosen location you can clearly perceive, letting you attack from unexpected angles, place barriers at range, or deploy innate techniques around distant targets without first crossing the intervening space.

You still expend the same Rolloluca and remain limited by the normal range and capabilities of the technique itself; this changes its point of origin, not what the technique can inherently do.

addons.title: Rolloluca Adaptation
addons.text:
Your Simurian biology has become exceptionally plastic, with your third eye acting as the control center for deliberate physiological adaptation. 

By directing Rolloluca through your body, you can reconfigure existing structures for specific purposes, altering musculature, senses, circulation, bone density, dermal toughness, organ performance, and similar systems.

You can also grow auxiliary Rolloluca organs that function as secondary reservoirs and conduits. These allow you to channel Rolloluca and activate techniques through different parts of your body, distribute the strain of heavy energy use, and continue functioning even if your third eye is damaged.

With time and training, useful adaptations can become more efficient and easier to reproduce, allowing you to develop specialized configurations suited to combat, survival, or particular environments.

These are controlled biological adaptations rather than shapeshifting. You cannot completely imitate another species or create supernatural abilities your physiology and Rolloluca cannot support.

addons.title: Triune Insight
addons.text:
Your Six Eyes synchronize with your Simurian third eye, granting precise control over its mental interference. 

While maintaining eye contact, you can selectively disrupt balance, coordination, concentration, sensory processing, or short-term memory rather than simply confusing or incapacitating a target.

You can also regulate your third eye’s Rolloluca output, spreading its effects across several weaker targets or concentrating them against a single stronger opponent. 

Targets sufficiently stronger than you can still resist or overcome these effects. The Six Eyes also protect your brain from the strain of ordinary third-eye use, but do not automatically negate natural Simurian drawbacks such as dangerous tears.

objects.title: Cebalrai (Dino Crisis)
objects.text:
You are now the Cebalrai, the final and successful result of MTHR’s attempts to create the ultimate lifeform. Furthermore, you are already on par with the one faced at the end of Dino Crisis 3.

As the Cebalrai, your capabilities are absurd, primarily due to your ability to reactively adapt, growing new organs and body structures, like an additional head, to survive and thrive in any environment or against any threat. 

At your baseline, you already have strength and durability that requires sci-fi civilizations field heavy combat vehicles to meaningfully face you, the myriad of traits needed to survive and function in the vacuum of space indefinitely without any issues, can stretch your neck several times its length in an instant, and the capability to channel your bio-electricity either to enhance the strength and lethality of your bites and strikes, or to unleash devastating beams of concentrated bio-electricity from your mouths.

Optionally, you may choose to manifest this race as a changer form instead.

objects.title: Mazoku (Kyou Kara Maou!)
objects.text:
You are a Mazoku, a supernatural race that appears human aside from their extraordinary beauty and exceptionally long lifespans of 400 to 500 years. They mature far more slowly than humans and are said to be roughly five times older than they appear, though Half-Mazoku age differently depending on the individual.

Mazoku are born with an innate affinity for Maryoku (magical ability) that allows Mazoku to wield Majutsu (demon magic). Maryoku is an intrinsic attribute of the soul and cannot be increased through training or other means. You possess Maryoku equal to that of the strongest Maou and are free from the limitations that hinder most Mazoku, allowing you to use your Majutsu freely even within human territories, where human worship of God normally limits the elemental powers available to them.

To use Majutsu, a Mazoku forms a pact with one of four elements: earth, water, air, or fire. Most can form only one pact, while rare individuals can form pacts with all four. Mazoku also possess healing Majutsu, which is innate and requires no elemental pact.

objects.title: Hemoanima (The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy)
objects.text:
Your veins are full of cryptoglobin, the blood of Futurans. And you specifically are one of the few blessed to get actual superpowers from it. By spilling your blood, you can undergo a transformation sequence, forming a set of personal arms and armor around yourself. While transformed, you are several times stronger and faster than a baseline human. Your attacks count as “magical” or “superpowered” for the purposes of damaging beings that are immune to mundane weapons. You can maintain the transformation for hours even starting off, although heavy exertion will tire you out faster and force you back to your base form.

Do note that your Class Weapon can be rather unusual. A set of wings, a heavily armed jeep, and a giant robot are all possible expressions of a person’s inner nature through hemoanima.

One final word: completely draining the blood of other hemoanima users will provide a small permanent increase in your power. In other worlds this principle may apply to various beings who gain power from supernaturally charged blood or flesh. You may do with this knowledge as you wish.

addons.title: Specialist Skill
addons.text: The supernatural alteration to your genetics made by your Quirk has “echoed” through your hemoanima. You possess a Specialist Skill strong enough to be considered a minor power in its own right. Examples include Shouma’s resistance to mind control and memory manipulation, Hiruko’s ability to retain memories across timelines, Kako’s flashes of future vision, or Tsubasa’s savant level understanding of Hundred Line-verse technology.

You have a supernatural spatial awareness that allows you to divine your nearby surroundings giving you insight into exactly how the forces of gravity and kinetic energy act upon you. Beyond this spatial awareness, you have the ability to both store kinetic energy at-will and instantaneous change your momentum, allowing for instant acceleration to your max speed and deceleration to a dead stop in an instant. Your maximum speed has been increased by a magnitude, and your body is now capable of handling any amount of pressure and strain. Additionally you will find that the sky is no longer your limit, as you are capable of riding on air, and your body is incredibly in-tune with Zero-Gravity scenarios that you will come across.
addons.title: Gravity Child

addons.text: Through a combination of your extraordinary mobility and your Spinjitzu you’ve become able to tap into your innate energy, creating a tornado-like vortex of energy around yourself that allows you to briefly levitate over land. In combination with your talent for traversal and supernatural speed, you can now achieve impossible feats of mobility by enhancing your movement with Spin- and Airjitzu. Be it vertical traversal of buildings, spinning over bodies of water, or achieving flight for short bursts of time, only the hardest, most trapped and secured areas will pose a challenge as you’ll breeze right through the rest.
addons.title: Airjitzu

objects.text:
You have surpassed your human limitations, granting you extraordinary mobility and agility, allowing you to effortlessly use your environment to your advantage. You can perform incredible feats like launching off surfaces, air dashing, swinging on lampposts, running on walls, grinding along rails, and move with supernatural grace. 

Combined, these let you effortlessly scale buildings, outpace cars, and with exceptional effort, even traverse an entire city in mere minutes.
