Not only have you gained enhanced mobility and dexterity but they have been effortlessly blended with your combat prowess, allowing you to seamlessly take down multiple foes untouched through connected physical attacks with coordinated follow-ups.
objects.title: Flowmotion

objects.text:
You are now a novice in the art of Qinggong, often called the lightness skill. At its core, Qinggong is the art of transcending earthly limits, making the body as light as the breeze and flow like water. This skill allows you to defy gravity in extraordinary ways—leaping across rooftops, sprinting effortlessly from branch to branch, and navigating the world with unmatched agility.

Though you are just a novice, the true peak of Qinggong is awe-inspiring. Masters of this art can traverse a hundred miles in a single step, stride across the seas, or leap across the heavens themselves. 

Currently, your speed rivals that of a car, with flexibility and grace it could never match. Your style of Qinggong is pure and neutral, seamlessly adaptable to any fighting technique or mystical power. Moreover, your natural talent for learning and improving your Qinggong marks you as a true savant in the art.
objects.title: Qinggong

objects.text:
You are now a beginner in the art of Zhonggong, often referred to as the Art of Heaviness. At its core, Zhonggong is the art of enhancing the earthly limits of the body, making it as heavy as a mountain and as firmly rooted as a tree. This discipline allows you to defy gravity in extraordinary ways: increasing your body weight by tons, resisting any pushing force through sheer weight, and generating more strength than your body would normally be capable of producing. All of this is achieved without being hindered by your own weight you can still move normally while retaining the benefits of your increased mass.

Although you are only a beginner, the true pinnacle of Zhonggong is astonishing. Masters of this art can become as immovable as mountains, unleash the devastating force of a meteor, create earthquakes with nothing more than a stomp, and much more.

At present, you can only increase your body weight by 1 ton. Your style of Zhonggong is pure and neutral, making it perfectly adaptable to any fighting technique or mystical power. Furthermore, your natural talent for learning and mastering Zhonggong makes you a true genius of this martial art.
objects.title: Zhonggong

objects.text:
You are now a beginner in the art of Yinggong, often known as the Art of Hardening. At its core, Yinggong is the art of solidifying the body's earthly limits, making it as solid as a mountain and as firm as steel. This discipline allows you to defy the limits of solidity in extraordinary ways: gradually increasing your body's density, resisting both blunt and cutting attacks, and enhancing your biomechanical strength in proportion to your body's density. This does not increase your weight inherent as would normally occur from increasing your body density, and its effects extend throughout your entire body, from your skin to the deepest recesses of your human biology. You can still move normally while retaining all of these benefits.

Although you are only a beginner, the true pinnacle of Yinggong is astonishing. Masters of this art can become as hard as diamond, achieve immunity to physical attacks, concentrate the art into specific body parts such as their fingers and turn them into the equivalent of an extraordinarily deadly spear, attain the hardness of solid rock and crush boulders as if they were fragile eggs, and much more.

At present, you can only increase your body's density to the equivalent hardness of wood, granting a maximum overall strength of 500 kg. Your style of Yinggong is pure and neutral, making it perfectly adaptable to any fighting technique or mystical power. Furthermore, your natural talent for learning and mastering Yinggong makes you a true genius of this martial art.
objects.title: Yinggong

objects.text:
You possess an extraordinary talent for evasion, unmatched by anything seen before. Your instincts, reflexes, and skill are so finely tuned that your body will automatically dodge any threat, even if the attack is undetectable or seemingly impossible to avoid. Whether it’s magic, dimensional assaults, overwhelming destructive power, or physical and spiritual forces, nothing can strike you unless it surpasses your speed or strength to evade.

This unique ability allows you to master any skills or powers related to dodging, evasion, and movement. Your reflexes, stamina, speed, and physical attributes can all be trained without limits, enabling continuous growth, over time, your stamina will naturally increase. 

Your talent also grants an innate and always-active danger sense, allowing you to react to threats instantaneously. This heightened awareness is complemented by both physical and spiritual reflexes, ensuring you are prepared for any challenge.

Additionally, your elusiveness makes it impossible for anyone or anything to capture or seal you—unless they are significantly stronger or faster than you. Even then, any seal or confinement will weaken over time, eventually losing its hold. The only true threats to you are individuals with extreme talents specifically in killing or sealing. However, even against such adversaries, the outcome will depend on skill, power, and luck.

One notable downside of this talent is your enjoyment of near-death experiences. Your body’s ability to dodge even the most impossible threats often results in you waiting until the last possible moment to act, heightening the thrill of survival. This tendency can make you reckless in dangerous situations, though it can be mitigated through training and experience.
objects.title: The Elusive One

addons.text:
You don’t begin as a novice Lancer, struggling to find your place in the world. You are a Dragoon—a master of your craft, wielding both martial prowess and arcane knowledge refined through years of training and battle.

From wreathing your lance in fire and other magics to enhancing yourself or your allies with sorcery, your aether takes on the qualities of a dragon, further enhancing your strength and resilience. Where once your jumping prowess allowed you to leap twice your normal height with a minimum of 50 meters added, you can now jump four times your normal height with a minimum of 100 meters added.

Your lance has been enhanced to deal more effective damage to dragons and those with dragon blood. As a Dragoon, you are more than just a warrior—you are a legend in motion, a master of the skies, and a nightmare to all who dare stand in your path.
addons.title: The Legend of the Dragoon

objects.text:
You’re the rival of the main character, the second-in-command of the adventuring party, or the badass Dragoon who shows up to help slay dragons.

In any case, you embody the traits and aspects of the classic fantasy lancer. Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness.

One aspect of your abilities that clearly surpasses human limits is your jumping prowess. You can leap twice your normal height with a minimum jump height of 50 meters. For instance, if you could normally jump 1 meter, you would instead leap 52 meters. This incredible ability also grants you immunity to fall damage. Additionally, you can perform mid-air acrobatics, change direction or momentum, and temporarily pause mid-jump, storing your kinetic energy to unleash devastating force on impact when you land.

As the Lancer archetype, you are an unmatched prodigy with spears, lances, and similar weapons. Even without prior training, you could master these weapons through self-study within a month. You also have the innate talent to learn new techniques by observing others or inventing your own.

While formidable on its own, your potential shines even brighter when paired with magic, mana, or other supernatural abilities. Simply having a mana pool would allow you to create spells tailored to lance combat or further enhance your physical capabilities. This includes amplifying your combat speed, extending your jumping range, and more.

To top it off, you are granted a lance—or a weapon of similar design—that is uniquely yours. While you can choose its appearance, this is no ordinary weapon. It is, in fact, an heirloom: indestructible, capable of being summoned back to you with a mere thought, and expertly crafted to enhance your abilities and magic, helping you solidify your status as the ultimate lancer. This weapon also counts as an OoP.
objects.title: The Lancer

addons.text:
Through your mastery and talent at both martial-based defense and magical-based defense, you have become the ultimate Shieldmage. 

Both your shield and defensive magic have evolved as a result. To begin with, you have gained the ability to change your shield’s form at a moment’s notice using a small amount of magical energy. Alongside this, you can freely turn your Shield into a semi-sentient construct of pure magical energy. While in this form, your shield moves and blocks attacks autonomously, as if wielded by you personally. Your defensive magic, on the other hand, has become two-thirds more effective in every aspect and far more resistant to exotic forms of damage. In addition, whenever you cast defensive magic on yourself or use your shield as a focus, these effects are doubled. As you continue using Defensive Magic, it will "soak" into the Shield, permanently enhancing it. This applies to both its normal form and its magical form. 

Finally, your natural talent as both a Tank and a Defensive Magic user has grown even further.
addons.title: Shieldmage

objects.text:
You’re the steadfast guardian of the party, the unbreakable wall that stands between your allies and harm, or the lone warrior who holds the line when all seems lost.

You embody the traits and aspects of the classic fantasy shielder. Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness, granting you exceptional strength, endurance, and resilience.

What sets you apart beyond human limits is your unparalleled defensive capability. You passively take only two thirds damage from all sources, whether physical, magical, or otherwise. Additionally, you are completely immune to knockback, remaining rooted and unshaken even against overwhelming force. You also have high resistance to all status effects—such as poison, paralysis, curses, and mind-altering conditions.

As the Shielder archetype, you are a master of shields in all forms—tower shields, bucklers, kite shields, and more. Even without prior training, you can master any shield within a month of self-study. Your expertise extends beyond simple blocking; you can deflect projectiles with precision, absorb the impact of heavy strikes without flinching, and turn your shield into an offensive weapon, using its weight and momentum to crush, bash, and control the battlefield.

Your defensive strength is not limited to yourself. As long as your allies are within close range, you instinctively intercept attacks by physically blocking them. This also comes with a vague sense that helps you notice attacks that will land on your teammates before they do.

While formidable on your own, your potential grows even further when combined with magic, mana, or other supernatural abilities. Simply having a mana pool allows you to enhance your defensive capabilities, such as reinforcing your shield to withstand greater impacts, be able to take damage in the place of others, or increase your physical resilience even further. Your magic can also be channeled through your shield to create shockwaves or deliver powerful counterattacks without compromising your defensive stance.

To solidify your role as the ultimate Shielder, you are granted a unique shield. You choose its appearance, but it is no ordinary piece of equipment. This heirloom shield is indestructible, can be summoned back to you with a thought, and is perfectly crafted to enhance both your defensive and supportive abilities. It naturally improves your capacity to absorb damage for others and increases your resilience beyond natural limits. This shield also counts as an OoP.
objects.title: The Shielder

addons.text: Your skill at taming animals and navigating the wild become second to none, you instinctively know at a glance which animals are safe to tame, the difficultly of taming it, and the most effective method to do so. Even wilder, fantastical, or dangerous beasts aren't beyond your grasp, but are no less challenging to obtain as companions. You also know how to wrestle these beasts into submission, intimidate them, trick them, and use other counter measures should the need arise. Any tamed animals you have gain the same benefits as your first animal companion, becoming a bestial hivemind at your command. If you have supernatural powers or abilities, they can also inherit and wield them with the same skill as you. Unlike your first beast though, they can't revive after death unless you've formed a True Bond with them first. If you possess Animal Spirit, their souls can transfer to both yours and first companion, gaining their abilities and traits, to the point of potentially becoming a chimera or beast humanoid yourself if you wish.
addons.title: Beastmaster

objects.text:
You are the master of the wilds, the unseen hunter, and the adaptable survivalist who thrives where others falter. Whether tracking prey through dense forests, navigating treacherous mountains, or striking from the shadows, you are the embodiment of precision, agility, and self-sufficiency.

Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness, granting you exceptional speed, dexterity, and endurance. You can move swiftly and silently through any terrain, adapting to your surroundings with near-supernatural ease.

What sets you apart beyond human limits is your unparalleled tracking and perception. You can follow a trail days after it was made, noticing the subtlest signs of passage. Your senses are heightened to extraordinary levels—you can hear a whisper from across a clearing, detect scents on the wind like a predator, and see clearly in near-total darkness.

As the Ranger archetype, you are a master of ranged and melee combat, excelling with bows, crossbows, thrown weapons, and light blades. Even without prior training, you can master any ranged or light weapon within a month of self-study. Your shots are unnervingly precise, allowing you to strike moving targets, ricochet projectiles with intent, and even split arrows mid-flight. In close combat, you are swift and relentless, wielding agility and precision over brute strength.

Your survival instincts are second to none. You can find sustenance in even the harshest environments, resist extreme temperatures, and navigate without aid through unknown lands. Poisons, venoms, and natural hazards have little effect on you, and you can recover from injuries at an accelerated rate when in natural surroundings. 

While formidable alone, your potential grows when combined with magic, mana, or supernatural abilities. Simply having a mana pool allows you to enhance your senses further, blend seamlessly with your surroundings, or imbue your attacks with elemental power. Your bond with nature grants you an intuitive understanding of animals, allowing you to tame, command, or befriend creatures that would otherwise be hostile.

To solidify your role as the ultimate Ranger, you are granted a unique companion—an animal bonded to your very soul. You choose its form, but it is no ordinary beast. This companion is as strong as you, though its abilities may focus on different aspects such as speed, stealth, or durability. It is more intelligent, resilient, and powerful than any natural creature, growing alongside you and gaining unique abilities. It can communicate with you instinctively, aid you in battle, and even share its senses with you. No matter the distance, you are always connected, and should it ever fall, it will return to your side after a time.
objects.title: The Ranger

addons.text:
You are no longer simply some aspirant of the sword, bumbling your way to eventual mastery of the blade one swing at a time. Now, you are a burgeoning Sword Saint—an individual for whom swordsmanship comes as naturally as breathing, wielding swords with a level of ease and mastery that would leave contemporary swordsmen awed.

Your overwhelming talent in all things tied to the sword leaves you bereft of the struggles most swordsmen would face, as you innovate upon sword-styles or techniques you see only once, whether they be face-to-face or even fictional, and improve them in ways tailored to your preference with this capacity exploding in potential if you have access to any form of spiritual or esoteric energies. With a mind so suited to swordsmanship as a whole, you'll never repeat an error in your swordsmanship after you've made it once, recognizing mistakes and easily rectifying them. Every swing of your sword guides you to greater heights, as it feels like no effort is wasted unless you purposefully make it so.

Of course, even all the talent under the heavens means nothing if faced with raw power that handily overwhelms your own, which is why your body rapidly hones itself to match your efforts depending on the style of swordsmanship you pursue; whether it be a style focused on fencing that quickly leaves you with a lean and agile frame that's capable of allowing you to deliver over a dozen strikes in an instant—to another style focused upon dealing great and mighty blows, giving you a powerful and toned physique that'd let you easily sunder entire cities with your attacks.

The path to the heavens is one wrought in steel, and you'll make your way there—one swing at a time.
addons.title: Nascent Sword Saint

objects.text:
You're the front-liner of your party—you're either filling in the place as the "hero" of your group or you're effectively someone of equal standing.

With great talent in picking up, creating, and enhancing all forms of swordplay, you are a true prodigy of the blade. Any flaws in your technique naturally correct themselves over time, and every sword user you observe—whether they realize it or not—becomes an unwitting teacher to you. You instinctively learn what to do and what to avoid, refining your skills with each passing moment.

You can reverse-engineer or recreate any sword-specific technique you witness, provided you have the capability to mimic it. As your mastery in swordplay grows, your body in turn grows as well—becoming stronger and faster, all to keep pace with your growing swordsmanship. If you happen to have any other supernatural powers, or even just mana or some other supernatural energy reserve, you will become better at both utilizing them and making or learning abilities and magics focused on swordplay.

This also grants you the ability to wield any sword safely, regardless of restrictions or drawbacks. It won’t allow you to do something absurd like swing around a building-sized sword while only being the size of a human and not having the strength to wield it, or ignore any energy requirements it may need to use its specific attacks. But it will make it so any sword that has drawbacks—such as sucking up your soul, driving you insane, or being restricted to a specific wielder—will be capable of being wielded by you at its maximum performance without any fear of repercussions.
objects.title: The Swordsman

addons.text:
You are no longer a crude and improvised warrior, surviving off pure wits and raw instinct. Now, you are a Monk—an individual who's dedicated themselves towards mastery of their mind, body, and spirit for combat. 

The battlefield is a stage that you've danced on countless times before, and have already seen all its tropes, making you navigate and adapt to it with the same grace, fluidity, and formlessness as water. Every motion is purposeful and effortless, every strike delivered with uncanny precision, and every dodge is calculated for an optimal counter. Furthermore, you've already mastered the foundations of Chi and have learned to harness it for a myriad of techniques and purposes. 

Some basic examples are enhancing your senses, physical abilities, striking rapidly at immense speeds, shattering concrete, or projecting Chi as a form of energy. At your peak, you'd be capable of producing similar effects to magic. Like turning invisible, manipulating the elements, imbuing Chi into weapons, manifesting your spirit as additional limbs or a spiritual creature of your own design, and even immortality. 

Your focus item also becomes a perfect conduit and amplifier for Chi, which can also fuel any other supernatural powers you possess.
addons.title: Nascent Monk
Magical Martial Artist
addons.text:
You've successfully combined a mage’s intelligence and problem solving, with the raw instinct and adaptability of a warrior, becoming a martial artist who wields magic as an extension of their craft.

Instead of chanting or elaborate preparations, you cycle through martial stances and handseals to cast magic. This simplified method gives you the freedom to perform magic at will and cast it nigh instantly. For example, you can conjure fireballs simply by punching, shoot arcs of wind by kicking, harden your body with a defensive stance, inflict aliments by hitting pressure points, and give yourself buffs through specific combinations of stances or handseals.

Furthermore each of these actions stockpile mana from both yourself and the environment, constantly building with each until you're ready to deploy it. Such as a martial dance based a dragon that not only keeps you moving on the battlefield, but builds the necessary mana to eventually unleash the equivalent of a Dragon's Breath by landing the ending motion. Alternatively, you can draw on this extra mana to further enhance your physical and magical power.

Your magic is powerful, but simple. As it forgoes the traditional principles in exchange for bursts of raw mana being expelled instantly. Resulting in simple technique that can be countered with mere interruption and it's own predictability, but as you grow, it will become more sophisticated and complex. To the point where every move you make is a potential spell waiting to be unleashed, or becoming a silent caster in your own right.

objects.text:
You’re the scrapper in the fray—the bare-fisted warrior, the unarmed juggernaut, or the wild card who breaks jaws when spells fail and swords fall. Whether as the lone fighter or the frontline brawler of your group, you embody the traits and aspects of the classic hand-to-hand martialist.

Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness, granting you overwhelming strength, speed, endurance, and explosive striking power. You fight with fists, feet, knees, elbows, and raw instinct—anything and everything is a weapon when you’re in motion.

What sets you apart beyond human limits is your adaptive close-quarters combat instinct. You learn as you fight, adjusting on the fly. Any martial artist or close-range combatant you face becomes an unwilling instructor—each punch exchanged sharpens your reflexes, improves your form, and evolves your style. You develop new techniques through combat experience alone, refining your body into a living weapon.

As the Brawler archetype, you are a master of unarmed combat and improvised weapons. Even without formal training, you can master martial styles or street-fighting tactics within a month of self-study—or sooner through direct engagement. You can shatter weapons with your strikes, break through armor with sheer kinetic force, and grapple beings larger than yourself using precision, leverage, and overwhelming momentum.

While formidable on its own, your potential escalates when paired with magic, mana, or other supernatural powers. Simply having a mana pool allows you to enhance your blows, reinforce your body, or channel elemental energy through your strikes. You can break enchantments with force alone, disrupt magical barriers through contact, and perform physical feats that border on the supernatural.

Your senses sharpen in close combat. You instinctively read tension, movement, and intent—allowing you to slip past guard, counter with brutal timing, or ignore feints and distractions entirely. Your resilience increases the longer a fight goes on, turning drawn-out battles in your favor.

To anchor your role as the ultimate Brawler, you gain a unique artifact: a pair of unarmed focus items such as gauntlets, hand-wraps, bracers, or something else of your choosing. These are indestructible, can be summoned back to you at will, and enhance your striking power and combat flow. They grow with you, evolving alongside your skill and strength, and serve as both weapon and armor in battle. These count as an OoP.
objects.title: The Brawler

addons.title: Rage Mage
addons.text:
You've pushed the boundaries of offensive magic beyond its limits, thus becoming a Rage Mage—a class that focuses on amplifying physical and magical power through raw emotion, especially rage. As a Barbarian, your compatibility with this class is a match made in heaven. 

You can cast magic through your emotions and will alone, cutting the normal casting time in half, and if you succumb to rage or any other intense emotions, it becomes near instant. Even with basic magical reinforcement, you can easily make deep craters in the earth, or wrestle a beast twice your weight class, with even simple elemental spells becoming classified as local disasters in their own right. A fireball can quickly become an inferno of colossal proportions that can easily burn a large sea of forest, a lightning bolt can pierce through reinforced barriers with ease, and weapons infused with your magic gain absurd levels of destructive power.

When you activate your Berserk State, this is increased exponentially, providing a fivefold boost to your physical and magical abilities at bare minimum. However, it becomes even more of a double edged sword, as your far more likely to be recklessness or have your mind clouded from the feedback loop of your rage and magic feeding off each other. With training this can be significantly mitigated.

You are still capable of using other forms of magic and can empower them with the power of Rage Mage, but will find a better affinity for learning and mastering offensive magic.

objects.text:
You are the juggernaut of the party, the walking tank who demolishes anything that threatens you and your allies, leaving behind a trail of bloodshed as the only evidence of the massacre inflicted in their name. 

Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness, granting you overwhelming strength, endurance, stamina, senses, and combat prowess. You are a monster on the battlefield, easily able to lay waste to a small army by yourself, and still have enough in the tank for more. Your body is just as durable to match, able to take just as much, or more punishment than you can dish out. Even the gravest of wounds can be shrugged off.

What sets you apart beyond human limits is your unparalleled brute strength and willpower. You simply don’t go down and push through all obstacles in your way, driven by your love of combat. You adapt as you fight, adjusting on the fly to find and exploit every opening that presents itself, using every opportunity to crush your opposition, simply because you can. This leads you to become an unpredictable engine of destruction that won’t relent until victory is within your grasp. Even if you do falter, your combat experience culminates into data you subconsciously analyze to improve yourself for your next battle. 

Your greatest ability is your Berserk state, where you enter a trance that makes you perform at your absolute best, fueled by will and rage. However, a lack of control in this state can lead to making you erratic and predictable.

As the Barbarian archetype, you are a master of both armed and unarmed combat. Even without formal training, your instincts and aptitude for combat guide you to turn the tide in your favor. While formidable on its own, your potential escalates when paired with magic, mana, or other supernatural powers. 

Simply having a mana pool allows you to enhance your senses, reinforce your body, strengthen your weapon, or channel elemental powers through your strikes. Allowing you to cause earthquakes, or breakthrough magical barriers with raw power alone.

To solidify your role as the ultimate Barbarian, you are granted a unique heavy weapon—from a greatsword, axe, club, mace, or anything similar. It is indestructible, can be summoned back to you at will, grows with you, and enhances your strength even further. It also counts as an OoP.
objects.title: The Barbarian

objects.text:
You are the ever elusive trickster of the party—the cunning thief who uses wits, sleight of hand, and dirty tactics to get what you want, the silent assassin who leaves no evidence of their deeds, or the ninja who became one with darkness itself. 

Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness, granting you exceptional speed, agility, dexterity, senses, and acrobatic ability. You are a master of stealth, espionage, infiltration, and theft in all forms. Moving with such grace and precision that others barely perceive you, and those that do have long lost sight of you.

What sets you apart beyond human limits is your unparalleled speed, dexterity, and agility. Able to move at superhuman speeds, leap hundreds of feet in the air, parkour through any obstacle, dodge or parry most attacks, and strike with deathly precision. Additionally, you are a master of trickery, able to read and exploit your opponent's weaknesses, plant traps for them, and escape various situations from bindings to a falling building unscathed.

As the Rogue archetype, you are a master of all tools related your profession—daggers, blades, kunai, shuriken, smoke bombs, lockpicks, etc. And have a toolkit of these items soulbound to you. Your expertise is great enough to utilize every one of these tools at their full potential, even when faced with overwhelming odds, allowing you to both control the battlefield and flee it without a trace.

While formidable alone, your potential grows when combined with magic, mana, or supernatural abilities. Simply having a mana pool allows you to become invisible, enhance your speed, stick to surfaces, silence your actions, or imbue your attacks with elemental power. 

To solidify your role as the ultimate Rogue, you are granted a unique weapon—either from or outside your toolkit. It is indestructible, can be summoned back to you at will, grows with you, and enhances your strengths even further. It also counts as an OoP.
objects.title: The Rogue

objects.text:
You are the charmer of the party, with the silver tongue and persuasion skills to keep enemies distracted, form diplomatic relations, extract information, or even tame a raging beast should the need arise.

Your physical abilities are twice that of a normal human with similar fitness, granting you exceptional acrobatics, agility, flexibility, and balance. You are a master in all forms of dance and performance. Moving with such skill and grace that even the most vile of beings will be captivated by your performance.

What sets you apart beyond human limits is your unparalleled charisma and stamina. Able to captivate a large audience and hold their attention nigh-indefinitely, persuade others to do favors for you, talk your way into getting a discount, and play with the hearts of others as you see fit. Additionally, you have the social skills and presence to achieve this, and an intuitive sense for how to employ them effectively. 

As the Dancer archetype, you translate all of your talents into combat flawlessly, moving as formless and fluid as water to turn the battlefield into your stage. Even without formal training, your expertise allows you to waltz through a small army, evade all of their attacks, and easily dismantle them with your unpredictable and alluring style. You work best with allies, able to support and bounce off of them effortlessly, amplifying both of your strengths and mitigating your weaknesses. 

While formidable alone, your potential grows when combined with magic, mana, or supernatural abilities. Simply having a mana pool allows you to cast various support and buff spells for yourself and allies, magic circles for both offense and defense, AOE spells for crowd control and debuffing your enemies, or imbue your attacks with elemental power. 

To solidify your role as the ultimate Dancer, you are granted a unique ranged, melee, and/or throwing weapon. It is indestructible, can be summoned back to you at will, grows with you, and enhances your strengths even further. It also counts as an OoP.
objects.title: The Dancer

addons.text:
You are no longer merely a knight bound by earthly oaths or fleeting loyalties to mortal kings. Your allegiance lies beyond the reach of crowns and empires—you serve the divine, whether god, demon, spirit, or something far older. You are a Paladin, an agent of higher powers, a living embodiment of their will forged in faith and tempered by steel.

Your knighthood remains the foundation of your being, but it has been transformed. The discipline, martial prowess, and honor that once defined you now serve a greater purpose, empowered by the connection you share with your patron. Whether your path is illuminated by holy light or shrouded in infernal darkness, you are a vessel through which divine authority flows. Your body has evolved under this sacred (or profane) influence. The physical conditioning you once achieved through rigorous drills and battlefield experience is now amplified. You possess strength and endurance that surpass even the mightiest of knights—able to shatter stone with your blows, stand unyielding against overwhelming force, and fight tirelessly without succumbing to fatigue. Your reflexes are sharpened to an unnatural degree, allowing you to react with supernatural speed, guided by the subtle whispers of your patron’s will.

Your skill in battle has also grown beyond the limits of mere technique. While you still wield traditional weapons with unmatched mastery, your strikes now carry divine weight. Blades and hammers glow with latent energy, your blows capable of bypassing armor, rending through magical defenses, or inflicting wounds that fester with sacred or cursed power. 

In return for this divine favor, you are both a champion and a servant. Your victories are offerings, your life a testament to the ideals—or the appetites—of the entity you serve. Yet, even in this, you remain a knight. Not sworn to a crown, but to something eternal. Whether you fight for the salvation of souls, the glory of war, or the spread of darkness, your path is your own.

You are the Oathbound. A Paladin whose power is written in the language of gods and demons, whose purpose is etched in rites older than kingdoms. And as long as you draw breath, your sword will never rest.
addons.title: Paladin

addons.text:
You are a knight without a lord, sworn not to crowns or banners, but to the path beneath your feet and the people you choose to protect. Though you have cast off the rigid hierarchy of feudal ties, you remain a knight in every sense—disciplined, relentless, and bound by a personal code shaped by your journey.

Mounted combat is at the heart of your skill. Your steed moves with you as if you share a single will, anticipating your commands before they are given. In battle, you fight from the saddle with unmatched precision, striking down foes while weaving through chaos with seamless control. Whether charging through enemy lines, executing precise maneuvers at full gallop, or leaping obstacles with effortless grace, you and your mount are one.

But the warhorse is only the beginning. Your mastery extends to all manner of mounts. You have learned to ride creatures beyond the reach of ordinary knights, from massive black wolves to colossal hogs to even war elephants. And when one mount is not enough, you take to the battlefield in chariots drawn by monstrous beasts. Thunderous bulls drag spiked chariots that shatter enemy formations. Packs of great wolves pull sleek, bladed carts, darting through battle like a whirlwind of fangs and steel.

Your armory is more than a collection of weapons and armor; it is a stronghold of possibilities. Within it lies not just arms and plate, but a grand ranch filled with steeds of every kind—warhorses bred for endurance, exotic creatures capable of extraordinary feats, and chariots built for speed or destruction. Here, your mounts rest, train, and recover, ever ready for your call. No matter where you stand, a simple thought can summon them to your side, armored and prepared for war. Like your horse, should they fall in battle they will revive in three days.
addons.title: The Black Knight

addons.text:
You have worn the mantle of knighthood for longer than most can imagine, through countless battles, endless campaigns, and lifetimes spent navigating both the brutal chaos of war and the subtle intricacies of noble society. Your title isn’t just earned; it’s carved into the very fabric of who you are. While others rely on training or talent, you rely on something far rarer: pure, hard-earned experience.

Your physical prowess has not withered with time; instead, it has been refined. Every movement you make is efficient, stripped of unnecessary effort. Your strength is not raw or explosive like the young, but steady, reliable, and deceptively overwhelming when applied with precision. You know exactly how much force is needed to break a shield, where to strike to topple an armored foe, and how to conserve your energy to outlast anyone foolish enough to believe age is a weakness. Your endurance has been tempered by years of sustained hardship—you can fight for hours without faltering, your body conditioned to endure exhaustion, injury, and pain without hesitation.

In terms of skill, you are a master without peer. Weapon forms that others spend years perfecting are second nature to you. The flow of battle is as familiar as breathing—you read opponents instinctively, predicting their movements not through conscious analysis but because you’ve seen it all before. Feints, tricks, and tactics that might catch others off guard are nothing new to you. Your reaction speed isn’t exactly any faster; it’s simply instincts honed through countless life-or-death encounters that allows you to predict your opponents. 

Your knowledge extends beyond the battlefield. You understand the politics of nobility, the strategies of war, and the subtle art of diplomacy. You know when to speak, when to stay silent, and how to read the intentions of those who believe themselves clever. Whether commanding armies or navigating court intrigue, your presence carries the weight of wisdom earned through victories, defeats, betrayals, and hard lessons. 

Most importantly, your instincts are your greatest weapon. They guide you without conscious thought—a passive awareness that alerts you to danger before it strikes, senses shifts in the rhythm of combat, and identifies weaknesses at a glance. This instinct isn’t supernatural; it’s the product of surviving what should have killed you a hundred times over.

You are not just a knight. You are the embodiment of what happens when a warrior doesn’t die young, when skill, experience, and sheer will endure beyond the fleeting glory of youth.
addons.title: Beware Of An Old Man In A Profession Where Men Usually Die Young

addons.text:
Your weapons, armors, and horse have been further enhanced through Battle Mage by making all of your equipment enchanted. Your weapons now make elements quadruple effective while being more durable, sharper, and even making wounds heal more slowly.

Armors have undergone a similar enhancement, but with a greater focus on defense. Any elemental enhancement applied to an armor is thrice as effective for defense or enhancement-type elements. The armors are also enchanted to resist up to medium caliber bullets, grant full coverage even if it doesn’t seem as such, and also boost your physical attribute by a factor of 2.

Your Horse now can be fully made out of an elements, like some elemental horse spirit, each elements granting different bonuses to your horse; a Fire Horse would be able to throw flame like a flamethrower, a Water Horse could let you dive underwater with no issue, a Lightning Horse could be faster than a F1 Race Car, etc.
addons.title: Knightly Battle Mage

objects.text:
You are a Knight, a master of combat, strategy, and discipline. Your skill with all melee weapons—swords, axes, polearms, maces—is unmatched, allowing you to cut through steel, shatter shields, and wield impossibly heavy arms with ease. Trained for both solo combat and battlefield command, you can break enemy lines, hold defenses against overwhelming odds, and adapt seamlessly to shifting combat scenarios.

Your body exceeds human limits. You wield massive weapons effortlessly, react faster than the eye can follow, and fight tirelessly for hours. In full armor, you sprint, leap great distances, and strike with enough force to break stone. Your endurance allows you to resist extreme conditions, withstand severe injuries, and recover quickly.

Beyond combat, you are an expert in mounted warfare, commanding your warhorse with precision in the chaos of battle. Your heightened senses detect threats before they emerge, and your reflexes allow you to dodge projectiles and counter attacks instantly. As a leader, you inspire troops, maintain discipline, and outmaneuver enemies with tactical mastery.

You live by a strict code of honor, loyalty, and justice, embodying the ideals of knighthood. Your presence commands respect, and your resolve is unshakable. Skilled in diplomacy and noble customs, you navigate both warfare and courtly life with authority and wisdom.

Your armory includes a vast selection of weapons and armor, each crafted for maximum efficiency. Plate armor provides superior protection, while lighter gear offers mobility. Both armor and weapons self-repair over time, ensuring they remain in peak condition without maintenance. Shields, survival tools, and battlefield equipment are also at your disposal.

Your warhorse is a powerful, battle-trained steed that scales with you, armored and unyielding in combat. It carries you and your gear effortlessly, charges through enemy lines, and executes complex maneuvers with precision. If slain, it revives in three days, ensuring it always rides by your side.

You are the pinnacle of knighthood—unstoppable in battle, unyielding in duty.
objects.title: Knight’s Valor

addons.text:
Though your time as a squire has passed, its teachings remain ingrained in every fiber of your being. The disciplined ambition, relentless curiosity, and raw hunger to improve that once defined your training have not faded with mastery but instead has deepened. Your evolution into a true Knight did not replace your foundations; it sharpened them, allowing those early lessons to now serve as accelerants for greater growth.

Your skill growth is accelerated by your foundational training. You improve more rapidly across all Knight-related disciplines, including combat, battlefield tactics, mounted warfare, and courtly etiquette. Whenever you would improve, refine, or master a skill related to knighthood, your progress is significantly faster, as prior learning compounds into advanced, instinctive expertise. Improving in one skill improve all others.

Additionally, all charisma- and leadership-based effects now scale directly with your physical and martial prowess, presence, and reputation. As your strength and battlefield capability grow, so too does your ability to influence, inspire, and command. Authority flows from you naturally, with respect coming automatically, loyalty being earned without effort, and your presence commanding, manifesting as an almost gravitational force. You no longer lead because you must; you lead because no one else can like you do.
addons.title: Foundational Learnings

objects.text:
You are a squire in training, someone who aspires to follow the path of a noble Knight. Instructed in all the subjects required of your station, under the tutelage of your great Knight—ranging from combat, strategy, tactics, mounted warfare, and even courtly matters of etiquette and intrigue—learning to navigate through these topics with growing skill, though lacking the polish that comes with experience. Raw as you may be, however, your breadth of knowledge still surpasses the common man.

Although not yet crowned a full Knight, you are no less inhuman. With coiled muscles that rival a war horse, you've gone beyond ordinary human limits—able to crack stone beneath your fist, keep pace with a galloping horse for hours on end, and weather punishment that'd be fatal for others, capable of surviving in all but the most extreme of conditions.

Yet what is a Knight without the presence that comes with it? As a knight-to-be, you carry a quiet charisma that commands respect, inspiring courage, bringing others together, and earning the loyalty of the men you work with. Though they know you're naught but a Squire, there's a potential within you that gives them hope—a promise with which they place their trust upon whilst amidst the field of battle.

And nor a Knight without their code of chivalry? Bound by oath, honor, valor, and loyalty, you are a follower of all that is true and an ally of justice. In your actions, you strive each day to embody these ideals; it is a harsh path paved only by an iron will, hardened discipline, and stoked by the flames of ambition.
objects.title: Knight's Squire

addons.text:
You were trained under the same merciless regime as the Root operatives of Konoha—raised without identity, emotion, or hesitation. Your body and mind were broken down and reforged in total silence, sculpted by discipline, brainwashing, and endless repetition. You were not taught to serve a master, only a mission. You do not question. You do not falter. You act.

Though the Root organization is gone, its legacy burns in your nerves and instincts. You operate as they did—silent, efficient, untraceable—but without a leash. Unlike others, you were cut loose before full indoctrination took root. You have no master. You are the last product of a system that no longer exists.

You have the combat instincts and conditioning of a Root shinobi—reflexes honed to react faster than thought, a pain threshold tempered by psychological suppression, and emotions dulled to keep your mind clear under pressure. You are trained in psychological warfare, field torture, counter-interrogation, and advanced stealth techniques. Your chakra control is precise and practiced to the point where you can perform basic jutsu with minimal hand seals. Years of mental discipline grant you resistance to most genjutsu below B-rank, as your detached psyche is difficult to ensnare.
addons.title: Root

addons.text:
You were born in absence. No name, no family, only duty. Yet where the path of the shinobi would have left you with nothing but death for company, the Lotus Sutra gave you a mirror. You looked into it and saw not just the weapon you were trained to be, but the person buried beneath the scars. Now, discipline and meditation move together as one. You are not a nameless blade. You are a monk whose silence carries weight, whose stillness holds power.

Your body remains a weapon, but it is no longer one that serves only death. Through monk training, you have learned to shape the same precision the shinobi used for killing into something more versatile. A strike can end a life, but it can also disarm, disable, or protect. Your understanding of anatomy and movement is now guided not by cruelty or necessity, but by clarity of purpose. You hit where you mean to hit. You hold back when you must. Violence becomes an instrument of balance rather than destruction.

Your breath becomes your anchor. Where the Sutra once gave you clarity, training has turned that clarity into strength. You can endure longer, recover faster, and strike with sudden bursts of speed and focus when the moment calls. Fatigue does not take you as easily as it does others, and poisons or pain are dulled against the discipline of your body. When you sit in meditation, your recovery quickens, granting you the renewal of a full night of rest in only minutes of meditation.

Stealth is no longer your only tool. Trained in the discipline of martial arts, you need not hide. Your stance makes it difficult for you to be knocked down or displaced. Your movements are measured, graceful, and unpredictable, making you hard to strike. Focused blows bypass armor and defenses. Attacks glance off as you parry, redirect, or absorb them with minimal effort.
addons.title: Monk Training

objects.text:
When you were born, you were given no name. You were given no love. You were given nothing but a duty, a purpose. To kill, to be killed. To serve the light, and be cast into the shadows. You are not a person, but a weapon forged in silence and suffering. You are a Shinobi with no name, no clan, no hope—only death walks beside you.

First among your skills is your Ninjutsu—a mastery of silence, deception, and precision. You move as smoke moves through cracks. You can vanish in plain sight, walking with steps too light to stir dust. You blend with your surroundings so completely that even the flicker of your shadow seems to lie. You move without a sound, even across gravel or broken wood, your presence never betrayed. Your eyes read the world in slow motion—every twitch of a muscle, every flicker of intent laid bare before you. You mislead your enemies with sound, drawing them away with the echo of something that was never there. When the moment demands it, you vanish in a sudden bloom of smoke or distraction, your silhouette already fading into the dark.

Second is your skill in killing. Not born of instinct, but of understanding. You know the body—its weaknesses, its limits, its end. You strike with efficiency. A cut is never wasted. A wound is never random. You know how to end a life in one movement, and more importantly, how to spare one long enough to make it hurt. Where others see violence, you see anatomy. Where others feel fear, you feel only purpose.

Last is the simplest: your body. Tempered in fire and pain, sharpened like a blade through years of unrelenting training. You climb where no path exists, your grip unyielding, your balance perfect. You can still your breath, slow your heart, and vanish into stillness like a shadow cast on stone. You endure without complaint, without hesitation. Your body is your only companion, and it has never betrayed you.
objects.title: Nameless Shinobi

addons.text:
You were born into silence, raised in duty, and hollowed by years of suffering until nothing remained but the shadow of a man. What was once discipline became absence, and what was once absence became power. When you took up the Formless Blade, that emptiness spilled beyond the sword, consuming every skill you had been forced to master. Now every art of the shinobi is filtered through the same void.

Your stealth no longer relies on shadows, stillness, or trickery. Instead, it functions like the Formless Blade: unreadable, without pattern or form. Enemies searching for you cannot predict your hiding places or anticipate your movements. They do not fail to notice you; they simply cannot conceive of you as being there. The world itself edits you out, leaving only emptiness where you stand.

Your killing techniques shift in form. Strikes do not merely target vital points; they are completely unseen and unnoticed, seemingly manifesting as if the body itself betrays the victim. An enemy cannot brace, flinch, or defend because your attack is invisible until it has already landed.

Your body, once tempered by pain and training, now moves as if it expends no effort at all. Climbing, balancing, holding still, or enduring pain shows no sign of your current state. Pain, fatigue, and breath vanish from an outsider's view. To observers, your body looks unstressed, even when enduring the impossible.

Through the Empty Hand, all that you are becomes hollow. You are not nameless, for even a name is something. You are not a shinobi, for even a role is something. You are not a swordsman, for even a stance is something. You are nothing, and in being nothing, you reflect everything. In this emptiness, no enemy can adapt to you, for there is nothing to adapt to. You are the mirror of fear, the reflection of mastery, the shadow that cannot be grasped.
addons.title: Empty Hand

objects.text:
A samurai of old was once said to be empty of all things—hollow of desire, emotion, and will. A warrior who reached Nirvana not through prayer, but through blood and stillness. From that silence, he gave birth to a sword style without shape, without signature—a blade that held no form, and in that absence, embodied them all.

You who have inherited this discipline do not carry the weight of aggression or pride into battle. When you draw your sword, you do not take a stance. You do not prepare. You simply enter a state of readiness so complete that it needs no structure. To the untrained, you look unguarded. To the trained, you look familiar—too familiar. For whatever form they practice, they see it reflected in you. Not mimicked. Not copied. Echoed. As though their style was born from yours.

Your blade cannot be tracked—not because it is fast, but because it gives away nothing. It does not warn. It does not announce. Your cuts appear only in the aftermath. You move without rhythm, without tension, each strike emerging from the space between moments. There is no wind-up, no shift of weight, no change in breath. Only the motion itself, pure and unburdened.

When you fight, you hollow yourself. You act without emotion, without hesitation, without thought. It is not instinct, but clarity. The kind of clarity that can only come from mastering every form, then letting them all fall away. Your body moves, your blade responds, and in doing so, you become the reflection of whatever your enemy fears most.

This is the Formless Blade—a sword style not defined by technique, but by its absence. A style that holds no stance, yet counters all stances. A blade that is not unseen by magic, but by discipline so refined it feels invisible. Hollow, like air. Real only when it strikes. With enough mastery, you can extend these effects to all things, not just swordsmanship.
objects.title: Formless Blade

objects.text:
The Standard Blade is an unadorned style born in the dust and blood of war camps, city gutters, and the weary paths walked by soldiers too poor to dream of heroism. It is not the style of the talented but of the desperate. For generations, it passed from hand to hand as a practical tool, a set of movements so brutally simple, so thoroughly honed, that even the untalented could, through sheer endurance, become deadly.

Your body has been shaped by thousands of hours of repetition, grinding out hesitation, error, and waste. Your strength allows you to strike with deadly precision at full extension, deflect heavy blows without staggering, and fight through exhaustion with mechanical reliability. There is no power wasted in your movement, no wind-up, no dramatics. You can split timber with a single cut, cleave through chainmail with the right angle, and fight for hours without slowing down. Practicing this style is monotonous to the point of madness. It demands a will beyond talent, a mind that can endure pain, repetition, and self-doubt. Those who persist must kill the part of themselves that longs for glory or spectacle.

The Standard Blade consists of a core of brutally effective fundamentals: downward strikes, horizontal cuts, direct thrusts, minimal but exact parries and a set of basic footwork. The sword is always kept in the centerline, the weight evenly distributed, every step designed to keep your kill zone within arm’s reach. It is a style of constant readiness, no dramatic changes in position, no sudden bursts of speed. Just smooth, inevitable motion.

What sets the Standard Blade apart is how deeply it is ingrained. The style becomes instinct. The moment an enemy twitches, your body knows how to respond. It is a style without ornament, but not without depth. In your hands, the same handful of movements becomes thousands of solutions.

The Standard Blade shifts seamlessly between offense, defense, and reaction, never committing too early, never overreaching. Against a fast foe, you become a wall, tight guard, short cuts, unyielding. Against a defensive enemy, you press forward, steady and suffocating. Against the unpredictable, you wait with quiet tension until their opening appears and the fight ends in a single, clean motion. It is this adaptability that gives the Standard Blade its terrifying presence on the battlefield. It is not a collection of techniques. It is a mindset: endure, respond, kill.

Though rooted in Eastern swordplay with its mindfulness, flow, and posture, the Standard Blade echoes the brutal efficiency of European martial systems. Your footwork is grounded and linear. Your strikes follow practical lines, not flourishes. Your defense relies on leverage and positioning, not agility or tricks.

Despite its simplicity, the sheer fluidity, the seamless transition from movement to movement, and the eerie stillness between actions all give the Standard Blade a haunting elegance. Spectators often mistake it for a high-level style. Non-combatants see it and speak of its grace, failing to realize the simplicity beneath. Even less experienced warriors, watching or facing it for the first time, assume they are witnessing advanced swordplay.
objects.title: The Standard Blade

objects.text:
You were given the skills of AEGIS CQC (Advanced Engagement Ground-Interdiction Styled Close Quarters Combat), a combat style designed by the Coalition of Mankind for every soldier under its command. These skills were made to let you move through chaotic or dangerous environments while keeping control over your body, the enemy’s body, and the space between you both.

You learned to move and strike with biomechanical precision in any gravity condition. Every motion is built to maximize output with minimal input and recoil, using leverage, timing, and anatomical targeting to transfer force cleanly into the opponent.

You also have training for different gravity conditions. In low gravity, you stay low with arms spread for stability. In high gravity, you take smaller steps and drive power through your legs and spine.

You refine tight, energy-efficient movement that channels force through your frame with precision, while forcing the enemy to waste theirs. In close quarters, you switch to grip combat. Instead of striking, you wrap a limb or section of the enemy’s body and use their motion against them. If they pull, you twist and roll to wrench joints. If they push, you drop your weight and collapse their base.

You trained for this even against non-humanoid forms. Standard drills include holding down targets twice your size, redirecting four-limbed attacks, and locking unstable shapes mid-movement. The goal is always the same: stop their ability to move, strike, or escape.

Your attacks are short, sharp, and targeted. You strike at nerve clusters, joint anchors, and motion-critical systems. Hits to the side of the neck, thigh, or shoulder base cause immediate motor loss or unconscious collapse. Against enemies that can’t feel pain, you strike to disable: stomping ankles to lock legs, hyperrotating elbows, or compressing the thorax to short out movement.

A trained user can fracture metal bone through joint-locks alone, rupture thick muscles with a rebounding strike, or send a half-ton target flying with a redirected shove. They could also cause temporary paralysis with a palm strike or drop a larger foe using one controlled blow to the spine or servo root. Every motion is designed to convert structural tension, rotation, and recoil into overwhelming force at close range.

This combat skill does not depend on having an augmented body, although it is exhausting to use without any augmentations, and it can easily be applied with any form of augmented or enhanced body, be it via internal or external enhancements. It can also incorporate weapons with relative ease, although its focus remains on close-quarters combat. The style was made for augmented bodies fighting other augmented or alien bodies across all types of environments and gravity levels.
objects.title: AEGIS CQC

addons.text:
You aren’t just a gladiator—you are the champion of the colosseum, the apex predator in a pit of chained wolves. Still a slave, yes—but one gilded in praise, power, and fear. Your name echoes through bloodstained sand and marble walls, spoken in reverence and dread. You didn’t climb here through mercy or favor. You carved your throne from the corpses of the hundreds who stood before you—rivals, beasts, slaves. Blood was your currency, and death your language.

Your body’s every movement is the culmination of endless battle and the instinctive genius of a born killer. You no longer fight—you perform, seamlessly weaving brutality with calculated grace. Your strength is monstrous, capable of ripping off armor and shattering bone. Your blows carry weight beyond muscle—guided by intuition, intent, and raw killing will. Even unarmed, you’re a walking execution.

You perceive openings before they exist, exploit weaknesses before they form. Your reflexes border on precognition; your body acts with a will of its own, guided by a mind that sees combat not as chaos, but as pattern and opportunity. You are fluid, reactive, and unrelenting—an embodiment of violent perfection.

No weapon feels unfamiliar in your grip, no fighting style feels foreign. Even improvised tools become instruments of death, enhanced by your uncanny intuition. Your mere presence on the battlefield disrupts enemy rhythm, your reputation alone enough to instill hesitation and fear.

And when you step into any space—be it arena, battlefield, or narrow alleyway—something changes. A pressure falls over the air, thick and heavy, impossible to ignore. It’s the weight of countless lives taken, the echo of crowds screaming for blood, the scent of sand soaked in iron. Your presence is war, the remains of a battlefield.
addons.title: Champion of the Colosseum

addons.text: You have walked the path of blood for a long time. You have entertained the masses not with skill alone, but with death, agony, and spectacle. In the colosseum, you didn’t fight—you performed. And now, that performance never ends. Your Killing Intent has matured into something worse than fear: recognition. Even strangers recoil from you instinctively, haunted by deaths they never witnessed, tormented by memories that aren’t theirs. Your aura now bleeds into perception itself, a hallucinatory force that overlays your every action with scenes of past violence. Your movements—no matter how ordinary—manifest violent echoes in the minds of those who witness them. When you raise a hand, they see a throat crushed. When you step forward, they feel the weight of a killing blow bearing down. When you speak, it sounds like it’s from the center of an arena, every word drowned in phantom roars. Your entire existence becomes a violent spectacle projected into the minds of the living. The longer you keep this effect active, the stronger it gets. The stronger it is, the more it weakens the will of those affected. This in turn makes your Killing Intent exponentially more effective, pushing even strong-willed enemies toward paralysis, madness, or death. Against those already weakened—or those naturally vulnerable to fear—the degradation accelerates quickly. Their ability to fight back degrades, thoughts blur, and resistance begins to die long before their body does. In places soaked with death—battlefields, killing grounds, bloodied arenas—the effect intensifies much faster. These locations act as conductors for your aura, letting the illusions grow rich and tangible within seconds. This is especially so if you actively participated in causing the death in the area. If you possess Champion of the Colosseum the effect is boosted drastically. The audience returns. Even in silence, the roars of the crowd can be heard echoing in the minds of your victims. They see not just what you’ve done—they hear it celebrated. Applauded. Every illusion becomes louder, brighter, more real. For those caught in the full force of your presence, it is as if they are trapped in a living arena, their death not just imminent—but cheered.
addons.title: Blood Theatre

addons.text:
A slave who plays at being a knight—that is all they see. A mockery clad in steel, a beast in borrowed honor. To them, you’re nothing more than a lowly thing dreaming of dignity, groveling for a light you were never meant to touch. You are a tool dressed in glory, a disposable thing used to inspire fear in enemies and amusement in your masters.

And so they send you into the jaws of death. The hopeless fronts. The cursed strongholds. The missions from which no one returns. Where the enemy is too many, too monstrous, too far gone. You are the one cast forward when others hesitate. And you go because there is nowhere else to go. Because you must. Because something inside you refuses to die quietly.

That desperation burns. You return each time—wounded, broken, near death—but more. Hardened. Sharpened. Changed. Pain becomes familiar. Loss becomes your teacher. And every time they think they’ve thrown you away for the last time, you rise again, dragging yourself out of fire and ash with blood on your hands and something worse in your eyes. 

Your fighting style is a contradiction—brutal yet refined, dishonorable yet mesmerizing. You strike with the precision of a knight and the ruthlessness of a caged beast. You feint and parry with elegance, only to pivot into a savage headbutt, a bladed elbow, a kick to the knee. You fight like one who has been trained to dazzle the crowd as much as kill the foe. Gladiators were never just warriors—they were entertainers. You learned to kill with flair, to make your enemy’s death look like art, to draw fear from style and savagery alike.

In your hands, every weapon becomes more than a tool—it becomes a performance. A sword stroke doubles as a flourish; a shield bash becomes a spectacle of force. You are unpredictable, shifting from polished knightly technique to gutter-born brutality without warning. Your enemies never know what’s coming next—a master’s stroke or a killer’s trick.

Your body, already pushed beyond human by both origins, reaches monstrous thresholds. You do not just wield heavy weapons—you overwhelm with them. Your strength spikes in short, brutal bursts, allowing you to rip shields from arms, tear weapons from hands, and shatter armored limbs at close range. Your pain tolerance borders on inhuman—you remain standing with wounds that should end fights. You do not falter. You endure.

Your armor and gear no longer remain standard. Plate still gleams, crests still shine, but beneath that knightly polish lie edges, barbs, and hidden hooks. Strikes tear deeper than they should, pulling flesh, mangling limbs, leaving enemies screaming instead of slain. Yet through all of it, you still look the part. Regal. Composed. Your blood-wet steel catches the light like a hero’s blade, even as it drips with ruin. There is nobility in your silhouette, and horror in your wake.

Even your warhorse bears the change. Armored like a knight’s mount, but something darker now runs beneath its skin. Its barding carries subtle spikes, its hooves strike like hammers, and its breath steams in unnatural bursts. It no longer waits for commands—it moves with you, fueled by the same violent instinct. It doesn’t just ride—it hunts. And when you charge, it’s not a noble gallop—it’s judgment made flesh.
addons.title: Slave Knight

objects.text:
Once, you were nothing but property—torn from your past and thrown into chains, offered as bloodsport to slake the boredom of emperors and crowds. You were not a soldier. You were meat, thrown into the arena to die for the entertainment of others. But you didn’t die. You learned. You endured. And in the crucible of blood and pain, you were reforged into something far more dangerous than your captors ever intended.

Each fight carved skill into your bones. Each wound tempered your resolve. You were denied proper weapons, so you learned to make any object deadly. You were denied armor, so you learned not to be hit. Every kill taught you something: how to read your enemy, how to move before they do, how to survive when all odds are against you. You were trained by pain, refined by repetition, and hardened by necessity.

Now, your body is a weapon unto itself. Your muscles are dense and battle-scarred, capable of explosive strength and inhuman endurance. You fight with brutal instinct, reacting faster than thought, striking harder than should be possible. Blows you land—whether with fist, foot, or steel—hit with unnatural force and precision, as though the very world recognizes your intent to kill. Weapons in your hands seem to find their target more easily; even poor tools, when wielded by you, feel like extensions of your will.

You possess an unshakable survival instinct. Your senses sharpen under threat, allowing you to detect danger before it strikes. Your body resists fatigue, pain, and injury longer than it has any right to. You move with the efficiency of someone who has fought for their life a thousand times, wasting nothing. You are chaos honed into control, brutality refined into instinct.

You are a gladiator—born in chains, forged in blood.
objects.title: Gladiator

addons.text:
Legends speak of eight ancient immortals who danced through battle with the elegance of spirits and the power of gods, each embodying a unique philosophy, form, and fighting essence. Their drunkenness was not weakness, but divine method—transcending the boundaries of form, mind, and strength. Through your own experience, be it with alcohol, narcotics, or vision-inducing toxins, you have touched the edges of their myth and gained fragmented enlightenment.

You now move with the full expression of the Drunken Eight Immortals style—a complete and chaotic martial system that blends fluid motion, unpredictable rhythm, and sudden, explosive force. Each Immortal’s essence influences a different aspect of your fighting: staggering evasions, low sweeps, off-balance strikes, deceptive footwork, acrobatic tumbles, and unorthodox use of the body’s weight and momentum. 

From empty-hand counters to wild, flowing weapon forms like the drunken sword or fan, your style is equal parts graceful and erratic, giving you mastery over feints, reversals, and disorienting movement. At your most intoxicated, you become a living echo of the Eight—each Immortal’s technique bleeding through your form in flashes of unpredictable brilliance.

However, the deeper you tap into their power, the more your body and spirit begin to crave the altered state that connects you to them. The intoxication that once opened the door becomes a habit, a growing dependency. You can still fight sober—but it never feels quite the same.
addons.title: Eight Drunken Immortals

objects.text:
You are a master of the Drunken Fist, a deceptive and fluid martial art rooted in ancient Chinese traditions and perfected through chaos. Though its techniques can be employed with a clear mind, the style reaches its peak when your mental state is altered—typically by alcohol, but other intoxicants or disorienting mental states can also serve as a conduit.

Drunken Fist is a calculated blend of misdirection, rhythm disruption, and unorthodox movement that masks deadly precision beneath the guise of instability. To the untrained eye, you may appear clumsy, off-balance, even vulnerable—but in truth, every stagger and stumble is a feint, every slurred sway hides a strike, every fall is a setup for a fluid counterattack.

Your movements bend the expectations of traditional combat. You roll with strikes instead of blocking them, you strike from prone or inverted positions, and you use your momentum to unleash power from unexpected angles. An opponent trying to read your intentions finds only confusion, facing a combat style that refuses to follow predictable patterns.

While a sober practitioner can mimic the erratic flow of Drunken Fist, true mastery requires surrendering to chaos. Intoxication doesn’t impair your combat—it unlocks the raw, instinctive reactions and deep muscle memory your training has burned into you.

As your mind becomes more unmoored, so too does your body transcend natural limits. The more altered your mental state, the more your strikes distort the laws of human capability—blows that once staggered become enough to crack stone, kicks that once swept legs now send foes flying. At your peak, in a state of complete intoxicated clarity, your fists carry enough force to shatter walls, your movements defy physics, and your presence on the battlefield is a whirlwind of impossible momentum and unstoppable chaos.
objects.title: Drunken Fist

addons.text:
Is it any surprise that you, who have no name and no purpose beyond being a blade to kill, were taught a technique that can kill its user? You were forged not to live, but to end lives. Trained without identity, honed without mercy, you learned the art of moving without sound and striking without restraint. In time, your body bent, broke, and reshaped itself to house something more than a human spirit. You became more than a killer. You became the Hitokiri Mu-na, the nameless manslayer. No record. No legacy. Only death in silence.

As Hitokiri Mu-na, your physical training as a Nameless Shinobi has been rigorous, using and breaking your body many times with Body Break that your baseline strength now matches, and in some cases exceeds, that of a typical Body Break user while they’re fully active. You can punch through steel plating, tear through reinforced concrete, or launch an enemy across a room without sacrificing your body to do it. Actually using Body Break with your body can allow you to punch through meter-thick reinforced steel, tear through steel walls and even throw a man across a football field.

Your anatomical mastery, honed from years of silent assassination, allows you to manipulate your body with impossible control. You know exactly how much pressure a joint can take before it snaps, how far a tendon can stretch before it tears, and how to reconfigure your body in the blink of an eye for maximum force with minimal trauma. You can contort into unnatural forms while keeping key structures intact, redirect your momentum mid-air using a broken shoulder as a pivot, or allow your hip to dislocate during a slide to reposition under an enemy’s guard, then re-engage with a killing blow from beneath. In essence, you can use lower-level techniques of Body Break with no damage, and higher-level techniques cause less damage overall.

Your stealth now augments the impossible violence of your attacks. You can engage in full-speed combat while remaining nearly silent, able to collapse bones, tear muscles, and break steel without a sound. You strike from angles the human body should not allow, and you do so without alerting a single soul. Your enemies are crushed without a sound, your feet never stir dust, and your silhouette never lingers long enough to be feared.

Your body, already marred by countless trials, has transformed into something terrifying. Years of shinobi conditioning combined with Body Break’s grotesque demands have resulted in a physique that defies biology. Muscles twist in layered cords around the bone. Veins pulse beneath scarred skin, ridged with hardened calcium deposits. Your forearms bear horn-like spurs that deflect blades and tear through armor on contact. Your posture is hunched, always tense, always prepared to collapse or explode into motion. Your body has long been adapted to Body Break, further lowering the damage it causes.

Even your recovery is faster. While Body Break users may take a week to recover from their injuries, your meditative training and precise self-inflicted trauma mean your body heals in half the time. You know how to stabilize damage as you cause it, distributing strain, limiting tissue collapse, and isolating trauma with internal pressure control. In stillness, you can accelerate healing by slowing your heartbeat, conserving energy, and entering a state of near-total metabolic suspension, taking only a day to fully recover.
addons.title: Hitokiri Mu-na

addons.text: If Body Break was a martial art not meant for humans, then Body Destruction is one not meant for superhumans. To use this style without any form of regeneration is instant death. First comes Breath, with it Weightlessness. Your lungs expand until they burst, not just themselves but your other organs, forcefully expanding your lung capacity within your now ruined chest cavity. Your speed has increased as you are no longer weighted down by your organs. Next comes Bloodflow, with it Fire. You sway back and forth as your blood acts as a pendulum, moving in unnatural, inhuman ways. Blood pumps at such speed that its friction begins to burn away your body and burn those around you. Third is Musculature, with it Charge. To move, a muscle requires the connection of nerves and an electric pulse. Even if your nervous system is completely destroyed, you not only move but every strike causes your target’s muscles to spasm. Finally is Bone, with it Shrapnel. Your strikes hit with the force of an explosion. Bone that no longer has a use is expelled and breaks apart, each fragment scattering like dozens of small, sharp pellets striking with the blast of a shotgun.
addons.title: Body Destruction

addons.text:
By mastering both Titanbound and Body Break, your transformation has changed completely. As the Valsalva maneuver hits its peak and your muscles begin their hyper-dense expansion, you initiate a precise sequence of architectural self-sabotage. You deliberately micro-fracture the epiphyseal plates of your long bones. These controlled faults are then wedged apart by the expanding muscle mass and flooding fluids. Your bones lengthen in agonizing, audible increments, granting you an additional 6-12 inches of height mid-transformation. Additionally, you rupture the deep fascial sheaths surrounding your major muscle groups The swollen muscles then explode into the new space, expanding your girth by nearly double the original technique's limit. Lastly, you dislocate major joints, wrenching them into a new, wider set. The ball-and-socket is forcibly remodeled into a broader, shallower arc of motion.

This results in your height pushes up to 9 feet, a grotesque monument of strained sinew and exposed, swollen muscle. Your skin, stretched to translucency over new mountain ranges of flesh, hardens into a substance resembling layered granite. The sheer power of this form is catastrophic. You are able to uproot small trees, crumple steel plate armor like parchment, and deliver punches that generate concussive shockwaves.
