However, when the transformation ends, you catastrophically deflate. Bones that were wedged apart now settle and muscles that burst their confines retract. You are left a gaunt, trembling, ravenous wreck, needing to consume the caloric equivalent of a week's feasting in a single hour. 

Through the Body Break healing, your micro-fractured growth plates fill with denser, more mineralized bone matrix. When the healing is complete, you stand a permanent quarter-inch taller. Your skeletal structure is heavier, thicker, more resilient. The torn fascial sheaths heal back looser, more elastic. You regain your normal proportions, but they are now supercharged. Your chest is broader, your back wider, your limbs carry a heavier, more powerful set. You gain a permanent 5-10 pounds of pure, functional muscle mass. This process is cumulative with every time you enter this state, with less and less gains as your baseline increases.
addons.title: Giant’s Flesh

objects.text:
You have mastered a combat style that is not meant for humans. It is an art of pure, reckless aggression, forged to kill monsters and supermen, a style that shatters the body with every movement and tears past the limits of flesh without hesitation.

The essence of this unnamed style is the deliberate, brutal breaking of your own body in motion. The technique forces your body to bend, twist, and violently reshape itself in ways that should be impossible. Strikes are thrown with reckless abandon, twisting joints far beyond their limits, ripping muscles mid-swing, and even fracturing bones to create temporary new pivot points. You wrench your limbs into unnatural arcs, collapse your own structure to dodge or reposition, and forcibly contort your frame into shapes that no human anatomy should endure.

The way your body reshapes itself in motion is monstrous to witness. Your muscles bulge grotesquely, your joints swell unnaturally, your bones seem to shift visibly beneath your skin as you force your body to coil and recoil through sheer force of will. In the heat of combat, you contort, collapse, and whip yourself around like a weapon that’s barely holding itself together. Your blows land with terrifying force, capable of punching through reinforced steel, splintering stone walls, and crushing bones like paper. You move in bursts of violent, snapping power, lashing out from impossible angles and blind spots that no opponent could reasonably guard—your strikes bending around shields, slipping beneath defenses, and crashing into vital points from grotesquely contorted arcs.

Your physiology allows you to heal the torn muscles, broken bones, and ruptured joints without any permanent damage—but the damage stacks quickly. You can die long before your body finishes repairing itself if you push too far. Even then, the healing process is by no means fast, taking at least a week of bed rest. Should you survive the toll of this style, your body will not just heal—it will grow exponentially stronger. Bones thicken, muscles fortify, and your threshold for pain and damage surges beyond what most could comprehend. 

Originally forged as an unarmed martial art, it flows easily into weapon use. Axes, swords, chains—whatever you wield becomes an extension of your violently reshaping frame. You drive weapons through impossible trajectories, hurl yourself into crushing spins, and use broken limbs as new hinges to deliver strikes from angles no opponent could predict.
objects.title: Body Break

addons.text:
The Wingless Phoenix is a fused cultivation method that combines the destructive mechanics of Body Break with the metabolic cultivation process of The Lowest Path. It operates on a closed loop of destruction and adaptation, using self-inflicted injury as a direct catalyst for accelerated growth.

When using Body Break, the practitioner constantly tears muscles, fractures bones, and dislocates joints in combat. Every instance of bodily destruction is metabolized as cultivation fuel. Torn muscles, bone splinters, ruptured ligaments, and the biological stress they generate are processed by the Lowest Path’s unique physiology. This results in the rapid generation of Blood Qi, as well as permanent reinforcement of the body. Each wound creates a cycle of injury → stress → Blood Qi → recovery → mutation. Every battle, every injury, becomes cultivation and an investment into power.

The Wingless Phoenix accelerates the growth curve of The Lowest Path significantly. Where The Lowest Path normally requires prolonged physical exertion to metabolize impurities, Body Break guarantees such extreme exertion with every combat exchange. This creates a feedback loop where the body constantly wrecks itself, metabolizes the stress into strength, then adapts so it can endure greater wreckage the next time. The process naturally drives exponential progression. Bones grow thicker after each fracture, muscles denser after each tear, and joints more flexible after every dislocation. Over time, the body mutates into an inhuman anatomy capable of withstanding and amplifying the grotesque mechanics of Body Break without immediate structural collapse. 

The presence of Blood Qi intensifies this cycle. As impurities and stress are metabolized, Blood Qi automatically condenses in muscle and bone, reinforcing them mid-combat. Under heavy exertion, the practitioner’s body swells with red heat, skin steaming as impurities burn away. Emotional surges or moments of desperation can trigger violent Blood Qi resonance, causing temporary but drastic amplification of size, strength, and resilience. This transformation increases destructive potential at the cost of extreme strain and accelerated injury accumulation.

As the body adapts, the contortions and pivots of Body Break become sharper and more devastating, while the Lowest Path ensures those same injuries push the body to evolve. Over time, the user’s physiology mutates into something barely human, with steel-like bones, layered muscle fibers, and joints that function along unnatural axes.
addons.title: The Wingless Phoenix

addons.text:
The cultivation world has always believed that the laws of growth are set in stone. To walk without spirit roots is to crawl at the feet of gods, and to regress into primal form is to borrow power briefly from a forgotten past. Yet in uniting these two heretical arts, a new way is carved. 

Upon acquiring the Original Path, your Blood Qi draws from the combined genetic memory of your entire ancestral line, causing it multiply by multiple magnitudes, filling every fiber of muscle, every sliver of bone, and every drop of blood with dense reserves of vitality. The increase is not linear but exponential, meaning that the longer you continue training and enduring strain, the greater the compounding effect becomes.

As Blood Qi accumulates, the ancestral resonance embedded in Regression to Origin begins to stir. Your body begins to mutate in subtle, constant ways. The Regression form gradually imprints itself onto your natural state. Muscle, bone, and skin adopt permanent traces of your ancient lineage, creating a physique that is more primal, more resilient, and more instinctively honed than an ordinary body. Over time, the line between base state and Regression erodes until you exist in a hybrid condition at all times.

When you then choose to fully enter Regression, the amplification is significantly greater than before. Instead of merely awakening traits from early ancestors, your body resonates with the image of Spirit Beasts. The resulting transformation exceeds mundane biology, granting attributes of the supernatural. This can manifest as scales tougher than steel, talons sharp enough to tear through armor, or regenerative organs that repair wounds at impossible speed. The form ceases to be limited to instinctive predation and instead becomes an expression of perfected survival fused with raw spiritual force.

Over time, this process leads to the acquisition of traits normally reserved for cultivators born with specialized physiques. You may, for example, develop an internal furnace physique that resists fire, a crystalline bone structure capable of storing energy, or a marrow that generates inexhaustible blood. Unlike innate physiques, however, these are not bound by exclusivity. Your body can reconcile conflicting mutations by brute adaptation, allowing you to accumulate multiple physiques at once, even those considered contradictory or impossible in orthodox cultivation.
addons.title: Original Path

addons.text:
Your Blood Qi and your physical blood are fundamentally the same energy in different states of refinement; blood is the raw material, and Blood Qi is its ultra-condensed, purified essence. When you perform the Drowning Blood Demon Blade technique, you can deliberately burn a measure of your pure Blood Qi instead of shedding your blood. This results in a violent transmutation, generating Demonic Blood Qi. It possesses all the corrupting, frenzied properties of standard Demonic Qi but is profoundly different: it carries the overwhelming physical density and biological imperative of your Blood Qi. This makes it not just an energy for projection, but a tangible, crushing force that grants your attacks immense kinetic weight and allows your blood-mist to solidify like molten iron.

This Demonic Blood Qi will inevitably soak back into your flesh as you fight, forcibly tempering your body with its corrosive power. This accelerates your physical adaptation, making your tissues denser and more resistant, but also infuses them with a permanent, growing demonic resonance, which can alter your personality and affinity with Holy things. Additionally, Demonic Blood Qi is a temporary, spent energy; you cannot use it to fuel further cycles of this technique. It is a one-time conversion. Your base Blood Qi remains your only permanent resource and the sole fuel for this explosive power. You can double this up by both using Blood Qi and shedding your blood for maximum effect.
addons.title: Sword Demon

objects.text:
The founder of this technique was born with unusably poor spiritual roots—barely able to absorb or sense qi. After offending an elder, his spiritual roots were shattered completely. Denied the use of qi and robbed of his spiritual roots, he built a method to cultivate without them.

This method bypasses spirit roots entirely. It does not involve drawing in qi through meridians or storing it in a dantian. Instead, it uses the fact that the body still absorbs qi indirectly through breathing, food, and the environment. Through using this method, the amount of ambient qi absorbed increases. However, due to the nature of this process, it lacks any qi refinement and without it, the energy that enters the body is loaded with impurities: spiritual toxins, environmental residue, and chaotic elements that would cripple or kill a normal cultivator.

The body stores these impurities as biological stress—stored in muscle, sinew, bone, and organ tissue. Every movement becomes harder, heavier, more painful. From here, progress comes from relentless physical action. Strength training, endurance drills, and intentional overexertion force the body to metabolize the impurities, breaking them down like fat and using them as fuel to increase power, density, and durability. The more effort you apply, the more of the “sludge” is burned into strength.

As you train, your muscle grows denser, bones tougher, nerves sharper. The immune system becomes hyper-reactive, healing is accelerated under stress, and internal organs gradually adapt to toxins, heat, cold, and injury. Pain thresholds rise, and reaction time shortens. As impurities are processed, the body becomes increasingly efficient, able to convert physical motion into usable force. With time, users gain near-perfect control over muscular and nervous responses, regulating breath, heartbeat, and even blood flow with conscious effort.

Over time, the body’s metabolic system mutates to generate Blood Qi—a crude, violent form of internal energy created by pressure, heat, and pain, not to be mistaken for the qi with the same name generated via bloodlust or murder. Unlike traditional qi, it cannot be circulated or projected easily. Instead, the Blood Qi will condense into muscle and bone. This stored power can, with extensive practice, be used to grant your body the ability to interact with spiritual forces. It can also be used to empower physical activities, such as regeneration, due to its innate affinity with biological systems.

You start off with the foundational methods of training and how to initiate the process, as well as the ability to train in the technique regardless of the world’s spiritual environment.
objects.title: The Lowest Path

addons.text:
Did you know what else Stickmen are famous for? Their incredible learning ability. They have a natural talent for understanding and mastering both everyday and supernatural subjects — as long as they have the chance to study them.

Now, you possess this amazing trait too. Anything you choose to learn will come to you much more easily. Even without teachers or instructions, you'll naturally improve through trial and error.

Subjects you're interested in — or areas where you have a natural affinity — will come even easier. For example, if you're learning something you feel neutral about, you'll reach the skill level of a master (someone who has trained for 10 years) about ten times faster. But if you're studying something you truly enjoy or are naturally gifted at, you can reach that same level up to twenty times faster.
addons.title: Stickman Talent

addons.text:
Your Stickman combat mastery has evolved beyond hand-to-hand fighting. You've integrated weapons into your combat style without losing speed, precision, or flow. You can use any weapon — from swords, bamboo staffs, and throwing knives to hand hammers, chains, and guns — with the same efficiency and control as your bare fists.

You can move, shoot, and reload in perfect sync with your motion. You fire accurately while rolling, jumping, or running along walls. You instinctively know how many bullets are in your gun at all times, even with unfamiliar or alien weapons. Guns, rifles and other firearms become part of your style.

When you pick up any object, you immediately know how to use it effectively as a weapon. A chair, a chain, a pipe, or a broken bottle — whatever it is, you can wield it with the skill of a seasoned master.

You also know how to use the environment as a weapon. Walls, doors, tables, loose bricks, broken glass — everything around you becomes a potential tool of destruction. You automatically spot objects you can use in a fight and apply them in creative, effective ways — like Jackie Chan on steroids.

You can switch between weapons and fighting styles without losing momentum. Transitioning from a blade to a firearm mid-fight costs you nothing. If anything, it makes you harder to predict.
addons.title: Stickman Weaponry

objects.text:
Do you know who Stickmen are? These simple figures made of sticks became famous not for their appearance, but for their phenomenal mastery of martial arts — a level of combat so refined it transcends mere fighting and becomes a form of true art.

Now, that same mastery is yours. Your hand-to-hand combat skills have surpassed the limits of human capability. You move with such precision and grace that every step, every strike, every dodge seems choreographed in advance — part of a perfect fight. Everything you do serves one purpose: to win — efficiently, swiftly, and beautifully.

Your style is built on lightning-fast reflexes, instinctive intuition, and absolute control over your body. You can fluidly shift between stances, unleash endless combo chains, parry attacks with millisecond accuracy, and strike from impossible angles. You can study other martial arts at lightning speed — even learning during combat by observing your opponents, adapting and evolving your fighting style on an intuitive level. You're capable of battling dozens of enemies at once, remaining unharmed as if you can sense their moves before they’ve even made them.

Your body is a weapon. Every hit, every kick, every motion is charged with lethal efficiency. You use your surroundings as an extension of yourself — walls, objects, even your enemies become part of your style. You fight with such precision and elegance that it doesn’t look like combat; it looks like a dance of destruction — cold, flawless, and utterly mesmerizing.
objects.title: Stickman Mastery

addons.text:
You possess the true, complete body of the Forgotten Human King, whereas your earlier abilities were only fragments of what his physiology truly was. You have the stabilized, perfected, primal form that the King bore naturally from birth.

This permanently sets your baseline body to the primal template normally accessed through Regression to Origin. You no longer shift into that form, it is your default physiology. Inner Body Strength then refines this primal structure with perfect developmental chemistry. Because your childhood and maturation occurred inside the Regression to Origin physiology, your bones grew under peak mineralization conditions, your muscles formed with extraordinary fiber density and contractile quality, and your organ systems reached efficiency levels that normal biology cannot match. In totality, this means your current body is far stronger than it would be even if you had transformed via Regression to Origin.

Lastly, instead of normal hormones regulating your body, your baseline chemistry uses the King’s Super Hormones. These hormones interface with both your ancient genetic pathways and your perfected development, allowing your body to operate at a heightened biological equilibrium at all times. In addition, Regression restores ancestral hormones long lost by your race, and your endocrine control allows those ancient compounds to merge with their modern counterparts. This produces a third category: fusion hormones, unique chemical messengers created from interacting ancient and modern endocrine systems.
addons.title: The High Human

objects.text:
You have mastered a technique created by the Forgotten Human King, who once ruled in pursuit of the primal strength buried within all living beings. Rejecting the constraints of civilization, he delved into ancestral memory and blood resonance to forge a method that awakens a being’s original, hyper-evolved form.

When activated, this technique draws from latent genetic energy, triggering a near-instantaneous transformation. The user’s body mutates to reflect traits from ancient bloodlines, physical attributes surge, enabling feats far beyond the norm. For an average human, their speed surpasses a cheetah’s, strength rivals an elephant’s, and reflexes sharpen to near-predatory levels. Senses heighten such as hearing, smell, and low-light vision all become animalistic, and instinct overrides thought in high-stress moments. The boost scales based on the user’s baseline capabilities.

The transformation’s appearance is race-specific. Humans may grow broader and more brutish, evoking early hominids. Lizardfolk harden with thickened, sharper scales and gain reptilian agility. Elves become more sinewy and silent, eyes sharpening and ears lengthening, tuned for precise ambush. Though forms vary, the function is constant: a physical state focused solely on survival and dominance.

In addition to general physical enhancement, the technique amplifies any inherent biological traits specific to the user’s race, ranging from climbing instincts, venom glands, echolocation, or regenerative factors will also be intensified. In rare cases, it may even restore a dormant or lost ability discarded through evolution.

This transformation drains stamina both upon activation and over time.
objects.title: Regression to Origin

objects.text:
You are a Samurai, a warrior of discipline, devotion, and deathless resolve. Trained from youth in the art of the blade and the spirit, you embody the code of Bushidō: honor, courage, loyalty, and righteous wrath. In combat, you are a storm of steel and silence, a master of the duel and the battlefield alike.

Your swordsmanship transcends mundane technique. Each strike is honed through thousands of repetitions; each movement, an expression of perfect control. Whether wielding a katana, nodachi, or yumi, no matter its material, your strikes cut through plate armour and deflect enemy blows with pinpoint precision. Against a single opponent, you are near-unbeatable, capable of reading their intent before they act and countering with lethal speed. In war, you move like a blade through flesh, targeting commanders, disrupting formations, and turning chaos into opportunity. In combat, time seems to slow. In this state, you can parry attacks faster than sniper bullets, strike through openings no eye could see, and quickly finish battles in a single, decisive moment.

Your spirit is not silent. You channel your Kiai into your strikes, your presence, and your will. When focused into your strikes, they gain a sudden explosive force that can cleave through meter-thick steel or deflect a weapon the size of a man. When used to reinforce your movement, it gives bursts of speed, capable of being faster than the average man can perceive without telegraphing any intent. With a shout, you can shatter fear, break the resolve of lesser foes, or reinforce the courage of allies. When unleashed at its fullest, your Kiai can disrupt enemy techniques mid-execution, halt an incoming charge, or paralyze a single target with overwhelming spiritual pressure.

When you fall, you do not die easily. Your devotion can bind you to a final vow, one ultimate act, fueled by every ounce of Kiai you have left. Be it a final blow, a last stand, or the defense of a charge, you fulfill it in defiance of death itself. Only once it is complete may your spirit rest.

Beyond battle, you are a student of philosophy, poetry, calligraphy, and strategy, raised not only to fight, but to represent your clan with discipline and grace. You navigate courts with measured poise, mastering the arts of conversation, tradition, and refined expression as keenly as swordplay. Through brushwork, verse, and ritual, you cultivate your soul, refining your spirit as surely as the blade; where training your body hones your will, these practices deepen your inner strength. In all things, bearing, speech, and duty, you embody the honor of your lineage, each action a reflection of the generations behind you.
objects.title: Samurai Spirit

objects.text:
The will of all soldiers enduring throughout history, from the Great Wars to the Wars from here and now, lives on through you.

You gain and experience the memories of all soldiers from every country involved in any "modern" conflict, throughout history and any potential alternative histories. From the beginning of the 20th century to the headlines of today, you've been there and done that. These memories span from the moment of enlistment or recruitment to the time of discharge or death of the particular soldier. You retain memories from all parts of the conflict, the good, the bad, the winners, the losers, the skills, and the let-downs: all of their great deeds and atrocities in the name of glory, victory, or ideology.

This offers you an extensive wellspring of combat, administrative, civilian, and strategic skills to call upon gained from the myriad of lives of the countless soldiers of the world.

Yet, it has a cost: As a result of your acquired memories’, you suffer from mental contamination from experiencing these memories, for as with any memory, it leaves a mark on someone’s psyche… 

Note: The power’s definition of ‘Soldier’ is essentially anyone who willingly or unwillingly fights in an armed conflict as part of an organization, meaning insurgents, rebels, and even conscripts or drafted soldiers are within your reservoir of memories.
objects.title: Ares, Legion of One

addons.text:
Due to the effects of The Lowest Path, your body has begun to restructure itself into something reminiscent of the legendary strength of Kintarō himself. As your body strengthens through the brutal crucible of The Lowest Path, the constant refinement, adaptation, and regeneration carve into you a system of flawless instinct. Over time, this process awakens the Golden Body Style from within as a natural state of being. Your body, molded through suffering and rebirth, learns the rhythm of Kintarō’s motion until it performs the Golden Body instinctively, much like Kintarō.

This process also alters your Blood Qi. The violent, crude current of Blood Qi has been tempered by the same internal harmony that governs your body, reshaping it into something luminous and transcendent. Within your body, this Blood Qi has taken on the appearance of molten gold. It moves through your veins like liquid sunlight, glowing faintly beneath your skin, as if your blood were infused with the essence of dawn. The new Blood Qi acts as a resonant amplifier. Every motion you make, every contraction of muscle, every impact, is echoed through this golden current. The Blood Qi vibrates in phase with your body’s natural resonance, multiplying the force behind each strike, and ensuring that none of your energy disperses as waste. Your Blood Qi’s resonance also allows you to maintain internal equilibrium under almost any condition. Temperature extremes, poison, or foreign energies entering your system are harmonized or destroyed automatically. The golden current flows continuously, preventing buildup of toxins, dissipating heat, and dispersing shocks. This includes the lingering impurities of The Lowest Path itself, your system metabolizes it automatically into usable vitality immediately without the needed stress and strain.
addons.title: Golden Kintarō

objects.text:
The Golden Body Style is the instinctive technique that allowed Kintarō, even as a child, to wrestle bears, shatter boulders, and move with the force of nature itself. His supernatural power was the result of his body instinctively using this style, drawing out the full potential of every muscle, bone, and nerve with perfect unity. While you currently are unable to use it instinctively as he did, you could reach his level with time and training.

When in use, your muscles fire in perfectly timed sequences that ripple through your body like a wave of raw energy. When you punch, every fiber from your heel to your fingertip fires in flawless synchronization. The force doesn’t stop at your fist, it travels through bone vibrations, perfectly aligned with your skeletal structure. This creates internal resonance that amplifies your impact, turning your body into a living tuning fork of destructive energy. For example, with a simple palm strike, you can crumple reinforced steel, with internal resonance compounding the damage deep within.

The style also includes the ability to generate devastating power in minimal space. Your body stores kinetic energy in tightly coiled muscle fibers, tendons, and ligaments, then releases it in a precise, instantaneous burst. Instead of needing space to build momentum, your entire body acts like a drawn bow, always ready to snap. Even with only an inch of space, you can unleash your full-body strength.

Lastly, instead of losing momentum or suffering recoil after an impact, you convert nearly 99 percent of that force back into your current movement. You can punch a concrete wall and feel no jarring backlash or pain, just a surge of energy flowing back through your body, fueling your strike further. In this way, you defy Newton’s Third Law.
objects.title: The Golden Body Style

objects.text:
Once a master jouster was crippled by injury and could never again ride or couch a lance. Broken in body and spirit, he wandered through weapons until finding the rapier; slender, delicate, everything a lance was not. Yet a revelation struck him: “was not the rapier a lance scaled to the hand?” Mocked by others, he devoted himself to proving this “truth,” creating a sword art that transformed rapier into lance and man into steed.

The art begins with a tense rhythm of footwork, restless and coiling. Each step winds muscle and breath together, storing potential like a steed pawing before the charge. The fighter narrows his awareness to a single line, from rear heel to sword’s point, where all energy aligns. Then comes the Linear Charge: a full-body eruption. The rear leg lashes back like a horse’s kick, launching the body forward as one continuous vector. The sword’s point in turn carries the full weight of proper jousting lance. Though the speed is human, every ounce of energy travels cleanly through the thrust, creating an illusion of mass using pure mechanical unity.

The attacks of La Lance d’Hommel draw from jousting rather than fencing, each strike a human echo of the mounted charge. The standard Course Droite drives straight for center mass, while the Ligne de Tilter angles up or down like a tilt pass, slipping through high or low parries. Le Passage carries the body past the target in one smooth continuation, momentum flowing seamlessly into readiness for another assault. Even at close range, half-lunges detonate stored tension in an instant, striking like a shattered joust. Defense is minimal, taking the form of glancing parries that clear just enough space for the next line of attack. Whether a blow lands or not, the rear leg steps through, keeping the fighter in motion, forever coiling for another charge.
objects.title: La Lance d’Hommel

objects.text:
Your body has undergone metamorphosis, a transformation attainable only by those who have reached a profound level of martial enlightenment.

Like others who have attained this exalted state, you have completely broken down the body you were born with and rebuilt it into one perfectly attuned to the practice and expression of martial arts.

Every trace of wear and tear accumulated over the years has been flawlessly repaired, and every impurity expelled. Even at the genetic level, your DNA has been refined, every non-beneficial deviation corrected, every flaw remade into a stronger, more efficient, and more perfect version of itself. 

For some martial masters, this process even restores their youth, returning them to their physical prime and greatly slowing the aging process thereafter, allowing them to live for centuries, often up to two hundred years, before showing signs of aging again.

As a result, all of your physical capabilities have increased tenfold. More importantly, your potential and talent have ascended beyond measure, granting you vastly greater returns from any form of training you pursue.

You now possess an extraordinary affinity for all forms of supernatural energy related to life force, such as aura and Ki, allowing your body to host immense quantities of it. Moreover, the energy you cultivate is of a much higher caliber than that of those who have not undergone metamorphosis.

It is highly recommended that you take other martial arts powers alongside this one to make the most out of it.
objects.title: Body Metamorphosis

objects.text:
You have mastered a combat style born from desperation and refined through relentless experience. It was first conceived by a lone guardian, a faker who was neither the strongest nor the fastest, but who survived encounters against those who vastly outmatched him. Devoid of overwhelming strength or supernatural talent, he relied on cunning, adaptability, and the hard-earned wisdom of countless near defeats. Over time, his understanding of battle crystallized into this art.

At its core, this style rejects rigidity and predictability. You keep your body loose and unguarded, every joint free to move in any direction. Instead of maintaining a fixed stance, you flow continuously; shifting your weight, adjusting your balance, and changing posture in ways that appear casual, even careless. Every limb is ready to strike, deflect, or redirect at a moment’s notice. You learn to attack and defend from awkward angles, to twist momentum into opportunity, and to never be trapped in a single form.

The defining trait of this style lies in exposure. To any skilled warriors, you seem unguarded; your torso bare, your stance uneven, your guard low or wide. Every apparent mistake is deliberate. These are the “open hands” of the style: calculated invitations that bait your opponent into striking what they believe is a weakness. The moment they commit, they fall into your trap. You read their intent, redirect their power, and counter with precision born of timing and control. Each feigned vulnerability conceals a response, each opening a lure designed to provoke the exact strike you’ve prepared to punish. You use their instinct against them, turning their confidence into downfall. This relies on awareness, composure, and an almost intuitive sense of timing. A single hesitation can undo you, but a single breath of calm control can end a fight.

While you can fight barehanded, this style is most naturally expressed through weapons, especially bladed ones. Short swords, curved blades, and knives suit your movements perfectly, allowing you to transition from attack to counter, offense to deception, without breaking rhythm. In addition to the principles of this style, you will also gain experience with all manner of weapons, blunt, edged, and polearm alike, enough to adapt to whatever the battle offers.
objects.title: An Open Hand

addons.text:
Having mastered the twin arts of forced evolution and systemic overclocking, your body has become a living siege engine. You have learned the ultimate perversion of the circulatory system: to weaponize your own vitality, turning your blood into a ballistic medium and your heart into the cannon that fires it.

The repeated cycles of extreme pressurization from Heartdrumming, combined with the radical, trauma-induced strengthening from Body Break, have transformed your myocardial tissue to be layered with calcified, bone-like reinforcement, and your valves now operate with the percussive force of hydraulic pistons. This way, your heart can beat with such force that it could pulverize stone within your chest cavity if not for your equally fortified ribs, resulting in your Heartdrumming being many times stronger and easier to use, with less points of failure. Your bone marrow, supercharged by constant demand for rapid healing, produces blood cells at a monstrous rate. The plasma is thicker, richer in clotting factors and oxygen-carrying compounds, giving it a viscous, almost syrupy quality under pressure. 

The true mastery lies in directing this pressurized fury. Using the same brutal, micro-traumatic control that lets you fracture a bone for a new pivot point, you can tense and contort musculature around major arteries and veins, creating temporary, high-pressure channels. By deliberately tearing a precise fissure in your skin and underlying tissue (often at the fingertips, palms, or even through old wounds you keep "unsealed"), you form a biological aperture. You control its size and shape by flexing the surrounding mangled tissue, allowing for anything from a needle-like jet with the force capable of cutting steel to a wide-area spray that can knock back a small group of people. 

This of course has its drawbacks. Each shot is a controlled, self-inflicted hemothorax. You feel the dizzying drain of vital fluid and the chilling cold that follows. Using it while already injured is exponentially more dangerous, as the body's priorities conflict between external defense and internal collapse.
addons.title: Crimson Cannon

objects.text:
A secret technique developed by a martial master of the Wulin—detailing a method to control and align the rhythm and beating of one’s heart in such a manner as to grant the user superhuman abilities through the precise, accelerated, and unique drumming of their heart. Hence the name.

Once activated, the user undergoes a physical transformation—as their skin takes on a deep red hue from the intense circulation, their body shall exceed its natural limits, with every muscle being forcefully awakened and driven into overdrive.

Even a novice can obtain the strength of four men, while true experts can wrestle charging bulls or shatter tree trunks with a single kick. In this state, the user’s senses also sharpen to an incredible degree, rivaling those of the keenest animals.

However, a single mistake during execution can cause the heart to rupture from the strain. The immense pressure and blood flow will also exacerbate the effects of any wounds or poisons on and within the user’s body. Whilst prolonged usage risks severe heart problems. Upon deactivation, users often suffer dizziness or, in extreme cases, lose consciousness immediately.
objects.title: Heartdrumming

addons.text: You are a born martial artist, and therefore, you can understand the founder better than anyone. You are no neophyte that's merely slightly healing more than they damage; you are akin to the old master at the end of his life. With just a slight bump, you can restore limbs and organs as well as cure sickness and illness. Not only that, but you can even restore and heal telomeric degradation, undoing some of the effects of old age, though even the first master could not do more than prolong life; eventually, time will catch up. Though, you might even go further beyond and truly be able to punch away old age. However, the grandest of all is the fact that you can revive the recently dead, provided the brain and body are relatively intact and that they haven't been dead for longer than two days at most.
addons.title: Master of Love

addons.text: The philosophical mindset that is foundation of the Fist of Love, the wish to strengthen and raise others up, is fundamentally at odds with your nature as a being whose very survival depends on the consumption of human beings. How can a being born to be a predator of man uplift them? This internal conflict has led you to reach deeper into the nature of the Fist of Love and its inversion of damage, and entwining it with your need to consume man as well as your wish to aid them developed a technique to fulfill both needs. The result of which is a technique that in nature functions as a ritual performance to bestow the Blessing of Sæhrímnir on your target, making consumption not the end, but a new beginning. Initially your mastery of the technique requires you to meet a manifold of conditons, those being that the technique can only be begun at or after dusk, that the target must not be killed in combat (meaning they must either agree or be slain so swiftly they cannot fight back), before being prepared and eaten by you, with the restrictions that their bones cannot be broken and their souls not devoured. Once these conditions are fulfilled, then destruction is inverted to restoration as the next morning at first light the target is restored not only to life, but perfect health, their bodies having in fact undergone a strengthening refinement proportional to how much of them was consumed. The will remember their deaths, but the memories will hold no trauma to them, seeming almost dreamlike. As you grow more skillful with the technique, the requirements that must be fulfilled are loosened as the benefits to the target grow in potence. If you are a Master of Love, you can devour your target completely and refine them body, mind and soul, not only empowering them but cleansing them from all ills, from soul-damage over negative karma to even a unavoidable Fated Death, for death has come and released the target from its mortal fetters.
addons.title: Blessing of Sæhrímnir

objects.text:
In roughly 1600 BCE, in the land that is today known as Southeast Asia, there existed a warrior with a problem. You see, this warrior loved combat; he loved risking his life and growing stronger; he loved overcoming challenges. But he had grown too strong. Every fight he entered, whether against men, animals, gods, spirits, or demons, ended far too fast; indeed, they ended in a single strike. And like that, his passion dried up, not because he finally lost or was bested, or even because his love for fighting died, but because none he ever met could really give him what he wanted: a great fight. However, instead of languishing in depression over this fact, he set out to work. He didn't know much about anything other than fighting, and he couldn't make alchemical concoctions or use magic.

So he set out to use what he knew to fix his problem: martial arts, of which he was a grandmaster a hundred times over. If he could not find someone he could not beat in a single hit, then he would either have to weaken his blows and disrespect his opponent's efforts, which is unacceptable, or find another way.

What he created was his magnum opus, a martial art that inverts the principle of damage. Indeed, instead of causing damage using this technique, it fixes it. Not only that, the damage does happen, but only for a fraction of an instant, before it is fixed. This means that getting hit using this technique is subtly strengthening, as though you just worked out. The amount of strength gained through this depends on how hard one is hit. For some reason, the body doesn't seem to need to use any resources to fix itself, as the martial art itself provides all one's opponent needs to heal themselves fully.

Having created this technique, which he named after his love of fighting, he once more set out into the world, not to find strong opponents to share this love with, but instead to create them. He never again took a life, as he never needed to, and he never again wanted for opponents for very long. He died old and happy, surrounded by pupils, allies, and rivals.

In time, this martial art was lost as it was deemed useless in the coming wars that sprang up after the consolidation of human civilization. However, now you are the heir to the long-lost school of the Fist of Love. Wear such a badge with pride, for you carry an ancient legacy of the love of combat.

You start out as a beginner, your attacks being able to heal a bit more than they inflict damage. However, with time, you could progress to much the same level as the founder himself, where even a poke could restore lost limbs as well as cure illness and disease. This art can also be taught to others; indeed, two opponents both knowing and using this against one another in combat is among the most effective training regimes in existence.
objects.title: Life-Giving Fists of Love

addons.text:
Now as you explore the world you will come across Powerups from the Mario series, from the Fire Flower all the way to Princess Peach's True Radiant outfit transformation as any powerup seen in the Mario or Mario related series can be found.

Not only that but the selection of powerups will expand according to your skills and powers as new powerups will be created, any transformation you have will generate a powerup that will allow instant transformation or increase power as all powerups stack on top of each and transformations.

Even the Invincibility Star can appear, however the odds of it appearing are very low and while you could possibly hold onto other powerups for as long as you want the Invincibility Star's power fades away after 60 seconds relative to you regardless of whatever power you have or what you do.

A small knock on effect of this power is that you find it easier to learn and develop new skills for careers, allowing you to go from a normal Brooklyn Plumber to Hero of a Kingdom and then become a fully licensed medical Doctor and Olympic Athlete.​
addons.title: Showtime Super ★ Star!

addons.text:
As you explore the world at Sonic Speed you will come across power ups and collectibles from the Sonic franchise in Item Boxes, everything from protective auras that come with differing additional effects, heal pods able to restore living and robotic beings, to floating hints to help you on what you need to know to a selection of weapons which includes swords and guns. You can, optionally, come across the Wisps as well with you deciding if their really there (and if anyone else can see them) or just another pick up to collect with you able to channel the power of the Wisps directly into yourself or through your items and equipment.

But one of the main draws are the Rings you can now collect, the most basic use for these rings is that they act as an additional layer of defence where instead of taking damage you lose a number of rings based on the damage you would have taken with you having a second to recollected those rings before they fade away. And said Rings can act as an extra source of fuel to power your abilities or technology without needing to draw on other internal or external sources, however the more power intensive the ability or item is the more rings will be used. One normal ring could run a fuel intensive car for a little over a day non stop before being used up. 

And beyond that you can condense these rings once they're collected to create more powerful variants such as the Power Ring which can enhance you physical ability and even your powers depending on the number of rings condensed into it, or create Travel Rings which can open portals to habitable worlds with the destination being a place you've been before otherwise the other end will be random.

Furthermore your Mobian form is much more malleable than before with you able switch between your original appearance and your Mobian Form instantly, now you can alter your Mobian form whenever you want like it was an avatar in a character creator letting you adjust it's appearance and clothes to whatever you like. Even giving yourself tails, wings or spiked knuckles like Sonic's friends that all work like the originals allowing you to punch apart rocks and fly.​

Due to the mixture of powers you've gained a Shaker effect that lets you determine how your speed affect the world around you, so you can catch people and carry them off at top speed without any negative affect to them, or allowing those near you being able to run just below your current speed in order to keep up.

Strangely enough, you have come into possession of three crystal medallions each that can transform into musical instruments in the form of a triple headed guitar capable of firing energy blasts and being used as a melee weapon, an electric keyboard able to be played with a strap over your shoulder or on legs with a much more powerful energy attack, and a drum set able to cause powerful quakes. Along with these mystical instruments you have the skills needed to play them professionally. They have bonded with you and can be summoned or dismissed at will.
addons.title: Freedom Fighter Extraordinaire!

addons.text:
Not only does the blood of Master Assassins run through your veins but so too does a lineage of Heroic Master Thieves belonging to the Cooper Clan.

The merging of an Assassin's stealth and the movement of Jump Hero allows you to sneak around areas much more quickly than any of those before you, scaling buildings in the blink of an eye, merging into the shadows to remain hidden even if your carrying around a tool larger than yourself and nimble enough to use said tool to pickpocket guards on high alert.

You not only possess all the skills and abilities Sly Cooper has used, along with mastering more from the Cooper Lineage through Knowledge, but also those of the Cooper Gang such as Bentley's Intelligence and Innovation, Murray's Driving Skill and Strength, Dimitri Lousteau's Diving and Forgery, The Guru's Mysticism, Panada King's Martial and Explosive expertise, Penelope's expertise with piloting and use of drones. You could fill the role of any heist as a one (wo)man team of professional thieves.

This fusion of bloodlines has also expanded your Eagle Vision allowing it to remain partially active at all times to help you pick out paths you can traverse safely, detect traps such as pressure plates or lasers and find opportunities of thievery which usually tends to make criminals the 'victims' of your thefts.

Finally you gain your own personalized thieves attire complete with a Domino Mask with a Stranger Effect to keep your identity hidden, a hat that can be summoned and de-summoned at well that happens to double as an explosive when prep and the iconic cane of the Cooper Clan to aid in thievery and movement with the ability to be summoned at will so as to avoid climbing and having to hold the thing in your mouth. All of these items can be treated as one Object of Power as their part of a set.
addons.title: Thievius Raccoonus

addons.text:
You gain full knowledge of Eco and technology from the Jak and Daxter series, from the Precursors and their study of Eco to the modern day where flying pirate ships sail the skies as desert raiders fight for survival. You also gain Jak's ability to use Eco to enhance yourself and your equipment, Eco will appear dotted around areas waiting for you to pick it up to use then or store or later use.

Green (Energy of Life) that heals you and your equipment with the option to use it to heal others or restore items.

Blue (Energy of Motion) which gives increased movement speed and reaction, selective attraction to pick up loose items of use and power all technology or even supercharge it.

Red (Essence of Strength) which triples your physical attacks along with providing increase durability and temporary aura to redirect long range attacks, but those that are sufficiently strong can bypass it.

Yellow (Essence of Power) which give the ability to shoot energy blasts from your hands and modify you attacks with the energy and channel the Yellow eco through equipment to increase the power of projectile weapons with explosive force.

Dark Eco has the power to warp, mutate and destruction, giving access to a werebeast form with dark eco sparking around you and damaging everything you don't care about protecting or leaving alone. However you are immune to it's corrupting effects.

Light Eco is the rarest form of eco with the essence of Balance, Purification and Restoring, the one from which Green, Blue, Red and Yellow come from​
and with them reunited it grants a x4 times boost to all of the four Ecos and your other skills and abilities while granting you flight. Due to it's nature of Purification and Restoration it can cure those suffering from possession or curses.

No matter where you are Eco will be found where and when it's needed.
addons.title: Eco Champion

addons.text:
You gain full knowledge of the technology seen in the Ratchet and Clank series with you having enough skill that you could make a functional star ship out of scraps on a mostly deserted world on your own, on top of that you gain the Lombaxes affinity for machinery making all your tinkering around 1.5 times faster with a similar boost in quality​

As you explore the world and go through Trail Areas you will come across armour sets [Three pieces, Head, Torso and Legs] that will grant you boosts individually and even more as a set. To help you collect these you gain a massive wrench like tool that can be used for any form of Tinkering despite it's size and a robotic companion that can ride on your back.

Your Robotic buddy can either have it's own personality, house an AI of your own creation or an AI companion or an extension of yourself. Regardless with time they will grow and evolve into being able to do whatever Clank and Kit can do in Ratchet & Clank canon.
addons.title: Stellar Example!

addons.text:
Embrace the title of “Maximum Pink”, for you have gained all the base abilities of the adorable puffball himself, Kirby. Optionally, you may change your form to resemble one of the many creatures within the Kirby Mythos, or of your own original design.

You can slide, guard, breathe underwater (and space), hover in the air, spit gusts of air (or water bullets if submerged), and share your vitality with others through mouth-to-mouth. <small>Yes, there are other ways to do this. Don’t make it weird</small>.

Along the way you’ll find items like Food to restore to your health or provide buffs, Ability Scrolls to learn new copy ability techniques, pickups like Cannons, mounts in the form of Animal Friends, Treasure Chests filled to the brim with goodies, Warp Stars that fly you to any destination almost instantly, and the list goes on. 

You’ll also encounter many of the enemies present in the Kirby franchise, from humble Waddle Dees to mini-bosses like Kracko, even have a crack at Whispy Woods all the way to Morpho/Galacta Knight. But if you look real hard, you’ll find some doors with a glowing star at the top, with differing shapes, colors and sizes for what lies ahead. You’ll understand what these mean at a glance to know what you’re in for.

Entering these doors will make you either complete a mini-game, fight a boss, do a fetch quest, boss rush, or other challenges appropriate to your current skill level. Successfully completing these will offer immaculate rewards such as; the Star Rod, Miracle Fruit, Triple Star or the Master ability. But wait, there’s more. Some will grant you exclusive copy abilities you can’t get anywhere else, or even brand new ones that’ll be too enticing to pass up
addons.title: Right Back at Ya!

addons.text:
As you zoom across the world at blistering speeds, you'll encounter many items, setpieces, enemies and collectibles from the Freedom Planet games. From life petals that restore your health, crystal shards as currency, shields that make you immune to elements, star cards that unlock secrets, and treasure chest filled with exchangeable goodies. 

Your abilities as an Avalican now develop into a full moveset matching Lilac, Carol, Milla and Neera in capability. Your moveset will start with attacks, movement options, and one signature ability that fits you. These can expand and change overtime. You also have a defensive ability called the Guard, which can double as evasion or a parry. 

You also have an easy time finding shops that sell various potions, charms, badges, power-ups, boosters, and other attachments that grant passive abilities, empower you, and even hinder you in exchange for great rewards, especially for when you fight bosses and complete challenges within dojos and the Battlesphere.
addons.title: Sparking Comet of Avalice

addons.text:
Your fighting instinct has melded with your platforming ability to give rise to something new, as your grab bag of powers has expanded to include Side Scroller Beat 'em Ups.

First, your punches, kicks, and general attacks can tear through solid steel. Your attacks can hit multiple enemies, so long as they are within arm's reach of one another, as if their hitboxes were overlapping. Your durability has been decently improved, allowing you to take a beating from a mob of enemies roughly equal to you in strength, getting back up after being knocked down. This gives you more time to turn things around or to make a hasty retreat.

Next, you will come across items that can aid you in fights, dotting the area—whether they're trash cans, sports equipment, bikes, or anything you can get your hands on. When you wield these items, they gain a Striker effect, where they will not break nor bend when used in combat. They last for a few good hits before losing this effect and returning to normal. While different items will give different effects, they all increase your attack power, with the weakest increase being 10%.

Whenever you get into fights, you notice there is a sort of barrier around your immediate area that limits the number of enemies that can be active in it at once, protecting non-combatants from any and all harm. However, enemies much stronger than you can force themselves into the barrier, removing the enemy limit.

As you defeat enemies, they will drop coins, with stronger foes providing more upon defeat. These coins are stored in a special Extra Dimensional Wallet that you alone have access to. You can use the coins saved in the Wallet as normal currency, with it transforming into what you need when you withdraw it—any conversation favoring you, drawing upon what something is really worth and taking advantage of any deals.

However, there is a special place where these coins can be spent: A Secret Shop.

A Secret Shop is a hidden location that can appear anywhere, with only a symbol you recognize revealing where it's hidden—from a secret passageway in the middle of the city to a cave hidden beneath a tree or in an old spaceship. In these Secret Shops, you are able to buy a wide range of things: skills both mundane and specifically for you, items that can begin appearing in the areas you're fighting, increases in your base abilities like strength and jumping ability, and even powers that enhance your fighting ability.

All of these powers are weak, with the strongest being worth no more than 5SP. But when used together to enhance your own fighting ability, they can be the key to turning the tide of a fight. Some examples of the powers you can buy here include short-use bullet time, doubling your own speed for 10 seconds, and summoning specialized weapons meant for a minor advantage against certain enemy types. However, the list of powers you can buy increases with whatever other power you possess.
addons.title: Beat'em and GO!

addons.text:
Your platforming ability has been taken to the EXTREME! Traversing the world, you'll find your leaps longer, your jumps higher, and you're able to use elements of the environment as ramps to jump over wide gaps with a running start, wall-running from a standing start without effort, and trampolining off objects to jump far higher into the air with zip lines to breeze through areas. Even your enemies are not safe from this effect, as now, when you damage enemies, they will either be more likely to be knocked back or you can use them to jump high into the air and more.

But there is another aspect of this power—something far more sporty! You are able to summon pieces of sports and exercise equipment whenever you wish, with your powers being enhanced through them, as they, in turn, enhance you. Bicycles, skates, unicycles, or whatever your preferences are, are able to increase your speed, and skateboards offer greater mobility and weapons if need be. Weights allow you to hit harder and slam into the ground, and even go-karts can be summoned at will, able to take a lot of punishment during high-speed needs.

And you are able to summon the needed equipment and uniforms if you and others want to take part in team sports. Taking part in these games will both strengthen bonds between those involved while helping them to better understand one another, sort out their differences, and offer an avenue of training for your abilities and powers—whether it's using aura to enhance your speed or kicking a ball so hard it ignites as it wheezes through the air. Should you not, or wish not to, have anyone to play with, you can summon up NPCs to take the other roles as you train.

As you go around doing the extreme, you can do tricks that can give you a minor boost to all of your attributes for a short time or until you get hit. The more impressive the trick, the greater the boost. Should you fail a trick, you won't gain a boost, but you also won't receive any damage from it.
addons.title: Level EXTREME!

addons.text:
Your connection with the Power Primate has shifted, granting you additional powers said to be as old as the sky and as ancient as the jungle. The power of Donkey Kong! ...Princess and Celebrity Kidnapping impulse not included.

Exploring the world, you will come across pickups and items connected to the Donkey Kong games, with the most notable being the barrels—sturdy barrels you can throw at enemies, cannon barrels that can send you flying through the air in set courses (or rotate, with you able to control the angle you launch from), barrels that you can hide in, and so much more to discover! You'll even come across flying vines, from which you can swing or climb up if no trees or construction sites are nearby. You'll also encounter Animal Buddies, the allies of the Kongs, who will lend you their aid—whether it's Rambi the Rhino acting as a destructive mount on land, or Enguarde the Swordfish to help underwater, with so many more to meet. They can be found in crates or out in the open if you're in the wilderness.

The Bananas you pick up can be used to help keep your stamina up, just by collecting them and giving them out to be eaten. The larger your stockpile of bananas, the greater your fortune, and the more animals see you as King of the Jungle— with only the greatest of them in strength, mind, or possessing supernatural powers being able to oppose you. Strangely enough, these bananas also seem to group together to help lead you to secret areas and items.

But it's not just the world around you that has changed— you yourself have gained the abilities of Donkey Kong. Your already impressive strength has become so strong and absurd that you can knock around small celestial objects, like a moon the size of a large island, or pull up ships from an icy ocean while still standing on said ship. Your hands are now capable of slamming the ground to create large holes, sending out shockwaves that throw enemies back, or sending out sonar waves to locate nearby or hidden items. But this can go even further, as you can draw upon the Power Primate to replicate the specialized hand powers of the Super Robot Monkey Team: claws, magnet hands, spinning saw blades, drills, a sword and shield, and of course, the classic large spinning spike fists.

If before you could jump a little over your own height, now you're able to jump over five times that easily. While the strength boost is most notable in your upper body, it has also improved your lower body. But if that's not enough, you can summon equipment used by the Kongs anywhere, such as D.K.'s Coconut Gun, Diddy's Jetpack, Orange Grenades, or the Bongos—which double as a fine musical instrument for parties and high-speed personal rocket boosters. In time, you will even gain the abilities of all the other members of the Kong family, such as size manipulation to become extremely small or large, arms able to stretch several times their length, and technological prowess.

Finally, due to this synergy of power, your Power Primate Aura is not limited to the form of a Gorilla but can take on the form and traits of other animals—such as Zebras, to allow you to run at such speed you can race across water, or birds, to fly through the air and drop egg bombs on unsuspecting foes, with more to discover.
addons.title: D.K. RULE!

addons.text:
Your ability to travel back in time through your Determination and Save Points has resonated with Jump Jump Hero giving rise to something new.

The first is in regards to you returning to the past as now not only can you go backwards in time up to five seconds, either affecting the whole world or just yourself depending on your Determination and if there are those with a stronger will than you, but your previous SAVE points allows you to appear in different locations given a few conditions. Should you have a powerful bond with someone or your fates intertwined in some grand destiny when you return to a previous SAVE point you can instead choice to appear where that person is, usually hidden as you arrive, however they will not have memories beyond that point of their timeline.

Next; the strength of your Determination is great enough that it was able to mix with ambient energies and condensed into a humanoid form creating your Harbinger. Your Harbinger is a semi-independent being born from you and whom will do their utmost to serve you, by default they take the form of a humanoid energy being with very little features wearing armour with their general shape being the opposite of your gender.

Your Harbinger is half as powerful as you are, but the greater your willpower the stronger they will become until they rival and even surpass you in power, if you so will it you can even send your Harbinger to a previous SAVE point and have them gather information without you going back yourself. Due to them being a Harbinger of your will anything they learn you will know too. However; they can only operate in that other timeline for 24 hours before forcefully be sent back to you and should you die before they return their own mission is cut short and potentially losing the information they went to retrieve.

And through this knowledge you have found an alternative means to gain power, by learning more about the world and it's people the power of you and your Harbinger begins to grow stronger, each new Truth you uncover about the world giving you a boost in stats, money or materials. But not all Truths are equal, learning the favourite meal of a friend may give you some pocket change whereas learning the identity of a Traitor to your faction giving you more power such as greater durability, strength and improving your Weapon of Choice.

Speaking of which. Along with these you gain a Magic Weapon of Choice, a melee weapon you decide now that can gain new forms with various effects but can only take on one form at a time, a Gauntlet with 3 Gem sockets, Gems you can uncover naturally on your journey as you learn Truths and whose power ranges from minor to moderate as they augment your fighting ability to suit the style you prefer, and a grappling hook for you to cross chasms and disarm enemies at a range. These items are treated as Objects of Power that can be summoned and dismissed at will.

Learning new Truths strengthens you and your Harbinger, improving their weapon and armour while you gain new forms for your weapon and new gems, this is but the tip of the types of upgrades you can gain. For as you learn more of the World and it's People the mightier you and your Harbinger shall become, and perhaps in time learn the Truths to save the world if the need arises.

Should you have additional Addons like 'The Human Potential' they can greatly empower not only you and the equipment from this addon but your Harbinger as well.​
addons.title: Of Stories and Omens

addons.text:
You have joined the ancient ranks of those who hunt the foul, the wicked and the strange.

When you defeat enemies, or destroy decorations such as chandeliers, torches, barrels, etc, they will drop small orbs of energy that will restore your health and energies (Stamina, Mana, Aura, etc) and more importantly tools of your trade. Knifes, Javelins, shields, spiked balls, crossbows, drinkable Holy Water, flame torches, holy icons, key items, parts of slain foes and literally anything you can hold in your hands or use. Including the souls of your enemies if you have some means of using them.

You have access to a specialized inventory that contains all these items which you can draw upon at a moment's notice, while in your inventory you can enhance your arsenal by combining items such as using a wolf's fang to enhance several knives or merging identical items to create a better version with no limit outside of time and Key items needed for something.

But you don't just have weapons and tools for you have a full set of knights armour you can summon around yourself, a powerful set of armour able to protect you from any and all damage… for about three to five hits before falling apart from you and disappearing. The armour can be re-equipped given time to recharge which can be cut down if your slain enemies drop a piece of armour.
Along with all of this you have a sixth sense for destruction sections of your environment, creating shortcuts through a demonic castle or finding stashes of resources and equipment, and hidden secrets to help you progress such as where to catch a stray tornado to move to a new location or that there's a world hidden inside a painting you need to enter.

Finally, you will come across spots of significant importance. There is no rule for what form they take, it could be a statue, a painting, a bonfire, a place of prayer or even an ally who offers a word of comfort, but whatever form it takes these spots will restore you to your best physically, magically and conceptually. Not making you better than what you were before but back to full health as the damage incurred over your adventure is undone. Essentially a Heal point.​
addons.title: Ghoulish Gothic Gallivanting

addons.text:
Armed with your sword and boundless courage, you're ready to tackle the trials that Link has faced throughout his many incarnations. You will encounter many things present throughout the Zelda franchise from enemies great and small, deceptive and terrifying, strange and mysterious, to discovering hidden treasure chests, fairy fountains, and benevolent creatures from the many races of the Zelda Universe like Korok, Deku Scrubs, Minish, Gorons, Gerudo, etc. 

You can find Rupees throughout the world by breaking pots, chopping grass, finding chests, and other methods, which you can use as exchangeable currency in any shop. The color of a rupee determines its value, with green being worth 1 due to being the most common, blue being worth 5, and red being worth 20, due to being somewhat rare. Others worth more can be found but are rarer.

You have a pocket dimension inventory that can store an infinite amount of these, as well as any equipment or other items found on your journey. Any item within can easily be sorted and summoned to you.

Most importantly, you'll find dungeons that will test your title as the Hero of Time. Housing various trials, puzzles, enemies, and a boss hidden behind a giant door. Every dungeon is guaranteed to have a useful item tailored to completing it and assisting your journey in the long term, pieces of heart to increase your vitality, a heart container to do the same after beating the boss, and hidden treasures in Rupees and other collectibles. 

The boss of said dungeon will always be a challenge but never overwhelming for your current abilities. With an Achilles heel, blindspot, recognizable pattern, or something else you can exploit for victory. You may or may not find it everytime, but there is always a clue that hints to it.
addons.title: Hero of Time

addons.text:
As you march on towards adventure, you'll encounter many things from the Shantae games. From enemies like tinkerbats, monsters, and surprisingly attractive monstergirls (or boys), to bosses with varying levels of goofy and dangerous hidden within dungeons.

Venturing into these dungeons gives you the opportunity to find many goodies, collectibles, and most importantly, new creatures to shapeshift into. You typically get these by finding a shrine with a depiction of a genie and give it an offering—which you must first find within the dungeon, but other trials are possible.

The new animal transformation is guaranteed to be a worthwhile addition to your arsenal, tailor made for the trials ahead and beyond. Some collectibles can also teach you magic, improve what you already have, or grant Objects of Power like Risky's Pirate Gear. Which are stored within your pocket inventory, alongside any currency.

You can use that currency and other collectibles to trade for goods and upgrades from a shop. They offer a wide array of options like magical items, charms, new spells, equipment, increasing your mana pool or vitality, etc. Some special items may be locked behind side quests or specific things to trade with.

Finally, you receive Shantae's hairwhip attack, and unlike the games, it's strong enough to knock down a well trained human at worst and shatter stone at best. It's range is also elevated, reaching up to 5 meters in length. Which can be further developed and augmented to achieve many feats of hair manipulation.
addons.title: Ret-2-Go!

addons.text: Armed with Ahrah, you're ready to fulfill your mission and will cut down any obstacle before you. Along the way, you will encounter enemies and setpieces from the Dust: An Elysian Tail game. Such as Save Shrines to fully restore you and resurrect you if killed, keys to open Treasure Chests, shops that sell various items, materials, and equipment, as well as consumables to restore health or cure aliments. You have a HUD that showcases your Health, Level, EXP, Energy, and a pocket to use a Consumable. As you defeat enemies the EXP Gauge will fill until completion, causing you to Level Up, and by performing a combo chain without getting hit, you will gain bonus EXP. Leveling up will increase all of your stats (Health, Attack, Defense, Luck) evenly, and rewards you with Skill Gems to further boost any of your choice. You can also gain EXP from side quests and other methods. Defeated enemies will drop various loot like money, blueprints, equipment, consumables, and materials, which are stored within a pocket dimension inventory. You can use the blueprints and materials to craft items yourself or at a shop. Furthermore, you can obtain new abilities tailormade for your journey like a slide, wall climbing, a sidestep, etc. There's also various portals that lead to Trials you can enter, which will reward you with a rare item, piece of equipment, new ability, or something else based on your total score and time taken to complete them. If you have the Dust to Dust Addon, Fidget also receives the same benefits as you, and will scale to your current power.
addons.title: Ashes to Ashes

addons.text:
As you enact the will of your deity, various setpieces, enemies, and mechanics from Kid Icarus Uprising will make themselves known to you. From minions of the Underworld all the way to legendary creatures and even the gods of mythology as boss fights, alongside items like Floor Ice Cream, Recovery Orbs, and Drinks of the Gods to restore your health, mana, stamina, etc. 

You can also encounter special rooms with hotsprings to completely restore you, Intensity Gates that hide challenges to overcome for rewards, and treasure chests containing power-ups, hearts, divine weapons, and other goodies. Whether in the air or on the ground, your deity will provide support for you in the form of routing your flights, bestowing powerful abilities, purifying aliments, and providing general advice. On rare occasions, you may even find Vehicles of the Gods like Exotanks, Aether Rings, Cherubots, and more. All with their own unique weapons and abilities.

Within your deity's domain, you can craft all the weapon types from Kid Icarus Uprising or create your own; Blades, Bows, Palms, Staffs, Orbitars, Arms, Clubs, and Cannons. Using the loot you've collected, fusing two weapons together, or other methods. Even the Three Sacred Treasures aren't far from your grasp. You can also equip Powers that provide various boons, like amplifying your physical abilities, heightened senses, reflect attacks, AOE attacks, etc. 

After every mission, you will receive a surplus of rewards in the form of hearts, points, and a total score that you can use to trade or provide the materials and services within your deity's domain. You can also wager these hearts to replay any mission you've completed on a higher difficulty for extra and greater rewards. Though these are treated as simulations instead of repeating the real thing.
addons.title: Champion of Palutena

addons.text:
It seems that becoming the greatest example of your species has had an interesting effect on your Platforming power, giving you powers similar to a certain Bandicoot, being able to spin in place to knock down, destroy, or deflect attacks; belly flop with enough force to break metal crates; and be durable enough to have hundreds of heavy crates fall on your head or be used as a snowboard down a mountain and get back up no worse for wear.

As you explore the world, you will come across crates from the Crash Bandicoot series that can help you with platforming or contain Wumpa Fruits, an apple-like fruit that is delicious to eat and heals people but can be used as projectiles by throwing them or using them as ammo for weapons, with them even being able to be processed into fuel to supercharge vehicles. Golden Wumpa Fruit exist, possessing 25 times the potency of a normal Wumpa Fruit, and can grant those who eat it greater vitality permanently, with people usually seeing diminishing returns after eating 14 of them.

Along with Wumpa Fruit, you can also find vials containing Mojo, called the essence of life (may contain nuts), of varying colours and sizes just lying around or obtained by breaking things and defeating enemies. Mojo can be used to upgrade yourself by collecting enough of it to create new techniques or enhance an aspect of yourself. It can also upgrade other people the same way, or you can use it to mutate them into Titans. Titans are typically hybrids between different animals, but they can be hybrids between living beings and non-living things like ice or other elements. You are able to jump onto these Titans and command them as if they are an extension of yourself. Alternatively, you can use Mojo to recreate the process that evolved Crash, Coco, and other uplifted animals seen in the Crash Bandicoot series.

Outside of Fruits and Mojo (Essence of Life that may contain nuts), you will come across equipment from the Crash Bandicoot series like vehicles, jet packs, and power armour that looks like it belongs on a construction site. With great effort, you can even come upon Platform Gems and Power Crystals. Platform Gems are large gemstones that can form platforms to open new routes for you to take to find hidden areas or make upcoming confrontations easier, if not bypass them entirely. Power Crystals are crystals able to generate large amounts of power to power anything from a laser gun to a space station filled with doomsday weapons, a shrink ray powerful enough to affect a planet, and a teleporter able to take others to other dimensions and enable time travel.

Trial Areas gain an additional level of challenge, as once you complete them, you can go through them again to earn Time Relics of different rarities, which go in ascending order: Sapphire, Gold, and Platinum. Essentially speedrunning your way through the Trial Area to complete it in the shortest amount of time, collecting items that can stop time for a few seconds. Earning different Relics can give different rewards, from gaining a truly obscene amount of collectables like Wumpa Fruit, Mojo, etc., to upgrading your previous rewards from the base trial, making them greater by several magnitudes. You can challenge and rechallenge these Time Trials whenever you want.

Finally, helping you along the way is a friend and mentor: an ancient Witch Doctor who bound their soul to the mask they wore in life, like the brothers Aku Aku and Uka Uka. Unlike said brothers, however, your Spirit Mask companion is a bit different. While their history, personality, and design are up to you, this Mask Spirit has infinite potential for growth and can replicate any Mask Spirit power seen in the Crash series, including those of the Elemental Masks (who were responsible for all natural disasters on Earth until sealed away) and the Quantum Masks (whose job is to protect the Multiverse), given time to grow.

For now, though, outside of advice and being a well of knowledge, if you find a crate with their mask on it, you can break it for the Spirit Mask to take damage for you. If you break three crates without taking damage, you can wear the Spirit Mask and become invincible for a short time, with all your skills and abilities, along with those of the Spirit Mask, amplified greatly.
addons.title: N Sanity!

addons.text:
