Your platforming ability has resonated with the Mythos connected to the Reploids, that of Mega Man, and through it you have gained access to the potential of these legendary machines.

First and foremost is your ability to change from a Human, Humanoid (Cyborg), and Reploid form, with each body being its own separate thing that you can switch between. Damage is not shared between them, and while not in use, the other bodies are able to be healed / repaired over time.

As you explore the world, you can come across enemies from the Mega Man series from across all eras and timelines, from the almost mascot Met in all its forms to the bosses of the Mega Man series, from towering mecha snakes to even replicas of named legends like Bomb Man or Sigma, Replica X, and Omega, but only when you are ready to face them.

To help you overcome these mechanical titans, you have gained an energy sword and gun that scale with you and that can be enhanced through data chips you can find through exploration and defeating enemies, acting as temporary power-ups to turn the tide of any battle. You gain the Double Gear system; a system that can increase your attack power or speed for a short time at the cost of increased strain and, should things be truly dire, you can use both at once for a massive boost in power, but be left very weakened afterwards.

Once you defeat bosses, you gain their power in two forms. Like Mega Man himself, you gain new weapons based on defeated bosses, but you are able to go a step further. You gain the ability to use A-Trans, the power to take on the form and perfectly copy the abilities of the bosses you defeat, with few limitations on what you can transform into, with no time limit. In time, with sufficient mastery, you will be able to use True A-Trans, letting you summon defeated bosses and control them.

Finally, Trail Areas can now house Armour capsules. These Armour capsules house upgraded armour to enhance your base stats or offer armours that are designed to support one of your other powers; it's possible for new Armour capsules to appear based on your own technology powers (such as armour designed by Gerald Robotnik if you have E.G.G.M.A.N or Bulma if you have Capsule Corp, etc.). Should you have the addon Stellar Example!, then you can use those armour pieces to craft a robotic animal companion like Rush, but only with a complete armour set.
addons.title: Rock On!

addons.text:
Through your possession of Military Grade Hardware and your Platform abilities you've now become a Character straight out of a Run and Gun Game. Rampage through Armies of Foes with a Gun that changes Loadout whenever you loot a Power up from the Paste that their corpses will probably become. 

Your Bullets will be able to Harm Giant robots if you shoot at their Pilots among other things like Elder Gods and you gain an instinctual awareness of where the weak spot of Particularly Tough Foes is, signified by the Flashing Red Weak Spot. or FRWS.
addons.title: Gunstar Contra!

objects.text:
With a figurative spring in your step you have gained the abilities of a typical Platformer Hero, offering you a grab bag of powers to aid you on your journey.

You are able to double jump mid air to reach higher areas or air dash to the side with the power behind it equal to your own jumping power, while limited to one double jump and air dash in the beginning with training you can increase this with no hard limit to the number of air jumps or air dash you can do. You also become immune to motion sickness or getting dizzy.

Along with being able to jump a little over your own height you strength has increased so that you can carry double your own weight without much issue allowing you to scale all manner of things without issue with your fists strong enough to shatter bricks. You also gain an awareness of everything around you like you were looking around you constantly, while this offers no other enhanced senses you will have no issue running away from a boulder while knowing what is in front and behind you.

With this new range of awareness around you moving around becomes easier allowing you to navigate moving platforms and narrow areas like it was second nature, while some hazards will still prove a problem you can avoid tripping and perform perfect long jumps.

But the greatest aspect of your power is the awareness of Collectables and Trial areas, Collectables are items dotted around areas that require some effort to hunt down with them offering you rewards such as money, information or upgrades for you and your equipment.

Trial Areas are zones that can appear anywhere, they could be an old warehouse on the bad part of town, a cave out in the woods or even a crack in the fabric of space time itself. These areas will test your abilities and at the end you are able to find more collectibles that act as part of a set that when brought together will offer a great reward beyond the usual collectables.
objects.title: Jump Jump Hero!

addons.text:
Your mastery of both Titanbound and Heartdrumming has resulted in a martial art beyond its components. Your skeletal muscles have evolved into auxiliary pumps. With every contraction, your muscles compress deep veins with such efficiency that they actively push blood toward the heart. This creates a continuous, low-level circulatory boost without cardiac strain. Additionally, your veins and arteries have developed elastic, muscular walls resembling those of smaller arteries. This means they can contract rhythmically in sync with nearby muscles, creating a wave-like peristalsis that assists blood flow. As a result, your heart no longer bears the full burden of circulation. At rest, its workload decreases by approximately 40%, allowing slower, more powerful beats. This means you can use Heartdrummer with far less strain, risk and maximize the power gained from each use. 

The main transformation however is when you use Titanbound. In this state, Heartdrumming no longer needs to be consciously activated, as it acts as the natural circulatory response to your transformed state. The initial Valsalva maneuver and total muscular recruitment now trigger a specific, optimized Heartdrumming pattern tuned precisely for Titanbound's demands. Blood flows to engorged tissues through coordinated compression waves rippling through your muscle lattice. Beyond the raw increase in power as the two build on each other, the enhanced circulatory efficiency delays the onset of anaerobic metabolism. This allows you to sustain the form for 45-50 minutes with clear consciousness.

However, the cost of using this state has been exacerbated. When the transformation ends, you enter a metabolic state where your body prioritizes rebuilding the fused system. You'll crave specific nutrients: iron-rich meats for blood, electrolytes for nerve conduction, vast carbohydrates. In addition to this and the other baseline costs, your temperature regulation falters for hours as your body recalibrates, with you alternating between feverish heat and chills.
addons.title: Goliath’s Heart

objects.text:
Titanbound is the art of self-augmentation through absolute dominion over one's own flesh, designed by a woman who was ordained the title of Titan. Through simultaneous extreme Valsalva maneuver and total muscular recruitment, the muscle tissues are flooded with blood and intracellular fluid, triggering a state of perpetual, hyper-dense contraction.

The result is your body becoming a grotesque monument to temporary might. Your frame swells, gaining height from the hyperextension of your taut, straining posture. Your girth expands as every muscle group balloons into knotty, cable-like bundles, pushing against your skin until it becomes as tough and resilient as layered leather. This dense lattice of swollen, rock-hard muscle acts as a formidable natural armour, turning aside glancing blows and blunting the impact of strikes that would shatter a normal man. This immense form also grants you strength enough to match a dozen men. You can remain in this state for up to a maximum of half an hour. 

When the transformation ends, the debt comes due. As your height and girth increase, your mass multiplies exponentially, while the supporting strength of your engorged muscles only increases by a square. This means that while in that state, your body would have needed burned all its fuel. Your metabolic bankruptcy crashes down as ravenous hunger and desperate thirst. Your body will be forced to rest and replenish itself. Additionally, should your body have any internal damage, or anything similar, using this technique will exponentially worsen them.
objects.title: Titanbound

objects.text:
You have learned the ancient art of Air Burst Breathing; a Heian-period discipline made to grant humans the power to drive back Yokai. You are not a master, yet no longer a novice; your lungs have begun to resonate with the rhythmic hum of the old monks, and your blood burns with the strength of the forgotten forge.

By deeply inhaling and compressing air in your lungs, your chest vibrates faintly causing resonance that separates oxygen from inert gases. With each breath, your blood becomes saturated with oxygen far beyond natural limits. Your muscles use this to trigger controlled micro-combustions inside the cells that flood them with energy. When you fight in this state, your body emits faint heat, your movements blur, and your strength surges beyond human limits. You can punch through brick walls, sprint faster than a trained race car driver can react, and leap several meters with a single bound. Your reflexes sharpen until the world seems to slow, every motion of your opponent mapped out before your eyes.

Additionally, the air around your body begins to form a shifting shell of compressed atmosphere that moves as you move. You can control this shell, shaping the air into short, explosive bursts that amplify your strikes or alter your trajectory without the need to touch the ground. You can vent this pressure through precise muscle contractions, redirecting it through your limbs to stabilize, pivot mid-leap, or propel yourself forward with blinding speed. At close range, your attacks strike with concussive overpressure, each blow followed by a sharp pop of collapsing air.

You can maintain this rhythm for several minutes before the accumulated fatigue sets in. The moment your breathing falters, the oxygen debt collapses upon you, causing your muscles to seize, your chest to ache, and black spots to flicker at the edge of your vision.

At your current level of skill, you are able to enter this state in a handful of breaths, needing four heartbeats of preparation before ignition. As you grow in both skill and body strength, the time taken to enter that state will lessen while the duration of said state will increase. Eventually, you will be able to have it active at all times.
objects.title: Air Burst Breathing

objects.text:
You are a student of Y Taranau, a martial art born during the era of plate-armored knights. It is a style that treats the body as a fortress and the armor as its unyielding walls. The art is dependent on full plate; unless your body is made of steel, your body cannot withstand the techniques without the armor to absorb and distribute the forces. With mastery, you learn to mitigate this slightly, functioning in a brigandine or a heavy coat of plates, but to practice it unarmored is impossible for a normal human.

You can shift your weight dramatically from foot to foot, using gravity to fall forward and build momentum with each stride while retaining perfect balance. This way, you can move faster in a straight line than a galloping warhorse at your top speed, your armored weight making you a human cannonball. A pivot lets your armored body spin to change direction, or generate force, while a stomp serves a dual purpose: it can crush a fallen foe's helmet like an eggshell, or you can use the same motion to explosively launch yourself toward your next opponent.

Your defense relies on presenting the curved surfaces of your armour, primarily your shoulder, hip and helm, to incoming blows. You can rotate your body so that swords and axes skid off you harmlessly, with the force of the glancing blow being absorbed as rotational energy, loading your core and opposite limbs. A strike against your right shoulder twists your torso and loads your left arm, turning your opponent's momentum into fuel for your own attack. You can take a warhammer swing to your hip and have the force of it already spinning your body into a counter before the hammerhead has finished its arc.

Your offence relies on you driving forward with your legs, your arm acting as a rigid steel beam to unleash a short, piston-like strike with either your armored gauntlet or weapon. You can crush an opponent's ribs through their breastplate with a single blow, the metal denting inward from the concussive force. In the closest quarters where longswords are ineffective, you can grip your own blade to use the pommel or crossguard as a dense striking hammer, caving in visors and helms with short, brutal strikes using the same principles.

You can optionally get a free, fully mundane suit of knight's plate armor and a sword. They require the same maintenance as any real medieval gear. Still, with this alone, a true master of the style can face an army and emerge untouched, their blade and fist having torn through enemy plate like it was parchment.
objects.title: Y Taranau

objects.text:
You practice Tremlyn, a style that rose from the Welsh marches as plate armour grew dominant across the battlefields of the late medieval age. The style spread quickly and was used by anyone who could afford to learn it, often taught in knight orders. Over time, its enemies gave it a nickname: the Knight Killer. This style cannot be used without a bladed weapon, working best with a sword.

Whenever you strike, you commit your full body weight into the cut while simultaneously triggering a rapid, voluntary tremor in your wrists and hands at the exact moment of impact. This localised oscillation transforms the blade into a primitive vibro-weapon at the instant of contact, creating a shearing effect that produces a ragged, serrated wound rather than a clean slice. Sustained strikes to the same location allow the serrating effect to gradually cut through steel plate. Additionally, the localised oscillation transmits through the sword and into the target.

An opponent struck by Tremlyn experiences their greatest protection becoming a liability. A knight who takes a blow to the helmet suffers a sustained, deafening peal that robs balance and leaves them vulnerable for several seconds. A hit to the arm harness causes the forearm to tremble uncontrollably, often forcing the knight to drop their weapon after two or three such strikes. Against the chest or shoulders, the transmission of oscillating force through the plate causes deep bruising beneath the padding and progressively seizes articulated joints.

The technique is straining to use without practice. At the start, you can only perform it a handful of times; overuse leaves your wrists numb for minutes to hours. Additionally, a poorly executed tremor will accelerate stress fractures in the blade. As you improve, the margin for error will loosen, and both the number of times you can use it in a row as well as the power behind your strikes will increase.
objects.title: Tremlyn

objects.text:
You are a novice practitioner of Byddin Un, a style designed by Welsh knight commanders who witnessed how, with the rise of plate armour, a single elite knight could alter smaller battlefields alone. Inspired by these moments, they sought to push further: to create knights so overwhelmingly dominant that warfare itself would reshape around them, returning to an age where conflicts were decided by single champions rather than massed armies.

The style functions by translating military formations into individual stances. When you adopt a Shield Wall stance, you position your body and weapon to cover every angle of approach, achieving the defensive coverage of four spearmen locked together. When you shift into a Cavalry Wedge, your footwork and momentum concentrate into a single piercing point, allowing you to punch through a line as a formation of charging knights would. When you move through an Encirclement stance, your circling footwork and feints create the illusion of being surrounded, forcing opponents to defend against multiple angles as you rapidly move and occupy multiple positions. Each stance is not a static pose but an active tactical framework, meaning you must continuously make micro-decisions about positioning, timing, and angle to maintain the formation's benefits. As such, it is very mentally exhausting, exponentially so with more complex formations.

As you grow more skilled, you learn to manage these micro-decisions faster and more efficiently, allowing you to utilise formations that require more individuals, such as the Schiltron or the Pincer. This also increases the speed at which you can transition between stances, allowing you to reorganise your "army" faster. Greater physical conditioning, on the other hand, increases the effective quality of each "soldier" in your formation and enables elite formations like the Forlorn Hope or the Shield Castle. To clarify, this style doesn’t make you conjure illusions, summon spectral soldiers, or multiply yourself in any way; you remain one person, yet through tactical perfection, you achieve the same results as a coordinated group. At the start, you can use formation stances that need no more than a dozen soldiers.

Beyond your physical and mental limitations, terrain also dictates which stances are viable: a Shield Wall requires space to cover its angles, a Cavalry Wedge needs room to build momentum, and an Encirclement demands open ground to circle, so a cramped corridor or crumbling ruin forces you into simpler formations or constant adaptation. You also cannot replicate a formation that requires equipment you do not possess unless you have something to replace it; a Cavalry Wedge would, for example, need a horse to be mounted on, while a Shield Wall normally expects shields, but if you are proficient enough and possess an appropriate power/ability, you may substitute that in place of the missing gear.

Byddin Un synergies well with other combat styles, as any technique you layer onto a stance gains the benefits of being performed by a formation of individuals using that same technique rather than a single individual.
objects.title: Byddin Un

objects.text:
This is one of the three styles left behind by the Monk who called himself Naraka, a man so hated that legend claimed half the world sought his death, yet so unrivalled in martial skill that he died peacefully in his bed while his enemies still drew up plans against him. Not even the Elven Sword King, who hated Naraka more than anyone, could cut him down.

The technique focuses on using your palms and the back of your hands, primarily using slaps, palm strikes, and backhand strikes to magnify kinetic energy across the widest possible surface area, dispersing it in a way that transfers maximum momentum to your target’s center of mass. When you deliver a full open-palm strike with this technique, you can lift a grown man from his feet and launch him nearly a dozen meters through the air as though he weighed nothing. A backhand slap sends an opponent tumbling across the ground like a skipping stone, each impact with the earth adding bruises to humiliation. You can strike a charging horse in the chest and send both rider and mount sprawling backward, or you can clap your palms together against a shielded enemy and send the man inside the armor flying.

While the style is generally non-lethal, if you use these strikes in rapid succession, the style can become lethal. By striking different parts of your target’s body in opposing directions, the body is subjected to conflicting vectors of immense force, literally tearing itself apart from the inside out as it is thrown in multiple directions simultaneously.
objects.title: Buddha’s Palm

objects.text:
This is one of the three styles left behind by the Monk who called himself Naraka, a murderer and drunkard who wore holy robes while living only for his own desires, yet whose rare whims saved the men and women who would go on to define the next age, one of such being the Dwarven Martial King. He did so not out of altruism but because he disliked their oppressors more than he disliked them.

The technique focuses on using your fingers, training each to move with complete independence so they spread and coil like serpents, each digit possessing grip strength sufficient to support your full body weight on a ledge so sheer that even mountain goats cannot find purchase. You can snatch arrows from the air with a pinch of your thumb and forefinger and return them to the archer’s throat before he can nock another. You can catch a thrown spear by the shaft with your middle finger alone and send it spinning back the way it came. You press a single finger against a man’s chest, and he will find himself pinned to the ground as though an iron pillar has been driven through him, unable to rise no matter how he strains. You can even scale a castle wall by digging your fingertips into stone walls with no visible handhold.

You can also use this offensively by using your strong grip to hold an opponent and use them as a living projectile, slamming them into another enemy with enough force to shatter bone. Your grip strength also means you can dent steel with relative ease, meaning if you use such a grip on your opponent’s body, shattering bones is far from impossible.
objects.title: Varuna’s Grasp

objects.text:
This is one of the three styles left behind by the Monk who called himself Naraka, known to his enemies as the Fake Monk, Devil’s Scripture, Monk of Hell, and the Evil Beast of Man, a figure so fearsome that even a decade after his death, few believed he had truly passed. When it was confirmed nearly two decades after his death, a festival was hosted, stretching most of the nation and lasting for a whole month.

The technique focuses on using the balls of your feet and the mechanics of a single step, turning that step into a pivot, that pivot into a spin, and that spin into a vortex. If an opponent swings a blade at you, you flow with their force to accelerate your own rotation, dodging by stepping inside their reach and spinning past their guard before they can complete the motion. If instead an attacker lunges, you can pivot off their thrust to add their momentum to yours, your speed increasing as you do. If an attacker tries to swing wildly, you can, with a single step, flow around them in a spin to appear behind them by the time their weapon finishes its swing. You become a blur, your single step’s radius becoming an absolute zone where you appear to be everywhere at once.

By halting your spin, you can convert all that accumulated rotational momentum into a single focused transfer of force, allowing you to go from a blur to an abrupt stop by channeling the full momentum of your stolen speed into your strike.
objects.title: Lotus Step

objects.text:
Farikaoba is a movement-based martial art centered on continuous motion, balance, and control. It is trained in open environments and emphasizes adaptability over fixed patterns, turning combat into a controlled form of sword dancing.

Your body is conditioned for constant, flowing movement. Jumps, spins, slides, and rapid directional changes link together without pause. Attacks are delivered during motion, such as mid-turn, at the peak of a jump, or while passing an opponent. This creates irregular timing and angles that are difficult to track or counter.

The style is well-suited for dual-wielding. Common combinations include sword and buckler or two swords. One hand maintains control of space through deflection, pressure, or positioning, while the other delivers strikes. Both hands operate in coordination, allowing seamless transitions between offense and defense without breaking rhythm.

Training includes ritualistic fire-leaping, where practitioners repeatedly jump over open flames as part of discipline and conditioning. This builds tolerance to heat, pain, and stress, allowing you to maintain performance in extreme environments such as intense heat, cold, or rough terrain without hesitation.

Your footwork adapts instinctively to terrain, as the style was developed in heavily mountainous regions where stable footing cannot be assumed. Rocky slopes, loose gravel, narrow paths, and uneven ground shaped its movement. As a result, you adjust balance and step placement automatically, maintaining speed and control even where footing is unreliable.

Farikaoba integrates both aerial and ground control. You can strike while airborne, redirect momentum on landing, and continue movement immediately. On the ground, you remain mobile through slides and rolls, attacking from low angles before rising back into motion.

The style avoids rigid stances. You rely on continuous repositioning and angled movement to avoid attacks rather than meeting them directly. Defense comes from spacing and timing, while offense is applied during transitions, when the opponent is off-balance or adjusting.

Farikaoba functions as a disciplined sword dance. Each movement feeds into the next, maintaining a steady rhythm of motion, evasion, and attack. In practice, it allows sustained pressure while remaining difficult to pin down, combining mobility and precision into a cohesive combat system.
objects.title: Farikaoba

objects.text:
This "technique" was designed by a muscle-headed buffoon whose only talents were sheer stupidity and bottomless determination. He was trained by the Martial King himself because he wouldn’t leave the man alone, later becoming the so-called "Ultimate Fist".

Every muscle in your body dedicates itself to a single straight right punch: your feet plant and drive, your hips snap, your back coils and releases, and even your left arm acts as a counterweight, pulling backward with equal force to amplify your pivot. This one punch can shatter thick steel walls and move faster than the eye can track, sending out a shockwave that rattles organs and splits eardrums. When you wind up your right fist, you do so with enough force that you create a vacuum strong enough to drag an average person off balance and into your fist's path, adding a second layer of force before your punch even fully lands. Consecutive punches are awkward because each is a full-body effort, but they are still possible, with each blow landing as hard as the first every time. 

This style has no concept of "blocking". Instead, you tank hits to make opponents overextend into your range, answering with your fist, being able to attack even in the middle of getting hit, making you impossible to be interrupted mid-strike. Your right fist is so tough it’s as though its skin is tempered leather over steel-dense muscle and titanium-hard bone. Every other part of you scales down in toughness anatomically, with the closer it is to the fist, the tougher it is. Even then, your untrained side is still akin to that of a boar’s hide.

If you are left-handed, you may instead specialise in your left fist. Training both fists is possible, but the human body has limited resources; you cannot specialize two fists the way you can one. Still, those who train both sides are far from weak, as each punch remains strong enough to leave boulder-like craters in concrete.
objects.title: Oh Righteous Fist

objects.text:
A remnant from the ancient age when the Sound King still rampaged and was worshiped, a martial art was born in an attempt to mimic a fraction of the horrifying power of the beast.

Fundamentally, this art is a combination of practices and forms that refine and alter your body to channel, amplify, shape and weaponize the various sounds it produces. Embodying the Sound King on a much smaller scale.

Initially, this will simply manifest as various sounds enhancing the force behind every move and strike you perform, but with practice and refinement, it evolves to become far broader and more devastating; with palm strikes that liquefy organs through echoes, chops that cleave like a blade, flexes that cushion with beats, shouts that shred on a molecular level, even snuffing out life with a whisper.
objects.title: Mimicry of the Sound King

addons.text: You and your Companions are now able to fight like the Phantom Thieves of Hearts in Persona 5 Strikers, meaning you automatically get a gun if you don't have one (granted, it will be an airsoft gun). Your Specials are now called Showtimes, you are able to chip away at a defensive gauge that once emptied, opens up an opponent to an All Out Attack with any of your Companions, treat all enemies' Null/Repel/Drain Physical affinities as if they were just Resist Physical, and your upgrade tree is the BOND tree, where upon getting a level up in friendship grants you points to spend on upgrades. Additionally, as a Wild Card, your Strong Combos will allow you to auto-cast certain skills your Persona can unleash without expediting SP or Health. Casting physical skills can drain your health, though it does leave temporary health that can be regained unless you use another Physical skill or get hit.
addons.title: Generic Persona 5 Strikers Character

addons.text: You and your Companions are now able to fight like the heroes and villains of Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity. You are able to chip away at a defensive gauge that once emptied, opens up an opponent to a Weak Point Smash, as well as being able to unleash a Flurry Rush any time you dodge an attack at the right time, and reflect lasers if you happen to have a shield. You also get a complementary ability that's tied to you or your current moveset, like Link's arrows for his one handed sword moveset or Revali's Flight stance, as well as a free copy of the 3 elemental Rods the Wizzrobes use. Additionally, your Sheikah Slate is upgraded as if the precious egg/mini Guardian Terrako is nearby, allowing you and nearby Companions to see a special warning sign to use either the Remote Bomb, Stasis, Magnesis, or Cryonis Runes in a manner that's unique to you/your Companions to counter certain enemy attacks, leaving their Weak Point Gauge exposed as they're stunned. Your Companions can therefore use these Runes without a Sheikah Slate of their own. Your upgrades take the form of sidequests where, in exchange for supplies, grant you special trainings to increase your Combos, Special Gauges, etc.
addons.title: Generic Age of Calamity Character

addons.text: You and your Companions are now able to fight like the units of Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes. You gain Unique Action, Support, and Tactical Abilities that are tailor made for your playstyle regardless of your current weapon or class, and you get the class tree system available for all units. If you have certain Property OoPs, any of the Organization sizes, or Plot of Land, you can get a Base Camp, allowing you to hang out with Companions, upgrade various facilities with the Facility Manager, and upgrade various stats with the Tactics Instructor, with your moveset improving as you raise your weapon rank level via mastering classes. You get new classes from the Combat Instructor after maxing out a class in the relevant trees.
addons.title: Generic Three Hopes Character

objects.text:
You gained the power and abilities of an average Musou character, granting you the ability to fight armies thousands strong and win, as well as pulling off big flashy attacks known as "Specials", capable of scooping up to over a hundred people in one attack. 

You also have the ability to make weapon-specific Light Combo strings and Strong Combo enders if the weapon is a big enough departure from the general weapon form. Any properties that the weapon may have, such as Anti-Armor, will be applied to the damage for your Light & Strong Combos.

After winning battles, you get paid on 3 areas: how much time you spent razing the battlefield, how much damage you took, and how many body bags you filled up. Getting triple Ss (15m, 15% damage or fewer, and 2k) will grant you a bonus to the paycheck, though some of this can change depending on circumstances/modifiers.

Getting enough victories under your campaign will unlock a Shop you can go to improve your battle experience, like resisting attacks, extend your combos, giving you more Special Bars to unleash more specials, etc.
objects.title: Generic Musou Character

objects.text: Long ago, the ancient master Nachtfiatebacht was under siege from many enemies. Old as he was, he only had a finite amount of energy left within him to use to defend from these creatures, for which he developed the Endless Defensive War Technique, allowing him to adapt his defenses to the monsters besieging him and his students. The technique of Nachtfiatbacht is fundamentally a ‘toggle’ of sorts. By moving your internal energy to different places, you can cause different defensive effects on your body. These being the Shadow, Soul, Bone, Heat, and Heart. While masters of the technique can infuse this energy into three or even more of these areas, you’ll initially only be able to use one at a time. The Shadow makes you able to conceal yourself and cloud your actions from clairvoyant sights of all kinds. From future seers to remote viewers, your actions will be hidden. This only conceals you and your presence, however, and in theory, you could be tracked by following the effects you leave on the world. The Soul protects from influence over your mind and perception. A ghost’s possession, for instance, would not find purchase on you while channeling this energy through the Soul. However, this is notably less effective when mitigating physical effects, such as various drugs. The Bone makes you stalwart, defended from attempts to target your body such as a hydrokinetic draining you of your blood from a distance. This does not make you invincible to all harm, but protects you from these more esoteric effects. The Heat fortifies your will and mind, allowing you to resist great suffering or push through great adversity to see your goals through. Similarly, it enhances your mind, but this does not make you any more intelligent; instead, it merely allows you to think clearly and rationally despite anything affecting you. Unfortunately, students of Nachtfiatebacht specialising in The Heat have a tendency to abuse it, becoming highly stubborn and hyperfocused, though this can be mitigated by avoiding overuse. The Heart defends from attempts to hamper your abilities. While passing energy through it, abilities you possess are affected much the same way The Bone affects your body, becoming resistant to attempts to steal, control, or otherwise alter them against your will. Notably, much like The Shadow, the indirect effect of these abilities can still be altered in kind, absent of this protection.
objects.title: Master Nachtfiatebacht’s Endless Defensive War

addons.title: Origin of Western Wrestling
addons.text:
"Float like a butterfly, sting like Ali."

It seems that your exceptional talent, discipline, and mastery of hand-to-hand combat have impressed Apollo, god of light, perfection, and the arts, who, according to Greek tradition, was associated with boxing and athletic competitions, earning you a portion of his divine favor.

Thanks to this blessing, your reflexes, speed, and perception are elevated far beyond the limits of any other demigod, allowing you to process and respond to attacks with a degree of speed and precision that would otherwise be impossible.

Additionally, this divine blessing enhances your understanding of combat rhythm, timing, and body mechanics, allowing you to refine and execute the techniques you already possess with perfect timing, seamlessly chaining movements together, exploiting fleeting openings, and maintaining perfect control over the pace of an exchange.

As a curious side effect, this blessing also grants you an unexpected talent unrelated to combat: you are now an excellent dancer. After all, good footwork is not only useful for avoiding punches; it can also save you on the dance floor.

addons.title: Phantom Submission
addons.text:
Thanks to the combination of your mastery of Pankration and your control over Killing Intent, you have created a technique known as Phantom Submission: the ability to impose the experience of any submission technique you have mastered without needing to establish physical contact with the target.

Although no real physical restraint exists, you are capable of transmitting the sensation of being trapped by joint locks, chokes, cervical locks, spinal locks, or leg locks, causing the target to become overwhelmed by the experience and suffer an inability to react equivalent to what they would feel if the technique had been applied for real.

For example, the target could experience the sensory simulation of a Rear Naked Choke while remaining standing and unable to react, feeling the pressure of the arm around their neck, the compression of the carotid arteries, and the progressive loss of stability, with their nervous system interpreting the technique as if it were actually happening, forcing their body to react as though they were experiencing a real submission through the manipulation of perception until the sensation of restraint causes them to lose consciousness.

However, the effectiveness of Phantom Submission, like your Killing Intent, depends on the difference between your power and the target’s willpower, meaning those who are more powerful than you or possess an exceptionally strong will may resist its influence, reducing its effects or even becoming completely immune to the technique.

objects.text:
You are a master of Pankration, an ancient martial art originating in Ancient Greece that combines striking, grappling, takedowns, and submission techniques into a complete combat system.

Through rigorous training and constant practice in this martial art, your body has progressively adapted to the physical demands of combat, developing exceptionally conditioned musculature—particularly in your back, shoulders, arms, legs, and core—capable of generating the strength necessary to take down, submit, and control an opponent; denser and more resilient bones, capable of withstanding impacts and extreme physical stress, significantly reducing the risk of fractures and bone diseases; and extraordinary muscular and cardiovascular endurance, allowing you to withstand prolonged exertion and maintain a high level of physical performance for extended periods of time.

At the same time, you have developed exceptional balance, coordination, mobility, mental agility, and proprioception—the ability to perceive the position and movement of each part of your body without needing to look at it—allowing you to control your body with precision, react quickly, and make split-second decisions even while moving, losing your balance, or struggling against an opponent.

Furthermore, thanks to the deep knowledge of human anatomy and biomechanics acquired through your training, you are capable of interpreting your opponents' body language, perceiving subtle changes in their posture, muscle tension, and weight distribution, understanding their intentions, identifying their weaknesses, and anticipating their movements even before they begin.

Lastly, as Pankration is considered a conceptual predecessor of modern Mixed Martial Arts (MMA), you possess an advanced mastery of the principles, techniques, and training methods that comprise this style of combat, allowing you to seamlessly integrate techniques from various martial disciplines and adapt them with precision to any situation, turning every confrontation into an opportunity to continuously refine and evolve your fighting style.
objects.title: Pankration
Rogue Ninja
objects.text:
You have awakened the ability to use Internal Energy, marking you as a Rogue Ninja. Normally used by the modern ninja clans, Internal Energy is a potent body enhancer, allowing them to fight on roughly even grounds with the creatures of the night, as well as making you highly receptive to further modifications, such as gene mods, or cybernetics.

You can easily lift 7 tons, move at over 250 mph in a dead sprint, and can take a hit from a tank shell with only some bruising to begin with, and will continue to grow from there.

But that is not all it can be used for, as the various clans have developed many different techniques and seals over the years using it, some of which have been spread over time and become part of the standard kit.

You know how to craft Explosive Seals - small paper slips that detonate with the force of a block of C4 after a short delay, when supplied with energy, as well as the Flash variation, which converts the explosive power into light and sound to disorient or even permanently cause your foes to become blind and deaf, as they attack and damage those senses.

You also know the Shadow Meld technique, which allows one to merge with any shadows they stand within, completely hiding their presence so long as they don’t move, and the Shadow Step technique, which is an advanced variation of the Shadow Meld technique, that allows you to move near instantly to any shadows or darkened areas within 5 feet of you at the cost of the shadow meld’s obscuring properties.

With time and practice however, you may be able to discover many other techniques.

addons.title: Proper Training
addons.text:
It seems you aren’t just a rogue ninja, who’s fresh off the streets, you’ve got some proper training under your belt.

You know how to use your techniques and abilities more efficiently, reducing the amount of energy they need to a third of what they’d normally cost you.

Additionally, you’ve either caught the eye of a Clan, or went through a couple of years of training at an academy, as you’ve learned how to blend your powers into your fighting style seamlessly, always allowing you to catch your opponents by surprise the first time you use one of your abilities in a fight.

objects.text:
You are a student of the Falling Petal school, having learned Rakuyō-ryū, a martial art that portrays itself as a traditional style focused on flowing flourishes over practical fights, while in reality it is a style made for assassins. Your body has been conditioned since childhood, possessing superior balance, joint flexibility, spatial awareness, and timing. Your fingertips have been hardened into needles of living bone while your feet no longer step but glide across the ground.

Rakuyō-ryū’s movements are reminiscent of Wushu, although they are focused on flowing motion, wide flourishes, and drifting footwork. Every movement is designed to look beautiful. In truth, every flourish is a feint, with every sweeping gesture a theft of attention. Your wide gestures, slow inhalations, and sweeping circles draw the opponent's gaze and attention away from your true strike. Your footwork is a constant glide; your heels do not plant until the moment of commitment. Your speed is used to emphasize flourishes, hiding real strikes. Every flourish is a feint. The actual strike is fast, short-range, and appears incidental to the form. 

Layered onto this physical art is a spiritual component. You have been trained to target seven specific meridian points on the body. A precise strike to these points severs the flow of Ki. This allows your strikes to do stuff such as locking your opponent’s diaphragm, cause your opponent collapses into immediate unconsciousness, create ruptures within your target’s internal organs or even sever a meridian to leave a limb hanging dead.

Traditional implements include the steel fan, the sharpened hairpin, and weighted sleeves, although these are all supplementary. The art is fully functional, and generally only used, with empty hands.
objects.title: The Way of the Falling Petal

objects.text:
You have harnessed the mystical energy of Shou-Lao the Undying, becoming the Iron Fist, the ultimate source of chi in the world. This immense power allows you to focus and enhance your natural abilities to extraordinary levels. By channeling the energy of Shou-Lao’s heart, you can transform your fist into an inhumanly powerful weapon. In this state, your fist becomes supernaturally resilient, resistant to injury and pain, and imbued with incredible destructive force. With a chi-enhanced strike, you can shatter wood, brick, and steel, knock out superhumans like Colossus, destroy a train colliding with you at full speed, and even bring down a H.A.M.M.E.R. Helicarrier in a single blow.

By channeling chi throughout your body, you can amplify all your physical attributes, such as strength, durability, stamina, agility, speed, and senses to superhuman levels. This augmentation enables you to engage foes far beyond ordinary limits, such as battling beings strong enough to overpower Luke Cage or delivering rapid strikes to a towering monster over a hundred feet tall at speeds imperceptible to the human eye.

Your mastery of chi extends beyond physical enhancements. You can channel your energy into ranged concussive blasts, imbue objects with chi, heal your and others' injuries, and detoxify poisons within the body. With this power, you can halt or reverse aging, recover your body from near-death with only a fragment of living flesh, and even create illusions. Additionally, you can sense and influence emotions in people and animals, detect energy signatures, tap into energy fields like the electromagnetic spectrum, and absorb magical or external energy to augment your abilities further.

As the Iron Fist, you also become a master of K’un-Lun’s martial arts, with the knowledge of The Book of the Iron Fist imprinted upon your mind. This sacred text contains the combined martial techniques, wisdom, legends, and mysteries of every Iron Fist throughout history, making you a living embodiment of K’un-Lun’s greatest warrior legacy.
objects.title: Immortal Iron Fist (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your mastery of both Ki and the art of the Ripple have given you the breakthrough you needed to understand Soul Power, a versatile application of Ki with nearly unlimited possibilities, such as self cloning, levitation, teleportation, mind control, energy manipulation, telekinesis, & many more abilities.

Just like the art of Goutetsu Style Shotokan, Soul Power has two paths. There is the path of pure Soul Power, the kind used by Rose or Menat, or that of Psycho Power, a technique embodied by its true master M. Bison.
addons.title: Soul Power

addons.text:
The sage arts of Senjutsu & Yoga, as practiced by Dhalsim and Oro, are now available to you.

This includes the ability to extend and contort your limbs, teleportation & levitation, breathing fire, powerful ki projection, complete ki mastery like that of Oro, the ability to effortlessly survive in extreme harsh conditions (such as standing on the wing of a jet liner in flight), super strength, homing energy projectiles, telekinesis, & eternal life.
addons.title: Mahayogi

addons.text:
The fruits of your ninja training has earned you mastery over the ancient art of Bushinryu Ninjutsu. This lets you apply all the skills you’ve learnt to their full potential, with near flawless precision.

Your fundamental tool is your speed, used to overwhelm your opponent with rapid strikes from various directions, make mix-ups with fakeouts, forcing them into giving you a free opening, manipulating the battlefield to your advantage, and laying waste to them with devastating combos. 

You may choose to follow tradition like the practitioners Guy, Maki and Kairi. Or develop your own personal flair like Ibuki, Kimerbly, or Hokuto.
addons.title: Bushinryu

addons.text:
In addition to the powers of the Devil Gene, you've also gained the powers of the Satsui no Hado. Granting you strength akin to Akuma himself, alongside the abilities of telekinesis, telepathy, an enhanced healing factor, as well as sensing and absorbing other sources of power. 

You also know all of Akuma’s techniques, starting with his variations of the Hadouken, Tatsumaki-Senpyukaku, and Shoryuken. All usable in the air, can be used consecutively, and charged to be more powerful. As well as aggression focused style to constantly keep up pressure, break guards, predict movements, and use your opponent’s attacks against them.

You also know the infamous Raging Demon to close in on your target, and instantly rain hell on them, and can awaken the Satsui no Hado within others.

By delving deeper into it, you can enter a state akin to Shin Akuma, and at your peak, Oni. Forms that amplify your power to godlike degrees. But be warned, as to experience this power, you must abandon your humanity. Forgo those weaknesses in favor of nothing more than the thrill of battle and conquest.
addons.title: Shun Goku Satsu

addons.text: "Well then, where do you want me to break you first?" You have a copy of the Feng Shui Engine, a device implanted into your eye socket that grants you the martial prowess and enhancements of Juri Han. Your strength, speed, and reaction times have increased dramatically, allowing you to seamlessly combo your attacks at breakneck speeds, and shatter someone's bones on impact. Your Ki has been equally bolstered, and can also be projected from your kicks instead of just your hands. Finally, you gain skill in Taekwondo equal to Juri, with all of her techniques.
addons.title: Feng Shui Engine

addons.text: "Now... What poison should I test on you?" You've incorporated your poisons for combat with the same prowess as both A.K.I and her teacher F.A.N.G. To start, you've created specialized gauntlets that store the poisons you excerte, with a host of features for releasing them. From simple claws, injectors, gas pumps, and extending fingerblades that can be manipulated telekinetically. Just to name a few. You've also becme a master of Poison Hand Kenpo, and Kung Fu, specifically the Crane and Snake style, with all of A.K.I and F.A.N.G.'s techniques.
addons.title: A.K.I
The World's Strongest (Wo)Man
addons.text:
Your enhancements make you on par with some of the physically strongest characters in Street Fighter, like Zangief, Akuma, Chun-Li, Cammy White or Guile. As well as grant a natural talent in using Shotokan, mastering any other martial arts from the series, and executing them flawlessly. Your potential and ability to use Ki is also enhanced from a greater capacity and output as a byproduct of your body.

You can just as easily perform techniques like Chun-Li's rapid fire kicks as you can move as fast as Cammy, lift as much as Zangief as you can strike as hard as Juri, and even replicate Vega or Balanka's unorthadox techniques. 

You may freely combine all of this to create your own unique fighting style, and don't be surprised if you receive recruitments from certain organizations.

objects.text:
Created in the feudal era as an assassination art, this style has evolved into the ultimate style for martial arts purists. 

You probably already know some of the core techniques: the Hadoken, a powerful Ki blast, the Shoryuken, an uppercut enhanced with Ki flames, and the Tatsumaki-Senpyukaku, a spinning kick capable of ending most fights on its own.

Your Ki is derived from one of two sources, which you can switch on the fly, although mastering one completely is superior to switching at a whim. There is the ominous Ki of the Satsui no Hado, the original method of this art, famously used by Akuma. There is also the pure Ki of the Kyoi no Hado, created by Gouken & most famously used by Ryu.
objects.title: Goutetsu Style Shotokan Karate (Street Fighter)

addons.text:
Through becoming one with nature, you inadvertently became the incarnation of a long gone deity named, Orochi. Through channeling his power you gain command over the forces of nature, starting at the same level as his Four Heavenly Kings; Goenitz who controlled wind, Yashiro who controlled earth, Shermie who controlled lightning, and Chris who controlled fire. 

All of these elements are strong enough to drastically alter the landscape around you, such as generating miniature tornados, causing small earthquakes, calling lightning from the sky, and summoning pillars of purple flames. You also gain their fighting styles and techniques, including his other Hakkeshu; Mature, Vice, and Ryuji Yamazaki. 

You can willingly activate the Riot of the Blood, a state that dyes your hair red, turns your pupils white, and significantly boosts your physical abilities. Your hands also gain slashing properties, effectively becoming claws despite not having them. In time, you can attain power akin to Orochi himself, gaining control over the other forces of nature and unlocking his other abilities like teleportation, telepathy, levitation, and more.
addons.title: Orochi Reborn

objects.text:
You have now learned both scrolls of the powerful Qigong art, Hakkyokuseiken, allowing you to manipulate your qi for uses like telekinesis, channeling energy into your strikes, creating and manipulating the elements with your qi, making yourself physically larger, immortality, & many other techniques.

The most effective use of it, however, is to empower an existing martial arts style with your qi. Hence, you have also been given mastery of every martial arts style that has ever been used with Hakkyokuseiken, including but not limited to the original style's Baijiquan Kung Fu, Andy's Koppouken & Shiranui style Ninjutsu, Terry's MMA, & the Aikijujutsu-Karate hybrid of Geese Howard.
objects.title: Hakkyokuseiken (King of Fighters)

addons.text:
Your expertise in martial arts has expanded beyond the Mishima Style of Karate, and has incorporated all other martial arts the other members of the Mishima family have learned, making you a master of Kazama Style Traditional Martial Arts, Karate, Tekken Force's Martial Art, Taidō and more.

Not only that, but you have become a carrier of the Devil Gene—a genetic abnormality that allows one to become a host to a parasitic malignant spirit that transforms someone into a literal Devil made physical. Originally carried by the Hachijo Clan, it found itself in the Mishimas, which brought decades of turmoil.

However, through the will of Mishima and Purification of Kazama, you have not only bested the spirit but made its power your own; now, you can transform into a Devil and Angel form at will to enhance your abilities, along with flight capable of reaching space and firing energy beams powerful enough to bring down satellites.

By defeating supernatural foes, you can take some of their power and add it to your own. While not gaining special skills or powers, it will continue to enhance what you already possess. In time, you will have the power to rule the world with an Iron Fist.
addons.title: King of the Iron Fist

addons.text: Your organization has greatly expanded, making it equal to the Mishima Zaibatsu. While the original 300 teams personally serve you they also direct several companies to spread your influence and power.
addons.title: Mishima Zaibatsu

addons.text: You now know how to create all the technology that exists in Tekken universe, this include Jack series robots, NANCY, Androids, Combot, Cryonics, Supersoldier Program, Devil-Human Integration Program, Orbital Laser Satellite, Supercomputers, Genetically modified animals, GENOCELL and more.
addons.title: Tekken Tech (Tekken)

objects.text:
Welcome to the Mishima Clan, where the men greet each other with a punch to the face instead of hugs.

You have been trained extensively in Mishima Style Fighting Karate, giving you the ability to take down whole squads of well-armored fighters and advanced machines of war, as well as having enough stamina to take on a world-class martial artist who could be considered your peer. All of that before factoring in your use of ki, allowing you to enhance your abilities to catch bullets with your teeth, shatter steel with those same teeth, and generate lightning to enhance your physical attacks.

Your durability is not something to scoff at either, being able to survive being thrown off of giant stone cliffs several times, being caught in the middle of an explosion strong enough to destroy buildings, and sending you flying off into the distance before landing with minor injuries. But it's better to get not hit at all—you have a reaction time to keep up with foes who use lasers, as you can dodge them with minimal movement, and if evasion is impossible, you can block to minimize the damage.

But should you be injured enough, around a quarter of your health, you can use Rage Arts to boost your attacks. The closer you are to death, the more powerful your Rage Arts become. Beware as Rage Arts can be a gamble that may cost you more than a match.

Through this training, your spirit and determination have grown leaps and bounds, giving you the courage to face foes who by all rights should be your betters, and defeat them. Even if you come under the possession of a demon or spirit, you can not only fight it off but have a chance to take back control. Potentially, you will be able to push forward after being hit with an attack that would destroy your soul through sheer stubbornness alone, at least for a time.

However, the Mishimas aren't a bunch of brutes. Rather, they are quite intelligent, able to run a multinational billion-dollar company(s) competently along with learning other languages to better understand what their opponents in a martial arts tournament are saying. This is a trait you share as well; the more powerful you become, the easier it becomes for you to learn and master new skills.

May you be a worthy heir to the Mishima name.
objects.title: Mishima Heir (Tekken)

objects.text:
Hokuto Shinken is the ultimate assassination martial art. This feared legendary martial art employs a deadly form of combat that targets the body's pressure points to cause various effects, including instant death and healing. Through the study and use of this martial art, users will gain greatly increased physical and mental ability.

Practitioners learn how to access and channel Toki, a weak form of Ki, able to empower themselves a fair deal beyond normal humans and perform supernatural techniques. One such technique is the signature Dragon Breathing technique, which allows users to increase their strength by 70% by unlocking their body's limits. Another signature technique is the Water Reflection Spirit, which allows the user to copy martial techniques of others. Strong emotions may play a role in allowing the user to tap into greater power during times of great need.

There exist countless techniques within Hokuto Shinken that typically cause incredible injuries, paralysis, or make people violently explode. However, note that while Hokuto Shinken is a martial art used for assassination first and foremost—it's, in fact, able to do the opposite and heal others through pressing specific pressure points on someone.

You begin with strength and ability equal to Kenshiro at the beginning of his Journey after completing his main training in Hokuto Shinken. This includes physical strength like being able to topple skyscrapers easily, and move faster than the speed of sound.

You also gain all knowledge of other assassination arts from the series, such as Nanto Seiken, though you will need to train and master them yourself. Lastly, be aware that using Hokuto Shinken on a nonhuman target may require a small amount of time to find the correct pressure points.
objects.title: Hokuto Shinken (Fist Of The North Star)

addons.text: The styles of Hermits and Demon Slayers have fused and strengthened each other. Each breath you take energizes you, restores your stamina and heals you. This allows you to go on almost endlessly in battle as long as you can still breathe.
addons.title: One Breath

addons.text:
Your talent and ability with Hamon has allowed you to recreate the Seven Heavens Breathing Method with your chakra system.

Developed by Shira of Sunagakure, it is a taijutsu breathing method that allows one to gather up large amounts of oxygen to increase one's lung capacity fourfold, granting one strength similar to the Eighth Gates, even including similar physical changes to the user.

Your proficiency with the breathing method is on par with Shira, who could block Neji's Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms with just one hand, along with Lee's kicks at the same time with his other hand, and fight on par with Lee later in the fight who had opened five of the Gates. You are also granted the same level of mastery as his original taijutsu, the Silent Fist, which lets him strike with no sound by masking it with chakra, making it almost impossible for his attacks to be anticipated.

Note: There have been no indications that this technique has the same repercussions as the Eight Gates.
addons.title: Seven Heavens Breathing Method (Naruto)

addons.text: The art of Hamon is the practice of using controlled breathing to create and harness a form of which is identical to the energy of the sun, manifesting as ripples. The magic of Mundus is sourced from the sun, a tear in reality leading to Aetherius - the realm of pure light and magic - through which magical energy flows. Thus, it could be said that magical energy is the energy of the sun. You have taken this truth and integrated it into your practice, changing the way your Sendo interacts with magic. Your Hamon and magical energy are now the same, each able to be used in the other’s place with no loss, allowing you to effectively create magical energy through breathing. Your Sendo can be transmitted through magical energy with startling ease and, with practice, can be used to modify or interfere with magic, utilizing ripples to alter the structure of a magical effect. As you continue to practice this version of Sendo and your connection to Aetherius deepens, with time you will find yourself becoming a living gate to Aetherius - albeit a small one - which can have profound effects on your magic.
addons.title: Echo of Magnus

addons.text:
By combining Hamon's breathing with the Spin, you learn to circulate Hamon in stable rotational patterns rather than simply allowing it to flow outward and dissipate. As long as the rotation is maintained, Hamon can remain stored and circulating within a spun object or technique, letting Steel Balls, projectiles, threads, liquids, or even parts of your own body continue carrying Hamon after leaving your direct contact.

This also lets the Spin repeatedly drive the same Hamon through a target with each rotation, turning techniques that would normally deliver a single pulse into sustained effects. With sufficient mastery, you can redirect or recycle this circulating Hamon between linked rotations, greatly expanding the kinds of techniques the two arts can produce together. The Spin's demanding control provides a secondary benefit of making your Hamon more precise, but does not inherently increase your talent or raw power.
addons.title: Breath of Rotation

objects.text: You are proficient in the ancient Tibetan martial art of Sendo, essentially a form of mixed martial arts based around Hamon, with talent and potential in Hamon on par with Jonathan Joestar, capable of creating new techniques mid-combat. On top of that, you will naturally gain a mighty physique, whether this translates to a bulky body like Jonathan's or a slimmer but still muscular body like Straizo, Joseph Joestar, or Caesar Zeppeli is up to you. As a bonus, perhaps thanks to your expertise in Sendo, aiding in your balance and poise, you can pose with the best of them.
objects.title: Sendo (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

addons.text: Having learned the secret of the Golden Ratio, you subconsciously arrange your 108 skill slots into a shape which follows the Golden Rectangle within your soul. As a result, you may channel the Spin through any of your 108 skills, allowing you to impart rotational energy through anything you do with them. As your mastery of the Spin grows, so too does the power of this rotation.
addons.title: Fibonacci Configuration

objects.text: You know how to use the Spin, able to follow the Golden Rectangle to use a simple object like a marble or corkscrew as a potent projectile or to harden your body to the extent of making you bulletproof. Eventually, you may unlock a Stand through mastering the Spin, and if you're lucky, you may get a Stand that would allow you to bypass Scion's dimensional barrier, however the rest of his defenses are a concern you'd need other powers to work around (Even with Sting, you wouldn't be putting out enough damage to kill Scion in a reasonable time frame) and while it is deceptively easy to learn the basics of the Spin, it is extremely difficult to master.
objects.title: The Spin (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

addons.text: Your superhuman lung capacity makes you the ideal practitioner of the breathing technique, significantly amplifying the physical power boost it provides. While using it, you become four times stronger than a Demon Slayer of the same mastery level. If you possess Golden Age Slayer or unlock the Demon Slayer Mark through training, the mark’s activation grants you a ×40 multiplier instead of ×10, while also minimizing the risks inherent in using your Slayer Mark. With True Monster, the power boost from the Slayer Mark increases to a ×60 multiplier, and you can maintain the Mark’s activation indefinitely without any negative side effects.
addons.title: Enhanced Breath

addons.text: Instead of gripping your blade with tremendous force, obtaining a Demon Slayer Mark, or clashing with a swordsman of similar power, you can dye your Nichirin Weapon bright red through Sword Intent. Which also means, you can do it at will. At the beginner level, your Nichirin Weapon's cutting force will become two to three times stronger, allowing it to decapitate Lower Moon Demons in one strike. As your proficiency grows, this will upscale to do the same to Upper Moon Demons and beyond, as well as increase the cutting force multiplier. Beyond just that, Sword Intent can also augment your Breathing Styles. For example, you can project devastating slashes across space with Wind Breathing. Generate incredibly intense fire on the blade with Flame or Sun Breathing. Cause potent electric shocks, create powerful blasts of thunder, and/or project blasts of lightning for ranged attacks with Thunder Breathing, and so on. If you have Golden Age Slayer or True Monster, you can reach these heights immediately or improve them even further.
addons.title: Bright Red Sword

objects.text:
You may select any existing Breathing Style or make your own; you start at the level of post-Demon Mountain Tanjiro with whichever Style you pick. In addition, you gain a powerful sense equal to Tanjiro's smell or Zenitsu's hearing.

You can select multiple Styles, though keep in mind that unless boosted physically by other powers, stronger Breathing Styles will be more stamina-intensive, such as Stone, Moon, Sun, etc. You can eventually train to be at the level of a Hashira with extreme diligence and effort for extended periods. It also comes with a Nichirin weapon of your choosing. This weapon works with upgrades that affect Objects of Power.
objects.title: Total Concentration Breathing (Demon Slayer)

addons.text: You are the closest thing to a physical God, for you alone have mastered and combined every physical class's abilities from the worlds of D&D and Pathfinder. Your might and skill surpass even those who have reached the status of Aeon, allowing you to effortlessly defeat legendary monsters like the Tarrasque with ease. Your mastery of each style of combat enables you to teach others what you have learned, making even those who lack talent shine as heroes.
addons.title: God of War

objects.text:
You are proficient in the use of the Sublime Way. You start out at the level of a beginner of the Sublime Way (equivalent to 1st level Martial powers). You are not limited to any class, and instead, can develop any class features available to the various physical classes across Pathfinder and D&D, allowing you access to classes in the Book of War, the Tome of Battle: Book of Nine Swords, and much more.

Through practice, study, reflection, and training, you can increase the number of martial powers you know, their level, class features, unique feats, and even improve your physical, mental, and spiritual condition.
objects.title: Sublime Way (D&D)

objects.text:
Profound is the irony for the peaceful Buddhists to seek conflict, but these Monks have abandoned the righteous path and seek immortality through vile and heretical means.

You gain mastery of martial training in the Senpou Temple school of martial arts. You’re a master with your hands, feet, polearms, and all Senpou arts. In addition, your martial arts have buffed you to superhuman heights, capable of shattering stone walls, blocking similar attacks with your bare hands, and moving at supersonic speeds.
objects.title: Senpou Arts (Sekiro)

addons.text:
Through your talent, rigorous training, and your ability to use magic with the bow, you have managed to recreate the ability to summon lightning from the sky, as developed by Genichiro's Mentor—Tomoe.

While she gained this ability through her skill with the sword, you have managed to do so with your skill with the bow. Because of your training, your magical power has also increased, letting you shoot arrows made of magical lightning. The power of these lightning arrows is strong enough to pierce through fortresses and obliterate battalions of soldiers.

Due to your adaptability with switching between sword and bow mid-battle, you have learned to direct lightning with your blade, as well as become incredibly resistant to lightning attacks (though not immune).
addons.title: Way of Tomoe

addons.text: "Combat, when brought to a truly impressive level, is like a dance. So why couldn't a dance, when mastered to perfection, be like a battle art?" Shadow Dance is an insidious, ever-changing, and shapeless battle style that absorbs the essence of opposing techniques. Rather than merely mimicry, it internalizes their core principles, turning an enemy's strength against them. You seamlessly weave the best aspects of each style into your own, refining your combat with every encounter. If a style is supernatural in origin, then only its more mundane and physical aspects will be copied—unless you possess a compatible energy source to use it properly. Simple techniques are absorbed quickly, while complex styles take longer to master. Even non-combat movements can be weaponized if fluid enough—a nod to Shadow Dance's origins as a temple dance before becoming a lethal art. Sometimes, a single encounter is enough to unravel and incorporate an entire style. By analyzing an opponent's technique, you uncover weaknesses and exploit openings with surgical precision. Its unpredictable nature and constant evolution make Shadow Dance nearly impossible to counter. As your foundation grows, you can incorporate the movements of non-human creatures, from dragons to flies to magic space whales, forging a combat style that is both rigid and fluid, graceful yet brutal, familiar yet alien. You'll begin at the level of an Awakened Sunless, with Immortal Flame and Stone Saint swordsmanship already woven into your arsenal.
addons.title: Shadow Dance

addons.text:
You gain the abilities and experience of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. This allows you to mix Sorcery and Swordsmanship in combat, into a deadly mixture. You also gain Rellana's swordsmanship style, focused on sweeping lunges and thrusts accompanied by both melee and ranged sorcery. You gain all of Rellana's experience with combat and sorceries, and are talented in creating your own melee sorceries.

You are familiar with all melee sorceries in the Soulsborne Series, such as Adula's Moonblade and Soul Greatsword. Furthermore, you can cast any sorcery originating from Caria, including sorceries such as Ranni's Dark Moon, Carian Phalanx, and Carian Slicer. You also have several unique sword sorceries: creating arc-shaped projectiles as you swing, a trail of pale blue light behind your sword dealing extra damage, twin moons which create giant explosions of energy, and a large pillar of light centered around yourself.

Any sorcery you cast is massively amplified. While normally a spell such as Renalla's Full Moon would tear through a wall when cast by a decent mage, yours could explode to fill an entire arena. A simple Carian Greatsword would be the length of a school bus. This also massively speeds up your time to cast, allowing you to perform the calculations for spells near instantly, even during intense combat.

You also gain a resistance to all types of magic and a boost to your health. This allows you to maintain focus on combat and cast spells even while getting hit.

You also gain all of Rellana's gear, comprising a set of magic-resistant armor, and 2 Carian swords which are catalysts for sorceries. One of the swords can set itself ablaze and launch massive projectiles of flame, as well as incinerate the area around you in an enormous explosion. The other contains an enchantment which increases its ability to pierce through magic-resistant defenses and amplifies the number of projectiles from sorceries by 3x.
addons.title: Sword of Messmer

objects.text:
Having undergone rigorous training in the Ashina school, you have mastered the art of the sword. In this renowned school, the philosophy ingrained in you is that a clash of blades is not merely a collision but rather akin to the graceful dance of a carp in motion.

Under the tutelage of your mentors, you were taught to emulate the fluid movements of flowing water, drawing inspiration from the majestic fountains and embodying the spirit of rivers and waves in your swordplay. This unique approach has allowed you to develop a seamless and adaptable style, effortlessly transitioning from offense to defense and counterattack, much like the uninterrupted flow of water. Moreover, your training has extended to archery as well, broadening your skills further.

With your extensive training and relentless dedication, you have reached a level of proficiency comparable to that of Genichiro, a formidable adversary renowned for his martial prowess. Your abilities as a swordsman are highly regarded, and you stand as an equal to him in combat.
objects.title: Ashina Arts (Sekiro)

addons.text:
You learn how to create the various supernatural items featured in Sekiro, from Buddhist Sugars & Medicine Pills, to Sculptor Idols & magic Gourds, to multifunctional prosthetic arms. Even the artificial Dragon's Heritage is within your reach.

This also gives you mastery of all techniques from the Prosthetic Arts Esoteric Text.
addons.title: Prosthetic Arts

addons.text:
You now bear a tattoo with the ink of the Sumi Flower. Of course, you can choose to have the Sumi Flower extract injected into your skin without taking the shape of something visible like a tattoo, but the tattoo comes standard.

You now have the powers granted by the Sumi Flower, including senses beyond any human, incredible speed that behaves like teleporting, and mental acuity that makes it seem like time stops while making a decision or preparing an action, as well as the combat, stealth, movement, and tool techniques of the Hisomu clan.

This is more stable than the canon version, and will not slowly drive you insane. You can still optionally hallucinate Ora as a helpful tulpa if you wish.
addons.title: The Mark (Mark of the Ninja)

objects.text:
Once, a curious shinobi questioned the relevance of swordsmanship when direct confrontations seemed unlikely. Regrettably, that shinobi's fate met a violent end. However, this incident sheds light on the importance of the Way of the Shinobi, a formidable art embraced by ninjas. While it may not possess the sheer potency of the Ashina school, the Way of the Shinobi thrives in situations demanding direct combat.

The foundation of this style revolves around unsettling adversaries and dismantling their defenses. Expertise in parrying and countering allows the practitioner to exploit vulnerabilities, seeking to unbalance opponents and penetrate their guard. Consequently, the Way of the Shinobi appears to be more defensively inclined, tailored for duels rather than large-scale warfare.

Through arduous training, you have become a master of this unique combat form. Your keen perception allows you to discern weaknesses in your opponent's stance, enabling you to exploit them flawlessly. You create windows of opportunity for precise and decisive "Deathblows," the strikes that spell the end for your adversaries.

As the master of the Way of the Shinobi, you possess the prowess to identify and exploit openings, capitalizing on them with lethal efficiency. Through your calculated movements, you wield the power to deliver the definitive blow that seals the fate of your opponents. This mastery also encompasses basic proficiency in the other arts of the shinobi i.e silent movement, presence suppression, infiltration, misdirection, and rudimentary knowledge of the shinobi texts.

You start on par with early-game Sekiro.
objects.title: Way of the Shinobi (Sekiro)

addons.text:
You gain all the skills and abilities of Jūbei Kibagami. You may also gain his memories and decide how they affect you, if at all. You possess superhuman strength, speed and resilience. You are a master swordsman, capable of analyzing an opponent’s weaknesses and turning their own strengths against them.

You are proficient in stealth, throwing weapons and the use of wires, which can be attached to your sword or bracers for weapon retrieval or grappling. You are equally deadly in close-quarters combat even without your sword.

Finally, you gain his Wind Slash Technique. With this ability, you can cut the very air with a single slash, creating a vacuum. Typically used as an iaijutsu technique, it is extremely fast, difficult to dodge and possesses great range.
addons.title: Jūbei (Ninja Scroll)

addons.text:
Your understanding of Jūbei's Edo-era ninjutsu has been supplemented with a much wider range of earlier Sengoku-era precursors, allowing you to reverse engineer many other Edo-era techniques. You may also gain the memories & skills of the former users of these techniques.

This includes giving one's skin the hardness of stone & possessing the might of ten men, making oneself immune to poison, making your skin and bodily fluids alternately poisonous or a form of antidote or panacea, storing & controlling deadly insects, spitting needles, summoning snakes from tattoos on your body, as well as shedding your skin, & controlling or turning into a mass of those snakes, traps & explosive techniques, super-hearing that acts almost as a substitute for sight, projecting electricity, summoning & manipulating miles long monofilament wires for multiple purposes (like communication or traps), merging with shadows, super-hypnosis, creating temporary clones, camouflage skin, illusions, supernatural stretching, teleportation within line of sight, & most impressive of all, cellular control that allows for both shapeshifting & regenerative immortality.
addons.title: Shogun Of The Dark (Ninja Scroll)

objects.text:
You have mastered the Bakumatsu period's deadliest sword art, Hiten Mitsurugi-ryū, on a level equivalent to Hiko Seijūrō XIII.
