Described as a "sword style for supermen", the foundation of this technique is its unbelievable speed, which cannot be seen with the naked eye. It requires extreme athleticism to wield properly, destroying the bodies of those too weak to properly wield it. You will not have this problem, as your body becomes athletic enough to handle even the most dangerous techniques.

It comes with a limited combat precognition that relies on using your ki to "read" your enemies.

It also somehow keeps its practitioners unnaturally young, with Himura Kenshin, who hadn't even properly mastered the style, looking like he did at 15 even at the age of 33.
objects.title: Hiten Mitsurugi-ryū (Ruroni Kenshin)

objects.text:
You have gone through the intense physical training and sword training to become proficient with Roronoa Zoro's Three Sword Style.

Your current mastery is at the same level of skill and strength that Zoro obtained after training with Mihawk (post-timeskip). This power also comes with a prodigious skill with swordplay, allowing you to quickly reach the greater heights Zoro achieves later in the series.

(Note: This power works well with any supernatural power that enhances your physique, besides Haki.)
objects.title: Three Sword Style (One Piece)

addons.text: You gain the ability to use an enhanced version of the Seimei Kikan or Life Return. This rare martial ability from the world of One Piece allows its user to control every part of their body in ways that ignore normal human biology and physics. With this ability, you could control your hair like limbs, change your body mass, instantly digest food, and heal yourself. The Seimei Kikan also drastically enhances the Hercules Method, allowing you to master it more quickly and use it not only much more easily but also quickly. The Hercules Method loses its typically sluggish healing and speed of use and instead evolves into something almost Zanny, quoting Looney Tunes. This combined discipline allows you to apply One Piece logic to yourself, which takes the form of a semi-limited Toon Force focused entirely on your body.
addons.title: Seimei Kikan (One Piece)

objects.text:
You are now adept at the superhuman martial arts style used by the World Government Marines & Cipher Pol agents—Rokushiki. This doesn’t include the Rokuogan, but you do possess the knowledge to be able to master every technique and develop your own variations of each technique.

Rokushiki consists of six basic techniques—each technique enhances an aspect of the user's body. The Rokushiki, in the hands of an experienced user, make for a formidable opponent.

<u>Geppo</u> is the first technique of the Rokushiki, focusing on the user’s jumping ability. It grants the user a form of ‘flight’ by jumping and kicking off of the air itself.

<u>Tekkai</u> is the second technique of the Rokushiki, focusing on the user’s endurance and durability. It lets the user harden their muscles to at least the level of iron, allowing them to withstand the damage of an opponent's attacks.

<u>Rankyaku</u> is the third technique of the Rokushiki, focusing on the user’s kicking strength. This technique allows the user to generate scything blades of wind, typically through the strength of their kicks.

<u>Soru</u> is the fourth technique of the Rokushiki, focusing on the user’s speed. Soru allows the user to move at high speeds, allowing them to avoid an enemy's attack. Soru works by the speed of a user’s kicks—the faster one can kick, the faster one can travel via Soru.

<u>Shigan</u> is the fifth technique of the Rokushiki, focusing on the user’s arm strength. Shigan is used to enhance the user’s arms, particularly the fingers. This allows the user to rapidly thrust their arms forward to pierce through their targets with their finger. This results in a wound similar to that caused by a bullet.

<u>Kami-e</u> is the sixth technique of the Rokushiki, focusing on the user’s flexibility. Kami-e allows the user to relax their body and make it take on characteristics of paper. This grants the user extraordinary flexibility to avoid attacks. Being in this state allows the user to float on the wind, and bend and contort their body in unusual ways.
objects.title: Rokushiki (One Piece)

objects.text:
A martial art developed and refined by the Straw Hat Pirates' cook, Sanji. The Black Leg Style originates from the combat philosophy and kicking techniques taught to him by Red-Leg Zeff, revolving entirely around the use of the legs in combat. 

As a chef, Sanji avoids using his hands for fighting, instead preserving them for cooking and utilizing them only to aid his mobility through acrobatic movements, flips, and handstands that enhance the power, reach, and unpredictability of his attacks.

Focused exclusively on kicks, this martial art possesses an extensive and highly adaptable repertoire of techniques. Powerful strikes, rapid combinations, aerial assaults, and sweeping attacks can be chained together fluidly, allowing a practitioner to pressure opponents without pause, engage multiple enemies at once, and maintain exceptional mobility throughout a fight. Its emphasis on agility and balance makes it as effective for maneuvering around the battlefield as it is for delivering devastating blows.

You have trained extensively in the Black Leg Style, acquiring the skills, experience, and instincts needed to wield it effectively. Your current proficiency is comparable to Sanji's upon his return from the two-year training period on Okama Island.
objects.title: Black Leg Style (One Piece)

objects.text:
You have survived the hellish training of the ninja village and emerged as a superhuman master of ninjutsu.

Not only have you gained immense mastery over all the weapons a ninja is expected to use and the art of assassination, but you have also become an expert martial artist and swordsman.

Thanks to your grueling training, your body now possesses enhanced senses, immense strength, and durability. Most importantly, you can move with the blinding speed that is the specialty of all ninjas from the village.

You can casually move and attack at hypersonic speeds, easily reaching Mach 50, and react to others moving at similar speeds.

Additionally, as someone with talent comparable to Flashy Flash, you need only a few more years of training to reach his level.
objects.title: Ninja Village Training (One Punch Man)

objects.text: A martial art created and taught by Bomb, the older brother of Bang and a martial arts master. This style has a focus on manipulating and creating razor-like blades of pressurized air that are fully capable of slicing the user's target apart. The pieces of the target are then pushed with various amounts of force relative to their proximity to the center of the whirlwind. Your mastery of this technique is enough to elicit a pinkish-red aura that trails around your extremities, similar to the aura associated with the Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist. Your initial grasp of the techniques of this martial art is comparable to Garou's, but will eventually grow to be greater than Bomb's.
objects.title: Whirlwind Iron Cutting Fist (One Punch Man)

addons.text: The combination of Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist, Total Concentration Breathing, and Hamon has reached a new level. Every breath you take empowers you to be slightly greater than you were before. Your physical capabilities are many times above what would previously be your maximum and can grow without limit. Any spiritual or mystical powers are likewise empowered with your every breath, with you having amazing reserves of energy and a seemingly supernatural talent. As you have complete awareness and control of your body, you will never lose balance and always be able to remain in fighting form.
addons.title: True Breathing

addons.text: Your mastery of Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist and Whirlwind Iron Cutting Fist has grown leaps and bounds, allowing you to use them simultaneously. This combination is enough to allow you to fight and win over Dragon-level threats, or even greater. Combining these techniques, one in your left hand and the other in your right, allows you to use the Roaring Aura Sky Ripping Fist technique. This technique sends incredible shockwaves through the body of the target, destroying them from within, and is capable of overcoming otherwise indomitable defenses. Pushing these martial arts further will allow the use of the Cross Fang Dragon Slayer Fist, an even more potent combination technique.
addons.title: Dual-Wielding Martial Arts

addons.text: You have mastered the art of breathing. Specifically: completely and utterly saturating your body with oxygen, bringing out and leaving behind the normal limits of your body. Not only do your physical attributes attain a beyond-perfect state, but your thought processes and reaction times attain an equal level, allowing your mind to keep up with your body and keep pace with those who would normally fully outclass you. However, you should be warned: pushing your body to such an extreme burns through your stamina reserves at nearly an equal pace to your physical boost, leaving you vulnerable once the technique wears off.
addons.title: Total Concentration Awakening Breathing

objects.text: Created by the S-Class Hero, Bang, this martial art stands as the ultimate defensive art that perfectly blends offense and defense. This art seeks to recreate the flows of torrential and undulating forces within one's body. Your mastery of this art reveals itself in the blue water-like aura that trails after your hands and other extremities. You have a perfect grasp of deflecting or redirecting an opponent's attack at twice the power. Your ability to redirect incoming attacks allows you to protect yourself from attacks that are notably more powerful than you are otherwise; however, even this feature of the art has its limits. Your initial mastery is comparable to Garou's and will grow to match and eventually eclipse even Bang's in time.
objects.title: Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist (One Punch Man)

objects.text:
You possess, within you, a superb talent and skill for the martial arts. You are fully capable of adapting to other people's fighting styles and finding counters to them in the middle of combat. Your ability to learn martial arts is in the realm of the supernatural, allowing you to quickly ascertain the fundamentals of other martial art styles. A single encounter is enough to make another's martial art one of your own, and even reading a martial arts scroll briefly is enough to pick up a martial art.

You have two notable martial arts in your repertoire:
Exploding Heart Release Fist: a dangerous martial art that relies on subjugating one's target through brute force and destructive power. Tuning your heart rhythm to beat explosively in time with your strikes allows you to flood your body with adrenaline and briefly surpass the limits of your body. The sheer power of your strikes produces shockwaves that can overcome nearly perfect defensive martial arts.

Void Fist: a martial art aiming to maximize the destructive power of one's strikes while maintaining a high output of attacks. It features many rotating and twisting motions to extend and/or magnify its attack damage.
objects.title: Master Martial Artist (One Punch Man)

addons.text:
Your swordsmanship has broken through the limits of flesh, technique, and perception. With the Sun and Moon blades empowered by your breathing styles, you have forged a cosmic art that transcends ordinary combat.

Your blade gleams with starlight, your movements shimmer with afterimages of moonlight and flame. You are no god, but to those who face you, it feels as if the cosmos itself were cutting them down.

Your techniques reach beyond speed. Each strike is faster than light, delivered with such precision that causality itself struggles to keep pace. If you deem something must be cut, it will be cut — steel, stone, atoms, even intangible forces like energy or barriers. Against you, durability and distance lose meaning; your intent is the edge.

Your innate mastery of the blade and the ability to teach anyone the art of the sword, combined with the Transparent World and Selfless State, grant you perception that borders on precognition. You see every possibility of your opponent’s movement and erase them with flawless precision. To them, your blade is inevitability — they are already defeated the moment you move.

Yet your art is not static. Like the True Monster, you can create and refine techniques on instinct, shaping entirely new sword styles in the heat of combat. Each battle hones your cosmic swordplay further, each breath bringing you closer to perfection.

You are not a divine avatar nor a vessel of borrowed power. You are the summit of mortal swordsmanship: the Cosmic Blade, a will honed to such purity that it cuts the universe itself.
addons.title: Cosmic Blade

objects.text:
You possess the skills, powers, and abilities of Kamikaze, or more commonly known as the Atomic Samurai, one of the highest-ranked S-Class heroes.

Your speed, strength, stamina and durability are massively enhanced. You can casually move and attack at hypersonic speeds, cut cleanly through solid matter with your sword, and unleash powerful shockwaves with a single slash, striking enemies just beyond your weapon’s reach. You can endure blows that would kill even most superhumans—but your greatest weapon is your unparalleled swordsmanship.

You are a master swordsman. Your iconic move, Atomic Slash, is a rapid storm of ultra-fast strikes concentrated on a single target. In less than a heartbeat, you can land hundreds of perfectly placed cuts, each aimed to weaken armor, sever vital tendons, cut softer targets into perfect cubes or decapitate outright.

However, your swordsmanship has limits — you cannot slice between the gaps of individual cells, but with training and experience, even this and more may become possible.

Additionally, you gain the Sun and Moon blades and become a master at teaching the art of swordsmanship, capable of raising disciples that could reach the vaunted S-Class, the same as their master.
objects.title: Atomic Samurai (One Punch Man)

objects.text:
This is the premier martial art created by the greatest hero of Greece, Hercules. While it originally started out as a technique he created to use with his bow and arrows to simultaneously exterminate all one hundred heads of the Lernaean Hydra, an immortal nine-headed serpent that would grow back no matter how many times it was cut down, it succeeded. Upon slaying the Hydra at the end of a lengthy battle, Heracles devised this combat technique and expanded it to be usable with any weapon. It transformed from a combat technique into "Heracles Style: Shooting the Hundred Heads," an all-purpose Noble Phantasm capable of adapting and changing its appearance depending on the target and the circumstances of its use. Just as with the Hydra, which had the circumstance of "resurrecting no matter how many times it is killed," this martial art adapted the trait "exterminates no matter how many times the opponent resurrects."

Upon gaining this, you have a basic level of mastery with every armament in existence, regardless of whether it is delivered with a bow, large sword, shield, spear, axe, or possibly even unarmed. The greatest aspect of this technique isn't its ability to adapt, but its ability to draw out the maximum power of any weapon it's used with, whether that be a bow, sword, shield, or spear. This makes them the greatest of their type in the moment the style is used with them. This is what puts this art on par with Noble Phantasms.

At complete mastery, you can display power from Anti-Unit to Anti-Army, and even up to fortress sieging, all depending on the target. Anti-Unit Nine Lives Blade Works with a series of slashes and the Anti-Phantasm Beast skill that discharges nine dragon-like homing lasers at the enemy. It's described as "a high-speed attack consisting of nine consecutive strikes, as swift as if the attacks are overlapping." Similarly, just like with the Hydra, there are one hundred simultaneous attacks that cancel out regeneration.
objects.title: Heracles Style Nine Lives: Shooting the Hundred Heads (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Through intense training alongside your Guardian Angel, using only Jacob's Limbs and constantly facing them in combat, you have managed to master this martial art, reaching the level of the ancient masters who once perfected it, such as Saint Martha, Noah, and Jacob himself.

Furthermore, your Guardian Angel has taught you techniques and fighting styles such as Jacob's Perishing Fist and Pacifying Raging Beasts, techniques developed by those who once mastered this sacred discipline, and thanks to this mastery, you now possess the skills and knowledge necessary to confront and defeat a Destruction Angel, a being who commands 12,000 angels.
addons.title: Biblically Accurate Wrestling

objects.text:
You have become a practitioner of an ancient and sacred fighting style known as Jacob's Limbs, whether through divine revelation or by inheriting it from a departed master.

An ancient Abrahamic hand-to-hand fighting style named after its creator, Jacob's Limbs is an adaptable fighting style ideal for any situation, with numerous forms designed to fight warriors, beasts, and so much more. However, while seemingly an effective and adaptable fighting style for ordinary humans, Jacob's Limbs truly shines when used against the supernatural and that which is not human.

The more supernatural your opponent is, the more effective Jacob's Limbs becomes against them, from a human with supernatural energy they barely know how to use to an Archangel of Destruction or a Devil Dragon God, Jacob's Limbs gives you the means not only to survive against these opponents but also to soundly defeat them through mastery of this art, and if they lack a humanoid form, Jacob's Limbs becomes even more effective at bringing them down, as it was designed for humans to defend themselves against the Supernatural, Alien, and Eldritch.

The key components of Jacob's Limbs are the user's willpower and faith, as the more willpower you possess and the stronger your faith is, the greater the power of Jacob's Limbs becomes, with your faith being placed in a higher power, some ideal, those you trust, or even yourself, and as long as you have strong faith, Jacob's Limbs will be able to aid you even in the darkest of worlds.

You gain basic knowledge of Jacob's Limbs, as well as the talent and martial prowess of a veteran Executor of the Holy Church, comparable to that of the most outstanding members of their order, granting you a level of skill sufficient to defeat even a Dead Apostle in close-quarters combat, as long as your faith and willpower are strong enough.

Although designed to combat the inhuman and supernatural, possessing supernatural abilities does not hinder its use; what matters most is your faith and your inner will.
objects.title: Jacob's Limbs (Type-Moon)

objects.text: By some miracle, you have learned the secret technique of Okita Souji. While your version remains a pale imitation of the original, it still carries a fraction of its terrifying potential. This technique allows you to unleash three simultaneous thrusts at a single point, using any weapon or even bare-handed. All three strikes occur in the same time and space, causing a localized breakdown of causality. Even if one is blocked, the contradiction of the remaining two strikes' landing creates a paradox—an event stagnation forms at the strike's tip. This saturation collapses causal logic, rendering the attack physically unblockable, as it doesn't just destroy matter—it erases the logic that holds it together. However, such power comes at a cost. Without Okita's mastery, each use inflicts immense strain, rapidly draining stamina and leaving you with heavy muscular fatigue. At your current level, it can only be used a handful of times per day. With training, your control and efficiency will grow. Note: Though modified, this technique remains a sword art at its core. As such, it'll only reveal its true potential when used with a proper blade, alongside being paired with a high-speed movement ability, as originally intended by Okita Souji.
objects.title: Three-Stage Thrust (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
A divine-level battōjutsu technique used by Kawakami Gensai, unleashed at an impossible speed that surpasses ordinary laws of physics. This hidden mystic sword art interferes with the flow of successive time along the path of your slash, tearing it apart together with the surrounding spatial coordinates.

In an instant, it opens a temporary space-time rift where continuity breaks down, deleting anything caught within that rift as they lose their existence, which is then immediately corrected—so at a glance, it'll appear like your target is suddenly bisected.

And because the strike comes from a dimension above normal reality, only something of a similar dimension or higher can even try to defend and block against it.

All that said, however, using this technique is incredibly taxing. Each sword-draw carries a heavy "recoil" that can quickly exhaust you and wrack your body with pain if you aren't careful—at least initially.
objects.title: Sword-Unsheathing - Might of Heaven (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
A secret martial art of the Burial Agency. The Iron Plate Effect is a throwing technique that utilizes martial arts to increase the force of impact dozens of times, allowing weapons to bore through even reinforced concrete walls and strike an enemy with enough force to be likened to being hit by a car.

While most commonly used with bladed piercing weapons like Black Keys, you may also utilize this technique with other weapons or items.

Despite the rather absurd power of this technique, it is completely mundane. The Iron Plate Effect can potentially be combined with magical techniques or enchanted weapons to enhance its potency. You are naturally skilled at inventing or combining such things.

You start as an experienced user of the Iron Plate Effect. As a normal human, you would be capable of easily throwing daggers that can pierce and explode concrete or metal. The force of your throws can easily rival bullets. Since this is merely a martial art, its potency will vastly increase with your physical strength and ability.
objects.title: Iron Plate Effect (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Sasaki Kojirou's fabled secret technique: Swallow Reversal, an unavoidable sequence of attacks that touches upon the territory of the Second Magic. One that, through the use of the Multi-Dimensional Refraction Phenomenon, creates a sword of infinity that disregards the concept of space and time, multiplying one strike into three.

These three slashes close in on the target from all sides, one overhead and two from either side, occurring simultaneously at the same point in time, trapping them in a net they cannot escape.

Human skill elevated into the realm of the gods, this technique transcends speed, dexterity, feints, and other conventional aspects of swordsmanship. The strikes happen so "quickly" that, unless one can defy fate itself or is a swordsman on the level of Miyamoto Musashi, there's generally no way to counter their momentum.

Nonetheless, it isn't unstoppable, as you're still quite limited by the amount of power you can muster and the weapon you're wielding, with its effective range being likewise determined by what you used to perform it, meaning it's possible to tank your blows outright.
objects.title: Tsubame Gaeshi (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your Blank Gene has caught the eye of both the Culexus Temple and the Ordo Malleus of the Ordos Majoris, making you a valuable asset against the forces of the Warp. Alongside receiving the rigorous teachings of the Culexus Temple, you are entrusted with an Animus Speculum and Psyk-out grenades, arming you to hunt psykers and daemons with unparalleled precision. Under the watchful guidance of the Ordo Malleus, you receive advanced training to identify, pursue, and neutralize Warp-touched threats, combining the subtlety of the Culexus Assassin with the unyielding resolve of the Inquisition’s Daemon Hunters.

This partnership extends your capabilities beyond even the typical Culexus methods. The Ordo Malleus, with its vast knowledge of the Warp, teaches you specialized counter-daemonic tactics, allowing you to recognize and counteract arcane symbols, unholy runes, and cursed relics that protect or empower daemons and rogue psykers. With their expertise, your Null aura is refined into a sanctified shield, an aura that actively weakens Warp entities and lessens the impact of their presence, making you a bulwark against corruption.
addons.title: Ordos Malleus Praestatur

addons.text:
Adeptus ANATHEMA is a clandestine augmentation project created by a secretive sect within the Adeptus Mechanicus to counteract the growing dominance of their own organization. By sponsoring you, they have fashioned a perfect weapon against Mechanicus supremacy, granting you the ability to operate covertly or openly to dismantle their most advanced technologies and doctrines. You are their failsafe, equipped to neutralize Mechanicus power if it ever threatens the Imperium.

With your enhanced abilities, you are a living nightmare for the Mechanicus, capable of disassembling their machines, blending with they rituals and sermons, and rendering their greatest weapons useless. You can infiltrate their systems, expose their vulnerabilities, and, if necessary, dismantle the Mechanicus from within, giving you unparalleled influence over their technological dominance.

Your neural network has been upgraded to interface with Mechanicus-encrypted data systems, allowing you to manipulate the noosphere and intercept communications. You can hack into Mechanicus networks, subvert machine spirits, and even repurpose their technologies. You are among the few with the capability to infiltrate the most secure TERRA and MARS systems, access hidden Dark Age Data Vaults, and potentially pacify rogue Abominable Intelligences.
Armed with specialized weaponry designed to exploit the weaknesses of machinery, you can bypass their most advanced defenses with precision. Whether using EMP-infused rounds, las-cutters, or viral-code blades, your arsenal is tailored to incapacitate constructs and cybernetic enhancements, making you lethal against their greatest assets.

Your deep understanding of Mechanicus rites and rituals grants you the power to disrupt their sacred processes. You can hex the fireward that bind's machine spirits, turning the spirits against their masters. In times of need, you can temporarily override or assume control of Mechanicus constructs and larger machines, weaponizing their own creations against them.
addons.title: Codename: ANATHEMA

addons.text: Your innate intuition and formal training in the arts of subterfuge and assassination have produced the Assassinorum's greatest known asset. Your combat instincts, honed by years of training and practical experience, are second-to-none and border on near-precognition. Moreover, your skills are perfected, making you the exemplar within each institution whose training you receive with this power. You could best the keenest Vindicare in a sharpshooting contest, out-perform the most brutal Eversor and outsmart the most cunning Vanus. Finally, any enhancements or tools you receive can instead be optionally replicated through biological mutation. For example, you could secrete the myriad poisons of the Venenum Temple, mimic the effects of polymorphine through your own shapeshifting capabilities, or produce the combat drugs of the Eversor Temple yourself within specialized glands. This even extends to esoteric or advanced technology, such as the Animus Speculum of the Culexus Temple, or even the Phase Swords of the Callidius Temple.
addons.title: The Perfected Art Of Assassination

objects.text:
You have undergone extensive training and enhancement by the Officio Assassinorum, making you the pinnacle of assassination. You embody the full mastery of (almost) every temple within the Officio Assassinorum, with physical prowess, skills, and tactics that are unmatched. Whether you are a flawless sharpshooter, a silent infiltrator capable of assuming any identity, a berserker who leaves devastation in your wake, or a living nightmare for info security—you are all of these and more. Your abilities from all Assassinorum temples blend perfectly, creating a deadly synergy that makes you the ultimate assassin.

Equipped with a unique Assassinorum enhancement system, you possess a neuro-interface far more advanced than any individual assassin's. This system provides real-time tactical data, tracks mission objectives, and analyzes enemy weaknesses. It also contains centuries of accumulated Assassinorum knowledge, allowing you to draw from the skills, strategies, and lessons of every assassin who came before you. This system is unbreakable, untraceable, and is a bionic on your head.

Your training has given you the lethal precision of the Vindicare Temple, making you a master sharpshooter with unmatched marksmanship. You can eliminate high-value targets from extreme distances, striking with calculated precision from the shadows.

From the Callidus Temple, you have gained mastery over infiltration and deception. With advanced polymorphine technology implanted on your spine, you can alter your appearance to blend seamlessly into enemy ranks, gather intelligence, or strike when least expected.
Drawing from the Eversor Temple, you become a relentless berserker, enhanced by combat drugs that boost your speed, strength, and endurance to superhuman levels. In close-quarters combat, your unrelenting assault leaves no survivors, turning you into a whirlwind of destruction.

You also possess the subtle lethality of the Venenum Temple, specializing in the use of poison. Whether through silent toxins or deadly compounds, you can incapacitate or eliminate targets discreetly, leaving no trace of your involvement.

Additionally, training from the Vanus Temple makes you a master of intelligence and strategy. You excel at manipulating events behind the scenes, using your strategic acumen to destroy targets indirectly and orchestrate their downfall. 

Finally, the Adamus Temple has honed your skills in decapitation strikes, allowing you to execute high-profile targets with deadly efficiency.

With this vast combination of abilities, you are the ultimate assassin—unmatched in versatility, lethality, and tactical genius. You are the embodiment of (almost) all the skills and expertise of the Officio Assassinorum, fused together into a single unstoppable force. Every mission you undertake will leave your enemies in fear, knowing that no target is beyond your reach.
objects.title: Officio Assassinorum Group Project (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
The sublime martial arts of the Adeptus Custodes, the guardians of the golden throne and the Emperor of Mankind. These disciplines marry martial stances, strategy and the philosophies of war together to form a greater whole.

Bring down gigantic beasts and towering war machines up to a hundred and fifty meters tall with the overwhelming blows of the Behemor stance or trap a teeming horde, a thousand strong, in a melee with the Kapatris Martial Ka'tah. These are not just fighting moves but ways of dismantling the foe tactically before they become a threat to the Golden Guardians or the Master of Mankind. Additionally, Martial Ka'tah are not just applicable to melee combat but ranged combat, combat using vehicles and much, much more.

You start off with passing familiarity with the primary Martial Ka'tah, the Dacatarai stance and the Rendax Stance, but through training and practice, you will subconsciously unlock and quickly master the thousands of permutations and techniques created by the Adeptus Custodes Eventually, you will be skilled enough to create your own Martial Ka'tah. 

Traditionally, it would take a transhuman of significant stature to employ these battle stances. Fortunately for you, they have been modified to make best use of the body you inhabit.
objects.title: Martial Ka'tah (Warhammer 40k)

objects.text:
You have walked a Path of the Warrior and learned the secrets of an Aspect Shrine of the Eldar Craftworlds. You have been touched by Kaela Mensha Khaine and the call of violence has been awakened in your soul. You can focus this violence into your craft on the battlefield, while off the battlefield, you learn how to put on a War Mask that keeps it completely suppressed.

Each Aspect Shrine focuses on a different aspect of the Bloody Handed God and a single art of warfare. For example, the Dire Avengers are elite generalist infantry, the Fire Dragons wield fusion beams that pierce heavy armor, Striking Scorpions focus on infiltration and assassination, and the Warp Spiders use teleport packs to ambush enemies. There are also vehicle focused Aspect Shrines such as the Shining Spears and Crimson Hunters. You can choose to have walked any single aspect shrine, from the most famous ones, to the obscure sects like Coiled Serpents or Slicing Orbs, or another shrine yet unheard of.

You start with the experience and expertise of an Exarch, without having fallen into the obsession with the Shrine’s art that such entails.
objects.title: Aspect Warrior (Warhammer 40k)

addons.text:
The limit-breaking nature of Demon Child and the temperance of Total Concentration Breathing combine to create a truly devastating Breathing Style. One that makes even the feats of Hashiras pale in comparison to you. Moving like a blur, striking like an earthquake, and tanking blows like an unbreakable pillar. 

At the same time, you pace yourself in order to not overload your body, while operating at maximum capacity. Even injured, you will remain as close to peak condition as possible. With a great boost to your pain tolerance, endurance, and stamina to match. 

Demon Breathing is a style that mimics the overwhelming presence of demons, their monstrous physicality, complex Blood Demon Arts, and even regeneration—though it can only stop bleeding, close cuts, extend your lifespan, and keep you alive from near-fatal wounds. It cannot regrow lost limbs or save you from decapitation. Your natural healing and recovery rate are also elevated. 

You may design this Breathing Style based on one or more Blood Demon Arts from Demon Slayer or make your own
addons.title: Demon Breathing

addons.text:
Tennen Rishin-Ryuu Empyrean, or simply Empyrean, is the ultimate expression of Okita Souji’s life—one entirely devoted to the sword.

It represents the purest form of Tennen Rishin-Ryuu, Okita’s original style, sharpened and perfected through relentless training and a fight to the death against the God of Swordsmanship, Susano’o no Mikoto.

Though you have yet to ascend to Okita Souji’s legendary heights, your mastery of Tennen Rishin-Ryuu has deepened to the point where you’ve begun to grasp the first, blinding truths of Empyrean.
addons.title: Tennen Rishin-Ryuu Empyrean

addons.text:
Onigo—your inner "Demon Child"—is not merely a transformation; it is a complete acceptance of self. More than tripling your physical power and reaction speed, it refines your murderous intent into something pure and terrifying: a Manslayer. Your instincts no longer resemble those of a human—they are demonic, predatory, born to hunt Men.

Visually, the change is unmistakable. The raging red aura of Demon Child is replaced with a chilling, ethereal blue flame that flickers from your eyes and mouth. Ironic, perhaps, that this blood-soaked clarity manifests not as chaos, but as focused serenity—the calm of a warrior who only knows the path of the blade.
addons.title: Onigo

objects.text:
Demon Child is the special ability of Okita Soji—something you now have. It is an innate form of breathing that accelerates your heartbeat, pumping three times more blood than normal through your body. This violently awakens every muscle cell, granting you superhuman physical abilities. At your peak, you’re capable of slicing supernatural opponents clean in half, and even the gods with their innate durability might be cut.

Your strength alone is capable of cutting steel, your speed enough to be a blur, and your vitality enough to survive what would normally be fatal damage.

A by-product of this state is that your eyes begin to glow a vivid red. As your blood surges even faster, the whites of your eyes (sclera) turn crimson, and a deep red aura begins to emanate from your body—most intensely from around your eyes and mouth—giving you the unmistakable presence of a demon.
objects.title: Demon Child (Record of Ragnarok)

objects.text:
You have inherited the legacy of Chiyou, a martial art developed by Qin Shi Huang, the first emperor of China, during his battle against Chiyou, the god of war. Chiyou consists of five distinct fighting styles, each named after one of the five weapons said to have been created by the god himself: Crossbow, Halberd, Sword, Spear, and Armor. Central to this martial art is the ability to redirect or nullify an opponent’s power, exemplified by techniques such as Heavenly Phoenix’s Power Embrace.

To fully wield Chiyou, you have also inherited Qin Shi Huang’s mirror-touch synesthesia. This ability allows you to perceive the flow of chi within your enemies’ bodies, enabling you to weaken their attacks by disrupting that flow—sometimes with something as subtle as an air bullet. However, this power comes at a cost: you experience all the pain you inflict on others, though without suffering any actual physical injury. Unlike Qin Shi Huang, you can toggle this on and off, but you can only see the flow of chi while it’s active.
objects.title: Chiyou (Record of Ragnarok)

addons.text:
You have pushed the Hercules Method to its absolute limit, achieving complete mastery without inheriting the murderous obsession that plagued its practitioners. 

Every technique, principle, and form of bodily control taught by the Method has become second nature to you, enhanced further by the monstrous physical potential and growth granted by Magic and Muscle.

Your control over your body has evolved into a form of Self-Biokinesis, allowing conscious command over muscles, organs, bones, nerves, metabolism, and other biological processes. 

You can alter your size and proportions, reshape or reposition bones and organs, control bodily functions normally considered involuntary, rapidly adapt your physiology, and perform feats of anatomical manipulation beyond what the original Hercules Method could accomplish.

Your senses and nervous system have similarly surpassed their normal limits, granting extraordinary situational awareness, reflexes, proprioception, and an instinctive sixth sense for danger. 

Through continued training, you may develop entirely new biological abilities, provided they can reasonably arise from manipulating or improving your own body.

Most importantly, there is no true endpoint to the Method anymore. 

As your physical abilities increase through Magic and Muscle, your mastery and bodily control can continually expand alongside them, allowing the Hercules Method to evolve rather than becoming obsolete at higher levels of power.
addons.title: Supreme Body

addons.text:
Magecraft runs on the principle of mystery, in that the older and less understood phenomena are known scientifically, the stronger it becomes. As The Hercules Method was created by Cain of the Bible over 10,000 years ago, it possesses an insane amount of Mystery. 

As such, The Hercules Method becomes massively empowered compared to normal, with its limits being nearly entirely removed and becoming more of a soft cap. In time, you may reach levels of physical, mental, and spiritual ability equal to the strongest of servants and figures from legend in their prime. 

In simpler terms, The Hercules Method can now increase your physical abilities hundreds of times compared to the original dozens. In addition, over the next hundred years, your body will slowly gain a level of mystery from The Age of Gods. 

This transformation will allow your entire body to act as a pseudo-magic circuit able to generate power comparable to a Dragon Core once complete. While also allowing your magic to act as true magic, using your body as a focus and medium, regressing your Body and Magecraft to Magic from The Age of Gods. Do note that the Composition of these Regressions you have will be up to the same era as when Adam walked the earth. Also, your body will be self-sustaining on your own power without needing external Mystery or Mana.
addons.title: Method of Mystery

addons.text:
You have internalised the underlying and universal truth to life as Cain did: we are all meat for the slaughter and that was basic human nature. This is not a philosophy you adopted—it is a realisation that stripped you bare, revealing the core of what it means to be human beneath all delusion. You did not “learn” the Method in the way others do; you discovered it, the same way a starving animal finds blood in the snow. It emerged from within you like an instinct that had always been there, dormant and waiting.

As with Cain, this truth grants not just knowledge, but innate ownership. The Method wasn’t something you studied—it revealed itself to you, rising up from within your body and mind like something remembered rather than learned. Your understanding isn’t technical or secondhand; it’s intuitive, natural, and foundational. You grasp not just how the Method works, but why it works, giving you a level of insight others can’t reach, no matter how long they train. This deep comprehension gives you a significant edge in applying and evolving the Method. You instinctively know how to optimise your training, avoid dangerous overexertion—or how to take advantage of it—and push into new territory with minimal trial and error.

And like Cain, there is no hesitation within you. No moral fracture to dull your edge. Where other Method users fight against their natures, flinch at the cost, or cling to ghosts of decency, you walk forward unshaken. This is not cruelty. It is clarity. You do not seek domination—you are domination, simply by existing in your truth. In your hands, the Method is not a tool. It is the echo of the first blow ever struck, and the promise that the last one will be yours.
addons.title: The First Murderer

addons.text:
Through your new insights into the mechanics of Smart Atoms, you have discovered a way to push The Hercules Method to the next level by converting every cell in your body into Smart Atoms.

By using the combined knowledge and practices of The Hercules Method, you can improve your body endlessly. With the right knowledge, you can recreate the various powers from the world of Invincible and beyond of other lifeforms through careful programming of the Smart Atoms, which now make up your body. You can not only copy powers based on biology and scientific principles but also improve them exponentially. With some effort, you can even copy other powers that have a basis in the physical form, such as Chakra from Naruto or Gear Cells from Guilty Gear, as some examples.

Also, your skill with both grants you the unique ability to slowly increase the density of your body by shrinking the size of Smart Atoms within your body by lessening and eventually eliminating empty space within the Smart Atom cells that make up your body, allowing your body to hold many more cells. This process allows you to vastly increase the number of modifications your body can hold and even vastly improve them over time. However, this process has the side effect of increasing the weight of your body, though even this drawback can be removed with some effort by adding a weight reduction power.

Be warned that while your potential is infinite, it is not without danger. Reckless modifications to your body without careful planning could cause you to suffer debilitating complications or just turn you into a pile of goo. Also, this process takes time both to study and implement, though with enough mastery of The Hercules Method, this speed will increase, and your ability to gain and enhance powers will improve as well.
addons.title: The Smart Method

addons.text:
The method of regression was created by Cain in an attempt to regress to a time before he was cursed by God to wander for eternity, one of many attempts, though all have failed.

Your unique physique enables you to fully realize the intended purpose of the method. However, you have no curse; instead, this technique will gradually regress your body and mystery to the original state of the "Human Genus" as it was created by the Lord.

By the time your regression is complete, the composition of your Regression of the Gods will be up to the moment God created Adam in the Garden of Eden, which is the sixth day of creation in the Bible.

As this Regression of the Gods has mysteries from Genesis, you can replicate all natural phenomena through magecraft. Additionally, like Adam, you have been given authority over all living beings on earth, effectively becoming the ruler of the planet.

After regression is complete, you obtain the ability to pull out a rib and create your Eve, allowing you to father a new generation of primordial humans.

Once completed, your body and regression of the Gods will be potent enough to fight Chief Gods on equal terms.

Without other powers to accelerate the process, it will take 108 years to completely regress.

As a being made in the image of God, you have no actual hard limits on how powerful you can get.

The method of regression is capable of regressing the mysteries inherent to the technique, preventing them from fading even if understood.
addons.title: Regression Of God / Method of Regression
Hunter Method
addons.text:
Through the insights provided by The Method, you have not only taken your Bio-Energy enhanced physiology to new heights, but also granted yourself the ability to use your Bio-Energy like Safi’jiiva.

Your newfound physical capabilities are absurd, rivaling those of legendary hunters and physically-focused elder dragon-level creatures. You can now wrestle and overpower gargantuan beasts like Lao-Shan Lung with ease, move fast enough to create afterimages, yell with such sound and force to create organ-shredding shockwaves, and treat mountains falling on you as an inconvenience.

Like Safi’jiiva, you can produce Bio-Energy akin to a perpetual motion device, only limited by your mastery of the Method and your stamina. Further, on top of the base enhancement, immense amounts of Bio-Energy grant you can efficiently channel it to multiply physical strength severalfold beyond what the Method already grants you in bursts, which superheats your body as a granting powerful offensive and defensive ability, or to unleash devastating beams, blasts, and explosions of Bio-Energy. Finally, you can also draw in extra Bio-Energy from the environment to either regenerate at an accelerated rate or to replenish your reserves and stamina should you overtax yourself.

However, do note that while you can continually draw energy from the environment to keep going, eventually you will begin to tire and weaken, which, should you continue, may cause you to faint or possibly die if pushed too far, though such occurring is extremely unlikely unless you are unimaginably reckless.

As a final note, perhaps with sufficient mastery of The Method and your Bio-Energy you could achieve and understand much more, like its connection with Dragon Element and the myriad of ways it interacts with other elements.

objects.text: The Mind Commands, The Flesh Obeys The Method is a series of teachings and knowledge enabling the user to focus their mind, body and spirit towards perfection. Through this practice, you will gain complete mastery over your body, allowing you to perfectly control its every part and process down to a cellular level. This leads to superhuman physical ability up to dozens of times stronger than peak human, greatly increased mental ability, enhanced regeneration, semi-immortality, a form of x-ray vision able to see the biology of living creatures, as well as precognition able to see seconds into the future. You will require no maintenance to maintain your superhuman physique for The Method maintains your body perfectly including lessening and later eliminating the need for sustenance. Though you will still need to eat to bulk up or heal after taking large amounts of damage. With further study and training, you will only grow stronger, even developing other abilities such as powerful hypnosis. If you're a different species, this power massively improves your condition in an equivalent manner. You will have high potential in learning these teachings and be able to complete its basic level within one month or less. Be aware that you're not invincible and should your brain or heart be removed or destroyed, you will still die. Any effect which hampers your control over your mind or body will also weaken you. You will not acquire any negative mental side-effects resulting from the Method.
objects.title: The "Hercules" Method (The Strange Talent of Luther Strode)

addons.text: Like Jin Mori, you are not only a master of Renewal Taekwondo but also of Nabong Needle Ryu, the acupuncture-based martial art created by Na Bong-Chim, granting you access to all the specialized acupuncture techniques Jin Mori has used. One of the most notable is the Limiter Removal. This technique allows you to temporarily bypass all of the body's natural physical and mental restraints, expanding the cap of power you can draw from and exponentially increasing your strength by a chosen multiplier. However, the greater the boost, the harsher the rebound. Once the effect wears off, your body suffers immense damage—potentially fatal if pushed too far. Otherwise, so long as you can endure the backlash, there is no theoretical limit to how far you can push yourself. The highest known boost recorded to date is an astonishing x250,000.
addons.title: Nabong Needle Ryu

objects.text:
A martial art developed by Jin Tae-Jin as a direct counter to Northern ITF Taekwondo, Renewal Taekwondo refines and enhances the strengths of its Northern ITF and traditional ITF counterparts while eliminating their weaknesses. It retains the foundation of strong, linear kicks but elevates them to an entirely new level. At its core, mastery of this style leads to the ultimate principle: Renewal Recoilless—a technique that applies to all Renewal Taekwondo moves once fully mastered.

The concept of Recoilless itself functions by concentrating all momentum and energy into a single point—thus allowing for all of your techniques to be executed with flawless precision and zero wasted movement. This results in attacks of unparalleled destructive force, capable of leveling mountains, distorting space, and even damaging the Yongpyo—the legendary armor of the Monkey King, said to surpass both the Sage's Robe of the Jade Emperor and the indestructible Barbadium.

However, achieving this level of mastery requires rigorous training. Until you can apply the Recoilless effect to all of your techniques, the full potential of Renewal Taekwondo remains just out of reach. But once mastered, few—if any—martial arts in this world could stand against it.

<small>You'll begin at the same level Jin Mori was at the start of the series, but with the combined potential of both Jin Tae-Jin and Jin Mori. Additionally, your body will be optimized to perfectly withstand the strains of this martial art.<small>
objects.title: Renewal Taekwondo (The God of High School)

objects.text:
Some call you a super soldier, others an unstoppable killing machine, for your expertise in ground warfare can be considered unparalleled. Your prowess is unmatched, you are a formidable instrument of lethal precision and remarkable efficiency, regardless of the terrain, you are able to swiftly neutralize dozens of highly trained soldiers without any noticeable duress. Equipped with a highly versatile jetpack, you effortlessly exhibit flawless maneuverability and graceful agility. From double jumping, wall running, and mantling, all executed flawlessly ensuring that your maneuverability is never comprised.

You're also fitted with a helmet equipped with state-of-the-art systems and an efficient HUD that provides comprehensive data for any combat and reconnaissance situations. Further enhancing your performance across all fields, while ensuring optimal situational awareness and effectiveness.
objects.title: Pilot (Titanfall)

objects.text:
You have the ability to fight on par with some of the greatest fighters in the JJK universe. Despite the name, this power is not limited to just Yuji, but instead, you are now granted the combined martial prowess, physical and mental skills, and battle IQ of Yuji Itadori, Ryomen Sukuna, Toji Fushiguro, and Satoru Gojo. This means that you can fight like them even if you do not possess any other amplification, and if you were to have any, such as being a Jujutsu Sorcerer, your powers would be amplified even further.

To stay true to JJK fashion, you can’t be respecting 1v1s. But for that to happen, you have to have battle partners capable of keeping up with you, which this power now provides. Any allies you have that you enter battle alongside, for the duration of the battle, will find their own skills, physical ability, and battle IQ will rise to match yours in any field they are lacking, and yours will rise to match theirs in any field you fall behind. Most importantly, you will find each perfectly coordinated, almost as if you were one person, and will need no communication on battle strategy or passing of information, as you are intuitively aware of everything you need to know. You can turn this on and off at will.
objects.title: Yuji “These Hands” Itadori (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
You have acquired the Heretical God Force, granting you the ability to practice this unique technique.

The firs step of this technique requires you to condense a Heretical God Seed within a self-created inner space, a process that takes anywhere from one day to one week. Once the seed is formed, it functions entirely on its own. It automatically draws in, compresses, and stores any form of energy you currently possess or may acquire in the future without requiring any active concentration on your part.

You can then draw directly from this highly compressed reservoir to unleash an explosive increase in your combat power. The violent expansion of this condensed energy multiplies your strength, speed, and the power of your techniques. The Heretical God Force is intended to be unleashed in short, devastating bursts.

The first stage enhances your strength and energy by 50%, the second by 100%, the third by 150%, and so on, until the sixth and final stage, which amplifies your original strength and energy by three times.

The Heretical God Seed is not static. As you grow stronger, it continuously develops, evolving from a seed into a sapling, then a towering tree, and ultimately bearing fruits. These fruits represent the ultimate crystallisation of your mastery over elemental Daos and Laws. To nurture its growth, you must absorb elemental materials and comprehend the Daos and Laws of the world. Furthermore, it is no longer limited to fire or thunder, it can now absorb and adapt to any element Dao and Law.

Even while practicing the Heretical God Force, you can still freely use your energy in its normal form at any time.

The Heretical God Force can be practiced and mastered by anyone, regardless of their level of power, without causing any drawbacks to the body, mind, or soul.
objects.title: The Heretical God Force (Martial World)

objects.text:
You now possess a comprehensive set of skills and abilities that easily allow you to become the world's greatest spy. While on the field, you can blend seamlessly into any environment, quickly grasping the lay of the land, understanding local culture, and staying aware of the current happenings as if you have lived there your whole life.

You've gained a trained eye to memorize small details effortlessly. Whether it's identifying inconsistencies in building floor plans or detecting any changes in a safehouse since your last visit, you possess a keen perception that allows you to spot discrepancies with ease.

No nation can confine you, but languages unlock a world of understanding. With your linguistic prowess, you effortlessly comprehend the nuances of real-world languages, speaking and reading them at a native level. This talent extends to coding languages and ciphers as well, allowing you to learn complex languages and codes in a matter of days or weeks rather than years.

Embracing the art of disguise, you've gained a talent to create disguises so perfect they are nearly undecipherable. Using materials and patterns found both on and off the field, you can even transform yourself into anyone you mimic, flawlessly imitating their appearance and mannerisms. You gain all their memories, knowledge, and skills of anyone you mimic, but not their powers. However, no matter how many people you mimic or memories you gain, you will never lose your sense of self.

Furthermore, you possess an innate understanding of moving stealthily and remaining undetected. You can navigate through any environment without leaving a trace, maintaining a near-perfect sense of how far you can push your presence without alerting even elite guard units. You become a ghost, elusive and virtually untrackable to your enemies.
objects.title: Venomous Phantom Snake (Metal Gear)

objects.text: You may select and fully master any martial art featured in the Volcanic Age series. As a martial artist you may gain access to internal energy which can temporarily enhance your body to superhuman levels or reinforce your weapons. Your internal energy reserves are moderate, allowing you to fight in full combat for three hours before needing to meditate to restore your internal energy. You may increase your internal energy through practice but to reach the realm of masters would take decades.
objects.title: Peak Realm Martial Artist (Volcanic Age)

addons.text: You gain all of Yujiro Hanma’s combat knowledge and experience. You can use all of the martial arts he has copied in his life, and you are capable of having the Demon Back active constantly.
addons.title: Yujiro Hanma

addons.text: You have a perfect mastery of all of the Chinese martial arts demonstrated in the show or manga, equal in skill to Kaioh Kaku at his best.
addons.title: Kaioh

addons.text:
The genetic factor of the Hanma and Kure bloodlines has mixed together with your Superman Syndrome, and formed a perfect union, making you an absolute freak of nature and an unstoppable force on the battlefield. 

All of the unique traits that now flow through your blood are now enhanced by a massive degree. Your strength now starts out at the level of Yujiro Hanma, and your muscle density can increase to 300% of your previous peak. In addition, your Removal percentage is now 200%, and can stack on top of the Demon Back for an even larger power boost.
addons.title: Freak of Nature

addons.text: You are now a master of every Karate style & technique shown in the Baki show or manga, equaling the head of the Shin Shin Kai, Doppo Orochi, in skill & strength.
addons.title: Shin Shin Kai

addons.text:
You gain the ability to utilize the Demon Brain technique. Your body will respond to your imagination, emulating the actions you visualize. This includes the sensation of being physically thrown around and causing cracks in concrete walls. 

You can even gain minor superpowers, as your body adapts to your imagination. An example being gaining increased flexibility by imagining you have more joints.

The experience is so immersive that others can sense your intent, and even you can manifest as ghosts, your consciousness remaining intact after death.
addons.title: Demon Brain

addons.text: You now possess the complete knowledge, skill and physical might of Japan's greatest swordsman—Miyamoto Musashi—along with every other sword and sword-based technique shown or referenced in the Baki series, show or manga.
addons.title: Niten Ichi-ryuu

addons.text:
You are a master of every martial art and martial feat a human can perform in the One Piece world — from the fluid strikes of Fishman Karate, to the seismic vibrations of Hasshoken. You wield the swordsmanship of legends like Mihawk and Shanks, and possess the sniping precision of Yasopp — and that’s only a glimpse of your arsenal.

Your Haki is without equal. You have complete command over all three forms — Observation, Armament, and Conqueror’s — and can perform every known technique with ease. Over time, your mastery even evolves into innovation, allowing you to create entirely new forms and applications of Haki.

What truly sets you apart, however, is the fusion of your Hanma lineage with your Haki mastery. Together, they elevate your martial prowess beyond any known limit. For example, you can effortlessly replicate Sanji’s Ifrit Jambe techniques — your body, far more durable than any modified Germa soldier, can withstand and generate even greater levels of heat, turning your kicks into incandescent weapons of destruction.

You are no longer a fighter. You are a force — a terrifying convergence of instinct, bloodline, and will.
addons.title: The Other Strongest Creature (One Piece)

objects.text: In your veins is the blood of a legend. You are now a Hanma—don’t dishonor the Hanma name. Your natural talent in combat is pushed beyond the limit, your physique is perfected for battle. With little effort, you can learn and master any martial art, as well as identify its weaknesses. You also gain the infamous Demon Face. In this technique, the user flexes the back muscles to form the face of a demon, allowing them to tap into their full potential and become many times stronger than they were before. This increase in physical strength, speed, endurance, stamina, and ability to absorb and reciprocate hits makes the user practically invincible on the battlefield. They are able to dish out immense damage and virtually absorb any attack that comes their way. Even without training, you can reach the same level of strength as early Jack Hanma, and at your peak, you can reach the same level as Yujiro Hanma, the man who stopped an earthquake with a punch, tanked a lightning bolt and is fast enough to dodge said lightning.
objects.title: Hanma (Baki the Grappler)

objects.text:
You are a master of Niko-style martial arts. This is a martial style that places a high focus on adaptability and applicability; many of the techniques are not set patterns, but rather basic principles that can be applied in multiple situations. The style has 4 Kata which are Adamantine, Flame, Redirection, and Water. Each kata has its own principles and specialization. 

-The Adamantine Kata involves the tightening of the muscles (thus hardening one's body) for both defensive and offensive purposes.
-The Flame Kata is centered around movement and positioning, giving the user incredible speed and agility
-The Redirection Kata involves seeing and manipulating the "flow of power", using minimal motions to turn the opponent's attacks against them. As a result, this kata requires incredible kinetic vision and delicate physical control.
-The Water Kata is a grappling-based kata that places emphasis on flexibility and fluidity of motion.

The principle of multiple katas can be used in conjunction with one another to perform techniques best suited for the task. Besides the 4 kata, you are also privy to the knowledge of how to perform the secret technique of the style. You start out equal to Tokita Ohma in both physical capability and mastery.
objects.title: Niko Style (Kengan Ashura/Omega)

objects.text:
You have become a grandmaster-level martial artist. A person who has not only mastered their chosen martial art but has also perfected it and pushed its limits beyond its original capabilities. Through rigorous martial arts training, your body has reached superhuman levels.

You are capable of demolishing a building with a single strike and withstanding blows of similar force. You can move so quickly that you leave behind afterimages, making it difficult for even superhumanly trained fighters to track your movements. Additionally, you possess an extraordinary ability to read and predict your opponent's attacks with pinpoint accuracy.

This mastery not only enhances any other martial arts power you may possess but also significantly boosts your ability to teach and learn new martial arts.

You have a choice between Sei Ki and Dou Ki. Fighters who use Sei Ki are calm and collected, preferring a methodical approach that emphasizes defense and counter-attacks. In contrast, fighters who use Dou Ki are passionate and aggressive, favoring relentless offense and overpowering their opponents with unmatched ferocity. The type of Ki you choose will shape your martial art, making it either more offensive or defensive in nature.

Additionally, you can choose a martial philosophy: the Life-Saving Fist or the Killing Fist. The Life-Saving Fist focuses on subduing and neutralizing opponents without causing fatal harm, while the Killing Fist centers on eliminating enemies, giving you a more lethal edge in combat.
objects.title: Grandmaster Martial Artist (History Strongest Disciple Kenichi)

objects.text:
You now know the art of knocking, a technique that allows the user to strike at the pressure point of creatures or objects to cause changes to them. Normally, this involves striking at the nervous system of a wild beast which causes the creature to be paralyzed for easy capture but it can also be used on your own body or others to stabilize wounds and increasing the body's physical strength.

Master of the art can even perform knocking on ethereal concepts such as when Teppei performs knocking on the entire world and stopping it from exploding or when Jiro performs knocking on time itself, causing localized time to stop.
objects.title: Knocking (Toriko)

objects.text:
Originally a dance that the monkey king would perform to playmates that could match its strength the dance has over time evolved into a martial art that is practiced by the monkey inhabitant of area 7 in the gourmet world. 

The art centered around creating a unison with all the trillions of cells within one body toward a single task thus greatly amplifying the effectiveness of the action. However, Enbu takes a lot of stamina and concentration to use if even a single cell in your body becomes exhausted the unison of cells will break and the technique will fail.
objects.title: Enbu (Toriko)

addons.text:
You have incorporated the breathing technique's ability to be continuously active into the Heavenly Destroyer method, allowing you to cultivate at all times just by breathing, eliminating the need to enter meditation to grow your inner Qi.

This also lets you regenerate your internal energy reserves during battle, effectively providing you with an endless reserve of Qi if you can pace yourself or allowing you to fight at your maximum capacity ten times longer than you should be able to.
addons.title: Continuous Cycling

addons.text:
You have learned to integrate your Magic Circuit into the Heavenly Destroyer Method, enabling you to significantly enhance the speed of your cultivation based on the number and quality of your Magic Circuits.

Furthermore, as you continue to cultivate, the quantity and quality of your Magic Circuits will improve, creating a positive feedback loop: the faster you cultivate, the more your Magic Circuits improve in both quality and quantity.

The Ki and magical energy within your body harmonize into an especially potent form of Od, which can be utilized for both martial arts and spell-casting. Your body's vast reserves of magical energy will never harm you; instead, they will continuously strengthen you, gradually transforming you into an immortal Xian from the Age of Gods.

If you possess the Factor of the Dragon, your evolution into an Xian is greatly accelerated. Additionally, you can choose to forgo absorbing energy from the external world, as you now generate the energy required for your cultivation internally. The rate at which you generate magical energy depends on the quality of your Dragon Reactor Core, which can also be improved through cultivation.
addons.title: Spirit Vein Expansion

addons.text:
Your sheer talent with the art of Breathing and Walking gives you the potential to become a Shenxian, the Chinese mythological equivalent of genuine gods, despite the Age of Gods already ending.

As you breathe in the Mana of the Greater Source, you refine and gradually converge it into a budding Divine Core within your Saint Graph. This is a slow process that takes decades to complete. Even before completing it, your incomplete divine core functions as a Magical Energy Reactor, generating True Ether in vast quantities, which you can safely use for your spells. As you refine this Divine Core further, the amount of True Ether it produces increases. Being in locations with high ambient mana, like the Age of Gods, speeds this up substantially.

The small amounts of True Ether already permeating your body enhance your physical attributes to the level that you can fight C~B-ranked Servants in physical combat, and you gain a high resistance to physical or mental interference with only the strongest forms of either getting through your resistance. You can still be harmed, but your body and mind just cannot be altered.

Your talent in teaching others your Breathing and Walking techniques extends to teaching others how to become a Xian or Divine Xian.
addons.title: Divine Xian Cultivation

objects.text:
The Divine Heavenly Destroyer Technique is an extremely powerful Qigong martial art created and developed by Dokgo Ryong, the Heavenly Destroyer. It allows the user to cultivate and utilize a vast amount of Inner Ki to perform superhuman feats and unleash Ki attacks with enough destructive force to reshape the surrounding landscape.

The body of the user is massively enhanced and can casually do things such as shatter rock cliffs with a single punch, withstand attacks of equal caliber, casually move faster than the speed of sound, fight off poison or diseases, and accelerate the body's natural healing process, granting longevity. Other miscellaneous abilities include the ability to project killing intent that can paralyze opponents in fear and enhance your weapons with your Ki.

When going all out, you can tear down a small mountain with a single technique. One noticeable Ki attack in the Divine Heavenly Destroyer Technique is the Cosmic Dark Wheel and its many variations, which allow you to create a vortex with your Ki that shreds everything in its vicinity to pieces.

You have the same level of mastery over the technique as Gang Ryong at the end of the series.
objects.title: Heavenly Destroyer Technique (Gosu the Master)

addons.text: It would be remiss to not mention your knowledge of the refinement and adjustment of souls that you've acquired from your learning. You can harmlessly extract them with Nevercold Brass, one of the many Neathy materials you've learned to make through the Red Science, or refine them as well. It's also possible to damage one's soul without losing it, something you're familiar with, in both methods of causing and healing. Every soul possesses the potential to ascend to become a Judgement, devouring others fed to it and changing the world around them. However, such a thing would require a great deal of effort to stoke, so the odds of you accidentally causing such a thing would be slim to none at best.
addons.title: Devil's Work

objects.text: Your newest educational course has revealed the secrets of the Shapeling Arts, utilizing vital essences held in various types of amber you've learned to brew, the substance being used to collect said essences harmlessly when in contact with various beings. Those familiar with the practices of the Red Science may recognize this as a somewhat advanced, personalized method akin to its process of changing your place in the Great Chain of Being. A practitioner can reshape their body, give themselves new skeletal structures or adjust the number of limbs they have, enhance their bodies to superhuman degrees, survive seemingly fatal attacks, and adapt new ways to change oneself on the fly, and even heal oneself. It should be noted that the Shapeling Arts are also able to be used on the world itself, reshaping massive stone structures in order to reposition them.
objects.title: The Shapeling Arts (Fallen London)

objects.text:
In the New World, there is a unique set of abilities used by warriors known as Martial Arts that allow them to perform incredible feats of physical skill. These abilities range from increasing strength, hardening the body, removing limits, increasing awareness and range, attacking six times in an instant, and many more. 

This allows you to both learn and create new Martial Arts. However, Martial Arts consume a user's focus depending on how strong they are. For this reason, there is a limit to how many of them can be used at once.
objects.title: Martial Arts (Overlord)

objects.text:
Death Kwon Do - the ultimate martial arts of mullets, cut off jean shorts, and totally radical death! Not just any chump can copy the moves and pull it off, they gotta play by the rules.

Step one: Rock a mullet. No mullet, no moves. Stylish!
Step two: Wear some cut of jean shorts. Without it, you’re just another Joe. But with them? You're a lean, mean, death machine.

Now just because you start with the martial arts, doesn't mean you’re a master, no way! You gotta have the deathly instructions on paper first. Don't worry though, you start with some basic moves-- the Leg Lifts of Death, capable of lifting steel containers, and Death Hairstyling of Death, which can allow you to give even a bald man a mullet. Don't worry though, all the techniques that have been revealed in the show are in your head, waiting for you to scribble down the totally lethal, totally awesome, and totally earned through "hardcore mastery".

You better watch your back though. If someone else gets their grubby hands on the deathly instructions, they could be throwing down with Death Kwon Do too. So keep those instructions safe, or you might find yourself being on the wrong end of a Death Kwon Do smackdown.
objects.title: Death Kwon Do (Regular Show)

objects.text: You have been trained in Kyotōryū, a swordplay style unique in its total lack of a sword. Rather than wielding a sword, Kyotōryū users have trained in combat to the point in which they, themselves, are to be considered swords. Kyotōryū is a versatile full-body combat style, focused on dodging over blocking and defense over offense. Additionally, it possesses several supernatural techniques, such as producing an afterimage that comes before a dash attack, or attacking with a shockwave that bypasses armor. Kyotōryū's martial philosophy is one that, as mentioned, casts its user as swords themselves, which results in its wielders having absolutely no talent in using martial weapons and difficulty in learning how, as there is no sense in a sword wielding another sword. Your skill and talent in this fighting style is equal to Shichika Yasuri at the start of the series.
objects.title: 13th Blade (Katanagatari)

addons.text: ’Pancosmic Loner' is a title once bestowed upon Yu Ilhan for his unparalleled gift of stealth. His ability to avoid notice was so extraordinary that even beings countless magnitudes beyond him could fail to perceive his presence unless he stood directly before them or they devoted their complete, undivided attention to searching for him. In time, people around Yu Ilhan would simply forget he existed. This effect extended beyond living beings, with mechanical devices, digital records, and other systems similarly failing to retain awareness of him. Like Yu Ilhan, you have inherited this remarkable gift—or perhaps curse. Your ability to avoid notice has reached supernatural heights, causing others to overlook, forget, or fail to register your presence unless given sufficient reason to focus upon you. In addition, you have become a Reaper, more specifically a Rookie Reaper. This has elevated your Presence Concealment to EX Rank and greatly strengthened your connection to the Valley of the Shadow of Death, granting you an instinctive affinity with its powers and mysteries.
addons.title: Pancosmic Loner

objects.text:
Transcendent Trajectory is the ultimate weapon skill created by Yu Ilhan, the 5th Transcender and Lord of all Dragons. While typically performed with a spear, this technique can be used with any melee weapon or even bare hands.

The skill condenses the principles of countless weapons and many combat techniques into a single, transcendent attack that surpasses cause and effect, space, and fate. It is impossible to evade, block, or perceive through any sense—sight, sound, smell, aura, or danger detection. Moreover, it cannot be detected by any form of information analysis or manipulation.

This technique allows the user to manipulate space and time, redirecting an attack mid-swing to a different location, as if it had been the intended trajectory all along, bypassing the opponent's defenses.

By distorting space, time, and causality, the user can strike multiple times with a single attack or overlap strikes to amplify the damage. Initially, this skill allows the user to either enhance the power of their strike by 200 times or unleash 60 strikes simultaneously.

With further mastery, both the power of the attack and the number of simultaneous strikes can be significantly increased.
objects.title: Transcendent Trajectory (Everyone Else Is A Returnee)

addons.text: You can now infuse your element into your Spinjitzu, increasing its overall might, speed and duration, while also allowing you to flawlessly utilize your elemental powers alongside it. Be it to augment your movement while leaving behind a trail of your element, giving your enemies a taste of it up close, or shooting it with precision while spinning. With a whole new avenue to improve, your Spinjitzu now has plenty more potential to reach a whole new level of power and versatility alongside your element.
addons.title: Elemental Spinjitzu

addons.text: By combining and unifying the four elements you’re capable of utilizing the Tornado of Creation. A Tornado that is the antithesis to ‘the final boss’s evil-force’™, whatever it’s called, be it Destruction or some other evil-sounding name, it's the force of Creation and good, should it come to a direct clash you’re certain to be the victor. This Tornado can also pull materials and objects from around you into the tornado, resulting in nearly any structure, tool, or object that’s only bound by the user's imagination and the materials absorbed. However, this tornado is a very demanding move, after the construction of something or a direct clash with the bad guy it will leave you exhausted. Should you be stopped while in the Tornado of Creation however, then you’ll suffer disastrous consequences as the four elements violently disrupt.
addons.title: Tornado of Creation
Spiral of Creation
