addons.text: Spinjitzu's shape and its ability to channel energy allows it to seamlessly utilize your Spiral Power, the infinite energy of potential within unlocking the true power of Spinjitzu. This allows you to perform something like the Tornado of Creation solo, converting your Spiral Power directly into matter at a more efficient rate.

addons.title: Endless Spinjitzu
addons.text:
Spinjitzu's ability to harness different types of energy, combined with the rotational nature of the technique allows it to synergize perfectly with the Spin, almost like it was made for it.

The energy of the Spin enhances your Spinjitzu, improving all aspects of it. It also acts to sustain your Spinjitzu, allowing you to maintain it with minimal effort.

objects.text: You're capable of using Spinjitzu, a martial arts technique developed for close-combat. By tapping into your inner balance while spinning rapidly, you can create a tornado-like vortex of energy around yourself. It’s the art of rotation, which adds force and momentum to blows. It allows quick perception and the ability to hit or spin enemies in the process. While in this tornado you can move horizontally across surfaces at a rapid pace, while remaining unaffected by stairs or the surface of still bodies of water. With some practice it may also enhance jumps, thus carrying you further for a short time, deflect projectiles, suck in objects and shoot them back out, drill holes into weak surfaces, allow quick-changing, simultaneous usage of weapons, and keeping your vision unimpaired while spinning. However, Spinjitzu requires a lot of energy to maintain and as such can't be used for extended amounts of time without training. With enough training you can increase its duration, create modified versions of it like ones focused on fast movement, increased strength or even ones granting temporary flight while in use. A technique based on balance and rotation in which you tap into your elemental energy while turning quickly. Developed by the First Spinjitzu Master long before time had a name, Spinjitzu is more than a martial art: It's also a way of living. Mastering it is a lifelong journey.
objects.title: Spinjitzu (LEGO Ninjago)

objects.text:
The Argentum Sphere is a technique accessible only to the most skilled warriors, allowing them to move and perceive the world at hundreds of times their normal speed.

Although this acceleration affects both the body and mind, the core mechanism lies in the hyper-acceleration of thought, enabling the user to stretch one or two minutes of real-time into several hours within their mind.

This altered perception removes the subconscious "speed limiter" imposed by the mind to prevent high-speed collisions, allowing the user to operate at their true peak velocity.

However, the technique is highly taxing, as it pushes the body beyond its natural limits. While the Argentum Sphere is active, the user consumes stamina at ten times the rate normally required for any activity. 

There are ways to mitigate this increased stamina cost, such as minimizing one’s own movement during its activation or toggling it on and off mid-combat during nonessential moments, extending total time in the Argentum Sphere before exhaustion sets in.

As each warrior’s approach to combat differs, most warriors will develop the base version of the Argentum Sphere into their own unique variation of the technique. 

For example, Argentum Sphere: Shared World allows the user to share their accelerated state with others.

The more one practices and masters the technique, the greater their rate of acceleration can become, with the potential to develop a personal variation of the Argentum Sphere.
objects.title: Argentum Sphere (I was reincarnated as the 7th prince)

objects.text:
You are a Künstler, a devoted practitioner of Panzer Kunst, the first martial art designed to thrive in the unforgiving conditions of zero gravity. Originating on Mars during humanity’s early expansion into space, Panzer Kunst has earned its reputation as the strongest of the cyborg martial arts. It seamlessly integrates the mechanical precision of cybernetics with the fluid grace of human intuition, forging warriors capable of combating even the most imposing foes. Especially renowned for neutralizing and dismantling larger opponents, Panzer Kunst has become the foundation for many other spacefaring fighting styles, such as Space Karate.

Panzer Kunst was developed not only to address the challenges of combat in zero gravity but also to accommodate the ever-growing prevalence of cyborg augmentation. It prepares practitioners for encounters against both unarmed and armed foes, including those wielding advanced ranged weapons. At its core is the mastery of Körperkampf—a state of balance and body control essential for fighting in the weightlessness of space or under the varying conditions of planetary atmospheres. This art emphasizes speed, agility, and a striking fluidity, enabling Künstlers to transition effortlessly between movements, attacks, and defensive maneuvers.

Panzer Kunst is characterized by its devastating techniques that leverage the practitioner’s entire body to generate momentum. Strikes often utilize vibration-based attacks to bypass the toughest cyborg armor, targeting vulnerable joints, internal mechanisms, or organic tissues hidden beneath. Kicks, spins, and grapples are executed with precision, often propelling the Künstler toward weak points at tremendous velocity. This combination of grace and raw force allows Panzer Kunst to excel against larger and more heavily armored adversaries.

More than just a physical discipline, Panzer Kunst sharpens the mind. Künstlers are trained to analyze their opponents’ combat styles in real-time, adapting to exploit weaknesses. A Künstler who survives a first encounter will rarely be bested in a rematch. This tactical edge, paired with an unyielding sense of duty and a willingness to sacrifice everything for the mission, defines the Künstler’s indomitable spirit.

As a beginner, or Anfänger, your body has undergone the minimum necessary cybernetic enhancements to endure and utilise Panzer Kunst’s demanding techniques. Your cybernetics grant enhanced reflexes, reinforced musculature, and a nervous system optimized for precision. You have the potential to reach the rank of Altmeister, the pinnacle of the Kunst. 

Additionally, you have installed instructions on all Panzer Kunst techniques, locked until you meet the necessary requirements to wield them. Schatten Forgen, a basic skill used primarily as a training exercise which teaches a künstler to stay in their target's blind spot, and Hertza Haeon, a strike that delivers a high-frequency vibration to the victim, bypassing the victim's armour, and concentrating kinetic energy that, when used correctly, can be used to destroy or at least disrupt function of the brain or heart, are the first skills you have unlocked. With time, training, and the right augmentations, you may ascend to become a master of this martial art, carrying its legacy into the endless void of space.
objects.title: Panzer Kunst (Battle Angel Alita)

objects.text:
You're not just a medic, you're a high-speed angel of death and life—fully certified, black-ops-tier, and Platinum-cleared by Trauma Team International, the most elite emergency medical contractor in Night City. Your training encompasses advanced combat medicine, rapid-extraction protocol, and urban warfare triage in hot zones where police fear to tread.

You’ve undergone extensive cybernetic augmentation to survive and perform in the Red Zones: Kerenzikov reflex boosters for time-slicing reaction speed, subdermal armor plating to absorb incoming fire, and Sandevistan enhancements for rapid kinetic engagement. Your nervous system is stabilized with neural dampers and endo-shock buffers, allowing you to function through multiple GSWs, neurotoxins, or blunt trauma. An internal combat chem dispenser maintains peak performance with stims, clotting agents, or chill-pills as required.

Your standard TT loadout includes smart-linked medtech tools—autoinjectors for maxdoc and bounceback, quick-deploy medi-foam canisters, and programmable nanite mesh for wound sealing. You’re also issued a multi-caliber smartweapon, field-adaptable for lethal or non-lethal engagement depending on contract terms.

Most crucially, you’re hardwired into TTI’s restricted neural net, a real-time, encrypted tactical overlay that feeds you threat analysis, target prioritization, GPS-based exfil routing, and a squad-wide telemetry feed.
objects.title: Trauma Team Operator (Cyberpunk 2077)

addons.text:
High upon the mountains, in the lap of the gods, you were granted a great honor: training by the ninja tribunal in the ways of Chi, weaponry, and Ninjutsu.

From Kon-Shisho, the master of spirit, you learned to tap into and manifest your spirit avatar. These avatars exist in a hierarchy, with the highest avatar being unique to each individual; no two avatars look exactly the same.

From Shikara-Shisho, the master of strength, you learned how to infuse your body with Chi, bringing forth your inner strength. This grants you superhuman abilities, such as leaping several feet in the air or punching through solid stone. She also taught you to focus your Chi while remaining calm under pressure, ensuring that you won't lose focus in the heat of combat.

From Juto-Shisho, the master of weapons, you mastered the use of Chi in armed combat, wielding shuriken, nunchaku, o-dachi, bo staffs, and more. Most importantly, you learned how to channel your Chi into your weapons, imbuing them with greater durability and enabling you to create beam slashes to strike your enemies.

From Hisomi-Shisho, the master of stealth, your agility and stealth were enhanced to levels beyond even Olympic standards. You can now run across creaking, rotten bridges without making a sound when channeling your Chi.

Go forth and restore the honor of the Three-Toed Dragon Disciple!
addons.title: Tribunal Disciple

objects.text:
You have undergone the rigorous training required to become a member of the Foot Clan on par with the Elite Foot.

As a member of the Foot Clan, you are a highly lethal ninja able to operate and dominate in the modern world.

To you, rooftops are now paths for silently traveling, walls are platforms for running on and leaping off to evade gunfire, and the shadows of alleys mask you to such a degree that, without dedicated equipment, you may as well be invisible.

You possess mastery of ninjutsu and hand-to-hand combat, allowing you to defeat multiple trained opponents even without weapons.

Further, you possess a mastery of all sorts of weapons, from all the armaments of both the ninja and samurai to modern weaponry, as well as exotics like laser rifles, assault hovercraft, and even mechs.

Together, these render you a master combatant that can take on entire gangs single-handedly and come out victorious.

Finally, you may optionally gain a set of standard gear and uniform as a member of the Foot Clan. You may also pick which version’s appearance you wish it to be.
objects.title: Foot Clan Training (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

addons.text: Instead of a spirit you visualize, your Inner Beast becomes your Guardian Animal. This allows you to directly draw and manifest it's power like with Asuka's Deep Shadow, or summon it to your aid like Hibari. It can also serve other purposes like an additional reservoir of supernatural energy or become the catalyst for transcending your limits as a form comparable to or beyond the Shinobi Transformation.
addons.title: Inner Guardian

addons.text: The applications and scope of your Shinobi Barrier expands tremendously through your Domain or Reality Marble. While inside it, you have full authority on its rules, structure, and mechanics. You can choose to reject others from entering the barrier, impose limits on those trapped within, change its entire landscape with a thought, slow down time within it, and so much more.
addons.title: Shinobi Kekkai

addons.text: "You possess nothing but raw power, yet power must both be a sword and shield.” You’ve taken Master Hanzo’s words to heart, and have realized them through directly harnessing the powers of Yin and Yang. Through the method of using Yin as a "Sword", and Yang as a "Shield", you've rapidly improved your mastery over both. You become deeply attuned to the Flower of Balance, allowing you to draw on the powers both Yin and Yang individually, without constant worry for balance. From this, you can summon the destructive power of Yin and protective power of Yang freely, as well as switch to and from them at will, or use them at the same time. Through mastering this, you can augment your abilities and body with one, or use both to transcend them. For example, you can choose to further multiply the sheer power of Frantic Mode with Yin, modify it with Yang to create its inverse of reducing your own strength in exchange for greater durability and regeneration, or combine both to transcend it further. In your Shinobi Transformation or Awakened Form, you can apply this to achieve an evolvoution that adds new abilities and techniques, or invert the demonic powers of a Yoma into a holy equivalent. Should you achieve the Dual Fist technique, your potential will only further increase alongside the possibilities for more applications and growth.
addons.title: Sword and Shield

addons.text: Through awakening your latent potential, an interesting resonance with both your base form and Shinobi Transformation occurred. Now as your grow and adapt, your True Shinobi Form grows with you, creating a stronger version of both and creating bridges between the two overtime. Furthermore, should you possess the Awakened Upgrade, Yoma Mode Addon, Frantic Mode, or other similar powers, they all become accessible within your Base Form, Shinobi Transformation, and/or Awakened Form. This means you can use Miyabi's wings or Yumi's cryokinesis without activating your Ultimate Secret Ninja Art, wield Homura's 7th katana without using Crimson Mode, use all of your Yoma powers without transforming, and gain the benefits of Frantic Mode without its drawbacks.
addons.title: Flash Mode

addons.text:
You are now a Yoma Hybrid, possessing the skills of a Shinobi and the power of a Yoma, setting you up for the prodigious growth and status of Fubuki. Your natural strengths are further boosted, and your Shinobi Transformation releases some or all of your dormant Yoma power. 

If you have an Awakened Form, it's power is further amplified, with more physical changes to resemble Yoma.

Alternatively, you can treat your Yoma half as an Inner Beast like the case of Yuyaki and Yasha.
addons.title: Yoma Mode
Shinobi Tools
addons.text:
You gain the knowledge and ability to create all the weapons and ninja tools of the Senran Kagura universe, as well as any of your own creation. These include all the weapons wielded by every known Shinobi; Super Secret Ninja Art Scrolls to bestow power equal to a Shinobi Transformation, Awakened Form, or imbued with Ninja Arts; Talismans to erect a Shinobi Barrier, seal Yoma, communicate with the dead, and much more.

As a knock on effect, you can not only wield these weapons and tools flawlessly, but also become an excellent tailor and fashion designer. Which means, you can create clothing that acts as the design of a Shinobi Transformation. Once that clothing finds a suitable owner, it will become the scroll that can activate its owner's True Shinobi Form

objects.text:
You can choose to inherit the martial skill and weapons of one existing Shinobi from the Senran Kagura series, or create your own. Either way, you'll have complete mastery over it as your foundation. Some examples you may inherit are Asuka's dual blades, Yumi's ice tessen, Homura's six katanas, Ryobi's shotgun, Shiki's double bladed sycthe, Hakura's puppet robot, and much more. Your Shinobi weapon is indestructible, can be summoned back at will, and can enhance your power. Its also treated as an OoP.

You start fresh after you've graduated from any Shinobi School of your choice, with a fully trained superhuman body capable of effortlessly sprinting for long periods, parkour to travel and maneuver across vast distances or obstacles, strength to shatter boulders, expertise in stealth, and proficiency in all standard ninja tools like kunai or shuriken. 

You can cast Shinobi Barriers, a spatial domain that sends you and others to another dimension. Where you can freely fight without worry of harming civilians, or causing destruction. No one else can detect or enter the Barrier, unless they have significant willpower or are specially trained Shinobi.

You have two Secret Ninja Arts and one Ultimate Secret Ninja Art of your own design. You can create more through experimentation, training, or modification. The foundation of your Ninja Arts comes from a Guardian Animal that represents you, which you can visualize and call upon as a focus to amplify or better perform these techniques. You may freely design this spirit or let it suprise you.

Your most important ability is the Shinobi Transformation, which is activated through a special scroll on your person, making you assume your True Shinobi Form as an outfit of your choice. This form restores all of your vitality and any supernatural powers or energies you possess, as well as amplify your abilities to their maximum potential. Also, the clothing of this form is completely invulnerable.

Should you possess supernatural powers or energies, you gain access to the Flower of Balance, which is composed of drawing on the powers of Yin and Yang. The former allows you to enter a state called Frantic Mode for enhanced strength and speed at the cost of reduced defense, while the latter can be used to further augment your base form and Shinobi Transformation. By harmonizing with both, you can transcend the limits of a Shinobi.
objects.title: Shinobi (Senran Kagura)

objects.text:
To the outside observer, your actions seem nothing short of magic. You slam an invisible door into someone’s face. You gallop through the battlefield atop an invisible horse. The door hinges squeal, The horse neighs… as if they’re really there.

But the truth is far more grounded—though no less impressive. Through a perfect blend of miming, ventriloquism, and explosive movement speed faster than the human eye can track, you've created a martial arts style built on deception, illusion, and misdirection.

Its only real weaknesses are those who can brute-force through it, those with eyesight sharp enough to track the truth behind your tricks, or the hopelessly intoxicated—who, ironically, may believe your illusions so completely that they become real to them.
objects.title: The God in a Box (Convict Colosseum)

objects.text:
Tam Quy Khí-Công is a dying martial art, much of it lost over the centuries. What little remains has been watered down into little more than an exercise, masquerading as martial arts, much like Tai Chi.

But you possess the knowledge to perform Tam Quy Khí-Công as it was meant to be — a martial discipline capable of explosive strikes that can shatter reinforced concrete, and movements so fast you blur to the untrained eye.

At its core, Tam Quy Khí-Công is about mastering control of the breath. As a side effect, this has vastly expanded your lung capacity. For example, you can resist aerosolized poisons or keep moving long after an ordinary person would have collapsed from lack of oxygen.
objects.title: The Future of Tam Quy Khí-Công (Convict Colosseum)

objects.text:
You have undergone martial training in the ways of the Nail. While you're no Nail Master, let alone a Nail Sage, you have gained basic mastery of your Nail and the three Nail Arts: Cyclone Slash, Dash Slash, and Great Slash. But it requires focusing to perform these techniques; this can be shortened with training.

You can, in time, create your own Nail Art, and pass it along—along with the three that come with the power—to anyone you teach.

You also learn the art of how to pogo on enemies, spikes, and other such hazards. By slashing your Nail downward at the right moment, the knockback sends you flying upward, allowing for more airtime. This also resets any abilities that you can use only once before landing on the ground (i.e., double jumping).

Your Nail Arts are a martial technique unto themselves, but they complement other weapons like swords, and they are transferable, allowing you to perform your Nail Arts with a variety of weapons, given time to adjust the technique.

You also gain your own Nail that will further grow and evolve with use. In time, as your strength and mastery increase, your Nail could rival that of the Pure Nail. Your Nail counts as OoP.
objects.title: Nail Arts (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
You have acquired knowledge of all the techniques practised by all known users of the Enlightenment of Thunder and Lightning (E.O.T.L.). The principles of E.O.T.L. are rooted in the Ki Theory of Yin–Yang, and the Five Elements, with particular emphasis on the cultivation of the Metal Element and the extreme refinement of Ki.

The breathing method of E.O.T.L. amplifies the presence of the Metal aspect of Ki within the surrounding atmosphere and forces it into collision with a medium, thereby generating lightning. Cultivating the Metal Element also strengthens the user’s body, as its presence within the body greatly enhances physical durability.

E.O.T.L. converts Yin Ki and Yang Ki into negative and positive charges, which are then brought into collision. The breathing cycle serves as the focal point of this transformation—Yin governs inhalation (negative charge), while Yang governs exhalation (positive charge). These polarized energies can then be manipulated to produce a variety of techniques.

At its core, E.O.T.L. follows a philosophy of quality over quantity. The art depends on highly refined and purified Ki, even in small amounts, rather than vast reserves of unrefined energy. The breathing method is essential to this purification process, much like how only purified uranium can produce an atomic explosion.

Over time, E.O.T.L. has abandoned rigid traditional movements and forms. Instead, it is passed down in a way that allows each successor to integrate its principles into their own fighting style, enabling the art to evolve continuously. Because of this adaptability, E.O.T.L. can also absorb and incorporate the principles of other martial disciplines.
objects.title: Enlightenment of Thunder and Lightning (Veritas)

addons.text:
You obtain the Record of Transcending Cultivation and Exhausting Martial Arts, a martial scripture originally developed by the Ender, Kim Young Hoon, for the sole purpose of allowing Martial Arts to contend against cultivators. Rather than focusing purely on the body or Internal Energy, this scripture focuses on refining Intent itself to directly affect consciousness, perception, and the spirit. Beginning from the understanding of Purple and the convergence of Intent, the Record allows one to penetrate the blind spots within another’s consciousness, making oneself appear seemingly invisible even while directly before them.

At the core of this scripture lies the Endless Path Within Paths, a principle centered around all Intent converging into a single point. Through this, your Martial Arts become capable of slicing through the domain of consciousness itself, interfering with perception, awareness, divine consciousness, and even the deeper recesses of the spirit. Rather than merely attacking the body, your Martial Arts can directly affect the opponent’s mind through your own mental strength.

The Record of Transcending Cultivation and Exhausting Martial Arts is not a fixed or completed path, but one continuously refined and evolved further. With sufficient talent, understanding, effort, and mastery, these methods can continue deepening to extraordinary levels, reaching heights such as diving into the Domain of Purity itself while further refining control over consciousness, Intent, and the spirit.
addons.title: Record of Transcending Cultivation and Exhausting Martial Arts

addons.text: Like the descent of fate into the Plane of Qi grants the Enders their talents and physiques, your metamorphosis grants you the supreme talent in Martial Arts of the Golden Heavenly King Enders of the Seven Brilliance Kings. Unlike the talents granted to the Enders through their fates, this gift is wholly your own, a natural genius that allows your understanding, growth, and refinement in Martial Arts to progress at an absurd pace. Even without any guidance from others, reaching the Peak Master realm within a few months is entirely possible, while proper guidance and resources can shorten such progress to mere weeks or even days. Your natural ability in the comprehension of Martial Arts borders on the impossible, allowing realizations that would normally require years or decades to occur naturally through battle and experience. You are capable of analyzing, adapting, refining, and even developing Martial Arts in the middle of combat itself, while bodily refinement and Martial Arts transformations become significantly easier to endure and adapt to. This same monstrous insight also applies outside of combat, allowing you to rapidly improve and create Martial Arts through understanding and practice alone. Like with achieving Five Energies Converging at the Origin, your body is now capable of undergoing repeated metamorphosis and further refinement as your Martial Arts continue to evolve, granting further rejuvenation and making your body increasingly suited for Martial Arts. Upon reaching the Peak Master realm, stepping directly into Three Flowers Gather at the Summit becomes almost natural, while reaching Five Energies Converging at the Origin is considered nearly guaranteed for those possessing the aptitude of the Golden Heavenly Kings. Your talent also grants you the capability to continue elevating Martial Arts itself, pushing it toward higher realms and developments beyond what was once thought possible. Your talent does not stop at the mortal realms of Martial Arts, naturally extending into the path of Heart Path Manifestation as well. Progressing through the First, Second, and Third Stages of Manifestation becomes vastly more achievable for you than for ordinary martial artists, allowing rapid advancement so long as sufficient effort, understanding, and experience are invested. The principles behind Manifestation, heart essence, and the shaping of one’s Martial Arts into reality become significantly easier for you to comprehend and develop. Though the higher steps still require immense insight, understanding, and time, your prodigious aptitude grants you the potential to continue advancing even through the Steps Before the Throne themselves. While progressing through those realms remains extraordinarily difficult and may still require centuries of effort and experience, even the Third Step Before the Throne Udumbara and developing Triple Divinity remain within the realm of possibility for you to eventually attain.
addons.title: Golden Heavenly King Talent

addons.text:
You possess the monstrous genius and killing talent of the Future King himself. Even while blind and still a young mortal child, his instincts and natural aptitude for combat had already reached a level that allowed him to instinctually develop breathing techniques, read the flow of Heaven and Earth, sense the hostility of others, possess an abnormal will and conviction, and step into Peak Master through natural comprehension alone. This same instinctive talent for killing and combat now exists within you, allowing realizations and enlightenments related to Martial Arts, slaughter, cultivation, and devilish arts to be reached at an absurd speed.

Killing techniques, movement arts, swordsmanship, Internal Energy methods, cultivation, devilish arts, Immortal Arts, and mantras become vastly easier for you to comprehend and develop. Your instincts for danger and survival continuously sharpen through conflict itself, allowing your techniques and arts to rapidly evolve and adapt under pressure. This same monstrous aptitude also applies outside of combat, allowing techniques, arts, and methods to be rapidly improved and developed through training and comprehension alone. Your aptitude for reaching enlightenments is similarly monstrous, especially during moments of suffering, pressure, madness, despair, and life-or-death struggle.

You possess the capability to create Martial Arts such as the Emptiness Sword and continue elevating them to far greater heights. You also possess the talent and potential needed to eventually reach Martial Pinnacle, the final stage of Manifestation and the pinnacle of Martial Arts. Finally, you even possess the qualifications to eventually create your very own Divine Art.

Like the Future King, your arts possess the potential to continue evolving without clear limit. It took the Future King only three regressions as a mere mortal to kill Fuxi, a Supreme Deity of his universe, while also killing and controlling the deity born within himself. A miracle achieved by a regressor in merely their third life. The same genius that you now possess would one day allow the slaughter of every living being within Mt. Sumeru, the grasping of the Absolute of Fate itself, and even the tearing apart of Creator Gods and their worlds. Techniques can gradually be refined into deeper forms and linked arts, while your understanding of combat, killing, and devilish arts continuously deepens through experience and enlightenment.
addons.title: Second Coming of the Future King
The Severing Mountain Swordsmanship (A Regressor’s Tale of Cultivation)
addons.text:
You have acquired the Severing Mountain Swordsmanship and have complete knowledge of all its techniques. Through a process of adaptation and refinement, the art has been custom-tailored to match your unique rhythm, temperament, and fighting style.

The Severing Mountain Swordsmanship consists of thirty-six primary moves and dozens of derivative techniques. However, it is not a static art. Through sufficient training, insight, and experience, you may continue to expand upon its foundations and create entirely new techniques of your own.

The more advanced techniques place greater demands upon the user, and the later forms may require a significantly higher level of power to perform effectively.

Moves 1–12: These foundational techniques rely entirely upon precise physical movements, flawless positioning, kinetic redirection, and pure martial prowess. Though lacking supernatural power, they form the bedrock upon which all higher techniques are built, allowing the user to dominate opponents through skill, efficiency, and mastery of the sword.

Moves 13–24: These techniques bridge the gap between mortal martial arts and cultivation. By channelling sword energy and martial intent, the user weaponizes spiritual power, manipulates space, redirects incoming force, and unleashes attacks that surpass the limits of ordinary swordsmanship. At this stage, the sword becomes an extension of both body and spirit.

Moves 25–36: These supreme techniques transcend physical limitations entirely. By harmonising the user's Heart Intent with the fundamental principles of Heaven and Earth, the sword ceases to be merely a weapon and becomes a force that can influence reality itself. These ultimate moves are capable of striking concepts, severing souls, distorting time, and cutting through phenomena that ordinary martial arts could never hope to reach.

objects.text:
Martial Arts is one of the three fundamental paths of cultivation. Unlike Heaven or Earth cultivation, it does not require a spirit root or any form of bloodline, relying only on one’s Heart. Through training in Martial Arts and Internal Energy, you refine your body, mind, and spirit, eventually reaching a level where you can form what other paths are born with, such as a Spiritual Root or an inner core.

You begin your journey as a Third Rate Master, gaining a suitable basic Internal Energy method from the setting along with a Martial Art to practice. In the early stage, you will need to learn either one of them, with reaching the middle stage requiring you to learn both. To enter the late stage as a Third Rate Master, you will need to be able to use both Martial Art and Internal Energy methods simultaneously, forming a proper foundation for your journey.

At the Second Rate Master realm, your control improves, and one can be considered to have a basic level of proficiency in martial arts. In the early stage, you will need to become skilled in both Martial Arts and Internal Energy, with the middle stage requiring you to be extremely proficient in both. Finally, in the late stage, you will need to be able to use both Martial Art and Internal Energy methods seamlessly, without conscious effort.

At the First Rate Master realm, you move beyond strict reliance on teachings and begin the proper use of your Internal Energy. To reach the early stage, you will need to achieve freedom in both Martial Art and Internal Energy, unfettered from following manuals. 

In the middle stage, you will need to understand the essence of your Martial Art and begin projecting Internal Energy externally. This is not simply used to reinforce your weapon, but to release the refined characteristics of your Martial Art itself, bringing out its defining traits and extending your attacks beyond your body. 

In the late stage, you will need to reach unity of Man and Weapon, where Internal Energy naturally flows through your body and weapon without strain. Sword energy no longer needs to be forced, instead covering your weapon on its own, becoming more stable and able to be maintained for far longer periods while allowing for more efficient and precise use, as you begin to develop Intent.

Next comes the realm most dream to reach, the Peak Master realm, also known as the Pinnacle. At this stage, you begin to peer into the world of Intent, perceiving it directly as lines of color, where Red represents others and Blue represents oneself. These lines are not reflections of movement or prediction, but Intent itself, the direction in which a martial artist unfolds their Martial Art. Martial artists at this realm are widely respected, as they see a different world from First Rate Masters, and it is said that at least fifty First Rate Masters must gather together to exhaust and defeat a single Peak Master.

In the early stage, you acclimatize your mind to perceiving Intent, being able to see either Red lines or Blue lines at a time. Through this, you begin to understand that Martial Arts are not fixed forms, but are shaped by the Intent of the one using them, allowing you to respond more precisely in combat.

In the middle stage, you are able to see both Red and Blue lines simultaneously, allowing you to fully perceive the interaction between your Intent and that of others. At this point, your Martial Art is no longer bound strictly to form, as it is guided by your Intent. By infusing Intent into your techniques, your Internal Energy evolves into weapon aura that can extend beyond the blade. This can manifest as Sword Silk, where your aura becomes thin and thread like, allowing you to project multiple lines of Intent at once, greatly increasing both control and adaptability.

In the late stage, you discover Purple, the intersection of Red and Blue, representing where Intent meets and overlaps. Through this, you gain a deeper level of understanding of both your own Intent and that of others, allowing you to interfere with, redirect, or overwhelm opposing Intent directly. At this level, your techniques remain stable and effective even when deviating from their original form, as your Martial Art is now governed by your Intent rather than fixed technique.

You have the potential to advance through these realms and reach the Peak Master realm within a few years through your own effort and understanding. However, your martial journey does not end here, as beyond the Pinnacle lies the legendary realm of Three Flowers Gather at the Summit, a stage said to require understanding that all Intent is fundamentally the same, with stages existing beyond even that. With sufficient talent, comprehension, effort, and time, it is possible to continue advancing even further along this path, eventually reaching the realms of Manifestation and beyond. If the setting lacks spiritual energies or similar forces, you can instead draw upon the ambient energy of the world and shape it through your practice, with your body possessing the proper physique and foundations required to continue along this path.
objects.title: Martial Path (A Regressor’s Tale of Cultivation)

objects.text:
Chi-blocking is an ancient technique used to block the movement of the opponent's Chi by striking at their pressure points. It can disrupt not only chi but any kind of internal energy like chakra or cursed energy. Furthermore the body part struck is rendered paralyzed for quite some time.

You become master in the art of chi-blocking and are agile enough to be able to hold your own against Ty Lee.

Be aware that metal armor is enough to stop block any chi-blocking strikes.
objects.title: Chi-Blocking (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

objects.text:
You have now gained one of the most impressive fighting styles in the PTJ Verse.

You possess the entirety of Samdak, the Fighting Rooster's legendary How To Fight series of martial arts. Every technique, every lesson, and every secret he ever compiled, this knowledge is now permanently etched into your mind, granting you the ability to identify and perfectly counter any martial art Samdak ever studied and/or encountered, which includes: Muay Thai, Boxing, Taekwondo, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Kyokushin Karate, Judo, and CQC.

However, you do not inherit Samdak's physical attributes, such as his strength, speed, and durability. What you do receive is his muscle memory from his prime. Your body moves with the instinct and precision of a legend, even if your raw power falls short.

The true power of this style reveals itself after combat ends, where both knowledge and inspiration floods your mind. You can immediately devise counters to your opponent's techniques and fighting styles, pulling from Samdak's vast repertoire to dismantle them.

But there's a deeper layer. When facing an opponent whose skill or power exceeds your current capabilities, the adaptation doesn't come instantly. Instead, you experience a burst of enlightenment, one that takes time to fully manifest, typically within minutes to hours of the fight's conclusion. The techniques that emerge from this enlightenment often appear supernatural to onlookers.

For example: you might remain completely still as a devastating punch connects, yet emerge unharmed, only to lightly tap your opponent's chest with your fist and send them flying through several walls, the force seamlessly transferred without a single step.

Or you could face a city block's worth of heavily trained soldiers, wearing nothing but a tank top, pants, and sandals, then defeating them all through sheer skill and technique alone.

A brief skirmish, followed by running away and returning, doesn't count. You must face your opponent head-on, fighting with genuine intent. Whether you win or lose, you'll be ready for whatever comes next.
objects.title: How To Fight (PTJ Verse)

objects.text:
You gain training in the seven forms of lightsaber combat used by the Jedi Order. These forms are designed primarily for use with a lightsaber and normally require a connection to the Force. However, you’ll be able to replicate their physical movements, and abilities with any sword-like weapon without damaging it, even without the Force.

Form I, <u>Shii-Cho</u>, was developed as the Jedi transitioned from traditional swords to lightsabers. It is simple and raw, but deadly in experienced hands.

Form II, <u>Makashi</u>, was created in an era when duelling rogue Jedi was almost routine. Designed for one-on-one combat, it favours fluid movement and precision over brute strength.

Form III, <u>Soresu</u>, was designed to counter blaster fire. It uses dodging and tight movements to minimise exposure to ranged attacks. Focused on defence, Soresu is well suited to long fights, as its minimal movements conserve energy.

Form IV, <u>Ataru</u>, relies on aggressive movement, combining strength, speed, and agility. Ataru users are in constant acrobatic motion, attacking with wide, powerful swings at great speed.

Form V has two distinct variations, <u>Shien</u> and <u>Djem So</u>. Shien focuses on deflecting ranged attacks and launching powerful counterattacks, while Djem So focuses on lightsaber duelling, relying on brute strength to overwhelm foes.

Form VI, <u>Niman</u>, attempts to achieve balance. Its “jack-of-all-trades” nature makes it useful in almost any scenario. Niman relies heavily on intuition, improvisation, and creativity in combat.

Form VII also has two distinct variations, <u>Juyo</u> and <u>Vaapad</u>. Juyo focuses on furious offence. It is difficult and demanding to learn, but full of malignant grace. Vaapad is weaponised chaos: its attacks appear unconnected, and its movements seem unpolished to the casual observer.
objects.title: Blademaster (Star Wars)

addons.text:
You’ve been given the ancient Darksaber, a lightsaber created by Tarre Vizsla, the first Mandalorian ever inducted into the Jedi Order.

With a slitted hilt made of Beskarr, the Darksaber is more akin to a traditional blade than most lightsabers, though in function it largely fulfils the same purpose, as an elegant weapon from a more civilised time.

However, unlike other lightsabers, the Darksaber was polarised slightly differently, allowing it to form a subconscious connection to the wielder, becoming heavier or lighter depending on how the wielder embraced the connection. Similarly, this polarisation allows it to lightly pull other lightsaber blades towards it allowing them to be parried with greater ease.
addons.title: Darksaber

addons.text:
Once, Tarre Vizla united the mandalorian clans and houses under his leadership, while remaining true to the ways of the Jedi. While he never achieved the rank of Master, he was nonetheless respected by the Jedi, and revered by the Mandalorians.

His skills are now yours, from the skills of a jedi in wielding the Force, or a lightsaber, to merging them with the skills and armaments of the mandalorian, in a potent and fearsome combination. Likewise, you have the ability to unite a conflicted people, forge beskar well enough to make from it a hilt, and to merge philosophies which only seem incompatible.
addons.title: Mand'alor The Jedi

objects.text:
You have been made Mandalorian in all ways that matter. 

First and foremost, you’ve received a full and comprehensive package of various martial arts. These are mostly dedicated to weapon-based martial arts (both ranged and melee) with side focuses on striking, grappling, and wrestling to take advantage of the fact Mandalorians are usually fully armoured. Many of the techniques used in this martial art were developed specifically to combat Jedi, making them especially useful for clairvoyant or otherwise supernaturally gifted opponents.

Secondly, you’ve been given a set of beskar armour. This is an incredibly strong metal, yet still lightweight enough for a Mandalorian to wear near-constantly. This armour also comes equipped with the standard set of Mandalorian accoutrement, such as Jetpacks, magnetised boots, hermetic sealing rated for space combat, heads up displays in the helmet, and the iconic mandalorian vambrace. The Vambrace itself is highly customisable, able to contain many useful but specialised pieces of equipment such as sonic repulsors or hidden blasters.

Finally, you may gain any two Mandalorian weapons of your choice, from the Beskaar sword to a standard Blaster Carbine. The only exception to this is the Darksaber which must be purchased as an Object of Power.
objects.title: Mandalorian (Star Wars)

objects.text: "The Pinky. Omnipresent yet unknown to each other…" It seems congratulations are in order. You have ascended to become one of the 108 peerless few members of the Pinky, a great honor indeed. The membership of the Pinky is divided into 2 sections, those of the 36 Heavenly Spirits and 72 Earthly Fiends. All hold a seat named after a certain Star, and the holders of the seats often have unique abilities corresponding to the title of said Star. For example, the Tiangang (Strength) Star would be a titan of a man who surpasses even most Color Fixers in raw power, while the Tiansha (Killer) Star would have peerless skill in the art of murder, outclassing most with pure skill. You may choose to either gain the power of a known Star or create your own abilities based off one which has not shown up in Canon yet. In addition to your unique ability, you receive a type of Relic known as a "star-forged" weapon. It bonds to you, forcing you to use it as your only Relic henceforth. Though the price is worth it, as it works in tandem with your unique ability to reach even greater heights, such as the Tiansha Star's blade being able to inflict permanent wounds and erase targets from existence. It would be quite embarrassing for you to be unable to effectively wield the Relic you have bonded to, so you have acquired the excellent combat skills and vast wealth of experience expected of a proper Pinky member, as well as the general enhancements of a Grade 1 Fixer. Finally, all official members of the Pinky are practitioners of Shin and Mang. While you are not a true practitioner yet, the use of the two come naturally to you, learning in weeks what would take others months and being able to use it with greatly reduced mental strain. Should you already be able to use Mang, then you will be able to manifest 3 more rings in addition to your baseline.
objects.title: Star of The Pinky (Project Moon)

objects.text: Shundō is an Instant Movement Technique that allows you to move by “grasping” the surface beneath you with your feet and using it as a point of leverage. Rather than simply increasing your speed, Shundō lets you instantly reposition yourself by pulling your body toward the point you grasp, making movement so sudden that it appears as teleportation. With practice, you learn to grasp more than solid ground. Advanced users can seize the air itself, allowing for omnidirectional movement, midair changes of direction, and movement without needing a surface to stand on. At the highest levels, you can grasp space itself, allowing you to move through the gaps between locations and effectively disregard ordinary distance. Shundō is also a powerful physical enhancement technique. By grasping the world beneath you, you can generate near infinite leverage and transfer that force throughout your body. This allows you to accelerate far beyond what your muscles should permit, dramatically enhance the power of your strikes, and maintain impossible balance and footing. The same principle can be applied to grappling, allowing you to use the environment as leverage when throwing, restraining, wrestling, or redirecting opponents. Mastery of Shundō turns movement itself into a weapon. You can appear behind an opponent, change direction in midair, launch yourself with tremendous force, or use seemingly impossible angles and positions to attack from anywhere. While it has never been done, using the technique with your hands is also possible with training.
objects.title: Shundō (UQ Holder)

objects.text:
Trained to both ignore the natural filter that limits your awareness to your immediate surroundings, and precisely isolate specific stimuli from the chaotic ambient background "noise" perceived by your senses. You've learned to "heighten" your perception—able to process all sensory information at once and take in everything occurring around you in full.

Such that you can, for instance, pick out the footsteps of a person a hundred paces away amid the droning noise of a crowded market; feel the subtle shift of air as they move through the crowd; or even see and process the image of a playing card flashing before your eyes for less than a split second.
objects.title: Sense of the Blade (Eternally Regressing Knight)

objects.text:
You've learnt how to focus your attention on a singular point whilst in combat. During this time, when your concentration is at its highest, everything around you shall clear away, as you discard all other forms of distraction to make way solely for what lies before you—leaving you in such an intense state of pure focus that time will seem to slow to a crawl.

Through it, you can calmly read the trajectory of your foe's attack, identify their weaknesses, freely observe their movements, and respond accordingly with precise, measured action.
objects.title: Focus Point (Eternally Regressing Knight)

addons.title: 'Talent' Core
addons.text:
You've formed within yourself a core of implausible 'talent,' using these four constituent skills and abilities to lay the foundation—much like Encrid's—that allows even the most talentless hacks and failures to calmly assess and quickly grasp advanced techniques and combat skills they'd otherwise never be capable of learning.

However, even with this core in place, genuine progress and advancement will still demand a great deal of effort and perseverance, even if you could now be considered a 'talented' individual.

objects.text: Having learned this technique, you've cultivated a calm and composed mind that never wavers in the face of danger. No matter how intense or perilous the situation may be, you can meet the threat of imminent death head-on—with a fearless resolve, an unflappable demeanor, and unflinching determination.
objects.title: Heart of the Beast (Eternally Regressing Knight)

objects.text:
A set of training methods that combine specialized breathing techniques with weighted movements, stretching, and deep tissue muscle conditioning—designed to rebuild a person's body and improve the quality of their muscles without sacrificing any of their flexibility, speed, or agility. In fact, it'll even increase it.

Within a few months of intense, dedicated training, even a normal person could lift small boulders onto their shoulders and run with them, swing massive logs as though they were ordinary swords, and have a body as strong as "steel."
objects.title: Isolation Technique (Eternally Regressing Knight)

objects.text:
You are a master of Sinanju, possessing the physical abilities of a true master, along with complete knowledge and absolute mastery of all its techniques. Sinanju is the "sun source" or the origin of all martial arts. Its strength and power come from within and doesn't depend on physical size or muscular bulk. Through its rigorous training, and special breathing techniques, masters of Sinanju are capable of performing superhuman feats. Below are some of the examples of what a Sinanju master is capable of.

This martial arts awakens dormant areas of the mind and fundamentally refines the nervous system. Masters of Sinanju can dodge bullets by sensing the displacement of air molecules, moving out of the line of fire before the trigger is pulled. They can run at speeds exceeding 100 miles per hour. By striking precise nerve clusters, they can bypass armor and muscle to inflict instant death, paralysis, or delayed organ failure with nothing more than a gentle tap.

They can rip a steel door from its hinges, land unharmed from tremendous heights, and overturn a moving tank. A Sinanju master can manipulate their body toughness in several ways they can make it hard enough to stop blades with their bare hands, or make them soft enough to absorb kinetic energy like a liquid gel.

A master can catch, redirect, or absorb kinetic energy. By regulating their body's internal bioelectric field, they can also ground or redirect electrical currents—such as those from a Taser or a live wire—away from their vital organs and harmlessly discharge them through their fingertips. A master can fight with complete effectiveness in total darkness, navigating solely by tracking heartbeats, body heat, subtle air currents, and the microscopic friction created by an opponent's movements.

Masters can run across sand without leaving a trace and sprint over wet cement without sinking into it. They can glide effortlessly over thin ice, and even walk on water through flawless control of balance, timing, and weight distribution. They can scale smooth vertical surfaces—including glass skyscrapers—by exploiting microscopic surface tension and pressure-point gripping techniques.

Through complete mastery of their body, they can reduce their effective weight to nearly zero, allowing them to stand on a single blade of grass or run across thin air for short distances.

Masters can reduce their heart rate and respiration to nearly undetectable levels, allowing them to survive underwater for hours, endure toxic environments, or convincingly feign death. Through disciplined meditative breathing, they can purge toxins from their bloodstream and accelerate the healing of open wounds within minutes. Sinanju also grants extraordinary longevity, slowing down and even reversing age.

You are also able to enter the ultimate martial state known as the Void. In this state, you no longer think about moving, reacting, or fighting. The body acts with perfect instinct, moving in complete harmony with the universe and responding to danger faster than conscious thought or ordinary human nerve impulses. While within the Void, one can render themselves completely unnoticeable. Even while standing in plain sight, others instinctively overlook them, as they project no presence, hostile intent, or detectable energy.

Entering the Void state is incredibly dangerous, because this state requires dissolving one's ego and identity, if they lose their anchor their physical body will die.

Traditionally, practitioners of Sinanju are unable to consume meat, drink alcohol, eat processed food, or smoke cigarettes, as doing so would be fatal to them. However, your version of Sinanju is free from these and any other drawbacks.
objects.title: Sinanju (The Destroyer)
Monster (The Boxer)
objects.text:
Like the titular protagonist, you're constantly cognizant of your entire body, down to the last inch, which will give you a complete understanding of how all those individual systems within it could affect one another.

Because of it, your senses are heightened to an inhuman degree, allowing you to take in and analyze everything happening around you with crystal-clear fidelity—thus heavily skewing your perception of time in turn, making each passing moment seem agonizingly slow and predictable.

And therein lies what truly makes you so monstrous, since awareness directly feeds into control—knowing exactly how each muscle, nerve, joint, etc., should move, you can replicate anything you've seen once.

objects.title: The Crimsonbright Diagram of Nine Heavens (Desolate Era)
objects.text:
You have acquired and gained the ability to cultivate the Crimsonbright Diagram of the Nine Heavens, widely acknowledged as the greatest Fiendgod body-refining technique in the Three Realms. While the original technique consisted of four stages and allowed a practitioner to cultivate up to the True God level, you receive six stages that detail cultivation path up to World God level, allowing anyone with sufficient talent and dedication to reach it.

Upon successfully reaching the Houtian level, the first stage of the technique, tattoos representing the Sun and Moon naturally manifest across the practitioner's body. These tattoos passively and continuously gather cosmic energy without any conscious effort, allowing the body to safely undergo a metamorphosis into one as powerful as that of a Fiendgod.

If trained diligently, you are nearly guaranteed to reach the Xiantian level within one to two years. At this stage, a practitioner gains control over water and fire, possesses astonishing physical strength, and develops a body that is both light and agile. All six senses become dramatically sharper, and even severed limbs can regenerate. 

At Xiantian, you may also begin preparatory training for divine abilities; at Zifu, you can begin practicing them as you meet their individual requirements. This inheritance provides principles for learning and developing divine abilities suited to your talents, Dao insights, and preferred fighting style, leaving their forms and effects open to your creativity. Each requires separate training, with more powerful abilities demanding greater cultivation, resources, or understanding.

Unlike other cultivation techniques, this method requires you to draw energy directly from the Sun and the Moon. If your world lacks these celestial bodies, you can still cultivate by drawing upon the ambient energy permeating the universe, allowing this technique to function regardless of the setting.

Your brain is now fully connected to a high speed wifi that you can toggle on/off, enabling you to browse the internet and the infinite amount of data it contains as much as you like.

Social media, Google, YouTube,,,etc you will be able to access everything in the online cyber space in your mind, and this connection can never be broken even if you are in different universes or dimensions.

Since this connection to the internet is an arbitrary link in your mind, it can never be traced, hacked, or tampered with in any detrimental way.
objects.title: Wifi

addons.text:
Your MUSE integrated with your brain mutation, gaining the ability to directly manipulate your physical and cognitive states. This enhancement enables you to automate various actions, sensations, and emotional responses, whether by your own volition, predetermined selections, or in response to external stimuli, such as performing psychosurgery. Moreover, this newfound capability can aid in breaking or bypassing Master effects, depending on its implementation.

Furthermore, your MUSE can now effectively "pilot" your body in instances where you lose consciousness or become distracted by internal/external influences, ensuring continuity of action and response.
addons.title: Mindful Helper

addons.text: Your MUSE now can connect to Networks, granting it the functionality needed to operate seamlessly within that network, whether it's the internet or another peculiar system. Regardless of the network's nature, your MUSE now functions akin to a computer and a phone combined, capable of a myriad of tasks such as making phone calls, sending or receiving text messages, appointment schedulers, scouring the network for information, conducting transactions from your bank account (if applicable to the setting), utilizing wireless protocols to control other wireless devices, and much more.
addons.title: Net Agent

objects.text:
You gain an unprecedented cognitive companion known as MUSE (Mind Utilization and Support Entity), residing within the depths of your mind. MUSE functions as both a helpful assistant and a cognitive interface, capable of communicating with you through your thoughts or other senses, similar to a heads-up display (HUD). Its primary function is to provide assistance in various tasks, whether immediate or long-term. Initially, your interaction with MUSE may be conscious or subconscious, as you prompt it with questions or thoughts, and it unfailingly provides accurate responses, drawing from your own knowledge and sensory inputs, enhanced by speculative reasoning.

MUSE serves as a lifelong companion, adapting to your tastes, habits, and preferences over time. It performs a myriad of tasks, such as simple and short-term functions like acting as an alarm clock, note-taking, memory retrieval assistant, display maps to complex and long-term endeavors such as accountant, search through information, monitoring use of anything/everything, recording images in 2 or 3D (depending on you) and sound of your surrounds and more, like providing therapy, requiring a comprehensive understanding of the task at hand.

Moreover, MUSE possesses the ability to tap into your other powers, unless instructed otherwise, enabling it to derive insights and conclusions that may elude your conscious mind initially, often without the need for explicit instructions due to its intuitive understanding of your needs. MUSE's ability to learn your preferences reduces the need for constant instruction, enhancing your overall efficiency and productivity (Muses generally learn the basics of a new user’s preferences in a month or two).
objects.title: MUSE

objects.text: By gripping someone's head, locking eyes, and shouting "Repent," you induce a trance where they experience the suffering they have caused others. Most individuals profoundly reconsider their life choices, while only the most sociopathic remain unaffected by this power.
objects.title: Repentance

objects.text:
You have the true quality of a leader. You lift those around you, to be better than they are, better than they even think they could be. Your charisma and force of personality make others believe in both themselves and you; To dare reach for their dreams, and see what fortune awaits for them. 

You inspire others as easily as you breathe, your ability to do so being outright legendary and you will always touch the hearts and minds of those you talk to if you wish it. People will flock to you for leadership, children will see you as their Hero, and your lovers will always hold you in their hearts. You can appear in your friends, followers, or otherwise close companions’ dreams and hallucinations whenever they are in danger or are being controlled by someone other than themselves. You can then guide them out of it with kind or inspirational words or give them the advice they need to survive or thrive.

Furthermore, whenever someone has lost sight of their goals, or has become consumed by panic, doubt, or despair, you can simply center them with a sudden smack, a shout for them to focus on you, and inspire a new wave of confidence in them through reminding them of their reasons, hopes and dreams they’re forgetting at their hard times.
objects.title: Believe in The Me Who Believes in You!

addons.text: Completing a story gives you the power to transport yourself or anyone within your line of sight into the world of the story. The only way to exit the story is if you allow it to happen. The characters within the story will be forced to follow the rules of the story world, regardless of the circumstances or laws of physics.
addons.title: Storyteller

addons.text: With the ability to illustrate your stories through drawing as well as writing, your skills have been taken to the next level. You now possess an advanced talent for creating comics or manga, with each panel you draw seemingly springing to life before your very eyes. Your drawings now capture the essence of your characters and settings, bringing your imagination to life in vivid and detailed illustrations that will captivate your readers. Whether you choose to illustrate your own stories or collaborate with others, your abilities now make you a truly exceptional creator of comics or manga.
addons.title: Mangaka

objects.text:
You are not the protagonist, nor the antagonist or even a side character. You are the narrator, the story teller, the Writer.

Your ability to observe people and your surroundings is above the norm, allowing you to gain [Inspiration]. [Inspiration] can be used to allow you to enter a fugue state where you can construct ideas for stories as well as to write these stories.

Your ability with any mundane written language is at the highest level a normal person can possess. When writing a story, your hand can fill up a page with words in less than 10 minutes, with perfectly understandable handwriting and amazing use of language skills.

Your writing reaches a point where a person may feel like they are experiencing the story firsthand rather than simply reading it.
objects.title: The Writer

addons.text:
After getting sufficient information about a case, you can simulate it into a scenario by consuming mind-altering drugs or drastically altering your state of mind, repurposing your Mind Palace into a vivid dream world. With time flowing much faster than in the real world, you can uncover connections that would have been difficult to make before. This will make it much easier and faster to draw conclusions, but it won’t help if there’s simply not enough information to solve the case; it'll at most uncover some clues. You can also predict the future to a limited degree in this state, extrapolating how known friends and acquaintances will react and act up to two weeks in the future, though this is only as reliable as your knowledge of them and their surroundings, as major unforeseen events can easily disrupt these predictions.

You can learn how to do these things without drugs, but it will take a while to reach the same level without them. This training will also increase the effectiveness of the simulation with time.
addons.title: Simulated World

objects.text: This power makes you a genius of deduction and perception. It doesn't make you any better at guessing, and you need sufficient evidence to make a conclusion. However, it is a lot less likely to be wrong than Tattletale's power.
objects.title: Holmes

objects.text:
In a world entrenched in deception and power struggles, you possess the supernatural skills and unparalleled expertise in planning, orchestrating, and manipulating others, allowing you to navigate the intricate web of influence with unrivaled finesse.

As the Hand Behind The Curtain, you possess an innate understanding of the motives and intentions that drive people's actions. This insight empowers you to craft intricate, long-term strategies and campaigns that span vast domains, seamlessly accounting for all relevant factors, treasures, resources, and variables involved, orchestrating plans that could span millennia, all while ensuring that your true intentions remain hidden from prying eyes.

With your masterful manipulation skills, you become the unseen puppeteer, orchestrating events and pulling the strings from behind the scenes. Your grand designs encompass vast networks, enabling you to wield unparalleled control and shape the outcomes of pivotal moments. While others remain oblivious to your influence, you steer the development of civilizations and hold the keys to their destiny.

Additionally, your mastery extends to the art of acting, allowing you to assume different personas effortlessly. With this added ability, you can seamlessly blend into any role, concealing your true intentions as you manipulate those around you.
objects.title: The Hand Behind The Curtain

addons.text: Hands are for using skills, and skills are best used with hands. Your maximum number of hands goes from a thousand to 1080, and your hands now possess all of your 108 Skills.
addons.title: Untouched Sights

addons.text:
Rejoice, for the essence of death now resides in the palm of your hands, all ten thousand of them.

Your Unseen Hands, with their ability to inflict diseases and siphon the life force of all living things, have undergone a profound metamorphosis, evolving into the very manifestation of decay and impermanence—a force that withers all. In addition to their pure destructive power, each hand can now induce rapid decay and withering upon physical contact with either organic or inorganic matter. The target begins disintegrating swiftly from the point of contact until not a single atom of their being remains in existence, if they remain in physical contact with your unseen hand. The base strength and speed of each hand have also increased fourfold, and their sole vulnerability to psychic attacks has been completely nullified.

As the user, you are totally immune to this withering ability, and you can selectively choose at will whether your hands activate this ability or not.
addons.title: Unseen Hands Of Oblivion

addons.text: Your Witch Factor of Sloth has resonated with the similar powers of your Unseen Hands and has drastically empowered them to eclipse Sekhmet, the Witch of Sloth and the second most powerful Witch to exist. You have five thousand of them, and each one has doubled in strength and can reach up to 1000 kilometers. Additionally, your miasma flows through each of your hands, allowing you to sense the world through each one. This enables you to manipulate them accurately without needing to physically see what they’re interacting with. If you have Ten Thousand Hands of Avalokiteshvara, you will have twenty thousand hands with a range of two thousand kilometers each.
addons.title: Sekhmet

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to summon numerous invisible hand-like appendages from your body. These appendages can be telekinetically moved in any direction you want, bending, twisting, and turning up to a range of 1 kilometer.

Only you, the user, can see and sense these hands, which act as extensions of yourself, with precise innate control and dexterity over each one as if they were your original arms. You also have unlimited multitasking capabilities.

A single hand is strong enough to effortlessly tear apart limbs, bend and break bones, reduce rocks to dust, lift heavy-duty trucks and launch them dozens of meters in the air, etc. To further enhance their strength, you can combine multiple hands to create larger and more powerful variants. Each combined hand doubles their overall strength, enabling you to reach a level where lifting entire islands and crushing them to dust becomes a distinct possibility. Due to their weightless nature, each hand can achieve extreme hypersonic speeds without sacrificing any of its maneuverability in the process.

The unseen hands are completely impervious to almost all forms of harmful attacks, and can block and negate them all, from physical attacks, to energy attacks, to magical attacks, and even attacks of esoteric nature, etc. Their only weakness is susceptibility to damage from psychic attacks, if they do manage to land. If a hand is damaged, you can retract it into your body for a maximum of 24 hours, depending on the incurred damage, to allow for complete healing.

You can summon up to a thousand hands simultaneously. With enough practice, at their maximum potential, the Unseen Hands and the force behind each one will be capable of shredding through the strongest metal alloys as if they were a piece of paper.

If you wish, the unseen hands can be retracted completely into your body at any moment, and in case of danger that would cause you bodily harm of which you are not aware, the hands will instantly and automatically react to protect you.
objects.title: Unseen Hands

addons.text: You aren't alone anymore, you've got friends in high and low places. You don't necessarily need to steal every asset to get your hands on it. When you get consent to copy someone else, the copied skill will be stronger as a result. As long as the person you're copying gives honest, informed consent and isn't forced to agree, any skill you copy from them becomes 6 times stronger, meaning a typical power will be 1/18th of the original's strength.
addons.title: All You Have To Do Is Ask

addons.text: ‘A book is splayed against your shoulder blades, a name matching each of your comrades appearing for each as they gravitate to your presence’ Beloved by many falling under your leadership as friends, confidants, and comrades, you can share the gift of your Brand. By marking someone with an imitation of one of your marks, you can channel it through them, allowing them as much control over it as you please. Naturally, you can revoke this gift on a whim.
addons.title: Connections

addons.text:
When your philosophy of boundless acceptance merges with a profound connection to the flow of the Dao, your ability to heal, lead, and transform others reaches transcendent levels. This synergy allows you to not only guide broken souls but to align their inner chaos with the natural harmony of existence, creating a unity that resonates with the infinite rhythm of the universe. Your presence becomes more than comforting—it becomes transformative, a catalyst for deep, lasting change.

Your instinct to say the right thing is now guided by the Dao’s flow, allowing your words and actions to resonate perfectly with the needs of others. You perceive the invisible threads of their experiences, understanding how their traumas and struggles fit within the greater tapestry of existence. With this insight, you do not merely soothe or command; you help others discover their own place within the Dao, turning their pain into purpose and their vulnerabilities into profound strengths.

Those drawn to you are no longer just a fighting force—they become a living expression of the Dao’s balance. Their individuality, shaped by their struggles, harmonizes under your leadership, creating a collective force that moves with effortless coordination. Each member finds strength in their unique journey, while you guide them to act as one, flowing seamlessly like water around obstacles and striking with the inevitability of a storm.

At the highest level, your ability to accept and align with others allows you to transcend barriers of culture, language, or even species. Alien or warped psyches that would be incomprehensible to others find solace and clarity in your presence. Through you, they reconnect with the greater flow of existence, finding not just strength but peace. This connection amplifies their potential, making them capable of feats that defy conventional limits, all while maintaining harmony with the Dao.
addons.title: Jiē Shòu Zhī Dào - The Dao of Acceptance

objects.text:
You possess supernatural charisma, with a perfect instinct for knowing what to say in any situation, and a magnetic aura of comfort. This aura draws in and soothes those with damaged, broken, warped, or alien psyches. Your very presence becomes a brightly shining beacon of solace, attracting individuals from all walks of life.

But your power goes beyond providing comfort. You possess the unique skill to transform these twisted souls into a formidable fighting force. Through your empathic connection, you can lead, command, and guide them, allowing them to tap into their traumas and vulnerabilities to fuel their strength and determination. United under your leadership, they become a powerful and highly effective fighting unit, combining their resilience with your strategic guidance to achieve extraordinary feats.
objects.title: I Do Not Judge, I Merely Accept

objects.text: You gain the ability to shape complex dreams and then force them upon others with a touch. The dream will begin the next time they fall asleep, and no matter how long you have decided the dream to last, it will be finished by the time that the person wakes up. The dreams will be completely lucid experiences.
objects.title: Dream Control

addons.text:
You now possess the intuitive combat genius of a member of the Joestar family, particularly that of Joseph Joestar.

While Fighting Instinct allows for optimal use of one's own abilities, the Joestars have mastered the maxim that he who knows both the enemy and himself will be the ultimate victor. This expands upon Fighting Instinct by adding better forward planning and careful consideration of the enemy into the mix, giving you such a clear view of battle strategy that you can plan to the most minute details, down to knowing the exact words your enemy will say when a certain point in your plan is reached.

This isn't invincible, as even Joseph frequently had to run from fights that were too far out of his league, and it certainly doesn't make you immune to being blindsided (like the Stardust Crusaders were by DIO's time stop), but this can turn normally unwinnable fights into ones where you hold all the cards.

As a bonus, you also gain a natural talent with cool catchphrases and dramatic poses.
addons.title: Next You'll Say... (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

addons.text:
Your mind’s rewiring didn’t just upgrade your cognition—it rewrote the foundation of your instinctive behavior. Without conscious effort, your perception of human behavior and mortality now loops directly into your reflexes. Every movement you make in combat is shaped by this integrated logic, fusing cold, predictive kill-analysis with raw, adaptive reaction. You no longer choose to optimize—your body simply does.

Once your senses register a target, even for a moment, your subconscious imprints a personalized sequence of lethal outcomes. Behavioral cues, microexpressions, postural habits, and even the smallest gestures are consumed and processed instantly, forming a unique psychological kill-pattern. By watching them enter combat, your automatic responses evolve even faster, until the kill pattern finds the most efficient way to kill them.

Even when your senses fail you—blinded, deafened, or disoriented—your instinct doesn’t falter. You feel where your attacks must land, based on the conclusion of the pattern you’ve already made. Spatial intuition bridges the gap between perception and execution, allowing you to strike unseen enemies or thread attacks through chaos with unerring precision. The battlefield becomes a silent conversation your body understands without needing to listen.
addons.title: Kill Sequence

objects.text:
You have an automatic response system wired into every aspect of your combat ability, allowing you to react with precision and instinctive efficiency.

In any fight—regardless of the opponent, terrain, or style—you move with natural ease, adapting on the fly to shifting threats and unpredictable situations. Your understanding of battle isn’t learned; it’s ingrained, guiding your movements with flawless timing and insight.

Offense, defense, evasion, and counterattacks flow together seamlessly, each action chosen in the moment for maximum effect. Even when faced with unfamiliar techniques or overwhelming odds, you intuitively find openings, exploit weaknesses, and adjust your strategy in real time.
objects.title: Fighting Instinct

objects.text:
Your maturity and mentality are impressive enough that you, even as a child, would be one of the best leaders of any country. Your wisdom exceeds that of powerful leaders.

You will do whatever it takes to accomplish your goals or see them accomplished. Even if everything breaks around you, if you so need to continue, you will. You will walk past your friends, as they die, or as you kill them yourself.

You are prodigal in nearly anything you try, able to master skills such as shurikenjutsu within the matter of a week.

And yet, your greatest feature is your knowledge of the human mind. With an illusion power, you can maximize the illusion to cause whatever you want to the target. You are so good at causing or manipulating illusions in people that you can sometimes even forget reality in favor of the illusion. 

Even without those illusion powers, you're good at making it seem as if you truly do have an ability to cause illusions. People's perception is yours to manipulate.

You are envied, you are feared, you are hated.

Thus is the path of the prodigy.
objects.title: Path of the Prodigy

addons.text:
