Introducing Doctor Wondertainment’s Technicolor Gadgeteer™—a dazzling new power crafted exclusively for you by Wondertainment Industries™, transform your wildest dreams into vibrant reality by transmuting everyday materials into marvelously quirky inventions at your whim. 

Engineered with cutting-edge, almost too-good-to-be-true science, this extraordinary power unlocks a realm of creative genius and innovative wizardry, though every spark of creation may also unleash a hint of unforeseen chaos, such as a playful bout of device sentience, an unexpected temporal hiccup, or a fleeting ripple in your everyday reality. 

Embrace this innovation with a confident smile and a dash of bravery, because at Wondertainment Industries™, we know that a touch of unpredictability is what makes every masterpiece truly extraordinary!

WARNING: Wondertainment Industries™ is committed to providing products that inspire joy and creativity. However, by using the Technicolor Gadgeteer™, you acknowledge and accept that some side effects may occur. Wondertainment Industries™ shall not be held liable for any unintended consequences resulting from the use or misuse of this product.​
addons.title: Doctor Wondertainment’s Technicolor Gadgeteer™ (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Prepare to embark on an extraordinary journey with the enchanting power known as Kid-At-Heart. As the bearer of this gift, you gain the astonishing ability to bend reality around you, unleashing the boundless creativity and logic of a child upon the world. Within your grasp lies a realm of endless possibilities, where the mundane is transformed into the magical, and the ordinary takes flight on wings of wonder.

Picture yourself grinding with unrivaled speed on rails, defying gravity and balance with carefree ease. Your backpack becomes a bottomless treasure trove, producing an array of wondrous items that seemingly defy the very laws of space and matter. And marvel as you ingeniously merge a nerf gun and a super soaker, birthing a mighty water weapon that drenches the world with awe-inspiring power.

But it doesn't stop there. With Kid-At-Heart, even the most ordinary objects turn into vehicles of marvel. An umbrella becomes your personal chariot, propelling you through the air like a fearless adventurer soaring amidst clouds. Don a simple cape and helmet, and you're instantly bestowed with the exhilarating abilities of a legendary hero.

The true magic of Kid-At-Heart lies in the wellspring of your creativity. Embrace your inner child, and unlock a kaleidoscope of fantastic effects that defy the limits of imagination. Discover the joy of seeing the world through unclouded eyes, where every moment holds the promise of delightful surprises and astonishing adventures.

Yet, as powerful as this gift is, remember that its enchantment is woven only within your immediate surroundings. Your playground of wonder is confined to your proximity, leaving the wider world untouched by your whimsical machinations.
objects.title: Kid-At-Heart

objects.text:
As the possessor of the Lie Eater ability, you gain an uncanny intuition, allowing you to discern with unerring precision when a person is telling a lie and precisely what the falsehood entails. This innate lie-detection ability becomes an indispensable tool in any social interaction or conflict.

However, the true strength of the Lie Eater lies in its unique capability to weave its own fabrications that are nearly indistinguishable from reality. When you tell a lie, it becomes exceptionally persuasive, causing even the most skeptical minds to believe the falsehood. This makes you a master manipulator, adept at steering conversations, situations, and even outcomes in your favor.

Furthermore, the power of Lie Eater extends beyond mere words, enabling you to create tactile illusions. When you lie, your words can manifest as convincing illusions, fooling the senses of those who hear the falsehood. These tactile illusions can be employed to create deceptive mirages, simulate sensations, or even conjure lifelike apparitions, making it a potent weapon for both offense and defense.
objects.title: Lie Eater

objects.text: Anyone that you've seen in person is added to a list of contacts, of which you can communicate with mentally. Only you can start a conversation, but once started they can reply back. This communication isn't just limited to words, allowing you to send images, emotions, or even memories. While you can force a telepathic connection, they are allowed to project harmful thoughts or emotions, such as pain. This has multiversal distance.
objects.title: Telepathy

addons.text:
Your Byakugan and Mind's Eye have synergized and resulted in your third eye fully opening. Due to this, your mind's eye perception is no longer limited by physical barriers; you can now see through solid objects and even peer into the bodies of others. You can also adjust your focus, narrowing your vision for greater distance.

Alongside this, your sensitivity to supernatural and esoteric energies, as well as the auras of people, is heightened to an extraordinary degree. You are now fully immune to any type of illusions while also gaining the ability to detect when others are under either them or any other type of mental effect. If you do detect someone under an effect, you may use the Gentle Fist and supernatural energy and hit them in the middle of their forehead to clear the effect.

You can now process vast amounts of information through your enhanced perception without becoming overwhelmed, extending your range of clarity. Finally, you can manifest a glowing eye symbol on your forehead, which functions as a fully active Byakugan, greatly expanding your range and precision even further.
addons.title: Ajna

objects.text:
You gain complete awareness within a 1-meter radius around yourself. At the expense of mental stamina, you can extend your Mind’s Eye awareness to function as a form of proto-clairvoyance up to 50 meters away. However, your precision and distance will always be inversely proportional when utilizing your Mind’s Eye. At a 1-meter radius, your Mind’s Eye can count the number of leaves falling past you. At 50 meters, you’ll barely be able to discern people’s faces and can only get a vague sense of what you're seeing. You can push your Mind’s Eye to see through solid objects, but this will heavily reduce your sight depending on how much you see through.

With your mind’s eye activated, you also gain a heightened perception towards supernatural energies, auras, and you can even vaguely gauge people’s strength relative to yourself. Through time and effort, you can enhance the power of your mind’s eye through mental exercises. This power synergizes greatly with any other mental powers you have.
objects.title: Mind's Eye

objects.text:
War is but a matter of logistics, men, and morale, and you are the master of all three.

You are a general, a warrior, and a leader rolled into one. You know the best strategies to employ in war and can craft plans that make those of your opponents seem foolish by comparison.

You would be able to gather a ludicrous amount of resources from a barren desert, and then send those supplies through a bandit-infested waste without being molested, and then turn around and convince your mutinous troops to march to certain doom for you.

Your charisma can only be described as a thing of legend. You can inspire men to fight for you to their last breath as though you were their father, or instill fear in them as if you were the devil himself. You can turn even the most spineless of weaklings into hardened warriors who can fight anything the world throws at them. And that's just the beginning—your army grows stronger, both physically and mentally, with each battle they fight for you.

If you wish for it, it will only be a matter of time before you inscribe your name into the annals of history alongside those such as Julius Caesar and Alexander the Great.
objects.title: Heir of Caesar

objects.text:
The last Roman Emperor, Konstantinos XI, fell with his empire on May 29, 1453. However, this is not the case. He had not died, but was rescued by an angel and turned into marble- or in this case, reincarnated with his memories suppressed, awaiting a call from God to retake Constantinople and restore his Empire.

You are the reincarnation of Konstantinos, the last Emperor of an empire that has fallen, and have returned to retake what is rightfully yours.

When it comes to ruling, you find yourself to be hyper-competent, able to maneuver even the most complicated and dangerous politics, manage the economy and put it in an economic boom, spot incompetent and disloyal people, and spot men with talent that don't even recognize their own with ease. You are also extremely charismatic, able to turn revolting men into men who would sacrifice themselves for you.

You are also quite lucky, as opportunities to begin the rise of the Empire are always around the corner, and even more opportunities to expand it.

Awaken, Konstantinos, for God is calling.
objects.title: Marble Emperor

objects.text:
When entering combat, you can choose to enter autopilot mode. When autopilot mode is activated, your consciousness detaches from your body. It is free to fly around and even pass through walls and other solid structures, giving you a bird's-eye view of the battlefield. An emotionless and purely logical personality begins to take over your body and act on its own, utilising everything it currently has available with optimized efficiency and machine-like precision to follow the order given to it and neutralize your enemies. Your view would also be shared with this second personality.

Be warned that when in autopilot mode, your well-being and safety are prioritized, meaning collateral damage and civilian casualties are often ignored, and lethal force is always the first option chosen. This second personality will even ignore the order you give if its calculation determines that the risk to your well-being is too great to be acceptable. Thankfully, you can enter and exit autopilot at will, whenever you please.
objects.title: Autobattler

addons.text: You can now summon a simulacrum of anyone who possesses knowledge of anything in the archive. If there is no one that you are aware of, or simply do not have one that you like, you can instead have the archive construct a perfect teacher for you, and you can freely swap teachers at any time.
addons.title: Mentor

addons.text: Instead of simply receiving an archive for your power, you receive an archive of everything. This includes information from other universes and anything else you can think of. This doesn’t give you the power, skill, or know-how of any other power, but it does contain the knowledge for you to peruse inside it.
addons.title: Library of Alexandria

objects.text:
For every power that you pick up now, you are granted a complete and incredibly extensive mental archive filled with information, techniques, exercises, blueprints, and so on that can considerably speed up your progress with it.

If you focus, you can actually enter an internal world where this archive manifests in a manner of your choice, whether it be a library, a lab, or whatever else you need. If you possess a power that grants you a personal or internal world/domain of your own, your archive can also physically manifest there.

The archive will grow the more of it you learn, seeming to never reach an end.
objects.title: Archive

objects.text: The ocean of impediment of all karma Is produced from one's false imagination. Let him sit upright and meditate on the true aspect of reality. Comprehend the truth Transcend the Nameless Reciting this sutra helps calm the mind, body, and spirit. If you're feeling unstable or experiencing mental attacks, it can help mitigate the effects. When combined with meditation, the sutra slightly enhances stamina and energy recovery. Additionally, meditating while reciting the sutra puts you in a deeply contemplative state. This allows you to better comprehend the truths and energies of the world.
objects.title: Lotus Sutra

objects.text:
Through meditation and practice, you've entered something akin to a flow state within Zen Buddhism, the serenity of No-Mind (無心 Mushin)—where the tempests of fear, anger, doubt, panic, and ego pass over you without taking root. No longer shall unnecessary thoughts and emotions govern your actions, though you'll remain aware of them.

Finally letting go of attachments and illusions, you transcend earthly perspective, having found your inner Buddha in the process. Able to fully view reality as it is, taking in its vastness undistorted, and act with a purity of intent unburdened by hesitation. Thus opening the heart to boundless compassion for all things. Ego dissolves, yet you do not lose yourself; only discover your place within the great expanse, moving in harmony with the world rather than resisting it.

And from this, your every action becomes tranquil and unclouded, embodying the essence of whatever you do. Imperfections reveal themselves the instant they occur and are unconsciously corrected, such that you never repeat the same mistake twice. Especially in battle, you become swift like a coursing river with the force of a great typhoon, wholly guided by unhindered intuition.

This shall also grant a state of spiritual perfection that wards you from malevolent forces, leaving no foothold for malice to take hold of your heart, mind, or soul.
objects.title: Mushin

addons.text: Every version of you, the timeline being split at the moment you gain your powers, has a copy of 108 Skills. As such a versatile power, it stands to reason that you'd have a colossal wealth of knowledge to draw on in this case. The intuition gained by Ouroboros is several times deeper in regards to 108 Skills, granting you a far clearer understanding of how to use it properly.

The Ouroboros plunges into the Engine of Escalation, tightening its grip upon your very being. No longer content with a mere million lifetimes, it becomes an infinitely branching serpent, ever-devouring, ever-growing. Within its infinite coils, simulations branch and bloom, encompassing every conceivable possibility, every twist of destiny, every possible variation that could exist. No longer are these experiences veiled in subconscious whispers, but true life's lived countless times, no mere simulations. 

To accommodate this infinitely growing pool of knowledge, an archive has blossomed within your mind, a perfect repository of tales of an infinite number of lifetimes lived, lessons learned.

Through this, you've become the architect of your fate. Pose a question, a goal, a desire, and an infinite number of minds within the Ouroboros churn in response. You see a tapestry of triumphs, a million paths to achieve victory laid bare before you.

This is no mere gift or curse anymore, but a twisted form of ascension, a limited form of true Omniscient. The simulations become truly flawless, encompassing every variable, every hidden factor. Blind spots vanish, the fabric of existence unfolds before you. Like a god weaving fate, you pluck the threads of possibility, selecting the course that leads to your inevitable design.

This is the ascension of the Ouroboros. No longer a mortal confined by mere echoes of knowledge, you become the center, the fulcrum upon which all possibilities turn. In a heartbeat, you amass the wisdom of a thousand lifetimes, the strategic brilliance of a million minds, and the skills accumulated through countless struggles. You are the master of your destiny, a god of knowledge and destiny in a mortal's body. The King of Pentacles that screams out to reality "I AM AT THE CENTER OF EVERYTHING THAT HAPPENS TO ME"
addons.title: Archetype: The King of Pentacles

objects.text:
You have been bestowed with a power that may be seen as both a blessing and a curse. Upon receiving this power, you are instantly immersed in a myriad of perfect simulations, experiencing a million lifetimes. Each simulation starts from the moment you acquire this power and continues until the simulated version of you meets its end. While you do not directly gain memories, skills, or powers from these iterations, you develop an extraordinary sixth sense for the future, allowing you to instinctively navigate the present and make choices that align with your ultimate goals.

Within this mysterious process, an alternate version of yourself is created, destined to relive your life in endless variations. These iterations explore different paths, hobbies, professions, and decisions, resulting in a wealth of diverse experiences.

This bestows upon you an unparalleled ability to discern the most favorable paths to achieve your objectives. Your intuition becomes heightened, granting you insights into the consequences of your actions and enabling you to make well-informed decisions that maximize your chances of success.

Furthermore, this gift endows you with profound wisdom, rooted in the echoes of countless lives. It feels as though you have been extensively trained in any skills you choose to pursue, as if you had already encountered and mastered them in a distant era. This heightened receptiveness allows you to absorb new knowledge and rapidly acquire proficiency in various disciplines, as if you have already traversed and conquered them in a forgotten time.
objects.title: Ouroboros - The Snake That Bites Its Own Tail

objects.text:
Through physical contact, you possess the ability to transport a target's consciousness into an alternate dimension of the world you currently inhabit. Within this realm, no being exists except for the target, and their doppelgänger—a 1:1 reflection endowed with all of their mental faculties, abilities, and experience at maximum capacity.

To escape this dimensional confinement and break off the effects of this power, the target must eliminate their counterpart; failure to do so results in their continued entrapment. The facsimile also relentlessly seeks to kill the target, possessing boundless stamina and immunity to fatigue, unlike the trapped individual. Should the target perish, they revive after an hour, returning to the precise location where their demise occurred within the alternate dimension.

Back in the real world, you wield complete control over the target's mind. You can manifest this influence as direct control over them, like a hivemind, or have the target become a mindless, devoted and obedient servant. The application of this power is irresistible, and you can exert control over numerous targets simultaneously if you manage to ensnare them. Moreover, you can revoke this power from any target at your discretion.

Should the target successfully overcome their counterpart and sever the mind control, you will be unable to utilize this power on them again for a duration of 24 hours. The target will have no recollection of their experience in the alternative dimension, if you so choose.
objects.title: The Best Of Both Worlds

objects.text:
Experienced combatants are generally skilled at reading their opponents and predicting their movements, allowing them to respond effectively. However, true masters of martial arts and great warriors elevate this ability to a whole new level.

They can read not only their adversaries' movements but also the intentions behind them.

This creates a form of communication that transcends words—a heart-to-heart conversation conveyed through the clash of fists and steel, where the heart and soul are laid bare.

As someone with this ability, you can easily predict and replicate your opponent's techniques (if you are capable of performing them). Moreover, you gain insight into their psyche and mentality as you battle. This ability can work both ways if you choose to allow it.

The understanding you gain makes it easier to sway those you have fought against to your side after defeating them, or at the very least, prevent a deep grudge from forming if your beliefs and morals are not too different.

Additionally, it enhances your ability to cooperate with allies, allowing you and your teammate to convey your intentions to one another instantly with just a glance.
objects.title: A Fistful Conversation

addons.text: You gain knowledge of individuals connected to your powers and their unique insights and talents. This understanding enriches your mastery by providing context and meaning to the powers you inherit. Their shadow can be seen through you, weaving their experiences and innovations into your own practice like threads in a tapestry. This deep connection not only enhances your understanding but also empowers you to refine and evolve your abilities with the accumulated wisdom of those who came before you, allowing you to harness them more effectively and creatively.
addons.title: Heir of Those Before

addons.text:
Through your insight into other’s psyche and mentality during battle, you have gained a whole new level of understanding. Your ability to copy others' combat style has reached a level where people may even mistake you for the person you are copying when they see you fight.

As you gain insights from both those you fight as well as those who developed and practiced the skills you use, you begin to inherit certain positive traits they may have. This can range from mental traits such as confidence or charisma, to more physical traits such as quick reflexes or pain resistance.
addons.title: I am You

addons.text:
You have stepped beyond mere skill inheritance. Your inheritance now reaches into Mystery itself—the foundational, arcane truths that underpin magecraft and supernatural phenomena. When you learn a skill, you no longer inherit just its function or history—you absorb the Mystery it once held, and the era in which it was still potent.

The more ancient, rare, or conceptually pure the skill, the greater the Mystery it retains—and the more Mystery a skill holds, the stronger and more potent it becomes when inherited by you. Skills tied to forgotten eras, hidden lineages, or sacred origins retain more Mystery, and this directly increases their effectiveness in your hands. A technique once practiced in secrecy or born from a divine or mythic source will function with greater force, presence, and supernatural impact than its modern, diluted equivalent.

This effect applies to all skills—any art, craft, or discipline with deep conceptual or mythic roots will manifest its conceptual weight, increasing not only your performance but its influence on the world around it. A combat form rooted in dragon-slaying legends may strike with greater intensity; a crafting method born from divine rituals may produce higher-tier results when making divine items.
addons.title: Inherited Mysteries
Self Taught
addons.text:
Your own intuition for mastering new skills combined with the insights of their progenitors, transforms you into a once in a lifetime genius. With the coveted ability to learn nearly anything by observing its practicality in action or being formerly taught about it. 

The trail and error required to learn skills has been reduced significantly, allowing you to surpass an apprentice or journeyman in said skill easily. Furthermore, the influx of knowledge from its creator bestows you aspects of the "theory" and a demonstration of its practically, as if you were being taught by them personally. 

You must still endure the process of actually learning however, as even all the talent in the world cannot make you learn something instantly.

objects.text:
Any skill you learn, be it a spell or some martial art, allows you to gain insight into its creator—the first person to have developed and practiced it. As you progress and deepen your understanding, you inherit their legacy, absorbing their knowledge, techniques, and philosophies. This connection expands as you continue your practice, enabling you to gain further insight into others who have mastered the same skill. You will not only inherit the legacies of these practitioners but also assimilate their experiences, innovations, and contributions, enriching your own mastery and creating a continuous lineage of shared expertise and wisdom. If the skill you are currently learning is a derivative of another skill, then after you master it, you will start gaining insight into the skill it originates from, and from it, the creator of said skill.

Additionally, this process can help you regain lost knowledge or skills related to the discipline, as the accumulated insights from past masters and practitioners reveal forgotten techniques and understandings that enhance your proficiency.

This also gives you a minor boost in learning skills from others, as you gain insight into the skills at a faster rate, allowing you to emulate your teacher to a degree.
objects.title: Inheritance

addons.text:
Your ideal self can be freely manifested and dismissed at will, serving as your physical form should you lack a body for your mind to inhabit. In practical terms, this projection can essentially become your true self for your disembodied consciousness.

Eventually, if you continuously inhabit and maintain this psychic construct for an extremely prolonged period of time, it can potentially evolve into a fully material body made of flesh and blood, should you so desire.
addons.title: Realised Self

objects.text:
You have become living proof of the concept of Mind–Body Dualism, the philosophy that the mind is separate from that of the body.

This power grants you a type of immortality in that your consciousness can continue to exist without your physical form. You can have your mind leave and re-enter your physical form at any point. Outside your body, you are a completely invisible, intangible entity consisting of pure psychic energy.

Alternatively, you can choose to have your disembodied mind adopt a form that incorporates your other powers. Your mind could be in another dimension, exist purely as electromagnetic waves or be digitally data-based, all so long as you have a power that would facilitate it.

While your mind is free, you retain the thought speed, intelligence, awareness and perception you had in your original form, but you also lose access to any powers or abilities that rely on you having a physical body. Beware the fact that you can potentially be trapped as an incorporeal mind forever if your body is killed or destroyed, unless you possess some way of regaining your physical existence.

As your consciousness is completely independent, you can make your mind selectively immune to physical influences such as drugs, toxins or even brain damage (although your bodily functions are still impacted).
objects.title: Mind Beyond Matter

addons.text:
In this state, you walk the fine line between chaos and clarity, drawing from both madness and serenity. You gain access to hidden truths and profound insights from the fractured reality of your mind, while grounding yourself through meditation and the recitation of the Lotus Sutra. This allows you to manage the overwhelming flood of knowledge, giving you the ability to extend moments of clarity and make sense of the strange visions that others cannot comprehend.

Your mind becomes a fortress against mental attacks, as the turbulence of your thoughts, combined with inner peace, makes your psyche nearly impossible to penetrate.

Through reciting the sutra while deep meditation, you can intentionally reach into this chaotic state, drawing out hidden truths and making sense of complex patterns. Your perception of reality becomes heightened, allowing you to solve mysteries, decipher cryptic symbols, and uncover hidden connections in the world around you.
addons.title: Lotus of Fractured Insight

addons.text: Your delirium utterly changes the prison that is your mind, drawing upon the hazards in your mind to inexorably teach itself and discard what’s left your mind has for a conventional psyche, becoming a mind as fathomless and alien as a lower eldritch entity. You see, these hazards contain untold realities and insights, revealing the ungodly knowledge sustaining them, the frameworks and bases of which they’re formed, gleaming awareness underneath and above reality; your comprehension sharpens and shatters, glancing to a clear picture—no, a broken mirror folding unto itself, a manifold structure of existence, yet whole— all the more of its enormity apart from its nature. Now, these insights are usual partners, ruminating and reflecting, revealing a growing, sinking feeling of lucidity and dreading derangement. Words and feelings left unsaid, events’ true place people’s true selves are never out of your sight, as if you always knew, your moments of clarity and delirium no different from one another; the haze plaguing your mind petered out to a daydreaming state, a neverending episode of reality’s true shape molding your lunacy. Your psyche is less of a chaotic realm and more of a plane of contradictions: order in disarray, disarray in structure, whispers and ideas tell their deepest secrets, mirages twisting and bubbling the ordinary around the edges of your mind to bear open its essence, so what’s beneath it. Essentially, both the veil of delusion and the world are lifted to a greater sense of maddened insight. Your mind is uninhabitable, a deathtrap for anyone settling on or pricking your mental world. Your psyche and thoughts are sharp knives to their attempts to either mind reading or control, or even possession, as it now backfires, causing pain, feedback, or madness to anyone invading your mindscape, leaking and infecting anyone nearby.
addons.title: Yawning State of Mind

objects.text:
You have gained access to profound knowledge, hidden truths, and heightened awareness by embracing an altered state of mind that dances on the edge of sanity. It offers you the ability to comprehend the secrets of the universe, to glimpse the deep patterns that shape reality, but always through a lens that is fractured and ever-changing.

Insights arrive suddenly, as if a bolt of lightning has torn through the darkness, revealing secrets that are usually concealed from ordinary sight—secrets about the universe, the hidden intentions of others, and the connections between seemingly unrelated events. These moments of clarity are vivid and intense, but they do not last long, fading back into a haze where reality begins to blur, twisting into strange shapes and unfamiliar forms.

Your mind becomes a chaotic realm where visions and voices intermingle. Whispers drift through your thoughts, offering cryptic messages that seem to hold answers or warnings, though their meanings are often obscure. These voices are not alone; they are accompanied by hallucinations that reshape the world around you, turning the familiar into something strange and unsettling, showing their true nature. This helps you to understand puzzles and mysteries, unraveling the meaning behind symbols, decipher ancient prophecies, or piece together events that appear unrelated. 

Your altered mind also protects you from those who would try to manipulate or read your mind, for your thoughts are like a storm—chaotic, unpredictable, and impossible to navigate. Anyone who tries to delve into your mind finds themselves overwhelmed by the shifting patterns and contradictions that fill it.
objects.title: Madness of Enlightenment

objects.text:
Many struggle with their self-image, with the gap between themselves and the perfected, idealised version of “them” they desperately wish to be. You, however, have now bridged this divide.

You can psychically project your idealised self into reality, manifesting in physical form as the best version of you that you aspire to be. This psionic projection flawlessly overlaps and molds your real body like a seamless exoskeleton, feeling as if it had been your body all your life.

The appearance of this projection reflects your innermost desires of what you wish to be. While it is rooted in your perfected self-image, you can make minor adjustments to suit your preferences. Outside mere looks, this projection can also influence your thoughts, personality and emotions if you wish. Do you want to be braver, more selfless or more driven? Your ideal self is so.

Beyond these adjustments, this projection empowers all physical aspects of yourself to a notably superhuman degree. At a baseline level, you’d become durable enough to withstand grenades, easily lift a pickup truck, move as fast as an arrow, possess heightened cognition, sharper senses and more. While this form improves your endurance and stamina, your original body still requires food, air and rest to sustain itself.

The overall power of your idealised form directly correlates to your psychic strength. The more potent your psychic abilities, the more powerful your self-projection will be to match it. Beware that this form is not invulnerable; sufficient damage can temporarily shatter it, although your original body will remain as protected as possible until it is overwhelmed.
objects.title: Ideal Self

objects.text:
You’re an investigator who's assured of finding Clues, getting Hints of what happened and the Weapons and Resources to combat any danger you might come across, as well as being rewarded Boons for solving them.

Where police wouldn't find anything even after a while, you’d stumble upon something nearly immediately. A lead, some kind of Clue that will lead you to yet another Clue, step by step unraveling the mystery. On the way you’ll find Hints, small bits of info painting a picture of what happened, who was involved and how it all might resolve. You’ll also find Weapons that will keep you safe, be that a baseball bat with nails, a gun or maybe even an esoteric weapon if your opponents are somewhat mystical in nature. You will also find Resources that will help with the trials ahead, some money, ammunition, useful devices, tools, keys and even healing items that are able to patch you, but only you up. You’ll also be able to carry a large yet limited amount of these Weapons and Resources in your pockets without difficulties, despite their weight and volume.
 
Although there’s always another Clue to find as long as the mystery remains unsolved, finding it is another matter altogether, especially the more difficult to solve it is. For a crime that’s been near perfectly concealed, you'd need to be very meticulous. Progressing can also become quite convoluted, maybe you need to glue two broken vinyl record pieces back together and listen to it for a clue, solve a puzzle requiring all kinds of random items found in your surroundings, repair a generator or perhaps even climb a tree to find out what’s reflecting light in a bird's nest. You’ll have an instinct for this, a sense for where to look, who might be important and locations you’ll need to visit. This is only a gut feeling however, you’ll still have to do the majority of the work yourself. For cases that are aged or don’t have any remaining Clues whatsoever, you’ll realize that you’ve hit a Dead End with the case, when you gain Boons that can help you with these, your gut will tell you which one is no longer a Dead End.
 
Though your path may be dangerous and twisted, as long as you keep at it, you’ll be able to unravel the mystery you’re pursuing. Once you complete a case your Weapons and all case-specific items will vanish alongside the mystery, returning to their rightful place. You’re only here to unravel the Truth after all. After completing a case you'll gain a Boon dependent on the investigation. A kidnapping in the woods might give you enhanced smell/hearing due to a dog being vital to the investigation, a very difficult case where the perpetrator managed to flawlessly clean the crime scene might give you retrocognition that only activates once per investigation, while searching for a missing item in a garbage dump for a long time might grant a mild shine to important items near you. These Boons will be useful, yet they won’t replace solid detective work, and should the investigation have been something easy, like finding a missing pet, it might just make you more likable to its species.
objects.title: Mystery Detective

objects.text:
You have spent your life immersed in the sprawling chaos of the city, where survival hinges on quick thinking, nimble movements, and an almost instinctive understanding of the urban landscape. Whether slipping through bustling alleyways, traversing precarious rooftops, or uncovering shelter where others see only ruin, you possess an innate talent for adapting to the city’s unyielding rhythms.

You instinctively understand the flow of urban spaces, effortlessly identifying shortcuts, stable platforms, and hidden hazards. Years of scavenging and improvising in the streets have also honed your balance and agility; you can climb walls, scale rooftops, and traverse tight spaces with ease. Falling from moderate heights rarely results in injury, as you’ve learned to judge the safest ways to land.

Your life in the city has also forged deep connections with its unseen networks. You know how to navigate the local underworld, tapping into the knowledge of thieves, beggars, and informants who form the lifeblood of the streets. Gathering information, picking up rumors, or finding black-market goods is second nature to you. This network also provides a certain degree of anonymity; blending into a crowd or vanishing into the city’s many hiding spots comes as easily as breathing. You can easily command the loyalty of other streetwise individuals who act as your eyes and ears.

Living on the edge has also sharpened your survival instincts. You can scavenge food, water, or basic supplies from the urban environment in mere hours, an invaluable skill when resources are scarce. Your keen eye for detail allows you to assess the value of goods at a glance or spot counterfeits and hidden wealth. If the need arises, you can quickly assess patrol routes or identify potential ambush points, making you an expert at planning urban operations.
objects.title: Alley Cat

objects.text: You are the quintessential business tycoon. You have an unnatural talent for creating and managing any kind of business venture. In just a week or two, you can make a multi-million-dollar startup if you ever need a quick few million dollars. If you ever need to buy your own solar system, you will need only about a year to be the founder of an intergalactic megacorporation. You are always aware of the current trends and have a feeling for how profitable they are now or will be in the future. If you wish, you can create an entirely new industry from scratch, firmly cementing yourself as a monopoly. You will always find a loyal customer base that will keep your companies afloat even in the most trying times, should those befall you by some miracle. Of course, there will be those who will not look favorably on your meteoric rise and potential monopoly in various business fields. From governments with their antitrust laws to rival corporations, they will all try to limit your reach, cut down your profits, and get hold of your assets. They will all fail. You can now navigate the treacherous world of business and politics with unparalleled ease, always able to find loopholes in rules and laws that would prevent your company from getting even more profit and even further reach. But what is a good company without talented and competent employees? You also have incredible talent and unparalleled luck in finding and vetting new employees, whether luring them away from other corporations or finding proverbial diamonds in the rough. Under your leadership, they will give their all to your cause, never even thinking about betrayal. And should you actually reward them appropriately for their efforts, their dedication to your business will border on fanaticism. As every employee will try to constantly improve themselves in their respective fields, you will never lack competent, knowledgeable, and loyal underlings.
objects.title: The Monopoly Man

addons.text:
Even when lost in the throes of fury, your instincts and mental framework prevent your skill and combat prowess from leaving you. You can strategize and feint, use complex techniques and wield potent magic with precise control even when frothing at the mouth with rage.

If anything, your rage makes your instincts and skill even greater, the purity of purpose derived from your single-minded drive for violence elevating you to a sort of enlightened state and transforming you into a force of nature seemingly designed solely for the purpose of slaying anything and everything that stands before it.
addons.title: Wrath Incarnate
Self-Control
addons.text:
Through your MUSE’s ability to regulate and manipulate your mental and physical states, you have developed what is effectively a safety net for using Berserk. 

In the event that you truly lose control, your MUSE can simply reset your cognitive state back to normal. On the flip side, that same control allows you to instantly sink into a state of mindless rage, skipping the ramping up stage.

For example, this would allow you to designate a goal for yourself such as triggering a mindless rage and having your MUSE guide your rampaging self towards accomplishing said goal and eventually refreshing your mind once you achieve said goal.

objects.text: You can now willingly enter a berserk state. Once activated, you will feel an ever-increasing surge of rage. The stronger your anger, the greater the boost to your abilities. Being mildly pissed off grants a meager increase to all your abilities, while murderous rage can amplify your strength to nearly double or triple. If you completely lose yourself to wrath, you will gain near-godlike boosts in power. The longer you stay in this berserk state, the deeper you sink into uncontrollable rage. You can only shut it down by forcefully dissipating your anger, but if left unchecked, your rage will continue to build until all you see is red. Using Berserk always carries the risk of losing control if you're not careful. You can maintain some lucidity through external means like perks, items, or magic, but these will limit how deeply you can succumb to fury. The power you gain is directly tied to how fully you lose yourself to fury—this is the absolute rule. Perks like Invictus, Well-Adjusted, or Eliminate the Negative can help limit your descent into wrath or allow you to regain your sanity if you lose yourself to the rage.
objects.title: Berserk

objects.text:
You have the ability to control the minds of others, tailoring the extent of your influence to your will. Whether you wish to gently guide a person’s emotions, subtly alter their behavior, or completely dominate their thoughts, your power grants you full control over their mental processes.

At its simplest, you can make them feel any emotions you want—happiness, fear, or anger—or adjust their perception of reality, making them more agreeable or obedient to your presence.

You can direct their actions to align with your desires, pushing them to make decisions that you guide them toward without them realizing it.

At its most intense, you can seize control of their entire consciousness, turning them into a puppet of your design. Every action, thought, or word can be dictated by you, rendering the target an instrument of your will.

The more powerful the control, the greater the strain on their mind, and the more resistance you may face, but with enough concentration, you can maintain control for as long as you desire.

Your mastery allows you to manipulate minds with ease. It doesn’t matter if it’s subtly influencing decisions in the background or completely overriding their sense of self.

The only limit is the willpower of your target relative to yours, so you’ve got to win the battle of wills before you can control them. But once you do, it’s up to you.
objects.title: Mind Master

objects.text:
There are times when reasoning with people becomes nigh impossible. The main culprit is extreme emotions, or irrational thinking, but that's a thing of the past for you. By gently but firmly tapping a hand or finger on their forehead, you can "factory reset" those emotions to absolute zero, leaving them with a clarity even monks would dream of obtaining.

This doesn't influence their next actions; however, it just gives them time to recompose themselves.
objects.title: BONK!

objects.text: You possess a rare and extraordinary talent—the ability to invent in the truest sense. Your mind does not refine, adapt, or build upon existing knowledge; instead, it conjures entirely original concepts, unbound by precedent. Your inventions are not limited to physical creations but can take many forms, including groundbreaking ideas, novel theories, revolutionary formulas, intricate designs, or even abstract systems of thought. Whether your innovations surpass existing methods in efficiency, effectiveness, or practicality is uncertain—what matters is that they are wholly new, never before conceived in any form.
objects.title: Invention

addons.text:
You will inevitably face problems beyond your current abilities. That’s where your true talent shines—you can gain new skills as needed. However, each new skill starts at a basic level, just enough to be functional but never enough to rival an expert. Sometimes, a single skill won’t be enough to solve a problem, but by stacking your ever-expanding set of abilities, you might just scrape by.

Additionally, you gain the same basic level in all skills native to whatever world you are in.
addons.title: All Rounder

addons.text: As the Ultimate Hope, not only do you gain superhuman mastery of each mundane skill described above, but you're also now at an advanced level for all possible magic spells, rituals, and alchemy you had the basic knowledge of due to you being the Ultimate Nerd, Mangaka, Occultist, etc.
addons.title: Ultimate Master

objects.text:
You are a jack of all trades, a master of none. If this were an RPG, you’d be considered a trash character—lacking the raw stats, specialised abilities, or game-breaking mechanics needed to survive the endgame. You don’t have the firepower of a DPS build, the durability of a tank, or the utility of a support. On paper, you’re the kind of character people reroll to avoid. But this isn’t an RPG, is it?

You have basic proficiency in all forms of weaponry, from swords and spears to bows and firearms. While you won’t outmatch a true specialist, you can pick up nearly any weapon and wield it competently. The same applies to martial arts—you know the fundamentals of various styles, enough to hold your own but not enough to master any single discipline.

When it comes to magic, you are no archmage, but you have a working knowledge of all basic elemental spells. You can cast small fireballs, summon small blades of wind, freeze small pools of water, and shoot piles of earth—just not with the precision or power of a true magic user.

However, your real strength lies in your versatility. You possess a wide range of miscellaneous skills that can make all the difference in survival and strategy. You can read maps and navigate unfamiliar terrain, identify useful herbs and craft basic remedies, perform minor equipment repairs and maintenance, barter effectively, and adapt to a variety of situations. These skills are just the tip of the iceberg.

While others rely on their singular expertise, you thrive on adaptability. You may never be the strongest warrior or the most powerful mage, but when it comes to thinking on your feet and making the best out of any situation, you’re in a league of your own.
objects.title: Master of None

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to create two simulacra at will. A simulacrum is essentially a clone, made from semi-solid energy, and appears as a mirrored version of you, only lacking a soul and internal organs. Each simulacrum retains a fifth of your powers and abilities but always maintains the physicality and skill level of an average human at least. For appearances, it can replicate mundane clothing but cannot create anything stronger.

When creating a simulacrum, there are two main options. First, you can control it directly as an extension of your own body. However, this does not enhance your multitasking capabilities; managing both your original form and a simulacrum is nearly impossible for the average person. Alternatively, you can imprint a copy of your mind onto the simulacrum to grant it autonomy. Your simulacrum will be intrinsically loyal, guaranteed never to betray you. It will follow your orders while retaining your personality, meaning it still has the same aversions you have towards tasks you dislike, such as doing homework or cleaning toilets.

Upon the destruction of a simulacrum, you will absorb all its memories. You can choose to experience these memories as separate or as if you were the one who did them. A simulacrum has no range or time limits and can exist indefinitely as long as you are alive, unless destroyed. You may create another simulacrum an hour after one has been destroyed.

A simulacrum is not truly alive but serves as a near-perfect reflection of you. Its form is fragile, and damage akin to a broken bone is enough for it to be destroyed. However, with time and practice, you can improve their quality and eventually even increase the number of simulacra you can create.
objects.title: Simulacrum

objects.text: Over the realm of fiction, we conjured up some nasty shit throughout our pursuit of the uncanny: cognitohazards that harm your psyche when you perceive or comprehend them, infohazards that are befuddlingly dangerous once you become aware of them. You are keenly aware of the danger and threat they pose for the world if left unchecked, for they are living hotbeds of these anomalies. Your mental framework houses a dimension physically manifested as part of your brain, that hosts, spawns, and controls these memetic constructs, their vectors of infection. These anomalies develop and evolve by cannibalizing and incorporating other constructs they encounter in the wild or when converging using similar infectious vectors; these vectors are anything capable of transmitting an idea, data, or information, anything in the modern age is a vector. Your thoughts and ideas, by that logic, can be utilized to spread your “thoughts” and “memes” with how they interact and evolve around the world. This changes you, not only to a certain degree, but your mind has adapted to be almost alien in its simplicity, your thoughts and ideas standing strong against them, meaning they won’t be destroyed or erased, only damaged. These damaged thoughts and views can develop into new anomalies for further development. Unfortunately, while you can direct an anomaly’s infectious vectors you can truly influence both its spread and the resulting interaction or effects it has between the concepts/information/meme it infects. You can release these anomalies into the world to expose them to the vast network of information and data the modern world has in store, further developing themselves naturally. While the fine points your anomalies escape you, influencing into them a certain target isn’t out of your toolbox. Finally, you can summon these anomalies back into your mind as you’re able to interact with its infectious vectors.
objects.title: A Mind Full of Hazards

addons.text:
You don't just possess the natural instinct and prodigal talent of an assassin—you've been mentally rewired for the role. Menticide's mental framework now fully integrates all the art of your trade into itself, allowing you to instinctively calculate the best approach to eliminating a target through whatever method's necessary and refining your skills with optimal efficiency.

With this, you can plan and execute a hit using nothing but a box of nails and some shoelaces, leaving no trace of your involvement. Every step is meticulously crafted to appear natural, ensuring that even the most scrutinizing eyes never suspect the truth.
addons.title: Professional Ghost

objects.text:
You have the instincts and natural inclination of an assassin, as you usually find yourself picking up skills or traits that define a killer for hire. From blending into a crowd, concealing your intent, striking without hesitation, tracking your mark, gathering intelligence, waiting for the perfect moment to act, etc—these all come as naturally to you as breathing.

Each step you take when on the path toward ending a life is executed with precision and purpose. You weren't just made for this—you were born with the potential to be the greatest hitman in the world, relying on skill and finesse alone.

Patience, above all else, is your greatest strength—the trait that allows you to wait days, weeks, or even months to see your goal through. It is matched only by your ability to orchestrate the perfect demise, each death meticulously designed to appear as an accident, a stroke of misfortune, or a natural passing, leaving no trace of your hand in the matter.

At the outset, you'll have a novice-level grasp of lockpicking, subterfuge, interrogation, and disguises—essential skills to refine and build upon from there. Alongside these, you also possess an uncanny knack for looking effortlessly sharp in a suit, regardless of the circumstances, with a keen eye for selecting the perfect fit and working with personal tailors to ensure it.
objects.title: Agent [Insert Number Here]

addons.text:
When you ride into battle, you are not merely a warrior—you are the heart of an unstoppable force, the pillar upon which entire armies rise or fall. Your presence alone can turn the tide of war, infusing your troops with unshakable courage and guiding them with flawless strategy. Steel does not waver in your presence, formations hold firm, and even the most undisciplined fighters move as though trained for years. Your warhorse thunders across the battlefield like a force of nature, unyielding in its charge, carrying you as a beacon of leadership and might. As long as you stand, so too does your army—unbroken, fearless, and unwilling to retreat. Yet this strength is not your own; it is bound to the faith and trust placed in you. The more your soldiers believe in you, the stronger you become, and as your power grows, so too does theirs, creating a cycle where the unwavering trust of your people fuels an ever-escalating force of unstoppable will.

But with such power comes an inescapable duty. The battlefield does not forgive hesitation, nor does leadership allow for selfishness. Should you falter in your ideals—should you abandon your people, break their trust, or stray from the path of an honorable ruler—this power will slip away like sand through your fingers. Worse still, the cycle that once empowered your forces will collapse, turning belief into doubt, courage into fear, and unity into disorder. The weight of the throne and the battlefield alike rest upon your shoulders, and to carry them is to accept that your strength does not belong to you alone. It is the will of those who follow you, the hope of those who stand beside you, and should you fail them, you will find yourself not just weakened, but utterly forsaken.
addons.title: The Monarch of the Battlefield

addons.text:
Your nobility is not a title but a contract, a sacred pact between yourself and the world. Every rule of etiquette you uphold is not merely a formality—it is a Binding Vow, granting you strength in exchange for absolute adherence. To speak with measured grace sharpens your mind, allowing you to process and respond with perfect clarity. To maintain flawless posture grants you unshakable balance, making you immovable even in the fiercest storms. To never interrupt another mid-speech hones your patience, expanding your perception until time itself seems to slow before you. Each tradition, each discipline, each vow placed upon yourself is a shackle—but in accepting these chains, you forge an unassailable foundation, gaining power that lesser beings, bound only by their whims, could never grasp. The more restrictions you embrace, the greater your abilities grow, refining you into an untouchable paragon of elegance and strength.

Yet, each vow is only as strong as your ability to uphold it. Breaking one does not strip you of all power, but the benefit it provided vanishes instantly, leaving you without its enhancement until the vow can be reforged. The first lapse is fleeting, the contract naturally restoring itself in moments. But with each subsequent failure—especially in quick succession—the process slows, the time needed to reestablish your discipline lengthening. A single slip may mean only a brief loss of balance, a brief dulling of your perception. But repeated infractions, close together, will leave you vulnerable for longer and longer, your once-impeccable grace eroding under the weight of broken promises. You are as powerful as your own restraint allows—and as weak as your failure permits.
addons.title: Golden Chains

objects.text:
You have been granted the presence, authority, and grace of true nobility, elevating you above common individuals in both influence and ability. Your words carry an undeniable weight, compelling those around you to act with dignity and honor, as if bound by an unspoken code. While you do not enforce obedience, your very presence demands respect, shaping the behaviour of those who stand before you.

Your strength is directly tied to your ability to lead and protect. The more you uphold your responsibilities, acting as a true noble should, the greater your power becomes. When you fight for others, when you serve as a beacon of order and duty, you become faster, stronger, and more resilient. However, should you falter—should you act selfishly, betray those who rely on you, or abandon your obligations—your strength will wane. Your power is not your own; it is the manifestation of the expectations placed upon you, and should you lose the faith of those who follow you, you will find yourself diminished.

You instinctively understand noble etiquette, high society, and the decorum expected of a ruler. Without effort, you carry yourself with grace, your posture flawless, your speech refined, and your mannerisms impeccable. You do not simply act noble—you are noble, down to your very core. Even in battle, your movements are deliberate and composed, as if combat itself is merely an extension of your poise. Fear does not shake you, nor does intimidation cloud your judgment. To falter in composure would be beneath you, and so, you do not. 

Yet, this power is both a gift and a burden. You are bound to the ideals of nobility, and to stray from them is to risk losing the very force that makes you exceptional. Dishonor, betrayal, or crude behavior will weaken you, stripping you of the strength that once set you apart. The respect and trust of others are the foundation of your power, and should you lose them, you will find yourself left with nothing.
objects.title: Noblesse Oblige

addons.text: Your nature has allowed you to travel up the dreamlands in such a way that cannot be described and that has no distinct or defined existence, only describable through soarings and plungings, travelling up the layers with each feeling like a dream, beyond the final layer, last barrier, the last one. But... There is no court of azathoth, no boundless demon sultan. no creatures around dancing at the horrific playing of a demonic flute. In this place, there only exists a silver gate. Which you are the key to. Your journey to the silver gate and similar existence to the All-In-One grants you significant powers in the dreamlands, becoming able to treat everything in the dreamlands as simply a part of you. This power doesn't extend beyond the dreamlands, however your ascent has made the boundary between the dreamlands and the external world ever-increasingly thin. You can now bring people into the dreamland, and by doing so, you can thin the barrier further, eventually allowing you to wield your powers in the dreamland in the external world.
addons.title: Through The Gate of The Silver Key

objects.text:
By reflecting inward and meditating deeply, you can access a world founded upon thought—a dreamland hosted deep inside the internal landscape of the mind. This realm is expansive and labyrinthine, a spatial reflection of the obscure and intangible nature of thought itself. You normally experience it as a structured yet fluid domain, shaped by your mental processes rather than physical laws.

In this dreamland, your mind exists in a higher world relative to the external world, allowing you to interact with constructs beyond the physical world. These can include, but aren't limited to—providence, souls and thoughts. Meditating within the dreamland facilitates deeper ascent, enabling engagement with increasingly elusive and invisible elements.
objects.title: Dreamland

addons.text:
You have passed through the looking glass—and now, through the veil beneath it. Your connection to Wonderland and the dreamscape has deepened into something stranger, older, and more boundless. When you fall asleep you are able to step into the place where all dreams and all myths converge.

You may now enter a surreal plane where reality is shaped by folklore, fables, and the fractured logic of dreams. This realm is not yours alone—it is vast, shared, and alive. Here, ancient archetypes from every culture mingle with childhood fantasies, forgotten gods, urban legends, and half-spoken bedtime threats. Wonderland is only one district of a greater dreaming, and now you walk its endless halls.

Within these lands, logic yields to symbolism. Doors open when spoken to. Time folds inward. People may speak in rhyme, or backwards, or not at all. The world is constantly shifting, built on your subconscious, collective memory, and narrative echoes from countless other minds. Landscapes resemble impossible paintings and fever dreams—skies made of ink, libraries grown from trees, oceans that reflect not water, but forgotten thoughts.

In this space, you can only navigate using instinct and belief. You may find locations that reflect fragments of past lives or myths that have chosen to remember you. Beings met here may be born of your imagination—or something much older simply wearing a familiar face.

However, the deeper you go, the more the dream resists being called unreal. The myths around you begin to recognise you as one of their own. Some may try to pull you in permanently. Others may ask you to carry pieces of them into the waking world. And there are places within this realm that even dreamers fear to enter.

Be wary, little dreamer.
addons.title: Wonderland Crossing

objects.text:
You exist in two worlds at once: the structured reality of the everyday, and the shifting dreamscape of fairy tales. Your presence weaves together the logic of waking life and the wild, symbolic rules of story. You are not merely someone who visits Wonderland—you are a part of it, and it a part of you.

Reality bends for you, not through brute force, but through the soft power of belief, metaphor, and myth. You can invoke the rules of fairy tales to shape the world around you. Doors may unlock if you recite a riddle; paths may appear if you believe hard enough in where they lead. You might shrink after sipping from a bottle marked Drink Me, or summon a guiding animal with the right nursery rhyme whispered into the wind.

You can draw on the power of archetypes, slipping into roles from ancient tales and children’s fables—the Clever Fox, the Lost Child, the Mad Queen. These masks don’t just change how others see you; they change what you are capable of, letting you embody their strengths and patterns.

At will, you may summon beings and objects pulled directly from the dreamworld of myths. A talking cat may walk at your side, or a Jabberwocky may rise at your command. These are not illusions—they are real while they are with you, bound by the stories that birthed them. But invoking these tales does not go unnoticed. The moment a story is summoned, the rest of it begins to stir. Summon the Jabberwocky, and the Bandersnatch may follow, uninvited. The Queen of Hearts might take offense. Old stories do not like to be disturbed without consequence.

Your power is not random or limitless—it is shaped by stories. You cannot create from nothing; only from narrative. If a tale exists to support your action, it may become real. If no story fits, your power will not answer. And even when it does, the stories you call upon may have plans of their own. 

Yet you do not begin with perfect control. Your dual existence first renders you childlike—curious, impulsive, easily swayed by emotion. It takes time, experience, and self-awareness to master the balance between the waking world and Wonderland. Until you learn control, your powers may slip out unintentionally—speaking riddles that change the weather, or dreaming a myth into reality without meaning to. Not all stories appreciate being called upon by accident. Some may come annoyed.
objects.title: Child of the Looking Glass

objects.text:
You carry the gift mankind has coveted since the dawn of time—the ability to see the future. You are a seer, able to witness what is yet to come with your own eyes. By focusing your mind, you can peer forward in time, watching future events unfold within your line of sight.

But time is a chaotic current, constantly in motion. Simply observing it begins to change it. Your foresight is not absolute and comes at a cost. The farther you peer, the greater that cost becomes. Looking ahead drains you—body, mind, and soul.

The more powerful the entity you're observing, or the more complex the future you're trying to glimpse, the more clouded your vision becomes. Attempting to see too much or too far—such as witnessing a prophecy in the future—can cause backlash. Pushing too far may fracture your mind, break your body, or scar your soul. Go too far, and you risk madness—or death.

At your current level, you can see roughly a day into the future, though only in broad strokes. You may see the shape of events to come, but not the precise details. Even this can only be used a few times a day before exhaustion sets in. Alternatively, you may peer into less distant moments with limited accuracy at a lower cost. You can stretch your vision beyond a day—but the images are faint, and the risk of backlash becomes extreme.

Your foresight can be enhanced by combining it with other powers or techniques. With time, training, and repetition, your sight can grow—peering farther, growing sharper, and demanding less of you.
objects.title: Foresight

objects.text:
The power to read the history of objects and places by making physical contact with them, allowing you to accurately relive the experiences that the item or place has undergone, along with the lingering impressions of the people who have interacted with them.

With a touch, you can experience everything the object has gone through from the moment of its creation to the present, "seeing" and "feeling" it from its own perspective. The experience itself can vary wildly—sometimes entering into the abstract, depending on the nature of the item and its purpose—yet still comprehensive, as you'll be able to understand what happened, though the way it is conveyed may be unintuitive.

You must also be wary of using this ability too often, as the impressions of those who interacted with the object can seep into your mind. The more recent and emotionally intense the interaction, the stronger the effect, and during this period, you may find yourself living through their viewpoint as well.

In addition, the sheer deluge of information and emotion involved can likewise easily overwhelm you if you aren't careful; even a brief attempt may leave you reeling with headaches. However, you can generally restrict the flow of information to limit this somewhat.
objects.title: Psychometry

addons.title: Noetic Automation
addons.text:
Due to your mind being one with your extremely malleable soul, you can compartmentalize your unified mind-soul into dedicated subroutines, allowing it to be "trained" to respond automatically. Your thoughts are no longer bound to a single stream of consciousness, and complex background tasks—such as maintaining ritual circles, running defensive spell formulas, or analyzing your own spiritual composition—are offloaded entirely to your soul's smart and autonomic functions while your primary conscious mind focuses on active combat or social interaction.

The boundary between mental fortitude and spiritual durability also dissolves completely. Someone attempting to read your soul, influence it externally, or bind it will have their efforts hindered. Whenever you face extreme mental stress, memetic attacks, or spiritual corruption, your mind immediately becomes aware of their nature, and your soul instinctively reconfigures its architecture to neutralize that specific vector of trauma, developing permanent immunity or massive resistance to that specific type of intrusion in future encounters. Perks and powers that would protect your mind will also protect your soul in a similar fashion.

Any technique, magic, or martial skill you master is no longer stored merely as muscle memory or neural pathways; it is deeply engraved directly into the fundamental fabric of your soul. Your soul actively optimizes the conceptual "flow" of these skills, allowing you to execute complex magic, psychic, or martial feats perfectly without somatic components, incantations, warm-up periods, or a specific state of mind, regardless of what physical condition or alternate body you inhabit.

objects.text:
Your mind and soul are now one. All that you are—memories, thoughts, personality and sense of self—are now fully housed within your soul. Thoughts no longer arise from your brain alone but are reflected from your true mind within your soul into your conscious awareness. You can now decide which thoughts pass through to your physical mind, allowing you to block, suppress, or alter them at will.

This makes you highly resistant to mind reading, prediction, and similar intrusions, as only the thoughts you allow can be seen within your mind. Most forms of mind control lose their effectiveness, since your mind is no longer bound to physical structures that can be manipulated, and damage to your physical brain would no longer affect it as well.

Because your mind now exists beyond the limits of the body, it is no longer restricted by biological processes. With time and training, you can increase its speed, split your awareness, manage multiple thoughts at once, and more. At first, your thinking will remain as it was, but you’ll gradually gain full control over its pace and power, shaping it freely as an extension of your soul to eventually become truly unrestricted. While your mind now lies beyond the physical, any boosts to your physical mind still apply, becoming part of your true mind stored within your soul.
objects.title: Soulmind

objects.text: You gain a powerful clairvoyant awareness linked to a select few people you care about. Whenever they are in great danger, you will be instantly alerted to their plight. You will instinctively sense their location and understand the nature of their situation—whether they are being assassinated, succumbing to illness, or suffering a psychotic break. At the same time, you will intuitively know how to best apply your powers and skills to reach them as fast as possible. This awareness is absolute and cannot be blocked by seals, spells, or any other means. It initially spans planetary distances, but over time, both the range and the number of people you can connect to will steadily grow.
objects.title: In the Nick of Time

objects.text:
You possess a monstrous capacity for learning, a mind so voracious that to master a single concept is to unveil a web of connected knowledge. When you learn one thing, your mind instinctively and instantly grasps ten additional subjects or techniques that branch naturally from it. For instance, by studying basic multiplication, you would effortlessly understand related ideas such as fractions, ratios, divisions, proportions, exponential growth, matrix manipulation, scaling, patterns, modular arithmetic, and basic algebra. This power extends beyond academics—physical skills are equally vulnerable to your intellect. In martial arts, learning a simple punch not only grants you proficiency in straight strikes but also grants you understanding of uppercuts, hooks, backhands, defensive postures, counterattacks, footwork adjustments, breathing techniques, balance control, force generation, and momentum shifts.

Each piece of knowledge can be broken down further, creating an endless tree of insight. That initial punch can splinter into deeper subskills: the positioning of your feet, the rotation of your hips, the timing of your breath, the focus of your gaze, the contraction of muscle groups—each point spawning ten more understandings in turn.

However, the effect is strongest when the subjects are closely related. The more distant or unrelated the knowledge is, the fewer insights you can draw from a single point. Similarly, if the new knowledge is far more advanced than what you are starting with, the connections grow weaker and fewer. Learning basic addition might hint at multiplication, but would offer little immediate understanding of complex calculus.

You cannot use this power recursively—insights gained from the ten related understandings do not themselves generate ten more unless learned independently, and only if they are sufficiently distinct or more advanced than what came before.
objects.title: Learn One Thing, Understand Ten

addons.title: Rank-Up Promotion
addons.text:
As a commander, you know how to truly bring out the best of the potential of those you lead. The longer your allies serve with you and under you, the better selves they become. They quickly improve and gain new skills and abilities that allow them to better serve the roles you need them for in your operations. You will instinctively know the best ways to draw out the potential of those under your command, and what is holding them back.

When an ally reaches an improvement milestone, makes certain achievements, or is helped with personal problems under your leadership, you may “Promote” them, unlocking entirely new abilities adjacent to their existing roles and abilities. This will also raise the ceiling of what they can develop with their original capabilities, pushing them to even greater heights. Promotion unlocks many branching paths of improvement that you can push your ally down, based on what you need from them and what would be best for them.

In addition, as you get to know them better, you will also help them solve personal problems that are holding their development back, and become closer to them both as commander and subordinate, and as friends and companions. They will also gradually bond with other allies they frequently serve beside, allowing them to synergize their abilities together, as well as growing closer personally. These improvements not only improve their raw power, but attune them to instinctively understand what you need them to do when commanding them.

Your book also tracks your allies’ progress and shows you what their immediate upcoming growth could look like.

addons.title: Join My Crew
addons.text:
For some reason, people seem to be naturally drawn to your leadership. You tend to come across a lot more opportunities to recruit more allies from different backgrounds to your cause. While you can’t recruit literally everyone you meet, people you are genuinely interested in joining you will be much more willing to, especially if you are helping with a problem or incident that they are also involved in.

You will also find that people you recruit will have abilities that are as useful off the battlefield as they are off. For example, a barbarian could also be their tribe’s medicine-person, while a lawyer would be inexplicably good at barrier magic. You also become even better at building and managing connections and networks that will help with what your group needs.

Because you will have so many different people coming together under your leadership, you also become adept at managing the differences and mediating conflict between those under you, and helping them mesh and grow together.

objects.text:
You're the person the hero would just find lying on the ground and naively take with them on their journey. And it was probably the best decision they ever made, which may be an indicator of their intuition.

You're not geared toward being a specific part of an adventurer party. You aren't meant to be the overpowered hero who runs in alone and destroys the enemy army with a single swing of their sword. You're not necessarily the support who does nothing but keep people alive. You were meant for bigger things! You were meant to lead!

You have the supernatural ability to look at anyone—absolutely anyone and anything—and instantly tell their general level of power, what items they have, what they would be weak to, and even what they have the best potential to learn. You also have a map that changes in size depending on how big the conflict is. It could be the size of a town for a small-scale battle or even the size of countries if you're in a war, leading massive amounts of troops. You can tell where hidden enemies are, where each ally is and their current status, and even where people of interest you may want to recruit during a battle are. This also comes with the ability to mentally transmit information—whether it be your thoughts, knowledge, or even just a big arrow pointing your allies where to go—allowing you to masterfully organize and position them to fight the right opponents.

In terms of actual tactics, you're amazing at learning them. With no training, you'd be better than most people who study them for years. With self-study for a month, you'd be pushing the human limits of warfare. And if you ever face anyone seemingly better than you at manipulating the battlefield, you will rapidly learn from their tactics to think up counters or incorporate them into your own repertoire.

While this is amazing on its own, having supernatural powers or energies—such as mana or magic—can greatly enhance your ability, allowing you to perform feats like teleporting your allies, enhancing everyone on your side, and potentially even turning back time a little bit to save-scum fights. You also gain a book, not an ordinary book, but an Object of Power. This thing works as both a record that keeps information on all your allies, including their general morale to you and your group, as well as gives you tips on objectives you should take during a conflict. It can learn how to do other things over time.
objects.title: The Tactician

addons.text: Warped thinking and perspectives open unforeseen insights into your enlightenment. As reality and fantasy blur your perspective shifts to become preternatural. Oneness with desires could let you see them shaping in the air, seeing them in others as extensions of you for instance. A true attunement.
addons.title: Phos

objects.text: You have managed to achieve a form of enlightenment. Naturally, there are many forms of Enlightenment, to become one with your desires, Oneness with fears, Oneness with pain, and many more besides.
