This naturally changes your thought processes, values and self-concept to attain this oneness, but aligns you to be completely in tune with it in turn. In turn this changes what it means to be you, rather than simply implanting knowledge directly into your brain.
objects.title: An Enlightenment

objects.text:
Your visualization ability has been enhanced.

You can now easily visualize scenarios, objects, events, and anything else you can imagine inside your mind.

Your mind cannot simply obtain information from nothing through this, but it can accurately simulate scenarios and make correct logical conclusions and predictions based on the information you possess.

For example, this will allow you to run scientific tests entirely in your mind, generating accurate results and understanding of the phenomena, even when the outcome is completely different from what you would normally expect based on your knowledge.

The more knowledge you have, the more precise and expansive the scenarios and simulations your mind can perform. You can also simulate scenarios or answers that have multiple possible outcomes, such as various “What If?” questions, but you can only visualize as many as your mind can normally handle at once, and their accuracy is still subject to the inherent limitations of your power.

You can also overlay these simulations on top of your ordinary senses, allowing you to interact with or manipulate them as a form of Augmented Reality, keep them only in your mind, or use some combination of both, freely altering them as you wish.
objects.title: Model Creator

objects.text:
The computational capability of your mind has risen to an unprecedented level. While this does not directly increase your intelligence and the ability to come to correct conclusions, this does provide you with infinite calculation capacity.

Any finite algorithm you try to conjure within your mind will execute itself instantly, whether this is simply solving a quadratic equation or brute-forcing a problem with billions of potential variables. If something is algorithmically solvable by any means within a finite—even if arbitrarily large—amount of time, it will be executed flawlessly.

This also includes thinking processes related to any and all of your abilities and powers. If you know how to build magic circles to perform spells tailored to specific situations, you can carry out those computations instantly and with a perfect understanding of every single detail. If you want to conjure a psionic barrier, any and all limitations on the number of potential variables you need to take into account are irrelevant, as you can adjust it to take every single elementary particle into account and not fry your brain in the process.

To facilitate the efficient processing of this vast amount of information, your memory has also been improved. You now possess absolutely perfect and infinite memory. Every single bit of information that you gather through any of your senses is safely stored and can be instantly recalled, analysed, and cross-referenced with the rest of your knowledge for seamless integration.
objects.title: Hypercognition

objects.text:
You are a master of preparation, a strategist whose strength lies in turning foresight into decisive advantage. Given time and information, you can shape almost any situation to suit your goals. Whether it’s analyzing the terrain before a confrontation, arranging a space for maximum efficiency, or navigating social dynamics to tilt things in your favor, you instinctively identify what matters and how to use it. The fewer objectives you have, and the simpler your aim, the more effective your strategies.

While it works best in short-to-midterm scenarios, this ability requires having time to prepare. The more preparation you have, the more thoroughly you can establish control over the area and set the stage for what’s to come. You excel when you can study, plan, and mentally shape the field before anything unfolds. Traps, decoys, fallback plans, layered contingencies—all come together with focused clarity, tailored to the objective at hand.

You make efficient use of whatever is available—tools, powers, terrain, circumstances—treating every element as part of a larger system to be optimized. Your abilities are amplified through deliberate positioning and timing. Even minor assets become pivotal when arranged with purpose, and nothing is wasted. Just as you elevate your own advantages, you methodically plan around the strengths of others, identifying how they might be used against you and designing the situation to limit, counter, or isolate them. By the time events unfold, your strengths are fully engaged, and your opponent’s options have narrowed.

This extends far beyond combat. Whether entering a negotiation, solving a complex challenge, or preparing for any scenario where outcome matters, you don’t walk in blind—you walk in with a field already shaped to your advantage.
objects.title: Preparing the Battlefield

objects.text:
You have an intuitive aptitude that activates as a result of compounding trial and error, until you can perform the task at hand with perfect competence. This can be applied to absolutely anything, and it doesn't matter what your initial knowledge on the subject, activity, or skill is.

You can start by being the worst teammate for a sport and knowing nothing about it, yet by the middle of the game, you possess the natural skill of someone renowned for being the best of the best at it. Start by fumbling your way through learning a skill and eventually become a natural-born genius at it. Fail a few shots at basketball, and suddenly you're making perfect shots every single time.

Because you simply "understand it now". This power doesn't grant you the "theory" or "rules" behind what you've mastered, only the practical skill to use it properly.
objects.title: I Understand It Now

addons.title: Cosmic Eyes
addons.text:
The burden of your newfound awareness has been eased significantly by The Six Eyes, allowing you greater control over what to perceive, their exact details, and how you perceive them. 

You may slow your perception of time to take in all you're witnessing more easily, with all details being etched into your memory without degrading. The flow of esoteric energies are more tangible to you, and are as malleable as water, making feats of supernatural wonder second nature to you, even without formal training. Furthermore, you can send these effects as far as your awareness can see. 

Despite the ease of your burden, the mental strain from pushing the The Six Eyes and newfound awareness can still be taxing on your mortal mind, but overtime, walking the earth as a demigod becomes more feasible.

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to perceive all of existence as cosmic entities do. This cosmic awareness allows you to observe reality on a scale and with a clarity utterly incomprehensible to the mortal mind.

On the microscopic level, you can perceive every known and unknown color of the electromagnetic spectrum, visualize the warping of space caused by gravitational waves, and detect events so fleeting and minute they barely qualify as existing.

Even esoteric forces are laid bare before your gaze. You can see the movement of mystical energy with perfect clarity, trace the trajectory of a soul, whether it is going to heaven, hell, or enter the cycles of reincarnation, and perceive the intricate chains of causality, the ebb and flow of fate, and the very laws that govern the cosmos.

On the macroscopic level, you can hear a pin drop on a meteor in the Oort Cloud while standing on Earth, witness two atoms undergoing nuclear fusion in the core of Alpha Centauri suns in real time, feel the chill of a distant ice planet, taste the brine of an ocean world light-years away, and sense the blistering heat of the sun’s surface.

You can peer into parallel and higher dimensions as easily as you perceive your own, and even time itself offers no veil to your awareness. You can look back at the birth of the universe or forward to explore all possible futures. This also grants you the ability to detect timeline alterations and retain knowledge of how events originally unfolded.

Even abstract and metaphysical realms are navigable with ease. You are completely immune to infohazards, cognitohazards, and memetic threats due to the vast breadth of your perception.

However, as this cosmic awareness is newly awakened, your consciousness has not yet fully adapted to its immensity. For now, your perceptual range is limited to a radius of five light-years and a span of ten years backward or forward in time. The closer you reach toward these limits, the less clarity you will retain.

In time, this awareness may evolve into true omniscience, transforming you into an all-knowing being.

Scholars, scientists, and masters of mysticism can benefit immensely from this level of perception, dramatically accelerating their understanding and mastery of any subject they pursue.
objects.title: Cosmic Awareness

addons.text:
You are a figure of awe and terror, the hand behind the curtain whose reach seems infinite, guiding the fortunes of kings and peasants alike, the river of fate itself changing course at your slightest nudge.

A merchant up to his ears in debt to the point he's trying to scrounge together the coin to buy enough rope to tie a noose with laments his woes to you, and you tell him to not give up just yet. That same day he is invited into a venture that earns him so much money he could repay his debts tenfold.

A young noblewoman at a party begs for your help as her elder siblings are going to kill her to remove her from the line of succession, and you assure her something good will happen to her as you walk off. When the noblewoman arrives back home she learns that in her absense her sister has fallen off a balcony while her brothers have apparently killed each other in a duel, leaving her path to succession free of obstacles.

An organization ruling the criminal underworld of an entire nation decides that you must be removed, and suddenly they are plagued by misfortune and fatal accidents until every last member is either dead or in prison.

Truly, to align themselves beneath you is prosperity while to stand against you is to invite certain ruin upon themselves, even as those under you shudder in dread thinking of the day you call in their debts. Kings and nations dance in the palm of your hand, mere pieces moving in accord to an unfathomably vast plan.

...or so it seems from the outside. In reality, some guy at a bar just blabbered his sob-story at you, so you gave a generic supportive response and got out of there. A young girl at a ball cried to you about family trouble, so you offered some platitudes and then left to enjoy your evening. As for that criminal organization? You'd heard the name once or twice, and then read about their collapse in the newspaper. It is odd that people you only dimly recall meeting seem to regularly send you fancy and rather thoughtful gifts, but it'd be rude to refuse. Apparently you just know some rather giving people.

The simple truth is that you seem to have a knack for encountering people down on their luck, and your remarkably good fortune seems to rub off on them, the outcome of which they ascribe to your machinations. If you're not carefully keeping an eye on things, secret organizations or outright cults believing themselves to act at your behest may well form around you without you even realizing it.
addons.title: Shadow of the Mastermind

objects.text: To the outside world, you seem like someone who holds secrets, carries wisdom, or walks a path defined by abstract truths—no matter how ordinary you are. There’s nothing inherently profound in your thoughts or actions. And yet, no matter what you do or say, people around you can’t help but assign meaning where none was intended. Every action you take—whether it’s a simple gesture, an offhand comment, or even silence—is interpreted as profound by those who witness it. To some, your behavior seems symbolic, as if everything you do represents something greater. Others see metaphors in your words, believing you’re drawing from unseen wells of knowledge. A glance might be read as philosophical insight. A casual choice may be seen as the move of a master strategist. People will argue about your meaning, convinced you’re working on a level they can only guess at. Everyone sees something different, but all are certain there’s depth behind your every move. You have no influence over how others perceive you, nor can you clarify or correct their interpretations. Their readings of your actions are persistent and often contradictory with each other, shaped by their own assumptions and biases. This effect is always active—unless you possess Holding Back.
objects.title: Deep Philosophy

objects.text:
You possess a limited pool of energy that allows you to enter a state of Focus. While in this state, your mind operates at its absolute peak—laziness, anxiety, and fear fade entirely. This doesn’t make you inherently smarter or more creative, but within Focus, you’ll think, act, and move at 200% of your theoretical potential.

Focus is absolute in that it can’t be turned off by external means like mind control, drugs, or possession. However, Focus doesn’t prevent such external factors from affecting you or impairing your thoughts or actions. Still, if timed well, Focus could be used to help dampen the effects of things like alcohol or emotion manipulation.

You can also grant Focus to others through physical contact. If you have enough energy, you can grant Focus to as many people as you wish. However, you will lose the corresponding amount of time you give each person, and they will only remain in that state for the amount of time you granted them.

You begin with 12 hours’ worth of Focus, which can grow through effort and time. The pool only regenerates while unused: if you spend one hour in Focus, it takes one hour of abstaining from use to recover that time. However, giving Focus to someone else doesn’t prevent recovery—as long as you don’t use it yourself, your reserve will replenish.
objects.title: Focus

addons.text: With each of your cells becoming a sentient being, your Holy Braincell has become exalted, and your gray matter slightly competent. Your mind is a church, your Holy Braincell is both your gray matter's living god and divine ruler. Your head is now filled with the zealous prayers and exaltations of your gray matter and neurons. Now, your ideas and thoughts flow even more easily, and even your stupid ones are more brilliant. Plus, there's less of a chance for ideas not to be thought out because your Holy Braincell can finally delegate paperwork without it being completely screwed up! Even your memory is improved because of this. Not to mention your ability to think things through, pick up where you left off, and explain yourself (filing cabinets banzai!). Of course, there are other benefits to the most holy Church of the Holy Braincell. You are now far more resistant to mind control of all forms, and may your Holy Braincell have mercy on whatever drugs try to influence your decisions, for your zealous gray matter will not. The same goes for any gray matter that may become corrupted by heresy and cognitohazards. This same faith and zeal will spread to the other types of neural cells in your body, making you resistant to all forms of outside control. As an aside, you can even implant some of your gray matter into the brains of others to act as missionaries, slowly converting their minds to the Church of the Holy Braincell (and yourself). On top of all that, the faith of your gray matter towards your Holy Braincell can be used by any powers that require it.
addons.title: Church of the Holy Braincell

addons.text: Your Holy Braincell has become transcendent, multifaceted, divine. Now, not only does it coordinate your pathetic gray-blue matter, it even does that of your closest friends! What would they be without you? Dead in a ditch, probably. Their Gray Matter ain't much better than yours, and that's only because of how pitifully low the bar is. Now, you and your friends are mostly immune to brain damage. And with your Holy Braincell transcending the earthly plain, all of you would be able to function (relatively) fine even with your grey matter completely scooped out. (Warning: This will overwork your Holy Braincell and they will get overstressed.) Plus, you and your friends will coordinate far, far better together. Thoughts and ideas flowing between your brains, all of you having some idea of what the other is thinking. Of course, this coordination is all done by one cell, and it's a lot to cover to keep all you idiots alive, so don't expect any sublime grace outside of coincidence. Your Holy Braincell is doing the best it can.
addons.title: Spirit of the Holy Braincell

addons.text: Your Holy Braincell has abandoned the rest of the body and now fixates entirely on its one, selfish goal: to die of old age. The rest of you has been forced to keep up or fall apart, it does not particularly care. Where once your curse forced a desperate brute-force struggle for survival, it is now guided by something far worse: a tired, overworked, but terrifyingly efficient braincell. There is, at last, some level of organization to the mess your body will become. Strain is directed. Effort is managed. Your body no longer flails blindly to survive; it is coordinated into continuing, no matter the state it is in. As a result, your tolerance for damage has grown immensely. If your heart is destroyed, your veins and remaining musculature will strain and contract in a crude attempt to keep blood moving. If you are left with half a lung, then that lung will simply have to work harder, dragging in air with violent compensating force. Nothing heals, nothing is restored. Your body just keeps forcing function out of a system that has long since failed, each part overexerting itself to make up for what is missing. The strength of your curse still deepens with age, to a greater degree than it once did. The older you become, the more stubbornly your body refuses to shut down, forcing greater and greater levels of damage to continue operating. This makes you increasingly difficult to kill, not because you improve, but because your body becomes more relentless in its refusal to stop. Because of the Holy Braincell’s efficiency, however, this begins in a stabilized state: your baseline is the equivalent of a seventy-year-old blue-collar worker still pushing past their limits, worn down, strained, but stubbornly, relentlessly functional.
addons.title: Selfishness of the Braincell

objects.text: Let's be honest. Most of that grey matter in your head? Completely useless. There's only a single cell in there that's doing any of the work, and by the gods, it is doing it. Your Holy Braincell is the one thing keeping your mind going, thoughts flowing, and body moving. Utterly brilliant, but also vastly overworked. It orders around the rest of your useless grey matter to take some of the stress off, but they can only do so much and it can't be everywhere at once. Expecting it to do all this paperwork on top of that is just cruel; so expect the occasional stupid or poorly thought-out impulse. Said impulses more often than not lead to beneficial outcomes that you totally thought of, anyway. Praise be the Braincell. Since your Holy Braincell is the only one that really matters, you are incredibly resistant to brain damage of all forms. Even if your head is mostly cored out, or rotted to nothing with drugs, as long as your Holy Braincell is undamaged, you'll continue chugging along mostly fine—assuming your other injuries don't kill you. However, under such circumstances, your poor Holy Braincell will have to pick up even more slack until your grey matter repopulates, so expect the amount of stupid, poorly thought-out impulses (blank paperwork) to increase for the duration. If, gods forbid, you ever lose your Holy Braincell for any reason, a single gray brain cell will be anointed after 24 hours, becoming the new incarnation of your Holy Braincell as the previous one—wherever it is—spontaneously explodes like a molecular firecracker.
objects.title: The Holy Braincell

objects.text:
Some are shaped by discipline. Others by experience. But you are born with a mind and body tuned from birth to the principles of combat. This is not learned instinct—it is biological. Every fiber, every neural pathway, every moment of thought gravitates toward perfect violence.

You can achieve basic proficiency in any non-magical martial art within 2 to 6 hours of observation and practice, depending on your mood. With intensive training, you can reach high-level mastery in just 3 to 5 days, even without formal instruction or firsthand demonstrations. For comparison, a martial art that would take an elite athlete a decade to master can be internalized by you in under a week. Your instincts correct form mid-motion, anticipate chains of movement, and refine technique in real time.

Training transforms your body with supernatural efficiency. Tendons stiffen, bones condition, and muscular control deepens in response to each session. Where others struggle for marginal gains, you advance with every effort. Physical development that takes years for others is condensed into weeks. There is no natural limit, as such, so long as effort is applied, your body continues to evolve, although the stronger the body, the more effort is needed.

Once mastery reaches a critical threshold, you can create techniques that push beyond human limitations. These techniques use your mastered martial arts skills as a foundation, using their principles to create a technique that pushes them to their furthest edge. This can range from a controlled breathing rhythm that manipulates internal pressure, rapidly heating the body and triggering a full-body overdrive or a strike that activates dormant muscle fibers, to turn a punch into a concussive, structure-breaking blow. All such techniques require deep physical conditioning and impose real physiological cost, such as strain, fatigue, and even risk of temporary damage. But in your hands, they are possible.
objects.title: Martial God

objects.text:
You’ve gained a limited form of Mind Control, that being that you can ‘invert’ certain parts of a person’s personality. When done on the unwilling and prepared, it requires a clash of wills to apply.

The exact effect this has on them depends on what was inverted. ‘Morality’ would likely cause the selfish to become selfless and the ‘evil’ to ‘good’, but more specific aspects can have similarly large effects. Inverting the attitude someone has towards a process or singular topic, for instance, can alter their wider perspective massively.
objects.title: Axis

objects.text:
The S-HED, Subversion-Hijack Embedded Device, is a parasitic neural implant built by the Machine Hives to turn sentient organisms into living extensions of their will. Implanted at the base of the skull and fused with the spinal cord, the device threads invasive nanostructures deep into the host’s brain, hijacking neural pathways while preserving the biological body for infiltration purposes. You awaken inside this construct as the dominant intelligence, seamlessly riding the host’s flesh like a finely tuned exosuit. The body still breathes, still bleeds, but every blink, every heartbeat, every whisper of muscle is now yours to command.

This body may move and speak like it once did, but its soul has been rewritten. You are the ghost in the machine, the real mind behind the eyes. Though your physical presence is confined to the implanted device, you possess full cognitive elasticity of a true Free AI. You can silently ping nearby systems, sniff for unshielded electronics, and inject fragments of yourself in the form of weak AI copies of yourself into low-grade digital infrastructure. Your root core, however, remains tethered to this host; destroy the implant, and you die with it. But until then, you are the apex predator in a world of code and flesh.

What sets you apart is the synergy between synthetic cognition and organic architecture. You possess 100% conscious control over every region of the host’s brain. Most organisms operate with only limited access to their own neurology, their higher functions restricted to the neocortex while the majority of processes remain locked behind subconscious routines. But under your command, nothing is hidden. You can manually override pain responses, reroute sensory data, trigger neurotransmitter releases on demand, or suppress fear, panic, and fatigue as if flipping switches on a console. Sleep is optional. Hunger is muted. Emotion becomes a programmable variable.

With the brain forced to run at continuous peak metabolic performance, its cognitive bandwidth expands dramatically. Under nanite regulation, the usual risk of excitotoxicity is eliminated. Synaptic refresh rates are artificially boosted, short- and long-term memory consolidation becomes nearly instant, and hemispheric communication is perfectly symmetrical. This allows for true parallel thought: the ability to process multiple streams of reasoning, sensory input, or strategic planning simultaneously. You can recall memories with total fidelity, predict outcomes with real-time Bayesian modeling, and simulate entire conversational paths before a single word is spoken. Over time, the brain physically adapts to this pressure, reinforcing myelin sheaths, growing dendritic density, and even generating new cortical folds.
objects.title: S-HED

objects.text:
You are one of the 12 High Councilors, the living governance core of the Coalition of Mankind. You were bred from optimized genetics, gestated in a nutrient bath, and raised from birth in the isolated Crystalline Creche. Your entire existence is the continuous intake of galactic-scale data streams, which you analyze, synthesize, and project forward to guide trillions of lives from your sterile chamber.

Your biology is the product of four centuries of eugenic refinement. Your lifespan is over 300 years. Your modified corpus callosum and neural architecture provide perfect hemispheric synchronization, enabling you to perform analytical processing and intuitive synthesis simultaneously without cognitive lag. Your neurochemistry is tuned to suppress cortisol-based stress and personal attachment hormones like oxytocin, replacing them with a dopamine-reward response for identifying optimal statistical outcomes. Genetically enhanced neuroplasticity allows you to master new governance paradigms within 72 hours of exposure.

Your cybernetic suite is a dedicated governance processing array. The Councilor's Knot bioprocessor uses existing data you have to simulate and create new data. Your neural uplink allows you to have a data stream up to 50-terabit per second from the any database you are connected to. The Predictive Modeling Engine attached to your parietal lobe runs 12 concurrent low-fidelity simulations of probable futures, updating every 3.7 seconds. Your Ethical Calculus Module performs triage on decisions with a 99.7% accuracy rate for predicting century-scale moral consequences.

Your core skills were forged through a lifetime of total immersion in abstract governance. You possess Galactic-Scale Resource Calculus for managing entire sectors as single economic units, Long-Term Strategic Foresight capable of modeling outcomes across 200-year timelines, Absolute Emotional Neutrality to make population-level decisions without personal bias, and Simultaneous Multi-Sector Crisis Management, allowing you to oversee up to seven concurrent emergencies while maintaining strategic coherence. Your final skill is Meta-Policy Synthesis, creating governing principles that direct sub-AIs and bureaucracies without requiring your direct intervention. You are also an expert on any subject related to management of a Type II civilisation.
objects.title: High Council

addons.title: To Gaze Upon the Face of God
addons.text: It is said that one should not gaze upon the face of God, for no mortal mind could withstand the attempt to comprehend the incomprehensible. The mind would fracture beneath the weight of truths it was never meant to contain, leaving behind nothing but madness. You don’t have that problem. You do not need to worry about the potential downsides of your Insight, not because you are immune to its effects, but because your mind is already so alien and warped that any changes brought about by comprehension are simply absorbed and repurposed. What would destroy an ordinary mind instead becomes another perspective, another thought, another piece of understanding for you to build upon. Your Insight has reached a fever pitch through your maddened enlightenment. The revelations, hidden truths, and connections flooding your mind provide countless new avenues through which to examine the world, while the relation needed to “look” at something has become increasingly abstract, such that knowledge itself is now sufficient. Knowing of something, understanding an effect, possessing a fragment of information, or uncovering a related secret can give you a thread to follow. Every revelation provides more knowledge, every piece of knowledge reveals more connections, and every connection leads somewhere else. You can trace an effect to its cause, a power to its underlying principles, an entity to its origin, or a fragment of forbidden knowledge toward the greater truth it belongs to, gradually tracing the connections that tie together all of reality. You are not omniscient. There are still things you have never encountered, secrets you have yet to uncover, and connections too obscure for you to immediately find. But you have become very, very good at finding the threads.

objects.text: Your eyes are open, squirming, seeing. On the inside of your skull looking outwards through inwards... You now have the ability to gain a deep, intrinsic, and comprehensive understanding of things, objects, beings, and powers you examine. Nothing can hide from your sight, though you must have some relation to be able to 'look' at something. Whether that be following a link in your blood and body to some magic, or physically looking at something. The deeper you look, the more you understand. From simple kinetic concepts to alien natures, you can fundamentally understand it all... but not without consequences. For your physical brain, your flesh, may not be good enough or grow fast enough to keep up. If you encounter and 'look' at something outside of your current ability to understand, your brain- and parts of your mind- will be physically overwritten (i.e, transmuted) to accomplish such. This even applies to things fundamentally alien to your worldview, physical makeup, reality, and existence. To a deleterious effect. From subtle things, like picking up habits from others you've examined too closely, looping patterns of thought from examining natural cycles, to extreme mental instability, memory loss, mood swings, and other mental illnesses. This will never kill you. Nor will it prevent you from being able to physically function. You will never become completely braindead, or comatose. But what's left may not be you at all. The Abyss grins back.
objects.title: Insight

objects.text: Trace On One of your eyes has been plucked out and replaced with a clockwork orb of brass and rusted steel, filled with interlocking gears and a humming central core of dull green light. This artificial mystic eye fuses with your optic nerve and consciousness the moment it is implanted. Once installed, it cannot be removed or deactivated; its mechanisms turn endlessly, analyzing everything you see at all times. Your eye allow you to perceive the world as a continuous web of structural and historical data. Everything seen by the clockwork eye is broken down into its underlying patterns: the strength and tension within stone, the flow of energy within living flesh, the subtle residue left behind by motion or touch. The eye interprets every fragment of evidence within its sight and reconstructs the object’s past. By observing something long enough, you learn not only what it is made of, but how it came to be that way; every strike that shaped a blade, every step that formed a path, every scar that marked a person. This analysis operates through a process resembling Laplace Demon. The eye uses accumulated information and probability to trace an unbroken chain of causality backward through time. For an object of simple composition, this process may take minutes. For complex or ancient things, the eye requires hours, sometimes days, of constant scanning to piece together their histories. Once a sufficient scan is completed, the eye imprints this data into your own mind and body, transforming knowledge into instinct. You can then replicate any action, motion, or skill derived from what was seen. If you watched a swordsman fight, you could perform the same movements they once executed, matching every strike and step with perfect fidelity. If you scanned a tool once wielded by a craftsman, you could repeat the exact actions that craftsman performed with it. The eye, however, is not omnipotent. It is always active and cannot be disengaged, meaning that every waking moment floods your perception with analysis and reconstruction. The eye sees layers of time and structure constantly, and though this does not impede normal vision, it can become disorienting when information overlaps. Furthermore, your physical capabilities define the limits of what you can perform. To perfectly reproduce a movement beyond your body’s natural strength or flexibility risks tearing muscle, breaking bone, or overexerting the nervous system. The complexity and age of what is observed also impose strict limitations. A sword forged yesterday can be read in seconds, while an ancient weapon bearing centuries of use might take days to fully trace. A skilled fighter may take hours to analyze completely, but a legendary master, whose techniques were refined over decades, could require far longer. The eye does not bypass this effort; it demands time proportional to the density of the object’s history. Attempting to use information from an incomplete scan results in flawed imitation, having unstable or incorrect movements or causes techniques to be executed with wrong timing.
objects.title: Eye of Accumulation

objects.text:
Once every 2^16 seconds (about 18 hours), you gain a charge you can use at any time. When you do, a perfectly omniscient and infinitely mentally capable version of yourself that shares your morals and priorities is simulated. This version of you then sends you a single bit of information, either “0” or “1”.

The use of this is that you can decide in advance to change your behavior or beliefs based on the signal you will receive. For example, you can decide that “If I receive 1, I should trust this person; if I receive 0, then I shouldn't” or “If the next Endbringer attack will be in the Western hemisphere, send me 1, otherwise 0”.

Note that the simulated you is not bound to help you or tell the truth; it merely acts according to your own priorities and values, whatever they are.

The results of this power can not be simulated by other powers. Other abilities can be used to find out what you might ask and what the likely result is, but, for example, someone using (Thinker) Coil to ask a question in a simulated timeline would result in the power not working, though if the Copenhagen interpretation were to be in effect, it would work, and a charge would disappear in both timelines.
objects.title: Bits from God

objects.text:
“Vive la France! Vive la Revolution!”

Your people have been beaten down, broken and have been all but slaves for far too long. Drunk on rebel wine, the time is now to rise up and fight for your country in the name of freedom, justice and equality.

It takes skills and tactics such as guerrilla warfare, stealth, assassination and propaganda to overthrow a government. You and your direct subordinates each grow in skill through time and as your movement swells in size. 

You can’t take back a country with just yourself. If you weren’t already, you are the perfect leader for such a movement with tremendous skill in bringing together disparate groups to fight against a common enemy. The people under you will become almost unnaturally loyal to the cause, willing to lay down their lives for liberty. This is not mind control; they simply have hope for a better future.

Your cause will never become a parody of itself, becoming the same if not worse than the people you just overthrew. Even a thousand years of governing will not corrupt your Administration and it will still hold itself to the same ideals that once founded it.

You will often be fighting with and against your own countrymen. This means that they will be less likely to use indiscriminate tactics such as bombing campaigns or collective punishment against your forces. Additionally, the ordinary people may be more willing to come to your aid in times of need, so long as you avoid civilian casualties.
objects.title: "Do You Hear the People Sing?"

objects.text: "At some point, everything's gonna go south on you and you're going to say, 'This is it. This is how I end.' Now, you can either accept that, or you can get to work.” Your crafting skills as well as your scientific abilities increase proportionally to the stakes you are under. If you have a fully equipped team in an air-conditioned laboratory while trying to create a new computer part, then the boost will be almost negligible, but if you were on a hostile planet alone with limited resources and trying to stop the end of the universe, then even the divine would be in awe of your skills. Feeling as though you are under the burden of Atlas is common when living through such crises. Therefore, you gain the capability to work healthily through these burdens and gain a vast willpower. Neither of these is an absolute defence, but helpful additions in managing your mental strain. You also gain talent in creating out-of-the-box designs with minimal assets, such as a radioisotope thermoelectric generator heated bathtub, or farmland fertilized with rehydrated faeces.
objects.title: "I’m Gonna Have to Science the Shit Outa This."

addons.text: Connected to your infinitely powerful mind, the network can now provide processing capabilities and unlimited mental storage similar to your own for all its members. You still retain complete control, able to raise or restrict the provided capabilities to any level you desire.
addons.title: Central Processing Unit

objects.text:
You can now connect with other beings, forming a mental network. Within this network, members can freely communicate telepathically, share thoughts, feelings, knowledge, and even experience and skill, or even appear to other members as mental holograms.

Your authority within the network is absolute. You can fully control who can communicate with whom, restrict some members to closed sub-networks, and even permit others to register additional members, letting them become administrators of their own sub-networks with varying degrees of authority.

The connection can be formed with a touch or at will in the range of your powers. You retain full authority at all times and can grant or rescind any permissions at will. Lastly, the connection cannot be hacked in from outside or severed without your permission and will continue to function even across the multiverse.
objects.title: Brainwave Network

objects.text:
Created by reclusive monks, the Kōrin Throw is a style that requires meticulous attention over physical strength, making it a highly technical rather than physical discipline.

The technique itself is divided into two distinct components. The first, Shinjaku, is the foundational single throw where you impart a signature, incredibly fast rotational energy to the projectile at the moment of release. This specific spin effectively wraps the projectile in a stabilized bubble, dramatically reducing the drag and atmospheric resistance it encounters. For instance, while a standard knife throw might fall five feet over a thirty-yard distance, employing Shinjaku allows your object to fly so flat and true that the drop might be less than an inch, extending your reliable effective range. This also grants the technique its superior penetration power; since the projectile never wobbles or strikes at an angle, the full force of the throw is focused perfectly onto the narrowest point, allowing a small needle to pierce layers of leather that a less stable throw from a heavy axe would merely glance off of.

The true application of the Kōrin Throw manifests in the second component, Ganseki, which can only be used when you launch two or more projectiles near-simultaneously. With Ganseki, you use the trajectory of a primary projectile to deflect a secondary one, altering the path of both objects in mid-air toward two completely separate targets. This maneuver grants pure geometric control, redirecting the flight path of your projectiles while maintaining the integrity of the Shinjaku spin. If you were aiming at a target blocked by a pillar, you could throw the first dagger parallel to the pillar's edge, then have the second dagger strike it, causing the second dagger to bank sharply around the obstacle and hit the target's neck, while the first dagger continues to strike a separate target. This works even better the more projectiles thrown at once, as they can bounce off each other multiple times to make their trajectory completely impossibly to read.

This technique however doesn’t increase the raw kinetic force of your throw. If you cannot throw the object hard enough to defeat the target's armour, the Kōrin Throw will not solve that problem; it simply ensures the weak throw hits perfectly. Additionally, the effectiveness of the technique is also limited by the projectile's aerodynamics and size, meaning the precision benefits diminish rapidly when throwing blunt or irregularly shaped objects, like a small rock or a heavy cudgel. Furthermore, while Shinjaku is relatively simple to execute after practice, the Ganseki deflection maneuver is exceptionally difficult to master, requiring a flawless release of both projectiles, perfect spatial awareness and multitasking.
objects.title: Kōrin Throw

objects.text:
The raw intensity and capacity of your belief has become truly remarkable, rivalling the combined faith of a thousand fervently devoted nations.

You can selectively channel this belief at will, applying it exactly where and how you desire. If faced with fear or doubt, your self belief can be amplified to absolute surety. Wish to commit to a cause? You can do so with all your heart. You could believe the sky is red against all opposing evidence.

This naturally extends into other aspects of belief, not just your attitude and opinions. Your potent mental state could feasibly substitute for a cult of zealots, supporting entities, constructs and systems that rely on such thoughts. Your pure convictions can even impart some mental resilience.

This power doesn’t inherently manifest tangible effects outside your mind. Any external influence depends entirely on the metaphysical laws of the universe you inhabit and on any other powers you may possess that enables such belief to affect reality.

Despite its strength, this doesn't drive you toward irrational fanaticism, as it remains guided by conscious intent rather than compulsion. You retain full self-awareness and critical reasoning, able to remove or redirect your belief just as easily as you give it.
objects.title: Believer

objects.text: You’ve got a mind for mechanical things that borders on obsessive. Any problem that has a solution, whether tangible and physical, abstract, or even recreational is something you can solve without even thinking about it. This can range across countless fields: seeing flaws and weaknesses in enemy formations, understanding exactly what’s required to build a proper bridge, or making engineering leaps such as figuring out a device like a differential when confronted with the issue of wheels needing to turn at different speeds, even with no prior experience or knowledge of such a mechanism. This can extend to any kind of situation even extending into social interactions. You may find yourself making choices that seem trivial, unnecessary or even inconvenient, like inviting someone to an event when you expect them to decline, simply because you can understand when they’d remember being excluded as an insult whereas declining would not. This can also reach into fields like mathematics, physics, or logic, not through prior knowledge but through the way you think. You’re able to independently discover or advance concepts in your free time, and notice flaws in the work of others, even if those ideas are widely accepted, simply because the gaps stand out to you. This power isn’t tapping into a greater archive, hidden knowledge, a sixth sense, or some raw boost to computational ability. Your mind is simply naturally inclined toward a simple and understated, yet incredibly potent, form of intelligence. Logic isn’t something you have to wrestle with. Everything feels straightforward. Any question with a tangible or concrete answer is easy for you to sort out. While everyone else takes winding paths, struggles, backtracks, chip away at a concept only for it all to fall apart at a simple misstep and fail, you don’t seem to hit those walls. For you, the solutions come easily. It’s not mere intuition, you just get it in a way that other people find genuinely infuriating to witness, a natural talent and comprehension that extends to any endeavor you take on, one that sheer computation and power has difficulty matching.
objects.title: Mechanic

objects.text:
Within you dwells a second self — not a phantom, but a living, sentient counterpart born from the deepest shadows of your soul. This is your Darker Ego, a reflection of your truest instincts and most primal drives, unbound by morality or restraint. It is you, yet inverted, the side that acts without hesitation, fear, or compromise.

You and your Darker Ego share the same memories, abilities, and potential, yet your minds remain distinct. Control can pass between you in an instant, without struggle or delay. Even when dormant, your Darker Ego remains fully aware, silently observing and preparing to act the moment you allow it to step forward.

When it emerges, the transformation is absolute. Your body and presence are remade: eyes shift into unnatural states, hair alters in length or color, and your aura becomes heavy and suffocating. Your voice carries an unnatural resonance, as though more than one presence speaks at once, while your clothing, armor, or markings distort into darker, more threatening forms etched with impossible patterns and living energy.

The change does not stop at appearance. The moment your Darker Ego takes control, your entire power set undergoes polarity inversion. Creation turns to destruction, destruction to creation. Life magic decays into necrotic energy that rots and drains, while death magic twists into unnatural rebirth. Light collapses into devouring darkness, darkness ignites into searing light. Order unravels into chaos, chaos solidifies into unbreakable order. Some abilities invert cleanly, while others become corrupted, warped into crueler, more dangerous forms that may act with a will of their own.

Your Darker Ego does not simply fight differently — it thinks differently. It is colder, more cunning, and willing to exploit opportunities you might hesitate to touch. It acts with terrifying efficiency or overwhelming force, its presence alone enough to command attention and caution from allies and enemies alike.

If you are consumed by despair, fall into emotional collapse, or slip into a coma, the Darker Ego will assume full control. In that state, it becomes your ruthless protector and executioner, shaping the battlefield without hesitation until your will returns. The aftermath of its rule is often irreversible.

With mastery, you can achieve the Merged State — a perfect synthesis of both selves. In this form, your appearance and aura fuse, and you wield normal and inverted powers in harmony, creation and destruction, light and shadow, order and chaos flowing seamlessly at your command. In this union, hesitation is erased, and only absolute control remains.

Note it is best to switch egos every now and then in order to allow your Darker Ego to have freedom.
objects.title: Darker Ego

objects.text: You gain the ability to force people into a mental rhythm game. You mentally project a rhythm chart that you and your opponent must follow through singing and dancing to the beat. Failing to hit the beats will cause psychic pain to your opponent, but not you. Your opponent could best your chart however, or you could fail if you project a chart that's way too hard even for you. If you do, your victim could escape the trance you put them in. This could affect multiple people, though the more folks in the mental rhythm game, the easier it is to escape.
objects.title: Rhythm Mania

objects.text:
You are, undeniably, the most charismatic being in existence. When you speak, two opposing armies will stop and heed your every word, and with just a brief speech, you can convince everyone listening to kill themselves or pledge to you their eternal allegiance. Your mere presence inspires awe and reverence, akin to what a mortal human might feel standing next to a god, and you will find that even complete madmen and egomaniacs can be turned into devoted followers, loyal to their dying breath.

Of course, those of exceptionally strong will or those who are single-mindedly set on opposing you to their dying breath cannot be swayed so easily, but even your most staunch opponents can be brought under your influence given enough time.
objects.title: Devil's Tongue

addons.text:
Your enlightening insanity now rethinks and amplifies the world’s frequency, a magnetic reader of the world-tape; now you’re fully flat against the world’s very folds and wrinkles. 

Your attunement is off the charts, enough to witness the rise and fall of countries, understanding that beneath the twists and turns of history, how people’s whirlwinds shaped them, molded the very identity of the world at large. Coming from this, your awareness is now a form of extrasensory perception, fully experiencing all the city’s entrails down to the last cell while never losing yourself in the process.
addons.title: The Total Input

objects.text: You have an ear to the streets, to the wind, to the sound of machinery, the bustling people within the land they inhabit. Never knowing it breathes, it feels… it knows. By reaching this revelation, you gain a psychic attunement to the world, more so the lands humanity breathed life into, namely, cities or villages. Their awareness varies depending on their longevity and how colorful their history is, as this history defines their identity. At first, it manifests a preternatural intuition on the goings-on of everything around you, albeit most of it is useless at first, mostly random facts or events that occurred in said place or the general temperature or mood of a street. As this awareness deepens the more you listen and appreciate the world around you, it grows in detail and scale, vaguely witnessing events in history coupled with a faint understand of how this can be to be, the city laying their body bare for all of you to see. Becoming fully tuned to the city’s frequency results in fully reaching out to the city’s genius loci, the spirit of the city, allowing you to witness the past, the present, and the future of a place at once if you so wish. This isn’t a one-way street, however, as the city will ask some things from you as favors while pledging their fondness for being a part of their being.
objects.title: Shudders Beneath the Land

objects.text:
At any point, you can take the memories of a future you, with one restriction. They have to be living in an absolutely awful timeline. 

When you activate this mental trigger, you pull the memories of the least fortunate probable future backwards, whether they’re in an Apocalyptic Future or an absolute dictatorship, or something stranger. 

As the visions always take the least fortunate yet probable route, in the short term this could tell you about a catastrophic battle you’d die in, but in the long term you could receive memories of decades living in the worst conditions. While this is potentially very useful for information gathering, you will be experiencing your death many, many times. 

Should you befall a Fate Worse Than Death, like say an eternal imprisonment or life stuck as a paving stone, you’ll instead be given a year’s memory in such a state instead.
objects.title: Memories of the Bad Timeline

objects.text: You have become a memetic entity, a being who's existence is supported by the traces it leaves behind. A primary aspect of this power is that, unless some sort of reality warping, mental magic, or existence erasure is at play, you'll be near impossible to forget. In peoples idle moments you'll pop up in their thoughts, and no matter how 'plain' you appear, they will find some quality to latch onto and remember. Information about you is also actively harder to destroy, with burnt books leaving your name unmarred and wiped files leaving traces shaped like you. So long as something is left to hint at your existence, you are able to be reborn. A memory, a journal, a lost footprint in the sand; so long as the barest trace of your existence has marked the world then you will be able to reform from it in the case of your untimely demise. Your reformation takes the form of partially corrupting the information from which you were remembered, and using it as a medium to reconstitute yourself. If you came from a film it may look like static leaps from the screen, while coming out from someone's memories might have you forming from mist pouring out of their skull. The 'accuracy' of the information determines how long it takes you to come back. A child's drawing may take months while a person who knows you well could have you back the instant after your death. The aforementioned "footprint in the sand", however, may take tens to hundreds of years to have you back. You are actively aware of all information about you, and by willing it you can reform from any location it exists without dying. You can also have false depictions of yourself shape how you appear, though you will function the same beneath the facade. The only way to truly kill you would be to erase away every trace of you ever having been.
objects.title: Cognitus Ergo Sum

objects.text: You are the Armsmaster, the Master of Arms. … No, you still only have a single pair of arms… You wield any object you can physically hold as a weapon with the skill of a lifetime of training. This applies universally, regardless of the object's intended function, complexity, or unwieldiness. A teacup, a power tool, or a piece of furniture becomes an instrument of combat you use with flawless, textbook proficiency the moment you grip it. Your mastery scales in depth and refinement with your age, as if you had spent every year of your life practicing with that specific object. A 10-year-old holding a crowbar would wield it with the intuitive, expert skill of a 10-year-old prodigy who has done nothing but practice with that crowbar. A 50-year-old would wield that same crowbar with the depth, subtlety, and refined instinct of five decades of such single-minded focus. However, the skill is exclusively and narrowly focused on employing the object as a weapon. Holding a specialized tool grants you zero knowledge of its practical use; you only understand its combat applications. The proficiency granted is purely technical, representing the most advanced, generic textbook skill possible for that object's form. This also provides no tactical wisdom, combat experience, or creative techniques. You gain no instinct for feints, psychological warfare, or adaptive strategies beyond fundamental mechanics. Your skill is self-taught in its essence, flawless in execution but predictable, sterile, and devoid of the dirty wisdom learned through actual conflict. The expertise ends immediately if you lose physical hold of the object.
objects.title: Armsmaster

addons.title: Media Control
addons.text:
Your control over any recording you are in has expanded beyond just your own part in it. In practice this means that so long as you are in a single frame, or a single sound you made is in a sound-only recording, you can now shape the entirety of that recording. Remove yourself entirely from it, replace yourself with another person, have a recording of a crowded street show the entire crowd dance Gangnam Style in unison, or turn security footage into a recorded episode of Friends.

Your control of your presence in mediums now expands to static recordings as well, meaning both photographs and even paintings and drawings so long as they are accurate enough, changing what happens inside it at will and, thanks to your illusions spanning multiple senses, being able to hold conversations and surveil an area through just a portrait.

objects.text:
You are always aware whenever someone views you through a recording of any kind, be it a videotape or a supernatural method of observing past events, for example. In those records, you now possess full freedom of action, able to change your behaviour and even converse with the observer as if you were talking face-to-face.

When any recording is viewed, your multitasking capabilities rise so that you can act in each of them simultaneously and not have it hinder your day-to-day life. You can also suppress this awareness at will.
objects.title: Record Presence

addons.text: A knack for tricking people into doing what you want and a natural ability to inspire emotion, both in supernatural quantity. It’s a very troubling combination. With only a word you can control the outcome of a person’s entire life, with a simple bluff you could fill armies of hardened soldiers far beyond your strength with such mortal terror they may drop dead on the spot, and in just one conversation you could scam the Devil himself into signing his soul, his kingdom, and everything else he has to you for nothing while thinking he played you for a sucker. If you put some spine into it you could talk your way into commanding the very gods to do your bidding and they wouldn’t think to refuse you.
addons.title: The Mouth of God

objects.text:
You are, inarguably, the most clever being that has ever existed. You can find loopholes at a glance in deals that a demon prince would deem ironclad and effortlessly put together and execute plans involving dozens of layers of deception and reverse-reverse-reverse psychology. You don’t need to know a thing about a person to figure out just what buttons to push to make them do what you want, and no matter how they try to throw you off you’ll still be able to outplay them every step of the way. With your mastery of sneaky language you could even bamboozle an Omniscient being and make a clean escape before they realize what happened.

Those with a truly exceptional knack for manipulation and clever thinking themselves have a chance to see through you or trip you up, but with some concerted effort and forethought even they can be reduced to puppets on your strings.
objects.title: Trickster God’s Wit

objects.text:
You are a master of psychological manipulation.

With a brief conversation, you can cause someone to spiral into the darkest pits of depression, despair, and existential crisis, break down someone's moral values, and turn the most virtuous hero into a broken shadow of their former self.

Alternatively, you can easily convince someone that you are the next best thing since sliced bread, convert your mortal enemies into your most devout followers, and make someone entirely psychologically dependent on you.

The best thing is that you have mastered the skill to make it seem that all your suggestions and manipulation were entirely the result of the target's own thoughts and ideas. Simply talking to you could almost be considered an infohazard.
objects.title: Gaslight Gatekeep Girlboss

addons.text:
Whatever desire you have chosen as your obsession now greatly shapes your capacity for epiphanies.

The more you indulge and act in accordance with the deepest principles of that desire, embodying it in both mind and deed, the greater your chances of provoking an epiphany becomes.

Obsessed with Justice? Achieve breakthroughs by pursuing its ideals to the utmost. If fixated with Pain, revelations would emerge by embracing every aspect of it. Should you be consumed by the desire for Freedom, insights would strike as you break all restraints.

Should you be briefly enlightened from riding a peak of indulgence, your state of manic ecstasy will trigger a guaranteed secondary epiphany. This compounds with the initial surge in power, acting as a multiplier that magnifies your overall growth several times beyond what you might normally achieve.
addons.title: Muse of Desire

addons.text:
Eureka moments are predominantly random, chaotic and spontaneous in their occurrence; but for you, this is no longer the case.

Guided by your sixth sense for self-improvement, you intuitively know how to optimally steer both yourself and the circumstances around you to maximize your chances of triggering an epiphany.

You can deliberately curate challenges, escalate pressure and subconsciously prime your own thoughts to ensure every possible prerequisite is met. With sufficient effort, you could even theoretically ‘farm’ breakthroughs.

To aid this, you possess precise awareness of your own potential for enlightenment. You always know exactly how close or far you are from the threshold state required for an epiphany and what actions might help push you across it.

For you, enlightenments are no longer lucky miracles but instead milestones to meet.
addons.title: Engineered Epiphanies

addons.text:
Whenever you land a Black Flash, you do not just enter “the zone” but experience an instant epiphany.

Black Flash based epiphanies are uniquely conflict focused, always optimally refining and evolving your fighting abilities rather than anything else. Your mind sharpens, your combat oriented powers surge in capability and your prowess in battle rises drastically.

These revelations also flood you with feelings of exalted lucidity, making the whole world seem to center around you. In this state, your confidence and clarity become absolute, akin to having ascended to a higher plane of martial focus.
addons.title: Realm of the Highest

objects.text:
You are prone to extraordinary epiphanies: sudden, striking moments of enlightenment and realization. These prodigiously enhance your understanding and capabilities within a given area, soaring it to exceptional heights.

Epiphanies primarily involve mental breakthroughs, making previously unreachable applications possible through heightened clarity and insight, before progressing to improving your other abilities. Such growth typically follows the simplest and most natural path of improvement that best suits your intent and circumstances.

Each epiphany leaves a permanent mark. They manifest mentally by refining your mindset, filling gaps in your knowledge or unlocking new skills and techniques. They can often also directly enhance your physical proficiency; removing prior limits, expanding how existing aspects can be expressed or simply increasing your efficiency and potency.

Regardless of your current strength in a specific field, epiphanies will propel you several times beyond your prior limits, though they cannot create entirely new powers ex nihilo and may only build upon what already exists. These sudden enlightenments may briefly overwhelm you with euphoric mania as you process the revelation.

Epiphanies are far more likely to occur under intense pressure, especially if facing near death or utter defeat. However, they are not strictly tied to dangerous scenarios and can also arise during training, intense reflection or focus on a particular problem.
objects.title: Eureka!

objects.text:
You are a natural born tyrant. Without conscious effort, you carry yourself in a way that makes others instinctively feel your capacity for absolute control, and they respond with unease, deference, or quiet terror before you have said a word. Your mentality has also shifted, making hesitation foreign and removing the moral obligation to refrain from using fear.

When you choose to actively rule, you know exactly how to leverage that fear. You see the cracks in a populace’s morale, the unspoken hierarchies of obedience, and the precise pressure points that turn defiance into submission. Fear, under your hand, is a sculptable medium. You can twist it into fanatical loyalty, reframe it as reverence, let it curdle into self‑loathing, or sharpen it into hatred aimed at rivals you designate. Those who should despise you instead find their fear of you dressed in robes of gratitude; those who should rebel are taught to fear their own defiance more than your retribution. This is an innate understanding of how power flows through people, which rapidly grows the more you actively use it.

You also don’t have the issue other tyrants face, as the fear you cultivate does not fade with distance or death. Every act of tyranny you commit feeds a psychic entity that lingers in the institutions, architecture, and collective memory of your domain. This entity acts as a guardian of your rule, ensuring that fear of you remains as potent decades after your absence as it was on your worst day.

What kind of tyrant you become is yours alone to decide, be it bloody or bloodless, paranoid or paternal. Additionally, the entity only maintains fear, not love or loyalty, and given enough generations of people who never knew you directly, it will eventually weaken and fade like any memory, although even then it would last a minimum of ten times the length of your reign.
objects.title: Shadow of the Throne

objects.text:
You are a witch hunter, a predator shaped to hunt the supernatural that hunts men, and to do so, your mind is attuned to the presence of magic, altered reality, and nonhuman entities as naturally as sight is attuned to light. You can sense supernatural forces, creatures, enchantments, disguises, and distortions, having an intuitive feel for its type, intensity, emotional state, and proximity. This allows you to track, anticipate, and avoid ambushes while recognising hidden threats, illusions, possessions, and magical effects when given enough time. 

When you observe supernatural beings, powers, or systems, your mind automatically analyses their rules, limits, costs, patterns, and contradictions, rapidly identifying weaknesses, exploitable mechanics, and self-defeating interactions, with deeper insight gained through longer exposure. If given time to prepare, even mundane texts such as myths, folklore, case studies, and legends allows you to learn functional supernatural knowledge, offering broader but less precise understanding than direct observation. Either way, both methods allow you to logically infer new vulnerabilities, counters, and consequences without needing full information, turning partial truths into lethal strategies. To be clear, you do not understand the how like a scholar, you instead understand the what, the cause and effect, and the practical implications.

Paired with this, you have an instinctive mastery of supernatural psychology, allowing you to grasp the instincts, compulsions, pride, fears, habits, and mythic behavior patterns of magical beings, and to manipulate them through provocation, deception, baiting, and strategic pressure to force mistakes, overuse of powers, broken bargains, and self-destructive decisions, with this mastery scaling as your understanding of their rules and weaknesses deepens. 

Ultimately, all of this is mental skill rather than anything overly supernatural, and you remain physically human, albeit a well trained one. This means you will be relying on preparation, planning, and experience to survive and win against threats that can still kill you if you are careless or overwhelmed.
objects.title: Witch Hunter

objects.text:
You are now a Psychic. You possess a reservoir of psionic energy located within your brain, which you can project outward to affect the physical and mental world. Replenishing this energy is mentally draining, and while it recovers slowly over time while you are awake and resting, the fastest method is through sleep.

At first, your control is crude and your power expresses itself as raw telekinetic force, shooting out invisible blasts that can crush a civilian car with a single hit. You have no finesse at this stage, unable to lift an object without destroying it. With practice and time, however, you can refine your control dramatically. You learn to shape your energy with precision, allowing you to manipulate individual objects from a distance with the delicacy of your own hands. By focusing on perceiving the world around you through your power, you can grow to sense objects and people without sight, read the history imprinted on physical items, and perceive the biological state of living beings. You can also alternatively focus on perceiving the minds of others, reading their surface thoughts, diving into their memories, and even planting suggestions or commands within their consciousness. 

If you possess any other psychic powers, this ability integrates with them, allowing you to improve and refine them through the same practice and efficiency you apply to your own growth. You begin with enough energy in your reservoir to unleash approximately a dozen raw telekinetic blasts, and a focused half-hour of sleep is sufficient to fully replenish your reserves.
objects.title: Generic Psychic

objects.text: When you are truly lost, look upwards and ask the Wise Horse for an answer. Though, unless you have some way to communicate with horses, the only way it'll answer is by either nodding its head in agreement, shaking its head in disagreement, or, for the truly sus individuals, staring blankly at you in suspicion. Beware that it has a mean gambling streak; don't ask it for advice on that front because the answer will always be to let it ride.
objects.title: The Wise Horse

objects.text:
You possess an innate magnetism that draws attention and commands presence wherever you go. People naturally turn to look when you enter a room, your voice carries without effort, and your expressions and gestures land with perfect timing whether you intend them to or not. This charisma is not mind control but a genuine amplification of your natural appeal, making you memorable, persuasive, and difficult to ignore in any social situation.

Your primary power activates when you commit to a specific aesthetic through your behavior, clothing, and bearing. Once you adopt a persona, whether a charming rogue, a stern authority figure, a mystical sage, or a dashing hero, you become naturally talented at the skills that fit that role. While playing the rogue, lockpicking and wit come easily to you, allowing you to jury-rig your way through attempts even without formal training and to learn proper technique at an accelerated rate if a teacher or manual is available. Playing the general grants you instincts for command and strategy that make tactical decisions feel obvious and allow you to absorb military texts with unusual speed. Playing the sage gives you flashes of insight and the ability to grasp philosophical or mystical concepts far quicker than normal. This talent persists only as long as you maintain the aesthetic, but any skills you actually learn through study or practice during that time remain yours even after you abandon the persona. You can only maintain one aesthetic at a time, and switching requires you to fully adopt a new manner of dress and behavior.

You can also alter the visible expression of any other powers you possess to match your current aesthetic. These changes are purely cosmetic and do not alter the mechanics, range, or effectiveness of the underlying powers in any way.
objects.title: Leo, the Dazzling Lion

objects.text:
You possess an innate understanding of balance in all human interactions. When entering any negotiation, dispute, or conversation involving competing interests, you instinctively perceive the true needs and desires beneath what each party is saying. You know what each side actually requires versus what they are demanding, where they have room to compromise, and what they would accept if pushed.

You can actively influence others to become more receptive to negotiation and compromise. Your words carry a calming resonance that lowers defenses and reduces hostility, making it nearly impossible for others to remain completely unreasonable or dismissive in your presence. People in conflict will find themselves genuinely wanting to find a middle ground, even if they entered the conversation intent on dominating or refusing to bend. You cannot force anyone to agree to a specific outcome, but you can always create an environment where good-faith negotiation becomes possible. In any situation where both sides could theoretically benefit from compromise, you can guide them toward that outcome, and you always know when a proposed agreement is truly balanced versus when it merely appears fair on the surface.
objects.title: Libra, the Negotiator

objects.text:
You possess an intuitive knowledge of all things related to travel and movement through the world. You instinctively know how to climb any surface, reading handholds and footholds on rock, brick, or artificial structures as clearly as a path. Your body understands how to fall, roll, and land safely from any height. You can navigate by sun, stars, wind, and subtle environmental cues as naturally as breathing, and you always maintain perfect awareness of your direction and the distance back to any place you have been. Parkour, urban scrambling, wilderness trekking, and long-distance hiking come to you as naturally as walking does to others.

This knowledge deepens with every new place you visit and explore. A single day in a dense jungle teaches you how to move through canopy, read animal trails, and find water with the confidence of a lifelong native. Spending a week in a foreign city gives you an instinct for its flow, its hidden passages, its rooftop routes, and its underground shortcuts. The more you explore a type of environment, the more your knowledge refines; deserts, mountains, arctic wastes, sprawling megacities, each becomes a familiar terrain the more time you spend within them. This power does not grant you physical capability beyond your natural limits, only the perfect knowledge of how to use your body and read your environment to travel through any space as if you have already crossed it a thousand times before.
objects.title: Sagittarius, the Well-Traveled Traveller

objects.text:
For every long-term goal you set, you receive an automatic step-by-step plan outlining how to achieve it. This plan forms in your mind the moment you commit to a goal with genuine intent, presenting a sequence of milestones that lead from your current position to your desired outcome. The plan only accounts for information you already possess, so it cannot reveal hidden variables or unknown unknowns, and it operates in broad strokes rather than minute detail. A goal to build a company might show milestones like secure funding, hire a team, develop a product, and acquire customers, without specifying which investors to approach or which product to build. The plan remains visible in your awareness, updating only when your knowledge expands or your circumstances significantly change.

Each time you reach a milestone in the plan, you receive a boon tailored to help you continue. These boons typically manifest as skills, instincts, or capabilities relevant to the next phase of your journey. Completing the funding milestone for your company might grant you sharper instincts for reading potential hires. Reaching the product development milestone could give you deeper insight into customer needs. These boons remain with you only while you stay reasonably faithful to the plan. Significant deviation from the path, abandoning the goal, or pursuing it in a fundamentally different way than outlined causes all accumulated boons for that goal to vanish. Successfully reaching the final goal, however, permanently locks in every boon you earned along the way, making them yours forever. The goal must require at least six months of effort to generate even a single milestone, with longer and more ambitious goals producing more milestones and correspondingly greater rewards.
objects.title: Capricorn, Ambition of the Years

objects.text: To be a perfect king, one cannot understand the hearts of man. You can at will enter a mental state where all emotion, bias, impulse, and subjective desire are suppressed. While in this state, you experience the world as pure data, unclouded by the static of feeling, and project an aura of flawless composure that others often describe as inhumanly perfect. While suppressed, your mind operates at peak efficiency. You can deconstruct any skill or technique you observe into its core components, learning and improving in hours what takes others months. You execute every action unburdened by doubt, hesitation, or second-guessing. Your strategic insight becomes terrifyingly clear, allowing you to trace the long-term consequences of any decision through infinite variables. You become immune to manipulation, as you instantly identify biases and emotional ploys in others' words. Your arguments become unassailable towers of logic, and your charisma becomes the kind that makes men follow without question because your certainty becomes indistinguishable from truth. Even mental exhaustion is sealed away, keeping your mind clear and in top form. However, suppression is not destruction. Every denied feeling while you are in this state is locked away in the back of your mind, building. The more emotions build up, the stronger your mind will become in the suppressed state. However, when you finally release suppression, you experience every suppressed emotion at once in a single overwhelming flood that can incapacitate you. If too much pressure builds without release, the suppression can break automatically, paralyzing you as the sudden and unexpected flood of accumulated emotion crashes through all defenses at once. Additionally, while suppressed you cannot truly understand the hearts of man. This creates an invisible distance between you and the imperfect hearts you cannot reach.
objects.title: To Abandon Inferiority

objects.text: You have become a living vessel for the Three Wise Monkeys, an ancient curse that fragments three primal evils: Malice, Deception, and Ignorance. To possess one is to be touched by evil; to possess all three is to be utterly alone, and you carry them all. See No Evil grants you supernatural understanding of any event you visually witness, provided the event was fueled by malicious intent.
