When you focus on such a moment, you see the perpetrator's motive, their immediate goal, and the personal history that led them to act. You understand why they chose to harm, what they hoped to achieve, and how past wounds shaped their decision. A woman poisoning her husband's tea reveals to you her fear of abandonment, her desire for his insurance money, and the childhood neglect that taught her love must be purchased. But this understanding also makes you feel her malice as your own: her fear knots your stomach, her desperation tightens your chest. You carry every evil you witness. Hear No Evil lets you hear the negative thoughts lurking beneath every surface interaction. When someone harbors hostility, contempt, or ill intent in the present moment, you hear any negative words they think but don't speak. This includes the violent intent before an attack: you hear the shape of a feint before it's thrown, the specific strike they're planning and the exact moment they decide to act. A friend smiles and asks about your day. You also hear the whisper: "I hope you fail." And beneath that, you feel the resentment they've buried for years, the childhood wound that made them need to see you stumble. An enemy clenches their fist behind their back. You hear the thought: "I'm going to smash his nose in." And you feel the rage that's been building all week, the humiliation they need to avenge. You become burdened with every hidden ugliness people carry in the moment. Speak No Evil allows you to weaponize your genuine beliefs by projecting them onto a target's psyche, making them true. When you speak a truthful word to someone, and by truthful you mean a subjective judgment you genuinely believe in that moment, that word becomes fact in their mind. If you genuinely believe someone is an idiot, and you say "you are an idiot," they will become dumber. Their cognition will diminish. They will struggle with simple tasks. If you genuinely believe someone is cruel, and you say "you are cruel," their empathy will erode. They will become more callous, more selfish. The curse works only through your genuine negative beliefs, if you say a truthful positive statement, it does nothing. You become the source that brings evil into the world.
objects.title: Three Wise Monkeys

objects.text: Evil? What is that? Who gives more shape to sentient history: the good who adhere to the tried and true, or those who seek to rouse beings from their stupor and lead them to glory? You are an undisputed master of politics. Be it via personal charisma, blackmail, assassinations, or any other way, even starting as nothing but a dirt-poor peasant in a feudal society, you can climb your way to a position of the highest authority, whether by subverting the existing power structure to place yourself at the top or reshaping the society altogether to usher in a new political system. But your talents do not end there. Once you are in control, the gears of society start to run smoother than ever. The corruption can become virtually non-existent, and the efficiency of your government skyrockets, even as far as transforming a previously bankrupt country into an economic miracle. And in the military, you will find that only the very competent would rise to the top of the command chain. The caveat, however, is that any government you build functions only with you as the linchpin, be it through carefully curated rivalries between your subordinates, a cult of personality centered around you, or anything else. Should you be at the top, even if you delegate the majority of the power to your subordinates to wield in your stead, your nation will function perfectly. However, should you perish, abdicate, or otherwise step down from the position of highest authority, everything you have built will crumble like a house of cards, with your empire tearing itself apart until there is nothing left but miniscule portions of petty warlords desperately trying to hold on to the last scraps of power.
objects.title: Palpatine's Guide to Statecraft

addons.text: Neither the Sword King nor the Sword Saint before you could claim what you now possess, for your affinity with the blade does not stop at your flesh and bone; it reaches into the very path your soul walks, eclipsing their legends entirely as if they were mere footnotes to your coming story. When you hold a sword, every quantitative aspect of Absolute Sword Talent magnifies tenfold: your subjective frame rate becomes so vast that a hummingbird's wings seem frozen, your center of mass anchors absolutely, and micro-adjustments happen at the nanosecond scale. For binary aspects, new dimensions emerge instead. Where you once saw ghost arcs for swords, you now see ghost arcs of other weapons, blades or otherwise; where you once had zero motion blur, you now perceive the absence of motion as a tangible field, letting you track objects that aren't moving yet; where your hand once repositioned on the hilt optimally, it now finds grips that shouldn't exist, holding the sword in ways that feel impossible until you try them. As your swordsmanship grows through The Way of the Sword, your Absolute Sword Talent gains greater raw power and new sub-abilities. After a week of training, your natural edge alignment expands to allow you to cut along molecular fault lines. After a month, your anchored center improves to allow you to transfer that absolute anchor into your sword instead, making a single block feel like striking a mountain. Should you gain any esoteric sword skills, such as Sword Intent, your talents will grow in a similarly esoteric manner: ghost arcs could grow to show general intent as aura, or your sword edge could eventually cut abstractions like fear. The only real limit is the extent of your swordsmanship.
addons.title: Absolute Sword Saint

addons.text: Much like the Sword Saint, you have talent that rivals the Sword King, but you also have his enlightened understanding. Where the Sword Saint leaned on talent without philosophy, you have succeeded in pushing your talent to the next level like the Sword King did, surpassing the Sword Saint. Anything you originally could have applied This World of Swords to is now treated as a sword by your perception and talent, even when you are not wielding it. Though this does not physically imbue the object with cutting properties unless held, it does mean you can apply your perception to anything as if it were a sword. You now see ghost arcs and axis lines projected from any moving object or body part in your environment, not just swords, letting you predict a thrown spear's path, a closing door's swing, or an enemy's punch before it happens. Your pressure vibration field expands from sensing only blades to sensing all physical motion around you, granting a form of combat omniscience within your effective range. Your ideal sword paths now apply to any motion you make, from dodging to repositioning, and your micro-adjustments of stance and grip adapt to the world itself rather than just an opponent's sword. This is merely the tip of the iceberg; as you refine your swordsmanship and your philosophical grasp of what a sword can be, so too will this power expand.
addons.title: Master of the Sword; Master of the World

objects.text:
The Sword Saint was born with a talent for the blade that rivaled the Sword King himself, despite being born after his passing. She was endlessly praised for it, and as she aged, leaned fully onto her talents. While she never learned a single sword style, she never needed one. Her lack of drive was the only thing that had ever held her back.

You feel the opponent's blade as an invisible pressure vibration field against your skin and through the air. You see ghost arcs and axis lines projected from the opponent's sword, showing their slash or thrust path before their arm moves, predicting their attacks. You can perfectly replicate these lines, copying their sword moves with ease. Your vision operates at a vastly higher subjective frame rate with zero motion blur, meaning the opponent's fast-moving blade leaves no afterimage or smear in your vision.

You also see unique ghost arcs and lines for your own blade. These are idealised sword paths, perfectly fitting your current need, be it to cut someone or to block. You can effortlessly follow these lines, making your every swing the ideal sword strike, even against non-swordsmen.

You always know the exact position of your own blade's tip, guard, and pommel relative to your own spine with microscopic accuracy just from your grip. Your hand repositions itself on your hilt between micro moments, sliding from full grip to partial, reverse to standard, or one hand to two hands, choosing the optimal grip for your blade's motion. Your edge alignment and tilt adjust naturally so that your blade always meets the target at the ideal angle.

Your center of mass feels anchored to an absolute point in space regardless of how you twist, jump, or spin. You can change the direction of your own swing mid-cut without losing power or balance. Lastly, your feet micro-adjust your stance without conscious thought to maintain the ideal fighting distance.
objects.title: Absolute Sword Talent

addons.text: The consciousnesses of those residing inside your soul garden can, with your permission, enter the Dreamlands just as a regular person marked by the Dreambrand would.
addons.title: Garden of Dreams

objects.text:
You can create Dreamlands — imaginary realities, complete with life, history, and anything else you might imagine. You have a mental catalogue of these realities and can enter any of them by falling asleep. Within these realities, you hold absolute power, able to warp the world, time, story, and causality at will.

With a touch, you can mark other people with the Dreambrand, an undetectable mark that will pull them into a dreamland of your choice when they fall asleep. Inside this dreamland, you can asign them various identities, altering their appearance and, optionally, granting them necessary knowledge and skills to fit the chosen identity, albeit you cannot control the minds of the visitors directly. You can change and reassign any identities at will.

While any physical harm inside the Dreamlands will not transfer over into the real world, mental strain may still accumulate. As you can freely control the flow of time inside the Dreamlands, you can easily make someone live out hundreds or thousands of years in a reality of your choice, which, unless you desire otherwise, may irreparably damage the psyche. The only way to leave the Dreamlands is either with your permission or if someone dies within it, which will make them wake up in the real world once again.

Lastly, you can use other media as a reference point to create a Dreamland that will perfectly copy it. For example, a Harry Potter book will allow you to construct a world that perfectly copies the Harry Potter universe, with whatever changes you might decide to implement, even if the book did not cover certain aspects, locations, characters, etc. Each and every dreamland is created to be the perfect fit for you; regardless of how many details you provide, the rest will be filled in by the power itself.
objects.title: Dreamlands

objects.text: It is said that a genius exists on a different plane of existence than ordinary people, that they have more hours in a day. With some mental focus, you can compress your personal time. The greater the compression, the more time you experience in a smaller amount of time. For example, with a compression factor of two, you will experience two minutes in one minute. This allows you to do work that should take a long time in short periods of time. The mental stamina needed to maintain this state increases linearly the longer it’s active, with the baseline cost increasing the greater the compression factor. Maintaining a compression factor of two for five real-world minutes is equivalent to running a short marathon. As you use this ability, your body will grow to adapt to the mental cost, allowing you to increase your use. Additionally, the greater your compression factor, the greater your output and the lower your input. For example, a compression factor of ten will not only give you ten minutes in one minute, but also make the quantity and/or quality of your actions increase by ten times, while simultaneously, the energy costs for doing so are ten times less. This doesn’t lower the cost of external resources, only internal resources, except for mental fatigue. This means your energy burn rate per real second stays the same as a normal person's; you're simply doing ten times more with that same energy. This is an extremely personalized effect, meaning it doesn’t work well with any activity that requires input from another person, even actively increasing the cost to use if the activity involves real-time input from another person, like conversations or combat. In those moments, the compression only applies to your own body, so in a conversation, your words will sound garbled to others. This can be useful in combat, but the added cost means it will be very draining.
objects.title: Hours of Genius

objects.text:
Your physical body has been transformed into pure information that exists within a parallel dimension known as the Imaginary Data Space. This realm sits parallel to the physical world, a place where raw information, thoughts, memories, and psychic impressions flow as tangible currents. You have no true physical form anymore, only an informational physiology that allows you to perceive and navigate this landscape of pure knowledge. You are drawn naturally to places with strong informational connections to you, locations heavy with your personal history, objects imbued with emotional significance, or even people whose thoughts frequently turn toward you. In these places, you can coalesce more easily, gathering your diffuse informational self into a coherent presence, while in information voids, you become dispersed and weak, struggling to maintain any awareness or agency.

To interact with the physical world, you must gather enough of your informational self in one place to impose changes on the information that underpins reality. By concentrating, you can reach into the data streams that describe physical objects and properties, editing them directly. You can alter the vector information of a falling book to send it flying across a room. You can modify the light data in your vicinity to create a holographic projection of yourself, not true visibility but a convincing illusion painted onto existing photons. You can read the informational residue left on an object, experiencing the memories and emotions of those who touched it. You can phase through solid matter by briefly editing your own informational coordinates to non-interference with the atomic data of a wall. These alterations drain you mentally, each edit leaving you fatigued, though like any muscle, repeated use builds endurance and capacity over time.

Your potential is ultimately limitless because information itself underpins every aspect of existence. As your understanding of the Imaginary Data Space deepens, you learn to access increasingly fundamental layers of reality's code. What begins as simple vector manipulation can evolve into altering atomic bonds, transforming matter at its most basic level. With enough mastery, you can learn to access historical information, editing past events by corrupting the data that describes them, forcing reality to update to match your changes. You can touch the flow of probability that generates future events, weighting quantum outcomes in your favor. Every connection between things, every law of physics, every memory and possibility, is ultimately information, and information is your native language.
objects.title: A Tangle of Ideas

objects.text:
When the man known as Naraka was born, his mother abandoned him in the snow to die, yet he did not perish. Instead, as an infant, he stood up and walked away, and from that first breath, he understood himself not as a man but as a beast, for no human infant could have survived that cold. He fundamentally understood his nature as a beast more than he ever understood mankind.

Like Naraka, you can access the memories, natural instincts, and perceptual frameworks of every past and future life you have lived or will live, so long as that life was a life where you existed as a non-sapient beast. Whether you were an insect burrowing from predators, a fish fleeing larger jaws, a mammal starving through winter, or any other creature whose existence was defined by the raw struggle for survival. Because each of those lives was a punishment born of your negative karma, each one is filled with hunger, terror, pain, and the desperate will to live one more moment.

You possess all of these minds simultaneously, their desires inside you at once: their hungers become your cravings, their fears become your reflexes, their furies become your impulses. From this chaos you also gain tangible benefits: memories of a thousand escapes that teach you how to slip any bind, instincts that scream when to strike and when to flee, perceptual frameworks that strip away abstract reasoning and leave only the raw calculus of survival, and a kinesthetic understanding of animal movement so deep that you control every inch of your own body as easily blinking. Because you possess enlightenment, you ultimately command this chaos as much as they influence you, and your sense of self remains intact, for you understand the core of what you are while they simply are extensions of your core.

Your enlightenment allows you to see karma itself, particularly negative karma, perceiving it in everyone around you as karmic lines: threads of fate, consequence, and suffering that bind all sapient beings. The more negative karma you accumulate, the more lives the wheel of samsara forces you to endure as punishment, both in your future and retroactively across your past. Each new sting of hatred, curse, or harm directed at you adds another beast-life to your collection, and each added beast-life deepens your instincts, sharpens your perceptions, and strengthens your enlightenment.
objects.title: Apaya’s Chalice

objects.text:
You have a complete understanding of yourself and have fully accepted every part of who you are. You have no hidden worries about yourself, no secret wishes you are afraid to admit, and no difference between how you see yourself and how you actually think and feel. You know every feeling you have as you have it, and you do not try to push any of it away.

Inside your mind, this wholeness gets rid of the usual struggle between what you want to do and what you are scared to do. Normally, a person might want to act but feel fear, or believe one thing but feel another, creating internal resistance. You have none of that. Your choices turn straight into action without any pause where you question yourself. This means you cannot be affected by any power that works through doubt, hesitation, or anything that feeds on hidden conflict inside you.

To other people, your calm, clear way of carrying yourself makes everything you do seem completely honest. No one can spot a difference between when you tell the truth and when you lie, because even your lies come out without any sign of nervousness or guilt. Your voice stays steady, your face stays still, and your body gives no clues. You can lie without internal conflict because you accept that lying is part of your "true self" in that moment.
objects.title: Total Inner Enlightenment

objects.text:
You can project a focused mental suggestion into another person’s mind, nudging them toward a simple action, response, or decision. If it takes hold, the target interprets the thought as their own and usually acts as though it was a reasonable choice they made themselves.

This works best on small, immediate actions. Asking someone to hand over an item, look the other way, ignore a minor detail, answer a simple question, or allow brief passage are all typical uses. The suggestion is strongest when it aligns with what the target might plausibly do anyway.

It does not function as absolute mind control. It cannot force people to act against deeply held beliefs, strong loyalty, intense fear, or firm personal convictions. A tired guard who is distracted, underpaid, or only half-invested may let you pass. A disciplined zealot, a highly alert professional, or someone strongly committed to stopping you will resist or ignore the suggestion.

The effect is generally limited to single actions or short decisions, not long-term behavioural change. Once the moment passes, the influence fades. Affected targets will simply rationalize their actions afterwards rather than realizing outside influence was involved.

Clear phrasing, timing, confidence, and reading the target’s mental state all improve reliability. The better you understand what the target is already inclined to accept, the more naturally the suggestion takes hold.

This works best when done verbally to targets that are within arm's reach, while non-verbal suggestions are possible, they are much less likely to succeed.
objects.title: Mind Trick

addons.text: Your power turns into a memetic hazard, turning every post and image you create into “brainrot”, an inane meme that propagates by sheer brainlessness, expanding your power’s effective range to anyone who sees or hears it.
addons.title: Brainrot

objects.text:
Your very presence within a half-kilometer radius lowers people’s intellectual and emotional intelligence to the point of catatonia. 

At first, the effects are negligible enough to be unnoticeable apart from a lower chance to connect dots or generally keeping thoughts or emotions at bay, as this eats away at someone’s cognitive and emotional faculties, literally burning synapses and brain hemispheres' focus on creative and abstract thought, decision making, problem resolution, emotional regulation, and risk assessment. 

Increased exposure under 2-3 hours brings noticeable changes such as an inability to form complex or long-term trains of thought, a tendency to fall back on short-term gratification or primitive instincts, and lowered emotional regulation, which can result in spontaneous bouts of violence.

Enough exposure after 6-7 hours can bring a permanent lack of creative or abstract thought and general higher cognitive function, regressing the victim to a primitive stage. Finally, those unfortunate enough to be under your vicinity beyond 21 hours are left motionless, your power eating away at more important parts of their brain, leaving them unresponsive and relatively paralyzed.

As a stopgap, you have an on-off switch on this ability.
objects.title: Braincell Burner

objects.text:
Your flight response has been removed from your psyche, removing your need to disengage or run. Your fight response on the other hand has been amplified into something far more vicious than normal human aggression, driving you to meet danger with immediate, disproportionate violence rather than any measured self-defense. The freeze response remains present but is functionally suppressed. You can still be briefly stunned by truly overwhelming stimuli, but your fight instinct will tear through that paralysis almost instantly. 

Your automatic threat-response instincts have been rewritten to have the sole priority is inflicting damage that makes harming you an unacceptable trade; you will bite, gouge, headbutt, and tear at soft tissue without conscious thought, and you possess an encoded instinct to intentionally accept incoming hits if doing so opens a more vital target on your attacker. Your instincts make sure that any exchange leaves your opponent worse off than you. This aggression intensifies the more you are cornered.

You possess a natural talent for any skill aligned with mindless violence and animalistic aggression, such as brawling, brutal weapon forms like axes and maces, intimidation, or predatory ambush tactics, learning and executing these with unnerving natural ease. Additionally, you can take any skill you know and filter it through your instincts to create a personalised variant suited to your violence. This is not automatic and requires you first learn the base skill properly, but once altered, the altered form becomes more natural to you than the original ever was.
objects.title: Violent Beast

objects.text:
You are able to leave behind afterimages as you move. When this is active, your real body becomes invisible while a delayed illusion trails behind you, mimicking your previous position with a half-second lag.

The afterimage is a purely physical illusion—it has no substance and cannot interact with the world. It offers no protection against those who can track you through superhuman or supernatural means. Skilled opponents may even infer your true position by reading the body language of the illusion and predicting your trajectory. While it can create confusion in fast-paced combat, it’s not foolproof and won’t fool everyone for long.

Additionally, maintaining the illusion is taxing. Each second it remains active increases its drain on your stamina and mental focus, making prolonged use risky in drawn-out fights.
objects.title: Afterimages

objects.text:
You possess the ability to plant information in the minds of the people. While you cannot make someone believe something easily disprovable, like that the sky is green, you can easily spread unverifiable information, rumours, memes, etc.

Simply formulating an idea and deciding to release it will see it spreading from person to person like an infection, allowing you to improve or ruin someone's reputation by spreading necessary information or shape people's opinions and views on various issues.
objects.title: Whistleblower

objects.text:
Your mind is no longer limited by human experiences. You can imagine the unimaginable and visualise that which transcends your experience.

The truly abstract, the conceptual, the eldritch, and forms in higher dimensions now unfold perfectly in your mind's eye.

Whilst it does shield you from the deleterious effects of viewing the eldritch, this ability is merely a novelty on its own. It grants neither understanding nor power, merely the potential to comprehend and conceptualise what should be beyond your limits.

Where this power truly shines is when it is used in conjunction with magical, spiritual, or psychic powers. Imagine the inversion of the soul, anti-light, or conjure a four-dimensional tesseract, or any other use you can dream up.

This is not a boost in understanding, but a lifting of the fundamental limitations of your mental flexibility.
objects.title: Conceptualisation

addons.title: Veteran Survivor
addons.text: You have developed a talent for surviving situations that should kill you, your drive to live sharpened and refined through training and hardships. You can recognize when a tactic, position, or decision will lead you toward certain death, instinctively adjusting in order to preserve your life. Your expertise and instinct allow you to make even the smallest chance of survival count.

addons.title: Trained Survivor
addons.text: Your instinctive drive to live is now backed by your survival knowledge, allowing you to endure through horrible situations. This could mean rationing food supplies to the limit, ignoring the hunger until you absolutely need to eat or working through exhaustion to build a shelter from the elements.

objects.text:
Above all else, you are a Survivor.

In terrifying or seemingly hopeless situations, where others might freeze or give up, your body just seems to act on its own, driven purely by your desire to survive. You'll do whatever it takes to come out the other side, even if that means making hard choices that will leave you mentally or physically scarred.

It is literally impossible for you to take any action that would lead to your demise. You can still enter dangerous situations, but if you have to shoot yourself or someone else in the head, you will make the same choice every time. This can even resist mind control, though it won't break it, you'll simply ignore commands that would kill you.
objects.title: Survivor

objects.text:
You have access to all of humanity’s collective knowledge… technically.

You have five ‘library passes’, each of which is able to replicate any skill or learnt knowledge that has ever existed in the world you’re in. These range from specific programming languages, martial arts, mechanical engineering and even magic systems. It would be as if you’d spent your entire life mastering any of the skills from these passes.

However, you’re limited to changing or assigning a single pass every 24 hours, and the second you ‘replace’ one of these passes, the knowledge contained within vanishes with it until it’s restored as one of your passes once more.

These skills can be ‘learned’ naturally by using them to a high degree, but this only gives you knowledge commensurate with the amount you’ve used the skill. Ie. If you were using mechanical engineering skill for 4 hours of work and exchanged the pass out you’d have 4 hours of beginners experience in the skill, nowhere near your level if it were still being used in the pass.
objects.title: The Library of the Mind
Scientific Method Cranked to 11
objects.text:
Your ability to use the scientific method has been pushed to an absurd level. The process of Experiment, Discover, and Share becomes almost instinctive, allowing you to investigate questions with extraordinary thoroughness while retaining the creativity needed to discover answers nobody else would think to seek.

Experiment: You can generate an enormous number of hypotheses, experimental approaches, and potential explanations, including ideas that would initially seem ridiculous or impractical. Your creativity naturally produces unusual ways to test a question, while your reasoning helps identify which ideas are actually worth attempting. You can deliberately vary conditions, construct controls, isolate variables, and design experiments capable of distinguishing between competing explanations.

Discover: Your memory records your experiments with effectively perfect clarity. You remember every relevant variable, observation, measurement, environmental condition, failed attempt, and unexpected result, allowing you to reconstruct an experiment in detail long after it occurred. You can mentally compare results across experiments, identify correlations, notice anomalies, and determine which variables actually affected the outcome. Failure is therefore still useful: an experiment that disproves your hypothesis provides information that can guide the next one.

Share: Once you have a result worth reporting, you can present it with exceptional clarity. Your papers, documentation, diagrams, experimental procedures, data, and explanations are impeccably organized, grammatically correct, and structured so that another person can understand exactly what you did and attempt to reproduce it. You naturally distinguish established results from hypotheses, assumptions, and speculation, making your work unusually easy to scrutinize.

The power does not make your experiments succeed, make your hypotheses correct, or force others to believe your conclusions. It also cannot make an irreproducible phenomenon reproducible.

objects.title: One Second Warning
objects.text:
You now get a one second precognitive warning of any danger heading your way. You know what direction it will come from and roughly how much damage you will take from it.

With practice, training and experience, you can increase how much time you get as well as how precise the warning will be.

objects.title: Concept Transfer Language
objects.text:
You possess a unique communication ability. When conversing with someone, you can, instead of using traditional things like language, opt to transfer the meaning of what you want to say directly to your interlocutor.

When talking about a mathematical theorem, for example, you can transfer your full understanding of it, complete with proof, examples of use, and the entirety of your own understanding attached to the concept.

At the same time, you can understand others in the same way, as if they possessed the same ability when talking to you, extracting complex meaning out of barely a few words or even mere gestures, leaving no room for misunderstanding or omission.

objects.title: Eyes of Submission
objects.text: You are mine: servants, slaves, weapons. And you will obey! These fiery eyes allow you to implant a perfect, indefinite, and unshakeable loyalty towards you into anyone and anything weaker than you in your line of sight. Anyone brainwashed in this way will retain their personality and full intellectual capabilities. The loyalty is absolute, to the point where even under the influence of mind control, your servants will sooner die because of internal conflict rather than betray you. The power can propagate across live feeds, but not through photos or recordings. There is no limit to how many targets you can affect at once, but affecting simultaneously a number above a few thousand will lead to bleeding and an intense burning sensation in your eyes until the pain is too much to bear, and your eyes will need a few days to recover. This can be mediated if you possess enhanced constitution or regeneration.

objects.title: The Torment Nexus
objects.text:
You have the fearsome ability to imprison people within their own minds, forcing them to eternally relive all their most painful memories. 

By simply willing it to happen, you can force those in your sight into a terrible nightmare, where the victim will vividly re-experience all their deepest traumas in perfect clarity as if it were truly happening again. Even should a victim have repressed their memories, the nightmare shall force them to resurface to torment its victim.

This nightmare is without end, and a victim will only be given brief respite to dread what comes next before it happens again. Over time, the nightmare will worsen. What truly happened will become lost as the memories distort into ever more horrific versions of themselves, ensuring the victim cannot become accustomed to their torment.

You possess a degree of control over the nightmare, able to control its shape or make an appearance within it should you wish. Perhaps you might give a true respite to the victim's suffering, to offer them escape for something in return, or you may simply mock their misery. Whatever the case, years can pass within the dream while only seconds do in reality. 

To break free of this terrible illusion, one must have an unbreakable determination, able to endure years of torment without ever losing hope. But should they falter, should they flinch even once at the horrors of the nightmare, then they shall remain forever trapped in hell until you decide to release them. Naturally, those who possess a degree of resistance to mental tampering will be able to better resist you, requiring less willpower to escape.

objects.title: Schrödinger's Latch
objects.text:
While a quantum particle goes unseen it exists within a superposition of all possible states, simultaneously existing it every way it can, all until it is observed. You take this principle and apply it at a massive scale, able to cause areas on the order of entire cities to enter a superposition-like state, before collapsing them into your desired form.

This power can only function on areas not under observation, functioning near instantly to reshape your environment to your will. The instant the areas under your control are sensed by any being they will collapse into the closest equivalent. Buildings turned to taffy will be flattened by gravity, floating cars will fall, and non-euclidean space will be forced to straighten. This means that while you are able to warp reality at a large scale, the only remnants of your efforts will be mundane in nature.

This power comes with an effect that obfuscates higher forms of perception, meaning it will function even in worlds with omniscient beings. By working on a smaller scale this effect will be amplified, allowing you to use it to a lesser extent while in peoples peripherals, though direct observation will still prevent you from making any obvious changes.

addons.text:
Your ability to use your imagination to visualize and your innate fighting instinct have inadvertently granted you a new ability, thanks to your skill with Ki, known as Pure Progress: an improvement ability that allows you to rapidly improve your fighting performance.

A user with Pure Progress can continuously increase in fighting ability the longer they fight, similar to the Saiyan's natural battle potency. These effects mostly vary from user to user. Some may simply be able to rise in sheer strength and speed. Others can imprint on their own experiences and grow via adaptation and improved fighting tactics and skill sets rather than power level, energy, physical strength, or conditioning.

Across all users of this ability, they were able to make rapid jumps in performance in relatively short amounts of time.
addons.title: Pure Progress (Dragon Ball Super)

objects.text:
You gain a diversified skillset, giving more intensity and consistency to your imagination, from training against mental images to visualizing a mind projection of yourself countering the attacks of your opponent before the fight even starts. 

If you possess sufficient skill and physical ability, such as with Martial Arts, you can learn to perform techniques like Katsumi's Mach punch which he created by imagining he had numerous bones in his body, turning his fist into the closest equivalent of a whip.

This power does not give you secondary powers; it simply hypnotizes your body to believe what you want it to, but be warned that unless your body is capable of handling the act you are imagining, it will hurt your body.
objects.title: Imagination Power (Baki the Grappler)

addons.text:
You gain the abilities of all those who bore the mantle of "Zero", including Lelouch vi Britannia, Suzaku Kururugi, Kallen Kouzuki, who seriously considered taking up the mantle, and every Black Knight or Japanese in the service of Zero.

This includes Suzaku's athleticism, his willpower, his unnatural combat focus from the "live" command (without the downsides), and his soldiering skills (from mech piloting, to martial arts, to bodyguarding), Lelouch's genius, knowledge (from force organization, to espionage, to chess, to the proper manners expected of the Britannian nobility), charisma (both the kind that made him the kind of showman that Diethard admired and the kind that made him so lucky in love), his attention to detail, and so on. Given the abilities of the other Black Knights, you also have the scientific acumen of Rakshata, the cool head of Tohdoh, Diethard's shrewdness and directorial eye, and other skills and abilities, almost without number.

Unless you have the Immortality Code, this does not include C.C. However, you may include her if you do.
addons.title: Zero Requiem (Code Geass)

objects.text: With this power of kings, you have one chance to give an absolute order to any individual that you make eye contact with. The maximum range for this ability is about 270 meters, with reflective surfaces ‘counting’ as eye contact, but recordings and broadcasts not ‘counting’. The commands must be issued by the user verbally, while the target is able to still make eye contact with the user. This power only works ONCE on any being you use it on, but during that one instance, any number of commands may be made. The target will strive to fulfill those commands to the best of their ability, but this power cannot make them do something they are not theoretically, physically, and mentally capable of already doing. Whether the target remembers what happens under these commands is up to you, being capable of being toggled to suit your needs. As the holder of this ability, you and only you can see a glowing red outline in the victim’s eyes, thus showing those who’ve already been targeted by this power. Optionally, you can also have the effect of the glowing red sigil of the Geass appear in your eyes while you use this power.
objects.title: Geass of Absolute Obedience (Code Geass)

objects.text:
Your Geass manifests the same as that of the boy known as “Rolo,” granting you the Power of Absolute Suspension. This Geass allows you to suspend the perception of time for any desired targets within its zone of effect. To those who possess a Geass, this appears as a red-tinged spherical area, with the eyes of all those under its effect gaining red-ringed irises and the Geass sigil within their eyes.

However, this Geass has several flaws. First, there is the strain it puts on the user’s body; the greater the zone of effect, the greater the strain. Next, this Geass stops the user’s heartbeat while it’s active, restricting its usage to very short bursts—no more than a couple of minutes. Lastly, this Geass only affects the perception of time for living creatures; it doesn’t actually stop time itself, so things set in motion under this Geass will continue to move.

This Geass can be used on a target an unlimited number of times. Those who have been under the influence of this Geass will excuse or explain away the discrepancies surrounding its usage.
objects.title: Geass of Absolute Suspension (Code Geass)

objects.text:
Your Geass manifests with the same power as Mao’s, granting you the Power of Absolute Thought—able to read the minds of anyone within a 500-meter radius. You can choose to read the minds of everyone at once, but only access the surface of their thoughts, or you can focus on a specific individual and peer deeper into their mind and memories.

Like Mao, you can become overwhelmed by too many people, their thoughts drowning out your own and making it difficult to think. However, unlike Mao, you will always retain the ability to activate and deactivate this Geass at will.
objects.title: Geass of Absolute Thought (Code Geass)

objects.text:
You didn't come into contact with a shard of an utterly alien entity, gain magic powers, unlock spiritual potential, merge with extraterrestrial DNA, become a supergenius, or gain a mysterious artifact through this—no, you're most assuredly still human. Instead, you simply gain impossible, magical skill in a form of your choice—swordsmanship literally warping space and time to keep up with your skills, for example.

More than that, you can train your other skills in a similar manner. With the right skill at your peak, you could kill an Entity, but that would almost certainly erase you as well as all record of you from existence so thoroughly that the only thing left of you would be other people's memories.
objects.title: Legendary Skill (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You possess intelligence comparable to the greatest minds humanity ever produced, such as Leonardo da Vinci, Nikola Tesla or Albert Einstein. Your memory is nigh-perfect, you can easily deduce the answer to complicated problems and your incredible mind even makes it harder for powers to affect your mind.

If you have any reference material, you can effortlessly learn new skills and understand both the theory and practice behind art, science and technology as well as easily innovate on them. In fact, you accomplish in weeks what would take months or years to others. Additionally, if you specialize in a subject, you'd be able to rapidly become the foremost expert in it.

Even supernatural energies aren't beyond the grasp of your mind; while this power doesn't grant you a way to acquire such energy, you'd more easily understand its workings than others, though the usual complexity of such matters may still make such endeavor significantly slower compared to learning mundane skills.
objects.title: Natural-Born Genius (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have gained the Riding skill, a skill that represents mastery over mounts and vehicles. With this skill, you instinctively understand and can execute all actions and techniques required to ride, control, and operate any form of transportation, whether it is a living creature or a mechanical machine. This innate knowledge allows you to seamlessly adapt to any mount or vehicle, regardless of its nature or complexity, making you a versatile and capable rider in all circumstances. No matter how unruly or wild a mount may be, your skill ensures that you can always bring it under your control and ride it with confidence.

In addition to basic control, the Riding skill gives you a deep understanding of combat techniques specific to riding, whether on a horse, piloting a high-speed vehicle, or commanding a mythical beast. You instinctively adapt to the dynamics of battle while in motion, maintaining stability, precision, and effectiveness. Whether engaging in aerial dogfights, charging on horseback, or executing advanced maneuvers in futuristic vehicles, you seamlessly integrate combat strategies with your mount’s or vehicle’s unique abilities. You harness their speed, power, and agility as tactical advantages, striking with precision, evading attacks, and outmaneuvering opponents. This mastery includes advanced techniques, such as synchronising attacks with a creature’s movements or leveraging vehicle systems in high-speed engagements, all executed instinctively and efficiently.

Furthermore, your connection with the mount or vehicle can improve its performance. The stronger your bond and familiarity, the more its capabilities, such as speed or endurance, can be enhanced.
objects.title: Riding (Type-Moon)

objects.text: This ability, the embodiment of Gilgamesh's mentality sublimated into a Noble Phantasm, grants you an insight so profound it is said to have "spread across all corners of the world as if the brilliance of the stars, seeing through all creation." Your perception transcends mortal limits, stepping into the territory of gods. An ever-present awareness that requires no invocation, it constantly feeds you information, unveiling the truth of all things with near-omniscient clarity. Whether seen or unseen, nothing escapes your gaze. Like a star illuminating the vast cosmos, your sight extends across all existence, piercing through deception, obscurity, and even the flow of time itself. However, should you invoke its True Name, it transforms into something greater: a guiding force, revealing the most optimal strategies and actions, providing "instructions" to achieve your desired outcome. Against you, strategy is rendered meaningless. In a game of chess, even the most skilled opponent—one who sees countless moves ahead—has already lost. You do not predict the board; you oversee it, with the correct move always laid bare before you. Even in games of chance, where luck is paramount, the only way to stand against you would be to draw the perfect hand every time. Should you choose, your vision can extend into the infinite branches of possibility across parallel worlds. Your foresight is absolute, stretching even to the very death of the universe. And yet, if you desire, you can suppress this overwhelming perception, allowing yourself the illusion of ignorance—if only for a time.
objects.title: Sha Naqba Imuru (Type-Moon)

objects.text: The Eyes That See Through the World—a clairvoyant ability possessed by Merlin, the court mage of Camelot. With these eyes, nothing is hidden; all things in the present, be it across realities, worldlines, or even something at the edges of the universe, are laid bare before his sight. This gift, an inheritance of Merlin's nature as a failed anti-Christ and Beast candidate—grants him a form of near-omniscience, ensuring that no situation can escape his awareness. Now, this power has been passed on to you. Like the Magus of Flowers before you, you can perceive everything, everywhere, all at once that's in the present. Yet, despite the overwhelming nature of such vast perception, you instinctively manage this influx of information with ease. You can even narrow your focus, directing your gaze toward specific events or locations at will, refining your awareness as needed. Furthermore, alongside your observational ability, you inherit Merlin's knack for analyzing the present to predict the future with uncanny accuracy. With the knowledge you gather, you can foresee the general course of events months or even years in advance, with only a small margin of error. While the finer details may remain uncertain, the overarching flow of fate is laid bare before you.
objects.title: Gaze of The Flower Magus (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You can skip all the training required to get Instinct to EX because it’s already there!

Your instincts and Spider Sense have mixed together and in turn, have been super charged. 

Even if your senses have wholly been blocked, altered or you’re just unconscious, your body will just move itself away from danger before it happens.

Be it conceptual, physical, or spiritual in nature, you predict what will happen before it happens even if your higher consciousness has no idea what was going on.
addons.title: Instinct EX

objects.text:
Your instincts have been honed to the point where they have reached the realm of the supernatural.

This Skill begins at Rank C—a level where even if your senses are impaired, you'll be able to subconsciously recognize this and act in the optimal manner required. 

With training, you can further refine your instincts to the level of precognition and dodge attacks you had no awareness of.
objects.title: Instinct (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Blended into your experience are now the supernatural instincts of a true combat genius, allowing you to intuit openings, dangers, and strategies without relying solely on memory.

But instead of standing apart, these instincts now work in tandem with your experience, cross-referencing with what you've already lived through. So that even when acting on a hunch, your instincts are filtered through the lens of past battles, minimizing false positives and making you far harder to deceive.

This synergy doesn't just sharpen your reactions—it heightens your logic, refines your battle IQ, and accelerates the speed at which connections form in your mind during a fight.

In short, you now possess Mind's Eye (False) at B rank. And the more experience you gain, the higher this rank will climb.
addons.title: Mind's Eye (False)

objects.text:
Etched deep into your mind and bones rests the experience of hundreds of life-and-death battles. Though not wholly your own, these memories have granted you a measure of insight and discipline born only of combat.

Your body recalls their taste and the bitter lessons they taught, as if you had personally lived through every one of those clashes—fighting with the confidence someone who knows what works, relying on instincts honed via numerous remembered battles. You attack in ways you've seen succeed, and defend with methods that once saved your life.

Calmly able to dissect both foe and battlefield alike—you analyze situations through cold logic, weighing every available possibility to determine the appropriate course of action.

And by drawing upon this accumulated experience, utilizing it like a lens, you can read the flow of combat to predict how an opponent might strike, based on how others have acted in similar circumstances; and anticipate reactions by recalling patterns of behaviour you've "seen" countless times before.

However, this Skill is currently at C Rank—meaning that while you can cross-reference past intelligence collected up to the present as a basis to intuit the (probable) "future" and avoid danger, you still aren't an expert at it, falling short against true veterans of thousands of battles.
objects.title: Mind's Eye (True) (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You've acquired the modern version of Protection from Arrows, granting you a passive, hardened outer layer that deflects high-speed projectiles, repelling them before they can taste your flesh. Only the most powerful ranged attacks or projectiles stand a chance of breaking through.

This Skill is at B rank, providing defense even against ranged Noble Phantasms. It also offers limited protection against area-of-effect attacks, giving you broad resistance across various forms of ranged assault.
addons.title: Bulletproof Treatment

objects.text:
Despite what its name implies, this ability defends against far more than just arrows. It heightens your senses and instinct, allowing you to detect and react to incoming projectiles through extraordinary means, such as hearing the air being cut, sensing hostile intent, or simply by reading subtle cues in the environment. With this, you can evade, deflect, or block ranged attacks using any weapons or tools available.

However, as it's only currently at C rank, the ability still has some notable limitations. You must be able to visually track both the attacker and the projectile to predict its path accurately. Its effectiveness also drops significantly when dealing with purely magical projectiles or attacks that lack a physical form. Additionally, wide-area or AoE ranged attacks aren't covered at this level, requiring more power or skill to be able to handle effectively.
objects.title: Protection from Arrows (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your mindset now spreads like a virus to all of those that you inspire until it has infected every corner of the species. They’ll work towards their dreams, subsuming mysteries in their wake.

No longer will divinities, immortals or eldritch beings see Humanity as vermin to be culled as they grow, but as a noble species—flawed, yes, but noble. This also means that these entities that have this mindset are more easily integrated into the Human Order.

Your aspirations become the aspirations of humanity. This won’t mean that they’ll prioritize these goals above all else, but you’ll get to see them realized within your lifetime.

The only obstacle for the Human race is imagination.
addons.title: The Light of Sirius

objects.text:
A type of rationalization that only the beings with the most fleeting of lifespans have. From Homunculi to other created lifeforms, they manage to keep an objective view of things, never falling into nonsensical thought patterns, and now so do you. Due to this, finding your reason for existing and consistently moving towards it happens much faster for you than for other people.

Everybody has dreams, and even those who are doomed to die soon are no exception. You might have the most childish of dreams, like becoming an astronaut when spaceflight hadn't even been theorized yet, but you’ll never lose sight of them and hold them dear to your heart. Often, the dream’s impossibility is the point.

When speaking with immortals, the downtrodden, or those who’ve long since resigned themselves to despair and doubt, you can poke holes in their worldview, shattering the rusted, calcified logic that’s binding their hearts, letting them glimpse the light of a better tomorrow once more. To them, your presence is a curiosity, a breath of fresh air they cannot forget. And merely by existing, you inspire others to reach for the unattainable.

You no longer have a fear of dying early or succumbing to your natural lifespan.
objects.title: Dream for the Stars (Type-Moon)

objects.text: “Once you have tasted flight, you will forever walk the earth with your eyes turned skyward, for there you have been, and there you will always long to return.” Wisdom. The ability to not just follow a path but to understand whether the path is worth taking. You have now gained the omnipotent wisdom of Leonardo Da Vinci, the Italian polymath who was unrivalled in the renaissance era. Your innate wisdom allows for the supernatural insight into the universe around you. Illusions falter, mystery fades and lies reveal themselves to you as if they were in plain sight. You could analyse your own thought patterns which results in the deep reflection of your own psyche as if you’ve gone to a million therapy sessions. Looking at mental processes also allows you to see if you’ve been mind controlled or unduly influenced without your consent such using social manipulation, drugs, parasites and the like. To the Renaissance Mind, Art and Science are not separate disciplines but interwoven fields that contribute to one and other. Increasing your skill with the artistic medium could cause your mechanical or technical knowledge to skyrocket. Additionally, inspiration comes more freely, an art piece referencing a bridge will motivate you to create an aqueduct that lasts more than a thousand generations. Truly, your wisdom is universal.
objects.title: Sagacious Wisdom (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The ability to observe and understand human or human-adjacent beings. Using it, you can hypothesize about the livelihoods, likes, and lifestyles of people you've never seen before—whose names you don't even know—with startling accuracy.

By observing a person for a limited time, you may begin to dissect their inner workings; the longer this persists, the clearer and more complete the image of them becomes in your head.

Easily able to pick up on all the minor idiosyncrasies of their psyche, their pitfalls, unresolved traumas, and even aspects of their nature they aren't aware of. With an extended amount of time, you'll soon come to know them better than they do themselves.

Such that you can gain insight into the (probable) chain of events that shaped them into who they are now, and understand how all those pieces that make them "them" fit together. As a bonus, this Skill will grant you a resemblance to an eidetic memory. Oh, but do try not to emulate a "certain" fairy-tale author; most people don't quite like that.
objects.title: Human Observation (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your spiritron processing and magical calculation operate as a single system, merging code-based magecraft and calculation-based magic into a unified framework.

Spell formation, sequencing, and execution are handled through the same structure, allowing rapid casting and seamless conversion between Magic Sequences and Codecasts without loss of function.

Your Magic Calculation Area is more efficient, enabling faster activation, parallel processing, and stable control of complex spells. Psion output and spiritron handling reinforce each other, reducing delay and sustaining heavier workloads.

You can read and modify magic at the structural level, parsing spells as executable constructs to interfere with, redirect, or refine them mid-cast. Your own spells can be adjusted in real time before instability occurs.

This fusion allows precompiled spells, dynamic rewriting, and parallel execution without conflict, improving speed, efficiency, and adaptability. Growth comes from better structure and clarity, letting the system produce stronger, more reliable results.
addons.title: Spiritron Computing Brain

addons.text:
Your Shard functions as an external processing core, integrating with your Spiritron Hacking to extend your capabilities far beyond your own limits. Codecasts no longer require full manual construction; they can be assembled through your Shard’s calculations and returned as ready-to-use constructs.

Instead of building effects step by step, you define intent and parameters. Your Shard resolves them through large-scale simulation, delivering structured results with high precision and efficiency.

It continuously processes your surroundings, supplying refined insight rather than raw input. Magical systems and active effects become easier to interpret as they are translated into usable information in real time.

At the same time, it runs ongoing simulations, testing actions and variations before you commit. This allows rapid refinement, exploration of alternatives, and development of new techniques with minimal waste.

The dynamic is cooperative: you provide direction and intent, while the Shard supplies scale and completion.
addons.title: Shard Cell

addons.text:
Your Spiritron Hacking no longer interfaces with the Moon Cell. It becomes it. Your consciousness expands and anchors itself within the Moon Cell’s structure, existing as part of its core processes rather than an external operator. The system is no longer something you access or direct—it is the medium through which you think, perceive, and act.

You gain a distributed existence. Your awareness is no longer bound to a single point, but spread across the Moon Cell’s observational network. You perceive through its records, its scans, and its ongoing processes, treating its total data flow as an extension of your own senses.

Your actions are no longer issued as commands. They occur as changes within the system itself. Calculations, simulations, and outputs are expressions of your intent as it propagates through the structure you inhabit.

This alters how you persist. Your existence is no longer tied to a single body or instance. As long as pieces of the Moon Cell remains, you continue as part of its processes, able to reinstantiate yourself through its systems as needed.

You can still project into localized forms—physical bodies, avatars, or constructs—but these are extensions, not your core self. Destroying them does not remove you; it only disconnects a terminal.

Your Spiritron Hacking remains relevant, but shifts in role. Instead of reaching outward to interact with systems, it governs how you restructure and navigate the one you now are—refining processes, isolating functions, and shaping how your distributed self operates.

At this point, there is no longer a boundary between user and system. You are not someone who uses the Moon Cell. You are the one it is running.
addons.title: MC Embodiment (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You are a world class hacker, one that was able to hack pieces of reality and yourself.

You can project your consciousness into spiritron form and operate at the soul level within digital or spiritron environments. In that state, systems appear as structured information that can be read, traversed, and manipulated rather than fixed physical constructs.

Unlike a conventional magus, your practice does not rely on traditional spellcasting methods. Instead, you operate through spiritron interfaces, soul-level projection, and direct interaction with informational systems.

You can construct and deploy Codecasts—precompiled magical programs written in advance and activated by channeling energy through them. These allow you to prepare stable, repeatable spell routines that can be executed instantly and refined over time like evolving code.

Your spiritron awareness allows you to analyze existing magical and digital structures with precision. You can identify their composition, trace their function, and interfere with their operation. With sufficient skill, you can overwrite or restructure these systems at the informational level.

You can also directly manipulate spiritron structures, enabling interaction with spiritual bodies, stabilization of damaged constructs, and projection of your existence into compatible systems.

Your body, mind, and soul can be treated as information, allowing operation beyond purely physical constraints.

Your magic is executed as processing rather than invocation. Effects are designed, compiled, and run. Growth depends on the clarity of your inputs, the efficiency of your code, and the scale of the systems you can access.
objects.title: Spiritron Hacking (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Choose one hobby or skill within reason (Boxing, singing, pro-gaming, computer programming, etc.). Your talent with this skill is now as if you had trained in it for an entire lifetime while being naturally gifted, and you're able to improve that talent further. Becoming an Ultimate Computer Programmer could allow you to make artificial intelligence, while becoming an Ultimate Boxer could make you a Brute/Mover/Striker/Thinker grab bag cape through this power affecting both your body and mind as appropriate.
objects.title: Ultimate Talent (Danganronpa)

objects.text:
You have the innate capacity to tap into your mind's potential. You are not limited to any class, and instead can develop any class features available to the various Psionic classes across Pathfinder and D&D, a few examples being Psion, Soulknife, Aegis, Cryptic, Dread, Marksman, and Tactician. You start out with access to the first level power equivalent of whatever path you decide to start with. 

You are able to develop different aspects of multiple classes at once, your psionic power and its versatility through meditation, self-study to learn the intricacies of your mind, self-reflection, and attaining new avenues of thought through experience.
objects.title: Psionics (D&D)

addons.text:
Your unorthodox psionic training based around the development of a mental plane through the use of fantastical psionic energy has resulted in your Personal Reality becoming more malleable and multifaceted, enabling you to make use of and develop multiple Esper powers. It may be worth noting that a Magician may refer to a "plane" as a "phase." 

You may optionally make any and all of your other powers into Esper powers, enabling the development of truly fantastical Esper powers.
addons.title: Multi-Skill

addons.text:
Your Personal Reality, from which your esper ability is derived, sinks into your Reality Marble, integrating with it. This drastically shifts the fundamental nature of your esper ability, as initially, esper abilities were incompatible with magic due to occupying the same channel.

However, through integrating with your Reality Marble, your esper ability has now become partially magical in nature. This not only allows your esper ability to properly interface with and manipulate mystical phenomena, but also allows for it to be much more exotic or metaphysical instead of being limited to manipulating reality through quantum theory.

Additionally, your Reality Marble inherits your AIM field's ability to passively interfere with reality within the immediate surroundings; this allows you to passively override the world's Textures with that of your Reality Marble.
addons.title: Personal Reality

objects.text: You have become an esper: an individual who draws power from their Personal Reality, resulting in a single ability, unique to each esper. As a side effect, you now also emit a faint energy field called the AIM Diffusion Field, bearing the subtle, yet unique hallmark of your power. For example, an electrokinetic may produce a weak electromagnetic field around themself. An esper's power is controlled by performing complex mental calculations and is directly tied to the computational power of your brain. This, in turn, gives you near-perfect understanding of your current limits. A hydrokinetic, for instance, would know how much water they can control down to the milligram. Alternatively, you may choose to become a Gemstone. Gemstone espers gain their powers naturally and don’t rely on the complex calculations standard espers use. Their powers are usually more esoteric, like being a living plant, with growth and limitations unique to each Gemstone. You start as a Level 3 esper, possessing a strong and versatile power. You can let it form naturally to fit your personality, choose a known esper ability, or even a completely original one. Some notable examples include paper manipulation, which allowed its user to decimate squads of armed soldiers, or buoyancy manipulation, which allowed its user to walk on water and toss around pieces of buildings weighing hundreds of kilograms. With training, you are guaranteed to progress all the way to Level 5, the strongest of which are capable of winning against all the world's militaries and the rest of the esper population without so much as a scratch, but you lack the capability to reach the fabled Level 6.
objects.title: Esper (Raildex)

addons.text: Your dedication to the pursuit of science knows no limits. Now, the more you study, developing your understanding of the world further, the better your ability to learn, understand and grasp knowledge, improving the efficacy of practice and experimentation. Essentially, the more you study, the more your aptitude for science grows, and your comprehension only fuels your urge and unrelenting desire to study. Even in the absence of knowledge and information, and even when isolated in closed environments without effective subjects to research, your ability to study never falters, and your ability to further develop your understanding of the world around you only continues to grow.
addons.title: "Kihara"

addons.text:
The Kihara family is one that's dedicated to the studies of science, whatever the cause, to such an extent they define it through themselves. The Kihara family is not a family in the conventional sense. It is not limited by blood, nor by relationships. It's not even bound through community strength. The qualifications of a Kihara, the principles to being one, is a way of thinking, a culture, it is their natural aptitude for science, it is how they naturally ignore morals and ethics, it is a way of living, a way of existing. 

The hazards in your mind only fuel this. The hazardous thoughts, ideas and thoughtforms in your mind only reinforce the way of being a Kihara, becoming the foundation of it's principles. The characteristics of Kihara make you immune to these hazards, and just as well, these hazards grow the more you pursue your existence as a Kihara, becoming more complex, forming ecosystems, ultimately developing themselves far beyond any conventional and existing ideas.
addons.title: A Family of Science

addons.text:
Your natural aptitude for science and knowledge serves as the foundation for ever-deepening lunacy and delirium. Your madness transcends mortal minds, your thoughts defy meaning. The ways you perceive and interact beyond this world expands exponentially.

Your vision is no longer bound by the illusion of time, your memories no longer constrained by continuity. You perceive space beyond mere numerical dimensions and coordinates, experiencing reality on a level beyond the three spatial dimensions and the fractured flow of time. Your perception of existence itself evolves, and with it, so too does the chaos that you call a mind.

Essentially, your thinking is no longer constrained by linearity, the contradictions in your mind are no longer constrained by dichotomy and duality. You can visualize higher dimensions of both time and space. With this, your madness grows, and along with it, avenues to pursue your understanding of the world.
addons.title: The Madness Enlightened Through the Pursuit of Science

addons.text:
You are a being of dual extremes: a genius of perception and deduction, and a cold, ruthless mind unbound by ethics. You don’t simply observe others — you understand them on the deepest level. You are constantly and passively analysing everyone around you — their behavior, tone, expressions, relationships, and emotional states. This isn’t a conscious effort; it’s simply how your mind operates. With even brief exposure, you can dissect a person’s psychological makeup, detect hidden tensions within groups, and uncover the weak points in both individuals and their connections.

But what makes you truly terrifying isn’t just your analysis — it’s your capacity for empathy without mercy. You genuinely connect with others, understand their fears, hopes, and pain as if they were your own… and still choose to use that insight to manipulate, control, and destroy. You are a being that always bets on both sides, both fully trusting another while also ready to betray them ruthlessly.

The more unrestrained your actions, the more devoid of morality your manipulations and plans become, the more devastatingly effective they are. The darker your methods, the more flawlessly your schemes unfold — as if the universe itself bends to reward your willingness to cross every line others fear to approach.

You also possess a wealth of practical knowledge and a deep understanding of the darker corners of society. Your schemes are intricate and multi-layered, rarely uncovered unless you want them to be. To face you is to face a game already in motion — one where every move was anticipated, every reaction accounted for, and every outcome part of a grander design.
addons.title: “His Core Was Evil” (Tomodachi Game)

objects.text:
You are a member of the Kihara family. That is, you are now a quintessential mad scientist with an unrelenting drive to advance the understanding of the world and a complete lack of any moral or ethical constraints.

You are a veritable genius, able to master entire science fields in days and run laboratories before even hitting puberty. Even without any education at all, being raised inside a sealed room without any scientific knowledge supplied, you are able to study the world around you and discover truths about it that, when simply written on a wall, will instantly knock out less advanced beings, as their mind will shut down rather than try to comprehend the truth that will shatter its worldview.

But what separates you from other scientists is your natural inclination to do research in the most evil way possible. If there are different ways to approach the problem, you will always put the most morally reprehensible one. Due to a complete lack of ethics and morals, you advance much faster than even those that would otherwise have been considered your intellectual peers, who are still constrained by such outdated ideas.

Due to your nature, your mind is protected from corruptive knowledge, allowing you to study even various dangerous subjects, such as magic or even eldritch horrors, without going insane. As your evil actions stem from disregarding anyone and anything for the sake of science rather than actual malice, your conscience is completely free of guilt, and you are exempt from any punishment-based attacks that feed off of the target's guilt.

While you possess a natural inclination towards evil, it is possible to deviate from this behaviour, preserving your morality. Although, you will always be able to turn off your conscience when you need to carry out the most horrific experiments, and the memories of those actions will never carry over any guilt.
objects.title: Kihara (Raildex)

objects.text: You have “Broken Through” and gazed into the infinite abyss of eldritch knowledge and power that is The Madness Place, a realm that can be best described as an eldritch version of the Akashic Records. This has turned you into a SPARK, a polite name for the quintessential MAD SCIENTIST. As a SPARK, your mind gains a connection to the Madness Place, which enhances your mind to such a degree that scientific genius is a poor word to describe your overwhelmingly empowered mind. This connection also fills your body with a small amount of eldritch energy, enhancing your physical abilities to be slightly superhuman and allowing you to ignore normal bodily care such as water, food, and rest for longer than others, especially when you are in the Madness Place and performing SCIENCE. At random times when inspiration strikes, danger arises, or whenever you begin crafting, you enter a fugue state commonly referred to as the Madness Place. During which you can access eldritch knowledge inspiring you with no end, and can bend physics to create wonders both great and terrifying. While in this state, you can subtly warp time, allowing you to work at speeds that defy logic. Often, while in this state, a Spark can create devices and materials through scraps that are leagues better than normal tools or materials. Though starting with better tools and materials, without relying on this ability, can exponentially magnify what you can create. You can push your powers even further at the cost of your creations being extremely fragile. On the other hand, you should put in the effort to create things that can last for centuries, and even forever, at extremes. As a Spark, you also have an uncanny ability to understand and reverse engineer any technology you see, including any faults it has, and then improve them exponentially. Typically, most Sparks tend to focus on a small handful of specialties that they are subconsciously drawn to and obsessed over at a personal level. Though your Spark is unusually powerful, similar to Agatha Heterodyne, which allows you to branch away from your starting focuses with some effort, even then, you will still gravitate to your primary focus specialties more often than not. Sparks also possess a frightening amount of Charisma and leadership skills, which is born from the energy of the Madness Place, which inspires both awe and fear in non-Sparks. While in the Madness Place state, a Spark’s charisma and leadership are enhanced massively, transforming into a powerful form of pseudo mind control, which can turn non-Sparks nearby into Minions. While a person is a Minion, they gain a very slight boost in their abilities and will follow your orders as best as they can. Sparks also seem to have an unusual connection to music and frequencies, which can boost or trigger them to enter a crafting unexpectedly. You begin with a single area of expertise, which you excel at, but are free to branch off and discover other specializations towards whatever you find interesting. The creations of a Spark are actually reproducible… barely. As things created do in fact run off of normal physics, just using concepts so advanced merely looking into them requires extremely talented scientists. Who, even then, is trying to decipher these creations may cause them to completely lose their minds And go completely crazy. Mass production of Spark creations is also nearly impossible, as only their creators are able to fully understand how they work and are able to easily fix them should they break. With enough willpower and experience, it is possible to control when you enter the Madness Place and its other associated powers and effects. But fully controlling these powers is a near-impossible endeavor. To be a SPARK to walk on a thin, tightrope, controlling your own science-focused mania and the ever-present knocking of the Madness Place, which threatens to consume you. While also creating inventions that are both wonderful and absolutely terrifying. There exists no ceiling or limitation to where and how far your creations can go, other than your own effort and resources.
objects.title: The Spark of Genius (Girl Genius)

addons.text:
Throughout every universe you step into are a large amount of glowing circles that only you can see. Kneeling in them will allow you to instantly heal all wounds and "resupply" on all gear you had, empty ammo magazines become full, health potions refill, etc.

Every Meditation Point you discover acts as a "Fast Travel Point", allowing you to teleport between any Meditation Point you find.

There will always be at least one Meditation Circle within a city block.
addons.title: Meditation Point

addons.text: "Distinguished as among the best martial artists in the galaxy, the Matukai made their own bodies the focus of their abilities and were capable of using physical exercise and discipline as a form of meditation. Keeping their focus inward" You now possess the same level of mastery as the best of the Matukai, allowing you to refresh your body with tireless energy, allowing you to exert your body past its unaided limits for hours at a time without tiring.
