You possess inward mastery and self-awareness of your body, making you able to discern wounds, injuries, and sickness with ease and allowing you to purge your body from illness and poison and become immune to them altogether. You can raise and lower your body temperature to survive in hot or cold environments, or even cause your skin to become so hot as to burn anything you touch. You are able to give normally soft parts of your body unnatural rigidity to help drastically reduce physical damage. And finally, through your knowledge of Matukai training, you can strengthen your connection with the force. This also works for anyone you decide to teach, even if their connection to the Force doesn't make them considered strong enough to be a wielder of the Force.
addons.title: Matukai

addons.text: Your ability to harness life energy has granted you an unparalleled connection to the Living Force, the part of the Force which exists within and binds together all living things. While the benefits of a connection on this level are myriad, such as influencing the biology of yourself or others, you specifically have two unique abilities available to you. Firstly, you are uniquely gifted when it comes to replicating natural phenomena, able to use the Force to call upon the patterns of the natural world. With this talent, you can conjure storms and channel fire and lightning without having to resort to the corruptive influence of the Dark Side. Most impressive, however, is your ability to both passively and actively draw power from the life around you, drawing upon the ambient Force energy which exists in nature to heal yourself and increase your power. While this normally serves as a passive boost depending on the level of nature around you, you can choose to intentionally and actively draw upon the life essence and Force of your surroundings, so be wary not to draw too much and leave your surroundings barren of life and energy. The range from which you can draw power depends on your own strength and connection to nature, so while a novice may be able to draw from their immediate surroundings, a master could draw from entire planets or even star systems. Should you possess Aspiring Sage then your starting point and connection to nature are vastly increased, allowing you to draw from entire continents at minimum. This does have its own darker applications, with you being able to forcibly rip away the essence and Force of living beings and take it for yourself, leaving them a weakened husk if they even manage to live. With enough power and experience, you could even do as Sith Emperor Tenebrae did and rip the life and Force from a planet, absorbing the combined energy of every living being on it. While Tenebrae required a complex ritual and thousands of Sith slaved to his will; with time, you will be able to pull such a feat off on your own with next to no preparation, although reaching that level will take centuries at minimum.
addons.title: The Living Force

addons.text:
Your Nichirin blade has been upgraded using an ancient method employed by the Jed’aii before the creation of lightsabers. This method required the wielder to hand-forge their blade out of near-indestructible Madog steel while infusing it with The Force, before being structurally fused with a Kyber crystal. Unlike the traditional version, your blade is forged using a unique blend of Nichirin and Madog steel, granting it the best properties of both.

This method has resulted in your blade being supernaturally sharp, nigh-indestructible, highly resistant to energy, highly effective against “dark” beings, and capable of cutting through the intangible. Due to the blade’s unique and extremely intensive forging process, you are deeply connected to it through The Force, far more so than even a Jedi is with their first self-crafted lightsaber after years of use.

Additionally, your Total Concentration Breathing Style has been enhanced to better attune you to The Force while in use, resulting in your body and mind being further enhanced. The more skilled you are at your breathing style the more it attunes you to The Force. Optionally, your breathing style may also be fused with a lightsaber combat form of your choice. If you have a Demon Slayer Mark using it is far less dangerous and provides a even stronger boost.
addons.title: Breathing Style: Dance of the Force
Force Bond (Star Wars)
addons.text:
Much like the exile Meetra Surik, you form Force Bonds to others extremely easily and with no visible limit.

A Force Bond is a form of connection that’s usually indicative of a deep connection between force-sensitive individuals. Force Bonds connect two individuals, allowing them to communicate regardless of distance through a telepathic bond, sharing skills and knowledge.

Further a Force Bond links its participants enough that they can leech on the other’s connection to The Force, in essence adding their partner’s natural ability to their own, to such an extent that even after Meetra Surik cut herself off from the force, she was still able to use intensive force powers by drawing directly from the Force Bonds rather than her own ability.

objects.text:
Your Midichlorian count matches that of Anakin Skywalker, the legendary Jedi Knight. This extraordinary connection to the Force bestows upon you the immense capabilities to wield its powers on a scale reminiscent of the most powerful force users in Legends.

With the Force coursing through your being, you possess the potential to tap into both the Light and Dark Side. You can channel the Force to manipulate the physical world around you, exerting control over objects and individuals with your mere thoughts. Whether it be levitating objects, influencing the minds of others, or projecting powerful bursts of energy, your abilities are vast and versatile.

Furthermore, the Force enhances your physical attributes, granting you superhuman speed, agility, and reflexes. You become a formidable combatant, an undisputed master of every lightsaber style. Your heightened senses allow you to perceive the world in ways others cannot, granting you extraordinary situational awareness.

As you deepen your understanding and practice of the Force, you can develop additional Force powers tailored to your unique journey. These might include Force Healing, enhancing your own physical attributes, or even glimpsing into the future through limited precognition.
objects.title: The Force (Star Wars)

addons.text: You have gained the knowledge and mastery of perhaps the most famous wielder of Shatterpoint—Jedi Master Mace Windu. His nearly unparalleled skill is now yours, granting you complete command of the Force, full mastery of Vaapad, and an near unbreakable will.
addons.title: The Champion of the Jedi Order

addons.text:
You have unlocked the hidden potential within Shatterpoint, allowing you to use its insight to heal rather than destroy. You can now perceive the lesser fractures in both objects and living beings—not just weaknesses, but areas in need of repair or restoration.

With precise focus, you can mend broken bodies, objects, and even shattered concepts, repairing them at their core. The same knowledge that lets you break things now allows you to rebuild them, restoring balance where there was once harm or decay.
addons.title: Mending The Shattered

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to perceive the fault lines in reality itself. With a mere glance, you can see the hidden cracks within objects, people, events, and even abstract concepts—revealing the precise action needed to break them.

You can detect weaknesses in structures, weapons, and living beings, enabling you to strike with devastating precision and shatter them at their core. But your vision extends beyond the physical. You can perceive pivotal moments in time — turning points where a single action or decision could reshape history. A well-placed strike, word, or decision at the right moment can bypass even the strongest defenses, unravel powerful forces, or alter the destiny of individuals and nations alike.

But your reach also extends to the psychological, giving you deep psychological insight into hidden doubts, buried trauma, and the internal conflicts of a person. With this knowledge, you can destroy others in ways they themselves may not understand. 

However, shatterpoints are neither obvious nor static; they shift unpredictably with circumstances, and acting without foresight can lead to unintended consequences. This ability also does not grant the power to strike the killing blow, only the immediate foresight needed to destroy whatever is in front of you.
objects.title: Shatterpoint (Star Wars)

addons.text:
You no longer simply facilitate coordination; you can now dominate the minds of your allies entirely, forcing them to act not as a simple unified whole, but as an extension of your own will, always acting in total accordance with your desires.

At the same time, detrimental mental effects battle meditation has on your enemies increase exponentially. While you cannot instantly dominate the minds of those opposed to you, even the most battle-hardened veterans and the most strong-willed soldiers will feel like green recruits when facing your army. And should they falter and run, or surrender to you, they too can be joined in the ranks of your ever-increasing force.
addons.title: Sith Meditation

addons.text:
Battle Meditation evolves one step further, becoming a true melding of consciousness. Those united by your battle meditation now act like a single unified mind, all the while retaining their personalities and sense of self. The ideas and feelings are shared freely between the members of the union, and even the mental strain—be it from power usage or intellectual pursuits—can be redistributed.

As a consequence, you can maintain battle meditation almost indefinitely and without much effort for as long as there are enough people connected to you in a mind meld to share this burden with.
addons.title: Mind Meld

addons.text:
You are no longer the novice in the art of battle meditation; you are now an undisputed master, combining the skills and knowledge from all the users of this ability, such as Bastila Shan, Nomi Sunrider, Nial Declann, and Darth Caedus, to name a few.

With your newfound skill and power, you can now direct armies of people across the galaxy and even beyond it. Your battlefield awareness expands to the point where you are nearly omniscient within the area of your meditation. You are aware of the minute changes in the battlefields on distant worlds, and those under your command shift and act to counter each and every new development with unparalleled unity and efficiency.
addons.title: Battlemaster

objects.text:
You possess the ability of Battle Meditation, a unique Force practice that allows for coordination of an entire group of people to its maximum effectiveness and even beyond it. Under the influence of your ability, the coordination of those united by it becomes flawless. Although not true telepathy, everyone instinctively understands each other's intent, allowing them to act in the most optimal way, as if an entire army were a single unified being. At the same time, you are aware of the entire battlefield and can—with enough mastery—even directly command your forces.

Beyond simple coordination, however, the very will, psyche, and even physical capabilities of those united by your ability are enhanced. The thoughts of defeat become laughable, and soldiers are able to fight far longer than they normally would. At the same time, the enemies' will and resolve to fight erode the longer they spend within the area of your meditation.

You start as a novice, requiring extensive concentration to expand your influence, and your range is limited by a radius of approximately one light-second. As your mastery grows, however, you will eventually reach a point when you can coordinate armies across an entire galaxy, or even beyond it, without so much as a conscious effort.
objects.title: Battle Meditation (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Upon awakening, most espers possess the natural abilities to utilize psychokinesis, allowing them to manipulate things with their mind. They all have the basic ability to see Spirits, sense others with psychic power and also create a protective barrier around themselves. Almost no esper can perform two actions simultaneously, such as raising a defensive barrier and attacking, however, with enough skill and effort, it is possible to do so.

While simple telekinesis seems to be the default ability many espers are born with, some espers have their own unique abilities. They developed and specialized the way they utilize their powers, meaning most possess applied abilities and techniques unique to themselves (at the cost of only being able to perform said applied ability/technique). However, skilled espers are able to learn, copy and perform a multitude of psychic abilities and techniques
objects.title: Esper (Mob Psycho 100)

objects.text:
You have become an esper endowed with immense potential akin to Tatsumaki. 

Your primary ability is Psychokinesis, an overwhelming telekinetic power that can effortlessly halt projectiles the size of buildings traveling at hypersonic speeds, call down meteors of city-sized proportions from space, lift millions of tons of weight effortlessly, cleave land masses the size of continents, without even going all out, and exhibit minute and refined control over your powers, even on a subatomic level. 

Your esper prowess also grants you formidable durability, manifested as almost impregnable psychic barriers capable of absorbing virtually any form of damage, although their strength diminishes with your endurance. Your abilities also extend to supernatural reaction speed, flight, telepathy, supersonic velocities, superhuman stamina, endurance, and regeneration.
objects.title: Tornado of Terror (One Punch Man)

addons.text:
"Hello, human. We are here to harvest your banana organs."

Your already expanded mind has expanded yet further, learning the psychic, biological, & technical abilities of the Serpoian race. This does not require you to become Serpoian yourself, though you may do so at will (as if your normal biology was a skinsuit or a fusion with another being) if you wish.

Serpoian research has broken down the boundaries between fields we think of as totally unrelated, namely biology, parapsychology, & engineering, as implied earlier. This means their abilities cannot be so neatly separated into clean categories.

They can absorb and modify the abilities of other creatures or technologies by using their cybernetic "probe" (which you are allowed to alter to your taste rather than inherit its phallic appearance and placement), fight their opponents in an extradimensional "Empty Space" to prevent collateral damage or prying eyes in the real world, use significantly more versatile psychic techniques than relative amateur Momo Ayase (including brainwave alteration, direct telekinesis, creating barriers and powerful forces from nothing, the "Serpo-Grammetry" blast, and the "Awesome Zone" method of detainment), and have intelligence and knowledge far beyond that of humans, allowing them to create and alter their advanced technology for whatever purpose they devise.
addons.title: Serpoian (DanDaDan)

objects.text:
Either through spiritual awakening, alien experimentation, or both, you have opened your third eye, allowing you to perceive the world through new faculties, and act on those faculties with your newfound psychic power.

This takes the form of the psychic powers expressed by Momo Ayase, primarily through translucent "hands" that reach out and can manipulate, act on, or alter the world, usually by interacting with the Auras of objects or living beings. This is paired with a psychic "sense" that allows one to see things like spirits and Auras, as well as perceive things purely through psychic means which your human senses alone could not detect, like determining what was happening in a faraway soundproofed room with a closed door.

Examples of this in practice include latching on to a moving train by grabbing on to it with the "hands", tearing an evil spirit out of someone by grabbing their Aura and ripping the spirit's Aura out of them, reading the minds of those you grab the Aura of, whipping around heavy objects (like large trucks) as if they were made of paper maché, disrupting the use of other powers like a form of supernatural ECM jamming, causing simple psychic blasts, creating shields or makeshift cestuses, swinging from the extended hands like Spider-Man, and any other uses your creativity can come up with.

This may be just the beginning of your psychic abilities; it has been said that there is very little impossible to a fully awakened esper, but you will have to discover this for yourself.
objects.title: Psychokinesis (DanDaDan)

addons.text:
You have now achieved the dream of the Chitra Bhanu Psions; you are as much a psychomorph as you are a eximorph. In other words you are a being that can manipulate all five fundamental forces, a noetic being, both Psiad & Nova!

This missing piece of noetic control allows you to completely negate & remove Taint, removing both of the serious drawbacks of being a Nova.
addons.title: Noetic Being

objects.text:
You are a Psiad, a naturally evolved psychic, not artificially limited to one psychic discipline by the Doyen.

You can manipulate the fifth fundamental force, Psi, allowing for a variety of effects (such as those of the Psion disciplines, the crutches that the test-tube psychics known as Psions rely on). This includes Psychokinesis, Vitakinesis, Electrokinesis, Telepathy, Clairsentience, Biokinesis, & Teleportation. Notably, you have yet to grasp the finer points of Quantakinesis...
objects.title: Psiad (Trinity Continuum)

addons.text:
This... shouldn't be possible. Even to the Old Ones or Necrons, you are an anomaly. Your Psyker and Blank abilities now work alongside each other despite the seemingly inherent impossibility of such a thing.

You generate a negative psychic space that disrupts the psychic abilities of others while simultaneously also being able to use your own Pysker powers within it. Note that your ability as a Blank to disrupt psychic powers is completely separate from your power as a Psyker to warp reality.

Your Psyker powers are also independent from the Warp of Warhammer 40k, preventing any issues with Chaos. Instead, your Psyker powers are derived from a personal, completely empty extra-dimensional realm of psychic energy that has been specifically modified to operate alongside your existence as a Blank.
addons.title: Empyrean Enigma

addons.text: The secret methods of the saints and heretics of Known Space have been revealed to you. Now, you are capable of using Theurgy (the art of compelling intercession by divine forces), Phavian Psychic powers (that is to say, the psychic traditions of the Known Worlds), & Symbiot powers (the integration of the biology of a kind of shapeshifting alien fauna into one's body through use of psychic powers). Seeing as these psychic abilities originate from Jumpspace, they share some similarities to Warp powers, but they are not, allowing them to be used with all of the benefits of Warp powers (for example, the psychic enhancers used by Eisenhorn & Gideon Ravenor would work) without the most worrying drawbacks, such as Perils of the Warp.
addons.title: Eskatonic (Fading Suns)

addons.text:
You are now more than just an untrained psyker; you are a sorcerer. Sorcery does not necessarily require psychic abilities, though they act as a force multiplier. With the proper ritual, even a weak psyker could achieve greatness, and an already powerful one could shake the galaxy.

Sorcery relies heavily on symbology and mental state. Things like runes can nudge the flows of empyrean, achieving effects like summoning demons or negating a psyker’s abilities. Memorized formulae can charge up your rituals or hold an effect ready for later use.

Sorcery is almost always connected with the forces of chaos, with demonic pacts and deals providing much of the power for it. Fortunately for you, you are capable of drawing on the winds of magic instead, which, while still containing its own dangers, will always be safer than drawing on the forces of the immaterium.
addons.title: Warp Sorcery

objects.text:
A Psyker is an individual of any intelligent species in the 40k universe who possesses some degree of psychic ability or powers. Like many of the denizens of the grim dark universe, you can draw your power from the extra dimensional realm known as the Warp to enforce your will upon the four- dimensional Materium.

You start as an Epsilon-Class Psyker, the most basic type of Psyker in Warhammer galaxy. With proper training, you would be able to move small objects around using telekinesis, pick apart minds, shoot small blasts of lightning and other feats of minor casting.
objects.title: Epsilon-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You'z been bless'd by Gork 'n Mork wit da power to make yer own boyz fer da WAAAGH!, though ya don't need ta be a "Greenskin" as da humies call us if'n ya don't want to. Da brutal cunning of Gork (or wuz it Mork?) has made ya a proppa Warboss, lettin' ya make Boyz or da other sorts ya see 'round da camp (like da Goblins, da Squigs, da Spiders, 'n so on) from any source a' fungus, an' if'n ya want bigga ones, ya need more fungus. Yer boyz know all wot needs knowin' on a medi-evil world, so ya don't have to worry about deez gits bein' too stupid to raise squigs, tame critters, make iron, or to do wat fings dat shamans do.

Even though yer boyz can run fings wifout ya tellin' 'em how, you'z still got da last word from da WAAAGH!, 'cuz you'z da boss. You'z can control dem like a Hive Mind through da WAAAGH!, even though dey'z can fink for demselves, 'n dey can even get dere own personality 'n suchlike.
addons.title: Wildboyz (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You have tapped into the power of the collective Ork unconscious, you are able to apply effects such as making red objects go faster, and gaining the properties of a tank by chanting: "I'm a tank." You need to truly believe in these effects for them to work.

This optionally comes with Ork mentality and physiology, either or both.
objects.title: WAAAGH! Energy (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Your newfound purity has harmonized with your Blank aura, developing it into a strange but beautiful thing. Like a dark mirror to the power of the Living Saints, your Null aura takes on this purity, making it actively corrosive to the unclean, the sinful and the damned. 

Additionally, instead of passively countering immaterial energies and psychic powers, your Null aura becomes almost predatory. Even without your guidance, it will seek out and rip into any psyker, corruption or malevolent being unfortunate enough to be near, seeking to scour whatever it opposes from existence; woe to any daemon that crosses your path.

Finally, those pure of heart need no longer find your Null aura intolerable; your aura will be a calming and benevolent presence to those who have at least some measure of purity. You can control the magnitude of these new properties as you wish.
addons.title: Nihil Sanctus

addons.text: Your already naturally unsettling Null Aura is merged with your Killing Intent, making you even more disruptive to those who use psychic powers. You may apply your Killing Intent to any within your aura, and it becomes more effective against those who are already weak to your Blank powers, including daemons, psykers and the like. This benefits from any other upgrades to both of these powers.
addons.title: Killing Aura

objects.text: A Blank is a designation given to any human or sophont who possesses the rare mutation known as the "Pariah Gene" as a recessive trait; this mutation makes them generate an aura of negative psychic space that is highly disruptive to psychic powers. A psyker will find it difficult to affect the Blank or anyone in their general vicinity with their powers.
objects.title: Blank (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Thanks to your increased connection to the Immaterium via your psyker powers, you can summon, control and banish warp entities (such as Lesser or Greater Daemons) with astonishing ease by using their True Name in Enuncia. Any entities you summon will be completely loyal to you for the duration of their summoning. Due to your understanding of Enuncia, your risk of suffering from Daemonic possession has been removed although the possibility of other perilous Warp-related side effects remain.

If you have selected a psyker grade above that of a Gamma-Class Psyker, you're now capable of speaking and writing Enuncia that can warp reality equal to that psyker grade without any backlash.
addons.title: Daemonbinder

objects.text:
Enuncia is an ancient, fundamental language of the universe itself, considered the language of creation. Instead of communication, this language can be used as a tool to freely manipulate the very fabric of reality at will in the form of spoken or written words.

Your mind contains a complete mental Lexicon of this language and you have no issues speaking or writing Enuncia although you'll need to practise in order to use it to its fullest extent. This ability requires no psyker powers and has none of the drawbacks relating to psykers and the Warp. While it can technically be used by anyone, Enuncia is extremely esoteric and convoluted; appearing to almost actively resist being learnt, vocalised or even written.

There are dangers, however. By speaking or writing this language, the resulting backlash of warping reality can harm the user; this ranges from damaging their vocal cords to complete annihilation of mind, body and soul depending on the level of reality warping attempted. You're able to speak and write this language without any backlash so long as the degree of reality warping is within the bounds of your existence. You possess an innate sixth sense with regard to your limits.

You start able to speak and write words that can warp reality equal to what a Gamma-Class Psyker is capable of; such as bringing the dead back to life or telekinetically destroying cities. You can even use Enuncia with regard to a being's True Name and possess a strong intuition concerning the True Names of individuals. A being's True Name is its purest encapsulation on a metaphysical level and so knowing it grants you control over them.

Over time, you will adapt and grow so that more and larger changes can be made via this language without backlash; eventually enabling you to match the wonders of the Old Ones and warp reality far beyond what even the most powerful psykers would be capable of.
objects.title: Enuncia (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.title: Inquisitorial Archives
addons.text:
In addition to the collective knowledge of the Imperium’s military forces, you have now unlocked knowledge of the secrets of the Emperor’s holy Inquisition. This includes not only the knowledge, methods and records of the Inquisitors of the three great Ordos Xenos, Malleus, and Hereticus, but also of the lesser secret Ordos such as the Ordo Chronos, Ordo Sepultrum, and Ordo Machinum among others.

You gain records of every sorcery and atrocity that has been wrought by the alien, the daemon, the witch or any other horror of the galaxy, as well as how the inquisition countered and destroyed it. You are protected from being driven to madness by the forbidden information in these archives, and can sequester it away when not needed, so that it does not weigh on your mind. You gain records of forbidden rituals and artifacts that can be used to seal or bind dark entities to your service. You also learn how to root out any mundane or supernatural corruption, infiltration or subversion from a society.

This does not give you the abilities and resources of an Imperial Inquisitor, but it does give you their reference to destroy any type of possible supernatural threat you could encounter.

objects.text:
Now in your mind is Tactica Imperialis, a comprehensive military manual that accumulates 10,000 years of military experience gathered by the Imperium of Man in the grim dark future there is only war.. This work covers the period from the Great Crusade to the latest innovations of the time of Primarch Roboute Guilliman return.

Tactica Imperialis is not a single work, but a collection of various treatises and documents. It presents tactical and strategic doctrines, codes of military law, manuals on recruiting and training recruits, manuals on logistics, the construction of field and permanent fortifications, and the conduct of planetary and interstellar wars. Special attention is paid to the peculiarities of doctrines for genetically modified warriors.

You will learn not only about methods of waging conventional warfare against conventional enemies, but also about ways to combat more terrifying threats. These may include aliens with technologies resembling magic, demons, or creatures from other dimensions. However, some threats will require Astartes or their equivalents to combat them.

This guide will not make you a brilliant commander, and following its provisions to the letter may not lead to success. However, with a competent approach, you will always be able to find useful recommendations, tactical solutions, and strategic techniques for solving any problems. In any case, you will be at the level of a well-educated officer.

After all, you will have access to an almost endless number of memoirs by distinguished military figures and commanders of the Imperium. This will probably be interesting and informative material with elements of horror.

If you have a military threat, the Imperium has probably faced similar situations thousands of times before.
objects.title: Tactica Imperialis (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You are an Alphas, or more specifically a Hyperkinetic Alphas, where the mind's imaging systems and muscle control are perfectly in tune with the motor skills center of the brain. Hyperkinetics possess flawless aim, perfect balance, greatly enhanced motor skills, and perfect synchronization between thought and action.

This means you automatically achieve a state of perfect equilibrium in any position, able to adjust position by instinct, enabling you to balance on virtually any object, no matter how small or narrow, have flawless accuracy and dexterity, and automatically react to and hit any/all targets, no matter how improbable the odds are or fast it is, leading to easily shoot down a bullet aimed at you and hit the target with the exact same bullet without even having to aim at the target, making these alphas flawless marksmen.
objects.title: Hyperkinetic (Alphas)

objects.text:
You are an Alphas, specifically a Hypercognitive Alphas, where your mind-brain connection is perfect, granting you control over every aspect of your brain and what it governs—whether autonomic (involuntary bodily functions), somatic (voluntary bodily functions), or cognitive (problem-solving).

In a hypercognitive alphas, these systems operate in perfect synchronicity and are completely under voluntary control. This grants you unlimited access to the full potential of your brain and body, as all systems receive the necessary energy to function at peak efficiency simultaneously. For instance, you could climb a mountain, read a book, and lower your heart rate simultaneously.

Hypercognitive Alphas possess exceptional intelligence, wisdom, and cleverness. Free from obstacles like exhaustion, distraction, and unreliable memory common in most people, their cognition can continuously grow and develop. While they are not as intelligent as Quantitative Alphas, their mental focus extends beyond technology and mathematics. They also exhibit intuitive aptitude and adaptive muscle memory. Physically, they enjoy enhanced strength, speed, agility, senses, reflexes, dexterity, durability, and potent healing/regenerative abilities in the likes of being capable of perfect cellular detox and regeneration, suspending the aging process, most of which are instinctive and require little to no concentration.
objects.title: Hypercognitive (Alphas)

objects.text: You are an emotional, empathetic fool. You are also a cold, calculating genius. You have received a blessing and a curse. Your boon is great intelligence and great compassion, but the curse of not having them at the same time. As a result, you wake up every morning with a fluctuation of both. You are guaranteed at least one instance of "20 hours of lucid insanity" within one month of receiving your powers, as well as one every year. This allows you to make years-long plans that are functionally precognitive in nature within just 20 hours of work, leaving notes and information behind that can guide your less intelligent selves.
objects.title: Diagram (Cosmere)

addons.text:
Your proclivity for murder has allowed you to weaponize your 108 skills, allowing you to sacrifice a potential asset to deny it to an enemy. Whenever you harm someone you've copied a skill of, they take equivalent damage to the copied skill(s).

If you copied the swordsmanship of a foe and dealt a minor cut to them, their skill in swordplay would imperceptibly atrophy. If you were to copy someone's telekinesis and break their arm, that ability would lose strength by a significant margin. And if you were to kill someone, anything you copied from them would be gone forever, even if they were to revive later.

Naturally, as the sole holder of Menticide, nobody else can cause this sort of damage to the connected skill unless you direct their attack, and you may freely decide whether or not to deal this type of damage with each attack.

This is not without weakness, however. As you damage their Skill, the one you've copied weakens in turn, eventually becoming inaccessible to you upon full destruction. Furthermore, if the foe is not fully killed, their skill may "heal" later on, regenerating at the same sort of rate their body and mind would normally recover from damage.

This does mean that with sufficient injury, an individual without a way to avoid complications may see their skill forever damaged. Nothing stops them from learning the skill again, if such a thing is possible, but they would have to start again at a weaker point, and unlearn the damage you dealt to their foundations.
addons.title: Death of 108 Cuts

addons.text:
Menticide turned your mind into a killing engine—now that engine has evolved. No longer limited to violence, your cognition has been rewritten to systematize sin itself. You possess a supernatural mastery over wrongdoing: every sinful act, from deceit to indulgence to betrayal, becomes a skill you perform with flawless precision. Sin is no longer a temptation or a choice; it’s a discipline you’ve perfected, executed with the same instinctual brilliance that once guided your killing intent.

Your mind recognizes and weaponizes sin the way a virtuoso plays an instrument. You don’t just lie—you lie with a finesse that unravels truth. You don’t just steal—you make theft feel inevitable. Each transgression you commit feels natural, almost effortless, guided by an invisible calculus that ensures maximum impact. You act not from impulse, but from a deep, otherworldly comprehension of sin’s anatomy.

Each sin you perform sharpens your mind further, feeding your operating system and expanding its efficiency. With every transgression, you grow more adept, more intuitive, more impossible to stop. Violence, theft, manipulation—they’re all threads in the same tapestry, and you weave them seamlessly. You are not simply a sinner—you are the embodiment of sin refined, enacted with purpose and perfected through will.
addons.title: Original Sin

objects.text:
The mental framework of your mind has been altered. This enables your mind to gain systematic identification, analysis, and utilization of information essential for efficient and effective killing. Considered an upgraded operating system of the mind, Menticide allows you to tap into a wealth of knowledge specifically tailored to end the lives of others.

With Menticide, you possess an unparalleled sixth sense, an intuitive perception that grants you the ability to decipher the most advantageous methods of terminating a target in any given situation. This heightened awareness transcends mere physical observation, delving into the realm of psychological and strategic analysis. You possess an instinctive understanding of an individual's vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and patterns of behavior, enabling you to exploit them to their utmost advantage.

Furthermore, your proficiency in the art of killing knows no bounds. With Menticide, you possess the supernatural ability to turn any object, no matter how mundane, into a lethal weapon. From everyday items to the most unconventional implements, your mind instinctively comprehends the potential lethality of even the most innocuous objects. This supernatural prowess allows you to adapt to any situation, transforming the environment around you into a deadly arsenal, limited only by your imagination.
objects.title: Menticide (I'm Sorry For Being Born In This World)

addons.text:
To avoid gaining new power and limit yourself to the basics is the core of what Zero is. This philosophy has spread beyond the central training method, imbuing your ability to copy others with a twist to let it maintain the doctrine. You may seal portions of your power within your 108 slots, each one reducing all of your abilities by 1/108th per slot dedicated to this process. At a full 108 slots focused on sealing, you'd be no stronger than the average person. However, there are certain exceptions to this.

First, anything in your arsenal which improves your growth in some way isn't sealed off, allowing you to improve at the same rate you could completely unsealed. Secondly, if your life or autonomy were to be threatened in a way that your unsealed power could save you from, you'd gain the minimum required protection to save you from a fate you can't reverse.

As a technique, this ability's main benefit is to improve training, by moving your progress backwards you can stave off limitations and diminishing returns while still improving yourself. You may unseal yourself at will.
addons.title: Minus

addons.text:
When the philosophy of stripping techniques to their foundation combines with a deep connection to the natural flow of existence, your approach to martial arts and abilities becomes a profound practice of endless refinement. By breaking down techniques and rebuilding them from their core, you align this process with the harmony of the universe, transforming every flaw into an opportunity for transcendence. This fusion elevates your abilities to unparalleled mastery, where unlearning and rediscovery flow seamlessly into a state of infinite growth.

The Dao harmonizes the process of Zero, allowing you to see the natural rhythm and potential of each technique you dismantle. Instead of merely breaking down a skill to rebuild it, you uncover its true essence, removing inefficiencies and aligning it with the infinite wisdom of the Dao. This ensures that the technique does not merely return stronger—it returns perfectly attuned to the natural order, flowing effortlessly with your intent and the universe’s rhythm.

Techniques refined through the Śūnyamārgaḥ Dharmasya not only grow exponentially in power but also achieve a state of intuitive simplicity. Each move becomes an expression of effortless action, or "wu wei," where even the most complex techniques feel natural and inevitable. Strikes flow with the inevitability of water carving through stone, defenses adapt like the wind, and your movements are both deliberate and spontaneous, as if guided by the Dao itself.

Additionally, your perception of flaws in techniques deepens beyond the physical. The Dao enhances your awareness of spiritual and philosophical imperfections within your martial arts, enabling you to refine not just the mechanics but the underlying intent of your techniques. By aligning your training with the Dao’s balance, you eliminate unnecessary force or wasted motion, ensuring that every action you take is purposeful and harmonious.

When you reach oneness with the Dao, the process of refining techniques becomes infinite. The Dao teaches that perfection is not a destination but a continuous journey, and so, every technique you possess evolves without end. Even as you reach new heights, Zero ensures that your skills remain grounded, balanced, and uncorrupted by excess power. The act of unlearning and relearning becomes a meditation in itself, a cycle of destruction and renewal that mirrors the Dao’s eternal flow.
addons.title: Śūnyamārgaḥ Dharmasya - Open Handed Path of Emptiness

addons.text: Now when you use Zero on a technique, it counts as Prestiging that specific technique, increasing growth rate in addition to deepening your understanding. To be clear, this Prestige only applies to the technique being Zeroed, so you won’t be resetting anything else.
addons.title: Prestige Skills

objects.text:
Zero is a philosophy more than a technique but it works as such all the same. The creator of Zero is a martial artist who feared what he would become if he gained more power after seeing how it has corrupted many of the Rankers throughout the Tower. So he focused on the power he already had and honed that to prevent himself from gaining any new power. This philosophy of training massively enhanced his power to a level that left him considered one of the greatest martial artists in the entire Tower. 

Any technique can become a Zero technique by stripping away any experience using it and redefining what that experience means when you start from the foundation of the technique. This stripping away actually weakens the power of a technique at first, but increases the depth of the technique and greatly deepens your understanding of it. When that technique is brought back to the level it was before by training it all over again, it becomes considerably more powerful than before.

This is the wisdom of a master giving you the ability to look at every technique you have, no matter the power, and find any and all faults in it. Normally, it takes the aid of someone else to find flaws in a fighting style but by using Zero you can do this automatically by relearning that technique from the position of a master. All techniques and powers will grow stronger through this technique but how exactly that works is up to you.
objects.title: Zero (Tower of God)

addons.text:
Your Revelation and Faded Whole uses the Thought Cabinet to reinforce its structure whilst your powers embody parts of your psyche as your emotions, ideals, mindset, thoughts, etc., and vice versa.

In turn, the Pale has opened its pallid gates, using its pollution as a compendium for your exploration of powers, the world, and yourself alike to upgrade them: every conversation, battle, and discussion resonant with your psyche namely particular thought or psychological facet, will normally be internalized, promptly reinventing you mentally and physically, additionally improving any power representing said thought or facet giving a wider breadth of power and artistry. 

The Pale has, then, overtly seized upon you: your hair greys out, fog hugs every step of the way, memories long forgotten and yet to come drop by to be never recalled again.
addons.title: Entroponetically Pale: Solus Cogito, Totus Ergo Sum
What Happens In Your Head…
addons.text: Your Thought Cabinet has been broadened to take the role of a bevy of ‘Martians’ akin to The Martian and ‘Despair-0’. While this means each of your ‘skills’ in the Thought Cabinet is vastly more powerful than they were before, having a tangible impact on the world and not just yourself, they’re also driven to act in their nature. Authority’s assertion of dominance might literally reduce people to be ‘lesser’ underneath it, Conceptualisation warps the ‘real’ into the unreal and blurs the line between everything, and Half-light’s capacity to inspire violence, but also to protect the body may extend outwards to turn a town into a paranoid mass absorbing each other to defend themselves. Wrangling them into a cohesive whole would become a massive boon, more so than ever, but more so than ever a threat. Because What Happens In Your Head Also Happens.

objects.text:
Within the depths of your mind, the pervasive influence of the Pale has granted you the extraordinary power known as the Thought Cabinet. Each thought within your consciousness gains a distinct voice, representing a unique worldview, ideology, personality trait, or hobby. As you explore the world and expand your understanding, you unlock the ability to internalize these thoughts, shaping your very essence. Initially, you possess six slots to house these profound ruminations, yet as you delve deeper into the recesses of your mind, more slots become available to you.

The thoughts residing within your Cabinet possess the profound ability to permeate your being, triggering internal transformations that redefine your skills, capabilities, and even alter your perception of the world. With focused intent, you can harness the power of your thoughts, manifesting new skills and abilities as if conjured by sheer willpower. From mastering musical instruments to delving into martial arts, the boundaries of your potential expand with every thought embraced.

Moreover, the Thought Cabinet holds the extraordinary capacity to reshape your physical form, allowing you to cultivate new organs or modify existing ones to align with the thoughts you internalize. For example, by fixating on the concept of consuming magnesium, you can nurture the growth of Magnesium Receptacle Glands, enabling you to derive sustenance from this elemental source. This intricate symbiosis between your thoughts and your corporeal self empowers you to adapt, thrive, and transcend the limitations of conventional existence.
objects.title: Thought Cabinet (Disco Elysium)

objects.text:
You gain a connection to the <U>Sage Force</U>, a cosmic energy field centered around wisdom, knowledge, perception, and mental ability. It is most commonly associated with the Apes of Gorilla City, where it allowed them to evolve beyond the limits of their minds and bodies, creating a highly advanced society for themselves.

Those who connect to the <U>Sage Force</U> are enveloped by the fire of thought itself, appearing to be consumed by it. Upon awakening from the connection, you’ll find yourself restored to full health, with vast power over the mind and body—gaining physiological regeneration and constant mental evolution.

The <U>Sage Force</U> enhances the intellect of its conduits to super-genius levels, uniquely allowing them to create technology that brings their thoughts to life. Users also gain powerful psychic abilities—enough to be among the strongest psychics—such as telepathy, telekinesis, and the ability to call upon the flame of thought itself.
objects.title: Sage Force (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Your evolution reaches your mental prowess, compounding with your already astonishing intelligence. You gained both cognitive traits and intuitive talents from the smartest people in the Marvel Universe, with Amadeus Cho’s ability to process and correlate boggling amounts of information, innate talents in fields of biology, genetics, chemistry, engineering, mathematics, all manner of branches of physics, tactical and strategic acumen, an eclectic proclivity to techno-mystical avenues of knowledge, etc., all to name a few from the likes of the Illuminati, the Intelligencia, among many others. 

It is both a repository of potential knowledge as it is the next step in a human’s road to mental illumination.
addons.title: Marvelous Super-Genius

objects.text:
You have now become the world premiere super-genius, possessing a 12th level intellect equivalent to Lex Luthor and Brainiac. You can seamlessly hold and process 12 simultaneous thoughts, granting you the ability to innovate and advance any fields you take interest in, solving even the most complex problems with ease.

Moreover, your intellect has a compounding effect, as aligning your thoughts on a single subject multiplies your cognitive abilities exponentially. For instance, focusing two of your thoughts on the economy would make you 144 times more effective in devising solutions and crafting economic systems. Concentrating all 12 of your thoughts on a single subject results in a remarkable enhancement, making you more effective by a staggering 12^12 times. This level of concentration would essentially render you nearly omniscient in regards to that subject matter.
objects.title: Luthorism Mindset (DC Comics)

addons.text: With your peculiar ability to alter and project your voice, you can now utilize the hypnotic pitch with your voice any time you wish, even outside of singing. From giving your serious tone some extra power to further intimidate foes, or using it to increase the effectiveness of your attempts to make a lasting first impression.
addons.title: This Booming Voice

addons.text: ...But not you! Lack of options in your closet? None of your clothes make your next scheme really pop? Is it really driving you nuts with how expensive this stuff gets? Well, worry no longer! Along with your uncanny talent in making tunes on the fly, you have inherited Music Meister’s enigmatic ability of suddenly changing into different outfits whenever it suits him. With a dramatic flourish, such as the waving of a mantle or simply throwing away your current outfit off of you in a simple motion, you can change your clothes into something more fitting of the song you may be singing, fitting a certain theme you’re playing to, or simply into a funny getup. From a king’s comfy robes to a fancy tuxedo, a heavy metal getup, a funky DJ with an afro, and the list goes on. This not only changes your clothes, but parts of your actual appearance if it’s needed to make the outfit… well, fit, such as your hair or eyes. Of course, these cosmetic changes will only happen if you allow it. None of these outfits will ever hinder your performance.
addons.title: Fashion Drives Everyone Bats

addons.text: For someone like you, who has not only found a way to control all listening to your voice, but also having been blessed by music itself, now nothing is out of your reach. With your ability to evoke any concept, feeling, idea, etc. as a musical piece, you can now use this as a method to order those you control around without needing to spell it out for them. No matter how simple or complicated it may be, you will always find a way to translate it into a musical masterpiece. The voices of your minions will fit your songs perfectly, to the point where even tone deaf people will have no problems singing along with you or going off key at any point. Furthermore, with your ability to conjure any instruments you require, you can conjure objects that can project your voice further than it could’ve on its own, such as microphones and speakers. With this alone, you could theoretically control an entire city with your voice, provided that you’re in just the right place for everyone to hear you. The sound of any instrument that you conjure also carries the hypnotic pitch, and as such, can act as a substitute for your voice.
addons.title: The World is Mine

objects.text: ”...And so for me, it’s Destiny! To be the Maestro of Villainy! Yes, I’m the Music Meister, and I’m here to settle the score!” You now possess the ability to reach and utilize the very same pitch found by Darius Chapel, also known as the Music Meister, the Maestro of Villainy. This pitch is hypnotic in nature, allowing those who hear it to fall into a trance that will follow your every word (and optionally sing and dance along with you while doing so!). As it is now, you can only use this pitch when singing, not when speaking. This is kept up indefinitely until either one of four things happen: First, is that you manually cut off the connection, which you can do at any time you wish. Secondly, is (in the case that you’re using a medium to increase your range) if the medium you’re using, like a microphone or satellite, is destroyed or disconnected. In this way, anyone who can still hear you normally will still be hypnotized, provided that you are still singing. If not, then they’ll also be knocked out of the trance. Third, is if they’re knocked unconscious. Finally, if those hypnotized by you don’t hear you sing after half an hour since they last heard you, then they will naturally fall out of the trance. You can command your minions by giving out orders in between verses, or singing them out in your songs. Either way, they will follow the spirit of your words, rather than the letter, in the case that the orders are broad or simple. If it’s something more complicated, then they will need you to explain properly. You do not need to sing out every order, but their performance does increase if you do so. To complement this, you also have an uncanny talent for improvising songs on the fly, able to create catchy tunes even in off putting situations, or when you are caught off-guard. Good guys or bad guys, none of that really matters when all become minions to your hypnotic patter.
objects.title: Music Meister (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your ability to read body language now extends to every form, shape, and size. No matter how inhuman your opponent is, you can read them just as well as you could humans previously. You are still crippled by people like the Joker, as gibberish isn’t an actual language.
addons.title: Multilingual

addons.text: You didn’t just receive Cassandra Cain's ability to read body language, but also inherited all of her experience and skill in martial arts, including every single martial art that existed on DC Earth when she was alive.
addons.title: Greatest Martial Artist

addons.text: Your fluency in reading body language has extended to more esoteric and abstract forms such as magic, cursed energy, and life force, provided you are capable of seeing it.
addons.title: Third Eye

addons.text: You can now understand body language gibberish and similar atypical movements, so even the unpredictable and seemingly random movements of your enemies will be within your calculations. You’ll still have to be fast enough to react to them.
addons.title: Erratic Predictions

objects.text:
You gain the ability that made Cassandra Cain the greatest martial artist in the world; her ability, and now yours, to see and understand body language so fluently that you could have entire conversations just by using body language. This manifests as an extremely horrifying talent in anything body-related, from martial arts to stealth to acrobatics and everything in between.

Do note that despite how powerful this is, it does have its weaknesses. For one, this works only on humans; trying to read the body language of something like a Xenomorph would be like trying to speak French if the only language you know is English. You are also crippled if the person you’re fighting is so unpredictable their actions don’t match their body language, this is like trying to understand gibberish. Finally, your ability to understand body language so well allows you to, if you kill someone, see their death as they did, almost like you experienced it alongside them.
objects.title: Black Bat (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You transcend the boundaries of time and space, becoming one of the greatest Oracle the world has ever known. 

Through Parallel Minds, you gain the ability to perceive multiple alternate universes, peering through the eyes of your counterparts in these divergent realities. This extraordinary insight allows you to witness the potential outcomes of any given situation.

Through this, you unlock the secrets of the future, harnessing the knowledge of parallel worlds to predict the unfolding events that lie ahead with uncanny accuracy. You possess an unparalleled understanding of cause and effect, unraveling the complex tapestry of fate and glimpsing the myriad paths that lie before you and those around you.

But your powers do not end there. With a mere thought, you can invoke the enigmatic ability known as Time Leap. As you activate this temporal anomaly, time itself appears to skip forward for everyone except you. The world around you fast-forwards, yet you remain an unwavering observer, unaffected by the flow of time. Others will perceive this leap as a sudden jump forward, oblivious to the moments that slipped away during the time skip.
objects.title: Minerva (The Perfect Run)

objects.text:
You possess a remarkable talent for lucid dreaming. You have the ability to create incredibly vivid dream worlds that closely mirror reality. These immersive landscapes are filled with intriguing beings, some of whom are so lifelike that they feel sentient. As the master of these dreams, you wield god-like control, shaping them according to your desires. Through mental constructs and specialized tools, you can manipulate every aspect of these dream worlds. You can create extraordinary libraries and light bulbs that interact with your memories and even establish a "Memory Lane" where you can vividly relive past experiences. In your dream worlds, you can also forge imaginary friends with their own autonomy, who feel even more real than the inhabitants of your dreams. These companions can serve as guides, companions, or avatars.

Furthermore, you have the ability to bring your dream worlds into your waking life, experiencing them as daydreams and hallucinations. This allows for both amusement and practical use. For example, you can summon an imaginary advisor or overlay hallucinatory visions of your past to reinforce the importance of certain matters. 

The applications of your abilities are vast. However, there's a mysterious aspect to your gift. The dream worlds you create feel larger than your own imagination, as if you are tapping into something greater. At the fringes of your dreams, anomalies occur. Enigmatic figures provide crucial information before you could have known them in reality. Others seem to witness your hallucinations, and spirits of deceased loved ones, even those you didn't know passed away, appear to guide you. Although you lack conscious control over these phenomena and their true nature remains uncertain, they often prove helpful. The guidance of a shadow leading you unerringly to an unknown room in an unfamiliar building without being detected by anyone seems more than mere coincidence.
objects.title: Daydreamer (Omori)

addons.text:
Your Crown Chakra, the Sahasrara or Bai Hui point, has fully opened—an event that few would ever survive without first achieving true enlightenment. Ordinarily, this awakening overwhelms the mortal frame, severing the spirit from the body.

But with the stabilizing power of the Shinjitsugan, your mind and soul remain balanced, allowing you to channel the infinite without collapse. The energies of Heaven and Earth have now converged, coursing through you in harmony, dissolving the illusion of separation between self and universe.

You exist in communion with the cosmos. As the breath of stars, the rhythm of the earth, the pulse of unseen planes—all flow through you. Drawing upon this energy is as effortless as tapping into your own. From this stillness, insight arises naturally. Wisdom does not come from effort, but from attunement.

Your mind, lifted by this state, operates beyond intellect. With a glance, you see through the surface of any technique, understanding its structure, intent, essence, and spiritual imprint. You don't simply replicate what others spend years mastering. You refine it, elevate it, strip away its excess, and sharpen what matters. What would take others a lifetime to perfect, you achieve in moments.

In moments of deep concentration or spiritual resonance, when engaging with truths beyond mortal comprehension—a radiant, flaming violet lotus will bloom above your head.

A physical representation of the crown of Sahasrara itself, a symbol and proof of your divine attunement, revealing your place not merely as a student of the universe—but as one of its conscious extensions.
addons.title: Sahasrara

objects.text:
You possess an extraordinary gift, a remarkable ability to perceive the intricate dance of motion in everything you encounter. With a single glance, you unravel the secrets of movement, effortlessly calculating the impact of gravity, wind, and all other factors on an object or organism. A falling cherry blossom petal reveals its final destination, while a living being unveils its vulnerable points, guiding your hand to strike with lethal precision.

Such a power grants you the ability to achieve the impossible. Armed with a sword crafted from humble bamboo, you slice through flesh as effortlessly as if it were forged from the finest steel. Imagine a scenario where a group of highly-trained shinobi surrounds you, hurling kunai in a synchronized assault. Yet, with an elegant swing, you deflect each projectile flawlessly, harnessing their momentum to send them hurtling back at their unsuspecting masters, targeting their very throats.

But your intuition transcends mere objects; it penetrates the essence of living beings. Their movements are an open book to you, their intentions laid bare. You anticipate their every action, reading their intentions several moments before they even manifest. Picture a colossal monster with vines strong enough to shatter stone, yet you defy its attacks effortlessly. With each step, you gracefully evade its onslaught, closing in on its vulnerable core, until a single swift strike obliterates its existence.

Your abilities are nothing short of mesmerizing, as you embody the harmony between perception and action, transforming the impossible into a tangible reality.
objects.title: The Principle Of All Things (Jigokuraku)

objects.text:
Sing! Dance! You are an Idol now! Your appearance is boosted by 2 levels. If you are already at the top level, then you look divinely attractive. Your singing voice is perfect, you can Dance, and you have a mild hypnotic power that makes people like you! And that’s not all, you gain strength from Parasocial relationships. The more your audience love you, the more power you gain. 

Oh and we are not responsible if you get stalkers and stabbed in the gut.
objects.title: Idol (Oshi no Ko)

objects.text:
Congratulations! Like a certain spoiled princess of a crime syndicate, you've awakened the latent psychic energies within your mind. Your psychic prowess initially begins with the ability to effortlessly read the thoughts of those you near you, telekinetically move objects around you with a thought, and to soar through the skies by enveloping your body with psychic energy. 

However, the true worth of this gift lies within your mindscape—an inner world that exist in your head. By touching a living being, you can copy their consciousness, housing it within this inner realm where you reign as a God. Here, you hold absolute control, capable of probing their memories, imposing mental constraints, or even altering their thoughts to your whim. However, be cautious, as the strong-willed may resist your influence, and while they can't hurt you, their echoes persistently reverberate in your sanctuary.

A further facet of this power emerges as you channel psychic energy through these captive consciousnesses. Through this, you can simulate their abilities, mimicking their skills or powers through using your own psychic energy. A symbiotic exchange, but not without cost—for a trace of their essence colors your being during emulation, a reminder of the borrowed might.

Exercise caution when juggling multiple consciousnesses, for while one or two may barely shift your personality, an assembly of a dozen at one time could etch irreversible changes.
objects.title: Villainess? - No, I'm Totally The Heroine! (Villain Initialization)

objects.text:
You have an innate ability and talent which allows you to memorize and analyze your opponent's moves to form a simulation of them inside your mind, visualizing and battling said opponent until you find a way to defeat them. You can use this ability to predict your enemies' movements via mental simulations, creating and breaking down their thousands of possible attack patterns they might have by analyzing their constitution, gait, breathing and blinking all before the fight even begins. However, this ability isn't perfect, since using it puts a burden on your body and the predictions themselves aren't 100% accurate, especially if your opponent's holding back.

You can further advance this ability to infinite image defense with training which allow you to where you could not only analyze your opponent's movement but also the information present in your surroundings using the vibrations traveling through the air and the ground, allowing you to predict your opponent's movements even further and make your movements comparable to that of a Supreme God.
objects.title: Thousand Image Defense (Record of Ragnarok)

objects.text:
Why would you want this? Even the character this is based on would rather not have his powers.
 
You have been cursed with the gift of psychic powers; you are what psychics are to normal humans. While the normal psychic is limited to only one manifestation of mental abilities, you are more advanced than the average psychic. Similar to Saiki Kusuo, you have a vast array of psychic abilities that grow with you as you gain more abilities the longer that you exist. The might of your psychic powers grows in a similar fashion to Saiki's, growing with no upper limit at a rapid pace.

Your list of powers includes but is not limited to teleportation around the world, so long as you know the location that you have seen before. This would allow you to teleport to a location if you looked at a photograph, astral projection, leaving behind your mortal vessel. Possession into the body of someone else, pulling objects of equal value, transferring them between locations, The ability to duplicate yourself into multiple bodies, but the more you do so, the less the clones start to look similar to yourself and grow weaker with each additional copy, as well as sharing the pain between all versions of yourself; the ability of clairvoyance; cryokinesis; the ability to curse others with misfortune or death; electrokinesis; flight; hydrokinesis; hypnosis; invisibility; memory alteration; mind control on a planetary scale; the ability to turn others into stone by looking them in the eye; precognition; However, this brings debilitating headaches, telepathy, x-ray vision, and more abilities the longer that you continue to use them. With enough time, you could learn to copy the abilities of others through psychic might.

You also gain a pair of limiters that allow you to turn off your powers.
objects.title: Disastrous Life (The Disastrous Life of Saiki K)

objects.text:
You have the ability to erase all memory of your existence the moment someone looks away from you, using post-hypnotic suggestions. This ability applies to all ways a person can be viewed, even a photograph. When a person reestablishes sight upon you, they remember all past interactions with you, until they stop looking at you once again.

You can issue commands to any person looking at you, that will remain after they look away, acting as a post-hypnotic suggestion. This extends to any instruction issued while a subject is looking at you, including a picture of you will cause this effect.

Additionally, you can absorb electricity, even the smallest amount of static electricity from the air into your body, increase the voltage a hundred-fold, and fire it from your hands. These energy discharges are strong enough to obliterate a person instantly.

You are impervious to some types of scanning devices, though particularly esoteric devices, and clever algorithms can overcome this protection.

While any species that looks upon you will forget when they look away, they can still hear you. Additionally, mundane methods, such as tally marks, can be used to note an encounter with you.
objects.title: The Silence (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
Block Transfer Computation is a mathematical technique that enables individuals to create objects and manipulate spacetime through pure mathematics. You have acquired the skill to use Block Transfer Computation both safely and effectively. As a master mathematician, you excel at swiftly determining the equations and formulas required to deploy this powerful process. You can create an entire city filled with strange life forms, make duplicates of yourself, open brief portals through time, and instantly create advanced technologies such as the Eye of Harmony, as long as you have the necessary designs and information.

There are three limitation to this power:
1. A person must recite the equations aloud in their entirety for the effect to take place.
2. This can only be done through a living mind.
3. The greater the complexity and size of an object or change, the more information, equations, and/or individuals are required to accurately process and recite the necessary equations. For example, trying to time travel without a device will require a quorum of 12 people, and trying to stop the heat death of the universe required the effort of an entire planet to constantly use Block Transfer Computation to prevent entropy from destroying the universe.

You can teach individuals how to use Block Transfer Computations. However, their minds must be adept at rapidly processing and solving complex equations and formulas to harness its full potential. Simply reciting a series of formulas and equations will not work. Even then, Timelords has struggled to use Block Transfer Computations effectively or swiftly enough to make it useful.
objects.title: Block Transfer Computation (Doctor Who)

addons.text: By combining your enhanced psionic and mental powers granted from Gift of Mogo, you gain the ability to greatly enhance The Hercules Method far beyond its normal limits. This has the natural side effect of further amplifying the power of Gift of Mogo as your brain can handle greater and greater strain from using psionic powers. This powerful combination will even help you create and discover new ways to use both powers, opening the door to creating new, powerful, unique abilities that would normally not be possible. By combining both, it creates a powerful feedback loop that provides explosive growth, only limited by the amount of work and effort you put into improving yourself.
addons.title: The Psionic Method

objects.text:
Within the next few weeks, you’ll come to realize the existence of a new mental “muscle”, for lack of a better word—one that, when used, allows you to enforce your will upon reality.

Initially, it’ll manifest as a minor form of telekinesis, weak enough so that even holding a baseball aloft for a few seconds will be straining, capable of causing your nose to bleed. However, this power grows at an absurd rate.

Within a few weeks, if practiced regularly, you’ll find yourself capable of moving and crushing cars, holding yourself aloft and flying through the air, to even creating invisible force fields around yourself. Within a month, you’ll find yourself capable of flinging cargo freighters as if they were toys, flying through buildings without harm, creating telekinetic waves of force or shaking entire city blocks. This rate of growth will only increase as time goes by.

The flexibility of your power will grow just as rapidly, from initially doing simple things such as creating simple forcefields, directing lightning, causing things to combust at will, to more esoteric usages such as ridding yourself of an infection by crushing the bacteria in your body, even mending flesh back together by simply thinking it.

As you grow more powerful, you’ll subconsciously start to be aware of all that falls under your purview, acting almost like a clairvoyant sense. This allows you to keep track of and manipulate things even outside the range of your normal senses.

As your raw power grows, so does your skill and precision and vice versa. At first, moving a single item would require your entire attention; as your power grows, you’ll require less and less focus, finding yourself being capable of effortlessly doing things such as stealing just the phones of dozens of onlookers at the same time, turning their cameras on and facing you, while simultaneously flying hundreds of feet in the air, maintaining a powerful forcefield around yourself for protection, all while in a deteriorating mental state and heavily drugged on pain medications.

You’ll soon find yourself capable of keeping up numerous effects without any conscious effort, such as having a camera following you around while also angling for the perfect shot at any time.

While developing the various facets and techniques of your ability, such as flight, is entirely on you, there is nothing this power can’t eventually do, provided you put in the work to develop it. Your power and skill will never degrade due to disuse, unless you wish for some reason.
objects.title: Gift of Mogo (Chronicle)

addons.text: Freed from all restrictions, your Damocles shines. Now above you are all seven swords, working in perfect unison. The seven swords create a feedback loop of energy between each other boosting themselves, whereas before it might have been your peak now, a half-serious blow with one of your more offensive Aura's could shatter a small island. You may grant others a singular copy of Damocles marking them as a King, up to seven people. Regardless, your weissman levels, the measure of energy you draw from the Slate, are now perfectly stable though you can still cause a Damocles Down whenever you want.
addons.title: Rex Tremende Majestatis

objects.text:
You have become an Ex-α, one of the seven individuals given power over the natural world by the Dresden Slate, a King. Each King possesses a different aspect of the Slate's power marked by the immense floating sword, their Damocles, which shines atop them. Your sword emanates a colored sanctum from within it, manifesting as your Aura. By syncing the biological waves of a living being with your own, you may grant them weaker versions of this Aura.

Your Royal Sanctum and, in turn, your Aura may be the everlasting silver's gravity manipulation and absolute immortality, the grand gold's ideal self and astronomical object manifestation, the all-incinerating red's all-destroying flame, the tranquil blue's barrier creation and object repair, the wild green's thunder and physics manipulation, the clouded grey's mist creation and absolute defense, and finally the black's power to cause the most change to the Kings, changing itself each time from prophecy to spatial manipulation to possession, etc.

If you strain your sanctum to much, you risk drawing more power from the Slate than you can handle, causing your Damocles to crumble. Further stress, would cause it to fall from the sky, causing an explosion of pure energy that obliterates everything around it, a Damocles Down. This can be avoided by relaxing your powers from time to time.
objects.title: Colored Kingship (K Project)

addons.text:
In addition to your ability to wield Aura, you now also possess a comprehensive expertise in the alchemical processes used to synthesize and refine Orbs and their accompanying accessories, allowing you to craft additional armaments for yourself and expand the list of abilities at your disposal, as well as further enhance your already existing equipment to gain a greater edge over your enemies.

As an extra bonus, you gain an additional set of Aura-channeling equipment to wield as well as a slight upgrade to all of your owned sets for each requirement power you own, up to a maximum of four extra sets and a moderate power boost.
addons.title: Orb Alchemy

addons.text: Now, in addition to being a link between mystic and psionic forces, your Aura has obtained the ability to bridge the gap between even more types of powers by incorporating aspects of other newly-acquired abilities into itself: With Ki, Nen or Touki, your Aura will now be able to synergize with abilities based on life-force, vitality or stamina; while with Reiryoku, Aura (RWBY) or Atum Manipulation, your Aura will now be able to synergize with abilities based on spiritual energy or soul-power. This also further amplifies the benefits of both upgrades by proxy: With Plasma Infusion, its power boost and increase to your regeneration now also apply to such additional power types, while with Charged Aura, your radius of enhancement can similarly augment such powers in others, and the Aura that can potentially awaken in them will have this new compatibility by default.
addons.title: Expanded Aura

addons.text: Your other spirit within has been deeply attuned to the power and flow of Aura, both yours and in general: In addition to their base capabilities, your Inner Beast can now manifest itself in a form known as a Familiar, a semi-independent spirit formed from your Aura, resembling a much smaller, ‘cuter’ incarnation of your Beast’s default state. While in Familiar form, your Beast only has a tiny fraction of its true power, based on the strength of your Aura and its associated power types, but can be summoned and manifested without any strain, even persisting when when weakened or exhausted. Additionally, your Inner Beast now possesses a secondary ability: On top of their existing role as an advisor and mentor, due to their newfound connection to the mystical and psychic, they can now function as a sort of spirit-guide for any matters involving dream-worlds and mental/astral planes, protecting and guiding you when venturing to such planes or when dealing with beings and phenomena originating from them. This even synergizes with Expanded Aura, allowing them to also act as a guide for more spiritual and/or afterlife-like planes, should you also have the required power(s).
addons.title: Dream Familiar

objects.text:
You now hold Aura, an odd type of magic that also holds properties of psionics, capable of abilities from both power categories, including but not limited to telepathy and telekinesis, temporary constructs, enhancing physical attributes, various elemental effects, and potentially even creating portals. Such effects are achieved through alchemically created foci used to properly channel Aura, most commonly in the form of Orbs used as weapons with various effects, necklaces holding predesigned “spells” that can be cast by charging them, and rings that offer minor benefits when passive trickles of Aura are channeled into them.

While you start out fairly weak, being only around street-tier in terms of raw power and only enough reserves to use your abilities at full strength for a couple hours, there is no limit to your growth; should you fight great enough enemies or train for enough years, you could potentially even hold your own against demigods.
