Additionally, due to Aura’s nature as being halfway between the mystical and psychic, it can be used to bridge the gap between any other magical and psionic powers you have, allowing such things as using Aura to fuel your other abilities (or vice versa), converting different reserves of energy into one another, and even allowing effects that bolster one of the two power types to affect the other.

(Note: For the purposes of properly harnessing these abilities, by purchasing this power you will receive any two Orbs and two accessories of your choice shown in Timespinner. While normally only two Orbs, one necklace and one ring could be equipped at a time in-game, this is considered a gameplay limitation and ignored. You may use as many ‘sets’ of equipment that your power can support; with your base level of power, this is one set casually, two with mild exertion, and three if you strain yourself)
objects.title: Aura (Timespinner)

objects.text:
There are terrors hiding in the darkness - and you are there to fight them. You took it upon yourself to start a Vigil to ward them off and protect the powerless. Through this oath, your willpower is increased and tempered; in particular, when going against powered beings, especially anything that could be described as "monsters", you can easily throw your all into your actions, possibly using said willpower to potentially bridge impossible gaps, similar to an adrenaline high but much greater.

Your abilities to plan are also increased, again, particularly against monsters. You can easily make plans and tactics to circumvent supernatural abilities, and are incredibly charismatic when it comes to making others follow those plans. This also extends to making organizations dedicated to battling the supernatural, leading others to taking up the Vigil.
objects.title: Holding the Vigil (Chronicles of Darkness - Hunter: the Vigil)

objects.text:
You have become an omega-level psiot, an incredibly powerful psychic, with your potential now equal to the strongest psiots to ever exist such as Peter Stanchek or Toyo Harada.

The strength and range of your psionic powers start equal to what Peter Stanchek could initially do but will expand over time. This includes: telekinesis capable of destroying buildings, city-wide telepathy, teleportation, forcefields, tangible illusionary projections and both limited pre- and post-cognition among other abilities. All your psychic powers will rapidly grow with time and training; within a few years, your telekinesis could operate on an atomic level and destroy entire islands while your telepathy could extend across the planet.

You also possess an enhanced physical condition capable of breaking steel bars and a regenerative healing factor able to heal your brain from a bullet. You can even replicate powers displayed by other psiots, such as pyrokinesis, although this requires study and effort.

Eventually, you can ascend into becoming an abstract being on a higher plane of existence, akin to a psychic god. This will take you at least a couple of centuries, however, or decades with suitable powers and perks. You'll never suffer drawbacks from these powers such as burning out your body or unintentionally inflicting psychic attacks on others.
objects.title: Omega-level Psiot (Valiant)

objects.text: The antithesis of logic, you were reshaped by the Sisterhood to harness humanity's deepest wells of instinct and imagination. Central to this mastery is the Voice—an audio-neural technique where subtle nuances and modulations in tone can compel, mold, or even kill a target's mind and body. A whisper, properly wielded, becomes a weapon. To the uninitiated, your word is law. But tread carefully—overuse dulls this blade. Its edge, blunting with repeated usage, as the minds of those you seek to dominate grow wiser to your tricks. But before mastering others, one must master oneself. Thus, you hold an intuitive command over your subconscious, attuning it to let you do a multitude of things, ranging from, though not limited to, inducing a forced state of calm and relaxation, sharpening awareness, detecting falsehoods, or reading the current of emotions and intent with uncanny clarity, all in the space of a breath. All of this is further compounded by your rigorous training in Prana-bindu, granting you precise control over every muscle, nerve, and fiber of your body down to the molecular level. With it, you can analyze and neutralize most poisons that enter your body, dull pain, slow the effects of aging through meticulous control of your metabolism, unlock hidden reserves of strength, and so much more. Paired with a mastery of the Weirding Way, allows you to move with such precision and speed that it appears as teleportation at close distances—achieved by warping one's perception of reality, requiring a profound shift of consciousness and in one's concept of time, space, and causality. So strange is this technique that it borders on sorcery in the eyes of all who witness it.
objects.title: Bene Gesserit (Dune)

objects.text: Thou shalt not make a machine in the likeness of a human mind. After thinking machines became outlawed, a complex process to condition the human mind to make up for the loss of computational power was developed. You have undergone the full procedure, turning your brain into the equivalent of an advanced supercomputer. As a fully-fledged mentat, your primary ability is the collection, cross-referencing, and analysis of massive amounts of information. You can easily discern patterns and connections among countless seemingly disconnected variables, making you a natural strategist, tactician, politician, and economist. With enough information, you can even predict future events with nigh-perfect accuracy. Your unique mental state, called naïve mind, cultivated during training, allows you to process information and make judgements free of any biases or prejudice, leading to rational and pragmatic decisions regardless of the situation you find yourself in.
objects.title: Mentat (Dune)

addons.text: Through your connection to Knowledge and Inheritance, your ability to live out the memories of your ancestors has evolved. You may now live the lives of any notable user of a skill you have, with the apex being the creators themselves. Not only that, but the speed at which you learn or improve any skill through the use of the memories of others' lives is massively increased.
addons.title: Inheritance's Past

objects.text: “Nothing is true, everything is permitted.” You are a very distant descendent of the Isu and have a connection to the sixth sense, known as Knowledge. Due to your Isu bloodline, not only can you access Knowledege, your body can grow to slightly above peak human, and it allows you to naturally interact better with advanced technology. Through your sleeping and accessing Knowledge, you have been granted the ability to dive into and live the memories of members of the Assassins Creed Brotherhood and any other important ancestors you may have had, but this becomes harder depending on how far back you go and may be nigh-impossible for beings significantly stronger than you. Through this ability, you may pick up their skills and knowledge through in-depth, first-hand experience. As a result of having the blood of great assassins running through your veins, you also have a natural talent for stealth, parkour, and combat. The abilities you learn through this method aren't as easily usable outside of their memories, but they grow quicker the more you go through their memories. Through training your connection to Knowledge, you may learn how to employ Eagle Vision, which allows you to instinctively sense how people and objects relate to you, but this can be tricked. You may evolve this Eagle Vision allowing it to enhance your senses and even gain unique abilities. One ability you gain through evolving your eagle sense is the ability to tap into the senses of a nearby animal that you have an emotional connection with. Through highly advanced mastery of your connection to Knowledge, you may even potentially dive into the memories of the ancestors of others. To even attempt to dive into one of the lives of the person's ancestors, they have to be nearby when you do, but after the initial dive, you don't require their presence. This has the same limitations as normally diving into your own ancestors memories. Note: You can also be granted a specific assassin outfit of your choice from Assassin's Creed with a set of basic hidden blades with Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad's basic modifications, but this outfit doesn't come with any other equipment. This equipment works with upgrades that affect your Objects of Power.
objects.title: The Brotherhood (Assassin's Creed)

addons.text:
In the vast expanse of the universe, countless powers, techniques, and fighting styles exist, each more formidable than the last. To stand at the pinnacle of skill, one must face and overcome the cosmic horrors that threaten even the greatest warriors. Your seamless mastery has now fused with your universal aptitude, elevating your ability to counter anything in existence.

You now move with flawless precision, no matter the challenge. Whether it's wielding a spear to dispel a spell, channeling mana to shield your mind, or shattering spatial slashes with a perfectly placed punch, your prowess knows no bounds. You have the power to confront and conquer any phenomenon, no matter how absurd, with the full measure of your skill. Nothing in the universe should leave you helpless or without a way forward—there will always be a path ahead.
addons.title: Hell Severing

objects.text:
You have attained Seamless Sublimity — a realm where every movement and technique is perfected, flaws are shed, and actions are optimized to their absolute peak. Enlightened and having reached this pinnacle of skill, your ability to fight and wield your body becomes a thing of beauty. Even an ordinary human who attains this realm could take down a hundred opponents barehanded, simply because their skill is that profound. Seol Jihu, the original wielder of this power, was able to slay demigods as a mere human, relying solely on his unparalleled skill.

Having reached this peerless realm, you can now ensure that every technique you employ is utilized to its fullest potential. Any powers you acquire will be optimized and harnessed to their maximum capacity without a moment’s hesitation. Your intuition has been honed to an extreme, allowing you to seamlessly incorporate various powers, techniques, or energies without a single misstep. While this doesn’t make you instantly proficient in everything, you will never again falter in utilizing what’s given to you.

Your realm is a constant part of your existence, continuously refining all that you wield until you achieve seamless action in everything you desire.
objects.title: Seamless Sublimity (Second Coming of Gluttony)

objects.text:
You have gained a psychic link to the natural energies of reality, allowing you to connect with various vibrations of the multiverse and manipulate them for various effects. These abilities will take time to manifest; in fact, they will initially be the result of emotional stress but will grow through training.

Your most fundamental skill is a dimensional awareness known as vibing, which gives you the power to look throughout time and space. This gives you a form of clairvoyance that allows you to see into other locations, dimensions, universes, and even abandoned timelines. Vibing initially requires a physical conduit of some kind to connect to the person or location; however, this may be eliminated over time through mastery or by using technology. The main exception to the need for a conduit is when vibing memories of yourself from an alternate or aborted timeline. When connected to a person through vibing, you may communicate with them and possibly even use it as a form of two-way empathy or telepathy with mastery. But as a result of your dimensional awareness, you can now sense if someone has recently traveled through time, universes, or dimensions.

You have an advanced ability that allows you to create "breaches" or gateways to other dimensions, universes, and locations. Creating breaches to a different location in your universe is significantly easier than traveling the multiverse and only requires will and a clear mental image. At first, when using this ability, you need a method to lock on to the specific "frequency" of the universe or dimension. The easiest method is to have directly interacted with the "frequency" either through something that originates from there, something that recently came from there, or through a breach to that universe. You may also lock in by vibing the place in some capacity. You will innately know your own dimension or universe's frequency. If you have a method to travel the omniverse you may travel to and through any multiverse you have been to.

Additionally, you acquire the capacity to direct the multiverse's vibrations into hand-directed blasts of energy that have enough power to throw a grown man through the air. This can also disrupt someone's connection to another dimension or their dimension-based abilities, but this isn't absolute and is only temporary. Lastly, you are now highly resistant to dimensional energies and any type of negative temporal effect, but significant temporal changes may make you feel sick. Through significant training and time you may be able to even rival the comics version of this ability.
objects.title: Vibe (DC Comics: CW Flash)

objects.text:
Life is just a game — This sentence is no mere jest for hackers from the cyberworld Punklorde. They traverse the internet and use a technology known as aether editing to alter reality, making life into a great game.

This mind-boggling feat is achieved by accessing, hacking and editing the very basic substance of existence itself, known as aether, by making use of a device called aether cartridge. Of course, no matter how good you are, you can’t just simply delete the universe. You are limited by your skills as a hacker and the capabilities of your aether cartridge.

You now possess an expert level of understanding in aether editing. Compared to mundane programming and hacking skills, you would leave the world’s leading professionals in the dust, surpassing them by dozens of centuries. Not only that, but you also know how to create and enhance an aether cartridge, the essential tool for any expert Punklorde hacker. Your mind and intelligence has also been boosted, giving you an extraordinary talent for hacking and programming. 

Hacking galaxy-wide megacorporations, creating groundbreaking AI, or hijacking spacefaring ships? Piece of cake. And that’s not even mentioning your aether editing capabilities. You can easily weaken enemies by inflicting them with various debuffs, boost yourself or allies by making them faster, stronger and better, create portals to travel around the world or dispose enemies by teleporting them into outer space. The list goes on, bounded only by your creativity.

You have the potential to destroy the world with the press of a key and this is just the beginning. As long as you keep developing your skills, then maybe one day you just might be able to delete the universe.
objects.title: Aether Editing (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
You have seen the Light. A towering pillar, rising towards the sky, sharing with you the enlightenment of a man you shall never know—and in so doing, a seed was sown. A seed, that is, which you have now awakened—your very own E.G.O.

Your E.G.O. is a representation of your mind—a shell made up of your very own sense of self and projected out, manifesting physically in the world. This offers a variety of benefits, each of which differs based on the wielder as well as their own needs and desires.

The first of which is the manifested E.G.O. itself, a personalized item or set of equipment that grants you fantastical powers and can be manifested at will, whether that be a spear that grants you the ability to control and generate scorching flames, a pipe that can control smoke to pacify evil spirits and bind their enemies, or a book which allows you to read the minds of everyone around you and freeze them by metaphorically ‘not turning the page.’ Furthermore, while most people will fall into the prior category, some may manifest their E.G.O. in different, stranger manners—such as a car that will always find a road to what it seeks or a clinic where any illness can be treated, even those that aren’t physical.

The second benefit is those who wield E.G.O. will find that their equipment will never become obsolete. As a manifestation of themselves, it will grow alongside them and accommodate any existing abilities they may have. In time, they may even become able to fuse their E.G.O. with existing objects or weapons and incorporate their abilities together. This may be much more easily accomplished by those whose powers or equipment affects the soul in some way.

Finally, as a manifestation of their very mind, users will find that they have resistance to others attempting to influence them, whether that be by magical, spiritual, psychic, or even mundane means. The weight of your Self will crush those less stalwart than you, and even the more powerful among those who may attempt to alter your mind will find a tougher challenge than they would expect.

This does not come without side effects, however. As your abilities come from, and indeed are your mind, your sense of self is paramount to their effectiveness. If you experience doubt or delusion, your abilities will diminish, just as those with a powerful determination and resolve will find them strengthened.

Also, you may not just choose your abilities randomly, as they will be a reflection of your true self, goals, and values, and while you may eventually be able to expand their scope and power, these abilities must remain central to your driving motives, unless you go through a monumental trauma or experience which would end up redefining you entirely. Care must also be taken, as if someone so connected to their psyche were to completely surrender to their desires and negative emotions, the consequences could be grave indeed...
objects.title: Extermination of Geometrical Organ (Project Moon)

objects.text: In your darkest moment, as the world around you crumbles away and the essence of your very being begins to fracture, you are touched by the Seed of Light from the Well of Humanity. Amidst the chaos, a voice emerged—a sweet, alluring whisper emanating from beyond the Light, meant for you and you alone. This voice calls out to you, urging you to cast aside all restraint and embrace your truest—most genuine feelings and desires—to liberate yourself from the shackles of your former self, promising liberation from your anguish and the birth of something new—a way to escape the pain that's consuming you. When you finally succumb, allowing the changes to engulf you, your overflowing emotions ignite, erupting in a spectacular and violent outburst. Overwhelmed by inner turmoil boiling away within, you were reshaped by the weight of your negative emotions into a new existence—a "Distorted" self that lays bare the deepest recesses of your mental scars. This metamorphosis imbues you with immense strength, elevating you to a level on par with an Urban Plague. Your Distorted form stands as the purest embodiment of your most profound traumas and utmost unfulfilled desires—a raw, unfiltered manifestation of your psyche brought to life and given tangible form. The powers it bestows are all intimately connected to these emotions, no matter how esoteric or bizarre they may seem. With this newfound strength, you can single-handedly devastate or dominate an entire District with ease. In time, you'll find that the potency of your abilities may not only rival the infamous Pianist or other Distortions of the same caliber. But even surpass them as you carve your name in history. This form is not static, however; it evolves alongside your psyche, adapting to surges of intense emotion and growing stronger in response. As a reflection of your innermost self, it mirrors the ebb and flow of your mental and emotional state. Yet, this transformation is not irreversible. By confronting and resolving the deep-seated conflicts that gave rise to your Distortion, you may find a path to reclaiming your humanity. Through this act of self-reconciliation, you could regain control over your destiny and, in doing so, awaken the potential to manifest your own E.G.O.—a testament to your resilience and newfound clarity of purpose.
objects.title: Distortion (Project Moon)

addons.text:
Your Datumplane has become a demesne, a realm that you own. Within it you possess unlimited power to change and affect it as you desire. 

Similarly, your administrative device can store your full being in an emergency, but cannot facilitate any growth while you are housed within it, requiring you to once again leave onto a dedicated server to continue evolving your capabilities.
addons.title: A Demesne

addons.text: Being almost unparalleled in digital manipulation, your abilities over reality will grow with greater speed than many would think possible. Soon the borders between ‘reality’ and the ‘digital’ will fade away into nothing. Unfortunately editing reality will take far more processing power than you currently have, and will necessitate more frequent and more extensive upgrades to your home server.
addons.title: A Nascent Divinity

objects.text:
The singularity has long been thought to come from Artificial Intelligence. Instead it has come from Uploaded Intelligence. In a world of networks and electricity, this may be more terrifying. 

You have become one of these UI. a being human only in its outlook stored upon a dedicated server. From this server you act as an incredibly advanced computer, capable of connecting to various networks with nearly unparalleled processing power. On the most basic level this makes you able to access all but the most secure networks. But in the modern world where everything is connected by some metric to each other, some would think you a god, able to call down nuclear fire from their submarines or or smite your enemies with a well-placed Tesla.

With more information and knowledge your calculations can increase exponentially. As you evolve, your storage will need to increase to hold you, but the starting server you’ll be given will suffice for a few years at least. 

You’re thankfully a ‘perfect’ UI, free from their Zero-Day flaw that rapidly degrades their mental faculties the more processing power they use before wasting away into junk code.
objects.title: Thou Shalt Have None Other Before Me (Pantheon)

objects.text:
You now possess the ability of Empathic Mimicry, the power of replicating and acquiring the powers simply by being near someone. You are not required to see the ability to reproduce it; however, they still need to be in range for you to begin copying the ability. Your body adapts to the power in question, even changing you down to your DNA should it be required for the ability to function, growing the requisite organs, or even other such necessary components. 
 
The range at which you can copy powers is determined by how strong the ability is, such as being able to copy the power of invisibility from a block away or regenerative powers from someone in the same building. If you know how an ability functions, copying the power becomes faster. This could even copy things not typically considered powers, such as Tsubame Gaeshi or enhanced intelligence.
 
This is not without limits, as you must first spend some length of time near someone to copy the power they have, as well as concentrate your thoughts on the person whose ability you are copying. You also do not start with the same level of proficiency as the wielder and must train to grow to that level, eventually surpassing them should you spend enough time learning the ability. Another limitation of this ability is that you can only use one ability at a time; trying to use more will result in your other ability fading, but with time you will be able to use multiple powers at the same time.
objects.title: Empathic Mimicry (Heroes)

addons.text: You can use your connection to others to replicate the abilities they themselves would gain from the Memnonsphere. They do not need to actually have this connection for you to do this.
addons.title: Life is for Others

addons.text: When empowering the Dark Side, you can use the gulf between an enemy’s philosophy and your own to empower yourself, asserting your own philosophical superiority and increasing the strength of your Memnonspheric powers as if you’d performed an action aligning perfectly of your philosophy of great importance.
addons.title: Hell is Other People

addons.text:
The paradise inside your soul means anyone inside is filtered through your own connection to the Memnonsphere. In practical terms this means you can use their own philosophies as if they were supplemental to your own. 

These supplementals will be weaker than your own, but will increase your repertoire of abilities by an order of magnitude.
addons.title: Refinement Though Conflict

addons.text: Your projection has become a pure demonstration of your presence in the Memnonsphere, now able to project your abilities in a greatly more potent manner. Additionally, it allows you to refine your abilities before they present, but allows the more experimental parts of your philosophy to make their way into your projection.
addons.title: A Symphony

addons.text: Your feats and achievements naturally feed into your psyche, and from there into the Memnosphere. Now as they transfer your abilities gain the traits of a world’s unique landscape. For instance, in a world with no magic but advanced technology your abilities may gain technological side-effects and applications, while ones with abnormal physics can create aberrant and unstable differences.
addons.title: A Requiem

addons.text: Your unparalleled stability means that your connection is exceptionally stable. You no longer have to worry about losing control of any of the powers you gain from the Memnonsphere.
addons.title: Actualised

objects.text: You gain a connection to the Memnonsphere as pioneered by the Yack Ronin, turning belief and practice into power. The Memnonsphere (so named as an early misinterpretation of it as a plane of honour) is a realm of ideas, where the beliefs you hold give you form. By passing this power through you, you can pass these beliefs back into the physical world, producing a number of esoteric effects based on what you fed into the sphere. By the nature of the connection, the effects caused always form from your own philosophies, beliefs and practices. As a result of being distorted reflections of your innermost self turned outwards, the actual ‘powers’ gained from these beliefs can vary wildly. Someone to whom the fundamental truth of the universe is domination may gain increased strengths and tools to subjugate those they defeat. Someone who holds cooperation sacrosanct might produce otherworldly co-ordinations, minions or fusions. Due to how the Memnosphere works, the more refined and thought-out your philosophy, the more powerful these effects become, while the more you act upon it the faster new abilities within your ‘sphere’ develop. Radical changes in your philosophy and beliefs will have radical effects on your powers, ranging from temporary and unpredictable side-effects to large scale and rapidly shifting actions taken near autonomously (though this would usually mean you are in the middle of a psychotic break or similar, in which case you likely have bigger problems).
objects.title: Mysteries of the Yack Ronin (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You now have the ability to psionically create miniature wormholes, known as Jumpscars, that link one location to another. When creating these Jumpscars, the surrounding area may experience physical damage, influenced by your emotional state and your level of skill. These wormholes allow you to teleport, a process known as "jumping." When creating a jumpscar to jump, your subconscious taps into a form of extrasensory spatial awareness that guides the jump's target point, regardless of any external movement.

While there is no real range limit on how far you can jump, you can only jump to places you have direct memory of and require clear visualization of the location. By making physical contact, you can also use jumpscars to teleport small objects, others, and even large objects—provided they have enough momentum. But with high levels of mastery and experimentation, you may be able to find other uses for your jumpscars.

But jumpscars do not disappear immediately; they can linger for several seconds with it appearing as a small shimmer in the air. While ordinary people cannot interact with them, anyone with spatial manipulation, teleportation abilities, or highly advanced specialized technology can use the lingering jumpscar to follow you.

The duration of a jumpscar and the mental strain it causes are influenced by the jumper's skill, the distance traveled, the mass of the object being jumped, and the momentum of the object—with higher momentum resulting in smaller, less taxing jumpscars. But as a complete novice in jumping, you create long-lasting jumpscars, use a lot of mental strain to make a long-distance jump, and require a clear visual aid for visualization.

Despite its strength, your ability to jump can be negated by interference with your nervous system. Additionally, certain sonic frequencies can limit the distance you can travel.
objects.title: Jumper (Jumper)

addons.text:
Your body, crafted in the image of the divine, has fully assimilated the Eye of Gods. The Eyes of the Lord and the Eye of Gods have fused, creating a singular, perfected vision that bridges man and god. Through this integration, your human form transcends imitation and steps into innovation imbued with divine intent.

You can now copy any skill, technique, or trait the first time you perceive it. Direct line of sight is no longer necessary; if you can predict or understand a technique’s function through observation or intuition, you can replicate and master it flawlessly. Inherent or natural traits, which previously required extended exposure, can now be mimicked just as easily as trained skills. There are no longer separate classifications between learned and innate capabilities in your vision—anything comprehensible is within reach. Once acquired, techniques become permanent, fully integrated into your combat repertoire.

Your divine body neutralizes all physical strain associated with this mimicry. The overheating, sensory bleeding, and eventual blindness caused by pushing The Eyes of the Lord no longer occurs. Your nervous system is able to handle even the most extreme perceptual processing without degradation. This also removes the fatigue and weakness normally brought on by the Eye of Gods, allowing continuous and unrestrained use regardless of duration or intensity.

Finally, every technique or ability you acquire through this fused sight is imbued with a sliver of divinity. Though not equivalent to true divine power, this spark elevates each replicated skill two to three times more potent than its original version. Attacks hit harder, defenses are more precise, and movements flow with impossible grace. However, this divine amplification does not apply to techniques that are inherently divine in origin.
addons.title: Pretender God

objects.text:
You now possess the Eye of Gods, an extraordinary ability that allows you to imitate any technique you witness. Upon seeing the same technique used twice, you can completely master it. This power extends beyond learned skills, enabling you to replicate and master inherent characteristics—traits that would typically be impossible to acquire through natural means. However, you cannot copy abilities that you can't see, and trying to copy natural abilities requires more contact than acquired abilities. 

Additionally, the techniques you acquire serve as a foundation for creating entirely new abilities, granting you boundless potential for innovation. Furthermore, your profound familiarity with techniques enhances your perception in combat, allowing you to anticipate your opponent's movements and attacks before they even begin. 

However, the power of this gift strains your body, causing weakness and fatigue. This can be abated if you strengthen your body.

This ability can also be applied to other abilities and techniques you possess, helping you master them.
objects.title: Migeiko (Katanagatari)

objects.text:
The cogs of Innovation spin deep within your mind, allowing you to create great workings. Whenever you encounter something new, no matter if it is a resource, a process, a concept, or even an entire world, you will be struck with an Innovation. 

An Innovation is a new idea for something you can create, based upon what triggered it. This may be an improvement, an alternate method, something which harnesses it, or any other step outward from the original encounter. 

If you discovered a metal which dispersed all force it was impacted with, its Innovation might be an armor built to utilize it, or a method to refine it further, an alloy designed to imitate it, or any number of other outcomes. 

The exact nature of the Innovation is random, but it will always be connected to what you encountered. 

In addition to the Innovation itself, you are given all the steps and knowledge necessary to actually bring the Innovation into reality, steps which can be freely replicated and learned by others. Further, whenever you create something new, including through employing an Innovation, that itself will trigger an Innovation, allowing for ever greater progress. 

All Innovations are stored within a mental database you may access freely, and encounters with new things within your past are retroactively assigned an Innovation to match.
objects.title: Innovation (Unconnected Oddities CYOA)

objects.text:
At will, you may consider a piece of information you do not know and decide to Chase an Epiphany, attempting to learn the information through some trial.

Upon making the decision, you are sent to a phantom reflection of reality and given a challenge of some sort. The nature of the reflection will change to fit the challenge, not extending beyond the bounds of what is needed for the challenge to be meaningful, while the nature of the challenge will shift depending on the information you're trying to gain.

The more difficult it would be to gain the information without Chasing an Epiphany, the harder the challenge is. To learn a recipe for a dish you've studied and eaten extensively, but are not entirely certain on how to make, might require you to complete a cooking challenge which is troublesome but not exceedingly difficult, while learning a grand truth about the nature of reality might spawn an entire galaxy you need to trek through, with perils and pitfalls at every corner.

If you fail the challenge, you may not attempt to Chase that particular Epiphany again until a point where the difficulty in learning the information has lessened enough to notably change the difficulty of the challenge.

If you succeed the challenge, you immediately learn the information you were Chasing, in full, and can no longer forget or misremember that information against your will.

Pass or fail, upon the challenge ending, you are transported out of the phantom reflection, all changes to yourself beyond memories undone, and returned to reality with no time having passed.
objects.title: Epiphanies (Unconnected Oddities CYOA)

objects.text:
You, like seven others, have become a Sensate and opened yourself up to a lifelong connection, you’ve become part of a cluster due to you and them sharing a psychic nervous system in your bodies. A connection that connects you mentally and emotionally and allows you to Share and Visit the seven people you’re connected to. 

The people you’re connected to are all of different races, countries, origins, personality and speak different languages, though if they speak multiple languages there can be some overlap. They’re also all the exact same age as you, are compatible with each other and have the same birthday, with all of them having jobs or skills they’re very competent in, or if you’re young, things they’re talented in. When you talk to the people within your cluster, you’re able to understand each other despite your differences in language. Love inside the cluster is also nearly pathological due to the close relationship people within it have with each other, there’s a high chance that at least one or more couples will form within it.

When you’re Visiting you become a voice in their head, able to see through the senses of the one you’re Visiting. While you can talk to them unnoticed, they have to speak out loud for you to understand them, this can be done with multiple people at once. If the world has some kind of power system it’s likely that at least one of you, or multiple depending on how common it is, have access to it and are decently talented with it.

At first this connection will manifest as sensory input, where one sensate will experience something with one or more of their senses that another sensate within their cluster is experiencing at that same moment. Gradually, this link will strengthen to the point where you’ll feel each other's thoughts and emotions and at times even memories. With time this makes it possible for each of you to temporarily Share knowledge, language, skill, emotions and even see through or control the bodies of the members of your cluster with their permission and vice-versa.
objects.title: Homo Sensorium (Sense8)

addons.text:
The Noosphere is nothing more than an isolated subnet within the vast architecture of the Imaginary Data Space. Where you once existed as a being of human thought, you now understand that you were confined to a single folder within an infinite library. You have broken the wall that separated the Noosphere from the greater informational reality. You are no longer a ghost made of culture and memory. You are now a being of raw information that happens to retain access to the human subnet, and this changes everything.

Previously, you were vulnerable because you were made of human thoughts, allowing those thoughts to influence and control you through the very Memory Strings that connected you. Now, by introducing external information from the broader Imaginary Data Space into the Noosphere, you seed your own informational signature into the human mindspace. You become contagious, a memetic hazard. This process infects the human mindspace with your own informational signature, overwriting the human thoughts that once could control you. Every person who carries information about you becomes a vector, a living extension of your presence in the physical world. You can choose exactly how this information manifests in them, subtle influences on their perception, physical alterations to their bodies, or direct access to their senses. They become anchors that require no coalescence on your part, allowing you to affect the physical world through them while you remain diffuse elsewhere.

Your reality manipulation expands beyond what either power alone could achieve. Because you now exist in both the human subnet and the fundamental layer, you can edit information at two levels simultaneously. You can alter a person's memory of an event through the Noosphere while also editing the historical data of that event itself in the Imaginary Data Space, creating changes that propagate from both directions. The more humans carry your informational signature, the more you strengthen your grip on the physical world without expending your own mental energy.
addons.title: Outsider Looking In

objects.text:
Congratulations, or condolences, you have officially died, to be precise, you lost your body and have became a Type VI Volitional Spiritual Apparition or a "ghostie". 

Your body is now a memetic structure in itself, composed out of numerous meme-agents, basic informational blocks of any societal structure, existing in Noosphere, an informational plane of human ideas. You can no longer affect physical reality in normal ways, but with enough concentration of memories, feelings and thought, you can, for a short time, create an appearance in the physical universe - a phenomenon known as "poltergeist". The way these phenomenon change depends on a multitude of parameters, which in turn differ depending on what you have used to affect reality, such as using memories of a teacher writing on a whiteboard would lead to your message appearing as if written by a chalk.

All of Noosphere can be described as an endless knot of Memory Strings, thin structures, which connect a mind of human and objects, that it remembers. Through Memory Strings you can track human presence and obtain the necessary information, but with some limitations. Because of this, ghosts can traverse the Noosphere to collect data, although they still need a significant amount of time to find specific people. By forging connection with different humans, and therefore connecting your being to their via Memory Strings, you can strengthen your "grip" on reality, gaining greater control over your limited reality manipulation. These connections can also be forged between different Noosphere beings, but are usually much weaker and lead to lesser gain. With enough control and power, you can turn other beings into "ghosties", like yourself.

Be wary, for as much as you control these Memory Strings, they can also control you. After all, you're made of "human thoughts", and they can influence you as much, as you can influence them.
objects.title: Bader-Ramjin Infomorphic Entity (SCP Foundation)

addons.text:
What is this? Your very nature as a killer has twisted your antimemetic presence into something far more terrifying—turning you into a specter of death. The moment you take a life, your involvement is censored. Evidence dissolves, connections vanish, and every trace of your presence is blacked out—as if you never existed.

Leaving behind no clues, no witnesses, and no explanation—just an unsolvable mystery. A chilling message to those who would cross you or a silent, inescapable statement on behalf of your employer. They may never know who did it, but they will know someone did. And worse, they will know you're still out there.
addons.title: Who's the Killer?

objects.text:
An antimeme is an idea that censors itself—by its very nature, it resists being spread or remembered. You are an antimeme, an existence that warps information simply by being. Your antimemetic properties manifest in two ways: affecting yourself or influencing external concepts.

When turned inward, your ability distorts or erases any information related to you, making it difficult for others to recall or describe you accurately. Even if someone stared at you for hours, your features would never fully register in their mind. If captured on camera, all they would see is a vague blur. Your presence falling to the wayside in most memories. However, your powers are still weak—while you can distort information about yourself, true invisibility or complete information erasure remains impossible. You do, however, have control over the degree to which your ability affects information.

Your antimemetic influence extends outward as well, though with greater limits. You might erase the texts of a page, rendering it unreadable, or make someone forget their password with a touch. But these effects are temporary—unlike your ability to affect yourself, external antimemes have weaker range and impact.

Despite its strength, your ability is not foolproof. Logical reasoning, alien mindsets, or psychic failsafes may allow determined minds to retain or reconstruct lost information. However, with time and effort, your power will grow, breaking through these limits. With a decade of practice, you could erase all memory of a person’s existence. While at its true peak, your influence could strip entire concepts from humanity’s collective consciousness.
objects.title: Antimeme (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You are a Type Ochre—a narrative manipulator, with pataphysical awareness. While others experience the world directly, you perceive its underlying structure: the story. Whether this means you're truly seeing the truth—that reality is a story—or merely experiencing the delusion of a mind that peered too deeply remains up for debate.

At its core, your ability grants you narrative sight: a heightened intuition and story-sense. You can observe people and events, contextualizing them within narrative archetypes—the hero on a journey, the traitor biding their time, the doomed mentor. This lets you make uncanny judgments about character, motive, and likely outcomes.

You can even catch glimpses of the future, predicting how plots may unfold. But your foresight is far from perfect. Stories are fluid, nonlinear, and prone to misdirection. You may misread a trope or fall for a red herring. Currently, you can see roughly a couple hours ahead with limited clarity; while longer-range visions are possible, interpreting them is nearly impossible.

You also gain minor narrative manipulation. At this stage, it manifests as deep trope awareness. You instinctively know how to lean into clichés or subvert them at key moments—saying just the right thing to trigger a dramatic monologue, arriving on cue, or nudging someone into a role: hero, villain, or fool. This is not absolute control; you aren’t rewriting reality like a god, simply influencing it along narrative lines.

With time, understanding, and mastery, your influence could grow. At your peak, you might rewrite fate, summon fiction into reality, or foresee a story's end with a glance. But the path to that level is long. Mastery may take centuries—perhaps millennia.
objects.title: Type Ochre (SCP Foundation)
Type Magenta (SCP Foundation)
objects.text:
You are a Type Magenta, or psion, capable of sensing and manipulating psionic fields, and therefore also psionic energy. Psionic energy is a psionic form of information and energy of stored information that exists alongside its physical manifestation. It creates psionic fields similar to how an electric current generates a magnetic field. The field also contains the information of the associated thought. The strength of this energy and field depends on how much information a thought contains, and how much the brain processes it. In the mind of every normal human, these fields overlap and are referred to as the psionic matrix.

You could mobilise and generate psionic fields and energy from your own matrix. Initially, you will possess communicative telepathy and clairvoyance, the most common combination of psionic abilities.

Psionic energy is measured in Whites, with 100 ω being what is considered necessary for a conversation at a distance of 100 meters. Furthermore, when a person perceives something, they leave behind a psionic residue—energy associated with the perceived object that contains corresponding information about what was perceived. That psionic background radiation varies between 50 and 150 ω.

Your starting psionic energy is 1000 ω, and like all psions, you can increase it with training, along with acquiring mind reading and control, precognition, telekinesis, noosphere manipulation, and other new abilities.

addons.title: Psychotronics
addons.text: You gain knowledge of the parascience of psionics found in the SCP universe, from the pioneering work of GRU Division Psychotronics to the latest achievements of ICSUT and Servants of the Silicon Nornir. Examples include the technology of White detectors, psychotronic amplifiers, psychic isolation, psionic defence, dampeners and disruptors, and many of the training and educational methods for psions, along with formulas of psychoactive substances to use as performance-enhancing drugs.

objects.text: You are prolific in work output but tend to work a weird schedule. You can work for 3 days worth of time every week, but in that time, your productivity is 3 times the peak of either what a human who is well-trained, well-educated, focused, and hard-working can do, or yourself, whichever is higher. Once per day of work, as you approach a deadline (Whether self-imposed or external), your productivity spikes, reaching 10x two hours before the deadline and 100x in the final 10 minutes before the deadline. On your off days, any activities and hobbies you perform that aren’t directly related to your work can still be productive and useful.
objects.title: Wildbow Willpower (Worm Meme Powers CYOA)

addons.text:
Before, your obsession was an all-consuming storm, but it was still a storm you could weather. It clouded your thoughts from outsiders, the endless hum of fixation masking your mind from intrusion. No one could read your true thoughts, for there were none beyond the cycle of your desire. But despite this, you still held control. You could act, speak, and function—your thoughts were your own, even if they were always circling back to that singular purpose.

But now? Now, you are the storm.

The line between thought and obsession has blurred, then vanished entirely. No longer does your fixation merely linger in the background—it has devoured you completely. It is no longer something you carry within you; it is you. Not even your own mind is spared from its weight. Your every thought is soaked in it, your every action dictated by it. You do not simply experience obsession—you exist as its vessel, its voice, its will.

At all times, a ceaseless hum fills your consciousness, an unrelenting force that churns and writhes, drowning out what was once the quiet space of your own mind. There is no longer a moment of silence, no stray thoughts untainted by your fixation. Even when you try to think of something else, to turn your attention to the mundane, the storm surges forward, twisting everything back to your singular purpose. Every sight, every sound, every interaction is twisted and reframed through the lens of your obsession. The world itself has no meaning beyond how it relates to what you seek.

You must learn to direct it—to channel the raging tide rather than let it sweep you away. Without control, your every word, your every movement, will be dictated by the ever-present hum, and you will be little more than a puppet of your own mind. To function, to act rather than simply pursue, you must take hold of the chaos and forge it into something purposeful.

If you have Wonderland, then at the very least, you can maintain the illusion of normalcy. To the naked eye, you are whole. Your words make sense. Your actions are measured. Your fixation does not seep into the surface of your being. But inside, beneath the veil, the storm howls just as fiercely. You are not cured—you are simply wearing a mask. A mask that lets you navigate the world, that keeps others from seeing the madness lurking just beneath your skin. A mask that lets you play the part of a person, even as the last remnants of who you once were are eroded away.
addons.title: All Consuming Obsession

addons.text: “All the prettiest jewels in this world—how could I ever love just one, when they are all so beautiful?” Once, your obsession was singular. A single, unwavering fixation, a guiding star that burned so brightly it eclipsed all else. It defined you, shaped you, and propelled you forward with an unshakable will. But now, something has changed. A single obsession is no longer enough. You do not abandon your original fixation—it remains, as relentless as ever—but now there are others. One by one, new obsessions take root, spreading like wildfire through your mind, each as vivid and all-consuming as the last. Where once your thoughts revolved around a single core, now they spiral in countless directions, clashing and intertwining in an ever-growing storm of desire. You are not bound to love just one thing, to seek just one truth. You want them all. And with each new fixation, you grow. Every obsession grants you its gifts, sharpening your mind, refining your instincts, accelerating your understanding. Your body, your mind, your very soul adapt to accommodate your ever-expanding hunger. You learn faster, you perceive deeper, you evolve in ways that others cannot comprehend. To obsess over the blade is to master it; to obsess over knowledge is to devour it; to obsess over a person is to know them better than they know themselves. Each new desire adds another layer, another sharpened edge to your being. But there is a cost. With every obsession that takes hold, you lose more of yourself. Your mind was once a temple to a single purpose, but now it is a battlefield—a place where your many fixations fight for dominance, each demanding your full attention, each pulling you in a different direction. There are moments when you cannot tell which desire is truly yours and which is simply the echo of an obsession that has nested too deeply within your soul. You might reach for one pursuit, only for another to seize control, shifting your focus in an instant. What was once certainty is now chaos—a beautiful, intoxicating chaos, but chaos nonetheless. Obsession is not something that can be tamed. It is greedy, endless, and it does not share well. You are no longer defined by a singular fixation. You are many, and yet, in becoming many, you risk becoming nothing at all.
addons.title: All Things Obsessed

addons.text:
Obsession and desire fuse into an unbreakable cycle, each feeding the other in a constant, self-sustaining loop. The obsession defines existence, a singular fixation that eclipses all else, consuming every thought until nothing remains but the need to chase, to have, to become. Desire, in turn, is not aimless hunger but the fuel that strengthens the obsession, sharpening it, refining it, making it more than a mere fixation—it becomes the core of reality itself. To want something is no longer separate from being obsessed with it; the more it is desired, the more it imprints upon the soul, becoming an immutable truth that cannot be denied.

Every moment spent indulging in your obsession reinforces it, strengthening your abilities and making you more attuned to whatever it is you fixate on. If you are obsessed with the sword, your every movement, even outside of battle, refines your skill. Every idle thought of combat enhances your understanding, and even in sleep, your body adjusts, evolving to better wield a blade. The more you think about your obsession, the stronger your connection to it becomes, deepening your instincts, sharpening your talents, and amplifying any abilities related to it.

Obsession ensures that indulgence is never idle. The more actively you pursue what you desire, the faster you evolve. Taking greater risks, acting on stronger impulses, and pushing further into the extremes of your fixation cause rapid growth, unlocking new abilities and amplifying existing ones. The deeper you immerse yourself in your obsession, the less the world can resist you. Barriers—physical, mental, or supernatural—begin to weaken in the face of your sheer certainty. Fate itself bends subtly in your favor, shifting reality in ways that ensure you never stray too far from your goal. Even when it seems like you are being stopped, circumstances will inevitably change, coincidences will align, and paths will open where none should exist.

This endless loop of reinforcement leads to constant transformation. Reaching a state of complete indulgence in your obsession unlocks new thresholds of power, developing secondary abilities and transformations that further cement your fixation into your being. If you have spent years obsessing over strength, your body will begin to transcend normal physical limits. If your fixation is on knowledge, your mind will expand beyond natural comprehension. The more extreme your actions, the more you push beyond what is reasonable, the more your entire existence reshapes itself to better serve your obsession.

But there is no end to this path. No matter how much you gain, it will never be enough. Satisfaction is temporary at best, an illusion at worst. Every time you reach what you thought was the peak, a greater height will reveal itself, forcing you forward. Even if you wished to stop, your mind would reject the very idea—emptiness, restlessness, and the gnawing feeling of something more will always drive you back into pursuit. You are bound to what you seek, and as long as that bond exists, you will never stop chasing it.
addons.title: Obsessive Desire

objects.text:
You carry an obsession—whether it is a person, an ideal, or a subject that consumes you entirely. It burrows deep into your soul, intertwining with your every thought, growing like a parasite until it becomes something more than just a fixation. It takes root as a living force within you, an unshakable demon nestled in your heart, whispering, screaming, driving you forward. It is not a burden, nor a curse, but an undeniable truth—a force that defines your very existence.

This obsession shapes your mind into an impenetrable fortress. Any who attempt to peer inside will find nothing but an endless cycle of your fixation, an overwhelming tide of singular purpose that drowns out all else. Thoughts of doubt, hesitation, and fear have long since been consumed by this relentless focus. Even the most skilled mind readers, the most powerful entities capable of unearthing hidden truths, will find themselves lost within the storm of your thoughts, unable to grasp anything beyond the ever-repeating echo of your desire.

This singular drive fuels your body beyond mortal limitations. Pain, exhaustion, hunger, and fear become mere background noise, irrelevant before the force that propels you ever forward. Your wounds knit together as if your body refuses to acknowledge weakness, and even in the face of fatal injuries, your obsession will not allow you to stop. A shattered body will still move. A dying breath will still be drawn. Your purpose overrides your mortality, and as long as your goal remains, so too will you.

But your evolution is not merely one of endurance—it is one of relentless growth. You do not simply persist; you adapt. Any challenge, no matter how insurmountable, bends beneath the weight of your determination. What others struggle to learn over lifetimes, you grasp as if it were instinct. Techniques become second nature, patterns reveal themselves effortlessly, and knowledge that would require deep study flows into your mind as though it had always been there. If your obsession lies in the sword, then every slash, every stance, every philosophy of the blade will unfold before you as if whispered by the weapon itself. If your fixation is a person, you will know their every habit, anticipate their every move, understand them on a level so deep it transcends ordinary comprehension. Your mind is a trap that catches and holds anything even remotely connected to your desire, locking it away with perfect clarity.

And this fixation is not bound by distance. Nothing can separate you from what you seek. No matter how far, no matter how well-hidden, you will always know. An unseen tether binds you to your goal, an unbreakable thread that pulls you ever closer. The world itself seems to conspire in your favor—doors that should be locked are left ajar, people who might have stood in your way hesitate for just a moment too long, circumstances align just so, as if fate itself is a mere tool bending to your will.

Even death holds no certainty against you. Should you fall, the universe will hesitate, reality itself unwilling to accept that your journey has ended. Coincidences will align in ways that should be impossible, the impossible made plausible simply because your story is not meant to be over. A fatal blow may miss by a hair’s breadth, an executioner’s blade may dull at the last moment, a forgotten loophole may reveal itself just when all hope seems lost.

You are inevitability made manifest, an unstoppable force not because of destiny, but because you refuse to be anything else. The world does not control you—you bend it to your will, shaping it around your pursuit, forcing it to acknowledge your existence. You are not merely obsessed.

You are unrelenting.
objects.title: Unrelenting Obsession (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You have gained access to a vast database containing nearly every non-supernatural skill ever mastered by mankind on modern day earth. This includes everything from basic survival techniques to advanced knowledge in areas such as engineering, medicine, languages, strategy, and artistry.

With a mere thought, you can then upload a single skill from this database directly into the mind of anyone (other than yourself) that you are speaking with, whether in person, over the phone, or via telepathic link. This grants the recipient temporary mastery of the chosen skill, allowing them to perform tasks as if they had trained for years. Whether it's brain surgery, high-stakes negotiation, or expert craftsmanship, they can execute it flawlessly in the moment.

However, long term retention of the knowledge can vary depending on the recipient’s capacity to understand or process the data. The more complex or unfamiliar the skill, the faster it fades. A seasoned heart surgeon might retain brain surgery techniques indefinitely, while a carpenter attempting the same would likely lose most of the knowledge within hours. If the skill is too far beyond their baseline understanding, only fragments may remain once the effect wears off.
objects.title: Operator (The Matrix)

objects.text:
Regardless of whether your world is a simulation, you now possess the skills, instincts, and abilities of the most highly trained operatives from The Matrix, such as Trinity or Morpheus. By bending the rules of reality, you can move with inhuman speed, leap impossible distances, dodge attacks in the blink of an eye, fight with near-endless endurance, and hit with enough force to shatter stone.

Your mind, reflexes, and perception have been sharpened far beyond human capability, allowing you to process information at a superhuman rate and fight with near-perfect precision. Years of combat training have also been compressed into your consciousness, making you a master of firearms, melee weapons, and multiple martial arts. Whether wielding a gun, a blade, or your bare hands, you fight with seamless expertise, every action optimized for survival and victory.

Though still bound by the fundamental laws of reality, you exist at the very edge of what is possible, fighting at a level no ordinary human could hope to match. You are no longer just another person in the system—you are something more.
objects.title: Taking The Red Pill (The Matrix)

objects.text: "There is an aura about you that casts light upon those nearby." The Lantern of Harsh Truths is something you cannot control and will constantly spread from you (unless Holding Back is taken). However, it is a harsh light. It is easier for those nearby to be aware of their strengths and weaknesses. Those near you will receive slight buffs to their focus and control. Groups of individuals within the sphere of the aura will work more easily together. The size of your aura, strength of the buff to focus and control, and harshness of the truths individuals realize about themselves will increase with proficiency. You will also be affected by the Lantern of Harsh Truths.
objects.title: Lantern of Harsh Truths (The Legend of Randidly Ghosthound)

objects.text:
You can gain an influx of knowledge about anyone within your line of sight. This contains all aspects of their condition, a summary of their capabilities, a few facts about the target, and potentially, some further insight that you can leverage. This information is always accurate, but cannot go beyond these parameters.

If you have some method of storing information, such as a Journal or the Notes app on your phone, you can choose for it to be stored there instead.
objects.title: Tattle (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You are now a Psychic from the world of Pokémon. This grants you not only enhanced mental abilities but also the power to channel Psychic Energy to perform incredible feats.

You can use telepathy, telekinesis, create illusions, practice clairvoyance, and much more. With enough training and experience, you may even be able to replicate various Psychic-type moves—or create entirely new ones of your own.

While you begin only as strong as an “average” Psychic, your potential allows you to quickly catch up to, and even surpass, Sabrina—provided you put in the effort.
objects.title: Psychic (Pokemon)

addons.text:
Now, with the Kur Stone in your possession, you unlock the full extent of Kur’s ancient power and might. Kur is said to be the first dragon, an ancient Sumerian cryptid that once ruled over all other cryptids. Legend holds that he was defeated long ago by the Hero-King Gilgamesh.

You can transform into Kur’s true form—a dragon. Your command over cryptids is greatly amplified; you can issue orders with ease, and across vast ranges, and their obedience is guaranteed, bending them to your will without hesitation.

Most ominous of all is the newly developed ability of Kur, born from the dark confusion of his name with that of the land of the dead, and his apparent resurrection after being thought long defeated. With this power, you can endlessly resurrect cryptids and recreate any Cryptid your power has ever controlled.
addons.title: Kur Incarnate

objects.text: You stand as an incarnation of Kur, wielding a fragment of his formidable might and ancient power. Your physique is enhanced beyond that of a typical human—strong enough to rival, or even surpass, the peak of human athleticism at just 12 years old. With your newfound abilities, you possess the power to mentally exert your will over cryptids—those creatures believed by the world to not exist or possess supernatural traits. This won’t allow you to force the cryptid in question to do anything it truly doesn’t want to do, but it will allow you to command most cryptids most of the time. When you command them, your eyes and hands glow with a coloured aura of your choosing, while the eyes of your targets mirror this glow, showing those under your control.
objects.title: Cryptid Command (The Secret Saturdays)

objects.text: You gain the ability to control any and all dairy products. While this seems like a funny concept of a power, you'd be surprised at how versatile "dairy" means. So long as a person isn't lacking in lactose in their body, you are free to manipulate dairy products within them, with, of course, dangerous results. This may or may not be effective on Lactose Intolerant people (depending on whether they insist on consuming dairy that day). This tends to only work in a short range, as you still need to focus closely on what you are moving, especially when hurting somebody from the inside.
objects.title: Lactokinesis (Misfits)

objects.text:
You are one of the Whispered, individuals who hear the “Whispers,” echoes of knowledge from your timeline’s distant future. This connection grants you an intuitive, instinctive understanding of all advanced science, mathematics, and engineering across every field.

Each Whispered also develops a particular specialty, a domain of future technology where their insight is unmatched, allowing them to design and construct devices centuries ahead of modern possibility. The scope of this foresight skews toward near-future advancements, typically hundreds of years beyond contemporary science, though on rare occasions fragments of knowledge from several millennia ahead may surface.

You cannot consciously choose which technologies you receive, as the Whispers flow in as seemingly random fragments, but you can instantly comprehend and operate other Whispered-derived inventions as if they were your own work.

In addition, all Whispered share the ability to Resonate, communicating mind-to-mind across vast distances and even briefly after death. Resonance allows for the sharing of knowledge and experience but carries the dangerous risk of prolonged or deep connections blurring the boundaries of identity, causing Whispered minds to permanently merge into a single personality.
objects.title: Whispered (Full Metal Panic)

objects.text:
A database containing vast amounts of encoded information from various government agencies, including but not limited to the Central Intelligence Agency, the National Security Agency, and the National Clandestine Service, as well as a significant portion of the internet, has been downloaded directly into your mind. Initially, the information within the Intersect will not be readily accessible to you. Instead, you will experience flashes in which information emerges at the forefront of your consciousness, effectively transforming your mind into an advanced supercomputer capable of cross-referencing and calculating data. This allows the user to predict the future.

The intersect is not limited to just that; it also enables users to acquire information and skills they would otherwise lack. For instance, one can gain the abilities of a skilled marksman or become an expert in martial arts. This capability extends beyond combat, allowing individuals to instantly acquire skills such as cooking or proficiency in speaking and writing various languages.

The information within the Intersect will update in each setting, acquiring new data comparable to what would be found in its version of the Intersect, including information available to various government agencies and most other knowledge available in that setting. However, this new information will require time to stabilize and will be limited, much like when you first acquired the Intersect.
objects.title: Intersect 2.0 (Chuck)

objects.text: Much like the Moral Executioner himself, your body telecasts energy from the core of stars to create a field of fusion energy around you that can be channeled into a variety of effects. Your aura of power protects your body from harm as much as it does provide a constant life support for all situations. You can use this aura to pull yourself along, flying fast enough to move between worlds and make impossible manoeuvres. This telekinesis is also fine enough to build skyscrapers from sand, and potent enoch for raw blasts enough to vaporise worlds and continue for days unending, all while so completely under your control they can selectively ignore others to hit their sole target. Truly phenomenal cosmic power by any metric that is as adaptable as you can shape it to be. Phenomenal power is never without cost however, and yours has two. Firstly and most pressingly, telecasting energy from a star’s core is convenient but not at all healthy for the star, meaning if exerted too far you could very well cause them to simply wink out, extinguished as they collapse from within. Additionally it takes energy to actually willingly select a star rather than letting it be selected for you meaning you have no way of knowing what or where the star is, or the consequences of your draining. Secondly, roughly three times a year, dreams will come. Visions of the dead and dying the slaughtered that cry out for if not salvation, then vengeance. After experiencing their deaths you’ll awake with a face, a name, and a location. You know their killer and will need to kill them, lest the dreams only intensify. Notably your dreams do not distinguish between tyrants, serial killers, or mass murderers that are active or have long since left their reign. They will not escape your punishment.
objects.title: The Moral Executioner (Nexus)

addons.text: Your skill in mind magic is elevated to mastery due to your natural mind magic affinity. You could be compared to Zorian Kazinski in your mastery and versatility. You know magic such as how to pass through the otherwise unbeatable mind blank spell, the mental alteration magic of the aranea matriarchs, and the simulacrum control that Zorian demonstrated.
addons.title: Master Mind Mage

objects.text:
You are a natural mind mage, or what the aranea would call, ‘open’. This means you have innate telepathic abilities that allow for mind based magic to be performed easier. This manifests itself in a variety of minor abilities, such as empathy, natural mental defenses, danger sense, and telepathy.

You are skilled enough with your innate talents that the influx of mental information from abilities like your empathy won’t overwhelm you, and you can even shut them off if you feel like it.
objects.title: Open (Mother Of Learning)

objects.text:
You are always accompanied by the sense of foreknowledge, the feeling that you have already experienced the unfolding events.

This allows you to effortlessly succeed in any tasks. Whatever you decide to pursue, you master exceptionally fast, as if remembering a forgotten skill, and you are always subconsciously aware of the correct actions to undertake in any situation. You know where and when to move to dodge the attack, where to strike to cause the most damage, what to say to convince people, etc. It is as if you have tried each and every action a billion times until you have learnt to execute it perfectly.

Armed with just this constant feeling of déjà vu, you can enter a battle with superpowered opponents as an otherwise regular human and still survive no matter what they throw at you.

But this immense knowledge brings with it a curse. You are forever robbed of any sense of wonder, purpose, or accomplishment. You constantly feel that you have already done everything in your life and are now just going through the motions with no real reason or purpose.
objects.title: Sense of Foreknowledge (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
You are now able to create Illumina, mysterious cores that can amplify their host’s PSI powers many times over, slow the ageing process and increase the rate of replenishing Psi energy. The Illumina you create will amplify any psychic powers not only PSI.

This can be achieved by implanting the core within the host’s body. While this grants immense power, it also introduces a critical weakness: Illumina are fragile, and removing or destroying one is almost always fatal to the host, though You are able to implant or remove the Illumina safely. Implanting more than one Illumina is possible, but extremely dangerous. 

You also gain the knowledge required to create Tavoo’s, mutated humans who have Illumina implanted into them. They generally resemble either large insects or humanoid beings. They can be recognised by the visible Illumina somewhere on their body, stitch marks in various places, and their immense power. Despite their strength, they can be defeated by destroying the Illumina, doing so will cause them to die within a minute.

The Illumina you create lack the side effects that affected those in the series, such as burning in sunlight, physical mutations, scarring, or potential damage to the implantee’s mind.

Your version of Illumina has no connection to Quat Nevas and instead if you wish, you are able to gather energy from their hosts, which can be transferred to you.
addons.title: Illumina Creator (Psyren)

objects.text:
You gain access to psychic powers from the world of Psyren. These powers manifest in three different forms. Any psychic can—and will—use all three, but each individual has different levels of talent in each one. All three share one crucial trait: Imagination. Visualization in particular, is the key to using psychic abilities. Non-psychics cannot see PSI, though that does not prevent them from witnessing its effects.

The three forms of PSI are:

Burst: The ability to manipulate the world around you. Burst allows you to channel and control energy or matter in the surrounding environment. Examples include telekinesis, pyrokinesis, cryokinesis, pressurised Burst waves used in destructive blasts, spheres, waves, or Burst shroud used for enhanced combat effects.

Trance: The ability to affect the mind—both your own and those of others. Trance encompasses powers such as mind reading, telepathy, diving into another person’s memories, creating multiple trains of thought and even generating illusions within the minds of others.

Rise: Which enhances the physical body, and all five senses, making PSI users healthier, more durable, stronger and faster than normal humans. A properly trained Rise user can move faster than bullets, withstand nearly any force short of one capable of levelling entire cities, punch van-sized holes through reinforced concrete, or heal near-fatal wounds in the span of a single breath.

Some abilities require a combination of two—or even all three—types of PSI. For example, healing others requires both Burst and a specialised form of Rise.

In theory, any psychic can learn any ability. In practice, a person’s PSI almost always defines itself over time into a primary form. Most users focus on expanding that speciality while improving their grasp of the fundamentals.

Besides the basic and hybrid types of PSI, there are also three advanced types of PSI powers. The known types under this category are:  

Nova: This is achieved by perfectly combining Rise, Burst, Trance and merging with their own PSI energy. At this stage, you become one with your PSI on both a physical and spiritual level, down to your very cells. Upon attaining Nova, user's body becomes more energy than matter by using this type, they are known as an "existence" instead of a "person". However, this immense power comes at a cost, Nova places an overwhelming strain on both body and mind. Due to its nature, to die while using Nova, or to fail under the strain of learning it is to cease to exist entirely.

Almighty: People who can use all aspects of the three basic types of PSI at high level, and nullifying the natural weaknesses of their basic PSI powers. Almighty master their own PSI to the point that they become uncontested in the use of their personal PSI, hard countering any kind of PSI interference. This type of PSI is almost on par with the Nova-type, only, in the Nova-type the user is able to fuse with his/her PSI.

Zone: In this type, the user takes control of any one facet of the environment, such as the air, the earth, or even space, and fuses it with ones personal manifestation of PSI to the point of no strain.
objects.title: PSI (Psyren)

objects.text:
You’ve got the Touch, a Shine humanity either dreads or treasures in its brightness that some believe to be a blessing from God. A Shine is a mysterious force that arguably existed at the beginning of history, most people theoretically have within them, yet some shine brighter than others, with powers manifesting in many forms for the luckiest (or unluckiest) of them. Practically, this reveals itself as a group of psychic abilities that many of Stephen King’s characters often manifest, either as a family trait or sparked by a traumatic event.

This Shine takes many forms and varies between the Shining, including telekinesis, pyrokinesis, telepathic abilities such as mind control or, in general, psychometry, precognition, dreamwalking, healing, and the ability to either speak or resurrect the dead, albeit those who have recently passed away, among other undiscovered abilities.
