How these abilities function is oddly abstract. For example, Healing works by transferring the person’s “pain” by taking it upon oneself and vice versa, with the result of greater vitality and a longer lifespan for the cured. Your Shine can be strengthened with practice and age, while also being diminished with constant use; it is also proven that trauma also enhances or awakens your Shining—a look at Carrie is more than enough as an example.

The Shining only possesses a talent for one or two powers you can choose that merely emerge at small levels, something one purchase of this offers at the strength of common Shining. An additional purchase puts you on the level of Dick Hallorann, Danny Torrance, or Jake Chambers, with the potential of developing other abilities. Three purchases put your Shine to Carrie White’s strength on whatever abilities you choose. And finally, purchasing this one final time will place your Shine on Abra Stone or Charlie McGee’s level, with the possibility of going further than what they were capable of at the time.
objects.title: The Shine (Stephen King Universe)

objects.text:
The Void, aka the Flame and the Void, is a term for a state of nothingness, a concentration or meditation technique used in combat arts throughout the cultures and Ages of the Wheel of Time universe. While in this state, the mind is completely cleared of fear and emotion, leaving the individual in a hyperaware state of consciousness that allows them to focus exclusively on their desired task.

Swordsmen enter the Void in order to achieve perfection in performing sword forms, archers use the Void to aim without distraction, and magicians can use the void to cast spells without getting distracted.

"The Flame and the Void" refers to the visualisation of a single flame of a candle into which the person could throw all their emotions, fears and obstacles which block them from performing. All concerns, thoughts, even the concerns of life and death - can be learned to be fed into the flame. This allows the user to perceive reality cleared from everything distracting. Sometimes other external focusing device is used.

Another technique is to imagine to become one with their weapon and one with their target or opponent, removing obstacles of rational thoughts and emotions such as the opponent is stronger or more advanced in combat, and such.

But be aware that, being in the state of nothingness numbs the physical senses of the body of the performer. Cold or heat of the surrounding environment, pain of the injury, tiredness of the body, sourness of muscles are only observed from a distance as the subject would be someone else's body. One can simply bleed out, freeze or burn to death and watch their own dying emotionless from the Void.
objects.title: The Void (Wheel Of Time)

objects.text:
Everything in existence, including you, is connected through quantum entanglement. Infinitesimal stimuli can create immense change. You can exploit this connection to change reality with your thoughts. You must focus your thoughts in the right way and visualize, in detail, what you want to happen, and you can make it be so. Anyone is technically capable of it, but most unconsciously restrain themselves out of doubt. The larger and/or more complicated an actuation is the more difficult it is to pull it off, both because there is more interference from preexisting entanglements that you must project your thoughts over and because it will be more complicated to visualize.

The lowest end of the scale, Class One actuations, are barely noticeable things like moving small objects with your mind. Trained actuators can pull off Class Two actuations; for example, fireballs, miniature rain clouds, lightning bolts, gusts of wind, or nonphysical things like erasing memories. Highly gifted and experienced actuators are capable of Class Three actuations which affect entire systems, pulling off feats like creating tornados or hurricanes, or radiating emotions to manipulate crowds of people. There are theoretical higher levels that no one has reached before; Class Four, which could do something on the scale of creating major earthquakes at will, anywhere, and Class Five, the actual scale of which would be unimaginable.

Of course, Classes are a measure of scale, not difficulty; a Class One actuator could pinch a blood vessel in your brain or weaken the molecular bonds of metal in the right places to bring down a skyscraper, so long as they understand how those work. You need some level of understanding of a subject to actuate it, like knowing the molecular formula of water to create it or the inner workings of a lock to pick it.

You will possess a prodigious level of talent, like Ben or Mr. Weathersky, enough to reach Class Two with little trouble and Class Three with some experience. Perhaps you will even be the first to go beyond that level.
objects.title: Actuation (The Quantum League)

objects.text:
You have manifested the same Side Effect as Yuichi Jin, the Foresight. This ability allows you to see into the potential future of any person you look at.

The time frame of the prediction depends on the probability of the event, so you can see several years into a future that has very high chance of coming to pass, but not very far ahead in improbable ones.

You’re able to determinate the probability that each possibility will be actualized and the Side Effect will notify you when one of the possible outcomes you saw becomes more likely than another. The visions become more reliable and detailed the more participants in an event you have looked at.

Potential futures may branch off into additional possibilities or converge towards a single event, which may, in turn, spawn a plethora of other potential futures. You know the likelihood of one course of events occurring over another, but it’s also possible for improbable futures to come spontaneously.

You are unable to see the future of individuals who you never meet personally, however, you gain some insight into the outcome of their actions (like foreseeing someone you know leading you to someone who can help you, but not who the person in question is or what the solution to your problem would be).

Be careful not to lose yourself and become too much absorbed in reading the future and neglect the present.
objects.title: Foresight (World Trigger)

objects.text:
You are now a Septimal Adept—a being who exists on the seventh level of the Lifewave. This grants you access to a unique power known as a Septima, typically centered around manipulating different forms of energy according to your will. The strength of a Septima is closely tied to the user’s emotions, growing more potent as those feelings intensify. In addition, Adepts possess enhanced physiology, enabling them to endure extreme conditions—such as temperatures that would kill an ordinary human within minutes.

You may choose any canon Septima from Azure Striker Gunvolt, or create one of your own. Regardless of your selection, your overall power is comparable to Gunvolt prior to his Primal Dragonization. At that level, he was capable of effortlessly destroying multiple tanks and defeating an Adept powerful enough to annihilate a heavily fortified space station—all without relying on power enhancers like Glaives or Binding Brands.
objects.title: Septimal Adept (Azure Striker Gunvolt)

addons.text:
As two sides of the same multiversal coin, your impossible existence breaks your powers’ safeguards against mental contamination, including the uncontrolled link between your iterations fracturing your mind across the Multiverse and turning you into a multiversal consciousness, where every iteration has gone through every possibility you might have faced or encounter in the past and future. Multiversal Constant ensures you exist throughout the Multiverse, while Shifting Singularity ensures their unique circumstances and factors, for example, you may exist in a world where you are a rock or have sausages for fingers.

As you experience an countless number of skills and gain a theoretically infinite amount of knowledge through provide there exists an iteration who has a given knowledge, you are virtually omniscient when it comes to your personal experience, where you’ll be intimately aware of someone’s deep desires and insecurities, knowing you’ve gained this through alternate realities where you’re deeply intimate or close with them.

In the same scale, you practically travel through the expanse of the Multiverse, where you’re able to find and watch anyone and anything by triangulating the possibilities through the minimal deviations that create alternative realities.

In return, this awareness brings control to the confines of the Universe, reshaping reality by instantly flickering organic and inorganic matter—including probability—with the equivalent component from a parallel universe. With this power, you can shift objects and people into anything else imaginable, as the Multiverse ensures that every possible factor or configuration for any given object or outcome is out there, in the case of turning a person into confetti or turning being shot by gun into a fake injury made of organic ketchup.

Whatever you do with this is a matter of philosophy: Taking the Multiverse’s absurdity as the confirmation of life’s meaninglessness, can develop into creating a multiversal singularity in the shape of a bagel, with those sucked into it erased from existence; taking this absurdity as motivation for life’s beauty and the chance to be kind, makes it easier to tap into other’s best selves throughout the Multiverse, leaving them in a state of bliss and fulfillment by letting them experience this.
addons.title: BAGEL / GOOGLY EYE

objects.text:
You gain the innate power to tap into the skills, knowledge, and experiences of your alternate selves across the Multiverse. Like most of the time in a setting, these alternate selves exist in parallel universes where different life choices or random events have led to entirely different outcomes, creating versions of oneself that might be a chef, a martial artist, a movie star, or anything else imaginable. By “jumping” into these realities, you can temporarily channel the abilities or characteristics of another version of yourself, effectively becoming superhuman in your universe.

Beginning a “verse-jump” is inherently absurd, needing to act or perform a wild, surreal action—giving yourself paper cuts, eating lip balm, or declaring your love to a stranger. This creates a “friction” against your personal reality’s natural flow of events, allowing you to momentarily align with the appropriate alternate self where events unfolded differently. Once you establish a connection, you can download and permanently retain the skills of your counterparts, as long as you keep your connection.
objects.title: Verse-Jumping (Everything, Everywhere, All at Once)

addons.text: In intense enough situations, your unconscious mind creates brief visions of the perfect way to achieve your ideal victory by scanning all elements at play. No matter how stupid, selfish, or impractical, following those visions will enable you to map out every known movement, reaction, and decision you could make, letting you achieve a perfect victory, as long as your skills and resolve can keep up with your visions.
addons.title: Vision of Victory

addons.text: Your Ego sharpens not only your performance, but your ability to grow. You learn, adapt, and refine skills at an accelerated rate, especially in competitive or high-pressure situations. You can quickly identify someone's strengths and adapt, either by copying or countering them, using your own abilities, new and old, to their fullest. The greater your foes, the more you'll improve to match and overcome them.
addons.title: Genius of Adaptability

addons.text: Your presence ignites the Ego of others, lest they be left behind. You can make those who fight alongside or against you awaken their own drive for victory, becoming stronger, more focused, and more dangerous. This creates powerful rivals and allies, ensuring constant evolution, as the Egoists around you force yourself to evolve or be left behind. In time, you can deliberately nurture this growth, shaping others into worthy challengers who push you ever higher.
addons.title: Ego Catalyst

objects.text:
You possess a weaponized Ego, an unwavering sense of self, so strong it sharpens your instincts toward personal victory. In any conflict, your mind filters out doubt and distraction, guiding you toward the path where you come closest to your goals. Your perception, reactions, and decision making improve as your focus narrows to that goal, letting you fully use all of your knowledge and skills to the fullest.

When fully committed to your own success, you can enter a flow state, drastically boosting your performance and allowing you to adapt and evolve mid-conflict. Even despair and failure become fuel for future successes, with your overwhelming desire to overcome your failings triggering explosive growth. However, this power weakens if you hesitate, doubt yourself, or prioritize others over your own victory. The clearer your vision of winning, the stronger you become.

Additionally, you can manifest your ego as a visible aura, reflecting your identity, mindset, and desires. This aura can take on symbolic forms, such as flames, monsters, or even magical symbols, shifting and intensifying as your ego grows over time. Others can perceive this aura, both by feeling pressure and by actually seeing the effects themselves. You can choose what effect your aura will have or let it be decided fully by your subconscious.
objects.title: Egoist (Blue Lock)

addons.text:
You now possess all the technological and psitech knowledge of Armacham Technology Corporation. This primarily includes the ability to create Replica Forces and all of their weapons and equipment. Replica Forces are cloned super-soldiers that can be telepathically controlled.

You also know how to manufacture all of Armacham’s weapons, combat vehicles, and robotics, including vehicles such as the UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter, Armacham helicopters, and others.

You have access to powered armour tech such as REV6, REV8, REV9, REV10, Enhanced Power Armour, and Elite Powered Armour.

You can also create weapons like the S-HV Penetrator, VES Advanced Rifle, Armacham HV Hammerhead, G3A3 Assault Rifle, and many others.

In addition, you gain access to all projects developed by Armacham, including Icarus, Paragon, Pythagoras, and more.
addons.title: Armacham Technology (F.E.A.R.)

objects.text:
You now possess psychic powers from the world of F.E.A.R. These include superhuman reflexes that allow you to act with vastly heightened speed and agility, as well as the ability to enter Slow-Mo, where time appears to slow down around you.

You also gain Telepathy, the ability to enter the minds of others to read their thoughts and access their memories; Mind Control, which allows you to influence the minds of others; and Psychic Illusions, which create realistic mental projections that force your victims to perceive whatever you want them to see.

In addition, you have Telekinesis, enabling you to psionically levitate and manipulate matter to varying degrees. You can also unleash Thunder-Clap, a psychic shockwave capable of killing every enemy within a certain radius. These are only some of the powers at your disposal.

While you begin with relatively basic abilities, with time and training your power will grow dramatically. You will gain additional abilities such as Psychic Flame Manipulation, which creates fire from pure psychic energy, and Liquefy, which melts a target’s flesh away, leaving behind only a charred, blood-drenched skeleton.

At your strongest, you will be capable of Psycho-Warping, the ability to warp reality itself through your psionic power on a metaphysical level. For example, you could create illusions that become real, generate a personal reality that gradually spills into the real world, or Summon Nightmares—fragile yet malevolent creatures drawn from the depths of your mind that manifest both as hallucinations and as physical entities in reality.
objects.title: Psionics (F.E.A.R.)

objects.text:
You have a Super Quantum Unit Intel Processor, or SQUIP. The SQUIP is a “quantum nanotechnology CPU” that implants itself directly into your brain and uses its calculating abilities to help you achieve your goals; these are typically social advancement, but you may use yours for other ends.

The SQUIP is hyperintelligent, able to access practically the entirety of human knowledge, analyze others to understand their lives in detail and precisely how to manipulate them to a desired outcome, and predict the future with a high degree of certainty.

It is also able to manipulate your perception and bodily functions, interacting with you in the form of a hallucination resembling someone or something you look up to, changing what you see or hiding details, or taking control of you to execute some plan on your behalf.

Your SQUIP will have a personality custom tailored to you, and is guaranteed to be loyal to you and not go rogue like Jeremy’s.

If you want you may instead choose to be the SQUIP and be implanted into a host, such as one of the Character Insert options, a Companion, or a custom-made person designed to be pliable to you. You will be able to use all of your powers through your host. It is apparently possible for one SQUIP to spread to several people, so you may be able to do the same by reproducing the pill and getting other potential hosts to consume it with Mountain Dew (Not Mountain Dew Code Red, which is harmful to SQUIPs).
objects.title: Super Quantum Unit Intel Processor (Be More Chill)

objects.text:
You’ve become awakened to the world in much the same way CAIN’s Exorcists are. 

You are able to see Psychic entities called Sins that arise from tragedy, trauma, stress, and extreme circumstances. While usually invisible to the psychically dull they can have disastrous effects when allowed to roam widely, which is why Exorcists exist.

Exorcists like yourself can see Sins and combat them, using their own psychic energies to manifest ‘Blasphemies’ to battle them. Most Exorcists are only able to manifest a single Blasphemy, though with training and effort they can manifest several at the cost of being more likely to suffer Psychic Overflow. Psychic Overflow itself is usually lethal, though occasionally it is able to be resisted. Surviving Overflow results in the Exorcist gaining a Sin Mark on their body, usually granting new abilities and talents, though if an Exorcist dies to Overflow they become Sins themselves, utterly consumed by their own psychic backlash.

There are many distinct Blasphemies that Exorcists manifest; from Tension which allows the Exorcist to project a forcefield of sorts of incredible durability, to Vector imbuing objects with sudden sharp bursts of velocity, to Bind which allows you to tie Sins to your being to control and transform them, to Palace manifesting rooms from a manor of your mind from libraries to research in to Cellars with which to simulate scenarios. These are only a sample of the Blasphemies available, with them only growing stranger the deeper you search.
objects.title: Exorcist (CAIN)
Telepathic Omnipath (The Power Fantasy)
objects.text:
You are an Apex Telepath, or Telepathic Omnipath, with psychic abilities on par with those of Etienne Lux. You possess virtually every mind-related power imaginable, with a range that extends across an entire planet and even into high orbit. These powers include memory reading and manipulation, telepathic communication, mental commands, personality alteration, sensory hijacking, body puppeteering, thoughts reading and mind control, psychic attacks, astral projection, the creation of unwitting sleeper agents, psychic contagions, the division of your own mind into multiple threads to operate several bodies simultaneously, the analysis of memetic and ideatic structures and entities, and much more. All of this is paired with extraordinarily powerful mental defenses that make you virtually invulnerable on the psychic front.

You can also affect your own mind with any of your abilities, giving you absolute control over your emotions, psyche, and personality, should you wish to exercise it.

While your range remains constant, the number of minds you can affect simultaneously decreases as the complexity of the operation increases. You can communicate telepathically with, or read the surface thoughts of, every human on Earth at once. However, more invasive operations, such as completely rewriting the core moral values of seven billion people, or even simply shutting down their brains, could take minutes or even hours to accomplish.

Unlike Etienne, you do not have a tumor in your brain, let alone one that constantly grows. Your brain is and will remain perfectly normal looking.

objects.title: Gamma NULL (Katana Zero)
objects.text:
You are one of the psychic super-soldiers created by New Mecca to fight in the Cromag War, a NULL. Specifically, your abilities are at the highest tier, that of the Gamma NULLs.

The core of this power is a kind of in-depth short range precognition that allows you to simulate a time-loop an infinite number of times until you "get it right", with your skill and knowledge seeming to carry over between loops, as well as the ability to seemingly slow down time. This would normally make you highly dependent on the drug Chronos, but you've overcome this weakness, as if your body generates an infinite supply on its own, or simply doesn't need it.

This is not the only thing that comes with being a Gamma NULL, however; all candidates were raised from birth as perfect super-soldiers, and it shows. You are a flawless swordsman who can easily slice bullets out of the air, a peerless fighter who can mow through hundreds of trained soldiers like chaff, are strong enough to throw common objects with enough force to bust people's heads open or lift a 300 pound man single-handedly, can move so fast you appear to be teleporting (even to high-framerate photography) or dodge bullets & lasers, are agile enough to leap several floors, & possess a generally high level of soldiery & fieldcraft equivalent to action movie or video game depictions of special forces or ninja.

addons.title: The Chronos (Katana Zero)
addons.text:
You gain the knowledge necessary to create all the technology and psitech from the Katana ZERO universe. This includes energy weapons, various types of swords, and, most importantly, Chronos—a drug created by Leon von Alvensleben for the New Mecca government as part of the NULL Project, which was intended to create super soldiers.

Chronos grants limited precognition, allowing its users to anticipate and preplan the outcomes of combat. It also allows users to slow their perception of time and rewind time to a certain point in the past. The formula you receive is for a perfected version of Chronos that has none of its side effects. With enough time and research, you may even be able to develop a version of Chronos that permanently grants its effects after a single dose.

Furthermore, you gain complete knowledge of the NULL Project, a program designed to create super soldiers through the use of Chronos and other experimental methods.

objects.text: sings "My Divinity is past Infinity, Am I... getting THROUGH?" You have been given the power of a twofold Creative AI inside of your brain. Thankfully, you can choose to turn on or off these consciouses with no repercussions. With these AI, you have an interesting connection to the digital world. Each of the AI have their own personality. Abel, the blue AI, is more conservative, cold, not as caring towards humanity besides yourself. And Caine, the red AI; a much more bombastic, energetic, and in your face personality. Each are able to help you in different areas, although it helps if you talk to them and make them feel loved and wanted. Depending on the world you inhabit, you could be the closest thing to a digital god it has. You create matter and manipulate data on a surprisingly easy level, just by "creating" a window into the digital plane. Find data files like you already know where they are from anywhere in the world, create whole realms for you and whoever else you allow to use them with AI capable of achieving sentience. Finally, you are able to take any available brain scans of individuals and turn them into living breathing people in their own right, giving them any form you desire. However, at the beginning, your influence is strictly to the digital world. If you attempted to bring anything you created outside, no matter what other power you had, It would simply vanish before it left. However, with roughly a genius IQ and a few years, you could start summoning minor manifestations of your digital creations to reality. And finally, in the digital world, creations based on brain scans or even human beings themselves in your realms, could "Abstract" or become corrupted data, taking immense effort and almost guess work to figure out how to undo.
objects.title: Cainbel (The Amazing Digital Circus)

objects.text:
Your mind grants you control over gravity at a level equivalent to that of Ray "Heavy" Harris. Your sheer raw power allows you to levitate cities, hurl continents into space, or even split the entire planet apart like an egg. Your finesse allows you to induce seizures by pinching veins in people's brains or to reassemble your own body at the cellular level after it has been blown apart. Your range allows you to stop meteors and natural disasters anywhere across the globe, or even spawn a literal miniature black hole inside the head of a target on the other side of the planet. You can use your control over gravity as a shield, fly at high speeds, survive in space by gravitationally gathering oxygen around yourself, and much more.

Like any Superpower, you possess an innate resistance to mind control and mind reading.
objects.title: Walking Singularity (The Power Fantasy)

objects.text: This is the ability to manipulate the mathematics that make up the world, allowing things such as travel between universes, manipulating flesh and minds, and creating a device to wake an eldritch being from thin air. However, using it puts great strain on the user, limiting initial abilities to one simpler use every couple of hours. Initially, you can do one specific, simple thing, like deflecting projectiles into another universe. However, with training and reshaping your body to better bear the strain and energy cost, there is little you cannot eventually do.
objects.title: Self-Implementing Hyperdimensional Mathematics (Katalepsis)

addons.text: All 108 of your skills may be cast as spells through Magik. Passive skills will typically manifest as a temporary buff, while esoteric skills will have various unusual manifestations. The power of spells will be roughly on par with what Magik is usually capable of, just with more variety than mere offense.
addons.title: Miniature Spellbook

addons.text:
You’ve unlocked the true potential of Jobs! Magic Jobs, with the potential of learning resurrection spells or chronomancy capable of freezing time. Though the first two would take quite a bit of dedication to get the necessary Skills and mana for. With enough time and dedication you’ll be quite formidable as your Magic will be the primary Parameter that will grow along with your Job level, increasing your mana and mana regeneration. 

What exactly you can do depends entirely on you, you could become a Sushimancer who makes delicious sushi that influences people, making them blurt out their grievances or make snappy decisions. At a very high level, nearing 100, this can go as far as making soul trapping, time manipulation and body alteration sushi, though it would take centuries of sushi-making to reach that level. You could be a simple fire-, ice-, or plant-mage or a mage of pretty much any element or concept you can think of. Though actually achieving anything with those will take a while. 

For example, while you could with time learn Chronomancy as a Chronomancer and thus how to freeze time, you’d at most be able to freeze it for a second before you’re drained of mana, and that’s with years of dedication, you’d face much more success with acceleration and deceleration of time instead. Likewise with Resurrection spells, it’d take a lot of dead bodies and wrongly reanimated corpses, bordering on necromancy, to get to a point where people you resurrect are brought back exactly as they were, while healing would be much easier, though it would still take years to get to an acceptable level. You can learn pretty much any magic, but once you’ve chosen a Job you’ll have to stick with it, unless you wish to reset it and thus all of your progress with it as well.
addons.title: Magic Jobs

objects.text:
You can shoot elemental spells at your opponent, reminiscent of fantasy magic. While you won't get anything stronger than a fireball the size of a watermelon or a stone spike jutting from the ground from this, it is fairly versatile.

You have a limited amount of magic that regenerates over time. Two hours of sleep will completely regenerate your reserves. This pool of magik combines with the reserves you use for any other magic system, as long as the magic system uses internal energy and not external (for example, Chakra, Ki, and Od (Fate) would work, but Nature Chakra and Mana (Fate) would not).
objects.title: Magik

objects.text: You possess a pair of unique mystic eyes that can alter reality, turning falsehoods into truths and fiction into fact, rejecting reality and substituting your own. These eyes allow you to deceive the fabric and tapestry of the [world] itself, forcing it to have no choice but to accept your reality as its own. Each of your eyes holds a distinct ability within, working in unison to bring your illusions to life. The right eye wields the power of the Lie, the act of lying to the face of the universe, transforming rumors and falsehoods into truths. The more believable and widespread the lie, the easier it is to manifest and the longer it can persist in reality, softening the impact on yourself. If a lie is sustained for long enough, that lie will eventually become a permanent Truth, turning fleeting illusions into fact. The left eye embodies Rejection, the act of denial against reality, capable of negating a singular Truth of the world at a time, altering how reality is perceived. However, the more fundamental or universally accepted the fact you're rejecting is, the harder it becomes to erase it from both your mind and the world around you. The strain to maintain this illusion intensifies with the magnitude of the truth you're defying—Greater Truths will have the potential to overwhelm or even kill you if you're not careful. As you wield these eyes, you will find your abilities blossoming with time, gradually expanding their reach while the burden they place upon you begins to ease. Though the weaknesses inherent to their power can never truly be cast aside, they will become far more manageable, growing far more tolerable as your mastery deepens. With each step forward, the strain becomes a distant dream, and the weight of their gift will rest lighter upon your soul.
objects.title: Mystic Eyes of Fantasy

objects.text:
You can summon random base-level Servants from the Throne of Heroes by using Saint Quartz. You gain one Saint Quartz per day and can obtain more by defeating enemies, defeating a baseline humans gives one Quartz Shard (you need 10 Shards to make a full Quartz) while defeating a Parahuman gives Quartz depending on their strength (5 Shards for a street-level parahuman, one Quartz for a mid-tier parahuman, three Quartz for a high tier parahuman, five Quartz for a top tier parahuman, and three hundred Quartz for an Endbringer). Defeating an Entity gives you ten free pulls per day for ten years.

If you obtain duplicates, they are turned into Wisdom Essence that can be used to improve your existing Servants by increasing their level or skills, as well as crafting equipment.

(You can substitute the catalog for another franchise like Arknights, Azur Lane, Girls Frontline, etc. when picking the power.)
objects.title: Spin the Gacha

objects.text:
Harness the extraordinary power of Libriomancy and become a master of manipulating the enchantment contained within the written word. As a Libriomancer, you possess an understanding of the magical potential hidden within books, granting you the ability to draw forth their contents and bring them to life in the real world.

The strength of your Libriomancy is influenced by the popularity and significance of the book or story you draw from. The more widely known and beloved the work, the easier it is for you to access its magic and wield its creations. Famous literary classics, beloved bestsellers, and iconic stories hold immense power within their pages, serving as a wellspring for your abilities.

However, the magic of Libriomancy has its limitations. Each book possesses a finite amount of magical energy that can be tapped into before it needs time to recharge. You can only use Libriomancy on a specific book a limited number of times before it requires a period of rest and rejuvenation. This restriction encourages you to explore a vast array of literature and discover new sources within different books.

Your mastery of Libriomancy extends beyond traditional printed books, allowing you to tap into the enchantment of other literary forms. Comics and manga come alive as vibrant illustrations leap from the pages, while digital e-books unravel their mystical potential, blurring the boundaries between the physical and virtual realms.

Your connection to the written word unlocks endless possibilities, enabling you to summon weapons, creatures, and objects to aid you on your quests. However, remember the delicate balance between fiction and reality, and exercise caution when altering the fabric of stories, as the consequences can be unpredictable.
objects.title: Libriomancy

addons.text: Due to possessing the blood of an Elder, your existence has changed. And, thanks to this change, your capacity to use Blood Magic has now escalated exponentially. A powerful ritual that might have previously drained you of your life force entirely would now only require a single drop of your valuable eldritch blood. And, as you further transform into an Elder, the potency of your blood will only increase over time. This means that you'll be able to cast more frequent or more powerful spells for less of a sacrifice until eventually, you can effectively cast such spells at will. Furthermore, as the Elders are primordial creatures, coming into existence before the universe itself, your mind has adapted to comprehend the ancient eldritch spells and rituals behind Blood Magic with far greater ease than before.
addons.title: Sanguimancy of the Elders

objects.text:
Sanguimancy, or hemomancy to some, is a highly contested magic that is often seen as a dark art. However, blood magic is no more dark magic than any other magic; indeed, that could not be further from the truth. Blood magic is one of the purest forms of magic that one can achieve, as it is the oldest magic to exist since time immemorial, before the void that existed before the universe. However, it also costs more than many would be willing to pay, as the more taxing a spell is, the more likely it is that you will die from blood loss and your life force being drained as it is used as fuel for arcane reality manipulation.

To learn more spells, the practitioner must perform a spell to reach through time, reach the void, and look into it, as the very nature of the universe is revealed to them, oftentimes leaving the recipient blind for the next few minutes due to the overstimulation of looking so far into the past and learning things that mortal minds should not have understood.

If one thing is certain, the scholars of old have learned that nothing is ever free, and everything comes at a cost; the only question is if you are willing to pay the price.

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Blood Magic

objects.text:
You are a magician of the Soul. You have the necessary knowledge to detect, manipulate and destroy souls, summon and bind spiritual creatures, summon souls that were long dead, and call upon the spirits of nature for help.

With sufficient time, you can create souls ex nihilo; awaken souls inside non-spiritual and alien beings, granting them human thoughts; create elemental spirits by infusing a soul in various natural and conceptual elements; remove the concept of death from your soul, making it immortal; and much more.
objects.title: Spiritual Magician

objects.text:
You've gained command over the mystical forces of the abyss and wield three distinct abilities. With Abyssal Corruption, you possess the ability to taint and corrupt nearby entities with the insidious power of the abyss, transforming them into your loyal familiars. This process can only be performed on entities that are gravely wounded or recently deceased, with corpses over a week old proving resistant to successful corruption. These corrupted familiars serve as extensions of your will, obeying your commands and aiding you in your endeavors.

The second ability, Abyssal Calling, grants you the power to summon beings from the realms of myths and legends. Through this power, you can temporarily bring forth these entities into the material world, allowing their presence for up to one hour. However, with skillful negotiation and forging of pacts, you can establish a lasting connection with the summoned beings, turning them into either familiars or powerful patrons who bestow you with their otherworldly guidance and abilities.

The third ability, Abyssal Pact, endows you with the ability to bind contracts in an unbreakable manner. Any contractual relationship you enter into becomes irrevocable, rendering your enemies, servants, comrades, familiars, or patrons unable to break the terms of the agreement. Should they attempt to violate the pact, severe consequences befall them, acting as a powerful deterrent against betrayal or treachery.
objects.title: Abyssal Warlock

objects.text:
With this power, you possess the ability to perform limitless magic. You can unleash fireballs, unlock locks, manipulate minds, or even attain godlike powers with Omnipotence and Omniscience. However, every spell requires you to perform specific actions or utter special words, similar to the excuses made in sci-fi shows to explain advanced technology. You must wave objects, chant incantations, or perform rituals to manifest the desired magical effect.

While any spell is possible, each has its own requirements. Simple spells may only need gestures or brief incantations, while complex ones demand elaborate rituals and sacrifices. You possess a general understanding of the necessary steps to achieve your goals, and different magical systems can aid your Magicbabble power. For instance, a fire spell cast with a wand may require fewer gestures, and a potion might require fewer ingredients if they possess magical properties. Moreover, you have an innate talent for learning and mastering various magical systems across the multiverse.
objects.title: Magicbabble

addons.text:
It seems your cooking magic has seeped into the pouch, maximizing its potential.

The pouch that once only produced mundane spices and seasoning can now produce magical ones as well. Even without being cooked into anything they can grant small buffs on their own, however when mixed into a meal the buffs produced can be massively amplified in strength and duration. A simple coffee with a pinch of sugar thrown in can not only energize you through the morning but the whole day now, if not several if it was brewed to be particularly strong.
addons.title: Magic Seasoning

objects.text: "It's a piece of cake to bake a pretty cake!", were the wise words from a young baker of her time. But this phrase means more to you than most, because you, my friend, are an alchemist! Not the common cauldron and potions kind—no, you are a mystic baker/chef. You have the potential to create esoteric and wonderful recipes through alchemical transmutations and advanced cooking skills. You can create transmutation circles to alter organic materials into the ingredients you need to make these wonders and techniques to infuse them with mystical essences. Make pies that can allow people to fly, coffee that truly energizes you and causes no addiction, candies that are nutritious and grant people the power to shoot laser eyes, milkshakes that give mild regeneration and bring all the boys to the yard, brew up alcoholic drinks that don't cause hangovers and instill enhanced charisma. The possibilities are endless, but in the beginning, you'll only be able to make enhanced food that is more nutritious than it should be. To start with, you have a bank of alchemical recipes in your head to go off of and a specialty in creating cooking/kitchen-based equipment. You also know recipes for alchemical devices that help you procure data useful to these fields. Finally, you have enhanced senses mostly focused on taste and smell, so strong that you could take a whiff of the air and tell what someone had to eat for dinner the previous day! A new world is opened to you, it's time to start cooking!
objects.title: Cooking By The Book

objects.text:
Necromancy, undeath or death magic to some, is the darkest of all magic. Most of the magic in this field of the arcane focuses on the manipulation of the dead and the souls of the living. You wield the darkest of all black magic. Harvesting the leftover parts of the world to reanimate the dead requires three resources that are essential for necromancy: vitae (the life force of humans), the remains of the dead, and entropy. Wielding all three, you cast spells that change the world around you to come closer to death or reanimate those close to death.

You start with beginner-level spells in the three main branches of necromancy; however, you are not limited to these branches.

Undead manipulation: What most people assume necromancy is all about is being able to raise the dead, whether they be skeletons, zombies, spirits, or just about any other type of undead creature. There is no limit to what you can raise to become part of your undead legion. You may have any number of undead servants at a time, taking no Vitae for them to linger but only what it costs to resurrect them. You gain a mental link with every undead that you create, which allows you to assume direct control over them as the overlord of a hivemind of undead minions. So long as they fit within the theme of being undead, you can bring someone back into various forms, such as mummies or vampires that possess abilities similar to their fantasy counterparts, such as a lich being able to resurrect the dead as a general or possessing a phylactery.

Curse manipulation: You are proficient in curses, being able to use many curses that slow, weaken, cause misfortune, Blindness, petrification, Drain energy, and even cause damage to those you curse. All curses you cast are permanent unless the one you cast them on is stronger than you. This magic uses entropy in a more focused fashion than any other branch of necromancy. You start with basic spells such as slow, blinding, and corpse explode.

Soul manipulation: You can manipulate souls and the life force of others. Creating and shaping the souls in any way you wish is possible so long as you possess souls, both the ones you are manipulating and the ones you use to feed your energy. To start down the path, you must possess an understanding of your own soul. The more you grow this branch of necromancy, the more you can shape the world around you or absorb the souls of others, creating monsters, converting souls to energy, absorbing them to gain power the person once possessed, creating souls from nothing, even forging souls into armor, and so much more.

At later stages of necromancy, you can even start manipulating those who are not dead, shaping flesh, and creating new species from magic alone, creating abominations from those still alive or dead that are loyal only to you. At mastery, you can even reverse the flow of entropy and instead focus it into your undead creations, evolving them to no longer be dead but instead a half-step between death and life, allowing them to grow past what they once were.
objects.title: Necromancy

objects.text:
You are a radiant painter. By infusing both your materials and yourself with magical energies, you can create magical and mystical creations of Art. At first, you will only be able to apply a small amount of magic through your works, creating minor effects like illusions or emotional stimulation in those who are near the work of Art. But with time, special material and with mystical preparations, you can imbue an incredible amount of magic into your works, which would put a whole city into a dreamscape, or turn a small backyard garden into a backyard jungle that slowly consumes the town.

You can create a wide variety of artistic medium, gaining the knowledge of how to create any kind of mundane artistic medium. The infusion of materials can take many forms based on your personal style of magic, but compounding infused materials with other infused materials increases the infused magic amount multiplicatively.

You can create a wide variety of handcrafted artistic works that create magical effects based on the intent and design of the work of Art. With enough practice and experimentation, you could achieve a wide range of effects as long as they are all centered on the work of art itself. Its strengths lie in area effects and require a skilled artist to create complex functions or conditions within the works of art, working at its peak when indiscriminate in effect. As the painter, you can choose to be completely immune to the effects of your creations.
objects.title: Radiant Painter

objects.text:
Curious, you seem to have been blessed utterly by music.

Your skill as a composer and performer of music has reached legendary status, and you can translate any feeling, idea, or concept into a song, evoking these things.

You also possess the ability to summon and telekinetically utilize to the peak of your abilities any instruments you desire or need, no matter how expensive or rare. Have your orchestra be staffed entirely by Stradivarius violins if you so desire.

However, the true power of this is revealed when you channel these feelings into your pieces with the intent to cause change in the world around you.

As your blessing has touched the realm of magic, through the medium of music, you can cause magical and mystical effects tied to the song and the things it evokes.

A raging song evoking a storm or the wrath of the heavens might summon up said storm; a quiet contemplative piece might enhance the learning capabilities of everyone who hears it. A nostalgic, sorrowful piece could soften the heart and ease the burdens of those it reaches.

The sky's the limit, so to speak, as the things you evoke and represent with the primordial language of sounds reach out and persuade the world to change through pure emotion.

This is an old and powerful branch of magic, tracing its roots all the way through Orpheus and Solomon, and even deeper into mankind's primordial past, and beyond.
objects.title: Magical Melody

objects.text:
You are a master of the school of illusion, which ranges from minor tricks and misdirections, all the way to fooling the perception of reality itself.

You focus on the magic of perception itself, creating lies so good they might as well be truth, hiding in plain sight the fantastical, or fooling the senses to perceive the impossible in the mundane, But not only is the mental aspect of this magic open to you, the physical is as well—craft puppets made of light and shadow, overlay a differing reality upon this one, or even fool memories, creating lifetimes, experiences and sensations in people, making them question the very fabric of the world around them.

The grand art of this school of magic is the lie so great it fools all the world, turning lie and fiction into truth, and overwriting reality. This is far beyond you as of right now, but with time and effort, you may be able to accomplish this. Just remember, if you hit the universe, the universe tends to try and hit back, so trying to turn your thought to reality incurs an enormous cost, whether that be by magical energies, or if you are unable to pay with that, physical ones, even including lifespan.
objects.title: Illusion Magic

objects.text:
You have awakened a trace, a fragment, of magical power; your biological makeup has changed to withstand the nature of magic. All magus who practice the thaumaturgical nature of biomancy possess an organic flesh sack inside their bodies that helps with the gathering of the vestiges of the lifeblood of the universe. Those who practice possess a more evolved body as a result of the mutations that they gain from casting spells or the backlash from spells that have forever scarred their body.

You start with a beginner-level understanding of the main branches of biomancy; however, through experimentation and research, you can branch outside the current understanding of biomancy.

Shaping: When most people picture those who work with flesh, you are the first thing their mind goes to. This is the school of manipulating the flesh of beings who are still alive and even those who are dead to change the bodies of the living into something else, using magic to influence the evolution and creation of flesh into something that it was not before. You can cast magic and change the biology of others and yourself, augmenting the already existing biology. Others are often able to tell those who practice this type of magic based on how they look, as those who delve into shaping often leave differently than how they came in, grafting additional arms, eyes, or even growing tentacles to attack offensively. Most people do not wish to get into a fight with Shapers, as they will turn them into biomass that they will then use to further augment themselves.

Monster Manipulation: This is the school of magic relating to the creation of new life and a subsection of Shaping. Those who practice this magic are fond of creating monsters instead of augmenting themselves, distancing themselves from combat, not wanting to dirty themselves with the blood of their enemies, and creating elaborate monsters to do the job for them, such as bears that can breathe fire, dragons that can turn invincible, snakes with the upper body of a man that can poison their enemies, and so much more. The more imaginative the one who created the monster, the more features that could be hidden in the monster that they created. They are not bound by the biological laws of the universe, being able to fit more into their creations the more they have spent researching this branch of magic, even creating all-new forms of beings that have abilities beyond what normal biology should allow.

Blight Craft: The first plague that was ever discovered was the result of a biomancer who did not properly seal the container that they kept their research in. This field of study is that of transmuting flesh into diseases and plagues, able to create plagues that even the most deadly of creatures could fall into. Creating parasites and diseases comes as second nature; you can create diseases that shouldn't exist with enough research and study, corrupting others into misshapen blobs of flesh, turning their eyes into bees, creating boils, and so much more.

As you progress into biomancy, you can start to create biological monsters with magic alone instead of relying on already existing biomass, creating abominations that evolve the more magic that you put into them. At mastery, you could even start to shape the world around you as you reach beyond the limits of mortal biology.
objects.title: Biomancy

addons.text: Your nature as both a child of the Moon and also as one of her Exalted champions have synergized and further strengthened your Lunar physiology and powers beyond the norm: Your lunar attributes are no longer equivalent to Earth’s own Moon, but rather that of a truly colossal moon, significantly greater in size and mass than even Ganymede, with all of the appropriate enhancements to your abilities - physical attributes and reserves, Gravity, and Reflection - to match.
addons.title: Lunarch

addons.text: Your solar and lunar halves have combined into a greater whole, unlocking greater strength than their individual parts - in addition to the greater control and finesse of your lunar gravity gaining the much greater power and reach of your solar half, and your reflection benefitting from the proportionate increase in durability, you have unlocked another ability: By using your lunar half as a sort of ‘lens’ and reflecting your own solar radiance, you can unleash rays and lances of searing light strong enough to vaporize nearly any mundane material, at the cost of weakening your reflection while in use. This also allows access to your magic’s solar eclipse powerset at any time. Should you have purchased Usagihime as well, your power of healing is also enhanced, granting it a golden shine that invigorates those bathed in it as well, restoring stamina and bolstering strength and courage.
addons.title: Total Eclipse

objects.text:
You have been gifted a new and greatly enhanced form with all of the qualities of the Moon, and even more: First and foremost among your abilities, Physique: Your body has been enhanced with not only all of the durability, raw power, and mass - of which you may selectively exert, with your gravitational abilities - of Earth’s own moon condensed into your human form, but also similarly massive reserves of stamina and magical energy, granting you a staggering amount of might.

Your second ability is Gravity, similar to a Sun’s: Where yours differs from theirs, however, is that you are gifted with an extreme degree of control and nuance over it rather than just sheer exertion of force, being more akin to a sort of telekinesis; at the start, you may ‘only’ be as capable as your physical abilities, you can do so on such a scale as the tides themselves, and will only grow more precise with time and practice, with surgery and complex machinery as examples of mid-level skill, and Tinkertech at your heights.

Your third ability is Reflection: This allows you to unconditionally reflect any attack toward the assailant at full power without incurring any damage yourself. This reflection is directly linked to an internal reserve of power that continuously decreases with each reflected attack until it empties. Once depleted, Reflection becomes temporarily unusable. Your reserve passively refills, and depending on the amount depleted, takes at most 24 hours to fully replenish. The strength and nature of attacks will directly translate into percentages reflected: For instance, attacks that might have caused a cut that drew blood would deplete only a minuscule fraction.

Your fourth and final ability is Phase: Depending on the current phase of the moon - new, crescent, half, gibbous, or full - you gain a complement of supporting magical powers to help augment yourself and your other three abilities, with examples such as concealing darkness, unnatural cold, illusions, or even divination. While these sets don’t have the raw power of your primary abilities, they’re no slouches in their own right. Odd lunar ‘phases’ like blood moons and solar eclipses grant unique powersets that are stronger than usual.
objects.title: Child of Luna

objects.text:
You are a witch who finds themselves mysteriously linked to the unfathomable concept of the void, where all things end, and ordinarily, mere contact with this void results in death. Your power stems from a realm lurking beneath the fabric of existence, representing Entropy and Death. Through this connection, you have acquired proficiency in the arcane arts of the darker magical disciplines. You will be able to fire a Void Blast that can be fired as a beam, wave, or general blast.  You will also gain increased proficiency in energy manipulation and necromancy.

Furthermore, you possess entry to a secluded dimension, out of sync with reality, that acts as a Prison. This realm serves as confinement; any entity you encase within the Prison becomes incapable of escape unless those imprisoned surpass your strength or seek external assistance. Your ability to teleport allows you to travel anywhere on the planet you currently reside on in a flash of purple light.

It's important to acknowledge that beings connected to life or those opposed to entropy instinctively fear you. They can sense your connection to the concepts of entropy and death, prompting an aversion towards any association with you. This drawback, however, can be mitigated through dedicated time and effort. Additionally, you are immune to the natural progression of aging or succumbing to illness. Also, excessive use of your powers will lead to weariness and lethargy.
objects.title: Witch of the Void

addons.text:
Through enchanting, you can now create set items with a multitude of effects. Set items offer two main bonuses: first, they have a set effect; second, they function as a single item for the purposes of any beneficial magic, power, or other ability.

There are two primary methods for creating set items. The first method is far weaker but significantly simpler and less expensive. It involves simultaneously enchanting several items, resulting in a weaker set effect and weaker enchantments than usual. The strength of the enchantments is directly related to the number of enchanted objects; the more enchanted objects at once, the weaker the enchantments become. Enchanting too many items at once may render them completely worthless or even fail.

The second approach involves enchanting each object separately in two ways: either enchanting them all with the same enchantments, which provides a weaker set effect, or enchanting them with complementary effects. Regardless of the way you enchant using the second approach, you will need to perform a ritual to join all of them. If your items are metaphysically incompatible, the ritual may fail and destroy them all. However, if you succeed, the enchantments will reinforce one another, providing a stronger set effect based on their compatibility. This method theoretically allows you to have an infinite number of objects in a set effect, but the likelihood of failure rises as you add more items.
addons.title: Set Effect

objects.text:
Enchanting Mastery grants you the ability to infuse everyday objects with magical properties, enhance their existing qualities, and craft reagents from mundane items through specialized rituals. With this power, you can create items that would boggle the mind by focusing your intent to imbue items. Through the art of inscribing intricate magical runes or symbols, you can enhance an item's durability, amplify its damage, grant it protection against specific elements, and achieve many other effects.

As a master of enchanting, your expertise extends to the crafting of mystical reagents. Utilizing specialized rituals, you can transform commonplace materials into potent magical substances, further expanding the possibilities of your enchanting abilities. You can also incorporate crystals or gemstones into your rituals to augment the potency of your creations.

The result is an item imbued with unique, fantastical abilities. Whether it's a cloak that grants the wearer temporary invisibility while worn or a ring that eliminates the need for sleep, your enchanted creations are limited only by your imagination and materials. One unique feature of this ability is the ability to establish activation mechanisms for the enchantment and/or item. For example, only a specific person may use the item, or it can only be activated during the day.
objects.title: Enchanting Mastery

addons.text:
Through your druidic nature and ability to absorb animal spirits, you’ve fully unlocked one of a druid's most iconic powers: Wildshaping. At its core, Wildshaping allows you to channel the essence of the animals whose spirits you carry. By attuning with these souls through understanding the animal and meditation, you can not only learn to cast powerful animal-based cantrips that scale with your level of attunement and the number of spirits you hold, but also reduce the mental strain of housing these spirits.

With enough connection to a single spirit, you gain access to your strongest ability: the ability to transform into that animal using your pool of Natural Energy. Over time, with study and communion, you may even learn to combine compatible souls, creating hybrid forms. The energy required for Wildshaping depends on the creature’s magical nature, its size compared to yours, and the depth of your attunement.
addons.title: Wildshaping

objects.text:
Plants! Fur Babies! Smoking the Devil's Lettuce and having a completely chill vibe! Congratulations, pal. You've become a tree-hugger with superpowers. You've got a collection of abilities that make those eco-fighters look like chumps.

First off, your body has been changed; your physical condition is now four times better than it was initially without powers. Your stamina is also enhanced even more so that you can walk for several days straight and only feel slightly tired on the third day. You are tougher too, capable of walking on sharpened glass with no cuts or scratches.

Secondly, you can commune with nature on a deep level. Hear the plants' whispers, understand the animals' language, and the weather's feelings. With this connection, you can accomplish a couple of things: convince plants to move a short way or get them to grow in a specific way, get animals to do small tasks for you (like sitting, attacking, guarding), get angry ones to calm down, and even predict the weather with very high accuracy. Later on, you could do much more with this connection, but you must subsume yourself to Earth for it to grow.

Thirdly, you have access to the Natural Arts, a technique-based version of the manipulation power. You can create Cantrips (basically spells) through the use of Natural Energy, which you now have a decent pool of within you. Design spells to alter/create plants, summon/strengthen animals, cast elemental powers, and heal others/yourself. But to create these spells, you must perform communion with nature. To make a spell that affects flowers, you must commune with flowers. To create a spell to make rain fall in a small area, you must commune with rainstorms themselves. To cast a fireball, you must understand fire.

Finally, you are skilled in potion-making, woodworking, and botany.
objects.title: Street Druid

objects.text:
You have the ability to summon an extradimensional scroll of power and knowledge, and unsummon it at any time.

Within this scroll of magic, you find a nearly endless collection of magical systems of all different varieties and potencies. While there is a wide variety of systems that are contained within this single scroll, all of them follow a similar pattern in several ways.

The magic systems of this scroll all have some amount of power progression, reaching higher levels of mastery and effectiveness through study and practical work in the system.

The magic systems work off of internal principles or laws that can be studied and understood, allowing the dedicated to progress far. There could be the laws of mana interactions or an elemental cycle that can be studied and modeled accurately. The level of detail and depth of the fields of study are determined by the strength and depth of the magic system itself. This restriction doesn't mean that all of the magical systems are highly scientific or "physical", just that there are actual rules and internal logic that have to be followed for it to work.

If the magic system needs some form of special trait or condition that you do not have, the system will have a method to develop them. This might mean that the early stages of progression in a system require you to work only on developing those special traits, but all of the magic systems can be progressed through your hard work and dedication.

For a magic system with external resource needs, they might rely on specialized magic sub-systems for a specific external resource; multiple magic systems might use the same or similar sub-systems. External resources don't have to be consumable, and could be something like a magical focus.

While a lot of magic systems use some kind of internal energy source, not all of them do; some take the form of spell slots, or even Trading card game-like cards. However, in some way, there will be a resource economy that means your system has some form of limits that require intelligent management.

You begin with one magic system for free that would be the equivalent of 20sp power. This would be at the high end of street-level powers. As you study and further your understanding of your current magic system, you build up energy within the scroll. The energy is expended to check out another magic system.

While actively studying and practicing with your magic system, you have access to a Tutor who is focused on the specific Magic system you are studying. This tutor isn't sapient or sentient, and while it can act with specifically chosen personality and mannerisms, it doesn't know much else beyond its magic system. The tutor is specifically enchanted to be able to figure out methods of teaching that actually work for you. The Tutor cannot be used to shortcut your work or path to power.

Your ability to gain access to another Magic system is locked until you reach what would be a moderate or journeyman level of power in the magic system, even if you have enough energy built up. You can, however, gain access to any subsystems your unlocked magical systems reference.

When you select a magic system, you will mentally transmit a search for the kind of magic system you are looking for. You can specify the kinds of effects that can be produced, or what kind of requirements the system has, even an energy cost range for it, so you know what you have the budget for.

If you are in a world that has a magic system that would fit the Codex Esoterica, then it is an option you can specifically search for and acquire at a discount.

When you reach levels of mastery within a system, you can begin to syncretize it with magic systems that have similarities or synergistic interactions, allowing for a boost to the effectiveness of combined principles or laws, and smoothing over contradictory interactions that increase the further you are into mastery.
objects.title: Codex Esoterica

addons.text:
Your mastery of occult knowledge has sharpened your magical practice into a seamless art. The rituals, symbols, and hidden languages of the unseen have become second nature to you, allowing you to “speak” the occult as fluently as if it were your native tongue.

Where once your workings demanded painstaking precision, you now move through them with practiced ease. You can strip away extraneous steps without compromising potency and channel your expertise to empower the workings of others. Minor effects—charms, wards, flickers of insight—can be summoned with little to no preparation, as naturally as breathing.

Your breadth of lore now extends into the rare and forgotten, granting you creative workarounds when materials or conditions are lacking. You can substitute ingredients, alter incantations, or modify ritual structures without destabilizing their intent.

This refined understanding also makes you a natural innovator. You will find hybridizing disparate traditions, combining incompatible systems, and even crafting entirely new rites far easier than before, with you having an instinctive sense for what works and what doesn’t, as well as the result of doing so.
addons.title: Trained Occultist

addons.text:
Due to the foundation built by both Natural and Parahuman sciences, your knowledge of the Occult has expanded into something greater: an understanding of the fringes of knowledge, or in other words, the Paranormal.

Your understanding of Paranormal Science covers the whole spectrum, from Cryptozoology, Ufology, Ghost Hunting, and other pseudosciences. With this knowledge, you are the greatest pseudoscientist in the world, being able to identify and explain these ideas and topics, either explaining them away so anyone could understand what really happened or giving convincing ideas and arguments for how a Paranormal event could be real, with the chance to prove it/discover it.

This, in turn, functions as a bridge between known science and the extraordinary, giving you a much stronger foundation for researching the supernatural and superpowered, becoming a forerunner in understanding these powers, with all that entails depending on the world you are in. Your own knowledge of the Occult has been supplemented by these sciences, giving you ideas for workarounds and innovations that could have escaped you, using the advances of humanity to rework and improve things like rituals with modern knowledge and tools, if possible within the world/setting.
addons.title: Paranormal Sciences

objects.text:
You possess a variety of abilities derived from real-world occult practices that actually function, including but not limited to: divination, voodooism, curses, herbology, demonology, and necromancy. The majority of your power sets must be initiated through complex rituals, and only a small fraction can be performed without any preparation. Moreover, some spells, particularly divination, will not yield clear-cut results, leaving it up to you to interpret their hidden meanings.

A fair warning: Your magic is very unstable, as even the smallest things can affect these rituals, from the number of tears used to how high the sun is. Sometimes, even intent can alter its output.
objects.title: Occult

objects.text: Long ago, an ancient civilization sought to use the energy of a dying star to empower their race and escape their inevitable demise. Their brightest minds worked together and found a way to infuse aether - a special type of solar energy - into their very bodies. They managed to transfer a portion of their consciousness into a state of living, hyperdense aether, which was able to transmit information back to their bodies. They named this new form of existence the soul. Utilizing their newfound souls, they were able to achieve a variety of spectacular effects. Aether was an extremely potent and versatile form of energy capable of interacting with and even diluting into a variety of particles. Through careful calculations and mastery of physics, a formula could be created. A formula is an extremely specific series of actions involving manipulation, flow, and transfer of aether to create an effect on the physical world. The most basic formula is manifesting aether externally in an unstable state to rapidly fire beams of scorching hot aether. However, from this foundation, more complex formulas can be developed, allowing for intermediate uses such as elemental control, teleportation, telekinesis, and flight equivalent to your maximum running speed. Advanced users of aether have extreme fine control of the energy, and can utilize the continuous transfer of aether between their soul and body to achieve effects such as complete and rapid regeneration of the body and reinforcing the body (and weapons) with aether. At the theoretical height of aether manipulation lies the ability to control the very fabrics of the world, shaping time and creating aetherial stars with ease. Aether is capable of assimilating other energies and forms of mana into itself, gaining their properties and capabilities. Though it is important to be careful, as you are essentially modifying the fabric of your own soul when you do this. You start at the level of a beginner mage, capable of materializing aether rays and some basic forms of elemental manipulation. Your mind is enhanced to the level of a high-end computer to facilitate this level of aether use. Your soul passively generates aether for your use, but you can convert other forms of energy, such as radiation and sunlight, into aether, which will replenish your reserves. Regularly absorbing external aether can increase your maximum capacity — if you somehow survive an extended stay at the core of a star, your aether regeneration and reserves will become monstrous. (With enough time, you can do anything with this power)
objects.title: Celestial Current

addons.text: recursive text on the inside of an O. Forever dOwnwards. Forever dOwnwards. Your tattoos, as created with Tattoo Genesis, have fused with the Brand & Bond, allowing you to will your tattoos into smaller and more complex forms. The size of your tattoos can now be greatly compressed, compensating for the lack of size with recursive detail.
addons.title: Infinite Recursion

addons.text:
You are now able to create the Tattoos of every Siren in the Borderlands games and the knowledge on how each ability works.

This includes Lilith's Phasewalk, Maya's Phaselock, Amara's Phasetrance, Angel's Phaseshift, and Tyreen's Phaseleech.

You can use these abilities as foundations to create new mystical tattoos based on your knowledge of Eridian magitech.
addons.title: Siren

objects.text:
You possess a unique form of magic that harnesses the power of tattoos, allowing you to create and draw strength from them. Your magical reservoir can be channeled to either craft new tattoos or activate existing ones. The complexity and size of a tattoo directly correlate with the energy required for its creation or activation.

For instance, a simple snake tattoo on your arm might grant you the ability to summon a serpent, while a full-body dragon tattoo could potentially enable you to transform into a dragon. The type of power you gain from the tattoo is dependent on your understanding of what the tattoo symbolizes; for example, you may gain the power to control fire from a fire tattoo, while others may gain the power to summon fire spirits.

If your energy reserves are insufficient, the magic will draw from other sources, including your life force if necessary. Additionally, you have the ability to bestow tattoos upon others, sharing your powers with them.

If you have other powers, you can imbue them into your tattoos.
objects.title: Tattoo Genesis

addons.text:
Congratulations, you have a better connection with Chaos than most across the Omniverse! As a favored child of Chaos, your own Chaos Spells can no longer directly inconvenience, harm, or kill you—unless you desire it. You also have the power to shield those you choose from the effects of your chaos spells, though be aware: only you are the favored child, and each protective attempt increases the risks for those you protect.

While chaos cannot act directly against you, it has plenty of indirect ways to complicate your life. Enjoy wading through your bedroom transmuted turned tundras, fleeing from dragons you've unwittingly summoned, or dealing with a charmed Cthulhu you accidentally romanced. Although you are shielded from direct harm by your spells, the indirect consequences of chaos can still lead you to your doom.
addons.title: Favored Child of Chaos

objects.text:
Your magic stems from the wild, underlying forces of Chaos that shape the foundation of reality. Chaos represents both the origin of everything and the realm of infinite possibilities. As a conduit to this primordial force, you wield the power to bring forth its might.

Chaos Magic is one of the most ancient forms of magic, existing free of the rules and traditions that bind other magics. Your spells are direct extensions of your will, and require no hand signs or incantations—merely a direction for guiding chaos into form. With a mere snap of your fingers, you could extinguish the sun or vanquish gods. Oppositely, the same spell could morph you into a flesh-eating blob, teleport you into Hell, or charm every penguin in the world.

As a conduit of primordial chaos, you can vaguely guide the intensity and direction of your spells. However, mastering the fluctuations of chaos magic is extremely difficult; even a minor misstep could lead to a minor cantrip turning into a city-breaking calamity. For Chaos Mages, calamity or death will always be knocking on your doorstep.

Attempting to impose order on Chaos is futile. So each spell you cast, whether to ignite a match or curse an opponent, carries the risk of a misfire. These could be mere nuisances or lethal mistakes; no chaos spell will ever follow your orders perfectly.

Chaos is disorderly, volatile, and often verges on madness, but its chaotic potential can accomplish anything—as long as you are willing to roll the dice.
objects.title: Chaos Magic

addons.text:
Through your own management and household skills, you have created a master enchantment of Household Magic that can be applied once, rather than requiring multiple casts, known as the House Matrix Enchantment.

Thanks to this enchantment, the entire process becomes automatic, transforming the house where it is cast into an enchanted home, allowing those who live in it to go about their lives without worry.

The home will be self-cleaning, self-organizing, and self-repairing, ensuring that the residents feel relaxed and at home; at the same time, it will also organize itself in the best way to suit and reflect its residents, with each personal bedroom receiving help in maintaining its unique atmosphere. However, this could lead to a slightly odd situation when one half of a shared room is decorated to suit one person, while the other half is decorated to suit another.

The House Matrix Enchantment also responds to the desires and responsibilities of its residents, meaning it can help prepare the home for a last-minute guest in record time or advise residents on what they need through any medium available. For example, it could change the channel on a TV to show an advertisement relevant to their current situation, or open a book to the exact page they need, or if a crime were to occur inside or around the house, it could preserve or eliminate any evidence, depending on your preference.

But there’s more: a weaker, but still present, aspect of this enchantment is protection and purification; on its own, with just this add-on, it will cleanse weak curses and other supernatural forces that wish harm to the residents, although stronger forces will persist, albeit weakened.

This also extends to other forms of protection, such as noticeably stronger internet security within the home, making it much less likely that scams, malicious attacks, or phishing attempts will reach you or go unnoticed; even if someone breaks in, the house’s magic will fight back, but it will do no better than a regular person throwing objects, forcing doors and windows shut, and setting off alarms.
