You can add other forms of magic and skills you know to enhance the House Matrix Enchantment; however, it will primarily remain a means to maintain, nurture, and protect a home and those who live in it, therefore, it is more likely to grow legs and run away than to fight if given the chance; but still, that doesn’t stop you from making a small improvement to the enchantment so that, if someone breaks in, you can have an army of action figures fighting them before taking them prisoner in a "Small Soldiers" situation.
addons.title: House Matrix Enchantment

objects.text:
Magic has played a major role in human history, with countless powerful spells and incantations developed for a variety of purposes. However, some magics are designed to specifically assist with the mundane tasks of daily life. One such type of magic is Household Magic, which uses its powers to help with household chores and domestic activities. This is the magic you now have.

The spells of Household Magic range from simple incantations that can speed up the process of doing laundry to more advanced incantations that can clean up and/or repair messes in an instant. Spells for drying clothes, folding laundry, and keeping floors clean are just a few examples of the magic that can help the ever-busy homeowner stay on top of chores.

Household Magic also extends to other areas of domestic life, such as cooking and gardening, making it a versatile and helpful tool for anyone seeking to ease the burden of everyday tasks. Whether you're looking for a way to make housework simpler or just want to bring a touch of magic to your home, Household Magic is the perfect solution.

This magic builds off what you have available, so if you have modern appliances such as a washing machine, you can instead temporarily boost their effectiveness. You are also know how to make enchanted objects that can help around the house, such as brooms that can sweep the floors by themselves, self-cleaning dishes, crystal orbs that can control the room temperature and more.
objects.title: Household Magic

objects.text:
You can harness the forces of malevolence and misfortune to afflict your targets with a variety of afflictions, from minor inconveniences to devastating calamities. From the depths of resentment and envy, practitioners harness the malignant energies of the universe, weaving intricate spells of suffering and despair.

Through twisted rituals and incantations, curses are wrought upon unsuspecting souls, casting shadows upon their lives with afflictions both subtle and catastrophic. Whether it be the gnawing agony of illness, the torment of madness, or the shattering of fortunes, curse magic leaves its mark upon its victims with a cruelty unmatched by any other form of sorcery.

Yet, the tendrils of these curses reach far beyond the present moment, stretching across generations to haunt the bloodlines of those who have incurred the wrath of the arcane. Breaking the chains of these hexes demands not only skill and sacrifice but also the intervention of benevolent forces and the unraveling of ancient mysteries.

Your nature as a child of curse allows you to ignore the usual difficulties of using such magic, such as the damnation and damage to one’s soul and psyche.
objects.title: Cursed Child

objects.text:
You can literally eat curses for breakfast. Whenever you get targeted by a curse, you can eat the energies that compose that curse with your own magical energy, negating any effect the curse had and giving you a boost of energy from magically digesting that curse.

At first, this only serves as a way for you to recover your strength and gain a temporary power boost equal to the energy of the curse. But you will notice that as you eat more curses, your own personal magical energy reserves will start slowly growing stronger from the absorbed energy, training your reserves.

If you don’t have some other power that gives you access to magical energy, this power will give you a minor reserve of a generic magical energy connected to your soul. This energy slowly regenerates when expended at a rate of one percent every ten seconds. Though you’ll have to figure out how to manipulate that energy yourself.

While this power doesn’t give you any sort of generalized magic control, intuition, or knowledge, when it comes to curses, you are a prodigy. Just by thinking of a concept for a curse, you’ll be able to intuitively mentally construct a basic curse fitting that concept. Though those curses will not start particularly powerful or energy efficient, they are an excellent jumping-off point for further curse development.

For example, starting with a curse of stepping on LEGOs might eventually lead to developing curses for various degrees of misfortune manipulation.

As you further develop this ability, you will be able to learn from curses you eat, allowing you to cast spells based on them for your personal use. Say, for example, you go to Jusenkyo in the Ranma verse, you could learn to transform yourself, or curse anyone else using what you learned.

It is possible to expand the radius of your curse eating beyond your body, though with just the reserves this power provides, you’ll run out of magic to fuel the effect within 15 seconds with the radius expanded just a foot in any direction.

You are only able to eat curses that are equal to or weaker than your personal magic reserves. Though you are resistant to curses in a general manner, directly proportional to the strength of your magical energy compared to the curse.
objects.title: Curse Eater

objects.text:
This is the magic of infectious traits. Any traits you have access to or can study, you will be able to make infectious with this magic. This includes biological, mental, magical, and spiritual traits.

You start innately knowing how to make basic magic varieties of vampires, werewolves, and zombies in a variety of ways.

Maybe make an enchanted ring that turns people into vampires or perform a ritual that makes a person a werewolf. You will also be able to set up conditions in which someone infected by your magic will be able to further spread it like a vampire bite.

The manner in which those you have infected can infect others into more of their kind will have increased difficulty the higher quality and power their particular variety of infection possesses, especially if you don’t want quality to degrade in successive generations.

So an Elder Vampire might be only able to infect someone once a month with a specific ritual if they don’t want the resulting vampire to be weaker; meanwhile, a common zombie could casually infect through a bite with no problem.

As progenitor of this magic, you can optionally retain a measure of authority and control over those infected with your magic, along with any successive generations they produce.
objects.title: Pire Craft

addons.text: A Hero to some is a Villain to others, for greatness is often shadowed by its own darkness. The brightest lights inevitably cast the deepest shadows, and those who rise to legendary heights may be seen as saviors by one side, yet feared or hated as enemies by another. True heroism and villainy are rarely pure; they are defined by the eyes that behold them. You can reshape a recorded story by creating alternate interpretations or endings, adjusting the summon’s nature, appearance, or abilities to reflect a different version of the tale. This lets you craft alternate outcomes, reimagine endings, or change perspectives within the legend, granting flexibility to the summon’s powers and appearance. However, each change strains your mana, and overly radical alterations risk destabilizing the construct or creating unintended effects.
addons.title: Author’s Edition

objects.text: There once was a bard who sang of worlds beyond his own—of heroes and villains from distant realms, of lands unseen by any who walked his soil. Some called him mad, others thought him a visionary, but the bard cared little for their judgments. Day after day, he wove tales of legendary deeds and otherworldly mysteries, stories brimming with power and wonder. You can summon Crystallised Legends —living constructs drawn from the stories you’ve personally witnessed and recorded. These constructs are not exact replicas of events but are shaped by the myth and grandeur that the story gains over time. Each summon represents an idealized version of a hero, monster, or moment. The more dramatic the tale, the stronger the entity. However, to create a Crystallized Legend, you must be present for the event, as secondhand stories lack the energy needed. The stronger the Legend, the more energy it requires to summon. If you lack mana, you can draw from your stamina instead. Your second ability makes it so that when you sleep, your “Astral Self” travels to other worlds and times, drawn to significant events or places of power. In this dream-state, you can observe—though not interfere with—these events, recording them for your first ability. However, you have no control over where or when you’ll be drawn, and witnessing dangerous events may leave lasting mental scars.
objects.title: The Bard’s Dream

addons.text:
Through interacting with the Threads of Destiny, you have elevated yourself beyond the level of a mere divination mage. You are a seer, and your connection to the future is nigh absolute, making all your future divinations impossible to block or sense, excluding those connected, or disconnected, to fate itself. Not only that, but future divinations are now far easier to do and more accurate. 

Through this connection to the future, you can now naturally gain visions of important events in the near future. This also makes you naturally slightly precognitive, which manifests in a gut instinct of the future. 

Lastly, you have gained a unique and powerful ability—the ability to alter someone's fate itself. By viewing someone's thread of destiny and applying magical energy, you may change the major event in question. At first, you don't have control over how the event actually changes, but with time, you may learn to lean it in a more positive or negative direction. But the more you use this on someone, the harder it will be to use it again, and the more resistant they become to your seer abilities. Overusing it on someone in a short period may result in them gaining a chaotic fate for a period of time, which makes their threads intangible and invisible to you, along with them being more likely to encounter a good fortune or profound misfortune.
addons.title: Fate Weaver

addons.text:
You have now mastered the most basic forms of divination magic and learned to hone them to a very high extent. This includes, but is not limited to, using a crystal ball, tarot cards, palm readings, and you have even learned to act like a medium. You also now excel at using rituals to assist in your divination magic, along with the ability to use magic to prepare the area to make your divination more effective. Lastly, as a result of your namesake, you gain a natural talent for improvisation and cold reading.

You have also been granted magically conductive implements for your basic divinations.
addons.title: Fortune Teller

objects.text:
You are now a master of divination magic and have a talent in all its aspects, which ranges from the simplest of detection spells all the way to viewing the future with clarity. The main way of casting divination magic is through the use of ritualistic magic, which typically has long incantations and requires certain preparations. Some basic forms of divination magic can require little to no incantations or rituals, but rituals and incantations can make them more accurate. Divination magic is divided into three main categories: past, present, and future. Beings who have strong supernatural senses can sense when someone is divining them (directly or indirectly), and if they are significantly stronger or more skilled than you, even block it.

Past-based divination isn’t as widely known or used, but it typically involves divining an area and seeing what recently happened. The farther into the past you want to look, the cloudier and harder it gets.

Present-based divination is by far the most common and widely used. This type of divination is mainly used to detect someone in an area, improve your senses, find something, and scry another area. This category of divination is usually less strict and requires fewer incantations or preparation.

Future-based divination is by far the most well-known and hardest type of divination. This divination gives some type of information about the future. The accuracy of your findings using future divination is based on multiple things, which include the importance of the event, your magical power, your skill, and, most importantly, how far into the future you wish to know about. The less important the information and the farther in the future you wish to know, the less accurate your information is. Even the most accurate future divination magic is vague.

Lastly, you will also learn spells and how to defend against divination-based magic.
objects.title: Divination

objects.text:
This is the art of infusing inanimate objects with a semblance of life and magic.

There are various applications to this, like making disposable minions capable of simple tasks out of all sorts of materials like dirt, fire, water, and air. But you’ll also be able to create what can be described as truly intelligent AI whose programming is made of magic at higher levels.

The bodies of your golems do not need to be mechanically flexible or capable of functioning; a pure metal statue, for example, would flex and move like flesh under the direction of your golem magic. This is important because this power comes with no mechanical or engineering knowledge. Though if you do have any abilities that grant you such technological knowledge, you’ll find that if your golems don’t need to use magic to move their bodies, they’ll be able to use that extra magic for other things like powering enchantments built into their body or spellcasting.

This power comes paired with a minor regenerating reserve of magic, along with some minor talent for spell crafting and enchanting in general, intended to help you advance the capabilities of your golems.

This talent for spell crafting is genuinely minor, meaning you’ll struggle to figure out how to cast a single standard fireball, but can easily and rapidly build over a dozen average golems, which you’ll be able to sustain with your reserve of magical energy.

Your ability to enchant your golems is also quite exceptional. Even just starting, you’ll be able to give your average golem up to three enchantments that give abilities equivalent to 5 SP powers. Though either you or the golem in question will have to power those enchantments one way or another.

Intelligent golems you make can cast spells that you either pre-programmed them to know or they learned after creation.

Two qualities determine the strength of a golem and how much magic it can hold. One is the material its body is made of; dirt, for example, will barely be able to handle 1 or 2 SP enchantments; meanwhile, pure gold makes an excellent golem body able to handle multiple high-level enchantments. The second factor is the quality and efficiency of the magical programming of the golem in question.

If a golem’s programming is awful, it won’t matter if it’s body is made out of the best material possible; it will be entirely dependent on you for direction, being only capable of simple tasks, but as you advance your craft, you’ll be able to make increasingly complex and independent golems who are even able to generate their own magical energy and think for themselves even if they’re made of dirt. Sufficiently advanced magic programming is also able to slowly start surpassing the limitations imposed by a golem’s material quality, though it’ll be months or even years of effort before you’ll be able to start giving a dirt golem enchantments comparable to higher quality materials.

Those qualities are only considering your starting capabilities with this magic. You can modify the magic programming and body of a golem after its creation.

There are ways around having to personally supply basic golems with energy at every moment; for example, you can make them with a magic battery as part of their enchantments. You can also make stations dedicated to passively gathering or generating magical energy that golems with magic batteries can be programmed to go to recharge when low on power.
objects.title: Golemancy

addons.text: You have gained the understanding of how to utilize your knowledge of the cosmos in crafting various magical weapons, tools, and even the Stellar Garbs. Through this, you could perform feats such as making bows that shoot meteors, hammers that create surges of gravity, fans that unleash solar winds, or even scissors that cut through space itself.
addons.title: Stellar Armaments

addons.text: Through the mixing of your Astromancy with Magecraft, you have become an equal to Kirschtaria Wodime, having gained access to all of his skills, power, and knowledge. Furthermore, you can make full use of these capabilities even in locations like modern Earth, unlike Wodime himself, who required the conditions of the Lostbelt to make full use of his Magecraft.
addons.title: Grand Order

addons.text: Through possessing both Astromancy and Nature Magic, you have gained access to the various forms of star-based magic within Warcraft. You could perform divination, call down magic moons and stars, draw power from celestial bodies, and potentially much more.
addons.title: Starcaller

objects.text:
You have gained access to the magic that draws upon and embodies the cosmos, Astromancy.

Through this magic, you draw upon both science and symbolism around cosmic phenomena, objects, and events to form your spells. You could potentially perform feats like creating and summoning meteors, calling down blasts of starlight, summoning based on constellations, crafting miniature planets to call forth buffs or to be used as a projectile, or even drawing power from the stars themselves.

You will begin with a moderate reserve of magical energy, knowledge of one particular cosmic phenomenon, object or event to form your first spells, and a Stellar Garb. The Stellar Garb is a unique set of robes that will change in both appearance and abilities by linking it to a cosmic phenomenon, object or event you are knowledgeable of, such as being red, armored, and increasing your all-around combat capabilities upon being linked to Mars. The power of the change will depend upon your knowledge of the linked subject. The Stellar Garb is considered an OoP.

In time, you could potentially reach the level of a master of this magic, who could perform feats such as creating a localized Big Rip, a miniature Big Bang, or even controllable black holes.
objects.title: Astromancy

addons.text:
Your mastery of the Occult, combined with the raw power of Eldritch Magic, has created a dangerous force. Occult practices like divination, necromancy, and curses are now infused with the alien energy of the Eldritch, elevating them to new and unpredictable heights. Divination unveils not just hidden truths but glimpses of infinite realities, while curses spread madness and corruption like a contagion. Even your tools and rituals have changed, becoming semi-sentient and alive with Eldritch energy, eager to bend reality at your command.

The fusion of these arts allows you to summon and bind terrifying Eldritch entities through your rituals, weaving together Occult precision and otherworldly chaos. The herbs, sigils, and artifacts you grow and nurture will bear traces of alien influence, granting powers that defy natural law while introducing creeping corruption. Rituals can now reshape landscapes, alter time, or even open rifts to other dimensions, but their success is never guaranteed. The volatile combination of these forces means every act of magic risks catastrophic consequences, from uncontrolled dimensional tears to the wrath of incomprehensible beings.
addons.title: Alien Influence

addons.text:
Eldritch magic is no longer something you borrow or desperately force through fragile mortal limits. It is the natural language of your existence, a divine birthright written into your blood by your cosmic lineage. Where cultists scrape fragments of truth from forbidden tomes and risk madness for a glimpse of the infinite, you command these forces instinctively.

Your body and mind are perfectly aligned with the structure of eldritch power. The corruptive strain, memetic madness, and existential erosion that normally accompany this magic simply do not occur when you wield it. Instead, your spells manifest with clarity, stability, and ease that even the greatest cult magi could never achieve. What others require entire cults, sacrifices, and months of preparation to accomplish, you may eventually perform alone through mastery and will.

At higher levels of skill, this birthright allows you to enact truly monumental workings worthy of your lineage. Stable portals spanning interstellar or even interdimensional distances, the fusion or separation of physical and spiritual planes, the rewriting of ecosystems or planetary biospheres into alien forms, and more all fall within your potential.
addons.title: Eldritch Birthright

objects.text:
You unlock magic made to transcend the boundaries of your reality and draw upon unfathomable, otherworldly powers. With this magic, you can unleash devastating blasts of incomprehensible energy, summon horrifying Eldritch Beasts, and manipulate the fabric of existence in ways that defy human understanding. The extent of these abilities is limited only by your skill and the resilience of your own mind.

One of the most fearsome aspects of this magic is the ability to create intricate rituals to call upon the Outer Gods themselves. By forging a pact with one of these beings, you may gain its favor and power, effectively making it your patron. However, such rituals are extremely risky. The presence of an Outer God is a catastrophic force in and of itself, and without proper safeguards, you risk annihilation—body, mind, and soul—or worse, becoming a vessel for its inscrutable will.

The further you immerse yourself in these magics, the more perilous it becomes. The very act of wielding such powers strains the mind and body, and the knowledge itself grows increasingly dangerous as it advances. At higher levels, these eldritch revelations can become memetic in nature, spreading like a virus to others and corrupting them with the same mind-breaking truths. Those who tread this path must do so with caution, for the line between wielding power and succumbing to madness is perilously thin.
objects.title: Eldritch Magic

addons.text: Your particular magical affinities lend you a new ability. You can substitute spell components with varying amounts of explosive material. The more rare the necessary materials, more powerful explosives are required. A common natural material can be replaced with a small charge of gunpowder, while to replace the blood of a god you would need nuclear weapons on par with the strongest ever made. You can also use more explosives to strengthen magical effects, though there are diminishing returns.
addons.title: Needs More Boom

objects.text:
Unlike other magic users that choose a staff or a wand as a spell focus, you have instead chosen the modern option: a gun.

To begin with, you possess the knowledge to convert any modern or past firearms into a spell focus, with futuristic and magitech firearms requiring some research before you can perform the conversion. Along with your new method of spell focus, you have gained knowledge of the versatile spell Mana Bullet and the beginnings of how to further manipulate its properties.

Initially, Mana Bullet will be a spell that fires a bullet made of magical energy whose size and power scale based on the magical energy utilized and the caliber of your gun. Once you begin research, however, it will show its true versatility, by being able to mix and match properties from other spells, materials, items, creatures, and more, such as by studying a sword with the dragon-slayer trait, you could make dragon-slayer mana bullets or by studying a healing potion to make a mana bullet that heals its target.

On top of the abilities mentioned beforehand, you gain the knowledge of how to create Spell Shells and Mana Shells to give a preparatory edge. Firstly, Spell Shells are made by infusing a bullet matching your firearm's caliber with a preset spell and enough magical energy to achieve said spell. Essentially, this allows you to have spells ready even when out of magical energy. Next, Mana Shells are made by infusing a bullet matching your firearm's caliber with as much magical energy as it could handle to amplify your spell casting, notably the amount able to be stored scales with the bullet caliber and your own skill.
objects.title: Gun Magic

addons.text:
You can assume the role of any holiday spirit, such as the Easter Bunny, Jack O’Lantern, Cupid, or even lesser-known cultural icons, inheriting their powers, responsibilities, and resources as you would have as Santa. This includes their unique abilities, magical headquarters, specialised tools, and dedicated workforce.

When you take on a mantle, you fully embody that figure, gaining access to their powers and magical infrastructure. For instance, the Easter Bunny’s super speed, ability to burrow through magical tunnels, and enchanted eggs with effects such as explosions or healing. Or Jack O’Lantern’s control over fear, autumnal forces, and the power to summon illusions and spirits, or even Cupid’s ability to inspire love, resolve conflicts, and mend emotional wounds with enchanted arrows. 

Additionally, you gain access to their magical headquarters, such as Jack O’Lantern’s Halloween Town or the Easter Bunny’s burrow, which serves as your base of operations while embodying that spirit. With those bases are your workforce. The Easter Bunny is assisted by magical rabbits, birds, and spring spirits, Jack O’Lantern has a team of mischievous ghouls, skeletons, and scarecrows, while Cupid has cherubs.

Similarly, your mode of transportation also changes to fit your role, such as the Easter Bunny’s burrow portals, or Jack O’Lantern’s ghostly steed. Your operational base also adapt to fit the role, with sweet shops connect to the Easter Bunny’s Egg Realm, and romantic landmarks resonate with Cupid’s Love Sanctum.

Although you can switch between mantles at will, each transition causes all previous powers, workers, and tools to vanish, replaced entirely by those of the new spirit. Changing roles also requires a brief adjustment period during which your powers are not fully functional.
addons.title: The Holiday Mantle

objects.text: Like countless individuals before you, you have become the spiritual successor of Saint Nicholas of Myra, inheriting all the powers, responsibilities, and characteristics of Santa Claus. How this has come to be is up to you—you may have received this legacy from your father or grandfather, or perhaps you simply donned the suit after the last Santa passed away. Regardless, the duty to spread goodwill and cheer, as well as to deliver presents to countless children around the world, now falls to you. Your primary support comes from the ELFs—Enforcement, Logistics, and Frontline Divisions. These divisions are comprised of a diverse group of beings, ranging from talking penguins and polar bears to humans imbued with Christmas magic and elemental spirits of ice and snow. The Enforcement Division serves as the security force for the North Pole and a bodyguard for you, while the Logistics Division oversees all mail, flight paths, and resupply efforts. The Frontline Division is strategically deployed to facilitate your entry and to conceal your tracks. Assisting you in your mission is the North Pole Complex, which has greatly expanded from its humble beginnings. This small, secret Arctic city-state operates much like a monarchy—without the politics or ceremonies—and it is dedicated to supporting you in your duties. From planning your route to the complex tasks of building, wrapping, and supplying the vast number of gifts you need to deliver, the North Pole has got you covered. One of its most valuable features is that every toy store around the globe acts like an embassy, granting you and your allies immediate passage between all toy stores and the North Pole itself. As the new Santa, you can choose to adopt the iconic appearance associated with Santa Claus or to maintain your own look. Either way, you possess a body capable of withstanding the rigors of the job, allowing you to descend and ascend countless chimneys, endure the cold and wind, navigate the challenges of high-altitude flight, and enjoy all the Christmas "tributes" left out for you without any negative effects. The powers bestowed upon Santa are numerous. Foremost among them is the ability to visit every home in the world in a single night to deliver presents. You also have the unique abilities to "know when you're asleep," and "Know if you've been bad or good" with this you possess the extraordinary capability to compile and check the legendary Naughty List and check it twice—a task so monumental that it would take a normal individual a decade to complete even once. Finally, one of the most beloved elements of Santa Claus lore is associated with "Mrs. Claus." While this power won't provide you with one, you’ll need to seek your own the traditional way, upon finding your "Mrs. (or Mr.) Claus," you will be able to share both the power and the responsibilities of being Santa Claus with them. You and your operatives are equipped with a variety of fantastic and downright magical gadgets and gizmos. This includes technology that can adjust the size of its users or their targets, suits that allow for comfort in any temperature, and vambraces that grant superhuman strength and can temporarily alter reality, making toys real turn into realistic versions of themselves. Your primary mode of transportation for this monumental task is The Sleigh, which is pulled by a team of Magical Reindeer. This sleigh can fly swiftly enough to keep up with fighter jets and can warp space to be invisible from the ground or reach your destination faster. Beyond these details, many aspects of your role are open to your interpretation. If you prefer a fully magical Santa experience, this power will accommodate you. If you envision a more modern approach with supply chains and organizations to support you, that’s also achievable. Even a fully sci-fi Santa experience is possible if that appeals to you.
objects.title: Santa Claus is Coming to Town!

addons.text:
A phoenix is a creature of life, yet you are not that. You are a Dark Phoenix, a dark reflection corrupted by the foul magic of Necromancy.

In addition to your normal flames, you also possess Death Flames. These pale gray flames-altered by the touch of dark magic-are seemingly frigid to the touch, burning ceaselessly without heat or fuel.

These flames no longer heal, instead burning away the lifeforce and soul of anything they touch. They are especially effective against things aligned with the holy and light attributes.
addons.title: Dark Phoenix

addons.text:
As the personification of death and the afterlife, no more you are an affront to the natural cycle of life and death, stabilizing your existence into a Twilight Phoenix, a being that resides perpetually on the boundary between life and death.

As your nature stabilizes, so do your Death Flames, changing once more to become Twilight Flames. These twilight purple flames can burn effectively anything: magic, souls, curses, injuries, even concepts such as space and time. If you can find some way to target it, these flames can burn like kindling.

Additionally, your control over your flames is so precise that you can decide what they do or do not burn, allowing you to perform acts such as burning a parasite infecting someone while leaving the person themself unharmed.
addons.title: Twilight Phoenix

addons.text: As a Phoenix, a creature of Life, your potential in the Force has grown exponentially. Your presence in the Force is not that of a mortal, a shining beacon of Life and Might. For starters, you possess a great affinity for the Living Force and are innately talented with Force techniques relating to Fire and Healing. Additionally, every cell of your body is saturated in the power of the Living Force, providing noticeable physical enhancements. If you were to possess Child of Mortis (Star Wars), then in addition to representing a side of the Force, you would also represent the Living Force. Similarly, possessing the The Living Force addon would amplify your affinity for the Living Force such that your previous affinity would be but a candle in comparison to the bonfire of your current strength. And of course, if you possessed both, it would not be inaccurate to call you the physical manifestation of the Living Force in its entirety.
addons.title: Beacon of Life

objects.text:
You’ve transcended humanity and become something extraordinary—a Phoenix. This legendary flaming bird is renowned for its mastery over fire, unparalleled healing, and immortality through rebirth. You possess two forms: your humanoid form and your Phoenix form. Initially, the size of your Phoenix form varies, but its maximum size can rival the size of buildings. With training, more energy, or access to more flames, this size can grow.

Your abilities include an incredibly rapid healing factor, allowing you to regenerate limbs and organs in mere seconds while instantly neutralizing any ailments or afflictions, whether natural or supernatural—unless they involve something specifically designed to counter immortality. Even then, your ultimate trump card is your refusal to stay dead. Should you die, you automatically resurrect, either instantaneously or after a delay of your choosing. You can revive at the location of your death or a designated place, such as a property, world, or pocket dimension you control.

Your mastery of healing and fire is unmatched. Your flames can heal anyone or anything they touch with the same speed as your own regeneration, even repairing soul damage and corruption. The heat of your flames is intense enough to melt steel with ease, and while they originate from you, once created—or once you take control of nearby fire—they are yours to command.

While your ability to use your fire and healing is immense, it functions more as an affinity than a refined system of techniques. Acquiring fire or healing magic—or magic in general—will greatly enhance both and unlock unique ways to wield your powers.
objects.title: Phoenix

addons.text: Before, your special pool of mana can be used to create your own "custom spells" that grow and improve over time. Now it's expanded to let you create your own Magic System, using any Laws and Concepts you've studied as a foundation. The more of these you know, the more robust your Magic System becomes. They also add more applications to your spells and make it easier to cast them. Studying the concept of Cards, for example, allows you to use them as a conduit, sealing agent, weapon, or any other purpose you can think of in your system. Love lets you perform love-based spells and adds new applications to them related to it, such as being amplified by emotions. A simpler one, like Fire, will let you create complex fire-based spells in no time. But by fully understanding them all, they combine to allow for astonishing feats, like a burning love so great that not even death can stop the person empowered by it, or you can casually summon a powerful fire dragon or love fairy by flicking a card containing it. Since this your Magic System, you decide the rules, limits, spell usage, name and other aspects of it, even ignore them entirely. You can easily teach it to others, awaken their own pools of mana to use it from, and even grant the talent to use it at a certain level. The true strength of a Magic System is the mages who collectively use it, with their own methods and unique ways of applying it, some you might have never thought of before.
addons.title: Essence of the Progenitor Wizard (Essence Meta)

objects.text:
You now possess a pool of mana that only needs a few hours of rest to completely recover—a reservoir of magical energy that allows you to harness and manipulate magic, which can be expanded with regular use and allows for the creation of your own system of spells and other types of magics with minimal limitations besides time, mana, and imagination. While it is imagination, this does not mean you can instantly create any magic you want. What it rather means is that it does not require precise, long calculations or have defined forced rules.

The types of magic you can create can be anything, such as elemental magic, healing, illusions, necromancy, body enhancement, etc. Creating things like runes would be you magically adding spells to specific words or letters of your choice, that will automatically or continuously cast them when written out or fed energy. Creating weaker spells, like a palm-sized fireball, would only take you a few minutes to an hour at most; something like an inferno capable of blowing up a house would take you weeks.

This can be sped up by environmental factors, like studying actual real-world phenomena. It can also be sped up if you happen to have talent in magic.
objects.title: Spell Crafter

objects.text:
The Aurora is kind of ‘planar glue’, fusing the gaps of the multiverse together, the ‘sealent’ one must break through to move between planes of reality. But, as a substance made of pure possibility, it is extremely malleable, and can have serious effects on the surrounding area when dragged to the surface of these realities by those with the talent to call it. Importantly, the Aurora is a distinctly physical phenomenon, unable to source esoteric effects. Instead, calling the Aurora can perform three different, distinct, but reaching effects: Creation, Transmutation, and Manipulation.

Creation is the art of channeling the Aurora into the active creation of physical material; steel, fire, and more are common specialties among Creation-focused mages. Often, however, the material is related to the caster’s personal experience or cultural significance, but this is not strictly necessary to create with the Aurora. Masters of this discipline can reign down storms of fire or feed thousands in a single action.

Transmutation is a similar but separate discipline, instead using the Aurora as fuel to convert an existing material to another. This is by far the rarest of disciplines to find natural talent in, but it is common to see researched due to the capability of Transmuters to mitigate troublesome natural phenomena such as tsunamis or the odd migrating army that hasn’t been turned to salt yet.

Manipulation, meanwhile, is simply calling the Aurora to control what has already been created from its calling. It’s generally accepted that anyone with the talent to call the Aurora will have some skill with manipulation by necessity, though edge cases and outliers are known to exist, such as transmuters who explicitly take the ‘long way round’, simply re-transmuting the same material again and again.

It is also worth noting that self-taught Callers tend to find strange workarounds for their techniques. Where one may create fire by calling the aurora into simply superheating the air until its spontaneous ignition, while another may take two steps to create a spark, and a continually active development of fuel.
objects.title: Calling The Aurora

objects.text:
You are the covering fire of the main character's group—a versatile generalist in terms of skills or a specialist in taking down waves of enemies, as long as you can stay in the fight.

You're a prodigy in all forms of magic, with a large mana pool that grows over time, only needing a few hours of rest to completely recover, and unparalleled talent. You're immune to the usual drawbacks or corruption that magic users often face. Even at the start, your capabilities are astonishing: you can hurl fireballs twice the size of a person, conjure water out of thin air and launch it with the force of a cannonball, unleash lightning from your fingertips, and teleport either to familiar locations or, if you're bold enough, to random ones.

Your magical growth depends entirely on your personal training and the spells you've observed. Reverse-engineering another mage's magic is easy for you, even if it involves complex systems like mathematics or science. Your unique affinity allows you to adapt such spells to work through sheer imagination, or what is more commonly known as soft magic instead. While innate racial magic takes more time and effort to replicate, you can eventually develop alternative versions tailored to your style.

Any magical focus or item you wield—be it wands, enchanted cloaks, or magic rings—becomes more potent in your hands, amplifying its effects to be better than it would normally be.
objects.title: The Mage

addons.text:
You've been promoted to a Cleric—a priest(ess) acknowledged by your Patron Deity as the best candidate to enact their will. Thus, they've gifted you with a significant portion of their power, enough to elevate your effectiveness as a White Mage manifold, and create miracles in their name. The range of just a normal healing circle can easily extend to over 1000 meters, and be so effective that even rotten corpses will revive back to their former glory.

This further reinforces the connection with your deity. Allowing you both to interact in the waking world through prayer, receive messages from them as telepathy or visions, grant you various blessings, and even summon the deity to assist you in the battle. You also add their power to your own as more abilities for your repertoire, based on the domains the deity rules over and their overall nature. 

As they grow more powerful, so to does these abilities and the more they can grant you. Some examples are spells powerful enough to smite demons in one blow, a purification ritual to purge all forms of malevolent energies, alchemy to make holy water as a powerful elixir, or gifting you a divine relic of their own design.

Finally, you a become a great evangelist for their religion, easily able to captivate a crowd of people and convert many of them into followers of your deity.
addons.title: Cleric

objects.text:
You are the healer—the White Mage of a hero's party, the priest(ess) of some fantasy religion, or another support character who specializes exclusively in healing and supportive magic. By default, you are at your strongest when healing a specific individual within a foot of you. However, your effective range extends up to 100 meters in all directions, with the strength of your healing and supportive spells increasing in intensity as the target gets closer to you.

Your repertoire includes spells to mend lacerations, restore lost body parts (even without the original part), repair soul damage, cure ailments and negative effects, undo transmogrification, and even resurrect the recently deceased. The speed of these spells varies: at your maximum range, they may take hours to complete, while for someone nearby, they can work in mere seconds.

Beyond healing, you also have supportive spells. You can temporarily accelerate a target's speed by manipulating time, create shields that halve all physical or magical damage, cast wards to render them immune to specific elements temporarily, and imbue them with enhanced strength or other buffs.

While this makes you the ultimate healer and support member for any aspiring hero, your powers are more of an affinity than a magic system. If you were to obtain a magical system or simply possess a pool of magical energy, your abilities and potential range would be significantly amplified. For instance, your resurrection spells would no longer be constrained by how long someone has been deceased. Furthermore, you would enhance any healing or support spells from other systems beyond their normal limits or create new ones, provided they focus on healing and buffing rather than combat or debilitation.

A side effect of this affinity is that you're one of, if not the best, user for holy items, divine blessings and are generally well-liked by holy or divine beings.
objects.title: White Mage

addons.title: Fully Automated Magic
addons.text:
Your Unique Skills merge with Green Magic to create a much grander system that optimizes and adds new options for it. Beyond simply amplifying the effects of your magic and weakening hostile phenomena directed at you, your magic itself becomes automatic. To the point of mistaking it for being alive.

Within your radius, specific spells from your arsenal can automatically activate in response to any phenomena within it. Such as amplifying the attack output of your Sorcerer ally at the exact moment they unleash their strongest spell, reinforcing the shield of your Paladin ally and weakening the attack their protecting the party from at the same time, or using a chain of specific debuffs that prove supernaturally effective against your enemy.

However, keep in mind that the magic cannot account for anything outside of your radius unless you make it wider—which you can do by either pouring mana into expanding it temporarily, or training to permanently expand it overtime. Your magic also smart enough to treat all allies in your radius as extensions of yourself and remember them, so they receive just as much attention from it as you. Likewise, hostiles within the radius will be dealt with in the most efficient and effective way possible, while accounting for optimal mana expenditure and other factors.

You still have complete control over your magic despite all of this, so you won't accidentally waste a spell or miscast at inappropriate moments if you wouldn’t have intended to.

objects.text:
Maybe you're a pacifist, or maybe you just want to style on enemies by beating them without directly harming them.

Either way, you've chosen the path of the Green Mage. This path works by utilizing spells that solely buff allies or debuff enemies. For buffs, this can vary from simply increasing a target's physical or magical defense to speeding up time for them to move faster. More advanced spells could allow you to greatly increase their strength by casting Bravery, make an ally's spells cost zero mana for a time, or temporarily grant someone complete immunity to a specific element, such as Null Ice.

For debuffs, the theme is weakening your enemies—slowing them down with time magic, putting them to sleep, drenching them in oil to be set on fire by someone else, making them confused, or even shredding their physical or magical defense. More advanced spells could allow you to turn foes into zombies so that healing spells hurt them, shut down their ability to attack, petrify them, or even charm them into attacking their allies.

You start with a moderate amount of mana that will grow over time, and you have the capability to create more Green Magic as long as it stays within the restrictions of how such magic functions—that is, Green Magic can only be used to enhance allies or disrupt foes, never to directly harm or heal a target. More powerful spells will cost more mana to cast.

On top of all this, any other magics or powers you possess allow you to easily create more Green Magic based on them or even enhance any powers you have, as long as they follow the Green Magic rule. Your spells can be cast on yourself.
objects.title: Green Mage

addons.text: You've become the Ultimate Spellblade—a hybrid class of mages who blend physical combat with magical prowess, represented by their use of weapons as a focus instead of traditional staffs or wands. In a sea of such mages, you are a Master of All, capable of using any weapon as a medium for magic, and be just as effective with it in all forms of combat. On top of that, your skill with any magical or martial discipline is now comparable to that of masters of those fields, with dedicated study in them elevating you to directly match or surpass them. As a side effect of Master of None, all other skills you have can rise to match your current proficiency in your best skill, translating your mastery of marksmanship for bows into swordplay or elemental magic easily. You can also just as easily combine both for a various feats like infusing a spear with fire magic, shooting debuff arrows, creating an arc of wind from a sword slash, or extending your blade's reach by a few meters. Even your miscellaneous skills have elevated, with enhanced mental functions to rapidly improve your understanding to the point of a local expert, becoming a highly skilled navigator, strategist, crafter, etc. Though you must still actually learn the skill, your foundation will give a greater headstart in studying them. The last and most dangerous aspect of you, is not only the sheer variety of tools within you, but how you use them. With your adaptability becoming the stuff of legend.
addons.title: Spellblade

objects.text:
Why dedicate yourself solely to being a healer or damage dealer? Why even focus solely on just being a squishy mage when you can get up close and personally beat down any meathead warrior stupid enough to think rushing the "mage" before they cast their spell is the way to go?

You've begun the path of the Red Mage—jack-of-all-trades and master-of-none. You're not the best at buffing or healing allies, weakening foes, slinging fireballs, or even necessarily the strongest physically. But you make up for it in sheer variety. You know enough healing spells to deal with minor and even somewhat pressing wounds and sicknesses—not to the point of regenerating limbs or raising the dead, but healing a broken arm or torn muscles is possible. You know multiple elemental spells up to the level of an average magician in casting them; you may not be dropping meteors or blowing up houses with fireballs, but you can definitely light someone on fire.

With your knowledge of buffing yourself with spells, enhancing your body with magic, and weakening your foes, you're capable of performing enough superhuman feats to outrun cars, lift a couple of hundred pounds, and create barriers capable of stopping force up to that of a cannonball. All of this runs on your mana, which starts big enough to cast a couple of dozen spells before needing a few hours of rest—this grows with use and over time.

But that's not all. You being the Red Mage means that any other powers or magics you may have will allow you to easily learn or make new abilities that are the equivalent of the average of that power. It is possible, if you're talented beyond being a Red Mage, to actually become jack-of-all-trades and master of many, if not all.
objects.title: Red Mage

addons.text:
Instead of relying on chance or defeating monsters, you can directly choose what abilities you wish to take from them. The rule of only one ability per monster still applies, but now the methods of attaining it are as simple as direct observation and/or touching the monster. Afterwards, you may freely choose what aspect of them you wish to inherit. 

This aspect will manifest as both the natural effects of Take Over Magic, and a spell or other ability based on the monster. What aspects you can take are immediately beamed into your head upon touch, or gradually reveal themselves through observation, even if the monster hasn't showcased them yet. Furthermore, you aren't limited to transforming into a single monster but can take the traits of multiple at the same time, becoming an anthropomorphic chimera.

Due to your foundation as a Blue Mage, the amount of mana needed to use Take Over Magic is reduced significantly, allowing you to use the forms and powers of higher tier monsters more easily. Though the gap of their power level and your mana reserves still remain.
addons.title: Take Over: Blue Soul

objects.text: "Know thy enemy and know yourself; in a hundred battles, you will never be defeated." — Sun Tzu You took this philosophy to heart. Starting with a moderate amount of mana and a dream of being the very best, you've taken on the path of the Blue Mage. Instead of just sitting in a library learning spells from books, you have the ability to learn the spells, abilities, skills, and powers of monsters. By defeating a monster, there is a small chance that you will learn an ability. If you instead allow them to use an ability on you, there is an even higher chance you will learn it. That chance further increases based on how dangerous the monster is relative to the world it exists in. There is no actual limit on what you can learn from monsters, but it is both random whether you learn something and whether it is the correct ability you want. You can only learn one ability from a monster; this doesn't stop you from fighting another monster of the same species to learn more. As a bonus, you start out knowing the Water Cannon spell. Not the strongest, but it will help you get started on your path toward greatness.
objects.title: Blue Mage

addons.text: You took this role to gain power, and have vowed to obtain it no matter what. By embracing and accepting the true nature of magic, you're set to gain power that leaves even the greatest of archmages in awe. Your prodigious skill quickly turns you into a master of occult practices, and have transformed them into new additions to your arsenal. Unlike lesser occultists, you won't need to fear the wrath of misusing it, having already studied its workings. Blending your exceptional magical power with the versatility of occultic arts. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that you're beloved by the forces of darkness, as even the devil himself will grant you much more favor than any other foolish mortal who'd attempt to summon him. Note: If you have the Trained Occultist Addon, all of these effects are exponentially amplified, and if you took the Demonology or Theurgy Upgrades, then angels and demons become your friends on the other side.
addons.title: Diabolist

addons.text:
Your bond with the devil deepens, as you aren't just their broker. You're their warlock. As a token of that, they've shared a significant portion of their power with you. As you perform rites in their name, both of you will grow in power. 

This can result in making your already potent arsenal even more powerful, gaining new spells derived from the devil's domains, rituals that summon lesser demons loyal to you, the gift of immortality, and much more. At your current power, you can defeat an army of one hundred well trained mages effortlessly.

Finally, you can summon the devil to assist you in battle or they can choose to manifest themself into the real world. Usually as a spirit that only you can see, unless you grant that sight to others.
addons.title: Infernal Patron

addons.text:
The principles of Cursed Energy has opened new doors for you as a Black Mage. To start, your physical power now matches your magical might, eliminating the main weakness of your profession, and Cursed Energy itself becomes a renewable and more malleable source of mana for you.

Your spells can be fueled, amplified, and augmented through raw negativity instead of just mana. Causing an explosion spell with a hefty mana cost to now require only half as much or less, and become even more powerful through raw skill in Cursed Energy. If you have a Cursed Technique, you can apply this principle to make it more powerful and versatile, or even make your own. It's also possible to recreate the many techniques shown throughout Jujutsu Kaisen as spells or any other facet of magic. 

When enough Cursed Energy is cultivated in a certain area, a Cursed Spirit is born. You have weaponized this knowledge to create or summon Shikigami of your own design as familiars, or even tame Cursed Spirits and entities similar to them. With none of the mind games or risks that come from dealing with higher powers, as they are loyal to you.
addons.title: Black Sorcerer

objects.text:
Instead of most mages who focus on providing support, or specific niches, you perfer to take the frontlines, and have chosen to become a Black Mage. This path has lead to you dabbling into the ancient and darker aspects of magic, but the results speak for themselves. 

You can cast a wide array of offensive and destruction based spells to overwhelm your enemies with tremendous force, and self buffs that amplify both physical and magical might. Some examples are fireballs that explode on impact, lightning that takes the shape of a dragon, gusts of wind that cuts the air itself, or condensing raw magic and releasing it to create a miniature explosion. At your peak, you'd be capable of raining meteors from the heavens, causing local earthquakes, raising an army of undead, manipulating the soul, and much more. 

You can easily overpower an average mage with just the raw strength of your magic alone, and will only grow more powerful with time and training. However, true growth comes from fully embracing the dark side of magic and the risks that come with it. As of now, you can comfortably perform most feats of black magic without worry. 

Due to your familiarity with Black Magic, you are a prodigy in all things related to it—Necromancy, Summoning Demons, Curses, Voodoo, etc—and can mitigate or avoid most harmful effects that would befall lesser mages. As such, you know how to handle cursed artifacts, or anything similar, and even turn them into weapons of unimaginable terror.
objects.title: Black Mage

objects.text:
You were the lazy one compared to your peers, and to be fair, they were half-right. But seriously, why go through all the effort of asserting your own will over magic when you can have others do it for you?

That's the philosophy you developed as a Purple Mage, one who dominates the wills of those around them into doing their bidding. Learning many spells necessary to achieve such, but true mind control is still long out of your reach. For now, you can induce various subtle effects within sentient creatures that sway them in your favor, without compromising their own sense of self. 

Charm spells that make a target more susceptible to your advances; Perception spells that induce a variety of sensations, or mess with their sense of reality; Domination spells that compel a target to obey a single command or temporarily overwrite their will; Memory Manipulation spells to create false memories, or make them forget recent events; Hypnosis spells to implant ideas into their subconscious that slowly change them overtime, etc.

You can combine this with other kinds of magic or other powers for more versatility. For example, you can use Alchemy to create potions that can quickly become a vice your client is willing to pay any price for. While with Summoning Magic or Necromancy, you can bind familiars to your will much more easily or create internal mechanisms that make your undead army much more coordinated and dangerous. 

You are most effective on creatures with lesser intelligence than humans, but in time, you can waltz right up to a king and have him become your puppet in the open, with all witnesses present simply accepting it.
objects.title: Purple Mage

objects.text:
You are a mage who specializes in the manipulation, transmutation, and creation of technology through magical means. As a foundation, you can channel magic through technology to interface, control, or give commands to it. You also have a natural talent for understanding and reverse engineering any kind of technology given enough time. 

Your mental facilities have increased exponentially in correlation, allowing you to learn, recall, and memorize vast amounts of information for all things relating to technology. Keep in mind that functions as an addon to your brain rather than an overhaul of it. So outside of your expertise, your cognitive abilities are unchanged.

Through this understanding, you can use magic to create various spells based on aspects of technology, shape and alter it into different forms while retaining all of its functions, conjure components or a perfect replica of said technology, create new or derivative versions, reinforce it to create upgrades or evolved forms, disassemble and reassemble one machine into a completely different one, and much more.

Your own mana is an exceptionally potent power source for all forms of technology, even a drop of it is enough for a modern laptop or smartphone to remain fully charged and run at peak performance for a week with no issues. It can also purify rust, reverse wear and tear, clean, and passively enhance the quality of technology overtime.

Your milage depends on your level of understanding with technology as a whole, imagination, and mana capacity. Conjuring an advanced supercomputer will be impossible if you don't even know what a normal computer looks like, how it functions, or have the necessary amount of mana to create it.
objects.title: Cyan Mage

addons.text:
You take the brute force methodology and pour it through the Battle Mage framework, creating something that has no right to exist. You are an archmage who has never studied, a genius who cannot explain how any of it works, only that it does work and that it works harder than anyone else's.

First, every spell you brute force to a higher level hits with significantly more raw power than before, all without any additional cost beyond what it already demands. Your mastered fireball is not just equal to a real fire mage's; it is noticeably larger, hotter, and more destructive. Second, any spell you successfully brute force, no matter how complex or subtle, becomes accessible through the same instinctive casting used for Battle Mage. You are no longer limited to Battle Mage’s “Bigger Explosions is Better Magic” philosophy anymore. Subtle magic, defensive magic, utility magic, all of it can now be deployed in combat with no cast time, no tells, no warning.

You still keep your limitations. Your foundations are still cracked and shaky, every spell still costs grotesquely more mana than it should and the bottlenecks still exist.
addons.title: Magic Ooga Booga

objects.text:
You are a mage forged in the crucible of war, one who channels the raw forces of magic not into delicate enchantments or abstract manipulations, but into raw, brute power. You are the barbarian of the arcane world. Where others might weave subtle illusions or summon fragile constructs, you favour the philosophy that “big spell go boom” represents the highest form of magical refinement.

Your magic is a visceral extension of your body, a tool for smashing through enemies rather than weaving clever solutions. Every spell you wield is built to augment your prowess in battle—wind spells sharpen your speed and reflexes, lightning dances across your weapon to pierce armor, stone magic thickens your skin and strengthens your armor, and fire clings to your blade, turning each swing into a blazing arc of destruction. These spells are cast through sheer will, requiring no chants, incantations, or named invocations—just instinct and immediate release.

You begin your path with only the simplest of elemental enhancements—coating weapons with flame or charging them with a jolt of lightning, and the ability to infuse mana into your body and weapon to reinforce them and increase your physical capabilities. Your mana pool is respectable, able to sustain around a dozen minor augmentations before exhaustion sets in. It is enough to get the job done, but you are far from your peak. With time and experience, you’ll learn to channel greater quantities of power and your well of mana will steadily expands.

Alongside your magic, you gain the well-trained body and instincts of a decently experienced warrior. While not a master of arms, your training is solid enough to make full use of your magically enhanced strength. This magic also adapts easily to other magic systems or supernatural powers, and if desired, you may channel alternate forms of energy to fuel your spells.
objects.title: Battle Mage

objects.text:
You have the ability to summon grimoires that contain between three and twelve spells, or up to three incantations that allow for more free-form magic, or up to five rituals that can be used to bolster the other two, with the specific amount depending on how strong they are. You can search the library for specific tomes for keywords or spells, summon specific tomes or make a simple request, and the library will select the best match. The grimoires can float in the air in a twenty-five-meter radius from you, and you have precise control over their position in that space. You have a minor ability to multitask to coordinate the position of your grimoires.

You also gain a pool of essence to fuel your magic. It has enough capacity to fuel around a dozen weak spells at first and will slowly grow over time. The starts to pool quickly recharge when you stop casting spells for five seconds or more, and takes around ten seconds to completely refill, no matter the capacity.

To cast the spells written in the grimoires, you can either hold the grimoire in one hand and use the other to "pull" the spell from the pages or remotely cast the spell from a floating grimoire. The stronger the spell is, the longer it will take to cast, ranging from instant to several seconds. Some complex spells or rituals might require multiple grimoires placed in specific ways to form the full spell. When cast, a spell consumes an amount of essence that matches its strength, and it will be on cooldown for two seconds for weak spells and up to twenty for powerful spells.

At first, you can only cast the spells that are on the visible pages, but as you gain mastery over each grimoire, you will be able to cast all the spells from a single page, then with the book closed but still held in your hands, and then with the book on your person. You can also use a focus like a wand or staff to channel the spells. With time, you will be able to use meta-magic to modify the spells you cast with a variety of modifiers such as increasing the number of projectiles, changing the element, or combining multiple spells.

The Libra Arcana synergizes with other magic systems you have access to and fills the library with spells from those systems. You are also able to summon blank grimoires to inscribe with spells of your own creation. If you do not have access to any magic systems, the Libra Arcana will fill the library with a generic magic system. That system starts at the same strength as the Magik power but with a wider array of spells and grows slower than average.
objects.title: Liber Arcana

objects.text:
You have the ability to summon magical foci, objects that are used to channel or enhance magical abilities, for any magic system you have access to. They often take the forms of wands or staves, but this usually depends on the tradition; some use rings, gloves, or even gemstones.

By default, this power will create a generic focus compatible with you, made from commonly available materials: a carved oak staff with a quartz crown, a pine wand with unicorn tail hair, and engraved iron rings. You can improve the quality of the focus you summon by absorbing rare materials like samples or rare woods, precious metals or gemstones, parts of magical creatures, etc. This power can also absorb any focus you create and reproduce it faithfully.
objects.title: Virga Arcana

objects.text:
You become a practitioner of jewel magic, the art of using gemstones to focus your magic, cast spells, and store mana.

The primary method of casting spells is through the use of magic jewels, high-quality gemstones imbued with the magic of a specific type, which allow the user to channel that element in their spells. For example, a ruby attuned with fire would allow the caster to throw fireballs or create walls of fire. Jewels can be combined to create more varied effects, such as a fire ruby and a wind emerald to cast a fire storm.

Another use for jewels is to store spells for later use. Since they are single-use, lower-quality or value stones are often used. When the jewel is crushed or thrown, the stored spell will trigger. They can also be used as traps when paired with a trigger mechanism.

Some practitioners, often those who do not have access to a regular supply of gemstones, are also able to create gemstones out of their own crystalized mana. These jewels are only 80% as powerful as mined or alchemically synthesized stones, but have the advantage of not draining your wallet, only your mana core.

Finally, the last use is to create mana batteries. While you have a mana core, it is not optimized for directly casting spells. At most, you will be able to cast a dozen spells before you need to rest for an hour.

However, you can refill a capacitor capable of fueling the same number of spells in five minutes. It takes you ten to twenty minutes to crystallize your mana into a gemstone, depending on the size, and imbuing takes another ten minutes. 

You begin with a comprehensive understanding of jewel magic principles, advanced knowledge of three elements, and basic knowledge of the rest. Your spell repertoire reflects this and includes all basic spells and a dozen advanced spells for each of your specialized elements.

You also start with 6 flawless gemstones already imbued with elements of your choice, 12 quartz mana batteries with a capacity for sixteen spells each, and 48 minor gemstones ready to be loaded with spells, two small bracelets with three gem slots each, two leather cords with six gem holders, all stored in a small belt pouch with compartments.

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Jewel Magic

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge to create magic runes, stones imbued with magic that are used to store spells.

You know how to prepare regular stone into blank runes using a simple spell. One cast can transform 500 grams of granite into 25 blank runes.

You begin with a basic understanding of runic spells, which allows you to imbue blank runes with a variety of spells: elemental attacks, magical barriers, status effects, and healing. You also have the necessary knowledge to develop more powerful runic spells.

One imbued rune can store one spell with multiple charges, up to twenty for weaker spells and as few as one for powerful spells. After the charges are exhausted, the rune crumbles to dust. To cast stored spells, you need to be in physical contact with the rune.

The easiest way is to hold the rune in your hand. Some users of magic runes have also developed special accessories, like gloves and bracelets, that allow them easy access to their runes.

You have the blueprints for the basic variants that can be built out of widely available materials like cloth and leather.
objects.title: Rune-Smith

addons.text:
Your familiar becomes something more, a conduit to a mysterious and otherworldly power, which grants you access to spells and hexes when you commune with it. Initially, you are not aware of the identity of your patron, only its general nature. As you grow, you can seek out the truth and learn about the source of your magic, or choose to remain blissfully ignorant, it is entirely up to you.

You start with the ability to cast 5th level spells, your patron also grants you specific spells tied to its nature in addition to your base slots.
addons.title: Witch (Pathfinder)

addons.text:
As a Shaman, you do not call upon the gods but form a close bond with the spirits of nature, which grants you power. Your familiar becomes a spirit animal, the conduit that allows you to commune with the spirits.

Initially, you form a lasting bond with one nature spirit. As you grow in power, you will be able to deepen that bond and access the greater and true form of your spirit, granting you access to additional spells, hexes, and more powerful abilities. In your travels, you can also form bonds with wandering spirits and gain access to their spells and hexes. The more powerful you are, the more spirits you can bond with.

You start with the ability to cast 5th level spells, your bonded spirits also grant additional spells and hexes. You can learn any of the standard shaman and witch hexes from your bonded spirit.
addons.title: Shaman (Pathfinder)

objects.text: You become a fledgeling witch and gain access to hexes, the magic unique to witches, and a cute familiar of your choice, who is both a faithful companion and repository of magical knowledge. Unlike other magic users, you do not have a singular mana pool. Instead, each of your hexes has its own energy reserve and recovery rate. You have basic knowledge of hex-craft and an intuition on how to progress to improve; the discipline, while formalized to a degree, is highly personal and your discoveries might not always match with those of another witch. A hex is composed of two main parts, the first is are roots that defines the primary function of the hex (such as fire or ice, healing, barrier, curse, etc.), and the second are the branches that give the hex its various functions. As a witch develops their skills, they can improve their existing hexes to add new branches and even develop new roots. For example, you could have a hex with the fire root and branches that allows throwing fireballs, laying down a wall of fire, or creating a nova around you. As you improve your hexes, they will increase in tiers, which allow more branches, but not more roots; each tier signifies a qualitative improvement of the hex, making the branches more versatile, and also increases the base power of the hex by 20%. There are three types of hexes: minor hexes, which have a low mana cost, a small mana pool that recharges quickly (20-30 uses with a 2 minute recharge time), they can have one root and three branches per tier with a maximum tier of 9; major hexes, which have a medium mana cost, a larger mana pool with a slower recharge rate (10-15 uses with a 2 hour recharge time), they are can have two roots and six branches per tier with a maximum tier of 6; and grand hexes, which have the highest mana cost, the largest mana pool with the slowest recharge rate (5-8 uses with a 20 hour recharge time), they can have three roots and nine branches per tier with a maximum tier of 3. At most, you can have 5 minor hexes, 3 major hexes, and 1 grand hex active at the same time; however, the repository within your familiar can store any number of formulas. You can commune with your familiar to swap out active hexes and create new ones. No matter the species, your familiar has near-human intelligence and is capable of following complex orders, but isn't otherwise stronger than a regular animal. If your familiar is killed, you can bring it back with a simple ritual during the witching hour (between 3 and 4 AM). You start out with three hexes of your choice, 2 minor hexes with two branches and 1 major hex with a single branch, all at tier one. (If you are allergic to cats or ravens, you can substitute the familiar for a grimoire, which only acts as a repository for formulas; hat sold separately.)
objects.title: Hex Witch

objects.text: Your Diet has become slightly arcane. When you encounter Arcane and Esoteric energies, your body actively works to absorb and metabolise them. The Energy absorbed is stored internally, allowing it to be used to amplify your physical abilities, power other magics, or enhance other abilities you possess temporarily. Energy that goes unused will be metabolised by your body, working to keep you in peak physical health, youth and make you resistant to harmful magical effects in that order of priority.
objects.title: Thaumavore

addons.text:
It appears that the bloodline you’ve inherited isn’t from some ordinary specimen of the species but from the pinnacle of its kind, a being worthy of myth and legend.

If you possess an angelic bloodline, it is not drawn from some humble celestial servant but from an Archangel, a radiant paragon of divine might. Demonic heritage? Your lineage doesn't trace back to just any infernal creature but to one of the 72 Demon Lords of Hell or perhaps a living embodiment of the Seven Deadly Sins themselves. A sea serpent bloodline? You may well descend from the likes of Leviathan or Jörmungandr, titanic entities that reign over the oceans with absolute supremacy.

Thanks to this exalted pedigree, every benefit normally granted by Bloodline Sorcery is amplified many times over. You also gain access to a fearsome ability known as Bloodline Suppression, a potent aura of raw dominance that weakens, terrifies, and bends the wills of those with lesser bloodlines before you.

No matter which path you choose, Hybridization or Atavism, you retain only the strengths of your bloodline, shedding its former flaws and vulnerabilities. With time, your power will soar beyond imagination until even the legendary being from whom your bloodline originates becomes a shadow in your wake.
addons.title: Exalted Pedigree

addons.text:
You are not the child of a mere supernatural being, but the child of a being who holds authority over a part of reality itself. Your demigod heritage has evolved, further enhancing your superhuman physiology, slowing your aging once you reach your prime, and strengthening your connection to all your divine and demigod abilities. Through this improved connection, you have learned the truth about all manifestations of demigod abilities. They are, in essence, a form of Innate Sorcery that ordinary demigods only have fragmented access to.

Unlike them, you can use your Bloodline Sorcery to tap into any of your parent’s Domains to manifest miracles and magic. What you can achieve depends on the Domain you are channeling, your understanding of and connection to it, your willpower and intent, and the effect you wish to bring forth. This allows you to manifest your parent’s Domains in far more unique and versatile ways than the average demigod.

Unlike other Bloodline Sorcerers, you are naturally Hybridizing by gradually attuning yourself to your parent’s Divinity through time and use. However, due to your natural affinity for hybridization and the uniqueness of Deities, Atavism is far more challenging. Though if you succeed despite this difficulty, you will instead become a new Deity in your own right with new Domains rather than becoming your parent. There is one exception to this: if your parent does not exist as a Deity or is dead, then you may take up their Mantle, becoming the Divine Heir of your parent. While this won't immediately grant you the full power of your parent, being their recognized heir will make you grow up to their power far faster.
addons.title: Divine Sorcerer

objects.text:
You have become a Bloodline Sorcerer, a mage infused with the essence of powerful, mystical beings coursing through your veins.

Whether this Bloodline was passed down from your ancestors or acquired through arcane experimentation and self-alteration, the result is the same: your body and soul have transformed on a fundamental level. Your magical prowess and potential have surged dramatically, and your physical capabilities have been enhanced to superhuman levels.

Like many magical creatures that grow stronger with age and maturity, you possess a similar trait.
