Additionally, your bloodline grants you heightened affinity toward particular types of spells and elemental magic, depending on your lineage. A sorcerer with a fire elemental bloodline excels in pyromancy, while one with angelic heritage might be a prodigy in holy magic. Those with infernal blood could easily master the dark arts.

Beyond these general enhancements, you possess a gift known as Innate Sorcery, powerful abilities that feel as natural as breathing. Unlike conventional spells, these abilities require minimal stamina or magical energy to wield and can be activated at will without incantations or gestures. Your bloodline shapes the nature of your Innate Sorcery: a draconic sorcerer, for instance, might unleash devastating dragon breath, transform their hands into claws sharp enough to rend steel, grow scales for protection, or even temporarily assume the form of a dragon itself.

Collectively, these powers grant you a formidable edge in combat, outclassing other mages of equivalent skill and experience. As you delve deeper into your bloodline’s potential, two paths of progression will emerge before you: Hybridization and Atavism.

Hybridization allows you to merge your original race with that of your bloodline, gaining some of its unique traits and powers without fully abandoning your natural form. This path keeps you adaptable, unshackled by the limitations of the original creature while offering the potential to forge your own destiny, perhaps even surpassing the source of your bloodline.

On the other hand, Atavism grants complete metamorphosis into the being from which your bloodline originates. This transformation bestows upon you all the strengths and abilities of the original creature but also binds you to its inherent weaknesses and limitations.

Because your power is woven into your very genetics, any children you may have will inherit your bloodline and all the gifts that come with it. If you possess other powers that turn you into a magical creature, this will also amplify your innate abilities, stacking strength upon strength.
objects.title: Bloodline Sorcerer

addons.text:
Your ability to shape your mana has expanded, allowing you to manifest almost any physical object, such as clothes, swords, shields, or even something more complex with a bit of practice.

These objects are truly physical and do not require further mana to sustain themselves. They can even spend some of the imbued mana to repair themselves when damaged at the possible cost of their density and structural integrity.

You maintain a connection with every created object, allowing you to control them or channel mana into them remotely. Additionally, you can issue your mana and force constructs simple commands that they would follow, such as "Track that target", "Defend me", etc.
addons.title: Mana Shaping

objects.text:
You can now cast Force Magic, shaping raw energy into forms like magic missiles, protective shields, or chains of force. With enough focus, you can mold your magic into nearly any shape or structure—but the more complex the spell, the higher the cost in both energy and skill.

You begin with basic proficiency, able to fire magic missiles and create simple barriers with ease. More advanced spells, however, will take time and practice to master.

Force Magic draws power from both your soul and body. A typical human could cast a few dozen spells before reaching exhaustion. You will naturally recover with rest, and as your skill grows, the energy cost of your spells will gradually decrease.

Inherently neutral and highly adaptable, Force Magic can be seamlessly combined with other magic systems or supernatural powers. You may also choose to channel other types of supernatural energy to fuel your Force Magic if desired.
objects.title: Force Magic

objects.text:
Born of jesters, prophets, and madmen, the Clown walks the line between the sacred and the absurd. In many cultures, they are ridiculed or feared, yet their presence marks the turning of fate’s wheel. You are now also a Clown.

The core of your class is drawn from chaos—not the shapeless kind, but the focused, deliberate absurdity that reveals truth through laughter. Humor is your medium; when wielded correctly, it undermines the laws of magic, logic, and even emotion. The strength of your magic is determined by how funny, surprising, or unsettling your acts are. Your magic responds not to incantation, but to performance—the stronger the reaction you provoke, the more reality itself bends to your will.

Your class is somewhat varied in abilities, though all stem from performance. Some Clowns rely on deception and disruption, using illusion and mimicry to twist perception and challenge authority. Others train in athleticism and flair, treating combat like theater, weaving through blades and danger as if every move is part of a show. These types may wear elaborate costumes, speak in riddles, or duel in crowded plazas while never dropping character.

Some Clowns channel sorrow and longing instead, using melancholic storytelling and visible vulnerability to sway the emotions of those around them. These are often healers or mourners who turn grief into strength, mending spirits through shared pain. And others command entire legions of traveling carnivals and conjured spectacles, surrounding themselves with conjured crowds, animated props, or ghostly troupes. All paths are united by their reliance on reaction—your magic does not demand belief, only attention. 

You possess the knowledge to walk all these paths at their simplest form. Whether twisting perception, dancing through danger, evoking sorrow, or conjuring spectacle, the fundamentals are yours to wield. As your skill in comedy and showmanship deepens, so too will your power. The stage is yours, and every reaction is a spell waiting to be cast.

This also comes with a complete Clown costume set, tailored to your preferred style and makeup. It shifts subtly to suit your persona in each performance, becoming bright and gaudy, tattered and haunted, or austere and surreal as needed. It is your mask, your banner, and your skin. Treat it with care.
objects.title: Clown

objects.text:
Have you ever been reading a story that seemed to be purely mundane when something happened that makes you question “wait, was magic real the whole time?” What you’ve been given is the power to channel that confusing grey area. You can do things that seem like they should be impossible, with the important limitation that you aren’t able to do anything that would be clearly supernatural.

Talk to someone in their mind? They might just be imagining what you would say or interpreting subtle signals, so sure. Appear in a locked room? You theoretically could have snuck in somehow, probably, maybe. Make the skies go dark for a bit? Pushing it, but a cloud could have gone in front of the sun while everyone was looking at you. Just don’t expect to be throwing fireballs unless you’re in a situation where that could make sense somehow.

If you’re in a world where magic is a known quantity then methods of detecting magic will return inconclusive results when analyzing the things you do.
objects.title: Maybe Magic, Maybe Mundane

objects.text:
You’ve become a mage, but unlike your peers who generate or absorb magical energy, you've chosen to manipulate the ambient magic already present in the environment. You don’t use your own reserves; instead, you control and direct the energy that already exists around you. This grants you precise influence over leylines, magical fields, and naturally occurring flows of magic. Because you aren’t producing or holding power yourself, you're much harder to detect through magical means.

Your abilities become stronger in worlds with high ambient magic. In places where magic is thick in the air or ground, your control expands significantly. You can also interact with solidified magic, such as crystals made of pure magical energy. These can be used as power sources or weapons depending on how you manipulate their stored energy. You can discharge, redirect, or repurpose their magic without destroying them. However, in mundane worlds with little to no ambient energy, this power is nearly useless. Without existing magic to draw from, you have nothing to work with.

You gain no built-in knowledge of spells or systems when you acquire this ability. However, by studying how magic moves through others and the world around you, you can gradually learn how to use that universe’s magical rules. This allows you to pick up techniques over time and adapt your control to local conditions. You can also sense magic with extreme accuracy, detecting spells, enchantments, and hidden flows with detail most mages can’t match. This lets you disrupt or redirect spells mid-cast by interfering with their structure or source.
objects.title: Atmospheric Mana Manipulation

objects.text:
You have glimpsed the Godhead, touched the root of all creation and knowledge. Now, you hunger to understand the world. Through your own insight and comprehension, you may wield the art to shape and control the world.

Though you've only taken your first steps, your powers begin at a modest level. At first, you’re not far beyond an average low-tier wizard. With basic modern knowledge, you might conjure fireballs, summon shields of metal, or cast simple healing spells. But unlike other magics, yours does not rely on arcane energies or pacts with mystical beings. Your power grows entirely from your knowledge and understanding.

To truly master fire, it is not enough to know that it burns. Whether through the laws of thermodynamics, the philosophical implications of flame, or even the physical and emotional sensation of being burned—your magic strengthens as your comprehension deepens. The more profound your knowledge, the more potent your spells. Knowledge is divinity, and every truth you uncover brings you closer to it.

But true understanding is not mere memorization. You must fully grasp every facet of a thing—scientific, spiritual, fantastical, and more. One who knows the basics of combustion may conjure a simple fireball. But one who studies thermodynamics, attains enlightenment through flame, and has felt the agony of being burned alive, can wield fire with godlike power. For if you knew as much as God, would there even be a difference?

Yet with knowledge comes danger. You may affect anything—everything—with sufficient understanding, but to act beyond what you truly comprehend invites disaster. Attempting a spell without full comprehension, being interrupted, or failing to foresee the consequences may trigger catastrophic backlash. The form of this backlash depends on the scale and nature of your intent. If, for example, you tried to curse a man's body to boil, your own flesh might erupt instead.
objects.title: Ars Scire

addons.text: Your rapid potion-making technique has fused with your ingredient substitution skill and the brewing stand’s power, granting two key benefits: your potions become more potent, and you can now craft Minecraft potions swiftly using your Budget Potioneering skill, without sacrificing any potency. Furthermore, this also enables you to create upgraded Budget Potions directly through the brewing stand.
addons.title: Quick Brew

objects.text:
Typically, potions require uncommon magical ingredients and considerable time to brew. But you are the exception, possessing the rare skill to quickly craft potions using common materials with nothing more than a simple stir. This method relies on three key components: ingredients, intent, and magical energy. Should you lack magical energy, you can substitute using your stamina, though this is far less efficient.

The physical properties and symbolic meanings of each ingredient determine the potion’s possible effects. Your intent shapes the final outcome, while your magical energy infuses, purifies, and amplifies the mixture—removing unwanted side effects and turning otherwise weak brews into something magical.

At your current level, you can infuse a liquid with only a single non-magical ingredient, producing potions with basic enhanced effects. However, as your mastery grows, you may learn to infuse multiple ingredients, channel your magical energy more efficiently for stronger results, or even incorporate magical components.

While this method cannot produce truly powerful potions, its strength lies in its speed and convenience, making it an invaluable skill to have.
objects.title: Budget Potioneer

objects.text:
You are now a lich—one of the mightiest undead. Your soul has been severed from your physical body and placed into a phylactery. Your body is no longer your true self, merely an extension of your will.

Your body is now undead. It can endure physical harm without issue—blunt trauma, severed limbs, and mortal poisons mean nothing to you. Pain, hunger, and sleep no longer burden you, though you may still choose to experience them. Your form will only cease to function if it suffers severe damage, is affected by certain esoteric effects, or if you willingly allow it.

The greatest power granted by lichdom is your immortality. Even if your physical body is destroyed, you will revive at your phylactery. The time this takes depends on the severity and nature of your death—reviving from a shattered skull might take an hour, recovering from a fireball that turned half your body into ash might take a day, while total disintegration by holy magic could take weeks. Regardless of how you died, as long as your phylactery remains intact, you will always revive at its location, fully restored.

Liches are also renowned for their magical prowess—and you are no exception. You possess above-average talent in every magical art you encounter, with a strong affinity for death and darkness. While you are spared most of the weaknesses of lesser undead, you remain vulnerable to divine or holy effects.

Finally, you may choose the appearance of your body and phylactery—but only once.You might take the form of your living self, a gilded skeleton, or anything in between. Likewise, your phylactery can take any shape: a book, an amulet, a ring, or something more obscure. These choices are purely cosmetic—both will start at the same level of strength, regardless of their form.
objects.title: Lich

objects.text:
You now possess a magical ability to “awaken” any painting you encounter. This renders the artwork almost photo-realistic and dynamic, with subjects moving as if truly alive. 

You can enter and exit any awoken painting at will, and you have the power to teach others to do the same. While inside, the contents of the painting become real—living, breathing, and fully interactive—with a depiction of the world you left behind serving as your exit point.

You may remove or add items and subjects within a painting, causing it to adapt and change accordingly. With a bit enough effort, you can turn the surface of the canvas into a portal, allowing  seamless travel between the real world and the painted realm. You can choose to trap real people within the painting, though they will remain there as an active, living entity—unable to leave.

One final note: while inside a painting, you are free from all human needs—no hunger, sleep, or other physical requirements are necessary.
objects.title: Painted Portal

objects.text:
The bane of many magic systems is that they get left behind with the advancements of society and technology. Not yours. You now possess a near-limitless arsenal of spells for most modern-day problems, whether to help you deal with them or curse someone.

Your knowledge ranges from low-level, single-target spells and curses to grand rituals that can affect society at large. You can curse someone with extremely slow internet, hack into protected servers, or cast an economic recession on an entire country.

If you ever lack the necessary spells, you have an innate talent in developing new ones. The difficulty of the task is lessened the more similar spells you already know and the more you are familiar with the field. If the knowledge of desired effect and how to achieve it is sufficiently widespread, you will need only surface-level understanding of the underlying principle. And if the phenomena is completely unknown, you better have comprehensive knowledge of how to achieve it to be able to craft a desired spell.

As the society advances, so too will your magic. With each new discovery made, new avenues for spellcrafting open. While you cannot create spells that far exceed the knowledge and capabilities of the society you develop them in, you have almost free rein for as long as the mechanics to achieve this are relatively well understood. For example, while you cannot develop a spell to conjure an FTL-capable starship or cure mortality in the Victorian era, you will be able to create magic computer viruses, hack into nuclear submarines, cure cancer, and much more in our time.
objects.title: Modern Magic

addons.text: Your essence as an actual Phoenix has significantly enhanced the potency and expertise of your Phoenix Slayer Magic, elevating you to a status comparable to a Phoenix equivalent of a Dragon King such as Igneel. As you already possess proper self-resurrection Phoenix Rebirth has been fully integrated into your pre-existing immortality, compounding to counter any potential edge cases that may arise. Additionally, as a true Phoenix you can use Phoenix Tear much more frequently and with greater finesse, capable of precisely healing as much as you desire and nothing more, as well as having enough energy efficiency to produce multiple Tears capable of restoring someone from the brink of death without feeling winded. With mastery you can even use Phoenix Tear to convey the effects of Phoenix Rebirth to someone, enabling true resurrection of others. Optionally you may choose to change your affinity for fire from Phoenix to reflect the element of your Phoenix Slayer Magic, enhancing your magic even further and turning your resistance to your element up to such a level you heal from it instead of being harmed.
addons.title: Phoenix Lord

objects.text:
You have gained a self-refilling medium-sized ethernano container and have been altered by a Phoenix, granting you their elemental abilities through a magical transformation of your body and soul. This transformation allows you to take on the elemental powers of a Phoenix and more closely resemble their kind. The change enhances your physiology, granting you a stronger body with a focus on speed, natural healing, and a deeper connection to magic.

Choose one element (fire, water, ice, lightning, etc.) to become your element. Through the Lost Magic Phoenix Slayer Magic, you can now use spells and magical energy from your Ethernano container to summon and control it. Your element can also serve as a conduit for healing magic. You gain a high resistance to your chosen element and can consume it to replenish your reserves, enhance your abilities, and quickly heal yourself.

With enough mastery, you may learn two powerful abilities known as Phoenix Tear and Phoenix Rebirth. Phoenix Tear is a spell that condenses all of your remaining magic power into an elemental tear that enters another person and heals them. Phoenix Rebirth is a powerful skill that allows you to instantly and completely restore yourself to perfect condition once per year. With sufficient magical energy, this recovery time may be reduced.

While Phoenix Slayer Magic is naturally weaker in raw strength than both God Slayer Magic and Dragon Slayer Magic, you can consume your element from any Slayer magic of the same type. However, a God Slayer or Dragon Slayer cannot consume your element unless they empty themselves first.
objects.title: Phoenix Slayer Magic

addons.title: Changeling (Dresden Files)
addons.text:
You are now a half-mortal half-fae known by many as a Changeling. 

Upon puberty you inherit several qualities from your parents: an eternal lifespan, the Summer Fire or Winter Ice of their Court, some aspects of their Faerie nature, and a degree of protection by the Court your Faerie parent came from; all while retaining mortal Free Will (ability to act contrary to your inherent nature), a degree of resistance to iron, some ancestral mental compulsions, become a potential target for any foes of your parent and Court, and are considered a vassal of the Court by Faeries.

The more you lean into your Fae side and use it’s power, the more affected you will be by it’s qualities and the less you will be able to use your Free Will.

You have the Choice to become wholly Mortal or Fae at any time: losing most of the benefits of the other side upon doing so. The Choice can be delayed indefinitely should you not truly desire to become one or the other.

objects.text:
Somewhere in your ancestral line, you bear the blood of the fae. Though you may not sprout wings or vanish into moonlight, your body and soul carry the echo of the Otherworld, and that echo shapes your life in subtle, powerful ways.

Firstly, your body is touched by fae vitality. Your health remains unnaturally perfect, untouched by disease or decay. Common illnesses pass you by without so much as a sniffle, and chronic ailments like high blood pressure, diabetes, or obesity are simply unknown to you. Your body regulates itself flawlessly. Beyond this, you are blessed with an ethereal beauty. Your appearance is elevated to its ideal form, what your mortal lineage could have been, perfected. In addition, you have a magical sheen over your base appearance, your skin seemingly glowing faintly in certain lights, eyes gleaming, and presence drawing attention, even if only subtly.

You also wield a natural affinity for folk magic. While you may not be a grand mage, your connection to nature and the unseen allows you to perform a variety of subtle but potent workings. You can call upon the aid of local spirits, inscribe protective wards, grant minor blessings, heal the wounded, or even lay curses when angered. Your magic is earthy, intuitive, and deeply tied to the materials of the natural world. Herbs, bones, twigs, carved stones, and feathers are your mediums, and through them your will can shape reality in quiet, profound ways. Lighting specific woods, grinding herbs into powders, or soaking sigils in moonlit water may all serve as catalysts for your spells. Your fae blood enhances this magic, increasing its potency and making your enchantments more effective than they otherwise would be.

But the gifts of the fae are never free, and you are not immune to their price. Iron, the bane of all fae, wounds you more than it should. While it won’t sear your flesh like molten metal, it is hot on contact, leaving behind red welts and a deep ache in your bones, although no permanent damage. Additionally, your openness to magic is a double-edged sword. Just as your blessings and healing are magnified, so too are the curses and offensive spells cast against you. Magic finds you easily, and while this brings power, it also invites danger.
objects.title: Fae-Blooded

addons.text:
You have learned to manipulate magma by heating up rock through your plasma affinity, which has transformed into a potent affinity for magma, heat, and fire in its own right. Giving you control over various forms of fire, magma, and heat, you can use this to manipulate existing fire, heat, or magma, or generate it through the expenditure of magical energy.

At your current level, you can throw fireballs with the force of a hand grenade, heat food without burning it, or melt steel and rock. However, with time, research, and practice, your magic can grow to the extent of vaporising cities, triggering super volcanic eruptions, or cooling the planet's core.

Like your lightning, you can imbue exotic effects into your flames and the magical materials you create. This leaves inventing new materials much easier, as you only need to know how to actualize an effect to generate a corresponding material.

You can sense fire and heat in a 50-meter radius, including body heat, giving you a better understanding of your surroundings. Your ability to permanently strengthen your body through consuming mana grows now; your thinking speed, senses, and reaction speed grow with your body.

You gain a strong resistance to all forms of fire and heat and a moderate enhancement to your physical resistance. At this point, even swimming in lava for short periods won't harm you.

At its core, this is an elemental affinity rather than a comprehensive magic system. Thus, it is far more powerful when expressed through another magic system.
addons.title: Volcano Magic

addons.text:
The fine control over your sea magic rubs off on your geode magic, significantly enhancing your micro-scale control over magic. With the fine control you have, you could create silicon wafers with little difficulty, allowing you to create magically enhanced CPUs with only some research.

This also allows you to control geode magic on a much smaller scale, allowing you to manipulate sand and mud. You can create sand tornadoes and small mud slides at your current level. However, with time, research, and practice, your magic can grow to the extent of creating supermassive sandstorms, deserts covering continents, or sinking cities into mudpits.

You also learn how to extend your magical material generation to create life forms through the life-giving properties of the sea. Initially, you can make simple single-celled organisms, but with time, research, and practice, you can learn how to create nearly any form of life you can imagine. Even magical species such as dragons aren't beyond your reach, though it will take time to reach such heights.

You also learn how to infuse materials with the essence of the sea, allowing you to create a form of sea stone, without being limited to rock alone, enabling you to create sea steel and so on. These sea materials drain the magical energy and stamina of those in contact with them. This drained energy is stored in the sea material, strengthening its durability and strength. You can also absorb the energy stored in sea materials when in close proximity to refuel your reserves.

At its core, this is an elemental affinity rather than a comprehensive magic system. Thus, it is far more powerful when expressed through another magic system.
addons.title: Beach Magic

objects.text:
You have an affinity for Geode magic, a combination of earth, metal, and crystal magic. Giving you control over various forms of rock, crystal, and metals. You can use this to control existing material or generate it with the consumption of magical energy. At your current level, you can barely move 100 kg slabs or rock, propel bullet-sized chunks of rock at speeds just above the sound barrier, bend a cast-iron skillet into a breastplate, or create crystalline glass planes. However, with time, research, and practice, your magic can grow to the extent of summoning massive meteors and creating new volcanoes or mountains.

You can sense earth, metals, and crystals within a 50-meter radius,  which allows you to determine the earth's composition and detect the enemies' location through vibrations in the ground or through sensing the iron in their blood.

Your body is moderately enhanced, with your flesh having the strength and durability of granite and your bones akin to mythril. You can expend mana to refine your body and give it the properties of the materials you can create. The stronger your body gets, the more mana it takes to refine it further.

Furthermore, you can create magical metals or other magical materials through your magic, which consumes much more mana than mundane materials. You begin with the knowledge of how to create Enchanted Granite, Mythril, and Arcane Quartz.

Enchanted Granite is sixteen times more durable than mundane granite and boasts an incredible magic resistance, making it suitable for construction. Mythril is three times as strong as steel and one-third the weight, and is very receptive to enchantment magic. Arcane Quartz is capable of storing vast amounts of magical energies for prolonged periods of time and is also a decent neutral magic focus.

You can learn to create other mystical materials by encountering them or through independent study, though learning from existing materials is easier than coming up with your own.

At its core, this is an elemental affinity rather than a comprehensive magic system. Thus, it is far more powerful when expressed through another magic system.
objects.title: Geode Magic

objects.text: You’ve gained the ability to generate and control the twin forces that define all things, Eidos and Acton, the two paths that form Tai, the harmonization of Imagination and Will. Eidos governs Imagination. It defines the form, nature, and essence of everything — what something is. It is the mind’s power to shape form and nature, the ability to define what something is, allowing you to control the nature and essence of whatever you envision. With this, you can create a flame that carries heat, light, even kinetic force, or it can be cold, dark, silent, healing instead of burning. Eidos does not manifest on its own; it only allows you to define what something is. Acton governs Will. It enforces action, manifestation, and existence — that something is. It is the force that makes the unreal real, that commands what Eidos defines to take form in the world. Through Acton, imagined flame burns, imagined motion moves, imagined thought becomes action. Neither can exist without the other, Eidos without Acton remains as thought and never manifests, while Acton without Eidos has no nature to manifest and becomes nothing. Together, they become the mechanism by which every phenomenon in existence occurs. Eidos defines what something is; Acton enforces that it is. Your body and mind are completely suffused with this energy. It doesn’t circulate or build up; it simply is you. The energy is infinite, limited only by your own imagination and will. A greater imagination refines Eidon, granting control, variety, and complexity; a stronger will strengthens Acton, giving stability and power. The two grow together as one’s confidence and self-belief rise, and falter when doubt or fear creep in. Your mindset directly shapes the strength, form, and range of what you can accomplish. A confident, focused user radiates raw, stable energy. An imaginative, curious user becomes endlessly adaptable. Both reinforce one another until the line between them disappears. Because Eidon and Acton stem from your mind, they also shape you in return. Your body, instincts, and perception gradually adjust to the image you hold of yourself. Someone who believes they can move faster simply will. Someone who imagines their body as unbreakable will find it harder to break. Someone who envisions clarity of thought gains it. The self is always the first creation. Even in its earliest form, Tai reshapes its user completely. The moment Eidos and Acton awaken, the body and mind begin to harmonize with imagination and will, aligning themselves toward function and control. A user who was once an ordinary human immediately finds themselves capable of physical and mental performance far beyond natural limits. Their body moves as their will demands; their mind processes thought as clearly as they can imagine it. Even without training, their capabilities already rival mid-tier Brutes and Thinkers, with agility and precision fast enough to contest Movers within the same range. Their reflexes, focus, and control over their own body are exceptional. Movements flow exactly as imagined, and thought translates instantly into action. Beyond that, the versatility of Tai is endless. By merging imagination and will, you can freely shape, alter, and erase phenomena. You can imagine a flame and give it the nature you desire, a fire that burns cold and soundless, or a dark flame that illuminates only memory, and then will it into being. You can use Eidon to shape that flame’s essence closer to illusion, then extend your Acton through line of sight to make everyone within range perceive and feel its heat as if it were real. You can reshape your own inner world, using Eidon to construct a mental landscape within your mind, connect to it, and then employ Acton to pull your consciousness entirely inside, walking through thoughts as if they were places. You could dissolve your physical body into pure Eidos, by infusing it in Eidos and changing its nature into such by Acton transform your being into essence, and use Acton to reassert yourself elsewhere, true transference born from concept rather than space. Eidos and Acton can also affect what already exists. You can rewrite an object’s nature, using Eidos to redefine its properties and Acton to enforce the change, a wall into air, a bullet into mist, or sound into silence. You could even erase an object completely by surrounding it in Eidos, redefining its nature as “nothing,” and enforcing that new definition through Acton until it ceases to exist. You may even create things with nothing more than Imagination and Will, able to use Eidos to form them and Acton to bring their forms to reality. Everything you create is real for as long as your will sustains it. If what you’ve made could naturally exist, it remains even after your energy ceases to flow. A healed wound stays healed; a sword of ordinary steel endures. But a flame that devours all or a shadow that shines must be continually fed or they will collapse once your will withdraws. You can infuse more Acton at a time so you don’t have to necessarily concentrate to maintain it, only that you had infused it with enough. To start with you’ll have a natural grasp of 5 practical techniques or styles of your choice, representing fundamental insights you can already apply through Tai. These are not affinities or fixed paths, for these do not exist within Tai, these are starting disciplines meant to provide practicality and flexibility. Examples of these techniques include manipulation of fire, regeneration, direct biological healing, telepathy, sensory expansion, mental communication, flight, etc. These only serve as your initial foothold, the real strength, as always, will come from how far your imagination and will can take you. Do note that this power can be taught, and infused into others as well, by shaping one’s Eidon and Acton to grant another the ability to generate and control their own. The only limits one has are the ones they themselves refuse to shed.
objects.title: Tai

addons.title: Quietus
addons.text:
Being an entity not only made of pure manna but able to take it from your surroundings with great ease, your ability to sacrifice parts of yourself as ‘collateral’ is markedly less risky. 

When in your ‘true’ form you can substitute the usual price of a summoning for a roughly equivalent amount of manna. This not only drastically reduces risk, but essentially allows a flat conversion between your summonings and mana far more easily and reliably than you would otherwise have simply performing a summoning.

objects.text:
You can summon all kinds of things to the mortal plane, for a price.

At your fingertips is a personal pocket dimension you can push your body into. While inside, these pieces function as normal despite being held outside of normal space. After pushing pieces of yourself inside, you can summon something into the material world.

These summonings are not limited to creatures, but also inanimate objects and even magical effects (though a temporary effect would likely be incredibly dangerous to produce). These summons are of a proportionate power to what was placed in the dimension.

For instance, a finger might produce a weak summon roughly equivalent to a mundane dog, with a full limb producing a far stronger or smarter summon, or perhaps an item with esoteric abilities. You can summon multiple entities at once, but you’d have to insert a proportionate amount of you into the pocket dimension to produce them. This could also be used to enhance a single summon.

However, should the summon die or be destroyed before de-summoning, the pocket will immediately close, severing any piece of you inserted into it as a consequence. While the pocket dimension remains accessible, your flesh is gone.

The pocket dimension only recognizes pieces of your body, and will recognize them regardless of whether it is meat or not.
objects.title: Sacrificial Summoning

objects.text:
You can summon a diminutive elemental creature known as an Aspect anywhere within 13 meters of you.

A neutral Aspect is akin to a gremlin; small, smart and profoundly annoying to deal with when properly motivated. Similarly, the fact that they can just be re-summoned has led them to have fascinatingly low self-preservation skills.

Notably, as elementals first and foremost, Aspects are informed by their environment. To this end, the surface they are summoned on informs their characteristics. An Aspect summoned on ice, for instance, may be able to fire off superheated spouts of steam, one on earth may throw oil and ooze tar through its claws, or one summoned on a blood pool could manifest swarms of mosquitoes to harry enemies.

Though you can only summon a single Aspect at a time, as you grow in skill, your single Aspects will become hulking monsters and champions on the battlefield, only made more deadly and effective by the variances given by their environs.
objects.title: Aspect Summoning

objects.text:
A Magic Crest that was inspired by a certain red-haired “Hero of Justice” whose improper training had him channeling mana directly through his biological nerves before having his Magic Circuits awakened properly.

Your body works by replacing your nerves and electrical signals with streams of magical energy that move through glowing circuits woven into your flesh. These circuits link every part of you directly to your soul, forming a smooth loop between the physical and the spiritual. Your body produces bio-energy, such as body heat, which then travels through your circuits to your soul. There, it is refined and purified into usable mana before being sent back through the same network. This loop powers both your body and any spell you perform. Because the process relies on magical transfer instead of physical signaling, it happens almost instantly, much faster than any ordinary nerve communication. Your brain, which once needed to interpret and send signals, is no longer necessary. Its former role is taken over by the magical network that now connects your whole being.

In place of your biological brain sits a crystalline organ, a physical manifestation of your Magic Crest. Formed from condensed mana and held stable within your skull, it serves as your body’s new processor and memory core. Inside the Crest are countless runes and magical formulas, forming the base of your magic. Using the information in it, you can design spells, needing to shape it from geometric arrays, mathematical logic, and runic syntax. Once complete, the organ records and memorizes the formula exactly as you’ve constructed it, ready to recall and execute it when needed.

When you cast, the organ retrieves the formula you’ve chosen and calculates its remaining variables, factors like air speed, target distance, or mana pressure that change from moment to moment. The finished magical pattern is then sent through your circuits, ready for release. You can discharge it from any nerve ending by directing the flow of energy wherever you wish. The complexity of a spell depends on the density and compactness of your original design; the more intricate and layered the formula, the stronger and more refined the result. But as the number of variables increases, so too does the time your organ needs to calculate them before activation. Additionally, due to the fact that the Formulaic Spell has far more information than normal signals through the body, it causes your circuits to glow, signaling your casting.
objects.title: Nerves of Steel

objects.text:
You can now cast curses, shaping your will and magic to bring misfortune or calamity into the world. Curses are one of the most fundamental and wide-reaching branches of magic, appearing in countless forms across cultures and traditions. You are naturally talented with any and all forms of curses.

You begin as a novice, armed with knowledge of a couple dozen minor curses to start you off. These include things like a weak Taoist karma curse, basic voodoo-doll workings, and witchcraft-style beauty curses. Your arsenal is broad, though most curses at this stage are merely inconvenient or painful to a person. With time and practice, you can strengthen these curses or develop entirely new ones.

Curse Magic draws power from both your body and soul. A typical human can cast a couple dozen minor curses before becoming exhausted, though you naturally recover with rest. Curses also often require items or rituals depending on their nature—things such as the target’s blood, ritual circles, sacrifices, or similar components.

Inherently neutral, your Curse Magic can be seamlessly combined with other magical systems or supernatural powers. You can adapt curses from different cultures or traditions into your own form of cursecraft, and you may choose to channel other kinds of supernatural energy to fuel your workings if desired.
objects.title: Curse Magic

objects.text:
You have basic mastery and a high natural affinity towards creating, casting, and understanding Defensive Magic. You have access to two main types of Defensive Magic: Wards and Shields. Both of these variations of Defensive Magic typically use magical energy, but if you don’t have access to any, you can use your stamina instead.

Wards are pre-cast and long-lasting defensive spells that are typically applied to an item, person, or place. These offer by far the most powerful form of defense but usually require a long time to set up or cast. You know the basics on how to make a defensive artifact that projects a barrier of your choice and how to temporarily Ward an area against intrusion and attack. Depending on the Ward, it may have conditions for its activation, but currently, you only know how to make Wards that are always active and those that activate when supplied with magical energy.

Shields are the opposite; they are Defensive Magic that can be quickly cast but are far more temporary. Unlike what some may think, this can not only make Barriers but also buff the defensive aspects of others. Currently, you know 3 Shield-Based Spells: Magic Barrier, Physical Barrier, and Resistance Buff.

Magic Barrier is a barrier specifically designed against Magical Attacks and, later on, other supernatural effects. Physical Barrier is the opposite, a barrier specifically designed for Physical attacks. You have 2 main ways to cast these Barriers, named Set Casting and Concentration Casting. Set Casting only requires initial concentration when being formed, with you supplying it with a set amount of magical energy. After being formed, it will slowly deplete its set amount of magical energy through existing and when being hit/damaged. Once formed, though, you will only have a basic connection to this barrier, enough to sense how low it is and to dismiss it. Concentration Casting, on the other hand, creates a barrier you maintain full access to, though due to this, it requires concentration and magical energy to maintain itself, drawing more magic from you upon being hit. Barrier spells have one odd limitation: they can not form anything sharp, since it goes against one of the fundamental natures of Defensive Magic.

Resistance Buff is the oddest of the three; it can strengthen someone's resistance towards a specific type of damage. The strength of Resistance Buff is dependent primarily on the simplicity of the resistance, the scope of the resistance, and the target's base resistance. Specifically, the simpler, the narrower, and the less someone's base resistance, the more it is enhanced. Currently, you can only buff someone's resistance against a specific type of physical damage or a very specific basic type of magical damage.

With time, mastery, and magical energy, you could potentially form Wards that permanently separate dimensions or Shields that protect solar systems, though even with your talent, that would take centuries of studying.
objects.title: Ward Magic

objects.text:
You have ignited your Heart of Power, a part physical, part spiritual space that overlaps your heart and soul at the same time. The Heart of Power houses your Core Runes inside of it, your Heart of Power naturally fuels and empowers your body as well, increasing your physical, mental, and spiritual condition at all times. There are three aspects to your Heart of Power's growth, it's Quantity – the maximum quantity of energy you are able to store in your Heart of Power at a time. A higher cap means that you are able to fuel more runes. It's Quality – the quality of the energy you are able to store in your Heart of Power. A higher quality of energy means that each Rune is better in every way than a Rune fueled by a lower quality of energy. And it's Rate – the speed it takes for your Heart of Power to go from empty to full. 

You are able to receive Wisps of power through a conceptual measure of success when confronted with adversity. The quality of the Wisps received depends entirely on the challenge, facing off against a man with only a knife would grant a lesser quality Wisp in comparison to man wearing a full set of magical armor. Wisps can be used to increase either the Quantity or Quality of your Heart of Power. Alternatively, you are able to improve your Heart of Power’s Quantity, Quality, and Rate through meditation, initially you are only able to improve one of the three at a time. With enough practice you could begin to improve two aspects at a time. Only a true master would be able to improve all three aspects of their Heart of Power at the same time. To ignite your Heart of Power is to bare your being to the world and lay claim to your first Core Rune. Core Runes are concepts, principles, and fundamental truths; these are the runes that are imprinted onto your Heart of Power. Core Runes are what every Runic Chain is built off of. You are able to make minute modifications you make to the Core Runes so they fit your Intent best. 

Rune Chains are the spells of this system. These Runes Chains are unique in that they are results of practice and dedication to a combination of runes. Once you have cast a proper combination of runes enough, it can become a singular Rune Chain of its own, separate from the Core Runes that make it up yet also still connected to the growth of the individual runes. You are able to improve both the Rune Chain and the individual Core Runes at the same time. 

In order to create more Core Runes, you need to design their image and your understanding of the concept in your Heart of Power. Each design is going to be connected to the meaning of each Core Rune, and you only need to make a Core Rune once for it to be permanent.

Casting using your runes is an incredibly intuitive process. You will be able to project your Core Runes directly onto the world from the start, removing any need to draw them out in the air. As your comprehension of a Rune grows, its design will become increasingly more complicated to represent that amount of understanding that goes into projecting such a vast understanding onto the world.

As you use your Runes, you will find that they grow more detailed and extravagant. This natural growth is sufficient enough for most Runic Mages, however any mage that hopes to be somebody will have to prune the inefficient parts of their Runes. This pruning process isn’t simply about cutting apart parts of your Runes and is instead focused on condensing your comprehension of a rune, finding places of overlap in your knowledge, this reduces the complexity of a rune’s design, allowing you to cast incredibly complex runes at a much faster rate.

Prestiging a Rune is done with more than your comprehension, requiring an incredible feat that has deep personal meaning to you. You are able to begin extracting your Prestige Rune(s) from your Heart of Power. Extracting a Rune crystallizes your comprehension of it, allowing you to express the same power and understanding in a less complex manner. Each time your prestige a rune, it will be pulled further from your Heart of Power and be moved closer to Reality, resting over your heart once you prestige a rune ten times.

Every time you prestige a rune, you are able to select one of three Major Boosts, Quantity, Quality, or Rate. These boosts are qualitatively different from the ones you receive from Wisps of Power. You get to pick another prestige bonus every time you prestige a rune. On the first, third, fifth, seven, and ninth prestiges you will find that you receive a Talent that is well aligned with both the Rune itself and how you use it. The closer a rune is to Reality, the faster you are able to cast it, the less energy it takes to fuel, and the faster it grows. Upon the tenth prestige, you will find that your Prestige Rune no longer needs to be projected from your Heart of Power, requiring no more energy when casting or crafting, as it is in a constant state of existence. Additionally, you receive a Capstone Talent that both grants you a passive ability related to the Rune, and strengthens the Talents earned from earlier prestiges. You are also able to prestige Rune Chains, although this only prestiges the whole Rune Chain and not the individual runes that make it up. If a Rune Chain is composed of one or more Prestige Runes, the effectiveness of the Prestige Rune Chain is qualitatively better.
objects.title: Heart of Runes

addons.text: `Five sigils decorate the fingers on your hand below your first knuckle, each denoting a different entity. When evoking them, they flow down and eclipse your entire finger in ink’ Bonding is usually a risky procedure, locking away your abilities with the Art while in use. However, thanks to your Brand, you can apply a semblance of a true bonding to your tattoo. This does not impact your ability to use the Art, but these pseudo-Bondings are both dramatically inferior to a true Bonding, and grow at a slower rate.
addons.title: Compromise

addons.text: Thanks to the distinctly physical nature of the Aurora, you can now use it to amend your summons physical forms. What this actually entails changes based on the variety of summon, for instance merely creating more flames to enhance a fire daemon would have a greatly differing outcome to making numerically more ‘bodies’ for an External to inhabit.
addons.title: Form & Flesh

objects.text:
Summoning, Bonding, and Binding are fundamentally three branches of one focus; the art of contracting with outside entities. Entities are split into five categories: Servitors, Egregores, Daemons, Fundamentals, and Externals. You can now see, contract, and bind these entities, the only restriction being your own knowledge and energy. Your development and energy is tied to your learning. As you begin to unravel the mechanics of different entities, you’ll be able to achieve greater and greater heights. Starting out, you will be able to summon minor Daemons and bond with fundamentals under strict contacts, but with time and experience you will become a master of the Art, weaving contracts and forces as second nature to you. 

Servitors are entities created by an individual summoner, often for a singular purpose. Be that acting as a familiar, or in menial roles like timers or page turners. Being created by a summoner themselves out of their own energy reserves, they are often highly specialized, and as a result deficient in all other areas. A talented Summoner may be able to create a physically strong and capable Servitor far outstripping a human, but it would require a large amount of energy and the being would be possessed of no will or intelligence of its own, blindly following its creator’s orders to the letter.

Egregores are entities created by collective thoughts; often sourced from religions, mythologies and any figure that people funnel their faith and belief into. Comparatively to Servitors they are quite powerful, even if they do not reach the level of true gods. They derive power from the same energy they’re sourced by, often seeing the act of spreading their influence as morally correct. The power of an Egregore is directly correlated to the amount of belief and faith they consume. A local Egregore, known to very few devoted followers may be able to only summon small fires, while the conglomerated faith of a major religion could create an Egregore capable of creating vast firestorms with no strain.

Daemons are agents of the world, spirits, and entities that exist without human interference or belief. Commonly cited Daemons include fire and the ocean. Daemons, much like Egregores, scale in strength to their domain, but unlike Egregores they are not tied to humans and can theoretically persist separate from them eternally. A Daemon has complete control over their domain, but it will only act in accordance with itself. A fire cannot extinguish itself from nowhere, but it can choose how it grows and spreads. The Daemon of fire therefore has complete control over the element and everything contained within it, and is powerful to match; but incapable of fundamentally altering it. They also have their own internal structure, with Daemons of specific objects and locations deferring to their grander cousins. For instance, the Daemons of the seas, atlantic, mediterranean and further would all defer to the aforementioned Daemon of oceans.

Fundamentals are entities so intrinsic to reality that conceptualising them as entities is often foreign to non-summoners like Gravity and Time. They are difficult to control and bargain with due to their range and power, but truly embody the concepts they represent. Even the most powerful Daemon cannot truly affect the nature of its domain, while the ‘weakest’ Fundamental of entropy could completely stop its presence in a certain area, or permanently accelerate its pace on certain areas or figures.

Externals are beings completely outside reality, incomprehensible to and uncomprehending of those within its confines. They are completely alien in thought, action, and desire, and as such cannot be classified. Each can be equivalent to varying levels of entity, featuring only commonality in how unlike anything else in reality they are. General Externals vary from other-dimensional beings that cannot comprehend existence isolated to four dimensions, to Daemons of alternate worlds with physics so aberrant that they cannot be understood in the terms of their brethren.

Summoning is a discipline focused around calling these entities forth. The level of variance however is within the entities preferred by the summoner. A summoner can deal with Daemons for specific benefits, contract with larger Egregores, or summon temporary Servitors for specific purposes all within this branch of the art. The presentations of these can vary greatly, a Summoner who calls Gravity into an anomalous crushing force still contracts with a Fundamental.

Bonding however, is a summoning discipline rarely practiced by the academics studying the art. Bonding centrally allows you to form a connection with a singular entity, gaining a greater access and understanding of them and the domain they exist within. By bonding with an Egregore for instance, the great feats attributed to them are within your grasp, while bonding with a Fundamental would allow you to twist their domain as much as your skill allows. Bonding with a Fundamental of Gravity, for instance, would give you intrinsic control over local gravity, but eventually you could train this skill and learn to affect the pull of the stars themselves, though this would require great energy and learning. However, it completely warps not only your form, but also makes you unable to summon, bind or bond any other entities. You can unbond from an entity, but doing so can unleash its effects on the environment temporarily, potentially causing massive damage depending on the specific entity you bonded with. In addition, unbonding it will scour its influence from your mind, bringing you back to the level of Summoning skill you had before bonding yourself to it. As a consequence, if you ever wish to bond to the same entity you will have to relearn its influence from scratch.

Binding meanwhile, is similar in its restriction from other Summoning techniques, but it externalizes the force. Binding a Daemon to yourself ensures its service and assistance, but you do not gain benefits from its form or purpose. You can still use the Art and even Bond while Binding is in effect. In addition, when severing a Binding (which can be done on either side of the arrangement barring either extreme preparation or skill), the Summoner retains all skill in the art they gained at the cost of having less control over the entity's interpretation and action than they would have when Bonding.
objects.title: Art of the Other

objects.text:
You are now totally immune against harmful magical influences. Adversarial spells, no matter how potent, are rendered utterly ineffective against you, this also includes magical potions or anything concocted using magic with the intent to harm you. 

This doesn't affect your ability to use magic, nor does it hinder your ability to harness and derive benefits from benevolent magical forces.
objects.title: Am I Supposed To Be Impressed?

objects.text:
You can generate and manipulate flames from your body, projecting them up to twenty feet with enough control to shape them into simple forms like walls, orbs, or tendrils. At this baseline, your flames burn hot enough to melt through steel plating within seconds, turn concrete to slag with sustained contact, and can be concentrated into a cutting beam no thicker than a wire. You are immune to the heat of your own flames and can instinctively sense the temperature and intensity of any fire within fifty feet of you.

The temperature and intensity of your flames are directly fueled by your courage. For every moment you feel fear but choose to stand your ground and act despite it, your flames grow exponentially hotter and more resilient. A flicker of doubt overcome in a tense negotiation might make your flames burn as hot as magma, while charging into certain danger against a foe that terrifies you could push them to the heat of a lightning bolt. Panic, desperate flailing, or actions born purely from fear without the will to conquer it will instead cause your flames to sputter and weaken. The power demands not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.

In the absolute worst moments, when you face hopeless odds with no guarantee of survival yet still choose to fight, when your body screams at you to run and you refuse, your flames can reach the surface temperature of the sun.
objects.title: Aries, the Flames of Courage

objects.text:
You draw physical power directly from the earth beneath your feet. While standing on solid ground, your strength increases at minimum tenfold, allowing you to lift a sedan over your head, punch through a brick wall, or brace yourself against the force of a speeding truck without being moved. The more stable your footing, the more power you can draw; a concrete foundation grants more strength than loose gravel, and bedrock makes you nearly immovable. You instinctively know the stability of any surface you stand on and can root yourself in place, becoming impossible to knock over or drag so long as you remain in contact with the ground.

You can channel injury and fatigue down through your body and into the earth, dispersing harm like a lightning rod grounding a strike. A broken bone can be pressed against the ground and transfer the fracture into the soil, healing you in minutes while the earth absorbs the damage. Poison, exhaustion, and even deep bruising can be purged the same way, leaving you fresh while the ground around you cracks and blackens from the strain. This transfer requires you to be consciously pushing the harm out, and the more severe the injury, the longer you must remain in contact with the ground to fully expel it.
objects.title: Taurus, the Grounding of the Earth

addons.text: Your ability wield magic as an extension of yourself has merged with your skill at crafting armor from pure mana, turning you into a master of both offense and defense. Now, armors can be formed in an instant, and it takes barely any focus to maintain them. Plus, your more offensive spells can be channeled through them easily, amplifying a Battle Mage's buffs by at least five-fold.
addons.title: Armory Mage

addons.text:
You've delved even further into the art of making spellcraft more and more durable. Now, you can instantly flash-forge parts of your armor, or with focus, create armors that require no further concentration to maintain. In either case, their base durability becomes an order of magnitude stronger than steel, increasing further with training, mana spent to conjure them, or studying better materials to mimic.

Additionally, you can fine-tune your armors to allow certain effects or attacks through, while denying others even more strongly.
addons.title: Bastion

objects.text: "Above all else, I wanted to be invincible." Your magic lies not in pure destruction or displays of might. Rather, such things are secondary to its primary purpose, which is personal protection and enhancement. At the beginning, you gain the knowledge of how to use mana to protect yourself from all sorts of environmental hazards, from extreme heat and cold to poison gas. Over time its effectiveness will increase with mastery. More importantly, all of your spells will allow you to solidify your mana into armor. This differs from simple barrier spells, as this mana armor will conform to your whole body and move with it. By default and at its weakest, it is completely immune to all mundane forms of damage, and will heavily resist weaker supernatural ones. The armor will also assist your movements, boosting your strength, speed and reflexes. As you learn more, you may discover how to construct various other forms of armor out of your mana, embodying different effects and enchantments. You might learn how to harness fire magic to create flame armor, ice armor from ice magic, and so on and so forth. This may grant you more utility and offensive capabilities as a side effect. Of course, there is nothing stopping you from supporting allies by granting them your Mana Armor as well, or even creating Animated Armors to do your bidding. The culmination of Armor Magic is the creation of Giant Armors: vast constructs of pure mana that still obey your movements or commands like a mecha. The size and scale of Giant Armor, as well as additional capabilities, will all depend on how much mana you pour into it, as well as what you've learned. If for whatever reason you possess any technological powers that allow for creating types of power armor, this magic will allow you to create it purely from imagination and mana. Go forth, Armor Mage, and let all foes break themselves against you.
objects.title: Armor Magic

objects.text:
You are a magician that specialises in dimensional manipulation. You know spells that allow you to teleport across the world, create portals, conjure small pocket dimensions, and even construct artefacts to serve as a portkey or an inventory-like space to them.

You start with a dozen spells for almost any occasion, and with practice, you will be able to create almost any spell related to the manipulation of space, from traversing the multiverse to creating barriers that put infinite distance between any harm and you; nothing is beyond your grasp.

Your senses have also sharpened; you can feel when the space is being manipulated and perceive dimensional distortions. This allows you to effectively evade or protect yourself from hostile dimension manipulations should someone, for example, attempt to teleport a weapon inside you.

Lastly, you possess an incredible affinity for any dimensional magic. Creating a new spell or understanding and replicating an existing one of the same affinity will take orders of magnitude less effort than it would take other magicians, and any space-aligned entities will view you much more favourably.
objects.title: Space Magic

addons.text:
Your ability to manipulate mana both internally and externally has given you an amazing foundation for controlling magic. All forms of magic are now easier to learn and understand, putting you at the level of a savant.

Your control over mana is exceptionally refined, allowing you to shape and direct it with far greater precision and efficiency than before. This makes spellcasting easier to optimize by reducing waste, lowering mana costs, strengthening effects, and giving you a better intuitive understanding of how spells and magical systems function.

While this began with mana, the principles learned here have made it possible for any other forms of energy you already possess to become slightly easier to understand and control. For example, if you can manipulate kinetic energy, then what you’ve learned from manipulating mana will allow you to apply some of the same principles from mana manipulation to kinetic energy manipulation, making it easier to refine and improve.

That said, other forms of energy still follow their own rules and limitations. You have not bypassed those restrictions, merely gained a sixth sense that helps you understand and control them more effectively.
addons.title: Mana Control Mastery

objects.text:
Mana is the most common form of energy used in the mystic arts across many realms, and you have acquired the fundamentals of manipulating this energy.

Your understanding enables you to more easily control your personal mana. While you won’t be given specific spells, you will instinctively learn how to use your mana. Keep in mind that this does not mean instant mastery, but rather a significant enhancement of your natural abilities.

If you already know any magic, you will be able to improve your spellcasting by refining your mana manipulation. This includes learning to reduce the mana expenditure required to cast spells by eliminating any excess mana, as well as discovering how to overcharge spells, allowing them to exceed their standard limits.

Your intuitive knowledge of mana manipulation also gives you a better understanding of how spells are formed, enabling you to improve and modify them effectively over time.
objects.title: Mana Manipulation

objects.text:
As a practitioner of Onmyōdō, you're learned in its ways, being an especially smart student of your masters of this school. Though that doesn't necessarily make you a master, you're still more than capable of casting a few spells yourself, from warding and purification rituals to lifting or placing curses, divining fortunes and future events, even performing rites meant to honor or appease the gods, etc.

The main method of invoking your craft relies on a mix of hand signs, chants, and paper talismans inscribed with sacred scripts. Alongside those, you can conjure and command shikigami—beings analogous to familiars contracted and bound to you by a spiritual link.

These spirits are brought to life through complex ceremonies and shaped around your intent and skill, letting them serve in many roles, from either scouting and utility to direct combat. Summoning one beyond your level, however, is ill-advised due to the inherent risk.

Because Onmyōji act as intermediaries between the living world and the unseen one, you've also learned how to calm, guide, drive off, or exorcise spirits when needed. To help with that, your sight can pierce the veil itself, allowing you to perceive the hidden world of spirits and Yōkai that most people never notice.
objects.title: Onmyōji

objects.text:
You know a spell that allows you to condense your mana into a small crystal. This crystal can either be used as a source of mana—to replenish your reserves later or power an artefact, for example—or fired off like a bullet.

The power, weight, and speed of the bullet are directly proportional to the amount of mana you condense, with no upper limit, although you limit it to any desired level. Made entirely out of your own mana, the bullets are completely under your control. You can determine their flight path and decide their behaviour on impact, from dealing regular physical trauma to exploding with all the stored mana or something more esoteric. If you possess knowledge of or affinity for different types of magic, you can infuse special properties into your bullets, like creating incendiary ones with fire magic or bullets that slip unseen past any defences with shadow magic, allowing you to amass an incredibly variable arsenal.

Without any other power, you possess a small mana pool, enough to cast several hundred bullets equal in power to a .50 BMG AP round.
objects.title: Mana Bullet

addons.text:
You have learned that a puppet is a body without a face, and a mask is a face without a body. By combining your crafts, you give the faceless a face and the bodiless a body, creating something neither was alone.

You can now craft masks that become the literal face of your puppets rather than something worn. The puppet's body subtly reshapes itself to fit the mask as if the face was always meant to be there. Because a standard puppet is hollow with no identity of its own, it does not clash with the mask's nature but is instead filled by it, granting the puppet all the buffs and drawbacks of the mask as if the mask's identity were its own. For example, a puppet given a basalt mask carved with clenched teeth gains immense physical strength and the ability to shatter stone with its fists. A puppet given a mask of woven copper wire and polished gears develops the power to slowly mend its own wooden body over time.

When you craft a personalised mask for an autonomous puppet that already possesses a core and has developed some history of action, you achieve something greater. Such a mask requires materials gathered by the puppet itself and your deep study of its emerging nature. The mask does not impose a foreign identity but awakens a true one within the puppet, granting it genuine selfhood and the ability to regenerate its own energy, freeing it from daily refueling. Its loyalty to you ceases to be programmed and becomes chosen, as loyal as any person can be to another. A puppet that tirelessly guarded your workshop might, with a personalised mask of iron and oak, become a true sentinel who stays by choice, while a puppet that accompanied you on journeys might develop a wanderer's soul and a face weathered like old leather. 

Once a puppet receives a personalised mask and becomes a true living being, that face cannot be removed or replaced without destroying the self you helped create. Such an act is not merely destructive but ethically monstrous, and no craft you possess can undo it cleanly.
addons.title: Face of a Puppet

objects.text:
By carving and crafting natural materials such as wood, stone, and similar substances, you can create fully articulated puppets. The specific material influences the final product through symbolic buffs, for example, the type of wood granting certain properties, and these buffs become stronger and blatantly obvious rather than subtle if the material is explicitly supernatural. At the start, you can only create humanoid puppets with no additional features.

You have two ways to animate these puppets.

The first method uses your personal energy reserves to create energy strings, allowing you to puppet them directly. This offers extremely low cost, direct control, and the ability to see through the puppets. However, the cost includes limited range, vulnerability to sabotage if enemies cut the energy lines, and difficulty with multitasking, creating a steep learning curve.

The second method involves creating a core and imbuing your energy into it to generate a spark that animates the puppet and grants it pseudo-life. This offers autonomy, unlimited range, and unwavering loyalty to you first and foremost. However, the puppets remain individual creatures who, while loyal, are not slaves that mindlessly obey, and they require constant fuel for their core, meaning nearly daily refuels are necessary.

As you improve, you can add more advanced mechanics into their puppet bodies, such as hidden blades, and you can lower the limitations of both control methods, such as lengthening the energy line for more range or improving the core to hold more energy.
objects.title: Puppet Carver

addons.text:
Your 1000 Planar Runes and any Relativistic Arcana formulas you discover are register within your System Authority soul storage as Macros, consuming Soul Blocks equal to each rune or formula's character count divided by 10. Casting a registered rune via "System Call [rune name] Install" costs only the Authority for the name, such as registering the rune sequence for a celestial-scale gravity inversion as a Macro named "GravFlip" costing 8 Authority to cast rather than the full 400-character formula, while the spell still produces its original mathematical effect. Additionally, you may attach System Authority Parameters to any Mathemagician spell cast through a registered rune Macro, such as appending ", empowered, radius equals 50 meters" to a standard fireball rune to multiply its damage and area at half Authority cost per parameter character, without altering the original rune's formula.

You can now also target mathematical singularities like division by zero or infinite series that fail to converge to exploit glitches. Instead of cleanly resolving your Quantum Arcane Formula, you trigger simulation bugs analogous to System Authority glitches, producing effects far beyond your normal magical budget at zero Authority cost, such as solving for the exact position and momentum of an electron simultaneously by feeding the universe's physics engine a divide-by-zero that forces it to return both values as a corrupted double. Furthermore, any System Authority glitch you discover can be analyzed mathematically using your Quantum Arcana, allowing you to derive the glitch's root equation and trigger it later with a rune instead of code, potentially bypassing reality's patch detection if the mathematical singularity remains valid after the code patch is applied.

Lastly, your Mathemagician HUD gains a secondary code view overlay that displays the System Authority code of any object, spell, or effect you are measuring.
addons.title: Grimoire.exe

objects.text:
The world you inhabit is a simulation. Every rock, every breath of wind, every law of physics is compiled code running on an underlying reality engine. You, like everyone else, are a simulated entity. But unlike the rest, you have gained insight into this truth. This awakening makes you an Administrator.

You can summon an interface with the verbal phrase "System Call." A translucent overlay appears inside your mind, displaying the raw code of your immediate surroundings. From here, you can inject your own code into reality's active processes. Every character you write costs one unit of Authority, the fuel for this magic. After doing so, you say "Install" to activate it. The phrases "System Call" and "Install" themselves cost no Authority.

Your Authority pool is determined by the complexity and coherence of your personal identity, essentially how much existential weight your soul carries before it begins to fragment under the strain of rewriting reality. Authority regenerates slowly over time or more quickly through rest. It is also possible to use external sources to replenish it, such as Ley Lines or other Administrators.

The language of reality is a chaotic fusion of every programming language ever conceived on Earth plus alien syntax and mathematical notations no human invented. A fireball written as "spawn(projectile, type equals fire, speed equals 30, damage equals 20)" costs 52 Authority. The same fireball written as "spawn(proj, t equals fire, v equals 30, d equals 20)" costs 37 Authority and casts faster. There is no inherent power difference between verbose and lean code, only efficiency. When you inject code, reality must compile and install your instructions, and installation time scales with code length, roughly one second per fifty characters.

To bypass this, Administrators create Macros: pre-written chunks of code stored permanently in your soul, which serves as a personal server bank. Your soul has finite storage capacity measured in Soul Blocks, typically 1,000 blocks for an average Administrator. Each Macro occupies a number of blocks equal to its character count divided by 10, with a minimum of 1 block. To cast a Macro, you simply say "System Call" followed by its name, closing with "Install". The code installs in the time it would take to speak that short name rather than the full Macro. For example, you could define a Macro called "FireV3" containing 1,200 characters of complex flame logic, costing 120 Soul Blocks. 

However, you cannot exceed your Soul Block limit. To add a new Macro, you must delete an old one, permanently losing it unless you have an external archive. Archived Macros can be reloaded into your soul over several hours, costing Authority equal to their character count. Your soul storage can improve if you find ways to make your soul stronger and more resilient. A stronger soul grants more Soul Blocks, allowing you to store larger or more numerous Macros.

Beyond raw code, you can apply parameters to your System Calls by adding specific values, modifiers, and denominations. A modifier might be "empowered" which doubles damage but quadruples Authority cost, or "silent" which suppresses visual and auditory manifestations of your code for stealth at a flat surcharge. Denominations let you target categories rather than individuals, such as "all enemies within five meters" or "the nearest three objects made of wood." Values include numeric adjustments like "duration equals 30 seconds" appended to a spell that would otherwise last only 5. 

Parameters are lightweight hooks into existing reality functions rather than novel instructions. As such, each parameter character costs only half a unit of Authority, making them significantly cheaper than writing raw code. You can apply parameters to Macros as well. However, parameters cannot be stored inside Macros themselves. You must write them live at the moment of casting.

Improvement comes through two paths. The first is writing leaner code: learning the language's shortcuts, exploiting implicit assumptions in reality's parser, and stripping every unnecessary character. The second path is discovering and exploiting bugs in the simulation. There are glitches: edge cases where the physics engine returns a divide-by-zero, rendering rules where occlusion checks fail, or memory leaks in persistent objects. You can write code that triggers these bugs intentionally, producing effects far beyond your normal Authority budget. However, reality occasionally patches overused bugs, as such overusing a specific glitch risks losing access to it permanently.

You cannot directly edit anything protected by a separate permission layer you do not have access to.
