Similarly, you cannot delete or permanently alter the fundamental constants of reality, such as lightspeed, absolute zero, pi, or the gravitational constant, because those are write-protected system files. Attempting to do so simply returns a permission error and wastes the Authority. Similarly, syntax errors cause the entire injection to fail while still consuming half the Authority cost.

If you run out of Authority mid-cast, the partial code sometimes installs incompletely, producing unpredictable glitches such as a fireball that spawns inside your own hand or a shield that inverts and traps you. Finally, overloading your soul storage beyond its block limit causes fragmentation: Macros corrupt, random System Calls trigger without your command, and prolonged overflow can shatter your soul entirely.
objects.title: System Authority

addons.text:
You now have a faster way to  breed bugs with a specific set of traits instead of having to constantly start over from scratch or go over multiple intermediary species to gain bugs able to breed with each other. You can now place multiple of your bugs into a jar or pot, with an upper limit of 100, and seal them in for an hour. When you open the jar again there will be a single bug left inside it, with all special traits of the bugs placed in the container.

While all abilities are retained, there is a certain element of randomness to the process, as you don't control the appearance of the resulting bug, having no control over which of the bugs will end up serving as the foundation for the result.

Though you can of course stack the deck in your favor by adding more specimens of the specific type of bug into the container.

Finally, if all bugs added are of the same type, or at least extremely similar to each other, then all universally shared traits will be enhanced in the resulting bug.
addons.title: Kodoku

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge and skill to breed and subsequently control supernatural insects, arthropods, and mollusks. These bugs can be roughly divided into two categories, those being external and internal.

External bugs work much like regular insects would, except far more effectively. Centipedes with venom toxic enough to melt the victim's bones inside their body, slugs whose secretions could eat through a metal safe's door in minutes, and swarms of fanged beetles that in sufficient numbers could strip a body down to a skeleton in seconds like a school of flying piranha are only some examples of what you can make. You can also breed insects specifically designed as conduits for other powers you have, by for example using a bugbite or sting to deliver a curse or swarms forming a magical array to enact rituals.

It is however the other type, internal bugs, where your craft truly shines. You can breed a variety of parasitic and symbiotic bugs that influence their hosts in a variety of ways. Malevolently they could be used to cause hosts pain, subtly weaken them by sapping strength or stamina, influence their behavior by altering their body-chemistry or outright taking control like a green-banded broodsac can do to snails, or even devour their good fortune, making the host extremely unlucky.

On the flipside the bugs can be beneficial symbionts that can enhance their hosts, accelerating growth, reducing pain and even repairing the body internally or replacing lost organs, as well as attracting good fortune like a living good luck-charm that actually works. Properly calibrated they can even allow their hosts access to new power-systems by spreading through the body and acting like chakra-coils, magic circuits, or spiritual medians for as long as the organism is present and alive within them, or enhance and empower any system already present in their host. Though even the most beneficial of symbionts will extract a price from its host to sustain itself, which can range from the mundane nutrition to the abstract lifespan.

There are a few caveats however. It will take some trial and error, as well as multiple generations, to successfully breed a bug with the specific traits you want. The bugs you breed are actual living creatures, so you must ensure to keep them properly fed lest they die on you. It also takes time and resources to breed them, the more esoteric the properties of the bug the rarer the ingredients required to grow them, though once you have a few of a specific breed you can use natural reproduction to reduce the costs of bolstering their numbers. Finally as living creatures designed to follow commands they are vulnerable to being snatched away, whether that be by means like pheromones or something like Skitter's power, though you can breed immunity against specific types of control as well with enough effort.
objects.title: Mystic Bug Breeding

objects.text:
You are a Sound Mage, a partitioner of magic who sought what the union of sound frequencies and magical enhancement could achieve. With the notable result of your showcasing two expressions.

The first expression is not only recreating and modifying any sound frequency you encounter, but also amplifying the effects of said frequencies. Essentially, allowing  you to take a sound that causes minor irritation, and transform it into the source of immense agony on a single target.

The second expression is converting your spells into new magical sound frequencies, with an increasing cost scaling with potency, making your far magic subtler and less costly. This means that after the initial cost to create the frequency, you could freely use said spell with and across mundane means like a guitar, recording or phone call without cost.
objects.title: Frequency of Magic

objects.text:
You passively release invisible waste mana in a small, fluctuating radius around your body. This waste mana acts as a sixth sense for your own power, detecting incoming attacks before they land. In the moment before impact, your unused mana, both ambient and stored, converges instantly toward the detected threat, much like how muscles tense before a blow. It becomes more and more dense the closer the attack gets. If you have enough mana, this density can become fully solid, creating a temporary point that blocks the strike completely. The defense works on its own and costs nothing to maintain, since you are not spending mana, only moving what you already have.

The defense works best against single, focused attacks. Your mana can only gather effectively in one place at a time. Saturation attacks, fast flurries, or wide area spells can overwhelm it by asking for too many shields at once. Also, because the skill depends on your available mana, it gets weaker as you use your mana for other magic. When your reserves run low, your defense runs low too, leaving you open when you might need protection the most.

You also gain a large increase to your total mana pool, or alternatively gain an above average mana pool if you don’t have any. This gives you enough reserves to make the skill useful in a fight and to keep it working even after you have spent a good amount of your power.
objects.title: Mana Shield

objects.text:
This technique was the signature killing art of the Faceless Prophets, an order of master archers who served the Magic King during her campaign to destroy the world. They were her silent executioners, each one surgically removing commanders, champions, and mages from enemy ranks before a battle could even begin. It was with this technique that ultimately brought down the Sword Saint.

To use the Spiritless Arrow, you first create a stable wind tunnel using precise wind magic, suspending an arrow weightlessly at its center. You then perform the physical motion of drawing a bow, this somatic ritual triggering your mana to compress a pocket of air behind the arrow's nock. Upon release, the pocket detonates into the wind tunnel, launching the arrow at extreme velocity. The residual magic wreathes the projectile in a spinning shell of wind that negates all air resistance and drag, allowing the arrow to maintain its initial speed indefinitely and travel in perfectly flat trajectories without a sound. By manipulating the symmetry of this wind shell during flight, you can cause the arrow to curve and turn in long, graceful arcs, the spinning air around the tip forming into a drill that bores through armor and flesh alike.

Each individual shot costs minimal mana, time and focus thanks to the efficiency of the technique's design. You are able to split your attention across multiple projectiles, allowing you to launch and broadly direct a volley of several arrows at once. However, this multitasking is insufficient to apply fine precision or complex mid-flight curvature to more than one arrow at a time.

You get a stock of fifty arrows, each one longer and thicker than standard shafts with dense heartwood cores and heavy armor-piercing heads. You also have the complete technical knowledge for crafting replacements.
objects.title: Spiritless Bow

objects.text:
Everyone has a “core” of what is essentially crystallized magic replacing part of their body starting with the heart. Your Core is attuned to a single element, allowing you to use magic to enact effects derived from both the physical - and even conceptual given enough skill - properties of your chosen element. What can be achieved with this is determined by two factors, the size of your core and your talent. 

The size of your core, i.e. how much of your body has been replaced by crystallized magic, determines the amount of magical energy you produce and can use. Mana Cores do not grow in size with time, so whatever you’re born with is what you get. Talent refers to how intuitive it is for you to use magic, with greater talent allowing for increased control, efficiency, and ability to bridge into conceptual applications. A large core with mediocre talent would be unable to do more than brute force applications, while a small core with prodigious talent would be capable of some truly impressive acts but would be unable to sustain prolonged usage of all but small-scale spells.

You in particular are actually quite lucky, possessing not only unrivaled talent, but also an abnormally large core, one which has completely replaced not just your heart but some of your organs and skeletal structure.

Furthermore, there are certain benefits that occur when certain parts of your body are replaced with a core, depending on not only the element but also what part was replaced. A Light-aligned core - that carries properties of truth and revelation - which replaces the eyes might grant some form of true sight, while a Wind Core that replaces the nerves would allow for increased reaction speeds.

Despite being described as crystallized magic, a Mana Core carries out all the functions of the parts it's replacing and even looks almost identical, save for a few details being off such as colored markings or crystallized eyes glowing. However, even though it looks and acts like normal flesh, it is still crystallized magic and is more durable than normal flesh or bone.
objects.title: Elemental Core

objects.text:
You can mentally summon “little folk”, also known by some as 'brownies' or 'hobgoblins'. These are intelligent, 3 foot tall magical beings with a thin, goblin-like appearance.

You can summon up to a dozen of these beings at any one time and they are eager to aid you in whatever way they can. Whilst they are innately loyal to you, they may play pranks or vanish if they feel they are being abused. They do not tire, nor do they need to eat and sleep, but they do appreciate the odd snack for their efforts. 

They wield a special form of magic; anything they could accomplish in under a dozen minutes, they can instantly do with a snap of their fingers. This magic is restricted to being unable to directly harm sentient living beings in any regard. As such, this lends them to domestic tasks such as cooking or cleaning rather than combat. 

With this magic, they can also turn completely invisible and may teleport to anyone or any location they can mentally visualise at will. Lastly, they are capable of minor feats of telekinesis, enough to lift a person or juggle several small objects simultaneously.
objects.title: Little Helpers
The Runes of the Hanged God
objects.text:
You have chosen the path of torment and transcendence, mirroring the ordeal of Odin in the pursuit of forbidden wisdom. Though you did not carve the blood eagle into your own back, nor hang pierced from a meat hook upon the World Tree for nine nights, the world believes you did. Myth, saga, and scripture speak your name as if it were etched there since the dawn of time. Skalds tell of your sacrifice, and the very roots of Yggdrasil echo with the memory of your suffering.

You may decide if your body bears the false proof of this eternal story. Scars would run like rivers across your body, as if carved by going through the ritual. They are not weakness, but glory. They would mark you as one who has endured death and torment for knowledge, and from them radiates a will that cannot remain broken for long and a pain-tolerance fit for one who has gone through such a Ritual. In your soul lies the certainty, and marks of one who has already endured the worst, and emerged greater for it.

For this remembered sacrifice, the Runes bow to your command. You read them not as symbols, but as truths of existence, and an innate language. Kenaz brings flame into the world, Isa freezes the marrow of creation, Algiz shields against ruin, Nauthiz binds fate, Tiwaz carves victory, and countless others shape destiny itself. No guesswork taints your craft; you wield runic sorcery with a mastery second only to Odin.

But your dominion extends beyond the writing of reality. It reaches into the birth of new life. From Primordial Ice you may draw bodies of frost, gleaming and eternal, either forged by your hand through arduous runic craft or torn raw from Niflheim itself. From Primordial Fire you may call forth beings of living flame, children of Muspelheim’s burning void. From driftwood you may shape mortals as Odin did before you, breathing into them the spark of will. From Light itself, born either of your runes or of Alfheim’s radiance, and Darkness, you may form shining, and Dark races who worship you as the Ljósálfar and Dökkálfar, once venerated Freyr. From stone you may carve Dvergar, not born of maggots in Ymir’s corpse, but sculpted by your own design, their loyalty hammered into them with every strike of chisel and rune.

You may even create rituals to Uplift your and others existence with the essence of other beings, or even ascend through the hierarchy of the Gods and Jotun, and may eventual match or surpass Ymir, or even create new rituals with the Runes with new effects.

All who are born of your hand revere you, as man once revered Odin and his kin. They see you not as a distant god, but as their Father, their Shaper, their Creator. They whisper your name in prayers, call to you in fear, and exalt you in worship. You are not merely master of the Runes. You are the Hanged God reborn, the forger of races, the shaper of worlds, a second voice in the endless sagas of the North.

Second only to Odin Himself, and In time, not even he will be above you.

objects.title: Mana Burn
objects.text:
You have learned the basics of the magical technique known as Mana Burn, which is a dangerous technique designed to combat magical phenomena via thaumic combustion. Thaumic combustion is a process similar to mundane combustion, but instead of affecting the material plane if interacts with the aetheric one.

Similarly to normal combustion, which requires fuel, oxygen and heat to occur, thaumic combustion also requires three things to happen. These requirements are: inner mana (mana originating from inside a being), outer mana (mana originating from the world) and thaumic heat (a measurement of mana volatility).

The process of thaumic combustion creates what is known as a thaumic blaze, also known as mana fire. As an exothaumic reaction, mana fire raises the volatility of nearby mana. This makes the actualization of spellcraft harder. When close to sources of inner mana that are exposed to outer mana, like spells, this allows mana fire to spread.

Mana Burn is divided into three steps; Friction, Ignition and Stoking.

Friction involves "clashing" your mana with the mana of the world. This artificially raises the volatility of both. Once the volatility reaches the required threshold, Ignition will naturally happen.

Ignition is the creation of a small aura of mana fire around your body. This fire will go out if not maintained, which is where Stoking comes in.

Stoking is the process of maintaining the mana fire in a controlled way. Under fueling it will lead to it going out, while over fueling it will quickly consume your mana.

The aura of mana fire from Mana Burn will automatically consume magical phenomena that come near you, either burning inner mana in it as fuel, or using the outer mana forming it as a catalyst. Significantly powerful magical phenomena may overpower your aura or cause it to go out of control. This can be counteracted through careful control of your mana to direct it.

objects.title: Arcane Synapse
objects.text:
You possess a myriad of arcane "nerves" spread across the entire universe. These nerves allow you to use any teleportation or similar powers much more easily, removing the need for detailed knowledge of the destination or a mental image, as well as simplifying navigation in dimensions and spaces with different laws of physics and reality.

Additionally, these nerves allow you to passively analyse the underlying laws of reality, and, in case you are ever trapped in a "lower-ranked" reality compared to the regular one you inhabit, like in a lower dimension, a simulation, a dream, etc., you will be able to detect such an occurrence and construct a spell to escape rather easily.

Lastly, by expending mana, you can utilise these nerves to telekinetically manipulate matter and energy, albeit the cost rises dramatically with distance to the object you wish to manipulate, its mass, and the complexity of the action.

objects.title: Arcane Knight
objects.text:
You are a quintessential magic knight. Even without any magic, you possess a transcendental talent and nigh-unrivalled skill with any weapon, to the point where even as a child with no prior experience you would've been able to best masters of a blade with only a few days' practice.

Martial prowess, however, is far from your only strength. You also possess the same extreme talent in all things related to magic, with especial proficiency in anything related to combat. You already have mastered a few dozen spells for nearly any situation; you can summon magical weapons, enhance your armaments and armour, and use spells that would help you endure the rigours of armoured warfare and quickly patch up wounds, whether your own or those of your allies.

But where you truly shine is in the merging of the two. Combining your magic and martial prowess comes as easy as breathing and yields results far greater than the sum of their parts. If you had peers in the field of magic, when you take up the sword, you would cut them down in droves.

Your mind and body are hardened and trained to the point where you can fight for days straight without rest, with the reaction time and perception fast enough to allow you to fire off a dozen spells in a few seconds in the heat of the combat.

objects.title: Digestion Magic
objects.text:
You have gained the potential to earn the skills to becoming a Digestive Mage. What this means is that you gain access to a magical system all about food consumption, with anything you can digest being the fuel to your abilities.

To succeed as a digestive mage, you need to keep in mind two principles. One, food is fuel, and the more you cast spells, the more calories and fat you burn, so be sure to be able to hold onto a good amount of meals or else you may accidentally starve yourself to death via overexertion. Two, whatever you consume shall end up becoming the basis of the spell you're conjuring. Your stomach is a cauldron, and the right combination of ingredients shall provide you with interesting results. This ranges from simple ones like drinking fireball to cast fireball, to more complex spells like opening a small portal to an eldritch dimension via eating squid ink pasta. The effectiveness depends on how properly the dish is cooked and how much you can stomach the dish, meaning this magic system has near endless experimentation if you're willing to expand your palette. This isn't even counting the types of forbidden magic you can do with it via cannibalism or ingesting more dangerous stuff, with this magic manifesting differently depending on the diet of different species who end up practicing it.

Overall, you are encouraged to see what you can do with this new practice. Food is the gift of the Gods, and you are its devoted servant. Your body is no longer a temple, it is a kitchen, and you are a master chef. Now get to tasting, and remember, indulge a little, and don't starve yourself by pushing yourself way too hard.

objects.title: Monster Development 101
objects.text:
You have undergone a course in the development of monstrous beings, inducting you with the innate capacity to produce, contain, and utilise what is known in the biz as monstrous energy without suffering horrific mutations.

A monster comes neither from the chicken nor the egg, but from this transformative force filtered through the conditions provided to it. This energy consumes and incorporates whatever resources are made available to it, whether existing energies, inorganic materials, organic matter, or less mundane sources. Left uncontrolled, it rapidly adapts and mutates whatever it comes into contact with, reshaping it to facilitate the production and propagation of both itself and new monsters.

While monstrous energy is technically expended when incorporated into a monster, the resulting creature's life cycle naturally produces more of it. This generally occurs through the consumption of resources, reproduction through processes analogous to mitosis or meiosis, and, eventually, death.

Unless purified, monstrous energy retains an imprint of everything it has been exposed to. This allows it to become increasingly sophisticated with each generation, though in the wild it has a tendency to favour predatory behaviours and physiologies.

Once 'born', its host monster constantly circulates the monstrous energy, with accumulation of additional energy what allows them to 'grow up' so to speak. Environmental stressors or exposure to foreign monstrous energy can influence this natural evolution, potentially speciating into something entirely new.

Evolution can also occur through reproduction, as offspring may mutate in response to the surge of monstrous energy involved in their creation, through the coupling of otherwise different monsters, or through the introduction of foreign monstrous energy by some source.

Death releases their accumulated stores of monstrous energy back into the environment. Monsters descended from monsters can decay relatively normally, being consumed by rot and contributing to the ecology. Created or ex nihilo monsters, by contrast, rapidly break down and release their energy into the atmosphere unless stabilised.

Beyond the ecology of monsters, their parts are exceptionally valuable, as they possess numerous secondary adaptations beyond the obvious abilities of a creature. A dragon's fire breath, may also result in fireproof throat sacs large enough to be worked into a cloak. Monstrous flesh is likewise remarkably delicious and nutritious, often providing various beneficial effects, being completely safe to eat if processed.

While monstrous energy is capable of producing similar effects, without samples of esoteric energy it can only emulate supernatural phenomena at the cost of vital monstrous energy itself. This allows normally impossible traits such as telekinesis, hypnotic pheromones, or superhuman strength to exist.

Such abilities are usually limited in scope unless possessed by a monster with exceptionally concentrated reserves, necessitating more cost-effective supporting adaptations as possible to reduce the energetic cost.

When exposed to examples of esoteric energies or capabilities, monstrous energy demonstrates a remarkable ability to reproduce and incorporate them. Once successfully adapted, these properties can subsequently be passed on to new monsters.

It can even mutate such esoteric phenomena, a far riskier proposition than ordinary monstrous mutation, potentially twisting the original capability in unstable ways, resulting in creatures that are dangerous to themselves and others.

As a baseline, your reserves are sufficient to produce an ex nihilo monster on the level of a baby acidic slime every hour, with larger or more complex creations requiring proportionally greater quantities of monstrous energy and resources.

In addition, you have the technical expertise necessary to design and construct basic monster-development equipment, focusing on monstrous energy production, processing and containment.

objects.title: Spell Swap
objects.text:
You can swap any spell in your opponent's arsenal for any one spell you are capable of casting yourself. The next time your opponent tries to cast the swapped spell, the one you placed in its stead will take effect. This allows you to bypass opponents' resistances and defences by having them, for example, cast debuffs on themselves instead of buffs.

The swap-out is so intricate that it is impossible to tell when a spell has been switched for anyone but you. Even a god of magic will be unable to detect anything amiss until the wrong spell activates.

objects.title: Kaiju Witch
objects.text:
You have become a Kaiju Witch, a Magical Girl whose magic fundamentally is based around manifesting and drawing upon aspects of Kaiju.

With this magic, you could recreate the abilities and traits of Kaiju as spells, summon spectral limbs of Kaiju for a myriad of purposes, create transformations based on Kaiju you have an affinity with, call upon an associated Kaiju to enhance and reshape spells of any other magic you may possess, and perhaps in time figure out how to make Kaiju themselves.

addons.title: Expanded Kaiju Spellcraft
addons.text: Oh my, it seems that you’ve managed to transfer your knowledge of Kaiju producing mutagens and energies into a repertoire of spells. Further, you’ve expanded not only into spells to permanently alter others with Kaiju traits, but also on how to pull a Rita Repulsa and make your monsters grow.

objects.title: Thread Magic
objects.text:
With this power, you possess the ability to perceive and manipulate magic in the form of threads. Your thread magic initially takes the form of clear threads that you can weave, create knots in, and dye with concepts. Clear threads can be used to accomplish a wide variety of basic magical spells, however they will always be more rudimentary and weaker than fully dyed threads. Spells are created by weaving threads together into patterns. Further complexity and control over spells can be attained by creating knots in the pattern; for example taking a relatively basic magical shield woven from threads, and applying knots which better manage impacts or convert the shield into a ward.

But it is the ability to dye your threads with a variety of concepts and elements that truly elevates your magical workings. Through meditation, time based on the complexity of the element / concept, and being in a location strongly associated with the element / concept you gain the permanent ability to dye your threads in that particular element / concept. Knots, particularly, help coordinate thread weaves of different dyes, ensuring that possible volatile combinations will work together. With research into your dyes you will be able to adjust the hues to further add complexity to your spells. For example dyeing threads with water would initially allow you to cast magic associated with water, however with further experimentation you will find that water dyes also, when tweaked, add fluidity and adaptability to your spells. Each dye increases the possibilities of your magic near exponentially, however it will be entirely up to you to explore and expand your capabilities.

While you will certainly be able to utilize thread magic in direct combat, bear in mind that its true greatest capabilities will be found in magics such as wards, enchantments, great workings of magic. Essentially magics that allow for great complexity, often permanency, and likely aren't the quickest in a tight situation.

You gain the ability to wield the magic from the Magicka games. With this power, you become a master of elemental forces, able to use and combine the elements of Water, Lightning, Life, Arcane, Shield, Earth, Cold, Fire, and the sub elements of Steam (Fire & Water), Ice (Water & Cold), and Poison (Water & Arcane)

You gain the ability to wield Magicks, powerful spells with more abstract effects than raw elemental destruction, such as Reviving people from the dead (helpful when you blow somebody up by accident), Nullifying changes to the environment (helpful for cleaning up all the property damage you're going to cause), randomly instakilling someone in the general vicinity (possibly including you), or Summoning a Napalm Airstrike from thin air (no, really.)

You can also create any of the staffs, robes, or weapons found in the games or DLCs
objects.title: Grimnir (Magicka)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of various rituals, as well as your knowledge of and proficiency in magic, have synergised exceptionally well. While rituals themselves are usually based on the idea of imitation of a higher power, you can now use one more level of abstraction, imitating the necessary conditions required for various occult practices.

Using the mechanics of Idol Theory, you can now replace the events, materials, and phenomena required for your rituals, magic, potions, etc., with substitutes that bear the necessary symbolic resemblance, at least in your own mind. For example, do you need to ritualistically draw blood from the possessed inside a magical circle to initiate an exorcism? Well, now you can lure your target to a round enough stadium and draw some blood during combat; it will serve as an appropriate substitute. Need for the ritual to take place during the first sunlight? Well, you can just blow up a gas canister in the air to imitate the rising of the sun. This makes your occult knowledge not only applicable even in the middle of the combat, but it also serves to mask your intent, as it is enough for your actions to bear symbolic resemblance to the ritual in your mind only, with your opponents being none the wiser.

This can also be used to weaken or, in some cases, depower or even outright kill your opponents. If your opponent has a symbolic resemblance, or, even better, has its abilities or magic based upon some known character from fiction or history, you can now use this character's weaknesses against your opponent. For example, if a magician styles their magic, or at least bears enough resemblance in your mind to Cinderella, you can rewind any clock to strike midnight, symbolising the time when Cinderella's magic ran out, depowering your opponent.

All this makes the outcome of your occult practices much more predictable, as it is far less dependent on various random variables. But, at the same time, the harder it is for you to see the resemblance, the less potent the effect will be.
addons.title: Levels of Abstraction

objects.text:
Magic is the science and art of causing change to occur in conformity with Will.

- Aleister Crowley, Magic in theory and practice

You have gained the ability to perform magic based on the concept of Idol Theory. This theory states that it is possible to draw out a small portion of the power of a great source of magic by performing the actions or using special items that bear enough of a symbolic resemblance to the source in question. The closer the resemblance, the more power can be drawn out. In practice, this has mainly led to the creation of spells and spiritual items. They are an end product of exhaustive attempts, through much trial and error, to imitate some grand event or phenomenon, when everything irrelevant and insignificant has been pruned. In case of the spells, only a gesture or a few words needed for activation of the effect are left, and in case of spiritual items, only a close enough shape and material, followed by complex rituals to infuse the object with your mana. Of course, this still requires a deep understanding of the intended effect as well as the nature of what is being imitated for spells and spiritual items to have any effect. The inverse is also possible, with changes enforced upon the representation, copy, or a part, sometimes affecting the greater whole. Like curses that can be transmitted through a severed body part or a voodoo doll; creating a ritualistic representation of the room atop a table, then flipping the table, with the gravity in the room following suit as if the room itself was flipped; drawing a number of portals on an incredibly accurate map of a country, and then such portals will appearing in the real world. Idol Theory functions without regard for intent, so even someone with no knowledge of magic can, for example, accidentally arrange various objects in correct formation and trigger a spell, albeit the probability of such a case is so low that it might as well be nonexistent. Now, pick one ideological premise, preferably one that is close to you mentally, spiritually, or culturally. It can be anything — a religion, a fairy tale, etc. All these beliefs form Phases, dimensions and universes in their own right that act as a sort of filter that overlap the real world and change how we perceive it. They also serve as the most common source of power for magicians. You will gain knowledge of a dozen spells, based on your theme, as well as enhanced aptitude towards creating new ones that are rooted in the same ideology. You are not limited to one theme; just as there are an immeasurable number of Phases, with enough research, you can access any of them and create spells that can shatter even the most fundamental aspects of reality under the influence of these alien laws. But the grander the spell, the more potent the effect — the more effort it takes to create it. With the most powerful ones, ones that can be considered your magnum opus, easily take decades of extensive research. But with enough study and dedication, nothing is beyond your grasp. Initially, you have an average amount of mana, but you can increase your reserves with practice and specific techniques, such as purifying and converting the energy of your soul. You can also use mana from neutral outside sources, such as Ley lines or even specific energies of other Phases, although the latter will take a great amount of preparation, generally far beyond the grasp of novice magicians such as you are now, and in most cases carries with it a great deal of drawbacks.
objects.title: Magician (Raildex)

objects.text: You now possess perfect eidetic memory. You are capable of instantly memorizing everything you experience down to the most minute detail, such as remembering songs up to the exact decibel or analyzing a 30 FPS anime frame-by-frame after seeing it once. Additionally, you are immune to any corruptive mental effects any forbidden knowledge might bring. This allowed you to safely record the contents of 103,000 magical grimoires, instantly making you one of, if not the most knowledgeable person in regards to magic. While you are incapable of performing magic, unless you possess another power that would make it possible, your vast knowledge, paired with your supreme analytical skills, nevertheless allows you to use some abilities that do not require mana. First of all, you are capable of instantly pinpointing weaknesses in other people's spells, even in active combat, so long as their spells are based on the knowledge from one of the grimoires in your memory. This allows you to very effectively use spell intercept, a short incantation based on Notarikon codes capable of hijacking an opponent's spell, making it go berserk, or even outright canceling it. Lastly, you are capable of Singing. A practice that allows you, through various songs, to unravel spells and other similar supernatural effects. Both Notarikon incantations and Singing can be used to share, temporarily or permanently, the knowledge contained within your mind with others. Do note that others do not possess your natural resistance to the corruptive influence of grimoires.
objects.title: Index Librorum Prohibitorum (Raildex)

objects.text: You gain a magical tattoo somewhere on your body that grants you access to a selection of magic spells that can be cast innately. You can choose which mark will manifest. The more you use your mark, the more it will grow in power and increase the amount and selection of spells you have access to. The time to go from Least to Lesser takes around a year, then two years to Greater, then four to Siberys.
objects.title: Dragonmark (D&D)

objects.text: Kineticists are living channels for elemental matter and energy, manipulating the world around them by drawing upon inner reserves from their own bodies. You start as at the level of a newly awakened kineticist with a single elemental focus. With training, you will be able to unlock more and develop a wide variety of techniques.
objects.title: Kineticist (Pathfinder)

objects.text:
You are proficient in the use of Occult Magic. You start off at the level of a novice (1st level spells). Through research and rigorous training you can increase the number of spells you can memorize as well as the level of spells you can cast.

This power can behave like any of the arcane classes available such as the Psychic, Occultist, or Mesmerist. The classes are merely guidelines for the unexperienced to follow, you are are not locked into any single class, and can instead can develop any class features available to the various Occult Magic classes. 

Outside of Golarion you are able to cast spells of the 10th level and higher as the gods cannot reach you there.
objects.title: Occult Magic (Pathfinder)

addons.text: You are now a master of the magic of Hydeland, especially that used by Wizards, Sorceresses, and Enchanters like Morgan Lisley. On top of gaining their mystic knowledge, spells, & abilities, you can choose to use your MP (which recharges relatively quickly) to cast D&D/Pathfinder Arcane Spells instead of exhausting your spell slots. The inverse is also true.
addons.title: Mental Absorb (Dragon's Crown)

addons.text: You start as an Arcanist, which blends the spontaneous casting of the Sorcerer with the flexibility of the Wizards. You have two sets of spell slots, one where your spells are prepared and another set that are expended when a spell is cast; this allows you to, for example, prepare both Shield and Magic Missile as 1st level spells, but cast one of them two times. On top of this, you have an arcane pool, separate from your spell slots, that allows you to use Exploits and meta-magic. You start with 2 exploits known and the ability to cast 3rd level spells; your repertoire of spells also expands to include arcane spells from the Warcraft series.
addons.title: Arcanist (Pathfinder)

addons.text: Most mages spend their lives stuck in their towers, poring over dusty tomes. You are not most mages, you are a man (or woman) of action, you embody the term "sword and sorcery." As a Magus, you gain the ability to spellstrike with a melee or ranged weapon. You can imbue a touch-range or projectile-based spells into your strike and deliver it straight to your enemy while looking at them in the eyes. You also have an arcane pool, separate from your spell slots, that can be used to grant your weapon an enhancement bonus (up to +5) or a magical property (such as flaming or vorpal). During your travels, you will also develop new ways to blend your magical and martial skills called arcana; some of those arcana might allow you to draw from your arcana pool to enhance your spells, gain minor abilities, or enhance yourself; others give you a new perspective on things and can expand your abilities, such as borrowing features from other classes, the ability to blend spells together, and more. You start with the ability to cast 3rd level spells.
addons.title: Magus (Pathfinder)
Orb of Karsus
addons.text:
Like Gale of Waterdeep before you, you play host to the Orb of Karsus, otherwise known as the malformed Karsite Weave. However, unlike your predecessor, you have the means to control its power and make it your own, as it is your second piece of Karsus’s own Regalia.

The Orb is, in the most simple terms, a powerful arcane battery, one that can condense and store immense amounts of mystic energy.

In its current (largely empty) state, possessing the Orb alongside the Crown doesn’t provide you with much more than an additional reserve to cast from. However, should you diligently feed the Orb mystic energies you can unlock it’s true potential as the Karsite Weave.

Once you’ve gathered enough energy you can wield the Orb to grant magic to other beings just like the True Weave of Mystra and Mystryl before her. You retain complete control over this Weave, allowing you to set restrictions on who can use it and what they could use it for, even going so far as restricting the use of individual spells on each user of your Weave. 

On a personal level, casting through your Weave allows you to bypass many restrictions on your spellcasting, even those Mystra imposes on Toril. Likewise, casting this way can allow you to significantly exceed your normal limits as a spell caster, letting you wear away at your fledgling Weave to wield the might of an Archmage, even as a mere apprentice.

With just a slight push beyond that level, you could even use your artifacts to ascend into a proper God of Magic, one innately capable of growing in divine power by consuming magical energies, including those of other gods. Though you should tread carefully with this, lest you destroy the foundation of your own powers as Karsus himself did, or anger the wrong deity by encroaching on their domain.

objects.text:
You are proficient in using Arcane magic. You begin as a novice, capable of casting 1st level spells, you will gradually gain more spells and unlock higher levels of magic as your mastery of arcane energy improves.

This power can behave like any of the arcane magic based classes available such as Wizard, Sorcerer, Arcanist, and even hybrid classes like Magus. The classes are merely guidelines for the unexperienced to follow, you are not locked into any particular one, and can instead develop any class features available to them.

Outside of the Forgotten Realms or Golarion you are able to cast spells of the 10th level and higher as the gods cannot reach you there.
objects.title: Arcane Magic (D&D/Pathfinder)

addons.text: Thanks to the synergy between your druidic powers, you become on par with a level 20 Archdruid. This also allows you to recharge your spell slots with your mana, breaking your limit on spellcasting between long rests, although this takes a short amount of time and concentration, making your spell slots valuable for casting your spells in a rapid manner. You can also Wild Shape an unlimited amount of times, and with effort and mastery, any and all forms you take can be trained to the level of a true feral druid, with a Circle of the Moon-focused druid becoming especially powerful as a shapeshifter.
addons.title: Archdruid

addons.text: Your conduit to divine power is different from others — instead of prayers and worship, you glean sacred truths and great mysteries of the divine essence, either because you perceive the common ground between deities or even circumvent their power entirely. You explore one of these mysteries and draw upon its power to cast miraculous spells, but that power comes with a terrible price: a curse that grows stronger the more you draw upon it. Tied to your chosen mystery, the source of your powers, is an oracular curse, the consequences of tapping into forces greater than yourself. You also gain special revelation spells that act as focus spells, and several mystery spells that are added to your spell list on top of those you already know. When you cast those spells your curse worsens and its effects become more pronounced until it becomes debilitating and you become unable to cast spells, the effects of the curse recede over several hours. You start with the ability to cast 3rd level spells.
addons.title: Oracle (Pathfinder)

objects.text:
You are proficient in using divine magic and have discovered how to tap into divine sources of power. You begin as a novice, capable of casting 1st level spells. Regardless of whether your power comes from worshiping a deity or other sources like abstract ideas, personal beliefs, or universal forces, you will gradually gain more spells and unlock higher levels of magic as your mastery of divine energy improves.

This power can behave like any of the divine magic based classes available such as cleric, druid, oracle, and even hybrid classes like Paladin. The classes are merely guidelines for the unexperienced to follow, you are not locked into any particular one, and can instead develop any class features available to them.

Outside of the Forgotten Realms or Golarion you are able to cast spells of the 10th level and higher as the gods cannot reach you there.
objects.title: Divine Magic (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text:
You are adept in using Weird Magic, the special magic hags pick up that just doesn’t obey the normal rules of magic. It can be used to do things other casters can’t or to mimic more traditional spells in line with your equivalent level in highly nontraditional ways, like healing minor injuries by releasing a swarm of wasps to stitch you up with their stingers.

Most of the magic this can give you is minor tricks, but extremely powerful users are on par with powerful beings like the Archfey who rule the Feywild. Hags of renown or experience could know rituals to temporarily or permanently alter a creature, bring back the dead for a limited time, rewrite memories, or siphon emotions. Even hags of regular power can have tricks in their backpocket like knowing the ways to invoke the razor wind or the three syllables for crystallizing blood.

Most uses of Weird Magic involve items that are difficult or impossible to duplicate or replace, making almost all uses one-off. The strength of Weird magic lies in being an endless bag of novel tricks, rather than something you can consistently rely on specific uses of like with orthodox methods of casting.

You begin as a novice, capable of using magic equivalent to 1st level spells, and you will gradually gain more spells and unlock higher levels of magic as your mastery of arcane energy improves. Weird Magic calls upon the Weave just like Arcane Magic, just in a different way that makes it act like an entirely different system. Outside of the Forgotten Realms or Golarion it will be able to create effects equivalent to 10th level and higher spells.
objects.title: Weird Magic (D&D)

objects.text:
You are proficient in the use of Primal Magic. You start off at the level of a novice (1st level spells). Through research and rigorous training you can increase the number of spells you can memorize as well as the level of spells you can cast.

This power can behave like any of the primal classes available such as the Druid. The classes are merely guidelines for the unexperienced to follow, you are not locked into any single class, and can instead can develop any class features available to the various Primal Magic classes.

Outside of Golarion you are able to cast spells of the 10th level and higher as the gods cannot reach you there.
objects.title: Primal Magic (Pathfinder)

objects.text:
You are proficient in the use of Elemental Magic. You start off at the level of a novice (1st level spells). Through research and rigorous training you can increase the number of spells you can memorize as well as the level of spells you can cast.

This power can behave like any of the classes that can access elemental magic such as the Sorcerer, Wizard, or Druid. The classes are merely guidelines for the unexperienced to follow, you are not locked into any single class, and can instead can develop any class features available to the various Elemental Magic classes.

Outside of Golarion you are able to cast spells of the 10th level and higher as the gods cannot reach you there.
objects.title: Elemental Magic (Pathfinder)

addons.text:
Your blessing of music and abilities as a bard seems to have gotten along like a house on fire. You start with far more bardic abilities, specifically those of a level 20 bard. 

Your genius and unparalleled talent for music also lets you seemingly create bardic masterpieces on the fly—where others would have to toil for months or years to create such works of art, you merely have to exert the will to create to reach such goals.

The scale and reach of your masterpieces and spells have also been lifted—you are to bardic magic as Karsus was for arcane magic.

You are seemingly able to modify your spells on the fly as a sorcerer would be able to, meaning you can use meta magic on your bardic spells and bardic masterpieces.
addons.title: Musical Genius

addons.text:
Your bardic ability to influence the world with your words and song naturally compliment your understanding and ability to use the Thu’um.

So much so, that your ability to sing to creation via shouts is expanded far beyond what any mortal has ever achieved, going far beyond the three-word shouts and into the divine level of using the primordial language to sing.

When singing, you can weave complex and multi-layered effects and abilities into being, creating things from nothing, or layering complex and powerful enchantments and wards. Your ability to use the voice to affect reality is only surpassed by the divine Akatosh himself.

Furthermore, your proximity to the divine has turned your voice supernaturally beautiful, able to entrance any that hear it, not because of magic or other supernatural phenomena, but simply because of its sheer and perfect grace.
addons.title: Master of The Voice

addons.text:
Your inner light, song, and nature as a thought of Eru Ilúvatar has combined with both your peerless talent for music, and your divine understanding of the primordial language of the Thu’um, becoming something far greater. You no longer simply sing to the unseen, you sing as the unseen.

You are alike to Eru himself in skill, the secret fire burns bright within you. You are not near Eru himself in power, but in his skill at singing and using the secret fire you are close.

That, too, might change with time—as you grow more and more powerful as a greater source of light and secret fire, you could perhaps, one day in the distant future, equal his might. Nevertheless, you can sing into creation your thoughts, your ideas, your ideals, your stories, and your emotions and make them real.

You are the source of all that you create and no theme may be played that hath not its uttermost source in you, nor can any alter the music in your despite.

For he that attempteth this shall prove but thine instrument in the devising of things more wonderful, which they themselves hath not imagined.
addons.title: Singing as The Unseen

objects.text:
Whether through the power of words or music, you weave magic to inspire your allies and demoralize your enemies. You have proficiency in Bardic Magic, utilizing your force of personality and performance to influence magic and guide it to create spells.

You start with the abilities of a beginner bard as you can give bardic inspiration to people of your choice and cast 1st-level bardic spells through your performance. You also have the ability to create and perform bardic masterpieces to accomplish powerful magical effects, though doing so is far easier said than done. You can gain more feats and abilities as you improve and gain more experience in using your abilities.

This power can behave as any bardic class or archetype available such as, archeologists, Thunder Callers, or Flame Dancers. The classes and archetypes are merely guidelines for one to follow—you need not be locked into any particular one—and thus, can develop powers and abilities from any path with time and effort.

Outside the Forgotten Realms or Golarion, you are able to cast spells of 10th-level and higher, as the gods cannot reach you there.
objects.title: Bardic Magic (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text: You made a pact with an otherworldly entity for power. In exchange for the occasional favor, your supernatural sugar daddy/mommy will grant you a sliver of their power. The higher your favor with them is, the more powerful abilities you will have access to.
objects.title: Warlock (D&D)

objects.text:
You wield the power to summon any beast, being or monstrosity ever chronicled in the realm’s grand bestiaries, calling them forth from every domain to serve your will.

This power draws on an internal ‘cycle’ of conjuration magic; as it endlessly turns, the cycle amasses more energy. This can be spent to summon any creature, being or monster featured in an official D&D 5th Edition bestiary sourcebook or supplement (such as the Monster Manual, Volo’s Guide to Monsters, Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes etc). 

The magical cost of a creature is determined by its Challenge Rating (CR), with a CR of 0 requiring half a day's rotation. The cost initially doubles per fractional CR: 1 full day for CR ⅛, 2 days for CR ¼, 4 for CR ½ until reaching CR 1 at day 8. After CR 1, the cost increases at a flat 2 days per Rating (e.g. CR 2 is 10 days, CR 3 is 12 days etc), culminating in the infamous Tarrasque at CR 30.

Optionally, instead of a specific creature, you may perform a random summon for a given Challenge Rating and spend only half the usual cost of conjuration. This choice, however, is only possible for creatures with CR 10 and below. For CR 11 and higher, this option is unavailable due to the rarity and power of these fantastical beings.

Your summoned creatures are fully loyal to you, able to act autonomously, or you can exert direct control over them. You can perceive via their senses and mentally direct their actions as intuitively as your own limbs, your multitasking scaling as required to seamlessly coordinate any number of beings simultaneously.

You are immune to any harmful effects caused by your summoned creatures. Any being you purchase can be freely summoned or dismissed, returning them to nothingness to recall when needed.
objects.title: The Celestial Bestiary (D&D)

addons.title: Second Coming of Shandril Shessair
addons.text: During the days leading up to her death, Shandril Shessair displayed uniquely powerful manifestations of spellfire, though the intensity of those effects outstripped her control many times over. You gain her power, magnifying your already potent abilities, though without the loss of control. For example, she showed the ability to instantly recover her spellfire energy to dangerous levels despite having just drained herself to emptiness at one point, single-handedly destroy dracoliches at the age of sixteen, or kill a Weave-wraith through an accidental burst of spellfire—a creature equally capable of absorbing magical energies.

addons.title: Chosen of Mystra
addons.text:
You gain the might of a Chosen of Mystra, even if not one yourself, granting many benefits. You gain greater command over spells, replenishing your energies quickly and casting high-tier spells by tapping into the Weave. Chosen of Mystra like you become more familiar with magic and can detect its presence. In addition, you also develop immunities to certain spells, and immunity to disease and poison. You also become much more hardy, showing a toughness uncharacteristic of most mages, and age extremely slowly. Finally, you can utilize silver fire, a kind of specialized variant of spellfire in a refined, controlled and precise incarnation, and can thus be used in more complex and subtle ways, though perhaps less destructively. 

Silver fire can be used for the same destructive and healing purposes as spellfire, instantly restore dead areas' connection to magic, purge all external magical and psionic compulsions from yourself, or teleport without error. It can also be used to hold spells and cast them without need for verbal, somatic, or material components. While spellfire needs a source of magic to draw on, your silver fire is granted to you directly by Mystra and needs no such fuel, though it is still subject to its own limitations.

objects.text:
Spellfire users possess a rare and powerful ability to draw on the raw energies of the Weave itself. The result is a storied power that produces great legends and the interest of mighty beings.

Wielders of spellfire are mainly known for three manifestations of their power. Firstly, they could hurl stored energy as an all-consuming, blue-white flame that was destructive beyond its heat. Secondly, they could use their stored energy to replenish their own health. Finally, they could absorb energy from spells that struck them, if they readied themselves to do so, with the limit for energy absorption depending only on their hardiness. Starting as an inexperienced wielder, however, you will have only the most basic of abilities. These are still quite useful, and include: immunity to fire, the ability to absorb mundane and magical fire passively to bolster your own energy, the ability to detect magic as far as you can see, a sense of any other wielding of spellfire within 100 miles, the ability to purge yourself of all diseases or poisons with your spellfire, and complete immunity to disintegration magic. Creatures sustained by magic are also defenceless against spellfire, and any blow that strikes them will disregard any damage mitigation.

With practice, you'll eventually unlock new secrets, like channelling and hurling spellfire from anywhere on your body. Advanced users of spellfire have utilized several strange applications, such as using it for flight or blocking flying projectiles. You could also drain enchanted devices, eventually learning how to temporarily quench the power, even in permanent ones, to power yourself. There are many more applications beyond this, for you to eventually master as you grow into a spellfire hierophant.

However, this power does not come without risks, such as in the case of overloading your spellfire: some wielders were known to train and exceed their limits for energy several times over, with increasing danger and discomfort: beyond one's normal capacity, being touched would waste energy as a harmless, if alarming, burst of light, and risk backlash. These issues will only intensify with an increased overdraw.

Despite not being a spell, spellfire can be dispelled by anti-magic, though spells of this variety can be absorbed as well. Spellfire wielders who can cast magic can absorb their own spells at reduced efficiency, but trying to cast spells on yourself will likely be distressing and painful. In theory, this power shouldn't replenish itself unless you're in Realmspace, but buying it here lets you circumvent that by making you a living font of spellfire. As a spellfire wielder, it will always be difficult to travel through the Weave itself, concerning teleportation magic, or through anything similar in other worlds.
objects.title: Spellfire (D&D)

objects.text:
Arcane, the most common form of magic, comes from the cosmic concept of order. It is a cold and intellectual magic that warps time, space, and controls the flow of mana. Though extremely volatile, arcane can be so similar to an element it might as well be one, for all magical intents and purposes; for example, a fireball isn’t actually fire, it is just arcane that mimics fire. While arcane represents order, fel is the magic of chaos and disorder, and thus they are considered opposite ends of the same spectrum.
Since arcane spawns from order it can technically do anything as long as enough power and knowledge is used, however this power must be gained naturally and rightfully, as order allows no shortcuts to power.
objects.title: Arcane Magic (Warcraft)

addons.text:
"Gilded icons and dogmatic rituals; For some, a tonic against the bloodshed."
-The Ancestor

Your power over Light now includes the Light of the Darkest Dungeon universe, as manifested in the abilities of the Vestals, the Crusaders, the Lepers, the Flagellants, the Fanatic, & the Prophet. You also gain the strange and cheerful bardic abilities of the Jester.
addons.title: Transept (Darkest Dungeon)

objects.text:
Light and Shadow are the most fundamental forces in existence. They dwell outside reality, but shades of them drift into our reality.

Light exists in the physical world as holy magic, holy magic can heal, defend, attack, and restore life to the dead. Although only experienced practitioners can restore life to the dead. This magic is very effective against anything un-natural, undead, demonic, or otherwise in contact with shadow. The light and holy magic promote positive emotions and feelings in all that feel and see it.
The Light shows only half the truth. It cannot fully see destiny, though neither can the Void because neither is singularly responsible for creation.
objects.title: Light Magic (Warcraft)

addons.text:
"In time, you will come to know the tragic extent of my failings..."
-The Ancestor

Your power over Darkness now includes the Darkness of the Darkest Dungeon universe, as manifested in the abilities of the Occultists, Cultists, Necromancers, the Abominations, & the Ancestor himself. You also receive the Alchemical knowledge of the Plague Doctors, The Antiquarians, The Crones, & The Hag.
addons.title: Necromancer (Darkest Dungeon)

objects.text: The void, also referred to as shadow, along with the Light, are one of the most fundamental forces in existence. They dwell outside reality, but shades of them drift into our reality. Void exists in the physical world as shadow magic The Void is not necessarily "evil", it is a primal force with its morality characterized by how it is wielded. The Void can be a source of terrible power, the kind of power that comes at a price. While the Light is often said to bring about feelings of positive emotion—hope, courage, comfort—and the like, Shadow abilities are the opposite, able to impart feelings like despair, doubt, and panic. In a poetic sense, it can be said that the emotions which the Light brings about come from the "heart", whereas the emotions manipulated by Shadow are often based on survival logic, and therefore affect the "mind". The Void shows only half truths. It cannot fully see destiny, though neither can the Light because neither is singularly responsible for creation. The magic can accomplish many things and can effect reality to a great degree, but never without some form o sacrifice, in the form of mana most of the time.
objects.title: Shadow Magic (Warcraft)

addons.text: Thanks to your druidic affinity for beasts and shapeshifting and your mastery of the Theriomorphosis Surgery you unlocked the ability to do partial shapeshifting like therianthropes, and if you are a therianthrope yourself you can also treat it as a druidic form exclusive to yourself, enhancing it with your magical capabilities. As you research and master your new powers you can also improve your surgery to impart magical power associated with the animal form they take, like magical claws, fly with wings which shouldn’t be able to support their bodies or even become completely invisible with a stealthy animal turning others into shapeshifters on par or even better compared to true feral druids.
addons.title: Feral Theriamorph

addons.text:
Thanks to your divinity, you become a fledgling Wild God. You must choose an animal or one of your existing forms, which will become your new true form, massively empowering it while also boosting all of your druidic powers massively. You can also effortlessly shapeshift back to your original appearance. Any offspring you have will also become a hybrid heavily affected by your own form and powers, granting them a demigod status.

You also gain an innate authority over all creatures tied to your own true form, making you their ruler unless there are other divine beings to contest you.

Finally, this allows you to start your own druid circle, bestowing druidic powers on others and also granting them your own druidic form in its basic version.
addons.title: Wild God

addons.text:
Your Soul Garden changed into a nature sanctuary and afterlife comparable to Ardenweald. Now any and all animals and beast like creatures which matters to you can enjoy their afterlife within your own soul, while also empowering your druidic powers as you become a Guardian of the natural cycle of life and death.

You can also use your rebirth spell to resurrect souls from your soul garden, but it requires either their own corpse, which is restored, or you must grow a wildseed, which, if carefully nurtured, will allow them to be reborn as an animal they have the most affinity for.
addons.title: Heart of the Forest

addons.text: Your druidic powers combined, boosting your powers to be on par with the offsprings of the demigod Cenarius who protect the woodlands of Azeroth. This will allow you to shapeshift into a dryad-like, half-stag, and half-humanoid form, which will boost your magical powers massively. Compared to the Moonkin, the other common magically focused form druids can take, this grants you power over plants, animals, and nature in a more general sense instead of harnessing the powers of the sun and moon. Allowing you to effortlessly commune with nature and, with mastery, even reach the consciousness of the planet itself.
addons.title: Keeper of the Grove

objects.text:
The energies of life, commonly known as nature magic, promote growth and renewal in all things. Death, in the form of necromantic magic, acts as a counterbalance to life. Together, these two forces hold sway over every living thing in the physical universe.

Life lies closer to the light while death closer to shadow, life is the magic and force which controls and makes all things that live, nature and all that includes are a result of the energies of life seeping into the universe, this allows you to create, manipulate and heal all natural things.
objects.title: Nature Magic (Warcraft)

objects.text: Necromancy, also called the dark arts or the black arts, is the study and use of magic to raise and control the dead or death. Necromantic magic, or death magic, has many functions beyond simply raising the dead. Masters of this tainted field of magic can conjure festering diseases, harness the shadows into bolts of incendiary energy, and chill the living with the power of death. Necromancy can also be used to reconstruct the flesh of undead creatures, allowing them to function again even after the foul monsters have been destroyed. Death magic comes from the cosmic force of death, all things that have a beginning will have an ending, it is the opposite of life which spawns all things and is therefor the end to things, this is not necessarily evil, although it has been used for evil things commonly, it is a natural part of the world and holds no moral leanings what so ever.
objects.title: Death Magic (Warcraft)

objects.text: Fel magic is a destructive form of magic often used by the members of the Burning Legion. It is demonic, entropic, chaotic and extremely volatile. Its use results in the alteration of the individual, or corruption, which manifests as a physical transformation such as a change to an individual's eyes or skin color, or heavy genetic mutations. All of the Burning Legion carry the taint of Fel magic within their very blood, allowing them to spread greater evil. Warlocks use life force to power their fel magic. Fel magic is the opposite of arcane magic and is chaotic and unpredictable, no study will allow you to fully tame fel and produce the same effect over and over again, fel does as it pleases. It can easily be said that you are as much its servant as it is yours to wield.
objects.title: Fel Magic (Warcraft)

addons.text: Your gift for divine magic allows you to serve as a conduit for spirits; through you, these spirits can commune and interact with the physical world. The form these spirits take varies widely, from ghosts that linger in the world, to spirit animals and even powerful elementals. You can choose to either form a bond with a small roster of spirits that travel with you wherever you go, or commune with local spirits, or a mix of both; at most, you can form bonds with many spirits but can only attune with four of them at once during your daily preparations, one of which must be your primary spirit, and can switch which of the two spirits is active when you refocus. You can channel the powers of your bonded spirit to reinforce your body, enhance your strikes, and eventually assume the form of an Avatar (a 10th level spell) which fully embodies the power of your bonded spirit. Your spell slots are split equally between your innate ability to channel magic, which manifests in the form of prepared spells, and your active spirit, which manifests as spontaneous spells; you also gain up to three vessel spells, which are a type of focus spell, tied to your primary spirit. Your spirit spell slots do not recharge when you refocus and change your active spirit, only the spells available to you. You start with the ability to cast 5th level spells.
addons.title: Animist (Pathfinder)

objects.text:
Shamanism is the spiritual practice of communing with the primal elements and the spirits that govern the natural and spiritual realms. Through this connection, shamans wield the raw forces of Water, Earth, Fire, and Air, bending them to their will in both battle and healing. Whether unleashing devastating balls of lava, calling down lightning to smite foes, fortifying their physical strength with the resilience of stone, hastening their attacks with the swiftness of wind, or healing and even resurrecting allies with the restorative properties of water, shamanism is as versatile as it is powerful.

But shamanism is not limited to elemental manipulation alone. True mastery involves forming deep bonds with the elements themselves, the elemental spirits that embody them, ancestral spirits, and even primal gods. These relationships are built on mutual respect, honor, and sometimes delicate negotiation. By cultivating this connection, a shaman can achieve extraordinary feats, such as assuming a temporary ascended state, transforming into spectral animals like wolves, peering into the threads of fate to glimpse the future, and even self resurrection.

However, shamanism is not without risks. The elements are not inherently benevolent, and the spirits a shaman communes with may have their own desires and tempers. Displeasing a spirit, abusing the power granted, or communing with malevolent entities could lead to catastrophic consequences. A shaman who loses the favor of the elements may find themselves unable to call upon their power, or worse, subject to the wrath of these primal forces. Respect, balance, and wisdom are the keys to a shaman’s success and survival.
objects.title: Shaman Magic (Warcraft)

addons.text:
Through the Solver of All Equations, you've mastered the art of combining Runes to produce precisely the effects you need. Simply thinking of an idea causes your Alpha Stigma to assemble the correct runes and arrange them in your mind. From there, you can project these runes into existence through your vision alone—no need to trace them in the air or inscribe them on objects. All you require is your sight and a clear target for the runes.

With your abilities to copy and analyze magic, any spell or magical effect you encounter is broken down and recreated through your own runes. This allows you to modify spells, granting them new effects or significantly enhancing them by adjusting or adding to the rune sequence. Enchantments work similarly; any that you observe are deconstructed, enabling you to strengthen them or eliminate weaknesses before applying them to objects or people.

Additionally, your eyes have integrated a runic sequence that generates vast amounts of magical energy to power your runes, effectively enabling you to cast powerful magic. The only real weaknesses you have is that you didn't start with any runes inscribed on your body or eyes to increase your physical durability and if your eyes were ever destroyed you would lose these advantages.
addons.title: Solver of All Equations

objects.text:
Runic magic is a magic that employs runes. The runes can access various types of magic, such as Fel, Void, Arcane, and Death.

Through the use of the proper combination of runes and where you inscribe them (whether it be with ink, carving, blood, magic, or even just tracing them in the air with your finger), you could do things such as enhancing your abilities or physical strength when inscribed on your body; strengthening and adding magical effects to weapons or armor; or inscribing them on a building or area as a way to ward off specific beings and energies, or to strengthen walls. Even more esoteric and blatant things, such as carving runes on stones that allow you to travel to a set location—whether it be on your current world or even another world entirely—are possible.

The ways to power runes are either by absorbing ambient mana through a unique combination of runes or by using your own or some kind of object to power them. Though with time, you may be able to find the proper combination on the proper surface to create self-sufficient runes that will always be active.

The amount of things you can do with Runic Magic depends greatly on your own knowledge and skill with runes. You gain knowledge of a great number of runes of the various types of magic that use them. But any proper use of them in the right order will need to be discovered through trial and error.

It would be best to think of it like a programming language but for magic—the better you get at it, the more complex "programs" you can create.
objects.title: Runic Magic (Warcraft)

addons.text:
To take a piece of something is to understand it, ever so slightly more. To understand something is to control it, and so the result of your ability is clear. You may expend slots of 108 Skills to learn pieces of the Name of anything within range, giving proportional control as long as it is held.

To have 1/108th of a target's Name is to have barely noticeable control, while to have the full Name would be to have full control, as expected. You may take as many pieces of a given target's Name as you would like, and you are not limited to animate beings for this function of the power.

However, as the target's power grows, they will have smaller and smaller pieces of their Name take up the same single slot. Those of extreme power may only give you the smallest fraction of control even if you dedicated all 108 slots to learning their Name, but that fraction you have is still yours to command.
addons.title: Piece of a Name

objects.text:
You have the skills of an Arcanist freshly graduated from the University and know four branches of what might be called magic. You learn and improve your skills quickly.

Sympathy is a system of energy manipulation (considered a form of magic ) that requires extreme skill and concentration. Sympathy requires a user to create a sympathetic link between two objects, so that whatever is done to one object will affect the other. For example, if a sympathist creates a sympathetic link between two coins, he may move both coins equal distances by exerting force on only one.

Sygaldry involves the use and application of runes, which create effects similar to a permanent form of sympathy. There are 197 runes, and they can be used in a variety of combinations to perform a wide assortment of effects on various materials.

Naming is a discipline where one perceives the true name of a person, place or thing, and through that understanding gains absolute control over the subject. This power can be used by the Namer in a variety of ways. For example, natural forces like the wind can be called upon to do the Namer's bidding, solid rock can be commanded to crumble into dust, and living beings and people can be forced to do whatever the Namer desires.

Little is known about Alchemy currently but it may work in a similar way to fae grammarie. By taking the substance or essence of something and adding to it or putting into a mixture. Thus making the bound 'principles' referred to in the text.
objects.title: Arcanist (Kingkiller Chronicles)

addons.text: You don’t just have the basics of the most common schools of magic, you have the basics of all forms of magic, from the tribal shamanistic spells of the Orcs and Deep Devils, to the Infernal Pacts used to summon and bind demons, even the twisted and corrupt magics of the Cult are at your disposal. Should you possess Archmage, then you even have knowledge of the unique abilities of heroes, from the arcane martial prowess of Kutsao and Saitam to the vampiric sanguinomancy of Margosa.
addons.title: A World of Magic

objects.text: You now have access to the magic used in the universe of Kingdom Rush, or at least the basics of the four most common types. You possess rudimentary beginner’s knowledge in the fields of arcane sorcery, druidcraft, necromancy, and holy magic. Arcane Sorcery involves manipulating raw magical energy for a wide variety of spells, from energy blasts and elemental manipulation to teleportation and animating objects. Druidcraft involves calling upon the power of the world and wilderness, from taking on the traits of animals and animating plant life to harnessing the power of celestial bodies and calling upon elemental spirits. Necromancy involves not just the manipulation of death but also disease, from raising undead and manipulating souls to conjuring plagues and inflicting debilitating curses. Holy Magic involves invoking the might of a higher power, from blessing allies with strength and resilience and healing others to smiting with holy light and invoking divine gifts. This is very much a soft-magic system where the only limits are how much power you can supply, your knowledge of what you’re trying to accomplish, and the possibility of backlash or complications if you aren’t careful. Therefore, to get the most out of this power, you should find some way to rectify these problems, such as an artifact or an arcane array that amplifies your magic. Additionally, you only start with beginner’s knowledge: simple mana blasts, raising basic zombies, partial shapeshifting, stuff like that. So it’s up to you to discover more advanced applications yourself through experimentation and practice.
objects.title: Sorcery (Kingdom Rush)

addons.text:
Like a bullet launched from a barrel, your Powder Trance pushes your Allomancy further and harder.
