Whenever you are in a powder trance and ‘burn’ a metal with your allomancy you find its effects expanding in uses. Maybe the pushing and pulling of iron and steel apply to more materials, or copperclouds dull enemy magic. 

Your abilities won’t be something new, just expansions of what you already have.
addons.title: Abnormal Drug Use

objects.text: Allomancy is one of the Metallic Arts. It allows you to ingest sixteen metals and alloys to 'burn' them to produce effects such as Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Senses, Metal Sensing and Manipulation, Precognition, etc. Every time you defeat a Parahuman/Parahuman equivalent you gain a bead of Atium that can last 45 seconds. This power can be blocked by aluminum. You also know the exact proportions of all the allomantic elements.
objects.title: Allomancy (Mistborn)

addons.text:
You have a significant part of the combination of the abilities that allowed the Lord Ruler to become so powerful. By ingesting your metalminds and burning them using Allomancy,you multiply the energy released, getting more of whatever trait out than what you put in to begin with. 

You can put the energies gained from doing this into further metalminds, allowing for exponential growth.

There is eventually a limit to how much a metalmind of a given size can hold, and without extremely esoteric uses of the Metallic Arts you will still be subject to natural physics.
addons.title: Compounder (Mistborn)

objects.text: Feruchemy is an ability that allows you to store traits such as Health, Strength Speed, Weight, Memories etc. inside 'metalminds' as long as they are in contact with your skin. For example you can store your speed, but you will be slower while storing the speed depending on how much speed you are storing. You can draw on whatever traits you have stored. You are the only one who can use your own metalminds. You also know the exact proportions of all the allomantic elements.
objects.title: Feruchemy (Mistborn)

addons.text: Hemalurgy is an inherently messy art. To even empower a spike, you must kill someone, mangling their Spiritweb or soul, in the process. When you finally implant the spikes, it shoves apart and disrupts their Spiritweb, leaving gaps to be exploited. Forgery, while much more elegant, is fleeting, falling apart after a day or two. Well, now you are able to spike someone who has been altered with forgery, and not only will the spike take in at least part of those changes, stabilizing them into a more permanent form. Furthermore, the false soul created by the forgery acts as a sort of ablative protection, reducing the damage to a donor's soul to minimal levels, allowing for their survival, as long as the more physical aspects of the injury are seen to. When you implant one of these Forgery holding hemalurgic spikes into someone, there is less disruption to the soul, as a Soulforging is an overlay to the soul rather than a disruption. If the donor is themselves the receiver, this disruption is approaching zero, as there is much less spiritual dissonance. With enough practice, you can skip the need for a donor entirely, inscribing the spike itself with the Forgery.
addons.title: Spiritweb Surgery

objects.text: Hemalurgy is the third of the Metallic Arts. With it, you can pierce people's bodies with metal spikes and use those spikes to drain them of traits and implant them within yourself or others. You have knowledge of all the Hemalurgic Points and the functions of each metal's spikes. You also know the exact proportions of all the allomantic elements.
objects.title: Hemalurgy (Mistborn)

addons.text:
The human body is a poor container for Stormlight in it’s natural state. It leaks through the skin, and is released whenever the Surgebinder breathes. With Total Concentration Breathing, you are now able to greatly enhance the effects of Stormlight, while reducing waste to near zero. 
    A couple of breaths of Stormlight now supply you with enough strength and stamina to fight for days on end, and your healing factor can now practically instantly regrow limbs.
    Lastly you are now trained in the various forms of Shardblade combat found in the world of the Stormlight Archive.
addons.title: Storm Breathing

objects.text: You are now a Knight Radiant, of one of the ten orders. The orders are: Windrunners, Skybreakers, Dustbringers, Edgedancers, Truthwatchers, Lightweavers, Elsecallers, Willshapers, and Stonewards. Each of these orders has two out of a total of ten 'Surges' that they can wield. They gain their powers through an oath they have sworn to a type of spirit known as spren. Once they have sworn the correct ideals, they can also manifest armor known as Shardplate that boosts your physical abilities, and can turn your spren into a Shardblade, a weapon that carves through anything and cuts souls when it meets living flesh. The surges can be powers ranging from gravitation to adhesion to transformation. You have the ability to metabolize food to create lifelight which you use to power your abilities.
objects.title: Knight Radiant (Stormlight Archive)

addons.text:
Besides AonDor and Forgery, there are many magical arts present in the world of Sel, all of which are now open to you. They all share a common feature of being composed of forms that each correspond to the local geography. For you, these all flow into each other, allowing you to use one method to substitute for another.
​
Dakhor is a brutal practice native to the Fjordell Empire that requires human sacrifice to function. A user’s bones are reshaped and twisted, enhancing their physical capabilities. Dakhor can also grant more mystical effects, such as countermagics and teleportation, though these require more sacrifices than simple physical enhancement.
​
Bloodsealing is a distant cousin of Forgery, where a practitioner draws on the inherent connection and power found in materials like blood and bones. A Bloodsealer can enact effects on a distant target through the connection to their blood; this can even be used in a defensive manner to create wards. Simple necromancy can even be performed, animating skeletons to perform specific tasks.

These are merely some of the more understood abilities, and there are many more that are yet to be explored, such as the alchemy of Hrovell and the martial arts of JinDo.
addons.title: Master of the Dor

objects.text:
You become an Elantrian. This optionally changes you physically, granting you glowing skin and silvery hair.
You can draw Aons, which are a sort of magical programming language based off of the land. You will have to draw Aons based off of wherever you are, and will be able to easily intuit Aons.
objects.title: Elantrian (Elantris)

objects.text: By creating and using objects called Soulstamps, you can overlay a false soul onto objects, rewriting their history. These can change an object's material, alter its structure, repair or damage it, and much more. Its use on people is arguably more impressive, as it can change appearances, heal, grant new skills, or even new powers. On a blank slate of a being, it may be possible to nearly create a brand new person. ​ A Soulstamp must include information on how its history changed. Additionally, the less plausible the change, the shorter the stamping will last, though this can be somewhat offset with more detail. If it’s too implausible, then it may not take at all. Rewriting a bar of gold to a counterfeit, making it turn out to be lead, is much easier than the reverse, rewriting lead into being hidden gold. ​ The Forgery of living beings is particularly hard, requiring multiple linked stamps, and even if successful, the ever-changing nature of life means that these Forgeries rarely last more than a day. The script used for the stamps takes after the shape of the surrounding geography. Thankfully, you have a natural intuition for the variations and can correct your stamps with only a small period of study and research.
objects.title: Forgery (Cosmere)

addons.text: You can now store traits inside of Breaths and draw on those traits as if they were Metalminds, without the need of any metal touching your body.
addons.title: Metallic Breaths

objects.text:
Awakening makes use of Commands and BioChromatic Breaths to Awaken an object, which places some sort of Command in the object which it then carries out. Everyone on Nalthis has one Breath which they can bestow onto someone else. You can possibly power Awakening through other forms of magic, though it will be difficult to do.

You start with twenty thousand Breaths, knowledge of Awakening, and an ability to gain three Breaths every week.
objects.title: Awakening (Warbreaker)

addons.text:
Your strength and mastery of the martial arts now extends to the martial skills present in the world of Fullmetal Alchemist.

This includes the raw physicality of the Curtis or Armstrong Families, the techniques of Xingese martial artists & Ishvalan warrior-monks, the swordsmanship of Ling Yao, Olivier Armstrong, or the Führer (absent his particular inhuman advantages), the marksmanship of Riza Hawkeye, the secrets of optimal Flame Alchemy on par with Roy Mustang, and the hybrid hand-to-hand combat alchemy style taught to the Elric brothers by Izumi Curtis.
addons.title: Armstrong (Fullmetal Alchemist)

addons.text:
In some ways the known types of Alchemy correspond to three of the four elements. Amestrian Alchemy is related to the element of Earth as it draws from tectonic energy and Alkahestry can be seen as related to the element of Water Alchemy due to dealing with “flow.” 

In fact, while it may be a bit of a stretch you could even consider Roy Mustang’s Flame Alchemy to be, as the name suggests, related to the element of Fire. Now, through your knowledge of Airbending you have created yet another form of Alchemy, this one related to the element of Air. 

Air Alchemy excels at dealing with gases, vacuums, air pressure, and other such phenomena. Most notably, Air Alchemy draws power not from tectonic energy or the Dragon's Pulse, but from the atmospheric currents of the sky, freeing it from reliance on tectonic energy which can be interfered with as shown by Father.
addons.title: Air Alchemy

objects.text: You have Fullmetal Alchemist's Alchemy, specifically Circle Alchemy. You didn't even need to lose a limb! As long as you understand the structure of something, you can, with experimentation, create an alchemical circle to transmute it into something else, as long as you understand that too. All transmutations must obey the law of Equivalent Exchange.
objects.title: Alchemy (Fullmetal Alchemist)

objects.text:
Magic in the Marvel universe is the application of various forms of energy to manipulate various aspects of the universe beyond the scope of technology or science, using spells and phrases to simulate the powers of others, such as teleportation, astral projection, divination, mind control, Elemental attacks, and more.

There are various ways of gathering the energy needed to cast spells. Personal energies are those that a sorcerer can develop naturally and through studies of the mind, and they will get stronger over time, although without spells to extend one's lifespan, they will never reach the levels of the other two sources of energy. Secondly, you may tap into the ambient energy of the universe; however, spells cast while using this energy will be weaker as they are tied to the laws of the universe they are in. Lastly, you may use extradimensional energy; however, this is more dangerous than the other two sources as it comes with costs such as the entity you are borrowing the energy from deciding they don't like what you are doing, the energy corrupting you if gotten from an evil source, or any other consequences that would happen with borrowing energy from an entity or object.

There are various forms of magic schools, such as chronomancy, necromancy, chaos, chi, and significantly more than can be listed. This starts with MCU levels of power, but through training and time, it can reach comic book levels of strength. You instinctively know the basics and are able to master advanced techniques with ease. You know how to build basic tools like a Sling Ring as well. With enough time, you can achieve practically anything.

Take care when dealing with extradimensional eldritch beings when growing stronger, as you can very well doom a civilization by summoning a creature from the beyond in your covetous search for more power.
objects.title: Master of the Mystic Arts (Marvel)

addons.text:
You receive the full expertise of mysticism as a certain Warlock, granting you extraordinary knowledge of the mystical forces of the universe. This allows you to wield a wide variety of spells for purposes such as exorcism, astral projection, portal creation, and resurrection.

You are capable of performing large-scale and complex spells, including obliteration charms powerful enough to destroy entire islands. Your newfound mastery of Quantum Magic can also be applied in diverse ways, such as manipulating technology, particles, atoms, matter, energy, vectors, space, time, and even quantum strings.

Through Quantum Magic, you can also cast spells capable of altering entire timelines, transmuting a planet into metal, or even reshaping reality itself. However, such feats require vast amounts of energy and complete focus—leaving you unable to hear or respond to others during their preparation and casting.
addons.title: Warlock

objects.text:
Created by Adam Warlock to prevent a possible future invasion of the Cancerverse by repairing a fissure in space and reality itself, Quantum Magic allows the user to manipulate magical and physical forces on a quantum level, warping the rules of science and magic to alter the laws of reality. With Quantum Magic, you can exploit both the natural and supernatural forces of the meta-structure, granting them limitless possibilities.

Using ambient energy and "conjured psi-llables," Quantum Magic enables you to cast a variety of spells. As a beginner, your abilities are limited; however, you can already divine solutions to problems, uncover hidden truths, project energy blasts, use telekinesis, create force fields, transmute matter, disintegrate people and objects, teleport across vast distances, heal others and repair objects, harness the energy of souls, and manipulate elements.

While you must still master your magic to become a true quantum magician, over time you may learn to manipulate technology, particles, atoms, matter, energy, vectors, space, time, and even quantum strings—eventually achieving feats such as transmuting an entire planet into metal, manipulating entire timelines, and far beyond.
objects.title: Quantum Magic (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have become a powerful being composed of vegetable matter, tasked with protecting the Nexus of All Realities. Infused with the SO-2 Serum and mystical energy from a magical swamp, your abilities mirror those of Man-Thing. You possess superhuman strength capable of lifting automobiles and battling heavy hitters like the Hulk—and your strength is potentially limitless, as it embodies the Earth’s life-force.

You can manipulate and control plant life, elongate and reshape your limbs to form weapons, and even ooze through narrow gaps. Your porous, semi-fluid form makes you highly resistant to physical harm, allowing bullets and punches to pass through without injury. Unlike Man-Thing, however, you retain full consciousness, the ability to speak, and emotional clarity.

You have the ability to sense the emotions of others, particularly fear. When near someone who is afraid, your body secretes a burning sulfuric acid that causes severe chemical burns on contact. Once the fear subsides, your body produces a soapy mucus that neutralizes the acid. When fueled by enough fear, you can grow to immense sizes—towering like a skyscraper. Your regenerative abilities allows you to reform your body from surrounding plant matter, even when on the brink of death, using tendrils to seek out nearby vegetation to aid in your restoration.

As the guardian of the Nexus, you can channel its power to warp reality, such as altering the fabric of your world and characters with components from alternate realities, and opening portals to other universes. You can teleport yourself and others to specific locations, even ones you've only seen in images.
objects.title: Guardian of the Nexus (Marvel)

addons.text: You gain access to the magic of the world of Mashle, mostly (but not wholly) consisting of wand magic, starting out with the basic magics you can create Wands for. But you do not need to create those wands to use them and can simply use your own personal wand to manifest those spells. Your talent for creating wands has merged with your innate power to grant you prodigious talent with both Mashle and Harry Potter Wand magics, allowing you to swiftly learn and create new spells. If you purchase Grand Sorcerer (Harry Potter) you will have the same magical skill and knowledge of Mashle's greatest Wizards and Witches, but most importantly you will be granted the capability to use the power of Master Canes through your ability to use Ancient Magic from Harry Potter.
addons.title: The Living Grimoire

addons.text:
The essence of Shendus Talismans has granted you the ability, knowledge, and skill to rival the greatest Chi and Dark chi sorcerers depicted in the Jackie Chan Adventures show. This allows you to use many forms of ancient Chinese spells, rituals, potions, and enchanted armor and weapons you can create.

This encompasses many magics recorded in Chinese mythology beyond just the show which you become a expert on. This includes creating talismans, wards for defense against spirits and warding off evil influences, the ability to steal souls or capture them, Taoist influenced incantations and Alchemy, And healing as well.

You also can use any chi sorcery with your wand. With your skill however in Taoist influenced sorcery which revolves around harmony with nature and the manipulation of qi (vital energy) you are able to perform magic without needing a wand.
addons.title: Disciple of the Dragon/Demon Sorcerer

addons.text:
You have achieved a seamless integration between the structured Magecraft of Type-Moon and the intuitive, soul-rooted magic of the Harry Potter universe. This union has resulted in the formation of a true Magical Core—a living, self-regulating organ created from the perfect synthesis of Magic Circuits and the innate magical gene of wizardkind. This Core acts as both a magical generator and a control hub, refining your power, enhancing your precision, and removing the traditional pain or mental triggers required to activate Magic Circuits.

In the process of this fusion, stabilizer nodes have naturally developed throughout your body as part of your internal architecture. These nodes are not artificial additions but organic extensions of your Magical Core and Circuits, ensuring smooth energy flow, reducing strain, and maintaining complete energetic harmony within your system.

Your body itself is transforming slowly to align with this new mystical configuration. Tissues, nerves, and cells are adapting to carry and support this dual-system magic more efficiently—granting increased durability, rapid magical recovery, and heightened sensitivity to both structured and intuitive spellwork. Your Magic Circuits retain their iconic glow when active, now enhanced by the rhythmic pulse of your Core, a sign of your body’s complete magical synchronization.

Spell learning and creation come more naturally to you. You can fluidly interpret and combine both magical systems, allowing you to craft hybrid spells and rituals with unique properties and effects. Your internal magical structure allows direct testing and shaping of spells within your body before external application.

This fusion is also heritable. Your descendants will naturally possess a latent form of the Core-Circuit synthesis, giving rise to a bloodline with immense potential and adaptability in the magical arts.

Socially, your existence blurs the lines between magus and wizard. Your Magical Core represents the apex of magical evolution—honored by ancient wizarding families as a symbol of a "true pure-blood," and revered by magi as the culmination of thousands of years of mystical refinement. Whether seen as a prodigy, anomaly, or herald of a new magical era, you carry within you the legacy and future of two worlds united.
addons.title: Arcane Convergence

addons.text: Olivander’s makers of Fine Guns since 850 A.D You are no simple wizard but a true red-blooded Yankee wizard. Who needs wands when you have guns? Your wand is replaced by a custom-fitted gun, taking its place. This so-called “wand” (read gun) is special such that you can create basic ammunition with your magic, which can act like normal bullets. However, if you can, instead, optionally have your bullets cause excruciating pain and leave superficial damage to the target. Whenever you fire your “wand”, you can cast a spell which will affect the target like normal. You can shoot something to Tansfigure it, such as fixing a pair of glasses. This also changes how you do magical crafting. You can shoot a pile of magical ingredients to make a potion. Your wandless magic also changes to allow you to use “finger gun” to cast spells or act as a gun with power dependent on your skill and magical power. Should you be a Parselmouth, you can instead become a Firemouth with the ability to “speak” to guns. This addon also allows you to create gun-themed versions of magical items from the Harry Potter world. Lastly, should you purchase any Harry Potter related Objects of Power, you can also convert them into guns or gun-themed items.
addons.title: Harry Potter and the “Deathly Weapons”

objects.text: “Harry — yer a wizard.” — Rubeus Hagrid As a wizard or witch, you possess several advantages over Muggles. You are immune to many common ailments that affect them, such as colds, flu, and even cancer. You also age at a slower rate than Muggles, allowing you to live for over a century with relative ease. Additionally, your magical nature provides greater durability, protecting you from ordinary harm. You begin your journey with a custom wand of your own design, a magical focus that assists you in channeling your magic and casting spells ranging from simple light charms to intricate transfigurations. Crafted from magical wood, your wand is perfectly tailored in length and core to harmonize with your magic. With practice, you may even learn to no longer require your wand, for all but the most challenging of magic. Having studied various magical disciplines, you are well-versed in Potions, Charms, Herbology, and more, having reached the level of a Hogwarts graduate, signifying that you would successfully pass your N.E.W.T.s in at least seven subjects. Your skills extend to the creation and enchanting of a wide array of magical items and artifacts. You can craft many objects, including broomsticks, invisibility cloaks, wands, Portkeys, Pensieves, and even Horcruxes. For things like potion-making, when faced with ingredients that might not exist in the world you enter, you have the ability to find suitable substitutes given time and effort. Furthermore, you are also able to explore non-canonical aspects of magic, such as Arithmancy, Runes, and Magical Cores. (This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Witchcraft & Wizardry (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
You have been granted the ability to cast a modified version of the Fidelius Charm, one of the most powerful concealment spells in wizarding history. The Fidelius Charm is a high-level magical spell that can hide a secret inside someone's soul, which then magically protects the secret. Typically, a Fidelius Charm has two main participants: the caster—the one who casts the spell—and the Secret Keeper—the one whose soul holds the secret and can share it at any point, both directly and indirectly. However, your variant has been modified so that the caster and Secret Keeper can optionally be the same person. To cast the charm, you must mentally recite a secret in your head, or write it down, and then incant "Fidelius."

This version of the Fidelius Charm can conceal not only a location but hypothetically anything that might be considered a secret, including—but not limited to—an identity, place, object, memory, or truth. This manifests in several ways, most notably through high-level cognitive concealment—even affecting those who may have known the secret in the past—and spatial concealment, specifically in the case of a location. This magical protection is so strong that not even telepaths, powerful magic, technology, science, or any other type of supernatural ability can successfully negate it unless they can directly access and completely overpower the Secret Keeper's soul.

However, due to the spells nature, the more people who know about the secret, the more widespread the knowledge of the secret is, or—in the case of a location—the larger it is, the more difficult the spell becomes to cast and the greater the strain it places on the soul.

Note: Typically a normal human soul can only successfully hold one secret.
objects.title: Fidelius Charm (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
Your Spark has ignited, one that the Pre-Mending Planeswalkers once held. You can planeswalk through the multiverse at your leisure. You can target any plane you have already visited easily but accessing a precise destination blindly will require some practice, in the meantime you will jump to semi-random destinations every time.

Your body is now a projection of your Soul, in time you will be able to alter your appearance at will and even replicate the abilities of other creatures. Your Soul is also a powerful source of Mana. While you are able to cast spells, you do not have the knowledge to do so.

In time, as you grow in power and familiarity with your abilities, you will be able to create your own pocket dimensions and planes.
objects.title: Planeswalker (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
You are a mage who uses some of the five colors of magic to cast spells. The colors are: White, Blue, Black, Red and Green. Each of these colors represent a different aspect of a human's personality, and everyone is attuned to at least one color. You draw mana from within yourself or from leylines that are usually within the land to power your spells. You start off skilled in a color that highly suits you and will be talented at learning more types of magic.

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Colored Magic (Magic: The Gathering)

addons.text: Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion. Your ability to convert material into Lazotep has given you access to its most formidable use, the Eternal Dreadhorde. You can now convert material into Lazotep through your minions, not only through touch but also converting the minion itself into mindless Lazotep drone. They operate by your will completely under your control and command, An armed and armoured undead army in seconds.
addons.title: Amass

addons.text: “Cease all psychic attacks pending intel on enemy countermeasures.” —Dimir communiqué Your deep understanding of Necromancy and the means to enhance it further has made you a monster of Lazotopic might. You’re no longer limited to converting only metals or bone, instead able to create it nearly Ex-Nihilo, fueled by only your magic, with material to subsidise. Additionally, you can convert material back from Lazotep to its original components. Finally, you can convert parts of yourself into pure Lazotep, losing your frail normal form to become a metal titan of dark magic, and reaping all the benefits of Lazotep both intimately and constantly.
addons.title: Lazotep Chancellor

addons.text: As the lazotep covered his body, he heard Norn’s voice fade from a deafening clarion to a distant whisper. Your command of Lazotep has given you the ability to compleat non-organic beings with far greater ease than they would naturally gain. In addition, Your command of Lazotep has served to bulwark your mind, allowing it to resist the various calls and instincts given by the oil, or even other Praetors.
addons.title: Lazotep Convert

objects.text: Beneath each gleaming mineral shell rots a once-proud warrior of Amonkhet. You have gained the ability to convert mundane metals and bone into the mystical Lazotep. As far as its nature as a metal is concerned, it is a lightweight and durable metal, more comparable to a ‘hyper-titanium’ than most of its medieval contemporaries. However, it’s real strength comes from its mystical properties, that being that it acts as a potent enhancer for any necromantic magics both channeled through it, and even in the vicinity to a lesser degree. Additionally when crafted into armours, a light lazotep coating tends to act as a minor ward against most non-necromantic magics, with a specific antipathy to telepathic and illusory magic.
objects.title: Lazotep Conversion (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
Transcension Fields, otherwise known as Magical Fields, are psycho-reactive fields that can be manipulated by sapiens. There are four main fields that are used by mortals: Fae, Arcane, Holy, and Infernal. There is a fifth subcategory known as Shadow Magic that refers to the magic that does not fall into one of the four.

Fae Magic involves communion with nature and spirits, and drawing on their power to cast. It is the most imprecise yet can have subtle and subjective effects. Its practitioners are called Witches. The main barrier for power in Fae Magic is the kinds of spirits you can call on to do your bidding.

Arcane Magic is the most precise and versatile, yet it involves the most amount of steps to achieve any effects. Its practitioners are called Wizards. The main barrier for power in Arcane Magic is the amount of power you can store in your aura.

Holy Magic is used primarily by Clerics, and can be used for healing, shields and burning. It is also the type of magic that is best at manipulating the mind. The main barrier for power in Holy Magic is the amount of power you can channel before you burn out.

Infernal Magic is used by Warlocks, and is used in Demon Summoning, and is the primary method of tapping Shadow Magic due to its corrosive effects on reality. It is incredibly versatile, but it's Infernal Corruption risks cancer in its wielders if they mess up. The main barrier for power in Infernal Magic is how much you can safely handle at a time, without corrupting yourself.

With enough research and preparation, you can achieve anything with this power.
objects.title: Transcension Fields (The Gods are Bastards)

objects.text:
You have Night; a power that lets you harvest power and knowledge from the dead and to wield it in various ways. You gain the skills and power of a Mighty, and can optionally become a Drow.
The version of Night you gain is the version of Night that existed before the reforging of Sve Noc in Serolen.
objects.title: Night (A Practical Guide to Evil)

objects.text: You can call upon the Light of the heavens. With this you can heal, shield, burn, undo magic and bless artifacts.
objects.title: Light (A Practical Guide to Evil)

objects.text:
You can wield Sorcery with sufficient skill as someone with the ability to wield High Arcana.
You can use magic to ward areas, summon beings, call upon the elements and more.
You can choose which tradition of magic you follow, such as Trismegistan, Jaquinite or Ligurian. If you choose Ligurian, then you are bestowed the innate abilities that the Gigantes had that make using it possible.
objects.title: Sorcery (A Practical Guide to Evil)

addons.text:
Your name has been upgraded through The Voice of the World. Your name is massively empowered, holding power greater than any other Named from the world of Practical Guide to evil, and yet, amazingly, can grow in power and depth even further. The number of Aspects it holds is upgraded from the normal 3 to 10 and may grant much more esoteric powers and abilities compared to normal, in the form of Skills from The Voice of the World. At most, your Aspects will manifest as Unique Skills, though they may evolve into one or more Ultimate Skills given time and the right encouragement.

Your ability to grant Names to others is also empowered, allowing you to grant Names in the style of Practical Guide to Evil alongside the Names given through the Voice of the World. This process will almost certainly evolve the recipient's species by at least one level or more, based on the power difference between you and the one you are naming. The being you Name will also gain 5 aspects instead of 3 in the form of Skills from the Voice of the World.
addons.title: Name²

addons.text: Your narrative sight and manipulation has crystallized into an additional Aspect similar to the one the Wandering Bard once held. You can now manipulate your own narrative to a much greater effect as a Named character in your own right, letting you steer yourself into or out of stories with an instinctual ease. You also gain the ability to halt narratives, allowing you to let events play out that should be contradictory to the stories they embody, regardless of if one was playing out beforehand. For example, this can manifest as letting a Villain succeed, a Hero not receiving a fated victory through coincidental providence or the total defiance of a fated prophecy. This can be overcome through enough narrative "weight", so sufficiently symbolically significant stories may take more effort or simply be beyond your ability to stop.
addons.title: Genre Savvy

addons.text: Already safeguarding you from inappropriate ends, your Named plot armor now reaches almost ludicrous heights. It now takes a narratively satisfying and concentrated effort to put you down for good. This lets you get away with the dubious escapes from sticky ends both Heroes and Villains are known for, moreso if you have a story behind you; if try to survive being thrown off a cliff, pull off the first step of your malevolent master plan or attempt a heroic last stand, it's practically a certainty you'll survive. This isn't invincibility; trying to get away with a final, gloating villainous monologue or performing a mentorly sacrifice will still likely result in a sticky end.
addons.title: Narrative Assurance

objects.text: You receive a Name, either based on your identity as a cape, or a Name from A Practical Guide to Evil. Your Name is based off the powers you wield, and the sort of story tropes you fulfill. You receive either the full set of Aspects of someone who has had your Name, or choose three Aspects of your own.
objects.title: Name (A Practical Guide to Evil)

addons.text: By opening yourself up to the magic of the Garden, you have awakened your ancestry and gained full control over your Fae power. Your magic is much improved, your inhuman ancestry improving your sorcery such that you are at least on par with a Count or Countess with your skill as a mage alone.
addons.title: Awakened Ancestry

addons.text: Your Night or Light powers now stem from your Fae ancestry, merging with them seamlessly. The main benefit of this is that your Night or Light no longer draws on an external source, being an intrinsic part of you and considered your magic, and therefore are no longer affected by their usual countermeasures or weaknesses (such as Night being weakened by the dawn). They also gain the same beneficial properties that your Fae nature would confer upon sorcery.
addons.title: Twilight Court

addons.text: You have gained a title through trickery, birthright or blood, and are now a Prince, Princess or something similar in status. These are incredibly powerful combatants, able to take on powerful veteran Named head-to-head. You gain powerful magical abilities that align with your court, and are a demigod in your own right. Unfortunately, your Fae nature combined with a Name makes you more constrained by the stories you become a part of, even if not to the same degree as an actual Fae might be. Any magic you possess is empowered even further than usual, to at least match the abilities you gain here.
addons.title: Title Bearer

objects.text: You gain a Fae ancestry, one that can confer a minor magical power based on the Court you belong to, which can vary wildly. If you are a mage of any kind, you'll find you can cast more concentrated spells, alongside a heightened accuracy with your magic. This power won't cause any complications when interacting with your own powers; no growing wings when casting too many spells. You may choose which Court you claim ancestry from.
objects.title: Fae Ancestry (A Practical Guide to Evil)

addons.text:
Your chakra network, with its 361 Chakra Nodes and Eight Gates, has been modified to gain the traits of Magic Circuits. In simpler terms, you now have 361 Magic Circuits, which start at very low quality. But by training your chakra, these new hybrid Magic Circuits will massively improve their quality. In time, they will become similar to the Blue Blood Magic Circuits of the Barthomelio Family.

The Eight Chakra Gates, which limit chakra use within the body, are also modified in that they now function as pseudo Mana Cores when opened. When opened, the Eight Gates now also provide a monumental amount of magical energy, but now carry the risk of overloading your soul in addition to the normal bodily harm their use causes. You can still train up their usage, but note that the Eight Gate is still a death sentence without extreme measures. Should you open the Eighth Gate, you will have enough power to fight higher gods for the few minutes before your body turns to dust.

You retain the ability to use both power systems however, you can also use them together to create abilities stronger than the sum of their parts. Chakra grants a fairly large amount of Mystery on its own, which can be further enhanced by spending a large amount of Chakra. This means that you can skew the rules of Magecraft and even completely ignore them with enough spent Chakra. This synergy also grants a great talent and ability to use Reinforcement Magecraft on the level of a Nasuverse Servant far beyond most modern human Mages.

Should you have a Dragon Core through one way or another, your Eight Gates will have their limits loosened and greatly increase your Chakra and Mana reserves, comparable to a Jinchuriki’s reserves.

Because Magic Circuits naturally absorb the energy of the world, these hybrid Circuits grant exceptional talent for senjutsu: you gather natural energy faster and more safely than ordinary sages, can convert it into pure chakra, magical energy, or a hybrid form, and face far less risk of petrification.
addons.title: Magecraft Network

addons.text: Your connection to the Holy Light of Yahweh (The God of the Bible) has connected you to the Thaumaturgical base of the Holy Church from Type-Moon, giving you knowledge and skill in the Holy Sacraments. Your inner Holy Light allows you to make even the most basic exorcism two times more potent against the creatures of Darkness. You also gain knowledge on how to create the basic tools of the Church, such as the Black Keys, Ash Locks, and Keys of Providence. You also gain the skill and ability of a graduated Executor from the different Sacrament divisions with the same being for Exorcist training from the Church in DxD. (Note: If you have Violence of Heaven, you will gain knowledge of every Exorcism, Holy Rituals/Rites, knowledge of how to create every Artifact used by the Church, and the skill and ability of the strongest Exorcists in the Type-Moon franchise.)
addons.title: Eighth Sacrament

addons.text:
Through your occultic abilities and your mastery over magecraft, you have become a master of formal craft. As a result of your mastery of formal craft you have gained knowledge of bounded fields specifically made to stabilize and minimize the impact of outside variables. 

Formal craft, at its core, is a process of tapping into the world's mana or any external magical energy through the use of rituals and materials to achieve magecraft. Using formal crafts requires no use of your circuits or your own magical energy and instead mainly taps into ley lines (or the world's equivalent).

Anything you can achieve through magecraft, you can achieve through formal craft, with you also having the ability to enhance magecraft or the effects of magecraft, but it will take both time and resources.
addons.title: Formal Craft

addons.text:
You possess the Thaumaturgical Attribute known as Wish-Granting, a trait previously seen only in the Justeaze model Homunculi, who served as vessels for the Holy Grail. This attribute allows you to enact miracle-like magic.

In practice, this means you can actualize any effect possible through Magecraft, even those you may not fully understand. 

The only limitations are that you can’t fully replicate Old or True Magics - although some lesser applications may be fair game. Additionally, Wishcraft is inefficient and requires more Prana than normal Magecraft to compensate for your lack of understanding of the effects you wish to actualize.
addons.title: Wishcraft

addons.text:
As a semi-spiritual organ, your magic circuits have been impacted by the malleability of your soul, seamlessly integrating with your body. This transformation has eliminated the pain, overheating, and risk of self-inflicted damage that typically comes with their use.

Alongside this, your circuits no longer require a trigger to activate. They now operate through conscious and subconscious intent, allowing you to open and close them effortlessly. These circuits also possess regenerative properties—capable of healing from damage and granting an immediate boost in quality by at least one Rank. With continued training and growth, their quality may increase even further.

More than just efficient, your circuits adapt to changes, subtly refining themselves to better suit your needs. Given time and experience, you may even develop the ability to consciously alter their composition and structure to optimize their functions accordingly.
addons.title: Smart Circuits

addons.text:
In addition to the organ placement and skeletal system, the composition and placements of your Magic Circuits are also identical to the Son of God.

This allows you to recreate any of the miracles described in the Bible as magecraft; the miracles performed by the Son of God are both significantly easier to turn into magecraft and require less magical energy to perform. Something like turning water to wine would require a mere gesture, but resurrection would require months to turn into magecraft. 

This magecraft is still limited in output depending on the quality and quantity of the Magic Circuits you possess, so even if you turn the creation of the universe into magecraft, you will not have anywhere close to the magical energy needed to perform it.

As you carry a mystery from 2000 years ago, you wield mysteries and thus magecraft that existed at that point; despite the advancement of science, the ancient mysteries you carry will prevent your magecraft from degenerating.

Your brand of resurrection could be used to incarnate Servants.
addons.title: Circuits of The Saint

addons.text: Like some before you, you possess a connection to the Root. Unlike them, whether you were born with this connection or acquired it later in life is up to you. This link connects your Magic Circuits to the Root, allowing you to channel the magical energy they generate to access and alter the Records—bypassing the need to physically enter and manipulate them. Direct access to the Root renders you effectively omniscient, granting awareness of everything recorded within. However, you can choose to limit this perception to preserve your human ego. Additionally, this connection begins in a dormant, closed state. In terms of alteration, this connection enables you to convert magical energy produced by your Magic Circuits directly into phenomena—effectively making you an omnipotent mage, limited only by the quality and output of your magical energy. Note: This connection does not expand what Access to the Records allows you to do. It merely bypasses the need to manually enter and alter the Records, using your Magic Circuits as a conduit to facilitate the process. While this connection could, in theory, allow you to drag a pruned world back from oblivion and create a Lostbelt, you cannot sustain such an act. Without the required magical energy output to challenge the Quantum Time Lock, the Counter Force would simply undo your efforts.
addons.title: Connection to the Root

addons.text:
Your Shard–more computational lattice than sense–now works as another surplus of high-quality circuits that congeal within each other enough to work as a jury-rigged Magic Energy Reactor, both as the ironic mystery of their working and the unintended result of feeding from the Ether of planets they inhabit.

Tapping into your Shard helps in your Magecraft’s potency and duration, as it heightens the spell’s mystery by exploiting your partner’s processing and analyzing capabilities that fully apprehend the mystery you’re casting, while expanding your magical energy reserves by an order of magnitude by using your partner as a secondary source.

Grasping your Shard’s Origin and Element is also possible, as every Shard contains an Origin fitting of their specialization and function, with an Element for both Ether and an Average One.

Depending on your Shard, you can also quickly develop Thaumaturgical Attributes, depending on where your Shard comes from, its functions within the network, and the type of [Data] it holds. Working similar to an advanced, yet alien, Magic Crest: a Warrior Shard can develop combat related attributes, developing a talent for branches for Reinforcement or Projection; a Thinker Shard can develop non-combat-related attributes, developing a talent for Transmutation or Transferring branches; a Wanderer Shard can develop more esoteric attributes, where it can develop a talent for more unearthed branches only seen for Mystic Eyes.
addons.title: Shard Core

addons.text:
You possess the same monstrous potential and talent for Magecraft which made Flat Escardos the ‘ideal’ heir to a Magus lineage. Your magic circuits are orders of magnitudes greater than normal, filling every inch of your body with Od and having incredibly precise control.

While you cannot break the rules of Magecraft, you can twist and bend them to a ridiculous degree. Your spells don’t use existing magical foundations and instead act as their own impromptu foundations, creating new foundations on the fly. You also possess knowledge of how to ‘hack’ magic, nullifying or interfering with the spells of others. You can hijack the senses of familiars, seize control of existing wards, and even rewrite Command Seals.

Most impressive is your ability to improvise and create new spells, constructing new formulas every time you cast a spell, to the point that your Magecraft is almost whatever you feel like doing. You use all sorts of Magecraft regardless of Mana, Od, or knowledge, making up Magecraft on the spot without understanding the process and just using your sense.
addons.title: Escardos

addons.text: The transformation from Nerves of Steel, which replaced your biological nervous system with a circuit-based mana network, has performed a perfect, symbiotic fusion with the standardized Magic Circuits granted by Magecraft. This created a framework of unparalleled density and capability. Standard magi are born with a fixed number of Magic Circuits, clusters of these spiritual organs typically numbering in the dozens, located in a spiritual layer superimposed over the physical body. Your condition defies this norm entirely. Because your Nerves of Steel permeate every millimetre of your form, the quantity of your Magic Circuits is no longer bound by spiritual convention or genetics. Your number of Magic Circuits is now equal to the number of nerves in the human body, effectively billions of individual, microscopic, low grade Magic Circuits. While they are individually of extremely poor quality, their sheer number gives you a mana generation and processing capacity that is functionally immeasurable by modern standards, as well as provide an unimaginable degree of fine control, allowing you to channel and direct mana with cellular precision. However, this fusion inherits the limitations of both systems. The complexity of your magecraft is now bounded by the calculation speed of your crystalline Crest-organ, which must process the variables for spells channeled through this unimaginably complex network. Furthermore, your magecraft remains subject to the rules of equivalent exchange and the local world's Mystery, though the sheer scale of your personal power may allow you to brute-force acts that would cripple or kill a normal magus.
addons.title: Full Body Circuit
[Insert Country] Magecraft
addons.text: Through your connection with the Divine Spirit residing within you and your own experience in Magecraft, you have gained an impressive amount of knowledge of the Magecraft related to the lands of the Divine Spirit, especially those connected to their domains. Making it easier for you to call upon their Authority.

addons.title: [Density]
addons.text: You are privileged to be one of the rare few among Magi to harbor a Thaumaturgical Attribute, also known as a Sorcery Trait. Many would trade away fortunes to have one purely for the sake of having it, even if the Attribute wasn't all that useful. Thankfully (and/or unfortunately, depending on how you view it), yours is not only useful, but among the few known Attributes to be universally desired and applicable to any Magus… that is, if it was known. You actually have an entirely new Attribute within you. This one doesn't give you some new way to use your magical energy, like the [Wish-Granting] Attribute, nor does it allow you to access a powerful item, like the [Tradition Carrier] Attribute. What this one does is very simple, but nonetheless effective. Your Thaumaturgical Attribute, [Density], safely enhances your magic circuits to generate and store magical energy that is naturally 10 times as dense as it otherwise would be. In more simple terms, if we were to compare you with a copy of yourself that did not have the [Density] Attribute, a single unit of magical energy produced by you is of such quality that it would take 10 units of magical energy from that copy without the Attribute to match that singular unit. A Magus who can output 100 units of magical energy at a given time could now do things that would require 1,000 units thanks to the [Density] Attribute. This technically does make spells cheaper for you to cast, by the merit of having a quality of magical energy per unit that is worth much more compared to the average Magus. However, this also makes it easier to overload those same spells by putting in an amount far greater than what is required. So caution is advised, even if you wish to weaponize that fact.

addons.title: Kabbalah
addons.text:
It is unknown how it happened, but the Magic Circuits in your brain have slightly mutated, affecting your entire nervous system. All information your mind receives, be it through your senses or abilities, is first perceived in an abstract way, recording everything as variables, vectors, and formulas that underpin the workings of reality.

Normally this extra information is automatically filtered out, allowing you to experience the world as a normal human would, but with a mental switch you can change your perception to the mathematical worldview. In situations of high emotions these calculations may bleed through into your thoughts, and if you are in danger the mental switch may activate on its own.

Incidentally, as your brain constantly records and references countless calculations of every kind in the background, you gain a prodigious talent for learning and understanding mathematics and physics. You are skilled in Numerology, the core of the Kabbalah Magecraft, and a natural at using its two major branches.

Gematria allows you to construct Numerological Crests through mathematical formulas to directly interfere with natural elements or other Magecraft. Examples include creating lightning, converting magical energy into pure heat and back, and manipulating information and commands in magical constructs and rituals.

Notarikon revolves around connecting and shortening phrases by substituting them with words that contain the same meaning. You can reduce lengthy Incantations to a single sentence, express them through citing physical laws, or define certain variables to insert into your calculations, all without losing any of the spell's potency.

addons.title: Crest of Fódlan
addons.text:
Your Magecraft has transformed the Fire Emblem Crest you carry, integrating a hypothetical Magic Crest version of what that Crest might have been had Fódlan and its history existed within the world of Type-Moon. 

The Crest contains magecraft and knowledge relating to and extrapolated from its original abilities, including techniques for enhancing your body, weapons, or spells according to the nature of your Crest. A Crest of Fraldarius, for example, might have spells for reinforcement and explosive bursts of physical power. The Crest also contains knowledge on how to properly wield the Heroes' Relic(s) associated with your Crest, including techniques for drawing out their full potential and magecraft designed to augment their abilities.

Lastly, the inclusion of Mystery has elevated your Heroes’ Relic(s) and their supernatural properties to the level of high-grade Noble Phantasms, befitting weapons forged from the bones and hearts of the draconic children of a primordial goddess. For example, a Crest of Gloucester could turn Thyrsus into a powerful Mystic Code capable of extending the range and potency of your magecraft while providing defenses against both physical and magical attacks.

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to perform Magecraft—the reenactment of Mysteries/Miracles, using magical energy as a shortcut to achieve what science could accomplish, bypassing typical constraints through supernatural means. Magecraft then operates on the principle of equivalent exchange, transforming magical energy from the user or the environment to manifest predetermined phenomena, analogous to executing a Program (Spell) through Commands aligned with your System (Foundation).

However, Magecraft has limitations. It cannot create something from nothing, nor can it cross into the territory of True Magic and generate new Mysteries. Instead, it acts within the bounds of what is theoretically possible, only enhancing this potential through the expenditure of magical energy.

You have an innate grasp of a school of Magecraft of your choice—far surpassing the average magus. Its principles come naturally, and its complexities are absorbed with ease, placing you on par with a genius like Luvia Edelfelt. While you're free to study other schools or systems of thaumaturgy, none will match your intuitive brilliance in your chosen field.

To complement this talent, you begin with standard Magic Circuits capable of comfortably generating and storing up to 500 units of magical energy. In times of need, this capacity can be temporarily pushed to match your maximum output of 1,000 units.

Additionally, while the exact number and quality of your Magic Circuits are up to you, your overall magical energy is equivalent to that of Rin Tohsaka—whose 40 high-quality circuits, roughly in the B to A rank ranges (excluding her crest), provide a comparable output and capacity.

Lastly, depending on the world you've found yourself in, the potency and properties of Magecraft may vary. The Mysteries at work could be stronger or weaker compared to those in the Type-Moon setting, influenced by the world's inherent magical structure.
objects.title: Magecraft (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Now, not only have you mastered the fundamentals of Magecraft, but you have also mastered many of its branches as well as the ability to actualize (create spells) using both Magecraft and Old Magic simultaneously. You gain a century of experience to distribute between three to six branches of Magecraft, such as Alchemy, Runes, Jewelcraft, Formalcraft, and many others. This experience cannot be spent on Old Magic.

This mastery gives you a good fundamental basis to understand all future magic, and that not only makes you more powerful in other forms of magic but vastly increases the rate of learning and power of Magecraft, Old magic, and all other types of magic.
addons.title: Old Master

objects.text:
You are capable of Old Magic from the Age of the Gods that is equal in strength to the True Magics. Along with being capable of this, you are capable of any form of magic used in any universe you travel to, as long as over 1% of the population has the potential to use it. To power your abilities, you have a truly massive (though not nearly infinite) reservoir of mana inside you that will self-generate through ancient breathing techniques from a time long since past. On top of this, you gain the ability to use modern magecraft and learn more about Magic and Magecraft just from using what you do know through practice and combat, though this process is slow.

You are also a beginner in one of these three magics:
Divine Words: This is magic from the Age of the Gods. Unlike modern magi who need incantations to cast their spells, you're always surrounded by divine mysteries of ancient lore, so magic is just something you can command like ordering a guard dog to attack. This is done through using an ancient language that modern humans can no longer pronounce to utilize a fraction of a god's authority. Such words include things like Αερο (Aero), which causes a plague wind that will easily mince your target as if they were sent through an enormous fan, to others like Μαρδοξ (Argos), which makes a protective spell by borrowing the concept of the Argos.

Fairy Patterns: These are a unique type of magical circuits that usually only fairies have. Just like fairies, you do not need incantations, Thaumaturgical Foundations, Mystic Codes or Formulas on what you want to do. Simply using the necessary amount of mana and having the imagination of what magic you want to cast will allow you to manipulate the world to cast such magic. The strength of your spells or creations using Fairy Patterns depends greatly on how much magical energy you expend and how great your imagination is. More complex actions, such as mass healing multiple people with grievous wounds, will take a lot more magical energy compared to something as simple as shooting a ball of fire. You also have a rudimentary knowledge of Fairy Letters, a language used to inscribe onto items crafted by the Fae to show it was not crafted by human hands.

Primordial Runes: These Runes hail from Scandinavia and could even be considered Scandinavian crests. Different from more modern Runes, these are from the Age of the Gods. By either writing the necessary runic combination on something or simply tracing them in the air you can do things such as create massive tornados of fire with a gesture, creating a magical map of the continent you're on, healing lethal wounds, inflicting divine curses on your enemies, or even inscribe the primordial rune of death on a target to bring inescapable death upon them.

Even outside of a world from the Type-Moon series, this power will generate Mystery equivalent to the modern world of Fate/Stay Night at the bare minimum.
objects.title: Old Magic (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Now, not only have you mastered the fundamentals of Magecraft, but you have also mastered many of its branches as well as the ability to actualize (create spells) using both Magecraft and True Magic simultaneously. You gain a century of experience to distribute between three to six branches of Magecraft, such as Alchemy, Runes, Jewelcraft, Formalcraft, and many others. This experience cannot be spent on True Magic.

This mastery gives you a good fundamental basis to understand all future magic, and that not only makes you more powerful in other forms of magic but vastly increases the rate of learning and power of Magecraft, True Magic, and all other types of magic.
addons.title: True Master

addons.text:
By blending the raw power of Old Magic with the reality-defying force of True Magic, you have ascended beyond both.

Your body now acts as a perpetual Thaumaturgical Foundation, allowing you to fuel any spell without external sources, allowing even faith-based magic without the need for a divine patron.

Furthermore, you can instinctively tap into the magical laws of any world, instantly gaining access to its magical systems as if they were your own. However, while you acquire the ability to use these powers, you do not gain knowledge of their techniques or applications. You will still need to learn how to wield any new magic effectively.
addons.title: Ancient Magus

addons.text:
You are not a master; you are a walking legend on par with Zelretch, Merlin, and Solomon. Not only have you mastered over a dozen branches of Magecraft, but you have pushed your original magic (Old or True Magic) to its absolute limits, allowing you to discover the base secrets of a second magic (the other magic selected).

This means that not only have your power and rate of learning Magecraft, Old Magic, True Magic, and other forms of magic been vastly improved, but you also gain a further boost to discovering all other forms of Old and True Magics you don’t already know.

There is no magic beyond your reach, and given enough time, preparation, and research, you can even kill a God.
addons.title: Grand Master

objects.text:
As a beginner Magician wielding one of the True Magics, you possess the potential to manifest true Miracles—wondrous feats that lie beyond modern Magecraft and are unattainable even with centuries of accumulated magical knowledge. Your power operates on a level of Mystery so profound that it could only be unraveled by a turn in the very age of humanity, akin to Tesla's demystification of Lightning in the modern era. However, True Magic remains far beyond such an understanding, existing in a realm that defies complete comprehension, where even the most advanced Magecraft falters.

You can choose to have either one of the five known True Magics or create your own, as long as it fits the criteria.

You have also gained proficiency with all forms of Magecraft. With this power, you can perform modern Magecraft without magic circuits through ancient breathing techniques, seamlessly connecting to the flow of magical energy as you actualize Mysteries through your entire body.

This talent makes you an exceptional practitioner, able to wield spells and skills without the reliance typical of most magi. Through combat and practice, your knowledge of True Magic and Magecraft grows, the experience itself guiding you in understanding spells and principles. Although this learning process is slow, it adds a unique adaptability to your practice of True Magic, honing your instincts alongside formal knowledge.

The scope of your ability is vast, though equally restrained by your status as a novice. But at your current level, only brief flashes of your full potential are within reach, though this will change as you grow in skill. However, caution is paramount; even small applications of your power can have far-reaching consequences for the world—and perhaps the universe itself—if wielded recklessly. (See Aoko)

Even if you find yourself outside the reach of the Type-Moon cosmology or worlds, you can still freely tap into the magical Foundations of other worlds as if they were your own. And if none exist—or prove unsuited to your needs—you can act as your own Thaumaturgical Foundation, ensuring nominal operations of your spell casting.

While in worlds utterly devoid of either magic or Mysteries, you have nothing to fear—as the font of Mystery that is your True Magic will be able to sustain you in such events, keeping your power intact even where all lesser sorceries would unravel.
objects.title: True Magic (Type-Moon)

addons.text: The power of the Holy Grail has supercharged your power as a Servant. All of your Parameters, Class Skill(s), Personal Skill(s), and Noble Phantasm(s) have been increased by 3 Ranks. Being supplied with Magical Energy by the Holy Grail also means that you could use your power and ability to your heart's content without fear of running out of Magical Energy.
addons.title: Palingenesis

addons.text:
The power of Saga has bolstered your power as a Heroic Spirit. As your fame and renown increase, so too do your Parameters, Skill(s), and Noble Phantasm(s) grow in power.

Any Noble Phantasm you have now gain the trait of a Saga, which means you can now utilize them in new ways based on your own interpretation and recontextualization of their abilities, and Saga now carries Mystery, which increases their potency and allows them to gain more esoteric effects.
addons.title: Unfolding Hero Journey

addons.text:
Your vampiric physiology, along with your true history and existence having been distorted by a monstrous reputation, have combined to make you a living incarnation of the Servant—Vlad III the Impaler. You are granted all of his memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, equipment, and abilities. At the very least, this will equate to your parameters being enhanced to A-Rank, except the Luck stat, which is at D rank.

Optionally, you may take the appearance of the servant Vlad—either a specific one or a mix.
addons.title: Vlad III the Impaler

addons.text:
You have become the living incarnation of the various versions of Medea of Colchis, inheriting all of their memories—ones you can choose to embrace or ignore—along with their skills, abilities, and blessings. This includes her mastery of High-Speed Divine Words, which allows her to cast high-tier magic instantaneously, as well as the knowledge gained from Circe.

Additionally, you acquire any items and weapons that the different versions of Medea have utilized throughout the Type-Moon franchise. This encompasses the magic-canceling dagger known as Rule Breaker, the Argon Coin, also referred to as the Golden Fleece, which can summon a dragon that you have the ability to command and control. You also gain Pain Breaker, a Healing Noble Phantasm that can reset any injury or ailment to zero.
addons.title: Witch of Colchis

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the many variants of Iskandar featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many variants of Iskandar have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes the vast army of Ionoi Hetairoi, the speed of Gordius Wheel & Bucephalus, the strength of Zeus Funder, the charisma of Rosy-Cheeked Youth & the Charisma skill, and the incredible Tactics that let him refrain from suffering even a single defeat during life.
addons.title: King of Conquerors

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the various Gorgons featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many variants of Medusa & her sisters have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Rider's incredible speed & her Pegasus, the Gorgon's many methods to harvest magical energy (like Blood Fort Andromeda & Pandemonium Cetus), Harpe, Chrysaor, Smile of Stheno, Eye of Euryale, & Breaker Gorgon.
addons.title: Gorgon

addons.text: You have become a living incarnation of Jack the Ripper, encompassing all versions of Jack across the Type-Moon franchise. This grants you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you) along with their skills, abilities, and blessings. You also gain access to the various tools, weapons, and techniques wielded by the many incarnations of Jack the Ripper. Notable examples include the Skill Murder on a Misty Night and the Noble Phantasm The Mist. You also gain Maria the Ripper, a Noble Phantasm which can target and fatally wound those who meet certain criteria, as well as the skill Thousand Faces and the Noble Phantasm From Hell. You also gain access to all the evil spirits that make up Jack the Ripper (Assassin) to use as either your soldiers or hostages. If your heart is pierced, the spirits are released. These spirits attack the nearest living being to trap their victim in an illusion of Whitechapel formed from their memories. The illusion is destroyed if the spirits are exorcised.
addons.title: The Whitechapel Murderer

addons.text:
You've become a Demi-Servant of Mash Kyrielight and her copies: Tachie, Galahad, and Galahad Alter.

This grants you all the memories, abilities, skills, and items they possessed in life, such as the Ortenaus transformation to Lord Camelot with its Noble Phantasm Mold Camelot, the Black Barrel replica (command spells not included), the Sword of Strange Hangings, the Around Round Shield, and even a free Fou (Beast form not included). You have the option to also take the form of Mash or the other three.

In terms of raw power, you possess strength equivalent to Super Mash, placing you on the physical level of a high servant. Additionally, you have a massive amount of personal mana, allowing you to power your abilities for days on end without needing to rest.

The Black Barrel takes the form of a three-meter-long iron cannon that, even without command spells to fuel it, has the firepower to destroy a large swath of a castle in a single attack. If you find appropriate ammo, this weapon gains the ability to enforce the human concept of a natural lifespan on a target, then inflict a massive amount of damage that increases depending on the amount of Grain or Ether inside the target. This is also known as "the gun that kills gods".
addons.title: The Second First Avenger

addons.text: With the possession of Balmung and the Dragon’s Blood, you have now become the living incarnation of the Germanic hero, Siegfried, most famously known from the Nibelungenlied. You are granted all of his memories—deciding if and how they affect you—skills, equipment, and abilities. The Dragon’s Blood within you now evolves, granting you the Noble Phantasm Armor of Fafnir, granting you almost total invulnerability—other than a space the shape of a linden leaf, upon your back—and a dragon’s magical core within your heart. You also gain the Noble Phantasm of the Homunculus Sieg—who wielded Balmung in a potential future—Ákafiloga All-gríð a powerful ability that allows the user to transform temporarily into the form of the dragon slain by Siegfried, Fafnir, to obliterate your foes with the dragon’s powerful breath.
addons.title: Dragon-Blooded Knight

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the variations of Edmond Dantes featured in Type-Moon, giving you all of their memories (which you can choose how they affect you if at all), skills, abilities, and blessings. This includes Dantes’s Determination of Steel, which allows you to become impervious to pain and endure thinking and moving at superhuman speeds.

You also gain the various Noble Phantasms wielded by the Count of Monte Cristo, including Enfer Château d'If, Paradis Château d'If, and Attendre, Espérer.
addons.title: King of the Cavern

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the various EMIYAs featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many variants of EMIYA have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Unlimited Blade Works, EMIYA Alter's Unlimited Lost Works, Murumasa's Tsumukari Muramasa, Kiritsugu's Time Alter, Shirou's mad cooking skills, and Assassin EMIYA's deadly Phantasm Punishment.
addons.title: Nameless

addons.text: “Heh, yes, I see. Omnipotent. All of you are calling me as such.” You once just had a mind on the level of Leonardo Da Vinci, but now, you are the living incarnation of the great Italian Polymath. This gives you the memories, Skills, abilities and equipment of the various Da Vinci found in the Nasuverse. From Caster Da Vinci’s Noble Phantasm Uomo Universale, an attack that adjusts itself to negate all magical and physical barriers, to Rider Da Vinci’s Beautiful Journey, which allows you to summon the Storm border to travel time and Space, all of these are subsumed into your being. If you wish, MNEMOSYNE may be included in this as well.
addons.title: Uomo Universale

addons.text:
You have undergone blackening—your soul steeped in the corrupted mud of the Grail, twisted by its will. Whether through exposure, overuse, or a desperate pact, the evil of humanity has seeped into your core, reshaping what you are into something darker, more monstrous… and far more powerful.

Your physical and magical parameters are enhanced beyond your original limits. Strength, speed, and magical output surge violently, turning you into a terrifying force on the battlefield. Spells become brutal and raw, Noble Phantasms hit harder but burn mana faster, and your body endures punishment far past human or Servant norms.

Your mind is not untouched. Your personality has shifted—aggression rises, restraint weakens, and your darker instincts take precedence. Your goals may remain the same, but the way you pursue them grows colder, crueler, and more violent. At first, it feels like clarity or focus, but slowly, you’re losing the ability to care about what once mattered. The mud’s influence feels like your own thoughts—subtle, invasive, and deeply persuasive.

Visually, you are no longer the same. Your color palette darkens—armor blackens or rusts, eyes glow ominously, your skin or hair pales. Everything about you reflects a being something forged in the corrupted depths.
addons.title: Blackening

addons.text:
You have become the living incarnation of the various versions of Frankenstein’s Monster/Fran in Type-Moon, inheriting all of their memories (in which you determine how they affect you) along with their skills, abilities, blessings, and items, such as Bridal Chest, Bridal Blade, Blasted Tree, and Wail of the Falsely Living.

Optionally, you may take on her form as well.
addons.title: Berserker of Black

addons.text:
You now become a living incarnation of King Richard the I of England, better known as Richard the Lionheart. You can inherit all of his memories, and gain all of his skills, and abilities.

You’ll also find you are able to summon via Rounds of Lionheart any of those loyal to Richard, that would have answered his summons, and gain his final Noble Phantasm Utopie Purgatoire allowing the summon of the flames of purgatory in the form of lions to attack your foes.
addons.title: Wandering King

addons.text: "I bask in the shadow of legends far greater than mine. I am the boy who wishes to reach the stars by his own hand and the girl who sees the world for what it could be. Yet reality lays me low, left forever to behold the true heroes who are just out of my grasp." You are a conceptual Servant made up of all those nameless people who wished to be something greater then they were, the ones who looked towards the heroes of old and desperately whispered "I wish that were me." They have no great deeds nor fame like a true heroic spirit, yet, their faith and desires have somehow fused you and them into one. There is no hero that you do not admire. This will not change your personality but you can find something within them that is admirable; Be it their strength, values or deeds. Also, your ability to recreate the sagas of old has now become your noble phantasm. While it still retains its limitations and drawbacks, it's power is considerably more potent.
addons.title: I Dream to Be Like You

objects.text: "I ask of you, Are you my Master?" Familiars of the highest rank, Servants are legendary spirits that have been repurposed to be used to participate in a Holy Grail War and somehow you've been transformed into one. Servants are not of flesh and bone but formed out of Ether. This means they do not require any mortal needs, save for magical energy, and as long as their spirit origin is not damaged, they can regenerate from just about anything. As they are beings that have higher mystery than the average person, it requires a similar amount of mystery for them to be even harmed by mundane attacks; Weapons such as swords, bullets or even bombs are ineffective against Servants unless they are packed with magical energy. They can also astralise, a sort of low power mode that requires less magical energy and allows you to turn intangible and invisible. You start off as a Servant with E Rank Statistics, no Skills and no Noble Phantasms but as your story unfolds, with humanity recognising your achievements, this may change. You may also choose one of the seven traditional Servant Classes to take up; with all of your attributes being much easier to grow in your chosen class. You may also give one person a set of three command seals. This is a symbol of their status as your master and would ordinarily be used as a control mechanism, but in your case, that effect is diminished and it's ability to empower you has been magnified. You also have the bare minimum amount of magical energy needed to support your existence, however, to use any mana intensive abilities you will need an outside source of magical energy. This may be food, energy generated from your master or perhaps even souls.
objects.title: Servant (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
An Eastern esoteric art that turns your body into a living magic circuit. Mysteries no longer need rituals or incantations, but are realized through breath and motion—each breath a prayer, each step a spell—as you move in rhythm with the World.

By drawing in outer energy, you link your inner world to the outer, turning your body into a pure magic circuit, capable of interfering with spells and phenomena without formal training—such as banishing spirits with a clap.

At first, this grants you athletic ability on par with a professional athlete through passive reinforcement, allows you to perform minor magical feats comparable to simple magecraft, and the subtle capacity to blend into the environment.

Since this path is one of endless refinement. The closer your breath and movement align with the pulse of the World, the greater Mysteries you can actualize, until even the simplest gestures may rival rituals. At its peak, your body becomes like the Lungs of a Dragon—drawing in, purifying, and releasing vast amounts of magical energy with every breath and step.

Though it grants no spells or martial arts directly, Breathing and Walking is a foundation—one that enables limitless growth in both mysticism and combat.
objects.title: Breathing & Walking (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Typically, Mystic Eyes are fixed and cannot be altered; however, your ability to manipulate your Magic Circuits has released this limitation.
