Instead of possessing Mystic Eyes, the Magic Circuits within your eyes are up to you to imbue with spells, effectively creating any Mystic Eyes that correspond to any spell you can cast. 

The magical energy required to materialize the spell is drawn from the Magic Circuits within your eyes.
addons.title: Custom Order Mystic Eyes

objects.text:
It is through the eyes that the soul’s power is made manifest, and some eyes show that power a lot more strongly than others. You possess a pair of very high-class Mystic Eyes that are capable of an incredibly powerful magical effect transmitted through sight. It can be forcibly bending to your will anyone who looks into your eyes to as advanced as granting you powerful sight-based telekinesis. Whatever you choose, it is extremely difficult for others to resist the effects, and even those with potent magical resistance are still likely to feel a reduced effect instead of nothing. Given the magical nature, you can also choose what your eyes look like.

(You can't choose the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception and the Mystic Eyes of Petrification with this.)
objects.title: Mystic Eyes (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
All things die eventually. No matter how clever you are or what paradox you invoke to escape it, all that is born ‘alive’ into this world will eventually leave it. You can see the conceptual manifestation of death up close with your eyes. You're able to perceive ‘death’ itself on living beings and physical objects, appearing as thin red lines. When you touch or cut along these lines, the object or being in question is immediately cut deeply and entirely, regardless of their durability, and attempts at healing or regeneration are completely stunted, though the lines can become thinner and more difficult to target the tougher the being or object is.

At first, these lines are all you can perceive and influence, but after some time passes, they will become clearer to your eyes, and you will eventually see circular ‘points’ on their body that the lines all trace back to. Cutting or stabbing this point of death directly will immediately kill the target in question; no form of reincarnation, resurrection, or regeneration will save them from the bitter taste of death. This is what it means to kill something.

You may eventually be able to understand and perceive the concept of death in less tangible things, such as the spells of Magecraft or the empty space between you and an object, though some things can only be ‘cut’, not ‘killed’, for they have no point of death. However, perceiving how fragile the world and existence as a whole is something no human mind can truly bear witnessing. This would not be the case for you. When your eyes are active, the perception of death will have no strain on your mind and will cause no negative or unwanted impact or side effects on your brain, body, or mental health from continued use. You are also able to activate and use these eyes for as long as you wish to, and you have equal potential for perceiving and understanding death as Shiki's eyes.

The ‘points’ of death may never appear for certain beings, beings that were never ‘born’ or are free of the concept of death entirely, such as a True Ancestor at the peak of their power during the night of a full moon. You would have to remove the source of their immortality or introduce them to the possibility of mortality in a different way, though hard to achieve, but not impossible for your eyes.
objects.title: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
In the realm of rarity and rarity alone, the manifestation of beauty emerges, a splendor so pure that mortals ought never to possess it. What you now hold are the highest order of Mystic Eyes, the eyes of Cybele, unparalleled in their magnificence, beyond the replication of any magecraft. These violet jewels possess an allure so captivating that even the gaze of deities would pause to marvel at their brilliance. However, their true power lies not just in their beauty but in their ability to induce an unconditional petrification upon anyone who comes within the user's line of sight, whether they meet their gaze or not. You can even, with time and practice, induce petrification through your memory of the intended target(s).

These eyes are all-encompassing, and their effects are impossible to block with any form of protection, even capable of reaching the very essence of living beings, their souls. The more prolonged the exposure to the powers of your eyes, the deeper the petrification, leading to a complete state of stone-like rigidity and even true death. Beings of the same power as the user would find themselves instantly petrified. Though the pace of petrification may vary depending on the power gap between the target and the user—no being, no matter how superior or more powerful than the user, could escape the inevitable fate under the power of your divine eyes.

These mystical eyes will additionally provide a massive superhuman boost to the user's vitality and overall physical attributes. Owning such a rare and potent treasure would also elevate your physical appearance significantly, granting a two-level boost in attractiveness. Even those considered average, with these eyes alone, would take on an alluring charm akin to supermodel status.

These eyes are utterly indestructible and an unchangeable aspect of the user's existence, as the wielder retains full control over them, where they can selectively or fully toggle their effects on or off at will, and would suffer no drawbacks or fatigue from continuous use.
objects.title: Mystic Eyes of Petrification (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You own and control a pocket dimension containing the original version of every single treasure that humanity knows of, and more. Every invention, every making, every forging, every last creation, every natural resource, every divine artifact, every last treasure that mankind has found, created, knows of, or has appeared in the world, past, present, or future, is found within this endless vault of space. The volume of your treasury has by far exceeded your knowledge, so you do not know what every single item you own does or how it looks. The treasure within your Gates of Babylon continues to grow, contributing to the immense wealth of items already found within it. With each new world, new treasures from the past, present, and future are incorporated into your Gates of Babylon.

You can expel any items in your pocket dimension by opening a portal between dimensions that allows for the contents to pass through upon your command. You can summon items directly into your hand, pull out weapons from directly behind you, or prepare numerous weapons midair, loaded like bullets, to be expelled at hypersonic speeds. Anything you throw out can be retrieved back into your treasury with a thought.
objects.title: Gates of Babylon (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You possess the knowledge and skill to perform a ritual that summons a Heroic Spirit from the Throne of Heroes in the form of a Servant. Normally, the mechanics of the Grail War are responsible for the lion’s share of sustaining this new ally; however, your Servant seems to be almost entirely self-supported.

When you perform the ritual, you gain the opportunity to summon the Servant you desire. You will always summon one of the infinite variants of your desired Heroic Spirit, compatible with your personality, goals, and desires. Each successful summoning grants you three Command Seals, with each Seal capable of issuing a near-absolute command to the Servant it’s connected to, thereby linking the Servant to their Master.

If you exhaust all of your Command Seals or if your Servant is slain, you can perform this ritual again to summon another Servant to replace them.

<small>Note: If you attempt to perform the ritual while you currently have a Servant, any newly summoned Servant will not be supported by this power, nor will they be guaranteed to be compatible with you.</small>
objects.title: Summoner (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Now, if you successfully cursed somebody, you can write stories about them with captions appearing between the lines to refute, explain, or expand upon what you write within that context.
addons.title: Captioned Stories

addons.text: By having access to the skill of Murasaki Shikibu, you also gained insight into her specific type of lesser-scale Curse Arts skill, which allows one’s own words to be used as a form of Magecraft. This allows you to incorporate curses into your works, which could affect both the reader and, in some specific cases, even the being or object written about.
addons.title: Curse Arts (Lyric)

addons.text: As the Master of Words, you can also insert words into the captions you see, affecting your cursed target directly, as only the truth can ever appear in the captions, even if it has to change the target to remain true. But you are still limited by your own skill within the mystical art of Word Magic, having the initial three-word chain limit.
addons.title: Caption Editing

objects.text: You obtained the ability to affect anybody with a special curse, which makes you or anybody else besides the target see captions appearing around the affected being, explaining the words and actions of the target. The captions will exposit entirely on their own, pulling information from the target, so it can easily explain why they are doing things. The captions are also affected to a certain degree by the viewer, as it will consider their interests but are unable to write lies. Andersen: “Oranges? Why should I care? Ridiculous. My fingers would get all smudged.” Caption: “Despite what he says, this boy actually loves himself some sweet oranges.” Osakabehime: “Heh, so that’s how it is, hehe (smirk)”: Murasaki Shikibu “AH… Not again…!” Andersen: “? What’s wrong with your faces?”
objects.title: Caption Curse (Type-Moon)

addons.text: With the acquisition of the Skill Galvanism, many things change. So long as this skill can provide power for System Keraunos, you will find the energy drain from you to be much more reasonable. Galvanism's benefits don't stop there, due to its drawing on the electromagnetic field around you, you will find your control in the immediate vicinity—around 20m or so—to be much more precise. The effects aren't one-way. System Keraunos's ability to manipulate electro-magnetism allows you to 'automate' Galvanism, setting the rates at which it converts energy, and which energies it will or won't convert without your constant conscious input. Together, they can create a zone around the user that provides a nearly absolute defense around the user, Galvanism protecting from energy-based attacks, and System Keraunos protecting from physical-based ones. However, do be careful—something truly exotic or overly powerful may be able to penetrate even this.
addons.title: Wardenclyffe

objects.text: Legend of Mankind, Advent of Lightning This is the Noble Phantasm of Nikola Tesla, the embodiment of his contributions to the modern AC electric supply systems. This power allows the user to manipulate electromagnetism on a wide scale through the use of magical power. The uses range from the basics, such as generating and manipulating electricity & magnetism, to more advanced uses, such as atomic and molecular manipulation. As powerful as the potential here is, it suffers a significant weakness in that it is an intense drain on your magical reserves to use. Note: This power starts you off with the bare basics, and you will need time—around a decade on average—and practice to eventually achieve the potential explained here, with higher limits being theoretically possible.
objects.title: System Keraunos (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You now wield the Noble Phantasm Rho Aias: The Seven Rings that Cover the Burning Heavens, a legendary seven-layered Bounded Field that manifests as luminous flower petals. This barrier, fueled by magical or supernatural energy, embodies unparalleled defense. Each petal carries the strength of an entire fortress wall and possesses a unique conceptual advantage against projectiles, nullifying their power upon impact. Unlike Shirou Emiya's imitation, your access to the true Rho Aias grants you a far more powerful and stable manifestation. This version eliminates any risk of backlash from the broken petals and even enhances its overall potency. At full power, with all seven petals intact, Rho Aias can halt any projectile—regardless of its nature or power—dead in its tracks. The shield's defense mirrors the legend of Ajax (Aias), who stopped Hector's legendary javelin throw with his seven-layered shield, halting its march at the seventh and final layer. With mastery, you can transcend the need for incantation, summoning Rho Aias through sheer willpower. Its defensive capabilities are infinitely scalable—channeling greater amounts of energy strengthens its resilience, while conserving energy allows you to summon fewer petals for situational use. Note: Once the seventh and final petal absorbs an attack, the shield will shatter and become unusable until reformed. While Rho Aias blocks direct attacks, it does not mitigate environmental side effects or collateral damage resulting from the attack's impact, which might lead to injury or death if you're not careful.
objects.title: Rho Aias (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Unlimited Raise Dead
addons.text:
By mixing together the Curse of All the World’s Evil and your Authority, Return by Death, you have replicated Angra Mainyu’s ability: Unlimited Raise Dead.

You, and optionally a person(s) of your choice, are placed within a four-day time loop. Upon either your death or the end of the four days, the loop resets.

At the end of each loop, a Shade is created, taking the form of a shadowy wolf-man.

The person(s) you designate within the Timeloop will be forced to fight the Shade(s) at the end of the Timeloop, should they succeed their memories are (optionally) reset leaving them unaware of being inside a Timeloop. That said instincts may remain if the Timeloop last long enough.

As a baseline, each Shade possesses enough physical power to slaughter any normal human. Only someone with ten or more years of combat experience could last more than a few seconds in a one-on-one fight.

That said, every Shade carries a weakened copy of all your powers, skills, and perks.

If you possess ‘The Perfect Loop’, its reprisal effects are increased. In addition, everyone who has killed you or the individual you chose to include within the loop gains a conceptual weakness toward your Shades. The more harm they inflicted, the stronger this weakness becomes.

objects.text: You can release a black, mud-like substance from your body—a vile, putrid sludge that spreads rapidly across any surface. But this is no ordinary mud. It is the physical embodiment of six billion curses, the distilled malice, sorrow, and hatred of all humanity. Normally, curses are formless and unseen, but this is different. For this is the concept of All the World's Evil itself given shape. Its hatred is so incomprehensibly heavy, so absolute in its nature, that its sheer density gives it form. What emerges is a writhing tide of corrupted magical energy, born from collective sin. A spiritual cancer that desecrates everything it touches. It doesn't simply kill—it ruins. Nature itself recoils from its presence. To even come into contact with this black tide is to be instantly and irreversibly cursed. Flesh bubbles and melts as though devoured by acid. The soul is raked raw by forces beyond comprehension. And the victim's final agonies—their pain, terror, and regret—are all consumed by the mud, absorbed into its depths, and recycled into fuel for the next victim caught in its grasp, with each life taken only making the next more horrific. For those fully submerged, death would be a mercy. Instead, the mud "paints" the world around them in a surreal nightmare: an unseeable hellscape etched into their consciousness. Forced to witness the totality of human sin, every cruelty, betrayal, and unspeakable act across history—relived again and again, endlessly within the prison of their mind. Ugliness, which defies reason. Truths too revolting to accept. Atrocities that erode the soul. These poor souls are made to suffer the pain, hatred, and sorrow of all mankind at once. The mud doesn't just kill. It undoes you. Only those with extraordinary willpower, divine protection, or a powerful resistance to curses have any hope of enduring it. But even then, survival is not salvation as they may still emerge shattered—haunted by phantom agonies, their bodies and minds scarred beyond repair. Worse still, no clairvoyant can perceive it. No oracle can read it. No prophecy can foretell its path. This curse-mud exists outside the boundaries of fate. It is a blind spot in the gaze of the divine. And yet, you remain untouched by its horrors. The one thing immune to its defilement. You may even exert limited control over its spread, able to shape its flow or pull it back into yourself at will. Though born of ruin, it bends to your presence.
objects.title: Curse of All the World's Evil (Type-Moon)

objects.text: “The star of prophecy, The land of hope, and the ruins of paradise. Even if no one calls, you will hold the star aloft. For whom is this fate...?” Using this spell, you may project your mental world upon the physical one. Crafted from both your conscious and unconscious desires, as well as your memories, this inner world can have various powerful effects, such as blessings of regeneration or curses that hinder movement, depending on what makes thematic sense for the environment. These will be deployed upon activating the technique and cannot be changed until the spell is halted and deployed again. While this is similar in concept to a reality marble, your mental world must adhere to the laws of reality of the universe in which you exist. Additionally, you gain the ability to project Artoria Caster’s inner world, the fragment of paradise that all men aspire to reach. This mere memory of Avalon grants the people within this mana-intensive technique incredible defences and healing, protecting them against even the heat rays of a dragon with its anti-purge defences. However, the technique cannot be kept active indefinitely, for even a fragment of paradise must stay ever-distant and will require increasing amounts of mana to sustain the same level of enhancements. Eventually, with time and training, you may be able to manifest the mental world as Round of Avalon, the upgraded version of Around Caliburn, giving you the ability to gift people the spiritual weight of the Knights of the Round Table, allowing for the people fighting alongside you to become almost pseudo-servants of figures such as Lancelot or Percival, though more tailored to their abilities.
objects.title: Around Caliburn: The Star of Hope That Embraces You (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You possess an ability gained from one of the legends of Richard the Lionheart, a former King of England. This Noble Phantasm originates from Richard's tendency to call any sword he wielded “Excalibur” and manifests as the power to turn anything within his grip into an echo of the strongest Holy Sword, at least temporarily. While this power can allow the user to reach towards the might of the strongest holy sword, it can never fully match it. The echo of Excalibur manifested can call forth lesser versions of the infamous “Excali-blasts”, and due to their weaker nature, they can be controlled with great precision. The greatest weakness of this ability lies in the requirement for an object to form a foundation for Excalibur’s “echo” to inhabit, with stronger or better foundations allowing more power. Most foundations will fracture and eventually shatter under the overwhelming force being channeled through them. A stick is likely to barely last a single attack, while a well-made sword might survive several uses. Even another Noble Phantasm will begin to break down eventually if this ability is used on it too often.
objects.title: Sword of Forever Distant Victory (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Play the Lion’s Melody on the Round Cross This is one of the trump cards of Richard the Lionheart. It utilizes the bonds one makes with others during your lifetime to temporarily manifest weaker Servant versions of them, dedicated to your service. Rounds of Lionheart is only able to summon forth those who willingly allow themselves to be summoned, and the largest cost of this ability is the tremendous amount of magical energy required to manifest them for long. Typically, this requires those summoned to remain within the user's soul, able to share their wisdom and knowledge, and only able to interact briefly with the world via your shadow. With the expenditure of enough magical power, though, you can manifest them truly as full—if weaker—servants to aid you.
objects.title: Rounds of Lionheart (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
As an unusual Alchemist with exceptionally high-quality Magic Circuits, you can leverage your circuits’ lesser-known computational functions to enhance your already immense mental faculties, making you a living supercomputer.

Additionally, you can leverage your computational capabilities to enhance your nature interference magecraft, allowing you to do things like alter the environment with inhuman precision or fabricate proofs for your magical phenomena that reduce, or outright eliminate, the world’s rejection of your influence, thus reducing your magical energy expenditures to the bare minimum.

With a good deal of effort, you could even recreate the effects of Shirou Emiya’s Projection Magecraft without a Reality Marble, by deriving an object’s history and characteristics through your observations and calculations, then manually filling that information into your Projection Magecraft.
addons.title: Computationally Backed Magecraft

addons.text:
As a result of the increased processing power and memory capacity granted by your mastery of Archive Magic, you have gained the functionality of a living pseudo-spiritron computer.

Using this newfound power, you can create and install yourself with virtual Magic Circuits that are pre-programmed with a given set of spells. These pseudo-spiritron structures essentially function like applications for your soul, each capable only of what you programmed into them beforehand, and each taking up some of your soul’s finite data capacity until it is uninstalled.

Given you take enough care when creating them, these Magic Circuits can even be used to perform Mysteries that you are otherwise unable to cast, such as nature interference Magecraft.

You could even use this skill to directly modify your own soul, to increase your innate data capacity and evolve beyond the human framework, or for some other purpose. Be warned, such modifications are extremely risky for a human; in the worst case, your soul could collapse, extinguishing your existence, and even in the better cases, your soul could end up distorted, leaving you quite insane.

Such risks are not nearly as severe for beings with greater innate soul capacities, such as Servants, Phantasmal Species, and high-ranking Dead Apostles.
addons.title: Spiritron Programming

addons.text:
Through arcane body modifications not unlike those of the Six Sources that head the Atlas Academy, you have acquired the ability to perform a series of complex arcane operations to refine your internal magical energy into Photonic Crystals, otherwise known as Philosopher's Stones.

This material is among the finest any alchemist could ask for, the bedrock for wonders like Atlas’s own Tri-Hermes or even the Moon Cell itself. 

That said, this process is not exactly an easy one, especially for one with Magic Circuits as inferior as yours, as it can take a month or more of dedicated calculations to form a crystal the size of a grain of sand.
addons.title: Photonic Crystal Formation

objects.text:
You are a talented Alchemist of the Atlas Institute.

This grants you a high level of competence in both Thought Acceleration and Memory Partition, techniques that make use of the human body as an arithmetic unit.

Thought Acceleration is, at its most basic, merely the ability to think extremely quickly, but in the hands of a competent Alchemist, it is the ability to quickly and accurately perform complex calculations and operations with the same fluidity a layman might observe the color or shape of an object.

Memory Partition is the ability to partition your thoughts to form multiple independent thought processes. While normal people can only have a single "room" in their brain and focus on one thought, partitioning can divide this one room into several. Such partitions are synergistic, essentially squaring your current total thought processes with each added partition, such that a superior Alchemist, like yourself, with 3 partitions has access to 16 independent thought processes to allocate however you wish. Should you ever achieve your fourth partition, you would have a staggering 256 thought processes, then 65,536 at your fifth, and so on.

Despite your skills as an Alchemist, your Magic Circuits are hopelessly inferior in both quality and quantity, leaving you largely incapable of nature interference Magecraft, forcing you to enact your mysteries within your own body, where there’s far less resistance. At high levels, such Magecraft can be used to create things like bone familiars capable of crushing average clock tower magi in combat, or altering your skin such that it can dissolve other objects on contact.

The zenith of your Magecraft as an Alchemist lies not in your own personal strength, but in Mystic Code creation. Unlike most magi, Atlas Alchemists' special abilities are based on a Man and Machine approach. They use the quantifiable energy of the Soul; the Pseudo-Spiritrons, to engineer organisms with Magic Circuits such as Homunculi, or powerful artifacts such as the Black Barrel or Logos React.
objects.title: Alchemist of Atlas (Type-Moon)

objects.text: "Three Wise Men of the East. The Great God of the Norse. The Fruit of Wisdom. My intellect, my omnipotence, surpasses all forms of wisdom!" This Noble Phantasm is personification of the era defining omnipotence that was Leonardo Da Vinci. When it's true name is called, your attacks will automatically adjust themselves to best defeat the individual that you have selected. Though it will take immense calculation ability, with even "basic" attacks needing a magi-tech supercomputer's worth of output, things like time and space, magical barriers and regeneration will not hinder your attack power. Additionally, even if an enemy has an innate resistance to an elemental attack, then that attack will also adjust itself. For example, if your opponent has an innate lightning resistance then your Thunder spells will change into water that behaves like lightning, negating it. Eventually, you may able to use this noble phantasm to reflect back any phenomena upon your foes.
objects.title: Uomo Universale: The Universal Man (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to unleash a rainbow-colored surge of mana embodying every power humanity associates with the concept of “calamity.” Within that spectrum lie floods, earthquakes, pestilential curses potent enough to leave Gilgamesh on death’s door, fire tornadoes, flash freezes, and countless other disasters.

Because human civilization itself has become a source of catastrophe—through its mastery of forces like gunpowder and electricity—those man-made calamities can be invoked through this power as well.

This ability can be focused into a devastating blast or beam capable of traveling hundreds of kilometers, striking its target with the chosen disaster. Alternatively, it can manifest as a defensive dome, a living symbol of everything humanity fears as calamity, strong enough to withstand attacks as powerful as Alcides’s Hydra-venom-infused Nine Lives.
objects.title: Mana Burst: Calamity (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
The power of God Hand can now be distributed between you and your summons as you desire. With this you can give one of your summons all twelve lives, spread them out between your summons equally or keep them all to yourself. 

So long as they have been given one life, they will still have the resistances and immunities of the traditional God Hand.
addons.title: Those Showered With Glory

addons.text:
Your Nine Lives may now be imbued with the aspects of the various glories you've gained through King's Order. 

An arrow imbued with the water's of the Aegean stables may be tipped in water or hit with the force of a river. A sword given the aspect of the sash of Hippolyta may be infused with much more divinity than would usually be allowed or the pelt of the Nemean lion may give an attack the ability to ignore defences that are the works of man. 

While your attacks are imbued with the various glories, they may not be summoned to your side and if they are destroyed whilst completing an attack, it will be the same if they were killed as a summon.
addons.title: Sing Us the Tale of His Labours

objects.text:
The Noble Phantasm of Alcides that crushes the conventions of the Holy Grail itself. King's Order is made up of the various Mystic Codes and phantasmal beasts that Alcides encountered in his penance of twelve labours. 

These include the pelt of the Nemean Lion, Chiron's Immortality, the sash of Hippolyta and creatures such as the Stymphalian Birds, Cerberus and the Mares of Diomedes.

As the Noble Phantasm is essentially twelve Noble Phantasms in one, trying to manifest more than one of the labours at one time will see the Noble Phantasm's magical energy consumption multiply.

When these summons are killed, they may not return unless you manage to use a resurrection power on them.
objects.title: King's Order: Twelve Glories (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Musketeer Servants
addons.text:
Whenever you create or replicate a Servant from a pre-existing entity or one born from your own inspiration, you gain the ability to perform two distinct functions that arise from combining the summoning power of the Musketeers with the Throne of Heroes.

Triple Summoning: Your Servant acquires a superior nature to the Double Summon attribute. This allows it to possess three different Classes, each with its own legend that grants a unique set of powers and Noble Phantasms. All three coexist within a single individual without disrupting their consciousness. This enables the Servant to amplify its powers and abilities by a factor of 5×, based on whichever Class is most compatible with the current situation. If the original entity possessed multiple versions of the same legend due to different reinterpretations, the Servant is capable of manifesting all of those alternate versions as a single unified legend.

Multiple Summoning: You are no longer limited to summoning a single Servant. Instead, you may summon three individuals representing the same entity. Unlike the previous ability, this works by separating the different reinterpretations of a single legend into completely independent entities. The summoning cost remains the same—the only difference is the manner in which they manifest. This has the advantage of taking full advantage of the telepathic link granted by the Musketeer powers. Combined with the Throne of Heroes, they are capable not only of perceiving each other's thoughts and tracking one another's locations, but also of sharing their senses among themselves and, optionally, with you, creating a prototype hive mind.

Keep in mind that by acquiring the powers of the Musketeers, your Servants receive a Role, which can be directly translated into a Class. Therefore, whenever a Servant is created, they are guaranteed to receive a Class designation instead of being classified as Classless. Depending on the nature of their legend, these Classes may extend far beyond the standard and Extra Classes, becoming entirely unique or even of your own design.

Furthermore, with the aid of the Throne of Heroes, the time required for both Servants and their Master to resurrect is reduced to 6 hours. Alternatively, you may sacrifice one of your existing Servants as the price for an immediate resurrection. In exchange, the sacrificed Servant will be erased from the records of the Throne. However, you may recreate that Servant later, though they will return without any of the enhancements, experiences, or changes they accumulated throughout their previous existence, effectively resetting them completely.

objects.text:
The Throne of Heroes—a dimension outside the World and the time axis where Heroic Spirits reside. Beings who left their mark on history through great deeds, myths, or legends, ranging from a grand warrior king to a savage assassin, can be recorded within its halls.

You are connected to your own personal Throne, granting you the ability to store and summon your own Heroic Spirits.

You can replicate or create a Heroic Spirit from any being you observe and connect with—from figures of myth to characters found in mere stories. This allows you to manifest them as “classless” Servants, provided they are “heroes who achieved great fame in the world” and you possess the necessary magical energy. If they are still alive, you can synchronize the Heroic Spirit with their living counterpart, instantly projecting their soul into your Throne. This transforms their physical body and soul on the planet into an extension of the existence nested within your Throne.

These Heroic Spirits possess all the memories, skills, abilities, and blessings they held in life, alongside their various weapons and artifacts as you understand them to have, further augmented by any mythos attributed to their name. This grants them a conceptual weight that allows them to transcend their previous limits. Unlike true Heroic Spirits, these entities can continue to grow and evolve with every new legend you discover.

As your understanding of these beings deepens, you will eventually gain the ability to forge perfect replicas. Much like a standard Servant, you can summon them into specific "classes." However, because you are shaping the spirit to fit a Class rather than filling an existing class container, they will only be as powerful as that specific class allows, receiving no additional parameters or benefits from the container itself.

Currently, your Throne lies empty, newly forged and waiting.
objects.title: Throne of Self (Type-Moon)

objects.text: “The weight and pain of taking just one step forward? ---- I am familiar with how much it can take." This the Noble Phantasm of Odysseus, the King of Ithaca and protagonist of the Homeric epic ‘The Odyssey’. Penelope is the crystallisation of Odysseus stringing the bow, that would shoot through twelve axes, signifying his return and love for his wife. You have become the conceptual bow that all projectiles are released from. Arrows, bullets, magic can be released using your body as if they were launched by the perfect vessel. Through this, spells that usually require a focus can be cast instantly, artillery shells can be shot over the horizon and pebbles can hit a man with the force of a bullet. This takes no effort on your behalf, simply the nature of anatomy, meaning you could do this without rest so long as you have enough ammunition and your body endures. Even in the direst circumstances, your love will never leave you empty handed. Reminiscent of the Olympian Gods, you can fire a singular arrow of light even if you have completely spent all other reserves.
objects.title: Penelope: Love's Radiant Stringless Bow (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Witch-Marked
addons.text: Once upon a time, Hecate, the first being of Magic in the DC Multiverse, was captured and imprisoned for eons by a group of humans. Once she escaped, Hecate, in her paranoia, decided to divide her power into 5 pieces and implant them into human girls, with each piece automatically being implanted into a new girl upon death. You have one such implant now, and unlike the other 4, you can directly access the power contained in this fragment and tap into her Authority of Magic. Unlike the Divine Spirits of Type-Moon, Hecate is not bound by Mystery and as such the Authority is stronger and will never deteriorate. Currently, you can only tap into this Authority to instantly conjure basic magical phenomena or phenomena you already have the skill to perform and significantly enhance your magic, with the only price being the strain placed upon the Authority itself. But with time, you can control the magic of others, grant others magic, make others Homo Magi, and conjure magical phenomena typically outside your capability. Though you only carry a fragment of Hecate's power and will never match her full might purely using the Authority. Note: If you're in the DC Universe, Hecate will not know you possess a Fragment unless you use it near her or use the Authority to perform a significant feat.

objects.text:
When the Age of Gods was ending, it did not all end at once, and island nations like Japan were able to hold out longer. Because of this, certain families would save fragments of a divine spirit and host them inside a human. This allows them to keep a contract with the divine spirit and use their authority similar (albeit weakened) to how magi from the Age of Gods did. These people are known as Black Chests.

You are also a Black Chest. You can choose any known Divine Spirit in the Type-Moon franchise and possess a part of them inside you, allowing you to call upon a weakened version of their Authority.

An Authority is a god’s ability to influence the world according to their domains. While normal Skills and Magecraft "achieve a certain result based on some logical process or principle," Authorities "realize a result simply because the user has the right to do so.”

Normally, stating the name of the Divine Spirit whose fragment you possess would lead to the piece inside of you to deteriorate but for some reason you do not have this problem.
objects.title: Black Chest (Type-Moon)

objects.text: A Knight Does Not Die with Empty Hands A unique ability of Lancelot du Lac, born from the legend where he was forced into a duel unarmed and proved his skill by claiming victory with nothing more than an elm branch. Because of that, anything you touch and intend to use as a weapon can become your Noble Phantasm—so long as you can genuinely conceptualize it that way, thinking "this is a weapon," and actually have the skill to use it. There's a bit of nuance to it, however. In your mind, the item's role as a weapon must clearly not be secondary to some other purpose; if it is, then it simply won't qualify. Still, regardless of whatever object you're wielding, it'll be elevated to a D Rank Noble Phantasm and handled naturally like an extension of your own body—almost as if you've spent years specifically mastering it. 「Knight of Owner」 will also let you seize ownership of another Servant's Noble Phantasm—claiming it as yours with no change in Rank—the moment you wrest control from its original user.
objects.title: Knight of Owner (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Chromaturgy needs color to function, and BioChromatic Breath, is, in some ways, color given spiritual form. So of course, it’s only natural that they would complement each other. When drafting colors off the aura given by holding large amounts of breaths, you will find your Luxin becoming more... itself. Your Oranges become slicker, your Blues harder, your Greens more flexible, and much more. This effect improves the more Breaths you have, capping out at 50000 breaths, where they would gain perfect material properties. Additionally, should you ever be somehow stripped of access to colors, you can Draft directly using your Breaths, achieving the aforementioned perfect material properties, as well as Awakening your Luxin, allowing you to Command it with great ease.
addons.title: Color of the Soul

objects.text: You are a natural-born Prism fit to rival Lucidonius himself. Your prismatic eyes mark you as a Lightsplitter capable of wielding the full Spectrum of Chromaturgy. White, Chi, Super-Violet, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red, Sub-Red, Paryl, Black, you are capable of Drafting all types of Luxin with the perfection of a Superchromat. Being a true Prism, you can Draft a nearly unlimited amount of Luxin, held back only by your own stamina and endurance. As the foremost example of a Drafter, you possess an unbreakable Will, capable of bending the rules of what should be possible with Luxin through sheer stubbornness. This also comes with supernaturally perfect vision, a weak healing factor, and immunity to possession.
objects.title: Prism (Lightbringer)

objects.text: You have the inherent potential to warp time and space. The basic use of this power allows you to mimic super-speed, combat teleport, and even teleport long distances. With practice and training, one can travel the breadth of the Omniverse, capable of going to any other dimensions, and even through time itself.
objects.title: Elder Blood (The Witcher)

objects.text:
You are a Square Mage, someone who can combine four elements into one. You are capable of wielding all four of the standard elements, such as fire, wind, water, and earth. From there, you're able to combine these elements up to four times, either by stacking the same element or using different elements to create unique and powerful spells.

Such spells can range from turning a large blast of fire into a raging inferno of flames by stacking fire and wind with itself multiple times to transmuting rocks or other mundane minerals into gold by stacking earth to enhance such a spell. Along with this, you gain a large pool of willpower that recovers when you rest. Doing simple dot magic, such as flight, would cost significantly less willpower than casting a square (four elements) spell, such as creating gold or creating a hurricane capable of ravaging a small army. You could cast at first 100 dot spells, 50 line spells, 25 triangle spells, or 12 to 13 square spells in a day before growing too tired. Over time, your willpower will increase, allowing you to cast more than you were capable of.

All your spells can potentially grow stronger depending on whether you are feeling strong emotions like anger.

You also get a free wand or staff that you can choose the design of.
objects.title: Square Mage (Familiar of Zero)

objects.text:
You are one of the few mages who can wield the Holy Element of Founder Brimir himself, Void. You're able to do spells such as erasing memories or even mind control effects from someone's mind, creating explosions capable of decimating armies, opening portals to other worlds, casting vast illusions, undoing the magic of others and even simpler things as temporarily enhancing your physical abilities to potentially beyond even what the Gandálfr Runes could give you. You also start with a large amount of willpower, double that of the average Square Mage, which will grow with time.

A limitation to such powerful magic is that most of the more powerful spells require an extended time reciting the incantation to use them at full power. You have a general knowledge of most Void spells and know intuitively how to create more.

You also get a free wand or staff that you can choose the design of.
objects.title: Void Mage (Familiar of Zero)

objects.text:
You have access to Firstborn Magic. Where human mages know only one element and, over time, may potentially learn the other three and combine them through the use of incantations and foci, you can easily wield all four elements naturally with no incantations or foci—even casting spells that do not belong to any of the elements. This also grants you greater control and finesse, allowing you to craft spells and use them without the risk of backfire.

This works by harnessing the spirits of the land and having them amplify your own spells or cast the spells for you. This unique help from the spirits allows, for example, a spell capable of shooting a fireball the size of a person to instead create one the size of a house using the same amount of willpower. 

Beyond traditional elemental spells, you have the ability to perform magic similar to Void Mages, such as teleporting long distances—potentially even to other worlds—creating magical barriers that can reflect attacks, healing magic capable of restoring limbs or missing organs, and creating life, such as artificial spirits bound to weapons. You can also trap others in a location, shoot lightning, create or control plants, or even create magical stones and crystals filled with an element for later use. As a user of Firstborn Magic, you have a greatly increased lifespan.

While there aren’t many limits to what you can and can't do, the spirits you control are tied to the land, making it difficult to call upon their help when high in the air. Though even without their help, with your large amount of willpower and overall skill at magic, you would still at least be better than the average Square Mage.
objects.title: Firstborn Magic (Familiar of Zero)

addons.text: Derflinger is now able to use your rune as an anchor. If whatever weapon he is currently in is destroyed he can instead go to your rune and stay there until you or him decide a new vessel for him to inhabit. If he is ever personally destroyed he will automatically begin regenerating in your rune over the course of a week.
addons.title: The Chosen User

objects.text:
You have the runes of a Familiar of a Void Mage. They each grant you powerful abilities relating to their specific domain. They are:

Myozunitonirun, Mind of God - Being a Myozunitonirun allows one to use any magic artifact and create almost any magical feat. This serves as the opposite of Gandalfr, whereas Gandalfr uses weapons and scientific application, Myozunitonirun uses magic and spell theory.

Gandalfr, Left Hand of God - The primary power of a Gandalfr is absolute mastery of any item meant for combat, from swords and pistols to artillery cannons and fighter aircraft. The runes also give you a great boost in all physical parameters, allowing you to fight and potentially defeat armies in the thousands. This rune also gives you the scientific understanding of the weapon or item of war, allowing you to do or recommend maintenance. These effects only last as long as you're touching a weapon.

Vindalfr, Right Hand of God - The Vindalfr has the special ability to control animals. This even includes sentient beings like Rhyme Dragons, but it does not extend to humans or elves.

Lifprasir, Heart of God - This allows you to amplify your own spells at the cost of your own life force. You also have the power to stockpile magic, spells, make them stronger, and, for lack of a better word, turn yourself into a bomb. This has limited utility if you do not have magic of your own.
objects.title: Familiar Runes (Familiar of Zero)

addons.text:
You have the knowledge and capability of a legendary-level Skyrim smith with all perks maxed out. You also gain knowledge on how to craft an Aetherium Forge, a Skyforge, an Atronach Forge, and a Lunar Forge. Lastly, using magicka, you know how to transmute ingots and ores into ones exclusively found in Tamriel, the quality of the material and the amount of magicka used determines the quality and quantity of materials formed, returning lesser amounts when creating higher-quality substances. With time and effort, you may be able to forge something to the level of Auriel's Bow and other artifacts, but you start with no knowledge of their creation.

Note: This does not include any Dwemer Technology.
addons.title: Smithing

addons.text:
Your ability to capture the spirits of animals, create soul gems, and capture souls into soul gems has been combined with your soul garden. Your soul garden may now act like a giant soul gem, with it being able to absorb the souls of recently deceased beings who are spiritually or mentally weaker than you. The number of forceful souls you can hold directly correlates to how strong the target spirit is, their resistance, how strong your spirit is, and how strong your magicka is.

When enchanting using magicka crafting, you can forego the need for a soul gem and directly connect it to a soul stored in your soul garden. While this does increase the amount of time a soul can last when using it to enchant, this does not make it infinite, and the soul will fade from your afterlife, either to the actual afterlife or wherever souls go. By closing the connection you may allow a soul to recharge, but the more you do this the less effective this is. Alternatively, a soul can choose to stay in your afterlife, and while you may use them to enchant again, they will take time to fully recharge.

This also grants you the ability to selectively alter the amount of comfort your soul garden gives to its residents, up to removing it entirely.
addons.title: Personal Soul Cairn

addons.text: Your Master Robes can now grant all perks from their chosen school of Skyrim Clever Craft. Additionally, each Master Robe grants access to that school's Master-level spell tomes.
addons.title: Perks of the Mage

addons.text: Your Archmage Robes instead grant all magic-based perks from Skyrim, including Enchanting. Additionally, you now have access to all Master-level spell tomes from Skyrim.
addons.title: Perks of the Master Mage

objects.text:
The Clever Craft, also known as magic, magicka, and the Higher Arts, is the ability to manipulate the energies flowing into Mundus from Aetherius by way of the holes left by Magnus and the Magna Ge, known as the Sun and Stars. You have been given the ability to manipulate this energy as well as a good-sized pool of magicka and, attached to your soul, a hole to Aetherius. You are able to train and exercise to increase your magicka pool.

You start out with novice-level knowledge in Illusion, Alteration, Destruction, Conjuration, Restoration, Mysticism, Thaumaturgy, and Enchantment and have a small library of novice—to adept-level spell tomes, with you also being able to make your own spells.

You may create soul gems out of geodes. As long as you don’t use them in Mundus, you won’t send the soul of any being caught in the soul gem to the Soul Cairn.
objects.title: The Clever Craft (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You have awakened. Through exposure to mana, you have adapted to it and integrated it into your body, acquiring a unique set of powers. You are now a Hunter; even the weakest Hunter is vastly more powerful than the peak of humanity. Hunters are classified into six categories based on the powers they gained upon awakening. These categories are Fighters, Mages, Assassins, Tankers, Rangers, and Healers.

Fighters typically acquire abilities focused on close-range combat, such as transformation skills or other physical enhancements. Mages develop the capacity to cast spells using the mana accumulated within their bodies. Assassins often gain skills centered around stealth. Tanks acquire the ability to draw enemy attention, compelling foes to target them. Rangers obtain skills focused on ranged attacks, such as summoning firearms or magical arrows. Healers generally gain the ability to restore health to others and cast beneficial spells.

Furthermore, Hunters are ranked according to their power level upon awakening, ranging from the highest, S rank, to the lowest, E rank. This ranking system reflects their innate abilities. Unfortunately, you fall into the E-rank category. However, as this power is wholly yours and not just the result of mana pollution, you can slowly climb up the ranks and achieve what is called a reawakening, granting a significant boost in power and drastically surpassing your previous limits.
objects.title: Awakening (Solo Leveling)

addons.text: Your Talent, knowledge, and ability to create wands has expanded from the world of Mashle to the various Soulsborne games (i.e. Demon's Souls, Dark Souls, and Elden Ring). You now possess the knowledge on how to create every catalyst shown in each game series for every Sorcery (but not Pyromancies). This includes legendary Catalysts as well, but this does not mean you are limited to just those worlds. Should you find yourself in another world with similar magic systems, you can create Catalysts that let you use the spells.
addons.title: Magic Touch

objects.text:
You are adept with the power of sorcery from the Soulsborne games series. Using your intelligence and magic power, you can create spells with a wide variety of effects through calculation. You start with the magic power of an experienced sorcerer. Most spells created using this power manifest in the form of pure energy projectiles, though it is possible to create more physical effects as well. 

You can also create various magical items with a variety of effects and enchantments such as teleportation, resistance to certain types of damage, and elemental control. These effects can be made temporary in exchange for a large boost in power.

As of now, you are adept with a few basic spells from every school in the Soulsborne series, such as the Swift Glintstone Shard, Soul Spear, and Pursuers. You also have a high damaging spell as a trump card, such as Comet Azur or Zamor Ice Storm. You can optionally choose to specialize in a single school and gain mastery of all basic spells from that school with 2 advanced spells. You can discover and create new spells with research over time.

(With enough time you can do anything with this power)
objects.title: Sorcery (Soulsborne)

addons.text: Your Talent, Knowledge, and ability to create wands has expanded from the world of Mashle to the various Souslborne games (i.e Demon Souls, Dark Souls, and Elden Ring) You now possess the ability to create every Talisman shown in each game series for every different faith you can also create Talismans that are substitutes for sacred seals. This includes legendary Talismans as well but this does not mean you are limited to just those worlds should you find yourself in another world with divine Miracles or blessings than you can in time learn to harness them as well through Talismans based on them.
addons.title: Holy Trinkets

objects.text:
You are adept with the power of miracles from the Soulsborne game series. Using your faith and magic power, you can utilize miracles from a variety of sources. You start with the magic power of an experienced cleric (or the equivalent for your school). A common theme across all miracles is drawing power from an external source, whether that be an outer god such as The Greater Will or the power of dragons. Most miracles or incantations cast using this power manifest with a golden aura.

Miracles are also adept at removing curses, purifying enemies, and healing others. They also have a wide variety of utilities that can affect others or yourself with various buffs or debuffs such as scarlet rot or frenzy. You are also capable of curing similar conditions yourself.

As of now, you are adept with several miracles/incantations from a variety of schools, such as replenishment, greater heal, vow of silence, and lightning/sunlight spears. Instead of a powerful trump card, you are familiar with a variety of basic uses of faith that cannot be fully considered miracles, allowing you to perform almost any minor task as long as you don't expect to much of it. You can discover and create new miracles with time. 

(With enough time you can do anything with this power)
objects.title: Miracles (Soulsborne)

addons.text: Your Talent, Knowledge, and ability to create wands has expanded from the world of Mashle to the various Souslborne games (i.e Demon Souls, Dark Souls, and Elden Ring) You now possess the ability to create every Catalyst for Pyromancies shown in the Dark Souls Game series. But you also can create Catalysts that can help you make Pyromancy equivalents based on other similar abilities from other systems of power even ones that are inherent to other beings like divine flames from gods or acid used by mystical races. with enough research you can possibly even make new types of flames.
addons.title: Pyro Arsenal

objects.text:
You are adept with the power of pyromancies from the Soulsborne game series. Pyromancies do not make use of any attribute of yourself, instead relying solely on your talent with the art and as such can be utilized together with almost any magic system. While you can (technically) use and create a catalyst for pyromancies, these are extremely rare. 

You are capable of casting a variety of powerful pyromancies such as toxic mist, chaos storm, and acid surge. Although pyromancies have some utility options such as reducing damage to fire or boosting your stats, these usually come with a cost like limiting your mobility or gradually draining health. You are experienced in using these utility options.
objects.title: Pyromancies (Soulsborne)

addons.text:
You gain the unique physique granted by Fran Madaraki to her assistant organ container and harvester, Adorea. First, you have zippers all over your body, which give you quick access to the insides of your body, which have been remodelled to allow you to freely attach or detach organs and body parts in a matter of seconds without any actual injury, allowing you to have multiples of the same organs stored inside your body. This will also grant you immunity to all forms of traditional organ rejection. Second, your face has countless precise tentacles attached to it, which allows you to harvest organs and body parts at extreme speeds and precision.

Thanks to your surgical skills, you can also grant this physique to others and use grafting on others with immense precision and skill. You can also do cosmetic surgeries on both yourself and others to make the grafting much more seamless and aesthetically pleasing.

Optionally, you can choose to have your tentacles in other places or even have them hidden inside your body and/or change the aesthetics of your zippers to something like stitches.
addons.title: Adorea

addons.text: Thanks to the malleability of your soul, you can slowly integrate with the fragmented minds and souls seeping into your through grafting. This allows you to slowly absorb not only the body but the soul and mind, giving you access to skills, experience, insights and even talent the original holder had. This process isn't immediate and is hampered and slowed if you have multiple grafts done in quick succession.
addons.title: Perfect Amalgamate

addons.text: Your ability to graft had been strengthened thanks to your malleable biology. You no longer need to cut and snitch parts onto your body, instead with a touch you can fuse parts into your body, gaining control over them. You are also no longer limited to only grafting living creatures, you can for example graft a machine to your body, gaining control over it. You can also extend the effects of any other power you may have to anything you graft no matter what is is, for example you can extend regeneration to any machine parts you grafted.
addons.title: Grafting+

objects.text:
Grafting is a dark and twisted practice rooted in the relentless pursuit of power and perfection. It involves the surgical attachment of limbs, organs, or other body parts from different beings to oneself in an attempt to gain their strength, abilities, or even their essence. 

Grafting is more than just a physical process; it symbolizes the corruption and decay of one’s soul in the pursuit of power. Those who practice Grafting are often driven by a deep-seated fear of weakness and a desire to escape their own inadequacies. However, this pursuit comes at a great cost. The more one grafts, the further they drift from their humanity, becoming monstrous both in form and spirit. Grafting is seen as an affront to the natural order, a defilement of the sacred harmony between body and soul.

The practitioner first identifies and harvests limbs or body parts from powerful beings—typically warriors, creatures, or even other demigods. The more formidable the source, the greater the potential strength gained from the graft. These parts are chosen not only for their physical attributes but also for any innate magical or spiritual qualities they may possess. The harvested parts are then surgically attached to the practitioner’s body. This process involves cutting, stitching, and fusing the foreign limbs to the host’s flesh. The procedure is deeply painful and often carried out in macabre rituals, with the practitioner or their servants performing the graft in hidden, desecrated chambers. Once the graft is complete, the host begins to absorb the physical and mystical attributes of the grafted parts. This could result in increased strength, enhanced abilities, or even access to new powers, depending on the nature of the graft. For instance, grafting the head of a dragon might grant fire-breathing capabilities through said head, while the limb of a legendary warrior could provide unparalleled combat prowess.

The most immediate effect of grafting is the grotesque transformation of the host’s body. With multiple limbs or monstrous appendages, the practitioner becomes a walking patchwork of flesh, often losing any semblance of their original form. The grafts may appear mismatched, with different skin tones, textures, or even non-human features, resulting in a horrific, abominable appearance.
objects.title: Grafted (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
You are a Magicborn—an individual gifted from birth with an innate connection to a specific form of magic. Unlike most who must study, train, or be granted magical ability, Magicborns are naturally attuned to the flow of mystical energies, capable of wielding their powers instinctively.

These abilities typically manifest during early childhood, often with no prior warning or formal instruction. Due to their natural affinity, Magicborns tend to possess greater magical potential than trained mages, but they also require guidance and discipline to avoid harming themselves or others.

All forms of magic ultimately draw from one or more of three fundamental realms: the Material, Spiritual, and Celestial. Accordingly, the three primary types of magic are Elemental Magic, Spirit Magic, and Celestial Magic.

Elemental Magic is derived from the Material Realm, allowing manipulation of physical elements. This includes raw forces such as fire, water, earth, air, lightning, and light, as well as more theoretical elements such as time.

Spirit Magic draws its power from the Spirit Realm. Those born with this gift can communicate with spirits, traverse dreams, manipulate emotions, and influence the spiritual energy that permeates all beings—living, dead, or even inanimate objects with a presence in the Spirit Realm. Some Spirit Magic users can even tap into the forces of life and death or channel the abilities of spirits they commune with.

Celestial Magic, linked to the incomprehensible Celestial Realm, is the rarest and most mysterious of the three. It channels raw power from universal concepts and divine principles—ranging from celestial bodies like stars and planets to abstract notions such as justice, war, or chaos. Celestial Magic is immensely powerful and difficult for mortals to fully comprehend, as it allows its wielders to distort reality to an extent.

Among the many types of magic, there also exists Void Magic, a unique and unnatural form of power. Void Magic draws from the Void realm, which is a manifestation of the unknowable nothingness that lies beyond and is the absence of magic itself. Those who wield Void Magic can unleash destructive blasts of raw void energy, create force fields, open portals to the Void to let its influence fester within the physical realm, and even summon Voidborns to serve their will.

Notable examples of Magicborns include Annie, who commands fire; Taliyah, who shapes earth; Zeri, who manipulates electricity; Seraphine, who senses and influences souls and emotions; Lux, who wields light; Sylas, who absorbs and replicates others’ magic; and Syndra, who channels overwhelming power through emotion.

By choosing this option, you begin with the same raw magical potential and inherent talent as characters like Lux and Taliyah.
objects.title: Magicborn (League of Legends)

addons.text:
The Blade of the Ruined King has absorbed a fragment of every Camavoran king who ever bore it, including Viego himself, and now that you have claimed the blade and become the Ruined King in full, those fragmented souls belong to you as well. They are not merely whispers or echoes but dormant wraiths bound entirely to your will, meaning you can reach into the sword at any moment and pull forth the knowledge, combat skills, tactical instincts, and courtly cunning of every fallen king who came before you, using their centuries of accumulated mastery as if they were your own memories. 

Beyond that, you can summon any of them as a spectral wraith fully loyal to you, armed with whatever weapons and armor they favored in life. While these summoned wraiths do not start at the full power they commanded when alive because you only possess a fragment of each soul, they are immortal just like you, reforming from the Black Mist whenever destroyed, and they grow stronger as you grow stronger, their skills sharpening as your dominion expands. The longer you hold the crown of sorrow, the closer each wraith returns to its living peak, until you command a ghostly army of Camavor's entire royal lineage, each king fighting at your side with the same grief-fueled immortality that you yourself possess.
addons.title: Old Camavor's Evil

objects.text:
You have inherited the crown of sorrow, the will of the mist, and the curse of a king who once tore the boundary between life and death. By claiming this power, you do not become a vessel — you become the Ruined King in full. The mist answers to no one but you. The blade sings with grief. And your soul is no longer bound by time, mercy, or mortality.

The Black Mist is your body now, an extension of your mind and pain. It crawls across the battlefield at your command, swallowing light, corroding magic, and silencing divine influence. Within it, your enemies grow weak and disoriented, while you sharpen. The mist pulses with forgotten memories — fragments of voices, names, regrets — and it whispers to you truths only the dead should know. Through it, you see hidden paths, invisible spells, and the heartbeat of every living thing. The fog is not a tool. It is your kingdom.

When enemies fall before you, their deaths are not endings — they are invitations. You may briefly wear the form of the fallen, absorbing echoes of their strength, fears, and final thoughts. You do not mimic them. You mourn them. Their skills become yours, their memories spill into your mind, and your own body becomes incorporeal mist, watching from the edge of the realm like a predator in fog.

But what truly fuels your dominion is not conquest. It is loss.

Each time a bond is broken — an ally slain, a relic shattered, a vow betrayed — you grow stronger. Rage and grief mix in your veins, becoming spectral fire that burns through armor and resistance alike. Your strikes become faster, your movements blur, and your senses open to the invisible wounds of others. You see the scars that words left behind. You hear the heartbeat that quickens when guilt takes hold. You do not simply strike the body — you strike the weakness it hides.

And when the moment comes, when you are ready to unmake what remains, you may invoke the Final Ruination.

The world fractures. The terrain bends to your sorrow. Phantom castles rise from the soil. Shadows of forgotten warriors rally to your side. You become fully mist — no longer flesh — and dart through reality like a broken memory, unstoppable and intangible. With the Blade of the Ruined King in hand, you execute all who resist, erasing them not just from the battlefield, but from the world’s memory. And those who escape your grasp are not spared. No. They are marked. Haunted. Cursed. Each night they sleep, they will see you again, and each time, it will be worse.

This is Ruined King. Not a power, but a sovereign state of being — the fusion of love that defied death, sorrow that broke the world, and a will too strong to pass on. You are no longer simply alive.

 You are the Ruination.
 You are the blade, the mist, the memory, the monarch
objects.title: Ruined King (League of Legends)

objects.text: Having mantled the legacy of Veigar, the Tiny Master of Evil, you are now following in his footsteps to becoming the most evil villain ever! His legacy grants you a multitude of physical and magical benefits. Such that you are now a spiritual being akin to a yordle in essence, unable to be permanently killed by normal means, and aging incredibly slowly. You also gain Veigar’s mental repository of all his Runeterran spiritual, elemental, celestial, and primordial magic. His knowledge of these arts allow him access to many spells and abilities, such as throwing bolts of dark energy, trapping foes within the timeless infinites between moments, summoning meteors of dark matter from the sky, and even recreating primordial bursts of destruction through the combination of multiple magics. However, the crown ability of Veigar that makes him such a force of nature, is his innate ability of Phenomenal Evil, which permanently increases your raw magical potency whenever you hit an enemy with any of your spells or abilities.
objects.title: Phenomenal Evil (League of Legends)

addons.text: You possess the ability to combine the powers of a dragon and a god. This halts your transformation into a dragon and allows you to wield both Dragon Slayer Magic and God Slayer Magic together, allowing you to combine the two for greater effect and more potent attacks.
addons.title: Dragon God Slayer Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text:
Your essence as an Ancient Dragon has significantly enhanced the potency and expertise of your Dragon Slayer Magic, elevating you to a status comparable to that of dragon kings like Igneel or the five-dragon god.

You also now possess the transformation magic that the Dragon God uses to transform into human form.

Furthermore, you are no longer confined to a sole element for your Dragon Slaying Magic; you can explore and master other elements beyond your initial one. This grants you the potential to become like Acnologia, who can consume/resist any form or type of magic.
addons.title: Dragon King

addons.text: By combining Super Archive Magic with Dragon Slayer Magic, you have awakened a new and powerful attribute: Law (法, Hō). This attribute grants you a deep connection to the information of the world itself, allowing you to perceive, analyze, and manipulate the very fabric of magic. You can tap into hidden knowledge, instantly understanding magic, history, and unseen truths. This allows you to suppress enemy spells, absorb and store vast amounts of information, impose magical restrictions on others, and even rewrite the laws of magic itself. With this fusion of raw draconic might and limitless data processing, you have become a living archive of magical law, capable of issuing binding commands that enforce absolute rules upon reality.
addons.title: Law Dragon Slayer Magic (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Despite its name, Dragon Slayer Magic is not magic created to slay dragons; it is the magic of dragons. Choose one element (fire, water, ice, lightning, etc.) to become your element, and you gain immense resistance to it to the point where only a superior wielder of your element can harm you.

For instance, a Fire Dragon Slayer can swim in lava with no issue. You can consume your element to regain your reserves and give yourself a temporary boost in power, but this power is not without costs. You will slowly but surely transform into a dragon and slowly but surely lose contact with your humanity. Even if you possess the ability to transform into a humanoid form, you will not be able to enjoy the pleasures you enjoyed as a human.
objects.title: Dragon Slayer Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text:
The divinity in your Blood has empowered the divine magic you wield due to fueling it with actual divinity, even as said magic stimulates the growth of said divinity and provides direction for said. 

Furthermore, in a manner similar to the transformations induced by other Slayer Magics, usage of God Slayer Magic accelerates your transformation into a God, with the added benefit of becoming a God of whatever element your Slayer Magic is.
addons.title: Rising Divinity

objects.text:
You have attained the elemental abilities of a god. Choose one element (fire, water, ice, lightning, etc.) to become your element. Your element will become darker, either becoming black or merely being tinted black. You can consume your element to regain your reserves and boost yourself.

If you are a Sky God Slayer, you can heal yourself by consuming air. You can also consume your element from a Dragon Slayer of the same element, but a Dragon Slayer cannot consume your element unless they completely empty themselves.
objects.title: God Slayer Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of the magic to create Etherious and the magic of demons has undergone an unforeseen synergy and transformed you, shedding the need to fear Devil Slayer Magic’s transformation into a demon because you already are one.

You are an Etherious, with your own Curse perfectly suited towards your nature. Furthermore, your Devil Slayer Magic gains the attributes of a Curse as well, serving as a sort of hybrid magic, part-Curse and part-Magic, with all the benefits and none of the downsides.

Lastly and most impressively, your nature as both a creator of Etherious and an Etherious yourself has given you the ability to use the Curse of any Etherious you create, each one expanding your arsenal.
addons.title: Etherious

objects.text:
Similar to Dragon Slayer Magic and God Slayer Magic, you choose one element (fire, water, ice, lightning, etc.) to become your element and become immune to it. This immunity can be overpowered, and you can consume your element to regain your strength and get a temporary boost.

You can gain information about any demon or devil you see by observing them for a couple of seconds. You can do the same with curses and curse magic. You're also capable of killing demons by using your magic. But all of this power comes at a cost. You will begin to transform into a demon. If you're able to master Devil Slayer Magic, you're able to halt the demonization and allow you to call upon a transformation to boost your physical strength and speed.
objects.title: Devil Slayer Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text: Having a complete and comprehensive understanding of every creature that has ever existed on Earth gives you an extra type of Take Over Magic focused on animals. Being the avatar of all fauna instantly elevates you to the master of this magic, allowing you to rapidly switch between transformations in both partial and full forms. By further practice, you can also expand into mythical animalistic creatures like harpies and kitsune, giving you powers beyond mundane animals.
addons.title: Take Over: Animal Soul

addons.text:
Thanks to your cursed energy, you obtained an Innate Technique based on your magic that allows you to Take Over the cursed spirits you defeated. You will also receive your first form with an unnamed cursed spirit based on yourself, which, if you are transformed, will amplify the power of your other techniques and boost your cursed energy. This will allow you to utilize the Innate Techniques of other cursed spirits you transform into, but you are limited to your current form’s techniques.

You can also use this technique on other creatures of a similar type to cursed spirits, like ghosts, hollows, shikigami, etc.
addons.title: Take Over: Cursed Soul

objects.text: You learn the basics of the Take Over caster magic; this will also unlock your Ethernano container, which allows you to generate and store magic power regardless of your current location. This magic allows the user to, essentially, "take over" the power of another entity and then transform themselves into the embodiment of said entity. Your transformation can be partial, like only transforming your limbs, or a complete transformation, but in most cases, it will result in an anthropomorphic form, which is a mix between your own body and whatever you used your magic with. Most mages only focus on a single type of Take Over Magic, like Beast Soul, which focuses on beasts; Satan Soul, which focuses on demons; or Machina Soul, which focuses on machines. You will also start as a beginner in a single type you can freely choose, which can be a non-canon type, but it must target a single type of entity, and eventually, you will be able to branch out and master multiple types of Take Overs if you wish to do so. To learn how to use your magic on new types of entities within your category, you must defeat and/or analyse them to a sufficient degree and touch them to record them into your magic. Your magic will consume your own magic power based on the power level of the entity you used Take Over with, so forms massively more powerful than your base capabilities will drain your reserves quickly, but it is also possible to keep weak forms up for an extended period.
objects.title: Take Over Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text: With the ability to breathe life into the lifeless creations you materialize, you now have a method to bend, if not outright break, the first limit of Arc of Embodiment Magic, so long as you pay the right price of lifeforce or inner energy. This has eased up on the second limit as well, allowing you to materialize golems modeled after people or creatures who are still alive and animate them that way. The third limit remains unbroken and must still be followed.
addons.title: Imaginary Factory

addons.text:
When you awaken your creations, like how you would a golem, the newly awakened Aura of your creations now makes them more like living beings rather than soulless objects.

They will eventually be able to act and speak for themselves, having been given a spark of personality that will slowly grow over time.

Despite this, they will still follow your orders as they normally would, as you are their creator.

If it wasn’t already broken, the first limit has now been completely bypassed using these methods, and the second is inconvenient at worst. While some of your creations can awaken a Semblance that lets them manipulate powers, ultimately, you have no sort of control over what Semblances they gain whatsoever. Other than that, the third limit remains as is.
addons.title: Spiritus Vitae

objects.text: Arc of Embodiment Magic is a Lost Magic that utilizes your own imagination, allowing you to materialize anything you can imagine, so long as you have sufficient magical energy to create them. The more powerful the item or the potential it has, the more energy is required to make it. From objects to weapons, and to an extent, even creatures or people. A magic like this, of course, has a few limits to its usage. Along with this Lost Magic, you have unlocked your Ethernano container, which allows you to generate and store magic power regardless of your location. Firstly, while you can conjure beasts, creatures, and people, you are unable to conjure anything that can truly be considered as alive.
