For example, you can create a dragon that can use a type of magic, but for all intents and purposes, it is closer to an object than a living being. It is unable to truly speak for itself and follows your orders to the letter. It is without a soul, no matter how close to life-like you make it. If someone has the power to possess objects, then they can possess anything you make using this magic. Secondly, you are unable to create a 1:1 replica of a specific person or creature that is still alive. You can make a generic person, or even a creature you dreamt up that has a name, but you are unable to make a replica of your friend, or your cat specifically. If your friend or cat is dead, then it’s fair game, but the first limit still applies. Finally, while you can make something that stores or boosts your magic power, you are unable to make anything that can manipulate, erase, or otherwise mess with a person’s type of magic or power(s). For example, you could make an item that can disable people’s usage of magic for a limited time, but you are unable to make a power that outright erases them or changes the way those magics work or express themselves. If you do not have enough magical power to materialize something, you can bargain with your magic to get the energy to make it, but in exchange for losing something for a set time. You can exchange many things, such as your ability to use your magic, your physical strength, your sight, your hearing, your intelligence, etc. You can even exchange esoteric or intangible things, such as your luck or some of your memories. Note, however, that exchanging just one thing may not be enough to pay the price. You may have to exchange more than one of these if you wish to create a truly powerful object, if you do not have the magical power to materialize it yourself. The more magical energy you do not have to materialize the thing you wish, the more you will have to give up to do so.
objects.title: Arc of Embodiment Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text: Thanks to Infinity, your magic has evolved, making every change real instead of a temporary magic effect. This will also allow you to stack its effect, as every change you make is just a new default state, albeit with a limited maximum and minimum size depending on your mastery of said magic.
addons.title: Permanent Transformation

objects.text:
You learn the basics of the Command T caster magic; this will also unlock your Ethernano container, which allows you to generate and store magic power regardless of your current location. This magic allows you to temporarily increase or reduce the size of anything while also affecting its mass. With practice, this can affect parts of an object or being separately, so you could only reduce the size of a wound, increase the size of their head, or even collapse an entire island by changing the size and mass of its parts. This magic can also be surprisingly lethal, as it could easily rupture organs by simply expanding their size.

In its basic form, magic is only used for “reduction” or “expansion,” but it also has a third technique called quality of magic power, which allows you to combine it with other magics to reduce and/or expand their effects and capabilities, which would allow you to transform a simple fireball into a city-sized ball of inferno.

This magic has limitations on its duration, only working for about 3 minutes after application, but this can be increased via training.
objects.title: Command T Magic (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
You have gained basic knowledge of the Black Art that allowed Zeref and Faris to create their Etherious Demons.

To begin, Etherious are a subspecies of artificial demons that are comprised completely of Ethernano and loyal to their creator. Additionally, Etherious, instead of using magical energy, is powered by a form of non-magical energy called Cursed Power. As for their appearance, Etherious tend to have two forms, being their book form and a demonic-looking Etherious form, although some can learn to take a human form by restricting their Cursed Power. Notably, an Etherious’s creator can forcibly switch which form they are currently in by a mere gesture.

The Cursed Power of the Etherious grants them two abilities of regeneration and their Curse. All Etherious possess the ability to rapidly regenerate by expending some of their Cursed Power, with those capable of human form able to completely regenerate from their wounds when switching between human and Etherious forms. An Etherious’s Curse is their own unique ability powered by their Cursed Power, and can manifest in all sorts of forms, such as perfectly cloning oneself, creating explosions on contact, killing music, necromancy, and even sensation amplification.

It should be noted that Etherious are capable of growth, as seen by the Etherious guild Tartarus and its leader Mard Gear, which developed a method to resurrect slain Etherious, a method to turn humans into demons, and a spell to potentially overcome Zeref’s immortality.

As for how one may create an Etherious, the known process is that the creator must write a book in Demonic Scriptures using their own magical energy about the information for said Etherious and how to manifest them.

This does lead to this Black Art’s trade off that the lives of any Etherious created are linked with their creators, so should their creator perish they all shall as well.
objects.title: Black Arts - Etherious (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
You have learned the basics of Crush Magic, which has a side benefit that has unlocked your Ethernano container, which will allow you to store and generate magical power regardless of your current location.

This magic allows the user to smash and crush anything they come into contact with, often into many cubed pieces. The power of this magic can even be used to nullify some spells by smashing them to pieces. Furthermore, it can even affect living beings with lethality depending on the caster’s intent, ranging from temporarily splitting the target into many weaker chibi versions of themselves to breaking them into pieces.

It should be noted that skilled users of this magic can use it for either more precise or larger-scale actions, such as enhancing one’s striking force to send foes flying, being fired as a short-ranged attack, forming a defensive barrier, and even smashing mountains and valleys apart.
objects.title: Crush Magic (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Archive Magic is a rare and advanced form of data-based magic that allows the user to convert information into magical data for storage, retrieval, and transmission. With this ability, the user can access vast amounts of information, even including historical records and personal profiles that may not be commonly known. This magic is relatively new, making it rare among mages.

At its core, Archive Magic enables the user to create and manipulate holographic magic screens, which serve as both an interface for information processing and a medium for magical attacks and defenses. More advanced users, such as Hibiki Lates, can use Archive Magic for telepathic communication, data transfer, and real-time tactical support. However, overloading an individual with too much information at once can cause severe mental strain.
objects.title: Archive Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text:
By integrating Super Archive Magic with Memory-Make, your mastery over information and memory reaches unparalleled levels. No longer limited to just personal recollection, your mind becomes a magical database—capable of storing, categorizing, and retrieving not only magic you've seen, but magic you've read about, sensed indirectly, or even heard described.

You can now memorize spells and techniques without directly witnessing them, pulling from your vast mental archive built through sensory data, magical analysis, or transferred knowledge. Your ability to combine spells is greatly enhanced, allowing for more complex, refined, and stable results.

Additionally, "forgetting" magic now works at a higher tier—you can impose memory negation effects on others, making enemies forget their own spells or breaking illusions and mental attacks by erasing their foundation.

In essence, you’ve evolved from a memory manipulator into a living construct of magical knowledge, blending the analytical prowess of Super Archive Magic with the creative adaptability of Memory-Make.
addons.title: Memory Archive (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
An ancient and rare form of Molding Magic, Memory-Make grants you control over a unique "element": memory itself. With this power, you can memorize any magic you witness and reproduce it as your own, much like Mimic magic—but with a critical difference: you can combine memorized spells into entirely new creations, blending their effects in innovative and devastating ways.

You also gain an exceptional memory capacity, allowing you to track enemy heartbeats, footsteps, and magic signatures with ease. This ability extends to combat, where you can create afterimages of yourself—illusory projections based on memories used to confuse or distract enemies.

Memory-Make also enables you to "forget" enemy spells that you've memorized, rendering yourself immune to them. If you've seen it once, it will never work on you again.

While wielding this power, you adopt a signature stance—fingers pointed to your temples—calling forth spiraling memory glyphs that swirl around you like echoes of thought. However, the magic’s only true limitation lies in speed: if an opponent’s spell is cast too quickly, you may not be able to capture and memorize it in time.

A favorite of skilled tacticians, Memory-Make is a terrifyingly adaptive magic that rewards quick thinking and deep focus.
objects.title: Memory-Make Magic (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
You have learned the basics of Enchant Magic, which has a side benefit that has unlocked your Ethernano container, which will allow you to store and generate magical power regardless of your current location. Enchant Magic is a versatile form of caster magic centered around the application and manipulation of traits, properties, and connections. At its most fundamental level, Enchantment means taking something a target does not naturally possess and making it part of them. 

Transferring your magical power to an object is the simplest example, but the same principle can be applied to physical characteristics, magical abilities, concepts, identities, and other properties. Dragon Slayer Magic, for example, is the result of enchanting the properties of a Dragon onto someone. This makes Enchant Magic extraordinarily flexible. You can enhance or alter physical attributes, empower weapons and allies, transfer or combine Magic, apply concepts and properties, modify bodies or personalities, and separate unwanted qualities or Magic from their hosts. 

With sufficient mastery, these principles can be extended beyond individual targets or small groups to affect anything they see fit within range; the air, terrain, weather, and even entire landscapes. The strength and scope of an Enchantment depend on your magical power, skill, and understanding of what you are attempting to apply, with more complex or abstract Enchantments requiring considerably greater mastery.
objects.title: Enchant Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text: You can now create the myriad forms of Magitech that exist in the Guilty Gear universe, as well as the banned Black Technology of states like Zepp or the pre-war United States.
addons.title: Black Technology

objects.text:
You now have direct access to The Backyard and can manipulate its energy into the five elements (Fire, Lightning, Water, Wind, and Ki) and the 666 known spells. The magic works by arranging up to 12 of the spells into a phrase written or spoken aloud to produce an effect depending on the context, number, and order of words, in some ways similar to programming.

You can research new spells, find new applications and approaches for your spells and magic, and invent combinations and synergies between them, as spells are just means created by humans to manipulate the energies of the Backyard.

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Backyard Magic (Guilty Gear)

objects.text:
You have undergone an infusion of specialized artificial magical stem cells, known as Gear Cells, transforming you into a modified organism commonly referred to as a Gear. These unique cells are metaphysically linked to a parallel dimension called The Backyard a mirrored plane of existence that serves as the blueprint and backbone of the universe. This enigmatic dimension holds the schematic of reality itself and contains a duplicate of the universe's energy, manifested as mana.

Through this connection to The Backyard, you gain extraordinary power. Though your Gear Cells are third-generation copies and weaker compared to the original prototypes, they are still far superior to those of the mass-produced Gears. These cells bestow numerous enhancements, including vastly improved physical capabilities, heightened senses, exceptional intellect, boundless stamina, accelerated regeneration, an endless lifespan, and a greatly expanded capacity for magic, along with a steady and continuous well of mana.

At the outset, your Gear Cells grant you remarkable physical prowess: strength sufficient to lift five tons effortlessly, building-level durability, and sub-sonic movement speed. Your regeneration allows you to instantly heal minor injuries and recover from severe wounds or even lost limbs within 24 hours. Additionally, your intellect has reached genius levels, your senses sharpen to near-superhuman precision, and your stamina becomes virtually inexhaustible. Your mana pool expands significantly, with the ability to fully replenish your reserves within a single day.

Over time, the Gear Cells will naturally multiply within your body, gradually enhancing their effects. This process reaches its peak over a decade under normal conditions but can be accelerated through rigorous training and combat. At their zenith, your abilities will increase tenfold, magnifying every enhancement to staggering levels.

Unlike other Gears, you are free from the mental instabilities often associated with these modifications. Your Gear Cells are perfectly stable and seamlessly compatible with your biology as if they were a natural part of you from birth. This stability ensures that your transformation is both powerful and harmonious, granting you unparalleled potential without the typical drawbacks of such enhancements.
objects.title: Third Generation Gear (Guilty Gear)

addons.text: You gain the knowledge and expertise of a Law Magus, allowing you to use Karma to your advantage, be it helping you accumulate it, turning the Laws against your enemies or creating institutions where you can decide the Laws yourself. Through firm declarations, oaths, amnesties, pardons and permissions you can use and abuse the Laws of magic to your advantage, where even the vilest of crimes can be turned into an act that grants you karma. Due to already starting out with good karma you can unbalance the scales slightly to your favor and still win out, allowing you to disregard the normal rules a tad more shamelessly.
addons.title: Law Magus

addons.text:
Once per day you get teleported to a different Realm, you’re stuck there for at least an hour, at which point you can return through an intuitive ritual. Though the initial destination will always be safe, this safety will rarely last. Due to your nature as a Practitioner you have gained some control over this ‘talent’, as you traverse the Realms, finding new places and rediscovering forgotten ones, you can attune yourself to the Realms. Not all of them of course, instead you can choose a few and bind yourself to them, so that you’ll always teleport to one of the Realms you’ve chosen. Though the more you bind yourself to, the more diluted your Practice with each of them will become. Binding yourself to only one of them would lead to a strong connection, but in turn would lock you out of most other Realm Practices outside of their basic ones. 

After binding yourself to the Realms this way, you can choose to voluntarily enter them. As you explore them and spend time within, your ‘talent’ will start to become more controllable due to you accepting your role as a Realms Hopper, and in a few years you’ll gain enough control to treat it as a limited dimensional teleportation power. That doesn’t mean that your time will be boring, each time you teleport, be it before or after you’ve tamed your ‘talent’, you’ll find yourself in an interesting place. Where danger, treasure, knowledge or resources might be found. Due to a lot of Realms having arbitrary rules and being incredibly easy to die in, you’ll also have a Realm Practitioner's instinct, allowing you to survive at least the first few trips without being horrifically injured or killed and a sense for what kind of Realms you’ve entered.
addons.title: Semi-Reluctant Realms Hopper

objects.text: You are now a Practitioner, someone who has made their word inviolable through a pact made with the spirits of the world in return for magic. At the start, you have the Sight, which lets you trace connections and affect them in some small level. You will need to summon Others, supernatural beings so you can bargain with them for power so you can use larger types of magic. You will start off with knowledge on the basics and will intuitively figure out more. You can choose a type of Practice to begin skilled at, such as Dragonslaying or Diabolism.
objects.title: The Practice (Otherverse)

objects.text:
Also known as the "Beloved Child of the Night," a Sleigh Beggy is a rare type of human with the ability to both generate and absorb massive amounts of magical energy from their environment. This unique trait also gives them a natural affinity with fae and other supernatural creatures, who often view them as kin. Because of this connection, a wide range of supernatural beings—from the smallest spirits to the largest gods—might be inclined to listen to your requests.

However, there is a significant drawback to being a Sleigh Beggy. The overwhelming amount of magical energy you produce and absorb places great strain on your body, leading to illness and weakness. Unless you find a way to channel or release this energy, it will eventually break your body down, resulting in death.
objects.title: Sleigh Beggy (The Ancient Magus' Bride)

objects.text: Shapers are magical researchers who use magic to shape biology to create life. They are often arrogant and egotistical because of this, as they can literally shape life into existence. Now you too can do this using essence to form creations, and while you start off unrefined and only able to support up to three creations before the psychic link that shapers use to control creations breaks and you are unable to control the strain, eventually, with enough practice, you can shape creations that other shapers could only dream of. At the start, the strongest creation you can make would be three Fyora or something of equal strength; however, you can limit yourself to one strong creation equal to a single Glaahk.
objects.title: Shaper (Geneforge)

objects.text:
You have learned your True Name, which is the source of magic itself. Your True Name has been carved into your heart to protect it from being used against you. The powers conferred onto you as a result of you knowing your True Name grant you vastly heightened magical power, enhanced physical abilities, a highly capable form of magical adaptation, and greatly enhanced mental capabilities that aid in your usage of magic.

Over time, your power will grow and you will develop new abilities such as magical sight that allows you to understand magic, to grant magic onto other people, as well as anything that is in theory within the reach of magic. You are not restricted at all in what kinds of disciplines you wish to learn, and given time there is nothing truly beyond your reach.
objects.title: True Name (Skulduggery Pleasant)

addons.text: After the Conjunction of the Spheres, the world of The Witcher gained access to Magic, which was said to be the stuff of raw Chaos, and could be formed into various effects. This is not so far off from your manipulation of the Aethyr. With the little bit of extra information provided by your other powers, you have become a master of the magic of The Witcher universe, comparable to an elven Sage or notable human Mage.
addons.title: Lodge of Sorceresses

addons.text:
A Runesmith is a dwarven artificer who specializes in a unique form of magic known as Rune Magic. Unlike humans and elves, dwarves are unable to use magic in the same way. Instead, a Runesmith traps, binds, and harnesses the mystical energies, referred to as the Winds, within a rune of power to safely utilize this magic. Learning Rune Magic requires dedication, patience, and hard work—qualities that dwarves possess in abundance. You are knowledgeable of all the runes and the rituals needed to carve them, from the simplest rune to the mightiest. You also know of all the lore surrounding Rune magic.

There are four fundamental rules governing the dwarven art of Rune magic, as stated by the Guild. Some of those rules can be broken, but others must be respected at all costs, or the Runesmith may find their lives at risk.

1. The Rule of Three: A single magical item cannot have more than three runes inscribed on it. This rule is primarily a limitation of materials since it is nearly impossible to forge a substance capable of containing the immense magical power that flows through it.

2. The Rule of Form: Runes must be inscribed according to their specific categories. Weapon runes can only be placed on weapons, armor runes on armor, banner runes on standards, engineering runes on war machines, and talismanic runes on talismans.

3. The Rule of Pride: No two items can carry the same combination of runes. This rule also applies to the use of individual runes. Crafting runic items requires significant effort, and Runesmiths prefer not to duplicate their own work or that of their peers, except during their apprenticeships.

4. The Rule of Jealousy: No master rune may be used on more than one item within an entire Dwarf army, and no item can bear more than one master rune. Master runes are exceedingly powerful and cannot be combined with other master runes on the same item or used together on the same battlefield. Because of this, Runesmiths refer to these runes as "Jealous Runes."
addons.title: Dwarven Runesmith

objects.text:
The Winds of Magic are the invisible currents of arcane power blown into the world from the realm of souls and thought, otherwise known as the Aethyr or the Realm of Chaos. The Winds of Magic allow a wizard to use their willpower and mind to cast spells. As part of this your mind is enhanced enough to handle weaving all the winds of magic together. You start off proficient in one wind at the level of a Magister, and have potential enough to become a Lord Magister within a reasonable amount of time.

Be warned that while this form of magic is incredibly powerful it is also equally dangerous for the unprepared mind, for Aethyric predators, Chaotic or otherwise exist where emotions and thoughts exist.

The eight Winds are as follows: Aqshy, the Lore of Fire, Azyr, the Lore of Heavens, Chamon, the Lore of Metal, Ghur, the Lore of Beasts, Ghyran, the Lore of Life, Hysh, the Lore of Light, Shyish, the Lore of Death, and Ulgu, the Lore of Shadow.
objects.title: Winds of Magic (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You have the power of a Ether Gear, which is a kind of mechanical wizard. Your Ether flow has been altered inside your body to resemble a machine. This gives you the ability to control certain elements or even reshape machines. You can choose any kind of Ether Gear you like, from Machina Maker to Satan Gravity. Using an Ether Gear requires a lot of practice and is vulnerable to electromagnetic pulses.

Ether Gears are not easy to master. Most people need several years of training, but some are gifted enough to do it in just one month. Once they are activated, Ether Gears can evolve and unlock more abilities. Skilled used can reach Overdrive, an Ether Gearist can acquire a massive boost to their capabilities as well as being able to achieve feats with their Ether Gear they normally wouldn't have been able to. Along with this increase in power, the Ether Gearist also takes on a new appearance similar to that of a machine's; having three-dimensional lines of Ether surrounding their body and covering their skin. Overdrive can only be achieved when the user pushes their Ether to its critical point and is considered the ultimate power of an Ether Gear.
objects.title: Ether Gear (Edens Zero)

addons.text:
The name of the Ancient Language, to which all magic is bound, has long been forgotten. Those who learn this name can bend the language to their will—naming new things, altering the meanings of words, or even rendering words meaningless. With such knowledge, one holds the power to reshape the understanding of magic itself.

Now, with the Alpha Rune in your possession, you have gained access to this ancient knowledge. You can manipulate the Ancient Language at will, wielding its power to forge new spells, redefine meanings, and command the very fabric of magic.
addons.title: The Name of Magic

objects.text:
Gramarye is magic that grants its users the power to use their energy to manipulate the world around them. Magic is ultimately directed by a user's thoughts, but is usually cast through use of the Ancient Language, which was tied to magic by the Grey Folk. Every act of magic is corresponds to a specific word in the Ancient Language, allowing for a much more regulated command of magic. The impossibility of telling lies with the Ancient Language greatly reduces the chances of making mistakes over non-verbal casting of magic. The link between magic and the Ancient Language grants great control to those who learn the true name of someone.

The cost of casting magic is the expenditure of energy required to accomplish the task of the spell under mundane means. Usually this energy is drawn from the user, but practiced users can learn to draw energy from infused gems, or be supplemented with energy from other magicians. Proper knowledge can allow a magician to merely draw the required energy from their surroundings.

Magic allows a magician great capacity for affecting the world around them, limited only by their own knowledge and ability to supply the energy for their spells. You start with a basic knowledge and vocabulary of the Ancient Language. As you study and practice you will find yourself learning new words and phrases you can use to cast magic through.
objects.title: Gramarye (Inheritance Cycle)

addons.text:
Not all mages excel in close combat, which is why the Pactio system exists. This system consists of two roles: the Magister Magi and the Minister Magi. The Minister’s duty is to protect the Magister using their physical abilities and an artifact granted through the Pactio.

The Pactio allows the Magister to transfer a portion of their magical power to the Minister, greatly enhancing the Minister’s natural capabilities typically by a factor of ten, though this can increase depending on the Magister’s magical strength.

A Minister also gains a significant degree of protection from both physical and magical attacks through an energy field emitted around their body. The strength of this barrier depends on the Magister’s magical capacity

Forming a Pactio requires drawing a magical circle, with both participants standing inside it and exchanging blood. There are two types of Pactios, permanent: Which you may only have one of and temporary which you can form an unlimited number of though the actual number you can sustain depends on your magical power.

Another major benefit of a Pactio is the Minister’s ability to summon a magical artifact. Each artifact reflects the Minister’s personality, so artifacts differ greatly from person to person.

When a Pactio is formed, a card is created as proof of the contract. Copies can be made, but the original remains with the Magister. These cards allow for telepathic communication between the Magister and Minister. The Minister can use the card to communicate not only with the Magister, but also with other Ministers under the same Magister.

If the Minister is left on their own, they can use a copy of the Pactio card to borrow magical energy from the Magister.

Finally, the Magister can summon their Minister at any time using the incantation “Evocem Vos” (“Come Forth”), followed by the Minister’s name. This ability allows the Magister to instantly teleport the Minister across space.
addons.title: Pactio Maker

objects.text:
You gain an Innate knowledge and mastery of magic from the Negima manga series, immersing yourself in a world of extraordinary magic and advanced magical technology. This encompasses a deep understanding of spellcasting, mystical artifacts, and the intricacies of magical engineering. With this knowledge, you become a master magician, harnessing arcane forces and blending them with magitech to achieve remarkable feats.

Armed with this expertise, you possess the ability to cast powerful spells, manipulate elemental energies, and wield enchanted devices with precision. Additionally, you can merge magic with technology, creating innovative gadgets and inventions that enhance your magical abilities.
objects.title: Magister (Negima)

objects.text:
You gain a unique power of the royal bloodline of Vespertatia, White of Mars, which can negate all manner of magic aimed at the user and can negate the magic barriers of others, letting their attacks make contact.

This power can be used offensively as an extension of your body or weapons; you can form anti-magic walls and erase island-sized magic spells. At the beginning, you start with only the passive protection of White of Mars that surrounds your body.

White of Mars can be bypassed by powerful enough magic, as it exists as an energy within you; it can be improved over time with training.
objects.title: White of Mars (Negima)

addons.text:
Normally, possessing both White of Mars and Black of Venus would render you incapable of using even the simplest magic. However, you have mastered a technique known as Revolution, which allows you to generate and apply centrifugal force to both powers within you, separating their magical energies and enabling their coexistence, you can have this technique active subconsciously at all time.

With Black of Venus, you’ve gained complete control over your berserk form, granting the ability to enter and exit it at will. You can now tap into an inexhaustible well of energy drawn from the solar system itself, manifest massive demonic forms, or channel this boundless power for devastating attacks. Furthermore, you can absorb White of Mars as a spell through Black of Venus, amplifying your strength even further.

With White of Mars, You can now nullify magic at a distance, erasing spells you can perceive and even dismantling entire magical worlds, restoring the surrounding area to reality itself.
addons.title: Revolution

objects.text:
You now possess access to the powerful and forbidden spell Magia Erebea (Black of Venus). This technique allows you to absorb any spell and merge their essence into your own body even fusing with your soul. However, only one spell can be absorbed at a time, and it must be reabsorbed with each subsequent transformation.

When you absorb a spell using Black of Venus, it enhances your physical attributes and you gain unique magical abilities based on absorbed spells properties, this phenomenon is known as Armament.

Over time, this power can render you immortal and allow you to draw strength from the planet itself and eventually, the entire solar system.

However, Black of Venus carries a severe drawback: its corruptive nature, feeds upon your body and soul, thriving on negative emotions such as hatred, greed, lust, and vengeance. As corruption deepens, your body becomes overwhelmed by darkness, gradually transforming into a monstrous, partially reptilian form.

In this monstrous state, you gain vastly amplified physical prowess and magical power, manifested as a crest-like aura radiating from your body. Yet, you lose all sense of self, descending into madness and becoming a mindless beast driven solely by the urge to destroy everything in your path.
objects.title: Black of Venus (Negima)

addons.text:
You gain all the skills, abilities and magic of Ialda Baoth the Lifemaker, without her madness (You may also choose whether to inherit her memories and decide how they affect you). You become a master mage with absolute magic mastery, being able to create perfect mage constructs such as the Averruncus Series, who each wields perfect mastery in Elemental Magic.

You can now effortlessly endure the darkness of millions of people at once. With this strength, even ordinary spells become devastating artillery strikes. You have mastered the art of weaving the black mud into monstrous creatures and extending your consciousness through it across great distances. The Resonance also allows you to corrupt and brainwash enemies, binding them as loyal servants, or to forcefully link them to it and drive them insane.

Over time, with training and research, you will gain the ability to create an imaginary world outside of reality where you hold complete dominion. This realm can be shaped and influenced however you please. Within it, you may craft perfect replicas of people, complete with their powers, skills, and memories, and direct them to act exactly as you wish.

If you are ever killed, you can survive by possessing your killer, transferring your essence into them. At first, the victim retains control of themselves, but this respite is temporary. Inevitably, the Resonance will awaken within them, eroding their mental resistance until you completely take over.
addons.title: The Lifemaker (Negima)

objects.text:
Resonance is the cursed magic that Ialda Baoth the Lifemaker was born with. This is the power of infinite empathy; it constantly forces the user to experience the negative emotions of everyone and everything. Without careful control, it can easily drive one to madness. This power spans the entire universe and follows you into any new universe you enter.

Your version of Resonance does not carry the original curse; instead, it creates a channel to the greater Resonance, allowing you to draw power from it. However, the more you tap into this magic, the more you are forced to feel and empathize with the negative emotions of those around you, risking your sanity if you are not cautious.

You may disable this power at will, but the more you channel it, the wider its influence spreads. The negative energy gathered can be used in several ways: to enhance existing magic in a corrupted form, to convert negative emotions directly into magical power, or to manifest cursed mud that can be shaped by your will, capable of corrupting and brainwashing your enemies.
objects.title: Resonance (Negima)

addons.text: You're not just a mage, but a Spirit Arts User. This allows you to use Spirits, beings made of mana as gates to cast magic using the mana in the atmosphere. Each Spirit can come in one of six elements and start as lesser spirits which are balls of mana with no sense of self, to Quasi-Spirits who have a sense of self and more power, and finally Spirit which are evolved enough to speak and take on different forms. There is a form above this called Great Spirits that could be reached with enough time and accumulated power. You start out with 5 lesser spirits of each element and one quasi-spirit of your chosen color that will be completely loyal to you. If you will it you can set a location saturated with your mana that will call more lesser spirits to that location. Your affinity for your chosen element has given you a great enough spirit affinity that your corresponding spirit has the potential to reach Great Spirit status in at most 2 years. Each purchase of Additional Element will raise one of your initial spirits of the appropriate element to quasi-spirit rank and give them the same boosted potential for growth. Should you possess Elemental Spirit Bond then you gain an affinity for the elements Wind, Water, Fire, and Earth. Additionally, the elemental spirits of Elemental Spirit Bond count as Spirit-level spirits, as does the spirit of your chosen element.
addons.title: Spirit Arts User

addons.text:
You have gained the knowledge to make magical items called Meteors or commonly known as Metia. You're capable of making such things as mirrors capable of connecting to each other to allow contact, cloaks that hide the identity of anyone wearing them, capes that block one magic attack, even more powerful ones such as magic amplifiers or a cube capable of trapping people inside until they complete a set of trials.

With time and effort you can raise your skill to even crafting more powerful magical items on the level of the Ten Enchanted Swords or The Crystal Palace.

You also gain the knowledge on how to saturate crystals and ore with your magic to turn them into Magic Stones able to power your inventions.
addons.title: Metia Crafting

addons.text:
The adaptive and malleable aspects of your soul have led to it deciding to make beneficial changes to how you gain and use your magic and Od. Now, your Od does not risk lasting consequences from using it as mana, as your soul has modified itself so that it passively regenerates mana by converting excess Od into mana. You can still "burn" your Od in emergencies, but all this will do is slow down how fast your mana naturally regenerates, as your soul will be spending that time healing any lost Od. This doesn't stop the usual way of gaining mana from mana passing through your Gate.

Your Gate has also become more intelligent. Now, it has learned how to change the element of your mana when using spells more easily. What this means is that you can cast spells of the other five elements even if you didn't have them before. This does not make you the Color Mage of those elements or teach you all the spells, but it does mean you could potentially learn how to do them at an average or even above-average level.
addons.title: Smart Gate

addons.text:
Your chakra network and your magic have seamlessly integrated into one system. At the core of your pathways lies your indestructible Gate, which leads to your Od, with your pathways functioning as extensions of this system, taking the physical energy generated from every cell of your body and moving it into your Gate to be refined and transformed into a type of mana that also functions as chakra, before then sending it back out to circulate through your body.

Through this benefit, you will be able to learn all elements, even if you aren't the Color of them, and all jutsu no longer require hand signs—only the invocation of their name as an incantation, as they are treated as spells. 

Whatever element you are the Color of does not require knowing any jutsu's name and can be cast silently or through traditional spell names to aid in visualization. 

Lightning is a part of Fire, Wind, or Yang Magic, and you have the potential to learn combination elements like Wood or Lava by merging elements as one normally would with magic. 

Likewise, techniques and spells that would normally require chakra or mana specifically may now be fueled interchangeably by your unified energy, allowing the two systems to function as one without incompatibilities.

If you know how to utilize the Eight Gates, then the fact that your Gate and the rest of your pathways are now indestructible—and naturally, constantly enhance your body through the use of the Flow Method—means that the strain of using the Eight Gates has been reduced. As a result, the Gate of Death is unlikely to kill you, and eventually, its worst outcome may only be exhaustion.
addons.title: Prismatic Pathways

addons.text:
A curse doll is usually an individual who has a target's name engraved on them with a curse, causing them to lose their sense of self and gain semi-immortality until they kill the owner of the name engraved on them.

You're not the same as the average curse doll—there is no name engraving or loss of self. With this, you have extremely powerful regeneration that efficiently runs on both your mana and your stamina.

With this, you instantaneously heal major lacerations and regrow severed body parts in a short amount of time. You can even completely regenerate from having your entire body crystallized and shattered in under a minute. To many, you will seem like an unstoppable killing machine. But in actuality, your regeneration is dependent on your mana and stamina. Getting into a prolonged fight against a rival or greater opponent and taking multiple fatal or catastrophic injuries without a chance to restore your energy will eventually overwhelm your regeneration, leading to your death. Over time, this ability will become more and more efficient. Someday, you may even become a perfected curse doll who truly cannot die.

You can also use other supernatural energy to power your regeneration, but it won't be as efficient as mana or stamina.
addons.title: Curse Doll
Refined Gate
addons.text:
Your Magic Circuits have integrated with your Gate, allowing Color Magic to be structured into Formulae rather than only directly cast. 

You can design spells with predetermined instructions—such as conditions, delayed activation, automatic responses, changing behavior, or sequences of effects—which the spell follows after being released without requiring your continuous direction. 

With sufficient development, you could create persistent magical systems using your Colors, such as an area that automatically heals those you designate, flames that react to intruders, or barriers that alter their response depending on what strikes them.

Your Gate acts as the bridge that converts these Formulae back into Color Magic, while its connection to your Circuits also allows them to draw upon mana gathered through the Gate instead of relying solely upon your own life force.

objects.text:
You have gained a gate, an invisible portal-like apparatus that exists in every living thing. This allows mana to pass through the body and be stored in the Od, the life energy that dwells inside of all living beings which is synonymous with the soul. Unlike others of the world your gate will never break and your Od's capacity to store mana will continuously grow with use. Do note, you do not passively generate your own mana. Instead, you unconsciously gather mana from the environment. If there is no mana available, you can burn up your own Od as a last resort. Doing so is permanent and can reduce your lifespan. Overusing this method can completely burn through your soul. You won't die, but you will stop being "you" and become sick and weak.

Magic of the world of Re:Zero is separated into six elements, Fire, Earth, Wind, Water, Yang and Yin. Each element covers an array of effects, both the straight manipulation of their elements, Yin covering light while Yang controls darkness, and also more esoteric or symbolic effects associated with those natures, such as fire covering temperature, Water covering life and healing, Wind functioning outside of the bodies of living things, and Earth functioning inside of the bodies of living things. There is also some overlap between elements, with both Water and Fire magic being capable of involving the usage of Ice.

You possess a powerful affinity for one of these six elements, enough to be considered a Color Mage, the strongest mage of an element in the country. While a normal Water Affinity magician could heal most wounds of others, a Blue Color Mage could resurrect themselves from death once or twice a day at the same time as they heal several crews of badly wounded soldiers back to their optimal condition. Another example of high level magic would be a Black Color Magic using Yin magic to conjure black holes or banish people to other dimensions.

Magic is usually accompanied by incantations, usually two word phrases which dictate the strength and the spell in question. The basic incantations for each element are as follows; Goa for fire, Huma for water, Fura for wind, Dona for earth, Shamak for Yin, and Jiwald for Yang. The effects of Spells can be increased or altered by adding El, Ul, or Al, scaling in strength in that order. However, incantations aren't a definitive mark of strength, as even a simple Goa can burn down entire cities with enough power.

A side benefit of this magic is that practitioners unconsciously flow their mana through their body, which provides them noticeably superhuman physical capabilities.
objects.title: Color Mage (Re:Zero)

addons.text:
Your compatibility with your Witch Factor is absolutely perfect. Unlike Witches, Sage Candidates, and Archbishops, there is no risk of poor compatibility leading to a weakened Authority. In fact, you now have the option to choose how your Authority is expressed, as well as what weaknesses and limitations it may have. Whether it’s a well-known Authority like Return by Death or Greed’s Lion’s Heart and Little King combination, the choice is yours.

Because you are the perfect host for your Witch Factor, your Authority will naturally grow over time—either by increasing in strength, removing vital weaknesses, or even learning the different expressions of past wielders of your chosen Witch Factor.

When you share your Witch Factor with apostles, you can still use its full strength without worrying about it being weakened. Additionally, both you and your followers or apostles gain the ability to control the amount of miasma you passively release. This miasma can cause sickness, madness, or even death to anyone weaker than you within a certain range. Another unique trait of miasma is that it allows you and any cultists you command to sink into your shadows, enabling moderate-range teleportation.

With time you will eventually become a Calamity that threatens the world as Satella did.

If you possess the Sage Candidate, this will also enhance any additional Witch Factors you purchase.
addons.title: Great Calamity

addons.text:
You can generate miasma. Miasma is invisible, contaminated mana that exudes from those who have a Witch Factor or are connected to them.

You can choose when to generate it or not. When you do, it can be used to enhance your magic or authority, depending on how much you have accumulated or how much is in the area. But this comes with the drawback (or benefit) that miasma is typically harmful and deadly to nearly everyone else who isn't you, a fellow witch, or an apostle. In small doses, it won't do anything, but in increasing amounts, it contaminates someone's soul, causing them to vomit or be driven homicidally insane. With large enough amounts, it will kill anyone and anything in an area unable to handle the effects.

This also indirectly makes it difficult for similar such things to corrupt or harm you.
addons.title: Miasma

objects.text:
You have come into contact with the mysterious Witch Factor turning you into one of the Witches of Sin. Witch Factors are the antithesis of Od Laguna and you have gained an Authority from by coming in contact with it. This Authority grants you the right to interfere with the World and gives you a power based on your desire; however, you have no control over what kind of ability is born out of your "sin". An Authority user also has the ability to share their Witch Factor with other individuals, and those who receive them become known as an Apostle. However, this comes at the cost of weakening of your own Authority's effectiveness until all your shared Witch Factor is returned.

You can choose one of the following sins: Sloth, Greed, Gluttony, Wrath, Lust, Pride, Envy, Vainglory and Melancholy.
objects.title: Witch of Sin (Re:Zero)

addons.text: Your nature as a sun infuses your magical abilities gained from Sunshine, you are now always at your peak, perpetually at Noon, as long as you allow it, for you can dampen and raise your magical power as you please. Furthermore your flames and heat enter a new level, as the combined magical powers of a sun and the magical properties of sunshine enhance each other exponentially.
addons.title: Eternal Sunshine

addons.text:
Your nature as a Seraph has resonated with the Divine Grace known as Sunshine, created by the supreme Goddess of the Goddess tribe. This has granted you the strength, power, knowledge, and skill of Mael (which includes the Goddess Clan's magical abilities he had the ability to use and had mastery of), the strongest of the four Archangels. 

Your mastery of Sunshine now allows you to accomplish feats such as creating an intense ball of sunlight—so strong it can be mistaken for noon, even if only one or two hours have passed—and fighting the Original Demon on even ground, along with Zeldris, two demons second only to the Demon King himself in power. 

This mastery of Sunshine ultimately allows you to use its power more efficiently and with greater control, preventing environmental damage while bringing out its full potential, which could potentially allow you to defeat the Demon King or even the Supreme Goddess in a fight.
addons.title: The Strongest Archangel

objects.text: Your current form and power is no longer your maximum. Rather, it is your new minimum. At night, just after dusk and until dawn, you are as you are now. But the moment Dawn breaks, you begin to grow in power, magic, size and pride. As time progresses towards dawn, you will grow stronger and stronger, physically and magically, as well as more and more of a paragon of your race in appearance. You will begin to give off waves of light that are so hot that they can easily melt even the armour of a holy knight or gather this light into a miniature sun in your hand. When the sun hits its’ noon point, you will enter the state known as The One, a form so powerful that anything short of the Demon King himself is essentially powerless against your might, as well as having grown to gargantuan sizes in comparison to your original form. During the day, the burning light that emanates from your body will also suffuse your soul, affecting any who try to attack or devour it. This power will begin to leave you as the day turns from Noon towards Dusk, finally disappearing entirely as night falls and awaiting until the next day. You also gain the Divine Axe Rita if you wish it.
objects.title: Sunshine (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
Full Counter allows its wielder to reflect attacks aimed at them at more than double the power back at their attacker, with the strength of the user's power increasing in direct proportion to the strength of their opponent's abilities. Your "perfected" version allows you to also deflect both "magical" and "physical" attacks. It is important to note that your ability would not be effective if you are unable to read the nature and timing of your opponent's attacks.

To use this power effectively, your reaction speed and kinetic vision have been significantly enhanced beyond your original baseline. As a result, even as an ordinary human, you could effectively use Full Counter against attacks moving as fast as a speeding bullet.
objects.title: Full Counter (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text: Crisis is a magic power wielded by the Original Demon, enabling the user's abilities to exponentially increase as they suffer injury or take damage. As the user's death approaches, their power level rises accordingly, providing them with a final burst of immense strength and abilities.
objects.title: Crisis (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text: You have inherited the Demon King's strongest technique, The Ruler. This technique allows you to "invert" all attacks and effects of powers used against you. Any attack against you will no longer harm you, instead it will heal you, while any attack meant to weaken you will instead strengthen you. However, as it works on the concept of magic inversion, it is not without it's own drawback, as any magic meant to strengthen you or increase your power will instead weaken you, while any magic meant to heal you will damage you instead. You can easily overcome this weaknesses by deactivating your power.
objects.title: The Ruler (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
Magical Powers are mysterious and supernatural abilities unique to their wielder, allowing them to perform extraordinary techniques. These powers are often categorized into offensive, defensive, and support abilities, each playing a role in combat or various aspects of life.

A person’s magical power can be quantified using specialized tools, such as Balor's Magical Eye, which measures their overall strength. The total Power Level of an individual is determined by combining their magical power, physical strength, and willpower. This aura, or magical presence, can be sensed by others. Some individuals are born with inherent magical powers, while others may awaken them later in life through significant events or trials. Magic is not static; it grows and evolves with training, time, and personal development.

The source of magical power lies within an individual’s will, beliefs, and experiences, often manifesting in ways that reflect their character. In rare instances, magical power can be inherited and passed down through generations, sometimes re-manifesting in descendants after a predecessor's death. The nature of magical power typically shapes the wielder's strengths and weaknesses.

Magical powers can also come from external sources such as research, experimentation, or through inheritance from specific races that possess shared abilities. For example, the Giant Clan’s Creation, the Goddess Clan’s Ark, and the Demon Clan’s Power of Darkness are abilities tied to their entire races, yet individuals from these clans may still develop their own unique powers.

As a wielder of Magical Power, you can either choose your unique ability or select from the setting’s pre-existing powers, such as Ban’s Snatch, King’s Disaster, or Gowther’s Invasion. However, you cannot select powers that are already in the CYOA. You start with a Power Level of over 1,000, and through rigorous training and experience, you can ascend to new heights, unlocking the full potential of your magical prowess.
objects.title: Magic Power (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
You have received one of the Demon King's Commandments, a set of ten decrees created after he split half of his power into ten fragments and bestowed them upon the most elite warriors of the Demon Clan. Each Commandment carries a specific rule and grants its user great magical power, and anyone who breaks the Commandment's rule is subjected to a curse of absolute power—even the holder of the Commandment is not exempt. However, those who bear a Commandment are immune to effects of all others except their own.

The Commandments and their effects are as follows:

Faith: Anyone who shows a lack of faith will have their eyes set ablaze.

Love: Anyone who harbors hatred in their heart will be unable to harm another.

Pacifism: Anyone who kills will have their remaining lifespan rapidly drained, causing them to age swiftly and die.

Patience: Anyone who shows intolerance toward pain will be inflicted with even greater pain.

Piety: Anyone who turns their back on the wielder will become an obedient servant of the Demon King and, by extension, the Commandment’s holder.

Purity: Anyone who commits impure acts will be afflicted with illness.

Repose: Anyone who fights without rest will have their magic sealed.

Reticence: Anyone who reveals hidden feelings or emotions will be rendered unable to speak.

Selflessness: Anyone who desires another person will lose their memories, emotions, and sense of self.

Truth: Anyone who lies or breaks their word will be turned to stone.

A curse can also only be lifted if the victim defeats the wielder of that decree or upon the victim’s death, and the Commandments themselves possess a degree of sentience, though they can't act independently. In addition, absorbing a Commandment transforms any member of another race into a demon. However, if a member of the Goddess Clan absorbs one, it will gradually corrode their soul due to the opposing nature of their powers.
objects.title: Commandments (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
You possess proficiency in Tier Magic, granting you the ability to cast spells up to the 3rd tier, the knowledge of magical theory required to craft your own spells, and the ability to use metamagic to alter known spells on the fly when you cast them. Furthermore, when you initially acquire this power, you gain knowledge of 4 spells of your choice per tier as well as 6 cantrips (0th tier utility spells) to get you started.

You have various means to unlock further tiers of spells, including magical research, learning from mentors, and forming contracts with mystical beings. Once a month for the next two years, you can perform a powerful divination ritual to summon a grimoire which contains magical knowledge of your choice. This includes spellbooks with a small library of spells, between two and twelve depending on their tier, advanced theory for a discipline or school of your choice, or the means to contract specific spirits or beings. Studying spells from other magic systems and adapting them to work within the Tier Magic system is also within your capabilities.

Your mastery of Tier Magic extends beyond the confines of specific disciplines, granting you the ability to cast Arcane, Divine, or Spiritual spells from any schools provided you meet the requirements. Your magical reserve empowers you to cast 3rd tier spells over a dozen times per day and increases when engaged in magical activities. Furthermore, you gain the basic proficiency in enchantment and alchemy, enabling you to craft magic items and create potions.
objects.title: Tier Magic (Overlord)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use Wild Magic, an ancient or primal magic that existed in the New World long before the introduction of Tier Magic.

Wild Magic differs from Tier Magic, as instead of mana, it requires the caster to release souls in order for one to perform the casting of a powerful spell. In other words, Wild Magic was different from modern magic because it was powered by souls rather than needing mana to cast. Although the cost of spellcasting via Wild Magic is grisly, the results speak for themselves. The more beings or souls offered up as living sacrifices, the stronger the magic when released. However, using Wild Magic can also end up destroying the link to the user's own soul, as well as making the casting of stronger magic a risky gamble in and of itself.

On the other hand, Wild Magic cannot affect a World Item Holder or another user of Wild Magic, you can still indirectly damage them with Wild Magic.

To gain access to Wild Magic, one must possess the blood of a Dragon Lord, although you seem to be the sole exception to this rule. You can choose to pass this ability down through generations, but each descendant may find it increasingly difficult to utilize, requiring more souls with each passing generation.

Your magic remains untainted by the Player, making it easier to cast spells and even create enchanted items like Gazzef’s ring and sword. Additionally, you have the ability to passively collect souls, similar to the Coffin dragon lord Cure, without needing to be undead. This ability can grow in range over time.

Furthermore, you have learnt three Wild Magic spells, including Soul Breaker, which can extinguish souls and render resurrection impossible. The second spell, World-Warping Wall, preventing teleportation outside of the dome. Lastly, there is a mysterious Necromancy spell that can turn souls within range into mindless zombies. With practice and experimentation, you may learn even more Wild Magic spells.
objects.title: Wild Magic (Overlord)

objects.text:
You gain the Technological, Magical and Martial knowledge from the 4 Cut Hero comic.
You possess the ability to create anything that have shown, referenced, or hinted at being able to work in the comic.
This includes, but is not limited to: Curses, Buffs, Debuffs, Elemental, Healing, Magic, Summoning and other fantasy-hero genre media.

This also encompasses a deep understanding of artificial god creation, advanced EGO (castles, swords, ships, etc) production, to the martial Kelz Arts and Gathel/Balchad swordsmanship technics.

As a bonus, you instinctively know the basics, find yourself learning quickly, and will become incredibly fit to practice and use any and all magical and martial arts you can find.
objects.title: Zeed Toven (4-Cut Hero)

objects.text:
Your eyes are not normal eyes but the Alpha Stigma, a legendary Cursed Eye renowned and feared for its ability to analyze and comprehend all forms of magic. With this power at your command, you gain unparalleled insight into the intricacies of spells and magic itself, allowing you to instantly replicate, modify, and even create them with mastery. The Alpha Stigma is also known as "The Eyes of Destruction."

As a bearer of the Alpha Stigma, you possess the extraordinary gift of analyzing and copying magic. Through careful observation and comprehension, you can swiftly modify or use any spell or magical ability you see as if you had mastered it yourself. You do not need to see the full incantation or effect to know how to do it yourself. Through the potential of the Alpha Stigma, your ability to comprehend magic is absurd enough that by analyzing mana itself, you could even come up with new spells as magic just seems to "click" for you. Through your eyes' ability to comprehend and analyze all magic, you become extremely adept at learning or making magic regardless of how difficult such spells would seem for others. 

Any spell you cast will be at least double the strength of its expected strength when cast by anyone else while also being able to efficiently use the least amount of mana needed for a spell. Your eyes can also perceive hidden magical traps and dispel enchantments on buildings and objects.

If you ever feel the need to become more powerful, you have another stage for your eyes. You can temporarily power up into another state that enhances all your magic by orders of magnitude. This surge of power comes with the ability to analyze and deconstruct nearly anything, including objects or people.
objects.title: Alpha Stigma (The Legend of The Legendary Heroes)

objects.text:
Authority - Stigma bestows upon you a powerful tattoo, intricately woven from pure magical energy. This mystical mark grants you unparalleled control over its boundless power, enabling you to manifest any effect you can envision. Unlike traditional spellcasting, the Stigma's magic responds solely to your thoughts, eliminating the need for intricate spell structures or complex rituals.

The Stigma comprises five streaks of potent energy, which regenerate slowly over time. Every 6 hours, you regain one streak, ensuring a steady supply of power. Each streak holds immense potency, and even a single streak can enhance a mundane attack to possesses the capability to obliterate a magically fortified tower with ease. As time progresses, the potency of your abilities will gradually increase, allowing for even more extraordinary feats.

However, employing multiple stigma at once may result in a temporary sensation of over exhaustion. It is crucial to note that while the Stigma's power is unrestricted and can be harnessed in places where conventional magic is limited, caution must be exercised to avoid potential consequences.
objects.title: Authority - Stigma (The Novel's Extra)

objects.text:
As a Magician, you are intimately connected to the Wellspring, an internal well of limitless magical energy. This Wellspring flows through your very being, granting you the ability to tap into its mystical currents and unleash a versatile array of magical abilities.

Within the vast realm of magic, you have the opportunity to specialize in one of six unique Disciplines, known as "houses," each encompassing a distinct aspect of magical practice. These Disciplines include Physical Magic, Natural Magic, Illusion Magic, Knowledge, Healing Magic, and Psychic Magic.

Your chosen Discipline reflects your innate affinity and natural talents. It allows you to excel in a specific field of magic that resonates with your strengths and preferences. Whether you focus on the rare and specialized Quaeromancy, honing your ability to locate objects with unparalleled precision, or immerse yourself in the intricate realm of Horomancy, where time manipulation and glimpses into destiny await, your chosen specialization enhances your skills and effectiveness.

As you delve deeper into your chosen Discipline through dedicated study and practice, you unlock the full potential of your magical abilities. This dedicated mastery enables you to conjure spells and manifest magical effects with heightened potency and precision, establishing yourself as a formidable presence within your chosen field of expertise.

However, even as you specialize, your connection to the Wellspring ensures that you retain access to the broader spectrum of magical practices associated with being a Magician. This versatility ensures you possess a well-rounded repertoire of spells and abilities, bestowing upon you adaptability and the capacity to confront diverse magical challenges.
objects.title: Magician (The Magicians)

addons.text: Due to possessing multiple personalities, each personality will have their very own wish. But the amount of karma you have is split among everyone. You have no control over what they wish for and you cannot use their magic. Each personality also has their own outfit, unique magic, and weapon that reflect their wish and personality. But even then, you all share the same Soul Gem. Due to this, if you work together, it is possible to share each other's abilities.
addons.title: A Wish for Every Person

addons.text:
Instead of a single wish, you are given the unique opportunity to instead use a selected portion of your Karma to gain another Wish, as well as a unique Magic, weapon, and outfit of your choice, and can merge them together to be used in tandem similar to how Magical Girls are capable of enhancing each other with Connect. The used karma dictates how powerful that Wish and Magic are.
You don’t get additional Witches, your Witch just gets more powerful with new magic and abilities.
addons.title: Wishing Cycle

addons.text: You can store personal equipment in your Soul Gem to add to your Magical Girl transformation as well. This can range from swords, cloaks, a full set of armor, and so on. The equipment itself is only stored inside your Soul Gem to call upon whenever you want. Additionally, this space exhibits minor repair capabilities, capable of mending torn clothing, but not complex electronics or magitech. The amount of things you can store in your Soul Gem depends on how skilled you are with your Magic.
addons.title: Stored Form

addons.text: Your Karma and Wish protect you from all kinds of strange and esoteric forms of reality manipulation. You can remember things clearly that no one else can, such as people who have been erased from existence by the multiverse, events that have been changed by time travel, or things that have been erased from memories. The more Karma you possess, the greater you can influence how such cases may occur. If you possess a greater Karma than the source, you can even negate it entirely.
addons.title: Remember Us

addons.text: The theory of the cognitive revolution suggests that, in the distant past, humans underwent a brief but profound transformation, suddenly gaining the capacity to feel deeply and express themselves through stories—when they first possessed spirit and soul. While no one could explain why this occurred, you know the truth: humanity developed these capacities to proliferate the soul. From Homo Erectus, who lacked the ability to share stories or form complex relationships, to Homo Sapiens, who still struggled with conflict and distress, humanity has now evolved into Homo Magica. This new species transcended internal contradictions by erasing distinctions of race and gender, embracing an existence centered on universal empathy. They cultivated an unnatural cuteness—so extreme it induces unease in earlier humans—all for the removal of distress in interaction. They evolved solely to enhance tolerance, communication, and understanding. All of this was driven by a singular goal: to spread love, hope, and emotion—the soul. Like Kosane Kiriha, you have fused with the time railroad and the Kyubey inside your head. You are now the wellspring of infinite proliferation and possibility, existing across past, present, and future. You are the source of the soul within humanity, the force that allows humans to channel emotional energy as magic. And as such a being, you now wield the power to use magic with just as much potency as any wish a magical girl can have.
addons.title: Null Magical Girl

addons.text: Ignorance is bliss, yet Knowledge is power. If so, what is Grief? You can choose to store your regrets in your Soul Gem. These Regrets fester and compress into a stronger form of Grief that affects your mental state even more but take up much less space in your Soul Gem, about a hundredth of your capacity at the maximum. Adding more Regrets will only compress them further into that small space, intensifying your negative emotions. The more Regrets you accumulate in your Soul Gem, the more control you have over all of your powers. Complex magics that would demand immense precision can now be completed with a thought. Whenever you cleanse your Soul Gem, you can choose to ignore your Regrets and simply clean out the normal Grief. Doing this will increase the strength of your Regrets even further however, so make sure to clean them out at least once every two weeks. Cleansing a Regret will remove the negative emotions associated with the memory, so you cannot store the same Regrets over and over.
addons.title: The Need for Control

addons.text:
Following in the footsteps of the System Breaker herself, you have obtained control over Grief, the negative energy/corruption which accumulates in Soul Gems and comprises Witches, Labyrinths, and Familiars. In a radius of 100 meters you possess absolute authority over the movement and properties of Grief, such as barriers for defense, flying clouds of razor-sharp shards for offense, or even just pulling the Grief out of your Soul Gem to cleanse it without needing a Grief Seed. 

This ability to control the properties of Grief allows you to use it as a sort of wonder “meta-material” able to create seemingly any material or effect through the same principles as a Witch and her Labyrinth. Of course, these properties are not natural and dissipate once they leave your radius of control, so you are somewhat limited in scope, but within your range you can create almost anything your mind can imagine: fire, a working lightsaber, a healing staff, etc.

Of course what you can accomplish with this depends entirely on the amount of Grief you have to work with, with just the Grief produced by yourself you’ll need to be conservative with its usage unless you have a way to quickly produce more. Of course, if you were to have some way of creating more Magical Girls or Witches or where to go someplace which already has them, this limitation becomes a bit of a moot point.
addons.title: Adfligo Systema

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl, your soul is transformed into a Soul Gem that gives you magic. You can survive lethal wounds, but if the gem is shattered or corrupted, you die. Using magic or experiencing negative emotions darkens your Soul Gem with curses. But if it turns completely you will become a Witch, a being of despair. Your Soul Gem has a range of 100 meters from your body. You can also control your pain by adjusting the connection between your Soul Gem and body. Powers that protect your body also protect your Soul Gem.

You have the opportunity to make one wish. Your wish determines your unique magic, weapon, and strength based on your karmic weight and potential to change the world. Your karma can increase even in a time loop, merging fates with alternate timelines and increasing your karma. Your karmic weight also depends on how much SP you spend on powers and upgrades. The total karma you possess is 1/5th the amount of SP spent; additionally, any unspent SP will be converted to an equal amount of karma. If you have more than 150 Karma, you can rewrite everything in reality across time and space in the multiverse and become the Ultimate Magical Girl.

You can still grow stronger after creating your wish by learning creative ways to use your magic, enhancing your soul, or being an important individual that influences the fates of others. Unlike other magical girls, you will not lose karmic weight and magic as you grow older. You can create Grief Seeds to purify your Soul Gem from corruption, but it consumes energy and can darken it with curses. You need to balance creating and using Grief Seeds to avoid becoming a Witch.

(You can wish Endbringers or even Scion away based on the cost of End of the Kaiju or Overcharge Strike.)
objects.title: Mahou Shoujo (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
You gain a shroud called The Mist, a magical veil that distorts people's perception. 

This enchantment allows supernatural events to remain hidden from targets. Targets will perceive ordinary, mundane explanations instead of supernatural realities.

By manipulating the Mist, you can create illusions to hide or alter appearances, making yourself or objects invisible or look like something else. 

The Mist also allows you to alter or erase memories, ensuring that mortals forget encounters with the supernatural. Additionally, it can obscure or protect magical locations from being noticed or discovered by ordinary humans.

In addition to that, they can create Mistforms cards. Mistform Cards are three by five inch cards that allow who ever uses them to summon people and objects to their aid when needed. When done with the Mistform, one simply taps the card and the image returns. If used too frequently, they will burn up.

These are only basic uses of a beginner in Mist Manipulation, as later you will be able to learn other tricks such as Teleportation, Summoning and Banishing objects or people so long as you have a good understand of the places involved and Materialising objects at will from the Mist itself although they are fragile in the beginning.

Actively manipulating the Mist requires a strong will and mental focus. You will need training to master it effectively.

While this ability primarily targets non-magical humans, it can also affect individuals with supernatural abilities, though they may be able to see through the shroud depending on their own powers and talents. 

The Mist is especially effective at hiding knowledge that the ordinary mind cannot handle, often completely erasing such information from their memory and any memetic elements.
objects.title: The Mist (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of the Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei franchise, being able to create anything shown, referenced, or hinted at in the franchise. This includes Ancient Magic, Casting Assistant Device, Activation Rituals, Magic Sequences, Strategic-Class-Magics, Holy Relics, Magic Engineering, and so much more. You know everything that has to do with technology seen in The Irregular At Magic High School or in any of the canon materials.

As a bonus, you gain a Magic Calculation Area, Psion Emissions/Count, and Speed casting of a Ten Master Clans prince (or princess) of Rank A and one of each: -secret magic casting technique; -Non-Systematic-type Magic; -Outer-Systematic Type Magic;
objects.title: Magic Technician (Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei)

objects.text:
You are a beginner in one of the Ancient Magics, which can be any of the seven currently held in Tortus or the Calamity World. 

The seven Ancient Magics featured in the show are:

-Creation Magic (which can manipulate any inorganic material)
-Gravity Magic (which can manipulate the energy of a star)
-Spatial Magic (which can manipulate boundaries)
-Restoration Magic (which can manipulate time)
-Spirit Magic (which can manipulate the negative material possessed by living things)
-Evolution Magic (which can manipulate the information of existing things)
-Metamorphosis Magic (which can manipulate any organic material)

You have an affinity and talent for all forms of Magic that exist in Tortus, as every form of magic used in Tortus is, in some form, a degraded version of these Ancient Magics.

Acquiring all seven Ancient Magics also grants you access to Concept Magic, which is a combination of all known Age of Gods Magic.

Its main ability allows one to manipulate the laws of the world and impress concepts upon it. By elevating a powerful wish or desire with Spirit Magic and Evolution Magic, it can be raised to the level of a concept before being forcefully materialized with magical power.

As powerful as Concept Magic can be, its main drawback is the tremendous amount of magical energy it consumes, which could even kill the wielder if they do not have enough magical power to back up what they are trying to do.

Thankfully, the more concrete and understood the concept, the less mana it requires to perform Concept Magic.
objects.title: Ancient Magic (Arifureta)

objects.text:
A specific brand of underutilized magic hailing from a doomed world—Desir Arman used his skill in this type of magic to almost overcome insurmountable odds against a divine dragon that was engulfing the world in destruction.

You now possess greater skill than his in Analysis Magic, which effectively lets you hack, cancel, and reflect other mages' magic. Besides allowing you to modify existing spells in the local area, it'll also provide you the boon of copying new spells. The speed and efficiency at which you can perform this magic is unprecedented, leading you to become known as the sole 'anti-mage' of the era.

Your skill in Analysis Magic grants you incredible potential in all known and unknown forms of Meta-Magic, allowing you to modify spells in ways nobody else thought possible. Amplifying the strength, range, duration, and much more of a spell, altering a spell's casting time, casting requirements, and even elemental composition can be done with ease.
objects.title: Analysis Magic (A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special)

objects.text:
You possess a rather special magical power; not only can you copy the magical abilities of others in your vicinity, but you can also combine them in different permutations, stronger than the sum of their parts! Combining fire and lightning magic to make plasma magic, combining multiple different styles of air magic to compound and multiply their effects, and even combining two magics from different worlds into a new hybrid practice are all examples of what Copycat can accomplish.
