Copycat's duplicates are limited by your own raw magical strength; should you copy the magic of someone stronger than yourself, your versions of their abilities will be naturally be weaker than the originals, though this also means that if you copy a weaker opponent, you can use their powers more effectively than they can! Copycat also grants you the the knowledge of and skill with said copied magics that their original users had, preventing you from being stuck training it trying to catch up to the original, though this is also lost along with the magic if you discard it, unless you put effort to train it yourself.

You start out with a limit of three copied magics at a time and a copying range of thirty meters, both of which can be expanded with just training and time. Copied magic can be anything from all of someone's magical abilities to just a single spell as you wish, with the only limit being that it has to be from just one target at a time - no stuffing multiple peoples' magics in a single slot.
objects.title: Copycat (Copy Kitty)

objects.text:
You are able to cast cantrips that cost no resources to cast, but similarly, aren't particularly impressive. This catalog of cantrips initially has 100 cantrips. You are able to improve different aspects of each cantrip by focusing on the part you wish to improve while practicing. Mastering a Cantrip takes roughly 2000 hours. Once you've mastered a Cantrip you gain an appropriate passive ability that's always up and an active ability that supercharges the cantrip for one use at the cost of temporarily burning it out called your Overmagic.

Cantrips can be taught or enchanted into items at a 'lower' level than your level of mastery. You are able to develop metamagics through willingly limiting your usage of a specific facet of a wide variety of cantrips, forcibly limiting the durations of your cantrips can allow you to develop metamagics that extend the durations of your magic. This Cantrip Catalog rests in an internal pool of magic that used to develop more and new types of magic.
objects.title: Cantrip Catalog (Cantrip CYOA)

objects.text:
As the Master of Words, you possess an extraordinary power known as Word Mastery, which grants you unparalleled control over the mystical art of Word Magic. Allowing you to draw words with your fingers and bring forth the power of the word’s meaning into the world; e.g. Flame, which bursts the vicinity of the written word’s location into flames.

Your mastery allows you to effortlessly utilize advanced techniques such as Parallel Writing, Simultaneous Invocation, Range Designation, and Air Writing from the start. With Parallel Writing, you can inscribe multiple characters simultaneously, creating complex combinations and synergistic effects. Simultaneous Invocation enables you to activate and control multiple words at the same time, enhancing your versatility and strategic options. Through Range Designation, you gain the ability to specify both the effect and the area of your spells with precise control. And through the power of Air Writing, you can inscribe words into the air using your magical energy, allowing for contact-based activation or even shooting them like arrows. This versatile technique opens up new possibilities for long-range attacks and creative spellcasting.

Furthermore, you possess the unique ability to replicate the effects of any magic you know by invoking its name. Your deep understanding of Word Magic allows you to tap into the essence of other magical practices and recreate their effects, though the potency of these replicated spells depends on your own innate magical power.

Initially, you can effortlessly wield the power of up to a three-word chain, effortlessly connecting words to unleash formidable spells. However, mastering the usage of four-word chains and beyond requires dedicated training and further honing of your magical prowess. These advanced chains offer even greater power, range, and versatility.
objects.title: Master of Words (Konjiki No Wordmaster)

addons.text:
You're not an aspiring magician starting on your journey in learning how to wield and cast magic. No, you have the skills and knowledge—and if you wish, the appearance, memories, items, and being—of Le Fay Pendragon, descendant of Morgan Le Fay and Arthur Pendragon. This makes you a master magician capable of using Elemental Magic, Defensive Magic, Teleportation Magic, Summoning Magic, Black Magic, White Magic, Fairy Magic, etc., all to the level of a talented individual. You know the calculations to cast your magic as effortlessly that where a normal magician struggles with complex equations, it's more like simple addition for you.

You even have the skills to start making your own unique magic circles and calculations. While you do not have the sheer raw power of someone capable of utilizing the Kankara Formula, you're a master of the fundamentals—giving you something to build off of and eventually create your own Formula someday.
addons.title: Le Fay

addons.text: Formula Magic, which uses complex equations to alter the world around you. Archive Magic, which works with information and is basically just computer magic. The synergy should be obvious. By offloading necessary calculations and processing onto Archive Magic functions, you can greatly amplify your ability to wield Formulaic Magic, and that’s just scratching the surface. Perhaps you might store the formula of a spell into a File to be accessed at any point, allowing you to seemingly instantly cast spells by drawing upon preset calculations, or maybe you’d create an algorithm to spin up multiple instances of a semi-inaccurate Divination spell before compiling the results to form a more accurate generalization. While you are not quite at the level of the Kankara Formula, the automation and machine-like precision afforded by Archive Magic takes your capabilities far beyond that of all but the most advanced practitioners, held back primarily by the fact that you still need to know the formulas for spells in order to cast them. Possessing Le Fay greatly boosts your starting point as it grants you the formulas for a vast array of magic, as well as the proficiency needed to make your own unique magic. Similarly, Super Archive Magic with its touch-based system and instant processing and analysis providing a major increase to your capabilities. And if you had both then the compounding results would give you a solid head start on the road to creating your own version of the Kankara Formula.
addons.title: Computational Magic

objects.text:
The power of numbers: you have gained the magic system the humans use in DxD. Through the power of research and calculation, you are able to emulate the power of devils. Though the devils can bring about their vision of reality through pure imagination and will, yours is different in that it takes study and equations. Through this magic, you can wield various powers such as illusion, hypnosis, healing, enchanting, and other effects. Teleportation's would require calculating the distance and the energy required, while casting a fireball would require the calculations required for the fireball and the forces that would affect it.

With enough study and preparation, you can affect more of the world around you, producing effects that the humans of the DxD universe could only dream of.
objects.title: Formulaic Magic (High School DxD)

objects.text:
Embracing the essence of magic, you have awakened as a Mage, harnessing the root of all sorcery—the enigmatic Gnosis. This ethereal force acts as a compass, guiding your connection to the very core of magic itself. While your journey begins as rank 1, your Gnosis serves as a beacon, drawing you closer to the divine source of magic. With each stride forward, your Gnosis deepens, unfurling hidden wisdom and bestowing upon you unmatched mastery of the arcane arts.

As your Gnosis ascends, your comprehension of the profound Arcana expands, unlocking enigmatic secrets and granting a multitude of benefits. Rituals quicken, bending time effortlessly to your will, while your mana pool expands, allowing you to channel greater mystical energy. Moreover, higher levels of Gnosis facilitate the exploration of advanced Arcana, enabling you to unravel their mysteries with ease. 

Yet, heed this solemn warning: True Archmastery, a realm beyond the fifth ranks of Gnosis, demands unwavering dedication and sacrifices yet to be made. As the dance between heightened Gnosis and powerful magical effects, such as creating earthquakes or granting sentience to machines, may carry a risk of backlash for the unprepared Mage. 

Embarking on this journey, you begin as a humble disciple in your 2 ruling Arcana and a mere apprentice in all other's. As you chart the vibrant tapestry of the Arcana, your Gnosis stirs something within you—an unmatched intuition and innate ability to ascend through the ranks swiftly, mastering and even creating spells without the need for a mentor. Instinctually, you discern the path to progress, growing ever closer to the pinnacle of your awakened potential. 

In your boundless pursuit in realm of Arcana, you are unfettered, guided by the luminous path illuminated by your expanding Gnosis.
objects.title: The Awakened Gnosis (Chronicles of Darkness - Mage: The Awakening)

objects.text:
You are Lost, yet you are Free. You were reshaped by the True Fae, which made you close to them in nature and bound you to the Wyrd, but you made those yours. You escaped the mad realm of Arcadia, you are a Changeling.

Your true form, your Mien, is weird and somewhat inhuman, yet is hidden by the Mask, the greatest of illusions. Only those capable to see through Fate itself can pierce it, though other supernatural senses can reveal some truths about it. You can also tear it down, granting you great supernatural might until it reforms in about an hour, though attracting any supernatural means of detection.

Your Mien's Seeming also grants you advantages - the fleetness and instinct of the Beasts, the stealth and flexibility of the Darklings, the environmental control of the Elementals, the beauty and leadership of the Fairests, the brutal might of the Ogres, or the cleverness and supernatural crafting of the Wizened. Additionally, your Kith, the purpose you served when imprisoned, conceptually empowers you to take certain actions related to what was once your role.

You feed on Glamour, the emotions of non-fey creatures. The more intence and lasting the emotions are, the greater the meal. You can also Reap someone, granting you a lot of Glamour while muting all the victim's emotions until they surmount this depression. You can release that Glamour to cause Bedlam, creating an explosion of emotions affecting everyone nearby.

Glamour can also be used for Portaling. This allows to create a portal to the Hedge through any opening or reflective surface, a realm in which emotions and stories create magical fruits, minor conceptual artifacts and enigmatic hobgoblins. With sufficient focus and time, you can shape the Hedge to your will. Travelling through the Hedge lets you cross large distance in the material world in a very short time. If you aren't in the Chronicles of Darkness setting, the Hedge will only start to fill when you first enter it. Portaling can also be used to escape any mundane binding in an instant, and can even clash against supernatural bindings. Anything restricting your freedom counts for those purposes.

You can also use the magic of various Pledges. You can Seal the promises of non-fae; doing so compels them to follow on their exact words. If they manage to resist this, the magic batters them, physically and mentally, though lets them gain experience and wisdom if they follow through. Bargains binds you to a non-fae being through a continuous exchange, and by doing so reinforces the magic of the Mask, making it near impossible to pierce and making it so you also resist various means of divination; if the non-fae party of the Bargain breaks their side of it, the Wyrd punishes them, often through making them tumble into the Hedge, enable to escape without help. Oaths, unbreakable Pledges, can only be done between two True Fae, changelings or Avowed, but those are unlikely to come into play if you aren't in the Chronicles of Darkness setting.

You also have access to Contracts, spell-like abilities created by making contracts with aspects of reality. You can also, by making a Bargain with a sufficiently powerful being, create a Court, granting you an emotional affinity, appropriate contracts and a few other varied benefits after grand trials. You can instead become part, in name, of an already existing Court.

However, iron ignores your powers and protects those wearing it from them, and cold iron, which must be forged without machine or magic, burns you. Your experiences also affected your sanity. It is easier for you to fall prey to madness, as challenges to your reality affects you deeper than most, and yet, it is also easier for you to shake this off, and reach enough clarity to see through lies and illusions. You can even focus to try to detect anything defying human comprehension nearby.
objects.title: Through the Thorns (Chronicles of Darkness - Changeling: The Lost)

objects.text:
You've gained unparalleled expertise in magic tricks, akin to the incredible talents possessed by Kaito Kid. You possess an innate understanding of illusion, misdirection, and sleight of hand, enabling you to perform magic tricks with near-supernatural precision and finesse. You can flawlessly execute complex card manipulations, escape from seemingly impossible situations, and create mesmerizing stage illusions that leave audiences in awe.

Furthermore, the power enhances your natural inventive prowess, granting you the ability to create intricate and ingenious gears and devices specifically designed to support and enhance your magic tricks. These gears are not only aesthetically appealing but also functional, providing you with the necessary tools and props to execute your illusions flawlessly. They can range from mechanical contraptions to optical devices, each tailored to suit your unique magical style.

Additionally, you possess a passive minor reality warping ability, tied directly to your magic tricks. This power allows you to temporarily bend the rules of reality within the confines of your illusions, enabling you to achieve effects that would typically be deemed impossible. For example, you could make an object genuinely disappear rather than merely creating the illusion of vanishing, or levitate an object without any visible support. Granting you the flexibility to push the boundaries of what is considered achievable, as long as it remains within the realm of magic tricks and illusions.

Furthermore, the power grants you the capability to perform any magic trick instantly, without the need for prior preparation or setup, as long as it is theoretically possible. With a mere thought or gesture, you can summon the necessary props, create intricate illusions, or execute impressive feats of magic without hesitation.
objects.title: The Last Magician of the Century (Magic Kaito)

objects.text:
Planar runic magic is, quite simply, the best there is. You can do just about anything with it, there are so many fields to explore, and everything stems from mathematical theory—just lovely, beautiful magic. Taking this path lets you step into a world of wonder, giving you the fundamental rules and a thousand planar runes - some powerful, some weak, some basic, some on the cutting-edge of runic magic. What can you do from there? Whatever you want.

To manage the runic spell formulas, your mind is integrated with a tech-free piece of complex planar magic originally perfected by Archmage Jylx: a fully internal Head-Up Display. Operating on its own internal OS and terminal language, this reprogrammable interface allows you to write custom scripts, tailor your user interface, and automate complex calculations seamlessly. Within the HUD is a comprehensive sensory precision tool that allows you to measure physical reality down to exact values, allowing you to instantly calculate distances, velocity, acceleration, mass, precise time, and count vast quantities of objects in a single glance, feeding any variable you need directly into your equations.

You are also capable of metamagic. As its most basic application, you can act as a natural attractor for ambient or nearby magical energy, siphoning power toward yourself to supercharge your own spellwork while starving your foes - though overusing this siphon risks disastrous effects: explosions, death zones, gods getting pissed, anything. With practice, you will develop your metamagic further, learning to boost active effects, channel power, break an opponent's spell mid-cast, dispel both planar and universal magic, and smooth out the cosmic ripples that make wild magic unpredictable.

Finally, your HUD comes pre-loaded with master grimoires containing the core formulas for two high-tier disciplines. Quantum Arcana is a cutting-edge school of magic built directly around quantum physics, granting pinpoint control over directional radiation, particle decay, nuclear forces, quantum uncertainty, and superdense matter. At the opposite extreme, Relativistic Arcana manipulates macro-scale physics and space-time geometry, which in practice allows you to pull a moon out of orbit... provided your calculations are accurate, that is.
objects.title: Planar Runes (Planeswalker Rising)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have ascended to become a mage, but be wary of the inevitable recruitment into the army.

As a mage, you've undergone rigorous training to harness Magic, a phenomenon where mages channel their mana to manipulate the world around them. To achieve extraordinary magical feats, magitech devices like the computation orb play a crucial role. With this, you also gain the ability to create magitech wonders, including Computational Orbs, Formula Rifles, and Flight Gear. Furthermore, your magical capacity possesses boundless potential, surpassing even the most accomplished mages.

But there's more; due to your unique circumstances, you've been bestowed with a blessing from a higher entity, endowing you with magical capacity akin to that of a Mary Sue. This immense power allows you to cast advanced-level spells tirelessly for hours without fatigue. Additionally, by praying to a deity or an unspecified higher being, you can temporarily amplify your magical might over tenfold, making you a force capable of obliterating entire armies single-handedly.

However, what truly sets you apart from others is your unparalleled grasp of computational orb theory, magical formulas, and magitech crafting. Your mind serves as a crucible of invention, effortlessly devising tools, technologies, and new magical formulas to bolster your abilities.

Moreover, you are now a master of various magical formulas. From Flight Formulas that bestows upon you the grace of soaring through the heavens, to Defensive Formulas envelop you in an impenetrable shield of protection. Use the intricacies of Offensive Formulas to unleash devastation upon your foes, or harness Combustion Formulas to engulf the world in awe-inspiring explosions.
objects.title: State Approved Magic (Youjo Senki)

objects.text:
You have become a practitioner of a unique form of magic and witchcraft. As a Witch, you are now intimately attuned to the essence of animals, choosing one to be the embodiment of your powers. Upon delving into the heart of this power, you unlock the ability to take on the physical traits of your chosen animal, becoming a harmonious fusion of human and beast.

Each time you invoke the magic of your animal-based powers, a subtle whisper of temptation attempts to draw those around you towards destructive ends. This malevolent influence seeks to exploit the primal instincts within all living beings, urging them to unleash havoc and chaos upon the world. But fear not, for you are able to curb these whispers if you so chooses, as within you resides an indomitable willpower capable of curbing this ominous call, enabling you to wield your magic responsibly and with control.

At the core of Maddening Witchery lies the profound Transformation Magic, a gift that grants you the ability to shift between your human form and the embodiment of your chosen animal at will. This metamorphosis empowers you to adapt effortlessly to diverse situations, tapping into the full potential of your animal-based powers.

As a practitioner of Maddening Witchery, you gain the ability to create Demon Tools, powerful magical artifacts with diverse capabilities. From containing entire worlds within their pages to housing sentient beings with their own souls, your proficiency in crafting these enigmatic objects sets you apart from your peers.

To safeguard your true identity, you are able to cloak your soul, rendering it indistinguishable from an ordinary person's. This concealment allows you to move in the shadows, evading the prying eyes of those who can perceive souls, ensuring your Witchery remains a well-guarded secret.
objects.title: Maddening Witchery (Soul Eater)

objects.text:
You have become the 25th Dark One, one of the few individuals who have hosted the Darkness, a dark magical entity. You are also granted the knowledge and skills of all the previous Dark Ones.

Being the Dark One grants you immortality, such that you no longer age and don't need sleep (though most Dark Ones find a hobby to pass the time, like spinning gold from straw or making dreamcatchers). You are not affected by temperature or most dark magic. You can regenerate from any wound not inflicted by the Sword of the Dark One. If you die by means other than the Sword of the Dark One or a being of much greater power, you will reform in the "Vault of the Dark One", The ability to generate and control darkness is another gift of being the Dark One. Additionally, you have a great affinity for magic in all its forms except Seer, Divine, and Fairy magic (though these limits can be bypassed if you are clever at making deals or finding loopholes).

Your magic can be used for teleportation, age manipulation, telekinesis, elemental control, energy blasts, healing, enhancing your physical abilities, potioncraft, alchemy, summoning objects or individuals, planar/dimensional travel, technopathy, metaphysical heart extraction and control, and more. This branch of magic is only limited by a few laws, such as raising the dead (creating an alternative reality instead), creating love (only an illusion of love, not the real thing), and time travel (the attempt will create an alternative reality instead of actually traveling to the past). all your magics can be enhaced by your emotions 

As the Dark One, with the knowledge and experiences of your predecessors, you are a grandmaster at making magical deals, bargains, etc., with individuals to grant their deepest wishes and darkest desires. These deals can be made for objects like gold or lessons in a skill, or something as esoteric as someone's power, love, knowledge, etc. The possibilities of these deals are only limited by your ingenuity and cleverness, and they don't have to be "fair" deals.

You have a few weaknesses: the Sword of the Dark One, which can kill you (if someone does this, they will become the new Dark One), being in a realm where magic can't exist, and items enchanted to block magic.

Last but not least, you possess the Sword of the Dark One, also known as Excalibur, which can cut magic and kill immortals by cutting their immortality. With a ritual, you can turn it back into the Holy Grail which when drunk from grants immortality and great magic power.

Note: You do not have to worry about the corruption of the Darkness leading to your death or your morals and looks being twisted by being the Dark One.
objects.title: The Dark One (Once Upon a Time)

objects.text:
You’ve received the Gift of Aion which grants access to (and massively enhances your capabilities in) the magic system of the Sorcerously Advanced roleplaying game and total immunity to direct mind control (but not other forms of mind manipulation). You also instinctively know the basics of magic and find yourself learning quickly. 
Universes outside of Sorcerously Advanceds cosmology explicitly have appropriate levels of Flow to equivalent locations in Sorc Adv (e.g large amounts of Flow on a world with a biosphere with appropriate aspects, a level 2 null zone in space (as unlike worlds of the kaleidoscope, space in a normal universe is not empty it's merely hard to detect and interact with what’s there in a useful manner) although the Flow is only weakly interactive with the natural world until disturbed by something or someone capable of interacting the Flow.

You can also explicitly use the settings grand wonderworks outside of the kaleidoscope and the worlds beyond effectively as normal with any conflicts with other settings metaphysics/cosmology resolved in whatever way is most favorable (within reason anyways) with the option to decide if they are the same instances of the wonderworks that would connect & interact with the Sorcerously Advanced setting normally or are identical copies (either way the universal repositories would explicitly contain all the contents of that you would find inside them in the Sorc Adv setting which is all that you need to learn a tradition from the game or create your own)

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: The Gift (Sorcerously Advanced)

objects.text:
You possess a remarkable magical anomaly: instead of depleting your internal magical reserves when you use magic, you generate more magical power within yourself.

This gives you access to an essentially limitless source of magic, enabling exponential growth as each spell amplifies your magical abilities proportionally to its cost.

However, there's a crucial caveat: the human body has limits in containing magical energy. Overuse could lead to a catastrophic explosion, as your body may burst like an overinflated balloon due to the immense pressure of the magic you generate. It's essential to give your body time to adapt to its heightened magical baseline before casting spells again.

With enough time or a sufficient number of spells, you could potentially reach a level of magical prowess comparable to that of a deity.

Furthermore, you've gained some knowledge about elemental magic from the planet Lore.
objects.title: Warlic (Artix Entertainment)

objects.text:
Long before the mushroom war, there existed an ice elemental of great renown, Urgence Evergreen. He and the other elementals discovered that a comet filled with evil magic was headed to the planet, and in order to stop the comet, they created a crown, a crow filled with magic that could grant the wearer's innermost wish. Sadly, before he could use the crown to save the world, he got stuck under a block of ice and was forced to ask his student Gunther to wear the crown and save the world Urgence Evergreen, however, did not anticipate that Gunther's deepest desire would not be to save the world but to be just like Urgence Evergreen. Like Gunther, you have gained abilities similar in nature to Urgence Evergreen. Just without the sacrifice of sanity that comes with wearing the crown and being transformed into a different person.

You have gained unparalleled control over the field of ice magic, being able to freeze both living and non-living creatures into ice, transform ice into creatures, or use the ice to make weapons. You can also call storms of snow and ice or even shoot bolts of ice lightning from your hands. You also have access to a plethora of other abilities, such as flight, withstanding intense temperatures, seeing things beyond the ordinary, a sixth sense that could alert you to danger and protect you while not conscious, invisibility, illusion creation, and so much more.

While you are not limited to simply using ice magic, using other magic takes more time and effort than using ice magic. Your current strength in magic is enough to level a small country and will only grow as you get older, and with immortality, you have eternity to study and practice magic and grow in strength.
objects.title: Ice King (Adventure Time)

addons.text:
How curious it would seem as though a master level Registrar, or perhaps the Dragon Goddess Rozeta, has conversed with you and given a full, detailed guide on how to guide your progression and build with The Script. 

What this means if you have an extremely detailed guidebook perfectly tailored to your desires within your mind for how to guide your growth and advancement with The Script. This also includes knowledge on how to gain or create spells, skills, and abilities that may normally be a secret to those within the world of Ar'Kendrithyst.
addons.title: Registrar Guiding

addons.text:
Your Divine Patron can now assign quests and tasks where should you complete them you will gain various rewards such as experience, Points for The Script which may be used as normal, and Divine Boons which can grant many powerful permanent new skills and passives which may even allow you to breakaway from limits within the Script such as limited daily health and mana regeneration.

Optionally, you can also have your Divine Patron be one of the gods from Ar'Kendrithyst, such as the Dragon Goddess of The Script Rozeta.
addons.title: Divine Script Boons

addons.text:
One of the most critical choices one who bears The Script must make is the choice of their Scion Skill. 
There exist five Scion Skills, each of which is focused on a single attribute except the fifth, which counts as a weaker hybrid of the other four. This choice drastically matters for someone, as each person with The Script is defined by their choice of Scion Skill. You, however, like the dirty cheater that you are, have somehow acquired all five of them and each of their prerequisites. In addition, your Strength, Vitality, Willpower, and Focus are increased to 50 instantly.

You gain the following benefits:

- You gain 20% universal damage reduction
- Your maximum health is increased by +600%
- Your Health Regeneration is increased by +600%, and the daily limit is removed
- You gain the Second Wind ability, which allows you to pay 10% of your health to increase the speed of your health regeneration from per day to per minute for one minute
- The health cost of all physical skills is reduced by 50% or 75% for Favoured Skills
- You gain the Mana Shaping Skill, which allows you to change the target type of spells to various areas or targets
- You gain the Mana Manipulation skill, which allows you to modify the effects of spells
- You gain the Meditation Skill, which changes your mana regeneration from per day to per minute while active

In addition to the above, each of the taboos within the Script is removed for you. This means you can fully mess around with atoms, biology, and space-time with no blockages. You can even buy and build spells and skills related to these disciplines as well.
addons.title: Lawbreaking Scion

objects.text:
You have access to a magic system called the Script. This allows you to gain experience through living life, upon reaching an increasing threshold, you level up. Initially this system has 4 stats and a Class, Strength, Vitality, Willpower, and Focus. Strength is directly proportional to your max Health, while your Vitality is tied to your Health regeneration. Willpower and Focus are the magic versions, reflecting max Mana and Regen respectively. You are to receive points from leveling up and performing incredible feats. These points allow you to upgrade your stats and buy spells. 

Even without putting points directly into your Willpower, you are able to increase the amount of magic you produce. Mana Production is affected by how well a person knows magic, how much magic they do, and the mana itself. These growths are based on your lifes feats, saving an entire city of innocents could net you a sizable increase, being an important teacher of magic would give you a much larger boost, leading a country would net you a robust boost.

Classes allow you to specialize in certain magics, you may design your own Class with enough skill. Each Class initially has five slots for bonuses that improve you tremendously, a single bonus would allow you to double your health, triple your regen, or even be something more esoteric such as an Affinity towards an Element. To get more of these bonuses you must complete various Quests or perform on the level of making an entirely new branch of magic.

However you should remain aware that the Script itself is a crutch, not every spell is purchasable, Time Magic for example requires the completion of an incredibly lengthy Quests in order to even gain the right to the most basic spells. In order to achieve some of the rarer spells you must work to craft them yourself, casting them out into the world upon the formation of the spell. If you are unsatisfied with the result of a combination, you may rip the spell apart inside your spirit, giving yourself another attempt at greatness.
objects.title: The Script (Ar'Kendrithyst)

addons.text: Your affinity to learning and casting Final Fantasy increases. You gain the ability to cast spells with reduced or no chant through your Keyblade. In addition, you learn the basics of the many spells and abilities shown throughout the Kingdom Hearts game series.
addons.title: Keyblade Magic

objects.text:
You gain access to tier magic from Final Fantasy, and a modest mana pool that you can increase with practice. By chanting your spells, you are able to launch a different array of effects. Spells are made with two factors: an element and a tier. 

Element is an attribute that defines the spell. “Fire” will make fire, “Ice” will make ice, etc. You can use more esoteric elements like “Stop” to freeze objects, or “Heal” to bring a person back to health, but the more abstract the element the more mana it will cost. A tierless spell, that is, only the element, will be a simple thing: “fire” will make a small fireball or a stream, “thunder” would make a small stream of light, “heal” will fix a shallow cut, etc.

Tiers are how strong a spell is. By adding a suffix at the end of the element, the spell is made stronger. Each tier grants an output of power twice as strong as the previous one, and proportionally increases the mana cost. As you gain experience, you will learn more suffixes.
objects.title: Tier Magic, kupo! (Final Fantasy)

objects.text:
You are branded, turning you into a I’Cie. Unlike the games, you're not bound to a higher entity. You gain a moderate mana pool, and the ability to use spells. Your body is also enhanced, your magic internally reinforcing your resistance, stamina and strength to near-superhuman levels. As you gain experience in using your powers, you can meditate and access an inner skill-tree, expanding your powers and granting you access to new spells and skills. 


Unlike the I’Cie that receive their focus from a god, you can set it yourself, and change it at will. The harder your focus is, and the more you do to conclude it, the more your power will grow. You must either succeed in your focus or wait a week before changing it. 


And finally, you have the ability to cover yourself with an indestructible crystal. The process is near instantaneous, and you are vaguely aware of everything around you, but you come out of the crystal exhausted and depleted of mana until you have properly rested. You won't age inside the crystal, and can set conditions to be automatically removed from it.
objects.title: I’Cie (Final Fantasy XIII)

objects.text:
You possess the Echo also known as the power of transcendent which is a vestiges of power that all people on Etheirys once held as the ancient. The nature of the echo is the ability to transcend the boundary between one own soul and that of another. 

This power can give those who have it a variety of different abilities such as receiving visions of the past and future, The ability to speak to and be understood by any creature with a soul regardless of language barrier, combat precognition by viewing the vibration of the soul, see the distinct color of the soul, immunity to mind control and the ability to extend such protection in a radius near oneself.

Some advanced users of the echo like the Ascian can even use this power to greater effect capable of achieving things such as teleportation, immortality, possession, and even undergoing fusion with another to create a more powerful being. 

At first, these abilities will be hard to control and at times go off at random but with practice and training you will gain more finesse and control over the power.
objects.title: The Echo (Final Fantasy XIV)

addons.text: Your affinity with learning and casting all magic greatly increases for both you and your followers. You and your followers learn the basics of the many spells shown throughout the Final Fantasy series. In addition, you gain the ability to cast Final Fantasy spells with reduced chants and with time and training no chants.
addons.title: One Big Happy Franchise

addons.text:
Your limit break bars can now be used to temporarily activate one of the 3 abilities of the chosen king: The Wall, The Summons, and the Armiger. Using multiple limit break bars will further increase the ability of the selected chosen kings ability by 5 (for each bar) but not allow you to cast multiple Chosen King abilities at the same time. 

In addition if you have King of Kings, you can now use a limit break bar to cast either a Chosen King ability with zero exhaustion or a Ring of the Lucii ability with zero cost to your life force.
addons.title: Kings Make Their Own Rules

addons.text:
Your affliction has mutated, turning you not into a heartless but into the Starscourge incarnate. Fright not, however as you still retain all the abilities and skills of a heartless but also those of the First and Betrayed Chosen King Ardyn Lucis Caelum. These include creating (but not controlling) Daemons by releasing starscourge, becoming more powerful by consuming dark aligned energy (or creatures), wielding the 13 royal arms, and consuming worlds if enough Starscourge is released into a world to blot out the sun forever. 

You have become the incarnation of a man who planned and schemed the killing of a god but unlike most, he and now you possessed the power to succeed.
addons.title: Ardyn Lucis Caelum

addons.text:
No longer is your Inner world just an empty world, now it contains the city of Insomnia and can be permanently summoned into the world you inhabit. This summoning includes the Kingsguard, Kingsglaive, unpowered Crownsguard, Hunters organization, all the vehicles and weapons they had, and all the civilians that inhabited the city right before its fall. Due to your ability having saved their lives from certain death, each and every citizen of Insomnia is completely loyal to you and your rule as Insomnia’s King. 

If you have “King of Kings” this city is also surrounded by the (now) permanent new Wall, which has protected the city for 150 year. If you have “Ardyn Lucis Caelum”, then you may substitute the city with Gralea, the capital of Niflhime and thus also includes their (now perfectly controlled) Magitek Army, including the infamous Diamond Weapon which has felled entire nations.
addons.title: No Man Rules Alone

objects.text:
Throughout the history of Eos several crystals from the beyond have been sent by the Astrals down to the mortal world and while on Eos only one crystal has survived to the modern era, You are now the chosen bearer one of these crystals. The crystal grants you seven abilities, one from each of the six Astrals, with a seventh ability that enables you to create a loyal force known as the Kingsglaive, which contains the elite Kingsguard. The six abilities, bestowed upon you and your followers by the Astrals are:
  1. Strength and endurance enough to fight a dozen men at once.
  2. The ability to call and control arcs of lightning.
  3. The ability to summon and shape shards of ice.
  4. The ability to conjure and manipulate balls of fire.
  5. The ability form a barrier as strong as castle walls.
  6. An indestructible weapon that they can always teleport to or have teleported to them.
For your followers, the Kingsglaive, you can gift each the basic gifts of the Astrals. For your 3 most elite soldiers, your Kingsguard, you can gift each 2 teleporting weapons and the strength of the each of their other abilities increase by an order of magnitude. For you, the King of the crystal, you have been gifted 3 teleporting weapons, the ability to anoint others as Kingsguard or Kingsglaive, and your other gifts are twice as strong as your Kingsguard. While each of your Kingsglaive are only slightly above street level mages in their capabilities, it takes very little strain to anoint an individual as a Kingsglaive, so much so that the original King of Insomnia could, after years of preparation, field multiple literal armies of trained Kingsglaive soldiers. However, the main drawback of this system is killing the King separates all from the magic of the crystal, something that can be migrated (but not negated) if the King has a living blood relative as they would become King instead and could re-anoint those that lost their power. Although an alone Kingsglaive may seem insignificant against all the monsters and horrors the universe throws at Eos, Kingsglaive are rarely alone.
objects.title: King of Insomnia (Final Fantasy XV)

objects.text:
You are a dominant being who hosts the power of a powerful godlike elemental being called Eikon. through an act called priming, you can assume the form of your chosen Eikon and unleash its devastating might upon the battlefield, or through semi-priming clad yourself in the power of the Eikon without fully transforming. Either way, because of your nature as a dominant you can instinctively use magics of the same element as your Eikon and have a great affinity for said element. 

Eikon can enter an empowered state by absorbing a large amount of magical energy though this tends to make them go berserk, there is also a major drawback as overuse of the Eikon and their power sap the vitality of their user causing their body to slowly crystalize over time as they use more and more power.

you can choose to have your Eikon be one of the existing ones or create your own custom Eikon with one of the 8 original elements
objects.title: Dominant (Final Fantasy XVI)

addons.text: You’re a prodigy when it comes to magical thought and theory. Learning different magical approaches comes naturally, and synthesizing them only takes a bit of creativity. In theory, you could rival Timothy Hunter if you channeled all of your talent into raw magical potency.
addons.title: Magus Superior

addons.text: You are no longer merely a descendant of Chthon, but of Trigon as well. Aside from giving you the general abilities of Trigon's favored child, Raven, your reality warping abilities now require far less emotional control to achieve a stable result; instead of reality warps "backfiring", you can choose to offload it to a demonic alternate personality when you overextend yourself, giving them temporary control over your actions commensurate to the extent of your reality warping.
addons.title: Azarath Metrion Zinthos (DC)

addons.text:
Your potentially non-human status as a Sleigh Beggy and your subspecies as a Homo Magi have fused together, truly divorcing you from humanity. Under a microscope or in the eyes of supernatural creatures, you would not be considered human. At best, you would be seen as the next obvious step in humanity’s evolution. Because of this, harmful things like diseases, viruses, and even certain supernatural elements that specifically harm only humans won't affect you, as you are genetically not human.

You no longer suffer from the weakness or potential death of a Sleigh Beggy. Instead, your very cells generate and absorb massive amounts of mana, empowering you. This grants you effective immortality, and you no longer require sustenance, as your own magic sustains you. Your regenerative capabilities are also incredibly strong—unless someone completely destroys your head in one strike, your cells will replicate and undo any damage. This happens because you are so connected to mana, and your cells are so saturated with it, that they can be generated just as you normally produce mana to replace old ones. 

Over time, even this limitation will fade as the excess mana you accumulate continues to strengthen your very being—not just physically, but on a soul-deep level.
addons.title: How Do You Do, Fellow Hoomans?

objects.text:
Homo Magi, also called Homo Magus, is a sub-race of naturally magic-wielding humans. Many powerful civilizations came from them, Atlantis being the most significant.

As a Homo Magi, you can learn to manipulate any kind of magic, but true mastery still requires significant practice, though your natural talent far exceeds that of a normal human. Additionally, due to your race naturally being attuned to magic, the strength and potential of all your other magical abilities have been enhanced. Lastly, Homo Magi age at a slower pace, and can live from centuries to millennia.
objects.title: Homo Magi (DC Comics)

addons.text: You have brought the reality-warping forces of magic and Enuncia together, enriching your command over creation itself. Now, instead of needing to speak, you can also use Logomancy by writing words backwards such as "llaberif" for a fireball. What gets really interesting is when you speak or write Enuncia backwards via Logomancy. The combination of using Enuncia with Logomancy results in a multiplicative effect wherein it causes spells cast to become exponentially more powerful. A spell that might normally only affect a large city could instead impact an entire country when using Enuncia. You won't receive any more backlash from the spell than what you would typically receive if you were casting an unaltered version. However, these spells are extremely difficult to speak or write, meaning that careful preparation and learning are needed. These restrictions will ease with practice and eventually your spells will become something truly earth-shattering.
addons.title: Enunciatic Evocation

objects.text:
Logomancy, also known as "backwards magic", is a type of Order Magic that allows the user to create supernatural effects by speaking backwards.

You can do almost anything with Logomancy like manipulating the weather, traveling through dimensions, flying, or healing and even resurrecting people or animals.

As an Order Magic, Logomancy takes a toll on the user. The more complicate and powerful the effect, the higher the cost, going from a negligible cost to an insufferable pain that can kill you. With more practice and experience you can reduce the cost of the spells.
objects.title: Logomancy (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Atlantean Magic is a mystical art practiced by the inhabitants of Atlantis, typically fueled by belief, will, and faith within the city itself, making it a unique form of magic deeply tied to Atlantis’ history and culture. Its origins are ambiguous, with several myths surrounding its creation, such as Darkworld, the wellspring for the Gods of Atlantis, and the Rock of Eternity.

Practitioners of Atlantean Magic can control water in numerous ways by mentally "speaking" to it. This includes abilities like diverting water, walking on water, manipulating water molecules from the air, creating water constructs, boiling or freezing water, manipulating ice, and even controlling the blood inside creatures. However, the secret to using hydrokinesis is exclusively reserved for Xebelian royalty.

Atlantean Magic also encompasses a wide range of spells, such as energy blasts, force fields, and complex large-scale incantations. Examples of this magic include coral manipulation, typically used by the Artisans Guild, the Silent Craft of the Silent School of Atlantis, and the Crown of Thorns, a barrier that protects Atlantis from invaders.

As a beginner in Atlantean Magic, you possess knowledge of the basics but have the potential to surpass powerful figures like Mera. With practice, you may one day master the ability to create tidal waves or even summon a tsunami, with the possibility of becoming the strongest Atlantean sorcerer.
objects.title: Atlantean Magic (DC Comics)

addons.title: A Piece of the World
addons.text:
You’ve become an elemental linked to your Realm. This has essentially replaced your Spiritual Core with a direct connection to your plane, allowing you to expend more energy at a time for longer periods. 

With some training you could increase the flow of energy from your plane into you to become greater and greater, perhaps taking your place as a member of your realm’s parliament, or perhaps even its Avatar.

If you’ve taken multiple realms, you might be an elemental of the place where they intersect. An elemental of both The Metal and The Red might be a Biotechnology elemental for instance.

objects.text:
Some say forces pervade and reach throughout the world and beyond, encompassing our life: the flora, the fauna, bacterial culture, so is their passing in their decomposition; having said that, not only do they comprehend facets of life so the world at large: the air we breathe, the fire we stoke, the stones we use and built, the tides sweeping you away across the sea, lastly the gears and systems we put into place. These are Elemental Realms, the powers that be in charge of particular elements of the universe and source of Elementals across the DC Universe, and you had been picked for a connection to an Elemental Realm of your choosing. Each dwelling contains a Parliament constituted of previous Avatars and Elementals of their respective Realm. Your options are as follows:
  • The Green: It is a force inherent, linked to all forms of flora, a natural force that animates and embodies all plant life in existence. Those connected with The Green usually exhibit varying levels of Plant Manipulation and physiological changes relating to flora, some demonstrate other specialized or advanced abilities such as Poison Manipulation, Nature Manipulation, and controlling ecosystems, a full connection to Nature and all flora allowing for understanding and communion with it, a Cosmic Awareness by sensing disturbances in the Green, among others. The Green can also bolster your physical abilities to a supernatural level, while also directly tapping into it as energy for both offensive, defensive, and supportive purposes.
  • The Red: Also known as the Morphogenetic Field to some, it is the natural force permeating and connecting to any fauna in existence, which in itself is a systematic field of information imprinting the forms of living organisms, giving form to them. That’s to say, it archives and collects the essence of all fauna in existence for you to access. It extends to all species, both sapient and non-sapient, natural and supernatural, terrestrial and extraterrestrial. Those connected with The Red usually exhibit Therianthropy, Animal Mimicry, Empathy, and/or Manipulation in varying levels, some demonstrate specialized or advanced abilities such as Biological Manipulation of all fauna and yourself, tapping into multiple biological templates simultaneously, directly channeling their energy for blasts, being connected to all fauna, among others.
  • The Black: More commonly known as the Rot, the force permeating where decay and death are most present, characteristically in opposition to both the Green and Red in the natural cycle of life. Those connected with The Rot usually exhibit Rot Manipulation in varying levels and physiological changes relating to decay and rot; this is one of the Realms where their specialized and advanced abilities are more along the lines of specifically furthering decay and rot on certain parts of existence, like pestilence, necrosis, or outright necromantic powers.
  • The Blue: Being the force pervading all aquatic life, also known as The Clear, it acts as the universal consciousness of all sea life, just as the Green and Red do. Those connected to the Clear usually exhibit varying levels of Water Manipulation, aquatic adaptations allowing both breathing and traversal in aquatic environs, and a connection with all marine life bordering on near-authority with nearby aquatic life, some demonstrating specialized and/or heightened abilities from the aforementioned powers and more.
  • The Melt: The elemental force for all forms of rock and metal in existence, this force is simplistic as it is everpresent. Those connected to the Melt usually exhibit varying levels of Earth, Mineral, or Lava Manipulation and physiological changes related to the Melt, while some demonstrate specialized and/or heightened abilities that are either advanced applications from the previous abilities, connection with the geosphere, among others.
  • The White: Is the force representing air, wind, gas, and the atmosphere across existence. Those connected to the White usually exhibit varying levels of Air, Gas, or Weather Manipulation and physiological changes related to The White, while some demonstrate specialized and/or heightened applications from the previous abilities, and connection with the atmosphere, among others.
  • The Grey: The force with the unassailable drive to consume and spread, is one pervading and representing all fungal life in existence. Those connected with The Grey often exhibit varying levels of Fungal Manipulation and physiological changes related to The Grey, while some demonstrate specialized and heightened applications such as Mind Control through the weaponization of ophiocordyceps modified by The Grey.
  • The Metal: A relatively contemporaneous force manifesting in the 21st Century, it is the one pervading and representing all metal, technology, and machinery throughout existence. Those connected to the Metal often exhibit varying levels of Metal, Technology, and technological changes transforming their body to that of a cybernetic lifeform, with some demonstrating advanced and/or specialized abilities from previously mentioned boons. Being a fledging force it will continue to grow as long as technological progress persists.
  • The Divided: The seldom known force encompassing bacterial life or prokaryotic organisms, living in peace while its influence unbeknownst was spreading death and illness; to other forces, it was chalked up as the whims of nature, until humanity researched into it and started fighting its proliferation, giving The Divided the first taste in war. Those connected to The Divided often exhibit varying levels of Bacterial Manipulation, communing and establishing a connection with microbes on your vicinity, among other abilities.
  • The Shine: Another scarcely known force pervading the element of fire, yet unknowingly the atom. It is mysteriously connected to the Firestorm Matrix, although its veracity is never confirmed. Regardless of it, those connected to The Shine usually exhibit Fire, Plasma, or Ionic Manipulation or varying levels, miscellaneous abilities related to the Firestorm Matrix, and more.
The potency and depth of your abilities depend on your connection’s affinity: a low affinity to your chosen elemental force procures low-level abilities and uses, while a higher affinity and closeness to their metaphysical roots procured to nearly the full extend of possible powers. While formidable at high affinity, you’ll never grow to the level of an Avatar of your chosen force.
objects.title: Elemental Realm Connection (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You are magic user from a particular bloodline, characterized by both your unique ability to utilize Synchronicity Wave Travelling and your tendency for rebuking and outsmarting Gods, Demons, Spirits and just about everything else.

You have preternaturally good luck, bullets fly around you, people trip and fall on their own swords, and the cosmic dice are weighted in your favor. Fate cannot touch you as you make your own way, but the very same Fate will bend to make your plans come to fruition, even as it guides your hand into the heart of your enemies.

When you actively ride the Wave -- which requires only that you focus and will yourself to do so -- these effects are amplified drastically. You can stand against beings of immense power and watch as it almost seems as though a writer changes the story to allow you much greater odds of coming out on top. Facing down the ultimate embodiment of evil would spell doom for most any man, but your chances of pulling the wool over the devil’s eyes and walking away with the last laugh are much higher than they would be for just any common schmuck, even if you were just an otherwise common schmuck – but we both know you’re already much more than that, don’t we?

You start of being as experienced as John Constantine with your power, however with time and practice you will be able to gain near godlike power, controlling fate, magic, and even bending the fabric of reality just as the Golden Boy did in one universe.
objects.title: The Laughing Magician (DC Comics: Hellblazer)

addons.text:
Your occult expertise has been elevated to the level of magicians such as Zatanna Zatara, John Constantine, and Doctor Fate, placing you among the most powerful magicians in the world. You are akin to a Sorcerer Supreme, capable of casting complex spells effortlessly, altering their mechanics on the fly, and wielding magic that can manipulate reality itself. You possess an unparalleled mastery of magic and the supernatural, with access to innumerable spells and knowledge so vast it could fill entire libraries.

Your profound understanding of the occult and mystical realms equips you to confront the most formidable forces the supernatural world has to offer, whether they are sorcerers like Felix Faust or gods and goddesses such as Circe. With sufficient time and preparation, this expertise allows you to overcome nearly any challenge.
addons.title: Sorcerer Supreme (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Magic is a natural, primal force capable of influencing events and beings without reliance on the physical world. It is the art of reshaping creation itself; however, to practice it, one must first become aware of its existence and understand how it can be shaped through will. This awareness—often called magical sensitivity—varies greatly among individuals and is notoriously subjective, even among experienced sorcerers. It is not merely a matter of knowledge, but an intuitive grasp of the unseen forces that govern reality. Without this sensitivity, the understanding and application of magic remain beyond reach. Magic also always comes at a cost for those who use it, though the specific cost depends on the type of magic performed and the spell being cast.

The practice of magic relies on two key components: the external and the internal. The external component involves incantations, runes, or a combination of both, functioning as formulas that bind prior knowledge or established spells into a desired outcome. This aspect is considered more accessible, as it depends on research, study, and structured learning. The internal component, however, is far more demanding, as it represents the caster’s intent and the will to rewrite reality itself. It requires unwavering belief in one’s capacity to alter the world, making it the most challenging and defining element of true magical mastery.

Occultism is the practice of understanding and harnessing the hidden workings of magic. Unlike those naturally gifted with magic—such as the Homo Magi—occultists pursue esoteric knowledge to access mystical power, often through rituals, invocations, and ancient texts. You have acquired a profound understanding of magic and its applications, allowing you to perform a wide range of mystical feats. These include astral projection, casting offensive spells such as mystical bolts, creating defensive wards to protect yourself or others, manipulating the elements, exorcising and banishing entities, sensing magical energies, perceiving supernatural beings such as ghosts, and opening portals to other dimensions.

Additionally, you possess an encyclopedic understanding of magical creatures, granting you not only the knowledge to confront them, but also the means to negotiate with them. While this expertise encompasses only what is necessary to qualify you as a competent practitioner of the occult, you may grow stronger through the acquisition of deeper esoteric knowledge, the forging of deals with supernatural entities, and the acquisition and harnessing of power from magical artifacts.
objects.title: Occultism (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Being the host of multiple demonic entities is never easy, especially when you’re managing multiple forms at once. Thankfully, you’re able to skip that specific hurdle.

Whenever you transform into a Ghost Rider, you can choose to manifest whatever demon you have bound to you as a summoned partner. This can take the form of either a summon to be commanded as you see fit, or you can allow the Demon itself control of its body while it’s on the physical plane.

Notably, while summoned you can use the abilities of both of these forms through each other, letting you use the penance stare through your demon and any of its magics as the Rider.
addons.title: Convoy

addons.text: The Sunstone’s pocket plane that holds all of its previous holders as advisors has been adapted slightly, allowing you to not only store your bonded demon there rather than hell (which is likely to render you far less at odds), but store multiple demons within it. While you still need to acquire these bonds normally (though already having a link to hell will certainly make it easier than usual), having multiple forms that you can switch between will be a massive boon. Additionally, the Sunstone can be used over the top of your demonic forms, enhancing it further and giving it access to all of its abilities while allowing it to enhance your forms’ abilities with the Black Flame and protecting you from harm with it’s innate defence.
addons.title: Reprieve from Hell

addons.text:
Rather than binding any old demon, you’ve become bound to one of the rulers of hell, be that Trigon, Lady Blaze, Neuron or more. Far above regular demons, these rulers are of near limitless power in their home realm only capable of being beaten  by the greatest of magical champions and divinities. Projected outwards they’re certainly weaker, but still massive forces in their own right.

As you’re bound to one of these rulers, your own abilities are notably enhanced by drawing from their realm and power. Similarly, taking their form makes you a true demonic tyrant, dramatically more powerful than you were before. 

Still differentiated by the specific ruler you’re bound to, each is still virtually indestructible, and regenerates in seconds from what harms them even in the mortal world. Similarly from this when transformed your magical ability has been enhanced massively, giving rise to illusions, blasts, changing shape, and dimensional traversal as easy as breathing. 

As for more bespoke abilities these still depend on the demon, Trigon is a physical force of nature and a threat capable of breaking worlds with his hands alone, while Lady Blaze is a corruptor and magician first and foremost making her by far the greatest demonologist and magician of them.

Unfortunately, you will still grow weaker over time as their form is away from their realm, but there is a greater risk besides. Like Rachel Roth you’re a living portal to their realm and must retain a level of restraint lest the amount of energy you use allow them into the material world to wreck havoc.
addons.title: Trigon-Bound (DC Comics)
A Mutually Beneficial Relationship
addons.text:
Your naturally soulless nature has made you near royalty in hell. As such you have a far better relationship with your bound demon than you would otherwise. They’ll be more willing to lend you aid and advice, and are far less likely to betray you than they once were.

Additionally, since you’re using their form, they have a level of prestige in hell that’s almost unmatched, being akin to a royal advisor or the periphery of fame. Naturally the specifics depend on your specific demon. An Incubus may find his prestige and influence growing to be greatly beneficial to his station, while a ruler of hell with the ‘Trigon Bound’ addon would see less dramatic benefit due to their already massive prestige.

objects.text: Rise the demon Etrigan! By reciting the rhyme of Jason Blood, you can pull a demon directly from hell itself to take your place in the mortal world while you take its own in hell. Thankfully though, unlike Jason and his particular binding, you will also swap minds during this process, staying in control of the Demon’s body while it’s on the mortal plane. This comes with an additional benefit of tying your fates together, making you immortal unless the Demon itself should die as well, which is exceedingly difficult. The demon itself is incredibly strong, agile and durable, able to lift tons with ease and take hits from kryptonians and remain in the fight. Additionally, when it is harmed it can heal far faster than a normal person, using some of its energy to heal the most grievous of wounds. Its senses are also heightened, able to see further and hear for miles around. Similarly as a direct link to hell, the demon is perfectly able to use demonic magics to do a number of esoteric effects and spells far easier than a moral magician capable of both traditional devils bargains and more traditional schools such as necromancy and scrying. Similarly, summoning hellfire comes naturally to it, able to produce streams of it from the mouth and hands at will. Unfortunately, your body will affect your mind, becoming more attuned to the ‘demonic’ way of doing things. For instance, punishment and cruelty come naturally while in this form, and you will find your personality shaped by it in kind while transformed. Similarly, you have the weaknesses of the form you inherit as well, for instance, as a demon holy items and attacks will do massive damage to you as with any other demon, and knowing your demon’s true name can allow others to bind you. Additionally the longer the body remains outside of hell, the weaker it will become, cut off from its infernal energies. You may choose the aesthetic of your Demon, whether it be a classical beastly demon or a more modern figure like Etrigan. Different demons have various unique benefits, such as wings or razor sharp claws.
objects.title: Gone, Gone the Form of Man... (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You are the latest person to connect to the Shadowlands, giving you a connection to its power comparable to the Shade and Obsidian. You can effortlessly blanket an area the size of Opal City in darkness and, with effort, engulf the entire planet. This darkness can become dense enough to stop even the Atom, or be fired as blasts powerful enough to break Green Lantern constructs.

You can create weapons, guns, force fields, tendrils, and shadow duplicates from darkness, as well as summon Shadow Wraiths capable of taking almost any form. You can also teleport others across immense distances, including from Earth to the Moon, and reach locations between dimensions or within the Starheart.

You can transform into a living shadow, becoming malleable, two-dimensional, intangible, and capable of growing to building size. In this form, your strength is sufficient to kill an Anti-Monitor Shadow Demon in one blow, while your durability allows you to withstand attacks from beings like Doctor Fate and the Spectre. You can absorb energy attacks, making you effectively immortal—even having your heart ripped out by a Black Lantern would not kill you.

Your shadows also grant you telepathy, allowing you to possess others through their shadows or expose them to the darkness within their souls. The latter can mentally incapacitate even hardened killers like Deadshot, though you can also use it therapeutically to help people overcome their fears, inner darkness, or outside possession. Unlike the Shade, your powers cannot be destabilized by heightened emotions or outside possession.
objects.title: Into the Shadowlands (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Your connection to animals and creatures has evolved into something more. You gain a natural connection to all fauna nearby, with you easily being able to touch into their senses and telepathically speak with them.

Skinchanger has evolved your connection, allowing you to tap into the traits of beasts you have tamed would have granted as if they were absorbed. Through this ability and your natural connection to all fauna nearby, you can also do the same for any of the beasts nearby.

Lastly, you have gained the ability to spiritually project a magical replica of a beast your soul houses. If destroyed, they take an hour to regenerate, and while it is regenerating, you cannot access the boost the beast would give.
addons.title: Beastkin

objects.text: You have the ability to leave your own body and control animals that you can bond with. There isn't any hard limit on what kind of animal you can control, but proximity does make it easier to do so. A powerful and skilled skinchanger could keep six or so animals under their control at once. This control can extend towards humans, but it is difficult to dominate their minds and bodies.
objects.title: Skinchanger (A Song of Ice and Fire)

objects.text: You are a wielder of Blood Magic, a dark type of magic that is focused on sacrifice to achieve results. It can be done through ritualized sacrifice or burnings that are used to achieve various magical effects. You can also use this to craft weapons and items such as horns to bind beasts to you, or highly durable and sharp metallic weaponry and armor. You can use fleshshaping arts to craft horrors made of flesh. You can summon assassins made of shadows, and can shape stone like it's clay. You can manipulate fire and create glass candles to scry in areas far away.
objects.title: Blood Magic (A Song of Ice and Fire)

objects.text:
You are a Water Mage, a magic powerful but situational, just like the children of Mother Rhoyne. You draw your strength from water itself and are hence strongest near or ideally on large bodies of water, particularly if in motion, such as a great river or a stormy sea. When in such a location, a true master of water magic can call forth great floods to drown enemies and wash away fortifications, raise mists and fogs to blind and lead foes astray, summon watery shields that can withstand dragonfire, and conjure waterspouts that can swat a full-grown dragon out of the sky. When pushed to the breaking point, they can even call upon the waters to curse their enemies with blights such as the horrific greyscale. Beyond combat, water magic can help find drinkable water even in harsh environments, let dried streams flow again, and, with enough time and effort, make even deserts bloom with life.

However, as you draw your strength from the waters around you, away from it, your magic wanes, growing weaker, leaving a Water Mage who could smite a dragon if by a river, struggle to fend off lone bandits if caught in a dry wasteland. For your magic draws from the water and animates it, you cannot conjure deluges from nothing.

Optionally, you can choose to gain Rhoynish features, namely a slender build, smooth olive skin, and dark hair and eyes.
objects.title: Water Magic (A Song of Ice and Fire)

objects.text:
You have become a Sorcerer as shown in the Sorcerer Apprentice series. A person who is able to access 100% of their brain's power and thus able to manipulate mana to perform sorcery while also granting an increase to intelligence. Spells can either follow the natural laws of physics or ignore them entirely. As such knowledge of physics can greatly benefit this magic power. In its base form mana has electro-magnetic properties that allow it to interact with electronics though can be changed not to. There exist 7 domains that a Sorcerer can manipulate which include Space-Time, Matter, Elements, transformation, Mind, and love. You are given a focus which is typically in the shape of a ring or staff which is needed to cast spells. One of the most common abilities all Sorcerers seem to eventually gain is the ability to grant themselevs biological immortality eternally freezing their age. 

With time it is possible to accomplish anything with this power.
objects.title: Sorcery (Sorcerer’s Apprentice)

addons.title: Grimoire Network
addons.text:
With your ability to summon grimoires, you have a constant network of new spells to learn and cast at your fingertips. On average they will contain spells you are capable of casting immediately based on your current skill level, and some moderately higher than your current one to keep you motivated. Also, they will adapt to your current needs in real time as you summon them, bestowing attack spells to deal with a powerful demon or utility spells to make tedious work more bearable.

The essence pool now becomes a secondary mana pool that's at least half of your current capacity, capable of casting triple a dozen weak spells at worst and three strong spells at best by itself before recharging. 

Should you personally study any of the grimoires you will advance your mastery in them much faster than average, with a full day dedicated to one allowing you to cast specific spells simply by holding it, and a few days to a week to cast half or all of them by having it on your person, or without need for it, becoming a permanent addition to your arsenal.

objects.text:
You are a first class mage, someone who is endowed with the ability to wield magic through usage of your own mana. In order to successfully cast a spell, a mage must have knowledge of the spell via a grimoire or teacher, a strong image in mind of the spell's effect and outcome, and enough mana to cast it. Spells are generally cast through a staff, though some spells do not require it. 

As a first class mage, you stand as a cut above the rest. You know a number of general and basic spells, as well as a personalized type of magic that you specialize in. Your mana capacity and skill in magic sits around the level of Fern, as well as a magic staff customized to your liking.
objects.title: First Class Mage (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text:
Dark Magic is dubious in nature, but isn't always evil. Relying on your knowledge, reason, and magical energy, you are capable of creating basic spell formulas to achieve a variety of minor effects:  manipulating and creating various elemental attacks, creating curses, hexes, talismans, and with some effort, healing wounds. 

The true power of dark magic is its potential, which most users are unable to fully reach. With enough understanding, willpower, and study, dark magic is capable of incredibly esoteric and powerful effects; these include immortality, possession, millennium-long seals, teleportation, spells that ignore magic resistance, soul manipulation, creating cursed (or normal) artifacts, and multi-continental floods (such as those of Sothis). However, due to the rarity and difficulty of dark magic, achieving such effects will require immense training and dedication.

You start with all normal dark magic spells and can select any 3 notable spells of your choosing. You will eventually be able to work your way up to casting legendary spells, such as Apocalypse and Naglfar, with little to no effort.

(With enough time, you are able to do anything with this power.)
objects.title: Dark Magic (Fire Emblem)

addons.text:
You will be soul-bonded to both of your dragons, with them both gaining the positive traits of the other. Both of your dragons now have telepathy, wild magic, an Eldunarí, the ability to cast almost any magic they have knowledge of, and they are both affected by your size-changing spell. Your dragons also now gain the ability to turn weapons into Dragon-Rider equipment through their breath, and your dragon-rider sword now also has the property of being able to kill almost anything while counting as an OoP. Alternatively, you can instead get one dragon that is stronger, both magically and physically, and larger.

Alongside that, you have gained the ability to create a bond with any willing dragon and person, turning them into dragon riders, with the person gaining the same physical enhancements you did and the dragon gaining both an Eldunarí and telepathy. Lastly, your dragonlord powers also expand, becoming fully telepathic towards draconic-like beings while expanding in range, and you can now also telepathically speak to any dragon rider even if you cannot order them.
addons.title: Dragon King

objects.text:
You are now a dragonlord, which grants you one main but powerful ability: the ability to speak to dragons in their language. Speaking in their language is partially telepathic, with you being able to speak to a dragon from impossibly far distances. Through speaking their language, you also gain the ability to control dragons and draconic beings, but stronger dragons may be able to resist your orders, and depending on your orders, they may find loopholes. Being a dragonlord is a hereditary trait, and as such, you have the ability to pass it on to your kids, and unlike an actual dragonlord, you don't have to die for them to gain the ability.

Alongside this ability, you also get a dragon egg, which can only be hatched by a dragonlord by giving them a name. Dragons are creatures of magic and, as such, are highly resistant to any physical or magical attacks, but they can be killed by stabbing their hearts, which are located on the right side. They have multiple abilities, including the ability to fly, to grow to massive sizes while staying nimble, to enchant weapons to kill almost anything, to heal others, and to be capable of casting almost any magic they have knowledge of.
objects.title: Dragonlord (Merlin)

addons.text: You are an elf; specifically, you are one of a variety of elves that hold a connection to an arcanum. Depending on what type of arcanum you choose, you may become a Moonshadow elf, a Sunfire elf, a Skywing elf, an Earthblood elf, a Tidebound elf, and lastly, if you choose the Star Arcanum, you become the rarest type of elf, a Startouched elf. Each type of elf has their own unique ability related to their arcanum and their connection to their arcanum is strengthened. If you choose multiple Arcanums you can only pick one type of elf. If that elf subtype has any rare traits you can choose if you have them.
addons.title: Xadia Elf

objects.text:
You gain a connection to one of the Primal Forces of the world: the Earth, the Ocean, the Sky, the Sun, or the Moon. A connection to the Arcanum allows you to draw its force and manifest it on the world; a connection to the Sky would allow you to make huge gusts of wind, call thunderstorms, and even grow wings. A connection to the Sun would allow you to throw fireballs, surrender yourself to magma, or haze a city in an inferno. A connection to the Moon would allow you to create illusions, concealment spells, and connections with spirits and the veil between life and death.

To draw your spells, however, you need to have a physical connection to your arcanum.
