Water spells would be easier to cast closer to a body of water, while a sky mage or a moon mage would find it difficult to cast spells while underground. Spells are typically cast through the use of Dragon Incantations and runes, with runes having to be drawn precisely either by hand or through the use of a magical foci. 

Besides knowing how to cast spells related to your arcanum, you also know how to create Primal Stones, objects that hold a huge concentration of a specific arcanum energy, enabling more powerful spells even when not near your source. But creating Primal Stones is difficult, expensive, requires the skill of a master-level mage, and requires specific rituals. Through using a Primal Stone others with potential for magic can cast spells from that Primal Source, even if they do not have that connection themselves.
objects.title: Arcanum (The Dragon Prince)

objects.text:
You possess a metaphysical organ known as a linker core, enabling you to absorb and store mana from your environment. While mana naturally replenishes at a slow pace, its restoration can be expedited by converting nutrients into mana. Hence, maintaining good health is crucial for accelerating mana replenishment. Additionally, mana can be conserved in cards or cartridges for future use, including combat scenarios.

Mages and Knights are the common terms for individuals equipped with a linker core. They utilize this core to shape mana into the desired form through a process known as Linking. This process demands intricate energy calculations typically performed by the brain. Predefined programs, referred to as spells, aid in these calculations, facilitating the achievement of magical effects. Mages or knights equipped with devices find it easier to execute these spells. The visualization of these calculations materializes in the form of a magical circle. However, an Anti Magilink Field (AMF) can disrupt spells and active magic utilization.

In addition to conventional linking, some individuals possess an ability known as Mana Conversion Affinity. This enables mages or knights to convert generated mana into other forms of energy, such as electricity or heat, bypassing the intricate calculations required by others. Furthermore, certain individuals can learn to channel atmospheric mana directly into specialized spells called Breaker spells. These spells surpass the limits of their linker core entirely, allowing for the casting of stronger spells at the expense of their health.

Finally, mages begin their journey as C-rank practitioners, with the potential to ascend to the highest rank, SSS. However, achieving this pinnacle requires rigorous training and substantial dedication. The mage rankings range from F to SSS with plus or minus distinctions aiding in differentiation among mages of the same rank. You will gain access to both the Ancient Belkan and Midchildan magic systems, granting you access to various types of spells, one of which includes The Dimensional Transference Spell.   

The Rankings for mages are F, E, D, C, B, A, AA, AAA, S, SS, SSS in ascending order.
objects.title: Linker Core (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

objects.text:
Furycrafting, a magical system in which humans bond with elemental spirits known as furies, allows practitioners to manipulate elements and perform a wide array of tasks, from simple daily chores to advanced combat maneuvers. As a rising Furycrafter, you may either bond with a strong fury of a single element or multiple weaker furies across different elements, achieving similar overall power levels (Street Level). Over time, you can encounter and bind new furies through tests of willpower.

The effectiveness of a Furycrafter's abilities vary greatly, depending on their personal power and the strength of their bond with their furies. Furycrafters might specialize in a single type of fury or bond with multiple types. Furies can either visibly manifest, appearing as animal or humanoid shapes, or remain invisible, sensed only by their crafters.

Furycrafting serves numerous functions. It can be used for mundane activities like heating baths or boosting agricultural yields, as well as for military purposes such as wielding elemental forces strategically in combat. The capabilities of Furycrafting are limited by access to the relevant element and the physical condition of the crafter; excessive use can lead to fatigue or more severe consequences.

Each type of fury grants specific abilities:

Earth Furies: Enhance strength, manipulate earth and stone, create tremors, and detect seismic vibrations. Useful in construction, farming, and combat.
Water Furies: Manipulate water, sense emotions, and enable underwater breathing. Key in healing and espionage.
Air Furies: Boost speed and senses, generate winds, and allow flight. Employed in travel, messaging, and reconnaissance.
Fire Furies: Control fire and heat, enhance eyesight. Utilized in combat, forging, and signaling.
Wood Furies: Communicate with plants, enhance physical prowess, and control wood and plants. Applied in camouflage, construction, and hunting.
Metal Furies: Manipulate metal, enhance weaponry, and increase durability. Useful in combat and forging.
objects.title: Furycrafting (Codex Alera)

addons.text:
The water of Sea Magic is now hyper-conductive to electricity and can utilize its magic-absorbing capabilities to act as an "insulator" for the magic within your lightning, preventing it from dispersing. This essentially allows for your electricity to spread extremely far without losing too much power using the water you control with Sea Magic as a conduit. A thunderbolt could electrify everyone inside of a small lake before dispersing, assuming the lake is under your control. 

To complement this, the lightning under your control now has an innate nature to spread embedded within it. Upon reaching a target and dealing damage, it unleashes a small shockwave to further increase damage. The closer an object is to the center of a shockwave, the more damage it takes. Your water can passively carry this explosion throughout it, ensuring everyone touching it will take some damage, though those closer to the impact will be impacted greater than those far away.

The water you create or control gain a major increase in speed and penetration capacity. Similarly, your lightning gains a weak energy drain, slightly sapping the reserves of anything it targets. This still doesn't increase your starting maximum capacity for water or lightning, so you will have to train to improve them.

Finally, you gain some control over the weather at your current location. You can summon or disperse rain, thunderstorms or a mixture of the two. With enough training, you can control all the water and electricity within your storms, and summon sweeping typhoons and hurricanes. You also gain incredibly minor aerokinesis, though this can only send blasts of wind with the power of a bullet.
addons.title: Lord of Storms

objects.text: "Lightning, nature's fury, the weapon of the gods. Rather enchanting, eh?" You have an affinity with lightning magic, giving you control over various forms of electricity and plasma. You can use this to manipulate already existing electricity, or generate electricity out of nowhere by consuming mana. At your current level, you can do little more than shoot a few blasts of lightning and distort electrical currents. However, with time, research, and practice, your magic can grow to the extent of leveling cities and purging civilizations. As your lightning is magical in nature, it can cause more damage than natural electricity and can penetrate through defenses far easier. Furthermore, you can apply various exotic effects if you know how, such as creating explosions, rending souls, or chaining from one target to the next. Despite being the powerful offensively, lightning also has a surprising number of support uses. You can detect all electrical currents within a 50 meter radius, including nerves, giving you a comprehensive understanding of your surroundings. Furthermore, you have an enhanced eyesight around the level of an eagle. Finally, you have gained a middling resistance to all forms of electricity, heat, and plasma, as well as an increase in your reflexes to the point you seem prescient. At its core, this is an elemental affinity rather than a comprehensive magic system. Thus, it is far more powerful when express through another magic option.
objects.title: Lightning Magic (JRPG Traitor)

addons.text:
Your ability to manipulate entropy has merged with the energy-draining capabilities of your Sea Magic to form something greater than the sum of its parts. Water under your control now gains a dark blue tint. 

The rate at which Sea Magic drains the energy of objects and your opponents has been greatly increased, to the extent that it could fully drain the entire 300 years energy supply of an Endbringer in a few hours if they were fully submerged. A normal human would shrivel up and turn into a lifeless husk in an instant. All of your other attacks and powers now also contain energy-draining properties. 

Whenever you shoot a beam or blast of entropy, it is instead replaced with hyperdense water that would do the same amount of damage. However, you can use this water for future attacks. 

Due to being infused with entropy, the water under your control isn't purely "water" anymore. This means you can usurp water controlled by other hydrokinetics, which they will then be unable to effect.
addons.title: Flood of Entropy

addons.text:
Your deep connection with Irminsul and mastery over water grant you dominion over the greatest source of life—the Primordial Sea. This vast and ancient ocean is the cradle of all existence, the origin of life on Teyvat. However, the Primordial Sea under your control is far denser, deeper, and more powerful than the waters of Teyvat itself.

With this power comes unique abilities. Your control over the Primordial Sea extends to all water, as it is the original source of every drop that exists. Even water gods, such as Poseidon, would be unable to surpass you in this domain. While Titans and Primordial Gods may still pose a challenge, in time, your strength will grow enough to rival even them. Currently, your command over these waters is only at the surface level, but as your connection deepens, you will eventually gain control over the very abyss of this vast sea.

The Primordial Sea resides just beneath Irminsul, feeding and nurturing it. Hidden within a separate pocket space at the heart of the world, it remains protected from those who would seek to misuse its waters for malevolent purposes.

At different levels of control, you will gain the ability to create various forms of life. With the most basic mastery, you can bring forth creatures and animals, all of whom will share an inherent loyalty to you. As your power advances, you will gain the ability to create sentient life with their own souls.  The Primordial Sea functions much like Tiamat’s Chaos Tide—life and souls are born from its waters, and in time, all life shall return to it. Any being touched by these waters is weakened, and those fully submerged will dissolve into nothingness. While life created from the Primordial Sea is most susceptible to its influence, even other beings are affected by its overwhelming presence.

Every world possesses a source of Primordial Water that sustains its existence, and no matter where you go, you will gain dominion over the waters found there. This power also presents the potential for you to become the very avatar of the Primordial Sea itself, much like Irminsul. However, this transformation is only possible if you ascend to the status of an Archon, an Aeon, or a being destined to evolve into godhood. Additionally, should someone create life using these sacred waters without permission, you possess the authority to curse them, just as the Heavenly Principles did to Egeria and Fontaine.

Your power is immense, but it comes with great responsibility. The waters of the Primordial Sea are not to be wielded carelessly, for even the slightest miscalculation could cause it to overflow beyond its cradle and spill into the world. Be cautious, for the fate of existence may rest in your hands.
addons.title: The Primordial Sea

objects.text: "And to the great Sea, I offer blood in libation" — Slidnirari You gain an affinity for sea magic - the mixture of water and dark. Sea Magic spells behave like those of water, but contain an insidious property in the form of mana draining. Any enemies hit with your sea magic will find their magic power fade as they succumb to the depths, and any spells weaker than your own which make contact with your Sea Magic will simply fizzle out. Any magic power drained by this ability is used to refuel your own reserves. You can use Sea Magic to control already existing water, or creating new water out of nowhere through expenditure of magical energy. Your control is extremely precise at the micro scale, allowing you to easily manipulate the density, pressure, surface tension, and permeability of the water. Any water under your control is also further amplified by your magic and any magic it absorbs, allowing for your spells to hit far harder than normal water. When touching water under your control, all your physical abilities are amplified by a moderate degree and you gain a slight increase in recovery rate for any supernatural energies. You also gain a decent healing factor when submerged. However, your large-scale control is not very good. When you first obtain this power, you will only be able to control up to a small pond. However, with immense training and dedication, you will eventually be able to summon endless downpours and part oceans. To clarify, Sea Magic is actually an elemental affinity despite its name. Thus, it is best used when integrated with and expressed through an actual magic system, such as other Magic powers in the CYOA.
objects.title: Sea Magic (JRPG Traitor)

objects.text:
You are capable of using the 3 methods of magic item creation: Enchantment, Alchemy, and Imbuement, together in order to form high-quality components or magical items such as catalysts to enhance magic and weapons which fight by themselves.

Enchanting is the art of applying pre-casted spells onto various materials, objects, and weapons. These effects can either be fueled through an internal magic pool granted to the item, paid by the wielder, or by drawing from ambient mana. Unlike the various potions and constructs produced by Alchemists, enchanted items almost always consume magical energy when activated. Enchanted items get a general boost to durability and strength.

Alchemy is the art of extracting various principles of matter in order to achieve an effect. Alchemy is an art primarily focused on achieving reproducibility over all else, often removing various confounding variables in order to streamline the creation process. Unlike the other creation arts, alchemy focuses more on shaping materials through the use of mana rather than manipulating magic itself. You can use this to refine, transmute, and repair various materials.

Imbuement is an exotic art, focused on the artificial manipulation of mana. Rather than pre-casting a fireball like an enchanter or making a bomb like an alchemist, a master of imbuement would have their pet golem fire a laser for them. Imbuement is generally focused on creating algorithms, which make objects respond by manipulating mana in various ways in specific conditions. 

You can create high-quality magical items fit for adventuring use in a matter of weeks, as opposed to the months or years needed by lesser minds.
objects.title: Craft Magical Items (JRPG Traitor)

objects.text: "Ice, Water sans life. It is thus known as the element that belongs to death." You have been gifted an affinity of ice magic, giving you control over ice and the frigid temperatures around you. With your affinity, you can either create and fire off your own ice with your own magic, or turn the frigid environments around you into your personal playground. You are but a beginner at the start, only able to fire small blasts of ice at your enemies. Do not fret, for with time, research, and training, the world itself can become your very own winter domain. Due to its magical nature, your ice magic is colder than regular frost and cold, and can turn any defense an opponent has into an ineffective, frozen pile of ice. Furthermore, it is the element of death, as any spells used on the poor souls who dared anger you today will see the life slowly drain from them once hit by its spell. Even with its offense, ice magic shines in other ways. You can create walls of ice that even the hottest of flames will have a difficult time melting. As Ice is a derivative of water, you are an excellent swimmer, able to navigate the most shallow or most frigid of waters. And of course, the coldest of environments have no effect on you. Only blizzards can annoy you, and that's because its so damn hard to see. Please note as since this is an elemental affinity rather than part of a magic system, this will only become stronger when expressed through a proper magic option.
objects.title: Ice Magic (JRPG Traitor)

addons.text:
You now have significantly more proficiency in creating and using bonecharms, with you now being able to use your mark to bypass the ritual process. You may now design and create bonecharms with any number of effects, but the more effects a bonecharm has, the more likely it is to get corrupted. 

It is much simpler to construct brand-new bonecharm effects and even to take existing ones and combine them with other bonecharm effects to create a whole new and unique effect. If you have enough skill, you can even increase the effects of a bonecharm through corruption, or at the very least decrease the likelihood of corruption altogether. 

Last but not least, your bonecharms are now growing with you, with the only restriction on how many you can possess being determined by the strength of your mark.
addons.title: Bonecharm Master

objects.text:
You are now granted the ability to make bone charms from Dishonored. You can use bones, special runes, and a ritual to tap into the powers of the void to create any of the canon corrupted bonecharms, black bonecharms, or normal bonecharms. 

Bonecharms are passive or semi-passive abilities, but you may only have the abilities of five bonecharms at once active, with each bonecharm holding one effect, with other people only having three at most active at a time.

You also gain the ability to craft corroded bonecharms, which are supercharged bonecharms that are temporary and break after a predetermined period of time, which is determined by how enhanced you want the effect to be versus how long you want it to last. These special bonecharms do not count towards your bonecharm total, but you only have the ability to hold three active at once.

With time and effort, you may remove the corrupted effect from corrupted bonecharms and possibly even design new bonecharm effects, allowing for greater customization and power.
objects.title: Bonecharms (Dishonored)

addons.text: You are now a genius in every Originium-based scientific field in Terra. Not even the top minds at Rhine Labs may compare to your brilliance. Capable of bringing to life technological wonders, the likes no one has ever seen, once thought to be impossible, breaking through all known records, nothing can stop your genius. With time, research, and a lot of hard work, it's even possible for you to find a cure for Oripathy on your own.
addons.title: At the Cutting-edge

objects.text:
Originium Arts—colloquially referred to as Arts—is a pervasive discipline across Terra, with deep roots in the mysticism of countless cultures throughout history. From the dawn of civilization to the modern era, Arts have evolved alongside society, eventually finding their way into scientific fields and everyday life alike.

In practical terms, Arts are the manipulation of supernatural phenomena through one's will, using Originium as both a catalyst and medium. Their applications are vast and varied, ranging from simple destructive projectiles and large-scale environmental manipulation to healing, physical augmentation, and the transmutation of substances/matter, etc.

The use of Arts also relies on an innate trait known as Originium Arts Assimilation, which lets you harmonize your body with the energy drawn from Originium and release it in various forms, e.g., chemical, electrical, and radioactive.

While most people can perform only rudimentary applications, true Casters are those proficient in wielding Arts consistently and with control; though coincidentally, you are among them. Formally trained under one of the many traditions available around Terra—either from the classical styles of Leithanien, Columbia's modernist methodologies, the unorthodox and esoteric teachings of the Sarkaz, or some others.

Regardless, you'll be equivalent to a fresh graduate. Alongside this, you'll possess an above-standard aptitude for all categories of Arts, and have an Assimilation rate similar to that of an average Caprinae.

<small>Finally, as a freebie, you are provided with a personalized Arts Unit and the know-how to tune, maintain, and repair it properly.</small>
objects.title: Originium Arts (Arknights)

addons.text: Your death attribute charm has evolved. Now, those with broken psyches—the depressed, the lost, the erased, and the despaired—as well as those under hostile mind control are affected by your charm. Your aura fills in the cracks in their souls, worming under master effects, and supplanting addictions. Replacing all ill affects with determination mixed with fondness and adoration for you. This gives those affected the strength and clarity to pick themselves up and recover, while also making them quite faithful and loyal to yourself.
addons.title: Balm for the Broken

objects.text:
You have inherited the death-attribute from the previous Demon King Gudunaris, similar to Vandalieu Zakkart. This means you are now capable of death-related magic, such as necromancy and golemancy. You can create armies of undead and golems, see ghosts and manipulate souls.

You can also eventually learn how to reverse genetic degradation in order to increase lifespans, manipulate your own soul, break the souls of other beings and infuse your death-attribute into metals to create magical alloys that rival Mythril and Adamantite in quality through learning about how to better use your death-attribute magic.

You can exude an aura that charms all death-related creatures into loving, obeying, and protecting you. Beings like ghosts, undead, and ghouls are attracted to you like moths to a flame, though creatures vastly stronger than you can resist your charm or even be outright immune.

However, you can initially create only Rank 1 undead, which can evolve on their own by killing other creatures. As you grow stronger in death-attribute magic, the strength of the undead you can create increases.

Additionally, you are capable of using No-Attribute Magic, a weaker type of magic that doesn't require an attribute like water or fire. In other words, No-Attribute Magic is the manipulation of raw mana.

You also have an immense reservoir of 1 million mana, without being limited by the three curses Vandalieu had.
objects.title: Death-Attribute Magic (The Death Mage Doesn't Want A Fourth Time)

addons.text: Your Black Dwarf Star form no longer uses your life force, but instead rapidly increases the amount of grief in your soul gem the longer you are in that state. From the grief generated, you gain more and more magic that strengthens your abilities. Your transformation is also instant and your mascot can act as your soul gem if you choose, making it completely undetectable except to yourself.
addons.title: Ominous Star

addons.text: You can now modify the appearance of your Magical Girl form, Mascot, and magic however you like to fit your current theme. This also grants you an improved sense of flair for your words that makes anything you say sound cool and dramatic fitting your theme. This does not alter the magic your star gives you.
addons.title: Dress Up Your Star!

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl, your power given to you from a chosen star and given a role to play your most idealized self even if you are unaware of it. The more you act as your idealized self, from how you speak and act, the greater power you can use from your star. Every star is different and can grant a different magic depending on the nature of that star. For example, Vega gives fire-based abilities and Deneb can grant sensory skills. You have a mascot that only you can see and speak to, your mascot also acts as your method of transformation into a Magical Girl. While transformed, you are faster, stronger, and more durable depending on the intensity of your starlight. But even if you are not transformed, you can recover quickly from even near death in a day and stop aging at your prime due to the purified starlight in your body.

You gain starlight from love and peace, by maintaining it through various actions like community service or gathering love from thoughts like self-affirmation, it allows you to grow stronger and even unlock new forms later on should you possess sufficient brightness of your starlight. As you grow, you can develop new techniques or different ways of using your magic to match the latest developments in your journey. You can also sacrifice this power and your life force to transform into your Black Dwarf Star form. A much more powerful state than your current form that, if not canceled, will continuously consume your life resulting in your death. Even if canceled, your mascot will die, you'll lose this power, and you'll live on a limited lifespan ranging from a couple of seconds to 20 years depending on how long you’ve used Black Dwarf Star.
objects.title: Magical Girl (Transformation or Death)

objects.text:
You gain power over Od, the mystic force behind all phenomena in the universe.

In particular you gain mastery of Witchcraft (as practiced by Schierke, Farnese, Flora, Gedfring, & many others, especially on Skellige Island) & Kushan Magic (As practiced by Daiba, Ganishka, the Harashada, & arguably the Bakiraka).

Some abilities of this include manipulation of the four classical elements, mystic protective shields, telepathy & speaking to others without knowing their language, astral projection, creation of magic items, mind control, speaking, summoning, & contracting with spirits & elementals, control of the weather, soul possession, creation of mystic beasts such as the Daka, the Pishaca, & Garudas, levitation & flight, and the many physical powers granted by Kushan yoga.
objects.title: Od Magic (Berserk)

objects.text:
You are now a versatile spellcaster who can use the many subtypes of magic in the Shadowrun universe. Since all Magic comes from the same source & is simply "expressed" differently, you are not limited by class or tradition the way a normal mage might be. Being a Mage, a Shaman, an Adept, and a Technomancer/Otaku all at the same time is possible for you where others might be limited to but one.

You can optionally choose to become a metahuman species of your choice.
objects.title: Awakened (Shadowrun)

objects.text:
You are the Arisen, a being chosen by the Dragon to be the champion meant to defeat it. The process involved in this results in your heart being ripped out, though you still survive. Arisen do not die from age, only from battle. Being Arisen means that you have incredibly potential at almost anything you try your hand at, from magic to archery to sword-fighting. Arisen also are known for their incredible strength of will, which is the criteria by which they are chosen.

Arisen can also command the beings known as Pawns, who are superficially similar to regular people, but lack will of their own unless an Arisen commands them. Every Arisen has a Main Pawn, who is created specifically for them, and grows with them and learns from them. Pawns come from a place known as the Rift, an otherworldly place that connects to different parallel worlds.

You start off with a single Vocation Rank's worth of ability in every vocation from Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen, Dragon's Dogma: Online, and Dragon's Dogma 2. These can include vocations like Warrior or Fighter who use standard melee weapons with incredible strength and skill to vocations like Sorcerer or Mage who are pure casters. There are even hybrid vocations like Mystic Knight and Mystic Spearhand.
objects.title: Arisen (Dragon's Dogma)

objects.text:
You have become a Blazer, a magic knight capable of manifesting your soul as a weapon and wielding magical power.

The weapon a Blazer manifests is called a Device, and each Device has a unique power known as a Noble Art. The form and abilities of the Device reflect the wielder's heart and will evolve as the wielder experiences significant growth or changes in mindset.

By controlling magical power, Blazers can enhance their physical abilities to incredible levels—cutting down buildings, moving at super speed, and shrugging off lethal attacks as if they were nothing. These effects increase in potency based on the amount of magical power used. Even the weakest E-rank Blazers can boost their physical abilities by five to six times their baseline and withstand gunfire with only bruising.

However, despite their power, Blazers have a fixed limit on their magical potential, determined at birth. This limit cannot typically be increased through training. When a Blazer reaches their maximum potential, they perceive black chains wrapping around them, symbolizing the constraints placed on them by fate.

But these limits can be broken. Blazers who reach the end of their given potential yet still possess a tremendous desire and will to improve can shatter the chains of fate and transcend the world's causality. These individuals are called Desperado.

Unlike normal Blazers, Desperado have stepped outside of fate and causality. They can increase their magical power through training and possess the ability to manipulate fate and causality to some extent. Additionally, they are immune to such manipulation themselves.

You can choose to have between C-rank to A-rank level of magical power but the higher your initial limit is the more time-consuming it will be to become a Desperado.

If you possess any other power that frees you from the influence of fate or destiny, or that allows you to transcend your own limits, the chain of fate will instantly shatter, making you a Desperado.

This power also synergizes well with abilities/objects of power that are fueled by your soul or will, merging with them and boosting their potency.
objects.title: Blazer (Chivalry Of A Failed Knight)

addons.text:
Due to Battle Continuation, you can now push far beyond your body's natural threshold into the extreme, surpassing even the critical point at which the body would typically collapse in on itself.

Through this, the backlash of both Ittou Shura and Ittou Rasetsu can be forcibly delayed, allowing you to prolong their use far beyond what should be humanly possible. The cooldown period—time your body would have needed to recover and reacclimate—is rendered meaningless, enabling you to chain these Noble Arts in rapid succession, one after another, without pause or hesitation.

But such defiance comes at a steep price. The more you abuse this, the more your body will deteriorate—ligament by ligament, nerve by nerve—until what remains is little more than ash, gore, and the memory of a warrior who dared to burn brighter than life itself. Tread carefully. For though the will may endure, the flesh is far less forgiving.
addons.title: Overlimit

objects.text:
You've learned to use the Noble Art of Ikki Kurogane—a technique born of desperation, want, and a stubborn refusal to accept his limits, one that gathers every ounce of your vitality, supernatural energy, stamina, and willpower to push your body beyond its natural limits. Overriding all internal safeguards, ignoring survival instincts and pain thresholds to unleash your full potential. While in this state, all of your abilities are amplified tenfold for a single minute, followed by a cooldown period of several minutes before it can be used again.

But beware, this technique comes with significant risks. For an ordinary human, even a single use will be enough to result in an immediate hospitalization. As such, it is generally advised that you only use it once per day unless absolutely necessary. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the power boost is dependent on your physical conditioning—if you are undertrained, the benefits will be reduced as a result.

While in this state, you may optionally choose to suppress certain senses in order to heighten others. For example, shutting down your colour receptors could allow your vision to process movement and form at superhuman speeds, or sacrificing sight might push your spatial awareness and hearing to their absolute peak. These sensory shifts are voluntary and can be adapted to suit your combat needs.

Yet this isn't all of it, as you also possess a secondary, far more extreme technique—Ittou Rasetsu. A refined and devastating evolution of Ittou Shura, it functions by forcibly shutting down all five senses and ceasing all nonessential bodily functions, concentrating your entire existence and compressing it all down into a single instant. In that moment, you gain a one-hundredfold boost in power—a burst of godlike might contained in a single second or action.

This is a technique born of the Rakshasa, exceeding limits beyond limits, transcending humanity into the realm of the Shura, and straining against the boundaries of life itself. But the cost for such power is immense: without immediate medical intervention, the user may die from the overwhelming toll it exacts. Ittou Rasetsu is not to be used lightly—it is a final gambit, a last resort, a blade to cut down your enemies where all others failed.
objects.title: Ittou Shura (Chivalry Of A Failed Knight)

addons.text:
You are no mere Magician, you are a full blooded Yokai, a creature born of Fear and Belief. Your appearance can range from completely inhuman to being nearly human, although there will always be traits which give away your inhuman nature, often relating to whatever species of Yokai you are or whatever Fear you embody if you were born directly from fear.

As a Yokai you lose the need for sleep or conventional sustenance. Instead, you gain sustenance from the fear and belief of human beings. If people do not believe in the supernatural or fear you and/or what you represent, you will wither and fade, starved of energy and power. On the other hand, you can also gain power from fear and belief, the more you are feared and believed in, the stronger you become.

Your spiritual nature grants you an increased affinity for magic and greater physical capabilities, additionally, as fear and belief made manifest you can somewhat shrug off damage which has insufficient "meaning" behind it. You innately specialize in and gain in-depth knowledge of magic relating to whatever your nature is, such as a Kitsune having foxfire and being talented at illusions or a Nuclear Devil innately knowing magic involving Nuclear Fusion.
addons.title: Creature of Fear

addons.text: As a magician who wields the power of Eternity and Duration and is destined to become a Youkai, you inherit the powers of Kaguya Houraisan, the Immortal Princess of the Moon. You gain control over both Eternity and the Instantaneous. With your control over Eternity, you can render things immutable—forever unchanging, unable to be interfered with, unaging, and unbreakable until you release your power. Drawing from your own eternal soul, this immutability is absolute and cannot be overridden. Even esoteric methods, such as temporal manipulation, are unable to affect that which you have declared as eternal as yourself. In combination with advanced alchemical and medicinal knowledge, this power could be used to create an elixir capable of removing the very concept of death from someone’s soul. With your control over the Instantaneous, you can manipulate the countless “instants” that act as the true smallest unit of time, serving as its building blocks. This allows you to simultaneously experience "time the same as others" and "time different from others" in a manner similar to existing in multiple parallel timelines at once, taking multiple undetectable actions at the same time. Furthermore, due to your control over “instants,” you can make a moment last forever or allow eons to pass by in the blink of an eye—although this is more a manipulation of the “perception of time” than time itself. Lastly, you gain the physiology of a Lunarian, with an endless lifespan—something unnecessary given your own immortality—and greatly enhanced physical capabilities, surpassing all but the strongest of Youkai.
addons.title: Hourai

addons.text: As a Magician who wields the power of the Sun and is all but destined to become a Youkai, you inherit the powers of one Utsuho Reiuji, the Hell Raven heir to Yatagarasu. Hosting the power of the Herald of the Sun - gained via eating the God oddly enough - you now wield divine control over both Nuclear Fusion and Nuclear Fission on a level equal to the sun itself. With this you can do things such as conjure “miniature” stars and supernovas, as well as wield gravity and explosions of sunfire with precision using spellwork. You also gain the ability to summon the ‘third leg’ of Yatagarasu in the form of an orange magical nuclear control rod. Finally, you also gain the physiology of a Hell Raven, with the ability to manifest functional raven wings, fully transform into a raven, the innate ability to harness the flames of hell, an immunity to any negative effects of residing in hell, and the standard Youkai attributes - increased affinity for magic, lessened physical needs, greater physical capabilities, etc.
addons.title: Infernal Sun

addons.text:
Your Taoist & Buddhist studies have made you not just a Magician, but a Hermit (or a Celestial/Saint which are effectively the same thing). 

This greatly increases your capacity to cast spells without relying on external sources. As such you can now freely wield the basics of Celestial powers, such as teleportation, riding clouds of lightning & instantly taming beasts. You can now also craft and wield Celestial weapons such as the Sword of Hisou, or elixirs capable of making others into Hermits. 

The worries of other Celestials, such as needing to defeat Shinigami during your Tribulations, or the dreaded five weakeners, are not something you need to worry about at all.

Your potential is equal to that Toyosatomimi no Miko, Kasen Ibaraki, Tenshi Hinanawi, or other eminent Hermits, Saints, & Celestials.
addons.title: Hermit

addons.text:
You are now a Lunarian, a being similar to a Celestial that resides on the Moon, which can live eternally if not killed. This increases your physical & magical strength greatly and gives you near endless stamina. As a side benefit your intelligence is now second only to Eirin Yagokoro.

Normally Lunarians need to live in Pure Lands, places that are free of "Impurity" otherwise they slowly die. You do not need to worry about this however and will always maintain the highest possible Purity.

You have access to the fruits of Lunarian magitech, such as Veils of Moonlight that can facilitate instant travel between the Moon & Earth or barriers that can hide entire cities & other futuristic tech found in the Lunar Capital. 

This does not include the Hourai Elixar, which was created through Kaguya Houraisan's unique power.
addons.title: Lunarian

objects.text:
You are a Magician, someone who devotes their life to the study and practice of magic. More specifically, you are a Magician in the world of Touhou, possessing a level of talent and potential on par with Marisa Kirisame. This extraordinary aptitude allows you to learn, replicate, and innovate magical techniques with remarkable ease, even adapting foreign magical systems for your own use.

Due to the time and dedication demanded to mastering magic, most Magicians specialize in a narrow field—be it enchanted dolls, elemental manipulation, or bodily enhancement. But your exceptional talent gives you a rare advantage: the ability to pursue multiple disciplines, cross-reference magical theories, and blend them into entirely new sorceries and wonders.

What truly sets Touhou Magicians apart is their unique relationship with spiritual energy. While most beings are restricted to powers inherent to their nature, a Magician can—in theory—achieve almost any magical effect, so long as they understand the mechanics and can construct a suitable spell. Though they remain dependent on the materials and energies available to them, their creative potential is nearly limitless. With the right resources and knowledge, even turning a mountain to ash could be a trivial task.

At heart, Magicians are researchers. "Magicians build on observation"—they study the abilities of others, learn from them, and refine what they've seen into something grander. You begin your journey with a solid grasp of magical fundamentals: the ability to fly, conjure basic barriers, and cast magical projectiles. In addition, you possess advanced knowledge in one particular branch, such as potion-making or celestial-themed magic drawn from stars and astronomy, etc.

Touhou magic, in many ways, mirrors science. Both are governed by cause and effect, requiring experimentation, knowledge, and discipline. Magic doesn't happen randomly—no more than gravity or electricity. True mastery demands an understanding of the underlying laws of reality. Yet this kind of magic is also finicky. Its success depends not only on your intellect and soul, but also on timing, location, available tools, and sometimes sheer luck. Fortunately, a bit of good fortune can compensate for gaps in preparation.

In Gensokyo, "Magician" refers to both a profession and a species of Yōkai. These Magician-Yōkai are either born as such or emerge when a human Magician transcends mortality—halting the aging process and severing their need for physical sustenance. Although you've yet to attain this state, the seeds of it lie within you. Upon embracing this path, you gain vague insights—hazy visions of potential methods to reach that transformation. But turning theory into reality is your task, one that demands continued research, discipline, and growth.

Your magical knowledge also extends to the creation of arcane tools and artifacts: ofuda, handheld spiritual reactors, and, most notably, Spell Cards. These cards store magical energy and prepared spells, allowing you to cast them instantly without buildup or incantation. Higher-quality cards can hold more powerful magic, making them essential tools for any serious Magician.

To accompany this, you also possess knowledge of the Spell Card Rules—a magical contract system that substitutes injury with exhaustion. However, pain is still felt, preventing only permanent or lethal harm, transforming battle into a test of skill and spirit rather than brute force. This rule of magical dueling lies at the heart of Gensokyo's culture, and now, it's part of your craft as well.

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Magician (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
You have a connection with a Titan giving you access to their glyphs. This gave you access to their supply of magic so you can fuel the glyphs and made you be able to perfectly draw together with a rudimentary understanding of how to use them, any further knowledge needs experimentation. Glyphs are the language of a Titan and what they use to perform their spells. Titan magic also nullifies the magic of the Archivists.

Glyphs are separated into Light, Fire, Plant and Ice and are activated through intention and touch and create exactly what their name says. The bigger you draw a Glyph the stronger their effect will be. Connecting them through circles, specific positions, sizes and lines allows you to craft a sentence that allows you to create spells that aren't Light/Fire/Plant/Ice.

As a bonus you gain a single vial filled with Titan blood. If it is broken or empty you will gain a new one.
objects.title: Glyphs (The Owl House)

addons.text:
Your power to manifest spells makes your own mana the ultimate material for wands - shaping it directly into staves, blades, gauntlets or any form you desire. Each construct serves as both vessel and conduit for the effects you’d otherwise crystallize, with greater investment producing more potent, stable gear.

These wands remain dynamic: by swapping or combining manifested Spell Crystals on the fly, you change their abilities mid-combat, though every added effect and layer of complexity reserves extra mana to sustain it. To ease this burden, in addition to reduced spellcasting cost, each construct doubles as an arcane battery, storing a portion of your mana to bolster your pool - though it never fully removes the trade-off between wielding potent gear and keeping enough liquid reserves to fuel it. 

As the last resort, you can collapse all stored mana from a wand into a single, devastating attack. In that final discharge, the construct itself unravels, sacrificing its form to unleash a focused surge far beyond normal limits.

You can now also manifest any spell you know directly as a Spell Crystal, with everything that entails. Gambling for new spells remains an option, but you can choose to crystallize any spell you know and understand, giving you more control over your arsenal.
addons.title: Arcane Arsenal

objects.text:
You've awakened with a strange itch in your fingertips, a tingling sensation that hums with chaotic energy, eager to transform into Spell Crystals. These shimmering crystals seamlessly integrate with anything you hold, from a worn leather boot to a rusty pipe. The quality of the material determines the crystal's capacity. A sturdy metal staff can hold multiple crystals, while a twig might shatter after a single, powerful spell.

Creating and casting Spell Crystals expends energy from your internal mana pool. The mana cost is directly tied to the complexity of the Spell Crystals, with more potent Crystals capable of draining your mana in moments. You start with a sizeable mana pool, enough to create a handful of Crystals or cast over a dozen weaker spells, and it recharges back to full within minutes.

At first, the Spell Crystals you create will contain a single random spell or effect from the hundreds in the world of Noita. These range from the mundane – a fireball, a summoned deer, a burst of levitation – to the apocalyptic – a miniature supernova, a pocket black hole, a rain of angry bees.

Beyond basic spells, you can also create Spell Crystals imbued with Meta-Effects. These potent modifiers can amplify the existing spells, doubling their power or area of effect, allowing them to be cast remotely, or even altering their properties in surprising ways.

The true potential of this power lies in combining these Spell Crystals. By attaching multiple crystals to a single object, you can create truly devastating (or hilariously useless) combinations. A "wand" of fire and teleportation becomes a fiery escape pod. A boot imbued with flight and ground slam becomes a personal earthquake machine. The possibilities are as endless as your imagination, and the limitations only bound by the durability of your chosen materials.
objects.title: Knower To Be (Noita)

objects.text: Through chance or fate, you have been chosen to become the next portal master of the Skylands, as the next portal master you gain a vast array of magical powers You can create portals to summon champions called Skylanders to enact your will. At first, when you come to your powers you can only summon one Skylander from each of the ten elements, Air, Dark, Earth, Fire, Life, Light, Magic, Tech, Undeath, and Water. But when you mature with your power you'll have an army of Skylanders at your beck and call. Someday you might even learn how to create a new skylanders out of your imagination; Skylanders grow in strength and abilities every time they're summoned and by completing tasks that you set out for them, when a Skylander reaches sufficient strength you can promote them into either Giant, Swap Force member, Raider, Trapper or a Trainer, Giant Skylanders are stronger, bigger, and tougher than other Skylanders, performing incredible feats, being unparalleled on the battlefield; Swap Force members can switch their body parts and abilities with other Swap Force members, Raiders are faster than other Skylanders and can summon weapons, treasures, vehicles and temporarily terraform landscapes to aid their fellow Skylanders in and out of battle; Trapper Skylanders can create Trap Crystals and cage lifeforms and objects inside them, which after trapping a creature they can summon imprisoned as minions to fight for them. It is almost impossible to escape if the Trap Crystal's nature matches the trapped creature; Trapper Skylanders are immune to being trapped; Trainers can speed the growth of their own and other Skylanders' development, and are excellent team leaders, trainers might be able to teach even you few tricks. Every Skylander is unique and once slain, they will be banished and can be summoned again after few weeks time You have access to great magical strength and knowledge of the previous Portalmasters, gaining great elemental affinity with the ten elements and the ability to perform great feats like peering back in time. Causing tornadoes earthquakes and volcano eruptions, bringing the dead back to Unlife, divining answers to questions, using mystical voodoo to transform people into troll-eating sheep, animate mundane objects to clean for you, spell islands to float forever in the sky, craft airship armadas, exist as a spirit after death, give sage advice, and act mysteriously. After promoting your first Skylander to a Trapper, it is customary to undergo a ritual that coats portalmasters bones in Trap Crystal which draws essence around you giving you a chance to manifest abilities of your Skylanders or foes that you have defeated, in addition sliver of the Core of Light and Darkness has been implanted in your spirit, so you can either bring peace and harmony to the lands or despair and darkness.
objects.title: Portalmaster (Skylanders)

objects.text: “A ‘Sorcery’ is an instinctive command of any one thing you can conceptualize as an element.” — Hecate, Goddess of Magic Sorceries are innate magics that grant you control over an element without the need to cast a spell. You can sense, conjure, vanish, and manipulate your element, limited only by your understanding of the element, creativity, and raw power. All Sorceries have two levels: Lesser and Greater. These levels reflect your level of talent with that Sorcery. For example, a Lesser Fire Sorcery would allow you to easily create fireballs but not grand infernos, while a Greater Earth Sorcery would enable you to create an island overnight, provided you have the necessary raw power. Examples of Sorceries include: Earth: The power to manipulate naturally occurring elements like magma, gold, and more. The rarity of the material determines the difficulty of conjuration. Fire: The ability to manipulate fire, from exothermic reactions to plasma. Technically, you control the vibrations of subatomic particles, allowing you to create fires, manipulate heat, and with sufficient knowledge, even electricity. Air: The ability to control atmospheric gases. This can be used to provide air in enclosed spaces, stoke fires, create vacuums for preserving food, or deprive enemies of oxygen. Water: The ability to manipulate water. Water is present everywhere—in the air, in the ground, or in a body. Water Sorcery can also be used for healing. Flesh: The ability to manipulate the biology of anything you touch. While the easiest application is healing, it’s not limited to that. You can do incredible things, such as changing genders, reshaping bodies, altering biology enough to turn people into other races (like catgirls), or copying traits from animals, such as a dog's keen sense of smell. With enough practice, you could even grow a full body from a drop of blood. Though it would have no soul, but you would have a full body to experiment on. This magic can also be applied to yourself just as easily. Mana: The ability to manipulate the energy of magic itself. This can be used to craft or reverse-engineer spells, apply enchantments, manipulate energy, or with enough skill, absorb or disrupt spells. It also allows you to see magic at will, making it trivial to detect the effects of enchantments, curses, and spells. Life: The ability to control the forces of life itself. This could include accelerating or halting the growth of plants, commanding the aging of living beings, or even manipulating the life force within organisms to heal or harm. Spacetime: The ability to manipulate the fabric of space and time. This could be used to bend space for short-distance teleportation, slow down time in a localized area, create small pockets of altered time flow, or even open portals across great distances. With enough practice and talent, you could even create your own pocket dimension. You will receive a Greater Sorcery of your choice. Getting additional Sorceries would require you to perform certain sacrificial rituals, make pacts with gods, or engage in similar acts. However, you do not receive any knowledge of how to do this. For simplicity, your starting pool of mana is directly proportional to the number of Sorceries you have access to. A Greater Sorcery provides mana equivalent to that of a mage who has been studying and practicing magic for several years. A Lesser Sorcery grants half of that amount.
objects.title: Sorcery (Daniel Black)

objects.text:
You wield the magic system of the World of Twelve, utilizing the mystical power of Wakfu. Wakfu is nearly omni-applicable and can be utilized in many ways, from manipulating plant life and taming animals to shapeshifting and slowing time. The usage of Wakfu is basically a soft magic system but lends itself particularly well to acts of life and motion, owing to its nature as the very energy of creation, life, and motion. Your personal reserves of Wakfu scales with your life force, as befitting of the energy of life itself.

Of course, you only start with the basics of how to manipulate Wakfu, not any specific usages aside from things like subconsciously reinforcing your physical capabilities, so much of your usage is going to be trial and error until you figure out how to do things unless you possess some other means of gaining knowledge. Furthermore, truly grand acts of power carry enormous energy costs, so you won’t be carrying out divine miracles without either truly gargantuan Wakfu reserves or a way to store Wakfu for later.
objects.title: Wakfu (Dofus)

objects.text: Sometimes when two strong spells collide, negative energy is produced where the spells meet. Like Vincent and Noah, you have learned to harness negative energy, the antithesis of world magic, into your spell repertoire. Negative energy seems to do infinite damage, but only over a certain amount of mass. Once the negative energy deletes that amount of mass, it evaporates. While some spells and skills are restricted to one class or another for players of World Tree Online, you are not restricted to what you can learn and use. This power also gives you basic background knowledge into frequencies, which all spells of World Tree Online use. You start with Vincent’s Void Gun and Gravity Shield with no upgrades, but further spells you must develop yourself. Warning: both Vincent and Noah needed years to develop individual negative energy spells and also didn’t need to worry about permanent death if a developing spell turned against them, so be careful when experimenting!
objects.title: Negative Energy (World Tree Online)

objects.text: Though traditionally reserved only for children, you’ve been granted the training and education of an apprentice magician. One of the most important parts of this involves the selection of a new name for oneself, for beware Names have power, it is names that allow you to call spirits from the Other Place, and if they should ever discover your true name? You are unlikely to either enjoy or survive the consequences. This training ensures you have a good memory for the incantations, and the lengthy and tedious process of inscribing magical circles, either drawn or carved onto the ground, one to act as protection for the magician, and one to act as the cage for the spirit, until they are bound. This power only gains you the basic level training and knowledge of how to call spirits from the Other Place able to summon, and most importantly bind them to your command. Without greater power, practice and experience, you will be only able to summon and bind Imps and Foliots, the weakest forms of spirits. Spirits can be bound to objects, forced to perform whatever task is expected of them until they are released. With this comes limited ability to see into the second and third of the seven planes, and therefore see through the disguises of lesser spirits. You have the ability to naturally intuit the names of spirits with time and meditation.
objects.title: Apprentice (Bartimaeus Sequence)

objects.text: Holy Magic or Luxa is a type of magic where it is most effective against demonic and supernatural entities. It has two main properties: 1. Light Arts/Koubo: These Arts created weapons from light which are described as having the properties of steel while having weight similar to feathers. Using these Arts consumes a portion of the casters’ magic. They can be used for both offense and defense. These weapons are personalized by the user as a whole, composed of your way of life, your way of thinking, and more. 2. Cleansing: Cleansing is used for the removal of negative factors such as injuries, diseases, and evil intent. It is also very effective in countering demonic, undead, and supernatural entities which is the main use for the power. As long as you have Mana you can always use Holy Magic. its versatility heavily depends on the creativity of the user, such as compressing it into marble for emergency use or conjuring it on other people as a substitute for the real weapon. You are a conduit. This means you can grant this power to other people in who they receive the entirety of this power except its upgrade, add-on, or the ability to be the conduit.
objects.title: Holy Magic (I was reincarnated as the 7th prince)

objects.text:
You have inherited the magical abilities, talent, and knowledge of Lloyd de Saloum, the seventh prince and undisputedly the strongest being in his world.

Like Lloyd, you are a prodigy in both the study and use of magic. You can analyze and comprehend any supernatural concept you encounter, allowing you to master an entirely new school of magic or supernatural discipline after merely observing it in action or receiving a brief explanation.

Your understanding of magic is so vast that, if written down in its entirety, it would form a literal mountain of books. This immense knowledge allows you to cast spells across a wide array of disciplines: manipulating the elements, transmuting objects, splitting souls, teleporting people or objects, warping space itself, and much more. Beyond conventional magic, you are also a master of Qi, Alchemy, and Holy Magic.

Your mastery enables you to cast hundreds of highly potent and complex spells simultaneously, each capable of tearing massive chunks from a planet’s surface. Coupled with the immense size and density of your mana reserves, you can spam such spells repeatedly without ever worrying about exhausting your magical power.
objects.title: Monster of Sorcery (I was reincarnated as the 7th prince)

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to summon Materials—beings from beyond human understanding—using a flexible and dynamic system that surpasses traditional summoning rituals. Unlike conventional summoners, you have the freedom to create, modify, and customize rituals to suit any environment, from forests to cities, and can use any physical object or entity as a vessel for summoning. This mastery also grants you the power of all five Summoning Ceremonies, allowing precise control over the summoning process and the materials you summon, from Regulation-Class constructs to powerful Unexplored-Class entities embodying fundamental metaphysical concepts.

The Summoning Ceremonies grant you progressive capabilities, starting with reshaping physical and mental states (First Ceremony), establishing communication with supernatural entities (Second Ceremony), and summoning Materials from different classes (Third Ceremony). The Fourth Ceremony introduces strategic depth, allowing you to evolve Materials in real-time through symbolic harmonization. The Fifth Ceremony is the pinnacle of summoning, merging you, your vessel, and your Materials into a unified entity, enabling you to manipulate abstract concepts such as life, justice, or entropy to reshape reality itself.

Like Kyousuke Shiroyama, your summoning abilities are further enhanced by Wisdom, an omnipresent force that guides your understanding and helps you navigate the complexities of the system. Wisdom offers intuitive insight during rituals, reveals hidden synergies between symbols, and ensures that your summoning practices remain balanced, especially during the Fifth Ceremony, where merging with your Materials demands careful control to prevent destabilizing consequences. Wisdom also aids in adapting rituals to shifting circumstances, ensuring your mastery remains dynamic and adaptable in the heat of battle.

Materials are immune to ordinary physical attacks and conventional weapons, only being affected by other supernatural forces. Materials fall into three classes. Regulation-Class Materials are human-made constructs such as golems, homunculi, or mechanized beings, which you can design with traditional or modern symbolism, such as a doll armed with alchemical weaponry or a clockwork knight infused with time essence. Divine-Class Materials include mythological beings and legendary creatures such as gods, spirits, or phoenixes, whose attributes you can reimagine to fit contemporary interpretations or novel domains. Unexplored-Class Materials, the most powerful, embody fundamental laws and metaphysical concepts like justice, life, or entropy. These beings not only shape reality but represent the forces that govern its existence, such as "The Spirit of Eternal Flame" symbolizing the endless cycle of creation and destruction or "The Lady of 'Purple Lightning' Who Separates Good from Evil," a judge of morality and balance. The symbolic essence from which each Material is shaped influences its power and stability, and careful consideration is required to avoid creating contradictions that could lead to catastrophic failures, such as the appearance of the Black Maw.
objects.title: Summoning Ceremony (The Unexplored Summon://Blood Sign)

addons.text:
The legendary Silver Crystal amplifies you to a new level of power, which gives you powers similar to those of Sailor Moon. All of your Sailor Guardian powers are enhanced by an order of magnitude. Feats such as leaping from the Earth to the Moon, purifying an entire planet, faster than light travel and many more are now possible, and you will continue to strengthen over time. You are a champion of the cosmos and can face almost any threat.

You also gain a natural aura of royalty. This comes with innate grace and charisma, coupled with a new transformation worthy of a queen. People naturally defer to you and you make friends as easily as you breathe. 

With the Silver Crystal's power you are ageless and eternally youthful, free of disease and other mortal weaknesses. You can bestow this blessing on others freely, and even on an entire planet.
addons.title: Moon Princess

objects.text:
You are a Sailor Guardian, a planetary protector and magical girl imbued with great power. Your soul is a star seed, the source of your powers and your connection with your planet. This provides you with a large amount of magical power that grows as you develop your powers. You can choose the planet to be the guardian of, or alternately choose a moon, meteorite or other celestial body. You can transform into a Sailor Guardian at will and gain a magical transformation item that enables to you assume your Sailor Guardian form. 

Outside of your transformation, you enjoy low end superhuman physical abilities and one or two other supernatural abilities, such as precognition or elemental control. Once you transform, you have increased superhuman physical abilities, a perception filter that protects your identity and a single powerful magical attack. Your magical attacks follow a particular theme, such as fire, water, love or storms. You can improve all of these over time and develop new attacks and powers, often at times of great emotional stress. 

Examples of powers you might learn are flight, teleportation, telekinesis, telepathy and many more. 

As magical girls, Sailor Guardians are beautiful and you'll become beautiful to match.
objects.title: Sailor Guardian (Sailor Moon)

objects.text: Across the boundless realms of possibility, in the Second Timeline, a small orange cat with a human head brimming with chaotic energy perks up from his resting spot. He turns his gaze towards another timeline. Shifting into a more human-oriented form, his feminine face rises into a smug grin, eyes twinkling with excitement as he raises his hand. A fragment of his magical power is sent out into the infinite, flying right into your chest, unable to be separated from the core of your being. Goddess help us all, we got another one. You have inherited the magic wielded by Xiod Tensei, the-MAGICAL CAT! Xiod uses a variant of Power Words, where the effect of a given word when evoked is changed by how the user defines or understands the word. Now you, too, have this magic. Unfortunately, any potential for new words to be discovered and redefined by you has been sacrificed, as the Magical Cat has locked in a singular word you have access to, just like him. Now you have begun walking the path of hyperspecialization, to focus all potential that you have for this magic into a singular word for maximum potency. You have inherited the only word Xiod knows and the definition he made for it. The word in question being the Power Word, “SCRUNKLE”. SCRUNKLE is defined by Xiod as a small animal, cute in their appearance. As the self-proclaimed ‘paragon of cuteness’, Xiod believes this word means ‘Xiod’ himself. So to find out what it means to be ‘Xiod’, he looked into himself to find what made up his Center, the core of his being, and found only Chaos. Everchanging, Entertaining, Wondrous Chaos. Thus, Xiod defined the word “SCRUNKLE” as ‘Chaos untamed. Wild but not malevolent. A being that seeks entertainment and lets the whim of chance carve his path, but not guide it.’ This definition is engraved into your Center as well. When this Power Word is evoked, the whims of chance resonate from your voice, manifesting random attacks, events and/or creatures from each usage. The possibilities of this word is seemingly endless, but never useless. No matter how destructive or horrid whatever comes from it may be, it will always have a viable purpose or use for you. All you have to do is find it. To channel the Power Word effectively, one must seek to have fun. The more fun you wish to have, the more powerful effect the Power Word will bring. Alternatively, you can be super boring channel magical energy into your voice to enhance the effect. There are a few limits to this magic. Firstly, until you reach a level of power directly independent from your proficiency in your Power Word, you will be unable to use the Power Word to manifest anything or anyone on a level that you yourself cannot defeat or destroy on your own. If you cannot feasibly destroy a planet by yourself, then no matter how many times you evoke the Power Word, you will never manifest something that has the potential to destroy a planet. That doesn’t mean that the possibility of something that can harm or even put an end to you is off the table, mind you. Secondly, is that your Power Word, while very cheap for you in comparison to a Power Word user who didn’t harbor such a massive affinity towards it, is still expensive and can be quite stressful on your body. Evoking your Power Word numerous times will quickly put your body in a grievous state, so using it sparingly and giving yourself time to recover is recommended. Practicing this magic will help reduce the strain it puts onto your body. The Cat of Chaos has given you his blessing. Make use of it, and most importantly, have fun!
objects.title: Voice of The Magical Cat (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
I Shall Become One with God

- Mayo Lich

You have acquired the forbidden knowledge pioneered by the Mayo Lich—the power to command souls. In a desperate attempt to escape a sacrificial ritual to the Benevolent Goddess, the Mayo Lich uncovered the secret of survival without a physical body. He learned to interact with souls directly, possessing and manipulating objects, including his favourite form made of mayo. When you possess an object, you gain its properties: for instance, the fluidity and shapeshifting abilities of mayo, allowing you to take on various forms. Beyond this, your power extends to controlling the souls of others. You can extract them from their bodies and force them into different vessels, objects, or substances of your choosing, reshaping their essence to suit your needs. In addition, you can summon the souls of the dead through objects they once cherished. By using these personal items as conduits, you call forth their spirits, binding them to the physical world once again. You can also combine multiple souls into a single object, particularly those with deep connections to each other. When souls that share strong bonds are fused together, they form a superstate—a singular entity of amplified strength and abilities. However, this fusion is fragile, and the superstate can become unstable, risking collapse if any doubt in one another appears.
objects.title: Mayo Lich (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
“What? An Anaqi was raised by Symbol? The ‘Magical Boy of the Sky’? Curse you Symbol!”
—Excerpt from a Conclave within the Citadel of Anaqi

Your magic is born from a deep and natural affinity with the timeless spirits of the wind. The breezes whisper secrets to you, and the gales recognize a kindred soul in your restless heart. This innate kinship means the spirits are inclined to listen to you, finding your presence harmonious and your will aligned with their own playful, untamed nature. However, as a beginner, your grasp of their complex, sighing language is instinctual and raw; you lack the formal grammar, nuanced punctuation, and the storied reputation needed to make great demands.

At the start of your journey, you can ask the winds to carry you aloft, granting you the gift of flight as you surf upon their currents. You can plead for them to gather into fierce storms or to breathe out a winter's chill, shaping the immediate weather around you. Yet, these commands are requests, not decrees. Your power is limited by your rapport and the local spirit's mood; a particularly stubborn or contested gust may simply ignore you, and your influence extends only as far as the natural wind might plausibly go, unable to truly defy the climate of a place.

As your understanding deepens through practice and communion, your power grows in both scale and defiance. You learn the precise dialects of the winds, building a reputation as a true speaker and a worthy ally. Your authority expands, allowing you to command impossible weather, from calling a torrential storm in the heart of a parched desert or summon a blistering, dry wind to scour an icy tundra.

With practice and dedicated partnership, you can achieve partial oneness with the wind, able to transmute parts of your body into swirling air. At this level of mastery, you no longer need to be carried; you can become the current, propelling yourself with a thought. You can channel the storms directly, manifesting forks of lightning from your fingertips without the need to summon a cloud, or letting a gale howl from your outstretched palm.

The ultimate expression of your bond is a full and willing transformation into a being of pure, sentient wind. In this form, you are untouchable and boundless, capable of dispersing to avoid harm, flowing through the smallest crack, or coalescing into a titanic tempest. Your connection with the wind spirits becomes seamless and absolute; having proven yourself through a lifetime of symbiosis, your will and theirs are in such perfect concert that your commands are simply the wind choosing to act. They will never deny you, for you have become a cherished and sovereign part of their eternal chorus.
objects.title: The Great Magical Sky (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
The gears in your head have begun to turn with new ideas and grand designs. From the world of Fantasy Gear, you have gained knowledge on how to perform the art of Gear Crafting. 

Gear Crafting is done by performing a true and earnest act of creation such as painting, poetry, or anything else that you could consider “art”. From this performance, you generate what is known as Charisma, which is then imbued into different substances with your will and intentions, transforming them into gears. Using a gear requires it to either be on your person or smart enough to activate itself. Based off your intentions, the gear will become one of four different gear types. These are in no particular order:

- Protective Gears: Theses gears are dedicated to protecting you from various kinds of attacks. These include both physical, mental, or other more esoteric forms of attack.
- Offensive Gears: These gears are dedicated to attacking your enemies in various ways. One gear could shoot out fire balls while another sings catchy but annoying songs to break their concentration.
- Observation Gears: These gears are dedicated to gathering or even relaying information in different forms. You could have one gear focused on clairvoyance to locate treasure or another that just acts like a normal computer.
- Alteration Gears: These gears are dedicated to changing the environment of the world around you. While there is some overlap with other gear types, these gears can also perform more esoteric feats such as localized time stops or creating portals.

While any gear could reach into other categories because of their abilities, the core of their power will always be tied to their main category. It is possible for gears to affect each other, but this typically requires one or more of the gears involved being specifically designed to augment or combine gear effects.

Almost no two gears are alike, even if they share the same type and function. This is because each gear has their own personality and degree of sentience. Their sentience can range from barely any to indistinguishable from a human. The more sentient they are, the more powerful the gear. A gear can also increase their power through learning or being taught, however this requires that the gear is sentient enough to be able to learn. It is possible to manually upgrade a gear to make it more sentient, but this becomes harder the more sentient a gear is.

The first method is known as Benign Changing, which is a relatively simple method for increasing the gear’s intelligence, and by consequence, their power. This method requires replicating the original feat that created gear and then taking the feat ‘further’ in some way. This method is considered the standard but is the most difficult due to both the knowledge and talent required.

The second method is known as Dark Changing, a forbidden path that involves overwriting the original gear. This method is akin to a blood sacrifice as it involves killing the original personality of the gear to replace it with a new one. While it is easier, its dark nature means it has a chance to twist the gear into something evil.

When a crafter is experienced enough, they have a chance to gain a Personal Gear. These gears are created by a very deep, single moment of skill and dedication that no one can truly predict. The gear that is formed from this moment will essentially be a lifelong companion for the gear crafter. They will have human intelligence, can be summoned and desummoned at will, and will possess the powers that would best complement and augment the bearer’s own abilities.
objects.title: Gear Crafting (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆ - Fantasy Gear)

objects.text: You master the ancient art of Merlin’s Sign Magic, a spellcasting technique that relies on performing intricate hand signs in rapid succession. Each spell effect is unlocked by a unique combination of gestures, including finger snaps pressing a finger to your palm, claps, sweeping hand motions, and tapping fingertips together in rhythmic patterns. When performed swiftly and precisely, these signs allow you to summon a variety of magical effects, offering incredible versatility in both combat and exploration. With this skill, you can transform yourself into creatures like birds for stealth and agility, duplicate objects to multiply resources, animate trees and natural objects to act as loyal minions, conjure shimmering shields to block attacks, or channel energy through your hands to heal wounds. With enough time and experimentation, you can create any type of spell.
objects.title: Sign Magic (The Kid Who Would Be King)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of the occult has broadened your perspective on magic, providing you with knowledge of the major magical traditions across the SCP universe. You now have basic knowledge of the magical practices used by every major Group of Interest, including but not limited to the flesh crafting techniques of Sarkicism, crafting blue lily chains from the Serpent's Hand, and the basics of Anart from Are We Cool Yet. 

While the depth of your knowledge may be shallow, the extensive breadth of your knowledge more than makes up for it.

This foundational knowledge, combined with your talent in occultism, has significantly advanced your mastery of Thaumatology. You have gained deeper insights into the nature of "magic" as a whole and your skill in experimenting with magical practices has greatly improved. You also have become a genius at analyzing and adapting to foreign magic through the lens of Thaumatology.
addons.title: Jack Of All Magic

addons.text: You have touched divinity, your divine nature distorts the very laws of the world. Your status as a divine enables you to cast spells without suffering the backlash that would typically destroy mortals. Your immunity to backlash grants you the potential to cast spells that mortals can only dream of. Additionally, your divinity provides enhanced protection against those attempting to manipulate the world around you. You possess a high resistance to reality-warping and magical effects.
addons.title: Demiurge

addons.text:
