Demon Summoning, Spirit Calling, Celestial Manifestation—many names exist for the art of summoning. The Global Occult Coalition suggests that summoning may not create beings but instead impose a summoner’s beliefs onto a form, shaping its intelligence and characteristics. Whether these entities are newly formed or merely altered remains a mystery.

What is undeniable is your mastery of Constructed Intelligences. Whether summoning a cat familiar, calling demons, or invoking a pagan deity, your skill in establishing binding vows has refined your summoning and pact-making abilities.

You can now 'summon' entities based on your beliefs and make them manifest. However, in line with the principles of binding vows, these summoning's and pacts follow the principle of equivalent exchange. You cannot simply conjure an all-powerful, benevolent spirit from nothing without extensive practice and the necessary offerings. Furthermore, such beings, especially more potent ones like demons, often have strong limitations, inherent risks or tendencies to betray you.

The enigmatic nature of summoning ensures that no Constructed Intelligence is ever truly the same. Even if you summon from the same race repeatedly, differing conditions will make each manifestation unique. You might summon a dragon from your dreams, call upon Hell itself, or shape an intelligence from the void. The unpredictable nature of these entities means even external forces cannot guarantee their loyalty. The only certainty lies in the binding vows that govern them, the foundation of all your interactions.
addons.title: Constructed Intelligence

objects.text:
You are a Type Blue, a thaumaturge—a practitioner of magic. You’ve gained a foundational understanding of Thaumatology, the study and application of magic as a science governed by its own laws. It follows three core principles: “Like Produces Like,” “The Part Affects the Whole,” and “Observation Changes Reality.”

Thaumaturgy relies on EVE—Elan-Vital Energy—emitted by all living things, with higher sentience generating greater amounts. EVE acts as the bridge between mind and matter, allowing conscious beings to manipulate reality. When concentrated, it forms Aspect Radiation (ARad), a potent energy capable of bending reality. ARad has four qualities: Intensity (power), Hue (visibility), Pitch (creative or destructive nature), and Weave (integration with reality). Understanding these traits allows thaumaturges to predict and control ARad’s behavior.

Thaumatologists channel EVE and ARad through rituals, symbols, and tools to achieve effects such as scrying, teleportation, curses, summoning, and elementalism. However, magic resists control and often "pushes back" through backlash. Poorly managed ARad can distort its traits, turning a protective spell destructive—like a failed fire ward summoning flames instead. Skilled thaumaturges learn to redirect or neutralize backlash, sometimes even twisting it to their advantage.

Your knowledge of Thaumatology is comparable to that of a GOC trainee. You understand basic spells and the path to more advanced techniques, but your potential isn’t confined to thaumaturgy alone. Given enough time and experimentation, you may harness or even create other forms of magic found in the SCP universe. However, developing new magic from scratch is an immense undertaking, requiring decades or even centuries of research and practice.
objects.title: Type Blue (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: The light of the invisible sun shines against the worlds. When a War in Indigo under the light of truth threatened to swallow you, you fled. You shrouded yourself into the Grey, a world smothered in banal nothings where the light of the Invisible Sun, Magic, can barely penetrate. Now you’ve escaped again back into Indigo. The Vislae are by all accounts a species unto themselves, but in all ways they differ from a Human can be summed up through the Testament of Suns. a six-fingered ritual object that most Vislae carry to demonstrate the six parts of their soul. Such is the nature of the Testament that most Vislae introduce themselves through reciting it’s less sensitive parts. ‘I am a [KA] [LA] of [TOR] whom [DA]. Tor - The first finger denotes the Order of a Vislae, and the way they express their magic. The four main Orders being; Vances who store living spells within themselves before releasing them. Makers who are enchanters and artificers all, Weavers who take concepts form the world and weave them together to provide magical effects, and Goetics, who summon, speak to, and bind magical creatures and spirits. (There are also the Apostate, who deny the orders themselves as partake in fused or stranger magics besides. Some going so far as to reject the Testament of suns for a symbol called the VERTULA KADA, A Testament absent of Order). La - The heart of a Vislae, governing how they act in their truest self. From the Empath to the Galant. Da - The Forte of a Visale. The Forte is what one does and the path they walk. A Vislae’s primary identifier besides their Order, and which itself conveys magic related to its remit. A Vislae who Consumes Flesh may gain benefits from its consumption, for instance, while one who Bares an Orb gains powers both from and imbued into said Orb. Forte are also usually evident in the appearance of a Vislae, as many do not appear outwardly human. A Vislae who Hosts a Legion may be covered in patches of flesh not their own or eyes that look with their own will for instance. Tu - The Soul of a Vislae. The first of the more secret aspects of a testament, the Soul governs not what the soul of a Vislae is made of, but which allegiance it has, akin to a star sign with metaphysical ramifications. One whose soul falls under the Child will be very different to one under the Guardian or Eye. Ka - The Foundation of a Visale. Ka is the representation of how a Vislae lives. A Vislae’s home in Satyrine, the prize city of Indigo is tied to their soul in a peculiar way. It is no pocket dimension but reflects them in kind. A Vislae who’s connected and established may have a great manor home as their Foundation, while more bizarre and unstable figures can have increasingly abstract and strange foundations. Ver - The Arc of a Vislae. Vislae are creatures of Magic and Magic’s drive is to change. A Vislae’s Arc denotes how they will change. A Vislae cna go through many arcs in their life (Rebirths, Vengeances, Cleansings etc), but the fact they do so empowers and recharges them, being the primary method of advancing their magical ability in both order and Forte. A Vislae must never stop moving. Do you feel the heat of the Invisible Sun?
objects.title: The Heat of the Invisible Sun (Invisible Sun)

addons.text:
You have the remarkable ability to merge magic with technology, creating appliances and tools that seamlessly integrate magical spells into everyday functions, bridging the gap between traditional magic and modern convenience. By utilizing mana as an energy source and embedding it into mana crystals or circuits, you power enchanted devices that mimic or surpass modern technology, such as refrigerators that use cooling spells or heaters fueled by fire magic.

This system heavily relies on expertise in magical circuits, which regulate the flow of mana and allow for stable operation, and the incorporation of enchantments to imbue devices with specialized functionalities. It could easily combine with other forms of technological or magical enhancement, creating multi-layered tools and gadgets with extraordinary capabilities. However, this system is severely hampered without a consistent mana source or the knowledge to maintain and repair enchanted mechanisms.
addons.title: Household Magitech (Yu-Shibu)

addons.text:
You treat magic as applied mathematics, merging ritual practice with computational methods to make occult forces predictable—at least in theory. Spells become code, sigils become programs, and rituals act as the hardware layer that runs them.

With this approach, you can build devices and systems that combine the precision of calculation with the raw power of traditional magic. A summoning circle functions like a firewall, a blood sacrifice provides entropy for stability, and chants act as loops to keep processes running without collapse. The result is technology that channels curses, divinations, bindings, or even necromantic animation as if they were engineered functions.

Your creations can operate with a degree of autonomy—interpreting divinations, animating servitors, or establishing sympathetic links between objects and people—but they remain subject to the usual risks of magical computation: leaks, feedback, or dimensional intrusion. Everything works because the math is sound, but the danger lies in the fact that the universe itself is not a safe operating system.
addons.title: Computational Demonology (Laundry Files)

objects.text:
A Magi Craft Meister is a rare craftsman who seamlessly combines the disciplines of Ether manipulation and engineering, creating groundbreaking constructs and tools that push the boundaries of possibility. Central to this craft is the mastery of Ether circuits and the transformation of raw materials—metals, crystals, and rare gemstones—into Ether-infused counterparts. These enhanced materials form the foundation of magitech—technology sustained and empowered by Ether.

Your journey begins with the study of basic Ether theory and engineering principles, focusing on concepts such as Ether flow, the properties of meta-materials, and elemental energy manipulation. Early projects often involve crafting practical tools and simple devices powered by your Ether or small Ether reserves. Examples include elementally enhanced tools, self-repairing mechanisms, and other innovations that demonstrate the symbiosis of Ether and engineering.

As your expertise grows, you develop the ability to design and inscribe Ether circuits, the intricate frameworks that control the operation of constructs. These circuits serve as the lifeblood of magitech, channeling Ether efficiently and effectively to power your creations. Through experimentation and refinement, you evolve from crafting basic tools to designing complex mechanisms capable of autonomous or semi-autonomous functionality.
 
A key milestone in a Meister's path is mastering the creation of Ether cores—the essential power sources for advanced constructs like golems and automata. These cores, typically crafted from refined Ether crystals or rare gemstones, act as reservoirs and processors of Ether energy. Functioning as the "hearts" or "souls" of your constructs, Ether cores grant your creations enhanced durability, adaptability, and, in some cases, rudimentary intelligence. With this skill, you move from building mere tools to engineering constructs that exhibit lifelike functionality and purpose.

Advanced mastery of magitech involves deepening your knowledge of runes, spell integration, and energy conversion systems. Runes and spells can imbue your creations with specialized effects, such as reinforced structures, environmental adaptability, or unique programmed capabilities. Simultaneously, you explore techniques to harness ambient Ether, enabling your constructs to operate autonomously without depleting your reserves. 

However, these advancements require extensive research, experimentation, and sometimes the rediscovery of ancient Ether theories or forgotten technologies and collaborations with other skilled artisans/Tinkers. Alongside the intellectual challenges, crafting high-level magitech demands vast amounts of Ether and rare resources, pushing you to train your body and Ether reserves to withstand the strain of supporting such creations.

The work of a Magi Craft Meister is an intricate blend of technical ingenuity and artistic vision. Over time, your creations transcend their utilitarian origins, evolving into sentient, adaptive entities with unique personalities and emotions. No longer merely tools, these constructs become living testaments to your skill, embodying your legacy as a master craftsman.
objects.title: Magi Craft Meister (Magi Craft Meister)

objects.text: Asoniti! Kyorucha! Beazlebor! Wizardry? *Gets kicked in the nuts* You remember, somewhat. The times when people were giants, and their strength great. Magic flows through your veins. No, really, there’s some octarine (the Eighth color, the color of magic) in there, if you know how to look (and you do, now!). You’ve got magical talent letting you access the magic of the Disc. The magic of Discworld is essentially just you telling the universe what you want it to be like, in terms it can't ignore, with spells and rituals being the mechanisms through which you do this. As such, there's practically nothing you can't do with enough time, effort, and magical power. You constantly have a small field of background magic around you like the one on Discworld, enabling you to absorb and store this magic into objects such as your staff before then using it in spells such as fireballs. You can throw fireballs, perform the Rite of AshKente (The ritual to summon Death), turn people into newts, and learn even more powerful spells, though there’s always a price to any magic. Also, you have training in seeing what is there and not seeing what isn’t. And Death’s personal attention when you die! Your magic still follows some rules, primarily the Law of Conservation of Reality, Magic's version of the Law of Conservation of Energy. For this reason, illusions or transforming a dog into a cat, for example, are relatively easy as it's just manipulating existing matter and energy into another state whereas creating an object ex nihilo is nigh-impossible. The most complicated parts of most spells aren't the effects, but the baffles to ensure the wizard survives. While you’re just a little above average, having an extremely strong sense of will and self tends to make one’s magic stronger. Your connection to the Disc grows stronger as you practice your new magic, granting you even more magic.
objects.title: Wizardly Wonders (Discworld)

objects.text:
You are a half-human, half-magical creature, possessing the powers of a Magical Girl and a magical creature. As a half-magical creature, you can form contracts with humans to communicate with them telepathically, although they do not gain any magical powers. Additionally, you can create portals to and from alternate dimensions, such as the Magical World.

As a Magical Girl, you can transform, gaining enhanced physical strength, speed, and durability. You have enough physical force to throw objects at the speed of sound and gain a unique magical weapon based on your personality, dreams, or desires. This weapon can range from a ladle to a hamburger and has unique abilities and properties. Initially, your magical weapon will be weak, but with training, it will grow stronger and gain additional features and capabilities. However, using your magical weapon expands your magic, and running out of magic drains your stamina.

Your body and soul are interconnected; anything that impacts your soul will also affect your physical body and vice versa. If your soul is captured, your physical body will dissolve and reappear once your soul is freed. As a Magical Girl, your soul is difficult to contain, allowing you to escape from attempts to trap it.
objects.title: Magical Girl Idol (Magical Girl Another World Idol)

addons.text:
One of the greatest limitations of Magecraft, Old Magic and Mystery has always been their fleeting nature. As knowledge of these arts spreads and their practices become widespread, their potency diminishes. 

This weakening, a consequence of the collective understanding of magic stripping away its enigmatic power, has historically constrained even the most gifted practitioners. But now, through your ascension, that limitation is abolished.

You have become the Endless and Limitless Font of Magic, a wellspring of eternal power. No matter how many people uncover the secrets of Magecraft, Old Magic, or True Magic—no matter how many practice and utilize its intricacies—its strength will remain undiminished. 

Magic will no longer wane with understanding. Instead, the magic you embody is self-sustaining, thriving in perpetuity regardless of how broadly it is shared or how deeply it is studied.

As the source of this resurgence, you are intrinsically connected to all Thaumaturgical Foundations in existence. This connection grants you unparalleled knowledge of their inner workings, including every spell, rite, and secret they contain. 

Even the closely guarded Magecrests—magical lineages passed through generations of mage families—are fully accessible to you. With but a thought, you can unlock the deepest mysteries hidden within these crests, no matter how long they have been guarded or forgotten.

In worlds where Magecraft or Ley Lines are absent, your presence awakens latent magical energies, allowing you to create Thaumaturgical Foundations and Magecrests from nothing.
 
The ley lines of the world stir under your influence, and new magical traditions take root. You become the architect of an entirely new magical ecosystem, giving rise to families, foundations, and the flow of magic where once there was none.

Your bond with Magecrests and their bearers grants you a unique form of immortality. These Magecrests now serve as second souls, tied to your essence. Upon your death, you gain the ability to be reborn through the Head of the Family that holds the Crest. By assuming their body, you prevent the extinction of magic and maintain the continuity of your presence in the world.

This safeguard ensures that you are not forced back into the Cycle of Reincarnation until the very last Magecrest holder has perished. Only when all Magecrests are extinguished, and magic itself is in decline, will you return to the Samsara cycle to begin anew. Until then, your essence remains intertwined with the fabric of magical existence, guarding its survival and evolution.

You are the Fountain of Mystery, a force that ensures magic’s endurance across the ages. No longer will the spread of knowledge dilute its potency. No longer will the loss of a single mage family spell the end of centuries-old traditions. Through you, magic flourishes eternally, unburdened by the limitations of secrecy or scarcity.

As the endless source of magic, you are not merely a practitioner or a guardian of Mystery—you are its heart and soul. With you, the boundaries of what is possible continue to expand, and the magic of the world becomes boundless.
addons.title: Fountain of Mystery

addons.text:
As the Samusara, you were originally the Font of Magic and Spiritual Energy, with your influence on life energy being an indirect consequence of your power. Spiritual Energy, by its very nature, enhances all things, but now your mastery has evolved. 

Your connection to Life Energy has deepened, making it a direct and transformative force under your command.

You are no longer just a conduit of magic—you are now the Font of Life Energy, the wellspring from which vitality itself flows. Your presence alone becomes a catalyst for creation and growth. Wherever you go, the world around you flourishes in extraordinary ways,

Flowers bloom to colossal proportions, becoming as large as houses. Trees grow into towering giants, their canopies touching the heavens like living mountains. Even the earth itself can respond to your will, transforming into a massive, living entity under your guidance. Entire ecosystems thrive and expand, reshaping the natural world into a paradise of vitality.

You wield absolute authority over life energy, granting you the ability to: cure diseases, mend wounds, and restore vitality to living beings. Even terminal illnesses and genetic defects are no challenge to your power. Just as easily, you can unleash devastating plagues and biological calamities, spreading destruction wherever you choose.

Your mastery over life energy extends to the very fabric of existence: shape entirely new lifeforms, from simple plants to complex, sentient species. These beings are not temporary constructs but fully independent creatures, capable of sustaining themselves without your intervention.
 
Transform your own body into any form of life you desire, from the smallest insect to the mightiest beast. You can also adapt features from multiple species, blending their strengths into an unparalleled form.

Beyond creating individual lifeforms, you can fundamentally alter entire species, modifying their biology, behavior, and traits to suit your vision. These changes are permanent and self-sustaining, persisting even if your magic fades.

One of the most profound aspects of this power is its permanence. Changes made through Life Energy are not tied to your existence as the Samusara. Even if you die and magic disappears from the world, the lifeforms, ecosystems, and species you have shaped will endure. They are not dependent on your power to sustain them; they become independent entities, thriving as natural parts of the world.

Your influence as the Font of Life ensures that your legacy will outlast your lifetime. The trees you grow, the species you create, and the cures you develop will remain, reshaping the course of life itself for generations to come.

As the Font of Life, you now embody the essence of vitality and creation. You are a force of nature, capable of transforming the mundane into the extraordinary. You heal, nurture, and build—but you can also destroy, corrupt, and reshape. 

Your power over life energy is not only vast but also versatile, enabling you to act as a guardian, a creator, or even a harbinger of devastation, depending on your will.

Through you, the boundaries of life are no longer fixed. They are as limitless as your imagination, eternally expanding and evolving.
addons.title: Font of Life

addons.text:
Your connection to the boundless magic of the Samusara has deepened, granting you the ability to bestow unparalleled gifts of talent and transformation upon others. What was once a limited ability to enhance others has now grown into something far more profound and versatile.

You can now share your knowledge of specific magical methods or the traits of magical races you are familiar with, gifting these abilities to others. 

Through your influence, you can: unlock latent potential within individuals, increasing their magical aptitude and talent far beyond their natural capabilities. Even those with no inherent magical inclination can become prodigies under your guidance.

Or you can change the very essence of an individual, turning them into a more magical race. These transformations are not limited to simple physical changes; they bestow the abilities, traits, and magical potential associated with the new species. Whether it is the energy-wielding prowess of an Anodite, the ethereal grace of a Fairy of Paradise, or another form of magical excellence, the choice is yours.
 
Your gifts, while extraordinary, are not without conditions. When you grant someone greater talent or transform them into a magical being, you have the option to impose Limits or Taxes on their continued existence. 

These conditions can take many forms, depending on your desires or the nature of the pact between you and the recipient: you may take years of life from them as payment, tying the gift of their new power to their lifespan, A binding magical contract can ensure their loyalty to you, making them your ally, servant, or agent, may extract a price in exchange for their transformation—whether it be material wealth, services rendered, or a promise to fulfill a future request.

Or you can create unique and creative conditions for their gift, such as requiring regular tribute, performing a specific task, or surrendering something of value (material or abstract). This feature ensures that while you elevate others, the balance of power remains in your hands.

You are no longer simply a benefactor but a Creator of Magical Evolution. You shape the destiny of individuals, fostering the rise of new magical beings and empowering those who may otherwise have remained ordinary. Your gifts can uplift, inspire, and transform entire societies, creating a ripple effect of magical growth.

However, the conditions you impose ensure that your power is not misused, and that the magic you share comes with a measure of accountability and control. You decide who is worthy of these gifts and at what cost.

You are not only the Source of Magic but also its Sculptor, crafting a world where magic thrives under your guidance and vision.
addons.title: Gift of Talent

objects.text:
You are the latest reincarnation of the Samusara, the eternal Font and Source of Magic. Your existence is not merely an event but a transformative phenomenon. 

Your presence causes the very fabric of the world to awaken, generating spiritual energy that spreads throughout creation, allowing magic to take root once more. This spiritual energy fuels not only your abilities but also serves as the foundation for a new magical age.

As the flow of magic suffuses the world, it triggers profound changes. Magical plants will sprout in forgotten corners of the land, animals imbued with mystical traits will emerge, enchanted objects of incredible power will surface, and specific regions will become magical nexuses. 

Even people will begin to awaken to their latent potential, gaining innate magical abilities or being born as natural spellcasters. Civilization itself will change, shaped by this resurgence of mystical energy.

You are the Source of these transformations, the beating heart of a magical revolution. This role endows you with unparalleled potential. Your capacity for all forms of magic is boundless, transcending the limits imposed on ordinary mortals. 

Though your magical reservoir may begin modestly, it grows rapidly, expanding with each use and mastery of your powers. Flight is an innate ability that comes instinctively to you, as natural as breathing.

As the Samusara, your magic knows no boundaries. Decades of training and experience will elevate you to unimaginable heights, where there is almost nothing you cannot achieve. 
 
Your abilities will include, but are not limited to: time travel, rewriting destinies, or peering into alternate timelines, opening portals between realms, connecting disparate worlds, or creating entire alternate dimensions, bringing forth creatures such as dragons, phoenixes, forging enchanted artifacts, birthing magical species, or shaping new magical ecosystems, granting great power to others, creating new schools of magic, or awakening dormant magical abilities in those around you.

Your power grows exponentially, with no true ceiling. The only limit to your potential is your own imagination and the wisdom with which you wield your gifts. For those that wield your power and the magic you bring forth, you can choose to either remove their access to it or otherwise take control of them if they do not remove it themself.

However, your connection to magic comes with a profound consequence. Should you die, the flow of magic across the world will begin to fade. Over time, magical plants will wither, enchanted creatures will vanish, and mystical energy will retreat into dormancy. Yet this is not the end.

You are bound to the eternal cycle of Samsara. In time, you will be reborn, stripped of your memories but destined to rekindle the spark of magic once again. As you grow, your powers will return, and with them, your memories of past incarnations will awaken. 

The cycle ensures that magic will never truly vanish, as long as you continue to exist.
objects.title: Samusara (Soulfire)

objects.text:
You are an adept of the six primary schools of magic: Continuum, Aether, Ritual, Homuncula, Morphic, and Alchemy. On the universal scale through which mastery and knowledge are measured, you have achieved the second rank out of five. While these six schools form the foundation of magic, many more exist—but you must discover them on your own.

The Continuum school governs the magic of time and space. With its power, you can stretch moments into hours, shorten days into seconds, manipulate the timing of future events, or open portals to any location on the planet.

At the third level of mastery, you gain the ability to teleport into the future, traverse any point in the universe, and peer through time into both the past and the future. The fourth and fifth levels grant paradox-free time travel and near-absolute control over all aspects of time and space.

The Aether school channels the magic of energy, encompassing fire, ice, lightning, telekinesis, and the enhancement of physical abilities. Even at the second rank, you can shatter steel, withstand explosions, and outrun speeding cars.

By the third level, you can destroy entire buildings, achieve unparalleled durability, and summon storms of fire and lightning capable of consuming cities. At the fourth and fifth levels, your power expands to creating and annihilating stars and planets, manipulating entire solar systems, and even crushing space itself within your grasp.

The Ritual school of magic controls laws and properties of the world and objects. You can use it to enchant objects and manipulate cause and effect to change fate. As a second level user of such magic, you can make use of rituals that give illumination, great luck and prevent illness—along with bewitching the laws of nature to help you and curse your enemies.

At the third level, you can create great mystical artifacts with ordained purposes that help their chosen ones or impossible good fortune and fate for yourself and others. The fourth and fifth levels allow you to do the impossible, completely alter cause and effect, make artifacts that can destroy or alter worlds. Fate is but clay to you.

The Homuncula school is the magic of life. It allows you to heal wounds, transform into animals, grow plants, and create entirely new species or alter existing ones with unique attributes.

At the third level of mastery, you can create massive beasts, sapient but soulless humans, and versatile multipurpose lifeforms. At the fourth and fifth levels, you gain the ability to craft and alter entire biospheres, engineer armies of living beings to conquer worlds, and assume any living form you can imagine.

The Morphic school governs the mind and perception. At the second level, you can read thoughts, alter memories, achieve extrasensory perception of auras and intent, and experience minor premonitions.

At the third level of mastery, you can create illusions, exert mass mind control, and see more precise visions of the future. By the fourth and fifth levels, you gain the power to control entire armies, rewrite consciousnesses, and achieve nearly complete perception of the world around you and your foresight becomes almost flawless.

Alchemy is the magic of matter—creating, transmuting, and combining substances. At the second level, you can transform basic materials like lead into gold, duplicate physical objects, combine them into new forms, and even create small amounts of matter from nothing.

At the third level of mastery, you can violate the conservation of mass and energy, enabling the creation of vast quantities of matter and the synthesis of materials with impossible properties. At the fourth and fifth levels, your abilities extend to creating and fusing matter on a planetary scale, designing entirely alien materials that obey only the laws you define, and more.

For mastery of the third level and above, you will be given a mental library with various paths of study so that you improve over time, but it will depend on your own effort and study. This includes all things that either exist or are hinted to exist in the CYOA that can be achieved with magic.
objects.title: Magical Expertise (Ouroboros CYOA)

addons.text: In the moment between moments, the instant when Witch Time activates, your body is no longer the only thing enhanced. While you are under the effects of Witch Time, all of your 108 skills are enhanced 10 times over.
addons.title: Flash of Brilliance

objects.text:
Witch Time is an ancient art used by powerful Umbra Witches to greatly increase their speed, granting heightened senses to perform and move at incredible speeds to accomplish normally impossible feats. You can use Witch Time to evade attacks and counter-attack extremely quickly.

Witch Time heightens all five senses and pushes your emotional energy to its very limits, sending you to a world where a falling drop of water can become a crown and a hummingbird slowly and elegantly flaps its wings. It completely boosts your physical attributes to move freely within that single moment.
objects.title: Witch Time (Bayonetta)

addons.text:
As the holder of both Eyes of the World, you have awakened Jubileus, the ruler of Paradiso—also known as the Creator—from her endless slumber. Unlike Balder, who revived her improperly, this version of Jubileus has been resurrected at full power, making her far more formidable and on par with the Queen of Sheba. As a Dea, the highest rank within the Hierarchy of Laguna, Jubileus is one of the gods who rule over the Trinity of Realities alongside Aesir and the Queen of Sheba.

Jubileus possesses a godlike superhuman body, stands hundreds of meters tall, can survive in the vacuum of space, and can exist as a soul without a physical body while retaining her full strength. She can manipulate the elements, effortlessly slay Infernal Demons such as Gomorrah, summon galaxy-like projectiles, create black holes, destroy planets simply by falling upon them, and perform countless other feats.

As the one who awakened her, your relationship with Jubileus functions similarly to contracting an angel from Laguna, allowing you to summon her in battle and have her follow your commands. However, despite her immense power, it is important to note that Jubileus possesses the personality of a self-absorbed, typical sixteen-year-old human.
addons.title: Jubileus, The Creator (Bayonetta)

objects.text:
The Lumen Sages, followers of light and counterparts to the Umbra Witches, were formed after Aesir granted the Eyes of the World to both clans with the intent of bettering mankind. While the Umbra Witches aligned with the demonic forces of Inferno, the Lumen Sages drew their power from the angels of Laguna. The clan wars between these factions ultimately led to the extinction of the Lumen Sages. Unlike their counterparts, Lumen Sages do not typically summon angels to fight directly as witches do with Infernal Demons, though a contracted angel can be summoned to battle or follow a sage’s commands. Upon death, sages are lifted toward Paradiso by angelic hands, unlike witches, who are dragged to Inferno.

As a Lumen Sage, you possess immense spiritual powers, enabling communication with supernatural entities. By forming a pact with an angel, such as those from the Auditio, you gain extraordinary abilities, including superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, agility, and a healing factor. Mastery of the Light Arts allows you to perform a variety of magical spells, such as summoning celestial fireballs or lightning spheres, calling down rays of light, generating lava from the ground, levitating to achieve flight, creating hardened constructs of light like swords and shields, and healing magic. A Lumen Sage's power peaks at the height of the sun’s ascent, contrasting with the witches' strength during a full moon.
 
By chanting in Enochian and using magical feathers as conduits, you can summon high-ranking angels to attack your enemies. The Light Speed technique allows you to stop time, mirroring the Umbra Witches' Witch Time. You can also enter a super-powered state, marked by radiant peacock wings and a golden aura, significantly enhancing your abilities. Like the witches, you can transform into various animals using the Beast Within technique.

You are also given a set of equipment, including a Lumen Watch, shaped like the sun and inscribed with Angelic Alphabet script, which extends your lifespan indefinitely unless you are killed. A battle robe, customized to your liking and woven with divine threads, wards off evil and is paired with a mask that sharpens your focus on singular targets. You also wield a weapon capable of killing demons, such as the Holy Glaive or Inferno Slayer. Lastly, you receive the Book of Revelation, which contains detailed descriptions of all angels.
objects.title: Lumen Sage (Bayonetta)

objects.text:
The Umbra Witches were once part of two rival clans, the other being the Lumen Sages, who drew their power from the light of Paradiso. The two clans maintained balance in the world until the Umbra Witches ended the Lumen Sages during the Clan Wars.

As an Umbra Witch, you form a blood pact with an Infernal Demon, drawing power from Inferno to master the Dark Arts. Through these abilities, you can slow time with Witch Time and transform into various animals with Beast Within. Witch Walk allows you to defy gravity, enabling movement on vertical surfaces and ceilings. Your magic is channeled through demonic incantations in Enochian, allowing you to summon powerful demons such as Gomorrah and Madama Butterfly to aid in combat.

Umbra Witches possess immense physical power, far beyond that of ordinary beings. You are capable of feats like headbutting skyscrapers, throwing satellites, and kicking jets into the air. Your speed and agility are equally superhuman, allowing you to perform intricate and devastating combinations of attacks with precision.

Using your magic, you can summon demon limbs through Wicked Weaves, delivering crushing blows to enemies. This ability is enhanced during Umbran Climax, which amplifies your attacks and allows you to summon larger parts of Infernal Demons for devastating effects. Torture Attacks enable you to conjure infernal devices, such as guillotines or iron maidens, to destroy enemies in brutal fashion.

The Umbran Watch, an intricately designed timepiece inscribed with infernal script, completely halts your aging, preserving you in your physical prime. However, when an Umbra Witch dies, they are dragged to Inferno by demonic hands, a consequence of their infernal pacts.

With these powers, you become a formidable practitioner of the Dark Arts, capable of taking on even the most fearsome foes from Paradiso and Inferno.
objects.title: Umbra Witch (Bayonetta)

objects.text:
You have gained the legacy of the royal family of Mewni. This includes The Magic Wand and The Book of Spells. 

The Magic Wand is a powerful heirloom that changes form for each user and can channel infinite magic power from The Realm of Magic a realm of limitless magic to perform any spell imaginable from the show and beyond with time and practice.

The Book of Spells is an ancient Heirloom tome that holds thousands of years of knowledge recorded from the Royal Family and every spell shown throughout the show. But it also holds the deceased spirit of the Glossaryck the ex God of Magic. While he is merely a spirit bound to the Book of Spells without any power of his own he is still an extremely wise and knowledgeable mentor in anything and everything you can think of and things you can’t. He is often very cryptic often speaking in riddles and can be a handful at the best of times. Though he can be bribed with his favorite food chocolate pudding to be more agreeable. While powerless on his own he can use your magic to help teach or to save you but otherwise don’t expect anything major from him as he is “retired”.

Within your starting arsenal you will find many useful and unusual spells. Such as typical spells you would expect but also things such as food-based spells and spells which summon fully sentient creatures each with unique skills and specialties. These living spells come from a pocket realm they live in after you create them. Be sure to treat them well else they decide to mutiny. You also gain the ability to use the infamous and extraordinarily dangerous Whispering Spell. This spell is able to fundamentally destroy any form of magic at a conceptual level. However, be warned this spell is extremely hard and dangerous as it usually leads to extremely explosive backlash as magic is destroyed. With mastery, it is possible to cast this spell more safely but even then should only be used as a last resort.

You also gain the mutation royal Mewmans have such as above peak human physical ability. As well as vestigial wings and the ability to assume a Butterfly form. This transformation grants 4 extra arms, wings, and a great increase to your physical and magical ability. Vastly increasing your ability to cast complex spells and increasing your ability to draw magic from The Realm of Magic.
objects.title: Legacy of Mewni (Star Vs. The Forces of Evil)

objects.text:
You are a practitioner of the enchanting and whimsical magic found throughout the Disney multiverse. This power grants you access to the lower-end, yet still remarkable, magical abilities seen in Disney’s stories. From the charming spells of fairy godmothers to the mischievous tricks of magical creatures, your magic is versatile and full of potential.

You can perform feats like animating objects (à la Beauty and the Beast’s enchanted household items), transforming into small animals (like Merlin’s playful transformations), or summoning minor elemental effects (such as creating snowflakes like Elsa’s early powers). 

You can also craft simple enchanted items, like a rose that never wilts or a music box that plays melodies that soothe the soul.

While your magic is not yet world-shaking, it carries the essence of Disney’s charm—hope, wonder, and a touch of mischief. With time, training, and practice, your abilities can grow stronger. 

You might start with lighting candles like Cinderella’s Fairy Godmother but eventually learn to weave more complex spells, such as creating protective barriers or enchanting entire rooms.

This magic is a gateway to greater power, and your potential is as vast as your imagination. The more you explore and experiment, the closer you come to mastering the full spectrum of Disney’s enchanting arts.
objects.title: Heart Full of Wonder (Disney)

addons.text:
You now have the essence of a true God. Your being is that of a newly minted Pantokrator, as if you had captured all of the Thrones Of Ascension, making you a mighty being indeed. While not limitless (for the previous Pantokrators often sealed powerful beings instead of destroying them, one of the Neterets was a Pantokrator who was destroyed by a rebellion of lesser gods, and there is the obvious matter of all previous Pantokrators disappearing), such beings truly deserve the appellation of "Gods".

You have every possible ability in the Dominions series, at maximum power, and with no resource requirements whatsoever. You can spam Wish without getting hit with the Monkey's Paw, create items or locations that shouldn't even logically exist, solo armies of Doom Horrors, create, destroy, summon, or banish beings up to the level of advanced Pretender Gods on a whim, and that's just the start.

The reason that all those previous Pantokrators disappeared is that there's something more, something far away from you that you can sense out in The Void, and the feeling that if you reach it something even greater than mere godhood is waiting for you.

The wheel turns once again...
addons.title: Pantokrator

objects.text:
The Wheel Turns Once Again...

You have inherited the magic arts of the Pantokrator's realm. The magic types are Elemental Magic (Fire, Air, Water, Earth) & Sorcery (Astral, Death, Nature, Glamour, & Blood Magic), and it is expressed via Conjuration, Alteration, Evocation, Construction, Enchantment, Thaumaturgy, & Blood Magic (which is so highly specialized it has both its own magic type & its own method). This also includes the ability to learn the spell-like abilities used by most units and Pretenders, including Divine Magic. If a unit can do it in the game, you can learn how as well.

Most importantly however, you become a Pretender God. This isn't quite as impressive as it sounds, as it grants few powers in and of itself. The powers it does grant are related to dominion (a passive aura constantly spreading out from around you and things you control) & blessings (the ability to grant boons without being present), consisting of the ability to alter the general vibe of areas under your dominion, such as by making it more peaceful or more fortunate, or by making it more chaotic & more deadly. You can also grant people priesthood, which allows them to use Divine Magic (permitting them to use your blessings at your discretion, as well as to use or grant certain abilities depending on how strong your other magic paths are).
objects.title: Prophet (Illwinter's Dominions)

objects.text:
You possess knowledge of the mystical arts of Middle-earth, granting access to the forms of magic attainable by mortal Men through wisdom, willpower, lore, craftsmanship, and spiritual strength. The magic of Arda is subtle rather than overt, relying on inner power, ancient knowledge, ritual, language, music, and harmony with the world instead of endless destructive spellcasting.

You are capable of learning Words of Power, creating wards and blessings, resisting corruption and supernatural influence, healing wounds and spiritual afflictions, sensing evil or hidden forces, and using songs, chants, and ancient languages to inspire, calm, strengthen, or influence others. You may practice arts of concealment, prophecy, ritual magic, and spiritual perception, as well as create enchanted objects such as blessed weapons, protective charms, concealed garments, or other subtle magical works through skill and empowerment.

With enough mastery, you may rival the greatest human loremasters and sorcerers of Middle-earth, capable of shaping kingdoms through wisdom, presence, enchantment, and spiritual authority. However, the magic of Arda is spiritually demanding and rarely immediate or flashy. Great feats often require preparation, knowledge, craftsmanship, symbolism, and immense force of will.

This power does not grant the innate abilities exclusive to races such as the Ainur or Elves, only the full magical potential achievable by a human within the world of Arda.
objects.title: Magic of Arda (Lord of the Rings)

addons.text:
Your mastery of magic is no longer limited to general mystical principles—you can now learn and wield any form of magic as it exists within its native universe. This allows you to invest charges into specific magical systems rather than just broad magical concepts.

With this enhancement, you can now study and practice Harry Potter’s Witchcraft & Wizardry, the MCU’s Sorcery, the Arcane Arts of the Elder Scrolls, the Thaumaturgy of the Dresden Files, or any other common magical system. Your knowledge will develop as if you were a natural magic user within that universe, gaining the same understanding and capabilities as an average practitioner.
addons.title: Universal Magic

addons.text:
Your connection to magic transcends normal limitations, allowing you to learn and wield even the rarest and most exclusive forms of magic. No longer are you bound by bloodlines, innate traits, divine selection, or unique circumstances—you can now invest charges into magics that would typically be restricted to a chosen few.

With this enhancement, you can master abilities such as Harry Potter’s Metamorphmagus, Fate/Stay Night’s True Magic, or even the Kekkei Genkai of Naruto. If it is considered magic within its universe, then no matter how exclusive, you can learn it as if you were naturally born with the potential. However, the rarer the magic, the more charges are required to gain even basic proficiency, ensuring that the most esoteric abilities demand greater investment.
addons.title: Unrestricted Magic

addons.text:
From now on, each time you gain points for Marvelous Mage, you will gain a single special quest. Should you complete one of these special quests, you will gain one-to-ten points based on its difficulty.

You may choose to refresh your current special quest when you gain a points refresh.
addons.title: Marvelous Quests

objects.text:
Every two weeks, you receive eight charges, which can be spent to enhance your magical expertise within a specific school or theme of magic. Six charges can be assigned freely, while two are automatically allocated to the same randomly determined area.

A single charge grants you proficiency in that field, equivalent to someone with your skill and talent spending several years dedicated to just studying that field. Progressing further follows a triangular number system for charge requirements: reaching level 2 requires an additional two charges, level 3 an additional three, level 4 an additional four, and so on. Each additional level represents nearly another decade of knowledge and study in that field of magic, significantly enhancing your understanding and capabilities.

Broader fields provide a more shallow generalized understanding with a single charge, while highly specific areas allow for rapid mastery of their deepest mysteries. Your specializations then stack and connect seamlessly, blending into a singular, integrated mastery of magic, powered by your new magic source.

By investing in Evocation, you can command fire and lightning with the precision and destructive force of an Archmage. Focusing on Ritual Crafting allows you to reshape matter, reinforce your body to be as unyielding as stone, or create living constructs from raw elements. Channeling power into Healing grants you the ability to mend broken bones in seconds, cure head trauma effortlessly, and understand anatomy on par with a medical-school graduate.

A branch of magical knowledge is considered full only when there is nothing left to learn about the subject, or when any more knowledge about that subject is so far from the original idea, that it should be considered something different. For example—eventually, the subject of lightning magic would start to delve into the knowledge of subatomic particles and their charges, which is really no longer lightning magic.

All mystical fields—such as rune-crafting, alchemy, warding, summoning, chronomancy, and even reality-warping—are viable for enhancement. Your potential is limited only by your imagination and how you choose to wield the arcane forces at your command.
objects.title: Marvelous Mage (Brockton Bay's Marvelous Mage)

objects.text: Archetypes are an ancient form of magic, allowing the user to transform themselves into the forms of the various Archetypes of heroes. While in theory, anyone can learn this magic; in practice, the actual method has long been kept secret from the world—until now, that is. You start with the basic level of any base Archetype unlocked. While this only allows access to a fraction of an Archetype’s true potential at the start, this will swiftly grow with experience to show the true potential of the Archetypes. The Seeker is Master of None, but a Jack of all Trades. Capable of healing, Wind Magic, buffing allies and debuffing enemies along with physical attacks. The Mage is a Master of Magic, its powerful reserves allow it to use its spells to great effect, specializing in Fire, Ice and Lightning Magic. The Warrior is Master of the Blade, its powerful strikes taking down it’s targets with ease. The Knight is Master of Defense, drawing the attacks of its enemies upon itself. The Thief is Master of the Darkness, stealing magic, health and treasures from its targets, and specializing in Dark Magic. The Masked Dancer is Master of Masks, able to change its mask to copy another Archetype’s powers to a degree, while also having skill with Fire Magic. The Summoner is Master of Summons, capable of summoning a variety of powerful creatures to aid it in battle. The Berserker is the Master of Attack, forsaking defense in the interest of more damage to the enemy. The Gunner is the Master of Range, able to hit its mark from considerable distances. The Healer is the Master of Healing, specializing in Light Magic, removing debuffs, and restoring health. The Brawler is Master of the Fists, able to convert its health into more damage done with every strike. The Faker is the Master of Deception, able to apply a variety of debuffs to its foes, remove debuffs from its allies, and raise barriers against attacks. The Commander is the Master of Tactics. It buffs its allies and commands them in battle—this along with its Fire Magic makes it a force to be reckoned with. The Merchant is the Master of Coin, it fights by turning coin into unresistable damage, while doing its best to ensure a return on its investment. No matter which Archetype you unlock here first, you will eventually unlock the others with time, and find yourself easily able to awaken this power within others as you desire. And you will want to share this power, for many of the Archetypes when working as a team can provide powerful synergies for you to exploit. As you unlock and master further Archetypes, more advanced variants will make themselves available. Who knows what the limit might be?
objects.title: Archetype (Metaphor: ReFantazio)

addons.text:
Through your mastery of blood magic and extensive study of vampiric essence, you have discovered a way to emulate and wield the power of the Children of Caine without becoming one yourself. 

You have access to the following Disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Blood Sorcery, Celerity, Dominate, Fortitude, Obfuscate, Oblivion, Potence, Presence, Protean, and Thin-Blood Alchemy, each at a mastery level of five dots.

You can effortlessly combine their abilities to create powerful new effects. With further research and training, you could easily learn more obscure Disciplines and advance those you already know beyond the five dots of mastery, or even craft entirely new Disciplines as you continue to unravel the mysteries of vampiric essence.

Your blood has been altered into a substance analogous to vitae, granting all the benefits of being a ghoul while also allowing you to use it for blood bonding and grow in power over time like a Kindred without being limited by factors such as generation.

With rigorous training and research, your growth in both potency and mastery will far outpace that of ordinary vampires. Within a decade, you could match the might of a Methuselah; within centuries, rival the Antediluvians. After a millennium or two, you might even rise to stand as the equal of the Dark Father himself.
addons.title: Hemovorian Art

addons.text:
You are now a master of the Hermetic Arts equivalent to great sages like Bonisagus, able to use the versatile Magic of Mythic Europe.

You can use the Techniques (such as Creo - I Create, Intelligo - I Perceive, Muto - I Transform, Perdo - I Destroy, or Rego - I Control) & the Forms (such as Animal, Auram - Air, Aquam - Water, Corpus - Body, Herbem - Plants, Ignem - Fire, Imaginem - Image, Mentem - Mind, Terram - Earth, Vim - Power), to create almost any effect within the parameters. You can also add multiple Techniques or Forms beyond the first two for a more complicated or specific effect, known as "requisite" spells.

That said, the system is an incomplete and mysterious science; often groups like The Craftmasons, The Tremere, the druids of The Old Faith, or others, have their own variants and pet theories that allow them to work the arts in a different way with different features. Sometimes they don't have limitations than Hermetic magic has, or they have ones it doesn't, but boons are granted in return. Some have extra Techniques or Forms, while others fold several into a single one. Some even speak of the Hermetic Orders of other dimensions, whose own art works differently. You understand these variants too, but only on their own terms; if you want to integrate them into the greater magic theory they are surely a part of, you will have to discover it yourself.
addons.title: Primus (Ars Magicka/Dark Ages: Mage/Mage: The Sorcerer's Crusade)

objects.text:
You have unlocked the secrets of sorcery—the art that allows ordinary mortals to wield magic within the World of Darkness. Unlike the dynamic, reality-defying power of the Awakened, sorcery—often called linear magic—follows a structured system governed by strict principles and rules. It functions by exploiting loopholes within the universe, bending its laws to achieve your will. 

Sorcery is defined by its rigidity. It consists of distinct paths, traditions, and disciplines, each bound by precise rules and limitations. These traditions typically focus on specific magical effects—such as alchemy, divination, or enchantment—and often require precise rituals, materials, or procedures to function. While sorcery is reliable, it lacks flexibility, as practitioners must follow established steps or formula with little room for error. However, this very structure makes it possible for you to teach the art of sorcery to anyone, should you choose to do so.

You begin with a strong foundation in sorcery, possessing a working knowledge of multiple disciplines that mark you as a skilled hedge mage. You understand how to craft new spells and rituals, as well as refine and enhance the traditions you have studied.

With time and practice, you can refine your rituals and spells to adapt to unique physics, energies, and powers of different realms or universes. By studying unique laws of reality and magic, you can forge new traditions and carve new paths through careful research and experimentation. With enough knowledge, will, and power, you may even reshape the very fabric of the world itself.
objects.title: Sorcery (World Of Darkness)

addons.text:
The Consensus, a tyranny of the masses upon your true and perfect being. The Lie, a Tyranny of the few upon all beneath their boot. You will suffer no tyrannies.

As the nature of magics swirl and join within you, you’ll find you’re able to manipulate the structures of the Consensus and the Lie as if they were a unique Sphere or Arcana of your own. Functionally, this means with time you’ll be able to manipulate the cause and structures of Paradox itself. 

Ancillary to this, the Spheres and Arcana have merged in you with their equivalent counterparts, slightly reducing the time of their development, but also meaning you don’t need to develop your understanding of equivalent areas independently, such as the Time Arcana and the Sphere of Time, or Space and Correspondance.
addons.title: Consensus & a Lie

addons.text:
The Celestial Chorus is a choir of the faithful united by their devotion to the One – the singular divine source of all creation (the Prime from which all things originate). Choristers come from many religions but believe these are all facets of the same One; all voices join in the cosmic harmony. Their magickal paradigm is fundamentally prayer and divine will: they sing hymns, recite holy verses, and perform sacraments to channel the power of creation itself.

Chorister magick often manifests as miracles of light, healing, and holy fire – effects they ascribe to the One working through them. Culturally, the Chorus emphasizes faith, unity, and selfless service: members might be priests, shamans, imams, or simply devout souls who felt the call of the divine. They have a history of crusades and hymns, martyrs and miracles, and in modern nights focus on righteous deeds over dogma. Despite their religious diversity, they share a reverence for the divine spark in every soul, believing humanity’s collective song can transform the world.

When you speak with sincere faith, people listen—even when they do not share your beliefs. The divine presence within you carries weight in a way that defies reason. You radiate a quiet authority, a sense of higher purpose that can inspire allies or disarm hostility. Your prayers are not mere ritual; they resonate with the collective dream of a better world. Miraculous events seem more natural in your presence, and even the skeptical may find themselves questioning what they thought impossible.

The Celestial Chorus occupy the seat of Prime on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Celestial Chorus

addons.text:
The Dreamspeakers (Kha’vadi) are a broad Tradition of shamans, spirit-talkers, and mystics who serve as intermediaries between the material and spirit worlds. They practice ancient forms of shamanism and animism: to a Dreamspeaker, everything has a spirit – from animals and plants to rivers, winds, and even cities. Their paradigm centers on honoring these spirits and maintaining balance between humanity and the unseen realms. Dreamspeakers commune with spirits through ritual drumming, dance, vision quests, sweat lodges, and sometimes entheogenic (hallucinogenic) herbs.

They can travel into the Umbra (spirit world) in dream or trance, negotiate with totems and ancestor spirits, and summon spirit allies to aid or teach them. Culturally, this Tradition is extremely diverse, encompassing indigenous and tribal magickal practices from all over the world (First Nations, African, Aboriginal Australian, Polynesian, etc.). Many members were originally lumped together by more “modern” mages, but despite varied customs they share a respect for the living Earth and the balance of the physical and spiritual. Dreamspeakers see themselves as voice of the voiceless – representing the needs of spirits and marginalized human cultures alike – and carry the burden of preserving ancient ways in the face of a world that often forgets or ignores the spirit realm.

Spirits recognize you. Whether in the deep forest, a city street, or someone’s dreams, unseen presences take notice of your passage. You are rarely alone, though you may be the only one who senses your companions. Doors into the spirit world open more easily for you; spirits are more willing to speak, to trade, or to guide. Animals may pause in reverence, and sacred places seem to reveal themselves in your presence. The boundary between flesh and essence is thin wherever you walk.

The Kha'vadi occupy the seat of Spirit on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Dreamspeakers

addons.text:
The Euthanatos (or Chakravanti, “Wheel Turners”) are a Tradition of mages devoted to the forces of death, rebirth, fate, and karma. Often called Death Mages or Entropy Masters, they understand death not as an evil, but as a necessary transition in the great cycle of existence. Their paradigm holds that all things are bound to the Wheel of Life and Death – endings make way for new beginnings. Thus, Euthanatoi see it as a sacred duty to ease suffering by ending what is hopelessly corrupt or terminal, and to ensure the natural cycle isn’t blocked. Their practices are occult and somber: they might perform funerary rites, cast lots or use tarot to discern destiny, commune with ancestors or underworld spirits, and (when needed) administer the “Good Death” to those whose time has come (whether through mercy-killing, assisted transition rituals, or in darker cases, supernatural assassination).

Paradoxically, they are also healers and keepers of life’s balance – knowing when to save as well as when to let go. Culturally, the Euthanatos draw on mystic traditions of India, Greece, and elsewhere: one can find Hermetic necromancers alongside Hindu sages of Kali among their ranks. They dress in everything from funeral garb to simple everyday clothes, but all share a solemn commitment to upholding fate’s balance. Their reputation can be fearsome, but they act with reflection and heavy conscience, ever wary of the personal toll (the Jhor, or death-taint) that comes from dealing out death.

You carry the weight of endings with grace. Death does not fear you, nor do you fear it. In moments of loss, suffering, or karmic consequence, others may look to you without understanding why—sensing in you a quiet knowing. People confess to you. The dying find peace in your voice. Even chance itself seems to respect your presence: you’re often in the right place when fate balances its scales. You are a midwife of transformation, and wherever cycles turn, you are a steady hand on the wheel.

The Chakravanti occupy the seat of Entropy on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Euthanatos

addons.text:
The Order of Hermes is the archetypal society of wizards – a highly disciplined, hierarchical Tradition that codified much of what mages know as magic theory. These Hermetic magi trace their roots to medieval and ancient sorcerers; they organize into Houses, memorize invocations in High Speech (the primal language of creation), and emphasize precision and scholarship. Their magickal paradigm is highly formulaic: true names, complex symbols, ritual circles, astrological timing, and strict correspondences are all vital to crafting an effect.

To Hermetics, reality is made of layers and rules – a structure that can be reshaped with the right understanding. Culturally, the Order prizes tradition, intellectual rigor, and mastery of lore; members often dress in archaic or esoteric garb, carry wands, staffs, or grimoires, and quote from magical texts. They are deeply respected (and sometimes resented) for their power, as well as their arrogance. But few doubt their competence: in terms of raw magical theory, the Order remains unmatched.

Your mastery of structure, language, and symbol grants you access to deeper layers of reality than most dare glimpse. When others flail in chaos, you find pattern. You see the underlying architecture of things: the equations behind the storm, the grammar beneath the miracle. Complex rituals come naturally to you; the words of power resonate on your tongue. Your magick is refined, precise, and rooted in centuries of accumulated wisdom. Where you tread, ancient forces stir in recognition.

The Order of Hermes occupy the seat of Forces on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Order of Hermes

addons.text:
The Sons of Ether are visionary scientists, inventors, and explorers of the impossible. They broke from the Technocracy to embrace science as wonder, not dogma. To a Son of Ether, the universe is a grand experiment governed as much by inspiration as by laws – and the more people believe something can’t be done, the more they want to try it. Their paradigm is built on fringe science, weird theory, pulp imagination, and wild invention: ray guns, reality stabilizers, interdimensional goggles – if it’s ridiculous but inspired, it might just work. 

Their practices draw from steampunk, retrofuturism, and mad science; they build their Devices using theoretical constructs that mainstream physics calls nonsense. Culturally, they are eccentrics, rebels, and dreamers – more comfortable in labs, workshops, or airships than in polite society. They may talk like pulp heroes or dress like vintage tinkerers, but beneath their theatrics lies real genius. To them, magick is invention powered by belief – and belief powered by awe.

Your genius defies common sense—and reality occasionally agrees with you. You think in bold hypotheses and elegant impossibilities, and sometimes the universe rewards that imagination. Machines seem to work better when you build them, even if they shouldn’t. Wild inventions spark into life under your hands, not through any known science, but through belief and brilliance. People dismiss you… until your devices start doing the impossible, and you stand back, grinning, because you always knew it would work.

The Sons of Ether occupy the seat of Matter on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Sons of Ether

addons.text:
The Verbena are witches of the old ways, working with blood, bone, root, and season. Their magick is primal, visceral, and deeply tied to the living world. They channel life energy through ancient rites – fertility dances, blood sacrifices, herbal brews, sacred intercourse, and moonlit rituals. To the Verbena, life itself is sacred, and magick flows from its rhythms. They tend to revere nature spirits, old gods, or archetypes of the wild divine.

Birth, death, pain, pleasure – all are tools to connect with the greater cycle. Culturally, they carry the memory of pagan traditions, witch covens, midwives, and village shamans – often persecuted, never forgotten. They may wear tattoos, ritual scars, or natural fetishes, and they live close to the land, whether in forests, farms, or urban green spaces. The Verbena embrace the raw beauty of existence – blood on the altar, blossoms in spring, and the grave beneath the oak tree. They are both nurturing and ruthless, healers and hexers, life-bringers and reapers.

Life itself answers you. The beat of your heart echoes the pulse of the earth. Wounds close under your touch, seeds sprout where you walk, and blood carries your intent like ink on a page. Nature recognizes you as one of its own. In storms, in birth, in death, and in the sacred spiral of seasons, your magick blooms with primal force. You are a creature of cycles and sacrifice, wild and beautiful and terrible as the turning of the moon.

The Verbena occupy the seat of Life on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Verbena

addons.text:
The Virtual Adepts are reality-hackers who believe the world is made of information. Originally part of the Technocracy, they broke away to pursue freedom of thought and virtual transcendence. Their paradigm frames reality as code – manipulable data that can be rewritten with the right access. Virtual Adepts use computers, networks, virtual reality rigs, and encryption to warp the boundaries of space, perception, and identity. 

In the Digital Web, they are gods; in the real world, they bend the rules through wireless sorcery, augmented gear, and precision logic. Culturally, they’re technomancers, crypto-anarchists, and futurists – drawn from hacker culture, transhumanist thought, and online collectives. They value privacy, freedom, and the liberation of consciousness. Some are ghostlike cyber-ninjas, others are hyper-connected digital prophets. They don’t just use technology – they embody it. Reality is no longer fixed; it’s open source.

You are everywhere. The moment you touch a network, your consciousness expands beyond your body. Screens flicker with your presence. Security systems misfire or bend just enough to let you through. Information flows toward you like water through cracked stone. You navigate space not with steps, but with intention—distance is a suggestion, not a rule. Reality feels digital in your hands, and the code beneath it trembles when you start typing.


The Virtual Adepts occupy the seat of Correspondence on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Virtual Adepts

addons.text:
Also known as the Sahajiya, the Cult of Ecstasy consists of visionary mages who transcend ordinary limits through sacred experience. Ecstatics seek to shatter the constraints of time and perception by pushing the mind and body beyond the mundane. For them, magick comes from altered consciousness – achieving ecstatic trance states that let them see beyond linear time and conventional reality. To reach these states, Ecstatics use intense experiences as tools: drugs, music, dance, intercourse, pain, and adrenaline are all means to catapult the senses into new realms.

It’s not hedonism for its own sake, but a deliberate quest to expand awareness; they take “ecstasy” in its original meaning: ekstasis, to stand outside oneself. Cultists believe reality’s rules (like time) are only as solid as our perception – by changing perception, one can slip through time’s stream or find eternity in a moment. Culturally, the Cult is diverse and free-spirited, tracing lineages from dervishes, tantrics, bacchanals, and bohemian artists. They value personal freedom, experiential wisdom, and pushing boundaries (with responsibility not to get lost in excess). Their paradigm makes them masters of Time and emotion, using their own bodies and sensations as instruments of magick.

You experience time differently than others. At your most open—lost in trance, intoxicated by passion, music, or revelation—you can slip between moments, finding eternity in seconds or seeing glimpses of what has not yet come to pass. To outsiders, your insights may seem prophetic or your reactions uncanny, as though you knew what would happen before it did. You live in the Now so completely that the boundaries of time become porous around you, especially when you embrace your ecstasy fully.

The Cult of Ecstacy occupy the seat of Time on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Cult of Ecstasy

addons.text:
The Akashayana are an ancient sect of mystical monks and sages devoted to achieving enlightenment and inner harmony in a chaotic world. Often misunderstood as mere “peaceful warriors,” they believe magick is a side effect of spiritual growth rather than an end itself. Akashic mages unify body and mind through rigorous training – meditation, breath control, and the martial art Do – to channel cosmic truth. 

By strengthening their bodies to cultivate their minds (mastering the Sphere of Mind in the process), they tap into the Akashic Record (a cosmic memory of all thoughts and actions) and strive to transcend ego. Culturally, the Brotherhood’s practices draw from diverse Asian philosophies (Buddhist, Taoist, etc.), emphasizing discipline, humility, and the sanctity of life. They seek balance in all things, preferring efficient, ethical solutions and only resorting to conflict as a means to restore harmony when absolutely necessary.

Your body is your temple and your spellbook. Through rigorous discipline and meditative focus, you have achieved an instinctive clarity few others know. In combat, your every movement is guided by perfect awareness; in stillness, your thoughts cut through confusion like a sword through silk. Magick flows from you not through grand gestures, but through subtle breath, precise motion, and unshakable inner peace. Even when others falter, your centered mind grants you calm in chaos and harmony with the world’s rhythms.

The Akashayana occupy the seat of Mind on the council of Nine Traditions. You as their disciple are especially gifted in this sphere of Magic. Now Starting at the equivalent of 3 dots in the sphere, three dots would indicate expertise in the sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Akashayana (Akashic Brotherhood)

addons.text:
Of course, it would be awfully greedy to keep that power all to yourself, wouldn't it, you Reality Deviant?

The Technocracy has a long history that you're probably not interested in, but suffice it to say, we've been the ones determining what 'reality' is for a very long time. The purpose of this is to create a Paradigm that lets all of humankind Awaken and eventually Ascend together. What we don't want is a couple of almighty Reality Deviants (like the Traditions have) ruling the world as god-kings the way they used to.

You don't really need to familiarize yourself with our Paradigm, because you've been living under it your whole life. Provable, repeatable experiments show that something is universally true, which can then be applied to particular cases and applications. The more of this information we know, the more we can do. The computerized device you're reading this on right now is a product of that.

You can now use the Paradigm (singular, that's the whole point) of the Technocracy. This includes both all science that The Masses (that's what we call Sleepers here, it should have been part of your onboarding training) acknowledge as being part of Consensus, and the Enlightened Science still on The Inner Circle's Time Table.

This includes all of our tech that the public is just not ready for yet, like Cyborgs, Robots (including the Hyper Intelligence Technologies series), Void Ships, Dyson Spheres, Genetic Engineering, AI (this one may have changed since 2004), advanced economics and psychology to let you manipulate people and markets alike, all kinds of nasty sci-fi weapons for killing Reality Deviants, and a great deal more.
addons.title: Technocracy

addons.text: The Quiet. A magical insanity feared by all mages, that are born from Paradox backlash, trauma, or the spiritual erosion of certain actions. It manifests through states of Madness, Clarity, or Jhor, pulling the mage away from shared reality and into their subjective reality that only they see. While recovery is possible with time and aid, those who succumb entirely become Marauders: mages trapped in a permanent delusion where their shattered Avatars rewrite the world to fit their insanity. Yet you have achieved the impossible: you have conquered the Quiet. Rather than falling into a fractured state, you function with your mind perfectly intact, working seamless with your Avatar. You command all the reality-warping benefits of a Marauder, but with none of the madness, maintaining total control over your vision and your soul. At will, you can project an external bubble of reality that overlays and can reshape your environment to reflect your inner world and paradigm. Within this field, you are untethered from the Consensus, allowing you to cast any of the Spheres instantaneously without fear of Paradox backlash or the need for instruments, paradigm, rituals, and Quintessence. The potency of these changes scales with your expertise: while a novice can only produce fleeting, visual changes that vanish once the bubble moves, a master can exert godlike influence, rendering any alterations permanent even after the bubble is gone. While you remain immune to Paradox backlash within your bubble, any magical effects that extend beyond the bubble’s border are subject to the weight of the Consensus and are consider vulgar magick. Should you manifest a fireball, craft an impossible artifact, or inflict unnatural biological changes, these vulgar changes will accumulate Paradox within the bubble the moment they cross into the outside world.
