Only effects that do not defy the consensus, such as restoring a body to normal or creating mundane objects, can exit the bubble without penalty, remaining stable and untainted by paradox or being rejected by Consensus. This build up of Paradox will stay within the bubble even after you dismiss it. As paradox builds within this bubble, there are two ways to purge this. You can deflect and redirect the paradox to your surroundings, forcing every living being (except you) and the environment within the bubble to absorb the backlash; however, this process is chaotic, and you cannot control which targets are afflicted. Alternatively, you may allow the Paradox to build-up within the bubble until it reaches its breaking point and "pops." While this will successfully nullify the contained Paradox, the strain leaves you unable to redeploy the bubble for 24 hours. Furthermore, the bubble has a finite capacity, so any excess Paradox that exists after the bubble disappears will affect you. With frequent use, the bubble’s radius and Paradox capacity will expand. Within this space, your seamless connection to your Avatar will streamline the mastery of the Spheres and Arete; you can ascend your Arete without the trials of a Seeking and achieve mastery and above over the spheres by simply using them frequently within this bubble. Additionally, having conquered the Quiet, you are immune to the soul-staining effects of Madness, Clarity, and Jhor and cannot affect other mages or people with the Quiet if they are inside your bubble. With the Consensus & a Lie addon, you gain direct control over your reality bubble. Through mastery of this Sphere or Arcana, you can rewrite the laws of reality within your bubble at a whim, changing how your paradigm can affect the world. You decide what triggers Paradox, create paradox spirits to fight your enemies, and define the Truth and Lie within your domain. You can even allow phenomena that directly contradict consensus reality to exist beyond the bubble’s borders without consequence, or program the bubble to absorb Paradox, converting it into raw power or Quintessence.
addons.title: The Quiet Conquered

addons.text:
Theoretically, a Mage with the right Spheres and sufficient Mastery can achieve any effect. In practice, however, there are consequences to this as a Botch can lead to dire effect for a Mage. This is why Rotes are so highly valued: they are refined, repeatable spells that are easier to cast and far less likely to fail in high-stakes situations. When a team of HIT-Mark assassins is rushing your position in a chaotic firefight, you don’t want to be improvising your Magick unless you are willing to risk a lethal dose of paradox.

You are the exception; you are like a living encyclopedia of every Rote that exists or has yet to be imagined. With sufficient Mastery, you can pull forth a specific Rote to reshape reality to your whim. You can render your skin impermeable to gunfire, transmute the very air into a silver haze against a werewolf, or permanently turn an elder vampire into a lawn chair regardless of their ability to soak it. Your expertise also allows you to achieve the impossible using a single Sphere in ways others can't fathom such as turning poison within a body into a restorative elixir with Matter, converting your body into pure electricity to travel with Forces, or solidifying raw Quintessence into permanent solid objects using Prime.

And with high enough Mastery and Arete, you can bypass and cast extended casting spells and rituals in mere seconds that would normally take a normally days or weeks to invoke. You possess the ingenuity to bypass traditional preparation, quintessence, and accumulated successes to cast your magik by utilizing the environment and your surroundings. Rather than laboring over a giant circle of salt, you can hijack a city’s entire power grid to act as a massive battery for your ritual. You can pinpoint a single metaphysical pressure point within the urban sprawl that, once struck, triggers a chain reaction affecting every soul in the district. You can even ignite the entire atmosphere of a city, using the very air as a fuel source to power a spell of world-altering proportions.

You never have to worry about botching a spell; every Rote in your arsenal is refined to such a degree of efficiency that failure is impossible, even in the high intense struggle of a life-or-death situation.

However, there are limitations. These Rotes are strictly bound by your Mastery of the Spheres, Arete, and Paradigm; you cannot transform a vampire into a Lawn Chair with the mere sensory perceptions of Matter 1 and it must work through your Paradigm. Furthermore, your rotes are born from your unique experiences and cannot be taught to others. A Rote does not exist for you until you have attained the necessary mastery to cast it. Finally, you are never above Paradox. While Rotes provide a safety net against a Botch, they offer no protection from Paradox itself. Any Magick—no matter how perfectly executed—will inflict Paradox on you if it’s vulgar. Even with high-level Prime Rotes designed to bleed off or draw it away, you will have to face the cost of using these rotes if not careful.
addons.title: The Vampire Lawn Chair Rote

addons.text: The Avatar. The Genius. These are but a few terms used to describe the thing that tethered to a human soul. Which allows a human to rewrite reality, opening the path to Ascension. So wondrous is their nature that they are impossible to create. An Avatar can be killed, stolen, reshaped, or shattered, but never created. Not even the greatest of mages has done such a thing. Until now. You have the ability to awaken Sleepers or grant them the potential to become Willworkers. You can either awaken them on the spot, where they will have a paradigm similar to your own, or allow them to awaken naturally. While the specific awakening depends on the individual, you can determine how long this will take, allowing them to forge a unique paradigm that fits their personality and beliefs. You can awaken not only humans but also supernatural beings like vampires and werewolves. These Avatars will be stable and not shatter. Each of these individuals will develops their own paradigm, and their Awakening is permanent—surviving species transformation or fundamental changes to their soul. This by consequence will make it so that your own Avatar will not immediately shatter if you happen to change species or your soul. Keep in mind that the Sleepers and creatures you awaken, along with their Avatars, will follow their own paths. The Mages and enlightened agents you bring forth will pursue their own destinies, driven toward Ascension by their Avatars. Upon a host's death, these Avatars simply reincarnate into a new vessel to continue their pursuit of Ascension until they either succeed, are destroyed, or fall to corruption, turn themselves into a Marauder or a Nephandi. With Loyalty Insurance, any Avatar you create or awaken is completely devoted to you, placing you above even Ascension. If a Mage dies, their Avatar is guaranteed to awaken in a new host and guide them to stay loyal to you. This bond is so strong that even Marauders and Nephandi will serve you faithfully, regardless of their nature and goals. With the power to awaken and create Avatars, your Spheres can safely manipulate a mage's avatar without endangering their mind, body, or soul. You can mend a flayed Avatar, reforge one that has been shattered, and dispel the fog of Quiet. Furthermore, you do things even the greatest of mages would find impossible such as restoring the sanity to a Marauder or even re-invert the soul of a Nephandus, turning them back toward the path of Ascension. Any beings you Awaken or give an Avatar to have the potential to use any of the Awakened (World of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension) addons you have. However, learning and utilizing them will be long and arduous without your teaching and mentorship.
addons.title: The Sleeper Awakening

addons.text:
Every Mage, from the newly awakened apprentice, to the godlike Archmages is limited by their paradigm. Even the most enlightened minds can only expand so much, and will experience a sort of “dilution of belief”.

You are quite the exception however. You have no need for Seekings, those grand quests for Enlightenment. Your Arte can grow through integrating the knowledge and understanding of other Paradigms. A three week seminar on the art of desire, a vision quest, or a tour through a steampunk laboratory, all of these are equally valid for your ascension.

You can also freely use the Wonders and Rotes of any paradigm, from Hermetic ritual magic to the relics of a saint. 

Ordinary Ascension requires rejection of any sort of paradigm, but you can Ascend through an opposite manner, by understanding every viewpoint.
addons.title: Harmonious Paradigm

objects.text: I tell you this: We are Divinity. Reality is ours to bend. To subvert. To command. We have that power - All of us. The truth is thus: reality is governed not by immutable laws of creation. Reality is what we make of it. Convictions, beliefs, ideals, desires—all of these and more go into creating the world around us and its rules, each human mind unconsciously adding to the consensus of how the world works around them. But not you; you are no sleeper, are you? At least you are no longer one. You have awakened, gained a connection to your avatar, a part of your soul that seeks your ascension and guides you towards it. This is what allows you to perform Magick. In essence, complete reality manipulation and alteration, also known as dynamic magic, Simply choose how you wish to try and alter the world using the knowledge you have of the spheres of magic and your Arete, your magical omph, so to speak, and hope you are strong and experienced enough to pull it off. Your Arete, your ability to perform dynamic magick, starts low, but with experience and seekings, shadow plays and quests, your avatar decides to put you through, which grants increased magical ability and knowledge. With training and completion of your seekings, you can grow stronger and stronger until you can do anything you put your mind to. Your focus, the lens, philosophy, and belief system through which you use magic are up to you. Perhaps you are part of one of the nine traditions, using martial arts as a focus for your magick, such as the Akashayana Sangha, or perhaps you use traditional spells, such as the order of Hermes. Perhaps you are even a technocrat and employ your abilities through the lens of reason and science, or perhaps you are entirely unique in how you bring forth your magick. In the end, such things are up to you and your own sense of reality. However, you need to remember one thing: this power is not unique to you; it is within every single human, whether they know it or not. Simply because you have grown cognizant and proud enough to both realize that the laws of reality are illusions and to decide that you know better how the world should work than every other person does not mean that their power over you has subsided. Ultimately, reality is controlled by the many; the consensus for how the world works around them shapes reality as it is now, and reality does not like to be pushed around; vulgar magicks and being witnessed performing them might not be punished as severely in non mundane world, but going beyond what is normally thought possible still incurs the wrath of the consensus. Be careful of paradox; you could easily summon paradox spirits and be put in reality jail, even in otherwise fantastical worlds, if you go far enough beyond what is thought possible by the masses. Still, there is light in the dark, for you are a particularly talented mage and have proficiency in every single sphere of magic, effectively meaning one dot in each one in game terms. And five more dots to doll out as you please among them. One dot here is the equivalent of basic knowledge and perception of them, and five dots denote total mastery of their domains, allowing you to perform insane godlike feats with them.
objects.title: Awakened (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension)

objects.text:
You become capable of learning magic and start off with a basic understanding of F-Rank spells which are as strong as cantrips, knowing a spell for each magic type. You're talented enough to get to the top with enough time and research. A C-Rank spell would be a decent for combat, like throwing spears of ice or even lightning and an S-Rank spell would be strong enough to take a chunk out of an army, if not eradicate one completely.

The higher the Rank, the more difficult it is to achieve. For B-Rank, mages need to understand how to create a four-dimensional spell matrix. For A-Rank, mages need to create a thesis centered around a magical school or concept. One about spell absorption might allow you to absorb magic you're blocking, thus allowing you to replenish your reserves even while under attack. 

It’s called ascension for a reason however, as the process for rising to A-Rank means fundamentally reconstructing your magic and body. This can be done by either actively reforming your body or by passively changing your magical makeup in which case the body will change itself to match. This way the body becomes a part of the matrix forming a spell, thus granting you its passive benefit. The S-Rank ascension is similar to the A-Rank ascension, though it’s also much more difficult to achieve, while A-Rank grants a passive benefit, S-Rank is active, for example it could allow you to imbue spells with blood magic to enhance them, allowing you to multiply the strength of your spells.
 
Magic is structured as follows:
F-Rank: A one-dimensional spell matrix(line, sizzle, etc...).
E-Rank: A two-dimensional spell matrix(circle, triangle, etc...).
D-Rank: A three-dimensional spell matrix(cube, pyramid, etc...).
C-Rank: A four-dimensional spell matrix(Tesseract, complex four-dimensional shapes, etc...).
B-Rank: Animated four-dimensional spell matrix (moving and changing shapes through time).
A-Rank: Ascension passive.
S-Rank: Ascension active.
Magic schools include: Elemental Magic, Blood Magic, Healing Magic, Illusion Magic, Druidic/Soul Magic, Necromantic Magic, Shamanic Magic, Imbuing, Inscription, Genetic Magic.
objects.title: Magic (Jackal Among Snakes)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use Sorcery, the power to alter or create natural and supernatural phenomena through the use of magic circles and calculations.

Sorcerers are as much artists as they are scientists, their ability to alter the world is proportional to their understanding of it and only constrained by their creativity. For Sorcerers, knowledge and power are two sides of the same coin.

You begin with the mana reserves and knowledge of a novice Sorcerer who has apprenticed under a competent master for a decade and the talent to reach the level of a Master Sorcerer in a decade and an Archdemon Candidate in the span of a few decades more. 

(With enough time and research, you can accomplish anything with this power.)
objects.title: Sorcerer (Archdemon's Dilemma)

addons.text: As a High Elf, you can wield Celestial Mysticism freely. The chants no longer take a toll on your body and the spirits are eager to respond to your requests, however selfish. They will protect you from harm but also react to strong emotions.
addons.title: Titania

objects.text:
You gain the power of the High Elves to call on the spirits of nature through chants, Celestial Mysticism, and complete knowledge of the Celestian language.

Through chants, you can call down the wrath of the stars or bring forth storms of crystal to purify evil, heal fatal wounds, and even resurrect the recently dead. This power require a strong will and earnest heart to wield and take a heavy toll on the user.

When inscribed onto objects, Celestian can be used to create weapons or armor that can enhance the user and cut through Sorcery.
objects.title: Celestial Mysticism (Archdemon's Dilemma)

objects.text:
Rudeus isn't the only wayward soul to have received power from the Demon God Laplace. In his effort to reincarnate into the future, Laplace's soul has imparted several of his characteristics onto your soul. Your soul isn't a perfect match for laplace, so you have no need to worry about the Demon God assuming control of your body. 

You've, through this attempt, gained both mana—the potential to cast the magic of the Six-Faced World—and increased potential and capacity for magic and mana, respectively. Mana circulates throughout the body like blood. Because of the internal constant mana flow, it is impossible for magic to materialize inside the body, thereby giving you protection from an enemy magic caster attempting to cast spells that attack you from the inside. While your growth rate in capacity will be highest while you're young, it will continue to grow so long as you continue to push your limits with magic, and you will be able to improve those very limits. Another benefit is that you have increased strength and endurance. It starts small, but like your mana, it will grow if you truly push your physical limits.

You start off with a decent amount of mana that grows with use and beginner knowledge in attacking, healing, and summoning magic. Attacking magic is the basic elements such as water, fire, and earth. Healing magic is both healing injuries, removing toxins, divine magic for smiting dark foes, buffs like making barriers and increasing mana regeneration, and even debuffs such as doing the reverse to weaken someone's defenses or mana regeneration.

Summoning magic is used to call forth beings such as spirits, fiends, and even people from one location or another through teleportation using magical circles and your own mana. The strength of the being and distance you can summon depends on both your own mana used and how clear of an image you have of what you want summoned.

You are knowledgeable enough to know the incantations and circles of all schools of magic to a novice level, and you also have knowledge of the next stage of each school up to God Rank. Though you cannot skip steps, and it will likely take you years of study and practice to get to such a level. Such a level could allow you to do feats like teleporting to other worlds, time traveling, healing anything short of death, and potentially even that. You will also develop the ability to forgo the chants for your spells.

You notably lack the trait that would prevent you from forming and wearing a battle aura. You may optionally possess the trait of having green hair, which might instill some level of apprehension in others or arouse their bigotry if you ever find yourself in the Six-Faced World.
objects.title: Laplace Factor (Mushoku Tensei)

addons.text: Your potential for self improvement in your mana acquisition and physical prowess has influenced your ability to wear Battle Aura. No longer is there a limit in sight for your prowess with Battle Aura. It is a near certainty that consistent training will see you becoming the next Fighting God and even God Rank within the 3 fighting styles.
addons.title: Fighting God

addons.text:
Your introspection and ability to manifest your very soul has boosted your innate understanding and ability to wield Battle Aura. Your Battle Aura now rivals that of the Dragon Tribe, boasting a much higher efficiency and overwhelming defensive quality. Training with this form of Battle Aura will see you one day able to rival the likes of Dragon God Orsted in aura usage.

You also learn the legendary fighting style of the Dragon Tribe Saint Dragon Battle Aura. A form that boasts greatly increased defensive power and requires much less mana to use.
addons.title: Saint Dragon Battle Aura

objects.text:
A seemingly mundane physical application of mana manipulation, Battle Aura seeks to provide a method for explosively improving physical power, defense, speed, and combat senses. While it functions off of manipulating the mana within the body, its use is more a function of instinct that grows with the physical training of one's body and can be further amplified with focus and additional mana. As one trains their body and fighting forms, they will innately come to understand how to wear their Battle Aura and improve it.

Battle Aura can be applied to specific body parts or the entire body as needed.

Offensive use of Battle Aura goes hand in hand with one of the three primary sword-fighting schools. Your Battle Aura will improve your physical prowess and if applied to your sword, allow you to strengthen it as well. A strengthened sword can slice through boulders in a single strike or unleash a flash of your blade to fell distant foes.

Enveloping your body in your Battle Aura provides a defensive shell against attacks; mastery of this will allow you to become impenetrable to most physical attacks and provided limited magic resistance. Extending your aura to your clothing and armor will extend their durability by an equal measure.

Your initial mastery of Battle Aura places you at the Intermediate Rank with Sword God style, Water God style, and North God style. Understanding the fundamentals of your style and continued physical training will see you progress to the Saint Rank and maybe, one day, even King or Emperor Rank.
objects.title: Battle Aura (Mushoku Tensei)

addons.text: Your Arm and Tablet are now connected. Any Rune can now be used as a power, and your powers from the Arm are accessible as Runes as well. You can manifest items stored in your inventory on your hand and store things through it as well. Your GPS/Markers can be accessed in your mind, and so are the other functions.
addons.title: Sheikah-Zonai Integration

objects.text: Once the arm of the king of the Zonai, it is imbued with mighty power, able to channel four abilities: Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, and Recall. Ultrahand allows you to grab and move objects, with a limit of ten times you could lift with your body. You can also stick (and unstick) objects together. Fuse allow you to attach an object to a piece of equipment, enhancing their function depending on what was attached: gems could give elemental attacks or defenses, a piece of iron increases a shield's endurance, etc. It is highly dependent on the object nature, quality and symbolism, and the fused object will eventually run out of power and disintegrate. An equipment can only handle a single attachment at time. Ascend allows you to move upwards solid material. Be it a single floor above you or a whole mountain, so long there is a surface above your head, you can ascend above it like it doesn't exist. While it can not be used to go back down, so long as you don't leave the exit above you, you can return to where you stood before. And finally, Recall allows you to rewind the movement of objects. They will follow the same movement they did in the last minute, with you able to forward and rewind their movement in this minute. While the object can be destroyed in this mode, it can be stopped if anything sufficiently solid stands in its path. You can turn your arm's appearance on and off, changing it to another form you possess if you wish, and it could be a left arm you want. Alternatively, it can take place as your actual arm if you lack one.
objects.title: King Rauru's Right Arm (Legend of Zelda)

addons.text:
You have acquired knowledge in the field of magic tool creation and development. You could create everything from flying carpets that utilize strength magic's manipulation of force vectors, to teleportation arrays that take advantage of the higher space-time applications of light magic, or even great magic cannons that fire blasts of composite magic capable of wiping out scores of enemies.

Given enough time and resources you could recreate and improve upon the "Magician's Country" Magnostadt's capital city, which can be thought of as one giant magic tool supplemented by many other smaller magic tools. A city protected by grand magical barriers and armaments, with endless water supplied by water magic and food grown with life magic, where heat magic ensures you will never need to brave the cold again. 

A veritable paradise where all of one's needs are met and you can devote your focus to further developing your magic in complete comfort. A paradise that would require a truly immense amount of magoi to function properly.
addons.title: Magic Tool Artisan

addons.text:
You are truly beloved by the Rukh.

Your mastery of Senjutsu has transformed your nature as a magician. You are now a Magi—a rare and powerful magician capable of not only drawing upon and manipulating your own magoi, but also accessing the magoi in your surroundings. This grants you a virtually limitless source of magical energy.

As one of the Magicians Who Shape the World, you stand head and shoulders above ordinary magicians. Even your most basic spells can reach awe-inspiring levels when fueled by the vast energies at your command.

This simple, yet immensely powerful, advantage grants you the potential to accomplish anything—limited only by your preparation, creativity, and skill.
addons.title: Magi

addons.text:
You have acquired a Metal Vessel that houses all 72 of Solomon's Djinn. In addition to all of the powers implied by this extraordinary Metal Vessel, such as Djinn Equip and Extreme Magic, your unique status as both a King Candidate and a Magician has elevated you into something greater.

Given your inherent ability to manipulate your own Magoi, you will have a far easier time learning to wield your Djinn's power when compared to your non-Magician counterparts. This means you will progress far faster and more naturally than other Metal Vessel Users, learning to wield your Full-Body Djinn Equip and even its Extreme Magic in just the time it would take for another to get a real handle on their Djinn Weapon Equip.

More impressively, you now have a far greater ability to synchronize with your Djinn, allowing you to truly make their power your own. As you gain mastery over your Djinns' power, you will gain the ability to use those powers as your own magic, from simple elemental manipulation in the early stages all the way up to the complete powers of all your Full-Body Djinn Equips at the highest levels of mastery, all without relying on your Metal Vessel.

If you also possess the Magi Addon, your unlimited Magoi allows you to physically manifest and command all of your Djinn simultaneously as your subordinates. This also grants you Solomon’s Wisdom, an ability that lets you perceive the past, present, and future through the flow of the Rukh. Since all life eventually returns to the Rukh, this effectively gives you access to the entirety of humanity’s accumulated knowledge, a power described as omniscience.

Tread carefully, for the human mind is not meant to bear the weight of such vast amounts of knowledge.
addons.title: Solomon's Vessel

addons.text:
No longer are you merely blessed by the Rukh—for the Rukh themselves have become extensions of your will. Like Solomon before you, you have usurped the power and authority of the creator god Ill Ilah. Through this, you have acquired domains, magic, fate, and creative power equal to your own primary one.

You now possess near-total dominion over magoi and the magic born from its manipulation, even gaining the ability to create and populate entire worlds with sentient life. You can establish alternate systems and laws to govern your creations—such as fate, magic, or the afterlife—just as Solomon and his followers once did.

This ascension has also vastly enhanced your previous abilities. By drawing on ambient magoi, you could effortlessly drain entire worlds of their life force to augment your already immense power. Likewise, with your magical prowess, you can casually cast basic spells amplified to rival, or even surpass, the scale of Extreme Magic.
addons.title: Usurper of Ill Ilah

objects.text:
You have been blessed by the Rukh, granting you an intrinsic ability to manipulate your own magoi—a form of life energy. This begins with the natural ability to form a Borg, a magical barrier whose durability depends on your power and skill as a magician, as well as the ability to fire your magoi as a projectile.

That, however, is only the beginning. The true power of magic lies in transforming magoi into physical phenomena. By shaping your magoi in increasingly complex ways, you can do anything from casting a simple fireball to transmuting nearby matter into a cozy cabin—or even bending the fundamental laws of the universe to your will.

Your journey begins with you classified under one of eight categories. These define the first and second types of magic you’ll learn most easily. However, these affinities only represent your personal strengths and do not prevent you from learning or mastering any of the other types—or even combining them for more powerful effects.

You begin with the magoi capacity of an average magician and one of the following alignments: 

Red Magician: Attracts the first type of Rukh. Specializes in Heat Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of flames and thermal energy. Secondary affinity is Wind Magic.

Blue Magician: Attracts the second type of Rukh. Specializes in Water Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of water and ice. Secondary affinity is Sound Magic.

Orange Magician: Attracts the third type of Rukh. Specializes in Light Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of light and even space-time at higher levels. Secondary affinity is Strength Magic.

Yellow Magician: Attracts the fourth type of Rukh. Specializes in Lightning Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of lightning. Secondary affinity is Life Magic.

White Magician: Attracts the fifth type of Rukh. Specializes in Wind Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of air. Secondary affinity is Heat Magic.

Green Magician: Attracts the sixth type of Rukh. Specializes in Sound Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of vibrations. Secondary affinity is Water Magic.

Black Magician: Attracts the seventh type of Rukh. Specializes in Strength Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of force vectors. Secondary affinity is Light Magic.

Purple Magician: Attracts the eighth type of Rukh. Specializes in Life Magic, which focuses on the generation and manipulation of biological matter. Secondary affinity is Lightning Magic.
objects.title: Magician (Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic)

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl whose power comes from Ena, the life force in all living things. Unlike traditional Magical Girls who channel Ena into themselves, you use it to summon insect or crustacean-based Familia. These are loyal, semi-intelligent beings with insect and crustacean themes that you communicate with mentally. They can grow massive and more powerful depending on how much Ena you invest, but they require a steady supply of Ena to remain active. If destroyed or left without energy, they dissolve back into formless Ena.

Familia can mimic existing lifeforms or be entirely custom. They have intelligence, act independently, and can use a wide range of abilities. They feed on living beings to survive and grow. As they face new challenges, they evolve and adapt. Information is shared instantly between all Familia and with you. This includes strategies, mutations, and combat data. With enough Ena, they can generate their own Familia that surpasses previous generations.

Familia can develop adaptations such as EMP bursts, magic-nullifying songs, amplification effects, or plasma weapons. Even when dormant, they evolve ways to conserve energy and improve. You can use their experiences and your research to enhance designs. If one evolves the ability to disable an entire city with an EMP, you can summon that version again or modify it further.

There are no distance limits to your connection. You remain in contact with them even across dimensions. You can speak to them without transforming, and you also command all insects and crustaceans. You can summon up to ten Familia per day, and their power can rival modern battleships. Your Ena capacity depends on your physical body, and your regeneration rate is tied to your stamina recovery. Both are influenced by anything that affects you physically.
objects.title: Silver Lotus (Predator Magical Girl)

addons.text:
Your nature as both a siphoning witch and a vampire has created something far more blasphemous than a typical siphoner—a heretic. Unlike ordinary witches who lose their magic upon being turned into a vampire, you retain your magical ability. This unique trait allows you to siphon magic directly from your vampiric curse, effectively granting you a source of magic.

Most heretics must be cautious not to over-drain their curse’s magical energy, as doing so can lead to death. But as an Original, you are different: no matter how much magical energy you siphon from your curse, you will never truly die. At worst, over-draining will put you into a temporary coma while it regenerates.

Furthermore, by siphoning magic from your curse, you can gradually strengthen its power over time, much like training a muscle.
addons.title: Heretic

objects.text:
You're a rare subclass of witch, often seen as an abomination by others of your kind. Unlike traditional witches, you aren’t born with innate magical power. Instead, you possess the unique ability to siphon and temporarily use magical energy from external sources through physical touch.

Because siphoning relies on touch, it’s most effective with direct contact, allowing you to absorb energy at nearly a perfect ratio. While siphoning through thin materials is possible, doing so significantly reduces its efficiency. Siphoning from sentient things is especially difficult—they innately resist the process, and this resistance increases sharply if they actively fight back.

Though powerful, siphoning magic is both physically and mentally draining, with the strain scaling according to the strength and resistance of the source. Finally, due to the absence of innate magic, siphoned energy can only be retained temporarily, fading entirely over time and at an increasingly rapid rate the longer it is held.

Note: This doesn't give any knowledge or mastery on using the magical energy you siphon
objects.title: Siphoner Witch (Originals)

objects.text:
Zero Numbering Skills, also known as Skills of Annihilation, are the most powerful abilities available in the otherworld. Upon complete mastery, they elevate the wielder into a transcendent being, capable of either destroying an entire world or ruling over it as an invincible existence.

Some known Skills of Annihilation include:

Demonic Dragon Reinforcement: This skill allows the user to cloak themselves in draconic energy, enhancing every aspect of their body as well as any magical artifact they wield. It also enables racial metamorphosis, transforming the user’s internal physiology to that of a demonic dragon.

Pandemic Blade: This skill grants the user the power to create magical disease agents in various forms, such as viruses, fungi, and more. These agents possess a wide range of devastating effects and consume everything they touch to propagate themselves further.

Nine Dragon Spear: This skill forms nine strands of mana in the shape of dragons, which coil within the user’s body. When activated, these mana-dragons draw out all the user’s strength and magic, causing immense strain before unleashing the accumulated energy at the tip of the user’s weapon, at the speed of light.

Immortal Soul: This skill grants the user overwhelming regenerative power that affects both body and soul. As long as the user is alive, they will rapidly recover to full health, making them nearly impossible to kill.

Demon’s Gate: This skill allows the user to borrow power from the thirteen strongest Demon Lords of the Abyss, in exchange for a sacrifice equivalent to the power being drawn.

Mad Demon / Soul Explosion: These twin skills allow the user to greatly amplify their power by burning away their own life force and soul in exchange for a temporary but massive increase in strength.

While each skill grants different powers, the conditions for mastery remain the same: you must fight until either you or the world is annihilated.

You may choose from any existing Zero Numbering Skill featured in canon or create your own of comparable strength. Regardless of your choice, you will begin with very low proficiency and must endure numerous trials, both internal and external, before you can fully master the skill and achieve transcendence.
objects.title: Zero Numbering Skill (Reincarnator)

objects.text:
Craft is the art of sculpting the many facets of the world to one’s desires. However, its use is limited by several rules that need to be respected in order for Craft to work correctly and to keep the user safe. In order to use Craft, one needs to know the appropriate ritual to cast the spell. For most Craft types, this ritual only involves doing specific hand signs as well as some minor gestures, such as clapping, putting your arms up or snapping your fingers. 

Using Craft also requires the user to spend some amount of power. For most Craft types, this consumption is barely noticeable, but when someone uses Craft intensively without taking the time to rest or cool down, they might become sick, woozy and feverish. Those symptoms are usually harmless and go away after resting. 

Craft has a wide variety of applications, from skills used during battles to everyday spells, such as sculpting matter to a specific shape, painting, creating weapons, or giving objects magical properties, such as animating statues and drawings, making clothes able to regulate their temperature and grow with their user, or making candles which change smell as time goes by. 

One example would be Body Craft which can modify your appearance, and go as far as completely changing your body and gender, though it can take up to a month to Craft your new body.
 
There are three main types of Craft: 

Rock Craft (also called Protecting Craft), which focuses on protection by tanking hits, buffing allies’ defense and debuffing enemies to prevent them from doing too much damage. The hand sign associated with Rock Craft is a closed fist, as if mimicking a rock. Rock Craft smells like wet rocks.

Paper Craft (also called Creative Craft), which focuses on creation, crafting powerful spells and modifying allies and enemies’ Craft resistance in order to get an advantage during a fight. The hand sign associated with Paper Craft is an open hand with the fingers held together, as if mimicking a sheet of paper. Paper Craft smells like wood or leaves.

Scissors Craft (also called Piercing Craft), which focuses on raw damage by attacking multiple enemies or one enemy several times and buffing allies’ speed in order to attack first. The hand sign associated with Piercing Craft is a closed fist with the index and middle fingers held outwards, as if mimicking a pair of scissors. Scissors Craft smells like scissors.

You can choose which one is your primary Craft type, making it possible for you to easily pick up skills of the corresponding Craft, but with enough research and time, Craft skills can be acquired regardless of one's type.
objects.title: Craft (In Stars and Time)

addons.text:
You also gain Chrestomanci Castle, a fortress of magic defended with some of, if not the most powerful magical protections it’s possible to make.

Similar to the White House, this Castle is both the head of the Government Office you lead, and your personal private dwelling, and is staffed by an assortment of loyal servants. It has a variety of workshops to practice your magic within, an expansive garden, a vast library, and a multitude of offices, among other things.  

This Castle also has the ability to act as a school, to educate any children or wards the Chrestomanci might have in their care. You can choose to educate these young minds yourself, or elect to leave that responsibility to an array of elite tutors instead.
addons.title: Chrestomanci Castle

objects.text: Well now, aren’t you something interesting? With your purchase here, you gain the title, powers, and privileges of Chrestomanci. To be Chrestomanci is part name, part title, and part of what you are. The name of Chrestomanci is special. While you are the current Chrestomanci, it can serve as your legal name for any purpose, and if necessary, it can be considered your only name. This name is protected from all harm that might befall it; it can’t be stolen by the fae, accidentally traded away, or connected to your original name in any way. Additionally, it cannot be used to control you, even if someone attempts to learn your "true" name. You are also aware of every instance in which it might be invoked, able to sense the context of its use and who is using it. Should you wish, you can teleport to the location via magic. Three uses of this name by the same person, can be used to attempt to summon you, though due to your purchase here, you are not forced to answer such summons. The title of Chrestomanci is a government position, with each Chrestomanci responsible for locating and training their own successor while regulating the use of magic across the world. Thanks to your purchase here, you may choose which government your new position is associated with and how that connection is defined. Perhaps you will serve as the Secretary of Magic for the United States? Or maybe you prefer the role of Minister for Magic in the United Kingdom? In either case, this comes with a generous government salary and nearly free rein to act as you see fit, provided you maintain order within the magical community. What a Chrestomanci is represents something rare, almost unique. Across all known parallel worlds, there can be no duplicates, meaning that all the magical power and potential those duplicates might have possessed is concentrated in that singular life. A Chrestomanci is consequently born with an immense amount of magical power and multiple extra lives—one for each world that lacks a duplicate of them.
objects.title: Chrestomanci, Chrestomanci (Chrestomanci)

objects.text: Ask not for whom the Bells toll, for they toll for thee. You are an Abhorsen, a guardian tasked with defending the fragile boundary between Life and Death. Your unique nature grants you the ability to freely traverse the realms of the dead and return unharmed. This power allows you to journey to any afterlife across different worlds; if no specific afterlife exists, your destination defaults to the Nine Precincts of the Old Kingdom's afterlife. Your primary tools are the Seven Bells—powerful artifacts capable of commanding life and death in myriad ways. You possess a complete set of these Bells—and a bandolier to secure them in—with the ability to craft more if needed. Ranna, the Sleeper: The first and smallest of the bells, yet far from weak. Her gentle, lullaby-like tone can lull any listener into restful sleep. Mosrael, the Waker: The second bell is loud and raucous, reminiscent of screaming birds. Its shrill cry awakens the dead, at the cost of being cast into the realms of death yourself. Kibeth, the Walker: The third bell is challenging and rebellious. Its discordant song can struggle to be heard, but compels those who hear it to move at its unpredictable tune. With skill and care, however, all who hear it will march to your command. Dyrim, the Speaker: The fourth bell sings brightly and clearly, granting the gift of speech—both to the living and the dead—and can just as easily silence them. Belgaer, the Thinker: The fifth bell emits a bright, resonant tone. A cunning Trickster, Belgaer can bestow or extract independent thought, or erase memories entirely. Saraneth, the Binder: The sixth bell peals deep and commanding. Its long, low tones can bind those who hear it to the wielder’s will, forcing obedience. Astrael, the Weeper: The largest and final bell, her voice begins softly but swells into an all-consuming crescendo. Those who hear her are cast into the depths of death’s embrace. Note: Typically, these powers would require both free magic and the Charter of the Old Kingdom. This version of Abhorsen operates independently, wielding these abilities in their own right.
objects.title: Abhorsen (The Old Kingdom)

objects.text:
Magic in this system is the art of turning pure imagination into reality, fueled by Mana and shaped through the clarity of the caster’s visualization. Unlike rigid schools or prefabricated spells, the limits of Imagination Magic depend entirely on how well the caster can picture and understand the phenomenon they wish to reproduce.

At its simplest, a Magician gathers Mana and shapes it into an effect through visualization and intent. Beginners often use chants and gestures to stabilize their mental image, but these are merely tools; a truly skilled mage needs only willpower and imagination. Spells can range from the ordinary—fireballs, barriers, healing—to the extraordinary, such as folding space to create a gate or amplifying fire by picturing its chemical reactions. The more precise the visualization, the more stable and effective the result.

Mana is a personal, internal energy that replenishes naturally with rest, though intense casting can burn out the body and mind if control is lacking. In rare cases, a magician who completely loses control may be consumed by their own Mana, transforming into a “Devil.” With discipline and training, however, Magicians can push their limits safely, achieving devastating effects without chants or formulas.

In addition to spellcasting, Imagination Magic grants the ability to enchant items. By visualizing a desired effect and inscribing its structure into an object, you can create enchanted gear and magical tools. These tools can replicate spells without requiring magical ability from the user, making them invaluable to both warriors and common folk. The stronger the material and the clearer the visualization, the more powerful the tool becomes.

At your starting level, you are a competent novice: capable of elemental attacks, simple barriers, and minor enchantments. With practice, creativity, and knowledge of natural laws, your magic can grow exponentially. A modern mind equipped with science or engineering knowledge has an immense edge, as understanding the mechanics behind a spell allows for more complex and powerful applications. Ultimately, with enough imagination and control, there is no ceiling—your magic can rival the laws of nature themselves.
objects.title: Imagination Magic (Wiseman’s Grandchild)

addons.text:
Thanks to your studies in Biomancy, your mastery as a Devil Forgemaster transcends simple creation. No longer are your Night Creatures bound by the forms imposed at their forging—you can now reshape them through the forbidden art of fleshcraft. Their bodies become mutable clay in your hands, flesh and bone bending to your will as you alter their capabilities, appearances, and functions.

You may graft wings onto a hulking brute, lace a beast’s veins with venom, gift a Night Creature armored hide impervious to arrows, or weave entirely new organs that allow them to breathe fire, release toxins, or regenerate endlessly. This process is not limited to mere enhancement; you can reforge them mid-existence, evolving them as battles demand, creating living weapons perfectly suited to any challenge.

Beyond monstrous transformation, you can also restore to them the power of disguise. Through your will, a Night Creature may don a human shape—flawless enough to move through cities, interact with mortals, and pass unnoticed. Yet at any moment, they can cast aside the mask of humanity, reverting to their true, terrifying form in an instant. This duality makes them not only weapons of war but also tools of deception, infiltration, and subterfuge.

Each change reflects your intent and imagination, and over time your creations may evolve into entirely new breeds of monstrosities—nightmarish beings that blur the line between invention and evolution. But such power carries its danger: every modification pushes your creatures further from the memory of humanity, and only your will—and your preserved human mind—keeps them loyal and bound.

Through Fleshforged, your Night Creatures cease to be static horrors. They become living, ever-changing extensions of your craft, evolving echoes of your dominion over life, death, and flesh itself.
addons.title: Fleshforged

objects.text:
You are now a Devil Forgemaster, a rare human marked by the forbidden gift of giving life where only death remains. This power is not mere necromancy, for it does not restore a body to its former state—it creates a new existence from death itself. With every forging, you infuse a corpse with a soul torn from Hell, shaping the body into a vessel through which that damned essence may manifest in the world. From this act are born the Night Creatures, beings whose very existence defies the laws of creation.

The forging process differs from one Forgemaster to another: some work with patience and crafted tools, carefully reconstructing remains to grant them a new purpose; others prefer more direct methods, invoking with their own magic and channeling souls without elaborate preparation. Yet what truly distinguishes one Forgemaster from another is not the technique, but the essence within them—reflected outward in a unique glow that mirrors the Forgemaster’s own nature.

Your Night Creatures may take on terrifying and varied forms: winged horrors, fanged beasts, abominations with countless eyes, grotesque amalgamations of flesh and bone, or towering monstrosities meant to crush armies. All share strength, speed, and resilience far beyond that of humans, and many are born with the instinct to wield weapons like seasoned warriors. Still, while their natural urge is to kill, devour, and destroy, it is your will that shapes their purpose. You may unleash them as an unstoppable legion of annihilation—or, should you choose, direct them toward impossible labors, burying the dead, raising walls, and rebuilding ruins.

But this power demands a singular price: to be a Devil Forgemaster, one must preserve their humanity. It is that spark which binds you to the damned souls and grants absolute command over them. Without it, the creatures would spiral into chaos, and the Forgemaster would be consumed by the very darkness they wield. Within you coexists compassion and damnation, creation and destruction, humanity and Hell.

You have received this power, and with it the paradox of being both creator and destroyer. For as a Devil Forgemaster, death itself becomes your workshop—and your will is the law that guides the beasts of the abyss.
objects.title: Devil Forgemaster (Castlevania)

objects.text: You have the knowledge of Glyphs from the Castlevania Series. Created by the Order of Ecclesia, they are magical symbols that contain abstract representations of power infused with magical energy which can be released when the user channels mana through the glyph. Glyphs have many uses, they can project weapons, create defensive shields, call down elemental attacks, summon familiars, enhance the user, manipulate gravity or magnetism, and more. When casting two or more glyphs at the same time, you can perform a Glyph Union, such as the creation of a fire sword by combining the Ignis and Secare glyphs. You can create any of the glyphs seen in the series, including the three fragments of Dominus, and even develop your own designs. You can assign glyphs to several parts on your body, each arm can have three projection glyphs, your back can have five support or enhancement glyphs, and one projection or enhancement glyph on each leg. To use those glyphs, you also gain a small pool of mana, enough to cast glyphs two dozen time (or channel a glyph for 30 seconds). It takes 5 minutes to fully recharge from empty. This mana pool will grow over time. You can also awaken other people with a ritual glyph (that you will need to discover), this will grant them a mana pool similar to your own and allow them to use glyphs, but they remain dependent on your to create and implant those glyphs on their body. They are also limited to a single glyph on each arm and back.
objects.title: Glyphs (Castlevania)

objects.text:
It seems you’ve inherited what even Gaius the Sage could not fathom: the fusion of all four Crests into one perfect whole. This “Fifth Crest” grants the strengths of every mark without their weaknesses, something akin to a Transcendental Art on itself.

With it, you command the 1st Crest’s enchantment and crafting arts, the 2nd Crest’s devastating magical artillery, the 3rd Crest’s relentless consecutive casting, and the 4th Crest’s brutal body reinforcement and melee sorcery. Instead of clashing, these specialties flow together, giving you adaptability in every role and a limitless path of growth.

In addition, you inherit the entirety of magical knowledge preserved by modern humanity—the faded legacy of Gaius’s age, studied, reshaped, and passed down through the centuries. Though a shadow of what once was, this corpus of lore grants you mastery of every spell, method, and technique known to the world today, letting you apply the Crest’s perfect harmony on top of all current magical practice.
objects.title: The Fifth Crest (Shikkakumon no Saikyō Kenja)

addons.text:
It seems that your Shadow and Stand have fused into a singular, far more powerful entity.

On top of retaining and being able to swap between all the abilities your Shadow and Stand had, like switching whether it is visible or not, the Shadow/Stand gains two new abilities.

First, your Shadow/Stand can fuse with yourself to attain a corporeal transformation that is several times more powerful, and eliminates the weakness of targeting the wielder.

Second and finally, the Shadow/Stand can now learn the abilities of other Stands like it would in classes. Notably, the difficulty of learning an ability depends on how powerful and how different the Stand is from either your original one or one you have previously learned.
addons.title: My Shadow Walks Beside Me

addons.text:
It seems that the mixture of plasmids and vigor flowing through you and your Shadow manifested has resulted in an expansion of both your and your Shadow’s versatility.

Your Shadow can now learn classes based upon the plasmids and vigors flowing through you, and conversely, you can make plasmids and vigors based upon the classes your Shadow has accessed. For example, a Teleport class that has spells and abilities based around teleportation, and a Sword Master plasmid that allows you to emit all manner of elemental blades from your body.
addons.title: ADAM’s Shadow

addons.text:
It seems that you learned to create the various technologies that belonged to Blue Dragon’s ancient civilization. 

Through this, you could make shapeable force fields, moon-based lasers, fish-shaped flying vehicles that are space-capable, devices that, when powered by a Shadow, produce seemingly limitless power, a teleportation network, sapient robots/AI, gargantuan machines capable of splitting worlds into cubes, and even biomechanical weapons capable of destroying or wiping out advanced civilizations.
addons.title: Ancient Machinery (Blue Dragon)

addons.text:
As you walk your journey of self-realization, the power of your emotions reaches new heights, and your Persona's power imparts strength upon your Shadow, giving it access to Classes based on the Arcana, such as the Chariot Arcana, which grants it a class that vastly increases its speed, as well as classes based on the Race of Demons, such as Genma / Demigod and Dragon.

As your Persona and Shadow become interconnected, while remaining independent powers, you can utilize them both simultaneously without extra strain, and due to this, you can perform Fusion Spells right away with your Persona and Shadow, with the number of Personas used at once increasing over time as you continue on your journey.

Finally, you can call upon the Shadows of those with whom you have a bond (even if they have yet to awaken their own, though this means their strength would be diminished until they do) to draw upon their power, and you can even merge them with your own Shadow temporarily to increase its power and gain new abilities.
addons.title: The Fool's Shadow

objects.text:
Through a surge of powerful emotions, you have created a soul light that subsequently created your Shadow, now making you a Shadow Wielder.

To start with, shadow wielders are those who use the type of magical power known as Shadow, through which the user’s natural shadow manifests into a corporeal creature. Further, possessing a Shadow grants the wielder immense power in both the form of magic and superhuman capabilities.

Notably, the abilities of shadows will manifest in the form of a class, with abilities and spells that match, like Sword Master, which conjures elemental blades, but it is possible to learn other classes, expanding the Shadow’s arsenal. The classes are the following: Sword Master, White Magic User, Black Magic User, Monk, Assassin, Guardian, Sniper, Forger, Support, Bind, Death, Barrier, Item, Spread, Charge, Divinity, Stasis, Star, and Moon.

It should be known that with training, a wielder could perform Corporeal Attacks, which temporarily turn their Shadow into a real creature to unleash a devastating attack that also restores the wielder’s magical energy.

Finally, depending upon whether you use your Shadow for good or evil, it will determine its coloration, with using it for good making it blue and using it for evil making it purplish-red.
objects.title: Shadow Wielder (Blue Dragon)

addons.text: You've succeded where Babidi, Demigura, Cucumber, and Zahha have failed in bending the wills of the Z-Fighters one way or another. You can cast a specialized spell upon a target of your choosing, drawing out all their latent power and gain them as a loyal servant bound to you, with a change to their appearance that reflects this, like a Majin Mark. This boost scales in proportion to your total magical power and the potential of your target, with all but the strongest wills being defenseless against this. None of your subordinates are able to challenge you, and that's even if they think to do so in the first place.
addons.title: Bibidi Bababi Buu

addons.text: You inherit the magical power and abilities of Moro, a Galatic Patrol prisoner who once threatened numerous planets by himself. Your magical abilities are now on par with his—able to absorb the life energy of living beings and entire planets and convert it into more magical power. Boosting your reserves, granting eternal youth, sustenance, acquiring knowledge, skills, and other applications. You also have access to his many techniques and understanding of magic as a whole. Currently you can match his fully restored form before absorbing OG73.
addons.title: Moro

addons.text:
You can create all the magical items from the Dragon Ball Universe. From senzu beans, specialized containers for the Mafuba, the Ultra Divine Water, Third Eye, Powerpole, wands, Zahha's swords, etc.

Even creating your own set of Dragon Balls and upgrading them isn't far from reach. You can easily create variants or your own original creations as well.

Optionally, you can have a replica of Kami's Lookout as an archive for your creations and a wizard's tower.
addons.title: Kami
Unified Essence
addons.text:
Your understanding of Ki allows you to perceive and manipulate the life force underlying Magic with far greater precision. 

Ki can be used to fuel, reinforce, or stabilize spells, while your magical knowledge makes shaping, controlling, and developing Ki techniques significantly easier. 

The Ki cultivation manual naturally incorporates these interactions where applicable, helping you safely refine both disciplines together. 

Your mastery of Ki also improves your ability to empower, craft, and maintain magical objects by directly supplying them with your own life force, allowing them to become stronger and more efficient than they otherwise would. 

As both disciplines grow, each continually reinforces the other, making the creation of unique hybrid techniques increasingly natural.

objects.text:
You gain access to the power of Magic from the Dragon Ball universe, a multifaceted art that's just as, if not more versatile than Ki. With widespread applications such as manipulating the elements, healing, conjuration, transmutation, sealing, mind control, energy absorption, shapeshifting, empowerment, telekinesis, and so much more. 

Unlike Ki which relies on your physical constitution for advancement, Magic only requires knowledge, imagination, and practice to expand your potency. Even the frailest of beings will still keep their immense magical power as long they are still breathing. 

It's possible to mimic techniques derived from Ki with Magic or mix them together to create unique results; such as flight, energy blasts, or teleportation. Furthermore, you gain a natural talent for interacting with magical objects or creating them should you be able to.

Your growth rate in Magic increases should you be someone or something naturally gifted in it. Such as a Namekian, Majin, or Demon.
objects.title: Magic (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
The experience of traveling through time and space sublimated your soul, enhancing your talents in the fields of Spirit and Inspiration. Your unique experiences have also made you sensitive to changes in time and space and immune to temporal or spatial paradoxes.

And with sensitivity to changes in time and space can assist with learning temporal and spatial spells. When you experience or observe things that manipulate time or space, you will be able to perceive exactly how they work and learn them.

While this Trait isn't particularly flashy compared to other SSR grade traits, it's far rarer due to how it is obtained.
addons.title: [Otherworldly Soul {SSR}]

addons.text:
From your parentage, you inherit this mental trait. A powerful trait graded SR. While learning from mistakes is a talent inherent in all intelligent beings. This trait takes that to another level, through countless battles and hard work, you can improve your skills in a terrifying year. 

You’re not a genius, but you can shorten the gap between you and geniuses through hard work. With a persistent and unyielding will, you learn from your failure and get stronger with each setback. What doesn’t kill you only makes you stronger.
addons.title: [Hard Work Can Make Up for Talent {SR}]

addons.text:
From your ancestry, you’ve inherited the Trait that made the God-King stand above Heaven. A Core Trait surpassing SSR and becoming UR. While all intelligent beings learn from mistakes, this trait pushes it to the extreme. Through sheer persistence, everything becomes a lesson, letting you close the gap between yourself and true geniuses through some effort alone. 

What doesn’t kill you makes you stronger. When you take damage, you instantly analyze it and develop a resistance to that specific type of damage. The same kind of damage won’t harm you twice. Any mistakes you make are corrected so you won’t make them again. If your skills fail to work, you can adapt them to work. Even if you're piloting a mech, you can raise your piloting skills to copy the abilities of Angels despite using an inferior mech that isn't even the same lifeform. 

Any Learning, Mental, or talent-enhancing traits you evolve are reduced to costing nearly nothing. This trait is the culmination of a Witch’s Learning capability combined with their ability to evolve themselves further. Through practice, you can gain mental Traits without evolving them.
addons.title: [Fool's Wisdom {UR}]

addons.text:
You stand as the future Queen of Witches, even among the best of the top genius Witches. Every trait you possess is enhanced to be greater than any other member of your species and any member of the species your traits come from. And your Talents for any field can surpass even the most specialized of Witches.

You start with a Mana Capacity of 300,000, and it grows unhindered regardless of your current Mana Capacity. You can burn only a fraction of your Mana Capacity for evolutions that are far stronger than what they are based on, almost like you are copying the best of the best from a given trait. If you have multiple traits, they will work together and synergize seamlessly. And any trait you possess, no matter how weak, can be enhanced just by training with it. Even if you evolve an N Trait, as you use it, it will evolve alongside you into a UR Trait.

You have a destiny equivalent to one of the Queens of Witches, blessed by the world, as you accomplish great feats or get stronger, your destiny grows brighter. The larger your fate, the greater your magic growth speed, magic recovery speed, magic power, and luck will improve. If your fate is high enough, you can achieve anything you want and perceive the river of fate itself.
addons.title: [Fourth Calamity {UR}]

addons.text:
Your qualifications have been recognized, the whole Witch world will recognize your achievements and look forward to your future. It’s not a matter of how strong you are, instead, it is a matter of when you get strong. Simply by aging, Fate compounds on you, your Mana Capacity, Mana Recover, Magic Power, and Luck increase faster than anyone else. A Destiny on par with three previous Queen of Witches and the World.

It's from this Destiny that you can perceive the rivers of fate more accurately than anyone else. Allowing you to predict the future and manipulate it, perceiving the cause and effect of things. You can alter and subterfuge fate, though the older you get, the better you are at this. Should you grow to have enough Fate, you can reverse Fate itself. Divination and other future-seeing abilities from enemies would instead betray them.

You are the Nightmare of All Beings and the Dream of Witches. Without doing anything, you experience growth in Mana Capacity simply by existing. Although while they grow, it doesn’t mean it’s anything special right now. But assuming you do not evolve and simply wait, you could surpass anyone. Any Traits you possess will evolve without spending anything, even the simplest of abilities will become something that can surpass SSR Traits and become UR after many years.
addons.title: [Old One Ruler {SSR}]

addons.text:
When you die, you go to the Underworld, regardless of what condition you were in when you died or what killed you. You will come here when you truly die. If you have the means to revive yourself, then you’ll only go to the Underworld when you run out of options.

As a Witch, conquering territories is written in your blood. The further you explore the Underworld, the next time you come back or respawn, you go to where you’ve previously explored. And Demons are creatures full of mana, not only can you claim their power. But you can also eat their flesh to expand your maximum mana capacity. The more powerful the demon, the stronger you get and the better they taste. If you conquer the Underworld completely, you can skip conquering the tower and revive yourself almost immediately.

If you go to other places in the multiverse with different Underworlds, you can conquer those as well. Due to your familiarity and powers gained from Demons, evolving demonic traits is cheaper. Similar to every other evolution, Demonic traits make your Demonic powers stronger.
addons.title: [Underworld Blessing {SR}]

addons.text:
Through intense martial arts training, a Witch can condense a Martial Arts Will into a Martial Soul. And you've formed a Martial Soul that stands above all others, an Indomitable Martial Soul. A Martial Soul allows you to perceive the willpower of others, seeing their thoughts and combat style, and even knowing the opponents they faced to build their willpower. Without a Martial Soul, even the most skilled martial artists are powerless against you.

The strongest aspect of your Martial Soul is the ability to find pleasure in pain. Things that would make even those afraid of pain find the joy in combat and intense training. A Martial Soul can turn pain into strength, increasing in fever the more you fight. Just having a Martial Soul makes you 10 times stronger, with more willpower boosting it even further to 100 times or more.

You can manifest your Martial Soul to fight with or within you, allowing you to fight remotely or boost yourself. Only those who can perceive willpower or other Witches with high Inspiration can see your Martial Soul, which looks like your inner self. It could vary from looking like a Paladin to a Dragon Witch.

You can still summon or use your Martial Soul even after you die. Existing entirely off your Martial Soul, your entire body could be vaporized or your soul destroyed, and you can still keep fighting. The more battles you face, the more refined your Martial Soul becomes. Even if your body and soul are destroyed, you can use magic to restore them.

However, should there be a gap in your willpower while your flesh is dead or your soul is destroyed, you will die.
addons.title: [Indomitable Martial Soul {SSR}]

addons.text:
From your parentage, you inherit the ability to control technology. Interfacing directly with all mechanical and scientific creations and enhancing them beyond their limits. This trait improves your Inspiration and construction abilities. 

Anything you create is blessed by you, improving their capabilities and allowing them to become psychic over time. A spiritual object that has gained sufficient experience through combat or emotions will awaken, evolving towards the user to be used better or even gaining entirely new abilities. A machine blessed by a Witch far surpasses machines created by other species even without awakening spirituality.

You can create designs with just an idle thought or simply just the idea of it without any foundational knowledge. And with just a design, you can create an improved version. Which in turn can create an even better version with just a glance through it. Your Inspiration can improve any flaws in its designs quickly and evolve them into something more. While constructing technology, you can incorporate magic and abilities you possess or know to work better with them or even replicate them. You can learn to create warships that enhance a Dragon Witch’s Dragon Breath or a set of dice that creates prophecies.
addons.title: [Technology Witch {SSR}]

addons.text:
From your parentage, you inherit the source of a Dragon’s power. A legendary trait graded SSR that stands far above any natural trait. This trait allows Dragons to stand as one of the disasters of the multiverse. You inherit their breath, which shapes and gives a Dragon their strength. 

As long as you can breathe, you will keep growing stronger. This breath is the source of a dragon’s strength, and it is their breath that has the power to destroy everything. As Dragon's Breath is the core of a Dragon's strength, any Dragon-based evolutions you do are far cheaper. But even without evolving, simply by breathing, you can obtain traits Dragons possess.

You start out possessing the Traits all Dragon Witches possess. You possess Dragon Claws that pierce through magic, Dragon Scales that resist magic, Dragon Wings that allow flight, Dragon Eyes that can see souls, and Dragon’s Breath that can be changed to any element you want and destroy anything. As you continue to breathe, you can gain special traits from more unique Dragons like [Golden Lands of the Earth Veins {SSR}].

As a Dragon Witch, you also are born mastering the Dragon Language. While the human language needs paragraphs to explain dozens of lines of words. Dragons can chant magic with a single syllable or roar that is not just faster but stronger. Compared to non-Dragon Witches, Dragon-based abilities are stronger, and you slowly surpass that of ordinary dragons.
addons.title: [Dragon’s Breath {SSR}]

addons.text:
You inherit the Traits of the Demonic Earth Mother Goddess Dragon. While not a Core Trait, this is a Trait that can consume wealth and store it into a treasury inside you. You can summon this Golden Land along with any buildings, structures, and treasures you stored and control them. Creating portals, you can shoot out and control any weapons you stored or create building walls. If you have materials from a War Spaceship, you can use that to construct not just your buildings but also your scales.

The strength of your Golden Land is determined by the amount of Wealth you accumulated. While summoned, all your Attributes are enhanced, from physical and magical to talents and Inspiration. And if necessary, you can consume this wealth to gain a permanent boost to your abilities depending on how valuable the wealth consumed was. Consuming wealth also heals you and restores magical power. As you inherit traits from a Demonic Dragon Earth Mother Goddess, you get an additional permanent enhancement when you satisfy your desires.
addons.title: [Golden Land of the Earth Veins {SSR}]

addons.text:
From either your parentage, the world's consciousness, or faith, you have become a God Witch. Capable of using divine power, you can suppress those weaker than you with just a thought. A God Witch has ascended and passively gained divine power through managing the world and faith.

You gain abilities based on your domains that let you control a core aspect of the world. For example, a God of the Sun can control the sun’s movement and gain abilities based on it, but if you did not create or absorb the sun, you cannot control it. Your soul takes on traits from your domains. Manifesting your soul’s image can impact reality, and your illusions become real until they run out of mana. Your soul allows full control over your inner self. Your primal instincts cannot influence you beyond what you allow, and you are immune to outside influence.
Once, by declaring a world as your home, you can upgrade it. Any beings native to the world will have higher upper capacity and better natural talents. If the world lacks a consciousness, it gains one. A world’s consciousness can grow on its own or by consuming other worlds. For a larger world, attacks that normally destroy the universe would instead require something capable of destroying multiple universes. Upgrading a world also raises the limit of what beings can enter without collapsing reality.

As a God Witch, you can speak the highest effect of language. With just words, you can manifest what you describe. Magic becomes cheaper and stronger when cast using your myths and domains. In rituals or other magical methods, your presence alone boosts the result. Since your words are your true voice, you can combine this with any language you know.
addons.title: [Daughter of God {SSR}]

addons.text:
From your parentage, you inherit the source of an angel’s power. You gain an angel halo. It can channel faith from others and allow the use of holy light. With enough faith from believers, you can ascend into a god.

An angel’s halo can gather prayers and control faith. While witches can use faith for themselves, the angel ring lets you use faith from others to boost magic. Curses and negative prayers can be purified by faith. The halo can also absorb positive emotions to restore holy light energy. When a believer holds faith in you related to a domain, such as admiration for your fighting skill or love for your cooking, it unlocks more domains and gains more faith.

Domains can also come from your personality, your subordinate’s personality, or from alternate versions of you, like a martial soul. Every domain can amplify not only your talents but also those of your followers if you allow it. After becoming a god, these effects are enhanced. You can directly share your abilities with your followers.

Angel Witches can control fate. By granting yourself a fate, like becoming a master swordsman, you grow stronger toward that goal. You can also assign yourself a false fate, such as being the Daughter of the Sun, multiplying your power up to 12 times depending on the time of day. You can curse others with bad fate, making their powers unreliable or causing extreme misfortune. Powerful Angel Witches can view fate, see alternate futures, and summon other versions of themselves.
 
The halo can be copied. You can give others copies, talk through them, and receive the faith they gather. You have a special version called the Oath Halo, which allows you to share power with one person. All halos include features like auto-responses, reminders, and faith tracking. Every prayer adds to your fate, giving Angel Witches the highest potential in divination among witches.

Possessing core angelic traits lowers the cost of angelic evolutions. Even without evolving, gaining faith unlocks more angelic powers. Due to high Fate sensitivity, you instinctively sense bad outcomes or when something is wrong. Stronger Angel Witches get more detailed insights. Your holy light affinity also revives you unless your holy light is fully depleted.
addons.title: [Angel’s Halo {SSR}]

addons.text:
From your demonic parentage, you inherit Original Sin’s desire. You draw power from negative emotions or even your positive ones. You can absorb curses and despair, growing stronger from them. The more intense your emotions, the more your desire swells, and the stronger you become.

The more emotions you feel, the more you desire, and the stronger you get. Following one of the seven sins or three hatreds (fear, despair, and hatred), you can enter Apostle mode. Every sin multiplies your power by 10. Falling deeper into a sin increases your power further, and it stacks with other sins.

You can form contracts, even verbal ones, without the other person knowing. Once the condition is met, the contracted must obey, whether it’s eternal loyalty or becoming an unaware pawn. Others must follow the contract, but you do not. You can break your contracts without consequence.

Possessing core demonic traits lowers the cost of demonic evolutions. Even without evolving, being closer to your desires unlocks more demonic powers. But if you get too close, it can get out of control.
addons.title: [Original Sin {SSR}]

addons.text:
All living beings have instincts. As long as someone is alive, they can never escape their desires. Primal instincts are the sum of a living being’s survival instincts. They cannot indeed die, no matter how many times they are defeated or suppressed. Human nature is the balance between instincts and rationality.

You can weaponize your primal instinct. By letting it control you, you become stronger. Disregarding reason and acting on instinct, you become crueler and closer to your base desires. This transforms you, adding demonic-like traits to yourself and making you 20 times stronger.

The draconic, bestial, or demonic evolutions you possess have a stronger inner beast. Having those evolutions makes it grow faster, but also harder to control. The more you suppress your inner beast, the stronger it becomes. The harsher the chains of reason, the more fiercely it resists, until it eventually turns you into a wild beast. This is not a demonic trait but an instinct all beings possess, enhanced to the point of resembling a demonic one.
