You can control your Primal instincts by occasionally satisfying their urges. The longer you suppress them, the stronger they become. But by feeding them, you can keep them under control.
addons.title: [Demonic Nature {SR}]

addons.text:
From your parentage, you inherit the core talent of a Nine-Tailed Fox. Although unlike other species, Nine-Tailed Foxes have two core talents. Nine-tailed foxes are known for their beauty and luck. Your beauty, spiritual talents, Inspiration, and illusion abilities are all greatly increased. You're beauty in particular is enhanced to the level that can ignore racial, gender, and other differences.

As a Witch inheriting the blood of an auspicious creature, you are the embodiment of good luck. Lucky things naturally happen to you. Those who are kind to you receive a blessing, and those who are evil will face divine punishment. Being a Nine-Tailed Fox Witch, you are also capable of sensing emotions, feeling the intent of those around you, and reading them.

You possess Dominating Magic Eyes that can charm anyone you see, allowing you to control them. If they cannot be charmed, then you can control them if you possess more magic power than them. These Magic Eyes gives you an alternate sight that allows you to see from the sky. It will show itself a a large pair golden eyes that looks down from Heaven.

Any Demonic, Fate, or Fox-based evolutions you do are far cheaper. And even without evolving, you naturally gain Nine-Tailed Fox traits over time. The time needed to obtain new tails is reduced to 1/5th.
addons.title: [Auspicious Nine-Tails {SSR}] & [Bewitching Nine-Tails {SSR}]

addons.text:
From your parentage, you inherit the core talent of Vampires. Any Vampiric evolutions you do are far cheaper, and by continuing to absorb souls, you can obtain Vampire traits. You can store the dead souls of those you killed and summon them as soul puppets. These soul puppets retain the memories and combat experience in life, and if your magic power is enough, their combat effectiveness will not be inferior to that before they died. In addition, every dead soul you possess can be used to resurrect yourself in exchange for that soul. So long as you have enough souls, you can revive endlessly. 

If you bite someone or drink their blood, you can turn them into blood slaves. Acting as soul puppets, even if you did not kill them, you can control them the same as a soul puppet. Due to the requirements of this Talent, your Constitution and Spirit are S grade. Allowing you to survive even if you are decapitated or your organs are destroyed and to regenerate them quickly.

Inside you is a river of blood containing all the souls you've absorbed. You can release this river externally and control it, or draw blood to you to enlarge this river. Anyone who touches the river of blood will be cursed, forced to be part of it and absorbed. Those who resist suffer damage, as even if they cannot be controlled, their blood can.

As a Vampire Witch, you also are born mastering the Vampire Language. While not as strong as Dragon Language, chanting with the Vampire Language makes your magic stronger. Compared to non-vampire Witches, your vampiric powers are stronger.
addons.title: [River of Dead Words {SSR}]

addons.text:
You've learned the ability to create Incarnations from your spells, traits, multithreaded minds, objects, or supernatural abilities to create additional bodies. You can turn anything into an Incarnation if you have enough understanding of it, and these Incarnations do not have to be Witches. Witches use Incarnations to have a way to do multiple things at the same time and train more than what a single person could achieve in a given timeframe. These Incarnations can have abilities based on the thing they were created from, such as puppet bodies, divinity, alternate timeline versions of yourself, Martial Souls, or more.

Making an Incarnation grants it abilities based on the medium used to create it, and anything they could do or learn, you can do so as well. What they learn, you learn. And while they can operate independently, you will know what they did. This means that if you have an Incarnation that is based on you 20 years from now or an alternate timeline that spent all their time learning something else, if you can make one, you will be able to use the powers and abilities of those Incarnations.

While loyal and a part of you, each Incarnation possesses personalities that impact their decisions. An alternate timeline Incarnation of you would make decisions and operate based on the things they learned from that alternate timeline, and an Incarnation that is a God will have a personality based on their divinity, but ultimately, their personality is some part of you.

You can use any power you possess as the basis for your Incarnations. If you make a giant transforming building, you can turn it into an Incarnation. So long as you have an Incarnation alive, they can revive you. You or your Incarnations can teleport to each other if needed. As far as anything is concerned, it's impossible to tell whether someone is someone else's incarnation.

Incarnations can have their own soul, mind, and body.
addons.title: Incarnation

objects.text: We stripped the feathers off the Lord of Radiance and used them to make pillows. You are a Half-Witch, a hybrid of a martial, magic-wielding species revered for its strength across the multiverse. You possess a 1,000-long lifespan, enduring beauty, physical prowess rivaling other species, and innate magic so potent that even infants can cast high-tier spells. Although your initial Mana Capacity is only 1/30th that of a pureblood Witch, it naturally increases with age and training. With enough hard work, all limits can be surpassed, allowing you to achieve immortality and even exceed the power of Dragons, Angels, Demons, and Gods. Witches are blessed by the World. Under moonlight, they are stronger and feel safer. The Witch’s World protects them, it is as if its very consciousness favors their existence, rendering other worlds unable to directly counter them. Even when facing Evil Gods whose presence corrupts others, Witches sees them as ingredients to be consumed. Over time, your Witch blood strengthens and refines you. If the other half of your lineage proves too weak, it may gradually be overwritten. Although you retain the benefits without any flaws. Over centuries, your Mana Capacity steadily grows until it eventually matches that of a Full-Blooded Witch. Mana Capacity grows rapidly when low and slows as it increases. Witches can also consume living beings to increase their Magic Capacity, the stronger the better. Moreover, a higher Mana Capacity enhances spell efficiency. For example, a Witch with 100 Mana spends 10 to cast a fireball, while one with 1000 Mana casts it for 1 Mana and with 10 times strength. The higher a Witch's Magic capacity is, the stronger they are as a whole. Their mind, body, and soul grow as their mana capacity does, allowing them to resist influence and magic from those weaker than them. Witches can evolve by sacrificing maximum Mana, gaining new traits such as gills, night vision, or characteristics of other species, which they can master beyond the originals. A Dragon Witch, for example, might rule over Dragons easily. These evolutions are inheritable, passing on traits like Precognition, Dragon Scales, or Combat Instincts. With sufficient Magic Capacity, they could evolve these evolutions far beyond just copying the characteristics of other species. Witches possess a unique trait called Inspiration. A powerful form of intuitive understanding that transcends knowledge and logic. It lets a Witch perceive the essence beyond appearances, seeing through disguises, illusions, and hidden truths. With enough Inspiration, they grasp concepts completely unknown, even if presented in unfamiliar languages or governed by alien laws. This ability extends beyond magic to any field of knowledge and more, enabling a Witch to intuitively uncover secrets in others with a mere glance. The more knowledge they learn, the stronger their Inspiration gets. Witches also wield the Belief, which is faith in their ability to channel willpower into magic. While Inspiration provides understanding, Belief imposes one’s reality onto the world. With sufficient Mana, a Witch’s Belief can temporarily override natural laws, bending reality to their intent. Unlike Inspiration, Belief declares and forces the world to comply. It’s a path a Half-Blood Witch cannot use due to insufficient mana, but if they find a way to resolve this issue, they can cast spells by believing it to work instead of knowing. Naturally, it’s far more expensive compared to casting magic with knowledge. When a Witch accomplishes feats, regardless of how minor, they gain Fate. Even something as minor as winning 100 matches in a row in a virtual reality game can add to their destiny. The stronger they are or the grander the feat they accomplish, the stronger they get. They will experience their mana capacity growing faster, mana recovering quicker, magic power increasing, and their luck will improve. The higher their Destiny, the more they can perceive how the rivers of fate will flow. There are two primary paths for Witches: Omniscience and Omnipotence. An Omniscience Witch learns all about the multiverse and uses Inspiration to master its laws, bending reality with Inspiration and knowledge. Conversely, an Omnipotence Witch uses Belief, overwhelming obstacles with raw Mana and willpower until the universe yields. A powerful Witch going on either path bends the environment to suit them just by existing and can destroy worlds with a flick of their hands, and even that is not their end goal of strength. Because for a Witch, the battle crazed species wishes to become God. Not the weak gods they’ve defeated, but the Omnipotent and Omniscient God. You begin with 10,000 Mana, equivalent to a three-year-old pureblood Witch and the minimum for formal education. You possess basic skills in all branches of magic, like divination, necromancy, alchemy, and so on. To other species, this is genius-level, but among Witches, it is only the start. Note that you are not restricted by gender.
objects.title: Half-Witch (Homebody Witch)

addons.text:
Every consumed soul now shares in the eternal qualities of your own soul, providing you with a never-ending supply of energy, forever bound to your relic. Even should you use your abilities nonstop for aeons, you will never run out of souls to fuel your powers.

Any new soul gained still enhances all your physical, spiritual, and mental characteristics, but now they can never degrade no matter how long you maintain your abilities or how much damage to your body you are forced to repair. Additionally, due to your extremely high-quality soul, you no longer have any limit on how many souls you can store.
addons.title: Immortal Engines

objects.text: The Song of Eternity. This sorcery was developed as an easier path to godhood by the Mercurial Snake. Using the Eternity Formula, you form an unbreakable symbiotic connection with a Holy Relic, also known as an Ahnenerbe. It is an object that has gained a will of its own due to the thoughts and feelings people have poured into it throughout history. Some are so strong-willed that they reject all but their chosen master, destroying the soul of anyone else who touches them. Others have a shallow history, making them weaker and more likely to bond with less determined wielders. You may choose any historical or mythological object as your Relic, real or fictional, except for the Longinuslanze Testament. Examples include the crystallised blood of Vlad Tepes III, the diary of Elisabeth Bathory, or the Dora Railway Cannon, although it will not have any special supernatural powers on its own. Alternatively, you may pick any Object of Power or Item that you already have or purchased. The Relic is guaranteed to be an ideal fit for you. Upon bonding with the Relic, you become what is known as an Apostle. You gain the baseline capability to absorb the souls of other living beings, either by killing them or being around when they die. Any damage you deal is inflicted both spiritually and physically, requiring your adversary to be able to defend on both fronts. The added history of the Relic suffuses your attacks with related esoteric properties. For example, a Relic with a bloody history may make wounds much harder to heal. These effects are so potent that you can kill a normal human simply by touching them, and even incorporeal spirits are defenceless against your attacks. Lastly, you also gain a range of supernatural senses, allowing you to feel souls at large distances and even discern their quality. Only the first three stages of Die Ewigkeit are available to you, and they are as follows: Assiah: The first stage, also known as Activation. The Holy Relic has now bonded with your soul. You receive a minor physical boost and a limited array of abilities, which are entirely dependent on your Relic. For example, a guillotine blade Relic granted its user an ability to project invisible blades to cut things at a distance. Yetzirah: The second stage, also known as Formation. Your Holy Relic is fully stable and weaponizable, though its exact form and abilities will differ depending on the Relic itself. Each soul you gathered now suffuses your body with energy, completely halting ageing. This, in turn, elevates your spiritual, magical, mental, and physical capabilities in proportion to your soul count. You also gain all the knowledge and skills of the souls you consumed. By expending their energy, you can regenerate your physical and spiritual bodies—even reforming almost instantly after complete destruction. Soul damage heals within a day at most. Only total eradication of both your soul and Relic can kill you at this stage. Lastly, you can passively form spiritual armour around you that protects you from all phenomena, be it physical, magical, or even something more esoteric like causality manipulation. The more souls you possess, the stronger the armour. With only a thousand souls, you can withstand a nuclear explosion at point-blank range without a scratch. Briah: The third stage, also known as Creation Figment. At this stage, your innermost desire, also referred to as a craving, manifests in the form of a special ability you activate with a chant that is instinctively known to you. There are two distinct types of cravings, and thus two types of Briah: Gudou, also known as Transcendence, which is directed inward and alters the user themselves; and Hadou, also known as Hegemony, which is directed outward and alters the world around the user, although there do exist mixtures of both types. Briah manifests its own law, independent of any preexisting rules and concepts. If it grants the ability to emit poison, then this poison will affect even those immune to any poisons, inorganic beings, and souls themself. If it grants the ability to stop time, it will stop even beings who completely transcend the concept of time. To counter a Briah, you must use another Briah or an ability of similar or greater power—and be at least as strong as the user. You start with the Assiah stage unlocked. To reach Yetzirah stage, you will need to feed your Relic at least 100 souls. Furthermore, to reach Briah, you need to hold at least 10,000 souls. These numbers can be significantly reduced if you acquire higher-quality souls (namely, souls of those who surpass normal humans in capabilities) or possess a sufficiently powerful soul of your own. Once you unlock the stage, you can enter it willingly at any time. While you do not control the exact ability of your Briah, it will naturally be perfectly tailored for you to wield as it is born from your craving, your deepest desire. For all those boons, there are few limitations you must work around. As the Relic is forever intertwined with your soul, should it be destroyed, then you will die as well, unless you can survive the destruction of your own soul. Additionally, each consumed soul strains your mind, body, and soul. Generally speaking, you are currently capable of storing up to 100,000 high-quality souls or 500,000 low-quality ones. Every active use of your abilities—be it regeneration, Relic manifestation, or activation of your Briah—will drain your reserves. Should all your stored souls be consumed, then your physical capabilities will be no different than that of a normal human until you replenish your stock. And should you try to activate Yetzirah or Briah, the Relic will start to consume your own soul as fuel.
objects.title: Die Ewigkeit (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
You have access to the magic from Guild Wars series. You start with basic training in one professions of your choice; from the Guardian, Revenant, or Warrior who are focused on close-range combat, to the versatile Engineer who merges magic and technology, the Ranger and their loyal companion, the stealthy Thief, or the Elementalist, Mesmer, and Necromancer who focus on magical prowess. 

You have above average talent and a natural intuition for general magic theory and the intricacies of your chosen field. As you train your skills and study magic, you can gain access to the core and elite specializations for your profession. Since a lot of skills and spells require a weapon as a focus, you start with two sets of weapons of your choice (either a two-handed weapon like a staff or spear, or a pair of main and off-hand weapons like a pistol and focus or a sword and war horn).

You are not limited to your main profession and are able to branch out into other professions and even multiple specializations. However, your rate of progress in secondary professions will be slower, depending on how different they are from your main profession; for example, a Warrior would be able to easily branch out into a Guardian but an Engineer or Mesmer would be considerably harder.
objects.title: Antikytheria (Guild Wars)

objects.text:
When you cast a spell that expends mana, you can absorb an affinity residue; when you do so, you recover a small amount of mana and add an affinity that matches the spell to your cocktail.

The cocktail can contain up to three affinities, which represent the elemental type of the spell they come from (ex: fire, ice, dark, holy, arcane, etc.). If you collect another affinity when the cocktail is full, the oldest one will be replaced. When the cocktail is full, it can be used to cast the spell that matches the affinities, taken from the spells you are able to cast; the order does not matter, fire-fire-holy or holy-fire-fire are equivalent and would both cast, for example, a purifying fire nova.

You can empty the whole cocktail but not individual affinities.
objects.title: Magic Cocktail (Elden Ring: Nightreign)

objects.text: You possess the unique ability to create Pictos—glyphs carved into surfaces or drawn freehand with careful precision, acting as powerful conduits for magic to give the user specific abilities or effects. While all Pictos give various small boosts to your health, durability, speed and luck in various amounts, they fall into two broad categories, Pictos that generate objects, and Pictos that grant abilities. Object generating Pictos enable you to create particular objects, while weapons and armor are most common, virtually any object can be created with the right Pictos. To create the Pictos, you need to have a clear understanding of the object in question, having an example of the target object present helps. With time, focus and a clear intent to craft the Pictos, your mind will naturally begins to visualize the lines and layout of the glyph that will bring it into existence. Pictos that grant or enhance abilities are more complex, but more versatile, allowing you to perform abilities beyond the standard scope—such as enhancing physical capabilities, manipulating elements, creating shields, or amplifying other powers you possess. While creating such a Pictos can be more challenging, with an example present you can study it and focus your intent similarly to Object Pictos. However, for more esoteric or powerful abilities—with or without a subject present—it often requires hours or even days of dedicated focus to conceptualize and forge the appropriate glyphs. You have access to all of the known Pictos from the game, and may only have three of each kind of Pictos active at once, three that generate Objects, and three that grant or enhance abilities. The final ability of Pictos magic is Lumina, when you have gained enough experience with one of these glyphs, you can activate it as a Lumina. This form of a Pictos loses the boosts to your health, durability, speed and luck, but allows you to retain the ability or object the Pictos affected, and even allow your allies to receive the ability to activate any Lumina you have unlocked. You start with slots for five Lumina and gain one more slot per month.
objects.title: Pictos Lumina (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33)

objects.text:
Due to a magical curse, you have gained the ability of Bio-Fission, the power to create and absorb clones of yourself at will. These clones are perfect physical and mental copies of you, all connected through a unified hive mind. There is no hierarchy among the clones, each one shares equal awareness and operates in perfect coordination, no matter the distance—even across different worlds or dimensions. When creating a clone, you can replicate only the normal version of the outfit you are wearing, and nothing else.

Your clones can use all of your powers but only one power at a time, through with time and training even this can be overcome. If you have any supernatural energy, all your clones share it but you can decide which clone uses which energy, and how much can be used by which clones. The power limit doesn't include physical or biological abilities, skills, mental intelligence, perks or supernatural knowledge.

When a clone is injured or dies, any trauma or damage it suffers is not shared with the other clones. This also means that mental or more esoteric effects—such as soul-based attacks—affect only that specific clone.

At first, you can create up to five clones. However, with time and practice, you can expand this number indefinitely. Your clones are permanent fixtures in reality once created, they persist until you absorb them back into yourself or die.

As long as at least one clone survives, you can remain alive. For this reason, it’s wise to hide at least one in a secure location.
objects.title: Dupli-Kate (Invincible)

addons.text:
Through the Water God, Sword God, and North God styles, you have gained access to the arts of Battle Will, whose techniques resemble magic by using the aura of your own body.

Just like your Battle Aura, you will have an Intermediate-level proficiency in Battle Will. The most basic uses you can perform are reinforcing your body and the weapon you hold, directly proportional to the amount of aura you infuse. You can also generate an octagonal shield or an aura dome, whose size, durability, and manifestation time depend directly on your skill.

With greater mastery, you would be able to fly through the skies using nothing but your own aura. You could perform ranged attacks by creating aura constructs in the form of projectiles. You could forcibly infuse your aura into an enemy, whether to paralyze them, hinder accelerated regeneration abilities, or simply cause internal damage.

The limits of what you can accomplish with Battle Will depend on your skill, as well as the quantity, quality, and level of control of your aura.
addons.title: Battle Will

addons.text:
Your magical prowess has reached extraordinary levels as a result of a mutation between magicules (Tensura), prana (Type-Moon), and mana (Mushoku Tensei).

Your Fairy Pattern has elevated your newly magicule-assimilated body into a peculiar evolution. You are now a Demonoid subspecies of the Majin, a tribe that still retains human origins. You also inherit their weakness to Holy Magic and anything of similar nature, but this can be resolved simply by developing a resistance or a magical countermeasure.

Your evolution grants Elemental Magic by default, regardless of your original Mage selection. However, if you had previously chosen it, then it becomes enhanced to a level equivalent to an Intrinsic Skill, in terms of power and efficiency, passively.

Your Divine Words have become the ultimate tool not to maintain the mental image and knowledge of real-world phenomena. Instead, they now legitimately boost your spells to the level of an Extra Skill when used actively.

Along with this, the Laplace Factor alters your vital condition as a Demonoid, whose power and lifespan increase according to the amount of magicules absorbed and controlled. In your case it's similar: every time you surpass your own limits, you become stronger and more long-lived than before.

The combination of Primordial Rune and Runic Magic has enabled a level of efficiency and versatility akin to a programming language, and its impact on reality is equivalent to the language used by the Voice of the World. You may perhaps acquire a connection to it artificially or through force.
addons.title: Extraordinary Mage

objects.text:
Your body has been exposed and assimilated to magicules. The fundamental particle that grants property and makes magic itself possible. You are officially a Mage capable of perceiving and manipulating magicules both from the environment and from your own reserves of magical power.

To cast a spell you use imagination or mental image, the knowledge of cause and effect of the phenomena present in your environment, the use of Casting (chants and/or hand gestures), and finally pouring magicules into the spell to conjure the magic that performs the desired effect. If you possess scientific and mathematical knowledge then you will have a certain level of ease to manifest magic without the need for Casting or some magical tool like wands, but you are still limited by your skill in manipulating magicules.

The power and rank of a Mage are determined by their level of control, the quantity and quality of their magicules, as well as the number of different magical disciplines they have mastered. The ranks are: Novice, Magician, Wizard, Royal Mage, Archmage, and Sage. For reference, Shizu would be considered a powerhouse equivalent to a Royal Mage. You begin as a Magician with three primary types of magic already mastered of your choice, which are:

Aspectual Magic: Functions by controlling either ambient magicules or the user's own reserves to bend the laws of nature, using imagination and visualization so long as the caster understands the underlying process. The created phenomenon is unaffected by physical factors. For example, magical flames cannot be extinguished by ordinary water, though they can be affected by water with magical properties.

Elemental Magic: Functions by borrowing magical power from the Elemental races in order to perform magic. You only need to use ambient magicules or your own reserves to meet the magical demand generated by the spell. As such, you have contracted an Elemental entity that is loyal to you and responds to your desires in the manner it generates the magic. The elements may include Earth, Water, Fire, Wind, Light, Darkness, Holy, Time, and Space. With time and training, you can contract additional Elementals.

Summoning Magic: With a certain degree of mastery over spatial manipulation, you are capable of summoning entities from other planes, binding objects and entities for future summoning, and even achieving teleportation itself. What you can accomplish depends heavily on your understanding of Space and your level of mastery. At a basic level, you are only capable of performing a familiar summoning, which can be done with any entity with which you have formed a bond.

Illusion Magic: Functions by using magicules themselves to directly interfere with the souls and spiritual bodies of others and yourself. At a basic level, you are only capable of creating illusions and confusing the senses. At more advanced levels of mastery, despite the name of the magic, it becomes a degree of control equivalent to soul manipulation.

Physical Magic: Uses scientific principles and mathematical formulas to turn theories and interpretations into reality. It is a form of magic that produces purely physical effects and lacks any magical foundation beyond its manifestation. This magic is susceptible to physical factors. For example, the fire you create can be extinguished by ordinary water.

Holy Magic: Functions by controlling Holy Power, which is born either from directly manipulating Spiritrons (the fundamental particles that compose spiritual bodies and souls) or by converting your thoughts and feelings as a believer in a “God” or the concept of miracles into Faith. Regardless of which energy source you use, both function in the same way. At a basic level, you can purify, heal, and create barriers that protect against corruption. At more advanced levels of mastery, you can perform feats such as Disintegration, Resurrection, and much more. You possess the knowledge required to perform prayers and rituals ranging from basic rites to true miracles.

Finally, you have Rune Magic and Golem Master as a secondary specialization where you will be able to apply your spells in the form of runes that will then be engraved into the artifact or person to generate some desired effect, as well as create autonomous artificial entities from some material or simply create complex automatons. 

With time and training your control, amount and quality of magicules will grow. Also, keep in mind that this is not a Skill that helps you automate or enhance magic. Because you’re not connected to the Voice of the World, therefore it entirely depends on you to achieve great feats in the mastery of magic.

And the more complex and powerful the spell you are trying to conjure, the more difficult it becomes to master and even meet the magicule demand. For example, trying to generate negentropy without knowledge of how it works or a mathematical formula that explains it is out of your reach.
objects.title: Mage (Tensura)

objects.text:
Structured magic is the process of manipulating or 'shaping' mana to achieve a desired result through spell elements bound to proxies. Mana comes in two forms. Mana that is created by living beings, their own personal 'well'. Ambient mana that spews forth from the Dungeon, otherwise known as Mana Wells. Use of ambient mana can be poisonous to the body and mind if used more quickly than it can be assimilated by the body. You possess a high personal magnitude on par with Zach Noveda, which means you possess a high amount of inner magical reserves. You have a decent level of control over your personal mana and are skilled in taking in any ambient mana to replenish your own reserves. Additionally, you know basic shaping exercises to improve your control over your personal mana.

You know Structured Magic, which uses Spell Elements and Mana to cast spells, and you are highly skilled with Projection Magic specifically. This field focuses on spells that produce light, sound, heat, physical force, electricity, and other forms of energy. A staple of the modern mage due to its extreme utility, ease of use, and how it is required for many other magical disciplines.

Spell Elements are instructions to your soul on what you want and how you want to achieve it. By stringing spell elements, you have the ability to cast spells and achieve magical effects. Since Spell Elements are not naturally usable by humans, they have been magically bound to proxies. Proxies are components used to invoke Spell Elements, typically verbal or somatic, though diagrams and symbols also apply. Typically, mages use both somatic and verbal components to speed up casting speed by letting them use 2 proxies at once. Currently, you know the Old Ikosian magical conventions. Due to their interaction with your soul, you will instantly know if you perform a proxy correctly. You also know how to bind Spell Components to another proxy, though fully translating them to a new source would take centuries of hard work.

While significantly faster to learn than Unstructured Magic, Structured Magic still takes practice and shaping to successfully cast, even if you know the proxies perfectly, because your soul may try to follow the commands but be unsuccessful due to low shaping skill, not enough magical energy, or weak visualization. There are 2 main downsides to using structured magic: it's currently impossible for mortals to create more, and it grants less control over the spell after casting. This is enough to undo a spell or to move it with enough shaping skill, but not to change its properties after casting it.  After casting a spell for years, it can become more of a reflex, allowing you to cast it faster and shave off proxies. With time and effort, you can turn these reflexes into partial Unstructured Magic, granting you more control over the spell and its effects.
objects.title: Structured Magic (Mother Of Learning)

objects.text: With this you are now a fairy, a magical being commanding the power of nature, and most commonly found in the Otherworld. Perhaps you were born there? Perhaps you are a Changeling, a fairy swapped for a mortal child at birth? Regardless, the powers of your magical form have begun to awaken, though for the most part there is little difference between a mortal and a fairy, other than the magic within you. Fairies are born with the ability to manipulate one of the elements of nature, and your eyes will glow the colour of your natural elemental affinity when you use your magic, though this will evolve to silver if you master other elements. You can freely select which element your fairy magic is naturally attuned to, and will be able to learn it quickly. You can learn to use the other elements once you have mastered your original element, though learning them will not be as quick. A fairy with power over Air can control the various properties of the element, speed, temperature, power, even sound and electricity. The eyes of a fairy using Air magic glow Dark blue. While a fairy with the power over Earth can control sand, soil, rock, and all manner of plant life. When the power is being used the eyes of the user glow Green. Fairies with power over Fire control flame, heat and to an extent light. Able to create flames out of nothing, and control pre-existing flames and their effects. When a fairy uses Fire magic their eyes glow orange. A fairy with power over Light has control over light, illusion, and energy. Able generate light, control what others see, and cast their appearance far and wide akin to astral projection. The eyes of Light Fairies glow yellow when using this magic. Fairies with power over the Mind have the ability to access and control emotion, thought and dream. When the power is used, the eyes of the fairy turn magenta. And fairies with power over Water can control water, drawing it from the air, the lakes, seas and other bodies of water. It can be used to create ice, a skilled fairy can even control the water within the bodies. When used the eyes of the fairy turn icy blue. Finally, you have what was once thought lost. The Transformation Magic a power drawing upon the balance between positive and negative emotions, that allows the fairy in question to generate wings formed out of their element, and access much greater power.
objects.title: Fairy (Fate: The Winx Saga)

objects.text:
Archons are individuals who wield immense arcane power. No one knows how the Archons gain their arcane strength. Some Archons are born into power and privilege. Others were beggars in the street before their powers manifested.

The true measure of an Archon is not some sort of birthright, but their life and achievements: An Archon becomes one through belief. As the future Archon grows confident in their power and more importantly, the people who surround them start to believe in their power, it increases organically.

While all Archons possess magical powers, there is no other common thread between these women and men. An Archon might be made of fire, capable of conjuring storms, or able to heal with a touch - the only defining trait of an Archon is that this magic power originates from within. It is unclear how Archons come into their powers, but it is generally understood that most grow into or develop magical power throughout their lives, with only a few notable exceptions (such as Sirin, Archon of Song) having shown powers seemingly from birth.

You are an Archon at roughly the same level of power as the Voices of Nerat or Graven Ashe, with a focus of similar breadth and depth to them.
objects.title: Archon (Tyranny)

objects.text:
You underwent the dangerous (and painful) process of mana baptism, which formed a mage core next to your heart, and a mana gem in your brain. As a side benefit, you also gain access to the System, as using magic without its assistance is almost always very fatal. You start out with one tier-0 magic class of your choosing (such as [Student of Kinetic Magic] or [Student of Organic Magic]) at level 1, as well as one magic seed, which must match your class, one magic tendril, and above average mental attributes (~100 in Intelligence, Willpower). Your Magic attribute starts at 1.

Each magic seed generates mana of a specific type (kinetic mana for a kinetic seed). The maximum capacity and rate at which mana is generated are dependent on your attributes. Magic quantities are measured in Mariums, where one Marium is equivalent to one unit of mana granted by one point in the Magic attribute inside a seed with a 100% conversion ratio. This ratio, as well as the number of maximum magic seeds and  tendrils you can have, can be influenced by perks and achievements; the number of magic tendrils can also be increased, permanently or temporarily, in this way as well. As you use magic, your Magic attribute will grow, quickly up to 25, then the rate slows down every 25 points.

The four basic types of magic seeds are: kinetic, thermal, electromagnetic, and organic; it is also possible to form seeds of other types, such as pure mana, often used for enchanting, or even dimensional mana, which can open portals. The latter, and many other more abstract mana types, generate broken mana, which is not only highly lethal to living beings and corrosive to the environments, but also self-propagates unless cleaned up; you'll have to figure that last part out yourself.

As your mage core, and the magic seeds housed inside, are physical parts of your body, damage complete removal of the organ will affect your ability to use magic; the same goes for the mana gem inside of your brain.

Access to the System allows you to view your status, which includes your attributes (strength, dexterity, endurance, charisma, perception, intelligence, willpower, and magic), primary and secondary classes, perks, skills, magic seeds, and achievements. You can have up to 5 primary classes, which gain perks every 5 levels, and an unlimited number of secondary classes, but the latter have a hefty penalty to their levelling speed (around 80% slower) and only gain perks every 10 levels. To gain a class, you need to perform activities related to that class, such as fishing for [Fisherman], or be married for [Husband] and [Wife]; when the threshold is met, the system will prompt you to gain that class.

Perks provide passive or active benefits related to the class, such as more magic tendrils or bullet time when in danger, while achievements are gained from your notable deeds, which can range from common, like {Murderer (Rarity I)} gained when killing another human being, to vanishingly rare, like {Outworlder (Rarity 10)}. Once a class reaches level 75, you can combined two perks together to form a new, usually more powerful, perk instead of picking a new one.

At level 25, a tier-0 class can evolve into a tier-1 class, which resets it to level 1, and at level 100, it can evolve again into a tier-2 class, and ascent to become an Immortal. However, very few reach this point, due to the steep decrease in levelling speed past 75; if you want to reach immortality, you will need to stack perks and achievements that boost your growth far past the normal speed, and also stay alive long enough. Thankfully, past level 75, your aging slows down dramatically, and stops completely at level 100. Of note, an Immortal is not actually immortal, just incredibly hard to kill due to their ability to fully regenerate their body once a week, and their very large bag of tricks; their only weakness is the destruction of the brain, which leads to permanent death.

Your System is a local instance and, if you can peek behind the curtain and have the necessary knowledge and tools, you can alter how it works, provided you can reach the mainframe. Careful not to break anything important while you do, or things might get wonky, or you might destabilize reality, or create a thermonuclear explosion; maybe you should look for the notes from the creator first, and test things out on a part that nobody cares about, like the one that manages the [Exotic Dancer] class, and not the power core or main linkage.
objects.title: Mage Core (Budding Scientist in a Fantasy World)

addons.text: You gain the unique achievement [By Gandalf's Grey Beard! (Rarity X)] which grants you the following: an additional primary class slot, with the [Dungeon Mage] class at level 1; access to magic skills, the ability to raise them to a new tier or fuse them together once at maximum level; the [Will] attribute, which increases the strength of your magic, with 50% while below 100; +50 to your Magic attribute; and the ability to create up to three special magic seeds with a 120% conversion ratio, five magic seeds with a 60% ratio, and an unlimited amount with a 30% conversion ratio, for [Dungeon Mage] elements you know the construct for.
addons.title: Mana Glands

objects.text: You gain the ability to shape mana, which allows you to create elemental constructs that convert raw magical energy into mana attuned to a specific element — such as fire, ice, or mind — and then shape this mana into spells. You have basic knowledge of the the elemental constructs and first tier spell forms for the four basic elements: fire, air, water, earth. As your mastery over these elements improves, you will gain insight into both higher tier spells forms, allowing you to create stronger and more versatile spells, and the pattern for higher order elements, from ice and lightning to healing, barriers, and mind magic. You might even unlock the secrets of the fabled gravity magic. Mind magic is particularly useful as it allows you to create mind constructs which can be leveraged to improve your spellcasting prowess, as the virtual brains allow you to focus on more than one spell or construct at once. Since you might not have access to the monster cores and mana-infused materials necessary to build a proper focus, you gain an internal mana pool which can be used to fuel your spells. This mana pool improves over time as you refine your magical skill. Your mana can also be crystallized into tier one cores, which can then be fused into higher tiers, and infused into mundane materials, from simple mana-infused wood to legendary materials like gravity compressed diamond or ascendent slime, provided you have the skills and knowledge to do so.
objects.title: Mana Constructs (Chrysalis)

objects.text:
You can wield Source, the energy from which magic is born. Naturally this makes you a mage able to pull phenomena into being, but more so it lets you pull Source from the void and imbue it into not only your magic, but any of your other abilities and skills to enhance them dramatically. 

While imbuing a jet of water can result in scalding blasts of steam, or turning fireballs into great meteor showers, you could imbue your skills in warfare to produce an onslaught of blows, or opening planar gateways from a simple summoning spell.

Unfortunately, Source is a resource. In order to restore it you either need to find the rare spills from the void entering the world to drink, or use skills like Source Vampirism, utterly consuming spirits and souls in order to add to your stockpile.
objects.title: Sourcerer (Divinity)

addons.text:
So, do you remember where it said only one arm could have this power? Now all of your arms possess this power, with many of its limitations removed. Your arms can now absorb any forms of energy, taking it into yourself without limit.

The draining process is optimized for magic, so draining other forms of energy will take longer, and the density of the energy source will also impact the process.

Your arms are now also capable of draining from you, drawing energy from one pool and converting it into any other form of energy you possess. Drain your magic to replenish your chakra, or your ki to refill your reiryoku.
addons.title: Devouring Arms

objects.text:
It seems you possess the same power as Atsuma, though lacking the evil presence and the inability to control it. One of your arms—that of your choosing—will be ‘enchanted’ with great power.

Whichever arm you choose gains the ability of ‘absorption,’ allowing it to drain magical power from everything it touches to rejuvenate the user. This could involve an incoming attack, an enemy mage, a magical item, or even a magical barrier in your way. You retain the ability to control what your arm is draining, so you won’t destroy a one-of-a-kind magical item just by picking it up—unless that’s your intent.

This ability doesn’t confer any protections from the magic you are trying to absorb, and you may absorb too much power for your body to handle.
objects.title: Hungering Arm (Enchanted Arms)

addons.text: Your ability to freely change your gender expression expands to include your usage of the One Power. Now you can freely switch between usage of Saidar and Saidin. Be aware though that the skills are not directly transferable. Some effect you produce with Saidin will need to be weaved completely differently with Saidar, and vice versa.
addons.title: Fluid Power

addons.text:
The greatest achievements with the One Power were never done by a single channeler, but instead through linked groups of them. 

You may now grant anyone in your network the temporary ability to channel, though only for direct use in a circle. When granted this ability members of your network are allowed a one time choice between Saidin and Saidar, with their potential determined randomly, and elemental affinity by their personality.

When channeling in a circle certain ratios must always be kept. Always more Saidar than Saidin, and for every thirteen of Saidar there must be at one more Saidin. There is a hard maximum of 72 members, though there are some tasks where smaller numbers may be more effective. 

When channeling in a circle, the leader gains the elemental affinity, and a portion of the strength of its members. The far more important thing though, is that each member of the circle may aid in the weave, adding all of their skill to the task. These attributes can together allow for world shaping effects at its peak.
addons.title: Circle Maker

addons.text:
You now gain the knowledge and skill necessary to create the various Angreal, Sa’angreal, and Ter’angreal from the age of legends. 

Angreal and Sa’angreal allow someone to channel much more of the one power than previously, with Sa’angreal being much stronger, and much more difficult to make.

Ter’angreal are specialized tools with a variety of uses, but many can often be summed up as a preexisting weave that any channeler can activate by feeding a small amount of the One Power into it.
addons.title: Relics of the Age of Legends

objects.text:
You can now Channel the One Power, the force that drives the Wheel of Time in its weaving of existence. Your potential is comparable to that of the strongest Aes Sadai during the third age.

Ordinarily one has to be careful when channeling, as not only is the sensation of channeling considered addictive, but also there normally would be the risk of burning out and becoming unable to channel. Fortunately in your case, such a circumstance will be only temporary, and your ability to channel will slowly return.

The power is split between feminine Saidar and masculine Saidin. There are certain differences in their usage, though generally they can achieve the same effects. Saidar is channeled through opening up and letting it in. Saidin is channeled through a fight for control against a raging force. You may choose which one you can channel when you select this power. If you select Saidar you have more fine control, and for Saidin you have more direct strength.

Because of its nature as the source of existence there is very little that the One Power cannot be used for. Weather alternation, long distance teleportation, and existence erasure are some of the higher end examples. The only things the One Power can’t be used for is affecting yourself, and raising the dead.

The way these are achieved is through weaving together flows of the five elements. Fire governs heat and light. Earth governs solid, non-living material. Water governs liquids, and to a partial extent living bodies. Air governs gases and movement. Lastly Spirit is for anything that involves metaphysical or intangible. Saidar is often stronger with Water and air, Saidin is stronger with Fire and Earth, and Spirit is shared equally between the two. You may divide your affinity for the elements how you wish, anywhere between a completely even split, to being a once in a millennium savant with just one.
objects.title: The One Power (The Wheel of Time)

objects.text:
Wordchains are an ancient magic built on equal and opposite exchange. By speaking certain phrases and making specific hand movements, a person can cast a wordchain without using any magical resource. Casting one half of a wordchain creates a “debt” that must eventually be paid by casting the other half later. Most wordchains have a “good half” and a “bad half.”

Examples include Peace of Mind, which grants calmness and dulls your awareness of fear for a time. In exchange, when the debt comes due, it forces a heightened focus on your fears. If a debt is left unpaid for too long, the wordchain can “snap back,” triggering the other half at a random time.

Any wordchain can be cast as long as you have the vocal and manual dexterity to perform it, which means anyone can learn them if you properly teach the right phrases and movements. But to cast one successfully, it must be performed perfectly. Even a slight mistake or stumble in the chant can ruin the wordchain.

You are gifted with knowledge of a few dozen wordchains with a wide range of minor but versatile effects, including but not limited to strength boosts, healing, and mental enhancements. You are a talented beginner at wordchains. With time and practice, you will be able to discover more powerful wordchains, such as the Gloss, which can imbue luck, or even invent new ones of your own. Eventually, you could learn to bestow wordchain effects on others, store wordchains for later, and enhance the gains you receive from wordchains.
objects.title: Wordchains (Super Supportive)

objects.text:
As a child, you’ve always been fascinated by the flames. They danced and leaped with as much vigor as you played, despite their short life.

Now you’ve dedicated yourself to the art of Pyromancy and achieved some mastery over fire.

You have managed to shape your flames into a few basic forms, like a Searing Bolt or an explosive Fireball, though you know there are still greater forms out there.

You’ve even deciphered the scorched notes of a Shade consumed by the flames, and created a Living Flame of your own, it is even able to replicate your spells without draining your magic. Though for now it is weak, only able to travel a few feet away from you before it dissipates and has to reform.

Perhaps you may find a way to strengthen both it and your magic in time?
objects.title: Pyromancer (Arcanum: Theory of Magic)

objects.text: Gloam refers to a sort of primordial darkness that can be wielded by select practitioners. It requires 'occluding', a dangerous process that involves infusing different organs with gloam. This process can kill people if done without care, and will eventually turn someone into a 'Hollow' or kill them. Hollows are believed to be without souls. The gloam can be banished by the light of the sun, or any light infused by it. This is not absolute, but it does weaken it greatly. Gloam can be wielded through the usage of 'signs' as well as other arts that can achieve various effects. Signs were an alphabet created to standardize the use of gloam, but there are as many different ways of wielding gloam as there are cultures in Vesper. Basic effects include blasts of physical darkness to impale people and other physical projections but it can be expanded to more advanced manipulation of the soul as well as creation of minions and more. The backlash of having your abilities counteracted harshly can be severe and cause damage to your soul.
objects.title: Gloam Sorcery (Pale Lights)

objects.text:
Sacred Seals are believed to be the wisdom of the divine bestowed upon mankind to fight off the corrupted blight. It is a runic script, that is powered by sunlight and triggered using a person's lifeforce.
 
With these you can create seals that hold back corruption, create magi-tech and empower people to create exploding projectiles or make jumping seem like flying. 

However, Sacred Seals require maintenance unless you want them to fail at an inopportune moment. 

Additionally, to inscribe sacred seals upon a person requires combability with said sacred seal; Most people can only be compatible with one or two sacred seals. Whilst sacred seals inscribed upon a object can be fuelled by sunlight, the seals written on a person must be powered by their own life force.

You start with the same amount of talent as Norgalle Senridge with sacred seals.
objects.title: Sacred Seals (Sentenced to be a Hero)

objects.text:
You are now one of the Powder Mages, which grants you an unusual magical affinity for gunpowder. 

The primary use of this affinity is the ability to sense and ignite gunpowder from a distance, approximately a city block in area. Ignited, even if by natural means rather than your magic, you can shape and redirect the blast. With a little bit of practice you can even use this ability to guide bullets, adjusting their trajectory. 

The other main ability you have is the Powder Trance, whereby ingesting gunpowder (nasally is generally quickest), a powder mage gains enhanced strength, speed, healing, and senses. Be warned that some find the experience addictive, and overuse can lead to negative side effects.
objects.title: Powder Mage (Powder Mage)

objects.text:
You have learned the transcendental defensive spell: Dispel Bound. When deployed, it covers the caster in billions upon billions of invisible protective shields that defend the caster from nearly all phenomena. These phenomena include supernatural senses, magic itself, supernatural abilities, physical harm, reality manipulation and alteration, fate manipulation, possession, mind reading and control, power negation, immortality negation, instant victory, conceptual attacks, and almost everything else you can imagine, even niche and trivial things like insects, viruses, radar detection, or sonic waves.

Similarly, the Dispel Bound also cancels nearly all protective measures of any target you attack—either physically or via magic—negating their immortality, regeneration, magic and mental defences, etc., allowing you to bypass anything that Dispel Bound protects you from.

Each shield is duplicated an innumerable amount of times and regenerates near instantly, making it almost impossible to penetrate or circumvent, as one would need to individually break each of the nigh-infinite amount of layers of defence. By encountering and analysing new phenomena, you can incorporate them into the Dispel Bound, allowing you to expand the scope of your protections as needed.

The spell requires an immense amount of mana to manifest and maintain under attack. With this power alone, you possess a small pool of mana, enough to maintain the shield for a few minutes under continuous assault, although with training, you will eventually be able to hold the spell indefinitely.
objects.title: Dispel Bound (Bastard!)

addons.text:
You harness the dark arts of the Nightmare Empire of Cryx and become a master of Necrotech. You can create necromechanical thralls from corpses, some simple runes, and spare parts easily in the field. You can perform rituals to create mechanikal wraiths that can do things like possess machinery or harvest the souls of the fallen for you.

You can create soul cages, which automatically trap the soul of any mortal being slain near you, which can be used to fill your magical reserves or fuel or boost an ability or spell. Your thralls and jacks can also be equipped with soul cages and use them in the same way. You can use the echoes of death and suffering to refine coal or other fuels into Necrotite, which burns a ghostly green and is much more potent and energy efficient than normal fuels, as well as being toxic to the living.

You can use the remains and souls of terrible monsters in the construction of your warjacks to create bonejacks and helljacks, which, while slightly frailer than most warjacks, are faster and armed with gruesome weapons and cruel demeanors. Lastly, you can construct Necromanufactorums, hidden underground factories where necromancy is performed on an industrial scale. Large amounts of corpses and materials can be processed into masses of thralls and bloodthirsty bonejacks and helljacks.

Optionally, you may become undead if you are not already, and replace any portion or even the entirety of your body with a necromechanikal Iron Lich body. This body has integrated Warcaster armor, soul cages, internal or external phylactery, and implements for creating necrotech and performing necromantic rituals.
addons.title: Iron Lich

objects.text:
You become a potent battlemage commander called a Warcaster, allowing you to cast battlefield-altering spells at long ranges while commanding troops and machines. You gain a small array of battlefield support spells that buff your forces and harry enemies based on your favored tactics and combat styles. You project a control range around yourself where it becomes easier to target spells and order your forces. Your control range covers a good chunk of a battlefield. You also have a preternatural sense of nearby magical energies and advanced technologies.

You gain a suit of Warcaster armor, which has a backpack-mounted miniature turbine that harnesses your own magical energies to generate a forcefield around you and boost your abilities. This armor can be anything from a form-fitting light chestplate, power-assisted fullplate, or even a small mech. You can also upgrade any weapons or equipment, including artifacts and Objects of Power, to use the arcane energy harnessed by your armor. You can train other mages into Warcasters and build gear specialized for their abilities.

You also gain a Feat of your own design, a decisive battle stratagem backed by your own will and magical abilities. This can be a powerful attack, but it can also be a powerful ability that buffs not only you, but the forces under your command, or creates dangers and complications for an enemy army. This can include manipulating time to slow the maneuvers of enemy forces, making your warjacks invincible as they plow through enemy lines, inspiring divine fury in your troops that wreathes their weapons in holy fire or any other powerful strategic ability. Your Feat can only be used once per week, and its effects only last for around 10-15 minutes.

Secondly, you can also build warjacks, large steam-powered robots driven by a runic computer called a cortex that gives them a simple intelligence and the ability to follow verbal commands. When attuned to the magic of a Warcaster, jacks gain increased intelligence and can be commanded telepathically. As a Warcaster, you can transfer portions of your magical reserves to your warjacks, which they can use to boost their systems, execute complex tactics and activate inbuilt functions. Warjacks that stay attuned to a Warcaster for a particularly long time are known to develop imprints that give them increased intelligence and personality quirks. You will bond much quicker with the jacks you command. Lastly, you will be able to replace the CPU of any mech or large droid you own with a cortex, allowing them to function as warjacks.

You also gain the knowledge of Mechanika, the arcane steampunk technology from the Iron Kingdoms/Warmachine/Hordes setting, as well as spin-offs like Gobbers, Grind, and Riot Quest. You can create any of the arcane machines shown, mentioned, or implied to exist in the setting. This includes magelock firearms and rune bullets, Nemo’s voltaic storm chambers, Man-o-War armor, the alchemical experimentation of the Order of the Golden Crucible, the advanced arcantrik technology of the Iosan elves, the necrotech thralls of Cryx, the mad surgeries of the Cephalyx, and the ley clockworks of the Convergence of Cyriss.
objects.title: Warcaster (Iron Kingdoms)

addons.title: Play Like You Got A Pair (Iron Kingdoms)
addons.text:
In addition to being both a Warcaster and a Warlock, you learn many of the different stranger practices of the spinoff factions of Warmachine/Hordes. You can psychically dominate biomechanical Monstrosities like a Cephalyx Controller, or summon eldritch Horrors as an Infernal Master.


You also gain all the various traditions of magic in the Iron Kingdoms setting, various practices of wizardry and sorcery, prayers to holy and unholy faiths, Dhunian shamanism, Blackclad druidry, Skorne mortitheurgy and others can be practiced by you.

objects.text:
You are a Harnesser, also known as a Warlock, capable of taming ferocious monsters and bending them to your will. Taming Warbeasts requires a magical battle of wills that is more difficult but also more rewarding the stronger and more terrible the beast is. You gain a telepathic link to your creatures and can command them using your own mystical abilities. Creatures you tame are now capable of rapidly growing into large and ferocious Warbeasts that can form the centerpiece of armies and tear enemy troops and armored war machines to shreds. You also gain the endurance of a beast that lets you survive wounds that would kill a dozen lesser men over.

You gain a small array of battlefield support spells that buff your forces and harry enemies based on your favored tactics and combat styles. You project a control range around yourself where it becomes easier to target spells and order your forces. Your control range covers a good chunk of a battlefield. By riling up your Warbeasts as you command them, you can leach on their fury to empower yourself and your magical energy. However, if you fail to manage the fury of your beasts, then there is a chance they may lash out inp rage that you cannot control until they calm down.

You will also find that each Warbeast you command has a unique hidden ability in its soul (or otherwise being if it does not possess a soul) called an Animus that grants it certain temporary preternatural instincts. Examples of Animi include entering a primal rage, blowing back or holding down enemies, focusing a paralyzing gaze on an enemy, or growing wicked spines. A Warbeast can be commanded to use its Animus in battle, but you are also capable of casting the Animus as a spell to gain those temporary capabilities.

You also gain a Feat of your own design, a decisive battle stratagem backed by your own will and magical abilities. This can be a powerful attack, but it can also be a powerful ability that buffs not only you, but the forces under your command, or creates dangers and complications for an enemy army. Your Feat can be something like allowing allies to strike with unstoppable momentum and courage, upheaving the surrounding terrain, or unleashing torment that prevents enemies from using their own abilities. Your Feat can only be used once per week, and its effects only last for around 10-15 minutes.

Additionally, you will find it particularly easy to harness and bond with beasts that are connected to the origin of your abilities in some way. This could mean commanding the squamous lesser servants of your eldritch patrons, evolutionary relatives of the race that taught you ancestral shamanism, whimsical animals that inhabit the wilds where the fae reside, or bio-horrors bred by your own alchemical expertise, etc. Even something as mundane as using the philosophies and methods behind your martial arts to train and condition a beast could help you form a connection.
objects.title: Warlock (Iron Kingdoms)

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl, when you transform you fully heal your body to peak condition, gain a mildly enhanced body to the point where you can throw someone across a small room, mildly enhanced speed, mildly enhanced reaction, and can fly. Your appearance is improved and maintained with magic, additionally you can’t gain unnecessary weight as excess consumption is converted into magic. You gain a cute outfit when you transform. Your magic specializes in household cleaning and other conveniences. This includes instant cleaning, clothes changing, and purification.

In your base form, you have a fraction of the abilities you have while transformed. You can detect even minute poison and sense geographic locations. You can also sense vaguely on specific types of items you are seeking, such as clean water or mountain veins. Your ability to sense anything starts at a thousand meters and increases with your magic. This includes through the ground, buildings, and other materials. And using magic, you can guide and command animals.

You possess abilities like Cognitive Interference, you are unable to be recognized from your base self. Cognitive Interference also works on Artificial Intelligence and technology, it can even delete all records of you. You can control the basic elements like create fire, water, earth, ice, wind and so on. You can also construct spatial gates to connect two locations in space, but it costs more magic compared to other spells. The last spell you have is Starlight Burst, a long range beam that can blow up buildings. These abilities can be manipulated, such as bending space around your fist to prevent contact with biohazards or using cleaning magic to break all hidden objects with a wave of your hand. 

You have an understanding of the internet and how it operates, allowing you to easily ragebait antis and create prolific internet memes. You’re a Multi-Talented Number One Beautiful Idol Magical Girl who can use any skill in the entertainment industry. You’re also knowledgeable about survival, acrobatics, butchering, and any mundane skill. You’re also capable of playing any form of musical instrument with specialty towards any kind of Zither. This includes the Fuxi style, Luoxia style, Shennong style, Haozhong style, Shenhui style, Xuanhe style, Zhenghe style, Liezi style, Jiaoye style, Lingji style, Liangluan style, Zhongni style, Lianzhu style, and Fengsu style Guqin. You’re so good at it, you can play multiple different instruments at the same time simultaneously.

The maximum length of your transformation is dictated by your internal magic, using magic consumes it faster. Starting out, you can create about 2 spatial gates before running out. Consuming all your magic and letting it restore doubles your magic. It takes approximately an entire day of rest to restore your magic, but things like food can hasten this. The more magic you possess the stronger your abilities get overall.
objects.title: Magical Troll (Magical Girl Attacks Through The Internet Cable)

objects.text:
You possess the ability to resonate with the Heart Seed within you and transform into a Magical Girl. While transformed, your base and transformed bodies are not fully synchronized. You do not need to eat in either form. If you eat while transformed, your stomach will be empty when you return to your base form, and neither form depends on the other for sustenance.

Your upper limits are determined by your confidence as a Magical Girl. Confidence defines your strength, power, and overall potential, forming the foundation of all your abilities. Magical Girls are naturally resistant to mental interference, and with enough confidence you can ignore such effects even from opponents several ranks above you.

Your courage dictates your resistance to external powers. The stronger your conviction, the more you can resist abilities such as time regression, even negating or remembering altered timelines. Against esoteric or divine protections, if your conviction surpasses your opponent’s, you can choose to allow or deny those effects. This applies to telepathy, future sight, long distance scrying, and similar abilities, even those that would not normally be resisted by willpower. With enough courage, you can prevent others from gathering information about you entirely.

Acting in accordance with public perception of a Magical Girl increases your growth rate. Performing good deeds and saving others accelerates your development. Deviating from this perception grants nothing, unless your confidence is high enough that you do not view your actions as evil. Doing good increases your growth speed by 10 percent per notable deed, whether recognized by others or only by yourself if your confidence supports it.

A Magical Girl grows passively over time, though extremely slowly, taking about a week for minimal progress. Actively circulating magic within your body increases growth to fifty times that rate and can be done through breathing while moving. You can also absorb magical power directly from external sources. In truth, your power comes from conviction rather than magic, and these methods work because you believe they do. Emotional fluctuations can also strengthen you, and intense shifts in feeling may even increase your rank.

At Rank 4, you develop an Ultimate Move based on your Innate Talent. This talent reflects your growth and abilities up to that point. If your powers are primarily psychic, your Ultimate Move will be mental in nature. If you favor brute force, it may embody annihilation. If you specialize in time, it will grant a unique form of temporal control. No two Magical Girls are identical. Even with similar domains, their expressions differ. Anyone who replicates or uses your Ultimate Move becomes detectable to you, allowing you to track them whenever it is used.

You can learn and replicate the abilities of others. This requires time and practice, but you can reconstruct their powers and adapt their unique traits for yourself. These reconstructions are not perfect copies and may function differently, such as requiring additional magic for abilities that were originally purely mental. If a power can be directly shared with you, you learn it instantly.

As you grow stronger, a flower on your chest gains petals, representing your power level. Magical Girls are ranked numerically. Rank 1 is the initial stage and quickly progresses to Rank 2. Rank 2 establishes the basics and grants flight. Rank 3 is the average level, where your Innate Talent begins to form. Rank primarily determines your magical energy, while higher ranks make your personal traits more pronounced.

At Rank 5, you become immune to effects such as drugs and can survive extreme internal distortions, as if your body were rearranged like a broken spatial puzzle. Your growth rate increases dramatically, rivaling that of a Witch who grows stronger by killing others.

Rank 5 is a gamble. Your lifespan is consumed in exchange for rapid growth and accelerated learning. If you fail to reach Full Bloom, you will die young at 25. To advance, you must accomplish a feat worthy of recognition. Upon achieving such a feat, you reach Rank 6, Full Bloom. At this stage, you can control a star, use your powers anywhere you want, and gain an infinite lifespan. You could also throw the star at whatever enemies you have.
objects.title: Heart Seed (Magical Girls also have Strength Anxiety)

objects.text:
You have become a Witch. When a Magical Girl is aware of the existence of Witches and feels negative emotions, instead of experiencing growth they gain Witch Factor. The more Witch Factor they possess the more killing intent they have towards living beings. When their courage is less than ten times their magical power, you will become a Witch.

Witches are not inhibited by the limits of their mental energy and can grow endlessly. Similar to Magical Girls, you get stronger from feeling negative or positive emotions. And by killing people you feel unparalleled joy which raises your power more. Witches can also devour the energy from living beings they kill and absorb it to get stronger. The stronger the being, the greater the boost they get. 

As a Witch, you possess a core that can revive you an infinite number of times so long as it isn’t broken. This core can only be broken by sufficiently strong powers. But even without a core, it’s very hard for you to die. You can regenerate even from a drop of blood.

Depending on your Innate Trait, you will be able to survive so long as something related to that trait exists. For example, if it is the moon, then so long as the moon exists you will not be able to die and can even cast effects on people who touch moonlight or see the moon. Even the idea of the moon exists or the concept of it is enough to revive, but if through some miracle someone manages to remove all traces of the moon from the past and present, remove the moon, and somehow erase the concept of the moon entirely. So long as you yourself also remember the moon you can revive through it.

Once you get strong enough, you can create Avatars. Additional bodies that you can control to do things in other places while your main body is somewhere else. Where you get these bodies is up to you, but the easiest way is simply marking a living being and replacing it. It could be a cat, a Magical Girl, a random person on the street, or even a bug. So long as one of your Avatars is alive, so will you. The amount of Avatars you can maintain depends on the amount of courage you possess. Similarly, your ability to erase and replace a person relies on the amount of conviction you hold.

While you live longer than 25 years old compared to a Rank 5 Magical Girl. Your lifespan is dictated entirely on how well you can keep your sanity from being lost to the corruptive influence of the Witch Factor.
objects.title: Witch Factor (Magical Girls also have Strength Anxiety)

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl who can transform, your associated element is Earth and your Magical Girl theme is yellow. You can control and cast holy light to attack foes, and while you are resistant to corruptive influences you are not immune. While there is no cooldown on using your magic, it consumes Mana to cast. You also possess an inventory that carries a limited number of items, even capable of containing non-physical items.

Your holy magic can break illusions and Realms. Realms are an altercation to the world where people must follow specific rules, similar to miniature domains. Even those normally immune to mind control or restraining abilities must follow the rules. Holy Magic possesses a natural suppression over anything dark and evil, it’s twice as effective against them and can purify them.

You also know Retrospection Magic, allowing you to review memories of past events so long as you have a medium of the person. By gazing upon the stars, you can read Star-Hints. They are fate dictated by the stars and to you they sometimes whisper incredibly vague things. You do not need to be transformed to gaze upon the stars.
objects.title: Earth Magical Girl (Become a Magical Girl: I Have a Proficiency Panel)

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl blessed by the Golden Tree of Proverbs, a gift granted to you by the Omnipotent and Omniscient tree. You have a mascot, with a unique supporting power that assists you in combat.

As a Magical Girl, when you transform you become stronger. Against evil, demons, and monsters they feel fear against you. Under the protection of the Golden Tree of Proverbs, your Magical Girl powers cannot be cancelled. Even your combat uniform is directly attached to your body unless you yourself peel it off. Once a Magical Girl, always a Magical Girl. An airtight defense capable of preventing even Gods from negating or preventing transformations.

More importantly, you grow stronger by overcoming negative emotions. The deeper the negative emotions, trauma, and so on the faster you grow. But in actuality, “overcoming” means being capable of finding joy after fear. To find happiness while traumatized. Even if you’re still an emotional wreck who seems completely unstable, so long as you have even a modicum of something happy you will get stronger.

Overcoming great personal issues also allows you to hear the true name of your Magical Girl form. Your Liberation grants a power based on the reason you use your Magical Girl powers. It manifests as an indestructible weapon shaped to fit you. This can range from returning attacks back at the foe at twice the strength or controlling vines. The powers your Liberation grants are separate from the powers your Magical Girl form grants, effectively giving you two different powers.
objects.title: Magical Girl Liberation (Are you kidding me? Magical Girls)

objects.text:
You are the Great Witch of Envy, a fallen Magical Girl holding one of the 7 sins. Your authority of Envy is capable of copying anything so long as you have the minimalist most basic understanding of the thing you are aware of. This can replicate powers of other Magical Girls, supernatural abilities, espers, spells, and technology. Anything you can envy becomes something you can replicate and copy.

You can create vessels, empowering people into becoming Magical Girls like yourself, but fallen. They are completely loyal to you regardless of their previous inclinations as they cannot disobey their “mother”. This also grants them a false Liberation. If they have any powers to copy, you’ll be able to copy it too. Unlike how Magical Girls get stronger, you instead need to corrupt Magical Girls. Every Magical Girl you corrupt makes you stronger and restores mana.

When copying something, as long as you can guess what kind of power it is, you can copy it exactly. If you vaguely think it’s a Magical Girl power you can copy them. If you vaguely realize a transformation belt is achieved through technology, you can copy it so perfectly it also inherits its drawbacks. When you copy a power, you also copy any limitations or drawbacks it possesses.

Additionally, as the Great Witch of Envy, you possess several life saving methods that can save you from death. The first one is being able to transfer damage you take to something else, making it so if you transfer it to something indestructible like your Liberation then you also become invincible.
