The second one is being able to make clones that can act as real bodies, so long as one of those clones exists you can still survive.
objects.title: The Great Witch of Envy (Are you kidding me? Magical Girls)

objects.text: You know the secret of witches, kept hidden from the greater world since the Day of Conspiracy: magic only needs three things, a pen, ink, and knowledge. Spells are not cast but drawn with special magic ink; simple spells are composed of three elements, the rune in the center determines the type of the spell (fire, wind, water, light, etc.), the keystones that modify or augment the rune, and a circle around the whole. These elements can be combined and nested to create more complex effects. As soon as all the circles are closed, the spell is cast. Witches make use of this by drawing partial circles or building them into object, then closing them later. The scope and breadth of effects you can create, provided you have the knowledge and skill, can range from minor cantrips and one-off effects, to permanent teleportation gates, flying carriages, large-scale barriers over entire cities, and many more. However, magic is dangerous, your spells can (and will) behave in unintended ways or backfire; a careless witch can end their life with just the stroke of a pen just as easily as they can make a flame. Magic that affects the body, including healing, and spells that can be used to hurt others are considered forbidden magic; use them at your own risk. You start out with the knowledge of a freshly graduated witch, which includes the ability to draw runes, keystones, and circles freehand; basic equipment: multiple wands (pens and brushes), an endless phial of magic sap which needs to be processed to produce magic ink, some notebooks, a small collection of reference material, and a copy of the magic picture book Coco received form the brimmed hat witch. You can teach this power to others, and so can they once they have learned the secret.
objects.title: Witch (Witch Hat Atelier)

objects.text: Wizards are highly educated scholars of the arcane, and highly respected on Eora for their willpower and intelligence; you become one such scholar, your well-rounded knowledge of Arcana and Metaphysics, combined with your keen Insight, allow you to understand spells easily, and even develop your own with some effort and research. You start with the ability to cast 1st level spells and have the potential to become an archmage, provided you put in the effort. However, the process of casting spells is so complex and physically demanding that even practiced wizards cannot invoke them without the use of specially enchanted tomes called grimoires. These tomes, made from rare materials able to absorb ambient soul energy, serve multiple functions: a repository for the wizard's spells, a battery to power them, and a focus to cast them; more powerful grimoires can hold more energy and cast stronger spells. You start out with a Fine Wand, which can fire bolts of soul energy that can pierce or crush the target, and your personal grimoire: the Apprentice's Tome which contains three 1st and 2nd level spells and two 3rd level spells of your choice, and can support up to 3rd level spells. You also know how to create your own wands and grimoires, provided you can source and/or transmute the required materials. To help your progress further, you also have two special grimoires: the Archmages' Legacy, a legendary grimoire that contains every spells seen on Eora — however, the contents must be decoded beyond common 1st level spells; and the Divine Mysteries, an occult grimoire which contains every Priest, Druid, and Cipher spell seen on Eora — each section of this tome must not only be decoded, but the spells will need to be translated to a form usable by a wizard.
objects.title: Wizard (Pillars of Eternity)

objects.text:
You have learned much of the realms of magic which exist in the short story “Green Magic.” This magic system involves the calling down of beings from higher, more spiritual planes of existence to perform tasks and teach their arts to the wielder, granting them powers. The realms could be visualized like a spiral moving out from the material plane, with each full rotation consisting of two opposing realms with one being more advanced than the other, as the further out the spiral goes the more advanced that realm of magic is.

White and Black Magic are simple realms of Good and Evil. White Magic is the realm of benign spirits like angels, white sprites, merrihews, and sandestins, while Black Magic works with more malicious entities such as demons, magners, trolls, and warlocks. The uses of these realms include spells to protect the user from harm, to give life to the inanimate and bind it to servitude, and to summon the respective realms’ spirits to perform tasks or reveal knowledge. Black Magic could be considered the stronger and more advanced of the two. The spiritual planes these arts draw from are as far above the basic material world as they are below the realms of Purple and Green.

Purple Magic is the realm of Incarnate Symbols, and it is a great deal more advanced than either White or Black. Among its abilities is the power to control minds totally, likely as well as a great deal more; it has spirits that may be summoned just as the lower realms do, but the inhabitants of these realms are as supernatural to the ones below as the angels and demons are to humans.

Green Magic is the corollary of Purple Magic, though far more advanced and difficult to understand as a discipline. Green Magic is the realm of Dynamic Nomism; it is best described as interacting with pure Meaning of a kind that humans simply cannot comprehend, and the sprites of the Green Magic realm use it for conjurations and transmutations of symbols more intricate, delicate, and important than any human could understand. Of course, put in the hands of someone who wanted to use it that way, it could freely manipulate space, time, mass, energy, life, thought, and recollection as easily as you could break an egg with a club.

There are realms beyond even Green Magic, such as Rawn and Pallow, though there is no way to describe these.

You have mastered the realms of White and Black Magic, learned a fair amount of Purple Magic (which is usually the most even the greatest magicians achieve), and are aware of how to contact the realm of Green Magic to potentially start learning it.

Purple Magic is prohibitively complicated and requires prodigious skill to master; actually learning Green Magic is essentially an impossibility, and even some of the greatest wizards of all time would need centuries of study to learn just enough to realize they’ll never master it, though at least even just that much makes them godlike in the material world. Of course, learning anything of Green Magic involves expanding your consciousness and understanding to the point that nothing the material world offers is pleasing anymore, forcing experienced practitioners to decide between staying in the Green Magic realm where their clumsiness and inelegance is perpetually obvious or the material realm where everything feels both trivial and disgusting.

Hey, maybe you’re special enough that you’ll actually master Green Magic, or even the realms beyond it. As a small mercy, you’ll be given a guarantee that your ability to advance further will never plateau completely, so you will always be able to make some measurable degree of progress, however slow it is.
objects.title: Colorful Magic (Green Magic)

addons.text: You are a natural Superconductor, someone with so much magical power that normal people would need to have every bone in their body broken by a Mage Maker to emit as much as you do naturally. Magic overflows from you to the point it turns everything you touch magical, such as a Diviner who’s a Superconductor being able to clearly perceive the future years or even decades in advance through anything around them. Anywhere they look they would see all events to come laid out plainly for them alone. If you had the right method of outputting it your mystical power could destroy entire cities, or warp them into new shapes at your will.
addons.title: Superconductor

objects.text:
You gain the abilities of a Mage Maker, someone with the power to impart magical ability upon others. You do this by breaking bones to release magical energy, with different bones granting different magical skills. These are permanent and stay after the bone heals.

A fracture on the radius and ulna would make a Cloth Mage, who can use effects they find in the natural world to enchant fabric and create clothing with mystical effects like creating illusions, enhancing strength, negating other magic, or freezing everyone around you in place. A break on the humerus would make a Book Binder, who can enchant books to act in ways similar to highly advanced computers or smartphones.

Other bones can grant Innate Magic, performing supernatural feats on your own rather than enchanting objects. A fracture on the jaw can let someone speak to birds, the arm can give superhuman strength, the index finger can make anyone you introduce yourself to like you. Innate Magic can sometimes have side effects, like preventing you from performing any acts of violence if you gain the power to make people like you, but it isn’t universal.

You can even turn other people into Mage Makers themselves, though the release of magic involved can be dangerous for the one undergoing the procedure. Only one in every couple dozen will survive. Possessing confidence and willpower helps. If you broke every bone in a person’s body they would become a magical weapon of mass destruction capable of melting cities and bending every human in them into unknowable shapes, although they will also probably be insane, and die soon if they even survived the process.

There’s also another method of magical empowerment, Deep Magic, which involves leaving all the bones untouched but removing the skin. This causes a partial reversion to the pre-Fall state of humanity, when rather than flesh and blood they were beings of pure spirit and magic like God. The more skin is removed the more magical power will be unleashed, potentially allowing the user to pull off the same feats as the biblical God like smiting cities, resurrecting the dead, altering genetics worldwide, instigating a worldwide flood, and so on. Not on the list of powers granted by this procedure is the ability to survive having your skin removed, which is not helped by the immense surge of magic. Most people will die at around the point where they gain the ability to implode people with a gesture or recreate one dead person.
objects.title: Mage Maker (The Marrowbone Spells)

objects.text: You have been inducted into a Great House of the Dead City. As a member of this house you’ve been given tutelage in the necromantic arts, and the power to raise a retinue to follow your whims. Initially you’re able to gather, harvest, and consume ambient ‘Soul’ energy for rudimentary effects, the particulars and less general abilities though depend on the house itself. Your Retinue meanwhile is made up of 5 ‘units’ at a time, usually composed of your own house’s creations. However, while you can only have one house, your retinue may comprise two though the majority must remain your own. These Units are divided into 5 categories; Thralls that are so weak two may be considered a single unit, Scions that are specialised and elite units, Freaks which play a support role, Horrors that are fast but often fragile, Hunters that specialise in high ranged damage, and Tyrants, a truly massive powerhouse of which you can only control one at a time. You must choose a House, which will determine both your initial unit list and the specific skills and abilities afforded to you as one of their Necromancers; C.A.R.C.A.S.S, a private military company dedicated to strict discipline and ranged domination. Their Necromancers are ‘Operators’, adept with guns and Special Operations manoeuvres. Their units meanwhile range from simple but effective firearm-armed Thralls to massive un-living Juggernaut Tyrants acting as living mortars. The Goregrinders, A brutal cult of melee berserkers and speed freaks that fuse their bodies with infernal engines and devil-blood injectors. Incredibly powerful, but always on the brink of igniting their own blaze. Their necromancers likewise are often warlords priming their retinue to charge heedlessly. Their units are often within this ‘berserker’ mold, though with some variation such as ‘Painghoul’ Freaks hooking opponents and controlling the battlefield, or ‘painwheel’ Horrors catapulting themselves into enemies in an endless scream. The Gargamox, a loose cohort of gutter trash sucking the power from other dead necromancers specialising in area denial and sickening infections. Their necromancers are likewise often plaguelords, immune to their own virulence but spreading toxic miasma and verminous plagues. Their units likewise are equally disgusting, from pustulent Rotting Hunters that’s sloughing flesh infects adversaries to verminous Host Hunters sending plaguerats to harry foes. The Deadsouls, a dark cohort of priests who have died a second spiritual death in return for mastery of the soul itself that specialise in applying curses and dooms onto their foes. Their Necromancers are likewise dark priests, feeding on souls and isolating foes. Their units meanwhile are often their unwitting victims. Sacrificial Thralls that give benefit when slain, wailing Hunter Banshees that shriek relentlessly, and great Tyrant Bound Devils capable of being in all places to tear victims limb from limb. The Abhorrers, a once-heretic religious order that bring ‘Miracles’ upon their foes with modal ‘stances’ to enhance themselves. Unlike most Houses, as they’re at least theoretically opposed to ‘Necromancy’ their ‘Necromancers’ are often more akin to holy vessels, or true priests walking a way of absolution and meting out the Will of God. Their units meanwhile are as you would expect, Inquisitor Horrors to vanquish foes, Antipriest Freaks to purify the battlefield, and even Holy Body Tyrants, the angelic bodies of saints, to bring righteous vengeance on their enemies. The igorri, experimenters and traveling physicians using darker sciences and the bodies of the fallen to create their own bespoke mutating abominations. Their Necromancers are of a piece, little frankensteins, enamoured with experimental surgeries and novel materials. Their Units are often painstakingly created to fulfil their niches, such as Stitch Thralls that fall to shambles when killed further crowding a battlefield with their corpse(s), to Lycan Horrors and Humunculous Tyrants that each gain massive benefit from absorbing the corpses that surround them (and that they often generate in battle. The Steeple Wracks, a feral community of the city’s spires that worship the giant red owls and feed from their blood. They favour an overwhelming swarm overrunning enemies with frightening speed. Their necromancers are prone to extreme sacrifice, ripping apart foes with their bare hands to feast on their offal. Their Flock Thralls are so numerous that evermore seem to appear regardless of your Unit Limits. Siren Freaks that inspire horror in nearby foes,and even the great Carniphagious Owl Tyrants gorging themselves on flesh. The Hellminth, A group of pale extradimensional parasites that adapt and evolve as they grow more attached to the host’s nervous system. Their Necromancers are known as Nephellim, decadent swarm-fathers that seek to refine and enhance their spawn. THeir Units likewise are composed of these spawn, from Thralls with larval Hellminth inside to Knight Scions and ‘Sage’ Freaks, each evolving and adapting during battle to suit an enemy at the whim of their Nephellim. The Volvadani Machine Fief are the Defacto government of the Dead City, though they are in essence little more than a brutal cartel ensconced in steel shells taking action with timed explosive response and arbitrary violence. Their Necromancers are likewise ‘Praetors’, Sargeants of a kind in personalised power armour they can never leave. Their Units are similarly fixated on their ‘legitimacy’. ‘Clerk’ Freaks that forge contracts to bind opponents, Mancatcher Hunters that are mostly used to round up the feral or mindless undead, and Penitent Engine Tyrants fueled with grief and pain of the ‘criminal’ inside the Iron maiden at its center. As a Necromancer you’ve gained all the abilities, knowledge, and skills expected to run your Great House, from a C.A.R.C.A.S.S operative’s understanding of weapon maintenance to a Hellminth’s ability to produce their spawn. As you grow and develop as a necromancer, you’ll be able to use the Dark Power you accrue to upgrade both yourself and your retinue, becoming a true force to be reckoned with as battles harden and refine your unit.
objects.title: TO BREAK DEATH (Magnagothica: Maleghast)

addons.title: Rescue Captain
addons.text:
Your body is now the perfect vessel for Healing Magic, bursting with strength and vitality. You took to your training so well that you can rival the power of Captain Rose herself—the single greatest user of Healing Magic. 

Your power flows through your body effortlessly, passively healing all wounds to various degrees depending on immediate severity and your current activity. Your physique is now as much of a nuclear weapon to enemies as it is a stronghold for allies, making you virtually unkillable to most conventional or supernatural means. 

The effects of Healing Magic on your body is so potent that you rarely—or don't—feel pain anymore. Either from you able to treat it as a papercut or healing so fast that it appears so. Furthermore, the raw potency of your magic is enough to achieve regeneration, reviving the dead, remove the need for sustenance, or even true immortality with enough practice.

addons.title: Blursed Magic
addons.text:
Combining Jujutsu Sorcery with Healing Magic created an astonishing new type of magic—Blursed Magic. This combines the destructive potential of Jujutsu with the restorative properties of Healing Magic, creating a contradictory fusion of the two. 

By combining normal Cursed Energy with Healing Magic, your physical abilities are enhanced tenfold, easily outclassing Grade 1 Sorcerers or Rose herself through sheer might. More importantly, the contradiction of these two forces make you the perfect destroyer and healer simultaneously. You can just easily decimate Special Grade Cursed Spirits as you can restore a bisected soldier in mere seconds from one punch, which can also cause no pain in the latter case, and maximum agony in the other while leaving said Cursed Spirit alive if you wished.

Reverse Cursed Technique is the key to this, allowing you to easily toggle and amplify the destructive or restorative power of Healing Magic. Allowing you to literally beat an opponent or ally to life or death, keep them in a state of limbo between the two, restore youth, repair or reinforce organs, recreate bodies from almost nothing, and more.  

You can also create many applications of Blursed Magic through mastery of Jujutsu Techniques and Healing Magic respectively.

objects.text: You've discovered your innate affinity towards Healing Magic, the rarest of all magics within the Llinger Kingdom. Which began the start of your training from hell, and came out the other end as a messiah of the battlefield. Not because you defeated the villain, but because you're the sole reason everyone else is alive. Provided the victim isn't outright dead, you can heal any and all wounds and injuries, with the potency to heal a fatally wounded soldier within a few moments at best, as well as cure poisons and dull pain. With the potential for further improvement such as regenerating severed limbs, or reviving the recently dead. Through your training, you've developed a superhuman body that transforms you into a living ambulance. Capable of sprinting to where you're needed in seconds, have the strength to carry multiple patients at once, endurance to persevere through physical fatigue, and endless stamina to repeat this process nigh-indefinitely. In combat, your physique alone can easily defeat a beast over five times your size, with constant healing to keep you in peak condition, and shrug off any sustained damage. By cloaking your body in healing magic, you can amplify your physical power even further, and channel it into various techniques or other applications. Starting with the Ultimate Healing Punch as your first. Beyond healing, you also gain an intuitive sense for "wrong" methods to use healing magic. For example, against an opponent with regeneration, you can modify your healing in a way that nullifies it completely and inflict significant damage to them. When handling cursed objects, you can slowly "heal" its cursed properties away, or inverse the curse entirely.
objects.title: Healing Magic (The Wrong Way to use Healing Magic)

objects.text:
You've been blessed with the prowess to manipulate Water Magic on the same level as Ryo Mihara. You don’t use incantations, focus items, or any crutch for casting this magic. Mere thought is all you need to bend the element of water in all its forms to your will. 

By visualizing the effect you wish to achieve, you can easily create it, or at the very least, the first steps towards what you originally envisioned. Once complete, the spell is recorded within your mind for you to use at any time, including any variants or imperfect versions should you wish.

The foundation of Water Magic is in manipulating the molecular structure of water by using your imagination to achieve various effects. From generating water; Changing it into a solid, gas and back to a liquid; Manipulating its shape, temperature, or viscosity; Creating constructs of both water and ice; Propelling it with enough force to pierce wood, and many more. Even esoteric things like scanning lifeforms, magic detection, manipulating other liquids, and even spell negation are possible, but require an advanced skill level.

You can improve your proficiency with Water Magic by simply practicing with it, and will advance much faster compared to normal mages due to facing less demanding hurdles than them. You also have a greater mana pool than the average mage to fuel this magic.
objects.title: Water Magic (The Water Magician)

addons.title: Self Writing Magic
addons.text:
Your magical quill gains the properties of the Self Writing Quill, allowing you to cast more spells and make the process much faster.

For reference, by merely thinking of two mundane objects you wish to summon, your quill will have already created them the moment you blink. While ten different special objects can now be summoned simultaneously in less than a few seconds, compared to the minutes it would take you normally.

objects.text:
The Written-Style Summoning Magic allows its user to conjure, alter, and shape any object from their imagination into reality. This is done via a specialized quill that draws various runes and formulas into open space to effectively edit the "code" of reality to summon the desired object as intended. 

You can use this magic to summon anything from giant autonomous robots, weapons both mundane and supernatural, crystals and ores with any properties you wish, to relics of legend like an exact replica of King Arthur's sword. The summoned objects are permanent, kept within a special pocket space of unlimited storage, and can be summoned at any time. The more complex the objects, the more time is needed to summon them.

Furthermore, you can deploy this magic for combat. Such as manipulating the runes for grabbing and stopping objects, altering their properties, propelling them like missiles, raining arrows from the heavens, or spawning grenades from someone's stomach.

You start with the same spells as Adonis, and can create new ones over time. As well as a magical quill of your own design as the conduit for this magic. It is indestructible, can be summoned back at will, and grows with you. It also counts as an OoP.
objects.title: Writing Magic (The Kingdoms of Ruin)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to convert your stored magical power directly into physical objects, conjuring anything you can create out of nothing, so long as you have the mana to pay for it. The cost is not fixed — it scales with what you're making. A mundane object, something with no magic of its own, costs only a small fraction of your reserve, letting you mass-produce ordinary goods cheaply. A magical item, like a potent elixir, can cost an enormous amount of mana, potentially millions of "mana points" or its equivalent, meaning what you can create at any given moment is entirely capped by how much mana you currently hold.

You can raise that cap by using the skill on itself: create an item built specifically to increase your magical capacity, absorb it, and your reserve grows, letting you create bigger and more expensive things next time. For example, creating a seed that increases your mana by 0.1 "mana points" or it's equivalent. This is the only way to scale up, there's no separate leveling system, just this compounding loop of spending mana to get more mana.

The skill has one absolute restriction: it cannot create skills or abilities directly. If you want a power that would normally take training to earn, you have to create an item or catalyst that grants it instead, the magic itself refuses to hand you the ability outright.

The one thing the skill doesn't directly grant but leads to regardless is immortality, once your accumulated magical power becomes large enough, your body simply stops aging, as a byproduct of how much mana you're carrying rather than anything you deliberately cast.
objects.title: Creation Magic (Maryoku Cheat na Majo ni Narimashita)

objects.text:
You can now wield the Elemental Sacred Arts of Project Alicization. This system uses verbal and somatic components with a precise syntax, similar to a computer program, to control the eight elements. To initiate Sacred Arts, say "System Call" followed by the specific spell command. The complexity of the spell determines the length of the incantation and the mana it consumes.

Sacred Arts require a conductor, such as the caster’s fingers, toes, or eyes, linked to their consciousness. Each conductor needs the user to maintain an image of the chosen element throughout the incantation. Experienced users can manage multiple elements simultaneously. When a spell is activated, the conductors glow faintly.

To generate an element, use the command "Generate [element] element." Manipulating elements involves subtle fingertip movements, with each finger able to handle one element, though advanced rituals can involve multiple elements without repeating "System Call" for each. The eight elements are Aqueous (Water), Aerial (Wind), Cryogenic (Ice), Luminous (Light and Healing), Metallic (Metal), Thermal (Fire), Umbral (Darkness and Item Finding), and Crystalline (Glass).

Once an element is generated, you can shape it with commands like "Form element, [shape] shape" and control its movement with commands such as "Fly straight; Counter [element] object; Adhere possession, [Item]." Common command endings include "Discharge" to execute commands, "Burst Element" to cause an explosion, or "Adhere" to attach the element to an object.

You can continue to give instructions to a Sacred Art until all elements are destroyed or resources are depleted. As long as the user maintains the element's image, they can pause giving instructions. Simple effects have quick casting times, while advanced spells may require lengthy commands, upwards of multiple paragraphs in length.

For example "Generate cryogenic element. Form element, bird shape. Counter thermal object, discharge." would create ice birds that seek out and counter thermal (fire) objects.
objects.title: System Call (Sword Art Online)
Summer Fire / Winter Ice (Dresden Files)
objects.text: Whether through birth, bargain, or blessing you have been granted the ability to use Summer Fire or Winter Ice. Both can be used to strengthen mortal magic (particularly matching elemental magic: Fire, Earth, Light, and Life for Summer Fire; Ice, Water, Darkness, and Air for Winter Ice), and will leave traces of themselves in any spell fueled by one; but they can also be used individually to create glamours (Fae illusions) and enchantments, or be summoned and controlled directly. They are antithetical to each other, so cannot be used at the same time; and affect their users over time by causing their magic to align more with the chosen Court’s elements. Summer Fire is the power of the Summer Court. It can be used to burn magical energy and physical matter; sustain, manipulate, grow and heal all forms of life; destroy Winter Ice; and create or strengthen “fiery” emotions such as passion or hope. It manifests normally as fire which burns brightly orange with flickers of yellow and red flame. Winter Ice is the power of the Winter Court. It can be used to freeze magical energy and physical matter; control air currents and the weather; destroy Summer Fire; cause hysterical strength in human users; and freeze people’s minds and intentions into perfect clarity aside for their most primal of instincts. It manifests as pale blue ice with a core of pure black if enough is manifested. Manifestations of either will last as long as they are provided magical power, or if they are enchanted to do so; but will quickly fade outside of Faerie realms when not continuously powered, or enchanted to last. Further, this magic is dangerous for non-fae; it is highly addictive, wants to be used, does not come with safeguards on power draw or any other way; and prolonged use will warp the mind of the user. Finally, Faeries of each Court are particularly vulnerable to their own Court’s magic. Although most Fae could overwhelm a weak mortal user of their Court’s power; with surprise, or the right obligation behind an action, even the strongest could be slain using their own Court’s gift.

addons.title: Bound to the Court
addons.text:
You are bound as a minor vassal of a Faerie Court (should one not exist in your world, one will be created) subject to the whims of your betters, the desires of your liege, and the hatred of any of its enemies: at least unless you somehow manage to break your bonds to the court or raise your status enough to takeover. 

Good Luck.

addons.title: Power of Both Courts
addons.text: This really should not be possible. Somehow you have both the blessings and the aptitude to switch between using Summer Fire and Winter Ice without issue. Perhaps given time you might even combine the mutually exclusive magics; since you’re already doing the impossible by having inherent sources of both anyway.

All your soulbound items now automatically become Fullbrings, granting you a unique power for each of them. The strength of these powers depends on both your emotional connection to that particular object and its own power.
addons.title: Fullbring

objects.text:
You have the ability to bind a single item to your soul, turning it into what is effectively an extension of yourself. This selection is not permanent, as you are able to retract the bond from your item at any time. The item bound to you can be stored within your soul and recalled at will.

Your bound item benefits from any perks you have and a fraction of your passive powers, including attribute enhancements, regeneration, and similar effects. You can also sense its location from anywhere, unless it is somehow protected from you.

Your bound item is indestructible unless you will it otherwise. Consumable and perishable items, such as food, drink, or medicine, will restore or refill themselves over time, with more valuable or potent items taking longer. They are also immune to spoilage or degradation.

In addition to ordinary items, you may also bind supernatural ones, such as weapons infused with magical, psionic, or divine power. Such items not only share the same benefits as normal ones but also receive a fraction of any self-power-augmenting powers you have, as well as any abilities that share their source. For example, magic-infused items benefit from your magical powers, further amplifying their own capabilities.

You may not bind living creatures to you.
objects.title: Soulbond

addons.text:
You have acquired the eyes of a divine, elevating your senses and perception of the world to superhuman levels. Yet, the most powerful feature is your heightened divine perception. This ability fine-tunes your awareness of everything aligned with your chosen divinity, allowing you to detect even the faintest manifestations of your domain. For instance, with a divinity of justice, you could discern whether a weapon was wielded in murder or perceive a person's past crimes with a mere glance. If your divinity is connected to death, you could see those nearing their life's end or ways they might die. A divinity of the arts could peer into the depths of a painting, understanding its essence and the emotions of its creator.

The strength of your divine eye is a formidable tool, yet its power is directly tied to the strength of your divinity.
addons.title: Divine Eye

addons.text:
Your fragment and aptitude have enlightened you with a deep insight into the cosmos, allowing you to select two additional concepts to add to your divinity. These chosen concepts will initially possess strength significantly weaker than your core divinity, starting at roughly one-third of your primary one. However, even if the cosmic insights you select are entirely unrelated to each other or your core divinity, over time, they will naturally develop synergy with your main domain.

With time and effort, you could pursue other cosmic insights to bolster your divinity, but uncovering the secrets of the cosmos is hard work. Be prepared to dedicate decades, or maybe even centuries, to acquire more cosmic insights.
addons.title: Cosmic Insight

addons.text:
Your ability to rise to divinity synergizes with the fragment you hold; your nature reacts much more than another would to every step you take toward divinity. A single person praying to you is enough to make your domain flare and shine, enough for example to use a Water domain to control an Olympic pool worth of it, and this only increases with further stimulation and the closer you are to divinity. Your blessings are also greatly amplified the closer they align with your domain, whether conceptually or literally.

Your path also takes much shorter, especially the more your path aligns with your domain, and once it is completed, your control over your domain will be even greater than other divinities of it of similar power.

Your own actions also affect your power and progress depending on how closely they align with your domain. With a War domain, entering a combat meditation could have a similar effect to prayers on your control of your domain, and winning battles would greatly increase your progress on the Path. If you have A Path Walked Fearlessly, those are the only ways your domain influences your Path.
addons.title: Rising Once More

addons.text:
Your divinity has fundamentally been altered into a Law. Your Law requires slightly more work than a fragmented divinity but overall, it is less tiring to use and stronger than a fragmented divinity of the same level.

Your Law starts off at the lesser and most basic level with a focus on a single aspect of it and mainly only has more passive effects when you consciously apply it. But through knowledge, understanding, and willpower, your Law can grow with you imbuing more aspects into it, and once it gets strong enough, you can even use it directly to manipulate the overarching focus of your Law.

The broader the focus of your Law, the less innately powerful it is and the longer it takes to grow. With mastery, you may also learn to apply the lesser aspects of your Law onto other things. Any additional divinities you gain will also be transformed into a Law.
addons.title: Law

addons.text:
Your Law has turned into something far greater in both strength and size, a Dao. A Dao is a specific universal truth of reality, and as such, the only limit it has is your understanding of it. 

Your understanding of the Dao is weak at best, but with time and effort, nothing can truly stop you. The stronger your Dao becomes, the longer and more knowledge it takes to grow any further, possibly even taking centuries to grow to a medium-level Dao without any enlightenment. 

If you gain any other Fragmented Divinities, they will instead become an above-average Law that has some sort of connection to your Dao.
addons.title: Dao

addons.text: Your Fragmented Divinity wasn't stolen; it is your Birthright as the child of one of the Divine. Instead of choosing a new Divinity, you can alternatively choose a Domain from your parent based on the aspect you inherited to inherit as a Fragment of Divinity. As a result of this being your birthright, rather than stolen, you will find this Divinity growing far faster, being far easier to use, and being far more malleable. Unlike other Demigods, this Divinity can not only potentially match the strength of your parents' divinity but eclipse it entirely with time. Note: If you have Child of Prophecy (PJO), then you gain all of your parents' domains as Fragmented Divinities
addons.title: Divine Birthright

objects.text:
You’ve consumed a small fragment of a god and gained divinity. Choose a single concept, skill, item, or element that will define your divinity. You gain a conceptual connection and control over your selected domain. 

Depending on the nature of your divinity, you can access a variety of powers. Someone who chooses War can gain exceptional strength in battle or can manipulate the battlefield with ease. A divinity of Justice could sense evil or judge criminals with a thought. Opting for a divinity in the Arts could allow you to create some of the finest pieces that have ever existed. The applications of divinity are endless, but mastering these powers will require extensive practice to fully realize your potential.

Currently, your powers are still diminished, and all your abilities are stuck at around street-level potency until you can recover more of your divinity. Taking actions in line with your chosen portfolio can help enhance your divinity. Broader concepts or elements like martial arts, creation, space, blades or fire will take longer to grow. In contrast, more specific or focused concepts such as punching, painting, portals, knives, or ash will grow quicker in comparison.
objects.title: Fragmented Divinity

addons.text: You can make your Aura Sing to Eternity like your Shehai does, allowing your entire body to act as a weapon. Your self-correction now applies to everything you do. You can do similar things to your Shehai without the use of a sword. Stepping miles at a time, grabbing space to rip a hole open to teleport, moving things with a wave of your hand. You can do anything and connect it back to the Song of Eternity, bringing forth unrealized possibilities with each action.
addons.title: Soul's Panoply

addons.text: You are able to give a piece of your soul to your students to carry through their Story. You cannot design these Artifacts entirely, however you are able to influence them heavily. These Artifacts will require a portion of your student’s copied Concept, from a small trickle to almost the entire thing. You are able to use golden pages to enhance the Artifact tremendously, giving it innate qualities otherwise unreachable. The more you put into the Artifact, the more it will grow for your students. These Artifacts will adapt to their owners story, retroactively receiving abilities that reflect its owners past feats. These Artifacts are able to be combined with a Shehai, binding them to a Students soul and empowering the respective Shehai. Over time and through incredible feats, the original Concept used to create the Artifact will return, keeping a connection to Artifact made from it.
addons.title: Soul Smith

addons.text: Shehai wielder's are often referred to as Sword-Singers, moving their Spirit Swords in a manner that resonates with the universe. You are capable of so much more, putting even the Dovahkiin to shame. You will be forever capable of listening to the Song that Eternity itself conducts. This allows you to insert Notes into the Song of Eternity directly with unparalleled ease. Enforcing a change upon reality only requires enough willpower to make it so. Skill is no longer a factor as your soul has no more fixed expressions it needs to work through, resonating with the Song of Eternity at all times. Allowing others to hear the Song is possible although it takes a special person to be able to work with the Song of Eternity. Even without an idea in mind, you are able to press upon the world with merely the weight of your soul.
addons.title: Singing from the Soul

addons.text: They say the soul remembers, and your soul is proof of that. You carry more than just yourself to the end of Eternity, every student, regardless of whether they are a True Student, will have a Mark in your Reality Marble and will have a seat for themselves in your Classroom of Semblances. Your students no longer have to choose to remain in your Reality Marble after passing on, for every afterlife has some place in Eternity. You have perfect control over the effects your Story has on reality, allowing you to pass as unordinary to the rest of existence at a moment's notice. The Marks that fill up your Reality Marble and the Semblances in the Classroom have no more growth limitations, be it in power or versatility. You remember your beginnings, never losing yourself to power, never forgetting your values. You gain an incredible intuition for people, you are able to shed light to talents that may not have existed before you looked.
addons.title: A Soul's Annals

addons.text: The Marks inside of your Reality Marble have started a self sustaining cycle, they are constantly being refined by the countless Concepts of various students while also increasing the students direct comprehension of their Concept. You are able to imbue your True Students summoned Shehai with the associated Mark and release it out into the world. Your True Student's shade will attempt to increase its power and feed it back into its Mark which will then bolster the shade and living student if possible. Once the free-roaming Marks have built up enough momentum they will begin to spawn weaker versions of your True Student's Reality Marbles. These weaker versions will be assimilated back into your own Reality Marble, shoring up areas that require more support.
addons.title: Seeking Enlightenment

addons.text:
Your powers are one of a kind. They cannot be copied, replicated, mimicked, etc. This protects even from Paragon-level powers and above.

While it doesn't prevent others from copying powers similar to yours, if someone were to somehow successfully obtain a copy of your power, a close enough replica, or even steal it, your own power would instantly become stronger than said copy or replica, and all stolen, copied, and replicated abilities will be instantly transferred to you.
addons.title: One of a Kind Special

addons.text: Your Significant Other now can, if you so choose, benefit from all the protections of Eternal Flame, as well as any immortality-related perks you yourself possess, such as Immortality Insurance, for example.
addons.title: Death Never do us Part

objects.text:
Your Immortal soul burns brightly, like few others, leaving your existence eternal and nearly inviolable. Over time, you can recover from anything, even things like true death or reality erasure, reforming at a safe location. You will always return to peak condition in body, mind, and soul. You will not age past your prime, remaining at your peak fitness and attractiveness eternally. These protections are conceptual, allowing you to somehow heal even from things like imprisonment, misfortune or timeline alteration. This power works slowly, but is completely loophole-free. You are an Omniversal constant.

This power cannot be lost, stolen, drained, suppressed, copied, or otherwise negatively affected, and it will restore your other powers and abilities just as it restores you.
objects.title: Eternal Flame

addons.text: You simply cannot be cut down a peg. No matter what you do, you profit from it in some manner. When someone assembles a team to take you down, you seemingly become allies instead. When you fall asleep in a meadow, you wake up finding that someone has lost their treasures right at your feet. And you never seem to get any comeuppance from whatever crazy stunts you pull, seemingly always coming out of it smelling of roses.
addons.title: Luck of the Devil

objects.text: You. Have. Risen! Through great internal struggle, you have surpassed the chains of fate. The slings and arrows of misfortune no longer find purchase upon your being, leaving your fortunes untarnished and unfettered. To those who observe you, it will appear as if you are walking on the very clouds themselves—impossibly and preternaturally lucky in all of your actions and pursuits.
objects.title: Fate Breaker

objects.text: You deny god's miracles. The power allows you to go against the gods' authority by nullifying any power that comes from a divine source. Moreover, this also weakens any gods, divine beasts, priests, divine champions and/or prophets fighting against you. The higher the divinity of your opponent, the weaker they would be. However, if the difference in strength between you and your opponent is too large, the debuff will be less.
objects.title: Denial Of Heavens

addons.text: Your ability to manipulate the souls of others has extended to those that inhabit your garden. With minimal effort, you can replant any of your resting souls in the body of the living, giving them new life. Whether this combines the two souls in question or swaps them is up to you. It becomes trivial to collect wayward souls for the purpose of growing your garden into the seedbed it was meant to be.
addons.title: Soul Gardener

addons.text:
It is said that Peter was given the keys to heaven, and it seems that he has granted you the blessing to never be forced into hell. In other words, the tower is in your Soul Garden, your own afterlife. The greatest advantage of this, is that the Tower no longer abides to the rules of Hell. Thus, you no longer have a time limit until such moment as you enter the Tower. Once entered, the timer starts as normal, with the difficulty still set to when you died.

You don't have to climb the tower alone either. Anyone within your afterlife also has the priviledge to climb it, if you so allow it. Through this, the tower bends the rules, only making the difficulty considering the strongest, not everyone as a whole, allowing a much easier time. Although they themselves are also under the time limit as well.

A crucial detail you might notice is the fact that no demons are within your afterlife, meaning there is no such beings for you to conquer and steal their powers. To compensate for this, similar beings are created within the tower. It is not required to fight them, and are only hostile upon getting close enough. This allows you, or any other person, to try and absorb their power if they wish to try.
addons.title: St. Peter's Blessing

addons.text: Your Soul Garden takes on the properties of the Infinity Circuits and World Spirits of the Aeldari. As a result, it can now serve as a well of power, letting you safely but slowly siphon a fraction of the energy from every soul contained within. This is in no way harmful to the soul, and is more akin to drawing off excess. This pool of power is universal, able to fuel any power you possess or boost their potency, though it is entirely dependent on the number and strength of the souls being siphoned. A single human's soul might only provide a big enough well to recover a little stamina, whereas an untold number of Eldar ones across every Craftworld would have fueled the birth of a new god. You can also commune with it, though the dreamlike state of this afterlife makes any communication difficult at best, and as more souls enter the harder it is to parse clear answers.
addons.title: Living Infinity Circuit

addons.text: Your Null aura cocoons your Soul Garden, providing a layer of protection that wards against any breaches from spiritual or psychic entities trying to enter, safeguarding the souls within. No daemon or other form of predator can enter without first overcoming this, if they could even stand to look at it. This doesn't affect nor harm the souls present within your Soul Garden.
addons.title: Walled Garden

objects.text:
The Soul Garden is a simulated afterlife dimension that's tethered to your soul. The weary and the mourning are welcome to rest and heal within its comforting embrace.

With this, you possess your own personal afterlife for the souls of those who matter to you, or for those you allow to enter. The ones you have lost or those who have passed on can find solace in the garden when they reach their time. While here, they will experience an afterlife as designed by you.

Keep in mind that this isn't a real afterlife, however. It's essentially a soul storage from which spirits can "sleep" and "dream". However, taking respite here comes with many advantages; not only do they heal from any spiritual injury or curse with time spent within its healing aura but it also allows for the safekeeping of their soul.
objects.title: Soul Garden

addons.text: ‘A great eye sits on your pectoral, it moves and watches from your chest’ The Inner Beast is now able to coordinate your Brand and Bond in order to maximize their synergy, perfect their development, and ensure their best use. In addition, much like how it can control minions you create, your Inner Beast is capable of managing the Brand’s abilities in real time to best suit the situation.
addons.title: With Tooth and Claw

addons.text: Your Inner Beast and Curse Manifest are one and the same, the spirit having a grudge against you, as usual; the Beast’s ways of harming and hampering your livelihood goes beyond Curses, too, as your powers and the control you have over them are additionally disrupted, instead of being a guide to maximize your abilities and growth, they stifle it, and causes complications and roadblocks along the line. Your Beast also exploits your connection to haunt and prey on your weakness and hang-ups, even looking forward to a moment when you’re caught off guard to take over and do what it takes to make your life as hard or miserable as possible, fulfilling their goal to fully take over and ruin every thing you held dear and more through corrupting your soul. You are essentially a match made in Hell, water and oil against one another. Any common ground or suitability you’d have as a normal Inner Beast is wiped clean, turning your Beast into an inner enemy you have to wrestle and tame. All of this doesn’t feel palatable, no? Well, there are a few benefits from this arrangement when and once you wrangle your Beast to shape: your available power and potential are double what could’ve been, your Beast’s sheer malice swelled your powers, which segues into another boon that is feeding from any negative emotion particularly those born from your Curse and how you feel about them further soaring your capabilities, and the resulting connection between your Beast resulting in being tainted by your Beast’s killer instinct and capacity for brutality. This means your turmoil and struggle are your greatest strength, giving you enough to put your Beast into submission. Protection Against Evil doesn’t lower your Beast’s hostility as much as it curbs the ways it can hurt and mess your day-to-day up, it’ll still try to make your life miserable and take over your body, but isn’t as crippling or significant, being easier to subdue your Beast this time.
addons.title: Inner Turmoil

addons.text:
Your Inner Beast and Curse Manifest are one and the same, with the solace it doesn’t have much hold of you if it weren’t for a timely intervention of Cure Curse. It’s good you got your Beast under control by it, it really did its job. Don’t let your guard down, however, as the risk of letting it grow and recover could spell disaster personally. It can’t take your body and soul, so small mercies, I’d say.

Your Inner Beast still has a large degree of animosity and certainly will screw up on guiding your powers to a detrimental or misleading direction or slightly disrupt your powers’ control, but there’s something different: you can talk things out, understand each other, and, finally, come to a conciliation with a part of yourself that has come to hate you. 

This, in kind, makes you regain your Inner Beast’s favor and full capabilities once you get through your Inner Beast’s “heart,” albeit with the caveat there’ll be some baggage they have to contend with and live through. This has the benefit of sourcing strength from your Curses without any ailments, feeding from your negative feelings and anyone around you, and a certain amount of power growth or cultivation. It might take a year to get to that point, but aside from the power and skill bump you get every time you make some headway at this, mending your ailing curses, and rebuilding some connection with your powers, it’ll be worth it.

Protection Against Evil facilitates an olive branch between you and your beast, halving your time from reconciling.
addons.title: Inner Conciliation

addons.text:
Well, aren’t you a match made in heaven? While your Beast and Curse are very same, still,  your efforts to embrace a part of you that, while prickly and could’ve torn your head off at any moment, remains with you regardless has done leaps and bounds to accept one another. You aren’t there yet, just close. It helps you’d be perfect for each other, seamlessly harmonizing save for your Beast’s initial animosity. 

Embracing your Beast blesses you not only with turning around your Curses but your powers as well, just as you recover Inner Beast’s capabilities, it also infuses your curses and blessings into your powers, as your Beast learns to control and shift how your Curses operate to your liking, for example, you can shift your Blessing of Green Thumb back to Black Thumb followed by channeling this through Seed of Yggdrasil and vice versa; your curses, your blessings, are now tools. This doesn’t stop from feeding from your Curses’ negativity, but also your Blessing’s positivity, finding nourishment in any kind of emotion in your surroundings. And what that means is it also turns Living Curse’s danger into a safety net, a union between you and your partner, your soul with theirs, fully synchronizing with your Inner Beast with powers such as manifesting your Beast through you or using the apex of your powers for a short time leaving you wrung dry afterward. You are all also a well-oiled machine, capably helping each other in matter in-and-out combat, both having each other’s backs.

Your Inner Beast’s relationship will be stronger than ever once you make peace and come back to each other’s embrace.

Protection Against Evil essentially wipes away the tension or animosity between you, turning it into a simple disagreement, something that still takes time to sort out, though it takes far less to come to a close.
addons.title: Inner Unity: A Real Connection

addons.text:
Your natural aptitude has perfected your already powerful bond with your Inner Beast. 

They can now physically manifest on their own, needing no effort nor strain nor even contribution on your part, able to manifest themselves independently. 

Your power condenses upon itself, your Inner Beast possessing its own version of your powers for its own use, which it can use in concert alongside your own to amplify them. 

And finally, your Inner Beast can act as a haven for you as you are for it. You can enter inside your Inner Beast’s inner world, where you can recuperate and spend time, your Beast’s inner world as perfect for you as your beast is for you. If you do die, as long as your Inner Beast lives you’ll resurrect inside your Inner Beast’s world.
addons.title: Inner Protector

addons.text:
Due to the nature of the Inner Beast, your ‘Familiar’ has been fused with it. While functionally this means the Inner Beast is in control of your OoP it also means it itself can not only modulate lit like your other powers but store it internally within you like it does.

This does however mean the beast is in complete control of the OoP’s functions and you must rely on it for these. Whether this takes the form of a summonable conduit or merely the OoP’s active effect depends on what best fits the specific item your Inner Beast has fused with.
addons.title: Un-Familiar

addons.text:
As the Inner Beast is the consolidated manifestation of your powers, it can facilitate and fulfil all the functions of your powers on its own, consolidating any other ‘residents’ that would otherwise be administrating your powers into itself. 

However, your Inner Beast can also be split into many, specialising these ‘lesser beasts’ for specific powers or aspects rather than being the sole responsibility of the one. These Lesser Beasts can be created to fulfil many specialised roles, but are all subordinate to the ‘Greater whole’ that makes up your Inner Beast.
addons.title: Huge Layoffs

objects.text:
Inside your soul another awakens, you gain a spirit embodying your powers. This spirit is a part of you and has an absolute and complete understanding of your powers, can you help learn your exact limits, help to train to surpass those limits, and help you maximize your performance as much as possible. 

They can communicate telepathically, manifest themselves before you as incorporeal and invisible to others, can take over and/or manifest through minions you have control over through master-like powers or can physically manifest in the real world. Physically manifesting will be tiring at first and cannot be held for long but over time will become easier till you can hold it permanently. 

They can also take over and continue a fight if you become incapacitated and may freely manifest in any inner world or dimension you have with no strain. Their personality, appearance, and every other aspect is perfectly suited for you and will change to continue to be as you change, as such they are the perfect friend, lover, teacher, and whatever else you wish and will never betray you. 

If you wish your inner beast may simply remain silent and improve your performance as much as possible.
objects.title: Inner Beast

objects.text:
While this ability doesn't give you the power to travel the multiverse, it does help make the transition easier. You can activate this ability either right before or during travel to a new universe. Doing so will allow you to send a small piece of yourself, a soul shard, ahead of the rest of you. You will be able to choose the specifics of this piece. Whether it's just your base personality, or even including restrained copies of some of your perks. Though this soul shard is too small to contain any of your actual powers. The soul shard acts as a beacon for your main soul to locate, allowing for a "reincarnation" into the new world.

After determining what to include in the soul shard, you can designate its destination. The ability to travel the multiverse determines whether it's a random or specific universe, but the personal details are your choice. This also applies to the time your main soul will arrive and fuse with your soul shard. By default this will be near the start of 'canon' but can be manipulated if you have other abilities that allow you to move through time. You can decide factors like the race or personality of the family into which you'll be born and when your main soul enters the new body. However, you cannot be born into a race that doesn't give birth or a race significantly more powerful than you. If the race your soul shard is born from is different, your new incarnation will possess the benefits and drawbacks of that race.

Once the soul shard enters the new world and is born, the specifics are mostly beyond your control. As a part of you, it will generally adopt your base personality and align with your actions in various situations. This facilitates a smoother social fusion upon your full self's arrival. However, the soul shard may act differently depending on its creation and if you assigned it specific goals or objectives to pursue before your complete self arrives.

When your main soul arrives, the soul shard seamlessly merges back into the whole without any negative effects on your main soul. The memories of your new life integrate easily into your mind. You have the ability to determine the level of realism these memories hold for you, whether they feel completely real or more detached, akin to watching a movie.
objects.title: Forward & Onward

addons.text:
Your patron knew you'd eventually try to copy them, it's only natural for a human to attempt to harness the power of a god. As such they've granted you a blessing such that you won't break under the strain of their power, and allow you to benefit one another more closely.

You've become the slightest bit divine, allowing you to synchronize with your patron more easily, and increasing the power of miracles they perform through you. Further, your status as a human who is linked to them has enhanced their ability to gather worship, as now any form of "worship" for either them or you can be harnessed.

Hero worship directed at you, devotion to causes you lead, and similar forms of faith will still produce usable faith for your patron despite not technically being linked to their religion, although the amount produced is lesser compared to direct devotion to the religion.
addons.title: Spark of Divinity

addons.text:
As a being blessed by divine patrons, you hold a unique position. Any god who takes a liking to you can become an additional patron, showering you with the weapons and blessings meant for their most devoted followers.

But if you possess the Divine Obsession this effect goes even further. These same gods will shower you with every blessing they can muster, ensuring your survival long enough to become theirs. And with Divine Obsession, you're not just the most blessed of your patron gods; you're THE blessed. You receive every blessing they can bestow without jeopardizing their chance at your affection.
addons.title: Divine Sugar Baby

addons.text:
Your Divine Patron is no longer a single god but an entire Pantheon—a collection of deities, spirits, or powerful entities united by shared purpose or history. While you may choose one as your primary patron, the one you are most closely attuned to, you are ultimately blessed and guided by all of them. As before, your connection allows you to enter the divine realm in your sleep or at will, but instead of communing with a lone deity, you now step into a celestial court where the gods gather. Each god may offer their own wisdom, boons, or challenges, and together, their power is far greater than that of a single divine being.

Rather than a single domain of influence, you receive multiple divine blessings from the various gods within your pantheon. One may grant you unmatched martial skill, another control over the elements, while yet another blesses you with prophetic insight or divine protection. Worship fuels not just one deity, but the entire pantheon, allowing their collective influence to shape the world.
addons.title: Pantheon’s Chosen Envoy

addons.text:
You are about to make all the other demigods jealous—because your divine parent didn’t follow the “neglectful godly parent” stereotype. In fact, they are your Divine Patron, and their bond with you is stronger than anything seen before. Unlike most demigods, who inherit only a fraction of their parent’s domain, you possess multiple facets of your parent’s authority, with your abilities naturally expanding over time. You do not age past a certain point, your mortal limitations are all but erased, and your presence alone carries the weight of true divinity, setting you apart from even the strongest demigods.

More than just power, however, you have something truly unheard of—a godly parent who actually cares and remains fully present in your life. Unlike other demigods who must beg for attention through prayer or omens, your parent watches over you constantly, their influence flowing through you like a second heartbeat. Their faith in you grants you immense favor, allowing them to act through you far more freely than they could through a normal champion. You are their chosen heir, and they will not allow you to falter.

Even beyond your personal growth, your presence strengthens your parent in ways no normal demigod ever could. The faith of mortals naturally gravitates toward them through you, spreading their influence faster than any priest or champion ever could hope to accomplish. Whether through awe, devotion, or fear, belief in them flourishes in your wake, granting them greater power and, in turn, granting you even more divine favor.
addons.title: Divine Progeny

addons.text:
You are not a simple Emanator, nor is your Pantheon composed of normal Gods. Rather, your Pantheon is the Imaginary Tree itself, the Aeons your Patrons, as if you were an Emanator for all of them. What boons you gain from an Aeon depends upon how well each one views you, yet you can be guaranteed that each will bestow at least a small boon and none will try to harm or sabotage you or your abilities.

Your Celestial Court’s nature as a neutral gathering place for the Aeons also presents an intended but immensely important opportunity, the ability to serve as a mediator amongst the Aeons. While some issues are likely beyond your ability to mediate a suitable agreement, you can at least get both sides to communicate and maybe even reach a temporary compromise in the event of an emergency.
addons.title: Speaker of the Tree

addons.text: Through eldritch magic you have contracted not a normal Deity, but a newborn Eldritch God. On one hand, you can now more easily and safely (for you) utilize Eldritch Magic, and your Patron possesses greater power, versatility, and a higher growth ceiling. On the other hand, not only is your Divine Patron a newborn with the maturity to match, but now all of your powers - and eventually your presence - carry traces of Eldritch power, which can be somewhat detrimental to others. Taking Godheart with this will amplify both the upsides and downsides, saturating your existence with Eldritch power for better or worse, and Divine Cultivation takes this to extreme levels.
addons.title: Patron of the Deep

addons.text:
Your Patron acknowledges you as their most devoted servant and zealot, earning more favor from them than you would've otherwise. By designating your Patron as your "Master", you gain a spark of their divinity alongside a grab bag of powers befitting a Nascent Champion of said deity. 

For example, if you serve a War Deity, you'd gain a physique and combat genius that puts even the strongest Super Soldier to shame, or if you serve a Love Deity, you'd gain beauty, charisma, and a silver tongue that can easily give you a following in the thousands. 

Though this is only the beginning, as by faithfully serving your deity, any gifts you receive and any surges in power they gain is increased exponentially. Which further elevates with your level of devotion. Your Patron is also far more likely to spoil you as a reward for such zealous service.
addons.title: Zealot

objects.text:
You will be connected to a benevolent higher being, with personality, tenets, gender, and appearance, up to you- as such things are easy enough to humor you with. 

They will select you as their champion and leader, entrusting you with the task of spreading their religion throughout the world.

As their champion, your mind will enter into the realm of the deity every time you fall asleep or request to be there while awake. They need your presence to act in the mortal world, conveying messages and energies through you.

The more followers they gain through worship, the stronger their influence. With enough people devoted to their cause, they can perform small miracles to protect and aid those loyal to their religion. The worship of an entire town will be enough to ward off an endbringer, while 90% of the population worshiping them could even take down an entity like Scion.
objects.title: Divine Patron

addons.text: ‘Your markings and sigils softly glow, radiating with power’ Your ability to enchant has been extended to your inscriptions. The abilities gained from the Brand and Bond have been enhanced to the same level your Enchantments can reach. Enchanting the brand & Bond itself is possible but outside your reach without dedicated training.
addons.title: Self-Improvement

addons.text: You may guide the development of enchantments that objects infused with Grand Enchant will develop more effectively. At first, your guidance will be based on your subconscious preferences, but in time you will be able to willfully manifest the enchantments of your desires through regular infusions.
addons.title: Smart Infusions

addons.text: The purity of your soul has empowered Grand Enchant's innate property of elevating the base quality of an object during infusion, granting a subtle and all-pervasive idealization effect on the base object's quality in terms of aesthetics, craftsmanship, and material that perfectly suits your subconscious preferences and desires. In addition, the enchantments of your infused objects will inherently possess a purifying property, enabling them to dispel, cleanse, and purify corruptive influences.
addons.title: Idealized Imbuement

addons.text: You may unlock new expressions of power in your enchanted objects upon reaching certain milestones of spiritual infusions, known as Armament Artes. These may take the form of active or passive effects based on the existing enchantments and your accomplishments with the infused object(s). You may improve the parameters of your Armament Artes through practice and through adversity.
addons.title: Armament Artes

addons.text:
Awakening the light of your soul has caused a unique interaction with Grand Enchant, converting it into your Semblance; and with it, the spiritual power that comes with Grand Enchant, doubling your starting Aura reserves, as well as its regeneration rate.

Not only that, but objects regularly infused with this Semblance will also be infused with your own Aura, optimizing them to their best possible form, as well as removing the need for maintainence and repairs.
addons.title: Auric Enchant

addons.text:
Your cursed energy has influenced Grand Enchant, converting it into the innate technique Desecration, allowing you to create customized Cursed Tools only you may wield. Objects empowered through this innate technique will not only have their combat-applicable effects amplified, but also become more effective against spiritual and psionic entities, or those who utilize such powers.

This also grants your cursed energy the trait of "Infusion", enabling you to create cursed tools without using your innate technique, allowing them to be wielded by others. However, there is a trade-off: there is a soft-cap to the potency of the cursed tools created via this method, limited by the base form of the tool and your own proficiency with manipulating cursed energy.
addons.title: Desecration

objects.text:
You possess the ability to permanently strengthen any object you can physically touch by imbuing it with your spirit. To support this power, you have a regenerating reservoir of spiritual energy that fuels your enchantments. Repeatedly infusing the same object with your power allows it to grow stronger without limit. However, such deeply bonded artifacts can only be used effectively by you.

Infused objects will develop enchantments linked to their form and function, usually biased towards simplistic combat-applicable effects. All enchanted objects will gain extreme durability and strong resistance to conventional physical forces, including impact, cutting, heat and cold, pressure, and shock, making them highly resistant to mundane damage, wear and tear, and natural environmental hazards.

Your spiritual reservoir grows through use of your power and especially through long-term bonds with your own enchanted equipment. Personal artifacts act as conduits and secondary reservoirs, feeding you energy and shaping how your power manifests. Stronger or more numerous bonded items grant greater passive benefits.

Some benefits will eventually become permanent and remain even without your gear equipped, such as heightened stamina, slower fatigue buildup, resistance to disease, toxins, and curses, and minor regeneration. With substantial gear resonance and practice, these advantages can expand to reduced or eliminated biological needs, slowed aging, enhanced physical condition, and survival in extreme environments, while the greatest boosts still arise from your bonded artifacts.
objects.title: Grand Enchant

addons.text: In addition to whatever your chosen element is, you also now have the added elements of the Avatar. Your control has now been expanded upon to include Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Energy, Lightning, Combustion, Blood, Ice, Steam, Cloud, Storm, Plants, Lava, Mud, Metal, Sand, Dust, Glass, Crystal, and Spirit and you possess the ability to, with time and effort, add additional elements to your repertoire. Any elements, concepts, or domains that you possess or can manipulate through any of your powers are also expanded to this power.
addons.title: Expanded Domain

addons.text: You no longer simply control your element; you embody it, and may now freely shift your own body back and forth as you wish into your element the way you would with a Logia. If your chosen Devil Fruit was a Logia, or a substance-controlling fruit, then the element or substance of your choice is added to Elementalism's scope.
addons.title: Embodiment

addons.text: You’re not just the concept of your element, not even the embodiment; you become the God of it by absorbing the Chaos Emeralds, either partially, temporarily, or permanently. Just like the Water God of Destruction, Chaos—every emerald you absorb alters your form, bestowing a godly boost in power and levels of access to Chaos Energy, which you can manipulate as easily as your element. By consuming all seven emeralds, you become Perfect, transforming into a deity worthy of reverence, fear, sacrifice, or whatever else. If you could easily flood an entire city before, now you can drown the entire continent and even the world in your wrath. The Chaos Energy within your veins makes the invulnerability of your form so absolute that even other gods cannot harm you, and decay in your presence at your will. You have complete control over your form in all seven states, sculpting their appearance as you wish, even to resemble godlike beings from the Sonic Universe based on your element.
addons.title: Perfect Chaos (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: You possess an incredibly potent conceptual tie to an element of your choice, this can be something as simple such one of the classical 4 such as Fire, more esoteric versions such as Metal, or even something completely unique such as Life. Your control over your chosen element is unmatched and can be expanded to encompass elements similar in scope, such as Earth is to Lava. From the moment you acquire this, you have complete control and mastery over your chosen element, being able to effortlessly create, summon, dismiss, shape, and control this element on an extraordinary scale, such as grand tsunamis or ferocious storms, and with such immense precision that you are not constrained to traditional limitations. You're able to just as easily create an intricate dress made of Metal as you would in summoning a tidal wave of Water. You are granted precise control over its every manifestation, from the gentlest breeze to the most intense inferno, and are incapable of being harmed by it. But most importantly, your ability extends beyond the physical realm. You have the knowledge and ability to use your chosen element conceptually, tapping into its symbolic representation and harnessing its metaphysical properties. You could utilize Fire to inflame passions, ignite creativity, drive others to anger, or use its connection to the sun, heat, and summer to create an everlasting summer.
objects.title: Elementalism

objects.text:
Your Soul has been brought before the weight of reality and withstood it, thus Igniting it. This Ignition allows you to produce and store Soul Energy in endless amounts inside your Soul. 

Soul Energy can be utilized in a nigh-endless amount of way with enough experience, these expressions of your Soul are known as Arts. Initially, you are able to condense your Soul into a weapon of your own design, this weapon can be used beyond to influence reality using the weight of your Soul. 

You are also able to infuse your body with your Soul Energy, increasing all of your physical and mental attributes tremendously. Infusing your body can delay your aging, eventually progressing to the point of immortality, replacing all your bodily and mental faculties with your Soul. 

The amount of Soul Energy you produce increases as you use your Soul and grows qualitatively as you perform incredible feats, each feat, also known as Soul Feats, grant you a new ability related to the experience. 

The ability gained can be active or passive, and truly heroic acts may even grant both.
objects.title: Ignited Soul

addons.text:
Your Demon and Angel forms have combined into an unholy abomination. Angels and Demons are known to cause, specifically in mortals who see them, primordial fear and madness. The inclusion of your demonic inheritance has changed your angelic form to be more eldritch, as your form includes more tentacles and eyes than normal. Instead of causing conflict with the two energies now running through your form, this has instead bolstered them to be further enhanced. If just having a soul and demonic energy made your body a nuclear reactor, then the inclusion of an angel's grace has made your very being a reactor equivalent to the sun in potency. You retain your ability to access both your Angel form and your Demon form. You also gain access to unique forms such as Samael, the angel of death and the serpent that Lucifer took, which was described as a dragon.

Let there be light: You have acquired the ability to shape reality in the same way that the universe did. Similar to Samael, when he was still an angel, he created stars and was thenceforth known as the Lightbringer. While you can create virtually anything with this, you find creating holy fire and hellfire to be the easiest things to produce. You were present during the birth of the universe, and the secrets of creation are yours to change and bend to your whim. Concepts and secrets are nothing in your presence.

The root of all evil: You command sin, and with the seven deadly sins, each one grants you a power related to the sin.
