You are a well of pure corruptive energy, being able to release a mud-like substance that contains the very essence of corruption and all the world's evil that can change others into evil versions of themselves that are loyal only to you, as the corruptive energy makes them stronger than they were before. However, you don't need to use the mud/corruptive energy, as just being in your presence can corrupt those near you. This energy can also be used to create monsters and demons loyal to you; this can be done by molding their souls or by doing nothing at all. The more evil that exists in the world, the more powerful you become.

Additionally, you gain the powers, abilities, and memories of one Lucifer Morningstar, Samael, the Lightbringer, the king of lies, the prince of darkness, and the originator of sin. However, this will not change you as a person. Optionally, this comes with an empty pocket dimension that houses all the souls that you have taken and those who are evil. Should you be killed, you will reform in this pocket dimension, and the only way to truly kill you would be to kill you inside it. This pocket dimension can be shaped to your whims.
addons.title: Morningstar

objects.text:
You are a Cambion. Specifically, a hybrid between a human and a demon, making you half-human and half-demon, the half-step between human and demon. You are not bound by the normal weaknesses of either race and still keep a soul that is natural to humans and can no longer be kept at bay via faith, holy water, salt, or any other stereotypical weakness of a demon. Your body has been enhanced so that you could take down a continent with barely any effort, tank hits from a nuclear bomb without a scratch, most weapons made by mortals cannot harm you, and you have virtually infinite stamina. You require no food, water, or oxygen to stay alive. You also have senses stronger than those of the most perceptive animal. You do not age; the only way to die would be through someone killing you.

Your demonic powers are vast and many, including but not limited to: biokinesis, electrokinesis, invisibility, pyrokinesis, thermokinesis, telepathy, mental manipulation, soul reading and manipulation, demonic energy manipulation, teleportation, terrakinesis, voice mimicry, weather manipulation, regeneration, telekinesis, and low-level reality manipulation. However, your abilities are powered by your demonic energy, which is enhanced by your human heritage and soul, allowing you to do anything with demonic energy, including wish-granting so long as it's within your power and making contracts or deals for people's souls. However, it doesn't have to be just souls that you can make deals with; you can take virtually anything, so long as the deal is upheld.

You can be summoned by those trying to summon demons. However, it is your choice if you wish to be summoned or not. You will only get a mental message that someone is trying to summon you.

The more time that passes, the stronger you get. You feed on the souls and worship of humans, growing your power the more faith or souls you consume, and your own souls react to your demonic energy, acting like a superconductor and supercharging your powers. While you are still alive, you maintain human and Demon forms that are around ten times stronger than your human form. Once you die, you can possess humans until you regain your physical form. Your demon form is a multidimensional form that takes the appearance of your sins and is an energy being in nature when physical. This form can also take the appearance of black smoke when non-physical, which allows for the possession of humans.
objects.title: Cambion

addons.text:
Your mastery of the bow intertwines with a deeper connection to the natural flow of existence, your archery transcends mere skill and becomes a manifestation of balance, harmony, and intention. Each shot you take embodies the rhythm of the universe, turning your arrows into extensions of its infinite flow. No longer just weapons, your arrows become vessels of cosmic precision, striking with purpose and inevitability, guided by the natural order itself.

Your ability to transmute matter into bows and arrows is now enhanced by the Dao’s effortless action. The transformation becomes second nature, as if the world itself offers its materials for your use. Magical arrows created from your energy are imbued with the Dao’s essence, making them far more efficient and precise. Each arrow flows with the inevitability of water following its path, striking with unparalleled accuracy and force, as if the Dao itself guides your aim. Even the most chaotic elements bend to your will, allowing you to craft arrows of rare and esoteric energy with greater ease.

Your mastery of archery fuses seamlessly with the Dao’s principles. Each draw of the bow and release of the arrow becomes a meditation in motion, a physical manifestation of balance and focus. As your connection to the Dao deepens, your arrows begin to defy the constraints of time and space, striking not just where the target is but where it will be, as if the Dao’s flow allows you to see the moment of impact before it occurs.

In combat, your movements are fluid and unshakable, blending physical strikes with bowmanship in perfect harmony. By channeling the Dao, your body withstands the strain of godlike feats, allowing you to fire an unceasing torrent of arrows or a single shot that holds the power of a celestial storm. Your arrows no longer need to hit physical targets to be effective—they can sever intentions, pierce illusions, or dissipate harmful energies, all while maintaining their grace and precision.

At its peak, this synergy allows you to unleash the Infinite Arrow, a shot that embodies the Dao’s boundlessness. It is not a single projectile but the potential of countless strikes, able to alter the flow of battle, reshape landscapes, or bring divine entities to their knees. This ultimate expression of archery is an act of transcendence, not destruction, as each shot aligns the world closer to harmony.
addons.title: Shè Dào Zhī Hé Xié - Harmony of the Archer's Way

objects.text: Bowmanship is an unappreciated art in these modern times, and you can put the Heroes of Old and even the Gods to shame. Your skill with a bow has transcended its human limits and breached into the realm of the supernatural. You can transmute any loose physical matter into the shape of an effective and usable bow and/or arrows. Using the magical energy within you, you can replace the need for physical arrows, creating magical arrows that are incredibly efficient, shattering boulders with minimal amounts of energy. There is no limit to the number of arrows you can cast at once; you are only limited by the number of physical arrows you can hold or the magical energy to create arrows. Creating arrows of various elements is not beyond you, although more esoteric elements are exceedingly difficult. You can use the magical energy inside of you to strengthen your body to withstand the amount of strain it would take to put down Gods. As a master of bowmanship is not useless without their bow, you can blend archery and physical combat into a fluid style. You will be able to create magical arrows that hold nigh-infinite amounts of magical energy.
objects.title: Aspect of Archery

addons.text:
You are either a direct child or legacy of Inari Okami, the Shinto goddess of foxes, fertility, rice, tea, sake, agriculture, industry, and prosperity and good harvest's. As one of Inari's Children or Descendants, you have the potential to transcend the typical nine tails of a kitsune and reach a fabled tenth tail, granting you the right to ascend to godhood. 

Inari watches over you closely, far more than the Greek and Roman gods do with their own offspring. Throughout your life as a kitsune, you’ll gain nine tails, and with each tail, you’ll grow in power and mastery. When you finally reach the ninth, only a great deed, quest, or meaningful sacrifice can unlock your tenth tail. Upon this transformation, each of your tails will embody a major domain, while each major domain will branch into secondary and tertiary minor domains.

As Inari’s child or legacy, your kitsune powers and magic are far stronger than those of others. You will also be able to transform into both a small fox and a giant fox. Because of Japan's early beliefs about Inari, you will have a slight connection to swordsmiths and merchants. Additionally, you’ll gain privileged access to Inari’s Personal Realm of Foxes, a sanctuary for kitsune and Inari’s followers, where you can come and go as you please.

Your progression to godhood will be quicker than that of most kitsune, earning you each tail at an accelerated rate. Upon reaching the tenth tail, your blood will turn to ichor, the golden blood of the gods, granting you immunity from most mortal needs and protections against common harm. You will gain a profound connection to your domains, bolstering your resilience and bestowing a form of immortality. Free from the divine rules that bind most gods, you’ll also enjoy near immunity to manipulation by time, fate, and destiny—though not complete freedom from their influence. You will become mostly similar to the Gods of Percy Jackson. 

As a Kitsune you have gained the ability to Fast Travel anywhere a Torii Gate resides, even in other worlds.
addons.title: Blood of Inari

objects.text:
You have acquired the physiology of a Kitsune, commonly referred to as a  Fox Spirits. You start with a single tail, which grants you the fundamental abilities all Kitsune share. These abilities include but are not limited to, the power to change your form by altering your shape. Your Kitsune heritage also provides access to magic. This magic can be utilized for various purposes limited only by your imagination; dark magic, nature manipulation, and cursing enemies are among the more straightforward applications, including the ability to fly. 

Additionally, your Kitsune lineage endows you with powers over illusion and insanity inducement. You possess the ability to absorb and manipulate life force, enabling you to give and take life energy for your purposes and accelerate the process of gaining new tails. Other abilities include possession and inducing sleep, along with the capacity to manipulate the dreams of others. Furthermore, you possess a supernatural intelligence that increases with age.

You possess immense strength, capable of easily destroying a city, and your durability allows you to withstand an explosion directly or endure attacks of comparable force. Your Foxfire can incinerate anything and will remain lit as long as you will it to exist. You require neither sleep nor food to survive. Your sense of smell is so acute that you can detect every scent within a city identify between the odours of individual people, and discern when they are lying or unwell. Similarly, your sense of hearing is highly developed, and you possess superior night vision.

Your powers increase with each tail you acquire; you gain one tail for every 100 years you live, with the ninth tail requiring  1,000 years. Each new tail doubles your existing powers and grants you new abilities. For instance, upon obtaining your ninth and final tail, you will gain control over space and time, and reality manipulation. Additionally, you have the option to become any species of kitsune. Examples include, but are not limited to, Tengoku, Tricksters, Kukan, Kaze, and many others.
objects.title: Kitsune

objects.text:
You belong to an offshoot of an ancient and recluse race, the Yuki Onna. Yuki Onna are a race of yōkai that can instinctively control supernatural snow and ice that cannot be melted by normal mortal fire. You are particularly powerful, able to wield snow on a scale as to freeze a small town on a moment's notice, and so precise and skilled as to recreate an entire village down to the most minute details with no more effort than blinking. As a side effect all your other powers, if you have any, will rise to match the instinctive control and strength of this if possible. You can continue to grow this over time

A traditionally almost entirely female race, your offshoot seems to have resolved this issue through the result of interactions with humans generations ago, resulting in your population not needing to follow the strange practices that the original race had to make sure they survive. As a result of this you’ve been granted incredible control over the development of your offspring, enabling you to choose whatever they inherit from you and any other parent, whether gender, appearance, disposition, or even powers based on genetics. They will all be perfectly healthy and free of any diseases, genetic or otherwise, and unless you wish it otherwise, will be the most perfect version of themselves they can be. As a bonus this also makes you the perfect parent, granting you the supernatural skill and knowledge on how to make every single right decision in raising them and the ability to follow through with it. 

If you wish, you may take a small village of 200 of the same race as you to take as free followers. They will all possess the Yuki Onna power, and if you wish, you may also impart on them any other ability you possess that is a result of a race or species. All members of this village, and any children you have as well, will be perfectly loyal.
objects.title: Yuki Onna

addons.text:
Reincarnating endlessly can grow tiresome, the cycle repeating with each new life, carrying all your experiences and knowledge. Now, you have the choice to break free from this monotony. Upon reincarnating, you can opt to start with a true blank slate, where your new self has no memories of past lives, and your true self remains dormant. Even forces like fate will recognize your new self as a completely separate individual, with no connection to your original soul. Everything to do with your true self will remain hidden and outside the reach of such cosmic forces unless you choose otherwise.

You can influence how your new self will be, including what they will reincarnate as, their personality, talents, ambitions, and whether they inherit any of your powers or abilities, such as the increased potential gained from each reincarnation. Alternatively, you can choose to have your true self remain conscious, watching and subtly influencing your reincarnations, guiding their choices, and even granting them your powers whenever you wish. If your true self is dormant, you can set a condition for when it will awaken, such as after a specific number of reincarnations or when your new self is in great distress or danger. You can then choose to fully take over your reincarnated self when the condition triggers or simply awaken within them, secretly helping from the inside or revealing your true self to offer guidance without fully taking control of your shared soul. As the true self of your soul, you can take full control of your reincarnated selves at any time, overriding their will and actions.

Additionally, you can fully conceal the true nature and powers of your soul from being detected. No one, not even your reincarnated selves, will uncover the extraordinary aspects of your soul, as you can perfectly mimic the appearance of an ordinary soul. This ability extends to anyone trying to sense or interact with your soul, ensuring its true essence remains hidden unless you choose to reveal it. When reincarnating into different worlds, your soul will adapt seamlessly, mimicking the traits and nature of the inhabitants so perfectly that you will become indistinguishable from them. Even the gods or universal systems of the realm will see you as a native of the world and treat you as such, completely unaware of your true nature.

When your reincarnated self dies, you can choose to assimilate everything they have gained or become into your true self, growing more powerful with each reincarnation, with the impact on how this influences you being entirely up to you. You can set this to happen automatically while your true self remains dormant, allowing for a completely new reincarnation slate to be born repeatedly. Alternatively, you can choose to allow a specific reincarnated self to reincarnate again as many times as you wish, carrying their past memories, and unaware of why they are being reborn. You can also invite your reincarnated selves to become observers with you, watching your new selves’ lives unfold together, or, when the time comes, you take control of the cycle once again.
addons.title: Novus Cyclus

addons.text:
If you fail to escape Hell within a year, your original body is permanently lost, meaning you forfeit your chance to return to life in that form. However, your cycle of Reincarnation remains intact—you will still be reborn, but to do so, you must now escape Hell first. Time in Hell and the real world no longer move in sync when this happens. Whether it takes you a century or a millennium to climb the Tower, your reincarnation will still take place within 5 to 10 years of your original death.

Everything you achieve in Hell—every power gained, every skill honed, every battle survived—solidifies into your potential. While you won’t be born with your full strength immediately, your body will naturally grow into it over time, guaranteeing that by adulthood, you will regain and possibly surpass everything you once had.

Additionally, no matter what happens, while you are in it, Hell will always protect you. As long as you are within its domain, no foreign force—no gods, no eldritch beings, no meddling outsiders—can interfere with your trials. Your personal Hell remains sealed off from external influence, ensuring that only you, the Tower, and Hell’s own denizens shape your fate.
addons.title: Hell and Back… Again

objects.text:
Death is not the end for you. After every death, you will awaken in a new body, starting a new life as a baby. The gap between your death and rebirth is somewhere between 5 to 10 years. When you are reborn, your abilities are temporarily suppressed due to your newborn body not being able to hold them. As you grow and train, your power will naturally be released and its potential will be increased, allowing it to grow stronger than it could before. You can forcefully unseal it, at the cost of damaging your body and potential.

You will usually reincarnate into the children of those your karma is connected to; for example, being reincarnated as the child of your enemy, or perhaps your own descendant. However, this doesn't mean that you'll possess their body; rather, a new child will be born specifically for your rebirth. If you wish, you can simply choose to reincarnate into someone completely random as well. Reincarnating as something other than a human is an option as well. You can choose when you wish to stop reincarnating. If you have Homecoming, then you can choose to reincarnate in a different world.
objects.title: Reincarnation

addons.text: Now you can store the souls of the recently deceased animals inside your Soul Garden, greatly pacifying them, allowing you to hold an unlimited amount of souls and massively increasing the amount you can borrow power from at once.
addons.title: Shepherd of Souls

objects.text: You can absorb the souls of recently deceased animals. By doing so you can gain various enhancements and after a while you may even gain a unique power related to the animal. The amount of spirits you can hold is dependent on your willpower and the compatibility between animals, if you do not meet the necessary requirements you will go mad, acting on instinct alone.
objects.title: Animal Spirit

objects.text: You can contract living beings to become your familiars. Familiars gain a general boost in all areas and continue to grow and evolve at the same rate you do, gaining new abilities and powers as time passes. If you have a form of magic or other energy, they gain a new ability for whichever element they are most attuned to. You can, if you’re powerful enough, store your familiar in your soul, allowing them to bathe in your energy, increasing their rate of growth even further as well as increasing their affinity towards any energies or elements you may have access to. These familiars are extremely loyal and will never betray you.
objects.title: Familiar Contract

objects.text:
You now find yourself with a powerful Guardian Angel, forever unconditionally committed to your protection, and this bond can never be broken under any influence, not even yours.

This highly intelligent and sentient being has the potential to develop a distinct personality if you so allow it. A telepathic link connects you both effortlessly, enabling seamless communication across any distance. The physical manifestation of your Guardian Angel adapts to your aesthetic preferences while aligning its morals and worldview with yours.

With a conceptual link to protection, this entity will always surpass your capabilities by a factor of 25 in every conceivable way, with an enhanced passive growth that further strengthens it the more its abilities are utilized. This entity also has six unique abilities dedicated to ensuring your safety:

Elemental Manipulation: The capacity to fully conjure and manipulate one of the four main elements (fire, earth, water, air) of your choosing.

Divine Shields: The ability to instantly summon nigh-impregnable opaque shields of varying sizes and shapes.

Unseen Retribution: The power to turn invisible and undetectable by all except yourself.

Healing Touch: Proficiency in healing and rejuvenation—able to mend wounds, cure diseases, and fully restore lost limbs and damaged internal organs within minutes.

Flight Of The Valkyrie: The ability to soar through the skies, effortlessly gliding and levitating. Their flight speed can escalate from stillness to hypersonic in seconds, all while maintaining exceptional maneuverability. The existence of actual wings is left up to you.

Sword of Absolution: A pure manifestation of the concept of protection, acting as your Guardian Angel's strongest trump card. Its sharpness intensifies with the degree of danger towards you, reaching a point where it can irreversibly cut through anything.

Free from the need for sustenance and immune to fatigue, your Guardian Angel, if vanquished, retreats into your soul for a 24-hour regeneration period before reappearing again at full capacity. While naturally inclined to be in your proximity 24/7, it is at your command to faithfully fulfill any other tasks you require. If the host has died, the Guardian Angel has 24 hours to resurrect them, or they will perish as well.
objects.title: Guardian Angel

addons.text: ‘A rose rests on your pectoral, each blooming petal itself inscribed with a god’s symbol, faintly glowing’ Beloved as you are, Gods would loathe to lose contact with you. Utilising your bond, they’ll never have to. Thanks to the Brand and Bond, you can now have a god’s symbol inscribed upon you. Using this sigil, you can call and signal them no matter where you may be, so that they can lend aid, make deals, and extend their influence, however local or temporary.
addons.title: Divine Messenger

addons.text:
As the Beloved of the Gods, and bearing the Curse of the Zealot, you have accomplished the impossible: you have made the gods themselves worship you. This  shift has resulted in several significant changes.

One notable change is that all gods you encounter are now compelled to bestow upon you a minor blessing, such as an enhanced talent for home care from Hestia. However, this also brings a major drawback: the Curse of the Zealot expands to affect the worshipers of the gods who now also revere you.
addons.title: Worthy Of Worship

addons.text:
As the Beloved of the Gods, and bearing the Curse of the Yandere Lover, you have achieved the impossible: you have made all the gods you have met, and those you will meet, completely obsessed with you. As a result, these gods will go to great lengths to isolate you from other gods. Some, like Loki, may even resort to initiating wars with other pantheons in their desperate attempts to keep you by their side.

On the brighter side, these same gods will bless you with all you can handle to ensure you stay alive long enough to become theirs.
addons.title: Divine Obsession

objects.text:
Gods, spirits, eldritch beings, and other supernatural entities often treat mortals as tools, pawns, or prey. For reasons even they struggle to explain, you are an exception.

Supernatural beings tend to find you unusually appealing. Whether it is curiosity, admiration, affection, or simple fascination, entities far beyond the mortal world often take a liking to you. Even beings that normally view humanity with indifference or outright hostility are inclined to treat you with unexpected warmth.

You may invoke the name of a supernatural being and request an audience. More often than not, they will humor you with conversation so long as you approach them without hostile intent. These meetings can range from casual discussions and shared knowledge to genuine friendships with beings far beyond the mortal world.

Gods and spirits that take a liking to you may offer aid, gifts, blessings, artifacts, or guidance simply because they want to. Some may treat you as a favored mortal or champion, while others may simply enjoy your company.

Relationships with such beings are also possible. Friendly conversations, companionship, romance, and even fleeting encounters with divine or supernatural entities are all within the realm of possibility if mutual interest exists. Throughout myth, gods frequently formed personal relationships with mortals they favored, sometimes granting them gifts, protection, or even immortality.

This ability does not grant you control over supernatural beings, nor does it guarantee their help. However, your presence tends to intrigue them, and once a god, spirit, or cosmic entity becomes fond of you, they may continue to watch over or occasionally meddle in your life simply because they like you.

Supernatural beings often compete for your attention, occasionally leading to rivalries between gods, spirits, or eldritch entities who all consider you “theirs.”

Even entities that despise humanity will usually refrain from harming you unless you deliberately provoke them. Their hostility toward humanity may remain unchanged, but you will often be treated as a rare exception.
objects.title: Beloved of the Gods

objects.text:
You have been chosen by a god to be its vessel in the mortal world. This means that you will be given access to the god's powers, albeit with certain conditions.

You may decide who this god is, and there's no limit as to which god has chosen you as its avatar. You can talk with the god, and they can speak with you no matter where you are. They can also appear to you in visions and dreams. However, the stronger the god, the more obligations you will have to deal with, and the higher the risk and restrictions their commands will impose on you. What the god commands you to do varies based on the god's divinity and personality.

How much of the god's power you can channel at each moment depends on the god, so they can make you weaker or even equal to them depending on their mood. However, fear not, as the god will never lower your powers in a way that would get you seriously harmed or killed.

The powers of the god that has chosen you vary based on their divinity and the setting from which the god came. Gods are immortal, though their kind of immortality varies. Most are capable of blessing others with good fortune, protecting them from harm, giving curses, manipulating the elements, being in multiple places at the same time, manipulating aspects of reality such as space or time, resurrecting the dead, creating life, and more. Some of the gods you can host include, but are not limited to: Thor, Poseidon, Tsukuyomi, Shiva, Morrigan, Anubis, and Nezha.

You will be able to live your daily life without hassle. However, whenever the god wishes or commands you, you must fulfill its demands. The god won't control you against your wishes, and you are not obligated to fulfill its commands. But if you don't, you will be unable to access its powers and will receive visions and dreams of a pissed god demanding you comply. The god's demands will never be something you cannot accomplish.
objects.title: Avatar of the Divine

objects.text:
Now existing in a state between life and death, you are an immortal being, perpetually maintaining a pale youthful appearance. You don't feel pain, and you are impervious to all forms of injuries, with your flesh, organs, and bones seamlessly mending themselves almost instantaneously, regardless of severity. This bizarre condition also extends to grant you full control over your movements and an impeccable sense of balance, enabling you to initiate any action with utmost efficiency. But your power doesn't end there.

You can instantly summon and dismiss a weightless Scythe, its aesthetic appearance tailored to your preferences. A pure manifestation of your soul, this weapon is indestructible, with sharpness that allows it to cut through nearly anything, but its true power lies in the supernatural ability to steal the souls of those it kills. 

When your Scythe claims a living being, you are presented with two choices regarding their soul. You can either fully siphon the soul for yourself, enhancing your physical attributes based on the strength of the soul, with this self enhancing cycle having no limits, or summon/dismiss the soul into the physical realm as a perfectly loyal servant. These servants retain their powers, skills, experiences, and memories intact from before their demise at your hands. There are no limits to the number of servants you can command, and if vanquished you can summon them again after 24 hrs.

Also whether through your connection to the after-life, or something else entirely, you have the power to manipulate the speech of others. This control extends to muting them, compelling them to speak words of your choosing, or even making them converse in an entirely different language. The targeted individuals find themselves entirely unable to control their mouths and tongues, compelled to move or remain still according to your will.

You start off with the physical attributes of an ordinary human being.
objects.title: Deathlord

addons.text: Your stream isn’t any ordinary stream, but one hosted by a dokkaebis, designed to display humans to constellations. Constellations are inhabitants of the Star Stream. They are extremely powerful beings who have been immortalized in the history of humanity. The constellations vary between mythic heroes, great sages, mythological creatures, spirits and ancient gods. Some humans become constellations when they die due to the fame of their stories. Constellations are ascended incarnations and are the more powerful of the two types of scenario participants. They have immense Statuses and a large number of high-level Stories. Constellations can sponsor coins to you through your channel if you impress them, and even can form sponsor contracts with you. This allows the constellation to grant you their own stigmas, powers gained through stories, however you can only have one sponsor contract with a constellation at once. To unlock your constellation’s stigmas, you need to complete their Persona Story, a mini quest based of the story your stigmas will be based off. You yourself can become a constellation upon gaining five Stories, each of which must be Historical grade rank at minimum, which essentially means the story will go down in history.
addons.title: Star Stream (ORV)
Astral Tapestry
addons.text:
For eons, trillions of conscious beings have looked up at the night sky and painted the dark expanse with their hopes, fears, and stories. The stars are the universe's greatest canvas, holding the collective beliefs, myths, and legends of every civilization that has ever lived.

By marrying this truth with your unique affection for the stars and your capacity to serve as a vessel for these constellations, the cosmos has willingly lent you the stories they have been told.

As your cosmic map spans the entirety of the known universe, you are in no way limited to human astrology. You possess the authority to invoke the forgotten mythologies of long-dead alien empires and the stellar pantheons of galaxies millions of light-years away.

You might veil your movements in the conceptual shadow of an alien constellation known as "The Devouring Maw," erasing your presence entirely from the fabric of reality, or find the best solution for a problem by enforcing the intent of a nebula dubbed "The Great Thinker" by an ancient civilization.

Furthermore, you will be able to switch at will between the power granted by these constellations so long as they are present in the night sky above you, granting you vast versatility in any situation.

objects.text:
It is said that when heroes and deities in ancient myths and legends perform extraordinary feats, constellations are formed in their honor. You have been chosen by one such constellation to be its avatar, allowing you to tap into the power and influence that this celestial symbol represents.

The chosen avatar status grants one the ability to access unique and powerful abilities that reflect the characteristics and attributes of the specific constellation they were chosen by. For instance, if the chosen constellation is the Ursa Major, the avatar may possess the ability to transform into a bear, or summon seven servants at will. One other example could be the constellation of Aquarius, which is commonly associated with water. As the water carrier of the zodiac, an avatar chosen by the Aquarius constellation could have the ability to manipulate and control water, creating waves, fountains, and even transforming into water itself. Additionally, Aquarius is known for its humanitarian spirit, so an avatar could also have the power to heal and protect those in need.

The range of abilities one can acquire depends entirely on the mythology and legends associated with the chosen constellation.
objects.title: Beloved of the Stars

addons.text: You’ve become the gravitational center of the Omniverse, drawing in forces from every dimension, timeline, and reality. But there’s something unique about the way they are drawn to you—it's not just power they seek. There's a deep, subtle connection that forms as they enter your orbit, a magnetic pull that they can’t resist. In your presence, something within them shifts, and they find themselves drawn to you in ways they can’t fully comprehend. They don’t merge with you, but they are irrevocably shaped by the bond, carrying pieces of your essence within them. This connection doesn’t just change their path—it transforms their very nature, as if they’ve been touched by something greater than themselves. Over time, this bond deepens, weaving an intricate tapestry of mutual influence, where their existence is forever intertwined with yours. In this way, the forces evolve, not out of sheer will, but because they’ve been subtly and profoundly marked by you—changed by something beyond their control, something that runs through them like an unseen thread. It’s not love in the simplest sense, but an undeniable force that alters them forever, as they continue to move through the Omniverse, forever touched by the pull of your presence.
addons.title: Obsessively Adored

objects.text:
Many across the omniverse have claimed Fate to be on their side, and some are even accurate. These people, the blessed, often end up with incredible fortune or power or skill, usually a mixture of those three or one in extreme measure. Examples you may know would be Naruto Uzumaki, Yujiro Hanma, Ichigo Kurosaki, Monkey D. Luffy, Ainz Ooal Gown, Reinhard van Astrea; it could be said that these men are the apples of Fate's elusive eye.

On the minor, small, inconsequential level that these singular universes operate on, it may even be true to say so; but you, you are so much more. You have caught the eye of a far greater creature, the personification of the concept of Fate, the one in whom all those smaller ones are modelled after and or take power from.

 Fate loves you, truly, absolutely and fully. You and you alone hold its heart, and as such, it will do all it can to help and appease you; the world will fall at your feet, and power will be fed to you.

This manifests as a sort of omnipresent luck, everything will go your way even if it doesn’t look like it in the short term. Probability is also skewed in your favor as a natural consequence; for example, if a super serum only has a 0.001% chance of not killing the user, you can treat it as an absolute certainty that you will survive and almost certainly have some beneficial mutation or power never before seen from the serum.

If a thing is possible (sometimes even if it isn’t), it’ll happen for you. Drop a coin? Oh, don’t worry, the love of your life has your back. That coin will hit a piece of ground at just the right angle so it lands perfectly back into your pocket. An enemy is about to catch you unaware while you sleep? Well, don’t worry, a bug flies directly into their path, causing them to slip and stab themselves through the heart, and the fall also causes them to hit their phone perfectly so it resets their lock feature, or they have the scroll/letter from their boss still in their unsullied pocket.

Your luck is so good that any enemy you face will receive innumerable disasters, and they will surely die before meeting you. This applies to any enemy you might face, including threats on the levels of Entities or above.
objects.title: Fate's Favored

objects.text: The spark of your being is not easily hidden or suppressed. Your soul is unique, not necessarily brighter or stronger, but capable of aligning with your conscious desires. It can assist you in pushing your limits during a final attack or hardening to withstand an assault. This aid is so significant that a ritual that typically requires a portion of the soul can be performed with just the natural energy loss from yours or an attack that would normally kill a soul would instead put you in a coma state from the pain, but the soul will not be destroyed and, in a case where it would, it could even be "healed", given enough time and the rest of you being alive. Initially, your soul will be more influenced by unconscious desires or extreme emotions. However, with time and experimentation, you can fine-tune your control and even "train" your soul to respond more effectively and automatically. This process works best after experiencing a variety of intense stimuli, such as moments of high stress or deep emotional experiences. Beyond resilience, your soul learns from the skills you master, subtly adjusting itself to improve energy flow, increase ritual efficiency, and enhance spiritual techniques. With enough refinement, your soul becomes not just a passive essence but an active force, instinctively optimizing itself to support your survival, power, and growth.
objects.title: Malleable/Smart Soul

objects.text:
For reasons beyond comprehension, the essence of omniversal pain has chosen you as its singular obsession.

This unconditional love manifests in a simple way. Any act intended to harm you, whether physical or mental, regardless of the perpetrator's intent, nature, or attempts to conceal it—whether by a sentient being or an inanimate object, regardless of their power or origins—will be immediately confronted with the pure essence of pain. The likelihood of the act succeeding in harming you directly correlates with the intensity and paralyzing effect of the pain experienced by the perpetrator. This pain can reach such excruciating levels that even entities incapable of even comprehending pain will pass out instantly upon experiencing it. If, by some divine miracle, they manage to wound you, the primordial fury of pain will descend upon them. This pain will transcend flesh and bone, soul and mind, affecting all members of their species. The only way to stop this ever-present curse is through the death of the perpetrator or the extermination of their entire species. The pain entity can differentiate between malicious harm and benevolent acts; for example, a doctor performing surgery to improve your health will not be subjected to pain.

This phenomenon virtually has no range; as long as you are in your local omniverse, this concept will always accompany you. In normal circumstances, the pain will start to subside when the harmful act towards you diminishes. You may also plead with the primordial entity to dismiss the pain, which it will do on most occasions only if it believes you can manage the threat involved.
objects.title: Benevolence Of Primordial Agony

objects.text:
By making a promise, be it to yourself or another, you can gain power. This usually manifests as a boost to your existing abilities; however, if the promise is strong enough, you can even gain new abilities from it. The powers you gain are intricately tied to the nature of the promise you make, weaving a mystical bond between your word and your potential.

For example, if you solemnly swear to protect someone, you might find your physical strength and agility vastly enhanced, allowing you to become their steadfast guardian. A vow to never utter a lie could grant you an uncanny ability to detect falsehoods in others, making you an unparalleled judge of character. If you promise to master a new skill, you might experience accelerated learning and perfect recall, absorbing knowledge with supernatural speed.

Making a promise with another person amplifies the effect, providing a greater boost compared to making a promise with yourself. This is because it adds a limitation: you lose the enhancement if the person to whom you made the promise dies.

To mitigate this risk, you can make the same promise to multiple people. Vowing to protect a group of friends, for example, spreads the dependency across several lives. The power you derive would only turn against you if all members of the group were lost, allowing you to maintain your enhanced abilities while diversifying the risk. However, this has its own limitations, as the power gained will be far weaker.

The consequences of breaking a promise or losing the person to whom you made it are dire. Failure to keep your word, or the death of the person bound by your promise, results in the power you gained turning on you.

In certain situations, depending on the nature of the promise, there might be variations in the consequences. For example, if a promise is designed to end or start after the death of either party, the outcomes can differ. If your promise was meant to end upon the death of the person you made it to, the power would simply vanish without any adverse effects. On the other hand, if the promise was intended to begin after their death, the power will start strong, and will slowly weaken, gradually becoming a curse if not completed.

Successfully fulfilling a promise brings a different outcome. If you complete a promise, you will not be cursed. Instead, you will retain the boost you gained, solidifying the enhancement as a permanent part of your abilities. This may not apply to all promises, as some cannot be completed, such as “I will never lie”. Promises that cannot be completed tend to be stronger.
objects.title: Promise Me

addons.text:
Gods, magic, ritual. All of these things are deeply intertwined, with no way to tell which makes the others. The gods gain power from the rituals, and the rituals gain power from the gods. 

Your occult ritual magic can now function as Rites, letting your Patron shape and empower the magic. The results and changes will be based on who you have as your patron. With say Zeus your magic may function through the sky, and be more effective when used in the pursuit of justice. 

You may also use your occult rituals to empower, and even grant yourself boons. Be wary though, as some patrons would be less than excited about their servants taking power without direct blessing, though your ritual includes some sort of sacrifice that would go a long way towards keeping them happy.
addons.title: Divine Rituals

objects.text:
You inherited a technique known as Rites. This ancient practice has been used for millennia by priests to commune with their gods or warlocks to bond with their patrons. The methods for performing these Rites are diverse, ranging from simple chanting and meditative prayer to elaborate ceremonies involving living sacrifices. Each patron, be it a god, spirit, or otherworldly being, may demand different types of Rites, tailored to their unique nature and desires.

As you faithfully perform your Rites, the connection between you and your patron deepens, enhancing the flow of their power to you. The boons you receive are tailored specifically to your patron's nature, the strength and quality of your connection, and the particular Rite you perform. These boons can manifest in various ways, such as increased strength, heightened senses, magical abilities, or prophetic visions. The more devoted and precise you are in your Rites, the greater and more personalized the rewards you may receive from your patron.

If you currently lack a patron, these Rites can also serve as a means to attract one. By demonstrating your dedication and skill, you may draw the attention of a powerful entity willing to form a bond with you. The nature of the Rites you perform can influence the type of patron you attract, guiding you towards a being that resonates with your intentions and desires. The patrons you attract are often aligned with your own affinity and personal attributes, sometimes being influenced by other powers or abilities you may already possess. This natural alignment ensures a harmonious and potent connection, maximizing the benefits you receive from your chosen patron.
objects.title: Divine Rites

objects.text:
In the womb, you committed fratricide, consuming your twin before birth. Yet, against all odds, your sibling survived—not in body, but in soul, fusing with your own in a desperate act of self-preservation. Now, you and your twin exist as two sides of the same coin, forever intertwined.

This manifests in three distinct ways.

You can communicate with your twin within your mind, as seamlessly as speaking in person, giving you the advantage of essentially having a second mind—two individuals thinking and processing information simultaneously. You can shut off this communication at any time.

The second ability, is by allowing your twin to manifest in the real world by instantly swapping positions with you. They take your place in reality, while you are transported inside their soul. Inside their soul you are able to see the world through their senses, but you can't control them or influence their actions apart from communicating with them.

Having come so close to death and yet escaping from its clutches, your twin is now untethered from mortality. Making them virtually unkillable, where any damage they incur is instantly repaired, like a simulation correcting an error. But there is no such thing as absolutes, as your soul being the only anchor they have linking them to the real world, should you ever be damaged, they too will be damaged, and should you die, they too shall forever perish. 

Lastly, any powers or skills you possess, will also be mirrored by your twin but at ten times the output. 

You can end the shift whenever you want, swapping your place back to the real world. But your twin being the subservient soul can swap places with you, only with your express permission.

The relationship between the two of you is yours to define. However due to the unnatural circumstances that led to your twin's existence, their personality and temperament tends to lean toward the sinister and sadistic.
objects.title: Me And The Devil

addons.text: To walk the Golden Dao is to see the web of causality with perfect clarity and guide it with effortless grace. You do not fear cause or consequence—for they are one, and you are their gardener. Through the harmonious blending of enlightened insight and the natural flow of existence, you achieve an unparalleled mastery over the threads of causality. This fusion empowers you to move through the flow of existence not only with grace and balance but with an unparalleled understanding of the interconnected threads of cause and effect. You do not simply perceive reality or align with it—you become a living embodiment of its possibilities and inevitabilities. The Dao teaches effortless action and alignment with the natural flow, while the wisdom of the Golden Valley grants you the ability to see how every choice shapes the tapestry of creation. Together, they allow you to act with perfect precision: every decision, movement, and word becomes not only harmonious but transformative. You don’t just flow with the Dao; you guide its currents by planting the seeds of causality, ensuring that the outcomes you foresee align with the balance of the universe. Your sight into causality sharpens under the Dao’s influence, revealing not only the threads of what "can" and "will" happen but also how to act to bring about the most harmonious outcomes. The Dao steadies your mind, ensuring clarity and detachment, allowing you to see the threads of causality without being overwhelmed by their complexity. Conversely, your understanding of causality enhances your ability to flow with the Dao, as your actions are no longer merely intuitive but guided by a deep awareness of the consequences they will produce. This combined power grants you an unrivaled ability to nurture growth in all forms. Under your guidance, people, situations, and even the environment flourish. You can predict not only what is needed to help others thrive but also the exact moment and method to act, ensuring success with minimal effort. The Dao’s balance tempers the intense foresight of the Golden Valley, preventing overreach or misuse, while your vision amplifies your ability to guide the Dao’s flow with purpose and precision. At its height, this synergy allows you to reshape reality itself. You flow effortlessly with the Dao, nurturing the seeds of causality to blossom into harmonious outcomes. Whether healing broken systems, guiding others toward enlightenment, or resolving conflicts before they even arise, your combined mastery over flow and foresight makes you a force of boundless creation and wisdom. However, this gift demands alignment with its principles. Greed, malice, or destruction weaken your sight, clouding your ability to perceive causality. If your actions stray too far from nurturing or balance, your power diminishes. But if you embody compassion, growth, and balance, your sight becomes limitless, guiding you and others toward flourishing.
addons.title: Jīn Gǔ Zhī Dào - The Golden Dao of Harmony

objects.text: "You reap what you sow. This is the simplest truth there is—all consequences stem from their cause. Yet sages fear the cause, while fools fear the consequence. It is just as you would tend to a crop. Neglect to water and fertilize, and you ought be well aware that the harvest will be a hard one. So why wait until you see the reality occur before your eyes to regret your inaction? Causality is not something imperceivable, they merely pretend not to see it." Through enlightenment from your study of The Way, following the example of Shennong, you gain eyes free of the Fog. You 'see' and 'view' through Oneness with the world, grasping the field of possibilities that opens before you. You see not the hidden, but only what was always there. Causality unravels, letting you peer into the tapestry of creation. This new 'sight' grants you nigh omniscience anywhere you set your gaze, knowing the future with such certainty and clarity that what 'can' is what 'will' happen. This 'sight' of yours is achieved through a transformed mind, following the philosophy of the Divine Farmer himself. You align your mind with his and view the world through his eyes. Since this ability comes from aligning one's heart and mind with Shennong's, the more you are opposed to this frame of mind and viewpoint, the less you may know and see. Those with minds only caring for death and destruction may even find that they would lose this power over time. The Way directs, and The Way nurtures. So too, will your power wax when it directs and nurtures those under you, able to know and view more of that twisting tapestry of causality than you would alone, help them fully blossom.
objects.title: Dreams of The Golden Valley

addons.text: To cultivate with the eternal Dao is to transcend limits and walk a path of infinite potential, guided by the flow of the universe. When combined with the power to cultivate, Dao Zhi Lu transforms your cultivation journey, granting you unmatched talent and harmony. Qi flows effortlessly into you, as though the universe itself empowers your growth. Barriers to breakthroughs dissolve, and tribulations become manageable, as your connection to the Dao smooths the path forward. Techniques and abilities you learn are infused with Daoist principles, amplifying their power and precision. Your potential is limitless, free from constraints of bloodline, environment, or innate talent, allowing you to master even the most esoteric methods with ease. Natural treasures and spiritual beasts are drawn to your Dao-aligned aura, offering their aid and resonance on your journey in exchange for your guidance. Your comprehension of the universe’s laws like Yin-Yang and the Five Elements is unparalleled, allowing you to grasp even profound principles with little effort. However, your cultivation path demands harmony with the Dao. Straying into greed, domination, or excessive aggression risks stagnation or catastrophic backlash. By staying true to balance and humility, your growth remains as boundless as the Dao itself.
addons.title: Dào Qì Xiū Xíng - Cultivation with The Eternal Dao

addons.text: The Dao flows, the Sutra reveals. Together, they dissolve illusion, illuminate truth, and guide you to transcend the nameless while embracing the infinite. When combined with Dao Zhi Lu, the recitation of the Lotus Sutra bridges Daoist and Buddhist philosophies, creating a harmonious synergy that elevates your cultivation, perception, and spiritual growth. Rooted in the Dao’s natural flow and the Sutra’s insight into reality’s impermanence, this combination allows you to embody the balance of effortless action and profound mindfulness, achieving a state of unparalleled harmony with the universe. Reciting the Sutra while attuned to the Dao calms your mind, body, and spirit, anchoring you amidst chaos. Whether disrupted by internal turmoil, external conflicts, or spiritual attacks, this practice centers you, dispersing illusions and stabilizing your Qi. The Sutra’s contemplative nature aligns seamlessly with Daoist principles, allowing you to transcend false imaginings and embrace the true nature of reality. Together, these philosophies guide you to let go of attachments while flowing naturally with life’s rhythm. In meditation, the synergy of the Dao and the Sutra grants unparalleled clarity. The Dao reveals the universe’s natural flow, while the Sutra illuminates its deeper truths. You perceive the interplay of duality—yin and yang, permanence and impermanence—and understand the energies that shape existence. This heightened awareness accelerates your cultivation, allowing you to master even the most profound techniques and comprehend the interconnectedness of all things. As your mastery grows, your presence becomes a manifestation of Daoist harmony and Buddhist compassion. You radiate tranquility and wisdom, uplifting those around you. Your energy calms turbulent minds, aligns imbalanced Qi, and fosters an atmosphere of peace and enlightenment. Nature itself responds to your presence, harmonizing with your spiritual resonance, as the Dao and the Sutra guide you to act effortlessly and with purpose. To maintain this balance, you must embody both philosophies authentically. Focusing too heavily on detachment risks neglecting the Dao’s principle of effortless action, while overindulgence in flow may overshadow the Sutra’s mindfulness. True mastery lies in embracing both paths as one.
addons.title: Dharmāya Padmasūtram - Lotus Sutra For The Dao

addons.text: To Cut is to divide, but to Cut with the Dao is to realign. It is not destruction but transcendence, the ultimate expression of want tempered by harmony. When combined with Dao Zhi Lu and the power of The Sanctioned Action, your ability to Cut transcends raw skill, merging the principles of Daoist flow with the absolute precision of the blade. Cutting is no longer simply an act of division—it becomes an extension of the Dao’s natural rhythm, a profound expression of balance, intention, and inevitability. The Dao guides your blade, allowing you to cut not only physical objects but also the intangible: energy, concepts, and even fate itself. Your Cuts resonate with the harmony of the universe. Each strike flows effortlessly, as if the world itself yields to your intention. The Dao tempers the destructive nature of the Cut with wisdom, ensuring that every slash aligns with the natural order rather than disrupting it. This balance elevates your mastery, allowing you to cut with unmatched precision and elegance, whether severing an enemy’s defenses, dispelling illusions, or carving paths through esoteric barriers. As your mastery grows, the Dao amplifies the reach and depth of your Cutting. You can split even abstract concepts—like fear, doubt, or destiny itself—while leaving physical forms untouched. Your blade extends beyond the material, guided by the Dao to cleave through the multiverse’s deepest potentials. Projected Cuts become harmonized with Qi, carving through the fabric of reality with the inevitability of flowing water. At the pinnacle of this fusion, your Cuts are no longer bound by the sword. With a gesture or a thought, you divide and harmonize the world around you. The Dao transforms your act of Cutting into one of transcendence, not merely destruction but a reshaping of existence itself, aligning what remains with the infinite flow of the Dao. The harmony of the Dao demands responsibility. Cutting out of anger, greed, or imbalance risks severing your connection to the Dao and leaving you vulnerable to its consequences. The Dao of the Blade must always flow in alignment with balance and necessity.
addons.title: Dāo Zhī Dào - The Dao of The Blade

objects.text: The Dao does nothing, yet nothing is left undone. Walk the path, and all will follow as it should. The Dao that can be told is not the eternal Dao. The name that can be named is not the eternal name. The nameless is the beginning of heaven and earth. The named is the mother of the ten thousand things. You embark on the Path of the Daoist master, a journey of harmony and enlightenment that aligns you with the natural flow of existence. At the beginning, your connection is subtle yet profound. You sense the rhythm of the world, intuitively discerning the path of least resistance. Challenges and conflicts become opportunities for effortless action as you move through life like water flowing around rocks. Reflexes sharpen, balance becomes instinctive, and tasks feel effortless as you embody the principle of “wu wei” (effortless action). In time, your very presence radiates tranquility, calming those around you and fostering a sense of peace. As your bond with the Dao deepens, your body and mind harmonize with the natural world. Your energy, or Qi, flows freely, granting you resilience against the extremes of life—heat, cold, toxins, and even exhaustion seem to have little hold on you. This vitality extends outward, allowing you to subtly influence the flow of Qi in your surroundings. Tensions dissipate in your presence, plants thrive under your touch, and chaotic situations naturally resolve themselves as you gently guide the energy of the world toward balance. Health, harmony, and vitality become second nature, both for yourself and those within your sphere of influence. Eventually, you move beyond sensing and influencing the flow of the Dao—you begin to shape it. Your mastery of Qi allows you to mend what is broken, whether it be physical wounds, damaged tools, or fractured spirits. With focus, you can imbue objects, environments, or even people with the essence of the Dao, making them unyielding like stone, flexible like water, or serene like the stillness of a quiet forest. Attacks against you falter and dissolve, disrupted by your seamless alignment with the Dao’s flow. As your understanding of duality deepens, you become a bridge between opposites, effortlessly balancing yin and yang to bring harmony where there was once discord. At the pinnacle of your journey, you transcend the ordinary boundaries of existence, becoming a living embodiment of the Dao itself. Your mastery allows you to harmonize entire environments with a thought, calming storms, dispelling chaos, and bringing clarity to confusion. You dissolve your physical form into pure Qi, traversing space as an ethereal presence before reconstituting wherever the Dao guides you. Time and space feel pliable in your hands, no longer barriers but companions on your journey. Your presence alone inspires enlightenment and tranquility, awakening in others the potential to find their own path within the Dao. You act with the effortless grace of one who understands that the Dao flows everywhere, sustaining all things without striving. Yet with great power comes great responsibility. The Dao’s nature must be respected, for it abhors force or imbalance. Should you misuse your abilities to impose your will unnaturally, your connection to the Dao will be weakened. To walk the Dao Zhi Lu is to surrender ego, embrace humility, and trust in the infinite flow of the universe. By aligning with this eternal cycle, you achieve a state where nothing is done, yet nothing is left undone, becoming a guide, a guardian, and a manifestation of the Dao.
objects.title: Dào Zhī Lù

addons.text: Though your soul is already at the peak of purity and quality, you can now go even further. You've unlocked the secret fourth stage of Soul Refinement: Soul Layering, the process of adding more layers to your soul. Each layer you add is a significant milestone, a breakthrough that strengthens your essence in profound ways. Completing a layer marks a personal achievement, a moment of clarity that deepens your connection with your soul and strengthens its weight as a concept. With every new layer, the overall structure of your soul is strengthened, as each addition exponentially enhances the layers beneath it, making your entire soul far more powerful than before. The deeper you go, the more resilient your soul becomes, with each layer now increasing its resistance to all esoteric threats, such as the metaphysical, and its ability to withstand greater forces. You can shape these layers to focus on specific aspects of yourself for greater specific effects, enhancing specific esoteric defenses or amplifying qualities of your being like willpower or abilities. With each layer, your soul becomes an evermore intricate and complex structure, both a formidable fortress and a reflection of your inner power.
addons.title: Soul Layering

objects.text:
Souls, the foundation of intelligent life. Every lifeform, from a simple ant to the mightiest of Gods have a soul. You are proficient in the fearsome art of soulweaving, allowing you to manipulate and modify souls. This comes with 3 primary abilites: soul sight, soul refinement, and soul alteration. All acts of soulweaving are performed via touch or through a vector like an spell or a weapon. However, high level practitioners can manipulate the souls of weaker lifeforms from miles away without any contact.

Soul sight grants you a sense for the souls, spirits, wraiths, and the like within a 100 meter radius. You can determine the specifics of the soul and even use souls to identify individuals. Your soul sight is detailed enough to identify controlled lifeforms, possessions, curses, and even minor soul wounds or fractures. This is to the extent to which you can forego all your other senses and navigate the world solely through the souls of living beings around you.

Soul refinement involves a variety of training methods and techniques which allow you to continuously refine your own soul, making it stronger and more dense while removing impurities. Strengthening your soul also improves your ability to soulweave and defend against soul attacks.

This is divided in to 3 stages. The first is strengthening, in which you increase the raw potency of your soul, boosting any supernatural energies you have. The next is refinement, in which you loosen and cut your own soul to make it denser in an incredibly painful process. It is in this stage that impurities are removed. Finally, pacification involves recovery of the soul, healing damage caused by refinement. This increases willpower and makes you less prone to emotional decisions. You then begin the cycle again, incrementally increasing the soul's power.

Finally, soul alteration, considered by many to be a taboo art. You can directly change the souls of others, modifying key aspects of their being. You can create vile curses which doom entire bloodlines, degenerate the spirit of living beings, or even dissipate them entirely. Your spells, physical attacks, and weapons are also imbued with the ability to harm enemies' souls. The most powerful users of soul alternation are even capable of grafting the souls of others together or creating hidden soul markers to act subtly on others' souls from afar.
objects.title: Soul Weaver

objects.text:
You are skilled in the art of creating formations. Formations are similar to electrical circuits, transferring and manipulating supernatural energies in various ways to achieve an effect when active. At the most basic level, this can be something like consistently cooling a room once it goes above a certain temperature. At the highest levels, you can achieve effects like making semi-conscious formations, layering countless formations, or creating self-modifying formations. There are 3 major categories of formations:

Seals attempt to entrap an object, soul, or consciousness into an area or object. The more powerful the sealed object, the harder and more expensive it is to create a formation to seal. Seals can also take the form of barriers, which are physical boundaries that prevent others from entering or exiting a location. You can modify these formations to create complex access systems with levels of permissions to determine who can access the formation when, where, and in what way. 

Dominions attempt to monitor a certain area for certain conditions or apply a certain effect on those within. These formations use detection capabilities to determine targets (such as sensing souls contained within), then applying a function such as detecting if those souls are possessed or not, their life expectancy, or energy levels. Some practical applications of dominion formations are monitoring a city to collect data and catch spies/intruders, boosting the fertility of an alchemical plot, or prohibiting spells in a peaceful area.

Combat Formations are those made for the purposes of bloodshed and war. Formations can act as a major force multiplier through making areas easier to defend, adding powerful utility effects on allies, setting up ambushes, or even through powerful offensive attacks. Combat formations are generally far more durable and resistant to effects, but are also more expensive.

Dominions and Seals also generally have some subsidiary combat formations for defense and protection. 

There are many other types of formations, such as maintenance formations, portable formations, or city shields, but they all usually fall within the 3 aforementioned categories. All formations usually have at least one formation core, normally a physical object used to handle the computational needs of the formation. Larger formations can have multiple cores to extend range or boost potency. Other physical implements can be required to spread, maintain, or enforce the effects of a formation, such as statues serving as teleportation gates. These often require supernatural materials such as enchanted crystals for array cores, magical grass as constant fuel to provide an effect, etc.

In addition to the physical components, formations are primarily intangible and created through flow, transfer, and modification of supernatural energies that you possess. This part of the formation cannot be seen without some form of supernatural detection. Both physical and intangible parts of formations can be damaged, so it is important to include defenses or retaliatory measures to prevent this. Too much damage will prevent a formation from functioning or even make it irreparable.

All formations require a source of energy. This can either be a preset reserve or through an energy collection system in a formation, such as draining a negligible and unnoticeable amount of energy from all souls in a city for its monitoring and defensive formations. 

You have a basic understanding of all types of formation arts and can develop your own formations. Creating a formation is an extremely time-consuming process, and other skills, such as artifact creation to design formation cores and components, will be helpful. Once the schematic is designed and components are created, it will also take time to physically set up the formation. The speed and cost depends on your attainment.
objects.title: Formation Master

addons.text:
It seems the blueprint of your soul is under your complete control, allowing you to  change the shape of your ghostly replacements to whatever you desire, within reason. You can change the blueprint of your soul to anything, but the less acceptance you have over the change, the slower it will manifest.  Making your arm a hammer might take hours to properly manifest, but make it say, the arm of a gorilla, it might take just a minute or two.

You don't even need to have your body damaged to utilize this ability. You can even will yourself to have wings, and they will grow after a while.
addons.title: Pliable/Savant Soul

objects.text:
A phantom limb is the sensation that a missing limb is still attached. For you though, it IS still attached. Well, kind of.

If you lose your limb, or just any part of your body, the missing will be replaced with a translucent version that would not only allow them to see your blood flow, but remind people of a ghost, which is what it kind of is. This replacement will act exactly the same as the original, possibly even better as it will be based on the blueprint of your soul, which means that it would not be affected by things like disease, and poison.

If a ghostly body part is destroyed, it will reform in mere seconds. An interesting quirk of this ability is that it allows you to eventually regenerate your missing original part. It won't heal at any exceptional pace, just at the pace your original body heals. Do note that blood will still be pumped and will not be accounted for replacement, and if over 50% of your brain is destroyed, you will be truly be dead.

The blueprint of your soul is somewhat dependent on your actual body. If a limb of yours was to have been replaced with a superior robotic prosthetic, and you feel like it really is your limb, that prosthetic will be also become a part of the blueprint of the soul, presuming that it's superior then your original limb.
objects.title: Prosthetic Spirit

objects.text:
Your soul is special; as long as you have nutrition, you can't die, effectively becoming immortal. Your regeneration is slow — taking minutes to heal cuts, and a day to reattach limbs — but even being turned into ashes can't kill you permanently. Your soul stores any nutrition you acquire above a certain threshold, allowing you to stockpile the resource that fuels your immortality.

You are hyperaware of any harm caused to your soul and body, and can with ease ignore them to a certain extent. You would be able to talk using your head despite it being detached but you wouldn't be able to pick up something with your left hand if you don't have it.

Besides your immortality, your soul offers one more thing: a ritual. By ingesting the DNA of someone, you create a link between their soul and yours. Through this link, any harm done to your body will not only affect their body, but also their soul, and any healing they are subjected to will affect your soul and body. The reverse — harm to them affecting you or healing yourself affecting them — can only happen if you allow it. Souls weaker than yours will be permanently connected to yours, souls equal to yours eventually will be freed from the link, and souls stronger than yours will be freed much quicker the stronger they are.

When someone dies while they are connected to you, their soul will be absorbed by yours, slightly increasing your regeneration and giving you their memories and anything else their soul has to offer.
objects.title: Walking Voodoo Doll

objects.text:
You can create mouths anywhere on your body. Through those mouths, you can shape and animate anything you put inside them. They can also be used to store those creations and infuse them with anything from yourself, like memories or powers. You can remotely control your creations, and if you are touching them, you can alter their size anywhere from nano-sized to gigantic heights.

All of this—except the storage, creation of mouths, and infusion of self—is fueled by a huge well of explosive energy generated by your soul. To shape and animate, you need to infuse the material with this energy; to control your creations and adjust their size, you need to expend this energy. Due to this, all of your creations can explode—which you can trigger at a distance—and the more energy they are infused with, the bigger it will be. The size of a creation control affects how much energy it can hold inside.
objects.title: Life is an Explosion

addons.text:
Due to your nature as a Perfect Host for means of empowerment, the bond with your Elemental Spirits has both deepened and expanded, allowing you to draw on more of their powers and take on new forms.

You can fuse with one of your Elemental Spirits, amplifying their power by several magnitudes and granting you new equipment that best suits you and your fused spirit; you can decide what appearances these transformations have so long as it's consistent with all of them and at minimal, a change of eye color or hair styled differently.

With time and training, you will be able to stack these Elemental Forms on top of one another to have a Dual Elemental Form and Triple Elemental Form; without additional perks, powers or special circumstancesm it would take a year to be able to stack all four of them simultaneously.
addons.title: Perfected Union

addons.text:
Your four bonded Elemental Spirits get the full benefits of being your Familiars with their own power blessing your other familiars as well allowing them to gain more powerful elemental abilities.

Within your soul, four new Domains corresponding to each of your Elemental Spirits form with them residing over them; here, you can send Familiars of a matching element to aid them in growing stronger faster or have Familiars of a different element gaining a new elemental affinity and form they can switch between after training in different Elemental Domains.

Your Elemental Spirits can be summoned like your other Familiars to fight alongside you, this can either actually be them or merely a projection as they remain within your soul, and while summoned like this, they can use abilities inspired by the Familiars within their domains whether through using traits or powers of said Familiars or briefly summoning copies formed from their Element.​
addons.title: Trainer of Elements

addons.text:
Each of your four Elemental Spirits have gained the traits and abilities of the Genryu—the five elemental dragons who each represent one of the five nature transformations.

Sylph also gets a twin sister named Fulgora whose power is equal to hers in terms of pure natural ability and possesses the traits and power of the Lightning Genryu.

This also gives them the ability to spawn Mugonhei, simple clay soldiers that have varying specializations to defend territory.

They also possess the power to disrupt the use of chakra around them, which can also be used to do the same for magic and other supernatural abilities that fall within their respective elements, singular or combined. Alternatively, this can be inverted to nurture the land around them.

Lastly but certainly not the least, your now five spirits possess the most powerful ability of the Genryu, which is to turn into the Light Genryu—a very powerful dragon that is said to have power to destroy the world.

The Light Genryu, unlike the Jūbi, retains access to the powers of each spirit but with none of their weaknesses, along with the ability to produce devastating light-based beams and attacks in massive amounts.
addons.title: The Genryu (Naruto)

addons.text:
Due to your status as the Primordial Man, your Elemental Spirits have undergone a profound metamorphosis. They are not gaining new power but rather reclaiming what they had before as the truth is revealed. The Spirits bonded to you are Primordial Elemental Spirits. Just as you are the First of Man, they are the First of their Kind. In the beginning, you forged a deep bond where they shall walk with you even after The End (though the specifics are up to you).

As Primordial Elements that helped shape the world in the beginning, the power they wield cannot be understated. Even Pantheons would hesitate to take up arms against even one of them and would prefer to avoid them unless absolutely necessary. Rightly so, as their status as Primordial Elements allows them more esoteric abilities that they can use.

As their original power is regained, your Elementals can take on three different forms: Restrained, Loosened, and Unbound.

For reference, let's use Sylph as an example: Their Restrained form would be the same Fairy, with their Loosened form being a Fairy Queen, appearing as an evolved state of their previous form. However, when Unbound, Sylph becomes an Entity of Living Winds.

These are more than mere cosmetic changes as it shows how much of their power they are using. Restrained is 25%, Loosened is 50%, and Unbound is all their power being brought to bear. Even when Restrained, your Elementals are nothing to be taken lightly. Unbound means their mere presence can affect environments across entire worlds and anything orbiting them. Winds that blow away the surface of worlds, Flames that can burn hotter than the core of worlds, what were once Mountains become more like Planetoids, and Waves that consume all in their flow are just a mere taste of the power of these Primordial Elements.

You can also decide now if they are Progenitors like yourself, with each being the origin of their own species and circumstances behind them, or if they are merely the First to appear.
