Should you possess the Trainer of the Elements Addon, then the rate of growth your Familiars undergo becomes exponentially greater, with new more powerful specialized abilities forming relating to each Familiar. And should you summon one of your Primordial Elements, know their mere presence can reshape the area around them or even affect an entire world while their not using their full power.​
addons.title: Pillars of Creation
Fury of the Elements
addons.text:
The powers of your Elemental Spirits and the Furies of Alera combine, creating a greater whole from disparate parts.

Firstly, your Elemental Spirits (including those below) gain the abilities of Aleran Furies, notably the potential to allow the user to manifest their elements instead of merely controlling them. This enhancement also boosts your connection to your Elementals by a good margin.

Next, two new elemental spirits are now bound to you, formed as representations of their Aleran Counterparts: Dryad, the Spirit of Wood, and Aura, the Spirit of Metal. 

Embodying a bottomless curiosity, Dryad's abilities are born from the limitless growth of nature. Through focus and meditaion, you can create a "seed" that represents the potential to grow, and apply it to any aspect of yourself or the world, boosting the potential of whatever it "touches" by significant degrees. You can create as many seeds as you wish, as long as you put in the effort to do so, and the seeds can be applied to anything that you can access to do so, including intangible or supernatural things.
Dryad's powers over growth also significantly enhance her natural control over plants and plant matter, allowing you to, with time and effort, achieve feats such as creating an entire forest from nothing on barren soil, and having it not only grow but prosper.

Embodying an unbreakable will, Aura's abilities emcompass the power of Metal in all its forms. This includes most Metals' aspects of Durability and Unyielding nature, but can also include the varied aspects of other, individual metals as well. This allows you to draw upon the subset of concepts and meanings applied to any individual metal type, such as Silver's purifying nature or the luster and glory of Gold. It is even possible to mix metals (and their concepts) into alloys to create a greater, more powerful whole, or shape metal into more useful forms for offense, defense, or even utility purposes. 

Optionally, you may have your elementals take on different forms coinciding with your interpretation of their concept or a connection with a place where their element is present and strong. Whether or not this affects a gain in power is something that even Aleran Scholars still debate on.

objects.text:
Your soul is now home to four loyal element spirits: Sylph (Wind), Gnome (Earth), Undine (Water), and Salamander (Fire).

The presence of these spirits in your soul has granted you three benefits. 

Firstly, the spirits will actively defend your soul from hostile interactions, such as attacking the soul of a demon attempting to take yours, or preventing a ghost from possessing you. Secondly, your affinity, talent, and growth rate for abilities that match their element are increased to prodigious levels, mastering them in record time. Third and finally, the spirits, through their bond with you, will teach you how to channel their elements into your body and fighting style, as well as how to channel a symbolic ability.

It should be noted that elemental channeling is restricted to only augmenting, so you can’t fire bullets of water, but could instead extend the reach of a slash instead.

Embodying a child-like freedom, Sylph’s symbolic ability is to play with the wind.  By freely moving in tandem with the wind, you gain a noticeable boost in speed, agility, and evasiveness. Once mastered, your playing will result in a wreathing windstorm that guides you both around dangers and towards freedom, deflects projectiles, and propels you to create after-images.

Embodying a steadfast reliability, Gnome’s symbolic ability is to breathe alongside the earth. By breathing in unison with the earth beneath you, a steadfast and reliable connection forms that boosts your strength, durability, and weight. Once mastered, your connection renders you the same as a mountain emerging from the earth, possessing an overwhelming strength, durability, and weight to bear down.

Embodying a calm relaxation, Undine’s symbolic ability is to flow with the world. By truly calming and relaxing yourself, you flow in along with the various flows found in the world granting you a significant boost in evasivity and offensive power. Once mastered, you are rendered nigh-untouchable as you simply flow along and around the waves of oncoming attacks, and possess an offense both that strikes the intangible like fire and sound via their flow, and bypasses durability through the targeting internal flows that lie beneath.

Embodying a burning determination, Salamader’s symbolic ability is to cleansing through flames. By focusing and igniting your will, flames burst forth that burn away both your physical and mental ailments, boosting your determination and offensive power, whilst also cleansing yourself of poisons and diseases. Once mastered, the flames that emerge purify and restore, healing both yourself and allies to peak form physically and mentally, followed by burning away any false power of foes as if they were ailments as well.

Finally, once you have mastered the connection to all four spirits, they will teach you how to combine their powers into either a devastating singular strike or a brief superpowered state. Notably, this combination is multiplicity rather than addititive, resulting in a power that would allow you to hit above your weight class. Further, these abilities could potentially become stronger with the ability to wield elements not possessed by your spirits and mix them as well. Finally, for all the power these techniques possess, they have two drawbacks. First, they require each element to be added individually, granting a charge time, and second, they require focus to keep stable, so taking a hit whilst charging could easily disrupt it.

As a final note, the form and personality of the spirits will mostly be up to you with a stipulation. The form and personality must be somewhat associated with their respective element, such as Sylph being an air-headed fairy or Salamander being a hot-headed dragon. Furthermore, you can choose what type of relationship you wish to have with the spirits.
objects.title: Elemental Spirit Bond

addons.text:
Your divinely crafted body has been enhanced by your Crest Stone into an unholy amalgamation of crest components:

Since you do not require any sustenance to exist, your now useless organs (lungs, stomach, esophagus, etc.) are replaced with far more useful and deadly versions. Each of these new organs is composed of a bone-like material similar to your Crest Stone. and is nigh-indestructible from brute physical force. Your body body operates internally at -320 °F, and your skin is extremely cold to the touch (~ -200° F).

You have bone spikes protruding from your spine, which extend all the way to the subdermal layer of your skin. Anyone who pierces through your skin with their hands is not going to have a very fun time. Furthermore, rather than a rib cage you have a sturdy rib plate which prevents external forces from going near your crest stone. All of your joints are enhanced with a 360 degree range of motion, and you can spin them rapidly akin to General Grievous. Your nerves, veins, and blood vessels are replaced with extremely thin bone-pipes centered around your crest stone which move materials and information around your body at extremely rapid speeds.

Your muscles have been replaced with a fleshy, pale-gray, shock absorbing substance. These are embedded with bone-pipes scattered intermittently throughout, boosting their structural integrity greatly. This can allow you to withstand disproportionately high amounts of damage without flinching or staggering back. The kinetic energy you absorb from these blows refills your magic energy reserves. More of this substance can be produced from your bone spikes.

Your skin and hair have also been enhanced into combat-capable versions. Your hair is now ocean blue rather than mint-green or turquoise, and has an extremely thin but sharp layer of transparent bone around it. You can launch strands of hair in any direction as projectiles.
addons.title: Living Weapon

objects.text: You are the equal of Pandora, bestowed with all gifts. You also gain a variety of unique traits corresponding to each Olympian: Zeus - You can fly at speeds up to 5.5x your maximum running speed on land. Your fine control is excellent: you can easily make sharp turns, perform complex aerial maneuvers, control your speed, or even passively float a few inches off the ground. You can also perceive the movement of air around you in a 1km radius, allowing for you to utilize natural wind and air currents to further boost your speed. You can detect almost any movement within your radius via the displacement of air. Hera - You have a regal demeanor and a supernatural sense of charisma. Over a few conversations, you can convince others to at least consider your way of thinking. You can cultivate loyal subordinates who would die for you with ease. Furthermore, you can speak extremely politely, regardless of the circumstances. You will drive anyone who is trying to get a reaction out of you into a rage as you remain calm and composed in any situation. Poseidon - You do not need to breathe. Sea creatures see you as one of their own, and you can issue requests to various forms of sea life via verbal commands. Generally, they will agree to help you as long as it does not harm their interests or go against their principles. Even the most tyrannical sea monsters such as Leviathans or Krakens will be at least neutral to you. Aphrodite - Your appearance has also been modified — you are now perfect. Your skin is extremely soft to the touch and does not have any blemishes, your features blend together and are aesthetically pleasing, and you do not have any flaws whatsoever. You can entice desire in even the most stalwart and dedicated of individuals. This makes you appear somewhat similar to a doll at a glance, and can trigger the Uncanny Valley effect for some people. Hades - You absorb a small portion of the souls of every lifeform you kill. If you killed an average human, you would gain a marginal increase in your physical capabilities and a small boost to your magical energy reserves, if you have any. The increase in power corresponds to the potency of the soul you killed, so spiritual lifeforms have a greater yield than usual. Your growth is rather underwhelming and minor on an individual basis — almost completely unnoticeable. However, it will quickly stack over time or if you go on a murderous rampage. Hephaestus - Your body is naturally designed to be superior to all other humans in a variety of ways: You have an enhanced physique that allows you to shatter metal walls with a punch, survive hits from a battle tank, enhanced senses that allow you to track someone from miles away, and limitless physical stamina that allows you to continue fighting endlessly. If you have any spiritual or magical powers, your energy reserves are far above the norm for whatever system you use, about 20x that of the average practitioner. Ares - Your physical, mental, and magical abilities ramp up over time in combat. This increase is linear, and does not depend on the strength or number of enemies you are facing. You are a master at aggression, capable of instigating wars and escalating constantly. You would feel right at home in a constantly escalating series of situations. Artemis - You can, at will, choose to make any and all of your movements, items, and abilities completely silent and more subtle. For example, a giant glowing doom laser may become far less noticeable and bright. You no longer need to eat or drink and are capable of surviving in virtually any environmental condition, from desert winds to winter snow. You can see perfectly regardless of light level. Apollo - Your voice is extremely soothing to hear and can pacify others with a few words. You have the power to invoke prophecies in which you greatly increase the probability of whatever you verbally state. You can use this to influence any event you know of, in the present or in the near future. Your prophecies have harsh requirements for plausibility — they have to be something which could reasonably happen. However, this does not have a range limit, so you could influence events on the other side of the globe. Demeter - You have a mental index categorizing every single fauna you have ever encountered by their various characteristics. You are talented in selective breeding of crops to develop new and unique species which suit your needs. You are a genius at all types of alchemy and can use plants as substitute materials for various rituals and objects. Athena - You have an awareness for the global "trend of the times" which you can use to determine how events will play out. For example, you could sense how social undercurrents will lead to a revolution, or the economic impacts of a virus. You can create multi-layered and complex plans to achieve your goals. Hestia - You are the world's greatest therapist. You know exactly how to heal mental disorders and repair the minds of traumatized or damaged individuals. Your therapy is supernatural in nature, making it capable of healing curses, telepathic or soul damage, and even eldritch corruption over a few sessions. Hermes - You have a maximum running speed of Mach 2. You can accelerate to this speed within seconds. You have supernatural dexterity which allows you to move with the grace of a dancer even at your top speed. You can sense extradimensional disruptions, such as teleportation, in your normal perception range. You can determine where beings have teleported to/from. If you have a teleportation power, you can follow them, even to other dimensions. Living up to your name, you are amazingly gifted in all fields you choose to pursue, regardless of whether they are mundane or supernatural. Your learning capabilities are greatly enhanced to the point you could finish a 4-year university course in a day if you had access to the right materials. You can leverage your abilities and intellect to find cures to complex diseases over an afternoon session, find solutions to global economic and political problems over a cup of tea, and find errors in the life's work of a professor while skimming over a paper. Like Pandora, you have the infamous boon of curiosity, which gives you unending dedication to discovering the unknown and innovating upon what you already have. You can constantly create new and creative solutions to problems you encounter. Unlike Pandora, you also have a particular bias towards useful knowledge, so you won't be opening up random jars or boxes to see what is inside. You can also control your desire for knowledge when dealing with important affairs. Your abilities are natural attributes of yourself rather than a blessing from any god.
objects.title: The All-Gifted

objects.text: The sword’s path cleaves illusions apart, Its edge, a mirror of the wielder's heart. In stillness, find the strength you seek, Where silence whispers, and truth will speak. Each swing untangles the ties that bind, Freeing the soul, unshackling the mind. Know your blade, and know your soul, Together as one, you become whole. You follow the path of the sword, hear the whisper of steel and cleave your enemies apart with each swing. A monstrous prodigy, you are destined to become the Sword Saint—a being capable of severing Heaven and Earth with a single stroke. With your first few swings, you will learn enough to be able to beat the average clumsy swordsman with a few months of training. A dozen swings and less than a week or so of training will elevate you leaps and bounds, allowing you to beat an experienced swordsman with years of practice. With each swing thereafter, mastery of the sword comes naturally to you, a being of hard work and natural talent, carrying you further along the way of the sword. Your talent with the sword is unmatched. After a few months of practicing alone, you could reach the limit of what is humanly possible with swordsmanship, and within a year, you could reach superhuman levels of swordsmanship. This power also grants you an instinctual understanding of other essential qualities for a sword saint: physical mastery and training, technical skill, mental fortitude, strategic thinking, philosophical depth, and a deep connection with your sword. How you use this power and the journey you undertake are entirely up to you, for the path of each sword saint is unique. While this power does not teach you any specific sword style, it gives you the ability to effortlessly learn or create your own. Using things such as Sword Intent or other esoteric, abstract or spiritual ways of using the sword are all possible with time.
objects.title: The Way of the Sword

addons.text: "A single god walks through many heavens— bearing a thousand names, answering to all." You are no longer confined to a single divine pantheon. Your divinity now extends like an invisible thread across the sacred tapestries of many mythologies. This now gives you the basic traits and abilites of every pantheon such as there is no need to choose. The Loa of Haitian Vodou recognize you as one of their own. The Orisha of the Yoruba pantheon call you sibling. Among the Kami of Shinto, your presence blends seamlessly into the landscape of the sacred. Monotheistic and Omnipotent pantheons are still not included in this. You may now take on a greater, more potent domain, so long as its echoes remain consistent across your forms. Perhaps you are a god of sacred waters—presiding over mountain lakes among the Inca, mighty rivers among the Yoruba, salt tides among the Atua, and primordial springs among the Aztec. This Divine Aspect reflects their culture, mythos, and spiritual structure. These forms are fully divine and distinct, each form is an equal true form you have. As such you may shift between them, wear them all at once or have them walk around separately without issue- being in multiple places and pantheons at once. While the names and tales vary, the essence remains: your worshippers may one day see through the differences, and realize the truth. Thousands of Names. A single Truth.
addons.title: Mantle of Many Heavens

addons.text:
You are no average member of your chosen pantheon. You are a Major God who possesses vast influence and strength to hold sway over the mortal race.

This doesn't automatically make you the leader of your pantheon, but you will initially possess the same amount of power and strength as a major god like Ares, Thor, and Hachiman.

You possess the potential to grow to heights surpassing even the strongest members of your divine hierarchy, though it is up to you whether or not you seek to usurp your divine leader.

If you don't wish to become a subordinate of any known pantheon, you can instead decide to create your own, as your power alone can help you establish a new celestial hierarchy.
addons.title: Divine Leadership

objects.text:
Choose any one pantheon of gods like for example the Greeks, Egyptians, Shinto, or Chinese and you’ll become an average god of that pantheon. 

You’ll develop all traits and abilities that are associated with the average god of that pantheon separate from any individual talents like say the common shapeshifting abilities of a Greek God or the fighting skill of a Norse God. 

If the world you first insert into has a local counterpart of that pantheon you can choose to develop according to their local attributes instead of our world’s mythology on them. You can also choose any pantheon unique to the world you first inserted to.

This is a real transformation: if the pantheon you have become a part of exists in the world you inserted into, they will be able to sense your connection to them with the appropriate abilities.

You can’t choose monotheistic pantheons or any pantheon in general where being all powerful in any capacity would be considered average like The Endless or Lovecraft Outer Gods.

If it’s absolutely expected among all members of your selected pantheon, you may select an average amount of talents or domains which you possess exceptional talent and control over. While you are free to choose within reason, these talents or domains must not exceed the average of your pantheon in power, number, or importance. 

So being a god of a specific form of art, a style of fighting, a mountain, a forest, or a river would probably be ok for a Greek God. While being god of the heavens, god of gods, or god of kings would certainly be too much. This may create environments for you to be the god of based off your selected talents and domains near the point you inserted to.
objects.title: Part of the Pantheon

addons.text:
Any object you bind to your soul now becomes your phylactery, providing you with the same healing and resurrecting properties that the Soul Marriage does.

As long as the bound object exists, you will heal from any and all wounds, even fatal ones. And should your body be destroyed completely, or if you just wish so, you will resurrect in the safe space nearest to your phylactery.
addons.title: Phylactery

addons.text:
Both you and the person you have bonded with can now freely share any and all of your powers with each other.

If both of you possess similar powers, allowing one of you access to your combined capabilities will cause a state of soul resonance, amplifying the ability to an exponential degree.
addons.title: What's Mine is Yours

objects.text:
You can bind your soul with that of another living being, creating an inseparable bond between you that will persist even in death.

While one of you lives, the other will also live, healing from any injuries and even resurrecting after death, with resurrection taking longer the more gruesome and esoteric the death was. A bullet to the head will be healed in minutes, while being atomised or having the soul itself destroyed will likely take months or even years. This bond feeds on itself, making both of you immortal unless you both perish without anyone having a chance to revive, and even in that case, you are guaranteed to be bound even after death, with both of you going to the same afterlife or reincarnating should even one of you possess such ability.

The bond also provides both linked a limited form of telepathy, allowing you to share thoughts and feelings regardless of distance, as well as seamlessly coordinate your actions, whether in combat or in any other situation.

As an additional benefit for those you bind your soul with, you are capable of sharing any of the self-targeting perks you possess, such as 'Immortality Insurance' or 'Blank', for example.

While you are capable of breaking the link, doing so will result in a backlash due to quite literally tearing your souls apart, leaving you temporarily weakened.
objects.title: Soul Marriage

addons.text:
Where Heroes draw their strength from the love, respect, and camaraderie of their allies, your power stems from an entirely different source: the hatred, despair, and humiliation you inflict upon your enemies. This strength grows with each act of cruelty and devastation you unleash, particularly when it concerns those destined to oppose you—Heroes.

Your strength is intricately tied to the creation and destruction of Heroes. To put it plainly, your greatest source of power comes from crafting Heroes through tragedy, only to annihilate them later. This involves stripping them of everything they hold dear, igniting within them an unquenchable thirst for vengeance. Their hatred, their overwhelming need to defeat you, becomes the foundation of their rise as Heroes and, paradoxically, the key to your own growth.

Killing a Hero you created is the ultimate source of your power. The strength you gain from their death grows with their fame, skill, and the depth of their hatred for you. Defeating a young, inexperienced Hero brings little reward—they are too weak, and their hatred is not yet strong enough. Allowing them to rise to greatness only makes their eventual fall more rewarding. A Hero at the height of their power, driven by an intense desire for vengeance or righteousness, gives you an enormous boost when you bring them down. Be wary, as Heroes still have conceptual advantages when facing you.

Beyond Heroes, your growth also extends to ordinary mortals, albeit in a lesser capacity. Killing them provides a marginal increase in your strength, but such gains are minuscule—like attempting to drain an ocean with a spoon. However, the potency of the boost increases significantly when their deaths are accompanied by humiliation, despair, or an intense hatred directed toward you. A broken spirit, a shattered hope—these are the echoes of suffering that amplify your power. Though even this pales in comparison to the surge you gain from a Hero’s demise, the cumulative effect can still be worthwhile when applied on a broader scale.

While you can delegate the killing of ordinary people to your subordinates and still gain the minor boost, the same does not apply to Heroes; you must personally strike them down, or you will forfeit the immense power their death provides.
addons.title: Hero Killing

addons.text: You are not just a mere demon lord, you are The Demon Lord, the darkness of the world itself. Conflict no longer merely follows but instead erupts from your presence. Civilisations fracture under your shadow with terrifying speed. Even among the orderly or devout, darkness surfaces. Civilians, leaders, even heroes who falter become monstrous under your influence, shaped by their inner flaws and desires as their worst selves manifest. Entire cities can transform into monstrous reflections of their former selves, serving you in your growing, sprawling, monstrous empire. But with this darkness comes light like never before. Heroes rise faster, shine brighter, and strike harder. The world’s immune system activates with greater force. Weapons of light burn hotter. Miracles grow stronger. You empower them by existing. Once they defeat you, the golden age that follows eclipses all others. It is not merely peace—it is a miracle. A true impossibility made real. Social, magical, and technological progress surges to world-altering levels. The stronger you rise, the more powerful the world becomes after you.
addons.title: The True Demon Lord

addons.text:
The union of the Overlord Gauntlet and the mantle of the Demon Lord elevates you beyond mortal comprehension. You ascend into the role of the Demon Overlord, the living embodiment of dominion and terror, a sovereign whose shadow stretches across all realities.

The Gauntlet, once a relic gripped in your hand, begins its slow, inevitable fusion with your essence. Its dark veins spread into your flesh and soul, until the distinction between you and the artifact disappears. The day comes when the Gauntlet no longer exists as an object—it is you, and its infinite might is bound seamlessly to your being.

From this moment on, the powers you possess no longer stand apart from the Gauntlet—they shape it. Every shard of strength, every magical gift, every supernatural force you acquire reshapes and amplifies the Gauntlet’s arsenal. Fire, shadow, sorcery, and raw force of will bleed into its nature, expanding its destructive capacity and deepening its dominion. It becomes a mirror of your supremacy, evolving endlessly as you do.

Your minions reflect this transformation. Empowered not only by your demonic aura but also by the Gauntlet’s living essence, they grow in ferocity and cunning, adapting to your every conquest. They no longer march as expendable soldiers, but as a devoted, fanatical tide, their power scaling with yours, their loyalty absolute.
The combined might of demonic sovereignty and artifact-born chaos grants you unparalleled mastery of dark sorcery. Rituals that rend worlds, curses that shackle nations, and spells that annihilate armies flow effortlessly through you, no longer restrained by the limits of mortal casters. Unlike others who falter beneath such weight, you channel it as if it were your own breath—because now, it is.

With each victory, the world bends further beneath your rule. Nations collapse, dimensions crack, and even demons who once held thrones bow in recognition of your supremacy. Yet destiny itself stirs: Heroes rise inevitably against you, their story bound to yours. But they no longer face a Demon King—they stand against the Demon Overlord, one whose very being is both sovereign and weapon, whose dominion is written into the fabric of all powers he commands.
The Gauntlet is no longer your weapon.

 It is your essence, your throne, and the eternal reflection of your limitless power.
addons.title: Dominion of the Demon Overlord
Grand Deceiver
addons.text:
You are now a cancerous tumour that infects all that is good in the world. Your dark power can now affect even those not directly sworn to you, slowly corrupting them with mutation after mutation until your will overpowers theirs and they become enthralled to your service. However, this is subject to two limitations. First, they must willingly accept something you offer, whether that be a payment, an object, a deal, or even a simple helping hand. They do not have to know this will corrupt them, but must accept it of their own free will.

Secondly, this corruption can still be rooted out and destroyed. This can happen through sheer willpower, and if they succeed in rejecting your influence, they will be free of your taint, though pitting a weakened mind against your undiminished will still be difficult. It can also be burned out through your weakness to holy power, which will cleanse anyone affected by your corruption who has not been wholly subsumed.

objects.text:
You take on the mantle of a true Demon Lord, becoming the embodiment of fear, authority, and dark majesty. This transforms you into a sovereign of evil and a master strategist, granting you abilities that mark you as the supreme ruler of any dark realm.

As a Demon Lord, you gain a huge increase in physical powers. Your very presence commands respect and fear. You radiate an oppressive aura of domination that weighs heavily on the hearts of those who oppose you, sapping their morale and resolve. Allies who fight alongside you feel a surge of confidence and strength in your presence, inspired by your unshakeable authority. Even among the monstrous and unruly, your will becomes law, and few can resist the compulsion to obey your commands. This effect is especially potent against races deemed “lesser” or “monstrous” by human standards, as they instinctively recognise your superiority and submit more readily to your rule.

Your authority extends far beyond simple commands. Those who swear fealty to you are infused with your dark power. As they serve you, they gradually gain demonic traits—sharpened claws, tougher skin, enhanced strength, and a growing resilience to harm. The stronger you become, the more powerful your servants grow. Even existing demonic entities acknowledge you as their superior, deferring to your authority unless bound by other oaths or contracts.

Your role as a Demon Lord makes you intuitively capable of using dark and forbidden magics. While your mastery over these arts isn’t great initially, you possess an unparalleled ability to learn and adapt quickly. Given enough time and research, you can harness these magics to devastating effect, far surpassing the efforts of most. Unlike others who dabble in forbidden powers, you experience minimal side effects from their use, allowing you to explore and wield them with greater freedom and efficiency.

As a true Demon Lord, you excel in creating and ruling a nation. Your innate mastery over authority allows you to forge a kingdom from chaos or seize control of an unruly land. However, any nation you build will reflect your essence: a “monstrous” realm defined by ordered chaos. It will be a land of raw power, untamed creatures, and ruthless strength, where your rule enforces unity among the disorder. Under your command, this chaotic domain thrives, bound together by your will, becoming a brutal yet thriving empire unlike any other.

While this power brings immense strength and influence, it also places a heavy burden upon you. Your presence and actions mark you as the embodiment of darkness and a direct threat to those who champion order, justice, and light. Figures known as Heroes have a conceptual advantage when opposing you. Their belief in themselves as Heroes, combined with the faith of those who follow them, reinforces the idea that “The Hero always slays the Demon King,” making them particularly dangerous opponents. This does not guarantee your defeat, but it makes battles against them far more arduous. Their weapons strike deeper, their magic burns brighter, and their resolve resists the oppressive weight of your aura where others would falter.

Furthermore, holy-attributed abilities and relics are your greatest weakness, capable of piercing through your defences and leaving wounds that resist your otherwise remarkable resilience. Your very essence is antithetical to such powers, making confrontations with those aligned with light particularly dangerous.
objects.title: Demon Lord

addons.text: "No one can win every battle, but no man should fall without a struggle!" - Spiderman To be a Hero is to embrace suffering, to shoulder the burden of being the difference between life and death, and become an unbreakable pillar should evil rear its ugly head. The traditional hero must summon the resolve to combat this evil, even as they are all but broken, but you are not the traditional hero. Where others may falter in this broken state, you thrive. Under these conditions, your resolve burns with the intensity of a thousand suns, amplifying your abilities to a level that should be impossible, and restoring you for one last stand. This also spreads through any allies you have, reigniting broken spirits and lost hope.  So great is this resolve that Fate herself will acknowledge your cause and lend you her blessing, giving you a massive advantage against even the greatest evil. Once said evil is slain, and you recover, you will be rewarded with a permanent portion of the total power you displayed added to your base. This can be a general increase across the board or be poured into one or more specific areas.
addons.title: A Hero’s Resolve

addons.text: "Even if you kill this body, someone stronger than me will surface, and take my place" - Future Gohan The death of a Hero marks the end of an era, and their legacy forever immortalized as legend. But for you, death is rest. A dormant slumber until you are needed once again, a passing of the torch, and an opportunity for rebirth. After triggering Prime Soul, you can pass your spirit to anyone you deem worthy, and they will gain all the qualities of a Hero, even if they seem unfit for it. You will then slumber within them, as a silent mentor that subtlety guides and brings out their full potential. It won't be long until your shadow can be seen behind your host, as if they were your reincarnation. At any point, you can choose to manifest yourself to communicate with your host—whether as a voice, spirit, dreams, etc—or leave them to become reborn as you would normally with Prime Soul. Your previous "incarnation" will still retain their abilities, continuing their path as a Hero, while you continue yours reborn. When they inevitably die, their own Prime Soul is added to yours, alongside their spirit and all of their abilities. You can then choose to resurrect them, let them take over your body, or transfer a portion of their's or your soul to another soon to be Hero at anytime. Creating a cycle where the Hero never truly dies.
addons.title: A Hero’s Will

addons.text: "What you see is what you get, just a guy that loves adventure." - Sonic the Hedgehog The purity of your soul and role as a Hero transcends your very essence into what can only be described as heaven, marking you as Pure of Heart. Your natural talent in any spiritual, magical, or soul based arts lets you achieve feats that should be impossible. The sheer radiance of your being exudes a quiet aura that naturally draws others to you, whether they be future companions who gain solace from your presence, or enemies who see your inner perfection as a threat to their ego. Either way, you possess the ability to slowly, but surely change those around you for the better. A few words of comfort or inspiration from you can be just the spark someone needs to become their very best selves, or perhaps your silly yet charming demeanor can begin the conversion from enemy to ally. The other party this affects must willingly choose to accept the change or not, and doesn't compel or force them in any way. Only offering a nudge and glimpse of what could be. Due to being a Pure Hearted Hero, your resolve has also transcended. Not only is it far more powerful, but tangible, able to be physically felt and touch the hearts of others to ignite their own resolve, or give evil a heart attack. Each activation of your resolve is enhanced tenfold, with far less strain on your body. You can choose to lower the multiplier of your enhanced resolve. Note: If you have Spiritual Transcendance, these effects are exponentially amplified and your resolve's full potency increases to one hundred fold.
addons.title: A Hero's Heart

addons.text: "Set your heart ablaze!" - Kyojuro Rengoku The ignition of your soul lit a fire within you, one that will burn for eternity due to your role as a Hero. Every act of heroism and surge of valor generates Soul Energy in vast amounts, and can be fueled further by either your own performance, or the scale and importance of the act. Simply stockpiling Soul Energy passively enhances your body, and can be used to fuel, empower, refined, or be a substitute requirement for any of your abilities. Such as Life Energy for Reiki (Yu Yu Hakusho), or stabilizing the Kaioken for Ki (Dragon Ball Series). You can easily create new techniques and applications for them and other powers with Arts. With Soul Feats bestowing more powerful ones. Your resolve can now be activated with Soul Energy. Removing the limit of only being proportional to your opposition and risk of death entirely, but will also deplenish Soul Energy in equal proportion. In theory, enough of this Ignited Resolve could let you perform feats like self resurrection, resist soul attacks, or defy fate itself.
addons.title: A Hero’s Soul

addons.text: "Power comes in response to a need, not a desire. You have to create that need." - Son Goku You've evolved into the Shonen Hero, combining your innate talent and intuition as a Hero, with the relentless drive and determination of the Shonen Protagonist. Creating a monstrous combination of potential and power. All of your abilities, and new ones you wish to learn can be understood and improved rapidly through training regiments, with the most gains coming from real combat experience. You can create new techniques or innovations mid fight, and even draw brand new wells of power from thin air through summoning enough will for it. With dire circumstances and desperation increasing the chance for this and its potency. The quirks of the Shonen Hero now have tangible effects on reality, to the point of manifesting the tropes common for such heroes. You can potentially meet a mentor figure to teach your foundational abilities whilst kickstarting your journey, a rival to compare your strength to, gain surges of power through rage, or eat enough food to sustain you for several days. These effects also rub off on other people, such as by rekindling hope through your enthusiasm, your victories as motivation for self improvement, or healing traumas through your kindness. These effects become significantly enhanced with your Resolve, with your own will being able to amplify it. You can also extend the duration of your Resolve through sheer will, though the strain and potential consequences can become dire with prolonged use.
addons.title: Shonen Hero

addons.text: "Fear not citizens, because I AM HERE!" - All Might When a Hero gives his word, he intends to keep it. Others recognize that, and instinctively believe it. When you make a promise to another person, you gain a greater surge of power based on their faith, belief, and trust in you to fulfill it. If they don't know you, or have no reason to hold you in such regard, then you only gain the normal boost from making a promise. Now if you swear to a rescued damsel that you'll bring her back home, her faith in you will make your strength and speed skyrocket to the point of covering miles of ground within seconds and shatter golems with one precise strike. Vowing to master a technique taught by a teacher who sees your potential, will make you develop an even greater growth rate in achieving exactly that. But to swear an oath to a dear friend or lover, that will bestow power and new abilities of legendary status. If you swore a promise to multiple people, their collective faith will further boost your gains. The same rules for making a promise still applies, this just enables you to gain a bonus. Promises to yourself are not affected by this.
addons.title: A Hero's Word

addons.text: "I ain't such a saint that I can promise to risk my life for strangers. But neither am I scum enough to sit quietly by while people are getting hurt before my eyes." - Ichigo Kurosaki On your way to save your companion in need, you gain a surge of valor that raises your speed and is guaranteed to reduce the time it takes to get there by half at bare minimum and upscales with the level of danger they face. A mental breakdown that can potentially lead to suicide will reduce this time to a quarter, while a secret assassination that's one trigger pull away will get you there in seconds. This valor is still temporary and leaves once the matter is resolved, but it will always last longer than any normal boost of valor. You can also ignite your Resolve to go even faster, and even if you were in critical condition, you will be temporarily restored to peak condition for this moment. Once you reach your companion, your valor becomes stockpiled, ensuring that its benefits remain for as long as possible even as it wanes overtime. During this state, you will operate at your absolute maximum to save your companion, such as telling them the words they need to hear to not take their own life or giving the edge needed to put down their assailant. Assuming you were at your wits end beforehand, your condition will improve just enough to be manageable at best after the event resolves. Otherwise, you will return to your baseline. Finally, you can designate people besides those select few companions as targets for this power.
addons.title: The One Protector

addons.text: "Look at the sky! It's a bird, it's a plane! No, its Superman!" Every heroic feat you've achieved now becomes immortalized and recorded into your very essence, transforming you into a living legend. You can call upon the experiences of those achievements to recreate them or create a new and more grander one based on them. For example, if you were seemingly swallowed whole by a dragon but destroyed it from the inside and emerged no worse for ware, you can recreate that feat again, or perform a derivate of it. If you were well renown for slaying dragons in a multitude of ways, those experiences will translate into slaying other monsters of equal threat level. If villains feared you for a signature characteristic or technique you possess, it will never dull with time nor be any less impressive than your best showing of it. You also gain a subtle form of "Hero’s Luck" when traveling to a new world, such as being given better commadations by a Guild or Inn by instinctively recognizing your legendary status—even if they aren't fully aware of it—or finding equipment tailor made for you in dungeons.
addons.title: Legendary Hero

objects.text:
You possess the heart of a hero, embodying hope, courage, and resolve. You are a champion of good, a defender of the weak, and a slayer of evil—the Hero of heroes.

Your path as a hero gives you an instinctive sense of where you need to be, guided by a subtle awareness of what lies ahead. This can allow you to find hidden dungeons, sense when your party is in danger, guide you to informants, pick up traces of evil schemes, or just know when someone needs a hand. It’s the ultimate skill for a hero, ensuring you’re always in the right place at the right time.

As a hero, your natural talent is legendary, granting you a knack for almost anything—swordsmanship, magic, diplomacy, and more. In whatever field you choose to practice, you're exceptional. You adapt and learn quickly, though your knack doesn’t extend to abilities requiring unique conditions, like divine or draconic powers. If you prefer specialization over versatility, you can choose, once, to redistribute your talent—for example, becoming a savant in magic at the cost of slower progress in other skills.

You are a hero who draws strength from valor. When you shield or save someone from harm, you gain a surge of power that amplifies your abilities and evolves the powers tied to your actions. Defending your allies might boost your body’s defenses, while healing a child with magic could deepen your healing affinity. The magnitude of the boost scales with how difficult the task is for you—walking an old lady across the street would have little effect, while protecting an entire city from doom would grant an immense surge of power. These boosts are always temporary, and you can’t control how they manifest.

The most important trait of a hero is your resolve. In dire situations, you can ignite your resolve to grow stronger in proportion to the danger you face. A minor robbery grants a small boost, while a last stand against a Demon Lord can push you to incredible heights. This ability sharpens every aspect of your being, adapting to the danger. It doesn’t grant new powers but perfects your existing ones to overcome obstacles. Once the danger passes, your powers return to normal, leaving you heavily exhausted. Frequently igniting your resolve could potentially lead to death, so use this wisely.
objects.title: Hero

addons.text:
Now, in case your body dies or you simply wish to, you can move your soul to the body of one of your sensories. This will also transfer any powers you originally had to your new body. If the original body still exists, it now becomes a sensory.

You do not get to keep any powers from the sensories you’re possessing; you’re simply using them while you’re in their body. You keep any powers you’ve developed on your own though.
addons.title: Spare Vessels

addons.text: No longer are you powerless when outside your body. Now, your spiritual form retains all the powers you possessed, as well as all the benefits of being a Prime Soul, making you even more powerful while outside your mortal shell.
addons.title: Power Projection

addons.text:
You can now manifest your astral projection without losing control of your body. When you do so, your multitasking capabilities will rise with the express purpose of allowing you to control both your body and spirit at the same time, effortlessly coordinating their actions.

Moreover, your aura solidifies your astral projection, allowing it to wield both mind- and soul-related powers, as well as possess physical capabilities on par with your body for as long as your aura remains intact.
addons.title: Astral Platinum

addons.text:
Your ability to manifest ghostly replacement limbs and channel the light of your soul has further strengthened your Astral Projection, elevating you to a true master of Soul-Body Dualism.

Due to this, you now possess the rare and potent ability to regenerate your physical form should your body be destroyed. This process is inherently slow, typically taking several weeks, as your soul patiently weaves together flesh and bone from pure memory and spirit. However, by willingly burning your Aura as fuel, this regeneration can be significantly hastened—at the cost of temporarily weakening your spiritual defenses and combat abilities.

Beyond this, your mastery of Soul-Body Dualism grants you two advanced and esoteric capabilities, each a reflection of the deep harmony between soul and vessel:

-Phantom Resilience

Your astral form is no longer a mere projection—it is a fortified extension of your essence. It gains resistance to most forms of psychic intrusion, soul-severing attacks, and energy-based disruptions. Entities that prey on spiritual weaknesses find little purchase in you. The seamless synergy between your body and spirit grants stability under conditions that would unmake lesser beings. And even severe damage to your soul can be recovered from given enough time.

-Possession Resistance and Override

Hostile entities attempting to possess, control, or corrupt your body or soul are repelled automatically, as your dominion over selfhood is absolute.
On the inverse, you can override spiritually vacant or weakened hosts—temporarily inhabiting bodies, constructs, or objects by flooding them with your soul-light. This allows you to operate vehicles without touching them, animate statues, or briefly commandeer unconscious or soulless creatures. The more complex the vessel, the greater the strain on your Aura.

These capabilities mark the beginning of your transcendence beyond the limits of flesh, time, and space—making your soul not just a vessel, but a weapon, a shield, and a guide.
addons.title: Soul-Body Dualism
Multi‑Projection
addons.text:
Due to the flexibility of your soul, which is also a mind capable of splitting into several parts, you are now able to send out multiple Astral Projections, spending one stream of thought on each, including one to control your body.

This division is limited by the number of parallel streams of consciousness and overall fatigue - each projection individually expends stamina or an equivalent energy resource to sustain its existence and activity.

objects.text:
You can leave your body in the form of an intangible and invisible spirit. The spirit naturally resembles your physical form, complete with any clothes you may have worn, although you may tweak it to an extent. Like discarding or changing your clothes, appearing slightly younger or older, etc.

When in your spirit form, you cannot be felt, heard, seen, or otherwise interacted with by other beings unless they possess extremely high levels of spiritual awareness or you deliberately allow them to interact with you. Naturally, this makes you invulnerable to any damage not targeting your soul specifically, as any attack will simply pass through you without harm.

While you are in the spirit form, you can travel anywhere in the universe, fly across the cosmos, teleport to other dimensions, even into the minds and dreams of others. But be aware of dangers, as some entities may have ways to deal with unwanted intruders and can force you out, imprison, or harm you if you are not strong enough.

Due to your new nature, you can now perceive any supernatural entities, be they ghosts, spirits, or even pure souls, and can interact with them the same way you would with another living being. If you are strong enough, you can even eject the souls of others, which can be incredibly detrimental if the target does not have any spiritual awareness and capability to return to their body, trapping them forever as an incorporeal existence.

While you are in the spirit form, your physical body lies asleep, although it still requires nourishment, so be sure not to leave it for too long. Should your body perish, you can continue your existence as a spirit until you find a way to rebuild your body or construct a new one.
objects.title: Astral Projection

addons.text: Within hell, one can confuse the body to be seperate from the soul. This is true within the realm of the living, but here, your body is a representation of your soul. Thus, you will be a Prime Soul for the duration of your stay in hell. It doesn't make clearing the tower any easier, but it sure would help subjugating demons.
addons.title: Hell's Prime

objects.text:
"Welcome to Hell! Where the heat is unbearable, the Wi-Fi is nonexistent, the customer service is always unavailable, and bureaucracy is slightly slower than usual! Whether you got here by sin or sheer bad luck, one thing’s for sure—you’re never leaving. Please take a number, and our demons will be with you in a indeterminate amount of time, and remember—screaming does not expedite the process!"

It seems... You're dead. When you died, how, and for what purpose doesn't matter now, all that does, is the fact you are fell right onto the floors of hell. But not all hope is lost! You have the special privilege of being able to leave, and to not have any mandatory torture! Do know that entering hell will have your body be restored in good condition, however your mind and soul will remain untouched in the process of restoration.

Well, “leave” is a strong word, more like escape. After putting your name at the front desk, you have one year to climb the indestructible tower, an extremely tall structure that houses various monsters, challenges, and puzzles. All of which are designed to be extremely difficult the moment you entered hell, but never impossible. Luckily for you, this is only set when you enter hell each time, so you can get stronger without worry.

Although you have time limit on escaping, you can opt to instead challenge powerful demons to claim their power as your own. The power of these individual demons vary greatly, but claiming there power will make you just as powerful. Not all demons are eligible to be challenged, only the powerful. Only some demons will attack on sight, as most near the tower are around to ensure everything is going smoothly. This can also be done for demons outside of your personal hell, but that would naturally require leaving your hell.
 
The details of the hell you reside in is somewhat dependent on the setting you are in, but it can be more accurately described as a personal hell. Not in the sense that it's a hell made just for you, but that no other notably powerful and foreign being can interact with you. This isn't to say that your personal hell isn't connected to the rest of hell, you just don't have to worry about foreign intrusion.

Managing to escape hell will have your body be completely rejuvenated, or a new one created that's exactly the same, depending on the condition of your corpse. Any improvements you made in hell will carry over.

If you fail to escape in time, you're stuck in hell for all eternity... Although, if you manage to somehow escape anyways through other means, you can still be eligible for the tower if you enter hell again. Also, the affect of foreign intrusions not being allowed will be lifted, giving demons- or any other horrid creature, free reign to torture you for all eternity, or worse.

If you die in hell though, you will just be dropped where you originally landed in hell, giving you infinite tries! Although there will be scars left behind as a constant reminder of your failures.

And remember, the Tower is NOT on your side, and never will be.
objects.title: To Hell and Back

objects.text:
Inside your soul, there are endless library shelves packed to capacity with empty books, ready to be filled. The instant that someone comes inside ten meters of you, one of those books starts writing itself, documenting their entire life from birth to this moment. All the things they've done, everything that has happened to them and why it is all written down in real time. Even when they venture out of your radius, the book will keep updating as long as they are alive. When they die, the writing stops. If they somehow return to life, a sequel will spawn, picking up right where the first book left off.

The way the book is written is totally up to you. It can be a classic novel, a firsthand autobiography from their own perspective, a detailed documentary breaking down every event, or even a fully illustrated manga. You decide how deep it goes it can be a quick rundown of the big moments or an insanely detailed, moment by moment account of their entire life.

Getting the information you need is easy. You can pop into the library by focusing, walking along the shelves in your mind, or just summon a copy of the book into your hands. No time is lost paging through copies, as there is a built in search function that lets you find exactly what you need in seconds. When you're done, just release the book, and it will cease to exist.
objects.title: Library of Life

objects.text: Within these sacred yet accursed scriptures lies the doctrine of a sect unlike any other—one that embraces the inescapable truth that all life is born into suffering. Across the Three Realms, from emperor to beggar, all are bound by karma to the ceaseless wheel of samsara. Desire begets pain, and pain chains the soul to endless rebirth. Yet from this ocean of sorrow emerges a singular path of twisted grace: the way of the Heavenly Demon—a paradoxical figure who incarnates all suffering not to rule, but to redeem. Neither god nor devil, the Heavenly Demon is a vessel forged in sin and burdened with karma, devouring the wicked not out of wrath, but to purify them. They shoulder what others cannot, capable of transmuting poison into medicine, and walk the world not to escape it—but to descend, so that others may rise. To tread this path is to enter the flames willingly. It is a cultivation of six trials, each one a shedding of humanity and an immersion into defilement. Until even the stars bear witness to your fall and ascent. The soul of the practitioner becomes a black lotus blooming in the abyss—feeding on suffering, refining transgression, and transmuting it into boundless might. As sins are devoured and karma consumed, the body is reforged, the spirit tempered, and the will awakened. This journey begins with the transformation of flesh, Stage One – The Red Body: A Bronze body surpassing mortal limits, tireless, with strength vast enough to rival a hundred men, and unbreakable bones. Blood runs vibrant crimson dense with vitality, and from the hands blaze the purifying fires of Naraka—not to destroy, but to cleanse. With every soul consumed, the practitioner sinks deeper into the inferno, taking in others' suffering so that they may return to the cycle of rebirth unburdened. As one continues, each tribulation reforges the body and soul further—Stage Two – The Thousand Agonies: Eyes awaken to the threads of karma as illusions shatter. The body heals without rest, yet never without suffering as though being seared alive. Muscles swell with the strength of a thousand as flesh hardens like Iron, and the flames that once only cleansed the spirit now also mend the body, and with each wound healed, they take upon another's wounds and pain as the flames burn away at their body. Every burden taken deepens the descent, where holiness and defilement become one. Eventually, coming to Stage Three – Judgment Manifestation: The flesh becomes divine Steel, blood turns to sacred nectar, and heaven's judgment answers your call. Lightning cleaves the sky in retribution; storms rend the earth not from anger but from karmic balance, striking down sinners with unyielding might. The practitioner becomes both storm and stillness, fury and compassion. Later, all impurities are expelled, coming to Stage Four – The Inner World: The body becomes ageless and perfected, now of celestial Gold. An inner realm awakens—an embryonic world of Dharma and intent—able to impress its will onto reality at great cost. Strength swells to mythic heights, holding the might of a million men, not for conquest, but to carry the weight of countless sins. In the penultimate phase, worldly limits are cast aside of Stage Five – Void Ascendency: Mountains shatter, stars tremble, and chaos itself flows through the practitioner's veins. Their inner world now consumes the outer, bending reality within its bounds to their law. What was once the self becomes the cosmos. Finally, onto the last step, the self dissolves, arriving at Stage Six – True Samsara: Desire vanishes—save the burdens inherited from all sentient beings. With one thought, they can reshape existence. With one breath, rewrite samsara. Yet to become the Heavenly Demon is not to transcend, but to remain. To become the final chain at the base of the wheel—its last, willing link. This is the final truth of the Heavenly Demon—a willing sacrifice who turns back at the gates of ascension, bearing the world's karma so others may rise. Neither god nor devil, but the last anchor chained in lotus flame, walking the night so others may see the dawn.
objects.title: Heavenly Demon Sutra

addons.text:
It seems that, just like the Martial King, you too are a dwarf. Because of this, your very nature aligns with the ancient path he walked, allowing you to learn and wield The Living Forge Sutra with a level of proficiency that other races can only dream of. While others must struggle against their limitations to even grasp its core principles, you embody them as though they were etched into your very soul. But what truly sets you apart is not just your natural affinity—it is the inheritance of a secret only dwarves practicing the Sutra can unlock: the Flaming Heart Breath, a technique passed down by the Martial King himself, created to overcome the greatest weakness of his kin.

The Flaming Heart Breath is no mere breathing exercise; it is a method of altering the very foundation of the body, reshaping its nature to transcend the inherent limitations of dwarven stature. The Martial King, despite his unparalleled skill, understood that dwarves, for all their endurance and strength, were born with a disadvantage in size. Their reach was short, their frames compact, and their ability to forge larger works was hindered by their very biology. Such a flaw was unacceptable to the greatest martial artist and smith in history. Thus, the Flaming Heart Breath was born—not merely to enhance power, but to forge the body itself into something greater. 

As you train in The Living Forge Sutra, your breathing will be altered to match that of the Flaming Heart Breath, with the breathing technique subtly integrating itself into your body, altering your form. Over time, your stout frame expands—not losing the raw durability of dwarven heritage, but elevating it. Your body grows broader, your muscles denser, your bones harder than iron. Your height increases as though you were a blade reforged, until even among humans and other tall races, you are no lesser in stature. Those who diligently train for a year find themselves standing at a minimum of two meters, with some surpassing even that, their forms reminiscent of the Martial King himself—giants among their kin, walking anvils of flesh and steel.

Yet, this transformation is not simply about physical might. Every increase in mass, every ounce of newfound size, is in perfect harmony with the Living Forge Sutra. Greater mass means greater internal heat retention, allowing Fire Burst to burn hotter and spread through the body more efficiently. Larger muscles ensure that Burning Spirit can process and redirect extreme temperatures without strain, turning excess energy into further refinement. The broader frame provides a stronger foundation for Steel Soul, ensuring that weapons forged by the practitioner hold even greater stability, infused with the very essence of an unshakable body. In the end, this is not merely an enhancement—it is the completion of the Sutra, the final step toward becoming a living forge, where mind, body, and spirit burn as one, refining not just weapons, but the very self into something truly indestructible.
addons.title: Disciple of the Martial King

objects.text:
The Living Forge Sutra is a legendary cultivation technique created by the dwarven Martial King, a master smith whose philosophy held that true strength comes not from destruction, but from creation. Born from centuries of refinement, hardship, and the relentless pursuit of perfection, this technique treats the body as a piece of raw ore, the spirit as the flame, and the will as the hammer. Those who follow this path do not simply cultivate—they forge themselves anew, tempering their very being through fire and hardship.

The foundation of the Living Forge Sutra rests upon three core techniques: Fire Burst, Burning Spirit, and Steel Soul. Fire Burst is a technique that amplifies and refines flames, enhancing not only their heat but also their ability to channel spiritual energy, allowing a forge to burn with unnatural intensity. Burning Spirit is a method of absorbing and redirecting heat, using the stray energies of the forge to temper the body while replenishing stamina, ensuring that no power is wasted. Steel Soul is the act of forging itself—not merely the shaping of metal, but the infusion of one’s will into creation, allowing weapons to carry an intent beyond mere craftsmanship. Together, these three techniques demand immense focus, as a practitioner must keep the fire burning, absorb and redistribute its energy, and forge with precision—all at the same time. Mastery over these techniques is not about using them individually, but as one seamless process, for they are interdependent. Too much heat from Fire Burst will destroy the weapon and the forge without the redirection of Burning Spirit, and overly concentrated spiritual heat into a weapon with Burning Spirit without understanding it through Steel Soul will only shatter it. Likewise, Steel Soul without spiritual heat cannot bring out the latent power of materials, rendering the forging process incomplete.

As mastery over these techniques deepens, Fire Burst evolves to the point where a practitioner can superheat their body at will, igniting their very aura into a raging inferno capable of melting weapons mid-strike or setting the battlefield ablaze. Burning Spirit refines the body beyond mortal limits, allowing the practitioner to withstand the heat of molten metal with bare hands, absorb enemy fire techniques to strengthen themselves, and convert battle intent into raw power. Steel Soul reaches the realm where weapons are no longer just tools, but living extensions of the will—swords that resonate with their wielder, warhammers that refuse to break, and weapons so deeply connected to their master that they return when called. At the highest level, a cultivator of the Living Forge Sutra can craft weapons in the heat of battle using only their own hands, their every strike shaping the world itself like a blacksmith molding steel. 

The cultivation path of the Living Forge Sutra follows a process akin to the refining of metal, divided into seven progressive stages. The Raw Ore Stage marks the beginning, where the cultivator is full of impurities, weak and untempered. The Smelting Stage follows, where hardship and suffering burn away their flaws, forging them in the crucible of experience. The Quenching Stage tempers the will, forcing them to endure overwhelming pressure and pain, just as metal is cooled to harden its structure. The Tempering Stage refines their combat technique, achieving balance between offense and defense like a perfectly honed blade. The Living Steel Stage is the point at which the cultivator’s body becomes as indestructible as their spirit, immune to mundane weapons and mortal afflictions. The Divine Forge Stage allows them to reshape matter itself, their very presence radiating the heat and authority of a master smith at work. The Anvil of Creation, the final stage, grants the cultivator absolute mastery over their craft, where their mere will can shape destiny as a blacksmith shapes metal.

At the peak of mastery, a Living Forge practitioner stands within an active volcano, their surroundings unnaturally cool as they absorb and redirect the overwhelming heat, crafting weapons with their bare hands. Hammers are deemed unnecessary, for only direct contact allows them to fully understand the steel they shape. In battle, their bodies shine like molten metal, able to withstand even the deadliest of strikes without breaking. Enemies who wield steel find their weapons betraying them, liquefying at a touch or shattering under the cultivator’s overwhelming will. At the highest level, their presence alone warps the battlefield, turning it into their personal forge, where every strike is a hammer blow that reshapes the fight to their advantage. Such masters do not merely fight—they refine themselves in every battle, eternally forging their path to perfection.
objects.title: The Living Forge Sutra

addons.text:
You've tapped into a powerful connection with the elements, blending your shamanic abilities with the ancient art of totem creation. This newfound power allows you to create stationary totems that channel the Shaman Magic of the World of Warcraft universe.

Unlike in the game, you don't summon totems directly. Instead, you craft them, imbuing them with specific symbols and effects. The potency of the totem's power is directly linked to its quality and the strength of your connection to the elements.

These totems are not mere trinkets. They are extensions of your will, bound to you through the elemental energies you infuse within them. This allows you to summon them at will, bringing their power to bear, and then dismiss them back to their original location when you are done.

Initially, you can only maintain one active totem, but as your mastery grows, you'll unlock the ability to wield multiple totems simultaneously.
addons.title: Shamanic Arts

addons.text:
Due to your druidic nature, your art form of totem creation has evolved. At a base level totem creation is far more intuitive, easier, and generates a far more powerful effect than it did before. Alongside this your totems now can absorb and store Natural Energy, with the amount dependent on the quality of the totem. 

On its own, the ability to absorb and store Natural Energy isn't very strong due to you not being able to actively siphon from it but alongside this, you now gain the ability to bind Natural Arts to your totems which you, or anyone, can cast using its pool of Natural Energy. If the totem has no Natural Art bound to it then the Natural Energy inside passively enhances the totem's effect.
addons.title: Druidcraft

objects.text:
You have gained the art of making supernatural totems. These totems have a few basic requirements: they have to be made of a natural material, and you have to make them yourself. Totems, in essence, are objects that grant their wielder, or an area, a passive or semi-passive supernatural effect of some kind based on symbolism. To create a totem, you need to have a generalized effect in mind, an image, symbolism that connects the effect and image, and intent on what the purpose of the totem is. The strength of the effect depends on how well the symbolism connects the image and effect, the strength of your intent, the effort put into the totem creation, and the materials used: both the strength and symbolism connected to the material.

There are two main forms of totems: personal and stationary. Personals are handheld totems that typically provide the buff to the wielder and only the wielder, typically in the form of necklaces or other accessories. On the other hand, stationary totems apply a supernatural effect to an area instead of a person, typically being far larger and heavier. Some examples of totems could be a wolf enhancing your senses, a bear increasing your strength and minorly increasing your durability, and possibly even a dragon increasing your physical and magical might. As a result of the effect being so intent-based, your totems can selectively work on certain people if done correctly and visualized well enough.

While a totem will be slightly more durable than its natural materials, they are by no means indestructible.

To complement this, you have now been granted a natural talent in carving, visualization, and how to process and use natural ingredients.
objects.title: Totem Creation

addons.text:
Your path of blood and devouring has evolved. With your mastery over alchemy, you’ve turned what was once crude consumption into a refined and horrific art. No longer limited to ripping flesh with your own hands, you now understand how to extract and refine the essence of your prey with precision and purpose. You are no mere butcher—you are a chef of sin, a connoisseur of forbidden refinement.

Through your alchemical knowledge, you can now process flesh, bone, soul, and spirit into concentrated elixirs—potent brews that contain the strength, skills, and spiritual essence of those you have slain. The process is brutal and irreversible, often requiring rare catalysts to bind the remnants of life into a stable form, but the results are unmatched: years of cultivation condensed into a single, steaming draught. The blood of a hero might grant battle instincts; the marrow of an elder cultivator, a surge in cultivation; the soul of a genius, fragments of technique or memory.

You may also distill the more intangible aspects you consume—hatred, despair, obsession—into alchemical reagents or enchantments, allowing you to corrupt items, brew curses, or imbue yourself and others with temporary bursts of stolen power. Potions made in this manner may carry lingering malice, granting strength at a price, or acting as lures to draw in weaker prey.

Eventually, your skill will reach the point where even the concept of consumption becomes a ritual. You may prepare bodies and souls as sacrificial ingredients in grand alchemical rites—each sacrifice not just feeding you, but reshaping you. Over time, your body becomes an evolving cauldron, your blood a living solvent that refines what you devour even before it reaches your stomach.

The deeper your cultivation, the more potent your concoctions. What begins as crude slaughter becomes something else entirely—something deliberate, methodical, and terrifying. You are no longer simply a predator. You are a kitchen of nightmares, a temple of slaughter, and a laboratory of damnation.
addons.title: Gourmet of the Damned

addons.text:
You've learned to apply your culinary alchemy to the gruesome fuel that feeds your needs as a demonic cultivator. Instead of gorging yourself on the flesh of your victims like a wild beast or barbarian, you turn their bodies into a marvelous, mouthwatering display that will seem near-irresistible to all who remain blissfully ignorant of its grisly source. Using your culinary skill you carefully season and pair meat with the finest fruit, vegetables and herbs, ideally those with spiritual or mystic properties, to refine its properties and magnify its effects.

Prepared correctly and coupled with other ingredients of sufficient quality traits such as the lineage or aptitude can be refined, making the flesh of a beast with distant draconic ancestry give the same benefits as if you'd eaten the pure-blooded dragon it had descended from, or letting the tendons of a middling Sword Cultivator marinate until they are indistinguishable from those of a Nascent Sword Saint. Though here too the rule that the better your ingredients, the better the ultimate result can be when properly prepared still applies.

You are also able to precisely extract specific things from your victim and into your meals, creating a blood wine that will impart the drinker with all the secrets of the source's sect, or a platter of appetizers that when eaten will imbue the consumer with the knowledge how to perform specific secret arts the user knew in life.

Properly leveraged and with the correct ingredients the inherent sophistication and refinement of culinary alchemy can even mitigate, though by no means neutralize, the drawbacks inherent to demonic Qi, allowing you to hold on to more of what you were for longer. Some rumors claim that it is possible to stop and possibly even revert the effects of demonic Qi through cooking, though a dish with such properties would require both peerless culinary skill and ingredients of outright mythical quality and rarity to cook up.

Finally and perhaps most mundanely, your culinary alchemy allows you to adjust properties such as flavor, consistency and texture of your ingredients, allowing you to, should you have grown weary of meat dishes, further your cultivation while enjoying what looks, feels and tastes like sweet pastries, a fruit salad, or even a milkshake. More malevolently this can also be used to carefully lure unsuspecting victims onto the path of the Demonic Cultivator, whether as disciples or merely convenient distractions and scapegoats.

If you must be a monster, at the very least you can be a classy one rather than a savage.
addons.title: Culinarian of the Macabre Feast

addons.text:
You have transcended the crude beginnings of raw consumption and stepped into a higher, blood-soaked cultivation method—one that fuses the savage hunger of the demonic path with the divine intuition of the Killing Dao. No longer do you simply devour to grow. Now, you cultivate through slaughter itself. Each act of killing is no longer just a means of survival—it is a ritual, a refinement, a step further on the path toward absolute power.

In your hands, death is cultivation. Every life you take, every soul extinguished beneath your will, is absorbed not only for its Qi, but for the resonance it stirs within your demonic essence. The moment of death becomes sacred, a transference of meaning and might, sharpening your Killing Intent while feeding your demonic Qi. The two paths no longer walk side by side—they have become one. Devouring empowers your slaughter. Slaughter enriches what you devour. Together, they fuel a dual cultivation method that grows stronger the deeper into carnage you sink.

In the early stages, the physical body is your gateway—blood, bones, marrow, and soul essence, consumed piece by piece. But now, death itself becomes something you can absorb. A scream, a dying breath, the final surge of willpower before collapse—these are sustenance. The fear you inspire, the despair you provoke, the violence you unleash—it all gathers in the Sea of Blood within you, refining your Qi in ways traditional cultivators cannot even fathom. 

Your Killing Intent now functions as a spiritual forge. Each death fans its flames, allowing it to burn hotter and reach further, while simultaneously tempering your demonic Qi with greater strength and cohesion. The Heaven Slaughter Star grants you an instinctive understanding of this process—each enemy, each battlefield, each massacre becomes a perfect storm of cultivation, where every blow is a lesson, and every kill a breakthrough.

The more you kill, the more refined your power becomes. The more you devour, the more profound your Killing Dao grows. And in the union of these two paths, a truth becomes clear: in you, the act of murder is not mindless destruction—it is enlightenment by blade, ascension by blood.
addons.title: Butcher King of Ten Thousand Corpses

addons.text:
