All demonic cultivators share the same fatal flaw—a crumbling, unstable foundation. Their power rises swiftly but erratically, built on stolen life and devoured essence, lacking cohesion or spiritual balance. But you are different. Where others rot from the inside out, collapsing beneath the weight of what they consume, you have forged something deeper. Something darker. Something unbreakable.

Your Negative Emotion Drive serves as the cornerstone of your cultivation, not merely fueling your growth but stabilizing it. Every scar you carry, every scream you’ve swallowed, every betrayal, loss, fury, and hopeless moment—you don’t run from them. You bury them into your Qi. You refine your rage, your despair, your grief, and your hatred into a stabilizing pressure, compressing your demonic Qi into something thicker, denser, more potent than anything a traditional cultivator could dream of. This is your Abyssal Foundation: a wellspring of power forged from pain, refined by loathing, and unshakable in its resolve.

The more you suffer, the more complete you become. This foundation mutates your body and soul alike. Slowly, traits begin to emerge—unique, visceral, often grotesque, always powerful. Claws like black razors. A heart that beats with molten Qi. Eyes that see weakness as cracks in reality. These traits are not bestowed—they are born from within, shaped by your trauma, and polished by your hatred.

You begin weak, of course. Every step forward is one earned through pain. But as your cultivation deepens, your abyss grows wider, and your form begins to change. Your physique warps to reflect your evolution. These are not blessings granted from above, but scars turned to armor—mutations born from resilience. 

And while others crumble under the spiritual corruption of demonic Qi, your foundation only strengthens. Because your Qi is not wild—it is you. It knows your pain. It is your pain, given shape, structure, and purpose.
addons.title: Abyssal Foundation

addons.text:
The path of demonic cultivation is one of hunger, and with absorption as part of your nature, that hunger has become efficient. You no longer carry the weight of useless traits. Any ability, mutation, or feature gained through absorption that no longer serves your path can be broken down completely. You may cast off the unnecessary, not through rejection, but through refinement.

These discarded traits are not wasted. Once removed, they are reduced to raw cultivation energy, fueling your progress directly. This energy can be used to strengthen your foundation, increase cultivation speed, break through bottlenecks, and repair any part of your cultivation should it ever unstablizes or becomes crippled. Even if an enemy damages your core or wounds your path, you can burn what you no longer need to recover.

Nothing you consume is ever lost. You take, you refine, and when something no longer fits, you burn it down to rise further. Furthermore, you now also gain more traits and deeper benefits from devouring others, since the process itself has become far more powerful.
addons.title: Ashes to Essence

addons.text:
Though demonic cultivation offers immense power, its unstable nature corrodes the mind, soul, and foundation of the practitioner. But no more, this advanced refinement method—The Tempered Abyss Path—integrates the core teachings of the Foundational Arts into your blood-soaked path, creating a stabilized foundation to anchor your spirit and mitigate the madness that often consumes demonic cultivators. Rather than suppressing your demonic essence, this path tempers it—like folding steel—through ritual, reflection, and structured inner cultivation, allowing you to remain lucid without sacrificing power.

The key lies in harmonizing your Blood Qi with worldly Qi before it becomes fully demonic. Through daily meditations, spiritual grounding techniques, and internal circulation patterns derived from the Foundational Manual, you can refine stolen essence into purified force, stabilizing your inner core and slowing mental degradation. While you still consume to grow, your soul is no longer flooded with the raw chaos of devoured spirits—instead, that power is processed through a tempered cycle, reducing instability and allowing for long-term cultivation without collapse.

With continued discipline, your Blood Core evolves into a Bound Core, a hybrid structure of demonic and balanced energy that allows for steady breakthroughs without spiritual distortion. Madness becomes manageable—no longer a looming inevitability, but a force you can channel selectively, weaponize, or seal as needed. The Tempered Abyss Path doesn’t cleanse your darkness; it masters it, granting all the raw power of the demonic path with the resilience and clarity of a refined cultivator.
addons.title: Tempered Abyss Path

addons.text:
You have learned the Living Puppet Ritual, a particularly feared and abhorred technique of demonic cultivation. A difficult ritual with a low success-rate, the result is nonetheless terrifying.

The ritual requires the demonic cultivator to capture a victim alive, render them immobile, and then slowly extract and absorb the target's soul without killing the body, only to then immediately inject their own spiritual energy tinged with the victim's soul back into the body in a cyclical way, repeated again and again over the span of hours if not days until the victim's soul has been fully replaced by the demonic cultivator's energy which has taken on all properties of the victim's soul.

The difficulties here are manifold, from outside interference, the victim breaking free, and most commonly the appetite of the demonic cultivator tempting him to drink too greedily of the soul, causing damage that causes the victim to expire. The last case is most common because to a demonic cultivator the ritual is an exercise in frustration, requiring absolute concentration while only slowly sipping when the inclination is to gulp. Initially the success-rate of the ritual is below 1%, though talent, self-control, and practice can over time increase the odds of success dramatically.

When pulled off successfully, the resulting Living Puppet is indistinguishable from the person they used to be, only with absolute and unbreakable loyalty to the one who conducted the ritual on them. Memories, personality, behavior, skills, everything remains unchanged and the Living Puppet can even continue cultivating, there is no way to tell a Living Puppet apart from a regular person, even all but the most in-depth and thorough soul-searching techniques performed by someone on a far higher state of cultivation than both the Demonic Cultivator and the Living Puppet will fail to find anything wrong.

These Living Puppets make formidable spies, able to lure other victims into the waiting arms of their master, or once the limits of their own cultivation have been reached or their master demands it, the Living Puppet will willingly serve themselves as a far more scrumptious feast than they would have been when first captured.

Rightfully feared as being able to supplant entire Sects if not caught, any knowledge of how to perform this technique is purged by righteous cultivators, and should any discover that you know how to perform it, prepare to be relentlessly hunted to the ends of the earth and beyond.
addons.title: Living Puppet Ritual

addons.text: Your Killing Intent has evolved from a mere quirk of power to the foundation of your cultivation. It replaces your Demonic or Blood Qi, serving as a direct method of cultivation, letting you cultivate in a more primal & efficient manner; you no longer need to follow the standard cultivation methods that others do, as you can  cultivate simply through the growth of your Killing Intent. It still benefits from whatever benefits your Blood Qi or Demonic Qi might have provided, or cultivation techniques that your Demon Cultivation teaches, however. At this point, you posses a brutal and primitive method more befitting an animalistic predator instead of a refined cultivator.
addons.title: Sanguine Cultivation

objects.text:
You have abandoned the righteous path, turning your back on balance, order, and enlightenment. Where others draw Qi from the air and rise through meditation and harmony, you have chosen the forbidden. You cultivate by consuming—devouring life, stealing potential, and reforging it into something twisted, something stronger. Your power is not earned through peace or introspection, but through bloodshed and desecration.

Unlike orthodox cultivation, which advances through spiritual refinement and Qi absorption, demonic cultivation thrives on devouring others. In the beginning, this process is physical and brutal: you must consume the actual flesh, blood, and organs of other living beings to grow your Blood Qi. The stronger the victim, the greater the benefit—especially if they are cultivators, monsters, or other beings with refined energy.

As your cultivation increases, you gain the ability to extract and absorb more refined forms of power—spiritual energy, Qi directly, or even intangible aspects such as memories, emotions, and souls. However, even at these higher levels, using the physical body as a medium remains the easiest and most efficient method. The body serves as a natural vessel, trapping and concentrating these aspects in one place, allowing you to devour them all at once. Purely spiritual consumption is possible, but more difficult and far less reliable—there is always something left behind unless you reduce the target to nothing. 

Where others master stages like Qi Condensation, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, and beyond through careful study and spiritual harmony, you mirror those stages through blood-soaked equivalents: bathing in gore, hardening your body through devoured marrow, condensing your own Blood Core from stolen lives. As your cultivation deepens, you brand your soul with the remnants of those you’ve slain, turning inner demons into weapons, and ultimately ascend by drowning yourself in suffering until you rise above it.

As your Blood Qi deepens, it transforms into demonic Qi—a volatile and chaotic force that grants immense power but corrodes both mind and soul. The more you feed it, the stronger you become, but the further you drift from what you once were. There comes a point where you are no longer merely walking a darker path—you have become something else entirely.
objects.title: Demonic Cultivator

addons.text:
Your purity has ascended to a level beyond even divine, reaching a state of Sacred Transcendence. All things about you—your speech, your blood, your very presence—are now infused with absolute holiness and innocence. 

Your essence transcends mortal and divine purity, becoming a radiant beacon of unblemished sanctity, incapable of being tainted or corrupted by any outside influence.

This sacred clarity makes you a figure of universal reverence. Wherever you go, beings of all kinds view you in the most favorable light, seeing you as the epitome of goodness and incorruptible virtue. 

Your words are believed without question, and you inspire unwavering trust and admiration in all who encounter you. Few, if any, would even consider the possibility of harm from you, for your purity is so absolute that it shields you from doubt or suspicion.

You are now immune to any attempts to corrupt or stain your being. Any imperfection that might approach you is immediately purified, leaving your soul and body as flawless as the moment they were first created. 

Your transcendence ensures that your existence remains unaltered by the world’s darkness, free from the flaws that taint the hearts of others- that nothing can touch or harm the essence of who you are.
addons.title: Sacred Transcendence

addons.text:
You bear the sacred voice of the Divine — a vessel through which holy Hymns flow. These are no ordinary words or songs, but utterances woven with divine resonance, carrying across the boundaries of land, life, and time. Whether spoken or sung, each Hymn channels the will of the Sacred One, echoing with power that touches spirits, mortals, and gods alike.

Your voice is not merely heard — it is felt. It commands the wind, stirs the earth, and speaks to the soul. When you raise your voice in Hymn, it reaches distant realms, transcending barriers both physical and spiritual. Messages of warning, guidance, or command stretch far beyond your presence, imbued with the weight of sacred authority.

The effects of your Hymns are many. You may bless the land, sanctify hearts, or create divine protection. Your words can bring harmony where there was strife, peace where there was fear. A consecrated space sung into being by your voice becomes hallowed ground, warding away chaos and evil.

Yet just as your Hymns may bless, they may also condemn. With equal power, you may declare a soul impure, mark a being for judgment, or proclaim a place profaned — barren from that moment forward, where nothing may grow and no peace may rest. Your voice may cleanse, or it may cast down. The choice is always yours.

What makes the Hymns truly divine is their permanence. Unless you will them to fade, your words remain — echoing eternally through the land, within the hearts of those who heard them, and in the fabric of the world. 

Time cannot erode them, Silence cannot bury them. Even after your voice is gone, your Hymns linger as sacred echoes — guiding, warning, sanctifying, or damning across the ages.

To speak a Hymn is to shape reality. And with each note, each word, you leave behind a trace of the Sacred — eternal, unshakable, divine.
addons.title: Hymns of the Sacred One

addons.text: Your innocence now shields you from literal filth, repelling or eradicating filth and grime such that not even a speck can touch you. Every step you take leaves behind a trail of cleansed perfection. This also either cleans or wards off others who are unclean themselves and attempt to approach you, at your discretion.
addons.title: Divine Cleanliness

objects.text:
You embody a purity that transcends mortal understanding, a state of being untouched by sin or corruption, much like the eternal clarity of divine beings from ancient myths. 

Your essence is a radiant light, dispelling all darkness and shadow, leaving no room for malice, guilt, or temptation to cling to you. No corruption, whether born of mortal flaw or dark magic, can take root within your being.

Where others might need purification, rituals, or cleansing to approach certain places, beings, or artifacts that demand purity, you remain unaffected. 

These sacred spaces, objects, or beings that require innocence to wield or interact with—whether it be the touch of a divine weapon or entry into a sanctified realm—hold no power over you. You are already perfectly pure, you bypass any such requirements effortlessly.

Whether it’s curses, vengeance, or spiritual retribution, none of these forces can touch you. Your divine innocence shields you from harm, making you impervious to the forces that seek to punish or corrupt. 

Nothing in this world—no power, no curse, no trickery—can strip you of this innocence. Not even your own actions, thoughts, or desires can soil this purity. 

It is woven into the very fabric of your being, an eternal force that cannot be undone. You are forever untouched, forever pure, and your divine innocence will remain with you, untainted by the world, as you ascend beyond all that seeks to corrupt.
objects.title: Divine Innocence

objects.text:
You are the most recent to succeed to the throne of Qinglong, the Azure Dragon of the Eastern Heavens, Lord of Mù, holding dominion over Dawn, Spring, Water, Wind, and Dragons.

As the Lord of Dragons, you can change your form between that of a ‘normal’ human and your full divine form as an Eastern Dragon—with any mix in between available. Lesser dragons will instinctively follow your commands.

The Wu Xing element of Mù, also known as Wood—or Tree—is yours to command, with a variety of abilities to discover. Manipulate ink and paper, acid or poison, size, or elasticity. These are but a small handful of the potential abilities available to someone who can manipulate Mù.

You also have the ability to command the element of Air, allowing you to create gusts of wind or scything blades of air. With time, you could generate powerful hurricanes and windstorms to devastate your targets.

Finally, there are the domains of Spring and Dawn. You are the embodiment of new growth and new beginnings. Flowers bloom in your presence, snow melts, and warm, gentle breezes seed the world with new life. You can command plants to grow, rain to fall, and replenish the life force of the old, sick, and weary. During the hours of dawn and the season of Spring, you will find your powers enhanced, gaining greater strength and control.

Your abilities start off capable of leveling city blocks with effort and will only grow with time and experience.
objects.title: Azure Dragon of the East

objects.text:
You are now the most recent to ascend to the throne of Zhūquè, as the Vermillion Bird of the Southern Heavens, Lord of huǒ, with dominion over Summer, Noon, Light, and Birds.

As the Lord of Birds, you are able to freely transform between a 'normal' human form and that of a full Divine Bird—and all stages in between. You can freely communicate with and command avians of all forms, and they will eagerly await your word.

The Wu Xing element of huǒ—or fire—is yours to command, granting you many abilities. Heat, fire, magma, and smoke are among the many things you will discover within huǒ’s power, with more to be discovered with time and patience.

You also have the ability to command light, generating and gathering it to form a variety of techniques and constructs. Becoming invisible or creating visual illusions will be easily within your power with time.

Finally, there are the more esoteric domains of Summer and Noon. You are the very embodiment of abundance and growth. Crops flourish in your presence, fruit ripens on the vine, and the heat of the day blazes as the sun sits high in the sky. With effort, you can scorch the earth itself with this power.

Your abilities start off capable of leveling city blocks with effort and will only grow with time and experience.
objects.title: Vermillion Bird of the South

objects.text:
You are now the most recent successor to the throne of Báihǔ, the White Tiger of the Western Heavens, Lord of jīn, with dominion over Autumn, Dusk, Air, Electricity, and Tigers.

As the Lord of Tigers, you will be able to freely transform between a ‘normal’ human form and a full Divine Tiger form—and everything in between. You will also be able to communicate freely with felines of all kinds, and tigers of all forms will follow your commands.

The Wu Xing element of Jīn, or Metal, is yours to command, granting you many abilities, from the manipulation of crystals and metals to control over ductility and conductivity. These are just a fraction of the potential of the element of metal, with more uses waiting to be discovered.

You have the ability to command the elements of Air and Electricity. The power to create gusts of wind or bolts of lightning is child's play for you. With time, even the command and creation of hurricanes and other such storms will be within your power.

Finally, there are the domains of Autumn and Dusk. While these provide less immediate benefits, they still have their uses. During the hours of dusk and the season of autumn, you will find your powers enhanced, gaining greater strength and control over your abilities.

Your abilities start off capable of levelling city blocks with effort, and will only grow with time and experience.
objects.title: White Tiger of the West

objects.text:
You are now the most recent to be enthroned as Xuanwu, the Black Tortoise of the Northern Heavens, Lord of shuǐ, with dominion over Winter, Midnight, Darkness, Tortoises, and Snakes.

As the Lord of Tortoises and Snakes, you possess the ability to freely transform between a ‘normal’ human form and your full divine form—that of a Tortoise entwined with a Snake—and all intermediary stages. You can communicate with and command Tortoises and Serpents of all kinds, who are eager to follow your every command.

The power of the Wu Xing element of shuǐ—or water—is at your beck and call. You can control all forms of water, from Snow to Steam; even the weather itself bends to your will.

In addition, you wield the power to manipulate Darkness—generating shadows and shaping them into a variety of techniques and constructs. You can travel through shadows and influence others via their shadows. With time, you could even rip shadows away from your targets, creating shadow servants to serve your every whim.

Finally, there are the more esoteric domains of Winter and Midnight. You embody the inevitability of the end, but also the promise of renewal. Plants wither and die in your presence, only to nourish the rebirth of the next season. Animals become skittish and frightened by your aura. You bring the Cold of Winter’s snow, blanketing the earth in endless white. With enough effort, you could even summon a short-lived ice age—if you so desire.
objects.title: Black Tortoise of the North

objects.text:
From the depths of your shadow emerges Selene, a majestic and ancient dire wolf of silver-grey fur, her coat shimmering as though woven from moonlight itself. Her glowing eyes hold the wisdom of ages, luminous and deep as the full moon on a clear night. She is forever bound to your soul — not as a servant, but as an eternal companion, guide, and guardian. Though entirely independent in thought and action, her loyalty to you is absolute, unwavering, and eternal.

Selene can dwell within your shadow, unseen but ever-watchful, moving with you wherever you go. At will, she may step forth from that shadow, manifesting with a presence both graceful and overwhelming. Her form is immense, her frame large enough to carry a grown human with ease, and her strength sufficient to crush steel beneath her jaws or tear through barriers both mundane and magical. Her bite and claws alike ignore defenses, cutting through spells and armor with effortless ease, and her movements are as silent as falling snow, even when racing at blinding speeds.

She can run faster than the eye can follow, reaching her top speed instantly without the need to build momentum. Wherever she runs, gale-force winds follow, though she can temper them into a whisper if she desires. No surface hinders her — water, walls, ceilings — all are paths beneath her paws.

Selene holds dominion over moonlight, shaping it at will. She can illuminate the darkest night with soft silver radiance, heal minor wounds, cleanse impurities, and share her lunar strength with you, enhancing your physical and mental capabilities. Under the moon’s glow, her power swells, and she may extend that blessing to you as well.

With a simple breath, Selene can summon gentle winds, curling mist, or soft rain, and with a subtle effort, part the clouds to reveal the moon’s face. Nature itself seems to listen to her presence, and though her influence over it is subtle, it is undeniable. Her connection to wolves across the world and to ancient myths is deep and instinctive. With a howl, she can summon wolves from afar or command their loyalty without question. Her voice can fill hearts with courage, dispelling fear, breaking mental chains, and inspiring resolve — or she can unleash a howl so fierce and primal that it strikes terror into the hearts of her enemies, shattering their composure.

Selene is wise, motherly, and protective. She speaks to you with clarity and kindness, offering guidance, insight, and ancient wisdom to help you navigate the complexities of life. Her knowledge stretches from nature’s secrets to forgotten legends, and she will never hesitate to remind you of strength and purpose when doubt creeps in.

She is immortal. If ever struck down, she retreats into your shadow, where she rests and regenerates over a day’s time before returning to your side once more. No distance can separate you, for she will come when called, crossing any expanse to stand with you.

Her presence is comforting, her protection absolute, and her companionship eternal. She is your shadow’s sentinel, the whisper of the moon at your side, and the embodiment of loyalty, wisdom, and strength — Selene, the Silver Huntress.
objects.title: The Silver Huntress

objects.text:
You are granted the divine right to rule, marked by the Heavens themselves. The Mandate of Heaven flows through you, giving you undeniable authority over the mortal world.

Those who encounter you feel an instinctive recognition that you are the rightful ruler, chosen not by birth or war, but by Heaven’s will. Your words carry weight, and your decisions shape the lives of all who fall under your rule.

With the Mandate of Heaven, you are an unparalleled leader. Your governance is wise and just, guided by divine providence. Bureaucracy and diplomacy come naturally to you, and your skill in managing both people and resources is unmatched.

Kingdoms flourish under your rule, not merely because of your strength, but because the celestial forces guide your actions. Those who attempt to defy your authority find themselves thwarted, as if fate itself conspires to ensure your success.

The Mandate of Heaven also enhances your ability to inspire loyalty. Soldiers fight bravely under your banner, ministers carry out your will without question, and the common people respect and trust you. Your divine authority is absolute in the mortal realm, and few can challenge your right to rule.
objects.title: Mandate of Heaven

objects.text:
You are the living vessel of Lua’s Luminance, a divine wellspring of moon-born force. Within you burns the infinite radiance of the moon — not merely reflected sunlight, but the ancient, esoteric power that makes the moon a symbol of tides, cycles, stillness, mystery, and rebirth.

This light is yours to command, not only as an external weapon but as an intrinsic part of your being. You do not just wield lunar energy — you are lunar energy, shaped by emotion, intention, and imagination.

At your core is a crystalline reactor of moonlight — your Lunar Heart. It is both an inexhaustible generator and a colossal battery, allowing you to endlessly produce, store, and release lunar energy. It pulses with light under your skin, channels through your soul, and floods your body with strength, clarity, and power. Even sealed away from the sky, you remain a radiant force.

Your energy can be used in infinite shapes and scales. You may fire blasts, waves, or beams of searing silver light; unleash wide shockwaves that batter landscapes; or launch fine, needle-like strikes of pain and pressure. With precision or raw force, your attacks may crush, cut, scatter, or stun.

The light you wield is not warm, but cold and unyielding, echoing the moon’s frozen silence. It can freeze on contact — coating objects and enemies in frost, slowing movement, sapping strength, or encasing them entirely in crystalized silver ice. Your beams don’t burn — they bite, with temperatures cold enough to make steel brittle and winds howl like dead starlight.

You may shape this lunar energy into items or objects — tools, blades, shields, clothing, armor, or supportive structures — all glowing with the serenity or fury of the moon. These constructs can persist as long as you desire and may self-repair in your presence.

Light itself answers your call. You may generate bright or soft moonlight for vision, illusion, or radiant strikes. In your hands, light becomes malleable — shaped into reflective barriers, piercing rays, soothing auras, or binding strands of silver force.

You can heal others with your touch, closing wounds and purging toxins through concentrated moonlight, and your body regenerates rapidly when infused with your power. You cannot die easily — even torn apart, your form pulls itself together, so long as your Lunar Heart still pulses.

When needed, you may shift your form into pure light — becoming intangible, immune to physical harm, able to drift through walls or fly unhindered by weight. While in this state, you are luminous, nearly silent, and almost impossible to harm through mundane means.

Your presence alone radiates lunar influence. Under moonlight, your abilities grow stronger. In darkness, your glow stands out like a star. You are immune to the dangers of your own light and the influence of lesser lunar forces. You are a moon unto yourself — serene, powerful, and cold as the stars beyond.
objects.title: Lua’s Luminance

addons.text:
Once sundered into divinity and damnation, your two patrons have fused into a single, transcendent being—neither wholly holy nor fully damned. This new god bears two faces, one of salvation and one of temptation, shifting seamlessly between them as needed. It is not worshiped or feared—it is worshiped because it is feared, and feared because it is revered.

Worship and deals now function interchangeably. Anyone who worships your god is treated as if they are also under a minor contract, passively empowering the god over time. Likewise, anyone who accepts a deal is automatically considered a worshiper, contributing to the god’s divine influence. You can use either method—faith or bargains—to expand your god’s power, and progress toward large-scale miracles, world-altering effects, or eventual manifestation. Sermons, prayers, and rituals may include contractual clauses, while contracts can be framed and accepted as sacred rites. 

You can now invoke divine miracles and infernal contracts in the same moment—healing a dying soldier as you bind him to eternal service, or blessing a city’s crops while claiming a fraction of each soul in the next harvest. Any order spoken in your god’s name resonates through both devotion and debt—those who worship and those who are bound alike feel it not as suggestion, but as sacred obligation.
addons.title: Twin-Faced God

objects.text:
You are bound to a malevolent higher being—an infernal power, devil, or demon lord of your choosing. Their name, form, domains, and demeanor are yours to define, though understand: you are not their servant. You are their broker.

This being gains power through deals. Any pact made—by you or others—feeds their strength. These contracts can take any form, but they must be willingly accepted. You act as the broker, offering power in exchange for something the devil desires (souls, loyalty, actions, artefacts, etc.).

The rewards the devil can grant with each contract are limited by their current strength. As they fulfill more contracts, their power grows, allowing them to offer greater abilities and more significant rewards. While they tend to overprice their deals with others, they are more generous with you, offering better terms and even discounts as your familiarity and relationship with them deepens.

You can enter the devil’s realm while asleep or on request while awake. This realm reflects the devil’s current power and serves as the hub for communication and planning.

If enough deals are made, the devil gains the ability to influence the world directly, even without needing to broker individual contracts. At first, a single pact might grant only a minor spell, but as their influence grows, they can empower armies, reshape events, or alter reality on a large scale. If their power becomes great enough, they may even manifest physically in the world.
objects.title: Infernal Pact

addons.text: Your mind begins to warp under the weight of your soul. The darkness that once clung to your spirit now coils inward, distorting your thoughts in ways both subtle and profound. The change is gradual but relentless—your reasoning skews, your fixations deepen. Obsession takes root where clarity once lived. Indulgence eclipses restraint. Morality, once a guiding force, begins to blur and unravel, leaving you increasingly unstable, unpredictable, and consumed by a darkness you no longer resist.
addons.title: Drowning In Burning Tar

addons.text:
You have ascended into something unspeakably perfect in its revulsion. Your soul is no longer merely stained—it is composed of sin, thick and asphalt-like, so dark that it devours light and radiates a purity born of total moral collapse. What was once horrifying is now revered; your presence inspires not panic, but solemn surrender. Yours is the beauty of absolute depravity, refined until even angels hesitate. You are not a corrupter—you are a sanctified defilement, a holy-like being formed in the silhouette of blasphemy. You are what comes after the fall, when corruption no longer spreads but simply is.

Before, spirits of suffering, demons, and other dark creatures recognized you as kin. Now, however, you are no longer merely kin—you have ascended to a higher rank of their nature. Cursed objects resonate as if returning to a greater source. Dark forces do not merely acknowledge you; they treat you with the respect due to a higher being. Chaotic and unstable entities become still and reverent in your presence, as if standing in a cathedral of shadow. To lesser beings, you are an unquestioned superior; to those of comparable might, you are recognized as an equal; to the godlike, you remain as you were.

Additionally, any sin committed by you or those under your influence is no longer only strengthens your dark nature—it is refined into usable, stored spiritual energy. This refined sin acts as a universal resource: it can fuel your spells, sustain your body like stamina, or reinforce your aura and durability. Whether you are channeling a forbidden ritual, enduring a mortal wound, or simply influencing the weak-willed, this stored sin empowers you without pause or penalty. This can be used to empower any aspect of yourself, although works best when used to power dark or sinful acts.
addons.title: Black Sacrament

addons.text:
Your demonic path has resonated with your sin-eating soul, granting you enlightenment. You understand the connection between spirit and flesh, allowing you to use one to affect the other. The most basic use is devouring flesh as a vector to consume the soul as well—but the true power lies in wielding their souls to break their bodies.  

As your presence passively blackens the souls of those around you, this corruption now bleeds into their physical forms. Their bodies twist in reflection of their sins—the greedy grow scales of tarnished gold, the violent sprout jagged bone spurs, and the deceitful find their tongues forked and venomous. The longer they remain under your influence, the more monstrous they become, their humanity sloughing away like rotting flesh. In addition, they will also grow stronger the more monstrous their form becomes, making them a real demon.

Yet these transformations only deepen their devotion. As their flesh reshapes, so too does their mind - each mutation binding them irrevocably to your will. Their warped forms become sacred to them, marks of your dark blessing. And should you choose, you may reverse these changes with a thought, temporarily restoring their humanity or permanently cleansing them - though few would ever wish to be freed from your touch. You may toggle this at will, and given enough times even your followers can do the same, freely shifting between human and monster.  

Their loyalty transcends mere fanaticism now. Their very biology sings for you, their reshaped souls crying out for your approval. Even those you restore completely remain haunted by whispers of your presence, their bodies remembering the perfection of your corruption. They are yours in every sense - mind, soul, and flesh - and no force in heaven or hell can sever what you have joined together.
addons.title: Demonic Soul

objects.text: You are a demon—perhaps not physically, but spiritually. Your soul is stained by darkness, oily, tar-filled, and sin-covered. Wherever you go, morality withers. People near you begin to stray from their values—your presence renders indulgence justified, encouraging people to sin. Restraint weakens, guilt fades, and temptation becomes a trusted voice. The longer they remain near you, the more they believe their darkest urges are not only right but necessary. There’s a gravity to you, cloaked in smoke and velvet, that draws people in. You feel like understanding, like danger dressed as comfort. Even when they know what you are, they make excuses to stay close. You don’t need to persuade them—they persuade themselves. Eventually, your influence deepens until a glance is enough to steer their actions, with them loosing more and more of their morals and indulging in sin. With each sin, each indulgence, they feel closer to you. You become their truth in a world of lies. Finally, when—not if, when—those under your influence break, shattered by guilt or desperate for meaning, they turn to you. Not as a monster, but as salvation. You offer freedom in surrender, purpose in their shame. Their devotion becomes absolute. They will lie for you. Bleed for you. Die for you. In addition to your corruption, your sins empower you—and so too do the sins of those influenced by you. Any transgression committed by you or by those you’ve corrupted strengthens you. With each act—be it theft, deceit, or bloodshed—your connection with sin deepens, granting you a natural affinity with sin itself. Acts like lying, stealing, and killing become easier to perform; you grow more skilled and talented in committing them. This also amplifies your connection to cursed or dark magic (if it exist in your current world or if you have any from the CYOA). Additionally demonic forces and other dark entities recognize you not as an outsider, but as one of their own. Forbidden rituals respond as if attuned to your presence. Cursed objects resonate in your grasp. Spirits of suffering and demons greet you as kin. Even so, you are not invincible. Pain still finds you—but your body endures with unnatural tenacity. Wounds that should cripple only slow you. Blows that would kill another leave you bloodied, but standing. As long as the damage isn’t truly fatal, your soul drives you forward. But for all your resilience, the sacred remains your equal. Holy power can bypass this resistance, although while it hurts you as it would any mortal—it does not hurt you with greater wrath, just ignores your resistance.
objects.title: Beneath the Skin of God

objects.text: You have a very peculiar form of immortality. No matter in what way you die, or the circumstances, you will be eventually reborn, rebuilt or returned somehow. You’re very unlikely to remain unchanged from this, the new you may be a completely different species, robotic, magically inclined, even a true reincarnation, but it will always be you with a continuity of existence. You will retain access to any ability gained through this CYOA or that is endemic to your ‘being’, or soul to keep its continued consistency. Unfortunately, you do not have control over the method or particulars of your return unless you actively went out of your way to orchestrate it as if this power did not exist, in which case it would merely ensure that return succeeds in some measure.
objects.title: Reconstruction

addons.text:
You're not a Shinigami. But your already impressive spiritual powers are enhanced further, to the point that you've picked up some traits from them.

First, your physical body is enhanced by your spiritual power—enough that a steel beam could fall on your back and only cause a minor injury, bruised bones, and maybe stun you for a minute or two. It also allows you to jump out of windows of several-story buildings and hit the ground running, and have the strength to rip out an electrical pole from the ground and swing it around like a weapon.

The second, and most important, is that you know Kido. Specifically, you have knowledge of all Kido from its various branches, including healing Kido, and you've already mastered the first 20 of each branch to the point that you can cast them with just the name and number. You can even cast the first 10 of each branch silently. With time, you will master all the others to this level and even create your own.
addons.title: Kido

addons.text:
You've completely absorbed the knowledge, powers, and abilities of one of the greatest Mikos and the Creator of the Shikon Jewel, Midoriko. With this, even without the jewel, you have the ability to live for centuries, the physical prowess to beat down yokai capable of destroying mountains, and the spiritual strength to purify hundreds to thousands of lesser yokai with a single swing of energy from whatever weapon you're using.

The Shikon Jewel has acknowledged you as its master, and you will no longer have to worry about corruption from it. With its ability to grant wishes, you have the capability to live forever, raise the dead, create new techniques on the fly, become durable enough that it would require city-block-destroying levels of force to even begin to harm you, and so much more. For as long as you have the Jewel, you're effectively immortal and will keep regenerating or reviving no matter how much damage you take. Should you lose the Jewel, you know where it or its fragments’ general location is at all times. The Jewel will also hostilely kill or weaken anyone who uses it without your permission.
addons.title: Midoriko

objects.text:
Your soul has a holy quality that you've cultivated by training in the duties of a Miko, otherwise known as a Shrine Maiden. You're immune to corruption and possession and have the ability to sense supernatural entities and objects within a 5-mile radius.

Through your knowledge of chants, ritual dances, and the creation and use of ofuda (paper talismans), you can attack and destroy spirits, yokai, and other supernatural entities. Your attacks don't just hit the flesh but the soul itself. This allows you to harm the immaterial and potentially destroy an entity’s very soul to deal with pesky immortal yokai.

But you do not just fight—you can cleanse curses and other taints from people, objects, and even areas. Through the use of your chants, you can exorcise entities from another’s body. With your ofuda, you can create barriers to either ward off the supernatural from an area or seal such beings or objects, potentially forever.

You also have the ability to heal others. Your powers can work by themselves, but by praying to divine entities, you can empower yourself further if they decide to bless you with some of their power. Even without them, you can effectively pray to a theoretical divine being and slowly grow more powerful over time. You're also skilled at archery and can bless your arrows and other objects with your energy to make them take on holy qualities and powers.

You receive a white kimono, red hakama, a gohei, a bow, a quiver filled with arrows, and a bag filled with 30 ofuda to begin your duties.
objects.title: Miko

objects.text:
You have gained the power of a Divine Peacock. This grants you the ability to transform at will between a radiant humanoid form and a resplendent peacock of divine beauty. In either shape, your feathers shimmer with otherworldly color and light, reflecting emotions, dreams, and deeper truths beyond mortal understanding.

These feathers are far more than mere decoration—they grant you clarity beyond the veil of illusions and deceit, allowing you to see through lies and perceive the hidden threads of the mystical world and dreams.

With a graceful movement, you can cloud minds, stir desire, or entrance entire crowds, bending wills as easily as petals follow the sun. But your feathers are also formidable weapons and impenetrable armor; they can withstand blows that would shatter steel and pierce through stone and steel alike. 

You can summon and launch shimmering feather-shards with deadly precision, while your plumage shields you from the fiercest assaults, placing you far beyond the reach of ordinary weapons—even in your human form.
The wings you have can carry you through the Mortal World, unseen at speeds surpassing sound without distrubing it. But more than that you can let them carry you into the world of spirits or even dreams of mortals.

Your voice and movements are suffused with divine power. Whether singing, dancing, speaking, or playing an instrument, you command the attention of all who hear you. 

Your music flows like a sacred river—sometimes haunting, sometimes joyful, sometimes terrible—and mortals are left breathless and spellbound. Even gods pause, compelled by the depth and beauty of your performance.

As a being touched by divinity, your body is free from the bounds of mortality. You do not age, cannot fall ill, and cannot be destroyed permanently. If you are slain, your feathers scatter across the world—luminous, eternal fragments of your essence. 

In time, they draw together once more, and from their convergence, you are reborn.
objects.title: Pavan of Eternal Song

addons.text:
You have become a practitioner of Onmyōdō, the Way of Yin and Yang—an arcane art developed in the Land of the Rising Sun. This tradition focuses on maintaining harmony between the physical world and the spiritual realm.

Rooted in the observation of celestial patterns and the manipulation of earthbound energy, Onmyōdō allows you to perceive the movements of fate, command elemental forces, and summon shikigami spirits you have either bound or formed contracts with to serve you.

While you can use your own spiritual power and chants to cast spells, as in other magical traditions, your true strength as an Onmyōji lies not in brute force, but in precision and preparation. You can inscribe Ofuda sacred talismans etched with esoteric symbols and incantations, each acting as a fragment of cosmic law. When placed with care, these talismans can ward off evil, bind restless spirits, purify corrupted ground, or unravel curses that twist the threads of destiny.

By observing the movements of stars and reading the flow of mystical energy, you gain glimpses into future events. You may interpret dreams, decipher omens, or uncover hidden truths. With enough insight, you can even shift probability itself, guiding fortune like a leaf carried on a flowing river.

You may also bargain with or bind a spirit, compelling it to become your shikigami, granting it form and purpose. These spirits serve as spies, protectors, or weapons, their abilities and personalities shaped by your spiritual strength and the terms of your pact. However, a poorly bound shikigami may rebel or become unstable. Thus, clarity of mind and intent are essential.

The most potent of your abilities are spiritual rites, powerful ceremonies that ask or compel the spirit to do things such as summon celestial fire from the heavens, conjure storms from a clear sky, shake the earth with tremors, or even tear open a gate to the underworld to unleash a legion of ghosts.

Yet, these high-level rituals demand exquisite precision and thoughtful execution. The more powerful the magic you attempt, the more exact your ritual must be. Even a small mistake can cause the magic to unravel disastrously, with results that may be catastrophic.

To walk the path of the Onmyōji is to live in constant awareness of self, spirit, and the subtle currents of the world. This is not merely magic; it is a philosophy of balance, reverence, and intention. For when yin and yang fall into harmony, even fate itself may bend to your will.
addons.title: Onmyōdō

objects.text:
You now possess both the gift and the knowledge to commune with spirits, the animistic entities that inhabit all things, whether living or inanimate, for nothing is truly lifeless. Everything holds a spirit, waiting to be heard.

Most spirits fall into two broad categories. The first are ghosts: the lingering souls of once-living beings who, by will or circumstance, remain tethered to the mortal plane. The second are intrinsic spirits: conscious essences born from nature, objects, or places, awakened and empowered over time through long existence, reverence, and accumulated spiritual energy.

Ghosts often retain self-awareness, shaped by the memories and emotions of their former lives. Intrinsic spirits, though more primal and abstract, may become unfathomably powerful. Some ancient spirits of mountains, rivers, cities, or relics have grown so vast in essence that calling them deities is not mere metaphor but a quiet truth. Each is a wellspring of wisdom and an unrelenting force of spiritual power.

Communing with these spirits varies in both difficulty and form. Some may demand ritual purity, sacred offerings, or aid in completing unfinished tasks. Others may respond simply to genuine friendship, a bond of mutual respect and trust. In return, spirits may offer guidance, protection, or even share their power.

You might call upon a ghost to serve as an unseen scout, gliding through shadows and walls unnoticed by mortal eyes. Or you may earn the favor of an ancestral katana’s spirit, a blade whose soul thrums with forgotten martial wisdom teaching you to cut through stone and steel as easily as slicing wet clay. Even a tempestuous weather spirit might lend you the wind to fly, teach you to summon rain, or call down lightning from a cloudless sky.

The possibilities are as vast as the spirit realm itself, but only if the spirit is willing. The more ancient and powerful the spirit, the harder it is to earn its favor. To such beings, your mortal offerings may seem paltry, your presence fleeting. And yet, even the mightiest spirit may pause to listen to one who approaches with humility, reverence, and a heart unsullied by greed.

To walk this path is to embrace the sacred harmony between worlds where respect, sincerity, and spiritual balance open doors that force never could.
objects.title: Beseech the Spirit

addons.text:
You are no longer limited to expressing dualism within yourself; you are now capable of manifesting it in all things around you. It will still retain the same limitations as the base power.

You are also no longer limited to the literal sense of dualism; you can manifest whatever you consider to be the “opposite” of the applied target. For example, instead of generating the opposite of the male gender as the female gender, it could instead be something entirely different, such as a demon, a cyborg, a god, a simple kitchen knife, or anything else you interpret.

However, manifesting such freedom of interpretation of dualism will cost twice as much as ordinary dualism.
addons.title: Abstract Duality

objects.text:
Whether it's your soul, your body, your existence, or however you choose to manifest it—you possess the ability to embody the opposite of what you are. The opposing aspect you obtain becomes completely natural to you, with no interference or adverse reaction. As such, the usual “oil and water” logic of opposing forces repelling each other no longer applies to you.

This power allows you to develop an attribute that is the opposite of what you possess, whether of the body or the soul. You can embody your whole self or just a specific part, and you can freely control how this opposite form is expressed. For example, if you are biologically male, you can transform into a female. Another example: if you are an angel, this power gives you the option to transform into a demon. This transformation is reversible, but it consumes energy (of any kind), physical stamina, and mental strength (including energy derived from mental powers).

The energy cost of each embodiment varies. Changing your biological gender consumes relatively little. However, attempting to switch elemental affinity for instance, from fire to water or any power system with a defined opposite, comes with a relative cost. And when you try to convert a divine power into its opposite, the cost can be dangerously high, potentially shortening your lifespan. This limitation can be reduced, improved, or even removed entirely through mastery achieved through practice and frequent use.

Your power is limited to what you naturally possess in body and soul. This includes any power you acquire through the CYOA, as all such powers are considered innate unless otherwise specified. Once the opposite aspect is acquired, control over it becomes as natural as your original power. You may even manifest both simultaneously, allowing you to express both your original and opposite powers at once.
objects.title: Dual Embodiment

addons.text:
Each of your two bodies develops its own pool of Yin and Yang energies, giving rise to a form of Dual Cultivation that enhances your existing capabilities and accelerates your growth to greater heights.

Whenever one body uses Yin or Yang, a small portion of the spiritual energy and power it generates is shared with the other body, allowing it to benefit as well, though to a lesser extent. Thus, if one body is using Yin and generating Yang, the other body will likewise generate a smaller amount of Yang.

Should each body be using a different Art—one employing Yin and the other Yang—the energies exchanged between them instead stoke the power of the opposite Art. This interaction strengthens the flow of both energies, making any techniques fueled by them more potent.

Most notable, however, is the way Yin and Yang feed into one another. Their interaction drastically enhances both bodies' ability to generate energy, allowing their reserves to replenish faster than they can be expended.

This heightened state fades once either body ceases using the proper energy needed to sustain the cycle. However, so long as the balance of Yin and Yang is maintained between your bodies, you can continue fighting longer and harder than someone of your level should reasonably be capable of.
addons.title: Dual Cultivation

objects.text:
Through a rare opportunity, you have come to learn an ancient art that makes use of spiritual energy. This energy is divided into Yin and Yang. Using one charges the other while depleting the one in use. Yin moves, also known as the Soft Fist, the Moon Fist, or the Receiving Fist, allow you to absorb, redirect, halt, or soften incoming attacks or spells. These moves focus on manipulating the various energies in a passive, non-destructive way. Yin techniques can also affect the spiritual realm, enabling you to purify spirits, exorcise darkness, and interact directly with unseen forces.

Yang moves, also called the Hard Fist, the Sun Fist, or the Dominating Fist, unleash tremendous force. These moves focus on causing destruction, bypassing most defenses, and inflicting devastating damage. Yang techniques can harm entities and objects that are otherwise impervious, dealing significant internal and external damage.

Yin moves are often accompanied by a black ink-like effect, while Yang moves produce a white ink-like effect. However, you can suppress these visual effects if desired.

Using either Yin or Yang energy quickly exhausts it, requiring balance between the two. With enough experience and years of practice, you can achieve enlightenment—known as the Way of the Dual Fist. At this stage, Yin and Yang reach complete harmony, resonating with each other and unlocking their deeper, conceptual aspects. This resonance allows you to wield Destruction in one hand and Creation in the other, granting access to extraordinary conceptual abilities that you can discover with time and practice. It also lets you mix the various properties of both side with each other, allowing you to—for example—do a Yang move that is both destructive and also strikes directly into an individual's soul, dealing soul damage.

At that stage, there is little left that your Yang Fist cannot destroy or your Yin Fist cannot subdue.

Even before enlightenment, you can harness Yin and Yang creatively. One option is tempering your body with their energies to grow stronger. Another is the various Spiritual Arts—powerful techniques that consume spiritual energy to achieve remarkable effects. For example, Yin Arts can create talismans to seal beings, while Yang Arts can deal direct damage to an enemy’s core.

These Fists posses immense power and potential. They enable you to move almost as fast as the sound, destroy buildings, and jump as high as one too. Upon achieving the Dual Fist, your abilities transcend, allowing you to leap as high as the clouds or strike mountains down with a single blow. The various different Spiritual Arts also show a leap in effectiveness and range at this stage, though developing such techniques is up to you, the only limits being your imagination.

The limits of Yin and Yang are governed only by your mind and soul. As long as you keep moving forward, your body, mind and soul will continue to grow and alongside it, the effectiveness and power of your Dual Fist.
objects.title: Zenith and Nadir

objects.text:
You have embraced divinity and reached the heavens… but only within a single family. You are the patron god of a bloodline, now existing as a fully spiritual being. You can only be seen or heard by your bloodline or those able to perceive spirits, and you cannot interact with anything non-spiritual. You no longer age, eat, sleep, or drink.

Your core ability is to ‘link’ yourself to a bloodline. This grants its members improved health, resistance to illness, and longer, better lives. Your strongest power, however, is incarnation—where a bloodline member willingly lets you take over their body. This grants them enhanced physical might, glowing eyes tied to your essence, flight at incredible speeds, and durability enough to survive house-leveling impacts. Incarnation is draining for both you and your host, and if you are killed while incarnated, you suffer direct spiritual damage. This weakens your blessings and suppresses your strength for at least a generation, with recovery tied to time and the bloodline’s growth.

You may shape your blessings broadly or specialize in specific traits such as swordsmanship, magic, or intellect. It can even manifest as a special ability they have access to. These focuses can be changed over time, though shifts take several generations to solidify. Transitioning between similar disciplines is easier than changing to something unrelated. 

Your power scales with the number of currently blessed blood relatives—those born into the line after your ascension. Blood purity doesn’t matter; even distant descendants strengthen you. A larger and longer-lasting bloodline results in stronger incarnations and greater blessings for future generations, including more naturally gifted base bodies to incarnate into. You share a natural affinity with your descendants, able to sense them and naturally bond with them—this connection deepens as your influence grows.

You can only ever be bound to one bloodline at a time. The link to a bloodline only breaks when the entire line dies out. When this happens, you lose access to your power, which remains locked until you form a new link. Upon bonding with a new family, you return to base strength, but grow faster than before—the stronger you were when the last line ended, the quicker you regain your might and go beyond.
objects.title: Household God

addons.text:
You now don’t need all of 'You' to keep going.

If your body is destroyed, your mind and soul continue. You remain active as a psychic or spiritual presence, able to perceive, think, and act through whatever means are available to you. If your mind is erased, your body and soul still function, driven by instinct, will, and memory etched into them long ago. As long as one of the three fully remains, you will keep moving, thinking, and existing without interruption.

Each part of you carries enough of the others to hold your sense of self. Losing one doesn’t unmake you. You won't fade, forget, or fall apart. As you will stay exactly who you are, though you may feel the absence of what was lost such as becoming a bit more instinctive with the mind gone, and abilities tied to it might weaken until it returns.

Like your soul, each missing part will grow back over time and even stronger then before. Mind, body, or soul — all recover simply through your continued existence.

You’re not dependent on being whole. One part is enough.
addons.title: Triune Echo

addons.text: As your powers no longer rely on your mind, body, or soul to function, instead connecting directly to your true self, the loss of any one of those components no longer interferes with your abilities. Powers that would normally weaken, malfunction, or cease entirely due to the destruction or absence of the soul instead continue to operate at full effectiveness, unaffected by that loss. While the absence of a soul may still dull emotions or instincts, abilities that once depended directly on it are no longer impaired by its destruction or regeneration. If you possess Triune Echo, this protection extends to the mind and body as well, ensuring that powers which would normally depend on any missing part continue to function without weakening or interruption.
addons.title: Severed Dependence

objects.text:
Losing your soul isn’t the end for you. Where most would die, go mad, or fade into nothing, you remain alive and whole. No collapse, no spiritual death, just a gap where something used to be.

You’ll feel the difference. Certain emotions may dull, instincts might feel quieter, and abilities that rely directly on the soul can weaken or stop entirely. But your mind stays intact, your body keeps going, and your sense of self remains untouched.

Over time, something strange happens. A new soul begins to grow, a perfect replica of your previous soul and a fresh one shaped by who you are now. It starts small, weak, and mostly dormant, but it develops steadily just by existing. Eventually, it becomes strong enough to fully replace what was lost, restoring anything that went dormant with it and even expanding to greater heights from your new experiences.

Until then, you’re immune to most soul-based attacks, possession, servitude, extraction, or tracking. You’re still mortal, still vulnerable in other ways, but this part of you is no longer a single point of failure.
objects.title: Hollow Within

objects.text:
Can you feel it? Deep within you – in the depths of your mind, body and soul, at the very center of your essence – lies the path you have chosen. All you need to do is follow it; what awaits you on your journey is something only you can discover. However, you do not need to reach the end to reap the benefits of walking this path.

The difficulty of traversing your chosen path will vary, as will the benefits gained from it. This difficulty is purely spiritual, heavily dependent on your soul and mind. The more you grasp your path and attain enlightenment, the further you will have walked upon it and the more powerful abilities you will gain. This enlightenment is based on the understanding you gain on the path you have chosen. Be careful, though: if you completely abandon the path and forsake all you have learned, you will lose the benefits you've acquired. Conversely, as long as you complete the journey, the improvements will be permanent.

The paths you can choose are limitless, no matter how abstract or absurd. For example, you might select the "Path of Transience." As your understanding of transience deepens and you gain further enlightenment from it, you will acquire increasingly strong powers. Initially, you might gain minor abilities, such as sensing the passage of time or discerning if something has expired. But as you continue, you could unlock powers tied to more conceptual elements of your chosen path, such as drastically shortening healing times to near-instantaneous recovery, marking incoming attacks as "transient" to negate their effects on you, or even becoming transient yourself to prevent interaction with anything else, even death.

The more you have moved along the path, the more abilities you will uncover. There are no limits to the number of abilities you might gain. Even after you have walked a long way into your chosen path, you can still choose to try and gain enlightenment on lesser previously undiscovered aspects of your path, thereby gaining powers related to such discoveries.

The path chosen and the abilities you gain are entirely unique to you. The more enlightenment you attain, the more powerful you will become. The powers you gain will increase in strength and depth the further you walk the path. Be mindful, however, while the path walked will be rewarding, it will also be equally challenging and take time, it will also irrevocably change you in body, mind and spirit. This change might manifest as small body mutations, changed personality traits or perhaps even changes to one’s soul.

Should you reach the end of your path, the levels of power you attain will be enormous, truly awe-inspiring and potentially universe-shaking. This journey might take you years to complete, but the ultimate rewards will be profound.

Once you finish one path, you may decide to walk another path. However, whatever consequences you might get as a result of this will be up to you.
objects.title: The Chosen Path

objects.text:
Your heart has been blessed by the vastness of the sea and infused with the lingering essence of an Okeanid. To bear the Heart of the Sea is to be cherished by the waters. The tides will rise and fall in answer to your needs, the winds over the sea will turn in your favor, filling your sails and pushing you onwards. The storms that rage across the waves will part for you, their fury calming at the edge of your vessel. The heart of the ocean shields you, and even the endless sickness that haunts sailors on long voyages will refuse to take root in your body.

The sea provides for its beloved. Fish gather near your ship, willingly offering themselves to stave off your hunger. When thirst presses on you, the saltwater at your fingertips turns fresh and drinkable, flowing as cleanly as a mountain spring. Even when cast into the open ocean with nothing but your Heart, the sea itself will conspire to sustain you. Ships remain buoyant beneath you, the waters calm themselves around you, and dangers of the deep seem to turn away, hesitant to approach the one marked by the Okeanid’s blessing.

Any action tied to the sea is as natural as breathing. Steering ships, charting courses, reading waves, and navigating storms all become second nature, even without formal training. This ease of movement and understanding extends to your crew—they will find themselves working in harmony with the sea. If you wield water-based magic or powers, your Heart amplifies its strength and control while at sea, deepening your connection to the element and allowing your spells to flow with greater scale, power, and endurance amidst the ocean’s embrace.
objects.title: Heart of the Sea

objects.text:
You have learned the fiery cosmic dance of Lord Shiva, the Lord of Destruction and Transformation.

When you invoke the dance, your body begins to move in a paradox of motion—each gesture fluid and graceful, yet bound by an unseen resistance, as though the very fabric of reality recoils from your presence. This tension births a sacred friction, and from that friction, flame erupts—pure, divine, and unrelenting. It coils around you, consuming your form in fire not born of the mundane world, but of the same divine fire that fuels Agni and blazes from the third eye of Mahadeva.

Your body reddens, steaming with unbearable heat. If you wish, you can extend this to your weapon of choice. This is no mere combustion: it is transcendental fire, capable of cauterizing flesh and searing through the soul itself. It pays no heed to ordinary barriers, ignoring physical resistance and reducing the mundane to ash. The fire of the Rudra Tandava burns not only the body, but touching the essence beneath.

Yet this gift is a double-edged flame. The Tandava is no ordinary technique; it is a fragment of divine rhythm, a dance too immense for mortal frames. What you wield is but the faintest echo of Shiva’s original fury—a dim shadow, far removed from the rhythm of the true Tandava. Though your flames may wound the soul, searing through spirit and essence, they cannot utterly annihilate it. You can burn, scar, and fracture that which lies beyond flesh, but not erase it from the wheel of existence. Those with sufficient non-mundane strength—be it divine lineage, spiritual mastery, or protection forged in realms beyond the physical—may endure the flame, resisting its deeper bite.

Your body, still bound by samsara, may blister and crack beneath its strain. Your soul, unless steeped in divinity, may fray and unravel under the weight of its own ignition. For this is the dance through which Shiva ends worlds. Only those whose being resonates with the grandeur of the Trimurti—whose strength is as unshakable as Mount Meru, whose divinity burns with the clarity of sacred fire—can hope to master its full fury.

In its true form, when performed by Shiva himself, the Tandava was the heartbeat of the cosmos: with each step, the heavens trembled; with each beat, the elements bowed; and around him, a blazing circle of fire erupted—within which lifetimes ended, galaxies took birth, and souls found liberation.
objects.title: Rudra Tandava

objects.text:
You are not a person—you are a role, a function of the cosmos. Where peace festers into stagnation and order begins to rot, you emerge. Your purpose is to spark conflict, to unearth lies, to shatter what no longer serves. Your death is the seed of a better world.

Wherever you go, conflict follows. Tension rises, trust breaks, and violence spreads. The longer you remain in a place, the more conflict appears, from tension to collapse, suspicions end in open war. And blame always falls on you, no matter how unrelated you are to the issue. You are the scapegoat of all unraveling.

As society collapses in your wake, truth surfaces. Corruption gets exposed, systems start to fail, and long-buried sins come to light. And in the chaos, you tempt those who are rapidly losing power. You offer indulgence—wealth, power, pleasure, knowledge. You inherit the remnants of the broken: abandoned gods, ruined empires, failed heroes. All that the world casts off becomes yours. They serve as your minions, your soldiers, and you become a ruler of hell in all but name.

Yet resistance always comes. Those who endure your presence grow stronger. Heroes awaken, legends form, and entire civilizations unify to bring you down. Eventually, destined by fate, they will defeat you. And when they do, the world enters a golden age—unified, awakened, and advancing. Until the moment the world is ready for your death, fate will conspire to keep you alive.

Even then, your death is never final. You will return, sometimes in the same world, sometimes in another. You may be reborn as a child, appear as you were, or awaken inhuman in form, sometime with your memories buried temporarily. As long as stagnation exists, so will you. And when you rise, the world will break, and from that breaking, it will change.
objects.title: The Great Evil

objects.text:
Through ritual and the consumption of human flesh, you have become a wendigo. You can assume your monstrous form at will: an emaciated figure with skin stretched tight over bone, lips chewed away, and a head crowned with unnaturally long, branching antlers. Your legs end in hooves, and your limbs are elongated beyond human proportions. You grow more powerful by eating living human flesh. The more you consume, the more your body grows in size and strength. You do not need sleep or shelter, and you are immune to cold, frostbite, or starvation.

Your physical capabilities are drastically enhanced. You can sprint through deep snow at unnatural speeds, leaving no trace. Your claws can rend bone, and your strength allows you to overpower multiple humans with ease. Your sense of smell is heightened; you can detect blood and fear from over a mile away. In darkness or whiteout conditions, you suffer no penalty to perception or movement.

You possess voice mimicry and mental luring. You can perfectly imitate any voice you have heard, using it to call out to victims. With practice, you can implant a hallucination in a nearby target, it typically taking the form of a loved one or shelter, compelling them to isolate themselves. This effect grows stronger if the target is already cold, starving, or afraid.

You exude a passive aura of despair. Humans within a short radius feel rising paranoia, dread, and in extreme cases, suicidal thoughts or cannibalistic impulses. This aura intensifies during winter or in places of scarcity. Weak-willed individuals exposed for extended periods may fall under your mental influence, gradually transforming into lesser wendigos that serves you.

You regenerate slowly while exposed to freezing temperatures, even from otherwise mortal wounds. Fire is your primary weakness and bypasses your regeneration entirely. To be permanently destroyed, your icy heart must be shattered or incinerated.

You are considered a spiritual entity. You are not affected by disease or poison, and divination magic only detects you as a vague, malevolent presence. You may possess the body of a dying or spiritually broken human, transforming them into a vessel for your will. Only one vessel may be active at a time, and possession ends if the body is purified or destroyed.

In warmer climates or among large communities, your power is weakened. In deep wilderness, during blizzards, or in famine-stricken areas, you are at full strength.
objects.title: Wendigo

objects.text: Your body is covered in full-body irezumi, etched in the Munewari style — traditional tattoos with a vertical gap down the chest for spiritual restraint. The ink is a sacred blend of black pigment and powdered yokai bone, harvested from slain spirits. Their grudges and malice are sealed beneath layers of sutra-laced design. Dragons, tigers, and wind motifs conceal script-like mantras that keep the creatures bound. The tattoos act as both prison and weapon. Though the sutras bind the yokai’s wrath, their power flows through you — granting superhuman strength, speed, and durability. You can tear through concrete, leap rooftops, and endure bone-breaking blows. Under pressure, your reflexes sharpen, allowing you to outmaneuver spirits or react to ambushes. The more power you draw, the more your spiritual nature drifts from human to yokai — your presence, instincts, and raw spiritual weight becoming something otherworldly. You remain human in form, but your essence is no longer easy to categorize. By channeling their energy, your attacks can strike the soul as well as the body — disrupting auras, causing lingering spiritual pain, or destroying ghostly forms outright. Even spiritually protected humans feel the impact. A single blow can exorcise lesser spirits or shake a seasoned onmyōji’s soul loose. Even without attacking, your yokai-infested presence radiates dread. Your aura feels predatory, as if something ancient watches from beneath your skin. Spirits instinctively flee or freeze. Spiritually aware opponents feel an ancient malice hovering over them — some drop weapons or panic. To greater beings, your aura reads like a battlefield grave: a clear warning not to draw near. The tattoos remain fully visible unless you possess Holding Back, which allows you to suppress and conceal them at will.
objects.title: Kurobashō

addons.text:
Where once your puppet form demanded constant feeding from the well of suffering, your demonic soul now bleeds into the ichor itself, transforming it into an eternal reservoir. Your very soul now generates ichor endlessly, creating a baseline ichor supply enough to exist indefinitely as long as you don't use it beyond living.

Additionally, the corruption you spread further empowers this sustenance. Those who have been corrupted and succumb to your influence, become nodes for you to absorb negative emotions. Negative emotions around them flow into you without conscious effort. The more deeply a person is bound by your corruption, the less emotions is lost during the transfer.
addons.title: Blood of Hollowed Idols

objects.text:
Your body is no longer flesh, but a cursed puppet made whole in human shape. You appears outwardly indistinguishable from any other person, but within lies porcelain constructs for bones and organs, and black ichor that flows where blood should be. 

The black ichor is a liquid that fuels your existence. The ichor sustains you, repairs damage, and keeps you moving. You can either generate it slowly by passively drawing in negative emotions, or generate it quickly by causing then consuming negative emotions yourself. If you run out of ichor, you will grow sluggish and die. 

You can strike with force equal to a sledgehammer blow, enough to break concrete with a full hit. You can lift and carry weights up to 600 pounds before strain shows in your porcelain frame. Your speed is above human average but not beyond natural limits. You can sprint up to 50 miles per hour in short bursts and sustain 20 miles per hour. You can further boost this at the cost of ichor.

Your porcelain frame is reinforced enough to withstand the force of your own maximum strikes, so you do not break yourself when attacking. A full-force punch will not fracture your hand, but blows of equal or greater strength from outside sources will. Piercing and crushing damage are extra dangerous, as they bypass surface durability and can shatter internals.

Your body feels pain, but it only informs you of damage without forcing a reaction. There is no instinctive flinch, loss of focus or anything that can put you down.

Lastly, you can move yourself as though pulled by strings. You can rise from the ground without planting your hands or feet, pulled upright as if lifted by unseen threads. You can bend your arm backwards at the elbow and still strike with it, because your actions don’t require realistic force application since they are directed by the “strings” rather than muscles.
objects.title: The Hollow Doll

addons.text:
You gain all the abilities, skills, and knowledge of the infamous leader of the Night Parade, Nurarihyon. This includes his ability to seamlessly blend into human society, slipping past detection and infiltrating any place as if he belonged there. His natural authority extends to monsters and humans alike, allowing you to command them without resistance once they fall under your influence.

In addition, your aura of leadership becomes boosted to the level of Nurarihyon’s, where even your very presence is enough to make others subconsciously treat you as their rightful superior, whether they realize it or not. Against monsters in your Night Parade, this instinctive loyalty is absolute; against humans, it manifests as obedience disguised as free will.
addons.title: Nurarihyon

addons.text:
Your artistry now extends beyond the realm of shadows and into the pages of legend itself. No longer limited to dolls born of imagination or borrowed faces, you may now summon living effigies of any monster drawn from myth, folklore, or scripture, manifesting them at their full narrative strength so long as they fall beneath the threshold of beings that can be bound into your Parade. Vampires, oni, griffons, lamias, kappa, draugr—their cultural archetype becomes your template, and the entity itself is given form at your call.
