Yet your mastery does not end with creation. Just as your dolls find sanctuary in the depths of your shadow, so too do the spirits and yokai of your Parade. This living archive becomes a shifting bestiary, a personal compendium of monsters you can withdraw and deploy at will. Each creature slumbers, studies, and evolves within your shadow, with their myths refined under your dominion. The longer a being remains bound to you, the more their archetype distills into perfection—an oni grows more cunning and brutish, a vampire more enthralling and predatory, an angel more radiant and terrible.

Over time, your collection transforms into a mobile mythology, each bound entity subtly weaving together into a cohesive mythology centered on you as their author and master.
addons.title: Gazu Hyakki Yagyō

addons.text:
All monsters within your Demon Parade now take on a thematic template drawn from your Tutorial Boss power. Their forms, abilities, and behavior reflect the same motif that defines you as a Boss, unifying them under your aesthetic and narrative.

In addition, their strength scales in direct proportion to the power you gain from any upgrades to The Tutorial Boss. This effectively transforms your Demon Parade into the mobs and adds that surround a video game Boss encounter. Should you advance to The Final Boss, for example, your Parade evolves accordingly—its members becoming as fearsome as the monsters typically found in the final areas of an RPG, with you enthroned at their center as the true Boss they serve.
addons.title: Area Boss

objects.text:
Your presence exerts an overwhelming dominion over monsters. Any unholy or inhuman being—spirits, demons, yokai, revenants, vampires, dragons—within 100 meters of you that is weaker than yourself is instantly bound and bent to your will.

The moment your power touches them, their instincts are shackled, their hungers silenced, and their loyalties reforged until resistance is impossible. Once claimed, they obey you absolutely, and they act of their own accord in ways that further your will and goals even in the absence of direct commands.

Strength here is measured not by mere muscles and magic, but by any aspect of your being. Any being you outclass in any singular ability such as skill, intelligence, magic, physical capability, or even simple charisma is yours to command. Furthermore, this criteria does not have to be the same ability throughout your Night Parade, but can be tailored to each being. Thus, your parade only grows larger as you grow stronger, until even Outer Gods and Titans may march in your shadow.
objects.title: Night Parade of 100 Demons

addons.text:
Where you walk, famine becomes faith. Fields wither, granaries rot, and coffers grow hollow, yet in your presence this collapse is mistaken for providence. The starving do not curse you; they kneel, for only you hold the keys to survival. What you take is never seen as theft but as divine mystery, and what you return is cherished as sacred bounty. Your charisma transforms deprivation into devotion, and your followers mistake hunger for holiness.

Your rule does not spread by sword or flame but by dependence. Those beneath your banner compete for your favor, believing that to serve you is to eat, to worship you is to live. The more you withhold, the more desperately they love you. The more you grant, the more they believe no life exists without you. In this way, conquest becomes effortless: resistance withers before it begins, as every would-be rebel finds themselves bound not by chains, but by need. And as your reach grows, the wealth and resources you hoard scales even more, increasing in quantity and quality.

But the abundance you bestow is poison disguised as blessing. Those who thrive by your hand grow hollow, not with famine but with worship. Their passions fade, their autonomy evaporates, and their only labor becomes the endless praise of your name. Societies under your rule do not war or rebel, but neither do they grow for themselves. Any and all innovations are for your comfort and convenience.

Your gift is devotion, your curse is decay. Kingdoms under your dominion do not live. They wait, suspended in hunger and reverence, their futures sacrificed at the altar of your shadow. In your dominion, famine and conquest are no longer separate, but a single illusion that binds the world in worship until it rots away.
addons.title: False Idol

addons.text:
Where you walk, peace becomes permanence, and devotion becomes death. Those who fall beneath your voice surrender more than their will, they surrender their years. Their remaining lifespans bleed out like sand from a broken hourglass, and in that sacrifice they blaze with stolen brilliance. Strength floods their bodies, skill sharpens in their hands, and zeal ignites their souls. They move as saints possessed, their lives condensed into radiant glory.

Yet this brilliance is hollow. Their passions dissolve, their autonomy withers, and what remains is obedience refined to perfection. They are not enslaved by chains or fear, but by love so total it leaves no space for the self. They fight not for themselves but as your limbs, your voice, your hands, extensions of your being while their borrowed years dwindle away.

When at last their time runs dry, their service does not end. They do not collapse into death, but step seamlessly across its threshold, rising again as husks of eternal loyalty. These are not the restless dead of Pale’s legion, but vessels long emptied of all but devotion. Their strength in undeath does not come from what years they lost but from how long they served you while alive, their hollow flame burning hotter the longer it was fed. This boost in death builds upon the boost they had in life, increasing it by exponentials.

Your gift is peace, your curse is eternity. Kingdoms under your dominion do not change or grow, they endure as monuments to your will, their people burning bright before withering into perfect obedience. In your dominion, conquest and death are no longer separate, but a single covenant that forges an undying kingdom where time itself bends to your shadow.
addons.title: Promised Land

objects.text:
You are the White Horseman of Conquest. However, you have yet to fully mature.

Even in your incomplete state, you radiate an overwhelming presence. Charisma seeps from your every word and gesture, drawing the weak-willed to your cause without effort. Crowds gather because something in them needs to follow you. Your aura commands attention, and you intuitively understand the levers of influence, the structure of belief systems, the subtle art of persuasion, and the raw mechanics of power. Ideologies unravel before you, pliable clay in your hands, waiting to be molded into tools of conquest.

You do not require violence. You speak, and people listen. You are able to calm violence and direct people to diplomacy. You are a herald of order cloaked in the illusion of peace, guiding others by the strength of your voice and the sheer gravity of your presence. You can quell conflict and unite warring factions beneath a shared banner of purpose, diplomacy serving as your first and most dangerous weapon.

And as more followers gather under your name, your power only grows. Your charisma grows to compel even nobles, generals, kings and even entities of greater will. What began as personal charm evolves into an almost divine authority. But this power bears a curse disguised as a gift.

For every soul that bends the knee, something quietly breaks. Your conquests do not uplift, they pacify. The wills of your followers erode beneath your shadow, their passions wither, their autonomy fades. Societies under your influence slowly hollow out, not from tyranny or bloodshed, but from a haunting desire to please you. Innovation outside those you command ceases, independent growth stagnates, and the very fabric of civilization begins to rot in quiet adoration of your rule.

You are the White Horseman. And though your conquest begins with peace, its end is ruin.
objects.title: White Horseman

addons.text:
Where you walk, people kneel in servitude. Those who hear your words feel their resistance stripped away, their wills bending into loyalty as if by divine decree. In your name, devotion is sharpened into a blade. Your charisma sanctifies violence, weaving belief and blood into one indivisible creed.

Your presence turns chaos into order, and order into war. The more followers you claim, the stronger your dominion grows. But unlike mere conquest, these followers are driven not toward stagnation, but toward endless expansion. Every sermon you speak is a call to arms; every doctrine you establish is a justification for war. Wars begun in your name do not end when the enemy is slain, for your believers see new foes in every shadow. They hunger for fresh conquest, feeding upon the cycle of battle. The strength of your armies does not falter with exhaustion; their faith is renewed in every act of killing, each drop of blood is sanctified as proof of your destiny. As their faith grows, they become more attuned to violence, slowly inheriting the instinctive mastery of War bestowed by the Red Horseman.

Where you rule, society organizes itself into a permanent war machine. Innovation is not extinguished as under the White Horseman, but redirected and compounded into the engines of war. All things outside of war are hollowed out, their fanatical faith in spreading your conquest is all that remains. Outside your presence, the world smolders; inside it, people breathe only for the fight and to spread your rule.

Your gift is control and your curse is escalation. Kingdoms under your reign do not simply obey; they crusade, driven by the belief that conquest is salvation and war is the only means. In your dominion, conquest and war are no longer separate, but a single force without end.
addons.title: Holy Crusade

addons.text:
Where you walk, survival becomes a wager of blood. Violence itself becomes the source of wealth and sustenance. To kill is to feast, to shed blood is to grow fat, and to abstain is to starve. Every strike, every kill, every act of cruelty transfers resources from victim to victor. Those who fight and kill grow fed, enriched, and strong. Those who refuse are starved into weakness, their bodies and spirits collapsing until violence is the only way left to survive.

Your presence turns scarcity into fuel, binding famine to the rhythms of battle. The more one fights and kill, the more resources and riches they gain, turning every war a harvest. The victors gorge themselves, yet their wealth and nourishment seep upward into your unseen vault, siphoned without end. Even the strongest grow lean with time, forced again and again to return to slaughter lest famine hollow them out.

As your dominion spreads, societies reorder themselves into predator and prey. Entire kingdoms become feudal slaughterhouses, their people shackled to the endless cycle: kill to live, starve if you do not. The elites rise above the starving masses, fattened briefly by violence, until they too are drained and sent back into the fray. The disparity grows, widening until nothing remains between starvation and the sword. And always, no matter how much is gained, it piles at your feet, for all blood paid is blood tithed to you.

Your gift is bounty and your curse is addiction. Wars under your reign do not resolve; they are fed by famine and famine is fed by them. There is no peace, only the spiraling hunger for more bloodshed, more plunder, more survival by the blade. In your dominion, famine and war are no longer separate, but one unending economy of blood.
addons.title: Blood Tithe

objects.text:
You are the Red Horseman of War. However, you have yet to fully mature.

Even in your incomplete state, you are a prodigy of battle. Matters of war come to you not through study or discipline, but through instinct, as if etched into your soul. Strategy, tactics, weapon mastery, hand-to-hand combat, no technique or art of war lies beyond your grasp. Where others train for decades to achieve competence, you ascend to mastery in mere moments. Amid the chaos of violence, you find purpose, focus, and evolution.

But your gift goes beyond personal prowess. Your very presence draws warriors to you like wolves to blood. Those with violence in their hearts find themselves compelled by your aura. Even those who once swore pacifism are slowly unmoored from their convictions, their restraint eroded by your influence until the act of killing becomes not just acceptable, but joyous. 

And as blood spills, your power grows. Violence feeds you. Every blow struck in your name, every life taken under your influence sharpens your skill, deepens your insight, and broadens your control. Your sword strikes with preternatural precision, your strategies border on prophecy, and your will becomes an unrelenting command in the hearts of those who follow you. The violence you inspire begins to spread like contagion. Those touched by your presence become carriers, infecting others with the same lust for battle. Witnesses to the aftermath feel a heat stir in their chest, the desire for blood and craving for chaos. 

But there is no peace in your wake. Battles grow bloodier, wars last longer, hatred runs deeper. There is no limit to the carnage, no natural point of conclusion. Under your influence, violence itself becomes self-perpetuating. 

You are the Red Horseman. And your dominion is not over armies or territory, but over the very instinct to kill.
objects.title: Red Horseman

addons.text:
Where you walk, your presence unravels more than flesh. It corrodes the world itself, leeching away nourishment, prosperity, and warmth until nothing remains but husks and shadows. What begins as scarcity deepens into famine, and famine festers into death. Yet death under you is not final. Those who starve and wither in your shadow do not find peace, they rise, hollowed, as your undead.

The dead you raise from famine are different from those born of execution. They are not reborn with unchanging echoes of their former selves, but with gnawing hunger that cannot be sated. Their existence is parasitic. They drain the living around them, sapping food, warmth, vitality, and even the will to resist. The longer they endure, the more they devour and spread your hollow dominion. As they spread, your power swells, strengthening their hunger.

Through them, famine becomes self-perpetuating. Your undead are not soldiers but famine embodied, walking blights upon the land. Crops wither as they march, water stagnates, livestock waste away, and even the memory of joy rots in their wake. What they consume never returns, it is denied to the world and hoarded in their starving forms, treasures of absence stored in hollow chests. The only one who can claim it from them is you.

Your gift is dominion, your curse is hunger. You have bound famine to death and death to famine, and so neither may ever be undone. To resist you is to starve, to fall before you is to rise for you, and to live under you is to wither until the hunger takes hold. In your dominion, famine and death are no longer separate, but one endless hollowing.
addons.title: Dry Bones

objects.text:
You are the Black Horseman of Famine. However, you have yet to fully mature.

Even in this nascent state, your presence unravels the delicate balance of sustenance and wealth. Fields grow barren in your presence, food spoils in storage, coin loses its worth, and the warmth of fat and comfort bleeds from flesh. All dwindling things spiral toward you. The world does not simply lose; it feeds you in its losing.

Resources, be they physical nourishment, currency, or energy, are drawn to you like water to a drain. And as they flow inward, you hoard them. You stockpile what others need, an ever-growing reserve of plenty surrounded by a desert of lack. The more that others are denied, the more your vault swells. The imbalance is the engine of your power.

But famine is not a solitary force. You may share your stolen abundance with chosen individuals, not as charity, but as a curse. Those you empower become beacons of disparity, amplifiers of deprivation. They act as vectors of your presence, spreading your famine. With every widening gap, between the rich well-fed and the ruined starving, your influence expands. The greater the disparity, the faster the collapse. The suffering of many becomes the soil in which your famine grows. 

Over time, you learn to starve less tangible things. Hope, ambition, love, and loyalty, each can be drained, hoarded, or redistributed at your will. People will wither in place, hollowed out until only obedience remains.

You are the Black Horseman. Your presence is not announced with armies or fire, but with hunger. And in the void you create, nothing grows but need.
objects.title: Black Horseman

addons.text:
Where you walk, war is not an ending but a prelude. Violence is never final, death is never release, and the battlefield is never empty. Every soul touched by your presence, whether by your hand or the hands of those already infected by your influence, carries a mark. To strike another, to shed blood in your shadow, is to be claimed. Even the smallest act of violence seals their fate: they are yours, though they may not yet know it.

When the marked one dies, their end is denied. They are resurrected as your undead. The blood spilled in your name becomes the measure of their return. Those who fought briefly rise slowly, hollow sparks flickering after long years. But those who reveled in slaughter awaken swiftly, summoned back in the heat of the battlefield. Violence is their tether, and the more they fed it in life, the stronger and quicker their second birth under you.

Within each corpse burns an echo of your gift: the instinctive mastery of war. The more violence they committed in life beneath your banner, the more that genius infuses their bones in death. A farmer who struck once may rise with a predator’s reflexes, while a general who bathed in blood may return a savant of battle, wielding tactics and skill beyond their mortal years. They are fragments of your instinct, reflections of your genius for killing, shaped by the violence they once committed for you.

Your gift is eternity, your curse is inevitability. You have bound war to death and death to war, and so neither may ever end. To fight you is to join you, to fall before you is to rise for you, and to live under you is to kill until the mark takes hold. In your dominion, death and war are no longer separate, but one unending massacre.
addons.title: Last Trumpet

objects.text:
You are the Pale Horseman of Death. However, you have yet to fully mature.

Wherever you walk, mortality becomes palpable. You perceive the invisible countdown over every living being: the approximate length of time they have left to walk the world. You can kill others before their destined time, and in doing so, take ownership of what remains.

When you slay a living being before their appointed end, you automatically raise them in undeath, a shadow of what they were, yet imbued with unnatural vitality. The more unused time they had before their natural death, the more potent their undead form becomes. A warrior slain decades before their natural death may rise with strength far surpassing what they had in life. But this gift carries a flaw: their minds are frozen at the moment of death. An undeveloped child or a dying madman will serve you with all the limitations of their final thoughts. 

Like you, these undead gain the ability to perceive the death-clocks of others. And when they strike down the living before their time, they too can raise the fallen. Yet their harvest is imperfect: half the remaining time is stolen, absorbed by the killer to empower themselves, while the newly risen are thus made weaker.

As your legions multiply, so too does your dominion over them. What begins as mere command becomes communion. Your undead become extensions of your will, your senses, your presence. They move not as soldiers obeying orders, but as limbs responding to thought. With every soul claimed, your reach grows. With every corpse that walks, your control deepens. And through it all, your influence spreads like a quiet plague. 

You are the Pale Horseman. Death does not merely follow you, it answers to you.
objects.title: Pale Horseman

addons.text: Instead of a passive passenger on your journey, your Spirit Guide becomes an active and reliable partner that consistently aids you when needed most, or makes the challenges you face much less daunting. Their form is stronger, sturdier, and faster than before, with some unique abilities specifically designed to both defend themselves and make up for your shortcomings. At minimum, they will be comparable to 25% of your power, and can grow overtime to keep pace with you. For example, as a Vampire Slayer, they will have a suite of abilities that make such a grueling profession much more tolerable, enjoyable even. Such as a blinding flash of light to stun the fiends long enough for you to decapitate them, curing you from their forbidden magics, or weaken them overtime with rays of sunlight. Additionally, they gain various skills fit for a support role in video games, such as being a walking map, giving hints when you're lost, deciphering cryptic texts, or documentating noteworthy information. If you took any addons under Jump Jump Hero!, their supportive abilities are further elevated and become thematically appropriate for you. For example, with Freedom Fighter Extraordinare, you can have the equivalent of Tails that will catch you the instant you fall off a cliff, or a Chao that provides you various buff effects. Another is with Ghoulish Gothic Gallivating providing a familiar that will highlight weakpoints in the creatures you face, and having various defensive and purification abilities to protect you. Otherwise, they will have generic abilities appropriate to the setting and your mission. Finally, your Spirit Guide can shapeshift between these various forms of support and appearances, and will adapt in real time to your adventures.
addons.title: Mascot Companion

objects.text:
You've gained a spirit guide—their form is yours to decide—perhaps they'll be a fairy, a light spirit, a ghostly familiar, or some other small mascot companion. What matters is that this guide will do their best to aid you in your journey. A sentient, floating little helper, they may point you toward hidden treasure, organize your belongings during downtime, chart out a dungeon ahead, warn you of lurking dangers, or even do their utmost to get you back on your feet when you've been downed, using whatever means they have available.

So go forth, little adventurer—together with your new companion, carve out your journey and tread your own path.
objects.title: Spirit Guide

addons.text:
You walked the path of the Shin’yōji, treating machines as vessels of spirit and prayer. Yet in your journey, you encountered the Gaijin Mages, those who wield the Processor and bend technology through Prints and Tokens. Where others saw only crude manipulation, you saw a mirror of your own arts, and through study, communion, and daring, you merged their techniques into your rituals. Now, your prayers flow with code, your scripts breathe with spirit, and your companions are both Shikigami and machine.

You can now transmute Net Kiai and Tokens between one another. Kiai may be condensed into Tokens for stable storage, while Tokens may be burned to sustain Kiai resonance in barren zones. This allows you to keep your Shikigami.exe active where no currents flow. Either resource can fuel Prints, and when both are combined, they create surges of overwhelming force at the cost of rapid depletion. You can channel Kiai for precision and Tokens for overwhelming force, though such surges quickly drain your reserves.

You may bind a Shikigami.exe into a Print, turning it into a semi-living script that persists rather than fading, autonomously adapting to any defense against them. Wards, seals, and bindings written this way resist intrusion with both logic and will. Most powerful among these is Installation, a Print that anchors a Shikigami.exe into hardware permanently. Such a device awakens as a techno-shrine, turning the Shikigami into a mountain god of circuits and steel, growing stronger the longer it is honored and used.

At the center of your power is your Familiar, the evolution of the Processor itself. This organ is no mere machine, but a Mitama bound to your soul, both companion and guide. Through it, you may perceive the hidden leylines of the digital world, mapping flows of resonance, locating nodes of corruption, and sensing the quiet emotions embedded in networks and machines. It can also act as a defense against net and soul attacks. As your Familiar grows, it sharpens your rituals, harmonizes your energies, and deepens your bond with the unseen soul of technology itself.
addons.title: Techno Miko

objects.text:
Onmyōdō was once the art of balancing natural forces and communing with spirits through prayer, ritual, and contract. Though the mediums have changed, the practice endures. In the modern age, practitioners of Shin’Yō Jutsu, called Shin’yōji, thrive where machines are revered in place of shrines, and networks carry the currents of human belief and emotion. Just as old practitioners prayed to mountains, rivers, and stars, their successors now pray to the devices and systems through which human life flows.

At its core, Shin’Yō Jutsu treats machines and code as Mitama, living essences shaped by creation, use, and human presence. Mitama can be communicated with through prayer and ritual, much like the spirits of old. Once resonance is established, a Shin’yōji may contract the Mitama, awakening it beyond the limits of ordinary AI. This binding allows it to passively draw upon Net Kiai, the energy generated by human emotion embedded in code and networks. The older and more emotionally laden a system is, the stronger its Mitama and the richer its Kiai.

When contracted, a Mitama transforms into a Shikigami.exe, a spiritual entity layered atop its technological program. Unlike conventional AI, Shikigami.exe are fueled by Kiai, which allows them to bend, twist, and even defy the rigid rules of code. They act as companions, guardians, and extensions of the Shin’yōji’s will. A Shikigami.exe can battle hostile entities, infiltrate or seal networks, or manifest through hardware to alter its function. Because they operate on spiritual energy rather than conventional logic, their actions appear black-boxed and impossible to ordinary programmers.

The art of Shin’Yō Jutsu is performed through Shikigami.exe, who serve as the medium for every working. They can strike hostile systems by attacking their Mitama, seal corrupted code through ritual bindings, or interface with machinery so it acts as though possessed. Wards become protective scripts, seals act as prisons within networks, and possession manifests as machines behaving with will beyond their design. To outsiders, these workings are indistinguishable from miracles or curses, operating outside the limits of normal programming and security.

The system is bound by place and flow. Practitioners rely on digital leylines, areas where Net Kiai pools, such as heavily trafficked networks, old machines with long emotional histories, or dense data centers where countless interactions occur. Within these currents, Shikigami.exe act with full strength, and Shin’Yō Jutsu becomes seamless. But in barren zones, such as fresh systems or disconnected machines, the lack of resonance starves both practitioner and Shikigami.exe. Techniques weaken, wards falter, and extended use drains the Shin’yōji directly. The art requires connection; without living currents of Kiai, even the strongest contracts cannot be sustained. This can be partially mitigated by storing Net Kiai in advance, which is something that happens automatically when you are in a place with high amounts of it. Nonetheless, this is merely a mitigation as you would have no way to replenish it.
objects.title: Shin’Yō Jutsu

objects.text: A mask is a face. To wear one is to step into another skin. To make one is to give shape to an identity that already lingers in the world. You are a mask maker, a crafter who weaves magic into faces not truly alive yet not inert. Your masks are vessels of awakened material and symbolic form; potential identities waiting to be worn, empty skins that only take meaning when matched with a living bearer. The act of mask making is both craftsmanship and sorcery. Each material carries a latent spirit, and when shaped into a face, these spirits awaken. Shape determines role, material determines power. A mask of ash wood carved as a sly fox lends its wearer a quick tongue and sharper reflexes, but causes others to instinctively distrust their words. A mask bound in stag bone with curling antlers makes its wearer steadfast, able to endure fatigue and rally others, but it also creates a restless instinct to challenge others. Yet masks are only faces without bodies; their power is minimal until worn. When a person dons a mask, they borrow its identity. Sometimes the mask rejects them. A mask of guile may resist an honest man, causing unease, distortions, even rejection. Masks are identities, and a clash of identities can twist or fracture. Your greatest works are personal masks, crafted for a specific individual. This requires intimacy: materials gathered by the intended wearer and your deep study of who they are beneath the surface. Such masks do not impose a foreign identity but reveal one hidden within. A grieving mother with a willow-wood mask of soft lines might find her sorrow tempered and her voice able to soothe others. A wandering scholar with a silver mask of spirals might infer and extrapolate vast truths from the smallest fragment of data.
objects.title: Mask Maker

objects.text:
You have learned Kokyū Hohō, a core breathing art within Eastern magic and martial traditions. This technique centers on absorbing the energy of the outer world and harmonizing it with your inner world, forming a living bridge through breath. In practice, it shapes not only your physical body but also your capacity to create magical interference through it.

As a result, your body itself becomes a pure conduit, granting you the potential to manifest feats of magic even without formal knowledge of the mystic arts. For example, Shinto priests have banished evil spirits with nothing more than a clap, while Buddhist masters are said to disperse demons with a single palm.

Your mastery begins with exceptional command over breath and body. Physically, you could rival Olympic athletes. More than that, your body can now sense and interact with mystical or esoteric energies, allowing you to influence spells or perform minor feats akin to magic solely through breath, movement, and body.

This art does not grant you spells or martial techniques by itself. But its true strength lies in being a foundational skill—one that enables rapid growth in any form of Eastern martial or mystical art.
objects.title: Kokyū Hohō

objects.text:
Your soul has been bonded to a summonable set of tarnished bronze armour designed in the earliest stages of the Trau‘s Imperial conquest . While this carries all of the presumed benefits being cloaked in metal would give you, this pales in comparison to its main function. 

The Armour is programmed to execute specific lines of Black Code, allowing you to twist physical materials like clay. While this is far from intuitive, it acts more akin to an adapted modeling system than anything else. However, with practice it can easily alter the terrain around you, states of matter, and even biological functions.

Additionally, as the armour is stored within the Black Code, this allows you to touch any entity reflected in it, such as spiritual or energy beings as if they were physical, though using the armour to alter them would be impossible if they had no ‘matter’ to alter.
objects.title: Grasp of Bronze

objects.text:
A sword has been forcefully embedded within your soul, as if it had stabbed directly into it and been left there to rust in place. This old, worn steel sword is not a weapon in the physical sense, but a manifestation of a foreign idea, the inherited ideal of a hero who once took up another’s cause. Through it, an obsession has been implanted deep into your being: the absolute need to save everyone.

This obsession drives you beyond physical and spiritual limits when acting to protect or rescue others. Fatigue, pain, and injury are ignored as long as your purpose is to save someone. You might lift debris with broken bones to free the trapped or fight tirelessly to shield civilians until the threat ends. The strength granted scales with the danger and those at risk: saving one person grants athletic prowess, saving a dozen grants the strength of a hundred men and saving a city lets you shatter reinforced steel or magic alike. The sword’s energy only stirs for selfless intent; any trace of greed, revenge, or self-preservation silences it.

You also gain an instinctive awareness of others’ peril. Threats to anyone in sight feel like pressure in your mind, while danger to those emotionally tied to you pulls sharply at your chest or makes the sword ring within your soul. When a great disaster looms, the sensation becomes overwhelming, dragging your attention toward it. This sense reveals only the direction and intensity of danger, never its exact form or cause.

Yet this ideal carries corruption. Each use of the sword spreads its rust through your soul, eroding emotion and identity while replacing them with an ever-growing compulsion to save. Minor use dulls your sense of self, making your own safety feel irrelevant when weighed against the lives of others. Moderate use strains your spirit, breeding intrusive thoughts that reject rest or recovery, even through mortal injury, as the need to act overwhelms all reason. Repeated or large-scale use hastens decay; you begin to forget “I,” existing only as the sword’s will made flesh, a being that lives solely to save, regardless of the cost to oneself. Metallic circuits begin to surface across your body, their number reflecting the depth of the rust within your soul. When the sword is invoked, these circuits ignite with a green glow, pulsing in rhythm with the sword embedded in your soul.

External forces can slow or even reverse the corrosion. Genuine care and spiritual healing can “paint over” the rust, restoring fragments of your self-worth and awareness, though the sword itself remains tainted. With rest and restraint, the rust may flake away naturally, but resisting the implanted instinct to save is agony. It feels like suffocating while watching someone drown, and the more you fight it, the louder the sword calls.
objects.title: Ideals of a Certain Hero

addons.text:
The art of Sendo, also known as Hamon, has merged with your chi, endowing it with unique properties.

You can heal yourself and others by channeling your chi in combination with Hamon. This powerful synergy allows you to direct positive healing energy, enhancing both your own recovery and that of those you assist.

Thanks to the fusion of Hamon and chi, your natural vitality has significantly slowed your aging process. As a result, you can maintain the appearance of someone in their twenties well into your late 80s, and you can expect to live six to seven times longer than the average human, with your lifespan increasing further through training and the expansion of your chi.

By circulating chi throughout your body and practicing Sendo breathing techniques, your chi will begin to exhibit properties similar to those of the Sun, allowing you to reach a level of Sendo comparable to that of Kar.

Unlike typical practitioners of Sendo, who can infuse Hamon into liquids to harden them, you have the ability to shape water into simple constructs, such as whips or blades. The durability of these constructs depends on the amount of Hamon and chi infused into them.

Additionally, your blood and life force become a bane to all those weak to the Sun’s rays, such as zombies and vampires.
addons.title: One with the Sun

addons.text:
The Bending Arts find their root in Chi, spiritual life energy, relying on specific movements to stimulate its flow through the body and outwards to interact with the world, which in turn manipulates the elements. As someone with an opened Dantian, you can directly manipulate Chi. This changes things.

For starters, whatever Bending Styles you chose have been integrated into your ability to manipulate Chi, becoming true Chi techniques. This does away with the need for specific movements to stimulate your Chi, as you can manually direct your Chi to accomplish the effect, although the movements do make the techniques easier and more efficient. More importantly, however, is the way your ability to manipulate raw Chi has interfaced with the Bending Arts. 

You have gained insight into Energybending, allowing you to use a limited, bastardized version of it. In the beginning your Energybending can’t do much on its own, merely allowing you to communicate and interact with spirits, and needing to be mixed with another Bending Style to achieve physical effects, like combining it with Firebending to create ethereal flames which can burn Spirits. 

With time and practice however, you will be able to do things like interfere with and disrupt the Chi of others, astral project, or open paths to the Spirit Realm. At the peak of your mastery you will be able to remove or grant Bending Arts you possess, and potentially even master true Energybending and learn other Bending Arts.
addons.title: Novice Energybender

addons.text:
You have gained the ability to perform spells instead of martial arts techniques through the use of mantras (chants), hand seals, talismans, and pure Chi control.

As a Xian practitioner from the world of immortals, you are naturally capable of accessing the full elemental expression of the Wuxing foundations, forming a Five Element Spiritual Root within your soul specifically within your Lower Dantian. You do not suffer the effects of the restorative or restrictive cycles, though the techniques you execute are still influenced by them. Furthermore, you can actively trigger Sosei (generative cycle) and Sokoku (overcoming cycle) regardless of the target’s elemental affinity.

The five Tao cultivation methods and the Lower Dantian healing method have merged into a true Wugong (Immortal Martial Art). Through this, you can actively maximize your potential using Tao-based Enhancement, Emission, Manipulation, Armor, Redirection, Suppression, Pressure, and Detection. Your level of competence is comparable to that of a Tensen with 50 years of experience.

You can now truly accomplish feats reserved for immortals such as summoning storms with a casual gesture of your right hand, paralyzing someone with a glance, moving objects with your mind, purifying malignant influences, and much more. Additionally, both Chi and Tao can now increase in quantity and quality through Wugong training. You are not affected by realm-based suppression from cultivation level differences when facing a Xian of a higher realm.

The regeneration of your Lower Dantian can now be achieved simply by actively circulating Chi and Tao simultaneously, without the need to use the dedicated healing method. As a side effect, your mind and soul also benefit from this process. This allows you to heal internal and spiritual injuries even in the midst of combat or other activities.
addons.title: Taoist

addons.text:
Your seven Chakras are now developed into a set of dantians. The degree to which they are opened at first allows for a chi absorption rate only slightly higher than just your lower Dantian. Once all are fully open, your Chakras produce more than the sum of their parts, producing an order of magnitude more energy.

Additionally, you can feed more chi into an already fully opened Chakra, causing it to “bloom” , becoming larger and able to take in more energy. There are diminishing returns to this process, and it is subject to a similar limitation to opening them, where a Chakra can only bloom as much as the ones below it.
addons.title: Chi Reservoirs

objects.text:
You have learned how to manipulate Chi, which, regardless of its many names, is the spiritual life energy that nourishes the body.

You will start by opening your lower Dantian, which is located in your soul, which will allow you to gather Chi from the air. Passively having your lower Dantian open only slightly enhances your physiology, mind, and soul. Still, with time and practice, you will be able to utilize this Chi to enhance your strength, speed, agility, and healing. Your lower Dantian itself can be damaged, either through external influences or overuse, which will remove any benefit Chi has given you, but you gain knowledge of a technique used to heal your lower Dantian.

With sufficient practice, you may be able to manipulate others' Chi and even the ambient Chi in the air. However, manipulating another person's Chi is much more challenging and nearly impossible without the knowledge and power to dominate their Chi.

Note: This does not grant any knowledge of Chi techniques, excluding the one to open your Lower Dantian and repair it.
objects.title: Chi Manipulation

objects.text:
When Ornathi die, their angels put them to work in the Conflux, forging celestial chains to contain Vaniterra's demiurge. By tapping into this afterlife, you can pull these chains into reality.

At will, you can summon these celestial chains, manifesting them either in their entirety or ejected from portals with great speed. Though these can only be brought into reality within two meters of your body, once summoned, they have no such restriction on their movement.

Once summoned, these chains are under your complete control and direction, able to be moved with a thought, though they are still subject to momentum and other physical laws.

Finally, as these chains are linked to you, you can channel any power or ability you possess through them as though they were your own body at your discretion, in essence making them extensions of yourself.
objects.title: The Chains of Sophia

objects.text:
Carved and burned into your flesh are the words of all sins. Every evil is etched upon your skin, visible for all to see. You are both the scripture and vessel of sin; every wrong ever committed echoes within you, making you a living archive of corruption.

Every form of evil recognizes you as its own. The corrupt, the damned, the malevolent, and the monstrous are drawn to you with instinctive reverence. Any being of equal or lesser strength, if evil-aligned, will desire to serve you, obey you, or remain in your presence as if bound by unspoken command. Beings greater than you would have a favorable impression of you, but nothing else.

Your moral resistance is nonexistent. Acts of evil or cruelty carry no hesitation, doubt, or psychological burden. You can commit murder, desecration, or betrayal without remorse or hesitation. This removes any mental, moral, or spiritual cost associated with performing evil actions, including those that would normally break oaths, reduce virtue, or harm one’s sanity. Additionally, any act categorized as evil, whether magical, spiritual, or mundane, is significantly easier for you to perform. Dark spells require reduced casting time and lower magical cost. The more wicked the act, the more naturally and efficiently you perform it.

You are immune to all harmful supernatural or magical effects derived from evil. Curses, possession, corruption, and dark energies cannot harm or alter you in any way. The intent behind evil, hatred, fear, and bloodlust cannot influence you, nor can it empower attacks against you. However, this protection applies only to the spiritual and supernatural nature of evil. You can still be struck, cut, or broken by a person or creature acting with evil intent; their violence may harm your body, but their malice will find no purchase in your soul. To harm you through sin or corruption is impossible, for you are already filled with it completely.
objects.title: Sins Carved in Skin

objects.text:
One of your eyes has changed. With this change, your eye is capable of seeing the unseen. Darkness of any kind is no longer a barrier, illusions become transparent, magically concealed doors stand out, the invisible becomes visible, ghosts you can see, and transformed beings will have a life-sized spectral image superimposed over them revealing their true form.

Whether it is ghosts or gods, you can see the unseeable.
objects.title: Seer's Curse

objects.text:
You are a practitioner of the ancient Kyūdō-derived art known as the Graceful Bow, an archery discipline that values absolute precision over all else. Through intense meditative focus, disciplined breath control, and perfected motion, you learn to release arrows that follow a flawless, unbroken path toward their target. Each arrow reflects the purity of your will; once released, it ignores air resistance, gravity, and momentum loss, traveling in a true line until it strikes exactly where intended.

As a practitioner, your body has been conditioned to use the Graceful Bow, giving you enhanced physical and sensory control. Your eyesight sharpens beyond normal limits, capable of clearly distinguishing fine details and reading subtle movement at extreme distances. Even as a novice, your effective range with your bow begins at over one kilometre, allowing you to hit distant targets with unwavering precision. As your mastery increases, this range extends dramatically, eventually allowing for perfect shots at several kilometres without environmental interference.

When you draw the bow, spiritual energy condenses around the arrowhead, forming a sheath of stabilizing force that neutralizes drag and turbulence. The moment you release, that energy locks the arrow into its “true line,” erasing deviation. The arrow’s velocity remains constant until impact; it never arcs or slows. Once it reaches its target, the arrow does not explode or splinter; it simply passes through the target as if it were the only point in space that mattered. Each arrow fired through the Graceful Bow carries immense penetrative force relative to the quality of your focus. The arrowhead experiences no loss of kinetic energy, allowing it to pierce progressively denser materials the stronger your concentration becomes. As a novice, your arrows can easily pierce layered steel plates at a kilometre’s range.

However, the Graceful Bow demands total focus and restraint. You cannot fire rapidly; each shot requires stillness of mind and absolute intention. Attempting to release multiple arrows in succession without re-centering your focus drastically reduces accuracy and negates the style’s defining property of force immunity. In practice, this means that while other archers may shoot dozens of arrows in a minute, you may only release one.

The style also consumes immense spiritual and physical energy. Maintaining the state of perfect calm drains your stamina and focus over time, and any emotional disturbance, such as fear, anger, or hesitation, will immediately degrade performance. Missing a shot due to a lapse in concentration is punishing; recovering mental stability in combat takes precious seconds. You are also vulnerable when re-centering yourself, as the Graceful Bow requires you to remain stationary and composed to operate at full strength. Finally, while your arrows can pierce nearly anything, they cannot strike what you cannot see and aim for.
objects.title: Graceful Bow

objects.text:
You are a practitioner of the Revolving Blade, a sword style derived from Kendō and Iaido that teaches restraint and precision above all else. You do not waste movement, strength, or thought. You draw only when the outcome is certain, and you swing only when the line of your blade has already formed in your mind. Every strike you make is deliberate, measured, and complete. Those who master the style are known not for the number of their cuts, but for the finality of them.

You channel your intent into your weapon, creating what practitioners call a sword line. When you commit to a strike, your awareness, breath, and muscle control align perfectly, allowing the sword to travel through its intended path without deviation. This means your single attacks hit with exceptional precision and force, scaling with your focus rather than raw strength. A properly executed cut can cleave through defences and cut through any mundane material. The style emphasizes single, high-damage actions rather than continuous offense.

The technique also enhances your physical coordination and endurance through the discipline’s conditioning. Your stance training and circular movements develop exceptional balance and lower-body strength, improving stability and evasion. You gain refined control over your breathing and timing, allowing you to anticipate openings or avoid overextension. The conditioning is not brute-force training but micro-control, with your body learning to align perfectly with your intent, making even minimal motion efficient.

However, Revolving Blade requires focus and patience. You cannot maintain its state under distraction or panic. If your concentration breaks, your strikes lose alignment with the sword line and revert to ordinary swings with no enhanced effect. The style is not suitable for prolonged combat or fighting multiple opponents simultaneously; the deliberate timing it requires leaves you vulnerable during recovery periods. You rely on anticipation; if the opponent’s rhythm is unpredictable or if you are forced into rapid exchanges, your efficiency collapses.

The technique also depends heavily on mental discipline. Fatigue, emotional instability, or hesitation directly reduces the style’s effectiveness. For example, a single lapse in focus can cause your strike to miss its intended trajectory, nullifying the sword line and wasting your stamina. Revolving Blade favors those who can remain calm and decisive under pressure. Without that mindset, the technique is more a hindrance than a help, turning your reliance on “one perfect cut” into a fatal delay.
objects.title: Revolving Blade

objects.text:
You take up Death in full, not as a trick or technique but as the final authority that every living thing acknowledges. Your presence clarifies endings, quiets falsehoods, and makes the border between life and the afterlife obey your will. You hear how any life has ended or is ending, and you can lay a soul bare with a glance, reading the truth beneath masks and alibis. Corpses, remnants, ghosts, and greater spirits answer when you address them. If you wish, the dead rise—swift, precise, and bound to your intent—until you dismiss them back to stillness.

Death does not mistake your intent. You can forbid an end, holding a life in place until you permit release, or lift the weight of mortality so that a broken body moves, fights, and speaks before the bill comes due. You can call a departed mortal back to breath when the passing is not sealed by a paradise beyond reach. When you decide an ending must happen now, your word is enough; lesser foes topple with a whisper, and even great ones feel the scythe if you have marked them and drawn first blood.

Your will shapes bone, memory, and grave-echo into useful forms. Old skeletons answer as steeds, guardians, hounds, and warriors. White bone flows like metal under your hand, taking the shapes of masks, tools, armor, and engines. You can manifest the dead as signs and witnesses that bind the living: a murdered child confronts her killers, a betrayed knight stands in judgment, a wronged parent gives a final warning that cannot be laughed off. What you make from death can endure as long as you care to sustain it.

You command spirits as surely as you do fleshless remains. You can summon, bind, bargain with, shelter, or disperse ghosts; you can set a haunting to rest or rouse an army of shades to harry the living. You move through the places between worlds as a rightful custodian, and the unquiet recognize you as master or psychopomp at your choosing.

You wield the raw energy of ending and release. You gather it, refine it, and spend it as lightless fire, cold radiance, or silent pressure. You weave it into shields that turn blades, circles that deny decay, brands that mark a condemned fate, and wells that feed your works. You can steep a place in peace so killing fails to take root, or flood it with inevitability so rot hastens and lies fall apart. Where you walk, death is not rumor. It is a tool, a promise, and a truth that answers only to you.

Death also arms you. Your gaze can drop an enemy in silence. Your touch carries the chill that severs the thread of life. When you choose mercy, the same edge becomes a clean severing of pain without ending the person who bears it. A single uttered command can turn a battle, still a monster’s heart, or break an immortal that believed itself beyond consequence. Your reach is not confined to graves; you tug at cause and effect around your servants so that doors open where they must appear and streets narrow where a fleeing target will be caught.

You speak all tongues. Death understands every farewell and every vow, and so do you—living languages, forgotten scripts, the speech of beasts and stranger minds. You can name a thing as it truly is, and names spoken by you carry the weight of an epitaph or a reprieve.

Your body bears Death’s sign. You regenerate at a steady pace, knitting flesh, mending bone, and clearing poison without drama or delay. You have no basic needs in any ordinary sense: you do not tire, hunger, or thirst, and you can go without breathing for as long as you please. No aspect of death can lay casual claim to you. The cold embrace that steals warmth cannot numb you, grave-chill cannot slow you, and the wither that rots wood, flesh, or courage will not touch your nerves or will. You sense the approach of endings the way others feel a storm coming, marking who is dead, who is dying, and how long remains, and you can follow that thread to a name, a place, and the shape of a final moment.
objects.title: Thanatarch

addons.text:
Your unique soul has impacted Carnwennan, soulbound as it is.

Firstly, the spear’s form is more malleable than ever, becoming able to shift far more than its haft, turning from knife to axe to claws and even firearms.

Additionally, being able to push your soul through it to infect others allows you to bestow a semblance of your own soul’s properties on another. While this can give similar abilities to your own if left untouched afterwards, you can also begin pulling their soul through the spear and into your own, acting as more raw resources to subsume and enhance your own soul even without killing the victim, leaving them a soulless husk able to be commanded (though without much finesse) until another soul takes theirs’ place.
addons.title: Transience

addons.text: Your soulbound objects have fused, firstly supplying each with the abilities of the other; the chains are now able to infect the souls of others, and the spear is controllable physically with far more accuracy.
addons.title: Kusarigama

addons.text: When you implant a fragment of your soul into someone, you can also implant a piece of the Manus into them. While theoretically this could let them utilise a vastly diminished form of the Manus themselves, you can utilise the shard as a node, allowing you to use the Manus’ full power through them as a proxy, great distances from you.
addons.title: Manus Notational

objects.text:
You can summon to your hand a knife with a forearm length blade. The handle of this knife can extend up to five meters in length at will.

Carnwennan is a tool bonded to its user’s soul, acting as both a weapon and a conduit for the user’s soul to be pushed through. As such, whenever something is stabbed with the spear, the user can push their own through it and into the subject.

By planting a piece of your soul into the target, you can cause a variety of effects: seeing through their eyes, leeching from their stamina or mana, influencing their actions, and even inflicting injuries from afar. Similarly, killing someone with the spear absorbs their soul into its mass, allowing it to be consumed as a resource to enhance the spear and its own abilities or any other ability you possess to a degree, though this will destroy the soul.
objects.title: Carnwennan

addons.title: It Was There All Along
addons.text:
Your powers do not require a soul to function...but what would happen if you got one anyway?

Whether it's because of the emptiness inside you, or some part of the Soul craves a proper body of its own, you may open the jar to let the Soul enter you. You will not suffer any loss of control from this change, but you may find yourself feeling emotions a little more strongly than before. More importantly, with a Soul now sitting firmly where before you had a lack of one, all powers that before functioned without it are now amplified by at least 500% in raw potency.

However, this does not mean that your immunity to soul-based effects is gone. Any attack that happens to harm the Soul will affect you only 20% as strongly as it might someone else. Additionally, you may at any time remove the Soul from yourself to place it back in its jar, returning to your previous Soulless state.

If you purchased multiple Souls, you may house all of them inside yourself, each one granting another 500% boost, stacking linearly.

objects.text:
For all intents and purposes, you have no soul. While this will have no obvious effect on your consciousness it means that anything that relies on you having a soul will automatically fail.

Notably, this does not affect physical attacks, but rather anything that affects your soul primarily. A soul-stealing dagger wouldn’t work, but you would still likely need aid from being stabbed. Psionic attacks would likewise work if they don’t use the soul as a medium to operate through.

Any abilities or powers that rely on you having a soul will instead be drawn from the inverse ‘lack’ of one, creating an effect that is practically similar and yet acts very different in most interactions and edge-cases. In essence you would still have a ‘Soul’ for the purpose of anything gained through this CYOA but would not otherwise.
objects.title: Soulless

objects.text: It seems the air itself has declared you a champion of its domain. On the very base level, you have been granted wings of your desire, as long as they at least generally match an existing winged creature. These wings, at the start of your journey, will give you thrice your running speed, powered or not, in the air. As expected, they also use your own stamina. You are also given access to air-bound magic like wind and, with time, lightning. At the start, you'll be able to push people around with 50+ mph wind gusts, and speed up your own flight in a pinch. You'll also be able to, on the more complex side, be able to give someone a minute or 2 more of oxygen if they need it. Later on, you'll find yourself able to even manipulate the weather to an extent and cast somewhat weak lightning magic. Finally, it seems your mastery with any species of aviary or species that call the sky their home is impressive. You can talk to them as if they perfectly spoke your language. Furthermore, they will at least be inclined, even if not forced, to help you out if you call for them. They'll even find themselves minorly enhanced in the process.
objects.title: Child of the Sky

objects.text:
By aligning your will with the act of cutting, you have been enlightened to the secrets of Sword Intent.

Having grasped the basics, you may now choose to project a sharp aura that causes others to instinctively treat you as a blade. At your current level, ordinary people will flinch simply by meeting your gaze.

Sword Intent can also be used to sharpen a weapon beyond its physical limits. By layering intent onto a blade, even a toy sword can cut as cleanly as a masterwork blade. However, having only grasped the fundamentals of Sword Intent, this enhancement remains limited. At present, any blade you imbue with intent will maintain at least the cutting quality of a well made steel sword, regardless of its condition. With further mastery, you may eventually imbue blades with supernatural sharpness.

The most legendary aspect of Sword Intent is the ability to cut through sheer will. By projecting your intent outward, you may release physical slashes that cut from a distance. At your current level, your intent is constrained by the sharpness of your weapon and can only extend up to ten meters. With continued mastery, both the range and sharpness of your intent will increase, eventually allowing you to forgo a sword entirely and cut using will alone.

Sword Intent does not require supernatural energy to use, but it is physically and mentally draining to wield. It can, however, be combined seamlessly with other supernatural arts or energies.

You may improve your Sword Intent by honing your skill with the sword or by further sharpening your own will.
objects.title: Sword Intent

addons.title: Dual Aspects
addons.text: Your Aspect Seed has subsumed your Elemental connection, with you manifesting another Aspect Seed attuned to whatever your initial Element was. Alternatively, if both your Elemental connection and Aspect Seed are of the same element then they compound upon each other and instantaneously bloom to full mastery of your concept. Even if you have two Aspect Seeds instead of compounding, both start at greater mastery matching what Elementalism was capable of, including gaining the ability to manifest effects derived from conceptual meanings and applications before you achieve true mastery.

addons.title: Aspectual Embodiment
addons.text: Your nature as the sole embodiment of your domain and the absolute authority it provides you have drastically accelerated your mastery of your Aspect, reducing a process requiring years to a mere handful of months. Additionally, if you possess two Aspect Seeds through the Dual Aspects addon then the effects of Absolute Authority expand to encompass your other Aspect Seed as well, including the ability to survive as long as a trace of it exists.

objects.text:
Within you grows the seed of an Aspect. This manifests as a deep conceptual connection to a specific sliver of reality. This bond is not constrained by category or scale; it may be a classic element, such as Fire or Water, something more abstract like Good or Evil, or even a purely conceptual domain such as Time or Fate.

At present, your authority over this Aspect is limited. While it holds vast potential, its current effects are weak and restrained. Regardless of the Aspect chosen, its maximum effective impact is limited to roughly city block scale, and its potency is similarly constrained. Selecting an Aspect such as Death does not grant instant conceptual death. Instead, your early influence may manifest as the ability to inflict negative energy, debuffs, gradual deterioration, or related expressions appropriate to its theme. This limitation, however, is temporary.

With practice and time, your control and understanding will grow rapidly. Within a few months, your Aspect can reach city scale influence, with precision and control improving alongside raw power. Over the course of years, continued refinement can lead to true mastery, allowing both subtle and overt expressions of your Aspect to be wielded with ease. As you progress, your resistance to the effects of your own Aspect increases, eventually granting full immunity to its unwanted manifestations.

At true mastery, your Aspect begins to express its deeper conceptual meanings. You gain the ability to wield its symbolic, metaphysical and conceptual properties in addition to its direct effects. This evolution is shaped partly by your actions, choices, and interpretation of the Aspect’s nature, though it remains thematically consistent. Once fully realized, your connection to this Aspect cannot be suppressed, overridden, or taken from you by external forces.

At this stage, your authority over the Aspect within its domain is absolute.
objects.title: Aspect Seed

objects.text:
Your faith has found purchase, and your prayers have become shouts into the aether. Your call can reach any entity that has the capacity to receive prayer, ranging from nature spirits to true gods. They will be able to answer, even if things such as distance or seals would normally prevent them. These prayers must be done with the intention that they be received as such, so, just as you cannot accidentally invoke a god you would be unable to use this gift to pester one.

The simplest of prayers, those handed out on a whim, such as a blessing upon your meals or a simple offer of faith, are received without any cost. For greater prayers, an offering must be given. These offerings usually take the form of either true faith in the one being prayed to, or a sacrifice in the form of food and coin, or, more gruesomely, blood. You can also offer more esoteric offerings, such as energy from your soul, stamina, magic, or unknown knowledge. Make no mistake: while most are fickle beings, there isn't much a god won't accept.

As a final gift, you may send your prayers into the aether itself, calling to entities that aren't there. This act of calling upon imaginary gods is sufficient to temporarily bring one into being, should the plane in which you reside not have an entity who could answer your prayer. While much, much weaker than a true divinity, these fakes lack the history, and thus the fickle nature that most gods possess. This can also take the form of asking the 'universe' for help, should praying to false idols not be your cup of tea.
objects.title: Smite Me, O' Mighty Smighter

objects.text:
Your soul is closer to death than most. You can sense sources of near death, such as someone on their deathbed or a plague ward in a hospital, and you may guide them to the afterlife, peacefully and painlessly letting them pass on. This awareness also applies to ghosts and lingering spirits, granting you an instinctive understanding of what a restless soul needs to move on, with your presence bringing calm and relief to all but the most deeply hateful dead.

Your perception extends beyond the present, guiding you to where you will be needed in the future. This guides you to future warzones and places of destined death or plagues, where your gentle repose will be best put to use. This applies to individuals as well, granting you awareness of whether their end is near or far, and the broad strokes such as whether or not it will be painful.

Finally, you can sense the karmic weight of a soul, perceiving the burden of its sins and spiritual impurities. You are aware of nearby afterlives and their pull, and when a soul passes under your care you may guide it to its preferred destination, or choose one if the soul is unclaimed. You can subtly tip the balance of judgment, nudging a soul toward reward or punishment, going as far as being able to argue on their behalf to any relevant powers.
objects.title: With A Gentle Hand

objects.text: You have the ability to slice a piece of your soul off from yourself and implant it into another and vice versa. While doing so, you determine whether they are the Arm or the Mount. After the ritual, the partner deemed ‘Arm’ can transform into a perfect weapon for the other to wield, able to be reshaped and reformed into whatever weapon is needed at the time. The partner deemed ‘Mount’ meanwhile can transform into the perfect mount for the other, equally malleable in form. This connection notably allows either partner to channel powers and abilities through the other while transformed, synergising and mixing. Additionally, one can pull the other through their link to wherever they are (though they cannot return as easily). There is no limit to how many people can be designated what, only that there are two partners to each link, each with one designated ‘arm’ and ‘mount’, meaning a single person can be listed as both and either to multiple people.
objects.title: Two Part Cavalry

objects.text:
Your soul has been irrevocably marked by the realm of Hell itself. You are a condemned soul, a future inmate who has been granted a line of credit against their own eternal torment. You traded your afterlife for access to its infinite power in the here and now. You are damned, a fact signed and sealed upon your essence, to be collected upon your final death.

This spiritual mark functions as a permanent gate that connects you to an effectively limitless reservoir of infernal energy. Using this energy feels like liquid confidence and fury made manifest, creating a profound craving to tap into that feeling again once it fades.

This energy can be directly channeled to fuel and overwrite your own biology. When used to mend your wounds, your body rapidly regenerates, filling the wounds with temporary, glossy black flesh resembling cracked magma. When used to augment your body, the energy knots muscles with hellish vigor, causing your veins to glow with a dull ember-light beneath the skin, and may release puffs of sulfur-tinged vapor with exertion. These physical alterations are intense but temporary, lasting only minutes after the flow of power ceases, violently reminding you of your fragile mortality when they vanish. Furthermore, this energy can be poured into any skill, talent, or magical ability you possess, acting as a supercharged catalyst. An argument, fueled by this power, warps into a psychic compulsion that forces obedience but leaves the target’s will violated and seething with instinctive hatred. A thrown weapon strikes with piston-like force and unnatural accuracy, but may shatter or leave a corrosive, hellish residue in the wound. A fireball spell can result in a clinging, black and violet flame that burns soul the as well as flesh and induces hallucinations of damnation.

You cannot use this energy to power anything antithetical to its nature. Attempting to fuel a holy blessing, an act of pure creation, or a selfless protection spell will simply result in wasted energy. Additionally, the feeling of using this energy is highly addictive. The rush of power and endless energy causes the crash from not using it to be extremely disorienting, and can result in withdrawal symptoms.

The cost of this power is the compound interest of damnation. Every iota of energy siphoned from Hell is a debt incurred. The mark ensures that upon your final, permanent death, should you have the ability to resurrect, your soul will be claimed by the realm that fueled you. You will not merely suffer the standard tortures of a damned soul; you will endure a personalized eternity meticulously crafted to reflect and punish the specific power you stole. The more energy you had drawn from the well, the longer and more severe your sentence becomes, transforming your afterlife into an endless calculation of pain multiplied by the energy you consumed.
objects.title: Marked for Hell

objects.text:
From your chest you have three retractable tentacles, each tipped in three-pronged manipulators. The lower two being manipulators roughly 5cm in diameter each, with the larger primary tentacle being twice over their size in the center of your chest. 

Your tentacles allow you to sense the fundamental ‘quintessence’ of the universe, that being the spiritual medium between atoms, and shape it by resonating at the right frequencies. The tentacles themselves allow you to manipulate it with great skill, nurturing and tending to it in ways mundane hands are incapable.

While this natively allows you to sense souls and distinguish the energy they leave with great talent, by touching your larger tentacle to someone’s chest and vibrating at the right frequency for their soul, you can induce a kind of soul-hemorrhage causing it to lose cohesion and begin to discorporate. Naturally this will have fatal effects as someone’s soul leaks out of their body

The tentacles themselves are rather strong, capable of approximately double the strength of each of your arms.
objects.title: You Speak in Matter. You Hear in Light.

addons.text:
Your divine blood has augmented your inherited curse, refining it into a precise instrument of authority and control, granting you mastery over the golden form.

Once you have completely transformed a discrete object into Imperial Gold, you can animate it with a focused mental command. These constructs, such as golden statues or weapons, can follow simple, direct orders like "guard," "advance," or "attack," though they possess no true intelligence. Furthermore, your transmutation now preserves the essential functional properties of the original material, expressed through Imperial Gold. Gilded cloth remains flexible and wearable, wood retains a semblance of its texture, and other materials behave analogously, all while gaining the supernatural durability and monster-repelling qualities of the sacred metal.

You can now willfully revert any object you have transformed back to its original state through concentration, no longer requiring running water to dissolve the gold.
addons.title: Gilded Authority

objects.text:
You are a Legacy, a distant descendant of the legendary King Midas. You have inherited a diluted echo of his infamous curse. Fortunately, the Fates are not without mercy, and your inheritance has been tempered and focused, transforming a destructive affliction into a potent, if dangerous, tool.

Your right hand and forearm, up to the elbow, are permanently transformed into living Imperial Gold. It possesses full sensation, articulation, and strength, appearing as a gleaming metallic limb. By channeling stamina and intense focus through this hand, you can transmute any object or being you make direct physical contact with into Imperial Gold. Imperial Gold is a sacred metal blessed for combat against supernatural forces. It is lethally effective against monsters, immortals, and their demigod or legacy descendants.

The transformation begins at the exact point of contact and spreads outward from there. The stamina and focus cost of transmutation is determined by the total volume of the target you intend to transform. You can cease the effect at any time, resulting in a partially transformed object where the spread of gold stops at your chosen boundary. For example, you could turn only the blade of a sword to gold, leaving the hilt intact.

You can revert a gilded object back to its original state only by submerging more than half of it in running water.
objects.title: Gilded Right Hand

objects.text:
Your soul is literally that of Golden Royalty—worth more than any other, blessed with greater rights in the eyes of existence itself.

No afterlife can claim you without your permission. The natural flow of souls passes you by. Grim reapers, angels, demons, and all who serve as psychopomps find themselves unable to touch you, barred by something they recognize as above them. You go where you will, when you will, or remain as long as you choose.

Beyond this, you possess Spiritual Wealth—a weight of worth separate from your actual soul. You may draw upon it instead of your true self when something would consume, sacrifice, or trade away part of you soul.

With this Weight of Wealth, as long as you keep it below a certain draw you can do it indefinitely, scaled based on the strength of your soul. If you actually spend some of your Weatlh, such spent Wealth and Weight slowly recovers over time.

Your Spiritual Wealth & Weight is functionally endless as long as you never spend it all at once, and how could you? 

A permanent retinue of demons can serve you forever, costing nothing but a negligible sliver of this wealth. A greater angel might build you a castle from light and covenant for a price your wealth covers without strain, you can even fuel a ritual or burn it for raw power instead of your actual soul.

This same wealth & weight ensures that fortune recognizes its own. Real wealth gravitates toward you. Gold finds its way to your hands. Deals turn in your favor. Opportunities appear. You do not need to seek fortune; fortune seeks you.

Infinite Wealth is a Royal's right to have.
objects.title: Soul of Royalty

objects.text:
You can summon two invisible spirits that resemble faint currents of wind. They have no physical presence and cannot interact with the material world, but they are completely undetectable by any form of sensory ability, technological surveillance, or supernatural awareness. Each spirit can travel up to one mile away from you and can pass through any barrier short of a fully sealed magical ward. They see and hear everything around them and transmit this information directly into your mind as though you were standing in their position.

The two spirits share a perfect telepathic link with each other regardless of distance, allowing one to serve as a forward scout while the other remains with you to relay information. This relay is instantaneous and cannot be intercepted or blocked by any means. You can also use either spirit as a vector for your other abilities, allowing you to cast spells, apply powers, or use gifts through the spirit's location as if you were standing there yourself. The spirits cannot be harmed or dispersed by any physical or magical means and will only vanish if you dismiss them or fall unconscious.
objects.title: Gemini, the Ghost Twins

objects.text:
You can create a crab-shaped totem within the center of any space you consider a home. This space must have defined boundaries and a roof, and the totem materializes as a small figurine carved from whatever material is most abundant in that place, appearing in the heart of the home such as a living room, kitchen, or main gathering area. The totem is immovable and indestructible while the home stands.

The strength of the totem grows in direct proportion to the quality of the relationships within the home. If the bonds in the home weaken or turn toxic, the totem grows cold and the house falls into disrepair until the relationships are mended. A house filled with love, trust, and mutual care will develop a totem that radiates warmth and actively eases the burdens of domestic life. Pipes do not leak, appliances rarely break, dust settles slowly, and small repairs happen overnight as if the house is maintaining itself. The home becomes a sanctuary where inhabitants sleep more deeply, argue less frequently, and find it easier to reconnect after conflict. The totem subtly encourages activities that strengthen bonds, like family meals or shared quiet time, while discouraging neglect and isolation. 

A strong totem also extends its influence to protect the home and its inhabitants. Intruders will find doors slightly harder to open, stairs more uneven underfoot, and loose objects more prone to sliding or falling at inopportune moments. A shelf might tip at the wrong time, a forgotten toy could roll under a foot, or a curtain might tangle just enough to slow someone down. These events never cause lethal harm but create enough inconvenience, noise, and unease to warn those inside and discourage anyone with ill intent from staying long.
