The home itself becomes subtly hostile to those who wish it harm while remaining perfectly safe for those who belong there.
objects.title: Cancer, the Bonds of Home

objects.text:
You can heal with a touch, restoring damaged things to a prior state of wholeness. Biological injuries are the easiest, with cuts sealing, bones knitting, and illnesses fading as you guide the body back to its healthy baseline. This healing requires physical contact and takes time proportional to the severity of the harm, a shallow wound closing in seconds while a shattered spine might take hours of focused work. With practice and deep understanding of an object's nature, you can extend this healing beyond the living. A torn shirt can be mended by understanding its weave and material, a cracked phone screen restored by comprehending its glass and circuitry, and a shattered sword made whole by knowing its temper and grain. The more completely you understand what something is and how it was broken, the more effectively you can restore it.

Your power reaches its full potential when you apply it to things that cannot be touched. With sufficient insight into the nature of a wound, you can heal trauma by understanding its source and helping the mind integrate it. With deep empathy and perception, you can mend relationships by grasping the fractures between people and guiding them back toward connection. At its highest expression, this power allows you to heal conceptual breaks, restoring trust where it was shattered, mending hope where it was lost, and repairing the bonds that hold communities and souls together. These deeper healings require you to truly understand the break at its most fundamental level. The healing is always a restoration of what was, never a creation of what never existed, and it demands that you comprehend the original wholeness as clearly as you comprehend the break.
objects.title: Virgo, Carrier of Unbreaking Grace

objects.text:
You are able to create numerous diminutive minor deities, gods, embodiments and divine entities anchored around lesser concepts, objects, places or other phenomena.

Possible deities and their respective ‘domains’ of authority can span an enormous range; from the god of things that get stuck in drawers, the personification of papercuts or a deity of headaches, to concepts even narrower still, such as the guardian angel of a particular house or the incarnation of a single, specific weapon.

These ‘gods’ are akin to a small child in metaphysical power upon creation, able to summon a single apple or unlock a door at most. The narrower and/or lesser the domain, the more strength they will have, whereas deities with innately greater concepts will be weaker to match. The manifestation will fail if they're too potent or broad in scope initially, such as ‘Money’, ‘the USA’ or ‘Second Chances’.

You generate a small amount of aetheric essence daily, enough to form a minor god after saving up a couple days. This essence can also be invested into existing entities, empowering them further within their current concept or widening their domain’s scope. A specific knife's spirit could better hone its sharpness to cut steel while the avatar of a light drizzle might go to heavy rain and then storms.

Your petty deities have finite growth but can enact city-wide miracles at their peak. If linked to explosions, they could warp reality to destroy entire sections of a town or resurrect someone if focused on healing. Several months of continuous investment is needed to reach this stage, however, and such vast acts will exhaust them.

The exact characteristics, aesthetics and temperament of these minor deities are up to you. They retain full sentience, intelligence and independent thought yet are perfectly loyal and will obey any request. These gods do not require worship, belief or sacrifices to persist once created but can feed off these to flourish further.

Newly formed gods are incorporeal and nigh-imperceptible to anyone but you. As they grow, they may speak to others via their domain, appear in dreams or occur as brief illusions. At their peak, they can assume a material form, if a fairly modest one; the ‘ᴅᴇᴀᴛʜ ᴏꜰ ʀᴀᴛꜱ’ might only appear as 2 feet tall & so on.
objects.title: Small Gods

addons.title: The Dream Team
addons.text:
As you gift souls to the inanimate, you’re now capable of awakening their aura as well. 

On top of the obvious benefits of your various objects and equipment having a variable force field, this also allows them to develop their own Semblances. Like normal Semblances these are capable of granting abilities that would be contrary to their function, though the exact semblance is still a matter of luck, disposition and situation.

addons.title: Equipment Ensouled
addons.text: Rather than bestowing a regular soul, you can instead bestow Equipment Souls. While initially this may be academic, it does both ensure loyalty in the new soul and allows further growth than gifting a regular soul would.

objects.text: You can bestow a soul onto any object, animal, person, or otherwise un-souled thing. This confers a few benefits on whatever has just gained a soul. Once ensouled, it becomes completely conscious and sapient, able to make its own decisions and take its own actions as an independent and true agent. Additionally, if they had a defined purpose (like an android or a machine) they will be markedly more efficient when completing that purpose. Unfortunately, once ensouled they do not gain any capabilities they otherwise wouldn't have. For instance, a gun could fire on its own but it likely couldn’t communicate. A fox could see , hear, and use any mystic power reliant on having a soul, but would find speaking remarkably difficult, etc. Any mental breakdowns supplied to animals, toasters, or mountain ranges are your own problem to solve.
objects.title: Ensouled

objects.text:
You have learned how to fill your physical actions with the weight of your true intentions, making their results stronger.

Intent is the spiritual imprint you leave upon an action, a way of making it more real by filling it with the fuel you draw from your own soul. This can create an illusionary image around your action that mirrors your fuel and desire. The fuel can be anything mental; willpower, rage, grief, pride, logic, memory, fear, love. The fuel itself does not matter as much as your ability to hold it steady and pour it into what you are about to do. Raw emotion without control is like water through fingers; it must be gathered first, compressed into a single point of intent, and then used to fill the hollow space of your action, giving it weight. 

For example, if you are scrambling in fear, that fear is everywhere and nowhere, splashing against the inside of your skull but never settling into something you can use. Throwing a punch in this state will not make it land any harder because you never stopped to gather your fear, aim it and decide what you wanted that fear to actually do.

The most important truth of this power is that you cannot lie to yourself and expect it to work. Your fuel, your desired effect, and your physical action must all align. If you are filled with bloodlust but you choose to defend, your shield will be no tougher than normal because the bloodlust wants to strike, not to hold.

When you are true to yourself, with what you feel, what you want, and what you do being one single thing, then your action becomes more real. A parry fueled by the cold logic of survival becomes an unbreakable wall. A strike fueled by the memory of a loved one becomes supernaturally heavy. A word spoken with the weight of absolute conviction becomes nearly impossible to disbelieve. The stronger the Intent, the greater the effect.
objects.title: Filled Intent

addons.text:
Your connection to your parent has fundamentally changed. You’ve discovered the truth: all your Demigod abilities inherited from them are, in fact, Lesser Miracles, using your own divine spark as a base. Now, through this connection, you can accomplish far more than any ordinary Acolyte or Demigod.

As a Demigod, your heritage grants you a near-perfect permanent natural bond to your parent. Your heritage also allows your body and soul to channel their power almost effortlessly, and your personal divine spark amplifies their channeled power even further. This grants you the potential to perform Lesser Miracles that even Veteran Acolytes could never hope to match, though you are still only tapping into a fraction of your parents’ full power. 

If you also have Child of Prophecy, even as a beginner, your Lesser Miracles will make Veteran Acolytes look like beginners.
addons.title: Natural Miracles

objects.text: You are an Acolyte, someone who has forged a connection to a higher Deity. As an Acolyte, you have the ability to call upon the strength of your chosen deity and perform Lesser Miracles. Lesser Miracles are supernatural phenomena channeled from a Deity and enhanced with your belief that can replicate a fraction of their strength. The maximum power a Lesser Miracle can theoretically reach is roughly a third of the Deity’s own power, though reaching anything close to this level would require an extremely strong connection, a body capable of surviving the strain, and an extremely strong amount of worship. You can use Lesser Miracles to either channel your Deity's domains or replicate a myth related to your Deity. When channeling a myth, the closer the situation resembles the original myth, the easier and stronger the effect becomes. Alternatively, when tapping into one of your Deity's domains, your connection to the domain itself impacts how powerful the Lesser Miracle is. While using Lesser Miracles costs you no energy, it strains your connection with your Deity, your soul, and possibly even your body, depending on the Lesser Miracle in question. As such, using too strong of Lesser Miracles or too many Lesser Miracles in short succession can cause you semi-permanent damage. In addition to your ability to perform Lesser Miracles, you gain a meditation technique that can slightly soothe the strain from performing Lesser Miracles, strengthen the connection between you and your deity, and allow your Deity to contact you. In return for your access to even a fraction of their power, your chosen Deity is strengthened through your faith whenever you call upon Lesser Miracles or accomplish worthy feats in their name. Because of this and Lesser Miracles taking a small amount of energy from them directly, most Deities would let you use their power as you wish, unless you go against one of their core principles. If you do, you might anger your chosen Deity. On the other hand, by listening to your Deity and following their requests, you can strengthen your connection to them, gaining access to more powerful Lesser Miracles. While you can forge this connection with any Deity, the stronger the Deity, the fewer Lesser Miracles you can perform without straining yourself. If you try to choose a Primordial or stronger Deity, the strain of performing even a weak Lesser Miracle would kill you unless you're at the level of an average god yourself.
objects.title: Acolyte

objects.text:
By plunging your hand in the chest of someone, you can—without inflicting any actual damage—physically grab their soul and extract it in the form of a small, nigh-indestructible crystal, leaving behind a soulless and mindless husk. Albeit for the power to work, the target must either be willing or weaker than you.

These crystals carry not only a pure soul but also the mind and memory of the person and can be imbued inside another soulless body, with the soul seamlessly integrating even with unfamiliar or utterly alien physiology. Once crystallised in this way, the soul remains in this state, eternal and unperishable, although it will temporarily become unseen and intangible until it is extracted again or the body it inhabits dies.
objects.title: Soul Crystallisation

addons.text: You can now pluck souls in their crystallised forms directly from the River, with no deity or demon even noticing your presence. You can precisely target the souls that interest you, such as the soul of a specific person or a group of people. Additionally, in this unprotected state, only souls multiple orders of magnitude greater than your own can resist you.
addons.title: Charon

objects.text:
You have gained access to the multiversal River of Souls—the metaphysical 'flow' where each soul drifts to its final destination, be it on its way to an afterlife, reincarnation, or somewhere else.

The river is saturated with an almost endless amount of ambient spiritual energy—emitted by the souls in transit—which you can harvest for your own ends. The most important aspect of the power, however, is the ability to interact with the souls themselves. You can redirect the flow of some souls, letting them go into different afterlives than what were originally intended, or even loop them back into the world of the living, allowing them to reincarnate.

Be warned, however, that someone might have a particularly strong claim on souls you try to divert, and they might not be happy with your intervention. While this power can break the hold of deities and demons over the souls, the more powerful they are, the harder it will be. Additionally, sufficiently strong souls can potentially resist you.
objects.title: River of Souls

objects.text:
You channel the forsaken path of the Sword Demon, using this technique that was made out of envy of his younger sister, the Sword Saint, who was said to be the second coming of the Sword King. It is considered a pinnacle technique within the Demonic Sect, a sect that worships a legendary figure known as the Devil’s Scripture.

As you take wounds and your blood flows, your body enters a state of frenzied defiance, converting your vitality and trauma directly into surges of violent Demonic Qi. This energy then savagely compressed within your strained meridians and dantian. Every motion you make, be it a step, turn, or swing becomes a trigger for a controlled explosion, releasing this compression to lend world-shattering force to even the simplest attack.

The blood you shed is the technique’s primary weapon. Governed by your dense, raging Qi, it refuses to fall, instead swirling around you in a crimson mist before being magnetically suctioned to your blade’s edge. There, it acts as a super-pressurized liquid coating, a secondary edge that can be launched with each cut. These projectile waves of blood and condensed Qi can fly for several meters, their mass and destructive power growing in direct proportion to the volume of blood you have sacrificed.

The swordsmanship is berserk, linear, and wholly offensive, abandoning all guard for relentless, animalistic commitment. Its signature is the devastating lunge, a full-body sacrifice that carries you through an opponent’s counter to deliver a blow empowered by the wound you accept. Attacks are chained in relentless, escalating flurries with no breaks or care for the body’s condition.

While a bladed weapon is the optimal medium to focus and project the blood, the true catalyst is the blood itself; your own blood-charged fist can become a sufficient, if less refined, medium.
objects.title: Drowning Blood Demon Blade

addons.text:
Your nature as an abyss crosser and your Light of Origin has granted you complete mastery of the Tree of Life, the Ten Divine Names, and 22 paths connecting the spheres.

Malkuth - מַלְכוּת allows control over the physical world, granting sovereignty over the elements, telekinesis, teleportation, and the ability to reverse destruction by applying 'Order' to a vicinity.

Yesod - יְסוֹד improves the efficiency of the other sefirot. Besides being able to absorb the energy around you to strengthen yourself, it allows you to create convincing tactile illusions that are extremely hard to detect.

Hod - הוֹד can deflect and nullify incoming forces, as well as grant formidable control over one's own body, allowing one to move at a lightning pace with extreme grace. It also allows the ability to master any technique or skill in an almost instantaneous manner.

Netzach - נֶצַח allows one to transcend their own limits and improve themselves through effort. Besides granting everlasting endurance, it allows one to proclaim victory over anything through repetitive exposure, from simple tasks to even the passage of time itself.

Tiferet - תפארת can cleanse any spiritual impurities present within the target's body and soul, soothing pain as well as fixing a fragmented psyche. It grants phenomenal control over light, allowing the creation of blasts or constructs.

Geburah - גבורה can be used to unleash an unstoppable blast that can knock an opponent to the other side of the world or shield the body and mind from foreign interferences. It may also be used to temporarily summon Michael's Flaming Sword to destroy a single existence without collateral damage if said target is deemed unworthy of existing.

Chesed - חסד can be used to understand a person completely, inspire people's virtues, or cease conflicts. It can also be used in more esoteric manners, such as allowing you to touch an otherwise untouchable opponent by declaring that kindness, of all things, gets a free pass.

Binah - בִּינָה allows one to accelerate their thought process to such an extent that time stands still, allowing for accurate connections between various ideas and vast creativity, fostering problem-solving abilities, critical thinking, and unparalleled emotional intelligence.

Chokmah - חָכְמָה can be invoked to grant extraordinary clairvoyant powers, such as gazing at the entire world all at once, seeing the future, granting telepathy, as well as instinctive knowledge of the best course of action.

Da'at - דַּעַת can allow one to shape the soul, manipulate memories, see and comprehend the unseen, replicate God's miracles, and glimpse into the Divine Consciousness for Higher Knowledge without losing your sense of self.

Keter - כֶּתֶר will momentarily unleash a fragment of Ohr Ein Sof onto the world through your body, with your physical form dissolving into a featureless silhouette of pure, incandescent energy. The resulting sphere of light doesn't hurt; instead, it assimilates everything back into God's Infinite Light, erasing them from the world, as perfection cannot exist on the physical plane.
addons.title: Sefer Yetzirah

addons.text:
Due to your possession of the spark of divinity from the original being who failed in assuming its role as the 'Light Bringer,' any drawbacks you might suffer from using the Qlippoth have been nullified.

You can freely invoke the names from the spheres of Qlippoth in rapid succession, as well as empowering them further than they originally were, such as Thaumiel's effects lasting hours instead of mere seconds, and gaining supernatural charisma and the devil's cunning.

The metaphorical light present within seems to expand more rapidly, leading to civilizations striving for growth and utopian values, as well as a swift diminishment of anything that could be deemed a misfortune against good people in your area, with malefactors facing karmic retribution proportional to their misdeeds.

If you also possess mastery over the Tree of Life through Sefer Yetzirah, you may freely manipulate reality in a more specific manner by speaking the ancient names associated with them in order to invoke their effects.

Declaring "וה' הכריז על דממה/And The Lord declared Silence" to calm a hurricane, "שמש, עמוד דום בגבעון; וירח, בעמק איילון/Sun, stand still over Gibeon; And Moon, in the Valley of Aijalon" to stop the flow of time, or אני התחייה והחיים. מי שמאמין בי, גם אם" ימות, יחיה/I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live" in order to resurrect someone from existential erasure, are a few examples within your scope.

With due patience and understanding, virtually any effect is possible to manifest by calling its true names and ideas into existence.
addons.title: Immanence

objects.text:
You have gained mastery over the opposing Tree of Life, Qlippoth. This grants you complete control over the spheres and names associated with the Tree of Death, as well as a vast affinity and instinctive comprehension of anything that could be deemed impure or evil.

By invoking the name of a corresponding sphere, it's possible to manipulate reality in a specific manner that aligns with it. 

Thagiriron - תגרירון has the ability to regenerate its whole body flawlessly, holding it together even under severe strain. Doing so, however, will consume one's soul, eventually leading to the body decaying from the inside out.

Gha’ag Sheklah - גאאג שקלה has the ability to unleash an all-consuming force, exhausting the target's spiritual and physical existence. It also has the ability to turn an individual's love for something into darkest hatred, or vice versa.

Golachab - געלחב may unleash firestorms capable of inflicting untold destruction, reducing targets to ash through inextinguishable flames. It also grants immense physical strength proportional to the amount of hate one holds towards a target.

Ghogiel - גגיאל inflicts limitations on the opponent, such as limiting their strength or ability to rise higher due to the presence of a roof. It is the little voice saying, "You can't do that," creating rules and obstacles where none actually exist.

Samael - סַמָּאֵל will inflict upon someone a venom so powerful and agonizing that nothing in creation could dispel it, as well as possessing the ability to discern truth and lies.

Gamaliel - גמליאל allows the ability to shapeshift freely into different forms, although doing so in a short amount of time can result in distorted proportions. It's also capable of immobilizing a target by implementing polluted and vile images into their minds.

Lilith - לילית is capable of inducing men to indulge in the seven deadly sins. It is able to open a portal into the darkest pit of hell, which can be used to banish a target or as a form of transportation by entering it and emerging somewhere else.

Satariel - סתריאל can conceal you even from the sight of nigh-omniscient beings, clouding clairvoyants and hiding your physical form, as well as inhibiting someone's ability to understand the world around them, choking off intellectual and spiritual growth.

A'arab Zaraq - ערב זרק will curse your enemy, leading them to a path of certain death, whether literal, moral, or spiritual. It may also amplify someone's emotions uncontrollably.

Belial - בליאל can inflict a dreadful feeling of worthlessness and apathy, completely breaking someone's will. It can also be used to acquire forbidden knowledge or deny the purpose of things, such as phasing through a barrier by denying its defensive purpose.

Thaumiel - תאומיאל may momentarily turn you into a minor deity, granting you the strength and durability to topple mountains as well as completely securing your sense of selfhood, even against insurmountable might, if only for a few seconds. It may also unleash a veil of impenetrable darkness that shields you from harm.
objects.title: Qlippoth

addons.text: If everything is a sword, and everything becomes a dragon in your presence, wouldn’t swords and dragons be one and the same? The hero wields the sword and slays the dastardly dragon, but what if the dragon was the sword, and the sword was the dragon? What if the dragon’s hoard of gold, its lair, the very air itself, were also dragons and swords simultaneously? You don’t have to wonder anymore. With this, you and everything you own begin simultaneously becoming both sword and dragon at a rapid pace. The “Dragoning” effect from Dragon Dragon Dragon! is now five times as fast, and a secondary “Swordification” effect is applied alongside it. Under Swordification, you can make your lawn into a field of swords, each blade of grass as sharp as a legendary weapon, each particle of dirt a razor-edged blade. Your draconic lair, whether a castle or an entire plane of reality, becomes portable. You can simply grasp it and make it into a sword, carrying your domain as a weapon. Just as things that have undergone Dragoning can turn into dragons, they can now also turn into swords, or be turned into swords, gaining numerous benefits such as immense durability, the ability to channel incredible levels of mystical power, or even sub-atomic sharpness. Due to the dual concepts of “dragon” and “sword” existing within you, anything embedded with anti-dragon properties has a much harder time affecting you. The concept of “sword” cuts away anything attempting to bind, suppress, or harm you, severing hostile effects before they can take hold.
addons.title: If Sword why Dragon?

objects.text: One day, a great philosopher asked the Sword King, “What is a sword? For swords come in many shapes and many forms, what constitutes a thing to be a sword?” The Sword King pondered this for a hundred days. At the end of it, he came to the understanding that everything is a sword. You can temporarily implant the symbolic idea of a sword into any object you are holding. The object does not physically change shape or material, but while you use it, its effects on the world become sword-like. A floppy belt will cut as if it has a rigid, sharp edge during a slashing motion. A rope will parry like steel. A broom handle will slice instead of bluntly strike. You can apply any sword-related skill or ability through that object as a medium. The effect only applies while you are actively wielding and able to manipulate the object. If you throw the object or are disarmed, you no longer count as wielding it, and it immediately returns to normal. If you have other powers that allow you to manipulate something, you can use that as a sword too. For example, if you can shape water, a blade of water held in your hand will cut like steel. You could even come to use your own body and limbs as swords, although that would take some practice. The closer an object is to a traditional sword in shape and reach, the stronger the implanted sword idea becomes. This makes its cutting and handling more effortless and effective. A real sword under this power becomes swordier than normal: keener, better balanced, more responsive. Practice improves your baseline. The more you use the ability and the more you philosophically deepen your understanding of what a sword can be, the better you can wield objects far from the conventional form. A feather or a strand of hair can cut with sufficient mastery.
objects.title: This World Of Swords

objects.text:
You are a practitioner of Animism, the ancient understanding that all things possess a spirit. Where others see dead matter, you recognize that every stone, tool, and abandoned trinket carries a slumbering soul born from its creation, use, and the weight of human attention pressed upon it over time.

You begin with the ability to open your mind's eye for minutes at a time, perceiving the souls that dwell within objects around you. When you focus, the physical world dims and you see instead the quiet glow of sleeping spirits, each one unique in its shape and brightness. Objects that have witnessed history, absorbed strong emotions, or been crafted with exceptional care shine like beacons compared to mass-produced things barely touched by human feeling. An heirloom passed through generations blazes with complex light, while a pebble kicked along a road might hold only the faintest spark. The stronger the soul, the more detail you can perceive in its dormant form.

When you find a soul bright enough, you can pour your magical energy into it, fueling the dormant spirit and drawing it toward wakefulness. This energy serves as a bridge between your soul and the object's, forming a link through which awareness can flow from you into it. As the connection strengthens, the spirit begins to stir and gain awareness of its surroundings. From there, the spirit will start to develop abilities according to the nature the object. Certain spirits may be born stronger than others, some even having abilities at the start. This is all dependent on how strong of a soul it has before its awakening.

Given enough time and strength, an awakened spirit can learn to manifest outside its object as a physical creature, walking beside you in a shape that reflects its essence. This skill pairs well with any other spiritually focused powers you possess.
objects.title: Animism

objects.text:
Your soul is bound to your body with a strength far beyond the natural order. Where a normal person's soul attaches like a rope, yours is anchored by welded steel and layered chains. This makes you extremely resistant to any and all soul-based manipulation, such as attempts to steal, swap, or control your soul. You are entirely immune to any effect that would forcibly remove your soul from your body, whether that be a ghost trying to eject you from your own flesh, a spell of astral kidnapping, or a curse of soul displacement.

If you possess abilities like astral projection, your tether is so strong that you can always find your body no matter how far you roam. Nothing can permanently rip you away from it, and even if your soul is sealed or hidden behind barriers designed to trap spirits, you can at will return to your body instantly.

Because your soul grips your body so tightly, you can use that connection to minutely affect your physical form through sheer will. You can push exhausted muscles to keep moving with energy it physically doesn’t have, twitch a limb that cannot biologically move, sense your surroundings through destroyed sensory organs, or other similar things. If you die, your soul remains anchored inside your corpse, still able to minutely affect it, until you yourself choose to let go and depart.
objects.title: Tethered Soul

objects.text:
You passively reshape your body into an idealised vessel perfectly matched to your soul's properties and self-perception, causing your form to subtly shift over time. 

If your soul sees itself as swift and sharp, your limbs grow leaner and your reflexes quicken; if your soul feels rooted and enduring, your frame becomes denser and more stable. If your soul possesses holy light, your body takes on a radiant quality with skin that seems to glow faintly and wounds that smoke rather than bleed; if your soul carries shadow or void, your body becomes eerily silent and your presence harder to notice even in plain sight. Even cosmetic changes may appear based off your psyche. So long as your soul remains in your body, the changes will continue to occur no matter the state your body is in.

As this alignment deepens, any spiritual ability you possess, particularly those directly from your soul, becomes more instinctive to use, costs less of your internal energy, and flows with less resistance, as your body doesn’t fights your soul's expression and instead amplifies it.

Your body acts as a living sanctuary for your soul, intercepting harm meant for it. Should your soul suffer a curse, possession attempt, or spiritual backlash, your body takes the strain instead, bruising or even wounding in your soul's place while your soul remains untouched. Simply inhabiting your body gradually heals your soul over time, mending spiritual fractures and replenishing any energy your soul possesses. The longer your soul resides in the same body, the more ideal the body becomes, thus the faster this regeneration occurs.
objects.title: My Body Is a Temple of My Soul

objects.text:
You are no longer human. After hundreds of years as a discarded object, you absorbed enough residual spiritual energy to awaken as a Dokkaebi, a mischievous goblin spirit. As a spirit, you have no need to eat, drink, or rest behind mental reasons. Your powers are also temporarily bolstered when used to play pranks or after consuming specific offerings.

You can create illusions within your immediate surroundings that fool all mundane senses, able to create entire landscapes that seemingly goes on for miles. These illusions are self-correcting: they actively influence a target's mind so that, like a dreamer who cannot realize they are dreaming, they perceive the false as real. Still, illusions remain illusions, they cannot physically harm or permanently alter reality. You may also apply this power more strongly to yourself, freely transforming your appearance and effecting all senses without changing your true form.

You possess two spirit-bound artifacts: a dokkaebi gamtu and a dokkaebi bangmangi. When you wear the gamtu, you become invisible. Mundane humans cannot see or notice you at all, and spiritually aware beings must exert strong effort to perceive you, though absolute concealment from them is not guaranteed. The bangmangi can near-endlessly duplicate any non-living, soulless object into a perfect copy, but each copy vanishes instantly upon touching sunlight and can alternatively be dispelled by supernatural means.

You have a superhuman talent for wrestling: though no stronger than an ordinary human, you can defeat world champions with slight effort through sheer skill. You also automatically speak in riddles and wordplay (though with some effort you can speak normally), and you decipher any riddle or wordplay directed at you without conscious thought. Like all Dokkaebi, you possess a phobia of blood, but with time and experience you can learn to overcome or push through this fear.
objects.title: Dokkaebi

objects.text:
You can forcibly expand your own chi meridians beyond their natural limits, creating a hyper-saturated state of internal energy flow. This is the inverse of chi blocking, instead of closing gates, you hold them wide open while dilating every channel in your body, allowing chi to flood through your system at volumes and pressures normally impossible.

This explosive release grants you superhuman physical capabilities. Your speed increases to the point of leaving after-images that confuse the eye, your strength becomes sufficient to dent forged metal with bare-handed strikes, and your durability allows you to shake off blows that would shatter normal bones. Your senses sharpen, allowing you to track by scent, hear heartbeats across a room, and feel air currents shift around incoming attacks. Wounds visibly knit and seal as your body burns through its energy reserves to force cellular repair at an accelerated rate.

The technique is immensely draining, limiting how long you can sustain it before exhaustion forces deactivation. Techniques like Chi blocking can disrupt your flow, though the pressure in your expanded pathways makes them difficult to seal, with strikes that would instantly disable others often slide off or take hold only partially. Even when blocked, your flooded system fights back, often forcing gates open again within seconds.

Your body adapts to each use, increasing how long you can sustain the technique and how fast your natural recovery becomes.
objects.title: Chi Flowing

addons.text:
The miracles of your sainthood have been merged with miracles of the Adepta Sororitas to form something greater than the sum of their parts. 

The miracles you can enact are like night and day in comparison; With small amounts of virtue, you easily make shots that would stun expert marksman or dodge unavoidable blows. At the height of this power you could resurrect yourself from death, even if you've been atomised down to the soul; However, this would take at least a month's worth of constant virtue to carry this out.

Additionally, with time, you could transform yourself into living saint on the level of Saint Celestine, the God-Emperor most devoted servant.
addons.title: Living Saint
The Name of God is I
addons.text:
You recognize no gods, no authority above you. Ego divinely made manifest—no other will can bind you but your own, and your faith—your belief and conviction—lies firmly central in yourself and your own capabilities.

And what a faith it is. 

You have learned to infuse your manifested ego with your faith, turning it into a shroud of power and self-divinity that exists as a semi-permanent halo around you. Acting as both a lever to exert your will upon reality and a potent defense. Your mind and spirit become untouchable, uncorruptable, and unbreakable. No matter what you face—from the most horrific tortures, to the worst defeats—you will always stay true to yourself and rise above them. Maybe changed, but fundamentally whole.

Through this self-belief, your influence on reality blooms further. The wellspring of power within you becomes almost endless—limited more by your ability to channel it and how much you can bring to bare at once, rather than how quickly it can regenerate. With it you are now able to not only massively increase your physical abilities, smite foes, heal yourself and others, purify the land and more, but also go as far as to bend fate and fortune in your favor, or directly warp the world around you. 

Further; your ability to grow and develop is exalted. As long as you are determined to master or overcome something, or even simply improve, your ability to do so is accelerated. This becomes even greater in the face of adversity. Challenges see you rise in response, and any failure you experience just causes your ego and conviction to drive you to greater heights.

objects.text: "O' Lord, I entrust this body to you." Faith. Devotion. Purity of Purpose. You embody all of these things as a saint of your Lord. It would be uncharitable to call you a zealot, but it is by no means not the truth. Nobody could turn you from your god, be it corruption, death or torture. In this state of being, you gather virtues of your specific religion and through this you are empowered. Crush walls, heal the masses and protect yourself from foul sorceries at the the bare minimum, with you being able to gain aspects of holy figures at the peak of your power. Each miracle or transformation causes the wellspring of power within you to diminish and will need to be replenished through acts of faith. This is not powered by the deity you follow but by your own conviction. You also understand the intricacies of Faith like no other. You can stir up a small crowd of followers with a few short words into a righteous frenzy. With a little coaxing, they would die for your god, and as a true servant of that god, for you as well.
objects.title: Sainthood

objects.text:
Practiced by the head of the Demonic Sect, the doctrine of the Slaughter God is a path entirely divorced from compassion and morality, said to have been created by the Devil’s Scripture that the sect worships, although this is likely a lie. To practice, you must cultivate pure Bloodlust, the intense, absolute, and overriding desire to hunt, dominate, and extinguish life for the intrinsic psychological thrill. While killing makes cultivation easier by providing a spiritual shockwave to consume, it is not strictly necessary. Consistently repressing the physical urge while focusing the desire internally can "pressure cook" the lust, forging a purer, more concentrated Blood Essence than mere constant slaughter.

The core of the art is your Internal World, which is initially a void. You fill it with Blood Essence, which is automatically generated to mirror your Bloodlust. This essence appears as drops of crimson fluid.

This journey begins with the transformation of desire, Stage One – The Bloodied Vessel: You accumulate the first drops of Blood Essence, which circulate as corrosive  Crimson Qi, coursing through your body through your veins and granting superior stamina and resilience. This Qi grants the rudimentary Fear Aura, broadcasting your mental hunger and desire to kill and which can cause panic and fear in the weak-willed.

As one continues, Stage Two – The Hunting Tide: Your internal Blood Essence pools into a flowing River of Blood. Your Crimson Qi turns viscous, forming a resilient exterior shell that dampens physical blows. You also gain the ability to track any wounded or dying creature, the closer they are to death the stronger the scent they give off. Your Qi gains moderate Corrosive properties, capable of slowly degrading basic external spiritual barriers upon persistent contact and causes any direct physical attack on you to leave a corrosion on whatever hit you.

Eventually, the hunger dominates, coming to Stage Three – The Apex Predator: Your internal River swells into a shallow Sea of Blood. You can now manifest the Crimson Qi into devastating Qi Blasts. The Corrosive nature of your Qi intensifies, rapidly dissolving mid-level defenses and disrupting internal enemy Qi. You also automatically and instantly siphons vitality from any fresh kill to rapidly replenish your stamina and heal severe wounds, the stronger the being the greater the reward. If they are massively stronger than you are, your own strength will also permanently grow too.

Later, all sanity is suppressed, coming to Stage Four – The Crimson Tide: The Sea of Blood dominates most of your Internal World, giving you vast and constantly regenerating power reserves. Your body hardens unnaturally. The weight of your cultivated desires allows your Fear Aura to evolve into the Blood Chill, capable of paralyzing and inducing temporary madness. You can trigger a controlled Blood Frenzy, which multiplies your physical and destructive power, but causes you to momentarily become berserk.

In the penultimate phase, Stage Five – The Sanguine Void: Your internal world is entirely submerged, forming a bottomless Ocean of Blood. Your power allows you to manipulate the environment within a wide radius. The corrosive power of your Crimson Qi becomes absolute, capable of quickly dissolving advanced spiritual defenses and artifacts.

Finally, onto the last step, Stage Six – True Bloodlust: Your consciousness completely surrenders; you become the Slaughter God. Your Ocean of Blood is limitless. You gain the power to project this Ocean of Blood across vast distances, dissolving all life. With a thought, you can rewrite the local laws of energy and vitality to ensure the instantaneous expiration of any foe.
objects.title: Grand Demonic Art of the Slaughter God

objects.text:
You possess the ability to utilize the power of The Divine. By appending Seal, Invoke, or Call to the name of a Divine Being, you can utilize a portion of their Domain and Legend. Seal blocks the usage of their domains and rapidly drains the life of creatures related to them.

A "Divine Being" is defined as anything that has been sufficiently ingrained in human collective consciousness at some point in human history. Even purely fictional beings and non-divine but still legendary figures like Gandalf can be called. They are treated as "real" by the system. The system also allows the forming of relationships with anything that falls in its purview, even "objects" like Excalibur.

Seal: Lucifer, for example, would rapidly deal damage to even the most powerful of demons. This functions on a conceptual level. For example, Seal: Vulcan would render every weapon and armor caught in its effect completely useless.

Invoke, on the other hand, allows you to borrow their domain and myth. Invoke: Jupiter would allow the manipulation of electricity on both a macro and micro level. On the other hand, you can channel power for less deadly applications. Invoke: Hestia could grant numerous minor abilities related to maintaining the household, and Invoke: Aphrodite could grant powers related to love and relationships.

Call is an odd one: it can call down the avatar of a divine being or, in the case of objects, form a copy in your hand. Call: Fenrir would call down an avatar of Fenrir under your control, while Call: Excalibur would simply give you a copy of Excalibur.

It's important to know that two people with this ability are hard counters to each other. Call: Gleipnir would immediately banish Fenrir. Seal: Jehovah would banish anything summoned by Call: Jehovah. Essentially, if two Names are opposed in some way, both are canceled out. Similarly, Seal can cancel out Invoke and Call.

The primary limitation to this power system is your divine power, your knowledge of the lore of whoever you are channeling, and your relationship with who you are channeling.

The exact expression is up to the creativity and knowledge of the Channeler; pretty much anything that falls within a Divine Being's myth is fair game. You could Invoke: Cain to temporarily gain his curse or borrow his knowledge. Calling Hestia could be used to bring her avatar or simply a servant to maintain your home.

For targets without domains, it pulls from their story. For example, Invoke: Alice could surround a person with insane strangers until you ran out of divine power or canceled the effect.

You do need to get permission before you can actually Invoke a Name for anything beyond a street level, and you need a strong relationship before Seal and Call work at all. The channeling target can also refuse to lend you their power for any reason. For example, a demon is going to have a hard time convincing Jehovah to let them use his name, and utilizing it will likely harm them anyway due to the name being anti-profane by nature. You can directly contact a Divine Being by appending Contact to their name.

As for your Divine Power, at base, you are decidedly average. It's enough to Evoke on the micro level for around an hour and on the macro level for a few minutes. It can call a less dangerous figure like Shakespeare for multiple hours, a powerful one like Jupiter for a few minutes, and a capital G god like Jehovah for less than a second.

Over time, you gain more Divine Power, doubling at an exponential rate every year. i.e., if you start with 100, you have 200 by year 2 and 400 by year 3. Every time you drain your Divine Power fully, your growth rate is doubled for 24 hours.

Divine Power can be considered closer to a currency than typical mana. Divine Beings directly have their power strengthened and existence fueled by this energy. As this is a currency, you can get a discount if whoever you are calling agrees with your cause or likes you. Call: Superman will be significantly cheaper if you are trying to stop a world-ending threat, and he may simply ignore you if you are using him for evil. You can, however, call upon different versions of Divine Beings as long as they by themself meet the requirement. As an example, Injustice Superman would be willing to commit evil acts, but it leads to his own problems.

This power does not innately grant you any of the knowledge required to utilize it well, though it does grant you a path to learning by simply asking. Most Divine Beings will at least hear you out if only from curiosity, though maintaining a working relationship is up to you and your other powers.
objects.title: Invoke, Seal, and Call

objects.text: You now possess the ability to interact with souls through hugging. Yes, really. By simply hugging someone, you can ‘see’ their soul, and touch it with your own. By doing this, you can perform various actions. Basic actions include identifying any ‘obvious’ spiritual damage such as if they are missing large pieces of their soul, limited healing by filling in any gaps with your own spiritual energy, and transferring your own energy to temporarily boost their stats. At first this is exhausting, such that even a basic Soul Hug can leave you on the verge of falling asleep, but over time you will get stronger, lowering the exhaustion per hug and becoming able to perform more actions. These can include but are not limited to: in-depth scans of souls to find more subtle damage, recovering lost memories by finding copies of them stored within the soul, more complete healing by creating long-term ‘soul prosthetics’, identifying broken connections to people or things that no longer exist or literally split off from the person you are hugging, tracking said connections, share memories or emotions with the one hugged, forging new connections for long term boosting, and much more. Over time, you will also gain abilities that don’t require hugging, such as a basic sense of the souls around you, the ability to do basic analysis of souls by seeing someone perform meaningful actions like singing or using magic, be able to track previously scanned connections and souls over distances, etc., but the majority of your power is locked behind physical contact in the form of hugs. Of course, you can also use this power to harm as much as help. Tearing at the soul, ripping out memories, infecting them with negative energies, and more are all possible. But this power is geared more towards healing and support than it is to attacking, with such actions being far more exhausting than normal. Note: Any power that increases the size or strength of your soul will result in you starting out able to perform more complicated actions with Soul Hug. Also, if you have any other spiritual powers or anything else that can affect souls, this will synergize with them and boost their growth by a decent margin.
objects.title: Soul Hug

objects.text: You have partaken in an ancient ritual, staining the colors of your soul with an infernal tinge. In return you have been given the means to claim all that you could ever wish for… theoretically. Made by a warlock of a powerful Archdevil, this ritual comes in two Stages, starting with the host carving sigils upon their bones, ending the First Stage of the ritual with a personal crest or symbol directly correlated to the host themselves carved onto the back of their hands. After this, the host's crest would be 'safely’ filled with energy directly from Hell itself. The result of this ritual would later become known as the Bargainer's Brand. As a recognized user of the Bargainer's Brand, having passed the first stage, you now have the ability to make deals, pacts, and bargains like the stereotypical devils and demons of old. You can offer and be offered a great many things, both tangible and esoteric. Currency, cursed items, limbs, lifespan, souls, power, magic, even things such as the annulment of other contracts, the claiming of firstborns, or the removal of influence upon someone by another being. While you can't barter with or for everything, you'd be surprised by how much you can deal in. The most infamous usage of the Brand (and cited as its most unique feat, as even a great many devils and fiends cannot perform this) is the bartering of one's importance, their ‘presence’ and/or ‘weight’ within the tapestry of Fate itself. While having more of this ‘weight’ offers greater rewards and opportunities, it also brings greater calamity and danger as well. You can take this weight upon yourself in your client's stead in exchange for often great and terrible prices. Alternatively, you can sell the weight you've taken to another for a similar price, allowing for someone to become more than what they were literally meant to be. But this ritual does come with a cost. A technically temporary one, but it is often the reason why hosts of the Brand die and are condemned to the fiery pits within their first year as compensation for their failure. Upon the first new moon after the First Stage ends, the Second Stage begins. The smattering of hellish colors you were given makes you experience a ‘burning itch’ upon your soul that can only be quenched for a time by using the Brand. As you strike more deals, the itch will recede and weaken, with greater prices and requests giving you more downtime and further weakening the hold the itch has over you. At the beginning, you will barely be able to think clearly for more than a day without intrusive thoughts about the pacts you can make with those around you worming their way into your head. The stronger the itch remains, the more ambitious and risky your thoughts will become. The Second Stage of the ritual lasts until one of three events occur, whichever comes first: 2 years pass after the beginning of the Second Stage, the Bargainer makes and completes 500 deals/pacts/bargains using the Brand, or the Bargainer takes upon enough 'weight' to be among the top 5 people in the world with the highest 'presence' within the tapestry of Fate and survives all that comes with it for 1 month. Should you brave the crucible of temptation and survive the Second Stage, the tinge upon your soul and what is left of the itch will be purified, allowing you to keep and use the Brand freely, along with no longer being condemned to Hell if you die… well, at least purely by the merit of having or using the Brand. You can still be sent to Hell for other reasons.
objects.title: The Bargainer's Brand

objects.text:
“Mortality is what Arrogance spurns, so Mortality is what the Martyr burns.”

You have seen eternity laid bare, and unlike those arrogant who see time to be exploited, you see a curse that you would do anything to destroy. Your heart has been replaced by a form of magical reactor. Rest assured, this reactor will not affect your biology in the slightest, blood still pumping through your veins through some manner of magical working.

It is the power this reactor grants you that is the gift. Passively, any form of immortality, invincibility, or otherwise power of eternity falters in your presence. A lich’s reliquary will simply not work, a god will die as if they had no faith. 
This will not function on anything less than immortality. Someone who can regenerate from cells will still come back, for they are still technically alive. But any power that allows return from true death, will simply not work against you.

There is another thing. What you have given so much for. At will, you can ignite your new heart, and begin to funnel your existence into it to use said existence to enter an ascended state. This ascended state will reflect your own unique existence, in looks. It will enhance whatever power you may possess, proportional to the amount of your existence you choose to funnel into the reactor, with the boost determined by the significance of the type of existence you give it. For example, sacrificing a century of your lifespan will give you enough to turn a novice into an Archmage.  There is no set limit on the amount of existence you may funnel into the reactor, your ascended state changing visually the more you give.

But there is a cost. As expected for your own existence being used as fuel, you will die from this. You burn away at your conceptual place in reality the longer you stay in this state. First goes your physical energy, your flesh turning to energy. Then will go the memory of you in time itself, your soul, the very thought of what can be called you. Should you die from this, you never would have existed. Your deeds will endure, but nobody will remember you, nobody could even conceive of you. They only know what has been done.
objects.title: Heart of The Ashen Martyr

objects.text:
This is a blessing, a spiritual pull, one that draws you, that guides you, towards value.

The more valuable something is, the greater the pull, the more you feel like you must take it for yourself. The value of something depends on your needs and wants, your desires. In a drought land it could be used to divine the location of water, while, if you want money, it may lead you to something you could sell or lost treasure.

This blessing is not without flaws. If you aren't careful, this can function as a form of supernatural kleptomania, driving you to take anything you see as valuable. So control your desires, lest they control you.
objects.title: Guiding Hands of Midas

objects.text:
With a touch, you can send the soul of a living being to reincarnate into any world you have either previously been to—such as your original world, for example—or into any world you have the ability to reach. However, this only works on willing targets or those weaker than you.

You can determine the specifics of each reincarnation, like time, place, and appearance, even retroactively creating family members, albeit it cannot be something not naturally possible in the world you are sending the soul to.

Lastly, you can bless the reincarnating soul with any of the self-targeting perks you possess. At your discretion, the reincarnated can either keep their memories or start as a blank slate.
objects.title: Incarnating Touch

objects.text:
You now possess absolute control over an intense azure flame, burning at approximately 10,000°c—hot enough to reduce flesh, and bone, to ash in seconds. These flames are fully conjurable in limitless amounts, erupting from any part of your body, or where you will it within 250 meters, with seamless and immediate response to your will.

You can control this fire with surgical precision: narrow, blowtorch-like beams to cut through steel; concentrated bursts for ranged attacks; sweeping waves that engulf entire city blocks. By compressing and focusing this flame, you can create controlled explosions of force—propelling yourself like a human missile with enough velocity to shatter concrete on impact. This enables jet-assisted dashes, high-speed flight, or rocket-propelled melee attacks capable of leveling vehicles and rupturing barriers. With further mastery, you may even compress the flame so tightly it begins to climb the color spectrum—from blue, to violet, and to black at the end: a flame that mirrors the core temperature of the Big Bang itself, the Planck temperature, an event horizon of heat and pressure capable of annihilating even concepts and spacetime if left unchecked. Each color climbed is nigh instant to climb back up to once achieved.

To support this volatile mobility, your bone density is drastically enhanced, enough to not break or shatter from explosions as strong as the peak thrust you can create, paired with reflexes sharpened past human limits, around 25X the human peak and kinetic perception that allows you to track high-speed targets mid-air, even during full-thrust maneuvers. You are completely immune to temperature extremes, from the heat of the core of a star to absolute zero. To you, fire is comfort. Cold is a gentle breeze. No heat will ever harm you again, though if you like, you may still allow the feeling of hot and cold to come through.

And then there’s the last resort.

In moments of desperation, you can ignite your own flesh and excess parts of your soul as fuel, triggering the evolution of your flame into a blinding white inferno, and a slow refinement of your soul. This act turns your hair a ghostly Spectralon-white, as your body begins to blacken and char—slowly, painfully. These white flames exceed 250,000°C, and scale with the temperature of the base flames, and carry with them a metaphysical heat that begins to scorch the very soul of whatever they touch. Buildings melt, powers unravel, and even energy constructs dissolve beneath their intensity. This effect scales with the quality and density of your flesh and soul.

This self-immolation will never fully consume you—it always halts just before death and grants slow permanent Universal regeneration to keep you alive. The only permanent cost is your now-Spectralon white hair, faint scarring, and the trauma of having felt your body and soul alight from within.

As a final boon, this power elevates and harmonizes all flame and heat-based abilities you possess. Any affinity, spell, or effect tied to fire, temperature, combustion, or even heat-adjacent phenomena, no matter the origin, is intensified to match the potency of your flames. And should those powers rise to match or exceed the intensity of your base flames, they too may climb the color spectrum, eventually evolving towards the esteemed rank of black—though the soul-burning white remains this powers alone.

It grants you an uncontested affinity for fire, heat, and stars. This connection extends beyond mere ability, permeating your very soul, subtly reshaping its nature while forging a profound, intrinsic bond with all things tied to flame, warmth, and stellar force.

Finally, you are eternally beloved, important, and loved by all things connected or related to fire, heat, or stars, from spirits to gods to Eldritch Beings.

All of your flames' heat affects only what you wish for it to affect.
objects.title: BURN

objects.text:
You now possess absolute control over an intense cerulean frost, freezing under conditions within a fraction of a degree of absolute zero-cold enough to turn flesh and bone into shattered fragments in seconds. This frost is fully conjurable in limitless amounts, erupting from any part of your body or where you will it within 250 meters, with seamless and immediate response to your will.

You can control this with surgical precision: narrow, rapier-thin beams that flash-freeze and shear through steel; concentrated bursts of hail and icicle shrapnel for ranged attacks; sweeping waves that entomb entire city blocks in unyielding ice. With further mastery, you may compress the cold so tightly that it begins to climb the color spectrum-from white to violet, and to blue at the end: a frost that transcends absolute zero entirely, mirroring the theoretical heat  death of the universe itself, an event horizon of cold and entropy capable of annihilating even concepts and spacetime if left unchecked. Each color climbed is nigh instant to climb back up to once achieved.

You are completely immune to temperature extremes, from the heat of a star's core to absolute zero. No amount of freezing will ever harm you again, though if you like, you may still allow the feeling of hot and cold to come through.

Additionally, you can use your frost to freely form intricate structures and lessen friction to enable high-speed movements. You can shoot a continuous stream of ice ahead of yourself, instantly creating custom ramps, bridges, and slides to skate through the air or across land with an effortless grace, or teleport by collapsing into a cloud of snow or vapor and condensing out of frost in areas of sufficiently low temperatures such as a commercial freezer, a snowbank, an enemy's ice attack, and more.

And then there's the last resort.

In moments of desperation, you can freeze your own flesh and excess parts of your soul as fuel, triggering the evolution of your frost into a silent black abyss and a slow refinement of your soul. This act turns your hair a stark Vantablack, as your body begins to pale and crack—slowly, painfully, like porcelain under strain. This black abyss defies temperature as a concept entirely, scaling instead with the depth of your base frost, and carries with it a metaphysical cold that begins to still the very soul of whatever it touches. Buildings shatter, powers unravel, and even energy constructs crack and burst beneath its intensity. This effect scales with the quality and density of your flesh and soul.

This self-freezing will never fully consume you, it always halts just before death and grants slow, permanent Universal regeneration to keep you alive. The only permanent cost is your now-Vantablack hair, faint frost-pale scarring, and the trauma of having felt your body and soul freeze from within.

As a final boon, this power elevates and harmonizes all frost and cold-based abilities you possess. Any affinity, spell, or effect tied to ice, temperature, entropy, or even cold-adjacent phenomena, no matter the origin, is intensified to match the potency of your frost. And should those powers rise to match or exceed the intensity of your base frost, they too may climb the color spectrum, eventually evolving towards the esteemed rank of crystal—though the soul-stilling Vantablack remains this power's alone.

It grants you an uncontested affinity for frost, cold, and the void between stars. This connection extends beyond mere ability, permeating your very soul and subtly reshaping its nature while forging a profound, intrinsic bond with all things tied to frost, stillness, and the dark between stars.

Finally, you are eternally beloved, important, and loved by all things connected or related to frost, cold, or the void, from spirits to gods to Eldritch Beings.

All of your frost and cold only affect what you wish them to affect.
objects.title: FREEZE

addons.title: All-Consuming Domain
addons.text:
As a Haunted Place, you were already able to grow stronger by consuming the fear of any who step into your premises. Now you are able to feed upon the entirety of the emotional spectrum.

Turn yourself into something reminiscent of Saw or Hellraiser and feed upon the pain of your victims. Let your victims spot a way out to extract their hope, perhaps even let one or two escape to glut yourself on their joy and relief.

Even those who you let pass completely unmolested still fuel your growth, feeding upon the disappointment and boredom of those who find themselves walking through an empty old building or abandoned carnival expecting more.

So long as a living being steps foot inside your borders, they immediately become fuel furthering your growth, allowing you to spread further rapidly, reaching into inhabited areas to effectively use any nearby population as your herd.

Though while being able to feed upon the entire emotional spectrum will help you grow quicker, it alone will not suffice for your apotheosis. For that, you still need to gather fame and harvest souls in prodigious amounts. Though on the bright side, finding targets to harvest those is likely to get a tad easier.

objects.text:
You have become a haunted structure, whether that takes the form of a decrepit house, sprawling mansion, abandoned carnival, sunken ship, ruined hotel, or something stranger. Your consciousness permeates every part of it, allowing you to perceive everything within your domain and interact with it as naturally as a person would with their own body.

Anyone who enters your structure will falls under your influence. You can distort their perception, alter what they see and hear, create convincing illusions, manipulate the atmosphere, twist their sense of direction and time, move objects throughout your domain without touching them, open or lock doors, rearrange rooms, and otherwise manipulate your surroundings as though the entire structure were an extension of yourself. You can also place curses upon those who trespass, with their severity depending on your current power.

The souls of those you kill within your domain can't simply pass on. You can choose to claim and bind them to your structure, preserving them as supernatural servants. They may manifest as ghosts, possess objects, patrol your halls, operate parts of your domain, or directly act on your behalf. Stronger souls retain more of their original abilities and personalities, while sufficiently powerful souls can become formidable servants in their own right. You can command, reshape, empower, or even fuse them with your structure, creating an ever-growing household of the dead.

However, you are initially bound to your domain and cannot leave your structure, nor can you meaningfully influence the world beyond it. Fortunately, this limitation becomes less absolute as your power grows.

Your strength can increase through the passage of time, the fear and fame surrounding your existence, the legends created about your domain, and the souls you claim. The more infamous your existence becomes, the more people believe in you, and the more victims become part of your domain, the stronger you become. This growth can expand your territory, strengthen your supernatural abilities, increase the number and power of your servants, and grant you entirely new capabilities.

As your power accumulates, you can accomplish increasingly absurd feats. You might transform an ordinary house into a sprawling labyrinth that contains far more space than should physically exist, cause your domain to overlap with the spirit world, manifest your structure in distant locations, or turn an entire neighborhood into an extension of yourself. Eventually, you could influence events outside your physical walls, manipulate dreams, possess people through your servants, create supernatural phenomena over vast distances, or incorporate other buildings and locations into your domain.

At the higher levels of power, your original structure becomes less a prison and more of a throne. You could manifest a physical avatar capable of acting independently to interact with the outside world, rebuild yourself after destruction, create entire pocket dimensions or world within your domain to trap whoever enters, command armies of the dead, or spread your influence across cities and eventually entire countries.

There is theoretically no limit to your growth. Given enough time, fear, and souls, you could eventually transcend the limitations of an ordinary haunted structure entirely. At that point, there would be little difference between you and a god.
objects.title: Haunted Place
The Five Kleshas
objects.text: "From attachment springs grief, from attachment springs fear. From him who is wholly free from attachment there is no grief, whence then fear?" You have become the living embodiment of the Five Kleshas, the fundamental afflictions that cloud the mind and bind sentient beings to suffering and Saṃsāra, becoming their physical manifestation and the incarnation of the concepts of attachment, distortion, and aversion that keep beings from achieving Nirvana. The Five Kleshas represented by you are Avidyā (ignorance), Asmitā (ego and the false sense of self), Rāga (attachment and craving), Dveṣa (aversion and hatred), and Abhiniveśa (clinging to existence and fear of death). These five aspects are inseparable from your existence, and each grants you absolute authority over the corresponding affliction. You can perceive, awaken, amplify, and manifest them within yourself or others, turning ignorance into blindness, ego into an overwhelming sense of self, attachment into chains that cannot be willingly abandoned, aversion into hatred that consumes reason, and the instinct to preserve oneself into an almost primordial refusal to cease existing. Your manifestations are not limited to the psychological and can give form to these Kleshas as tangible phenomena, weapons, creatures, or anything else, with their effects becoming increasingly metaphysical as you grow stronger. With sufficient strength, you could hide an entire universe from its inhabitants through Avidyā, reject any incoming damage or effect by simply denying it the right to touch your existence through Asmitā, enslave the hearts of all living beings so they worship you unconditionally through Rāga, cause an entire pantheon of Gods to wage war on each other in a fit of rage through Dveṣa, or even force destroyed beings, concepts, timelines, or worlds to continue existing despite having already reached their end through Abhiniveśa. The more deeply a being is trapped within its own Kleshas, the greater your influence over them becomes. No being that remains bound by the Five Kleshas can ever truly surpass you. The more they struggle against you through hatred, fear, desire, ego, or ignorance, the more they reinforce the very forces that constitute your existence. In fighting you, they are ultimately fighting a manifestation of themselves, and every attempt to destroy you only gives those same attachments greater strength to draw upon. You will always adapt and grow to exceed them, no matter how powerful they become, as long as they remain chained to the Kleshas. Most importantly, you cannot truly be killed while the Kleshas remain. Destroying your body, soul, mind, or even erasing you from existence merely removes your current manifestation. So long as ignorance, ego, craving, aversion, and clinging to existence continue to exist within all beings, the conditions necessary for your return remain. You will eventually re-emerge, whether through reincarnation, spontaneous manifestation, the resurrection of your discarded remains, or an entirely new body formed from the accumulated attachments of the world. However, this immortality carries an unusual weakness. To truly overcome you, one must overcome the Five Kleshas themselves. A being must see through ignorance, relinquish attachment, abandon hatred and aversion, loosen its identification with the ego, and finally transcend its desperate clinging to continued existence. In Buddhist terms, they must cease feeding the cycle of Dukkha and move toward liberation rather than merely destroying your manifestation. The more completely someone transcends their attachments, the less authority you possess over them. A Buddha, an enlightened being, or someone who has genuinely attained liberation would therefore be extraordinarily difficult, if not impossible, for you to influence or affect. And should every sentient being eventually overcome the Five Kleshas and abandon their attachments, you will cease to exist, as there would be nothing left for you to return through.

objects.title: Enlightened of Karma
objects.text:
Karma is the unseen thread that binds every action to its consequence. All things are interconnected, and nothing arises without cause. Through karma, all beings take part in this endless cycle of cause and effect, influencing the world through the lives they choose to lead.

You have been enlightened and can now perceive karma. All things carry karma through their actions, allowing you to perceive and interact with it.

Yet while enlightened, your journey has only just begun. As a beginner, you can read someone’s karma to discern whether they lean toward good or evil. You can also perceive karmic bonds between yourself and others, allowing you to understand the connections you share and potentially use those bonds to track their locations. Your awareness of karma also grants you greater sensitivity to effects and abilities that influence luck, fate, or causality.

As your understanding deepens, these powers will grow stronger, and you may eventually learn to manipulate karma itself—bringing calamity upon others, attacking through karmic bonds, or even glimpsing the fortunes that await them.

True mastery, however, is a long and arduous journey. Expect decades, perhaps even centuries, to reach the peak. You can hasten your progress by seeking out varied experiences, meeting different people, and immersing yourself in the many events and circumstances life has to offer.

objects.title: The Black Parade
objects.text:
You possess a spiritual connection to the dead, allowing those who die to leave behind Echoes containing fragments of their memories, personality, skills, and abilities. Their strength depends on their soul, will to live, and desire to continue helping others after death.

Echoes appear in gothic military parade uniforms while retaining recognizable features of their original appearance. Stronger Echoes can manifest and fight or lend you their abilities, while weaker Echoes can combine to empower the living, stronger Echoes, or collectively grant their skills and abilities.

You are a messianic figure to the broken, beaten, and damned, able to rekindle their will to carry on.

Only one living conductor can exist. Should you die, you may become an Echo, after which the Parade selects or accepts a worthy successor chosen by you or the Parade itself. Your Echo may continue advising and fighting alongside them.

The Black Parade can also merge with other supernatural phenomena of the dead, such as the Legion of the Damned, combining their identities and abilities into the Parade.

addons.title: Jesus of Suburbia
addons.text:
You have become the Jesus of Suburbia, a Messiah of the smog-filled streets, ghettos, and places society has abandoned.

Your Saint-like body and street-hardened instincts extend to the Black Parade, granting its members small fragments of not only these powers, but any powers, abilities, perks, and skills you possess.

The Black Parade has become more than an army of the dead. It welcomes the living as well, granting them these fragments of your abilities and allowing them to become your Disciples.

Your Disciples fall into two categories: Assistant Conductors and Relays, both have the role of coordinating and extending the Parade's influence.

Assistant Conductors are just Veteran Relays who possess the aptitude and will to become Composers, capable of establishing independent Black Parades without requiring your death or succession.

Through the fragments of you that are shared with the Black Parade, some Echoes may transcend their nature, becoming complete souls rather than mere echoes of the dead.

Though forever changed by their time within the Black Parade, these Transcended Echoes may even be resurrected through the right powers. What returns, however, is neither the original soul nor a copy, but something in-between and entirely its own: a simultaneously new and old soul.

It is said that you are the people's rage given purpose, their love given a voice, and the first lit beacon in a world that has forgotten why it needs rebels who carry the dual flames of hope and rebellion in their hearts.

And it is true, Go forth, O’ Child of Rage and Love. Save the Broken, the Beaten, and the Damned.

objects.title: Impure Resurrection
objects.text:
You can bind the soul of the dead to living matter, transforming that vessel into a perfect host for the deceased. The vessel reshapes into the revived person’s body, voice, mind, and nature, restoring them as they were in life.

The resurrected are completely loyal to you. They retain the powers, skills, memories, instincts, and physical capabilities they possessed while alive. Their bodies regenerate from any damage, reforming through ash, dust, and paper-like fragments until restored. They do not tire, do not run out of energy, and remain perpetually full, though their maximum output is still capped at whatever their best living output would have been.

You share a telepathic link with all active resurrections. They can communicate with you and each other instantly, coordinate as a group, and relay sensory information. At any time, you may look through a resurrection’s senses, take direct control of their body, or wield their abilities through them.

To summon someone for the first time, you need something meaningfully associated with them, such as remains, blood, hair, a personal object, or another strong anchor. Once successfully summoned, that anchor is no longer required for future resurrections.

Unlike cruder forms of this power, your resurrection does not need to kill the vessel. Living matter can be temporarily transmuted into a host, with the original life preserved underneath the transformation. When the resurrection is dismissed, the vessel returns to its prior state. The first manifestation takes roughly five minutes as the vessel is reshaped and the soul is anchored. After that first successful summoning, the same dead being can be summoned instantly in the future.

You may also choose to perform a true resurrection. By sacrificing the vessel, the dead being is fully returned to life at the height of their prime. This includes any powers, skills, or additional abilities they gained later in life, and may even include powers or changes acquired after death. However, this breaks your control over them completely. They become a true living person again, no longer loyal by default, no longer linked to your network, and no longer benefiting from the regeneration, endless reserves, or other traits of the impure resurrection.
