You can maintain a dozen impure resurrections at once. This number grows with time and practice, and the strength of the revived has no effect on your limit. A resurrected Parahuman and a resurrected civilian occupy the same amount of capacity.

addons.text: "Always remember these words: Work hard, study well, and eat and sleep plenty! That is the Turtle Hermit way!" You have inherited the skill, ability, knowledge, and might of the Grand Master of the Turtle Hermit School of Martial Arts, Muten Roshi. This includes the Thunder Shock Surprise Attack, Hypnosis, Drunken fist fighting mastery (without needing to get drunk), the Mafuba sealing technique, and the world-renowned Technique, the Kamehameha. Your fighting instincts are so great that they can be almost confused for Ultra Instinct in terms of movement and evasive ability. You have knowledge of more than just the Turtle Hermit School of Martial Arts, such as the techniques of the Crane School and other martial art techniques Roshi has seen used, but are required to train in them and will gain mastery in days with no interruptions.
addons.title: God of Martial Arts

addons.text: You have been given the ability and skill with the Kaio-Ken. Originally made by King Kai, this technique grants one the ability to multiply their overall power of their basic capabilities, granting one the ability to increase their strength by two times. Your skill with it, however, is enough for you to multiply up to ten times, but beware, as the Kaio-Ken puts an immense strain on the body if you are unable to handle the multiplier. You do, however, possess the skill to use it without much strain when going times five. One of the greatest benefits of this technique, besides allowing you to increase your power to fight against those above your original full might, is that the greater your handling of higher multipliers, the greater your Ki Control. Should you purchase the Spirit Control Upgrade, your multiplier for the technique will be times fifteen.
addons.title: Kaio-ken

addons.text: You've learnt the Time Skip technique—allowing you to jump forward in time for a tenth of a second and move freely during that instance, creating the illusion of instantaneous and imperceptible action from others' perspective. You have all variations of it that were showcased by Hit himself, as well as his combat prowess, super speed, and one thousand years of assassination experience. This is only one expression of the technique, as by honing your own Time Manipulation ability, you can expand the scope of it further. Such as increasing the interval from 0.1 seconds to 1 second, reversing time to repeat or delay it, pausing time to trap your opponent in a loop of the attack, etc. Note: If you possess the Pure Progress Addon under Imagination Power (Baki the Grappler), you can increase your growth rate in improving this technique.
addons.title: Time Skip

addons.text: You've learned another of King Kai's techniques, the Spirit Bomb. Where you gather energy from the surrounding environment, inhabitants, inanimate objects, to even the entire planet you stand on, and the universe itself to create a sphere of potentially infinite destructive energy. How much of that becomes realized is based on how much energy you successfully collect and your overall range to pull from, represented by the size and density of the orb. After you've accumulated enough energy, you can deploy the Spirit Bomb for various purposes. From simply throwing it at a target, absorbing it for a massive power boost, or imbuing it's power into others. It requires constant and prolonged concentration to gather energy, leaving you relatively wide open. However, should you possess the Spirit Control Upgrade, you can refine it to be more efficient and powerful, especially with Forced Spirit Fission. You also pass the requirement of having a pure heart to use the Spirit Bomb, regardless of any changes in your nature, as well as anyone else you deem worthy. Finally, the moment it makes contact with an entity of great or pure evil, it will either completely eviscerate or severely injure them based on total gathered energy.
addons.title: Genkidama!

addons.text:
The strength of Ki is determined by the constitution of one's body, and the strength of Haki is determined by one's will. Through combining both, your mind and body have synchronised into an engine that produces a monstrous amount of Ki, and your raw output is a natural disaster just waiting to be unleashed. 

Even as your body succumbs to fatigue or injury, your will is enough to not only keep you in fighting condition, but to summon new wells of Ki for as long as you maintain it. Likewise, your Ki and body are amplified or deflated in proportion to your will and state of mind. And most importantly, this synchronisation allows you  to manifest the versatility and power of Ki with greater precision, efficiency, and ease.

Observation Haki elevates your physical and spiritual senses, allowing you to not only sense another's presence, but also their emotions, intent, and true strength, all in perfect detail. With practice, this can develop into mastering the technique of Ultra Instinct, as well as develop or further enhance mental techniques like Image Training, Mind Reading, or Telepathy.

Armament Haki reinforces your body to the point of complete immunity to attacks within or below your current power, either dissipating on contact or bouncing right off your body. Against attacks stronger than you or don't target your body, it merely offers enhanced resistance and durability. Techniques that rely on your body like the Kaioken become far easier to manage and can be pushed further as well.

Conqueror's Haki produces effects similar to God Ki, causing it to become denser and thus stronger. As well as elevate your manipulation of Ki to create various techniques much more easily, such as the Soaring Fist, Yardratian Techniques or Ki Constructs, though you'd still need knowledge of them depending on complexity.
addons.title: Supreme Ki

addons.text:
The balanced nature of Chakra has fundamentally enhanced your Ki. By mixing spiritual and physical energy into a perfectly harmonized force, your Ki gains vastly superior control, efficiency, and adaptability. Techniques that once relied purely on overwhelming power can now be shaped with incredible precision, allowing for far finer manipulation of blasts, barriers, flight, and reinforcement.

Chakra also grants your Ki an affinity for specialized techniques and transformations. Your Ki can now more easily take on elemental properties, empower illusions, cling to surfaces, reinforce the body internally, or be molded into stable constructs and techniques with far less effort than normal Ki shaping would require. Even your sensing abilities improve, as Chakra’s spiritual balanced allows you to perceive energy, emotions, and intent with much greater clarity.

Most importantly, Chakra greatly reduces the wastefulness inherent to Ki usage. Your techniques consume far less energy, your control becomes exceptionally refined, and your stamina in prolonged combat increases enormously, allowing you to fight at full power for far longer than a normal Ki user ever could.
addons.title: Chakra Integration
Unified Philosophy
addons.text: Ki and Aura, while distinct in their properties, represent two different expressions of the same underlying phenomenon: Life Force. Ki represents the cultivation, refinement, and projection of life energy, while Aura represents its spiritual, mental, and empathic expression. Thanks to your now-innate understanding of how these two systems relate to one another, you can seamlessly integrate them into a single, unified discipline. The benefits of this are numerous. The simplest is that your two energy reserves are merged into one, larger pool. But it doesn't end there. You can manipulate your own life energy, as well as the life energy of others, with far greater ease and precision, making you a natural prodigy in the art of Spirit Control and techniques such as the Spirit Bomb or Telepathy. Not only that, but your Ki and Aura senses combine into something far more impressive. You can sense not only someone's life force, but also their emotions and mental state and, with enough training, even their very soul. This perception can function through physical obstructions and, with sufficient mastery, across vast distances. Additional benefits include Aura techniques gaining the scalability and potential of Ki techniques, allowing them to grow far beyond their previous limits, while Ki techniques become capable of operating beyond merely the physical level. For example, you could infuse your attacks with your emotions to disrupt your opponent's focus. A Kamehameha could project your genuine desire to befriend an opponent, while a Hell Grenade could be infused with your sheer hatred for someone. Even a Destructo Disc capable of cutting through body and mind simultaneously, or a Solar Flare that blinds not only the eyes but also someone's spiritual senses, isn't out of the question. If you possess God Ki (Dragon Ball Series) or have access to TE via either being a Pokémon or having the Type Energy (Pokemon) upgrade, the benefits will obviously extend to them as well. There is theoretically no upper limit to how far this unified system can be developed, provided you possess the time, dedication, and means necessary to continue cultivating it.

objects.text:
You now possess the knowledge and the requisite skills to effectively utilize and cultivate the potent force known as Ki to its utmost potential. Ki, the life force that permeates the essence of every living entity, through the process of extraction, can be manipulated and harnessed beyond the confines of your physical form.

The versatility of Ki cannot be overstated. It serves to enhance both the body and spirit, refining your proficiency with martial arts and propelling them to unprecedented levels, creating techniques from sealing to powering up your stats and even teleportation. Its utilization is bound solely by the limits of your imagination. The magnitude of your reservoir of Ki corresponds directly to the potency of your physical constitution; thus, the more powerful your body is, the more you can draw upon this life force.

However, this process usually takes considerable time, effort and proper guidance to sustain. The rewards, though, are boundless, as Ki growth possesses the capacity for infinite expansion. Advancing along this path becomes progressively more arduous as you ascend to greater heights.

To facilitate the journey towards your Ki cultivation, a comprehensive manual is directly installed in your brain and can be accessed at any time. It meticulously outlines a step-by-step progression and provides explicit instructions for the diligent practitioner to follow, ensuring continued advancement and proficiency in the art of Ki manipulation as long as one remains dedicated to this pursuit.
objects.title: Ki (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text: You gain the skill and knowledge to create both Ninja Tools and Scientific Ninja Tools, such as Puppets, Shinobi-Ware, Food Pills, & unique swords like those of the Hidden Mist. You also gain great skill and encyclopedic knowledge with sealing jutsu, as it is necessary to make items like Scrolls & Explosive Tags.
addons.title: Ninja Tools

addons.text:
You now possess the abilities of a master samurai, as well as those of a shinobi. Samurai focus on pure chakra manipulation, typically used in body enhancement, and coating their sword in chakra. By imbuing your chakra in your blade, you may enhance its cutting and piercing power, send out chakra slashes, and alter its shape to appear as a different weapon. On top of that, your body's enhancement is now also connected to your breathing style, allowing you to passively use your chakra to enhance yourself through your breathing style. Depending on your breathing style, with enough mastery, it can also act as a form of nature transformation. 

Your Nichirin weapon is now strengthened and has been combined with a high-quality chakra blade metal, with you optionally being able to get up to four different Nichirin weapons for free. Optionally, you can gain the full samurai arsenal, but it will be made of regular, high-quality steel or a basic, high-quality material, depending on the weapon.

You also gain a form of personalized, high-quality, chakra steel, light-weight, and flexible samurai armor with a helmet, which includes a respirator and a radio that cannot be listened to, jammed, or otherwise externally messed with. This armor also includes a small storage seal, which is typically used to store other weapons and essentials.

All of your samurai equipment can function as an Object of Power, for any relevant purpose.
addons.title: Master Samurai

addons.text: The mingling between your talent of harnessing and shaping both Ki and Reiryoku, being largely physical and spiritual energy respectively, caused your Chakra to alter its nature: easily shaping Chakra to various forms not unlike Hoshigakure shinobi accomplish through the Mysterious Peacock Method, albeit with none of the restrictions or drawbacks. This allows a talent in Chakra Control and Formation, no matter your reserves, helping the creation of constructs of various uses and your advances on Chakra Enhancement, Shape, and Nature Transformation, to add a few. This subsequently promotes the same talents in both Ki and Reiryoku Control, helping with deftly fashioning Ki or Reiryoku constructs.
addons.title: Chakra Formation

addons.text:
Your chakra explodes exponentially, making you rival a proper Tailed Beast in chakra. Your skills in Kenjutsu are amplified, allowing you to fight even the greatest swordmasters with Samehade.

With all of that said, your greatest asset is still your ninjutsu. The power of your Water-Style ninjutsu is increased tenfold (creating lakes is as easy as a single hand-seal for you), and you can swim faster than the eye can track.
addons.title: Tailless Tailed Beast

addons.text:
The combination of Chakra and your Quirk(s) has caused a particularly interesting mutation.

You may choose any one bloodline from Naruto that does not already have an option in the CYOA to acquire. More powerful bloodlines will begin at a weaker level.

Alternatively, you can choose to transform your Quirk into a Chakra-based bloodline, which will gain greater power and flexibility by running on Chakra.

Either choice will result in enhanced growth potential, as your Quirk factor amplifies your Chakra and vice versa.
addons.title: Quirky Bloodline

addons.text:
The coexistence of Haki and Chakra within you has caused your Chakra to evolve in expression rather than quantity. 

Observation Haki has refined your awareness of chakra flow to an instinctive level, allowing for effortless control, shaping, and detection with minimal waste. 

Armament Haki reinforces chakra-enhanced movements and constructs, granting greater durability, striking power, and stability without excessive strain. 

Conqueror’s Haki strengthens the spiritual authority behind your chakra, amplifying killing intent while disrupting an enemy's focus and their ability to mold chakra as well as strengthening your resistance to genjutsu and similar supernatural manipulation techniques. 

For the Eight Gates, Haki does not remove the risks of the Eight Gates, but through training and ultimately mastery Haki can delay damage, increase efficiency, and raise overall output—allowing fewer Gates to be opened for greater results and extending survivability even at extreme levels. To be clear this does not make you independent of the Gates but makes it so you are able to handle the strain physically and spiritually as well as make it so the first Gate and so on grant as much chakra as the next gate due to their improved chakra quality.

Note: Should you gain "the voice of all things" with Observation Haki mastery. You will be able to with training learn how to harness Sage chakra without needing to be taught by any sage clan. As you will understand, respect, and synchronize with the natural world turning Sage training from a dangerous trial-and-error process into a guided dialogue with the natural world.
addons.title: Willbound Chakra

addons.text:
Cursed Energy and Chakra fuse into something far more complex and versatile compared to the sum of their parts. Both energies are conjured, shaped, and deployed through emotions, will, and lifeforce, causing them to flow in dual alignment and compliment each other. 

Negative emotions increase the power output of your jutsus; Chakra Control makes the flow of your Cursed Energy nigh-unreadable and reduces expenditure for Cursed Techniques immensely; Mudras can be used to cast powerful jutsus like the Water Dragon with a single handseal; Chants and Binding Vows become viable amplifiers during the casting time of jutsus or techniques; Taijutsu skill or the Eight Gates can raise the chance of landing a Black Flash; and so much more. 

Even at the most basic level, you will naturally have high level Chakra Control due to using the simpler method of focusing and redirecting Cursed Energy throughout your body. Add in concepts like Nature Transformation, Chakra Molding, or Shape Transformation, and you'll make creating a one handed Rasengan look easy with enough practice. Your physical reinforcement is enhanced to the point of contending with Might Guy, Tsunade Senju, or Sakura Haruno in pure Taijutsu, and be manipulated to create explosive movement, precise strikes, slow your perception, expand your range of awareness, and travel vast distances in seconds. 

Any jutsu you know can be performed the same way you'd activate a Cursed Technique by supplying it with enough Chakra, skipping the need for handseals entirely. However, jutsus with high ranks will require greater energy expenditure to perform them this way. Likewise, the mechanics of Chakra allows you to create many extension techniques and derivative jutsu from your Cursed Technique. Though depending on said Technique and your abilities with Chakra, that can be easier said than done, but always possible.

You also possess the Dark Release Kekkei Genkai, allowing you to absorb all forms of supernatural energy or techniques fueled by them into yourself for storage and release them as more powerful and darker versions. You don't suffer the drawbacks of Hiruko, allowing you to safely absorb energy with no risk of deterioration. You can also use this absorbed energy for other purposes, like refuelling your own reserves, increasing your vitality, or gain the traits of the absorbed energy. 

If you have Reverse Cursed Technique, you gain even more options to manipulate these dual energies. Such as applying Cursed Technique Reversal to manifest the opposite version of your jutsus; Create techniques derived from Yin or Yang Release; Infuse positive energy into others to empower, heal, or restore youth; Prolong usage of the Eight Gates by constantly healing yourself; Advance the Transformation jutsu into true shapeshifting, and more.
addons.title: Cursed Chakra

addons.text:
Chakra and Nen, both being Life Force based power systems, have combined, creating Pure Chakra, a drastically powerful fusion that pushes both power systems far beyond their norm.

This fusion grants you a greatly increased energy pool that is also far denser than normal, comparable to about half that of an Uzumaki or Senju. You will also find this new Pure Chakra to be far easier to control, thanks to the 4 Basic Principles of Nen. This increased control will further improve with mastery of every Advanced Nen Principle, quickly pushing your control to Kage-level and beyond. Also, your lifespan now measures in centuries at minimum and will only grow greater as you train your Pure Chakra and grow stronger.

Your Nen Affinity will uniquely change your relationship with your Pure Chakra, making it so that any Chakra Techniques that fall under your Affinity become far stronger and easier to use, consuming far less energy compared to normal.

The Four Basic Principles of Nen will also empower your Pure Chakra, combining the benefits of both systems seamlessly to create a drastically more powerful whole.

You also gain the ability to empower your Original Hatsu to absurd levels of power with greatly reduced energy usage. With a great amount of time and effort, you may convert a single Jutsu or Chakra Technique into a Hatsu Technique, turning it into a kind of inherent technique you can call upon at will with zero effort.

Each of the Advanced Nen Principles will also become far stronger and easier to use than normal, both in learning them and their energy costs. The Advanced Principles, which govern Aura Control and the empowerment of your body or an object, will become drastically stronger with Pure Chakra. Gyo will grant you increased ocular abilities with the ability to see the Life Force and Chakra of living beings. En will grant absurdly powerful sensory abilities, allowing you to sense targets with a beginning range of one mile.
addons.title: Pure Chakra

addons.text:
You have gained true mastery over Yin Release and Yang Release.

Most jutsu draw from Yin or Yang in some capacity, however you now can utilize both releases at a level normally reached only by exceptional training, rare inheritance, or unusual circumstances.

Yin Release involves giving form to things that don't exist through imagination and creating form out of nothing. Yang Release involves breathing life into things that don't have it and affecting the physical world. In conjunction they can be used to incredible effect. 

Your mastery of Yin release will allow you to do things such as creating Genjutsu on par with Itachi and imbuing imaginary properties to Elemental Ninjutsu with Yin Release, and your master of Yang Release grants you Medical Ninjutsu on par with Tsunade and augmenting your body to better handle the Eight Gates with Yang Release.

Your advanced mastery of both allows you to access advanced techniques such The Creation of All Things when Yin-Yang is utilized simultaneously. 

You also gain insight as to how to create Truth Seeking Balls, malleable chakra constructs that can be shaped freely and can serve as a focal point for creation and destruction. 

An inherent technique, that you also now also have use of, is that you can imbue it with the ability to erase anything it interacts with, whether that be other ninjutsu, physical objects, or even metaphysical things like spirits. 

They can be shaped into various weapons and constructs, but larger constructs may require more than one orb. These are also freely manipulated, allowing you to levitate them, shoot them as projectiles, and other kind of movement. 

This will allow you to do things such as shaping them into floating disks for transportation, or shaping them into spears as projectiles, and any other manipulations you can imagine. 

As these are manifested and created directly through your own technique, you can freely make as many as your chakra allows. 

Creation of Truth Seeking Balls will require you to gain some basic understanding of the other 5 basic chakra natures, but the most major hurdle, being the understanding of the technique and Yin-Yang Release’s mastery, has been passed.
addons.title: Yin Yang Release

addons.text:
Your awakened potential manifests as a Chakra Mode perfectly tailored for you. As a base, it will massively amplify all of your Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, and physical abilities to Jonin level. If you were already a Jonin, then it will scale to Kage level, and so on.

You can infuse any of your abilities into this state to create various effects, like a nature transformation to gain an Elemental Chakra Mode, which will cloak your body in a thick layer of Chakra coated with that element, and grant all associated effects related to it. Such as the Lightning Chakra Mode to gain speed and reflexes so great that even the Sharingan fails to track you, and the lightning cloak will shock those who attempt to harm you. 

Other examples are if you took <u>Ittou Shura (Chivalry Of A Failed Knight)</u>, your Chakra Mode will remove the risks of using that power entirely, and allow prolonged use of it; With a Dōjutsu, your Chakra Mode can augment its abilites even further or create something completely unique, akin to the Tenseigan Chakra Mode from the Byakugan; If you have multiple conflicting powers, then your Chakra Mode can unite them all as a unified whole, like Naruto's Six Paths Sage Mode.

You can freely switch and combine the other nature transformations and your powers into this state. Also, it will grow alongside you and stacks with other powers.
addons.title: Chakra Mode

addons.text: You inherit the Kekkei Genkai of the Kurama Clan, making you a natural born genius and prodigy at Genjutsu, to the point of creating illusions so powerful that they have real, physical effects on the target, and can even kill them. The barriers that made using Genjutsu difficult no longer apply to you, nor is injecting Chakra into your target needed, as you can simply will it onto the them and the environment itself. Unlike Yakumo Kurama, you have full control over this power, allowing you to easily scale and hold back, as well as choose what does and doesn't become affected by it. You can mimic the various Genjutsu used by Kurenai, Kakashi, Itachi and several low grade ones easily. Such as making the target live through their worst fears, make them subject to various forms of body horror, psychological attacks, or straight up torture them for what feels like an eternity, while only a few seconds have passed in the real world. You're also free to make variants and original ones that make the target live in their head while being stunned in reality, make them hallucinate in the middle of battle, impair their senses under certain conditions, and any other things you can think of. You can also affect the environment on a similar scale, such as by making quicksand appear as a relaxing spa, a group of snakes as rabbits, a mist that makes anyone who enters thinks their trapped in a giant maze, and more. Furthermore, your Genjutsu can replicate any real phenomena or create new ones entirely, causing the above examples to feel real because to the target, they simply are. Which means any torture methods can leave legitimate physical scars and memories of a life that never was still carries the weight of being experienced firsthand. In time, you can even create your own version of the Infinite Tsukuyomi.
addons.title: Kurama Heritage

addons.text:
Through your knowledge in the creation and innovation of talismans and formations, you have achieved its equivalent in Fuinjutsu. Your talent and mastery in this field are directly proportional to your Taoist arts.

However, what is truly special is that you inherit one of the most extraordinary methods of Chakra control. It is the legacy of Tsuchigumo Shiranami.

Instead of performing jutsu through hand seals or previously prepared Fuinjutsu, you do so through Jibakujutsu. This involves manifesting kanji, symbols, or any language of your choosing in the air or upon any surface, and in doing so releasing the jutsu represented by or linked to the meaning of what was written.

For example, if you write "Fire," it will manifest in reality as such. The advantage is that it does not require Nature Transformation or fine Chakra control beyond the necessary calligraphy and the cost required to manifest it, much in the same way that Fuinjutsu functions.

A side effect is that it serves as a perfect substitute for the mundane and supernatural material costs required to create formations, talismans, and Fuinjutsu. By simply engraving them directly using your Chakra or any supernatural energy you possess, you can achieve the same result. However, doing so consumes more energy in proportion to the scale and complexity of the creation, in addition to the energy required to activate and maintain it.
addons.title: Jibakujutsu

addons.text:
You inherit all the knowledge and abilities of Sai Yamanaka, as well as mastery over all of his Ink Techniques, Fuinjutsu, and derivatives of the Super Beast Imitating Drawing Jutsu. You can manipulate, shape, and control Ink as a form of Yang Release for numerous applications and combine them with any jutsus and abilities you know. Such as spraying it over a wide area before igniting it with Fire Release, or cloaking yourself with ink to obscure yourself.

You have a variety of pre-made drawings you can summon to your aid without expending any Chakra, these include all of the Ink Beasts Sai used and any of your own creation. Each of these are stored within special scrolls on your person, which you can seal your creations into for later use and summon from just as easily. 

You start with 10 scrolls and a specialized brush that generates ink by infusing it with your Chakra, which you can make more of with the necessary resources. They also count as OoP.
addons.title: Super Beast Imitating Drawing

objects.text:
Chakra is the life energy that is produced by every individual to some degree, composed of physical and spiritual energy. Physical energy is collected from every cell of the body and can be increased through training, stimulants, and exercise. Spiritual energy is derived from the mind's consciousness and can be increased through studying, meditation, and experience. Chakra is normally not visible unless it is highly concentrated or manifested in large amounts.

You've become capable of using Chakra on the same level as an Academy Graduate, with the knowledge of basic Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, and Taijutsu.

You can use Chakra to reinforce yourself to become stronger, faster and more resistant. You gain an Elemental Affinity of your choice with a C-rank technique in that elemental affinity, and knowledge in how Jutsu is made through experience in Chakra Molding and familiarity with Chakra theory. With study and experience, you can use all 5 elemental affinities.
objects.title: Chakra (Naruto)

addons.text:
You are the closest member of the Ōtsutsuki who can be considered close to Godhood. You possess a perfect and innate ability to use Chakra, surpassing any other member of your species that hasn't ascended like your ancestor. Your chakra reserves are akin to the Ten Tails in terms of quality and potency.

You also possess the strongest dōjutsu the Ōtsutsuki Clan has ever seen—the Jogan. While not on par with Shibai Ōtsutsuki's, you have complete control of all its powers and, through your perfect control, can seemingly do anything with chakra—even copying or creating abilities based on any non chakra-related powers you encounter or can think of.

You are able to perfectly bond your essence into any host without the fear of incompatibility and can even decide to just have your essence be dormant until you either perish in battle or decide to take over the body.

Alternatively, due to your unique nature, you can also just absorb the essence of other living beings and choose what traits, skills and abilities you desire to gain from them, eliminating the need for a Chakra Fruit to evolve.

Finally, while you don't need it to evolve, any God Tree that you plant can accelerate its growth so that it reaches full maturity in minutes should you desire.
addons.title: The Heir of Shibai Ōtsutsuki

objects.text:
As an Ōtsutsuki, you are part of a clan of extraterrestrial parasites that consume energy and genetic information from Chakra Fruits, which are cultivated by the God Trees. 

Chakra is a supernatural energy that the Ōtsutsuki possess, allowing them to perform incredible feats such as interstellar flight and concealment from others of their kind. With greater control and skill, they can use chakra to perform various applications.

As a Ōtsutsuki, you possess a seed that has the potential to grow into a god tree. However, you can't access higher abilities like the Rinnegan because you haven't consumed a Chakra Fruit yet. You can cultivate the God Tree to grow a Chakra Fruit, which, when devoured, grants god-like power and immortality. Each Chakra Fruit contains unique genetic material and energy from the planet where it was grown. endowing unique abilities and transforming into an improved version of yourself, ultimately leading you to reach godhood and become divine.

To extend their lives, the Ōtsutsuki have developed the Kāma seal, which overwrites the host DNA, transforming it into an Ōtsutsuki. If the Ōtsutsuki is slain, their soul transfers to the Kāma until they regenerate and reincarnate into the vessel. While the vessel is in control, it gains a fragment of the Ōtsutsuki's power and abilities. However, a suitable recipient is required; otherwise, the vessel will not survive the implantation of the Kāma.

(It is important to note that once the seed is sown, you cannot replant it until it has finished consuming all the energy and genetic material on the planet.)
objects.title: Ōtsutsuki (Naruto)

addons.text: Your already indomitable will allows you to inherit the will and resolve of those who face death with a smile, a desire for freedom, see your ambitions realized, and with an unshakable faith in dreams—both theirs and their friends. This gives you weight, a gravitas that inevitably pushes you to greater heights, leaving a mark on the world at large. As Haki is Will taken shape, this influences your strength and potential in Haki, easily having a handle on the advanced techniques and an augmented potency on basic techniques, especially on Conqueror’s Haki—probably because you possess “the qualities of a king”.
addons.title: Will of D.

addons.text:
“The flower of Haki only truly blooms in the extreme condition of real battle. The more you face off against strong enemies, the stronger you become.”- Silvers Rayleigh

Haki bloom is a phenomenon where a user's Haki undergoes an explosive growth in both mastery and potency during a life-or-death battle, especially when emotions are running high. This surge can turn the tide of battle by enabling the user to unlock advanced forms of Haki they already have the potential to wield, significantly boosting their combat effectiveness.

When combined with fighting spirit, a Haki bloom is almost guaranteed to occur during combat. The extent of this bloom depends on how much fighting spirit the user has accumulated during the fight.

A harmless sparring session would result in only a small bloom, offering minor improvements. However, a prolonged battle where one is pushed to the brink of death would trigger a massive bloom, potentially allowing the user to rival a Yonkō or Marine Admiral and beyond.
addons.title: Haki Bloom

addons.text:
You are no longer limited to defeating and/or killing the target in combat. Now, you can even bend the target to your will through sheer force of will—that is, through Conqueror’s Haki.

Those with weaker willpower than your own will fall under the effects of Domination Power. Not only do you absorb their souls, powers, and abilities, but you also absorb the target’s will.

This doesn’t mean you have direct control over the target. Some things can affect your control. For example, strong emotions, traumas, habits, dislikes, and other subconscious or instinctual things will remain outside of your control.

The number of targets, the time they can remain under your control, and the level of freedom you have over them directly depend on the strength of your Conqueror’s Haki, in other words, the strength of your own will.

If you dominate too many entities, if you try to control them beyond the allowed time, or if you try to force them to do something against their will, the probability that someone will regain their lost will and start a rebellion increases as it puts strain on your will over the target. However, this can be solved if the difference in willpower between you and the target is more than double.

If this condition is met, the limitations can relax, but they will never be completely eliminated. The only viable case for total domination is if the target no longer has the will to live, has a damaged soul, or is mentally unstable.

The powers that you’ve absorbed from those you’ve defeated and/or killed will never be lost, even if the target regains their lost will.
addons.title: Dominant Will

addons.text:
Your Haki and Aura have fused into a single spiritual force that embodies both indomitable will and universal life energy.

Through this fusion, your Haki can now be fueled and refined through Aura. This greatly increases the stamina efficiency of Haki usage, grants greater resistance against emotional instability weakening your abilities, and allows for far finer control over your spiritual power.

Although your Aura and willpower can each fuel your Haki independently, they are at their strongest when used in unison. When both are brought together, your Aura regeneration is significantly enhanced during combat so long as your resolve remains unshaken.

Notable benefits include applications derived from mixing different types of Haki with your Aura. 

By extending the offensive and defensive properties of Armament Haki through your Aura, allowing you to reinforce your body, weapons, and even techniques with condensed Aura-Haki, enabling them to directly strike intangible, spiritual, ghostly, or energy-based beings.

You may also project Armament Haki externally in the form of blasts, shockwaves, or barriers, and with sufficient mastery, your attacks can strike the body, mind, and soul of an opponent simultaneously. The advanced Haki techniques of Emission and Internal Destruction also become significantly easier to learn and wield.

Merging Observation Haki with your Aura Sense grants a near-instinctive awareness of nearby living beings, a heightened ability to perceive emotions and intent, and enhanced combat precognition through direct perception of another being’s Aura flow. With mastery, you can even track spiritual signatures across vast distances and effortlessly perceive through even powerful forms of invisibility, concealment, and illusion.

Lastly, the connective nature of Aura transforms your Conqueror’s Haki from a force of purely oppressive dominance into something far more profound. Rather than simply crushing weaker wills, it imposes the “truth” of your spirit upon reality itself.

This allows you to inspire courage in allies while instilling terror in enemies at the same time, disrupt possession, mind control, curses, and corruption, and overpower hostile spiritual domains or psychic influences.

At higher levels of mastery, you can force spiritual entities into physical manifestation and temporarily suppress spiritual or soul-based techniques by exerting pressure not only upon an opponent’s will, but upon their very soul itself.

If you are a Pokémon, or possess the Type Energy upgrade, the benefits of your Aura-Haki also extend to your Type Energies and moves. Additionally, you may optionally choose for your Haki to manifest with a luminous or flame-like appearance unique to your soul.
addons.title: Aura King

objects.text:
You gain the power of Haki from One Piece, in all of its variations.

Armament Haki covers all or part of your body in a black coating, enhancing your strength and durability, and allowing you to injure beings whose powers would usually make them immune, such as those who are intangible or have a body of living fire.

Observation Haki is a sensory power that gives its user the ability to sense the aura and emotions of others in range. With enough practice, it shall confer a type of combat precognition.

Conqueror's Haki creates a sort of 'pressure' that can knock out the weak-willed, or temporarily force fear or compliance on those who fail to resist. In extreme cases, it can damage physical objects.

Unlike most powers, Haki relies heavily on the determination and willpower of its user, and falters when they do.
objects.title: Haki (One Piece)

addons.text: Your skill with Senjutsu has granted you the ability to create, mimic, and develop abilities used by the four canon races shown in Bleach. Such examples include: The Spirit manipulation of the Fullbringers, allowing you to create your own Fullbring. The ability to create weapons made out of Reiryoku/Reishi like the Quincy. You're not limited to bows, it's also within your capability to create shields and simple weapons like spears and swords. However, unlike them, yours are much efficient and powerful. You can learn to recreate and reverse engineer the Kidō techniques used by the Shinigami, as well as the powers of the Arrancars like the destructive Cero or the protective Hierro. It's also possible for you to emulate the effects of the spirit swords known as Zanpakutō, but not the weapons themselves. However, to do so, you must first understand how the spiritual energy is used and developed to recreate the effects. Your current skill with Senjutsu can easily allow you to recreate abilities like Ichigo's Getsuga Tenshou, create a spiritual weapon like the Quincies, manipulate the spirits in all things surrounding you like the Fullbringers, and allow you to create Cero and its weaker but faster generated technique Bala. Should you gain Aspiring Sage, your skills will be updated to allow you to recreate a Hollow's instant regeneration, an Arrancar's Hierro, a Quincy's Blut techniques, a Shinigami's Advanced Kidō techniques, advanced mastery of a Fullbringer's spirit manipulation, and finally, obtain advanced skill in all of the races' high speed movement techniques. As a reminder, you can create your own techniques and use those listed above as examples to grow greater in power.
addons.title: Sage of Spirit

addons.text:
Chakra opens new paths for using Reiryoku, especially Kidō. Instead of incantations, you can weave handseals to cast spells, and either add more to reinforce their strength or skip them for faster casting, but with reduced strength. If you're skilled enough, you can perform both Jutsu and Kidō with less handseals, incantations, one handed, or skip them entirely.

All expressions of Kidō aid in manipulating Jutsu and vice versa. Such as Hadō amplifying the destructive power of Fire Style Jutsu, or the cutting force of Wind Style Jutsu; Bakudō mixing with nature transformations for elemental barriers, and enchaning Fuinjutsu to the point of potentially sealing a Tailed Beast; Kaidō matching Tsunade's talent of Medical Ninjutsu with greater ease and restoring chakra reserves; Mixing both incantations and handseals to cast two separate jutsu and/or spells simultaneously, and much more.

The Five Elemental Natures become easier to learn due to several Kidō spells directly manifesting them. Reiatsu reinforces your Killing Intent to the point of being classified as a high level Genjutsu, and speaking of which, those also become easier and less taxing to use due to being fueled by your Reiryoku. Reishi can be converted to Chakra to restore your reserves or be used as a secondary source entirely. 

Finally, the amount of Reiryoku you possess can further deepen your Chakra reserves. For example, Captain Level Reiryoku can give you Jōnin Level Chakra reserves, while Immense or Immeasurable Reiryoku will make you rival Tailed Beast Level reserves.

Beyond that, you can mimic the various clan techniques of Naruto. Like the Yamanaka clan's Mind Transfer, Telepathy, and Mind Reading; Shikamaru clan's Shadow Possession; Amakichi clan's Body Expansion; Hyguga clan's Eight Trigrams; Uzumaki clan's Adamantium Chains or Seals, and much more.
addons.title: Kidō Jutsu

addons.text:
Despite being a human, you've reached power akin to a freshly graduated Shinigami through the methods of Total Concentration Breathing. Each breath is used to draw Reiryoku from the environment into your body, as the medium to channel it into your techniques, and the method to release them. Additionally, the elemental and esoteric aspects of your Breathing Styles, once visual metaphors, are made manifest through Reiryoku and Reiatsu, similar to Captain Yamamoto's flames or Hitsugaya's ice.

Beyond Zanjutsu, you can choose to express your Breathing Style through Kidō, Hakuda, and/or Hohō. Such as by pairing the already amazing speed of Thunder Breathing with Hohō to move even faster; Beast Breathing, a once wild and reckless style, can be made much more sophicated with Hakuda; Love Breathing paired with Kidō can create hypnosis or charm based spells, and much more.

Outside of affecting spirits the same way as demons, your Nichirin weapon is unchanged. Though you can choose to transform it into a Zanpakutō, with a named inner spirit waiting for you. Overtime, it will awaken Shikai and Bankai.
addons.title: Soul Breathing

addons.text: "So what's the characteristic that dinguishes these two beings? There's only one answer... INSTINCT!" Reiki and Reiryoku fuse in a way that brings this philosophy to life, thus making you the embodiment of it. As you enter battle, your emotional highs and lows cause your Reiryoku and Reiatsu to intensify throughout its duration. Even without formal training, your growth rate and talent will echo the rise of Ichigo Kurosaki himself. However, having his recklessness will hinder your growth, as by learning to properly control your emotions and focus both forms of Spiritual Power, your abilities not only become more powerful, but diverse and refined to perfection. The most potent way this manifests is through a battle instinct that develops with each battle you experience, etching various lessons, insights, epiphanies, and raw experience into your very essence. As you develop this instinct, you can correct your mistakes, learn to master your abilities, create new techniques, gain battle precognition, look into your opponent's soul, resonate much more deeply with your Zanpakutō, cause your Fullbring to develop its own sentience, and many other things. It can only develop through engaging in serious battles, with deathmatches and high stakes causing rapid acceleration, but are not necessary. This instinct and the memory of all battles you've entered will never fade, and will always be dormant within your subconscious. Always ready to be unleashed at a moment's notice.
addons.title: The King and The Horse
Spiritual Investiture
addons.text:
By using Shu, you can envelop an object in your Nen and temporarily treat it as an extension of yourself. By feeding Reiryoku through this aura coating, you can gradually anchor spiritual power into the object itself, causing it to develop a genuine spiritual counterpart.

Once sufficiently invested, the object can interact normally with souls and incorporeal beings, accompany you into spiritual environments, and resist effects that would normally ignore or separate physical matter. Continued investment can make this state permanent, allowing ordinary weapons, clothing, and tools to function as true spiritual equipment without being made from Reishi.

The Nen coating is the framework that allows Reiryoku to take root in something outside your own spiritual body; without it, the invested Reiryoku simply disperses.

addons.title: Spirit Exorcist
addons.text:
Due to your mix of "Light and Dark" spiritual powers, you've simultaneously become the ultimate destroyer and healer of all spiritual aliments and creatures. Cursed Energy turns you into a radar for hunting Hollows, or empowers and sustains you as one. While Reiryoku opens a new world of possibilities and options for a Jujutsu Sorcerer. Regardless of whether you're a human, spirit, or spiritual creature, you will share similar baseline starting abilities.

You gain a higher ceiling, your power is more flexible, and depending on your talent or expertise, significantly streamlined; Jujutsu Techniques become much more powerful, longer lasting, and imposing on reality in proportion to your amount of Reiryoku; Negative Emotions can become a catalyst for greater growth, augment innate abilities, or manifest unique applications of them. This is only a general overview, as the possibilities are endless.

Both systems compliment and reinforce each other for incredible results. Such as Reverse Cursed Technique significantly injuring a Menos Grande or Vasto Lorde from sheer positive energy output; Open new doors of experimentation for the 12th Division; Domains and Bankai fusing into a greater manifestation of power; Black Flash causing rapid racial evolution, unlocking transformations, or releasing dormant power, and more.

Lastly, Cursed Tools become much more valuable and powerful, to the point of marking the right person as a Grade 1 or Special Grade entity by itself. They can also function like the various weapons from Bleach, like the Shinigami's Zanpakuto by taming the Cursed Spirit within and treating it as the Zanpakuto Spirit, or Fullbringer objects by resonating your Cursed Energy with the tool like Yuta and Rika.

objects.text: Reiryoku—Spiritual Power—is tied to your spiritual sensitivity and willpower. It's used by Shinigami and other spiritual beings to provide power for their various abilities. You start about as strong as a Shinigami-in-training or newly-formed Hollow. With Reiryoku, you're capable of seeing ghosts and spiritual beings, affecting spiritual beings and sensing the Spiritual Power of others. With the right training (and one of the races picked), you could run at supersonic speeds or even at the speed of light, stand in the air while keeping still, live for thousands of years, and manipulate Reiryoku to heal, defend, and fuel powerful attacks of sheer spiritual energy. You're capable of emitting Reiryoku as "Reiatsu", a form of intimidation capable of even making people much weaker than you die by your spiritual pressure.
objects.title: Reiryoku (Bleach)

objects.text: You now have a comprehensive—though largely academic—understanding of the Shinigami magical art known as “Kidō” or “Demon Arts,” having mastered the basics of the three main classifications: Hadō, Bakudō, and Kaidō. You are familiar with the first 10 numbers on the grading scale—or the rough equivalent when it comes to Kaidō—with enough knowledge to recreate stronger Kidō spells, or create your own with time. Kidō spells are graded on a scale from 1 to 99, with the higher the number, the more powerful, difficult, and dangerous the spell is to perform. To activate a Kidō, the user needs to recite a specific incantation, which is often long and requires a few seconds to perform. An experienced user can employ the technique Eishōhaki—Incantation Abandonment—to cast a spell without chanting. This drastically weakens the spell but reduces the casting time to almost nothing. Hadō, The Way of Destruction, is filled with powerful offensive spells, often utilizing elemental forces to some extent. Some of its most powerful techniques are known as Gisei Hadō—the Sacrificial Way of Destruction—requiring the user to sacrifice a part of their body to perform the spell. Bakudō, The Way of Binding contains techniques designed to enhance the user's capabilities on the battlefield. These include barriers to defend the caster and seals to trap opponents. Though subtle, when used effectively, they can drastically alter the course of a battle. Kaidō, The Turn Way, often feels like a different discipline altogether. Focused on healing, this branch of Kidō lacks individually named spells, incantations, or numbered rankings. The caster holds their hands above the patient's wounds and uses their own energies to restore the body and energy reserves of the target. Normally, this art requires spiritual energy to perform. However, this power doesn’t grant you any particular reserves of spiritual energy. Instead, you will find that you can easily adapt Kidō to utilize any energies you have access to, even powering it via stamina if needed.
objects.title: Kidō (Bleach)

addons.text:
Cursed Energy allows you to use a pseudo form of Yoki—Demon Energy. As the name implies, this is the kind of Reiki used by Demons. While you are not one yourself, you can wield strength on par with them. 

Your Reiki can now be deployed for more esoteric techniques the same way demons can. From manipulating the elements, conjuring weapons, telekinesis, hair manipulation, animating plants, awakening your third eye, summoning dragons made of black flames, etc. You will naturally have one of such abilities as your Innate Technique, and can treat it as you would a normal Cursed Technique. 

Due to your version of Demon Energy being powered by negative emotions, the strength of your Reiki can fluctuate based on them. Also, unlike a normal Jujutsu Sorcerer, improper usage of Cursed Energy and being overwhelmed by emotion actually benefits you. But proper control is still highly recommended.
addons.title: Yoki

addons.text: Instead of your own lifeforce, you've learned to draw on the ambient and bountiful Spirit Energy from the environment, allowing you to safely utilze Life Energy and empower your Reiki. More importantly, you have undergone Genkai's training and emerged even greater because of it. Your control over Reiki is so great that even if you couldn't draw on the environment for Life Energy, there'd be virtually no risk of death unless you were plain careless, and even then, you can heal your own spirit to reverse the effects of using Life Energy. You also have greater precision and efficiency when manipulating Reiki, allowing you to walk on a thread as a tightrope, defend against devastating attacks with minimum damage, and strike well above your weight class as examples. You gain all of Genkai's Techniques, such as the Spirit Gun to blast a massive beam of Reiki; Spirit Shotgun to fire a spray of bullets made of Reiki; Flight to levitate and travel at great speeds through the air; Shockwave to unleash an invisible burst of concussive force; Spirit Wave to perform excorism and healing, and more. You can also mimic the various other techniques from Yu Yu Hakusho created by humans, like Kuwabara's Spirit Sword, and with the Yoki Addon, you can mimic the one's created by Demons, like Tugaro's Tornado Fist.
addons.title: Genkai's Protege

addons.text: The combination of two different kinds of Spirit Energy has transcended your Reiki into its pinnacle form, Seikoki—Sacred Energy. From this, the power of your Reiki is brought to its fullest potential, and all applications of it are strengthened to the absolute limit. You can manipulate it with the same skill as Shinobu Sensui, alongside some bonuses based on your path of obtaining it. With Aura Guardian, you can manifest Reiki into many forms, shapes, constructs, and even materialize objects into existence, similar to Shinobu summoning his Sacred Energy Armor and Weapons. These constructs only remain active for as long as you will it, and dissipate back into Reiki when you stop. The strength of these objects and constructs, as well as any magical effects and other buffs they have are dependent on the strength of your Reiki. Attempting to conjure something beyond your own strength is simply impossible. With Aura (RWBY), you can infuse your Reiki into objects and even others to empower and grant various effects. Such as imbuing a sword with the properties of sunlight, or a shield with the power to repel what strikes it. Also, your Semblance becomes the truest expression of your Reiki, which can also be infused into conduits to create various effects and variants of its applications. Note: Having the Aura² Addon will fuse the above additions into one cohesive whole that is greater than the sum of its parts.
addons.title: Seikoki

addons.text:
Like Yusuke Urameshi, you can manifest your own Spirit Beast—a spiritual creature born from your own Reiki and soul, as a perfect reflection of you. However, this instead causes your Inner Beast to manifest freely as a physical entity, and gain several benefits.

Due to its formless and adaptable nature, not only can it freely change into various forms while manifested but also manifest new abilities due the nature of Reiki. For example, it can summon fire under immense rage, heal and purify aliments through hope, or corrupt and corrode matter under despair. This also translates into the many forms it can take, such as water manipulation as a shark or earth manipulation as a golem. 

These forms gain even more variety from other supernatural energies—such as Yoki or Seikoki—but can still undergo these transformations by itself under various circumstances. Unlike Yusuke and Puu, your Beast isn't affected by your physical condition, though it can still sense your well being if separated.

As you grow, it can take on upgraded forms to reflect your current strength.
addons.title: Spirit Beast
Legacy of Toguro
addons.text:
Through combining the Hercules Method with Reiki, you have gained an enhanced form of the muscle control ability of the absolute menace that was Younger Toguro. Through this, you can seal away your enhanced physique using a percentage-based system. At 0%, you appear completely normal, but as you raise the %, your body will begin to bulk up massively. At 100%, your body will bulk up to around 1.5x your original size with insanely huge muscles. While fully unleashed, your power increases exponentially, and your agility even though it should do the opposite. Do note that using your 100% form will demand a large amount of energy such that you should use it sparingly or employ a method to draw in more energy, such as from the environment or consuming the souls of nearby lifeforms.

When pushed against the wall, you can push beyond 100%, increasing power to even grander heights at the cost of a drastic amount of energy and physical/spirital recoil.

Lastly, you gain an ability that would cause everyone in the Spirit World to fear you like none other. You can now pull forth extra energy from your life-force with next to zero fear as the Hercules Method grants quasi-infinite life-force for as long as you can use it. However, using the Hercules Method to do this demands a large amount of mental focus such that it cannot be employed forever.

objects.text:
You have awakened your inner Reiki—Spirit Energy—the spiritual power dormant in all humans. From this, you're able to see and interact with ghosts and spirits, have a unique spiritual aura, and can sense the Reiki of others. 

You can utilize Reiki for a variety of abilities and techniques, such as physical reinforcement, healing, creating constructs, telepathy, flight, energy projection, and more. You will have a natural talent for manipulating Reiki in one or more of such ways, alongside a signature technique perfectly tailored for you.

The strength of your Reiki is linked to your emotions and understanding of them. This can manifest through flares of power as you experience them in extreme degrees, or by fully embracing and accepting them as examples. With true self actualization, or overcoming one's own demons allowing you to reach your full potential. 

As a last resort option, you can further enhance your abilities through drawing on your own Life Energy, amplifying them beyond their current limits. But runs the risk of death should you draw too much of it.
objects.title: Reiki (Yu Yu Hakusho)

addons.text: Like how two different people can learn the same thing yet go in different ways to master it, you have gained access to similar yet different applications of Aura. Because of your ability to use the version used by the people of Remnant and the version used in the world of HxH, you have gained a unique insight that has led you to gain mastery of the four major Principles and Advanced techniques of Nen. This ultimately allows you to immediately gain faster progress in utilizing and creating your ability based on your nature as a Nen user. You can also implement Nen's Principles onto Aura, including Post-Mortem Nen.
addons.title: Dual Insight

addons.text:
You have acquired a new form of control and understanding of your own Nen and Cursed Energy. Alongside this, you'll gain an increased affinity for both the Conjuration and Transmutation Nen categories, regardless of whether your original one or its neighboring ones.

The Innate Cursed Techniques that were often exclusive are now within your reach. You are capable of creating your own or imitating other preexisting ones through Hatsu. If you apply Binding Vow or naturally possess a Specialization-type Nen affinity, their effects are doubled in both power and efficiency.
addons.title: Cursed Nen

addons.text:
Your Nen has evolved and mutated in a way that not even the Chimera Ant race has been able to achieve or perfect.

Your Nen affinity with all aura types is 100%. Keep in mind that this is not a fake all-around affinity like Kurapika’s Emperor Time ability. In your case, these are real affinities.

The total malleability of your soul has allowed your Hatsu, Manipulation-type Nen affinity, and Specialization-type Nen affinity to be less restrictive than they used to be. Over time and with training, you will eventually reach the point where you can use them without any cost or limitation.

Thanks to the efficiency and firm control your soul has over Nen, this makes you a pseudo-genius regarding the Four Fundamental Principles of Nen at the level of an expert with years of experience. But you are still far from being a master, and much less from mastering advanced techniques.
addons.title: Free Nen

addons.text:
The best way to create strong Nen Abilities (aka Hatsu’s) is to place restrictions and limitations on them by their creator to drastically increase their scope, depth, and power. This works in a form of equivalent exchange, whereby placing large amounts of vows or ones of great severity grants much larger benefits. These Vows also become stronger based on your resolve and conviction, which requires great skill with Nen and a mix of a strong mind with powerful emotions.

This addon with Binding Vow not only allows you to bend the rules of this process but also allows you to create temporary Vows. Through this, you can modify your existing Hatsu, or even create entirely new sub-abilities as needed. That said, all vows and restrictions created through a Binding Vow must be followed through. You will remain bound by the consequences of what you create, so careless use can be extremely dangerous, even possibly killing you, depending on the Vows you create, should you fail to follow them.

With the Binding Vow upgrade Tithe, you can modify or remove existing vows, restrictions, and their associated drawbacks. Even the consequences of breaking these limitations are significantly reduced. For example, a vow that would normally cost your life in exchange for a power boost could be mitigated so that, instead, you are only severely weakened for a few days.
addons.title: Dynamic Vows

addons.text:
You no longer possess a Nen whose nature was acquired through training or a baptism, nor one that is artificial or forced like your bond with the Nen Beast. Instead, you possess a completely naturalized Nen, intrinsically bound to your soul.

This allows for an instinctive level of mastery over the Four Fundamental Principles, as natural as breathing. This goes beyond being a mere genius; you are a life form that uses Nen naturally. You even possess talent and experience in advanced techniques, surpassed only by true elite masters such as Isaac Netero or Meruem.

Your body now gains the same benefits granted by the physiology of a Nen Beast. Your aura reserves have risen to the same level as Meruem himself, allowing for more prolonged and more powerful use of techniques than normal. You could unleash a very powerful Hatsu a dozen times before feeling exhaustion. Additionally, your advanced En technique initially covers a perfectly defined 5 km sphere and can be maintained for 12 hours.

Finally, your bond with the Nen Beast, combined with this naturalization, grants you triple Hatsu output and Nen affinity. If you have the Free Nen add-on, you may even gain a permanent 200% increase in power and efficiency, as well as a 100% aura recovery in 2 minutes.

Your creativity, training, and understanding of Nen are the only things that truly limit you.
addons.title: Natural Nen

addons.text:
You now possess an extraordinary inversion power resulting from the interaction between Nen and Reverse Cursed Technique.

With the Enhancer Nen affinity, you are capable of regenerating and healing organic parts in seconds. This even removes the weakness of being unable to regenerate brains or soul-related alterations. As long as you have sufficient aura, cursed energy, or any other supernatural energy you possess, you are essentially immortal and eternal unless you are completely destroyed. You can also extend this effect to others.

With the Conjuration Nen affinity, you can repair inanimate matter and even invert matter into energy. Thanks to this, you will almost never exhaust your power reserves as long as there is matter within reach.

With the Transmutation Nen affinity, you can completely invert your body from a physical state into a body made of Nen along with the concept or property you have developed. For example, if you developed a lightning-based Nen aura, you would become a lightning elemental and could potentially gain true elemental or even conceptual control depending on the property you have mastered.

With the Manipulation Nen affinity, you can essentially manipulate the soul and mind themselves, inverting them from an altered state to a healthy one and vice versa.

Finally, with the Emission Nen affinity, you can invert the state of both mundane and supernatural connections. This ranges from severing the link between a telepath and their target to disrupting phone signals between communicating antennas. This only works within your sphere of influence, such as within your En or any sensory or domain-based power. Energy consumption is directly proportional to the number of targets and the difficulty involved. For example, attempting to sever the connection between a god and a mortal vessel could be difficult, while disrupting the electrical signals of electronic devices across a city could be easy.
addons.title: Miraculous Nen

addons.text:
Through the breathing-based martial art technique and by mastering its fundamentals, you can awaken Nen along with a level of mastery in Ren, Ten, and Zetsu equivalent to that of a beginner practitioner. If you reach the level of a Hashira or obtain the martial art's enhancement, you will instead master Nen at the level of an expert with three years of experience. Additionally, the difficulty of mastering advanced techniques such as Gyo, In, Shu, and other Nen techniques is reduced by 25%.

At the moment of your Nen awakening, your remaining four senses will increase to the same level as the super-sense you selected. Meanwhile, your En gains a greater range and an increased capacity to process information. At the same time, it becomes more stable and consumes less energy than normally required.

Depending on the Breathing Style you selected, you gain 100% affinity with the Nen categories of Transmutation, Enhancement, and Conjuration, adapted to your elemental style. However, if one of those was already your chosen Nen affinity, it becomes 50% more effective than it previously was.

If you choose to obtain a Nichirin Blade, your Conjuration will naturally manifest that weapon or any object possessing the same properties by default. Your Transmutation and Enhancement will also transmit the same properties of the Nichirin through your aura.

Unlike standard training methods for increasing and mastering all aspects of Nen, you have the opportunity to achieve the same results simply by applying the same rigorous training found in Breathing Techniques, physical conditioning, and the extreme training regimen of the Hashira.

Finally, through the breathing method, you can recover aura that you have expended on anything. Each breath restores the equivalent of four hours of rest. This means you can maintain your Hatsu indefinitely or increase its power far beyond its normal limits, so long as the aura consumption does not exceed your rate of restoration.
addons.title: Nen Breathing

objects.text:
You have unlocked your Aura and the ability to direct and control it.

This gives you the ability to use your Nen and a solid understanding and grounding in the four major principles, as well as an understanding of advanced Nen techniques, although only at the level of a beginner. You can choose your nature as a Nen user, whether that be an enhancer, a manipulator, or what have you.

You can choose a Nen ability as well as any canon ability, but the conditions and restrictions of said abilities remain. You can create abilities that are powered equal to the Nen sacrificed using it, and this ratio changes with increasing mastery of your Nen skills. By adding conditions and restrictions, the abilities are strengthened beyond what your mastery of Nen or raw supply would otherwise be able to achieve.
objects.title: Nen (Hunter X Hunter)

addons.text: Your power as an Esper has caused an interesting link with your Cursed Energy reserves. The more you improve your skill with psychic powers and the more intense your emotions become, the more refined and stronger your Cursed Energy. This does not increase your reserves but increases your potential with Cursed Energy along with your control of it, allowing you to not only waste less when using your Innate and Learned techniques but also make it so you can continuously grow in ability and beyond.
addons.title: Negative Feedback

addons.text:
Your ability to manipulate the world’s natural energies gave you a crazy but brilliant idea to manipulate the ambient negative energy of the world around you, and succeeded.

This allows you to deduct and enhance the amount of Cursed Energy used for your techniques. The increase is proportional to the amount of negative energy in the surrounding area, with the more living beings that are in your range which is as far as you can sense with natural or Cursed Energy.
addons.title: Sage of Curses

addons.text:
Your connection to the innate chaos magic within you has loosened the limits of your Cursed Energy manipulation.

For starters, your Innate Technique is now more fluid, allowing you to develop more than three techniques, granting you even higher potential.

Your Cursed Energy grows significantly higher the more chaotic a battle becomes, but take note of your control, as your higher reserves make your reserves harder to channel and use.

Overall, your Cursed Energy becomes looser in how you wield it, allowing you to perform new never-before-seen skills with it.
addons.title: Touched by Chaos

addons.text:
Your journey to Hell and back has changed you and irreparably changed the nature of your Cursed Energy, as Hell seems to be chock full of Cursed Energy, rivaled by none.

The effects are undeniable, for the first thing notable is that your Cursed Energy burns all who comes into contact with it, and destabilizes all Cursed Energy that is not similar to Hell's.

That is not it's primary function—no, that's its side effect. Its real function is being able to absorb the Cursed Energy of Hell, allowing you to develop your reserves, with the only limit being that of Hell itself. You do not increase your reserves at a 1:1 rate, it's more so 1:1000.

The speed you absorb Cursed Energy is dependent on your output, as you will take CE in at the same rate. As a side effect, as long as you are in Hell, your body will automatically perform Reverse Cursed Technique due to the intake of excess Cursed Energy.

The final thing you can do is that you can perform a Domain Expansion. This one is a bit unique, as it is not your domain, it is Hell's. By performing this Domain, you bring forth the very Hell you are familiar with. The affects for everyone else though, will not be the same as you.

The CE of Hell will not fuel your enemies, it will burn at them instead, and due to the affect of Hell's CE, Simple Domains can not protect your enemies, or tank it by just using RCT.
addons.title: Domain Expansion: Personalis Infernum

addons.text: You gain the innate Cursed Technique of Suguru Geto, a man Satoru Gojo considered his equal and with whom he shared the title of The Strongest. Your version, due to your magical nature as a curse eater, allows you to conquer similar entities that are close enough to cursed spirits in nature. The type of entity—whether magical, spiritual, or psychic—does not matter as long as you are strong enough to dominate them. Also, unlike Suguru, you can create cursed spirits and cultivate their strength by combining weaker spirits, though they can never become stronger than you. And should you conquer and devour a psychic entity that is similar to a cursed spirit, as mentioned above, you can learn to create psychic entities as well. Finally, you can summon your conquered spirits from any part of your body via shadow portals or within about an arm's length of your position. There is no limit to how many you can summon at a time, nor to how many entities you can hoard with your technique. If you purchase Cage (Jujutsu Kaisen), you will be able to harness the power and abilities of any cursed entity — magical, psychic, or spiritual — under your control by assimilating them; they will offer no resistance due to your dominion over them.
addons.title: Cursed Spirit Manipulation

addons.text:
Unlike most sorcerers, whose cursed energy is limited by their genetics and innate potential, your power is bound only by the depth of your negative emotions.

At base, you possess cursed energy comparable to a Grade 1 sorcerer. As you experience emotional surges, such as intense hate, sorrow, or rage, your cursed energy permanently increases exponentially. However, you do not start with the experience, techniques, or control that a Grade 1 sorcerer would typically have. While your raw cursed energy will grow faster than your control and technique, you can relatively easily keep up with this expansion through consistent training and dedicated refinement.

Due to the sheer amount of cursed energy you have, your body reflexively uses cursed techniques in response to immediate danger, similar to a smaller-scale version of Hakari’s unkillable state. This automatic defense activates without conscious effort and can only deploy either cursed techniques you personally know or simple techniques, such as cursed energy reinforcement, barrier creation, or basic cursed attacks. Complex techniques, Domain Expansions, or Reverse Cursed Technique will not trigger reflexively if you do not personally know them.

Your cursed energy gains the trait of “weight,” making it unnaturally dense and heavy. This weight increases the impact force of your physical and energy-based attacks and makes your cursed energy harder to deflect, neutralize, or erode by others.
addons.title: Negativity Flood

addons.text:
Your upgraded Striker power, Critical Hit!, had already mimicked the Black Flashes of cursed energy—but now it has been absorbed and transformed into a Cursed Technique that allows you to strike Black Flashes at will.

Additionally, any Critical Hit upgrades like Critical Heals or Critical Dodge can Black Flash too.
5 Minute Crit-Man and JACKPOOOT!!! have their effects doubled
addons.title: The Prince of Black Flash

addons.text:
Your Cursed Energy carries a special trait akin to Hakari's Edge or Kashimo's Lightning, through the Concepts you choose to study. This coats your Cursed Energy with an additional layer that makes your strikes hard to defend against, even with reinforced defenses. Unless said defenses carry enough energy to overpower yours, the recipient will always feel the effects of your trait, even if minor.

You have control over how the trait manifests and behaves, as well as evolve them through a deeper understanding of your studied Concepts. For example, a "Sharp" Concept can start with making each punch feel like being stabbed by a knife, and evolve into developing a Cursed Technique based on knives.
addons.title: Cursed Concepts

addons.text:
By combining Soul Weaving with Cursed Energy Manipulation, you gain access to the innate technique of the Cursed Spirit Mahito: Idle Transfiguration.

Idle Transfiguration reshapes the body by altering the soul through cursed energy. Soul Weaving grants mastery over the process. With authority over the soul itself, you no longer rely on intuition, experimentation, or trial-and-error when transfiguring others or yourself.

Guided by Soul Sight, you perceive the exact structure, integrity, and flaws of a soul, allowing deliberate and stable modifications rather than crude or unstable reshaping. You can precisely alter bodies, form limbs, organs, or weapons from the soul, correct soul distortions to restore or perfect damaged forms, and adjust the soul’s imprint to awaken or repair innate Cursed Techniques.

Through Soul Refinement, your own soul is strengthened, stabilized, and resistant to damage, allowing repeated and extreme self-transfiguration without identity erosion or structural collapse. With training, you may freely reshape your body and eventually attain a perfected transfigured state comparable to Mahito’s Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing, though yours is sustainable rather than self-destructive.

When combined with Soul Alteration, Idle Transfiguration extends beyond immediate contact, enabling delayed activation, long-term maintenance, and composite or reinforced modifications—capabilities that Mahito never demonstrates due to his lack of structured soul mastery.
addons.title: Idle Transfiguration

addons.text:
You have preserved and inherited the most extraordinary qualities in the mastery of puppets. Through the combination of the legacy of Kokichi Muta and Sasori of the Red Sands.

You are no longer limited to infusing cursed energy or using threads to control puppets, people, and any object within your reach. You can now, within the wide range of a city, control everything within its influence. Although you can infuse cursed energy or threads as an alternative form of control, and make the enemy believe that you have a supposed limitation or weakness.

Your multitasking ability and the capacity to take direct possession of the puppets and anything you control have allowed you to become a pseudo-hive entity. Every element you control is under your iron command.

While you can master such puppet manipulation with a healthy and strong body, even an organic one, you have the option of becoming a cursed corpse with total autonomy, either in puppet form or a humanoid mechanical body. In this way, you can persist in your existence as long as there is at least one puppet that harbors your soul.

Last but not least, your mastery in puppet creation extends to total compatibility with any technological power you possess. It is now within your reach to recreate Mechamaru Absolute Mode or a much better version.
addons.title: Mechamaru Red

addons.text:
You are now a veritable cannon. Your cursed energy has influence (Blaster/Mover) Cannoneer and turned it into the innate technique, Cursed Energy Discharge. Your cursed energy output is now the greatest ever recorded.

You can now unleash beams of cursed energy without risking physical backlash or death such as a barrage of homing blasts that track your opponent or a single condensed strike capable of leveling several city blocks.
