However, there is a trade-off: your energy beams now draw directly from your cursed energy reserves, and require a charge to reach their full power. Using all the cursed energy granted by Curse Energy Manipulation and a few second charge, a single blast can severely harm an Endbringer if it hits them. With even greater cursed energy reserves, your output can scale to insane levels.

This also allows you to amplify the cursed energy output of any ability that relies on cursed energy, such as other cursed techniques, Cursed Energy Reinforcement, Barriers, Simple Domains, and Reverse Cursed Technique through channeling additional cursed energy into them. Doing so can even bypass some of their limitations, provided you are willing to expend the necessary energy.
addons.title: Cursed Energy Discharge

addons.text:
The fusion of your Cursed Energy with Shaker/Breaker Miracles has granted you an enhanced version of Haruta Shigemo’s cursed technique: Miracles.

In addition to gaining one charge per day, you can accumulate extra charges by witnessing small, everyday “miracles”. These miracles are minor yet unlikely strokes of luck—such as noticing all the same digits on a clock, or unexpectedly finding loose change on the ground. As you build up charges, they will subtly influence your luck, causing fortunate outcomes to occur more frequently. With seven charges, these likely luck events will happen more often. While you cannot manually control when or how these events happen, they will trigger more frequently when your life is in danger. You have an option to have these marks to appear under your eyes just like with Haruta Shiegmo.

This cursed technique can activate itself subconsciously when you face lethal danger, automatically consuming one to three stored charges to ensure your survival based on the severity of the threat. Unlike Haruta Shigemo, you retain awareness of your remaining charges and when they are expended, whether consciously or instinctively.

You can initially store up to seven charges. This limit increases as your power, control, and proficiency as a jujutsu sorcerer grows.
addons.title: Miraculous Marks

addons.text:
You have acquired the innate cursed technique of the mercenary who wears a paper bag over his face. However, it has diverged from its original version by merging with the mental ability Simulacrum.

You are no longer limited to creating a single simulacrum; you can now create five simulacrums and perfect copies of yourself. This includes your mental qualities, elevating you into a nascent hive mind. The more you master the Simulacrum ability, the stronger your hive-mind state becomes. Additionally, since they are perfect copies of yourself, you also become virtually eternal as long as at least one copy of you exists.

The simulacrums can now exist independently of your own existence, whether you are alive or dead, and they are real enough to possess their own soul and organic matter. They are no longer semi-solid energy avatars, but fully real bodies.

Through the link that allows you to absorb the experiences gained by your simulacrums when they are destroyed, you now also receive any gains they achieved independently that would otherwise not have been possible.

And from the original innate cursed technique that allowed you to swap the position of your real body with your copies, it is now also possible to perform position swaps between the simulacrums themselves. As such, this has no distance limit, at least within the same dimension.
addons.title: Cursed Clone

addons.text:
You are the second person to awaken the innate cursed technique, aside from Ogami, who caused her own death through overestimation and arrogance: Spiritism.

This ability consists of two parts to invoke an entity and manifest it either through your own body or through a willing volunteer who serves as the vessel for the invoked entity.

Flesh Session: This involves using the DNA of a deceased entity or directly using its corpse. The invoked entity lacks its own consciousness and only provides the information that composed its body, including its powers and muscle memory. The vessel can use these as naturally as if they were their own body. It does not grant the knowledge the entity possessed. For example, manifesting an ancient warrior allows you to adopt their martial skills, but invoking a scientist does not guarantee obtaining the knowledge they studied throughout their life.

Soul Session: This involves using energy or anything that spiritually binds the entity you wish to invoke. Unlike the Flesh Session, this does invoke its consciousness and the knowledge it possesses. However, it carries the risk that if you do not have a strong will or soul, you will be consumed by the invoked entity itself. Its advantage is that the qualities the entity possessed in life are doubled.

With the help of Yokai Vessel, you can carry out the Soul Session without fear of being consumed. You can even acquire a limited shapeshifting ability tied to the souls you have invoked and stored within your body through Soul Garden. Unlike the original technique, you can adopt their knowledge and abilities without the need to incarnate the invoked entity.
addons.title: Cursed Spiritism

addons.text: You've inherited all applications of the Blood Manipulation Technique. From the Kamo clan’s Piercing Blood, Flowing Red Scale, and Convergence, to Choso’s Blood Meteorite, Blood Edge, Supernova, and more. However, due to your experience in Blood Magic, the technique has transcended its limits. The drawback of losing too much blood is no longer a concern, since you can now convert Cursed Energy into blood, with the same proficiency as a Death Painting like Choso. Making the creation of new applications and pushing them to their limits even easier. This also applies to your rituals, where you can offer Cursed Energy instead of blood. You can also perform a unique version of Binding Vows by giving up a certain amount of Cursed Energy and/or your own blood. These are temporary and scale with how much you've sacrificed, as well as the conditions you've set. Such as giving up one application to strengthen another, preventing the use of Blood Magic in exchange for great physical prowess, fulfilling criteria to receive a divination into the future, etc. Note: Should you possess the Sanguimancy of the Elders Addon, your eldritch nature will further expand the scope of Cursed Energy, Blood Manipulation, and Binding Vows.
addons.title: Kamo Heritage

addons.text: ”From now on, all three of them, have reached 120% of their latent potential” Where other sorcerers must reach the flow state to perform at their best, you can do so at will by drawing out your latent potential. With unwavering focus, willpower, determination, breakthroughs, or even the love of combat allowing you to ascend beyond the limits of it. Such as the case with Yuji Itadori, Aoi Todo, and Mahito. As a base, drawing out your potential allows you to amplify your own Cursed Energy. Multiplying its potency for greater physical reinforcement, more durable barriers, a wider Simple Domain, stronger Domain Amplification, etc. Your Cursed Techniques can also be amplified into Maximum Techniques, bringing out the absolute pinnacle of their power, and Maximum Output to fuel them with the highest amount of Cursed Energy possible. You can regulate the total power of these amplifiers, able to go from a 30% Output to a Maximum 100% Technique, and push it even further to 120% and beyond with simple intent. This is at its most potent and seamless in the midst of battle, especially long ones, where your mind and body will instinctively amplify your Cursed Energy or Techniques at the perfect moment, with the exact amount needed. Increasing in scale and potency as you continue, and naturally pushing beyond your current limits, both in your strengths and any areas you are lacking. As a side effect of this, your Cursed Energy Reserves have increased and can grow over time. You start with ten times the reserves of an average sorcerer. Any gains made from this are permanent.
addons.title: Maximum Potential

addons.text: You gain the Innate Technique of Fumihiko Takaba—Comedian. By itself, this would make you a low end reality warper and pseudo Toon Force character by manifesting whatever you think is funny, as long as you remain confident in your ability to be funny. However, due to your sheer ability in comedy and awareness of it, you’ve transcended the technique beyond its limits. You instinctively know many, many ways to use the technique both in and out of combat, and can bring every single one of them to its absolute potential. As well as how to chain your jokes into a snowball of chaos to rain on your opponent, embarrass them into shedding tears, confuse them into submission, or even use dark humor to break their will. The only limit to what you can do is your own wits, creativity, and adaptability. As of now, you can wield the technique at the same potency as Takaba himself.
addons.title: Comedian

addons.text:
You have acquired the ability to replicate any cursed tool revealed or hinted at throughout the Jujutsu Kaisen series.

In addition to this, you possess the basic knowledge required to create new cursed tools, but only using materials you already possess, as well as Cursed Energy and Cursed Spirits. You cannot combine different properties into a single item.

The effect you can grant to your creations depends directly on the nature of the Cursed Spirit used or the specific nature of your Cursed Energy. For example, if you were to use Jogo, a special-grade entity with volcanic powers, you could grant the artifact an effect derived from his innate cursed technique or Domain Expansion. The same would apply if you used your own Cursed Energy, whether due to a special nature or based on your own innate cursed technique.

Depending on your level of skill in this craft, the quality of your creations may improve or degrade accordingly. You can also apply this craftsmanship using any entity similar to a Cursed Spirit and any supernatural energy with unique properties.
addons.title: Cursed Artifacts

addons.text:
You gain access to the inherited cursed technique of the Inumaki Clan, Cursed Speech. However, it has mutated after merging with the heritage of a Master of Words.

You no longer suffer the physical strain on your throat with each use of your cursed technique. Instead, you can redirect that burden through manifested words, which appear as primordial runes or symbols. You are still limited by your own skill and the amount of cursed energy you possess.

These manifested words can be engraved onto any target or even appear suspended in the air. They can also be activated at your will without speaking or producing sound. You are no longer restricted to the Ja-no-Me-to-Kiba seal any word in any language, or even symbolic scripts, can serve as your medium.

Depending on your mastery, you can go beyond producing a single word per use. You may generate long, complex sentences carrying great power and multiple layered effects depending on your intent. You can also modify their potency, range, and manage multiple manifested words and spoken phrases simultaneously.

For example: “Fireball, burn my enemies with infernal flames, yet protect and heal my allies with the fire of the phoenix.” This allows you to produce a phenomenon that perfectly matches the first half of the sentence, while the second half manifests through your runic words. However, the greater the complexity and power, the higher the cursed energy cost.
addons.title: Divine Word

addons.text:
You are the third person to inherit the innate cursed technique: Projection.

With the help of Model Creator, you are able to perceive or alter your view of the world in FPS (frames per second) with little effort. Meanwhile, through the use of Thousand Image Defense, you are able to predict and form a sequence of FPS of all possible movements a target is capable of performing.

In this way, you can greatly alleviate the mental burden of using this technique. Best of all, you can now surpass the 24 FPS limit, making you faster and granting greater reach to affect the environment with your technique.

Through the inherent properties of Model Creator, you can now affect intangible things or phenomena, such as electronics, spells, and anything beyond physical contact. And since it is capable of simulating anything, it also grants the secondary effect of storing anything within a frame, ignoring weight and size while preserving its properties for long periods, as long as you infuse it with any type of energy you possess to keep it stored.

If you possess Reverse Cursed Technique, you can apply the opposite effects of your techniques to your targets. For example, increasing a target’s FPS would make them slower and take longer to react to external stimuli, while you yourself would be able to reach Mach speeds.
addons.title: Cursed Film

addons.text:
You gain the cursed technique of the special-grade cursed spirit Ganesha-Obstacle Removal. As the name suggests, this technique allows the user to target anything that they identify as a hindrance to their immediate goals and remove it. It does so by entangling with the concept of the thing being identified as an obstacle and changing its properties into those of something that isn’t an obstacle.

For example, when the user of this technique was faced with a squad of trained soldiers who barred their path, Obstacle Removal teleported all of them into the air outside the building and let them fall to their deaths. By identifying the space between two points as an obstacle to travelling between them, Obstacle Removal can open a wormhole bridging the gap. Against an enemy sorcerer Obstacle Removal can negate their technique as an obstacle to defeating them. There are practically an infinite number of ways Obstacle Removal can work.

Each obstacle removed requires a separate use of this technique. To be a valid target for the technique the target must be definable by the user as one discrete and concrete idea, so “this squad of soldiers” or “this wall” are valid targets but “anyone who wishes me harm” or “whatever all that is” are not. The greater the magnitude of the obstacle being eliminated the more cursed energy this consumes.
addons.title: Obstacle Removal

addons.text:
Your bond with the cursed spirit of your ring deepens to the point of mutual reverence, alongside gaining the Innate Technique of Yuta Okkotsu—Copy. When your spirit devours the body part(s) of a Sorcerer, you will gain a duplicate of their Cursed Technique, but the more powerful said Technique is, the more vital said body parts must be to copy it. 

You can hold an unlimited number of Copied Techniques, but can only use them for a limited number of times. How many will be dependent on the value of the body part and the power of the Technique. If the entire body has been cannibalised, you gain permanent access to the Copied Technique, which can be used at anytime regardless of whether your spirit is fully manifested or not. There is also no time limit for how long they can stay manifested. 

Depending on your cursed spirit, you may have a different mechanic for Copy. Such as Mahoraga needing to observe the Technique at least once, Mahito needing to touch the Sorcerer's soul, or Hanami needing to place a bud on the Sorcerer.

Note: Copy also works on those considered equivalents to or different from Jujutsu Sorcerers, such as Hunters from RWBY, Shinigami from Bleach, or Shinobi from Naruto. The Copied Techniques will be translated as any one ability or technique the target is capable of, or a general grabbag of abilities, which you can choose upon fulfilling the conditions for Copy.
addons.title: Okkotsu Heritage
Idle Death Gamble
addons.text: ”For the next 4 minutes and 11 seconds… Hakari is effectively immortal.” You gain the Innate Technique and Domain Expansion of Kinji Hakari—Private Pure Love Train and Idle Death Gamble. The first allows you conjure visual indicators of a pachinko game or parts of a train for offensive and defensive purposes. Such as giant versions of the gates as a shield or to be thrown towards a target, or the pinball as a projectile. The second allows you to create an environment to host the game itself. However, due to that pachinko machine being within your soul, you can activate it instantly, with no need for a hand sign or the 0.2 second start up like Hakari. Once activated, your odds of landing a jackpot now become 1 in 239. With a successful jackpot granting you INFINITE Cursed Energy, and causing your body to use Reversed Cursed Technique automatically, subconsciously healing any injury the instant it’s inflicted on you. Even if you never learned it. On top of the potential one hundred fold boost to your abilities. These effects last for a duration based on when you landed a jackpot. With your first try granting 10 minutes, your second halving it to 5, and an anytime after that at exactly 4 minutes and 11 seconds. After the effect ends, your Technique is replenished, allowing you to repeat this process again, but your chances become reset. Finally, you can assign any song you wish to play after landing a jackpot, either in your head or for all present to hear.

addons.title: Sky Manipulation
addons.text:
You gain the Innate Technique of Takako Uro—Sky Manipulation. Allowing you to bend space in ways akin to how a lens creates distortion, by grabbing the literal fabric of space as you would a physical surface. Through this, you can distort the laws of motion and physics to cause various effects to the environment, yourself, others, or objects that occupy space.

For example, you can cause an object going in a straight line to travel through all sorts of directions as if it was natural. A beam of energy fired at you can be sent back to sender by changing its trajectory. Turn the very ground you stand on into a bedsheet you can both flap and tear off, and the laws of physics will cause the logical conclusion of such absurdity.

However, by honing your own Space Manipulation ability, you have more ways to manipulate the "sky". Such as by cutting a portion of it to close distance, pulling it to force an object still, tearing it to rip what's caught in half, and much more.

You also gain Uro's Extension Technique: Thin Ice Breaker, which turns space into a solid surface you can then break like glass to cause a burst of concussive force for offense, a barrier for defense, and more. As well as her Domain Expansion, which you can define to your liking.

addons.title: Cursed Saint
addons.text:
You have inherited Angel's innate cursed technique, Extinguishment, from the Heian Era after receiving Holy Light into your soul. However, upon mixing with Cursed Energy, the two suddenly reacted and mutated. As a result, you have gained new abilities and enhancements in the process.

The base power of the innate cursed technique can now be applied to things beyond evil. From nullifying the powers of a magical beast to the divinity of a god. It can even nullify sacred powers or anything of a similar alignment; there is no bias or exception. The more powerful the opposition, the less effective the technique becomes and the more energy it will require to succeed.

Your extension technique, Jacob's Ladder, can transmit the same effect through your light manipulation and anything you imbue with sacred power. For example, holy water can now possess the same effectiveness as if you had unleashed the technique directly.

The wings of Angel's incarnation and your Holy Light have allowed you to partially access the physiology of an Angel from the DxD universe. This turns you into a special kind of hybrid, similar to Choso. This means you can convert your Cursed Energy into Holy Light and vice versa, thereby providing you with a doubled reserve of power. You also gain half of the extraordinary capabilities of this physiology. If you obtain the Angel (High School DxD) upgrade, your abilities and power will be completely doubled.

Through Holy Light, your mastery and affinity with Reverse Cursed Technique will become as natural as your mastery over Cursed Energy. You will also be capable of generating Positive Energy.

addons.title: Moon Dregs
addons.text:
You gain the Innate Technique of Junpei Yoshino—Poison. Due to your own talent in making poisons, you've transcended the technique beyond its limits.

You can convert Cursed Energy into any mundane and exotic poisons, as well as imbue your Cursed Energy with the properties of your poisons. Furthermore, you can manipulate these poisons with far more ease, precision, fluidity and efficiency. From simple projectiles, constructs, coating yourself in armor, weapons, and then some. 

You can also have a Shikigami to store and deploy these poisons, as well as fight alongside you. You may choose to have Junpei's jellyfish shikigami, Moon Dreggs, or create one of your own design.

addons.title: Deadly Sentencing
addons.text: You gain the Innate Technique and Domain Expansion of Hiromi Higuruma—Judgeman and Deadly Sentencing. It retains the same abilities as your Judge and Executioner power, with the following changes: 1. You can bring multiple targets into the courtroom instead of just one. 2. You can have a shikigami of your own design to assist you during prosecution, or any other role within the courtroom. It can also assist you outside of it, both in and out of battle. 3. You gain an additional ability to use within and outside the courtroom called, the Executioner's Sword. It takes the form of any sword you wish, and without exception, will kill anything it cuts. But can only be summoned if the situation deems it absolutely necessary. Such as when facing an entity of primordial evil, or if the crimes of a target warrant the death penalty. 4. If the prosecution is successful, you can inflict an additional punishment on the target of equal or less severity in relation to their list of crimes. 5. Once within the domain, you can use one of your courtroom abilities a second time.

addons.title: Cursed Programming
addons.text: Cursed Energy is intrinsically linked with the soul, while the soul reflects the body, and vice versa. These are closely connected, yet Sorcerers, unable to fully take on this undiscovered yet essential insight, focus on the fundamentals and their Cursed Techniques. Through the Hercules Method, you have gained the enlightened realization of how to use the Hercules Method’s unification of the self and the properties of Cursed Energy to transform yourself into a new breed of Jujutsu Sorcerer, one who is made for a single absolute purpose: to become the ultimate killing machine. Using the Hercules Method to unify your mind, body, and soul, you’re capable of feats of fine CE control, feeling as an extension of yourself, that will leave a Six Eyes user looking you in the eye and complimenting you as an equal. In detail, you become a prodigy in CE manipulation at a micro- and macro-scale, where your Cursed Energy can “remember” and autonomously maintain raw CE manipulation, as well as “program” it to finely control it on a grand scale, leaving instructions for your CE to “remember” in any circumstances which can be set to trigger as complex programs to be executed with a thought or run subconsciously for as long as you have enough CE. Examples are improving Reinforcement through one’s body by “programming” CE to naturally suffuse your cells at the microscopic level, creating a deeper, stronger and vastly more energy efficient level of enhancement to your physical as well as mental abilities, creating a CE “bomb” by putting an explosive “program” to one’s CE, replicating Curses Techniques with enough understanding of their underlying or symbolic nature, heal your body through CE alone via Reinforcement sub-programming focused on tissue repair getting closer in discovering Reverse Cursed Technique and, once you discover it, automating the conversion process to continuously regenerate and identify potential injuries are among the many exploits your Method is capable with Cursed Energy.

objects.text:
This is a profound practice, that involves harnessing and controlling the primordial energy known as cursed energy, which is intrinsically linked to the existence of curses—negative and malevolent spirits that inflict harm and misfortune upon humans.

The process of manipulating this energy involves gathering it from the environment or within oneself and then directing it towards a specific objective. This process necessitates a resolute will, unwavering focus, and a deep understanding of the foundational principles that govern cursed energy manipulation. By tapping into its reserves, you gain the ability to employ it for a multitude of purposes, encompassing both offensive and defensive techniques. Which includes exorcism, erecting protective barriers, and augmenting your physical attributes to transcend the boundaries of the natural world, and much more.

However cursed energy manipulation is not without its risks. Improper handling or excessive use of it can have detrimental effects on you, potentially leading to physical and mental deterioration.

Picking this would imprint the foundations and intricacies of cursed energy manipulation in your mind, you gain a comprehensive understanding of this energy and its practice. However, the journey to mastery extends beyond the imparted knowledge. The responsibility for further exploration and refinement rests solely upon you.
objects.title: Cursed Energy Manipulation (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
Your body has adapted to act as a complete support framework for the Six Eyes. Instead of concentrating strain in the mind, its perception and efficiency are distributed throughout your physiology, You no longer will suffer any strain using the eyes.

You can safely push the Six Eyes beyond its former limits, increasing duration, precision, and intensity without suffering the drawbacks that would normally follow.

This does not break the rules governing supernatural systems. It refines how well you function within them, ensuring that growth is stable, controlled, and limited only by how far your body can adapt.
addons.title: All-Encompassing Six Eyes

addons.text:
With the power to grow your own soul, your usage of the Six Eyes has risen beyond what any thought possible.

Your efficiency when using any form of supernatural energy becomes absolutely perfect, and your progress in mastering any supernatural art rises to the level of a genius. You will see, perceive, and understand everything in a way no one else possibly could. For example, simply watching someone perform a spell or technique will allow you to replicate it.

This phenomenon doesn’t provide the theory or the foundation behind what you learn, and it’s not an absolute rule-breaker. You still have to obey the rules and limitations of any techniques you use. However, any price or risk that a given method imposes on you will be reduced to a minimum or adjusted. Nothing can stop you now, it’s simply a matter of time.

If you possess Free Form Style, then your efficiency, control, and comprehension become equivalent to those of an extremely advanced machine. However, the sheer volume of information and complexity can overwhelm you, requiring training and strengthening of your soul to withstand.
addons.title: Phenomenal Efficiency

objects.text:
The Eyes represent a rare ocular jujutsu that endows you with extraordinary perception and enables the fullest utilization of any supernatural energy technique in your arsenal.

These eyes serve as the key to unlocking the maximum potential for Limitless, propelling your mastery over it to unprecedented heights. They provide vast perception and immense brain processing power, allowing you to precisely manipulate the sophisticated powers of the Limitless down to an atomic level. Additionally, they facilitate highly efficient processing of supernatural energy, ensuring a near-impossibility of depletion.

The mental prowess of the Six Eyes distorts time, expanding a single moment in reality into a considerable span within your mind. This ability synergizes with enhanced sight, enabling instant analysis and calculation of positions within your entire field of view. You possess the capacity to discern distinct figures within a vast range of several kilometers. You can also see and sense energies in extreme detail.

However, the heightened ability of these eyes to perceive intricate details imposes significant strain and fatigue on the brain. It is highly recommended to wear a blindfold to mitigate these drawbacks. Even with a blindfold, the eyes continue to function akin to a high-resolution camera.
objects.title: The Six Eyes (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
Through Post-Mortem Nen, you can become a pseudo-cursed spirit one made entirely of Nen which makes you immune to the positive energy generated by Reverse Cursed Technique and any type of exorcism. You can also feed on Nen as a secondary source of sustenance and evolution.

The innate cursed techniques and Hatsu you possess will be based on the legend or fear associated with you. If you are someone who causes natural disasters, the negative emotions of the human collective or even the environment itself will give rise to a power capable of controlling volcanoes like Jogo or water like Dagon.

Alternatively, through the fundamentals of Nen, you can naturally develop a power of your choosing using those emotions as fuel for its creation, without risking the need to make vows or accept the limitations that usually accompany Hatsu.

Your appearance will no longer be malevolent, as you will still be the human you were before. You can even resist or eliminate the urge to instill terror in the innocent. However, adopting your cursed spirit appearance can boost your powers to twice what they were before.

Over time, your original body will gradually be reconstructed, and the more energy you invest in it, the less time it will take. However, the stronger you are, the longer the process will take to fully return you to your pre-death state. This makes you an immortal being as long as your soul remains intact.
addons.title: Cursed Post-Mortem

addons.text:
You've become a hybrid between a Cursed Spirit and a Human, like Yuji Itadori, Choso, and the other Cursed Wombs or Death Paintings. However, you are not a creation of Kenjaku, and even if you were, you'd far exceed his expectations.

You have the complete package of physical ability, intellect, and adaptability from humans as well as the power of a Cursed Spirit and instinctive understanding of Cursed Energy. Your base instinct to inflict suffering has vanished, replaced by your own sense of self. This allows you to wield your powers with newfound clarity and understanding, blend into human society, and grow from the avenues provided by both Sorcerers and Curses. 

You also possess the traits of all the Death Paintings, such as poisonous blood, the ability to convert your Cursed Energy into blood or any other substance that fuels your Technique, have ageless immortality, and can form a telepathic bond with a select few individuals. Regardless of whether they're related to you or not.

You can also become "invisible" at will, by shifting into your Cursed Spirit form, hide any trace of Cursed Energy within your Human form, or shift freely between both in your hybrid form.
addons.title: Cursed Womb (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: You are naturally strong enough to destroy walls and fast enough to outspeed a car. You regenerate quickly and cannot be killed without the use of esoteric means like Cursed Energy. You can sense local humans, groups of humans, and local hotbeds of cursed energy/negative emotions. You are made of and therefore can use Cursed Energy instinctively, basic abilities will come to you naturally and special techniques will come as you grow more powerful. You grow stronger/more powerful when in proximity to a place of great negative emotion like schools, prisons and cemeteries, etc. You feed on these energies like a parasite and you can increase the levels of these emotions through your actions and presence causing a positive feedback loop, for you at least. Downsides include a monstrous appearance, a dislike of humans and a want to cause them suffering, and that you are completely invisible to the non-enhanced which also means all your actions will be written off as something else if small or ghosts and hysteria if large.
objects.title: Cursed Spirit (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text: Stands normally possess a limit to how far they can be away from their user, as they are tethered to the one who wields them. However, due to your ability of Astral Projection, your Stand is now no longer limited in range; it can go practically any direction with any amount of distance between the two of you and still be at full power and strength. This does not eliminate the weakness of being physically linked, as you still receive any damage that is inflicted upon your Stand. However, now that your Stand can be far away from you, it allows you to ambush unsuspecting enemies.
addons.title: No Strings on Me

addons.text: Your Stand is abnormal; normally, a Stand, when damaged, will share the damage done to it with its user. Your Stand is similar to other Stands, like Black Sabbath, in that any damage done to it is not shared with you. This does not eliminate the damage to the Stand itself, but eliminates the danger of dying should your Stand be damaged beyond repair for any normal Stand User, which would end in death to the user; however, should this happen, your Stand will enter a period of time in which it repairs itself and cannot be used.
addons.title: Only a Stand!

addons.text:
Through the bonds you create with people, you can do more than summon a Persona; you can form new, unique Stands based on the personality of the person you make a bond with, gaining what would have been the Stand they would have been granted if they had been pierced with a Stand Arrow and acquired a Stand. The stronger the bond you have with the individual, the stronger the Stand will become.

In typical JoJo fashion, your method of creating bonds with people is no longer limited to just having a meaningful relationship with someone. Through fighting someone, you can increase your bond with them; gaining a full bond should you beat them.
addons.title: Same Stand as ____!
Inner Stand
addons.text: Your Inner Beast becomes your Stand, and as a result, is much more unique compared to other Stands. It can manifest as both a spiritual and physical entity, begins with greater potential and versatility in its powers, and full autonomy over itself. It isn't limited to one form like most Stands, instead able to shapeshift into various ones—though it cannot gain the powers of other Stands this way, only take their shape. Your Stand isn't simply an avatar of your power, it's all of your innate power and potential fully realized and optimized. You don't command your Stand, you work together alongside it in perfect sync. You don't simply train your Stand, it evolves alongside you, gaining new abilities and developing new applications for them from various circumstances. If you took Upgrades like Stand Requiem or Evolutionary Stand, it develops even more nuances on top of the benefits established by them. Even then, it can naturally reach such heights overtime.

objects.text:
It seems like you were shot with a strange Arrow, because you have gained a Stand, a manifestation of your life energy as a visualization of your psyche! It fits you and will likely integrate and hold similar mechanics to other powers you may have, but be warned, if you're weak-willed, this very well could kill you. Of course, your descendants will also have a Stand, and the same dangers apply to them, plus the fated attraction of Stand Users.

Generally speaking, it's said that only a Stand can beat other Stands since the only thing known to affect Stands would be other Stands, but in truth, that's not entirely the case. High-level powers like Scion's Stilling and Sting are actually able to affect Stands despite their ghost-like nature due to their own esoteric nature.

Note: You may choose to have any canon Stand shown throughout the series, design one of your own creation, or leave what it is up to chance. Regardless of choice, your Stand still fits you as if you were it's original user, or you will have an innate understanding of it.
objects.title: Stand (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

addons.text:
Combining your touki with chakra infused by the element you have affinity for allows you to form an elemental cloak. Your aura will change colour based on your affinity and enhance it based on the element. Lightning would massively boost the speed enhancement, while earth affinity would make its defensive properties much more robust.

Your elemental cloak will also change your aura properties, making your Touki-enhanced attacks burn, cut, shock, bruise, or stick, depending on your element.

If you have access to elemental Kekkei Genkai, then it can also be used as a cloak, massively increasing its general power boost.
addons.title: Elemental Touki Cloak

addons.text:
You gained the ability to harness cursed energy fused with your aura without descending to madness. This will make your combined powers more potent, and because of the duality of your energy, the Reverse Curse Technique becomes much easier to achieve and will allow you to convert cursed energy directly into life-force. When more cursed energy is mixed into your aura, its colour becomes darker.

Finally, because of the more flexible nature of Touki, it allows you to manipulate the texture of your own mixed aura, like giving it a sharp or rough texture.
addons.title: Cursed Aura

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use a basic form of lifeforce manipulation, also called fighting spirit, often achieved through sheer physical training or by learning it by practicing Senjutsu.

Touki is an external manifestation of lifeforce in the form of a white aura wrapped around the user, amplifying their offence, defence, and speed. Releasing high amounts of Touki can generate wind pressure and crack the ground around the user. At advanced mastery, it can also be channelled through weapons, disperse attacks, cause massive shockwaves, or even be used as a ranged projectile.

The natural colour of the aura changes when combined with other powers.

Overconsumption of your lifeforce can cause permanent harm to the user’s lifespan, which requires specialized healing to restore.
objects.title: Touki (High School DxD)

addons.text:
Your Senjutsu enables you to forgo hand signs for molding your chakra in favour of using highly efficient magic circles, which, when sufficiently practiced, enable you to use ninjutsu techniques in a near instant.

As chakra is also based on your own life force, both your reserves are combined, which can be used interchangeably for both systems.

You also become a natural sensor-type ninja, as it’s a basic Senjutsu technique.
addons.title: Sennin

addons.text:
You will gain access to the racial power exclusive to the Nekomata in the world of DxD, called Kasha. It can be used to summon spiritual flame-covered wheels said to be able to lure the dead to the other world.

A skilled enough Senjutsu user can imbue it with the power of purification, turning dark beings like vampires to ashes in contact, and it will even affect creatures who overcame their racial weaknesses, as the flames won't stop burning until they change the reason and principle of their existence. It can be used in conjunction with other sealing techniques to empower them.

This will also give access to all the abilities the Nekomata native to the DxD world have.
addons.title: Kasha

addons.text: Your skill and talent in utilizing life force are prodigious. You possess a genius-level intuition for senjutsu. Your body is inherently blessed with enormous amounts of life force. With time and effort, you will be able to achieve Sagehood, and your potential could allow you to surpass even Sun Wukong himself.
addons.title: Aspiring Sage

objects.text:
Senjutsu is the power to sense and control the flow of life force in living beings.

It can deal interior damage to others by disrupting or severing the life force of their opponent's, and it is also capable of bypassing conventional defences, preventing others from using their own abilities, and forcefully putting others to sleep. It can also be used to seal away other beings, and advanced users could even master esoteric techniques like increasing the luck of others by controlling the flow of their life force or to grow older temporarily, gaining access to powers that would only be available in a more matured state.

It can be used to remove curses, poisons, diseases, or just bolster their life force for a regenerative healing effect. Meanwhile, it's not the best at rapid healing, but it's capable of healing esoteric damages like restoring lost lifespan or otherwise hard-to-detect hidden injuries.

It also gives the user the ability to sense and perceive life force, which, even at the most basic level, allows for locating living beings and giving a basic read of their general wellbeing. At advanced levels, to sense the presence of Sacred Gears in people or read the movements of others just from their aura.

Senjutsu heavily relies on an understanding of nature, so most of the techniques are related to it, like manipulation of mud, earth, and plants, but it struggles with manipulation of the artificial.
objects.title: Senjutsu (High School DxD)

addons.text: You gain the knowledge and expertise to produce the basic weapons used by exorcists, including the light gun and the retractable light swords. These basics also serve as a great foundation to experiment and learn how to make more advanced blessed tools and weaponry, allowing the creation of real holy swords with enough practice.
addons.title: Light Weaponry

addons.text:
Your skill with Touki allows the Holy Light to flow directly through your life force, transforming it from an external power into an extension of your very spirit. 

Holy energy can be infused into your Touki to dramatically enhance your physical abilities, empower every strike with purifying force, and naturally reinforce your body against both physical and supernatural attacks. 

Techniques that combine the two become faster, more efficient, and far more devastating, allowing even unarmed blows to emulate the legendary Holy Fist. 

As your Touki grows stronger, so too does your ability to shape and project Holy Light, creating radiant shockwaves, barriers, and weapon techniques that seamlessly blend martial prowess with divine power. Your skill with Touki allows the Holy Light to flow directly through your life force, transforming it from an external power into an extension of your very spirit.
addons.title: Radiant Spirit

addons.text:
Your understanding of Senjutsu reveals the Holy Light as a force that flows through all living things, greatly expanding its mystical applications. 

By guiding divine power through the currents of life force, your blessings, exorcisms, and healing become more potent and precise, capable of mending spiritual wounds, restoring damaged vitality, and purifying even deeply rooted curses, corruption, and malignant influences. 

You can perceive distortions in the flow of life, allowing you to instinctively identify unclean spirits, hidden curses, and beings tainted by darkness. 

As your mastery grows, you learn to harmonize Holy Light with the natural world itself, sanctifying forests, rivers, and sacred grounds, weaving miracles into nature, and developing entirely new techniques that unite divine radiance with the life force permeating creation.
addons.title: Sage of Holy Light

objects.text:
You obtain the power to wield the Holy Light, which is a part of the divine power system governing divine protection, mercy, and miracles, making it possible to practice exorcism, wield and grant blessings, and even sanctify objects like holy water and crosses. Your power is especially effective against dark beings like devils, fallen angels, and vampires.

This also gives you a strong holy factor, which makes you a naturally talented wielder of all kinds of holy weapons, and experienced users could even master the legendary Holy Fist technique by undergoing rigorous and constant training.

Of course, the Holy Light is not limited to using weapons and rituals; you can also fire off blasts of the Holy Power, and with sufficient mastery, you might even form the light into much more deadly projectiles like the Angel’s spear of light.

Your talent and affinity for the element allow you to tap into other power systems as long as they are connected to the light. And the holy element and light element can also be wielded and recombined separately, which can be used to master powers like holy lightning, holy fire, or even pure light manipulation.

You will not need to worship or believe in the Christian God to wield this power, and the light will not abandon you even as a dark being.
objects.title: Holy Light (High School DxD)

addons.text:
You now have an affinity with and the ability to percieve and interact with Duel Monster Spirits. By default, the spirits within your chosen deck will have a friendly disposition towards you regardless of the cards in question, though they cannot yet manifest as a spirit in the real world. To do so, you will need to forge a deep bond with one or more of these Duel Spirits, these spirits are called Spirit Partners.

If you have a two-star or below monster in your deck, you can start with one such monster as a Spirit Partner, them able to manifest when needed and help you in the real world. As an example, a Spirit Partner at their peak and with a high enough level could shield you from a powerful attack when played as a monster card outside of a duel, while the lower leveled one you start with could help you gain insight as to what someone else is thinking or in locating other people.

Normally, only the person a Spirit Partner is partnered with can see them, and if they don't speak your language you can understand them implicitly without issue.
addons.title: Spirit Duelist

objects.text:
In games of chance, you now possess the seemingly mystical ability to obtain the best result needed for a situation whether that be a max roll on a d20, or drawing just the right card when you most need it. This ability isn't infallible however, as it is fueled by your faith and belief in the medium you're expressing it through, such as having a lucky die or believing in the capability of your deck winning a duel.

While it can work in most situations, this ability becomes much more difficult to utilize in activities that are just for fun with no stakes, and likewise would become incredibly easy to use in situations with high stakes, though it is rare for it to work more than once or twice in a single instance of what it's being used for.
objects.title: Heart of the Cards (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

addons.text:
With your uncanny, universal aptitude for acquiring and processing energy, the powers you once depended on as external catalysts for transformation can now fully fuse into your being. No longer reliant on outside sources, you now generate these energies internally—with nothing more than a single transformation, you can produce more of the energy required for future transformations.

This offers more than just independence. By summoning the distinct energies you’ve encountered and internalized, you can combine, contrast, and hybridize their forces, triggering enhanced reactions born from compatibility or conflict. Complementary elements bolster one another with fluid synergy, while opposing forces ignite volatile metamorphoses, forging powerful new states through tension and release.
addons.title: Light of the Branded

objects.text:
You've inherited a power akin to the Fallen of Albaz, granting you the ability to absorb elemental or ambient energy and undergo a metamorphosis that reflects its essence. When struck by a concentrated light-based energy attack, you can internalize the energy—nullifying most of its impact, though it still inflicts pain—and repurpose it to fuel your transformation into a radiant dragon of light. Likewise, absorbing fire magic or raw flame evokes a blazing wyrm of heat and fury, while water grants rise to a serpent shaped by rivers and tides; each transformation is a considerable jump in power, along with new features that enhance combat prowess.

Even in worlds devoid of magic, this gift allows you to absorb the energy of your surroundings into something that you can consume. A mountain, dense with physical mass, becomes the catalyst for transforming into a bulky, stone-armored titan of endurance. A scrapyard births a dragon of scrapped metal—an armored beast forged from metal and decay.

Initially, this ability is triggered instinctively, heavily influenced by your emotions and the nature of the transformation. But through continued use and emotional discipline, you begin to harness this power consciously—shaping your draconic forms with intent rather than wild abandon.

Each transformation not only grants a monumental boost to durability and raw offensive power but also customizes its enhancements to the specific nature of the absorbed energy.

For example, the Scrap Dragon, while already immensely resilient thanks to its hide forged from repurposed metal and shattered alloys, possesses a secondary trait that sets it apart: technological integration. By absorbing mechanical remnants, electronic scrap, or even active devices from its surroundings, it can repurpose and reconfigure them into deadly weapons or utility tools mid-battle, yet even in places without it is still a formidable threat.
objects.title: Fallen of Albaz (Yu-Gi-Oh!: Fallen of Albaz)

addons.text:
You have ascended beyond ordinary shamans by forming a bond with one of the Five Grand Elemental Spirits—primordial nature spirits tied to fire, water, wind, earth, or lightning. This chosen guardian spirit eclipses nearly all others in power, allowing you to Oversoul or Armatize with it to enter a state of overwhelming elemental dominance.

Unlike lesser spirits, a Grand Elemental can briefly materialize in the physical world to act independently, unleashing signature artes of devastating, city-wide scale. s a chosen vessel of a Grand Elemental, you stand as a living avatar of pure elemental force—and may now form bonds with other Grand Elementals, should you find them in your journey.
addons.title: Elemental Warrior (Shaman King)

addons.text:
You have claimed the title of Shaman King, forging a bond with the Great Spirit—the metaphysical heart of the planet that holds the collective knowledge, memory, and energy of all life, past and future. Through this bond, you no longer merely channel spirits—you channel the world itself by fusing with it. You can also separate yourself from a world’s Over Spirit in case you with to bond with a different world’s Over Spirit.

Your Oversoul becomes near-limitless in size, scope, and duration, capable of shaping nations, altering weather patterns, speaking across continents, or unraveling entire armies with a gesture.

As the Great Spirit’s chosen vessel, your perception extends across the whole of the world. Your abilities transcend elemental limits, letting you reshape reality itself on a continental or planetary scale—restoring ruined lands, collapsing dimensional rifts, or purifying entire civilizations of spiritual corruption. You are no longer just a shaman. You are the living axis of the world’s will.
addons.title: Shaman King (Shaman King)

addons.text:
Your spiritual senses have transcended the mortal realm. No longer limited to local souls or elemental spirits, you can now perceive and commune with beings from beyond this world—departed souls, divine messengers, eldritch horrors, or any spiritual entity that exists on a different plane.

These otherworldly spirits can be bargained with and bound as guardian spirits, allowing you to forge Oversouls with truly unnatural properties: a saint may grant divine strikes that sever sin, while an eldritch fragment might distort space, time, or reason with every blow.

Such entities are alien by their very nature. Their presence can corrode the soul, fray the mind, or tempt the will. Maintaining a stable Oversoul demands iron resolve, layered protections, and a willingness to pay steep and unpredictable prices. But if you can endure it, your reach now extends into realms untouched by mortal shamans—and your Oversoul reflects powers reality was never meant to hold
addons.title: Spirits Beyond

objects.text:
You are now a Shaman, a rare individual born with the ability to perceive, communicate with, and channel the power of spirits. You can see and interact with ghosts, ancestral souls, elemental spirits, and other spiritual entities normally invisible to human eyes.

These spirits are naturally drawn to your presence, and with proper ritual or intent, you can form lasting bonds with them—granting you access to their memories, skills, and latent power. You can also sense spiritual disturbances, detect malevolent forces like poltergeists or curses, and perform basic purification rituals to banish or cleanse them.

However, you are still a rookie. Your spiritual strength is limited, and your ability to channel power beyond that of peak natural humans is unstable and short-lived.

Your current Oversoul—the temporary spiritual fusion between a spirit and a physical object or body—is weak and imprecise. For the few minutes you can maintain it, you might use a wooden sword to cut through metal or survive a gunshot, but little more. Oversoul at this level grants minor supernatural enhancement, not true battlefield dominance.

With time and training, you may unlock specialized Oversoul techniques, merge your spirit directly into your body for full-possession boosts, or even briefly dual-channel multiple bonded spirits for devastating combination attacks. However, your strength depends entirely on the depth of your connection. Doubt, fear, or emotional instability can disrupt your bond mid-battle and cause your Oversoul to collapse.

You are not yet one of the Elemental Warriors, and far from the power of a Shaman King—but the path lies open before you. With trust, discipline, and spiritual growth, you could one day command the might of gods.
objects.title: Shaman (Shaman King)

addons.text: Using the technique Meisters use to adjust their soul wavelengths, you can adjust your Aura's wavelengths, allowing you to reduce or increase the stress produced by its interactions with the physical world - in other words, allowing you to increase your offensive and defensive capabilities by adjusting your Aura's wavelengths with that of a target.
addons.title: Aura Wavelengths

addons.text:
The Demon Weapon of your pair now also functions as a Zanpakuto.

As a result, your pair has much greater innate compatibility, allowing for soul resonance that is both easy and powerful. As such, you can easily manifest simple effects like Witch Hunter or Getsuga Tenshō, without even releasing your Shikai.

When actually releasing your Shikai, soul resonance allows you to enhance its capabilities to a whole new level, such that observers could be forgiven for assuming you were wielding your Bankai. Greater still would be your Bankai, should you possess it.

On that note, your pair’s existing co-operative relationship ensures you will have a much easier time unlocking your Bankai.

Additionally, should you possess any other soul-based abilities, such as Kidō, they too can be enhanced through soul resonance, allowing for far greater effects at smaller costs. This synergy could allow you to cast your Kidō without incantations without sacrificing any of their effectiveness, or produce devastating effects by undergoing the full casting process.

Finally, should the Demon Weapon of your pair manage to evolve into a Death Scythe, their powers as a Zanpakuto will grow beyond any other. At that point, they will be able to wield the full breadth of their Shikai’s powers in their unreleased state. Keeping with this, actually entering Shikai will produce effects equal to a proper Bankai, even without any additional enhancement. Truly releasing your Bankai would allow you to fight on par with members of the Soul King’s own Royal Guard, and perhaps the whole squad, with ample soul resonance.
addons.title: Shinigami's Armament

objects.text:
You are either a Weapon Meister or a Demon Weapon, and have a partner of whichever type you aren't. The Demon Weapon can be of any type seen in the series besides a Death Scythe, or of a type of your creation of roughly equivalent power. Your soul resonance is very compatible with each other to start, and you both have experience similar to that of Maka and Soul at the beginning of Soul Eater in both the specialized abilities of Meisters and Weapons as well as in the use of the fighting styles associated with the type of Weapon you chose.

Weapon Meisters specialize in manipulating their soul wavelengths to produce various techniques. With training, the Meister of your pairing may learn to use this to sense souls, to strike with their own soul and to adjust their wavelengths on the fly to negate soul-based forms of offense, among other more specialized techniques.

Demon Weapons are humans with the ability to transform partially or fully into a specific weapon, though certain types may have multiple weapon forms. They also can eat souls and act as a conduit to amplify the soul wavelengths of a Meister. At the start, the Weapon of your pairing may only do broad changes to their body such as transforming a limb into the blade of their weapon form or popping their torso out of the blade when otherwise fully transformed, but with training they may perform more delicate changes.

The more synchronized the two of you are, the more your abilities are augmented when the Meister is wielding the Weapon, and through this you have access to a powerful combo ability, such as Witch Hunt Slash or Death Cannon, which if used well can potentially kill even immortal beings, but this ability is draining and hard to use.

If one of you dies, the other can house the soul within them; if a new body is constructed for the dead, they may inhabit it.
objects.title: A Dance of Souls (Soul Eater)

addons.text:
Instead of you taking the Yokai's power, both of you now share it. You may decide the specifics of how this manifests, whether one remains in control while the other guides, or if both are active participants. Either way, your spirit becomes an active helper instead of a passenger.

The Yokai can freely Astral Project themselves as a spirit only you and those with spiritual awareness can see, and can interact with both you and the world independently. While in this state, they share a telepathic bond with you that allows them to share senses, thoughts, and communicate regardless of distance. As well as use their powers on their own.

While in your transformed state, they can optimize your own performance or use the exclusive ability unique to them, or do the inverse in your normal state. For example, you can retain Turbo Granny's speed while transformed as she either coaches or takes the steering wheel from you, or have a manifested Acrobatic Silky use hair manipulation while you retain the physical boost in your normal state.
addons.title: Yokai Dualism

addons.text:
Your Inner Beast takes the power of your Yokai benefactor, or maybe it's the inverse. Either way, you undergo three major changes.

The first is far greater power and potential, raising the floor and ceiling of your Yokai power beyond what was thought possible. Initial weaknesses and limits become mitigated or outright removed, with new applications and expressions of their abilities appearing just as easily.

The second is your Inner Beast can now manifest itself as a Yokai spirit, allowing them to use all of their power as a separate entity from you or share half or less to fight alongside you. At a bare minimum, you will have the physical reinforcement as if you were in your transformed state. Alternatively, they may instead take over when you transform. 

The third is their exclusive ability undergoes and evolution beyond their limits with an unparalleled mastery over them. For example, Lord of Flies goes from controlling small objects to high-end telekinesis capable of lifting large buildings and manipulating their structure to recreate them as giant automations. Acrobatic Silky develops Medusa-like traits with her hair and can now cut and alter them into the shapes of various creatures. Evil Eye's soccer balls become miniature nukes waiting for a trigger, and then some.
addons.title: Yokai Beast
Yokai Sanctuary
addons.text:
Instead of only one, you can become a vessel for multiple Yokai by treating the Soul Garden as a storage space for them. Every Yokai that blessed you with its power can also take refuge within the Soul Garden, which will both heal the spirit and improve their powers overtime. As well as reinforce your own soul so you can better handle them, removing the physical backlash of Turbo Granny's All Outs or bypassing the limits of how many you can do a day as examples.

You can draw on the power of one or multiple Yokai separately or simultaneously, which will always manifest in the most harmonious way possible. You have no fear of overtaxing yourself this way. Furthermore, the Soul Garden allows you to create new Yokai, either by fusing them into a greater whole, or transforming certain souls into a Yokai counterpart.

objects.text:
Due to an encounter with a Yokai, you have been blessed with its power. Yokais draw upon Aura, which is different from Ki since it allows them to exist in the first place on this plane. In the case of a Yokai Vessel, however, they have a very unique interaction. First, the transformation itself is invisible, meaning that while to those who can see spiritual energy you DO look different, those without spiritual energy will simply notice you acting differently.

Second, your personality is altered in some way not quite predictable. You could become a depressed version of yourself, a rage-filled monster, or simply cheerier. And finally, your power can likely overwhelm you at first due to its intensity.

Your physical attributes are boosted tremendously, enabling you to smash steel and run faster than bullets. As well, you can interact with spiritual energy physically. You can also get an exclusive ability based on the style of Yokai you so choose, whether that be hair manipulation from an Acrobatic Silky-type, or Reflection manipulation from a Slit-mouth woman Yokai.

Your powers come with optional consciousness; the Yokai are always loyal to you and are willing to assist depending on the personality.
objects.title: Yokai Vessel (DanDaDan)

addons.text:
You are a master smith with the knowledge to properly handle and forge Datenseki, a rare ore capable of amplifying a person’s spirit energy. However, Datenseki is volatile and cause its user to explode due to an overwhelming surge of spirit energy. Datenseki is created by blending multiple alloys with your own spirit power.

Datenseki is the primary material required to create Enchanted Blades. Each Enchanted Blade possesses three primary techniques. Unlike traditional sorcery, which uses spirit energy to produce various effects, Enchanted Blades amplify spirit energy within the user to the point it manifests outside the body into different forms, each unique to the blade.

These manifested forms can be freely controlled by the wielder. Moreover, the wielder can partially see and hear through these forms, extending their senses beyond the body.

Enchanted Blades can also be charged with Spirit Energy, enabling the wielder to activate their techniques even when physically separated from the blade until the stored energy is depleted.

There exists a phenomenon known as the True Realm, which occurs when the wielder fully synchronize their thoughts, instincts and desires with the blade, this deep resonance allows the blade to evolve to suit the wielder’s needs, enhancing and developing extensions to the three primary techniques.

You possess the knowledge to craft all seven known Enchanted Blades. With time and research, you can create even more. Furthermore you can forge blades that draw power not only from Spirit Energy but from any energy source you have or gain and even physical stamina.

Finally, you can forge lifelong contracts for your Enchanted Blades, once a wielder is bound to a blade, only they can access its techniques until their death. Users of Enchanted Blades cant use their innate sorcery.
addons.title: Enchanted Blade Smith

addons.text:
You are now a master of the famed esoteric sword style developed by Itsuo Shirakai: Iai White Purity Style. The foundation of the style rests on Shirakai’s belief that the fastest strike is the strongest, leading him to develop stances designed to maximise movement and slashing speed. The style centers on building spirit energy within the sword’s sheath, then releasing it explosively upon unsheathing, resulting in sudden bursts of overwhelming speed.

Uniquely, practitioners wield their katana in a reverse grip, with the blade facing the wrist—opposite to standard grips, where the metacarpals align with the blade’s edge. Because of this unconventional hold, the sword must be rotated 180 degrees after being drawn, before the blade can reach its target.

This rotation constitutes the primary challenge of the style. With a conventional grip, sword fighters can maintain their channeling of spirit energy into the katana with relative ease. However, the necessary regripping during the rotation can easily disrupt one’s focus, causing the spirit energy to disperse.

To wield the style masterfully, a swordsman must intuitively handle the katana as a natural extension of their body, requiring no conscious adjustment—effectively merging with the blade through spirit energy, which you now can.
addons.title: Iai White Purity Style (Kagurabachi)

addons.text:
Your Pocket Dimension has been linked directly to your ability to use Spiritual Energy, transforming it into the Storeroom Sorcery. Now, using your Spiritual Energy, you may mark or register anything you touch, animate or inanimate. Once you have done so, at any time you may teleport anything that you've registered into your pocket dimension, with the visual of it disappearing into or appearing out of black bubbles. The dimension has also taken on the form of an island of white sheets in an endless black abyss, and will expand over time. Naturally, you may teleport in and out yourself, and can manipulate the substance of the island.

Additionally, at any time you may project an illusion of anything registered your Storeroom, showing it to others without pulling it out.

Finally, your registration process works by marking the spiritual energy of the target, if it has any. If for some reason the target is connected to another entity for some reason (for instance a sword bound to its wielder), then registering one will mark them both. Anything you have registered will remain marked until it is completely destroyed or you die.
addons.title: Storeroom

addons.text:
Cursed Energy and Yōjutsu have fused, augmenting and complimenting each other in the best way possible. To start, both energies freely flow throughout your body with the effortless and calm rhythm of a river, amplifying your physical abilities far beyond what was normally possible with either. Making you comparable to a Grade 2 Sorcerer or elite Kamunabi member. 

Your Innate Technique and Sorcery compliment each other, whether they are two separate abilities or have fused to create a stronger one is up to you, and won't have to worry about losing either due to overuse. Your control over these energies is also enhanced, to the point that simple reinforcement can make your movements be mistaken for teleportation, a focused strike can carry multiple effects upon or after impact, and your Innate Technique/Sorcery can be manipulated with far more skill than average.

Usage of Spirit Energy is far less taxing due to mainly drawing on your Cursed Energy Reserves, and even without that, it would take spamming your strongest techniques in rapid succession to cause damage to your brain. Likewise, rest and recovery can make you recharge your Cursed Energy much faster, and will already begin doing so passively when not in use. Negative emotions are also good way to generate ownerless Spirit Energy within yourself as temporarily surges of power. You can also imbue your energy into objects to create a similar effect to the Enchanted Blades, by using said object as an extension of yourself and expression of your technique. 

Finally, you can manipulate these energies much more freely, allowing you to learn the Non-Innate Sorcery and Jujutsu Techniques much more easily and invent your own applications of each, or even original ones.
addons.title: Spirit Sorcerer

addons.text:
Your Yōjutsu has undergone a profound transformation through its interaction with Chakra. While ordinary Yōjutsu manifests as a single supernatural art shaped by Spirit Energy, Chakra grants your soul a far greater degree of flexibility and refinement.

You retain your original Yōjutsu, but may now shape it through principles analogous to Yin Release, Yang Release, and Nature Transformation. Techniques once limited to a single expression can be altered, refined, combined, and evolved into entirely new forms. Constructs created through your Yōjutsu possess greater permanence, while enhancements affecting the body become dramatically more efficient and versatile.

Most remarkably, your Chakra Network and Spirit Energy pathways have merged into a unified circulatory system. The resulting synergy allows each energy source to reinforce the other, granting vastly improved control, efficiency, and recovery. What would normally require extensive Spirit Energy expenditure can instead be supplemented by Chakra, while Chakra techniques may be empowered by the unique properties of your Yōjutsu.

This fusion also grants access to a unique ability possessed by only a handful of shinobi throughout history: the power to imprint techniques into your Yōjutsu itself. Through sufficient mastery, your art may develop Extensions, evolutions, and entirely new manifestations tailored to your instincts and experiences, similar to how Enchanted Blades develop new expressions through synchronization with their wielders.

The result is neither Chakra nor Yōjutsu, but a synthesis of both—a living supernatural art capable of growth without clear limit.
addons.title: Shinobi Arts

addons.text:
The fundamentals of Breathing Styles have elevated your control over Yojutsu, and reduced the strain of wielding it significantly. 

Firstly, circulation of Spirit Energy is effortless, allowing you to remain at peak performance for as long as you maintain your breathing. Secondly, Recovery Breathing becomes a major asset for reducing the strain of Spirit Energy, ensuring your neural pathways remain intact even as you push yourself beyond your limits. Both of these become second nature once you reach the Hashira level and beyond.

Your Nichrin weapon can easily be mistaken for an Enchanted Blade due to Yojutsu augmenting your Breathing Style, and by pouring Spirit Energy into it, you can manifest several effects. Unlike the Enchanted Blades, you have full control over the kinds of techniques you're capable of. While limited by the theme of your Breathing Style and won't grow as fast as an Enchanted Blade user, you have the advantage of freedom and your own imagination.

For example, with Thunder Breathing, you can project slashes of lightning, cloak yourself in said lightning to raise your speed, or create variants of Cloud Gouger's Mei. With Water Breathing, you can summon constructs of sea creatures like Enten, project streams of pressurized water from a single thrust, surf across a wide area at great speeds, and more. If you have multiple Breathing Styles, you can freely combine them to create unique results.

Your Sorcery can also be used in conjunction with all of this, providing another advantage against Enchanted Blade wielders. Finally, you become much more efficient with Spirit Energy, reducing wasted expenditure and elevating your stamina significantly.
addons.title: Enchanted Breathing
Mikaboshi
addons.text:
Your body's ability to wield spiritual power has been enhanced even further. Now, much like the Mikaboshi clan of Shokoku, somehow, you are able to easily withstand the mighty power of Datenseki, freely drawing on its strength.

You gain the ability to use Sorcery that takes on insect like forms, like Kera, which fires a powerful projectile shaped like a bee, and can also tap into the True Realm of raw Datenseki, even without it being formed into a weapon. While the full capabilities of such an ability are still unknown, a confirmed effect is known as Sumika, or the reconstruction of the environment around the user to suit their needs.

Sumika, even when only partially activated, allows the user to rapidly regenerate their body, even healing from fatal wounds, with the added benefit of rendering the atmosphere 'poisonous' in a way that dulls and slows the senses of opponents. When fully activated, the user may unleash blasts that gouge massive holes in the opponent's body.

objects.text:
You are a Sorcerer, an individual capable of manipulating Spirit Energy a force similar to life energy. Spirit Energy can be used to amplify physical prowess and perform sorcery.

The ability to wield Spirit Energy depends on specialized neural pathways in an individual's brain. If these pathways are damaged, a sorcerer's ability to channel energy and use sorcery becomes impaired. Mastery of Spirit Energy involves two primary stages:

The first step is circulating Spirit Energy throughout the body. This enhances physical attributes strength, speed, agility and durability to superhuman levels. It can also be channeled into weapons, imbuing them with destructive power.

After mastering circulation, sorcerers unlock the ability to manifest a supernatural power, each individual's sorcery is innate and pre-determined. Individuals belonging to the same bloodline have an increased chance of inheriting the same sorcery.

A manifested sorcery can take almost any form from summoning pine trees of varying sizes, to creating explosive Daruma dolls of different intensities, or even manipulating specific elements.

Most can only develop one primary ability, though they can also learn universal techniques such as barrier, spells and movement sorcery. You gain basic knowledge of these techniques.

Channeling Spirit Energy places strain on neural pathways, overuse may cause headaches, hallucinations, sensory degradation and in severe cases irreversible brain damage. Without proper rest and recovery a sorcerer risks permanent disability or death.
objects.title: Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi)

addons.text:
With the combination of these two powers, you are now able to create items that merge the abilities of Vital Instruments and Fullbrings. These items will be more powerful and possess a wider variety of abilities than either Vital Instruments or Fullbrings.

You can instantly turn any mundane item into powered item. You will intuitively know what powers any item can have, and you may choose whichever abilities an item receives from them. The longer you use an item you have created, the stronger it will become. Through a Fullbringer’s ability to manipulate souls and Anima—the power of thoughts and emotions—any item you create can, over time develop its own consciousness. These items can be used by anyone you allow, as long as they have some kind of energy source, whether its Ki, Spiritual power, Chakra, or anything else.

By combining Reiryoku and Anima, you can use this energy far more easily and create a much greater variety of techniques. For example, with your ability to manipulate souls, you can reinforce your body in a manner similar to Quincy Blut for both defence and offence, or create beasts from trash that remain under your control.

Even without these combined items, you can now create Vital Instruments that rival the Watchman Series in strength, which is said to contain an unlimited amount of Anima. Previously, only people who had lost a part of themselves that formed their identity could utilise these items, but now anyone capable of using them can do so. You can also create multiple Fullbrings much more easily than before.
addons.title: Fullbring Series

objects.text: Anima, the power born from accumulated thoughts and emotions—gathered over time until it crystallizes into supernatural potential. Givers are people who can utilize this source of energy, drawing upon it to awaken and wield Vital Instruments. Each Vital Instrument began as an everyday item—something personally precious to its Giver. Through constant care and honing, an aspiring Giver steadily pours their Anima into it, in an effort to give it “life.” Once awakened, any Giver can use that Vital Instrument. Though the more love, attention, and time invested in an object, the higher its “quality” and the stronger it becomes, which is why most Givers choose to focus on a single Instrument. But quality alone isn’t everything—its abilities matter just as much. A Vital Instrument’s powers always reflect its user’s mindset, making each one uniquely personal to the Giver who awakened it; shaped by their experiences, values, and the way they view the object. Vital Instruments generally fall into two distinct types: Attacker, for those who want to use the item to its fullest and embrace combat; and Defender, for those who prioritize its preservation, resulting in non-combative abilities instead. And when a Vital Instrument is passed down through enough generations, the layered Anima of its many owners eventually becomes overwhelming—dense enough to drive ordinary people insane. Those already “broken,” however, may instead find comfort in it, as the accumulated Anima fills something “missing” within them. Note: You will have the option to turn any Object of Power you own into a Vital Instrument, further enhancing it in the process.
objects.title: Giver (Gachiakuta)

addons.text: You possess the combined skills, physiology,  knowledge, ninjutsu, and power of all of the shinobi shown in Jigokuraku. You are the superior of master shinobi like Gabimaru, Yuzuriha, and Shija in virtually all aspects.
addons.title: The Hollow

addons.text: You gain the full knowledge of the swordsmen depicted within the series, with skill on par with Shugen. You also gain all of the unique abilities shown by the ranked Asaemon, such as Shugen’s mimicry of fighting styles and ability to change the elemental attribute of his Tao, Jikka’s ability to see the Principle of All Things, and Sagiri’s ability to follow the Middle Way and greatly increase the power of her Tao.
addons.title: The Asaemon

addons.text:
