Your first trait when merging Tao and Chakra in perfect harmony is the ability to ignore the restorative and weakening effects of the mutual influence loop of the wuxing. You can, at will, reverse this quality, allowing you to either exploit it or avoid being exploited by others.

Your second trait introduces a new type of Tao training. This involves absorbing and assimilating the Tao of other individuals and even the environment itself, thanks to the natural properties of Chakra. You can also petrify or inflict other elemental effects on individuals by forcibly infusing them with Chakra from Sage Mode. The stronger the target compared to your own strength, the harder, slower, and less rewarding the absorption will be.

Your third trait is that, through Tao’s emission capabilities, any jutsu generated with Chakra can now be performed using energy from the environment instead of your own body or any typical medium. This allows you to conserve or bypass the use of your personal energy reserves for extended battles. Keep in mind that the power and efficiency of this ability depend on the amount of energy present in the surroundings. Additionally, it requires no hand seals or physical stance techniques can be executed purely through will or thought.

Your fourth and final trait is a Tao with full affinity to all five wuxing attributes, including Yin and Yang, thanks to the versatility of Chakra. Furthermore, your Tao can adopt combined or advanced elemental chakra natures, such as sand, lava, and other specialized attributes.
addons.title: Sage Tao

addons.text:
You have developed a hermit art that enhances all general Tao capabilities by 1.5 times the normal. But some features incorporate extraordinary new effects.

First, your talent and understanding of Tao allow you to develop new techniques in the arts of Emission, Enhancement, and Manipulation with relative ease. You can even develop new techniques in the middle of combat, and outside of it, you can still maintain the same power and quality. Therefore, you will no longer fear the lack of epiphany.

The Dō'in and Taisoku exercises have fused into a single Tao exercise under the fundamentals of Sendo. This means that any gain you obtain through training will be twice the usual. If you have other add-ons that enhance the same Tao exercise, then their effects will also be doubled.

The Tao’s fire affinity is now as strong as it was in the legends of Sendo. You no longer need bladed weapons or techniques, as your mere presence burns any demon or similar class due to imitating the very essence of the sun. And if you use a weapon, it will burn instantly upon making contact, with even a scratch being enough to reduce them to ashes.

Even if you lack a fire affinity, this benefit will still provide a suitable method to gain a secondary affinity without affecting your primary elemental affinity. Since it has the very essence of the sun, it also removes the fire element’s inherent weakness according to the Wuxing fundamentals.

Since Sendo is an art that allows the fighter to continue battling perpetually until the enemy falls or yields to your will, it has caused the Tao to be capable of restoring your physical, mental, and any supernatural energy integrity. However, once this technique is used, a strong tension will run through both soul and body. The severity of the tension depends on the duration of the technique’s activation.

Lastly, just as any physical matter melts or yields to heat, the very essence of solar Sendo causes your Tao, through pressure, to induce a weakening effect on victims, and this effect grows stronger the longer they are exposed to your Tao.

And most importantly, the Tao has also eliminated the greatest weakness of Sendo, the requirement to always apply breathing. As an auxiliary measure, you can apply Hamon through your own body, soul, and Tao without completely depending on breathing.

Over time and with training, you will be able to eliminate some weaknesses, such as suffering strong tension in the body and soul between Tao and Hamon. You may even improve and evolve.
addons.title: Tibetan Tao

addons.text:
Between the combination of Tao’s Taisoku exercise and the Demon Child breathing technique, effects have been created that are not only devastating but legendary.

With the regenerative effects of Tao, you are now almost immortal, as long as there is a trace of Tao in your power reserves that you can draw from to regenerate from any damage. At the same time, the Taisoku exercise allows you to replenish your Tao reserves as long as it doesn’t exceed its regeneration rate. This makes you practically unstoppable, as it also restores your physical and mental stamina.

At a higher mastery level, even without performing Taisoku, you could match the immortality and extraordinary resilience of the Tensen, without the weakness of having a core. But you are still mortal if you lack sufficient energy to heal from the damage suffered.

The more intense the Demon Child technique becomes, the redder the practitioner’s Tao becomes, regardless of their elemental affinity. This causes an increase in power, efficiency, and quality. At a maximum level, it could triple all physical capabilities and any power the practitioner possesses.

At a more extreme level, if you choose to burn your own Tao equivalent to burning your lifespan or vitality. Your Demon Child technique can quintuple all the effects it provides.

If you survive such a suicidal action, you can replenish the lost vitality through the Tao’s Taisoku or Shu’itsu exercise. You can even prolong your longevity for thousands of years as long as you have Tao in your body and soul, with eternal youth as a side effect.

At the same time, your control over Tao becomes as instinctive as breathing. You still can’t perform complex maneuvers like the Tensen are capable of, but at the very least, it greatly reduces the difficulty in mastering Tao and all its techniques.
addons.title: Red Tao

addons.text:
Your Tao Emission techniques cost 50% less energy thanks to the fact that Armament Haki has improved their durability and added the effect of causing internal damage to the victim. As a result, this creates projectiles with greater impact and penetration damage potential. Meanwhile, AoE attack durations are extended as long as your power reserves allow. At a maximum mastery level, you could reduce this energy consumption to 20% of its original cost.

Your sensory capabilities are no longer limited to detecting physical form and soul. Now you will be able to perceive both intention and emotions, allowing you to decipher and understand the how and why of their actions. This indirectly improves the quality of your precognition abilities with more clarity than before.

Observation Haki and Tao have allowed the practitioner to perceive weak points and breaking points more easily and as clearly as water. No matter what shape or stance the enemy takes, their weaknesses become very obvious. Even subconsciously, it subtly guides you to the direction, stance, and right moment to take maximum advantage.

In reverse, you have also developed a formidable defense even without being consciously aware of the dangers you face. Armament Haki and Tao Armor manifest their defenses in the same way the subconscious guides you on the battlefield.

Your Conqueror's Haki is no longer limited to causing "pressure" effects. It is now capable of inflicting an elemental effect on the target according to their own Tao affinity. In a lighter effect, fire element pressure could cause the victim to experience heatstroke or a sudden increase in temperature. In a more extreme effect, whether through rage, murderous intent, or a berserker state, it could cause spontaneous combustion in the victim.

Finally, Conqueror's Haki has greatly enhanced Tao Manipulation techniques. This allows the practitioner a very strong and precise level of psychokinesis. It also eliminates the need to resonate with targets; by simply imposing your strong will, you can manipulate them as much as you desire.

Your natural weakness, according to the elemental affinity of Tao, is reduced by 50% thanks to the fact that Haki enhances not only your physical abilities but also your soul.
addons.title: Tao Conqueror

addons.text:
Your practice of Taisoku and Dō'in has reached new heights, where it once required hundreds of years just to master and improve your Tao. Now it will take less time to achieve the same effect in decades or in just a few years if you have great talent and diligent training.

Now, Tao, in combination with Breathing techniques, results in physical boosts being three times greater than usual. It can also be maintained longer before having to deactivate the technique due to overexertion or reaching its limit. However, due to the effects of Tao, this cycle constantly improves the practitioner's base body and, consequently, becomes stronger than the previous state.

In addition, the control and reserves of Tao are refined to the same level as the gradual advancement of the practitioner's physique. This, combined with the fact that Breathing techniques provide the four basic elements, allows one to transform their personal Tao affinity into another affinity with its corresponding Breathing technique that represents that element.

You can now manifest the corresponding element instead of being limited to martial techniques during execution. Not to mention that you can now use multiple Breathing Styles, and the difficulty of reaching the Hashira level is considerably reduced.

Without the need for a Nichirin sword or a bladed weapon made of the same material, you are capable of using the same effect on demons and any creature of the same category. This is achieved through the Tao armor technique on bladed weapons or any object instead of your own body. This includes hand-to-hand combat if you attack directly at their soul.

You are no longer limited to a single enhanced sense; the other four remaining senses are elevated to the same level, thus granting the practitioner a very clear awareness of anything within a 500-meter omnidirectional radius. With training and Tao refinement, sensory capabilities can improve in range, clarity, and efficiency.
addons.title: Tao Breathing

addons.text:
You have developed an innate cursed technique based on the concepts of Tao.

This technique draws upon the elemental foundations of the Wuxing and channels them through the cursed aura you exert or infuse into objects. You may even create cursed tools whose effects are determined by the intention and elemental concept applied. For example, a necklace imbued with the Water element could grant exceptional mental clarity or resistance to mental interference, or make your body as agile and fluid as water itself. Your Shikigami and Kekkaijutsu can be maximized, such as forming a resilient wall by infusing both Earth and Metal together, or creating a shikigami formed from a specific element whether generated by you or drawn from a preexisting source.

Your manipulation of cursed energy becomes significantly easier, reaching a level of competence comparable to that of a Grade 2 sorcerer, thanks to the incorporation of Tao-based Emission, Enhancement, and Detection. Furthermore, the five Taoist cultivation practices can be applied to cursed energy, increasing the size of your energy reserves, the amount of energy you can use at once, the rate at which you generate it, and your refined control over it. 

If you master this technique within a Domain Expansion or any equivalent method that allows it, you can create a domain whose sure-hit effect imposes a random element upon those within it. All affected individuals both allies and enemies, except yourself will experience the restorative and restrictive cycles of the Wuxing elemental foundations. Every 30 seconds, all affected parties are reassigned a new designated element. The domain persists as long as you have cursed energy or Tao available, or until you choose to cancel it.

If you possess Reverse Cursed Technique, you are capable of applying a restorative cycle effect of the Wuxing. As a result, in addition to the elements you already command, you can enhance them to become up to five times more powerful and efficient than before.
addons.title: Cursed Tao

objects.text:
You have gained access to the Tao within yourself. Tao is a form of energy present in all things, living and nonliving. Tao is generated in the tanden below the navel and circulates through the body. Utilizing the Tao within yourself grants you superhuman abilities far beyond any human.

You currently have basic-level mastery over your Tao, which grants you abilities like discerning information based on Tao, enhancing your physical attacks and weapons with your Tao to cause internal damage, enhancing your durability with Tao, and concealing your presence from others. Over time, you can learn to perform techniques on the level of Sennin.

Tao possesses elemental aspects that counter and aid each other in accordance with the concept of Wuxing. You can choose the elemental alignment (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) of your Tao. While you can increase your power using another’s Tao with a complementary attribute, Tao with an opposing attribute will drain and weaken your Tao. Injury to your tanden will negate the flow of Tao and can potentially kill you. Finally, extreme overuse of Tao can lead to heavy physical and spiritual damage, though this can be healed via interaction with Tao of a complementary attribute. You can identify the Tao alignments of others through your sensory abilities.
objects.title: Tao (Jigokuraku)

addons.text:
You aren't a mere beginner; as the Avatar, you are a Master Airbender, and not only that, you are a prodigy at Airbending for an Avatar. Where others bend blasts of wind, you could bend a tornado.

As a bonus, you get a well-constructed Airbending Glider empowering you with flight.
addons.title: Airbending Master

addons.text:
One of the greatest weaknesses of modern Airbending is that it is almost purely defensive. By integrating your airbending techniques with the Whirlwind Iron Cutting Fist, you are now able to use airbending in more offensive ways. Examples of this include creating a tornado of air blades, shooting air pressure cannons with your fist, or even creating massive explosions of pressurized air.

You do not have to worry about this weakening your spirituality either. You possess the quality of Bomb himself to both value life and take it when necessary. This means that no matter how violent your bending is, you will not lose your heart and be able to remain spiritually balanced.
addons.title: Windbending

addons.text:
Through combining the act of Breathing and philosophy of Airbending, you've created a style that transcends its limits, Harmonic Breathing. 

Not only does breathing become a much more malleable vessel and amplifier for Airbending, but a direct medium to lead your mind, body, and soul towards enlightenment. With each breath being a step forward to reaching it, and thus mastery of Airbending. From this, you can easily develop derivatives and innovative techniques for Airbending.

For example, basic proficiency would aid in moving more swiftly, leap across vast distances, and project air with much more concussive or cutting force. While with mastery, easily blow gusts with the power of a hurricane, produce clouds and mist by manipulating the water vapor within air, or cut mountains clean in half.

More importantly, each "step" towards enlightenment attunes you much more deeply to the spiritual aspects of Airbending. Which can lead to gaining an awareness or connection to the Spirit World, awakening your chakras to manipulate, sense, and see chi through Breathing, or even a state of zen to move and act instinctively without thought. 

This can also translate into achieving the Selfless State to become invisible to all sensory abilities, or seeing the Transparent World to view the anatomy, flow of energy, or predict the movements of other living things.
addons.title: Harmonic Breathing

addons.text:
Airbending is an art that both improves and requires agility. To make maximum use of it, one must move with the wind. 

Now your aptitude for parkour and acrobatic combat is due to more than talent and physical enhancement, the winds themselves guide and augment your movements.

By moving with it and letting the wind guide your movement you achieve a special flow state where not only do you move faster and more agilely, but also more effectively. Your blows landing on weak points, and dodging blows before you even recognize them coming.

With sufficient practice you may be able to let the wind guide your travels, leading you to safe passage, and places to stay.
addons.title: Wind Born

addons.text: By severing all ties to worldly desire, you achieve the legendary state of true flight, as once realized by Guru Laghima and later Zaheer. No longer bound by the pull of the earth, you move freely through the air, your airbending elevated to that of a master of all 36 levels of airbending. Your control, precision, and power are such that you can contend even with the Avatar in the Avatar State. This complete spiritual detachment sharpens your awareness beyond the physical realm. You possess a natural aptitude for spiritual projection, allowing with some training for your spirit to separate from your body and traverse the Physical or Spiritual World, much like Jinora. Your perception of spirits, energy, and unseen forces is significantly heightened, granting insight that few mortals can rival. Effectively, you exist in a state between worlds: untethered in body, and unbound in spirit.
addons.title: Weightlessness
Soundbending
addons.text: You have rediscovered an incredibly rare form of airbending, called Soundbending. While the original user of this bending style, Avatar Yangchen, only showed minimal usage through amplifying the sound generated by her scream, but even just that sound was augmented to the point of splitting the ocean and deafening those nearby. You however, with the assistance of your mimicry fighting style, have developed far beyond this feat, nearly to the point of reaching the feats of the mythical Sound King after a bit of practice and experimentation. A casual swish of your arm increases the noise of moving air to the point of creating several high velocity slashes of vibrational energy. A mere breath of air can reach a frequency that can cause intense nausea or fainting. If you ever deign to give your full attention to a challenge, you could raze away a mountain into dust.

objects.text:
You gain the ability to Airbend, which can be used to manipulate Air, the element of freedom, starting with only knowledge of the basics but holding prodigious talent, enough to become a master Airbender on your own and even invent new Airbending styles and applications like assisted flight through the use of a glider or flightsuit.

Airbending is a deeply spiritual discipline, and as such, necessitates constant spiritual awareness, which will result in the deterioration of your airbending capabilities if such is not adhered to.
objects.title: Airbending (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

addons.text: You aren't a mere beginner; you are a Master Waterbender, and not only that, you are a prodigy at Waterbending for an Avatar. Where others bend waves, you could bend a tsunami.
addons.title: Waterbending Master

addons.text:
As a prodigious Waterbender with skill in Total Concentration Breathing, you have developed a special technique that inverts the principles of Firebending, enabling you to create Water from your Chi through the use of your breath.

With mastery, you may be able to use this to cool yourself down and even heal yourself, but be warned that the power of your Waterbending is still affected by the phases of the moon to the point that lunar eclipses can negate your ability to Waterbend.
addons.title: Breath of Water

addons.text: Through either being a child of the moon or having an affinity for the sea, you are no longer fully dependent on the moon for power. While you can still be buffed by the full moon, you no longer require it to perform your bending. What other benefits your situation provides are based on what you have chosen. Having Child of Luna will mean that you are more connected with Tui, the moon spirit. This means that you have both enhanced healing capabilities, capable of even imparting some of your own life force to prolong another’s. You also gain the ability to bloodblend whenever you want, even being able to use it to disrupt a person’s Chi so that they can not bend or perform any other techniques based on using one’s life force. Together, it is possible to absorb and change another’s chi in what is a bootleg version of energy bending. Having Sea Magic means you are connected to La, the ocean spirit. You are thus able to bend truly massive amounts of water, able to conjure up tsunamis at will. The force of your bending is also enhanced to the point where even a single water whip can have the force of storm surge, let alone your other techniques. You can use your sea magic to summon water using magic power, eliminating the weakness of not having any nearby. You can even perform a technique that allows you to have the power of the mighty Koizilla, allowing you to fight armies with ease. You don’t even need to worry that much about how much chi you’re using, as you will be able to renew it with any magic power you absorb. Be aware, however, that using this technique without already existing water, and instead using water made with sea magic, means that you will deplete your magic reserves at a rapid rate. Having Breath of Water will help you with this due as your breathing now also refills your magic. If you have both, all mentioned powers will be boosted immensely, to the point where you will be able to fight on par with a fully realized Avatar. Once your powers are mastered, of course.
addons.title: Tui and La

objects.text:
You gain the ability to Waterbend, which can be used to manipulate Water, the element of change, starting with only knowledge of the basics but holding prodigious talent, enough to become a master Waterbender on your own and even invent new Waterbending styles and applications like healing.

Waterbending relies on the presence of Water, which can be quite restrictive as a beginner, but with mastery, can be accessed through unorthodox sources like sweat, the moisture in the air, plants, and potentially even blood. Waterbending is spiritually connected to the moon, and as such is strongest at night, during the full moon, during winter, and near the north pole and south pole, but weaker during the day and close to the equator, and powerless during lunar eclipses.
objects.title: Waterbending (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

addons.text: You aren't a mere beginner; you are a Master Earthbender, and not only that, you are a prodigy at Earthbending even for an Avatar. Where others bend boulders, you could bend mountains.
addons.title: Earthbending Master

addons.text: To bend the earth around you, one must be as stubborn as a rock. With Haki, you're even more stubborn. Earthbending is fueled by the user’s willpower and determination, and yours can already be manifested into reality. The result is that the power of your earthbending becomes strong enough to outdo even Toph and Bumi. You can bend massive boulders, small mountains, and create small earthquakes if you will it. The stronger your Haki, the stronger your bending. The earth you bend has also been enhanced by your Haki, much like a Logia user. Have a pesky spirit who keeps phasing through your rocks? Just use Armament Haki and watch them get pounded into the dirt, by the dirt. Mix in Conqueror’s Haki, and you could use a pebble to break through a steel door. That’s not all, you have managed to have a revelation about metal. Metal veins form in the Earth, metal is dug up from the Earth, and metal is in the core of the Earth, so why is pure metal not Earth? The answer, it IS Earth, just more stubborn than any rock could ever be. And so, through sheer force of will, you can bend any metal no matter how pure, because of the simple reason that Earth is Earth. It won’t bend without a fight, however. The stronger the metal you wish to bend, the stronger your Haki must be to bend it. Some with weak Haki will struggle with pure copper, while those with immense Haki could bend platinum into origami cranes.
addons.title: Earth is Earth

addons.text:
You've combined Earthbending with the principles of Stone Breathing, creating a new expression of both arts that transcend their limits. 

To start, your Nichirn weapon now becomes a conduit for Earthbending, able to be manipulated with the same proficiency as Gyomei's kusarigama. Allowing you to not only Earthbend, but also sense vibrations in the earth through it, elevating your spatial awareness. This extends to any other weapons you have.

Each breath amplifies your five senses, concentration, physical power, resistance, and will, producing awe-inspiring feats of Earthbending. The force of just a single breath empowered strike is enough to kick boulders like soccer balls into the sky, or cause miniature earthquakes after smashing the ground. 

Through Repetitive Action, this can be raised even further by repeating Eartbending forms or channeling sheer stubbornness and emotion. This also raises your heart rate and body temperature, and while it doesn't produce the same risks as the Demon Slayer Mark, prolonged use can still leave you exhausted. Though the extra adrenaline can be useful.

This style also extends to any subtypes of Earthbending. Such as each breath granting a glimpse into seismic sense for Metalbending, or coating your weapon in magma for Lavabending.
addons.title: Legacy of the Stone Hashira

addons.text:
To shape something, you must first know it, and now you know the land better than you know yourself. 

Your ability to connect to the land is no longer exclusive to those influenced and created by humanity. Instead being in an environment like that gives you a more detailed and organized understanding, while being in a wild, natural area gives you greater range.

As you earthbend in an area, you and the genius loci become more familiar with each other. You learn its quirks and distinctions, allowing you to earthbend faster and easier, eventually reaching the point where the earth in that location starts to respond automatically as you wish it to.
addons.title: Earth Friend

objects.text:
You gain the ability to Earthbend, which can be used to manipulate Earth, the element of substance, starting with only knowledge of the basics but holding prodigious talent, enough to become a master Earthbender on your own and even invent new Earthbending styles and applications like bending sand, lava or metal.

Earthbending relies on the presence of Earth, specifically rock and soil, as a beginner, which can be quite limiting in certain circumstances. With mastery, one can learn to access further forms of Earth such as loose sand, mud, glass, even lava and the slag deposits within processed metals, though more finely refined metals may prove intractible to your abilities. True mastery of Earthbending can even allow one to sense vibrations through the earth for a variety of effects. Earthbending expresses the aspect of neutral jing, which involves listening and waiting, and also requires decisiveness; when the time comes to strike, it must be done without hesitation or uncertainty. If an Earthbender lacks determination, the Earth will not respond to their will.
objects.title: Earthbending (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

addons.text: You aren't a mere beginner; you are a Master Firebender, and not only that, you are a prodigy at Firebending for an Avatar. Where others could create blasts of fire, you could create fiery explosions.
addons.title: Firebending Master

addons.text: Power in Firebending and Sendo comes from the breath, the sun, and one's internal life energy; thus, with your overwhelming talent in both styles, you have fused them into one discipline, empowering both with the capabilities of the other. You can make your fire more intense, use it to heal, use it during a solar eclipse, wrap yourself in flames without burning yourself, sense heat as a supernatural 6th sense, manipulate other substances with your flames just as you would with Hamon, and even stop aging so long as you maintain your training in this discipline. The spiritual side of Ripplebending is entirely unexplored, thus up to you to grasp and learn.
addons.title: Ripplebending

addons.text:
Firebenders possess a unique power fueled by the sun's scorching heat. As the sun rises, firebenders' abilities are amplified, allowing them to tap into the full potential of their firebending powers.

As the incarnation of the sun, your firebending abilities are magnified beyond imagination. Your Chi has merged with the sun's rampant energy, creating a reaction similar to nuclear fusion, allowing firebenders to generate flames at temperatures much higher than any ordinary firebender, including the originators, the dragons. You have also gained the ability to create miniature suns produced by your firebending using the heat of a star, a testament to your unparalleled Dominion of fire.

Those who wield fire against you find fire ineffective at damaging you; rather, their fire heals you. Moreover, your power to manipulate lightning has merged with the solar winds, allowing them to infuse it with plasma, elevating your abilities to new heights. The result is a power that is even more formidable than before, enabling you to harness the immense power of the sun and lightning and to command them as you please.

Your very essence is akin to that of the sun, and with time, you may become a full-fledged spirit of the sun.
addons.title: Child of Agni

addons.text: You've taken your first steps toward mastering your breath and Chi, unlocking the art of combustionbending through the use of the Breath of Combustion. Derived from both Fire and Thunder, this Breathing Style blends the intense, searing power of flame with the explosive speed and impact of a thunderclap. It is a discipline rooted in destruction, precision, and overwhelming force—demanding unwavering control of one's body and spirit. Combustionbending is a harsh and brutal path, requiring incredible focus, perfect breath control, and uninterrupted Chi flow. Practitioners must learn to cycle, concentrate, and channel Chi with deliberate, calibrated precision, or else risk disaster. It is a physically and spiritually grueling art, one that few can wield at all. Whilst regular meditation and mastery over one's self are essential, the core of it lies in its application as a devastating combat art. In conjunction with this, you've also learned the martial art practices and forms that comprise combustionbending—an aggressive offensive style reminiscent of a blend of Muay Thai, Karate, Kickboxing, and Taekwondo. It emphasizes sharp, calculated strikes designed to end fights as quickly as possible. Your mastery of breath and Chi gives you far greater control over combustionbending than all its previous known users, like Combustion Man or P'li. Unlike them, however, you aren't restricted to firing from the ajna chakra (the forehead). Instead, via the openings of your meridians, you can project combustion blasts from any part of your body, be they fingertips, palms, elbows, feet, etc. That said, firing from more spiritually attuned points (like the ajna) yields more refined and potent blasts due to their heightened spiritual resonance. To initiate a combustion blast, you must first begin with a breath—with its depth determining the amount of energy you can mobilize. You then gather your Chi into the dan tian (stomach), concentrating it as you cycle energy through your meridian pathways. The faster and more efficiently you cycle your Chi, the faster you can fire and the less downtime you'll need between shots. Cycling multiple times before release further compounds the potency. At early stages, a single breath allows you to fire one blast per second—each powerful enough to shatter rock or small boulders. But as your skill deepens, so does your output. Masters of the Breath of Combustion can unleash blasts far superior to anything seen before: curving and redirecting them like P'li, launching multiple volleys in a second from a single shallow breath, or even bringing down Ba Sing Se's walls with a fully-charged ten-breath strike.
addons.title: Breath of Combustion

addons.text:
Through your improved lungs, you have gained the ability to generate the unique blue flames of Azula, albeit through a different method. While Azula’s exact technique is unknown, your blue fire is derived from your enhanced breathing capacity. Specifically, by supplying your flames with more oxygen, you generate a blue fire that burns hotter and stronger than standard Firebending flames. While powerful, this fire is harder to control and burns away more Chi than regular Firebending.

With sufficient mastery of Firebending, you may eventually be able to produce white fire, the hottest form of flame a Firebender can achieve. You will also find producing regular fire far easier and more efficient than before.  

Alongside your already prodigious talent in Firebending, your new blue flames allow you to rival Azula in all but lineage and training.
addons.title: Azul Fire

addons.text:
Unknown to most of the world, some Dragons are, in fact, minor fire spirits who have taken mortal form after crossing over from the Spirit World. You have learned this truth after being altered by the blood of one of these minor spirits. This has resulted in a greatly increased spiritual connection to Firebending, making it more instinctive, powerful, easier to control, and easier to resist. Your Firebending has also become more spiritual in nature and is now fully capable of harming spirits. To complement this new spirituality, you have learned the Dancing Dragon's Firebending form which resonates with your new blood.

Additionally, you have gained a minor connection to the greater Sun Spirit, the source of all Firebending itself and the spiritual representation of the Sun. As a result, your Firebending is permanently enhanced as if empowered by Sozin’s Comet and remains available even during a solar eclipse, because not even the Moon can block your connection to the Sun. While this connection can be theoretically strengthened, the greater Sun Spirit is a powerful Primordial Spirit that is inhuman, ancient, and largely passive, with little direct influence over the mortal world, as it still resides in the Spirit World. 

Lastly, the mana granted through Dragon’s Blood is now a purer and more spiritual form of Chi unique to spirits. This makes it significantly more effective when used with Firebending, potentially allowing you to achieve feats that are impossible for ordinary Firebenders.
addons.title: Dragon's Flame

objects.text:
You gain the ability to Firebend, which can be used to manipulate Fire, the element of power, starting with only knowledge of the basics but holding prodigious talent, enough to become a master Firebender on your own and even invent new Firebending styles and applications like the use of lightning.

Firebending draws power from the breath, the user's Chi, and the sun, and as such can be manifested through the user's Chi and is strongest during the day, during summer, close to the equator, and during spiritually significant phenomena related to fire, but weakest during the night, more so during the full moon as the opposite of Waterbending, during winter, even powerless during solar eclipses, and can be greatly diminished if the user loses their 'drive' or 'passion.'
objects.title: Firebending (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

addons.text: Your connection to your previous lives has caused a synergy with Raava, the embodiment of Light. Through this, you are now the reincarnation of every known Avatar from the first Avatar Wan all the way to Korra. The accumulated knowledge, wisdom and skill of every known Avatar has made you so powerful that you do not even need the Avatar State to use your full bending might.
addons.title: The Bringer Of Balance

addons.text: Your absolute gift with all forms of bending extends even to Energybending. You know all the basic techniques of the Lion Turtles and can even perform techniques exclusive to you, such as turning into a giant made of energy or even shooting lasers.
addons.title: Energybending Master

addons.text:
Your connection with the elements has grown deep, even beyond the Avatar State.

You can now manifest any element you have mastered through the chi contained within your body. This is an energy you produce as you meditate, train, and deepen your connection with the elements, as well as from the residual effects of the Avatar State. Meanwhile, the benefits of elemental empowerment are doubled.

New spirits manifest, born as variants of the four primary elements. This only happens if you master their derived element or if the primary elemental spirit evolves.

These spirits will have the same benefits as the primary ones but will be more difficult to master and bond with. In addition, derivative spirits will be subordinate to their respective primary elemental spirit, but you will still hold greater authority.

For example, a Lava Spirit is born the moment you master Lavabending, a sub-skill of Earthbending, or simply when Gnome evolves into a higher version of herself.

Your Avatar State can now act as a double of yourself in the form of an elemental spirit that represents chi energy. This also includes all natural Energybending abilities.

Your sensory abilities are now enhanced by elemental effects. The water allows you to perceive moisture and the flow of any fluid. The wind grants you highly sensitive and sharp hearing. The earth lets you perceive your surroundings through echolocation. The fire enables you to detect the heat emitted by living beings and any heat source. Chi energy allows you to sense the life force of living beings and any spiritual entity. Your sensory range is directly proportional to your mastery of the elemental bending arts.
addons.title: Harmonic Convergence

addons.text:
Through the opening of your chakras, you have found your strength and control in the Avatar State greatly enhanced. From the very start, your Chakras will be open enough to exit and enter the Avatar State at will.

The first Chakra will empower your earthbending to the level that in the Avatar State, you can eventually shift tectonics and control trillions of individual grains of sand separately.

By opening your second Chakra, your waterbending in the Avatar State could part entire oceans, or bloodbend entire cities.

When you have your third Chakra opened in the Avatar State, your firebending could greatly surpass even the grandest performances shown during Sozin’s Comet.

With the fourth Chakra open, your airbending in the Avatar State could create self-sustaining weather fronts.

The fifth Chakra, your energybending will be on a scale where you could recreate a Harmonic Convergence on a smaller scale. This would be able to grant or remove the bending abilities of entire countries.

With the penultimate Chakra unlocked, your avatar state exists in physical and spiritual planes simultaneously, being able to affect both at the same time.

With all Chakras opened, including the Crown, your Avatar state can be held open as long as you wish, without drawback or strain. Even if you are killed in the Avatar State, the cycle will no longer be disrupted in the least.
addons.title: Unlocked Avatar State

objects.text:
You are the Avatar, the human embodiment of light and peace and master of the elements. Not only can you bend the four standard elements of fire, air, water and earth, but you can also bend life energy itself: With training, you can use this to give and take away bending to others. You also learn how to bend at an accelerated rate, about three times as quickly as an ordinary bender.

As the embodiment of the Avatar Spirit, when you die, you will reincarnate without memories for the rest of eternity, though you can recall memories from your past lives and commune with them with training. You also retain any other powers you have throughout your reincarnations.

Due to being part-spirit and possessing an innate connection to the Spirit World, you can communicate with spirits, as well as cross over into the Spirit World through meditation. Your greatest ability is the Avatar State, allowing you to harness the combined knowledge of all your previous incarnations, greatly increasing your capabilities (and temporarily negating any memory-removing drawbacks, if you have them). However, this does have one weakness: while in this state, the Avatar Spirit can be harmed. If you were to be killed while in the Avatar State, the cycle would break and the Avatar would cease to be.
objects.title: Avatar (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

addons.text: A radiant tattoo of celestial geometry across your back, its heart a divine crest. From this center, branching tattoos unfold across your body, woven from ancient runes, symbolic glyphs, and shifting script. As you act, grow, and challenge yourself, your Falna updates in real time. Every stat, skill, and spell becomes the root of something new: from each one, fine threads known as micro-bonds extend across your body, forming intricate lattices that grow with you. When you strike with strength, crimson lines unfurl from your original mark, building entirely new physical traits that deepen your raw power. When you cast with magic, cool blue threads spiral out, forming new magical circuits that eventually branch into unique skills to enhance your magic. As they stretch outward, they intersect with other bonds — and where they cross, something wholly new can emerge. The physical layout of your Falna — the way it wraps around your body, forms patterns, and branches outward — reshapes itself passively. It layers upon itself, each old mark remaining visible, like rings in a tree. The moment you gain a skill, spell, or developmental ability, it etches itself into your flesh as a unique tattoo. These tattoos are visual reflections of the moment you earned them.
addons.title: Mythic Falna

addons.text:
Your demigod nature has fundamentally altered how you gain and interact with Excelia. Your innate divinity has replaced the sliver of divine power normally required for a Familia Mark. This allows you to gain Excelia far more quickly than before, especially when performing actions related to your inherited domains. Furthermore, this change removes your Familia Mark entirely, making the process of Excelia conversion completely internal.

More importantly, you have gained access to a new stat called Divinity. By raising your Divinity, you strengthen your godly nature. At lower levels, increasing Divinity enhances your affinity with your parent’s domains and grants greater resistance to divine and magical effects. As your Divinity grows stronger, it begins to act as a multiplier for your other stats. Once your Divinity reaches sufficient strength, typically around Level 3, you gain the ability to grant Falna to others. However, since you are the source of this Falna, you may only bestow it a limited number of times dependent on the strength of your Divinity, and those who receive it can never reach the same Level as you. 

Note: If you have Child of Prophecy or Titan's Blood then your Divinity Stat will be far stronger and grow far quicker, to the point that you could grant Falna at Level 2.
addons.title: Mortal Arcanum

addons.text: Your Falna is now a living conduit to your Divine Patron, marking you as their chosen and channeling their essence directly into your being. Each time you level up, your patron’s power flows through the mark, enhancing your essence in ways that reflect their divine nature. Furthermore, acting in accordance with your patron’s tenets—be they good or bad—provides Excelia, accelerating your Falna’s growth and even unlocking unique blessings, Skills, and Developmental Abilities tied to their domain. Over time, your Falna becomes more than a record of progress; it is a miniature extension of your Patron’s will, storing fragments of miracles and allowing you to manifest their divine power through your own actions. If you are a Pantheon’s Chosen Envoy then your Falna becomes an irregular existence, linked to multiple Gods simultaneously with all the benefits that entails, namely an abundance of domains and divine power from which to grow.
addons.title: Patron's Mark

objects.text:
You've been imbued with a sliver of divinity, gaining a Familia mark on your back that starts at Level 1. This will allow you to go past the bounds of the typical mortal body by gaining Excelia by doing actions, such as fighting or researching magic.

Upon reaching a certain threshold of power, you can condense all that you are through a process known as leveling up. Leveling up resets your stats to zero while still retaining all previous growth. You will be able to update your status in times of rest.

You will be able to join a god or goddess's Familia with this and your abilities are displayed on your Falna. You cannot lose your Falna and no being can seal it or remove it.

You have no spell slot limitations and will gain a new spell each time you level up. You can gain Skills and Developmental Abilities this way.
objects.title: Falna (DanMachi)

addons.text:
You have now gained access to all forms of magic found in the Percy Jackson Universe. The two most notable magics you gain access to are Egyptian magic and Norse magic. You have beginner-level mastery in both of these fields but are very talented in them.

Egyptian magic accesses the duat, which is a deeper layer of reality where magic resides, to cast spells, which, if overused without caution, can burn their life force to ashes. You also can optionally have Pharoah Blood, which not only increases your talent in Egyptian magic but also makes it less risky to not only cast spells but also host gods. Some notable forms of Egyptian magic are direct duat manipulation, combat magic, the path of the gods, and divine words, but Egyptian magic is highly versatile and can do just about anything with enough time, energy, and training.

The most unique and powerful form of Egyptian magic is the Path of the Gods, which allows you to summon the power of a god through sympathetic connections and also to be inhabited by part of the spirit of an Egyptian deity. Hosting an Egyptian deity is a highly dangerous use of the Path of the Gods, with the deity being able to overpower weak users and take control, but even if you are strong, if you host them for too long, your body may be damaged and destroyed. At first, you can only summon the power and spirits of Egyptian deities at the level of Percy Jackson, but depending on their strength in your new world and with training, you may summon more power.

You also have access to two forms of Norse magic, namely Rune magic and Alf Seidr. Rune magic is very simple, allowing you to call upon the meaning of Norse runes in the form of magic in some way, shape, or form. This can be done by the user carving runes, chanting, or singing. After using the runes, they disappear while taking energy to cast the spell. Alf Seidr is elven magic, which is mainly wielded by Frey and his children and focuses on peace, healing, and growth. Unlike Frey's actual children, casting Alf Seidr is not only far harder and more draining, but it can only truly be used to great effect in the summer, with it being slightly weakened in the spring. You may only use Alf Seidr by channeling positive emotions.
addons.title: Myth Caster

addons.text: By your own merit and the will of the Gods, you have achieved the lofty goal sought by many mortals: ascension to the rank of the immortal Olympians. Although this only elevates you to the status of a minor deity, it grants you a range of benefits. You no longer need to sleep, eat, or drink, though you may do so if you desire. Your body will be impervious to mortal attacks and will heal rapidly from any injuries you sustain. More significantly, you will have the ability to draw power from worship and to shape your form as you wish, whether to resemble another person or to take on the appearance of an animal or creature of some description. You can also take your new ‘natural’ full form, bursting with radiant light so bright that any mortal gazing upon it will be reduced to ashes. To interact with mortals, you can take on a ‘lesser’ form of part of your power that can be safely viewed. As a God, you also have the ability to appear in multiple places so long as a domain of yours is being invoked, along with maintaining eternal youth and controlling your physical age at will. Lastly, you possess a Domain, albeit a minor one, likely connected in some way to your divine parent. Within the contexts of this domain, you are a near omnipotent being—you're able to use and manipulate it for a wide variety of reasons. Do be warned, by becoming one of the gods, by their works, you become bound by their rules for better or worse.
addons.title: Divine Ascension

addons.text: By your own strength and achievement, you’ve done the near impossible. You've achieved Apotheosis and risen to become a god—though not just any kind of god—but a major player in the Olympian Pantheon. This gives you all the many minor and more significant abilities of the Divine, along with some new ones. You gain near immunity to Fate, Time, and Destiny, with your powers growing significantly with worship. You now gain a major Domain, something significant enough for even the Gods to sit up and take notice of, though it would be wise not to take the same major Domain as any of the other major Gods, but you can do so if you're prepared for the consequences. With this also comes two more minor secondary domains loosely linked to your major one, something akin to an Archery domain linking to hunting, or a cooking domain to fire. Regardless of which domains you receive, you gain enough power to demand and receive a throne on the Olympian Council with all the powers, privileges and responsibilities it entails. Though you became one of the gods, it was by your power and efforts, rendering you unbound by their rules, for better or worse.
addons.title: Divine Apotheosis

addons.text: Through your knowledge of divine rites, you have gained a greater connection to your godly parent. This doesn't grant any more power in and of itself, but through this connection, you can sacrifice things or perform deeds to be granted a boon while also strengthening your godly parent. These boons can range from simply strengthening your demigod abilities, granting you access to more rare demigod abilities, divine artifacts, or even magically enhancing an object. The strength of these boons depends on the size of your sacrifice or the magnitude of your deeds, as well as the strength of your divine parent. Enhancements gained through feats or sacrifices cannot be fully taken from you because they were not just gifted but earned, but they can be heavily weakened if your divine parent pulls their support. Though there is potential for your parent to grant a boon without a sacrifice, your body and soul can only handle so much of their power without this channel. As your relationship deepens, you may even reach a point where you can request favors or temporarily boost your own abilities through prayer alone—essentially calling upon your parent for help in times of need. This power also guarantees that you will at least start on neutral terms with your parent. Note: By default, this connects to your settings version of your parent, but optionally you can change it to PJO.
addons.title: Love You Too Mom/Dad

addons.text:
You've kind of become an anomaly. You have the Ichor, you have the divine parentage—you should have become a God. But you didn't. Instead, you're three-fourths of the way there. This did not weaken you—no, it actually might have been the best possible outcome.

Unlike actual gods, you have the strength and might you would expect of a god, without any of the drawbacks such as needing faith to grow stronger. Instead, you grow more powerful over time while remaining slightly mortal—your flesh, for example, becomes more and more durable until you can eventually mimic the Curse of Achilles without any of the drawbacks. Your domains from your parent expand until you will eventually rival them in power, even beginning to tap into the domains of their family members. All without having to actually perform the duties of a god or submit to the masses to gather faith to grow stronger.

If you ever wish, you could completely ascend to godhood. But why would you want to?
addons.title: Wedge of Heaven

addons.text:
You are no ordinary Demigod from one of the pantheons of Percy Jackson. No, you are a Demigod born from one of the infinitely numerous gods from across the omniverse. You may select a single god from any source to become your Divine Parent.

Through your exceptional heritage, you can gain all kinds of powerful abilities. While your starting power will be limited to what an average Percy Jackson Demigod exhibits, that does not mean you cannot grow to insane levels of power, but it will require an exceptional amount of effort to reach the level of strength close to that of your Divine Parent.
addons.title: Omniversal Demigod

addons.text:
You receive a gift from the Goddess of the Hearth: a small, ancient wooden box, finely hand-carved with Greek symbols representing home and flame. When held, it always feels warm to the touch, and its fragrance evokes the subtle scent of wood smoke and toasted marshmallows.

Inside the box are 12 magical matches, crafted from blessed olive wood with reddish tips that glow softly when struck. Although they burn when used, the box automatically replenishes itself each time you return home, ensuring you always have matches ready.

When one of these matches is used to light a campfire, the flame becomes Hestia’s sacred fire. This flame emits a soft light that illuminates a ten-meter radius and lasts for one hour, imbued with magical properties. The heat adjusts to each person’s individual comfort, creating a warm and cozy atmosphere rather than a fixed ambient temperature. Its glow lifts the spirits of those nearby, eases fatigue, and encourages peaceful sleep. It also gradually purifies any exposed water, making it drinkable, and ensures that any food cooked near the flame never burns.

Any food eaten within the warmth of this fire has all negative effects removed, allowing people to eat without fear of allergies or poison. Even a mortal can safely consume the food and wine of the gods, without harm or discomfort.

Note: Marshmallows toasted over this fire always turn out perfectly—neither too soft nor too crispy.
addons.title: Hestia's Enchanted Matchbox

addons.text:
Normally, a Demigod's innate supernatural nature would negate their Innocence. In your case, however, that Innocence has been transformed into a form of metaphysical immunity based on the Ancient Laws.

This altered Innocence shields you from the direct interference of supernatural beings vastly more powerful than yourself, such as gods or other high-tier entities, unless they follow specific cosmic rules. If the rules aren't followed, the entity will face Karmic Backlash. Karmic Backlash is a punishment enforced by the universe, with the severity and duration depending on the extent of the violation. The most common form of punishment is temporarily weakening the entity or restricting their influence over mortals. The entity in question will sense if they would incur Karmic Backlash by an action taken against you.

The exact form of these Laws may vary between settings, but three universal Ancient Laws always apply in some capacity: the Law of Proportion, the Law of Just Cause, and the Law of Reciprocity. The Law of Proportion makes it so that a supernatural entity cannot directly attack you or intend to harm you with a power vastly beyond what you can reasonably oppose. The Law of Just Cause relaxes these restrictions if the entity has a valid metaphysical reason to intervene against you. Some examples include sworn oaths, cosmic obligations, or in the case of gods, violations of their Domains. The Law of Reciprocity loosens restrictions based on how much you escalate first. This includes, but is not limited to, attacking them, attempting to break into their home or place of power, or trying to steal from them.
addons.title: Ancient Laws

addons.text:
The Pantheons, be they Immortals or Demigods, are far weaker in the modern age than they ever were in the past. You are the exception to this rule and are much more like the Demigods of Old.

Most noticeably, this has resulted in your body being far stronger than that of any modern-day Demigod, even if you will likely never match Hercules' strength in his prime. While not strengthened, you also retain all the benefits of modern Demigods, most notably the active expression of their parents' domains.

If you have Child of Prophecy, you gain the potential to match the physical strength of Hercules in his prime, and your active expression of your parents' domains is also strengthened. Through both, you can and, if you survive long enough, eventually will surpass the strength of Hercules, the greatest Greek Demigod to have ever lived.
addons.title: Ancient Demi-God

objects.text:
You are now a demigod—also known as a half-blood—the end result of a mortal and a god having a child.

A demigod is visually indistinguishable from a human, though they typically inherit some characteristics from their divine parent, such as hair or eye color. You may freely choose which characteristics you inherit.

Due to the divine part of your nature, you will be stronger, faster, and more durable than an equivalent mortal, able to reach peak human abilities even as a young teen. Your divine heritage also grants you a much longer lifespan, should you survive your adventures at least.

You can choose which god you would be a demigod of, and which aspect of that god you inherit. Your inherited abilities will depend on which form your divine parent took, such as Poseidon’s capacity as God of the Sea or his role as the Lord of Horses. You’ll have the ability to control your divine parent’s domains in various ways, though the aspect you choose to be the child of will always be the strongest.

Like all demigods, you also gain access to demigod dreams, periodic dreams of importance—often a message from someone else, important events happening currently, or what may happen in the future. These dreams are generally uncontrollable and vague, but usually helpful or important in some way.

Next, half-bloods often inherit heightened senses and battle instincts—that are often likened to ADHD—and something akin to dyslexia, as their brains are naturally hard-wired to their divine parent's language. Due to your choices here, you can opt to have these traits or not, or even toggle them as needed.

Finally, demigods are considered quite the snack to many of the evil supernatural monsters out there. Greco-Roman demigods suffer under a curse cast by Lamia, which allows all monsters to easily track demigods down. You can optionally accept this curse and toggle it as needed.

Note: You can choose to be the demigod of any god from any pantheon, world, or franchise. It will affect you as if they were a god in the Percy Jackson universe. The deity in question will be at most as strong as Zeus or Odin from Percy Jackson.
objects.title: Demigod (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
You have gained the abilities, skills, and equipment of a Hunter of Artemis. First off, you are now ageless, have an enhanced physiology moderately above peak human, and can communicate with animals. You are also now a master hunter with 100 years of experience.

This includes knowledge of how to hunt and survive in harsher environments and even how to track and hunt monsters. Alongside this, you have gained a significant amount of knowledge in Greek mythology and mythological monsters in general.

You have also gained some magical equipment as a result of being a Hunter of Artemis. First off, you gain a small box that is about the size of a pack of chewing gum, which can expand to a full-sized tent by throwing it on the ground. By attempting to dismantle it, it will automatically revert to its box form. A flask of Moonwater that gives energy and power is similar to "six hours of sleep and a good hot meal" that refills at midnight. A magical parka that has the ability to keep you at the perfect temperature in any environment magically, muffle your sound, and grant you a form of magical stealth when you are inside forests. A basic, slightly enchanted silver-coated steel dagger that is sharper and more durable than naturally possible.

Lastly, you have gained a Silver Bow that disappears when you don't need it and reappears when it does. This silver bow can kill monsters and has an enchanted quiver that is bigger on the inside, full of 50 magical silver arrows that refill while in moonlight or at midnight. This quiver can also hold 50 separate arrows that you may instinctively choose from at will.

Note: The oath and gender requirement are optional.
objects.title: Hunter of Artemis (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
You have gained access to the power system of the Norse gods, which is called Saga.

A saga is a tale of your accomplishment, whether true or false. The recreation of important moments and major events in your story as abilities that you can draw upon. It is the distilled essence of the belief of others in you and what your story represents. This grants you abilities based on what you were famous for; the more widespread or stronger the belief in your legend is, the more powerful your abilities become.

Each saga has its own synchro rate which indicates how much you live up to the legend and how well you can use the ability the saga gives you, The higher the synchro rate the more skillfully you can use your ability and can even open up new ways to use your ability based on your interpretation and recontextualization of your legend.

You are not provided a saga in the beginning, but must earn one yourself by performing a feat that at least a hundred people know about or convincing a hundred people that you have done the feat. The saga you gain can only get stronger with fame, but not weaken due to the lack of it; the strength of the saga will always stay at the level of its peak popularity.
objects.title: Saga (Valhalla Saga)

objects.text:
You become infused by the planes and energies of pure goodness.
This changes your body and soul, for one thing it makes you moderately ‘more’ than a normal human in just about every which way, it also makes you incredibly and supernaturally beautiful, although not in a seductive manner, your beauty being more akin to a sacred piece of art. 

This beauty is supernatural in that it is not only due to your physical traits but also a supernatural tendency amongst all that view you to find your traits incredibly beautiful. Your very soul also becomes a thing of incredible beauty and value. 

You gain an incredible affinity for all things of light and goodness, you can feel peoples prayers and channel pure positive energy to heal and banish evil and corruption. You will find it very hard to be anything other than good and just to the people around you, it will not be impossible, but you will find that it goes against your base instincts. 

You can also call weak angels and celestials from the heavens, who will grow stronger as you do, to help you every so often, the can also be from the retinue of any good aligned deity if you choose to have your heritage specifically from them. although your bloodline cannot come directly from any greater or middling deity, you being at least several generations removed from them. 

You are even able to read/write/speak the beautiful language known as Celestial.

Your hair shines like metal, like pure heavenly gold if you are blond, and like the purest most sacred ruby if you have red hair, and so on. Your eyes also turn golden with a soft glow to them. 

You can at will turn off and on a radiant halo which appears around or behind your head and will buff and heal your allies, and the innocent who are hit by its light.
objects.title: Aasimar (D&D)

addons.text:
Your nature as a sun means that you are uniquely suited for a solar exaltation.

You start at essence level 5 instead of essence level 1. You also regenerate your essence at near-instantaneous speeds, as your generation of mystical energies is immense and unstoppable.
addons.title: Sol Invictus

addons.text:
When a Solar has a deep physical and spiritual bond with a Lunar, they are said to be bond-mates. A hidden charm would usually allow these exceptionally rare bond-mates to physically merge into a single being, represented by both the Solar's anima and the Lunar's spirit-animal; however, as an embodiment of both, the charm's full power is perpetually within you.

Although, as a kind of artificial version of the Hallowed Bond of Night and Flame, you can seamlessly split into your constituent bond-mates. Your Solar anima and lunar spirit-animal split into separate bodies. However, this is not the end. Should you have access to other Exaltations in addition to these, you can split these from you as well. Your constituent exaltations can be split to the level of a single, or distributed to these separate bodies, as long as the exaltations themselves are not split. Should these component exalts die, they will return to your nearest component.
addons.title: Hallowed Bond of Night and Flame

objects.text:
You are given a Solar Exaltation without the Great Curse and without age limits. You have the abilities of a Solar at character creation.

As an Exalted, you have "Charms," supernatural abilities which make you unbelievably and magically exceptional at things that you do, such as being able to leap several miles or being able to write a speech so impressive you're appointed leader of a country without even running for office. Charms also give you conceptual attacks and defenses comparable to Heroic Spirits from Fate, with Perfect Parries being able to do things like Block Sting, and Undodgeable Attacks being able to hit Contessa actively dodging you. Charms cost Essence, a resource you have a finite amount of per day, and must regenerate over time (usually while resting) or by doing something at least mildly impressive (called "Stunting" or "Stunts"). Using Essence from your Peripheral pool (ambient energy) rather than your Personal pool (internal energy) gives you an "Anima Flare", a bright anime power-up energy field that makes it obvious you're doing something supernatural, with the degree of the anima flare corresponding to the peripheral Essence spent.

As a Solar Exalted, your abilities are focused on being "excellent," with your Charms focusing on taking abilities you (or humans in general) already have and dialing them up to 11, like being such a strong Martial Artist that you can kill Endbringers, or having such a commanding and Charismatic presence that you can convince supervillains to turn themselves in.
objects.title: Solar Exalted (Exalted)

addons.text:
Air to Ash. Water to Blood. Earth to Void. Fire to Pyre. Wood to Bone. If willing to allow it, your Abyssal nature can warp the elemental powers of your Dragon-Blooded might as well as your once-Solar grace, granting you additional power over the corresponding "Aspect" of the Underworld as well as your Creation-given nature.

In addition, it offers fell alternatives to Terrestrial Charms, especially granting new and inventive uses of Cooperative Charms with fellow Deathknights, spectres and vestiges, and other forms of risen dead.
addons.title: Corpse-Dragon's Crown

objects.text:
You are an Abyssal without the Great Curse or Age limits, having the abilities of an Abyssal at character creation.

The Abyssals ride forth from the sunless lands on a pale horse, bearing black blades forged from the damned, and building lairs in the barrows of fallen kings. A Solar Exalted corrupted by the Deathlords, an Abyssal is made at the moment of their death, forsaking a name and their place among the living, existing only to bring doom and destruction. 

Almost all Abyssals serve a Deathlord, serving its designs and gaining favour as consequence. Those who escape their dread master meanwhile face little camaraderie in their aims, as necromancers and black-knights. 

The Charms of the Abyssal Exalted, being corrupted Solars, are much the same in theory, but all take twisted and corrupted forms of their old nature. World-Walking darkness, calling voids, necromantic upheavals and headstones flung like pebbles.

Where a Solar is an excellent and radiant being, an Abyssal is a corrupted and teething one. The ‘excellence’ of a Solar twisted to the dark ends of their masters.
objects.title: Abyssal Exalted (Exalted)

addons.text:
Not even the Terrestrials are safe from the twisted essence of the Yozai, either. Through your Infernal nature, you may "enhance" and similarly corrupt those Dragon-Blooded powers with the Hellish might of your Yozai progenitors as well.

The soldiers of Creation's Charms and other such elemental abilities can be tainted with the Hellish element of Vitriol, warping them into new and novel permutations by the seething, acidic substance of the fallen Primordials' prison... Or, if you wish, you can warp your Dragon-Blooded Exaltation into a completely new Aspect aligned with Hell, its new element that of Vitriol itself in both pure and impure states.
addons.title: Devil-Dragon's Mien

objects.text:
You are an Infernal without the Great Curse or age limits, having the abilities of an Infernal at character creation.

Once victims of injustice and betrayal, the Infernal Exalted stride across Creation seeking brutal vengeance, sweeping revolution, or temporal dominion. Serving the alien might of the Yozai with stolen Solar Exaltation, the Green Sun Princes remake the world in Hell’s image.

The Infernals brim with demonic might, their charms reflecting their nature as demon Iconoclasts, Anarchists and Seekers of Vengeance, toppling organisations and dominating their foes with the emerald light of the Yozai. They shape themselves into new forms, scrutinise vices, and create armies of devils to serve their whim.
objects.title: Infernal Exalted (Exalted)

addons.text:
Your existence as a moon makes you uniquely suited for a Lunar Exaltation.

You start at essence level 5 instead of essence level 1. You also regenerate your essence at near-instantaneous speeds, as your generation of mystical energies is immense and inviolable.
addons.title: Moon Born

objects.text:
You are given a Lunar Exaltation without the Great Curse and without age limits. You have the abilities of a Lunar at character creation.

You have Charms & Anima Flares similar to a Solar Exalted, but your abilities are more focused on shapeshifting and being mutable like the phases of the moon. You don't quite have the straightforward power of a Solar, but your shapeshifting makes you more versatile. You can gain new shapeshifting forms by ritually consuming the heart of species you wish to learn how to shapeshift into, known as their "Heart's Blood".

Because you probably do not have access to Creation, you gain the Heart's Blood of any animal from Creation your Knacks would have otherwise allowed you to shapeshift into for free, as long as it has no Earth equivalent.
objects.title: Lunar Exalted (Exalted)

objects.text:
You are given a Sidereal Exaltation without the Great Curse and without age limits. You have the abilities of a Sidereal at character creation.

You have Charms & Anima Flares similar to a Solar Exalted, but your abilities are more focused on fate and conceptual manipulation. You don't quite have the brute power of a Solar, but your fate and conceptual manipulation makes you a powerful reality warper. You can also selectively manipulate your Arcane Fate, meaning who remembers you, and what exactly they remember about you is up to you.

Despite the Loom of Fate not existing in most universes, you can manipulate fate as if it does. Your Exaltation makes this possible through Wyld Shaping. You are also no longer fated to die on a specific date like other Sidereals.
objects.title: Sidereal Exalted (Exalted)

objects.text:
You are a Getimian Exalted, you never truly existed, but were chosen and incarnated from a discarded destiny before the world was shaped. The Getimian Internal Alchemy that made you, allows you not only to break fate, but to reseam it into your pattern.

As an outsider plucked from an unrealised destiny, your ‘charms’ are dictated according to your fate, Not quite weaving destiny as a Sideral, but binding others to your once discarded fate, Getimian specialise in the breaking of fate and its thread, more akin to a corrupted Sideral, created outside of and opposed to fate’s whim as opposed to enforcing it. As such, Getimians can learn Sideral martial arts, enlightenments and further at the whims of their own internal alchemy. You tear apart what is and rip at the loom of fate replacing them with what might-have-been. 

Much like Exigents, Getimain are not so much one ‘type’ of Exalted as a collection of ‘could-have-been’ heroes, tyrants, and legends that have broken free. Whatever your aberrant destiny, you will only be on a matching level to a Sideral of similar strength.
objects.title: Getimian Exalted (Exalted)

objects.text:
You are given an Alchemical Exaltation with an immunity to the negative effects of Clarity. You have the abilities of an Alchemical during starting character creation. As Alchemicals are constructs of clay and brass given life and a soul rather than born, your body will be transformed appropriately, but will still be considered both fully human and a living being for supernatural/metaphysical purposes.

You have Charms & Anima flares similar to a Solar Exalted - unlike most other Exalted, your Charms are not learned supernatural abilities, but instead magitech artifacts surgically implanted into special “Charm Slots” in your body, granting you greater versatility over other Exalted at the expense of only being able to use so many Charms at once. While you would normally require a facility known as a vats complex to install your Charms, as you are purchasing this power with SP, you can instead develop Charms directly from your body as you grow in power, similar to regrowing broken Charms, and store them by displacing them to Elsewhere.

As an Alchemical, you start out weaker than most other Exalted, roughly on par with Dragon-Blooded, but at certain thresholds of power, you can undergo a transformation into much greater forms; first into a Colossus, a great machine up to 30 feet tall capable of using stronger Charms more akin to siege weaponry than ordinary implants, and then eventually a Patropolis/Metropolis, an entire living city whose Municipal Charms can comprise entire buildings and infrastructural elements. While ascending to the rank of Patropolis/Metropolis would normally require a connection to Autocthon and His systems, you are free from such limitations, instead being able to undergo metamorphosis in any area sufficiently rich or ‘charged’ in supernatural energies and/or resources.
objects.title: Alchemical Exalted (Exalted)

addons.text:
Your Terrestrial and Alchemical Exaltations have harmonized with each other in an odd synergy, further enhancing their powers: For your Terrestrial half, you gain an additional element from Autocthon alongside your original, depending on your Aspect and Caste. The second element can be used with or instead of your first, not just in in any ‘Elemental’ Charms you have, but also your Anima flares and even Aspect markings.

For your Alchemical half, not only are many of your Charms augmented to be capable of channeling your elemental powers in a variety of new and interesting ways, but you now also possess the knowledge to fashion new Alchemical Charms inspired by the Elemental Dragons and their Chosen; this even translates to the Charms of your Colossus and Patropolis/Metropolis forms.

(Note: The Elements of Autocthon and their equivalent Aspects/Castes are; Lightning (Fire/Orichalcum), Oil (Water/Moonsilver), Steam (Air/Starmetal), Metal (Earth/Jade), Crystal (Wood/Adamant), or Smoke (Soulsteel; no Creation equivalent, available to any Aspect))
addons.title: Machine-Dragon Symbiosis

objects.text:
You are given a Terrestrial Exaltation without age limits, and you have the abilities of a Dragon-Blood during starting character creation. 

You have Charms & Anima flares similar to a Celestial Exalted, but your abilities are much weaker, being closer to street level. You receive max rank in the Breeding background for free, and can learn Immaculate martial arts. You have powers related to one of Creation's five elements: Air, Water, Fire, Earth, & Wood. Unlike the other types of Exaltation, your descendants will inherit your abilities.
objects.title: Terrestrial Exalted (Exalted)

addons.text: Whether it is because your divine sponsor looked kindly upon you when they bestowed your Exigence, or because you simply proved to be exceptionally compatible with the spark of Exaltation, it seems that your Exigent abilities are now amplified significantly: Your Exigence is now roughly on the level of a Celestial Exalt such as the Lunars and Sidereals, not just in terms of raw power, but also versatility and breadth of abilities as well.
addons.title: Heavenly Destined Hero

addons.text: Even among the Exigent, you are truly unique. Your status as the Hierophant means many lesser gods have a vested interest in your success, and so a number of them teamed up to craft an Exigence the likes of which was never seen. Not only is your Exigence similar to a Solar Exaltation in terms of raw power, its breadth and versatility is unmatched, as it is shaped by the nature and domains of all of your patrons, and your divine magic can be used to temporarily gain abilities relating to further domains which you have mastered.
addons.title: Champion of the Four Directions

objects.text: ”Sometimes there is calamity beyond measure. Sometimes there is crisis beyond reckoning. Sometimes the world must have a champion, but does not. Then the gods themselves lift their faces to Heaven, and utter a prayer for deliverance.” You are given an Exigence without the Great Curse or age limits. You have the abilities of an Exigent during character creation. While Exigents have Charms & Anima flares similar to a Solar Exalted, their nature is different from most other Chosen in that they are less one type of Exalt so much as a collection of different types, due to the fact that their Sparks of Exaltation come from the many lesser gods of Creation. You may pick any god of Creation, past or present, to serve as the basis of your Exigence, with that god’s nature and domains shaping your Exaltation’s appearance, abilities, and Charms. Regardless of who you choose, you will only be on par with Terrestrial and Alchemical Exalted in terms of strength and versatility.
