(Note: Picking one of the Incarnae for your exigence will only result in you becoming a watered-down version of a Celestial or Solar Exalt, which is not advised. If you have any powers from a specific series, or have chosen to insert into that setting, you may pick any gods - or other sufficiently 'divine' beings - from that world for your Exigence)
objects.title: Exigent (Exalted)

objects.text:
You are one of the Raged Chosen, without the Great Curse & without age limits. You have the abilities of a Liminal during starting character creation.

The Liminals are made in death and set apart in creation. The Dead cannot be brought back but sometimes Creation puts something new in the shell. This is a Liminal. The Liminal are children of death, the most resilient of the Exalted, capable of restoring to life as long as their brain remains undamaged, capable of seeing, communicating with and touching the dead in all their forms. 

The Charms of the liminal centre on Death, the death of things, people, objects and civilisations, seeing them, touching them, understanding how they were and how they are, what their death has done and what it will do.
objects.title: Liminal Exalted (Exalted)

objects.text:
You may form a supernatural brotherhood with up to eight other willing individuals, binding yourselves together as sworn companions. This bond is far more than an oath or emotional attachment; it is a metaphysical connection that treats those within it as family, allowing the whole to become greater than the sum of its parts. Unlike the original Sworn Kinship, this power is not restricted to Dragon-Blooded, and any sapient beings may become part of the brotherhood.

While the brotherhood remains intact, all members are empowered whenever they work toward a common goal, with their abilities naturally complementing one another. Cooperation becomes almost instinctive, allowing members to coordinate their actions with extraordinary efficiency, cover each other's weaknesses, and accomplish things together that none of them could manage alone. Powers, skills, and supernatural abilities can interact in ways they normally could not, with the brotherhood instinctively finding ways to combine them into a more effective whole.

The bond also creates a profound sense of kinship between its members. Arguments, disagreements, and conflicting personalities do not disappear, but affection and loyalty remain beneath them, making genuine hatred or lasting estrangement between members extraordinarily difficult. Over time, the connection deepens naturally. Members begin anticipating each other's actions, finishing each other's sentences, recognizing thoughts and emotions without them being spoken, and eventually communicating through little more than shared intent. At its greatest depth, speech becomes almost unnecessary, as the members can coordinate as naturally as if they were parts of a single mind.

Every member can always sense the condition of their sworn companions. If one is threatened, injured, or otherwise placed in serious danger, all others immediately know it and gain a perfect sense of that member's location relative to themselves, regardless of distance. The death of a member is likewise impossible to mistake, striking the others with an unmistakable sense of loss.

The bond can be dissolved willingly by all involved or by you at any time, severing the supernatural connection without harming the former members. You may form a new brotherhood afterward whenever you wish.
objects.title: Sworn Brotherhood (Exalted)

addons.text: You have been granted all the powers of the endgame (including the DLC) Dragonborn from The Elder Scrolls: Skyrim. You have done all that can be done. There is nothing left. No quests are to be undertaken. There are no villains left to be slain. There are no challenges to face. As a son of Akatosh, you have done much, including, but not limited to, slaying Alduin, Killing Miraak, Lord Harkon, and many others. You've undergone adventures with the likes of the Dark Brotherhood and the Thieves Guild, learned magic at the College of Winterhold, or became a Vampire Lord or Werewolf in the fight against the Vampire threat or the Dawnguard. You may optionally acquire any of the Items that the Dragonborn obtained by the end of the game, including the DLC. Or perhaps you have done none of them, and your adventure still awaits you.
addons.title: The Last Dragonborn

addons.text:
You are not merely an endgame Dragonborn, you are a Dragonborn who - through the power of exploits and glitches - has completely shattered the constraints of logic and reason and taken the first steps towards Amaranth.

You have mastered every conceivable aspect of the world of The Elder Scrolls to their limit and beyond, you are a master Warrior, Alchemist, Archmage, Enchanter, Assassin, Smith, etc. From being able to forge Iron Daggers which deal 7 digit damage and are sharp enough to sever space to health and magicka pools so large they achieve integer overflow and become infinite, you have achieved power so great that to lesser beings you may seem omnipotent.

With this you possess the strength and skill to make gods look like ants compared to you. You have mastered every branch of magic, your Thu’um is strong enough to bring the world to its knees, and your strength is such that even the toughest of materials fold like paper, and yet through your System you can improve further still given time.
addons.title: Path to Amaranth

addons.text:
Dragons are steeped in power and magic, and those connected with them equally so. As one who has two different types of these bonds they complement each other well.

Eldunarí are containers for the souls and minds of dragons, as the Dovahkiin they are naturally an excellent source of power. However, because of their crystalized forms Eldunarí have a few additional uses. Firstly they contain the personality and will of their dragons. Additionally you may easily lend them to another as a source of magical energy. You can freely convert dragonsouls to Eldunarí and vice versa. One day with enough skill and power you can resurrect the dragons into new bodies.
    
Additionally your usage of the Thu’um and the Ancient Language compound on each other, with the Thu’um gaining the precision and finesse of the Gramarye, and being learnable by your bonded dragon. 

The Ancient Language now has power of it’s own, adding what could be described as tweaking, and adding smaller notes to the song of creation. It could now be a match for your dragon’s wild magic.

Lastly, instead of killing and eating the souls of the dragons you defeat, you may instead choose to form a bond with them, very similar to the ones between dragon and rider, though slightly weaker. Note that this does not guarantee loyalty of the defeated dragon, only encourages it.
addons.title: Draconic Heart and Soul

objects.text: Long has the Stormcrown languished, with no worthy brow to sit upon. By our breath we bestow it now to you in the name of Kyne, in the name of Shor, and in the name of Atmora of Old. You are Ysmir now, the Dragon of the North, hearken to it. You are a dragonborn, a mortal born with the blood and soul of a Dovah—a Dragon—and a child of Akatosh, the Dragon-God of Time. By your nature, you are a born hunter of dragons, able to bring a form of death to them by slaying their physical bodies and consuming their souls to gain their power. You have fluency in the language of the dragons and are capable of replicating any known Thu’um, as well as creating new ones as you see fit. With the ability to insert ‘notes’ into the ‘Song of Creation,’ a Thu’um can run the gamut from low-end to high-end reality warping, so use it with care. The use of Thu’um in quick succession—over a prolonged period—will leave you metaphysically drained. A regeneration power would mitigate this to some degree, but overuse will still be draining. One of the greatest powers of the Thu’um is its ability to name a Dovah. The use of a Dovah’s name allows you to call on them, summoning them to your side to aid you as needed. This still works in other worlds to summon such allies as Durnehviir or Odahviing to aid you. Unlike the mortal order known as the Greybeards, you retain full control over the power of your voice. It will never grow beyond your control or become too much for a mortal to hear. In other worlds, with other types of dragons, this power will still work, allowing you to kill those dragons, devour their souls, and gain their power. Yes, in theory, this means you could kill a dragon like Great Red from DxD and gain his power—good luck pulling it off, though.
objects.title: Dovahkiin (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text: You have Mantled Lorkhan in a way no Shezzarine has done before. You are not merely an Aspect of Lorkhan—you are Him, but also not, for the Missing God is not Missing because He is lost, but because He no longer exists at all. A hollow shell bereft of Soul and Mind, Lorkhan does not exist because there is nothing to exist, at least until you came along. You have absorbed the Heart of Shor and the Tools of Kagrenac in their entirety, taking in not only the Divine Spark but also a means of properly harnessing it—and in doing so have become the Soul and Mind of Lorkhan, the God Which Is No Longer Missing. While you have not yet awakened from the Dream and cemented your independence from the Dreamer, it wouldn’t take much to do so, and even now, you still possess some level of control over the state of your existence, capable of making the final decision as to what you are and aren’t. And lastly, remember that the greatest trick the Missing God ever performed was not creating the World, but convincing the World he ever existed in the first place.
addons.title: The Missing God

objects.text:
You are the reincarnation of an aspect of Lorkhan, the spirit of man.

Your ability to change and learn is astounding—astronomical, even. You can go from a non-combatant civilian to a demigod of war in weeks. You also seem supernaturally able to change the status quo, able to establish empires and inspire men to be better than they currently are.

Whether through leadership, combat, magic, or trickery—you are one of mankind's greatest champions.
objects.title: Shezzarine (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: Six are the walking ways. Six are the formula to heaven by violence. Six are the walking ways, enigma, enemy, teachers. Begat by precursor gods, come we now their creatures. Embody splendor in your name, and wisdom in your features. The Walking Ways are six interrelated means of achieving Apotheosis. Or attaining a mantle. Allowing for a state of transcendence and freedom from all known laws and mortal limitations of Convention created by the Aedra, as well as the corruptions of the black sea of Oblivion. All walking ways lead into and out of each other; to begin walking one, one naturally encounters the others. You can choose to start walking any of the ways described below as a beginner, or indeed perhaps walk a way entirely your own; perhaps that below exists merely to show you what not to do. Either way any path walked is long and hard. But the rewards are great indeed. The first of the walking ways, and described by Vehk as a wrong walking way, is the Numidium. The Numidium is an anti-creation. A rejection of the shaping of the Aurbis, which Shezzar brought about. Created from the hatred and disgust the Dwemeri felt for creation, it exists to counter and annihilate anything that it encounters via violence, physical, metaphysical, philosophical, and more. Powering an anti-creation takes nothing less than the heart of the world or at least something of roughly equivalent power. While this is not truly a path to heaven in and of itself, it can allow one to free oneself of the Ada-Mantia and therefore the laws which the Aedra have set in place for Nirn. Thus, this path can free you from divine and physical law. But beware that this path does not consume you. Second of the walking ways, and described by Vivec as a “sword the size of an ancient road.” Is the endeavor. It can be thought of as a long journey an enemy puts before you, but which you walk anyway. It is tied to the trials and adventures of a Hero, which test their character and cut them into better shapes, allowing them to attain apotheosis. Examples of people who have walked this way are the Nerevarine and, by extension, Nerevar, as well as Hjalti Early-Beard and the Prophet Veloth. It is tied to the Psijic Endeavor, by which mortals are tasked to overcome and surpass the gods which birthed them. It is the way to walk to achieve an Exodus through pain. As it is violence and suffering which brings one closer to one's true AE. This way was shaped by Lorhkan and conceived before time existed. It is to gain by losing. Lorhkan was willing to suffer, to lose his power and his heart to gain something new, Numantia. This is the formula to reach the heavens through violence via the Endeavour. Enigma, to Enemy, to Teacher. Remember it well. Third is the Prolix Tower, Word of Action. Exploring hysteria without fear by means of speech and writing. The Aurbis is made of words and thoughts. So too are thoughts and words made of meanings. And meanings spawn from the self-reflection of the AE. As meanings made the world, so too can they change it. Manipulation of the Earthbones is therefore possible through writing and speaking. The Towers, the Thu’um, Tonal architecture, and Earthbone Spinning are reflections of the walking way. Ysmir achieved his apotheosis this way, according to some. For if one can change the nature of the world, one may also change the nature of oneself. This way can perhaps be called “Story re-writing”. Fourth walking way, The Enantiomorph. First shown by the very first gradients of creation. All creation is subgradient. First was Void, which became split by AE, from which sprang the Two. These twin forces go by many names: Anu-Padomay, Anuiel-Sithis, Ak-El, Satak-Akel, Is-Is Not. Anuiel is the Everlasting Ineffable Light, Sithis is the Corrupting Inexpressible Action. In the middle is the Gray Maybe, Nirn, in Ehlnofex also known as the Aurbis. Two creates three, as it attempts to display duality, which by its nature is impossible. Thus creation subdivides. But what can be divided can be multiplied. Thus three can become two, and two can become one. Thus Wulfharth and Hjalti became Talos Stormcrown. Thus Zurin Arctus and Hjalti became Tiber Septim. Thus Wulfharth and Arctus became Ysmir. Thus, Wulfharth, Hjalti, Ysmir, Talos, Arctus, and Septim. Became TALOS. 5th is the Steps of the Dead. Walk like them until they must walk like you. To mantle another is to repeat their actions until you become one and the same. To experience life in their shoes completely and align yourself with them. Lorhkan united the Et-Ada through violence, deception, and persuasion; Talos united Tamriel through violence, deception, and persuasion. Thus TALOS and Lorhkan became one and the same. Lastly is CHIM. The final and most powerful apotheosis. The secret syllable of royalty. To understand CHIM is to return to the first brush of Anu and Padhome, when stasis and change intersected to create possibility. It is therefore to be free of any limitations. To reach CHIM is to take the secret of the tower. It is the existence of the True Self within the Universal Self. AE is I. I ARE ALL WE. What is the tower's secret? How to permanently exist beyond duplexity, antithesis, or trouble. This is not an easy concept, I know. Imagine being able to feel with all of your senses the relentless alien terror that is God and your place in it, which is everywhere and therefore nowhere, and realizing that it means the total dissolution of your individuality into boundless being. Imagine that and then still being able to say "I". The "I" is the Tower. This was the reason why Mundus was made. We are the hub, the Mundus that goes by many names. We are the heart of all creation. What does this mean? Why should we care? Lorkhan created it so that we could find what he did. In fact, and here is the secret: the hub is the reflection of its creators, the circle within the circle; only the border to ours is so much easier to see. Stand in its flux and remain whole of mind. Look at it sideways and see the secret and only true name of God. “I”. To start on the path of CHIM, learn to truly love yourself and all others as if they were you, because they are. Love is violence, violence is love. This is the Arena. Some however believe the CHIM is merely the precursor to the final path, to mantle the Godhead and reach Amaranth. To not merely achieve the Tower but what comes after. Those who do not fail become the new men; and individual beyond all AE, unerased and all-being. Jumping beyond the last bridge of existence is the last existence The Eternal I.
objects.title: The Walking Ways (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text: You can teach your students how to manifest a Shehai with ease, although only your True Students will be able to go as far as you can. Each student who learns the way of the Sword Spirit gives you an extra golden page when you receive their true gratitude. Each golden page used to advance your soul has twice the effect. You can shade your Shehai with anything stored or sealed within the Library, adding a unique power depending on the source of the tinge. The more a student learns from you, the more you can receive from shading your Shehai. You can give True Students your Shehai temporarily, allowing them to experience a skill of yours directly, or even as a life-saving move later on.
addons.title: A Teacher is Always Learning

addons.text: Your Shehai has transcended its limitations as a Spirit Sword and can now be used as an expression of your Reality Marble with all the conveniences of a Shehai. No longer will the world try to remove your Reality Marble for as long as it is fueled through your Shehai. This allows your Shehai to remain in the world even after it leaves your hand, existing as a true piece of your inner world made manifest. Your Reality-Infused Shehai will have its own unique abilities reflective of your Reality Marble. Just as you can shape how your Reality Marble is expressed, your Shehai is no longer constricted to a single shape, becoming more than a sword. If a spear, mace, or club is required, then it shall be. With enough experience, even a Bow would be possible. Your Shehai deals more than just physical damage; it attacks conceptually, dealing damage to spiritual and divine beings as well.
addons.title: Soul Manifested

addons.text: Your soul is strengthened to the point that it can handle Eternity, and it shows. Your Shehai is indestructible, requiring no effort to manifest. Eventually, you will be able to permanently manifest your Shehai. You have an affinity for Eternity and can develop abilities related to it with ease. Even starting off, you leave behind a slice of Eternity in each strike, meaning your Shehai's attacks cannot be healed with ease; to cut with your Shehai is to tell the world this is how it will be for the rest of time. Your swordsmanship is self-correcting and ever-growing, reducing the amount of energy required for every swing with more use. You will never lose your Shehai as a result of pushing too far, sinking entire continents at no cost, or giving an entire race an inborn heritable trait with no sacrifice.
addons.title: Eternity Weaponized

addons.text: You can create a Shehai of a True Student at any time. Not only will you have access to their skills, but you can also use their own style as if it were your own. These Shehai can either be wielded by you or by a shade of your True Student. The only exception to this is if a previous True Student of yours has decided to take home inside of their mark upon their death, then this is no mere shade wielding a Shehai, but the very creator fully actualized. If you use a living True Student’s Shehai, they will have the opportunity to receive your own insight into how they wield their Shehai.
addons.title: No Mere Shades

addons.text: Your soul is mutable enough to remain stable from a reasonable distance outside of your normal Reality Marble. This allows you to perform ranged attacks that you would otherwise be unable to do with only your Shehai and Reality Marble. This new branch of Soul is not about simple cause and effect, but an effort to convince the world. You instinctively develop your skill with your Shehai and Reality Marble into suitable Soul Arts. These Arts may not be a one-to-one translation of the original skill, requiring a different kind of nuance to remain true to the skill's intention. Your Arts are reliant on how concrete your willpower and skills are; an idea with no belief behind it means nothing in the face of Reality. These Arts can be cast at full strength from any point within your Reality Marble and even a little bit outside of it. Initially, there is a drop off after this point, similar to how you can hear a song in the distance but not be able to distinguish what it is.
addons.title: Soul Arts

objects.text: You are a Sword Singer, able to harden your soul and wield it as a spirit blade to incredible effect. Starting out, you will be capable of little more than rending your way through a small bandit clan. But as you grow in skill and power, you will be capable of ever more extraordinary and exotic effects. Eventually, you will boast a host of esoteric sword abilities, including the power to divide the indivisible.
objects.title: Shehai (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
When people talk about the indomitable human spirit, they are referring to you. You exemplify one of the greatest aspects of humanity: the will to never give up. With the greatest body of humanity and the Spirit of Humanity, your determination to overcome seemingly impossible challenges is truly extraordinary. Even if there is no foreseeable future where you can succeed, you have the ability to defy that reality and shape your own destiny. A 0% chance no longer means something is impossible to you; it simply signifies a difficult path. In your mind, even a 1% chance is as good as a 100% chance of success. As long as you can visualize your triumph, you can make it a reality.

This resilience is most potent when faced with high stakes. When the fate of humanity rests on your shoulders, you refuse to succumb to pressure. With a confident smile, you forge ahead, overcoming any obstacles that threaten mankind.

Furthermore, you have the option to revert your spiral power to its primal state at will. This reduces the strain on the universe caused by spiral energy to nothing, ensuring that the Spiral Nemesis is not a concern unless you desire it to be. Additionally, you possess the ability to unlock the potential for others to wield Spiral Power.
addons.title: The Spirit of Man

addons.text:
You gain knowledge of all the technology of both Spiral & Anti-Spiral civilizations. As is the nature of the Spiral, you also gain the ability to innovate on them further.

This includes Mecha like the Gunmen all the way to the Super Tengan Toppa Gurren Lagann, Anti-Spiral reality warping tools, & the various applications of Spiral Energy used in Lordgenome's Empire & New Kamina City.
addons.title: Lordgenome
Power of the Golden Spiral
addons.text:
The Golden Ratio, no, The Golden Spiral, it is present in so many places within nature, a pattern repeating again and again within the natural world. This is not some coincidence, it is a manifestation of Spiral Power, the energy that drives forward evolution itself.

The infinite energy contained within the Spin is not simply rotational energy, it is imbued with the infinite potential of Spiral Power. Mastery of the Spin will allow you to master Spiral Power, for the two are one and the same.

objects.text: You have in your very genetics the power of the universe and the future, the infinite potential; Spiral Power. You can accomplish and do practically anything, so long as you have confidence in yourself and the fact that you can do so. Your hotheadedness and determination determine your power; with enough heart and spirit, nothing is impossible for you. You also have a much tougher body and can come back from most injuries with little time. You can also naturally live for thousands of years.
objects.title: Spiral Power (Gurren Lagann)

addons.text:
You gain the complete knowledge and techniques of the Mu Clan on how to repair, craft, and even upgrade Cloths. This knowledge includes methods to repair Cloths from superficial damage to utter destruction. However, restoring a completely dead Cloth requires a dangerous amount of blood drawn from its wearer. How to craft entirely new Cloths which begin with a basis of Gamanium, Stardust Sand, Orichalcum, and divine blood. More powerful Cloths require even stronger, rarer material and much more divine blood. You also learn how to reforge and enhance Cloths to higher Tiers through complicated crafting techniques requiring a mix of esoteric materials, extreme amounts of Cosmo, and large amounts of Divine Blood.

To start, you are given masterwork tools and a small amount of materials, enough for you to craft a single Bronze Cloth, along with samples of more powerful materials. Such as a single extremely small vial of Divine Blood from a Deity on the level of Athena from Saint Seiya.
addons.title: Muvian Secrets

addons.text: Your golden ichor has been absorbed by your Cloth, elevating it to such a degree that it is like a single rank higher Cloth (Bronze-Silver-Gold-False God-True God). Should your Cloth ever be damaged or destroyed, your Ichor will be able to quickly repair and even enhance it. As your Ichor and Cosmo become stronger, so will your Cloth and with time may even evolve into higher rank Cloths, eventually becoming a True God Cloth.
addons.title: Promethean Cloth

addons.text:
You gain the Saints of Athena's most powerful ability: that of “Miracles”, whenever a Saint is pushed to the limit or losing a battle, a Miracle may occur by the burning of their Cosmo. This Miracle acts as extremely potent plot armor and makes one nearly unbeatable unless against an opponent comparable to their own power. Do note this power can be taxed and will fail if overly relied on.

Note this has nothing to do with the 7th Sense despite sharing a very similar name.
addons.title: Divine Miracles

addons.text: Your destined path to Godhood has synergized with the evolution of your Cosmo. You are now destined to reach the 9th Sense. The speed at which you awaken, grasp and master higher Senses is greatly increased. Upon your final ascension, your Cloth will evolve into a True God Cloth.
addons.title: The Cosmic Path

addons.text:
Normally, burning one's inner Cosmos can be dangerous to the user without the aid of a Clothe or other divine armor. But you have a nifty workaround thanks to the Hercules Method. This allows you to forcibly evolve your body to be able to get used to the imaginable power of Cosmo and eventually be able to handle the full power of your Cosmo without the need for outside aid in the form of special armor. This combination will, in fact, create a rather powerful synergy with your ability to consciously gain control over your own biology and enhance your mundane senses. This will help you master you gain and master each Sense much faster than normal.

You will be able to master your Sixth Sense extremely quickly with nearly zero effort, as the Sixth Sense is based upon mastering your internal Cosmo. Your Hercules Method-enhanced mundane senses will give you a moderate edge in unlocking and mastering your Seventh Sense. Lastly and most terrifyingly, this combination will help you discover and gain a sense of your own soul, allowing you to bypass the normal near-death requirement to unlock your Eighth Sense with enough effort.

With this combined power, you will be able to hit above your weight class as a Cosmo user. Gaining the ability to partially match a Cosmo user with a higher Sense in terms of physical and mental ability. However, you have the supreme edge in not needing to rely on an artifact to use your full strength.

Your body has become an engine by which you channel the power of the Cosmos to evolve your body and very existence as you slowly attain enlightenment and ascend towards divinity.
addons.title: Method of the Cosmos

objects.text:
All Matter is made of atoms and thus is connected to the greater universal Cosmo. With this logic, you gain an inner universe within you. You may “Burn” via exploding it to generate Cosmo, an insanely powerful and nigh-limitless energy source.

By Burning Cosmo, one can vastly increase their strength, speed, stamina, mental abilities, and senses beyond imagination. However, Cosmo does not offer any increase in durability and, in fact, can harm the user if they Burn too much Cosmo. When someone burns Cosmo, they release a massive amount of heat, acting as both a weapon and pseudo armor. With training, it is possible to generate other elements at extremely potent levels instead. Such as cold temperatures near absolute Zero at the 6th sense and true zero with the 7th and beyond with higher Senses. Cosmo may be used as a projectile or solid light constructs, and may also generate elemental attacks and effects with the right training and knowledge. Cosmo also grants an extremely potent ability to manipulate atoms. This ability is generally used to destroy things at an atomic level, but can also be used to create or change matter. Cosmo can also be used for Telekinesis, Telepathy, transformation, and anything given enough knowledge and training and a high enough Sense.

You begin with your 6th Sense unlocked and the strength of a Bronze Saint. Your Cosmo grants you strength equal to one ton of force and the ability to move at Mach one and possess the knowledge expected of a Bronze Saint in Cosmo usage.

You are also given a special armor known as a Cloth. Cloths are semi-sentient, powerful artifacts that allow a Cosmo user to burn their Cosmo without strain and enhance their Cosmo, and they will subtly assist them as they can. Cloths also have an Object Form which resembles a statue of whatever constellation it is named after. Each also comes with a Pandora Box, which may repair superficial damage to a Cloth that is placed inside it.

Each Cloth can also come with a special ability. You may pick a single Bronze Cloth from Saint Seiya Canon or create your custom Cloth with a theme of your choice. A Bronze Cloth has durability able to withstand forces up to 4 tons and covers roughly half of its wearer's body. Lower-ranking clothes only cover part of the body, but still provide slightly weaker protection to areas it does not cover. Only a Cosmo user can wear and use a Cloth, as otherwise it is impossibly heavy.

Cosmo is broken into levels based on Senses, with each more allowing one to further grasp reality and thus expand their Cosmos and ability to Burn their Cosmo.

The 6th Sense “Intuition” is unlocked when one can sense and begin training their Cosmo. Those who have unlocked their 6th Sense possess strength equal to 1-5 tons and the ability to move Mach 1-5. Bronze Saints possess abilities at a lower level, while Silver Saints are at the peak.

The 7th Sense “Miraculosity” is gained when one can grasp and connect to the Cosmo of the world around them. Those who have gained the seventh sense have strength anywhere from planetary to multi-solar system and can move at the speed of light to start, and can grow even faster. With extreme effort, one can travel to other local universes and realms.

The 8th sense, “Arayashiki”, can only be gained by being able to sense your soul, either by almost dying and burning your Cosmo to the limit and beyond. Or through a long period of deep introspection and training. Those who have succeeded in unlocking the eighth sense transcend death and can exist as only a soul and rebuild their body at will. They possess strength able to destroy multiple solar systems at a minimum and may grow to multiversal with mastery and a powerful enough Cloth. Those with the 8th sense may move countless times faster than the speed of light and can travel the universe and with time multiverse at will.

The 9th sense, Divinity or Supreme Virtue, is attained upon reaching enlightenment and is nearly impossible to achieve. Those who reach this Sense become full Gods, gaining appropriate domains that possess effectively limitless Strength and Speed. They can also freely manipulate reality with nearly no limits.

Whispers speak of even higher Senses that are held by only the most ancient gods and immortals.
objects.title: Cosmo (Saint Seiya)

objects.text:
You have now become the most powerful Flügel in history, even more powerful than Jibril. The power of the Flügel, created to slay gods, grants you transcendence over physical laws. You also gain superhuman strength, reflexes, unparalleled speed, & unassisted flight.

Your magical prowess defies mortal comprehension, truly earning a ranking superior to mere "Creatures". The weakness of Flügel magic, its lack of finesse and technique, does not exist for you, as your repertoire rivals the sophistication of the Elves themselves. This mastery of magic allows you to detect elementals and sense the use of magic, but it is in the art of teleportation that you excel most.

Even so, Heavenly Smite is your most formidable trump card. By concentrating nearby elementals, you can unleash attacks capable of leveling countries. Even using less than 5%, you can rend the sea asunder or continuously flatten an enemy city.

Immortality is yet another side benefit of being a Flügel. You are immune to disease, toxins, and physical or mental interference. You are nearly invulnerable to harm (for reference, this includes being immune to the explosion of a thermonuclear bomb), and you can regenerate from the gravest injuries totally unscathed, even without a Rite of Restoration.

You can also tap into the wisdom amassed by the Flügel. Your mind absorbs the race's collective knowledge, turning you into a walking Flügel encyclopedia. As a bonus, you are now fluent in over 700 languages, excel in intellectual challenges, and have no trouble learning new languages.
objects.title: Avant Heim (No Game No Life)

objects.text:
You are a Devilman, a hybrid being created from the fusion of a demon and a human. You are the host of the exemplar & most powerful member of the Demon race, Amon.

Even in your human form, you've been enhanced, able to run circles around Olympic athletes even while sandbagging, rip weaker demons to shreds with your bare hands, leap several stories high, gain sight through objects similar to comic book x-ray vision, general super-senses, the ability to sense other demons & supernatural beings, telepathy, the ability to spit flames, and the ability to completely regenerate from all but completely fatal injuries.

In your demon form, your strength and speed are enough to keep up with (but not defeat) that of Satan, a being who destroyed the moon in a single strike. This fight supposedly caused seas to boil, continents to sink, & mountains to crumble. You also have the secondary abilities of creating even more flame than the human form and in more ways (such as heat beams from the hands), electricity manipulation, phasing through objects, flight, the creation of powerful winds or kinetic force by yelling or flapping one's wings, the creation of psychic force fields & telekinesis, time travel, dimensional travel, extending one's limbs, & changing size.
objects.title: Are Wa Debiru... (Devilman Series)

objects.text:
The Mark of the Wanderer now graces your brow. It is an ancient rune of protection, first used upon Cain as a divine punishment by God himself. This protection is truly impenetrable by anything short of an omnipotent being. Anyone attempting to, or succeeding at doing you harm will find their efforts returned upon them sevenfold.

This reflected harm is conceptual in nature. A normal human might find their punch throwing them across the room with a broken arm. But a Demon Lord dealing a grievous blow will find themselves swiftly turned into a pillar of salt.

Having been marked to wander eternally by God, you are immune to the ravages of time and are completely incapable of doing yourself intentional harm.
objects.title: Mark of Cain (Mortal Instruments)

objects.text:
Charyeok, also known as Borrowed Power, is power gained from a contract with a higher power. This higher power can be a god, demon, ghost, mythical creature, or legendary figure. There are seven different ‘classes’ of contracts.

Individuals can enhance their physical strength, speed, and durability at no cost. Further activating the contract draws from the user's life/biological energy. Tapping into extraordinary abilities, special techniques, or magical powers associated with their chosen higher power is also possible.

The range of high powers is incredibly diverse, drawing inspiration from various mythologies, folklore, and religious traditions. Users can summon and utilize the abilities of gods, goddesses, demons, legendary warriors, and other supernatural beings. These abilities can vary greatly, ranging from elemental manipulation, shape-shifting, energy projection, and mastery of various combat techniques.

You may choose the entity with which you make a contract. This contract cannot be broken or interfered with.
objects.title: Charyeok (The God of High School)

objects.text:
Lucifer has surgically implanted you with Magatama, demonic leeches that magically alter your body and soul to become more powerful, growing with experience to make you a being that can kill Gods. This has no upper limit, with the original Demifiend growing in power until he killed a being that created and destroyed billions of universes every second.

The Magatama also gives you unique abilities and magic as they grow, such as being immune to all physical damage, or being able to cast mass Almighty "make your save or die" attacks, not to mention increasing your stats.

You need no equipment to perform the feats of the COMP or Demonica, being able to negotiate with, bind, and fuse demons yourself.

You start at level 1, slightly above peak human and barely able to kill nature spirits, but you start with all of the Magatama unlocked, giving you a boost to your starting power that the original Demifiend only received on New Game Plus.
objects.title: Demifiend (Shin Megami Tensei)

objects.text:
You have fused your being with a demon, combining a demon's power and Immortality with a human's self-awareness and Knowledge of good and evil, allowing your body and soul to become more powerful, growing with experience to make you a being that can kill Gods. This has no upper limit, with some Nahobino growing in power until they could dethrone their universe's most powerful god.

You can grant yourself new abilities known as "Miracles" with Glory, a resource earned through your deeds. This is on top of and separate from the skills you will learn & power you will gain from experience, as other demons do.

You need no equipment to perform the feats of the COMP or Demonica, being able to negotiate with, bind, and fuse demons yourself. In fact, being partly a demon, you can fuse yourself with certain demons to gain their Essence.

You start at level 1, slightly above peak human and barely able to kill Imps.
objects.title: Nahobino (Shin Megami Tensei)

addons.text: You have gained complete knowledge of the technology and magitech of the Disgaea multiverse, such as that used by Captain Gordon and Jennifer in the Human World, the weapons of the Netherworld War, the gates and seals used by the Angels of Celestia, & even the goofy tokusatsu technology of the Prism Rangers and Unlosing Ranger.
addons.title: Thursday (Disgaea)

objects.text:
The previous Overlord of your universe's Netherworld has kicked the bucket (or maybe not? The rules are a little inconsistent), granting you the title.

You are now a powerful Demon, stronger than the previous Overlord and all of the many demons and other beings in your service (otherwise, they would have overthrown you already). You also have power over a Netherworld, a pocket dimension which you can modify to your taste, though you do need to pass a bill in the Dark Assembly (or whatever the equivalent is in your Netherworld, such as the Homeroom in Evil Academy) to do so.

This includes various Shops, The Item World (a portal into any item you own, where you may enhance it by going through a dungeon, with each floor corresponding to how much the item is upgraded), the Innocents Farm (another method of improving items by imbuing them with spirits), a portal that can go to any dimensions you are not barred from, an interdimensional mail service, the creation of new servants, reincarnation from level one to improve you or your servants' stats and accelerate your or your servants' improvement, and many more things besides. This does not even mention the many things possible through the Dark Assembly itself.

Your stats are equal to an endgame character or superboss, and you're versatile enough to learn the many abilities available to characters in the Disgaea multiverse, even other Evilities (unique passive abilities of specific beings) & Overloads (the same, but for active abilities), so feel free to experiment, and don't feel pigeon-holed into one class, archetype, race, or even type of Overlord. However, in typical Disgaea fashion, it might require some grinding or starting over from level one to fully realize this potential.
objects.title: Netherworld Overlord (Disgaea)

objects.text:
You become a Celestial Brush God. This gives you the ability to rewrite reality using your divine power and some skill. You can do this by stopping time and writing upon reality what you wish to create, change or destroy. You also, as a god, have an innate connection with nature, and all things within it will recognize your authority and power and rightly defer to you. Your power grows the more you help nature and the world, granting you more faith and therefore power. All things can grant faith, but helping humans and other sentients grants the most.

Mortal weapons and powers can no longer hurt you.

You can choose an animal form that you can change in and out of at will.

Note: You use your divine powers in the form of brush techniques. You start with knowledge and skill with one, but can expand on this by using and experimenting with your powers.
objects.title: Celestial Brush God (Okami)

addons.text:
"O child of Pandora, thou hast proven thyself worthy of mine blessing. Hahaha! Take thine prize in full and grow—feast upon mine flesh! Grow, and let thy strength burgeon! We shall meet again, Campione, and thou shalt find it far less easy, next time!"

For having bested the might of the Bull of Heaven and proving yourself worthy before its eyes, you have been bestowed the full breadth of his authority. Now, the boundless power of the winds, skies, and storms lies within your grasp, but how this immense might may manifest itself is up to the theme that defines you as a Campione. Yet, regardless of the path your authority takes, you're assured to hold some dominion over nature's fury.

Whenever you invoke this power, no matter its form, you're imbued with the strength to sunder nations and alter the fabric of the Earth itself. Holding the divine authority over the heavens, freely able to sculpt the world as you see fit—whether as an unrelenting destroyer, laying waste to vast swaths of land beneath the weight of your wrath, or as a tender gardener, nurturing the buds of renewal and coaxing new beginnings into life with a gentle touch. Your ultimate potential to shape the destiny of the realms knows no equal.
addons.title: Divine Beast of Sumer

addons.text:
“From the earth to the sky, it is I who has created all; thus, I say, let there be light.”

It seems, Campione, that thou have defeated yet another heretic god. Now, after claiming victory over another divine being, you have been granted the full extent of its authority over creation. However, this power begins small and will grow with time and effort.

You begin with the ability to create angels that possess strength comparable to your own with a single pair of wings. However, this initial power is merely the beginning. As you continue to refine your skills and deepen your understanding of your newfound authority, your ability to create these angels will evolve, enabling you to develop superior and more diverse creations beyond those seen in dxd. These angels can acquire additional wings.

With time, you can expand this knowledge, uncovering the secrets of the heavenly system and the various artefacts created by God. The power of your holy energy has surged dramatically due to its connection with your new Campione body and newfound authority.
addons.title: Everlasting Light

objects.text:
You have accomplished the impossible by slaying a deity as a mortal(?). As a result, you have become one of Pandora’s adopted children and gained several advantages. As a Campione, you possess a significantly enhanced physique, a natural aptitude for understanding any language, monstrous instincts, and a supernatural ability to recognize divine beings. You also have an extraordinary talent for combating gods, a substantial increase in mana, and innate Magic Resistance that rivals the gods, rendering most mortal magic ineffective against you and significantly reducing the potency of magical attacks from divine beings. 

Furthermore, your body has become nearly ageless, and you have accelerated healing abilities and enhanced magical senses if you did not possess them previously. You also resist fate and enjoy remarkable luck in all your endeavours. In summary, your transformation enhances every aspect of your being, and you gain a single [Authority] with which you are most compatible from any Heretic God you defeat. (Despite the term 'Heretic God' actual divinity is not a requirement for what they are. All creatures, beings, or even relics of myth and legend could be considered valid targets for this Rite of Usurpation).

However, not everything is roses. You attract the hostility of Gods and other divine beings. You and the gods are also more likely to attack each other on sight, without any means of diplomacy. Ordinarily, this power is only granted to mortal humans; however, you are an exception, becoming a Campione regardless of your species. 

Moreover, your powers are not dependent on Pandora. Since you have slain a deity on your own, you gain an appropriate [Authority] based on the deity you have defeated. (The [Authority] you acquire should be around the level of a country’s power at the start, and it can grow as you train with it.) Do beware of becoming complacent, as many Campiones have fallen after relying too heavily on their natural advantages since there are ways to circumvent them.
objects.title: Pandora's Child (Campione!)

addons.text: Well, it looks like you're spoiled for choice as when the Wizard SHAZAM went to make contracts with different Gods, he somehow didn't realize how popular you were with them. Instead of being stuck with one set of Gods (and certain legendary figures like King Solomon) you now can switch and change the set of Gods for your powers and they don't need to have a letter compatible with the letters in SHAZAM to be used by you.
addons.title: God of Gods

objects.text:
The Wizard Shazam has imbued you with the power of the Living Lightning. Saying the words "Shazam" changes you into your mental and physical peak, granting you your full potential; with children, this transforms them into an adult form. This further gives you the power of each god that gave their power to The Wizard; Solomon, Hercules, Atlas, Zeus, Achilles, and Mercury, further enhanced by The Wizard himself.

The Wisdom of Solomon grants you instant access to knowledge and directly advises you on all things. You gain the ability to speak any language, an eidetic memory, and a vast intellect.

From The Strength of Hercules, you gain a level of strength that is only matched by the likes of Superman or Wonder Woman.

From The Stamina of Atlas, you gain the ability to endure great physical exertion without tiring, have unlimited stamina, and survive without food, water, or any other sustenance. 

From The Power of Zeus, you gain Zeus’s lightning bolts, able to generate and manipulate the "Living Lightning", which is the magic lightning that transforms you into Shazam. You can project the energy from your fingertips and even use the lightning bolt as a weapon by dodging it and allowing it to strike an opponent or other target. You also possess great magical talent, and the power of healing.

From The Speed of Mercury, you gain speed and reflexes similar to those of someone enhanced with the Speed Force, and can keep up with the likes of Wally West and Barry Allen, as well as gaining the ability to fly.

From the Courage of Achilles, you gain the durability to take hits from the likes of Superman, and the courage to go through mind-altering effects like fear toxin with inhuman willpower.

Despite the mention of Billy Batson's pantheon, you can choose to have the Egyptian deities that power Black Adam's version of Shazam.
objects.title: Shazam (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Your Soul Self now becomes a completely sentient entity, with an entire personality of your choosing and full autonomy, similar to Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk: Dark Shadow. Unlike him, your Soul Self doesn't suffer the same weakness to light or pain, remains fully loyal to you, and has no range limit. 

You are capable of all the feats showcased by Dark Shadow, such as Black Fallen Angel for high-speed flight on par with Hawks, Black Abyss to coat the Soul Self around you as armor that amplifies your physical abilities, or its Berserk State by feeding it your negative emotions or letting it fester in darkness. This will also adapt to create new abilities tailored to you.

Thanks to these benefits, it's a much more effective helper in and out of battle and capable of far more advanced feats. It also makes a good friend, since it's literally "you".
addons.title: Dark Shadow (My Hero Academia)

addons.text:
Your Inner Beast now takes the place of your Soul Self, allowing it to manifest freely and act independently from you. While within your soul, it will double the power of your spectral avatar, shape itself, and act autonomously to best aid and guide you. While manifested, it will gain full power and control of the Soul Self, whilst still allowing you access to it's power.

Should the Soul Self be destroyed, it will regenerate much faster, and if you should be killed, you will eventually resurrect within the Soul Self's domain, and have a physical body also constructed for you in the real world. So long as both of you don't perish at the same time, you're effectively immortal.
addons.title: Soul Anima

addons.text: Your Soul-Self inherits the traits of your unique Soul, resulting not only in active and reactive adaptations, but also in the slow accumulation of sentience and consciousness. This new awareness of itself further enhances its already phenomenal development by making deliberate and calculated long term changes instead of only simple and short term ones fuelled by your desires. As an expression of your soul, and thus yourself, it understands you better than you do yourself. Making it adaptable as an almost perfect partner that can fill any role for you. As of now, it's still in its infancy stages, only capable of cold logic at worst and simple language at best in terms of communication and will make innovations based on what it calculates as your current "trajectory". But overtime, you can influence it to become more intelligent and profound in its adaptations. If you have Free Form Style, you can skip this stage entirely. Beginning with a fully completed, intelligent, and loyal anima with your best interests as its first priority, but will still operate with full autonomy.
addons.title: Smart Anima

addons.text:
Your powers as a Type Purple become greatly enhanced due to the power of your Soul-Self, acting as a nigh-endless well of souls you can freely mould as you wish, which will always regenerate after use. From this, you can easily create numerous spirit constructs from your own soul, which you can take a step further by splitting it into various fragments, making them stronger while granting them a degree of autonomy while remaining loyal to you. The more you pour into them, the greater the result, though keep in mind that this can lead to exhaustion at best or death at worst. 

You can absorb souls to increase and modify the power of your Soul-Self, making it no longer limited to its default shape and composition, instead becoming much more fluid and formless. It can go from a raven, to a shark, octopus, dragon, or even something more fantastical, eldritch, or imaginative. It can also wield the powers and other characteristics of its shape or be completely separate from them, though still limited by the strength of your own soul and the amount required to achieve them.

The pocket dimension within your Soul-Self can safely store any soul you've absorbed as well as summon or dismiss them with ease, and you can also modify and strengthen them overtime.
addons.title: Soulshifter

addons.text:
As expressions of your own soul, your Aura and Soul-Self become intertwined, increasing the strength of your own soul and the powers fueled by it. Your Aura becomes semi-autonomous, able to act on its own through manifesting a forcefield, channeling it into weapons, or preparing a strike before conscious thought reaches you. This is not precognition, simply raw protective instinct, or even vengeful aggression depending on your circumstances. Likewise, your Soul-Self becomes the purest expression of your Aura, able to become reinforced and augmented by it as your greatest construct.  

The Soul-Self can also possess weapons or other objects to strengthen them beyond the limits of normal Aura and even grant them sentience or become self animating. Upon awakening your Semblance, your Soul-Self evolves to become its conceptual embodiment, bringing out its full potential.
addons.title: Aura-Self
Soul Clones
addons.text:
Through the Soul Garden, you've learned to manifest the Soul-Selves of those within your storage and wield them as your own. Each soul within possesses a composition, set of powers, and overall shape unique to them and an optional consciousness that inhabits the spectral avatar they represent. Through Soulmind, you can manifest and control multiple of these Soul-Selves at once with full coordination, either acting as extensions of your will or autonomous beings fully loyal to you. 

Due to your innate soul manipulation, you can also cultivate and strengthen these souls overtime, have the Soul-Selves fuse into a stronger form, split them apart to create variations, deconstruct and rebuild them anew, and much more.

objects.text:
You have the ability to manifest your Soul-Self, similar to Rachel Roth. Summoned through astral projection, the Soul-Self is a spectral avatar formed from your soul. Its shape and composition vary by individual—for example, Rachel Roth’s Soul-Self takes the form of a raven made of shadows. The Soul-Self can be projected as spectral energy to assist in battle, granting superhuman strength and durability capable of lifting cars. It can shapeshift, regenerate even after complete destruction, become intangible, possess others, and manipulate souls.

The Soul-Self also allows you—and others you bring with you—to teleport across vast distances and through dimensions, absorb people and objects into a pocket dimension, operate under your control across interstellar distances, and function as an extension of your senses. Your powers can be channeled through the Soul-Self, and in the event of your death, you may continue interacting with the world through it. While it is an extension of its creator, the Soul-Self can sometimes act independently, serving as an automatic defense mechanism when you are incapacitated. However, if your connection to your Soul-Self is severed, you lose most of your powers until it is restored.
objects.title: Soul-Self (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You have been imbued with the Light of Creation, similar to Kimiyo Hoshi. The Light of Creation is an aspect of The Presence that dates back to the dawn of existence, when there was nothing but the Great Darkness. This connection grants you the ability to control and manipulate all forms of light at extraordinary levels of output. Although your initial power is greatly diminished compared to its true potential, you are still capable of feats such as generating enough energy to power all of Metropolis on your own. One day, you may unlock your full potential, though doing so will require extensive practice, deep self-reflection, emotional growth, and a very long time.

You are capable of projecting blasts of light with immense destructive force. These blasts can vary in type, allowing for versatility in combat; for instance, Doctor Light once replicated the light of an orange star to depower a Bizarro Supergirl. Such blasts are especially effective against the Great Darkness and its manifestations. At her peak, Doctor Light effortlessly exorcised the Great Darkness from Justice Incarnate. You can also create constructs of light, though not as complex as a Green Lantern's. The most intricate creation Doctor Light managed was a group of humanoid "light men."

Additionally, you can absorb any light-based attack and re-release it with amplified power. For example, Doctor Light absorbed Power Girl’s heat vision and redirected it as a more powerful beam, strong enough to obliterate an Anti-Monitor's gestalt Shadow Demon. Your absorption ability extends to stellar energy, allowing you to safely absorb and discharge energy from stars. You can transform your body into pure light, enabling you to move at incredible speeds while remaining intangible.

Finally, your senses have been enhanced by the light, granting you the ability to scan the entire electromagnetic spectrum and perceive infrared. This also includes a unique sixth sense that allows you to feel the presence of light around you, providing heightened situational awareness. With this, you can even detect attacks from behind, making you a nearly untouchable force in battle.
objects.title: Light Energy Conduit (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You have become the host of a shard of the Spectre Force, also known as Aztar, the Spirit of Vengeance and the wrath of The Presence made manifest. As its vessel, you are permanently bound to it, and your role is to serve as the Spectre's empathetic half as you enact judgment upon evildoers.

However, because you host only a shard, you wield only a sliver of the entity's true power. As the Spectre, you are granted a superhuman physiology, with strength, durability, speed, agility, stamina, and senses rivaling those of a Kryptonian. This also grants you biological immortality and the ability to fly at supersonic and even faster-than-light speeds.

You also become the vessel of unfathomable magical power, granting you the ability to cast spells with power rivaling that of the greatest sorcerers. This allows you to perform feats such as perceiving spiritual beings, manipulating any form of energy, shapeshifting, altering your size, using telepathy and telekinesis, and traveling across dimensions.

As the Spirit of Vengeance, you possess cosmic awareness and can sense nearby acts of evil, as well as when innocent blood has been shed. You may also draw upon Aztar's vast occult knowledge, including the history of countless rituals, demonology, and other supernatural lore.

However, it is important to remember that the Spectre is bound by divine laws. Violating these laws would result in punishment from The Presence through your connection to the Spectre Force. Furthermore, the Spectre can be harmed—or even slain—by sufficiently powerful magical forces or beings possessing overwhelming raw power.

Over time, as you carry out your duties as the divine instrument of vengeance and grow more accustomed to your powers, your shard of the Spectre Force will gradually become stronger, eventually allowing you to attain the full power once possessed by the complete Spectre. However, achieving this will require extensive practice, and while the greater the evil of those you punish, the faster your shard will grow, its growth will still be a long and gradual process.
objects.title: Spectre Force (DC Comics)

addons.text: You have unlocked your true demonic potential, becoming a being equal to the greatest demon lords such as Mephisto or Dormammu. This comes with a powerful mastery of magic (including that of Hell and the Dark Dimension), Faltine physiology on top of your demonic power, an overall enhancement to your reality warping, an ability to create binding contracts between yourself and others that create 100 percent "stable" reality warps in service to the contract, your own "Dark Dimension" which you are master of (allowing you to ignore anti-magic the same way Clea does), and the creation of lesser demons.
addons.title: The Devil's In The Details (Marvel)

addons.text:
The plane within the Sun stone has been adapted to contain not only the former wielders of the Sunstone, but also the souls of the damned. 

Now acting as your own personal demiplane, the Sun stone can store any souls you consume as a Ghost Rider, even allowing your Penance State to act as a gateway into it. From this pocket plane the souls within can be used to fuel any number of magical spells or even enhance the Rogue Sun armour itself. Theoretically you could even turn the Sun Stone into a kind of Afterlife of its own with enough power behind it (though this would require quite a bit of spiritual infrastructure)

Additionally, your Hellfire can infect the armour itself supercharging it in much the same way it can vehicles, turning it into a truly fearful artifact in your hands.
addons.title: Midnight Sun
I BREAK WITH MANY HANDS
addons.text: “I HOWL WITH MANY MOUTHS I BREAK WITH MANY HANDS THEY ARE THEMSELVES, BUT THEY ARE ALSO ME” Your Spirit of Vengeance is not a mere demon, but a shard of the under-thing, the reflection of the creator The One Below All. Drawing your power from the Green Door and the endless below-place beyond it, you’re infused with gamma-energy to such an extent that any expression it’s had is available to your weaponisation, only aided by your shard of the One Below whispering into your ear about all you could do. Infusing your penance stare to burn people’s souls out from the inside, wreathing your chains in something older than hellfire to corrupt and enslave victims, opening gateways on this earth to that terrible place. You can even command the door to an extent, closing its access to others, or opening it, granting them a cursed immortality of sorts all indebted to you and your shard. Similarly, anything you enhance, such as the usual vehicle of a Spirit of Vengeance would become a gamma form of itself, vastly more powerful than usual, though more amenable to ‘holding back’ the full might of the below-place through it.

objects.text:
A Spirit of Vengeance has been bound to your soul—whether the demon Zarathos or one of Heaven’s divine enforcers tasked with protecting mankind since ancient times. Unlike other Ghost Riders, your bond is unbreakable, and you can transform at will. In your Ghost Rider form, you become a fearsome entity with a flaming skull engulfed in hellfire.

As the Ghost Rider, you gain immense superhuman abilities, including strength, durability, stamina, speed, and reflexes. Under normal conditions, you can lift up to 25 tons, but you can increase your strength to immeasurable levels. You are virtually immune to injury, shrugging off blows from powerhouses like the Hulk, resisting extreme temperatures and pressures, surviving long falls, and ignoring gunfire entirely.

Your regenerative abilities are equally formidable. Even if your skull is shattered or your limbs destroyed, you can regenerate almost instantly. You cannot die from aging, and you possess limitless stamina, allowing you to fight indefinitely without tiring. Your reflexes are heightened to the point where you can dodge bullets with ease. Only divine weapons can truly harm you.

The Ghost Rider's signature power is the Penance Stare, which forces anyone who locks eyes with you to relive all the pain and suffering they’ve ever caused others—condemning them to endure that torment for eternity. This ability not only punishes but can also compel individuals to reveal information or reflect on their wrongdoings. However, it is ineffective against the truly innocent.

You can project and manipulate hellfire, a supernatural flame that burns the soul as well as the body. You can forge weapons or chains from it and imbue hellfire into vehicles or objects. You can also summon and control hellfire-enhanced chains that are virtually unbreakable, can cut through almost anything, and can manifest from any part of your body. Imbuing vehicles with hellfire transforms them into unstoppable Hell Vehicles, fast enough to outrun even Thor’s Mjolnir.

You can sense supernatural entities, detect and purge sin, and identify beings by their souls. You can manipulate and consume souls, create vortexes to travel between dimensions, use magic, and even grow in size. Though you retain full control over the Spirit of Vengeance, doing so limits its full potential. When you relinquish control, the Spirit’s power is unleashed—powerful enough to rival beings like Mephisto, Thor, and the Hulk. While your bond compels you to punish evil in proportion to the severity of the crime, it will never harm those it deems truly innocent.
objects.title: Spirit Of Vengeance (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have become the host of the Enigma Force, also known as Captain Universe and the Uni-Power, a powerful cosmic entity and the God of Light created by the Celestials as Knull's opposite. The Enigma Force is a protector of the abstract entity Eternity, an avatar of life, and, as living light, is also used by the Beyonders through their Concordance Engines to maintain the Multiverse from the Beyond.

The Uni-Power selects worthy hosts to bond with, bestowing its cosmic powers upon them. Those chosen become Captain Universe and gain access to the Uni-Power's memories, as well as the ability to choose their appearance while empowered. Through its bond with you, the Enigma Force grants you a variety of abilities, beginning with a superhuman physique that provides strength, durability, speed, and agility on par with some of the physically strongest beings in the universe, such as Thor and Captain Marvel.

The Enigma Force also grants you Uni-Vision, a form of cosmic awareness that allows you to perceive things on a subatomic level and across vast distances. Through Uni-Vision, you can communicate in all languages, grant others the ability to understand different languages, force someone to tell the truth, see through lies, perceive events happening throughout the cosmos, understand the inner workings of cosmic forces, and perceive the actions and decisions people have taken.

The Uni-Power also allows you to manipulate matter and energy at the atomic level. You can divert energy flows or convert them into different forms of energy, achieve flight by manipulating the flow of gravitons, and even contain the radioactive fallout of a nuclear meltdown with ease. The Uni-Power further enhances any powers and abilities you already possess, while protecting you from environmental hazards such as extreme temperatures and the vacuum of space. It can heal you from any disease or injury, resurrect the dead, and allow you to enter places that would normally be inaccessible to others, such as the Dreamtime.

As the God of Light, Captain Universe also possesses power over the Lightforce, which the Celestials harnessed to generate the Big Bang. Through the Lightforce, you can manipulate light itself, allowing you to produce heat and generate a cleansing energy capable of purging malignant substances, curing diseases—whether physical or supernatural—and treating mental instability and criminal inhibitions. You can also use the Lightforce to create various constructs, the most notable being All-Light, though it is not something you can simply manifest on the spot and instead must take your time creating.

Typically, the Enigma Force chooses hosts for one-time missions intended to resolve specific crises, abandoning them once the danger has passed. The Enigma Force is also tied to its native universe and becomes depowered if it leaves it. Unlike the original, however, the Enigma Force will never abandon you, nor will you become depowered for leaving your native universe. Even so, as the literal personification of the Lightforce, encompassing concepts such as honor, benevolence, compassion, nobility, and life itself, it would be very displeased if you used its power for personal gain or evil.
objects.title: Captain Universe (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Phoenix Force, one of the oldest cosmic entities, predates darkness and the universe itself. It stands as an immortal, indestructible, and mutable manifestation of the prime universal force of life. This cosmic entity is the nexus of all psionic energy throughout the Multiverse, originating from the void between states of being. The Phoenix embodies the cycle of life, death, and rebirth, serving as the spark that ignites creation and the flame that consumes it. Its "heart" is the White Hot Room.

Feared and revered, the Phoenix Force possesses the power to cut and regrow existence, capable of burning away what doesn't work. Typically, the Phoenix channels its power through hosts it bonds with, although it can just as easily bring destruction. In its corrupted form, it becomes the Dark Phoenix. Although, as a bonus, you can't lose control over the Phoenix Force, thus you won't become a Dark Phoenix unless you deem so. Upon the demise of the Phoenix and/or its host, they are reborn from a Phoenix Egg, residing in the White Hot Room.

Upon acquisition of this power, you are granted a permanent bond with the Phoenix Force, ensuring you never lose this power.

However, be aware that as the host of the Phoenix Force, you will sense and feel compelled to travel the cosmos to purify stagnated civilizations, planets, and whoever else, whose existence has become overdue. Upon their ashes, you will bring about the birth of new life, whose spark grows and innovates until they decay, and the cycle is repeated.

As the host of the Phoenix Force, you possess unparalleled psionic might, allowing you to manipulate matter and energy on a sub-atomic scale. Not only that, but you can also lift, pull, and manipulate objects of massive sizes, such as buildings or even cities. You have enough psionic might to even throw objects into orbit. Furthermore, you possess telepathy with a global range, surpassing even the greatest of telepaths, with not even gods capable of resisting you.

But that's not all; the Phoenix Force grants you the ability to generate and manipulate cosmic fire, travel through the stars unaided and faster than light, teleport to other planets and galaxies, emit concussive beams, resurrect the dead, generate, manipulate, and absorb any type of energy, manipulate life force, achieve immortality through unaging and resurrection in the White Hot Room, manipulate the weather, and even manipulate time.
objects.title: Phoenix Force (Marvel)

objects.text: You are the Vessel for a Shard of Adonalsium. This is a type of godhood centered around a concept such as Ruin, Preservation, Honor, Cultivation etc. It grants you access to a source of infinite energy, enhanced perspective and enough power to create and destroy worlds. Within minutes of having the power, you can move planets, alter biology, create microbes, and restructure landmasses. The Intent of the Shard can affect you, such as Honor making you more obsessive about keeping deals, or Preservation making you unable to destroy things directly.
objects.title: Shard of Adonalsium (Cosmere)

addons.text: You are able to form your Shehai from any part of your Aura; having your Spirit Sword suddenly form on your heel mid-kick is surprisingly effective. Aura has a profound effect on your Shehai, stabilizing it with the light of your soul, no longer requiring constant focus. You can awaken an individual's Shehai in a very similar manner to how Aura is awakened. As you have learned how to both protect and attack with your very soul, you experience twice the growth you otherwise would. The best defense is a good offense, and you take that to heart. You can sacrifice your Aura to improve your Shehai's capabilities. Initially, you are only able to sacrifice half of your Aura for a 25% boost to your Shehai. With time, you will be able to control exactly how much Aura is sacrificed, and even improve the conversion rate.
addons.title: Auric Blade

addons.text: Your Aura connects your soul to your body without tension. It is now easier for you to influence reality through your Aura. Your Aura is qualitatively better than the norm when it comes to efficiency, durability, and versatility. Additionally, your Aura's protections now extend to provide an incredible defense from non-physical attacks, including poisons, sickness, Trumps, Masters, Strangers, reality rewriters, and any power that directly affects others, so long as your Aura remains unbroken.
addons.title: Soul-Body Connection

addons.text: You have found a way to manipulate the copied Semblances you receive in the Classroom. This allows you to sacrifice specific parts of a Semblance to increase another aspect. You are now able to awaken your students to both Aura and Shehai at the same time, granting them an individualized form of Auric Blade. Your golden pages can now be used in much more esoteric manners, from permanently copying Semblances to creating a new power from a sealed object. Your ability to affect your Shehai using outside sources has increased tremendously; you are now able to affect your Aura with these bonuses. In combination with a golden page, you'd even find yourself capable of modifying your True Students Shehai with their permission.
addons.title: Redefined Restrictions

addons.text: Aura, Shehai, Marble, these words are terms lesser wielders use to try and identify Soul. Your soul no longer has any form limitations. You can use a brick as a sword, a spear as a shield, a marble as a mace; your intent no longer binds the shape of your Soul. You can manifest your Shehai more than once, although it will cost dramatically more at first; you may eventually adjust to this spiritual drain. Even having a Reality Marble filled with Swords akin to Unlimited Blade Works is possible (although don’t forget to give credit where credit is due). You may condense your Aura into solid pieces; through this, you can make Aura Armor, giving you the same benefits as normal Aura with a magnitude difference.
addons.title: Soul Unbound

addons.text: Now, when you light up your student's Aura, you also receive an additional golden page if given a student's true gratitude. Your students are guaranteed to awaken their Semblance even without your help; with your support, you can tailor Semblances not yet unlocked to smooth out inconsistencies and faults that would be unwanted. Any student taught by you in the use of Aura experiences a 10x growth multiplier during your teachings and receives a 2x passive growth multiplier. Your True Students can access your Classroom of Semblances, an archive of all your True Students' Semblances. Here, all of your True Students can temporarily access other True Students' Semblances, without sparing any additional energy; the shared Semblances will only be a facade of their normal strength. True Students can volunteer a portion of their Aura to gain a stronger connection with another's Semblance, eventually reaching the strength of the original owners.
addons.title: Classroom of Semblances

addons.text: The presence of Spiritual Power in your soul has synergistic effects with your Aura, stimulating it and making it grow to absurd levels. This has amplified the offense, defense, healing and all other abilities provided by your Aura. Moreover, due to the absurd amount of Aura and its healing capabilities, your lifespan has been increased to around 1000 years (around the level of Shinigami Captains), and this continues increasing with the increase in spiritual power of your soul. This also allows you to use all your powers that are restricted to your soul form in a physical body and increases the might of your Semblance to an unprecedented level.
addons.title: Mythical

addons.text: Aura is a manifestation of the Soul, and Stands are a manifestation of the Soul. Because you have both Aura and a Stand, this allows you to project your Stand alongside your Aura, allowing you to use the power of your Stand directly. When your Stand is damaged, your Aura will be damaged before your body is. Only when your Aura is broken can your body/Stand be damaged.
addons.title: Standbound Auranomaly

addons.text:
Apparently, Aura and Anima are different manifestations of the same phenomenon.

What this means for you is that your Aura and Anima are one, having the characteristics of both, though for the sake of convenience, it will be referred to as Aura.

Your Aura is much more effective, and using essence replenishes your Aura reserves, temporarily overcharging it if it’s full; the excess Aura will start fading as soon as you stop using essence, taking at most half an hour to recede to normal levels.

Additionally, your Semblance is augmented depending on your exaltation: a Solar's Semblance would get a big all-around performance boost, a Lunar's Semblance would be way more versatile/flexible, Terrestrials would have elemental effects based on their Aspect, etc, etc. You can also fuel your Semblance with essence, further strengthening it and even evolving it over time.
addons.title: Exalted Aura Supremacy

addons.text:
The properties of your Aura have merged with your paracausality, significantly enhancing their effects. As a result, your physical abilities experience a substantial improvement across the board, positively impacting your mental capabilities as well. The Light of your soul is now much brighter and has become more adaptable, durable, efficient, and versatile. For instance, you now have some resistance to esoteric effects like time stops or spatial distortions. Over time, you can potentially become immune to such effects, allowing you to exist in realms where time does not flow and space is a non-existent concept.

Your Paracausal ability to infuse light into your armor and weapons has been upgraded by your Aura. Now, their effects are multiplicative rather than additive. For example, previously, wearing street clothes or armor provided the same defensive properties, due to it scaling with your Light. Now, however, wearing armor of any kind will significantly enhance your defensive abilities. The same applies to your weapons: shooting a bow infused with your Light will cause considerable damage, but using a sniper rifle will cause even more devastating wounds.
