Your ghosts also gain from this, having unlocked their own Aura. They are now safeguarded by their light, enabling them to protect themselves if necessary. Their ability to heal you has also been enhanced, now allowing them to cure you of all wounds and illnesses, even mental ones.
addons.title: Lightbearer’s Glory

addons.text: The light of your soul has awakened, but what is the soul of a mortal compared to the soul of one with ichor in their bloodline? The combination of your divine heritage and awakened aura has significantly empowered both. Your aura reserves are now as large as they would be if you possessed Mythical. Similarly, this has amplified the offense, defense, healing and all other abilities provided by your Aura. As you grow in age and power, your lifespan might naturally increase due to this amplification, up to 200 years if you are merely a legacy or in the case of someone as powerful as Percy Jackson, perhaps as high as 500 years. Even mortal steel, if bathed in your aura, would be enough to threaten any being that would have otherwise not feared any metal less noble than Celestial Bronze, Imperial Gold or Stygian Iron. Similarly, such mythical metals will not ignore the flesh of mortals if bathed in your aura. Your semblance is both amplified and guaranteed to support your divine-sourced powers, whether by making your abilities more potent, increasing their versatility or your control, or providing secondary powers to support the usage of your primary divine gifts.
addons.title: Deific Aura

addons.text: Your Malleable/Smart Soul and Aura merge into a single adaptive system. Your Aura is no longer a fixed pool but a responsive extension of your soul, adjusting in real time to your intent and condition. Your defenses automatically shift, hardening against heavy impacts or dispersing to absorb and deflect force, reducing energy loss. Offensively, your Aura reinforces strikes at the right moment, increasing efficiency without conscious effort. Due to your soul's malleability you gain control over the “texture” of your Aura. It can become rigid like armor, elastic to absorb blows, sharp to enhance cutting edges, or fluid to flow around attacks. This applies to both your body and any Aura-infused weapons or constructs. Aura strain is mitigated through your soul’s resilience. Instead of shattering easily, your Aura can bend, redistribute damage, and recover faster, while your soul prevents permanent harm and stabilizes collapse states. Over time, your Aura learns and optimizes itself, improving energy flow, refining constructs, and enhancing Semblance use with minimal waste and faster response.
addons.title: Shifting Aura

addons.text:
Your Aura and Type Purple abilities merge into a unified system of spiritual energy control, becoming a refined medium for manipulating soul energy.

You can direct, shape, and compress Aura with far greater precision, treating it like a tangible spiritual substance. This allows you to form stable constructs, reinforce attacks, or layer defences with controlled density and flow rather than raw output.

Your perception of souls extends to Aura itself. You can read spiritual signatures, detect disturbances, and identify the intent or nature behind energy, improving awareness and targeting.

Your own soul manifestation becomes fully supported by Aura, increasing its stability, duration, and strength. Instead of brief, draining uses, you can maintain and shape it with consistent control.

External souls can be refined into usable spiritual energy and fed into your Aura, improving efficiency and reducing waste. This allows smoother integration of gathered soul matter into your constructs and techniques.

Your overall abilities shift from simple use to true manipulation of spiritual energy, combining Aura’s output with precise soul-based control.
addons.title: Aurora
Sublime Emanation
addons.text: The Halo of a student is a manifestation of their connection to the Sublime, the innermost core to their existence, one could even call it a reflection of their soul. For you this has become much more literal, with your Aura and Halo becoming two sides of the same coin; a manifestation of your soul (Sublime) reflected into the physical world. Aura and Mystic intertwine, strengthening each other. Your enhancements from your Aura and Halo compound, with Aura’s physical enhancements now considering your Halo-enhanced capabilities as the baselines and multiplying from there. Meanwhile, Aura’s ability to recover from being broken allows you to survive in the event your Halo is somehow destroyed, although the backlash will likely render you unconscious and temporarily catatonic. If you have Applied Mystic your Semblance will perfectly complement your Mystic and its abilities, and will be uniquely compatible with and receptive to the application of your Mystic’s power.

addons.title: Auric Light
addons.text: Your Aura acquired some of the properties of your Shin, giving it more malleability in how you use it. You may now "shift" aura from protecting the rest of your body to form Pseudo-Mangs and enhance the striking power of your blows, sacrificing protection for power. Unlike true Mang, these Pseudo-Mang incur no mental strain. The number you can create scales with the amount of Aura you possess, with each new ring requiring exponentially more Aura.

objects.text: “For it is in passing that we achieve immortality. Through this, we become a paragon of virtue and glory to rise above all. Infinite in distance and unbound by death, I release your soul, and by my shoulder, protect thee.” Aura, the lifeblood of every person, from the lowliest street urchin to the richest of merchants on Remnant, has now been awakened in you. It's the truest expression of one's soul, unique to each person in every way. Aura’s most basic abilities are an omnidirectional forcefield that protects a Huntsman’s body from harm until the amount of damage accumulated shatters the Aura into colourful motes and an all-around boost in physical capabilities, including healing minor wounds. More advanced abilities include suffusing your weapons and armour with your Aura to make them sharper, more durable and more reliable. In addition to this, creating Aura constructs such as shields and shockwaves is possible with enough training. In time, you will be able to unlock Aura in other people. Eventually, you may discover your Semblance, an exclusive ability to you that is fuelled by Aura. These abilities range from the power to amplify Aura to more conceptual Semblances, such as bad luck. Unlike some of the Hunters of Remnant, you won’t be left without a Semblance. Aura may also be used to power certain magical artifacts.
objects.title: Aura (RWBY)

objects.text:
Well aren’t you a curious little fella? Though it is now in your nature I suppose.

You have been turned into a semi-immortal cat with a diamond pattern design, capable of a great many things. Not only are you able to turn your body invisible, but you can also separate yourself into various ‘glitch-like’ pieces and levitate. You are also able to travel to anywhere you wish to go through a bright flash of teleportation, though only to places you have been to before.

But that’s not your most potent ability; you are able to look at a being’s ’Heart’ and determine their emotional and psychological state to determine whether or not they are ‘Broken’. If they are, you have the ability to ‘Heal’ them through giving a piece of yourself to them, though this doesn’t actually hurt you and is more symbolic than anything, which is signified through a glitch-like effect over their heart or their eyes. This can also be used to calm a person down from states of mania or fury.

Finally, you have two more combat oriented abilities. One is the ability to possess a person who is at their all time low and is ‘Broken’, allowing you to have access to all their skills and abilities, even if they are supposed to be entirely unique to the person in question like soul based powers. This possession can also be used if the target is willing. The second ability is to transform into an anthropomorphic ‘Battle Form’, which gives you incredible strength, speed, and agility.
objects.title: Curious Cat (RWBY)

addons.text: You do more than just teach students. When holding a lesson, you pass down a Legacy best fit for your students. These Legacies are custom-made for each student without any input. The Library of Heaven's Path cross-references both the Classroom of Semblances and the Marks that make up your Reality Marble during this creation process. You no longer require a student's true gratitude to form a golden page, as each student you teach now passively feeds into the Book of Heaven’s Path. The Book of Heaven’s Path is a golden book that holds a list of every single student you've taught and what they learned from you. When you rip a golden page from this book to use, the same page instead goes a dull off-white color while it waits to reform. Normally, it takes around a month for a page to return to its normal golden shine. The more a student learned from you, the more this recharge rate and students who give you their True Gratitude, half their own pages' refresh time. Golden pages can enact miracles, bringing the dead back to life en masse no matter the time since death. The number of people revivable is inversely proportional to the strength of the dead.
addons.title: Teaching Heals the Soul

addons.text: You are a Teacher, and Reality knows it. Each of your True Students has left a mark on your Reality Marble, be it as a constellation in the sky, a favorite plant, or a small rock reminiscent of one gifted to them decades ago by you. These marks allow you to access your True Students' power, although it will be flavored by whatever you taught them. An elemental manipulator that was taught how to make friends could result in a form of elemental control that helps bridge the gap between different conflicting powers. Your students are never gone for as long as you live; these marks will never degrade in strength and may even grow with enough use. You will never struggle to connect with people, always finding a way to help others and work through their problems. The marks may grow into phantasms of their creator, giving your students the possibility to never leave your side once they have passed on.
addons.title: Favorite Teacher

addons.text: You are to use all Semblances of True Students with ease; your Eternal Soul fuels the Classroom of Semblances, reducing the energy requirement from True Students while increasing the overall power of shared Semblances to their normal power. Each Student’s Semblance is enhanced due to the bleedthrough of your soul, granting them each Soul-Body Connection. Whatever you discover when using a True Students Semblance is refined and then passed on to them. This refinement occurs passively across the entire Classroom regardless of the current Semblance.
addons.title: A Proper Education

addons.text: Each of your students leaves behind a Concept that best fits them. These Concepts can be used for various purposes, although you will always find success when applying these Concepts to your Shehai. For example, a True Student with a burning love for fire could leave behind some aspect of Fire, allowing you to create a Shehai that represents this Concept, perpetually burning its own Concept til the end of time. No Concept doesn't exist, and while you may not know everyone's Concept on sight, you are certainly capable of nudging students in the right direction. You may only guide them, not earn it for them.
addons.title: Core Concepts

addons.text: Your soul and archive of knowledge are constantly being refined by your soul's light. The effects of your golden pages are qualitatively better than before. Each golden page enhances your soul by a magnitude compared to your old golden pages. You may even develop the powers of your students, without the weaknesses they suffer from; golden pages can allow you to gain these extra powers at a much faster rate.
addons.title: Eternal Refinement

addons.text: Your skill in alchemy has expanded, furthering your reach into the art. The library now catalogs and cross-references your alchemical creations, knowledge, and research. Showcasing all of their flaws, perfecting your recipes, and opening up new avenues to explore. You’re now also able to gain golden pages from making alchemical creations that mark a milestone or major achievement in your journey. Additionally, whenever you use a golden page on an alchemy-related subject, it performs to a higher degree than normal.
addons.title: Golden Creation

addons.text:
Your Gamer Power now grants access to an new feature: the Sect System, which allows you to gain power through additional methods, primarily by founding and developing sects.

You have also unlocked a new feature: the Sect Interface — a digital management dashboard that displays your sect’s statistics, active missions, spiritual energy levels, architectural status, treasury funds, member information, and other essential data.

You can earn Sect Points by exchanging experience points, recruiting or teaching disciples, completing missions, expanding territory, defeating enemies, discovering hidden realms, and more. The greater the potential, rarity, or talent of your disciples, the more points you will earn.

These points can be used in the special Sect Shop you now have, where you can create or purchase cultivation arts, combat and movement techniques, spells, and more. You can also use them to buy sect buildings, cultivation-supporting structures and items, secret realms, cultivation materials, weapons, valuable resources, and other treasures.

In addition, you can now view special details about anyone or anything you see or touch, including bloodlines, talent grades, hidden injuries, physiques, loyalty percentages, and more.
addons.title: The Sect System

objects.text:
You have the Library of Heaven's Path. This allows you to organize all of your knowledge in any way you want, as well as automatically infer any new knowledge from the information you already possess. Within the Library of Heaven's Path, your reading speed is more than a hundred times faster than it is outside.

Anything or anyone you look at or touch, the library will catalog and write a mental book about, with all their flaws and strengths presented. You can then use this knowledge to help others improve their skills and techniques, whether by guiding them through the pill-forging process to create perfect pills, identifying and correcting flaws in artifacts to enhance their quality, or teaching them how to properly perform a martial technique.

Another ability the Library possesses is to compile books of a similar nature together, and by taking the correct portions from each individual book, it is able to form flawless manuals.

Finally when you teach someone and receive their genuine gratitude, you will be given a Golden Page in your mental library.

The Golden Page has many uses, some of which include: enhancing your soul, instantly assimilate the contents of every book you have collected into your mind, purify and enhance bloodlines of others, seal anything within the Library in the form of a book, and temporarily materialize the Book of Heaven's Path, allowing you to wield it as a weapon to crush your enemies.
objects.title: Library of Heaven's Path (Library of Heaven's Path)

objects.text:
You gain the essence to embody the iconic hero from the world of Hollow Knight. Through this transformative ability, you can become a powerful humanoid bugman. With this transformation, you experience a significant increase in physical and mental capabilities, granting you unparalleled strength, agility, and heightened senses.

Embracing the Knight's Essence, you gain mastery in the art of weapon-wielding, effortlessly handling a variety of weapons with precision and skill. Alongside your formidable combat prowess, you gain the knowledge and proficiency to craft and utilize supernatural charms, enhancing your abilities and granting you unique advantages in battle. Furthermore, you tap into the essence of soul-based magic, enabling you to cast spells and manipulate the forces of the Hollow Knight's world to overcome obstacles and vanquish enemies.
objects.title: The Little Knight Who Dreams (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
You become a hollow vessel - an empty shell animated solely by the ancient Void. Your physical form is an artificial construct - a hollow shell of your own design: durable, but lifeless on its own. Your true self is a Shade contained within - Void given form.

You can repair damage to your shell through total concentration, drawing on the Void to mend cracks and rebuild lost sections. This process is not particularly time-consuming, taking anywhere from seconds for minor fixes to minutes for severe damage, but requires a moment of safety, as you are effectively immobilized for the duration.

Your "thoughts" arise not from a traditional mind but from the Shade within, making you detached and inscrutable - granting functional cognition without emotions, instincts, subconscious drives, or psychological vulnerabilities. This also renders you immune to mind-affecting influences - telepathy, fear inducements, charm effects, or emotional manipulation find no purchase, for you have no mind to think. Illusions or deceptions that exploit desires or fears appear transparent to you, for you have no will to break.

Lacking true life, emotions, or a soul, you exist as a perfect conduit for the Void's power. You do not age, eat, breathe, or sleep, as your existence is sustained purely by the Void. This empty existence also renders you immune to toxins and disease - for there is nothing within you to poison - while your shell is heavily resistant to environmental hazards like extreme temperatures, pressure, or vacuum. Even when shattered, you feel no pain, only the cold awareness of structural damage, for you have no voice to cry suffering.

Although you start without any magical abilities, your potential is limitless. As you deepen your connection to the Void, your ability to draw on its power increases. This enhances your physical speed, strength, and shell durability, eventually allowing you to project the Void outwards - manifesting tendrils, shockwaves, or briefly becoming intangible.

When your shell is shattered, the Shade within fractures as well. You reform at a safe location of your choice, but weakened: roughly one-third of your current strength is left behind. That lost fragment takes form as a feral Shade - a hostile remnant of yourself that haunts the site of your defeat, wielding the power you lost. Only you can destroy a feral Shade permanently and reclaim your power; others may scatter it, but it will reform. Repeated deaths spawn multiple feral Shades of varying strength; left unchecked, they are drawn together and merge, combining their power.

You must hunt down and destroy these echoes of yourself to become whole again. You will endure this cycle of death and violence endlessly, filling the world with your ghosts if you must - for no cost is too great.
objects.title: Hollow Vessel (Hollow Knight)

addons.text: As a being of magic whose appearance is shaped by your thoughts and Soul, a more malleable Soul naturally results in a more malleable body. By changing the ‘shape’ of your own Soul, you can induce minor changes in your appearance, such as altering your hair or making your teeth sharper. Your emotions and unconscious thoughts can also affect your appearance, although with time, you can learn to prevent this. Should you have Free Form Style or Pliable/Savant Soul, then you will no longer be restricted to minor changes, able to freely shape your body however you choose. However, this is purely a physical and mostly cosmetic transformation, so this can’t be used to give yourself Kryptonian physiology or a chakra system, although claws or even functional wings are fair game.
addons.title: Fluid Form

objects.text: You are one of UNDERTALE's monsters, a being of pure magic with a closely linked SOUL. Monsters come in all shapes imaginable, with your new form being generally something based on your subconscious thoughts. Other Perks, Drawbacks, and Powers will also come into play, and having Case 53 in particular, will heavily alter your form depending on your appearance and although you will not look human it can range from anthropomorphic to eldritch. Most monsters are weaker than humans physically, but fortunately for you, the remnants of your old SOUL kept you at least on a human level. Your monster SOUL is filled with potential, which allows you to use magic. Said magic is just as varied as each monster species, like manipulating fire or throwing magic bones, so your abilities may vary greatly, but they will naturally be quite strong; it'll be enough to kill someone. Moreover, one particularity of monsters is that their strength and durability fluctuate greatly depending on their emotional state. Hatred toward someone will empower you and greatly boost the lethality of your attacks, while refusing to fight could weaken you enough to become defenseless. In the same vein, the emotions of others can affect you, with strong killing intent and treason, in particular, being extremely dangerous to the point of one-shotting you if you don't steel yourself in preparation. One of your most fearsome abilities, however, is that you can take the SOUL of someone if they die right in front of you. Should you successfully take one of a human, your power would increase immensely. Finally, one last warning: DETERMINATION is dangerous for you. You can reasonably endure its effect due to the remnants of your old human SOUL, but your new body will melt down if you have too much, killing you very painfully. It is possible to survive having bigger amounts and even use it as a great power boost if you have Invictus, but you will need to be careful, as it is impossible to hold it indefinitely.
objects.title: Monster (Undertale)

addons.text:
Through gaining the powers of a Monster, your soul becomes malleable, allowing you to tap into the essence of other traits and harness their unique abilities. In addition to your core Determination ability, you can now wield the powers of Kindness, Justice, Patience, Bravery, Integrity, and Perseverance.

Kindness manifests as a vibrant green aura that acts as a force field. Through shaping it, you provide comprehensive protection in the form of a wall, sphere, or even as armor. While powerful attacks can be withstood, excessive damage will eventually break the shields.

Justice imbues your ranged attacks with tracking capabilities. They can change direction midair, relentlessly pursuing their target. Dodges and even teleportation won't help, as the attacks will adjust their course to relentlessly pursue the target for as long as you wish.

Patience grants you the ability to manipulate time and emotions. Slowing time around you to dodge incoming attacks, you gain an advantage in combat. You can also calm yourself and others, preventing emotions from clouding judgment and pacifying individuals in intense states.

Bravery fuels your determination with unmatched courage and speed. Tapping into this power grants incredible swiftness, almost as if you're teleporting, allowing you to charge fearlessly into battle. You develop resistance to fear-based and mental attacks, shielding your heart with determination.

Integrity radiates a "truth aura" from your determination. Conversations with you compel honesty, bypassing deception. Your unwavering commitment to your morals grants you resistance to mind control.

Perseverance endows your determination with unwavering resolve. You passively warp probability, allowing you to overcome any challenges with persistence. Exceptional resistance to pain enables you to forge ahead despite the toughest trials.
addons.title: The Human Potential

addons.text:
LOVE. It is an acronym meaning "Level of Violence." It is a measurement of someone's capacity to hurt. The higher a person's LOVE is, the stronger they are and the easier they can bring themself to hurt others. LOVE is increased via the gain of "Execution Points", otherwise known as EXP. Unlike other Gamer systems, the gain of EXP is also tied to how cruel and personal the kill is. For example, personally strangling someone to death will be worth a lot more EXP than mercy-killing someone being tortured.

After murdering an entire sapient species, you will reach LOVE 20 and gain the ability to ERASE. A power that lets the user wipe anything from existence up to entire planets. Particularly powerful beings will take longer periods of time to be deleted, with something like an Entity Avatar taking a full minute to be erased. Once a target is deleted, it cannot be restored or revived by any means unless the user allows it to be.

There is no cap for your LOVE, and your power to ERASE scales with your LOVE and overall strength, being faster and stronger the higher it is.
addons.title: L. O. V. E.

addons.text: Due to possessing a power from Glitchtale, your Determination Soul has gained its Glitchtale counterpart, manifesting weapons of Determination, magical constructs forged from Determination itself. What constitutes a weapon is a bit loose, as you can even manifest a skin-tight shield. If you possess The Human Potential, you may manifest constructs made from those traits as well, such as strings of Patience to slow and bind your opponents.
addons.title: Soul Weapons

addons.text: You gain the ability to awaken the souls of others, enchanting them with the power of a Soul Trait. This allows them to manifest the powers of soul traits such as Kindness, Justice, Patience, Bravery, Integrity, or Perseverance. Awakening the soul of another requires some magic to jumpstart the process, with the amount scaling based on the strength of the soul you are awakening. You can't control what trait they awaken, with that being decided by what traits match them as a person.
addons.title: Soulful Enchantment

addons.text:
As a Monster, DETERMINATION acts as a disrupting force that should be lethal to your Monster SOUL. Yet, be it due to a stroke of luck or the remnant of your old SOUL, you are somehow capable of withstanding its effects to an unreasonable degree, to a point where you can use it to fuel your magic and trigger a powerful transformation.
In this new form, not only are you much stronger than it should be possible for a Monster, but you are also in a sort of "undeath" state, preventing you from dying as long as you keep fueling your SOUL with DETERMINATION.

Beware, though, you aren't completely immune to the adverse effects it will bring on you as you use it to keep yourself alive. And although you can keep a steady use of this form without many consequences, overusing it will end up killing you as your SOUL ultimately succumbs to the corrosive effects that DETERMINATION has on Monsters.
addons.title: Undying

addons.text: Your ability to affect the physical world with willpower alone has allowed your Determination to take a more active twist. Now you can do more than just refuse Death, you can refuse anything provided your will remains unbroken, outright reject the influence of anything you do not permit to interact with you. With practice, you can even utilize this more offensively, utilizing your willpower to reject the very existence of something. For example, a shield imbued with your refusal effortlessly disperses attacks, even as a sword imbued with your rejection erases everything it touches. Of course, the strength of this is dependent on your willpower and Determination, so if your will isn’t strong enough to overcome the thing you’re trying to reject, then it will remain unaffected. With time and practice (and a lot of willpower), this can scale to abstract and esoteric levels, such as rejecting the existence of wounds or the passage of time. Of course, as the scale of your rejection increases, so too does the willpower needed to achieve it.
addons.title: But It Refused

addons.text:
The real power is the friends you make along the way. Literally, as you befriend more people, your DETERMINATION grows stronger and stronger. This makes you better at SAVEing and LOADing, as well as making you tougher (though not stronger) and boosting your recovery when you’re injured. With enough bonds, you can reduce the damage you take and recover your health just by focusing on your hopes and dreams.

By the time you’ve befriended an entire sapient species, you will gain access to the SAVE button, a power that allows you to bend reality to help others, surviving even the destruction of timelines and reaching out to the SOULs of others to bring them back, no matter how far gone they are. Whether they’re mind-controlled, dead, or even erased from existence, you can find them and restore them. Even for people who have been twisted by the result of their own actions, you can touch them with your compassion and pull them from their dark path, allowing them to redeem themselves.
addons.title: SAVE The World

objects.text:
You've gained the ability to SAVE, LOAD, and RESET. You can set a SAVE Point in time and space, which you will automatically return to if you die, and you will only truly die if you wish to.

When you create a new SAVE Point, it will permanently erase the old one, but you can choose to RESET at any time you wish, and it will send you back to when you first gained this power. You'll be able to jump through time at your leisure. However, there are a few drawbacks: strong-willed individuals might have feelings of deja vu after timeline alternations, and those with determination significantly higher than yours can cause your powers to fail.

With enough willpower, you will be able to circumvent those drawbacks via a TRUE RESET and refuse death entirely, staying alive long past when you should have perished through sheer DETERMINATION alone. This power also acts as a general willpower boost.
objects.title: DETERMINATION (Undertale)

addons.text:
Through gaining the human's DETERMINATION, your Monster-based power has become greatly strengthened, and allows you to develop new monster-based powers rapidly, expanding your repertoire of already formidable abilities.

Firstly, your power now grants you the unique physiology of W.D. Gaster. With this, you gain the ability to warp space-time around you, granting you the power of teleportation. You can instantly appear anywhere you desire, allowing for swift maneuverability and strategic positioning in battle.

Additionally, your power has evolved to include a second form called BOSS Monster. When activating this form, your already great power is supercharged. You gain the ability to warp space-time around you, creating a battle arena where your enemy cannot escape. Within this arena, you have full control over the environment, manipulating it to your advantage. Furthermore, all your attacks directly damage the soul of your opponent, making them even more devastating and difficult to defend against.
addons.title: Megalovania

addons.text: You possess the knowledge and means to create any of the technology shown in the game Undertale, from robot bodies that can be possessed by ghosts to geothermal reactors that can scatter people across time and space. Much of this tech base relies on magic to function and draws much inspiration from magic and the powers of Souls, meaning that with the right knowledge, you could replicate the functions of other Soul-based abilities and magic systems. If you possess The Abominable Substance, you also gain the knowledge of the technology from Glitchtale as well, which much more heavily interfaces with magic, such as shield devices powered by the magic of protection-aligned Souls.
addons.title: Monster Tech

objects.text:
You've been blessed by the greatest pun-loving skeleton known to man; this grants you a unique powerset that allows you to manipulate gravity, control bone-based attacks, summon formidable weapons known as Gaster Blasters, and unleash Karmic Retribution upon evildoers.

Firstly, you possess the ability to control gravity, granting you the power to manipulate the weight of objects and manipulate them in the air. You can make objects heavier, allowing you to throw them with great force or disrupt their movements at will.

Secondly, your mastery over bones manifests in a wide range of attacks. You can shoot bones towards your foes or create barriers to protect yourself. These bone-based attacks are imbued with a special energy akin to magic, making them exceptionally strong and formidable.

As an extension of your bone manipulation, you have the ability to summon Gaster Blasters. These powerful weapons take the form of floating dragon skulls and unleash devastating energy beams upon your enemies. Their destructive force is unparalleled and can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Lastly, your most crucial ability is Karmic Retribution. This power serves as a means to punish evildoers. It amplifies the damage you inflict based on the target's level of "evil" and the extent of harm they have caused to others. Against heroic individuals, this ability holds little effect, but when facing monsters or those of wicked intentions, the damage you can unleash becomes magnified exponentially.
objects.title: You Like Em Bad? Cause I'm Bad To The Bone (Undertale)

addons.text:
Your affinity for Negativity has synergized with and enhanced your affinity for HATE. Your threshold for over-usage of HATE now scales with your affinity for Negativity, vastly increasing the amount of HATE you can use before succumbing to corruption.

You can choose to spread your HATE to others within your range, although you do not gain any control over them. Still, this forms a feedback loop as your HATE causes negative emotions, which empower you and your ability to spread HATE.
addons.title: Essence of Hatred

objects.text:
Oh, you poor thing. Your soul has been tainted by the wretched substance known as HATE. HATE is the physical manifestation of the emotion of the same name, spawned from grief, pain, and rage, a black and viscous substance that corrupts all it touches.

Despite what the name suggests, this does have positives. The presence of HATE within you bolsters your body, enhancing your physical capabilities. Furthermore, HATE also boosts any magical or spiritual powers you possess, its loathing of life spurring the manifestations of your power to greater heights of destruction.

However, this does come at a cost. HATE’s corruptive nature drives its hosts to aggressive actions they would have otherwise wouldn’t have considered, and its disdain for life means that extensive and prolonged active usage causes physical backlash.

Finally, for most people, the more they use HATE, the harder it is to control it or stop using it until they eventually lose control. For you, however, over-usage carries less of a risk. You may use it more frequently than others without suffering the consequences, and spending some time without using it refreshes your self-control.
objects.title: The Abominable Substance (Undertale: Glitchtale)

addons.text: "Oh, boy. You've made a huge mistake." - X-Event Chara You have found out the true nature of Overwrite: Its power is derived from the SOUL. Due to your soul not being like those of human SOULs found in Undertale, you were limited in how you could use it. But now that you have a true SOUL, and one strong enough to SAVE and LOAD on top of that, you have unlocked the full power of OVERWRITE. OVERWRITE works basically identically to Overwrite, allowing you to alter any aspect of a reality and its inhabitants with the literal push of a button, but with a few differences. For one, the range has expanded massively, allowing you to potentially alter the entire universe and its timeline(s). This means you can make changes retroactive, meaning a time traveler can no longer undo your changes since the past is changed along with the present, and you can now reach into 'nearby' dimensions, such that pocket dimensions and other extradimensional spaces up to and including the local afterlife are within reach. Due to being complete, OVERWRITE now works properly as intended, so no more incomplete changes or failed activations. This also means that all changes are permanent unless you use OVERWRITE to reverse them, although other reality warpers could theoretically do the same. While powerful, OVERWRITE still has limits even now. You cannot reach into other, completely alternate universes to OVERWRITE them, so if you're in Worm, you could Change Earth Aleph or Earth Shin, but not Earth 616 over in Marvel. Beings that are 'unique', should not exist, or are stronger than you maintain their immunity/resistance to being directly OVERWRITEN. Finally, you still cannot Create, only Change.
addons.title: OVERWRITE (Undertale: X-Tale)

addons.text: "Just one universe, made of the best of the others. And I know how to do it." - XGaster Before, OVERWRITE still had limits. But, through becoming similar in nature to XGaster and then further enhanced through reaching the Zenith of Monsterkind, you have shattered those limits. Your range is now infinite, and where before you couldn’t affect ‘unique’ beings and those who should not exist due to being living paradoxes or because they did not have a ‘home’ universe, now you can change them as easily as anyone else. Not only that, but you can now Create in addition to Change, using OVERWRITE to Will people and things into existence. Basically, you are the X-Event now. OVERWRITE is essentially omnipotent now, with the only limit being you, as a finite existence cannot channel infinite power. First, you can only change realities and dimensions you are aware of, so one could avoid being OVERWRITTEN by hiding in a universe you never even heard of. You can technically reach them anyway, allowing you to pull souls from afterlives you have no proof exist, for example, but the 'further' away they are, the harder it is, since you are essentially trying to affect every reality in an ever-increasing range until you stumble on the right one. Next, trying to affect literally everything all at once isn't possible, as the multiverse is infinite. You are still limited to changing the equivalent of one universe at a time, though changing multiple universes consecutively is within your power. In addition, Creating is much less efficient than Changing, so while you can Change an entire universe all at once, attempting to Create one is much, much harder, and best done very slowly in multiple steps, and you cannot Create anything more powerful than you. Finally, beings that are stronger than you are still resistant to your power, although those are few and far between, and other reality warpers can use their power to actively resist until they are overwhelmed. This means that while you can, say, OVERWRITE Type ORT, it would fight back, although not for long. On the other hand, attempting to OVERWRITE the One Above ALL would at best get you permanently kicked out of the Marvel Multiverse. Essentially, if the being is Paragon Tier or stronger, you can't affect them at all, and other reality warpers take active effort to Change.
addons.title: X-Event (Undertale: X-Tale)

objects.text: "This is what has ruined our world ten times. I'm tired... but I'm forced to use this power." - X-Event Frisk You find in your possession a power unlike any other. A power that should only be found in the hands of a God, now in yours. The power to Overwrite. Overwrite can simply be described as "the ability to change everything within a timeline". With this, you can change reality as you please, including the thoughts, actions, memories, and roles of people. However, it seems as though the power is... incomplete, for lack of a better word. Something is missing that prevents it from reaching its true potential. Overwrite isn't omnipotent; it has several limits. As is, it is limited only to the 'local' spacetime. This means that it cannot reach into the past, so a time traveller could easily 'undo' any changes you make by just resetting to an earlier point, nor can it reach into other dimensions or realities, so one could avoid being Overwritten by just hiding in a pocket dimension. This also means it only has a planetary range, at best reaching the planet's moon(s), so anyone beyond that range can easily note and track large-scale changes. Certain beings cannot be affected by Overwrite. Specifically, any being that is sufficiently 'unique' from a multiversal/temporal perspective and any being that should not exist, such as due to being a living paradox, is immune to direct changes, and any being stronger than you can resist being Overwritten, although indirect changes like changing their current location or their equipment work as normal. In its incomplete state, Overwrite may work improperly, either leaving some aspects unchanged or even outright failing to activate, possibly requiring multiple activations to work. Even then, the changes may not be permanent, requiring active effort to maintain them. Finally, Overwrite cannot Create, only Change, so all uses must affect preexisting people, places, or things. Even with all this, this power can still easily be abused, but surely you'll use it for good. Right?
objects.title: Overwrite (Undertale: Underverse)

objects.text:
The Art, short for the Art of Lying to the Face of God, is a general term for what can be called 'magic' in the multiverse of Kill Six Billion Demons. It is often explained as the practice of lying to the universe convincingly enough that it becomes true; as such, it is heavily reliant on the practitioner's will for things to become true. It is generally split into sub-Arts: Red, White, and Black. The Red art uses vocal speech to change one inanimate thing into another. The White art uses one's soul as a medium to warp the self to do things like teleport, enhance physical abilities, create additional limbs, form the atum (soul energy) into weapons, etc. The Red-White art applies the White art to another entity. The Black art is the hardest to use; it is the ex-nihilo creation of matter, life, and souls. Very advanced users of the art can also spin the wheel and laugh at god, negating recent actions and physically or mentally traveling backwards in time, persist past death as a ghost, or attain limited omniscience.

On purchase, you are only able to do minor things with the Red art and can progress from there.
objects.title: The Art (Kill Six Billion Demons)

addons.text:
Your skill with Ki has taught your Atum a new way to flow. Rather than being confined entirely to the meridians of your physical body, you can circulate your Atum through your projected Ki, temporarily treating your aura, energy constructs, and techniques as extensions of your own meridian network.

This allows you to carry the properties of your Atum beyond your flesh without simply expelling and losing it. Atum threaded through a Ki blast can continue circulating within it, an aura can act as an external layer of spiritual pathways, and sufficiently stable Ki constructs can retain a controlled portion of your soul-flame until dismissed or disrupted.

With training, you can create increasingly elaborate external circuits, redirecting Atum between yourself and your manifested Ki without interrupting its flow. This does not inherently increase the amount of Atum or Ki you possess, but greatly expands where and how your Atum can function, allowing techniques normally dependent upon internal circulation to be adapted into entirely new forms.
addons.title: Perfect Circulation

objects.text:
You now contain within you Atum. This is the refined soul flame or essence of each individual. The Atum is observed to flow through many channels, or meridians, within the body. Precise knowledge of how the soul flame flows through these channels, the ways in which it can become blocked, and the ways in which it can be aligned to unlock a person’s hidden potential are key to various schools of martial arts throughout the multiverse. Breath is key in controlling one's Atum. Someone with high breath control will not only have incredible constitution and body health, but also align the energy pathways in their body to the point that they can perform unbelievable physical feats of endurance, such as turning blades away from their skin.

As you train in your breath control and martial arts and get used to controlling your Atum, the level of your power can increase as your body and spirit are tempered by the refined soul flame. An Atum that burns particularly bright can actually be seen as an aura or ring of light, sometimes called a halo or animus. In those warriors or sages who have cultivated enough strength, it burns as a physical, smokeless flame across their body. Ancient sage kings were said to have golden animus that wreathed their bodies in flames as bright and hot as molten metal, while leaving their skin and clothing unharmed.

A particularly strong-willed user can even do things like forming constructs out of their Atum, such as weapons, limbs or even entire clones, and different attacks. However, only strong will, control, and training can bring you to the level of a single warrior who slays armies and shatters cities - or whatever you choose to do with your power.
objects.title: Atum Manipulation (Kill Six Billion Demons)

addons.text:
With the Key of Names connection to your Atum it is able to draw out your soul flame and use it to craft unbound devils. These unbound devils can only exist within the void as chaotic masses of blackflame, that is if you decide not to use their mindless energy right away. With the ability to draw energy and materials of unbound devils you can create technology that relies on that energy as well as various materials made from the bodies or flames of different Devils. Different devil colors can be used for different effects, as well as can be distilled down into Devil Liquors, each carrying a variety of effects.

The devils you create and bind with masks will naturally view you as their Progenitor in whatever familial relationship you wish. This means that they probably won’t commit random acts of violence and sabotage against you and your holdings and hold some level of respect for you and what you say. However this does not mean that they cannot be paid to act against you in certain ways, as then it just becomes business.
addons.title: Devil Flame Artifice

objects.text:
Your soul is chaotic and untamed Hot Black Flame, the soul of a Devil. Unlike other devils, you are not the mask, but the flame underneath, though the mask is still required to maintain your personality. You are a Masked being of Immortal Chaos whose natural home is within the void. At the onset of this power you may design the look of your basic mask, as well as your name. With your ascension and mask creation you also get to choose a single word name. Binding with a mask grants them sentience, memories, a personality, and the ability to enter a world rather than being stuck in the void. Devils may "change" their own names or trick mortals into renaming them. The higher colored names of devils are powerful and kept exceptionally secret, and usually (though rarely) discovered by devils themselves. While you start as a blue Devil with this power, and have a long enough name appropriate for such a being, knowing your ebon name allows you to have much more freedom and ability that your average blue devil. You start capable of The Art, but do not have the skill with it, merely the potential all Devils have. You also do not suffer from the drawbacks of certain devil types like normal devils do, such as the different mind states and thought patterns different devil colors might have, though you can indulge in those instincts without issue should you wish to.

As a Devil you start out as a Blue devil and must work your way up through the colors, losing portions of your incredibly long name in order to reach higher colors such as red, green, gold, and finally ebon the strongest and most capable demons. There is also a lesser form of devil below Blue devils known as Pale or Pallid devils, however these devils, while they have their advantages, are limited in their mental capacity and will compared to even weaker Blue devils.

Blue devils are physically weaker than other devils, but their natural cunning makes them gifted at the Art. Red devils are warhorses of strength and stamina that never tire. Green Devils have the cunning and complex thought of a Sphinx, but with reptilian features and ferocity. Gold Devils have the mental capacity and psychopathy to run criminal empires, underground and state alike near single-handedly, and Ebon devils combine the mental and physical fortitude of all of the devils before as well as being able to freely shape their form almost like an unbound devil can. A devil's power in the art grows with each step closer to Ebon devils, at which point their very voice becomes a weapon — a language that inflicts not only pain but also cleaves through matter, asserting their dominance over the fabric of reality.

The way that a devil improves the color of their mask is by increasing the amount of black Atum they have in conjunction with removing names. They do this either with power, or through tricking humans into misnaming them with shorter or different names. By making a pact with a being you can leave a small portion of your black flame on their soul which will allow you to absorb energy from them for the duration of the pact, you can choose to have your energy draw from any energy source intrinsic to the contractor if they do not have black flame of their own. The leftover spark of black flame can be fed into for increased power gain, as well as beginning the process of transforming the afflicted person into a Devil themselves. This small and possibly growing spark of black flame gives the Afflicted the ability to use the Art as well, however this use of the black flame will accelerate their transformation into a Devil.

As a devil you can choose to separate your mask from your body, which can then be worn by a living person. This allows your bodies and wills to attempt to emerge, however this is rarely done by either devils or willing people since the merge can create a strong clashing of wills if the merged people cannot work together, it can also be dangerous for the person attempting to wear the mask as the transformation and powers draw on a lot more energy and could cause a weak host to burn up under the strength of the Devils Atum. With the knowledge of your ebon name and your greater control over your Devil Instincts you are able to better control the effect you have on beings that you are merged with, reducing the impact of your power on them, or how much your wills clash by instinct.

Unlike your other devil kin, if your mask is broken apart and you are banished back to the void as mindless chaotic black flame, a new kind of reformation occurs. If your mask shatters and you turn back into an unbound devil, you will naturally turn into a pale devil after a decade or two, and then into a blue devil after another decade, with no memories of your former self. You will regain the memories as you progress in mask colors, with each ascending color restoring a portion of your past life. If you eventually obtain the ebon mask, you will functionally have all of your memories of all of your previous incarnations. While this immortality is true, it is not impervious to other means such as binding or entrapment, and the time it takes to reform fully will certainly not be quick.

If you walk the void long enough, you will eventually find distortions that access some physical location in your world. You can use these to pass through into the real world as a Masked Devil.
objects.title: Infernal Ego (Kill Six Billion Demons)

addons.text:
With the Key of Names you know the name that relates to the puresilver, you can use this material to forge puresilver Vessels. This armor is a lot harder and sharper than the stone like ash vessels that are normally used by angels. This material also stops the flow of Atum and when used to pierce or cut can temporarily disrupt Atum flow, which can have the effect of banishing devils and Angels. 

Through your connection with the Key of Names you can draw out some of your Cold White flame and use it to create your own Angels, and forge puresilver vessels for them to inhabit.
addons.title: Pure Silver and White Flames

addons.text:
Your true form is now that of both Hot Black Flame and Cold White Flame forming a single, stable whole. The stabilizing nature of your Angelic half eliminates the need for the Devil's mask to maintain your chaotic soul's integrity; the two halves perfectly balance each other. However, to anchor yourself in reality and prevent your soul from returning to the Void, you still require a physical anchor - either an Angelic Vessel forged of Ash of the Void or a more fragile Mask (also forged out of Ash). The Mask grants you greater nimbleness, while the heavily armored Vessel is significantly tougher. You may choose for your appearance to favor either the angelic (eyes, wings, halos, rings and flames) or the devilish (teeth, claws, animalistic or insectoid traits, more eyes), or a fusion of both. 

Your progression is a unification of both systems. Moving from one tier to the next - both in Angelic density (Plasma to Neutron) and Devilish color (Blue to Ebon) - requires simultaneous progress in both areas: you must have achieved enough density (Angelic) to support the growing power and enough refinement (Devil) to utilize its full potential. The ultimate goal is to reach the Neutron stage and possess the Ebon Devil Name, signifying the complete unification of your Hot Black and Cold White Flames into a singular, indestructible, and fully realized soul-flame.

While you know your Ebon Devil name, you only know a few bits that make up the divine law that your name represents as an angel. Your full name is some combination of your Angel and Devil names, but the length will not reduce your power or color. The two names could be divided by the Reincarnation number, or can take whatever form that includes both.

Because of the complete stability provided by your dual nature, if your vessel is destroyed and you are pushed to the point of reincarnation, your recovery will be swift, and you retain all your memories and skills upon awakening in the Plasma stage.
addons.title: Aspected Chaos

objects.text:
Your soul is the fierce and rigid Cold White Flame, the soul of an Angel. This flame was very harsh and granted all angels a strong sense of self, grasp on reality, and remarkable willpower. While in the Void, angels can take a myriad of forms (though common elements include several eyes, wings, halos, rings and flames), and their bodies are made of energy. Though sexless, many have masculine mannerisms, and an angel's true form is malleable, based on both values and personal preference. Angels progress through "states" of Plasma, Vapor, Liquid, Solid (Metamorphic, Igneous), Crystal, and Neutron (in order of youngest to oldest) as they age and grow in power.

In order to exist outside of the void however an Angel requires a Vessel forged out of the ash of the Void. If you walk the void long enough, you will eventually find distortions that access some physical location in your world. You can use these to pass through into the real world if you have a vessel that you can inhabit outside of the void. You can forge yourself Vessels from the Ash in the Void. When an angel is banished through various means their angelic body is sent back to the void, and in the case of sudden vessel destruction this can cause all the energy the angel's vessel was containing to explode violently outward.

Angels, despite their size and their armored shell being extremely heavy, can move incredibly quietly when they need to, though most often they use it to try and not disturb people when walking up and down stairs and on wooden floors.

All angels were imprinted with Old Law, giving them inherent knowledge of all laws and an incredibly strong sense of truth, honor, and justice. As law and order are within the very nature of angels they are incapable of Lying, their vessels cracking with each lie until eventually falling apart. Due to their immortality, fierce will, and a compulsive need to subdue chaos, all angels are naturally talented at martial arts. 

As an angel of the plasma stage, you have the potential for great mastery, but do not know any martial arts so far - you must train to unlock your inherent talent.

When your true form is slain, either in the Void by a devil, god or other angel, or by significant enough damage to fully breach its armor while the angel is inhabiting it, you will reincarnate: your void-form calcifies into a near indestructible shell and the your flame of life enters a stage of torpor; after a period of hibernation proportionate to the length of your previous life, you’ll wake up back at the Plasma stage and with knowledge of your skills and name intact, but little memory of your past incarnation. As you gain in power and ascend through the angelic ranks you awaken more of your memories of previous incarnations.
objects.title: Anointed Heaven Fall Inheritor Marked By The Broken Throne And Is Paradise Chosen (Kill Six Billion Demons)

addons.text:
You gain basic proficiency in the powerful sword techniques of the Arie Family. This swordsmanship style has no blind spots, and there are no effective techniques to counter it. Arie sword attacks can disappear and reappear within seconds, as the blades teleport across space, an attack may suddenly emerge from behind a target or from any direction at all. Due to its seemingly random behavior, Arie Swordsmanship is extremely unpredictable.

The only ways to overcome a practitioner of Arie Swordsmanship are to overpower them with sheer force, strike before they have a chance to attack, or surpass them in mastery of the style itself.

Normally, only a direct descendant of the Arie Family can use these techniques—but you are different. Although you begin with only the basics, you possess knowledge of every technique and training method required to fully master this sword style.
addons.title: Arie Swordsmanship (Tower of God)

addons.text:
You now possess knowledge of how to create all the weapons, armour, substances, technology, bio-tech and magitech that appear or exists in the Tower of God series. This includes the creation of Lighthouses, Floating Skyships, Living Ignition Weapons, Beastkins, Artificial Beings, Emile, Enkidu, Observers, Inventories, Pockets, Ignition Weapons, bombs, armour and much more. You also understand how to produce Suspendium, the mineral found and used throughout the Tower for crafting these items.

You have additionally gained the ability to craft every type of weapon, armour and artefact that exists within the Tower. This includes wands capable of manipulating and gathering Shinsu, Kranos, Frog Fisher, Bong-Bong, Mirror of the Past, Mirror at the End, the Seven Sacred Swords, the Thirteen Month Series and many more.

Finally, you have gained access to the mysterious power that has existed since the Tower’s beginning: Spells. These abilities are governed by several fundamental laws—laws you now fully understand. Your knowledge of Spells begins at a basic level, but it can grow over time through study and research.
addons.title: The Workshop Great Father (Tower of God)

objects.text:
Shinsu is the lifeblood of the Tower and now it flows endlessly from within you, although you are not able to manipulate much Shinsu at once as you are restricted in quantity, quality, and concentration. These Shinsu Manipulation limits can be raised through use and experience. By manipulating the Shinsu inside yourself, you enhance your physical capabilities (an initial increase of 50%), heal yourself at a faster pace, and various other abilities, you are only limited by your lack of experience. At the start, you can form one Baang, the unit of measurement of Shinsu Manipulation. Eventually, you will be able to perform feats that put even the best Rankers to shame, handling more Baangs than Enryu himself, signing deals greater than those of the Administrators, and even the possibility of creating life through Shinsu. Your lifespan is dramatically increased to a thousand years, this can be further increased as you improve your ability to control Shinsu.

In addition to your newfound Shinsu Manipulation capabilities, you can either naturally develop or choose your own Shinsu Quality or Shape, whichever you desire. Regardless of your decision, you will be able to work with whatever Quality and Shape you have as if you were perfectly aligned with them. Be aware that you can only have one Shinsu Quality or Shinsu Shape.
objects.title: Shinsu Manipulation (Tower of God)

objects.text:
“You are banished from death.” 

You are no longer a mere mortal but a powerful wraith. Unlike most wraiths you are able to manifest yourself a true physical body. You now posses a great many abilities, from greatly augmented strength and agility, teleportation, raising the dead, the ability to conjure phantasmal weapons on par, if not greater, with any physical weapon you are capable of wielding, slowing your perception of time down, to controlling fire, ice, poison, and light, and host of of other abilities that you can discover over time and experimenting. But your two greatest skills are Resurrection and Domination. With Resurrection, upon death whether by natural or unnatural causes you may reform and reconstitute yourself back to perfect condition at a safe area, though this take time on the scope of a few hours. Any equipment on you also reforms with you. And with domination you are capable of overpowering others, peering into and freely reshaping their minds and binding them to your will. You also gain all of the skills and equipment of Talion, Celebrimor, Eltariel, and Baranor allowing you to engage in combat with and destroy multiple enemies easily. You may also optionally gain the Talion, Celebrimor, Eltariel, and Baranor as companions for free.
objects.title: Gravewalker (Shadow of War)

addons.text:
Rather than becoming a being born of Chaos, you can choose to become a Living Saint, a radiant paragon of Order.

Your Essence of Corruption is replaced by an Essence of Piety, which forgoes the consumption of souls for a boost to the power gained from devotion.

Your starting power is at least equal to that of Saint Celestine, and you might even be her better.
addons.title: Firetide

objects.text:
As a Neverborn, you have transcended mortal limitations and become a Greater Daemon, an embodiment of Chaos, unbound by the servitude of any specific Chaos God. You embody the essence of a concept of your choosing, a living manifestation of everything it represents.

The challenges faced by daemons in entering the material realm are insignificant to you. As a Neverborn, you possess the ability to traverse between realms effortlessly. Shifting your matter between dimensions, you become intangible at will, rendering barriers that separate realms obsolete. Demons cannot bar your entry into Hell, and Angels cannot prevent your ascent into Heaven.

However, in the material realm, your power is limited, only when you venture into the realms of spirits or consciousness, whether it be the afterlife, the collective unconscious of an entire race, or the dream world of a single individual, can you wield the full might of a Greater Demon. Within these realms, your power shape reality according to your will.

In addition to your versatile realm-traveling abilities, you possess the unique trait of the Changeling. You can flawlessly mimic any being whose power does not far exceed your own. By assuming their form, you gain access to their experiences, powers, and abilities, making you a master of deception and manipulation.

Moreover, your very presence radiates the Essence of Corruption. Encounter with you plants the seeds of worship and devotion within others. The mere knowledge of your existence can inspire fervent loyalty and adoration. Over time, exposure to your influence warps even the champions of gods, compelling them to become your devout servants. This effect intensifies as you consume souls or feed on the devotion of your worshippers, ensuring that all will eventually succumb to your sway.
objects.title: Neverborn (Warhammer)

addons.text: You have become the ultimate vessel for Khorne's wrath, inheriting Khorne's mantle as the Chaos God of War. With your ascension, you gain access to a new warp realm known as the Bloodstorm, a turbulent realm of eternal battle and bloodshed. This realm feeds on the conflicts and violence of the universe, growing stronger as you unleash your fury. As you tap into the power of the Bloodstorm, your physical strength and combat prowess grows infinitely, allowing you to cleave through armies and even planets with ease. Through your newfound realm, you can summon and command legions of bloodthirsty daemons and creatures of Khorne, empowering your forces and spreading carnage across the mortal realms.
addons.title: The Throne Of Blood And Skulls

objects.text: Your devotion to the Blood God has tainted your soul and turned you into the Champion of Khorne, granting you an insatiable thirst for battle and an unparalleled affinity for bloodshed. Whenever you engage in combat or witness bloodshed, your physical abilities and combat prowess are enhanced exponentially. Your strength, speed, and endurance surge to supernatural levels, making you a relentless force on the battlefield. The more blood that is spilled around you, the stronger you become, empowering you to continue your rampage without tiring or relenting.
objects.title: Champion of Khorne (Warhammer)

addons.text: You have become the Changer of Ways and Master of Warp Sorcery, inheriting Tzeentch's mantle as the Chaos God of Change. With your ascension, you gain access to a new warp realm known as the Shifting Nexus, a realm of kaleidoscope madness that's constantly morphing and reshaping at your command. As the Shifting Nexus feeds on the ever-changing nature of the universe, your mastery over magic and sorcery grows. You can effortlessly twist and warp the fabric of reality, unleashing devastating spells and manipulating the flow of time. The Shifting Nexus serves as a wellspring of demons and forbidden knowledge, granting you insights into the secrets of the multiverse, and empowering your forces to spread madness inducing knowledge across the realms.
addons.title: Kaleidoscope Throne of Change

objects.text: Embracing the God of Change, your twisted soul have been chosen to become the Champion of Tzeentch's. Your very presence now warps and distorts the fabric of reality around you. The environment becoming unstable and unpredictable, constantly shifting and reshaping itself to confound and hinder your enemies at your command. Illusory barriers, twisted landscapes, and unpredictable phenomena manifest to protect you and impede those who oppose you. This ever-changing terrain serves as both a shield and a weapon, granting you a strategic advantage in any confrontation.
objects.title: Champion of Tzeentch (Warhammer)

addons.text: You have inherited the unchanging stagnation and sweet rot of pestilence, inheriting Nurgle's mantle as the Chaos God of Decay. With your ascension, you gain access to a new warp realm known as the Rotting Garden, where the cycle of life and death perpetually thrives. As the Rotting Garden feeds on the suffering and despair of the universe, your own durability and regenerative abilities reach unprecedented heights. You become an avatar of pestilence, spreading world ending plagues and diseases with a mere touch. The Rotting Garden teems with grotesque creatures and daemons of Nurgle, bolstering your forces and infecting reality with decay.
addons.title: The Rotting Throne of Entropy

objects.text: Embodying the decay and resilience of diseases, your stagnant soul have become the undying Champion of Nurgle, turning your body into a living vessel of pestilence and disease. Your body becomes host and ruler to a myriad of virulent plagues and contagions, emanating a miasma of filth and decay. Merely being near you weakens and sickens your foes, draining their vitality and sapping their strength. Your own constitution becomes nearly impervious to harm, allowing you to endure wounds and injuries that would cripple even the mightiest warriors.
objects.title: Champion of Nurgle (Warhammer)

addons.text: You have become the epitome of hedonistic pleasure and perfection, inheriting Slaanesh's mantle as the Chaos God of Excess. With your ascension, you gain access to a new warp realm known as the Blissful Expanse, within it every sensation is heightened to ecstasy-inducing levels. As the Blissful Expanse feeds on the excesses and desires of sentient beings, your own abilities and allure become irresistible. You radiate an aura of captivating beauty and charisma, enchanting those around you. The Blissful Expanse grants you unparalleled skill in all artistic endeavors, whether it be music, art, or the art of seduction. The Blissful Expanse teems with enchanting creatures and charming daemons that will temp anyone who's foolish enough to step in your realm, bolstering your forces and infecting reality with euphoric bliss.
addons.title: Euphoric Throne of Excess

addons.text:
You have taken the decadent arts of Slaanesh—the intoxicating allure of sensation, the razor’s edge of desire, the transcendent pursuit of perfection—and purified them through Dharma. Where the Prince of Pleasure twists ecstasy into addiction, you have woven it into the path itself.

Your every movement still carries the hypnotic grace of a divine champion, but now it elevates rather than ensnares. The same eroticism that once damned souls becomes a sacred fire that burns away illusion; the same pursuit of perfection that drove mortals to madness now carves a road to enlightenment.

Your mastery of these arts exists in dual forms: the original, profane techniques of Slaanesh (which you may still wield with terrifying precision) and their Dharma-refined counterparts. A single touch can plunge an enemy into paralyzing rapture—or awaken them to the emptiness of their cravings.

A whispered word can unravel minds with pleasure—or shock them into meditative clarity by revealing the transient nature of sensation. Even combat becomes a dance of skilled means, where lethal strikes are replaced by karmic pressure points that force introspection upon your foes.

Yet the greatest transformation lies in your heightened senses. Where Slaanesh’s gifts once drowned you in sensation, you now perceive the world with Buddha-like equanimity—every texture, scent, and sound a sutra teaching impermanence.

You may indulge without attachment, savor without clinging, and turn even the most debased pleasures into lessons on liberation. Your very presence becomes a paradox: a living testament that desire, refined by wisdom, can be the swiftest path to awakening.
addons.title: Kama-Mudra of Liberation

addons.text:
Ordinarily, you would have simply mantled Slaanesh and become the new Warp God of Excess. However, your serenity and enlightenment have purified the power of Slaanesh, turning a simple succession into something akin to Slaanesh’s own birth, a devouring of a god to birth a new one, a God of Serenity.

Gone is the Blissful Expanse, replaced with a Nascent Pure Realm, a domain suffused with serenity, clarity, and meditative light, which you preside over as its ruler, a sort of false-Buddha. The creatures that inhabit this realm are no longer merely charming daemons or temptresses. They are guides and companions, embodiments of the harmony between desire and detachment, moving with an elegance that mirrors your own.

Your influence reshapes those who enter. Formerly addicted minds feel a gentle pull toward introspection rather than indulgence. Formerly obsessed hearts find peace in the flow of impermanent joy. Your aura, still tinged with captivating grace and beauty, now inspires not submission but awakening. Mortals and immortals alike cannot resist the serenity you radiate, yet they are compelled toward self-realization rather than ecstasy.

Furthermore, with every soul guided towards self-enlightenment and peace, so too does your own power and serenity grow, until eventually you may reach true Enlightenment and become a Buddha in truth, complete with turning your realm into a true Pure Land.
addons.title: Warp God of Serenity

objects.text: As a devotee of the Prince of Pleasure, your entrance soul has been chosen to become the Champion of Slaanesh, attaining a perpetual transcendent state of perfection and artistry. Every action and movement you make exudes grace, beauty, and finesse, captivating those who witness your skill. Your senses become heightened, enabling you to perceive the slightest nuances and exploit them to your advantage. Whether it is combat, artistic expression, or any other pursuit, your innate talent and relentless pursuit of perfection grant you unparalleled mastery in your chosen domain.
objects.title: Champion of Slaanesh (Warhammer)

addons.text: As the inheritor of Chaos Undivided's mantle, you become the Harbinger of Ruin and Herald of the Apocalypse, a newly born Chaos God of Annihilation. With your ascension, you gain access to a new warp realm known as the Annihilation Abyss, allowing you to wield the raw power of the Warp to seep into every corner of existence. The Annihilation Abyss hungers for the collapse of order and the triumph of chaos, growing stronger as the universe teeters on the brink of annihilation. You gain the ability to summon and control daemons from all four Chaos Gods, wielding their combined might to unleash devastation on a cataclysmic scale. The Annihilation Abyss empowers your abilities to sunder reality, tearing through dimensions and unleashing waves of destructive energy.
addons.title: Apocalypse Throne of Ruins

objects.text: Embracing the unification of Chaos, your soul has become the Champion of Chaos Undivided, making your form constantly mutates and adapts based on your self-belief. As long as you believe yourself to be something, you will be it. With this, you gain the ability to alter your size, shape, and physical attributes at will. This versatility allows you to respec your combat abilities on the fly, growing additional limbs, merging with your weapons and technology, or assuming monstrous forms tailored to each battle. Your body becomes a canvas of endless possibilities, embodying the essence of Chaos itself. You can still retain your original form and appearance, able to seamlessly revert to it at will
objects.title: Champion of Chaos Undivided (Warhammer)

addons.text: Well, look at you now! You’ve gone from a little ‘umie with some favor to a real and propah Ork! Not just that, but you stand among the meanest, greenest, and baddest of Ork Warlords in terms of size and power, like Gharkul Blackfang and Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka, Da Prophet of Da WAAAGH! Some would even fink to compare you to Da Beast and his Prime-Orks! You bear Ghazghkull’s title as Da Prophet of Da WAAAGH! with pride because of your power and equal devotion to both Gork and Mork. While you probably wouldn’t win against a proper Krork on your own, you’re practically the next best thing, able to match up and even win against a Primarch, and able to give a good fight against da Emprah himself for a small time before gettin’ krumped. Your rate of growth is unparalleled compared to almost any other Ork in between the 31st and 42nd Millenium. Your nature and status calls any and all independent Orks across the galaxy to join your cause, giving you the potential to create da biggest WAAAGH! da galaxy has ever seen!
addons.title: Da Prophet of Da WAAAGH!

addons.text: You have become the psychic embodiment of the Green Tide, the Ork Gods of Brutal and Kunnin’, the Father(s) of Da WAAAGH!, Gork and Mork. This ascension is rather unique compared to the hypothetical mantling of any of the Chaos Gods, as Gork and Mork are a two-in-one package. As such, you will have the option to choose either Gork or Mork. Whoever you choose, you take up their end of the duo and inherit a moderate boost to the aspects they embody. Whoever you did not choose will have a ‘sibling’ of you be created to mantle them. This ‘sibling’ is, for all intents and purposes, you, but angled slightly to the aspect of the Ork God they mantle, like you are. For example, if this sibling were to mantle Gork, they would essentially be you, but they’re stronger and more prone to shows of brutality compared to you. If they mantled Mork, they wouldn’t be as physically strong as you, but they’d be more intelligent than you, making devious stratagems rather than just charging ahead. These changes are not obvious, but they’re not subtle, either. If enough Orks are gathered in one place (with the required amount of Orks changing depending on how large the setting you’re in takes place over), you and your sibling may choose to fuse together into one singular Ork God: the Twin-Headed Ork God of Destruction and Savagery, Gorkamorka. This form takes the best of both worlds and is more powerful than the sum of its parts. You and your sibling have no problems working together in this body, taking control of one head each, but if the gathered Orks scatter or there’s simply not enough of them to sustain it, you will both split apart once more. You can choose to end this preemptively, but both of you must agree to do so.
addons.title: Twin Thrones of The Green Tide

objects.text: You have sworn your mind, body and soul into eternal service to the twin Ork Gods and Fathers of the WAAAGH!, Gork and Mork. They must’ve found something great in you, because not only did they respond, but the blessing you were rewarded with was rather powerful as well. With this blessing, your sheer might and size is now equal to that of the average Ork Warboss, able to fight blow for blow with a space marine and (usually) win. With every fight you experience, you’ll only get larger and more powerful just like any other Ork, albeit at a slower pace in comparison to your peers. You also have an intuition that points you in the direction of the nearest opportunity for a good fight. You also gain a boost to your kunnin’ and an additional boost when it comes to the plans and schemes you craft when they’re more straightforward and simple instead of complicated or elaborate. You have become a living mystery to all life in the galaxy, as you now have access to the collective Ork unconscious as if you were an Ork yourself. With this, you’re able to use what is known as 'WAAAGH! Energy' to create small effects or buffs to anything you wield or use in battle not unlike the Orks. To do so, like any other Ork, you must truly believe these effects to be true. Giving your car some more time to keep going before running out because you remember filling it up not too long ago, or living in space unaffected because you don’t know that people can’t breathe in space are a couple of examples of what is possible for you using WAAAGH!
