Energy. In the grim darkness of the far future, the life of an Ork stands out as usually short, but among the most simple of lives to live in the galaxy. Some would even go so far to say that it’s fun. Now you travel along this path as well. Find joy in the simple things, big and small, for there is no need to make it complex, that just takes away from all the fun you can have. Live to fight, and fight to live, so you can fight all over again. All in the pursuit of a great life, in the name of Gork and Mork.
objects.title: Champion of Gork and Mork (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You have become the Great Corruptor, Lord of Malignance and Architect of Schemes, inheriting the Great Horned Rat’s hard-earned mantle of Chaos God. With your ascension, you gain access to a new Warp realm known as the Realm of Ruin, a realm choked by trinkets and refuse gathered by your subjects. This realm feeds on the treachery and betrayal of the universe, growing stronger as your plans unfurl. As you begin to take ascendancy in any form, your power grows infinitely, allowing you to corrupt armies and grow great gulfs of warpstone to engulf whole realms. Through your newfound realm, you can summon and command legions of verminous Daemons and creatures of your realm, such as the great Verminlords, empowering your forces and spreading your corruption through the mortal realms.
addons.title: Throne of Underhanded Might

objects.text: Becoming an associate of the God of Treachery has marked your soul and turned you into the champion of the Great Horned Rat, giving you an impeccable sense for schemes and plots. Whenever acting to corrupt or malign others through subtle means, you’ll find your intelligence, cunning and wit increased to align with the complexity of your plans. The more you sabotage others to place yourself on top of those around you, the more your abilities increase in turn, only further enabling you and your schemes.
objects.title: Champion of The Great Horned Rat (Warhammer: Age of Sigmar)

addons.text: You become the psychic embodiment of the Gloomspite, which acts as an alternative to the Waaagh! With your ascension, you gain the ability to summon the Age of the Everdank upon the battlefield. This moist and clammy age causes your Grots and Troggoths to be whipped into a frenzy as they fight with reckless abandon. As you conjure the Everdank, Da Bad Moon shows itself with an even stronger presence in the world than in your most desperate hour. The once small shards of loonstone that rained down on your enemies now increase to proper Fangz of Da Bad Moon, with them being able to crush buildings and impale giants. Once having a small ability to grow and control fungi, it has now increased to the ability to create and customize your own fungi with abilities ranging from mushrooms that can grant the ability to cast magic to nearly whatever you can imagine.
addons.title: Throne of the Everdank

addons.text: GorkaMorka has taken notice of Da Bad Moon's interest in you, so he decided to give you a blessing as well. This blessing grants you the ability to summon Orruks. These Orruks come in two varieties—the Ironjawz, who tend to be more brutal, while the Kruleboyz tend to be more kunnin. With practice, you could even summon the warbeasts they use, like the Maw-krusha, a massive dragon-like brute and the Corpse-rippa Vulcha, a less massive vulture-like beast. These Orruks will follow you so long as they get a good fight, although the warbeasts will follow you without question. To help in the running of a warband, you get the necessary Brutality and Kunnin to keep the warband together—functional, and you da boss.
addons.title: Blessed by Gorkamorka

objects.text:
You have been blessed by Da Bad Moon, this moon-like deity has a leering face that is said to drive men of weak mind to madness if they gaze upon it for too long. This blessing is known as the Clammy Hand and has many benefits, such as being able to summon the worshipers of the Da Bad Moon such as the Grots, these short and wiry creatures at their core are untrustworthy sadistic cowards but make up for it with their cunning and being very inventive, you could even summon the Grot's mounts and beasts of war like Squigs, giant spiders, and snarlfangs.

As your power under Da Bad Moon grows, you may even summon the mighty Troggoth, these regenerating brutes are strong enough to topple small buildings and uproot large trees with the toughness to take such hits in stride; in addition to that, these beasts can spit corrosive bile at their foes, and their only weakness is their minuscule intelligence with them being about as smart as a brick but summoning a Troggoth exhausts you physically and mentally leaving you unable to do much for a few days.

With time and practice, you can summon more of these creatures, with even stronger variants of them becoming available to you, like shamans, Dankhold Troggoths, and mangler squigs. These Grots see you as the Loonboss, and as such, they will follow you so long as they think they can't kill you. Though creatures of simpler minds like Squigs and Troggoths will follow you without question.

To help fend off these potential assassinations, Da Bad Moon has blessed you with the ability to create the fungi that grow in the subterranean realm the Grots call home. These fungi can have a variety of effects, ranging from simple poisons and antidotes to causing hallucinations and boosting the ability to do magic. With this mastery of fungi, you can grow them anywhere that the sun does not touch, and you can identify any mushroom, its properties, and how to best use them.

Lastly, when you are backed into a corner and truly out of options, you can summon Da Bad Moon. When under the light of Da Bad Moon, the abilities of you and your allies become boosted. For example, you can summon dozens of Grots and war beasts at a time while your fungi abilities grow so much that you can control them like extra limbs. While Da Bad Moon's light shines on your enemies, they suffer from bouts of madness and shards of Loonstone raining down on them, with the shards ranging from the size of knives to spears. Summoning Da Bad Moon is almost always temporary as it exhausts you utterly when the battle is over, leaving you nearly incapacitated for weeks.
objects.title: Blessed by Da Bad Moon (Warhammer: Age of Sigmar)

addons.text: Your Grail Knight powers and blessings are entirely self-granted, and you no longer need the approval of The Lady Of The Lake. It should go without saying that you can also use the abilities of her Damsels and the Fey Enchantress (for as a Miracle user, you already could). On top of this, you can refine your own Grail Knight body and spirit, allowing you to eventually raise yourself up to the level of The Green Knight, Louen Leoncoeur, & Repanse de Lyonesse.
addons.title: The Knights of Ni(hilism)

objects.text:
“My good blade carves the casques of men. My tough lance thrusteth sure; and my strength is as the strength of ten, because my heart is pure.” -"Sir Galahad" by Alfred Lord Tennyson

You have drank from the Holy Grail, and the Lady of the Lake has shown you her favor, turning you into one of Humanity's greatest warriors.

You now have strength & endurance greater than Chaos Champions & Orc Warlords, skill & speed exceeding the greatest High Elven warriors, a powerful resistance to magic & the Warp, an aura that repels or destroys hostile undead or Daemons of low power, the charisma and beauty to court the Lady of Lake and make lesser men worship you as a demigod, and an eternal youth that can regenerate wounds and make the scars of war disappear.

There are also purely cosmetic effects like radiant halos of light, glowing eyes, and mist appearing underfoot everywhere you walk, but these can be toggled.

If you pray to the Lady, never use cowardly or underhanded tactics, and keep your vows, you may even receive the various boons her blessings grant. She can even resurrect you from the dead if the situation is truly dire. Try to stay on her good side.
objects.title: Grail Knight (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Your mastery of Dhar gives you the characteristics of the other forces of the Undead, such as the wizardry of the Necromancers, the intangibility of Cairn Wraiths, Spirit Hosts, & Hex-Wraiths, the beastly vigor of Vargheists, Varghulfs, & Wight Kings, the power of the less than legendary sorts of Vampire Lords, & so on.

You are also a paragon of the Vampiric race, and are effectively the best of every bloodline at once; you are as statesman-like & regal as a Von Carstein, as charismatic and seductive as a Lahmian, as valorous and martially skilled as a Blood Dragon, as sorcerously inclined as a Necrarch, and as mighty and powerful as a Strigoi.
addons.title: The Graveyard Smash

objects.text:
You have drank from Neferata's flawed recreation of Nagash's Elixir Of Life, and are now a Vampire of a bloodline of your choice, such as The Von Carsteins, The Lahmians, The Blood Dragons, The Necrarchs, The Strigoi, or so on.

Your soul has been artificially bound inside your body thanks to the Elixir, giving you the incredible powers of these Undead Lords (according to the specialties of your bloodline).

This includes supernatural strength, speed, & endurance, rapid regeneration & easy revival from death if you're killed, walking on water, turning into a spectral form or mist, versatile shapeshifting, inborn Witchsight & Deathsight, super senses, arcane and necromantic power and knowledge, a large internal reserve of Dhar, peerless skill and vigor at fighting, a mystic aura of charisma, command, or terror (as the situation demands), hypnosis & mesmerization, unnatural beguiling beauty, psychic vampirism, calling the wind, supreme willpower from literally moulding your own soul, the ability to overcome your vampiric weaknesses and limits, all-around magic resistance, and many other Blood Gifts besides.

Unfortunately, however, Neferata's inferior spiritual moorings give you the famous weaknesses of Vampirism as well (sunlight, fire, silver, holy water, garlic, decapitation, stakes through the heart, lack of invitation to a dwelling, religious symbols of gods that don't like Undead, your own dark hunger, etc.)
objects.title: Midnight Aristocrat (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You have been granted a Sephira Crystal, becoming a magical lifeform known as a Spirit. This new form grants you many superhuman powers, such as the strength to level small towns in minutes, durability to actually survive taking such attacks head-on, high-speed regeneration that can bring you back from the brink of death, supersonic speed and even faster burst tempo, as well as the needed reaction time and mental processing to actually use it. However, you will not be able to unleash the full extent of your powers without first practicing, as even your improved body cannot withstand your massive spiritual energy reserves.

Additionally, you become resistant to anything that tries to influence you. Whether it be your mind, soul or even your very fate, you become unaffected by powers and their wielders if they are weaker than you, and even those stronger than you will have to put up much more effort to affect you. As a lifeform that relies on spiritual energy to fuel itself, you fully overcome the natural limits of your body, becoming truly ageless in body and mind, and lose the need for sleep or any kind of sustenance. Mundane harms such as sickness, radiation or extreme temperature have no effect on you unless they carry esoteric properties, and all wounds or other imperfections in your body will heal perfectly. Unlike the ten original Spirits, you are not bound to a Spirit of Origin, meaning your powers cannot be easily stolen or sealed as in Mio Takamiya's plan.

While you possess a relatively weak form of energy manipulation and projection through which you can use your spiritual power, your greatest strength typically manifests in the form of your Angel and Astral Dress. An Angel, named after one of the angels from Abrahamic religions, grants you a degree of authority over a specific concept, such as classical elements, physical properties like time or electromagnetic radiation, or even esoteric themes like fate. Your Astral Dress carries one of the names of God, and complements your Angel. If your Angel focuses on pure destructive force, your Astral Dress may become more durable and protective than the heaviest armor, and an Angel that influences the minds of others may be paired with an Astral Dress that grants you supernatural charisma. Or if you need to absorb the life force of others to fuel your powerful abilities, your Astral Dress may grant you a power precisely to help with that.

Being a Spirit naturally connects you to the Neighboring World, an alternate dimension adjacent to the real world from which esoteric energies diffuse into reality. This comes with an extremely versatile, if subtle, influence on the space in and around you. You will be able to fly without problem, and may summon or dismiss spacequakes, though without practice, you have little control over their size or the destructive energies released by interacting with them may cause. Spacequakes can be used as wormholes to connect two points in real space together, travel to other dimensions such as the Neighboring World, or simply shunt everything in their vicinity into the nothingness between dimensions. The nature of spacequakes makes it very difficult for anyone to dispel them or prevent their formation, though using them stealthily would be practically impossible.

If you experience extreme negative emotions, you may be forced into your Inverse Form, releasing all the latent spiritual energy inside you in a manner that will inevitably cause damage to your body. Your fine control over your powers decreases drastically, driven by a destructive urge to annihilate whatever forced you into your current state, your Astral Dress will reflect your negative state of mind, and your Angel will transform into a Demon King; this form will draw more spiritual energy than your Angel, and its powers generally shift to become more aggressive and destructive, though its nature always remains the same.

However, on your own, you are fundamentally still a human who has transcended their limits. While you may call yourself a spiritual lifeform that incarnates itself through your Sephira Crystal, you are still bound to a physical body and will die quickly if your gem does not inhabit a host body. Your Sephira Crystal is effectively indestructible; it will only lose its power and shatter when you yourself die.

Alternatively, you may instead take the powers, Angel and Astral Dress of any of the ten original Spirits. This will also grant you their intuitive memory of how to use their own powers, though you will equally become bound to a Spirit of Origin and become susceptible to their influence.
objects.title: Astral Spirit (Date A Live)

addons.text:
In a cataclysmic convergence of power, you have achieved the unimaginable—the fusion of the First Flame and the Dark Soul. As the Usurper of Fire, you stand at the precipice of an eternal phenomenon where the boundless nature of the Dark Soul is enhanced by the First Flame, resulting in an infinitely expanding and multiplying force. Conversely, the First Flame draws sustenance from the Dark Soul, fueling its growth and perpetuating an unending feedback loop of power.

This fusion of opposing forces has also unlocked the secrets of the Deep—an age beyond the fading fires. Visions of the Deep have touched your mind, endowing you with eldritch and otherworldly knowledge, allowing you to cast magic that far surpasses even the power of the Dark itself, relentlessly pursuing your enemies. The corruption of the Deep spreads at your behest, affecting all but those with indomitable willpower.

Yet, it is not just magic and corruption that make the Deep so formidable. The Usurper of Fire possesses a fearsome ability—the power to devour. You can consume the flesh and souls of others, whether they be man, beast, or even gods. Through this devouring, you assimilate their powers and memories, growing stronger with each conquest. Your body remains unchanged unless consciously willed otherwise, allowing you to reach unimaginable heights of strength.

As the Usurper of Fire, you stand at the precipice of existence itself, wielding an immeasurable and endless power. You are the harbinger of a new era, where the fusion of the First Flame and the Dark Soul ignites an Age that defies comprehension—a new Age filled with wonders and impossibilities, where you alone define what can or cannot be.
addons.title: Usurper of Fire, Bringer Of A New Age

objects.text:
As the Chosen Undead, you embody the essence of humanity in all its forms. Your transitive soul is able to be given and absorb the souls of others while retaining your own identity. Regardless of the souls you possess, your core remains intact, transcending the essence of those you acquire. 

In a world where failure is a constant companion to humanity, each stumble and defeat becomes a valuable lesson, allowing you to grow stronger and adapt. Your unwavering determination and resilience in the face of challenges reflect the quintessential human spirit.

Like a valiant knight, your indomitable will resides even in a battered and broken body. Despite physical injuries and hardships, you press forward, fueled by enduring resolve. Your mind harnesses madness itself to propel you onward, overcoming the trials that stand in your way. Across countless eons, you persist in your duty without faltering. 

Immortality has been granted to you through the presence of a Fragment of a Lord Soul within you. Death's grip cannot hold you, as you rise again and again, defying the challenges before you. With each resurrection, your vitality is restored, allowing you to continue your journey. Unlike cursed Hollows, you retain your human appearance, forever bearing a healthy and vigorous visage.

Deep within you lies the power to spread the Curse of the Undead, known as the Darksign, to humanity across multiple worlds. Though a curse, it can also be seen as a gift to those longing for immortality. Should you desire, you can burden others with the same immortal fate, allowing them to rise from the grave and join you in the eternal cycle. This curse, intertwined with fragments of the Dark Soul, symbolizes the inseparable connection between humanity and the forces of darkness.
objects.title: Chosen Undead (Dark Souls)

addons.text:
From the embers of the First Flame, your soul ignites a new Age of Fire, surpassing even the might of the original. As the bearer of this power, you become the ruler of the First Flame residing within you, granting unparalleled dominion over all that falls under its domain, including fundamental concepts such as Death, Chaos, Heat, and more.

With the essence of the First Flame coursing through your being, Death becomes malleable, life and demise bend to your command. Chaos obeys, its destructive power reshaping the world. Heat is yours to control, igniting or extinguishing flames with but a thought.

Overtime, you will wield the power to shape reality itself, warping matter, energy, and time to suit your desires. Creation and destruction shall bow to your command, as you paint a new masterpiece of power and destiny. 

In this new Age of Fire, ignited by your soul, you are an unprecedented force, and the harbinger of a new era, where your might shapes existence itself.
addons.title: A New Age Of Fire

objects.text:
As the Inheritor of Embers, your power reaches unprecedented heights, With your embered form, you shine like a bonfire, emanating flickering flames that grant you heightened strength and endurance. In this state, your attacks carry the essence of Fire, inflicting devastating damage upon your foes. While you may not be a full-fledged Lord of Cinder yet, your mere presence commands awe and respect as you embody the very power of Fire itself.

But your abilities don't end there; within you is a mere fraction of the original Lord Soul, bestowing you enhanced prowess and resilience. It amplifies all your existing abilities, whether in combat, magic, or any other talents you possess, pushing them to new heights of effectiveness. 

However, what sets you apart even further is the unique inheritance bestowed upon you. You become the inheritor of every single being that has ever been sacrificed into the First Flames, including mighty gods like Nito, Gwyn, and Izalith. This extraordinary ability allows you to learn and absorb their memories, skills, knowledge, magic, and everything else that made them powerful beings. At the beginning, you may only access the abilities of weaker Lord of Cinders, but with time, training, and experience, you gain the capability to inherit even the skills of the gods themselves.

As the memories and powers of these beings intertwine with your own, you become a repository of ancient knowledge and extraordinary abilities. Through the ambers, you can manifest their legendary gears and wield them as if they were your own. 

With each new inheritance, you grow stronger, wiser, and more versatile. You can call upon the strengths of the gods to wield their elemental powers, harness the dark sorceries of Nito, the lightning bolts of Gwyn, and the chaotic flames of Izalith. Your arsenal of skills becomes vast and diverse, allowing you to adapt to any situation and overcome any challenge.
objects.title: Inheritor of Embers (Dark Souls)

addons.text:
You are not a mere child, but the living embodiment of the Abyss itself. Your new Abyssal form grants you the power to shape-shift effortlessly, disguising yourself as a flawless human or altering your body during battle, growing new limbs or towering over your foes. However, remember that you remain vulnerable to injury despite your transformative abilities.

Your soul has been infused with the Dark, a gift of the Dark Soul's boundless capacity to grow and expand. As you experience emotions, your soul deepens, generating and releasing new humanity into the world. This cycle strengthens and spreads your darkness, akin to Manus, the Father of the Abyss. The powers of darkness you possess have been greatly enhanced and will continue to grow alongside your Dark Soul.

Wherever you reside, you can warp the world around into an Abyss, a chasm of darkness that distorts space, time, and metaphysics. This Abyss expands as long as you remain, its darkness growing deeper in correlation with the strength of your Dark Soul.
addons.title: Ruler Of The Abyss

objects.text:
You have become the Primordial Man, gaining an unbreakable connection to the Dark Soul, the Abyss, and the inherent power of the Furtive Pygmy. 

Just like the Dark Soul, you will never fade with time; in fact, you will continue to grow stronger as long as you have the time to nurture and develop. You stand as the embodiment of the primordial nature of humanity, wielding the immense power of the Dark Soul and the Abyss itself.

Your darkened eyes see the world with unparalleled clarity, even in the darkest of environments. No longer will you lose your way in the night, as your eyes pierce through darkness effortlessly. Illusions hold no power over you, for you see through them as if they were mere mirages. Your vision is a beacon of truth, and those who attempt to deceive you will find themselves at a severe disadvantage.

You harness the power of the Dark to enhance your supernatural abilities. Any ability you possess, regardless of its nature, can be infused with Dark Hexes, granting it increased potency and rendering defenses against it ineffective without proper and specific protection. Your powers become exponentially stronger in the dark, and your attacks gain a will of their own, relentlessly pursuing your targets until they are vanquished.

As the Child of the Abyss, you carry a fragment of the Abyss, amplifying your mastery over the Dark. Your Dark powers will reach new heights as you unleash devastating blasts, beams, and showers of Dark energy upon your enemies. The very environment bends to your will, as you summon fountains of Dark to curse and hinder your foes. The Abyss empowers your explosions, infusing them with unimaginable might. Furthermore, you possess the unique ability to absorb the Dark from external sources, strengthening yourself and enhancing your speed and agility for a limited time. As long as you are surrounded by the Dark, you can draw upon its energy to fuel your own.
objects.title: The Furtive Pygmy (Dark Souls)

objects.text:
The core of your being has been twisted by an unknown power, granting you the ability to assume the form of the ancient and powerful entity known as the Old One. 

When activated, the power engulfs you in an aura of ominous white light, as your body undergoes a dramatic metamorphosis, you assume the divine form of the Old One, towering several stories high. Your body takes on the characteristics of a tree creature, resembling a majestic yet terrifying fusion of ancient wisdom and otherworldly malice. Your limbs elongate and branch out like gnarled roots, and your eyes shine with an otherworldly glow, radiating an aura of absolute dominance.

In this form, you are immortal, and gain unparalleled strength, endurance, and control over the souls of all living beings. Your mere presence radiates a malevolent aura, instilling fear and despair in those who behold you. Your very soul becomes a conduit for the Deep Fog, an otherworldly white fog that can destabilize reality, allowing for the anomalous phenomenon of magic and miracles to manifest in lands shrouded with the fog, while slowly spreading demonic madness across it. You gain intuitive mastery over the magic and miracles of the Deep Fog. 

As the embodiment of the Old One, you possess the ability to command and summon demons to do your bidding. These demons can be conjured from myth, resurrected from deceased creatures, or even transformed humans. These demons become your loyal agents, causing havoc and collecting souls for your newfound hunger.
objects.title: God of the Deep Fog (Demon's Souls)

objects.text:
Choose a historical or legendary figure from the annals of history, and you shall become their direct descendant and reincarnation. Through this newfound lineage, you inherit the awe-inspiring powers and abilities of your ancestor, embodying their epic tale and reenacting their remarkable deeds.

As a Descendant of a historical figure, you possess the ability to manifest the powers, appearance, and memories of your ancestor. With a mere act of will, you tap into the full potential of your ancestor's legacy, channeling their greatness and legend through your very being.

What sets you apart from other Reincarnators is that you possess the complete powers of your ancestor right from the start. Your transformation is permanent, granting you immediate access to their extraordinary capabilities. This advantage allows you to fully embrace the essence of your ancestor's legend, transcending the limitations faced by other Reincarnators.

Furthermore, you are not burdened by the uncontrollable urges typically associated with this lineage. Regardless of whether your ancestor was revered for great achievements or infamous for terrible acts, these urges do not sway your actions. Your own identity remains intact, granting you the freedom to choose your own path and forge your own destiny, unencumbered by the personality traits or desires of your ancestor.

It should also be noted that, as a Returner, you possess naturally superhuman physical abilities. Your agility rivals that of an Olympic sprinter, and your strength allows you to effortlessly shatter stone and trees with your bare fists.
objects.title: To Stand In The Shoulder Of Giants (Petals of Reincarnation)

addons.text:
You are no longer a mere Seraphim but have mutated into something far more, ascending beyond the bounds of angelic hierarchy to the point that, to lesser beings, you might be mistaken for God Himself. 

A Seraphim empowered to this degree once shattered a magical seal that bound Death itself, easily defeated thousands of angels and even killed an Archangel (albeit the weakest of the four). This transformation has also erased the vulnerabilities you formerly possessed, such as angel blades, due to the ancient exotic souls intertwined with your being.

Your incredible caliber of angelic Grace is the result of being energised by tapping into your vast well of spiritual essence deep within. As such, it is important to recognise that you still have limits to what you can do with nigh-almighty acts of power consuming large portions of this reserve.
addons.title: The Seventh Trumpet

objects.text:
Created by God, you are a celestial being known as a Seraphim. You are responsible for maintaining Heaven and fighting against the Demons of Hell in an eternal war. Similar to your demonic counterparts, you too can only interact with the physical world through the usage of a human body, called a vessel. However, unlike demons, you require permission to possess your vessel (though how you obtain that permission is up to you). Through the Cyoa, your current body or the body you choose to be either Inserted or Reincarnated into will be transformed into a perfect vessel for you.

As a Seraphim, your spiritual form and voice will prove overwhelming to most mortals. It can cause effects such as burning eyes or bleeding eardrums. Your size has been described as "approximately the size of the Chrysler Building." When outside of a vessel and on the physical plane, you will appear to humans as either a brilliant white light or a bluish luminous smoke.

Becoming a Seraphim has granted you a whole host of abilities, such as nigh-invulnerability (angels are immune to all forms of harm except Angel Blades, Holy Fire, and beings more powerful than themselves, such as Archangels, an Primordials). You also possess limited cosmic awareness, allowing you to have knowledge and awareness of certain topics in the universe, including demons, Enochian symbols and magic, spells, prayers, and all languages (dead or alive, written and spoken). Angelic senses and perception are incredibly enhanced, enabling you to recognize beings based on their body odor and genes, see atoms and ions, hear conversations from miles away, and taste every molecule in a meal. You can also see the true form of other angels, demons, and reapers, as well as sense the location of every being in the universe, except those protected by Enochian magic and those stronger than you who choose to hide and Teleporting whereever you senses reach. Furthermore, you possess limited chronokinesis, allowing you to travel through time, send others forward or backward through time, and manipulate time itself (e.g., freezing or speeding it up). However, repeated use of these abilities can be draining on your Grace. Additionally, you have a whole host of additional abilities, including reality warping, telepathy, telekinesis, high level healing & Biokinesis, advanced Dreamwalking, and the ability to hear prayers directed at you.

You have also been given an Angel Blade and Sword. These weapons can be used to kill most supernatural beings by channeling your Grace/Soul against your opponents. However, they are unable to kill beings stronger than you, such as Archangels. If lost or stolen, you will always be able to call them back to you.

Be aware that while within a vessel, angels only possess their powers thanks to their Grace. If your Grace is taken or drained, you become like a human, retaining only your angelic senses, while your Grace slowly regenerates. The regeneration process could take months or even years, depending on how much has been taken.

As a side effect of having cosmic senses, you are unable to enjoy food like usual. Your heightened senses allow you to taste EVERYTHING you eat. Therefore, if you want to enjoy food again like a regular person, it is recommended to choose a cooking power or the perk "Holding Back."
objects.title: Seraphim (Supernatural)

objects.text: You have become a living vessel for another universe’s purgatory, a realm dedicated to imprisoning the souls of monsters. This dimension holds approximately 30 to 40 million souls, ranging from mere ghosts to primal monstrosities, all of which have been poured into you. On its own, this power doesn’t grant any overt abilities beyond locking all these souls inside you. What it does do, however, is massively supercharge any abilities or powers you possess that can feasibly draw upon these souls. You can even convert the souls into pure energy to fuel alternative metaphysical abilities like magic or psionic energy, empowering them exponentially. To give a sense of scale, a Seraphim Angel infused with these souls ascended to a god-like status, capable of killing an Archangel with a snap of their fingers. A single subpar soul held within you is equivalent to a nuclear reactor while the souls of far more powerful entities, such as ancient leviathans that predate creation itself, possess power comparable to entire stars. Despite the burden of all these souls, you are the perfect container. You do not deteriorate, fracture or burn out under the strain. No soul can escape your grasp, nor can they exert any influence or harm upon you. They are utterly bound to your will and are yours to do with as you wish. Moreover, this reservoir is completely self-sustaining. You naturally replenish the souls within you by absorbing any appropriate souls readily available in the universe around you, ensuring your repository's potency never wanes or diminishes.
objects.title: Vessel of Purgatory (Supernatural)

addons.text:
Your creations are no longer limited to biological organisms or stable supernatural species. You may now create Legends: supernatural entities, urban myths, paranormal phenomena, conceptual horrors, cursed stories, symbolic beings, and other anomalies sustained through fear, belief, recognition, rumors, stories, and collective perception rather than biology alone.

Legends do not require consistent anatomy, physical logic, or even permanent existence. A Legend may exist as a creature, phenomenon, location, object, event, rumor, dream, shadow, structure, or partially real entity so long as the concept behind it remains coherent. You may create Legends entirely from your imagination or shape existing fears, myths, urban legends, paranormal concepts, and supernatural stories into living entities and phenomena.

Each Legend operates according to supernatural rules defined during its creation. Some may spread through stories, recordings, dreams, symbols, rituals, or sightings, while others only manifest under specific conditions such as darkness, isolation, storms, mirrors, abandoned places, fear, or direct recognition. These conditions form the foundation of how a Legend manifests, spreads, sustains itself, and interacts with reality.

The strength of a Legend depends on both its design and the amount of fear, awareness, belief, recognition, and narrative weight surrounding it. Forgotten or unknown Legends are weaker and less stable, while widely feared or recognized Legends become stronger, harder to suppress, and increasingly influential. Rumors, investigations, media, sightings, supernatural encounters, and recurring stories may all strengthen a Legend over time.

As the creator of these entities, you possess an innate awareness of every Legend you create. You may perceive through them, communicate through them, influence their actions, suppress them, alter them, or recall them regardless of distance or dimensional separation. Legends remain fundamentally loyal to you unless intentionally designed otherwise. You may refine their appearance, abilities, behaviors, manifestation conditions, weaknesses, and supernatural properties at any time.

Legends naturally evolve as they accumulate fear, stories, victims, influence, or cultural presence. A simple stalking entity may eventually develop territorial influence, dream intrusion, environmental distortion, memetic spread, or lesser manifestations of itself as its legend grows. You may also create location-based Legends tied directly to specific buildings, forests, roads, tunnels, stations, graveyards, districts, or regions, causing those areas to develop persistent paranormal effects, supernatural phenomena, altered laws, or hostile environments connected to the Legend inhabiting them.

Unlike normal monsters, Legends are difficult to permanently destroy. Destroying their physical manifestation does not necessarily erase the Legend itself. So long as the underlying fear, story, symbolism, recognition, or supernatural condition continues to exist, the Legend may eventually return.

Your existing monsters may also evolve into Legends. Through sufficient fear, recognition, mythology, or supernatural influence, creatures created through Originator of Monsters can develop conceptual behaviors, manifestation conditions, narrative persistence, and anomalous properties beyond normal physical limitations.
addons.title: Originator of Legends

objects.text:
Similar to Eve, you are a being formed from before the angels, a primordial entity made in the image of the Leviathans but before humans. You have gained the ability to create monsters– mixing and matching unique strains of monster DNA to create hybrids of existing monsters, copying monsters you did not create, or even creating monsters that have no pre-existing origin. 

Through simply a touch, you can turn humans into any monster that you have previously created or even a new monster. Although turning people into new forms of monsters can be tricky to get just right, that requires experimentation. You do not require a pre-existing life form to create monsters, as you can also form eggs through which monsters can be born without infecting a human and turning them into a monster. Any time you create a new Monster, the first of its kind will be vastly stronger than any of its brethren, being a so-called ‘alpha’ variant, an apex specimen.

Similar to Eve, you possess a telepathic link to every monster you have created, even through dimensions. Through this link, you can view the world through their eyes, speak through them, take over their body, and even communicate with them as a voice in their head. As the Originator of Monsters, all of your “children” are loyal to you, and you can influence them to act in ways uncharacteristic of previous behaviour or initial reluctance.

As a being created similarly to the Leviathans, you possess many similar abilities, such as invulnerability to normal human-made weapons, an ageless lifespan, possession of humans with a touch, Heightened Senses, Enhanced Speed and Strength, Regeneration that can restore you in a matter of seconds to peak health even after having your head separated from your body, and shapeshifting. 

You do possess one weakness; should you attempt to make a new creature vastly stronger than yourself, an element of their creation could prove harmful to yourself, acting as kryptonite, ignoring your durability and regeneration, similar to how Eve attempted to create a Phoenix only for its ashes to become her weakness.
objects.title: Originator of Monsters (Supernatural)

addons.text:
You have the capacity to reach Sequence 0 of your selected Pathway. This is no easy feat, requiring a Apotheosis Ritual worthy of a True God, as that is what you become upon your ascension. 

Your Uniqueness will meld into a full Authority upon your ascension. You will have virtually perfect control over your Authority and gain power from it as it is a part of your very being. 

Bestowing slivers of your powers onto your follows comes with ease, these powers come are temporary and can be incredibly draining. Your mere presence is enough to influence the environment around you, at-will you are able to cause bizarre and strange effects. These changes will be in line with your Authority. 

Additionally, you are able to manipulate your own personal size and maintain your physical proportions while doing so, increasing your height to be as tall as a mountain or shrinking yourself to the size of a normal human comes with ease and is near instantaneous.
addons.title: True God Potential

addons.text:
You have the capacity to reach a peculiar rank known as Above The Sequence, requiring one of the 9 Sefirots and the Uniqueness of the accompanying Pathways. 

There are 9 positions for Above The Sequence, each being tied to their own Sefirot, these 9 being God Almighty, Lord of Mysteries, Eternal Darkness, Goddess of Origin, The Anarchy, Calamity of Destruction, Father of Devils, Demon of Knowledge, and Key of Light. 

This level of power solidifies your Godhood, giving you near-omniscience and omnipotence, allowing you to hand out even greater power with even less cost, and so much more. 

All parts of your Authorities have been broadened and further increased in power, giving you an even wider base of power.
addons.title: Above the Sequence Potential

objects.text:
You have the innate potential to reach Sequence 1 of a single Pathway out of the 22 Pathways. This allows you to start at Sequence 9 and work your way up to the peak of Sequence 1 at no risk of losing your mind. Each Pathway has its own unique traits and abilties, extra information on these can be found on the Lord of The Mysteries wiki. 

You fulfill a paradoxical attitude of life, maintaining your own personal beliefs and view on life while still advancing your Pathway, additionally there is no thought off-limits to you, no Divine Revelation, knowledge, or Eldritch Truth can corrupt you. There are advancement Rituals required for your ascension to the next Sequence, you will instinctually know what these rituals are in-depth and can complete them with ease. 

Increasing your Sequence improves all of your skills qualitatively, bringing all skills up to the high capabilities of your current Sequence.

Upon reaching the High Sequences (4 through 1), you are able to influence reality, how this influence is expressed is dependent on your Pathway. You are timeless and will never lose control over yourself or your powers, not requiring anchors to maintain your sanity. 

Your Mythical Creature form will conform to your desires while still remaining true to your Pathway. 

You are able to receive prayers and respond to them with your will if you so choose.
objects.title: Beyonder (Lord of the Mysteries)

addons.text: You have ascended to the throne of sequence zero of a pathway belonging to your sefirot, which allowed you to complete your accommodation of said sefirot, becoming a genuine Half-Great Old One. As a Genuine Half-Great Old One, your power stabilises at the Half-Great Old One level. You have access to all the abilities and authorities and partial access to the symbols within your high sequence group. This leaves you able to dominate sequence zeros with trivial ease. Only when there are nine to twelve true gods can they roughly match your power. At this stage, you can even fight Genuine Great Old Ones, for short periods of time as an equal, at least as long as they don't have symbols that significantly counter yours. You can form a connection with anyone who possesses sufficient knowledge about you; you can use this connection to cast your gaze on them, or use this link to project your abilities on the poor, unfortunate soul who caught your attention. Only angel-level existences or higher can sever this connection. You can control and influence how information regarding you is reflected in the spirit world, allowing you to remove it entirely or tamper with it to misdirect divinations regarding you. As you have fully merged with your sefirot and dealt with any lingering consciousnesses within, leaving your consciousness a unified whole, it is impossible to divide your consciousness, even when in a consciousness space or under similar circumstances. With this, only obtaining the uniquenesses and a sequence one beyonder characteristics you lack from each pathway is needed to complete your transformation into a proper Great Old Dominator. If you have Additional Uniquenesses (Lord of The Mysteries) or the additional Sequence Zero Kits needed to complete your High Sequence Group, you instead directly become a complete Great Old One.
addons.title: Half-Great Old One

objects.text:
You have ascended to the ‘’The Unity of Heaven and Man’’ stage through the western continent's Daoism pathway system, becoming a Dao Integrator of a Sefirot of your choice. Unlike those within the western continent, you can integrate into the Chaos Sea or the Sefirot Castle in addition to the seven sefirot sealed in the western continent. 

Your method of Dao Integration lacks most of the native Dao Integrator’s flaws, such as lacking a fate and being without possibility, nor being able to leave the natural divine kingdom created by the sefirot. Since you lack these flaws, you possess a fate and future possibilities, and you can act freely in reality. 

As a Dao Integrator, you have the power, abilities, and authority of the Sequence Zero that aligns most closely with the essence of the corresponding sefirot; in the case of the River of Eternal Darkness, this would be the Death pathway, albeit in your normal state, you would be slightly weaker.

You can borrow the power, abilities, and authorities of a Half a Great Old One in short bursts, should you fight without regard for your survival. This will significantly reduce your mental and spiritual stability. Doing this for more than five minutes every hundred years would be heavily advised against. Certain Great Old Ones, such as the Lord of the Mysteries, can reduce backlash and extend the time limit to several hours.

As a Dao Integrator, you have partially merged with and thus partially accommodated the corresponding sefirot. Should you advance along the potion pathways system to sequence zero, you could finish your Sefirot accommodation in a few moments while maintaining an absolute advantage over the primordial one’s will inside, allowing you to become a Great Old One yourself without the traditional ego death it comes with.

As the aura of a sefirot permeates your entire being, you are highly resistant to corruption originating from other sefirot or outer deities. The original or previous owners of the sefirot you have integrated with are unable to awaken within your body.

Though the risk of losing control in other ways remains.
objects.title: Dao Integrator (Lord of the Mysteries)

addons.text:
You are no longer only destined for sainthood or being the echo of the Oldest One. Your future is fixed on becoming the Original Creator in full. Fate itself moves at your side, ensuring that every gain you make brings the moment closer, as reality bends in subtle ways to favor your ascent as an absolute inevitability.

You can now hold every pathway at once, no matter how incompatible. Advancing in any sequence now dramatically shortens the time required for your ascension, reducing what would have lasted until the end of the Universe and bringing the realization of sainthood and the Original Creator’s complete power as one. Your ability to bless others with power is also enhanced, allowing you to grant strength up to the level of Sequence 0 or even Great Old One, provided you hold such power yourself. All of your existing protections and defenses are elevated to their highest form, becoming absolute in their effect. You are absolutely immune to corruption, loss of control, manipulation of any type of nature, and all other complications, no matter the source, and anything that comes into contact with you or attempts to manipulate you is absorbed and assimilated by your absolute will, with the source immediately suffering corruption in return if you so desire.

You suffer no risk of convergence or divergence, not during your rise nor after you stand as the Original Creator. All forces, pathways, and powers, whether conflicting or not, remain stable within you eternally, becoming inseparably one with you. When you gain all 22 pathways, it will be enough to forgo the time required for your ascension, achieving sainthood and claiming the true totality of the Original Creator’s existence and powers, encompassing all that is within the pathways, together with those of gods outside them, and beyond.
addons.title: Return of the Oldest One

addons.text:
You have inherited the memories of the Primordial Chaos in full without being overwhelmed by the sheer number of memories the Oldest One has as the primordial creator of the universe and all things within. This leaves your self-awareness unchanged, and you truly remain yourself.

As God Almighty, Lord of Mysteries, Eternal Darkness, Calamity of Destruction, Demon of Knowledge, and the Key of Light are personas of the Oldest One, their memories are included in this, which gives you a deep understanding of their corresponding symbols and authorities. This also does not alter your self-recognition.

While this does not necessarily make you stronger, as it is purely memories, it gives you a near encyclopedic knowledge of the universe and all things within, as well as a deep understanding of reality, the spirit world, and the astral world.

This knowledge and understanding then act as a rock-solid foundation for some abilities, such as the Fool pathways historical projection, the Hermit pathways mystical re-enactment, the White Towers pathways imitation and spellcrafting, and the Visionary pathways pure idealism authority.
addons.title: Inheritance of the Oldest Memory

objects.text: The Oldest One is insane, yet sane, the most holy, and the most decadent abyss, human, yet bestial, divine, yet demonic, ordered, yet chaotic, for HE is the embodiment of all contradictions, all things are possible through HIM. A part of Oldest One's spirit has awakened within you and merged with your being, becoming a manifestation of a fragment of Oldest One's Humanity. You have a Status comparable to that of a Pillar, even if you lack the power and authority a Pillar would have. Your spirit is unbelievably durable, almost as enduring as the souls of Great Old One's, and your will is truly indestructible and incorruptible. It remains in some form eternally, even after your death. Eventually, it will drift into the spirit of another, allowing you to resurrect in their body. This can, however, take eons, but it will happen; even if the universe itself comes to an end, you will simply be reborn in the next. As a partial manifestation of the Primordial Chaos that created the universe, you can draw upon its energy to refill your own reserves. You can use spirit vision at will and have a similar capacity for ritualistic magic as White Tower or Hermit path angels, even if you lack the innate knowledge they have. With your Status, few spirits or deities will refuse to answer your rituals and prayers, even if they don't exactly know why. You have a much easier time advancing the beyonder pathway system, with an ever greater ease if you follow the paths that symbolize the Oldest One in some form or have inherited symbols pointing toward HIM, such as God Almighty inheriting the Genesis symbol, or the Calamity of Destruction symbolizing the feminine and masculine sides of the Oldest One. Acting according to your pathway comes naturally, almost to the degree that just living life naturally digests the beyonder characteristics within you. You do not risk going insane or becoming a monster, as your Status suppresses such complications. However, you still need to digest your potion to advance properly. As a fragment of Primordial Chaos, you can remain stable even if you unite the three fate pathways and become the Controller of Fate or become the Original One in the Mirror through Calamity of Destruction. Like the Oldest One, you are the Exception to All Rules. Your limits remain, and the impossible is still impossible, yet as the exception to the rules, you move beyond both, being capable of achieving the impossible.
objects.title: Oldest One’s Spiritual Awakening (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text:
You have received the Grace of the holy Erdtree (and through it, the Greater Will), which compelled so many Tarnished to enter The Lands Between.

The blessing grants a form of immortality, allowing you to revive yourself at "Sites Of Grace", circles of holy light you are guided to by shimmers in the wind. Here you can rest, fully healing you, restoring you, & replenishing certain consumables (such as the Sacred Flasks you have been granted), skipping periods of time, traveling to any other discovered Site Of Grace, & giving you the opportunity to upgrade your flasks or allocate your Runes, among other things. You also gain the ability to summon an Ethereal steed named "Torrent."

This also allows you to become a Runebearer, one who wields the mighty runes of the Elden Ring. You gain runes from defeating enemies (with more powerful beings granting more runes), which allows you to grant yourself new abilities & augment your strength.

Over time, you will ascend to the rank of Shardbearer, as larger fragments of the Elden Ring come under your dominion. These cosmic runes hold divine authority over specific concepts or ideas (such as Life, Death, Fire, Light, or Dark). At first, their power is somewhat limited (like increasing every stat slightly, healing slightly for each being you slay, or changing your appearance & reallocating your "stats"), but as you grow in strength, so will your Great Runes, granting you the power of the Gods of old.
objects.title: Grace of The Erdtree (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
An outer god of origins beyond mortal comprehension, an entity known only as the Scarlet Rot, has fixed its festering gaze upon you, deeming you the most worthy vessel for its all-corrupting powers.

You will find your body transformed, augmented with a massive supernatural boost to all of your physical abilities. If you so choose, your hair will also transform, turning a rich scarlet red, ever flowing gracefully with the wind.

Your willpower and mental fortitude have been tempered; pain and mental torment that would break even the strongest of men wouldn't even break a sweat for you. Your natural talents now lean and yearn irresistibly for the sword. You are not merely a genius with a blade, for your aptitude borders on the divine. Pick up a sword for the first time, and within a week, you will become a master. Persist for a year, and you shall never know defeat.

The Rot within you also grants the power to siphon the life force of living beings, healing you with every successful strike landed. The amount of siphoned life force depends on the severity of the hit. A powerful sword swipe that inflicts a grievous wound can regrow limbs instantly, while a simple graze that draws a shallow cut might only close an open wound, or stop the bleeding of a deep one. This can also extend your lifespan if you suffered no physical wounds while siphoning the life energy.

The most potent force in your arsenal remains the Scarlet Rot itself. This virulent and fickle devourer can consume everything down to the very soul or mutate beings into abhorrent, mindless creatures bound to worship you as their deity. You can learn to harness and even master the boundless power of the Rot, but beware: if it ever finds you lacking, even you will not escape its nigh-unstoppable decay.
objects.title: The Scarlet Rot (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
You are a Hellspawn, a being that was formerly human but made a deal with a Lord of Hell for a favor and, in return, were used as an officer for their army. When a Hellspawn is created, their bodies are reforged and infused with a dark energy called Necroplasm. While most Hellspawn tend to look grotesque (and that's being nice), you will look as you currently do, only brought to peak physical condition, bonded with a sentient and constantly evolving neural parasite also made of Necroplasm, which takes the form of a suit linked directly to their host's central nervous system. Yours is a K-7 model, a stronger, more purebred, and adaptive variant, making you a stronger Hellspawn. The suit feeds on the souls of those it kills to enhance, adapt, and evolve itself in response to your needs, wants, desires, and the stimuli it encounters. The suit is able to shift itself into any form you need and can take on various weapon forms for combat, only really limited by your imagination. It feeds off the Necroplasm (or any other spiritual energy you possess) in your body to sustain itself. The suit will move on its own to protect you even when you are unconscious. The costume can also feed off evil energy from the physical world, feeding off the ambient evil of people, animals, and even certain parts of cities.

The combination of a Necroplasm body and Symbiote being much denser than your mortal body gives you greatly superhuman strength that can go toe to toe with high-level angels and demons, speed such that you can dodge light, durability, reflexes, etc.

The greatest ability of a Hellspawn is their vast magical powers, though limited by your power supply, (though this can be replenished with time or absorbing it from spiritual sources). Though the power source is finite, what you can do with it is only limited by your imagination. Some of the ways this magic has been used include resurrecting the dead, firing blasts of necroplasmic energy, teleportation, transmutation, elemental manipulation, shape-shifting, flight, talking to animals, invisibility, multidimensional portals , space-time manipulation, soul manipulation, reality warping, regeneration, feeding off the evil sins and negative energy to augment yourself and refill your reserves, Healing, phasing, psychic powers, telekinesis, cosmic awareness. The list goes on.

Another effect of this transformation is that you now contain 6000 lost souls called the Legion. These are the souls of those who died during the same hour that you were transformed. The power from these souls renders you uncontrollable by the lords of Hell. You can, with practice, learn to access their knowledge and experiences. You can also cause these souls to manifest themselves physically as Hellspawn, allowing them to appear and aid you in combat wherever you are. You can talk to these souls and free them by completing any unfinished business they have, and while this lowers the effective force of the Legion, the souls that choose to stay will become stronger and more tempered to battle, lowering the quantity but raising the quality of the Legion.

Hellspawn are practically immortal unless beheaded by a weapon of heaven or by powerful magic. Though you can be rendered powerless (and therefore mortal) in "Dead Zones" small patches of Earth that are Heaven's domain. Also, you possess a degree of acausality, meaning that any changes to your past or future self will have no effect on the current you.

Note that as time passes, Hellspawn only grow more powerful and dangerous.
objects.title: Hellspawn (Image Comics)
Redeemer (Image Comics)
objects.text:
You have become a Redeemer, a former human chosen by Heaven to serve as a soldier in the war against Hell and as their equivalent to the Hellspawn. Likewise, you are no longer a living being; your body has been reforged and infused with Elemental Fire, an energy equivalent to Necroplasm, bringing your body to peak physical condition. Redeemers usually do not retain any knowledge of their previous mortal lives, but in your case, your memories will remain intact. Unlike the Hellspawn, who tend to look grotesque, Redeemers retain the appearance they had in life. Much like a Hellspawn, a Redeemer carries the same limitless rage within their soul, though the source of that anger is light rather than darkness.

You have also become bonded to a sentient and constantly evolving symbiote made of Elemental Fire that takes the form of a suit linked to your central nervous system. In your case, it is equivalent to the K7-Leetha worn by Spawn. The suit feeds on the souls of those it kills to grow stronger, and it can shapeshift into any form you desire, limited only by your imagination. It feeds on Elemental Fire, good energy, ambient positive energy, or any other spiritual energy within your body to sustain itself, and the suit will move on its own to protect you even when you are unconscious.

Your new physiology, combined with your symbiote, grants you immense superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, and agility, allowing you to fight powerful demons and angels. You are also completely free from Heaven's bindings and are virtually immortal, with only weapons of Heaven or Hell, or sufficiently powerful magic, being able to truly end you. Any attempts to affect you by altering your past or future will have no effect on you. Unlike the Hellspawn, you cannot be rendered powerless in small areas of Earth that belong to either Heaven or Hell.

As your body is made of Elemental Fire, you can harness this energy to achieve the same effects a Hellspawn would have through Necroplasm. While this means your reserves are limited, they can replenish over time on their own, feed on ambient good energy or positive energy, or absorb it from any spiritual sources you have access to. What you can accomplish with Elemental Fire is limited only by your imagination, including energy projection, flight, teleportation, reality warping, healing yourself and others, resurrection, psionics, and cosmic awareness. Lastly, your powers will continue to grow as time passes.

addons.text:
You gain the technology (and magic, which in this setting is not so different from technology) of the Seraph of The End universe.

This includes both Vampire & JIDA technology, the research of the Hyakuya Sect, the ancient Seraph civilization's many achievements, The Three Spells, spell circles, spell tags, magic sigils, many other forms of magic & spellcraft, Cursed Gear & Runic Gear creation, and much more.
addons.title: Tower of Babel

objects.text:
Seraphs were first created by humans trying to defy the natural order of the universe and resurrect the dead. You have become one such individual who was resurrected from the dead, thus becoming something greater than human. An abnormal existence that defies the natural order of the universe, harboring an angel within yourself.

While you still possess your normal appearance despite playing host to a divine being within your body and soul, you are anything but normal. Every ability you have is bolstered by the presence of the angel, giving you strength above what you would normally have. A human could go from being average to destroying a city with ease. You also gain a supernatural regeneration that keeps you alive as long as the angel is. The angel cannot be killed by normal means. It also takes more for you to be injured, as your durability has been altered to be equal to the amount of strength that you possess. You possess another form that you can transform into; this transformation only happens under great duress at the start. However, as time goes by and you gain more control over your power, you can access this form whenever you wish.

When in this form, your eyes turn pitch black with golden irises, as well as gaining six wings made of your own blood that has turned into a pitch-black, tar-like substance That allows for flight at around twice the speed you can normally go on land; additionally, your physical and other abnormal abilities are tremendously enhanced, to the point that you could, with your bare hands, shake an entire island and, with a sword, cut it in half. Your speed and durability have also increased to similar heights. Your regeneration has also been bolstered so that you can regenerate from a single cell in under a second, whereas before it would take at least a month.

Additionally, each Seraph gains access to a unique abnormal ability. This usually comes in the form of abilities similar to the Seven Trumpets mentioned in the Book Of Revelation. However, this is not a limitation that you have; your ability can be anything that suits your personality. This also comes with the ability to turn both living and non-living things into salt with a wave of your hand.

The Seraph that has entered your body is sentient and will take control when you are unconscious; however, the personality and form they take are best suited to your personality and are loyal to you.
objects.title: Seraph (Seraph of the End)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the status of a Guardian and a God, granting you the power to transform into an Idaten—a being born from the energy of thoughts and prayers, tasked with safeguarding a peaceful world. As an Idaten, you possess incredible advantages over humans and other creatures.

Free from the need for sustenance or rest, you exist on a different level. While you can experience pleasure and pain, you possess remarkable resilience and can endure great suffering without being defeated. Your body naturally reverts to an undamaged state over time, healing injuries and wounds.

You can choose to remain unseen by mortals, but supernatural beings can easily perceive your presence. Your speed is unmatched; even as a novice Idaten, you can run at incredible velocities, crossing vast distances in the blink of an eye.

Your most significant strength lies in your limitless growth. Fueled by the power of Want, you can continuously improve and evolve your abilities. By training diligently, pursuing goals, and yearning for progress, you can reshape your physical and mental attributes. Whether it's enduring injuries, becoming faster, or manifesting unique powers like technopathy or telekinesis, your potential knows no bounds.

Mental skills can be honed too, allowing you to excel in specific tasks. While you may not become an all-around genius, you can acquire exceptional expertise in your chosen fields.

Becoming a mature Idaten takes time and dedication, usually around one hundred and fifty years of focused training. But with each step of your growth, you transform into a powerful and compassionate protector of peace, embodying the noble purpose for which you were born.
objects.title: Guardian of A Peaceful World (Idaten)

addons.text:
You are the new Dark Lord, also known as the Prince of Darkness or Demon King. As the Dark Lord, your will extends across all Devils/Demons, allowing you to bend the demonic spirits to your command.

This has enhanced your Power Of Dominance, making it so you no longer have to just defeat individuals in combat. Instead, you can now have individuals swear themselves to you, binding their souls to you and Castlevania, tying their very existence to your power. They become as much a part of you as Castlevania has become. This allows you to do as you please with them, such as giving them access to any abilities you or those bonded to Castlevania have, changing their form, reviving them if they are killed, or even erasing their very soul from existence. It's up to you.

Your bond with Castlevania has become complete, making the Castle now an extension of you and your power. The Castle can freely change its form to suit your desires and control its interior dimensions as you wish. It also makes you aware of all that happens and is happening on its grounds, acting as a focus for your powers. Moreover, it can revive or recreate those in your power or service through the Castle if they die.

You also gain the knowledge & experience of all previous Dark Lords, and those of the Dark Lord candidates.
addons.title: The Dark Lord

addons.text: The Power of Dominance and that of a Shardbinder are not so different. Now on top of the Power Of Dominance's ability to directly manifest the power of your defeated foes, the demonic crystals in your body allow you to express their captured essence in different ways, such as water-based enemies giving you a water attack, even if they themselves had no such attack. This also allows your foes abilities to be upgraded beyond their limits using alchemy, or by absorbing the essence of more than one of a similar type.
addons.title: Shardbinder (Bloodstained)

objects.text:
This is the greatest and primary ability of the Dark Lord, and what makes the Dark Lord the Ruler of Chaos.

This ability allows you, like the Dark Lord, to use all the power and abilities of beings that you defeat in combat and/or kill, allowing you to absorb their souls and completely control them, thus gaining access to all of their abilities and power.

The power itself is extremely dangerous to handle, as those not specifically prepared for its power aren't able to contain it, and thus die. However, this isn't a danger for you, for you are perfectly matched for the Power Of Dominance.
objects.title: Power Of Dominance (Castlevania)

objects.text:
You have recently become an Awakener one who has come to doubt and reject reality as it is and begun walking the unconventional path of breaking free from its constrain and limitations, Gaining the power to turn belief into truth and conviction into reality, furthermore awakener has access to an infinite amount of spiritual power to fuel their ability but suffer from mental fatigue when they use it.

There are 6 stages to awakening and overcoming each stages grant greater power to the awakener. Each stage has a personal trial that is unique for each person which must be overcome to advance to the next stage. 

The first three-stage is referred to as the three-stage of a fallen world where an awakener breaks down and destroys the worldview they knew and grew up in, the later stages are referred to as the three stages of genesis in which an awakener creates their own unique world mental construct that is validated by the user's belief. When activated, the Unique World is projected throughout the environment. Unique Worlds are stronger when the Awakener has followers that believe in the world, or if the Awakener has high personal spiritual power.
objects.title: Awakening (The World After The Fall)

objects.text: "I will awaken the breath of the planet... For I walk with humanity." Born at the hands of Anu and Aruru and shaped into personhood by Shamhat, you are comprised of divine clay. This clay is incredibly mutable, allowing you to shapeshift into an almost endless number of forms, including animals, tools, and copies of different people. Your physical parameters can be consciously manipulated by you, like you would a video game character. For example, you can increase strength at the cost of agility, or increase your endurance at the cost of strength, making you an incredibly flexible combatant who can surprise even a veteran fighter with unnatural bursts of speed or feats of immense luck or strength. Additionally, earthen weapons and armaments of exquisite quality may be formed by your powers to be used and shot out at Mach speeds. These constructs are limited by the technology of the time period; For example, if you were in modern times, you would be able to create contemporary artillery pieces but not sci-fi weapons. But none of these compares to your two trump cards. The first is the Chains of Heaven, once used to bind Gugalanna. They are mighty chains that grow greater in power the more divinity that is shackled within them. Not even spatial warping could save you if you were immobilised. The other trump card is the ability to be empowered by the World. When an enemy threatens the planet or humanity, you will be suitably permitted to draw more magical energy from the planet, allowing you to increase your body's parameters and counter your opponents with your Noble Phantasm, Enuma Elish. This also means you have a greater connection to nature, allowing you to have a greater spatial awareness and to speak to all animals. You are Enkidu.
objects.title: Body of Mud And Clay (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You have learned to speak not only to other peoples’ souls but also to the soul of the World itself. 

As the World listens when you speak, your words directly affect the world around you, much like your Divine Words. However, unlike Divine Words you do not call upon fragments of Divine Authority, instead your words resonate with the root itself and command the World as a whole to action.

As it draws from something more fundamental, your nature interference Magecraft is far more difficult to resist or defend against, though not quite as irresistible as your power over people.

The actual effects of your Unified Language are limited only by your stock of magical energy, your imagination, and your eloquence.
addons.title: World Speaker

objects.text:
You gain the ability to wield the Unified Language, transforming you into a Master of Babel. The Unified Language, known as the Tongue of Babel, is a primordial tongue originating from ancient Babylonia, an era when no other languages existed and all forms of communication—be it among humans, creatures, or even living and non-living things—were one and the same. It is the “truth” that existed before the scattering of humanity, a language that draws its power directly from the Swirl of the Root, the metaphysical repository of all records, memories, and phenomena across existence. To speak the Unified Language is not merely to communicate but to wield an unyielding force that resonates with the very fabric of reality.

Unlike ordinary speech, the Unified Language bypasses the physical realm entirely. It is spoken directly through the soul, a resonance that connects to the Root itself. This connection allows a Master of Babel to bridge the divide between minds and souls. The Unified Language enables one to converse with any being, perceive the pasts and hidden truths of others, and exert complete and absolute control over them. This control is not a mere suggestion or compulsion but an ontological imperative. To resist the Unified Language is to deny the core structure of reality, which is fundamentally impossible for ordinary beings.

When spoken, the Unified Language transforms statements into undeniable truths. It is the ultimate form of hypnotism, not through mere suggestion or persuasion but by directly altering the listener’s existential understanding. Every being is, in part, derived from the Root, and the Unified Language speaks to this shared origin. It compels absolute obedience by speaking to the core of a person’s soul, bypassing conscious thought or will. The language imposes the will of the speaker as if it were the fundamental laws of existence.

However, targets who are themselves deeply connected to the Root and/or stronger than you can resist its effects.

This control generally lasts for a full day, though its duration can vary depending on the your strength, experience, and the difference in strength between you and your target. A novice may only maintain their hold for a few hours, while a seasoned Master of Babel can extend their dominion well beyond a single day.
objects.title: Unified Language (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
The one who defies fate and the one whom fortune favors—these two truths intertwine, creating a path where prosperity and possibility walk hand in hand. No longer are you merely breaking free from fate’s grip; you now seize fortune itself. The luck that shields you from misfortune also ensures that every step forward is met with abundance, as though the world rushes to fill the void left by the destiny you shattered.

Where before you had to work for your wealth, now even the smallest effort tends to yield disproportionate rewards, as if the world itself conspires to enrich you. Golden opportunities present themselves more frequently, businesses flourish under your hand, and gambles—both literal and metaphorical—have a way of paying off far beyond reason. Your prosperity no longer comes solely from effort but from the sheer impossibility of your existence: a being unshackled from fate, yet embraced by fortune’s hand.
addons.title: Destiny’s Spoils

addons.text:
To be rich is one thing—to be wealth itself is another. No longer are you merely favored by fortune; you are its very manifestation, a living embodiment of prosperity in its purest form. Where others seek riches, you define them. Where others struggle for wealth, you dictate its flow. You are not just fortunate—you are golden incarnate.

Golden Rule now starts at EX Rank, for there is no longer a distinction between you and the concept of wealth. Riches do not merely come to you—they orbit you, as if drawn by an immutable law of existence. Every venture flourishes, every opportunity turns to gold, and financial constraints simply cease to be a concern. Moreover, with Golden One, your command over wealth is no longer limited to acquisition alone; you create and shape riches at will, bending the world’s economies to your desire. Money is not something you earn—it is something you decree into being.

You are no longer just wealthy. You are wealth itself.
addons.title: Gilded One

addons.text:
To most, wealth is a means to an end. To you, it is the foundation of an empire. You are not merely successful in business—you define the economy itself, shaping industries and markets at will. Where others build companies, you build dynasties. Where others struggle to maintain wealth, you turn it into an unbreakable dominion. You are not just a tycoon—you are the undisputed ruler of commerce.

Golden Rule instantly rises in rank as your fortune compounds upon itself, rapidly climbing from its humble beginnings. Money no longer trickles toward you—it floods in, the natural consequence of your unerring instincts and boundless business acumen. Your ventures succeed at an impossible rate, growing from mere startups into world-spanning monopolies with terrifying speed. Markets bend to your will, trends shift at your command, and no competitor can stand in your way for long. Even the most rigid economic systems struggle to contain you, as you effortlessly exploit every loophole and avenue for profit with uncanny precision.

Yet true power is not built on wealth alone—it is built on people. The best and brightest flock to your banner, drawn by a force beyond mere financial incentive. Under your leadership, they become unstoppable, evolving into the greatest minds and most loyal forces in the world of business. Rivals who seek to challenge you find themselves outmatched not just by your fortune but by the sheer competence and devotion of those who serve you.

The world does not yet realize it, but you are not just playing the game of business—you are the one writing its rules.
addons.title: Monopoly Empire

objects.text:
You are destined for riches, manifesting as the skill Golden Rule, an undeniable mark of fortune woven into your very existence. Whether through wealth, beauty, physical perfection, or sheer charisma, prosperity follows you as though ordained by fate itself. The burdens of financial struggle, physical decay, or social rejection seldom touch you, for you embody the essence of abundance in all its forms.

However, Golden Rule does not create wealth from nothing. The skill begins at E Rank, meaning that while fortune favors your efforts, riches must still be pursued. Luck and circumstance will often conspire in your favor, but you must take action to claim what is rightfully yours. Unlike those who struggle to make ends meet, your work yields exponentially greater rewards, as if the world itself seeks to repay your ambition many times over.
