As your wealth and status grow, so too does this skill. The higher its rank, the more effortlessly prosperity comes to you, ensuring that each success paves the way for even greater fortune. Money, influence, and admiration accumulate like an avalanche, growing larger with every step forward. Whether through legitimate enterprise, beauty and charm, or cunning and force, the path to opulence is yours to walk—one where misfortune dares not tread, and where every effort is met with boundless reward.
objects.title: Golden Rule (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The King of Battles. The King of Culture. The King of Knights. All of them are facets of the true face, Artoria Pendragon. The Ideal King who led England to prosperity in the Medieval Era. 

Much like Lord Logres, you can forge an ideal self from combining the historical fact, faith and earnest wishes from the masses and the various what-if’s that come from speculation. Perhaps in another life you would have become a grand Arch-Mage, a brilliant politician or a skilled warmonger. These different identities seamlessly integrate into a whole, augmenting your mentality, skills and powers profoundly.

The What-ifs must be in the realm of possibility, including being founded on memories gained through this CYOA, so no declaring yourself an omnipotent deity without some very just cause.

This ideal self can then be subsumed into your body and soul until you’ve become the perfect representation of yourself.
objects.title: Lord Logres (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Much like Morgan Le Fay, your half-fae mother was impregnated by the British Isles itself to give rise to your birth. This supernatural conception has forced upon you three very distinct roles; The Witch of Camelot's Downfall, Morgaine Le Fay; The Human King, Morgan Pendragon and The Lady of the Lake, Vivian. Each of these acts like a different persona, a kind of split personality without the inherent drawbacks of such a mental disorder, save for the slight colouring of personality that each persona requires.

Morgaine Le Fay governs and magnifies your abilities that primarily harm, kill and are destructive whilst being adept at all kinds of vile acts such as assassination, blackmail, black magic and rebellion. Le Fay also has authority over the hereditary, primaeval curse of Britain.

Morgan Pendragon is the Human King that presides over your powers that neither harm, nor heal. Abilities like those that create or provide an intelligence boost are now amplified, in addition to being extremely competent in Statecraft, Kingship and diplomacy. She is also the most human of your personas, meaning the colouring of your mental state is lesser than when using the other personalities.

Vivian is the Fairy of the Lake and the one who controls your healing, nature, light and magical abilities whilst also enhancing them. She also is skilled in medicine, teaching and magic. As the Fae who gave Artoria Excalibur and Lancelot Arondight, Vivian has the ability to call upon the lake that she once resided in, not as a mere territory but a weapon creating factory for faery armaments.

The enhancement upon your abilities when in each persona is great enough that you could known as a heroic spirit from just those abilities. Whilst they will not in be the realm of the divine, they are firmly beyond what an ordinary mortal could accomplish. 

If there are abilities that are too broad in scope to be classified within these categories, then whichever persona you have equipped will amplify that part of the power. You may switch between personas at will.

Finally, esoteric phenomena that require true names will require all three of your True Names enacted upon you, due to your split nature.
objects.title: Child of the Land of Britain (Type-Moon)

objects.text: "The Medjai would never allow him to be released, for he would arise a walking disease, a plague upon mankind, an unholy flesh eater with the strength of ages, power over the sands, and the glory of invincibility." You have been cursed with the Hom-Dai, a punishment reserved for blasphemers. It is the worst of all ancient Egyptian curses. However, rejoice, for it seems this curse is more of a blessing. You have become immortal and invincible. The curse makes it so that you cannot die, and it was originally used to keep you alive as bugs ate you alive. However, now that you have escaped the sarcophagus they trapped you in, you no longer need to fear and gain the power of the curse for yourself. You have gained power over the Ten Plagues of Egypt and are now able to invoke them whenever you wish. You can also transform yourself into sand, as well as transform others into sand, transporting them across great distances. You also possess control over sand, water, and the wind, having immeasurable control over them. You can also move objects with your mind. You gain the ability to suck the life force from people adding it to your own and regenerate even faster than normal. You also have the power to control bugs, specifically the bugs that are meant to eat you from the inside out. The curse also gives you the strength to smash cars with little effort. So long as your soul is not destroyed, you can regenerate or be brought back into the world. You also have no need for food, water, or even the need to breathe to survive. Along with all this, you also gain a rudimentary ability to resurrect the dead as your undying servants.
objects.title: Mummy (The Mummy)

addons.text:
Your fleshy prison no longer limits you. As long as your Aura is manifested, you are able to use your full might as a Prime Soul.

When you awaken someone's Aura, your Prime Soul can optionally rub off on them a little, allowing them to imitate a small portion of your power as a Prime Soul. With time, their abilities will develop to be half as strong as a Prime Soul's.
addons.title: Prime Aura

addons.text:
You have been granted the title of "Prime Lifeform," granting a immense amount of bonuses and abilities. Your Prime Soul is malleable and can be controlled like your body, allowing you to give yourself wings, for example. Your physical body is also a fantastic conduit for your soul, allowing you to use your abilities related to it much more easily.

You possess even greater capabilities, like enough physical strength to flip things that weigh as much as a small country. You also have unmatched durability to withstand similar devastating blows. Your speed is such that it renders you invisible to the naked eye, making most people think you teleported. And that's just while you are alive.

Finally, the Red Stone of Aja has fused with your very soul, allowing you to transform other beings into an Ultimate Lifeform, granting them the abilities shown by Kars.

With Prime Aura, this essentially makes the soul and body perfectly intertwined, to the point where they are one and the same.
addons.title: Prime Lifeform

addons.text:
Your spiritual replacement limbs are your Prime Soul, meaning your Prime Soul manifests more as you are physically damaged.

Your fleshy prison can't die, kind of. For your body to die, your Prime Soul will need to be destroyed. This means that you can eventually obtain your original body over time, if you so desire. Naturally, though, the world will be shielded from your Prime Soul, meaning that you still can't fully use its full might if you have your body back.

You are also vastly harder to kill, as your soul naturally manifests into the world. This would mean that your opponents will have to damage your soul to even begin truly harming you.
addons.title: Prime Spirit

addons.text:
Your Prime Soul and disembodied consciousness have merged to become effectively one and the same, reinforcing each other. When one aspect is damaged or lessened, the other heals it. Your psychic aspect will rejuvenate your soul, for instance, and vice versa.

Typically, you'd need to continuously dedicate willpower to maintaining your existence. However, your independent mind removes this burden, acting as a lightning rod through which all your sheer will can fully materialise.

Consequently, your manifested physical form has become vastly more potent than before by an order of magnitude. You can even materialise this heightened form effortlessly, so long as your mind exists outside of a body and its constraints.
addons.title: Prime Psyche

addons.text:
When your Prime Soul is manifested, all objects imbued with Grand Enchant will be supercharged, as if you have spent an entire decade's worth of spiritual power individually infusing every single object. That is to say, each individual object affected by Grand Enchant will get supercharged as though you spent an entire decade imbuing that specific object and nothing else. 

In the event that you return to your flesh prison, a very small, almost minuscule portion of that supercharged effect will be retained on your enchanted objects as a permanent infusion.
addons.title: Prime Enchant

objects.text:
"MANKIND IS A FAILURE, FREE WILL IS A FLAW."

Death is inevitable, even for you. But when it comes, you won't go to Heaven or Hell. No, you resist the pull to the afterlife. Instead, your soul will leave your fleshy prison as a bright light. With pure willpower, it will then form a body befitting you, accompanied by a shockwave to announce your arrival.

Even while you are still trapped in your fleshy prison, you will still be much more powerful as your willpower fuels your growth. You will be more powerful, more skilled, and more focused. You will even be more forceful as a byproduct of having so much willpower.

When your Prime Soul leaves your body and manifests a form to represent who you are, you will be much more powerful. As a baseline, you will be able to create shockwaves and move with short bursts of speed that people would mistake for teleportation. But that is just assuming you were an ordinary man.

The stronger you were while living, the greater your strength and powers in death.

Having the strength to go toe-to-toe with Alexandria could see you beating Leviathan with only moderate difficulty. If you could lift a house with telekinetic abilities, you could lift a skyscraper with little difficulty.

Defy God, Prime Soul, and show your mettle to the world!
objects.title: Prime Soul (ULTRAKILL)

objects.text:
"May your L's be many, and your bitches few." - Gabriel, Judge of Hell.

Somehow you have the Light of the Father. Perhaps he created you or gifted it to you. It does not matter, only that you have it now, for you are a Supreme Angel, comparable to that of Gabriel.

For as long as you have the Light, you are ageless, have strength greater than that of giants, virtually endless stamina, durability to take blows from a Prime Soul, speed to evade explosions, and teleportation. You are also able to enhance your other abilities with the Light, but there is only so much to go around, so distribute it wisely.
objects.title: The Father's Light (ULTRAKILL)

addons.text: The maddening corruption you spread has been suffused with your Darkness, and has in turn suffused it: Wherever your corruption spreads, it carries the Dark along with it, seeping into the world alongside itself - and that same Dark now also acts as a conduit for your corruption, creating an almost self-sustaining effect. At lower levels, this means that the rate of your corruption’s decay when not in your domain is slowed massively, and at greater levels your twin corrupting influences create a feedback loop that at least keeps them from dissipating naturally, if not even causing them to spread without the need for your presence.
addons.title: Realm of Darkness

addons.text: Your nature as the Primordial Man has now further reinforced the bond to your Heartless nature just as much as it has the Dark Soul: While Keyblades and holy powers can temporarily purge the Darkness from you, this too is now just a stopgap, for such an unbreakable connection to the Dark means that you can never truly be deprived of it any more; only strong soul-manipulation or the destruction of your Heart can fully strip that from you now. Furthermore, your Heartless nature’s Darkness is now suffused with the defense-bypassing abilities of Dark Hexes, and, should you also have the Lord Of The Abyss addon, then the Abyss you form will also act like a miniature Realm of Darkness, becoming a safe haven for you and other Heartless.
addons.title: Eternal Shadows

addons.text:
Your Darkness has undergone a curious shift; now, not only is it spawned, fueled, and strengthened by negative emotions and evil, but now also by willpower and resolve of all kinds. Those of great determination in your vicinity, regardless of morality or emotional inclination, will now begin forming Darkness in their own hearts, just as much as the wrathful and the villainous, and this same connection now also allows you to detect such strong wills with your sixth sense as well.

Additionally, this connection between Darkness and willpower now goes both ways, allowing you to use your Determination to not only amplify your power and growth speed, but also to use your Darkness as a substitute for strong will, not only for the purpose of SAVEing, LOADing and RESETing, but also for refusing to die and prolonging your own life.
addons.title: Dark Will

addons.text: Your Heartless nature and its powers over Darkness have unlocked a new, secondary transformation in your Old One form: By infusing the Dark into your alternate form, you can further change it from an arboreal titan into a colossal, organic battleship - the World of Chaos. In this state, not only do you possess your Heartless powers, now boosted in strength and range from your status, but you also retain all of your Old One powers as well, now infused with new Dark might; your Deep Fog is dyed a rich black-purple, now carrying your Darkness’ corruption alongside its usual madness, and, more importantly, the demons you spawn can now carry the powers of Heartless in addition to their normal abilities if you wish it, and both they and regular Heartless can be spawned from any sufficient quantities of Darkness as well as the Fog.
addons.title: Guardando Nel Buio

addons.text: The formation of an Umbral Core within you has further strengthened both your Heartless nature and its Darkness, reinforcing them with the paracausal and physics-defying traits of your Core’s own essence. The first and most prominent effect is that you now defy simulations and predictions much like your powers, in addition to passively violating entropy at a low level just by existing, and being capable of infusing the powers of Stasis and Strand directly into your new body. Furthermore, not only can these new properties be extended to any other Heartless you create or are made in your vicinity in the future, but they can even be added to other ‘dark’ powers you wield or come across, allowing you to spread your paracausal influence far and wide.
addons.title: Umbral Heart

objects.text:
It seems that at some time in your past your Heart was taken and consumed by darkness, transforming you into a Heartless - unlike most others, however, you’ve not only retained your original form, but also your intelligence and memories as well. While you only begin as strong as cannon-fodder Heartless like Shadows or Soldiers, you have plenty of room to grow stronger, and your other abilities as a being of darkness help compensate for your initial weakness.

To start, as a Heartless, your form has become, ironically enough, a Heart - what most other settings would call a soul - manifested into physical form of condensed darkness, granting you a high resistance to mundane weaponry, a nigh-immunity to dark-based powers, and, most importantly, a form of resurrective immortality: While magic and strong conventional attacks can damage or destroy you, this is only a temporary measure, as you will simply reform elsewhere given enough time, with only Keyblades and sufficiently strong ‘holy’ powers (such as purifying, unlocking/releasing, soul-manipulating, or extremely strong light-aligned magics) being able to put you down for good.

In addition, you also possess some other tricks beside that: A sort of sixth sense for the ‘darkness’ - in the sense of evil and negative emotions - within peoples’ Hearts, strong enough that true ‘villains’ and other vile sorts can be felt from entire worlds or dimensions away, though pinpointing will take experience; The ability to open ‘Corridors of Darkness’, shadowy portals that can lead you across worlds and other great distances without the need for something like a Gummi Ship - albeit inaccurately, and incapable of breaching into sufficiently ‘Light’ or ‘holy’ areas without great strength; And, lastly, the ability to steal the Hearts of others who are on the verge of either death or falling to Darkness, quite literally forcing it out of their bodies - and from there, consuming it and either slowly incorporating its strength into yours, or fully corrupting and shaping it into a new Heartless like yourself.

While there are more abilities to be discovered - like harnessing Tier Magic, or commanding Heartless of lesser power - those are less immediately available, requiring you to deepen both your skill and power before you can access them. You can also optionally decide to forsake your original form and take on an appearance similar to most other heartless.

(Note: If you are sufficiently strong-willed when taking this power, or otherwise falling to Darkness in the future, then your Nobody will also form alongside you somewhere in the world.)
objects.title: Heartless (Kingdom Hearts)

objects.text:
Risen from the Glass Ocean and receiving world class assassin skills from before your time in Hell, you’ve become a Neon. Neons are masked, stark white beings that are given color coordinated code names, and forced by the ‘Believers’ to eradicate the Demons infesting Heaven. As a regular Neon, you have a particular relic or memento from before your death that acts as your base Soul Weapon, alongside your physique being enhanced to slightly supernatural levels. 

On top of your personal Soul Weapon, you can obtain varying Soul Cards that spawn around you while in combat which have dual abilities. The main ability being a random Spiritual Weapon (usually a ranged weapon) with limited ammunition, and the second ability (which when used, destroys the card) being an esoteric effect like a controlled supersonic dash, leaping high into the air, shooting a concentrated explosive which while harming enemies- only boosts your momentum in a particular direction, and more. 

Your Neon color and mask are usually representative of certain personality traits you had while alive, but you may optionally choose to select the color and form they come in. Your Neon mask may be removed at your leisure, and unlike in the game, it is not rigged to explode.
objects.title: Neon (Neon White)

addons.text:
Through exposure to Imaginary Energy your Magic Circuits have metamorphosed into a new form, becoming Imaginary Circuits.

Imaginary Circuits can directly channel Imaginary Energy, allowing you to use what is essentially a bastardized form of Magecraft which runs on Imaginary Energy instead of magical energy and Mystery. With this you can freely shape Imaginary Energy into any manifestation instead of simply relying on your innate manifestation as a Pathstrider. 

For the purposes of this ‘Imaginary Magecraft’ Paths and Elements are more akin to affinities than proper restrictions. While you can theoretically achieve any result with Imaginary Energy, manifestations aligning with concepts related to your Path and Elements are easier and more efficient and intuitive to accomplish.

Don’t think this makes you all powerful though, as you are still limited by how much Imaginary Energy your circuits can channel and by needing to figure out how to accomplish a desired feat. Lastly, you gain an incredibly strong affinity for the Imaginary Element, both the Star Rail version and the Imaginary Numbers of Fate.
addons.title: Imaginary Circuits

addons.text:
As a memetic entity - a living mass of memories and information - you possess great affinity for the Path of Remembrance. You have transformed from a simple memetic entity into a Memokeeper, gaining the Path of Remembrance in addition to whatever initial Path you resonated with, although if you already resonated with Remembrance then your potential will surpass even Black Swan.

As a Memokeeper you are more resilient than normal memetic entities, able to shrug off outside manipulations unless they come from a being much stronger than you. You also gain a talent in manipulating Memoria, a substance which serves as a vessel for memory and consciousness, which can form memetic entities and objects and can even spawn entire dream realms in large enough quantities.
addons.title: Memokeeper

addons.text: While in many worlds golden blood is representative of the divine in general, in the realms of the Imaginary Tree it is a sign of one particular god, Nanook the Destruction. The golden blood flowing through your veins has become symbolically connected to Nanook, drawing traces of Destruction-laced Imaginary Energy from Path Space and into your body. This greatly increases your affinity for Destruction, being uniquely suited to draw strength from that Path and even passively drawing some strength from it without actively treading the Path. However, for all this strength and increased connection, you are not a true Emanator, coming close but not quite meeting the requirements. However, should you purchase Emanator you would become analogous to the Pure Children of Anāsrava, a divided fragment of Nanook’s essence with all the power that entails.
addons.title: Child of Destruction

addons.text:
Among the countless performers who play at absurdity, a rare few embody it so completely that even the cosmos laughs with them. You are one such individual—a Masked Fool, a favored performer upon the stage of the Path of Elation.

As a Jester, you possess a natural resonance with the philosophy of Elation: the celebration of chaos, irony, mischief, and unexpected joy. Your mindset aligns instinctively with this Path, granting you exceptional compatibility with it. Your potential along this Path rivals that of Sparkle.

Your Jester magic becomes intertwined with your Pathstrider abilities. Techniques once fueled purely by humor or spectacle now channel Imaginary Energy, manifesting as Elation-aligned abilities you instinctively understand how to perform. Tricks, illusions, taunts, and performances can distort perception, twist probability, and weaponize amusement itself. With time, practice, and an increased philosophical grasp of Elation grows, these techniques can evolve—becoming stronger, stranger, and increasingly reality-defying.

Finally, alongside your Clown costume you receive a true Mask of the Masked Fools, a mystical mask said to be granted by the Aeon Aha. The mask acts as both focus and symbol, helping you draw upon the Path of Elation more easily and amplifying the theatrical nature of your powers. When worn during a performance, prank, or battle, it allows your laughter, mockery, and spectacle to resonate more strongly with the Path—turning every act of absurdity into a potential miracle.
addons.title: Masked Fool

addons.text:
Your intellect was already monstrous—an endlessly self-refining engine of discovery that devours knowledge and turns failure into revelation. And when such a mind encountered the Path of Erudition, the result was inevitable. You resonate deeply with the principles of knowledge, reason, and discovery, gaining extraordinary compatibility with Nous and THEIR power.

Your mental capabilities rise to a level comparable to the legendary geniuses acknowledged by the universe itself. Your raw intellectual power, analytical speed, and theoretical insight stand on par with the Peerless Gem of the Genius Society, Herta. Combined with the recursive growth of your Kihara intellect and Researcher’s Madness, your mind becomes a self-accelerating engine of progress—every discovery making the next come faster, deeper, and more profound.

Given sufficient time, research, and experimentation, your intellect alone can achieve feats that appear miraculous. You may conquer aging, manipulate space and time through advanced theory, construct autonomous puppet bodies equal to yourself, or engineer technologies that blur the line between science and the supernatural.

Should you ever reach the greater cosmos connected to the Imaginary Tree, your brilliance will surely not go unnoticed. The Aeon of Erudition recognizes minds capable of advancing universal knowledge, and your existence may draw the attention of a certain Inimitable Beauty—seeking to cultivate you as a true intellectual equal within the ranks of the Genius Society.
addons.title: Genius Society #85

addons.text:
By seizing a fragment of the essence of a God of Flesh, your body has already surpassed mortality. Yet this metamorphosis resonates strongly with a certain cosmic philosophy—the Path of Abundance, whose doctrine centers on the endless continuation and flourishing of life. Your existence aligns naturally with this Path, granting you an exceptional affinity for its power and the blessings of Yaoshi.

You gain the typical regenerative and life-enhancing blessings associated with the Denizens of Abundance. Normally these gifts lead to rampant mutation, uncontrolled growth, and eventual loss of identity. However, your compatibility with Abundance and absolute metaphysical authority over your own body allows you to suppress, refine, or completely negate these drawbacks. Your flesh remains wholly yours, even as it grows stronger under Abundance’s influence.

Your existing regeneration becomes dramatically enhanced. Healing occurs faster, requires far less stamina or energy, and can more easily restore catastrophic damage. Even resurrection through your Archon ability becomes more efficient, with surviving fragments rebuilding the whole more quickly than before.

Finally, possessing the essence of a God of Flesh makes you naturally adept at channeling Imaginary Energy to influence living matter. You can intuitively manipulate biological structures—accelerating healing, reshaping flesh, encouraging growth, or unraveling hostile lifeforms. With time and understanding of the Path of Abundance, this control can expand from simple regeneration into sophisticated biological manipulation affecting both your own body and that of others.
addons.title: Denizen of Abundance

addons.text: As a follower of Mythus, you have learned to channel the power of Enigmata through your words and illusions. Lies spoken through Lie Eater no longer remain simple illusions, they are reinforced by Memoria, allowing them to partially manifest as temporary reality. Objects, sensations, beings, and even events created through your lies can briefly exist in the world as if they were real, blurring the line between Fiction and Truth. With this, your deceptions become living possibilities rather than mere tricks, spreading confusion, rewriting perception, and turning misinformation into momentary reality. If Emanator has been taken, your distortions are no longer confined to being temporary, allowing Fiction, Lies, and fabricated history to permanently reshape reality itself. Now… “Go, Spread Misinformation”
addons.title: History Fictionologist
Gourmet Devourer
addons.text:
Your Gourmet Cells and Appetite Energy resonate perfectly with the Path of Voracity, transforming your hunger into a direct expression of the Path. Where others may merely consume, you possess the potential to understand, savor, and make use of everything you devour. Your connection is unusually complete, for the savoriness inherent to Appetite Energy preserves the concept of Aftertaste that Aha stole from the Path, leaving you exempt from the flaw that turned many of Voracity's creations into indiscriminate biological black holes.

Your consumption is no longer merely nourishment. Anything you meaningfully consume can become a source of strength, with the qualities of what you eat being incorporated into your body and Gourmet Cells. Unique creatures, exotic materials, supernatural energies, and other extraordinary substances can grant you new traits, abilities, and adaptations based upon their nature.

The more you consume—and the more remarkable the things you consume—the deeper your connection to Voracity becomes. Your Gourmet Cells incorporate Imaginary Energy into themselves and evolve alongside your Pathstrider abilities, allowing you to continually improve your physical capabilities, senses, regeneration, and biological adaptations. The strength of what you consume becomes your own.

Your Appetite Energy also provides an inexhaustible foundation for this growth. Imaginary Energy drawn from the Path can supplement the tremendous energy requirements of your Gourmet Cells, allowing your body to process increasingly absurd quantities of nourishment without being limited by conventional biological needs.

objects.text:
You have become a Pathstrider, someone whose personal beliefs and ideas have resonated with a confluence of imaginary energy representing a universal philosophical concept called a path. Drawing power from this connection, you can perform supernatural feats.

When resonating with a path, you gain one of seven types of elemental power based on your personality and the characteristic specialization of that path's philosophy.

For example: The core philosophy of the path of Abundance is the practice of selfless altruism to nurture and ensure the perpetual existence of life, free from the pain of death and illness. Those who follow this path have the power to heal others. 

On the other hand, the core philosophy of the Path of Destruction believes that the birth of the universe was a mistake, and civilization itself is a cancer that needs to be destroyed. Followers of this path tend to be reckless and anger driven often engaging in destructive behavior toward themself and their enemy with their great might.

How the power you gain from the path manifests is personal and unique to you. Even those who have the same element and path can have completely different ways to utilize their power, though the same specialization of the path still applies. Regardless of which path you resonate with all Pathstriders gain a great boost to their physical capability and resistance to environmental hazards.

The potency of the power you can draw from the path depends on your understanding of the path's philosophical concept. The deeper you explore and understand the philosophical concept of a path, the more power you can draw from it.

You can gain additional paths and elemental types by exploring the philosophical concepts each path represents and incorporating them into your ideas and worldview.
objects.title: Pathstrider (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
You are a Heliobus, a spirit made of energy. Heliobi as a race are all immortal, invulnerable and capable of manipulating energy and matter to an incredibly varied extent. Heliobi have been noted to shapeshift, freeze things, set things on fire, and create illusions. Heliobi also posses the ability to posses people and objects, being capable of accessing their host’s memories and control their nervous and imitate the host perfectly. As Heliobi grow in power/combine with more Heliobi (you will not be able to find other Heliobi), they naturally become more and more able to see the future.

As a Heliobus, you stand around the strength of giants like Ignamar, capable of shattering mountains, tearing apart cities, and slaying entire armies on your lonesome. 

However you do have some weaknesses, you are easily trapped in things that contain energy, and you are naturally an empathetic emotivore, meaning the emotions of your host, should they have emotions will taint you to some degree.
objects.title: Heliobus (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
You are the reincarnation of a Catalyst Comet, which is the incarnation of pure good meaning you are subsequently as well. And after death claims you, you can choose to reincarnate, or delay it for as long as you want. You also have a slight inclination to do good.

Due to your previous reincarnations, you have subconscious skills you can use. You have no memories of them and will have to use guesswork on what skills you have. Due to to the fact you are a comet, you also have a powerful soul, enough so to resist a primordial being sucking you for your soul.

When someone is having a bad day, feeling down, or just having a terrible life, you're able to intervene to subtly change their fate, so things are just a little better, and light a little brighter.

The more good you have done, the more powerful you become. The gains are minor, but it does add up. Your previous lives do count. Fate also has a tendency to make your right arm not attached in every reincarnation, but when you do, you will find yourself more aligned with your predecessors, and draw strength from them. For example, if you could see 10 seconds into the future, you could perhaps see 2-5 extra seconds into the future for each reincarnation you were in the past.
objects.title: Agent of Change (Adventure Time)

addons.text: The chilly opposite of the Correspondence, the Discordance, governing things closer to nonexistence, should not be discredited, though given its danger, it should perhaps be forgotten. It is far more unpredictable, and far more dangerous; In truth, it does not actually exist, in much the same way freezing temperatures are not heat, but the absence thereof. The laws it brings forth freeze the air and permanently change the temperment of souls that are touched by its nonexistence, dropping their temperature considerably. The only way to erase the effects of these laws is to completely erase it from those exposed's memory. The nuances of this language, the various exotic principles dictating it, are yours to exploit and work with, for how much they can 'be' anything.
addons.title: Discordant

objects.text: Lucky you! You've been granted a premier course in the Correspondence, the language of the Judgements, the stars and gods hanging over our heads, the words able to reshape the world rather than reflect it, compose and create thoughts of its own accord rather than merely ordering them. You can speak it in a variety of ways - Verbally, through dance, in sigils, even a rousing game of cricket, the possibilities are endless, really. The words convey concepts in a way that can push the bounds of reality itself, some of the most powerful uses able to manipulate time, space, and causality, albeit requiring great effort and preparation for one such as yourself to do correctly. Its ability to spontaneously generate heat should not be ignored either, the fiery speech able to brand the unwary, which can cause a great deal of unpleasant effects, death and combustion of the soul being some of the gentler ways to go. They can mean several things, as well, allowing for a variety of effects - though inscribing seven sigils on the same surface does tend to make them burst into flame and destroy the surface they're on, and location can change their meaning, as well.
objects.title: Correspondence Course (Fallen London)

objects.text: ”Legend Tells of an Ancient Artifact That can Grant a Woman’s Wish…" THE SKULL HEART You have found and made a wish to a talking and totally trustworthy skull-shaped heart. In reality, this was in fact, not a trustworthy being at all, not at first, anyways. You have been chosen as the newest Skullgirl, an entity of immense power and capable of vast amounts of destruction. Originally, like other Skullgirls before you, your fate was to become the avatar/servant to The Trinity, a trio of Goddesses who sought to destroy the world, but now the sentient and aptly named Skull Heart has deviated from its given purpose and found you to be the ideal host for its power, along with finding your wish to be “pure”. You gain a pair of Red Eyes and Silver Hair as a result of becoming the Skullgirl. As the Skullgirl, you gain control over the dead, both recent and ancient. If you choose to, the undead may have the personalities they had in life, giving you people to converse with and fonts of wisdom and knowledge to bounce ideas off of. This does not only give you a massive reservoir to pull upon if you ever need an army, but also as your arsenal. Throwing skulls, creating surprisingly effective weapons out of bones, using a bunch of ghouls to make constructs such as giant hands, and an assortment of other tricks and feats you can figuratively pull out of your now literally exposed back, which the Skull Heart will now reside in. This is not a weakness, and more along the cosmetic side of things. If you want something different, such as skeletal arms or have a giant floating rib cage in place of legs, you may. This also comes with a "Halo" of bones floating behind you, showing your status as a Skullgirl, and alluding to the Heart's Divine origins. Optionally, as you further immerse yourself in the Skull Heart’s power, some of your flesh will begin to decay and wither. This does not hurt, nor is it ever to the point of becoming a ghoul or skeleton, but enough to show some of your ribs and a full set of teeth. This decay is also cosmetic. If you don't want it, the Skull Heart will abide by your needs. Embracing its power also gives you an overall boost to your own power, and it only gets better with time. For example, you are capable of withstanding heavy damage without truly dying, such as still being able to fight, even when all that is left of you is a skeleton. Another example is using your undead forces to hold up a modern-day skyscraper with some effort and throw it across a city with fairly good accuracy. Being the Skullgirl (as the name would imply), the Skull Heart could only be used by females originally, but if you are a man or otherwise appear to not be a woman, the Skull heart is willing to bend the rules a little just for you. Whether this means your appearance changes when you call upon its power to something more feminine, or becoming the first Skullboy, is up to you and the Skull Heart to negotiate. Regardless, the Skull Heart will not abandon you nor hurt you intentionally, even if you both somehow happened upon a better host for it.
objects.title: The Skullgirl (Skullgirls)

objects.text:
You have been afflicted with Kazan Syndrome, a supernatural ailment originating from the ghost demon Kazan.

Those unfortunate enough to fall under this curse will notice their eyes becoming bloodshot, and one of their arms gradually transforming into a demonic limb, its skin turning red and its nails growing into razor-sharp talons.

The curse drastically enhances the victim’s strength and physical abilities, enabling them to fight dozens, or even hundreds, of opponents single-handedly. It also grants the power to project demonic energy from the cursed arm for ranged attacks.

However, this power comes at a terrible cost: the curse slowly drains the victim’s life force and drives them toward insanity, amplifying their negative emotions. Over time, this descent can trigger uncontrollable fits of murderous rage, ultimately reducing the afflicted to a mindless, rabid creature that kills indiscriminately.

Though no known cure exists, not all hope is lost. Strong willpower and the use of magical artifacts can suppress the curse’s influence to some degree.

To help mitigate its effects, you have been given a magical bracelet known as the Demon Shackle, which must be fastened to your cursed arm. While the shackle can ease certain symptoms and slow the curse’s progression, it cannot fully stop it.

Be warned: frequent, intense emotional distress or overuse of the curse’s power may trigger violent frenzies that accelerate your mental decline, making it increasingly difficult to retain your sanity.
objects.title: Kazan Syndrome (Dungeon Fighter Online)

objects.text:
Normally, a gift granted by an Archangel, you have been blessed with a grand ability, a small portion of what makes an Archangel so powerful. This is the ability to take a small portion of your soul and ignite it, turning it into the eponymous silver flames of Soulfire. It's effectively a form of mystical rebar that ties any magic or power it's infused with more deeply to the user's intent; it greatly enhances all abilities but shines most strongly when used towards creation. As an example, a simple force spell infused with Soulfire becomes another hand, as dexterous and capable as one you were born with for the duration of the spell, or an illusion becomes realistic to a degree you'd never managed without the support. Rather than increasing the 'power' involved, it can be viewed as an incredible boost to control, reducing the normal waste of a given power to truly absurd extents.

Unfortunately, such a power is not without a cost, as each usage, big or small, costs a slice of your very soul, leaving it ever more diminished, up to and including death, unless given time to recover somehow. Alongside this spiritual damage comes a degree of physical exhaustion, enough that even without burning away your soul in full, overuse could leave you passed out. The soul naturally recovers through acts that could be considered "Good for the Soul", such as simply living and enjoying life, but alternatives may be possible.
objects.title: Soulfire (Dresden Files)

objects.text:
Something normally obtained through being host to a Fallen Angel, you have obtained the ability to use Hellfire on your lonesome. Where Soulfire enhances the intent of any power it is imbued into, Hellfire enhances the means. A fireball becomes that much more potent, a wave of force becomes that much larger- Hellfire is a hammer, taking any use of a chosen power and increasing the strength involved. Unlike Soulfire, which works best when used to create, Hellfire is undeniably superior when it comes to destroying, taking any power used for destruction a step beyond what it could do for creative endeavors.

Just like its counterpart, to use Hellfire requires a matching cost, one taken from your soul each time you use it. A small portion is broken off and transformed into Hellfire, leaving your soul otherwise unharmed if lesser than it was moments before. Combined with the spiritual cost, channeling Hellfire is quite physically taxing, quickly straining the body and draining the stamina of the user the more it's used. Thankfully, the soul can recover so long as it's not used up entirely; simple time can restore it, helped along by doing things that are "Good for the Soul", such as enjoying life and being happy.

Unfortunately, such a power is not without a cost, as each usage, big or small, costs a slice of your very soul, leaving it ever more diminished, up to and including death, unless given time to recover somehow. Alongside this spiritual damage comes a degree of physical exhaustion, enough that even without burning away your soul in full, overuse could leave you passed out. The soul naturally recovers through acts that could be considered "Good for the Soul", such as simply living and enjoying life, but alternatives may be possible.
objects.title: Hellfire (Dresden Files)

addons.text: Your ability to use the stains on the souls of your enemies, combined with your Soulgaze now allows you to have your victims experience something else. Their own soul. This gives the kind of self knowledge that takes most years to develop, in the span of mere seconds. This comes with the side effects of a normal soulgaze, namely that the person cannot be subject to this effect in the future, and they can never forget it.
addons.title: Mirror Eyes

objects.text: It is said that the eyes are the windows to the soul, and for you, that is now more true than ever. Whenever you make prolonged eye contact with any being with a soul, you both perceive the other’s true, innermost selves. This gives both of you a deep understanding of the other person’s nature. Those experienced in these matters can use a soulgaze to detect any psychic tampering or injury. Be warned however that while everything that you see is true, you don’t necessarily get to see everything about a person. Furthermore Soulgazes are often shrouded in metaphors and symbolism. While one person might see someone’s soul as a building, someone else looking at the same soul might hear it as a complex musical piece. Once you look upon someone’s soul, you can never forget it. The memory can never fade or be taken away from you. The experience will always be as fresh and raw in your mind as when it first happened. Those who recklessly use this ability can often be driven mad. Lastly, you may only ever look upon a given soul once, barring extreme changes to personality and outlook.
objects.title: Soul-Gaze (Dresden Files)

objects.text:
Whether it is a blessing from the heavens, a contract you have made, or simply a distortion of reality... But now you can summon creatures that resemble Eastern dragons to fight on your side and obey your commands.

Each dragon is extremely resilient, strong, agile, and protected by tough skin, as well as capable of flight. Their skin can withstand even large-caliber weapons and completely ignore small arms fire. Their strength allows them to crush and throw heavy trucks. Their agility and maneuverability make them very difficult targets both at a distance and in close combat.

Dragons attack with sharp fangs and claws capable of tearing through steel and armor, as well as with magical fire attacks. They can also summon a huge magical blade 1.5-2 times the height of a human, which they can wield deftly by clamping it between their teeth.

When summoned back to life before their death, dragons are capable of unleashing a powerful area-of-effect magical attack on their enemies as a parting gift and healing their fellow dragons and allies. In addition, they will replenish the energy spent on their summoning and can soon be summoned again.

You have access to energy for 5 summons, but you can only maintain 3 of them at a time (4 with time and practice). However, you can strengthen up to 2 summoned dragons by infusing them with a double charge of energy. This will double their survivability, strength, and speed, and all their attacks will be further enhanced by magic.

These dragons understand you perfectly, and you understand them perfectly. Although they are unable to speak, they possess a sufficiently perceptive and sophisticated mind.

You can either summon them instantly as needed or keep them permanently summoned by your side.

If they are killed, they will not die permanently, but will return to where they came from; you will not be able to replenish the energy to summon them. It will be replenished within 24 hours, and you will be able to summon the dragon again.
objects.title: Ling's Summons (Arknights)

objects.text:
Once, above Yan, did a great dragon raise it's head above the clouds. The mightiest of all feranmut, Sui desired to rule Yan, and used his might to slay the other feranmut at the behest of Yan in order to gain control. But Sui was shattered by Yan after his victory, reduced to twelve scattered proxies that formed from the slain Sui. And you bear the might of one of those twelve proxies, bearing a divine skill that once belonged to Sui. 

For instance, if your skill was in blacksmithing, you would be a divine smith capable of forging relics that would easily outclass all made by mortal hands. A skill in painting could find you able to make worlds within paintings using normal ink, or repainting reality itself for a time. In addition, you are simply much stronger than a mortal would be, even stronger than any of Terra's races normally would be excluding the Abyssal Hunters or the might of a Wendigo. Your endurance is similarly mighty, and even if your divine might is focused into one area you do still bear divinity that can be used for other tasks. Though you may never age, do not forget that you are far from unkillable. Mortal arms may not be your bane, but you are, ultimately, a weak divinity. A fragment of a beast so grand that it's remnant malice alone could poison the land for generations. This perk does ensure that if the beast were to wake, you would not be removed from history as well like the other fragments.

If they do not exist in the world at the time of your arrival, you may choose whether or not there are eleven other fragments of Sui that are active in whichever world you drop in at your arrival. If they already exist in the world at your arrival, you may choose whether or not you have merely started existing and are a new thirteenth fragment, that you have replaced one of them, or you are a thirteenth fragment that has already existed.
objects.title: Fragment of Sui (Arknights)

addons.title: Variant Black Chest: Fell Star of Genesis
addons.text: You have become a unique variant of a Black Chest for Sothis, or at least the hypothetical version of Sothis had she existed in the world of Type-Moon: a primordial, Planetary-class Goddess from another Celestial Body. Unlike an ordinary Black Chest however, the pieces of Sothis within you are not slowly deteriorating, in fact they’re healing, gradually restoring the lost Divinity and Authority of the goddess within you until she eventually returns to her full strength. If you chose to have Sothis as a separate presence, she will gradually gain the benefits of Divine Spirit (Type-Moon) and, should she eventually acquire a physical body of flesh and blood, Incarnated God (Type-Moon) as well. If you instead fuse with Sothis, or chose not to have her present at all, these benefits become yours instead. Sothis’s nature as a Type-Moon deity also transforms the Crest Stone of Flames made from her heart; as your heart has been replaced with the heart of a Goddess you now possess a pseudo-Divine Core, a Magical Energy Reactor which produces True Ether and grants you the ability to use it safely, greatly enhancing your physical and magical capabilities to levels matching rivaling a Servant. As Sothis’ Divinity continues to return this pseudo-Divine Core can evolve into a proper Divine Core, increasing the amount and quality of True Ether it produces.

objects.text:
Your heart has been replaced with the Crest Stone of Flames, the Heart of a Goddess known as Sothis, The Beginning, The Progenitor, and to some, the Fell Star. This makes you her vessel, but you needn’t worry about her taking over your body, she’d only do that in emergencies. The Crest Stone does not hurt you in any way, beyond providing you with a pulse, but no heartbeat. The Goddess slumbers within you, but recent events have woke her up. Lucky you! Optionally, you may choose to remove Sothis, only keeping the benefits of this power, or to have her around like normal.

When you fall unconscious or sleep, you can go to a small realm that houses Sothis. There (if she’s not sleeping away on her throne, mind you), you may talk with one another in person, or alternatively, you may also communicate with one another telepathically in the waking world. Sothis can additionally create a projection of herself that only you can see. This projection cannot physically interact with anything, beyond floating around or walking on the floor. She can use her five senses, if it doesn’t interfere with the prior statement.

Furthermore, your physical capabilities are enhanced to a not insignificant amount beyond what is considered as ‘peak human’, and you receive years of experience both in combat and teaching others in regards to combat, as well as years of experience in leadership, from classes and teams, to armies and nations. The Crest Stone of Flames also gives you access to the veritable Crest of Flames. You can utilize this during combat to regenerate your body, healing around 1/3rd of all damage you deal via physical attacks, magic, or other combat arts. Additionally, around 1 in every 4 attacks will have increased potency and be less susceptible to counterattack. The true limits of the crest are unknown, with it theoretically being able to save you from anything short of death.

After some time acclimating with one another, you and Sothis will be able to use the Divine Pulse, a power that lets you rewind time a few moments back. This can be used to make different decisions that can save people’s lives, or to save your own. It can only be used 2 times a day at first, though eventually you will be able to raise this limit by using it, going up to 14 times in a single day.

Sothis, being a Goddess that only has her Crest Stone to connect with you, is initially weakened. Over the course of 2 years, she will gain her divinity back, and in turn, her power and authority. This allows you to achieve a variety of powerful effects such as stopping time during combat. Optionally, once that process has finished, you may choose to fuse with one another, becoming one being with the benefits of both. This does not change who you are on a fundamental level. If you chose not to have Sothis around, this will function the same, essentially. Her power, divinity, and authority are yours, with none of her personality or memories to draw from.
objects.title: The Ashen Demon (Fire Emblem)

addons.text: Your purpose is even more important than you might have once known, for even death will not stop the Child of Hades from changing the balance of the world. You will find your boons far stronger, on par with what a demigod of another deity may have as their primary ability at weakest, and rivalling non-combat-focused gods at strongest. Indeed, such is the case for all divine abilities you hold - and should they be lost to you, you will at least find embers of what you were once granted, which can be built upon time and again. Minor prophecies and simple luck can even bring you great wealth or mysterious cthonic substances with which you can improve yourself or your surroundings further.
addons.title: Count Your Blessings

addons.text:
Your Olympian family has bestowed upon you a portion of their divine domains, granting you permanent boons from each of them. These blessings have become an inseparable part of your divine essence, endowing you with abilities such as electrokinesis, hydrokinesis, the power to summon Blade Rifts, Hades’ invisibility, and more.

In addition, you’ve undergone rigorous training in both combat and magic, elevating your skills to rival those of Zagreus and Melinoe at the end of their journeys. As a result of your training, you possess the ability to generate an unlimited supply of Bloodstones.

Lastly, you wield a complete arsenal of all the Infernal Arms and Nocturnal Arms, fully upgraded with every aspect unlocked. You can freely and instantly switch between upgrades and aspects to suit your needs.
addons.title: The Gift of Family

objects.text: A new member of the Lord of the Dead's progeny walks the House of Hades. A new god has entered the Greek pantheon, another child of Hades and Persephone. There was Zagreus, Melinoë, and now you. And much like the other two, you'll find yourself armed with a fortune that might leave you believing the Fates themselves are on your side. For one, you have training from heroes and gods alike, enabling you to fight on a level with weapons and magic that the vast majority of mortals simply could not compare with without some level of divine intervention or similar. Whether you prefer the certainty in a well-crafted weapon or the power of a well-cast spell is up to your preference, but regardless, you have great potential in both physical and magical arts. Another facet that seems common amongst the children of Hades are how the gods, and really, most beings, treat them. Your natural charisma for powerful or divine beings is second to none, your very presence helping set all others at ease in most cases. That isn't to say you cannot anger them, as Hades himself can attest, but in many cases, these beings will act far kinder with you regardless and their wrath will fade in what, for them, would normally be record time. One could say you bring the best out of them, even. Your frequent chats with them certainly will help - Even in a world normally bereft of the divine, you will find that the Greek pantheon will stand with you. An extension of both your fortune and luck will see you gaining boons and gifts of divine and legendary potency, titan-slaying weapons and blessings from the gods entering your possession in such number that the ease you collect them could be compared to how a mortal collects any mundane trinket. Given the powerful synergy these boons can possess, able to tear through even impossibly tough or immortal foes, or make you resistant to similar levels of harm, or more esoteric yet still helpful things, it would be wise not to call anything you acquire with this a mere trinket. Lastly, and perhaps most famously, is a trick you picked up from your Dread Lord and Father, due to his blood running through your veins. When you are slain, you shall not stay dead, instead reforming in the Underworld from the River Styx. Unlike poor Zagreus, you aren't cursed to be trapped down there, dying a swift death on the surface, and fought by every denizen of the afterlife. Much to the contrary, as a noble heir to Hades, most doors in the Underworld are open to you, granting you more than a few exits out of it and back to the mortal realm.
objects.title: Child of Hades (Hades)

addons.text:
You can now sense the souls of all living creatures within the radius of your Mind's Eye, offering a variety of benefits. 

Firstly, you can utilize your soul sight to generally determine what emotions organisms are feeling. This is extremely broad, you could determine that someone was sad, but not determine whether it is melancholy, depression, or grief. Based on emotions and fluctuations of the soul, you can generally determine if someone is lying.

Secondly, based on the attributes of a soul you can determine what type of abilities they have. A bright, compressed, and refined soul may be a mage who has great control over their magic. This doesn't help you identify what techniques they use or what their fighting style is.

Finally, you can create Vessels by parasitizing the souls you see. Vessels now inherit all of your mental/soul-based powers, such as precise body control, soul sight, x-ray vision, and combat thinker capabilities. Abilities such as Inventory are communal, rather than a unique Inventory for every Vessel.
addons.title: Soul Sight

addons.text:
Like Mordret, you are an absolute genius when it comes to combat. You can intuitively determine the best ways to use powers, and come up with niche techniques and strategies with them on the spot. Furthermore, you excel at combining these powers together with those of your other Vessels in order to form devastating combination attacks the originals would never have thought of. This is to the extent that you can defeat someone solely relying on their own powers, seconds after acquiring them. 

Additionally, you have inherited Mordret's swordsmanship skills and talents. This includes the hundreds of styles Mordret has encountered and utilized, all joined together in a deadly combat art. Like all Transcendental Battle Arts, this style perfectly incorporates all of your powers and weaponry as if they were natural extensions of yourself. Your raw talent is so great that even as a child with no training you could defeat lauded Sword Saints and make the greatest swordmasters fear your potential.

Your body is a living weapon, similar to Morgan, Princess of War. Rather than just brute-force punching and bludgeoning, you can now slash, pierce, shred, or cut with any part of your body. Physically, you are strong enough to rip out someone's heart through layers of enhanced metal armor, tough enough to survive a massive pile of point-blank explosives, and fast enough to cross a large city within minutes at full speed. However, you can sometimes accidentally cut objects or people just by touching them if you aren't careful. It's better to wear fully-covering clothes and gloves.

During combat, all of your powers now ramp up together with your physical attributes.
addons.title: Prince of War

addons.text:
You have inherited a portion of the powers of Skinwalker, Source of Nightmares. 

Whenever you possess someone into your vessel, you can peer into their memories freely. This gives you an instinctive understanding on how they would act, allowing for you to assume their identity flawlessly. While you are imprinted on a body, you can slowly and subtly edit the memories of the host to suit your liking. This can turn an irreconcilable nemesis into your childhood friend, a traitor into a loyal subject, etc. Even if you remove your imprint from the body, they will act according to the changed memories you have given them.

Normally, your Vessel possessions are subtle and undetectable unless you encounter soul-based resistance. The host merely feels like they are going to sleep while you take control. Now, you can optionally force the host to stay awake while you puppet their body, aware of every action you take with it. This can also be used benevolently, such as if you are temporarily borrowing the body to teach them a technique.

The number of Vessels you can possess has been greatly expanded. You can have tens of thousands of Vessels before you even begin to feel any strain on your soul. Furthermore, your Vessel concealment has been further improved to the extent that even those with advanced soul sight would be unable to identify your Vessels from their originals.
addons.title: Wilting Flowers

objects.text: "Well. A mirror can only reflect what is in front of it. Is it my fault that the things in front of me are cruel, vile, and deceitful? I think not… then again, maybe it is. Either way, I don't really care." You gain a modified version of Mordret's powers. Every time you kill a living being, you absorb a sliver of its soul. This boosts all your physical attributes, powers, and supernatural energy reserves by an extremely small margin. Once you kill enough powerful beings, you can form a Soul Core, which massively boosts all of the aforementioned capabilities. You can have up to 7 Soul Cores at once, each getting exponentially harder to form. By separating a Soul Core, you create a Reflection. These Reflections are copies of yourself, controlled directly in a hivemind. They start off moderately weaker than you, but can themselves grow stronger by killing. They cannot form Soul Cores of their own. When a reflection dies or is recalled, you gain all the souls it has devoured. Creating a Reflection uses a Soul Core until you recall it, but you can form new Soul Cores to replace what you have lost. You can have a maximum of 7 Reflections. This means, at most you can have 7 Reflections active at once while having a full 7 cores to yourself. Furthermore, you have the capacity to create Vessels. Whenever a being interacts with your soul, such as making eye contact or looking at your reflection, you can imprint your soul onto theirs. This acts as a parasite, allowing for you to take over their body and utilize any physical (such as Parahumans) or soul-based (such as Semblances) powers they have. You don't have an instinctive understanding of their powers. Optionally, you have the ability to dramatically reveal yourself by temporarily changing the eye of a host to glow and match yours, in both color and shape. If you wish, you may choose to let the imprint lie dormant. In this state, you share senses with your host and even communicate with them. At any time, you may take over the host for yourself temporarily or permanently. Vessels are all in a hivemind with yourself. Reflections and Vessels both can create Vessels, but not other Reflections. If your main body dies, you resurrect within a Reflection of your choosing. If all your Reflections are dead, you resurrect greatly weakened within a vessel. Unfortunately, beings of your power level or greater can detect and resist the imprint process or even damage you. Vessels also do not have your powers unless it is something everybody can use, but can usurp the unique supernatural energies of the host to use your techniques. For example, you could burn the soul of a host to cast a powerful spell. Having too many vessels at once can overwhelm you with feedback and cause strain on your soul. Your maximum count increases as your soul grows stronger. Finally, you, your Vessels, and your Reflections can all see through and travel between reflective surfaces. You can hop from an imprinted body into a mirror, where you can control the shape your reflection takes or even not appear at all. You can also control reflections, allowing you to have conversations like a zoom call. You can use even the smallest surfaces such as drops of rain to reveal everything in the area.
objects.title: Prince of Nothing (Shadow Slave)

addons.text: "However, what he found there was Corruption, not the truth. Or perhaps it was the truth he found that corrupted him." You are akin to the Estuary in the Tomb of Ariel, a harbinger of truths that corrupts those who seek them. Anyone who actively focuses on divination, scrying, detection, or abilities seeking to draw information from you is subject to being "corrupted" by your "truth." This Corruption only activates when you are the specific target; appearing passively within someone's vision or path won't trigger it. However, this Corruption will take time to root, varying in strength with each encounter. On a first, brief attempt, the seer or investigator experiences only an overwhelming sense of having glimpsed something they should not—an experience too profound to be explained, captured only in a single word, that of "God." Continued observation leads their attempts to misalign, compelling them instead to reverence or worship. Prolonged exposure will complete the Corruption, drawing the individual fully under your thrall and transforming them into a fanatic willing to sacrifice themselves at your whim. Those who dare to glimpse upon your "truth" will gradually transform as their bodies slowly warp with mutations—tentacles unfurling from limbs, additional eyes bursting forth, mucus-secreting glands forming, and other grotesque changes marking their descent. Those fully enthralled under your influence grow stronger, though their minds become clouded, filled only with reverence for you, their capacity for reason giving way to devotion. In the Corruption's early stages, you can temper its effects, subtly guiding their loyalty without revealing your influence outright. For those with abilities dependent on other powers, a sense of dread may set in as their patron or source warns them of the danger—though only if they choose to intervene.
addons.title: Seed of Corruption

addons.text: "Hidden in the depths of the lightless abyss, an eerily beautiful creature floated in the vast and silent darkness." You gain the abilities of Sybil of the Fallen Grace, better known as the Terror of LO49. You are capable of thriving in any aquatic environment. You do not need to breathe, and are capable of seeing perfectly in even the darkest of ocean conditions. Instead of swimming, you can move freely in the water, similar to a flight power, up to 10x of what you could run at your max speed on land. This is further supported by subconscious use of hydrokinesis to propel you in water, like a jet stream. You also remember the paths you have taken underwater and can navigate yourself back to any location you have previously been to, or onto the nearest piece of land. Your primary combat ability is the use of mind manipulation to lure victims to yourself. You passively manipulate anything in a city-wide radius to take actions slightly more in your favor. The closer someone gets to your physical location and the longer they spend there, the more influenced they become. After a couple months of constant exposure in a city-block radius, they would actively seek you out to do your bidding (or be eaten by you, I won't judge). Anyone who is victim to your manipulation for long enough has a passive hex around them that causes people to ignore them, making investigating their disappearances a nightmare. You can also create phantom silk that causes those immobilized within to gradually lose their sense of self and become mindless husks. Unless you have other methods to produce silk, this silk takes enough time to create that it is unviable in combat. However, your manipulation can be resisted with mental defenses. If you stop affecting individuals they quickly go back to normal in a matter of days, though they will not have realized anything wrong with them.
addons.title: Terror of LO49

addons.text:
You have inherited the vast experience of Cassia, the brilliant tactician of the Fire Keepers and a trusted member of Nephis' cohort. Her unparalleled insight into visions and strategy has transformed your approach to combat. With her expertise, you now effortlessly merge your future sight with your present senses, perceiving an ever-shifting web of possibilities. Each outcome unfolds before you while you remain firmly anchored in the present, allowing you to devise innovative strategies on the fly. This newfound awareness enables you to counter your opponents' tactics, exploiting their weaknesses before they can even recognize the threat.

Guided by Cassia's wisdom, you map the battlefield in your mind, weaving the shared perspectives from your allies into a seamless, dynamic plan that shifts in real-time. Each of your allies now moves with a perfect understanding of your intent—where to go, when to strike, and how to win. You lead the battlefield like a master conductor, orchestrating every movement with precision, calculation, and undeniable effectiveness.

Your strategies unfold with a surgeon's precision, adapting effortlessly to the ever-changing tides of war. The chaos that once threatened to overwhelm you becomes the perfect canvas for your vision. Every action brings you closer to victory, consistently turning the tide of battle in your favor. Your command transcends mere strategy—it becomes an art form where every conflict is a symphony of your brilliance.

Through careful foresight and meticulous planning, you shape the battlefield into a realm of absolute control, guiding your allies with unmatched precision while ruthlessly dismantling your enemies. Your combat abilities are enhanced to a level few can match—every strike you make, honed by foresight, is as devastating as it's deliberate.

As an added benefit, you can readily adapt your pre-existing techniques and abilities to complement your precognition, alongside gaining access to all of Cassia's precognitive fencing styles.
addons.title: Precognitive Tactics

objects.text: Rise o' inheritor of Cassia, Song of the Fallen. For you now bear her mantle and legacy upon your shoulders—a path of seers and schemers, of powers woven from insight and manipulation. Your first gift is of sight beyond sight, a form of clairvoyance that grants near-omniscient awareness within your surroundings. With a glance, you can unveil secrets, discerning traits and attributes, and understand any abilities and affinities of those within your range—even granting deeper insight into the person and how they'd act. This level of foresight allows you to predict movements and actions with uncanny precision. This sight stretches deeper still, unveiling glimpses of past and future events—no mere flashes, but richly immersive experiences, as though you are reliving moments that were or might yet be. With focus, you control the depth of these visions, casting your gaze mere seconds ahead or peering into events stretching across weeks or even months. While in moments of great import or danger, these visions may activate on their own, a safeguard of sorts. By projecting your awareness into likely futures, you may witness them subtly shifting and adapting with each choice you make. Shorter visions—glimpses mere seconds ahead—linger with you constantly, like a subtle form of combat precognition, while visions of distant events can be accessed only once every few days. Pushing the limits of this ability too often will cloud the clarity of these visions, requiring rest to reset it. When used against those with similar powers, your accuracy may also waver; however, with practice, you may eventually see multiple potential futures at once, offering you a great deal of flexibility. Finally, within a 30-meter radius, you may forge a mental link with any sentient beings of your choice, weaving them into a sensory network that grants you access to their perceptions—even supernatural ones. This link enables a one-way telepathic communication, where you may convey thoughts to them, though they must respond aloud. While your clairvoyance and telepathy know no true range, managing such a vast flow of insight can strain the mind deeply. Additionally, you may also delve into the memories of those within your line of sight, able to view, alter, or erase them. This act requires a deliberate focus that makes it more suitable for quiet settings beyond the fray of battle. Those of lesser strength may yield memories unnoticed, while those equal to your power require either consent or defeat, with the ability to shield specific memories from you even then. With Cassia's legacy, you command vast knowledge and insight, wielding it as a powerful yet delicate tool, demanding careful focus and wisdom.
objects.title: Song of The Fallen (Shadow Slave)

objects.text: It takes a certain kind of person to face the very depths of despair, and still continue to fight. You have gained the powers of the feared assassin of the government, Soul Reaper Jet. You can devour the souls of those you kill. Every time you kill a living being, you gain a permanent increase in all of your physical stats and in the maximum capacity and regeneration rate of a magical energies. However, what makes this ability truly fearsome is the temporary rejuvenation provided by murder. With every kill, you heal yourself, recover stamina, and restore a portion of your magical energy. The stronger the opponent felled, the greater the healing and magical energy recovery. Stronger abilities also provide greater permanent increases to your stats. Your soul is also enhanced to increase the maximum capacity of any energies you possess, and granting you the ability to "stockpile" above the maximum capacity temporarily during combat. This stockpile can be used to temporarily boost your strength and speed or heal yourself when you are unable to find someone to murder. Furthermore, the nature of your soul means you can continue persisting in combat despite any injuries you suffer as long as you continuously murder. If you have a large stockpile, you can even persist after death through burning your stockpile, until you run out or revive yourself by killing others. Your core offensive ability is the power to damage the souls of your opponents directly with all of your weapon, physical, and magical attacks. Unlike supporting soul-based aspects like Mordret, your powers allow you to shred through common souls in mere seconds, devouring them to fuel your endless rampage. You can even critically damage souls of powerful Saints and others on your level after a few rounds of combat. This damage can pierce through some basic soul defenses, to a certain extent. Finally, you can temporarily turn into a supernatural mist form. By consuming magical energy, you can phase through objects and attacks as well as travel at high speeds. However, this state cannot be maintained for long and has a cooldown after each use. Your mist naturally phases through any obstacles/attacks and is not scattered by winds or dispelled by flames. You can return to corporeal form at any time, or automatically after a few seconds.
objects.title: Soul Reaper (Shadow Slave)

objects.text:
The Soul Serpent, also known as the Shadow Serpent, is a shadow creature created by Shadow God and presumably once owned by his followers. Unlike other shadow creatures, it is bound to a single master and possesses absolute loyalty. Should its owner die, the Soul Serpent journeys to the Shadow Realm to perish alongside them.

You receive a Soul Serpent that immediately binds itself to your soul upon acquisition. It can be commanded with a thought and is intelligent enough to understand anything you tell it. The Soul Serpent can shift between three forms: tattoo, weapon, and beast. In its tattoo form, it becomes an intricate image of a black serpent coiled around its owner’s arms and torso, serving as the mark of Shadow God.

While in tattoo form, the Soul Serpent enhances the efficiency and flow of its owner’s shadow essence and increases the rate at which they absorb it. In your case, it instead enhances the efficiency of any energy you possess and improves your ability to absorb energy, if applicable.

In weapon form, the Soul Serpent becomes a black-bladed odachi by default, though it can assume the form of any weapon. However, it is limited by the owner’s knowledge and imagination. The more intimately you understand a weapon and the more precisely you can envision its details, the greater the result. In beast form, the Soul Serpent takes the shape of a massive snake with jet-black scales, at least six meters long and strong enough to crush granite into dust.

Finally, the Soul Serpent grows in power alongside its owner. Originally, Sunless’s Soul Serpent strengthened as the Rank of his Shadow Dance Legacy increased. In your case, however, the more powerful you become, the stronger your Soul Serpent becomes, unlocking additional abilities over time. By default, your Soul Serpent is equivalent to an Awakened Rank creature. At higher ranks, it becomes capable of damaging beings comparable to you in power while in weapon form and grows to colossal proportions in beast form.

Examples of abilities unlocked at higher levels include the power to absorb a portion of the energy from slain enemies; the ability to assume the form of any creature you have killed that is not stronger than the serpent, including replicating their powers and abilities; and the capacity to ignore the reality-defying abilities of greater beings by embodying the Death aspect of Shadow God.
objects.title: Soul Serpent (Shadow Slave)

addons.text: You can alter and decorate your transformation to change their appearance however you like without impacting performance. It just makes it harder to identify both forms as you but it doesn't prevent people from figuring out your identity.
addons.title: Exterior

addons.text: You can use Shares as EXP, allowing you to level yourself up by spending Shares gathered from the faith and trust people have in you. Additionally, even if you lose shares you don't become weaker. Instead, your growth from Shares will only be stagnant.
addons.title: Level Up!

addons.text:
You can channel and enhance the Share energy you receive from those who believe in you as a way of enhancing both your own and their abilities. Using the shares generated from them to enhance them creates a cycle of empowerment. The more shares generated the stronger your collective strength becomes. You can also choose to dedicate shares to a select number of people if you want.
