The recipients of these Shares also gain the ability to transform into an HDD state which enhances them with the Shares shared with them to become even more powerful. As the collective generates more and more Shares, they will eventually be able to use it to unlock even stronger forms for everyone.
addons.title: Share Harmonics

objects.text:
You have been imbued by the power of a CPU Memory and turned into a CPU. Unlike those from the Hyperdimension, you still possess the power to transform even when disconnected from your Shares. As a CPU, you can gather Shares from people's faith and trust in you that you can harness to empower yourself with an HDD Form. Your HDD Form can be augmented with Processor Units and grows stronger the more shares you possess. With enough Shares, you can even gain more transformations that are stronger than before. Transforming causes your personality to change into a reflection of your inner heart but doesn't impact your core values and beliefs.

As an ageless CPU, you are difficult to kill with normal means. So long as you don't run out of Shares or get attacked by something that directly attacks your soul you can't die. Moreover, you possess the capabilities to establish a Sovereign Theocracy with such skills that you can indulge in your gaming passion while maintaining a prosperous nation.

(You are not forced to be female with this power. If you have a technology power, you can adapt advanced computer parts from things like cybernetic armor to quantum computers into Processor Units.)
objects.title: Console Patron Unit (Hyperdimension Neptunia)

addons.text: With your Lieutenant-Class spiritual power, your Kekkai's strength and durability increase significantly, meaning that fewer enemies can break free. However, this boost in power comes with a reduction in precision. Along with the increase in strength, you will gain scrolls detailing techniques that require considerable power to use. Notable techniques include Zekkai, a barrier of pure destruction that annihilates everything it touches, and Musou, a technique that clears your mind of outside influences, enhancing the speed, power, and effectiveness of Kekkaijutsu.
addons.title: Kekkaijutsu Adept

addons.text: Now, having gained exceptional control over Captain-Class spiritual power, you can use just the right amount of energy for each function. This mastery greatly reduces casting time, increases the number of Kekkai you can create simultaneously, and enhances their stability. You can even form needle-like Kekkai strong enough to pierce an opponent without breaking. Additionally, you will receive scrolls that teach techniques requiring precise control, including Phasing through opponents' techniques, selectively filtering what your Kekkai allows to pass, and various sensory techniques.
addons.title: Kekkaijutsu Expert

addons.text:
With this your spiritual power and precision are on par with members of Squad Zero or Head Captain Yamamoto. You gain a scroll that explains the steps and methods to master the ultimate techniques of Kekkaijutsu. 

The first of these is Shinkai. While Zekkai erases everything, Shinkai allows you to return to a state of zero, enabling you to create a new world. However, Shinkai requires significantly more power than other techniques, making it a dangerous gamble to attempt. Within this barrier, you can manipulate nearly anything essentially, you become a God of Creation and Destruction within your barrier for as long as you can maintain it.

Lastly, you will learn a technique that was the protoype for the Senkaimon. This technique requires preparation but allows you to bend space to connect two points, through a portal. Once mastered, it will permit travel to alternate dimensions, requiring preparations that may take days to complete. With the perk Homecoming, this ultimately can reach into full travel of the multiverse.
addons.title: Kekkaijutsu Mastery

addons.text:
You are an Onmyōji, a human who uses spiritual power to combat Yōkai. Onmyōji are primarily known for summoning Shikigami, chanting mantras, crafting spiritual weapons, creating barriers, seals and utilising various techniques known as Onmyōjutsu. Your talent rivals that of Abe no Seimei, the strongest Onmyōji in history, and you have inherited his skills and techniques, though not his memories or his Nue powers.

You are an expert at reading the patterns of the heavenly bodies, making you exceptionally proficient in astronomy-based Onmyōjutsu. Through this mastery, you can even influence the movement of the planets themselves, creating immense gravitational forces. This allows you to push or pull with overwhelming power while maintaining extraordinary precision and control.

You possess Abe no Seimei’s signature technique Heptagram: a seven-pointed star of immense power, capable of halting devastating techniques or even killing an opponent. By combining this technique with gravity manipulation, you can create invisible barriers that suspend anything in midair.

You are master of Wu Xing known as the Five Elements, you are able to summon and use any of these elements, turn your body parts into different elements, and combine the opposing forces to create a technique which disregards the laws of the five elements or the natural world, for example, combine Water and Fire for a powerful energy explosion.

Shikigami are spiritual beings summoned by Onmyōji, often through Ofuda inscribed with prayers or through spoken spells. There are many different types of Shikigami, each with its own appearance and abilities. They can range from a deer with incredible jumping power to a koi fish that can merge with your arm to form a cannon.

You possess the ability to fuse Shikigami together to create more powerful forms, or even fuse them with your own body. You also know how to create every Ofuda and every words of spell to summon all Shikigami shown in the series, and with time and research, you can create entirely new ones.
addons.title: Onmyōji (Nurarihyon No Mago)

objects.text:
The Hazama-ryu Kekkaijutsu is a versatile school of techniques primarily focused on creating barriers, typically in the form of cubes for containment. While these barriers (kekkai) are strong, they can still be broken by powerful opponents. By mastering these techniques, you will receive the essential training needed for Kekkaijutsu and acquire enough spiritual power to use these abilities frequently, though not indefinitely. You will also receive scrolls explaining the techniques and a customized bladed Shakujo.

A basic Kekkai technique consists of three main stages:

Hōi: Target the subject for the kekkai.
Jōso: Decide where to place the kekkai.
Ketsu: Create and activate the kekkai.

Once the kekkai is established, you have several options:

Kai: Releasing the kekkai without harming anything.
Metsu: Collapsing the kekkai, destroying its contents.
Tenketsu: Pulling in the remains of anything destroyed by Metsu, sealed away in an inescapable pocket dimension. (requires use of a Shakujo).

In addition to these basic techniques, you will learn several other skills, like the ability to disable other’s barriers, to repair inorganic objects or plants, to create barrier-threads for binding/capturing, and how to create and control Shikigami.
objects.title: Hazama-ryu Kekkaijutsu (Kekkaishi)

addons.text:
As Aura exists in every living thing, it bridges gaps and allows for communication between vastly different species, granting you the ability to understand the speech of Pokemon.

Furthermore, you gain the ability to send your Aura to Pokemon you possess a strong bond with, empowering them to heights far beyond what they could achieve alone.
addons.title: Pokebond

addons.text:
Through your possession of two different kinds of Aura from different worlds, you have found that they are not so different after all, each a representation of the life of a living thing. With this revelation, you have melded the two applications into a more potent and cohesive whole.

Your enlightenment towards the nature of Aura means that the usage of both forms of Aura is easier and more intuitive for you, especially when it comes to creating new applications. This is helped by the fact that your combined Aura is more malleable, leaning on both the spiritual and physical attributes of both sides for greater versatility. When awakening the Aura of another, you can choose to awaken this combined form of Aura in them.

Furthermore, the potency of both applications of Aura is boosted greatly and can scale even further with spiritual strength and potency, allowing you to fight evenly against Legendary Pokemon - beings rightfully worshipped as Gods - given enough time and training.

Lastly, you gain an understanding of how to recreate a variety of buff, martial, and non-elemental Pokemon Moves, such as Force Palm, Sacred Sword, Agility, and Swords Dance. Additionally, using Dust, you can mimic the effects of Moves outside of those categories, such as using Plant Dust to effectively cast Razor Leaf or Vine Whip.
addons.title: Aura²

addons.text:
Your Mind’s Eye has been profoundly enhanced by your ability to perceive and interact with Aura.

It can now ride on waves of Aura energy, allowing you to project your perception through your Aura — like echolocation powered by the soul.

This works by emitting a brief Aura Pulse, which your Mind’s Eye “rides”, momentarily extending your perception over great distances (hundreds of meters) in a flash.

Furthermore, you can now scan through solid objects such as walls with greater clarity, as your Aura acts as a carrier, bypassing normal perceptual interference.

Finally, your Pulse can read emotional and energetic residues, enabling you to track recent events or disturbances within an area.
addons.title: Clairvoyant Pulse

addons.text:
As an Aura Guardian, you benefit greatly from possessing a malleable soul. No longer are your soul and Aura merely related but distinct systems—they are now one unified whole.

The first benefit this provides is that the overall energy cost of your Aura techniques will decrease over time. Allowing you to achieve the same result with less energy as your soul will optimize itself for maximum efficiency. This assistance will be minor at first but will grow stronger over time as your soul learns and adapts.

Additionally your souls malleablility has imprinted itself on your Aura. Making it more flexible and versatile. Allowing you to create techniques and acomplish feats that would be incredibly difficult, if not outright impossible for other Aura users. 

The final benefit is that severe overuse of Aura no longer threatens your life. Instead, when your Aura is critically low or fully depleted, your soul will shift into a life-support mode while it waits for your Aura to replenish. There is a high chance that you might get knocked unconscious during this period, though this can be avoided through additional powers or sheer willpower.
addons.title: Soul-Aura Convergence

objects.text:
You possess the power of an Aura Guardian from the world of Pokemon, capable of wielding the spiritual phenomena known as Aura, an energy which is essentially manifested lifeforce and has been described as the essence of every living thing.

Aura can be used to accomplish many things; reading the minds and actions of others, a form of “aura sense” which allows for visual perception when the user’s sight is obscured, resisting outside influences, telepathy, projecting it outwards to form barriers and blasts, sealing entities, or fortifying and strengthening the user’s physical capabilities.

While Aura can be used to accomplish great feats, be wary of overtaxing yourself without rest, as you are literally using your own lifeforce to do these feats.
objects.title: Aura Guardian (Pokemon)

addons.text: The Underworld is a dark, bleak, and nasty place. Souls float listlessly along the river Styx, and those found outside of it are savage monsters, more often than not. However, inside your soul, a sanctuary that cares for those you cherish took notice of the state of the Underworld. While unable to do much, the soul garden attempted to make this dreary space just a little bit brighter. Most fortunately for you, it succeeded. Now, instead of taking solace in knowing that the souls of those you hold dear are in a better place, free from harm and enjoying their time away from the burden of living, in a small part of the Underworld, away from the blackened stone, the constant wailing and moaning, is your soul garden made manifest. With this, you are now able to visit the people inside of it. Promises unable to be kept, ripped away by the hands of death can be reforged. Last goodbyes can be properly made, and new memories can be treasured for the rest of time.
addons.title: A Little Slice of Elysium

addons.text: ’The Underworld is revived in all its splendor, as the seat once occupied by the Lord and Master of the House of Hades is filled again.’ You are now not only the Lord of the Dead, but the Lord and Master of the House of Hades as well. You’ve practically become the embodiment of Hades himself, taking the best of both worlds, of Disney and Supergiant. All of the abilities, equipment, and more that Hades has been noted to have used in the lore or seen using in the game is now yours. From the Helm of Darkness, which allows its wielder to go invisible, to his own copy of Varatha, the Eternal Spear, utilizing swift but brutal stabbing and sweeping attacks to decimate his opponents. Furthermore, your aforementioned ‘menagerie of monsters’ has been increased to hold any of the monsters or denizens of the Underworld seen in both Hades and Hades II. Scylla and the Sirens, the Bone Hydra, the Queen Lamia, Cerberus, and many more await your orders. The Underworld has been not only overhauled, but redesigned to resemble and function like the Underworld seen in Hades. Optionally, some notable figures can be brought here to liven up the place. In other words, you are free to choose to have any or all of the people who reside or have taken shelter in Hades’ Underworld, from Charon, Nemesis, Nyx and the Furies, to Zagreus, Persephone, Melinoё, and even Hades himself. The only person who is exempt from being chosen is the Primordial Originator, Chaos. You can make contact and connect Chaos to your Underworld, however, allowing you or others to visit them. You needn’t worry about who rules the Underworld if you do bring people such as Nyx or Hades along, but if you want, you can work something out anyways.
addons.title: Master of the House

objects.text: ”Geez Louise! Can this place get any more cramped? Heck, this isn’t even the whole dang Powers Section! I haven’t even had a contract this long before! I’m dying in here!” ”…!” “Oh, hey! The name’s Hades, Lord of the Dead, hi, how you doing?” You have been imbued with the essence of Hades, Lord and God of the Dead, and Ruler of the Greek Underworld, specifically the Underworld seen in Disney’s Hercules-”Ugh.” -With this, you gain his godly physiology, his power, the Underworld itself, among a few other things. As a small bonus, you have become a master in the arts of dark humor, quick wit, and smooth talking. With this, your charisma is, simply put, divine. Even when everyone doesn’t trust you at all, you’re able to trap even other gods in your casually honeyed words, effectively becoming a paragon of what every sleazy car salesman dreams of becoming one day. Firstly, as the God of the dead, you possess powerful abilities, such as raising the dead, animating corpses, and having them do your bidding. You have a body made of smoke, able to turn intangible at any given time. Not only are you immensely durable and strong, as a God would be, but you’re also immortal in the ageless sense. You can die, but you’ll be banished to the Underworld and are forbidden from exiting for a set time depending on-”How hard you get your butt kicked~! Don’t rely on it too much though, kid. It’s not fun.” With your-”Smokin’ hot bod-”, you have access to both typhokinesis and pyrokinesis, able to generate and manipulate those two elements constantly if you wish. You can conjure inanimate objects using your smoke, such as liquids, cigarettes, thrones, chariots, etc., and use these elements as a medium to transport creatures from the Underworld (along with people who owe you or you own) to your location. From jet black alicorns and small imps, to three-headed dogs and hydras, you’ve got quite the menagerie of monsters at your beck and call. You can make deals, wagers, and pacts with anyone who agrees with your terms. ”Make the rules, use that newly gained charisma, and souls, power, people, all sorts of things and doo-dads just fall right into your lap. Word of caution, though. The people you’re making deals with can just as easily bend the rules as you can, provided they got enough wit on ‘em.” The Underworld follows your every word, and the living shudder at your name. All hail Hades, God of the Dead. ”And hey, if you ever do see Wonder Boy, give him a good punch in the throat for me. As a thank you, of sorts. Sure, it was never my way of doing things, but seeing as I’m trapped here for the time being, ‘needs must’ and all that.”
objects.title: Lord of the Dead (Disney: Hercules)

addons.text:
Your Mind's Eye has deepened, granting you an enhanced perception of the spiritual realm. Now, not only can you see spirits, but you can also instantly assess their strength, abilities and gauge their emotional state by reading their aura. The aura reveals not just the spirit's power but also their intentions and emotions, allowing you to differentiate between the vengeful energy of a ghost filled with resentment and the natural, untamed presence of an elemental fey. This insight gives you an advantage in understanding the nature and motivations of the spirits you encounter, helping you decide how to interact with or defend against them.

With further training, your abilities could expand even more. You could learn to perceive nuances beyond the spirits themselves—such as detecting when a person is under the influence of a spirit, such as possession or under the effects of a curse. You could eventually be able to perceive other hidden layers of reality, such as the flow of spiritual energy within a place or the presence of sacred or cursed objects.
addons.title: All Seeing

objects.text: You gain the ability to see spirits, even powerful ones that are invisible to other mediums, with total clarity. Extremely powerful spirits, ones that are several magnitudes above your level, cannot be seen, although you can see their effects. This ability is active constantly, so you will always sees spirits in your day-to-day life. If you do not acknowledge them, the spirits will not bother you.
objects.title: Spirit Sight (Mieruko-chan)

objects.text:
You have the legendary powers possessed by Saints at birth. In truth, this is the same power held by the Witch, as Saints are reborn as Witches upon killing their predecessor, leading to an eternal cycle with continuous 15-year reigns of terror by the Witch, followed by a brief 5-year peace brought by the Saint.

The primary ability used by the various Saints and Witches is space-attribute magic, also known as Darkness magic. You can perceive the world around you as coordinates, relative to a certain location (either the center of the planet or the Universe). You can aim your attacks at specific coordinates with perfect accuracy, or teleport to any location for which you know the coordinates. Using math, you can figure out the coordinates of unknown locations as well. You instantly know the coordinates of any location you have ever perceived. You can use this power to teleport to different universes in the Omniverse.

Furthermore, your body has been warped by the darkness attribute, making you resistant to all types of damage. As long as attacks don't affect space in any way, their potency is lowered by as much as 50%. The space-attribute is merely an affinity, and is thus far more effective when paired with a proper magic system. All of your spells and physical/weapon attacks are also mutated by the Darkness attribute, allowing them to deal a portion of their damage to the souls of targets.

The second ability you possess is extremely powerful Biokinesis, including the ability to generate biomass out of nowhere. This is primarily used by Saints to heal others, either through touch or by creating various healing projectiles. Your healing can dispel curses, cure illnesses, and even save people with half their body blown off. You can even cast area-of-effect healing spells, though with reduced efficiency.

Meanwhile, Witches utilize Biokinesis to mutate animals into various custom-designed monsters with a touch. You will require a knowledge of Biology to do anything advanced with the power. Your minions are innately loyal to you, and you can grant them extremely weak versions of the Darkness attribute, allowing them to damage souls. Unfortunately, subjects granted the Darkness attribute will have an extremely shortened lifespan. Your biokinesis cannot affect yourself, though if you have powers such as Biomancy, Self-Biokinesis, or Panacea, they can benefit from the Biomass generation.
objects.title: Power of the Saint (Fake Saint of the Year)

addons.text:
Now, you can communicate with your Sensories same as you can with your vessels, as well as temporarily take over them or channel your powers through them discreetly, if you so desire, with Sensories being none the wiser. After you've possessed them, you can now return the control to the Sensory and, optionally, erase the memories of possession.

When you create a Sensory, you can imbue it with a soul core, in which case it will not count towards the limit of the Sensories you can have in one universe.

When a Sensory is imbued with a soul core at birth, you can allow it to wield some of your powers permanently, albeit at reduced strength. The soul core in them will also boost the speed at which the Sensory gains power, making all but certain that they will be head and shoulders above anyone else in their world if they invest enough effort. Should a Sensory bearing your soul core die, all the powers, skills, and knowledge it acquired will return to you.

Lastly, should you choose to completely awaken a Sensory with a soul core, the core will dissolve and allow your soul to inhabit both bodies simultaneously. Thus, both bodies will be truly you, with your consciousness in control of both of them; as such, you will continue to exist as long as even a single one of your bodies exists. This also raises the limit on the amount of soul cores you can have, with every body of yours being able to hold 7 cores each.
addons.title: King of Nowhere

addons.text: In any universe you have previously visited, including your original one, you can create a Sensory at the exact moment you left it, with the appearance you had at the time.
addons.title: Never Gonna Say Goodbye

addons.text:
You can selectively concentrate your presence in your chosen sensories. Other universes you have sensories in—or even one containing your original body—will be left in a 'paused' state, as if you personally visited them and then left.

The flow of time will resume when you try to act in the 'paused' universe, but you can still browse sensory's memories in this state.
addons.title: Pause

addons.text:
Now, if any of your Sensories, awakened or not, suffers an injury or even destroyed completely, as long as you yourself exist, you can rewind them to any previous state without physical contact, restoring them completely.

This also allows you to restore the mind of a previously awakened Sensory, if you so desire, although you, of course, can regain control at any time.
addons.title: Respawn

addons.text:
No longer will the question of whether your Sensory will be born with powers native to the setting be left to the genetic lottery. Now, if a universe your Sensory is born into has a magic system, psionic powers or any other system of supernatural abilities, you can make sure that your Sensory will be born with not just the ability to access these powers, but that his innate strength, potential, and talent will be at the level of most gifted inhabitants of this universe.

When your Sensory dies or is awakened, all its powers will be merged into your energy source, allowing you to access them at the same level your Sensory could. You will also gain all its knowledge and skills in utilising this power system.
addons.title: Gifted Sensory

addons.text:
Now each of your Sensories can become fully one with your being (as a new Hive Mind clone), providing you have a Hive Mind charge free to do so.

This means that you could send out a Sensory as a forward scout into a universe, determine if it is suitable for your plans, and if it is so, you can "awaken" your Sensory to the fullness of your being (moreso than even a normal Sensory), allowing you to carry out the aforementioned plan by actually being present.

This also streamlines the learning of new powers; if you have an addon like Gifted Sensory, you can send a Sensory to a universe to learn it's power system, and when you're satisfied, you can "cash in" and spread that power and knowledge across the whole network (though that's not to imply that you can't keep learning once you've turned that Sensory into a Hive Mind Clone!)

You could use the upgrades Mantled Avatar or Hijack to gain the full being of a specific person without worrying about the ten year timer. Similarly, you could use the upgrade Presence Manifestation to create versions of yourself anytime and anywhere, with any backstory, appearance, local abilities, or previous history you choose, allowing you to do things like create Manchurian Candidates that didn't exist the day before.
addons.title: Two Places At Once
Immersive Experience
addons.text:
You can now possess any of your sensories without fully awakening them. When doing so, you will forget everything about your true self and your other powers, leading you to believe that your sensory is your true reincarnation and leaving you without immediate access to your other powers.

Before that, you can set the conditions upon which your memories will be unlocked, restoring full access to all your powers. These conditions can be as precise as doing a specific action or as broad as achieving some lifelong goal. In any case, all your memories return on the death of the sensory you inhabit, as your mind is ejected into your primary body.

objects.text: Once per day, in any universe or dimension you wish and at any point on its timeline, you can create a Sensory, a remotely controlled terminal for you to interact with the chosen world. You cannot create a second one in the same universe you already inhabit, either yourself or through another sensory.
objects.title: Sensory (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
Crossing the abyss of Da'at has caused the essence you derive your abilities from to expand significantly to encompass the full scope of natural and supernatural laws in the universe.

This allows you to alter the physical and metaphysical structure of your star body at will. This ability only extends to the hill sphere of your Star body or within the area your Star body's gravitational pull is the dominant force, though ripples can impact the cosmological structure of the universe.

You have complete control over the physical structure of your Star body, allowing you to reshape landmasses with a thought, create and manipulate a large and complex biosphere of life to populate your body, creating or drying up oceans at will, or creating a Hollow Earth-like emptiness inside without reducing the structural integrity of your body.

You can use your ability to rewrite the metaphysical laws present on your body to create complex power systems. these are accessible to both yourself and lifeforms living on your Star body, which includes creating new unique energy forms for your power systems. These power systems cannot exceed your own power.

If you have access to other abilities or energies, you can replicate them within your own power system.

Despite your near absolute control over your star body, when using your Astral body outside the hill sphere of your Star body, your abilities weaken to the point of only allowing you to reshape the physical surface of a continent at most.

Though with time and effort, you can gradually grow to manipulate the physical world on a larger scale or manipulate the local metaphysical world, even when in your Astral body.

As long as your Star body remains intact, you will not lose your ego even if your Astral body is destroyed, allowing you to simply reform it.

In essence, you are akin to a miniature Hegemony God within the limits of your own Star body.
addons.title: Hegemony Star

objects.text: As a Star Spirit, your physiology is fundamentally different from that of humans. You now possess two distinct physical forms—the Star Body and the Astral Body. The Star Body is often the celestial form of a star spirit, normally a planet, though some, like Mashyana, take on unique shapes like a gigantic world tree. The power of a Star Spirit correlates directly to the mass of their Star Body, amplifying their abilities proportionally. Conversely, the Astral Body, also known as their Soul Body, serves as the crystallized core of their ego and acts as a sensory interface for interacting with lesser lifeforms. While in this form, they lose their perception as a celestial entity but gain heightened power and command over their celestial body. You are an entity fundamentally tied to the fabric of the universe, wielding powers that transcend mortal comprehension. Your abilities stem from an essence of your choice, which reflects a specific concept or domain—whether it's despair, balance, or destruction. For example, Bushyasta, the Goddess of Nightmares, embodies despair and lethargy, and her power allowed her to turn her entire planet into a surreal nightmare, bending reality to reflect her inner nature. Rivers became poison, creatures morphed into abominations, and even time seemed to distort under her influence​. This is in effect a Commandment that is applied upon every individual that inhabits your celestial body, and is also similar to the effect of laws applied by the Hegemony Gods, only on a much more minuscule scale (your star body). Star Spirits also possess a heightened perception that transcends physical and metaphysical barriers. This allows you to detect threats, shifts in cosmic balance, or even manipulate conceptual forces. For example, Varhran’s uncanny ability to adapt and counter Montserrat’s foresight or endure Bushyasta’s nightmare manipulations reflects this elevated awareness​. This makes you not just a powerful fighter but also a precise and strategic force, capable of navigating the most complex cosmic conflicts.
objects.title: Star Spirit (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
You have ascended and transformed into a higher being, towering above mortals at a height of 8 to 10 feet or more. Instead of blood, your veins flow with pure, glowing liquid gold. As a god, you are superior to mortals in every way—physically, mentally, and spiritually. Your larger stature demands a more durable structure, making your body far tougher, more resilient, and significantly heavier than any human's. Your godly muscles allow you to move weights that mortals could never lift, with ease and effortless grace.

In this new divine state, you possess a "true form"—a metallic, humanoid, animal-like being. When in your true form, your powers increase exponentially, and you can shift between this form and a human guise at will. The transformation begins with a bright red glow, as you absorb energy from your surroundings before fully assuming your true form, which is even taller and more imposing than your base form.

Each god has a unique source of power, which amplifies their strength, speed, agility, and overall abilities. Once fully realized, this power source makes you exponentially stronger, granting you a unique power from it. However, if your power source is removed, you will be weakened, unable to transform into your true form, and rendered almost powerless. The appearance of a god's power source varies—it could take the form of crystals, objects, places, body parts, or even weapons. You have the freedom to choose what your power source will be. You can only have one power source.
objects.title: Egyptian Deity (Gods of Egypt)

addons.text: “To master technique is to master truth. To embody truth is to become the Dao.” You have come to realize that each technique in Kung Fu is not merely a tool for combat—it is an expression of the Dao, a physical verse in the ever-unfolding scripture of existence. As your path deepens, you no longer distinguish between martial motion and cosmic truth. Strikes become sutras. Footwork becomes meditation. Styles are not styles, but shapes the Dao takes in motion. Each of the ten thousand forms of Kung Fu reflects a unique principle of the universe: the ferocity of Tiger is the will to endure; the fluidity of Snake is the wisdom of adaptation; the grace of Crane is the serenity of vision. By internalizing these truths, you wield martial arts not to impose force, but to reveal harmony—to return imbalance to balance through perfect motion. As your mastery expands, you unlock Satori Forms—pure expressions of technique that resonate with the very fabric of existence. These allow you to manifest the essence of a form instantly, bypassing effort, embodying not the appearance of the movement but its meaning, in essence allowing you to ignore cause and effect, removing the cause and only having the effect. If you have also taken Dragon Warrior, your mastery ascends from divine reflection to direct creation. No longer do you interpret the ten thousand techniques—you originate them. Each new form you invent is an extension of the Dao itself, rippling outward to alter the world’s balance. Your self-belief harmonizes with universal truth, making you the author of a new martial canon. You move beyond emulation and enlightenment into a state of transcendent originality, where every thought becomes technique and every technique becomes truth.
addons.title: Wànshù Dào Zhǎn – The Ten Thousand Techniques of the Dao

objects.text:
Kung Fu is a profound Chinese martial art and philosophy originally developed by the legendary Master Oogway. It encompasses various fighting styles, each utilizing Chi to enhance physical techniques like striking, blocking, kicking, jumping, and throwing. Some forms even incorporate weaponry or natural defenses, such as fangs and claws. However, the heart of Kung Fu lies beyond combat—it is a path to "excellence of self." Mastery of Kung Fu requires not only physical prowess but also internal strength and wisdom.

At its core is the concept of "inner peace," an advanced state of being where one has reconciled with their own journey and struggles. By achieving inner peace, a warrior becomes attuned to the flow of the universe, gaining heightened awareness and control. This state can be reached through years of meditation, personal trials, or the endurance of great pain and suffering. You have attained this rare state of harmony and have mastered all known Kung Fu techniques and styles, embodying the true spirit of Kung Fu. In terms of talent and skill, you can match Tai Lung.
objects.title: Kung Fu (Kung Fu Panda)

objects.text:
It is said that the Valkyries shepherd the souls of warriors fallen in glorious battle, guiding them to Valhalla. These ethereal beings, are forged from the very essence of war itself. Yet, through the folly of the gods, most Valkyries were lost—vanished, save for ten of the most powerful. Nine of them were sealed away by the gods’ potent magic, trapped for what seemed an eternity. Until now. 

Former queen of the Valkyries, deemed it time to free her sisters from their ancient prison, lifting their curse and binding them to a mortal soul—that of a single human who might one day deliver them to freedom. That mortal is you.

Eight Valkyries are now tethered to you by the threads of life and death. You are their anchor, the reason they can traverse the Nine Realms, freely moving between the planes of reality. Simply by uttering their names, you may summon these mighty Valkyries to you, as they soar on wings of power, crossing worlds in an instant to reach your side. Bound to your soul, they are unfailingly loyal and dutiful, though there is one condition, you must allow them to fulfill their duty from time to time—of shepherding the souls of fallen warriors to the afterlife.

The honored names of the Valkyries who now serve you are,

Gunnr, Mistress of War
Geirdriful, Master of Arms
Eir, the Healer
Kara, the Wild Storm
Róta, Chooser of the Slain
Olrun, the Valkyrie Historian
Gondul, the Beautiful 
Hildr, Mistress of Battle

The power these Valkyries wield is beyond mortal comprehension. Even Gunnr, the weakest of her sisters, could challenge the god of war himself, giving him a battle to the death. Each Valkyrie holds a unique power, setting her apart from her sisters. Should one be defeated in battle, she may retreat within your soul, healing before she can be summoned again—after a span of 24 hours. Should you perish, the Valkyries would find themselves whisked away back to their harrowing prisons, forevermore.
objects.title: Ride Of The Valkyries (God Of War)

addons.text: Through overcoming emotional obstacles that are holding you back. You become capable of temporarily using your True Potential. When in use, your body glows and you're surrounded by the color of your element, capable of freely controlling and manipulating it, while also granting you access to powers thematically relevant to your element, like invulnerability for earth, flight for wind and teleportation for lightning. After unlocking your True Potential for the first time, your Elemental power will gain a permanent boost, increasing your capabilities to a new level. You can enter this temporary state only if you maintain your True Potential, with no emotional obstacles holding you back.
addons.title: True Potential

objects.text:
You're an Elemental Master, capable of wielding an Elemental power. You can create and manipulate your Element, as well as increase your control over it as well as its power through training. Some Elements like Metal, Form and Shadow only make their Master capable of changing their body into them. By conquering and controlling your fears, you become capable of summoning a dragon capable of flight and unleashing an Elemental breath, this dragon is the physical manifestation of your power. Though it will instantly vanish if you lose control over your fear. 

Elements include: Earth, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Amber, Balance, Figment, Fusion, Gravity, Heat, Light, Mind, Nature, Plants, Poison, Quake, Reflex, Shockwave, Size, Smoke, Sound, Speed, Surface Tension, Technology, Time, Water, Wind and others.
objects.title: Elemental Master (LEGO Ninjago)

objects.text: Most people are not afraid of being dead. People are afraid of dying. The pain, the things they’ll lose, the people they’ll lose. When you died, you called out, and IT answered. A Geist, a thing that lies between a Ghost and a minor god of death has taken the place your soul should be and brought you back, at a price. Sin-eaters, Bound, those who are attached to Geists have many abilities but all draw from the Geist attached to them. Sin-Eaters are natural mediums, able to see and touch ghosts as if they were any other person, extending to recognising other Bound or the similarly deathless. Similarly the Geist also renders them immune to possession. The Bound’s greatest natural ability, however, is their Immortality. Sin-Eaters can heal themselves using Ectoplasm, restoring them to full wellness near-instantly, but should they truly die, the Geist can resurrect them at the cost of some of the power in their bond, which the Bound will have to regain. Another cost of this resurrection is the immediate death of a nearby sentient being, which the Bound will experience as if it were their own. Additionally, if the Bound is killed in a way that mirrors their original death, they cannot be resurrected. Sin-Eaters possess natural ability in manipulating Plasm, the stuff of ghosts. This can be used not only to heal, but to warp the body, recreate destroyed objects, or a milieu of other esoteric effects, albeit these are learned skills. The vast majority of Bound’s first abilities mirror the deaths of themselves or their Geist. The power of a Sin-Eater is determined largely by the bond with their Geist, going from transactional during their initial resurrection to the most powerful Sin-Eaters to whom the Geist could be considered a close friend and ‘life partner’ so to speak. Geists often do not remember their own lives, and have become caricatures with only a single strong remembrance and trauma trigger to their name. A Sin-Eater may choose to unleash their geist temporarily, allowing it free rein to spew plasm and death-magics unto the world, at the cost of having no control over it and temporarily weakening their bond. Bound do not have it entirely easy, gaining Plasm can be a chore, either being produced in minor amounts ambiently in places of great death, able to be torn violently from ghosts, or left behind in vast quantities after a Ghost’s anchors leaving it in the physical have been resolved. A Bound must physically consume the plasm, be that eating, smoking, injecting, however they see fit, although they will derive more from it if it is thematic to their own deaths. Your Geist is a partner, and it can choose not to revive you as it sees fit, so best to stay on good terms.
objects.title: Stygia-Bound (Chronicles of Darkness - Geist: The Sin-Eaters)

addons.text: Unfortunately, you are not Arisen, but Deceived. Given an incomplete version of the Rite of Return. When you descend to the underworld, instead of a sedate journey, you’re rendered spiritual, and must flee from the Great Devourer who hungers for your soul. Should she catch you, you’ll suffer unbearable torment until your next return tot he land o the living,and the cycle begins again. Entirely and utterly conscious the entire time, the silver lining is that your memory no longer slowly returns when you awaken, being fully comprehending of your situation at all times.
addons.title: Decieved

addons.text: Thankfully, you’ve absorbed the teachings of the Heretic. As long as you remain at half of your strength, you only need to return to the underworld to fully return your power, able to stay awake and immortal as long as you wish. (though your Judge may attempt to force you to return should you displease it)
addons.title: Teachings of the Heretic

addons.text: Not only have you learnt form the Heretic, but built upon it, able to stay at your apex of power eternally, regardless of your need to return to the underworld, only returning at your own whim.
addons.title: Heir of the Heretic

objects.text: You are an Arisen, a servant of one of the 42 Judges of Irem. Within your Tomb, you awaken, the cult that naturally gathers while you sleep attends to you, and you minister to them in return. As a servant of the Judges, you exact their will. When you awaken, you possess no memory but the Judges command, but are at the apex of your might, capable of calling divine judgement or pulling the heavens from the skies. As you stay awake, your power diminishes, but your memory returns. By the time you know yourself, truly, you will be at your weakest, barely able to read the stars for the weather before you must return to sleep to start the cycle again. But such is the nature of things that your ‘rest’ is a true death, as you descend downwards to the underworld. As an Arisen, the Rite of Return has given you possession of true immortality. Your body will not age, but should your body be destroyed you will grow another from a jar containing your essence. And should they be destroyed, return from a cultist containing it. Every time you die, you undergo a harrowing journey through the land of the dead, where you will have to confront your actions in life. After you’re done with your journey, you can drink from the waters of life to dull your memories, and return to the land of the living. You can be awoken before your time in a variety of ways, ranging from your cultists performing certain rites to a certain strong emotion with resonance to you being felt within the radius of your resting place, or by celestial alignment. It is also worth noting your ‘wakings’ aren’t… Chronologically consistent. One may take you into the 21st century, while the next to you may well be in the eighth century, or the thirtieth. Similarly, you may be repeating certain lives at the whim of your Judge. The judges range from Usekh-Nemtet, who judges those who would seek eternal life, to The Eater of Entrails - Unem-Besek, who judges crimes against territory. At your strongest, newly awoken, you could easily contest an endbringer, but after two months it would be unlikely you could defeat even a moderately experienced fighter without preparation.
objects.title: The Right of Return (Chronicles of Darkness - Mummy: The Curse)

addons.text:
Power flows through your veins, but it doesn’t burn anymore. 

You’ve absorbed your Scars into yourself, rapidly increasing your rate of development and efficiency by harnessing your Scars for all the energy they’re worth. 

The greatest aspect of this, is the effect it has upon your End Stage. Your End Stage has become akin to a form you can activate, rapidly overclocking your powers without the risk of death. The only price being that your Variations cease working for 24 hours following the end of your End Stage.
addons.title: Metamorphosis

objects.text:
You are broken, disfigured, and your soul is warped and cracked.

This damage has given you incredible power, ‘Variations’, depending on how it broke. Rapid healing, electrokinesis, pheromone control and omnicompetence are all but examples of this power, with none precluding the others.

As a Remade, your powers may come from a variety of sources, with their only commonality in how they broke your soul. Esoteric energies that now infest your body, arcane artefacts, technological viruses, or even spiritually allergic reactions to any of these are mere examples, and shape the Variations you’d receive.

However, it comes at a great cost. The magnitude of your Variations you have posess an equal or greater severity of ‘Scars’, crippling drawbacks like paralysis, involuntary activations, chemical dependencies and more. Furthermore, the more you power grows the more Scars grow in concert.

Similarly, your powers are tied to your own mental stability, should you eventually reach the absolute breaking point, you enter into something known as ‘End Stage’. During ‘End Stage’, your powers break past their limits, reaching total apotheosis, but also rapidly deteriorating your body and soul. Within an hour of it's onset there will be nothing left of you. The only way to stop End Stage is to violently destroy a ‘worthy’ target of your spite, however you would define one.

Knowing this, knowing the absolute price of power. Would you still desire it?
objects.title: Remade (Chronicles of Darkness - Deviant: The Renegades)

addons.text: Your unparalleled might is an echo of Father Wolf, the great elder who could patrol all of Pangea and keep it’s gauntlet clear. As a result, all of your gifts from Luna are dramatically enhanced, not to mention your physical skills and might, enough to fell even the mightiest of spirits that try to break through the gauntlet. Just… try not to trust your children too much, eh?
addons.title: Father Wolf

objects.text:
Mother Luna weeps for her children. The pups who killed their Father Wolf.

Werewolves have one foot on either side of a boundary. The guards between the Spirit and Reality. Thus, it is their job to maintain that barrier, and their responsibility. To this end, their souls are both Wolf and Man.

The most notable ability of a werewolf is, naturally, the five forms of a wolf, each in varying phases of Man to Wolf. Hishu, the form of a normal human. Dalu, a near-human form that is both stronger and faster. Gauru, the War-form made to kill all that stands before it (Unfortunately, the War Form brings to the surface the dire rage within a Uratha, and they must actively try to contain their blood rage while within it). Urshul, a huge wolf-form of five foot at the shoulder for harrying prey. And Finally, Urhan, the form of a wolf, indistinguishable from a mundane wolf.

Usually, Uratha take roles within a pack and tribe, hunters, warriors, seers. Unfortunately, without access to a pack you’re left without guidance, and community. Thus, though you can walk many paths you’ll have to find the roads yourself as a Ghost Wolf. That said, all a Pack truly needs is a single Uratha to facilitate their connection to the Shadow, so forming one of your own is far from impossible, and is probably advised due to the resistance it gives packmates to the Frenzy normal mortals enter when seeing your Gauru form.

One of the abilities of the Uratha that a Tribe exists to aid is the usage of a Uratha’s spiritual essence to use the gifts of Mother Luna. With time and sight may you find these gifts yourself. Thankfully, the most natural one is the ability to see into Shadow, the realm of spirits so that you may confer with spirits as much as the material thus you can speak First Speech, like most Uratha to facilitate this.
objects.title: Uratha: Child of Luna (Chronicles of Darkness - Werewolf: The Forsaken)

addons.text:
You are more than a Beast. You’re an Insatiable, a Lamashtu. At the cost of a gnawing Hunger, you’re always at the pinnacle of your might. Your nightmares always act as if you’re starving, and your Atavisms always act as if you’re well fed. You prowl the dream with a practised ease known to few, but your greatest skill is that of corrupting a lair. 

You can corrupt and steal the chambers of another beast’s lair, stealing them for your own. Eventually, you could have an entire network of nightmarish locations held inside the Primordial Dream so huge and encompassing no hero could assail it all, and no beast ignore.
addons.title: The Insatiable Lamashtu

objects.text:
A great legendary Horror dredged itself from the astral sea of the primordial Dream that connected humanity, encircled you, and Devoured your soul and took it’s place, changing your life forever.

You have become a Beast, one of The Children of the Dark Mother representative of one of the primal fears of humanity; Hopelessness, Darkness, Exposure, etc. unfortunately, you also possess a Hunger, a compulsion you must indulge in order not to starve yourself or your Horror Hungers can include; Hoarding items, finding secrets, and simply physical violence, with a great deal more, but less common, all symbolising a fear of humanity. 

In addition to the unerring ability to identify other ‘monstrous’ kin, Beasts have access to three main powers; Nightmares, Atavisms, and their Lair.

Nightmares are delusions Beasts are able to force onto people by speaking to them. While developing them often requires some fear or truth of humanity as a core, they can take many forms and have many effects, such as the otherworldly sickness created by ‘Bugs Everywhere’ or the mind rending anxiety of ‘Your Teeth Are Falling Out’. 

Atavisms, by contrast, are layering the Dream over your real self, allowing you to bring a fragment of your Horror into reality for a time. Be it the incredible strength of a cyclops, or the wisdom of the depths. These are dependent upon what your Horror is, as it needs the trait you’re pulling through. The one thing Atavisms cannot do is directly control someone’s mind.

The Lair is the ultimate expression of a Beast. The Lair is composed of various Chambers resonant to the Beast’s Horror, be that a labyrinth of blades for a minotaur or a frigid and exposed wasteland for a Yheti, all housed within the Primordial Dream itself. As a beast grows in power they can add more chambers into their Lair, each resembling a place of trauma or great fear. A beast can use this resemblance to enter their lair physically as long as they are somewhere that has a similar resonance. Similarly, they can use humans that they have used to indulge their Hunger at the cost of some energy. They can also ‘hold the door’ for others to follow, or use the lair as a ‘skeleton key’ to other supernatural realms touched by the Primordial Dream as long as they know the location of a gateway.

As you feed your hunger, you can grow sated, allowing you to empower your Lair with greater ease, but should you eat too much you will merely cause your Horror to slumber, removing access to your Nightmares. Similarly, depriving yourself can cause the horror to grow more powerful, in turn empowering your Atavisms in order to sate your Hunger. Should your hunger grow ravenous, however, you will lose your Horror’s powers, your wounds will fester, and you will require a true feast of your Hunger in order to return to some semblance of normalcy.

Beasts can live up to five hundred and eighty years if they grow strong enough, causing many to live solitary existences. Beasts can cause other Beasts to develop by drawing a Horror out of the depths and kickstarting their Devouring. But would you really devour someone’s soul just for company?
objects.title: The Wonderful Feeling of Being Devoured (Chronicles of Darkness - Beast: The Primordial)

objects.text:
You have been granted a boon in a moment of crisis by the Heralds, Imbuing you with the power you needed to face the terrors of the night.

Your Conviction gives you several abilities. You have a Second Sight, allowing you to see those things which conceal themselves from normal sight, like ghosts, spirits possessing human beings, who is or isn't a Mage, Vampire, or anything else "not normal", as well as letting you see through illusions. You can also use it to no sell Master/Stranger powers, to improve your Edges even further, or to improve your Virtues.

On the subject of Edges and Virtues; having especially strong "Virtues", namely Mercy, Vision, or Zeal, allows you to gain correspondingly strong Edges, little supernatural advantages that let you triumph over beings that could normally slaughter one hundred of you without breaking a sweat. This can include infusing your weapons with power, making the supernatural take damage if they get too close, making yourself seem like the embodiment of innocence so that your prey can't bring themselves to hurt you, preventing the use of supernatural attacks or methods of escape in your presence, discovering weaknesses by simply viewing a target, and so on.

You may also gain the more mundane Edges found in the non-Imbued "witch-hunters", such as being able to improvise tools from the environment, always seeming to have a vehicle on hand, having access to unusual weapons, or things of that sort.
objects.title: Imbued (World Of Darkness - Hunter: The Reckoning)

addons.text:
You are no longer a mere Demon, stripped of your divine grace and forced to subsist on the scraps of mortals, for your old power has been restored to you. You are now once again an Elohim, one of the angels who shaped creation.

Your power waxes to a higher point than that of even the most ambitious Demons, as your body is fully made of Faith, and you yourself are a nigh-infinite wellspring of it. You may spent a point of Faith to 10x the size of any of your powers that have a range of effect, you can return from having perished at the dawn of the next day, you may always be in your Apocalyptic Form unless you choose not to be, you have permanently maxed Willpower, and you cannot gain Torment.
addons.title: Elohim

objects.text:
"O sun, to tell thee how I hate thy beams, That bring to my remembrance from what state I fell; how glorious once above thy sphere; Till pride and worse ambition threw me down, Warring in heaven against heaven’s matchless King."
-Lucifer, Milton's 'Paradise Lost'

You are now one of Heaven's Fallen Angels, an Elohim that sided with Lucifer during the War In Heaven, hoping to prevent the unspecified disaster foreseen by Ahrimal. When the Tower Of Babel was destroyed you were cast into the Abyss with your compatriots, stewing in your own anger for millennia.

After the Week Of Nightmares, however, the seals have weakened. You are free once again, ready to interfere in the Final Nights just as you interfered with mankind in their infancy.

As a former angel you have the power of "Lores", special knowledge and abilities granted to specific hosts of angels according to their roles and duties, allowing them to "evoke" fundamental concepts of reality into effects. Normally, specific Lores would be kept within a particular host, but this was a matter of custom rather than a hard rule, meaning that there is nothing actually preventing you from learning Lores outside your purview. The known Lores include Fundament, Humanity, Celestials, Flame, Radiance, Awakening, Firmament, Winds, Earth, Paths, Forge, Light, Patterns, Portals, Longing, Storms, Transfiguration, Beast, Flesh, Wild, Death, Spirit, & Realms, as well as the corrupt Lores of Chaos, Contamination, & Violation.

You also have the power to possess others (though you can count as "possessing" your old self if you wish), the power to use the "Faith" of mortals to achieve various effects (either by sincere prayer or through contracts), your "Torment" which effects whether your powers are expressed in a positive or negative way, your "Apocalyptic Form" which reveals you in your full angelic or demonic glory, grants you immunity to mundane sources of damage, and other abilities depending on the Lores you know. Even in your human form and without spending any of your all powerful Faith, you have immunity to mind control or possession, the ability to see through illusions, immunity to disease, poison, and decay, superhuman strength, a sixth sense for the supernatural, the ability to telepathically speak to any other angel or demon you know the name of, super-healing, forcing others to worship you, and the ability to forcibly make weaker demons your servants.
objects.title: To Reign In Hell (World Of Darkness - Demon: The Fallen)

addons.text:
Child of Luna, Child of Gaia. Uratha Garou. Your Dual nature has given you malformed and maladaptive abilities similar to that of Father Wolf’s eldest, the Geryo. 

The first of these is  the ability to layer your forms. For instance; a Homid form of the Garou suddenly wracked as the Uratha war-form’s arms tear from it’s back to act independently, the Hishu of the Uratha sprouting from the neck of a Hispo Garou’s neck akin to a hideous centaur, and stranger things besides. 

Secondly, your understanding both the physical and spiritual arts of shape-changing allows you to adapt and simulate the abilities of forms of other changing breeds that you yourself are not and spirit-wracked, albeit twisted to fit the wolf’s form. These include small packs of wolves aping an Anansi spider-shifter’s Crawlerling or thick furs approximating the carapace of an Alaghidim crab host.
addons.title: An Apocalypse Forsaken

addons.text: Your nature as a Sleigh Beggy naturally draws the attention and generosity of the spirits, inclining them to teach you Gifts regardless of which tribe you may hail from. With enough time, effort and luck, you may well end up learning the Gifts of not just all tribes and breeds, but even those of the other fera races, so long as you can find a spirit you can convince to teach them.
addons.title: Collector of Gifts

addons.text: You have aligned yourself with Pentex and, by extension, the Wyrm. This has left its marks on you, cutting you off from Gaia and the spirits aligned with her. But where one door closes, another opens, and you can now learn Gifts from Banes, Wyrm-aligned spirits. Whichever breed of Fera you chose to become, you are now its Wyrm-tainted version (Garous become Black Spiral Dancers, Bastet become Hellcats, Corax become Buzzards, etc.). You can also choose to become a Mockery Breed such as a Samsa, Kerasi, or Yeren.
addons.title: Wyrmfallen (World of Darkness - Werewolf: The Apocalypse)

addons.text: Your abilities as the Avatar of All Fauna has mixed with your nature as a Fera, turning you into the Most Blessed Child of Gaia. You are able to shift not just into the form of every animal, but also become every race of Fera, inheriting their instincts and natural gifts, such as the Guhrals' control over their biorythm or the Mokolés' racial memory called Mnesis. You can also turn into extinct races lost in the War of Rage such as the Apis or Grondr, the Changing Breeds of Chronicles of Darkness like the Land Titans or Royal Apes, or become a completely new Fera based on any other animal on Earth. With practice you can even learn to reach back into the depths of your mental catalog to turn into one of the Lizard Kings that went extinct long before mammals became the dominant species.
addons.title: Most Blessed Child of Gaia

addons.text:
Ordinarily, when one of the Fera receives the embrace of Cain, the best-case scenario is instant death. If not, then they would be left a feral husk, losing their connection to the Umbra and Gaia.

Your transformation was much smoother though. You fully retain all Fera abilities, including Gifts and regeneration. You are even able to use the abilities of one to resist the weaknesses of the other. Your Fera toughness keeps you barely alive in the sun, and your vitae-based healing is effective on silver wounds.

Even though you are still capable of bargaining with spirits, most non-corrupt ones will shun you. However, through the power of Koldunic Blood Sorcery, you can enthrall spirits in the same manner you would mortals, addicting them to your Vitae. This would slowly corrupt the spirit to serve your bidding.

Due to your natural abilities as a Fera, you start with the vampiric disciplines Potence, Fortitude, and Animalism at levels only surpassed by elders. These are further boosted when in Warform.

Lastly, your Rage has been heightened to nigh unprecedented levels thanks to the presence of the Beast in your soul; you must take great care when both feeding and entering into Crinos, lest you go on a bloodthirsty rampage.
addons.title: Apex Abomination

objects.text:
You have been blessed by Gaia and reborn as one of the Fera—shapeshifters bound to the natural world as its guardians and stewards. Your tribe defines the spirit animal within you, shaping both your path and the forms you can assume. Alongside these forms, you wield Gifts—supernatural blessings bestowed by spirits, offering you many powerful and varied abilities. Though you begin with only Rank 1 Gifts, as your renown grows in the spirit world, far greater powers will soon answer your call.

These Gifts are fueled by Gnosis, which is your link to the spirit world. The stronger your connection, the easier it becomes to commune with spirits and cross into the Umbra—the spiritual realm shaped by belief, thoughts, and memories. The veil between worlds, known as the Gauntlet, is thinnest where nature thrives, thus allowing you to step through with ease in those areas.

But within you also burns Rage, a primal force that enhances your physical might. It lets you move with blinding speed, recover from mortal wounds, and tear through enemies like a force of nature. Yet Rage is volatile, clouding your judgment and threatening to consume you in berserk fury when pushed too far.

You are a being of many forms, shifting between them as instinct or strategy demands. But it is the war-form that is most feared. Towering and monstrous, a perfect fusion of man and beast—this shape grants you terrifying strength and resilience.

You become a living weapon, capable of taking on war machines and walking away triumphant, your body regenerating injuries at a supernatural rate—torn flesh knitting, shattered bones re-forming in moments. Your mere presence in this form triggers the Delirium, an ancient terror in the human subconscious, born from ancestral memory, driving mortals to madness or blind denial. Other supernatural beings, however, remain unaffected.
objects.title: Fera (World of Darkness - Werewolf: The Apocalypse)

addons.text:
Now, you are no longer just a Fae soul placed within a human. Instead, you are shaped to be the perfect vessel for that soul. Your true appearance in both the mundane world and the Dreaming/Hedge is the truest manifestation of your Fae nature, though you can easily Mask this from mortal eyes.

Additionally, now that the Dreaming and the Hedge are considered the same for you, you can freely enter it from just about anywhere, unless chained by cold iron. Thanks to this fact, you almost always have easy access to Glamour, though if you want some of a specific variety, you may need to seek out specific mortals.

Lastly, with time and practice, you can learn to reshape yourself, both Seeming and Kith, though it’s much easier if the change is between two Kiths that share theming, like Trolls and Clurichauns shared love of fighting.
addons.title: Fae Embodied

addons.text:
Mundane mist, as found in the ordinary, mortal world, arises when warm, moist air meets cold, deep waters. The Mist of the Supernatural variety, as found in both The Dreaming, and the world of Percy Jackson, also forms from the meeting of two opposites. The forces of Glamour and Belief vs the forces of Banality and Disbelief. 

Your natural ability to shape the Mist means that not only can you directly generate it from the overlap between your human and Fae souls, you can also do the reverse, splitting it into its two components. This lets you use the Mist as a direct weapon against creatures that, like yourself, survive on the belief and imagination of mortals. It can also let you gain Glamour from mortals seeing you use your magics, or even just seeing your Fae Mien. Though care would have to be taken to dispose of the excess Banality. 

With time and practice you can use Glamour, The Mist, and Banality separately, or together, to produce supernatural effects. Though Banality would be of most use in countering other magics, it could even be concentrated and used on mortals, inducing despair or weariness.
addons.title: Mist of the Dreaming

addons.text: Ah, children, the Fae have always had a special place in their hearts for the young. With their vivid imagination, and unrestrained emotions they are an immense source of Glamour. With your nigh unlimited sense of childish wonder and adventurousness your human half produces essentially endless Glamour. So much so, that it begins to spill out. Overtime, the area around you will become more and more close to the Dreaming, becoming less subject to the laws of physics, and more subject to the effects of human thought. People will find their movements quieted by exaggeratedly tiptoeing, vehicles with flame decals move faster, and things like cold or shadow become their own phenomenon rather than just absences. While these typically start eroding on their own after you leave, with the Banality and Glamour of the surrounding world achieving equilibrium, if you stay long enough, and increasingly emotionally invested in a location, it might become a Freehold, a place where the mundane world and the Dreaming become one and the same. A similar process occurs towards the people and objects in your life. Objects take one supernatural enhancements to become Treasures, able to be wielded by anyone who produces sufficient Glamour. The people become Kinain, able to wield weak Cantrips of their own, though without the weakness to Banality that ordinary Changelings have.
addons.title: Well of Glamour

objects.text:
There was once a world full of dreams. Glamour, the raw energy of imagination, emotions and dreams, flowed freely throughout the world. The Dreaming,a reality formed from emotions and the unconscious, was so close to the “real world” that the two were near and the same. Fae, beings of living Glamour thrived in endless variety. From the stately and noble Sidhe, boisterous Clurichauns, wandering Eshu, and many other Kith developed from the myths and legends of humanity. 

Alas, this would not last. Mankind would begin to study and catalogue the world around them, their cities would grow and swell, but there were less and less dreamers in the world. This would lead to a loss of Glamour, and a growth of Banality, its opposite, made from weariness and disbelief, thus deadly to the Fae.

To escape this, many had to undergo the Changeling Way, placing their souls into humans, as a way to shield themselves from Banality. And it seems you are one of these Changelings of the Kith of your choice.

As a Changeling you, or at least the Fae portion of you, has the ability to reincarnate. Your new incarnation will gain much of your personality, and a small portion of memories, enough that people who knew you in a previous life would find you somewhat familiar.

The second, greater gift given to the children of the Dreaming, are Cantrips, a form of magic powered by Glamour. Each Cantrip consists of a Realm, which controls what you can effect, and consist of Fae, Nature, Actor (non fae intelligent beings), Prop (created objects), Scene (spacial area) and Time. Arts determine a wide array of what effects can be induced, and include Contract, Naming, Metamorphosis, Soothsay, and much much more.

To fuel both your cantrips, and even your existence as a Changeling, you must harvest Glamour. This can be done in many ways, with the easiest being entering the Dreaming, in other settings this may be any dream or fae based realms. The more common method of harvesting is through inspiring human emotions and endeavors. This can be done in a sustainable, conservationist manner, where you slowly cultivate mortals, skimming a little bit of Glamour off the top. Glamour can also be harvested in a destructive manner, where you inject existing Glamour into a mortal, forcing them into a furious mania, producing insane amounts of Glamour, this does burn out the mortal completely, losing their creativity and drive. Lastly you can cultivate Glamour from your human half, striking a careful balance of production and consumption.

Just as you try to accumulate Glamour, you must avoid Banality. With the more Banality you gain, the less of your magic you can work, and with too much, your Changeling soul will be rendered dormant. Different Changelings find different things Banal to them, though there are some universalities. Flat out disbelief will always add Banality, but beyond that it is more or less what the changeling finds boring or depressing.
objects.title: Kithain (World of Darkness - Changeling: The Dreaming)

objects.text:
You are an Amenti, a new form of Mummy created using a refined Spell of Life, working as agents of balance with the power of Hekau magic.

Amentis are created from the merging of two souls. The powerful Tem-Akh, born from an ancient Egyptian Spirit, and a dying Nehem-Sen, who is offered a chance for ressurection. Once they finish a trial involving trying to reach the Lands of Faith within 70 days, the Nehem-Sen is judged. If they succeed, they are given this new life, fully merged and becoming a brand new being, strong in what their previous life lacks.

As an Amenti, your Hekau magic manifests into six paths. Each path having a specialization depending on what type of Amenti you are, which is determined by your weakness in life. These are:

The Tomb Watchers, who were born from formerly self destructive individuals. They specialize in Amulets, the art of crafting charms which could protect others.

The Scroll Bearers who were once ruled by blind obedience, now masters of Alchemy, which is the creation of potions that enhances the body.

The Night Suns who were once cheats and liars, now seeking to redeem themselves through Celestial power, which grants them control over probability and natural forces.

The Spirit Scepters who once lived selfish lives, now becoming masters of Effigy making, which are relics that come to life to serve them.

The Unbandaged Ones who were once unassertive, now becoming aggressive enforcers of balance with master over Necromancy, the magic of the dead.

And finally, the Judged Ones, the ones whom don't at first succeed the judgement and are given a second chance, gaining no memory or guidance from their previous life, but are bestowed the freedom to master any path of the Hekau, including Nomenclature, which is the power of healing and creation.

Regardless of what you are, you are now given this new immortal life so you may be able to make up for the mistakes of your previous ones. You are now a balanced soul, getting super therapy from the afterlife, and empowered with old Egyptian magic coming from Osiris himself. You are the closest thing to World of Darkness' superhero. So now, with this new begining, shall you use this power for the good of humanity? Or will you choose to keep living selfishly, and embrace this second chance like you haven't lived your life to the fullest?

After all, a Mummy experiences life even more vibrantly than any other creature. The world is far more beautiful now, colorful and delicious. So why not enjoy it?
objects.title: Amenti (World of Darkness - Mummy: The Ressurection)
Part of the Winning Team! (World of Darkness: Possessed)
objects.text: There is a hollow feeling somewhere inside you. Perhaps it is in your chest, behind your eyes, or somewhere deeper than flesh could ever reach. You can feel something else moving whenever you think, whenever you breathe, whenever you become angry. Congrats are in order. You've become Fomori. For starters, the nature of your transformation depends heavily upon the Bane that has taken root within you, the circumstances surrounding your possession, and the weaknesses within your own soul that allowed it to enter. For instance, some become grotesque physical monsters, only seeking to murder and despoil and destroy all around them. Others remain almost perfectly human, seeking to Entice and enthrall others into doing horrific actions and further spreading the corruption of the Wyrm. Either way, you are no longer just yourself, but a host to a parasite. As a Fomori, you gain access to supernatural Powers representing the effects of your possession, manifesting (usually) as something horrific, disgusting, or generally just evil. Such as your body gaining Beastial Mutations that drastically increase your physical attributes in exchange for making you look like a monster, to gaining an aura that makes you look like the perfect "mate" to all who look at you (And thus, being FAR more eager to help and assist you), to even being able to transmute someone's flesh into random, rancid trash upon physical contact with them, all relating to the thing inside you. However, while you are indeed "Gifted" with Great and terrible power, your will is now no longer entirely your own. You'll find yourself doing and saying things that you wouldn't have done before you became Possessed, as the Bane slowly guides you into further and further corruption in service to the Wyrm. You may even choose to surrender parts of your Autonomy in exchange for more Wyrm-Tainted "Gifts", but be careful to not fully give in, as then the Bane would be in control over your body, not you. (You may also choose NOT to do an incredibly stupid act such as surrendering parts of your free will in exchange for gaining a mutation/whatever-the-fuck the Bane inside of you chooses to do to your body/mind/shattered soul in order to "make room" for your new power. There is a limit to this, that being what you can take, but I believe in you, Champ!) Always remember. You are a Slave to Darkness, not a Servant to it. Not yet, at least.

addons.text:
Even after your ascension, your soul continues to constantly evolve to new heights. As such, it now naturally generates a transcendental energy of higher quality than anything you can naturally encounter in any world, with every energy source within you subsumed into one pool.

This transcendental energy can be used as a substitute for any other form of supernatural energy, such as mana, chakra, psionic energy, and so on, allowing you to directly interfere with any supernatural system. Moreover, with transcendent energy being inherently of higher quality, all of your spells, abilities, etc. that utilise it will become exponentially more potent, and any usage of this energy becomes completely undetectable to those who did not reach similar levels of strength and enlightenment.

With your knowledge, you can effortlessly interfere with the spells and abilities of your adversaries, cancelling, hijacking, reverse-engineering, and even improving upon them.
addons.title: Transcendental Soul

addons.text:
You have attained not only complete understanding, but also effortless mastery of the principles underlying your powers—and, by extension, nearly any phenomenon you encounter. Where others see “mystery,” you acquire structured, academic comprehension: the fundamental mechanics, the terminology, the models, and the hidden assumptions that make the unnatural behave as if it were simply another law of nature.

With a single look, an esper ability becomes legible. You can identify the theories behind it, the scientific principles it leans on, and the critical factors that shape its expression. A brief glimpse of a magical ritual is enough to unfold its entire logic in your mind—from its rudimentary foundations to its most advanced refinements—revealing how it was developed, what rules it obeys, and why it works the way it does.

More than mere insight, this knowledge is usable. You can translate incomprehensible knowledge into lessons, guiding others through concepts that would normally take years to grasp. Armed with transcendental intuition and an ever-growing library of esoteric understanding, you become a teacher unlike any other—one who can instruct from experience, explain with precision, and elevate students or civilizations to heights they never imagined.
addons.title: Theorem of the Unknown

objects.text:
You have crossed the abyss of Da'at, a void that binds all of the Sephirot. Thus, you have stepped into the Territory of God, obtaining Daʻat Elyon, Higher Knowledge on the workings of the universe. Rather than getting encyclopedic knowledge of every technique or spell, this gives you an intuitive understanding of the underlying principles of both natural and supernatural parts of the world.

With but a glance, you can comprehend how powers, spells, and even basic energies interact and function at their most fundamental level, allowing you to interfere with the inner workings of those phenomena. Potentially, you will be capable of such feats as fundamentally changing the cosmology of the universe itself, albeit it will take a great deal of preparation.

As you see the truth of the world, you are unaffected by the changes to reality and timelines. While your perceived history may change, your true self can never be rewritten, even if someone recreates a universe dozens of times over.

Finally, this newfound knowledge also extends to your own powers.
