You start with complete mastery over every single aspect of the powers currently available to you, thus obtaining an unshakable foundation which you can freely improve upon, easily incorporating newly encountered phenomena and principles into your powers, or developing entirely new aspects from scratch.

This also puts you and your powers on a fundamentally higher level of existence, with those who have not stepped into the Abyss being inherently lower than you on a cosmic hierarchy. Your abilities are now beyond the reach of such beings; thus, they cannot tamper with or otherwise affect them, and any attempts to resist your powers will be much less effective.

Do note that you can still be overwhelmed by sheer firepower, although somebody who has not crossed the Abyss like you or achieved a similar state will need to be at least multiple orders of magnitude stronger than you to even begin to contend with you.
objects.title: Across the Abyss (Raildex)

objects.text:
You’re dead. You should have ended up in a school shaped afterlife to make peace with your death and move on, this didn't happen. But don’t worry; you’re definitely still dead.

Though you appear human and can bleed, as a soul, you cannot die again. Any wounds will heal in under an hour, and “fatal” injuries only knock you out briefly. You don’t need to eat or breathe, though you can still feel hunger and even gain or lose weight. As a unique benefit, you can shape dirt into anything—clothes, weapons, food, or even electronics—if you understand how to create each part of what you're making.

You also have Guard Skills granted by the Angel Player, abilities that grant you supernatural powers but require vocal activation:

Hand Sonic: Summons a weapon or dual-wielding weapons, with forms that vary with practice. They're strong enough to slice through steel.

Distortion: Creates an invisible shield that deflects projectiles but doesn’t block melee attacks. You must deactivate it to engage in combat.

Delay: Produces an after-image where you just stood, useful for dodging melee attacks.

Harmonics: Creates a clone with its own consciousness and all your abilities, including Harmonics. Its personality mirrors your emotion at its creation and may go rogue depending on your mood.

Absorb: Merges clones back into you, though it’s risky due to their independent consciousness. This activates automatically after a few hours unless stopped.

Angel Wings: Sprouts wings from your back to slow your descent.

Howling: Emits a high-frequency sound from crossed Hand Sonic weapons, can make everyone nearby faint.

Overdrive: Passively grants superhuman strength, enabling you to lift up to 10 tons and throw it several stories.

Sonic Rotation: A silent skill that activates with Hand Sonic, enveloping you in a blue aura and spinning at superhuman speed to destroy everything within range.
objects.title: Angel Player (Angel Beats)

addons.text:
The mixing of your primate based mystical energies has granted you a new level of understanding. Firstly, this union grants you mastery of the skills of Veron Mystics masters of Power Primate, such skills are levitation, telekinesis, telepathy, phasing, invisibility, using the Monkey Psychic Scream without issue, and keeping one’s spirit in the world even after their body had been destroyed.

Secondly, you gain the knowledge necessary to create Mystic Monkey Artifacts, such as a staff that grants its wielder monkey traits or a sword that changes its form to match the wielder’s needs and desires such as into a phone.
addons.title: Primate Knowledge

addons.text: The Power Primate has drawn upon your M-Base causing your raw power to skyrocket. Your base form’s raw power is now equal to lesser titans in terms of strength, durability, and firepower; Whilst when you use the Power Primate Aura your power would rival that of Kong and other Alpha Titans. You can even make your Power Primate Aura grow to the same size as Kong. On top of this raw power boost the psychic and instinctive nature of the Power Primate has made wielding your Keizer Energy far more instinctive, reducing the effort required to become a Keizer.
addons.title: Titanus Primate

addons.text:
Your Power Primate, Mystical Monkey Power, and Keizer Energy have merged into a singular immensely powerful form. Now in your base form your abilities would be equal to those found in Alpha Titans. Your Power Primate Aura now raises your raw power to the level seen with Keizer energy infused Alpha Titans granting you the power to perform feats like launching daikaiju hundreds of meters into the air with a throw, energy blasts that reach into space, and being unaffected by direct meteor impacts. As a side note the appearance of your Power Primate Aura has also changed, gaining a blue back and prehensile tail, and golden crackling energy across the form.

Also may optionally choose to possess primate characteristics such as a tail, elongated fangs, or even fur.
addons.title: Primate King

objects.text:
You have formed a connection to the mystical entity known as the Power Primate. 

This connection has unlocked your Inner Primate and granted several abilities.

Firstly, you have gained superhuman capabilities, making it incredibly strong and durable as well as heal at an accelerated rate. You are strong enough to shatter stone and tear through metal with your blows, durable enough to endure the blows of those just as strong as yourself, and can recover non-fatal wounds after just a night's rest.

Next, on top of your superhuman physical you have also gained Electrokinesis, Monkey Mind Scream, Inner Primate. 

Electrokinesis primarily takes the form of channeling electricity into your blows to enhance them. Alternatively it can be focused into an explosive bolt of lighting to be thrown. 
Monkey Mind Scream is a psychic energy shriek that stuns and disorients those struck by it. Although it is initially exhausting to use, requiring time to master.
Inner Primate is a green energy that can be used to fire blasts of energy, envelope the body to enhance it, form a force-field in the shape of a green gorilla, and create Power Primate Aura. The Power Primate Aura being the full power of the Power Primate, enveloping you in a colossal green aura in the form a giant gorilla, making you powerful enough to create shockwaves with your blows, sending giant foes flying, and tear apart foes that would be unharmed by your normal forms strikes.
objects.title: Power Primate (SRMTHFG)

objects.text:
You have been imbued with the energy known as Mystical Monkey Power.

This imbuement has granted instinctive knowledge of the martial art Tai Shing Pek Kwar, as well as superhuman strength.

Initially you would be strong enough to knock down large stone statues, create small shockwaves, and crack boulders. Your instinctive knowledge would allow you to temporarily match a master of Tai Shing Pek Kwar.

Upon learning how to properly wield the Mystical Monkey Power you become enveloped in a blue aura that flashes as a blue monkey with your blows and guards. Your strength will be great enough to allow you to perform feats such as tossing your foes half-a-mile into the air, and overcoming experienced warriors.
objects.title: Mystical Monkey Power (Kim Possible)

objects.text:
Xiao Hei is a prideful and mischievous golden finger who enjoys teasing his host. Despite his playful antics, he is highly reliable when needed. You can communicate with Xiao Hei either verbally or mentally. His primary ability lies in the creation of various cards, with his specialty being "monster cards," which are made by breaking down the flesh and soul of defeated enemies and converting them into particles that can be transformed into cards. Each kill has a chance of producing these cards, and the stronger the enemy, the higher the quality and quantity of the cards. The first time you kill a monster you get 100% chance of dropping that monster's card.

The cards Xiao Hei creates are organized by levels and rarity. Levels correspond to a cultivator's realms, while rarity determines the monster's strength and purity of its bloodline. Monsters summoned from these cards will always be one realm higher than your current level, but if they grow too powerful—reaching two or three realms above you—their cards become temporarily unusable until your strength catches up. Unlike Lin Huang, who could initially summon only one monster at a time, you can summon up to ten monsters simultaneously.

In addition to monster cards, Xiao Hei can generate a variety of other useful cards. These include healing cards, annihilation cards that can instantly kill a set number of enemies, epiphany cards that greatly enhance progress in training or problem-solving, and skill cards that allow you to copy and permanently use one of your monsters' abilities. He can also create rarity-increasing cards, sealing cards to capture monsters without killing them (though there is a risk of rebellion after sealing if their power is way above yours), and transformation cards that let you temporarily take on the form and powers of one of your monsters.

In this version, Xiao Hei is directly linked to your personal strength. As you grow stronger, Xiao Hei can evolve, becoming a 2-star golden finger and beyond, unlocking even more functions and card types.

Beyond Xiao Hei's abilities, you gain access to the power system of the world you travel to, as well as the supreme genius talent level of Lin Huang. This talent allows you to accomplish extraordinary feats, such as challenging and defeating every ranked opponent in a virtual world without losing, despite being many ranks weaker, creating a new rune language on the spot with an epiphany card, or even becoming the successor of a long-deceased swordsman who surpassed even gods, after singlehandedly defeating all of his disciples.

Note: In essence, the monsters' power scale relative to you. If you're strong enough to destroy a skyscraper, monsters one realm higher could destroy a city, while those two realms higher could destroy a country.
objects.title: Xiao Hei (Monster Paradise)

addons.text: As a god with the ability to unlock and lock anything you can imagine, you inherit the powers and ability of Okina Matara, a secret god and one of the Sages of Gensokyo. You now gain the ability to create and open a door on the backs of anything, even living beings, you also obtain the ability to manipulate life energy and mental energy. Through your ability to open doors on the backs of everything, you can teleport through these doors, through this, you are able to open up a special dimension known as the Land of the Back Door. Through this special dimension you can access all of the doors at once, you can also bring others into this special dimension through one of your doors. Without your permission, nobody can access or use these doors. In extension, by opening up the door on the back of a living being, you are able to take away their life energy, killing them, or you can pour life energy into them through the door, enhancing and strengthening them. You can also take control of seasonal energy, and can manipulate the seasons. You can also manipulate mental energy, allowing you to influence the minds of others. Also, you now obtain stars, noh, silkworm breeding, hindrances, discriminated peoples, and the Earth as avenues of faith.
addons.title: Matara-jin

addons.text:
Your powers as a god, and your ability to attract the obsession of the celestial objects have fused. Now, not only do you inherit the powers and ability of Hecatia Lapislazuli, obtaining the ability to exist on Earth, the Moon, and Otherworlds, and each of their respective hells all at once with with different bodies, but now, the attention you receive from the celestial spheres is also valid as faith, tremendously strengthening the power that you are able to manifest as a god. 

If a world previously didn't have a hell, then you are able to manifest a hell for that world. Also, as part of the manifestation of your power, you are able to integrate elements of hell into your surroundings, not just this, but your celestial patron can now manifest along with you strengthening the divinity and power you express. The dream world also falls under the category of Otherworlds. You also now obtain hell as an avenue of faith.

However, you aren't just affected one-sidedly, now, through your connection with the planetary body, your planetary body also takes on aspects of hell, however, the elements it integrates depends on the planetary body in question. For example; a planet like Venus with the an aspect of love and femininity would take on elements of the blood pool hell or the hell of barren woman from buddhism.
addons.title: Hell God

addons.text:
As a god with the ability to create dolls, you now inherit the powers and ability of Keiki Haniyasushin. You obtain the ability to craft idols using soil and water. 

You are able to craft idols and can animate them by directing faith into them. These idols do not possess flesh, desire, or a soul in a conventional way. Each idol you create becomes inhabited by a life, by a spirit. The forms your idols can take are often associated with burials from the kofun period of japan. Other than a humanoid form like Haniwa, your idols can also take the form of bronze bells, mirrors, swords, and magatama. Your idols and craftsmanship can also act as your avenue of faith.
addons.title: Haniyasu

objects.text:
You are now "born" as a god, obtaining a godhood that requires faith as sustenance. If you previously had a physical body, your physical body is now part of your spirit, the 'you', that's part of you; like a limb; an extension of you, that's now a god. 

'You' are able to manifest your power wherever faith towards 'you' exist, and 'you' can split your spirit to manifest in multiple locations at the same time, this doesn't diminish your power in any way, as each split part of 'you' would have the same amount of power as the original 'you'. Not just this, but 'you' are also capable of entering the bodies of your believers, manifesting your power through them. 

'You' do not consume faith to manifest your power, however if you lose faith, then the power that 'you' can manifest becomes weaker, and if 'you' no longer have faith, then the god part of you becomes dormant, unable to manifest any power, however you can still recover as long as you receive faith again.

Your faith comes from your domain as a god, your avenue of faith, however, the avenues 'you' control is fluid, and 'you' can change the avenues you obtain faith from easily, like changing from a god of rivers to a god of technology, though not just this as 'you' can also obtain more avenues as 'you' continue to exist. 

Faith is a reverence towards existence, a fear of retribution for one's actions, and the will to enrich one's life, spirit, and body, but it doesn't really have to be that serious. Worship and faith can be as simple as just celebrating with 'you'. Faith from any beings with human-like sentience is valid. In some modern societies, many people place faith on friendships and news, both which are potential avenues of faith for 'you'.
objects.title: Divine Spirit (Touhou Project)

addons.text:
Your divine heritage elevates your mastery of Iddhi far beyond that of other Incarnations. Born with the blood of the gods, you begin your journey with innate access to fully realized divine forms, each a reflection of your boundless potential. 

Your Heruka form is now a cataclysmic force, capable of crushing mountains and rending the earth with a single blow. Towering with divine radiance, your presence inspires awe or terror, depending on the purity of those who gaze upon you.
The destructive power of your Asura form is unparalleled, molded by your inner nature. Whether a flaming lion with searing metal claws that burn all they touch or a serpentine titan whose venom brings chaos and ruin, this form embodies wrath and devastation in its purest state. 

Conversely, your Deva form channels celestial harmony and creative power. As a radiant lioness whose warmth heals and purifies, or an avian guardian whose luminous wings calm storms and restore vitality, you bring renewal and balance to a world in turmoil.

These divine forms are not only manifestations of your might but also tools to wield your heritage with purpose. They embody your role as an agent of cosmic balance, capable of unparalleled destruction, healing, and creation, paving the way for your ascension to godhood.
addons.title: Celestial Incarnation

addons.text:
Your Inner Realm blossoms into a divine sanctuary infused with the sacred power of the Lotus Sutra. Across this realm, countless lotuses of vibrant hues bloom, each representing unique spiritual and metaphysical gifts. 

These flowers become both tools and treasures, offering powers such as purification, healing, and enlightenment. The White Lotus cleanses corruption and banishes negative energy, while the Red Lotus mends wounds of the body and soul. The Golden Lotus provides divine protection and fortune, and the enigmatic Black Lotus transforms weaknesses into newfound strength.

Beyond its spiritual significance, the Lotus Realm evolves into a tangible space you can physically enter, bringing others with you if you desire. Here, time and exhaustion hold no sway, allowing you to train, create, and experiment with boundless Iddhi. 

Objects and artifacts crafted within this realm can be brought into the physical world, though their potency depends on your strength. Sacred lotuses retain much of their power, offering you tools to heal, protect, or influence destiny itself.

As the master of this realm, you hold the power to shape its landscapes and energies to reflect your will. 

Over time, it becomes a domain of limitless potential, a reflection of your mastery over Iddhi and your journey toward godhood. Within this sanctuary, you prepare for the trials of the cosmos, forging the balance of creation, destruction, and rebirth with each petal that blooms.
addons.title: Lotus Realm

addons.text:
You can externalize fragments of your mind, soul, or emotions into distinct, physical entities. These Incarnations embody specific aspects of your essence—your rage may manifest as a blazing tiger, your wisdom as a serene sage, or your compassion as a radiant healer. 

Their forms are as limitless as your imagination, appearing as animals, elementals, mythical creatures, or humanoid figures, shaped by the facet of your being they represent. Each comes with unique powers aligned to their nature: an Incarnation of courage might radiate an aura that inspires allies, while one of sorrow could drain the vitality of enemies, shrouding them in despair.

These Incarnations reside in your Inner Realm, but you hold the ability to summon them into the real world to act on your behalf. As physical beings, they are loyal and devoted to you, yet retain individuality, capable of interpreting your commands in their own way or even acting contrary to your immediate wishes. 
Their independence makes them powerful allies but also demands understanding and balance, as their actions are driven by their unique perspectives, formed from the aspects of yourself they embody.

Through discipline and mastery of Iddhi, you can overcome these divisions, achieving perfect synchronization with your Incarnations. In time, you can split your mind and soul to embody and control them all at once, transforming them into seamless extensions of your will. 

In this state, your Incarnations become manifestations of your totality, allowing you to act in multiple places or forms simultaneously, each carrying your power and intent.

Beyond their utility, the Manifold Incarnations offer a path of profound self-discovery. By externalizing and interacting with these fragments of your being, you resolve inner conflicts and gain a deeper understanding of your true self. 

Each Incarnation is a reflection of your infinite potential, a piece of the whole that leads you closer to enlightenment and divine unity.
addons.title: Myriad Incarnations

objects.text:
As an Incarnation born of Kala, the Goddess of Life and Rebirth, you are bestowed with the power of Iddhi, a miraculous energy that grants potential beyond human comprehension. In the beginning, your mastery of Iddhi is limited to strengthening your body and enhancing any weapons you wield. But with time you can gain control over the elements, of life and death, time and space along with all things between.

Your strikes carry supernatural force, your reflexes defy human limits, and your resilience allows you to withstand what would shatter lesser beings. This marks only the foundation of your potential.

As your connection to Iddhi deepens through discipline and growth, you will unlock the ability to transform your form and channel divine power. One of these forms is the Heruka, which imbues you with immense physical strength, turning your skin into vibrant hues of red, blue, or purple, and opening a third eye to perceive deeper truths. In this form, you may grow to towering sizes with multiple heads and arms, embodying the raw power of destruction and creation in one unstoppable force.
 
Yet, Heruka is but the beginning. With time and effort, you can shape new forms tailored to your spirit, such as the destructive might of an Asura, focused on wrath and devastation, or the creative and nurturing power of a Deva, channeling elements and life-giving energy. Each form reflects an aspect of your divine nature, allowing you to wield both creation and destruction as tools of balance.

Within yourself lies an Inner Realm, a sanctuary shaped by your thoughts and will. Initially chaotic and unformed, this space grows alongside you, serving as a training ground where you can experiment with Iddhi without limits.

Over time, this realm becomes a reflection of your mastery, a boundless space where you hold absolute power, preparing you for your ultimate destiny: to rival the divinity of Kala herself and embody the endless cycle of creation, destruction, and rebirth.
objects.title: Incarnation (Indivisible)

addons.text:
You are the embodiment of an endless cycle of fear and torment, a force that binds itself to the darkest corners of the human psyche. Like a living nightmare, you weave realms that reflect your victims’ fears and their unresolved traumas. The boundaries of your realms are shaped not only by the fear of those you ensnare but also by the echoes of their past—a reflection of guilt, anguish, and horrors they cannot escape from.

Your realms are a twisted reflection of its inhabitants’ psyches. Your prey are trapped in a constantly shifting nightmare tailored to their deepest fears and unresolved anxieties, where the environment, the shadows, and the creatures within are all extensions of your will. They are stripped of hope and gradually broken, their minds warped under the weight of constant terror. Through psychological manipulation, torment, and exposure to their darkest vices, you reforge the strongest among them into Killers—twisted husks of their former selves, brainwashed and conditioned to hunt those who come after them. These Killers act as your agents, spreading fear and driving new prey deeper into your web. Each Killer reflects a unique manifestation of their personal trauma, their methods of hunting tailored to the fears they once suffered, now weaponized against others. This realm is alive, adaptive, and inescapable.

Your strength feeds on the fear you induce. The more terror you evoke, the larger and more powerful your realms become. You can manipulate the landscape, summon monstrosities forged from the fears of your victims, and warp reality to disorient and trap them. At the height of your power, you can assume the form of their greatest nightmares, embodying the fears you have harvested.
addons.title: The Fearborn

addons.text: Through Essence of Darkness’ ability to be empowered by negative emotions, your power to feed on fear as The Entity has expanded, allowing you to feed on all forms of negative emotion: hatred, despair, envy, all feed you and your strength equally.
addons.title: Equal Opportunity Feeder
An Entity Unchained
addons.text: Your powers as a Dungeon Master and the Entity have fused into a greater whole. Not only does this allow you to use Fear and your internal energy interchangeably, but it also provides a new way to use them from the beginning. Your ability to craft beings with their own powers has now extended to yourself, allowing you to create new powers for yourself at the cost of energy which scales with the strength of the power created. Combined with your ability to alter the world as a Dungeon Master, you can even create powers for others as well, allowing you to effectively introduce a “leveling system” for your players if you so choose. If you possess The Fearborn then creating powers for your Killers is much cheaper than it normally would be, allowing you to better empower them to act in your stead. And if you are an Equal Opportunity Feeder then any negative emotion can serve as fuel for your creative abilities. Given enough time and fear you can effectively become all powerful, although this would take the combined fear of tens of trillions of people (if not even more) to achieve in any reasonable span of time.

objects.text:
You have transcended human limits, becoming something akin to a god—or perhaps a devil. Your very essence thrives on the negative emotions of mortals, feeding on their fear, despair, and anguish. This sustenance grants you an unerring ability to sense those ensnared in inner torment, identifying them as ripe for your manipulation, ideal candidates to join your ever-expanding army of ‘Killers.’

Your power is rooted in fear, which you wield as both a resource and a weapon. This primal currency fuels your creations, enabling you to craft new horrors, each imbued with unique abilities designed to sow greater terror. To each Killer, you bestow a personal realm—a macabre domain tailored to their methods of carnage. These realms are living extensions of your will, reflecting the Killers’ essence while serving as arenas for their grim pursuits.

Your awareness stretches across these domains, approaching omniscience. You see, feel, and consume the suffering and dread that permeate every corner of these twisted realities. Through your fog-like portals, you can summon or ensnare survivors, transporting them into the nightmarish labyrinths of your creation. Here, the lines between prey and predator blur, as you orchestrate the relentless cycle of fear and death, feeding ever more on the torment you inspire.
objects.title: The Entity (Dead By Daylight)

objects.text:
The Edge of Taixuan is a martial art originally developed by Fu Hua. It focuses on harnessing the power of calculation and prediction to manipulate the battlefield with unparalleled precision. The technique includes abilities such as Mantra, which enhances the user's mind, enabling rapid analysis of situations; Dao, which delivers precise and calculated strikes; Yi, which facilitates swift and agile movement; Shu, which provides robust defensive strategies; and Xing, which executes powerful offensive bursts, all derived from calculated outcomes. Mastering the Edge of Taixuan requires high strategic depth and intense mental focus, making it a discipline suited for only the most capable practitioners.

The Blade Mantra is a vocalization technique that induces auditory hypnosis. By repeating the mantra, the user instills SWARA, a discipline that compels the body to adapt to Honkai energy, thereby enhancing physical and mental strength. This adaptation enables the user to control surrounding Honkai energy and wield the Taixuan Eminence, a blade of pure Honkai energy capable of severing anything in its path. Herrschers, beings with a connection to the Imaginary Space, can also summon the Taixuan Eminence if trained. However, the technique’s full potential—capable of rivaling Herrschers—can only be realized by those who have completely mastered it. For most, attempting to use the Taixuan Eminence without full mastery results in a significant loss of effectiveness. Mantra can also be used to create Solid Energy Constructs, allowing you to never be unarmed, and can also be used to enhance objects such as swords, allowing you to fight against the most powerful of honkai beasts.

The Blade of Taixuan is an unstoppable attack that transcends physical and conceptual boundaries. It cannot be defined by form, making it impervious to physical barriers, imaginary landscapes, states of mind, or tangible objects—from the microscopic scale to vast celestial bodies. Its essence is rooted in the mind, intention, and will, rendering it untouchable and invisible to the physical world. This blade is capable of eliminating void beings, quantum-state entities, and manifestations of cognition and concepts. It is described as the origin of change and the grand void behind creation. The Blade of Taixuan can affect the Honkai Gestalt, abstract phenomena that govern all Honkai energy. These phenomena reside within the Imaginary Tree, which holds dominion over all creation, including nothingness, information, destiny, time, and concepts. The blade’s essence is intertwined with nothingness, making it impossible to resist or even recognize. A notable use of the Blade of Taixuan was severing the link between God and Sirin, showcasing its unparalleled destructive capability.

While the Edge of Taixuan was originally designed to work exclusively with Honkai energy, it has since evolved to function with all forms of energy, further broadening its applicability and potential. In addition, users of this Art can harness energy directly from Imaginary Space without needing ambient honkai energy.
 
In conclusion, the Edge of Taixuan is a profound martial art that demands immense discipline and mastery. Its techniques, though extraordinarily powerful, come with significant risks and limitations; you risk damaging your mind and body due to improper handling of energy and an unclear mind. You will start with basic proficiency in the Edge of Taixuan, and you will have the talent to reach and surpass Li Sushang.
objects.title: The Edge of Taixuan (Honkai Impact 3rd)

addons.text:
As a Quincy, your innate ability to control external sources of spiritual power has elevated the art of Wuju to unprecedented heights, surpassing all previous achievements.

Your Quincy heritage endows you with a body perfectly suited for harnessing external spiritual power. This allows you to draw upon significantly more spiritual energy from outside sources with greater ease and at a much higher capacity than an ordinary human practitioner of Wuju.

Moreover, your spiritual awareness is enhanced even more, enabling you to perceive and sense distant phenomena with extraordinary precision and detail.

Finally, your mastery of the Wuju style empowers you to replicate the devastating effects of the Sklaverei technique, breaking down everything within your spiritual senses into raw spiritual energy for your use. You can also harness this power to enter a state of empowerment comparable to Vollständig, without the need for external equipment.
addons.title: Spiritual Conduit

addons.text:
You have successfully integrated the breathing techniques of the Demon Slayer into the art of Wuju. Now, with each breath, you draw in vast amounts of spiritual energy from the world around you, saturating your body with power.

This saturation invigorates both body and spirit, strengthening you with every breath. You recover much faster from all forms of damage and injury. Aging is greatly slowed down for you, and your body can substitute spiritual energy for basic needs such as food, water, and sleep. As long as you continue breathing, you can operate at peak condition indefinitely.

The elemental aspects of each breathing style, once purely visual metaphors, are now manifest through the spiritual energy channeled via Wuju. A master of Water Breathing can summon massive tidal waves to crush and drown enemies. A practitioner of Thunder Breathing can transform a slash into a bolt of cutting lightning. An expert in Sun Breathing can ignite their surroundings in searing solar flame. These elemental manifestations deal damage on both physical and spiritual levels, forcing your opponents to defend against both if they wish to remain unharmed.

Your Demon Slayer Mark will eventually awaken on its own, even without any training. Its activation is no longer dangerously taxing or potentially fatal, though it will still leave you deeply exhausted afterward. The boost granted by the mark is now enhanced threefold and stacks with the boost provided by the Enhanced Breath add-on.

As your proficiency with the breathing techniques increases, all associated effects will scale accordingly.
addons.title: Spirit Breathing

objects.text:
"The focused mind can pierce through stone."- Master Yi

Through years of rigorous practice, you have mastered the mystical martial art created by the Order of Wuju. Considered one of the greatest martial arts in Ionia and perhaps the entire world, Wuju is a magical discipline rooted in absorbing and channeling power from the spirit realm.

Practitioners of Wuju seek to refine their spiritual awareness to an absolute level through specific martial stances, the pondering of poetry, and deep meditation. This heightened awareness grants them unparalleled perception of the world, enabling them to see and interact with intangible beings and energies, discern the strengths and weaknesses of both themselves and their enemies, and draw immense power from the spirit realm. This power elevates them to superhuman levels, making them nearly unrivaled in combat.

A true Wuju master can move with such blinding speed that they appear to teleport, cutting down entire armies in mere seconds. They can empower their attack to make their blow effortlessly shatter stone and rip apart steel like they were nothing. Additionally, they can channel the power of the spirit realm to heal grievous wounds or grant themselves seemingly limitless stamina.

As long as they draw sufficient power from the spirit realm, practitioners have the potential to shatter mountains, devastate forests, or even reshape the entire world. However, humans are inherently limited in the amount of power they can harness due to their weak physical bodies.

You begin with the same level of mastery as Master Yi. In areas where the spirit realm or any local equivalent is absent, you can draw from other external sources of supernatural power, such as ambient supernatural energy, magic from leyline networks, or magical artifacts capable of acting as batteries, etc.

If no external energy source is available, you can tap into your internal reservoir of spiritual power to fuel your abilities. However, this reservoir is far more limited than the spirit realm's vast energy. Consequently, the amount of power you can channel is limited and will eventually deplete.

When your internal reserves are exhausted, they will naturally replenish over time, typically within a day or two. You can expedite this process by entering deep meditation for several hours.

Exhausting and refilling your internal reserves is also an excellent way to train your body, increasing both the maximum capacity of your internal reserves and the amount of spiritual power you can channel from external sources.
objects.title: Wuju Style (League of Legends)

objects.text:
Aspects are celestial beings who embody concepts, originating from the Celestial Realm, and are some of the most powerful entities in the universe, having shaped the course of events throughout Runeterra’s history. However, Aspects need a mortal as a vessel to interact with the mortal plane, whether by making them their host or by imbuing them with their power.

You have been chosen by an Aspect to become its host. Although there may be as many Aspects as there are concepts, the only known Aspects are the Aspect of the Sun, the Aspect of Justice, the Aspect of Protection, the Aspect of the Moon, the Aspect of the Wanderer, the Aspect of Twilight, and the Aspect of War.

You may choose which Aspect chose you or even create your own, and the powers you receive will follow the same theme as your Aspect. All Aspect Hosts gain a body equal to that of an Ascended, including superhuman strength, durability, and speed; agelessness; virtual immunity to pain and disease; and celestial magic based on their concept.

For instance, as the Aspect of Twilight, you could project energy blasts, create arcane meteors and stars, fly by ignoring the laws of physics, warp space and time, form time bubbles, perceive time across multiple dimensions and realities, and travel through the universe, time, and alternative realities using portals.

Some Aspects take over their hosts, but you will remain in control of yourself, although you may let your Aspect take over at any time and can regain control afterwards. Your Aspect will also never abandon you, and any children you have will inherit a portion of your Aspect’s power. In the event that your Aspect somehow dies, you will ascend as the new Aspect in its place if the conditions are right, and this won’t prevent you from interacting with the physical plane unless you no longer have a physical body.
objects.title: Aspect Host (League of Legends)

objects.text:
You have undergone the sacred Ritual of Ascension and been reborn as an Ascended God-Warrior. Empowered by the celestial light of the Shuriman Sun Disc, your mortal limitations have been burned away, leaving behind a being of awe-inspiring might and divine purpose.

Now, you exist as an ageless celestial entity, a fusion of godlike power and mortal will. Your physical and magical prowess defies comprehension. You can unleash attacks and cast spells powerful enough to easily sink entire islands beneath the waves and withstand strikes of equal magnitude without faltering. From complete stillness, you can accelerate to blinding speeds in less than a heartbeat. You could effortlessly cross distances that would take a trained soldier three weeks of nonstop running to traverse in a single second. Your stamina is virtually limitless, allowing you to fight at your absolute peak for thousands of years without ever tiring.

Upon Ascension, your celestial form took the shape of your choosing, an expression of your innermost essence and greatest strengths. Just as Nasus’s mastery of life and death shaped his towering jackal visage and granted him dominion over mortality and the decay wrought by the inexorable march of time, you too will develop a unique specialization, rooted in your past knowledge, passions, and strengths.

Though your power begins at the level of a newly Ascended God-Warrior, within just a few years of dedicated training, you will grow strong enough to rival even the mightiest among the Ascended, such as Xerath and Aatrox. In time, your power may grow to challenge even the celestial aspects themselves, though such a feat would require many decades or even centuries to accomplish, depending on how intense your training is.
objects.title: Ascended (League of Legends)

objects.text:
You have manifested Motive Wings, a pure expression of Self ungrounded by objective reality.

You start at Eight wings, but those with a strong spirit can shed their Wings by overcoming great challenges and growing as a person. Though a lack of sufficient challenges can stall your growth.

When a Wing is shed the remaining Wings will Evolve enhancing old traits or taking on new ones. This is a deeply personal change, so two people who have overcome the same challenges with the same Wings may develop completely differently.

At Eight Wings you have basic Industrial stuff, like the Helicopter Wing or the Rifleman's Wing.

At Seven Wings you have Advanced Modern stuff, like the Jet Wing or the Server Wing.

At Six Wings you have Basic Sci-fi stuff, like the Thruster Wing or the Habitat Wing. 

At Five Wings you have more advanced stuff, like the Alcubierre Wing or the Wing of Fabrication.

At Four Wings your wings become obviously supernatural in function, like the Wing of Wings or the Titan's Wing.

At Three Wings this escalates again, like the Halo Wing which lets you act upon the mechanism by which Wings are manifested or the Phoenix Wing which allows you to travel through flames, to unleash devastating infernos, and to rebuild and restore large areas.

At Two Wings things get wild, like the Wing of Unrestrained Spirit which grants you a greater capacity to express and bolster your own spirit, and that of others.

At One Wing you have something that is itself almost complete, like the Courtly Wing which manifests and masters elements of identity, independent extensions of oneself born from their personality that hold great power.
objects.title: Motive Wings (Into the Cardboard Realm)

addons.text:
It appears your Inner Beast wasn’t too receptive to your less-than-amicable passenger. Your demon is now gone, and your Inner Beast has taken its role; as such, many of the drawbacks and limitations caused by your demon no longer exist.

Your risk of going berserk is now gone; instead, when you’re in moments of intense stress, your Inner Beast will take over, gaining the power boost from going berserk and fighting quite a bit more intelligently than the demon would have, now only targeting the people you want to actually kill, and you will go to a corner of your mind to de-stress.

Another benefit from your Inner Beast taking your demon’s role is the fact that you will grow in power much faster, considering that one half of the relationship is no longer actively hostile.
addons.title: Demon Beast

objects.text:
You are dead, but in return you have become something else, a Reaper.

Your body has changed greatly. First off, you no longer age, need to eat, drink, sleep, or feel pain; secondly, you no longer really need all of your body; you can be torn to bits, and you’d still be ‘alive.’ This is to such a degree that one reaper was still conscious despite being just a hand.

Your soul is not alone in your body; a demon is there as well. This demon is formless, but over time it’ll stabilise, gaining the form of an animal and providing a boost in its intelligence and power; it grants you all your powers. These powers are the ability to control demonic energy and can shape it into things, with a great preference towards (but not limited to) a weapon that is powerful enough to cut through a normal human like butter as well as being durable enough to take a hit from a similar weapon.

Another ability you hold is being able to sniff out people as a colour that’s related to them, your ability to smell them is greater the longer you spend around them.

That’s not all, though; you can also spot whether or not someone is a sinner. If they are, it’ll be represented by a large red X on their chest, and that’s all you get, you can’t tell the reasoning behind their sin or what it is, just if they have or have not, and if you kill this person, their soul will be sent directly to hell. What counts as a sin is entirely decided by what the collective humanity considers a sin, whether that be petty theft or murder. This bestows a boon: whenever you kill a sinner, you’re restored of all injuries.

Despite all this power, it does come with some drawbacks, the demon sharing your body is akin to an animal, it only has fight-or-flight reflexes, and in moments of intense stress, it’d forcibly take control, and if it completely takes over, you’ll go berserk, massively increasing your power, but the demon will be in control, ripping apart everyone in its path, and the only way you’d be able to come back is if someone you care about were to convince you to come back. Also, despite your strength being absurd, your body tears just as easily as any human's.

You start off as strong as Scarlet at the beginning of the series with the potential to grow as strong as Scarlet when she partially fused with her demon, Barghest. For some more context, another reaper, far below your max, was capable of throwing a car hard enough for it to hit a helicopter out of the air.
objects.title: Filthy Sinner (I'm The Grim Reaper)

objects.text:
You step onto the path of the Sacred Arts, cultivating madra—spiritual energy refined from the vital aura present in the world around you—to strengthen your body, mind, and spirit. You begin at the Copper stage with a core aligned to a madra type or types (such as Pure, Light, Dream, Force, etc.) and a Path of your choice, whether canon or self-created, along with a high-quality cycling technique perfectly suited to that Path.

Vital aura naturally manifests in the environment, taking on aspects based on its surroundings: stone aura gathers in earth and rock, water aura in rivers and rain, dream aura in sleep and thought, life aura around living beings, and so on. By cycling this aura, you refine your madra and advance along your Path. 

This system functions in any world; if vital aura would not normally exist, it will instead be generated from ambient energy, life, or other metaphysical or natural forces appropriate to the setting, ensuring you always have something to cycle.

Your techniques are engraved into your spirit through practice and grow stronger over time. These techniques fall into four primary types: Striker techniques project madra outward as ranged attacks, Forger techniques create stable constructs of madra, Enforcer techniques reinforce your body or equipment, and Ruler techniques manipulate ambient aura to produce large-scale or environmental effects.

Advancement in the Sacred Arts represents a continual evolution of both body and spirit. At Foundation, you begin cycling madra, slightly enhancing your body and enabling simple techniques. At Copper, you gain Copper Sight, allowing you to perceive vital aura and properly refine your madra. At Iron, you develop an Iron Body that enhances your physical capabilities according to your Path. At Jade, you gain Jade Senses, greatly improving spiritual perception while refining and expanding your madra channels in preparation for Gold.

Upon reaching Lowgold, you bind a Remnant or form a contract with a sacred beast; you will receive one perfectly suited to your Path. This grants a Goldsign and a significant increase in power, with further growth through Highgold and Truegold as your madra deepens and strengthens.

Beyond this lies the Lord realm. At Underlord, you advance through a personal revelation, forming a soulspace and being reforged in soulfire, greatly enhancing your body and spirit while slowing your aging. At Overlord, deeper self-realization further refines your power and control, and you are reforged again in soulfire. At Archlord, a final revelation perfects your Path, bringing your strength, control, and resilience to extreme levels while aging becomes nearly irrelevant.

At the highest levels, you approach ascension. As a Sage, you manifest an Icon and gain Authority, allowing you to impose your will upon reality within the scope of that Icon. As a Herald, you fuse your body and spirit through integration with a Remnant, gaining immense physical and spiritual power along with regeneration and control. As a Monarch, you achieve both Sage and Herald, standing at the peak of pre-ascension power, your very presence capable of influencing the world around you.

Your Path, techniques, and abilities continue to evolve through practice, experimentation, and insight, and you are not limited to existing Paths, allowing you to develop your own unique approach to the Sacred Arts.
objects.title: Sacred Arts (Cradle)

addons.text:
Spirit Light and Aura are two facets of the same energy. With your insights into both systems you have learned to enhance both techniques beyond their original capabilities. The first benefit of this is that you now recover spent energy over time with rest. 

Spirit Light constructs are now more easily formed with less concentration, and can be maintained for as long as you have the energy to sustain them. Your increased insight makes it easier to learn new applications, and to enhance old ones. You are also able to enhance your constructs with Dust. 

The greater malleability of Spirit Light can allow your semblance to grow to greater heights and in new directions, although it will always retain the same theme. 

You can now awaken Spirit Light in others, in much the same way as you would Aura.
addons.title: Light of the Soul

addons.text: Your Spirit Light can now replace or supplement Qi for the purposes of Cultivation at your discretion. You may freely convert one into the other, and may use both to fuel techniques for either system.
addons.title: Spirit Light Cultivator

addons.text:
You move through nature like you were born of it. You know exactly where and how to place your feet by instinct when the ground you run on dips and rises unevenly, as well as the best way to step and adjust your body to avoid making unwanted noise in the underbrush, and generally how your body should move to avoid hurting yourself or cause unnecessary strain. 

You know how to leverage something without injuring your back, can step in holes at full running speed without twisting an ankle, and walk without breaking twigs or leaving obvious signs of your passing. 

You are also able to land from any height without taking damage, and will always land on your feet unless you are stunned beforehand.
addons.title: Spirit Guardian's Grace

addons.text: You have learned to amplify the purifying powers of Spirit Light, greatly increasing its effectiveness against dark aligned, corrupted, undead or demonic entities and granting it the ability to cleanse areas, objects or beings of curses, poison, sickness, and corruption.
addons.title: Luminous Soul

addons.text: Your Shehai has merged with your ability to form constructs from spirit light, you now possess the ability to reshape it at will to better suit different tasks. It's abilities will change to reflect the new form.
addons.title: Versatile Tool Set

addons.text:
Your connection to Eternity allows you to concentrate your spirit to create beacons in spacetime.

You can heal and restore energy by Rekindling a link. In the case of your body's destruction you can choose to reform at your most recent Soul Link the instant after it was created or rekindled. 

You can only make Soul Links in places where enemies or dangers aren't close enough to threaten you and, if you respawn, you lose any personal progress except skills (such as items, money, and power growth). 

You can only maintain one Soul link at a time without the assistance of a Spirit Well, which will function as a permanent Soul Link once activated. 

Soul Links can be used as teleport destinations.
addons.title: Soul Link

addons.text: Creatures, plants, and objects now have auras visible to you that can indicate if they are dangerous/hostile. Such things will have a reddish purple glow about them which can be seen so long as you have a line of sight, nearness not required, though it helps if you can see.
addons.title: Field of Intent

objects.text:
You possess the ability to wield Spirit Light in the same manner as the Spirit Guardians of Nibel and Niwen. Spirit Light can be used to protect, enhance or heal your body, form constructs of light, and is especially suited for use in various movement techniques. 

To start with, you know how to use all of the abilities Ori learned in his journey at a basic level, excluding those that required the assistance of Sein. You'll be able to train your skills up to the level that Ori achieved as well, although you aren't limited to that level, and can even develop entirely new abilities.
objects.title: Spirit Light (Ori and the Blind Forest/Will of the Wisps)

addons.text:
You have learned the Lotus Sutra, an extensive and legendary Sanskrit text that teaches ways of being by adapting its methods to the user. It is a sutra that adapts itself to the disciple, altering how it works according to their nature and the best path to growth. It follows the narrative of teaching a way that anyone can use, ensuring that all beings have the potential to become Buddhas.

The Lotus Sutra seeks to awaken you, and simply hearing it guarantees your transformation into a cultivator. The more you listen to it and internalize its teachings, the greater its power in advancing your cultivation. It does not care if you are talentless or incompetent, for none shall fail to achieve Buddhahood.
addons.title: The Scripture of the Lotus Blossom of the Fine Dharma

addons.text:
Introspection, the right mindset, patience, understanding of self—these are the pillars of cultivation, the foundation upon which the path to immortality is built. Without them, progress is impossible. The unworthy falter, their minds clouded by doubt, their souls fractured by hesitation. But you? You do not waver. You do not hesitate. You do not second-guess the path before you.

You are one thing—a singular, driven being, defined not by uncertainty, but by obsession.

Where others struggle against bottlenecks, searching for enlightenment, grasping desperately at insight, you need only follow the path carved by your fixation. Introspection? You already know who you are. Self-improvement? You refine yourself endlessly, your very existence sculpted by your unwavering focus. Where others are stalled by uncertainty, you carve through obstacles with relentless determination.

For a normal cultivator, a bottleneck is a trial of the soul, a test of wisdom and understanding. For you, it is simply another wall to break through. Some barriers take time, some demand sacrifice, but none are insurmountable. The weight of the heavens may press down upon you, demanding patience, but your obsession refuses to yield. If enlightenment is needed, you will burn your mind raw until understanding is seared into your very being. If flawlessness is required, you will grind yourself to perfection. If sheer willpower is the only path forward, then you will drag yourself through eternity if that is what it takes.

For others, enlightenment is a revelation—an unraveling of the self to glimpse the vast truths of existence. But you are not like them. You do not dissolve into wisdom; you forge it in the crucible of obsession. You do not meditate in search of meaning—you drown in your own hunger until it becomes something greater. Enlightenment through Obsession. You are a beast of desire, a force that will never stop, never waver, never rest until you have taken all that you seek.
addons.title: Obsession Refinement

objects.text:
You can begin walking the path of Cultivation, starting at Peak Body Foundation. You are knowledgeable about common methods of cultivation and can draw in the Qi that flows through all things, refining it within yourself. Not just that, but this power grants you an intrinsic understanding of Intent, the foundation of your personal Tao. This Intent is based on your personal experiences and perspective, forming a Narrative of who you are, each with vastly different abilities. With each step forward, you will experience growth in your mind, body, and soul. As you progress through the six stages: Body Foundation, Qi Gathering, Core Formation, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, and Immortal.

Upon reaching Qi Gathering, you gain the ability to absorb Qi and store it inside your body, enhancing your body beyond human limits. Your strength, speed, and endurance become many times greater than those of an ordinary human without Qi. You can leap several meters into the air and defeat tens of normal humans without breaking a sweat.
 
At Core Formation, you generate your own Qi slowly, no longer relying solely on external sources, albeit at a slow rate. Because of this, you begin surpassing natural constraints, making physical and mental exhaustion a thing of the past as long as you have enough Qi to sustain yourself. You can imbue your Qi with Intent, augmenting your actions and enhancing your senses. At this stage, you can begin moving Qi with your willpower to trace Narratives. Stories are tales written that you can read and follow, imbuing them into your Qi and granting it varying effects, with effectiveness changing based on how well you relate to the story. The more weight people place on a story, the more famous and ancient it is, and the stronger it becomes. Your mind improves, allowing you to hear light sounds several meters away and process information with increased clarity. At this stage, you can also use Qi to defend against attacks targeting your mind, body, and soul.

At Golden Core, you obtain complete control over yourself, capable of using your Intent to move exactly as you wish, with such precision that you can achieve perfect equilibrium in any position. You can stand on a needle in perfect balance without moving a single centimeter, with every motion guided by your will exactly. This stage is considered the peak of human potential. Your lifespan extends to the natural best of your species, for humans, that would be about 150 years. Disabilities or permanent injuries can be healed with sufficient Qi. You are forming a Golden Core, the cultivated essence that will represent your desired rebirth to Nascent Soul. You are fast enough to break the sound barrier and can destroy cliffs with a casual move.

Upon reaching Nascent Soul, you begin returning to your awakened state and shedding your previous body. At this stage, you return to revitalization and no longer age. This is the second birth of yourself, and you can impose your Intent upon reality itself, replacing the world’s natural laws with the principles of your Tao for as long as you have Qi to sustain it. You can shape the world according to the themes of your Narrative and exert rules over it based on it. It can be something like [Strength in Numbers] that defies the laws of reality itself so two needles can break a castle or one missile cannot overcome two fingers. However, the same phrase can be interpreted differently. One interpretation could be that the more people fight together, the stronger they become. The barriers between your mind, body, and soul blur, with movement becoming thought and traversing space as if it is an extension of your will. Your senses begin to perceive how the cosmos works. By glancing at the stars, you can read fate and sense major changes across the world.

At the final stage, Immortal, all limitations disappear. You can directly harness the infinite and reshape the Trichiliocosm with your Intent. You can perceive everything that happens, see the chain of events that will cause something to happen, and see the true nature of reality. Speed ceases to have meaning as you transcend the limits of infinity. You have reached the final stage of Inner Alchemy, not just a cultivator but a force of nature who can shape infinite worlds.
 
While it can take months or a few years to go from Early Body Foundation to Early Core Formation, without assistance, it can take years to reach Golden Core and even entire lifetimes to reach Nascent Soul. It requires hard work, the right mindset, and a peaceful mind to begin seeing the footsteps of becoming Immortal. You can only improve if you are introspective and capable of improving yourself. Otherwise, you will be stuck at certain stages. It is impossible to get around these bottlenecks without undergoing enlightenment, recognizing your flaws, and improving them.
objects.title: Inner Alchemy (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
"Use your energy to form the image of the godly elephant, which shall dwell within each of the 840 million particles that compose your body. Each manifestation shall grant you the might of an ancient mammoth. When all particles have awakened, your strength will rival that of the highest gods—capable of overturning rivers and seas, causing stars to fall from the heavens with a mere roar, and moving the sun and moon with just a thought..."

- The opening part of the Hell Suppressing Might of the Divine Elephant scripture.

The Hell-Suppressing Might of the Divine Elephant is a cultivation art of the highest caliber, renowned for its unparalleled divine power. This technique divides the practitioner’s body into 840 million particles, each capable of awakening the image of a divine elephant within them. With each awakening, the user gains the strength of an ancient mammoth. Once all 840 million particles have been fully awakened, they can evolve into an even more powerful state, allowing each particle to contain even greater energy. Upon reaching certain thresholds of awakened particles, the practitioner unlocks powerful divine abilities to aid them in combat. These include forming weapons and armor from their vast energy reserves, forming wings to grant flight and enhanced speed, creating a crucible that disintegrates all things into pure energy for absorption, etc. This art also heavily imbues the user’s energy with holy and divine attributes, making them the natural bane of all dark, evil, and corrupt entities. Its power can crush, purify, and subjugate such entities down to their fundamental essence and instill awe and terror in their hearts with your mere presence. You begin with one particle already awakened, granting you superhuman capabilities, including the ability to easily lift dozens of tons, along with equally impressive speed and durability. However, while this art is truly peerless and unmatched, it is also extraordinarily resource—and energy-intensive. Progress requires vast amounts of supernatural energy or magical resources; without them, advancement will slow to a crawl. For those seeking to cultivate this divine art to its fullest extent, it is highly recommended that they either reside in a setting rich in magical resources and energy or acquire a complementary power to sustain progression.
objects.title: Hell Suppressing Might of the Divine Elephant (Sage Monarch)

addons.text: Oh? Have those two agreed to make another Key? It seems that you are a real Astral Key after all, this has enhance some of your abilities and unlocked some of the abilities you previously lacked: Your ability to see outcomes now allows you to see the full contents of the possible endings, though the path to get there is still obscured. You may now insert yourself into major events regardless of their time and place of origin. You can now see ahead in time a bit to see what the exact effects of a major choice would be in the immediate future. You may now freely swap your Mythic Items out between Key Events, as well as discover new ones. You now have the ability to recruit Partners, people from across Space and Time who have helped you before. Though there is one major limitation, you must have gained a close understanding of who they are as a person and have earned their trust. Partners will also always have one Mythic Item bound to them that they are closely related to. You may now also Record endings to apply to both yourself and your Partners, as if those events have happened in your/their current past - even if they take place in the future of the current timeline.
addons.title: True Astral Key

objects.text:
You have become an existence similar to Anan, Sothoth’s Astral Key.

This has allowed you to insert yourself into Key Events you come across to influence the outcome to be more to your liking, but it isn’t perfect.

Lacking the essence of Yog-Sothoth you can’t travel through time and space or see the exact outcome of your choices, but what you can do is see when a decision will have a major effect on the flow of events and can tell how many possible endings there are from the start, as well as gain a vague impression of what they may contain.

Additionally you may select 3 Mythic Items to be bound to you, though you can not alter this selection afterwards.

A Mythic Item can be anything of great significance and/or power, from a Ring containing the souls of countless forgotten warriors, a AI Chip that could contest a God of Dreams in their own realm, a simple Flower Ring made by a girl who was transformed by a cult, to many more things.

But be warned, the more powerful the items effects, the greater the price involved. Whether that’s paying a price, putting in effort to get it to activate, or both.
objects.title: Pseudo-Astral Key (Depersonalization)

addons.text:
Your mastery of rites allows you to extend your divine influence beyond yourself, teaching and spreading fundamental rituals that harness Akiva Radiation. Through these rites, others can channel their faith in you to manifest miracles. These rituals are inherently neutral and can adapt to any role you take—whether as a benevolent god, a revered sage, or a feared entity of worship.

With these rites, you can establish ceremonies that call upon fragments of your legend. A god of holy light might create a rite that grants blessed health, while a death god’s rite could protect spirits in a graveyard. When performed consistently in a dedicated space, such as a church or shrine, a ritual’s effects may even become permanent. You may craft any rite you wish, so long as it aligns with your own legend.

Followers and devotees can also gain abilities based on their level of devotion and the Akiva Radiation they generate. The more frequently they perform these rites and the deeper their faith, the greater the power they may manifest. In time, the most devoted may develop abilities that embody your legend, becoming living extensions of your divine will.

However, the strength of these rites is entirely dependent on the depth and sincerity of belief. A lone zealot, no matter how unwavering, would need immense dedication and time to produce meaningful results. Conversely, a large congregation performing a rite will yield little power if their faith is weak. The greatest limitation of these rites is the fickle nature of faith itself—should belief waver, the Akiva Radiation sustaining them will fade, rendering them ineffective.
addons.title: Sanctification

addons.text: The presence of the Falna - a story written in the tongue of the Divine - has intertwined with the touch of Divinity you possess, providing both structure and sustenance for its growth and nurturing it to become something more. Every skill and spell written in your Falna provides directions for your budding divinity, shaping your nascent Arcanum in ways independent of the beliefs of others. The divine scripture and story engraved upon your back form a separate source of belief, drawn from the conceptual power of the Falna as a way of drawing strength from the bearer’s story, something which proclaims to all corners of the world that you exist. The more potent and intricate your story - i.e. the higher your level - the more power can be drawn from it, but at the very least it serves as a guarantee that you can never be rendered powerless if bereft of worship. Additionally, with the record of your existence inscribed upon your body and soul with the blood of the Gods serving as an anchor and foundational record of who you were and are, the faith of others can no longer warp you as it once did. While you are still influenced by what other believe of you, the core of who you are remains immutable, allowing you to resist any unwanted compulsions with sufficient willpower and effort.
addons.title: Scripture

addons.text: The spark of divinity embedded within your soul acts like an Akiva Fusion Reactor, generating incredibly vast amounts of Neutral Akiva Radiation, around the same amount as having the faith of a million people. As this is neutral and self-originating, it causes no erosion to your mind, body, and spirit. This Akiva saturates your golden blood and acts as a balancing factor for Akiva obtained through faith. As long as the Akiva you gather through faith does not exceed the Akiva you generate yourself, it won't erode your identity, body, mind, or spirit. You can then Shape this neutral Akiva for your own needs, taking a chunk of it and shifting it to align with a concept or symbol, permanently granting you a new miracle within the corresponding domain to invoke at will. This is much less efficient than using normal Akiva, requiring about 3x as much Akiva to obtain a new miracle. You also gain six minor street-level miracles, split between the domains of Blood and Gold, due to the symbolism of your golden blood. Or you could trade three of these minor miracles for one moderately powerful one, which would be at around city-block level.
addons.title: Akiva Fusion Reactor

objects.text:
You are a Type Black—a demi-deity, a theurgist, a fallen god. Whatever your origin, you have touched the divine, granting you the ability to wield belief as a source of power. This energy, known as Akiva Radiation, is generated by sapient beings when they perceive something as undeniably real. Mere awareness of mythology or acknowledgment of existence is not enough—only genuine conviction produces Akiva. Religious worship, veneration of saints, and even ideological devotion to concepts like justice or the nation can contribute to its formation.

As a Type Black, you can harness Akiva by drawing from belief in yourself. If people see you as a god, a sage, or a monster, their faith shapes your abilities. The strength of your legend, the depth of devotion, and the number of believers define both the strength and the limits of powers you can manifest. A handful of worshippers might allow a storm god to control clouds or summon a light rain, while reverence from millions could let a saint revive a battlefield of dead.

But faith is not without consequence. If people revere you as a hero, you may find yourself compelled to act like one—even against your will. Over time, the weight of faith can erode your identity, altering your mind, body, and spirit. It may elevate you, but it can just as easily consume you. You may sever your connection to Akiva at any time, reclaiming your true self—but doing so strips you of all power derived from it until you revert.

To begin, you can perform a single minor “miracle,” usable even without followers—no stronger than street level, like turning water to wine, conjuring light, or mending small wounds.
objects.title: Type Black (SCP Foundation)

addons.title: Corpse Possession
addons.text:
When possessing corpses, you aren't simply puppeting them anymore, you're reanimating them. This applies the properties of a Type-Grey to your current body, allowing you to regenerate and enhance it by consuming flesh.

When depossessing one of these bodies, you may either return it to a normal corpse or spend energy to leave it as a mindless husk. These husks will mostly lay dormant, but will attack living things that come near them.

Your affinity for death abilities has been enhanced further, even allowing you to imprint the properties of your vessels onto your spirit by eating enough flesh in them.

objects.text:
You are a Type Cyan—a spectral entity, more commonly known as a ghost. Your physical body is gone, leaving only your soul, now free to roam the world. As a ghost, you are fully intangible to mundane matter and invisible to the naked eye. You can float, pass through solid objects, and move freely in any direction. Your soul also emits a faint chill—one you can control at will.

Your spiritual form grants you the ability to possess both living beings and inanimate objects. You may inhabit a living body if your will and strength exceed theirs, or if the host allows it. While inside, you can influence—or even override—their movements. Possessing objects grants limited telekinetic control: slamming doors, flickering lights, or levitating items.

However, these abilities come at a cost. Using your powers steadily drains your soul, and the more extreme the act—like flying at jet speeds or phasing through massive structures—the greater the strain. Overextending yourself risks slumber or even true death. Basic use at street level drains little, but pushing further—such as possessing an entire building or freezing a lake—requires a long recovery. Your powers are limited only by the strength of your soul.

As a ghost, you're vulnerable to holy magic, exorcisms, and purification, though their effects weaken when you possess a physical form.

Any physical powers you have may carry over into your ghost form, adapting to suit your new state.
objects.title: Type Cyan (SCP Foundation)

addons.text:
Your soul actively supports and stabilizes your manipulation, refining every construct you create. Spirit constructs become more cohesive, last longer, and resist collapse, even when formed from weak or unstable fragments.

You can now adjust and reshape constructs in real time. Your soul corrects flaws, reinforces weak points, and shifts form or function mid-use without breaking control.

Hostile or powerful souls are easier to manage. Your soul absorbs backlash and reinforces dominance, reducing the risk of losing control during summoning or manipulation.

Your personal soul manifestation becomes more efficient and sustainable, allowing longer use, greater complexity, smoother transitions between forms and enhanced ability to act independently.

Repeated use allows your soul to refine familiar fragments, making future constructs from the same source more stable, responsive, and easier to shape.

Strain from manipulation is redistributed and mitigated, preventing catastrophic failure and allowing recovery instead of shutdown or loss of control.
addons.title: Adaptive Soul Manifester

objects.text:
You are a Type Purple—a soul manifester. Where others are blind to the soul’s presence, you can see it, touch it, and shape it. With your hands, you mold souls, forging their essence into form.

You can interact with the souls of the dead, reaching into what remains of their memory, emotion, and will. Most souls degrade after death, passing on or fading—leaving only fragments: echoes of thought and feeling. Yet even these remnants hold power. You can gather and weave them into spirit constructs—wrathful knights wielding blades of hate, spectral beasts cloaked in despair, or guardian spirits radiating peaceful light.

The strength and abilities of your constructs depend on the nature of the souls used. Every fragment is a foundation, but your will gives them shape. Stronger or greater quantities of souls produce stronger spirits. While you can mold a spirit’s form, you cannot create from nothing—you must work with what the soul provides.

With greater effort, you can summon complete souls—true ghosts. But this is dangerous. Not all spirits are willing, and some cannot be controlled. Calling powerful or hostile souls may cause dire consequences.

You cannot mold the souls of the living. Their spirits are bound too tightly to their bodies—beyond your current skill. The only exception is your own.

You can manifest your soul into a symbolic form—an owl with spectral wings, a mirrored double to take blows, or tendrils that bind. Its shape and powers are yours to define. But manifestation is draining. For now, you can only manifest your soul in short bursts, with its power and form limited to street level.
objects.title: Type Purple (SCP Foundation)

addons.text: We, as Daevites, are the supreme. No other can match our glory. Our empire shall be spread by the sword and the spear and the holy chant. We are the Daevites. We are absolute. You are no simple fleshwarper, you are something much worse and yet greater. You the the true Inheritor of Daevites Empire, in all of their deformed and bloodlust glory. You gain all knowledge of Daevite's Empire at it's peak, as well as means to utilize it; this includes, but not limits to: mastery in horticulture and herbomancy, animancy — the magic over life and spirits, alchemy, mycomancy — the mastery of mushrooms, artifact creation, necromancy, hemomancy and more. You may also, optionally, choose to become a Daevite yourself.
addons.title: Legacy of Black Horde, Bound by Blood

addons.text:
You are no mere Daevite. No—through your fragment of Yaldabaoth’s essence and knowledge of their secrets, you have become the successor to the Grand Karcist himself, inheriting his knowledge and power.

Your powers are vast, capable of freely controlling and reshaping your body and the bodies of others, creating or summoning powerful monsters (including Yaldabaoth’s Archons), reanimating the flesh of the dead, etc.

Most important, however, is that—like Ion—the complete destruction of your body is not the end. Your spirit has grown in strength such that it can exist without a body, allowing you to transfer yourself into another should your current one cease to exist.
addons.title: Grand Karcist

objects.text:
Sarkicism is collective name for the numerous practices, teachings, doctrines and more, that are based on the alteration and manipulation of flesh, bone and organic matter in all of its forms; owing to the history, dozens, if not hundreds, of paths have emerged, tracing its origins to Grand Karcist Ion, a Daevite slave-turned-heresiarch who mastered organic manipulation and led an ancient revolt that forged living temples and biotic wonders across Eurasia.

Through means unknown, you gain access to one of many traditions, each born from millennia of innovation, change, and growth. Whether it’s the Church of the Red Harvest, from Siberia, renowned for its “harvest” regeneration ritual, in which the recently deceased are reborn as infants; Vātula, celebrated for its unparalleled mastery over viruses and plagues; or the neo-Sarkic Esoteric Order of the White Worm, whose flesh-warping rites are steeped in magical practices; make your first step into a lineage shaped by endless transformation.
objects.title: Sarka (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
The teachings of the Fungal Sovereign have pierced your mind. The ethereal threads of yaezloi, anomalous current of entropy flowing from the primal source of Decay, known only as the Rotting Lord, have threaded through your very being. Your consciousness no longer aligns with the world as it once did; in its place stands the imitation known as the Mycelial Mind, a lattice of dense spores and secret names whispered by His disciples, now rooted deep within your soul. The material and the conceptual united, this is the true form of the Mountain of Rotting Lord.

With every breath you take, objects around you pulse with life and decay, granting you dominion over entropy within your immediate system, be it the room you occupy, your own body, a social structure, or even someone else's mind. The scale and depth of your influence will grow alongside your skill. 

Among the possible uses of these gifts are the attainment of inhuman resilience, allowing a living organism to function long past what logic or medicine would deem possible; the summoning of unique mutations through the emission of specific pheromones, toxins, and hormonal shifts in the surrounding cells; the induced rotting of certain ideas within groups of people, causing beliefs to wither rapidly while you repurpose their memetic remains to spread narratives aligned with your will; the use of decay and void as a form of alchemical purification—refining ingredients for potions, rituals, and elixirs; basic energy manipulation becomes so trivial it barely warrants mention; and finding a limit of your potential is a great task in itself.
