With time, growth, and practice, you may gain the ability to transform entire ecosystems into bastions of entropy’s dominion; convert bodies into automatons placed at the threshold between “life” and “death”; bring forth the demise and metamorphosis of empires and their histories; dissolve souls and flesh into perfect spiritual remnants, and far more beyond.

In addition, you now possess a copy of "The Songs of Rebirth", a tome containing rituals, techniques, and occult practices used by the followers of Namahim, such as the summoning of demons, forging of bonds between minds, and [COGNITOHAZARD REMOVED].

Be warned. The Path of Decay is not merely a collection of ideas. It is a precipice. And you've just fell.
objects.title: Lessons of Fungus Sovereign (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Your spiritual essence, observed by the Third Observable Universe throughout the Outer Worlds, essentially your existence, is now transformed into a eudemon of mankind, renowned as the fourth strongest species in Little Garden, a Poet.

As a poet, you can distort the reality of history, turning enemies into friends, removing experiences key to the growth of their strength, or you could even distort the reality of their birth, erasing them from existence.

You could also redefine the meaning of words, trapping enemies into a millennia of agonizing experience in the time span of a single second, or changing the definitions of words in magical contracts, allowing you to circumvent, or even outright ignore them.

If your influence is great enough, you could even create a completely new pantheon of gods.

Your only real limitation is your influence, represented through the digit of your spiritual essence, derived from your metaphorical and figurative weight in the world. This can change based on your personal abilities, your social influence, or even just your luck or fate.
objects.title: Poet (Problem Children Are Coming From Another World)

addons.text:
As you awaken to your Dying Will Flame you gain a fundamental insight into the Dying Will Mode, a technique that greatly enhances the power of your flames, but at the cost of making it feel like your whole body is breaking apart, even if no damage is being done.

There are three known forms of Dying Will Mode, but more could be discovered/created, those being:

Dying Will Mode: A technique in which the user's external limiters are removed at the cost of entering a berserk-like state, in which you are dedicated to fulfilling one last task.

Hyper Dying Will Mode: A technique in which the user's internal limiters are removed, allowing for greater control of their powers and unlocking their inner talents.

Ultimate Dying Will Mode: A combination of the previous two modes, in which both external and internal limiters are removed, allowing for an explosive jump in power with serene control; however, this also doubles the strain on the user.

You can access these techniques with training and without external aids; however, it is strongly recommended to master both Dying Will Mode and Hyper Dying Will Mode before attempting Ultimate Dying Will Mode.
addons.title: Dying Will Mode

addons.text:
Your will is so powerful it has fundamentally altered your Dying Will Flame, turning it into a hyper-dense darkness that covers your body and increases all aspects of your base power, known as the 8th Flame Type: the Flame of Night.

These Flames of Night are able to overwhelm other Flame types and decimate areas with a single burst; along with this overwhelming destructive power, the Flames of Night can manipulate space, creating portals that can draw in others like a black hole and allow for both full and partial teleportation.

Unlike others, your Flame of Night does not overpower your already existing Dying Will Flames, allowing you to use them together.
addons.title: Flame of Night

addons.text: The secrets of the Mafia World's research into Dying Will Flames have revealed themselves to you, allowing you to create all forms of Dying Will Flame technology shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Katekyo Hitman Reborn series, including Dying Will Equipment and Box Weapons. You are able to synthesize any material needed for these inventions, with your intellect rivaling that of Verde, Talbot, and Geppetto Lorenzini.
addons.title: Flame of Innovation

objects.text: You gain the Dying Will Flames, a high-density energy refined from a person's life force and determination. With each acquisition, you obtain one of the Seven Sky Flames, each representing a distinct essence and emotional purpose; with all seven, you will have the foundation to unlock all other variations and combinations within the Sky Flame system seen in the anime and manga. The Seven Sky Flames of Dying Will are: - Sun Flames: "Destroying the misfortune that attacks the Famiglia with their own body, they become the Sun that brightly shines upon an area." These flames are a vibrant yellow with a whitish core, and their main characteristic is Activation, defined by stimulation, acceleration of bodily functions, and increased strength, speed, and healing capacity. Unlike purely offensive flames, Sun Flames excel at supportive enhancements, as they can rapidly heal wounds and boost the user's physical abilities for short periods. They can even stimulate cellular regeneration and muscle function, enabling techniques that push the body beyond normal limits. - Lightning Flames: "To draw damage to himself and away from the rest of the Famiglia, serving as a lightning rod." These flames appear as vivid green electricity rather than conventional fire and are characterized by their Hardening ability. They can be used to solidify and increase the firmness of objects. On their own, they can be used defensively to project a solid barrier, or offensively to cut like a sharp blade and electrocute as if they were real electricity. - Storm Flames: "Continuously at the heart of the attack, the furious Storm that never rests." These flames, with an intense crimson red and pale pink inner layers, are defined by their characteristic of Disintegration. Their raw power corrodes and breaks down everything they touch, including other Dying Will Flames. Highly offensive and volatile, Storm Flames are the most aggressive and unstable among the Sky Flames; their particles spin unpredictably, destroying both physical and energy barriers. - Rain Flames: "To square away conflict and wash away the blood spilled. The Requiem of Rain." These flames are characterized by their blue color with shimmering particles that seem to flow through them, giving them an appearance more like rippling water than traditional fire, and their main characteristic is Tranquility, symbolizing stillness, pacification, and the ability to weaken everything they touch. The power of Rain Flames lies in their ability to drain strength from enemies, slowing their movements or attacks. At their peak, these flames can even manifest ice. An expert in Rain Flames can use Tranquility so effectively that anything entering a specific barrier becomes completely immobilized, effectively destroying machines and killing a human by stopping all biological functions. - Mist Flames: "Creating from nothing into something, turning something into nothing; bewildering the enemy, so making the famiglia untouchable." These flames are identified by their indigo color with lighter shades and are defined by their Construction trait. The Construction trait of Mist Flames turns users into natural illusionists, granting the ability to create complex illusions that can deceive and manipulate even the most cunning opponents. They can also generate "real illusions" so powerful that they affect bodily functions, allowing them to easily deceive the senses, escape, or make an opponent vulnerable to attacks. - Cloud Flames: "A drifting Cloud, whom cannot be bound. Protecting the famiglia from an independent standpoint." These flames, with a purple hue, are characterized by their Propagation trait, allowing rapid expansion and multiplication, ideal for any technique involving increased size or multiplying numbers. They are very advantageous when performing techniques that cover large areas, such as creating a cyclone or an impenetrable force field. - Sky Flames: "Sun, Lightning, Storm, Rain, Mist, Cloud-- He envelops them all, he accepts them all. That is the Sky's purpose." These flames are the purest and rarest of the Dying Will Flames. Their vibrant orange color symbolizes their main characteristic: Harmony. Harmony represents a perfect state, free of defects or contradictions. This means Sky Flames can accept, harmonize, and balance all other Sky Flames, allowing the user to strengthen, absorb, or combine their qualities. Sky Flames are the only Dying Will Flames that can be divided into two different types: "Soft" and "Hard" flames. Soft Sky Flames have an orange core and a body that ranges from pale orange to bright yellow-orange, and they function essentially as the default state; with these flames, the user can do things like float, maneuver in the air, and maintain balance to adopt a stable stance. On the other hand, Hard Sky Flames have a reddish-orange core, with the parts closest to the edges colored in varying shades of orange and sprinkled with crystal-like sparkling particles; they are released when explosive energy increases, being perfect for bursts of speed or simply overwhelming raw power. On top of this, Sky Flames also allow the petrification or freezing of others —including other Dying Will Flames—, enabling the user to seal anyone inside ice that can only be melted by exceptionally strong Dying Will Flames.
objects.title: Dying Will Flames (Katekyo Hitman Reborn)

objects.text: Baraya, Baraya, Agabaraya You have trained under the Demonic Cult, immersing yourself in their forbidden swordsmanship. Like them, you bear an unrelenting hatred for the heavens, cursing its existence, clawing at the very fabric of the world in defiance. Your blade is not just steel—it is resentment given form, a weapon forged from suffering and rebellion. This sword style consists of nine forms, each rooted in a primal suffering, a torment that gnaws at the body and spirit alike. To wield these techniques, a swordsman must recall and relive the very essence of their pain. It is not enough to simply remember; one must become the suffering, shaping its form, color, taste, and sensation. No two practitioners wield this style in the same way, for each draws upon their own memories to manifest its power. The nine forms are: First Form: Sword of Starvation – The blade howls with emptiness, a desperate hunger given shape. It carves through flesh as though devouring it, insatiable, relentless. Second Form: Sword of Thirst – A strike that parches the soul, leaving the opponent drained, their strength and spirit siphoned away like water in the desert. Third Form: Sword of Drowning – A suffocating technique that engulfs the enemy in overwhelming pressure, their body and mind submerged in an unrelenting abyss. Fourth Form: Sword of Freezing – The cold steel carries the bite of winter’s deathly grip, freezing wounds, slowing movement, and numbing the will to fight. Fifth Form: Sword of Poison – A venomous cut that seeps into the enemy’s body, spreading agony with each heartbeat, as if their very blood rebels against them. Sixth Form: Sword of Illness – A technique that erodes vitality, burdening the foe with unseen afflictions, their body wracked with phantom fevers and wasting away with each strike. Seventh Form: Sword of Blunt Force – A merciless, crushing force that rattles bones and ruptures flesh, leaving behind no clean wounds, only ruin. Eighth Form: Sword of Incineration – A blazing arc that burns not just flesh, but spirit, leaving nothing but smoldering embers in its wake. Ninth Form: Sword of Suicide – The final and most terrifying form, where the swordsman wields their own death as a weapon. It is a strike that disregards self-preservation, channeling everything—life, suffering, and hatred—into a single, inescapable blow. To wield the Demonic Heavenly God Art is to bear the weight of suffering, to curse the heavens with every swing, and to carve one’s resentment into the bones of the world. It is not just a technique—it is the manifestation of a hatred so profound that it becomes a blade unto itself. In addition, you gain a foundational understanding of Sword Aura, the ability to extend your intent and energy beyond the physical blade. This technique allows you to coat your weapon in an invisible yet lethal force, sharpening its edge, increasing its range, and enhancing its destructive power.
objects.title: Demonic Heavenly God Art (SSS Class Suicide Hunter)

objects.text:
You’ve become The Slayer, this mystical title marking you as a Chosen One grants you various physical enhancements and benefits. Those being superhuman strength, stamina, speed, agility, reflexes, durability and accelerated healing. Beyond this you possess a natural proficiency with virtually all forms of weaponry and unarmed combat styles, have a heightened awareness of your surroundings that with training would allow you to fight while blind and sometimes have prophetic dreams, foreseeing future foes or events, thus giving you time to prepare for them. 

Your abilities improve with experience and training which increase faster and with greater magnitude than those of normal humans. Your strength, accelerated healing and endurance also improve with time. A stomach wound in your first year might hospitalize you, while the same wound in your seventh year could simply be slept off.

Your powers can fluctuate if you’re emotionally imbalanced, having an ‘off-day’ might just turn a typically easy fight into a life and death battle. Should you ever die the Slayer mantle will pass on, activating a potential Slayer. Should you be revived, dying a second time will not awaken another Slayer. If there are other Slayers in existence it’s possible for you to communicate with them through dreams.
objects.title: The Slayer (Buffy the Vampire Slayer)

objects.text:
You're a Hanyō - half human, half Yōkai. A Hanyō occurs when either a Yōkai breeds with a human, or when a human merges with one or more Yōkai. This non-human ancestry has given you physical characteristics that may alert others to your Yōkai heritage, such as oddly colored hair, pointy ears, horns, animal ears on your head, a tail, or a large stature. 

Physically, you can naturally move at speeds capable of outpacing horses, and you are strong enough to uproot trees, lift boulders, and break them. Your durability allows you to jump off cliffs and hit the ground running, shrugging off attacks with enough force to crack stone. Your regeneration is also formidable, allowing you to heal deep wounds within a day or two without scarring—though it is not strong enough to regenerate limbs. Additionally, your Yōkai heritage gives you a lifespan in the centuries.

Depending on the Yōkai, you will have natural abilities specific to that race. For example, a dog Yōkai might grant you claws and heightened senses, while a kitsune might give you the ability to cast illusions and shapeshift. Beyond your natural abilities, you possess Yoki, an energy that allows you to enhance yourself or develop new abilities. For instance, you might learn to create trails of energy from any claws you may have or learn breath fire. With enough time and practice, even abilities such as flight or healing could become possible. Naturally, you can choose which kind of Yōkai you merged with / descended from.

All Hanyō share a common drawback thought —once a month, during the new moon, they temporarily become fully human. It is best to hide during that night. You also have a weakness to spiritual powers, such as attacks from a Miko.
objects.title: Hanyō (Inuyasha)

addons.text: The God of the Bible's light has infused your being, granting you the ability to use the power of Miracle thanks to your True Faith. Starting with six dots, your ability to sense and drive off evil beings as well as sanctifying objects and even locations is greatly bolstered, and will only increase further as your True Faith continues to grow stronger. If you have The Violence of Heaven, your True Faith grows to 10 dots, allowing you to not only drive off impure beings with a prayer and exorcising evil spirits with your will alone, but also healing humans of all wounds and ills even on the brink of death, and even curing vampirism and returning a willing victim to their human self.
addons.title: True Faith (World of Darkness)

objects.text: "Let not the evils of the world break you, my child. Hear my voice and fight against it. Do not fall here—stand up, child. The Lord loves you still and has much for you yet." As a senior exorcist of the Holy Catholic Church, you have gone through rigorous training to confront and repel demonic entities through sacred rites, scripture, and unwavering faith. Able to bless and sanctify both objects and places, purifying them of infernal taint and halting the spread of evil across the earth. You may even extend this to weapons, allowing you to destroy a demon's physical form on earth if, by some unfortunate circumstances, it managed to claw its way to this plane of existence and banish its spirit back to Hell through a combination of holy firepower and divine invocation—much like Father Garcia with his consecrated shotgun and his judicial usage of it. Your deep knowledge of scripture and the sacraments enables you to discern and perform the proper rites to exorcise spirits from unwilling hosts or, when it is too late, to bring peace to the victim's soul as you strike down the demon and cast it back into the abyss, it crawled from. Never forget: your faith is your shield and your sword. It is the source of your strength and the hope you bring to others. In a world drowning in sin and shadow, it is the light that will never go out—so long as you carry it. Finally, you're also equipped with all the tools of both a priest and an exorcist, including a golden crucifix bestowed upon you by the archbishop of your order—a symbol of your authority, your mission, and your unshakable bond with the divine.
objects.title: The Exorcist (FAITH: The Unholy Trinity)

addons.text: You can have multiple Armored Beasts wrap around yourself or an object to enhance them, using all their abilities combined. The more Armored Beasts used will make the armor, weapon, or vehicle larger, but it would not hinder you in any way.
addons.title: Combination

addons.text: You possess a contract with an Armored Beast with Kitsune blood, possessing all the abilities a Kitsune has. It can form cannons that shoot foxfire and create illusions. The longer it lives, the more tails it gains.
addons.title: Mother of All Beings - Kitsune

addons.text: You possess a contract with an Armored Beast with Dragon blood, it possesses all the abilities a Dragon has. With scales that can wrap around the user to protect them, granting objects the ability to fly, and shoot dragon’s breath. If the object it fuses with can already fly, then it gains a speed comparable to a dragon.
addons.title: Mother of All Beings - Dragon

addons.text: You possess an Armored Beast containing pure Kryptonian genetic data. When wrapped around you or an object, it grants Kryptonian traits powered by yellow sunlight. This ranges from enhanced strength, speed, durability, flight, regeneration, heat vision, cold breath, and advanced senses. In the absence of yellow sunlight, these abilities gradually weaken over time. The armor is vulnerable to Kryptonite and red sun radiation, which can disable or endanger the user, depending on exposure.
addons.title: Mother of All Beings - Kryptonians

addons.text: You possess an Armored Beast containing Ōtsutsuki genetics and chakra. When fused, it grants chakra-based enhancements, including energy manipulation, interstellar flight, high-speed regeneration, and stealth. This Armored beast can grow Chakra Fruit. Devouring a Chakra Fruit grown from it allows permanent evolution and unlocks advanced abilities. If a living being wears this Armored Beast, its DNA will be overwritten. And if it dies, it can jump to another Armored Beast you possess or turn a worthy vessel into an Armored Beast.
addons.title: Mother of All Beings - Ōtsutsuki

objects.text:
Granting a True Name to a living being is a foundational magical act in Witch society. The named entity receives a portion of the namer’s power, often making them stronger and evolving. In turn, the recipient becomes bound to the name and the will of the namer. Familiars can be summoned to you when you want.

A True Name reflects the namer’s intent and can influence the recipient’s growth, traits, and fate. Because of this, names must be chosen carefully. Poorly given names can hinder potential, while well-chosen names can define one’s path.

While you can form Familiar Contracts with any living or spiritual being, you are also capable of creating specialized Familiars. You can extract the spiritual consciousness of objects born from age and emotions imbued into them and place them into new vessels customized for you. Spiritual consciousness placed into objects made using spiritual materials evolves faster. Familiars contracted to you will evolve to fit you or your purposes better.
 
Using a blood sample of a species, you can artificially create Familiars known as Armored Beasts using magic, which have the abilities of the species that the blood sample comes from. This is the most common kind of Familiar, as these Armored Beasts can transform themselves into various forms. It can wrap around a broom to gain the traits of that species, such as high-speed flight, or it can wrap around the user, granting them the strengths of that species. Even if a familiar is the same species as the user, the benefits of wearing them stack. The stronger the species, the more comfortable the Armored Beast is, such as creating cushioning when wrapping around brooms or maintaining the user’s temperature while worn as armor.

There is a limit to what an Armored Beast can wrap around, based on its size. While the older it gets, the larger it becomes, it takes time to grow large. And barring the abilities of certain races, wrapping around something extremely large like a Warship might be unfeasible.
objects.title: Witch's Contract (Homebody Witch)

objects.text:
Saints are beings who have ascended to a higher state of existence, omniscient and omnipotent in relation to existences below them. Your future self is destined to become such a Saint, and your present self now reflects that truth. Your fate becomes indeterminate—constantly shifting, rendering it impractical for any opponent to manipulate. You can alter both the past and the future without causing paradoxes, even where others would fail. This future sanctity also protects your past, shielding you from temporal interference.

The world itself seems to reveal its secrets to you, allowing effortless creation and modification of magic and granting you swift comprehension of mysteries that leave others bewildered. Your physical manifestation reflects your divine future: unparalleled beauty, an enchanting voice, and movements that trigger auspicious phenomena. Your will, reflecting your destiny, stands unshakable, such that even primal fears cannot sway it.

The time frame it takes for you to become a Saint is, at minimum, the time it takes for the Universe to end. However, you can shorten this if you get stronger.
objects.title: Congenital Saint (Homebody Witch)

objects.text:
You have received the divine favor of the heavens and inherited the title of Saint(ess), a role rarely bestowed and deeply revered. This sacred designation grants you unparalleled affinity with Holy magic and marks you as a beacon of protection, purity, and power.

The first gift of your new role is Blessing, a passive divine shield that surrounds and protects you at all times. When a hostile entity attempts to harm you, mid-rank or higher Holy magic automatically activates in response, even without your will. This effect manifests in two ways.

The first is direct defense, creating holy wards that intercept and nullify incoming attacks. Its strength is formidable—so much so that Clarice, the last Saintess, was able to withstand a direct blow from the final boss, Wellbrock, without so much as a scratch. That same attack devastated the immediate area, destroying an entire building and killing everyone but the Saintess.

The second function is retaliation: the moment an enemy strikes, Holy magic erupts upon them, dealing radiant damage as punishment. While this retributive strike is not as absolute as the defensive aspect and cannot be consciously controlled, it still serves as a powerful deterrent to aggression.

Your second divine trait is Divine Emission, a passive enhancement that grants your Holy magic overwhelming dominance in terms of magical compatibility. No matter the element, school, or type of opposing magic, yours will always have the “Type” advantage, even against elements that naturally have an advantage over Holy Magic.

This ensures your spells are more effective, more resistant to interference, and especially potent when facing enemy magic users. Moreover, this innate superiority strengthens the power of Blessing, reinforcing your divine protection.

Finally, your blessing as a Saint(ess) grants you immense natural talent with Holy magic. Spells of the divine come to you with instinctive ease, and even the most complex incantations feel as natural as breathing. Your affinity means faster casting, more efficient mana usage, and spellwork that far surpasses what any normal magician could hope to achieve in the same field.

Paired with Divine Emission, you can imbue any magic with Holy Attributes, thus making it “Holy Magic” and boosted by your various traits.
objects.title: Saint(ess) (The Extra's Academy Survival Guide)

objects.text:
You have become the half-human Son of Satan. But to protect yourself, and others, your demon heart, a spiritual organ, has been sealed inside Kurikara, which is the source of your demonic nature and abilities. While this being sealed has majorly limited your access to most of your demonic powers, it also has one benefit: when sheathed, your demonic nature is almost perfectly sealed, making your demonic side nearly undetectable and removing your demonic weaknesses. 

Even in this fully sealed state, you retain a high amount of physical strength—enough to break adult bones as a child—along with enhanced regeneration and durability. Additionally, by accessing even a fraction of your demonic power, you may release an overwhelming aura, which is feared by low- to mid-tier demons.

But by unsheathing Kurikara you now gain access to more of your demonic abilities, which majorly enhances you physically and, more importantly, grants you access to Satan's flames. Your demonic abilities manifest as glowing blue eyes, pointed ears, and a demon tail. As a result of accessing more of your Demon Heart, you will also gain a demon's weakness to Holy Water, even if they are majorly weakened by being half-human, with your biggest weakness being your demonic tail, which can paralyze you if grabbed. 

Your most powerful ability, Satan's Flames, are powerful demonic blue flames that have a unique feature, the ability to burn not only humans but also demons and other spiritual entities. These flames are so powerful that they can only be put out by powerful holy water or holy energy and can easily incinerate even most mid-level demons when accessed, with them even being able to damage high-ranking demons by accessing more of their power. Alongside this ability to burn humans, demons, and other spiritual entities, your flames will only harm and damage what you want them to, though this may take some training to master.

But even when unsheathed Kurikara weakens your demonic nature, both your demonic abilities and more importantly the influence your demon heart has on you. But through sheer anger or damaging Kurikara, you may regain more of this connection, massively amplifying not only your anger but all of your demonic abilities. When in this form, your flames and demonic abilities are strengthened enough to burn and almost kill a high-ranking demon with ease. With enough training, you may properly access your demonic heart, allowing you to fully access your demonic nature without going insane. If Kurikara's blade does truly break, then your Demonic Heart will fully be returned to you, which will allow you to access your demonic form without Kurikara but grant none of its protection for your humanity.

Alongside your abilities gained due to being Satan's son, you have also gained the sword Kurikara, a powerful katana that seals spiritual beings killed by it inside Gehenna, a different hell-like dimension. Contrary to common belief, the most vital part of Kurikara, and where it draws its power from, isn't the blade but the handle and scabbard, even functioning with no blade. Lastly, as a result of your demon heart sealed inside of Kurikara, you have gained a connection to it, allowing you to sense it, focus your flames through it, instinctively wield it, treat it as an OoP, and, with training, possibly even telekinetically summon it. Even if your demonic heart is unsealed from it you will still retain some connection to it, even if majorly weakened.

Note: While Kurikara is traditionally a Katana you may choose what type of bladed weapon it is.
objects.title: Son of Satan (Blue Exorcist)

objects.text:
A divine power once bestowed upon Zerea of Twilight—the Oldest Grail Knight—by Pleu, Goddess of Dream and Death, in solemn recognition of his ceaseless, lifelong struggle to ascend as a Grail Knight. Where others would have fallen to despair, Zerea endured, and for his perseverance, he was granted a power that defies time itself: the ability to summon his “past” into the present.

You now carry this sacred gift. When invoked, you summon a version of yourself from a specific moment in your own recent past, a “you” without this power. This is no mere illusion—it is a true, independent being, born into the world as though it had always existed. Though it walks freely and acts by its own senses, it remains unwaveringly loyal to you, bound by shared origin and purpose. These past selves inherit your current memories—but not your future skills or experience—allowing them to swiftly adapt to the present moment.

Should one of these past selves fall, it does not die in the conventional sense. Instead, it regresses—returning as a younger version of who you once were. This new self still carries the memories of you, the original, up to that point in your life. However, it does not remember anything the previous clone experienced after being summoned, since those memories were never part of your past.

Unlike Zerea, whose divine bond allowed him to summon only a single self, your connection to Pleu runs deeper. With time and mastery, you may call forth multiple pasts, though no two can ever be of the same age, for the Goddess does not permit the dreaming self to split along identical paths.

Even should you, the original, fall, your echoes will persist. Yet they are but fragments of what was—unchanging, unyielding, forever bound to what they were, never what they might become.
objects.title: Fated To Grab Ahold Of Victory In The Endless Dreams (The Knight King Who Returned with a God)

addons.text:
You did not seize power—it pooled beneath you, thick and silent, rising like floodwater in an empty room. When structures cracked and leaders faltered, people turned to you not with faith, but fatigue, letting you fill the vacuum with your slow, inevitable weight. You are not followed out of love or terror, but because everything else stopped moving.

As a Sinner, your body reflects your inner soul—and yours is a drowned empire of tar. Your form constantly leaks thick, black sludge from beneath the skin, seeping like sweat from your pores and fingers. The substance coats your flesh in a sheen of oil and rot, absorbing light but never glistening. Your frame is shrouded in ruined regalia—part uniform, part burial shroud. Ribbons, medals, and honors are half-melted into your body, twisted by heat and time. Velvet cloaks drag behind you, soaked and torn, as though you’ve walked for miles underwater.

Wherever systems begin to rot, you become the center by default. In gangs where the boss has vanished, in warzones where the chain of command has collapsed, in corporations spiraling from scandal—your presence alone reorders the room. No one declares you the leader, but decisions begin to route through you. People begin to phrase their choices in your name, often without realizing it. The longer you remain, the harder it becomes to act without you. Your aura feeds on surrender: every abandoned plan, every delayed action, every shrug of “why bother” weaves another thread into your mantle. Even those who hate you find their anger softened into passivity—until they’re just another face in the crowd, watching you sit on the throne they built from nothing but their own exhaustion.
addons.title: The Throne Beneath Their Apathy

addons.text:
Your presence compels others to indulge in your primary desire, whatever it may be—glory, bloodshed, domination, excess. Even those who would resist will begin to bend, slowly giving themselves permission to want what you want, until indulgence becomes identity and their values rot away.

As others surrender to your desire, your corruption takes root in their flesh. They begin to change in monstrous ways. If your Sinner form has horns, they begin to sprout. If your body is marked by flame, their skin starts to smolder. Tails grow. Claws form. Voices distort. They are still technically mortal, but no longer truly human. They become pseudo-Sinners—still mortal, but reshaped by your presence, marked by your obsession, and slowly transformed into a new breed of damned.

And as they change, so do you. Every indulgence committed by your chosen reflects back into your flesh, evolving your demonic body. Their sins become your fuel. Their transformations become new features on your form—more limbs, more eyes, armor, wings, or mouths, shaped by the desires they’ve surrendered to. With each change your power grows, until eventually being able to match Overlords in power alone.
addons.title: The Architect of Want

addons.text:
You were already a monster—twisted by sin, immortal by punishment—but now you are more. The demon inside you, once a wild and formless thing, has found resonance in your Sinner nature and has started taking on a form reminiscent of a warped, monstrous version of your Sinner form.

Rather than resisting your inner beast, you may now invite it forward, entering a fused state where your Sinner form and the demon’s raw hunger converge. Your body mutates violently—gaining new limbs, additional eyes, segmented armor, writhing tails, or whatever features symbolize the sins and instincts you’ve embraced. You remain in control during these fusions, but the longer you linger, the harder it becomes to tell where you end and the demon begins. 

This state is not as explosively powerful as fully letting go and going berserk, but it is vastly more stable—you retain control, can sustain it far longer, and direct its strength with precision.
addons.title: The Beast

objects.text:
You are a Sinner. Sinners are a distinct subspecies of demon—former humans condemned to Hell for the crimes, atrocities, or unforgivable acts they committed in life.

Your appearance is a direct manifestation of your soul. It reflects who you were in life and how you died. Sinners often exhibit monstrous or symbolic features that embody their vices, crimes, or final moments—mobsters might have arachnid traits, and a man killed by a piano might have features resembling piano keys. While most Sinners retain a humanoid frame, your form is not bound by human anatomy. Under strong emotion you can enter a partial transformation, allowing demonic traits to emerge from your humanoid form.

As a Sinner, you are immortal. You do not age, and you cannot die from disease, poison, or physical injury, no matter how extreme. You can be crushed, dismembered, or blown apart—and still survive, slowly reforming yourself over time. You require food and sleep, despite being dead, and you can indulge in drugs or alcohol freely without the risk of overdose or fatal side effects. You possess a unique set of supernatural abilities, determined by your identity in life and the nature of your damnation. These may include superhuman strength, transformation into a monstrous form, or animalistic behaviors tied to your design.

Unlike others of your kind, you are free to move, act, and carve out a place of power as you choose instead of being limited to the Pride Ring.

However, you are not invincible. Your one true weakness is holy power. Angelic weapons can destroy you utterly. A fatal strike from such a weapon can erases you. Your body would be annihilated, and your soul is dispersed beyond recovery. High concentrations of holy light or angelic magic have the same effect, bypassing your durability and reducing you to nothing. No resurrection, no reforming—just oblivion.
objects.title: Sinners (Hazbin Hotel)

addons.text:
Due to possessing a bloodline from your form as a Mythic Beast, you’re now capable of cultivating Beast cultivation methods. You also gain access to your bloodline inheritance, granting you another cultivation method in addition to the ones you have that will grow with you as you advance in realms. This allows you to punch upwards of your cultivation level. 

This will also grant you an initial species specific power and technique, like fire manipulation and a flight technique for a phoenix, or water and defense techniques for tortoises. 

As you cultivate, you’ll slowly unlock more and more of your bloodline inheritance, giving you a new ability and technique each time you advance to a higher cultivation realm.
addons.title: Mythic Bloodline

addons.text:
This dark path has unlocked your potential for a malevolent form, you can turn yourself into a demonic beast, whether temporarily or permanently is up to you. This form makes you much stronger at the expense of your rationality, making it more fierce and primal. Your bestial subconscious will come to the fore, turning into a bloodlust filled berserker with no other goal than to cause suffering and slaughter. Though you can learn to control this form, you’ll only ever reach its true potential if you let it be true to its base instincts or by acting exactly as it would. 

As you keep using this form, you’ll slowly and naturally learn demonic beast techniques as you absorb and devour your prey. Ranging from rabbit escape techniques to the chilling laughter of hyenas to the deviousness of humans, as you keep devouring the targets of your choice, their techniques will become yours, becoming stronger and more demonic the more of their kind you devour. As you advance in realms, these techniques will likewise grow in strength as long as you keep devouring your prey, even if it isn’t the prey these techniques were initially from.
addons.title: Demonic Beast

addons.text:
The Golden Elixir was powerful enough to let you regain the ability to transform into your human form, and due to the golden core permanently enhancing your body from within, you can now cultivate passively.

Should you remain in your child-sized form you can accelerate the rate at which you cultivate by concentrating your energies within. You’ll still take several decades to grow to the next realm, but you won’t need to actively cultivate to do so.

If you were to rush your cultivation though, your bestial instincts could awaken pushing you into qi deviation, so take care to not act recklessly.
addons.title: Passive Cultivation

objects.text:
You’re a mythical beast, though due to being kicked out from heaven, you’re far below your peak level of power and have turned back into a child-sized version of your species. Despite this, you’ve still kept your personal ability. This power can range from giving others some good luck when petting you, having a gigantic stomach that could house mountains of treasure, or the ability to create jewels by regurgitated them after creating them in your stomach which grant temporary powers with matching drawbacks like flight that’s limited to low-latitudes when consumed, you also have an enhanced physical characteristic which can range from having wings that allow high-speed flight, incredibly sharp horns, a supernatural sense or immense strength. Your starting power is limited to peak human outside of your enhanced characteristic and ability, no matter which race you choose.

Without decades of cultivation, you’re unlikely to regain the ability to transform into your original form even temporarily, and it would take several centuries to permanently stay in it. This transformation would drastically enhance your physical characteristics and ability. Cultivating halfway to that point as well as fully regaining your original form would each unlock another one of your personal abilities, though it would still take centuries to get even halfway to that point.

With training, you can learn to transform into a humanoid form for a part of the day, though it will take years to permanently stay in this state. Should you be majorly injured, you’ll revert to your child form as it hastens your recovery and barely takes up energy to maintain. By consuming spiritually dense food, you can recover your cultivation more quickly. Other forms of exotic energies can also help, though at much lower efficiency.
objects.title: Mythic Beast (Fabulous Beasts)

objects.text: ”When you look at the night sky, you'll know that the glittering stars are praising you for your courage.” The seven Star Spirits from Paper Mario 64 have made you a beneficiary of their power. Each has a unique ability you can call upon individually at any time through prayer, calling their name, channeling their essence, etc. As well as varying personalities from the wise Eldstar, motherly Mamar, elegant Skolar, energetic Muskuar, charismatic Misstar, studious Klevar, and tranquill Kalmar. Unlike the game however, you can only call upon them once per day. Eldstar can restore a portion of your vitality and internal energies, as well as cure you from ailments like poison or curses. Mamar can sing a lullaby to put designated targets to sleep. Skolar can rain a storm of stars from the heavens onto your enemies. Muskuar can freeze and weaken enemies. Misstar can replenish and heal your body. Klevar can immobilize designated targets for a limited time Kalmar can transform a target into a star and make them fly away. Finally, by calling upon all of them at once, you can perform the Star Beam. A powerful blast of light that can turn the tide of battle, and even permanently remove any positive effects from your enemies. But you cannot call the Star Spirits again for the rest of the day.
objects.title: Star Spirits (Super Mario)

objects.text:
Your lineage has been blessed, granting you and all of your descendants a mystical connection to the astral realm that allows you to transform into a single spiritual animal. You can choose which one, but once chosen it can’t be changed. 

The form you turn into will be an anthropomorphic version of the animal and a lot larger than the animal you’ve chosen, how much larger varies from person to person. You automatically turn into this form if you experience strong emotions, especially those that heighten your adrenaline, this is the only way to transform into this form, although you can learn to control the transformation in time by controlling your emotions which with practice, will allow you to transform partially as well. 

This form has super durability, super strength and can leap great distances. Your transformation itself also generates colored smoke, depending on the intensity of your emotions this smoke can appear explosively and in great quantity enough to flip desks and even at your lowest emotional intensity allows you to ‘double jump’ and cushion your falls. Your hair will turn into the predominant color of your chosen animal even when you’re untransformed, and very strong emotions while transformed will make your eyes glow.
 
While you’ll unlock this form immediately, your descendants will only awaken it once they hit puberty. You’ll also learn of a ritual to store your mystical animal within an object so you don’t transform every time you feel strong emotions, though you can regain your animal by destroying this object. This ritual can also be applied to your descendants.
objects.title: Mystical Animal Lineage (Turning Red)

objects.text:
One of the fundamental forces of existence, fate, is firmly under your control.

Like most oracles, you have a unique way of perceiving the effects of fate on the world. You always passively see golden "lines of destiny" indicating various possible events and futures. You can follow a line of destiny to see the potential effects or ramifications of the corresponding event. However, you cannot turn this ability off. The moment you discover a murder, you see the exact clues needed to find and convict the killer. The moment you meet someone, you see the result of various possible conversations you could have. In combat, you are constantly aware of your opponent's next moves.

By default, your power shows you the most important and relevant events to yourself, but by expending energy, you can search for something completely unrelated or follow lines of destiny. The longer you follow a line of destiny, the further into the future you look, and the more intensive the power is. Looking too far into the future or at purposefully concealed events could exhaust your energy reserves and damage your soul.

Unlike all other oracles, you have the ability of [Fate Alteration]. You can influence events to be more advantageous to yourself or increase the possibility of particular futures. Normally, to conserve energy, this ability is used to make slight nudges to events over a long period to create the most favorable future for yourself. However, if you wish, you can expend more energy to create blatantly implausible events. Your enemy could suddenly have a stroke, find their weapon shattering for no reason, or miss all of their attacks. The more implausible an event, the more energy-intensive it is to cause. You can use your other ability to see the potential effects of a fate alteration before you make it.
objects.title: Eyes of Fate (The Art of Gold Digging)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to perceive, interact with, and commune with Seraphim—elemental nature spirits normally invisible to humans.

By forming spiritual bonds with these Seraphim, you can borrow a portion of their elemental power. These bonds also allow for Armatization, a fusion between you and a Seraph that creates a powerful hybrid form. 

In this fused state, your physical abilities are dramatically enhanced, and you gain access to further devastating elemental abilities. With a Water Armatization you could halt a raging river or with a Wind Armatization disperse a storm.

Beyond combat, this power allows you to sense malevolent or corrupting energy in the environment or within beings nearby, and purify it. You can also designate trusted allies as Squires, granting them access to your bonded Seraphim’s power, including the ability to Armatize.

With training and experience, you can bond with a dozen or more Seraphim and switch between them fluidly in battle. True masters of the Shepherd’s path can even fuse with multiple Seraphim at once, combining elements to create advanced hybrid forms with compound abilities—such as a storm-infused fire Armatization creating multiple  city-block-sized fire tornados. However, these feats are extremely rare and require extraordinary spiritual control.

Furthermore, this power is not without cost. The more malevolence you purify and the more bonds you maintain, the greater the burden on your soul. Without exceptional willpower and discipline, prolonged use can lead to spiritual collapse, coma, or even death.
objects.title: Shepherd (Tales of: Zestiria)

objects.text: You are a Singularity just like the main character and Captain Gran/Djeeta. This effectively means you are unbound by fate. As such, you are not restricted by the rules of the world or the God(s) who created it. Furthermore, since becoming unbound by fate or reality, achieving the impossible is within your capacity. What makes you different (than the MC) is that you have infinite potential, capable of growing stronger without any limits, as anything you do will enhance your abilities. You are also immune to fate and reality manipulation abilities. The final and most powerful ability is to defy God. This manifests anytime you face a god—they will lose their divine protections, making them as vulnerable as mortals, and their powers become less effective against you.
objects.title: Singularity (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text: You are the inheritor of the legendary Mibu Clan, awakening the true crimson eyes. These eyes have no pupils or irises—only brilliant red orbs that gleam like gemstones. You may return your eyes to normal at will. The crimson eyes signify the manifestation of perfect unity between body, mind, and soul. This harmony fortifies your body at the cellular level, strengthens your mind with spiritual energy, and awakens an innate bloodlust capable of suffocating those with weaker wills, though sheer determination can negate this effect. Your spiritual energy is vast, comparable to a great lake. Your body’s durability, strength, reflexes, and speed are intrinsically tied to this energy, growing stronger as your spiritual power develops. Your mind is reinforced to the point where you can process information from dozens of sources simultaneously and maintain multiple spiritual techniques at once. Spiritual energy flows through nature as freely as it does through you. By attuning yourself to this truth, you have opened your Crown and Root Chakras, allowing you to channel the spiritual energy of the world into your own. As a result, your recovery rate of spiritual energy is nothing short of phenomenal. As the heir of the Mibu Clan, you inherit all the knowledge, skills, and techniques they have amassed over centuries; although, you lack the experience to wield them fully at first. These arts include the creation of battle dolls, necromancy, spiritual surgery, blacksmithing, and numerous shamanic practices. You also know renowned martial arts such as Sekireigan, Mumyo Jinpuu Ryu, Mumyo Dai’onryu, Mumyo Saikyou Ryuu, and many more. Within every True Mibu, there is a demon who relishes in slaughter and destruction. Stirred by battle and intense desire for strength, True Mibus can awaken the demon within them and gain immense power in exchange for losing their sanity, becoming a mindless berserker called a Demon God. You can overcome the demon within you and absorb its strength as your own to wield it at your own leisure, which is signified by a red cross sign on your back appearing, the mark of a True Crimson King.
objects.title: Heir of the Mibu Clan (Samurai Deeper Kyo)

addons.text:
Awareness is still valuable for those who’ve become Practitioners, but instead of a raw talent that they may only partially enjoy, you'll now get access to the full brunt of it. Someone with an Evil Eye could start to cultivate it into a fearsome weapon, to turn their Sight into something complex and much more versatile, or devise tools to use it for rituals.

While a Gilded Lily could turn to the Collector Practice to steadily rise in strength as the collected magic items form patterns that increase their might as well as that of their items.

With the weight of your word now as heavy as it is, your Awareness follows in kind, solidifying into a magical talent that you can intuitively learn to its fullest extent.
addons.title: Aware Talent

objects.text:
You’re Aware. This means that you’re no longer completely bound to the world of normal Innocents, people that aren’t connected to the more esoteric natures of reality, and have instead taken a step into the world of the supernatural.

Being Aware has benefits, the most prominent of which is that you’ll be able to notice the supernatural, even in places where it might be deliberately concealed, and you’ll have a tendency to get involved into situations that align with your Awareness. Aware also carry powers of some sort, though what type you are is up to you. You could make up your own, or choose from the dozens of types that are known. Though some options are barred from you unless you have other powers that touch upon it.

Some examples would be: 
-The Skeptic, a type of Aware that is so skeptical of all the supernatural, that they actively dampen it when confronted with it, mostly by calling it out as being fake in some way. 
-The Evil Eyed, people with Evil Eyes who can use it on others, what kind of Evil Eye is up to you, though extensive use can lead to repercussions. 
-The Gilded Lily is a type of Aware that attracts magical items and can make use of them.

The type of Aware you are can greatly influence the type of creatures and people you’ll encounter, and makes you a lot more competent with your Awareness, a Skeptic might want to visit a famous haunted house to film a video and prove that it’s just make-believe, where them disproving that ghosts exist within actually makes them disappear.
Being Aware also carries some drawbacks, you’re less protected in the metaphysical sense as you’ve lost some of your Innocence, while normal Innocents might be ignored by the supernatural you’ll frequently become a target if there’s magical beings out on the hunt or looking for prey. You’re slightly affected by karma, and will get slightly better karma if you don’t lie. Being Aware also means that you’re in a sense ‘weird’, you’ll become somewhat of an outsider, it’s nothing overpowering, but strange happenings around you and others feeling that you're somewhat off can push people away, you also won’t be capable of being put into positions of powers, not unless your subordinates are part of the supernatural world. 

You also need to actually ‘stay’ in this middle between Innocence and complete Awareness of the supernatural as that’s the only place Aware can exist. If you dive into the deep end with the supernatural, learning all about it and using magic drastically removed from your Awareness you’ll lose the last of your Innocence and Awaken raw. Leaving you much more vulnerable to supernatural creatures, making you unable to lie without severe repercussions and making you lose most of the benefits from your Awareness, a Gilded Lily for example might start attracting magic items that are actively dangerous to them instead of something they can easily contain.
objects.title: Awareness (Otherverse)

objects.text:
The year was 1943. Our ship was stationed in Philadelphia and was equipped to generate an electromagnetic field that would make us invisible to the enemy. What happened instead, we were teleported to New York. In that process, my shipmates were fused to the hull of the ship. Embedded in the metal, screaming for help. I was destroyed. Forced to regain my physicality.

— Mischief

Cerebral Electricity (or Energy) is a mystery, what’s known about it on top of its implications, origins, and surrounding explanations of its existence creates an intriguing picture: In its totality, Cerebral Electricity is alluded by scientists to be sentient, reasons for it coming from “revealing itself” to the experiment mentioned above occurring in Philadelphia ensuing a paradigm shift in the world; Cerebral Electricity also appears to be more material and energetic at once, taking incorporeal and corporeal form, due to the most likely conclusion being an embodiment of a being’s soul and/or consciousness, turning this into a blend of spiritual energy with psychic characteristics. This can also transmute itself into any type of matter and vice versa, implying Cerebral Electricity is a fundamental block of reality. Whether being from an accident mirroring the Philadelphia Experiment or a twist of fate annihilating your physicality, you gain the power to manipulate and be comprised of Cerebral Electricity from your metamorphosis, capable of a variety of powers depending on your nature as a living being: shapeshifting to an absurd level, attaining immortality, and/or being indestructible, among others. Your subconscious desires and wants guide your form/appearance, powers, and demeanor from this metamorphosis, and who you truly desire to become. Some hang-ups may appear from this transformation, from the need to feed from the Cerebral Electricity of others (or any other equivalent being on an Alternate Earth, such as psychic or spiritual energy) to the desire to follow your innermost last desires.
objects.title: Cerebral Electricity (Interface)

objects.text:
You gain all the powers and abilities of Chris Gordon without any of his memories, this includes characteristics of vampire, werewolf, demon and angel. Your appearance becomes more physically attractive with striking violet eyes.

Your soul is now strong like an Archangel, making you nearly immune to any magic you do not wish to affect you. You are shielded from rituals involving parts of your body, preventing bindings and love spells. This also turns your blood into a potent healing agent.

You have complete control over your body, regardless of how strong or fast you become. Your regeneration is enhanced to the point that you can survive having a chunk of your brain destroyed. You possess near-endless stamina, do not age beyond your prime and unlike Chris, you are free from his immense metabolism; your body will not cannibalize itself for energy. Furthermore, all your abilities grow stronger over time.

You also gain the power of Aura, a violet energy of immense strength that is devastating against demons, making you the perfect exorcist. You can use your Aura to: Fire energy blasts, knock out electronics, transmute matter into other forms, neutralize explosives or toxins, move objects telekinetically, shape it into armour or other constructs and imbue items with protective properties against demons and infernal forces.

Your Aura is capable of annihilating hundreds in a single blast while sparing those you wish to keep alive. It allows you to create monomolecular edges over your body capable of cutting through anything, but depleted Uranium disrupts your Aura.

You can also summon a Giant hawk, which carries demons you have exorcised back to Hell. Your soul grants you the ability to see auras and souls in solid hues, sometimes streaked with other colours, and pierce illusions that hide them from mortal perception.
 
Occasionally, you receive visions of events involving supernatural beings. These visions render you blind until they pass, so they will never occur during combat. Some visions also grant you an advanced tactical view of an upcoming battle.

Additionally, you were injected with demon blood. This blood granted you a secondary consciousness that uses all your experience and abilities to fight autonomously and improve continuously. You have complete control of this persona, and if you wish, it can take control during combat, allowing you to become a passenger in your own body.

This persona will never act against your will, as it is a part of you, simply without hesitation and far more ruthless, remaining constantly aware of your surroundings. The demon blood also grants cloaking, creating a bubble of forgetfulness that can conceal you and nearby allies.

You also gain power from the werewolf and vampire`s virus, which grants you supernatural strength, speed, sense of smell, thermal and night vision. You become strong enough to rip apart armoured vehicles, run faster than the speed of sound and smell odours such as wet leaves, garbage and all kinds of foods. You also gain a vampire`s Energy Manipulation; these abilities include:

Propel distant objects away from you.

Draw distant objects toward you.

Reinforce your body like armour, making you nearly impenetrable

Reduce your body weight to almost nothing.

Stick to any surface using hands, feet, or any body part (similar to Spider-Man).

Push yourself away from other objects.

These abilities require training to master.
objects.title: God’s Hammer (Demon Accords)

objects.text:
You are one of the solar knights, a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos. Gravity and Light represent the extremes of these forces, which you can attune yourself between. At their core, Solarians are a philosophy and culture wrapped around a martial art and spiritual conduit. 

You begin as an aspirant, proficient in the use of most common weapons and armours. Attuned to either photon (the power of stars to emit heat, light, and plasma) or graviton (the power of stars to attract and imprison objects through gravity) and are able to swap between them by shortly meditating. These two attunements modify each of your abilities’ manifestations when attuned

Actually manifesting this power however, takes three distinct forms; The Solar Shot, a raw ranged blast, The Numbus, a layer of photonic energy that surrounds you over your armour to defend you from attack, and your Solar Weapon, a tangible and summonable weapon forged from the same photonic energy. This weapon can take a variety of forms, but while summoning it is near instantaneous, re-forging it into another form requires at least ten minutes of meditative concentration.

As you learn and grow in the path, you will grow more adept with the power afforded to you, developing and understanding a variety of skills and techniques to utilise it, Such as the Advanced Revelation: Defy Gravity, allowing you to soar into the air while graviton attuned or the Greater Revelation: Big Bang unleashing a wave of photonic fire while attuned to it.
objects.title: Solarian (Starfinder)

addons.text: You have become an Elfin, a kind of ageless immortal spirit born when enough spiritual essence congregates together and collects enough physical energy and matter to condense into an Elfin spirit. Elfins are similar to Undertale Monsters but superior in every conceivable way imaginable, and do not possess the weakness that Undertale Monsters suffer from. All Elfin have a true form which usually takes the shape of some kind of mundane or supernatural creature. An Elfins physical form is somewhat malleable and grants semi-limited shapeshifting, which allows them, with training, to assume a human form and even shift partially between their true form and human form, though until they master this ability, small bits of their true form will bleed into their human form, such as elven ears, tails, feathers, and similar non-human traits. Some Elfins may also possess the ability to alter their size and do other limited alterations to their form based on their species. As physical spirits, they possess physical bodies that are superior to humans, which vary in amount based on the species of their true form, with some being far stronger than others. They possess a level of innate resistance to any mundane non-supernatural weapon or source of damage, which includes sickness, disease, and even radiation. Interestingly, they can also survive the vacuum of space and do not actually need to breathe, but do still require food and sleep. Each Elfin also possesses some form of natural flight, usually by creating wings or through one of their personal powers, which allows a much easier, less energy-intensive form of flight. They can also understand any animal's speech and speak with them. All Elfins possess a natural aptitude for the usage of their Spiritual Realm and Spiritual Energy as it is a vital part of their existence, and without it, they will perish. Each Elfin also has a single innate Elemental Type power that typically ties into their true form's species. The rate of growth for their Spiritual Realm is naturally much faster and easier than that of humans. Elfins can consume the flesh and or souls of humans to grow stronger, which is usually heavily frowned upon, with the reluctant exception for species that have the mandatory need to do so. As a hybrid with an Undertale-style Monster this ability is vastly strengthened. By default, your true animal form is a mundane animal, but should you also purchase the Boss Monster (Undertale) upgrade, you may gain a more powerful animal form based upon a supernatural species. Also, you will no longer weaken yourself and make you lose your ageless immortality. Lastly, your true form and species may be influenced by any other powers you select.
addons.title: Elfin

addons.text:
You gain the knowledge and ability to craft all of the various spiritual items from the The Legend of Xiao Hei series and its side stories. This includes various kinds of weapons, armor, medicine, plants, and miscellaneous artifacts. Additionally, you also know the mechanics of creating Formations to create various effects. Interestingly, there exist numerous spiritual items that can be combined with normal technology, such as computers.

This includes items like the Qiankun bag, which is a bag with an artificial Spiritual Realm that can be used to store items and other living beings. The Blue Jade Plate is a kind of artifact that allows its user to teleport to preset locations or any place they can sense. Teleportation gates, which allow instantaneous travel across the world through a vast network. The mind Mirror pendant, which can detect if someone is lying.

Also, you gain extensive knowledge and skill in the cultivation and preparation of all manner of teas and drinks that any cultivator would love to drink in copious amounts.

Lastly, note that there is little that is not possible through spiritual crafting with the right materials, along with enough time and effort.
addons.title: Spiritual Artifice

addons.text:
The Zone, also known as Domain, is one of the most feared powers someone can awaken within the world of The Legend of Xiao Hei. The Zone is a Space Type power that allows its user to overlap their Spiritual Place onto the world around them. Its size is based upon the user's Spiritual Places power and size, which can potentially cover entire cities or more with enough power. While inside The Zone, you have complete dominion and control over everything and everyone inside, comparable to warping reality, which is only limited by your own skill and power. Once deployed, entry of others or escape from inside it becomes impossible unless you permit it.

As this version also possesses the traits of a Reality Marble, you gain extreme control over it such that you can partially summon it or use it within your body to drastically increase your control over your spiritual energy and greatly empower other innate Type powers you possess to incredible heights.

While The Zone's power is overwhelming, it also poses a major risk, as if anyone were able to damage it, your Spiritual Place will be crippled or even destroyed, which will result in you permanently losing your powers.

It is debated that the entire world of The Legend of Xiao Hei is, in fact, one ginormous version of The Zone by a figure which can only be described as god, since natively every Spiritual Place resides in another plane of reality, which each living thing shares a small fragment of. While your Spiritual Place is firmly rooted in your own soul, unlike the normal canon. This information implies that this is the power of the one true god and its potential, and that of any other Immortal is truly limitless.
addons.title: The Zone

addons.text:
Your one of a kind Soul has enhanced your Spiritual Place and your talent to a height never before seen, even by the greatest freaks of nature from the world of The Legend of Xiao Hei. This enhancement is to such a degree that you can bend the rules of this system into a pretzel that would baffle any other Immortal. As you reach unimaginable levels in power that would normally take millennia in a matter of decades.

Your Spiritual Realm will now grant you a single power from every one of the six Types. Additionally, thanks to your soul's ability to evolve and assist you in its fluid nature, the powers that your Spiritual Realm grants you gain a level of flexibility such that you can use each power in more than one way. Each of your powers will also be able to evolve and gain new traits and abilities over time when pushed based on what you need, further expanding how you can use them and ever expanding your combat potential.

Should you also possess the Freeform Style upgrade, the above benefits are not only drastically enhanced. But your Soul now gains the ability to birth entirely new Spiritual Realms, with each new one granting you an entirely new set of powers. Each of these new Realms feeds off of one another, drastically increasing not only your spiritual power but also their rate of growth to a ridiculous level. In addition, each of your Spiritual Realms may grow to hold any number of powers, or you may specialize a Spiritual Realm into only holding a single power to drastically increase its power and flexibility to unimaginable levels.

With this power, your potential becomes truly limitless, such that you will eventually evolve into a being best described as an immortal spiritual God who can do anything given enough time and mastery over your powers.
addons.title: Smart Realm

objects.text:
You have gained a Spiritual Realm from the universe of The Legend of Xiao Hei. It is said that every living thing possesses a Spiritual Realm, which is a personal universe within their soul that holds the life force and spiritual energy of a living creature. Each Spiritual Realm is unique, granting personalized powers based on the individual, along with generalized spiritual powers. Those who unlock and train their Spiritual Realms are known as Immortals (or Cultivators in layman's terms).

You can expand the size and power of your Spiritual Realm by absorbing and cultivating spiritual and physical life energy from the world around you, along with training your body and spiritual powers. With training, it is possible to enter your own Spiritual Realm where you are effectively a god and can do anything within it. You can then turn your Spiritual Realm into your own personal retreat that you may sleep in or invite others temporarily, though doing so places them under your mercy, and they cannot sleep inside of it.

Those who walk the path of cultivating their Spiritual Realm possess a great array of shared general powers and a number of personal powers unique to them. Generalized powers include vastly enhanced physical body and greatly increased mental abilities that can be further boosted with spiritual energy, potent physical and spiritual senses, telekinesis, which can be used with pinpoint precision, healing yourself or others, telepathy, flight, and the ability to project spiritual energy to form constructs, which are only limited by your skill and amount of spiritual energy. Lastly, by expanding the size and power of your Spiritual Realm, your lifespan will be greatly increased, up to becoming immortal.

Each Immortal possesses one or more powers that are usually based on the following six Types: Elemental, Instrument (spiritual objects), Creation, Spiritual, Mind, and Spatial. While rare, someone can possess a power that does not neatly fall into the six main categories. Whatever power(s) you unlock are completely random, but they will be deeply reflective of who you are as a person. Note that it is possible to learn how to use more powers from other Types, with the partial exception of the Mind Type and complete exception of Space Type powers, which are innately unique to their wielder, and training any new powers will take upwards of a century to reach the basics. As such, only some powers are deemed important enough to learn outside of their innate abilities, such as telepathy. Depending on what powers you possess, it may be possible to draw strength from them and replenish your spiritual energy, such as from a lake with a Water Power affinity. You may optionally have what powers you awaken be influenced by other powers you purchase within the cyoa.

You begin with the knowledge of the strength of someone who has completed their basic training. This grants physical, mental, and sensory abilities above peak human. Your lifespan is increased to a time span of multiple centuries at a minimum. Also, you gain a good grasp of the basics of the usage of your spiritual energy and whatever special power(s) you unlock, along with basic combat training and knowledge that would be expected of a disciple Immortal.
objects.title: Spiritual Realm Cultivation (The Legend of Xiao Hei)

objects.text:
You are one of the Deus Ex Machina, also known as Synthetic Gods—a race of artificial deities created to eliminate or subdue malevolent gods. Built to the same design lineage as Nezha, you were specifically engineered to hunt and destroy the aberrations known as Outer Gods.

All of your abilities originate from your internal system known as ORGANS. This system allows you to transmute your body into a wide array of weapons and advanced technologies: blades capable of wounding Sun Wukong, propulsion systems for high-speed flight, and powerful repulsor cannons. ORGANS also enables rapid self-repair, restoring your body from damage sustained in combat.

Under normal conditions, ORGANS is powered by an energy core located at your center. However, you can also absorb the force of enemy attacks and convert that impact into an alternative power source. In extreme situations, you may activate Code: Ashura, a multi-armed combat mode that repairs critical damage and vastly increases your strength—at the cost of burning through your remaining life force to sustain it.

Despite its power, ORGANS has limits. Your regenerative capabilities can be overwhelmed by sufficient damage, and there is a maximum amount of energy you can safely absorb. Exceeding that threshold risks catastrophic failure, potentially resulting in the destruction of your own body. Fortunately, you can be “revived” by having your core installed into a new body.
objects.title: Deus Ex Machina  (Record of Ragnarok: Gods' Apocalypse)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have acquired a talent, innate powers that are solely original to the New World, powers inherited from birth, carved into your soul; often considered to be on par with both martial arts and wild magic, especially when the ability is strong enough, and you have gained a talent acknowledged as one of the top 10 in the New World.

Psychometry, the ability inherited by Antilene Heran Fouche and now you that allowed for the user of the ability to possess the skills and abilities of someone by touching an item that belonged to them or that they have used in the past, this ability even allows its user to avoid restrictions on items such as being able to wield non magical weapons despite being a magical caster or items that would otherwise have restrictions on who can wield them such as holy swords you would be treated as the optimal wielder by any magical artifact that you lay your hands on being able to wield artifacts that would generally only have one viable wielder such as guild weapons. 

Once in contact with an item you can replicate the abilities that any wielder of said weapon has possessed to the same proficiency they had even if you had no experience with swinging a sword equipping an item by someone who was a master swordsman would transfer over to you all the proficiency and talent they had with swordsmanship over to you along with any other abilities they possessed including inherit racial trains such as the [goal of all life is death] that typically restricted to only being wielded by those who have the racial class [Overlord].
objects.title: Innate Talent: Psychometry (Overlord)

objects.text: The world you live in is not the same that everyone else inhabits. Not quite. There is the subtlest difference in character- the Heart of Humanity. You may welcome anyone who is willing to join you to cross that finest threshold into the reality you experience, and in turn so can those who have already joined. When it's better to be close, this separation is less than nothing, and when it's better to stand apart- when the very universe around you is dissolved or entire concepts struck from existence- you can say "no, we're not a part of that", asserting and upholding the undamaged state of the local cosmology without the negative effects of whatever so damaged it. The Heart of Humanity hates and denies that which erodes and disgraces meaning, choice, and personhood, weakening or nullifying such phenomena. Within its world, such things as perfect precognition, history rewriting time travel, and absolute mind control are simply impossible. Though it disdains manipulation, it may interfere in subtle ways to steer the world away from the darkest possible timelines. The Heart of Humanity declares that there is a hidden variable, an essence of spirit, buried deep within every person, and it imposes that too upon other powers, conveying a great deepness that takes time to fully reveal itself. For example, if mixed with a magic system it wouldn't give people infinite magical power, but it would provide boundless magical potential, the merger of Crystallized Law and Heart of Humanity would let people develop their self-mastery until (eventually) they fully control local spacetime, etc. Under the right circumstances, individuals may be empowered for the sake of heroism. An ordinary mortal might surpass their limits in a time of need. Growth can be unshackled. With sufficiently absurd mastery of this phenomenon, impossible heroes may be created from whole cloth, that share their strength and splendor with all who surround them. Note: This is based on a yet to be released work, with help from the Author.
objects.title: Heart of Humanity Universal Access (Horizon Seeker CYOA)

objects.text:
You inherit the full martial tradition of the Yeonhon Guild, a combat system that uses the soul as both fuel and weapon. Its foundation is the spirit flame, a fire generated by burning spiritual essence instead of physical matter. This flame integrates into every aspect of combat. You can channel it into punches, kicks, and grappling techniques, form it into armor that covers your body completely, expand it outward into shockwaves that strike targets across a battlefield up to 200 meters in radius, or condense it into precision attacks that cut through magical wards and reinforced steel. The flame manifests in four fixed forms with distinct properties: red flames amplify the physical force of strikes by fivefold, blue flames maintain steady controlled heat to maximize efficiency, white flames increase attack speed to ten strikes per second, and black flames bypass defenses by directly damaging the soul at the cost of burning away 1% of your own spiritual essence with each use.

Your offensive techniques break physical limits. Flame-charged punches fracture five-meter-thick granite, palm strikes collapse layered enchantments designed to withstand siege weapons, and aerial kicks detonate with force equal to modern artillery shells.
