You can hurl spirit flame projectiles to burn targets within line of sight, or manifest a dragon-shaped construct of flame with a wingspan of thirty meters that devastates formations before detonating with destructive power sufficient to demolish a fortress tower. Your mastery of pressure points allows you to paralyze limbs for thirty seconds, silence spellcasting for one full minute, or restore damaged energy flows by realigning them, restoring the target’s ability to channel Ki or mana within sixty seconds.

Training strengthens both body and soul. You can sense Ki and mana within a precise radius of twenty kilometers, detecting hostile intent and magical activity. Your movement exceeds the fastest Olympic sprinters by twentyfold, allowing you to reach speeds of 120 meters per second. You can leap thirty meters vertically, sustain airborne flight for up to one hour, and withstand direct collisions with building-sized monsters or tank-level impacts without lethal injury. Your endurance allows continuous combat for twenty-four hours without fatigue.

Once complete concentration is achieved, you unlock Spiritual Incarnation. In this state, your body dissolves into condensed soul energy, making you completely immune to all physical and magical attacks. Your strikes bypass armor, flesh, and enchantments, tearing directly at the enemy’s soul. This state lasts exactly five minutes of combat and requires a full day of recovery before it can be used again.

Your mastery extends into matter itself. Within a radius of one hundred meters, you can reshape solid, liquid, and gaseous matter. You can mold stone into weapons, vaporize rivers, collapse buildings by unraveling their bonds, or scatter projectiles into dust. Combined with spirit flame, you can super-heat blades to 2,000°C, disintegrate incoming magical constructs by burning away their anchors, or alter terrain mid-battle to create cover or traps.

Though the art was not originally designed for sorcery, it has been refined to merge with magic. You can bind spirit flame into spell structures, reinforcing fireballs to burn hotter and travel faster, coating barriers with flame layers that consume hostile spells, or stabilizing summoning rituals with martial precision. This integration ensures that no matter the nature of your opponent—sorcerer, warrior, or beast—the Yeonhon art gives you the tools to counter and overwhelm them.

This martial legacy carries echoes of Chiyou’s ultimate art, tempered through the Yeonhon Taiji and its doctrine of the Two Wills. When awakened, these teachings manifest as the Astral Protection of Taiji—an esoteric state where opposing forces are brought into balance and turned outward as both defense and motion. In this state, hostile energies lose cohesion, attacks falter before reaching you, and your presence alone exerts pressure on the flow of battle.

Your awareness expands beyond the physical, allowing you to sense and influence the movement of Ki, mana, and intent. Techniques can be disrupted at their source, power can be redirected or destabilized, and openings reveal themselves as if the world itself were slowing to accommodate your will. Movement becomes fluid and unbound, as though distance and inertia no longer apply in the same way.

Rather than overwhelming force, this aspect embodies control—of momentum, of energy, of the space between actions. It represents the harmony of destruction and restraint, a state where the practitioner no longer merely fights within the flow of battle, but subtly rewrites it.
objects.title: Spirit Flame Martial Legacy (The Gamer)

addons.title: Undying Soul
addons.text: The previous restrictions on your soul's restoration no longer exist. Now, no matter how severely your soul is damaged, even if it is reduced below One Man Soul or completely extinguished, it will always recover to its full 999,999,999 Man Soul spiritual foundation. Your soul's recovery is also greatly accelerated, requiring only one month instead of three to fully restore your complete spiritual foundation no matter the damage. You will no longer suffer the negative effects of existing without a soul so long as even a single Man Soul has been restored. Your emotions, instincts, and soul-dependent abilities remain fully intact throughout your soul's restoration, though the strength of your soul-dependent abilities remains tied to the foundation provided by the Man Souls you currently possess. Whenever your soul is damaged or destroyed, the quality of your Man Soul foundation improves as it restores itself. The greater the damage your soul endures before recovering, the greater this improvement becomes. Newly restored portions of your soul return qualitatively stronger than before, while the remainder of your undamaged Man Soul foundation gradually refines itself until every Man Soul shares this new level of quality. Through repeated destruction and restoration, this allows you to safely surpass the former human pinnacle of refinement allowed by a 999,999,999 Man Soul, as each individual Man Soul is continuously refined beyond what was once considered the limit of a single human soul, potentially allowing even a single Man Soul to withstand what would have previously required the combined strength of countless Man Souls.

objects.text: You were born with a soul of truly exceptional strength and quality, as rather than starting with a One Man Soul, your soul begins at the pinnacle of how strong a human soul can reach at 999.999.999 Man Soul, before Red Lotus Demon Venerable damaged fate anyway. With this, your soul becomes solid and is able to interact with the material world even without a material vessel. This also allows you to withstand the backlash from failure in refining gu with little worry, as your soul is simply strong enough to withstand the injuries it causes. This also massively amplifies any ability that depends on the strength of your soul, such as Soul Path methods, which often depend on the spiritual foundation, as well as Enslavement Path Methods, which put a burden on your soul depending on how many beasts you have enslaved to your will at any given time. Moreover, your soul has an incredibly powerful restorative ability, regardless of how injured or damaged your soul gets, as long as it doesn't fall below One Man Soul your soul will fully recover within three months time, regaining your 999.999.999 Man Soul spiritual foundation with a quarter of a year of rest alone. As you were naturally born with this unusually strong soul, you possess Human Path Dao Marks within your soul that negate the immense burden this would otherwise cause your material body. While the Desolate Soul stage is a way to enhance the soul beyond Hundred Million Man Soul, this is however noted to be the incorrect way to surpass the Hundred Million Man Soul stage, with the true method lying within the profundities of the Human Path.
objects.title: Hundred Million Man Soul (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text:
“Flawed Castings from a Perfect Mold” - Samuel

You have inherited the might and legacy the Nephilim, legendary hybrid warriors born of both angelic and demonic essences.

Though the majority of your true power remains sealed by ancient magic, bindings, and cosmic authority, your body is nonetheless reforged into that of a genuine Nephilim. You no longer age, are highly resistant to corruption, mind control, and soul-based effects, and can survive extreme environments with ease. Your physiology is superhuman: you can effortlessly lift and throw vehicles, outrun most cars, and endure catastrophic physical trauma, easily surviving anything short of sustained heavy military weaponry. You also gain the potential to use Darksiders’ angel and demon magic although you begin with no knowledge on how to said magic.

This form represents a Chained, Pre-Apocalypse Horseman, a beginning rather than an end. Your bindings restrict your true potential, but they are not absolute. Through continued combat, training, and experience, your sealed power steadily strengthens and refines, laying the foundation for future awakenings that will eventually elevate you to the level of a true Horseman of the Apocalypse.
objects.title: Chained Nephilim (Darksiders)

addons.text:
Now your simulated fight no longer happens in a white void unless you choose so. Instead, you can freely choose any battleground: from a desert, a forest, or even a perfect replica of a real city of your choice, though devoid of any people other than you and your replica enemy, allowing both sides to freely make use of the environment.

Optionally, you can choose to add animals to the environment to act as both another form of environmental hazard for both sides as well as a resource for Master powers.
addons.title: Simulated Environment

addons.text:
You can now conjure more than one replica in your simulation, as well as designate their alignment with you and each other, being able to arrange scenarios like fighting a group of enemies at once, two groups fighting each other, or even multi-sided conflicts with different factions fighting to be the last one standing. You can also set up groups to prioritize targets so that they might temporarily work together to attack another party before turning on each other, as well as allowing internal fracture within groups so that two replicas in one team that don't like each other may sabotage or even backstab each other under the right conditions.

You can also alter the condition the replica starts in. Whilst a replica normally appears in peak condition, alert, well-rested, well-fed and in perfect health other than any permanent conditions like Genesis being in a wheelchair, you can now also choose to have some or all replicas instead start exhausted, tired, sick, injured, hungry and thirsty, or inebriated to create a wider range of scenarios.

How well the replicas work together depends on the natural synergy between their originals. People used to fighting together, or even accustomed to fighting each other, will be able to work together seamlessly like a well-oiled machine, while those unfamiliar with each other or who have a strong dislike of each other may even get in each other's way or choose to act independently.

Optionally, you can now also invite other people into your simulation, both on your side and your enemy's.
addons.title: Group Simulation

addons.text:
The end goal of your simulations now no longer has to be the death of the other side. Instead, you can set any goal so long as it remains a competition. It could be anything from a fight to subdue the other, a duel to first blood, a Norse flyting, an armwrestling competition, a chess match, a push-up competition, a game of tag, or even an eating contest.

Thanks to the integration with Idle Trainer, Simulation Trial now shares its time dilation as well as you actually being able to absorb any benefit from adaptive powers you gained in the simulation as a gain earned through Idle Trainer.
addons.title: Expanded Goals

addons.text: Thanks to your ability to gain information from the past through postcognition, your Simulation Trial has gained a new function. Instead of only replicating your chosen opponent as they are this exact moment, you can now choose to fight them as they were in a previous point in the past. Aside from being able to fight older fighters as they were in their prime and wielding weapons and artifacts they may have given away or lost by now, this also lets you choose those who were previously ineligible for being selected as an opponent due to the fact that they have already died.
addons.title: Enemies of Bygone Days

objects.text:
You gain the ability to enter and leave a mental arena at will, a vast white blank space. In this space, you can name anyone whose name or appearance you know, and a perfect copy of them will appear within the space and come after you with the intent to kill. This is not the actual person but a perfect replica with all their strength, skill, personality, knowledge, powers, and the equipment they currently have access to and would take into combat. They will react exactly as the real thing would if they aimed to kill you, including banter if they're prone to using words in battle like Mouse Protector or Jack Slash. The battle will feel completely real, including pain and injury, but win or lose, after the fight is over, you'll find yourself back in the empty void completely unharmed.

The purpose of this space is to simulate combat against every possible opponent, both to see if you can actually win, as well as to familiarize yourself with their style of combat and bait out any aces in the hole they might be holding. Replicas do not feed information back to the original person, so you're the only one who is aware that anything happened.

The Simulation Trial cannot be used for in-depth interrogation, as the replicas can't be tortured for information; their reason for existence is purely to kill you. Occasionally verbally inclined enemies may let some nuggets of info slip during combat banter, though caution is required here too as the replicas can lie in their taunts just as freely as their original.

That said, there are some limitations. The replica is perfect but static. While adaptive powers like Lung's or Crawler's are reproduced in response to your battle, they cannot undergo a Second Trigger or experience similar experiences such as Breakthroughs for Cultivators, and neither can you as there is no actual threat. In the same vein, if you have any adaptive powers, any changes you've undergone through them will revert after the battle, as they too were only simulated.

Replicas exist solely to try to kill you, so while they may try to make space or even temporarily disengage to launch hit-and-run attacks, they will never try to flee; therefore, over-reliance on Simulation can lead you astray when the actual person reacts differently than you expected.

Also, as you're fighting in a white void, enemies that make use of the environment may not be able to fight at full capacity, though some material or creatures are provided for powers requiring such to work, so that, for example, terrakinetics or Bitch are not limited to charging you with nothing but their fists.

Finally, Simulation Trial does not have any form of time dilation. If you're fighting simulated battles for three hours, when you end the Simulation, three hours will have passed. Your real body lies prone during the simulation, potentially leaving you vulnerable to attack, though the simulation will be forcefully ended the moment your body suffers damage.

Of course, any information gained through Simulation Trial will become outdated if too much time has passed since the last time you fought an enemy. Tinkers and those with permanent adaptive powers like Crawler are particularly susceptible to this, as their entire load-out and style of combat could completely change within a month.
objects.title: Simulation Trial (Secretly Cultivate For A Thousand Years)

objects.text:
You are an apprentice in the arts of a demonic spiritual master. You begin with a soul and body strength comparable to the Silver rank. This means you are above the peak of human potential in all aspects.

You will have a single demon spirit housed within your soul. It will be of the same rank as you and can be any spirit either revealed or hinted at in the series. Alternatively, you may have your own custom version of a demon spirit, along with a set of martial arts techniques appropriate to its rank.

Unlike other practitioners, you have the potential to reach the Supreme rank over time, through training and cultivation. You also share the same potential as Nie Li, the ability to host multiple demon spirits as long as your soul can withstand the burden.

The first ability you gain is the power to summon your demon spirit as your personal minion. Its physical capabilities will be twice as strong as its master's. You can control your spirit remotely through the soul connection. With time and effort, you could even split your consciousness between your real body and any number of demon spirits you possess. 

The second ability is Integration. This allows the practitioner to fuse with and take advantage of the racial traits and supernatural powers of the demon spirit they possess. Their physical capabilities and powers are quintupled as a result. If you have multiple demon spirits, you can also create a chimeric version combining them, either fully or partially. You can control the level of transformation you undergo.

The third ability is the Cultivation Link. Whether it is the practitioner or the demon spirit, either one can grow, evolve, and rise in rank to match their partner. This removes the possibility of any stragglers in your ranks. Unfortunately, the same applies if one becomes weakened the other will suffer the same fate.

Last but not least is the most fundamental ability of a demon spirit master: the power to absorb the soul of a living or supernatural being regardless of its origin, and then transform it into a demon spirit form.

Not every soul you absorb will be a valid target for becoming a demon spirit. It depends on luck. Also, you cannot absorb souls that are clearly far beyond your own power such as trying to assimilate the soul of a divine being.
objects.title: Demonic Spiritualist (Tales of Demons and Gods)

objects.text:
You are an Immortal, a being unbound by age and death, fated to rise again no matter how many times you fall. Immortals are the eternal guardians of Aelion, a world where gods and mortals coexist under constant threat. Since the disappearance of the Greater God Aeli, Aelion has endured relentless invasions by hostile deities and alien forces from neighboring worlds, and it is the Immortals who stand as its last and most reliable line of defense.

To fulfill this role, Immortals develop highly specialized combat disciplines known as classes, each reflecting a unique approach to battle. These classes are broadly divided into three major roles—Damage, Support, and Tank—and include paths such as Cryomancer, Paladin, Lightbinder, Berserker, Archer, Necromancer, Slayer, Alchemist, Monk, Kinetic, Warlock, Knight, Gunner, Outlaw, Revenant, Grovewalker, Soundweaver, and Firestarter. Immortals are also not bound to a single class; they may freely change their discipline as long as they are not actively engaged in combat, allowing them to adapt to nearly any threat.

Like the gods themselves, Immortals can draw strength from belief. By gathering worshipers and accumulating Faith, an Immortal may ascend beyond mortality and become a Lesser God. Upon ascension, you gain a divine halo and the ability to assume a Divine Form—a vastly empowered state that doubles your size and allows you to switch between any class even in the midst of combat. This form consumes Faith to sustain, but the more Faith you possess, the stronger you become, and with sufficient devotion, your Divine Form can be maintained indefinitely.

Your ascension does not end with Lesser Godhood. By amassing ever greater numbers of worshipers or by defeating the Avatars of six Greater Gods, you may unlock the path to Elder Godhood. Upon achieving this final ascension, you stand among the strongest beings in all of Aelion—an entity of divine authority and power, equal to the goddess Ianna herself.
objects.title: Immortal (Skyforge)

objects.text: “Anatawa... Hitorijanai” You've inherited the spiritual ability passed down by the Hamato Clan founded by Karai, daughter of the Shredder. This power can be passed down to direct descendants, clones, or even those adopted into the Clan, via the Hamato Essence, a wellspring of Mystical Power & Life Energy/Chi that fuels the clan's techniques. It is an ability intrinsically tied to the bonds of family, and will grow stronger with the faith you have in your family. You can choose to light the potential for this in anyone you view as your family, though it must be awakened by their own connection & trust with you & your fellow clansmen. By default, you will have the same level of mastery & power as the Mad Dogs displayed before their final fight with the Shredder. You gain superhuman agility & speed faster than the naked eye can see, scale several vertical stories easily, with reflexes that allow you to perceive, dodge & react to supersonic movement, and make extremely high leaps with little effort. You gain superhuman vigour that lets you carry almost 10 times your body weight. You can endure full body fiery explsoions with minimal damage & attacks from bus-sized blades. A signature technique of Hamato Ninpō is the ability to transmute matter into either enrgy constructs or mystic weapons. The weapon's form is up to you, but the ability is a unique expression of yourself. Or you can choose to attune to an existing mystic weapon to gain its ability. You can also enhance existing objects. Finally, you have the ability to talk to your ancestors. Any clansman can contact them via either meditation or a ritual you now know how to perform. With time, you'll tap into the collective power of past Hamato Clan members, excluding their individual unique powers.
objects.title: Inheritor of Hamato Ninpō (Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

addons.title: Sovereign's Mind
addons.text: The effects of Lotus Sutra and Well-Adjusted have made you well accustomed to the mental strain which naturally comes with invoking the user's most cherished memories to manifest Mang, enabling you to use it far more often than any other person usually would. Furthermore, the intensity of emotion required for manifesting Mang has been lessened, allowing you to manifest 5 Mangs as a baseline.

addons.title: Vital Resonance
addons.text: As both Shin and Vital Instruments are borne from strong emotion, they have a natural synergy with each other. The abilities of your Vital Instrument can be enhanced by the usage of Shin and Mang as if it were your own body. Furthermore, you may use your Vital Instrument as a sort of focus, drawing from the emotions of the Vital Instrument to strengthen your Shin and reduce the mental strain of Mang.

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to utilize a form of energy projection known as Shin. By clearing their mind of thoughts and focusing on a specific memory, practitioners of Shin channel the emotions invoked by that memory into energy which can be utilized for a variety of purposes. It is a technique which naturally requires emotional maturity and stability. The most basic use of Shin is to strengthen one's body, increasing the speed and power of your blows while hardening your body against attacks.

However, the most notorious use of Shin is the generation of Mang, generated by isolating emotions from a user's most cherished memories and manifesting them as physical rings of light. Mang acts as an exponential force multiplier for attacks, with each ring multiplying the power of the last. 5 Mang would allow a normal human to causally reduce someone's head to a fine red mist with a lazy swipe, while that same swipe with 7 Mang could allow someone to obliterate a house with air pressure alone. 

The better that someone can process their emotions, the more Mang they can generate. You start out with the emotional maturity and skill to generate 2 Mang, with potential to grow.
objects.title: Shin and Mang (Project Moon)

objects.text:
You possess the power of the Robe of the Yellow Emperor, an ancient and dangerous supernatural force that was once contained within a sacred artifact rather than a person. But that changed when its power was transferred into your soul, destroying the robe in the process and leaving its might fused directly to your spirit. Spirits sense it instinctively, demons covet it, and the supernatural world cannot easily ignore anyone who carries it. What rests inside you is not merely destructive energy, but a force deeply bound to ghosts, the underworld, and the unseen boundary between life and death. Like the Yellow Emperor himself, this power carries an air of spiritual authority, hidden balance, and dangerous centrality, as though you were a living axis between worlds.

At first, this power manifests primarily as fire, erupting from your body in blasts, waves, arcs, and bursts of supernatural flame. In moments of danger, those flames can answer your fear or anger before conscious thought, making the power feel as instinctive as it is terrifying. Strong emotions such as fear, stress, grief, desperation, humiliation, or rage can trigger it on their own, causing it to flare violently and without warning when you are emotionally overwhelmed. While this can protect you in critical moments, it also makes the power volatile, exhausting, and difficult to direct with precision. Suppressing it does not truly weaken it, it only increases the pressure until it bursts out in a more dangerous form. Because the fire is part of your soul rather than a force external to you, you are completely immune to fire and heat generated by supernatural or mundane flames alike. Your own power cannot burn you, and flames that would maim or kill an ordinary person wash over you harmlessly.

The power also strengthens and transforms your body beyond normal human limits, granting you the durability to survive impacts, strain, and injuries that would cripple or kill most people, while also imbuing you with a potent healing factor. Broken bones, torn flesh, and other severe wounds can recover with unnatural speed, especially when the Yellow Emperor’s power is fully active. However, while this makes you far harder to put down, it does not make you invulnerable.

With training and greater emotional control, you gradually unlock the deeper aspects of the Yellow Emperor’s power. Your spiritual senses awaken first, allowing you to perceive ghosts, spirits, and other supernatural beings invisible to normal sight through a true third eye: a physical spiritual eye that appears upon your forehead and can be opened, closed, and controlled at will. When shut, it remains dormant and unobtrusive, when opened, it sharpens your awareness of spirits, curses, lingering emotions, hidden magic, and disturbances in the boundary between worlds. This eye is not merely symbolic, but a real supernatural organ through which the Yellow Emperor’s sight flows. In addition, the power grants you a natural affinity for magic and spiritual arts. Talismans, rituals, seals, wards, and other forms of sorcery come more easily to you than to ordinary people, and you possess the raw capacity to wield them, but affinity is not the same as mastery. You must still study, practice, and learn magic properly if you wish to use it with skill, safety, or depth. The power opens the door, it does not walk the path for you.

As your mastery grows, you gain flight, letting you move freely through the air, followed by more advanced abilities such as telekinetic force to push, pull, lift, and hurl targets at a distance, and portal manipulation to open or close gateways to the underworld, other spiritual realms, or points within the same world. Each new ability emerges as your connection to the power deepens and your control over it becomes more refined.

This power becomes stronger alongside your emotions, but true mastery does not come from being consumed by them. Rage can fuel it, fear can unleash it, grief can distort it, and love or determination can steady it, but the real challenge is learning to feel those emotions without letting them control your actions. The Yellow Emperor’s power rewards self-knowledge, discipline, and acceptance far more than brute force. You begin with only fire, while everything else must be earned through experience, training, hardship, and personal growth, just as Jentry had to struggle, suffer, and mature before she could truly claim the full extent of what was hers.
objects.title: Yellow Emperor’s Power (Jentry Chau vs. the Underworld)

addons.text:
What is a Lord of Pandemonium without their Hyakki Yakō? With this, every single member of your village becomes a member of your Night Parade, meaning every single one of them is at the very least adept in combat. Additionally, the strength of their Fear is no longer capped at 50% of your own, meaning some of them could be almost as strong as you.

These yokai can either be of your own chosen race or any combination of yokai ranging from kappa to Gashodokuro and Kitsune. Finally, you may choose whether they are half yokai like yourself or full blooded yokai. There is functionally no difference between the two aside from pure yokai being unable to use Matoi.
addons.title: Hyakki Yakō

objects.text:
Much like Rihan Nura, you are a half-yokai. As a half-yokai you have a human form and a yokai form. In your human form you’re no stronger than any human of similar fitness, but when in your yokai form you are strong enough to fight a small army of people, without needing anything else. Much like all yokai, you possess Fear, a power that grows the more feared or respected one is by humans.

The most basic aspect of Fear is to make a yokais presence bigger and more intimidating. When done correctly this can also change the surroundings in the form of fog. Every yokai species has a unique application of Fear, which can range from elemental control to illusions and even creating other yokai, though these abilities tend to be simplistic in nature. Additionally, while Fear is grown through fear or respect, it does not wane if humans no longer fear or respect you.

As a half-yokai you are able to use an ability unique to half-breeds called Matoi. This ability allows for the transference of Fear between another yokai and yourself. This can be done in two ways; Izutsu, where their Fear is mounted onto your weapon, allowing for great offensive power at the cost of being unable to use your own fear, and Kasane, where their Fear is wrapped around you like a kimono, allowing you to use both your own Fear and theirs as well. Using Matoi requires mutual trust between both parties.

You can choose what kind of yokai you are.
objects.title: Half-Yokai (Nurarihyon no Mago)

objects.text:
You gain the power of the Sequence 1 Esper, Data Fission. This power allows you to increase something in the exponents. Anything you or your powers come in contact with can be applied with Data Fission. Applied to yourself, it will instantly square your strength by ^2. Applied to the ground increases its quantity by ^2 and you gain complete control over it. You can control it to create less than ^2.

You can square powers you come in contact with, taking control over it and can turn it against opponents. While you can only increase a living being’s powers once, this is not the same for anything else. You can apply Data Fission on a fireball, increasing its power by ^2, then apply it again.

This power also allows you to splinter yourself off into a clone. What impacts the clone doesn’t impact you and vice versa, but if the clone is stuck in a time loop or something similar it may be disorienting. The clone will spawn near you or in a random location around you, and cannot be denied through powers that ban spatial abilities. You can only create one clone per additional exponent. If you can increase by ^2, then you can only have 1 clone body. If you can increase by ^3, then you can have 2 clone bodies.

If your power level is 100, under ^2, then it becomes 10,000. The stronger you are and the better you get, you can further increase this. From squared, to cubed, and even further. You get stronger based on the collective total strength you possess, not how strong Data Fission alone is. Data Fission is a unique power across even parallel universes, as there is only one, other versions of you would not possess this power.
objects.title: Data Fission (To Prevent Me from Destroying the World, the Country Sent People to Stick with Me)

objects.text: You have ignited your Dantian and started on the path to become an immortal. You begin at the First Stage of the Initiate Realm, among the weakest of Cultivators yet with the potential to one day Ascend into the Heavens. Cultivation is the act of taking in Qi, refining it, and being refined by it in turn until one becomes immortal. Qi enhances its user in a myriad of ways, and can be used to fuel Techniques ranging from simple physical boosts or heating up water all the way to attacks that can erase mountains or warp reality, with greater Techniques possible at higher levels of Cultivation and skill. All Cultivators find their Qi aligned with one or more of the five Wuxing Elements, with the expected type advantages and affinity for elemental powers. There are seven Realms known, each with five Stages. Upon either reaching a critical mass of Qi concentration or through achieving philosophical realizations one will breakthrough to the next Stage, with multiple simultaneous breakthroughs being possible. Each Stage is exponentially stronger than the last; while a First Stage Initiate may potentially be beaten by 10-15 skilled Mortal fighters, a Fifth Stage could practically walk through an army of the same. A fight between two Cultivators of different Stages will typically massively favor the one of higher Cultivation, though people of lower Stages winning is possible, with rare instances of people defeating those an entire Realm above them being known to happen. The known Realms are Initiate, Profound, Spiritual, Earth, Sky, Imperial, and Divine. An Initiate is simply a person with power; your stats are boosted by Qi and you're capable of basic Techniques, yet your flesh is still flesh and your bones are still bones. In the Profound Realm, your body begins to harden as your Qi starts to more permanently enhance you. In the Spiritual Realm, your soul strengthens and becomes more tangible, able to be worn as armor and ward off attacks, and the formation of a core, a mass of solidified Qi that is a catalyst for further ascension, becomes practical. In the Earth Realm, your body is completely remade, as your skin turns to jade and your bones transform into incredibly hard metal, though you still look human on the outside. In the Sky Realm, you gain the ability to create a Domain, a personal world that you can bring out similar to a Domain Expansion or Reality Marble. In the Imperial Realm, you become a walking mass of pure Qi as you refine your entire existence into something approaching a living concept or dao. And in the Divine Realm, you practically become a god, able to split continents in two and Ascend into the Heavens, though what awaits you from there is unknown. Presumably more Realms exist, but no one who has Ascended has returned to tell of them. Each Realm also comes with a boost to one’s lifespan. An Initiate can live about 150 years if they reach Stage 5. For the others, Profound can reach 250-300 years, Spiritual 400, Earth 600-700, Sky around 1000, Imperial about 2000, and Divine can reach 5000+ years. This may be different if you aren’t human depending on what you are, such as snakes instantly attaining a form of pseudo immortality upon Ignition. Some creatures even have their lifespan decreased by their Cultivation as it ‘burns’ them until they hit Spiritual. It should be noted that Cultivation has its own dangers and trials. You require sources of Qi to advance swiftly or even at all, such that being in a Qi desert may result in some Cultivators never reaching the next Realm. You must also keep control over your Qi, as strong emotional outbursts like rage, terror, or even happiness can cause its flow to deviate, causing minor bleeding from the mouth at minimum to outright organ ruptures at worst if you fail to control them. And if your Dantian is ever struck in the right way by another Cultivator or certain spiritual attacks, it may be punctured, shattering your Cultivation and forcing you to repair it and start over from scratch if you wish to continue advancing. In addition, Cultivation is slow, with even transcendent talents only reaching the Earth Realm after over a decade of Cultivation and slowing dramatically after that to the point that Shen Yu, one of the most talented Cultivators ever, took several centuries to reach the Imperial Realm and spent several more within it. Finally, frequently there are bottlenecks to growth that prevent Cultivators from ascending even with the proper resources, requiring major shifts in their understanding of themselves and their worldview to move past, though you at least won’t face this problem. Note: If you are in a world without Qi, you may still Cultivate as if you are in a low Qi environment such as the Azure Hills. This will allow you to potentially reach every Stage and Realm of Cultivation, but is several dozen times slower than normal, to the point that you will die long before Ascending if you have no other means of increasing your lifespan.
objects.title: Dantian Ignition (Beware of Chicken)

objects.text: Touched by the light of God, you gain the ability to generate and control high-density spheres of destructive energy at no cost, similar to the power wielded by the Homeless Emperor. These luminous orbs can be created instantly around your body, suspended in place, or launched in rapid succession at targets within your line of sight. Each sphere is formed from condensed energy rather than physical matter. They detonate on impact, producing concentrated blasts capable of tearing through structures, overwhelming groups of enemies, or saturating an area with repeated bombardment. Their output can be adjusted, allowing anything from small precision shots to large explosive bursts that carve mountain sized trenches. Your control is highly refined. You can maintain innumerable active spheres at once, alter their trajectory after launch, and coordinate attacks from several angles simultaneously. They may hover around you as a defensive screen, remain suspended as delayed traps, or be fired continuously as sustained pressure. Unlike physical projectiles, these attacks possess no recoil and no conventional ammunition limit. Your multitasking ability extends based on how many you have summoned at once, thus so as long as you have the focus and desire to sustain them, the bombardment can continue. At its core, this power is simple but dangerous: rapid creation, precise control, and overwhelming destructive output from pure condensed energy. If you had the desire and a month or two to spare you could carve out an entire planet.
objects.title: Divine Light (One Punch Man)

objects.text: "Experience Tranquillity." A unique energy formed from the sacrifice of the first sentient Omnic, Aurora. It is worshiped by the Shambali faith, a symbol for spreading compassion, love and unity between all sentient creatures. When Aurora died, she is believed to have transcended consciousness itself and became a shining light to those who come after her. Those who follow teachings of the Shambali faith can suffuse their body with the light of The Iris to increase their awareness, strength, speed and durability. Additionally. they may also project orbs of harmony or discord which heals or harms those they wish. Another facet of these orbs is the ability to bring even mortal enemies together or cause strife between the closest of friends. At the peak of your power, you may use all of your the stores of the light of The Iris to become almost transcendent. In this state, you are invulnerable and immune to poison, hacking and other such maluses of the mind and soul. Finally, you stand as a master martial artist from the Overwatch franchise.
objects.title: The Iris (Overwatch)

objects.text:
Created by a supposed monster deemed traitor to the cultivation world, and inaccurately called "Demonic Cultivation" by those whom do not understand its true essence, the real power of the Ghost Path is all about the utilization of the resentment that holds together a ghost. These negative emotions that binds their spirits into the living world. That is the very power a master of the Ghost Path wields.

This path is unorthodox compared to other cultivation methods as this does not require the use of a Golden Core, which would normally be the source of your qi and thus your cultivation. This is actually a quick and easy way to cultivate compared to orthodox cultivation due to its accessibility. You only need to call upon the many spirits in your surroundings, and with them, you can empower your attacks, summon animated corpses, create paper effigies with souls attached to them, and so on. All the while, surprisingly, not harming the soul. Gentleness is actually encouraged in this technique, as you are now the deliverer of the dead, freeing the souls from their material shackles and leading them to whatever comes next.

That is unless, you wish to be truly despicable? For this technique can also forcefully rot a living person's body, turning them into zombies under your thrall. This is the true evil that people fear this technique could possess. It is only up to you whether or not to utilize that.
objects.title: Ghost Path Cultivation (The Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation)

objects.text:
You have acquired the Double Eye Pupil, which forms two pupils within each eye. Even before active techniques are used, you are able to see through spatial formations, magical arrays, optical illusions and disguises. You also gain enhanced spiritual power and extreme comprehension towards concepts, laws, Daos, skills, techniques, and countless other disciplines. At its peak, it can easily see through all the laws of the world.

The active abilities it grants are as follows:

First, upon activation, the Dual Pupils emit an oppressive, overwhelming pressure that scales with your strength, growing more powerful as you do.

Second, the right eye releases a thick beam of pitch-black light resembling fires from hell. This beam dissolves incoming magical attacks, divine constructs, energy-based defences, and it distorts the void itself.

Third, the left eye produces a restorative white light, serving as regenerative force. It rapidly heals injuries, restoring bones, muscles, and internal organs almost instantly.

Fourth, the user’s perception of time slows dramatically. Fast movements and techniques break down into visible sequences, while the flow of energy within an opponent is revealed before attacks are even released. This enables precise prediction of trajectories and impact points.

Fifth, the pupils emits a dense, expanding white mist. This fog obscures both physical and spiritual perception.

Sixth, the user projects a miniature spherical pocket dimension with a radius of one yard around themselves, creating a self-contained “Pure Land” that exists independently of conventional space-time. While still visible externally, the user’s body is effectively isolated within this separate dimension.

Seventh, the eyes glows as ancient runes spread across the user’s body, forming a full-body armor of condensed chaotic energy.

Eighth, both pupils synchronise and rotate, merging Yin and Yang energies into a single vortex. The left eye releases white Yang energy while the right emits black Yin energy, which together destabilise the fundamental balance of any target, reducing matter and techniques to formless dust.

Ninth, the user manifests and launches tangible energy weapons—most notably golden halberds infused with primal power. 

Tenth, when unleashed, the eyes erupt with blinding brilliance, firing a beam of raw, hyper-condensed primordial energy that strikes towards whatever the user looks at. 

You have complete control over the double eye pupil and can activate or deactivate it at will. These eyes are entirely free of any drawbacks and carry no negative effects on your body, mind, or soul. They operate using any form of energy you possess or acquire, including stamina. They suffer no strain or fatigue even during prolonged, uninterrupted use.

The more powerful you become the stronger the abilities of the the double eye pupil will be. When completely mastered you will be able to merge the pupils of the eyes into one, and vastly amplify their powers.
objects.title: The Double Eye Pupil (Perfect World)

addons.text:
As with any ceremony or ritual, its participants are bestowed with something that distinguishes them from others. In your case, it elevates your existence to the same level as the Angel who chose you.

As a result, you have become the same kind of existence as the Angel who safeguards your well-being. You do not merge with them; rather, just as you gained access to the powers that only an Angel can wield, you have also gained access to the rest of their abilities and enhancements. In turn, your Guardian Angel undergoes an even greater empowerment, becoming practically twice as powerful as before. For example, if they previously possessed a factor of 25 in all capabilities, they now possess a factor of 50.

Additionally, your Guardian Angel gains access to a pair of Wings of Freedom and three times the number of Arrows of Will. This number is doubled again if they receive the Sacred Guardian and Divine Guardian upgrades.
addons.title: God's Vestment

objects.text:
One of God's thirteen angels has chosen you as a God's Heir. You are, in essence, the heir to God's throne. Normally, this would mean there are other heirs competing for the same position. However, in your case, you are the only one, and you do not need to undergo any trial to prove your worth. As an heir, you gain access to two powers that normally only Angels are capable of wielding:

Wings of Freedom: You are granted a pair of wings that allow you to fly. Their appearance is fully customizable, and you can decide who is able to see them and who cannot. At a basic level, you can fly at up to Mach 1, with an instinctive understanding of aerodynamic control sufficient to compete with fighter aircraft. With time and training, you would gradually reach the speed of light, achieving such extraordinary aerial maneuverability that few could rival you.

While flying, both your body and wings ignore air resistance, gravity, and the weight of anything you are carrying, whether by your hands, telekinesis, or any other means. Finally, your wings possess enough durability to protect you from a point-blank shotgun blast. Their defensive strength scales alongside the increase in your flight speed.

Arrow of Will: You possess thirteen red projectiles and another thirteen white ones that can take any shape, but can only be as small as the palm of your hand and as large as your own body. You can telekinetically control these projectiles, whose speed and durability are half of what your Wings are capable of achieving. The special effects of both the red and white projectiles are consumable and replenish three days after being used.

The red ones are known as the Arrow of Love. Anyone pierced by one is subjected to an eternal and unbreakable love toward the bearer of the arrow, causing them to obey any command given by its owner while still retaining their personality, intelligence, morality, and free will. Keep in mind that this is not direct mind control, but rather the imposition of pure and eternal love. Furthermore, that love may manifest in many different forms, ranging from familial affection to more twisted expressions such as fanaticism or yandere-like obsession. The exact nature of the love depends upon the victim's relationship with the arrow's bearer.

The effect lasts for exactly 33 days before the victim returns to normal. They will remember everything that occurred while under its influence, but without the imposed eternal love. This projectile can affect any entity except those who are near or fully within divine territory. If you use it on yourself, you may create a Geas of your own design, though you will not gain eternal love for yourself.

The white ones are called Arrows of the End. They are truly intangible, designed to relentlessly pursue their designated target regardless of the obstacles they encounter. Keep in mind that they are not absolute arrows; their ability to damage a target depends on your own physical capabilities. For example, with half the defenses of your Wings, you can damage mundane objects or entities, but you cannot damage anything that surpasses your own defenses.
objects.title: God's Heir (Platinum End)

objects.text:
You have acquired and awakened the Heart of Snow Glazed Glass. This grants you an extraordinary mind and unparalleled perception, allowing you to perfectly remember and recall anything you have seen or heard even once.

You will also have all of your natural senses enhanced to an extraordinary degree, you will be able to perceive the threads of fate, see through even the greatest of illusions, and perceive the world as it truly is.

You gain an instinctive sense of danger, allowing you to perceive threats in any situation before they manifest. You can gaze into the hearts of others, discerning their true nature and determining whether they are good, evil, or anywhere in between.

The Heart of Snow Glazed Glass also nurtures and strengthens your soul, causing it to grow stronger with the passage of time. This growth occurs naturally and requires no conscious effort, yet it remains wholly subject to your will, allowing you to halt or resume it whenever you desire.

Though the soul may grow, the physical body remains bound by its own limitations. Should the power of your soul surpass what your mortal vessel can endure, it may result in various physical or spiritual side effects.

Finally, this power grants you monstrous levels of comprehension toward concepts, Laws, Daos, skills, and countless other disciplines. Even the most complex ideas, codes, patterns, and mysteries can be unravelled before your gaze. You are capable of understanding any technique, whether or not you possess the means to use it, including those restricted to specific bloodlines, races, unique constitutions, or other exclusive requirements.

This version of the Heart of Snow Glazed Glass can be possessed by both men and women. It is completely free of any drawbacks, has no connection to the Ancestral God, and carries no negative effects on your body, mind, or soul. Its power is entirely yours to command, granting you absolute control over every aspect of its abilities with flawless precision and unwavering mastery.
objects.title: The Heart of Snow Glazed Glass (Against The Gods)

objects.text:
You have learned to wield your life force and convert it into one of four derivative energies: Prana, Mana, Aura, and Force.

Each energy is naturally suited to a particular combat role, though sufficient creativity and mastery can overcome these limitations and allow it to be used in unconventional ways.

Prana

Prana is primarily used by priests and spiritualists to perform spiritual arts. Rather than altering existing natural phenomena, spiritual arts materialize something that does not normally exist by imposing the user’s belief upon reality.

Prana can be used to heal injuries, strengthen allies, and create solid barriers for protection. For this reason, most Prana users serve as backline healers and support specialists.

However, they are not restricted to this role. Powerful Prana users can enhance their own physical abilities and shape their barriers into weapons or constructs, such as bows, spears, shields, or enormous fists. In theory, a skilled Prana user can become an even more effective defensive fighter than an Aura user due to their ability to heal themselves and continuously generate protective barriers.

Mana

Mana is used by magicians to cast magic, creating phenomena that would not naturally occur by manipulating the elements, twisting logic, and altering the principles of reality.

It is the most versatile of the four energies and is theoretically capable of accomplishing almost anything. However, using it effectively comes with several major disadvantages.

A mage must possess extensive knowledge of magical theory and understand the principles behind any spell they wish to cast. Most also require a catalyst or focus, such as a staff or wand, to channel Mana efficiently and increase the power of their spells. A mage deprived of their focus is therefore significantly weakened.

More powerful spells generally require longer casting times, leaving the mage vulnerable while preparing them. Unlike the other three energies, Mana also provides little direct enhancement to the user’s physical abilities.

Aura

Aura is primarily used by warriors and martial artists. It greatly enhances the user’s physical capabilities, particularly their strength, durability, and endurance.

At higher levels, Aura can be projected beyond the body by releasing or absorbing energy. It can then be shaped, hardened, and sharpened into attacks, weapons, or extensions of an existing weapon.

A person’s Aura grows through hardship and the body’s efforts to adapt and survive. However, it is the most primitive and inherently destructive of the four energies, requiring extremely precise control to use advanced Aura techniques safely and effectively.

Force

Force is most commonly used by magic swordsmen. It possesses properties similar to electromagnetism and greatly enhances the user’s speed, reflexes, and mobility.

Force users often wield several weapons at once, controlling them remotely through electromagnetic attraction and repulsion. They can also release lightning, propel themselves at tremendous speeds, or levitate through principles similar to those used by magnetic trains.

Although Force is especially effective when combined with weaponry, its electromagnetic properties allow for a wide range of offensive, defensive, and movement techniques.

Ordinary Latians and otherworlders can normally develop only one energy type beyond a certain level of mastery. As they train, their life force is gradually and permanently refined into that chosen energy, preventing them from learning the others.

Should you choose to purchase more than one of the energy you will suffer from no such restriction.

You may instantly convert your life force into Prana, Mana, Aura, or Force whenever you wish. You may freely switch between them during combat or wield multiple energy types simultaneously, allowing their abilities to complement one another.

You begin with basic proficiency in all four energies and possess reserves and power comparable to a level-20 individual—the approximate strength of an average adventurer or a newly arrived otherworlder; those at this level are a bit beyond peak human capabilities and step into the realm of superhuman letting you able to fight big animals such as an elephant and come out on top.

Should you master any of the four energies to their absolute limits, it may become possible to refine them into divine power. However, even an extraordinarily talented individual would normally require decades, if not centuries, of rigorous training to achieve such a feat.
objects.title: Four Energies (Latna Saga)

objects.text:
By taking this power, you have achieved the Elementary Stage, the first stage of Heartforce, and begun cultivating a unique and incredibly rare form of power. Heartforce is the energy born from the mental and emotional power of living beings. Unlike traditional cultivation paths, Heartforce relies entirely on the user's mental fortitude and self-understanding rather than external energies.

Heartforce cultivators need to establish their Heartworld with their insights into the Dao, refining and perfecting them until they become increasingly real. The more stable the Dao, the larger and stronger the Heartworld grows. When a cultivator's Heartforce becomes powerful enough, it can influence reality itself, creating a singularity where what is real and what is false can collide.

Heartforce can be infused directly into weapons and techniques, multiplying their speed and destructive power. It can also influence the physical world itself, enhance the strength and precision of one's soul, amplify the power of illusions, and affect the hearts, minds, and spirits of others, overwhelming their emotions or imposing one's will upon them.

At the very peak of this path, illusions can be transformed into reality, allowing the cultivator to create tangible matter through thought alone. The cultivator can also project their Heartworld to crush, suppress, or restrain their opponents.

As you advance in cultivation, you will have to face Tribulations. You are guaranteed to safely overcome all such tribulations, provided that no outside party interferes during them.

Heartforce cultivation progresses through six stages:

Elementary, the fundamental foundation. This stage is notoriously difficult to achieve, and failure here means a cultivator can never become a Heartforce cultivator.

Iceheart, reaching this level means being able to detach your heart from your body of flesh and rise above worldly temptations. This way, your heart remains a still pond as if it's been frozen solid.

Ruler, by reaching this level the cultivator achieves spiritual supremacy over their fate and emotions.

Mortal Dust, though one comes from mortal dust, their heart rises towards the heavens. Understanding that you're are nothing more than dust, and desire to ascend into the heavens with limitless ambition. At this stage, one can also spread out their heartforce to sense their surroundings. This heartforce sense can spread much farther than divine sense and is almost impossible to detect unless someone also has stage four heartforce or above. 

Truth. At this stage, the cultivator's mind is completely unclouded. They perceive the "truth" of their own heart and can instantly see through complex illusions, formations, and deceptive techniques that would trap ordinary cultivators.

World, the absolute pinnacle of Heartforce cultivation. Once your Heartforce reaches this stage, all of your Heartforce will pool together within your sea of consciousness to create a literal Heartworld. If your Heartforce is strong enough, it can affect reality itself. From this point onward, the Heartworld's size, stability, and power grow in proportion to the strength and stability of the cultivator's primary Dao.

To aid in cultivating Heartforce, you also acquire the Daoheart Technique. This technique can be practiced at any level of power and subjects the user to tremendous agony to temper and strengthen their Dao Heart. This pain will never kill you or do any permanent or long-lasting damage to your body, mind, or soul.

Different from the original cultivation version, even if you don't use Heartforce to reach the Eternal Emperor stage, your Heartforce World will not perish after 108,000 chaos cycles.
objects.title: Heartforce Cultivator (Desolate Era)
Head of the Pyramid (The Power Fantasy)
objects.text:
You have the same powers as Jacky Magus. All the fundamental truths of the Power Fantasy universe are instantly uploaded into your mind, including a true comprehension of infinity, among many other things. All of this knowledge is perfectly compartmentalized and compressed so that it is neither overwhelming nor a threat to your sanity or mental well-being.

Just like Jacky Magus, you possess absolute and complete theoretical knowledge of The Power Fantasy magic, including how to game its underlying rules. You can, for example, create a pyramid scheme in which recruits are trained and taught magic by you and, upon joining your organization, allow you to tap into their own magical reserves as though they were your own, or even burn them up entirely to fuel your miracles and rituals. 50k disciples grant you Superpower status: your raw power and miracles make you capable of surviving an attack from another Superpower, including continent-busting attacks, and retaliating with an attack of the same magnitude. 250k disciples allow you to perform the same kinds of feats as Magus during the Second Summer of Love, such as instantly extracting the souls of 700 million dead people, gathering them into a psychic bundle, and sending it across the cosmos to colonize a distant planet, though such a miracle requires burning tens of thousands of disciples as fuel. 

However, should your disciples get killed by an enemy or another, you will lose all your capacities and will need to build back your organization. Your power directly scales with the number of recruits under you (without any disciple, you are basically a street-tier wizard that can telekinetically levitate his TV remote and other tricks of the same magnitude).

Your magic allows you to accomplish virtually anything, ranging from flight and telekinesis to invisibility, mind control, matter transmutation, dimensional shifting, divination, scrying, chronomancy, hardlight generation and manipulation, healing, shapeshifting, precognizance, plant manipulation, soul manipulation, power analysis, and the creation of countless magitech devices, weapons and vehicles. There is virtually nothing you cannot do, provided you have the time to prepare the necessary ritual or craft the appropriate Numinous device, as well as acquire the magical resources required to fuel it. The only exceptions are a handful of supernatural effects that fall under hellish magic, such as teleportation and space-warping. In essence, you trade the immediacy and raw scale of the other Superpowers' abilities for an unparalleled breadth and versatility of capabilities, at the cost of requiring preparation time for your rituals, unless you sacrifice disciples to manifest their effects immediately.

Even though your magic fundamentally taps into the Power Fantasy local cosmology, more specifically the Heavens and how the Power Fantasy reality is wired, it can be taught and used (by you or your disciples) in any other setting, no matter what.

objects.title: Angel (The Power Fantasy)
objects.text:
You share the same powers as Valentina. Your punches pack enough power to obliterate continents, and your body is resilient enough to withstand attacks of similar magnitude. You can pass harmlessly through storms that tear atoms apart like confetti, live without oxygen, and endure environments with lethal temperatures or radiation without any discomfort. You can fly fast enough to circle the planet in a matter of seconds or cross cosmic distances by gradually accelerating beyond what the known laws of physics allow, to the point of traveling half the observable universe in a matter of days. Your mind is a fortress, completely immune to mind reading and mind control.

You also possess Valentina's angelic sight and the vast array of vision-based abilities it grants. You can see virtually anything you wish, including pinpointing the location of a single planet half a universe away. You can instantly scan an entire continent from high orbit to assess the condition of every human on it. You can perceive things that are invisible to others, such as threads of telepathic influence, and even gaze upon a person's very soul while it is trapped in another dimension. You are also capable of firing giant beams of holy energy from your eyes with enough power and precision to strike a target on the other side of the planet.

Finally, you possess limited dimensional abilities that allow you to open portals at will between reality and adjacent planes, such as Heaven and Hell, and close them.

objects.title: Embodiment of Surprise (Surprise Attack – Unknown Superheroes)
objects.text:
You become the living incarnation of Surprise—a conceptual force that governs the unexpected, improbable, and unforeseen. Reality subtly bends around you, arranging events so that outcomes become astonishing, ironic, or completely unpredictable. Unlike ordinary probability manipulation, your abilities function through the metaphysical principle that the universe itself "prefers the unexpected."

Your powers activate when you genuinely experience surprise or deliberately cultivate a sense of anticipation for an unforeseen outcome. The greater the surprise involved, the greater the effect reality is willing to accommodate.

When activated through genuine surprise, you may instantly relocate, and If you suffer a fatal injury, your connection to the concept of surprise may trigger an unexpected return.

objects.title: Your Color (Genshin Impact)
objects.text:
Your soul has awakened the ability to act as a medium, using your emotions and memories as its Color. Deep within your soul you generate Neutral Color. While limited on its own, its true potential is unlocked when it’s turned into your Personal Color, formed from the infusion of your emotions and memories. Through this fusion you express your Color upon the world to manifest diverse techniques and powers, limited only by your imagination.

Neutral Color dilutes existing phenomena, returning them to a basic state. It can weaken attacks, calm emotions, or diminish a target's strength. True power emerges when using Personal Colors, which allow you to exert unique effects on reality. You can apply Color to surfaces, objects, or the air itself to produce your desired outcomes.

A happy memory painted as a flower can alleviate despair, while greater mastery allows it to purify corruption, evil, or darkness. Emotions of justice and vengeance can coat weapons to increase their effectiveness against wicked beings, while longing and yearning can paint portals onto surfaces for long-distance teleportation.

Your achievements depend on three factors: the strength of your soul (which dictates the quality of your Neutral Color), the intensity of your emotions and memories, and your artistic skill. You can refine your soul quality by creating art, enduring challenges, and deepening your connections with others. Experiencing unique memories expands your palette, and connecting with people allows you to learn and use their Colors, letting you mimic their abilities. 

With sufficient mastery, you can bring paintings fully into reality, wielding your creations with far greater effect. High enough soul quality, skill, and the right Color could allow you to forge pocket dimensions as vast as the universe or draw your imagination onto reality. As your skill increases, you can blend multiple Colors into single creations to produce complex effects or develop unique techniques. Your artistic skills start at a professional level and possess no growth limit. You are also exceptionally gifted as both an artist and a wielder of Color, mastering these abilities at an accelerated pace.

Initially, your power operates at a city-block level and you can only weave a few Colors into a single painting at a time. This power does not consume emotions or memories, though overuse can result in feeling drained, which can be prevented by having a stronger soul.

objects.title: Soulweaver (Artix Entertainment)
objects.text:
You have learned the art of Soulweaving, first created by Baltael and later taught at Edelia.

Soulweaving is a crafters art, using your Spirit Looms - a special pair of gloves, you can weave spirit threads into various objects with magical properties, such as a cloak that can conceal an armory, or a pair of shoes that can allow one to run on any surface. Soulweavers can also weave with another's soul as long as they are not resisting the process, to create objects bound to them.

But as you are currently a novice, you can only create small objects with simple effects, such as a pair of gloves that never lose grip, or goggles that can see through darkness.

All Soulweavers are partnered with an Elemental Spirit who aids them in their weaving, and you are no exception.

Your partner is made of an element and at least one aspect, such as Ice and Valor, and may evolve under specific conditions.

addons.title: Chaosweaver
addons.text:
You have learned the art of Chaosweaving, the method to use Soulweaving for combat.

As a Chaosweaver, you know how to strike at a person's soul, creating loose spirit threads that you may use to further unravel their soul.

addons.title: Soulsmith
addons.text:
In addition to your weaving prowess, you have learned the art of Soulsmithing.

As a Soulsmith, rather than creating an object with magical properties, you bind Elemental Spirits into objects to give them a degree of sentience.

Some examples are: A weapon that will respond to the wielder's will, an amulet that warns the wearer of danger, or a pouch that provides what the user needs from its contents.

objects.title: Strayed One (Dao of the Bizarre Immortal)
objects.text:
You have become a Strayed One, an incomplete existence possessing both form and essence, yet forever touched by the Primordial Breath. Unlike ordinary people, your heart is filled with an unending sense of Bewilderment, a fundamental contradiction that separates you from the rest of the world. Though this state would ordinarily fill one's life with confusion, doubt, and suffering, this power ensures your mind remains your own. You retain your memories, personality, and judgment, sparing you from the constant hallucinations and identity crises that plague others of your kind.

The Primordial Breath flowing through your body is your greatest source of power. Through dedicated cultivation of the Dao of Truth, you gradually learn to impose your own certainty upon reality itself, turning falsehoods into truth. At first your alterations are modest, changing the properties of simple objects or briefly manifesting harmless illusions as tangible reality. As your mastery deepens, increasingly impossible feats become attainable, such as transforming one material into another, altering the trajectory of attacks, conjuring fire from nothing, petrifying creatures with a glance, creating objects and living beings from imagination, and eventually reshaping entire stretches of reality according to what you sincerely believe to be true. These manifestations become stronger, faster, larger in scale, and increasingly permanent as your cultivation advances through the Seven Chakra Points of Truth. At the highest levels, even the natural laws of the world need not remain fixed if your conviction is great enough.

However, Truth cannot exist without Lies. Pursuing only Truth gradually erodes your ability to distinguish reality from fiction until everything you believe begins forcing itself upon the world whether you intended it or not, a path that inevitably ends in becoming a Demon. Fortunately, this power grants you an instinctive understanding of maintaining the balance between Truth and Lies, allowing you to cultivate both paths safely without risking such a fate unless you deliberately choose to abandon all restraint. Additionally, you have also inherited the complete cultivation method of the Sitting Oblivion Dao, granting you the means to cultivate Lies alongside Truth.

Your unique nature also grants extraordinary resilience due to the Bewilderment saturating your soul which prevents many forms of supernatural corruption, possession, and mental contamination from taking root, while your unusual physique allows you to consume an unlimited number of impure Lifespan Pills and similarly tainted longevity treasures without suffering the obsessive madness that cultivators usually faced. Furthermore, every part of your body blood, flesh, bone, hair, organs, and even skin possesses immense spiritual value, capable of serving as exceptional materials for alchemy, artifact refinement, rituals, and cultivation. Fortunately, your body naturally regenerate over time, allowing you to repeatedly harvest your own body for cultivation or artifact creation without permanently diminishing yourself.

Even becoming a Siming is not out of your reach. A Strayed One is an incomplete existence standing at the threshold of divinity, possessing the potential to embody a Heavenly Dao itself. With sufficient cultivation, insight, and opportunity, you may one day ascend into a Siming, whether by inheriting an existing Heavenly Dao, seizing one from another Siming, or cultivating an entirely new one through your own unique understanding of reality, just as Li Huowang ultimately cultivated Ji Zai, the Siming of Bewilderment. Such beings are living incarnations of the world's fundamental principles, their mere existence reshaping reality on a conceptual level. Reaching such heights is the culmination of countless lifetimes of cultivation, but the path remains genuinely open to you.

You have the remarkable ability to merge magic with technology, creating things that would astound scientists and wizards alike.

This could be easily combined with any other Tinker power, and is severely hampered without some form of magical ability.
objects.title: Magitech

objects.text:
You have the remarkable ability to merge psionics with technology, creating things that would astound Psychics and Scientists alike.

This could easily be combined with any other Tech Power, and is severely hampered without some form of psychic ability.
objects.title: Psitech

objects.text:
You possess the remarkable ability to seamlessly merge biology with technology, creating innovations that would astound biologists and engineers alike.

This ability can be easily combined with any other Tech Power. However, to fully realize its potential, it is recommended that you also possess some form of biokinetic ability.
objects.title: Biotech

objects.text:
You possess the remarkable ability to merge the spirit/soul with technology, creating things that astound Spiritualists and Scientists alike. 

This can be easily combined with any other Tinker power, and is severely hampered without some soul/spiritual ability yourself.
objects.title: Soultech

objects.text:
You have the remarkable ability to merge dimensional physics with technology, creating things that would astound physicists and mages alike.

This could easily be combined with any other Tech Power. However, to fully realize its potential, it is recommended that you also possess some form of portal or pocket dimension based ability.
objects.title: Planetech

addons.text: You are no longer limited to the need for close and thorough examination of an object; now, you only need to inspect an item once to learn how to craft it.
addons.title: Keen Eyed

objects.text: You are a genius when it comes to crafting. You are instantly skilled with any tool related to a crafting profession and will have at least a foundation in any craft you come across, even if you have never encountered or heard of it before. Furthermore, you have the ability to reverse engineer crafting techniques by simply observing someone using them or by thoroughly examining the finished product. Additionally, given enough time to inspect an item, you can determine how to craft it yourself.
objects.title: The Craftsman

addons.text:
The Datumplane has merged with your Soul Garden. As such, it no longer needs external devices to maintain its existence, being connected directly to your soul. This allows you to wield all the privileges of administrative access without any additional tools, as you are now able to dive into the Datumplane directly in the form of a digital avatar, with information visualising itself as three-dimensional highways and city blocks composed of data. You are able to give others a similar connection to the Datumplane, albeit with fewer privileges, as well as download and upload information directly from your own mind as well as let other users do the same.

For AIs, androids, and other similar beings, the Datumplane now also serves as shelter, where their 'digital souls', for lack of a better term, can safely recover from any damage, corruption, etc.

Due to the new nature of the Soul Garden, you can now put souls and consciousness residing in it into new bodies, although you will still need to construct them first. AIs and those capable of inhabiting multiple platforms can freely function unimpeded, albeit with diminished processing speed, as long as a single server or platform that processes their thoughts in the real world still exists.
addons.title: Digital Heaven

objects.text:
You can create a special type of device that both generates and connects to the Datumplane — a dimension of pure information that exists as long as there exists at least one device that generates it and can store and transmit an unlimited amount of information instantly across any distance.

The Datumplane is unified, so everything and anything that can access it can stay connected even across dimensions. You know how to create various connection devices, from modems to wireless routers, as well as special implants that would allow humans to access the Datumplane directly.

Lastly, you can create an administrative device that will grant you unlimited control over the distribution of information in the Datumplane; you can decide who can access what information and even separate the Datumplane into smaller Dataspheres, equally infinite in their storage capacity but unable to connect to other Dataspheres without your express permission.
objects.title: Datumplane

addons.text:
Your Celestial Workshop has fused completely with your existence, transforming from a mere mental realm into a true extension of your mind, soul, and creativity.

The workshop’s limitless resources now scale alongside your own growth, automatically providing not only the tools and materials required for your creations, but superior versions perfectly suited to your intentions and level of mastery. Magical, scientific, spiritual, conceptual, or entirely unknown principles can all be understood and incorporated into your works with startling ease.

The temporary knowledge granted by the workshop has also deepened. Rather than fleeting understanding, repeated use allows fragments of this knowledge to permanently remain with you, steadily increasing your own genuine mastery over magic, science, crafting, and creation itself.

Creations born from the Celestial Workshop are no longer static objects. Weapons, machines, constructs, and artifacts may evolve, self-repair, adapt to their wielders, or develop entirely new functions over time. Flaws naturally diminish with each recreation or modification, allowing your works to continuously improve.

Finally, the strain of manifestation is greatly reduced. Your workshop now absorbs ambient energies from its surroundings to assist in materializing your creations, allowing vastly larger and more complex works to be brought into reality with far less exhaustion.
addons.title: Celestial Smith
Legendary Material
addons.text:
Once you have created a Devil Arm, you’re able to use it as a crafting material in the Celestial Workshop.

While this lets you adjust and augment the form it has taken, such as from a hammer to a pistol (still with the influence of the original being), it also lets you deconstruct it fully, incorporating it into other designs to augment existing creations with its characteristic powers.

For instance, incorporating the essence of a Devil Arm made from an acid-creature into the existing design for a pistol might make its bullets have an additional corrosive effect on targets.

addons.title: Permutation
addons.text:
Your Celestial Workshop now also exists in a state of superposition much like yourself. This allows you to alter anything you’ve made with it the same way you would yourself, altering it into another version of itself.
