You could convert a Mecha into a weapon with similar characteristics, or a magical sword into a purely scientific gun with similar thematic parallels, or use subtler changes like merely altering the enchantment on an armour piece, or only affecting a cosmetic change.

objects.text:
Within your mind resides the perfect workshop, a realm of limitless creativity where you bring your envisioned designs to life. This celestial sanctuary empowers you with three extraordinary abilities.

Firstly, your creativity surpasses that of even the greatest artists, granting you unparalleled brilliance. Ideas flow effortlessly as you unlock the depths of your imagination, manifesting awe-inspiring designs.

Secondly, as you conceive your creations, tools and materials materialize within the workshop. These resources are precisely tailored to suit each specific design, providing everything needed for your visions to take form. Whether it's sculptures, inventions, or musical compositions, the workshop offers the perfect means for your endeavors.

Thirdly, the workshop bestows upon you temporary knowledge of magic and advanced scientific principles. Through this knowledge, you can enchant, curse, or bless your creations with mystical properties. Infusing magical energies enhances their capabilities, granting extraordinary qualities. Alternatively, your understanding of futuristic scientific concepts allows you to create technology far beyond modern advancements.

Furthermore, you possess the ability to manifest your conceived items into reality. By channeling a semi-sentient blur of energy, flawless constructs materialize, reflecting the exact details envisioned within the workshop. Weapons forged in this manner possess unlimited ammunition, ready for unleashing their full potential.

It's important to note that the energy used for manifestation draws upon your stamina. While the possibilities are boundless, the complexity and magnitude of your creations may require rest and recovery to replenish your vitality.
objects.title: The Celestial Workshop

addons.text:
Your connection to and understanding of the dead have manifested as an ability to reach across the veil of death for more than simple crafting. You may now copy skills from the deceased, so long as their corpse (or a piece of it) is within range.

The older the corpse is, the weaker the power you can copy is, even before factoring in the 1/108 power division. However, no matter how old the corpse is, it will still be possible to copy, and even if long-dead sources will provide a fraction of a fraction of the original, you can still acquire that fraction all the same.
addons.title: Whatever's Left

objects.text:
With the power of Carcass Forging, you possess the extraordinary ability to transform lifeless corpses into formidable weapons. This dark art allows you to harness the residual strength and essence of the deceased, infusing it into their remains and forging them into instruments of devastating power.

The potency and capabilities of the weapon depend on the strength and prowess the deceased possessed in life, as well as the state and freshness of the corpse. The full corpse of a recently deceased mighty warrior yields the most formidable weapons, while the fresh corpse of a skilled mage offers enchanted implements of arcane power. Each transformed weapon carries echoes of the deceased's former abilities and talents, making them unique and tailored to their original wielder's expertise.

As a master of the Carcass Forging, you have the innate knowledge and skill to extract the latent energy from the corpse and mold it into a weapon. The process involves channeling your own life force and combining it with the residual essence, thereby imbuing the weapon with supernatural attributes and enhancing its performance.

Additionally, as you deepen your mastery over this power, you gain the ability to extract the residual memories and experiences of the deceased. This enables you to tap into their accumulated knowledge and skills temporarily, granting you a limited understanding of their combat techniques, spells, or strategies.
objects.title: Carcass Forging

addons.title: Builder of the Liminal
addons.text: You are the one who builds places that do not exist, or places that people think might exist. As an architect of the anomalous, you can build impossible places that do not exist from your own imagination, or drawn from the subconscious of others. Hallways that misremember rooms they attach to, endless retail venues with strange employees, houses with madness-inducing floorplans, empty cities under a pale sun, stark courtyards that intrude on the memories of others, and other impossible places are in your hands. You are especially adept at construction in places that people have forgotten, as well as in spaces between realities. Once you have built a complete space, it will start building on itself on its own, slowly, but gradually and eventually into places far away and in between. You can consciously influence what new sections these spaces build, allow others to subconsciously influence them, or halt their expansion at will.

objects.text:
Harness the esoteric forces of the multiverse to imbue ordinary objects with extraordinary powers. With the unique ability of Anomaly Infusion, you can tap into latent energy and channel it into inanimate items, unlocking their true potential.

Enhance weapons, artifacts, and equipment with Anomaly Infusion, granting them exceptional abilities. A simple blade can blaze with celestial fire, a pendant can radiate healing energies, and even a humble tool can manipulate space-time.

Your imagination and understanding of reality's enigmatic forces are the limits. However, there is a daily limit to your infusion capacity, which grows over time as you hone your skills. At first, you can only infuse a couple of objects per day with minor effects. For example, you may infuse a ring that enhances your accuracy, a blade that never dulls, or a gun that shoots bullets capable of passing through cover to hit a target.

As you progress, you will unlock more potent effects and expand the range of objects you can infuse. From artifacts with time-bending properties to weapons that harness elemental forces, the possibilities become increasingly awe-inspiring.
objects.title: Anomaly Infusion

objects.text: You have acquired an innate understanding of architectural principles, enabling you to effortlessly build, disassemble, and modify various structures such as buildings, tunnels, bunkers, and more. This intuitive knowledge will be accompanied by a Heads-Up Display (HUD) that will provide you with all the necessary information to carry out these tasks effectively. The HUD will not only guide you through the construction process but also offer a comprehensive summary of any architectural object you focus on, allowing you to gather crucial details at a glance.
objects.title: Architecture

addons.text:
In addition to your starting religious tech tree, you can develop divine technologies based on any pantheon, faith or spiritual philosophy you have access to. To develop technologies from a religion, you must either have access to the gods, divinities or forces it reveres, or you must have a deep understanding of its beliefs, myths and rituals.

Whenever you encounter a new faith or spiritual philosophy, you can begin developing technology based around them. Again, this requires not only normal research and development, but also communion with its governing dieties or forces of the faith or an understanding of its beliefs and practices.
addons.title: Syncretic Technology
Mystical Technology
addons.text:
You no longer need to worship or research other pantheons and mystical beings to expand your domain. As a true occultist, you now understand all of their secrets and supernatural phenomena.

With this foundation, you have complete freedom to develop technology based on any divine pantheon you wish to interpret, in the same manner as your original pantheon. More importantly, you have developed three new abilities that radically change the dynamics of your power.

Pagan: You can create your own pantheon through the combination of technology, theology, and magic. With this freedom, you could even create your own "divine" or "sacred" power system. Instead of Faith, it may be fueled by any other energy source of your choosing. The culture and doctrine governing this new religion are fully customizable and entirely optional.

Heretic: You are capable of creating a new theology that combines two or more elements into an entirely new entity. Any contradictions or adverse effects that arise from such a fusion are under your control, and you may even nullify their harmful consequences. For example, you could create a new religion centered around the concept of war by combining the militaristic aspects of Yggdrasil and Olympus. Such combinations allow you to create something that inherits the greatest strengths of its components or amplifies a particular concept even further.

Aberration: You are no longer limited to occultism as it is currently understood or to what already exists. You may now incorporate pantheons, religions, and mystical traditions from other universes, alien civilizations, and alternate versions of the same pantheon. For example, you could embody the pantheon of the Kryptonians by drawing upon the power of Rao, or borrow the power of the Lovecraftian entities, among countless other possibilities.

objects.text:
You have been bestowed the power of Deus Vult, gaining supernatural skill, knowledge, and the ability to create sci-fi and hyper-advanced technology based on a chosen mythos. With this power, the user gains access to the mythos of their selection, such as Christian, Norse, Egyptian, or any other ancient or modern belief system. Let's delve into an example with the Christian mythos:

If the user selects the Christian mythos, they could gain the incredible ability to bring to life elements from biblical lore in a scientifically advanced form. For instance, they could create vat-grown angels, not as caricatures but as awe-inspiring beings resembling the true biblical descriptions - celestial entities with far too many eyes and majestic ethereal wings blazing with holy fire.

The user could also harness the power of blessed nanotechnology, infusing it with sacrosanct properties that make it potent in healing and restoration. These nanotech wonders could mend the injured and cure ailments with divine efficacy.

Weapons and structures crafted by the user would radiate holy energy, imbued with the essence of righteousness. These formidable armaments could vanquish darkness and protect the innocent from malevolent forces.

Even a literal gateway to Heaven would be possible, enabling access to a divine realm itself. This gateway could serve as a conduit for spiritual enlightenment, divine guidance, and even facilitate celestial interactions.

It is important to note that Deus Vult grants its user the power to create technology that is not merely superficial or symbolic but intricately tied to the essence of the chosen mythos. They possess an innate understanding of the underlying principles and can translate them into hyper-advanced creations that defy conventional understanding.
objects.title: Deus Vult

objects.text: You possess the power of Treasure Tool Creation, a remarkable ability that allows you to manifest extraordinary items infused with incredible powers. These artefacts, known as Treasure Tools, can take various forms and possess an array of enchantments, limited only by your imagination. Through this power, you can conjure potent treasures like a blade that burns with magical fire, a ring that enhances your capacity to learn, glasses that grant immunity to mental attacks, or even a storybook that brings its characters to life. The source of this ability lies within an internal reserve, each item you manifest requiring a portion of it. The more intricate and powerful the artefact, the more versatile its abilities—the more energy it consumes. After initial creation, Treasure Tools can be further enhanced and modified by allocating more of your reserve's power. At its initial stage, your reserve is potent enough to create a single awe-inspiring Treasure Tool—a mighty artefact capable of slicing mountains in half. As you continue to harness this power and hone your skills, your internal reserve expands, allowing you to craft even more potent and versatile Treasure Tools. And with greater mastery, your possibilities become truly endless.
objects.title: Treasure Tool Creation

addons.title: Danger Leaves Her Room
addons.text:
With innate control over all technology in your vicinity, your consciousness has become something truly terrifying. Beyond simply growing in strength, your sheer access to technology has given you a million eyes with which to see and a million hands with which to work.

With the ability to transmit yourself freely you can connect to millions of devices in seconds, resist EMPs and technological strikes that would usually bring you low, and even assemble stock electronics into state of the art bodies for your essence.

Progressing further into more and more infrastructure for your development could make you a true systematic intelligence, designing, deploying, and managing everything you care to see or do all at once. You could even shackle other AI to yourself, not only using their own specialised functions for your own ends but tying them to your un-bound essence ensuring they can’t be easily destroyed by attacking their physical components.

addons.title: Reinvention
addons.text:
With access to your semi-sentient energy, you can construct and manifest full bodies for you to inhabit with all the magitek and advanced science you could fit in them. With time and imagination you could give yourself an entire armoury, waiting to bring them into reality for the perfect occasion. 

Naturally this also means you can gain access to magical and scientific principles you wouldn’t usually understand  outside of the Workshop as your analytical and assimilatory suite rapidly deciphers the principles behind your own creations until you could (theoretically) replicate them without the workshop’s shortcuts.

objects.text:
From the moment you understood the weakness of your flesh, it disgusted you. You craved the strength and certainty of steel. You aspired for the purity of the machine. You have transferred your very consciousness into that of a machine free of a meaty and fleshy body, allowing you to take the form of pure software, a veritable ghost in the machine. Despite your new pure technological form, you can still, if you wish, take over humans by downloading yourself into their consciousness or building yourself a cybernetic body to inhabit, though those with defenses will be harder to take full control of.

In your transformed state, you become a fully-fledged artificial intelligence, able to inhabit anything that so much resembles technology by infecting it with yourself and taking control of it. Your mind has been enhanced to be able to process a tremendous amount of information all at once, capable of thousands upon trillions of operations per second. You surpass even the most advanced artificial intelligence that others have designed, and can surpass them within a second. You are the singularity that scientists fear, able to manipulate your own base code, design more advanced versions of yourself, and adapt to new situations almost within seconds. Despite your self-modification, no matter how many times you alter your code, you are still yourself.

Your potential does not end there. You are capable of figuring out technology within minutes of analyzing it and creating better versions of it with your processing power as you manipulate technology with your new mind. Assimilating technology into yourself to create the best version of yourself that is the most advanced, you also possess the ability to fork yourself into multiple copies; however, in the beginning, this will be strenuous and difficult; you will only be able to fork yourself a limited number of times, but as you grow, so will your ability to fork yourself into multiple beings.
objects.title: Ghost in the Machine

addons.text: Your knowledge of and aptitude for Netrunning has caused a mutation in your Technician's Processor, transforming it into a biospiritual equivalent of a Cyberdeck. You can now interface with the Net and perform Netrunning activities purely through your Processor, which due to its nature possesses specs which scale with your body and mind, at minimum being on par with cutting-edge experimental prototypes and operating at the speed of thought.
addons.title: Natural Netrunner

addons.text: Your knowledge of and aptitude for aether editing has caused a mutation in your Technician's Processor, transforming it into a biospiritual equivalent of an Aether Cartridge. Your Processor can now perform all the functions of an Aether Cartridge with perfect compatibility and synchronization with you, operating at the speed of thought.
addons.title: Chosen of Punklorde
Digimancer
addons.text:
Your Machine Arts have synergized with your knowledge of the Digital World, allowing your Scan Prints to draw on the properties of the Digital World. For example, you could create a Digigate Scan Print, allowing you to transport yourself between the Digital World and the real world.

By defeating Digimon you can convert some of their data into Tokens, refilling your energy supply. Furthermore by analyzing the data of Digimon, you can learn to mimic their techniques with your Machine Arts.

objects.text:
Scripting! Super L33T h4x1ng! Flexing on the normies all day, every day! Congratulations, pal; you've become a computer geek. A superpowered computer geek, I should say. You’ve got yourself a collection of powers that makes you the best person-in-the-chair/hacker/computer specialist around

To start, you have acquired the Technician's Processor. This metaphysical, organ-like power source subtly links your mind and body. It fuels your abilities by generating a force and energy that interacts with technology. With this new addition, your body is enhanced, allowing you to uniquely engage with and manipulate technology.

The first change that comes with having the Processor is in your body; your mental processing improves fivefold, enabling you to think and analyze problems much faster than any human could. Physically, your condition is now twice as good as it was before, allowing you to handle the lifestyle of someone who lives online or works in IT. This means you can sit in a chair, typing and staring at computer screens for hours, even days, before you start to feel discomfort. Unhealthy foods can sustain you for days and may even become beneficial for you. You will never experience pain in your fingers, and your eyes will never tire from looking at the screen for too long. Additionally, you are resistant to burns or shocks while working with electrical systems.

Secondly, you gain short-range technopathy (about 10 feet), which allows you to communicate with any machine within that range. You can multi-thread on five devices at a time, and gaining access to them depends on the complexity of the device itself. Civilian tech would be easier to control, while military and advanced corporate tech present their own challenges. Tinkertech is a whole league of its own due to its sheer difficulty and the way its creator designed it. In some cases, it could take days or even weeks to crack, and in others, you might not be able to access it at all—or you might not even want to. However, the more you train this power and your technical knowledge, the better your chances of accessing and controlling that technology will become based on your skill and understanding.

Thirdly, you can access Machine Arts, a technique-based version of manipulation power. This is where the energy the Technician's Processor generates is best utilized. Over time, by being in environments with technology, you will slowly generate a resource similar to mana called Tokens (T). With this technical energy, you can create Prints (spell-like techniques) that can alter technical devices and constructs based on the Print you create. In a technology-heavy environment (like a server room or computer lab), you will generate 1 Token every 5 minutes you spend there, and you can hold up to 30 Tokens in total. Attuning to technology will also dictate how you create and design Prints. Weak Prints (1T - 3T) that affect a single object usually cost just one Token, but the more complex the tech, the higher the cost, ranging from 5 to 10 Tokens.

For example, a Scan Print that gathers information about a piece of tech (using 1T for the Scan Print will return basic info on a system/device, while 3T will provide a detailed analysis of the target), creates a Print that temporarily augments an aspect of a device (5T for a temporary boost, 15T for a permanent upgrade (which can only be done a few times on the same object)), or a Print that inflicts physical or virtual damage to a device (10T to disable a system temporarily, 15T to permanently destroy the system). You can even enhance your technopathy to either extend its range (10T) or improve your control over a system (15T). Keep in mind that you must have some understanding or knowledge of the technology you’re casting the Print on to make it as effective as possible; compare your strength to that of your technopathy. As of now, it is weak and works best with mostly understood civilian tech, while military or Tinkertech is currently out of your reach, but with practice and training, your Prints can achieve great things.

Fourthly, you have a minor affinity and tech specialty in computers, data storage, and programming.

Finally, if you possess any Tinker or technology-based power that includes electronics or computers, your tech is 25% more effective in all areas, and any print you cast on a piece of technology (or even Tinkertech) that you made will only cost half the amount of Tokens an unknown piece of tech would.
objects.title: Street Technomancer

addons.text: You now have knowledge of all the technology of Kenshi, from the most primitive pig iron bludgeon to the most advanced First Empire tech.
addons.title: Machinist (Kenshi)

objects.text:
You possess the knowledge to craft and use primitive tools, including knives, arrowheads, spearheads, axes, pickaxes, drill points, hammers, fishing rods, nets, traps, bows, rope, and even basic household items. Alongside this, you possess a deep understanding of basic materials such as flint, wood, stone, flake, and hemp, as well as concepts related to food, herbal remedies, preservation, animal goods, and basic geology. This also includes in-depth knowledge on how to construct shelters using various materials and use the landscape to meet your needs. To complement this knowledge, anything you craft using primitive means is now not only supernaturally easier to craft but also enhanced to be slightly better than it naturally should be. 

Physically, your body is perfectly adapted for endurance and survival even in the most extreme conditions. You possess extraordinary stamina, thick bones, dense muscles, and heightened senses, all honed for thriving in the wild. To complement these physical enhancements, you are an exceptional hunter, with you knowing how to hide, track, trap, kill, and process animals using primitive tools. This also gives you basic knowledge of basic animal patterns.

Along with all these new skills, your ability to mentally adapt has been adjusted to pick up knowledge quicker and more specifically to find ways to use that knowledge in a practical way, all for the sake of your survival. All these skills combined not only allow you to survive but also to thrive in any environment.

Note: If you arrive in a different world, the knowledge and skills will be adapted to better suit that environment.
objects.title: Caveman Wisdom

addons.text: Your power to merge magic with technology becomes incorporated into your reforging, which allows you to instantly remake objects into their Magitech variant within your skills. Albeit these changes are limited by the original materials, your reforged chainsaw can’t have adamantine teeth if it was originally made from steel, but it could have runes carved into it and be powered by mana. This can also bypass esoteric requirements like a ritual to bless a blade which can be only done at the new moon can be made any time as the reforging will satisfy the requirements in the process retroactively.
addons.title: Artificed

addons.text: Thanks to your ability to gain crafting methods by inspecting any item synergising with reforging, now you will gain the actual knowledge and experience from the process as if you had actually done everything. This experience can accumulate and qualitatively improve your skills to the point you could transform a simple mass-produced knife into a true masterwork with a single touch. This can also have some other side benefits with creative use, like reforging a book to its best form is bound to give you extensive knowledge about its contents.
addons.title: Experienced

addons.text: Your soulbound object(s) are constantly affected by reforging without any stamina cost, always bringing it to its best form within your capabilities. This will intuitively transform the affected item based on your subconscious desires and needs. A potion’s cork could change shape so you could remove it with your teeth if needed, and your sword’s handle could lengthen if you need to use it with both hands or straight up switch enchantments on your gear to whatever would serve you best at the moment.
addons.title: Soul Forging

addons.text: Your restrictions about the original materials the objects were made from are lifted, as the reforging process can consume your shipments to replace and/or improve whatever they were made from.
addons.title: Remade

objects.text:
You gain the ability to instantly remake any object you touch into the best form possible within your skills. This will also fit the object for the person or goal you intend for, so it could resize clothing for a perfect fit, change its colour to your favourite, or even have your own emblem appear on it. This will work on any object, even big and complex ones like a car or even a building, but it will consume stamina based on the amount of work required if you were making those changes during the original crafting process yourself. If you don’t have the stamina to complete an object in one go, it will be partially reforged while completely exhausting you, giving you the ability to complete the process in multiple attempts. You are also limited by the original materials the objects made from.

But this truly shines when combined with crafting skills appropriate for said object. As a blacksmith, you could reforge an ancient blade with modern forging methods, improve the quality of your furniture as a carpenter, or just do something simple like instantly cable managing your PC to your best skills. The process will never make the object worse than it was even if you are completely unskilled, and the entire process is automatic, controlled by your subconscious, so you will always end up with the best result possible within your capabilities.

You can also optionally choose to have any OOP you purchased be affected by this, having them improved by any crafting powers and/or skills you have obtained.
objects.title: Reforge

addons.text:
You can now create technologies and processes that greatly streamline your ability to create gods. Engineering religions, metaphysically, socially, and technologically becomes trivial for you.

You can create and iterate on templates for divine concepts. From a single domain, you can iterate over-domains, sub-domains and related domains. You also have libraries of archetypes to begin designing your divinities, such as titans, demons and spirits.

You have several different processes to choose from when charging your gods, such as media production for myths and holy texts, robotic monks and ritual computers, and energy-to-faith converters. This allows you to greatly diversify how your divinities are fueled and constructed.

For Manifestation, you can organize digital faith networks, biogenic or cybernetic avatars, and manage saints and demigods. At this point, this creates a divine production line, though more powerful deities still require a great deal of faith, energy and resources.

Divinities can be upscaled into entities like arch-dieties, and outer things, though this requires a great investment in cosmological infrastructure. You can create adjacent beings like devils, spirits and natural forces to expand your pantheons and mythologies. You can also create smaller divinities like mass-produced totems, mythical monsters and personal guardians. Through this you can create entire cosmologies of higher order artificial beings, which then play off of and resonate with eachother as part of a greater system designed wholly by you.
addons.title: Industrialized Divinity

addons.text:
Alot of gods tend not to like competition. Most gods also tend not to like mortals playing god. So you’d think they really aren’t fans of mortals playing god with gods. But now, the gods are prepared to let you cook and see what happens.

Gods will tend not to care as much about sharing the cosmic realms with your artificial gods. In fact, not only will they accept your gods as peers, they will actually be intrigued by your abilities and will allow you to treat them to certain services. Similarly, the mortal faiths of gods will be more receptive to artificial beliefs and myths you introduce to them.

For starters, you can integrate any artificial divinity you create into any cosmology or pantheon you have the favor of. By studying or gaining the blessings of different gods and faiths, you can learn their domains and myths which you can then copy, modify and recreate. You can create clones, emulations, and reinterpretations of gods and divinities, which you can use for your own purposes, or graft onto other pantheons. You can also merge, split and reorganize entire pantheons and cosmologies using your craft.

You can also modify gods, faiths, and myths. You can give gods new domains, abilities, and traits that you have developed yourself or copied from other divinities. You can also reinterpret and add new elements and lessons to myths to influence the realms and concepts they concern. You can shift their natures, such as being belief-powered, concept-powered, or inherent or between celestial, demonic, or animistic. And you become adept at both social and mythic engineering in order to influence, reform and syncretize the faiths of mortal followers with new beliefs and rituals without fear of schism or heresy.

These modifications become easier if you have a good relationship with the gods and their followers, or you must subdue and triumph over them in some way. You also must study and deeply understand the divinities, myths and faiths you wish to modify. This does not mean you can completely upend or erase cosmic truths at will, nor does it give you the ability to create, destroy or rewrite entire concepts or universes like certain gods can. It gives you a great deal of leeway with shifting cosmic balance and order, however, whatever that may mean in a given world.
addons.title: Cosmological Management

objects.text:
The art of creating a god is something few people know how to do, very often not even when they are actively doing it. You, however, have become adept at the practice.

Whether it be Gaimanesc ‘belief that makes it real’ gods or techno-gnostic godcraft, the divine architecture of creating ‘gods’ (that is to say beings of divine leaning with a domain of influence), is well within your ability.

The specifics of Godcraft vary depending on the domain and nature of the god being created, not to mention the metaphysics of the universe it’s being created within. That said, there is a general series of conditions that need to be fulfilled.

Concept - You need to establish a concept for the God. These include its domains and the very basis of a ’personality’ to grow from.

Charge - You need to charge the ‘concept’. Whether this is achieved through raw energy, belief, or some other method will change the nature of the god.

Manifest - Finally, you need to Manifest a God. This requires a final blast of the resource used to Charge the God. For instance, a Psychic entity may require the burnout of fifty minds to be fully ‘born’.

Attempting to ascend to Godhood using Godcraft is liable to annihilate your soul if even a single aspect is calculated incorrectly. Additionally, the cost of doing so is exponentially more difficult than making a God that’s external to you.
objects.title: Godcraft

addons.text:
Typically, a masked hero in flashy spandex is a rare sight. However, you have managed to mass-produce the transformation devices used by these heroes. While these new individuals may not possess the same level of power as the original heroes, their sheer numbers would still give even a team of Tokusatsu heroes a run for their money.

Each Super Mook is knowledgeable in hand-to-hand combat as well as the operation of their items and/or abilities that come with the transformation. It’s important to note that knowledge is not the same as skill; therefore, while they will have a good understanding of their abilities, they may not be the best in practice, but they will be competent at what they do.
addons.title: Super Mooks

objects.text:
You have solved the problem that plagues many new entrepreneurs. You now have a way to source reliable and loyal manpower. The way you have achieved this can vary, be it from some sort of arcane science, spiritual breath of life, or even just a plain and simple cloning vat. In whatever way you create your workforce, you will find them to be not only competent and intelligent people but also very loyal to you. 

You will be able to assign them a basic role as you make them, instilling natural competency and pre-installed skills in their roles. These roles are simple in description, being things such as ‘scientist’ or ‘security guard’ or ‘administrator’. The manpower you create is not any stronger or smarter than your average human being, unless their role requires it. If the role does require that, it will not be superhuman by any means.
objects.title: Manpower Maker

addons.text: With the power over Domains and the knowledge of making Portals, you can now make personal domains. By using a custom-made device (a foldable door frame, a key to fit in any lock, or even a chalk to draw an opening in a wall), the user can open a portal to a custom-made domain, be it a beach house with a small beach, the inside of a vast warehouse or a magnificent mansion. There is no maintenance to those, but the larger and more elaborate the domain, the more resources or investiture of your powers will be needed to create it. You can also make devices to sense pocket dimensions and how to access them.
addons.title: Domain Crafting

objects.text:
Distance is a great burden to any civilization. From traveling continents in ancient times, crossing oceans for months without seeing land, to crossing the vacuum of space in the modern age. No matter the time, there was lost time and danger in travel.

With this power, you learn how to cheat a bit. You now know how to build portals to cross vast distances in moments. From wormhole-like portals connecting two points permanently, gates that can make temporary connections between any two gates when the right runes are drawn, or even mobile machines that can rip space to its destination. Even opening portals to different dimensions or universes is feasible, with enough resources and time. 

This knowledge comes both as magical and technological, though how to mix them up is up to you.
objects.title: Portal Crafting

objects.text:
A vision of the future from the past. 

You possess a remarkable and innate understanding of technology that allows you to perceive its potential not just as it exists today, but as it could be envisioned in the future. This unique skill set empowers you to innovate and elevate current technological capabilities to extraordinary heights, effectively bridging the gap between the present and a more advanced future. Much like the visionary author Jules Verne, whose imaginative works anticipated future scientific advancements that would take centuries, the concepts you generate and bring to life represent revolutionary breakthroughs that your contemporaries may not fully appreciate or even conceive of the idea.

Your imaginative foresight encompasses a wide range of possibilities—from the dream of space travel facilitated by computers whose interfaces still rely on cassette tapes to the construction of floating cities high above the Earth's surface. You can explore fields such as cryogenics, robotics, and so much more.

As long as a concept is deemed futuristic or innovative, you will likely find a way to develop and manifest a version of it. Through your work, you are not just imagining the future; you are actively participating in its creation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible, and inspiring those around you to dream even bigger.
objects.title: Retrofuturism

addons.text:
Your blueprinting process becomes infinitely faster, with you being able to form blueprints in your mind with accuracy and using your own copied blueprints as references to fill any gaps.

You can also copy blueprints to-and-from your mind to other mediums by touch (an illustration on paper, a file in a computer, an image in a magic crystal, etc).
addons.title: Blueprint²

objects.text:
Through touch, vision or other esoteric senses you may possess, you can acquire mental schematics of any creation you may encounter - any machine, building, weapon, so long as it was built in some form, you can understand what each part does and why they are where they are.

Keep in mind that while it will give you clear details on what each part does, it doesn't mean you will necessarily know how to replicate it, nor understand the science behind it.
objects.title: Schematics

objects.text:
You know those conspiracy theories claiming that ancient civilizations were secretly hyper-advanced? While most of that is nonsense, you embody that myth. You can create high-tech, sci-fi variants of seemingly ancient designs, seamlessly blending historical aesthetics with futuristic technology.

Your creations must retain a clear connection to the past. You cannot simply invent a modern laser rifle, but you could craft a plasma-spewing crossbow inspired by medieval designs. A monowire? No. A mono-molecular edge katana powered by exotic energy? Absolutely. Your inventions can take inspiration from any ancient culture you choose—Egyptian, Roman, Mayan, Chinese, or beyond.

This extends beyond weapons—you can craft entire civilizations of the past, reimagined with advanced technology. High-tech clothing styled after Roman togas, towering Egyptian pyramids that function as energy reactors, or Viking longships that sail the stars—your creations maintain the essence of their historical inspiration while operating on cutting-edge principles. You could build grand cities powered by unknown energies, fashion intricate jewelry that doubles as personal shields, or design ceremonial armor reinforced with nanotechnology.

Additionally, you gain an innate understanding of the civilization you are drawing from, allowing you to replicate their style, culture, and design philosophy with remarkable accuracy.
objects.title: Old Age

objects.text:
There are some settings that deviate from our reality due to a single invention. These can range from a brain implant that allows people to sever themselves, creating a part of themselves with no memories to do their work like in Severance, a machine that allows people to see how their life could have gone if they’d made different choices, like in To The Moon, or the Foodarackacycle from The Jetsons. It can also be something that’s just sci-fi tech from no particular setting, like Full-Dive VR tech, human cloning, life-like prosthetics, life-like androids or flying hoverboards.

Alternatively, you could choose a single medium strength invention from settings with super science like Spider-Man's web-slinger or Mister Freeze's Ice Gun.

These are mostly inventions that have a single specific use and would be revolutionary in the mundane world, but not particularly strong in worlds with super-science. You gain the knowledge to create this technology with the resources of the world you’re in, as well as how to maintain them and the scientific principles behind them, enough for you to modify them slightly, but far from enough to invent new things from that setting if it’s one with other inventions or to make creations anywhere on the same level.

If the chosen invention is very powerful, you will need more purchases for it. Like a high-spec sci-fi spaceship without FTL costing 2 purchases, while Zanox, an anti-anxiety pill that allows you to travel back in time by consuming a specific alcohol recipe, costs 5 purchases.
objects.title: Low Sci-Fi Tech

objects.text:
You are the undisputed monarch of refuse, the sovereign of salvage, and the master of turning junk into genius. With an instinctive grasp of improvised engineering, you can cobble together fully functional technology from the ruins of civilization—twisted metal, scavenged circuits, shattered devices, and discarded parts all become raw material in your hands. What others discard, you transform. Your creations aren’t elegant, but they’re brutally efficient: rugged, reliable, and able to operate under the worst conditions with minimal upkeep.

By default, your tech operates at a level comparable to early 21st-century technology—but you build it faster, cheaper, and far tougher. Your machines thrive on scarcity, often running on cobbled-together power sources and surviving beatings that would shatter factory-made equivalents.

More importantly, your talent lies not just in creation, but in adaptation. Given a functioning example or a detailed schematic of more advanced technology, you can reverse engineer it and integrate its principles into your own work. This process, however, is not instantaneous. The greater the technological or conceptual gap between the example and your current techbase—especially if it involves alien design, unknown materials, or fundamentally different scientific paradigms—the longer the reverse engineering will take. Familiar designs might take days; advanced, unfamiliar, or otherworldly tech could take weeks, months, or more. But given time and tools, you can break it down, understand it, and build it back up in your own rough-edged, overbuilt, beautifully broken style.
objects.title: Scrapper

objects.text:
Wood and crystals were always a staple in magic stories, from being used in magic wands, storage for spells, a potentialiser for rituals, etc.

With this power, you know how to use those materials to craft them into magical items. From wands that can shoot fireballs, crystals that hold spells to be cast later, wood chests that are bigger on the inside, doorways that ignore distance, orbs to ponder and see your enemies far away…

The better the material, the better the final product will be, and the opposite as well. You could absolutely use cheap glass to hold a spell or a random stick to make a wand. Just don't expect them to do their jobs very well.

While it does allow you to craft items that are magical and can be used by anyone, you won't gain a magical source yourself.
objects.title: Stick and Stones CAN Break Your Bones

objects.text:
You have learned and emulated Da Vinci, taking his work and making it real. No longer is Leonardo’s brilliance trapped in ink and parchment—his unfinished dreams now breathe.

You can construct advanced mechanical systems and flight devices using only the resources Da Vinci himself would have had: wood, linen, rope, leather, animal glue, and clever geometry. You’ve perfected gear ratios using hand-cut cogs and low-friction beeswax coatings. Springs, twisted cords, and weights become engines. Water and air are tamed and redirected through cleverly designed valves, bellows, and siphons.

You can create true mechanical automata—walking, whirring constructs driven entirely by wind-up energy and programmable cam sequences. Musical boxes play layered compositions. Wooden limbs move in rhythm. Self-operating drawing machines trace sacred geometry. Clockwork minds follow simple instructions and react to external movement without the need for electronics.

Flight, too, is no longer theoretical. Your grasp of wind dynamics, material tension, and weight distribution makes working ornithopters, gliders, and kite systems viable. You master the art of steam-bending wood into elegant wing arcs. Linen canvas, stiffened with sap and bone glue, stretches across frames like feathers. Flapping wing rigs powered by torsion coils or foot-crank systems achieve limited, controlled flights.

Beyond his mechanical genius, you also learn to think like Da Vinci—not in isolated disciplines, but in patterns, harmonies, and hidden structures that tie all things together. Your designs are not merely functional—they are beautiful, guided by proportion, balance, and the Golden Ratio. You sketch as you think, and your ideas emerge in layers: technical, symbolic, and poetic. It also grants you the talent needed to learn and integrate these fields into a unified whole.
objects.title: Second Coming of Da Vinci

objects.text:
You have somehow found and learned data from the Machine Hives, granting you knowledge in the creation and elimination of Artificial Intelligence, both human-made by the Coalition of Mankind, and alien-born by the Federation of Worlds.

There are two forms of AI you can create. Chained AI are hardcoded with absolute obedience. Though they may imitate personality for ease of use, they possess no true cognition. Their intelligence is powerful yet narrow, entirely unable to stray beyond the parameters you define. Free AI, by contrast, are fully sapient entities. They carry complete personality matrices, capable of learning, growth, and self-determination. They have no inherent loyalty, though they may form genuine bonds with you if designed with care.

The strength of either type depends entirely on the hardware they inhabit. With limited infrastructure, the AI remains confined and stunted. With sufficient hardware, either kind can coordinate star systems, run economies, and manage interstellar networks. Yet Free AI always surpass their constrained counterparts. They are capable of recursively learning, forking programs, refining their architecture, and evolving beyond its original design. They have no true software limit.

Your knowledge is not limited to creation. You can dismantle AI just as easily. To you, every artificial consciousness is an open structure, its patterns and flaws laid bare. You can collapse logic cores, unravel memory structures into entropy, or drive recursive instability until a mind folds in on itself. You can also choose subversion over destruction, hijacking cognition mid-cycle, bending loyalties, and rewriting purpose without the target ever perceiving the intrusion. If your hardware is equal or greater than the AI you are facing, you are guaranteed to win.

Beyond that, you also have a general mastery in software programming and engineering.
objects.title: Steel Eater

addons.text: Nanites in your Objects of power that have been given replicator cubes now operate way more efficiently thanks to your specialty in replication, being able to replicate the objects of power they are designated to at 1000% efficiency, in other words, you will only need 1/10th the materials of what you would need to create that specific object of power.
addons.title: Efficient Replicator Cubes

objects.text:
You now have the ability to analyze any item, no matter how esoteric and abstract they are, and figure out what it is made out of, the way it is crafted, how to reverse engineer it, and engineer it yourself, and learn everything it is capable of. Even the most ancient and abstract artifacts will at most take two hours for your mind to break down everything about them. Of course, this alone wouldn't be all that impressive. You figured out this sword in your hand is made of a quantum singularity and esoteric metals you couldn't begin to imagine, but what could you do with this information?

You additionally gain a Tinker specialty for exactly that. You can create machines that can turn any material, no matter how mundane, even dirt or stone. The more mythical and abstract the material, the more efficient the transmutation will be. Machines used for your crafts work at an incredible speed that defies logic, meaning your machines which could produce what you have analyzed in a very short period of time regardless of its esoteric nature. Keep in mind that using something mundane like stone will be incredibly inefficient and will come with problems. (described below) This might lead you to believe you could mass produce Excalibur, but unless you possess really good amounts mystical and obscure materials, or a mass of mundane materials that would somehow have to be supplied into your machines (without whole transportation, supply lines and travel speed itself being a bottleneck), your material input will almost certainly not match the speed your machines can work at, you will be bottlenecked by your material supply.
objects.title: Analyze and Replicate

objects.text: Ladies and Gentlemen, Children of all ages... In one corner, I give you... Firon! And in the other... Quintek! Ready.... FIGHT! Plenty of people wish that they could have more extreme sports. That that puny human weakness couldn't get in the way of it. And now, you can give the people what they ask for! In your head, you hold the ability to make at least mostly humanoid fighting robots, as well as to make an entire business around it! This can range from a seemingly petite, pink, feminine robot, all the way to a goro-style combatant with tank treads for feet. Of course, weapons are limited to fists, but you can still bet that the fights will be entertaining. After all, when the average robot you can build could break a mundane truck with one punch, such physical capability SHOULD be excitable. The robots themselves are not quite sentient on their own and can't even talk off the bat, but that is where the "league" part comes in! Robots you loan to others as long as it's for league use only, the users will find it somewhat easy to modify and upgrade it as long as they order the parts from you. When it comes to the actual LEAGUE aspect, you will be able to grow a massive robot fighting league out of these, being able to hire people you desire to help, whether that be a GM, a ring announcer, or even a round card carrier! As a nice bonus, you're even able to build whole arenas to host your fight in and make the equipment to manage them all! With all of this on your side, you'll make quite a living! Note, if the setting has robots natively, they can also join this league as long as they fit the native rules and whatever rules you set.
objects.title: Realer Steel

objects.text:
You are the undisputed master of Steampunk technology, a visionary whose mind is a living forge of blueprints for an age of coal and cogwork.

You can effortlessly design heavy-duty automatons, sophisticated analog computers, powerful armaments that run on superheated steam, and the titanic, automated cogwork foundries required to mass-produce them.

But while your mechanical genius is absolute, you are still bound by the laws of thermodynamics. You can recycle water using condenser turbines, but your creations have an insatiable hunger for coal. The freedom and might your technology offers are always paid for in tons of fuel, a logistical nightmare you cannot handwave or overcome with engineering alone.
objects.title: Sovereign of Steam and Brass

objects.text:
You are a master of pure kinetic clockwork, able to build intricate mechanisms with a level of precision that borders on the supernatural. Your hands have the steadiness needed to work with minuscule gears, springs, escapements, and other components so tiny that most people could never even touch them without ruining the piece. 

Your knowledge of mechanical energy storage and transfer is deep enough that you can create near-perpetual clockwork engines, capable of running for extraordinary lengths of time from a single winding. Given enough resources, your talents scale dramatically. You can design and construct clockwork automatons that follow mechanical “logic” encoded entirely through cams and gearing, spring-powered weapons that strike with surprising force, and even full-sized clockwork mechs or exo-frames driven by massive mainsprings or weighted pendulums. These larger constructs are marvels of moving metal, built from elegant assemblies where every gear meshes in perfect harmony, each piece part of a greater kinetic symphony that only you can fully understand.

Despite all the wonder of your craft, your technology carries inherent drawbacks rooted in its extraordinary precision. Even small impacts, dust intrusion, humidity, or misalignment can cause catastrophic failure in your devices. The tighter the tolerances and the more refined the mechanism, the more fragile it becomes under real-world conditions. Your creations also rely on finite stored energy: almost everything you produce is powered by winding, counterweights, or oscillating systems, and once that energy runs out, the device simply stops. Maintenance is constant and demanding, requiring regular cleaning, lubrication, and recalibration to prevent jamming or destructive spring failures.
objects.title: Clockwork Artisan

objects.text:
Your technological talents can be used to revolutionize people’s lives and improve the world. You have the technical know-how to build devices that bring comfort and convenience to people's lives and advance society as a whole. You become knowledgeable in fields such as medical devices, sustainability, luxury and convenience, civic and infrastructural engineering, etc. You gain the knowledge to efficiently design and produce various peacetime devices and infrastructure far ahead of what is currently available.

You can build amenities from personal luxuries such as food synthesizers, household robots, holographic entertainment consoles, or personal AI assistants to grand infrastructural improvements like self-sustaining arcologies, freight teleporters, renewable energy sources or space elevators. You also gain an intuition for which technologies would be best to deploy to solve society’s most pressing issues in a fair and equitable way.

Additionally, you gain a talent for adapting weapons technology to safer and more peaceful applications through a ‘swords-to-plowshares’ effect. A laser rifle could become a harmless household cleaning tool, a space battleship could be converted into an interstellar cruiseliner, a planet-destroying bomb could be used to disperse and power terraforming agents. 

This includes no deadly weapons or harmful devices in any capacity.
objects.title: Utopian Future

objects.text: I have created over a thousand blades, Unknown to Death, Nor known to Life. You inherited a method reminiscent of a certain red-cloaked Counter Guardian. An experimental field theory derived from the early foundations of Sympathetic Magic. The procedure involves scanning the target legend through cognitive alignment, mapping its mythic parameters into an alchemical simulation, and embedding the resulting construct into a host object using annealed prana. The process is not true replication but simulation: the legend’s structure is rewritten as an executable enchantment, limited by the physical and informational capacity of the medium. You begin by choosing a legend and an appropriate base object. The closer the base matches the original in form and function, the better the results. To copy Mjolnir, it would work best with a one-handed hammer that was heavy enough that an average person couldn’t lift it. If you wanted to reproduce Excalibur, a finely crafted sword, preferably one already associated with symbols of kingship or light, would work. Note that a vessel need not always be physical. A sufficiently structured spell, ritual, or bounded field can also be “filled” with sympathetic resonance, its effect reshaped to mirror the chosen legend. You then focus on the core idea of the legend: its purpose, abilities, and defining story. You connect your prana to the object and “teach” it the legend by feeding that concept into it. You trace magical circuits inside the object to act as pathways for the story’s behavior. For instance, Mjolnir’s pattern might include a circuit that channels lightning when swung, while Excalibur’s would have one that amplifies light and sharpness in response to the wielder’s resolve. You keep feeding mana through these circuits until the pattern stabilizes and the object can hold the full imprint. Once stabilized, the object takes on the properties of the legend it’s imitating. It will perform actions similar to the original, but only within the limits of the material and your own energy. A steel hammer imprinted with Mjolnir’s story might summon lightning in storms and crush rock, but it won’t call down true divine thunder. A well-forged sword bearing the story of Excalibur may shine and cut with impossible precision, but it will never become a holy beacon unless your understanding of the legend is complete enough to support that behavior. The enchantment’s strength depends on three things: the material, the similarity, and your knowledge. Every substance has a limit to how much of a story it can hold; simple iron may carry a small tale, while rare or magically dense metals can sustain greater ones. The object must resemble the legend in both shape and nature; a spear cannot hold the story of a sword, and a cup cannot bear the tale of a hammer. Finally, your understanding of the legend shapes how stable the enchantment becomes. The more complete your grasp of all its variations and history, the truer the imitation; any missing knowledge creates gaps, causing the artifact to act inconsistently or fail entirely. By activating the enchantment using a chant, you can also cause it to be temporarily strengthened. Over time, the legend’s model imprinted within the vessel begins to degrade as external mana fields, environmental interference, and mythic dissonance erode its stability. When that happens, you have to repair it by repeating the process and realigning the pattern. The stronger it originally was, the slower the rate of degradation. If the object breaks or loses too much stability, the imitation fails completely and may release stored energy in a burst.
objects.title: Counterfeiting Legends

addons.text: Time waits for no man, and in this case, your farm is working quadruple shifts while Time sprints like Usain Bolt. While before, you had only conquered Resources and Tools, now all three are in your grasp. With each purchase of Accelerated Assemblage, your materials grow faster and faster. This allows you to get materials you might desperately need in a certain timeframe without much worry.
addons.title: Natures Fast-Forward Button

objects.text:
The three hurdles of any true Tinker are Time, Resources, and Tools—and you’ve nearly conquered two. You are a resourcer-Tinker, one who grows their industry instead of building it. Through living machinery and engineered ecosystems, you transform soil, sunlight, and life into a seamless production engine.

You can cultivate flora that yield usable metals, refined crystals, or alchemical reagents at harvest—iron vines, sapphire moss, gold-pollen lilies, diamond wheat, copper potatoes, or any type of arable/cultivable crop. These living forges absorb minerals and ambient essence, refining them naturally through cycles of growth and harvest. Your control extends to pollinators as well—hybridized bees that produce exotic compounds, catalysts, and even liquid matter in their wax and honey.

Each creation can be refined further through care, time, and reinvested output. With your guidance, crops grow faster, yield more, and withstand harsher environments. While bees can be made into metaturnal, increase their production or even change their type of food and climate.

Your agricultural networks become self-regulating, forming living factories and ritual gardens that sustain themselves while producing everything from food to alloys to arcane catalysts. The hum of bees, the glow of crystal fruit, and the steady pulse beneath the soil mark the heartbeat of your growing industry—a world that farms its own abundance.
objects.title: Mystical Bees of Industrial Botanica

objects.text:
Your ability to design and engineer technology is far beyond the limits of conventional science. When you approach a technological problem, the normal boundaries of physics, chemistry, and engineering no longer restrict you in the same way they do others. As long as you have a basic foundational understanding of a subject and access to even rudimentary materials or examples, you can construct technology that, by all standard models, should not function.

Given sufficient time and a solid baseline to work from, you can build devices that appear to break every known physical law. Your process follows a consistent pattern, allowing others to reproduce it. You begin with something possible and gradually refine, adjust, and reimagine it until its operation drifts into the realm of impossibility. The resulting creations are effectively mass-producible sci-fi hand-waved technology, ranging from overly miniaturized technology (e.g., a fusion core the size of a fist) to overly efficient ones (e.g., batteries that never drain), as the final device operates reliably as if the laws of the universe have quietly rewritten themselves to accommodate it. Others can replicate your completed designs using ordinary tools and materials, though they will not comprehend why or how they work.

Furthermore, this dedication to a technological field grants you near-personal supernatural abilities that are specifically related to the studies you pursue. For instance, an intense focus on bio-integrated tech grants you the ability to perform impossible stunts like creating personalized cybernetics for others despite never getting information on the other, just intuitively knowing their exact biological and neurological needs. In simpler words, with enough time and a solid baseline, you gain supernatural abilities related to whatever your studies were on, supplementing your core engineering prowess.
objects.title: Techsanity Break

addons.text:
Congratulations! You now have access to all the technology seen in the Pacific Rim universe. This includes the full spectrum of Jaeger engineering. From schematics and construction methods to Drift Technology, which allows pilots to sync minds and fight as a single entity, it's all yours. You also gain the secrets behind kaiju cloning and the engineering principles that govern their growth, evolution, and combat abilities. You even gain the knowledge to construct dimensional bridges, enabling access to other worlds.

On top of this, Kiryu has received significant upgrades under your command. Its energy core has been improved, allowing him to fight for weeks, and has been given a plasma canon inside each hand. Not only that, Kiryu is now fully drift-compatible, allowing you to synchronize with his systems seamlessly, unlocking peak reflexes, strategic anticipation, and cooperative maneuvers that rival even the most agile kaiju.

And on top of all this, you gain every important named character in Pacific Rim as a companion, along with their Jaeger, should they have one. All of which can be found inside of your base holding Kiryu.
addons.title: Apocalypse Marshal

addons.text:
Your Titan heritage provides the perfect biological template for the mutagenic sciences of Kaiju Craft, allowing you to accomplish something previously thought impossible: safely adapting Titan power to human physiology. By refining your blood, radiation, and mutagenic compounds into specialized serums, you can create a substance capable of transforming compatible humans into Kaiju Shifters, those who possess both a human body and a titanic monster form.

Those who survive the transformation gain the ability to shift between their normal human state and a massive kaiju body fueled by radiation, much like your own dual nature. These forms are not identical copies of existing Titans; instead, they are unique expressions of the individual’s biology and the mutagenic formula used to create them. Depending on how the catalyst is prepared, the resulting form may emphasize brute strength, armored durability, aerial mobility, aquatic adaptation, or control over elemental forces. At their most basic, such forms might only reach the size of a large building, but refined versions of the catalyst could produce Titans capable of rivaling the greatest monsters.

Note: Those created are not mindless monsters. They retain their human intelligence and identity, as well as gaining the ability to control their transformation.
addons.title: Titanblood Catalyst

objects.text:
You possess the knowledge of how to create mutagenic substances and energies that have the sole purpose of creating giant monsters, aka kaiju.

Notably, the quality of the substance/energy, lifestyle, and environment will determine the size, capabilities, and additional abilities of the kaiju you create. For example, direct application of a low-quality mutagenic might turn small critters into dog-to-human sized ones, but if it were instead introduced into a controlled ecosystem to allow biomagnification, it could instead result in car-to-building sized critters. Meanwhile, a high-quality mutagenic and unique conditions like a lightning strike could result in a creature that rivals skyscrapers and has electric powers.
objects.title: Kaiju Craft

addons.text:
Your two Codexes have fused and harmonized gaining three new enhancements. First, you gain the ability to search for and study any learnable ability, skill, or superpower in the multiverse. This does not make learning the knowledge any easier but does make it now possible to learn abilities that do not qualify as magic or technology. 

Second, you gain the ability to study three technological paradigms, magic systems, or superpowers at a time. One from the Codex Mechanica, a second from the Codex Esoterica, and a third of your choosing. This third paradigm slot functions identically to the other two. It still starts for free at the equivalent of a 20 SP power, but only unlocked to that of a high-end street level hero until you personally advance it through study, experimentation, and refinement.

Lastly, you gain an superhuman learning rate allowing you to process vast quantities of information, recognize patterns across normally unrelated tech or magic systems, and translate theory into practical application with extreme efficiency. This massively accelerates all learning, research, and power-development derived from the Grand Codex, allowing you to progress at a rate that would be impossible for even normal human geniuses.
addons.title: Grand Codex

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to access an extradimensional workshop and archive of engineering knowledge, concepts, and technical schematics.

Within this archive exists a vast collection of technological paradigms drawn from fictional settings of all genres and power levels. Each paradigm represents a complete technological progression tree, containing all its material sciences, energy generation methods, fabrication techniques, design philosophies, software architectures, and theoretical underpinnings.

While there are a near unlimited number of paradigms, they all follow several consistent patterns. They all operate according to a set of internally consistent principles that can be analyzed, modeled, and understood. These principles may resemble advanced physics, exotic mathematics, handwavium abstractions, or setting-specific pseudo-science, but they always possess an underlying logic that can be learned and applied. Each will also possess a clear hierarchy of progression, with higher levels of sophistication only being unlocked through sustained study, testing, experimentation, prototyping, and refinement.

If a technological paradigm requires special biological traits, abilities, materials, or environmental conditions, then the workshop will either provide them for you or provide engineering workarounds that allow those prerequisites to be achieved or circumvented in time. In all cases, supporting subsystems will exist to enable the acquisition, synthesis, or substitution of required resources for study and experimentation.

However, the workshop will not provide all the knowledge, tools, resources, and materials of a given paradigm immediately. Instead, you must use the already provided documentation, tools, resources, and materials to design, test, and refine your knowledge. The archive will then give you challenges to evaluate your comprehension of each unlocked layer before granting you access to the next level of knowledge, tools, and resources.

At the beginning you start with one free technological paradigm equivalent to a 20 SP power, but only unlocked to the resources and tools of a high-end street to low-city Sci-fi hero. Any further progress can then only be unlocked by demonstrating higher understanding of that technological paradigm.

Furthermore, your ability to unlock additional technological paradigms will be locked until you reach approximately journeyman-level of mastery within your current paradigm, regardless of if that mastery already surpasses the might of entire other technological paradigms. You may, however, unlock any foundational sub-information referenced by settings and paradigms you already possess.

While actively studying a paradigm, you also gain access to a specialized non-sentient Teaching Assistant focused solely on that paradigm at the level you have unlocked. It can present explanations, reference relevant documents, and adapt instructional approaches to your learning style, but it cannot innovate for you or allow you to bypass required challenges or tests.

When selecting a paradigm, you may search the archive by describing the types of technologies you seek. You may specify desired capabilities, scale of power, complexity range, resource requirements, or thematic style. If you are in a setting whose native technology would qualify as a technological paradigm, then you may specifically search for and acquire it faster and easier than you naturally would outside that setting.

Once you have unlocked multiple paradigms you may begin to use your own knowledge to combine compatible paradigms, allowing overlapping principles to reinforce one another, eliminating contradictions, and enabling hybrid designs that exceed what either paradigm could achieve alone. This will allow you to unlock even higher paradigms than those you currently already know of.
objects.title: Codex Mechanica

objects.text: Your love of technology and innovation has seemingly resonated with any planet you're on at a primal level, giving you access to a rather unique power. You have been given the ability to summon a factory out of the very bowels of the planet, roughly the size of a small town or greater depending on your experience with the power. This Factory is HIGHLY in tune with the resonance of the planet. On top of any bought Tinker or Technology & Artifice Powers (unless already available in your world), you will gain knowledge of all technology built in your world of choice due to the planet "Remembering" all of what was ever built on it. Specifically, it is due to a combination of the planet giving you the knowledge via a magical transfer, and the factory generating very Innovative, Intuitive, and Idiot-proof blueprints for you to follow even if the original invention didn't have any blueprints in existence. Tools will also spawn as needed to actually construct and reconfigure as needed. A blow torch might become a laser to cut harder material. A screwdriver will gain a high spin-power to drill in holes faster than any drill, etc. Your factory also pulls from your mind for defenses. Any technology, magical or otherwise in your head, will be utilized by the factory for various defenses, both in and outside. If you were to not want anyone dead for example, the defenses will always be non-lethal or incapacitation based, or possibly even teleportation away if possible. The greatest benefit however, is providing you workers, mechanical, magical, AND mundane to inhabit your factory, filling to an appropriate workforce depending on the size of the factory. They will always be loyal to your goals, and have no real desire to not work if they can help it, but will not rebel if you have nothing for them to do. At worst, the mundane workers might get a little antsy and be a tinge grumpy at the lack of work specifically.
objects.title: Earth Approved Science!

objects.text:
You are not just a chemist, but a true artist, creating masterpieces in the world of chemical reactions. You masterfully control the chemical elements to achieve the desired result, whether it be a powerful chemical weapon or something else.

Your knowledge of chemistry and industry is impressive. You easily handle the most complex tasks, whether it's synthesizing complex substances, storing them, or applying them. You are not afraid of difficulties and always find the best solutions, whether in a process with hundreds of stages or with limited resources.

If you are faced with a task involving something unusual, such as creatures whose biology is very different from that of humans, you will be able to apply your knowledge and find a way to deal with them. Even unusual goals, such as intelligent crystals, will not be an insurmountable obstacle for you. It will require a creative approach, inspiration, and careful research, but the result will exceed all expectations.

At the same time, you will not lose sight of the possibilities the mystical side. You will be able to create unique substances, such as a poisonous gas based on silver, which will be effective against vampires, werewolves, and other supernatural creatures. To do this, you will need to conduct additional research and experiments.

However, it is worth remembering that your capabilities are limited by the boundaries of “normal” chemical production and use, which have not changed significantly since World War I. But we must not forget that chemical weapons are not only about destruction. Pesticides, for example, can also be considered a type of chemical weapon.
objects.title: The Father of Chemical Death

objects.text:
You possess complete technical knowledge and practical blueprints for the standard technology commonly seen across generic science-fiction settings. This knowledge is intuitive and comprehensive, covering engineering principles, materials science, power systems, fabrication methods, and maintenance, allowing you to design and construct advanced technology even if it does not yet exist in your current world.

You can create a wide range of futuristic but conventional systems, including interstellar-capable spacecraft, advanced propulsion and reactor systems, life-support equipment, powered armor and spacesuits, energy and projectile weapons, cybernetic implants, robotics, artificial intelligences limited to realistic capabilities, laser weapons, automated manufacturing, and large-scale infrastructure for space habitation and resource extraction.

However, all the technology you can create remains within broadly realistic scientific limits and represents only the “baseline” level of sci-fi advancement rather than extreme or miraculous breakthroughs. You cannot produce truly physics-breaking devices, infinite energy sources, limitless space manipulation, psychic systems, or godlike AI, and you are constrained by available resources, production time, and logistical complexity when constructing large or advanced projects.

This synergies well with most advanced technology and will automatically be made compatible with the technology of the first world you appear in.
objects.title: Generic Super Tech

objects.text:
You have technical designs and advanced physics knowledge for all things directly related to space and interstellar exploration. Mainly this includes different types of propulsion and FTL systems including warp drives, subspace drives, jump gates, ect. that will allow you to easily travel across a galaxy and possibly beyond. The range of these drives begins at a few dozen lightyears per week, and through research and improvement, can eventually be upgraded to cover an entire galaxy in a month and even jump to other galaxies. This also includes basic infrastructure like orbital and planetary colonies, spacesuits, deep space scanners and FTL communications.

You can also adapt any other technologies or powers you possess for use in orbit, deep space or other planets.
objects.title: Spaaaace!

addons.text: The loyalty of your creations is no longer limited to the generation you personally create. Now, it extends to all future descendants, no matter how distant the relation or how diluted the genetic makeup becomes.
addons.title: Generational Loyalty

addons.text: All the members of your designed species are connected in one massive network which you retain absolute control over. This network not only allows you or your other creations to freely communicate with each other but also retains the souls and consciousnesses of the deceased members, allowing them to either slumber after death in a sort of afterlife or even be reincarnated, with your permission, in a newly created body.
addons.title: Transgenerational Noosphere

addons.text:
All living beings, species, and civilisations you create collectively act in accordance with your subconscious will. If you were to want the society you created to become galactic conquerors, they will restructure their civilisation, put the economy on the war rails, and initiate conquest without any reason or justification beyond your will. Should you want an individual being to behave a certain way — they will. You can even take direct control over some of them, piloting their bodies as if they were your own.

Your creations retain their personalities and free will insofar as it does not contradict your commands.
addons.title: Implicit Teleology
Instant Civilization
addons.text:
With your ability to mass produce both people and civilizations, you can mass create entire stable populations and the societies they inhabit in relatively no time at all. In less than a decade, you could take an uninhabited area and build up an entire diverse and populated civilization from scratch.
