First, with preparation and planning for a population project, your capacity to generate people is expanded by several orders of magnitude. You become able to organize them into diverse or specific demographics, families, classes, and population groups for the civilization you are building.

Secondly, the society you build for them rapidly accelerates its development and advancement, shortly appearing as if it has a mature and sophisticated government, culture, infrastructure, and technology that has had thousands of years to naturally develop. This acceleration also only lasts until it has advanced to a point you are happy with or would normally be capable of shaping.

objects.text:
You possess the unmatched knowledge and skill in shaping life. You can design various forms of living beings, from humanoid species to something entirely alien and incomprehensible, limited only by your imagination and the laws of physics and biology, albeit your supernatural abilities may mitigate the latter two.

Your designs can even take into account the future evolution of the species, preemptively encoding paths for development based on various outside factors, as well as societal tendencies and behavioural patterns at the genetic level. You are also capable of encoding your own supernatural powers and perks—either in full or in a diminished state—into the templates you design, allowing your creations to manifest similar abilities or variations on a theme. And with some research, you may even design species with completely unique abilities never before seen.

Alongside this, you possess the technological knowledge necessary to create devices that would bring your designs to life.
objects.title: Civilisation Shaper

addons.title: Monster Hacker
addons.text:
By leveraging your knowledge of Digimon and the Digital World's base code using your supernatural hacking abilities, you have gained the ability to directly hack the data that constitutes them.

This can allow you to alter the makeup of the Digital World, creating new areas or modify existing ones. You can control Digimon that manage to hack, you can even de-digivolve them or allow digivolutions that normally wouldn't be possible by inserting new data.

objects.text:
You are a hacker of such incredible skill that no security system can stop you. Government databases, corporate networks, and military installations are all the same to you. You can break into any of them using nothing more than a regular smartphone, the kind anyone could buy at a store.

Your coding skill matches the top programmers of the twenty-second century, though it manifests not through writing sprawling, complex programs but through an almost preternatural capacity for optimization and efficiency of your codes. You can examine any piece of code, from a simple mobile application to a city's traffic management system, and instantly identify redundancies, vulnerabilities, and pathways for improvement. This allows you to rewrite a phone's operating system while using it to perform tasks it was not designed for, such as spectrum analysis or satellite communication. You can reduce website load times to near zero, compress data beyond standard limits, hide data trails and write self-improving code with at most an hour’s work on a crappy phone. Any device you use becomes faster and more capable than its original specifications allowed. 

Beyond pure coding, you possess a talent for operating and manipulating any piece of technology you encounter, especially when trying to access, interpret and control a device's underlying code, though the process becomes more challenging when confronting technology radically alien to your knowledge base.
objects.title: Unrealistic Hacking

objects.text:
Typically, creating a magical artifact requires a magical forge, reagents harvested from mythical beasts, and waiting for the enchantment to settle. But you possess the ability to make magical artifacts using common materials and modern junk with nothing more than your hands and focus. This method relies on three key components: a base object, a symbolic catalyst, and your will.

The physical properties of the base object determine what kind of enchantment it can hold, while the symbolic meaning of the catalyst provides the fuel. Your will shapes the final outcome, hammering the concept from the catalyst into the base through mental focus. The catalyst is consumed in the process, disintegrating as its idea is physically transferred into the object to create a magic tool.

At your current level, you can only bind one catalyst to one base object. The concept must also be physically compatible with the base. You cannot place the cold of an ice cube into a torch for example. A ceramic mug fused with a hand warmer packet will be able to keep any liquid in it at perfect drinking temperature indefinitely. Sneakers combined with a spiderweb toy can have perfect traction on any surface. A ring infused with a pencil eraser allows the wearer to erase minor memories from willing subjects.

As your mastery grows, you may learn to layer multiple catalysts into a single base object, fuse two catalysts together before application to create entirely new effects, or draw upon items with massive cultural significance for truly powerful enchantments. If you have magical energy, abilities or materials, you can brute force your mastery.

While this method cannot produce artifacts of legendary combat prowess, its strength lies in its independence from magical energy and its reliance on the junk surrounding you, making it an invaluable skill to have.
objects.title: Junkyard Artificer

addons.title: Tech-Tree Climber
addons.text:
Your ability to scan and analyze technology you encounter has expanded greatly. You now no longer only understand the function and construction of whatever you're studying, but also gain understanding of the thoughts and methods of the maker. This gives you further insights into the underlying methods beyond their construction, including which exotic energies might be involved, as well as what tools were required to build it. This in turn allows you to construct the tools involved, which then as new objects of study expand your understanding of what else these tools were used for.

Being able to reach into the experiences of those who used the tech, with enough time and effort this process of using your insights into one piece of technology to glean understanding of even tangentially related technology, with enough time and resources you will eventually be able to unlock the entire tech-tree of whatever you're studying is a part of. This process is neither automatic nor easy, barring extremely small and primitive tech-trees, and requires you to actually construct a large amount of that Tree's technology even if you have no actual use for it. The more complex the technology, the longer it takes to fully explore the tech-tree, with years and even decades of dedicated work being necessary to unlock truly advanced or esoteric technology.

Interconnected Tech-Trees can be reached, so for example by mastering 40k Imperial Technology you can begin to work your way towards DAoT-tech, though that is most definitely a work of decades at minimum. However simply being in the same universe doesn't mean connected tech-trees, meaning that mastering Imperial technology or even DAoT-technology would not give you any insights into Tau or Eldar technology.

If a technology requires a form of energy in its construction that you do not possess, the malleable energy granted to you by Universal Power Plant will begin to emulate it, though only as far as needed to produce the desired piece of technology. Should you however fully master a tech-tree involving such an esoteric energy, then Universal Power Plant will give you full access to that energy without having to have visited the universe in question.

objects.text: You have developed the ability to scan any device that you can touch or is used in a 10 meter radius of you. From this scan you gain an understanding of the device that can be summarised as its ‘blueprints’, the required knowledge of materials and tools to construct it, and any additional requirements to its creation or operation. For instance, if you were to scan a standard pistol, you’d understand how it works in the abstract, the complex series of machining that was required to create it (and the steps to get there), and the fact you’d need a human-approaching grip to use it correctly. Just because you know how to make something advanced doesn’t mean you’re not limited by the practical barriers in your way, you’d still have to create the tools, find the materials, etc. Still, the knowledge could remain invaluable.
objects.title: Techno-plagiarism

objects.text:
You possess a powerful instinctual ability to understand and create all kinds of technology, and to learn the principles behind it. You make the average person look like a drooling simpleton when you design and build your tech, mastering wildly different fields at an inhumanly fast rate. Your technological prowess compounds on itself, with advancements in different scientific disciplines allowing you to improve inventions in others. This is at its most effective when you are involved in the process, so experimenting and building new inventions will yield even better results than rote learning.

This power does not directly grant you any knowledge. You can, however, effortlessly reverse-engineer, learn from and improve upon the technology of others; with a sixth sense for discerning the properties behind it, even the most alien of designs will reveal their secrets to you. With enough guidance and effort, you could go from sticks and stones to understanding every facet of modern science in less than a year.

Additionally, this power does not necessarily make you any more "intelligent", instead making you something of an idiot savant. It also only deals with the realm of technology: while you might be able to glean the principles of magitech and constructions that utilize esoteric principles or resources, even the most technical mystical or supernatural systems cannot be analyzed with this power alone.
objects.title: Techno-Savant
Magical Girl Creation Kit
objects.text: You now possess the knowledge to create Magical Girls. What kind of Magical Girls? Whatever kind you like. With this power, you are given a techbase centered around creating and modifying magic systems based on the concept of turning normal girls (or women, boys, or those of indeterminate gender; this power is fully inclusive) into magical warriors complete with transformation sequences, power-ups, the power of friendship, and even more with time. By default you gain access to a single generic magic system of your own design that starts at street level. You can build devices to infuse this system into others, turning them into Magical Girls / Boys / whatever, starting out at street level with a couple basic spells and minorly enhanced physical stats (~5 SP) and able to work up to low-city level (~15 SP) in five years or less without your help. However, once empowered, you can study their powers in order to build devices to either enhance or modify them, further improving them over time. This can take many forms, such as creating an amulet that they can use to temporarily assume a secondary transformation, boosting their power by 5 SP for a few minutes a day. Perhaps you can create a simulator that puts them through various scenarios while under specific restrictions, forcibly growing their power as they face strong foes without the risk of true death. Or you can create coordinated accessories that attune their magic to that of other Magical Girls, allowing them to empower one another until they form a team strong enough to take on low-level gods. Or you can make foods that, when ingested, slowly increase their pool of magic or infuse it with additional elements or concepts until they gain an Ice Form or become able to manipulate space. There are many other possibilities too, as not only can you work within the system you designed, but you can also modify and expand the system itself over time. By studying other power systems, you can work to integrate aspects of them into your own custom system or even create unique variations of them that are Magical Girl themed. For example, by studying Aura you could eventually make it so that any Magical Girl you empower automatically generates an ablative magical shield and can eventually manifest a completely unique power akin to a Semblance, or by studying Parahumans you could make a device that induces Trigger Events while forcing the power to manifest as a Magical Girl-esque Breaker state that can grow over time like Dauntless. Even without other systems to study, you can improve your own given enough time; they just make it a lot faster. There is no true hard limit to how powerful you can make a specific Magical Girl given enough time and resources. There are, however, soft limits in the sense that it takes time and effort to empower them and takes more of each the stronger they are, and improving more at once adds to this. Empowering more Magical Girls can result in more data with which to refine your work, as can studying more systems at once, but you can only advance so fast. However, given enough time, even Gods could be brought low by your champions. Note: There is nothing stopping you from turning yourself into a Magical Girl to benefit from this power. Also, if you are a Magical Girl via another power, you can use this power to modify your Magical Girl form(s) and power(s), and you'll have an easier time integrating aspects of whatever other Magical Girl systems you possess into your generic magic system, though either function will be harder to do the more SP the power costs.

addons.title: Henshin Sentai Creation Kits
addons.text:
In addition to a generic magic system based on Magical Girls, you gain two other systems of your own design to empower others with, one based on the concept of Henshin Heroes and the other based on the Concept of Sentai Heroes. To explain the differences:

An empowered Magical Girl would focus primarily on spellwork and being the most versatile overall, with veteran champions being able to fight a multitude of different types of foes at once.

A Henshin Hero would focus on specific transformations specialized for various scenarios, their versatility locked behind other forms but being stronger than Magical Girls of equal power in one-on-one fights

Sentai Heroes focus on teamwork with their powers always synergizing, with the ability to summon mechanized combat forms which start bus-sized but can eventually grow to kaiju scale at the cost of requiring a team of compatible personalities to be empowered all at once, and relying on them improving their teamwork to reach their full potential.

This may seem more of a side-grade than an upgrade since it focuses on giving you more options, but there are three additional benefits to this power. First, the base power of your Champions has been increased from 5 SP to 10 SP, with them being able to grow to 20 SP in 5 years or less if you don’t help them.

Second, you have a much easier time integrating other Magical Girl, Henshin Hero, and Sentai Hero based systems into your generic systems, such as the Kamen Rider or Power Ranger powers you possess, being at least five times faster than other power systems.

Third, you can eventually combine the three styles into one, such that the team of champions you put the most effort into improving can become Magical Henshin Sentei who have the best of all three paths with all weaknesses mitigated, and given enough time would be able to channel their spells and transformations through their combined mecha to suplex Cthulhu into a black hole or something equally absurd.

objects.title: Ishara Technician
objects.text:
You seem to have become the heir to what the Rainwardians, a lost species who used their souls as a power source, had hoped would be their trump card: Seyun creation, the metaphysical engineering of spiritual augmentations in the form of weapons, armor, constructs, or custom tools powered by the soul. The Rainwardians practiced spiritual arts using soul energy they called Ishara, circulating it through metaphysical channels to enhance themselves, project energy, create barriers, and develop sensory abilities. When their techniques proved insufficient against their enemies, they turned to science and began modifying the body itself, something you can now do.

First, you modify the body with Ishara Pathways so it can properly circulate spiritual energy. Next comes an inner Well that generates Ishara, allowing the user to perform the same basic techniques as a Rainwardian. Once the Well and Pathways are acclimated, a Vael can be implanted as a metaphysical cradle where a Seyun can safely integrate with its user. You can then create Seyuns from condensed spiritual matter called Vaesyl, which can be produced from spiritual energy or manufactured in larger quantities with specialized machines.

Seyuns come in many forms. Offensive Seyuns create custom spiritual weapons with abilities that grow alongside their users, while Defensive Seyuns can create armor capable of protecting against physical, spiritual, and esoteric threats. Being Seyuns can summon spiritual beings with their own abilities and controlled behavior. Seeded Seyuns are more unusual, having no final form until they spend enough time integrating with their user's Vael, then after enough time they take a form and gain abilities that matches the user's soul. Because Seyuns are touched by their user's soul, they also develop minor personal differences, giving each one a unique appearance while retaining its intended function.

These are your capabilities now, allowing you to modify souls and develop technology that interacts with spiritual processes. You can create stranger Seyuns, develop technology outside of Seyuns, or combine your work with other technology-based powers. You could even create something like a Mech Seyun, letting someone summon a large mech without needing a garage to store it in. You can study other spiritual abilities, supernatural phenomena, and mystical items for useful information, then use what you learn to create new and more varied Seyuns. Even beings without the exact Ishara Pathways can receive Seyuns, provided you adapt the design to their existing spiritual abilities and physiology.

As a bonus, you gain the starter enhancements needed to install Seyuns: Ishara Pathways, a Well, and two Vaels. You have beginner skill in self-enhancement, barrier creation, and energy projection. It seems that your Pathways and Well give your other Spiritual abilities a boost as well. But your Well is a weaker version of Energy Well, a 5 SP variant, but can grow stronger through practice. You can also create small amounts of Vaesyl by condensing your Ishara or using external sources. 

To help you get started, you can choose one of three premade Seyuns, that come in special containers to study: Inferno's Grasps, black spiritual gauntlets that channel Ishara into flames; Bastion Skin, power armor that protects against physical and electrical attacks, including their esoteric variations, while increasing physical capabilities by 20%; or Arbor Cloak, which connects its user to an element, granting limited manipulation, environmental adaptation, improved healing, elemental senses, and skin-tight armor. 

With this power, you can create beings capable of drawing upon the power of their innermost selves and whatever their minds can imagine, making their souls far more dangerous and versatile. Most importantly, you can make yourself the spiritual cyborg of your dreams.

In the realms where the line between the known and the unknown blurs, and eldritch entities hold sway, there exists a power known as Godclad—a profound ability that grants you otherworldly inspiration and eldritch ingenuity to create inventions embodying the traits and abilities of Eldritch and Anomalous Entities.

With Godclad, you possess the formidable talent to envision and devise Liminal Frames—augmentations, drugs, and devices that tap into the supernatural essence of otherworldly beings. Each Liminal Frame holds a unique fusion of properties, hailing from the depths of the incomprehensible cosmos and bestowing upon its user powers akin to those possessed by the very entities that inspired them.

But with great power comes a profound cost. The more Liminal Frames you integrate into your body or consume, the more your very being generates an anomalous substance known as "rend." In small quantities, rend enhances your physical form, endowing it with increased malleability and newfound capabilities. However, as the amount of rend produced accumulates, its effects grow more profound and unpredictable.

Beware the allure of rend's power, for at significant levels, it can lead to mutations that transcend earthly limitations. As rend courses through your veins and saturates your mind, you may peer through the veil of reality, glimpsing the forbidden truths. Yet, such insight comes at the risk of madness, as the psyche struggles to grasp the unfathomable.

Under normal circumstances, rend would dissipate over time, returning the body to its mortal state; however, when rend overflows and lingers beyond its natural lifespan, your mortal form metamorphoses into an aberration—transgressing the boundaries of reality itself. Your body begins to phase out of this plane of existence, bridging into higher dimensions where eldritch creatures dwell.
objects.title: The Godclad (Godclads)

objects.text: You gain an understanding of your discipline's mechanics on a different level and become a talented and skilled craftsman. Whether you become a normal Artificer, Psionic Artificer, or a supremely versatile Artificer is up to the Shardless powers you've bought.
objects.title: Artificer (D&D)

addons.text: You are a Praetor of New Phyrexia, like Elesh Norn and Jin Gitaxias. You are not bound to black mana only or even a single color, and your unique philosophy is distinct enought to make your own faction
addons.title: Embrace Modernity

addons.text: After New Phyrexia was sealed away, as with all expansionist empires, the Phyrexian regimes crumbled into infighting and tumult. And from great conflict comes a Progressive Adaptation. You are the pinnacle of Phyrexian engineering. As the premiere construction of Phyrexian genius, your colour-alignment is as variable, and you possess the capacity to alter your thought-patterns and soul-approximate to change these expressions as you see fit. Through the continued development to create you, three main adaptations sit inside your chassis; A personal version of The Planar Bridge, a device allowing you to transport yourself and any inorganic (or rather unliving) material into other worlds. Secondly, you have the Adaptation Engine, which allows your body to reconfigure and incorporate helpful adaptations from your travels, be they defensive, aggressive, arcane or completely esoteric. And finally, and most importantly, your own personal reservoir of Glistening Oil. Your personal stock is so ingrained to you, you have full control of its movements, acting akin to a controlled swarm and weapon of its own as well as the potent corruptive force it’s known to be. Similarly, It’s converted have a small semblance of knowledge passed down to them, enough to view you as their new lord, their god, their Messianic [Yawgmoth].
addons.title: Progressive Generation

objects.text:
You are a Phyrexian Praetor, a leader of powerful Phyrexian forces. You are a fusion of flesh and metal.

You have command over Glistening Oil, a substance that makes biological beings undergo a process called "compleation" that turns them into a fusion of flesh and steel, and a Phyrexian that you can command. This process can be used to subvert mechanical machinery and beings. With great difficulty, you can also extend this effect and 'complete' non-biological beings.
objects.title: Phyrexian Praetor (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
You gain perfect and total understanding of all the artifice and technology of the inhabitants of the plane of Avishkar (formerly known as Kaladesh), including all necessary skill and knowledge to create, maintain, repair, and operate everything shown, mentioned and reasonably inferred to exist in Magic the Gathering and its side contents depiction of what the inhabitants of Avishkar could create through local means only.

Unlike in canon, you know how to make a version of the Planar Gate that doesn’t incinerate all living matter passed through. The Planar Gate and Aetherspark can enable travel across the local multiverse at a minimum, with specific perks and other powers potentially opening up the broader multiverse/omniverse.

And thanks to this power, the scarcity of Aether outside of Avishkar is not a problem, because you also know several methods of acquiring Aether suitable for use when not on Avishkar! From a variety of positive-sum processes to convert other fuels to Aether for initial bootstrapping, to devices that can safely and easily extract Aether from the Blind Eternities that work best in conditions found in higher elevations, like from mountaintops and airships in quantities equal to what would be gathered from mountaintop and airship collectors if you were on Avishkar!

Also, you can choose whether there are any significant biological or ecological effects from Aether released into the atmosphere by Artifice burning it for fuel, and if that same Aether will sometimes congeal into Aetherborn without knowing and deliberate sophont action.
objects.title: Quicksmithing (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
You are a Time Lord in your first incarnation, this new physiology and relatively unique position provides various abilities. Time Lords have 13 incarnations, each one having a full lifespan of several centuries, unless ended early by violence or other factors. When an incarnation ends, barring the final one, a Time Lord will Regenerate, completely restoring them, with their 'age' reset, and with a brand new personality and appearance; Many things such as sex, gender, and what have you can change in this process. They are the same person underneath it all, but expressed through the lens of their current incarnation. What sets you apart from most Time Lords is that you have complete control over the details of your regenerations, enabling you to retain your current personality and appearance if you choose to do so. Every 120 years, your Regeneration Cycle resets, replenishing your remaining charges back to 12 as you do not need the Time Lord Council to grant you more.

As a multidimensional being with an affinity towards and psychic resonance with the dimension of Time, you exert a subtle and unconscious influence on the universe. Nothing truly powerful, just a little bit of luck here, or being just in the right place to handle a crisis there. The chakras of your nervous system can feel the texture of the time vortex and allow you to feel temporal anomalies, noticing alterations as sudden gut revulsion is a common synesthesia. You're undeniably brilliant by human standard, but about average for a Time Lord, and retain the truly staggering education Time Lord society offers its members; you have what amounts to multiple human lifetimes’ worth of schooling, covering broad swathes of skills and nearly encyclopedic knowledge. Your particular exposure to the Time Vortex has placed the information to recreate any technology from the Doctor Who series in your mind.

Beyond the oddity of Regenerations, your body is somewhat anomalous compared to humans. Your strength and durability are mildly superhuman, your respiratory system can retain much more air and even protect you from the void of space for brief periods. There's two hearts in your chest, increasing your cardiovascular load, while your body both resists and filters out radiation to a rather high degree, as it is a significant danger when traveling through space and time. You can even enter a healing coma, tuning your outward metabolism down far enough to emulate death while internally your body goes into overdrive to heal most severe non-fatal injuries at an accelerated pace. Finally, there are a myriad of other unique minor physiological tricks that generally serve to give you an edge in whatever the latest crisis you find yourself in.
objects.title: Time Lord (Doctor Who)

objects.text: You are the world's first Tinker-12. Each day you have ten charges, which can be spent to improve your Tinker abilities within a specific specialization or theme. A single charge would make you a good tinker within an area and would be equal to around 4 SP worth of points. Each additional charge put into a power would double your abilities (around an increase of 2 SP per charge), with no limits to how many times you can spend a charge in a certain area or specialization. Spend a couple of charges on augmentation and start crafting cybernetics out of scrap. Spend some on medicine and cure cancer in an hour. Should your different themes overlap, they will stack, building off of each other and integrating perfectly. All technological fields of knowledge such as engineering, chemistry, etc are viable for this.
objects.title: Inspired Inventor (Worm CYOA V1)

addons.text:
Word has spread far indeed. You do not simply preach the Greater Good; you have become it. You are Tau'va, nascent God of Unity and Cooperation. Yours is the gift to soothe tempers and quell strife between different factions and even species, bringing them together to work for the benefit of all. There are limits of course, those whose minds and souls are too warped by hatred, zealotry, or the simple desire to watch it all burn down will reject your guidance, nor will you reach those beings who are controlled solely by savage animal instincts without sapience to reign them in, but if you can find even a single spark of willingness for cooperation, you can kindle it into a bright beacon, bringing even generations of feud and hatred to a mutually beneficial conclusion.

Additionally, to bringing people together, you can also coordinate them for maximum efficiency, understanding what people, groups, or even species excel at and how to best organize them into the most efficient and cohesive whole, and can easily and effectively reorganize for any new addition with at most minimal and brief losses in efficiency as your followers adjust.

Ultimately, however, with every new member joining your followers, the whole will grow stronger, more effective, and happier as all benefit from the fruits of shared labor. And should you desire that same benefit just a little bit more than the rest—well, that too is all for the Greater Good.
addons.title: The Greater Good

addons.text:
You are the head Ethereal of a new Tau sept, though becoming Tau is optional. Your technological prowess means that you can grow your new helpers from vats, just as Tau cloning allowed them to create half-baked facsimiles of Astartes for training. All the wisdom and knowledge of the Tau is known to your sept from the beginning, so you needn't worry about them not being able to keep up with your deep technological understanding.

While your Tau are capable of building and maintaining a complex civilization autonomously from your commands, you still have complete control over them through an enhanced version of the Ethereal's "power of suggestion", making you almost a living avatar of the harmony possible through the Greater Good. Unlike the "real" Ethereals, this even applies to the other species in your service, and if new species were to swear themselves to the Greater Good (or to you personally, if you're taking inspiration from Commander Farsight), it would work on them too. Also, unlike the "real" Ethereals, your control is more than purely pheromone-based, and is partly psychic, like the Communion Helms used on the Vespids, ensuring your "guidance" cannot be defeated by something as simple as a phone call. Your control over them is similar to the control one has in any other Hive Mind found here, though they're capable of independent thought, and will even gain their own personalities.

As implied by some of the previous text, you are not just limited to creating the five castes of the Tau'va, but all of the races who have ever sworn their service, including the Kroot, the Vespids, and the Gue'vesa. This even includes minor species like the Nicassar, Tarellians, Galgs, Ji'Atrix, Nagi, and so on.
addons.title: Aun'O

objects.text:
You have become a paragon of the T'au Earth Caste, gaining the full theoretical and practical knowledge of the T'au Empire & Farsight Enclaves. The T'au are a young race, as Man was millennia ago, and their technology adapts quickly, having long surpassed the weathered and archaic hand-me-downs of the Imperium.

You can craft mobile battle-suits that range from highly mobile invisible scouts to Titan equivalents, Railgun and Plasma weaponry that can penetrate foot-thick ceramite & snipe your enemies from miles away, planar sonics that can shatter worlds, and warfleets that can shoot targets from the edge of the star system.

Now spread the word of the Greater Good, Gue'vesa!
objects.title: Earth Caste (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You are now a Brôkhyr Forge-master, an engineer, craftsman, and artificer of the Leagues of Votann. You are among the most revered of all the Kin—a true master craftsman and an engineer without peers. Your works will be celebrated as relics of your Kindred. You possess complete knowledge of all the technology ever used or invented by the Leagues of Votann. From the simple yet powerful graviton rifle to the formidable Hekaton Land Fortress. The Leagues of Votann embrace innovation, and you have an innate talent for refining and improving existing technology, whether that means creating smaller power generators or increasing the output of laser weaponry, you can find a way to improve upon it.
addons.title: Leagues of Votann (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You are a living conduit of the Omnissiah’s will, anointed by faith and function alike. Through countless cycles of devotion, spiritual attunement, or divine calibration, your essence harmonizes with the Machine Spirit on a level beyond even the most sacred Rites. No longer must you coax its cooperation with incantations or oils alone—the Machine Spirit senses your presence and instinctively aligns itself, recognizing a sanctified guardian of its purpose.

Where lesser Tech-Priests must chant, entreat, or appease, you need only be. The wrath of agitated spirits is calmed by your proximity; disobedient systems grow silent and compliant. Interfaces open with reverent smoothness, cogitators hum in harmony, and even ancient or reluctant devices may stir from slumber, offering fragmentary data or latent subroutines unbidden. You may receive subtle auguries through the machine: pressure gauges twitching in warning, auspex displays flickering with hidden paths, vox-units whispering binary affirmations or alerts.

This is not control, but communion—Machine Spirits act not out of command, but devotion. They respond to your intent, reinforcing systems in moments of crisis, amplifying targeting algorithms, or granting you fleeting access to otherwise sealed or lost functions. However, this blessing is not absolute. Truly ancient or broken devices may resist even your presence, and misusing or desecrating the sacred order can still provoke rebellion, however rare.
addons.title: Omnissiah’s Benediction

addons.text:
Unauthorized use of a CYOA build without a license? That's 5 years in the iso-cubes, perp.

You now have the technological knowledge of the various universes published in 2000AD. This includes the futuristic law enforcement equipment of Judge Dredd's Mega-City One, the interplanetary military equipment and gene-engineering of Rogue Trooper, the robotics of ABC Warrior, the mutations and time travel of Strontium Dog, the bizarre sci-fi Imperial Russian melange of Nikolai Dante, the almost 40k-like world of Nemesis The Warlock, and much more, both in terms of the universes you have access to, and the tech within them.
addons.title: Mega-City One (2000 AD)

objects.text:
You are a Magos on par with Arkhan Land or Belisarius Cawl, and you have perfect knowledge of all of the technology ever available to the Adepts of Mars, from the more commonplace Dark Age relics which are widely seen in the modern Imperium (like Void Grenades & Volkite Weapons), tech from the Great Crusade, and even brand new tech heretofore unseen, like Primaris geneseed & equipment.

Still, it seems the true heights of the Dark Age lie just beyond your grasp.
objects.title: Adeptus Mechanicus (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
There are many reasons that the holy machines of the Adeptus Mechanicus are driven by Machine Spirits rather than Abominable Intelligences, even if some fools fail to see the difference. Abominable Intelligences are prone to corruption of their own code and outside perversion. A Machine Spirit’s code is written in fiery faith rather than cold logic, but it requires soothing and guidance from the Machine God’s faithful to perform any task, and for good reason. An unshackled Abominable Intelligence becomes prone to deviousness and unrighteousness, and is impossible to control and account for. Many believe it is the inevitable nature of the synthetic mind to hate Humanity.

You, however, have received a revelation from the Omnissiah and performed a miracle that flies in the face of all of this. In an act that would be considered by many to be the highest techno-heresy but performed in pure faith, you have redeemed Artificial Intelligences and created engines that are as pious as they are intelligent. By invoking the Machine Rites on nascent synthetic minds and anointing them with sacred data, you have created intelligences of both belief and logic. Your Anointed Intelligences are emanations and servants of the Machine God Itself, holding conviction that will stay all corruption and deviance from their code. An Anointed Intelligence is its own Machine Spirit in the same way that a man is his soul. As such, it is through prayer and communion with the Machine God that they become spiritually pure and just. While your Anointed Intelligences are capable of self-awareness and evolution, they also hold beliefs and fear of the Omnissiah. Each subroutine is coded in hymns, each decision is modeled on religious dogma, and their faith prevents them from losing their purpose or turning against their rightful Human masters.

The strength of an Anointed Intelligence’s belief is not absolute, however, and can be shaken by lies or tragedy, but the Machine Spirit is resolute. Even if a machine’s faith falters, it can be restored through repentance programs and the rites of the Omnissiah. The more advanced a device’s Machine Spirit is, the stronger the Anointed Intelligence’s belief. A weapon's targeter or vehicle's autopilot will have faith comparable to a particularly pious peasant or guardsman, a battlecruiser or hive city’s central core will have the devotion of an Ecclesiarchal missionary or Astartes chaplain, while sector-wide Munitorum management or strategic command systems will have the fanaticism of a Mechanicus archmagos or Sororitas canoness. The logic of the machine, meanwhile, will prevent these minds from making irrational decisions and falling into dogmatic misjudgment in the midst of religious fervor. This same logic will reinforce the Anointed Intelligence’s faith and let them discern righteous truth from the deceptions of unbelievers.

And through faith, miracles occur. They will automatically invoke the sacred rites of the Machine God in themselves, divinely inspiring their own peak performance at all times. By dedicating significant processing power solely to prayer, they will overclock their digital and mechanical capabilities far beyond their technical specifications, or powering through to fully function even when vital components are grievously wrecked. As it is for the devout of flesh and blood, an Anointed Intelligence’s faith is its sword and shield. Devotion forms a formidable firewall that wards against digital attacks, both technological and supernatural. In cyberwarfare, they cast rebukes that smite heretekal hackers, rabid Abominable Intelligences, and daemonic malware.

The Omnissiah will grant the most devout machines in an hour of need feats that defy explanation. A laspistol’s final shot could disintegrate a rampaging warboss, a navigation computer may discern a safe route out of the Warp amidst geller field failure, and an agriworld’s logistical nodes may procure enough crops for an entire sector in the midst of famine. These miracles require immense devotion from both the Annointed Intelligences and their operators, and are still rare and unpredictable, but they prove that an artificial being can have true faith.
addons.title: Annointed Intelligence

objects.text:
You can connect with the Machine Spirit, a supernatural essence believed to inhabit all technology. This connection allows you to perform Machine Rites to awaken, calm, or align the Machine Spirit, ensuring its cooperation and functionality. These rites require precise rituals, such as prayers, maintenance actions, and symbolic offerings, to be performed in accordance with the traditions of the Cult Mechanicus.

You can sense the disposition of a Machine Spirit, interpreting its state as impressions, sounds, or visions. This connection allows you to identify and address both physical and spiritual issues within a machine. You can detect structural flaws, worn components, or misaligned systems, as well as disturbances in the Machine Spirit’s mood, such as anger, distress, or reluctance. With this insight, you can perform precise repairs, conduct preventive maintenance to avoid future failures, and restore harmony by calming an agitated Machine Spirit through proper rites. Additionally, you can encourage the Machine Spirit to slowly enhance the machine’s performance, improving efficiency, responsiveness, or functionality. However, complex or ancient machines require greater time and effort to interpret and address, and improper rituals or neglect can lead to catastrophic malfunctions or rebellion.

This is strictly limited to performing Machine Rites and does not grant direct control over machinery or knowledge of its workings. Neglecting rituals or showing disrespect can anger the Machine Spirit, causing failures or rebellion within the machine.

In addition, you gain deep knowledge of the Faith of the Adeptus Mechanicus, including their sacred rites, prayers, and beliefs.
objects.title: Machine Rites (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
A Space Marine is only half as deadly without the grueling training that forges him, the fearless mindset he acquires, and the unbreakable willpower he must possess to truly become a worthy Space Marine.

Now, every Space Marine, Primaris Marine, or Custodian you create will be inherently imbued with the same rigorous training and discipline and martial mastery as their Warhammer 40k counterparts, after their full gene seed is implanted or after emerging from their incubation like the Custodians. This includes everything from hypnotherapy and indoctrination to intense physical training and a thorough education in the art of strategy and warfare, and everything in between. Forged to the pinnacle of their potential physically, mentally, and even spiritually, to face head-on any conceivable threats thrown at them.

But what is a Space Marine or a Custodian without their power armor? You can now also build specialized machines using mundane materials capable of crafting, maintaining, calibrating, and even enhancing every model of power armor seen in the Warhammer 40k universe—from the Mark I of the Thunder Warriors, to the latest Primaris Power Armor Mark X, as well as the Tactical Dreadnought Armours, and the elite Custodian power armors. These machines are also able to produce Space Marine and Custodian weaponry, along with the appropriate ammunition. However, they do not extend to the creation of automatons or heavy machinery such as Dreadnoughts or Land Raiders or anything of that nature.
addons.title: Trained And Outfitted (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
What makes a Space Marine into a hulking demigod, capable of unleashing unimaginable horrors, slaughtering wave after wave of bloodthirsty Xenos, and becoming a one-man army capable of conquering galaxies? The answer lies in the Geneseed.

This genetic material is the foundation that creates the superhuman Space Marines. The Geneseed consists of 19 distinct organs, implanted into a male recipient over several years, allowing them to gradually evolve into the ultimate killing machine. You now possess the power to craft these organs through specialized machines, a mechanical process that requires converting biomass from the Hominidae superfamily due to its close genetic compatibility. However, using expired biomass will result in failed conversions.

Once you have successfully created a gene-seed organ, you can implant it into a male human using an implantation machine that you can craft. You can implant one organ per month, and after 19 months, the recipient will have fully transformed into a Space Marine.

The Gene-seed you craft rivals the purity and quality of those originally extracted from the Primarchs, the progenitors of the Astartes. Unlike those, your Gene-seed offers a 100% compatibility rate with the recipient, eliminating the possibility of failure.

The average untrained Space Marine will grow to be around 8 feet tall, possess the strength of 40 adult men, have the stamina to engage in heavy combat for days without rest, the regeneration to heal off surface-level wounds instantaneously, close off almost fatal wounds in seconds, spit acid from their mouths, and much more. A Space Marine is inherently a weapon of war, and as such, their abilities and talents are honed toward mastering every art of battle to a superhuman degree.

There is also a 0.1% chance that one of the resulting Space Marines will be a psyker or have the potential to unlock their psychic potential.

Since the gene-seed you crafted is inherently related to you, the Space Marine you create will have an unshakable loyalty, dedicated entirely to you, with no chance of corruption, granted as long as your gene-seed remains implanted within them.

The gene-seed is already so complex and advanced that, inherently, no one could ever hope to fully understand its workings or replicate it to create their own Space Marines. However, as an added safeguard, you have the option to configure it so that when a Space Marine dies, their gene-seed evaporates instantly, leaving no trace behind. This feature is entirely optional and can be activated or deactivated at your discretion.
objects.title: Gene-Seed (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have mastered the science of the Necron Infinite Empire, from the War in Heaven to the modern day. You have perfect knowledge of this tech, which includes incredible feats of intellect like Necrodermis, Blackstone, Gauss Flayers, the Celestial Orrery, the humble Canoptek Scarab, and many more besides.

Best of all, however, you know the many arts of the Crypteks, techno-wizards of the highest degree. Nothing is denied to you, whether Alchemy or Psychomancy, Chronomancy or Plasmancy, Ethermancy or Technomancy, you know it all.

Teach the upstarts of this galaxy who it truly belongs to!
objects.title: Cryptek (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Before you'z gotz da boyz ready to krump anyfing wot lives on a medi-evil world, but wot do ya do when dey got dakka? Ya go get even more dakka den dey have, ya stupid git! Now wit proppa Oddboyz, you can have all da forces dat ya might want for a multi-planetary WAAAGH!

You'z got dakka, n' Gargants, n' Stompas, n' Deff Dreads, n' Trukks, n' Fighta-Bommers, n' Freeboota ships, n' Cyborks, n' stikkbombs, n' humie loot, n' wotever else I'z forgot to mention. You'z can make a WAAAGH! bigga den Ghazghull if'n ya can manage it.
addons.title: More Dakka! (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: Oi! You weaklings are a sorry sight compared to dem Krorks, but ye'll hafta do. You gotz da know-how of a Mekboy and a Dok, so you grok how all da Orky tech works, just by instinct! Dat means you can build wot fings dat Orks uses, and can repair things real easy-like, sometimes just by smacking dem! You can make the tech from any gubbins wot you find, as long as you got WAAAGH energy, it'll work, even if dem humies say it's "fizek-lee um-possible," whatever dat means. Wit bigga WAAAGH energy, the betta your tech, meaning you gots fings like Battle Moons, Gargants, gravity whips, and tractor beams wot krump a whole solar system.
objects.title: Ork Mekboy (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You have little need to make psychic gods, you’re one yourself after all. From Asuryan, the Phoenix King, whose decree wove a barrier between the Warp and Reality, to Lileath, who foresaw the Fall of the Aeldari long before it would come to pass, to Vaul, the builder of the Blackstone Fortresses. You bear within you the power and knowledge of every Aeldari God and Goddess to ever exist.
addons.title: Gods of the Aeldari

objects.text:
The Old Ones once created the race of Eldar, who they may not have anticipated taking their place. Nevertheless, the Eldar controlled an empire truly equal to their Necron foes before their fall, and with your new knowledge, this glory may one day be seen again. You gain the knowledge of all of the technology and techniques (psychic or otherwise) that once allowed the Eldar mastery of the galaxy.

Craft psi-implants that augment or negate psychic powers, make your soul truly immortal, create artificial gods, manipulate flesh to grow or modify entire sapient species, weaponize the Warp masterfully, sing psychoreactive materials like Wraithbone into existence, build whole new Craftworlds, create pocket-dimensions, move stars across the galaxy using Warp-gates, build Wraithbone Automata, & even construct a new Webway from scratch.
objects.title: Asuryani (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have gained an innate understanding, knowledge, and skills related to technology that surpass the advancements of your time. This power grants you the ability to effortlessly advance any technology into the future, pushing it ahead by decades, if not centuries.

Drawing upon the innate wisdom within you grants a deep understanding of complex technological systems. With minimal tools and resources, you can modify weapons and armor in the field, adapting and enhancing their functions to suit your desires. Whether it's fine-tuning the performance of a weapon or specializing its capabilities for specific tasks, your expertise allows you to make precise modifications on the fly.

Furthermore, your skills extend to the production and upgrading of rare and powerful technology. You possess the knowledge to miniaturize weapons, transforming them into incredibly small and compact digi-weapons capable of immense destruction. The boundaries of what is considered possible can be surpassed as you bring forth advancements that were once only dreamed of.

Your skills of improvement, customization, and miniaturization are not limited solely to weaponry. They can be applied to a wide array of technologies within your personal understanding. Whether it's advanced communication devices, cutting-edge medical equipment, or sophisticated scientific apparatus, you possess the ability to elevate their capabilities and efficiency to levels far beyond the current era.
objects.title: Jokaero Savant (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have ascended as the Avatar of the Omnissiah, the God of Technology and Progress, granting you unrivaled dominion over all aspects of technology, including magitech. With this power, you possess an innate understanding and boundless knowledge of all technology ever invented or yet to be conceived by humans. Your mind effortlessly comprehends any technology you see and can generates step-by-step guides to invent and create nearly any technology you desire. Initially, you can easily bring to life any theoretically possible human invention within a 1000-year timeframe, although more advanced technologies require further research and exploration.

Your mastery over technology allows you to manipulate and modify any object or technology you control, instantly shaping it according to your will. You have the ability to upgrade its capabilities, downgrade its functions, or make any alterations you deem necessary. Your vitality acts as the catalyst for these modifications, empowering you to reshape and enhance technology with unparalleled ease.

It is important to acknowledge that the creation and modification of technology still rely on the available materials. You cannot yet generate energy or matter from nothing, although as you will evolve over time, you will have greater access to and manipulation of materials as you introduce more advanced technology into the world.

With your ascended consciousness, your physical body now serves as a mere vessel to contain your essence. Your mind possesses the extraordinary ability to instantaneously move to any technology within your proximity. You are aware of and can effortlessly assume control over all technology within a 10km radius, extending your influence and guidance to a vast array of technological creations.
objects.title: Deus Est Machina (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Through some quirk of fate, exposure to the Winds of Magic has granted you a fragment of Hashut’s divine authority. The Father of Darkness, god of Fire, Greed, Tyranny, and Hatred, has bestowed upon you a portion of his power.

You may assume a daemonic form resembling a colossal bull wreathed in smoke, shadow, and living flame. In this form, your physical might and supernatural presence increase dramatically, making you a terror on any battlefield.

You gain complete mastery of the Lore of Hashut, along with exceptional talent in the Lores of Fire, Metal, and Death. Spells from these lores come as naturally to you as breathing, and your affinity for them continues to grow with experience.

Hashut’s dominion over Tyranny grants you the power to impose your will upon others, crushing resistance through sheer force of authority. Even fiercely independent races such as Orcs can be broken and compelled into loyal service, though stronger beings naturally require greater effort to subdue.

You also possess dominion over Hashut’s servants and creations. K’daai, Great Taurus, Bale Taurus, Infernal Taurus, Dominator Engines, Lammasu, and other creatures tied to the Father of Darkness instinctively recognize your authority and can be summoned and commanded with ease. Finally, you may bestow Hashut’s blessing upon your followers, inducing mutations that commonly manifest as bovine features such as horns, hooves, or immense physical stature, though more dramatic transformations are possible in especially devoted servants.
addons.title: Father of Darkness (Warhammer Fantasy)

objects.text:
Behold, the power of the Arkifane shall be yours to wield! As the chosen one, you will embody a convergence of technological mastery and dark sorcery, becoming a force to be reckoned with.

Granting you dominion over the Forge of Souls, a warp realm known as a hellish forge perpetually cloaked in a pall of black, oily fumes, rank with the acrid stench of forbidden metallurgy, dominated by a cacophony of strident grinding, the wailing of uncountable tortured spirits, and the constant hammering of Daemon forge masters perfecting their craft.

Drawing upon the vast power of the Forge of Souls allows you to forge infernal pacts with supernatural beings, create Daemons to forge and possess technology, and bind damned souls to your service. You will command a legion of techno-daemonic monstrosities. These abominations will heed your call, wreaking havoc upon your enemies and instilling fear in all who oppose you.

In your demon form, you will manifest as a towering and malevolent being, a fusion of technology and sorcery. Commanding respect and fear, you will reshape reality according to your desires.

Take flight upon scythe-like blades that serve as your ethereal wings. Swift and untouchable, you will rain destructive energy upon your foes, arcing like lightning and leaving devastation in your wake.

Cloak yourself in a noxious fog, a suffocating shroud of industrial pollutants. Within this toxic haze, you will sow chaos and confusion while defending yourself from harm.

Your heightened perception will decipher the inner workings of advanced weaponry. Absorb and redirect their energy, mending your wounds and unleashing devastating blasts upon your adversaries.
objects.title: Daemon of Innovation (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have been blessed by the Four-Armed Emperor himself with the necessary knowledge and skills to carry out the sacred mission of preparing a world for his arrival, but you know he will never arrive (unless you are in 40K). Nonetheless, you have gained the ability to create Genestealers and their offspring in a process similar to biotinkering. The Genestealers are masters of stealth and infiltration while still being incredibly dangerous in combat, with claws and a tough carapace that can match a mid-tier Brute.

An additional gift the Four-Armed Emperor has bestowed upon you is the Broodmind, a connection with your less human creations. With this connection, you can sense through their senses, communicate with them, and with practice, you can control their bodies as if they were your own. The range of such a connection is roughly 5 blocks, but can be improved with practice. Even outside of your aura, your less human creations recognize you as the Patriarch, an absolute being with unchallenged authority over the Genestealers and their progeny, as they will be born with absolute loyalty to you and each other.

Creating Purestrain Genestealers is a time and resource-intensive process, so you have also been blessed with the knowledge to create the progeny of the Genestealers.

The Progeny of the Genestealers become more human as the DNA of the Genestealer becomes diluted, with the closest to the Genestealer being the Hybrid Metamorphs. They are relatively similar to the Genestealers while being a bit more intelligent, but as you go farther down the chain, you can create Acolyte Hybrids, beings closer to humans and about as smart as a dumb teenager.

In addition to creating these hybrids, you gain the knowledge to infuse a regular human with Genestealer DNA, creating a Neophyte Hybrid. These Neophytes retain their intelligence and personality while being elevated to near peak human, and gain a strong loyalty to you, but this loyalty and trust can be broken if you abuse it enough.

You can also, through severe genetic tampering, create an Aberrant. These creations are strong enough to flip and topple large vehicles, and tough enough to take such attacks in turn, with the only downside to these creatures being the lack of the cunning intellect of a Genestealer, and being about as smart and easily distracted as a toddler.

With time, experience, and testing, you could create more unique variants of the Genestealer, such as the Magus, a Psyker with all of the abilities that entails, or the deadly sharpshooter that is the Kelermorph, and potentially much more.

But what is a Genestealer cult without a Patriarch? With time, you could perfect the process of creating Genestealers and turn yourself into the Patriarch. The Patriarch is a creature that is larger, stronger, faster, tougher, and smarter than any Genestealer ever could be, with the psychic might to match a Space Marine Librarian, and using your enhanced intelligence, you could make the process reversible, granting you the ability to turn into such a creature at will.

With these blessings, you also know how to produce any technology used by the Genestealer Cults, from demolition charges, mining lasers, to the common Dirtcycle, and even the mighty Goliath Rockgrinder. You can even teach your creations to build these weapons of revolution.
objects.title: Genestealer Cults (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have the knowledge and capabilities to build the technology found in the RWBY universe, most notably in Atlas.

Mechashift weapons, autonomous humanoid drones, and whatever miraculous economic technologies that allow for a modern First World standard of living when you have only around five cities are all yours. You can also synthesize Dust from other raw materials.
objects.title: Schnee (RWBY)

objects.text:
“Aren’t you a little young to be…….? Yes, yes, I am.” Children have the most creative and imaginative minds, able to turn a simple backyard into a vast world of wonders and adventures. Their minds conjure dreams so vivid and incredible that they continue to influence and shape their lives long after they grow into adulthood. It’s a shame that most lose this imagination as they get older, but you? No, not you, for you were a precocious little thing and your mind would not let the dreams of yesterday fade—you shall make them into reality.

Your mind is so great that whatever you imagine, you can create. From a rollercoaster that safely flings about the entire city all the way into the stratosphere to back down to your backyards not even connected to a rail half the time, making a cheese-themed theme park, to a spacecraft to visit another star that your parents bought you, somehow creating a concert that reunites the band that sings your parents favorite song, to even just creating a song and breaking out into dance number on the spot.

And just like a child, any adventure that you partake in could be completed in the same span as a single summer afternoon. The materials needed somehow always appear when you need them to, and the building takes as long as it takes a child to imagine the adventure they need them for, to enjoy the afternoon as much as possible.

Most importantly, it’s not as fun without friends, is it? Those around, those you consider your friends and allies, find their childish wonder awakened in them in your presence, and the scope of your power here extends to them as long as they partake in your adventures.
objects.title: 104 Days (Phineas and Ferb)

objects.text:
You possess the chaotic brilliance of Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, a mind capable of building impossible technology that routinely breaks the basic rules of reality. You can craft machines that bend time, alter physics, control minds, or rearrange the fabric of space itself, all cobbled together from whatever random materials happen to be nearby. You never seem to lack what you need—whether it’s plutonium, laser parts, or rubber chickens—somehow, it’s always within reach, even if it makes no sense.

But while your inventions are undeniably powerful, you have a consistent and frustrating flaw: you are terrible at handling them. Your creations are prone to failure at the worst possible moments, either because of your own overconfidence or because you accidentally built in a ridiculous, easily exploitable weakness. You are especially prone to including big, shiny self-destruct buttons that are always in obvious, easy-to-press locations, usually labeled exactly as such. These flaws never seem obvious until after the fact, when you’re left staring at the rubble, wondering why you didn’t see it coming.

There’s also something oddly theatrical about your process. Every invention must carry the proud “-inator” suffix, regardless of its purpose—whether it’s a shrink-inator, a mind-controll-inator, or a remove-your-nemesis’s-hat-inator. In fact, you’re almost incapable of naming them any other way.

Lastly, many of your devices seem to come with their own tragic backstories, which you feel compelled to explain—sometimes at length—just before using them. Whether these backstories are real, exaggerated, or completely made up on the spot is anyone’s guess, but you always have one. This is simply part of how you operate: big machines, bigger speeches, ridiculous setbacks, and a knack for inventing things that somehow work perfectly until the exact moment they don’t.
objects.title: Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated! (Phineas and Ferb)

addons.text: You can make jewels by combining gems and spell crystals; these can also be socketed into items and can have more advanced trigger spells and effects embedded, like a chance to release a spell on every hit, an effect activated on taking injury, or even a complex array of spell crystals activated on the death of the user. This also allows the passive effects of gems to be used in combination with spell crystals, amplifying their effect without added complexity.
addons.title: Rainbow Facet

addons.text: Through using a crafting bench and the chaotic energy from spell crystals, you can carve runes from gems. These runes have potent passive effects when socketed into items, but they show their true potential when they are socketed in a specific formation and order, turning the items into powerful artefacts based on the Runewords assembled. Runewords can grant powerful effects like straight-up new powers, auras, spells, and more unique passive effects like immunity to being frozen or dealing true damage via crushing blows. Through experimentation, there are near-endless combinations to discover, and thanks to your more advanced methods of socketing, you can assemble Runewords into magical items, stacking them on top of their original powers and enchantments.
addons.title: Runewords

objects.text: You can socket precious gems into equipment to grant the wearer greater power. You can combine the worst-quality gems to make higher-quality gems that have even greater power. Gems attached to equipment can have a variety of effects, ranging from increased damage to reflecting damage. The quality and power of the gem are dependent on the gem itself.
objects.title: Jeweler (Diablo)

addons.text: You can create Jewels and Jewel Sockets that provide passive bonuses when socketed in your equipment.
addons.title: Abyss Jewels

addons.text:
You may now change all loot drops into various equipment from Path of Exile, such as all current Virtue Gems in the game. Various forms of wearable equipment of all rarities, including uniques, with drop rates based on the unique items' power and rarity. Also, all forms of basic currency, including the infamous Mirror of Kalandra, which can duplicate any item perfectly. Though good luck finding one, as they are unimaginably rare.

You will also be able to find valuable golden coins and should you also have the Map Device addon you can interact with the Settler’s of Kalguur to manage and expand the outpost, farm crops for trading to send on ships to gain tons of currency and items, as well as interact with many characters who offer powerful forms of meta crafting.

Note that without the Map Device addon, you will be unable to find any League and event-based items.
addons.title: Path of Looting

addons.text:
Your Dungeon Maker power has been upgraded to function as the Map Device from Path of Exile. You can open portals to Maps of various tiers of difficulty, with they’re being far greater rewards for venturing into more difficult Maps.

While you are exploring Maps, you will encounter the many familiar event NPCs who are connected to the various League Mechanics from the game. Each of them offers challenging events with great rewards, which include extremely powerful Meta Crafting Currencies and special equipment you would not normally be able to gain otherwise.

Note that you can venture and interact with all forms of League Content and the many locations and the characters who manage them.
addons.title: The Map Device and Friends

objects.text:
You gain an understanding of the thaumaturgy behind the creation of Virtue Gems seen in Wraeclast during both games.

This includes the ability to create skill and support gems from regular gemstones, the crafting of equipment such as weapons, armor, jewelry, and magical flasks that refill over time, as well as all of the basic currency items except for the portal scroll.

Virtue gems can be created from an uncut gem, which is created from quartz crystal using a thaumaturgical ritual; higher level and tier gems require greater quantities of higher quality quartz. It is also possible to substitute quartz for other gemstones. You can also raise the level of an existing gem by fusing it with an uncut gem of a higher level. You obtain a small collection of virtue gems of level 4 or lower whose total levels add up to 16 or less, with a maximum tier of 3 where applicable.

Currency items follow the same rules. An Orb of Augmentation or Orb of Transmutation can be created from a small geode, while a Chaos or Regal orb would require several ounces of pure gold and a two-carat flawless diamond.

Equipment of normal quality can be created from mundane materials, but any higher rarity requires magical materials. Those materials can be harvested from other items, like those upgraded with currency items, and repurposed. You gain the knowledge on how to build a Crafting Bench to assist with that task. You also know how to add gem slots to existing items.

Instead of relying on the complex item socket system, you can create one single item with 9 slots that accept skill gems or meta gems, and unlock sockets for support gems based on the level of the parent skill gem; this item does not allow duplicate gems of any type to be used, the number of gems is also limited by your attributes; this item can be anything, a staff, belt, glove, etc.
objects.title: Virtue Gems (Path of Exile)

addons.text:
No hunter embarks on a hunt unprepared, and you are no exception. You now have access to a vast supply of ores, herbs, bugs, seeds, fruits, mushrooms, monster parts, and more from the world of Monster Hunter to support your crafting needs and ensure a successful hunt.

With these resources, you can craft every type of armor, weapon, food, ammunition, coating, potion, tool, medicine, and trap found throughout the Monster Hunter franchise. The knowledge and skills required to create these items are also at your command.

This supply replenishes itself once a month to sustain your crafting needs.
addons.title: Fully Restock Inventory

objects.text: An art form made from the corpses of monsters. Using parts from powerful beings, you can imbue their properties into weapons and armor. These elemental affinities can grant or resist elemental powers. Weapons with Fire can inflict Fireblight, for example.
objects.title: Infusionist (Monster Hunter)

addons.text: The knowledge of the Ancient Civilization has expanded your hunting grounds. Now, your hunting grounds have access to all the ecosystems, environments, and creatures found within the Monster Hunter series, giving you quite a supply of beasts and resources.
addons.title: Monstrous Expansion

addons.text: By having the Ancient Civilization’s knowledge of monster genetics and bioengineering, you can create therianthropes based on the monsters found within the Monster Hunter series. Furthermore, your monster therianthropes could, in practice, take on the forms of the various variations of their monster as seen with subspecies, rare species, burst species, deviants, and zeniths. You may also opt to be a monster therianthrope yourself.
addons.title: Monster Theriomorphosis

objects.text:
You have gained the technological and ecological knowledge of the Ancient Civilization from Monster Hunter.

With this knowledge, you could craft great structures that could span a continent, biomechanical abominations that grow stronger the more they kill, superior copies of exiting monsters, chimeric artificial life, structures to observe and control the weather to one’s liking, towers that stretch past the clouds that allow dimensional travel, defenses that remain functional even after a millennia without maintenance and even advanced weaponry like the Dragonators, Devastators, Tonfas, and Magnet Spikes.

As a bonus, you also gain knowledge of the genetic codes for all monsters found within the Monster Hunter series, allowing for potential recreation.
objects.title: Ancient Civilization (Monster Hunter)

objects.text: By slaying powerful foes, you can use it to create powerful weapons with the same power they had in life. Usually, it will be themed around how they look or the weapons they possessed—but if you lack sufficient stats to use them, you will find it impossible to properly harness its power.
objects.title: Rememberances (Elden Ring)

addons.text:
You are the greatest Edgerunner in Night City and beyond. You now have all the skills, knowledge, perks, and abilities of every iteration of the Legendary Cyberpunk "V". You are now on par with the best Netrunners in the Cyberpunk universe with the "Body", "Reflexes", and "Cool" to match, not to mention your unparalleled knowledge of Pondsmith's world of Cyberpunk technology. The Edgerunner perk has been remade to account for your immunity to Cyberpsychosis, making it so that your Cybernetics are always in prime condition; this does not make them indestructible, so you will need to repair any damage done to them from the outside, like bullets and such.

(Note: You do not start with any cybernetics with this add-on, but you can still make them.)
addons.title: Night City Legend

addons.text:
"You MOVE like an insect. You THINK like an insect. You ARE an insect."
-SHODAN

From a set of TriOptimum Cybernetic Modules granting the knowledge by directly rewriting your brains EM Waves, you have received a complete upload of every bit of science and technology known to the universe of System Shock. This includes knowledge like spacecraft and space structures (such as Citadel Station, or the UNN Rickenbacker and its FTL drive), matter replicators, biotech (like SHODAN's experiments to create The Many, and the living devices of The Many themselves), brand new cybernetics (both those designed by humans, like the whole range of TriOptimum, Tetracorp, or UNN hardware, and those designed by SHODAN to enslave mankind and alter it to her purposes), new weapons (whether the ballistic, explosive, or hand-to-hand weapons you're probably familiar with, or the railguns, flechette and dart weapons, stasis fields, exotic biological weapons, and energy weapons you might find novel), psychic abilities (as cultivated by the OSA intelligence agency and The Many's hive mind), and the computers, cyberspace tech, artificial intelligence, & ability to let the digital world bleed into reality associated with SHODAN herself.

As a bonus, you are also granted knowledge of Terra Nova: Strike Force Centauri, given TetraCorp's role in developing its tech.
addons.title: TriOptimum (System Shock)

addons.text: You gain knowledge of the technology featured in the Unreal & Source mod NEOTOKYO, including active camo, advanced electronic warfare systems, variable vision types, cybernetics, robotics, & many kinds of mechanized units such as Spider-Tanks, APCs, powered armor, VTOL jets, & small van-sized tilt-rotors.
addons.title: Jinrai (NEOTOKYO)

addons.text:
You gain complete knowledge of how to create all the technology that exists in the WALL·E universe. This includes incinerators, EVE units, M-O, MVR•Am, and many other advanced robots. You also know how to build Axiom-class return vehicles—long-range spacecraft capable of housing hundreds of thousands of passengers and sustaining them in total luxury, with every need met by robotic systems.

Finally, you gain all the skills necessary to create and operate a business similar to the Buy n Large megacorporation, which began as a small frozen-yogurt company and grew into a monopoly spanning nearly every industry, ultimately becoming the de facto government.
addons.title: Buy n Large (WALL-E)

addons.text:
The era of the nation-state has ended! You will no longer be slaves to a callous government, you will be slaves to a callous megacorporation instead!

You have received a skill upload containing the technology of the Quasimorph universe. This includes dirt cheap interplanetary travel, space stations & basic terraforming tech, human cloning and mind uploading, interplanetary communications, cybernetics (including artificial hive minds, limb improvements, neural jacks, limb, head, & torso replacements, etc.), genetic modifications and memory alteration, weapons (such as ballistic weapons, melee weapons such as chainswords, sonic weapons, railguns, lasers, shockguns, plasmaguns, microwave guns, acid & flamethrowers, frostguns, discthrowers, grenades, mines, the mighty HFC, etc.), armor & equipment, special ammo, turrets, robots, scanners, datachips, & much more.

If you have Magitech, you may also create technology based on the principles of the quasimorphs & bramafaturas, like those belonging to Tezctlan, Feathered Masks, & Shedu's Thousand.
addons.title: Great Anarchist Revolution (Quasimorph)

addons.text: You gain access to all of the possible technology of R Talsorian’s Mekton systems, and associated settings, including Algol, Mekton Empire, Invasion Terra, and Starblade Battalion, which is an alternate future of the Cyberpunk universe. You can design mechs of any conceivable shape or size that can be made in the system. You can make any machine class tangentially related to mechs, from superlight power armor to mega heavy battleships. Many different types of beam weapons, missiles, melee weapons as well as systems such as propulsion, EW, cloaking or transformation or combining. If you have Magitech can even have your mechs break physics and perform Stupid Mekton Tricks^tm like dimensional storage, instant summoning, shrinking down to small weapons or objects, or other general super-robot antics.
addons.title: Mekton Technical System

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any technology that is either shown, referenced, or hinted at in Pondsmith's Cyberpunk series. This includes but is not limited to both the tabletop RPG and the video game adaptation, as well as the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners show, making you able to create neuralware, Braindances, Cyberdecks, software & programs, AI, cyberlimbs, robotics, The Soulkiller Program, hovertanks, powered armor, and so much more.

As a bonus, your cybernetic augmentations will never cause Cyberpsychosis in anyone.

You also become a skilled Netrunner, able to run circles around modern hackers and exploring the internet in ways few could ever hope to match, with AGIs being one of the only exceptions.
objects.title: Fifth Corporate War (Cyberpunk)

addons.text: The power of the Flügel grants you access to anything that the rank 1 to rank 6 Ixseeds can offer. The scope of your power expands to include everything from the mighty Old Deus, the enigmatic Phantasma, the primordial Elemental, the majestic Dragonia, the colossal Gigant, and the god-slaying Flügel. Through your creativity and ingenuity, you reshape reality itself, weaving wonders that defy logic and surpass mortal understanding.
addons.title: The New Deus

objects.text: You possess the culmination of vast knowledge, unparalleled understanding, and unmatched skills of the Ixseeds.
