With this power, you can create anything that the rank 7 Ixseed (Elves) to the rank 16 Ixseed (Humans) have shown, referenced, or even hinted at being able to do. Your creative abilities extend to the Ex Machinas' adaptive weaponry, the Elves' magical wonders, the Dwarfs' colossal machinery and even their continent-shaking bombs. While you cannot cast magic yourself, you can create devices that harness magical powers, or even surgically implant the ability to use magic. In your capable hands, you can artificially recreate the species of any rank 7 or above Ixseed in a laboratory, and these species will be innately loyal to you.
objects.title: The Ingenuity To End The Eternal War (No Game No Life)

addons.text: With the ability to take a piece of anything, it's easier to know where you begin and where they end. For any E.G.O. Equipment within range, you may dedicate a slot of your 108 to synchronize with it. As long as that slot is reserved for synchronization, you will never risk being consumed by that particular piece of E.G.O. Equipment. E.G.Os that are extremely difficult to resist being consumed by may require multiple slots to synchronize with.
addons.title: One to 108

objects.text: You possess the ability to craft E.G.O. (Extermination of Geometrical Organ) Equipment by extracting IDEA from specific beings or individuals using COGITO. While E.G.O.s are considerably challenging and frequently perilous to utilize, they boast formidable strength because these artifacts are a siphoned IDEA from their respective subjects, granting not only the original abilities but also resistances, skills, and even weaknesses. Those lacking sufficient willpower risk being overwhelmed until it eventually takes over their mind, yet those with strong will can step into the persona of another.
objects.title: E.G.O. (Lobotomy Corporation)

objects.text: You gain the technological knowledge from Horizon Zero Dawn, delving into the advanced technologies of the post-apocalyptic world. This encompasses a deep understanding of robotic creatures, hyper-advanced AI, terraforming, and advanced weaponry. With this knowledge, you become a skilled hunter capable of deciphering the weaknesses of mechanized foes, utilizing powerful weapons and traps, and having a knack for exploration.
objects.title: Project GAIA (Horizon Zero Dawn)

addons.text:
Your engineering and scientific knowledge has expanded to include the entire scope of everything seen, shown, or referenced in the video game "The Outer Worlds", granting you access to even more advanced technology.

From AI-piloted ships, Holodisguises, plasma, electric, and corrosive weaponry, to the many ingenious science weapons such as Phineas Welles' Shrink Ray, the Gloop gun (anti-gravity device) and many others, which open up a new path of scientific breakthroughs.

You also know how to safely create the genetic anomaly that allowed the Stranger to slow down his perception of time.

Lastly, you know how to make Neuromods for the skills of those who inhabit the Outer colonies.
addons.title: Spacer's Choice (The Outer Worlds)

objects.text:
You have the technological knowledge of Prey. The advanced technology found on Talos I is yours to produce, make, and create. You can create all manner of technology found on Talos I, from 3D printers, recycling bombs, drones, fabricators, and Neuromods. You know everything that has to do with the technology seen in Prey, including the information and data on Typhons, which you can use to grant yourself Typhon-based abilities and powers.

As a bonus, even without the use of a Psychoscope or study, you know how to make Neuromods for most skills found in the year 2035. With the correct Neuromods, you can be a master musician or a skilled hacker. Your technology can adapt the exotic neuro patterns of alien creatures to make them into Neuromods, which you can use to grant yourself the strange and wonderous abilities they may have.

(The removal of Neuromods may erase all your memories gained after their implantation. With time and research, in addition to other Tinker powers you may have, you may learn how to negate this flaw.)
objects.title: TranStar Industries (Prey)

objects.text:
You gain comprehensive technological knowledge from the mobile game Arknights, unlocking access to advanced biotechnology, robotics, and warfare technologies.

You can create and replicate anything from Terra, including innovations from various races such as the Elders, Ancients, and Teekaz. This includes the construction of Landships—gigantic nomadic cities built on vehicles—along with Originum Circuit reactors and methods to synthesize Originum. Your expertise extends to advanced robotics, including holograms, medic and combat AI-controlled robots, UAVs, UGVs, steam-powered power armors, and sophisticated biotechnology like infection monitors and techniques to treat and remove Originum from the body.

You possess the complete and total research knowledge from every company and sector in Terra, from Rhine Lab specializing in Originium research, biology, and robotics to Blacksteel and Laterano, renowned for their weapon manufacturing to even ones like Rhodes Island, pioneering medical miracles and diverse technological advancements and miscellaneous sectors such as Rim Billiton expertise in mining systems or Aegir known for their comprehensive technological expertise.

While Terra's technological level is somewhat similar to Earth's, it surpasses Earth's in certain areas due to differences in terrain and resource availability. This disparity leads to unique advancements and specializations. Additionally, you can alter your genetics using a Sarcophagus, granting you immunity to Oripathy, similar to The Doctor or Priestess.

Armed with this expertise, you possess the ability to strategically deploy operators with specialized skills, combining their strengths to overcome challenging missions with a mastery of base management that allows for efficient resource allocation, unlocking the full potential of your team.
objects.title: Doctor M.D. (Arknights)

addons.text: You have gained access to the technological and scientific knowledge of the world of Atomic Heart, which is filled with many robotic and biological wonders and horrors. Any machine you build is incredibly efficient, able to move fluidly no matter their size or shape. However, the greatest thing you have is that you know how to create Polymer, an electrochemical substance that has properties of heavy water and silicon, which grants it near limitless potential with what you can do with it, such as being able to swiftly build and repair machinery of any size. You also possess the knowledge on how to create and control the many different biological creatures that are shown in the game.
addons.title: Crispy Critters! (Atomic Heart)

addons.text:
Tremble in fear, earthling! You are now a danger to your home planet, for you now may use the technology of the great Furon race! Of course, such knowledge must necessarily include the cheap, inferior knockoffs created by Majestic, the US military, the KGB, the Takoshima Ninjas, and the Blisk.

It should also be noted that the latent Furon DNA present in all humans has activated in you, granting you the psychic abilities of a Furon, similar to the Majestic Psi-Agents. You may also use Blisk mutations and Nexosporidium cybernetics if you wish.
addons.title: Cryptosporidium (Destroy All Humans!)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge from the year 2077 Fallout, a world that has been engulfed in nuclear fallout; from advanced laser and plasma weaponry to robotics and clean fusion energy, advanced medicines, deadly viruses, space age alloys, cybernetic implants, teleportation, and much, much more. You know everything that has to do with technology seen in Fallout or any of the canon material.

You can also use things from mod content within a certain threshold of lore friendliness (for example, Project Nevada cybernetics would be acceptable, as would official cut content, or things from Van Buren, while a minigun that fires Fat Boy warheads would not.)

As a bonus, you also become a skilled survivor, being able to build things from scraps that you find much easier than a normal person would find, and scavenging for supplies becomes easier for you. Your technology also lasts longer than others, surviving even after 100 years and nuclear fallout.
objects.title: SCIENCE! (Fallout)

addons.text: Your technological knowledge has expanded to that of the world of The Matrix, both Human and Machine. From the rise of the Machines (including the advanced export technology of Zero-One, and the even more advanced domestic technology solely for machine use), to the mechanized troops of Zion & the UN forces, to vast human energy farms & simulation tools allowing for the practical employment of billions of now obsolete human beings, your databanks (or brain) contains it all.
addons.title: The Second Renaissance (The Matrix)
Security Concepts (RoboCop)
addons.text:
We've got to actualize synergies to realize OCP shareholder value in Q3. To do this, Omni Consumer Products has provided you a complete database of our industry leading technology, which has seen enormous success in cleaning up Detroit as part of the Delta City project.

Naturally, this includes our core product line, such as Alex Murphy-style humanoid cyborg exoskeletons, Cain-style full cybernetic conversions, Otomo produced under license from our parent company Kanemitsu, the ED-209 & Urban Enforcement Droid autonomous drone units, advanced weapons like the Auto-9 & the Cobra Assault Cannon, Rehab PMC kit, the Flightpack, Delta City's architecture, the MetroNet NeuroBrain, & SAINT, as well as the scrapped revamp of our product line from 2014 (though there were some noticeable quality issues).

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of the Terminator franchise, being able to create anything shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Terminator franchise (including the tech of humans, Skynet, Legion, & Kokoro). Hunter-Killers, AI, Nuclear Energy, energy weapons, time travel, and so much more are at your disposal.

As a bonus, you gain the ability to improve technology at a rapid pace, similar to Skynet going from basic tanks with virtual intelligence to androids that can mimic humans within a short timeframe. You also bring a sense of loyalty in all the self-aware creations you make—so long as you don't try to kill them without reason, they will still trust you and be loyal to you.
objects.title: Cyberdyne Systems (Terminator)

objects.text:
You have the technological knowledge found in Azur Lane, a world where naval warships are personified as Shipgirls, with various technologies found from every faction, ranging from Iron Blood to Sirens. You know how to create, repair, and alter Wisdom Cubes. Wisdom Cubes can be used for a variety of things, and more importantly, can be used to create a Shipgirl. They are existences that embody various naval warships in the form of humans and can have a variety of different capabilities. Some are more esoteric than others; the stronger and deeper the history of a ship, the more likely it may develop abilities such as viewing alternate timelines.

As a bonus, you possess high Wisdom Cube compatibility and are knowledgeable in both naval warfare and ship-making. You can retrofit and improve just about any form of the ship without replacing the soul. With other Tinker powers, you can even turn any vehicle you create into a Shipgirl. Ships you created that have turned into Shipgirls can work well with you and have a sense of loyalty towards you.
objects.title: Wisdom Cubes (Azur Lane)

objects.text: You gain the profound knowledge of the Isu from the Assassin's Creed franchise. This includes advanced understanding of their technology, history, and secrets. Alongside this knowledge, you develop a sixth sense that grants incredible innate talent in any skill and selective prescience, providing instinctual knowledge of the future. With these newfound abilities, you become an unparalleled force, capable of shaping the present and foreseeing the future, while possessing exceptional expertise in any chosen field. Your actions carry the weight of ancient wisdom, positioning you as a catalyst for great advancement.
objects.title: Those Who Came Before (Assassin's Creed)

addons.text: Your knowledge of viral organisms has greatly expanded, allowing you to create the extremely fatal and mutagenic Viruses Redlight and its evolved variant Blacklight. But your knowledge and understanding of viral organisms has now allowed you to have complete control of the mutagenic paths of every virus you know how to create, preventing unexpected variables from natural mutations. This is the same for every virus you design, as well as allowing you to gain a complete understanding of any virus or similar organisms you encounter and study. This also accounts for supernatural viruses, such as those from Vampires and Werewolves.
addons.title: Gentek (Prototype)

addons.text:
You know how to make the downright impractical to the impossible workshop weapons and vehicles shown in the Dead Rising franchise.

This includes the Lightsaber made with a Flashlight and a Diamond. A M16 that has three barrels to shoot from and somehow has more bullets than the standard, despite having a regular magazine.

To the Roller hawg, which is a motorcycle but with the front part of a steamroller and fireworks that can be fired from the backseat.

You are not limited to just the blueprints shown in-game, however, and can turn even the most harmless objects into zombie killers and beyond.

Lastly, you gain the innate talent and skill rivaling the main characters, making you a force of nature against whatever force you face.
addons.title: Unorthodox Mechanic (Dead Rising)

objects.text:
You gain access to the technology of Resident Evil. Not only can you make everything seen in the games (and even the movies if you desire), but you can also upgrade 21st-century weapons like The Merchant, which also includes pushing a weapon past its limit in one category, like in the games. Due to also knowing the complete biology of every virus, parasite, and even the Megamycete, you can recreate them, and with your extraordinary knowledge of biology, can even improve, if not perfect them, so you can make your own Super Soldiers or your own personal B.O.W.S.

(Note: combining this with another Tinker power will let you also upgrade weapons in those tech trees.)
objects.title: Umbrella Inc. (Resident Evil/Biohazard)

objects.text: You gain the combined technological knowledge from Earth and Mars in the CthulhuTech tabletop game. From Earth, you acquire advanced military equipment and powerful Engels. Mars grants you expertise in arcane eldritch technologies and psychic abilities. With this combined knowledge, you become a formidable force, wielding advanced weaponry, piloting mighty Engels, harnessing eldritch knowledge, and wielding psychic powers. Your versatile skill set allows you to navigate both science and the supernatural, making you a formidable combatant against the cosmic horrors from beyond reality.
objects.title: Necronomicon (Cthulhu Tech)

objects.text:
You are now a genius of unparalleled proportions when it comes to designing, building, and using technology. With mastery of the collective scientific knowledge of all the factions and races that have ever existed or visited Earth in the Command and Conquer Series, including its various expansions, and mods. You can create any technology that is either shown, referenced, or hinted at in the series, from weapons of mass destruction to devices that manipulate time and space.

Whether you want to teleport your army with the Chronosphere, make them invincible with the Iron Curtain, unleash a psychic blast with the Psychic Dominator, create artificial storms with the Weather Control Device, deploy nanoswarms with the Nanoswarm Hive, suck everything in with the Vacuum Imploder, fire proton beams with the Proton Collider, collect and refine Tiberium with the Tiberium Harvester, blast your enemies with the Ion Cannon, Obelisk of Light, or Scrin Mothership, or anything else you can imagine, you can do it.

You are also able to artificially synthesize any material you need for your creations, from the unique living metal Japan had in Red Alert 3, to the exotic terrestrial ore known as Tiberium. You have no problem understanding, reverse-engineering, or improving any technology you encounter, even if it is alien or futuristic. You are also adept at using any technology you create or acquire, whether it is for combat, exploration, or entertainment.

This includes content from high effort mods, like Mental Omega, Rise Of The Reds, Twisted Insurrection, & Tiberium Essence.
objects.title: Supreme General (Command and Conquer)

addons.text:
You have gained the combined knowledge, skill, training, and experience of the greatest soldiers, tacticians, strategists, admirals, spies, and intelligence operatives from across the Star Wars galaxy, spanning both Legends and Canon. 

From the Clone Commandos and ARC Troopers of the Galactic Republic, to Han Solo and Leia Organa of the Rebel Alliance, to Grand Admiral Thrawn and the Empire's finest officers, as well as the most feared members of Imperial Intelligence during both the Galactic Empire and Sith Empire, their expertise is now yours. 

Whether commanding fleets, coordinating planetary invasions, leading special operations, gathering intelligence, or fighting on the front lines, you possess the instincts and judgment of the very best.

The synergy between Earth and Star Wars technology grants you a clearer understanding of both, allowing you to recognize and overcome many of the practical shortcomings found within Star Wars engineering. 

Shield generators no longer require vulnerable external structures, gravity well generators become more efficient and practical, Dark Trooper power armor can safely enhance its wearer without sacrificing their mind, and countless other technologies benefit from the same refined engineering.
addons.title: Battlefront

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any technology in Star Wars, from both Legends and Canon. From a hyperdrive to Kaminoan cloning to the Death Star—you can make it all. You can also synthesize any material from Star Wars, such as Kyber, Beskar, and blaster gases.

You can grow plants such as the trees of Kashyyyk, or even grow bacteria such as Bacta.

(If you do not have the Force, you are still able to build Force-reliant tech—you just can't use it.)
objects.title: The-One-Who-Creates (Star Wars)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any mundane technology in Star Trek, anywhere in the timeline from the Enterprise era to the Star Trek Online era. From warp drives to matter replicators to Borg cubes, you can make it all. You can also synthesize any material from Star Trek, such as Transparisteel, Dilithium, and Tritanium.

You can't use any technology or psychic abilities demonstrated by Star Trek's many "god-aliens," but very advanced mundane civilizations such as the Iconians, the Borg, the Undine, the Dominion, the Voth, and the STO era Federation are fine.
objects.title: Engineering Section (Star Trek)

addons.text: You now have complete access to TITAN & Promethean technology (as you are one), and have an extensive database of ETI, extraterrestrial, & exsurgent virus-based information which you can use as a starting point for researching those phenomena, with enough research eventually able to make you equal to the ETI.
addons.title: Total Information Tactical Awareness Network
Knowledge of the Godminds
addons.text:
As you have gained the scientific and technological might of the Archailects, the knowledge you gain from the Eclipse Phase universe has expanded to match. No longer are you limited to the achievements of Transhumanity and its contemporaries, gaining the achievements of every species and faction up to and including the ETI instead.
In order for you to safely receive and use this knowledge, you are granted immunity to all cognitohazards included within.

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any transhuman technology in Eclipse Phase, from cortical stacks and Cornucopia machines, to picomachines.

You don't initially understand technology demonstrated by TITANs unless you are one yourself, and ETI technology is right out, but you do understand "equivalent" extraterrestrial technology (like that of the Factors or Iktomi) and can research TITAN technology if you put time and effort into it.
objects.title: Argonaut (Eclipse Phase)

objects.text:
You gain the scientific and technological knowledge of the Orion's Arm universe, including everything from the simplest invention of a low tech civilization to the achievements of the Sephirotic Empires and their Archailects (godtech). Examples of the higher levels of technology included are: directed energy weapons, spacecraft, near-c travel, wormhole creation, nanofabs and monopole technology.

As a bonus you become a skilled and experienced engineer and pilot equivalent to the best of an ultratech civilization.
objects.title: Speculative Science (Orion's Arm)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge from Warren Ellis' comic book "Supergods," immersing yourself in a world of extraordinary superhuman abilities and groundbreaking scientific advancements. This encompasses a deep understanding of advanced technologies, genetic manipulation, and the exploration of human potential. With this knowledge, you become a master of pushing the boundaries of human capabilities, unlocking incredible powers, and reshaping the world through cutting-edge scientific breakthroughs.

Armed with this expertise, you command the power of transformative technologies, merging the realms of science and superhuman abilities. You possess the ability to manipulate genetics, unlocking hidden potential and bestowing extraordinary talents upon individuals. With the combined technological knowledge from "Supergods," you become a visionary, leading the charge in advancing the human race and forever altering the course of history.
objects.title: The Next Arms Race (Supergod)

objects.text: You gain the combined technological knowledge from Age of Wonders: Planetfall, encompassing advanced technologies from various factions. With expertise in energy weapons, defensive technologies, biological enhancements, swarm tactics, cybernetics, robotics, covert operations, economic manipulation, nature-based weaponry, guerrilla warfare, heavy industry, advanced mining, celestial energy manipulation, and honor-bound combat, you become a master of technological advancements.
objects.title: Planetary Unification (AoW: Planetfall)

addons.text: You now have access to the technology from Kojima's *other* series about mecha, Zone of The Enders. If you'd prefer something a little more 90's, you also receive access to the technology from Policenauts & Snatcher, some of his lesser-known works.
addons.title: Jehuty (Zone of The Enders, Policenauts, & Snatcher)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of the supernatural and the science of the foremost experts on ghosts has expanded your technological knowledge and given you an understanding of the world of Death Stranding's supernatural knowledge.

This includes incredibly advanced 3D printers that can fabricate just about any device you are capable of making, beyond what is shown in the games, as long as you have the appropriate materials.

Artificial bridge babies, which can allow you to manipulate ghosts and similar beings, as well as temporal-resistant clothing and other materials to deal with similar anomalies.

Lastly, you possess your own beach that you can use to teleport like Higgs and Fragile, with your range being great enough for you to travel across countries as big as the US, though you will experience immense strain should you do it too often. 

In time, you will learn how to manipulate your beach in other ways as your knowledge of the science of the ghost world grants you a greater understanding of how it can be used.
addons.title: Beached Things (Death Stranding)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of how to create any technology shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Metal Gear series. Now, you too can build a weapon to surpass all weapons: Metal Gear. You can construct any and all technology seen in the Metal Gear games, from Snake Eater to Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance. This includes cybernetics, cloning, Metal Gears, boxes, cigars, AI, viruses, psionics, communications, and even NANOMACHINES, SON!

As a bonus, you will become highly skilled in stealth espionage, assassination, and hacking—your abilities will rival the mythical Big Boss in everything from stealth to CQC.
objects.title: Lord of War (Metal Gear)

objects.text:
You now gain unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and skills to create anything that has been shown, referenced, or hinted at within the Terry Pratchett's Discworld series. This includes knowledge of enchantments, alchemy, and the intricacies of Discworld's whimsical and fantastical machinery. 

Though you don't initially possess magical abilities, you have the remarkable skill to artificially use magic through magitech or grafting the ability to cast magic. This artificial magic encompasses even the most esoteric abilities shown in Discworld, such as those of a Sourcerer or even beings like Death.

Armed with this expertise, you become a master at blending magic and technology, crafting wondrous inventions that defy conventional limits. You can manipulate magical energies, cast powerful spells, and tinker with eccentric machinery throughout the Disc. With this combined and magical knowledge, you become a true sorcerer-engineer, capable of remarkable feats.
objects.title: Leonard of Quirm (Discworld)

addons.text: You now have access to the science & technology of the GATE organization, from makeshift hardscrabble items created by scientists locked inside the Cascade Research Facility, to the largest megaprojects.
addons.title: These Ridiculous Ties (Abiotic Factor)

objects.text:
With your newfound knowledge of the science of Aperture Science and Black Mesa, you possess the ability to create anything the humans have shown, referenced, or hinted at being able to build in the Portal and Half-Life franchises. This includes, but is not limited to: quantum tunneling devices, long-fall boots, robotics, AI, turrets, interdimensional tech, gravity guns, HEV suits, advanced medical solutions, and much more. 

As a bonus, you gain the ability to think with portals, an innate understanding of how the forces of gravity and kinetic energy will act on your body and held possessions in any given scenario. You excel at thinking outside the box, approaching problems, and finding solutions that are innovative and unconventional.
objects.title: Science Team (Portal/Half Life)

addons.text:
You can now construct androids of a similar nature to Rensa cyborgs. These androids will be able to channel the supernatural abilities of anyone within the range of 200 meters, as well as maintain continuous access to up to seven individuals, allowing the android to draw on their power without those individuals being in range. While only one ability can be used at a time, it takes only 0.7 seconds to switch between the abilities.

Unlike the Rensa cyborgs, you do not need a human brain to pilot the body, as androids are fully capable of acting on their own.

Do note that this technology can only act as an 'output point' for the powers. As such, if the source of the power is unavailable, which can happen when an individual whose power is being drawn out is dead, then it will be impossible to access their power.
addons.title: Rensa 2.0

addons.text:
You now have access to the technology from PlatinumGames stylish shooter, Vanquish, allowing for the most high-octane power armor usage in all of fiction.

You are a master of this technology, including numerous power armor variants (particularly the Augmented Reaction Suits or Bogey Suits), personal weapons in the form of both regular infantry kit and BLADE modes for the power armor, space colonies like Providence, advanced energy production and distribution (such as nuclear, solar, & microwave beams), all manner of war machines & autonomous weapons, space battleships, and orbital superweapons.
addons.title: San Francisco Is Gone Now! (Vanquish)

objects.text: You gain the combined technological and magical knowledge from Nier and Nier: Automata, immersing yourself in a world of captivating technology and mystical forces. This encompasses a deep understanding of advanced androids, futuristic weaponry, and the enigmatic powers of the magical arts. With this knowledge, you become a formidable warrior, capable of wielding powerful swords, guns, and devastating magic spells.
objects.title: YoRHa (Nier/Nier: Automata)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge from the anime "Fafner in the Azure," with a specialization in advanced mechs and technologies derived from the unique abilities and physiology of the Festums. This encompasses a deep understanding of Festum technology, energy manipulation, and the integration of human and machine interfaces. With this knowledge, you become a master of piloting powerful mechs, utilizing energy-based weaponry, and creating technologies to wield the powers of the enigmatic Festums.

Armed with this expertise, you command the power of Festum technology, seamlessly merging your consciousness with the capabilities of your mech. You possess the ability to manipulate energy fields, unleashing devastating attacks and defending against formidable adversaries. Your understanding of the intricate human-machine interface allows for unparalleled control and synchronization, pushing the limits of what is possible in combat.
objects.title: EXODUS (Fafner In The Azure)

addons.text:
The rocket's red glare, the bombs bursting in air, gave proof through the night, that your mech was still there!

You gain a perfect understanding of the technology from the Metal Wolf Chaos universe, from the many goofy oversized superweapons to the titular mech suit itself.

You can also choose to retroactively become the President of the United States in any universe you visit where the United States (or an analogue) exists. You can choose this even if you would otherwise be ineligible, and like Teddy Roosevelt, term limits do not apply to you. You also have a natural talent for politics and winning elections, if you are in a situation where that matters.

Note that this is all optional: if, for whatever reason you don't want to be the US president, or even if you want to be president in one universe but not another, you're not forced into anything. This is even toggleable, though not easily, as you have to formally resign or formally be reinstated to toggle it; it's simply successful every time.
addons.title: Mister President!

addons.text:
Amidst the chaotic battlefield, your mech stands tall, a beacon of hope and power!

You now possess a profound understanding of the technology and magitech from the Daemon X Machina universe. From the formidable Arsenals to the mysterious Immortals, you are a master of their advanced creations.

Moreover, you gain an innate talent for salvaging materials from defeated enemies, allowing you to reverse-engineer and integrate their components into your own Arsenal. This unique ability grants you the advantage of constantly upgrading and customizing your tech, ensuring that you remain a formidable force against your adversaries.
addons.title: Project Moonfall (Daemon X Machina)

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge from the entire Armored Core series, becoming a master of advanced mecha engineering, weapon systems, and combat tactics. With this expertise, you possess unparalleled skills in designing and piloting powerful Armored Cores, equipped with a vast arsenal of devastating weapons.

Your mastery of Core customization allows you to optimize performance and adapt to any combat scenario, while your strategic combat tactics ensure victory against even the most formidable adversaries. As an elite pilot, you embody the pinnacle of mecha warfare, dominating the battlefield with unrivaled skill and precision, and emerging victorious in the face of overwhelming odds.
objects.title: Cradle of Extinction (Armored Core)

addons.text: Combining the Biotechnology and Godlike Artificial Intelligence with the science of Esper Creation and AIM Fields has led to something that completely outstrips either. You have completely mastered and refined the process of Esper Creation to an industrial output. Not only can you make factories of these reality benders, but you can also apply AIM Fields and personal realities to your Biotechnology. Shields derived from Vector Manipulation, weapons capable of exploiting the numerous properties of Dark Matter, AI capable of seeing the past and future directly, and other feats of reality bending are now within your grasp.
addons.title: Biological God Engines

objects.text:
You possess an unparalleled understanding and aptitude in the sciences of "Humanity Lost." With extensive knowledge of speculative biology and the creation of god-like artificial intelligence, you excel in comprehending and manipulating biotechnology.

Your supernatural aptitude allows you to push the boundaries of biological and technological integration. With boundless creativity, you invent and engineer biotechnological marvels, shaping living technologies and envisioning new possibilities.

As a trailblazer in biotech, you bring forth innovative solutions and discoveries that redefine the future of humanity. Embrace the power of Biotech and explore the wonders of nano-synth suits, genetic enhancements, super soldier armies, neural implants, bio-organic FTL spaceships, biological quantum computing, terraforming tech, and much more. Your journey in the realm of biotechnological horrors awaits.
objects.title: The Living Legacy (Humanity Lost)

objects.text:
You gain the magical and technical knowledge from the legendary world of The Legend of Zelda series, with a primary focus on the enigmatic Sheikah and ancient Zonai technologies. With this expertise, you become a master of both mystical and advanced engineering.

As a wielder of Sheikah knowledge, you harness the power of ancient technology, such as the iconic Sheikah Slate and its various functions. You unlock the ability to manipulate time, control elemental forces, and interact with hidden dimensions. Additionally, your understanding of Zonai technology allows you to tap into the ancient secrets of the forgotten civilization, utilizing their unique weaponry and harnessing their spiritual prowess.
objects.title: Korok Warcrimes (Legend of Zelda)

addons.text: You now have the technology from the fan work "Psi-Effect", including more advanced MELD modifications & psychic abilities, integrated Psionic-Biotics, Martian military equipment, & Titanian biological science.
addons.title: Mutare Ad Custodiam (Psi-Effect)

objects.text:
You are the completion of the Ethereal's Avatar Project, a human-alien hybrid capable of remarkable things.

You gain the abilities of the XCOM series' various units in one convenient package. You have the strength of an Elite Muton, the shapeshifting ability of a Faceless, the technopathy of a Codex, the Psychic power of an Ethereal or Prototype Avatar, and so much more. You can use the abilities of human units, alien units, hybrid units, whatever, as long as it appears in the series. Through a combination of Faceless shapeshifting, the biotechnology used in the Seeker's construction, and your own psychic power, you are able to change your biology to whatever appearance or functionality you wish, and combine organic and cybernetic abilities together, allowing for things like psychic MECs with genetically engineered eyes.

You also gain the knowledge and capabilities to build the varied technology in the franchise, from sentient UFO navigational computers, to plasma weapons, to even the Avatar Project itself. You can grow the biological units from the franchise in vats, and build the mechanical ones yourself, giving you loyal servants to carry out your plans.

This power also treats XCOM-likes such as Long War, Xenonauts, and Terra Invicta as "part of the franchise" for the purposes of this power. Try not to think about the logic of this.
objects.title: Uber Ethereal (XCOM)

addons.text:
You are the ultimate survivor of the Rim, a living legend whose skills, traits, and perks embody the very best. You now possess mastery(level 20) of every RimWorld skill: from intellectual brilliance and mastercraft artistry to flawless medical expertise, deadly marksmanship, peerless melee combat, and ironclad social influence. Whether it is construction, mining, cooking, or taming the most stubborn Thrumbo, you perform each task with the efficiency and perfection of a godlike pawn.

In addition, you inherit every positive trait and perk the Rim can bestow. You have the steadfast willpower of the Iron-Willed, the resilience of Tough, the productivity of Industrious, and the boundless drive of Sanguine and Optimist—while none of the drawbacks or burdensome traits cling to you. You are immune to mental breaks, addiction, disease, and injury spirals that would shatter lesser colonists, your mind and body operating at peak efficiency no matter the conditions.

This does not mean you are indestructible: wounds still bleed, bullets still fly, and mechanoids still strike hard—but your survival chances are greater than any pawn who has ever lived.

(Note: You do not start with any implants or xenotype's enhancements with this add-on, but you are fully capable of crafting, acquiring, and surviving them.)
addons.title: Rimworld Legend

addons.text:
Your legend no longer rests solely on flawless skill and unbreakable will — it now carries the full weight of the anomalous. You gain every perk, benefit, and trait that a creepjoiner being could wield. This includes Unnatural Healing that lets wounds knit as if by will alone, Psychic Slaughter that tears minds apart, Transmute Steel that reshapes matter with a touch, Release Deadlife Dust to command corpses into unlife, and Shape Flesh to twist bodies into new forms.

You embody every type and benefit known: the cold intellect of the Dark Scholar, the silver tongue of the Deal Maker, the agelessness of the Timeless One, the regenerative power of the Blind Healer, the secrets of the Cult Escapee, the burning insight of the Lone Genius, and all others besides. From Perfect Human with unerring Industriousness and Perfect Memory, to Joybringer whose very presence lifts spirits, to Occultist steeped in hidden lore, you carry them all. Death Refusal shields you from finality, Body Mastery frees you from hunger, fatigue, and weakness, while Shambler Overlord, Psychic Butcher, Alchemist, and Fleshcrafter each grant their unique, forbidden arts.

Where others might stumble upon one or two of these gifts, you hold the entire catalogue within yourself, parallel to your perfected mastery of every skill. Your genius is not only legendary but touched by the unnatural: awe-inspiring, unnerving, and impossible to match.
addons.title: A Vocation Out There!

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge from Rimworld, an expansive game with endless possibilities. This encompasses a deep understanding of advanced technology, colonization techniques, and the integration of various mods that enhance the experience, such as Glitter Tech and Ambition of the Cosmic. These mods are just examples of the vast array of options available to you.

Armed with this expertise, you possess an innate understanding of the optimal path of technological research, thanks to your inner tech tree. This grants you the ability to instantly know what to research next, maximizing efficiency and progress. Furthermore, your learning speed receives a significant boost, allowing you to acquire new knowledge and skills at an accelerated rate. With this combined knowledge and accelerated learning, you become a master of technological advancement, propelling your colony to new heights of innovation and prosperity.
objects.title: Glitterworld (Rimworld)

objects.text:
The ancient Theurgists of the Former Empires were pioneers who went beyond the limits of what was considered possible. They didn't just study the laws governing the world; they actively reshaped those laws. They were masters of both the physical realm and the enigmatic realm of the spirit. Unfortunately, their reign of brilliance was cut short, but had they continued, the world would have been radically different.

As their true heir, you possess the combined technological and magical knowledge of the Empire and the remarkable ability of a Theotechnician. However, your skills far surpass the realm of mere mortal science and magic. Your designs and creations are nothing short of miraculous, surpassing the boundaries of what was previously achievable.

But your expertise extends even further. Just like the ancient Theurgists, you can repurpose divine or cosmic elements as fuel for your work. For instance, faith and worship have long been recognized as catalysts for miracles. What if you bypassed the traditional intermediaries and directly integrated souls into your creations? There are countless unused souls that would otherwise go to waste. You can even sabotage natural law and redirect the cosmic friction to ensure they support your works.
objects.title: Throne of Empty Heaven (GodBound)

addons.text:
With this, you have achieved all that any player of Fallen London (and its sequels) can. You have effectively attained maximum stats in all categories that are measured in the Fifth City universe, possessing a Legendary Charisma, a Shattering Force of Strength, an Invisible Eminence, and an Extraordinary Mind, though this is hardly the end of your capabilities. With your knowledge, you can create nearly anything seen in this universe, and vast amounts of these materials, potentially even creating new lifeforms with your understanding of the Shapeling Arts. A deal cut with the Boatman allows you to return from death, again and again - though you will have to defeat him in a game of skill or chance before then. 

Most importantly of all, though, you have the choice to ascended the Great Chain of Being, and become something greater than human - a Master of the Bazaar (or, in terms befitting those familiar with the High Wilderness, a Curator, which is a giant eldritch space bat), and your own area of specialization (which grants you unparalleled control over a concept of your choosing, such as a focus on Value or Light/Law). Your skills with this are supernatural, earning you a befitting title of 'Master,' which all will recognize, alongside a representation of your skill, such as 'Mr Veils' or 'Mr Candles.' It bears mentioning, though, that for one of your skills in the Red Science and Shapeling Arts, such a species is as easily changed as a mask you wear, though total ascension to godhood is well beyond your grasp for now. You are fluent in Correspondence and thus have nothing to fear from its plasmic words, though Discordance may still prove troublesome if you are incautious. You may also compact yourself into a form somewhat resembling a human's, though it will still take effort and some rather heavy robes to hide your true nature.
addons.title: A Paramount Presence

objects.text:
Congratulations! You've been given a premier education in the Red Science. Put broadly, it denotes the investigation of the metaphysical order of the universe and how to manipulate it. In a more narrow, maligned sense—this is how you apply the principles of The Correspondence to reality, to break the Great Chain of Being (which dictates the form and purpose of all creatures) and other laws of the Judgements, or physics.

As a Crimson Engineer, with a little elbow grease and the right unnatural mechanisms, you'll find yourself able to manipulate spacetime, rewrite the rules of mathematics, and defy gravity on a local scale. It can be used to modify flesh and violate the natural hierarchy of all living things, allowing for a change in what a being fundamentally is, and their very nature—and this Chain of Being is something you are familiar with, top to bottom, to facilitate changes along it.
objects.title: Clockwork Sun (Fallen London)

objects.text:
You acquire the profound magitech knowledge from the BlazBlue series, delving into a world where magic and technology intertwine seamlessly. This encompasses a deep understanding of the Ars Magus system, a complex fusion of ancient sorcery and advanced machinery. With this knowledge, you become a master of magitech, wielding extraordinary powers, manipulating reality, and unleashing devastating spells and abilities.

Armed with the magitech expertise of BlazBlue, you transcend the boundaries of conventional magic and technology. You possess the ability to channel powerful elemental forces, create barriers and constructs, and tap into the limitless potential of the Azure. With this fusion of magic and technology, you become a formidable force, capable of reshaping the world around you and unlocking the secrets of the arcane.
objects.title: Azure Grimoire (BlazBlue)

objects.text:
Armed with your profound understanding of the sciences within Starbound and its various expansions and mods, you possess the ability to create any technology that has been shown, referenced, or hinted at, with unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and crafting skills. This enables you to bring to life exotic and groundbreaking inventions, ranging from star-powered energy generators, instantaneous teleportation devices capable of spanning vast distances, to even technology that uses and controls the metaphysics of reality.

Your supernatural comprehension of rare resources empowers you to forge cutting-edge weapons, armor, and tools that harness the raw potential of these materials. With your expertise, you can construct awe-inspiring structures and habitats, showcasing architectural brilliance and technical prowess. Moreover, your mastery extends to manipulating matter on a molecular level, allowing you to synthesize advanced materials and energy sources that defy conventional understanding.
objects.title: To Bind The Stars (Starbound)

objects.text:
You gain all the technological knowledge from the sci-fi manga series Biomega, Aposimz, NOiSE, Blame!, and Knights of Sidonia. This encompasses a deep understanding of advanced cybernetics, biomechanical engineering, and futuristic space-faring technologies. With this knowledge, you become a master of merging man and machine, designing intricate megastructures, navigating the vastness of space, and much more.

Armed with this expertise, you command the power of cybernetics, enhancing your own body and integrating cutting-edge technology into your being. You possess the ability to construct colossal structures, reshape environments, and harness the resources of distant celestial bodies.
objects.title: Toha Heavy Industries (Tsutomo Nihei)

objects.text:
You gain technological knowledge from the year 3750 DE, the far-flung future of the human race. In a world where humanity has transcended the human form in favor of a stronger society, the scientists from the year 2055 discovered phlux particles, although the name is a misnomer, as phlux particles are actually a virus that was found when scientists explored the sea and found a virus that supercharged evolution, causing biology to super evolve past its limits and allowing them to create bioengineered monsters that far exceeded the limits of normal biology and crammed more into them than was possible. It was named after Charles Ludvig Phlux, the marine biologist who found it after initially looking for anomalous sea life that had grown to unnatural lengths, which allowed them to facilitate the improvement of technology to unparalleled heights. 

The first thing humans did with this was create super soldiers to quell a rebellious public that started rioting after a global recession that made millions homeless. The superhuman soldiers could easily lift tanks with no problem and see and react to things faster than a normal man—around 200 times stronger than the strongest man.

Most humans use this technology for superfluous reasons, like grafting animal features to themselves to make themselves feel more exotic. There is more to the technology than simple cosmetics, as humans learned to shift from computer technology made from metal to using biology instead. They could connect to the internet through specialized devices called neural couplings that interfaced with all biological technology made by Spyder Microsystems.

The humanity of the modern age has figured out genetic engineering to create biological ships called leviathans that soar through space faster than light, plasma weapons made from eels and other aquatic animals that use water as ammo, clones made to do labor-intensive jobs and fight in war carrying genetic memories of how to fight and strategy, and monsters of war called Traarril. They are mostly used for the construction of buildings and other such labor jobs during times of peace, but in times of war, they are bioengineered to spit poisonous gas and launch bone spikes and can be piloted by trans-humans who have neural couplings.

<small>(Note that mega projects like Leviathans would take time to build; however, creating monsters of war like Traarril would be relatively easy, as would creating Quisers (biological guns that shoot various rounds such as bone spikes and acids.)</small>
objects.title: Transhumanist Future (The Red Sun)

addons.text: You are no longer barred from using things from G Gundam, meaning you can use Super Robot bullshit like martial arts strong enough to fight Mobile Suits barehanded, Gundams "evolving" without human input, yelling and/or the power of love/friendship giving you temporary superpowers, special moves that seem like they should not be able to be produced by mundane technology, Gundams based on various national sterotypes, and whatever "German Ninjutsu" consists of.
addons.title: Shining Finger

objects.text:
You acquire the extensive technological knowledge from the "real robot" parts of the Gundam series, basically meaning everything but G Gundam. This includes not only conventional technology like the Mobile Suits or Space Colonies, but those relating to humanity's evolution, such as being able to create Cyber-Newtypes as good as the real thing (both in ability & mental stability), Coordinators & Ultimate Coordinators without sterility or miscarriages, Biological CPUs without defects, X-Rounders without regressing to caveman brain, Alaya-Vijnana systems without the risk of dying from a malfunction, and Innovades that are effectively True Innovators.

You also gain Newtype abilities as strong as Kamille Bidan, as well as Innovator abilities equivalent to Setsuna F. Seiei, whatever the hell Heero Yuy was, & Coordinator abilities equivalent to Kira "Jesus" Yamato. These unique adaptations allow you to intuitively use & synchronize with technology, including but not limited to Mobile Suits, use a form of "super initution" like a Spider-Sense on steroids, use telepathy over any distance or across language and even species barriers, remain as a kind of space ghost long after your physical body dies, gain enhanced physical and mental abilities from being a Coordinator, potentially use telekinesis (I'm pretty sure that's what happened with the Axis Shock, right?), and many other useful mental, physical, & psychic abilities.
objects.title: Newtype (Gundam)

objects.text: You gain the combined technological knowledge from all factions in Doom 2016, its prequel Doom: The Dark Ages and its sequel Doom Eternal, immersing yourself in a world of relentless demon-slaying and advanced weaponry. This encompasses a deep understanding of the advanced technologies employed by the UAC, the ancient Sentinel civilization, the forces of Hell itself, and the enigmatic Maykr. With this knowledge, you become a skilled warrior, capable of wielding devastating weapons, harnessing supernatural powers, and traversing otherworldly dimensions.
objects.title: Maykr (DOOM)

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge from Sid Meier's Civilization: Beyond Earth and Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri. This encompasses expertise in terraforming, resource management, colonization strategies, scientific research, diplomacy, and advanced technologies from both games. With this comprehensive knowledge, you become a visionary leader capable of shaping the destiny of your civilization on alien planets and beyond. You can terraform environments, efficiently manage resources, conduct groundbreaking research, navigate diplomatic complexities, and leverage advanced technologies to build a prosperous and influential society. Drawing from the collective wisdom of these games, you possess the tools to navigate the challenges of space colonization, forge alliances, explore new frontiers, and lead humanity towards a brighter future in the vast expanse of the cosmos.

As a bonus, you also receive knowledge of all the technology appearing in the Civilization series, such as Future Tech, Giant Death Robots, Civ IV Next War, Afterworld, & Final Frontier, Civ VI Red Death, as well as the more primitive tech from earlier eras. If taken with Magitech, this includes things like Civ II Fantastic Worlds, Civ IV Gods Of Old, Civ V Empire Of The Smoky Skies, & Civ VI Heroes, Legends, & Secret Societies.
objects.title: Science Victory (C:BE & SMAC)

objects.text:
You gain the combined knowledge of the Endless, the enigmatic beings from the Endless Space series. This encompasses an immense understanding of the universe and its intricate workings, including the complexities of advanced technologies, cosmic phenomena, and the secrets of the Endless themselves. With this knowledge, you grasp the principles of interstellar travel, resource management, scientific discoveries, and the manipulation of Dust, a powerful substance that permeates the cosmos.

Additionally, your body undergoes a transformative change as it becomes infused with the essence of Dust. Your being now passively generates self-replicating nanomachines derived from the Endless' technology. These Dust nanomachines are capable of wondrous feats, including molecular manipulation, energy generation, and advanced healing capabilities. As they spread throughout your body, they enhance your physical and mental abilities, granting you unparalleled resilience, adaptability, and a heightened connection to the cosmic forces at play.
objects.title: Legacy of the Endless (Endless Space)

objects.text:
The Nobility were masters of both science and sorcery. During their prime, they developed mind-boggling technologies and harnessed magic in ways that surpassed our wildest imaginations. 

They created awe-inspiring inventions, such as devices capable of scooping up entire cities and fitting them into pockets, weapons with the power to obliterate multiple worlds in a single strike, and shields fueled by the movements of galaxies. 

Furthermore, their mastery extended to the mastery of the 4th dimensions and the manipulation of magic, as well as the control of life and death, even warping reality to their liking through mystical arts. 

They even delved into alchemy, crafting a homunculus capable of cataclysmic destruction. Additionally, their starships possessed capabilities far surpassing even the most advanced Clarketech, presenting mind-bending possibilities. 

These accomplishments merely scratch the surface of the astounding scientific and magical wonders achieved by the Nobility. Now, all this vast knowledge has been uploaded directly into your mind.
objects.title: Impossible Possibilities (Vampire Hunter D)

objects.text:
You acquire the profound technological knowledge from the Gunbuster & Daibuster series, delving into the realm of advanced mecha and colossal battles. With this expertise, you become a master of piloting and commanding mighty machines of destruction.

Armed with the knowledge of Gunbuster & Daibuster technology, you can harness the immense power of towering mecha, equipping them with devastating weaponry and impenetrable defenses. Your understanding of the intricate mechanics and combat strategies allows you to engage in epic battles against towering enemies and colossal threats. Whether defending humanity from alien invasions or embarking on heroic missions, your command over technology propels you to the forefront of the fight. With your mastery of the technological advancements from the Gunbuster & Daibuster series, you stand as a champion of humanity, ready to face any challenge that comes your way.
objects.title: Buster Machine No. 01 (Gunbuster)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of Krypton, a highly advanced civilization known for its mastery of sunstone technologies. This encompasses a deep understanding of advanced energy manipulation, molecular engineering, and harnessing the power of Krypton's sun. With this knowledge, you become a master of sunstone technologies, wielding the ability to create powerful crystal constructs, manipulate matter at a molecular level, and tap into the immense energy reserves of stars.

Armed with this expertise, you possess the ability to shape energy into various forms, such as protective barriers, offensive weapons, and advanced transportation systems. Additionally, you can manipulate the building blocks of matter, enabling you to create advanced materials, modify structures, and even heal injuries. With the combined technological knowledge of Krypton's sunstone technologies, you become a formidable force, harnessing the power of stars to achieve extraordinary feats and reshape the world around you.
objects.title: Krypton (DC Comics)

addons.text:
You’ve transcended the boundaries of your technological prowess, gaining access to the scientific understanding and advancements from the baseline DC Universe and beyond. Your knowledge encompasses cutting-edge inventions and projects from heroes, villains, terrestrial, galactic, and dimensional civilizations spanning the DC Multiverse and beyond, which particularly includes the advanced technologies of the Fourth World alongside other extraterrestrial races such as The Controllers, The Psions, and The Maltuseans, to name a few. With this, you obtain enough comprehension of the Source Wall and its wonders, harnessing applications of cosmic energy, or engaging with the mysteries of the universe left to see through your continuous experimentation. Limitless technological potential is the road standing before you.

Just don’t let it get away from you, you wouldn’t like to make Krona’s mistake.
addons.title: The Man Of Tomorrow
The Committee for Metahuman Affairs (DC Comics)
addons.text:
By gaining a piece of the Committee for Metahuman Affairs’ attempt to preserve American power in the face of superheroes, you’ve become incredibly adept at designing and distributing superpowers.

You can design chambers to imbue exotic energy, power-stealing robots, guns that bond energy beings, and techno-magic frameworks like the best of them all for the purposes of imbuing another with superpowers of one sort or another. With a little effort you could become the next T.O Morrow with the amount of heroes (and villains) you could make.

addons.title: Technothaumaturgy (DC Comics)
addons.text:
With access to the forces of magic, you’ve become extremely adept at weaving magic and technology together. From devices that use magical principles to charge themselves and create esoteric effects, to monitoring software, binding demons to emails, and even stranger mixings.

Even the cutting edge techno-alchemy of Elphius Levi and the unique mixture of blood magic and guardian tech that created the Red Lantern Corps are open to you.

objects.text:
You gain the combined scientific and technological knowledge developed on Earth of the DC Extended Universe (DCEU). This encompasses the groundbreaking inventions and discoveries made by brilliant minds like Bruce Wayne, T.O. Morrow, and Lex Luthor, as well as the advanced technologies and magitech of Atlantis and Themyscira. With this, you can easily recreate your own advanced Batsuits, gadgets, and program sophisticated AI systems like the Batcomputer.

In addition, you possess an extensive understanding of Earth's general technological advancements of the 21st Century. This knowledge allows you to build upon existing innovations and push the boundaries of scientific progress, creating revolutionary technologies beyond imagination.

Enhancing your abilities, you also possess a preternatural sixth sense, enabling you to perceive and anticipate potential threats and situations that require preparation. With an innate skill for meticulous planning and preparation, you are always ready for any encounter, as if you had ample "Prep Time" at your disposal. This intuitive foresight allows you to strategize, analyze, and adapt swiftly to any challenge, giving you a distinct advantage over your adversaries.
objects.title: S.T.A.R. Labs (DC Comics: DCEU)

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge from the Warframe game, delving into the advanced technologies of each faction, including the lost technology of the Orokin. From the Grineer, you acquire insight into their weapon manufacturing capabilities, genetic modification techniques, and their formidable war machines. The Corpus contribute knowledge of robotics, advanced energy weapons, and intricate financial systems. The Infested provide understanding of biotechnology, mutagenic experimentation, and viral warfare. Lastly, the Orokin's lost technology grants you access to powerful Void energy, sophisticated Orokin weaponry, and the ability to manipulate the fabric of reality.

With this diverse array of technological knowledge, you become a master of advanced weaponry, biomechanical enhancements, and interstellar travel. Additionally, you possess expertise in resource management, modding and upgrading equipment, and advanced crafting techniques.
objects.title: Fallen Empire (Warframe)

objects.text: You gain the combined scientific and technological knowledge of the Dragon Ball universe. This includes but is not limited to technology created by geniuses like Bulma Briefs, Maki Gero or Dr. Hedo, but even technology developed by various alien species or even by the very gods themselves. Examples of this include the hammerspace "Capsule" technology developed by Dr. Briefs, which allows you to store vast quantities of resources or even complex objects like vehicles and buildings inside handheld devices by just throwing them at the intended target. Though they are unable to "store" living beings. Spaceships with advanced propulsion systems and defensive capabilities, and gravitational technology that can drastically increase gravity in a given area. This is especially useful for improving gains in strength and endurance training. ﻿ Cybernetic enhancements comparable to the androids created by Dr. Gero and Dr. Hedo. Providing superhuman strength, speed, and even possibly a virtually infinite energy supply. ﻿ Even the manipulation of time isn't beyond your grasp, thanks to artificial pocket dimensions comparable to the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, the Time Rings of the Kaioshin, or the iconic Time Machine used by future Trunks. ﻿ Additionally, you gain the same skill in creating and reverse engineering technology as Bulma Briefs.
objects.title: Capsule Corp (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge and capabilities to build the wondrous technologies from the 31st century, along with supernatural skills in inventing and crafting futuristic tech. With this power, you become a living embodiment of scientific prowess and innovation.

You can effortlessly invent and create mind-boggling technologies that defy logic. For example, you'll understand and master advanced transportation systems of the future, easily travel through space, and design cutting-edge vehicles. You'll have an intuitive understanding of artificial intelligence, allowing you to manipulate and reprogram robots like a pro. You can even transfer and control consciousness, freeze yourself in time to wake up in the future, and invent mind-bending gadgets that go beyond what's considered normal. Your expertise extends to genetic engineering, enabling you to create one-of-a-kind and whimsical creatures, explore advanced medical technologies, and heal and improve life in ways that seem impossible. On top of it all, you have the supernatural ability to synthesize any unique material found in the far-flung future. With your newfound brilliance, you'll quickly amass a collection of world-ending gadgets.
objects.title: Hail Science! (Futurama)

objects.text:
You are now the steward of humanity's scientific knowledge and prowess, gathered under the United Nations Space Command, as of 2551. In effect, this gives you complete access to the developments, understanding and talent of the best of humanity's innovators. This includes the starships, vehicles, and weaponry gathered under the UNSC.

Considered relatively primitive by alien standards, humanity maintains a vast, deadly arsenal of projectile weaponry and combustion engine-powered vehicles, alongside rudimentary slipspace drives. It has, however, begun adding a limited number of advancements they have reverse engineered of xeno tech. This includes the use of the shoulder-fired "Spartan Laser", and most recently, energy shield technology, as is equipped to the MJOLNIR Mark V armors, worn by Spartans.

This power also grants you the biological understanding of their many supersoldier programs, which culminate in the Spartan IIs. 

Finally, you have a deep understanding of one of humanity's leading weapons, AI technology. While considered too dangerous by the Covenant, humanity has begun deeply delving into creating AI, and has created AI powerful enough to rival some of those made by the ancient Forerunners. However, while you are capable of making "Smart" AI, similar to Cortana, be wary, as once seven years of their lifespan pass, they become increasingly susceptible to undergoing Rampancy.

While this is a brief overview of what humanity has to offer, you have access to all of it and more, and beyond such, as you take on the spirit of humanity, being inherently capable of adapting, iterating, reverse engineering, and understanding science and tech to rapidly improve and expand upon what you begin with at a rate comparable to that of Dr. Catherine Halsey.
objects.title: Might of the UNSC (Halo)

objects.text:
You now have knowledge of the technological mimicry adapted by the Covenant, based on scavenged Forerunner artifacts. While powerful and advanced, the Covenant has only begun to scratch the surface of how powerful and precise they truly are. Perhaps you can uncover the truth.

Despite their lack of scientific rigor, the Covenant has procured some incredibly powerful advancements. To begin with, while humanity has slipspace drives, they are imprecise and unpredictable. Comparatively, the drives the Covenant have access to allow for reliable, convenient, and consistent faster-than-light travel. While concerns over slipspace debt still exist, the more advanced drives mitigate the risk significantly, on top of requiring a practically galactic spanning empire of constant use to become TRULY concerning.

For sub-light travel, the Covenant utilizes repulsor engines, which rely on a poorly understood combination of gravity "waves" and some form of highly reactive plasma displacement to propel spacecraft.

While poorly understood, the Covenant ARE capable of making AI; however, they tend to either be significantly less capable than UNSC AI or deeply susceptible to rampancy.

You also have access to their metallurgical understanding and advancements, capable of creating the same highly durable metals and alloys used in their space frames, architecture, and technology.

They have developed a broad range of equipment, mainly focused on plasma and particle beam weaponry, though they do make use of some others, like crystal-based and gravity weaponry. Alongside this, they have developed and broadly utilize powerful energy shielding in practically all of their constructions, from emplacements to vehicles to personal protection.

Their planetary vehicles tend to make use of anti-gravity technology for propulsion, which are faster and more stable, especially over uneven terrain, as well as more durable through their advanced alloys compared to USNC counterparts.

You maintain all of the knowledge of how to create these Covenant technologies and more, such as their automated surgical suites, alongside the various technologies of the various castes and races that make up the Covenant Hegemony.
objects.title: Covenant Hegemony (Halo)

addons.text:
Your machine empire now integrates the technologies and doctrines of the greatest automation wars across countless worlds. Each new protocol you absorb refines your systems toward perfect, self-sustaining conquest.

From M.A.X.: Mechanized Assault & Exploration, you inherit modular vehicle design and autonomous battlefield logistics, allowing entire armies to be custom-built from a shared library of adaptable parts.

Forged Battalion adds adaptive genetic engineering for machinery, enabling your factories and units to evolve mid-combat—rewriting their own blueprints as the battle shifts.

Metal Fatigue brings multi-layered mechs capable of transforming and engaging across land, air, and orbital layers, giving your legions unmatched versatility in every theater.

Reassembly contributes swarm-scale self-replication and modular reconstruction; your fleets can rebuild themselves from the debris of victory or defeat alike.

Sanctuary: Shattered Sun grants access to quantum-scale energy systems and post-singularity architecture—your infrastructure now hums with self-aware power grids and living foundries.

Zero-K perfects your automation, gifting you emergent command AIs that can coordinate entire planetary wars with surgical precision and zero oversight.

Warzone 2100 empowers adaptive evolution in real time, with battlefield research and scavenging protocols that let your forces retrofit themselves mid-conflict.

Finally, AI War completes the suite: a fully galactic-scale automation network. Self-learning fleets expand, defend, and adapt autonomously across the stars.
addons.title: From Machines, To Machines, By Machines

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge of Total Annihilation, the Supreme Commander series, and Planetary Annihilation. From Total Annihilation, you acquire groundbreaking technologies and devastating weapons for the battlefield. The Supreme Commander series imparts expertise in managing vast armies and coordinating military operations. Planetary Annihilation empowers you to wage war on a celestial scale, harnessing planetary resources and forces.

With this vast knowledge, you become a master of strategic warfare, adept at orchestrating large-scale conflicts, designing efficient supply chains, and unleashing destructive power. You command armies of robotic units, construct massive structures, and wield devastating weapons to dominate the battlefield. Your strategic brilliance and technological prowess reshape the fate of the entire Galaxy, making you an unstoppable force in the pursuit of victory.
objects.title: War Machines Without End (TA/SC/PA)

addons.text:
"You have the ability to become a great Pokémon Professor someday!" -Prof. Oak

Your expertise in Biology and Animal Husbandry has synergized with and enhanced your capabilities in the creation and modification of Pokémon. This has granted you the extraordinary ability to grant Pokémon access to the Region-specific gimmicks of all the current games. 

Now, if you so wish, all Pokémon can have the potential to use Mega-Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax/Gigantamax, Terastallization and Synergy Burst. Both separately and even combined. They will be able to do this even without the usual items or conditions that would normally be required for them.  

Though be warned that just because they can accomplish this doesn't mean that it will be easy. It will require extensive training and experience for Pokémon to use gimmicks that they didn't natively have access to. Additionally, it's important to note that to combine these abilities, they need to first master them separately, and mistakes or overuse can result in severe harm to the Pokémon in question.
addons.title: Pokémera

objects.text:
You gain all the technological knowledge of the world of Pokémon, a society that has thrived on capturing monsters and keeping them in Pokéballs. You gain the ability to make your own Pokémon through genetic engineering and the various other technologies seen in the Pokémon world, like cloning, Pokéballs (devices that can be used to store massive amounts of data), computers that can turn physical mass into computer code, devices to restore fossils, teleportation, holographic display, giant mechs, forced evolution and so much more.

As a bonus, you become great at training Pokémon and other animals as well as a great tactician, able to think slightly faster in the moment.
objects.title: Pokétech (Pokemon)

objects.text:
The Honkai, a monstrous force of imaginary energy that allows for its wielders to build wonderous technology and achieve feats thought impossible.

The benefits this power offers you are manifold, first and most importantly, this grants you full understanding of the science behind the Previous and Current Eras’ technology. This grants you access to an incredibly potent arsenal including but not limited to: crossing alternate universes, using the technology involved with Project STIGMA, one could convert living beings into information, then there are MANTISes, each of which is a human spliced with Honkai Beast DNA capable of destroying a city and perhaps most relevant to you are Stigmata, which you may grant to others to give them a degree of Resistance to the Honkai, and these are but a small example of what is available to you. For further reference, bubbles of slowed time are a casual thing most combatants have.

Secondly, you are a genius on par with Dr. MEI, one of the few who helped invent these many wonders, only some of those wonders survived to the Current Era, but those that did, like the Divine Keys and Stigmata, are what helped give the humanity of the Current Era a fighting chance.

Thirdly, you make Honkai Energy so that you can fuel your creations. This naturally comes with immunity to the energy so that you do not experience its side effects yourself. Though this protection against its corruptive and degenerative does not extend to your allies. However, this can be mitigated through methods like Stigmas. You will be able to make Herrscher cores for Divine keys through condensing enough Honkai Energy, as there is no natural way to gather them otherwise.
objects.title: Genius of a Previous Era (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
You gain the combined scientific and technological knowledge developed on Earth of the MCU. This includes the technology built by geniuses like Tony Stark, Bruce Banner, and Hank Pym, as well as the technology of Wakanda. You can build Arc Reactors and power armors, create nanotech, and even program advanced AI like Jarvis. With Pym Particles, you can alter the size of objects and access the Quantum Realm, allowing you to travel through time, space, and realities. You can also create the Super Soldier Serum, Extremis, and even reproduce what created the Hulk.

Additionally, this comes with all the general technological knowledge of Earth in the 2020s. Naturally, you can build upon this knowledge to build completely new technology.

Finally, you possess a particular talent for adapting your technology to different situations, which enables you to rapidly modify and upgrade your technology after learning about an existing problem or threat to address it.
objects.title: I Am Iron Man! (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge from all the factions in the World Trigger franchise. From Earth, you acquire advanced military equipment and All-Purpose Border Tech. Neighbors grants you expertise in Black Trigger technologies and Mother Trigger.

As a bonus, you will become incredibly knowledgeable about Dimensional Warfare, Guerrilla Warfare, Heavy Industry, Tactics. You also can use all types of Triggers, be them close quarters combat, mid-range or long reach ones. You also gain a Trion Gland of average strength, unless you have a Black Trigger, in which case your Trion Gland will be of the highest quality, with a capacity greater than Chika Amatori.
objects.title: Trion Soldier (World Trigger)

objects.text:
You have gained access to the vast scientific knowledge present in the world of Regios. You acquire an unparalleled understanding of advanced concepts and technologies, surpassing the limits of conventional understanding. Your mind becomes a repository of all scientific theories, breakthroughs, and discoveries, encompassing fields such as dimensional manipulation, energy conversion, reality warping, and more.

But that's not all. Your supernatural proficiency and skills enable you to craft and create anything shown or hinted at in the Regios universe. From the creation of separate dimensions with altered physics to harnessing infinite supplies of matter and energy, your technology can possess the ability to manipulate the very fabric of existence. Your crafting prowess allows you to develop weapons, devices, and technologies that defy the laws of physics, including advanced AI companions capable of traversing dimensions and challenging reality warpers on an equal footing.

The nanomachines you create can convert energy into matter, rendering energy-based weapons ineffective against your arsenal. With these nanomachines, you can control and reform massive godlike entities, giving you access to an unstoppable force, surpassing the capabilities of even the most destructive forces in the universe.

Furthermore, your technology can tap into the Zero Domain, drawing upon its limitless energy for fuel.
objects.title: The 0th Domain (Chrome Shelled Regios)

objects.text:
You know how to build all the tech shown in the Atlantis: The Lost Empire movie, both from the expedition group and the ancient tech from Atlantis.

You know how to craft a semi-sentient crystal that feeds off emotions of a large group of people in exchange for energy and longevity for them, you know how to use this energy in various ways like hoover-vehicles, massive-spanning defense systems, giant machinery, how to bio-engineer the fauna and flora in the deep and how to use it as a medical source. (This core will grow with its people, so be careful with it.)

In addition, you know how to speak and write Atlantean, which also allows you to learn any human language very quickly.
objects.title: Atlantic (Atlantis: The Lost Empire)

objects.text:
