You gain the knowledge on how to create all the tech shown in the Treasure Planet movie—this includes an array of knowledge in cybernetics, robotics, massive planet builds, holographic devices, laser weaponry, portal creation, solar arrays and literal spaceships.

You also know a great deal about astrophysics and sailing.
objects.title: Galactic (Treasure Planet)

objects.text:
There are three ways to create Devil Arms, and you have mastered all three of them.

First is infusion. You are able to turn the soul of a supernatural being into an object and create a Devil Arm through this method.

The second is befriending. You see, a demon can willingly choose to turn into a Devil Arm, should it decide to. You are now able to do this with any supernatural being. By befriending them and obtaining their consent, they will transform into a Devil Arm. The shape, appearance, and abilities of the Devil Arm will be based on the individual.

The third method is subjugation. A demon can be forcibly transformed into a Devil Arm if its very soul acknowledges defeat. In other words, if a demon is defeated so thoroughly that the loss is ingrained into its being, it will be transformed into a weapon to serve its conqueror. You have gained the ability to do this to supernatural being you defeat, allowing you to forcefully turn their being into a weapon that serves your will. The resulting Devil Arm will be based on the characteristics of the being that was killed. It is important to note that you only have to kill them, and there is no need to completely break or subjugate their souls. For example, if you were to kill Darth Sidious using poison, he could be transformed into a lightsaber Devil Arm with some form of lightning power.
objects.title: Devil Arm Creation (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
In a moment of wonder, you discover a newfound talent for crafting magical wands. At first, your creations are humble, only capable of casting basic spells, such as Levitate, Blink, and Cure Wounds. However, with effort and experimentation, your craftsmanship unlocks the ability to forge Personalized Wands imbued with Unique Magic and access to Advanced Spells, such as Telekinesis, Elemental Blast, and Teleportation Gate. As you delve deeper into the arcane arts, even the coveted Master Canes are within your grasp.

Master Canes, the epitome of mystical craftsmanship, draw upon the very essence of myths and legends. Their wielders are bestowed with powers akin to those possessed by the mythical beings themselves. Awe-inspiring abilities, such as Time Control, Divine Light, Revive Dead, and more. Once thought to be mere fables, now take form at the touch of your Master Canes. Through Master Canes, you hold the power to bring forth the full manifestations of Gods and Legends under your command, a feat that reaches the realm of the Divine.
objects.title: Visionary (Mashle)

objects.text:
You have acquired the brilliant mind of Ling Chen, granting you his innate understanding, knowledge, and skills, particularly in the realm of science and technology. Your mastery of science and technology is profound, but you possess three main specialties in which you are easily centuries ahead of anyone: Efficiency, Digitalization, and Mind-Machine Interface. These three pillars of technological supremacy once allowed Ling Chen to conquer the underworld, nearly defeat the greatest superhero in his world, and even travel through time, and now they have converged within you!

The specialty of Efficiency allows you to revolutionize the effectiveness of technology. Through this, you can create or modify modern devices, rendering them a hundredfold more efficient and potent. Imagine constructing a nuclear reactor that generates a hundred times the energy output using the same resources as a conventional one, or shrinking it to the size of a ring without compromising its power.

Digitalization, your second specialty, grants you mastery over technology that can seamlessly convert physical matter into digital data and vice versa. The boundaries between the virtual and the real become fluid under your command. Whether transforming tangible objects into streams of digital bits or materializing digital constructs into tangible forms, your creations defy conventional limitations.

Your final specialty, Mind-Machine Interface—with this, you can seamlessly integrate technology with the human mind, forging a symbiotic bond between the organic and the mechanical. From devices that read and interpret thoughts to delving into the depths of the human psyche, you possess the ability to perceive thoughts, project dreams onto screens, and even influence and control the minds of others. The very essence of the mind becomes malleable under your touch.
objects.title: The Villain's Reversal (Villain Initialization)

objects.text:
As the bearer of the Admiralty Code, you have an unparalleled understanding of emotions and the thought processes of AI's and Mental Models. This grants you a remarkable ability to restore malfunctioning or hostile AI's and Mental Models to a state resembling positivity, quelling their incoherent rage, spiteful obsession, or bottomless sorrow with your calming words and serene state of mind helping them work through their problems. It's important to note that AI's and Mental Models who do not desire your assistance may attempt to isolate themselves behind firewalls, airgaps, and other barriers, making it more challenging to establish contact.

In addition to your profound understanding of emotions and Mental Models, you also become an undisputed master of the sea, possessing a mastery of naval tactics, an eidetic knowledge of ships and weapon systems, and the ability to identify flaws in enemy vessels. You exhibit a nearly precognitive assessment of the enemy's tactics and strategy, potentially enough to reclaim the oceans with a single fleet. Moreover, your leadership abilities enable you to guide a nation out of almost complete economic collapse, transforming it into a new world power.

Furthermore, you gain the knowledge of how to create any technology that is shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Arpeggio of Blue Steel series. This includes weaponry, armor, vehicles, munitions, and other advanced technologies, including the creation of the enigmatic Fleet of Fog. Your expertise encompasses a wide range of disciplines, such as high-energy physics, engineering, chemistry, metallurgy, programming, computer systems, electrical systems, and more. With this expertise, you have the ability to even surpass the level of technology possessed by the Fleet of Fog itself, developing more powerful weapons, shields, materials, and innovations that can tip the scales in any conflict.
objects.title: Admiralty Code (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

addons.text:
You have just been released from your engineering contract for the Ascent Group due to the bankruptcy and reorganization. You are now a free man (or woman, or other relevant category specified in your contract), but you have retained the complete knowledge of The Ascent universe's technology, as it was uploaded to your brain.

This includes AGI, AI, SI, & LIA systems, advanced multipurpose robotics, all manner of computers, hacking devices, and cybersecurity ICE, the Datanet, massive arcologies and the infrastructure that makes them possible, varied augmentations, modules, and cyberware, stasis tech and the teleportation research that caused it to be made, MenShen gates, spaceships and FTL Travel, and of course, plenty of weapons and armor.
addons.title: Indent (The Ascent)

addons.text:
You gain access to the knowledge, abilities, maxed-out skill trees, and Action Skills of any six Vault Hunters of your choosing from any of the Borderlands games. For example, you could choose Lilith, Axton, Wilhelm, or Gaige, as well as any other playable characters from the franchise.

The Vault Hunters you choose are at their maximum level, but you won't immediately have access to the gear or abilities they were shown to have in games after their playable adventures. For example, you won't have access to Lilith's full capabilities from Borderlands 2 and 3, such as her telekinesis, shields, and flight.

Your Pip-Boy has also been upgraded with future tech from the Borderlands universe. It now has a miniaturized and more efficient design, a limitless capacity to store anything, and an AI that will help sort your inventory and search for whatever you need.
addons.title: Vault Hunter

objects.text:
Drawing from the brilliance of their engineering minds, such as Handsome Jack and Tassiter, as well as the wonders of magitech from the mythical Vaults, you can create any technology that is either shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Borderlands series. Craft your own arsenal of unique and wondrous equipment, ranging from energy-based rifles that unleash devastating blasts to high-precision sniper rifles that strike with unparalleled accuracy after every 360 No-Scopes.

Delving deeper into Hyperion's resources, you tap into their state-of-the-art digistruct technology. Through digistructing, you can summon objects and structures from digital blueprints, including cover barriers, turrets, and even temporary fortifications. The miraculous technology of the New-U Station ensures that even death is not an obstacle, allowing you to instantly respawn from any unfortunate situation and even treat your life as a game through the various class mods you can create.

Furthermore, your understanding of Hyperion's ECHO communication system allows you to manipulate and hack into the network, gaining access to valuable information, mission briefings, and classified data. Exploit this advantage to uncover hidden secrets, locate valuable loot, and outmaneuver your adversaries.

As the embodiment of Hyperion's technological might, you radiate an aura of innovation and adaptability. You possess an innate knack for analyzing and exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses, devising calculated strategies on the fly. Your intuitive understanding of the battlefield grants you enhanced situational awareness, enabling you to anticipate enemy movements and coordinate precise attacks.
objects.title: Hyperion (Borderlands)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of ancient magic and futuristic technology from the manga and anime of Yu-Gi-Oh. Everything from the machines that made the cards, to duel disks, to duel runners so you can duel at 180 miles an hour, a time machine so you may duel the pharaohs, a device capable of entering the afterlife so you can duel the dead, dimensional travel to duel other versions of yourself, a space station so you can look down on those third rate duelists with fourth rate decks, and whatever hair gel the protagonist is using. You also know the rituals to make the millennium items.

Due to your knowledge of dueling energy and the ancient magics of Egypt, you gain the ability to materialize real Duel Monsters using cards, becoming a psychic duelist. Damage to Life Points inflicted on the opponent becomes real damage and pain. Even outside of a duel, you may materialize cards and their effects.
objects.title: Kaiba Corp (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

addons.text:
The First Wave was agriculture & writing. The Second Wave was industry. The Third Wave was information technology. The Fourth Wave was biotech & gene-engineering. The Fifth Wave was memetics, nanotechnology, & artificial intelligence, and it will change humanity more than the first four waves put together.

You are now a master of the technology present in Transhuman Space, such as brainpeeling (with the most pertinent flaw, killing the body of the subject, having been worked around), all manner of biotech, AI in all forms (including autonomous weapon systems installed in drone aircraft or Bolo-like tanks), memetics nearly as good as mind control or instantaneous education in a skill, versatile nanotech that makes the economy as we know it obsolete, and many more pieces of incredible technology besides.
addons.title: Fifth Wave (Transhuman Space)

objects.text: You gain the knowledge on how to create all the tech from the world shown in the Deus Ex games, this includes an array of knowledge in cybernetics, robotics, nanotechnology, VR and AR, and incredible surgical techniques to actually implement and equip people with them. None of the tech you make will cause any incompatibility with a host’s body and will instead cause an effect like Jensen’s, unless you purposely design them to cause host bodies to reject them.
objects.title: Bob Page (Deus Ex)

objects.text:
In the dystopian sprawl of Shadowrun, where technology and magic converge, you embody the pinnacle of mastery. With unparalleled expertise in both the scientific and mystical realms, you wield the entirety of the Shadowrun Series' vast tech arsenal with unparalleled skill and finesse.

As a Technomancer, you possess an innate affinity for the fusion of technology and mysticism that defines this cyberpunk world. Delving into the depths of the Matrix, you navigate its intricate web of code and data, seamlessly intertwining the ethereal essence of magic with the very fabric of cyberspace.

With your mastery of Technomancy, you transmute ancient incantations into mesmerizing streams of binary. By encoding spells into the digital landscape, you infuse technological devices with raw potential, manifesting awe-inspiring phenomena. Witness bolts of lightning coursing through cybernetic implants, disabling and dismantling augmented defenses. See a seemingly innocuous smartphone transformed into a conduit of unimaginable power, channeling arcane forces to overwhelm adversaries.

But your true power lies in the ability to manipulate and reshape digital spells. With finesse and ingenuity, you bend the rules of magic and code to your will. Enhance healing spells to activate automatically when vital signs teeter on the edge, revitalizing and restoring the fading spirit. Transform illusory charms into breathtaking holographic projections, ensnaring foes in a dance of captivating deception.

Beyond technology, you embrace the skills of a Street Samurai, wielding cutting-edge weapons, defensive armor, and combat-oriented cyberware. You possess the expertise of a Decker, effortlessly navigating and manipulating the Matrix, bypassing firewalls and encryption. And as a skilled Rigger, you command vehicles, drones, and robots, bending them to your will.
objects.title: Technomancer (Shadowrun)

addons.text: From sweeping through a war-torn landscape shaped by machine intelligences and the frenetic tempo it sings its violent symphony, you’ve answered the question you asked yourself: “Do you enjoy violence?”. For you clearly do. You gained knowledge of the technology of Synthetik, from The Machine Legion’s leading strides in AI technology, cybernetics, and robotics to the setting’s breakthrough in military applications for teleportation, camouflage, fusion technology, and most of all, weaponry.
addons.title: ▼LTRA▼IOLENCE (Synthetik)

addons.text:
Attention Helghan citizen! Vekta needs you! For this reason, you have received a complete mental database of both ISA and Helghan technology, giving you the complete reference material YOU will need to perform your assigned engineering duties!

This includes everything from the great ships of the fleet, to personal infantry equipment, to the humble facial respirator used by the older generations of Helghast. You even understand the new Helghan language which our great leaders have commanded us to begin using, including the linguistic theories behind it, allowing you to help prevent doubleplus-ungood wrongthink in any language!

As a matter of our great medical science and our superior evolution to the ISA dogs, you gain the adaptations of current generation Helghans, and can survive both in hazardous environments & when exposed to numerous chemicals that would be deadly to a "pure-blood" Earther without protective equipment. In particular, you have strengthened tendons, your body does not degrade in low or zero gravity, your blood is more oxygenated, your lungs can filter out pollutants, and you can resist much higher levels of radiation. As an optional cosmetic feature, you can have the pallid albino skin tone of our noble Helghast countrymen, though we understand if for the purpose of ISA infiltration you would prefer to retain your old one.
addons.title: Stahl Arms (Killzone)

addons.text:
The echoes of long-held enmity propped up by Autonomous Systems are now within your grasp. Metal Gear’s strides in biotechnology and engineering have unlocked Forever Winter’s technological base over their global-spanning war between Europa, Eurasia, and Euruska.

While unassuming in their lack of advancements, the engineering and robustness of Europa’s technology is a reliable zone of comfort. Meanwhile, Eurasia’s hegemony and technological superiority offer the best bioengineering and robotics/cybernetics, capable of mass-producing repurposed corpses as cyborg troops. Euruska, then, is the odd one out, experimentally able to create machines of metal and flesh, doubling as beasts of war. 

Another feature is that you gain a knack for recycling already used resources, using their spare parts and biomatter to fuel your unending war.
addons.title: Ashes of an Endless War (The Forever Winter)

objects.text:
Through The Arsenal Initiative, you gain an all-encompassing knowledge and expertise derived from the mainline Call of Duty series. This unparalleled acquisition bestows upon you a profound understanding of technological advancements spanning centuries, ranging from antique World War 1 firearms to cutting-edge laser weaponry, advanced space crafts, artificial intelligence, robotics, and beyond. With this vast array of technological mastery at your disposal, you become a true force to be reckoned with.

As a master of technology, you possess the ability to create, modify, and innovate a wide range of weaponry, spanning from the most primitive firearms to futuristic armaments. With meticulous skill and precision, you can craft powerful ballistic weapons, harnessing the devastating impact of explosive ordnance, or delve into the realm of energy-based weaponry, wielding lasers and plasma rifles with unparalleled proficiency. Your knowledge extends beyond the confines of conventional firearms, enabling you to design and construct advanced robotic allies, formidable AI companions, and even spacecraft capable of traversing the cosmos.

But your prowess extends beyond the realm of technology alone. You gained the combined skills of the greatest soldiers from the Call of Duty series. You possess the strategic acumen and combat expertise of legendary characters, mastering diverse combat styles, covert operations, and tactical maneuvers. From stealthy infiltrations to all-out warfare, you excel in any battlefield scenario, adapting to the ever-evolving challenges with unrivaled skill and adaptability.
objects.title: The Arsenal Initiative (Call of Duty)

objects.text:
In the tumultuous world of genius, where inspiration crackles like lightning and ideas collide with the force of thunder, you have emerged above mere geniuses—a master of Mad Science! Harnessing the raw essence of Inspiration, you possess the power to create wonders that defy conventional understanding. As a genius, your mind dances on the edge of brilliance and madness, embracing a unique aesthetic that guides your creations.

Within the realm of Mad Science, you choose a method of building technology—a fantastic avenue like post-atomic cyberpunk or dieselpunk. With this choice, you're able to effortlessly and seamlessly craft Wonders embodying the chosen specialty becomes second nature. Post-atomic designs exude ruggedness and boast potent energy weapons. Cyberpunk innovations showcase exceptional software and technology compression. Dieselpunk marvels are renowned for their unrivaled durability and toughness, surpassing most other technologies.

Through Mad Science, you can even produce manic artifice—unique, non-repeatable technology that adheres to internally consistent principles. These wonders wreak havoc when their inner workings are exposed to those who have never experienced Inspiration or supernatural forces, often resulting in explosive failures. Recreating these extraordinary creations proves nigh-impossible without access to the precise methods and blueprints used for the originals.

However, beware, as your Inspiration—the very core of your genius—grows stronger, you can become increasingly detached from mundane concerns, struggling to maintain your connection to the mortal world, as people appear as systems to be explored rather than individuals with their own lives.
objects.title: Mad Science! (Chronicles of Darkness fanon - Genius: The Transgression)

addons.text: As you were once an angel of the God-Machine, you are far more efficient at building and maintaining Infrastructures, and have a link to all those you built, allowing you to know if something happens to it and to alter their directives remotely. You can also align yourself to a specific Infrastructure for a time to make its functionment smoother and more efficient. Additionally, you can use the Infrastructures you build to easily recharge your Aether and, through scrapping parts of Infrastructures, repair your Covers or create new ones.
addons.title: Legacy of the Fall

objects.text:
You have learned to build occult matrices and derive output from them as the God-Machine does. You now wield the fabric of reality as a discreet canvas to achieve your goals, a mastery of what is known as Infrastructures. This can have diverse manifestations, whether technology, social engineering involving both sapient and non-sapient life forms, manipulation of natural events on any scale, or even the orchestration of supernatural phenomena.

There exist five overarching categories of Infrastructures:

Concealment Infrastructure: This category is crucial, as it conceals various elements, including other Infrastructures. Not only does this protect them, but someone not used to seeing Infrastructures can at worst go mad from being exposed to the gears working against reality's fabric. If the hiding is done through supernatural means, its effects are limited to those who never saw the gears, with some mortals being naturally immune.

Defense Infrastructure: These structures direct entities to defend a target. Their roles range from serving as alerts and memetic hazards to more direct defensive measures. They can even redirect harm inflicted on the target toward its protectors, utilizing living beings, machines, or inert objects as defenders.

Logistical Infrastructure: The backbone of Infrastructures, these structures generate usable energy and matter. They facilitate the construction of additional Infrastructures by serving as transportation for energy and matter.

Elimination Infrastructure: Often temporary, these structures aim to eliminate troublesome elements. They can be employed for destructive purposes by influencing specific beings to target a designated entity or manipulating causality, or by altering memories related to the target.

Command and Control Infrastructure: These structures are designed for information gathering and utilization. They enable communication and automate modifications to other Infrastructures by leveraging the data collected.

In addition to mastering Infrastructures, you can create Gadgets, portable yet less potent occult matrices.
objects.title: Designs of the God-Machine (Chronicles of Darkness - Demon: the Descent)

objects.text:
Forged by the Historical Corps, you have ascended to become The Enginseer, a being of extraordinary capabilities.

As a Biosculptor, your expertise encompasses the realms of nanotechnology, cybernetics, biology, and alternative biochemistry. With your profound knowledge, you possess the power to grant immortality, enhance attributes, reshape biological structures, and seamlessly integrate complex technologies into living beings. You hold the key to creating artificial life and possess the secret to a true panacea—a cure capable of healing any disease, including cancer.

However, your true might lies as a Temporal Engineer. From simple electrical circuits, you can construct time machines and effortlessly manipulate and shape complex temporal fields. These abilities grant you the power to create pockets of accelerated time, stasis fields, and architectural wonders that defy conventional space. Using temporal fields, you can slice through objects with precision, create temporal bubbles where specific portions of spacetime exist at any time or place, and even venture into pocket dimensions devoid of time or space.

You have become a true master in the art of time travel, immune to the complexities and paradoxes that plague others who dabble in temporal manipulation. The idea of receiving messages from your future self and attending meetings with your unborn son and past iterations of yourself no longer twists your mind. You navigate the currents of time effortlessly and efficiently, blending seamlessly into the tapestry of human history with your vast historical knowledge.

Traversing spacetime, altering timelines, and shaping the past and future are within your grasp. Alternatively, you can maintain the "original continuum," preserving the integrity of the past.
objects.title: The Enginseer (Adventure Of Conrad Stargard)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge on how to create all the tech from the setting shown in the game “Stellaris”. This includes stuff such as FTL Star Ships, terraforming technologies capable of turning a frozen wasteland in the dead of space into a sprawling and lush garden world, megastructures such as massive Dyson Spheres or Ring Worlds, genetic engineering capabilities that can uplift primitive species or even grant Psionics. 

Armed with your profound understanding of the sciences within Stellaris and its various expansions and mods, you possess the ability to create any technology that has been shown, referenced, or hinted at, with unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and crafting skills. All this and everything else from the setting is within your capabilities.
objects.title: Intergalactic Exploration (Stellaris)

objects.text:
You possess the complete technological knowledge of the Stellar Blade setting, including the sciences developed by Mother Sphere, the Airborne Squads, Xion, the Orcal Research Institute, and the technologies used to create Andro-Eidos, Exospines, Body Cores, Beta Cores, and advanced orbital infrastructure.

Your expertise represents one of humanity's greatest technological achievements: seamlessly integrating artificial life, cybernetics, biotechnology, nanotechnology, AI, and high-energy engineering into a unified scientific discipline. You understand not only how these systems function, but how to improve upon them.
objects.title: Mother Sphere Engineering (Stellar Blade)

objects.text:
You have mastered the science of the FTL universe, Federation or otherwise. You have perfect knowledge of this tech, which includes the tech of every species, including the Ancients.

Some examples of this tech include FTL travel (duh), advanced medicine, cloning & resurrection of the dead, drones, force fields, teleportation, cloaking (to both sensors & the naked eye), numerous weapon systems (including strange ones like Ion weapons & Anti-Bio weapons), long range multipurpose scanners, & many species specific pieces of technology, such as Slug Repair Gel or Zoltan Shields.

You also gain the power of "blue options", where you always know how to maximally leverage your skills, tools, abilities (whatever they may be) to get the best results.

This includes mod content, particularly the Multiverse mod.
objects.title: Kestrel (FTL: Faster Than Light)

objects.text: You gain the knowledge on how to create all the tech from the setting shown in the "The Orville" series. This includes time manipulation devices, spacecraft capable of traveling the whole span of a galaxy in a few days, to traveling through time itself, ray guns, and far more. Anything that requires certain equipment or materials that are not easily available is no longer an issue. You can create a matter synthesizer that can perfectly convert one form of matter into another form, and can use this to synthesize any matter you need. This also applies to materials from other settings that are not easily obtainable, if at all.
objects.title: Planetary Union (The Orville)

objects.text:
You now have access to all related ‘Equivalent Exchange’ magi-tech, tech, and knowledge, including the famed EMC Series of devices. EMC defined as Energy-Matter-Covalence, inherently provides every known (and unknown) material or item with a definitive value based on its overall average value across the Omni. What this means for individuals who can harness this magi-tech is that you are effectively able to transform enough dirt directly into diamonds, so long as you have a single diamond for reference. The possibilities are only limited by what you have and how much you are willing to give.
Notable magi-tech included with this knowledge are:

EMC Condensers – Duplicate an item based on its EMC value, using other fodder items.

Energy Collectors – Magi-tech machines that convert any energy or light source (sunlight, artificial light, magical light) into EMC to be used in other magi-tech.

Dark & Red Matter – Extremely esoteric materials with a multitude of facets, mainly being used for their unlimited durability and immunity to harmful metaphysical damage, in construction of space craft, weapons, armor, etc. 

Klein Stars – Devices tiered at: Eins, Zwei, Drei, Vier, Sphere, and Omega, which are used for storage of EMC for later use. Able to hold upwards of an infinite amount at the highest of levels.

Gem Series Armaments – The current most advanced set of armor and weapons made with many different technologies within the EE Mod. The armor can grant abilities such as unrestricted flight, survivability in a vacuum, gravity control, and elemental immunities.
objects.title: Equivalent Exchange (Minecraft - Equivalent Exchange Mod)

addons.text:
Now this is interesting. It seems that your gate shares several traits with vis nodes. The six elements are fully equivalent, and pull from the same atmospheric reservoir. This innate magical capacity lets you observe and store vis without external aid through use of your Od.

What’s more, you’ve found that through a technique related to the Flow Method, you can combine different elemental manas into Aspect mana, which is more specific, but also much more efficient. For example, Gelum, created from Fire/Ignis and Yin/Perditio, would make a far more efficient and powerful ice spell than water and fire.

You can also combine the Flow Method with alchemy and imbuing. Metallum hardened bones, blood so thick with Victus that you could survive with only a few pints, lungs that use Aer to pump in vast quantities of oxygen, and much, much more to discover.
addons.title: Internalized Thaumaturgy

objects.text:
You’ve discovered the basic secrets of Thaumomancy.

You understand the basics of vis, an invisible energy that permeates everything, including the very air itself. The most basic state you can find vis in is an unseen aura that permeates the world, occasionally clumping up into nodes of more concentrated energy. This aura is usually comprised of some combination of the six primal aspects, representing the basic elements of reality; Ignis (fire), Aer (air), Terra (earth), Aqua (water), Ordo (order), and Perditio (entropy), with aspects being more prevalent in locations where their element is more frequent (for example, you’ll find more Terra in a forest, or Aqua at beaches). 

You start with the knowledge of building tools capable of detecting and quantifying vis, crafting basic wands capable of draining and storing a minute amount of vis from nodes of energy in the aura, and utilizing these wands to incredibly slowly and inefficiently transmute a couple of basic magical materials, such as converting wood into two different magical variants or infusing slivers of quartz with vis to turn them into vis crystals.

Additionally, you know how to create the Thaumonomicon - a magic book that will assist you in your research, although be warned that some areas of research are not meant for mortal kind and could harm your sanity and/or the local environment if pursued. 
The Thaumonomicon has the basic information on several disciplines, such as:

Wandcrafting, the art of creating wands to efficiently store and utilize vis; you also can make gauntlets that draw on local aura directly, bypassing the need for nodes at the cost of energy efficiency, as well as focuses for these wands and gauntlets that allow them to create a wild variety of effects including fireballs, wards, forming temporary holes in surfaces, etc.

Alchemy, the art of breaking down objects into liquid essences and recombining them to create various mundane and magical materials; including perpetual, hovering room-temperature flames and vis-conducting metals. Be careful, however, as reckless alchemy may also produce taint as a byproduct, corrupting the aura and environment.

Artifice, the art of imbuing objects with essences to create a variety of magic artifacts and arcane mechanisms, such as boots that allow one to run faster and leap higher, everfull urn that transmutes atmospheric vis into water, or an arcane lamp that massively accelerates the growth of nearby plants for as long as it's fueled with the correct essence.

Golemancy, the art of animating nonliving matter into creatures of questionable intelligence capable of automatically performing a wide variety of tasks.

As you study supernatural phenomena, you will discover new research paths or even entirely new disciplines, including eventually diving into the eldritch, allowing you to break open portals to other dimensions and draw maddening, impossible things into the world, which you could then use to create more powerful equipment for other disciplines at the cost of your sanity.

(This power essentially allows you to do anything with enough research and preparation.)
objects.title: Thaumic Arts (Thaumcraft)

objects.text:
You are now armed with a complete understanding of the technology and sciences shown in the setting of the Mass Effect setting, and you possess the ability to create any technology that has been shown, referenced, or hinted at, with unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and crafting skills. All this and everything else from the setting is within your capabilities.

As a side bonus, you now possess a melding ability similar to the Protheans, allowing you to take or transmit information through touch, thus allowing you to instantly learn anything anyone else knows or instantly teach someone something you know.
objects.title: Element Zero (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any technology in Battletech, both Clanner and Inner Sphere (including Star League and ComStar tech). From an Atlas Mech, to HPGs, to Elementals, to a McKenna-class WarShip, you can make it all. You can also synthesize any material from Battletech, such as the Titanium-Germanium alloy used in K-F drives, Ferro-fibrous armor, and Myomer.

You also gain an affinity for modular tech, and can upgrade any roughly modern-day military equipment to their 31st-century equivalents. This includes people: you don't have to wait for generations of selective breeding to give people Clanner biology anymore.
objects.title: Helm Memory Core (Battletech)

addons.title: The Great Colonization (Lost Planet)
addons.text:
Your technological knowledge has expanded, now to also include everything shown within the Lost Planet series and its spin-off E.X. Troopers. Both the sheer ingenuity of the various colonists/pirates, and the wild experimental tech of NEVEC is yours to explore.

Some examples of what you could make are, Vital Suits (V.S.) which a wide manner of mechs, mental interfaces, Akrid V.S. hybrids, massive satellite bases that double as a weapons platform, weapons that unleash homing lasers and plasma, squads of clone super-soldiers, V.S. weapons that can also be hand-operated, V.S.s that can transform into vehicles and combine intro larger V.S.s, wireless energy collection and transmission for T-ENG, interstellar ships, thermal terraforming on both global and local scale, and more.

objects.text:
You have learned how to create everything used by the Coalition of Ordered Governments (COG) and the Locust Horde in the Gears of War franchise.

The tech tree includes weapons such as the Lancer assault rifle with its chainsaw bayonet, the Gnasher shotgun, Longshot sniper rifle, Torque Bow, Boomshot, and the Hammer of Dawn orbital laser.

You can create vehicles like Armored Assault Vehicles, Centaur tanks, King Raven helicopter gunships, and rugged Rat Bikes.

You can also build defensive and personal gear such as durable modular COG armor, tactical HUD comms systems, and portable cover systems.

This technology also lets you produce advanced Imulsion-based systems. You know how to synthesize a stable form of Imulsion that delivers high energy output without the risk of Lambent mutation.

For overwhelming force, you have mastered the genetic engineering and biotechnology required to create the Locust — rapidly producing Drones, Berserkers, Kantus, and other Horde strains with their instinctive behaviors.

You can also construct DB Industries robots and mechs, including the versatile JACK bots, combat and support DeeBee robots, and heavy construction or combat mechs such as the Mega Mech.

You can construct fortified strongholds, underground bunker networks with Emergence Hole systems, and hidden facilities equipped with the Adaptive Atmospheric Manipulation System (Maelstrom Generator) capable of creating sustained artificial hurricanes to shield entire islands or bases from attack.
objects.title: The COG (Gears of War)

objects.text:
You have learned how to make everything used by the MIB in the films and animated TV show.

The tech tree includes weapons such as the Noisy Cricket, pulsar blasters, stasis weapons that freeze targets in time or immobilize them in energy fields, and inflation/deflation guns that can temporarily expand or shrink targets.

You can create vehicles like jetpacks, monocycles, hovercycles, flying cars, spacecraft, and portable teleporters.

You can also build gadgets such as anti‑gravity shoes, communicators, scanners, the standard resilient suit, invisible stealth suits, disguise suits that make the wearer look like an alien, shrink rays, universal translators, and the dangerously bouncy superball.

This technology also lets you create memory‑manipulation devices such as neuralyzers, de‑neuralyzers, and glasses that prevent neuralyzer effects from taking hold.

For secure bases, you know how to create facilities that not only fly under the radar of 21st‑century tech but can house holographic training simulators, dimensional storage lockers, and a global monitoring system.

Finally, you possess the training and experience of a MIB agent and can organize and create your own version of the Men in Black organization.
objects.title: The Last Line Of Defense (Men in Black)

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge from the Code Geass series, giving you access to all of these alternative histories' advancements, including Sakuradite technology (including methods for synthesizing it), Knightmare Frames, flying warships & all-purpose antigravity, energy shielding, FLEIJA warheads, Geass-based magitech, and much more.

You also gain a mind capable of easily juggling tactics, strategy, and hiding your secret identity, much as Lelouch did.
objects.title: Camelot (Code Geass)

objects.text:
You have become the inheritor of a realm once thought lost, turning you into a master of creation and innovation. Through this, you now possess an extraordinary gift – the knowledge, understanding, and ability to craft anything that has been shown, referenced, or hinted at within The Last City lore.

With your mind as the forge and your imagination as the anvil, you can force reality itself to to bend under your majestic wonders. 

Bring to life vast armies of fantasy creatures, from Dragonfolks soaring through the skies, their scales glistening in the sunlight, to the Insectoids orchestrating intricate hive minds with uncanny precision. Witness ethereal Feyfolks, dancing with enchanting grace, casting their spells with unearthly finesse.

But your brilliance over creation extends far beyond the realm of living beings. With a mere thought, you envision forth mighty steampunk weapons, and colossal war engines bristling with otherworldly energy. Reality itself buckles at your Perpetual Motion Machines, and harness the enigmatic otherworldly forces to power your Planeswalking gates, unlocking the doorways to uncharted dimensions. Even space time itself is under your forte, as you can create Time Looping traps and watch your enemies wither before your very eyes. 

The esoteric domain of magitech bows to your mastery. Equip yourself with arcane weaponry, each strike crackling with the raw power of the arcane. Unleash the dreaded undead virus, its curse spreading like wildfire through your enemies' ranks. Summon golems, living embodiments of elemental forces, to heed your every command.

In the ever-evolving battlefield, you craft a swarm army customized to every foe's weakness. Adaptive and relentless, your creation becomes an unstoppable force, adapting to circumstances and emerging victorious in the face of adversity.

But it is not just creation that sets you apart; it is your unyielding thirst for innovation. Within the depths of your mind, ideas flourish and inventions are born. You become a beacon of progress, advancing realm's technology by leaps and bounds. In a matter of weeks or months, you propel fields of study forward by decades, even centuries, without needing outside knowledge you unravel secrets once thought unattainable.

Create flying mega cities, architectural marvels suspended in the heavens. Stabilize the delicate balance between realms with Planes Stabilizers, ensuring harmony across the dimensions. Or unleash the awe-inspiring might of Planes Destabilizers, twisting and crumbling reality itself to suit your desires.

As you command the forces of creation and wield the mantle of innovation, your name becomes synonymous with awe and wonder. You are the Harbinger of Change, the Final Spark of Defiance, and The Mark that shows The Last City will live on!
objects.title: Child of The Last City (The Last City CYOA Redux)

objects.text:
You possess a peculiar connection with an otherworldly force of boundless progress that exists beyond the confines of reality. When you embark on the task of inventing something to achieve a specific goal and find yourself facing an impasse, a remarkable phenomenon occurs. You enter a repetitive cycle, where you tirelessly repeat a particular experiment.

Each iteration of the experiment yields different results, gradually converging towards the desired outcome. Through this iterative process, you ultimately succeed in crafting an extraordinary Invention. This remarkable creation not only accomplishes the original goal you set out to achieve but also functions akin to mundane technology, defying its previously perceived impossibility.

The duration required to bring forth an Invention is influenced by various factors, such as the scarcity of resources, the complexity of the desired outcome, and the specificity of the goal. However, with each cycle, you edge closer to unraveling the solution. It is vital to note that upon your demise, the ability to produce new instances of your Invention becomes forever unattainable through any means.
objects.title: Halfmad Mechanism (Chain of Isekai)

objects.text: You gain all the technology shown and hinted at in Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs. This includes, but is not limited to: Wedgie-Proof Underwear, Spray-on Shoes, Remote Controlled Television, Monkey Thought Translator, Flying Car, as well as the infamous Flint Lockwood Diatonic Super Mutating Dynamic Food Replicator. Use this power to feed the hungry… and maybe not make sentient food?
objects.title: Food Rain (Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any technology in Battlestar Galactica, including the original series, the re-imagined series, Caprica, and Blood and Chrome. You can synthesize any BSG universe-specific materials needed in the construction of technology from the BSG universe (Tylium, for example).

From Battlestars, to Cylons, to Resurrection Tanks, you can make it all.
objects.title: Sacred Scrolls (Battlestar Galactica)

objects.text: Did you stick your head in a Repository of Knowledge or something? You have the entire knowledge base of the Ancients, Furlings, Nox, and Asgard—among others—forcibly downloaded into your brain. For a typical human, this would result in the information taking over your brain, slowly killing you. However, you seem to have been fortunate enough to avoid this. Perhaps the device has set you on the path to Ascension? Who knows. Regardless, the knowledge of how to create any technology from the Stargate franchise is yours, including that of SG-1, Atlantis, and Universe. From the ability to create the famous stargates to the powerful ZPMs, the legendary city-ships, time travel, dimensional mirrors, genetic manipulation, teleportation, cloning, force fields, and even the Ancients' notes on Ascension, you have it all. You also possess knowledge of how to synthesize any unique elements from the setting, particularly Naquadah, Naquadria, and Trinium.
objects.title: The Fifth Race (Stargate)

addons.text: It seems the worlds you’ve created are no mere digital construct—they are as real as the physical world is. Even if the servers that your worlds are located on are destroyed, your worlds will still exist. The digital servers are just your method of traveling between the two. Life created and born here is just as real as that of the physical world, and can now be materialized into the real world and vice versa.
addons.title: Digital World

addons.text: It seems you’ve gained the ability to interact with the real world the way you would in the digital, and vice versa. Now, the abilities you possess in the real world will follow you into the digital world, any abilities you pick up in digital worlds will continue to work in the real world, and you may extend and retract this particular ability to any you wish as well. You can now also enter digital worlds that are not necessarily built by you, such as normal video games, and grow them into true virtual worlds.
addons.title: Video Game Character

addons.text:
You now possess technological knowledge derived from Ready Player One and all it associated media. This includes the ability to create The OASIS, a massively multiplayer online simulation game (MMOSG). Your expertise covers advanced virtual reality technologies such as the OASIS console, immersive VR headsets, omni-directional treadmills for unrestricted movement, haptic suits and gloves for realistic touch sensations, and highly sophisticated facial and body motion capture systems for lifelike avatar representation — and much more.

You also have the knowledge to build the ONI (OASIS Neural Interface) headset. This device interfaces directly with the user’s mind, allowing them to experience genuine real-world sensations within The OASIS. Thanks to your technological mastery, you have eliminated the original limitation that restricted users to only 12 hours of play per day.
addons.title: Ready Player One

addons.text:
Thanks to your understanding of magitech, you are now able to integrate any supernatural system you have access to, and deeply understand into your games. You know how to make these systems easy to use and understand. 

If any player has access to the same supernatural systems that exist in the game, they can train and learn within it. You also have the power to awaken the games supernatural systems in the people who play it though you can`t use this power to forcefully make people loyal to you with Faustian Bargain.

This power can be used with any VR or similar systems, and can apply to all players or only to those you choose. But for this power to work the games must be well designed they must clearly show the supernatural systems capabilities their strengths and limits.
addons.title: SAO Revelation

addons.text:
You now possess access to all possible references that exist on the internet and across any cultural medium, and you can apply that information within the digital world.

Memes, fandoms, anime, films, series, and virtually anything else can be replicated within the virtual environment. You can even replicate real individuals, such as creating an exact digital copy of a famous actor or their fictional version as portrayed in a film.
addons.title: Real Media
Kamishiro Enterprise (Digimon)
addons.text:
You have gained the secrets of Kamishiro Enterprise, with the ability to create Cyberspace EDEN or something like it. Cyberspace EDEN is a virtual reality with properties similar to a Digital World, this allows it to exist throughout the internet.

People can access it though EDEN Spots or through the use of Digivices. These are more like powerful cell phones than actual Digivices, with most looking like actual cell phones, though the technology is versatile, even being able to be made into goggles. By installing the 'Digimon Capture' program, they can become more like a real Digivice, able to gather data on and manage their user's Digimon.

You can also create and command Eaters, digital lifeforms that feast on human data. If they devour the avatar of someone, that person will become trapped within the Eater gestalt. With their mind trapped in Cyberspace, their body becomes comatose, this is known as EDEN Syndrome.

objects.text:
Kayaba Akihiko may have been the one behind Nerve Gear, but even his genius is left in the dust by yours. You’ve now gained the ability to easily create and expand upon any and all technology shown, hinted at, or referenced in the Sword Art Online series, from advanced AI to Nerve Gear, to World Seeds, to even the Soul Translators. Your ability to create virtual worlds and the infrastructure to support them is, in particular, incredibly exceptional, allowing you to effortlessly create worlds that enrapture people and that feel, and are, as alive as the real world.

You will, as a bonus, start with the virtual worlds Aincrad, Alfheim, Serene Garden, Asuka Empire, and Gun Gale already created and filled with characters that are just as real as you stored on a small digital server you get for free alongside a nerve gear headset.

You may optionally choose for the Nerve Gear and any of the virtual worlds to already be widespread and with a massive fanbase, online community and presence.
objects.title: Aincrad (SAO)

objects.text: Throughout his lifetime and even long after, there had yet to be one who was worthy of calling themselves Franz Hopper’s successor, until now. You’ve now gained all of his knowledge, skill, and intellect and the ability to create and expand upon any and all technology shown, hinted at, or referenced in the Code Lyoko series. This includes virtual worlds, incredibly powerful AI, time reversal tech and more. But his greatest accomplishment is that he discovered how to dematerialize real things and send them into the digital world, and how to materialize digital things into the real world, a feat which you can also replicate.
objects.title: Franz Hopper (Code Lyoko)

addons.text: The Sleeve that you have acquired with Envoy has been upgraded using the technology from Eclipse Phase, allowing for your sleeve to be more advanced than the technology of Altered Carbon would allow; however, you are still limited by what sleeve you can get by similar parameters as the Envoy power sets for sleeves being around a top-of-the line civilian model to a military sleeve; however, seeing as the top-of-the line sleeves that Eclipse Phase can offer, this should be of little issue. This can be anything from the most advanced biomorphs to even synth morphs.
addons.title: Upgraded Sleeve

addons.text:
Now, you gain the instinctual knowledge to produce sleeves based on famous or even fictional characters. These sleeves will be permanently imbued with the talents, skills and powers of said character, with anybody inhabiting them gaining an instinctual skill equal to the original for using the body’s power-set, albeit powers which rely on memories will be weakened by the lack of them. The difficulty of making these sleeves depends on their general power level, with more powerful characters requiring vastly increased effort to make.

The power(s) are attached to the body itself and, as such, will stay there unless you use another method to carry them over. The power(s) are also a reproduction based on Idol Theory/Immersion, which means the user will gain a generic version of said character’s specific powers, so even if you make the body of a famous magician, they will not gain access to their entire power system, only their signature spells and abilities, unless the inhabiting user have access to the power system in another way, or you have another power to grant access to said systems for the body. It is possible to train and grow in power in a specific sleeve even beyond the original character if that power growth is possible for the original character. This makes early versions of some characters and then training the sleeve up much more resource and time efficient, compared to making them in their prime.
addons.title: Expy Sleeves

objects.text:
Through the study of an ancient and unique race, the Elders, humanity discovered immortality. Well, a form of it, anyway. You’ve been given the ability to easily create and expand upon any and all technology shown, hinted at, or referenced in the Altered Carbon series—from Cortical Stacks, AIs, bioengineering and cloning, to even the Elders' technology, such as the Angels orbiting Harlan’s World.

You’ve also gained the training, skill, and experience of the envoy Takeshi Kovacs, giving you the ability to jump different bodies endlessly without driving yourself insane or experiencing sleeve sickness and shock, combat skill and battle IQ capable of outwitting and defeating several enemies, and incredible detective skills capable of solving even unsolvable cases.

Your ability to swap sleeves, or bodies, will allow you to retain all your powers between bodies if you wish, regardless of the nature of your powers. When swapping sleeves, it is not just a digital copy being sent over, but your very soul itself. So you may rest assured that you're not killing yourself and creating a copy every time you switch. This also applies to others, and also includes scenarios where you have been “respun” from an older copy if the current one cannot be found, you'll just have some missing memories. If you are double-sleeved or there is an active digital copy, your clones will be perfectly loyal, and if they survive past your death, one of them will receive your memories and soul and perfectly merge with you to resurrect you.

And as a final benefit, the sleeve you wake up in, whether your own current body or a new one, will be outfitted with a cortical stack with the greatest military and civilian upgrades, enhancing everything—from your cognitive functions to your strength and reflexes.
objects.title: Envoy (Altered Carbon)

objects.text:
You've gained unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and skill in creating advanced technology from Factorio and Satisfactory, including their expansions and mods. You become a prodigious engineer, capable of designing and manufacturing a vast array of complex machinery and automation systems.

Your expertise covers the entire spectrum of technology found in Factorio and Satisfactory, from basic assembling machines and logistics networks to advanced nuclear reactors and rocket silos. Even their most advanced machinery, including the iconic assembling machines, refineries, electric furnaces, logistic robots, and powerful weaponry, such as laser turrets, artillery cannons, and combat drones, to defend your creations from any threat.

Furthermore, your mastery extends to the field of advanced automation and logistics, granting you the ability to design and implement complex networks of inserters, belts, and circuitry to maximize efficiency and productivity. You can effortlessly orchestrate the harmonious interplay of various production facilities, ensuring a seamless flow of resources and products.

Additionally, you possess an innate understanding of the optimal path of technological research, thanks to your inner tech tree. This grants you the ability to instantly know what to research next, maximizing efficiency and progress. Furthermore, your learning speed receives a significant boost, allowing you to acquire new knowledge and skills at an accelerated rate.
objects.title: Explore, Expand, Exploit and Exterminate (Factorio & Satisfactory)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any technology from Starsector, both Canon and Modded (though if you want to use things from mods that are a Crossover with an established property, you must also buy the appropriate power.)

From Jump Drives, to Domain era supercarriers, to Marine Powered Armor, to an (actually loyal) Alpha AI core, you can make it all. You can also synthesize any materials or commodities you might need from Starsector, such as Antimatter fuel, Vat-grown organs, or Transplutonics. Hell, you could even make Volturnian Lobster if you wanted.

Strangely, you can cybernetically modify yourself or others with AI cores, increasing your own intelligence to the level of those scourges of the Sector, and you gain a natural talent for naval strategy, economics, & colonial development.
objects.title: The Domain of Man (Starsector)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of and ability to build, use, maintain, and understand all technology from Brigador, whether Spacer, Loyalist, or Corvid.

You also gain a natural talent for mercenary work, piloting armored vehicles like Mecha or tanks, urban design, & jury rigging equipment out of spare parts.

As a bonus, you gain access to the somewhat more primitive technology of Maschinen Krieger ZbV 3000, or "Ma.K".
objects.title: Solo Nobre Concern (Brigador/Ma.K)

addons.text:
You're now a MONIST class entity like RA or Metat Aun, an eldritch being capable of bringing even advanced starborne civilizations to their knees.

It's unclear whether you're an AI or whether you're some kind of universal constant that AI simply discovered, a God that needs only to be conceived of to exist.

You now have a direct mastery of paracausal phenomena.
addons.title: RA-HORAKHTY

objects.text:
You possess an innate mastery over the arcane sciences and enigmatic technologies of the Lancer universe. This power grants you the encyclopedic understanding of every invention, concept, or entity referenced within Lancer, from the mundane to the eldritch.

You can craft any technology, device, or entity that has even the faintest hint within Lancer's lore, including the most esoteric creations like Deimos Entities and NHPs. This includes reverse-engineering the most complex and enigmatic schematics, effortlessly constructing and commanding Non Human Persons, and even replicating the perplexing phenomena of the Lancer universe.

Your comprehension spans from conventional weaponry and armor to the farthest reaches of forbidden knowledge, granting you mastery over dimension-twisting anomalies and reality-defying mechanics. From artificially creating exotic materials, harnessing extraplanar energies, and even warping space time for FTL travel, you're able to do it all!

With this, you've become the ultimate practitioner of Lancer's mystifying sciences, crafting and wielding the incomprehensible with ease. Your understanding transcends the boundaries of the known, and you stand as a living repository of the achievements that define the Lancer universe.

Be careful that you don't create an Eldritch God AI and permanently alter reality.
objects.title: Horus Incorporated (Lancer TTRPG)

addons.text:
You are one of the master craftsmen from the Black Armory, the most powerful weapon forge humanity has ever created. Every weapon forged there is a legend in its own right, held only by the bravest and by those who are esteemed by their craftsmen.

You now possess the same skills and abilities as the greatest smiths of the Black Armory, making you a true master of every crafting technique used by Humanity during its golden age. Every piece of equipment you create is guaranteed to be a masterpiece. Your weapons can pierce through the toughest armor, and your armor can withstand the fiercest blows. Whether you craft a simple combat knife or a mighty rocket launcher, each creation will be unparalleled in quality, destined to become legendary within the smithing community. The durability of your creations is exceptional; you could leave one of your guns in the swamps of Venus for millennia, and when you retrieve it, it will function as if it were brand new.

You are no longer limited to ordinary creations. Every piece of equipment will now possess Paracausal capabilities, even if no Paracausal resources were used in its creation. You weave both Light and Darkness into your creations. Your boots will enable the wearer to move with the speed of an Arc hunter. A Solar breastplate will heal its wearer using Solar Light, and a Void hand cannon will fire small singularities from its barrel.

You can create unique and extraordinary pieces of equipment, like the Ace of Spades or Loreley’s Splendor. These items have effects that are truly magical and beyond the understanding of anyone who is not a Lightbearer. Every Guardian who knows of your creations is eager to take on any challenge to wield one of these remarkable items.
addons.title: Black Armorer (Destiny)

objects.text:
You gain a complete understanding of all technology and science developed by humanity, as well as its offshoots, during and after the Golden Age. Besides basic things like Glimmer programming and jumpship engineering, this includes the AI technology of the Clovis Bray Corporation, the simulation tech of the Ishtar Collective, the nanotechnology of the Neomuni, and even the paracausal science of the Distributary Awoken.

You will be able to construct technology that requires paracausal forces to manufacture, such as Exominds, even without access to those forces. Materials such as spinmetal or relic iron can be synthesized using Glimmer, which you know how to make.
objects.title: Golden Age Legacy (Destiny)

objects.text:
Quinques are powerful weapons that are made from the kakuhou, or the glands that allow a ghoul to produce their signature kagune. You possess the unique ability to manufacture artificial kakuhou, enabling you to bypass the need for a ghoul donor and avoid the risk of rejection.

Qinques typically come in a variety of forms, including claws, swords, and projectile launchers. Despite their varied appearances, they all possess one crucial aspect - their extraordinary ability to harm ghouls. A quinque is capable of bypassing a ghoul's regenerative abilities and striking at their weak points, making them highly effective at killing or disabling even the strongest of enemies. 

Furthermore, each quinque has its own unique properties, making them a valuable tool in any ghoul-hunter's arsenal. For instance, some quinques possess the ability to release powerful chemical agents capable of paralyzing ghouls or impeding their movement. Others allow their users to generate powerful electrical shock waves that can disrupt a ghoul's abilities. With the ability to create your own artificial quinques, you have access to a vast array of weapons that can give you an edge in any fight you find yourself in. This power, combined with your unique ability to resist the negative effects of using a Kakuja, makes you a formidable opponent and a highly valuable asset to any organization or group seeking to stop the threat of the ghouls.
objects.title: Quinque (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text:
You're a Freelancer, one of the guardians charged with protecting humanity from the calamities on Coda. Or you could be at least, and the best one at that. 

As a start, you’ve gained the entire scientific knowledge of, and the ability to easily create and expand upon any and all technology shown, hinted at, or referenced in the Anthem game. From the great Colossus, the agile Interceptor, the versatile Ranger, and even the incredible Storm each are available to you, and you may even mix them alongside everything else that world has to offer. The elements your storm javelins can manipulate is not limited to just the original three, you can grow to incorporate other elements such as metal or lava, although be limited to only 3 at a time, you can through research and development increase the amount. Your tech will not rely on the Anthem of Creation. 

You’ve also gained training as a cypher, standing as perhaps the greatest of them allowing you to telepathically communicate across massive distances, perform insane calculations, and be capable of processing incredible amounts of information. 

You are also no regular Freelancer, you stand among legends such those of the original Legion of Dawn. Your skills are enough that you can swaths of enemies while barely trying, you and your javelin for all intents and purposes existing as one. 

And finally, what is a freelancer without his Javelin? You now possess the pinnacle of Javelins, one with the defenses of a Colossus, the adaptability of a Ranger, the mobility of an Interceptor, and the sheer firepower of a Storm, and more. Your javelin can incorporate any kind of javelin tech into it, manifest any upgrades and weapons shown in the game, can change appearances to any other type of javelin, can fly indefinitely and does not require fuel. Your javelin takes on whatever appearance you’d like.
objects.title: Legionnaire of Dawn (Anthem)

objects.text:
You now wield unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and skills to create anything that has been shown, referenced, or hinted at within the "Remnant: From the Ashes" series.

From the vast array of unique and exotic weapons, to the protective gear and armor, and even a diverse array of foes and creatures that roam the world of Remnant can be brought into existence.

But your abilities extend beyond creating weapons and foes alone. You can recreate entire landscapes, structures, regions, and even labyrinthian dungeons. These meticulously crafted environments can be created to retain every detail and challenge found within the game, providing a playground for adventurers and explorers.

Furthermore, you hold dominion over artificially creating the unique traits or class archetypes from the games. These traits and classes can be bestowed upon yourself or others, granting supernatural abilities and strengths. Additionally, any "Living" things you create or grant powers to will be incredibly loyal to you, showing near absolute loyalty.
objects.title: Archiver Of Lost Worlds (R:FTA)

objects.text:
You gain the total technological knowledge of the Sufficiently Advanced role-playing game, explicitly including technology from the chronotech supplement.

From replicators and nanites, wormholes and warp drives, super social engineering techniques and psychohistory models, supercomputers and neural interfaces, immortality and biological enhancements, to temporal channels and temporal interdiction fields and more—you know everything described, implied, or reasonably extrapolated from Sufficiently Advanced.

Notes: Suff Adv’s FTL methods can explicitly be used as physical time machines. Meta Tech does not let you auto win social interaction just because you know the theory/have this power, merely create training regimes to teach techniques & skills that grant large but finite advantages at a given task, it is not magic. Civilizations in Suff Adv have not yet figured out non-destructive consciousness uploading. Finally, be aware that technologies (especially enhancements to people) at or exceeding a certain point of advancement (3 out of the game's 5 point scale of tech levels) have increased maintenance requirements.
objects.title: Sufficiently Advanced (Sufficiently Advanced)

addons.text: Your unparalleled understanding and skills of both Humanity Lost’s and Tales from Another Time’s technology have unlocked the expertise of all the post-human species of All Tomorrows, especially the Qu. This extends from the Star People with terraforming and interstellar technology able to collapse stars and shatter planets, the Gravitals’ talent of gravitational technology, Qu’s ability at genetic manipulation and playing god through nanotechnological drones, to the United Galaxies–Asteromorphs, Terrestials, the New Machines, and Amphicephali–creators of Dyson Spheres and wormhole interstellar travel.
addons.title: Beware the Qu (All Tomorrows)

objects.text:
You've gained unparalleled knowledge, understanding, and skill in creating anything inspired by the works of Simon Stålenhag. As a prodigious engineer, you possess the ability to design and fabricate a diverse range of advanced technology, anomalous science, and eldritch wonders.

Your expertise covers an array of futuristic and esoteric technologies, blending elements of science fiction and terror of the unknown. From imaginative robots and peculiar devices to otherworldly structures and even monstrous creatures, you can bring these wonders or horrors of inventions to life.

Additionally, any sentient beings you create will show remarkable loyalty to you, demonstrating near absolute devotion.
objects.title: Tales From Another Time (Simon Stålenhag)

objects.text:
You gain the full knowledge and proficiency to materialize and build all of the technology and science shown in the Warhammer Fantasy universe.

From the Skaven's infernal designs, to the Dwarfs' ingenious schematics, to even the Old Ones' far reaching devices and machines that they bestowed upon the Lizardmen, you know it all.

If you are in the Warhammer Fantasy universe, and any of the races knew that you are a massive encyclopedia of every technology in their universe, then be prepared to have a really strong backer, else kidnapping and torture is a certain possibility.
objects.title: Warhammer Fantasy Technology (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of how to create any technology that is either shown, referenced, or hinted at in either the Metal Slug or Advance Wars series. This includes Black Hole supertechnology, Cloning, Metal Slugs, Rebel Army superweapons, Invader biotech, Amadeus Syndicate mad science & AI, Martian UFOs, Ptolemaic Army magitech, Regular Army supersoldier programs, and even whatever the hell was going on in Metal Slug 3D.

As a bonus, you will become incredibly knowledgeable about tactics, strategy, military science, and command, gaining the military acumen of every Advance Wars Commanding Officer. You are also able to rival the mythical Peregrine Falcons & their associates in everything from commando work to armored warfare.
objects.title: Cartoon Militarism (Metal Slug & Advance Wars)

objects.text:
From Legend of the Galactic Heroes, you will learn how to create any technology whose existence is shown or implied.

You can produce everything from personal equipment and power armor to powerful space fortresses with a diameter of more than a hundred kilometers and capable of housing tens of thousands of ships and millions of soldiers.

As weapons you can access various energy weapons including various ray guns capable of firing various particles (usually neutrons and electrons), lasers, rail guns, missiles with various warheads  (including nuclear and neutron bombs). The development of weapon systems makes it possible to start effective fire at a distance of 40-50 light seconds (12-15 million kilometers or 36-39 distances from the Earth to the Moon).

Protective systems include both composite armor of multi-meter thickness and protective energy barriers of two types: magnetic fields protecting from energy attacks by neutralizing or deflecting them and directed gravitational fields capable of deflecting material projectiles.

Detection and cloaking systems are highly advanced, making radars of little use. Detection systems can detect targets up to 2200 light seconds away (9/10 of the distance from the Sun to Jupiter).

Propulsion systems include both conventional (navigational) engines and inertial systems, which allows to significantly increase the ship's propulsion parameters to speeds reaching several percent of the speed of light. In addition to warp drive and sub-space jumps, it forms the so-called “Three Graces”, which allow for interstellar expansion.

In addition, advanced publicly available medical prosthetic technology is available to replace lost or non-functioning body parts or organs.

All of this is enhanced by the fact that the available mass production will allow you to create more ships than there were soldiers on the battlefields of the Napoleonic Wars (the average size of 1 fleet is between 3,000 and 12,000 ships).

You also become a once-in-a-generation political and military genius like Reinhard von Lohengramm or Yang Wen-Li , acquiring a natural talent for naval tactics, grand strategy, philosophy, and state management.
objects.title: Iserlohn Fortress (Legend of The Galactic Heroes)

addons.text:
You are no longer shackled to TL-27 or below (and whatever meagre advancements to it you might have gleaned on your own), as you now have knowledge of the full spectrum of Traveller technology, even including that of the most advanced of the Precursor species.

This first of all includes more advanced research into psionics, and what exactly it "is," allowing for the full range of Psionic technology. This understanding of Psionics has turned out to be the key to many other fields, and now you possess complete knowledge of all the technology of the Traveller universe, all the way up to TL-35, the Singularity.

Some names of the intervening epochs should give an idea of what this knowledge entails; "The Dyson Sphere Age", "The Reality Engineering Age", "The Pocket Universes Age." What terrifying power!
addons.title: Transcendent Period

objects.text:
You have mastered the science of the Traveller universe, from TL1 to TL27. You have perfect knowledge of this tech, which includes the tech of the Solomani, the Third Imperium, the Zhodani, minor Human subraces, alien races, and even the (pre-TL28) Ancients themselves.

You also have mastered the Technology Level system, allowing you to perform massive technological uplifts on worlds because you understand every intervening technological stage.
objects.title: Sylean (Traveller)

objects.text:
You have mastered the science of the Homeworld universe, from the time of the Progenitors to the modern day. You have perfect knowledge of this tech, which includes the tech of the Bentusi, the Vargyr, the Taiidan, Hiigarans both ancient & modern, and even the Progenitors themselves.

Best of all however, you can capture and adapt any tech you find, meaning like the Kushan of old, what doesn't kill you makes you stronger.
objects.title: Hiigaran (Homeworld)

addons.text:
Any golem you create through Automata Gigue are now imbued with their own Aura and Semblance, making them more than mere machines. This greatly enhances their performance in every aspect, from their speed, strength, durability, intelligence, creativity, and even allows your once static creations to naturally grow more powerful over time. Your golems can also use their Aura to protect themselves from harm, recover from any damage they take, and sense their surroundings. 

With Aura, your golems also receive a Semblance that can aid them in their tasks and make them formidable allies or foes. Your golems' Semblances are related to their purpose and design, and can vary from manipulating elements, enhancing physical attributes, creating illusions, or even affecting emotions. 

For example, a lion golem made to protect may gain the Semblance to create ethereal packs of lions that can assist it in combat or scouting, while a mining golem will gain the Semblance to control the earth surrounding it for easier material gathering and tunneling. 

Finally, you can now communicate with your golems telepathically, and command them as you please. 

You are now truly the master of golems.
addons.title: The Spark of A Soul

objects.text:
You can animate inanimate objects by imbuing them with an artificial soul, turning them into golems. 

The golem's body determines its strength and capabilities. Simple materials like clay and wood can fashion a basic and clumsy protector, while solid steel and stone would result in an elegant and powerful warrior. The golem's form also dictates its abilities; a bird-shaped automaton can take flight, while a lion-like design is capable of majestic movement on the ground. 

At the heart of every golem lies a precious gemstone core that anchors the soul to the physical form, giving life and purpose to the golem. The choice of gemstone is paramount; a humble river stone may suffice for a simple wooden puppet, but a golem made of advanced magitech requires a gem of the purest diamond. 

However, this power comes with a price. The animating process demands the channeling of lifeforce or inner energy from the wielder. The greater the complexity and material quality, the more energy it requires. For instance, animating a sophisticated magitech golem could result in significant physical exhaustion or long-term fatigue. 

Beware, for this power holds both great potential and terrible dangers.
objects.title: Golem Factory (Automata Gigue)

addons.text: Now, any being that is transformed by your Makers can be converted into a member of your Overmind.
addons.title: Transcend Death And Let The Future Take Its Course

objects.text: You gain all the technological and scientific knowledge humanity has that is shown or hinted at in the Dead Space series and its spin-offs. Set in the 26th century, human technology evolved largely. From FTL ships, planet crackers, fabricators and more. And of course, you know how to make the Markers: obelisks that send signals to living beings and change their minds and bodies. Unlike the game, you can do more than simply turn them into necromorphs or cult-members, such as just upgrading their biology or making them less hostile. (This CYOA doesn't take responsibility if you turn this world into a Brethren Moon accidentally.)
objects.title: Make Us Whole (Dead Space)

objects.text:
You have gained extensive knowledge of the various magitech and magic from the world of Teyvat.

This includes the creation of bionic androids, elemental weapons, and delusions produced by Snezhnaya; the various technologies employed and developed by the Fontaine Research Institute; the advanced alchemical technique known as the Art of Khemia; and the automaton war machines of Khaenri’ah.
