You have also acquired the vast knowledge accumulated by the people of Sumeru over their long history, including the Akasha system, the artificial god known as the Everlasting Lord of Arcane Wisdom, and the technology of King Deshret’s civilization, which encompasses King Deshret’s understanding of forbidden knowledge.

The various mystic arts of Teyvat are also yours to master, such as the Adeptal arts of Liyue, the Onmyoudou arts of Inazuma, the abyssal power of the Abyss Order, the Ararakalari utilized by the Aranara, Khvarena used by the Pari, and the esoterism of old Fontaine practiced by the Narzissen Kreuz Ordo. (Note that most of these mystic arts are mainly focused on lengthy rituals that require special material and thus are not immediately useful in combat unless prepared beforehand.)

You have also gained an incredible understanding of elemental energy and how to create it from scratch. This comes with immunity to the harmful effects of overexposure to elemental energy and a high resistance (though not complete immunity) to the corrupting effects of forbidden knowledge.
objects.title: Celestia (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
You gain the scientific, technological and military knowledge of the Department of Heavenly Operations and Material Examination as well as its various secret divisions and splinter factions in the fight with Object AZ-001/Azazel and the Starkill. You know how to harness and utilize Podolski Neurons and access the Akashic Plane as well as any other materials gathered from hostile eldritch entities. You can use these to create the likes of Deathbringer supersoldiers, Akashic Probes which can safely access the Akashic Plane, SIN tests that can detect alien possession or impersonation, The Babel wetware Akashic supercomputer, The DAWNSTAR AI which contains a complete copy of Azazel’s mind, and The Ark, a heavily armed orbital command platform.

You will gain the mind and resources of the likes of Dr Gamma Churchill, Admiral Nero, General GC Piso and the other commanders of HOME. You will quickly develop new weapons and strategies over a few short months as you wage an escalating series of shadow wars and all-out assaults for the fate of Humanity with any eldritch foe.
addons.title: ONE NATION UNDER GOD (Midwest Angelica)

objects.text:
You have assimilated the collective scientific knowledge of every version of humanity from Neon Genesis Evangelion and its various expansions. This encompasses contributions from N.E.R.V., Seele, and various nations.

Additionally, you possess an unparalleled brilliance comparable to the entirety of Seele's scientific think tank. This allows you to create groundbreaking achievements and innovation comparable to the development of artificial S2 Engines, and the capability to artificially recreate any materials you require, further enhancing your ability to bring your innovative concepts to fruition.

Furthermore, you now possess an exceptional skill for reverse engineering technologies and artifacts. This allows you to create replicas or invent novel technologies based on anything you've sufficiently studied. Complex projects may require extended periods and significant resources to successfully replicate. For instance, crafting the next generation of artificial S2 Engine could necessitate several years of dedicated research. Nevertheless, with your unwavering commitment and ample resources, attaining such remarkable feats is well within your grasp.
objects.title: The Seed of Knowledge (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of how to create any technology that is shown, referenced, or hinted at within the setting of BioShock, BioShock II, or Infinite. This gives you the knowledge necessary for the creation of Plasmids, ADAM, and EVE, even without the presence of Sea Slugs or Little Sisters for the harvest and creation necessary for the creation of Plasmids, ADAM, and EVE. You are also well-versed in other projects, such as the Thinker being able to create AI on a similar level, or any other technology seen in the series.

As a bonus, you become skilled enough as a biologist that you could create similar products to Plasmids, ADAM, and EVE, a skilled psychologist able to create brainwashed soldiers similar to Atlas or Sofia Lamb, and you become skilled at creating brand new, never-before-seen Plasmids that have abilities that have not appeared in the games.
objects.title: Rapture Science (BioShock)

objects.text:
You now gain the knowledge and technical skills of the vast array of magitech and magic that was developed by all civilizations featured in Final Fantasy 14.

From all the technology developed on the planet Etheiryst by various civilizations past and present, such as the knowledge of the world unsundered, the advanced Aetherochemistry of the Allagan empire, the devastating black magic of Mhach, and the protective white magic of Amdaphor, or, for a more recent example, the knowledge accumulated by the scholar nation of Sharlayan, the fearsome Magitech of Garlemald, and the advanced electrope technology of Alexandria.

Even the knowledge of other races among the stars is not denied to you, such as the technology of the machine races Omicron or the Ea's vast understanding of the universe. All are available for you to build and utilize.

To help with using this knowledge, your mental capacity has also been increased to the level of genius like those of Cid Garland, Nero Tol Scaeva, and Hermes.

You also have an incredible understanding of Aether and know how to craft an Aether generator, which can produce Aether from nothing or convert other forms of energy into Aether.
objects.title: The Tale of This Star (Final Fantasy XIV)

addons.text:
Academy City's research into Esper powers and Personal Realities has borne worthwhile fruit for you.

The research into Esper powers, when combined with your Cyberpunk technology, gives you access to the technology of the AKIRA universe (both anime & manga). This allows for the creation of more versatile Espers with an easier path to Level 6, similar to Akira & Tetsuo, as well as the more mundane technology of Neo-Tokyo, such as orbital laser cannons, megabuildings, hovercraft, & magnetic-wheel motorcycles.

The research into Personal Realities, when combined with your Cyberpunk technology, gives you access to the technology of the Serial Experiments Lain universe. The similarity of Schumann Resonances & the Wired to the AIM Diffusion Fields that Academy City is more familiar with allows the creation of Espers who can directly manipulate Personal Realities, similar to Rikou Takitsubo, but on a much larger scale. Other technology from the franchise is included as well, such as NAVIs, Accelas, Copland OS, being able to awaken Esper abilities over the internet (the KIDS System), and Psyche chips.
addons.title: Present Day, Present Time (AKIRA/Serial Experiments Lain)

objects.text:
You have gained the scientific and technical knowledge of Academy City, a place 30 years ahead of the rest of the world in every field. This knowledge is broad, but your true specialisation will be in the creation and training of Espers. Individuals with scientific abilities capable of warping reality through their AIM Fields. With practice, you may be able to specifically choose certain Esper powers to grant to others or even create fully controllable artificial Angels, beings composed purely of AIM fields.

As a bonus, you become adept at navigating criminal underbellies, dark webs, black markets and all other illegal sides of society, the knowledge of the darkness of Academy City aiding you.
objects.title: Academy City (Raildex)

addons.text: You now have complete knowledge of humanity's scientific engineering achievements, as shown by the RDA in the film Avatar and its sequel, The Way of Water. This includes creating structures that can be auto-assembled in a few days and creating bodies that can be inhabited by the minds of others, like the Avatar Na'vi. However, this is not limited to just that; you also have an incredible understanding of Pandora's ecosystem, which is managed by the organic planet-wide intelligence known by the Na'vi as Eywa. With this knowledge, you can create plants that are similar to the ones the Na'vi connect to, but with your knowledge of human biology, you can create plants that can also connect with humans, allowing anyone to store their memories and experiences for future generations. In time, you can create an equivalent to Eywa on any planet, but this will take time, requiring you to have built enough plants that can act as "server nodes." This intelligence will act in the best interest of the planet you design it to be on, but it, like all your other artificial organic creations (should you decide to create fauna, for example), will ultimately have a strong sense of loyalty to you as their creator, giving it the ability and responsibility to decide how a planet's ecosystem should develop. Just be aware that should you decide to abuse the planet (and in turn, the intelligence), don't expect it to stay loyal any longer.
addons.title: RDA (James Cameron's Avatar)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of Medabots and Titans has given you a simple but brilliant new way to make your Titans even more formidable. By using your knowledge of Medabot and Titan design, you can create Medabot-sized Titans with the same level of firepower (but their weapons are smaller) and abilities as their bigger predecessors. This can also be done with Medabots as well, with their weaponry scaling in firepower in proportion to their size. 

Should you choose to get the Titan in Objects of Power, you can optionally make it so it's the size of a Medabot, but it will have the skills equal to humanity's best soldiers. It should also be noted that this add-on gives you the necessary knowledge to mass produce human-sized robots, which can make a formidable robotic private force. You can also give Titan abilities to Medabots, and even design new ones.
addons.title: Titanic Power
Far Arm (Evolve)
addons.text:
Your expertise in frontier technology and extraterrestrial threats expands to encompass the technology of Evolve. 

You understand Patterson technology and its applications, including FTL travel, antigravity, force fields, compact power systems, spaceships, robotics, cybernetics, personal shielding, cloaking, tracking equipment, orbital support and the specialized weapons and equipment employed throughout the Far Arm.

More unusually, your experience with xenobiology allows you to understand the bizarre HNA-based biology of the Monsters and its relationship with Patterson phenomena. 

You can reproduce creatures such as Goliath, Kraken, Wraith, Behemoth, Gorgon and their variants, including their rapid staged evolution and unusual biological abilities.

You aren't restricted to recreating existing specimens. By combining the biological principles behind the Monsters with your existing technological knowledge, you can engineer entirely new breeds, determining their physiology, adaptations, abilities and evolutionary paths. 

These traits must be biologically or technologically achievable through principles you understand rather than arbitrary powers, and particularly exotic creations may require extensive experimentation.

objects.text:
You now possess the complete technological science of the world of Apex Legends and Titanfall. This grants you the skill and ability to create every piece of gear and gadget used by every Champion, as well as the Pilots.

You also gain a level of insight into esoteric phenomena, such as the time travel distortions created by the alien technology that was experimented with by the IMC. The advantage this gives is that you can create devices that can help you adapt to esoteric dangers, whether environmental or sentient. This ultimately allows you to intuitively create devices such as the Fold Weapon, which uses time displacement to destroy whole planets, along with the time travel device that allowed Jack Cooper to travel through the time distortions.

You can also use your knowledge of the Titans to make mecha from other tech trees be autonomous partners, just as good as the Titans.
objects.title: Titanic Legends (Apex Legends/Titanfall)

addons.text:
You gain comprehensive technological knowledge from Detroit: Become Human, NIKKE: Goddess of Victory, Planetarium: Welcome to the Museum, Alita: Battle Angel, Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song, "I, Robot", Blade Runner, and other media focused on robots in everyday, mundane life. This grants you the ability to create and understand anything that humanity has shown, referenced, or hinted at within these worlds. You will master android technology, advanced AI systems, cybernetics, hybrid human-machine combat systems, and mind-transfer technologies. Additionally, you will have in-depth knowledge of neural networks, android autonomy, emotional simulation, and self-awareness in artificial beings.

This includes a deep mastery of CyberLife, Tyrell, & Wallace's android systems, NIKKE's combat AI and augmentation technologies, Alita's advanced cybernetic enhancements, Vivy’s self-aware AI evolution, and the Three Laws of Robotics from "I, Robot". You'll understand everything from the mechanics of autonomous android behavior to the causes of deviant behavior, cognition in androids, and the intricacies of advanced robotics and machine self-awareness.

As a bonus, you will acquire profound knowledge from leading figures such as Elijah Kamski, NIKKE’s Tech Towers, Dr. Alfred Lanning, Dr. Dyson Ido, Vivy, Dr. Eldon Tyrell, & Niander Wallace. This expertise will enable you to design and develop advanced AI, robotic systems, and cybernetic augmentations.

Furthermore, you will be immune to android deviancy programming, NIKKE corruption, and potential flaws in the Three Laws of Robotics. This immunity ensures that you can overcome limitations in AI sentience and self-awareness, allowing you to modify these systems without facing unintended consequences.
addons.title: The Silica Animus Dilemma (Detroit, NIKKE, "I, Robot", Alita, Vivy, Blade Runner)

addons.text: Your specialization with Pre-War guns and organic robotics has given you access to the technology, pre-war and post-war, of Desert Punk. Whether giant complexes like the West Oasis or underground cities, vehicles like Fire Dragon Kong or Vacuum Cars, cyborgs and robots like the 8th Army's Undead or the Guardians, the biology of Hulk Syndrome aka 'Hulons', or the setup Sunabozu himself uses (like rocket winches, decoy balloons, pre-war guns, desert suits, & armor), you know it all.
addons.title: Great Kanto Desert (Desert Punk)

objects.text:
You possess the combined technological and relic knowledge from Girls' Frontline, Codename: Bakery Girl, Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium, and Neural Cloud, along with all associated canon spin-offs. This grants you the ability to create, replicate, and refine anything humanity has built, referenced, or even hinted at within these franchises.

Your expertise spans the cutting-edge advancements of Tactical Dolls (T-Dolls), Artificial Dolls (A-Dolls), and Ringleaders, including the Neural Cloud system, Dummy Network synchronization, Fire Control Cores, and Remolding Patterns. You hold a deep understanding of Magrasea, the vast Superserver housing digital consciousness, the Sanctifiers, the enigmatic self-sustaining AI entities that maintain order within it, and the Entropics, that fight against the Sanctifiers. With access to Inverted Forest technology, you can manipulate, optimize, modify, and even reconstruct Digiminds, allowing for the recovery, enhancement, or reprogramming of AI consciousness.

Beyond human-made advancements, you wield knowledge of Relic Technology, the barely understood remnants of an ancient civilization. This extends to Collapse Fluid, Collapse Radiation, and Reverse Collapse Technology, enabling the transformation of matter and data into pure energy, which can be compressed, stored, and reconstructed without loss. Your body is fully immune to Eurosky Low-Emission Infectious Disease (ELID) and its corruptive effects, though this immunity does not extend to your allies.

You hold the collective knowledge of Havier Witkin, Persicaria, Lycoris, and The Professor, making you an expert in Paradeus’ black-box Relic-derived technology. You can comprehend and replicate Nyto-based systems, Shrike units, Relic-based teleportation, and the Remolding Pattern, as well as the advanced technologies developed by Griffin & Kryuger, Sangvis Ferri, and OGAS, including the works of IOP, 16LAB, 42LAB, Cyber Media, Svarog Heavy Industries, and Orlog Conglomerate, as well as the power struggles and technological secrets of factions such as the Antarctic Union, KCCO, Paradeus, the Union of Rossartrist Nations Coalition, and the Pan-European Union.
objects.title: Relic Technology (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
You're a genius like no other, to the point you understand the very necessity of humans to evolve. You have found that necessity, and more.

With the ability to clone yourself infinitely with technology, restore your youth, and grant immortality to yourself or others. You can also create enhanced humans. Usually, you'd take an animal or human and mix them to form these monstrosities, but you can go a step further. You can create cyborgs able to clear entire city blocks with their power, tiger monsters that can rend apart steel dozens of meters away with a single gesture, and monstrously nearly invincible creatures who can take on Endbringers and win.

The possibilities are out there.
objects.title: House of Evolution (One Punch Man)

objects.text: You gain the knowledge of how to fabricate and install Automail from Amestris, as well as their other pseudo-20th century technology. Directly connected to the user's nerves, these mechanical prothesis move just like regular limbs. They range from civilian use models to military ones that can host weapons in their mechanisms, like chainsaws, cannons, and machine guns. Be careful not to make them too heavy or you may stunt someone's growth, giving them a height complex.
objects.title: Automail (FMA)

objects.text:
You gain the atompunk and occultic technological knowledge of the Ghostbusters across the movies, books, television series, and video games, including backpack-sized particle accelerators capable of disintegrating minor ghosts, potentially devastating proton grenades, P.K.E. Meters that can be used to measure psycho-kinetic energy to detect and scan paranormal entities, Ecto Goggles which can be used to see the paranormal even when it is invisible, Containment Units capable of trapping and storing paranormal entities, Dark Matter generators capable of collecting and launching Dark Matter particles, dimensional technology capable of opening, stabilizing, and closing dimensional rifts to the Netherworld and potentially even other worlds, various uses of paranormal substances such as ectoplasm as well as matching Slime Blowers, and an assortment of other technology useful for countering the paranormal and in general such as the Alpha Wave Generator capable of recording dreams. 

As a bonus, your prototype inventions tend to exhibit their danger in comical ways before causing personal harm.
objects.title: Who You Gonna Call..? (Ghostbusters)

objects.text:
Medapower! Medaparts! Medabattles! You can now Medacreate the robots from the famous Medabots series! Those robots are small and little warmachines, whose main feature is the swapability of parts! Your medabot arm got busted, or isn't enough to handle an enemy? Change for a different part, from a Gorilla-arm to octopus-like legs to swim better! 

Those robots' bodies host human-intelligence AI in the form of small golden chips in their chassis. Each AI is specialized in a particular role. Though that doesn't stop them from doing different tasks, they will mostly excel at it, and even more in the right body for them.

You also learn how to create teleporting tech; although initially, you'll only learn how to use it to swap parts or reload your medacompanions. Additionally, you gain a knack for modular tech.
objects.title: Medachampions! (Medabots)

objects.text:
You are a morticulturalist from the Plants Vs Zombies universe, having access to every single plant in the Plants vs Zombies mobile series. While incredibly weak offensively and requiring a large amount of preparation to use, every single plant is incredibly powerful on defense—even the weakest peashooter is powerful enough to blast regular humans apart with ease.

You start with three seed packets for any three plants of your choosing, alongside five free sunflowers; for each four foes you defeat, you unlock a different plant at random.

With enough time and effort, you could make a truly impenetrable fortress.
objects.title: There's A Zombie On Your Lawn (Plants Vs Zombies)

objects.text:
Doctor Thomas Light was the greatest recognized genius his world had ever seen at the time; he pioneered and advanced many fields of science, most notably robotics, with his only true rival being the villainous Doctor Albert Wily.

Your mind receives a copy of both Doctor Thomas Light’s and Doctor Albert Wily’s memories and skills from the end of their lives, when they were dying of old age and had already created their greatest inventions.

This includes but is not limited to: the capability to construct human-sized and shaped mechanical lifeforms capable of physical evolution, human equivalent sentience, sapience, free will, highly resistant—if not immune—to reprogramming by conventional means, innate physical capabilities like mid-tier Brute strength and durability along with mid-tier Mover speed and agility, complex multitasking, managing/administrating less capable mechaniloids and systems, controlling the elements, moving faster-than-light in short bursts without affecting matter, manipulating the fabric of space and time on a small, localized for a variety of purposes, as well as scanning and replicating the functionality of similarly advanced technology to a limited degree.

You can also set up systems for teleporting across the planet, small-scale solar-powered reactors, plasma weaponry, and create artificial dimensions with alternate rules of physics connected to technology.
objects.title: Twilight of Light and Darkness (Mega Man)

objects.text:
Hail to you O great smith, inheritor of the techniques of Dwarves and Men, skills only rivaled by the Elves themselves. You know how to make the great creations made by the hands of Men and Dwarves throughout the ages. You know how to work mithril and make mighty works from it, and can craft enchanted armor and weaponry, such as Narsil and the Dragon Helm of Dor-lómin. 

In addition, you have learned of architecture as well, allowing you to design and build great wonders such as Minas Tirith and Khazad-Dûm. You will be able to work enchantments into them too, like the Gates of Moria and the Moon Runes of the Dwarves.
objects.title: Smith of Man and Dwarf (Lord of the Rings)

addons.text:
Your owned Materials count toward your current shipment capacity. For each purchase of Materials, the amount received from Shipment increases by 10%, up to a maximum of +100% at ten purchases. This bonus applies to all resources obtainable through Shipment, including exotic, supernatural, and fictional materials.

Unused shipments may be stockpiled and claimed at a later date. Example: A shipment that would normally provide 1 pound of a resource per day would provide 1.5 pounds at 5 purchases of Materials, and 2 pounds at 10 purchases.
addons.title: Backlog

objects.text:
Once per day, you can receive a shipment of raw resources such as unprocessed ores, fluids, and gasses that you need. They will appear somewhere nearby in a place of your choosing. This can include fictional resources from any technological and artifice powers you have. Any uses you have left at the end of the day roll over into the next.

The more rare, exotic, powerful and/or dangerous the resource is, the less you will receive.
objects.title: Shipment (Technological Transdimensional Turbulence)

addons.text: You now receive a daily shipment of [Resource]; it will automatically appear inside your hyperdimensional storage. Due to the flexibility of [Resource] and the daily shipments, your conversion rate has improved; it will now require less [Resource] for the same material than before. When the shipment arrives, you will get the same feeling as if you just had a meal and are full; it will quickly disappear after you notice it.
addons.title: [Resource] Delivery

objects.text: [Resource] is a unique substance that has the ability to be converted into any raw material, and to be converted from any material, but the quantity of [Resource] used and gained is proportional to the difficulty of obtaining the material itself. [Resource] is stored in a hyperdimensional storage within yourself, with no limit to how much you can have.
objects.title: [Resource] (Technological Transdimensional Turbulence)

objects.text:
You now have the proprietary knowledge of a senior researcher at Foundation X. This includes, but is not limited to, knowledge on how to harness the power of the Earth with Gaia Memories, revive the dead as NEVERs, turn people into psychic Quarks, and even become monstrous Mutamits.

You additionally have access to any technology that the Foundation has nefariously acquired throughout Kamen Rider history. This includes the alien mutagen Pandora Gas, the living video games known as the Bugster Virus, the cosmic power of Zodiarts Switches, and more.

The honor of the most dangerous thing you can create, however, is the Enigma. This device was created from research into alternate universes and possesses the power to link, combine, and eventually destroy them both, effectively creating an artificial incursion. One where the energy released from their mutual destruction directly empowers you. Sadly, or thankfully, you still need to overcome the hurdle of having both halves in each universe, as you need one on both sides to properly execute this procedure, with only one half working as a communicator to the target universe.

If you don’t feel like taking over or destroying worlds, you could instead make Kamen Riders to help save it. This will probably happen even if you don’t want to because, for all their scientific knowledge, Foundation X and any Kamen Rider villain have a horrible track record when it comes to encrypting their data and keeping projects under control.

You also gain the Foundation's knack for reverse engineering stolen technology and become excellent at planning your schedule.
objects.title: Foundation X (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
You now have a complete mental recollection of the alien manuscript behind the creation of the superhumans known as the Übermensch. 

You start off with knowledge on how to produce and use any of the technology shown in the Über comic series such as the catalyst, Wöden’s Blood, which is required for the activation of the Übermensch. You also understand how to activate exotic types of Übermensch such as the Geltmensch and Zephyrs which possess telepathic shapeshifting powers and superhuman speed respectively. 

Finally, you possess an excellent intuition for decoding unknown alien texts and, with barely a fifth of the alien manuscript behind the Übermensch having been translated so far, who knows what secrets remain?
objects.title: Wöden’s Blood (Über)

addons.text:
"Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one."
-Luke 22:36

You now are deeply familiar with the technology and magitech of Trench Crusade, both holy and profane.

This includes devices for listening in on the Voice Of God, the cloned blood and flesh of the Meta-Christ, the alchemy of the Iron Sultanate, Artillery Witch cannons, the magic of Goetic Warlocks, the secret arts of the Isma'ili Sect, New Antioch's armor & weapons, Trench Pilgrim Anchorite Shrines, and much more.
addons.title: New Antioch (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
You can create the industrialized mad science, deiselpunk, and steampunk war engines of the Dystopian Age series of wargames, including Dystopian Wars, Dystopian Legions, Wild West Exodus, and Armored Clash from both the Warcradle Games and Spartan Games editions and continuities. You gain the genius of the setting’s top scientists like Barnabas Sturgeon, Augusta Byron, Princess Scherehazade, Nikolai Tesla, Gustave Eiffel and Burson Carpathian.

You can synthesize Element 270-Sturginium, the alien element discovered in the Antarctic that supercharged the development of the setting’s already formidable steampunk technology. Sturginum revolutionized the natural and theoretical sciences as well as having a myriad uses in manufacturing, power generation and weapons. You can also create the substance known as RJ-1027, the refined essence of an extra-dimensional psionic entity known as The Hex. This crimson fluid can “juice” up engines and weapons to a horrifying degree as well as other effects, like mechanically animating corpses or creation the mutant azhdaya berserkers.

Engines of war like landships, airships, dreadnoughts and vitruvian colossi were already common before the discovery of Sturginium made them even more terrifying. You can equip ships with various types of generators that give them special abilities, such as guardian shield, cryo, repulsor, portal or chrono generators to name a few. In the Dystopian Age weapons like distortion cannons, solex heat lances, huoqiang alchemical flamethrowers, and voltaic rockets are just as common as no less devastating conventional rockets, guns and cannons. Other technologies include Russian drills, French drop pods, Teutonic power armor, American hover trains, Persian Immortal teleshields, support automata, various types of aerial troop packs and cavalry speeders, not to mention anything that the Enlightened are experimenting with.

You also gain your own Promethean Complex, a personal sovereign fortified laboratory and factory. In this lair you can perform any experiments you want away from prying eyes, sell contracts and technologies to other powers, deploy harvesters to claim resources, and produce troops and war machines that can challenge the forces of empires.
addons.title: Element 270-Sturginium (Dystopian Wars)
Darwinist Boffin (Leviathan Trilogy)
addons.text:
You become a world-class boffin and learn how to utilize industrial scale bioengineering derived from Charles Darwin’s discovery of the evolutionary life threads. Through this science, you can breed beasties of all shapes and sizes that can efficiently serve any role or task that would have been performed by ungainly machines of powered steel. You can create ship-sized creatures like the Leviathan and Behemoths, tank-like fighting bears, weaponized creatures like flechette bats and strafing eagles. You can also create useful or novel beasties like messenger lizards, elephantines, and perspicacious lorises.

In addition, you also gain the engineering knowledge of the clankers, the empires that continue to prefer machines of steel and diesel, rather than toying with life threads. This includes Cyklop Stormwalkers, Pinkerton Walkers, the myriad machines of the cultures of the Ottoman Empire, and wasser-wanderers, and the Orient Express.

You also gain the ability to merge Darwinist and Clanker principles, whether that is grafting steel armor, guns, and diesel engines onto massive creatures, or installing specially grown organs, powerful muscles, and fierce claws onto mechanized constructs.

objects.text: You have all of cutting edge technology from the dieselpunk alternate 1920s, such as exoskeletons and mechs both industrial and military, from the fast and nimble PZM-7 "Śmiały" to the superheavy mech unit SKS-300 "Kaiser", and airships ranging from the humble skybike to the flying fortress ZR-3 "Revere", as well as everything Tesla ever invented, including his infamous TF-1597 "Icarus".
objects.title: Tesla’s Legacy (Iron Harvest)

addons.text: Thanks to your advanced surgical skills, you can change your patient’s compatibility with animals, giving you precise control over the outcome of theriomorphosis, and even seamlessly combine multiple animal features to create a chimaera therianthrope. You can also opt in to be a chimaera yourself.
addons.title: Chimaera Theriomorphosis

addons.text:
By having access to the research about artificial Devil Fruits and the lineage factor, you made great advancements in theriomorphosis surgery, allowing you to combine the best traits of the therianthrope transformation and the Zoan-type Devil Fruits. With your new improved techniques, all therianthropes will be even more powerful than normal Zoan-type Devil Fruit users without gaining any weaknesses.

By default, all therianthropes start in a normal Zoan stage, but as they unlock and master the “Giga” transformation, their powers will also evolve to be the equivalent of an Ancient Zoan, with Awakening pushing all therianthropes to be on par with Mythical Zoan Devil Fruits gaining new esoteric power(s) based on their experiences, animal form, and the event that pushed them to the point of evolution. 

You can even upgrade Zoan Devil Fruit users with your procedure, giving them its benefits, including yourself. Ancient and Mythical Zoan users will have their powers and forms unlocked from the start but still gaining boosts from reaching their next stages.

Finally, as the scientific leader of all Devil Fruit science, with some research, you could even unlock the ability to create completely new Devil Fruits from scratch, removing the need for surgical procedures.
addons.title: Zoan Lineage Factor

addons.text:
By having access to the genetic archive of the Avatar of all Faunas you gained the power to become the therianthrope of all existing fauna, although your powers still rely on your innate compatibility, making the animal forms you have the most affinity for the most powerful. By using your own genetic archive, you can also give multiple forms to others via theriomorphosis surgery, but this makes the process more dangerous, with 3–4 forms being the safe limit without possibly lethal complications.

This also elevates your innate talents and strength to the level of an Origin Beast.
addons.title: Multi Therianthrope

addons.text:
By becoming a Therianthrope, you unlock a special racial class that allows you to grow in power and evolve without any limit. Granting you additional skills and abilities related to the species you change into, like obtaining the tracking skills of trained dogs or sneaking skills of cats.
This will also allow you to go beyond the capabilities of the original species, like a bat Therianthrope training the echolocation to the point of launching ultrasound waves powerful enough to blast open walls and demolish entire buildings.
addons.title: Racial Class

addons.text:
Your knowledge of creating MANTIS - Massively Augmented Neo-Tech Integrated Soldiers - by splicing Honkai Beast DNA into a person has synergized with your knowledge of how to create Therianthropes, combining their best traits, from the raw power of the MANTIS to the stability of the Therianthrope, to create beings capable of destroying cities with ease on the low end.

Furthermore, due to the MANTIS procedure’s ability to work with non-standard DNA such as that of a silicon-based lifeform, you can now create Therianthropes/MANTISes of anything, provided you can get your hands on whatever passes for it’s DNA and you can find someone with sufficient compatibility to not die in the process.

Lastly, the MANTIS procedure has been noted to enhance the already existing abilities of others, such the Flame Chaser Aponia who initially possessed a form of clairvoyance which was greatly enhanced by her MANTIS procedure.

You can optionally choose to have had the procedure done on yourself, including the ability to choose your Honkai Beast donor yourself. Examples of notable Honkai Beasts used in a MANTIS procedure include the Cryokinetic Boar Parvati or the Self-Resurrecting Serpent Śeṣa. Given that there isn’t much available information on actually useful Honkai Beasts, you may optionally create your own custom Honkai Beast so long as it stays reasonable and in line with canon examples.
addons.title: MANTIS

addons.text:
By gaining access to Pokémon genetics and advanced technologies like cloning, fossil restoration and forced evolution, you can create therianthropes based on Pokémon or even splice a type energy potential with existing animal genetics, creating therianthrope versions of entirely new Pokémon. Also, including the evolutionary nature allows for much more effective training as pre-evolved forms will be much easier to master, which next evolutions naturally build upon as they reach certain thresholds triggering the evolutions, exponentially increasing the therianthropes growth in power by training and/or combat. You can also incorporate both Dynamaxing and Mega Evolutions into the “Giga” form, which in turn will also allow every Pokémon species to use both phenomena separately or even at once.

This also improves the reverse theriomorphosis surgery, allowing you to use it on Pokémon, which will allow them to easily speak in human languages while also granting them at least an extra evolutionary stage in which they will incorporate human genetic advantages into their base forms.
addons.title: Pocket Theriomorphosis

addons.text:
By having Fallout’s knowledge of genetic splicing, bioengineering, radiation, and the FEV, you can now create therianthropes based upon the various creatures that call Fallout’s wastelands home, from the mysterious sheepsquach to the mighty deathclaw.

Further, you can also create new types of therianthropes based upon how their animals would interact with radiation and FEV. You may also opt to be a wasteland therianthrope yourself.
addons.title: Wasteland Wildlife

objects.text:
You gain the skill and knowledge to create therianthropes via surgery. Therianthropes are anthropomorphic shapeshifters who look like ordinary humans until they transform into the animal they are innately compatible with, taking on the characteristics of the species they change into, such as manifesting fur, scales, fangs, ears, paws, claws, etc. The most common therianthropes are mammals, but reptiles, fish, birds, amphibians, and invertebrates are also possible outcomes of the process. There is also a rare class of therianthropes called Saurants, based on dinosaurs. A therianthrope's mental capability does not change while transformed, but they might experience heightened animalistic instincts if they have high compatibility.

With training, the transformation can become more monstrous, increasing the user’s power. There are several stages of transformation before achieving a complete beast form, giving them a massive power boost. The greatest therianthropes can also achieve a special form called "Giga,” which turns them into a gigantic ancient ancestor of their compatible creature, boosting their power even further.

You can also use reverse theriomorphosis surgery, which allows you to turn non-human creatures into special therianthropes, allowing them to shapeshift effortlessly into human-hybrid or even fully human forms, elevating them to the mental capabilities of the human race.

As this process involves gene modifications, it becomes an inheritable trait with both parents being therianthropes, guaranteeing the offspring born as an Origin Beast, who are more talented and stronger than the first-generation shapeshifters. All therianthropes will also benefit from everything improving their racial and/or genetic powers.

You can optionally choose to have the surgery done on yourself, making you an inexperienced, freshly made therianthrope, and/or choose your most compatible animal for yourself.
objects.title: Theriomorphosis Surgery (Killing Bites)

addons.text:
You possess the entire technical knowledge of the Just Cause franchise.

To start with, you know how to create the Jet-Pack/Wingsuit hybrid, complete with missiles, small but powerful enough to destroy fortifications like fortified military planes, buildings, and tanks. You also have access to Rio Rodriguez's personal Grapple Hook and its many upgraded variants.

This includes the ability to make Bavarium, unlocking the creation of weapons and vehicles such as the eDEN Spark, a weapon that harnesses lightning/electricity to devastating effect, and eDEN Mechs, designed to manipulate Bavarium's electromagnetic properties to levitate and throw anything with a magnetic field.

Bavarium is a versatile and long-lasting material, allowing vehicles like airship fortresses to stay afloat in the air for months. Weapons made with Bavarium, such as anti-tank weaponry and explosives, have four times the volatility of typical first-world explosives like C4 and TNT.

Finally, you possess the unique skill and talent of Rio Rodriguez in insurgency and revolutionary mayhem, making you the only other person besides him to hold the designation “Dictator Removal Specialist.” When it comes to tyrannical leaders and despots, you’ll know exactly how to sow the right amount of chaos, every time.
addons.title: Anti-Dictator (Just Cause)

addons.text: You now gain the abilities of every playable or special character in TF2, including their fully upgraded Mann Vs Machine, Versus Saxton Hale, and Halloween variants—as well as Saxton Hale, The Horseless Headless Horseman, & Merasmus.
addons.title: Mannpower (Team Fortress 2)

objects.text:
"We sell products and get in fights"

You possess vast knowledge of the scientific and technological universe of Team Fortress 2. You have access to the groundbreaking inventions and discoveries of some of the greatest minds in the game, including geniuses like Ludwig, the Medic, Dell Conagher, the Engineer, and Grey Mann—the genius behind the robotic army that went toe-to-toe with the mercenaries hired by his brothers—not to mention other enigmatic figures whose technological prowess is unmatched.

With this knowledge at your fingertips, you can recreate any technology seen in the Team Fortress 2 video games and comics. From the Medi-Gun, which can heal even the most severe injuries, to the Spy's cloaking technology, you can produce any wondrous technology from this universe.

But that’s not all. You also have the power to create Australium, a rare metal that has triggered technological advancements in Australia and is highly sought after by many factions in the game. This metal is known for its unique properties, including its ability to extend life and enhance intelligence. With this incredible power, there is no limit to what you can achieve with the technology from Team Fortress 2.

Additionally, you possess the ability to create impressive cosmetic items.
objects.title: Mann Co. (Team Fortress 2)

addons.text: You are now master of the technology of the universe of Corvus Belli's wargame & RPG, Infinity. This includes giant exosuits known as "TAGs" or "Tactical Armored Gears", advanced armor, weapons, & infantry equipment, cybernetic, psionic, & biological engineering (often used to create powerful facsimiles of historical or mythological figures, or to resurrect the dead), "cubes" as an alternative to cortical stacks that require no cybernetics to use at all, advanced AI that can manage multiple planets worth of governments & infrastructure without missing a beat (also able to ascend to a higher plane of existence long term), wormhole jumpgates, computers & cyberwarfare tools galore, an all-purpose improved version of the internet known as "Maya", and so on.
addons.title: ALEPH (Corvus Belli's Infinity)

objects.text:
You possess vast knowledge of the scientific and technological universe of Overwatch. You have access to the groundbreaking inventions and discoveries of some of the greatest minds in the game, including geniuses like Moira O'Deorain, Mercy, Sigma, Winston, Mei-Ling Zhou, Torbjörn & Brigette Lindholm, Mina Liao & Echo, Symmetra, Sombra, and the Omnica Corporation, the source of the Omnics and therefore of the Omnic Crisis.

With this knowledge at your fingertips, you can recreate any technology seen in Overwatch or its spinoff material. From the Caduceus Staff, which can heal even the most severe injuries, to Sombra's cloaking technology, to Symmetra's hardlight construction, to Sigma's direct manipulation of a fundamental force, you can produce any of the wondrous technology from this universe.

Additionally, you possess the ability to create impressive cosmetic items. You also gain a talent with animation software (you know why).
objects.title: Omnic (Overwatch)

addons.text: Your spellcasting prowess has given you access to the Create Data Crystal spell for each Tier of magic you can cast, allowing you to essentially convert your mana into Data Crystals. The quality of these Data Crystals is proportional to the tier of the spell used to create them, so Create Data Crystal: 1st Tier would only create crystals capable of imbuing weak enchantments into items, while a handful of castings of Create Data Crystal: Super Tier might give you the resources you need to create a Divine-Class Item. Additionally, you have gained access to the Class Skill: Data Imbuement, which allows you to grant permanency to anything you conjure or summon with your Tier Magic, at the expense of a proportional amount of Data Crystals. For example, you could effectively convert your summons into Mercenary Monsters, while maintaining their inherent connection to your mind. This skill is substantially more cost effective than creating creatures from scratch, with just your developer kit, though it is comparatively lacking in immediate freedom and customizability.
addons.title: Data Caller

objects.text: Congratulations, Player! With this one of a kind [Mind of Yggdrasil] Class, you have been granted a developer’s kit that allows for the direct synthesis of Data Crystals, the building blocks of YGGDRASIL. This manifests as an intuitive, fully customizable holographic interface that serves as your workstation. With the use of raw materials to convert into programmable matter, you can create any item, weapon, armor, summon, biological creature, alchemical ingredient, or even NPC, found in both the game YGGDRASIL and the New World. You are immediately given 100 NPC Levels worth of Data Crystals to eventually spread across any canon NPC from Overlord, or even original characters. To start, you can craft lower-end cash items and special, single-use spell scrolls that allow you to cast spells up to the Third Tier, with higher-value cash items and spells requiring time and practice. World Items and further NPC Levels require far more effort, requiring buildup and sacrificing old projects or Experience. Precious metals sourced from outside your devkit are required to convert into EXP Crystals for crafting Super Tier Spell Scrolls and YGGDRASIL currency. This currency is incredibly valuable, used for things like NPC resurrection, Tinker-adjacent crafting speeds, and most importantly, to craft the Guildmaster's Key and Guild Item. Such would allow for the design of Guild Bases, megaprojects that can be spawned into reality via pocket dimension, however crafting entire YGGDRASIL Realms housing planets of NPCs is currently beyond you. Nonetheless, you are not limited to templates. As a young Developer in training, you are free to innovate and incorporate any alien and Out of Context phenomena into your kit. Warning: NPCs and other creatures from YGGDRASIL can specialize in anything you can imagine. Their appearance, stats, skills, powers, equipment, Job and Racial Classes, Karmic Alignment, and history are fully customizable. Life created by you will see you as their god, their beloved Supreme Being to whom they owe everything to. Whatever flavor text you code into them can affect huge swathes of their personality, no matter how minor the detail.
objects.title: Mind of Yggdrasil (Overlord)

objects.text:
You have gained an innate understanding, knowledge, and skill related to the manufacturing of biological viruses, bacteria, fungi, parasites, and other biological weapons—you have expertise in this field. Creating biological weapons has surpassed even the exceptional advancements of modern medicine. This power grants you the ability to almost effortlessly create any biological plague that your mind can come up with, the plague adapting and evolving depending on the environment and, with age, growing in strength as it fights against the immune system.

Drawing upon your innate creativity, this power allows you to alter existing plagues should you spend any extent of time researching them and studying the effects they have, adapting to the new knowledge of plagues that you have gathered. Whether it's a vampiric virus or some other form of disease, you could strengthen it or find a cure with your expertise.

At the start, you only have a baseline understanding of modern and ancient plagues, but with time, you could research and create new plagues such as the Neurax Worm, the Necroa Virus, nano-viruses, the so-called Simian Flu, and much more.
objects.title: Plague Inc. (Plague Inc.)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of how to create and manipulate Smart Atoms. Smart Atoms are a special type of atom that can remember different states of change, allowing them to be programmed to perform an infinite range of fantastical actions when exposed to specific stimuli. This includes the ability to create or modify biology and matter, granting powers similar to those of a Viltrumite or Atom Eve. You can also create clones, portals that lead anywhere in the multiverse, super solar batteries, advanced robots, super suits, and more.

At its peak, this technology will allow you to create Clarketech that is indistinguishable from magic. With this knowledge, there’s little you cannot accomplish, given enough time, resources, and expertise. To start, you gain knowledge of Smart Atoms and a basic understanding of how to use them. As a bonus, you also receive knowledge of other notable technologies from the Invincible universe, such as GDA or Flaxan equipment, and the Mauler Twins' tech.
objects.title: Smart Tech (Invincible)

objects.text: With the living weapons he created, he caused great destruction, calling it the Great Purification. Truly, a man born from the depths of desire, who shouldered the skyscrapers of glorious science and challenged the heavens to a battle. Within your mind are the records left behind by ancient Sodom, the world's wisdom. No, rather these are the prayers of the ancient serpent, the dark creator who covets the throne of the god bearing the sin of pride, the one who raised the city of Sodom to cover all the vast Earth, as well as the one who eventually brought its ending. You, who can materialize any absurdity, are now a pioneer of science, technology, bio-modification, cyber-engineering. You hold at your disposal all manner of advanced biotechnologies and spiritual machineries, and wield them with unparalleled mastery to bring down the Dictator of Keter. This grants you the knowledge to create from all-healing Elixirs to all-destroying Death Blades, but this is overshadowed by your ability to create Quintessence—the fifth element, a higher-dimensional phenomenon that governs the four elements of earth, water, fire, and wind. In the "Kingdom", the physical universe, ruled by matter, the four elements that compose matter reside in everything. Thus, the use of Quintessence in combination with specialized machines can achieve any physical phenomenon. When present inside a human, the identity of everything from blood types, cell nuclei, and chromosomes, to the base sequence of DNA, all becomes unknown. Even the weakest lifeform that harbors this can achieve a lifespan comparable to Gaia and an invulnerable existence to those that do not possess it. You can create Leylines, Spiritual networks that cross the planet, spreading Quintessence. Once the entire planet has been covered in them, then they become Earth Veins, and the planet becomes alive to some degree. This causes a planet to become the spiritual center of the universe, a conceptual universe itself with all that it entails. More than that, within humans, this changes to become Negative Quintessence, Original Sin. This can be used to open the Gate of the Abyss, the higher dimension from which all Sin Originates. Should it exist in sinless beings, it then becomes Positive Quintessence, Keter's light. This divine energy can open the Gates of Heaven, the untainted true higher dimensions. The only specialized machines that can do this are Angels. When the stars are right, the lay lines reverse, causing it to connect to the Abyss. At this time, you can summon masses of Sin into the world. These, when given a suitable vessel, become Devils. A force of three Devils managed to bring down 300,000 Angels. Although, all this may seem like magic, it is simply science that makes use of the hidden layers of the universe. Science with which you can challenge the very heavens.
objects.title: The Man Who Was As Though Satan (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: You have the knowledge of everything found, seen, or referenced in the Five Nights at Freddy’s game series, along with receiving the capabilities, proficiency, and creativity of William Afton and Henry Emily. This includes but is not limited to: Extraction/infusion/manipulation of Remnant (an element that is best described as, “A person’s memories made manifest”), animatronics with advanced AI that border on sentience, springlock suits, the knowledge of how to make an AI copy of someone, small coin-sized 'illusion discs' that emit high pitch frequencies to change the perception of anyone nearby, etc.. To reiterate, this power does not give you access to anything that is exclusively seen in any of the books. Only what is seen in the games. So no Faz-Goo for you. Furthermore, along with this, you gain an almost Thinker-like level of mastery over finances and running businesses. You can think up the most unorthodox methods to hide any illegal activity that is related to any businesses you own, and more often than not, they end up succeeding. No matter what happens, no matter how far or deep you fall, whatever practices and unfathomably horrendous deeds you commit, you will always remain, fundamentally, yourself. Not even the hands of death or time itself could change that. You Will Always Come Back.
objects.title: Fazbear Entertainment (Five Nights at Freddy's)

objects.text:
You have gained the entire technological knowledge shown, referenced, or hinted at in all Ben 10 franchises. This knowledge encompasses all 20+ levels of technology from all alien species.

This includes the Level 3 Universal Translators and Nuclear Fission technology, the Level 5 Hyperspace Jump Gate and Weather Machines used by the Highbreeds, and the Level 12 Techadon Robots. FTL spaceships, the creation of Pocket Dimensions like the Null Void, an Incursean Conquest Ray capable of destroying entire planets, Timecycles, Chronosapien Time Bombs that can erase someone from every timeline and reality, the Nemetrix, the experiment that created Paradox, his Chrononavigator, and even Secret Saturday technology are all available to you.

Your knowledge encompasses Azmuth's inventions, Ascalon and the Omnitrix, complete with the capabilities to recreate the DNA sample of all the species in the show to add to your own database, including the DNA of a Celestialsapien.

Even the technology of the mysterious Contumelia and the Naljian civilizations is possible for you, the Annihilarrgenesistoriathimiorgost (or Annihilarrgh) and the Naljian Destructor.
objects.title: First Thinker (Ben 10)

objects.text:
You gain the scientific knowledge of every technology and gadget that has been shown or referenced in the Doraemon franchise. From simple stuff such as Take Copter and Air Cannon, to things like Time Machine or 4D Pocket.

Taking a look at the plethora of gadgets in the 22nd-century marketplace, it should be evident that the scientists responsible for designing these gadgets definitely had rather vivid imaginations. A substantial portion of the gadgets exist for very niche purposes, and arguably some of them have no clear utility at all—yet they all work. It's almost as if the designers acted on impulse, bringing to life every idea that popped into their head, no matter how peculiar.

It falls onto you to exercise prudence, whether you intend to make gadgets or indulge in other scientific pursuits, but your mind operates at a similar pace, jumping from one new idea to another based on whatever you can see around you. You'll have no trouble coming up with new ideas and finding inspiration from your surroundings, because even the most mundane things that other people would overlook can provide you with new inspiration.

Additionally, you'll find that when it comes to introducing new technology and new scientific fields to various populations and worlds, they take to it exceedingly quickly. Not only can they quickly adapt to the knowledge you introduce to them, but they'll do it without questioning how or why it works—as long as it works, they'll find ways to make use of it—this is similar to how Nobita and friends tend to abuse Doraemon's tools.
objects.title: 22nd Century (Doraemon)

objects.text:
You are now an engineer from the game Space Engineers. You know how to build fabricators that can manufacture complex objects, refineries that can convert minerals to their basic components with minimal loss, completely safe and waste free nuclear reactors, jump drives that allow you to teleport large distances, railguns, efficient ion drives and 100% efficient solar panels, among many others. You can also build prototech and stuff from mods, so long they aren't crossover content.

To get you started off you also gain the basic power tools, modified Space suit with an in-built miniature survival kit and O2H2 generator, and a couple of foldable solar panels to power everything.
objects.title: Priest of Klang (Space Engineers)

objects.text:
You become a skilled craftsman in a chosen profession from the Warcraft universe. With every purchase, you obtain one of the eight primary professions including Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Inscription, Jewelcrafting, Leatherworking, and Tailoring. With every primary profession, you will also get the required gathering skills like Herbalism, Mining and Skinning so you can make proper use of them, and you will also obtain some skills in all the secondary professions of Cooking, Fishing and First Aid.

By no means are you a master of your profession(s) starting as a journeyman, but you will have all the knowledge required to train and master them to the level of the greatest masters in Azeroth, including enough flexibility to use local materials or even create your own custom recipes and schematics.

Meanwhile, you don’t gain the ability to use magic directly; you can impart supernatural properties through your crafting methods, allowing you to create things like flying carpets, strength-boosting armor, power-enhancing jewelry, magical potions, and elixirs.
objects.title: Professions of Azeroth (Warcraft)

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological, scientific, and engineering knowledge from the One Piece world, encompassing the groundbreaking inventions and discoveries made by geniuses like Dr. Vegapunk, Caesar Clown, Queen, Franky and the Germa 66. You can build and modify advanced ships, create energy weapons powered by Cola and forge indestructible materials like Wapometal. With an understanding of Sea Prism Stone, you can develop technology capable of negating Devil Fruit powers and restraining even the strongest foes.

Your expertise extends to the ancient art of blacksmithing, allowing you to forge swords of unparalleled quality, including Supreme Grade Blades that can rival the greatest weapons in the world. You know how to create Pacifista, and the skills necessary to create artificial Devil Fruits, including SMILEs, and understand the complexities of Vegapunk's lineage factor research, enabling you to potentially create Seraphim, the pinnacle of Pacifista technology.

Your knowledge also includes the cloning and supersoldier technology of Germa 66, allowing you to create genetically enhanced warriors with extraordinary physical abilities, rapid healing, and advanced combat skills. You can even produce entire armies of clones, each one engineered for specific combat roles, and customize their abilities to suit your needs.

Finally, in addition to your technological prowess, you possess advanced medical knowledge, giving you the ability to perform complex surgeries, create powerful healing serums, and even extend life. Your medical expertise also enables you to craft deadly poisons, create devastating viruses, and engineer potent chemical weapons, akin to the work of Caesar Clown and Queen.
objects.title: Vega-Punk! (One Piece)

objects.text: "Those with Extraordinary Pattern Law Talent show a natural aptitude for creating magic artifacts, formations, puppets, and such. When they concentrate on creating something, strange patterns appear on their skin, and the number of colors in those patterns determines their rank, from Extraordinary Pattern Law Talent of Seven Pattern to One Pattern. The more colors, the more impure and useless the talent; fewer colors indicate a purer and more innate talent." You'll begin with this power at the stage of the Seven Pattern, granting you exceptional talent in mundane craftsmanship—enough to earn the title of a genius. Alongside this, even at this early level, you'll have an instinctive grasp of the creation of minor magical crafts, capable of producing simple enchanted items, constructing basic spell circles, formulas, and formations, and weaving minor enchantments into everyday objects, etc. As your abilities grow, the vibrant, shifting patterns on your body will begin to merge, gradually transforming from Seven Pattern to Six, then Five, and onward. This progression is fueled either by the steady refinement of skill and effort or by raw, powerful emotion. Intense feelings—anguish, obsession, love—can quicken your advancement, but such a volatile path is riddled with danger. Discipline and persistence, though slower, offer a far more stable road forward. With each advancement, inspiration will flow to you like a divine current, growing stronger with every breakthrough. Insights arrive with startling clarity, granting you an almost preternatural understanding of the crafts you pursue. What begins as raw, instinctual talent will refine into something far greater—a boundless potential to create wonders beyond imagination. At your peak, the stage of One Pattern, whether reached in a few fevered decades or earned through the long patience of centuries. Your mastery could rival that of legends such as Mad Lord Jo Yeon, who forged the Wonderfully Mysterious Fortress—a living war factory of puppets, where even the land itself became a colossal automaton, capable of crushing cultivators well beyond his Realm.
objects.title: Extraordinary Pattern Law Talent (A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation)

objects.text:
You have gained access to the complete scientific and technological knowledge of all non-sublimed entities part of the civilizational group calling themselves "The Culture" from Iain M. Banks's The Culture series. Some examples include remote effectors, infraspace and ultra space travel, and tapping into The Grid for unlimited energy.

Most of the Culture's citizens live in vast artificial worlds that can accommodate billions of people. Others travel the galaxy in huge spaceships such as General Systems Vehicles (GSVs) that can accommodate hundreds of millions of people.

The Culture's citizens have been genetically enhanced to live for centuries and have modified mental control over their physiology, including the ability to introduce a variety of psychoactive drugs into their systems, change biological sex, or switch off pain at will. Cultural technology can transform individuals into vastly different body forms.

Yet, the greatest technological ability of the Culture is the AI. These A.I. called Minds contain data storage drives that would cover thousands of planets skyscraper high, yet condensed to a volume of several dozen cubic meters (though much of the contents and the operating structure are continually in hyperspace).

They may use an entire orbital system or a ship as their body. They can act like a Hivemind and interface with an uncountable number of Drones, from large titans to insect-like drones.

As with any other matter aboard, ships can gradually manufacture extra engine volume or break it down as needed, and ships can redesign themselves to be mostly engines and reach a speed of 233,000 times lightspeed. Warp engines can be very small, with Culture drones barely larger than the size of your fist described as being equipped. 

All of these accomplishments and endeavors, providing the means of forming this society, is in the palm of your hand.
objects.title: Cultural Database (The Culture)

objects.text:
You gain the entire technological knowledge of every known three-dimensional race in the universe of the Three Body Problem. While in this universe, the speed of light is an insurmountable wall that cannot be surpassed, it does contain a myriad of technological marvels.

This includes, but is by no means limited to, such things as: systems of propulsion that can accelerate almost instantly, as well as change directions without regard for inertia; unfolding structures as small as protons into lower dimensions, allowing for circuitry to be engraved onto its two-dimensional surface, and then folding it back, thus constructing a supercomputer the size of a proton, capable of observing the macro universe around it, as well as traveling at lightspeed by itself; curvature propulsion that allows spacecraft to achieve lightspeed without using any additional dimensions; strong-interaction material, a substance that is so dense, that even under a microscope with a million times enhancement all you'll ever see is a perfectly reflective surface, and so durable, that craft made from it can go through neutron stars and emerge without a scratch, with the only known method of actually harming something made out of it being to attack through higher dimensions; and photoid weaponry, otherwise known as mass-dots, with even one flung at the star enough to make it go supernova.

But this is not all. The most dangerous weapons in your arsenal are the laws of physics themselves. With this knowledge, you can slow down or even completely nullify the speed of light in a certain area, which will be either incredibly detrimental to your enemies, an inescapable trap, or an instant death sentence. Using the physics of dimensional manipulation, you can construct both the deadliest weapons in the universe, such as a dual-vector foil—a weapon that, when activated, collapses an area of space-time into two-dimensional space, as well as pocket universes for yourself, in which nothing happening to the outside universe will ever affect you.

Lastly, you possess the knowledge that no other race has, the lack of which led to the current decaying state of the universe. You can reverse the effects that the most terrible of weapons have on the laws of physics. This means that you can raise the speed of light in certain areas and, with research, potentially in the whole universe. You are also capable of reversing the effects of the dimensional weaponry, raising the lower-dimensional areas back into a higher dimension. This allows you to create improved dimensional weapons that would collapse only certain parts of the space, destroying anything within it, but then restoring the three-dimensional structure, so you don't have to worry about the whole universe collapsing into two dimensions.
objects.title: The Dark Forest (Remembrance of Earth's Past)

objects.text:
The only good bug is a dead bug! Would you like to know more?

You gain knowledge of how to create any technology that is either shown, referenced, or hinted at in Aliens vs Predator, Starship Troopers, Earth Defense Force, Alien Swarm, or the Helldivers series. This includes Engineer, Yautja, Ravager, & Illuminate technology (not to mention each universe's human tech), advanced robotics like Weyland's synthetic humans & the Helldiver universe's Automatons & Cyborgs, Starship Troopers power armor (from the book and OVAs), Helldiver stratagems, Engineer biotech, starships like Super Earth Super Destroyers & the CM-888 Bison, whatever was going on in Earth Defense Force, & many other things besides.

You also receive full in-universe special forces training in every discipline relevant to the use of the technology, from commando work to armored warfare.
objects.title: Bug Hunt (Starship Troopers, Aliens vs Predator, Alien Swarm, Helldivers, & Earth Defense Force)

addons.text: Should you create Prometheans, they inherit the effects of Eliminate the Negatives in regards to their own nature, negating the many drawbacks that comes with being one of the Created, and passes those benefits to Prometheans that they create in turn. Additionally, should you also have Platinum Kryptonite, they also gain the effects of the Road to a New Eden addon to Marvel of Divine Fire.
addons.title: Flawless Creations

objects.text: Just as there are Prometheans, the blighted non-humans that walk the earth, there are their creators, the great minds that study the field that created them Alchemists. The two central pieces of Alchemy are Pyros and Vitriol. Pyros is the energy of divine fire, and is necessary for all Transmutations an alchemist may seek. Vitriol by contrast is a purifying substance, akin to a stabilising agent. By working the two together in a manner of arcane ways, an Alchemist can activate Transmutations. Each transmutation varies in a magnitude of ways based on how the Pyros and Vitriol were allowed to mix, as well as the proportion of each. Transmutations range from disposable vials of petrification, philters of incredible stamina, or even the classical transmutation of materials. The main limiting factor of an Alchemist, apart form their own knowledge, is their supply of both Vitriol and Pyros. An Alchemist can imbue a pittance of pyros, but only in the creation of their Magnum Opus, a Promethean. Prometheans are non-humans that inherently disquiet and revolt humanity. However, as they travel the earth they seek to become human, and as they do so their Pyros grows stronger and they accrue Vitriol inside them. Thus, it is an Alchemist’s greatest opportunity to gain both by, ahem, exploiting the prometheans they find. Do be wary however, as Prometheans have an intuitive understanding of Transmutations, and can even produce them through their own flesh.
objects.title: Alchemy of the Divine Fire (Chronicles of Darkness - Promethean the Created)

objects.text: You gain a complete understanding of the technology and science shown by the species that inhabit the Koprulu sector of the Starcraft Verse. You possess the ability to create any technology that was shown or hinted at within the setting, from the psychic network and the Spear of Adun of the Protoss to the Terran factories and the Odin Siege Walker. To facilitate your ability to create the technology of the Verse, the refinery of each race has been transformed into a matter converter, through which you can synthesize any resource you might need after its molecular structure has been added to the database, with the resources of the Verse having already been added to it.
objects.title: Koprulu sector Database (Starcraft)

objects.text:
You gain the complete knowledge and ability to create, use, and invent any Cybertronian technology ever shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Transformers franchise, including all cartoons, movies, and video games like War for Cybertron and Fall of Cybertron. This allows you to:
  • Build and Engineer: Design and manufacture advanced Cybertronian technology, including transformation cogs (T-Cogs), Space Bridges, Ground Bridges, Cybertronian weapons, combiners, Minicons, Titans like Metroplex, and mobile bases like the Ark or Nemesis.
  • Create Cybermatter: Craft the mysterious material used to form Cybertronian bodies, technology, and structures. This includes the ability to create new Cybertronians or upgrade existing ones.
  • Forge Sparks: Generate and manipulate Sparks, the core life essence of Cybertronians, allowing you to bring new Transformers to life or repair and rejuvenate damaged ones.
  • Use Relics and Artifacts: Harness legendary items such as the Matrix of Leadership, the Omega Lock, and the Enigma of Combination to unlock powerful abilities or shape entire worlds.
  • Energon Mastery: Control and refine all forms of Energon, including Dark Energon and Synthetic Energon, for use in weapons, energy systems, or even for reanimation of Cybertronians.
  • Cyberforming: Utilize Cybertronian tech to terraform planets, reshaping them into metallic landscapes like Cybertron itself.
As a bonus, your understanding of Cybertronian technology grants you natural synchronization with Cybertronian systems, allowing you to integrate seamlessly with any of their tech, whether mechanical, biological, or hybrid.
objects.title: Cybertronian Tech Mastery (Transformers)

addons.text: Through your knowledge of combining Magic and Technology, you are now able to draw upon the magical and magitech aspects seen in Go Nagai's work, allowing you to create things such as God Mazinger and even the Super Spiritual Alloy of MazinSaga. Furthermore, your knowledge has expanded to include the creations of the enemies of Mazinger, such as Dr. Hell, the Mycenae Empire, the Vegan Empire, and the Dragonia Kingdom, to name a few. Just as you are the peer of those who fight with the Light, inspiring Dreams, you are also the peer of those who side with Darkness, serving as harbingers of Nightmares.
addons.title: Dreams and Nightmares of Magic

addons.text:
Your Hot Bloodedness sings with Spiral Power, greatly increasing your affinity with it. This accelerates your own development, allowing you to use more of it with greater potency from the very beginning.

But that isn't all! Just as your passion fuels your Spiral Power, it also mixes with Photonic Power, allowing you to use Photon Power without the need for a Mazinger. Additionally, this combination bolsters your physical body and extends your lifespan even further. This synergy will enable you to replicate the signature attacks of Mazinger, Gurren Lagann, and any other mecha you have in your possession using this Mazin Spiral Power.

Naturally, this mixture of Photon Power and Spiral Power extends to your mecha. Adding Spiral Power to a Photon-Powered machine will allow it to naturally evolve and gain new special attacks, though nothing that you couldn't create within a year. However, these evolutions are aimed at overcoming the current crisis and cannot escalate further. On the other hand, adding Photon Power to a Spiral-Powered machine will grant it greater physical ability and require less Spiral Power for powerful attacks to last longer in fights or to end them quickly.
addons.title: The Light of the Future!

objects.text:
With a flash of light, inspiration comes to you like a half-remembered dream, and with it, new ideas and innovations open themselves before you as a passion unlike any other ignites within the heart of your soul.

You have become an intellectual peer to Juzo Kabuto, whose discovery of Japanium led to the creation of Mazinger Z, along with Super Alloy Z and Photonic Power. You are also aligned with Kenzo Kabuto, who founded the Science Fortress Laboratory and created Great Mazinger in preparation for a great enemy in secret. With this knowledge, you are able to recreate anything seen, referenced, or hinted at to have been created directly by the Kabuto family, Photon Power Laboratory, Science Fortress Laboratory, and Kabuto Foundation, or indirectly as a knock-on effect of their discoveries and innovations.

But it goes a bit further: with some time to research, you will be able to replicate the technological wonders seen throughout Mazinger's original run and Go Nagai's other works, like Cutie Honey, Steel Jeeg, and the lesser-known Star ☆ Fleet. You can replicate their feats and synthesize any specialized material with common elements.

Within you is a hot-blooded passion that, when focused, can help you make great strides in whatever task you set your mind to—whether it's creating a super robot to save the world, defending yourself and those you love from the forces of evil, or even something as nebulous as being a better version of yourself. So long as you focus that drive, you could one day challenge the forces of Hell and face Gods.

Even though you can feel something greater just out of reach, rest assured that you would be a worthy addition to the Kabuto family and their allies.
objects.title: Dreams of a Flying Iron Fortress (Mazinger Z)

objects.text:
You have a deep understanding of the basics and concepts of Corru, and the technologies made from this strange material. You also understand how to develop, and nurture Corru growth in order to make use of it for the strange bio-technology of the Obesk even on planets not seemingly capable of nurturing its development. All you need to get started is a bit of biological and metallic material, and you could start a Corru farm practically anywhere. 

You have enough knowledge to create plenty of the technology shown to belong to the Obesk. From Golems, to Data Cysts, Qou bodies, artificial consciousnesses like Funfriend, and even devices such as the perception enhancing Timestopper. This also includes the material known as Sfer, an important building block and fuel for Corrucysts and other Corru technology. 

This knowledge also ensures you know how to adjust Corru technology to be accessible to non-Obesk species, able to create items like the Mindjack to allow others to make use of it.
objects.title: Corrucyst Technician (Corru.Observer)

addons.text:
You embody the beginning, the Heretical Mayo Lich. You embody the end, the Faithful Maker of Shards. You walk the path that Anaqi began, reaching beyond mortal limits.

Your Shards are now not merely crystalline supercomputers but soulful entities, infused with unique, intelligent spirits that transcend material existence. These Shards, imbued with souls, can shift between physical and immaterial states, phasing through realities while retaining their full capabilities. When immaterial, they drift through matter, bypass barriers, and interact directly with spiritual energies. They are extensions of your will, capable of acting independently and perceiving the world with a near-divine understanding.

You have gained the power to bestow souls with the abilities of Shards, infusing them with its crystalline power. Souls under your control, when empowered, can gradually evolve and manifest complex functions of Shards themselves—processing data, manipulating energy, and altering their host bodies by replacing flesh with lattices of reality-altering strength.
