What begins as a mere spark within them can, under your guidance, grow to rival even the mightiest of Shards, with souls becoming conduits for potent abilities that shape the material and spiritual planes alike.
addons.title: AnaqiX

objects.text:
As usual, Shards show their superiority

- Anaqi, The Maker of Shards

You have inherited the grand and revered title of Maker of Shards, once held by the legendary Veteran “Best Boy/Girl” Anaqi, devoted servant of the Great Goddess and witness to her divine Teapot form. With this title, you gain profound knowledge of crafting Shards—specialized crystalline supercomputers of unparalleled complexity and versatility. Each crystal is a feat of intricate engineering, a lattice of unique chemicals and elements arranged with staggering precision. These Shards serve myriad purposes, from data storage and energy capture to being invaluable structural components. Their sizes can range from the size of cars to entire continents, with the bigger they are the stronger their capabilities. Each of the supercomputers within these Shards, has unique energy patterns that they use to interact with the world in esoteric ways: manipulating energy, warping space, or interfacing with quantum fields. However, these Shards have distinct limitations. Due to limited resources, each supercomputer crystal excels only in specific functions and methods, with the best also being average in anything unrelated to their main specification. They require vast amounts of energy to operate effectively, meaning that they are both resource-intensive and vulnerable to interruptions in their power supply. While each Shard holds impressive power individually, it is through collaboration that they achieve their full potential. When networked together, their combined energy patterns align, amplifying their effects. The Shards become exponentially more powerful, working in tandem to overcome individual limitations and forming a unified force capable of complex, world-altering actions. These Shards are inherently loyal to you, their Maker. They seek to serve, aid, and protect.
objects.title: Maker of Shards (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text: “There was once a boy who sought to become a god. He failed. And in failure, he found the path to something greater.” You begin with technology from the year 2000—outdated, flawed, and crude. Yet failure does not hinder you; it fuels you. Every time your creations break, malfunction, or are decisively outclassed, your entire technological foundation—the very framework of what you can create—evolves. Like a vast and living tree, your tech base branches outward, expanding in unpredictable directions. Every failure forces new pathways into existence, opening doors that logic and linear progress would never allow. Your innovations do not merely refine what exists—they mutate, integrating the strengths of what surrounds them. Features from other technologies are not just copied but woven into your ever-growing design space, adapted, twisted, and made into something new. Each failure forces a quantum leap forward, accelerating at an exponential rate, pushing your potential beyond mortal comprehension. At first, the changes are subtle—improvements in efficiency, resilience, adaptability. But as your failures compound, so too does your progress. The further your tech base advances, the less it resembles anything of this world. The boundaries of science stretch, warp, and fracture, giving rise to devices that defy physics, machines that pulse with an unsettling vitality, and constructs that no sane mind would dare call technology. This is not mere invention. This is ascension. Your failures do not shackle you—they liberate you. Your creations claw their way out of ruin, reshaping themselves into something eldritch, blasphemous, and undeniable. And it will not stop until it has surpassed all things.
objects.title: Fallen Innovator (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
The Federation saw your potential and has shared all the technological insight and projects they’ve developed over their tenure. From their interstellar and planetary advancements from the Galactic Federation Marine Corps to their R&D endeavors, including E.M.M.I. (Extraplanetary Multiform Mobile Identifiers), allowing for expertise in researching and reverse engineering technology, with Sylux’s prototype armor and Shock Coil being a crowning example, approximating Samus’ Power Suit and Power Beam.

Conversely, the Space Pirates saw you as a great mule for their knowledge, deeming you the perfect vessel for their horrid experiments covering biotechnology, namely their ability to tamper with their genome to strengthen and adapt to different planetary environments, and space travel technology geared to ambushes and takeovers.
objects.title: Federation Made, Pirate Scoured (Metroid)

objects.text:
You possess an immense store of knowledge about the technology of the Great Diamond Empire, or the Diamond Authority. You have complete access to all theoretical and practical knowledge of this ancient empire and can replicate any technology shown or hinted at within the Steven Universe franchise. You are an expert on various technologies, including teleportation, cybernetic enhancements, starships, observation orbs, and any other marvels the Diamond Authority would have access to. 

Additionally, you have expertise in creating gems. You can produce any gem featured in the series, each with unique powers and abilities, even within the same gem types. With time and effort, you could create new, unheard-of gems that have never been seen or recreate the strongest gem type, a diamond. However, it's important to note that creating gems is disastrous to the environment and will gradually deplete life in the area where the gems are created.

Continuous depletion of resources in an area could eventually spread to the entire planet, leading to resource depletion and potential destruction of said planet. A normal Gem, such as Quartz, Amethyst, or Jasper, would do relatively little damage to the environment. In contrast, something on the level of a Diamond would do significant damage to the planet's environment.
objects.title: Homeworld Technology (Steven Universe)

addons.text: You limit to small scale uses of Ether energy has been removed, you can now create even the largest of Artificers and Mechons such as Siren, Ophion, and Aion. You can now with enough time and resources even recreate the true megastructures from Xenoblade such as the orbital elevator and Titans.
addons.title: Artificer

addons.text:
You now have the choice to transform into a Titan from Xenoblade, gaining the powers of both a Titan and your other chosen abilities. This fusion grants you the benefits of both selections while eliminating the specific weaknesses inherent to only one.

For example, your strength and size would increase exponentially, making you dozens of kilometers tall or you could harness your Ether production to fuel your abilities, removing the need to generate radiation or rely on finite resources.

Furthermore, if you are also an Aletheia, your Ether production also further boosts your magical capabilities of both yourself and your Terminals by acting as an alternative magical power system.
 
Simply put, you have become a living mountain—there’s no hiding that. But since when has a god ever felt the need to hide?
addons.title: A Living Titan

addons.text:
Your ability to summon blade core crystals has improved allowing you to now not only remove a lot of the randomness from awakening core crystals but also summon additional Trinity Processors. This means you can now create additional Aegis and Monado blades for yourself and others. 
 
Additionally, your starting Aegis has become the center to any cluster of Trinity Processors you create, allowing you to respawn any lost blades or Aegis with zero lost in memory so long as a single Aegis remains alive. 
 
However, because of the power necessary to create such a powerful reality warper means that you can only create an additional Trinity Processor (and thus 3 Aegises) every month. Also, Trinity Processors cannot be created piecemeal and must be summoned whole or not at all.
addons.title: Trinity Processor

objects.text:
You have unlocked in your soul an extra dimensional connection referred to as a conduit. You have also gained the knowledge of the smaller uses of this conduit and the Ether energy it generates such the ability to summon connections to this conduit referred to as Blades. Blades can take one of 3 awakened forms each with their own strengths and weaknesses. 
 
A crystal blade allows for direct manipulation of Ether through the body of the person wearing it. A humanoid blade takes the shape of a sentient creature with a weapon they give to their welder. Humanoid blades grow stronger not just from training but also the depth of emotional connection between blade and wielder. Finally, a weapon blade can take the shape of any weapon.
 
Through these blades and your new gifted knowledge, you can now create new forms of energy and matter manipulation referred to as Arts such as Battle Arts, Blade Arts, and Fusion Arts. These Arts can shape reality in a way indistinguishable from magic. 
 
However, you are not just limited to blades as you have gained the knowledge necessary to construct any roughly human sized technology from the Xenoblade Chronicles Franchise including but not limited to Sovereigns, Ether Gems, and most Mechons.
objects.title: Magic Through Science (Xenoblade Chronicles)

objects.text:
You have gained the combined technological prowess of Sebastian Wolfe and Kessler, granting you the knowledge of how to build any technology seen or hinted at in the Infamous franchise, from the games to the comics. This includes, but is not limited to, the Ray Sphere, the RFI, the Power Transfer Device, and the various things that Kessler has brought from the future that have greatly enhanced the speed of technological advancement.

With the Ray Sphere, you could grant people the conduit gene, exposing them to the radiation of the ray sphere that emits deadly radiation that mutates the human genome, granting powers to those who can withstand the fatal radiation disintegrating at the atomic level, those who cannot transfer the energy of those who are disintegrated into those who survive. Sometimes survivors of this radiation don't get powers but instead contract deadly plagues that mutate with no end. Those already possessing powers find their powers growing to new heights by activating the Ray Sphere and discovering new powers.

Most technology from the infamous franchise focuses on affecting powers by granting them, boosting them, or removing them. Now with your hands on this font of knowledge, you know how to alter powers.
objects.title: First Sons Inheritance (Infamous)

addons.text: For being one of our best consumers in the Vandelay ecosystem, and as an extension of our ‘Vandelay Techbase Package’, we will be giving you 2 very special gifts for no additional cost! The first is a fully functional replica of the companion of our company’s ambassador, the lovable feline 808. 808 is a robotic cat that can be more than just an adorable cutie, enhancing your attacks with numerous effects, such as shockwaves, beams, or simply more oomph to your abilities. She also works as a reliable metronome for any music you're playing. She is sentient, and more than capable of understanding you, so there’s always someone who you can rely on, in combat and cuddles. During combat, she can change into a spherical form that floats off of the ground for better transportation and is the preferred form when being used as a metronome. Speaking of metronomes, your second gift: Another easy-to-install enhancement, the very same given to our ambassador that once labeled him a defect, a specialized prosthetic core with an MP3 inside of it. After careful inspection, we were able to replicate the effects of Chai’s core for your own use! Using the music inside the MP3 (as well as any music you download into the core), the environment, no matter how rigid, will warp, move, and perform their functions to the beat, including you! Your steps, your movements, and even the way you fight is inclined to be close to the beat. When successfully attacking opponents on the beat, however, the damage you deal is increased by a noticeable margin, enough that it always feels satisfying and rewarding to you.
addons.title: A Real Rockstar

objects.text: If you're reading this, congratulations! You have been chosen to receive a copy of Vandelay Technologies’ entire database! …In regard to its technology and its applications, at least. Within this database (Which has been downloaded into your head) is a collection of all Vandelay tech, from products to top secret projects, and even some things that were forgotten and tossed away. From cute little creations such as 808 and the Smidge, robots that not only perform their jobs effectively, but also show varying degrees of personality and sentience, to architectural innovations along with any and all robot enhancements/prosthetics used in Project Armstrong, with some full body enhancements being able to break through fortified walls and extremely thick vault doors. This also includes the knowledge to create your own SPECTRA, an AI that is designed to be used to control anyone with a Vandelay prosthetic implant installed, as well as how to make an AI replica of yourself. You have also been given an (experimental) easy-to-install cognitive enhancement for free! This specific implant is designed to boost certain aspects of your intellect when in the development process for any and all technology you create, Vandelay or otherwise. When developing something that is designed/intended to make the lives of numerous people better, the implant should give you enhanced creativity and motivation by a massive margin, as well as a sense that will assist in ’Chai’ ’Loser’ ‘Idiot-proofing’ your tech. When developing something that will be made to benefit yourself or a select few people, the implant should enhance your sense of innovation and adaptability by an equally large amount.
objects.title: Vandelay Technologies (Hi-Fi Rush)

objects.text:
Ivo Robotnik is a genius nearly without peer, capable of creating mechanical marvels that leave the rest of the world at his mercy. Now, you are one of the few people who can claim to be his equal. You gain the same skill in designing and assembling machines that Eggman possesses. You are also an expert in harnessing different exotic energy sources, from small animals to power your robots, to reality-bending gems, aliens with exotic abilities, or even supernatural entities of godlike power.

You now also know how to make any of the technology seen in the Sonic the Hedgehog games. Examples include: a multitude of autonomous robot designs; a floating vehicle that can attach a variety of equipment; giant robots of various design, equipped with powerful weapons; massive fortresses filled with defenses and factories; massive flying battleships that function as production facilities and troop carries, and possess incredibly powerful beam cannons at their prow; machines that can convert organic lifeform into partial or total robotic beings, and back again; self-aware AI capable of improving themselves; robots that copy any power and abilities they see; dimensional and space travel; machines that can move planetoids; moon sized space stations; and much, much more.

Additionally, with time, you'll be able to reproduce the technology not created by Eggman as well, such as the alien tech of the Ancients or Black Doom. You are also an expert in building massive theme parks, to the extent that you could turn a group of planetoids into a sprawling complex dedicated to your own amusement.

Finally, you also possess the ability to grow a magnificent mustache if you desire.
objects.title: E.G.G.M.A.N (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
In the days of the Annunaki, much was understood which we lesser races have not equaled. In the times of the Second Republic, much was understood by Man that, in our benighted age, we have forgotten. At present, there exist alien races (such as the Vau) & barbarian nations (such as the Vuldrok and Kurgan) whose arts we of the Empire still ill understand.

But you have seen all this and more, for the Pancreator has given you the gift of knowledge, of all the sciences that have ever existed in Known Space. This includes powered armor, Fusion & Meson weapons, space dreadnoughts, Jumpgates, prana-bindu & Theurgy, the biology of powerful races such as the Symbiots & Gen-Warriors, nanotechnology, terraforming, Vau & Annunaki supertech, and much more.
addons.title: Guild Engineer (Fading Suns)

addons.text:
Greetings, my duke. Now, on top of the technology of the Pashidah Empire, its antecedents, and its successors, you have received the full technology of the Romani Empire, particularly that used to subdue the rogue province of Gerat.

The low infrastructural development and rough desert terrain of this province means that ground transport is difficult and time consuming, necessitating the use of large airships for most purposes. Your expertise extends to these airships, their design, their repair and operation, their weapons and systems (including their sensors, fighter complements, & nukes), the LNG infrastructure needed to keep them flying, & anything else that a tarkhan might find useful.
addons.title: Tanc A Lelek (Highfleet)

objects.text:
You are granted the collective knowledge required to create anything seen or referenced in the Dune franchise. This encompasses the material sciences used to create substances such as Plasteel and gel circuitry, as well as the biological knowledge required to create axlotl tanks and understand the various directed breeding programs surrounding Arrakis.

Along with that, tech based around the Holtzman Effect—a principle based on the repellant force of subatomic particles, and which allowed the creation of forcefields, space folding, and suspensors.

You also know the psychological science used to develop distrans, which allows information to be implanted in animals for storage and retrieval, as well as the knowledge on how to train others to become Mentats.
objects.title: The Holtzman Effect (Dune)

objects.text:
A Miraculous is an object that serves to empower the wielder, taking the form of a piece of jewelry or other wearable personal item. You possess the power and knowledge of the Sage who crafted the first Miraculous, allowing you to create your own Miraculi.

Wielding a Miraculous grants the user superhuman physical capabilities, a unique power and weapon - often related to the aforementioned power, and a transformation into a magical outfit with a theme based on the Miraculous itself. The outfit can be customized to a certain extent and is on par with heavy-duty armor in terms of protectiveness, in addition to being borderline indestructible, even when it takes the form of a skintight suit. Furthermore, while transformed, the user is equipped with a magical glamor that prevents others from connecting the wearer to their untransformed self. The glamor is so potent that the people will think up and believe the flimsiest of excuses and self-explanations to not connect the two, with only irrefutable evidence - such as literally transforming in front of them - being able to break the glamor.

The most interesting part of a Miraculous, however, is the method by which it empowers the user. See a Miraculous’ true purpose isn’t to empower people, but rather a method by which the Kwami - Gods aligned with a specific concept, who often happen to resemble animals in some capacity - can achieve a lesser form to interact with the world in a more stable manner. A Miraculous is made when one of the Kwami is bound to an existing object, granting them a lesser form, resembling a chibi-fied version of their true form. Activating a Miraculous essentially fuses the Kwami with their wielder, with the power granted by the Miraculous being related to the Kwami’s concept and the weapon and outfit being related to the Kwami’s appearance. When binding a Kwami, you can add stipulations to it, such as being unable to reveal their wielder’s identity or even being unable to disobey their wielder.

The Kwami themselves consent to this because just about every single one of them wishes to experience existence on a more personal level, although particularly powerful Kwami tend to have less human mindsets and, in turn, less of a conventional desire. See, in their unbound form, Kwami can’t properly manifest in reality and interact with things without damaging the world around them, and achieving a lesser form also grants them a more stable and balanced mindset, allowing them to properly enjoy life. Of course, their lesser form means they require sustenance to fuel their power, with most Kwami having favorite foods which often coincide with the foods consumed by the animals they resemble or related to the concept they represent, such as a Kwami resembling a snake liking boiled eggs.

Wielding a Miraculous requires a certain level of affinity for the relevant Kwami’s concept - such as a creative person being suited for wielding the power of the Kwami of Creation - although it is possible to force the usage without proper affinity, although this can negatively impact the health of the wielder. The power of Kwami is stressful on the bodies of those unaccustomed to magic, especially those who have yet to reach maturity and are still growing. Therefore, the power granted by the Miraculous has inbuilt limiters, both on how much power can be drawn and how long wielders can stay transformed after using their power. These limits loosen depending on how much power the wielder can take, so adults or those more suited for magic can draw more power more often. Wielders can push past the limiters with effort, although doing so runs the risk of literally burning out as their body falls apart from channeling raw divine power.
objects.title: Miraculous Creations (Miraculous Ladybug)

objects.text:
Sharpness! Channeling! Frost Walker! Minecraft enchantments galore, so many options, and they are all within reach.

To begin enchanting, you will need a three things first: An echantment table, Lapiz Lazuli, and the item you want to enchant.

To make an enchantment table, you will require a 0.75 cubic meter of obsidian or larger. Fret not, you have a supernatural ability to shape obsidian. It must also have diamonds embedded on or into it's corners.

Then you place a book on top of it. The moment you interact with the intention to enchant, it will become a full fledged enchantment table, with the book's words transmuting in Standard Galactic English, which you can perfectly understand.

Now that you have the hard part out of the way, you can have some fun. To begin enchantment, you must have the desired object on the enchantment table --it will float above the book--, and have the Lapiz Lazuli on the enchantment table. The book will present you with the compatible options you can enchant it with. Merely place your finger upon the desired enchant, and it will work it's magic in seconds.
 
You can also save enchantments by using a blank book. By enchanting it with whatever desired enchantment, you can enchant another object with it by simply having the two come in contact, given the enchantments are compatible with the objects. To disenchant a object, you must simply wish for it to go away on the enchantment table.

Do note though that you will only be enchanting at the first level. To increase the levels you can work with, you must have the enchantment table be surrounded with books. The more, the better. The books must have knowledge to it, like farming, smithing, swordfighting, anything in line with that. To reach the fifth level of enchantment, you will require 15 book cases. Not all enchantments can go so high. For example, Fire aspect can only go to a maximum of two, or sweeping edge can only go up to three.

Any item enchanted will have a purple sheen on it.

IMPORTANT: While you are the only one who can make an enchantment table, anyone else can use it themselves.
objects.title: Enchantment (Minecraft)

addons.text:
At any point during or after the brewing process, you can infuse your potions with mana to amplify their effects. The cost is equivalent to the average mana used to cast spells within a specified tier. 

If a regular speed potion lets you outrun a car, then a Tier 3 version could grant a portion of the speed to break the sound barrier. Furthermore, you could theoretically "mutate" the potion to grant adjacent effects related to speed. Such as heightened senses and reduced air resistance.
addons.title: Tier Potions

addons.text:
The potency and duration of your potions has extended beyond their normal limits, and it only increases as you climb to higher tiers. 

But most importantly, it's "mutations" become far more complex and nuanced, down to the most minor details. Even to the point of combining different potion effects into one. A simple potion could in theory, become a super potion that grants the drinker abilities akin to a demigod.
addons.title: Meta Potions

addons.text: The potion that is seemingly so powerful, yet counterintuitive at the same time, is something you can make. It will require all the ingredients you would make the original potion, but you can make it. Better yet, without any of the corrupted affects. If you so choose, you don't have to put every positive status affect on it, only a few if you so desire. Naturally, you wouldn't need as many resources then.
addons.title: One Potion to Brew Them All

objects.text:
Strength potions! Speed potions! Potions galore- Oh we did a bit like this already?

To begin brewing, you will need four things: A brewing stand, fuel for the brewing stand, a water bottle, and an ingredient.

A brewing stand is quite simple: All you require is a flat surface, and a... blazerod. Not to worry, you get a one for free, and gain an ability to make brewing stands with quality and ease, that even a complete novice can use, as long as they have the proper ingredients! And remember, only you can make a true and proper brewing stand, nobody else.

When you brew a potion with the standard brewing set, you can make up to three potions at a time without losing any potency. It only takes 20 seconds to make a potion.

The brewing of potions is also quite easy, as the brewing stand is the thing that matters. As long as you put the required items in it's positions, the brewing stand will do the rest. You also know all the recipes to make any minecraft potion.

Now do beware there will be some exotic ingredients you might probably won't have access to, like redstone, and ghast tears. Now, unless their are supernatural elements in the world you inhabit that you can use as substitutes, you won't be able to make majority of potions.

You will have odd little particles that will come from you that will vary in color depending on the potion. While this won't matter much, it's important to note for invisibility. Although that will only matter for particularly perceptive entities.

If you find yourself to have a status affect you do not like, simply drink a glass of milk!

IMPORTANT: While you are the only one who can make a brewery stand, anyone else can use it themselves.
objects.title: Brewery (Minecraft)

objects.text:
Through usage of iron, copper, or snow you can create a golem of the corresponding material. To begin the creation of a golem, you must have 4 cubic meters of iron, 1 cubic meter of copper, or 2 cubic meters of snow. By arranging these materials in the proper way, and then placing a carved pumpkin on top of them, you will create the appropriate golem. These golems are loyal to you and follow simple commands. They can repair themselves by absorbing some of the material they are composed of.

You can also create a wither through the usage of soul sand and wither skulls, but these materials are not naturally occurring in most worlds, and a wither created through this method would not be loyal to you.
objects.title: Golemancy (Minecraft)

objects.text: Congratulations! You've gotten a hands-on education in all the creation and innovation of all technology regularly seen in Nanotrasen's frontier stations, from the Antimatter, Tesla, Singularity, and Supermatter engines, plus how these stations in general function, to the innovations the boys, girls, and people of the Epistemics department can cook up, such as the anomalies that crop up in these sectors, all the various robotics one can learn of, bluespace dimension-altering devices, or psionic powers, or the crimes against nature that the genetics, virology, and xenobiology departments can puzzle out, like laser eyes, nanites that can heal you from critical condition, or diseases that can let you break past human limitation. That isn't to say that you're just on The Company's payroll. Not in this economy, no. You have a few dozen keywords programmed into you by the Syndicate, allowing you to access their extensive repertoire of gear schematics, ranging from Emags and Blood-Red Hardsuits to genetic modification that can turn an ordinary carp into a Space Dragon or a human into a changeling. That's to say nothing of the favors burned to get you intel on how the Wizard Federation manipulates bluespace to achieve their 'magic', the psychic phenomena manipulated by various cults, or the gear picked up from the Spider Clan to make you what's effectively a Space Ninja. Of course, having such extensive training in space-based matters, you know how to get a job done quickly and with the bare minimum of resources required, all the while learning as you go how to do it better next time. You could make a space shuttle in half an hour with just steel, circuits, and wires - given a day, a drill, some asteroids with a decent amount of materials, and a checklist, and you could probably 1:1 rebuild some of these stations on your own.
objects.title: In A Truck, Flying Off The Ridge (Space Station 13, 14, & Decompressed)

objects.text:
You hold the vast knowledge of Granblue Fantasy, encompassing the cultures, technologies, and arcane mysteries of its interconnected realms: the Skyrealm, the Moon, and the Astrals. This knowledge grants you unparalleled insight into their unique powers and creations, as well as the forces that shape their worlds.

The Skyrealm is a tapestry of contrasting civilizations, where technology and magic coexist in wild variation. Some islands are simple medieval farming communities, while others boast advanced magical societies, robotic technologies, or bizarre innovations like roller-coaster-like structures. Among its marvels are the golems—mechanical constructs powered by rock magic or designed with a blend of machinery and mysticism, serving as guardians or tools in the realm's patchwork of progress.

From the Moon, you inherit an understanding of advanced machine cells—nanobots that form the foundation of their technological achievements. The Moondwellers developed Seal Weapons, dormant tools designed to harness and absorb power from Primal Beasts, and Automagods, immense war machines created to combat these entities. Automagods, composed of machine cells, are nearly indestructible and equipped with energy weapons, capable of rapid regeneration and incredible destructive power. The mightiest among them, Diaspora, once made up 15% of the Moon's total mass and was designed for molecular deconstruction to recycle resources. Its final purpose was to annihilate life in the Skyrealm, paving the way for Moon-dweller colonization. Despite their immense power, the Moon's technology remains bound by the laws of conservation, requiring finite energy sources to function.

The Astrals, on the other hand, crafted their power through magic and divine will. Their magic-tech ships can traverse space, time, and dimensions, sustaining themselves indefinitely until destroyed. The Astrals' greatest creations are the Primal Beasts, manifestations of ideas and forces bound to physical forms. These beings, designed to serve the Astrals, embody abstract principles and represent the culmination of their magical and scientific achievements. The earliest of these creations, the Archangels, were prototypes with cores embedded in their wings. Among the Archangels were the Primarchs, elemental embodiments of the Skyrealm, led by the Supreme Primarch Lucifer, a being of immense power who sustained the balance of Light and Darkness while overseeing the evolution of life. The Astrals even managed to bind fragments of the Sky God into Primal Beasts and rewrite history to frame Estalucia, the divine Seat of God, as their own Island of the Astrals.

Through this vast repository of knowledge and abilities, you transcend the limits of any single realm, standing as a force that bridges the worlds of magic, science, and divine creation.
objects.title: Astral Genius (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text: You have been given access to the technology from a rather… unorthodox source. To be specific, this power gives you comprehensive knowledge and know-how of any and all technology found, shown, referenced, or reasonably inferred to exist from the Adam Sandler movie ‘Pixels’. This does not include all modern-day mundane technology, but instead the technology used and/or developed during the events of the movie by either the Aliens or Humanity, such as spacefaring ships, light cannons, and most importantly, the generation and manipulation of Voxels (The 3D counterpart of pixels). Voxels are used in various ways, such as being used to create a variety of constructs, including sapient beings, converting other forms of matter into Voxels, using Voxels as fuel, etc. Any sapient beings you create with Voxels will have free will, but are very loyal to you, their creator. This doesn’t mean they can’t betray you, but it would take a fair amount of persuasion and/or bad treatment from your end to switch sides. These beings can shapeshift into different forms with great effort. Creations based on fictional characters who have different forms or appearances in their source material, such as Dracula from Castlevania or Samus Aran from Metroid, will have an easier time shapeshifting between these forms. Any creations based on fictional characters will have the personality and mannerisms of those characters. Finally, you have become a low-level genius in recognizing patterns and exploiting them to your benefit. When it comes to playing retro games of all kinds, your skill befits a World Champion.
objects.title: Game On (Pixels)

objects.text:
You are an accomplished scientist, proficient in the six core disciplines of science: Computation, Genetics, Structures, Terraforming, Physics, and Anomalies. On the universal scale through which mastery and knowledge are measured, you have attained the second rank of five. While these six disciplines form a strong foundation, countless other fields of study await your discovery.

Computation encompasses the science of electronic systems, including artificial intelligence, predictive algorithms, and quantum computing. At the second degree of mastery, you can create technologies beyond the current era, such as portable quantum computers and software capable of hosting and managing the entire web.

At the third degree, your expertise extends to crafting lifelike artificial intelligences and humanoid robots indistinguishable from real humans. The fourth and fifth degrees allow for simulating entire worlds—or even the universe itself—and the creation of matryoshka brains, vast structures designed for superhuman intelligence.

Genetics is the science of biology and the processes of life. At the second degree, your skills surpass human mastery: you can clone nearly any organism, engineer viruses, splice genetic material, extend lifespans, and create new organs.

At the third degree, you can bioengineer entirely new species, mass-clone humans, design retroviruses to reprogram human biology, and restructure entire bodies and organs. By the fourth and fifth degrees, you can create thousands of species in a day, engineer a race of superhumans, transform entire planets into bio-hellscapes, or seed the universe with new life forms.

Structures focuses on the science of architecture and engineering—creating cities, megastructures, and ringworlds. Even at the second degree, you can design marvels beyond human imagination, build infrastructure to support a global empire, and craft palaces as grand as mountains.

At the third degree, you gain the ability to create automated construction systems capable of reshaping moons, converting them into futuristic palaces or colossal spaceships. By the fourth and fifth degrees, you can construct entire planets, starships the size of nebulae, and faster-than-light (FTL) starroads. If you can imagine it, you can build it with time and effort.

Terraforming is the science of transforming planets and star systems to make them suitable for life. At the second degree, you can adjust a planet's climate, build artificial islands, and even turn barren moons into habitable environments.

At the third degree, you can design artificial planets with unique climates and engineer entire biospheres to fit your vision. The fourth and fifth degrees allow you to reshape entire solar systems, terraform any planet to support life, and manipulate neutron stars or black holes to suit your grand designs.

Physics is the study of natural laws and phenomena. As a second-degree master of physics, your understanding surpasses any human scientist. You can create artificial gravity, develop laser weaponry, enable extraplanetary travel, and lay the groundwork for a spacefaring civilization.

At the third degree, you gain access to faster-than-light travel, quantum entanglement, high-energy weaponry, and more. By the fourth and fifth degrees, your mastery allows for wonders such as solar-destroying weapons, galaxy-scale technological structures, and traversal of alternate universes and dimensions. At this stage, physics is fully within your grasp.

Anomalies explore the science of the impossible, where the laws of nature and physics break down. This includes phenomena such as teleportation, nonlocal interference, antigravity, and more. With anomalies, you begin with basic control over these principles at the first degree rather than the second, as with the others.

By the second degree, you can create light without an energy source, create floating objects without support and other minor things. At the third degree, you can generate spatial anomalies which allow for perpetual motion machines spinning in on themself for negentropic energy generation and wormholes.

The fourth and fifth degrees push these abilities even further. You can now convert matter and energy without loss, create entire cities within self-contained environments (such as snow globes) where people can live, and design machines or formulas capable of bestowing abilities. At the pinnacle, your knowledge transcends science, bordering on magic itself.

You will be granted access to a mental library containing various paths of study, enabling continuous self-improvement. Your growth, however, will depend on your effort and dedication. Every possibility within the realm of science can be achieved through your pursuit of knowledge. This includes all things that either exist or are hinted to exist in the CYOA that can be achieved without magic.
objects.title: Scientific Expertise (Ouroboros CYOA)

objects.text: You gain the incredible technology created by the Hero Foundation—and stolen by the Council of Evil—the ability and know-how to replicate powers, and then offer them for download online. So long as someone possesses the web address for the site you create—and pays any fees you charge—they may download any superpowers you make available. You’re free to make whatever pricing models you wish, from payments for short-term usages of powers to rentals of much longer periods. Do be careful not to price your ‘wares’ higher than people can afford. You also have an advanced level of knowledge of website design and programming. Any websites you create with this power will be well built and rendered all but unbreakable. This technology on its own offers no other powers, you’ll need to track down, study and replicate powers first—with devices you can build—before you can make them available. Powers are stored in specially designed ‘capacitors’ with each download siphoning off a portion of the stored power. Power-sets can be ‘parted out’ into individual powers, allowing one to potentially download Superman’s super-strength, without the rest of his power-set. Note: this power will be less useful in worlds without an equivalent to superpowers, or without an equivalent to the internet.
objects.title: Super.org (Hero.com & Villain.net)

addons.text:
Your expertise now includes the creation of Royal Trees, intelligent lifeforms capable of bonding with individuals and growing into powerful spaceships. There is no standard design or layout for these ships, as they are shaped by their own personalities and the personality of the one they are bonded to. You possess complete mastery over any tree you create.

You can produce first-generation tree seeds, which, once grown, can produce second-generation seeds, and so on. The first three generations of Royal Trees are sentient beings. Beginning with the fourth generation, the trees are no longer sentient, functioning instead as advanced power or computer units. Each successive generation has reduced power, but still serves important functions.

A Royal Tree chooses its own partner, refusing to serve anyone else without permission. Each tree contains an internal folded-dimensional space tailored to its chosen partner; the space can equal entire worlds complete with multiple ecosystems. The more powerful the ship, the larger the subspace it can support.

To enhance communication, the partner can craft a key from one of the tree’s branches and crystallized sap. Partners of Royal Trees enjoy extended lifespans, enhanced physical abilities, and accelerated healing.

Even the weakest third-generation trees possess enough power to destroy a planet. Their primary weapon—used for both offense and defense—is the Light Hawk Wings, said to be the bio-energy of the gods.
addons.title: Royal Trees (Tenchi Muyo)

objects.text:
There is Clarketech, and then there's you. You have an intellect equal to Washu Hakubi, a woman who taught various classes at a galactic university catering to the best and brightest of all the universe's most advanced scholars. Math, hard sciences, and theoretical fields—you can master them in weeks and then revolutionize them. You could disappear for 5,000 years and still be laughably more advanced than everyone else.

You specialize in space-time technologies. You can make a lab equal in size to a planet and then keep it in your closet. Create an energy cloak that blocks surveillance so you can literally close the curtain on anyone trying to spy on you. Worried about a time traveler killing your friend's mom and erasing him from the timeline? Just make a temporal net that will wrap around and stabilize him until the problem is solved. Your main rival builds a spaceship as large as a galaxy, with several solar systems held within it? You can make a normal-sized ship with more space within it, and then build it again in an artificial mirror dimension, also connecting the two in such a way that they can't be damaged unless both are destroyed by a pan-dimensional attack at the same time.

Not that you must stay with just that branch of science. You can dabble in gene research and halt your own aging. If you tragically lose your child and don't want to deal with therapy, just revert yourself to nine years old, destroying your sex drive and losing any maternal instinct you may have had.

This comes with a fish tank filled with a strange sea-based life-form known as Masu. Using Masu as a base, you can create a half-cat, half-rabbit creature with various small powers. These Cabbits can turn into crystalline spaceships that can lay waste to galactic empires, so raise them right.

You can summon a holographic computer at will. This holocomputer can summon energy and matter from dead or empty dimensions, letting you rearrange the atoms of this matter to create whatever you need, seemingly Ex Nihilo. It has Washu's entire database on it, from her time as a student to the creation of her daughter, waiting for you to peruse. This technology is capable of anything given enough time and experience. With enough work, you can even locate the collective unconsciousness of all life, then hack and decode the information held within.
objects.title: Greatest Scientific Genius in the Universe! (Tenchi Muyo)

objects.text: You have a natural talent and creativity to assemble fantastic creations out of LEGO. Yes, the “Children’s” toy bricks, used to construct models. Colourful, varied, and most importantly plastic. But the most broken thing about this? Is that you can throw a completed model to the ground—with the intent to activate this—and have it turn into the full-sized, fully realized variant of itself. Your greatest limit is the amount of bricks you can convert at once, you won’t find a fixed limit, but in general, you will find it difficult to convert into anything bigger than a large house in a day, without a lot of effort. But more detail in the build, and the greater accuracy to the minifigure scale, will see that the strain shrinks significantly. Trying to convert a model into something very powerful, such as an Infinity Gauntlet, would require a level of strain all but impossible to bear, requiring a model of such detail that it could almost be mistaken for the actual item in question. This power comes with several notable drawbacks, however. Firstly, this power is a purist, and only officially licensed and produced LEGO bricks are recognized as valid. This means that if you need a specific piece and LEGO doesn't manufacture it, you're out of luck. Next, the model must be easily identifiable as its intended subject to the average person. In other words, it needs to be clear what the model represents. Models based on established franchises have an easier time here. Lastly, this power has a significant limitation—it is not capable of creating complex life—no animals, no people, no AI.
objects.title: Master Builder (Ancient Legos)

addons.text:
You now have access to the technology found in the Super Mario Galaxy duology and the Super Smash Bros. series, including but not limited to: Dark Matter, the usage and generation thereof, the creation and nurturing of Lumas, Launch Stars and other such constructs, the Comet Observatory, the various applications of Subspace, constructs such as Galleom, Duon, and the Robotic Operating Buddy, the Subspace Gunship, among many other things.

<b>It should be noted that the handling of Lumas can become very disastrous, as they can grow up to become various celestial bodies, including planets and entire galaxies. Any attempts or decisions involving their creation and growth should be approached and handled with severe caution and care.<b>

<b>The handling of anything related to Subspace should also be approached with a similar level of caution to Lumas. You have been warned.<b>
addons.title: Cosmic Beauty

addons.text: With this Addon, you are now able to grow and create various living beings and other such things from the Mario series, such as Toads, Koopas, Goombas, and many more of the species found throughout the Super Mario series. You are given the knowledge on how to properly do so, along with the knowledge about any prerequisites needed for the production of these beings.
addons.title: Now We're Coo-.... Growing. Right, Growing!

addons.text:
Your maximum magical energy capacity is increased, now being on par with Kamek, the top-ranking Magikoopa and advisor to Bowser. Along with this, you have been given the potential to use the magic seen across the Super Mario series. This can be used in many ways, such as creating objects, summoning simple creatures, teleportation, divination, telekinesis, size manipulation, and countless more avenues to pursue. You are also given the knowledge to craft your own magic wand, which will enhance the power or decrease the cost of your spells when using it. How much exactly depends on its quality and the materials used in its creation.

You do not receive knowledge on how to perform these spells by default, but you will have an intuition that will guide you towards learning them yourself. When you’ve mastered the current spell, it will lead you to another, and another, and another, until you’ve mastered everything that Kamek ever knew how to do. Any other spells outside of Kamek’s repertoire will need to be discovered and learned on your own.
addons.title: The Magikoopa's Apprentice

objects.text: With this Power, you gain the comprehensive knowledge of the technology found in the vast majority of the Super Mario franchise. However, this does not include technology found in certain entries, such as the Super Mario Galaxy duology or anything from Super Smash Bros.. The creation of sapient beings, such as Toads, Koopas, etc. is not given/included with this Power. This does, however, include pieces of technology and magitech from many of the games and shows, including adjacent series such as Donkey Kong, Luigi’s Mansion, Mario Party, Mario Kart, and WarioWare. From airships that can operate in space, flying castles and warp pipes, all the way to badges with numerous benefits, the many types of blocks found across the Mushroom Kingdom, Power Stars, and the countless inventions of Professor. E. Gadd. Large cannons to launch people out of, race cars that can achieve ludicrous feats, sushi that makes the consumer grow to twice their size and empowers them, and much, MUCH, more. As a small bonus on top of this, you gain the skills and know-how of a world-class plumber, along with the skills necessary to bake the most beautiful and delicious cakes.
objects.title: Across the Rainbow Road (Super Mario)

objects.text:
Congratulations Engineer! You've been given all the knowledge from Motherbrain, and you don't even have to spend hours getting rid of your excess hydrogen! You also are not getting a free Icarus, but beggars can't be choosers.

With machines that can harvest, transport and refine resources by the tons in seconds, fully automated assembling machines and drones that can fabricate goods faster than you can blink, you will want for nothing.

Advanced laboratories can simulate complex theories and the transportation capacity to move things even between stars in minutes by bending space, which by itself would make you an interstellar power.

Of course, any power needs protection. You can set artillery with orbital range and energy shields to cover an entire planet. If you don't want anyone even coming close to your planets, you can also make an armada of Destroyers, automated ships with immense firepower run by antimatter to attack your enemies.  And if even that is not enough, you can also make a grey goo to self-replicate and send waves and waves of slaughter without end. Just be careful so it doesn't turn against you.

And of course, there is the end goal, the aforementioned Dyson Sphere: the power of a sun in your hands, enough juice by the second to run comfortably trillions upon trillions of minds, each in their own personal virtual paradise, and that is running on a low capacity.

With this power and enough time, you can turn humanity into a fully fledged Kardashev 3 civilization: the entire galactic energy output at your command. Just be careful when setting your factories, spaghetti isn't meant for the floor.
objects.title: Icarus Protocol (Dyson Sphere Program)

addons.text:
Now you can integrate exotic technologies, magics, and magitech into your creations with greater ease than before.

But the most incredible advantage is that you can now create energy engines that adapt to all types of energy. As long as you have analyzed and mastered the exotic energies before incorporating them into your creations. On the other hand, if you possess a power that has its own exotic energy, you can incorporate it without needing to analyze it.
addons.title: Adaptable Technology

objects.text:
You possess the technological culmination of magic and engineering from Knight and Magic. This includes the power that grants users the ability to use magic.

You have a decent magical power reserve, but just enough to work on your creations. It’s not a noteworthy reserve in terms of combat power; barely a dozen fireballs are enough to exhaust your magical reserves.

But your true focus is your ability to create, maintain, control, and develop technologies revealed or hinted at in Knight and Magic. From creating simple compact artifacts or firearms models to building powerful mechs capable of annihilating an entire army. You have a great talent for performing magic that is not too different from programming. You begin with a talent or mastery similar to that of an average technician, slightly above a novice but below a true master.

You possess the knowledge necessary to synthesize the substances and metals required to support your creations. Among these is Mithril, a type of metal that exhibits incredible properties, appearing indistinguishable from silver, but with magical power induced, it takes on a turquoise hue.

It combines the best qualities of each chemical substance. It has great malleability like solid gold, high durability and heat resistance like tungsten, high magical conductivity, high electrical conductivity comparable to silver, and if you extract all the magical power inside, it turns into liquid like mercury. Last but not least, its weight in solid form is like lithium, and in liquid form, it is like liquid hydrogen, both in the same gram measurement.

Next, we have the Catalyst Crystal. It is a type of condensed magical power derived from the environment, which provides a very pure state. However, due to its purity, it is somewhat untamable, requiring high competence in magical power/mana manipulation. Only elves can handle it more easily, as if it were clay.

When crystallized, it becomes a substance similar to iron with a celestial hue, but its most notable feature is its ability to withstand high intensities of magical power consumption and generation. Think of it as the very core of a nuclear reactor, which requires physical specifications to handle high levels of energy. Therefore, it is used as the core for storing, generating, and conducting magical power/mana at high energy levels.

These are two of the most important substances for creating mechs and their wonders.
objects.title: Magical Mechs (Knight and Magic)

objects.text:
You now have skills comparable to the legendary fashion designer Edna Mode, most particularly that of “Super”-Fashion.

You have a knack for designing (and making) an iconic Super-suit for anyone, one that can invoke emotion from those who see them. Perhaps they need to be considered dark and brooding, to strike fear into the hearts of their foes? Perhaps they need to be bright and vibrant, to inspire hope in a brighter tomorrow? All this is but child’s play for one of your talents.

Super-suits need to be sturdy, but comfortable, stab-proof and bulletproof, while still being able to breathe like Egyptian cotton, and even to be machine washable (that’s a new feature). Even the integration of hidden armor plating and discrete electronics into these all but ‘skin-tight’ suits isn’t beyond your skill.

The most important part of your work is to ensure your designs complement the user’s powers perfectly. There’s no point having a Super-suit, if your power turns you invisible, while leaving the suit there for all to see, now is there? Now, you’re up for that constant challenge, to innovate new ideas, new machines, and new materials to find new solutions in this never-ending battle.
objects.title: Super-Fashion (The Incredibles)

objects.text:
You gain complete knowledge of all technology from the Babylon 5 universe, spanning the inventions of both the younger races (such as Humans, Minbari, Centauri, and Narn) and the godlike First Ones, including the Vorlons, Shadows, and the mysterious First Born. This knowledge allows you to design and construct any technological marvel from their civilizations, from Omega-class destroyers and White Stars to Shadow vessels and planet-killing superweapons.

You can synthesize any Babylon 5-specific materials necessary for construction, including Quantium-40 for jump gate technology. You also understand the deepest secrets of the elder races, including the Shadows' hyperspace phasing, the Vorlons' creation of telepaths, and the First Born’s nearly godlike engineering feats, such as species-wide Transcendence.
objects.title: The Third Age of Mankind (Babylon 5)

objects.text:
You are a Type Indigo, or more simply, a cyborg—a seamless fusion of flesh and machine. You gain a piece of advanced technology perfectly integrated with your body. You may choose the type of technology: a quantum-chip brain, anti-gravity legs, or a high-powered laser arm—the choice is yours. However, your tech is strictly street-level in power. The broader its function, the weaker it is—such as synthetic muscles that let you match an Olympic athlete—or, alternatively, a single focus like a laser arm that can melt steel. If you have another tech-based power, you can use its technology, but it must remain street-level.

You are unique in that you inherit the strengths of both organic and technological life. Your body has an extreme affinity for tech, allowing you to adapt to newly transplanted technology with ease. Likewise, any tech that becomes part of you gains biological traits, adapting and growing just like flesh. Train, and your cybernetics will develop strength just like natural muscles. If damaged, your technology heals over time instead of requiring repair.

Additionally, your hybrid nature grants you minor resistance to both biological and technological interference. Your nature confuses possessors as they struggle against your machine-linked body. Likewise, any attempt to hack or infect your systems is weakened by your living body’s natural defenses.

Lastly, as the perfect convergence of man and machine, you gain technomancy. Just as humans can move their limbs intuitively, you can instinctively manipulate any technology you touch. But this starts extremely weak, arguably even worse than just manual operation. However, just as humans refine motor skills, you can train your technomancy. With enough knowledge and practice, manipulating technology could become as natural as breathing.
objects.title: Type Indigo (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You are a Type Orange, also known as an Alternative Scientist. You have an innate passion for all realms of science, which directly correlates to your talent in understanding them, especially when you wish to apply that knowledge to create compounds, contraptions and other such creations. 

This starts within the bounds of mundane physics, though certainly at a level enough to make waves in whatever field you choose. But sometimes, you’ll have an idea related to your passions or circumstances that you know isn’t possible, but it comes to you in such vivid detail that your passion surges, and you’ll have a hard time resisting the urge to drop everything and get to work. 

Despite logic and reason saying otherwise, these anomalous ideas can be made real by your hand. Tools that bend reality to achieve their function, animated inorganic material, games that directly affect the mind and much, much more.

These are effectively glitches in reality that this power leads you towards. This doesn’t come with any protection from your own work, and nobody has ever accused anomalies of being safe or predictable. However, anything that you successfully create will become, for you, a proper field of science that you can research, expand on and apply in a myriad of ways, and which can be connected to any other fields of study you’re versed in.
objects.title: Type Orange (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: You now possess all the genetic knowledge and scientific know-how of the self-proclaimed “evil genius,” Dr. Jumba Jookiba, particularly his expertise in the creation of the ‘experiments’—a series of creatures with a variety of powers designed to cause chaos and destruction. With time and a little bit of elbow grease, you can recreate Jumba’s numerous experiments—all 628 of them, to be exact—each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Eventually, this will lead to the development and creation of your own new experiments. Will you continue Jumba’s legacy as an “Evil Genius,” or will you use these abilities for something else? You also gain knowledge of a few of the more, shall we say, less ‘interesting’ inventions of Jumba, notably the Prison Capsules—pill-shaped containment units formed from a transparent material akin to glass. You also acquire knowledge of how to ‘dehydrate’ targets into small spheres—about the size of a peach—and keep them in perfect stasis until they are rehydrated. Happy experimenting!
objects.title: Experimental Creation (Lilo & Stitch)

addons.text:
The speed at which you innovate, refine, and improve upon your designs is staggering, even by supernatural or technologically advanced standards. To others, another version of their prior designs can take months, even entire years to realize or make possible. You? Mere days, a month or two at most. You advance through new ideas and discover more breakthroughs as if you were merely cataloguing your discoveries as you went, jumping from one new improvement to the next, like paragraphs on an essay. 

To go to war against someone like you is to face an opponent that always shows up with something new to the battlefield, an unstoppable force of improvement and technological evolution. For every small breakthrough your opponent makes, you have already gone through at least 10 different models, each further improving upon the idea of the last.
addons.title: V1000

objects.text: ’War no longer needed its Ultimate Practitioner. It had become a Self-Sustaining System. Man was Crushed under the Wheels of a Machine Created to Create the Machine Created to Crush the Machine. Samsara of Cut Sinew and Crushed Bone. Death Without Life. Null Ouroboros.’ ’All that remained is WAR WITHOUT REASON.’ With this Power, you have gained comprehensive knowledge of all man-made technology shown in the game DevilMayQuake ULTRAKILL. From the towering Earthmover to the humble Gutterman, you represent the very essence, the core ideas that make war… WAR. Autonomous machines that fuel themselves by drinking the blood of their enemies, an arsenal of various electricity/heat-based weaponry that shreds through flesh and metal with precision, solar technology that could power cities, virtual spaces containing endless combat simulations, the list goes on and on and on. From the Final War and the New Peace to the Hell Expeditions and the last dying breaths of Mankind, their tree of blood-soaked technology is yours to use as you see fit. This does not include any of Heaven’s inventions, such as the method of creating a Flesh Prison and its kind, nor does it include anything molded in the depths of Hell itself, such as the creation of Demons and S̵ ̴O̸ ̴M̴ ̶E̷ ̵T̷ ̸H̷ ̷I̴ ̶N̸ ̵G̶ ̸ ̵W̷ ̴I̴ ̶C̶ K E D. Lastly, you have inherited Humanity’s collective sense of ingenuity and innovation. A war that lasted for countless years, eventually rendering the Earth’s surface uninhabitable along with clouding the skies with ash and soot, has molded you into a one-man(?) R&D branch. Finding new ways to minimize, upgrade, or otherwise make your creations even more efficient in their purpose is relatively easy for you, a nearly casual occurrence in your research rather than grasping straws at the theoretical.
objects.title: ANTENNAS TO HEAVEN (ULTRAKILL)

addons.text:
Through your divine nature, you gain the ability to create Divine Constructs. These armaments made by your divine hands have the same property of purge defence reduction, allowing them to injure the invulnerable and slay the immortal.

Your Item Construction is raised to A-rank, which allows you to create anything from immortality potions that revert the drinker to an adolescent age or provide biological immortality to weapons and armor to golems and other forms of automata and homunculi.
addons.title: Divine Construction

addons.text:
Due to your talent in both Item Construction and Territory Creation, you have refined the Perfect Workshop, a space specifically designed for a Magus to craft mystic codes and other esoteric items. Whenever you establish a territory, it manifests as the Perfect Workshop.

Inside your Workshop, your Item Construction skill is effectively raised by one rank, or depending on the time and effort you put in, up to two ranks. While working here, not only will you find it easier to craft anything, but any item you successfully craft will be more powerful, efficient, or durable than normal. For example, armor crafted in your workshop would be lighter yet stronger, offering better protection with less weight, while a club would hit harder, delivering more force with less effort.
addons.title: Perfect Workshop

objects.text:
You are skilled in the creation of powered items, ranging from weapons of war to items for everyday use. Using your powers, you can naturally craft supernatural items—whether you're a mage enchanting golems, a vampire blood-forging weapons, or a psychic molding armor. You are adept at applying your powers to the manufacturing process, naturally utilizing them to create items.

Your manufacturing skill begins at Rank C, enabling you to craft average-quality items, provided you have the proper components and tools. You are naturally talented at learning and improving how to use your powers in crafting. With time and practice, your rank will increase, and the quality of the items you produce will improve. Without supernatural abilities, you are simply a decent but mundane manufacturer.
objects.title: Item Construction (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You now possess bioengineering capabilities that allow you to create all types of aliens that have been revealed or hinted at in the Gantz series (all its variations).

You also have the ability to transform others—or alter your own body—with the extraordinary traits that aliens have demonstrated throughout the series. This includes the possibility of creating hybrids or entirely new creatures using their genetic data and other sources.

Anyone affected by this bioengineering will be completely loyal to you, or you may grant them free will as much as you desire.
addons.title: Alien Inheritance

objects.text:
You possess the culmination and full inheritance of the technology that the Alien God bestowed upon humanity—technology that allowed them to fight and hunt alien invaders, or those that have been lurking for millennia.

You can create, maintain, control, and develop technologies revealed or hinted at in Gantz (all its variations). This includes the technological marvels that the Giant Aliens used in their attempt to conquer Earth, or any alien species with its own exotic technology.

One of the exclusive wonders of this inheritance is its ability to defy death itself: the Black Sphere technology, or simply Gantz, whose science remains mysterious and extraordinary. You, however, possess the secret of this technology within your mind.

It is capable of creating an exact copy of any organic entity—and even inorganic objects—provided their existence can be analyzed and understood. In doing so, it can create what are called Duplicates. Another of its abilities is the power to manipulate the memories of both Originals and Duplicates with extreme precision, without side effects or residual memories.

Perhaps the most iconic and recognizable hallmark of this technology is its weapons, which operate using compressed energy in an unstable state—known as Gun-X. When it fires a compressed energy projectile and it is absorbed by a target—whether organic or inorganic—it explodes. The explosive force is equivalent to a dozen fragmentation grenades, all concentrated at a single explosive point of origin.

Or the coveted Gun-Z, which manipulates gravity in short, intense bursts—no more than three seconds. Don’t underestimate it; this weapon is powerful enough to crush a battle tank flat like a tin can or reduce organic targets to nothing more than a puddle of blood. Impressively, it can fire a dozen times before exhausting its energy. The manipulated gravity field has a 10-meter radius and a firing range of up to 30 meters.

This is just one of the many examples of what the inheritance granted by the Alien God—in his boredom and indifference—can offer. The Duplicates will be completely loyal to you, and any creation born from this inheritance is automatically sabotaged to prevent it from ever turning against you.

Finally, this inheritance lacks the inherent weaknesses shown in the Gantz series. For example, the fragility of the basic suits, which had an upper limit of up to 15 tons of force, could be destroyed as easily as ordinary clothing if that limit was exceeded. Now, without that inherent weakness, the suit can withstand attacks of up to twice the original threshold.
objects.title: Gantz Technology (Gantz)

objects.text:
"No one would have believed in the last years of the nineteenth century that this world was being watched keenly and closely by intelligences greater than man's... Yet across the gulf of space, minds that are to our minds as ours are to those of the beasts that perish, intellects vast and cool and unsympathetic, regarded this earth with envious eyes, and slowly and surely drew their plans against us."

You now have access to the vast technologies drawn up by the Martians as depicted in H.G. Wells's "War of the Worlds". Dominate your foes with mighty tripods! Use the dreaded "black gas" on your foes.

Aim and fire at opponents to melt them with invisible heat rays. Tinker around with flying machines. Ride spaceships fired out of a Verne gun. Just be careful and take your shots lest you (YES YOU!) Fall prey to Earth's diseases and perish!
objects.title: Tripod Technology (War of the Worlds)

objects.text:
You possess the collective knowledge required to create everything ever made in the world of Akame ga Kill.

You understand how to create and utilize the technology behind Teigu weapons, which are forged from the essence of Danger Beasts. You can also replicate this process using other creatures with similar biology, such as magic beasts or sci-fi monsters.

Your extensive knowledge of Danger Beasts allows you to create Kraken Broth, the substance consumed by the Four Rakshasa Demons, which grants them the ability to manipulate their own bodies.

You are equal to Doctor Stylish when it comes to the creation and development of medical technology, including prosthetics, surgical techniques, biological enhancements, dangerous performance-enhancing drugs, methods for creating artificial Danger Beasts, and ways to maximize the use of biological materials in both artificial Danger Beasts and Teigu.

Be warned: the most resilient Danger Beasts may be able to persist within a Teigu and even merge with its user.

You also know how to create various forms of armaments, including melee weapons, firearms, armor, missiles, and bombs. This includes the techniques used to prepare rare materials such as Orichalcum for the creation of Shingu and Teigu.

You possess extensive knowledge of alchemy, easily rivaling the best minds of the Empire. This allows you to develop technologies involved in the creation of a Philosopher’s Stone, methods for producing artificial Danger Beasts, body enhancements such as youth restoration, and processes used to create Teigu like Demon’s Extract, which grants its user the powers of Danger Beasts.
objects.title: Might of the Empire (Akame Ga Kill)

objects.text:
Crystallized Law is a sort of "substance of existence" that naturally seeks stability, coalescing from its raw state into spacetime, baryonic matter, and all else, including stranger things with which we have no avenue of interaction. That which is formed from the substance of existence holds an existential pressure beyond its structured existence, sheltering it from that which would erode its rules or nature, and it is entirely willing to contaminate other powers—the substance of existence can take myriad forms, including information and patterns, which maintain that tendency towards stability.

A universe born of Crystallized Law is not just one universe. The original substance could not become a single perfect crystal of self-consistent rules, but cohered around a massive number of nucleation points. There are a vast but countable number of worlds with physical laws so different they are unable to easily interact with us, most unsuitable for complex life, but many are potentially viable as sources of energy, matter, space and time to occupy, and exotic variations thereof to someone with sufficiently advanced methods. With even more advanced methods, it is possible to artificially crystallize new forms of physical law.

Substances operating under distinct physical laws in paradigms where they can mutually interact tend towards stability, under Crystallized Law. You can have a variant of elemental iron that enables controlled energy-positive fission reactions in arbitrarily small masses of any element heavier than iron, and it will retain without spreading its distinct behaviors even if you cast it into an alloy with conventional iron. In sufficiently extreme conditions, matter and energy can be converted from one Crystallized Law paradigm to another, even partially: this variant iron can be used to produce more of itself from conventional iron in a supercollider, and its exotic fission weakly adjusts the behavior of atoms within a piece of metal until the structure itself is destroyed (e.g., melted).

With this power, you may assert the nature of Crystallized Law into anything your power touches upon, and in doing so, ensure that anything possible under Crystallized Law may be realized anywhere under your power. Moreover, you may train your body's natural ability to measure and manipulate the quantized reality around you until it is equal to any tool you could create yourself.

You are capable of codifying this power and all of its upgrades as teachable practices which you may share with others, and those you teach may teach them to others in turn, for good or for ill.

(The default stable configuration of natural law asserted by this power is guaranteed to be at least as permissive and convenient as the baseline physics of Earth Bet from Worm.)

(And if you also have Pioneer of the Stars, unlike the canon version of Crystallized Law, truly negentropic processes are explicitly possible to discover and actualize within the rules of  Crystallized Law, albeit with considerable difficulty.)
objects.title: Crystallized Law Universal Access (Chain of Isekai)

addons.text:
You have accomplished the impossible: you’ve breathed life into the undying. More specifically, your understanding of Protodermis has accelerated the Necrons technology beyond its previous limits.

Now, even the simplest of your weapons can manipulate elements in new and exotic ways, harnessing the knowledge gained from Necron Crypteks. This includes the creation of flames so cold they burn, shadows that can engulf enemies as if they were alive, and much more.

The combination of Necrodermis and Protodermis has resulted in a material that is not only capable of self-regeneration but is also highly resilient, even against reality-bending attacks.

Your Necron constructs have transformed entirely; rather than merely mimicking life, they have become biomechanical creatures, infused with elemental powers of your choosing. For example, your Canoptek Spider may now incorporate the Visorak Rhotuka spinner in place of a particle beam, granting them multiple abilities based on the subspecies deployed.

The process of Bio-Transference has also been modified. Those who undergo this procedure will find themselves in bodies that possess the traits and abilities of the Toa and the Lychguard, making them demigods of the battlefield with an inherent loyalty to you.

The most significant change involves the Great Spirit Robot. Not only can you expand its interior size using tesseract vaults—making it as large as a planet internally—but it is also equipped with Necron faster-than-light (FTL) technology. Furthermore, it is less affected by the lack of repairs due to the integration of Necrodermis throughout its superstructure.

With enough time and effort, you could even reconstruct the Webway or should you choose, you could even create a similar dimension.
addons.title: The Everliving legacy

addons.text:
ADAM sea slugs, a unique species capable of producing the stem cell concoction known as ADAM, which can rewrite the DNA of individuals, allowing for the manifestation of exotic abilities, from throwing fireballs to shooting lightning from your fingertips.

Well it would seem you've learned to cross breed these sea slugs with Kraata the driving force of the Rahkshi, with each breed has one of 42 power, at least that was before, now you have the know how to implant Kraata into an individual similar to the procedure done for little sisters but with the benefit of said individuals being capable of manifesting multiple powers without the onset of madness associated with species.

your volunteers will also not suffer the same effects faced by the little sisters, alongside a heightened resistance to the powers they themselves possess

At first, the subject will have one of the 42 different Rahkshi powers, but will, over time, manifest new powers and abilities.

These new powers based on ADAM and Energized Protodermis will allow for the manipulation of numerous elements and enhanced physical capabilities such as super strength, speed, teleportation, and much, much more.

(Do note the Kraata were originally invented by the Makuta, megalomania may ensue.)
addons.title: Rahkshi under the Sea

addons.text:
In the time before time, high upon the Golden peaks, you studied under the First Spinjitzu Master and learned the secrets of how he created his artifacts of power, such as the golden weapons, four objects infused with the golden power of creation, and each with one of the four elements of creation.


From his tutelage and the knowledge of the Great Beings, you have learned to recreate the numerous artifacts and technologies from Ninjago, such as Nindroids, the Realm crystal, the Mega weapon, the Elemental blades, and much, much more. Through the knowledge you have gained, you will be able to create new artifacts, both technological and mystical, that shake the very foundations of creation itself.

Be warned that such objects will be coveted by those who learn of the existence of your creations.
addons.title: Secrets of the Golden Master

objects.text:
