You have been granted a great honor, the technological knowledge of the Bionicle universe, encompassing hover bikes, adaptive armors, vast glimmering cities of Protosteel, the forging of Kanohi masks, and the secrets of Protodermis. You have learned it all.

From the Great Beings, you have also learned how to construct the vast variety of lifeforms found throughout the greater universe, from the industrious Matoran, the honorable Toa, the vast hordes of the Visohrak, the Brotherhood of Makuta, the Bohrok hives, the unspeakable Tren Krom, and even the knowledge to recreate the Great Spirit himself, Mata-Nui all of which have an in built loyalty to you, you have also gained the knowledge to recreate any future species into biomechanical hybrids utilizing Protodermis.

You have also learned how to manipulate the elements using your creations, be it through Toa tools, Kanohi disks, Ratuhka spinners, Zamor launchers or Great Kanohi masks, you will know how to utilize the elements of Fire, Ice, Water, Earth, Stone, Air, Jungle, Sonics, Psionics, Light, Shadow, Sand, Lightning, Magnetism, Plasma, Gravity, Iron, Life, Creation, Destruction, Space, and Time to create weapons and armor of legend.

You also have gained an understanding of how to apply this knowledge to your future inventions, from incorporating new elements into your creations to modifying your creations.

May their knowledge help you to bring Unity to all you create, to be more than you were before is your Duty, and your Destiny is to one day surpass even the Great Beings themselves, for that is the way of the Bionicle.
objects.title: Legacy of the Great Beings (Bionicle)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of the Jurassic Park and Jurassic World franchises, being able to create anything shown, referenced, or hinted at in the Jurassic Park and Jurassic World franchises. From extracting DNA from mosquitoes and bones to genetic modification and animal training, with your specialty being creating dinosaurs and other extinct animals.

As a bonus, you are a master of business, specifically theme parks. You can create extremely successful theme parks, always knowing what is trending and how to make new rides and attractions popular, while always being able to dodge lawsuits no matter how many people die due to your mismanagement.
objects.title: Life uh... finds a way (Jurassic Park)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge on how to create all the technology from the setting shown in the Ark series, all the way from primitive stone tools to the illustrious Tek technology. This covers a wide range of technology, including cloning, mind uploading and alteration, spaceships, terraforming, genetic alteration, and even ascending human beings into a higher form of existence as Homo Deus.

Additionally, your knowledge of various tech levels provides you with the knowledge of how to build the tools to build the tools to build the tools, meaning you have the means to bring about a technological revolution and aren’t screwed if you end up in a medieval world without advanced technology.

You also possess knowledge of how to synthesize the substance known as Element, although do keep in mind that its usage poisons the planet and it can have detrimental effects on living beings.
objects.title: Ark Tek (Ark Survival: Evolved)

objects.text: The works set in Unraveled Tapestry take place in a setting where Clarke's Third Law is the core tenet and the virtual and the real have fused so intimately as to make everything, effectively, act like cyberspace. And with this power you gain a mental database containing all the technological knowledge of the factions in the Unraveled Tapestry setting inhabiting the Milky Way galaxy & its neighboring dwarf galaxies, from the distant past of pre-spaceflight humanity & the various xenosophont species conquered by the Empire, to the incredible hypertech of the Empire at its zenith, to the many factions that rose in the wake of the Empire’s collapse. Additionally, this database also comes with flawless records & understanding of how all this technology was used and how well it worked (or really didn’t) over the course of the history of Unraveled Tapestry’s Milky Way galaxy, meaning you know the best way to apply Unraveled Tapestry’s technology in any situation and what issues to watch out for and how to deal with them. (Also, all the info, cognitive, memetic etc. hazards and weapons are all appropriately labeled and safely stored in specialized sections of the database in formats that won’t negatively and/or unwantedly affect you from just perceiving/thinking about them with this power etc.) (Read the warning labels and follow the proper safety practices to avoid suffering a terrible fate! in particular, trying to physically time travel or to make a novel/unproven hyper-intellect without taking the proper precautions is a catastrophically bad idea!) Invariant Technology Invariant Technology is the most intuitive and familiar form of technology - technology which relies on the invariant physical laws defining the unmodified universe. Because invariant technology does not require formatted space and extensive computational/metric-altering support, its cost is essentially trivial for all but the largest projects. Invariant technology includes highly compact and efficient fusion reactors and drives, antimatter warheads and torchdrives, sophont uploads, nanoengineered materials two orders of magnitude stronger than their naturally occurring equivalents, efficient solid-state lasers, coilguns/railguns, and other systems. Stable Technology S-tech, also known as stable technology or synthesized technology, is technology reliant on exotic forms of matter - monopoles, negative matter, cosmic strings, strangelets, and other oddities that are stable under the invariant laws of physics but for whatever reason are not naturally occurring except in negligible amounts. S-tech can accomplish things which were seen as impossible, such as traveling faster than light or withstanding the fury of the atom unchained. Metric Technology As Stable-Tech advanced in sophistication and precision, it was eventually possible to selectively and rapidly alter the properties of a space, which opened up a whole new set of tools for manipulating the universe. Metric technology is technology which only works because of editing local Architecture. M-tech is generally heavily reliant on having that substrate of programmable reality underneath it, and thus will often drastically differ in function depending on the hostility or lack thereof of the local Architecture. The applications of Metric technology range from the farcaster networks which link civilian populations together and permit them to travel from world to world in hours instead of centuries to the destructive capabilities of militarized voidcruisers, which can duel each other from lightyears away while traveling at multiples of the speed of light, shrug off nuclear warheads and kinetic impacts, and hide themselves from electromagnetism and gravity while finding and targeting enemy units with the exact same stealth abilities. Architecture Architecture weaves computational capabilities and ex nihilo power generation and transmission deep into space and time, permitting a polity to manipulate the substance of the cosmos like variables in a computer program. In doing so, Architecture seamlessly blends the virtual and the real into an indistinguishable gestalt, enabling space to execute code that drastically alters or even violates physical law. Space modified into Architecture can run programs that generate matter or energy ex nihilo, alter the properties of objects and matter, and change the physical laws governing that space. Architecture-enabled technologies have their own inconveniences and idiosyncrasies compared to invariant technology that relied only on the stifling laws of physics, they often require prodigious amounts of power generation and computational overhead.
objects.title: Metric Technology (Unraveled Tapestry)

addons.text:
Now you can integrate exotic technologies, magics, and magitech into your creations more easily than before, as if it were a perfect fit. But the most incredible advantage is that now you can mass-produce Luxon along with the wonders it brings. You can now create an unstoppable, growing empire.

From its bioengineering, you can now create colossal beasts with the ability to resurrect and all kinds of smaller wild beasts from various habitats. From its already existing technological base, you now have technology based on psychic power, such as Weiss.

The best part is that now you possess the mysterious method by which individuals from another world were able to transmigrate between alternate realities. This method can be adopted as a scientific, magical, or magitech technology. As such, you now possess a form of dimensional travel technology.

However, it does not come with enough knowledge to make such travels, so you can only travel blindly. If you have the means to understand the mysteries of space-time and dimensions, you can improve this mysterious technology through experimentation and research.
addons.title: God MobuSeka

objects.text:
You possess the culmination of technology before and after the war that occurred in that world. This includes both New Humans and Old Humans.

You can create, maintain, control, and develop technologies revealed or hinted at in The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs (MobuSeka). This includes bioengineering to create Elves, New Humans, Old Humans, Dwarves, and Semi-humans. As such, you can also modify yourself or others within the mentioned races. Naturally, they will be loyal to you, including the AIs that come with them.

Among the wonders are the Lost Objects and Magic. With them, you can create artifacts capable of commanding an army of beasts that obey your will, or perform magic that can heal allies in the midst of battle, or simply enhance your own body to levels of extraordinary physical feats.

You also possess theoretical knowledge of all types of bladed weapons, defensive magic, offensive magic, magic for other purposes, science-based objects, magic-based objects, and even magitech objects like Arrogantz, the Magic Flute, the three holy treasures, and more. Keep in mind that this does not grant muscle memory or experience in handling everything, only knowledge. You will have to learn, train, and master the inheritance on your own.

This benefit does not include creations outside of their original source, such as integrating Arrogantz with other exotic technologies. For such things, you will have to experiment and train the new additions in your creations.
objects.title: MobuSeka Technology (MobuSeka)

addons.text:
It would seem the vita rays used in your augmentation were substituted for T.U.R.B.O. energy. This has given you a physique like that of the proud warriors of Tachyon.

Your body is now able to generate and manipulate T.U.R.B.O. energy similar to Jim McGrath to boost your physical attributes even further, from crushing Steel in your bare hands to running up to Mach 1.

Unlike Max McGrath, your turbo energy is stable, and you are not at risk of exploding from too much T.U.R.B.O. energy, though excessive use will burn through your stamina.
addons.title: Soldier of Takion

addons.text:
Your Nanosuit has been enhanced with Ultralink technology, allowing it to shift between alternate forms based on your own capabilities and fighting style.

Your new Nanosuit is also capable of adapting to any unique energies you generate and incorporating said energy into your new forms, regardless of their origin.
addons.title: Let's Go T.U.R.B.O.

objects.text:
From the distant planet Takion, to the Makino Empire, and back to humble Copper Canyon, you have learnt the secrets of T.U.R.B.O. Energy, or (Tachyon, Unlimited, Radiant, Bio-Optimized) Energy.

You have learned not only how to generate this exotic and potent form of energy but also its many applications, from boosting and enhancing physical ability to superhuman levels.

From this, you will learn how to construct Connect-Tek and its derivative Steel-Tek, which is a form of programmable matter capable of forming almost anything one can think of, so long as you have a proper power source, which you thankfully do in the Various forms of T.U.R.B.O. energy.

You will even be able to recreate the technorganic symbiotic lifeforms known as Ultra-links, which can combine with just about anything, be it technology, a living organism, or even minerals. They will be able to quickly transform what they have linked with into a weaponized state. However, you can tailor this to your own design, such as having them form a suit similar to the one worn originally by Ja'em Mk'Rah.

With time, you will even be able to recreate the Alpha link, which was capable of ultra-linking with an entire planet while serving as the home world for Makino's Army.

(Note this power comes with all the Technology displayed and hinted at within the 2016 series and the live-action movie.)
objects.title: T.U.R.B.O. Technician (Max Steel)

addons.text: Your ability to create wondrous technology through sheer nonsense merges together, allowing you to create things that would rightfully terrify any sane scientist. You gain the ability to apply both the power of Ork WAAAGH Energy and the power of Imagination and the super science of the Kids Next Door. This fusion allows you to generate your WAAAGH! Energy with no limit. Though it starts weak, with every discovery and creation, it will grow until it eventually eclipses what a full-power Krork would be capable of. You are also no longer limited to making stuff from scrap held together by WAAAGH! Energy, but rather may make creations that run off of normal science typically found in 2x4 Technology. This allows your creations to become much more durable and start much stronger with the backing of normal science.
addons.title: Orkz Next Door

objects.text:
T - Technologically E - Exuberant C - Creations H - Homemade O - Originally N - Neglected O - Odds and Ends G - Gadgets Y - yields

You gain both the knowledge and ability to create 2x4 technology from the world of Kids Next Door, which includes anything shown or hinted at in the series. This technology is created using an unusual combination of super science and a kid's boundless imagination. This allows the creation of super technology using random junk held together with nothing but nails, screws, and plenty of duct tape. With this power, you can create all kinds of things, from weapons, armor, vehicles, which include land, air, space, giant robots, communication devices, advanced supercomputers, and even more esoteric devices. Such as devices capable of editing memories, and more. Do note that this technology can be rather fragile if made by random junk quickly, though that is not to say you can’t create more durable creations with better materials and a larger time investment spent crafting. Your Imagination and creativity are also increased to the levels typical of a Kids Next Door Operative who specializes in creating 2x4 Technology. You can potentially create anything with enough time, effort, and imagination.
objects.title: 2x4 T.E.C.H.N.O.L.O.G.Y (Kids Next Door)

addons.text:
It would seem you have found a way to combine the Transformational abilities of the likes of Zeta and Wing Gundam with the Biomechanical physiology of Zoids, from fusing Minovsky, GN, Ahab, or any other power source found within the Gundam Multiverse with the heart and soul of a Zoid, their Core allowing these fearsome Beasts to take on humanoid forms.

This also means that you can have Fuzors and BLOX Zoids combine into larger Mobile Suits; these combined Zoids are often able to generate more energy than they could alone, leading to the fusion being greater than the sum of its parts.

Should you choose, you could also hybridize Transport Zoids with Carriers and other such spacecraft found in Gundam.

Do note that this applies to all Zoids, such as the Gojulas and the Ultrasaurus, leading to a massive Mobile Suit.

Another unique benefit is the ability to more easily modify the MZD's (Mobile Zoid Suits) due to the modular nature of Zoids.
addons.title: White Devil Liger

objects.text:
It seems that you, my friend, are an expert in all things Zoid, including BioZoids, Fuzors, Organoids, and Wild Zoids. You have absorbed an immense amount of information while studying for this degree, mastering the secrets behind Zoid physiology, from cloning to the transplantation of their cores—whether natural or artificial—into biomechanical bodies.

From Wild Zoids to Organoids, you have perfected the organic aspect of a Zoid, enabling you to program instincts and personalities into their cores and even modify how an Organoid interacts with a given Zoid.

You have also unlocked the secrets to creating the biomechanical bodies that Zoid cores are transferred into, along with an array of armaments such as laser claws, energy shields, ice armor, gravity cannons, and even hell armor.

Most importantly, you possess the ability to create Zoid cores—the heart and soul of a Zoid—without the limitations often encountered with BLOX cores. However, you can still incorporate their combination abilities into any Zoids you create.

This is not all; it appears you have also become somewhat of an omnidisciplinarian by learning about all the technology depicted throughout the Zoids genre, as well as the secrets of synthesizing the unique materials found in the Zoids universe.
objects.title: Degree from Planet Zi (Zoids)

addons.text:
Your mastery of technology and magic now extends beyond the limitations of the Morphin Grid. Where once the most powerful of Morphin tech required a direct link to the Grid to function, you can now forge weapons, tools, vehicles, and other devices that carry the same power independently.

These untethered versions are stable, efficient, and safe for use by ordinary people, requiring no Ranger bond or special connection. Blasters, swords, and even simplified morph-tech vehicles can now be mass-produced and distributed. Though not as versatile or infinitely evolving as the Grid-bound originals, they retain remarkable durability, energy output, and reliability, putting formidable firepower into the hands of common soldiers, allies, or even entire armies.
addons.title: Weapon Master

addons.text:
Your mastery of the Morphin Grid has reached a new frontier: the Zords themselves. No longer limited to the Grid’s resonance or Morpher-linked pilots, you can now design and construct independent Zords— titanic machines powered by your own ingenuity.

These untethered Zords can be mass-produced to be piloted by any ordinary person, requiring no special bond or Ranger heritage. Whether they take the form of mechanical beasts, mythical constructs, or humanoid war machines, each one is a fully functional counterpart to Ranger Zords. Their power source is not the Grid but advanced cores, reactors, or hybrid systems of your own creation, giving them a stability and accessibility the original Zords lack.
addons.title: Zords Master

addons.text:
The Morphin Grid has chosen you not just as a Ranger or Scientist, but as a catalyst. You now start your adventure with a small stockpile of Morphers large enough that you can create a full Power Ranger team. These devices are not fixed in number and will randomly over time replenish and even grow, spontaneously generating new Morphers attuned to potential champions yet to come.

Strangely, you will also find your stockpile selecting and disputing previously non-existent Morphers to worthy champions, but in a way that does not decrease the number in your reserve, almost as if the Grid itself is echoing your efforts, multiplying your influence across realities.

Weirder still, wherever you travel to a new major universe, you will find a newly formed Ranger team having just emerged. However, they are not your soldiers, but your peers, their existence a testament to the Grid’s expansion through your presence.

You are no longer just a Ranger, nor merely a master of its technology. You are the herald of a new age of champions, a force through which the Morphin Grid seeds entire multiverses with defenders. Wherever darkness rises, Rangers will answer.
addons.title: Power Rangers Unlimited

objects.text:
You are now the undisputed master of Morphin Grid technology, surpassing even the greatest minds who have studied it, such as Billy Cranston, Doctor K, and Mesogog. Furthermore, your brilliance is not limited to theory, but also the spiritual, with you standing as a peer in knowledge and ingenuity to even the legendary Tommy Oliver himself.

With your knowledge, you can design, construct, and refine virtually any piece of technology ever hinted at, referenced, or displayed in the various Power Rangers shows, movies, and comics. This includes—but is not limited to—Morphers, Zords, advanced weaponry, starships, robots, artificial intelligences, and even devices that blur the line between science and sorcery. Magic-fueled tools, hybrid constructs, and pure Grid-powered inventions are all within your grasp.

However, mastery over the Grid does not mean effortless omnipotence. As with the Rangers themselves, accessing the full potential of your creations will often require a strong personal connection to the Morphin Grid. You will find that those without it won’t be able to use your most powerful technologies. Fortunately, your expertise also extends to forging the very conduits and catalysts that enable the beginning of such bonds—Zeo Crystals, Dino Gems, Raptors, and countless other rare materials necessary for channeling the Grid’s power.
objects.title: Morphin Grid (Power Rangers)

objects.text:
You now possess the knowledge of the technology of the Phantasy Star franchise. Chief among these is the knowledge of and ability to harness Photons, a special light particle that exists throughout the entirety of the universe, and which is the basis of the technology and abilities shown throughout the franchise.

The technology used throughout the franchise is both broad in scope and highly varied, ranging from simple photon-based weaponry in both melee and ranged forms, the line shield technology (sometimes called shieldweave) that allows for even basic clothing to have the protective values of advanced heavy armor, photon-based communication devices such as the Visiphone, holographic and hard-light computing systems and advanced computing technology, mecha of all types, cyborg and robotic body templates and mind uploading technology to go with, and all manner of spacecraft, from simple interplanetary shuttles to the full-up fleet vessels and space stations for long-term colonization efforts. Other technologies not included here exist as well.

 Also included as a freebie is a refined and streamlined version of the Nano-transformer storage system (oft referred to as a nanotranser) that utilizes all of the known micro- and sub-dimensional storage technologies (in the franchise only, you munchkins), in the form of a pre-made blueprint to get you started.

Do note that Photons are known to resonate strongly with the “spirit” of the user, even through technology, with stronger spirits producing greater amounts of power. The exact mechanics of this are intentionally left vague, but it is assumed that all photon-based technology you build functions to a minimum set standard.
objects.title: Phantastic Photons (Phantasy Star)

objects.text: You have gained the technological knowledge of Stan Country, the most technologically advanced country in the world of Scissor Seven, populated by people who are extremely intelligent but physically weak. You can design, engineer, and construct any technology showcased, mentioned, or even subtly alluded to within the lore of Stan Country. From intricate weaponry and communication systems, advanced energy manipulation and robotics, to an anti-superpower wave and a personalized "death mode". Not only that, but you can design and build new devices, modify existing ones, and develop innovative strategies to overcome your opponents, ala the Prince of Stan, only limited by your imagination and materials. As an example, you could build a highly advanced machine that could harvest an island's rare crystals and have missiles capable of easily destroying said island, yet have no trouble adapting the aforementioned machine into perfectly harvesting the rare crystals without destroying the island.
objects.title: Heir of Stan (Scissor Seven)

objects.text:
You have gained access to the tech base of both the Trans-Govs (especially Alterra) and the Architects from the Subnautica & Natural Selection franchises, allowing you to replicate and improve upon any technology shown or referenced in the games.

From the Trans-Govs, you have gained fabricators, scanners, habitat builders, stasis rifles, Frontiersman weaponry, vehicles, exosuits, rapid deployment command centers and manufactories, repair and build tools, power nodes and resource extractors, starships, AI, robots (like the MACs, BMACs, ARCs, & automated sentries), teleportation and phase gates, cloning and memory storage (effectively allowing those KIA to "respawn"), jetpacks, personal nano-shields, catalyst packs that make the user faster and stronger, Kharaa biology, and much more.

The knowledge of the Architects grants you advanced construction materials, ion batteries, biotech, portals, doomsday weapons, and planetary defense systems. This is just the tip of the iceberg.

To complement your knowledge, you also gain the engineering and survival skills of the protagonist from the first Subnautica, as well as the versatile training of a TSF Frontiersman from Natural Selection 2.
objects.title: Frontier Spirit (Subnautica/Natural Selection)

objects.text:
You can create anything shown or referenced in the TV series, Generator Rex.

This includes the weapons and armor technology used by Providence, such as E.V.O. blasters, standard Providence armor, Agent Six’s weapons, and White Knight’s Power Armor. You can also create the technology for bases and ships, including Providence's "Helicarrier," stealth cycles, and the Space Elevator, as well as the AI technology used to program ZAG-RS.

Your knowledge of exotic physics allows you to create technology for dimensional travel, force fields, subspace engines, and time travel.

You also know how to create various forms of medical and biotech, particularly as they concern nanites, but also non-nanite cybernetics.

This does not grant you knowledge of how to create the Meta-Nanites or knowledge of the Dominion Code.
objects.title: Providence Index (Generator Rex)

addons.text:
Mankind was not born naturally from some primordial soup; no, we were designed 110,000 years ago by The Uranos, and in you they have left their knowledge of Biotechnology and Genetic engineering.

Your Guyver has downloaded the schematics for all that the creators left behind, from dinosaurs to humans and even the Zoalords themselves.

From Zoanoid genetics, you have learned how to create biotics capable of blending in amongst baseline humans, while retaining battleforms of amazing capabilities.

Next comes the knowledge of Relic ships, the ancient biological spacecraft used by the Uranos to seed Earth. You also know how to guide their growth to incorporate your own biological innovations and activate the genes that allow Relic ships to become like the Ark used by the Zoalords.

Lastly, your knowledge of G-units has merged with your understanding of Host armor, allowing you to combine the two to create living armors tougher than starships and able to fly using gravity orbs; even the mechanics of the G-units' hammerspace and mega smashers are not beyond your reach.

With this knowledge, may you do the Creators proud.
addons.title: Legacy of our Creators (Guyver)

addons.text:
Monsters are fierce creatures driven by instinct and bioenergy. With your knowledge of the Ancient Civilization and a comprehensive genetic database of all known monsters, your biotechnology has undergone a remarkable transformation.

You have learned to create new organisms by studying various monster species, including Elder Dragons and other unique monsters. Drawing inspiration from creatures like Rajang and Kirin, your biotech can now manipulate and generate electrical currents. This ability can be used both defensively and offensively, allowing you to unleash electric beams or even summon lightning.

Even the legendary Elder Dragons are now within your grasp. For instance, you have refined the blazing wings of Valstrax, the red comet, into biomechanical thrusters powered by draconic bioenergy. Additionally, you have harnessed Eruzerion's unique ability to control both fire and ice, enabling you to create biological siege engines that can freeze and burn enemies, causing thermal shock.

Most importantly, you have mastered the ancient process that enhances the physical abilities seen in hunters, allowing you to augment your troops with superhuman strength and durability.

The ancient wisdom you possess will push your biotechnology far beyond conventional biology. Furthermore, you can even incorporate other biological forms from the setting, such as mega trees and explosive slime molds.
addons.title: Savage Wisdom

addons.text:
Technocyte, once a curse of the Origin System, has become a powerful tool in your hands. With access to Technocyte, you’ve learned to harness the infection's unique ability to form advanced biochemical compounds, significantly enhancing your work in biotechnology.

Firstly, by manipulating various strains of Technocyte, you’ve discovered how to create bio-metallic compounds used by the infested. You’ve also learned to mold Technocyte to forge infected weapons, such as Synapse, a biochemical energy weapon.

Secondly, your understanding of the Orokin’s advances in biotechnology has allowed your Host Armors to incorporate the Warframe's unique ability to channel void energy. This knowledge has also facilitated the knowledge for the construction of biomechanical towers powered by void energy.

Thirdly, your insight into the infested hive mind, which spans the Origin System, enables you to create a psychic link between your creations. The scale of this network can vary depending on the amount of biomass used to facilitate hive transmissions, from a few feet to across galactic distances.

Most importantly, your biological creations can now operate in the vacuum of space. This capability allows for the development of advanced bioships, which, if properly shielded, can traverse the Void itself.
addons.title: Technocytic Revolution

addons.text:
You gain access to the biotechnological knowledge of the Precursors. This knowledge primarily centres on the creation of a giant, genetically engineered race of creatures designed for warfare known as Kaiju.

Kaiju are colossal beings, typically standing hundreds of feet tall and weighing thousands of tons. Due to their immense body mass, each Kaiju requires two brains to control its motor and cognitive functions. Bipedal Kaiju often possess multiple arms. Their physiology allows them to thrive and dominate across diverse environments—they can breathe and survive on land, underwater, underground, under extreme heat and pressure, and even in airless environments such as outer space. Kaiju are also symbiotic, often hosting large parasitic organisms attached to their bodies.

Kaiju possess a highly toxic biology. Their blood is extremely poisonous to both Earth and humans, contaminating any environment where a Kaiju is injured or slain. As their bodies decompose, the blood vaporizes, spreading toxicity throughout the surrounding area.

The Precursors clone Kaiju tissue from a single strand of DNA, “building” each creature by fusing the sinews and body parts of prior Kaiju creations. Although all Kaiju share the same genotype, they exhibit widely varied phenotypes, resulting in anatomical similarities across different specimens due to their shared cloning process.

Your mastery of biology enables you to enhance the Kaiju further each iteration, becoming larger, stronger, and more formidable than the last. You can also integrate new forms of biological weaponry and armour drawn from the organisms you study.
addons.title: Precursors (Pacific Rim)

addons.text:
You now have intimate knowledge of the biology of the various dragons that populate the world of How To Train Your Dragon, including those seen in sequel series like Riders of Berk, Race to the Edge & unfortunately The Nine Realms. You can even replicate the byproducts of the dragons without actually making the full dragon - i.e. Zippleback Gas, Monstrous Nightmare Sweat, Deathsong Amber, Screaming Death Scales, etc...

If you desire, you can instead receive a dragon's egg containing your partner, applying your skills to alter it in the embryo; limited to 3 modifications.

You also gain the knowledge & blueprints of any technology seen in the Franchise, including wrought-iron & wood prosthetics, Gronckle Iron, Hiccup's Sword, The Dragon Eye, and even advanced tech like force fields from the shows set in the future.
addons.title: The Dragon Eye

objects.text:
In a war-torn world where humanity must confront the consequences of its own creations, even the slightest contact with metal can be deadly. In this harsh environment, people have learned to manipulate biology in innovative and extraordinary ways, a feat made possible by Splicers like you.

You have unlocked the secrets of the Great Houses and their inventions, including host armor, war mounts, and bio rifles. Additionally, you have mastered the creation of gene pools, which serve as the foundation for developing new biotechnologies.

Your cornerstone is the Gene Pool, from which all your biotech is designed to grow and evolve. Over time, you can even artificially create librarians—tentacled brains connected to the Gene Pool that continuously research new genetic sequences to enhance your biotech.

Furthermore, you possess the knowledge to create organic counterparts to numerous mechanical technologies. This includes bio-comms as alternatives to radios, bio-organic thrusters, light cell weapons, and much more.

Your understanding of biology is dynamic; it expands with each new life form you encounter, continually adding to your repertoire of biological innovations. With time, research, and experimentation, you will be able to create truly miraculous organisms.
objects.title: Splicer Extrodinaire (Splicer RPG)

objects.text:
You gain the complete technological and biological knowledge of Slugterra, mastering every piece of engineering, weaponry, and bio-tech ever shown or hinted at in the series. You can build, upgrade, and innovate on all of the subterranean world’s technologies — from the iconic blasters and Mecha Beasts to advanced Slug research devices and Terraportals.

You can design and construct every blaster model, mod, and upgrade, whether crafted by the Shane family or Blakk Industries. This includes energy blasters, elemental variants, dual-mode weapons like the Sword Blaster, and heavy weaponry such as the Harbinger Firestorm or Quake Cannon. You can also produce and customize Slug Racks, Wrist Blasters, scanners, holo-gear, and even experimental items like Shadow Walkers or Tech Fu Controllers.

Your expertise extends to Mecha-Beasts, the biomechanical mounts of Slugterra. You can create, repair, and upgrade any model, from wolves and bulls to exotic or hybrid designs, including sentient or combat variants. With your engineering mastery, you can craft new Mecha-Beasts with unique traits, personalities, and combat specializations, powered by your own custom energy cores or Vitalis Crystals.

Additionally, you gain a full understanding of Slug biology and creation, allowing you to genetically engineer and artificially grow Slugs. You can design brand-new species with custom elements, transformations, and abilities, or enhance existing ones to evolve faster or reach new megamorph states. You may also create Roboslugs or hybrid techno-organic variants that interface seamlessly with your blasters or Mecha-Beasts.

Finally, your knowledge includes world infrastructure and Slugterra’s deeper systems — including Terraportals for instant travel, Slugnet data communications, energy generation through Turbine Hearts, and defensive technologies that can secure entire caverns or cities.
objects.title: Slugterra Techworks (Slugterra)

objects.text:
You gain complete engineering and xenobiological mastery across every Bakugan era, from the original Battle Brawlers through New Vestroia, Gundalian Invaders, Mechtanium Surge, and the Battle Planet continuity. You can design, fabricate, and upgrade all tech ever shown or hinted at: brawler gauntlets and scanners, BakuPods, printing and authoring systems for Gate/Ability cards, Interspace servers and arenas, dimensional transit to Vestroia, Gundalia, and Neathia, Vestal capture and analysis rigs, attribute-energy reactors and regulators, Battle Gear, Bakugan Traps, Mobile Assault platforms, BakuNano systems, and control frameworks for Mechtogan manifestations. In the reboot continuity, you can synthesize and seed BakuCores, forge Baku-Gear, and integrate Nanogan and Geogan interfaces, ensuring cross-era compatibility so legacy cards and modern cores work together without glitches or balance breaks.

You also possess the knowledge and facilities to create Bakugan yourself. You can grow, awaken, and evolve natural lineages and wholly new species across all Attributes—Pyrus, Aquos, Ventus, Subterra/Geogan analogs, Haos, Darkus, and Aurelus—calibrating G-Power/B-Power, ability suites, temperament, and evolutionary triggers. Fusion lines, Geogan constructs, Nanogan auxiliaries, techno-organic hybrids, and specialty variants are all within reach, including bespoke Battle Gear mounts and symbiotic interfaces. Your bioforges imprint stable cores and personality matrices that preserve free will while establishing an optional bond-link to a chosen brawler, enabling perfect timing for evolutions, mode shifts, and cooperative ability chains.

Your infrastructure expertise lets you stand up full ecosystems: safe habitats, training caverns, travel gates, Interspace arenas, and city-scale energy grids that keep high-output battles from destabilizing the environment. You can harden gear against chaotic surges and mechtanium overloads, patch dimensional tears, and refactor hostile tech into safe civilian use without diminishing performance.

As a personal edge, you develop instinctive brawling foresight: a real-time sense for attribute flows, Gate/Ability interactions, and field hazards. You read optimal lines at a glance, route energy cleanly through your gear, and never suffer misfires or illegal combos—whether you’re piloting a Mechtogan, deploying Battle Gear, or chaining modern core effects with legacy cardplay.
objects.title: BakuForge Architect (Bakugan)

addons.text:
Major, you've received a complete download of all examples of technology known to the TCR, allowing you some logistical freedom in the reunification campaign you've been assigned to, even in backwater systems like the Wayback.

This includes spacecraft, spacecraft modules, FTL gate systems, mecha, power armor, vehicles, novel weapon systems (like laser and plasma weapons, EMP guns, & long range indirect fire ATGMs), iterative improvements on the classics (like battle rifles, ARs, MGs, SMGs, autocannons, mortars, etc.), ramshackle pirate tech, the professionally made but last-gen tech of Wayback powers like Zayn-Beecher, The Backbone, DICE Of The Gods, or the Planetary Jingwei, the terrifying and inhuman cybernetic tech of the MENACE, and of course, the technology of our great Terran Congressional Republic.
addons.title: Terran Congressional Republic (Menace)

addons.text:
Your knowledge of robotics, biotech, brain-computer interfaces, & mind transfer has given you a scholarship to one of Mars' leading universities. Here, you will learn what makes the Mars of the 23rd century tick.

This includes the multiple types & purposes of robots, weapons systems like lightning guns, handheld AT missiles, & biotechnological tanks, more complete terraforming tech, the upload of human minds to robots, the alteration of human & robot minds (including skill transfers and memory alteration), holograms near-indistinguishable from real life, cybernetics, advanced transit systems, & spacecraft (including spaceplanes & generation ships).
addons.title: Noctis University (Mars Express)
Sold My Soul To The Company Store (Red Faction, Total Recall, Mars Tactics, & Mars Trilogy)
addons.text:
Out here on Mars, the working man answers to the big suits back on Earth, up in their ivory towers. Everyone's used to it at this point, but did they have anything to do with making this planet what it is today? Are they *really* why you can breathe the air now?

Well, what if things were different? What if the people who actually did the work called the shots?

With just the tech we have all over Mars, I think we could take power. We learned how to make demolition gear & vehicles from the guys in Red Faction, the mining equipment & memory manipulation tech we stole from Vilos Cohaagen & those "Total Recall" guys, the "Green Mars" terraforming equipment from the transnats, & the nasty military and police hardware of Capital, Ultor, The Commonwealth, or the EDF.

This is a revolution of the workers, all the workers, which means we've got our hands on even the most proprietary of proprietary designs. If you can think of anything those rich pricks have made here, or send up here from Earth, we know how to make our own. All we've got to do is secure a means of production, and we're golden. That's not even counting the shit we make ourselves, or that alien stuff the fellas on excavation duty said they found (you really think that's true?).

objects.text:
Stand tall, Ensign, you have every right to be proud. You have completed your technical training and you are now a qualified engineer of the Martian Congressional Republic!

You are now certified to create, maintain, and operate all known technology in The Expanse universe; this includes the famous Epstein Drive (and the many ships that require it), hand terminals and data cubes, vacsuits and power armor, railguns and other weapons (from personal to ship sized), drones, cybernetics, drugs (both medical and recreational), terraforming tech, the Protomolecule and the Ring Network, and any technology which humanity has mastered in either the books, the show, or the spinoffs.
objects.title: Martian Ingenuity (The Expanse)

addons.text:
You are a Student of Higher Beings! You know how the Pale King built his White Palace, how to craft Charms and Charm Slots, and even possess knowledge of the ancient Abyssal civilization.

And it doesn’t end there — no, you also gain the knowledge Grandmother Silk taught the Weavers, as well as the Weavers’ own Silk-based technologies, allowing you to create Silk-Based Lifeforms.
addons.title: Teachings of Higher Beings

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of Hallownest and Pharloom, their crafts, mechanisms, and designs, along with the wisdom to repair and restore long after the infrastructure and resources are gone.

While you could single-handedly keep a kingdom in working order, you also possess the knowledge to build anew!

From the kingdom of Hallownest, you can create a city that endures constant rain and water damage, public transport that requires no upkeep, and even buzzsaws capable of wounding a Godling.

From the kingdom of Pharloom, you gain the knowledge of the Architects on how to create sentient clockwork creatures, intricate tools, and complex machinery from the Underworks.
objects.title: Teachings of Menderbug (Hollow Knight)

addons.text:
Possessing both the knowledge of Vege-Genetic Technology and Morticultralist has allowed you to hybridize plants of the two, towards a much greener tomorrow.

With this, you could make things like towering sunflowers that generate enough sunlight to power entire space stations, pumpkin bunkers, laser bean systems to take out asteroids and enemy starships, and vege-suits armed with explosive wall-nut grenades, torchwood flamethrowers, and cattail homing pins.
addons.title: Plantpunk

objects.text:
You have gained the knowledge to create the various technologies from both Buzz Lightyear of Star Command and Lightyear.

With this, you could craft the various advanced and strange technologies of Star Command, Zurg, and Professor Triffid. This grants you a wide variety to always keep your foes on their toes, ranging from crystalline fusion, computer mainframes for galactic-scale processing, vege-genetic technology, dimensional shifting, time travel, and even truly sentient robots. Furthermore, this includes the unique addition of how to synthesize the more esoteric materials required to create some of the greatest technologies, such as fusion crystals, foolium, or even calendarium.

Finally, as a bonus, you have gained engineering and innovative capabilities on par with the LGM.
objects.title: To Infinity and Beyond! (Buzz Lightyear of Star Command)

addons.text:
You gain a complete understanding of the Soviet Omni-Sphere experiment, the hidden foundation of the Whispered phenomenon. With this insight, you can design and refine Omni-Spheres, stabilizing them into reliable, scalable systems far surpassing the Soviets’ unstable prototypes.

This mastery allows you to deliberately create Whispered rather than leaving their emergence to chance. Newborns can be shaped into Whispered en masse, but more significantly, you can now selectively transform fully grown adults into Whispered instantly.

Moreover, your comprehension of the Omni-Sphere lets you advance it even further: stabilizing the Resonance phenomenon, directing which fields of knowledge a given Whispered will specialize in, and potentially unlocking entirely new categories of future insight never seen before.
addons.title: Omni-Sphere Mastery

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create any piece of technology found within Full Metal Panic, from Electronic Conceal Systems to next-generation Arm Slaves, and even seemingly impossible devices like the Lambda Driver.

Every schematic, every system, every advanced or mundane insight generated by the collective Whispered is yours to call upon, letting you design and construct any weapons or machines ever hinted at in the series. The sole exception is the Soviet Omni-Sphere experiment that first created the Whispered.

Furthermore, you also understand and can reproduce the exotic materials and specialized systems required to make this Black Technology function.
objects.title: Black Technology Engineering (Full Metal Panic)

objects.text:
Now you will learn about all of humanity's technological achievements presented in the Tomorrow War series of novels and short stories by Alexander Zorich.

The list of technological achievements includes everything from genetic manipulation and industrial cloning to the production and construction of personal weapons and equipment, right up to interstellar warships.

Key interstellar technologies include: luxogenic engines for traveling through higher-dimensional folds in space; dynex chambers for controlling gravity; powerful thermonuclear engines and reactors. Luxogenic transmitters are also used for interstellar communication and transmitting large amounts of information.

Humanity uses lasers, rockets, and combined weapons with self-guided projectiles. The most powerful weapons are nuclear californium munitions used in rockets, torpedoes, and shells. Personal weapons are still mostly firearms, but they're powerful and often need a power suit. Laser and plasma weapons are also widely used.

Protective systems include armor made of durable alloys and a protective field that blocks energy weapons and radiation, but is powerless against physical attacks. The most powerful means are Nigredo systems, capable of transmuting matter at a distance and neutralizing nuclear and thermonuclear weapons. These star-ship-sized installations require significant power supplies. Personal protection includes power armor and spacesuits for pilots, allowing them to survive in space or hostile environments.

Modern technologies provide access to genetic engineering, prosthetics, and the production of the substance “senox,” which increases the body's resistance to overload. 

You can choose to train as an elite OSNAZ fighter, a starship captain, or a flugger pilot, the fighter of the future.
objects.title: Sfera Velikorasy (Tomorrow War, Zorich)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use magic, a scientific field discovered in the 70s by retired quantum physicist Suravaram Vidyasagar during a meditation exercise and more deeply researched by his son Rajesh after his death. Magic is a type of energy and a set of methods for manipulating and transducing that energy into other, more useful forms. Magic energy is called mana to distinguish it from the practice of magic. Physical objects can be used to channel, store, modulate, transduce and spend mana. Magical artifacts must be the correct shape and have the correct markings or engravings on them. These markings are long interleaving patterns. The chemical composition of materials is also important, liquid and soft metals as well as noble gasses are the best, but steel and other alloys are more commonly employed due to their ease of manufacture. Tanaka's world, also called the crystal palace, is a place that can be accessed by mages during their sleep or while in the presence of very high mana concentration. It is a desolate world covered in black smoky crystals where magic does not work. Instead, dream logic applies and it is possible for mages to conjure objects, reshape the landscape, and even teleport around through an application of pure thought. Spending too long in the crystal palace attracts the attention of eldritch beasts. It is not possible to wake up from Tanaka's help without external help. You start out with knowledge of magic equivalent to a master's degree with a dual major in in magical engineering and magical theory as well as several years of practice, which provides you with a solid understanding of magic and the ability to use it proficiently. You know how to bind a true name to yourself. You are certified for the use of high-energy magic and have an encyclopedic knowledge of the ISO standards that define industrial magic circles. You start out with a standard six-segment folding staff and magical tools in the form of jewelry, including several Montauk batteries, that allow you to cast a wide variety of spells. In theory, anyone on the same planet as you can access magic, they just need to figure out how.
Of course, the truth about magic is much more complicated. In reality, the system of magic in use by the majority of the world is controlled by a gigantic egg-shaped machine housed inside the earth's crust. The machine extends dozens of kilometers below the surface and leverages true magic and geothermal mana to create the effects of regular magic. It is possible to detect the position of the machine using a chi-oracle. The machine also functions as a recording device that monitors the whole planet for magical activity; the crystal palace is a backdoor into the data layer of this machine and allows access to the recordings. If you can figure out how to hijack the true name ra for yourself and gain access to the control areas of the machine, you will be able to use true magic and create fantastical devices such as the kara, a bracelet that is able to heal the wearer from even death (using the state recorded in the machine). With the right technique you can also bring objects and even people from the crystal palace and into the real word. There are no ghosts in Tanaka's world.
The deeper truth behind true magic is the existence of the Re Nonlocality Engine, a megastructure thousands of kilometers in size that exists at the core of the sun, with satellite relays placed inside the core of each planet, that is capable of arbitrary reality alteration through the use of quantum nonlocality. It can be detected with the use of a chi-oracle pointed at the sun and appears as a caltrop-shaped shadow. Ra and its satellites systems are the supercomputers that manage magic and simulate the existence of mana at the scale of the solar system. It uses undetectable nano-machines to monitor the world the use of magic. It is possible to gain root access to Ra, and thus unbound reality manipulation, by finding the master access key hidden in Tanaka's world, but doing so is nigh-impossible if one does not know where to look. This instance of Ra has not been corrupted by the Virtuals, not does it host their virtual realities. If you gain full access to Ra, you can create some for yourself and even upload people.
objects.title: Magic (Ra by qntm)

objects.text:
Welcome, User. You have been authorized access to the confidential technology of both ENCOM and Dillinger systems, namely their top secret Matter Digitization Laser technology, as well as the knowledge of how to recreate every version of the Grid in the series.

After doing research into the code of the Grid, you have found out how to create semi-sentient Programs that are designed to complete their functions, and these functions serve as the base of their personality. You can additionally both create and convert AIs to be compatible with Grid programming, giving them a simulated human existence.

Additionally, you have also learned to recreate the ISO's digital lifeforms that appeared naturally from within the chaotic parts of cyberspace. Unlike your Programs or AI, the ISOs are capable of evolving over time. The ISOs are beings who are capable of reproduction, similar to humans, with each ISO being their own unique individual.

Programs, however, are not the limit of your technology, as you are able to create and innovate on the vehicles and technology seen within the Grid; even technology taken into the Grid can be modified and upgraded utilizing Grid technology.

Lastly, your digital constructs need not remain digital because you have discovered a way to reverse the digitization process, allowing for things like light runners and identity disks to enter the real world. (Do note that the more advanced your programming, the stronger and more human your Programs and AI appear.)

Alongside all of this, every digital entity you create is inherently loyal to you, their Creator.
objects.title: ENCOM Classifieds: The Flynn files (Tron)

addons.text:
Normally, the creation of Magic Armaments, the liquid metal which powers your abilities, takes a great deal of resources and time to create, but you have discovered a rather nifty cheat that not only fixes that problem but also substantially empowers and increases your proficiency with Magic Armaments.

You have modified the Memory Metal Flask such that it now creates Magic Armaments metal while also keeping its wondrous properties. This new enhanced Magic Armaments metal is not only stronger than it would normally be at a baseline, but is also much easier to use and control. You can now create extremely complicated creations, both mundane and super technology, with much less effort.

The modified Memory Metal Flask now functions as a factory that allows you easily replenish your reserves of Magic Armaments, but also acts as a second way to empower it passively as you grow stronger, even without you putting in effort into improving the design of your Magic Armaments. Speaking of which, should you improve your Magic Armaments, the Memory Metal Flask will keep those improvements for any further created material.
addons.title: Memory Armament

objects.text:
You are a mechanically enhanced human who imitates Witches. You possess all the technology of the Mechanical Girls. By opting for Mechanical Ascension to replicate the talents and abilities of other species, you possess a Magic Armament hidden and merged within your body. However, this does not replace your body’s specs and instead bionically enhances them. As a Mechanical Girl, you possess control over technology and can interface with it.

You can create and improve Magic Armaments, a form of liquid metal that bonds with the user and can be altered to replicate the abilities of other species. It can also be used to shape itself into various machines. The more advanced your Magic Armament is, the longer your lifespan becomes. Through your Magic Armament, you can create templates of other species you encounter. By altering your structure to match those species, you gain their abilities. By replicating the brain structure of an Angel, you gain their ability to harness Faith. You can also record skills into miniature chips that can be implanted into the back of your neck, allowing you to use skills or magic installed on the chips. The better your brain becomes, the better your designs become, which in turn results in a better brain that enables even better designs.
 
You can manifest your voice of consciousness, allowing you to communicate with other creatures on a soul to soul basis. This exchange of information allows both you and the other party to know basic details about each other, such as name, birthday, and appearance. After doing so, you can ignore language barriers and communicate telepathically. Your voice of consciousness is an extension of your soul. Even while modifying your brain, you are still able to think solely through your sea of consciousness. Your consciousness is as strong as your willpower, and similar to Witches, you can resist death even if your soul is destroyed by relying on sheer willpower.

Unlike Witches, enhancing yourself through a Magic Armament is dangerous, often requiring great talent and careful planning. If you wish to replicate the brain structure of another species, such as an Angel, you must manually alter your brain using your Magic Armament. Because of this, Mechanical Girls often die due to a lapse in thought if they fail. In such cases, if you have constructed a Hell Gate or a Heroic Spirit Monument, you can revive as a fully digital being capable of possessing machines, or as a Heroic Spirit with all the abilities you had in life. Using a Hell Gate allows for complete and total resurrection, no matter how severe the death was, including soul destruction, total bodily destruction, or consciousness death. A Hell Gate can even revive a dying world’s consciousness.

You can create magical technology such as the Ending Requiem Spear, Hell Gates, cognitively altering concealment systems, mech suits, drones, and Heroic Spirit Monuments. This also includes technology capable of surviving multiple world-ending apocalypses occurring simultaneously, including, but not limited to, the sun falling directly onto you.
objects.title: Mechanical Girl (Homebody Witch)

objects.text:
You have gained the same potential as the Baker from Cookie Clicker. You are able to learn the entire technology tree of the Cookie Clicker universe, meaning you start with mundane modern-day technology, advance to mastery of magical spells, invoking deities, faster-than-light travel, and manipulation of antimatter and light, then eventually end with absolute control over time, space, and probability, universes contained in bowling-ball-sized spheres, planet-sized brains that can dream anything into reality, and control over the code of reality.

Each step up in technology will take exponentially more time, resources, and labour to accomplish than the previous one; early discoveries will require the resources of a regular large business, by halfway you’ll need at least one planet under your control to keep up with the demand, and endgame technology is the work of a multiversal empire. Luckily, each advance gives the necessary level of resource-extraction to make the next one possible.

As a bonus, you also gain the interpersonal- and business-savvy the Baker has, which is sufficient to allow them to get away with countless flagrant violations of environmental protection laws and labor rights and to slowly change the entirety of human culture to the point that within a few years everyone is obsessed with both them and cookies.

Despite how it’s used in its home series you aren’t required to use this technology for making cookies, if for some bizarre reason you want to do something else.
objects.title: The Bakery Grows (Cookie Clicker)

objects.text:
From the distant past to the far future, you have uncovered the secrets and wonders of wave motion technology, as well as the combined technology of all descendants of the Archelias, the precursors to numerous humanoid races in the known universe.

With wave motion technology, you can create not only the devastating Wave-Motion Gun—capable of obliterating an entire continent floating within Jupiter—but you have also learned to recreate the legendary Cosmo Reverse. This technology can restore life on a devastated planet, similar to how Earth was revitalized after the Biosphere was nearly stripped bare, and can even imbue a lifeless planet with vitality, as the Iscandaians did on Garmillas.

You have gained access to two forms of faster-than-light (FTL) travel: the first is Warp, which creates a wormhole connecting two points in hyperspace; the second involves Subspace Gateways, which form tunnels through subspace to allow travel across intergalactic distances, such as from the Milky Way Galaxy to either of the Magellanic Cloud's dwarf galaxies.

Another unique technology you have developed is known as dimensional submarines. These specialized vessels can shift between real space and subspace, enabling them to swiftly and stealthily attack enemies before they realize what has occurred.

In the realm of biotechnology, you can create an entire race of clones, much like the Zemurians did when they produced the Gatlanteans. Each clone is not only stronger and larger than a baseline human but also possesses a high resistance to heat and explosions. Furthermore, each clone can be equipped with a self-destruct feature to prevent enemy interrogation or dissection. You have the flexibility to tailor the genetic design of the clones for specific roles, including soldiers, tacticians, doctors, laborers, and more. You can draw on the genetics of any humanoid races seen in the series when creating your clone army.

Terraforming a planet or making a celestial body in the Oort Cloud habitable is well within your capabilities. You possess an instinctive understanding of galactic logistics, enabling you to transport an entire continent across the galaxy to act as a nursery for terraforming. You can also move sufficient resources across a galactic theater to fuel, supply, and arm tens, if not hundreds of thousands, of ships and stations.

Finally, you have the ability to construct the massive megastructures of the Archelias civilization, such as the Ark of Destruction—which is so large it masquerades as a gas giant—as well as future technologies from the Dezarians. This includes their Trans-Phase armor, the infinite ß cannon, and Mother Dezarian, along with their unique capability to transfer their minds between bodies through their bio-network.
objects.title: Wave Motion Warfare (Star Blazers & Space Battleship Yamato)

objects.text:
You can create advanced artificial intelligences for research, strategy, coordination, and technological development. These AIs can be designed to improve themselves over time, refining their own architecture and producing more capable successors. With enough time and infrastructure, this leads to a compounding technological ecosystem where progress accelerates with each new generation.

Once deployed, your systems can function independently. Networks maintain themselves. Drone swarms adapt to changing conditions. Factories adjust their own production. Rather than micromanaging every process, you build structures that continue to work effectively without your constant oversight.

You can directly interface with the machines you create. Through neural links, you can see through their sensors, control remote bodies, access external processing power, and split your attention across multiple systems. With sufficient preparation, you can operate entirely through drones or artificial proxies instead of relying on your physical body.

Given enough time, resources, and development, your technology can replicate effects that resemble other powers through engineering. Gravity-like manipulation, autonomous weapon systems, predictive engines, artificial telekinesis, orbital infrastructure, and biomechanical supercomputers are all achievable. Some creations can even imitate weaker versions of elixir abilities by replacing supernatural effects with advanced technological equivalents.
objects.title: Mechron (The Perfect Run)

objects.text: You have the ability to make Wings capable of granting the ability to fly. By default Wings appear angelic—feathered and white—but can have other appearances with little effort. Wings attach to the users back, and will shift through clothing and armour if necessary. They are controlled instinctively and intuitively by the users thoughts. Basic single use Wings can be created with little more than paper, and attached with wax. While better quality Wings can taken on and off at will, and shrink down to be discrete—and restore themselves when needed. You even have the ability to grant high quality Wings minor powers of their own, such as granting them the ability to shed light, turn invisible, or be used to shield the user from harm. You can grant almost any minor effect—about 5 SP at the maximum—so long as it is a power that affects the Wings themselves.
objects.title: Wingsmith (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
It seems you have gotten into a rather... whacky, form of technology. You have been given access to all forms of technology in the Crash Bandicoot Universe. From the creations of all four "N's" from Cortex to Tropy, to Emperor Veelo, Ebeneezer Von Clutch, Coco, and more.

A "basic" application means that you are now well versed in genetic mutation, especially in animals. Change a little anteater into a giant with a whip tongue able to smash through steel, a little blue bird into a being able to slice through the air like paper, and more.

You have also found yourself capable of creating vehicles, space ships, and other methods of travel with almost goofy levels of capabilities, like a motorcycle with immense suspension and speed, PLUS Space flight, a Giant mech that can convert into a spaceship, Biplanes and Blimps far more capable than normal ones in movement, and more.

Other applications of the technology include all Crash Kart racing technology, AI, Time Travel, Space Stations, Dimensional travel, etc.
objects.title: N.Sane Breakthroughs (Crash Bandicoot)

objects.text:
You possess the combined technological knowledge of all the baryonic races present in the Xeelee universe. From humanity's own god-like designs to the incomprehensible devices of the titular Xeelee.

With this knowledge, you possess near-absolute control over the space-time continuum. You can create materials capable of surviving energies of the Big Bang or handguns that can rip open a star, bisect entire galaxies with cosmic strings and use them as raw materials for your mega-projects, or even construct entire pocket universes with custom laws of physics.

You can freely travel through space and time using hyperdrives that can take you across the universe in moments, transport you to the deepest past, or the furthest future. Your mastery over time allows you to create stable time loops that would last billions of years and erase entire civilisations from history, even outmanoeuvring other time-travelling opponents.
objects.title: Baryonic Lord (Xeelee Sequence)

objects.text:
You possess the mastery of science that made Stardust a godlike being. You can create wonders like artificial lungs which grant the user the ability to breath under any condition, special gas which grants permanent immunity to heat or cold, a flexible star-metal skin which renders the wearer invulnerable to chemicals, electricity, or violent force, computers which can alert you to crime happening anywhere in the universe, and personal faster-than-light travel.

Most importantly you learn to create the countless rays which Stardust uses to do anything and everything, like turning invisible, teleporting, reading minds, shrinking foes, controlling gravity, reflecting damage before the attack has even been made, suspending targets in midair, even retrieving specifically skeletons of people the target has killed from wherever they are. That’s not even close to an exhaustive list; it seems there’s at least one for every possible use you could have. You have rays so powerful they could deflect an entire planet hurtling through space at more than a billion miles per hour. The technology involved seems to imbue the power of these rays directly into you, allowing you to manifest them at will without need of outside assistance.
objects.title: Interplanetary Science (Stardust, the Super Wizard)

objects.text:
You became a live repository of all the technology developed by humanity in the Revelation Space universe. From Conjoiners, Dermachist, to everyone else, you gain their whole repository.

To begin with, nanotechnology is incredibly advanced. From boosting the body and keeping it ageless and in peak health, Quickmatter being used in whole cities and orbital habitats to change their design in moments, keeping them whole and in pristine condition. It can even be used to enhance neural connections, from giving you skills, boosting your intelligence, allowing you to project your thoughts on others or even control them.

Bioengineering allows you to craft bodies like clay. From creating organisms from zero to uplifting species to fully human or anything between, crafting bodies that can handle pressure and cold from desolated alien oceans. If it is physically possible, you can do it.

In space, you can build huge self-sufficient habitats, automated to give every one of its tens of thousands of citizens a utopian post-scarcity life - or condemn them to a hell beyond their imagination. To travel, you can craft Lighthuggers, kilometer long ships that can accelerate to near the speed of light, powered by a pair of thrusters that run infinitely by accessing through a wormhole a universe where the bigbang never happened.

One of the most esoteric discoveries perhaps is the use of Exordium, a process where your past and future self communicate - from exchanging technological advancements to warning about future threats.

There is much more to what this gives to list: manufacturing technology, advanced computers, artificial intelligence, antimatter, robotics. This is a civilization that achieved much, and its knowledge is now yours to choose what to do with it.
objects.title: Exordium Repository (Revelation Space)

objects.text:
You have gained the complete magical, technological, and magitech knowledge of the entire Tales franchise, encompassing every system of power, artifact, and engineered construct developed across its worlds.

You understand the underlying principles behind artes, enchanted weaponry, mana manipulation, summoning systems, and the construction of advanced magitech systems such as the Tower of Salvation, Sephiroth Trees, and Lenegis. To you, magic and science are not disparate systems but expressions of the same unified discipline, allowing you to design and construct devices that convert ambient or internal magical energy into stable, usable power. Whether creating city-sized barriers, airship flight systems, mana energy weapons, palm-sized healing devices, planet-wide communication arrays, or environmental control engines, your work seamlessly blends magic and technology into a seamless whole.

Futhermore, you possess exceptional talent in weaponsmithing, armorsmithing, and magical production, allowing you to easily reproduce any weapon, armor, accessory, or consumable seen throughout the series. This ranges from simple items such as healing gels and stat boosting herbs to legendary equipment such as the Devil’s Arms, each recreated with complete functionality and abilities. You instinctively understand the materials, enchantments, and processes required, and can even improve upon them with the integration of other powers.

Beyond mere replication, you are capable of forming contracts with spirits, summonable entities, and other metaphysical beings, as well as replicating or stabilizing their abilities within artificial constructs. This will allow you to create weapons and devices that channel or contain such immense power, including relics on the level of the Eternal Sword.
objects.title: Blacksmith of Ancient Eras (Tales Of)

objects.text:
You have gained the combined scientific, technical, and magical knowledge of the Star Ocean series, granting you complete mastery over a style of magitech indistinguishable from both advanced science and spellcraft. 

You now understand the principles behind interstellar engineering, advanced computation, energy weapons, starship-grade systems, genetic engineering, combat androids, artificial intelligence, medicine, and the countless branches of item creation that the series is known for. This includes alchemy and smithery to engineering, crafting, and pharmaceutical synthesis. You are capable of designing, producing, and refining anything from handheld tools to planet-scale infrastructure and faster-than-light capable vessels, all with efficiency equal to or exceeding the greatest figures in the setting.

More importantly, you understand Symbology as a complete and formalized science that encoded magical properties and laws into reality. You can embed symbological programs into weapons, armor, machinery, environments, or even living beings, granting them powers equivalent to spells, enchantments, or other entirely new impossible functions. This includes the ability to artificially grant magical capability, enhance biological performance, stabilize or alter environments, and create hybrid systems where magic and technology are indistinguishable.
objects.title: Symbological Engineer (Star Ocean)

objects.text:
You possess complete technical understanding of Kivotos, from modern academy engineering to the systems of the Nameless Civilization. Relic technologies, forgotten infrastructure, and contemporary corporate hardware all operate on principles you fully grasp.

Given time and materials, you can reproduce and improve anything within that scope. This includes autonomous weapons, drones, sealed artifacts, and the large-scale platforms associated with the Prophets of Decagrammaton—their true bodies, whether fortress, vehicle, or mobile weapons system, can be built and operated as intended.

You can also design and support advanced artificial intelligences on the level of entities like Arona and Plana, including the creation of compatible bodies, support frames, and infrastructure that allow them to function in the physical world.

Ancient and modern technologies integrate cleanly in your hands. Relic components, academy equipment, and corporate designs can be combined into unified systems that remain functional, scalable, and reliable.

You are especially skilled at understanding sealed mechanisms, autonomous control systems, and unusual device logic, allowing you to work with technology that others would consider unusable or impossible to replicate.
objects.title: The Nameless Civilization (Blue Archive)

objects.text:
You acquire comprehensive knowledge of every piece of technology ever featured or mentioned within the Artemis Fowl series. From Iris-Cams and Neutrino Blasters to Artificial Wings, Time-Stop Towers, the terrifying Biological Bombs colloquially known as the “Blue Rinse,” and all the other technology of The People.

Your mind is flooded with the complete blueprints, schematics, and developer’s notes for every device that the tech-savvy centaur ever encountered. This vast wealth of technological knowledge is downloaded directly into your brain, allowing you to recreate, modify, or innovate upon it at your leisure.
objects.title: LEPRecon Archive (Artemis Fowl)

objects.text:
You gain the knowledge and practical skill to create, modify, and repair any equipment seen, referenced, or implied within Bloodborne. This includes trick weapons, firearms, hunter tools, attire, and specialized consumables, all built using the unique materials and design logic of the Workshop.

You can craft trick weapons with complex transforming mechanisms, allowing seamless shifts between forms without loss of durability or effectiveness. Firearms such as pistols, blunderbusses, and cannons can be produced and tuned for impact, stagger, and reliability. All weapons you create are particularly effective against supernatural and eldritch entities, able to harm, disrupt, and resist beings that would ignore or diminish conventional weaponry.

You are capable of producing hunter tools and consumables, including blood-based items, throwing weapons, and alchemical mixtures for offense, support, or utility. In addition, you can develop your own eldritch reagents and materials through alchemy, refining mundane components into unusual substances for crafting and enhancement.

Your craftsmanship extends to reinforcement and modification. You can upgrade weapons and gear to improve durability, sharpness, and effectiveness, as well as integrate rare or eldritch materials to grant additional properties suited for hunting unnatural threats.

As a bonus, your creations are stable for use. While they retain their strange and otherworldly qualities, they do not cause mental degradation or loss of control in the user under normal conditions.

You also gain the instincts of a Workshop hunter, allowing you to properly wield and maintain your creations, ensuring they perform as intended in combat.
objects.title: Hunter’s Workshop (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
You gain complete technical knowledge and engineering skill drawn from the full Spy Kids series. This covers covert field equipment, advanced miniaturized technology, virtual systems, reality-bridging devices, and temporal control technology. You can design, build, modify, and maintain the kind of tools normally reserved for the Cortez family and the world’s most advanced spy organisations.

You specialize in compact multi-function technology. Everyday objects can conceal advanced systems such as communicators, scanners, spy watches, encrypted computers, grappling devices, surveillance tools and infiltration gear. Your designs focus on portability, concealment, and practical field reliability.

Your knowledge also covers wearable systems and specialized vehicles. You can create enhanced suits, anti-gravity gear, magnetic climbing equipment, spy cars, compact submarines, miniaturized aircrafts, and other mission-focused transport platforms built for rapid deployment and manoeuvrability.

Your knowledge expands into gaining mastery over advanced virtual, reality-conversion technology, and temporal technology. You can build immersive simulation environments, digital combat platforms, remote interface systems, and software capable of operating within large-scale virtual spaces.
