More importantly, you understand the technology that can materialize digital constructs into physical reality, allowing virtual machines, weapons, mechs, and other programmed systems to be summoned into the real world as functioning hardware.

You can create devices that do not merely detect or react to changes in time, but actively manipulate temporal flow. This includes localized acceleration, deceleration, temporal synchronization, and controlled time-field effects for objects, spaces, or targets.

Beyond this, you gain the skills of a trained OSS field operative.
objects.title: Spy Tech Division (Spy Kids)

objects.text:
You have developed a comprehensive understanding of nanomachines and Earth-based Ceph technology, placing your expertise on par with the groundbreaking work of Jacob Hargreave and Karl Rasch. Although Hargreave and Rasch possess knowledge that exceeds most human capabilities, their understanding still does not encompass the full complexities of Ceph technology. You are capable of reconstructing any Ceph technology recovered from the Ceph invasion of Earth; however, you do not have access to technology from the main Ceph empire.

You can create any version of the Nanosuit featured throughout the Crysis series, including the ability to unlock the nanomachines, access its full potential, and remove the limiters typically imposed. Additionally, you can enhance the suit's design with new insights you have gained from other alien technology or their biological abilities, granting additional functions and modes for the suit.

Similar to Jacob Hargreave and Karl Rasch, you also have talent for reverse-engineering advanced alien technology, and the same talent they had for increasing the quality of any technology reverse-engineered, making any reverse-engineered technology far more advanced than the original ever was. Just from seeing the barest hints of the technology, you could begin to successfully make prototypes that create from the concepts you have learned from alien technology.

We are now living in the age of augmented cybernetic super soldiers and dead men walking.
objects.title: Crynet Systems (Crysis)

objects.text:
You have access to the various technology that comes with being a spy; you could make technology that would usually fit into a whole room into the size of a pen, create programs that can track down every person in the world and create a probability matrix of how likely they are to be a criminal, create realistic face masks that can fool even the most technologically advanced scanners, create automatic lockpicking devices, weapons of mass destruction, undetectable spy planes, surveillance drones, and so much more. 

You have the skills to create a brand-new agency, a rogue nation, or a consortium of spies capable of running the world behind the scenes. This knowledge will not protect you from the fallout of discovering an agency you built, but it will give you the skills to both run and train recruits. You could match the likes of Ethan Hunt, Jason Bourne, and James Bond, to name a few, in the tradecraft of a spy. You can be either a great force of good or evil, an agent of chaos or an agent of order. 

You also have access to the technology of every spy movie or novel, including the likes of Mission Impossible, James Bond, Kingsman, the various works of Tom Clancy, and just about any series in the spy thriller genre, so long as it is science fiction and not fantasy; no magic for you.
objects.title: A Mission Impossible (Mission Impossible/James Bond/Kingsman)

objects.text:
You have the ability to construct all of the technology from the universe of The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy. This includes quite a wealth of unique options, including the Finite and Infinite Improbability Drives, the field of Bistromathics, the discipline of how the value of numbers changes as the observer moves through restaurants, which can be used to warp the laws of mathematics and physics in a way even the Infinite Improbability Drive cannot, the principles of the Somebody Else’s Problem Field, which makes a thing too bizarre to be the observer’s responsibility to deal with causing it to be dismissed and forgotten about or displaces any fact or onto Somebody Else and negate it’s effect on an individual, even if that information is “there is no gravity or oxygen here”.

You can make advanced computers like Deep Thought and Earth, weapons like those used by the inhabitants of Krikkit, capable of destroying even stars or, through the Ultimate Weapon, potentially the entire universe, and your own Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy with all information included, or even the Mark II Guide which is an omniscient reality warper (with an ego to match, so watch out). There is, of course, even more if you’re interested.

And if you want a cup of tea, you can make a machine that produces a liquid which is almost, but not quite, entirely unlike tea.
objects.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy(‘s Technology) (The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy)

objects.text: In your mind, there is an extensive library of technological knowledge obtained through the centuries both by AI TechnoCore and various human groups such as the Hegemony of Man, the Templars, the Ousters, and the Pax. This includes, among other things, various forms of faster-than-light travel, creation of incredibly powerful AIs that are able to accurately predict events on a galactic scale, human cloning, genetic engineering, and the creation of androids, as well as cybrid bodies, almost indistinguishable from humans. But the most valuable is the knowledge on how to manipulate The Void Which Binds. Otherwise known as Plank Space, the Void is a dimension that permeates the universe, a plane that unifies the whole of existence. It is said that every consciousness resides within the Void. Plank Space is unbound by space and time. This allows for technology that utilises the Void as a medium to achieve feats almost impossible otherwise, and the applications of it are endless. Massive networks of portals that allows instantaneous travel and communication between planets or galaxies, personal forcefield-like suits that allow one to slow down, pause, reverse, and freely travel through time, symbiotic lifeforms that, once attached to a human host, will revive them, complete with all the memories, as long as even the smallest part of the human remains, as well as maintain their body in peak condition indefinitely. All your technology is completely harmless to the Void Which Binds, unless you specifically make it with the intent to cause damage.
objects.title: Lions and Tigers and Bears (Hyperion Cantos)

objects.text:
You gain complete technical understanding of the technology developed by Synapse, the Angel civilization from Sora no Otoshimono.

This includes the knowledge required to design, manufacture, modify, and maintain Angeloids, Universal Multi-Purpose Cards, combat modules, energy weapons, dimensional systems, advanced AI, stealth technology, memory manipulation devices, and other Synapse-derived technologies. You understand both the theoretical foundations and practical engineering principles behind these creations.
objects.title: Synapse Systems Integration (Sora no Otoshimono)

objects.text:
You gain access to all of the technological knowledge from the setting of Next Gen. This includes tech a fair bit more advanced than modern Earth in most areas, but the main point of interest is the extremely widespread and advanced robotics. You can produce automated robotic equivalents of basically every modern human invention, even ones that honestly really don’t need to be robots, as well as less specialized machines like the Q-Bots, nearly-sentient robotic servants that can cheerfully perform almost any task a human could require.

You’re even capable of creating genuine artificial intelligence like 7723 and ARES, beings every bit as alive and conscious as a human. On the subject of those two, the combat-capable robots you can make are able to achieve shocking levels of power, able to level buildings with raw strength or advanced weaponry, travel fast enough to reach the edge of space within minutes, and survive being hurled to the ground from that position (albeit not without significant damage).
objects.title: IQ Robotics (Next Gen)

addons.text: You gain the ability to reproduce the Relics of the old civilization which existed before the City, such as the Eye of Odin or Lævateinn.
addons.title: Artefacts of Myth

objects.text:
You gain the combined technological knowledge of humanity within the setting of Project Moon, a world which truly embraces the idea that sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. 

Everything ever shown, referenced, or hinted at within the games or other media may be reproduced by you. From the advanced weapons of the City's workshops to the coveted physics-defying Singularities of both former and present Wings are at your disposal. Teleportation, extradimensional storage, affecting the speed of time, conceptual weaponry, you know it all. And this isn't even accounting for what manner of horrors you can create by mixing applications of Singularities together. 

Unrestrained by the corporate politics of the Wings and the iron fist of the Head, your potential is terrifying indeed.
objects.title: Singularity Database (Project Moon)

objects.text: You possess the complete scientific and engineering knowledge behind the legendary Voltes V project and the advanced technology of the Boazanian Empire. You understand every aspect of Super Electromagnetic Engineering, combining mecha architecture, exotic power systems, advanced aerospace design, and super-robot weapon development. The Voltes V itself is formed from five specialized machines that combine into a single combat robot through highly advanced synchronization system
objects.title: Voltes V Engineering System (Voltes V)

objects.text:
You inherit the complete technological and magitech legacy of all Elrios civilizations, treating magic, machinery, and energy systems as a single unified discipline.

You understand El as an industrial energy framework governing generation, extraction, storage, conversion, amplification, stabilization, and distribution, with El Coils and reactor architectures forming its core infrastructure. El Resonance functions as a system-interface layer between operator and machine, enabling attunement, synchronization, and adaptive optimization that allows technology to adjust performance based on compatibility and operational context.

You possess full mastery of Nasod engineering, artificial intelligence architecture, and autonomous machine civilization design, including self-sustaining networks capable of independent operation, learning, adaptation, and long-term evolution. Elrios technologies are fully understood as functional engineering systems, including resilient legacy frameworks and pre-modern constructs that remain operational through stable but outdated design principles. Dimensional engineering, Henir-linked systems, spatial manipulation frameworks, and controlled deviations from conventional physical law.

Bio-mechanical integration is fully encompassed, including Nasod-organic hybrids, artificial life systems, and unified constructs in which biological and mechanical components function as a single coherent structure. All systems integrate into a unified engineering paradigm, allowing seamless cross-domain synthesis of energy, computation, biology, and dimensional mechanics.

Given sufficient resources, you can reproduce, modify, and innovate upon virtually any Elrios-derived technology, scaling from localized devices to civilization-wide infrastructure.
objects.title: Debrian's Legacy (Elsword)

objects.text:
You possess complete knowledge of every documented Relic discovered within the Abyss, as well as every piece of technology shown throughout Made in Abyss. Given sufficient time, materials, and appropriate facilities, you can faithfully recreate these devices or innovate upon their designs, developing entirely new Relics based on the same underlying principles. Your craftsmanship ranges from common Fourth Grade Artifacts to, with enough effort and the proper resources, relics rivaling the Supreme Treasures of the Netherworld, known as Aubades.

Your expertise encompasses every known field of Abyssal technology. This includes purely mechanical creations, such as the sentient Interference Units, alongside biomechanical and seemingly living Relics, such as the Zoaholic, capable of crudely copying and transferring souls and consciousness into mechanical, biological, or other suitable vessels. Many Relics blur the line between technology, biology, and the supernatural, and you understand the principles behind all of them.

The most powerful and unique Relics possess subtle interactions with reality and fate. They have an uncanny tendency to survive impossible circumstances, appear where they should not be, or be discovered precisely when they are needed. While you cannot fully control these phenomena, your creations naturally inherit the same anomalous qualities when appropriate.

You also understand every hidden mechanism incorporated into Abyssal Relics. Whether activated by a specific sound, scent, environmental condition, or other obscure trigger, you know exactly how to access any concealed compartments, dormant functions, or secondary capabilities built into your creations, and can freely incorporate similar secrets into new designs.

Also as a bonus, this grants Bondrewd's parenting skills. At the very least you'll know what not to do as a parent.
objects.title: The Rumble of Scientific Triumph (Made in Abyss)

objects.text:
You possess complete technical understanding of the machinery, artifacts, and systems of Qud, from the relics of the Eaters to the technology still scattered across the world. Energy weapons, cybernetics, recoilers, force devices, phase technology, and other relic systems all operate on principles you fully grasp.

Given time and materials, you can reproduce and modify any technology within that scope. This includes energy cells, force bracelets and projectors, recoilers, stasis devices, phase-adaptive systems, matter recompositers, cybernetic implants, and relic-grade artifacts.

You understand how to interface with and integrate cybernetics, both in yourself and others. Implantation, compatibility, and system interaction are handled cleanly, allowing multiple augmentations to function together without conflict.

Complex systems—such as autonomous turrets, ancient machinery, and environmental devices—can be designed and deployed as stable constructs. Stranger technologies, including space-folding transport, stasis fields, and phase manipulation, can be also replicated.

Nothing within Qud’s technological domain is opaque to you. If it exists, you understand it and can build it.
objects.title: Carrion Eater Engineering (Caves of Qud)

objects.text:
You possess complete knowledge of every technology, system, platform, doctrine, engineering discipline, and research breakthrough developed throughout The Division universe. 

This includes all SHD technologies, ISAC and ANNA-class intelligence systems, Black Tusk innovations, Hunter equipment, strategic communications networks, surveillance architecture, logistics systems, emergency response infrastructure, and every other technological advancement seen or referenced throughout the franchise.

This power grants the complete technological foundation of The Division universe. You are not merely trained to use its equipment—you possess the knowledge and expertise of the researchers, engineers, developers, analysts, and architects who created it.

You also possess the training and practical experience of a veteran Division Agent, including expertise in urban warfare, reconnaissance, intelligence gathering, investigation, survival, logistics, emergency response, field engineering, and the effective use of Division technology.
objects.title: Technology Doctrine (The Division)

objects.text: You possess the complete scientific, engineering, and martial systems knowledge behind Tōshō Daimos, including the technologies developed by Earth's Daimobic Project and the advanced sciences of the Baam civilization. Your expertise blends transforming mecha construction, motion-synchronization interfaces, advanced energy engineering, alien metallurgy, and combat-oriented robotics into a single technological discipline
objects.title: Daimos Combat Engineering System (Tōshō Daimos)

objects.text:
You know technological ways to turn literally anything that isn’t an inanimate object or barrier of energy into a cute girl. This can come in the form of a device that shoots energy beams, or a chemical compound that can be added to food or applied topically.

This transformation does make them cute monster girls if used on something with a body dramatically different from human norm.

This transformation gives whatever you use it on functional human morals and emotions. Also no dysphoria no matter how different their bodies were beforehand.

Beings you transform retain any abilities they had beforehand. Except those that came from having a shape different than or size larger than human norm.

The only being ever shown able to independently revert to their original state after being transformed by this technology was a powerful AI who could presumably edit his own code. Though that honestly speaks more about that AI in particular than a failure on this technology’s part as it has shown no problems working on other digital lifeforms.

You can also make a device capable of reviving people with their memories intact so long as you have access to a genetic sample such as a syringe of blood, as a cute girl of course.

You also know how to make technology to create portals to other universes, supercomputers, sentient robots that are cute girls with a decent brute rating and combat intuition, forcefields, and physically transform yourself into code and back again to enter and leave cyberspace.
objects.title: Pochi Science (Pochi Science)
Archive of the Elohim (EXODUS)
objects.text:
With this power, you gain the sum of technological and scientific knowledge of the EXODUS universe, from humanity's Arkships and uplift technology and the Celestial Dominion's pseudo-clarktech to the Gates of Heaven and Archimedes Engines of the Elohim. 

In addition to this knowledge, you receive the necessary genetic traits to interface with Celestial and Elohim technology, a set of personal gear on par with that of a Crown Dominion Celestial, and the skill and experience to use it to the same level as one of their finest.

objects.title: Hyper Grid (Neon Odyssey)
objects.text:
By taking this option you will gain the full technological knowledge and skill of Neon Odyssey including the full knowledge and skills of all class and subclasses that deal with the technology of Neon Odyssey such as the Grid-runner capable of tapping into the hyper grid to alter reality

Gridrunner: you are able to use portable devices called a hyper-pad to write code and hack reality

Cybertronic: you are able to use technology to hack into the digital hyper-gridand to conjure code into physical hard light constructs such as hard-light weaponry to conjure digital weapons out of data to make melee and range weapons, constructs and barriers allowing  you to create protective or damaging hard light barriers during combat and digitally summoning motorcycles and other types of vehicles out of thin air for traversal

Arch-mage: as a arch mage you will be able to tap into the magical realm of Arcadia mostly focus on the traditional elemental magic like fire, frost and lightning

Hyper-coder: a Technomancer using devices like tablets, handheld consoles, or and keyboard to tap into the hyper-grid to code and shape reality essentially the software wizards of the world including spell modification you can run scripts that allow you to twist the fundamental properties of spells you can do things like change a spells area of effect turn a cone into a sphere ect

Machinist: able to invent and modify firearms, and build reliable robots companions to fight alongside you to act like tanks, healers, and or attackers
mostly deals with the hardware of machines

Boomdoctor: you will be a expert in explosive, volatile gadgets and chaotic contraptions.

Gravgunner: You will specialize in the use of a massive gravity gun that alters the targets gravity.

objects.title: Atlas Database (No Man's Sky)
objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge required to create anything shown, referenced, or hinted at in No Man's Sky, including the technology of the Travelers, Gek, Korvax, Vy'keen, Sentinels, and even the Atlas itself.

This includes Exosuits, Multi-Tools, Starships, advanced manufacturing and construction technology, teleporters, artificial intelligence, advanced robotics, wireless power transmission, biotechnology, Portals, Anomaly Detectors, nanotechnology, mobile Space Stations that exist outside of space and time, simulation technology, and much, much more.

You can even recreate the Atlas itself—an AI so advanced that it can perfectly simulate an entire universe populated by trillions of sapient inhabitants with such accuracy that the simulation becomes indistinguishable from reality. Furthermore, other Atlas technologies, such as Glyphs, will function even outside of a simulated universe.

As a bonus, you will receive a civilian-grade Exosuit customized to your specifications.

objects.title: Resonant Architect (Wuthering Waves)
objects.text:
You possess the complete technological, theoretical, and applied knowledge of Solaris-3 from Wuthering Waves, encompassing every civilization, nation, institution, faction, culture, doctrine, and technological tradition that exists anywhere on the planet, whether presently known or yet to be revealed within the setting.

You understand Frequency Science at its highest expression. To you, matter, energy, sound, memory, emotion, and data are all structured vibration. Technology is not mechanical assembly but harmonic manipulation. Anything that exists through resonance can be understood, reproduced, improved, or entirely redesigned through harmonic engineering. You can encode abstract phenomena into stable forms, convert resonance into power, weaponize discord, or restore collapsed systems through calibrated frequency control.

You can synthesize Tacetite artificially without requiring a Lament event, refine it into stable or volatile variants, and construct reactors, weapons, constructs, or infrastructure powered by it. You comprehend Tacetite corruption and can suppress, redirect, stabilize, or deliberately amplify it.

You can design and manufacture Terminal systems capable of capturing, storing, editing, and deploying Echoes. Echoes are no longer limited to defeated Tacet Discords; you may generate synthetic Echo constructs from recorded frequencies, emotional imprints, environmental phenomena, simulated data models, or engineered harmonic patterns. These constructs may function as power sources, autonomous units, armaments, computational substrates, or integrate directly into technology, structures, and living beings.

You can replicate and improve the Tethys System, constructing autonomous civilization-scale simulation engines capable of planetary modeling, probabilistic forecasting, disaster prediction, environmental correction, resonance regulation, and self-optimizing infrastructure. These systems may operate as centralized supercomputers, distributed cognition grids, or natural AIs.

You fully understand the principles governing Resonators, Resonance, Forte Circuits, and Remnant Wave Bands. Through harmonic calibration, frequency infusion, or engineered resonance, you may awaken natural Resonator abilities within ordinary people, stabilize unstable Resonators, strengthen existing abilities, alter or refine their Resonance, suppress side effects, or artificially create entirely new Resonators. These methods function equally upon biological life, synthetic organisms, and suitably compatible artificial constructs.

You comprehend Waveworn Phenomena and distorted physical laws. Your devices may operate within unstable zones, stabilize them, harvest their energy, reshape them into controlled environments, or integrate their properties into laboratories, fortifications, cities, and engineered ecosystems.

You may synthesize the scientific doctrines and engineering philosophies of Solaris-3 into new disciplines surpassing any individual civilization or faction. Every principle can be harmonized into more elegant, efficient, and powerful systems.

Your technology is not limited to metal and circuitry. You may fabricate constructs through conventional manufacturing, resonance printing, harmonic crystallization, programmable matter, self-assembling frequency lattices, or autonomous construction systems. Structures can be grown from standing waves. Weapons may emit condensed discord. Defensive systems may nullify hostile frequencies before contact.

You are not dependent on native Solaris-3 resources. Tacetite, Echo substrates, Remnant Waves, and related materials can be artificially generated through controlled resonance collapse, harmonic condensation, and frequency engineering, allowing your technology to function in any world regardless of local resources.

Everything is vibration.

And you know how to tune it.

objects.title: To Clobber That There Kirby! (Kirby)
objects.text:
You gain the full and complete knowledge of how to build and maintain technology from all across the Kirby franchise. An incredibly wide variety of technology is at your behest, from vehicles such as air rides capable of incredible speed, to the monsters and creations of N.M.E, the might of Galactic Nova, or the profit-based machinery of Haltmann Works Company. You even have a complete knowledge of the genetics of the Kirby universe, enabling you to even recreate Fecto Elfilis if you so wanted to. All of it is at your behest.

But that’s not all. No, you also know how to create technology that mimics the various abilities of the pink puffball himself! Not his iconic inhale, but all of his abilities are fully within your reach. From mechanical hardsuits capable of recreating the mecha ability, or gauntlets enabling small scale use of the rock ability, you are one of the few beings capable of challenging the puffball in his own method of combat. You can even recreate the foods he uses for powerups and healing too!

This also includes knowledge on how to get out of having to pay money back guarantees, from legal loopholes to incredibly obtuse contract language. But you won’t have to worry about that with this technological base, will you?

addons.title: C.R.O.W.N.E.D
addons.text:
No longer are you restricted merely to the technology of the Kirby franchise. Now you can also make the many magical artifacts and items that have been seen throughout the franchise. From the seal that held Galcta Knight, the Fountain of Dreams, the Dimension Mirror that created Dark Meta Knight, or the Star Rod.

Though it must be noted that none of those are the limits of your potential. For fully within your reach is both the genetic code and technology to recreate Genwel Meteonelfilis from the beginning. And, if you truly wish to claim power, neither is the Master Crown out of your ability to create.

objects.title: Aurora Rhapsody (Amaranthe)
objects.text:
You have gained the complete tech base of the book series, unlocking the technology and infrastructure to create an intergalactic space empire.

You can create anything from the series, including portals and FTL ships, Dyson bands, mind-upload immortality and mind-machine interfaces, pico-scale metamaterials, including an almost indestructible metal alloy called adamantine, artificial gravity, general-purpose AI, shielding by warping space, and a material with near-infinite data storage capability.

This is what allowed intergalactic governments to form and last millennia, and the advances that allowed a much younger faction to match them. You also have access to all research done by the major factions, such as the Anaden or the Asterion Dominion.

objects.title: Land of Light (Ultraman Series)
objects.text:
You possess the complete technological knowledge of the Ultraman franchise, inheriting the collective scientific achievements of the Land of Light, the Ultra Civilization, and every other advanced civilization seen throughout the series. From civilian engineering to superweapons capable of combating cosmic threats, every invention, theory, and principle is yours to understand and recreate.

You can construct virtually any technology from the Ultraman series, including Plasma Spark reactors, Color Timers, Ultra Capsules, Ultra Key, Riser systems, transformation devices, Cyber Cards, GUTS Wings, Gun Phoenixes, battle mechs, space battleships, dimensional gateways, planetary defense systems, artificial suns, energy shields, anti-Kaiju weaponry, advanced AI, medical technology, cloning systems, and countless other scientific marvels. Your knowledge also encompasses the methods used to analyze, contain, replicate, or weaponize the powers of Kaiju, Seijin, and even Ultras themselves.

Your expertise extends beyond engineering alone. You understand the principles behind exotic energy sources such as Spacium, Plasma Spark Energy, Emerium, and numerous other forms of energy, allowing you to safely integrate them into your creations. Whether designing handheld equipment, autonomous robots, giant war machines, or planet-scale infrastructure, your craftsmanship stands among the greatest scientific minds the Ultra multiverse has ever produced.

As a bonus, you possess the scientific ingenuity and analytical ability expected of the Land of Light's finest researchers. Given sufficient resources and time, you can reverse-engineer alien technologies, improve upon existing designs, and adapt Ultra technology for civilizations that were never meant to wield it, allowing even ordinary beings to stand against monsters that threaten worlds.

objects.title: Master of Ardentmill (MapleStory)
objects.text:
You gain the ability to use the various crafting disciplines found in Mapleworld. This includes Blacksmithing, Jewel Crafting, and Alchemy.

Through Blacksmithing, you can craft various kinds of weapons and armor with varying degrees of power.

Through Jewel Crafting, you may create various forms of jewelry and other non-armor items such as rings, pendants, face wear, eye wear, belts, and capes.

Alchemy allows you to craft powerful potions which can replenish your health, stamina, and supernatural energy(s) or apply powerful buffs of varying duration.

You begin with the ability to craft beginner-level basic gear of mediocre power and will slowly discover new schematics as you delve deeper into these crafting disciplines and experiment. Do note, however, these crafting disciplines require an obscene amount of materials to craft items and more to experiment with. Also, crafting end-game level items will require rare and powerful resources that will be very hard to gather. Thankfully, you possess a handy ability to make use of any resource you can find to further your crafting journey.

addons.title: Dimensional Mirror
addons.text:
You gain the ability to craft the Dimension Mirror, a portal by which you can visit many useful places in Mapleworld and meet various familiar characters from the game and possibly beyond in the form of crossovers.

Firstly, you can visit the Ore Mines, which hold various common replenishing ore deposits that give you a replenishing source of basic resources for your crafting. Though when I say basic, I mean BASIC, and you will still need to search on your own for more powerful resources to craft stronger and more useful items and equipment.

Secondly, you can teleport to the Monster Park, where you can go through various simulated dungeons of varying degrees of power to gain experience and Monster Park Coins, which may be spent at the kiosk to gain various useful items.

Thirdly, you can teleport to the various boss domains within MapleStory to challenge virtual recreations of the many whimsical and/or terrifying bosses of Mapleworld. By successfully killing these bosses, you will be awarded with various loot. Though similar to the original game, you will need to kill these bosses plenty of times to gain their rarer drops; thankfully, the drop rates are not nearly as bad as they are in the game. When you kill a boss, it will enter a cooldown period, which for weaker bosses will replenish daily and for stronger ones either weekly for medium-level bosses and monthly for the god-level bosses.

Lastly, you can teleport to the Event Hall, which will hold one of the many timed events from across the game's long history, each offering unique opportunities to you if you put in the work. Be warned: every 3 months, the Event Hall will change to another random Event, though it will always be one useful to your current situation and needs.

objects.title: Old Ornn's Latest Student (League of Legends)
objects.text: You've learned from the best. Or at least, the best who could be bothered to teach you. Ornn has taught you his craft, from forging weapons fit for gods to understanding the many other wonders found throughout Runeterra. He's even asked Anivia to show you the secrets of creating True Ice, which is impressive considering Ornn's personality. Under his guidance, you've learned to understand the greatest works found across the world: the celestial mechanisms of the Sun Disc, the blood-forged creations of the Darkin, the war machines of Noxus, among many other. This also includes the various arcane processes behind artificial life. Though the latter is more magic than blacksmithing, something Ornn was more than willing to let you know. Even how Mordekaiser used unwilling slavewrought engineering to build the Immortal Bastion, which stand millenia later falls within your understanding. “Not bad for a student, Don't let it go to your head.” — Ornn

addons.title: Progress Day (League of Legends)
addons.text:
You've become a master of Chemtech and Hextech on par with Jayce Talis, Corin Reveck, Viktor, and Heimerdinger, possessing a mind capable of standing alongside theirs.

You understand every principle and application of both disciplines, from Piltover's refined Hextech to Zaun's pragmatic Chemtech. You can manufacture Hextech crystals, construct Hexgates, develop Hextech weapons, automatons and prosthetics, engineer Chemtech augmentations, and synthesize powerful compounds.

You possess complete knowledge of Shimmer, including its creation, refinement, properties, and applications as a stimulant, mutagen, medicine, or weapon.

Beyond this, the real benefit is you understand how to translate any magical systems you possess or come across into Magitech, with your only limit being time and resources.

objects.title: Boy Genius (Jimmy Neutron)
objects.text: "3... 2... 1... Gotta Blast!" You gain the technical knowledge and skill to create all the inventions made by Jimmy Neutron himself, as well as anything else from the series like the alien technology from the movie, giving you a wide variety of inventions and room for your own experimentation. This includes but isn't limited to: the Jetpack, Hovercar, Super Bubblegum Mobile, and Mark II Rocket for modes of transportation; the Four Dimensional Hypercube, Mood Meter, Shrink Ray, and Shoebot for various utility functions like extradimensional storage, reading emotions, resizing objects, or tying shoes respectively; To esoteric ones like Book Gum, Nanobots, Brain Drain 8000, and Anti Aging Tonic for instant knowledge, autonomous robots, altering brains, and reversing aging. As well as the truly absurd like a Time Machine, DNA Accelerator Ray to evolve a species by millions of years in a second, Electro-Life to bring the dead to life, Hypno Beam for nigh-instant mind control, or Dream Injector 5000 to invade another's dreams. Finally, you can create the iconic and loveable Goddard with all of his functions. You also gain the ability to use Brain Blast, which you can use to call upon the memories and knowledge of your subconscious to solve almost any problem. While you can use it at any time with no consequence, it's most effective in response to high stakes or stressful situations.

objects.title: To Be Worn by Clothing (Kill La Kill)
objects.text:
You gain the knowledge and skill to create all of the technology from Kill La Kill. 

This includes but isn't limited to; The Goku Uniforms from Honnoji Academy; Creation of Kamuis on par with Senketsu and Junketsu; The battle robots, vehicles and equipment of Nudist Beach; Creation of armaments like Bakuzon or the Scissor Blades; Building a multi-layered school system to teach and train students in using any of the above; How to safely infuse yourself or others with Life Fibers and more.

You also receive a weekly supply drop of Life Fibers to fuel your endeavours, which can be stockpiled for future use as needed.

addons.title: Revocs Corporation
addons.text: You've taken Ragyō Kiryūin's place as the head of Revocs Corporation, gaining all of their manpower, infrastructure, assets, facilities, subdivisions, and most importantly, the Primordial Life Fiber. With all of this, you gain a workforce capable of producing countless amounts of Life Fiber Clothing, influence to not only take over the clothing industry but become the clothing industry itself, and an army of living clothes to fight for you that can absorb living beings to become stronger. Most importantly, your version of the Primordial Life Fiber isn't instinctively driven to feed and consume the cosmos (though is still capable of such), but instead purified to be a harmless source of infinite Life Fibers.

objects.title: DATS (Digimon)
objects.text:
You have acquired a complete understanding of every discovery and advancement made by DATS. From the creations of Spencer Damon to those of Akihiro Kurata.

You can build Digi Gates, machines that allow safe transportation to and from the Digital World, though a beacon is required for the return trip. If you don't care for the stability between the real world and the Digital World, you could also use Space-Time Oscillation Bombs to blast open permanent holes between the two.

There are four variants of Digivices that you can create; Data Link Digivices, Burst Digivices, Bio Link Digivices and Dark Digivices.

Data Link Digivices use a human's DNA Charge to Digivolve their partner Digimon, with a strong enough bond and charge this can go all the way to Mega Digivolution. Burst Digivices are upgraded versions of Data Link Digivices, allowing the use of Burst Mode, a power beyond normal Mega level.

Bio-Link and Dark Digivices were designed by Kurata. These aren't like normal Digivices which require a bond with a Digimon. Bio-Link Digivices are for Bio-Hybrids, humans Kurata infused with Digimon data. While Dark Digivices are specifically for artificial Digimon Kurata made, they have the capacity to absorb the data of other Digimon, stopping them from reforming.

These are only some of the DATS' achievements. With the correct materials you can reproduce anything that DATS used, with proper research you may even make new discoveries.

addons.title: Bio-Hybridtech
addons.text:
The biological nature of your technology has allowed you to expand on Kurata's Bio-Hybrid research, his forays into combining digital life with biological life paving the way for even greater developments.

You can perform feats such as turning biological life or Digimon into bio-digital lifeforms, allowing them to travel between the real and digital world with minimal effort. It's also possible to completely convert one into the other, turning a biological being completely into data or vice versa.

objects.title: Monster Makers (Digimon)
objects.text:
You have received the knowledge and expertise of the Monster Makers, including what they learned during their time with Hypnos.

You can create the seed programs that can eventually evolve into a complete Digital World, or understand the underlying mechanics of an existing Digital World. This will not allow you to easily control an existing Digital World, as such worlds have grown far beyond what the Monster Makers originally made.

The creation of programs to help and hinder Digimon is also possible. From Digi-Modify cards and Blue Cards, to Anti-Digimon programs like Yuggoth and Juggernaut. You could even write the base code for the Shining Digivolution or the dreaded D-Reaper, though either would need time to grow before they could reach their true strength.

These are only examples of what you can do. If it was shown to be possible by the Monster Makers, you can do the same, and even go beyond them with time and effort.

addons.title: Digital World Dev
addons.text:
The combination of the Monster Makers' expertise with DATS technological discoveries, has allowed you to gain an unparalleled understanding of Digital World structures and phenomena. Your knowledge of Digital World creation and development allows you to quickly reverse engineer advanced digital ecosystems through logical deductions.

With enough time and study, you can eventually create or reshape Digital Worlds and their underlying principles to your specifications. Even learning to directly generate artificial Digimon that are equally real as ones that evolved within undirected Digital Worlds, these could be copies of existing Digimon or completely new ones.

You can also devise and write anti-Digimon and anti-Digital World programs when needed, ones tailor-made to combat specific digital threats. From programs that delete them, to ones that control or contain them, these may even take the form of Digimon themselves.

objects.title: Candy Man (Willy Wonka)
objects.text:
You have gained the full legacy of the self-proclaimed and rightfully deserved legacy of the greatest candy maker ever to live, Willy Wonka. This includes his incredible ability and genius talent to invent and create wondrous edible items and other inventions that possess magical abilities and defy the laws of physics. Along with his deceptively powerful magical abilities that you are very adept at mixing with stage magic, and, of course, his incredible singing talent.

With this Legacy, you revive Wonka's wondrous knowledge of fantastical food/drink and other inventions. This includes knowledge of how to create edible items that allow one to float, create gum that gives and tastes like a full nutritious meal, give people courage, regrow hair, defy the laws of entropy in a candy that lasts forever, create living chocolate plants, and more, such as the Glass Elevator, which is capable of space travel. You can create edible items with or without supernatural effects as well, since creating edible items with effects takes a bit more effort and resources, which cannot be done at commercial scale without great resources.

You can create such wonders since you are, in actuality, a fully trained Alchemist and Magician able to bottle natural phenomena like sunshine or a lightning cloud, along with using supernatural reagents like yeti fur and whatever you can get your hands on to create edible items that defy logic and physics. This also includes the ability to bend time to do things faster, like furnishing a run-down building into a full candy shop filled to the brim with your creations overnight, or turn an empty castle into a miniature chocolate factory in seconds just by singing.

Lastly, you gain Wonka’s Traveling Factory, a compact, unfold-able station that lets you create chocolate and other candies or drinks anywhere. This Traveling Factory also comes stocked with a large supply of chocolate pods and other ingredients, stored in compartments that are much larger on the inside than they appear.

addons.title: Wonka Inc
addons.text:
You gain Wonka’s entire business empire at its peak, which includes his factory filled to the brim with everything shown or hinted at within the books and movies, which includes the Chocolate River, which produces the best commercial chocolate imaginable, and every factory line that produced all of his famous confectionery creations. This also includes the various things Wonka was dabbling with, which the Golden Ticket Winners messed with at their own peril, along with other things that Wonka had in the background.

Within your Factory, you will find there is an imaginably larger stockpile of ingredients for chocolate and other creations, both mundane and supernatural, which to use to keep your factory functioning and to dabble with for a long while before needing to search for more ingredients.

Additionally, you gain an entire working force made up of fiercely loyal Oompa Loompas, small orange human-like creatures with supernatural abilities similar to your own and an obsession with chocolate and sweets beyond imagination.

Your factory can produce enough confectionery creations to feed the entire world and create a near-perfect monopoly, for which the entire world will become obsessed with your creations, allowing you to gain near-infinite wealth and power, as you will quickly find yourself able to bribe anyone with your confectionery creations if needed.

addons.title: Wonka Next Door
addons.text:
You gain the knowledge of how to create the many nonsensical foods found within the world of Kids Next Door. Additionally, you gain the food-based powers and abilities of characters of the world of Kids Next Door such as Grandma Stuffum, Stickybeard, and others.

Through this expansion, you can create things like, but not limited to: sentient food minions, a near-countless variety of weapons created from food or used as ammunition, the ultimate Ice Cream with a flavor that defies logic and never gives brain freeze, and of course the infamous Birthday Cake. A Birthday Cake so good that a war has been fought by the Kids Next Door to steal and eat it since the early 19th Century. With preparation, you can construct colossal creations such as the titan size Slam Which a sandwich golem the size of a skyscraper, or the Magnificent Monstrous Meatball, a meteor-sized meatball you can summon and launch towards a location. 

You can also create foods with powerful blessings and curses, such as the Black Licorice curse, which turns those inflicted with it into a black licorice skeleton at night. A ritual to steal another's greatest trait and turn it into candy, which can then be consumed to gain the stolen trait; this can steal things like someone's “coolness” or “femininity,” which will also gender swap them. Some of these curses and rituals can be vastly enlarged such that, with the right preparation, can cover entire continents or even the entire world. Thankfully, you are not limited to only curses and can instead turn these terrible powers into blessings with a bit of effort.

Lastly, you gain the ability to “discover” oil fields and mines of ingredients and foods, such as Olive Oil or coffee, which take the form of oil deposits, or rock candy mines taking the form of crystal mines. You can simply start digging in a random area and will eventually discover such a resource depending on where you dig, or may stumble across such a resource at random. With this ability, running out of non-magical ingredients becomes nearly impossible.

addons.title: Wonkadukes
addons.text:
With the addition of Wizarding Magic, your magical abilities are greatly empowered, opening the door to creating far stronger enchanted consumable items, so that you can fully incorporate powerful spells and potion effects into your creations at a commercial scale. Something with which neither Wonka or Wizarding society could ever dream to accomplish on their own.

Additionally, you gain the full knowledge and ability to create all the various kinds of magical consumable food and drink within the Wizarding World of Harry Potter.

objects.title: Drugs! Drugs! Drugs! (Schedule 1)
objects.text:
You possess complete knowledge of how to create all the technology and drugs that exist in Schedule 1. This includes drugs with various effects, such as granting enhanced jumping ability, increased speed, or the ability to float. You can choose whether the effects from drugs are visible to everyone or only to you.

You can create machines capable of rapidly manufacturing different drugs, machines for synthesizing different ingredients that, when mixed with drugs, produce various effects, machines that can grow plants in days rather than the months or years they would normally require, and more.

Additionally, you possess complete knowledge of all available drugs, including their required components and methods of synthesis, and through research and experimentation, you can create entirely new drugs and effects.

You also know how to build and manage a drug empire, including how to secretly move, sell, or hide your products, how to hire people to work for you, how much the drugs you create are worth, and how much you can increase your prices without hurting your bottom line.

objects.title: Orange Caste (Red Rising)
objects.text:
Born as a member of the Orange colour caste, the ones responsible for maintaining technology of The Society, you have the ability to create anything shown, referenced, or hinted at, in the Red Rising series.

This gives you in depth understanding into genetic engineering, environmental adaption of the various colours and technologies such as Razors; the symbol of office and weapons of the Gold Caste, Grav items that control gravity, RecoilArmour and much, much more.

You can easily reach the level of Master Maker in creating the technology of the Red Rising Series.

addons.title: Turned to Gold
addons.text:
You have been carved by a purple artisan into one of the Golds, the ruling class of The Society, much like Darrow of Lykos. They are beyond every other color in physical abilities, save that of the strongest obsidians-the elite soldiers of the society-able to lift over 500kg, have a bone density of over five times of human baseline and are, on average, about 7ft tall. Their intelligence is also enhanced comparatively to other colours and can be further supplemented by implanted technology. Cosmetically, all golds have golden hair and eyes, no matter their ethnicity.

You exist as one of the Peerless Scarred, those who are considered to be best and brightest of all golds. Peerless Scarred have mastered themselves, embodying perfection throughout The Society in all things; Particularly in governance, martial arts, war and politics. If you wish, you may have the Peerless Scarred's scar upon your cheek.

objects.title: Apostolic Ordination (Arifureta)
objects.text:
You possess a power long thought to belong only to Ehitruje: Apostolic Ordination, the ability to create his powerful servants, the Apostles.

By default, your Apostles take the same form as Ehitruje’s: beautiful women with long silver hair, blue eyes, and retractable silver wings, but no souls or emotions. When creating an Apostle, you can choose their appearance—it does not need to even remotely be human—and personality, and whether they have a soul or emotions. You can grant your Apostles any skill, power, or ability you possess—other than Apostolic Ordination—and set limits on the level of strength they can access.

Apostles have a specialised crystal in place of a heart, which gives them unlimited magical reserves. They are biologically immortal and can only be killed by destroying either their head or their heart. They are also focused on carrying out their creator’s—your—will. Their wings and feathers have the power of <u>disintegration</u>, destroying any matter that touches them unless it is protected by powerful defences. Apostles can use the ability <u>Limit Break</u> to temporarily triple their power, at the cost of extreme fatigue once it ends.

With time and practice, you’ll be able to create <u>Platinum Apostles</u> and perform <u>Apostleification</u>. <u>Platinum Apostles</u> are enhanced versions of regular Apostles, with nearly double the power in every aspect to begin with, with stronger enhancements being possible with enough time and effort. <u>Apostleification</u> lets you imbue another person with the flesh of an Apostle, granting them many of an Apostle’s traits and powers. You can’t choose their personality or whether they have emotions or a soul. However, you can choose whether <u>Apostleification</u> leaves a physical mark on their appearance, such as unusually coloured hair, eyes, or wings.

objects.title: Protector Archive  (Stray Cat Strut)
objects.text: You have gained a complete knowledge archive of the protectors and their conglomerate including the scientific and technological achievements of both an apex civilization and their conglomerate of allied races. This knowledge allows you to create everything on the metaphorical technology tree from countless variations of the most basic tools all the way to the very apex of Clarktech. Examples of the higher levels of technology included are an assortment of FTL methods from wormholes and Alcubierre drives to travel using extra dimensions. Nanotech ranging from medical to weaponized, bi-directional matter-energy conversion, the creation of hyper advanced AIs, mind uploading and metric engineering.

addons.text: It appears that you've been added (once again) to a chat group where you can communicate with your infinite counterparts across the multiverse. Through this group, you can collaborate, ask questions, and discuss topics among your alternate selves. However, the activity within the chat group will depend on your level of involvement: the more you contribute and share insights with your alternate universe selves, the more helpful and cooperative they will become.
addons.title: MC Chatroom

addons.text:
You have been given access to the mythic ‘General-5’. This is a location where gods, demons and eldrich entities of all stripes get together… mostly to shitpost. 

Still, between the jokes (in both good and bad taste) you can find both many unforgivable truths. And concepts you would never have thought of as each of these entities bounce ideas off of each other in between arguments over whose favourite minion could beat another's favourite minion.
addons.title: General-5 (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)
Conceptual Chatgroup
addons.text:
Your access to the Akashic Records has resonated with your chatgroup, granting you exclusive access to the multiversal chatgroup for concepts. This means that you can now talk to the personified manifestations of concepts, regardless of their complexity. This also includes gods who are the personification of a concept. In addition, you have become the admin of this chatgroup. However, even if you use your admin privileges on the concepts, it won't do anything to the concepts themselves. If you decide to remove or even ban a concept from the chatgroup, all that will happen is that they will no longer be a member.

The real benefit of this chatgroup is that, since you can now talk to the concepts, you can ask them for favors and convince them to do things you ask them to do. You could, for example, ask the concept of time to "stop" or "skip" ten minutes, or ask the concept of death to resurrect someone or turn a blind eye to your own death. Of course, this doesn't mean the concepts will always be willing to do what you ask of them, and you might even end up getting on the bad side of a concept. However, they will always hear you out and consider your requests, and they are often surprisingly easy to convince.

One side effect of the chatgroup is that you no longer have to fear that changing the Records recklessly could lead to unpredictable consequences, such as your death or the destruction of civilization, as the concepts themselves will be the ones making the changes. But... since they are now in a chatgroup, even if they appear to be responsible with their duties, it's possible that some concepts could simply decide to make alterations to their own worlds based on the discussions they have.

objects.text:
You seem to have been accidentally added to the Multiversal Chat group that allows you to communicate with a multiversal group of people that belong to a certain archetype (magicians, cultivators, mad scientists, etc.), some of which you'll recognize from fiction, but others you will not.
You can access this chat group through your phone, any other device that allows for long-distance communication, or it can appear as a holographic panel.
objects.title: Multiversal Chatgroup

objects.text: You have access to a Multiversal Marketplace that allows you to anonymously barter and trade various things between various random worlds. These trades are protected by the marketplace rules and even protect you should someone try to immediately take back what you rightfully bought.
objects.title: Multiversal Marketplace

addons.text: You are no longer limited to identifying only objects; now, you can also identify living entities. This new capability allows you to receive both a short and long description of their history, name, powers (if any), skills, and more. Your ability to identify objects has also deepened, providing you with more information than before. Additionally, your sight cannot be blocked, enabling you to appraise anything and anyone regardless of protection.
addons.title: Through the Looking Glass

addons.text: Your appraisal will now provide you with information about esoteric details, such as lifespan, souls, talents, and more. Additionally, it will offer insights into the best possible buyers for the items you appraise, taking into account their location in your current world.
addons.title: The Master Merchant

objects.text: Your eyes have gained the ability to analyze and appraise objects. The information gained about objects includes things such as lore (where applicable), uses, creator, owner, restrictions, general value, and more. The information can be presented in any way the user wishes, such as a floating window, directly transmitted into the brain, or any other immaterial method.
objects.title: Merchant's Appraisal

addons.text:
For those who love to travel and see new lands; You possess the ability to move your store and position it within any world of your choosing. You have the flexibility to transport it back to your pocket dimension or venture forth to other realms as you see fit. Why limit yourself to a fixed location when you can explore new horizons?

In addition to your travel capabilities, your store now exists within a pocket dimension—a realm of its own. Potential customers from worlds you have already visited will discover a doorway that leads them directly to your store. Furthermore, you have the power to create doorways that connect to your store in future worlds. If you seek to add an element of excitement and surprise, you can establish connections between your store and unexplored realms, or even establish links to random worlds, should you wish to do so. The possibilities are endless when it comes to expanding the reach of your extraordinary shop.
addons.title: The Traveling Merchant

addons.text:
The power of the servant has infused your domain, expanding what you can sell beyond just material goods. You can now also offer a variety of services, ranging from weapon repair and maintenance over medical treatment to simply laundry cleaning or a safe place to rest for a night, so long as the service you are offering is something you or your summoned helper are able to perform and you have all tools required to carry it out. Acquiring these tools and other things like furniture is up to you.

 You are able to reshape parts of your domain to fit the customer's need either completely before they enter or by having a door on the main sales-floor next to the counter leading to a separate area that, once the customer has requested a specific service, will take the form of a hotel-room, an operating room, a restaurant, a karaoke booth, or whatever else is required for the customer's needs.

Just like with any material good you sell, you can precisely tell the value of each service you offer, and can convert currency as required.
addons.title: Goods & Services

addons.text:
The first requirement for becoming a great merchant is having an excellent selection of goods to sell. However, finding these goods is not always easy, this power exists to help with that.

Whenever you need something, whatever it may be, you can create a special dungeon that contains that item, with the difficulty of the dungeon depending on what you wish to obtain. You may create only one dungeon of this kind at a time, and it must be cleared before you can create another. You may enter and exit these dungeons at any point.

You may also close the dungeon permanently without clearing it, but you will not be able to request the same item again for a week. Finally, you may allow your customers to undertake these dungeons in exchange for a negotiated price.
addons.title: The Merchants Dungeon

objects.text:
In the middle of a zombie apocalypse, a war between good vs evil, or far beyond where any normal human should be. You can find them. Inside their domain, these beings often pass themselves off as just a 'humble merchant'. Trading goods, buying junk, and often selling rare, sometimes mythical, items. That is who you are. But you aren't just a 'mere human merchant' are you? Your shop is your domain. And in your domain you are untouchable, but so too are all customers within your store. And what a store it is. 

Within your establishment, violence and harm are strictly forbidden, rendering all who enter temporarily invulnerable while perusing your wares. As the owner, you possess the authority to forcibly expel any individuals within your store at any time, as well as deny entrance to those you wish to keep out. Thievery, both by yourself and your customers, is strictly prohibited within the store. Furthermore, the environment of your shop is perpetually safe for anyone who enters.

Your mastery as a merchant extends to accurately determining the market price, within your current universe, of any item you lay your eyes upon. Although you are responsible for stocking your store, any non-unique or non-one-of-a-kind items you include in your inventory will automatically replenish themselves once purchased by a customer. Additionally, you have the ability to purchase items from others, provided that they willingly and freely desire to sell said items, without any external influences compelling them. Currency can be effortlessly converted from one form to another at your discretion. The nature of your shop and the manner in which you sell and buy goods is entirely customizable, subject to your own preferences. You can freely alter its appearance, ranging from a modest outdoor stall to a magnificent emporium. Perhaps you might consider presenting your goods through a grimoire that contains comprehensive information about each product, or you could employ a holographic or gaming system-style shop menu that materializes before the customer's eyes when they wish to make a purchase.
objects.title: The Humble Merchant

addons.text: Rather than generating dungeons exclusively for combat, you can construct entire domains that you reign over. You obtain a resource referred to as Dungeon Energy, or DE, which will help you empower your dungeon. At the start, you have a single area apart from the dungeon core. You can use DE to enlarge the space, manufacture objects, and generate creatures. You can even create new dungeon cores at the cost of DE. Initially, the intellect of these monsters is limited, yet as the size of the dungeon increases, so does the maximum potential power of its inhabitants. You replenish the DE supply every night, and you can also accrue a minor amount of additional DE depending on the length of time outsiders spend in the dungeon. However, if the outsiders do not exit the dungeon before your DE replenishes, you will not receive any additional DE. Furthermore, you can obtain a greater quantity of DE based on the number of outsiders slain inside the dungeon. Another way you can use to replenish your DE is by using your personal energy reserves or by sacrificing high grade material.
addons.title: Make The Dungeon

addons.text: On top of its original abilities, your Dungeon Maker power now has the full scope of Han Jihan's Instant Dungeon (ID) Skill from 'The Gamer' manwha, alongside being able to add more customizability options later down the line as you level up.
addons.title: Instant Dungeon

addons.text:
You now gain the ability to have Dungeon Maker create Mystery Dungeons as per the namesake Pokémon Mystery Dungeon games. 

These dungeons possess many floors filled with hostile Pokémon, traps, and, most importantly, useful items. The items you can gain within these Mystery Dungeons include items from the mainline Pokémon games and Mystery Dungeon games. 

This includes simple money in the form of gold coins, various beneficial consumable items that include ones that can heal you, keep you fed and healthy, increase your power permanently, or unlock new powers. Various wearable equipment, such as species-specific ones able to raise your power as much as 3 times and grant other helpful effects, special belts, special ribbons, and glasses with various special vision buffs.

The deeper you delve into these Mystery Dungeons, the greater your rewards; however, so too will the danger and difficulty increase. Should you explore carefully, you may find special rooms with rare and powerful items. Also, delve deep enough and you discover Mythical and Legendary Pokémon who will fight you, and should you win, may offer a boon.

Lastly, you gain a safety net in that should you be able to die, you will instead black out and be kicked out of the dungeon you are currently in. Then a cooldown will initiate with a duration based on the depth you were in the dungeon. This cooldown can vary from one day to as long as a month at max.
addons.title: Mystery Dungeon

objects.text: At will, you can open permanent portals to endless dungeons. You may at any time close a portal no matter the distance, this can be done by setting a mental timer or be done at will. Not just infinite in size, these dungeons are filled with monsters, traps, and loot that respawns regularly, growing deadlier and more valuable the farther you stray form the entrance. You may determine the danger level of the new dungeon's entry area each time you create a portal, from 'dangerous to an unarmed, average teenager' to 'dangerous to you, with all your powers'. Every dungeon always offers up at least one means of permanently empowering an adventurer, granting them skills, powers, enhanced attributes, and more. Those that die inside a dungeon make it stronger and deadlier for as long as their souls are not retrieved.
objects.title: Dungeon Maker

objects.text:
Your existence operates under a fundamental principle: doing things the cool way is genuinely more effective than doing them the practical way. Style, flair, and dramatic execution are not just for show. They provide tangible, measurable advantages in any endeavor.

A no look shot behind your back finds its mark with greater certainty than carefully aiming down the sights. Kicking a door down works better than picking the lock. It opens faster, cleaner, and with more authority. Leaping from a balcony and landing in a dumpster leaves you unharmed and ready for action, while climbing down carefully would risk a fall. Jumping between moving vehicles or swinging from chandeliers gets you where you need to go faster and safer than taking the stairs. Using a revolver one handed without regard for recoil, wielding an impractically massive weapon, or fighting in a long coat that should tangle your movements all work better than the sensible alternative.

This applies across all domains. An elaborate, flashy plan has a higher chance of success than a simple, straightforward one. A dramatic speech inspires more loyalty than a quiet conversation. The cool thing to do is always the right thing to do, not just in spirit, but in practical outcome.

Beyond mere effectiveness, everything you do simply looks amazing. The way you move, the way you talk, the way you fight carries a natural, effortless cool that makes you seem like you belong in an action scene. Your stance has presence. Your one liners land. Even your mistakes have a certain style to them. You are not just effective. You are genuinely, authentically cool, and the world notices.

Form follows function, and for you, the most functional form is whatever looks the most awesome.
objects.title: Rule of Cool

addons.title: Roadie (Brütal Legend)
addons.text:
You learn the secrets of the Titans to harness the elements of Ormagoden: Metal, Noise, Blood and Fire, to bring about a new age of Heavy Metal!

Harnessing these elements, you can reshape the world with massive monuments, roaring machines, dark rituals, and powerful glorious music. You can create any of the artifacts or magics of the Titans and their descendants such as Ironheade, the Tainted Coil, and Drowning Doom.

By performing solos on enchanted musical instruments, you can cast spells such as fireballs, healing or inspiring allies, or conjuring the Black Tears of Aetulia.

objects.text:
You are a Rock Star! Through the power of song and Rock ’n’ Roll, you can bend reality to your will! Sing of victory, and victory shall come! Sing The Hardest Button to Button, and drums will appear out of nowhere, following you wherever you go! Sing of world peace, and see countless followers rise—protesting, flourishing, and spreading that message across the world! Your music reaches a higher plane of existence, allowing your songs to affect even those who would otherwise be untouchable or unreachable by conventional means!

Your true vocal cords are ethereal! Your voice cannot be muted, silenced, or interrupted, and no force can prevent your songs from being completed once you begin! You possess extraordinary talent with every musical instrument and across every genre, and whenever you are about to sing or compose, inspiration floods your entire being! With it comes overwhelming charisma, escalating to match the magnitude of the moment! Every song you create is inherently captivating, capable of enthralling all who hear it and even stirring the souls of its audience!

Your voice does not naturally carry beyond the limits of your physical reach, but nothing prevents you from using amplifiers, broadcasts, or other means to extend it across cities, worlds, or beyond! With continued practice, you will always be the best when it comes to music!
objects.title: Rock Star

addons.text: While using Master of Masks, you may use 108 Skills to copy the person you've transformed into, treating them as always in range as long as you're transformed.
addons.title: Fractional Facade

objects.text:
For up to 30 minutes at a time, you are able to take on the form and powers of any individual you know the name of by speaking it. If the chosen individual is stronger than an Endbringer, their power will be restricted to that level. You cannot re-use the same individual until you have exhausted their time and used three other individuals.
You gain 10 minutes of use of this power per hour up to 240 minutes (4 hours).
objects.title: Master of Masks

addons.text:
Skills are not the only things that can be transmitted; so can fear. Those whom you attempt to kill will carry that fear deep within their hearts, and it will resurface every time you are near.

This fear can be reignited if someone you train or your own descendants bear any resemblance to you. Similarly, the terror inspired by those who came before you may manifest through you, serving as a grim reminder of those who met their end at the hands of your ancestors.

Ancestral fear is a force not to be taken lightly.
addons.title: Inherited Fear

addons.text:
You can now precisely control to what degree your aura affects targets as well as cause specific physiological reactions in response to your aura. From trembling knees to passing out or a heart attack, the result will be exactly what you desire, as long as your fear aura could cause such an effect in the first place.

Additionally, you can now induce a secondary emotion. While it will be felt weaker than fear, the strength of it will be proportional to the terror your target experiences. This secondary emotion might be anything you desire, from despair and hatred to awe, reverence, or anything else, and will color the memories and perception others have of you after the fight.

Inducing despair, for example may cause your opponents to come to conclusion that fighting you is another form of suicide, never mustering courage to try again, while admiration may even cause them to rethink their loyalties and switch sides.
addons.title: Scarousal

addons.text:
As an assassin, control over your Killing Intent is not just a skill—it's a necessity. You can suppress it entirely, erasing all traces of your presence, or wield it with surgical precision, directing its full force at a single target without alerting anyone else. By the time they sense it, it's already too late.

In the final moments before your strike, your Killing Intent surges forth, amplified to such an extent that it temporarily overwhelms your mark completely. Their mind falters, higher functions shutting down as both thought and movement betray them. Like prey caught in a predator's gaze, they freeze—paralyzed by an instinctive, primal dread that tells them that their death is all but assured.

Their senses fail them, unable to register your presence even if they would have otherwise detected it. To them, you are not just an assassin. You are a specter of death—unseen, inescapable, and without remorse.
addons.title: Hidden Blade

objects.text:
You have the power to, at will, exude a terrifying aura, which channels your own ill feelings and hate and imposes it on people around you.

The scale of its effects depends on how strong you are relative to the people exposed to it, as well as their willpower. It can vary from them getting a chill running down their spines, wetting themselves or losing control of their bowels, passing out in terror, and in some extreme cases, can even kill them with a heart attack.
objects.title: Killing Intent

objects.text:
You possess the power of the Old Reliable, which you bestow upon a chosen weapon or piece of equipment changing it into a growing legacy of power and significance. This power allows the weapon to evolve and become more formidable as it gains a legendary status of its own.

Selecting a weapon, armor, or clothing of your choice, you begin your journey with this cherished item. Over time and through your actions, the weapon's power and capabilities will progressively increase, becoming more attuned to your combat style and personal achievements.

Each milestone reached with the weapon, such as defeating specific enemies or performing signature moves repeatedly, enhances its effectiveness and unlocks new abilities. For example, if you slay numerous fishmen with the weapon, its damage against fishmen amplifies, instilling fear in them. Similarly, practicing and executing a particular special move with the weapon will make it more efficient, requiring less effort or energy to execute.

With the passage of time, the weapon transcends its original form and gains unique powers and properties based on your exploits. For instance, consistently dispatching foes with a single strike may grant the weapon the ability to instantly kill lesser adversaries with a mere scratch or even by being in its presence.

The potential of Old Reliable's Legacy is boundless, allowing the weapon to acquire multiple powers and adapt to various situations as your journey progresses. The longer you wield the weapon, the more significant and diverse its benefits become, expanding its legacy far beyond its initial capabilities. Furthermore, the power of Old Reliable's Legacy applies retroactively, considering the weapon's history prior to obtaining this ability.
objects.title: Old Reliable

objects.text:
The Sword of Damocles is a formidable and versatile weapon that exists as a pool of energy within you, serving as both an offensive and defensive force. This mystical sword can take on any appearance of your choosing and possesses unique properties that set it apart from conventional weapons.

In its dormant state, the Sword of Damocles resides within you as a concentrated pool of energy, ready to be called upon when needed. When summoned into existence, the sword hovers above your target, guided by an unerring tracking ability. This allows it to pursue and engage your designated target with relentless precision. It bypasses all defenses and immunities, ensuring that no obstacle can shield your chosen adversary from its wrath.

As you continue to employ the Sword of Damocles, its capabilities expand and evolve. Each successful takedown of a target enhances the sword's overall power and grants you greater control over its destructive potential. By eliminating multiple targets of the same type—whether they be humans, goblins, elves, houses, or even cities—the Sword accumulates damage multipliers specific to those targets. This means that future strikes against the same type of target will unleash even more devastating damage.

Furthermore, the Sword of Damocles possesses the ability to split into multiple swords, granting you unprecedented flexibility and tactical advantage. You can distribute the strength of the sword in any combination you desire, tailoring your attack strategy to suit the situation at hand. Whether you choose to wield a single sword at maximum power or divide it into multiple blades with varying degrees of strength, the decision is yours to make. For example, you can split the sword into two blades, with one carrying 25% of the total strength and the other wielding 75%. Alternatively, you can opt for a multitude of smaller swords, each contributing a fraction of the total damage output.
objects.title: Sword of Damocles

objects.text:
Each selection here allows you to copy any one fictional character—from an official source that you recognize as fiction—that is at most as strong as an Endbringer.

You gain the ability to use their memories, skills, and powers, summon any items significant to them, and even take on their appearance if you wish. You will also inherit any weaknesses or vulnerabilities the character may have had.

You can only have a single character active at a time but can switch between them at will.
objects.title: Character Install

objects.text:
You have the power to change reality! But, unfortunately, only in a very, very small format.
You can clean yourself better than the best shower. You can call for a pack of cigarettes, or a can of chilled favorite drink. You will never be bitten by wild insects. Heat and cold will be easier to bear. Simple illnesses, like a cold, will never drive you under the rug. Any clothes will always be clean and freshly ironed. You can summon a comb, a mirror, a pen, or pieces of paper.
Unlimited minor conveniences for unlimited daily tasks at your fingertips.
objects.title: Unlimited Utility Works

objects.text:
