As the King, you have an almost supernatural gift for teaching the art of thievery, and any thief you mentor will develop a deep, unwavering loyalty, ensuring their devotion to your cause.
addons.title: King of Thieves

addons.text: You’ve mastered the art of murder, making you a terror in combat. Your instincts grant you an almost precognitive ability to know when best to strike for the kill. No longer bound to a single form, your weapon shifts effortlessly between multiple shapes. Multi-wielding an array of weapons and tools has become second nature, and its adaptability has only grown—enabling you to craft even deadlier counters against your enemies. You can curse a demigod with god-slaying bullets while driving blades that nullify magic into their flesh. Though many still remain beyond your reach, you always have a tool that brings you one step closer to the perfect kill.
addons.title: Master of Murder

addons.text:
With your new acquisition, you've unlocked a powerful new mechanic: the silent takedown. This ability can let you instantly kill and takedown most enemies that stand in your way—provided that you can catch them off guard and be up close enough to capitalize on it. Once initiated, your body moves automatically, closing the gap in an instant to deliver the killing blow. A fleeting moment of surprise is all it takes to dispatch weaker foes effortlessly this way, even being able to bypass defenses that might have otherwise posed a challenge.

Against those on your level, however, true stealth is required—as they must never see you coming, never suspect your presence, and never even realize that they are being hunted. Such that from their view, one instant, they're alive, and the next, everything fades to black.

For enemies stronger than you, whilst this ability won't guarantee you a kill, it will deal a devastating blow. The severity of the injury depends on their durability, defenses, and just how much stronger they are compared to you.
addons.title: Finisher

objects.text:
Sneaking! Thievery! Assassination! These are the core aspects of what it means to be a rogue. You've developed an arsenal of powers that make you a skilled hand at the craft. Your agility, acrobatics, and flexibility are honed to the peak of human capability, turning you into a top-tier stalker. You can connect with shadows, muffling your footsteps in the darkness or bending shadows to conceal you from your enemies. While challenging, you can even dash through shadows or meld within the darkness itself.

As a skilled thief, you possess the uncanny ability to intuit how to steal anything. Your sleight of hand makes pickpocketing effortless. You know exactly the right words to con someone out of their fortune. Locks, safes, and passwords are mere stepping stones in your path to claim what’s yours. To ensure you can carry all your spoils, you can expand your pockets into hidden spaces, doubling their capacity to hold whatever you need.

As for assassination, you wield the ultimate tool—a formless weapon that resides within you, ready to take shape at your command. This weapon can transform into any mundane tool or weapon you can reasonably obtain: a vial of poison, a sleek pistol, or a deadly scimitar. But its true power lies in its ability to kill. Once you choose a target, the weapon adapts to become the most effective means of eliminating them. Against a brute, it might become a poison-tipped dagger suited to their skin. A telekinetic might find themselves pierced by a power-nullifying bullet, and a clairvoyant could be blinded by a stun grenade that cuts them off from the future. 

However, the power of your weapon is limited by your own strength—creating a gun that could kill gods or poison to slay dragons remains beyond your reach, for now.
objects.title: Street Rogue

objects.text:
Sneaks! Stalking on the down low! Congratulations, pal, you've become a creepy person who lives in a dark place but this time with superpowers! You're a phone call to the cops with a supernatural edge that will leave your victims never trusting their own senses again!

First thing, your body has been altered neatly, your physical condition is now two times better than it was initially without powers. Your kinesthetics are even more improved, you can balance so well on a plethora of things you'd put tightrope walkers and even those daredevils that walk from one skyscraper to another, you can do that too with no sweat. Your reflexes are cat-like, and the senses are also further enhanced; you can see and hear four times better and three times as far, and your taste is so exact that you can discern individual items in a dish or concoction  Your senses are also far more controllable meaning that you won't suffer oversensitivity as you dial them back when need be (you can even dial back your sense of pain as well if you need to). Finally, your metabolism is also altered making it so you can go up to five days with little food and water. 

Speaking about senses, Secondly, you can control the perception of others concerning you specifically from things that they see to what they hear. You could make it so that a person doesn't hear actions you make or feel what you do to them; tip-toe around without a sound, hell steal candy from a baby right in front of their mother. The only caveat to this ability is that you can only latch onto one sense at a time and it takes you five minutes to switch to a new one once you've dumped the old one. You start at a range of 10 meters and latch on to up to seven different sources (i.e. people or entities). This power does affect technology but will have to double up your focus on the piece of tech itself. Finally, depending on the sense that you switch to you will be able to detect when someone or something is sensing you and you can determine where they are in your range.

Thirdly, you can access the Silent Arts, a technique-based version of the manipulation power. You can create Glooms (this powers version of spells) through the use of Hushed Energy, a form of energy that you now wield and have a decent pool of that can let you cast up to five Glooms a day. Normally you can gain more by meditating in quiet places and being silent in general with a fully depleted energy pool you'd restore by meditating like this in five hours, but on a starless/moonless night and/or darkened areas will see it come back in less than hour you wouldn't even have to meditate to do so. Create a gloom that coats an area in darkness or muffle the sound in said area, create false silhouette objects to trick people, or even make hard-to-see shadow weaponry that can go through clothing/armor. But to create these glooms you must perform communion with the dark, if you want to walk through the darkness to travel greater distances you must study the shadows. If you want to create false clones of yourself, you must study your own shadow and its place in the world. To shape the darkness one must be the darkness.

Finally, you specialize in hunting, hidden/spying equipment, and sleight of hand.
objects.title: Street Stalker

objects.text: You have the power to unlock and lock anything you can imagine, from unlocking the secrets of an ancient tomb, opening gates to different dimensions, or even unlocking someone's hidden potential. This power can also be used in reverse to do things such as locking away someone's memories, making areas completely inaccessible, and imprisoning others by locking them away.
objects.title: Skeleton Key

objects.text:
When times get tough and you accidentally hit your toe on something hard, when the party has done something stupid and you are now screaming for help, or when shit has simply hit the fan and people are getting killed, they all scream for one being, a healer, and that person is now you.

You have great potential and capability in the fields of medicine and medical sciences, surgical techniques, anatomy, biochemistry, other various studies of the body, and just healing in general.

Your senses are tied to these studies, and as such, you are to diagnose people's current physical/mental state by observing them for a short time. But at the current point, you simply have intuition on each of these concepts, meaning that you more or less have "feelings" towards how they work and function and must study both literarily and technically, but these skills will be obtained almost five times faster than the average person. Medical technology and equipment are also a specialty of yours, from advanced x-ray machines to new forms of medicines to environmental protection gear to keep one's health up.

Finally, you have access to a unique form of supernatural art: the Healing Point. This art is structured solely for healing and has little to no combat capabilities. The user will gain a pool of chakra-based energy, allowing them to imbue their patients along their chakra points with condensed nodes of the healing energy. Once a node is established, you will gain information equal to your current expertise about the patient's current status. At this point, you could send the energy to injured areas, make minor biological adjustments, or maybe even supercharge their body.

Later on, you will be able to heal someone's mind and even their soul, but the path is long and dangerous, as you must also protect your patient's life. Who knows? You might even be able to bring the recently dead back to life one day.
objects.title: Doctor, Doctor!

objects.text:
Within the intricacies of decision-making, cognition, and behavioral patterns lie the omnipresent presence of percentages and probabilities. You possess the ability to exert influence and direct manipulation over this phenomenon through a mechanism known as "Diminishing Returns." This power autonomously detects and scans the surrounding environment, identifying any potentially malicious or harmful elements, even those borne solely from intent, and introduces a diminishing return to their impact.

Imagine a fireball spell that gradually loses all its potency and effectiveness after the third casting, or a sword swing that progressively slows down until it comes to an eventual halt after the third strike. Consider the adversary who, upon taking their third step towards you, finds their legs inexplicably frozen, inhibiting their pursuit. This power permeates every facet of life until the targeted aspects are rendered obsolete, nullifying their influence entirely.

The effects of diminishing returns operate automatically, though you possess the agency to toggle its functionality entirely or selectively apply it to specific individuals or objects. With time and practice, you can refine your control, honing the ability to single out particular attributes or aspects on which you wish the diminishing returns to manifest their effect.
objects.title: Diminishing Returns

objects.text: This power grants you the ability to harness the essence of genres and bend them to your will. You can seamlessly alter the world around you, twisting and shaping it into different genres of your choosing. Want to turn a medieval fantasy world into a futuristic cyberpunk haven? Done. Craving a romantic comedy in a post-apocalyptic setting? Consider it done. You have the power to mix, match, or create genres to create a captivating and ever-changing story. Your imagination knows no bounds, and through your power, you can create immersive and exhilarating adventures for yourself and those around you. With each new genre you introduce, the world transforms, offering fresh challenges, twists, and experiences to keep your journey endlessly exciting.
objects.title: Genre Shifter: Boundless Imagination

addons.text:
The Fate multiverse is a realm where power takes on fantastical forms, where the impossible becomes reality. In this world, your unique ability to win the hearts of even the most hostile beings has set you on a path of extraordinary consequence. It's a power that could be used to forge alliances with dragons, appease ancient spirits, or even charm the most fearsome demons. But within this chaotic landscape, your power has attracted the attention of a being far greater than any dragon or demon: Gaia, the Earth itself.

Gaia, the living planet, is a force of nature unlike any other. Her love is not a fleeting emotion, but a primal force that binds you to her very essence. She is obsessed with you, her love a constant, unwavering presence in your life. This is a love that transcends the boundaries of human understanding, a connection that runs deep within the fabric of existence itself. It is a love that will shape your destiny, and change the very course of history.
addons.title: Beloved Of The Earth

objects.text:
You gain the attention and love of one of the planetary bodies of our solar system, the eldritch and alien spirit of the planetary body is obsessed with you and will do what it can to assist you in all your endeavors using their conceptual domains such as war for mars, trade for venus, or leadership for jupiter. As your bond deepens with your celestial observer more of their domains are able to have influence on your life. 

Beyond this the chosen planetary body can also impart different traits to you as well, including the effects of their gravity as well as different aspects of their planet. The Spirit of the planetary body is able to focus all of the powers that fall under their domain through you, for you in order to influence and assist you in all you do. For a cost you and those around you that you target can be pulled directly to the surface of your planetary body, with all targeted protected for the trip. No matter what kind of surface your chosen planet has it will always be livable and buildable for you.

The more direct influence the planet is exerting through you, the closer it will appear to the Earth, it can do this without causing gravitational problems or other environmental hazards to the solar system.
The degree of influence your Celestial obsessor can impart to you and around you grows over time and with increased use, personally visiting the celestial body is usually a good method.
objects.title: Obsession of the Celestial Spheres

addons.text: Your stories are more than just words on a paper. They are realities your eyes see, your hand records and your spirit made true. After completing a story, you are completely aware of everything about anything in the story. You know the protagonists favourite food, the antagonists child crush and even the names of all the background characters. You are able to immerse into any of them, as long as they are not more that 10 times stronger than you. The more people read and know of your stories, the easier it is to immerse into the characters. After every immersion, a fragment of the character is left behind, slowly strengthening you.
addons.title: The Inheritor of Words

addons.text: You can enhance others, allowing them to immerse into the characters of your stories. However, the requirement of immersion apply on them as well and must be met in order to achieve immersion. If any of these requirements are not met, immersion will be impossible. After every immersion, a fragment of the character is left behind, slowly strengthening the target.
addons.title: Special Scenario

addons.text:
You can apply your power of immersion to one of your empty character slots if all four rules of immersion are satisfied, turning it into a character avatar. The details in the UI are automatically filled in with the appearance and traits based on the immersed character, allowing you to switch to it like a normal character, granting you the ability to wield the skills and powers without the usual strain of immersion. 
With time spent actively using an Avatar-type character, its desired skills and powers will slowly bleed over into your default character, eventually mastering everything the Avatar can offer.
addons.title: Character Avatar

objects.text:
In every world there is a story. A protagonist, an Antagonist, the side characters and more. Through this power, you can tap into all of them. You can gain the might of Hercules, the skill of Lancelot, or even simply the tenacity of an average Spartan warrior everyone forgotten of. You embody all their stories. But this is not without cost. There are 4 rules to become immersed into their story:

1. You must know about these characters, the more you know the better. To know all of Hercules acts, instead of merely his labors, will decrease the strain of immersion.

2. You must be strong. It is impossible to immerse into a character that is more that 5 times your strength. The higher the difference in strength, the bigger the strain.

3. The more similarities between you and the Immersed, the better. If you have similar goals, dreams and beliefs, then the strain of immersing will be decreased.

4. The more people that knows the stories or variations of the stories, the lower the strain.

Objects you hold that has a certain level of resemblance to the immersed character’s gear will be effected, gaining the power of said gear.
objects.title: Immersion

addons.text:
Now you can choose to create a sensory with the explicit purpose of being summoned, be it as a servant, familiar, or in any other capacity.

You can make this summoning be truly random, set some parameters for your sensory's future master, or even choose a specific character. After that, when your chosen master will next perform a summoning ritual, your sensory will be summoned in place of whatever or whoever they would've summoned otherwise. Be careful, as your sensory will be subjected to all the bindings that the summoning ritual would impose, unless it is strong enough to overpower it.

Lastly, you can choose to have sensory's appearance and/or personality tailored to your chosen master's liking to maximise compatibility.

If your chosen character cannot perform any summoning ceremony or ritual, you can still appear to be summoned by them, but the only thing binding the sensory to them would be their, or your own, will. Although your sensory's master would probably be greatly surprised at this development.
addons.title: Reverse Summoning

objects.text:
You can designate one person or group as your "Master." This bond does not require you to blindly follow their every command, but it does increase your strength when you do so. 

You gain a passive understanding of your master's needs and will acquire all the necessary skills to assist and meet their needs. These skills will be above peak human potential, becoming superhuman in their own right.

However, you will be compelled to assist your “Master”, such as cleaning and cooking for your “Master”.
objects.title: A Servant's Duty

objects.text:
You can designate a single target to be your opponent. You and your opponent will then be sent into a mirror dimension of reality, where the only living beings there are you and your Opponent. The only way to leave is to either:

1. Kill your opponent 
2. Have your opponent surrender 

If your opponent surrendered, you can give them 3 commands that they must follow. Be careful, since this works both ways.
objects.title: 1v1 Me Bro!

addons.text: Your bond with your animal companion deepens. Your souls are connected, allowing both of your understanding of each other grow. Any spirits absorbed boost not only you, but your companion as well. You are able to send simple messages to each other telepathically. The boost your companion gains are increased.
addons.title: Spirit Animal

objects.text: You can tame animals. The wilder they are, the more difficult. Animals will instinctively find you tolerable, its up to you to make them like you. Animals and you are able to understand each other to a limited degree. As your bond with the animal increases, the stronger the animal becomes. The more wild the animal was previously, the bigger the boost they gain. They may awaken powers based off other powers you have.
objects.title: Animal Tamer

objects.text:
Choose any mundane type of object that you will resonate with on a deep level than the rest of the world. This could be something like a multi-tool, knife, chainsaw, football, phone, gaming controller, hard-cover book, or even a Rubik's cube. You become extremely proficient in the use and creation of your chosen object, as if you've been a master of using or making them for decades, if not longer. You gain the ability to change your object into any variant it's known to have, whether it be it's color, size, or any other specific detail or variation.

You have an innate sense for your object, causing you to know of every instance near you, and be able to perceive the world from any instance's location, through any of your senses. You also gain the ability to manipulate your object telekinetically, with their maximum speed equal to the speed they could achieve from you throwing them, and the precision with which you can manipulate them equal to how well you could with your own hands.
objects.title: Object Resonance

addons.text: You can now designate a specific amount of land, scaling with your proficiency in farming, for cultivating alchemical ingredients. Whatever you grow in said plots is now optimized for its intended purpose. For example, Blue Mountain Flower and Wheat used for a (Skyrim) Healing Potion will have its positive effects increased by a factor of two, and completely negate possible side effects. Creations meant to be harmful or negative in nature will still qualify for the boost since that was the intended purpose.
addons.title: Alchemical Plots

addons.text: Your power over animals and farming have conjoined into a greater whole. All animals become much easier to tame, with the animals of the same species you’ve tamed before, becoming almost effortless. Any tamed animals grow to adulthood quicker, breed quicker, and have a much shorter gestation length, as well as having their natural constitution improve. Tamed animals designated as livestock will produce significantly more harvestable materials. Tamed animals designated as pets, companions, or familiars now experience a larger boost to all attributes.
addons.title: Menagerie

addons.text:
After having acquired a system alongside a dedicated power for farming, your system has now evolved with specially designated abilities to help you on your capitalistic conquering of the agricultural market. First and foremost, what this synergy allows for is perfect awareness and measurement of the crops you are cultivating in specifically claimed areas through a UI menu, such as growth rate, total growth, any particular issues in growing, etc. 

Alongside that first ability is a flat percentage increase to growth speed, harvesting speed, crop resilience, and crop yield that scales with your system’s total farming proficiency.

Last but not least, your system now has a supernatural agriculture shop filled with items and static effects that increase crop yield, automatically harvest crops, etc. 

(If this is taken in parallel with the addon Mystical Agriculture then you are able to apply all effects towards traditionally non-farmable crops, such as wool, coal, diamond, etc. as well.)
addons.title: Farming Simulator

addons.text: Through your abundant connection with life and nature, your communication with plants has fostered into an ability that allows you total control over your crops. When nearby, your control allows you to precisely guide your crop’s growth, dictating the direction in which their magical, medicinal, or nutritional properties lean. You’re even able to completely change an individual plant’s chemical make up over time. Additionally, your crops have zero chance to fail, meaning they’re all but inviolate to inside or outside phenomena that would damage them prior to harvesting.
addons.title: Herbivicus

addons.text:
You are not just a scholar and follower of Shennong but one of his original disciples. Having inherited his teachings and legacy while he was but a mortal before ascension, your personal connections with the man in life have granted you much more of a solid grasp of Shennong's mindset, philosophy, and who he is as a person.

Now, making the power your own through personal interpretations of The Way; risks of weakening your 'sight' through incorrect alignment of heart and mind with the Divine aspect of Shennong are now gone, with his lessons imparting upon you prodigious knowledge and wisdom of agriculture, architecture, medicine, etc., turning you into a great teacher able to pass on your legacy to the next generation, continuing the cycle.

Stand proud as you are the inheritor of his legacy and will upon the earth, walking The Way based on his teachings, shaping the world as you go.
addons.title: Disciple of Shennong

addons.text:
A latent talent and a unique power have intertwined, granting you a rather nifty little ability. Now, whenever you tend to your plants, your fingers take on a jade-like hue and emit a soft glow, allowing you to form a sympathetic connection—albeit a bit rudimentary, at least at first—with the flora you're nurturing.

Through this connection that you share, you receive a detailed, intuitive report on the plant's overall health and well-being. But this isn't all you can do. If you were to press your fingers into the soil, this gift would extend further, providing you with insight into the soil's condition, its potential, and actionable ways to improve it.

Furthermore, you gain a broader, more intuitive understanding of all plant life rooted in the surrounding area, including how each interacts and coexists with the others. This awareness will roughly start around the size of 9 square meters, but as your skill and attunement deepen, the range will expand accordingly.
addons.title: Green Fingers
Avaricious Menagerie
addons.text:
Your agricultural abilities can now be extended to animals, allowing you to cultivate Resource Animals—living creatures specifically bred and modified to produce useful materials. Rather than being limited to ordinary agricultural products, these animals can be developed to generate resources in the same manner as your resource-producing crops and bees.

You can create specialized breeds such as Resource Chickens that lay eggs containing metals, crystals, minerals, or other materials, Resource Cows that produce milk with unusual properties, sheep wool of varying exotics, or pigs, goats, and other animals that produce useful resources through their meat, blood, wool, leather, bones, feathers, and other biological products.

Through cultivation, selective breeding, diet, traits, and the influence of your abilities, these animals can be developed into increasingly specialized resource producers. Your bees can also assist their development by producing specialized food, honey, and other materials that encourage particular traits.

The resources produced by your farms can be processed and compressed into Singularities. These are extraordinarily dense concentrations of a material's properties, allowing absurd vast quantities of ordinary resources to be reduced into a single, highly valuable component. Different resources can be refined into their corresponding Singularities, allowing your agricultural production to supply the materials necessary for increasingly advanced tinkering.

Singularities also provide the foundation for a collection of ultimate recipes. By combining Singularities and other rare materials, you can reproduce the equivalent of the most excessive form of magic and technology: impossibly durable materials, extremely powerful tools, weapons, armor, and other.

In time, however, your farms can become a self-sustaining industrial ecosystem. Plants produce resources, bees refine and transform them, animals generate additional resources, and Singularities compress the resulting abundance into the ingredients required for your ultimate creations.

objects.text: Farmer allows the user to grow crops of exceptional quality even in subpar circumstances. As the user cultivates their crops, these plants can develop various magical traits that correspond to the individual's abilities. Additionally, the user can communicate with their plants, encouraging their growth and showing them love and affection akin to the way a parent would care for their child. Overall, this power not only provides a means of obtaining valuable products, but it also gives the user the opportunity to nurture and connect with nature.
objects.title: Farmer

objects.text:
You can create, summon, shape, manipulate, and utilize any kind of firearm with perfect skill. Be it primitive, modern, or even futuristic weaponry, each firearm is an extension of your power, seamlessly integrating into your hands as if an inherent part of your being.

From physical projectiles to liquid-based rounds, and even energy ammunition, you can summon and discharge them all with effortless precision. Without the worry about ever running out of ammunition.

You can only summon firearms directly into your hands. With your two hands filled, you are unable to summon additional weapons. Instead, you may instantly dismiss a firearm and summon another in its place.

You can't conjure ammunition or firearms capable of killing omnipotent beings on the get go, but would need considerable time and effort to manifest them (from decades to a century even, depending on how much you use and practice this power)
objects.title: Gunhead

addons.text:
Now you can use both Materialization and Copying to create pre-bound familiars benefitting from everything a normal familiar contract would grant.

Your familiars also gain the ability to move through any medium they are depicted in. If you have two paintings of the same familiar, they could use it as a two-way portal and even bring things with them if they can carry them. But its true power shows when you copy a famous person or materialize a popular fictional being, as now every picture and drawing will act as a gateway for them.

You can also change and improve your familiars, even the ones you bound through a normal contract, by drawing pictures of them and doing a fusion summon, allowing you to upgrade them with features from the new depiction of them. Drawing them in a swordfight grants them new skills or simply depicting them breathing fire like a dragon, giving them the ability to do so. Upgrading a familiar will have an energy cost based on their new supposed power level, so you can’t upgrade them beyond what you are normally capable of summoning, but they can evolve beyond themselves.
addons.title: Drawn Familiar

objects.text:
You are able to create objects and beings by drawing, replicating what you have drawn into the real world, and imprinting your imagination into existence through art and visualization. To start off with, your ability to create drawings is enhanced to the point that your drawings are indistinguishable from reality. Tricking the world into materializing what you have drawn into reality, however, you can choose not to bring into existence what you have drawn, instead saving it to be summoned into reality at a later date or not at all.

This ability is divided into two specializations: materialization and copying.

Materialization: is the standard ability that brings drawings that you create into existence, from objects to creatures. You can draw anything and engrave your imagination into reality. Your creations are not temporary illusions upon reality but instead are perpetual facets of reality, so long as you will them into being. Anything you create is loyal to you, so long as you do not try to destroy it for unjust reasons.

Copying: is the subsidiary ability of the two specializations, allowing you to copy something already existing in reality by drawing it into reality. Your copy is around twice as strong as the original and will be completely loyal to you and allow you to bypass restrictions that would normally be present on an object or creature you copy, removing weaknesses or limitations originally present in the original, such as only good people being able to wield a sword or a demonic sword stealing its users lifeforce when wielding it.

However, your ability to summon is currently equal to the amount of energy you have. With things that require more energy to bring into the world being off limits to your current ability, with training, you could bring anything you imagine and draw into reality. By surpassing the limits of the world and breaking the physics and rules, your ability to summon things is not limited, so long as you have enough energy. The more you use the abilities, the less energy it takes to generate objects into reality.
objects.title: Drawing Creation

objects.text:
Your body has gone through a metamorphosis similar in nature to Kodoku, a method in which someone would mix various insects in order to create the perfect poison. Your body has gone through a similar event as it was turned into a breeding ground for various poisonous creatures and plants. It combined to make the perfect poison. You. Your body has changed, granting you control over the various creatures that play host to your body, including but not limited to various poisonous insects of the highest caliber, such as spiders, poisonous centipedes, and other dangerous insects; plants such as nightshade, water hemlock, white snakeroot, castor bean, oleander, and so much more.

Your body has adapted to and becomes immune to poison and generates poison in your blood, sweat, and the rest of your body. You start with poison deadly enough to kill even those with a high level of regeneration and superhumans slightly above peak humans. However, the more time that you spend alive, the more deadly your poison becomes, as the insects that have become your new body create deadlier poisons. You can also increase the potency of your poison by ingesting poisonous or other deadly substances, giving you access to the substance and allowing you to produce more potent versions of the substance.

So long as even a single insect remains, you can reconstitute your body. You can also hijack a person by infecting them with your insects and possessing them, turning them into a new control node for your insects. Each body is stronger than a normal insect, being able to handle around five times the damage you would normally be able to and being just as strong. This also gives you rudimentary control over nature, but you can only control and grow plants that are poisonous.
objects.title: Sovereign of Poison

addons.text:
Your Gamer System now provides additional benefits to your abilities as a Sovereign of Alchemy. This allows you to automatically craft potions and transmute materials from your inventory or a designated location of your choice, with the strength, complexity, potency, and amount of these potions/transmutations being tied to your level. As well as having the homunculi you create being naturally able to craft potions and transmute materials as well, with the option of learning more advanced recipes/transmutations overtime. 

On top of these additions, you’ll find useful rare or esoteric materials and ingredients now dropping from defeated enemies. The materials would be thematically similar enough to drop but not have to align perfectly, such as Lung dropping draconic ingredients, or Kaiser dropping magical metals. 

Finally this addon slightly increases your alchemical ability.
addons.title: Automated Factory

addons.text:
Your Alchemical powers have fused, exponentially increasing your potential in the field as a whole. Studying and experimenting now takes less time to yield results, and said results more often align with the original intent of the study session or experiment. You are never at a loss for inspiration when it comes to new transmutations, experiments, and potion recipes. 

Transmutations no longer require a circle, take less time to perform as a whole, and either output more of the new material than initially used, or qualitatively improves the end result when creating life. Potions now require far less ingredients to reach their normal efficacy, and using the normal amount or more, qualitatively improves the product.
addons.title: Alchemist²

addons.text:
Having become a Sovereign of Alchemy and the study of Magicka, you’ve obtained all of the alchemical knowledge from the world of Tamriel. You are now among the greatest of alchemists such as Asliel Direnni, Gyron Vardengroet, and Annaig Hoinart, Whose feats are among legends in Tamriel. Such as creating toxic blood for vampires, immortality elixirs, and soul-killing poisons able to injure a split portion of a Daedric Prince. Your greatness between enchanting and alchemy even allows you to recreate the miracle of the White Phial, an artifact that will replenish <i>any<i> fluid inside it within a day. 

Additionally the quality of your alchemical creations and enchantments has increased by a factor of two.
addons.title: Tamrielic Alchemy

addons.text: You are now able to optionally imbue alchemical products with Prima Materia during their creation process or use it as a substitute for common or rare ingredients. Imbuing creations raises the quality of the end-product by a factor of five because of the introduction of the fifth element æther and allows for slow but perpetual evolution of its traits, effects, and abilities. Additionally this allows for transmutation of a traditional philosopher’s stone, opening many doors in the realm of transmutation and potion making.
addons.title: Perpetuum Prima Materia

addons.text:
You have now become a xianxia pill maker, gaining comprehensive knowledge in creating profound works in eastern alchemy. You are proficient in using pill furnaces and cauldrons to refine the essence of both normal and supernatural ingredients using fire or fire-aligned Qi. This enables you to produce highly sought-after cultivation pills, healing pills, and more. Examples of such creations include Body Refinement Pills, Blood Replenishment Pills, Dantian Condensing Pills, Heavenly Qi Pills, Lesser Healing Pills, and more.

The quality and potency of your creations scale with your cultivation realm, Qi control, alchemical knowledge, and the quality of the furnace or cauldron you use. Additionally, you can now infuse your Qi into ingredients during the refining process. You can also slowly cultivate ingredients with your Qi, granting mundane elements supernatural qualities or enhancing the potency of already supernatural ingredients.
addons.title: Pill Cultivator

addons.text: You are a true culinary alchemist! Having achieved a delectable blend of mystical cuisine and traditional alchemy your creations now benefit from from both of these fields. Like with sweet & sour or hot & cold dishes, you are now able to combine diametrically opposed ingredients to form unexplored flavors, or in this case, new and improved supernatural effects. Additionally what this boils down to for all of your creations is, a large increase in presentation and appearance, acceleration of recipe discovery, assurance that all creations will taste impossibly delicious, and an overall increase in potency by two.
addons.title: Hermetic Gastronomy

addons.text: ‘A series of tattooed bottles along your thigh, each holding different coloured ink’ Your mastery over Alchemy allows you to alter your potions in a multitude of ways. The three primary means are the development of esoteric inks, Internal alchemical development, and covert potion transport. Much like your potions, the inks you create can allow you to create powers to apply to yourself, but the interface with the Brand allows you to customise and alter them along the paths you desire. Using these inks also allows you to access potions whenever you please, by turning a potion into an ink, you can absorb it into your skin and gain its effects at will rather than imbibing the concoction. Finally, you can use your own body to distill potions, cultivating it through your Brands rather than requiring specialized equipment. This does not remove or alter the reagent requirements for your potions.
addons.title: Internal Alchemy

objects.text:
You are a lord of alchemy, the pursuit of magic and science combined. Alchemy has gone by various different names over the years, such as the science of magic, arcane science, chemistry, hermetic magic, and various other names. Your intelligence has been slightly altered, allowing for immense potential in science, magic, and the combination of both. This allows for the production of potions, homunculi, and other alchemical creations. You also gain a rudimentary understanding of biology.

A minor subset of this power allows for the transmutation of matter into various different states. Transmutation also allows for the creation of life via combining different species into entirely new entities, or using available materials to create such things as homunculi, chimeras, and other biological monstrosities from scratch. This also helps with the creation of materials needed for potions. These processes are permanent, so long as you don't change it back with further transmutation.

The more you study alchemy, the stronger potions you can create, eventually allowing you to create powers in a bottle. These powers can be based on your imagination, such as regeneration, immortality, and even fictional abilities such as the sharingan, to name a few, and are not limited to just the named abilities or effects. The stronger the ability or effect that you wish for your potion to create, the rarer the ingredients are that will be needed to create the potion, such as the tears of the universe, the heart of a black hole, and the emotions of an eldritch god, to name the more difficult to acquire ingredients. However, with time and skill, you can learn to forgo needing more difficult ingredients by using stand-ins; however, the abilities and effects that you wish to achieve will be slightly weakened depending on the value of the ingredients used as substitutes. Finally, you can also use potions as a method of pseudo-enchanting, by distilling them into items themselves.
objects.title: Sovereign of Alchemy

addons.text: By reading the writing imbued by your power, you can now gain the powers as well.
addons.title: Reading One’s Own Work

addons.text: You can now choose the specifics of the powers and how they manifest. You can also place requirements on the books, making it that only a specific types of people are able to gain powers.
addons.title: Details, Details

addons.text: When someone reads the empowered words, they will enter the story with some type of goal. By succeeding in the goal, they will gain the power. The strength of the power that can be imbued is now 20 SP.
addons.title: The Journey

addons.text: You can now imbue pictures with your power.
addons.title: Image of Power

objects.text: The user has the power to imbue written words with a supernatural gift. Once a person reads the words enhanced by the user, the dormant power within them is gradually unlocked, allowing the reader to access it. The user can imbue the writing with as a single power, although the shorter the text the weaker the power. The strength of the power can be no more than 10 SP worth, and the user cannot control the specifics of the power, only it’s general theme. Once it has been read, the word will lose their powers. At minimum, the amount of word needed to imbue a power must be equal to that of a short novel. Powers may manifest differently based on the reader. Whether the imbued power aligns with the written content's meaning is irrelevant; the power can be completely unrelated. The user of this power is incapable of gaining powers from their books.
objects.title: Skill Book

objects.text:
The darkness. The greatest primordial fear that is within all humans is the real reason fire was truly invented—the first animal to ever escape a predator—and the fear humans have of death. You embody the primordial fears of humanity. As the primordial concept of fear, your power is only as strong as the fear you induce in others. Those who see you have a chill run down their spines as dread takes over. However, it seems that you have lost a lot of power, and you will need to work back up to being the true primordial fear that you once were.

This power gives you several abilities to start with that get stronger the more fear you collect from those around you. You have the power to make people's fears a reality by bringing someone's darkest fears into reality. The more you understand someone's fear, the stronger the construct becomes, allowing you to bring into reality anything so long as it brings fear. You gain the ability to manipulate the shadows and darkness to an extent and manipulate a black substance that makes others have nightmares.

You are also capable of absorbing the fear of others as a power source, augmenting your own abilities to make you stronger, faster, more durable, smarter, and so much more. After absorbing enough energy, you can transform yourself into the fears of others. Changing your form and appearance, as well as growing exponentially stronger to match the person from whom you stole the fear, you also emit an aura of fear around you as you take in more fear from those around you.
objects.title: Lord of Fear

objects.text:
You have mastered the creation and manipulation of puppets. Others often say that no man is an island, but that is not true for you. Through time and effort, you can craft puppets. The puppets that you create are stronger than normal humans and can hold unique powers that are equivalent to 10 SP. However, with enough time and experience in creating puppets, you can create powers that are stronger.

To start with, you have the ability to create threads that can connect to your puppets to allow for control and even attach to people; however, doing so takes more strings than using them to control puppets. You can also use these threads as weapons, but they are only as strong as steel wire.

You can also use your power to transform others and yourself into puppets for you to control and give powers to; however, using it to transform yourself drains more energy than using it to transform others into puppets for you to control. When you transform yourself into a puppet, you possess a core that, if destroyed, kills you.
objects.title: Puppet Monarch

addons.text: Ah, your affinity for the primordial blood makes sense now. Elders are the beings whose Dreams shaped primordial creation, and you already have a Dream of your own. This harmonious fusion strengthens both your nascent Dream and your power as an Elder. Your Dream is stronger and more resilient, already beginning to mature into a true universe of its own, a transformation that is inevitable rather than an eventual possibility. Meanwhile, due to possessing a Dream of your own, you are much more in tune with your newfound nature as an Elder and progress much faster through the process of growing your blood. Additionally, your knowledge of Sorcery provides more immediate avenues for applications of the power of your blood, fueling your magic with its reality warping power while using that same power to bend the rules and reduce the rigidity of pure sorcery. Should you be learned in the Sanguimancy of the Elders then your mastery of the Hemovorian Art is greatly enhanced and accelerated, the potency of your blood nearly matching that of an Antediluvian already, and you find learning and creating new Disciples to be an easy and intuitive process.
addons.title: A Dream Of Your Own

objects.text:
You have been cursed with the blood of an elder. Long ago, before time itself, there was nothing; there were monsters, and the beings that existed were bored with reality and fell asleep. In the dreams of these primordial dreams, all of creation was created; however, every once in a while, one of the beings would wake up and reality would falter as beings outside of creation filtered their way into reality. Beings such as humans revered these creatures as gods, their minds unable to comprehend the magnitude of the elders. In search of understanding the children of the Eternal Darkness, an order of religious priests managed to capture a weakened Elder and kill it, and they drank its blood, transferring the slightest amount of power into them in return for what little sanity they had left. However, as time went on, they realized that their bodies could not handle the blood and transformed into monsters.

Similar to the priests of the Elders, you too have been enhanced by the blood of the primordials. Unlike the priests, your body has an unusual affinity for elder blood, allowing your mind to remain intact. Your blood allows you to draw upon dark and enigmatic energies from an otherworldly realm, tapping into the very source and fundamental forces of the universe. Your body has been irreversibly changed as you disregard the natural rules of the universe. You have gained immeasurable potential as the limits previously in place for your mortal shell have been unchained. Like those from whom you have gained your blood, you also gain power from others worship, as your growth in power is enhanced when given worship by others. As you gain more power, your body changes to become more like those who came before you, turning you into an elder.

As your understanding of the blood and its uses grows, you acquire more abilities and unique uses for the blood. You start off with powerful telekinesis and telepathy, being able to lift large buildings and throw them at your enemies and read the minds of anyone within range of a city block. As your elder blood grows, you can do more, such as affect the world around you, change reality to how you see fit, absorb the souls of others, manipulate the biology of others, bring the dead back to life, create monsters, induce madness in others, and so much more.
objects.title: Echoes of the Void

addons.text:
Due to the good karma you already possess, it has become a lot easier to find opportunities to do good, as well as making the places and people that need you much easier to find. Maybe an errant flyer flies onto your face, maybe you’re walking in the exact right place for the acoustics to carry a scream to you, or maybe birds cycle above a fight in need of breaking up.

The more you help, the more karma you receive, the more opportunities to help appear. This recursive loop makes it possible for you to gain an increasing amount of karma as long as you keep on helping those in need.
addons.title: One Good Turn Deserves Another

objects.text:
Tired of being a good person and doing good things without that paying off? Well, look no further. For with this power, the universe now guarantees that good things will come to those who do good.

Saving someone from certain doom will mean good luck and fortune; doing small good deeds will lead to similar things happening to you. People will feel a need to repay you for your good actions and help, though you have some control over how this need manifests, allowing you to avoid creepy stalkers and the like.

The magnitude of your deeds affect both how much fortune the universe is willing to show you and how much the people you help wish to repay you. No one will find it unusual how the people you help wish to repay you, nor that you seem to have good luck afterwards.
objects.title: Karmic Rewards

addons.text:
World-Weary are people who have been Tested and come out of it with insight, skill and a dramatic shift in karma. Well your burst of Good Karma now no longer came out of nowhere, instead it’s partly the result of a trial of your own design that will reward you with it. On top of the other benefits such trials can bring, you gain this Karma in addition to that which already get from Good Karma and depending on the trial you could naturally accumulate Karma within it as well.

What this trial will look like is up to you, one possibility would be to fall into a time-loop with a seemingly impossible goal you’ll have to fulfill, resetting to the point it started until you manage to complete the goal. Another might be some kind of gauntlet of enemies you have to defeat, a ritual that’s half puzzle, half following instructions that can be rather grim to execute or falling into alternate timelines until you manage to complete some kind of objective. Whichever it is, it will take either very long to complete or be extremely difficult.

You may decide when exactly this trial will commence, whether in the near future, before a major battle or right before you die, though you can’t change the date after it’s been set.
addons.title: World-Weary

objects.text: You gain multiple lifetime's worth of good Karma. This Karma is a subtle but pervasive force, adjusting how your environment and the people you meet react to you in subtle ways. From simply becoming more lucky in everyday life, to people having a slightly better impression of you than they normally would have and perceiving you to be more likeable in person, while those with a bad opinion of you are unlikely to compare notes. You can improve your Karma, but without a power that touches upon it you’re unlikely to gain enough for it to make a difference unless you act like a saint. Likewise you can also lose Karma, though you’d need to act like a ruthless murderer, killing innocents relentlessly to lose all of it. If you were to simply live a normal life on the other hand, your Karma would remain relatively static, granting you its benefits without using any of it up.
objects.title: Good Karma

addons.text:
Your control of time, space, and the curvature of space-time, i.e. gravity, has synergized and allowed you to ascend beyond the constraints of three-dimensional existence, awakening to the alien nature of the fourth dimension. Through your understanding of higher-dimensional reality, you can sense hidden paths unseen by others and slip through attacks and obstacles as if they exist on a lower plane of reality - which they do for you.

As your mastery grows, so too does your dominion over the fabric of dimensions. You will learn to move in ways that defy logic, reaching through solid objects by accessing higher spatial layers and existing in multiple places at once. Time itself bends to your will, allowing you to experience moments out of sequence, rewind and replay actions, or even step outside of time entirely, observing the flow of causality from an omniscient perspective. With time, you can even reach out and striding between the boundaries of worlds, step between dimensions with but a thought.

Your perception has fundamentally changed—you are no longer bound to a singular point in time or space. The past, present, and future blur together, allowing you to perceive moments of the past and future overlapping with the present. Eventually, you may unlock the ultimate truth of the fourth dimension, transcending linear existence to become a being unbound by conventional space-time and the flow of time.
addons.title: The Fourth Dimension

objects.text:
Gravity bends to your will; you have harnessed the harness, the fundamental force of attraction between all things. In time, you will be able to generate new sources of gravity, affect larger spaces, work from further away, and even begin to manipulate Gravity for more esoteric uses like creating force fields, balls of gravity that will implode, and eventually create even black holes that are entirely under your control. Until then, you are only able to weaken and strengthen the influence of gravity in a small area around you.

Due to your changed relationship with gravity, you now have an innate spatial awareness that allows you constant insight into exactly how the forces of gravity and kinetic energy act upon you. Your body has further acclimated, allowing you to be truly omnidirectional with a perfect sense of balance and vestibular system, helped out by your newfound spatial awareness.
objects.title: Gravity Manipulation

objects.text:
Space itself bends to your will—you have unlocked the ability to shape and distort the very fabric of reality. At first, your control is limited, allowing you to subtly alter distances, making objects appear closer or farther than they truly are. You can create small pockets of warped space, bending light to render yourself momentarily unseen or slightly shifting the position of objects within arm’s reach.

As your mastery grows, so too does your influence over the three-dimensional world. You will be able to fold space to create portals, compress or expand areas at will, and even isolate sections of reality into self-contained pocket dimensions. With time, you may command space to such an extent that you can rewrite the very concept of distance, appear anywhere at a moment’s notice, and create labyrinthine realms of distorted and non-euclidean space.

Your perception has also evolved—your mind instinctively processes spatial dimensions in ways others cannot comprehend. You are always aware of your exact location relative to everything around you and even the cosmos at large, making you impossible to be disoriented. This awareness grants you an almost supernatural agility, allowing you to navigate even the most chaotic environments with ease.
objects.title: Space Manipulation

objects.text:
You have obtained the power to manipulate time—a dangerous ability that few can master and even fewer can wield without succumbing to madness. Time bends to your will; you have novice control over one of the universe's fundamental forces. At present, your command over time is limited; this power initially manifests as prophetic dreams that reveal glimpses of the future, allowing you to see a few days into the distant future or past. In battle, you will eventually gain the power to anticipate your enemies' moves seconds before they even consider them, enabling you to evade and counterattack before they can react.

However, eventually, you can unlock further potential in your time-manipulating abilities. Eventually, you may be able to freeze entire cities in time, traverse parallel timelines, age things to dust in mere seconds, and much more, provided you gain sufficient experience in time manipulation. As you gain greater control, undo minutes of future events, loop time within a city block for hours, and more.
objects.title: Time Manipulation

objects.text:
The Bifrost Eyes take the form of a pair of crystal-like heterochromatic eyes that allow you to see anywhere inside the dimension you reside in.

When anyone calls your name, you can hear it as long as they reside in the nearby realities, as well as, with your right eye, instantly focus on and see the person calling. And with your left eye, you can teleport anyone or anything you see from one point to another in a beam of rainbow light, though not more than four people at once. The point of arrival can be any place you can see or one you have been to previously, and unless you are very rough, you cannot hurt anyone by teleportation itself.
objects.title: The Bifrost Eyes

objects.text:
You possess the ability to manipulate space, creating "doorways" that connect different locations and allowing the formation of new dimensions. During the creation process, your control over these dimensions enables you to specify various modifiers. For example, you can choose a mountainous terrain for mining ores or a tranquil grassy plain. One straightforward modifier involves determining the available space within the dimension. Additionally, you have the power to adjust other aspects, such as making it eternally daytime or perpetually raining without causing flooding. There are numerous other aspects you can modify; the ones mentioned are just a few examples.

Once a dimension is created, altering its aspects becomes impossible using this power. Entrances can be established either permanently or by granting permission to others to open doorways wherever they are. The creation of dimensions is a time-consuming task, with the duration depending on the specified details, ranging from a few minutes to a few months, or even more.

The owner of the dimension always possesses awareness of who is inside and their specific location. While ownership of the dimension can be transferred at any time, as the creator, you will retain perpetual access to all dimensions.
objects.title: Dimensional Dominion

objects.text:
Music affects everyone differently, especially you. Now when listening to certain genres of music you’ll experience minor buffs related to what that music can be commonly associated with. For example classical music may grant you a sense of extreme focus and mental clarity for the duration, or EDM may cause you to experience an adrenaline high that temporarily boosts your physical attributes. 

You can toggle this effect if you want experience music normally.
objects.title: Bass Boosted

addons.text: Your skill replication has given you a crucial link into others. Whenever you copy an ability with 108 skills, you gain access to 10.8% of their own pool of energy they could use to Alloy if they were taught. For most people this would be equal to your own when you first learnt the skill, but as with you, training would increase their pool, and in turn, the addition you’d receive from 108 skills.
addons.title: Pool of Ages

addons.text: Your ability to Alloy has given you a unique perspective on all of your variants. Now, you can Alloy various versions of yourself together. This provides you all the usual benefits of all the components gear and abilities as if all were ‘swapped out’ simultaneously. Additionally, as you are using your own pool for alloying, you would also get all the variants pools (though the majority would be at an untrained level)
addons.title: An Alloy Internal

addons.text:
As your appeal to random forces grows, and more and more begin to find you, your alloying can affect them with greater clarity. 

While usually, alloying disparate objects can result in lesser compromises (a mace and a sword cannot achieve both a cutting edge and a blunt object), Alloying forces attracted to your ‘perfection’ as a host will always maximize their compatibility in all ways possible. Two symbiotic aliens may shore up each other’s weaknesses and exaggerate strengths, a power serum and a magical sword may reduce the effects of antimagic on your new ‘power granting sword’ or turn the serum intrinsically magical to minimize the serum’s detection. Additionally, as long as they are alloyed, the resultant alloy will always count as one entity for the purposes of your maximum active bonds.
addons.title: Depth Over Width

addons.text: When alloying people, the differeing motrives and perspectives can cause internal strife in the resulting creature. However, your aptitude dealing with the troubled has provided you quite the boon. When alloying yourself and allies, you find that your minds synchronise with unparalleled unity. Where usually it would require at least a few moments to adjust for all but the most similar of people, you could now alloy five people, yourself included, in the middle of an intensive combat without any loss of concentration or even  disorientation.
addons.title: Sympathy

addons.text: ‘A Great eagle split into two parts, one half is tattooed brilliant red, the other is branded onto your skin. The more full your pool is, the more of the eagle is ink’ Using the Bond as a conduit, you can exert greatly increased control over your Fusions. When you are Alloying two beings, you can choose for a sigil to appear in your Brand and Bond, by inscribing it onto the subjects of a fusion, you gain near complete control over the outcome of an Alloying as long as it does not dramatically favour one subject over another.
addons.title: A Steady Hand

objects.text:
To Alloy is to fuse disparate materials together to become parts of a greater whole. In its native state, this is a pool of energy that can be used to fuse disparate parts into a cohesive whole with only a touch. These Alloys are at the very least equal to the sums of their parts. While the pool itself is finite, the energy can be returned by un-fusing Alloys back into their component parts. The pool itself grows slowly over time, but fusing disparate and interesting combinations produces faster development.

You must touch components within a short time frame in order to Alloy them together.

When fusing objects, you are able to influence the outcome, if not completely control it. Fusing a mystical sword and shield, for instance, may allow you to dictate the preferred form it takes, the shape of the enchantment that stays, or the way it manifests, even if it is not completely controlled.

Another avenue of Alloying is in the fusing of people. The alloyed individuals are, as with the object, a new entity that is greater than the sum of its parts. The individuals that made up the new entity are influenced in personality from their components, but remain with access to their memories and powers. As with fusing objects you can guide the form this alloy takes, and what traits are more strongly expressed from each component. This does not give you control over the new entity. You may fuse people and objects together, but the results are largely unpredictable, and can become unstable easily if the Alloying is not directed carefully.

The ultimate expression of Alloying people is by fusing yourself with others, in which case a few differences are notable. As you perform the fusion, you can guide it with greater detail, allowing further control to the outlook and personality of the fusion, however, any other components cannot be disregarded, and will always have at least subconscious impact over the fused entity.

The final aspect of Alloying is the fusing of different powers and effects. With it, one can fuse even entirely scientific phenomena and magical enchantment into singular results. The outcome is likely to provide unexpected results depending on the separation in source of these powers, but are guaranteed to at least be interesting and useful in different ways. Powers that come from similar sources are likely to Alloy together better, providing minor additions and mutations in comparison to alloys from sources alien to each other.

Unalloying returns all energy expended fusing the components and returns the components to the state they existed in before alloying. You must touch the Alloy to unfuse its components. When un-alloying people, they will share memories of the time alloyed to a similar degree to which they had influence over the alloyed entity.
objects.title: Alloy Fusion

addons.text: You can run your 108 skills through your warrior’s bond, increasing its intensity. When copying abilities from individuals you’re wielding, it is instead at 10.8th the strength of the original rather than 108th. This does not reduce the secondary abilities they’ve gained as a weapon from Warrior’s Bond.
addons.title: As Above

addons.text: Your ability to organize and refine the damaged and alien has altered your bonds. Much like how you can turn disparate members into an admirable force, when transforming them, they will synergise with each other. You'll always be able to use them all at once to their fullest extent, another manifestation of your unifying presence.
addons.title: So Below

addons.text: Your knowledge of Alloying has allowed you to guide the shape a person can take when you form the bond. It will still bear resemblance to them, a soldier may still become a gun, or you could guide it into utility for night vision. In addition, when Alloying people, their bonded forms will always alloy in harmonious ways.
addons.title: A Duality of Purpose

addons.text: ‘A longsword down your forearm, faux damascus steel lines run down, each in separate brilliant colour, each another Bond’ By exploiting the link between both you and your Bonded as well as the Brand’s properties you can, instead of transforming people into weapons with thematic properties, transform them into marks upon the Brand and Bond. When transcribed into your marks, the subject can perceive what you can speak within your mind, and have minor influence over the gifted abilities. You can suppress a transformed person by winning a clash of wills.
addons.title: Liquidation

objects.text:
You have mastered the power of a Warrior’s Bond. With a touch you may bestow upon others the power to transform into specific weapons & tools that bear symbolic resonance and resemblance to them. A great fencer may provide a foil for instance, or a forgemaster a hammer.

These objects possess secondary abilities that also correspond to the individual composing it, such as chilling frost, or slight manipulations of attraction. Additionally, one of these powers will always be the gifting of any requisite skill or ability to use the weapon or tool itself.

While it is vastly easier to bestow this onto willing subjects and allies, it can also be inflicted upon someone with a clash of wills. If someone is transformed like this can only return by overpowering your own will too keep them in this form. If kept inanimate long enough, this will will weaken and can eventually disappear entirely.
objects.title: A Warrior's Bond

addons.text:
Each Sphere now also acts as a focal point for your Reality Sculptor power, acting as the center for a new radius. Your own body can also be treated as an 11th sphere, allowing you to alter yourself without giving up another sphere for it. 

The max size and range of influence of a single sphere is increased to a radius of 1 km, the range of Reality Sculptor is increased by the same factor, and will increase as your spheres range does.
addons.title: Divine Domain

addons.text:
You can imbue as many spheres as you have into any individual to grant them multiple powers. 

The powers remain just as powerful, however you can choose to merge spheres, giving up an ability but increasing the rating by one per sphere fused.
addons.title: Multum In Parvo

addons.text:
The Manus Superior has been subsumed by the commandments. Functionally, this means you can use the Manus through each of the spheres as if they themselves were the Manus, allowing you to affect things outside their direct influence on a more limited scale. 

Inversely, the Manus can act as another sphere. Through this it inherits their properties, including their mobility, though if left to its own devices it will return to its position on your shoulder unless otherwise occupied.
addons.title: Manus Compartmentalised

objects.text:
You gain the ability to create and telekinetically manipulate ten spheres of malleable material, whose form and characteristics can be altered in various ways. The Spheres are imbued with three main abilities: Alteration, Creation, and Destruction. 

Through Alteration, all aspects of the sphere can be freely manipulated. This allows you to shape your spheres into whatever form you wish or alter its properties such as making it into an elastic wall that can bounce back anything that hits it at even greater force, turning it into giant balls of fire to scorch enemies, shaping it into dark portals to another location, or into invisible autonomous clones of yourself and much more. 

Alteration also allows one to alter anything the sphere touches or is imbued into. This can be used to do things such as heal those that are touched by or encapsulated inside a sphere or create master effects to manipulate the allegiances and memories of anyone under their control. By imbuing a sphere into someone or something, you have better direct control, allowing them to do things such as reshaping the landscape quickly or allowing them to command and communicate from afar. 

You can grant someone imbued with a sphere any power up to a rating of 8 (~20 SP), which you can alter at any time. However, only a single sphere may be imbued into a person at a time. Permanent alterations remain after a sphere has been removed; however, effects maintained by a sphere, such as powers granted by it, also leave when the sphere is removed. 

Through Creation, it gains the ability to create anything you can think of by ejecting it through its spheres, whether powerful blasts of fire, simple stone, inanimate objects, to living intelligent creatures. For something that already exists, you just need to think about creating it and your power will do the rest. For something new, you simply need to come up with the basics yourself and your power will come up with the complexities itself. Your power will fill any gap you may have forgotten about. Anything you create will be completely free of flaws you didn't specifically give them and any life you create will be completely loyal to you. You notably don’t have any innate control over anything created after they are fully formed and disconnected from the sphere. 

Through Destruction, you gain the ability to erase whatever your sphere comes into contact with. This only affects the direct portion that comes into contact with the sphere. This is not mere breaking down of energy or matter, but true erasure. This can be used to bypass almost any defense, and can even be used defensively to destroy any attack headed your way. This effect counts as an all or nothing attack/defense, and you can imbue your body with this effect as long as you have a sphere imbued into yourself. 

You gain you a set of secondary thinker abilities. One that grants you infinite multitasking, another that grants you subconscious awareness of your spheres locations and current active effects, a third that grants perfect control over your spheres, a fourth that grants you awareness and understanding of anything inside or effected by your spheres, and a final one that allows you to use any of your senses through your spheres at will, allowing you to perceive the world through them. Any of your other powers can be used through the spheres, and you cannot be harmed by any of its effects unless you wish for it. You can dismiss and summon your spheres instantly. If they were somehow destroyed, you can create a replacement instantly by summoning forth a new one. 

The size limit for how large a sphere can be is a 100 meter radius, more can be fused into it, growing by an order of magnitude for every sphere added on top of the first. For larger objects imbued with a sphere, the range of influence stops at 100 meters, growing by an order of magnitude for every additional sphere imbued into it.
objects.title: Ten Commandments

objects.text:
"Woe to the lawless and the disbelievers"

You have the ability to single out a specific target and transport them to a separate dimension, in the shape of a courthouse adorned with aesthetics of your choosing. The cardinal rule of your court is an absolute prohibition of violence within its confines.

Upon arrival, you will be presented with a comprehensive profile of your target, detailing their physical characteristics, behavioral traits, and any powers, skills, or abilities they may possess. Following your analysis of the compiled data, your role is to act as the prosecution, presenting a criminal case against the target. Simultaneously, the target may defend themselves against the accusations. To aid in your prosecution, you are granted three abilities, each usable only once.

1-Scales of the Manifest: A detailed list of all criminal activities the target may have committed against the law.
2-Monocle of Law: One circumstantial evidence supporting your claim and a hint leading to damning evidence proving the target's guilt.
3-Hammer of Truth: The power to compel the target to speak one truth in response to a question, excluding an admission of guilt.

Should the prosecution succeed, the severity of the punishment depends on the gravity of the target's crimes. They may permanently lose access to one power, ability, or skill of your choosing, be sealed within a unescapable dimensional prison for a specified period, or face execution through a capital punishment of your choosing, to be executed irrespective of any external influence, beyond the confines of the court's dimensions, and once executed the target death would be immutable. If the target successfully defends themselves, the court adjourns, and both you and the target return to the real world without any consequences befalling the latter. 

You can dismiss the court whenever you want, and this ability can only be used every 24 hours on the same target.
objects.title: Judge, And Executioner

objects.text:
For every person to like you for the first time, you get a Fan. A Fan is a minion that you can summon that possesses a powerset that is thematically appropriate to being your minion similar in strength to a 7 sp power. Fans do not count as people for the purposes of getting more fans.

Your Fans take on forms that are visually pleasing to you, are thematically appropriate, and if it isn’t against your preferences they will be chibi sized and shaped. All Fans when first created share a similar basic personality and body but can learn and develop beyond that. 

Fans are created knowing what you would consider basic common knowledge, detailed knowledge of your history, and are as mentally, and emotionally mature as required to be able to relate to you, and your problems. They are also utterly loyal to you to the point that not even having their minds shattered, souls twisted, or bodies corrupted will make your Fans betray you.

When not summoned by you for whatever purpose you desire of them, your Fans will usually stay in a pocket dimension.

This pocket dimension will only consist of environments that are thematically appropriate for you, and your powers, it also expands to always have enough room for your Fans, and you to live comfortably. You can travel to any location in the pocket dimension at will, with you possessing a sub-power to have a general awareness of the layout of the pocket dimension and the activities of your Fans. You exit the pocket dimension near where you entered.

Fans can leave the pocket dimension on their own to visit areas of reality you have visited, or with other methods of dimensional travel, though they’ll never be near you when you don’t want them to be.

Fans are immortal, they do not age and if destroyed will quickly respawn back in the pocket dimension in perfect health, and if the pocket dimension is destroyed it will be rapidly restored within a month so long as you exist.
objects.title: Tako Time

addons.text:
As a Librarian of Akasha, your encyclopaedic knowledge regarding the Akashic records has deepened your understanding to a far greater level. Whereas before you might have had difficulty searching and navigating the realm and records within it, you can now instanteously acquire flawless knowledge of the specific record you wish to modify. For example, this would include all the information contained within the record itself, its location within this abstract realm as well as the quickest way to navigate to it.

This significantly improves the speed and ease at which you can traverse this realm and so simultaneously the speed at which you might modify records. Your existance as a Librarian of this realm also grants you a strong 'sixth sense' for when any alterations you've made to a record would cause dangerous unintended side-effects upon reality and yourself.
addons.title: Prajña

objects.text:
You now have access to the Akashic Records, an abstract metaphysical realm existing outside of space and time. It is composed entirely of pure information that records and quantifies all things in existence.
