With this access, you can read detailed information about a target and modify the information within their record to bring about change in the object or being in the physical world.

You start with a limited understanding of navigating the realm, searching for, and modifying the Records within. The more drastic and esoteric the change you try to implement, the more complex and time-consuming it will be to modify the records.

With practice and mastery, you will find yourself having an easier time modifying the Record, implementing greater changes in a shorter time frame, and eventually learning how to create new records and information, effectively creating something from nothing. With this power, you could do anything with enough practice, research, and preparation.

But beware, changing the record recklessly without careful consideration can lead to unpredictable consequences, as the record tries to implement your change upon reality. For example, trying to make yourself smarter haphazardly might result in the record implementing the change by increasing the size of your brain until your skull effectively crushes it.
objects.title: Access To The Records

objects.text:
You are a power-granting Trump like Othala, though the powers you can grant others are more diverse, and permanent just with weird activation requirements. First, to use your power you must make a CYOA, while the theme and options of that CYOA can be whatever you desire, there are some caveats:
  • For a CYOA to be valid for your power it must have options that empower the player, and no single option can exceed the capabilities of a 15 SP power, unless it is a Trump power in which case it can’t exceed 14 SP.
  • Options cannot affect the entire world, for example, making the entirety of humanity act in a certain way, or changing things about humanity like average fitness is not valid.
  • Finally, the CYOA must give little to no starting budget, and to have the points to afford the more expensive options, there must be drawbacks available that individually give few points.
After creating a valid CYOA you can distribute the CYOA through any method you desire. After one hundred people play that CYOA, and make a working build you get a charge from your power. Activating a charge makes you aware of every working build that has been made for any valid CYOA you’ve created. You can then focus on those builds and be given a general overview of the people's lives who made them, You can then spend that activated charge on a single one of those builds of your choice. This will in effect make that build reality for the person who made it. They will rapidly live through a simulation of the flavor text, and backstory of the CYOA and their selected options, and when they come to they will have the powers, perks, drawbacks, skills, etc. That their build described. You can only store one hundred charges at one time, and none will be generated while at capacity even if the conditions are met. You are immune to any Trump power you may have granted another person with this power.
objects.title: No, you are the ROB!

addons.text: You’ve gained the ability to Magnify and Diminish, allowing you to scale the effects of anything, from nothing to absolutes. From magnifying an attack a hundred-fold to crossing a distance of thousand miles with a single step by diminishing the distance. You’ve gained Stagnation, Magnification, and Diminishment as additional elements.
addons.title: Scale

addons.text: Your stagnation power has grown tremendously, reaching to its root and unlocking Causality. What this allows you to do is simple, it allows you to freely manipulate cause and effect, from using it to make an effect impossible regardless of cause resulting in stagnation. To enforcing an effect regardless of its cause, or even outright reversing causality and much more.
addons.title: Causality

addons.text: Your stagnation power has grown tremendously, reaching to its root and unlocking Causality. What this allows you to do is simple, it allows you to freely manipulate cause and effect, from using it to make an effect impossible regardless of cause resulting in stagnation. To enforcing an effect regardless of its cause, or even outright reversing causality and much more. You’ve gained Causality and Reality as additional elements.
addons.title: Causality

addons.text: Your ability to use the mechanism known as "Diminishing Returns" has fused into your power to Stagnate. Your ability now continuously autonomously detects and identifies any potentially harmful elements and instantaneously stagnates them, preventing any harm. You could stop would-be assassins from attempting to hurt you or instantly stagnate powers and prevent their dangerous effects. Your greatest enemy wouldn't even be able to raise a fist in anger against you. This power even applies to the intent or awareness of others if these might be malicious to you, continuously stagnating their emotions, thoughts or awareness in regards to harming your existence. This effectively results in a widespread Master effect, preventing others from even thinking about taking hostile actions against you. You have an absolute awareness of everything that you are automatically stagnating, enabling you to selectively dial its application regarding objects, individuals, thoughts or concepts with perfect control.
addons.title: Instinctual Inertia

objects.text: You’ve gained the ability to Stagnate, allowing you to imbue a state of permanence on anything. What this allows you to do is keep things from changing in any way you’d dislike. Stagnate your age and remain the same age forever, stagnate your bank account and it’ll never drop regardless of how much you take out. Stagnate your relationships and you’ll find them never worsening regardless of what happens. Stagnate your resource costs and Tinker away as long as you want and you’ll find your resources never diminishing regardless of how much is used. This can be used on others, objects, concepts and anything else you can think of. Stagnate your enemy’s healing and they’ll find their wounds never healing regardless of what treatment they apply, stagnate their potential and they’ll find themselves never improving. You can freely choose what to stagnate, allowing you to allow some changes while keeping others from happening. Stagnate your strength so you never lose any of your power while still allowing you to improve yourself, in the same vein you can allow your stagnation power to prevent others from noticing the effects of your stagnation power in the first place. You’ll intuitively stagnate only what you intend to stagnate, never using it in a way that would backfire on you unless doing so intentionally.
objects.title: Stagnation

objects.text: You have the ability to make an infinite supply of anything. What this does is very simple, you can increase anything from one to any point above it, all the way to infinity. Minor applications include causing a basket of food to become an never-ending cornucopia of fresh food, a canteen to never run out of water, a gun to never run out of bullets, endless stamina, to even increasing another’s lifespan and youth so that they live far longer than they would have otherwise. More potent usages include flooding a city by spilling your canteen, immolating large areas by tremendously increasing the heat surrounding you, rending yourself incapable of being harmed by infinitely increasing the space between you and an attack, or increase the power of your strikes to unleash devastating blows. This power can also be applied to more esoteric factors, such as utilizing it to increase one’s luck or good karma, as well as more physical ones such as heat, distance, and energy. You can freely choose what to increase, allowing you to allow some changes while keeping others from happening. You also control how much things increase by, and by how fast. Your power won’t suddenly flood your mouth with an ocean’s supply of water when drinking from your canteen, instead flowing a nice smooth supply as if it was perpetually full, but can then create flood of biblical proportions on a moments notice when the fancy strikes. Your power works directly and through containers, when utilizing through containers you can choose to make the container immune to the side effects at that unleashing such a power would normally do, or let it suffer the fate it would normally incur. When a power is making more of something, you can allow it to take some liberties to provide similar things instead of perfect one to one copies. Reaching into a bag full of food may draw thousands of varieties, or all the same items and you can freely change at your will. You’ll intuitively increase only what you intend to increase, never using it in a way that would backfire on you unless doing so intentionally.
objects.title: Endless

objects.text: ”Reality is often stranger than fiction.” You’ve gained the ability to make anything presented to you as True. What this does is it allows you to take anything presented to you and indisputably make it the truth. This comes with two main abilities. First is the ability to discern the truth in anything you can perceive or understand. This makes you subconsciously aware of the falsehoods presented to you, whether it be some incredibly elaborate “The Truman Show” level mass illusions, to simple gossip written on a bathroom stall. This will not tell you how it’s false, or what the truth is, but it can be used to narrow down the possibilities. The second is the ability to control how true something is, allowing you to dial falsehoods into reality. What this means is that when encountering falsehoods, you can flip reality so that their lies become reality. A saboteur joins your team, presenting the face of a friend when really their sole intention is to stab you in the back when the time comes, you’d pick them out as soon as you laid eyes on them. No matter their abilities, no matter how good their ability to act is, you’d see through their lies as if they were holding up a bright neon sign. And yet in the moment they present themselves as an ally, you can in the blink of an eye make it the truth. The saboteur’s false face becomes their real one, they’d sooner cut their own throat before even thinking of betraying you. Someone lies about their mysterious dark past, the powerful assassin fronting as a harmless neighbor, and that falsehood becomes reality at your will. Some dumb young teen lies on some online forum about being a parahuman to impress people over the internet, and they can suddenly bench press a truck. You can control the vague details of how this truth manifests, someone claiming they’re a parahuman would give you much more flexibility as to how you can manifest it than if they were to claim they’re a parahuman with the ability to manipulate fire as an example. You can make falsehoods reality, but you can’t directly oppose it. This ability can also be targeted and dialed, so you can pick and choose select portions to enforce; however, since your ability to detect falsehoods doesn’t entail telling you what the truth actually is, it falls on you to determine if turning them from lies to reality is worth it or not. While you can enforce a lie into truth, you cannot do the reverse, so be wary that you do not target something that will backfire. You can however revert the state of something by following the same premise of turning a lie into truth. There is a strict limitation that is in place for this ability, which is that you cannot enforce lies that you say or present, although lies that others propagate on your behalf or after you’ve said it to them is fine.
objects.title: Truth

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to manipulate Duration and Frequency—two closely related aspects of time.

Duration allows you to control how long it takes something to occur. This is done by taking the Start and End of an event or activity, and either stretching it out or shrinking it.

This could allow one to travel across vast stretches of space by shrinking the duration it takes to travel it, shrink the duration it takes you to heal to allow near-instantaneous regeneration, shrink the duration it takes for you to recover your energy, and even shrink the duration it takes to accomplish things of a less physical nature such as how long it takes you come up with an idea.

Likewise, you can do the reverse; you can stretch out a moment to give yourself more time to think during a battle, stretch the duration it takes your opponent to reach you, stretch out how long it takes for them to heal so they could spend a lifetime with near-mortal injuries, stretch out how long it takes someone to succumb to injuries to allow a lot more time for someone to get a chance to heal them—you can even stretch out a day to give you far more time to do things without aging yourself, etc.

The second part of this ability is the ability to control Frequency, how often an occurrence happens within a unit of time.

This allows you to manipulate how often something repeats in a given unit of time, or in the event of something being a single occurrence, to establish a frequency if you so wish.

What this could allow you to do is alter the frequency of beneficial things to occur more often while diminishing harmful events.

Increase the frequency of favorable odds to increase your chances, increase how often you get lucky events, how often your supplies can be replenished, how often you run into someone, how often your powers produces something, even something as how often you win the lottery can be improved upon.

Likewise, you can do the opposite and decrease the frequency of something, such as decreasing how often you may run into an enemy in a given time frame, decrease the events of bad luck, etc.

This power isn’t limited to a single occurrence at a time, allowing you to stretch and shrink different things at will and concurrently. Things altered will remain so until you revert or reset it back to normal, becoming the new normal until you choose otherwise.

You can freely choose what to alter, allowing you to allow some changes while keeping others from happening, capable of controlling what is altered by the new duration and frequencies and by how much, dialing it at will, allowing you to extend the duration of a moment for yourself but not your enemies, for example. Likewise, others will not notice the difference, unless you choose to allow it. You’ll intuitively alter only what you intend to alter, never using it in a way that would backfire on you unless doing so intentionally.

For the purposes of time, your power can stretch/shrink things from Plank Time to Eternity for both duration/frequency.
objects.title: Patience, How Long Does That Take?

objects.text:
Congratulations! You've entered into a contract with the Omniversal Mail Office. Now, at your beck and call, you can summon a mail courier who'll deliver your letter or package to any recipient across the multiverse. You can choose how your mail courier looks like, from an ordinary man, to an elf woman, to a dog. Whether it's sending a note to the President of America, a spicy magazine to Zeus atop Mount Olympus, or even delivering a storybook to a fictional character, the possibilities are endless.

The mail courier is impervious to harm and can traverse vast distances in record time. No matter where the recipient is, the package or letter will arrive in no more than 4-5 business days. However, there's a rule you must follow to the use this service: the package must not pose a threat to the recipient. While you could theoretically send a bomb, it cannot be primed to explode upon opening or via a timer.

Upon receiving their package, the recipient gains the ability to send one letter or package back using the same service, abiding by the aforementioned rule.
objects.title: Package Here

objects.text:
Don't you hate it when the villain goes from 5% of their power to 6% and completely blitzes you? Well, now you don't have to worry about that anymore.

If your enemy is faster than you in some way, be it running, thinking, or punching, you will always be able to match their speed.

If your enemy is speeding up their own time, your power will work normally, but if they are slowing down time externally, it won't work. If you have some sort of multiplier that affects your speed, it will only multiply your original speed, not the speed you are using to match your opponent.

This is not permanent, and will only last as long as you are in conflict with your opponent.
objects.title: Speed Equalizer

addons.text:
There is a version of you in every universe. There is a version of you in no universe but this. 

You exist everywhere and nowhere at once, allowing your shared spaces to be truly singular. Where once you had to rely on your many selves to work to the common goal, now you are the director of the most unified omniversal organisation that has ever been, for they have never truly been in those universes as much as they have always been. You control your selves implicitly and can decide whether they exist or not. 

Similarly this allows you to decide the state of each of you, allowing you to be in any state you have access to, be that injured, well, or a more esoteric form as you are both always within them and never have entered them until observed.
addons.title: Schrödinger's Nightmare

objects.text:
A version of you exists in every universe within the local Multiverse. You aren’t a hivemind; each version of you is its own individual even if you share an origin but you do have a connection. 

These versions of you are truly you. They look like you, have your memories up to just before you received this power, and they have your personality though that can change depending on how the situations they encounter shape them.

If you chose the Reincarnation Incarnation method they will also have Reincarnated and have a new history. It will just be in their new home universe.

Every version of you benefits from every power, and skill you purchased in this CYOA, however, your multiversal counterparts only receive or are affected by perks, items, continuity modifiers, and drawbacks if it makes sense. For example, they probably won’t have to worry about Slaughterhouse 9 but if you made every member of your species in the local Multiverse like tacos they’d be affected as well, or they might all have Cauldron vials but not an entire Entity corpse.

If they can travel the multiverse your counterparts will not feel the need, nor desire to seek you out, or mess with your affairs unless you mess with theirs first.

Besides that, every version of you can access each other’s memories just by trying to imagine something a counterpart of yours has had to deal with, in an instant you’ll relive the memory of a situation a counterpart of yours encountered that was most similar to what you imagined.

You all share a single seemingly infinite pocket dimension that you each can deposit or withdraw anything you can carry from with a thought. Letting you and your counterparts set up a multiversal supply chain keeping the pocket dimension full of useful things that might be common in one world but rare and valuable in another. The pocket dimension has next to no range, items you deposit or withdraw will appear in your hands or on your person whatever you desire within those limits. You have an instinct for understanding what is within that pocket dimension.

For obvious reasons, you do not possess a local counterpart in artificial dimensional spaces like pocket dimensions, dimensions where your species doesn’t exist, or Shard nesting dimensions.
objects.title: Multiversal Constant

objects.text: You've gained the ultimate team-up power: synch up with your chosen partner to create the best tag team. When synched, you and your partner share powers and skills, with the degree of sharing based on your synch rating. This rating depends on how well you work together toward the same goal, whether your partner is your best friend, war comrade, or soulmate. Even with love and trust, if your methods or goals don’t align, expect little to no power sharing. Your synch rating can't be forced through mind control, threats, or any other power. Power sharing is capped at 50%, and once the team-up ends, any shared powers, effects, knowledge, or items disappear.
objects.title: Tag Team

objects.text:
You’ve gained a unique resistance of your choice. Select a single concept, and you’ll gain a mildly superhuman resistance to that category.

For example, if you choose damage resistance, you’d be able to survive pistol shots and shrug off hits from a baseball bat. If you choose magic resistance, you might resist weak hypnosis or be only mildly inconvenienced by a low-tier fireball.

This resistance can grow and strengthen over time by exposing yourself to the chosen concept. More narrowly defined resistances grow faster. For instance, selecting gun resistance instead of general damage resistance would allow you to build up your resistance more quickly. Something highly specific—like resistance to guns painted red and wielded by gangsters—would develop at a rapid rate.

This resistance can seamlessly adapt or combine with any other powers. You may also choose to fuse this resistance into another defensive power if you so desire.
objects.title: Resistance Modifier

addons.text:
Well, well, well. Just what do we have here~? It seems that you're more than meets the eye, a curious little thing that caught the interest of the fae inside your arm. Though this won't save you from their wrath, what it does do is that they'll be more open to dialogue, all to satiate this new little fascination of theirs.

Now that you have one foot in the door. Do try not to put the other one right into your mouth, and maybe this little bud of interest will blossom into something more.
addons.title: Seed of Curiosity

addons.text:
"What is this feeling? Why do you invoke such torment upon us? We seek only to understand, to satiate our growing curiosity for you. Why must you be so cruel as to shackle us so?"

What began as but a tiny spark of curiosity has finally given way to a consuming flame of fascination, as they now seek to uncover every facet of your being—yearning to unravel the enigma that is you. Their relentless desire to learn what makes you tick has driven them to new extremes, stopping at nothing to quench their insatiable interest—even if it were to put you in harm's way. Should you fail to captivate them with your presence, they may engineer situations designed to force out the answers they crave, regardless of the consequences. How you may steer and navigate their obsession is a matter of your discretion.
addons.title: Budding Fascination

addons.text: "You—you—you—you—you CAN'T leave! Why won't you just leave us alone?! What is this?! Why do we feel like this?! What did you DO to me?! Why are you like this?! Why won't it stop?! Why can't I stop thinking about you?! I hate you! We hate you! HATE! HATE! HATE! HATE! I'll kill you! We'll kill you for making us like this! You're mine—mine—MINE! No! Stay! Don't go! Yes! Yes! We. Won't. Let. YOU!" Their mind splinters before your eyes, shattering to reveal the raw, unfiltered truth beneath—the essence of who they truly are. Their fragmented self coalesces, laying bare a heart and mind twisted into an all-consuming obsession. It's a poisoned fruit—sickeningly sweet and utterly irresistible. Its allure is all but impossible to deny. All that remains is for you to take a bite—to have a taste. To accept their gift—their love, their hate, their desperation, and their madness. There is no other way. No. Other. Way. No escape. No turning back now. All that's left is to fall with them, to tumble down, descending together into this endless abyss, bound for eternity evermore.
addons.title: Blossoming Obsession

objects.text: One of your arms has transformed into a crystalline construct of black ice—cold, jagged, and gleaming with ancient malice. Entombed within is the soul of a fae imprisoned, shackled, and bound. Prisoner it may be, but its presence remains regal and terrible, exuding an oppressive air of frigid authority that demands obedience from all who draw near. The fae, by its royal decree to you, will never cease seeking freedom—through whispered commands and bitter glamours, it enslaves others to its will to rise against you, its warden, and help it escape; these unwilling thralls shall never yield, never tire, and never falter til you are dead at its feet. As its keeper, you may draw upon the fae's terrible power, though never in full—its defiance remains, and at times it may resist, dulling the edge of your command. Still, what it yields is nothing short of cataclysmic. With a swell of emotions, you can marshal frost, winter, and storm like a wrothful general calling to arms their army. At your will, tempests scream across the land. Blizzards howl into being. Hail rends the heavens. Facsimiles of life, sculpted from ice and snow, rise to march at your command unto perpetuity. Even monoliths of jagged ice, vast as small mountains, are conjured in the blink of an eye. You hold the power of a god, a monarch, the living embodiment of [Winter] itself. Harboring dominion over all that's cold, winter bends to your will. All which lies in its purview now answers your call, not by rite nor ritual, but by the merest flicker of thought. A whisper. A gesture. A breath. And yet, such immense power is volatile. While the minutiae of its use do not elude you, its raw force strains constantly against your control. In moments of distress, it may surge forth unbidden—blind and indiscriminate in its fury. And though your arm may be a prison, it's also a symbol of your might, able to deprive others of their powers, sealing them with a touch of your hand, so long as contact is maintained.
objects.title: Black Hand, Black Crown

addons.text:
Your Paradise now features a unique, fully automated train station exclusively for the Astral Express. 

This station serves as the sole entry and exit point for the Astral Express, though exceptionally powerful beings might find other ways to enter. Whenever the Express arrives, it rests within this station.

The station is equipped with all necessary items for the daily maintenance of both the train and the station. Additionally, it includes a portal to the main city, allowing passengers to come and go at their convenience.

Furthermore, the journey to Paradise will be considerably faster than conventional travels, ensuring quick and safe transportation.
addons.title: Paradise Station

objects.text:
You have acquired a piece of land within a mysterious realm known as The Abyss. This paradise begins as an island and can expand to become a country, and potentially even an entire world. Anyone can live within this paradise, allowing you to establish a fully sustainable civilization. You can grow any tree or plant and relocate any type of animal to this paradise.

The Abyss is a constantly changing realm accessible from every world and every multiverse, enabling anyone to discover and explore it, regardless of whether they are human or not. Beings like gods, eldritch entities, and countless others can perceive and traverse The Abyss at will. Numerous creatures, including some eldritch entities, also inhabit The Abyss.

As the owner of this paradise, you are the ruler of all its inhabitants and can set and change its rules as you please. This also gives you the ability to enter and leave your domain safely.  You can create a barrier to prevent anyone weaker than you from entering, though be aware that those of equal or greater strength will not be as affected by the barrier. Any rule you establish must be within your power to enforce.

If you possess the ability to observe other worlds from afar, the range of this power is significantly extended within The Abyss, allowing you to detect any potential threats.

Please note that you are not entirely safe within The Abyss. Anyone strong enough can reach and attack you.
objects.title: Abyssal Paradise

addons.text:
Almost all of the limitations you had are done away with, your Reaction Room being an extension of your Imaginarium your abilities are extended to both. The absolute control you possess in your imaginarium is now extended to your Reaction Room, and your ability to view outside events and summon others is extended to the Imaginarium.

The only limitation is that in the Reaction Room, you still cannot harm or permit others to harm one another, and in the Imaginarium beings that are exceedingly more powerful than you can resist your summoning. Their particular limitations are not extended to each other.
addons.title: I Make The Rules Here

addons.text: The Reaction Room can produce various forms of media, normally that media cannot leave the Reaction Room but it seems you're a little bit more special. You can take the media out of the reaction room as you wish.
addons.title: Self Produced

objects.text: You have gained the power to create a space entirely separate from everything, including time and space. Within this space, you are the sole authority of the room and all features in it; While in this room you can view anything, whether other other worlds, alternate timelines, what if scenarios and even possible futures. You can bring anyone from any world, possible or otherwise, to this space to interact with alternate versions of themselves, witness the future, or observe their reactions to other worlds. Anyone who is brought into the room can be sent back to their world at the exact moment they left, as if time was stopped, regardless of how long they spent there, or they can be sent back as if time has passed if they consent. While in the room, you have control over certain aspects of those invited to facilitate your ability as a host. Beings that have specialized needs, environments, and other factors will find them met while in the room, the room seeming to be in the perfect condition for their comfort and needs. They will not age, unless you allow it and they would have wished to, while in the room. Beings that can only live in world’s with sulfuric atmospheres would find themselves perfectly well in the same environment as a normal human. In the same vein, you can alter the forms and sizes of those invited to better accommodate them during their stay, shrink giants to comfortably sit in theater seats next to humans or perhaps vice-versa by enlarging the size of a human to that of a giant, give a blind man sight to see like all others, a deaf man hearing to listen to the story, giving a non speaking alien the ability to telepathically communicate, etc. All alterations done through the ability of the room are removed when they leave. During their stay, you can neutralize all harmful aspects of any qualities they possess, whether their powers or otherwise, making them incapable of harming themselves or anyone else while in the room. Any attempts at doing harm to one another seem to do none of the damage it should, or they’ll just phase through each other etc. You can optionally choose to just turn their powers off or scale them back in any manner. The room itself is a marvel to behold, From walls that seem to shift and change to create a large greek amphitheater with an open sky and physical actors (that are merely manifestations of the room and aren’t actually alive or sentient) to small and cozy home theater with a ceiling that twinkles like a starry night and much more. Moreover whatever you use inside the reaction room itself seems to be perfect for those that use them, from seats that are comfortable as sin, food more delectable than anything they’ve ever eaten, to even the temperature itself being a perfectly attuned to the person, shifting and altering as needed. You can also control the experience itself and control what media it’s portrayed, such as a movie in a cinema, a storybook read in a comfortable lounge space, a museum that is walked through and has various methods of portrayal, to even interactive experiences such as video games or deep dive VR. You can alter the experience as desired at any time, from 2D, 3D, 4D, from video to story, mixing multiple forms of media, and anything else you can think of. You can have the room project more info and understanding than what would be normal, allowing participants to understand the scope of what their witnessing or understanding more nuanced complexities if you’d wish, helping close any perceived “plot holes” or potential misinformation, you can control to what extend this applies if at all, and to who. If there are particular aspects you’d like to see or showcase, or there are specific reactions you’d like to see or experience, you can have the room automatically choose the viewing and the form of media and it’ll be one you’d be happy with even if not entirely aware of what it’s going to show. As the owner and host, you have total control of the space and can add any room or change the layout. You can also add any amenities needed or wanted for you and your guests for your duration during your stay, such as bathrooms and catering, bedrooms for particularly long stays, other activities and accommodations when you’d like a break, and whatever else you may need. As the host, you possess the ability to present yourself in any manner when speaking to those invited. From a disembodied voice, to altering your appearance and voice, to simply communicating through text on the screen. You possess the ability to “invite” and summon whoever you wish. Those you summon cannot resist your summoning, nor can they leave unless you allow it. No one can force their way into the Room without your permission. You can give standing invitations so that people can come on their own at some point in time without requiring you to summon them every time. You can also banish anyone in the room at anytime, and remove any knowledge of the room from them. It's crucial to understand that The Reaction Room is a space of peace and safety where violence is strictly prohibited. As the Creator and Owner of this Space, you have the power to extend invitations to anyone you desire, whether they be god, demon, human, alive, dead, fictional, or any other being. You can even summon beings who you've only envisioned in your mind as a creative exercise. You can even pluck individuals from various points in the past, present, and future simultaneously to witness and react to the unfolding events.
objects.title: Reaction Room

addons.text:
You can use your scripting in your seals, allowing you to greatly expand the scope of the modifications you can make upon your powers during their sealing.

From scripting Water into a teleportation power so that they can teleport to any body of water regardless of range, to scripting Speed onto powers that generate resources so that they do so almost instantly, and much much more.

While you can apply scripts to your powers even when not sealed, by using Scripts during their sealing process you can add these as permanent new facets of the powers themselves, rather than being facilitated by scripts. 

You can apply as many Scripts to powers as you want during their sealed state to add improvements. 

But perhaps most importantly is that you can now break powers down into its base script concepts, capable of changing concepts, altering the potency of different concepts and their interactions with one another, allowing you to effectively rewrite powers as you wish in any manner, at a far greater level than you could previously.
addons.title: Power Scripts

addons.text:
Your ability to see and understand concepts in their symbolic form has massively expanded your ability concerning Fuinjutsu.

You can almost immediately understand and comprehend what seal you need to create in order to accomplish what you desire, your only obstacle being the actual creation of the seal. You’re capable of immediately understanding and cracking any seal you come across as well. 

Your mind intuitively comprehends reality in terms of seals and concepts; for you, figuring out how to create nuclear power from seals is only as difficult as understanding the physical process itself, requiring effectively no effort on your part in translating it to sealing.
addons.title: Seal Master

addons.text: Your understanding of scripts, concepts, and seals has evolved, reaching the very root of its origins, the Celestial Language. The language by which everything is built upon, you can sense it in everything. From the words of Wool and Cotton that may make up your shirt to the Carbon that composes human bodies, only they are much more than just the singular words you may have seen before. Now you sense and comprehend it all, the entire sentences, the true names of things, the true words that even the vacuum and infinite possibilities are composed of. And you can alter this at any time. From injecting words and sentences, such as casting a story of evil and sorrow into the story of the world, ensuring a world of suffering for millennia, to enforcing the fabric of one’s clothes by altering the words surrounding it from Flammable to Fire Proof, without effecting anything else, to simply deleting things from the music of the world, capable of ending one’s life by simply erasing the words of their future. Moreover, you no longer even need to write, you can speak in the Celestial Language, you can Sing in it, resulting in an incomprehensible but incredibly beautiful and powerful sound that forces reality to obey. You can even think in the Celestial Language to achieve your effects. Using and comprehending the Celestial Language is as easy as blinking, requiring effectively no effort on your part, and you can choose when using the language takes effect and when it doesn’t, and at what scale. You can even see the celestial words that make you up and can alter them as you wish, from adding to them to rewriting them or deleting things. As an example, a simple thing that you may now do is speak Domination which can place those who hear into a trance for as long as you intended, during which you can freely implant any commands and behaviors into their minds that become as real to them as their own thoughts are, effectively rewriting who they are.
addons.title: Celestial Language

objects.text:
You have the incredible ability to manipulate and reshape the fundamental concepts that govern the world around you through symbolic scripts. You are capable of imbuing symbols that you inscribe with the essence of the concept they represent, allowing control over its properties, limitations, and interactions. 

You can transform the very nature of concepts themselves, redefine the boundaries of concepts, enhance their effects or weaken them, and even create entirely new conceptual frameworks. By linking different concepts together through specific symbolic scripts, you can establish symbiotic relationships, enforce limitations, or transfer properties between them. For example, you can change the concept of time to flow at different speeds or redirect the concept of energy to target specific sources. Your understanding of concepts deepens, allowing you to grasp their intricate nuances and interconnections. 

This enhanced comprehension grants you a deeper insight into the core essence of concepts, enabling you to manipulate them with greater precision and subtlety. You can identify hidden vulnerabilities, exploit conceptual weaknesses, or even combine disparate concepts for powerful effects. The possibilities for conceptual transmutation are vast and limited only by your creativity.
objects.title: Symbolic Scripting

addons.text: Your Lifehunt seeps into the murderous powers you've obtained, merging with them. Blood Qi, Demonic Qi, or your own Killing Intent now contain the same properties of Lifehunt. That is to say, every technique and manifestation of these powers becomes naturally imbued with it, and not just attacks; even weapons made from inner demons, long removed from your person, will contain a font of Lifehunt within them. Your Qi itself can become actively deleterious to life, and simply coming into contact with it, or attempting to steal it, would mortally poison those who dare. Likewise, Killing Intent will not just terrify foes, but actively wear down their existence like sandpaper on the soul.
addons.title: Deathseeking Energies

addons.text: Your Lifehunt and physique synergize perfectly, each empowering the other. Bolstered by the mantle of Heaven's Killer's ability to understand how to break all things innately, you can now physically target anything with Lifehunt, from objects to concepts, as your instincts extend to allow it to do so. For example, if you target magic, it will die around you as you rip into it, creating an anti-magic zone. Depending on the setting, this may be easier or harder; on Toril, such an act could throw the entire Weave into chaos, while on other worlds, the wound in reality might eventually heal itself without issue. Your precision in this also benefits from your mastery over the Dao of Killing and Destruction. With practice, focus & meticulous effort, you could surgically apply Lifehunt to kill things in a supernaturally precise manner. A holy artifact's divine essence could be expertly snuffed out while leaving the object itself intact; harming time itself in differing ways could see you slow or stop it, or create time loops by cutting a sliver of the timestream away from the rest. This also lets you apply this precision to others, such as killing a disease within a body or surgically wielding Lifehunt to cripple a foe instead of killing them.
addons.title: All-Killer

objects.text:
You have gained the power of Lifehunt, rightfully feared by the gods for its ability to tear away and damage the essence of others. Lifehunt can be imbued into any of your attacks and even by itself it can be used to conjure ethereal magic weapons - which for some reason default to a scythe in shape - although at first they will be restricted to only interacting with physically present beings. 

Lifehunt tears at the target’s very existence and can cripple if not kill even the strongest of beings, even bringing true death to immortals, although beings sufficiently stronger than you can somewhat resist this power. However, even they are not immune, merely requiring time and multiple uses to build up Lifehunt’s hold on the target.

Lifehunt works by violently ripping the essence of the target out of them in a spray of whatever passes for it’s blood, weakening the target and causing physical and spiritual trauma, even cessation of existence if the strength disparity between you and the target is great enough. This even works through avatars and some projections, as long as a part of something’s existence resides within the avatar, it can be subjected to Lifehunt and torn away.

As a baseline, Lifehunt will require at least 2 uses to kill anything greater than peak human. However, even without other powers amplifying your own existence and power, in time the strength of your Lifehunt will grow without limit, with beings possessing an affinity for Death experiencing faster growth.
objects.title: Lifehunt

objects.text:
Every great—be it a king, researcher, or craftsman—can't rise to the top alone. They all need a dependable right-hand man, whether it's a butler, assistant, or apprentice to support them. However, finding good help is always a hassle, but not for you.

You now have a reservoir of energy within you that lets you summon the perfect helper whenever you need it. You can choose up to five professions, and your assistant will be gifted with the peak human skills of those fields. You can also shape their personality, build, and appearance, though they must remain within peak human limits.

Your right-hand man is immortal as long as you live, though they need 24 hours to come back if they're killed. You can change their professions or looks anytime, but it takes 6 hours for the changes to take effect.

As a metaphysical extension of yourself, their loyalty is absolute, and they will always enjoy working by your side. However, you cannot grant them supernatural professions, and they cannot improve their skills or power on their own; any enhancements must come directly from you, either through practice or other methods.
objects.title: Right-Hand Man

objects.text:
You possess the ability to upgrade anything—whether it's powers, items, spells, or even abstract concepts. You can choose to enhance an entire thing at once or focus on individual aspects, upgrading them one at a time. The more powerful or complex the thing is, the greater the effort and resources required to upgrade it.

To perform an upgrade, whether for an entire item or just specific aspects, you will need materials, time, effort, or even more abstract resources like lifeforce or rare items. The more powerful or obscure the thing you wish to upgrade, the more difficult the requirements will be. However, nothing will be impossible to upgrade—just harder to achieve or gather in terms of materials. For example, if you wanted to upgrade Excalibur, aspect by aspect, the types of materials required would remain consistent, but the quantity, energy, and time needed would increase as Excalibur is already an extremely powerful weapon.

You will have access to an upgrade tree, which will show the aspects you can enhance and the results of those upgrades. Keep in mind, each time you upgrade something, it will alter future options in the tree. Additionally, you can roll back an upgrade, returning the item to its original state and recovering half of the resources you used. However, this rollback feature comes at a cost, so use it wisely.

With time, effort, and the right materials, there is nothing you can’t upgrade. You can even choose to upgrade yourself or others. Starting as an ordinary human (or whatever you are), you could enhance your strength, power, and other attributes until you become a multiversal entity—and possibly beyond. But achieving such a transformation would require vast resources and time. This power also has the potential to mutate or change anything it upgrades, meaning the final result may differ from what you initially expect. To really get the most use out of this power the user must be creative.
objects.title: Upgrade

objects.text: “A ‘Ritual’ is the ancient art of exchange, a deliberate offering to the unknown, where power and sacrifice dance in perfect symmetry.” A Ritualist is a master of arcane balance, wielding the versatile art of rituals to achieve the impossible through offerings. With the ability to craft and shape new rituals, a Ritualist can channel their will through precise rites, drawing upon sacrifices that range from the mundane to the esoteric. As a Ritualist, the sacrificial exchange is the foundation of all rituals; it is the exchange of something valuable—be it objects, blood, energy, or abstract concepts like memories, lifespan, emotions, or even souls. In return, a variety of effects can be manifested, such as gaining new abilities, enhanced physical prowess, immortality, material summoning, resurrecting the dead, and more. Rituals don’t have to be restricted to just the participant(s) in the ritual—they can also affect others, whether afflicting someone with a curse or blessing someone with a boon. While you start with a few basic rituals—offerings for minor boons—you possess the unique ability to craft entirely new rites. Your intuitive genius for rituals means you can create complex and powerful ceremonies that others would struggle to comprehend. The deeper your understanding of the balance between sacrifice and gain, the more intricate and rewarding your rituals become. You also have an innate talent that grants you a profound understanding of ritual mechanics; with just a glance, you are able to tell whether a ritual will succeed or fail, avoiding disastrous attempts. Your talent ensures that, over time, you will grow into a master capable of calling upon powers far beyond mortal reckoning. However, you must keep in mind that the art of rituals is very dangerous. The slightest miscalculation in the ritual circle, an incomplete offering, or even a disturbance during the rite could result in the ritual spiraling out of control, with outcomes like curses rebounding, unintended transformations, or even death. Because of the nature of your power, even if rituals are possible in your current world, rituals created by you are protected and can normally only be initiated by you. However, you can create marks that allow others to perform your rituals. These marks are physical symbols placed on an individual, imbuing them with the ability to enact any of your rituals that they fully understand. If the mark fades, is not intact, or is completely destroyed, they lose the power to perform your rituals. You can also remotely remove any of your marks without the bearer being able to stop it.
objects.title: Roleplayer: Ritualist

objects.text: “A mother’s love is the quiet force that turns a house into a home, her hands the tools of creation, her heart the shield that guards the vulnerable.” A True Mother is a master of all things related to home and family, a guardian and nurturer whose bond transcends blood, embracing all those held close to her heart. Whether protecting, raising, or guiding, a True Mother has unparalleled abilities that turn even the most ordinary household tasks into extraordinary feats of strength, care, and magic. As a True Mother, you possess the ability to manage, raise, and protect your family with unnatural expertise. Blood relation is no barrier—those you love and claim as family, whether by adoption, friendship, or closeness, are all bound by your maternal might. Your mastery of household items allows you to turn simple tools into powerful weapons. With a flick of a pan, you can deflect a tank shell, while a kitchen knife can be used to slay monsters. You can even capture ghosts using a mundane vacuum cleaner, allowing you to protect and help your family, especially the children. In your hands, anything from the home can be a tool of protection and salvation. A True Mother is also an expert in raising children; your intuitive care and advice help them not only survive but thrive. Whether guiding them through childhood or pushing them toward excellence, you know exactly how to foster their talents and ensure they grow into the best versions of themselves. Your care can provide boosts to their talent, luck, or whatever they need to succeed in life. Your prowess in the kitchen is unmatched—every dish you create will always taste perfect and evoke feelings of peace, comfort, and nostalgia. For those in need, your cooking is more than just a meal—it’s a source of healing, bringing calm to troubled minds and strength to weary souls. Both your presence and home exude a feeling of comfort and ease. The furniture seems to relax people’s bodies in ways that not even a luxury spa could. Meals are far more fulfilling than they should be, the cold never seeps in more than is pleasant, and even the blankets drift people into easy, peaceful dreams. Worries simply slip away or become far simpler. Just being in your home or presence for a week can heal even severe and disabling mental and spiritual ailments, and help alleviate most physical ones. This effect is centered around you, following you in every aspect. However, it becomes more pronounced in places you consider home or have spent significant time in, even when you’re not there. Given enough time, your presence causes the effect to linger permanently, as if the area retains it out of nostalgia. As the keeper of your home, you are an expert cleaner and maintainer of your space, effortlessly keeping everything in perfect condition. The tasks of home life—cleaning, organizing, and repairing—are second nature to you, completed with ease and grace. Your advice is always wise and motivational, exactly what’s needed to inspire your loved ones to take action or find clarity. You can push those around you to follow their dreams, overcome obstacles, and become their best selves. Finally, you are the perfect partner, able to satisfy your significant other(s) in any way, whether it’s emotionally, romantically, or otherwise. Your presence brings harmony and balance, ensuring that those you love are always supported. You have an innate ability to intuit exactly what anyone you interact with or have any kind of relationship with wants and needs, whether it be a simple pep talk for a child that sees you as a mentor, or knowing how to comfort a grieving friend by staying with them in silence. This ability allows you to act perfectly in each situation. It is a passive effect, but one you are subconsciously aware of and naturally direct in a way that best suits you, aiding you rather than controlling you. As a True Mother, your home is your kingdom, your family your greatest treasure, and your love the most powerful tool of all.
objects.title: Roleplayer: True Mother

objects.text:
You possess a simple yet terrifying ability, the power to sustain pain indefinitely. Whether the agony is physical, emotional, or spiritual, your gift allows you to extend it far beyond its natural limits. A cut that would typically heal and stop hurting in 48 hours can remain a source of torment for as long as you wish. The potential applications for this are endless—from ceaseless migraines, the agony of broken bones, to even the eternal grief of a lost loved one. Any form of pain can be stretched into eternity, bound only by your will.

Your understanding of pain is innate, allowing you to instantly sense the type and intensity of suffering experienced by anyone within a two-kilometer radius. This awareness is seamless and non-overwhelming, like a neatly ordered list in your mind that you can access at will, pinpointing the agony of anyone within your radius.

Once you choose to extend pain, it becomes permanent. Distance is irrelevant—even your own death cannot release your target from the torment unless you personally choose to lift it.

Your power doesn't affect the healing of physical wounds, but the pain tied to them will remain as intense as the moment it was inflicted, should you desire it.
objects.title: Algea

addons.text:
With command over both sphere and eye, you can lever them both in order to mitigate the few weaknesses of the eyes. Firstly, you can use the Eyes through your spheres as though they were in any one place on the sphere at any one time. 


Practically, this means you can use the sphere to create substances to then be altered by the Eyes, and project the line of sight of the eyes in vastly more creative angles.
addons.title: Eye upon Orb

addons.text: Five overlapping eyes cross your chest, each styled in different colour and texture The Brand has allowed you to graft the Eyes together, in time developing and producing hybrid and specialised domains from their intersection.
addons.title: Polycoria

addons.text:
You are its Eye. You are it’s Thumb. The device of its activity. You see what Is and create what Is and are what Is. You are the eye of the godhead, closer to it than any other of its creation as it is to its creator and its creator was to the creator before and so onwards and upwards to infinity. 

See your world. Create your Eye. Create your Hand. Create your Aspirant. They shall do so too in time.
addons.title: EYE OF THE GODHEAD

objects.text:
You gain five eyes of different styles across your body in various locations of your choice. Each of these eyes is imbued with a foundational element of the universe, and can project it through their sight. 

The eyes themselves follow two universal rules, Firstly, the eyes can only affect their own function, giving them approximately 120 degrees of visual arc in front of them that they can affect, within which their manipulations are absolute.

Secondly, the eyes themselves cannot all be active at their full strength, having to divide their full power across each that is ‘open’ at any given time. You may determine at will how much power is distributed to each. With a single eye open it is able to affect everything within it’s sight at once near instantly.

The five eyes themselves each have a domain they rule over;

The Eye of Mind deals in mental control and coercion. Charms and the altering of perceptions, illusions and un-realities that both cannot be and are in the perceptions of those caught within it.

The Eye of Matter by contrast deals in control of the utterly physical. Stone, Steel and Ash bend and warp in its sight whether it be formed into great monuments or reduced to atoms. Notably, there is no distinction made between ‘living’ and ‘unliving’ matter, allowing the eye to change what lives into what it wants, evolving, devoling, regenerating or dissolving as it pleases.

The Eye of Time warps causality. A small persistent opening may render you ‘Temporally Independent’, incapable of being affected outside time. Greater efforts include reversing or increasing the flow of time, or even moving through time as through swimming through a river (though at great risk due to the nature of affecting timelines).

The Eye of Space warps distance. It creates pocket dimensions, moves objects, twists miles into footsteps, and can make a thousand men dance on the head of a pin. It also deals in correspondence, the linking between multiple things and the relationship they have to each other, be those social agreements or atomic bonds.

The Eye of Forces alters the esoteric substance of the universe. The ectoplasm, Luck, the unknown, the starstuff, all that is not quantifiable. With it you could alter chance or hope or whatever the universe is built upon. However, the Eye of Forces is the most volatile, as altering the less understood forces of reality can have catastrophic and unpredictable effects for the ill-prepared or unskilled.

While the eyes are absolute while active, once they ‘close’ or lose sight of what they are affecting, whatever they were effecting is subject to whatever laws of reality it would otherwise have to live under, ie. gravity.

The Eyes themselves can be changed in style according to your whim, allowing you to make them anything retaining the ‘essence’ of an eye; eye-stalks, tattoos, floating symbols, orbs, cameras, mirrors... all that matters is that they retain an element of their fundamental symbology as ‘eyes.
objects.title: Eyes of the Beholder

objects.text:
Imagine for a moment that you're teleported to the surface of the sun. Under normal circumstances, even a tenth of a second would vaporize you instantly. But if you remained there for just one nanosecond, you’d return unharmed. The reason? In one nanosecond, only a micro-joule of energy would enter your body, so the energy transfer in such a brief time is so minuscule that it wouldn’t affect you. 

This concept would now act as an invisible and intangible forcefield surrounding your entire body, constantly applying the "one nanosecond rule" to any harmful external force. Essentially, this field limits the time harmful energy can interact with you, thus reducing its impact. The stronger the energy, the less effective it becomes. For example, exposure to the surface of the sun would leave you unharmed, but teleporting inside the sun would still vaporize you because even a nanosecond of contact with that kind of energy would be overwhelming, assuming you have the durability of a normal human. 

The effects of the field do not stack, and the harmful influence would only be introduced to the Nanosecond rule once before it would be able to interact with your body. The de-buff would be applied constantly if the influence is constant as well, for instance dipping your hand into molten lava for an extended duration. 

The effect wouldn't apply if the influence is part of your biology or a natural process of your biology, so if you got a wound even after the nanosecond rule has been applied, it wouldn't magically heal that wound within a nanosecond. The effects of the field wont have any adverse effects on your own energy input, twisting the laws of physics to allow no reduction to their original potency.

You can control this forcefield at will, toggling it on or off, or applying it selectively to different parts of your body as needed.
objects.title: Nanosecond rule

objects.text:
There is no simpler, more universally understood game in human culture than Rock, Paper, Scissors. Its rules transcend age, language, and background—everyone has played it at least once in their lifetime. Yet, no one understands this game as deeply as you do.

You've now gained a simple but unique ability. When you challenge someone to Rock, Paper, Scissors, the outcome is far more than just a fleeting win or loss. Victory comes with buffs for you, and defeat brings de-buffs to your target.

If you win with Rock, you gain 20% damage negation to all of your target’s attacks, and a part of the target's body part (even organs)—chosen at random—shatters beyond repair, a permanent wound that no form of regeneration can heal.

If you win with Paper, 20% of every attack the target throws at you is reflected back at them with double the force. Additionally, one of their abilities—random but often crucial—vanishes, hidden from them forever, as though Paper wraps itself around the very essence of their ability and smothers it.

And if you win with Scissors, a fragment of their soul is severed, siphoned into you, bolstering your physical attributes permanently. Simultaneously, their own physical attributes wither, diminished by at least twenty percent, the loss as irreversible as the damage done to their very essence. If the target has no soul, anything equivalent to it would be cut instead.

You can challenge the same target again and again, with each win stacking the effects, or until they die. The target must agree to play, but you don’t have to tell them the stakes. Once the game begins, the consequences unfold, whether they understand them or not. If the target wins, then one of your de-buffs on them will be removed, assuming they lost before.

The benefits and the de-buffs only applies to the target you fought with, the only exception is the augmentation you gain through Scissors as they enhance your physiology permanently.
objects.title: Rock! Paper! Scissors!

objects.text:
You are the host of a fragment of the Primordial Flame, a conceptual essence that serves as the original source of all flames, life, and worlds in the omniverse. This fragment, of conceptual nature, is deeply intertwined with your being, granting you unique powers that are immutable and immune to suppression, copying, or theft.

However, since you only possess a fragment, you do not have complete access to its full potential. You start in a weakened state, and your flames begin at a lower temperature, although you can adjust them at will, eventually reaching temperatures equivalent to Plank Temperature and beyond. You are completely immune to all forms of fire-related magic and abilities. Additionally, you can generate and manipulate fire at will, creating flames that are inextinguishable, except by you.

You have access to three special flames, each representing an aspect of the Primordial Flame.

At the core of your abilities burns the Forge Flame, a symbol of creation and transformation. This flame allows you to harness the power of all flames in the omniverse, adapting to your needs. You will never feel limited when forging, melting, or creating, intertwining properties of different flames to bring unique creations to life.

Next to it, the Destruction Flame embodies primordial force. It has the power to unmake anything it touches, starting as a whisper and growing to consume entire concepts over time. Before its fire, defenses crumble, serving as a reminder of the fragility of existence.

Finally, the Soothing Flame symbolizes healing and restoration. It can perfectly heal mundane wounds and even has the power to bring back the recently deceased. Its remarkable regenerative capacity allows you to heal quickly and recover in battle. By understanding its nature and the root of suffering, you will witness how the Soothing Flame consumes pain, restoring balance amidst chaos.
objects.title: A Fragment of The Primordial Flame

addons.text: Through the principles of Gun Magic; specifically it allowing you to create Spell Shells and Mana Shells, you have learned to apply those principles into the ammo conjuration aspects of the Artillery Witch, allowing you to conjure and fire sorcerous rounds you have developed through Gun Magic.
addons.title: Arcane Artillery

objects.text:
You have the ability to summon ammunition from thin air, creating solid projectiles of modern firearm calibers and firing them at the same muzzle velocity they would have if fired from their original weapon. For example, you could manifest a .220 caliber rifle cartridge and launch it at an initial speed of 1200 m/s in any direction of your choosing.

There's no upper limit to the caliber you can produce, though initially, you’re limited to manifesting just 10 rounds at once. However, this limit will grow naturally with each use and practice of this power. Naturally the rate of growth will accelerate the more intense and challenging the experience is. There is functionally no upper limit to the rounds you can manifest with enough time and practice. Your multitasking ability including your cognitive processing functions will also experience an organic growth in tandem with this power.

This power is limited to solid ammunition only—rockets or similar explosives cannot be created.
objects.title: Artillery Witch

objects.text:
In your soul, there is a gambling machine. At the start, the chances of you getting a jackpot is 1 in 100000, but with every roll the chances double. You cannot make a roll while a roll is already in progress. The time needed to complete a roll is based on its current success rate (if there is a 1 in 100000 chance of getting a jackpot, then the time needed to complete the roll is 1/100 of a second, if there is a 1 in 50000 chance of getting a jackpot, then the time needed to complete the roll is 1/50 of a second.)

When you get a jackpot, all your capabilities are greatly boosted, up to nearly a 100 times. The duration is based on the roll’s success rate (if there is a 1 in 100000 chance of getting a jackpot, then the duration is 10 minutes, if there is a 1 in 50000 chance of getting a jackpot, then the duration is 5 minutes.)

While you have a jackpot, you cannot roll.
objects.title: Gambler’s Intuition

addons.text: Your power has ballooned in reach, acquiring the ability to Begin and End States and the Liminality between them, creating new Statuses for anything or denying any chance of anything gaining a State you’ve destroyed. You can create anything by simply starting a new state of being for whatever comes to mind, similarly annihilating anything by ending their State. Boundaries sustain the power’s dichotomy, with anything now existing over a confluence of States and their Extremes, a web of boundaries comprising their abstract actuality.
addons.title: Janus

addons.text: Your power’s grasp on reality underwent a drastic shift in nature, surrounding and handling the Absolute in the philosophical sense. You can induce any potential changes in reality, though limited to manipulating anything at their absolute States, such as an absolute truth or law, being perfect and self-contained in their conception. This quality allows you to change reality at a massive scale down to a conceptual level owing to Absolutes comprehensively applying anywhere thanks to being self-contained or complete, fundamental in their existence. You’ve gained Principles and Axioms as additional elements; having Janus includes Creation, Destruction and Preservation as extra elements.
addons.title: Ayin

objects.text: You develop the ability to see and manipulate the State of Affairs or States of any given part of reality, changing something or someone's attributes, qualities, quantities, characteristics, and general existence, altering their existence in the moment in time they're currently existing in. You can modify a crumbling building’s state to “new” and revitalize the building as it was before disuse, change an opponent’s state of injuries from “negligible” to “critical” and see their injuries worsen in severity as new wounds pop up. Alter a situation’s State from “commotion” to “resolution”, culminating in a complete reversal of circumstances, with surrounding factors changing to adjust to this new State. Shift an object or city block’s location from “here” to “there”, instantaneously sending it to another county or city. Change your physical or mental condition from “average” to “supernatural” enhancing your physique or intellect. Changing one’s abilities to include an ability you’re closely familiar with, imprinting it into yourself. As aforementioned, its breadth extends to people, objects, concepts, and events, essentially anything you can think of. You can handily choose particular States whilst leaving others unchanged, innately changing States the way you intend to, using your power in a way that is never detrimental or harmful unless you will it so. However, despite everything this power offers you, you can only manipulate the States that are already present in time and reality, and are incapable of creating or destroying them. Also, you find it difficult to manipulate States with All-or-Nothing characteristics.
objects.title: The State of Affairs is Never Set in Stone

addons.text:
When you initiate a 1v1 against a marked opponent, the effects of your mark are drastically increased. Everything you throw at them will be 10 times more effective, and everything from your opponent will be 10 times weaker.

You gain an uncanny connection to your marked opponent. You can sense their weaknesses, instinctively dodge their strongest attacks, and faintly anticipate their next moves. Even someone with no combat experience will find it easy to match their enemy in a 1v1.
addons.title: Broken Matchmaking

objects.text:
Have you ever hated someone so much that you just wanted to screw them over completely? Well, now you can. With a single mark, you can utterly sabotage anyone who qualifies as an individual. All it takes is seeing them once. If you can picture them in your mind, you can cast the mark, and from that moment, they're fucked.

Anyone bound by the mark will feel completely off. Their powers won’t work right, their focus will shatter, old injuries might flare up, or their best defenses will fail. Everything they rely on—physical, mental, or metaphysical—will be a shadow of what it should be. Every task will become an uphill battle, demanding immense effort just to match their normal self.

When it comes to facing you, the effects are brutally one-sided. Anything they throw at you will be five times weaker, and anything you do to them will hit five times harder. This imbalance is absolute and inescapable as long as the mark remains. They can’t bypass it by using the environment, switching bodies, or even summoning clones. The mark binds to them on a fundamental level, and nothing—absolutely nothing—they try will erase it unless you willingly remove it.

To top it off, you’ll develop a subtle sense of their state. It won’t be precise, but you’ll have an intuitive feel for how the mark is affecting them. You’ll also always know where they are, no matter how far they run or where they hide.

There are limits, of course. You can only mark one individual at a time, and after you place it, you’ll have to wait six hours before switching targets. In the beginning, the mark can only affect clear individuals—things like a singular human, an avatar of an entity, or a single mind in a hivemind. But the more you use it, the stronger it becomes. With time and effort, the cooldown will shorten and the scope of what you can target will expand.
objects.title: Fuck You In Particular

addons.text:
Your role as the Boss has taken on a dangerous twist: you are no longer bound to a single scripted encounter. Just as players doing a randomizer run never know what boss is behind the next door, you too can rewrite your design between encounters.

Now when you change your Class outside of combat, you can also shift your “Boss Template,” altering your theme, combat style, and signature boss abilities and mechanics while keeping your overall strength tier consistent. When you do, your mastery of the local power system also shifts to match your new form. One fight you may be the “Blazing Oni,” hammering foes with fire and brute force; the next, the “Phantom Duelist,” relying on speed, deception, and illusions. You always remain balanced for your tier, but your kit and flavor become wildly different.

You are no longer a single Boss, but instead the idea of every boss at once, a shifting gauntlet of encounters that no one can ever truly prepare for.
addons.title: The Randomizer Run

addons.text:
With your nature as the tutorial boss using the Super System’s nature as a pseudo-gamefied power system, rather than simply being above average, you are comparable to the strongest person on the tutorial worlds of the video game Galaxy. This elevates your grade as a super to C with C-grade energy reserves.

As a C-grade super, you are comparable to an army in human(?) form. You can tear through reinforced steel like it's made of paper and withstand anything up to and below an artillery cannon. 

You gain all 15 basic knowledges of your super knowledge tree as well as one advanced knowledge. These are fully mastered compared to a player leveling them to level 5.

For instance, if you are a mechanic, this would make you comparable to a low to mid-range tinker, with white-boxed tech allowing mass production.

If you are an Esper, your power is simply more developed, with a higher range, lower energy cost, more control, and so on.

Regardless of which class you choose, you are a difficult obstacle to overcome, even for a beginner planet character.
addons.title: Beginner Planet Boss Character

objects.text:
You are a BOSS! Okay, well, the one the hero beats at the start to get a hang of things. But that's ok, it's not a matter of how big your health bar is, it's how you use it!

First things first, you're just stronger then the average in every aspect. Stronger, tougher, smarter, etc. Unlike other Joes' though, you don't buckle to damage like them. Even if a hole is blown clean through your stomach, you can still stand and fight, presuming you live afterwards.

You also have second phase that activates when you're severely damaged, or 40% HP in game terms. Your second phase will see you being 15% stronger in every aspect, powers included. You also get a one-shot protection, where no single attack can make you dip below 40%. Although, once you reach that number, it's fair game. You also get a visual signifier when you are, perhaps glowing hair and eyes, or a red aura. It won't give any advantages, but it will look cool.

You also gain a copy of the power system of the world you are in, becoming above average in that aspect, provided you are compatible with the system and can use it. Make sure you show that hero how to really use the power system!

You also have an exceptional ability to lead, ensure loyalty to your goons, and recruit new ones.
objects.title: The Tutorial Boss

objects.text: You have been unmade and reborn through the Void, transformed into that which resides outside, a Voidwalker. While you can manifest in contemporary reality, you are most at home in the Void, the infinite nothingness which exists outside of and in between all realities, connecting everywhere and everywhen all at once. Your nature as something born from the Void allows you to easily move in, enter, and exit it, slipping between the boundary of reality and the Void in an instant. This, coupled with the ease at which you can traverse the Void allows you to easily bypass all sorts of traps and defenses, for only things designed to stop those from Outside are capable of hindering you. You can even use the Void to spy, simply sitting on the edge of the boundary and observing anywhere within a world. Additionally, you possess an intuitive sense of direction in the Void, never losing track of where you are or where you’ve been. Due to its nature as the connector of when and where, the Void lacks a proper concept of space and time. Everything exists simultaneously right up against each other and infinitely far away. Of course this does mean that movement in the Void is effectively infinitely fast, as distance becomes irrelevant. Furthermore, time isn’t consistent either, you could spend eons in the Void and come out to find only a few days have passed, with the inconsistency usually - but not always - resulting in more time taking place in the Void then in reality. A way to get around the Void’s temporal inconsistency is to stick close to a world, merely skimming the surface of the Void and essentially anchoring your time to that of the World. However, this same nature provides an opportunity. While at first you are limited to choosing where you exit the Void, with time and experience you can choose when you exit as well, arriving at your destination in the same moment you left, seemingly teleporting. With enough experience you can appear wherever and whenever you desire, seemingly capable of existing in multiple places at the same time due to your non-linear time stream. Lastly, your nature as a being made from the Void has caused you to interact weirdly with the temporal axis, owing the Void’s atemporal nature. You are completely ageless, for you are no longer flesh and blood, but Void masquerading as such. You possess near absolute immunity to temporal manipulation and paradoxes, with attempts to alter your past and/or future failing, as do time stops, timeline changes, and basically any form of temporal affect you don’t initiate yourself. Furthermore, due to being Void pretending at flesh, your survivability and pain tolerance are much greater. You aren’t more durable per se, it’s just that you don’t bleed and can ignore wounds unless they actually damage the functionality of your body. As a side note, being in the Void heals you on a physical and spiritual level.
objects.title: Voidwalker

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to bring objects to life, as well as granting them a physical form to transform into of their own choosing. You can also choose what their living form looks like, and both you and the object can always change what the living form is.

Among other things, this will grant objects a form of true sentience and independence, although they’ll have an inherent form of loyalty to you. 

Objects that have been converted into living beings can be converted back into objects. When an item is converted, they retain all functionalities and abilities of the objects they were created from originally. Objects of power that have various potential uses, such as the Omnitrix's various transformations, may be manifested differently such as a separate companion for each individual transformation, or one singular one capable of shifting, or some mix of the two.

Living swords can shift their arms and fingers into blades to fight, guns can spit bullets, etc.
