They can freely shape into their object and living form, some amalgamation of the two, or just separate aspects, all at will.

They can also manifest their object form alongside themselves for personal use, although the object in of itself can’t maintain its existence far way from the original source when doing so, ammo and other secondary accessories are however fine.

You can also do this for your Objects of Powers, allowing you to create Superpowered companions rather than objects for yourself.
objects.title: Living Objects

addons.text: Listen. Listen to the great cosmic symphony which underpins all of reality. Listen and understand creation in its entirety. Your ears hear more than just the song which makes up physical reality. No, you hear the great cosmic symphony, the notes and frequencies upon which all of creation - physical and metaphysical - is built. Your Resonances can be applied to anything and become more conceptual in nature. While the effects of this aren’t as noticeable with Harmonic Resonances, Opposing Resonances can inflict a complete cessation of existence, mutually annihilating two notes. With enough experience and power you can unmake notes on such a level they cease to have ever existed at all. Your normal hearing has been further enhanced as well, enough to perceive and understand every conversation in a city simultaneously. Additionally, you also gain immunity to sensory overload and enough multitasking to understand and follow every sound you hear.
addons.title: Cosmic Symphony

objects.text:
Your hearing picks up more than just normal sound, it also perceives the strings and notes which compose the physical world, the ways aspects of physical reality bind together. More than just perceiving these notes, you also intuitively understand them as well as how to create Resonances, notes which either harmonize or oppose a note. This also allows you to understand things around you once you get good enough at recognizing what certain notes and strings represent, like listening to the strings of a spell to figure out how to cast it yourself.

Harmonic Resonances compliment a note, bolstering and meshing with it. From strengthening a sword to seamlessly merging two spells, a Harmonic Resonance serves to expand upon the great song which makes up creation. With practice you can even create notes which harmonize in just the right way to reshape a note, sculpting reality through song. 

Opposing Resonances, as the name suggests, oppose a note, stalling and breaking it. From crumbling stone and shattering spells to cancelling out mind control and halting motion, an Opposing Resonance’s only purpose is to bring an end to something, to prune notes from the song of the world. 

It should be noted that your Resonances need to make contact with their paired note in order to have any effect. However, Resonances can be imbued into objects, powers, or even projected into reality in the form of sound. While Resonances can be simply channeled into reality, this power is strongest when combined with singing or other sound-based powers, especially singing.

Finally, your regular hearing is vastly improved, capable of simultaneously registering and understanding every conversation and whisper in a massive crowd.
objects.title: Resonant Song

addons.text:
The synergy between Runic Developer and your power to manipulate fundamental concepts gives you the ability to create a safe environment for experimentation. By subtly modifying the underlying ideas that govern your runic projects—such as lessening the impact of failure or reducing the volatility in testing phases—you greatly lower the risk of disastrous outcomes. Mistakes that once had the potential to unleash catastrophic effects on reality are now softened or contained within a secure “sandbox.”

With this freedom, you can craft enchantments and wardstones that affect concepts themselves in remarkable ways. For example, you might create a ward that bans all violence within its boundaries or enchant a sword that heals any person it cuts. By blending runic arrays with redefined concepts—turning harmful notions into helpful ones—you break free from traditional "limitations" and explore innovative uses of reality-altering magic.

Additionally, your insight into runic design deepens, allowing you to spot errors and imbalances in your "runic code" well before they escalate. This heightened awareness reveals where concepts might clash or destabilize each other, so you can fix or refine your designs.
addons.title: Runic Sandbox

objects.text: Harness the very source code of reality with Runic Developer, a power granting you the ability to wield ancient runes as tools of creation and manipulation. These runes are fragments of existence distilled from the metaphysical to the magical, predating and underpinning every world’s fundamental laws. Through this power, you gain access to every possible rune—some so obscure you lack the frame of reference to fully comprehend them—and a basic understanding of their “language.” Think of it as having the full alphabet but only knowing a little of the grammar. By carving runes into objects or wardstones, or by tracing them in the air with specialized techniques, you can craft esoteric items, erect wards, or cast spells that reshape reality. The potential of these runes is nearly unlimited, allowing for both simple effects—like minor protective barriers—and massive miracles—like reshaping entire landscapes. However, to power your creations, the runes can be fueled by anything—physical matter, ambient energy, elemental forces, emotions, or even abstract concepts like fear or hope. You can also design them to draw power automatically from their surroundings once you give them an initial jump start. Think of runes as an ancient programming language that can do almost anything. Your skill depends on how well you understand their “syntax.” You start with enough knowledge to handle small projects safely. But to pull off bigger feats, you’ll need practice and experimentation. Because they are older than reality itself, even small mistakes in crafting or placement can cause disastrous effects, potentially rewriting the world in strange ways. Yet in the hands of a truly skilled Runic Developer, these symbols hold near-limitless possibilities.
objects.title: Runic Developer

addons.text:
Emotionstone can convert emotion into an energy with properties of electric, thermal, or kinetic energy in order to power technology. However, not all technology runs on such conventional power. Within the vastness of the multiverse, there are multitudes of technologies running on more unconventional and exotic energies, ranging from mana, arrangements of celestial bodies, ki, leyline-energy, blood, radiation, spiritual energy, lifeforce, even human sacrifice or souls, to name but a few.

And now you can tune your Emotionstone to produce energies with the properties of these energies as well. Tuning Emotionstone to a new type of energy for the first time takes as long as the Universal Power Plant needs to synchronize you to a new Aptitude or Power System, though just like with such Aptitudes, once the tuning is complete, it is permanently retained for all Emotionstone.

This greater range of replicable energy types also opens new utility, as beyond powering technology you can now also use the energy generated by Emotionstone to power rituals and formations typically requiring other sources of energy. Though the more exotic the original type of energy is, the more emotional energy will be required to replace it, meaning grander rituals, especially those powered by living sacrifice, must be adjusted to take significantly more time to accumulate the required amount of emotional energy. Which of course also means you need to be able to actually sustain the specific emotional state for the entire duration of the ritual, which gets exponentially more difficult the longer the ritual takes.
addons.title: Universal Energy Adaptation

addons.text:
Every single Emotionstone you produce now remains connected not just to you, but also to every other Emotionstone, forming a vast network. Through this network flows not just information, but any Emotionstone currently producing more emotional energy than the technology it's connected to actually needs can now feed any excess power into this network, at your discretion channeling it to a different location whose Emotionstone may not be producing enough to power all that it is connected to. In this way you can guide a glut in one location to compensate for the scarcity in another, as well as store a certain amount of emotional energy within the Network itself for later use, with the total storage capacity depending on the total amount of Emotionstone in existence.

Before you had a power source that could change the world. Now you also have a power grid that lets you distribute that power freely. Truly, the world is your oyster.
addons.title: Emotional Power Grid

objects.text:
There is power in emotions and feelings. Pain and suffering can break down even the most resolute, hope can sustain through the darkest of times, love drive to accomplish impossible goals. Yet this power is metaphorical in nature, not directly usable. Or it was, before you. You are able to create crystalline stones in a variety of sizes and shapes that can collect the Emotional Energy and convert it into a more usable form by giving it traits or more conventional forms of energy, such as electric energy, thermal energy aka heat, or even kinetic energy. On its own this can be used in combat to batter, burn, and shock the enemy into submission, though the constructs make poor bludgeons due to being relatively brittle and prone to fracturing under pressure, though the fragments maintain their conversion-properties on a much reduced level as long as the shards are no smaller than a large splinter. However this power's true potential only shows itself when used in conjunction with Tinker or other Technology-based powers.

Not only can your constructs, colloquially called Emotionstone, as a functionally infinite power-source so long as there is someone close enough to supply it with their emotions, but the generated energy will infuse itself into whatever it is powering, enhancing it. This has multiple effects. First of all it strengthens the object itself, protecting it from breaking down. Even the most volatile Leet-tech would only have a low chance of self-destructing, and only after at least a day or two of use. This strengthening also extends to the materials themselves. Want to build a giant robot but thanks to that pesky square-cube law the metal of the legs keeps crumbling like a empty beer-can under its own weight? Well, with an Emotionstone installed as a power-source, that won't happen. Well, not as long as you make sure to keep someone around the source often enough that the charge doesn't run out. Finally, the more energy flows through a machine, unlike with actual electricity which would cause a short-circuit, the better the machine will work. It'll be better at its task, whether that means just working faster, or a mecha that due to its construction should be slow and cumbersome moving with the same speed and grace a human would or better. And since the energy is emotion-based, it interacts with its user, reacting with their will. Basically, any machine powered by Emotionstone works on anime-logic as long as the emotional supply doesn't run dry.

You can also modify the scope of an Emotionstone's collection in order to increase the energy-output generated using various restrictions on what it absorbs. Using a general Emotionstone that takes in all emotional energy will produce relatively low yield, enough to power household appliances but not much more as the different emotions muddle together. A construct aligned with just a single emotion, whether that be love, hate, joy, sorrow, pain, pleasure, courage, fear, or anything else, which can be further refined to for example romantic or familial love, will produce the greatest charge of energy per second,  so that a single very angry heroic person with a Righteous Ragestone could easily power a mecha big and strong enough to fistfight a kaiju attacking his home, and its arsenal of energy-weapons.
Another way to refine the energy generated is by restricting from whom it can draw emotions. Restrictions can be anything, gender, age, race, even more abstract criteria such as nationality or ideology. You can even restrict it down to a single person or small group of people.
Combining these two methods leads to the greatest results, placing an Academic Stressstone the size of a fingernail set to only harvest from those under the age of 25 in a college exam room would in a day produce enough energy to power not just the campus, but the entire college-town for a month.

Close proximity to an Emotionstone for extended periods of time does risk side-effects, namely that those feeding it power will eventually find themselves adapting to becoming better source for it. This takes years at least to become noticeable, but long-term exposure to a Lovestone will make the people supplying it more caring, a Joystone making them more jovial and happy, while a Couragestone making them more outgoing and less risk-averse. This can also manifest physically, such as those feeding a Ragestone for years becoming more muscular while those fueling a Fearstone might find themselves growing shorter and thinner. These changes increase their quality as sources, being more prone to their designated emotion and feeling it much stronger extent than a regular person. In consequence this does mean that in many cases the person fueling an Emotionstone aligned to specific emotions may not be the best person to actually use the machine powered by it, as someone deliriously happy or furious beyond reason may not be fully aware of their surroundings. You yourself are immune to this unless you choose not to, and can choose to either amplify the speed of adaption for others or completely shield them from it with a thought.

While all Emotionstone will work best if you are at least nearby, beyond its creation Emotionstone is not reliant on your presence to function. So go forth, create a new world of sustainable and completely green energy powering technology once believed attainable only in scifi. Change the world.
objects.title: Emotional Energy Conversion

objects.text:
You have acquired a pair of Fiery Golden Eyes, imbued with the essence of Molten Gold. These eyes resemble those of Sun Wukong but are enhanced with abilities that echo the All-Seeing Eyes of Heimdall and the Clairvoyance of figures like Merlin and King Solomon.

The first fundamental ability of these eyes is the extraordinary vision range. You can see up to 312 miles in every direction, day or night, thanks to the built-in Night Vision. The second key power allows you to perceive dualities—distinguishing between concepts like good and evil, truth and lies, or wealth and poverty.

Your Clairvoyant abilities enable you to view the past, present, and future across any era. However, the further back or ahead you attempt to see, the more strained your eyes become, eventually affecting your physical and mental state. In addition to this, you possess the ability to use various Clairvoyant skills from any culture you know.  Your most potent Clairvoyant power is Present Sight, which has almost no limitations. Since you are always attuned to the present, it’s only when you try to access past or future visions that your eyes, mind, and body begin to strain.

The Fiery Golden Eyes also grant you the ability to perceive paranormal, spiritual, esoteric, and supernatural phenomena. Illusions are ineffective against you, as you can see through them; even those created by powerful beings are only partially effective, depending on the caster’s strength relative to yours. Much like Heimdall, you can hear or see anyone who speaks your name, whether they are on the same world or within the same solar system. Additionally, these eyes bestow upon you some of the lesser abilities of Sun Wukong.

These eyes are always active, with the basic abilities and a minor aspect of future sight remaining in effect at most times. When not in use, they appear as ordinary golden eyes. However, when you engage your other powers, they transform into their full form of Fiery Liquid Gold.  These eyes are powerful, but they can experience stress, and pain from overuse you have been warned.
objects.title: Fiery Golden Eyes

addons.title: Dirty Glitch
addons.text: If reality is an intricate system running on the source code of the universe, then you are a flaw within that code. An erratic glitch that refuses to fit neatly into the rules governing everything else, a mass of bugged code whose connection to reality is fundamentally different from that of anything else. Your primary way of perceiving reality is through its underlying code and the information contained within it. Where someone else sees a sculpture and understands its shape through ordinary sight, you can perceive the code defining its dimensions, structure, and physical properties. The more complex the object or phenomenon, the more information you can gradually learn to interpret through this perspective. More importantly, your nature as a living error gives you a direct connection to the code underlying reality. You can perform Aether Editing without an aether cartridge, directly accessing and altering the base code of existence itself. Initially, this is considerably cruder than using a cartridge, as you are effectively brute-forcing your edits rather than working through a tool designed to provide precision. You may be able to change something, but doing so cleanly and selectively is another matter entirely. With practice, however, you can learn to manipulate this code with increasing precision. As your understanding of both aether editing and your own ERROR powers develops, your control can eventually surpass what an aether cartridge could provide. You are no longer limited by the capabilities or level restrictions of a cartridge because you are the interface through which the editing is performed. This also allows the two aspects of your power to reinforce one another. Your ERROR abilities let you recognize inconsistencies, vulnerabilities, and flaws within reality that others would never notice, while your Aether Editing gives you the means to exploit, alter, or deliberately introduce those flaws. Given enough mastery, the distinction between finding an error in reality, rewriting reality yourself, and simply being an error within it can become increasingly difficult to define.

objects.text:
Reality is an intricate system, but no system is without flaws. You hold the power to perceive and manipulate these imperfections, transforming them into tools to rewrite outcomes and reshape the very world itself. From technological failures to metaphysical inconsistencies, nothing is beyond your reach.

This ability not only allows you to exploit existing flaws but also to impose new errors onto reality itself, bending the rules to your will. Machines falter at critical moments, natural laws twist to your advantage, and even the abilities of others can fail under your influence. You can distort perception, destabilize systems, and cause chaos in the fabric of existence. At its core, this power grants dominion over the concept of "errors" that lie between stability and chaos, enabling you to potentially tamper with fate, obscure your presence from detection, and even render yourself immune to certain rules or consequences.

At first, your power is limited to small errors and glitches—such as causing equipment malfunctions, distorting perceptions, or misdirecting an opponent’s focus. These small disturbances may seem insignificant but gradually form the foundation for greater feats with continued use or with growth in power.

With time and mastery, your connection to these flaws deepens. You may even transcend the rules entirely, becoming an error within reality—a paradox that defies the natural order. As an anomaly, you might evade cause-and-effect chains, exist in multiple states simultaneously, or influence probabilities to ensure outcomes favor your intent. Such a state grants unparalleled freedom, as you operate outside the constraints that bind everything else.

From subtle manipulations like jamming a weapon or misdirecting an enemy, to grand feats such as warping space, traversing time, or cheating death, the possibilities are boundless. With each flaw you uncover or create, the cracks in reality become your path to power, making the imperfections of existence your greatest strength.
objects.title: ERROR

objects.text:
Darkness, both physical and metaphorical, is an unfortunate fact of life. The world can be a horrible and uncaring place. However, with you around, this will slowly change.

Anywhere you are, live, or rule, you begin to banish this metaphysical darkness, this spiritual creeping rot. And shine a brighter light onto the world. People will grow more compassionate, more tolerant of others, more helpful, more virtuous, more filled with joy, hope and happiness. The shadows of society and the world will appear to draw back, as the landscape and buildings, even at their lowest, seem more gracefully aged and welcoming than run-down.

The more you spread this metaphorical light around you, the more you make the world better, and the more the world around you will help you back. Something as little as a cookie freshly baked by your neighbor, given for free, or just random people stopping by to help you if your car broke down. This isn’t just limited to people either; the world itself will remember your betterment of it, and make sure your day off is nice and sunny, or that your fishing trip has plenty of catches. Even getting people to truly listen to you and act when you speak up against injustice or corruption.

When you act against the forces of darkness, you will not stand alone. Naturally, the forces of despair and darkness will notice your effects on the world and will likely hate you for them, but even if they find out it’s you who is the cause, they will have a very difficult time getting a hand in your territory, so to speak. They will find making inroads into your sphere of influence damn near impossible and will quickly lose the agents and resources they had there to begin with.
objects.title: Light Bringer

objects.text:
Darkness, both physical and metaphorical, is an unfortunate fact of life. The world can be a horrible and uncaring place. And with you around, this will only exacerbate.

Where ever you go, you stain the land with your presence. The longer you reside in an area, the greater the spiritual rot of darkness will grow, smothering the light in its coldness. People will begin to grow ever more fearful, distrusting of their fellow man as the world slides into the dark. Power structures will twist and contort into dark mirrors of their former selves, serving to benefit the few at the cost of the many.

Those who seek to do good, those seemingly perfect paragons of justice shall suffer for their goodness as the world turns against them. Their deeds will be spurned by the people, their heroics failing to inspire others to do the same. Eventually, they too shall succumb, falling into apathy as they realize everything they had done was for naught. 

And ultimately, this will come to benefit you. The forces of darkness will realize that you are their greatest weapon against the light, and treat you as their messiah. Those tempted by the senses with the cruelest of intentions will do anything to please you in order to keep their fragile hold on power.

Once your rot has set in, it is nearly impossible to remove. Outside attempts to inspire hope within the people under your rule will be met with harsh resistance from the people themselves. They will fear change, they will see your rule as the way it must be, as what is natural. Any attempts to change their minds will be met with scorn as people dare not hope again. Ironically, the people themselves will become your greatest tool, as they fight for their own stagnation.
objects.title: Shadow Bringer

addons.text:
Your light doesn’t just inspire—it commands. Radiant Dominion is the manifestation of your will made manifest, a domain where your vision of order and unity becomes reality. Within your Domain, the world reshapes itself to reflect your vision. Crumbling structures repair themselves as your light weaves into their foundations, mending cracks and restoring strength. 

Barren fields bloom with life, nurtured by Viridian Light, while the air hums with the clarity of Azure Light and the authority of Amethyst Light. This domain grows in size and potency as your mastery deepens, eventually encompassing entire cities or regions.

Those who dwell within your domain find themselves subtly influenced by your light. Crimson Light fuels their passion and determination, driving them to stand against oppression. Azure Light sharpens their minds, allowing them to see the truth in your vision. 

Viridian Light heals their spirits, mending emotional wounds, while Amethyst Light enforces order and justice. Even the incomprehensible aspects of Black Light shield your domain from external threats, obscuring it from the sight of your enemies.

At the pinnacle of your power, your Domain of Light becomes a realm unto itself, a place where your will is absolute. The land within your domain is no longer bound by the laws of the outside world; it becomes a reflection of your ideals. 

Rivers flow with liquid light, trees grow in perfect symmetry, and the air hums with the resonance of your authority. Those who enter your domain find their thoughts and actions aligning with your vision, their very beings touched by your light. 

This is the ultimate expression of Radiant Dominion, a testament to your mastery over the Light of Origin and your ability to shape the world into a bastion of order and unity.
addons.title: Radiant Dominion

objects.text:
You have obtained a piece of pure Creation, a fragment of the Light of Origin—the essence of existence itself, the primal force from which all things spring and to which all things return. It is the One Light without Duality or Opposition, a radiance so pure and absolute that it transcends all understanding. 

To wield even a fragment of this light is to touch the infinite, to hold a spark of the power that births stars, shapes worlds, and awakens souls. Even what humans perceive as black is but a shade of this light, a color beyond comprehension that exists in higher realms, where light and darkness are one and the same.

At first, your light manifests in a form suited to your personality, a reflection of your essence and will. In the beginning, your control is limited to physical and mental expressions of its power. 

Those who wield Crimson may burn a car to slag or ignite a roaring bonfire, their tempers flaring as hot as the flames they conjure. Those who channel Cyan might freeze a small lake or sharpen their mind to solve complex problems, their thoughts as clear and precise as the ice they create. 

Viridian could heal a wound or cause a tree to grow in moments, their touch bringing life and vitality to the world around them. Amethyst might sway a small group of people or impose order on chaotic situations, their presence commanding respect and obedience. These are the humble beginnings of a power that knows no true limits.

As your mastery grows, your light transcends the physical and mental, reaching into the realm of the conceptual. A wielder of Crimson might ignite not just flames, but the very concept of passion, burning away apathy or fueling an unbreakable will in others. A master of Cyan could freeze not just water, but the flow of time itself, or unravel the threads of knowledge to reveal hidden truths.
 
Viridian may one day embody the concept of growth, not just healing wounds but restoring lost potential or nurturing the seeds of destiny. Amethyst could command not just minds, but the very idea of order, reshaping societies or binding chaos into harmony. Each step forward brings you closer to the true potential of your light, a reflection of the infinite power of the Light of Origin.

Yet, the greatest power lies in the control of the laws of existence itself. This is not easily mastered. It requires a deep understanding of the Light of Origin, a comprehension of the intricate web of creation that binds all things. At first, you might impose small, localized laws—a patch of land where fire cannot burn, or a room where time flows backward. 

With greater mastery, you could rewrite the rules of an entire region, making gravity optional, rendering a city indestructible, or binding a concept like "fear" or "decay" to a single object. At the pinnacle of your power, you could reshape the fundamental laws of reality itself, creating entirely new systems of existence or unraveling the old ones. 

This is the domain of the White Light, the purest expression of the Light of Origin, where creation and destruction are but two sides of the same infinite coin.
objects.title: Shard of Creation

addons.text:
Now, even in the event you allow yourself to be harmed, you can instantly regenerate any and all damage by restoring yourself from nothingness, as your physical and spiritual existence is merely a mirage surrounding your true self. When you suffer any harm, it will not reflect on the underlying nothingness that is yourself, allowing you to continue functioning unimpeded even while your physical body gets vaporised, your soul shattered, and your mind flayed.

Should you wish to, you can also turn off any sensation of pain, be it physical or inflicted through some other esoteric means.
addons.title: Nihili Difficile Amanti

objects.text:
You have become a complete and true nothingness on all levels of existence, be it physical, spiritual, mental, informational, or any other.

You lose the need for any sustenance, no longer requiring air, food, water, or sleep to survive, as well as cease aging. Unless you specifically allow something to interact with you, everything will simply pass through without harm. Even attacks that enforce the concept of harm will be fruitless, as there is nothing to impose upon. This allows you to become completely intangible and/or invisible at will, hidden from all natural and supernatural senses, and even the most esoteric barriers will be powerless to stop you from walking right through them.

Your lack of informational presence makes it so no records of you can remain if you do not allow it, and you can erase yourself from any pre-existing recording or even memories, although the minds of living people will try to fill the void left behind by the information about you, leading to a slight sense of déjà vu whenever they see you again, though it will fade over time. This sense of déjà vu will become stronger the more often you erase someone's memories, and can even irreparably damage their minds so they will be trapped in this feeling forever, never again experiencing surprise or a sense of accomplishment.

You can still interact with the world even in this state and can control what will be able to interact with you. You can be selectively tangible to some things, but not others, as well as control the level to which interaction is possible.
objects.title: Nihili Est Qui Nihil Amat

addons.text:
You wield complete authority over your apartment, allowing you to reconfigure its layout and appearance at will. While you cannot alter the functionality of appliances or furnishings, you have full control over their cosmetic design, reshaping the space to match your desires.

Your rule also extends to who may enter and remain within your home. You can choose to deny entry, making the doors impassable no matter what—even if they’re left wide open. Likewise, you can expel any guest at will, instantly removing them from your space. This power is not absolute, but overcoming it requires someone to be several magnitudes stronger than you. Anything less, and they can forget about resisting.
addons.title: My House, My Rules

addons.text:
The magic of Fortress Millennia has reshaped your apartment into a residence truly worthy of nobility. Now spanning 3,000 square feet, it features top-of-the-line amenities and luxurious furnishings, all tailored to your desires.

Your ability to summon doors has also improved—you now start with 30 doors at a time, significantly increasing your travel access. Additionally, you can house the fortress directly into your personal dimension, allowing it to seamlessly merge with your apartment. If you choose to move the fortress into the outside world, you will always retain a direct, permanent doorway connecting your apartment to the fortress. This special door does not count toward your total door limit, ensuring effortless travel between your home and the fortress at all times.

Furthermore, you may now delegate the ability to create doors to anybody who serves you, enabling them to travel on your behalf while you remain at ease. However, this power remains yours to command—you hold absolute authority over the doors and may revoke this privilege at any time.
addons.title: A Noble’s Abode

objects.text:
You possess a personal dimension—a small, self-sustaining 150 sq. ft. apartment equipped with the essentials: a kitchen, bathroom, and bed. Floating in the void, this space can only be accessed through dimensional doors that you create. To leave, you must exit through one.

You can create up to 10 doors at a time, placing them anywhere nearby. These doors can take any form, from a gap in a tree to a hidden entrance in an alley, and only you can open them. Additionally, you can generate one-way viewing windows from your apartment to any location where a door exists. While you can dismiss doors at will, new ones must be placed where you currently stand. There is no limit to the distance between them, allowing you to build a vast network over time. However, while only you can open the doors, nothing stops someone from following you inside.

Over time, your apartment will expand, and you’ll gain the ability to create more doors. This process can be accelerated by placing doors in a variety of different locations. While you have partial control over how the space grows, adding new appliances or furniture remains your responsibility.
objects.title: Wanderer's Apartment

addons.text:
You are the bane of all things supernatural. Your Reality Anchor has evolved, granting you the ability to cancel any supernatural effect, regardless of its origin. Magic, divine blessings, curses, psychic powers, eldritch abilities, even technological enhancements fueled by anomalous energy—all fall silent in your presence.

You radiate an aura that unravels the supernatural. Spells fizzle, enchantments collapse, and shapeshifters revert to their true forms. The stronger you grow, the bigger this nullifying radius becomes. You can also focus on a single individual and forcibly shut down their power, or artefact, for a time. The stronger the target, the greater the concentration and effort required.

You are also inherently immune to supernatural influences. Mind control, illusions, curses, reality-warping, or even divine smiting cannot touch you. Furthermore, the more you are exposed to a specific type of being, the more efficiently your Reality Anchor adapts to suppress them.

The only aspect beyond your reach is the physical attributes, whether they are natural or gained through training. Beings, powers, and spells stronger than you can bypass this aura, but they will be weakened relative to your power to theirs.
addons.title: Bane of the Supernatural

addons.text:
Reikon Ryū is a martial art developed to combat supernatural threats, first made publicly known during the Seventh Occult War.

Despite being entirely non-anomalous and unrelated to known kinetoglyphic techniques, its forms and kata allow you to channel and anchor your anima, rendering you immune to direct thaumaturgic manipulation. Magic, curses, soul attacks, possession, and reality warping that would directly alter or control you simply fail while the art is maintained.

As a Reality Anchor, your mastery has evolved beyond its original limits. Rather than only anchoring yourself, you can use Reikon Ryū to actively shape and condense the 20-foot field of reality created by your Reality Anchor, reinforcing local reality and more effectively suppressing supernatural effects and entities within it.

You are a grandmaster of the art, possessing flawless mastery of every technique and kata, allowing you to effortlessly close distance, control opponents, and dominate supernatural foes in close combat.

However, Reikon Ryū was built for a time when forcing melee was practical. While devastating against supernatural opponents, it has become somewhat obsolete against modern enemies willing to rely on guns, explosives, or other long-range solutions.
addons.title: Reikon Ryū (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You are a living reality anchor, forcing all things within 20 feet of you to adhere to the laws of reality as you have experienced them. Foreign entities like eldritch abominations, interdimensional beings, or magical constructs, are made to conform to your plane of existence and its rules while within your influence.

An ancient horror might find itself limited to a physical, three-dimensional form. A time-warping anomaly would be locked into the same linear flow of time you experience. Even invulnerable magical beings would become subject to the physics and biology of your world.

The range of your influence grows with focus and effort, but stronger or more alien entities may resist, requiring intense concentration to anchor them fully. This doesn’t negate their traits but forces them to operate within the same constraints as everything else in your reality. However, your influence is not instantaneous—it takes time to adapt the rules and affect sufficiently complex or powerful beings.

The more you are exposed to the same type of being, the better your soul gets at affecting them. Like, if you encounter ghosts frequently, your soul will eventually adapt to make dealing with a normal ghost trivial. And you can impose the laws of realities you’ve spent significant time in, not just your reality of origin.
objects.title: Reality Anchor

objects.text:
You begin as a small creature—maybe a wolf pup, a panther cub, a hatchling snake, or a fledgling raven. Despite your unassuming façade, a voracious cosmic hunger churns beneath the surface. Your fur, feathers, scales, or skin radiate starless black hole energy: with a mere thought, you can turn this dark exterior into an event horizon, letting you absorb matter, energy, and even intangible forces through your mouth or skin. When you choose not to devour anything, your body behaves normally and won’t automatically consume those who touch it.

Your singularity-based physiology can feed on animals, plants, rocks, minerals, crystals, elemental forces (like lightning or storms), and even certain powers or magical energies. Each successful feeding heightens your overall mass and cosmic potential, eventually enabling you to consume far more exotic targets. Anything you devour that has unique properties grants you abilities tinged with void-like aspects. Absorbing simple rock might enhance your durability and strength; devouring a storm could yield black-laced lightning or dark gusts of wind; swallowing fire might cloak you in swirling black-flame attacks or an infernal void aura. Even intangible or arcane powers can become part of your arsenal, reshaped by the cosmic emptiness that defines your being.

As you absorb increasingly potent targets, your physical form can swell beyond its original scale, towering over structures or spanning entire landscapes. Yet you remain free to revert to smaller shapes at any time, preserving mobility and subtlety. You also gain a powerful regenerative factor that rapidly heals wounds, as well as the ability to warp local space and gravity—bending light, yanking foes toward you, or creating distortions to reel in distant targets. Trying to devour something drastically beyond your current capacity can destabilize your form, forcing you to purge excess energy or risk partial collapse.

Reaching true mastery of this cosmic hunger demands relentless discipline. Each leap in cosmic might tempts you to consume ever more exotic and powerful energy sources—perhaps a living storm or an entire mountain range. Overreaching before you are ready could overwhelm your singularity under the strain. Still, with time and caution, you can evolve from an innocuous small beast into an apocalyptic devourer, your ever-growing appetite eventually allowing you to swallow even concepts and abstract forces themselves.
objects.title: The Devouring Singularity

addons.text: Thanks to The Game of Life, now you can reroll three times within your daily simulation. It works by selecting a line you would want to do differently based on the knowledge of the complete simulation, and it will rerun the simulation after that based on the new decision you made. This practically gives you three “What if?” scenarios to use in every simulation. You can also reroll your reward options three times.
addons.title: Rerolls

objects.text:
Once every day, you can run a simulation of your future appearing where the key events are written out on an old text-based adventure-style game screen, taking a few minutes. The simulation lasts until you manage to survive, ending when it reaches your death, giving you a single choice of five random skills, items, knowledge or even powers, if possible, you accumulated during your simulated life.

The simulation is always based on what you would do and intend to do based on the knowledge you had at the start of the simulation, without the ability to run simulations within your simulations.

Your rewards are random, but things you made more use of in that particular simulation or which benefitted you at key moments are more likely to show up as rewards, compared to non-relevant miscellaneous things.
objects.title: Survivor Simulation

addons.text: It seems that the presence of your dragon has resulted in an expansion to your hunting grounds. Now, your hunting grounds also start with access to all the ecosystems, environments, and draconic creatures found within the entire How To Your Dragon series, giving you quite a variety of locales to explore and dragons to train or hunt.
addons.title: Draconic Redux

objects.text:
What is a hunter without prey to hunt? 

Through this power you gain the very beasts needed for your hunts, as you now can create hunting grounds filled with all manner of beasts to hunt.

In particular, this power functions by creating pocket dimensions that are a recreation of the ecosystems and their creatures. Furthermore, you can modify or mix these ecosystems to create new ones with new species and variations that would have evolved in such an ecosystem. 

Starting out, you will have access to all Earth’s ecosystems and lifeforms, past and present, but through either study and understanding or actually hunting said beasts, other creatures and their environments can be added. Such as, through sufficient study of the ecology, you could potentially recreate Monster Hunter’s ancient forest and its myriad of beasts that call it home or, by successfully hunting down a Skrill, you could add it to your hunting grounds.

It should be noted that you can take anything from within the hunting grounds out of it, making it quite a supply of resources.
objects.title: The Hunting Grounds

objects.text:
You are a lucky dog, never entirely without a chance in perilous situations. Even in the most impossible scenarios, there will always be an opportunity to escape, survive, or push forward. It could be a tiny flaw in your enemy’s plan, like a slight hesitation before a strike, or, if you’re in prison, there could be a weak spot in the bar that you can exploit to break free—like a rusty lock, a shift in the environment, or a rusty old spoon you can use to carve a hole in the wall. If you’re in a high-stakes negotiation, you might find a point where the other party is vulnerable to persuasion. Fate doesn’t love you, but it does give you a shot.

But while the opportunities will always be present, it’s up to you to spot them and use them. This ensures that failure is not set in stone, with your success being completely dependent on your own capabilities, awareness, and quick thinking. If you fail, it will be because you missed your shot, not because the odds were impossible.

Basically, any of your losses are just a skill issue.
objects.title: The Chosen One Until Proven Otherwise

objects.text:
Ever notice how, in every video game, the player always finds a shop that conveniently sells exactly what they need—whether it’s enchanted swords, healing potions, or rare spell components? You now have that same reality-bending luck, but with an even stranger twist.

Anytime you enter a store—be it a street stall, a department store, or a dingy gas station—you can ask for what you need, and the shopkeeper will miraculously produce it. It doesn’t matter if they’ve never stocked it before, if it makes no sense for the item to be there, or if they personally have no idea how to acquire it. The moment you ask, their body will move on its own, reaching under the counter, into a drawer, or even thin air, pulling out exactly what you requested. The shopkeeper, often dazed and mildly horrified, will stare at it as if seeing it for the first time—yet somehow, it’s priced, ready to go, and legally theirs to sell.

A baker might blink in confusion as they place a sniper rifle on the counter, still dusted with flour. A street vendor selling trinkets might reach into their pocket and pull out a glowing magical staff that can’t logically fit in their pocket. A tailor could watch in silent existential dread as their hands, moving without their consent, unroll a perfectly folded suit of medieval plate armor from a roll of silk. 

However, while the items always appear, their pricing still follows the store’s logic. A military surplus store might sell you an assault rifle at a reasonable price, but a flower shop would likely charge an absurd amount for the same weapon—after all, they shouldn’t have it in the first place. Likewise, buying a fancy suit in a clothing store might be cheap, but if you try to purchase the same suit in a convenience store, expect some serious markup. The store’s normal inventory and pricing habits influence the cost, so while you can buy a sword from a fast-food joint, it’s going to cost you way more than if you found an actual blacksmith.

There are limits, of course. This power only works in places that are undeniably “stores”—established businesses, market stalls, or recognized merchants. You can’t just hand a random person money and expect them to pull an ancient artifact out of their coat. Additionally, you can only buy items that exist somewhere in the world you’re in—no summoning hyper-advanced nanotech in a medieval setting unless it already exists there.

Lastly, you cannot purchase unique items. A shop might have a rack of swords for sale, but Excalibur will never be among them. One-of-a-kind artifacts, legendary relics, or uniquely significant items will never be available for purchase. If you want those, you’ll have to find them the old-fashioned way. 

Try not to traumatise your shop keepers too much.
objects.title: Shopkeepers

objects.text: You can instinctively assess someone's affinity and talent toward any subject, including your own, just by observing and willing it to happen. Talent and affinities are complex—essentially, a talent or affinity includes their willingness to learn, determination to understand and apply it, how quickly they pick it up, and other factors, though you can exclude any of these. When assessing someone's talent, you have three main options: checking their highest talents, evaluating more general or core talents, or focusing on a specific subject. This knowledge can take many forms, but by default, it appears as a list in your mind for easy reference and understanding.
objects.title: Talent Check

objects.text:
If you take something down, you can become it. Any being you beat—as long as you were the main reason for its loss—gets added to your roster, letting you take on its form at will. You get everything that form had at the time: its body, abilities, knowledge, gear, magic, techniques—whatever they had, you get. But the moment you switch forms, everything that came with it vanishes: items, body parts, hair, blood—all of it. No looting through shapeshifting.

Shifting isn’t free, though. The stronger the form, the harder it is to keep up. If it’s close to your level, you can hold it for a decent amount of time. But if you’re trying to turn into a godlike beast when you’re still just getting started, you’re gonna burn out quickly. The bigger the gap, the faster you’ll drain, and if you push it too far, you’ll be wiped out and feeling like you’ve just run a marathon.

The good news is, you can train. The more you use a form, the easier it gets. Over time, you’ll get more accustomed to it, and the strain on your body will lessen. Eventually, you can train a form so well that it’ll take barely any energy to stay in it, even if it’s way stronger than you.
objects.title: Winner’s Spoils

objects.text: You have the ability to float and propel yourself through the air, reaching the incredible speeds of 25–30 km/h initially, with the potential to improve over time as you train. However, just don't be expecting to break the sound barrier—human physiology isn't exactly built for such extremes without specialized gear, after all. Similarly, while you can ascend freely, reaching the cruising altitude of a commercial airliner will also require both training and protective equipment. Your flight is controlled purely by thought, thus granting you absolute command over your movement—with it, you're able to stop on a dime, glide effortlessly, or even act like you're walking on air, etc. The sky itself, now then, is your domain, allowing you to push off the air as if it were solid ground, giving you leverage for any attacks or evasive maneuvers. To complement this, your ability to float is remarkably stable, requiring no effort to maintain, allowing you to hover without constant or conscious focus. Once airborne, you can stay aloft indefinitely, and even if you were to lose consciousness, you'd remain suspended. Meaning that you could even sleep midair if you so wish. To aid in your flight, you've developed an innate sense of spatial awareness—an internal gyroscope that keeps you oriented at all times. This heightened perception lets you visualize your surroundings in structured three-dimensional scales, granting you an excellent sense of both distance and altitude, even eliminating any risk of nausea or disorientation, no matter how fast or erratically you move as a side effect.
objects.title: Float

objects.text:
You wield complete dominion over Quantum—the unified force that encompasses time, gravity, and space. These are not three separate powers, but one singular essence that you fully perceive, manipulate, and become one with. Your consciousness operates on a higher level, where the structure of the universe is visible to you as threads, tides, and pressure points—where every second, weight, and distance is yours to bend.

You see time not as a line but a flowing field of branching rivers, loops, and stillness. The motion of the past, present, and future lies open before your eyes. You can watch time breathe around people, objects, and places. You can feel it stretch, tighten, spiral, or fray—and with a thought, you can shape it. You may reverse its flow, freeze it solid, accelerate it until it becomes a blur, or fracture it into echoes of moments that never were. The more you focus, the more time becomes clay in your hands, subject only to your will.

Gravity sings to you like pressure through silence. You sense every gravitational curve, every hidden pull between things, every shift in weight and momentum. You can strengthen gravity until it folds metal or make it vanish to let cities drift into the sky. You feel balance and imbalance, orbit and collapse. With subtle nudges, you can alter gravity’s grip on objects, people, or even light itself, shaping it into shields, weapons, prisons, or pathways. Your own body exists in perfect equilibrium with all gravitational forces, granting you complete omnidirectional freedom, never disoriented, never touched by weight unless you choose to be.

Space itself opens before your gaze like woven fabric. You see the folds between here and there, the tension in distance, the warping geometry hidden in ordinary form. You can visualize coordinates, phase overlays, dimensional tension, and spatial convergence. You may tear open reality and pass through, summon tools from parallel spaces, displace others with a flick of your fingers, or rewrite the structure of rooms and landscapes. You can erase space between two points or stretch it infinitely. All location, direction, and separation are yours to rewrite.

Because these forces are truly one, you are not limited to working with them individually. You can overlay time onto gravity, pulling enemies into frozen singularities. You can collapse space into a moment of reversed time, snapping events back into place or displacing entire events across dimensions. You can wrap time, space, and mass into a single point—and let it explode into rewritten reality.

You do not just control time, gravity, and space. You sense them in their entirety. You see them in intricate layers, flowing across all matter and all moments. You visualize them as luminous currents and complex patterns no other being can comprehend. And within that vision, you can do anything.

There is no law of physics that can bind you. No rule of distance, mass, or duration that applies unless you choose it to. To most, the universe is an immutable framework. To you, it is a sandbox of infinite potential, a living diagram of causality, attraction, and geometry.

With every motion, you defy expectations. With every breath, you alter the shape of the world. You are the center of a new axis in the fabric of existence. You are Quantum.
objects.title: Quantum

addons.text: Instead of the negative side effects of drugs, food, or any other consumable being removed, it is instead reversed into a positive effect, and multiplied by Super Elixir Drinker's amplification.
addons.title: Accentuate Drinker

objects.text: Fascinating, it seems you have a interesting effects on all consumables. Any consumable you drink/eat has the potency of the beneficial effects increasing by 500%, and any harmful effects are decreased by 80%. While it works on the mundane, it shines the brightest with supernatural consumables.
objects.title: Super Elixir Drinker

addons.text:
As your influence seeps into others and awakens their hidden potential, something deeper takes hold beneath the surface—loyalty, not born of command, but of connection. The more of themselves someone uncovers under your quiet guidance, the more they feel tethered to you. You are not just the catalyst of their growth—you are its witness, its guardian, the constant in their transformation. They remember who they were before, and they see who they are now. That contrast becomes reverence.

This loyalty isn’t instant, nor is it enforced. It emerges naturally, gradually, in tandem with the potential you help them reach. The further you draw someone along their path of greatness, the more unshakable their loyalty becomes. A casual ally may feel respect. A protégé nearing mastery may feel devotion. Someone who has fully bloomed under your influence may see you as the cornerstone of their entire evolution. Betraying you would feel like betraying the source of their own becoming.
addons.title: Roots of Devotion

addons.text:
You are no longer just the one who gives—you’re the one who elevates. With a touch, you can still awaken in others the ability to wield any power you yourself possess. But now, your gift doesn’t stop where you do. Once someone has received your power, you can push it further, urging their growth past your own limits. Where you plateau, they ascend.

This isn’t a matter of control or force. It’s resonance, refinement, and purpose. You see the cracks in your own potential—the limits of your form, your mind, your choices—and guide others around them. You are not bound by ego; you do not fear being outshone. You create successors who exceed their source. A disciple who receives your flames may forge a new fire that burns hotter than you ever could.

You remain the root, the soil, the origin. But they become something more.

This process is not instant. It requires time, intent, and a connection strong enough to carry the weight of transcendence. But once it’s begun, it cannot be undone. The powers you grant are no longer yours alone—they evolve, branch, and transform in the hands of those you awaken. And when they reach their peak, they won’t look back down at you as a stepping stone. They’ll see you as the one who built the stairs.

You are not the throne. You are the reason a throne was needed.
addons.title: Crownless King

addons.text:
There is a gravity to you now—something subtle, but undeniable. The people who grow beneath your gaze no longer just reach their potential; they begin to draw the world toward them. As their greatness rises, so too does their narrative weight. They are no longer just individuals—they become pivots around which events begin to turn. The stronger they become, the more the world reshapes itself to accommodate their legend.

Those touched by your influence gain a magnetism that goes beyond mere presence. Allies, followers, and even enemies are drawn to them as if by narrative necessity. They start to gather symbols, rivals, and destinies—pieces of myth assembling around them like armor. In time, they will be written about, sung of, remembered—and the threads of fate will not just allow this, but conspire to make it so.

You are the unspoken variable, the hidden sun they orbit. Even those who never meet you feel the ripple of your existence in the deeds of your students. Their greatness carries your echo. And for those who walk furthest along the path you’ve lit, the world itself bends—ensuring that their rise is inevitable, and that their story will matter.

Your gift does not merely awaken potential. It grants mass—the kind that warps narrative space, distorts destiny, and turns mortals into legends-in-motion.
addons.title: Mass of Meaning

objects.text:
You are a well of potential—but not your own. It’s not what you do that matters, but what happens to others when they are around you. Without saying a word or lifting a finger, people in your presence begin to change. Over time, even the most ordinary person will slowly awaken to something greater. Give it a year, and someone once unremarkable could become a prodigy, a master, or a visionary—though they might never understand why.

But your influence goes beyond passive presence. You have a quiet, effortless talent for nudging people forward. A word, a glance, a small push in the right moment—these subtle things spark something deeper in others. You never know exactly what their potential is, or where it lies, but you always know how to draw it closer to the surface. Your presence is like rich soil, and people blossom without even realizing they’ve been planted. Doing this results in stronger effects. Not only do they reach their potential faster, but that potential grows. A pianist may also discover talent in composition. A fighter might awaken skills in leadership or strategy. Once their core begins to shine, anything nearby starts to burn brighter too.

You are not the fire. You are the spark that finds the wick. You are not the sun. You are the gravity that helps stars ignite. You carry greatness, not in yourself—but in what you leave behind.
objects.title: Seedbearer

objects.text:
You have the unusual ability to utilize a sword as a means of flight. Obviously, this requires you to possess a sword of some form, but this encompasses swords of all kinds—from high-tech energy constructs like a lightsaber to more traditional metal swords, and even to swords that aren't considered "proper" swords by most, such as wooden swords or toy replicas. As long as the average person would recognize it as a sword, it can be used for this effect.

Once you have your sword, simply drop it in front of you—or throw it, I suppose—with the intent to surf on it, then step—or leap—onto it. The sword will always be in the right position to receive you onto it, and you will find it impossible to fall off of it. The maximum speed you can achieve is limited only by your own bodies capacity to survive it.

But you might ask: isn’t standing on a blade dangerous? The answer is a resounding yes! To everyone but you, that is. No matter what style of blade or exotic effect it might possess, while you’re riding it, you have complete immunity to all dangers the sword might pose to you. Ride on the plasma blade of a lightsaber with ease, or on that sword cursed to cut all that its blade touches—you’ll be fine.

Finally, once you are done using your weapon as a means of transport, stepping—or again jumping—off will result in the sword naturally returning to either your hand or its sheath, as you see fit.
objects.title: Sword Surfer

addons.text:
Your ability to grant others a Herrscher Core, combined with your nature as the Cocoon of Finality, has now synergized with your power to create clones. These clones can now become Herrschers themselves, with the number and type of cores they receive depending on their classification.

Core Clones are capable of channeling your full power as the Cocoon of Finality. They can either hold a single powerful core or as many cores as you choose, making them the most potent extensions of yourself.

Multipurpose Clones are more versatile. You can grant them a combination of up to three Herrscher Cores to form entirely new fusion Herrschers. Just as Kiana became the Flamescion, these clones can evolve into hybrid Herrschers. However, the combination of cores must align with their intended purpose, and the resulting powers will vary based on the roles they were designed to fulfill.

Purpose-Built Clones are tailored for specific functions. They can wield a single Herrscher Core that suits their role, or the powers of the core itself may adapt to enhance the role. These clones form the foundation of your Herrscher army—specialized, efficient, and capable in their assigned tasks.

All clones, regardless of type, retain the ability to wield Divine Keys, summon Honkai Beasts, and control Honkai Energy. Your essence as the Cocoon of Finality even allows you to alter the nature of Honkai Energy itself, transforming it into a force of progress—perhaps even one that benefits civilization rather than threatening it.
addons.title: Clones can be Herscherrs

addons.text:
Your mastery over cloning and creating additional bodies has now fully integrated with your divine or eldritch essence. Any clone you create is now a complete and independent body. At the moment of creation, you can determine their strength—making them weaker or stronger as you choose—but all of them possess the potential to grow. You may keep these clones in their base forms or evolve them into a new category known as [Avatars].

These Avatars are more than just extensions of yourself—they are divine vessels shaped entirely by your will. Fully customizable, they can take on any humanoid or creature form to carry out your intentions across the multiverse. As before, you retain the ability to control each body simultaneously, whether they are clones or Avatars. You can also channel your true form through your avatars.

Avatars act as your agents, enabling you to influence multiple worlds at once, spreading your power and faith across the omniverse. Through them, you can channel your power and [Divine Power]—a force capable of reshaping reality itself. With it, you can create life, alter natural laws, affect entire planes of existence, and mold the fabric of the universe. The stronger the Avatar, the more [Divine Power] it can channel. This same force was once wielded by other divine entities to forge galaxies, birth dimensions, and give rise to entire civilizations.

Be mindful, however: [Divine Power] responds directly to will and intent. Even a stray thought could manifest into reality. At first, your ability to wield this power is limited, but as you grow in strength, age, and unlock new domains, your capacity—and the potency of the power itself—will increase.

Your very presence in the world alters the environment. Reality may bend, laws of nature may falter, and your actions alone could risk the stability of entire worlds. If your nature is eldritch, the effects are even more volatile and unpredictable. You can manifest as many clones or Avatars as you wish within any given world, and no matter where they are, anyone who calls your name or prays to you will instantly draw your attention.
addons.title: True Avatars

addons.text:
Your ability to create clones and extra bodies has synergized with your divine nature, unlocking a powerful new technique. Depending on your strength, you can create a unique type of soulless, empty body known as a [Blank]. A [Blank] has no mind, soul, or natural connection to you. It simply exists as an inert vessel. However, if you possess the domains of Life or Creation, you can transform it into something far greater.

By crafting a [Blank] as the foundation, you can then use either a Creation-based power or a Soul-based ability to create a new soul, which will inhabit the body. This process creates a potential [Blank God]. The next step is to charge this being, using your divine skills to craft new gods. The method of charging varies based on the nature of the god, the domains you assign, and the metaphysical laws of the universe where the god is born. Regardless of the method, certain core conditions must always be met: establishing the god’s concept, defining its domains, shaping its base personality, and charging the concept itself through raw energy, belief, or your own divine power. Be aware that different charging methods, known or unknown, might alter the god’s fundamental nature.

Finally, the god must be manifested. This usually requires one last surge of the resource used for charging, solidifying its existence within reality.  Note that at the time of creation, their place in your pantheon must be decided by you.

If your essence is that of an Eldritch being, you can create new Eldritch gods—whether they be Elder Gods, Great Old Ones, or Outer Gods. You will automatically become the chief deity of your pantheon. All beings you create or elevate to godhood are fully loyal to you. If you possess a Divine Realm, it will evolve, allowing other divine realms to form under your fellow gods. Each of these realms remains connected to you, channeling power, strength, and divine energy back to you, fueling your endless growth. Your fellow gods, like you, will continue to grow stronger over time without limitation. Additionally, any abilities, powers, or domains you possess can be passed down to your new gods either by gifting them outright or by copying them.
addons.title: A Pantheon of New Gods

addons.text:
As a shapeshifter, you possess the extraordinary ability to freely edit and customize your clones or extra bodies. Each one can be crafted in any imaginable way—age, sex, physical features, internal biology, even voice tone and cadence. If a clone is sentient, you can shape its personality, behavior, and emotional range. These bodies become unique expressions of your will, and those with souls can develop into complex individuals with thoughts and reactions that may even surprise you. Regardless of their autonomy, all remain loyal to you. You can assume direct control at any time or allow them to act independently.

This customization is fluid, not fixed. At any moment, you can revise, enhance, or entirely transform a body to suit new roles, environments, or intentions. You can mimic the appearance of fictional characters, though these replicas retain only surface traits—the look without the memories, skills, or true essence. They are aesthetic echoes, not incarnations.

Your abilities go further. In combination with your shapeshifting nature and seamless connection to your creations, you’ve unlocked the power to generate animal bodies. Drawing from your understanding of their anatomy, behavior, and instincts—whether of earthly or alien origin—you can replicate any creature you comprehend. You might become a solitary predator moving through untamed wilderness, a swarm of insects operating as a hive mind, or a network of birds serving as airborne scouts. You don't merely shift—you manifest entire ecosystems, factions, families, and armies.

Each form is a new lens through which to experience the world. Each body serves a purpose, and each purpose mirrors an evolving facet of your identity. Through them, you explore the boundaries of sentience, the essence of individuality, and the art of intentional design.

You are no longer a single being. You are a chorus of selves—a living archive of forms.
addons.title: Clone Customizer

addons.text: Your ability to create clones and extra bodies now works seamlessly with your power to store and use Templates. You can transform these creations into true replicas of fictional characters. Each clone, depending on their nature, can embody a certain number of Templates, inheriting the name, appearance, sex, age, memories, personality, items, and powers of the chosen character. Some clones can only handle weaker templates, while others are capable of hosting powerful ones—such as Kiana or Whitebeard. These replicas are more than simple copies. They become fully realized individuals who can evolve and grow over time. Though they remain mentally linked to you—allowing you to take control whenever needed—they are inherently loyal. If desired, you can sever this connection, granting them full autonomy while maintaining their loyalty. This opens the door to treating them as true equals. Certain clones, such as The Purpose-Built Clones, are designed for specific roles. For example, a healing-designated clone will perform best with a healing-based template but can only access powers relevant to its function. Multipurpose clones offer more flexibility, able to wield a broader range of template abilities. Core Clones are unique. Like you, they can host multiple templates at once, allowing for character fusions or alternate versions—such as combining different forms of Arturia into a unified but slightly weakened version with access to all her abilities. Alternatively, if a Core Clone holds only one template, it can wield its full power, as these bodies are extensions of yourself. All creations, independent or not, remain loyal and can even build lives and families of their own. However, progression is still required. Templates accessible to you remain limited by your current experience and what level of template you can currently access, and more powerful ones will unlock over time. Clones must actively use their templates to level up, evolve, and eventually unlock their full potential. Keep in mind that once a template is applied to a clone or body, it becomes permanently bonded. You cannot reclaim it unless the clone is dismantled or destroyed. Also, if you have taken Shapeshifter, then you can gain access to creature templates, like magical or supernatural creatures.
addons.title: Clone Expy

addons.text:
Your nature as The Gamer has now synergized with your ability to create clones and alternate bodies. These clones can gain experience, level up, enter dungeons, acquire loot, learn skills, and more—though at first, their growth is limited. Over time, as both they and your supporting skills develop, their capabilities will increase significantly.

One such skill is [Exp.Share], which allows you to gain a portion of the EXP your clones earn. The amount shared depends on the skill’s level—the higher it is, the greater the experience you receive. If your clones are modeled after fictional character templates, their powers, skills, traits, and even items can also be improved and leveled.  But something like this is only possible if you have the ability to store and use templates. There could be even skills to summon your clones and alternate bodies, or even swap places with them.  

Clones benefit from nearly all functions of your Gamer System. They can form parties, start guilds, participate in multiplayer events, and explore dungeons independently. You’ll also unlock clone-specific skills to help manage and customize them, but these too must be leveled up to become more effective.

As clones grow stronger, they may unlock the ability to evolve or rank up, depending on what features or systems you've acquired. If you've purchased additional modules—such as Mini Systems, fast travel, or minimaps—these may trigger the creation of new synergistic skills tailored for clone integration. You can even grant clones entirely separate systems, provided you have the necessary energy, power, and unlocked features—especially with access to the System Store.

Other system-related abilities, like the Divine System, Falna or Voice of the World, may also influence your clones. They act as both transmitters and receivers, capable of gaining skills and experience while transferring some of that growth back to you.

Ultimately, the Gamer System allows your clones and alternate bodies to truly evolve and adapt. As they put in the effort to grow, they may become fully sentient, independent entities—loyal to you and still under your control. Their systems, too, can evolve, becoming something uniquely their own while remaining an extension of your power.
addons.title: The Clone System

addons.text:
You have gained the ability to create two new types of bodies or clones: the weaker [Vassal] and the stronger [Hero].

Each [Vassal] is assigned a single Vassal Weapon or object, either from the known list or a custom one created by you or another. They are restricted to this assigned weapon, and all their powers, skills, and items revolve around it. Vassals receive a custom lite Gamer System similar to the one in Rising of the Shield Hero. Over time, they gain full access to the knowledge, powers, and techniques of all past and future wielders of that weapon. This includes both known and undiscovered methods of enhancement, leveling, and upgrading that align with their specific weapon or object. Vassals can freely leave their assigned world and travel across others without penalty or restriction.

Each [Hero] can be assigned a single Legendary Hero Weapon, either from the established set or a custom-made version. Like the Vassals, their entire skillset, powers, and inventory are based on that weapon alone, and they also receive a custom lite Gamer System. Over time, Heroes inherit the knowledge, abilities, and experiences of all past and future wielders of the weapon they hold, including both known and unknown enhancement paths and upgrade methods related to their specific armament. Each Hero commands two Vassals under their jurisdiction. Coordinating and working closely with their assigned Vassals enhances the Hero’s overall strength, unlocking advanced powers, skills, and synergy-based evolutions.

You may assign a limited number of Heroes to a given world. Once bound, they cannot leave that world without direct permission from someone in charge. If they attempt to do so, they are either weakened, forcibly reset, or subjected to the native rules and limitations of the destination world. This restriction does not apply to Vassals, who retain the freedom to travel between worlds without penalty.

If you possess any Dungeon-related powers, you also gain access to the wave monsters featured in Rising of the Shield Hero, including the Four Legendary Beasts. If you personally have a Gamer System, it automatically enhances the clones’ lite Gamer Systems. You can also temporarily act as a Class Up or Dragon Hourglass when needed.

You may continue adventuring across different worlds to strengthen these weapons or objects, with each world offering unique power metrics. Every assigned weapon or object contains latent functions waiting to be discovered, and specific conditions can trigger powerful evolutions or transformations.
addons.title: A Legion of Heroes

objects.text:
You’ve gained the power to create clones—or additional bodies—each tailored to specific roles or abilities by creating them using any type of energy. These clones can take inspiration from Shadow Clones like those in the Shadow Clone Jutsu, the autonomous duplicates of Kurumi Tokisaki, or the puppet-like copies of Herta.

There are three main types of clones you can create: Core Clones, Multipurpose Clones, and Purpose-Built Clones. Regardless of how many you create, your main body always retains all your original abilities and powers. Certain core traits—such as immortality, racial powers, and multiverse or omniverse travel—are shared across all clones. However, any powers assigned to a clone are only copies; you never lose them from your original form.

Each type of clone varies in strength, flexibility, and the costs required to create them. Core Clones are the most powerful. These bodies can access your full range of powers and energy, but are extremely resource-intensive—creating one demands more than what’s needed for five Multipurpose Clones. Multipurpose Clones are more limited; they're designed with a few roles in mind, such as a hybrid between a Mage and a Warrior, or a Support unit with crafting abilities. Their powers are restricted to their designated roles and are weaker than those of Core Clones. Purpose-Built Clones are the most common and easiest to produce. These are specialized for single functions like ranged combat, melee, magic, support, or construction. Although their power is significantly reduced, you can create them in large numbers as needed.

Clones cannot have altered appearances or sex, but their age can be customized during creation. Core Clones are time- and energy-intensive, so you can only create them occasionally. Multipurpose Clones require fewer resources and can be created in small batches. Purpose-Built Clones, being the most efficient and cost-effective, can be produced freely and in high quantities.

Your cloning ability also grants you extraordinary multitasking. You can control all clones at once, manage them in groups, or direct them individually. Each one can operate under your direct control, follow a preset script, run on autopilot, or act with independent thought. Distance is no barrier—you can command your clones from anywhere, even across worlds. However, if a clone is injured or destroyed, you feel that pain or death as if it were your own.

You won’t die unless all your bodies are destroyed, as your mind and soul are distributed across them.
