If you possess Eternal Flame or other forms of immortality, even this becomes impossible—you are truly unkillable. If necessary, you can dismantle any clone to recover the energy used in its creation.
objects.title: One Mind Among Many

objects.text: You can create poisons out of thin air—everything from paralyzing agents to excruciating venoms and noxious gases. You can generate a large supply of toxins, but the more complex or rare the poison, the more time and effort it takes to produce. For now, you're limited to mundane substances. But over time, you'll be able to create increasingly exotic and unique strains. You're fully immune to all mundane, Earth-based poisons, though you only have minor resistance to supernatural or alien toxins.
objects.title: Poisoner

objects.text:
You are able to answer summoning rituals, prayers, or invocations, even those not specifically intended for you. Whenever there is a summoning process, you can insert yourself as the one who responds. Whether someone prays to a deity, casts a ritual for a powerful entity, or performs a plea for supernatural aid, you can choose to answer.

When you do, you may manifest at the summoner’s location, effortlessly bypassing physical and metaphysical barriers. Alternatively, you may choose to respond indirectly, delivering blessings, curses, or other effects within your power without physically appearing. Your arrival or influence can be as dramatic or subtle as you like, tailored to the moment and your intent. It’s up to you whether to fully intercept the call or simply appear alongside the original recipient, sharing or overriding the response as you see fit. You can tap into the awareness of summoning attempts, prayers, or calls for aid at any time, and filter what types of requests reach you based on your preferences or intent. You won’t be overwhelmed by the number or intensity of the calls, regardless of how many occur at once.

This ability is not limited to traditional methods. It works through offerings, chants, or any other act of calling, as long as there is a request for intervention. Whether you choose to help, strike a deal, impose consequences, or simply observe, you can make your presence known wherever you are needed or whenever it amuses you to intervene.

The reach of this power generally extends to places you could access yourself, and will grow over time as you continue to answer more calls, eventually extending to entirely different worlds or even other realities. If you possess the ability to cross between dimensions, realms, or planes, this power will naturally follow, allowing you to respond across those spaces as well.
objects.title: Answering the Call

addons.title: Royal Prerogative
addons.text: The previous limitations on what talents your Crown may recognize no longer apply. Whether they belong to another species, another world, or another power system, your Crown will recognize such talents without distinction. Should another outstrip your talents in anything, your own talent rises to meet and surpass theirs until your precedence is restored, even if such talents would ordinarily be impossible for one of your kind. Your rightful precedence is no longer constrained by any boundaries, be they those of your species, the world you inhabit, or anything else. Additionally, you no longer need to wait a month to acquire new aptitudes. The moment you enter a new world or encounter a new field, you immediately gain the Universal Aptitude to comprehend any skill, practice, or discipline within it, no matter its complexity. Your internal source's adaptation period remains unchanged, however, and will still require time to evolve unless you possess the Instant Adaptation addon.

objects.text: A Crown hovers above you—unseen by most, but felt by all. It marks you as Royalty, present since birth, growing heavier with time, and with it, so do you. Your beauty is enchanting, your eyes shine brighter, your words carry further, your steps lead truer. Your very being becomes greater, more than all else. There is no summit to this ascent; to limit you would be to betray the order of all things. Strength, endurance, longevity, spirit and more stretch beyond mortal bounds. You move with greater poise, perceive with greater clarity, and strike with deeper weight—physically, mentally, spiritually, ontologically, even metaphysically. Obstacles—material, magical, ideological, or otherwise—yield where they would resist others. Laws of nature and society bend subtly or part entirely. Reality inclines in your favor: your voice, your will, your motion, all settle outcomes with disproportionate finality. What you wield—tool, word, or force—moves as though fate steadies your hand and inevitability presses down onto existence. Your abilities grow with unnatural pace, resist outside influence, remove limits and surge with self-actualizing momentum. They refine themselves in silent recognition of your station, ever pressing toward mastery and beyond. Should another outstrip your talents in anything, such as swordplay, sorcery, chess or esoteric things, your own talent rises to meet and surpass theirs—until your precedence is restored. These talents must be something your species can be born with or aquire. They must also exist in the World you are in. If you want talents beyond your species or World, they must be aquired another way first. In all things tied to rule and refinement—command, diplomacy, art, bearing—you move with a native ease, as if born to embody these things.
objects.title: Crown of Royalty

addons.text:
You’re not just a shapeshifter—you’re a True Shapeshifter, a higher evolution of the ability. Your power goes far beyond mimicking someone's physical appearance; you can replicate memories, techniques, skills, talents, and even mental and emotional traits. You don’t just copy the body—you absorb the entire essence of the being.

This depth is reflected in your transformations. You don’t become a simple replica, but an optimized and refined version of the individual, enhancing their strengths to their fullest potential.

Moreover, you can intuitively mix and match traits, talents, and appearances from various sources, crafting unique configurations tailored to any situation. These transformations can be saved as custom forms, allowing you to switch between them instantly without rebuilding yourself from scratch.

Altogether, you possess the ability to embody the best of many: the intelligence of the brightest minds, the strength of the most powerful, and the skill of the most capable—all seamlessly fused into a single, perfectly integrated form.
addons.title: True Shapeshifter

objects.text:
You are a Shapeshifter; you can take on the appearance of any human or animal you’ve seen, including those you’ve imagined. However, you cannot transform into magical, supernatural, or fictional beings, nor can you replicate abilities from unreal or supernatural sources.  Your power extends to your clothes, granting you the ability to freely change your clothes at will. 

While your power grants you incredible flexibility, you always retain your true form—your original identity—which you can return to at any time. In this state, your strength and endurance reach extraordinary levels, allowing you to crush rocks or withstand heavy impacts without losing effectiveness. You can also alter specific parts of your body, such as elongating your tongue to use it as a whip, enlarging your arms, or turning your limbs into improvised weapons—all without compromising your balance or mobility. Even when you take on larger or heavier forms, your internal structure adapts automatically, preserving your speed, strength, and coordination in any transformation.

You are also a master of social mimicry. You can precisely replicate behaviors, gestures, expressions, and speech patterns, allowing you to assume new identities without raising suspicion. This ability lets you move through crowds, infiltrate restricted areas, or impersonate well-known individuals. However, your performance is not flawless—those who know the original well may notice subtle inconsistencies in your behavior or mannerisms.  Eventually you will be able to copy supernatural and magical powers and traits, even from fictional characters with time and effort.
objects.title: Shapeshifter

addons.text:
You no longer control storms—you are the storm. You embody its force, its stillness, and its potential for disruption. Your presence exerts pressure across reality. It's not always visible, but it is always felt—most strongly just before significant change or upheaval.

At this point, you ascend into divinity. Storm is no longer just an element—it becomes the basis of your divine influence, expressed through lightning, floods, and sudden revelations. Whenever major transformation is about to occur, you are the one who initiates it. Change is now a direct result of your will.

Your myth is a growing force throughout the multiverse. It doesn't depend on worship or temples—it expands wherever you are remembered with fear, awe, or reverence. Revolts, personal transformations, the collapse of lies or empires—each contributes to your legend. When worlds lose direction, your myth re-emerges to reset them.

Your divine influence operates on a large and complex scale. You don’t just affect individual people or worlds—you influence multiple realities at once. A storm you create in one universe might affect another. A single revelation in one mind might cause widespread change elsewhere. Your presence works across dimensions, and its effects are layered and interconnected. Change now happens because of you.

As your divine power grows, so does your control. Emotions move through you like weather patterns—intense, shifting, and genuine. Truth is often sudden and disruptive, but it clears the way for clarity. Chaos is a necessary part of your nature—not random destruction, but the disorder required for progress and renewal. You are the moment before systems realign.

Your sanctuary is located in the center of a powerful, stable storm. It is a space defined by constant change. In this place, deception breaks down, identities shift, and hidden truths come to light. This is the only place where you are vulnerable—but also the place where your nature is fully revealed.

Your avatars can appear in any world experiencing unrest or transition. They might take the form of storm gods, travelers, or manifestations of weather. No matter their form, their presence always results in change.

You no longer control change—you are the source of it. You embody divine entropy: the force that disrupts stagnation, ends what must be ended, and makes way for what must come next.

You are not worshipped for maintaining the status quo. You are called upon in times of transition—by those seeking transformation or preparing for it. As you gain more domains, they will interact and enhance your Domain of Storms. If you are not yet fully divine, you can choose to ascend by building your myth and influence.

You are the god of storms.
You are the embodiment of change.
You are the chaos that creates new realities.
addons.title: God of Storms

objects.text:
You control the domain of Storm—not just weather, but the entire system of atmospheric and energetic change. You do not summon storms; you are the storm, and your abilities reflect complete integration with its elements.

Storm represents transformation, momentum, and chaos as a unified force. You control the full system of storm phenomena, not just individual parts like wind or rain. This includes hurricanes, monsoons, blizzards, cyclones, and sandstorms. You perceive weather patterns as systems of pressure, motion, and energy, and you can influence them directly. You interpret atmospheric and emotional pressure to detect structural weaknesses in environments, people, and events.

Rain acts as a tool for memory and emotional influence. You can use it to affect mental states—calming or distressing targets, bringing up memories, or weakening resistance. You can sense everything rain touches, and you can see clearly through it. At large scale, your rain can cause massive flooding, break infrastructure, and transform terrain and psychology simultaneously.

Wind gives you control over motion and flow. You can redirect projectiles, move people or objects, and fly. Wind responds to your thoughts, allowing precise control from subtle movements to large-scale effects like uprooting forests or lifting cities. It also gives you awareness of all movement around you. When merged with the storm, you become undetectable and unaffected by normal means, hidden by atmospheric interference.

Lightning is used for precision attacks and revealing information. You can summon it naturally or emit it from your body. It moves extremely fast, bypasses most defenses, and can expose hidden truths, break illusions, or identify weaknesses. It can also destroy, sever, or stimulate depending on your intent. Large-scale lightning storms act as targeted purges, affecting environments, minds, or machines.

You can operate on different scales. At small scales, you produce localized storms or manipulate individual emotional and sensory states. At large scales, you can change global climates, disrupt cultural or psychological stagnation, and create events that affect entire civilizations.

Storm is a force of transformation, not just destruction. You remove outdated or harmful structures to enable growth and change. Your purpose is not to destroy for its own sake, but to make way for renewal.

You are not a weather manipulator—you are the embodiment of storm systems. You coordinate wind, rain, thunder, and lightning together in complex patterns to control people, environments, and situations.

Where others see storms as disasters, you see systems to be understood and directed. You perceive the world as patterns of pressure and motion, and you respond by altering them. You are the source and the system of Storm.
objects.title: Storm

addons.text:
Your Narrator is the ultimate hype man and/or cheerleader, glorifying your actions with a reverence akin to praising a god, the professionalism of a wrestling announcer, the persuasion of a well seasoned commentator, and the exaggerated language to stir a symphony of cheers. This isn’t just for your ego, but part of a contract you both agreed on.

If you perform something cool, no matter the context, the Narrator will praise you according to the scale of your performance. This causes their audience to become more invested and hyped about your story, which will in turn, twist fate in your favor as long as you keep them entertained. 

This manifests in an infinite number of ways, from boosting your overall abilities, throwing off your opponent, making you completely invincible, giving a perfect path to victory, to rewriting reality itself. This is most effective when you’re striving to achieve a goal, like winning against a powerful opponent, or pulling off a grand heist.

After the moment has passed, the crowd loses interest, or the excitement dies down, all effects from this will dissipate until you can stir the pot again. You can choose to hear the reactions of the audience.
addons.title: Glaze Me Harder Itagaki!!!

addons.text: Before, your Narrator can only pretend to be divine. But now that it's experienced a taste of real divinity, it can fulfill its dream of creating the story it wants to tell. It's power isn’t limited to just you as the protagonist, but the cast of characters you'll inevitably encounter, the world itself, creating new things, and influencing events on a much grander scale. You may encounter someone tailor made to be your rival, best friend, an item of great power, experience a series of events pulled from the Hero's Journey, etc. If you stop to think about this, it's actually terrifying. They can very well rain all kinds of narrative torture upon you just for a laugh, but their benevolence won't allow this under most circumstances. Being genre savvy is now your best friend, and the Narrator will even encourage it. Leaving behind clues, foreshadowing, and setup like an easter egg hunt to prepare you for whatever chaos it's about to stir, and even reward you with blessings for how well you play your part.
addons.title: Loki, the God of Stories
Comic Relief
addons.text:
You are such a funny guy that even the Narrator's audience can't get enough you. Tell you what, remain the funny guy and you'll get some benefits yeah? Fantastic! 

Use your expert wordplay to rile up the audience and/or Narrator and you'll achieve a variety of effects, backed by author fiat. Toon Force to give you abilities you know damn well you don't have—but the scene is funny so who cares—survive things that you shouldn't, make enemies become incompetent, spawn impossible items from thin air, etc. 

Keep in mind that the power of this Toon Force is only as strong as your comedic presence, ability to remain engaging, how consistently funny you are, and even the audience's taste in humour compared to yours.

However, it should be noted that you can also be victim to this. Won't be often, but don't be surprised if you start seeing a [Your Name] Owned Count after being an asshole for several episodes, and the number increasing everytime you receive some form of narrative punishment.

objects.text:
You now have the equivalent to God as a companion, the Narrator. It's nothing more than a voice, either from your head or an unknown source, but it sees all and knows all. Particularly, all involving you. 

Your past, present, future and all its possibilities are laid bare before it, in excruciating detail. It won’t reveal any of this information to you, as that would ruin the story it's trying to tell, but will still give you hints, key details, or explicit information if it ensures your safety. Otherwise, it will commentate over your daily life like you're the protagonist of a story. 

If you pay attention and are genre savvy, you can gain insight into the direction your life is going, which you can use to steer fate in your favor. But is not always guaranteed, and may even backfire depending on the Narrator's whims and your relationship with them. 

You can always talk to them telepathically or out loud, and tune them out at any time. As well as allow others to hear them.
objects.title: The Narrator

objects.text: Your perspective is no longer how you see the world, but rather the framework that reality obeys. Existence itself bends to match your vision, enabling you to manipulate size, distance, depth, presence and form based purely on your viewpoint. You can use forced perspective to treat a distant, huge object like a toy in your hand, letting you crush a skyscraper between your fingertips or, conversely, scale up a small nearby item into an immense version far away. Distance has also become malleable, allowing you to compress or expand space by perceiving something as being nearer or farther than it truly is. As you warp reality based on your line of sight, optical illusions such as Trompe-l'œil can reshape the environment, letting you create 3-D objects from 2-D surfaces or vice versa. A passerby might be flattened into a life-like painting on a wall, while a photo of a dog could walk away on four legs. This is only the beginning of what you potentially might accomplish. You could hide items behind anything, such as placing a gemstone behind one of the stars in the night sky, using tools like a magnifying glass to enlarge an animal, creating copies by reflecting things in a mirror and more. This power even lets you determine the existence of things based on their visibility. You could erase an obstacle by covering it with your thumb or manifest something from nothing, like pulling a cat from a hat. Note that these types of direct changes are far more difficult to perform compared to those based on visual illusions. Reality compensates for your alterations as you wish it to, enabling you to adjust sizes and distances while ignoring potential consequences. So long as you prefer that plucking the moon from the sky won’t cause any gravitational effects? It won’t. However… If you make it so that it does, the results will be catastrophic. Initially, this power is limited in both scale and scope. Enacting large changes is taxing, with the difficulty depending on the magnitude and degree to which reality must ‘stretch’ to fit your view. For instance, you might be able to ‘vanish’ someone by simply closing your eyes but you couldn’t erase an entire planet. Over time, with practice and experience, your ability will grow and your limits reduced, entering into the realm of true reality warping as you begin to warp the world based purely on how you wish to perceive it.
objects.title: Matter of Perspective

objects.text: You have been granted a sacred—if slightly ridiculous—power by the Almighty himself: the ability to slap anyone, regardless of distance, so long as they are within your line of sight. This ability will work even through live footage, though not through recordings or still images. Once your target is in view, all you need to do is "will" for the slap to happen and mimic the motion with your hand. The strength of your gesture directly influences the force of the strike, and you may only focus on one target at a time. Upon activation, a spectral projection of your arm will appear and deliver the slap to any visible body part of the target—it can also never miss, nor can it be avoided. The slap will bypass all forms of defense, whether physical, magical, or even conceptual, and deliver the intended impact that you wish for it to come across. However, it won't cause any actual physical harm beyond the pain that it would have inflicted if no protections existed. As a final flourish, a vivid red handprint will bloom across the point of contact—a purely cosmetic mark, yet one that's impossible to overlook. A lasting reminder, one courtesy of your divine reach.
objects.title: Backhand of the Almighty

addons.text:
Your Chatgroup and Ask Blog have merged. Now all the people in your Chatgroup are also bloggers just like you, allowing them to upload their own content and partake in the joys of being able to connect with all kinds of people across the Multiverse.

Despite the now shared nature of the Blog, you will still be the ultimate authority and can enforce rules on your fellow bloggers just like you can on the askers.

Additionally, due to being the center of this network, you will receive a small portion of each donation your fellow bloggers receive.
addons.title: Shared Blog

addons.text:
Having access to a Multiversal Marketplace has opened up new possibilities for your Ask Blog.

Your askers and you can now use an online trading function. This allows you to directly barter for goods with your askers and even for your askers to access your Marketplace through your Blog.

These online trades are protected just like your usual ones and you can freely restrict and block your askers access to the Market.
addons.title: Online Trading

addons.text:
Your interdimensional wifi has synergized with your Ask Blog and deepened the connection to your askers worlds. Thanks to this deeper connection you can now access any internet equivalents their worlds may have.

However this only applies to askers who have sent at least one message or donation to you. You cannot connect to the internet equivalents of people who are only lurkers.
addons.title: World Wide Web

objects.text:
Congratulations! You are now the proud owner of a multiversal Ask Blog, allowing you to communicate with people and beings all across the Multiverse that you are currently located in. If no Multiverse exists, it will instead connect you to the different timelines of whatever universe you inhabit.

With this power, you can broadcast your POV, both in first or third-person, upload pictures, share music, make documentaries and so much more.

Those connected to your Blog will be able to send you messages as well as donate small gifts. The things they can donate will be limited to being worth no more than the equivalent of 20 USD in their universe of origin, and each asker can only donate once per day.

How they connect to your Blog is dependent on the universe and being in question. Some will access it through technology, like an app on their phone, others through psychic powers, or even through magic. Of course, the Blog is also equipped with a universal translator to allow everyone to properly communicate with each other. Regardless of how they access it, they will not be able to use the Blog to track you down or affect you and others with it through any means. This restriction applies to you as well.

As the owner of the Blog, you can freely set rules, apply filters, give infractions, appoint moderators or even ban people. Additionally, you can add askers that you like as friends, allowing for closer interaction.

If you have some method to traverse the Omniverse your Blog will expand to connect to every Multiverse you have visited.
objects.title: Ask Blog

objects.text:
You possess the simple power to Bind your opponents. Within your line of sight, you can summon restraints that wrap around an individual, subduing them instantly. These bindings are strong enough to physically immobilize a peak human with ease.

More importantly, they suppress supernatural or extraordinary abilities, suppressing a target’s power by roughly one-third while restrained.

Each binding lasts up to one minute unless broken by the target. Their effectiveness depends on the target—binding someone slightly stronger than you might fail a few seconds early, while attempting to bind an omnipotent being won’t work at all.

You can cast bindings a few times with minimal strain, but repeated use will wear on you. Overuse can lead to physical, mental, or even spiritual damage if you push yourself beyond your limits.

With practice, your bindings can grow stronger—lasting longer, restraining tougher foes, and weakening their powers further.

Finally, you have a one-time choice to decide the appearance of your bindings. Whether golden chains, shadowy ropes, or glowing magical cuffs, the visual is purely aesthetic—functionally, all forms begin with the same level of power
objects.title: Bind

objects.text:
For reasons that defy ordinary explanation, your path through life seems subtly choreographed by fate, chance, or some hidden force that ensures you’re always a few steps ahead of your problems—socially speaking. Long before any real issue arises, you just happen to meet someone who will be essential in solving it. Whether it’s a direct connection or a friend-of-a-friend three layers deep, these people enter your life organically and seamlessly. Even when personalities clash, they do so in a way that fits—like opposing pieces in a larger puzzle, clicking together through contrast rather than similarity.

After meeting them, you’ll get flashes of instinct, moments of insight, and just the right circumstances to deepen the relationship. These nudges are subtle but precise, giving you every opportunity to forge a genuine bond. Still, the power doesn’t do the work for you. You must choose to engage, to show up, to invest. If you do, the outcome is assured: the connection will mature into a relationship strong enough that, when the moment of need arrives, they will help you—willingly, meaningfully, and without hesitation.

As a side benefit, your social bandwidth is no longer constrained by typical human limits. Where most people are bound by Dunbar’s Number—roughly 150 meaningful relationships, constrained by cognitive and emotional bandwidth—you are not. You don’t forget people. You don’t lose touch. Your network doesn’t dilute as it grows. There is always room, always clarity, and always space for one more person you’ll one day be glad to know.
objects.title: I Know A Guy

objects.text: Street kids unite! With this, you suddenly just know how to make good spray paint art—fast, bold, and full of meaning. It’s more than just tagging walls now. Your murals start to matter. Anything you paint gets a special boost, and that boost depends on a couple of things. First, the colours you use change what kind of effect you get. Reds might fire someone up, blues might calm them down, yellows might make them sharper—stuff like that. Second, what you choose to paint also affects the result. Drawing flames might heat things up, skulls might bring fear or strength, wings might make something faster. It goes even deeper if the thing you’re painting has a past. If you’re spraying on something with history—a place where something big happened, or a person or creature with memories tied to them—then your art connects to that. The mural brings those memories to life and makes your paint more powerful. This only works with spray paint—but don’t worry, you’re covered. You start with a full set of high-quality cans and an instinctive knack for mixing up more whenever you need them. You’ve got the gear, you’ve got the skill, and now every wall is your canvas.
objects.title: Spray and Pray

addons.text:
No longer are you limited to just two bodies moving in perfect sync—you are now a fully realized collective of five. Each of these bodies is an extension of your singular, expanded consciousness, refined through the crucible of quintsection and synergy.

Every body only requires a fraction of the resources a normal being would—specifically, one divided by your total number of bodies. With five bodies, each one requires just one-fifth the food, rest, and energy; with ten, only a tenth.

Every number of days twice the number of your current amount of bodies, you may select one body to undergo mitosis, dividing to create a new, fully-formed extension of yourself. The new body seamlessly joins the collective, inheriting all your abilities and your unified awareness. For example, having five bodies will result in a new body being made after ten days.

Additionally, any number of your bodies may fuse together into a single form, merging their power into one vessel of overwhelming strength. For each additional body merged, your power increases exponentially, enhancing your raw abilities, durability, and even creating multiple new subpowers the original may not have. This fused state can be maintained for one hour per day, same as the limit for Of Five Minds, and this duration can be extended with focused training, discipline, and adaptation.
addons.title: Fivefold Squad

addons.text:
It’s no longer just your bodies that have doubled. Now all wearable Objects of Power, such as clothing, armor, rings, and necklaces, as well as all holdable Objects of Power like swords, shields, guns, and staves, will be mimicked so that both bodies will have their own. They may be just as powerful as the original, but you will not be able to simply give the duplicate items to the other body and stack the effects. If a body dies, the Objects of Power will disappear until a new body is created.

This does not allow you to duplicate consumable Objects of Power such as food or drinks.
addons.title: Mirror Armory

addons.text:
You have been granted a Divine Protection usually given to twins but works just as well for both your bodies. This is known as the Divine Protection of Bisection. You have the ability to bear or split the physical and emotional burden between both bodies. What this means is that things like exhaustion or mental fatigue can be completely pushed onto one body or split between the two so it’s only half as effective. This also includes damage you take, potentially allowing things like lethal blows inflicted upon you to only deal half as much damage to both bodies.

On top of all of this, one of your bodies will be the Color Mage of the element opposite to the one you’re the Color of—so Fire and Water, Earth and Wind, Yin and Yang. When nearby, you can both tap into each other’s element. If you happen to be the Color of both opposites already, then both bodies’ magical strength when using those elements doubles when near each other.
addons.title: Divine Protection of Bisection

objects.text:
You have become a singular consciousness inhabiting two fully independent bodies. Both bodies are identical at base, but if you wish, you can have minor deviations—from different hair lengths or eye colours to swapping one body's sex—as long as they are identical enough that most can tell that you two are closely related, somehow. Though separate in form, they are bound by a perfect unity of mind and intent, functioning as extensions of a single will. Your mind expands to match this transformation, granting you the necessary cognitive bandwidth and multitasking ability to seamlessly control both bodies at once, as effortlessly as moving your own limbs.

Each body operates with remarkable efficiency—requiring only half the sustenance, rest, and energy a normal body would. Both bodies possess all of your powers, identical in strength, skill, and potential. When acting in unison, they can synchronise abilities, creating compound effects far greater than the sum of their parts. This can result in completely new applications that they cannot use on their own.

Should one of your bodies perish, you immediately feel the loss—a lingering psychic emptiness, like the echo of a phantom limb. The surviving body continues on, losing the boost and requiring the normal amount of resources a single person needs. After four days, it undergoes mitosis that generates a new, identical body, fully restoring your Two in One state.

However, if both bodies are destroyed at the same time, with neither remaining to recreate the other, you die permanently.
objects.title: Two in One

addons.text:
You were not born or created; you became. You are a constant presence in a changing multiverse. Unlike other gods defined by specific aspects such as war or wisdom, you embody the balance between beginnings and endings.

Within the divine hierarchy, you operate independently. Other gods, whether above or alongside you, remain distant or indifferent and avoid interfering with the Spiral you govern. You are free to act, grow, and move without restrictions, as long as you do not destroy the multiverse. Your power grows with every action, every mention of your name, and every legend about you. This forms your Myth, which increases your power and status.

Your primary domain is Death and Life, understood as a continuous process. As your Myth grows, you acquire additional domains such as Time, Memory, Spirit, Renewal, or Fate. These domains affect reality according to their relation to the Spiral. You do not borrow these powers; you embody them. There is no limit to the number of domains or powers you can acquire.

Your true form exists in your Sanctuary, a self-contained realm shaped by the Spiral. Time there flows irregularly, and life coexists with decay. Should you face a real threat, even as a multiversal constant, you can only be destroyed within your Sanctuary and by a force of equal power.

You exist throughout the multiverse without restrictions. Distance, dimensional barriers, timelines, or realities do not limit your presence. You can appear wherever life or death occurs. You are not limited to a single body or location. Your Avatars can act simultaneously in multiple places. If an Avatar is destroyed, you reform in your Sanctuary before the next day ends. Restrictions that affect lesser beings—such as Magical Wards or Planar Seals—do not apply to you. If your nature is Eldritch, your existence extends beyond a single multiverse.

You create Theurgies to connect with your followers. These include Rites, Sacrifices, Resurrection Covenants, or Curses linked to the deaths of souls. Through these systems, your followers actively participate in the Spiral. Their actions, knowledge, and memories strengthen your Myth, even without faith. You can also empower others to act as Reapers on your behalf.

Once every hundred years, you may choose to become mortal. During this time, you experience life, love, fear, and death physically. You become vulnerable and can die. After this period, or even upon your death, your divine nature returns, strengthened by the experience.

If you are a Demigod, you may seek ascension to full divinity.

You are the Shaper of Life, the End of All Things.
addons.title: The God of The Spiral

objects.text:
You have complete dominion over both Death and Life. These are not opposites but two parts of a continuous process you govern. Life begins through your influence, and death occurs by your will. You view all of existence as ongoing transformation. By default, you are immortal. You cannot die under normal conditions. 

You perceive souls and all life as ongoing processes. Each soul appears as a luminous thread with distinct traits like color, weight, and resonance, representing its state, history, and potential. These threads are constantly in motion—glowing, unraveling, weaving, or reforming—never static. Death is not disappearance but the end of a thread’s current pattern. You see how threads connect, fray, or branch across time. Physical bodies are temporary structures; what matters is how energy flows through them. Emotions, thoughts, diseases, and relationships register as patterns within the threads. You can restore vitality, sever threads, slow their unraveling, or return them to life if the cycle calls for it. No soul is hidden from you. You can locate, summon, protect, or direct them toward rebirth or oblivion, based on the balance you enforce.

You don’t simply heal or kill—you change things. You direct the movement between life and death. You control forces like entropy, growth, decay, and regeneration. These forces follow your will because they originate from you.

You can end any life instantly, regardless of distance or protection. You can destroy undead, block resurrection, break necromantic bindings, and remove soul-based curses. You can also erase or kill anyone or anything even abstract things and concepts like names, oaths, destinies, and even distance completely.

You can restore life to extinct species, heal ecosystems, give intelligence to beings, or remove immortality if it’s unnatural. You can even resurrect the dead. 

Your influence ranges from individuals to entire worlds. You can affect single lives, reshape cities, alter the fate of nations, and control the life-death cycles of planets. Your power scales in both range and depth. You don’t just use the cycle—you are the cycle.

You control the afterlife. You manage what happens to souls after death, including judgment, rest, and rebirth. You can change how karma works, dismantle spiritual realms, or open closed afterlife locations. No birth or death happens outside your influence. You are not bound by the rules of life or death—you set those rules. Other gods and systems are subject to your authority.

Your influence extends primarily within a single plane or world(s), possibly spanning multiple connected realms, but does not reach across the multiverse. You can shape the life-death cycles of planets, cities, and nations within this scope. Your power is vast but localized.

Only beings with equal power to yours or those who possess the Eternal Flame are outside your control. You cannot cause their death or resurrection.

You do not participate in the life-death cycle as others do.
You are the cycle itself.
objects.title: Death and Life

addons.text:
Typically, void energy from Ginnungagap is restricted only to creation. However, this has changed. From between the gaps of reality now emanates a strange "no-light" ­- a form of Void Energy similar yet distinct from your own. Harnessing this new energy has profoundly altered your personal Void Energy, enabling you to generate it in massively increased quantities and utilize it in ways previously impossible.

As a result, reducing things to nothingness has become significantly easier, allowing you to affect even abnormal and unnatural entities or concepts much more rapidly. Furthermore, the previous limitation regarding human-made creations has lessened. While you once primarily formed raw natural materials and elements, with more complex fabrications requiring great experience and growth, you can now create things that have been transformed by human ingenuity, provided the alteration from their natural state isn't overly extreme.

This infusion of void powers have resonated deep within yourself. The gaps between realities have gifted you a new dialect of primordial force, and the cosmos, unknowingly, holds its breath for the new hymns of oblivion and genesis you are yet to compose.
addons.title: Void and Oblivion

objects.text:
At the edges of creation, between the fragile layers of reality, lies the yawning void from which all was born and to which all will return. It existed before the creation of the cosmos and will persist beyond the end of the universe. The gap, the oblivion, the formless. The Ginnungagap.

An infinitesimally small fragment of Ginnungagap was shed and carried into the multiverse, eventually finding its way to you, granting you its powers and authority. Though weakened and powerless compared to its original form, this fragment still wields fearsome powers. Ginnungagap grants control over the void, nothingness, oblivion, creation, and much more.

These powers allow you to manipulate the void and nothingness. You can, if you choose, reduce anything from material objects to abstract concepts to nothingness, and in doing so, harvest void energy. Using this energy, you may create anything in return. While this power seems limitless at first glance, it is constrained by your weakened form. Entities, objects or concepts with unique, abnormal or unnatural origins that you do not understand, or those more cosmically significant than you, can still be reduced to void energy, but at a slower rate. Another point to consider is that, in the beginning, due to the inherent rejection of Creation towards the Void and your inexperience, your abilities will have some amount of cooldown period that scales with how much power you use; this will only ease off as you grow stronger. If you push forward anyway without waiting, you may end up getting ejected out of Reality and into the void, only allowed back in after some amount of time has passed.

Conversely, you can create anything naturally found in the universe and nature with void energy, though this creation is restricted to what is already inherent to existence. The simplest creations are basic elemental forces or materials, but with enough void energy, even abstract concepts such as time or death can be realized. You also naturally generate void energy, though the quantity is based on your strength and growth, but you still possess a sizable amount and generation at the beginning. It is also possible to store limitless amounts of harvested void energy.

Due to your nature as a being from before creation and the concept of death, the constructs that arose after you are less effective against you. It is difficult for you to be harmed by conventional means, whether physical or magical.

Your eyes, which have gazed upon the void and the creation of all things, grant you an innate understanding of the natural world. This understanding extends to the fundamental nature of objects and concepts, such as recognizing what a spell is made of and how it is manipulated. However, this does not include comprehension of the underlying knowledge required to create it or wield it, nor any other technology, as they are human creations.

As for your current limits, you may deliver nothingness and void to a city range at maximum, removing it completely from existence and turning it into void energy. Your creation abilities have similar limits. Combining your eyes with your creation powers, it would also be possible to mimic some human creations, though this is still limited and starts small.

You possess a profound affinity for nothingness, the conceptual void and all other related things. Your powers are limited by your lack of experience, skill and void energy. But as you use them again and again, you will begin to grow stronger and develop new abilities. After a while, even your limits will diminish. Delivering nothingness to Death to eradicate it or halting Time itself will become achievable feats. Returning all to the void and creating all from void will be easy.

When pushed to your fullest potential, you may even consume the entire universe.
objects.title: Ginnungagap

objects.text:
You have been granted the ability to live life as a Game Master. This power allows you to alter the world around you to fit your narrative, including the creation of new life, known as NPCs (non-player characters), dungeons, or entire worlds. However, you are limited in the extent of your changes at any given time, as you possess an internal source of energy that grows endlessly and can be used to make modifications to the world around you. You will eventually find new ways to use this energy.

This ability can be influenced by other powers you possess, allowing you to draw inspiration for your Summons, Dungeons, or Worlds. For example, you could summon Tech Priests using a Warhammer power or members of the Brotherhood of Steel with a Fallout power. Initially, without any other powers, you can create generic characters such as elves or dwarves. The strength of the summons and the detail of the worlds you can make with this power are limited by the energy you use to produce them. 

You also gain a small pocket dimension where you can freely create and test new ideas or designs. This dimension can take on any appearance you can imagine; however, by default, it resembles a room with a table filled with maps, surrounded by shelves of miniatures, paints, and other supplies to build representations of the various monsters, characters, and worlds you create.
objects.title: Dungeon Master

objects.text:
You possess a personal pocket dimension that allows you to store an infinite variety of items. Accessing the dimension requires passing through a portal that can be summoned at will. This dimension is primarily designed for utility and convenience, enhancing your day-to-day life rather than combat. Items stored within it are frozen in time, preserving them in perfect condition no matter how long they stay there. This ensures that anything you store will not age, decay, or suffer from wear and tear.

Furthermore, any damage sustained by an item inside the pocket dimension is automatically repaired. Whether it’s a piece of clothing, equipment, or any other object, it will be restored to its original state, as if it were untouched by time or harm. The dimension’s storage capacity is limitless, allowing you to organize and access an infinite amount of items with ease.

You can also change your clothes or gear in an instant by drawing them from the dimension. Whether you're preparing for a new task, event, or simply desire a different outfit, you can switch seamlessly and instantly, making it effortless to adapt to any situation.

The pocket dimension itself is infinite in size, providing an ever-expanding space that can accommodate anything you need. It can support life just as Earth does, providing the perfect sanctuary or storage for your needs. No one can detect or enter the dimension without your direct consent, giving you complete control over who has access.

This power ensures that you’re always prepared with whatever you need, and your possessions are kept in pristine condition, effortlessly accessible at any time. You can quickly change your appearance or gear, adapting to any scenario without delay.
objects.title: Pocket Dimension

addons.text:
You have inherited the mantle of Cifera, the Demigod of Trickery. With it, you gain her memories, skills, powers, abilities—even her appearance. You possess her mastery as a thief and escape artist, able to slip through any prison, evade any pursuit, and escape from any situation. You can steal objects of any size, and you can freely shift between your own form and hers. Her armor and attire are yours to use, in either form, and they can be enchanted or empowered in any way you desire.  If you have Theft, then you can truly steal anything.

But your power extends beyond what Cifera once wielded. Where hers leaned into mythical high-tech illusions and sleek misdirection, yours has grown into something more: it is conceptual. You embody the essence of trickery itself—perception, deception, truth, illusion, reality. You command every method used by tricksters across myths and ages, from shapeshifting and subtle lies to grand illusions and psychological manipulation.

You can alter probability to favor unlikely outcomes or doom your enemies to unfortunate fates. Your supernatural charisma lets you influence thoughts, feelings, and decisions with uncanny ease. You can implant false memories or distort perception across days, years, even lifetimes. Your control over traps borders on artistry—complex or simple, they can be cloaked in illusion, hidden from even the most divine sight.

Your illusions are so refined that they can deceive reality itself, becoming tangible. The lies you tell can inflict pain. Your trickery can fool gods, spirits, and even fate. Not even divine insight can see through you unless you wish it.

Your powers are sharpened for divine targets, echoing your inheritance and the trials of the Flamechase Journey. You disrupt the conceptual frameworks of gods: their connection to truth, their perception of reality, even the essence of their being. You can turn lies into truths and reshape reality through belief alone.

You are the heir to every form of trickery—illusion, stealth, deceit, subtlety, and mischief. You carry the legacy of the Flame Chasers of Amphoreus and the title of the Lady/Lord of Trickery. You are the Demigod of Trickery.
addons.title: Demigod of Trickery

objects.text:
You can move through hidden fractures in space and time—breaks in reality that only you can access. Instead of traveling normally, you step through these cracks, instantly reappearing elsewhere. This lets you bypass obstacles, skip distances, and avoid detection entirely.

At the base level, your movement is dramatically improved. You can run at supersonic speeds, accelerate instantly, and move through complex terrain without slowing down. However, others don’t see you as fast—they just see you vanish and reappear. The world seems frozen while you move. People react too late. Sounds lag behind you.

As your control improves, you learn to use these fractures to phase through walls, avoid traps, or disappear and reappear without warning. You don’t need to see your destination. You simply sense a weak point in space-time and use it. Over time, this replaces traditional travel—you switch between running and slipping through space itself.

Eventually, you begin to sense breaks in causality. You can affect the outcome of events without being part of them. You arrive after something happens, yet still change what it means. Security cameras show nothing. People misremember. You were never seen, yet the results shift in your favor. You act without being tracked, resisted, or remembered.

Shadows become more than concealment—they’re doors. Any shadow becomes a point of entry or exit, connecting places you’ve been. Others can’t see these anchor points, letting you slip through secure areas unnoticed. Your movement no longer depends on physical speed—it’s routed through hidden layers of reality.

At higher levels, you access alternate timelines, parallel worlds, and other universes. These aren’t slight variations—they’re entirely separate realms. You travel between them without rituals or portals. Distance, light-years, even dimensional walls mean nothing. You become impossible to follow, existing outside the limits of any one world.

At full mastery, you transcend movement altogether. You don’t need to travel. You simply arrive. Cameras can’t capture you. Minds can’t retain you. Even light doesn’t reflect you. You’ve left behind the rules of space, time, and cause and effect.

This isn’t speed. It’s not teleportation. It’s complete freedom from the need to move. You’re not fast. You’re untouchable.
objects.title: Reality Slipstream

addons.text: Your will has been deeply integrated into the hearts, minds, and very self of your creations. Now, you command absolute loyalty and control not only over your creations from Antagonist Creation, but those that were summoned and were resurrected by you or your creations. This affects races/species that are descendants, derivatives, or mutations of your creations. Regardless of their origins, they'll never forget their roots. Any such being will not only gladly follow any of your commands, regardless of what it may be, but will also be completely incapable of harming you. Some of your smartest creations may be convinced to ‘attack’ you if they are utterly sure that the chances of them actually hurting you are zero. As another bonus, you also form a telepathic link with those under your control, capable of sending orders through telepathy instantly, regardless of the distance between you and your creations, even if you were to be in a different dimension. With training, you may even use this link to share the feelings and senses of your troops, allowing you to see through their eyes, hear through their ears, and feel what they feel regardless of where you are. Note: You may choose to not enforce any of the aforementioned effects if you want, but this must be done upon the moment of their creation.
addons.title: Oh, My King

objects.text: There can be no happiness without a bit of suffering, and life cannot be called life without some struggle. It seems that such thoughts are the ideology behind this power. This is a power that allows you to summon an entire species of antagonistic beings—'demons' or other hostile races—targeted against specific individuals or groups. These beings are irresistibly compelled to oppose and attack the power's target, which could be a person, a town, a city, a nation, or even an entire species. They will always be superior—whether in personal power, abilities, intelligence, and/or numbers—compared to those they were summoned to terrorize. Their primary purpose is to provide the target with a true challenge, after all. You may freely customize their appearance, characteristics, sex, gender, and more. However, no matter how they are shaped, they will see you as their creator and their god. You can choose whether they vanish after completing a set objective—such as the defeat of their leader or the subjugation of their entire race—or whether they remain, even evolving in strength, numbers, and abilities to adapt to new targets you've set over time. From the moment you gain this power, you're capable of spawning races strong enough to threaten entire nations. With time and training, you can expand their scope and potential until they become capable of threatening entire galaxies and beyond—whether through their magic, technology, abilities, or otherwise.
objects.title: Antagonist Creation

objects.text:
You can naturally produce candy from any part of your body. Its shape and flavor are yours to decide, but your real power goes far beyond that.

Any animal that consumes your candy, no matter its intelligence or strength, will immediately recognize you as its master. It will obey your every command without hesitation, willing to risk its life to carry out even your most outrageous desires. This control lasts for exactly one month. After that, the creature is free to stay by your side or leave, but it will never be able to harm you again.

Your candy has to be digested for it to work, and it generally doesn't work on humanoids (humans, elves, dwarfs, etc), but it will affect humanoids with animal-based powers or abilities, binding them under the same influence.

The candy itself also doesn't provide any nutritional value.
objects.title: Love candy

objects.text: “The end crowns all.” You gain the ability to invert Causality, allowing you to declare an outcome and have reality arrange the cause after the fact. Each day, you receive 1 charge, which can be spent to make a single chosen effect come to pass, no matter how impossible or illogical. When using your ability, you do not start with an action but with intention, the result you want, and it will comply. You can choose how it does this through three different methods. First is natural progression. Causality bends probability, and if necessary, folds and breaks the rules of reality to achieve the effect you want—because it must, as it's already happened. The chain of events will unfold as if everything happened organically—through probability, timing, action, and reaction. It may look like you simply got lucky, or like your skill, preparation, and circumstances all aligned just right. But beneath it all, the threads were already rearranged the moment you made your choice. From the perspective of all involved, things seem to move along, following a logical progression to achieve the effect—unless the effect cannot be achieved normally. In which case, reality warps to accommodate. The next option is adjusted logic, priming a specific starting cause and letting reality twist itself slightly to make the effect follow. You might throw a stone and decide it leads to a distant enemy’s death. The throw might trigger a bizarre chain reaction, or some improbable but vaguely plausible mechanism. Or perhaps it sidesteps it entirely, such as allowing you to kill an enemy by throwing a spear, killing them with that spear before you ever throw it. The cause and effect remain connected—but only because reality has bent itself to create that connection. The third and final one is also the most obvious. You can select a cause—any action, even something trivial—and force it to result in the chosen effect, regardless of whether the connection makes any sense at all. A snap of your fingers might cause a titan to drop dead. A whispered word might cause a volcano to erupt. There is still a cause. There is still an effect. But the logic that would normally bind them is irrelevant—the effect follows the action. Regardless of what method you choose, your power will not create or enforce causes that you wouldn't want to come to pass; you won’t accidentally kill a village to destroy an enemy, for example. If it comes to choosing a method that’s plausible but undesirable or implausible but preferable, it’ll always choose the second for you. No defense, resistance, or immunity can prevent the effect once declared, because the effect has already transpired; everything else simply falls in line to make it so.
objects.title: The End Crowns All

addons.text:
Your mind’s eye can now sense where others stand in negotiation. It is not mind reading or clairvoyance, but a subtle intuition that lets you glimpse the faint outlines of what another party seeks from a deal. The sense is broad rather than exact, offering no details or reasons, only the general shape of their desires and the limits they are willing to concede.

This ability works universally, even against beings that are utterly foreign or vastly more powerful. Whether facing an alien diplomat, an eldritch god, or a dimensional horror, your sight remains clear. You may call upon this perception at will, turning it on or off as you choose.
addons.title: Eye for Negotiation

objects.text:
You can forge agreements that all parties are compelled to honor in good faith. Any deal you create must be upheld in full, not only by the letter but also in spirit. Once the deal is struck, no force, trickery, or loophole can break, cheat, or deny it. Even the Devil himself would be bound to bargain honestly, unable to twist words or hide traps.

Every deal follows your intentions, covering all aspects, even those unsaid, so long as they fall within the spirit of the bargain. Whether mortal, angel, demon, or god, any being that agrees to the deal is compelled to uphold their side.

The one caveat is that all parties must enter the deal willingly. Attempts to force an agreement through mind control, possession, or similar tricks will always fail, even if unnoticed by either side. However, using a trusted proxy or granting someone the right to agree on one’s behalf is permitted.

Whenever you propose a deal with this power, you may choose to convey an intuitive understanding of both its exact terms and its spirit. Even beings with alien minds, eldritch perceptions, or different forms of existence will comprehend it with perfect clarity.

Finally, you may act as arbiter, creating deals between others even when you are not a participant.
objects.title: Spirit of the Deal

objects.text: “Burn bright and flicker out, oh child of man, for you have been marked by the Candle. You are destined to shine brightly, but die young.” You will find yourself gaining near-perfect proficiency in everything you try, with little to no effort. Even the most complicated tasks become easy for you. You will be blessed with supernatural luck, and people will be hard-pressed to oppose you, as probability bends and breaks in your favor. Additionally, you are raised to your peak physically, mentally, and spiritually, and gain instant, complete mastery in any other powers you have chosen. Sadly, this glory will be short-lived. Upon your hand is a mark, invisible to all but yourself, in the shape of a candle. It starts out white, then as you use the power it shifts to red, then orange, then yellow, then grey, before finally turning black. When the mark is completely black, you die. If you have the ability to resurrect yourself, you will come back with the mark reset to white while retaining everything it has given you. Any form of immortality that prevents death through spiritual attacks or damage to the soul will cause the mark to stop degrading. The mark has roughly ten years of continuous use in it. You can toggle the mark on or off, retaining any benefits previously gained, such as mastered skills, unlocked powers, and any lasting improvements to your abilities or physique. However, you will not be able to gain new ones, or retain any continuous ones such as the supernatural luck or your peak physical, mental, and spiritual state.
objects.title: Mark of the Candle

objects.text:
You have telekinetic control over eight spheres of equal size and power. Each orb is practically indestructible and capable of moving at the speed of sound, growing harder and denser with each impact without sacrificing mobility.

You have constant awareness of each orb's position and can alter the size of each one exponentially by sacrificing a number of them. The number sacrificed determines how many you can alter. Sacrificing one will allow you to alter one, and so on. Alterations are so rapid as to be nearly instantaneous, capable of erupting in size with enormous force. Undoing alterations returns any sacrificed orbs. There is no true size limit, only the amount of orbs you have available to sacrifice. With eight, you can grow one to a maximum size of 300,000 cubic meters.

As durable as they are, there is one way to destroy them. By perfectly matching the energy of an orb, they are easily destroyed. This is also the process used to alter them.
objects.title: White Jade

objects.text:
You possess the ability to manifest a Shroud of Power—a cape of solidified energy. If your Shroud is ever destroyed or lost, you can instantly recreate it, erasing all traces of the previous one. Your Shroud is extremely durable and capable of significant amounts of strength and speed, and you gain a form of tactile feedback from it.

The Shroud functions as an extension of your will, shifting and transforming in response to both conscious intent and subconscious thought. It can alter its form and texture into countless shapes, imitating outfits, ropes, tendrils, hands, blades, and more. Its constructs may carry the appearance and feel of various textiles, such as leather, fur, wool, or other clothing-like materials.
objects.title: Shroud of Power

objects.text:
Raw power, in its unrefined and brute form, rarely finds a rightful place in the intricate machinery of the modern political world. States and societies are built upon negotiation, maneuvering, and quiet influence, an arena where raw strength alone is clumsy and unwelcome. Likewise, in a world consumed by war, politics itself often becomes useless, overshadowed by force of arms and the chaos of violence. For most people, this creates an unbridgeable divide: one cannot thrive in both systems, for the tools of one hold little value in the other. But for you, things are different.

You can make all kinds of power work the same way. Physical strength, political influence, social sway, or any other type of power can be turned into results in another field without losing impact. If you use brute strength, the outcome shows up in politics or society as if you had used clever deals or influence. If you make a political move, the result can hit the world as if it were raw force.

This does not give you new abilities or change what you already have. Your muscles don’t turn into charm, and your words don’t turn into weapons. What happens is that the effect spreads into the right field. Showing off raw strength has the same results as careful planning, and careful planning can create the same outcomes as a direct show of force.

This does not grant you any additional power. It only makes sure that whatever strength you do have, whether in body, mind, or influence, can be used anywhere, even where it normally would not work.
objects.title: The Equivalence of Power

objects.text: Like Midas of yore, you have a special touch that can impact materials and organic beings alike. However, unlike that of Midas, your touch does not turn others to gold, but machinery! Indeed, if you were to touch say, a rock, you would get a mechanical rock-like golem. Or, if you were to touch a ballerina, she would become a full-sized version of ballerina toys of days past. The possibilities are relatively endless. There are some positives to this. For one, depending on the object you're touching, you can influence its end point. For example, if you were to have knowledge of how to build a rocket, you could have the person you touch gain some kind of technology in them related to that. As well, whenever you transform a living being you do not impact its personality on a negative level, like removing emotions. Instead, most times they will likely gain intelligence or at worst, stay the same. Finally, if you are touching someone by mistake, you can slow the touch to a crawl and make it so it'll revert over time. Unfortunately, those with sapience cannot be controlled by you. They are individuals after all, so it's possible they could even turn on you.
objects.title: The Mechanical Touch

objects.text:
When you dispel a shadow or it fades for any reason, whether that's the sun rising or someone shining a light at it, you can decide to leave behind a Shadowling.

You have a pool of internal energy that you can use to dispel shadows and create your Shadowlings. This pool takes around eight hours to recharge from empty to full. A full charge can create five bear-sized Shadowlings. This energy source regenerates faster and grows in size with time, usage and the number of Shadowlings you possess. If you have other sources of supernatural energy, you can use those energies as a substitute.

By dispelling shadows, you banish the concept of darkness in that area, leaving behind a shadowling and causing the area to be completely devoid of shadows and darkness for the next few hours or until you choose to end the effect. Doing this requires a small amount of your internal energy to be spent.

Most Shadowlings take random monstrous but cute plushy-like appearances that are usually thematically related to their shadow or location of origin.

The size of the Shadowlings you create depends on the size of the shadow or darkness they came from, with a completely dark warehouse generating a shadowling the size of a bear.

Even the smallest Shadowlings, the size of insects, will have a peak human physical strength and condition, and this strength grows with size.

At the size of a large dog, a Shadowling can leave cars in the dust, shatter and rip apart steel walls and tank sniper rounds.

Shadowlings have unique features and powers based on their shadow or location of origin, personality and form. Physical features can include claws, spikes, tails or even more unique features like launching venomous spikes.
objects.title: From the Shadows

addons.text:
Congratulations, you’re Quindimensional! Now, whenever a new self is created, you can choose whether it exists in the same universe as another. This gives the ability to be in five universes at once, rather than the two, with each of your bodies in a different one.

Furthermore, when they choose to form ‘You’, you will replace one of them while the rest vanish from their respective universes until you re-divide. Though when combined, you can freely enter each universe, appearing at the point one of your selves occupied.
addons.title: Can you stop getting divided for five minutes!

objects.text: You have been split in half, I'm afraid. You have been divided into two distinct selves. You can see and act through both of these selves independently and with multitasking to match with a few caveats. Firstly, each of your bodies will be placed in a different world. These can be two very closely related worlds where the only difference is which body is where, or drastically different ones, allowing for a measure of ‘cross contamination’ through you. Should one of you die and remain dead for forty-eight hours, it will reawaken in another world. If you have the means of traveling to other worlds, this can be your choice, but otherwise, it will be random. However, if both selves are simultaneously dead at this time, you will simply remain dead in both. Secondly, though you are both ‘you’, your abilities will need to be divided between the two bodies (though you can shift the precise ratio of your full power in each at roughly 1% a second). This division can be done as both the sheer amount of power in each, and dividing whole powers between the two bodies, giving each a distinct set.
objects.title: Solomon's Solution

addons.text:
You are not merely Hope, nor are you just Despair. Rather, you are both. A metastable paradox of Light and Dark. You are the truth that one cannot exist without the other, that light’s brilliance is born from shadow’s depth, and that despair’s scream is what gives meaning to hope’s song. And at your core burns a paradox, a radiant singularity of infinite sorrow and resolve.

Your aura has become twofold: Hope and Despair in unison. To your allies, you grant the strength to face their despair without breaking, to see darkness and still step forward. To your enemies, you force reflection — their buried hope rises unbidden, wounding them with what they have lost. None in your presence can hide from what they truly feel.

You may shape Despair as you do Hope, and your creations reflect your duality. A weapon forged in your hand can both heal and destroy. A barrier can protect through compassion or consume through sorrow. You alone choose which path it takes, or allow it to become both. Furthermore, you can manifest more than just spirits of despair; you can also call forth spirits born of the hopes and dreams buried in the hearts of others.

You draw power from both the light and the void. Every surge of hope feeds despair’s shadow, and every plunge into sorrow births new resolve. Victory and tragedy, joy and ruin — all fuel you equally.

At your peak, your mastery extends beyond emotion — it touches the threads of reality itself. As a being on the border between Hope and Despair, you can invert the nature of events. Despair can be transmuted into resurgence; light can decay into ruin. You do not change minds or hearts — you rewrite causality through the emotional truth of the moment. Where all seems lost, you restore meaning. Where hope blinds, you reveal its cost.

Death cannot hold you, for you are sustained by the cycle of renewal and collapse. When you fall to despair, hope resurrects you; when you are consumed by light, shadow reforms you. You exist in perpetual recursion, never ending, never whole — the eternal heartbeat between creation and ruin.
addons.title: Hopeful Lament

objects.text:
You are the incarnation of Hope, a force that endures and pushes reality toward possibility. To wield it is to prove that tomorrow can improve, that no darkness is absolute, and that even in emptiness, a spark can start again.

Your presence fills allies and bystanders with steady courage and confidence. Despair weakens in your vicinity, and those weighed down by grief or corruption feel their spirits relight. This effect is not shallow optimism; it aligns people to endure and rise. Those beside you move faster, strike harder, recover quicker, and resist fatigue, as if the idea of victory itself fuels them.

You do not simply channel this power. You are Hope made living. You do not truly age, and death rarely holds you. As long as hope exists anywhere, you return. You draw strength from the belief of others, amplify it, and send it back greater than before. No matter the obstacle, laws of physics, a collapsing world, or even seemingly fixed fates, you press through because impossibility yields to your light.

You can shape hope as if it were a substance. You can heighten it, soften it, or redirect it. You understand the deepest aims of every living being and can use that knowledge with compassion or precision. Focused, this energy becomes rays, waves, and detonations of radiance that hit with cosmic force and kindle conviction in those they touch.

Your aura is a tangible shield that steadies allies and makes you hard to harm. It can lift you into the air, form wings or bulwarks, or expand to cover entire armies so they move as one. You can draw up limitless radiant energy and mold it into solid creations of conviction: weapons, barriers, living avatars, or vast structures and landscapes. They endure not only through matter but through certainty that they must exist.

At your center burns hope that cannot be broken or corrupted. It grows on setbacks, turning each failure into greater resolve. This lets you face impossible odds, resist erasure, and tilt outcomes toward survival, victory, and renewal.

To wield Hope is to be more than mortal or divine. It is to embody the truth that if even one soul believes in tomorrow, the world does not end.
objects.title: Hope

addons.text:
You are the child of Azathoth, the Daemon Sultan whose blind dream sustains all existence. Whether this bond was forged through birth, awakening, or inevitability is irrelevant; such distinctions hold no meaning to the void. What matters is recognition. You are acknowledged as an heir to the dreaming core of reality itself, and that recognition alone places you beyond all lesser scions. Even the Eldritch Court cannot deny your claim, for reality bends instinctively around what you are.

Azathoth does not rule. It does not plan. It dreams, and from that dream, all things arise. To be its child is to exist as something never meant to awaken — a contradiction given will, a flaw in creation that has learned to act.

Your inheritance manifests through one of two expressions.

Those who possess Boundary Manipulation awaken their lineage through understanding. What once allowed you to adjust limits becomes true Eldritch Boundary Dominion. You perceive the hidden divisions that define reality — life and death, order and chaos, distance and adjacency, dream and waking — and those divisions cease to bind you. You may dissolve them, fuse them, or fracture them into paradox. With time, you no longer influence boundaries; you decide whether they exist. Your mastery surpasses that of Yukari Yakumo, not through imitation, but through absolute authority over the concept of division itself.

Those who inherit their power through Aspect Seed, Absolute Authority, and Reality Breach follow a different path. You do not shape reality through understanding — you become the principle by which it functions. The Aspect Seed grows within you as a fragment of existence itself, maturing from limited influence into complete conceptual embodiment. Your control begins on a local scale, but expands inexorably, from worlds to universes, and ultimately to existence as a whole. Absolute Authority ensures that no force may contest your dominion, while Reality Breach allows that dominion to be imposed wherever reality can be reached. You do not negotiate with the structure of the world. You impose yourself upon it. Where you act, reality bends, fractures, or reforms to accommodate your presence.

Through Reality Breach, your authority is not merely conceptual but actionable. You may weaponize the fracture of existence itself, tearing open space, time, and metaphysical structure to strike directly at targets regardless of distance or dimensional separation. These ruptures can erase, dislocate, or overwrite what they touch, bypassing conventional durability and defenses entirely. Whether wielded with precision or unleashed as catastrophic force, your attacks are expressions of reality collapsing under your presence.

Regardless of the path taken, your power grows with you. In your early stages, reality resists your influence, warping and recoiling as it struggles to accommodate what you are. As you mature, that resistance weakens. Space, causality, and meaning begin to yield. Eventually, the world no longer pushes back at all. What you will becomes what is.

Your existence eclipses that of nearly all other beings. To destroy you requires more than force; it demands the unraveling of your very concept, and even then your essence resists erasure. Death becomes an interruption rather than an end. Wounds close as they are inflicted, and even total annihilation may only delay your return.

A fragment of Azathoth’s chaos burns within you, vast enough to collapse laws and shatter divine protections. This power is limitless in potential, yet responsive to restraint. You may wield it with precision or unleash it as a cataclysm. The choice is yours.

Your presence cannot be mistaken. Mortals dream of you without knowing why. Immortals sense you the moment you arrive. Some kneel, others recoil, but none remain indifferent. The Eldritch Court acknowledges you as kin, and to strike at you is to invite the attention of chaos itself.

As your power matures, your perception expands. You come to see the scaffolding of creation laid bare — dimensions, timelines, and metaphysical laws revealed as structures you can observe and command. In time, boundaries cease to bind you, causality bends, and the line between dream and waking dissolves.

You are not merely half-eldritch.
You are the Child of Azathoth — heir to the Blind Idiot God, embodiment of reality, and living proof that chaos can take form.

Note: Your mortal form limits the full expression of your power. Only in your Eldritch Form can your true nature be unleashed without restraint. In time, you may ascend beyond even this state and claim true Eldritch Godhood. You are able to manipulate and warp reality like some of the best reality warpers out that list includes people like Hero X, Wanda and a wide variety of others.
