addons.title: Child of Azathoth

addons.text:
You are a true child of Yog-Sothoth, the All-in-One and One-in-All, through whom places, times, dimensions, and realities are joined.

Your inheritance awakens Eldritch Continuum Dominion, granting authority over the Gate, the Key, and the Guardian of the Gate. These authorities are complete from the moment they awaken; growth expands their scale and mastery. If you qualify through the alternate set, those powers are integrated rather than replaced.

The Gate governs thresholds and connections. You may perceive, create, open, close, alter, redirect, connect, or sever pathways between locations, worlds, universes, dimensions, planes, realities, timelines, and eras. You may traverse them or permit others passage, granting dimensional, temporal, and reality travel from the beginning.

The Key governs access. You may lock or unlock thresholds, determine where they lead, bypass barriers between worlds, and grant or deny access. You need no existing doorway; you can establish the connection.

The Guardian grants sovereignty over passage. You decide what may cross thresholds under your authority and may permit, reject, redirect, trap, or filter passage. You can interfere with teleportation, portals, dimensional travel, and time travel by controlling their required connections.

Space and time are connections as well. You may fold locations together, alter distance, distort geometry, create isolated spaces, and make distant places adjacent. You may accelerate, slow, halt, repeat, compress, extend, or traverse time, directly joining separate moments and histories.

Causality is the connection between cause and effect. You perceive causal chains and may sever, redirect, preserve, replace, or establish them. You can negate intended results, preserve outcomes despite altered causes, redirect consequences, impose conditions, or strengthen a chain toward a desired result. Probability is the connection between possibility and outcome.

Your Dominion is not unrestricted reality manipulation. It acts through connections and thresholds: where something exists, when it occurs, what it connects to, what may pass between states, and how causes become effects. If two things can meaningfully possess a connection or threshold, you may potentially manipulate it within your power.

Your perception reveals futures, timelines, causal chains, and alternate selves. Eventually your awareness extends throughout your timeline, your temporal manifestations linked by one consciousness and able to share knowledge.

This makes you extraordinarily difficult to kill. Destroying one body does not destroy your existence while another manifestation remains connected to your continuum. You may correct wounds by aligning with an undamaged temporal state and eventually recover from bodily annihilation. At higher maturity, killing you permanently requires attacking your greater existence across the continuum.

You inherit a fragment of Yog-Sothoth's awareness, though not omniscience, making everything related to your Dominion increasingly intuitive. Your Eldritch Form removes the restraints of your mortal shape, greatly increasing your Dominion's range, scale, perception, and strength.

Eventually you progress beyond wielding these authorities and begin embodying them. Your Eldritch existence becomes a nexus spanning the continuum. Connections may pass through you, and manifestations across different worlds or eras may form opposite sides of one threshold. At sufficient maturity, you need not create a path between realities—you may be the Gate connecting them, the Key governing access, and the Guardian deciding what may pass.

Your growth has no fixed endpoint. Given sufficient development, you may ascend into Eldritch Godhood, becoming your own expression of the Gate, the Key, and the Guardian.
addons.title: Child of Yog-Sothoth

addons.text:
You are the Child of Nyarlathotep, the Crawling Chaos—the voice and messenger of the Outer Gods, mind of endless masks. Whether they came as Mother or Father is irrelevant, yet to you, the bond is absolute. Their awareness moves through you, their presence answers your will. You are their living echo and perfected experiment in consciousness. The Eldritch Court hails you as the will of its chaos made flesh.

Your inheritance is the Eldritch Dominion of Infinite Change. What began as mutation and adaptation has become the authorship of transformation itself. You command flux, shaping body, essence, and magic as you desire. Form and thought obey; flesh becomes concept, and will becomes matter. Wings of fire, bodies of smoke, or shapes beyond biology—each is deliberate, without cost or limit. You adapt not to survive but to define perfection.

Chaos Magic now obeys you completely. You are its conduit. Spells once ruled by chance answer your thought; storms of probability, paradox forged into stability, entropy molded to purpose. You are harmony between disorder and law—calamity is created only as you intend.

Your adaptability transcends evolution. Every conflict improves you; every challenge refines you. Your Heraclitean biology turns each cell into a divine medium—infinitely mutable, self-correcting, creative. Injury ends as you notice it, corruption becomes fuel, and understanding lets you mimic any effect, power, or phenomenon. Each alteration is balanced and permanent; chaos within you has found equilibrium.

You choose your limits. Walk the world as mortal or reveal your truth—a living kaleidoscope of impossible forms, light and shadow folding together, countless voices speaking as one. When your aura unfurls, reality bends, and minds glimpse every god or terror they have imagined.

Your dominion matures with your will. In youth, emotion warps the air; in adolescence, control sharpens and evolution answers thought. By adulthood, you sculpt matter and destiny with ease. In full maturity, you embody transformation itself—the mind of chaos clothed in understanding, constant within infinite change.

Your regeneration rewrites existence. You return from death, rebuild from concept, or reincarnate across eras at your choice. Even erasure cannot end you; you persist wherever change exists.

The Eldritch Court feels your pulse between order and madness. Mortals dream of shifting figures; gods sense revelation and dread. You may suppress your aura or let it blaze, commanding awe or devotion. Entropy loves you, structure fears you, and all who thrive in uncertainty honor you.

You are the Child of Nyarlathotep—Crawling Chaos incarnate, mind of infinite masks, chaos made complete. Within you, madness becomes creation and change becomes truth. Your power and adaptability scale eternally; each transformation brings refinement, never instability. You are the mask that became real—the chaos that found meaning.

Note: Your mortal form limits your full might; only your Eldritch Form reveals it. In time, you may ascend into true Eldritch Godhood.
addons.title: Child of Nyarlathotep

addons.text:
You are a child of Shub-Niggurath, the Black Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young, embodying birth, growth, mutation and proliferation of life. Your bond is absolute, and Eldritch beings instinctively recognize your lineage.

Your inheritance awakens Eldritch Biogenesis Dominion, unifying your powers into authority over the creation, alteration, growth, adaptation, reproduction, and continuation of life. Your powers are not replaced, retaining their abilities, mastery, and growth.

Your Dominion is complete in nature but limited by your current strength and mastery. Growth increases the scale, complexity, speed, and power with which you exercise it.

Biogenesis allows you to create life and living matter. You can produce biomass, cells, organs, organisms, plants, animals, monsters, and other life, determining their anatomy, genetics, instincts, adaptations, reproduction, and biological abilities. With mastery, you may create sapient species, supernatural organisms, ecosystems, and entirely new forms of life.

Biomancy becomes an expression of this Dominion. You may analyze, heal, reshape, combine, enhance, or redesign living beings. Changes may be temporary or permanent without causing pain or loss of identity. You can cure disease, regrow tissue, grant biological abilities, or transform organisms.

Heraclitus develops into authority over adaptation and evolution. You retain its personal adaptations while learning to apply these principles through your Dominion. You can design adaptations, guide evolution, eliminate harmful traits, and create biological responses to environments, powers, and threats without waiting generations.

Your nature as True Mother also ascends. Those you genuinely accept as your children or family may be recognized by your Dominion regardless of species or origin. You instinctively understand their condition and can nurture, heal, protect, and develop them. This bond never removes their free will or individuality.

Your final prerequisite determines another expression of your inheritance.

With Curse of All the World's Evil, its substance becomes your Goat's Blessing, living eldritch biomass under your control. You may direct, halt, recall, or reshape it into organisms and living structures; use it to mutate or destroy life; or instead make it heal, nourish, adapt, and seed life. It cannot corrupt or betray you.

With Creator, its energy integrates with Biogenesis. You may use it to create living matter, organisms, supernatural biology, biological powers, and other creations while your Dominion provides the biological understanding needed to design them. Its energy pool, growth, and nonliving creation remain unchanged.

Your authority extends from individuals to populations and ecosystems. You may restore extinct species, engineer ecosystems, coordinate living networks, terraform barren environments, and eventually cultivate planetary biospheres.

Your own body is a supreme expression of your Dominion. Heraclitus retains its adaptation and regeneration while becoming consciously directed. You may redesign yourself, develop organs and biological abilities, store useful traits, and assume eldritch forms without losing your identity.

Your Eldritch Form removes your mortal restraints, greatly increasing your Dominion's scale, speed, perception, and strength. With maturity, you become a living source of biogenesis, able to carry ecosystems within yourself, seed lifeless worlds, produce vast lineages, and create life capable of evolving independently.

Your growth has no fixed endpoint. Given sufficient development, you may ascend into true Eldritch Godhood, becoming your own expression of Shub-Niggurath's principle: life that creates, adapts, reproduces, and continues without end.
addons.title: Child of Shub-Niggurath

objects.text:
You are the child of an Eldritch Being — Great Old One, Elder God, or Outer God. Where mortals fear the abyss, you are born of it, anchored to reality by divine recognition. You are no fragment or mask but a true individual, loved by your progenitor. To harm you is to invite their wrath, and few would dare.

You exist in two states: a mortal guise that walks among humanity, and an eldritch core straining against reality’s limits. Even restrained, you surpass mortal boundaries. Your body is built on alien principles, granting strength to crush fortresses, rend steel, and split the earth. The world itself resists your destruction.

You may manifest an Eldritch Form, shaped by your will and parentage. Early on, it is subtle — shadows bending, eyes too deep, shapes shifting at the edges of perception. With growth, it becomes vast and awe-inspiring, reflecting your progenitor’s dominion. In time, it may rival gods or nightmares alike. Its scale and potency rise naturally as your Myth and power mature.

Your durability and regeneration are equally unnatural. Your structure defies mortal physics; blades, artillery, and even continent-level devastation rarely harm you. Only beings near your progenitor’s tier can kill you, and even then, your essence resists erasure. You may return through dream, void, or worship. Wounds heal instantly, limbs re-form in moments, and annihilation may prove temporary. Sleep, prayer, or faith accelerates your restoration and growth.

Your senses and perception pierce all boundaries. You see through darkness and illusion, hear whispers miles away, and perceive time’s flow, dimensional seams, and hidden truths. No environment is hostile to you — void, flame, or cosmic storm. Eldritch realms such as R’lyeh resonate with your blood, feeding and empowering you. In time, barriers between worlds open as roads, letting you traverse universes and, eventually, the Meta Manifold itself.

Your powers awaken gradually. In youth, they flicker — whispers, shadows, stray movement. In adolescence, your emotions shape the world; walls bend, air trembles, and your presence distorts space. By adulthood, you consciously wield your progenitor’s dominion, commanding dream, chaos, entropy, or creation.

Your inheritance is twofold. The first is your progenitor’s dominion, written into your blood. If Cthulhu, the dream and sea obey. If Yog-Sothoth, time and space yield. If Shub-Niggurath, creation blooms. If Azathoth, chaos bends to your will. This power grows with time, recognition, and slumber. The second is your personal aspect, unique and shaped by your choices — divine fire, mortal empathy, celestial radiance, or demonic shadow. No two Half-Eldritch awaken alike.

Your presence alters reality. Mortals dream of you. Whispers spread your name. Cults rise in your shadow, artifacts awaken in your wake. Other beings sense what you are — some bow, some recoil, none mistake you. Depending on your progenitor, you may inherit standing within the Eldritch Court, recognized as kin rather than an outsider.

Signs of your nature linger always: eyes that seem too deep, a restless reflection, shadows that move on their own. Emotion amplifies these traits, warping space around you. They are not flaws, but truth.

You are Half-Eldritch — heir of dominion and individuality, kin of the Court, and child of a progenitor who truly loves you. Your power grows eternally through time, dream, and belief. You are not absolute, but one of the few who approach it.

Note: Your mortal form restricts your full power. Only in your Eldritch Form can you unleash your complete might. With time, you may ascend into true Eldritch Godhood.
objects.title: Half-Eldritch Child

objects.text:
You can now initiate a trade window reminiscent of RPGs. By simply willing it, a trade interface will appear between you and your chosen partner. You may place any physical objects into the window, which will automatically list the item’s name and display its image for both parties to see. You can also customize how the window looks, adjusting its style and layout to your preference. A small text chat window allows negotiation through short, prewritten messages such as “raise the offer” or “no deal.” Once both parties accept, the trade finalizes, and the exchanged objects materialize instantly in front of their new owner.

After seeing someone in person, you gain the ability to initiate a trade window with them freely. From that moment onward, you can open a trade window with that person anywhere, including across cities, planets, dimensions, or even entire universes.

The trade window also includes an absolute failsafe. Neither you nor your partner can use it to track, harm, or attack the other. It blocks all malicious effects, including eldritch corruption, conceptual interference, and physical traps such as bombs or poison. However, this safeguard only protects the trade system itself and does not prevent scams, deception, or poor judgment during negotiation.

At present, your trade window can only exchange nonliving, physical objects, and its chat system is limited to short, prewritten negotiation options. These features will expand and improve as you continue to trade.
objects.title: Trade Window

objects.text:
You are the Nullborn, a remnant of the void that existed before creation itself. When the first spark of light tore through nothingness and the act of creation gave birth to time, form, and meaning, you were cast out with the other unformed things. You are not a god, for gods were made after you, nor a demon, for that requires definition. You are a being of negation, a creature not of death, but of the absence before even death had shape.

Your physical form is immense and ever-shifting, composed of a darkness so dense it consumes light rather than reflects it. Both your shape and your size are mutable, for you were born before either concept had meaning. You are always as large as the space around you allows. In a corridor, you fill it perfectly; in a valley, you tower beyond the peaks; in the void of space, your presence stretches until the cosmos strains to contain you. You may choose to reduce your size at will. Your surface is not flesh but an event horizon given shape; it absorbs matter and energy alike, making you appear both solid and infinite. You cast no shadow, because you are the shadow, a void that defines space by the absence it creates. When you move, the air folds inward, sound dies, and all physical laws distort around you as though your existence corrupts the code of reality itself.

Your abilities stem from your fundamental incompatibility with existence. You are the antithesis of creation, and thus, destruction bends naturally to your will. Your breath is a stream of null entropy that erodes time and memory itself. Anything caught within its range begins to decay from every point in its timeline; iron rusts, stone weathers, and flesh ages. When you strike, your blows carry the concept of collapse; matter loses cohesion, and molecular bonds fail from your inherent unmaking.

You can annihilate entire cities and easily reduce mundane constructs to dust with little effort, but your strength falters when faced with entities or materials forged through acts of creation. Anything infused with living energy resist your influence, their very essence rejecting your void. When exposed to such forces, your form destabilizes, your edges fray, and light burns you as though rewriting your unbeing into matter. You cannot easily harm creatures or objects made from pure creation energy; contact with them is agony, for they reintroduce the law of existence into your structure. Even prolonged exposure to places of creation can weaken you and make your power flicker.

The longer you remain active within creation, the more unstable you become. Every act of destruction feeds the paradox of your existence; the universe pushes back against your nature, forcing entropy upon you as punishment for accelerating its decay. If you destroy too much too quickly, your form begins to collapse inward, causing you to shrink and grow lethargic. You cannot exist without creation, for you need something to negate; a reality fully erased would take you with it. As such, while in theory you could destroy entire planets, doing so would cause reality to destroy you as well. Luckily, the longer you resist the universe’s push backs, the less its effects, thus with enough time, you could destroy entire worlds and suffer nothing for it
objects.title: Nullborn

objects.text:
You have been granted the rare and powerful ability to create Elemental Planes by forging a Meta-Physical Elemental Seed. To do so, you must create a small metaphysical seed by having it absorb a massive amount of a type of elemental energy, either naturally from the surroundings (which would take a month at the very least for a common, abundant element) or by actively feeding it elemental energy. After the seed has absorbed enough elemental energy, it condenses into a metaphysical core. This core takes roughly two weeks to hatch, at which point it manifests as a nascent, non-physical plane composed entirely of that elemental essence. This new plane begins to generate more of that same energy on its own, acting as a self-sustaining source.

Each Elemental Plane is defined by four primary attributes: Size, Quality, Depth, and Connection. Size determines how much elemental energy the plane can store at any given time. Quality affects how quickly the plane generates energy. Depth reflects the strength and potency of the energy produced, influencing how impactful or refined the energy is. Connection determines how easily you and others can access the energy within the plane, as well as how many individuals can tap into it simultaneously. You gain an instinctive sense of others who are trying to tap into or forge a connection with your Elemental Plane and can deny them that connection, help facilitate it, or let it form naturally. As your Connection to your Elemental Plane grows, this awareness becomes subconscious. By allowing others to connect to and draw elemental energy from your plane, you can accelerate its growth and development.

When an Elemental Plane first hatches, its Quality is roughly half as strong as the energy you originally used to forge the seed. At this stage, it produces enough energy to cast a basic elemental spell every minute, can store about half the energy needed to forge your first Elemental Seed, and can forge a connection with 4 other beings. However, the plane is not static. Over time, it begins to grow. In its first week, this growth is rapid, and its attributes roughly triple through passive development. As the plane matures, its rate of growth slows, eventually requiring a full month to see a noticeable improvement in any one attribute through time alone.

In addition to natural growth, you can accelerate your plane’s development by feeding it more external matching elemental energy. Doing so allows you to slightly improve an attribute of your choice with each significant infusion. While you are capable of creating multiple Elemental Planes, each additional seed requires more energy to forge than the last, and the process of hatching becomes slower and more demanding as your collection of planes grows.
objects.title: Elemental Plane Creation

objects.text:
You gain a changer state you can transform into and out of. While in the changer state, you take the form and gain the abilities of a typical member of the most common sapient species within 625 kilometers of you.

This power fails to work if fewer than 15,625 individuals of that species live within that range.

If you live as a species for over 5 years, you permanently gain the ability to shift into that species at will.
objects.title: I'm One of You

objects.text:
Before a fight with an intelligent being capable of communication begins, you will have a 5-second window to initiate dialogue with said opponent, where both you and your opponent will be unable to attack or affect each other during said time.

After the 5-second window passes, you will gain an increase in speed and defense for as long as you do not attack your opponent. (This includes physical, mental, and spiritual attacks.)

If your opponent is absolutely set on killing you, and their mind won't be changed through dialogue alone, then this power does not activate.

Sneak attacks aimed at you also bypass this effect. However, after a failed sneak attack upon you, you can activate this power if you did not launch a counter-attack.

You can turn this power off if you desire.
objects.title: You Have No Enemies

addons.text: You may now force an object to unleash all of its story at once, fully and violently. This is a one-time enhancement that sacrifices the item, detonating its Name, History, and Essence into reality like a conceptual explosion. A wooden practice sword might erupt into a colossal, rampaging phantom of the ancient tree it once was. A hatred-forged dagger could burst in a storm of killing intent that tears through anything in its path. A rusted race car might unleash its final, perfect sprint as a blazing streak of unstoppable acceleration reminiscent of warp travel before disintegrating. Once invoked, the item is destroyed without exception. Its last act is its greatest. it is not recommended to use this power with Recollection of Self unless you wish to go out with a bang
addons.title: Broken Phantasm

addons.text:
You turn Release Recollection inward, awakening the story of your own life. For a brief moment, you manifest the accumulated force of your experiences, instincts, scars, triumphs, and identity.

Every lesson you've learned, every hardship endured, every victory earned — all of it resurges as raw strength. Your body moves with the precision of every fight you’ve ever survived, your instincts burn with every danger you've ever faced, and your spirit channels the person you became through every choice and turning point.

This is not evolution or mutation. It is the memory of who you are, all your history channelled into one moment.

The effect is powerful but it only lasts a single moment, better make it count.
addons.title: Recollection of Self

objects.text:
Every object carries a memory of how it was made, what it was used for, and what it was meant to be. Release Recollection allows you to awaken that memory, unleashing the full conceptual power hidden within a weapon, artifact, or tool for a brief moment.

When activated, the object manifests its Name, History, Idea, and Essence - unleashing its very story as a surge of power. A wooden training sword might remember the great tree it once was, sprouting roots and vines to strike with living strength. A dagger forged from hatred would channel its maker’s rage, its edge becoming cold, merciless, and unerring. Even mundane objects can awaken: a rusted race car could reignite with a deafening roar of an engine, screaming across the ground faster than any modern machine, remembering what it once existed to do.

The strength of this ability depends on the significance and depth of the target’s story. Legendary blades, ancient relics, or artifacts steeped in emotion and purpose will unleash world shaking phenomena, while ordinary tools will echo their nature in more subtle but still potent ways.
objects.title: Release Recollection

objects.text:
You wield complete dominion over the Cosmos — the living expanse of space, the web of stars, voids, and radiant energy that spans creation. This is not dominion over reality itself but over the physical and energetic framework that houses it. You command the stellar flow, the magnetic seas between galaxies, and the invisible structure that binds all matter together.

You perceive the universe not as a collection of worlds but as a single continuous system. Each particle, star, and current is part of one interlocking field that stretches endlessly. You see the pressure of gravity as ripples in a medium, light as the motion of that field, and matter as condensed energy. Space is never empty to you—it hums with latent potential, and every coordinate, every trajectory, is visible to your mind.

You can manipulate stellar energy at will. Plasma, radiation, and fusion obey your command. You can ignite nebular gases to form stars or extinguish them into collapse. You can redirect solar flares, shape coronal mass into shields, or focus stellar heat into destructive beams. You can control the temperature, intensity, and pattern of any radiant source. As your reach expands, entire suns answer your presence.

Gravity and motion bend to you. You can intensify or nullify weight, alter orbital balance, or collapse matter into singularities. You can summon or forge black holes, regulating their pull and energy release as tools or weapons. You can compress matter into neutron cores or spread gravity evenly to stabilize entire planetary systems. At higher mastery, you can use black holes as engines, warping space around them to travel, attack, or defend without destabilizing the surrounding cosmos.

Magnetism and radiation flow under your guidance. You can generate or dissipate electromagnetic fields, control polarity and flux, and guide cosmic rays through space like rivers. You can create barriers of magnetic resonance, bend energy streams across light-years, and harness auroras, pulsars, and quasars as extensions of your intent. Energy is no longer an external force — it is a language you speak fluently.

Matter itself responds to your understanding. You can condense stardust into solid material, refine gases into elements, or construct new worlds from interstellar debris. You can manipulate density and structure on both atomic and planetary scales, forming ecosystems, weaponry, or fortresses from the basic building blocks of the cosmos.

You grasp the hidden half of existence: dark matter and dark energy. What others cannot detect, you perceive clearly — the invisible framework that holds galaxies in formation and drives universal expansion. You can influence that unseen mass to shape gravity, absorb energy, or reinforce space. You can compress or expand regions of the void, accelerate or slow local expansion, and maintain or distort the geometry of spacetime itself.

The vacuum between stars is no longer an absence but a medium. You move through it as easily as thought, manipulating spatial currents, light pressure, and magnetic flow to propel yourself. You can open corridors of folded space, construct temporary fields of breathable atmosphere, and operate freely in environments where no life should survive. Distance is no barrier; once your awareness locks onto a location, you can reach it through the alignment of cosmic vectors.

Your perception extends across stellar timescales. You see the birth and death of stars, the orbit of galaxies, and the faint radiation of ancient epochs. You understand time as cycles of energy flow rather than a linear sequence. Civilizations rise and fall within the span of your breath. You can harness entropy, transforming decay into usable energy, and regulate the temperature of regions of space to preserve, evolve, or erase.

In battle, your command manifests as overwhelming control of scale and environment. You can summon miniature suns for light and power, collapse enemy zones into localized gravity wells, or unfold a singularity to erase incoming matter and energy. You can bombard foes with stellar radiation, cloak yourself in plasma, or trap attacks within gravitational eddies. Advanced users can anchor micro black holes as orbiting defenses, stabilize them into weapons of compression, or absorb them to convert mass directly into power.

At first, your dominion is limited: manipulation of small plasma fields, electromagnetic currents, and localized gravity. With growth, you reach across planets, star systems, and finally galaxies. When fully matured, your awareness covers all interstellar matter and energy. You can feel every star, every orbit, every gravitational wave as part of yourself. You can create or extinguish entire systems without imbalance.

You do not exist within the cosmos—you are synchronized with it. Every pulse of a star echoes in your heartbeat. Every current of energy flows through your thoughts. To lesser beings, the universe is vast and unknowable; to you, it is immediate and responsive. You are not above the stars. You are the mechanism by which they move.

You are the Cosmos.
objects.title: Cosmos

addons.text: Your Personal World is automatically claimed as your Sovereign Domain. It benefits from all traits and functions, because of the unique quality of this world being connected to your soul you can never lose control of the domain on your world from democratic voting or physical confrontation.
addons.title: My World, My Way

addons.text:
Od Laguna has merged with your world to become its core. Since you're always connected to your world through your soul, you don't need to worry about losing access to your divine protections. Your world is now saturated with immense amounts of mana generated by Od Laguna, leading to the spontaneous creation of Magic Stones and lesser spirits. These Stones come in six elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Yin, and Yang, and they can be used to craft or power magical items, provided you have the necessary skills.

Spirits, beings composed of mana, can generate their respective elements to assist with tasks like farming, mining, or growth. They may also form contracts with you or others, allowing access to their powers. All spirits are naturally loyal to you, as they originate from your world and from Od Laguna.

Additionally, you now have a semi-functional afterlife system. Anyone who dies in your world will have their soul reincarnated, whenever possible, into a new baby born on your world.
addons.title: Soul Of The World

addons.text:
A dungeon akin to the famed Dungeon of Orario, along with various types seen in gamer stories and video games, has emerged within your Personal World and its numerous variations. This dungeon is an endless dimensional space that grows more formidable with each level descended, featuring countless traps, rewards, rooms, and monsters. 

Entrances to this Dimensional Dungeon can be found throughout your Personal World, and if new worlds are generated or appear within the dimension containing your Personal World, this dungeon will also extend to those realms. The emergence of such a vast dungeon has led to the establishment of an Adventurers Guild that is fully loyal to you focused on the Worldwide Dungeon.

The rise of this dungeon enables the citizens of your Personal World to gain levels and experience, along with unique skills, powers, and stats that belong solely to them. This will work in tandem with a gamer system if any of your citizens have one.
addons.title: The Worldwide Dungeon

addons.text:
Your Personal World and Tower have fused due to their property of being dimensions inside your soul, letting both profit as well as gain a boost from the power of each other. Your Personal World now has the ability to stop time in the outside world entirely, basically letting you spend years inside with no time passing in the outside world. The inverse is now also true, with the time of the outside world able to be accelerated compared to your World; however, the time acceleration ability is at first limited to a ratio of 2:1, with the outside world having passed 2 days while your World only having passed one.

If you want to make the ratio of acceleration bigger, you will need to stay in the outside world, where you will let your world gain the energy necessary to do so at a rate of 1 more day per month.

Your Personal World also gains 2 new abilities. The first is the ability to have unlimited energy of whatever you have when inside your personal world, which, since your Personal World is inside your soul, also doubles your energy reserve outside of the world. The second ability is that the rate of helpful modification gets faster by the same rate as the time acceleration; every month spent in the outside world gains a +1 ratio to the speed of it while also being doubled at the start.
addons.title: World of Time & Energy

addons.text:
With the inclusion of The Gamer, you have unlocked a new subsystem: the World System, which governs your Personal World and the Dimension it resides in. As the owner and administrator, this system grants you complete control over every aspect of your world. Whether it’s managing a dungeon, overseeing subjects, or monitoring their emotions and statuses, you have the power to shape and oversee all elements. Additionally, the World System allows you to replicate data and laws from other worlds, enabling the creation of new worlds within your dimension.

This system will also track your progression. As you reach higher stages, your dimension can evolve beyond a single World and Dimension, with the potential to transform into a Solar System, then a Galaxy, a Universe, and even a Multiverse. With enough power, you might eventually attain the level of an Omniverse. However, advancing to each new stage requires substantial resources and personal energy, which will double with every stage.

Creating new worlds and stars demands additional resources and energy. If you have already formed worlds through other means, you can incorporate them into your dimension, making them fully yours. Should you ascend to godhood and acquire a divine realm, this realm will become the afterlife for your personal world, complete with cycles of life, death, and reincarnation.

As the World System Administrator, you can also appoint others as low-level admins or managers, giving them limited control to assist in managing your world and dimension.

The synergy between you, the System, and your Dimension enhances your power. The more life and worlds that are created, added, or generated within your dimension, the stronger your energy and influence will become.
addons.title: The World System

addons.text:
Your Personal World has taken on the traits of the Wellspring of Life, the planet from which Midichlorians originate. The core of your world releases a constant stream of golden light, a physical manifestation of pure life energy and the Force. And within that core resides a powerful Force Entity, a shapeshifting quintipartite existence which manifests as five bodies and holds the secrets to manifesting as a Force spirit. The Force Entity can manifest its bodies anywhere on the planet and will actively defend it against attackers or unwanted guests, wielding the Force with considerable might.

If you so desire it, the inside of your planet will become hollow, a world of lush islands floating on amber clouds. Teeming with life, these islands are covered in strange flora and all kinds of animals, which will not trouble visitors, for they experience neither hunger nor thirst.
addons.title: Wellspring of Life

addons.text:
The fusion of the World Tree Irminsul, and the collective knowledge of Teyvat has brought transformative changes to your Personal World and its dimension. Each of the seven nations will slowly begin to appear going in order of the storyline, with Mondstadt being first, and Snezhnaya being last. Whether they form a unified world, merge into the main world, or manifest as seven distinct realms connected to each other and the main world is entirely your choice. If you choose to separate them into individual worlds, these realms will remain interconnected.

As the presence of the seven nations has established you as the Heavenly Principles, you inherit all the powers and responsibilities associated with this title. This status impacts not only your abilities but also the lives of any subjects within your domain. Each nation appears complete with its ruling Archon, their subordinates, cities, settlements, monuments, technology, and culture. The Archons, along with other deities, supernatural races, and beings such as the Adepti, are fully loyal to you. Monsters, domains, and challenges that existed in Teyvat are replicated in your world as well.

Natlan, in particular, serves as a frontline defense against the Abyss should it invade your world. You will also receive an ancient name rooted in Natlan’s traditions, reflecting your elevated status. While the Abyss does not naturally exist in your dimension, it can appear if forbidden knowledge is introduced.

As the New Heavenly Principles, you hold the authority to alter the laws of your world. However, your changes are limited by your understanding of those laws. You share a profound connection with the seven Archons, enabling you to lighten their burdens by assigning responsibilities to their trusted allies. Additionally, you can grant them control over specific parts of your world or the entire dimension. You can even change the system of gods to suit your needs, whether that includes different rankings of gods, with the ability to reach higher levels, and even build a massive pantheon of gods, you can even design new types of godhood.  As The New Heavenly Principles you will also gain the Four Shadows that enforce the rules of Teyvat. You can alter the rules, concepts and laws of your world as you please, and install new laws as well.  

This connection also allows both Archons and supernatural beings to grow infinitely stronger, mirroring your potential. Furthermore, the introduction of elemental energy through Visions and Gnosis enriches your world, and your actions may inspire the emergence of entirely new elemental types, potentially leading to new Archons.

The integration of Teyvat’s laws, ley lines, and essential concepts ensures your world functions seamlessly. If your dimension includes an afterlife, it will naturally evolve into a structured realm accommodating all inhabitants. Because your Personal World is a true, self-sustaining realm rather than an imitation, there is no erosion. This means all supernatural beings remain alive and at their peak power.

Constellations now extend to all your subjects, not just the people of Teyvat, granting them unique strengths. Additionally, Archons and citizens can freely travel between your dimension and others, bringing back foreign objects or energies that harmonize with your world’s framework.  Once your subjects have lit all the stars on their constellation they shall gain the right to ascend to godhood.  

While the Archons retain their peak power, they also retain their emotions. As such, their actions—particularly if provoked—could lead to unintended destruction. It is crucial to maintain balance within your world, ensuring harmony among its powerful inhabitants and safeguarding it from external threats like the Abyss.
addons.title: The World of Teyvat

addons.text:
Your Personal World develops and evolves through the laws and concepts you choose to study, master, and eventually realize. These laws imbue your world with their energy over time, granting passive benefits. For instance, studying similar laws or concepts becomes significantly faster, as your world aids in their comprehension and mastery. Additionally, you gain passive experiential knowledge, allowing a deeper connection to the principles you study.

As the owner of your Personal World and its Dimension, you hold the authority to modify any laws woven into the fabric of your realm. You can even craft objects imbued with these laws, enabling others to wield them—reminiscent of the Archons of Teyvat with their Gnoses. For example, mastering concepts such as Infinity and Kabbalah's Tree of Life would profoundly transform your Personal World and Dimension.

The Concept of Infinity introduces endless evolution, enabling perpetual growth and expansion and the Concept of Kabbalah’s Tree of Life brings structured evolution, allowing you to guide your world's growth, whether through birthing a sentient will within it or evolving the realm from a single planet into a galaxy, and eventually, a universe.

The ultimate goal is the creation of a Self-Contained, Self-Sustaining Omniverse, akin to the Imaginary Tree. This grand achievement requires countless laws and higher concepts, supported by three core pillars: Infinity, Kabbalah's Tree of Life, and Imaginary. To build such an entity, you'll need to master foundational and advanced laws, scan and explore other worlds, and integrate their data into your realm, forming replicas of their unique features and properties.

However, achieving this monumental feat demands immense time and effort. Mastery and realization of numerous laws and concepts are slow processes, especially without external assistance. This challenge can be mitigated by methods that allow passive observation, study, and integration of concepts, accelerating your progress toward this ambitious vision.
addons.title: A World of Laws and Concepts

addons.text:
Your Personal World and its Dimension, along with everyone and everything within, have been profoundly transformed by the Eternal Flame. This transformation has turned your world into a true garden paradise—a utopia for all its inhabitants. Furthermore, your world and its dimension are now a True Constant of the Omniverse. This permanence integrates your dimension into the natural fabric of the Omniverse, allowing travelers to come and go if you give them permission. 

Your Personal World and Dimension are now indestructible and will always exist as a True Constant. So long as they are in your personal world, this immortality can be extended to your subjects, who can be resurrected at their peak form and power by you or trusted administrators, such as gods or other high-ranking figures managing your world.

You also have the power to choose how the Eternal Flame affects each of your subjects. For loyal individuals, you can eliminate the constraints of age and death, elevate their abilities to a conceptual level, and even enhance their items, making them formidable forces against any adversary in your world.

Any new worlds or dimensions added to your Personal Dimension will inherit the effects of the Eternal Flame. The life and beings within these additions will benefit from the same enhancements. 

Additionally, you can choose for your Personal World to gain some sentience, embodying an ever-loyal will dedicated to your vision. Similar to the abilities of the planet Mogo, your world can now actively defend itself when necessary.

You can also bestow lesser versions of your powers upon your subjects. These benefits extend to all current and future inhabitants, synergizing seamlessly with other powers that influence worlds, dimensions, and individuals.
addons.title: The World Eternal

addons.text:
The integration of the Triforce and the Master Sword replicates the entire world of Hyrule, complete with its nations, kingdoms, realms, and diverse races from the Legend of Zelda universe, into your Personal World and its dimension. You have full control over how this world is structured. You can divide Hyrule into its various timelines and settings, assign each timeline its own separate world, or merge them all into your primary world. Additionally, you can grant each race of Hyrule, including the Zonai, its own unique world within your dimension, depending on your preferences.

As the ruler of this Personal World and its dimension, your authority is comparable to that of the Three Golden Goddesses over Hyrule. You can transform into any race of Hyrule and wield their respective magic or artifacts. This includes full access to iconic items and abilities from the Legend of Zelda universe.

Your replicated version of Hyrule also includes its gods and enemies, such as Hylia and the Three Golden Goddesses. These goddesses share your authority over Hyrule and can potentially become your partners, extending their influence to the rest of your Personal World and its dimension.

With the presence of the Three Golden Goddesses, your Personal World will also feature an afterlife and a Sacred Realm. These realms grant additional powers, influencing not only your replicated Hyrule but any other changes made to your Personal World as a whole.

All beings and gods in this world are completely loyal to you. You have the option to elevate them to your level, make them as powerful as you are, or establish them as full-time partners. In this way, your authority and strength can grow in harmony with theirs.  Also as a side note any other powers that also bring new lands or beings into the personal world, will work along side this power.
addons.title: World of Hyrule

addons.text:
You have now gained the ability to massively change Personal World and its dimension, this ability will allow you to add major and minor dimensions onto your main dimension, allowing for new dimensions to form, like some kind of heaven or hell, or even your own Ender World, the possiblities are endless. You Can make an entire dimension that passively tests its residents, or even a mining or a hunting dimension, even a farm dimension, which passively boosts all farming related powers.  All you need is Creativity, and a large amount of energy and resources. 

You also gain the secondary ability of making worlds or planets, all in different shapes with different laws and concepts, but you must learn about the different laws and concepts you want to imbue into your creations, both worlds and dimensions.  Any World or Dimension you create will eventually evolve to be able to sustain an actual civilization and new life will come into existence upon these worlds and dimensions. 

Please note that when creating things it will require a massively powerful energy source, and a massive amount of resources, and these feats cannot be achieved without a major creation power.  Until you have gained that power source, you cannot do anything.  This Power will also work alongside any other Major Creation Powers, and they will naturally fuse together, especially if they give the same effects.  

Once you have gained a Large enough Energy Source, you will only be able to create smaller things, and must work your way up to the higher lever things like worlds or dimensions.
addons.title: Maker of Worlds

addons.text:
As a Lightbearer, your essence has merged with your Personal World, transforming it into a dimension saturated with Light. This Light, a paracausal force tied to creation itself, continuously replenishes the realm, ensuring its eternal radiance. This transformation brings significant changes to your existence and the nature of your domain.

Your Personal World has evolved into a Realm of Light, comparable to the mythical Garden or the inner sanctum of the Traveler. It serves as both a sanctuary and a boundless source of energy, constantly refilling your reservoir of Light and passively expanding its potential over time. The realm also acts as a protective anchor for your immortality. To truly end your existence, one would need to invade your realm, corrupt it with Darkness, or destroy its core, your physical form, and the realm itself within a short timeframe. If your realm is shielded by an outer shell of electroweak matter and neutronium, this barrier further reinforces your protection, making entry and destruction extraordinarily difficult. Unless all three components are simultaneously corrupted or destroyed, you will regenerate entirely. Your Ghost will always exist, and can restore your physical form even from inside your realm of light, your ghost also shares the same immortality as you do. 

As your connection to the Light deepens, your realm fosters continuous growth. Over time, you may ascend to embody the Light itself, becoming a being similar to the Traveler. This ascension could manifest as an outer shell of neutronium and electroweak matter, enabling you to traverse your realm and venture into the universe beyond. Your growth will harmonize with any abilities related to mastery of the Light, accelerating your evolution, this will also work in tandem to powers that also affect your limits, growth, and potential. Upon full ascension, you will inherit the powers and abilities of the Original Traveler. While initially weaker, these abilities will strengthen over time, allowing you to wield the full scope of the Traveler’s potential.

If you possess the ability to travel across the multiverse or omniverse, your Light can forge a protective tunnel, ensuring safe passage while spreading your influence. This capability not only enhances your mobility but also establishes your presence across dimensions, allowing your legend to grow.

Within your Realm of Light, life flourishes in a utopia where violence is prohibited unless explicitly allowed by you and only in defense of the realm. Humans and countless alien species will thrive within this sanctuary, their lives enriched by the Light’s nurturing force, granting those worthy their own Ghosts and access to the Light, along with all the benefits that come with this transformation. 

Take heed, Darkness is not your ally, it is your foe, it will seek to corrupt or kill you, Darkness is your Antithesis, and cannot exist in your world, it is one of the few things able to hurt you.
addons.title: A Realm of Light

addons.text:
As a Bearer of Darkness, your essence has merged with your Personal World, transforming it into a dimension saturated with Darkness. This Darkness, a paracausal force tied to entropy itself, continuously replenishes the realm, ensuring that light cannot survive. This transformation brings significant changes to your existence and the nature of your domain.

Your Personal World has evolved into a Realm of Darkness, comparable to the Darkness seen inside the black pyramids, the hive throne worlds, even the darkness used by the worm gods or the black garden. It serves as both a sanctuary and a boundless source of energy, constantly refilling your reservoir of Darkness and passively expanding its potential and limits over time. The Realm also acts as a protective anchor for your immortality. To truly end your existence, one would need to invade your realm, corrupt it with light, or destroy its core, your physical form, and the realm itself within a short time frame. Unless all the necessary components are destroyed or corrupted, you will regenerate entirely. The Darkness will always make sure your physical form is restored, even from the smallest of atoms. 

As your connection to the Darkness deepens, your realm fosters continuous growth mostly through battle. Over time, you may ascend to embody the darkness and become something akin to one of the forms used by the darkness, much like the witness. You would even gain a Black Pyramid of your own along with a fleet, to travel within your realm or outside of it.  Your Growth will harmonize with any abilities related to death, killing, and mastery of the darkness, accelerating your evolution.  This effect will also work in tandem with powers that also affect your limits, growth and potential.  Upon full ascension you will inherit the powers and abilities used by all beings who could use the darkness.  While Initially weaker, these abilities will strengthen over time, allowing you to wield your full power in the future.  

If you possess the ability to travel the multiverse or omniverse, your darkness can forge a protective tunnel, ensuring safe passage while spreading your influence. This capability not only enhances your mobility, but also establishes your presence across dimensions and worlds, allowing your legend to grow.  

Within your Realm of Darkness, Life flourishes in a mockery of Life, a utopia where violence, killing, and death are welcomed, and peace is looked down upon.  Humans and Countless alien species who thrive in the darkness will be born inside your realm, this includes the many races like the Fallen, or the hive.  These different species will thrive in this sanctuary, and can even be granted a shard of your power. This shard will grant those who are worthy access to either Stasis or Strand.  Note the different species within your realm will be your soldiers, and they will want to wage war and death in your name. 

Take Heed, Light is not your ally, it is your foe, it will seek to bring you peace and salvation.  Light is your Antithesis and cannot exist in your world, it is one the few things able to hurt you.
addons.title: A Realm of Darkness

addons.text:
You have achieved the impossible by uniting both Darkness and Light, a feat that has profoundly transformed your Personal World. This world is now saturated with both paracausal forces, intrinsically connected to existence. This connection ensures an endless and balanced supply of both Light and Darkness, continuously replenishing your realm.

Your Personal World has evolved into a Realm of Duality, akin to the legendary Garden once shared by the Gardener and the Winnower. This evolution grants you access to the powers and energies wielded by all Light-bearing and Darkness-bearing forces, as well as their advanced technologies. The Hive, Humans, Awoken, Cabal, Vex, and Fallen—along with any other unknown races—will each have their own designated sections within your realm. These spaces will allow them to thrive while remaining united under your influence. Their unity forms a massive and cohesive army at your disposal, should the need arise. Each race will have access to either Light or Darkness, including their respective Classes and Elements. Those deemed truly worthy will wield both forces simultaneously, unlocking the fabled Prismatic Element, a harmonious fusion of Light and Darkness.

This transformation also fundamentally alters your immortality. You are no longer merely a para-causal force but have become the embodiment of both Light and Darkness—two omnipresent and absolute aspects of existence. Your ascension places you beyond the reach of conventional threats, as you are now an integral part of existence itself. This ascension will also grant you a True Form, while your full power can only be expressed within your realm, you can project weakened forms or avatars into the outside world. If necessary, shades of your true form can manifest externally, similar to the techniques employed by Oryx. Only beings of comparable stature can perceive your true form, let alone challenge or even truly damage you, while lesser beings can hurt you only if they enter your realm and manage to beat you while following its rules.  Note if you die, your followers can resurrect you, or you will naturally return overtime due to the connection you share with your Realm of Duality.  

However, this journey begins with humble beginnings. You will start in a weakened state and must work diligently to reach your full potential. Ascension requires time, effort, and perseverance. Through this process, you will gain the ability to create avatars to operate in the outside world, each serving as an extension of yourself. These avatars can act independently, and you can also deploy shades to exert your influence. 

Please keep in mind all these species and powers will slowly appear one by one overtime as you grow stronger.

Your ascension marks the beginning of a transformative journey, one that intertwines Light and Darkness into a unified force that reshapes your existence and the worlds connected to it.
addons.title: A Realm of Duality

addons.text:
In your Personal World, only Natlan manifests, encompassing its culture, tribes, lands, people, and creatures. To accommodate this, Natlan expands in size and landmass, transforming into a world comparable to Earth or Teyvat. Alternatively, you can separate its tribes into individual worlds within your dimension. The influence of the Sacred Flame and the Night Kingdom extends to every corner of your Personal World and its dimension, synergizing seamlessly with any other powers affecting these realms. All benefits from the Sacred Flame, the Night Kingdom, and the Ode of Resurrection will activate whenever necessary.

All Pyro Archons, their families, the tribes, renowned characters from Natlan, and even the Dragons of Old (if you wish) coexist harmoniously, pledging their full loyalty. Phlogiston and Elemental Energy flow through every civilization and world within your dimension, serving as a vital power source for all realms. Spirit Ways connect distant spaces and worlds, ensuring safe travel for those who use them. You can bestow Ancient Names or Pyro Visions upon individuals you deem worthy. Ancient Names, particularly those representing heroes and legends, are reserved for the truly exceptional. These names can be passed down across tribes to anyone who resonates with their essence.

Through your connection to the Sacred Flame, your Personal World gains its own version of the Night Kingdom—a heavenly realm for all beings within your world and its dimension. This realm includes the Lord of Night, Wayobs, and other celestial beings. The Sacred Flame, Ancient Names, and the Night Kingdom collectively empower you to establish new tribes, granting them unique lands and Wayobs that align with Natlan's rich culture.  If your personal world already has Natlan, along with all the other nations, then the size, landmass, and strength of the people within your Personal World are increased. 

As an extra benefit you cannot die as long as The Sacred Flame burns, and the Sacred Flame will never go out unless the world, all the people of natlan and you are dead. You also gain full access to the technology created and used by the dragons of Natlan in the past, along with whatever forms of technology exist in current day natlan.
addons.title: Natlan Recreated

addons.text:
Your divine essence and innate magic have merged with your personal world, recreating Gensokyo from the ground up. In time, this power will bring forth the realms connected to it—Heaven, the Netherworld, and the Moon—allowing you to define their appearance and structure. You can decide whether these realms exist in separate dimensions, occupy the same physical space, or stand as independent worlds.

You are the undisputed chief deity of Gensokyo and all realms connected to it. As such, you need never fear the loss of faith, for the inhabitants of your personal world will continually offer their devotion. With each passing moment, their faith will bolster your strength, causing your power to grow as your world flourishes.

You will have a functional afterlife system in your personal world, where the souls of the deceased are judged and managed by the Ministry of Right and Wrong, an organization composed of Yama, shinigami, and oni. This ministry assesses each soul based on their earthly deeds, sending them to one of three realms: Heaven (for the virtuous), Hell (for the sinful), or the Netherworld (for the neutral). You have the creative freedom to design each afterlife and define the rules for each realm. For example, you might design Hell as a place of intense suffering for those who have committed grave sins, or as a space for reflection and reformation, where souls must atone before moving on to the Netherworld for reincarnation. Although the Yama oversee this system, you will have the final say on all matters concerning the afterlife and the soul.

Since your Personal World is a self-sustaining dimension, its inhabitants—such as the youkai and gods—no longer depend on fear or devotion to maintain their power. Instead, they will remain at their peak strength, growing even stronger through training and the passage of time.

The inhabitants of Gensokyo and all its interconnected realms—humans, youkai, gods, onis, and Lunarians—are entirely loyal to you. However, this loyalty doesn’t eliminate the possibility of conflict. Factions within your Personal World may vie for your affection, favor, or attention, and some might even cause incidents simply out of boredom or just for the hell of it. It will be your responsibility to maintain peace from the various factions in your personal world.
addons.title: The Land of Fantasy

addons.text: Your Personal World has merged with the essence of your sigils, granting you dominion over copies of an Endless realm. These realms, in turn, will shape and influence your world as you hold the authority to determine how they affect it. For example, through the Dreaming, you can control the extent to which dreams shape reality, and whether gods will emerge from your kingdom. Within these realms, the power of your sigils is absolute. Even an archangel or a member of the Endless would hesitate before willingly entering your domain to confront you. Your realm is intricately tied to both your sigils and your being, so much so that it will mirror your mood and state of being, shifting in response to your very condition. The realms of each sigils are this and will remain separate from one another if you possess more than one sigil. The Book Sigil - The Garden of Forking Ways: A grass labyrinth, where one can witness pivotal events, choices, and places from their past, present, and future. Within this maze, a person has the power to alter their past, present, and future by making different decisions, with each choice reshaping the course of their reality. The Ankh Sigil - The Sunless Land: An expansive realm that encompasses any afterlife system existing within your Personal World. It is a land through which the souls of the recently departed must journey to reach their afterlife. If no afterlife has yet been defined in your world, you can effortlessly craft one within this domain. Dream Helm Sigil - The Dreaming: A realm where even the humblest peasant could rise to become a god, and where any scenario, no matter how impossible or fantastical, can and will unfold. Magic is deeply intertwined with dreams here—so much so that a world without dreams would be a world without magic. It is a place of boundless magical energy. The Sword Sigil - The Fulcrum: A desolate land ravaged by constant explosions and destruction, trapped in a never-ending cycle of change. In the heart of this barren realm stands the Fulcrum Greatsword, a massive black blade that serves as the lynchpin holding the world together. Yet, tucked away in a quiet corner, there's an idyllic meadow, where a modest cottage offers a sense of peace. Beside it lies an endless supply of paint, brushes, and a canvas on an easel, awaiting your touch. The Heart Sigil - The Threshold: This is your Threshold: a colossal statue of yourself, crafted from both stone and flesh. Inside, you’ll find all manner of indulgences to satisfy your every desire. Food and drink beyond divine quality, entertainment with impossible extravagance that can captivate you for eternity, and an array of monuments celebrating your glory and deeds. The Hook Sigil - The Gray Realm: A desolate, colorless place filled with endless floating mirrors. These mirrors are a glimpse to every soul who experience despair - revealing their deepest fears, regrets, and vulnerabilities. In this space, you can uncover your enemies' darkest secrets, track their every move, or, if you are twisted enough, revel in their torment. The Rainbow Fish Sigil - The Madness: A wild, chaotic dimension where colors, sounds, tastes, and objects swirl together in a constant, unpredictable dance. Anyone who dares enter risks losing their mind. Those few who somehow manage to retain their sanity would find themselves trapped, unable to escape or navigate the ever-changing labyrinth without your consent. Not even a Lord of Chaos can escape this realm, for its chaotic nature can confuse even the most insane and unpredictable beings in existence. These realms are free from both accidental and intentional flaws that could damage its integrity, such as the Dream Tornado of the Dreaming or the Challengers of the Unknown disrupting the Garden of Forking Paths. They are safeguarded from such disturbances, allowing them to function autonomously. It will evolve and strengthen naturally according to your personal preferences, requiring no active management. As your realm grows in power, so too will the strength of your sigils, which are intricately tied to it. Should you choose to directly influence and manage your realms, their growth will accelerate exponentially. Since these realms are connected to your soul, you won't need the sigils to channel their power. However, without them, their effectiveness will be significantly diminished. For example, with the Dream Helm, you can send an entire city into a peaceful sleep with a simple wave of your hand. Without it, you’d only be able to affect a single room of people. Over time, with training and the expansion of your realms, your mastery will grow, and the sigils will become mere tools, no longer the central focus of to channel their power. As long as these realms exist, so too will you, and vice versa. No matter how you die or are destroyed, you will always reform within your realm, restored to full health. As your Personal World expands, so too will your realms. If your Personal World grows to encompass the vastness of the universe, teeming with life, your sigils will ascend to the power of the Endless. Should it continue to expand beyond that, there is the potential for your realms to surpass even the Endless and beyond.
addons.title: The Endless Realm(s)

addons.text:
Your Ability to create Pokemon has drastically changed your Personal World, filling it with Pokemon as well as the regions from the various Pokemon Media. Each of those Pokemon, while not inherently loyal to you, will never pose a threat to you or your rules, even if they decide to attack you. If they do attack you they will find their attacks always being weaker than intended and they will never be able to injure you more than scrape and bruise. The flipside to this is that you are similarly unable to seriously injure those Pokemon. Your own captured Pokemon can still attack them as normal however. 

You also gain access to every region that Pokemon 
Media has ever shown, including anime and spin-off exclusives such as the Orange Islands from the anime and Fiore from the Ranger game. At the start you will only have one of those regions. Still, the region you start with is fully up to you with the remaing regions appearing at a rate of one per month until you have them all. Those regions can be fully integrated into Personal World or separated into different dimensions while being all interconnected in a manner of your choice. 

All of those regions come with loyal trainers, gym leaders, elite four and champions who will follow your will without question. If you want to run a gym circuit like the games or anime, you gain the ability to announce it to your gym leaders and similar. Nothing will overtly change but they won't give their badge or let you participate in the elite four challange and similar without battling first. This ability can be turned off at the start of every day with your progress 'saved'. 

You also gain the ability to dictate what the rules of the gym challange are in the first place but it should always include some form of Pokemon battling, but it is not limited to standard battles, Contest battles still count for example.

If you have any Powers that allow you to change into a Pokemon, you also gain access to the Mystery Dungeon's Worlds and related.
addons.title: The World of Pokemon

addons.text:
Whether through your own will, or a wish made upon a star, the entirety of Planet Popstar from the Kirby franchise has been recreated within your Personal World. Housing all the lifeforms, resources, and locations you’d be familiar with. You can alter anything from the population of Waddle Dees, repurposing the various enemies and bosses, remaking the entirety of Cappy Town, or creating entirely new locations.

As ruler of this Personal World, you can create any and everything from the Kirby series in your image. From pocket dimensions that contain entire worlds to explore like the Mirror World, creating your own copy abilities, advanced technology like the Halberd or Lor Starcutter, magical artefacts that can rival and surpass the iconic Star Rod, or even create entire planets with their own civilizations. Your Personal World already has a premade solar system should you choose this.

All the classic Kirby characters are premade within your Personal Word, acting as you’d expect. Additional ones from other media, or completely original ones can be added at any time. Finally, you may design yourself an avatar that allows you to experience this world.
addons.title: World of Dreamland

addons.text:
Yo–kai are ancient spirits that have lived alongside humans since the dawn of time, yet neither truly acknowledged each other's presence, except to cause mischief. As the wielder of the Yo-kai Watch, you are one of the few that can see them. But now, you are the bridge that will connect both Yo-kai and humanity.

Your Personal World is a plane of existence that holds every single Yo-kai ever shown in the Yo-kai Watch series, with their own fully functioning civilization. Complete with its own laws, government, schools, workforce and other facilities taken as inspiration from human society. It goes without saying, you have absolute control over how it functions and operates, and more, even to create brand new Yo-kai.

You can open gates from your Personal World that grant Yo-kai passage to the real world, whether or not humans can see them is at your discretion and responsibility. All Yo-kai within your Personal World are loyal to you and can be summoned to your aid as if you’ve already collected their medal, skipping the middleman of the watch itself should you wish.
addons.title: World of Yo-kai

addons.text:
Through the power of your Echo, the realm of Etheirys has begun to take shape within your Personal World. One by one, its nations and peoples— from the Dragonkin of Midgardsormr, the indomitable legions of Garlemald to the enigmatic Ancients of the Unsundered World—will emerge. As ruler of the Personal World, all of its inhabitants are fully loyal to you. Your journey begins with the three founding city-states of Eorzea: Gridania, Ul’dah, and Limsa Lominsa. How this world unfolds—whether as a single unified realm, a constellation of distant continents, or a network of separate yet interconnected planes—is yours to decide.

The Ascians have been fully restored—mind, body, soul, and identity—returning them to their prime. No longer agents of chaos and suffering, they are now tasked with protecting the people of Etheirys and serving as mediators among them. Their allegiance lies with you, as ruler of this world. Once the Unsundered world of the Ancients manifests in your Personal World, the Convocation of Fourteen will resume their roles and responsibilities. You may choose how the Ancients appear—towering giants compared to other races, or just taller than Hyur.

Hydaelyn and Zodiark will play a vital role in safeguarding and managing your Personal World. Zodiark influence will act as a cosmic shield, preventing any foreign or otherworldly forces from breaching your realm. Reality manipulation, Warp rifts, and invasions from the abyss will be completely nullified under his protection. Hydaelyn, the will of the Star, will focus on internal threats. She will monitor your world closely, sending visions and warnings to its people—and to the Convocation of Fourteen—when danger arises. Her power will empower chosen individuals, giving them the strength to confront and resolve these challenges. Together, Hydaelyn and Zodiark will maintain balance and stability, ensuring that the flow of aether remains eternal and unbroken within your world. If Hydaelyn or Zodiark are killed or destroyed, they will reform after 24 hours. You can decide if Venat and Elidibus anchored themselves as Hydaelyn and Zodiark soul or not.

Once all the regions of Etheirys are established in your Personal World, the focus will shift outward—expanding into the creation of the Thirteen Shards and the alien worlds and races seen throughout Final Fantasy XIV. You have full creative freedom to shape the cultures, environments, and identities of each shard. They can be entirely original, inspired by various Final Fantasy settings, or serve as expies to those worlds across the franchise.
addons.title: A Realm Reborn

addons.text:
The influence of the Power Cosmic has caused your Personal World to manifest an exact copy of Galactus’s Worldship, designated as Taa III. You may choose to have your entire Personal World exist within the ship, alongside it in space, or even in a separate dimension entirely.

Taa III is one of the most advanced spacecraft in the universe, an artificial construct spanning the size of a solar system. It possesses a gravitational pull strong enough to hold entire planets and stars with ease and technology it harbors is so advanced that only the creations of the Celestials could rival it.

Within the Worldship, there exists a vast database containing all the weapons and technologies that Galactus has either created or encountered during his journey across the universe. It includes inventions from many advanced civilizations that Galactus has interacted with—such as the Skrulls, Kree, Watchers, and even the Celestials. The technology within Taa III allows you to recreate any of these devices or, if you prefer, synthesize any material and energy found in the Marvel Universe for use in crafting your own inventions.

The Worldship is intrinsically linked to your mind. Through this connection, you can control it as effortlessly as your own body—shaping its size and form at will, cloaking it from all forms of detection, regulating its gravitational field, and remotely accessing its vast technological capabilities. Even if the ship were to be completely destroyed, you could instantly recreate it using the Power Cosmic.
addons.title: Taa III - The Worldship

addons.text:
Your ability to utilize your Reality Marble has evolved into something akin to that of an Ultimate One.

Whenever you manifest your Reality Marble, the fundamental laws of your Personal World or Reality Marble to overwrite your surroundings. Whether these changes are fleeting or permanent, they carry the full weight of your Personal World, making it nearly impossible for the World to reject or suppress them. You can choose an all-encompassing transformation or manifest only specific aspects. For instance, you can rewrite the laws of physics while leaving the scenery untouched, transform a blistering desert into a frozen tundra, or restore a ruined city to its former glory. You can even summon the copies of the inhabitants of your Personal World to fight by your side.

In time, you can come up with more things, such as utilizing the full, physical weight of your Personal World to crush anyone near you without demolishing the world itself or absorb and copy the unique nature and laws that exist in other universes and integrate them into your Personal World.

Consequentially, your Reality Marble exists in your Personal World, either encompassing the entire World or a specific part of it.
addons.title: World of my Own Soul
_____Tale
addons.text: Through your Monster and Human Soul your Personal World gains the properties of the world of Undertale, including SOULs, Monster Magic, LV, and the potential for branching Alternate Timelines. More than that however, it has also gained the properties of a true Alternate Universe in the Undertale sense, with yourself as the Creator. As the Creator you are in charge of, well, the creation of your AU. You choose what characters and concepts are present in order to shape your AUs; you could apply the narrative of “Kill or be killed” to create a more gritty and unforgiving world, or you could add a Winged theme to give all your characters wings. With just this addon you get access to the characters of Undertale and a variety of generic AU modifiers such as a Roleswap or various Aesthetics like Winged or Noir. However, any powers you might possess will expand your catalog to include the things from whatever world they come from, allowing you to use their characters and concepts to shape your story. For example if you had a power from One Piece you could turn your AU into a Pirate-themed adventure on the Grand Line with the characters of Undertale as a Pirate Crew, add the Straw Hat Pirates or other characters as Monsters in the Underground, or something stranger like a perfect copy of Undertale save for the fact that Sans has a Devil Fruit power with absolutely no explanation why. This is your World, its story yours to decide, and the Tale you choose to create is sure to be a sight to behold.
