The moment a confrontation begins, you instantly gain the appropriate gear, information, skills, and strategic plans as if you had spent the past month solely dedicated to preparing for this exact fight. This preparation is simulated into existence, overlaying your present reality without altering the actual past.

The preparation you receive is bound by a strict one-month retroactive window. You cannot gain knowledge, resources, or skills that you could not have realistically obtained or developed within one month of dedicated effort starting from your original state. The simulation generates separate, parallel preparations for each distinct threat. If you face one opponent and then another appears afterwards, you gain two independent sets of gear and data. If multiple opponents begin the fight as a coordinated (or uncoordinated) team or group, they are treated as a single composite threat, granting you one unified set of preparations designed to counter their combined tactics.

All gear and information from all concurrent simulations are simultaneously accessible to you, regardless of physical or logical contradictions. You can carry all generated equipment without being overburdened, and your mind compartmentalizes all conflicting data and skills for immediate use.

A key secondary effect seamlessly adjusts the perceived history of the immediate past for you and all observers. To everyone’s memory and any recorded evidence, you entered the situation already in possession of all your gear, as if you had been carrying it all along. This prevents the power’s activation from being perceived as a sudden materialization of equipment.
objects.title: Prep Time

objects.text:
You are a bane of those who consider themselves plotters and masterminds. Any harmful or hostile elaborate plots and plans that interact with you tend to go awry. This happens through your actions, even if you are not aware of it. The more elaborate and calculated a plan is, the more likely you are to trigger a point of failure.

This can happen passively in your life. A scrap of paper you throw away might contain an assassin’s secret orders. You might cut a delivery of illicit goods off in traffic, while renting a venue for an evening might prevent a warlock from accessing a critical ley line. You will probably not notice these events unless you pay attention.

When you take an active role in the world, your actions are still more likely to collaterally dismantle secret plots. Busting a gang hideout actually ends up taking down a major base of a vast criminal network, while capturing terrorists could expose a conspiracy to start a war under false pretenses. Actively seeking to destroy conspiracies and plots can cause a domino effect of failure for related plans.

You can subconsciously prevent this power from affecting plots or aspects of plots that would be beneficial to you.
objects.title: Came In Like A Wrecking Ball

objects.text:
Twisted Logic is an ability that severs the natural chain between cause and effect whenever an action, event, or phenomenon is directed at you. Instead of suffering the consequence, you may reroute the resulting effect to any target within your vicinity—be it a person, object, creature, or environment.

A punch connects with your body, but the impact transfers to a wooden barrel beside you, splintering it apart while you feel nothing.

A rumor is spread with the intent to destroy your reputation. The story still circulates, but the social fallout settles on the gossip who started it, turning their attempt at sabotage into their own public disgrace.

This does not negate the cause itself. The punch is still thrown, the spell is still cast, the accusation is still spoken, the disease is still transmitted—but the outcome lands elsewhere, twisted to your choosing.

Twisted Logic can automatically apply the effect elsewhere—whether physical, emotional, magical, or conceptual—with sufficient training and precision.

In a world where action defines consequence, you alone decide who pays the price.
objects.title: Twisted Logic

addons.text: Each of your five selves count as a different person for the purposes of Convoke, allowing you to use abilities through them even while unmanifested as your own whim.
addons.title: Silver Linings

objects.text:
You can channel any abilities (Spells, effects, powers etc) through others, using their own lifeforce to reduce the time to deploy the ability or increase the power proportionally to the number of people being used to summon it. 

Each additional person used to convoke an ability either halves it’s relative time to use or adds a third of its initial strength. This is cumulative for each person, so using three people to convoke an effect would be over twice as powerful as the original.
objects.title: Convoke

objects.text:
The Ten-Step Technique is inevitability made flesh. It is not a dash, nor a strike, nor a spell. It is walking. From the moment your first step lands, every enemy before you feels the weight of your approach, and with each stride that follows, despair builds until no one can endure.

The first step collapses distance. Space itself yields, and the ground carries you forward regardless of walls, wards, or obstacles. At that same instant, the first wave of pressure rolls outward. A crushing gravity clamps down on all within your presence. Everyone feels it—weak, strong, and legendary alike. For the frail, despair sets in immediately. They know they cannot last ten steps. Their bones creak, their knees buckle, blood rises in their throats. Some die before the second step lands. You decide who bears this weight and who does not; allies can stand untouched even as foes crumble.

The second step doubles the force, and the third doubles it again. By now, weaker foes are corpses, their bodies crushed by the invisible mountain pressing them flat. For mid-tier fighters, despair blooms here. They try to fight, raising weapons or weaving spells, but their arms falter and their hearts break when they realize their strength is already failing. By the fourth and fifth steps, they stagger helplessly, coughing blood, their barriers shattering like glass. Projectiles collapse midair, magic dissolves before completion, and arrows veer into the dirt, crushed by your presence.

With the sixth step, armies are undone. The weak are gone, the middling broken, and only the strong still stand. Yet even the mighty are shaken now, forced to acknowledge that inevitability grinds closer with every stride. At the seventh step, the battlefield itself begins to bow. Stone cracks underfoot, air distorts and groans, and escape routes collapse as the terrain yields to the pressure. The strong feel their movements falter, their breath grow ragged, their weapons tremble in hands that once held steady. Their despair comes not from weakness but from recognition: even their strength means nothing before this march.

At the eighth step, the oppression becomes unbearable. Those who once stood tall can barely move an inch, locked in place as though chains of gravity drag at their every limb. Their willpower cracks, their eyes shadowed by dread, for they know the march cannot be stopped. The ninth step pins even the legends. Their knees strike the ground, their weapons slip from their hands, and despair consumes them whole. They are not fighting you anymore—they are fighting inevitability itself, and inevitability does not lose.

Then comes the tenth. The conclusion. The final step is not an attack, not a flourish, not a strike—it is judgment. All the pressure, all the weight, all the inevitability built across nine strides falls at once. The foe before you collapses, body broken, life extinguished, spirit crushed. Shields cannot block it. Spells cannot withstand it. Distance cannot spare them. The tenth step is absolute, and no one bound to this world can endure it.

The Ten-Step Technique does not stand apart from your strength—it magnifies it. Each stride compounds not only inevitability but your own power, scaling with the weight of your will and the authority you command. In your hands, its reach is defined not by limits but by who you are; the stronger you become, the heavier the steps, the more impossible they are to withstand.

You may halt at any point before the tenth, and the effects of the steps you have taken remain. Three steps are often enough to scatter weaklings. Five may annihilate battalions. Seven may bring champions low. Nine breaks even the legends. But once you begin, you must walk with conviction. If hesitation enters your stride, the chain of inevitability shatters, and the technique collapses into nothing, leaving you exposed. You are not merely walking forward—you are declaring the end.

The Ten-Step Technique is more than a martial art. It is the authority to decide when the battle ends. All feel it from the first step, but not all endure equally. The weak perish early, the middling collapse midway, and the mighty resist until the end—but none survive the tenth. And because you choose who bears the weight, it is not blind destruction but the execution of your will. Ten steps, no more, no less. Each heavier than the last. Each pressing the battlefield, each grinding down hope, each carrying despair. And when you walk, the world bows.
objects.title: The Ten-Step Technique

objects.text:
You’re no wide-eyed beginner fumbling through a tutorial—you’ve been here before. You’ve played the game, studied its mechanics, and conquered its greatest challenges. You don’t just know the rules; you’ve mastered them. Every experience, every battle, every hard-won victory has forged you into something beyond ordinary. 

Whether the setting relies on magic, ki, cultivation, superpowers, or any other system, you have already climbed to the highest possible level. Your stats are maxed, your abilities are fully developed, and your skills have been refined to their theoretical peak.

This means that within the mechanics of the world you are in, you are as powerful as it is possible to be without breaking the system itself. If the world operates on levels, you are at the level cap. If it has skill trees, yours are fully unlocked and mastered. If progression is tied to enlightenment or understanding, you have already grasped the ultimate truths. You are not merely strong—you have mastered the logic and limitations of your reality and optimized yourself accordingly.

Additionally, this extends to any other abilities granted by the CYOA. If you have superpowers, they evolve to their highest potential. If you have unique skills, they are perfected to their absolute limits. If you possess knowledge-based abilities, your understanding reaches the deepest level possible.

As a true late-game character, you also possess the advantages that come with such status. You have near-limitless resources, whether in the form of wealth, magical artifacts, legendary weapons, or rare materials. And just like any late-game powerhouse, while you may not be outright invincible, only the most extreme threats—secret final bosses, hidden superbosses, or world-breaking anomalies—could pose any real challenge to you. 

However, you are still a player, not a boss. You may have immense power, but you lack the broken, reality-defying abilities that true “final bosses” or transcendent beings often wield. You follow the world’s mechanics, meaning you don’t get immunity to all damage, invulnerability to certain effects, or hax abilities that outright ignore the system’s rules. If a setting has a being who is meant to be the strongest in-universe, they will still hold that position, even if you stand just beneath them in raw power.

Note: This scales to the relative power level of the world you enter. If you arrive in a high-powered setting where individuals can shatter mountains with a punch, manipulate reality, or ascend to godhood, your abilities will scale accordingly, ensuring you remain at the pinnacle of that world’s mechanics. Conversely, if you enter a lower-powered world where the strongest beings are merely peak human or slightly superhuman, your maximum potential will be limited to what is considered the highest level within that setting. This scaling only applies to the first world you appear in—should you travel to another world afterward, your strength will remain at the peak of your original starting world rather than adjusting to the new one. 

Alternatively, instead of scaling to the world you are entering, you can choose to scale to the power system of an ability you obtained from the CYOA. This means that regardless of the strength of the world you arrive in, your power level will be based on the highest potential of that specific ability’s original setting. However, by choosing this option, the skills, abilities, and mechanics you have mastered will also be based on that power system’s world, rather than the one you are entering.
objects.title: Late-Game Character

objects.text:
"A sound soul dwells within a sound mind and a sound body."

A common challenge for any aspiring hero, villain, warrior, or mage is that while they may possess a powerful body capable of withstanding or healing from any blow, curse, or injury, their soul remains vulnerable to attacks. Alternatively, your soul might be exceptionally resilient, able to ignore or heal from most damage, but a well-placed arrow to the neck could still kill you as easily as a regular human. Or perhaps you possess both a strong body and soul, yet your mind remains vulnerable to illusions or manipulation.

But with you, your mind, body, and soul have achieved Equilibrium.

Now, your regeneration, endurance, resistances, and even immortality (if you possess it) are perfectly balanced across all three aspects. If your body can regenerate a missing limb in seconds, your soul can repair any damage to itself just as quickly. Similarly, if you have a resilient soul that can resist or heal from harm, your body will respond in kind, regenerating or resisting damage just as effectively. Your mind, in turn, becomes more resistant to control and can swiftly recover from hostile telepathic attacks.

For example, if your body is resistant to curses, poisons, or forces that erode it, your soul will be equally resistant to those that target it, and your mind will either ignore or rapidly fight off attempts at manipulation while recovering from attempts to destroy it.

This state of Equilibrium does not grant you any new abilities on its own, but it ensures that any powers you already possess or acquire will apply equally to your body, mind, and soul.
objects.title: Equilibrium

objects.text:
You have the uncanny ability to randomly "remember" a technique, spell, power, or unique expression of your power that happens to be the right ability to either counter or mitigate whatever negative thing you're going against.

What this means is that if you were facing someone who is about to hit you with a massive attack, you may come up with a new way to use your powers that would allow you to block, redirect, or even nullify said attack. If someone is about to control your mind, then you might end up "remembering" that you had a special way of using your powers to protect your mind.

This does not give you powers by itself, nor does it let you suddenly do things that you could not potentially do before. For example, if someone is shooting a fireball and you have magic, you might "remember" an anti-fire ward spell. But if you did not have magic, then you would not "remember" such an ability and would either have to dodge or hope you don’t burn.
objects.title: Ah, yes. My anti-[X] Technique. I haven't used this since the Heian Era.

objects.text:
You are able to bypass an opponent’s natural or magical resistances, ensuring that your attacks affect them as if they had no special protections.

For example, if you strike an enemy that is normally immune to physical attacks, they will still feel the full force of your punch as if they had no such immunity. Likewise, a creature resistant to fire will burn just as easily and as intensely as any ordinary being when exposed to your flames.

However, this does not increase the overall power of your attacks or allow you to bypass physical defenses such as armor, magical barriers, or innate durability. For instance, while you could burn a fire-resistant creature, you would not be able to melt through a thick steel wall any faster than usual.

Similarly, if an opponent has an impenetrable shield, this alone will not allow you to break through it unless its invulnerability comes specifically from an immunity to damage rather than sheer durability. It strictly negates resistances, making it possible to harm otherwise untouchable foes.
objects.title: Anti-Resistance

objects.text:
The open road is yours to walk, and thankfully, it seems the world has chosen to bless you for that fact. You have been given a supernatural, if selective, form of luck. Namely, whenever you walk by your lonesome without any form of transportation, you will gain immense luck related to your travels.

For example, you might encounter a celebrity taking a trip cross country who offers to pick you up. Bad weather could avoid you in a mile radius around you as if you were the eye of the storm. You could come across edible plants, food, and more depending on your environment. As well, you will be able to find plenty of help if needed, like a garage willing to let you use your phone to call someone, or a Bed and Breakfast willing to pity you and give you a free bed and, indeed, breakfast. Even if the most evil person on the road were to find you, as long as they don't know who you are or are a long-time target of them, they'll gladly give you a drive to the next town. Finally, this power can activate even if it's not a traditional road, like a dirt path in a forest or the like.

This power is limited to a "naked" form of travel for you. Whether by foot on a road, swimming in a sea lane, or even somehow a trading lane in space, it has to be an on-foot method of traveling. The power will activate of course if say, your vehicle breaks down and you need help, but will deactivate once it is fixed. But otherwise, the road is yours to walk.
objects.title: Hitchhiker's Guide to the Land

objects.text: There are two wolves inside you: one barks and the other bites. You can, at will, release one of the wolves, allowing it to use its unique ability. One of the wolves is All Bark, able to shatter concrete with sound or create portals reminiscent of Boom Tubes. While the other is All Bite, it can summon ethereal jaws that can enlarge or shrink depending on the target, capable of shearing through tank armor like it's made of paper.
objects.title: You've Got That Dawg In You, Or Two

objects.text:
You possess within you a pool of an anomalous matter, which you may at any time manifest in the real world and manipulate freely. By default, it flows like liquid, but can instantly solidify at will into any shape you can imagine, including splitting it up into multiple masses, each of which can be controlled precisely. More importantly, you can also cause it to transform into any material you have encountered and are familiar with. To facilitate this, you are given the ability to analyze the physical and supernatural (if necessary) makeup of any material.

The matter can be manifested most easily in your immediate vicinity, appearing to emerge harmlessly from your body, but with enough practice and visualization, you may cause it to appear anywhere within 25 feet, potentially even up to 100, though line of sight makes this easiest. After creation, the matter can be withdrawn into your pool at any time from any distance, otherwise it will remain in the default state of its material form, depending on whether you are controlling it. You can always sense the matter's location(s) no matter the distance, and can even learn to sense things within its vicinity.

With practice, the speed and precision of your ability to manipulate this matter will increase to allow for hypersonic speeds, ignoring inertia and friction.

Initially, your total pool will be equal in mass to your body. Every two weeks, the pool shall increase by that amount again.

Note: If you possess some form of energy, such as mana, you may freely expend it to produce more matter, though matter created this way will dissipate over time. Additionally, your matter can be instantly enchanted with maximum efficiency, or disenchanted.

If you possess a power that gives you knowledge of a given technology, the matter may be used to construct that technology, which can then be freely controlled by you.
objects.title: Imaginary Mass

addons.text:
It seems your Curse of the Mother Hen, combined with your absurd charisma and that constant aura of warmth, comfort, and safety, has fundamentally changed how this power manifests.

At its core, the ability still works the same way. But now it evolves in two disturbing directions.

The first change is tied directly to the core part of the original power.

The more someone hates you, the more seriously they entertain the idea of hurting or killing you, the deeper the Curse takes root within them. At first, the effects are almost imperceptible: brief hesitation, flashes of concern, instinctive protectiveness they can’t quite justify.

Then the corruption deepens.

Slowly, the Curse works its way into the very cores of their souls, reshaping them into your perfect protectors. Unlike the original Curse of the Mother Hen, however, this version suppresses every symptom until the transformation is complete. There is no gradual descent into attachment. No slow awareness that their feelings are changing.

When it finally surfaces, it happens all at once.

Every buried instinct, every suppressed compulsion, every twisted fragment of devotion crashes down on them simultaneously. In a single horrifying instant, they realize that somewhere along the way, protecting you replaced their hatred entirely—even though they can still vividly remember wanting to hurt you, break you, maybe even kill you.

The second change may be even worse.

Your aura quietly plants doubt in people’s minds. Small things at first. Fleeting thoughts they dismiss almost immediately.

“They looked tired earlier.”

“It’d be irresponsible to assassinate them before they’ve eaten.”

Those thoughts accumulate over time, blending perfectly with the Curse and smoothing out its more obvious flaws. Most importantly, it eliminates the compulsive need to lock you away “for your own safety.” this effects the entire Curse.

Which should concern you far more than reassure you.

Because now, instead of unstable obsessives trying to stuff you into a basement, you’ve created fully functional protectors who can move through society unnoticed while treating any threat to your wellbeing like a national emergency.

Congratulations.

You’ve weaponized the full, concentrated force of an overused Chinese webnovel trope.

May whatever gods still exist have mercy on the poor bastard who mildly inconveniences you in public.
addons.title: CN Regret Trope

objects.text:
You are able to make anyone who works for you far more effective than they should naturally be, but only if they genuinely hate you and want to see you fail or die. The stronger their negative intent towards you, the greater the boost they receive.

When someone enters your employment with genuine hatred for you, they rapidly develop skills relevant to their assigned role, reaching peak human performance in that specific area. A personal assistant who dreams of poisoning you becomes an organizational genius, memorizing your entire schedule and anticipating every need, all to find the perfect moment to strike. A bodyguard who fantasizes about stabbing you develops reflexes that let them intercept any threat, positioning themselves as your ultimate protector while waiting for their chance. Their competence is directly proportional to the depth of their malice, and this boost always includes an improvement of their ability to ultimately kill you.

To facilitate this, you are able to identify and convert people who hate you, even those actively fighting against you. An enemy general trying to crush your army might find himself pausing mid-battle as you offer him a position, framing it as the only way he'll ever get close enough to truly destroy you. A rival spymaster who has spent years plotting your downfall could accept your job offer, suddenly finding their intelligence network becoming twice as effective now that they work for their hated target. Once they accept, the boost activates immediately.

As a secondary effect, you have an intuitive foresight regarding their plots to kill you, giving you a chance to survive. You also know how to cultivate their resentment, feeding it just enough to keep the boost strong while ensuring their hatred never reaches the point of reckless self-destruction.
objects.title: Keep Your Friends Close and Your Enemies Closer

objects.text:
You have been anointed—if such a word still fits—by a ravenous divinity bound not in temple or tomb, but in flesh. From just above your shoulders down, your arms are no longer human. Now they are relics of hunger made manifest: obsidian-black, unnaturally smooth and glass-like. Beneath this veneer, the veins glow a radiant, electric violet—circuitry of otherworldly power, throbbing with anticipation. Buried within the surface are countless miniature eyes and mouths, each unique in color and size. These organs blink and whisper in unison, murmuring devotion, praise, and want. They can be hidden or shown at will—but they are always awake. Always watching. Always hungering.

These are not just arms. They are living, thinking extensions of your will—sapient entities wholly devoted to you. They whisper praises for your every action, Do All they think may satisfy you, in any way, celebrate your victories with wordless joy, and weep in manic grief should you be hurt. Protective beyond reason, they will act independently to shield you, defend you. And when they act, it is with purpose. They do not flail—they worship. They fight for you like apostles defending a god made flesh.

The Gluttonous Arms are divine in resilience. Their substance rivals adamantium in toughness, letting them withstand dragonfire, cosmic entropy, or the wrath of Gods. This imperviousness extends to your entire skeleton, transforming your bones into a divine scaffold capable of bearing the weight of impossible power. Yet they are not merely strong. These arms are receptive beyond reason, like living Mythril—they flawlessly absorb, integrate, and channel power from any source. Magic, psionics, divine energy, cybernetics, spiritual enhancements, even emotional concepts or esoteric forces—nothing is rejected. Everything is metabolized. Everything is made yours.

When the Gluttonous Arms touch something, they do not simply grip—they consume. Not in a destructive sense, but in a manner infinitely more violating: they absorb the essence of what they touch, taking in every positive trait and discarding the flaws. The structural integrity of a fortress wall, the regenerative vitality of a hydra, the radiant purity of holy flame, the precision of a Cybernetic Arm, the grace of a master blade—these are devoured and integrated, often permanently. The arms hunger for excellence, for supremacy, and they will never accept mediocrity.

This power is not without cost. Though they love you, these arms are gluttonous, jealous, and never satisfied. They constantly urge you forward—to fight, to claim, to consume more. Mercy makes them restless. Stagnation agitates them. If denied their feast of experience and essence for too long, they may act without your leave, hungering not out of rebellion, but out of a deep, desperate devotion. They want you to be powerful. To be divine. To be worthy of their Worship.

Because that love—unlike most things in this world—is endless. They will never betray you. They will never abandon you. They will simply keep taking, until nothing is left to take… and you are all that remains.
objects.title: The Gluttonous Arms

addons.text:
The concept of eternity present within your soul shines brightly, resonating with the abstract nature of your power. You no longer step into a State of Grace; you become it.

You are able to deploy and maintain a continuous and mobile version of Temporal Grace around you that extends a few centimeters from your skin. This will apply the effect of your field on you by using your Aura as a conduit, maintained by the eternal nature of your existence.

All those inside your field when it's fully activated will be brought back to their peak self, healing at the same rate you would regenerate mind, body, and soul. You are able to control to whom these benevolent effects apply.
addons.title: Perpetual Grace

objects.text:
You are capable of deploying a field of roughly 4 meters in radius, which you can freely shape, that has the ability to temporarily erase the concept of change. 

Within this State of Grace, anyone inside, including yourself, cannot be affected by any outside or inside influences, regardless of their nature or magnitude. 

This creates a fleeting environment of 'Peaceful Coexistence' inside its indiscriminate influence, where you cannot be harmed, but also cannot affect those inside it.

Any attempt at interaction between beings or objects inside the radius will result in them phasing through one another. The field cannot be moved after its deployment unless it is deactivated. It doesn't grant any regeneration, but it will prevent anyone with life-threatening injuries from dying or feeling pain of any nature.

You start being able to hold it for a couple of minutes, with training allowing you to expand its radius and duration.
objects.title: Temporal Grace

addons.text:
Powers affected by the Startless drawback are penalized: summoned projections will wear out quickly and have a 24-hour cooldown before they can be resummoned.
However, repeated use/training, as well as/or familiarity with the tools in question such as through crafting, holding, or examining similar objects reducing the cooldown and rate of wear.
addons.title: Poor Equipment

objects.text: You can create projections of equipment based on your powers. For example, you could create a projection of a sword and armor for the Formless Blade or the Standard Blade, as these powers grant the ability to wield a sword, but not the sword itself. For magical powers, this could be projections of various magical focuses; for Tinkers and tech powers, it would be tools and so on. However, these projections represent mundane items (a regular sword, not a mythical, legendary, magical one, etc.) with no bonuses for you. Finally, they will exist only as long as they are in your hands or equipped on your body (not literally, but following the spirit of this restriction — a throwing knife will disappear as soon as it hits a target, a tool will not disappear if placed nearby while working, etc., but will disappear if you decide to sell them, use them as a means of obtaining materials or raw materials, or create an entire warehouse, etc.).
objects.title: Support Equipment

objects.text:
You possess the power to alter your perspective regardless of space, time, or physics. This ability allows you to change how you perceive reality itself. For instance, you can shift your viewpoint from first person to third person, adopt the perspective of another individual to understand how they perceive the world, or alter your perspective to reflect a different emotional state, such as calmness or anger. You may also change how you visually perceive reality, enabling modes of perception such as infrared vision, X-ray vision, or even viewing the world as though it were animated or drawn in a comic style.

You can further alter your perception of time, allowing moments to appear as though they pass far more quickly or far more slowly than normal. By extension, this ability allows you to project your perspective across time in a form of clairvoyance, enabling you to observe the past or future and even manifest physically at those points in time to experience events as the people of that era perceived them.

This ability also allows you to perceive endless possibilities, showing how events might have unfolded had you acted differently, or how they may unfold if you take specific actions in the future. Through this, you can effectively experience alternate realities by shifting your perspective to that of an alternate version of yourself.

Additionally, you may adopt a “fourth wall” perspective, viewing the world as a bystander observing a fictional narrative. In this state, you are unaffected by entities that exist solely within the story itself, much like an audience member watching a theater performance—where the characters are unaware of your presence and cannot interact with you, nor can you interact with them.

Finally, you can shift between these perspectives seamlessly without damaging your mind, revert your perception to that of a normal person at will, and avoid any permanent changes to your personality or sanity as a result of the many viewpoints you experience. However, switching perspectives too frequently can cause disorientation, requiring rest before continuing. Pushing beyond your limits may result in headaches, which can escalate into nosebleeds, fainting, or more severe consequences if you overexert yourself. This power also does not allow you to adopt perspectives that are fundamentally inconceivable, such as that of an all-knowing god, as such viewpoints lie beyond your capacity to comprehend.
objects.title: Omni-Viewpoint

objects.text:
You can manipulate fate, but only in very minor ways. For example, you can ensure that you encounter a chosen person or frequently run in with some group, although depending on the distance between you, it may take some time before your chosen fate comes to pass. Alternatively, you can 'curse' someone with a fate, or fates, of your choosing. For example, they may regularly stub their toe, experience some accidents that make them late for work, avoid meeting someone, etc.

This power cannot bring about the impossible; everything you will to happen must already be achievable with at least a decent chance of success. You cannot make yourself fated to defeat an Endbringer as a normal human, even should this technically be possible, but you can ensure that you will not die to a stray bullet in a shootout or that a poorly maintained gun will jam.

Do note that as you manipulate fate, probabilities of various events shift and adjust. Thus, although you may apply this power rapidly, you may accidentally make some of your desired outcomes unachievable by the means of this power alone.
objects.title: Minor Fate Manipulation

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to open a holographic window. When opened it displays a single sentence. The sentence is generated automatically based on a combination of your immediate desires, what you are currently doing, and your needs at the time. You can select one word from it and replace it with any other word.

Reality is then retroactively changed to reflect the new word. No one but you will notice this change and you are given an extra set of memories to go along with the new reality. 

For example you could change the sentence “Sarah is a clerk of a major corporation.” To “Sarah is a CEO of a major corporation.”

The changes are limited to what is possible in your world. If a mortal cannot ascend to godhood then you cannot do so. If your circumstances are decided at birth they cannot be changed. It does not need to be possible for you specifically to do just someone in the world.

No one but you can see the window unless you choose to show it to them.

You have 5 charges per day and every change consumes one charge. You don't have a limit on how many charges you can accumulate.
objects.title: Change One Word

addons.text:
You can now broadcast your shows as livestreams, using them to generate stream points that you can use either for yourself or feed back into the show as for example a prize.

You can also tie your streaming audience into your shows by having them vote in polls, suggest ideas, or giving them the option to invest their money by for example making bets on who will win, with you keeping the money of lost bets as stream points. Additionally you can give your audience the option to spend money to help or hinder a candidate of their choosing by for example being able to send them instructions which direction to go next inside a maze or by buying them items that may help them succeed in their current game, opening or closing gates to shorter and easier paths, or paying for increases or decreases for the game's countdown-timer. Any money spent this way is also turned to stream points for you.

Now the games you play aren't just entertainment anymore, they can in fact become quite profitable for you as well. It's good if you're an entertaining personality. It's better if other entertaining personalities come along to further boost your engagement, especially if they already have their own followings.
addons.title: Prime Time

addons.text:
One of the greatest restrictions on the games you can play is the Law of Compensation, that the prize must at least equal the value of the challenge and danger to the contestant. However, as the value of the prize is subjective and tied to the candidate, you can now use your more subtle powers to massively inflate the prize's value in the eyes of the contestant, meaning you can get away with far more dangerous games as well as much harsher penalties for losing than the objective value of the prize would otherwise justify. Subjective value ultimately means that “What is it worth?” is less important than “How much do you want it?” 

After all, value is in the eye of the beholder, and you are a master at pulling wool over eyes.
addons.title: Excessive Investment

addons.text: Your pocket-dimension's ability to rearrange itself according to your will is vastly increased, allowing it to form complex environments, detailed stages and obstacle courses, materials with esoteric properties, and even simulacrums of living creatures, all to enrich the games you orchestrate. None of what you create inside your pocket-dimension, barring things like food and water, can be removed from the dimension, even those exceptions only applying to things that have already been consumed, unless they've specifically been designated as a prize of a game of corresponding stakes and difficulty, though this too has limitations, as for example money produced this way would register as counterfeit and not be eligible as a prize.
addons.title: Greed Island

addons.text: You can now connect your prizes to the Multiversal Marketplace, allowing the fortunate winners to select their own prize from the Marketplace's near infinite offerings, limited of course to the upper cap you've set for the prize. The bill for whatever they choose will be your responsibility to pay, so set your limits wisely.
addons.title: Multiverse of Prizes

addons.text: You can now store the bodies of anyone drawn into the Pocket Dimension in the equivalent of a waiting area, while the actual games take place in the simulated environment of the Simulation Trial. As this reduces the risks to any participant to zero, excluding penalties for lost games, this means the Law of Compensation now only applies to the penalties for lost games, otherwise you can set downright insane games for barely any prize.
addons.title: Simulated Games

objects.text:
Life's a game they say. You win some, you lose some. But for you, those sayings can be made more literal, and you're the moderator. You possess access to a special pocket dimension you can draw others into, both individually or just anyone within a 100m-radius, as well as set designated areas where anyone entering it is drawn in. The pocket-dimension itself is built around the concept of “Game Show”, with you as the host. The pocket-dimension is capable of simple transformation into different types of terrain and climate as well as rearranging materials brought into it, but anything complex or elaborate you must procure yourself. You can use other powers in conjunction with and across the entire dimension, whether it be to set the stage, run the games, or serve as the prize.

You can set rules and tasks that anyone inside the dimension must follow, though you can set different rules for the specific roles. The specifics of the game are up to you and can range from the tameness of shows like Who Wants To Be A Millionaire or The Price Is Right over the unpredictable and often humiliating madness that are Japanese Game Shows, all the way to death games like you'd see in Deadman Wonderland or Squid Game. You can choose to replicate an existing or fictional show, tweak it, or come up with your own.

Anyone else inside the dimension will be assigned a role of either audience, contestant, or assistant generally at your leisure, though assistants must consent to their role.

Contestants are those that must actually participate in the game you've arranged, either by themselves or in teams, competing against you or each other depending on the setup.

Audience members are usually restricted to a pure observatory role and cannot interfere, though depending on the rules of the game they can participate in restricted ways as for example advisors or even bargaining chips to be bet in certain competitive games by their candidate.

Assistants in contrast serve on your side, whether that's just as window-dressing, demonstrating tasks and games, or even serving as obstacles in the games themselves.

Prizes can be anything from tangible things like money or objects like cars, furniture, and property, to less tangible and abstract things like information, healing, or even copies of any skill or power you possess. You can only offer prizes that you actually possess, and acquiring them is your responsibility. They will typically go to the victorious candidate or candidates, though depending on the setup they can also be partially or even completely distributed to the audience-members.

Both the severity of the stakes of the game as well as how elaborate and difficult they can be are restricted by the value of the prize placed as a reward for winning it. Something's value as a prize always depends on its value to the contestant, so to someone with cancer healing would be extremely valuable while to a fit and healthy person in their twenties it'd be worth little.
Things like their lives or their freedom can only offered as prizes if they were absent or threatened prior to entry into the pocket dimension. Money and powers generally have near universally agreed value, though some exceptions always exist.

You can decrease the size of the required final prize by giving out smaller sub-prizes in earlier portions of the “show” or by making it easier for contestants to win, for example by giving them Jokers they can use to skip games or make victory easier.

While the prize must be at least proportional to the stakes and the difficulty of the games, nothing stops you from inflating the value of a prize, so you could give someone a million dollars for winning a game of twister if you have the money and choose to do so.

Additionally, you as the moderator can set penalties for lost games or rule violations, which can range from partial reductions or complete withdrawal of the prize, over penalty games or being ejected from the pocket-dimension, to even death in high-stake games, as well as other things such as temporary or even permanent loss of powers should you possess other abilities that can inflict such. The severity of the penalty you can inflict is tied to both the value of the prize as well as, in the case of a rule violation, to the severity of the infraction committed.

There are however restrictions to your power, five unbreakable laws that you operate under.

1. Law of Victory. First and simplest, there has to be a victory condition, both for individual games as well as the “show” as a whole, either a set number of games that must be played, a specific threshold that must be reached, or simply a set amount of time that must pass. You cannot keep anyone within the dimension indefinitely.

2. Law of Transparency. You must explain the rules of the game, how it'll work, what the victory conditions, stakes and rewards are, and what is forbidden. You can leave “surprises” that make games more challenging or entertaining out of the explanation, but they can't contradict or void previously established rules.

3. Law of Consistency. You can't change the rules mid-game. Different games can have different rules, but once a game has begun the rules are set in stone. Similarly you can't alter any established stakes for the overall “show” once established by, for example, turning what you introduced as a faithful reproduction of Family Feud into a game where the losing team is killed mid-game.

4. Law of Compensation. It's a game, therefore there has to be a prize that corresponds to the challenge the contestants face, meaning you can't reward someone for winning a death game with a box of tissues. The reward must be at least proportional to the effort required by and risks to the candidate, though it can exceed them. 

5. Law of Fairness. All games must be winnable for any candidate participating in them, if participants compete with each other neither side can have an unfair advantage, and once the game has begun you cannot directly interfere with them beyond what your role as moderator requires. Any loophole or oversight in the rules a contestant finds, while correctable in future games, is resolved in the contestant's favor unless doing so would disadvantage competing contestants.

Whether you choose to use this power to set up horrific death games, save lives by evacuating the population of cities under attack by Endbringers into a nice, safe game of Wheel of Fortune, or simply dole out wondrous prizes to deserving souls or random strangers is up to you.

Let the Games begin.
objects.title: I Want To Play A Game

objects.text:
You have the unnatural power to draw strength from and manifest things that were forgotten, be it from an individual, society, or history.

This manifests in a variety of different forms. If you know magic, you may gain knowledge and cast ancient spells that even the oldest wizards have lost to the passage of time, ranging from ones that could bind gods, to sealing away or releasing apocalyptic threats, for example.

You can bring back objects, reenact events or concepts that have been removed from general consciousness or erased from the world: a powerful artifact, a superstition, creatures from folklore whose history has been lost to the whims of eternity and even natural disasters.

As a side effect, you have the ability to access the memories of others, allowing you to access forgotten memories, continuously remove yourself from the memories of others for espionage, and make yourself "forgotten" to gain power.

You will gain an instinctive mastery and knowledge over anything you manifest with this power so as not to immediately hurt yourself with whatever esoteric effect you create, and any being you bring forth will be loyal to you. Just be careful, as perhaps some things are best left forgotten.
objects.title: Whispers of Time Forgotten

objects.text:
You know that myth where you can 'pay off' sleep debt by just getting more sleep later on, when that's not actually how it works long term? Well for you this is literal, and not just for sleep either.

You can now consciously choose to add something to your debt. This can be anything that affects your body, such as the need to sleep, eat food, heal, and other such things. By doing this, you instantly gain the benefits of having done so. This means you'll feel well rested, no longer be hungry, be completely recovered from your injuries, etc. This can allow you to work, fight, or do anything for longer than you should be able to, but it won't work on other people or things, so you can't add 'win this fight' or 'build a treehouse' to your debt to instantly accomplish those tasks.

There are three downsides to doing this. The first is that you must be physically capable of doing something yourself with at most purely mundane assistance to benefit from adding it to your debt. For example, if you get injured and wish to heal from it, you must actually be capable of recovering from the injury in question, so if you get decapitated you won't be healed unless you can regenerate from it, but you could recover from a venomous snake bite since modern medicine and therefore antivenom exists.

The second downside is that you must eventually 'pay off' the debt in question within the week or else you will instantly have the benefits removed, with the same kind of debt stacking, so if you don't sleep for a week you will instantly feel a week's worth of exhaustion and sleep deprivation hit all at once. You are allowed to pay it off in increments, so long as it is fully paid off after one week.

While you can pay your debt by simply performing the actions you skipped later on, this puts an upper limit on what you can get away with, as while sleeping for 16 hours may pay off a day of no sleep or eating a big meal to pay off a skipped lunch may be simple, paying off other forms of debt such as recovering from being stabbed are much more difficult if you have no access to supernatural healing since a doctor can't stitch up a wound that isn't currently present.

The third downside is you must consciously choose to use this ability. You can't recover from being knocked unconscious since you can't trigger this power, but you could recover from the injuries that knocked you out when you wake up.

Choosing to pay off the debt will have any downsides from doing so lowered to an extent. If you sleep for over a day to pay off several days of missed sleep, you will not wake up with bed sores or a stiff back unless 8 hours or less of sleep would cause that, nor will you experience starvation or incontinence during the process, but you will still be hungry and need to use the restroom afterwards. Similarly, you could eat a truly massive meal to pay off several days without food and not be in danger of overeating or feeling bloated, but you will still have to deal with proportionally longer trips to the bathroom later as a result.
objects.title: Sleep Debt

addons.text:
How curious… your extraordinary fortune has had a very welcome effect on your donkeys; now your loyal companions can accompany you safe and sound throughout your adventure!

They are not invincible, nor does it eliminate danger, but in risky situations, luck leans in their favor, preventing them from taking serious damage and allowing them to come out mostly unscathed (maybe with a few scratches, nothing serious), even in the most dangerous moments.

But the good luck doesn’t stop there: when you really need it, your donkeys can appear carrying whatever you happen to need at that moment. For example, if you need to cook but don’t have the ingredients, one might arrive with everything required in its saddlebag; or if someone needs medical attention, it could appear with a first-aid kit ready to help.

Keep in mind, however, that they will always bring mundane items—don’t expect one to show up carrying a magical sword or anything like that.
addons.title: A Donkey’s Luck

addons.text:
Have you ever heard stories about carrier pigeons, or seen in a movie how wizards and witches use owls to communicate or deliver packages? Well… now you can do exactly the same thing, but with donkeys!

Whenever you need to send something to a friend —whether it’s a letter, a package, or even a gift to brighten their day— a donkey will appear, ready and equipped with sturdy saddlebags containing a pocket dimension, capable of holding any package you want to send.

The truly magical part is that you don’t need to know where your friends are: somehow, the donkeys always know —don’t ask how— and they will simply reach them to deliver the message without fail.

Likewise, you don’t have to worry about their safety, as the courier donkeys always reach their destination without taking any damage, no matter what dangers they face along the way, and they return to you with news from your friends.

Just keep in mind that the farther away your friends are, the longer the donkeys may take to reach them; however, they will always succeed. So if you have a friend who’s an astronaut on the Moon, it’s best for them to prepare to see a rocket arriving and a donkey in a space suit stepping out to deliver a letter.
addons.title: Friendonkey Couriers

addons.text:
Whenever someone close to you—whether friends or family—is emotionally distressed or in minor danger, one or more donkeys will appear to accompany them.

Thanks to their gentle, calm, and patient nature, donkeys help foster emotional connection, self-esteem, and relaxation through simple interactions such as brushing, walking, or physical contact, acting as effective therapy animals for your loved ones whenever they need it.

Among the main benefits of Donkey Therapy are emotional ones, as they help reduce stress, anxiety, and depression while improving overall mood; psychological ones, as they foster self-esteem, confidence, and responsibility through caring for and guiding the animal; and physical ones, as they can support motor rehabilitation, coordination, and balance.

Additionally, although they are not suited for direct combat, they will instinctively remain by the side of those in need, offering comfort, reassurance, and a gentle sense of safety until things improve; after all, your loved ones are just as important to the donkeys as you are to them.​
addons.title: Donkey Therapy

addons.text:
Whenever you need an extra pair of hands while caring for children, a donkey nanny will appear to lend a hoof.

These female donkeys are expert mothers and caregivers with years of childcare experience. Whenever you're overwhelmed or simply can't be in two places at once, a donkey nanny will step in to help.

Need someone to watch the baby while you prepare dinner? A donkey nanny will happily keep them safe, entertained, and content until you're finished. Has a child lost their favorite teddy bear at the park and you can't leave what you're doing to retrieve it? Don't worry—a donkey nanny will fetch it for them, return it with a reassuring nuzzle, and spend time playing with the child until you're available again.

In addition to their experience, donkey nannies possess a powerful "maternal aura." Children naturally find it difficult to misbehave in their presence, regardless of species, size, or temperament. Is a giant cyclops toddler throwing a tantrum powerful enough to shake the walls? The supervising donkey nanny will tap her hooves against the ground to get their attention and deliver the unmistakable Look of Disappointed Motherhood. More often than not, the child will settle down and remember their manners.

As an added bonus, any child who spends enough time under a donkey nanny's care will develop a deep fondness for donkeys, often counting them among their favorite animals. The feeling is usually mutual, as donkeys tend to show unusual affection toward the children they help raise.
addons.title: Donkey Nannies
Donkey Life Line
addons.text:
The primordial life elixir flowing through your veins has begun to affect the donkeys that follow you.

They receive a blessing originating from your Fons Vitae, causing the life force that permeates your existence to gently flow into them, granting them extraordinary health, vitality, and resilience.

Thanks to this blessing, they become extremely difficult to kill by conventional means: wounds that should be serious close with remarkable speed, diseases are driven from their bodies, exhaustion fades far sooner than would naturally be possible, and they even live for many decades longer than would normally be expected of their species, retaining their health, vitality, and vigor throughout all that time.

But more importantly, they can share part of this blessing with others… through a lick.

A simple lick from one of your donkeys can greatly accelerate recovery from wounds, exhaustion, and illness. The effect is nowhere near as powerful as that of pure Fons Vitae, but it is more than enough to accelerate the recovery of someone who has been seriously injured, restore the strength of someone who has been pushed beyond their limits, or help someone recover from an illness much faster than would naturally be possible.

Of course, there is a certain amount of dignity lost when the miraculous cure consists of having a donkey lick your face.

But if it works, it works.

addons.title: Combat-Ready Donkeys
addons.text:
It seems that your bond with donkeys is deeper than anyone could have imagined, as even after they have passed from this life, they continue to love you.

The Donkey’s Jawbone seems to be proof of this, as it reacts especially strongly to you and seeks to protect you whenever you are in danger, causing a small portion of its power to manifest through any donkeys that come to your aid, granting them the strength they need to better protect you.

That said, it is important to clarify that, rather than responding to a numerical disadvantage as it does with you, the magnitude of the increase to their strength, speed, and durability will depend on the severity of the danger they face. For example, a group of donkeys facing an enemy vastly more powerful than themselves can become a surprisingly formidable force, allowing them to stand against opponents who would normally be completely beyond their capabilities.

However, just like the effects of the jawbone on you, these enhancements are only temporary and will last as long as the danger persists; so once it has passed, the effects will disappear and the donkeys will gradually return to their normal state.

It is also important to keep in mind that, because the jawbone’s power is being shared with creatures other than its wielder, it may suffer small fractures due to periods of instability whenever its power is repeatedly pushed to its limits.

Fortunately, these fractures are not permanent, as given enough time, the Donkey’s Jawbone will slowly repair itself and recover from any damage caused by the instability of its power, allowing these cracks to eventually disappear and the jawbone to return to perfect condition.

objects.text:
For reasons that neither gods nor spirits can explain, donkeys feel an unusual affinity toward you; they do not merely follow you everywhere, but in random and surprisingly fortunate ways, there are always donkeys nearby whenever you need them.

Are you tired of walking? A donkey will appear from around a corner and stand by your side, ready to carry you; are you asleep and an enemy attempts to attack you while you rest? A donkey will appear behind them and bray with all its strength, frightening them away and alerting you to the danger; are you alone in a difficult moment and in need of company? A donkey will be there for you, of that you can be certain.

Of course, you cannot control them directly, and their help is still guided by their own nature; even so, their loyalty and protective instincts mean that you are rarely alone and that, with them around, you are often far better protected than you might expect.
objects.title: Beloved of the… Donkeys?!

objects.text:
You have been blessed with an incredible rapport with a chosen concept. This connection is imprinted onto your very being, granting you a wide range of benefits.

When you are in environments strongly associated with your concept, you gain an all-around boost to your capabilities. All aspects of your performance are tripled, and you are able to traverse and interact with that environment far more easily than others.

Creatures and beings connected to your concept will also treat you more favorably than they would someone without an Imprint. Hostile entities become less aggressive, while ordinary people feel less inclined to view you as an outsider and instead regard you as something closer to distant kin.

Even in situations where your concept is involved, circumstances tend to shift subtly in your favor. For example, if your concept is Water, water-based powers or attacks will deal reduced damage to you and will be more difficult to land, as they seem to instinctively avoid you.

Your concept also grants you an intuitive understanding of itself, as if it is constantly whispering knowledge to you. You learn related subjects, techniques, and secrets at four times the normal rate, and your application of this knowledge appears prodigious. If you choose Swords, for instance, swordsmanship, blade-based magic, and even the crafting and design of swords will come naturally to you. Any discipline associated with your concept becomes significantly easier to master.

Finally, this power grants you two minor abilities, each at the strength of 6SP. These abilities are unique to you, meaning that even if another individual selects the same concept, their abilities will differ from your own.
objects.title: Conceptual Imprint

objects.text:
Your eyes have been cursed with the ability to see the future in a limited manner. You are able to see the final state of things, viewing everything in two states simultaneously: as they are and as they will be.

Gazing at two people having a heated discussion might result in you seeing several knife wounds and blood seeping through them. Seeing a sheet of paper with questions might result in reading the answers already filled in.

This is limited to your line of sight only, but applies to anything, be it objects, people, locations, and much more. You cannot see minor changes, only changes to what would be considered the 'norm'; thus, the change has to be drastic.

Most visions are short-term consequences. Impactful, terrible events, however, may trigger abrupt and foretelling visions several years into the future with perfect clarity, such as seeing a flooded city after the inauguration of a dam, or an impact crater after an announcement on television.

You may also use this sight on yourself, such as looking at a mirror during a high-stakes situation, allowing you to see wounds that will form on your body.

The changes seen by this sight are absolute truths, with the only blind spot being yourself, thus allowing you the free will to act in a manner to avoid terrible outcomes, although some futures cannot be avoided, only endured.
objects.title: Eschatological Sight

objects.text:
You wield dominion over Causality—the fundamental principle that governs why anything happens at all. Where others see actions and results, you perceive the invisible chains that bind them, the conditions that allow them, and the outcomes they inevitably produce. Every event exists as part of a structured relationship: cause leading to effect, condition leading to resolution, possibility collapsing into reality. These relationships are not abstract to you. They are tangible, visible, and manipulable, appearing as layered chains, branching paths, conditional triggers, and converging outcomes that span every moment and interaction.

At a glance, you understand how events are linked. You can see what must occur for something to happen, what outcomes are competing to manifest, and which results are stable or fragile. You perceive probabilities not as numbers but as weighted outcomes, each pressing against reality with differing force. You recognize dependencies, sequences, and hidden conditions, allowing you to identify the exact point where a chain may be altered, redirected, or severed entirely.

You may manipulate causality directly. Causes can be removed, preventing their effects from ever manifesting. Effects can be rewritten, replaced, or redirected, allowing outcomes to resolve differently than they should. You may impose conditions upon reality itself, defining rules such as success, failure, immunity, or inevitability, so long as they are anchored to a causal structure. You can sever connections between actions and results, nullifying attacks, negating processes, or collapsing abilities before they resolve. You may also retroactively alter causation, changing why something occurred without rewriting time itself, allowing events to remain while their origins are replaced.

This authority extends to external application. You may bestow causal properties onto objects, actions, or phenomena, embedding outcomes directly into them. A weapon may be defined to always wound, an attack to always strike, a defense to always hold. These are not enhancements, but enforced results, bound into the causal chain of the action itself. Conditional effects may also be imposed, allowing outcomes to trigger only when specific criteria are met, effectively rewriting the logic by which interactions resolve.

At lower levels, your influence is limited to individual events or short chains, requiring focus and precision. Larger systems, complex interactions, or heavily reinforced outcomes resist alteration, demanding greater effort to influence. As your mastery grows, your control expands from isolated manipulations to layered chains, allowing you to influence multiple outcomes simultaneously, enforce cascading results, and reshape entire sequences of events with increasing ease.

Causality resists distortion. Significant alterations generate strain, producing instability, unintended outcomes, or redirected consequences as reality attempts to preserve coherence. The greater the deviation from established outcomes, the greater the resistance and potential backlash. However, as your dominion deepens, this resistance diminishes. At full mastery, causality no longer opposes you. Backlash ceases entirely, and all chains, conditions, and outcomes exist solely as expressions of your will.

To others, the world is governed by rules. To you, those rules are negotiable. Every action, every result, every possibility exists within a system you can read, alter, and ultimately command. You do not simply influence events. You decide why they happen—and what they become.
objects.title: Causality

objects.text:
You can target anyone within ten meters of you and nullify any extranormal powers they possess by cutting them off from the source of their powers. This can be used on any number of people within range of you, during which time they cannot use their abilities. 

Should someone whose powers have been nullified be further than 50m of you, all their abilities will cease to be nullified and instantly return regardless of whether you have re-activated them. It should be noted that this means that they’ll be returned to a normal human baseline from any powers they had, which varies in practicality depending on their mundane skill and ability.

This ability can be selectively toggled to affect only certain people in your area.
objects.title: Power Nullification

objects.text:
The world is not silent to you. It breathes, listens, and remembers. Beneath every step lies a steady heartbeat, and within every current, flame, and gust of wind, there is a voice waiting to be heard. Nature is not a collection of forces, but a living presence—vast, ancient, and aware. And you are the one it chooses to speak with.

You are the Bard of Nature. Where others command or control, you converse. The elements are alive, each with its own temperament, and they answer you because they recognize you as one of their own. Wind shifts between play and storm, earth endures yet yields, fire burns with warmth or fury, and water flows between calm and wrath. You understand them instinctively, and they respond in kind, not as tools, but as willing voices answering yours.

Your voice shapes their response. Words, tone, and rhythm turn intent into action. A quiet phrase can still the air or draw mist across the land, while a rising song can call storms or set the world into motion. You may guide one force or weave several together, layering your voice so wind, water, earth, and fire act in concert, each reinforcing the other. Lightning answers through storm, ice through cold, and magma through the shifting earth. You do not create these things—you call, and the world answers in the form your voice gives it.

You are not bound to song alone. The elements speak freely and often act with a thought or a word. Wind may carry distant voices or warn of danger before it arrives. Earth steadies your footing and shifts in subtle guidance. Water alters its flow, and fire dims or flares in acknowledgment. Your song refines this connection, but it never falls silent, and the world is never beyond your reach.

This recognition extends to all living things. Plants lean toward you, growing where you walk. With your voice, growth takes form—roots weave, branches bend, and living structures rise, shaped rather than built, unfolding with purpose as they form. Animals do not fear you unless you wish it. Predators pause, prey does not flee, and when you call, they come. You guide rather than compel, and groups move in quiet harmony with your intent, acting as participants in a shared motion rather than puppets under control.

Nature shelters you. As one favored by the living world, you are protected wherever its influence can reach. Wind diverts harm, the ground softens your fall, and water supports rather than drowns. Fire warms but does not consume, cold cannot take hold, and lightning bends away or dissipates before it can strike you. Hunger and thirst fade as the world provides through its own abundance. This protection is not absolute, but constant, a quiet force that shifts the world to lessen harm wherever it can.

Around you, the world settles into alignment. Winds soften, the ground steadies, and life gathers or disperses in subtle patterns. Where you remain, this deepens into a natural sanctuary, a place more responsive, more alive, and quietly protective. The longer you stay, the more the environment adjusts to you, becoming an extension of the same will that answers your voice.

All that you call remains natural. Storms gather, fog forms, rivers rise, and flames spread as they would, guided by your voice. Your power grows with harmony. What begins as a call becomes a chorus, and what begins as influence becomes presence, until there is no divide between your voice and the world’s response.

You are not a master of nature. You are its voice, its listener, and its chosen child. When you speak, it hears. When you sing, it answers.
objects.title: Nature's Bard

objects.text: If you can choose to be a dragon, always be a dragon. The concept of Dragon fills you... and fills you... and fills you some more and oh dear, now look at what you've done. You've dragon'd so hard you're now dragoning all over the place. All the benefits of being a dragon imbue every single part of your being—increased strength, toughness, power, the works—and then spread further. The concept of Dragon becoming imbued in everything you come into contact with for long enough. Your clothes? A dragon. Your castle? A dragon. Your land? Dragon. Your weapons? Dragon. Your friends and lovers? Yup. Dragons. Pets? Dragons. Your toilet? Also a dragon. Most of what this 'Dragoning' grants is potential, but there is a notable immediate boost. Things and beings become stronger and more durable, straight up. They also gain increased potency for whatever energy they have, and if they have the ability to store some type of energy, then their reserves greatly expand. Basically, they get all the benefits of conceptually becoming a Dragon can grant, with the slight potential to gain sentience and-or the ability to turn into an actual dragon and back at will. Plus, abilities common to dragons become easier to achieve, with the more common abilities—breath and flight—taking just a bit of effort to develop the basics of. As a caveat, this does make everything close to you vulnerable to anti-dragon magics and such, but that's not much of a downside. After all, you're all dragons. As another caveat, this can also potentially affect your enemies too if you keep them around long enough in your basement or something, so be careful of that. Side note: You are a minor eldritch reality infection. Those guarding against such things may not react well to you.
objects.title: Dragon Dragon Dragon!

objects.text:
You can form bonds with people, by building up favorability by talking or showering them with gifts. You slowly build up a meter which ranges from 0 to 100. This meter represents their favor towards you and increases and decreases based on how well you can talk or how thoughtful the gift is.

It’s also a good idea to build favorability from holiday events, which gives ample opportunity to build favorability. Finally, once favorability reaches up to a certain point you will get a mysterious event in your heart similar to a beating heart.

After that, you can propose to the person to establish a partnership. Once the person agrees you get to see a unique special CG of you both together and take them as a partner. This is the most logical and practical process to gain favorability.
objects.title: Magical Girl’s Event CG

objects.text:
For any power system you possess, you become a living, walking wound, a black hole that breaks down and absorbs all outside influences originating from that system.

As a result of this condition, you become immune to any outside effects that are reliant on some type of energy you possess. The spells break down, never reaching you; telekinetic control slips and disappears in your vicinity; and even more esoteric manipulations have no effect on you. You can allow some beings and effects to be immune from this.

This does not detrimentally affect your powers, and you can even remove any negative consequences of wielding any system by having them be absorbed into the wound. Moreover, you can use this void to reroute the absorbed energy to replenish your own reserves or shed excess energy instead. However, once the energy is completely broken down, it vanishes entirely, beyond even your reach.
objects.title: Living Wound

addons.title: Vessels
addons.text: Instead of creating normal puppets, you are now able to create Vessels. These specialized puppet bodies are not powered by a core or your mana, but rather by being possessed/imbued with one of your Beings. This offers several benefits: Firstly; the weight and strain caused by manifesting a Being is greatly reduced if they are possessing a vessel. Secondly; Vessels are far stronger and more durable compared to ordinary puppets of similar make, becoming warped and reinforced by the Being which possesses them. Thirdly; all of the Being's innate capabilities are still usable while they possess a vessel and potentially even strengthened depending on the initial make, material and synergy. However this does come with a downside. Beings who possess a vessel are extraordinarily hard to separate from said vessel without destroying both—the vessel permanently, and the Being until it regenerates from your Nothing—with you having to endure the expected and full backlash of the Being's death. Practically this means any Beings that are infused into a vessel become permanent summons until destroyed.

objects.text: The world arose from chaos. But chaos? Chaos arose from Nothing. Within your existence lies a hole. One with no geometry. No space. No time. A Nothing. Not gaping. Not hungry. Not swelling or physical or noticeable... but undeniably present. With effort and a peculiar brand of madness, you have learned to reach in and turn infinitesimal fractions of the Nothing within into life and Beings. The first step is to select a seed. A Concept such as motion, fire, water, other elements, places, or things. Then, the seed must be nurtured with an Expression. Such as attack, defence, support, or more specific variants such as block, strike, accumulate, or heal. Then, with both Concept and Expression, you must push it towards a Form. One of two. Beast or Item. The former is active. Animant. Beasts will take input and direction from you, but their choices and decisions are their own. The latter, Items, are passive. Thinking and aware, but will rarely act without prompting and command. Both types of Being have wills of their own, but are ultimately loyal to you and will work to attempt to fulfill your desires. This is not necessarily completely to your benefit, as their minds and perceptions can be strange and alien. Their appearances themselves are variable within their types, and oft eldritch and unnatural. With time and practice, you can learn to dictate and modify the appearances your Beings take. At any point after creating a Being in and from your Nothing, you may Manifest it nearby. How strong the being is is determined by your will, but each Manifestation strains and burdens your mind, soul, and existence. The stronger the Being, the more you are burdened by the weight of their link to you. Too much, too many, and your soul and mind will fray and warp and crack, potentially scarring or becoming permanently injured. But with careful practice and training, you grow your resilience and existential fortitude, thereby allowing you to handle greater and more numerous Beings. Those you Manifest can be pulled back into your Nothing, where they do not burden you as extensively. Be careful, as you can never rid yourself entirely of a Being once created, and you cannot unmake them. Some Beings may resist being desummoned, or even try to claw their way out of your Nothing, to your own detriment. Further, if a Being is destroyed while Manifested you will face backlash to your soul and mind. The more powerful the being, the worse the backlash of their destruction. Any Being destroyed this way will be reborn over time from your Nothing. At the start you can handle simultaneously Manifesting two street-level Beings, each with a single Concept and Expression. Eventually, you can learn and train yourself to create Beings with multiple concepts and/or expressions, Manifest stronger Beings, and Manifest more Beings at once. Be careful you do not create and manifest something beyond your control and ability, lest the consequences shatter you entirely.
objects.title: Eldritch Wellspring

addons.title: The Overview Effect
addons.text: You have spent so much time gazing upward in search of answers; have you tried looking inward or at your fellow man as well? It seems your experience with the Grasp of Eternity has taught you not only to gaze outward at the big picture but also at the small things, the realization that everything is intrinsically connected to everything else; this, in turn, leads to the crystallization of a unique form of discernment within you. You are able to see the threads that bind everything together, be it fate, causality, the unseen, or love; you can see how different things are related, why they happened the way they did, their unity, and what these connections long to become. As you gaze inward, you see your faults, your virtues, and why you do the things you do, as well as what paths would lead you astray and what steps would elevate you; you have the aggregated wisdom and experience of all versions of yourself: the quiet and the ordinary, the irredeemable and the exalted. You know what makes you, you.
