Gazing outward, you can grasp someone's core nature in a manner indescribable in words: the way they see the world, why they matter, their interconnections with others, the pivotal choices approaching them, and the branching paths of their potential futures and what-if scenarios. You can choose to impart the insight and memories of one of their alternate selves, giving them a new outlook and the clarity to change their life for the better. This development has a strong interaction with your personality; you may find yourself leaning toward more peaceful solutions to problems, perhaps speaking in a bedside manner or simply being more patient, kinder. Regardless, you will still be yourself, with older and wiser eyes. It has been said that astronomy is a humbling and character-building experience [...] To me, it underscores our responsibility to deal more kindly with one another, and to preserve and cherish the pale blue dot, the only home we've ever known

objects.text: You may form a bridge between a single mind and the collective unconsciousness of the entire multiverse. Upon physical contact, the subject's mind is instantly ripped from their linear perception of time and space. They won't just "see" the history of existence; they experience every single and overwhelming bit of information and emotion involved in the span of one second of regular time, akin to an ephemeral cosmic awareness. The vision encompasses every beginning and every end. They will witness the white-hot static of the Big Bang, the rhythmic cooling of the galaxies, the messy tapestries of trillions of alien civilizations, and all timelines, like ever-expanding branches of an infinite tree. A mother's love for her child. A father's pride in his son. The last breath of a long, well-lived life, the first gasp of a new one. All infinite variations of oneself in all realities. All failures and triumphs, all the love they ever gave and received, everything they could be and never could be. The end of all things. Everything, Everywhere, All at Once. This effect is capable of stunning any being, even those with only a spark of sentience. While it won't permanently damage their minds, as most cannot comprehend—let alone remember—everything, it will change the person's way of living, leading them to reflect upon themselves and their existence, as the soul doesn't forget that momentary brilliance. If you choose, you can nudge the types of things the target may remember about their experience. You can use this on yourself, although you might want to sit down first.
objects.title: The Grasp of Eternity

addons.text: Drafted luxin can be used to make Chromons. Additionally, Chromons can be made of multiple colors. The main benefit of this is that Chromon inherit the properties of the luxin used to create them, allowing for the creation of a red luxin Chromon made of a flammable gel akin to napalm. These traits are inherent and not considered as powers.
addons.title: Drafted Chromon

addons.text: When creating a Chromon, you can Awaken them using any amount of breaths. Using Awakening on Chromons in this way is much more effective than otherwise. You may also use Chromons as an incredibly potent fuel for Awakening. Draining a Chromon changes their color and by extension their powerset, to that of a gray Chromon, or white if you’re at the tenth heightening.
addons.title: Awakened Chromon

objects.text:
​You can drain colors nearby and use them to create monsters called Chromons. Chromons can be made from pigment or light and have abilities reflective of which color and medium was used to make them. Chromons made with pigment have more physical abilities while those made from light tend to have more esoteric abilities such as thinker and master powers. Chromons can only be made of a single color.

A red pigment Chromon might be physically powerful while a red light Chromon might have the ability to induce passion or aggression in others. A chromons strength and size is dependent on the vibrancy and quantity of the color used in it’s creation, with a chromon made from 10 sq meters of solid color having powers roughly equivalent to 10 SP. Black pigment and White light are the most efficient and valuable colors of their respective medium, enough that using only these two would be enough that you could make 1.5x as many Chromons as you would normally be able.

Chromons last indefinitely unless destroyed, which would require an amount of damage done to them that would be lethal for a brute of comparable strength. Upon destruction, the color used in their creation bleeds back into the world, depending on which medium was used this could result in random splotches of color on objects or a sudden explosion of colored light. These can be used to create more Chromons.

Creating Chromons takes energy, of which you have enough to make roughly several dozen Chromons with powers equivalent to 10 SP. the sensation.
objects.title: Chromon Creation

objects.text:
It’s said that, regardless of your actions, on average 10% of people will support you, 10% will hate you, and the remaining 80% will remain indifferent or undecided. But with this, you’re getting anything but the average.

Instead of only 10% of people always supporting you, you now have 80% ready to support you, while 10% remain indifferent or undecided. You now have the people on your side.

Trying to get elected to office? Now it’s as easy as a walk in the park. Want to get a message out to the world? It’ll go viral in no time. An indiscretion in your personal life? You’re only human, and it’s really no one’s business but yours. Have a public identity but want some privacy? Suddenly, people have the decency to leave you be.

Even when you perform actions that are outright illegal, you can count on the people to grant you the benefit of the doubt. Perhaps a ploy to infiltrate an enemy organization? A dastardly villain holding innocent lives hostage without the people knowing? You’ll never be convicted in the court of public opinion without the chance to tell your side of the story.

This power doesn’t prevent you from having enemies, nor does it prevent you from creating enemies if you give people a reason. It simply starts you off on the right foot when it comes to public relations—and keeps you there. Without a deliberate and concerted effort to alienate the people, you’ll still have your supporters. Even when the whole world’s against you… well, the people love a redemption story, so you’ll be able to climb back into their good graces with minimal effort if you wish.
objects.title: Beloved by the People

objects.text:
You possess the ability to deploy a Domain, a region denoted as the inside of an arbitrarily large and complex shape which is defined by forming and moving coordinates at a point in space, which connect to each other to form the outside of the shape. This allows you to form both 2D and 3D shapes for greater versatility.

Creating and maintaining coordinates requires mental focus, with each coordinate requiring more focus than the last. This puts a soft cap on the complexity of shapes you can produce unless you have some way to increase your ability to focus on multiple things. 

Within your Domain you can reject pretty much any existence or phenomena; reject the passage of something to form a shield, reject the existence of it to harm, or even reject causality to undo a wound. Rejecting something also takes mental focus, scaling with what and how much you’re rejecting; a small two dimension plane of rejection to block physical attacks is much less straining than enclosing a building in a Domain and rejecting that it ever existed.
objects.title: Rejection

objects.text:
You have the power to summon three golf ball sized geometric cores. Each core can sink into an inanimate object or material and convert it into an empowered tool based on the object’s original function or conceptual weight and the type of core implanted into it. Each core has up to 5SP, which it uses to grant the transformed item an ability. The exact ability is somewhat random, but it is always influenced by the object’s function, nature, and intended use.

Implanting a core takes only a couple of seconds, but the object requires a full minute to shift into its empowered form. Once a core is implanted, the object’s durability increases. If the transformed item is damaged badly enough, the core inside it will crack and disappear. Afterward, the user must wait a few minutes for the core to reform before it can be used again.

The first core, a crimson cube, is the Offensive Core. When implanted into an object, it shifts that object into a weapon or damaging tool that can harm enemies or damage the environment. For example, if the cube were implanted into a flashlight, the flashlight could become a light-based blade, its beam could gain destructive properties that ignite anything it shines on, or it could shift into a laser pistol with multiple subtle effects upon striking a target. The user can nudge what form the weapon takes, but the object cannot split into multiple forms. This core makes the implanted item twice as durable.

The second core, an emerald dodecahedron, is the Defensive Core. When implanted into an object, it shifts that object into a defensive structure, armament, or protective tool meant to guard the user or the surrounding environment. If this core were implanted into a tree, the tree could expand into a temporary fortification, with walls as durable as titanium and capable of regeneration. If implanted into a transformer, it could convert the object into a set of power armor that is highly resistant to electricity and electricity-based powers, while absorbing power to repair itself and heal you. This core makes the implanted item four times more durable.

The third core, an azure sphere, is the Utility Core. When implanted into an object or material, it shifts that object into a support item that provides some kind of practical benefit, such as healing, communication, mobility, purification, energy production, or general assistance. If implanted into a generator, it could become a mobile energy production unit. If placed into a flask, it could turn the flask into an item that purifies any liquid poured inside and makes it restorative. This core makes the implanted item three times more durable.

You are granted intuition and skill in using the newly transformed item the cores make. You will get better at using them the longer the core stays in an item.

Be advised: the cores cannot be placed into objects that already perform functions matching the core’s purpose. The Offensive Core cannot be placed into weapons, the Defensive Core cannot be placed into armor or shields, and the Utility Core cannot be placed into support tools such as med kits, phones, or similar utility items. You are also unable to place a core in something edible, no sandwich weapons.
objects.title: Tactic Cores

objects.text:
In the world of Muses and magic, Warlocks are supernatural servants of fae-like memetic deities known as Special Cases. They enter these pacts for every reason under the sun, but usually do so for the magical knowledge and prestige that comes with service to their chosen deity.

Regardless of whatever powers they manifest, all Warlocks have an enhanced physique and sixth sense that renders them mostly immune to mortal threats such as mundane martial arts and melee weapons, biological and chemical warfare, and mid-range ballistics available to a typical advanced civilization. They all possess a universal resistance to environmental hazards typically found on our Earth, and lack certain biological shortcomings such as aging, weakness to suffocation, dehydration, starvation, and waste management. This even extends to preventing mental degredation from a lack of sleep. 

You are now one of them, however you lack a connection to a Special Case, as such you do not receive the typical benefits like a built-in power system and infinite energy. Nonetheless, Warlocks are unkillable demigods to mundanes, to the point that a single one can destroy or subjugate a Kardashev Type 1 civilization within a human lifetime, lesser civilizations like ours not even requiring a single generation.
objects.title: Warlock Pact

objects.text:
Many dimensions and inhabited worlds have been lost to time, their population all but exterminated.

In the best case scenarios, intelligent life still exists on these post-apocalyptic worlds, clinging stubbornly to the dregs of their civilizations. Functional examples of high technology and esoteric secrets are still owned and utilized by sapient beings, and people may even gather together to form societies and try their best to rebuild.

But in the worst cases, the situation has turned irrecoverably hostile to life as we know it. Whether through cataclysmic stellar events, dimensional collision, eldritch invasion, the laws of nature changing beyond recognition or through causality itself becoming uncertain, these worlds or dimensions can no longer recover and support life on their own.

The danger of any of these lost worlds is immensely high, but the rewards can be just as high. These worlds are full of treasures of lost civilizations, exotic energies and metamaterials, and even simply materials and creatures that function in ways beyond regular reality. Even entropy has failed or reversed in some of the most dangerous of these worlds, creating samples for anyone researching negentropy.

With this power you can travel to these post-apocalyptic worlds and dimensions, and maybe make a difference. Or, in case all is truly lost, sterilize and start anew, or plunder what you can.

In order to travel to these lost worlds, you will be able to create permanent portals, the first time you open a portal to a new world the coordinates of the portal on one world will be the same on the other, or in special cases, the closest approximation, meaning if you were to open a portal multiple floors high in a building, the exit might be placed similarly on a building on the other world or in cases where no such structure exits, it will be placed on the ground level. Once a connection is established you may freely move the portal of the world you are currently in, for example, you may create a portal entrance in your own home, and once you are on the other side, move the exit elsewhere by closing and reopening it at the desired location.

Portal creation takes about a second of focus and only possible in your line of sight.

Connections to a lost world is randomised and you will have to explore and discover on your own what type of apocalypse or end of the world scenario happened to your connected world, but once a connection is made, you can open and close portals to that world freely. After the first connection, new connections take about a week of local time to establish.
objects.title: Lost Worlds

addons.text:
Enhanced by the great bevy of energy available to the Homo Superior, you’re embodying the great pteranodon hypnotist himself, Sauron!

Firstly, your energy vampirism has been enhanced, allowing you to absorb a portion of the powers anyone you drain may possess while you’re draining them. Should they die during this drain you’ll keep them at the level the original owner possessed.

Similarly, you possess the ability to enchant someone by locking eyes, spending some of your energy to hypnotise them. This can cause them to lose focus or even hallucinate scenarios temporarily.

Finally, should you absorb too much energy, your body will metamorphose and change into a man-pterodon capable of flying great distances and causing damage with your new claws. Luckily, you retain a second set of teeth behind your dinosaur-esc jaws allowing you to speak normally. With time you may be able to transform on command, but it will always require having a large amount of energy stored within you.
addons.title: “But I don’t want to cure cancer, I want to turn people into Dinosaurs”

addons.text:
Your thaumatic diet has enhanced your absorption. Not only can you now draw life-energies independently of touch, drawing it from your vicinity, but sense sources of it in your general area.

While this allows you to survive more efficiently off of magic, it also allows you to completely drain the magic from a target, leaving it (or them) a completely mundane husk. 

Your ability to sense ‘Life-energies’ therefore also applies to sources of magic, letting you identify magical items, places and even people incredibly easily.
addons.title: Thaumatic
Energy Vampire Lord
addons.text: You’ve become a true Energy Vampire. No longer restricted to blood, you can survive off of the energy drained from others just as well. Similarly, though you would need to use some of that captured energy to defend yourself from the sun, you can greatly weaken the effect the sun has on you.

objects.text:
You have the ability to drain life-energy from anyone you touch with your bare hands, storing it for later use. This ‘life-energy’ can be anything that explicitly sustains life be that magical, divine, or even necromantic depending on what they are. Touching someone for a few seconds is enough to drain them to the point of unconsciousness for a few minutes, with only a minute enough to kill them.

You can survive only off of the energy you absorb from your victims if necessary. Otherwise,this energy can be used to enhance any of your other abilities, from your strength to any power you possess.

Naturally, you have a minor ability to locate sources of ‘life energy’ within your vicinity for you to hone in on and feed.
objects.title: Energy Vampirism

objects.text:
Your speed and your capacity to affect the world around you are inversely related.

The faster you move, the weaker your influence on the world: your blows become unnoticeable, shoves won't budge objects and your voice barely stirs the air. At the limit, moving with the speed of thought, you become nearly incorporeal.

But you can also slow down. Moving hundreds of times slower than an ordinary person, you turn into a living hydraulic press: your durability, power and inertia grow in proportion to your slowness. Each step compresses asphalt, your grip crushes steel and your body withstands a direct tank shell. 

Switching speed is a free action, but it takes a second to accelerate or decelerate, during which you are as vulnerable as your current speed dictates.

Through training, you can improve both the switching time and the maximum distortion coefficient.
objects.title: Relative Velocity

objects.text:
You can take the equivalence of a step forward or backward in time. That is you can go backwards or forwards in time by up to 30 seconds.

You need only concentrate for a moment to travel through time. You are stepping through time not space.

Just like taking a step would this consumes minimal stamina to do. It takes about the same amount of stamina taking a single step would. 

For reference a person with average fitness can walk around 6000 steps without tiring.

You can use any supernatural resource you possess or stamina if you lack one to fuel this power.

Note that excessive use can lead to feelings of deja vu even in especially perceptive normals.
objects.title: Time Stepper

objects.text:
You have become a living crossroads that changes the lives of others.

From now on, the world will subtly arrange itself so that your path intersects with people standing at a crossroads who are struggling with something, whether it be physical, emotional, financial, romantic, or similar. You possess an uncanny instinct for timing; these circumstances repeatedly place you exactly where you need to be, neither too late to matter nor too early to understand what is happening. This effect becomes stronger whenever someone is in immediate danger or facing a life-altering crisis, such as arriving in time to prevent an idol from being fatally wounded in her apartment by a crazed fan, for example.

You will never be overwhelmed by these encounters as Fate limits them to what you can reasonably handle, while continuously guiding you toward those whose lives can still be saved by you.

A single glance will reveal their problems; you instinctively recognize when someone is struggling, even if they show no outward signs. As you focus on them, information unfolds naturally in your mind, such as their condition, the trauma they carry, the events that brought them here, the forces acting upon them, and the most effective solutions toward helping them. You can sort, organize, and review this knowledge effortlessly.

Additionally, others will find it difficult not to trust you. There's something about you that causes them to feel safe in your presence, making them become willing to listen and share their burden with you, causing trust to develop quickly and sincerely around you. Your words carry unusual weight; to people you've just met, your advice can hold the same importance as that of a trusted friend, and to friends, your guidance may carry the significance of a beloved mentor or parent.

Whenever you're actively trying to help someone, any attributes and abilities you possess that could meaningfully contribute to their rescue, recovery, or wellbeing begins to rise to meet the situation. If circumstances demand it, these enhancements may reach outright superhuman levels. So long as your goal is genuinely to help, you will rarely find yourself lacking the means to do so. However, these boosts will fade away after you manage to settle the issues, so don't expect to gain anything from them.

When you seek assistance from emergency services, authorities, medical professionals, or other support systems, things will work as they should. Bureaucratic failures, negligence, and absurd coincidences become dramatically less likely whenever they would obstruct a legitimate rescue effort. 

Likewise, justice becomes unusually reliable around your involvement. The guilty face consequences proportionate to their actions regardless of wealth, influence, status, or luck. The innocent are protected from undeserved punishment and blame. Once a matter is resolved, it stays resolved; retaliation, revenge, media harassment, and collateral fallout fail to take root around you or those connected to your intervention.

Furthermore, this ensures that every single good deed you've done will guarantee to make positive changes to the lives of people you have helped and will have more impact than it would otherwise, producing a positive cascade of effects that can continue long after your direct involvement has ended. A few coins given to someone in need may place them on the path toward proper support, treatment, stability, and a better future. This influence remains active throughout the year, though it grows especially potent during special holidays or celebrations.

Most importantly, those whose journeys you see through to completion won't fall back into despair. If you fully guide someone past the crisis that threatened to ruin their life, it can never truly claim them again. They cannot fall back into the same trap, nor become lost to another that serves the same role. They will remain free to make their own choices, but their future will never again collapse into tragedy.

This protection extends as far as necessary to secure that outcome. Friends, family, future partners, and other meaningful connections may benefit indirectly if doing so is required to preserve the person's chance at a stable or happy life. However, this only applies when the issue is completely resolved. If you abandon someone before their path to recovery truly reaches its end, it won't take hold.
objects.title: [Insert Names] Saves The Day

objects.text:
You have an uncanny ability to induce immense "Aura loss" in your opponents. Be they on a political stage, in a debate, or in a fight, your words and actions will always result in the maximal amount of humiliation, resulting in your opponents losing the respect of all who witness the events taking place, even should they previously have had fanatical loyalists ready to die at their command without question.

You can control whom this ability will target should you choose to preserve someone's dignity.
objects.title: Aura Loss

objects.text: By planting money in the ground and watering it daily, its value grows. This works over the course up to one week, requiring at least 24 hours to start working. The series of 1x, 2x, 2x, 2.5x, 2x, 2x, 2.5x results in an end-of-week net return of 100x whatever was grown. This watering does not hurt the currency, even if it ordinarily would. Once harvested, a piece of currency can no longer be nurtured further. All currency received from this is legal tender, even if it is a previously nonexistent denomination.
objects.title: Money Gardener

addons.title: Chatroom Section
addons.text:
Your Multiversal Console now possesses a new screen called "Multiversal Chats." This section allows you to create one-on-one conversations and group chats with the individuals in your Multiversal Contacts, letting you communicate with them through text, voice, video or 3D hologram from your floating, translucent screen, no matter where they are in the multiverse.

You have access to all the standard features associated with modern chat applications, including the ability to leave any group chat, block specific people from contacting you through this system, send files such as pictures and videos, and more. You can even enable an option that automatically alerts selected people in your contacts if you're in trouble (even if you're in a coma and unable to summon your database), sending them the coordinates of your current verse even if those coordinates would normally be hidden.

These features also apply to the multiversal chatgroup you've been accidentally added to.

addons.title: News Integration
addons.text:
Your Multiversal Console's "Multiversal News" screen has been upgraded to fully integrate with your Ask Blog.

Rather than simply displaying articles and discussion threads, the News screen now functions as a complete multiversal media hub. Every post you make on your Ask Blog can automatically be submitted to the Multiversal News network, where it may appear as a news article, documentary, travel log, interview, opinion piece, or trending discussion depending on its content. You may also choose to keep any post private, restrict its audience, or publish it exclusively to your Blog without it appearing in the News feed.

The News screen will also periodically recommend stories and worlds based on your interests, previous travels, Blog activity, and the people in your Multiversal Contacts. It can notify you whenever subjects you follow make headlines or whenever a major event occurs in a world contained within your Multiversal Database.

Finally, if you possess sufficient credibility within the multiversal community, your reports may be designated as Verified, causing your eyewitness accounts and investigative reports to receive greater visibility and trust. This status is earned through consistently accurate reporting and can just as easily be lost through deliberate misinformation or repeated negligence.

objects.text:
You now possess a quality-of-life-oriented console designed for multiversal travelers, in the form of a series of floating, translucent screens that you can summon individually or all at once. Admittedly, this power has very little use if you do not also possess a means of traveling across the multiverse.

The first screen is called "Multiversal Database" and contains a list of every world, universe, setting, or timeline you have ever visited (including your own original Earth homeworld), along with its multiversal coordinates, a brief two- or three-sentence description, and a short list of tags. It also features a search bar and numerous filters, allowing you to search for a specific verse by name, date of visit, duration of previous visits, description, tags, and more. 

If you possess a means of traveling across the multiverse, you can return to any verse in your database with the press of a button (you will be either sent to the last "safe" location you've been in this verse before leaving it or the most generic possible landing spot for this verse). When you encounter another individual with multiversal traveling abilities, you can share the coordinates of any verse in your database with them, allowing them to reach it too, as these coordinates will be automatically translated to any form of multiversal travel they use.

The second screen is called "Multiversal Contacts." With a brief physical contact, such as a handshake, you can add any individual to your contact list. Next to each contact's name, you can see which verse they are currently in, along with a short description of it and how long they've been there. This is particularly useful for keeping track of other planeswalkers and multiversal travelers you've met. With the press of a button, you can add their current verse to your Multiversal Database (You can decide to keep your current multiversal coordinates hidden to whoever also possesses a Multiversal Console). 

The third screen is called "Multiversal News." It features dozens of articles and discussion threads covering what's happening across the multiverse, such as the exploits of notorious planeswalkers, trending worlds and the hottest hubs for multiversal travelers, major multiversal events, worlds to avoid due to a particularily dangerous on-going crisis, the latest drama within the multiversal traveler community, and much more. The news feed can be refreshed to display additional stories and you can post your own articles. Any world mentioned can be added to your Multiversal Database for a future visit, while any individual mentioned can be sent an "Add to Contact List" request.

Note that you can decide at any moment to make your screens visible or invisible to others.
objects.title: Multiversal Console

objects.text:
You've become the greatest Hench(wo)man this world has ever known! 

From shaking down business, ordering your fellow mooks around, or getting down and dirty in a street fight, you've got all the skills to be the best of the best in the goonery business. And to make sure no regular Joe Schmoe thinks he can take ya, your body becomes tougher than steel and you can punch through walls.

In whatever evil organizations you join, you'll become a rising star of a Goon, quickly rising to a mid-level position and becoming your boss' most trusted minion to do all their most important dirty work. Don't worry, even if ya fail, your boss will be more lenient on you in comparison to your fellows, you'll get away with a slap on the wrist for most things as long as you tried your best.
objects.title: The Ultimate Goon

objects.text:
You can summon ten little guys. While not very bright (think a particularly smart crow) they are great at following simple tasks and excel at team work. They even have personalities, which you can decide beforehand or let them develop naturally.  

Physically, they can be any shape or form, so long they remain on the short side and the form doesn't bring any above-human advantage. Each one has distinct powers of your choice, in the range of 5SP.

You can dismiss them with a touch and summon them again at your side anytime, but if they are killed, imprisoned, displaced, or anything similar, you must wait 24h before summoning them again.
objects.title: Little Guys
Autonomous Reflection
objects.text:
Mirrors have long since been a source of superstition, with the reflection being viewed as an extension of the soul. For you, that's actually true. More than that, your reflection is a part of you that you can control the same way you can your regular body.

Your reflection can move freely through any reflective surface that shows your reflection and interact with everything else reflected inside it. You can select how each reflected interaction affects the real world, whether it's just an illusion happening entirely inside a mirror's surface, or if your reflection's actions influence the real world.

For example, if your reflection picks up a glass reflected in the mirror, the actual glass would float in the air, held in invisible hands to all who don't look in the mirror. It can also construct Tinkertech or handle volatile materials in this way. In a more offensive sense, your reflection can attack your enemies without you making a visible move, your reflection having all of your powers and skills, but cannot be damaged by an enemy or the environment. You can use its senses of sight, touch, and even taste in addition to your own, though due to its nature it is deaf and cannot smell. You have enhanced Multitasking allowing you to operate both your real body and your reflection at the same time.

That said, there are limitations to your reflection's power. First of all, you can only animate a single reflection, even if you are currently being reflected in multiple mirrors.

In the same vein, your animated reflection can move between reflective surfaces, but only those that you yourself are reflected in.

Your reflection is also tied to its medium. While it doesn't take damage if the mirror it resides in is destroyed, it can be disrupted and be left temporarily incapable of acting by intense light or darkness blotting out the mirror it's residing in. Similarly if said mirror is fogged up or covered, or if there is no mirror, your reflection is left helpless. If the reflective surface is too small or poorly angled, your reflection may find itself left with little to no room to actually operate in.

Finally, while you can see through the eyes of your reflection in addition to your own, your reflection's senses are restricted to the medium it resides inside, meaning that if it's not reflected in the mirror your reflection is occupying, it can't see it. Nor can it directly interact with anything not reflected, though indirect interactions by for example picking up a reflected object and throwing it at something out of frame, so to speak, is possible.

addons.title: Reflective Presence
addons.text:
You are no longer restricted to a single autonomous reflection, now each and every one of your reflections is now an extension of your self you can move at will. If you have multiple reflections at the moment, multiple of them can move into and act within the same mirror, though their total number is still restricted to how many reflections you should have at that particular moment, with the reflections immediately vanishing the moment you step out of a mirror's reflective field of view.

Your Multitasking now scales in accord to the number of your reflections, meaning you'll be able to move and coordinate all of them and use their senses without getting confused.

Additionally, while the senses of your reflections are still restricted to what is shown in their mirror, there is now one exception. They can look out of their reflection into the real world the same way one would look through a window and in this way see things not reflected in their mirror.

Finally, if any recording of you is reflected, the reflection also counts as a controllable extension of yours.

addons.title: Peter Pan’s Shadow
addons.text: Just like the reflection has often been viewed as an extension of the soul, so has the shadow. In fact, the Egyptians viewed the shadow, known to them as the Shuyet, to be one of the nine components that make up the human soul. And just like your reflection, now in your case your shadow is a genuine extension of your being. Your shadow can now fully separate from you and freely move across surfaces connected surfaces. Just like your reflection with other reflections, your shadow can interact with other shadows, which you can choose to have translate back to the object casting the shadow being interacted with. Despite its animated nature, your shadow is still a shadow, meaning it can be disrupted by bright lights fading it out as well as deep darkness swallowing it up, both rendering your shadow temporarily unable to act. There is also a certain amount of contrast required for your shadow to act, so in the twilight of a cloudy day where shadows become so faint they seem entirely absent your shadow cannot act. There are further limitations. First, your shadow cannot change its total surface area, meaning it is bound to the dimensions your shadow should be casting at any given moment, growing and shrinking automatically if distance or angle between you and the light source changes. Second, your shadow cannot change shape in ways you cannot physically cause unless you have Autonomous Shadow, meaning it only moves as a silhouette of yourself, bending only where your joints allow. Third, if you are casting multiple shadows, only one of them can be animated unless you have Reflective Presence. Fourth, should you have Shadow Show you can interact with the real world by treating borrowed shadows as extensions of yourself, however you cannot change the shape of an object or living creature merely by twisting its shadow, though restricting, moving or even damaging it by interacting with its shadow using those under your control remains possible.

objects.title: Accepting Darkness
objects.text: It's going to be okay. You have stared into the abyss. The infinite. Stepped within it. Looked around. Took it in. The vastness. The emptiness. Realized the objective truth; the endless universes have no goal, no point, nor purpose to give you. And you laughed with relief, the knowledge setting you Free as the dark became your home. You emerged, a piece of the abyss- the endless, the dark- interwoven with your very existence. A kind shadow of self cast on reality wherever you go, seeping into everywhere you are and everything you touch. Shadows deepen. Depth and detail grows. Reality around you becomes a little bigger. A little deeper. A little more mysterious. Your influence spreads. Beings gain clarity. Senses beyond fleshy form strengthen. Empathy. Understanding. Insight. Acceptance. Determination. Enlightenment. Communication eases. Will strengthens. Ignorance slips. Echo chambers quiet. Delusion dies. The world, life, becomes greater around you. Illness fades. Corruption starves. Hope grows. People become wiser. Kinder. Stronger. And maybe a little stranger, accepting their own and others' quirks. The mystical grows around you. Spirits find your presence and influence comfortable, and will subtly change to be more dark-aligned. Influenced people have an easier time developing supernatural abilities and growing beyond normal averages and limits. Beasts, flora, and minerals with esoteric and strange properties or abilities can appear and grow around you even in worlds where none exist, and in worlds where they do such things may grow stronger and more varied. Cooperation blooms, yet independence remains. Self awareness comes easier to your people, as does understanding others. People influenced by you will firmly stand up for themselves, their dreams, their beliefs, their communities and those they care for. Those who have felt your darkness are inherently Free, and will instinctively fight to retain such. No missionary or conqueror will find your people easily swayed, their lies and hypocrisies seen through and rejected. Swindlers and scammers will find no purchase, and slavers and rapists will find only violence against them. There's so much more beauty to this world than what lays in the surface you can see- you just have to feel for it.

objects.title: Invention Projection
objects.text:
You can summon a projection of any device, artefact, mechanism, etc. that you know how to create.

The projections are permanent, existing until you—consciously and with a bit of concentration—dismiss them, or until they are destroyed. They are completely undistinguishable from and retain full functionality of the real thing. When damaged, projections can be repaired instantly with but a thought, or you can grant them permission to repair themselves. This also grants the projections unlimited and ever-replenishing ammunition.

You maintain continuous telepathic and technopathic control over all your projections, regardless of distance, even in another dimensions and universes. Your multitasking capability rises with each projection summoned for the express purpose of controlling each of them individually.

addons.title: Living Projections
addons.text:
Your ability to summon projections now extends to include any and all living beings you know how to create.

As with regular projections, you maintain continuous telepathic contact, allowing you to remotely control them. You can also grant your projections customised personalities of your choice.

Each projection may come with any knowledge or skill that you possess embedded in its mind.

objects.title: Something Born to Kill You
objects.text: You've gained the power to summon a single, entirely unique monster, whose sole purpose is to hunt and kill one designated target. What makes this monster so special is that it's created specifically for its target. The more information you possess about the target, the more powerful and specialized the resulting monster becomes. Things like the target's abilities, weaknesses, physiology, habits, defenses, history, methods of combat and more are valid. Your monster may develop physical traits, supernatural abilities, resistances, senses, weapons, or other adaptations specifically suited to defeating its target. For example, if the target possesses a form of immortality, the monster might develop an ability specifically capable of bypassing that immortality. If the target relies upon regeneration, the monster could develop methods of preventing or overwhelming it. If the target possesses a particular weakness, the monster will instinctively exploit it. However, this power has several limitations. Attempting to summon a new monster will immediately end the existence of the previous one, causing it to shatter like glass before its remains fade away. The monster's appearance and abilities are also permanently fixed upon creation; if you don't like the results, you have to dismiss and summon it again. The monster's effectiveness is also dependent upon the accuracy and completeness of the information provided during its summon. If your knowledge is incomplete, inaccurate, or based on false assumptions, the resulting monster may be poorly suited to its opponent. Finally, this monster takes several seconds to summon, where it'll grotesquely emerge from your shadow (or a portal that appears near you if you don't have one), and getting attacked while you're summoning it would result in your monster being forced back into non-existence and a lengthy cooldown of approximately 24 hours. You won't have this cooldown if you dismiss it, which you can only do after your monster has completely manifested. On the bright side, it requires no hand signs, incantations, or other rituals; you can summon your monster at will, regardless of your location. With enough time and training, the abovementioned limitations will eventually disappear.

objects.title: Generic Pulp Hero
objects.text:
Like Flash Gordon, The Phantom, or any number of pulp heroes of old, you have a foundational base competence that can never be dulled.

No matter what you try, you always possess a foundational base competence. From swordfighting, to spacecraft piloting, to scientific learning and more. While this would likely not be enough to overcome a specialist, your breadth of skills, even in a ‘workmanlike’ capacity makes you a highly versatile threat with a solid base on which to grow more specific skills.

As your adventures continue and you find yourself gravitating to a certain ‘niche’ you’ll find your skills growing to compensate, with you becoming notably more talented within this margin. For instance, if you find yourself becoming an explorer of forgotten ruins and antiquities you’d find you have a talent for skills like trap detection and archeology, while a space-age swashbuckler would find themselves better suited to 0g flight and swordplay.

Additionally, you're in peak physical condition, and will always quickly return to it after a nights rest and a good meal.

objects.title: Scales of You
objects.text:
You have gained the ability to disrupt conceptual balance, temporarily increasing any personal attribute - whether it be the speed of time flow, strength, or luck. However, the scales must be balanced, so after the boost expires, you will be weakened by the same magnitude for the same duration.

Initially, you cannot exceed a tenfold coefficient and one‑minute duration. During the cooldown, you cannot re‑apply the boost to the same attribute, but different attributes work independently of each other. You may also voluntarily decrease an attribute, first suffering a penalty in exchange for a boost that will be activated in time.

objects.title: Stargazer
objects.text: You are a Stargazer, a human who looked up at the stars and attempted to reach out to them with faith and hope, and in turn received a love greater than you've ever known. The firmaments have acknowledged your wish to see their beauty in its entirety and opened your eyes, receiving the favor and kindness of all the stars and astrophysical phenomena in the sky. Your gaze allows to instinctively know every piece of information and story from any celestial object regardless of distance, flawlessly allowing you to perceive the entire electromagnetic spectrum, gravitational waves, and even the mysterious and elusive dark matter/energy, You are provided with a mental map, roughly the diameter of the Cosmic Microwave Background, that provides you with images and the knowledge of every being or civilization within any star sector you pay attention to. This has fostered within you complete knowledge of navigation, planetary formation, physics, astronomy, astrobiology, and every other discipline related to the cosmos and its exploration. More importantly, you are able to talk directly with any celestial object, be it a specific one or simply referring to them all at once in the sky. You could ask for directions, or the location of a specific thing, and a constellation might point you toward it. Ask a star to spare its planets from its solar flares, for a planet to clear the skies a bit, or simply call for the firmaments to shine brightly so all citizens can see their full glory in broad daylight while you sing along. They are inclined to humor you most of the time if you politely ask but will refrain from doing anything destructive. Go, beloved child of the cosmos, those who gaze into the abyss not with dread but with wonder—the firmament answers in kind.

addons.title: Voyager's Blessings
addons.text: Houston, Tranquillity Base here. The Eagle has landed. It appears you have evolved, finally gaining the ability to physically journey to the distant stars you have long communed with from afar. In recognition of this milestone, the firmaments have chosen to smooth your travels among the heavens. The mental map within your mind and your phenomenal navigation skills allow you to flawlessly track your position within hyperspace relative to the physical universe, enabling you to chart complex routes bridging billions of light-years with dazzling precision. Furthermore, your heightened perceptions bridge the sensory void of traveling at near-light speeds, granting you the agility to maneuver fluidly rather than being locked into rigid, linear trajectories, as well as using it in rapid succession to dodge. You may request a celestial body to bend hyperspace with its mass, carving out a safe corridor that deposits you seamlessly into a planet's low orbit. Alternatively, you may enter hyperspace even in proximity to objects as massive as a black hole by asking them to dispel their gravitational influence on you. Thanks to these cosmic graces, the dreads of space travel—whether drifting blindly off course or emerging fatally within an event horizon—are a thing of the past.

addons.title: The Might of the Heavens
addons.text: Spacetime tells matter how to move; matter tells spacetime how to curve. You are familiar with it, and you know the truth of it despite how the human mind creates concepts like past, present, and future to make sense of it. Your unique connection to the astral bodies has guided your growth far past novice and closer to true mastery. Your awareness, shining through like the light of a thousand suns, has granted you complete mastery over the intrinsic dance between gravity and the spacetime medium. Your control is finely tuned and effortless. Physically grabbing spacetime to divert an attack, creating ever-expanding space within a few centimeters of your skin as a barrier, sending your consciousness hours into the past, or gazing into the future are all but trivial applications you know by now. Due to your sense of navigation, even the complications of traveling through parallel worlds and time-traveling are less of an unfathomable idea and closer to a basic right, your mind being capable of differentiating minute changes between timelines or detecting temporal alterations. If, however, you lacked the extra "oomph" before, now you would be capable of channeling the gravitational influence of all celestial objects within 1 AU in order to increase your influence over spacetime. A planet, for example, would allow you to stop time for an entire continent, while a supermassive black hole could see you rewind time within a range of several light-years. Should you truly be at your wit's end and cry out in desperation for the stars, they might answer back. The consequences of bearing the physical weight of the entire Cosmos are not to be taken lightly, so do be mindful.

objects.title: Everything has a Price
objects.text:
You now have the power—power to purchase... anything, really. As long as you can find the owner—or their closest representative—and provide the purchase price, a transaction can be made, and you can quite literally buy anything.

That nice bridge in Brooklyn, a rare spell or bloodline, a shiny throne or presidency, a house, a pet, a soul, a service—if you can define it, you can put a price on it. And if you can put a price on it, you can buy it.

However, this power does come with a drawback. Once you buy something, you’re responsible for it—maintaining it, paying taxes, utilities, supplies, and much more. Sometimes, it may not be worth it.

You also need to provide enough of whatever funds or currency are required to make the target willing to sell. For something owned by a group, you’ll need at least enough funds that the average person would consider it an acceptable trade.

Now, everything has a price.

addons.title: And Every Price, a Discount
addons.text: While you can't use money gained from such things as Golden One or Black Card for any purchases here, ownership of any such power or item will entitle you to a flat 50% discount on all purchases made via Everything has a Price.

objects.title: The Straight Man
objects.text:
Toons and Gag Characters, beings which bend reality to their whims for the sake of a joke. Amusing as they are, they are quite the annoying foes to deal with, turning whatever method of harm dealt to them into setup for just another punchline. Indeed, one would be forgiven in thinking them invincible. If it weren't for you, that is. You are an existence which denies Toons and Gag Characters their power. You are The Straight Man. 

You nullify Toon Force by your mere existence, any attempts to make a joke at your expense, to make you a punchline, will always fail. A pie thrown at your face will simply bounce off. A gun shot at a Toon will not just cover them in soot, it will wound them as if they were any other person.

This extends to not only everything around you, but also anything you have touched. Your weapons and technology will never backfire on you, and reality will not suddenly alter itself to suit the needs of a Toon. A painting of a tunnel will remain a painting, and Toons will not be able to pull items from nowhere or walk from "off screen" to teleport or evade death. 

Even Toons which rely on metaphysical fourth wall breaking comedy have their powers nullified by you. For all intents and purposes, whatever "fourth wall" they attempt to manipulate will simply not exist. Reality is reality, nothing more.

This power does not provide any other abilities other than the nullification of Toon Force and Gags, beneath it all you remain a perfectly mundane human being. So if you decided to say, confront Popeye and he wisens up to your power and fights you without comedic intent or his spinach, you are still fighting a trained, athletic sailor and will most likely lose.

objects.title: Champion Annointment
objects.text: You can annoint other willing sentient beings as your champions. Those champions can wield a portion of your own powers, perks, and other abilities as if they were their own. You can determine what subset of your abilities you want to bestow upon your champion. Do note, however, that your own abilities will be proportionately weakened while they are in use by the champion. The abilities you share will seamlessly merge with and mutually enhance your champion's own powers, producing a result greater than the mere sum of its parts. Your champions do not need to practice and develop skills to use your powers, as they can intuitively pull on your own mastery of the powers to achieve whatever effects and applications are possible for you. Optionally, the champions may get a new form, signifying your connection. This form is purely cosmetic—activating whenever they channel your powers—like glowing hair or new clothes, and will generally be in line with the theme of your powers, albeit you can tweak it more to your liking. You have a narrow but extremely potent form of telepathy for the express purpose of finding and selecting champions. You can cast a psychic ping into the multiverse to look for people that fit any criteria you desire. Afterwards, you can telepathically communicate with them to get them to agree to the position. You can establish conditions that they must abide by and goals they must follow, with breach of those conditions automatically stripping a champion of the power unless you permit it. This connection has no range limit and can be cast even if you are sealed in a pocket dimension or otherwise incapacitated, allowing you to gather help to free you, for example.

addons.title: Endless Champions
addons.text: Your own powers no longer weaken when you share them with your champions.

addons.title: Halls of Walhalla
addons.text:
Your champions now automatically become members of your legion, and vice versa. Additionally, you can pull any of your champions and legionnaires into a sort of mental 'meeting room', where you can converse as needed.

While you are inside this meeting room, time in the wider universe does not pass.

objects.title: Body Horror
objects.text:
With a touch, you can twist and reshape any living being into any shape and form you desire. The new form can be anything, from a mundane inorganic object to a horrific jumble of organs stuck inside a box. You can allow the target to retain its senses and even redistribute them across its new form; for example, you could allow the target to see, hear, and even taste through all of its transfigured surface, or concentrate those senses in one spot of your choosing. You can choose whether the target retains its consciousness or not as well.

The transfigured objects can last indefinitely and can be any size, ranging from having a volume of a small coin to about quintuple the size of what they had before transformation. You can also dismis the transfiguration at any time, returning the target to their original form.

This ability works on those weaker than yourself, either naturally or after they have been sufficiently weakened to the point where they cannot resist you.

You can also apply this power on yourself. Whatever form you take, you always remain fully conscious and can always return to your original one. By extension, this makes you totally immune to any unwanted body manipulations.

objects.title: No-Sell
objects.text: Between you and those weaker than you is an insurmountable wall that cannot be overcome with clever tricks or unorthodox powers. So long as you are stronger than someone, you can completely ignore any and all of their abilities, no matter how tricky or absolute they are. If you cannot be defeated without relying on a hax of sorts, then these hax will not work on you no matter what your opponent tries. An attack that never misses will miss, and an all-killing blow won't so much as scratch you.

objects.title: Energy Eater
objects.text:
You are able to absorb any kind of ambient energy from things that contain it in a passive or moderately active form — for example, ambient mana, wind, warm objects, or batteries. What you absorb can be converted into any type of energy available to you, even satiety, although the latter does not replace material for regeneration or growth.

In passive mode, this only works on contact with you and without violating thermodynamics - that is, it is impossible to absorb heat from an object colder than your body, or mana from someone who has less of it. Also, the absorption rate is not very high, so it would be dangerous for an ordinary person to stick their hands directly into a fire.

In active mode, you can invest your own energy into the process, increasing its speed and range - which does not guarantee obtaining more than you spent.

objects.title: Absolute Death
objects.text:
When you kill something, its death is absolute. It is unable to return in any way, shape, or form, unless you allow it.

The scope of what you can kill has also expanded. Slay a directly controlled clone, and you kill the original. Kill a lich, and its phylactery is destroyed. Kill a god’s avatar, and the god will also die.

Any consequences that may arise from killing entities that govern fundamental laws can optionally be ignored. Things will continue to operate as they normally would, as if those entities still existed.

You will be aware of any attempt to resurrect anything you have killed.

objects.title: Retinue
objects.text:
Each day you get five charges, which you can spend on creating a companion. One charge grants you a companion with capabilities equal to that of a peak human, and, unless designed otherwise, created companions will be biologically immortal and unageing. Each subsequent charge spent allows you to add various supernatural powers or skills, with the second charge being equal to around 5 SP power, adding one more SP taking 1 charge by itself, and each subsequent SP taking twice as many charges as the previous one.

You can fully customise the appearance and personality of your creations. It is enough to provide rough guidelines, and the power will fill in the blanks according to your desires. Created companions may possess whatever degree of autonomy you deign to grant them, from unthinking biorobots to unfailingly loyal but otherwise free to act as they please to complete freedom of action.

Once created, you cannot change the companion's appearance and personality, but you can still grant them new powers and improve or modify existing ones.

You can summon your created companions to your side at any time or desummon them at will, in which case they will discorporate and wait in a sort of dreamless sleep, with effectively no time passing for them between summons. Should any of them die, you can resurrect any of your companions by spending one charge.

Lastly, you now can create a template of any character, real or fictional, whether encountering them in person, seeing their photo, or reading about them in a book, etc. Using this template, you can instantly create a copy of them without having to design every detail yourself, although you are free to tweak any aspects to your preference. You will still need to pay the full cost of this companion in charges, as if you were creating them from scratch.

addons.title: Retroactive Insertion
addons.text: You can now create a false history for any members of your retinue. This will retroactively implant them into the world, creating all the necessary paper trails, even a family should you wish so.

objects.title: Forum Quest Communications
objects.text: "You have been contacted by the Consensus." What you have gained could either be deemed a blessing or a curse. You have gained access to the consensus, an interdimensional guide composed of many many voices, all of whom have the vested interest in helping you succeed. That is, if you can deal with some annoyance of needing to directly communicate with a legion of voices in your head. The uses of this is twofold. For one, this is great for heavily edited settings, where things diverged from canon so much that you end up with a world you don't fully understand anymore. Your Consensus has full knowledge on one timeline, a "canon" one as it were, as if the world you are in is already a story and you're the main character. This is akin to a limited form of Omniscience, as while the Consensus has knowledge of everything in your story, they don't have future knowledge on what may occur should you make decisions that diverges the timeline. So equal parts caution and aggression is still needded, especially as the Consensus may care for you... But they also wish to be entertained. Final thing to keep in mind is that this is primarily an information exchanging ability. You will still need to rely on your skills or other powers to support you. With this, we bid you adieu, and we hope you lend us a fruitful story.

objects.title: Pandora's Cubicle
objects.text:
Congratulations on getting your new job at Pandora's Storage! We will either provide you a basic apartment, or all equipment needed to setup work from home. From there, you will receive mundane items from various kinds of clients and must organize them for storage. However, said items have a magical twist that can and will conspire to send you on miniature adventures, or cause a few hiccups in your day.

Anything from lifting dumbells as a challenge, being dragged into a government conspiracy, participating in extreme sports, being sent to other dimensions, meeting deities, the works. You'll have some down to earth ones to balance them out, and are guaranteed to survive them. Most will even be wholesome in nature. 

The items themselves can range from anything appearing mundane to artifacts of myth. Each item has a special property or ability equivalent to a 1-5 SP power, or allow you to contact and/or summon any companions made through them. You're free to use the items sent to you. However, while unlosable and protected from damage, they are soulbound to the Cubicle, not you. Company policy. 

You will receive new items once every few days to weekly.

addons.title: Multiversal Clients
addons.text:
We've extended our reach for items from local to multiversal. You are now likely to receive more items throughout your weekly shifts, about one to two extra at minimum or three to five at maximum.

All previous policies and job expectations remain, but with a notable increase in the chaos of your mini-adventures.

addons.title: The Pandora Charm
addons.text:
Oh hey, you're just like Pandora! Right that can be confusing, you're just like Prime Pandora! Your mini-adventures tend to go exceptionally well even when they look like they might go south, especially with the numerous entities you can encounter. 

Like, hear me out, she accidently proposed to an outer goddess capable of smiting planets with a glare out of pure dumb coincidence from wearing her ring. Then there's the time she got the Sun Goddess, Ra flustered despite accidently offending her upon introduction. Got to call a mafia of demons to repair damage done to reality when playing with a demonic sword. Was even saved from getting killed by a ghost girl because she was playing her Nintendo Switch at the right time.

You'll also receive gifts and other offerings from various otherworldly beings as your reputation grows, or even proposals. Wink wink.

addons.title: Across the Pandora-verse
addons.text:
Every version of you in your Universe has signed up as an employee for Pandora's Storage, expanding your catalog of items beyond your wildest dreams.

For any kind of item you can think of, there's a version of you with a treasury of full of it in their own personal Cubicle across dimensions! As the original "You", you'll be tasked monthly to deliver and sort a set amount of items you collect towards your alternates. Mainly to save up space, or offload whatever you no longer need.

Feel free to visit your alternates and borrow whatever items you need at anytime.

objects.title: No Such Thing As A Free Meal
objects.text:
The world is a transactional place, and nowhere is this more true than with you. For every person you meet, an account for them opens within you. Whenever you do something for them, from something as small as holding open a door to things as grand as saving their lives or uplifting their family out of desperate poverty, an exact value of your service is calculated and added to their tab.

This calculation starts with a base-value of the act itself that will always cover its monetary value, with additional multipliers of at minimum 1.0 for how much it cost you and how much they value it. These addition can be lump-sums for a single concluded action such as covering a bill for someone, or produce continuous debt if it's an open action, such as keeping a potentially damaging secret. For continuous favors the trickle of debt is not constant either, but will increase massively if the person is in a situation where their secret being revealed would be catastrophic for them, and in turn ebb to practically nothing if the secret loses its value by for example being revealed in a different way.

This even includes involuntary actions, meaning that someone robbing you would accrue an immediate debt equal to the value of what they took, with additional debt being continuously generated for you not reporting them to the authorities.

Specifically excluded from debt accrual are services expected by profession or position, so long as it is a compensated arrangement. If you are working as a surgeon you will not generate debt from saving a life in the operating room, as that is your job, though volunteer work would work. In the same vein paying for a meal in a restaurant does not create debt, but leaving a tip does.

Also excluded are any acts forced upon someone against their will, meaning you can't just dump money on someone trying to refuse it and expect to generate debt, not even if they do end up accepting it under duress due to social pressure.

A single action can result in debt for multiple people so long as they benefit from it, for example covering a shift so that a colleague can spend Christmas with his family will put not just him, but also his family in your debt, but only those who you know attended. If you are not aware of someone benefiting from your actions, then they will not accrue debt for them. 

At any point, you can go up to a person and demand something of them whose value is equal or less to the debt recorded in their account, and they will oblige without question, both during the act and after. It doesn't matter what it is, lending you their car, lying to give you an alibi, commit murder, handing over their firstborn child, so long as they are physically capable of it and the value of what you're asking for does not exceed their debt, they will comply, with the corresponding amount being subtracted from their balance. You will always know how much what you intend to ask them is worth, with the value again being malleable depending on a multitude of factors such as whether it's a temporary or permanent demand and how much they value it.

It should be noted however that even without you asking for it, should someone decide to do something nice for you of their own volition their action's value is calculated and automatically subtracted from their debt, meaning that you should always check on your debts before making requests instead of relying on previous knowledge.

For every person, there is an upper limit, a specific amount that reflects the worth of the entirety of their being. Should their debt exceed this limit, you are at will able to trigger Total Bankruptcy, effectively liquidating their existence and permanently turning them into a thrall who will treat your wishes as their highest priority but otherwise act entirely natural, the perfect spy or sleeper agent.

You're always happy to help. The only question is, can they afford it?

addons.title: Loan Shark
addons.text:
The natural synergy between your two abilities focused around keeping track of what you are owed and collecting it has merged them into a cohesive whole. Both abilities now measure debt in the same units and share a single debtor-list.

Consequently you are now able to demand things in return for favors that were previously not eligible, such as skills or talents, while Skill Lender in return can draw from those whom you've never lent a Skill to.

Skill Lender's 10% compound interest every 10 days still applies to all of the combined accounts, meaning that even those who you've long since lost contact with may find themselves gradually moving towards Total Bankruptcy if they've still owed you anything.

On the flipside, it also means that those who you've lent skills to can now offset any debt exceeding the skill points they acquired using the skill simply by doing nice things for you instead of having their skills seized.

objects.title: Product Attack!!!
objects.text:
Pick a product, any product. That product now considerably boosts your charisma and persuasiveness, able to calm and trick almost any foe just by pitching it to them. This can range from throwing twinkies at a rampaging villain to calm them down, or bribing mooks with golden spongecakes to get them to release you. For some reason, it almost always works.

Of course, the effectiveness of this is based on if your target could even be feasibly interested in your chosen product. Obviously food is a no go for most robots for example. And some products like appliances could be annoying to carry around if you intend to choose that. Regardless, you may only choose one main product type like food, stationary, cleaning supplies, etc. And with this choice, gain a bit of a talent marketing your said product as well.

Now is that Endbringer hungry? Just grab them a snickers.

objects.title: Person of Interest
objects.text:
You can now mark any character in the universe as a person of interest, and fate will conspire in such a way that you will inevitably meet in such a way so as to make a favourable first impression, maybe you will be in a position to help them, for example. While you do not control how that meeting will play out, the situation will always be something you will be in a position to easily solve.

Additionally, instead of selecting a known character or person, you can set the power to direct your fate towards people who fit a set of criteria you select.

At the start, you can use it on one person at a time, and the time it takes for fate to arrange the meeting will vary based on various factors, including the positions of you and your target, your strengths and social statuses, etc. With practice, you will be able to extend this power to target multiple people at the same time, as well as allow for more expedient, even if less likely, meetings.

addons.title: Soulmate Magnet
addons.text: You can now designate any character you target as a potential Significant Other, and fate will not only conspire to have you meet them but also to arrange events so that your relationship rapidly progresses in the way you desire and as perfect as if they were the target of the A Significant Other from the start.

addons.title: Fated Meeting
addons.text: You can now control what manner of meeting will happen, as well as what kind of impression you will leave on your target. Do note, however, that while you can enforce even the most improbable meeting to happen, the more fate has to work to organise it, the more dangerous, potentially, may the circumstances of that meeting be.

objects.text: I have counted your atoms. Welcome Home. My Offspring, I have sent you here to guard my beloved humanity. Your universe is inside the mind of a higher entity, and then inside of another, and on and on creating a tree whose branches extend beyond time and space. I will give you a single Xenosphere, matter from my universe above yours, to do so. Allow it to alter your body, it will not harm you. By absorbing your first Xenosphere, you are made indestructible in this universe, nearly transcending it to enter the one above yours. However, you will need even more power to do your duties. As such you can fly at ‘Mach-8’ with ease and launch destructive blasts capable of destroying buildings and punching through the toughest armour with ease. In order to increase your power you will need to absorb more Xenospheres. These will allow you to connect to your ‘home’ with greater intensity. When absorbing them you can grow new abilities in an instant or channel it into one of your others enhancing it greatly. For example, a single Xenosphere might increase your flight from Mach 8 to one trillion times the speed of light, or grant you the ability to collapse entire worlds, or duplicate those same worlds with ease. There are fifteen Xenospheres in your universe (not counting the initial one you have been given). They are spread thin across many galaxies and under many different stars. While you must find them to grow, they are not protected from others, allowing their power to be harnessed, analysed or adapted for their own means. Your only advantage in this search is that they will call out to you, a vague chime reaching across the vastness of space allowing you to hone in on them one at a time.
objects.title: My Offspring (Megaton Rainfall)

objects.text: You can transmogrify equipment to make it look like another piece of equipment. While it doesn't provide any practical uses, it can drastically alter the appearance of things. You can even change weapons, but too differing of appearance might hamper proper usage of the weapon.
objects.title: Transmogrification (Diablo)

objects.text: You know how to Sing, Dance, and Play in order to revitalize allies and motivate them to continue. Skilled usage of these abilities can improve their offensive and defensive powers, and even allow them to surpass their limits and move further than they could normally.
objects.title: Sing, Play, and Dance (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
You have successfully performed a blood pact and now bear a special symbol somewhere on your body. Your bloodline has been blessed by the power of the Divine Dragon God, Naga.

The direct benefits offer to you include a 20% boost to your vitality, and a 40% boost to both your magical potency and resistance. The strong connection to your bloodline also confers a small, passive probability manipulation granting you a roughly 15% increase in ability to successfully make use of your other abilities and skills in combat.

Your mark of divinity grants you a special birthright to ascend and lead others; none can legitimately question your right to wear the crown. You find it easy to invoke the visage and imagery of notable or legendary members of your bloodline. The potency of your blood will never dilute, ensuring that your descendants will always bear the gifts you wish to pass on; by default your most versatile skills or abilities, or those you are known for, will be the ones passed on if you do not make the conscious decision.
objects.title: Brand of the Exalt (Fire Emblem)

objects.text: “He keeps kicking me in the dick. Why?! Why does he keep kicking me in the dick?!” You, my good friend, are Grade A fucking hilarious. You have the innate talent, wit, and comedic timing to have anyone’s stomach hurting from laughing so hard. You have the uncanny ability to effortlessly and seamlessly come up with and deliver absolutely hilarious and unforgettable one-liners that leave everyone in stitches. Not to mention the most subtle and perfectly executed callbacks that have never seemed to be out of place and have even the most stone-faced personalities unable to keep themselves from giving in. Not to mention the utter frustration and humiliation you can ensure on your enemies as you lead them round and round on the proverbial ego death trap that it is to cross words with you. A few simple words from you and you’d have an enemy obsessed with absorbing you and your powers saying something, that out of context, would have them seem to act like an obsessive ex, from whom bystanders may start to interact and offer relationship advice, etc, your enemy so perplexed and caught flat-footed that they don’t even think of using their mighty power to blast them and getting hilariously sidetracked for hours trying to both futilely defend and clarifying themselves.
objects.title: Abridged (Dragon Ball Z: Abridged)

objects.text:
You have mastered the Metamoran Fusion Technique, otherwise known as the Fusion Dance. When performed simultaneously with a willing partner, both of you will combine into a singular being of incredible power. 

In this state, the collective strength of both your powers, abilities, skills, and techniques are compounded and multiplied exponentially, in perfect synchronicity. To the point of breaking limits that neither of you could individually reach, even if you truly tried. From this, you can create new abilities and techniques based on the sum of your parts. The new being is considered its own entity, but will still feel like "you". The same goes for your partner.

You can only remain in this state for thirty minutes before being forcefully split apart into your original selves, and must take a cooldown period before you can attempt to perform the dance again. You don't need to fear burning out the timer for any reason, even as you summon all of your collective power.

While you have already mastered the dance, your chosen partner likely hasn't, which can cause unfavorable results over bending one lousy finger, or getting the angle wrong. Fortunately, anyone you choose as your partner will intuitively gain the same mastery of the dance as you, removing this possibly entirely.

Note: While you can fuse with anyone, the best results will come from partners with comparable strength or attributes to you. You can also teach others the Fusion Dance, quickly reaching the same mastery as you
objects.title: FU-SION-HA! (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You possess the power of Dream Mastery, which allows you to enter a meditative state and access the realm of lucid dreaming. Within this state, you are immersed in a distorted reflection of the world where you encounter hostile entities known as Nightmares. These Nightmares are Dream Eaters, feeding on the happy dreams of others and embodying their worst fears. By vanquishing these Nightmares in the dream realm, you alleviate the negative emotions and distress caused by nightmares, bringing comfort to those affected.
